title: Gasoline!! Seriously reeks of gasoline!
text: Opened the package & instant migraine. I cannot believe the stench.  I have purchased other packages that did not smell at all so I do not know if these were a damaged shipment or damaged during packaging or what, but the minute I opened the Amazon package I smelled it before I even opened the Terra Tattoos package. I couldn’t believe it. Then I find that the pink inks from the back have smeared all over the fronts of the tattoos. Yes, you eventually take the clear part off to apply the tattoo, but I always lay it down with the clear covering first to line it up & I didn’t want to risk the pink ink transferring to my art projects so it’s going back. I’ll update the review when Amazon sends my replacement. I’m upset because now my resin is here & I don’t have the tattoos to do my project, but I’m more mad about the fact that I have a massive migraine because of the gasoline fumes that lingered.  I believe they arrived a week ago, but I didn’t check the tattoos then as I didn’t have resin & the smell of gasoline is just as string toast when I opened them to check them as it was last week when I forgot to start the return. I’ve been sick or I would have done it already.  I really hope the replacement tattoos are okay.

I found it to be light, yet effective, and I can easily apply makeup after I use it. I love the way my skin feels after using daily for the past two weeks. Great presentation as well in the box and jar. Highly recommend as a good moisturizing cream!

title: Love this highly mositurizing night cream!
text: I have been looking for a good overnight moisturizing skin cream and I think I finally found it. This cream is thick and goes on smoothly (being quickly absorbed into the skin). There is no residue to stain my pillow cases or anything else. My 60-something skin in the morning feels amazingly hydrated, soft and plumper looking.  I am not thrilled with the scent (it is almost a mint or even a mild medicinal smell, like Vick's vapo rub) but it doesn't stay on the skin once absorbed. I highly recommend for anyone looking for a great overnight moisturizing cream.

title: Love this Lock N Shine gloss!
text: I love wet n wild lip glosses, have been using them for years. I like that I can make my lips as glossy as I want with the dual applicator. The color pink I received was a little too dark for me so I used it sparingly with a lot of gloss and it worked great. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great, reasonably priced, lip gloss. Lasts for hours, makes my lips feel soft and smooth.

title: Great for use between salon visits!
text: I have had red light therapy treatments from my skin salon for years now (as part of a facial or microderm treatment). My salon tech sings the praises of using red light therapy for boosting collagen and making your skin look and feel youthful. This is a great hand held device. Well made (quality) and so super easy to use. I have been using it for over a month now and it works really well. I think it's great that I can use this at home between salon visits to keep up with my beauty regimen. Highly recommend for all people who want to look their best and retain youthful skin.

title: Best facial serum I have used in years!
text: This is a wonderful daily facial serum. I have been using this exclusively for almost a month now. I love the way it makes my skin feel and look (younger, healthier and brighter). Very watery when it comes out (a little goes a long way), it is almost instantly absorbed into my skin. I use this as a base for all my regular daily moisturizes and my fine lines (especially the crows feet) are practically diminished. I am not sure, when I am done with this, whether I will reorder with this $200 price point. But this is a nice size bottle and should last another month or two so I have time to save up some money. Definitely highly recommend.

title: Best hair dryer I have ever used!
text: This is a really cool hairdryer. Never tried anything like this before. I will say, it was one of the fastest hair dries I have ever had and, now that I am used to it, not, sure I can go back to my old dryer. Really sleek, light weight, super quiet and maneuvers super easily. Only downside is the price (I don't think I would spend over $150 to get one of these in the future). But, I love it and highly recommend it if money is no object.

title: Great facial cleanser for multiple uses a day!
text: I live in Florida and I am very active. I wash my face multiple times a day to remove sweat and dirt (I love to play pickleball and tennis).  This is truly a gentle cleanser, my skin feels great after using and not dry at all. It lathers up nicely and my skin actually feels softer and moisturized after using. Highly recommend for all skin types (I have mixed oily and dry skin).

title: Salon quality for home use
text: I have owned several microneedling devices over the years, but I can say this is one of the best. Easy to use, easy to maneuver,easy to change out heads to customize the treatment. I love the way my skin feels a couple of days after treatment. I used to get this done in the salon years ago, but this Dr. Pen does the trick just as well. For the price of the device, I used to pay far more for a single treatment in the salon. Highly recommend for all people and all skin types.

title: Great toner for men!
text: My husband is not one of those guys who is considered a metrosexual male. If anything, he shies from using any skin treatments considers it kind of a feminine task. However, he really likes this toner. He has been using it now for well over a month and I can say he is using it daily. I love the clean fresh smell his skin has and I can see an improvement in his skin tone and it feels soft and smooth after shaving. He is now using this instead of an aftershave. I bought him a second bottle as a stocking stuffer at Christmas since he liked this so much. Highly recommend!

title: A lifesaver for aching tired feet
text: I have a job where I am on my feet most of the day. When I get home at night, I love using a good foot bath and this new one I just received is great. Multiple massage, jet and heat settings, I can soak my feet while watching TV for about an hour before going to bed. In the morning I wake up with my feet feeling amazing. This is my new favorite go-to device and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a cure for aching sore feet. This would also make a wonderful Christmas present for the special someone you love!

title: Great overnight cream!
text: I usually do not use a product which is classified as a 'night cream' mainly because when I have in the past, they tend to be super greasy/thick and I get the cream all over my pillow. This Odacite is really nice. It is light and absorbs quickly into my skin. I love the light floral fragrance. Having used this nightly for almost three weeks now, I can say I see a noticeable improvement in the dryness of my skin. It is supple and super smooth when I wake up int he morning. This cream is a bit expensive for me so unless the price drops a bit (it's over $100 now), I am not sure if I will be repurchasing. However, I can recommend it!

title: Who knew it could be this easy and quick?
text: I never tried at home waxing before. I was surprised how easy this was to use. I was able to easily do my legs and it was relatively painless. I heated up the wax and used it almost immediately. It was not super hot and it easily grasped the hair and removed it. I was able to cover it and reuse it again in a few days. This should save me a ton of money from salon visits. Highly recommend this wax warmer for anyone.

title: Powerful scrub
text: This is a nice scrub, super powerful. Great for my body and legs, but not so much my face (which is why I deducted a star). I really was hoping for a facial scrub, but the particles in this are too strong for my face. Other than that, great scrub. My legs and arms are super smooth after showering. Highly recommend as a scrub anywhere other than face.

title: Good for inbetween salon keratin treatments
text: I usually get keratin treatments 2-3 times a year. As they tend to be expensive and as I desperately need the treatment more often, I was looking for an in between alternative. For the money, this is actually pretty nice and works well. It is lightweight, absorbs quickly and is not greasy. Deducting a star due to the design set up of the tube (not real user friendly) but, outside of that, for the money this works really well.

title: I really like this collagen serum!
text: Really nice serum. I have been using this now almost exclusively for the last few weeks. It goes on easily and is absorbed quickly into my skin. Contains collagen and vitamin E which my aging skin really needs. I have noticed my skin looking plumper and brighter since using it. I will be buying more. Highly recommend!

title: Versatile razor set, works great!
text: Really nice men's razor set. Would make a great holiday gift. Can be used as a razor or as a trimmer. My husband tells me this is one of the nicest razors he has used. Close shave and maneuvers easily in his hands. Highly recommend!

title: Nice but overpriced facial serum
text: This is a nice facial serum. Goes on a little oily but quickly is absorbed into my skin. Smells nice but not overwhelming. I love the fact that it contains all the vitamins my 60 something skin craves. I don't see any noticeable improvement after using this for a little over two weeks now. If I notice a difference, I will update this review. I deducted a star because I think it is overpriced.

title: Best face wash on the market today!
text: I love Olay products and this face wash is no exception. It is gentle on my skin and does not dry it out. I use it morning and at night before I sleep, and then apply my nighttime retinol and moisturizing routine. I wake up refreshed looking and my skin is fully hydrated. I highly recommend this for anyone looking for a great facial wash (and best of all it's sulfate free)!

title: Amazing aloe gel for multiple uses!
text: Living in Florida, where the sun shines most of the time, I was looking for a great aloe vera gel to treat sunburn and overexposure. I also get microneedling occasionally from the dermatolgist and my skin burns. This aloe gel works great for both, my skin feels cool and pain is diminished. I love the lavender fragrance in this gel as well as it not only cools, refreshes and moisturizes my skin but also leaves my skin feeling and smelling great. Highly recommend!

title: Super nice set of soaps!
text: This is a great variety pack of soaps. I love all the fragrances and the fact that they don't dry my skin. I have been using two of the bars now for the past month and my skin feels and smells great. These also would make a great gift so I have already ordered a set for my sister who had commented she liked them as well. Highly recommend!

title: Not impressed at all
text: I go to the spa at least once to twice a month for either a facial or microdermabrasion. Doing this does end up costing me a couple of hundred dollars a month which, although this 60 something skin needs the treatments, is getting harder and harder to afford. I was excited to try this device at home. I honestly am not impressed with the quality. I did not get the same abrasion level that I get in the spa and the crystals are a terrible quality. What this device relies on is a strong vacuum and I found myself constantly trying to keep my face from being sucked in. Maybe it was me, or maybe it's because I am not used to trying to do this on my own skin, but it didn't work well for me.

title: Great way to keep your feet looking great!
text: I have suffered from rough skin on my feet for years (soles and balls of my feet). I typically go to a nail salon every two to three weeks but I honestly need some work sooner than that and it gets expensive. When I saw this, I really wanted to try it as a between salon gadget. This is great. Super easy to use and the vacuum picks up all of the dandar from my feet. I highly recommend to anyone who feels they need touch ups or in lieu of a salon visit.

title: Skin care is so important and microneedling is a must do!
text: I have been getting facials, microderms and microneedling for 15+ years now. I honestly feel that my skin (67 years young) looks better than it did when I was in my 30's. Spas can be expensive, so I was really looking for an easy to use at-home device and this Dr. Pen microneedle kit is it. I love the various attachments and I can make it as deep or as light as I see fit. I use a great serum to go with it and my skin is flawless. I have been using this every two weeks now and I can say my skin has never looked healthier and glowing (sure, the first day after the treatment it is a little red, but it goes down within 24 hours). Highly recommend to everyone!

title: Great laser hair removal!
text: Super easy to use laser hair removal. I love the cooling device, makes the device relatively painless. I used this on my legs for almost two months now and the hair is basically gone. I am usually helpless when it comes to figuring stuff like this out, but I found this device super easy to figure out and use. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a laser hair removal device. A tad pricey, but totally worth it.

title: Looked good, but adhesive is not good
text: I got these originally for a cruise I was taking in July. They came in a really cute box and I thought they would be just perfect for me. Well, once I figured out how to apply them, they just didn't stay on me. I mean, it was warm and humid in the Caribbean so I am assuming the glue they came with just doesn't work well (giving them the benefit of the doubt). They did look cute, but lasted less than an hour and I felt myself pushing the lashes to my eyes to be sure they didn't come off. I finally took them off and went back to mascara. Sorry, can't recommend.

title: Expensive, but ok
text: I was looking for a good night time retinol serum to use. I was hoping this would have been a better alternative. As a negative, the applicator pump is a negative. Several times it either didn't pump or, when it did, it sprayed sideways (landing either on my mirror or countertop). As a positive, the serum (which is an orangish color) does go on easy and is absorbed readily. My skin feels a little tacky after use, but I did see good results after using for a month now. I think for $70 you can do better.

title: Great microneedling pen for at home use!
text: I typically go for microderms and facials several times a month and it can add up money-wise. I have gotten microneedling facials done in the past and they typically run about $100-150 for a good one. I noticed that the last one I had received earlier this year, the spa tech was using a Dr. Pen. So, when I saw this, I wondered how easy it would be to try to do this myself. I was so surprised to see it was easy! In spite of the fact that it is a little uncomfortable with the deeper settings, I knew that I was going to see a noticeable improvement. After using this three times in the last two months, I can vouch for how great (and young) my skin looks. I do need to use some aloe vera after use (to keep the redness down). The results are just as good (if not better) than doing it in a spa setting. Highly recommend!

title: Powerful hair dryer!
text: I was in the market for a good traveling hair dryer for my trip to Italy this summer. I was totally afraid that I would be sacrificing power for size, but I opted to try this Lasrz model. FIrst, it's a great size and folds nicely to fit easily into my suitcase. Second, and most important, it's got great power settings. My hair was able to be dried just as well (or even better) than I get with my regular full size dryer. I love the way it fits in my hand and has great maneuverability. I am starting to use this now on a regular basis in my home. And I absolutely love this dryer. Highly recommend!

title: My new favorite way for eyeshadow!
text: This was the first time using an eyeshadow stick, so I wasn't sure if I would like it. I found it incredibly easy to use (I used for under my brow line for contouring purposes. I loved this champagne color and the glitter (not too much, just right for my use. Color was great, consistency was great and it lasted me all day at work. I just ordered an additional one for my eyelid coloring. Highly recommend!

title: Great moisturizer, not so much for making your lips fuller
text: This is a really nice moisturizer for my lips. I tend to worry about the regular skin on my face and not my lips. I could honestly feel the difference after using this daily in the softness of my lips. I am deducting a star because I didn't notice any 'plumping'. I do tend to have thinner lips, but there was no difference. Also, for the price, I think you could do much better in purchasing a lip moisturizer.

title: Nice overnight moisturizing cream with noticeable results
text: I wasn't sure if I should try this as there was no internal seal for the product, but I did anyway (I figure that must be how they manufacture this since others have mentioned it). I have been using it nightly now for a good month. I do see a nice difference in my skin: plumper, more radiant and the crows feet under my eyes seem diminished. I can recommend this as a really nice overnight moisturizing cream with retinal. I wish it did have an internal seal, would definitely have made me feel safer.

title: Almost salon quality
text: I get facials/microderms at least once a month. Usually, as part of the spa visit, a light peel is included as part of my visit. I found these pads easy to use. I don't feel quite the strong tingling I get at the spa, but I feel a light tingle. I am using these between visits (once a week) and I have noticed my skin looking younger and fresher. Highly recommend for at home use!

title: Good hair removal device
text: This is a good (not great) hair removal device. Super easy to use (instructions are clear), the device is simple to maneuver. I have been using it for well over a month by now and I still see some hair growth, so not sure how great it works compared to another device which I had used a few months ago on my legs. I can recommend, but not fully, depends on your hair growth and what part of your body you are using it (in my case, underarms).

title: Great shaver for women!
text: This is a great shaver/trimmer for the most delicate of areas. I am super impressed how easy this was to use. Fits well in my hand (ergonomic), maneuvers easily. Closest of shaves, no knicking, no razor stubble afterwards, just perfect. Highly recommend!

title: Great facial moisturizer!
text: This is a really nice facial moisturizer. Goes on thick and luxurious and is readily absorbed into my skin. Having used this almost exclusively for over a month now, I honestly can say I see a noticeable improvement in my skin. It feels super soft and hydrated and the skin under my eyes appears plumper and less saggy. Highly recommend for all skin types.

title: Great serum for every day use!
text: This Hyla3D™ Face Serum Hylaruonic Acid is a great serum. I have been using serums for over 10 years now, every morning after I shower and I have definitely seen a noticeable improvement. This complex is great and contains all you need to combat aging and fine lines. It goes on easily and absorbs readily to give your skin what you need. Highly recommend for all skin types.

title: One of my favorite moisturizers, ever!
text: I love this Michael Marcus moisturizer. I use it every morning after I shower and at night before I go to bed. It applies thick and rich and will absorb fairly quickly. After using for over a month now, I can honestly say my skin is softer, fine lines are diminished and it is noticeably healthier looking. I am 67 and my skin needs a good rich moisturizer and this definitely is what I needed. Highly recommend!

title: Easy to use and really works!
text: As I had just been using another device for the past few weeks, I had my sister try this one. She really loved it. She, like me, has rather light hair and sometimes it is difficult to remove since it's so fine. She said this device is super easy to use, maneuvers easily in her hands. She has been using it once a week on her legs and she said all of her hair is currently not growing back. She highly recommends this for all women.

title: Great device, really works!
text: I had never tried a laser hair remover and I have to say I just love it!! I have been using this device for over a month now and the hair on my legs is all but gone. I have to admit I was a bit skeptical thinking I could only get results like this if I went to a professional salon, but I was greatly mistaken. This is super easy to use, I use it twice a week and the results are amazing. Highly recommend for everyone, I will save a ton on razors!

title: Really great hair clippers!
text: This is an amazing clipper set. It comes with every attachment you will need. My son has relatively thick and longish hair and a light beard. He is able to use this easily to keep his hair trimmed between salon visits. He told me this is easy to maneuver and the attachments change easily. I can see a major improvement in his appearance since he started using this. Comes in a nice box, too, great for gift giving (think Father's Day). Highly recommend for the man you love in your life!

title: Great quality sulfate free shampoo!
text: Really nice, sulfate free shampoo. I love the fragrance (lavender and vanilla) and the way it smooths my hair. It contains aloe, argan oil, shea butter and jojoba, so it is great for my hair as well. I typically get keratin treaments several times a year to help defrizz my hair and this sulfate free shampoo is a great way to maintain between treatments. Highly recommend!

title: Great for traveling or any time!
text: This was perfect for my most recent 4 day cruise. It contains a facial wash, an exfoliator and a moisturizing cream, everything I needed to keep my regular beauty regimen going while I was away from home. Perfect to pack and use, really nice moisturizer, too. Kept my skin looking optimal! I will be buying another set as I will be doing an extended trip to visit with family in July. Highly recommend!!

title: Great shampoo and conditioner!
text: This is a really nice moisturizing shampoo and conditioner. I love the coconut fragrance, reminds me of being in the Caribbean and summertime. A little goes a long way with this shampoo, so this should last me for a couple of months. My hair stays frizz free and is soft and smooth. Highly recommend for men and women who are looking for a new moisturizing shampoo and conditioner set.

title: Great for my upper lip and brows!
text: I have been spending money for years in nail salons for eyebrow and upper lip waxing, so I have been looking for an alternative. I was thrilled when I saw this Michael Todd trimmer. I love the way it works. Super easy to use and set up. It really cleans my upper lip peach fuzz, fits well in my hand and it is totally pain free. It also works really well on my eyebrows. I highly recommend this tool to save money and get salon results at home.

title: Great compact hair dryer that packs a punch!
text: Nice travel hair dryer. It is small, but super powerful. I love it's size and the fact that I can easily take it with me when I need to travel. It has multiple heat and strength levels for optimum drying. It also fits well in my hands and it is easy (and light) to maneuver. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a new hair dryer.

title: Great facial brush!
text: This NewDermo cleansing brush is great. I use it daily each morning in the shower along with my favorite facial scrub and my skin feels incredibly smooth and clean after use. This brush holds a charge for quite a long time (I have been using it daily for almost 3 weeks now and haven't had to recharge it yet). I highly recommend this device to all people with all skin types. It's so important to take care of your skin and this NewDermo brush is a great way to start!

title: In love with a safety razor!
text: This is a really nice safety razor. To be honest, it's been years since I have used one of these (I typically use disposables) and I was really surprised at the close shave I received. My legs were totally soft and smooth and it seemed to me that the shave lasted me longer than the shaves I had with the disposables. This is a unique razor and felt really good in my hands (ergonomic) and allowed me to easily shave. Also, changing blades was easy. I think I am now hooked on this one. Highly recommend!

title: I love this gift set!!!!
text: I love this lavender gift set!!! It has everything you need for a great at-home spa experience. The lavender scent is light, but definitely there and my bathroom had a great fragrance. My favorite was the body scrub (which I would love to get more of). It comes in a nice wrap and is perfect as a gift from children for teachers or other women in their lives. This would great around the holidays for gift giving (especially with the current 40% off coupon). The little basket it comes in also makes a nice way to organize countertop products. Highly recommend!

title: Nice rich moisturizer
text: This is a rich moisturizing cream which comes in a small (1.69 oz jar). It goes on lightly, smooths easily and is absorbed quickly into my skin. I do like the fragrance, somewhat fruity, but I would honestly prefer it in a light orangy scent (simply because of the vitamin C content). I am deducting a star as I have used over the counter products (like Oil of Olay) that works just as well at less than 1/2 the cost. This is my first time using an M. Asam product and I was very impressed. My skin does feel softer and smoother after using for almost 3 weeks now. I do recommend the product, just wish it was in the $20 range.

title: The best collagen boosting treatment on the market!!
text: This Doctor Babor product is absolutely amazing! It goes on super lightly and is absorbed quickly into my skin. I recently used this with my microneedling machine as a serum and my skin looks healthier and younger than it has in years. My crow's feet have been greatly diminished and my cheeks just are radiant. This price is typically out of my price range, so I am using it sparingly, but I do have all intentions of purchasing another because of how my skin looks. I highly recommend this collagen boosting treatment for everyone!

title: Great straightener for all hair types!
text: This is a great flat iron. I have been using irons for many years now as I love to keep my naturally wavy hair as a straightening mechanism. This Hot Tools iron is really nice. It feels well in my hand, is relatively light weight and is easy to maneuver all around my hair. And my hair looks so smooth and shiny! The iron heats up quickly and evenly and makes my hair styling go relatively fast. I also love the white and gold design, looks great on my bathroom counter. Highly recommend!

title: Great at home microneedling pen for almost professional results!
text: I have had microneedling done in the salon several times. It is typically a semi-painful experience but the results are well worth it. However, it is expensive (typically $125+). When I saw this at home kit, I really wanted to try it. I will say that it is pretty comparable to what I get in the salon. I have used this twice in the last month. Not that easy, for me anyway, to do this on my own face. I have a tendency to 'take it easy' on the areas that I think may be sensitive, so I did not concentrate on all the areas the same. I used some great serum here as the base and my skin did feel amazing after use. I did convince a girlfriend to try this tonight, figure it might be easier if we each do it on each other's face. Other than my not being able to do it to myself properly, I highly recommend this microneedling pen.

title: This is a terrific eyebrow pencil!!
text: I have dirty blonde hair and I am a woman in her 60's with ever more thinning/graying brows. I typically go for eyebrow tinting every two to three weeks to try to mask the gray. It honestly looks great for about a week and then the gray begins to reappear. I have been looking for a good eyebrow pencil that can help me and typical pencil type ones just don't seem to do the trick. This is a great brow pencil. It's not a pointy tip, it's a slanted on which makes it super easy to totally cover my brows and mask the thinning. The handy brush is great, too, to evenly distribute the crayon. This lasts all day and makes my brows look absolutely great between tintings. Highly recommend!

title: Irish Spring is the best!
text: I have loved Irish Spring since I was a kid. Typically using bar soap, Irish Spring has been a staple in my bathroom for years. Now that I, and my kids, are older, we find ourselves switching from bar soap to liquid body wash. I was anxious to try this Irish Spring body wash and I am so glad I did. Same great fragrance as the bar soap, but in a handy pump bottle. This seems to last a long time as we have been using it for almost two weeks now and the bottle is only about 1/4 depleted. My bathroom smells great from the fragrance, our skin feels amazingly soft and clean. Absolutely love this and highly recommend!

title: Not the highest quality, but did impress my granddaughter!
text: This is a really cute gift for a little girl. First, the 'Frozen' name was a big hit with my granddaughter. She squealed with delight when she first unwrapped this, she was also super anxious to get started at putting makeup on. Of course, at the age of 5, she definitely needed a lot of assistance, lol. On the negative side, this is just a plastic piece, not made for the long haul. Mirror is not a real one (of course, I understand that with the problem of glass with children). The makeup is basic and doesn't last very long (good for a couple of tries, but afterwards gone). So, I can't give this a 100% positive review, but it is definitely a fun gift to give to a little girl.

title: A taste of the Caribbean in your shower!
text: I absolutely love this body scrub. When I use it in the shower the light coffee flavor wakes me up and the coconut makes me feel like I am in the islands! It lathers up easily and leaves me feeling refreshed and clean all day and my skin feels moisturized. I think using the word 'scrub' in the title may be a little misleading as it is not truly a scrub. It does have a few crystals that I can feel, but I would not exactly call this an exfoliating experience. However, the fragrance and the cleansing factor rate this as a 5 star. Highly recommend for men and women!

title: Luxury at it's best!
text: I really like this Rose Chai moisturizing gel. It goes on luxuriously thick and smooths on my face easily and has a light rose fragrance. It absorbs nicely, but I will say a little longer than other cremes (maybe better for nighttime use if you are in a rush in the morning). I have been using this daily and evening for almost two weeks now and my skin feels amazingly soft and smooth. Comes in a great container and box so would make a great gift as well. When I first ordered this, retail was $79. Today, as of this writing it is $49. I am ordering another because at this price this is a wonderful product. Highly recommend!

title: Really nice daily facial serum!
text: I really like this RevitaPearl system. I have been using serums for over 20 years now and I am always looking for something new to change up my beauty regimen. This serum had ingredients that my other serums don't, so I was anxious to try it. I love the way it is applied with a dropper type head, it allows me to apply it easily to my face in the right spots and in the right amount. This is light and absorbs quickly into my skin. After using this daily for two weeks, I can say my skin looks glowing and healthier. Also, the skin around my eyes in noticeably plumper which makes the wrinkles appear less. Highly recommend for daily use for every skin type.

title: What a great gift set!
text: I love this gift set! First, I love the fragrance. Peach has always been one of my favorite fragrances and in this gift set the fragrance is light and not overwhelming. It includes a candle and a bath bomb (bubbles) a small bar of soap and some light luxurious massage oil. Just draw your bath, light the candle and you have everything that you need for a great spa experience! It also comes in a great gift box which would be perfect for a woman you love or just a special someone (like a teacher, etc). For the price, this cannot be beat for a nice gift. Highly recommend!

title: Great device, low on battery life
text: This Dumite hair clipper system is a really cool device. It is sleek, thin and light and fits perfect in your hand allowing you the ability to maneuver it easily around your ears, sideburns and back of neck. I had my son try this first (he is 35) and he absolutely loved it. He told me how easy it was to trim his hair (something he had never tried on his own before). With the change of heads and combs, he was able to adjust it easily for the length of his hair. I am deducting a star for the battery life on this. It states that after charging for 3 hours, it should last 2 hours. My son, after using it twice, had to recharge. Of course, the use was two weeks apart, but considering the device had only been used for about 15 minutes each time, I would think we could have gotten another use out of it without having to charge. Other than that, this is a nice nose, ear and hair trimmer.

title: Decent for home use
text: I typically go for microderms and facials at least once a month (and have so for the past 15 years). A good microderm treatment can cost over a $100, so I was hoping I could find one I could have at home. I saw this and really was anxious to try it. Unfortunately, I was not thrilled with this. For home use, it is ok. Took a while for me to read instructions and get going. I didn't find the 'beads' to be as good, or as strong, as a professional salon has. I also found there was more suction/vacuum than was really needed (so my skin was being irritated more with the vacuum than the crystals). I will keep it and will try it again, but will only be using it when I can't get to a salon. Wasn't thrilled with these results, but it was ok for the home.

title: Look elsewhere
text: For the positives, this comes in a great gold container and a really nice box (great for gift giving). Other than that, I really didn't like it for the money. I got this replace an exfoliator I typically keep in the shower. When I first opened it I found it was kind of a jelly based cream that has kind of a light, funky (not necessarily pleasant) fragrance. The exfoliating granules are few and far between, so don't think you will be getting any kind of a scrub. It does clean my face, so it does that job well. Just for the money, you can do better.

title: Not only for men!
text: I love this soap! This is a sizable bar, too, so don't look at the price. This will last months in my shower. I love the fragrance and the fact that it has a bit of exfoliating in it as well. I know it says for men but I had to try it since I love mint and eucalyptus. Fragrance is very light (wish it was a little stronger), but it lathers well and makes me feel clean and refreshed after I shower. Highly recommend for men and women.

title: A different way to style your hair!
text: This is an easy to use brush with a hair dryer built in. The brush has multiple settings for heat and power. I will say, it is nice to only have to have one device to work with (instead of having to hold a brush and dryer at the same time). I deducted a star, though, as I just feel it took longer to dry my hair than usual. I am not sure if it is the power lacking what my regular hair dryer has (I mean it certainly sounded as strong). I still am using my regular set up when I am in a rush, but I will keep this around as a back-up.

title: Great for home or business!
text: This is a really nice hand soap. It cleans well and leaves your hands feeling soft and smooth (non-drying). The dispenser makes it a nice item to keep right on my kitchen sink for when I come in from the stores. It actually is quite attractive, too, and looks nice in my kitchen. During this pandemic, I have been washing my hands continuously, so it is nice to find a soap that is not only antibacterial but also moisturizing. And the fact that is ecofriendly is just icing on the cake. Highly recommend!

title: Terrific device that really works!
text: For the money, this is a great little device. It works right out of the box (after inserting battery), no parts to install or put together. Painlessly, you can insert this into your nose and in a flash, all little hairs are gone. It seems the older we get, the more hair appears in places that we really don't want. This gadget is perfect and can address nose or ear hairs easily. For the money, this is a great tool. My husband liked using this too, as his ears tend to get hair in them as well. Highly recommend for men and women alike. Would make a great stocking stuffer!

title: Nice kit containing everything
text: This is a cute makeup kit containing everything you need. It is super compact and easily can fit in a purse. I think, as this contains small portions of everything, that this would be a terrific gift for a young girl. Big variety of colors and styles, would be nice to travel with, too. I wish it had come in a box (it came bubble wrapped) so it would be better for gift giving. Other than that, cute set of products.

title: Great for straightening hair!
text: This is a nice ceramic hair straightener (that's what I used this for). It heats up quickly and evenly and is super easy to use. It fits well in my hand and is easy to maneuver around my hair, the plates are a perfect size,  so within minutes my hair was straight and shiny. This also came in a nice box so it would make a great gift for someone. I also love the lavender color. Highly recommend!

title: Really nice facial serum which contains Vitamin C and Aloe
text: I have been using serums for years after my dermatologist told me how I can improve my skin. I was anxious to try this because it contains vitamin C. I have been using this exclusively for the past three and I can say that I definitely see a great improvement. This goes on light and is absorbed fairly quickly into my skin and the light orange fragrance is yummy. I have noticed a definite glow to my skin and my fine lines around my eyes (crow's feet) are definitely diminished. I love the way my skin feels, too, so soft and smooth. Highly recommend!

title: One of my favorite conditioners on the market today!
text: I love this shampoo and conditioner (I have purchased both). First, I love the scent. Lightly peppermint and lavender, it fills my shower with the most amazing calming fragrance which lightly lingers on my hair for me to smell during the day. Second, I love how my hair feels after using it. The conditioner goes on thick and smooth and makes my hair shiny and super soft. I highly recommend for all hair types, but especially for hair that is dry and difficult to manage (i.e. frizzies).

title: Ok facial cleaning tool, not great with battery life
text: For the money, this is a good facial cleanser. I keep it in the shower and use it to help in exfoliating my facial skin every morning. Really does help keeping my skin clean and shining. Lots of attachments (although it seems I only use two). I like that it is waterproof so I can keep and use it in the shower. Doesn't hold a charge that long, so be sure to recharge often.

title: Great eyeshadows, would have liked an applicator
text: This is a really nice pallet of eyeshadow colors. I love the muted solid colors and the ones that have a tinge of shiny in them. I deducted a star just because it doesn't come with a brush/applicator which I really would have liked to have had. I understand some people prefer their own brushes, but I didn't have any so had to search around for one in an older eyeshadow that I had around. Other than that, I really liked the neutral/brown colors and the quality of the shadows.

title: Nice gift package of winter necessities!
text: I have been using Nivea products for years and you can always depend on the name for a good solid quality product at a reasonable price. I love this gift pack, it is great for a stocking stuffer during the holidays. It containers hand moisturizer and lip balm, so great to have during the colder winter season that is so drying on the skin. The hand moisturizer is my favorite. Goes on thick and creamy but absorbs quickly. My hands feel soft and smooth and definitely better looking than they did a month ago since I have been using this. I do wish the gift packaging was a little more 'elaborate' but, the products are great. Highly recommend!

title: Really nice hairbrush!
text: This is a nice hairbrush and my husband absolutely loves it. It fits ergonomically well in his hand and he is able to maneuver over his hair easily. It has great bristles which are not overly rough but do grip the hair, which is wonderful for styling. I love the way it is quality made, too. Highly recommend this brush for men or women!

title: Excellent variety pack of shadows!
text: Nice variety pack of eyeshadows. I love the muted neutral colors, go perfect with almost anything I wear. Also like the fact that these would make an excellent gift as well with the packaging. Colors last a super long time. When I apply in the morning (super easy to apply), it remains all day and comes off easily with my makeup wipes at night. Highly recommend!

title: Super nice hand moisturizer!
text: I have been using Dove products for years now. From moisturizers made exclusively for your face to overall body ones, Dove always provides a quality product at a reasonable price. This hand cream lives up to the Dove brand. It is creamy and once applied makes my hands feel noticeably softer and smoother. I tend to have really dry hands (and feet) and this moisturizer has really made a difference in my 60 something year old skin. I highly recommend for men and women and all skin types. And to top it off, it comes in a value multi-pack!

title: Really nice lip gloss, absorbs quickly, though
text: This is a super shiny, moisturizing lip gloss. Lightly pink, I apply it over my existing lip color and it helps enhance the glow and shine. I really like it. Only thing I had a problem with is that I found myself reapplying often as it seems to absorb a little too quickly for my liking. Other than that, I can recommend for the shine it applies to your lips.

title: Great shampoo and conditioner!!!
text: This is a great shampoo and conditioner set. First, I love the Tea Tree fragrance, it is light and slightly musky and smells great on my hair. It also is a super moisturizing pair and my hair looks shiny and healthy after each use. It states it's also great for dandruff and I can honestly say I have seen less flakes since I have been using this almost exclusively over the past 6 weeks. It also is sulfate free which is great for my keratin treated hair. I can highly recommend

title: Wonderful hair dryer!
text: Really nice powerful hair dryer. Multiple speeds and with several versatile changeable heads, this hair dryer will work for all hair types. I have naturally wavy hair and typically try to straighten, and iron, every day. This dryer helps straighten my hair and leave it looking shiny and healthy. Highly recommend to everyone and all hair types.

title: Nice for traveling
text: This is a handy little set to take with you when traveling. It has everything you need for a manicure or pedicure fix up between visits. It also comes in a really nice pack which is perfect for gift giving. I am thinking I may buy another one of these next year for a stocking stuff for my son.  Of course, this is not a professional set and you could buy a better one for more $$. But I think this is a great set to have around and take when you are on the go.

title: Makes a wonderful gift!
text: I really loved this lavender gift set. I honestly had to consider keeping it for myself as I really loved all of it. Lavender is my favorite scent and I have everything in my bath to accentuate it (including light lavender accents in color). However, I felt I needed to give it away since it was a gift set, so at Christmas I gave it to my aunt. She absolutely loved this! She told me her favorite was the bubble bath but that it was difficult choice as she loved it all so much (and this says a lot considering how persnickety she can be. Highly recommend for gift giving, would make a great gift for a school teacher as well.

title: Perfect gift for the woman you love!
text: I have been using Neutrogena products for years now.  This Hydro Boost gift set is one of my favorites. I love the moisturizing gel, it goes on lightly and is absorbed quickly into my skin. The moisturizing mask is something that I have used in the past and I really like. After using both, my skin looks younger and glowing. This is a great gift set to give to someone as it gives them a kick start into getting their skin in optimum condition and you can always trust Neutrogena for the best beauty products. Any woman would love to get this set.

title: Great gift for a teacher!
text: Really nice gift for a female teacher. Nice presentation for a gift. When you open it, it looks great with a cute little writing on the inside of the cover. I had my grandson give this to his second grade teacher and I was there when she opened it. She absolutely loved it and all the gifts inside the box (especially the candle). I highly recommend this for gift giving!

title: Great smoothing cleanser for men!
text: My 36 year old son who typically hates men 'beauty products' loves Jack Black products. This exfoliating cleanser is no exception. He uses it in the shower every morning and he has told me he loves the fragrance (musky scent) and the way his skin looks and feels. It is not a strong exfoliator but enough to keep his skin feeling soft and smooth and aids in his shaving. He highly recommends!

title: Great men's night moisturizing serum!
text: My husband has never been anywhere near a metro-sexual male, worry about skin or hair care. As he has now approached age 60, he is finally starting to come around to seeing how important it is to take care of your skin. This night serum is great. A simple wash of his face before bedtime and an application of this Tieso is all it takes. He has been using it for almost a month now and I can see a difference in his skin. It looks refreshed and smoother and I think he is waking up looking more refreshed every morning. A little goes a long way and it is absorbed quickly in his skin. Highly recommend!

title: Perfect for gift giving!
text: This is a really nice soap set for men. My husband tried all three bars and loves all of them. They also come in a really nice gift packaging so these are perfect to give to a teacher or relative/friend. They are also a convenience size so you can take them with you when you travel. Highly recommend!

title: Great collagen shampoo and conditioner set!
text: This is a really nice shampoo and conditioner set. I typically get keratin treatments a few times a year, so I am always looking for a good moisturizing product to help prolong the treatments. This is lightly fragranced, shampoo lathers up nicely and the conditioner leaves my hair soft and smooth with no frizzies. I highly recommend this shampoo for all hair types man/woman.

title: Really nice facial serum!
text: I have been using all kinds of serums and facial products for 20+ years now. I really do like this Resveratrol Concentrate by Reveel. Goes on lightly and smoothly and is absorbed quickly into the skin. My skin feels noticeably softer after using this daily for several weeks now. I deducted a star because I thought, for the money, I could do much better than this price. Other than that, it's a really nice daily facial serum.

title: Great soaps for men!
text: I gave these to my son to use in his bathroom. He loves the fragrances and he says his hands and face feel clean and refreshed after use. They are definitely fragranced for men (not flowery) so these are perfect for gift giving (would have made a great stocking stuffer). Highly recommend!

title: My new favorite shampoo and conditioner!
text: I have been getting keratin treatments a few times a year for quite a while now. I need to use sulfate shampoos to help prolong the effects, which usually means I am spending more than normal on shampoos. When I saw this combo I had to try it. I love the fact that it contains keratin and that it is sulfate free. It lathers up great and smells wonderful. My hair looks and feels softer and shinier than it has in years and I know it is prolonging my treatments. I highly recommend this shampoo and conditioner to anyone who wants to use quality products and have their hair looking and feeling great!

title: Great for gift giving!
text: This is a nice box of soaps which is definitely suitable for gift giving. I did find my skin was really clean after using and definitely softer/moisturized. I didn't really care for the fragrance for myself (too floral), so I will not be buying more. But this might make a great gift package for a child's teacher or coach for the holidays.

title: Little capsules that pack a punch!
text: I really like this Borghese Power-C Firming & Brightening Serum product. I love the the little capsules. I tear the little top and then place little drops all over my face and with small circles, smooth it in to my face. Within seconds, the serum is absorbed. Having used this now for well over a month now, my skin actually feels amazing and does look like it has a real healthy glow! I love these little vials and I will be ordering more soon. Highly recommend!

title: Love this facial scrub brush!
text: I have never tried Project E products, but I was in the market for a new facial scrub and I was anxious to try this. Using a scrub brush has been a routine beauty staple in my shower for the past 15 or so years. This is a really nice one. I have been using it daily with an exfoliating powder and my skin feels noticeably smoother and softer. So far, after 2 months of usage, still have not had to change batteries. I highly recommend this to everyone (men and women).

title: All natural hand soap - great size!
text: I volunteer at a woman's shelter and we go through hand sanitizer and soap like crazy. This is a great economically sized hand wash. Lightly scented, a little goes a long way. It doesn't dry your skin and my hands actually feel softer after I use it. It's also a green product so it is good for the environment as well. We just ordered two more boxes of this and will be using it exclusively going forward.

title: Didn't work for me
text: After using this daily for two weeks I eventually stopped. First, the instructions were lacking and it took me quite a while to figure out what I was doing (and I am still not sure if I was doing it right). Second, the serum was not like anything I have used before (it was not light and took a while to get absorbed). Third, I haven't noticed any difference (I have some pronounced age spots that I have been trying to diminish and this did nothing). Sorry, can't recommend, but maybe it may work for you.

title: Best hot tub pillow in the market today!
text: This is a great pillow. I recently got a four person GE Whirlpool hot tub which has a lounge side to stretch out in. I love all of it except for my head which basically lays back on the tub. Although it is not entirely uncomfortable, I was looking for something better. When I saw this pillow I just had to try it. It is a great waterproof pillow which stays in place with suction. It is soft and definitely is the way to go when I am trying to full on relax. Highly recommend this for all hot tub users.

title: Great overnight collagen treatment for your skin!
text: I love L'Oreal products. This overnight moisturizer is one of my all time favorites! I have been using it nightly now for over a month and my skin looks incredible. This does go on a little thick, but it is absorbed relatively quickly. My skin feels and looks satiny and definitely has minimized the crows feet around my 60 something aging eyes. Highly recommend! Would make a great, reasonably priced, stocking stuff for the holidays, too.

title: Best facial wash for men!
text: My husband has been using this nightly to wash off the effects of daily dirt. His facial skin (in combination with other Sky Organic products) has never looked better. It is so important to take care of our skin as we age and, unfortunately, most men have not recognized this need. This is a great facial wash, cleans without drying skin, and leaves the skin looking clean and refreshed. Highly recommend. Would make a great stocking stuffer stuffer for the man that you love in your life!

title: Great exfoliator!
text: My husband has never been a metro sexual kind of guy, but as he has gotten older he now appreciates how he needs to take care of his skin to help minimize the effects of aging. He has been using this daily, in the shower, and his skin has never felt smoother and softer. He loves the way his skin glows and looks, too. This would make a great stocking stuffer for the man you love. Highly recommend!

title: Great tattoo cream!
text: My son recently expanded on his tattoos (arm) and I got this for him to try out. He really liked it. Said it went on smoothly and had a calming cool feeling on his skin. Moisturizer balm was absorbed quickly and he said it seemed to heal sooner than it has in the past when he has gotten his tattoos. He said he will be using this in the future and will be recommending to his friends.

title: Another great L'Oreal product!
text: I love L'Oreal products and have been using them for years. This daily moisturizer is great. It is loaded with antioxidants and contains a lot of great anti-aging ingredients. I have been using this daily for over a month now and I love the way my skin looks and feels. If I had any complaints it would be that I would have liked a higher than 25 SPF for use down here in Florida (so I ave to supplement it with additional sunscreen when I leave the house. Outside of that, this is a really nice moisturizer which goes on lightly and is quickly absorbed. Highly recommend.

title: Best of all worlds!I l
text: I live in Florida and find the need to apply sunscreen every day. Typically, I have my beauty regimen every morning where I apply expensive serums and moisturizers and then apply the sunscreen. Sunscreen normally is greasy and does not absorb well and I honestly hate wearing it. In comes this Shore Magic product and it is great. I am now using it as the last part of my regimen. It absorbs quickly, is lightly fragranced and best of all it is SPF50. I am in love with this product and I will be buying more. Highly recommend!

title: Probably the nices bar soap I ever used!
text: This is a really nice bar soap. I actually use it in my shower. I have shampoo and conditioner that kind of matches it (tea tree), so I love the fragrance my shower has. This lightly exfoliates my skin and leaves me feeling soft and clean and I just love it. I have already ordered another bar. Highly recommend!

title: Great multi-use tissues!
text: These are really nice tissues. Stronger than typical tissues, you can use them for cleanups, makeup removal, anything that you can use a regular tissue for, but better. Absorbs super quick and does not tear easily. Best part of all these are good for the environment. I highly recommend these for every home.

title: Great combination of moisturizer plus SPF protection!
text: I love ROC products! And, this moisturizer with the added benefit of SPF 30 protection is amazing! Goes on lightly and smoothly and is absorbed quickly. No greasy after feel (typical of SPF products), this can be used under makeup easily. Highly recommend!

title: Great for men!
text: My husband has never considered himself a metrosexual kind of guy. But now that he is in his 60's he's become more aware of how important it is to take care of his skin. This is a really nice pack of products from cleanser to moisturizers it's a nice way for him to start a regimen. Also comes in a nice box and would make a great holiday gift for the man you love.

title: Great daily moisturizer!
text: Really nice moisturizer. Goes on easily and smoothly and is absorbed readily into the skin. I can use this easily under makeup with no greasy feel. After using for over a month now, I can say my face looks younger, skin is tighter and fine lines around my eyes look much better. Highly recommend!

title: Salon results!
text: This is a nice way to get salon results at home with gel manicures. It is easy to use, the nail dryer works perfectly and there is a good variety of colors. I have used this twice over the past 2 months to do my own nails at home. To be honest, I still would rather the salon as I am not good (especially with my left hand applying to my right hand) getting the polish on smoothly to my nails by myself. However, it is good for me to be able to use this between salon visits for redos and touch ups. Highly recommend!

title: Really nice facial peel!
text: For the money, this is a great facial peel. I have been using it weekly for over a month now and I can say my skin is super soft and smooth. I usually get facials at the spa once a month and they usually will apply a light peel. This peel is just as good and, at $15, is a super bargain. Lightly exfoliates my skin and rejuvenates my skin without a heavy peeling factor. Highly recommend.

title: Nice cleanser for everyday use
text: This is a nice facial cleanser. Does remove makeup and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. I am not sure about the claim to exfoliating as I didn't feel any scrubbing particles in the cleanser. However, I have been using it exclusively for almost a month and I do really like it. I use it nightly before bed to reduce the daily dirt and makeup collected on my face. It also has an extremely light fragrance that I also liked. I recommend this for anyone looking for an oil based cleanser.

title: One of the best handsoaps in the market today!
text: This Wavertree & London Natural Liquid Soap is wonderful. It's made from pure, natural sustainable plant oils and extracts, smells great and is great as a hand soap. It contains shea butter, so it helps to keep my hands from getting overly dry from repeated washings. I keep this on my kitchen counter next to the sink and have been using it exclusively over the past month. I can highly recommend.

title: This is a great gift set!!!!
text: This gift set is a steal at under $25. It contains deep moisture body wash, deodorant dry spray, Intensive Repair Shampoo, Intensive Repair Conditioner, Macadamia and Rice Milk Body Polish and a loofah. If you were to purchase all of these separately you would run over $40. I love the way my skin feels after using these in the shower and part of my morning routine for the past month now. I particularly love the body polish. I highly recommend and can say with the boxing, this would make a fantastic present for the holidays. Highly recommend!

title: Great every day moisturizer!
text: I really like this Jurlique rose cream moisturizer. Typically, I don't like rose scented products because they usually make the scent too strong. This Jurlique is different. Lightly fragranced, it doesn't conflict with any scent I may wear. It goes on smooth and luxurious and absorbs quickly into my skin. I can apply my makeup right after application with no problems I have been using this for about a month now and my skin does feel softer and smoother.

title: Nicest moisturizer on the market!
text: I love La Roche-Posay products and I have used them for 10 plus years and have several varieties in my bathroom currently. This facial moisturizer is no exception. It is light and is absorbed quickly into my skin. This is perfect to use under my makeup as a base. My skin is softer and smoother after using it for over a month now and my skin looks flawless. I highly recommend this moisturizer for all skin types and for both men and women.

title: Will add smoothness and fullness to your lips
text: This product does work (minimally) and I have noticed some added fullness to my lips when using. However, it doesn't last that long, found myself reapplying often. I will say that my lips definitely are noticeably softer and smoother after using this for almost a month now. Highly recommend as an alternative to doing lip fillers.

title: Shiny lips for sure!
text: I have been using these for almost a month now. I really do love the way my lips look when using this, beautiful and shiny. I deducted a star because I didn't notice any kind of plumping factor on my lips (I have very thin lips). But, honestly, the shininess made up for the lack of plumping. I also have to say I needed to reapply a lot more often than other lip glosses, this absorbs very quickly into the lips. Highly recommend if you are looking for a real shiny lip appearance.

title: Great styling brush!
text: This is a great brush. Quality made, strong bristles, it works perfectly on my shoulder length hair. I typically like to straighten my hair so I spend quite a while brushing and blow drying my hair every morning. This brush is a perfect size for me, fits well in my hand and maneuvers easily. Just perfect. I ordered another for my guest bathroom for when people visit. Highly recommend!

title: Great for gift giving!
text: This makes a great gift set for anyone. Nicely packaged and contains everything you need for a nice at-home spa day. This would be excellent as a gift for a school teacher or day care worker or someone you love. Makes your skin smell and feel soft and smooth. I love the unique fragrance, too. Highly recommend.

title: Really nice addition to every day beauty regimen
text: Overall, this is a great moisturizing cream. I have been using it for almost 2 months now. My skin looks noticeably younger with more fullness. I also definitely can see a difference with the crows feet under my eyes. I love the way my skin feels. This cream goes on lightly,  absorbs into my face quickly and is perfect to wear under makeup. If there is any downside it's in the cost (not sure if it is worth almost $100).

title: Great eye cream for aging skin!
text: This is an amazing under eye cream! I have been using this now for a little over a month and I honestly can see a difference in the skin and under eye appearance. I have had dark circles and bags under my eyes for years now and I have been searching for something that can help make a difference. This Avya product makes my skin noticeably smoother and my skin feels amazingly soft. The dark circles have definitely been diminished and I look 5 years younger. Highly recommend!

title: A must have for daily use
text: This is a really nice facial serum. I have been using hyaluronic acid serums daily for twenty plus years and my skin looks great. I have used ISDIN products for years now and they produce a quality product. This serum applies lightly and is absorbed in my skin almost instantly. Fine lines are diminished and my skin looks healthier and glows. Highly recommend for anyone to make this a part of your every day beauty regimen.

title: Wonderful shampoo!
text: I really love this argan oil shampoo. It smells great and is thick and luxurious. It lathers up quickly and my hair feels amazingly smooth and frizz free after using and my relatively thin hair does look fuller. I have just ordered the conditioner as well. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a new quality shampoo, this is it.

title: Really nice hairbrush for men or women
text: This is a great hairbrush. I love how I can use it on wet hair and it detangles my hair quickly and painlessly. I have been using this every morning for the past month and I can honestly say it's one of the best brushes I have ever used. Quality wood, strong bristles. Highly recommend.

title: Comparable to salon treatments!
text: I have been getting microdermabrasions at spas/salons for almost 10 years now. As I am now entering retirement, and will need to keep a close eye on finances, I know that self-care may have to take a hit (and not go quite as often as I had been). I was anxious to try this and I was not disappointed. I can now do what the salons did in the privacy of my own home and I can own one for the equivalent of 2-3 times the cost of a salon treatment. I still will go for professional treatments but maybe only once a quarter and I will be using this bi-weekly in between. It works well and my skin feels almost as good as a professional treatment. Highly recommend!

title: Great way to extend your Keratin salon treatments!
text: I get Keratin treatments at the salon at least 3-4 times a year (would do it more often if I could afford it). I am always in the market to use products that can help extend my salon visits. This Keratin Perfect shampoo is really nice. It is sulfate free (which is the first thing I look for ) and makes my hair feel silky smooth and soft. If I had any complaint at all it might be for the price (or at least the size of the bottle compared to price). Other then that, I highly recommend for anyone who wants to improve the texture and appearance of your hair.

title: Perfect spray for me!
text: I get keratin treatments at my salon several times a year, so I am always looking for products that can help prolong the treatment. This spray is great. During my styling after washing and partially drying, I spray this on and continue with my routine. My hair looks noticeably smoother and feels softer and brings the keratin to life again in my hair. Highly recommend whether you use it like I do or if you are looking for a great way to have your hair looking its best at all times.

title: Ok if you use it with another lip product
text: I usually love Haus products, but this Lady Gaga Oil Stain doesn't do it for me. First, I think it is way overpriced at $24. The color is almost transparent and is not even good as a normal lip gloss. I am not sure how this even qualifies as a stain. The one saving grace is that it is moisturizing and I have been using it as a base to my morning colors and my lips definitely feel better and smoother.

title: Nice set, but small
text: Not a bad bath set, but I know you can do better. Small in size (only 3 bath fizzies) so if you are planning to give this as a gift (as the name suggests), you might want to keep that in mind or use it as an add-on gift (or stocking stuffer). I really liked the fragrances (both tea and thyme) and the creams are very moisturizing. Nice way to pamper yourself for a couple of 'spa days', probably should look into buying products separately in larger sizes.

title: I've used much better
text: DIdn't like the Matkas foot peel mask at all. Biggest issue with me is the time. An hour and a half. Seriously? I mean, in my life the only time I have a free one and a half hours is when I am sleeping. I did try using it before bed, while watching tv, though, for the purpose of this review. I found that I needed to add additional tape to help keep the bags on my feet. Make sure you don't need to move during this process either as your feet will be exttremely slippery.  After using 4 times I finally started to see the peel, but I found it very uneven and the peeling would be completed on one part of my foot while another part was just starting. I also didn't care for the smell of this product as well. I have used several other foot masks that I much prefer (and they work faster and my feet look much better. Can't recommend.

title: I use this in the shower every morning
text: As an older woman, I have always had enlarged pores and even still had blackheads well into my 50's. I usually do use some kind of scrub in the shower to help with exfoliation and to help clean out the pores. This Aadya product works well. It is tough acting, but also gentle. I love the fragrance and the way my skin feels after using. Highly recommend this to anyone looking for a good every day scrub.

title: Lower quality, but for the price it's great
text: This is a really a cute man's grooming set. Perfectly boxed, would make a great gift. Not the best quality, tools are lightweight and not sure how they would hold up for prolonged use. However, this makes a great travel set (I packed mine for my husband on a recent trip to California) and for less than $6, it would also make a good stocking stuffer for the holidays.

title: A must have for every household!
text: I love Dove products and have been using them for years. I love this value set of products! Moisturizing and cleanses my skin amazingly. The shampoo and conditioner is really nice as well. I already ordered another set for my son in college. Everyone should own one of these sets for complete and total body care.

title: Great shampoo, my new favorite!
text: I am always in the market for a quality sulfate free shampoo to help me prolong my salon keratin treatments. I really like this Moroccan Argan oil shampoo. It smells great, lathers well and my hair remains smooth, soft and frizz free. I liked it so much I also ordered the same brand conditioner and I know this will now be my regular shampoo routine. For the price, I feel I am getting a salon quality product at a lot less than my regular products. Highly recommend!

title: Nice, but expensive, eye cream
text: I found this to be a really nice eye cream. Thick and luxurious, it comes impressively packaged and would be perfect for gift giving. I apply it to my eye area in dabs and gently smooth it in. My under eye skin feels smoother and softer definitely. Not sure about the 'lifting' impact though, don't see a difference after almost 3 weeks of use. I am deducting a star simply because of the price. I have had Olay products which have similar effects for 25% of the price.

title: It works a little
text: This is an ok eye gel, not necessarily worth the money, though. I keep it in the refrigerator and put it on about 30 minutes before I am going out. I will say that it goes on easily and is absorbed relatively quickly. I didn't really see an 'amazing' difference after using this for almost three weeks now. And, I am not sure if the fact that the product is cold is what brings down the swelling and the bags a bit (similar to when I used to cut up cold cucumbers). Didn't really see any long lasting progress though. Not sure if I would order again.

title: Another great Olay product!
text: I love Olay products and have been using them since I was a teenager. I really like this Moisture Whip moisturizer. After I do my regular morning regimen and apply serum, I finish with this. I love that it has sunscreen so when I finish, I am protected (of course, if I am doing a lot of outdoor activity I need more than a 25 SPF and will add additional). I love the way this cream goes on, it is rich and creamy, yet light. When I apply it, it absorbs quickly and makes my face feel soft and smooth and definitely moisturized. Highly recommend!

title: Good green deodorant!
text: This is a good deodorant. I love that there is no plastic here (Tom's has cornered the market on being a green company). These are relatively small containers, but a little goes a long way. Has a pleasant smell, works relatively well.  Recommend.

title: Not the kind of cleanser I typically use
text: Not a great fan of this cleanser. First, it's not like cleansers I have used in the past. I guess sometimes that's a good thing because this cleanser has an added benefit of moisturizing. This cleanser is thick and gel like and it goes on to my skin easily. Problem is, I don't feel like my skin is clean after I rinse it off (even though I am sure it is). I guess, I prefer my cleansers to clean and then I use serums and moisturizing creams after to moisturize my skin. Of course, this may work well for you so I am still rating it as 4 stars. Just not the type of cleanser I like. Also, the exfoliating is not in the cleanser, it's in the cloth you use, not part of my daily regimen.

title: Great facial wash for men!
text: My husband has never been a 'metro-sexual' male, but I am finding as he is getting older he is taking skin care seriously. This is a great face wash and he loves using it either before he shaves or at night before he goes to bed. He loves the great light tropical smell (coconut) and I like that it contains oils for moisturizing and vitamin E. The name Schick gives him confidence too that this is made for me (not girly-girly).  He really loves this wash!

title: Great daily moisturizing gel!
text: I have been using this Positively Radiant moisturizing gel daily for almost three weeks now. I use it in addition to my daily serum routine and I love the way it makes my skin feel. Goes on as a gel and gets absorbed into the skin readily (my skin actually drinks this up). My skin looks and feels younger, smoother and it does seem to glow. For the money, you can't go wrong. I will be buying more. Highly recommend.

title: In love with a face cream!
text: I really love this Versace face cream. It contains collagen and other ingredients to help my aging skin retain some youthfulness. I love the way it goes on silky and thick and absorbs quickly into my skin. My skin is noticeably softer and smoother after using for a little over two weeks now. I have been using it twice daily to my neck and face and I see a definite improvement in elasticity as well. Highly recommend!

title: Great hair trimmer!
text: This Schon cordless hair clipper and trimmer is really a nice quality set. Lots of attachments and speeds, I can easily help my husband trim his hair, neck and sideburns. He gets a quality trim comparable to going to a salon (of course his hair is not fancy styled). I love the way this fits in my hand and is very maneuverable, making it easy to go around ears and tighter spaces. I highly recommend this if you are in the market for a good quality clipper/trimmer.

title: Nice moisturizing cream for a more youthful you!
text: Really nice facial and neck moisturizer. It goes on thick and luxurious and absorbs into the skin quickly and easily. I have crepey skin, particularly on my neck area, and I am always looking for something which will help. This cream has definitely made a difference as I can see a definite smoothing and tighter neck after using for just a few weeks. The only complaint I have is the price as I think this is expensive, but a little goes a long way (I can use a medium sized pea shaped dab to do most of my face and neck).  I recommend this for men and woman and all skin types.

title: A little goes a long way
text: I have been using serums for years now. This OxygenCeuticals Couperose serum is really nice. Enriched with collagen, it goes on easily and is absorbed quickly in my skin. After using this exclusively for almost 2 weeks now, I can say that my skin is noticeably smoother, healthier and has a glow it hasn't had in a long time. If I had a problem with anything at all it would be the price, but you only need a small pea size amount for a full application. At this rate, I should have enough to last me for at least 3-4 months. Highly recommend!

title: Love this coconut butter body scrub!
text: Absolutely love this body scrub. I keep a container in the shower and have been using this several times a week for the past three weeks now. I love the way my skin feels and looks. Super smooth and soft and my dry crepey skin looks noticeably better. I also love the fragrance, makes me feel like I am in the islands on vacation with the coconut butter. Highly recommend this Dove scrub for anyone (man/woman) who wants their skin to look and feel amazing.

title: One of the best sunscreens on the market and it's Neutrogena!
text: This is a great sunscreen product. I have two grandsons who are big squirmers and it's difficult to get them to stand still for 5 minutes (particularly when it comes to applying sunscreen). This Neutrogena sunscreen sprays on quickly and evenly and is a light mist. No sticky residue or milky appearance, it blends into your skin quickly. Lightly fragranced and with an SPF45, this is definitely my go-to sunscreen now in Florida (for myself and my grandsons when they come to visit. Highly recommend!

title: Nice thicker make up remover and washing cloths
text: These are like a cross between tissue and paper towels. They are thicker than standard tissue and work really well when I am using them to remove make up. They also are a great alternative to a regular wash cloth when you need to clean or wash something as well. Wish they had a dispenser to put these in, would make it easier for storage in my bath (would look prettier, too). Recommend these if you are looking for a soft, disposable way for cleaning/washing.

title: Nice non-drying facial cleanser
text: This is a really nice facial cleanser. I really like that it is not one of the foam types I have used in the past which tend to leave my face feeling dry. This cleanser goes on easily and rinses off completely leaving my skin clean and healthy looking. I have been using it twice daily now for the past three weeks and I am really happy with this Airare cleanser. Highly recommend.

title: Another great Dove soap!!!
text: I have always loved Dove products and this new soap is no exception. My skin is left feeling clean and refreshed after using. Unlike other soaps I have used, Dove always leaves my skin feeling softer and moisturized (instead of dry). I love that this is unscented because as a person who loves to use body lotions and occasional perfumes, I don't have to worry about conflicting scents. Highly recommend this bar soap to everyone.

title: Easy to use, works amazing!
text: This is a super easy to use eyebrow trimmer razor. With two blades, it is easy to use and style your brows at the same time. I love the LED light which helps me to see what I am doing while using a magnifying mirror. Takes only minutes to use, you get a perfect spa brow trim and contouring is a breeze. Saves me loads of money from getting my brows done at the salon monthly. Highly recommend.

title: Great way to pamper yourself or the one you love!
text: This is a great hydrating bath and body set consisting of body wash, lotion and bar soap. I have been using the wash and soap in my shower for about 3 weeks now and the lotion in the morning and evening on my arms, hands, legs and feet. I have seen a noticeable improvement in the moisturizing of my skin and I love the fragrance it leaves behind. Highly recommend this shea butter set for everyone.

title: I recommend to anyone with eczema or any sensitive skin issues!
text: I have eczema and I am always looking for items that will not impact my skin. Body washes have tended to be very drying on my skin, causing it to peel and itch after using, so I had stopped using it. I was anxious to see how Dove did, since I do rely on them for alot of my skin needs. I can say that this body wash is great, my skin comes out soft and clean after using and I have no negative side effects. I now keep one in my shower and use this daily and I absolutely love it! Highly recommend!
