title: Great way for the little ones to get in the holiday spirit!
text: I have two grandsons ages 3 and 6 and these were a big hit this past St. Patrick's Day. Colorful and easy to put on and remove, they are a great way for the little ones to celebrate the holiday. We even had some left over that we dropped off to the day care for the littlest one which made several of the other children thrilled to apply and wear. For the money, this is a great way for them to celebrate. Highly recommend!

title: Great spa day package and giftable!
text: This is an absolutely lovely gift basket for the woman in your life. Contains everything she needs for a great spa experience.  This makes a wonderful gift for any woman. Great presentation in a super giftable box. Would be perfect for a school teacher, mail person, nail technician or any woman.  Highly recommend!

title: Amazing way for the man in your life to take care of his skin!
text: My son is far from being a metrosexual, but he is getting older now (35) and I think he is finally realizing that he needs to take care of his skin to begin minimized the effects of aging. This is a great daily scrub, he uses it in the shower. He loves the masculine scent and his skin feels smooth and soft after using. This has become part of his morning routine now and I have already ordered him another tube. Highly recommend!

title: Great toiletry bag, holds a lot!
text: This is a really nice toiletry bag. Although I haven't used it for traveling yet due to covid, I am using it in my linen closet to store my extra cosmetics and supplies. It is small yet room and carries a lot of stuff. Quality made, the zippers can definitely hold up to a lot of wear and tear. I can't wait to begin travel again and be able to use this. It will definitely protect my clothing and make an easy hanging tool in my hotel and cruise ship closets. Highly recommend!

title: Just like getting a spa pedicure at home!
text: I have extremely rough and dry heels and feet. I tend to get pedicures every 2-3 weeks and it seems like within a day or two of having one done, my feet are back to being rough. I wanted to try one of these home pedicure callous removers and this one is exceptional! I love how it makes my feet feel and look, and it is actually really neat that the built in vacuum helps keep my bathroom clean while using it. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a home pedicure tool!

title: Perfect for gift giving!
text: This is a super nice lavender bath set for women. It includes everything you need for a terrific home spa day. I love the lavender scent which is full bodied in the bath but very light on your body so you get a full aromatherapy feeling when bathing. My skin felt super moisturized after my first 'treatment' and my legs especially (which have a tendency to be super dry) feel smooth and silky. I love the reusable gift box this set comes in. Would make a great and very thoughtful gift for a teacher, parent, friend. Highly recommend!

title: I love this little tool!
text: I try to get facials and microderms at least once a month (more often if I can afford them). I wasn't sure what to expect when I saw this little tool. I actually love it now after using it for the past 3 weeks! It may not be quite as good as a professional microderm, but it is great to use weekly when I am between salon visits. Super easy to use and the results are actually pretty amazing. I highly recommend it for anyone who is looking to supplement their beauty regimen and to help improve your skin tone and texture.

title: One of the nicest facial cleansers on the market!
text: I was in the market for a good facial cleanser that wouldn't dry my skin and I knew that Melixir makes great products, so I thought I would try it.  This Herbaceous Gel Cleanser with Salicylic Acid and Green Tea Extract perfect for me. It contains all vegan ingredients and is not overly harsh on my skin. It lathers well and I love the light fragrance which leaves my skin clean and refreshed. I highly recommend this for any woman or man to use as part of their daily beauty regimen to keep their skin looking and feeling healthy!

title: Great daily repair cream!
text: I try to go at least once a month for a facial and mild dermaplaning. So, when I saw this cream, I definitely thought it would be great to use in between treatments. I love the way it goes on, soft and creamy and my skin absorbs it quickly. It has a very gentle exfoliating factor (urea) and I honestly can see a noticeable difference in my skin (staying smooth and fine lines diminished) after using this for several weeks now. Highly recommend!

title: Really good moisturizing cream for my 60-something skin!
text: This is a nice moisturizing cream. It goes on light and absorbs quickly into the skin. I love the way it feels when it goes on, so soft and creamy. My skin looks great after using this now for almost 3 weeks daily.  It is a great cream to use before bed and I wake up looking refreshed. Highly recommend!

title: Wonderful way for a woman to look her best!
text: Great hair remover. I keep it in my shower using it several times a week. It's strong enough for leg hair, but gentle enough for my underlip and chin areas. Lots of attachments and speeds and my skin feels super soft and smooth after using it.  Comes in a great box so it is also good for gift giving. Highly recommend.

title: Nice, thick night facial moisturizer
text: Nice, thicker, night facial cream. Doesn't absorb that quickly so it can transfer to your pillowcases if you are not careful. It has a real luxurious feel and I awaken in the morning with my skin feeling super soft and smooth. Seems to do the job well in moisturizing my skin, just be sure you allow sometime for the cream to absorb before going to bed.

title: Great moisturizing exfoliator!
text: This is a really nice moisturizing facial scrub and exfoliator for the money. It is creamy and rich and works well when I use it in the shower. I am 65 years old and I am always looking for a way to improve my skin texture and elasticity. This cleans my skin well, helps with exfoliation but with the moisturizing component, it leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth after use. I highly recommend this for all skin types.

title: High priced but nice!
text: This is a nice facial moisturizing/care set. It consists of a cleanser, a serum and a moisturizer. The cleanser is very gentle on my skin (non-exfoliating) and the serum is light and absorbs quickly. The moisturizer goes on thicker but also absorbs quickly. After using this set for about 3 weeks now several times a week, I honestly can say I really like these products. The light orange fragrance does nothing to disrupt any other fragrances you might be wearing and smells very refreshing. The fact that this contains vitamin C  helps to repair and maintain my 60 something year old skin. I am deducting one star simply because of the price. I think you can do better buying products separately for a lesser cost. This does come in a nice set, though, and would make an impressive gift for someone.

title: Nice moisturizer, small jar, high price
text: From a size perspective, this is a great little jar of moisturizer to keep in your pocket or purse to have with you at work, at the store or while traveling. The moisturizer is really nice, a little thick and takes a while to absorb, but afterwards my skin feels super soft. I am deducting a star, however, because of the price. I mean for $52 (the current price while I am writing this) is crazy high for what you get. I have lower priced moisturizers at home which work just as well , come in a much larger size and cost less. If it's only the portability you are looking at than this is a great little jar of moisturizer. Otherwise, shop around a little.

title: Great shave but overpriced
text: Gave this to my husband to try. He may be old school (he just recently turned 60), but he really wasn't impressed. He likes his shaving cream to be the shake up and foam on type. This goes on almost like a lotion and when shaving he doesn't even see it. He told me he likes the old fashioned kind of foam as he can always immediately see if he missed any areas. On the plus side, he loved the way his skin felt after shaving, said it was one of the nicest/closest shaves he has had. But, for the money for such a small tube, he felt it was over priced.

title: Where have you been all my life?
text: I have suffered from rough and calloused feet since I was in my teens. Most of my jobs have involved me being on my feet for most of the day and, on top of that. I love to run and take extended walks. I do try to get professional pedicures but the only seem to last me for a day or two and then I am back to the cracked and rough heels and soles of my feet. This callus remover is super easy to use and I am able to do my feet on my own. My feet look salon fresh now every day (I finish them off with a really good body butter). Highly recommend this to anyone with rough feet.

title: Wonderful that men have their own skin care line!
text: This is a really nice man's facial wash. It smells great, very manly, and cleans his face thoroughly. Suprisingly, it contains hyaluronic acid, which is kind of unique for a wash product. My husband was a little resistant at first to using something other than his Old Spice body wash, but he really likes this and uses it daily. I just ordered my second bottle of it for him. Highly recommend!

title: My husband recommends this!
text: I let my husband review this product, so this is what he says: "This is a good moisturizer, have been using it now daily for almost 2 weeks. It goes on evenly and smoothly and absorbs fairly quickly into my skin. I also use it on my face when it is super cold or windy out and it seems to protect my face from becoming chaffed. It's funny, but never really thought of taking care of my skin before, so this body hydrator is really good."

title: Great facial serum, but a little oily
text: I have been using facial serums on my sixty something skin for about 20 years now, so I have tried many different brands and varieties. This is a nice serum with unique ingredients. I love that it is from Israel where the women have some of the most beautiful skin on the planet (Dead Sea minerals?). I am deducting a star, though, simply because it is kind of oily and takes a while to absorb into my skin. I tend to like a serum I can apply and then almost immediately use other products. Not so here, I have to give it a good 5-7 minutes before I apply anything else. Other than that, it is really nice. Will use it for days when I am home and not having to rush out.

title: Great for gift giving!
text: This is a gift basket is a cute gift for someone. Contains body Wash, body Lotion and a bath fizzer (something I had never tried before). I was not crazy about the rose scent (it might just be me) and the sizes are on the small size. This is not something I would buy for myself but I can see how this would be great to give your child's teacher or mother-in-law or mail person.

title: Great set of hair clippers!
text: During this pandemic, I was looking for a good set of hair clippers to use on my two grandsons and my husband. This is a great clipper device. It fits well in my hand and is super easy to maneuver (especially around a squirming 2 and 5 year old). It comes with a load of attachments so it easily goes from doing the hair to trimming the back of the neck to getting rid of those sideburns. Comes in a great box as well, good for gift giving. Highly recommend!

title: Nice serum, but kind of expensive
text: This is a nice facial serum. Absorbs quickly into my ski, goes on easily. My skin does feel softer and smoother after using it twice a day for almost 3 weeks now. It also does seem to be a little firmer as well. I am deducting a star because of the price. I have used many serums over the years now (I am 60 years old) and I have a lot of experience with different brands and their impact on my skin. This is really nice but not worth the $90 ticket price. If it goes on sale I would recommend it.

title: Great package of shampoo, conditioner and body wash for men!
text: This is a really nice gift set of toiletry needs for men. My son really liked the shampoo and conditioner, he liked the fragrance and the way it made his hair smell and feel after showering. The body wash was good, too, helping him stay clean throughout the day. No noticeable fragrance afterwards which is nice for him when he uses cologne. A little expensive for the size of these bottles, but it does make a great gift set for holiday giving to the special man in your life.

title: Perfect for my two grandsons!
text: I was looking for an alternative to regular paper masks for my grandsons and these fit the bill. They fit perfectly, cover their eyes and mouth. The plastic is thin and transparent so there is no problem with them when they wear them in preschool and 1st grade classes. And, the best part of all, they want to wear them (unlike the paper ones). They love the design and the colors and have often fought over which one they will wear for that day. Highly recommend these if you have a child who is difficult and does not like wearing paper masks!

title: Ok cleansing bar with great ingredients
text: I use a lot of Dead Sea products in my daily regimen. When I saw this, I was really excited to try it. After using it exclusively in my shower daily for the past 3 weeks, I can honestly say that I  am not thrilled. First, it's a small bar and I am just about finished with it. Second, I don't feel that clean or refreshed after using it. I am thinking that maybe it's not meant to be a true 'soap' product, but I do like when I come out of the shower feeling clean and this bar is just leaving me feeling blah. I am still rating this as 4 stars as I do like the ingredients and feel it may work for others.

title: Good body wash, cleans well and lightly fragranced
text: Really nice natural body wash. I love the light fresh scent and the ingredients. Non-irritating, my skin feels incredibly soft and clean after use. I am not sure of the pricing of this as I only received 1 bottle for my Vine review, but even if it is 4 bottles for over $40 it does seem a little high priced.

title: Quality pedicure set at a very reasonable price!
text: This is a fantastic pedicure tool set for the money. Contains everything you need to give yourself, or someone else, a professional pedicure. It also comes in a black leather case which makes a terrific presentation especially for gift giving purposes. I have purchased another set as a Christmas gift for my brother because I was so impressed with the contents and the quality. Highly recommend this as either a gift for someone or just for yourself.

title: Nice products, great packaging
text: This is a great gift set of products designed for the optimal care of your skin. I love the serum and the moisturizer and they both work extremely well on my overly dry skin. This comes in a great gift box and would make a great gift for the woman in your life. I deducted a star simply because of the price. I feel that for the money you could get larger sizes of comparable products (toners and serums are typically lower in price). But, as a gift set, this is great and would be sure to impress someone for the holidays.

title: Good way to tint and color brows
text: I have sparse eyebrows which have a lot of gray. I tend to get them tinted at least once a month and really should do it more often. When I saw this I was thrilled to try it to help maintain my brows between tinting. On the plus side, the lighter brown color works well for me and it lasts a long time. I am not thrilled with the applicator which makes applying difficult (I wish it was more of a brush than a pointed applicator). I can recommend this to anyone looking to darken or enhance their sparse eye brows.

title: Overpriced, not great
text: Overall, not thrilled about this gel. It is a little thick and does not absorb quickly into my skin (leaving my face feeling slightly sticky). I have been using it for about 3 weeks now and have not seen any noticeable improvement in my skin. I do not find it to be moisturizing at all and for $70, I think you can do better elsewhere if you are looking for some kind of a moisturizing formula for your face.

title: Good night time moisturizer
text: This is a nice night time skin moisturizer. Thick and creamy, this is meant to be used at night (does not absorb quickly into the skin). I have used Crepe Erase in the past and don't feel that this lives up to its more famous brand, but overall it is a decent moisturize. I have seen a softer improvement in my skin and the crepiness  does seem to be diminished, but I am afraid it is just a temporary improvement (if I stop, I am sure it will quickly return). Overall, it's a nice moisturizer but may be overpriced.

title: A great gadget that every household should own!
text: This is a great trimmer. I got it for my husband to use as he is at that age where he is growing hair in all places except the top of his head, lol. He found this a super easy to use device, able to maneuver easily into his nose and ears. He also told me it is easy to clean and appears to be a good quality make. This would make a fantastic holiday present for the man who has everything in his life. Highly recommend!

title: Great for diminishing age spots!
text: I have been using this Hylunia product for almost three weeks now. I have always had a tendency for dark circles under my eyes as well one dark age spot on the right side of my face. I can honestly say that after using this daily, the age spot has definitely faded a bit (the under eye circles do not appear to have been impacted yet). I love that it also contains Ester C which is beneficial to my skin's tone and elasticity. Highly recommend!

title: Really fun temporary tattoos!
text: These are super fun! I wore them for Halloween when I dressed as a 'biker babe' and I got all kinds of comments and compliments! They look super realistic (especially when it's dark or dim out) and you just slide them on and off.  Super colorful and lots of designs and pictures. Highly recommend getting these for next year for a fun costume!

title: Good, light moisturizer
text: This is a nice morning moisturizer. It goes on light and is absorbed easily into the skin. I like the fact that it has some SPF protection, would be nicer if it were greater than 10, but I guess having it on under makeup there is a benefit. Light fragrance does not interfere with any perfume I may use for the day and the small portable size makes it easy to take with me when travelling.

title: Nice quality hairbrush for the money
text: This is a really nice, well made hair brush. Nice thick sturdy bristles, quality wood handle. Fits well in my hand (ergonomic) and allows me to blow dry my hair quickly and easily. It is a nice round size, too at 2.3 inches (not too wide or too narrow) so it fits a lot of my hair in the same styling motion.  Highly recommend this for anyone in the market for a new hairbrush.

title: Great facial moisturizer for men
text: I have been stressing to my 30 something year old son for years now how important it is to take care of his skin. I think now that he is getting older, he is finally beginning to understand. He has been using this for almost 3 weeks now and he loves it. When he gets out of the shower and dries, he does his usual shave routine and finishes it by applying some of this moisturizer. He says it applies lightly, absorbs quickly and has barely any fragrance which means it won't conflict with anything else he uses on his face. He says his skin has felt smoother, softer and better than it ever has. I have already bought him another bottle for a stocking stuff for Christmas since he seems to like it so much. Highly recommend.

title: Nice but expensive bar of soap
text: This is a nice lightly scented bar of soap. I have been using this daily for almost a month now and there is still plenty of the bar left. My skin is left soft, smooth and clean and I like the light lavender scent. I also love that it is 100% natural. I am deducting a star only because of the price. I think that $15 for a single bar of soap is super extravagant and I don't think I will be buying again.

title: Great facial serum made a noticeable difference in my skin!
text: This is a really nice facial serum containing collagen. I typically use a serum every morning on my face after showering and have done so for at least 20 years or so now (at the recommendation of my dermatologist). I really like this new serum from Manilla. I always thought Asian women had beautiful skin and now I think it might have to do with the rice milk ingredient (something I never tried before). This serum goes on light and absorbs easily into my skin. It has a light fragrance that I really like, too. My skin over the past few weeks has begun to look noticeably healthier, smoother and has a definite glow. I will be ordering more. Highly recommend!

title: Great pomade for all men!
text: This is my son's favorite new hair product. Applies smoothly into his hair, is not sticky, and holds his hair in place for hours. He loves the light fragrance, too, and he loves the way his hair shines. We highly recommend this for all hair types (he tends to have very dry, flyaway) and lengths (his is just below his ears).

title: Great light moisturizing cream!
text: I really like this InfiiniteAloe moisturizing cream. First, it comes in a large tub with a handy small tub that I can keep in my purse for use during the day (or if I travel overnight somewhere). I can easily refill the small container which keeps this more economical for me. When using it, the cream applies easily and my skin quickly absorbs the moisture (I have relatively dry skin). My skin is glowing and noticeably softer after using it daily for a few weeks now. I really do like the musky scent as well, it is light and almost not noticeable when absorbed. Highly recommend this cream for all.

title: Great way to help your hair look shinier and healthier!
text: I get Keratin treatments several times a year. Of course, they can add up money wise, so I have a tendency to try to stretch the times between visits to the salon. I typically use special sulfate free shampoos and also look for supplements to help my treatments last longer. This Kerazon Keratin argan oil helps fill that role.  My hair looks smoother, shinier and between treatment frizziness is diminished. I highly recommend this even if you don't do keratin treatments to keep your hair healthier and better looking.

title: Really nice way to maintain and lengthen keratin treatments
text: This is a great, reasonably priced, keratin protecting conditioneer. I have been getting either keratin or agave treatments regularly over the past 10-15 years and I always have to purchase special shampoo to maintain the treatments (sulfate free, etc). This is a comparable product to the more expensive shampoos and conditioners I have been used to buying. My hair stys sleek and shiny and I love it. Highly recommend this conditioner!

title: Great thick facial tissue for clean ups!
text: Nice thicker facial tissue. Great to use for cleanups (they hold up to water and wringing). I carry several with me in my purse at all times and use them whether it be for spending the day with my two young grandsons or simply to remove and retouch makeup after a long day of wear. They can also be used as facial tissue but keep in mind they are on the thicker side. I think all moms (and grandmoms) should carry these with them at all times.

title: Great way to scrub and exfoliate!
text: I have been using scrubs in the shower for the past few years. I have really dry, crepey skin and scrubs really help. I wasn't sure what to expect when I saw these cubes, couldn't figure out if I would be able to control it in the shower (trying to get it onto my legs and arms). I was pleasantly surprised, however, to see how easy it was.  As I begin to use it the cube stays in the palm of my hand and begins to 'melt' slowly as I moved it up and down my arms and legs. There was plenty to go around and it was super easy to use. My skin felt amazing after just one use. I really did like the fragrance, too. I will be buying a few more of these for myself and also as stocking stuffers for my two daughter-in-laws (a unique gift). Highly recommend!

title: Really nice fragrant moisturizing soap
text: Nice size bar of soap with a lot of botanical ingredients. I love the fragrance, it's light but makes the shower fragrant and fun. I love the fruit and vegetable extracts, makes me feel I am doing something good and natural for my skin.  After using several times already, my skin feels soft and smooth and the smell lingers lightly. Not sure if $7 is too much for this soap (I can buy a package of soaps for this price) but it is the ingredients that make this special. Recommend!

title: Great hold, great smell, not your Grandfather's Old Spice!
text: I got this for my son (age 35) to use. He typically likes to use some kind of gel in his hair to help maintain the slightly spikey look he likes his hair to have. He was reluctant at first, thinking Old Spice was something his grandfather used to use. He was pleasantly surprised. It smelled great, was easy to apply and his hair held well all day without any stickiness. This would make a great stocking stuffer for Christmas (in fact, I already ordered another set for that very reason). Highly recommend.

title: Nice, large facial tissue
text: These are a larger, thicker facial tissue, perfect for wetting and wiping down sticky hands and faces. I like to carry them to help keep my makeup in check after a long day wearing mascara and eyeliner. They can also be used for nose blowing and other typical facial tissues, but not sure how well they will flush (as I stated they are larger and thicker than standard tissues). Recommend if you are looking for a stronger tissue to carry with you.

title: Nice, thick, facial tissue
text: These are a thicker facial tissue, perfect for wetting and wiping down sticky hands and faces. I like to carry them to help keep my makeup in check after a long day wearing mascara and eyeliner. They can also be used for nose blowing and other typical facial tissues, but not sure how well they will flush (as I stated they are thicker). Recommend if you are looking for a stronger tissue to carry with you.

title: Great moisturizing skin cream!
text: This is one of the nicest skin moisturizers I have ever tried. It goes on super silky and is quickly absorbed into my overly dry skin. Lightly fragranced, you will not have a conflict with any perfume/fragrance you will be using. My crepey skin has begun to look much better after using this daily for the past 3 weeks. I love this applicator bottle as well. I keep it in my bathroom and after I shower I pump a little on the palm of my hand and then smooth it over my legs and arms. I highly recommend this for all (men and women) to help your skin feel and look health.

title: Nice foot mask, softens skin and diminshes cracked skin
text: I have extremely dry feet and cracked heels. I have used these three times now and I do notice a difference. My skin is softer and the cracks are noticeably diminished. I have deducted a star simply because I do not like the way these come. Both socks are attached together and I need a scissor to separate them. It would be so much easier if they had a perforated place to make it easy to tear them apart.

title: Wonderful shampoo, helps prolong the time between expensive keratin treatments!
text: I have naturally wavy, thicker hair. I always get keratin treatments several times a year to help remove the frizz and allow my hair to stay straighter longer. Since I used these keratin treatments I have to be sure to use sulfate free products to help the chemicals remain in my hair follicles as long as possible. However, sometimes the shampoos that the keratin manufacturers recommend can cost as much as the treatments themselves. I loved that when I found this Alterna shampoo it had everything I need to maintain my hair health. Vegan and sulfate/paraben free, this shampoo is safe to use on my colored and treated hair. My hair looks beautiful, clean, shiny and smooth. I highly recommend this shampoo for everyone!

title: Not much for the dark circles, but definitely a great moisturizer
text: Nice, light moisturizing under eye skin cream. Goes on silky and is readily absorbed into the skin. I have been using it for several weeks now but, to be honest, I haven't seen any noticeable difference in my dark circles or fine lines. I do, however, feel a difference in the elasticity of my skin and there is a noticeable glow. Can't recommend this 100%, but it might work for you, so worth a try (even just for the improved moisturized and softness of your skin).

title: Great exfoliating cleanser for daily use!
text: I really like this Trilane Daily Cleanser. First, it has a great fragrance (light but clean smelling). Second, it works well to remove all my make up at the end of the day and allows my skin time to breathe and refresh (with some light night creme of course). It's so important to keep your skin clean and pores unclogged. The light exfoliation helps me keep my skin feeling smooth and fresh. This is now a part of my daily regimen, highly recommend!

title: Nice device, works well on thinner hairs - great for upper lip
text: This Cadeya Eyebrow Hair Remover is a nice product. Sleek, thin, easy to use and relatively quiet. I use it for between eyebrow threading visits and it has helped me space out the visits a little more.  I cannot use this exclusively, though, as my eyebrows tend to grow relatively thick and this razor really isn't good for thicker hair. I like it on peach fuzz (like new growth between my brows and my upper lip). Nice addition to my bathroom routine.

title: Useful and easy to set up and clip! Has everything you need for all hair types
text: I was looking for a hair clipper that was versatile and could be used on adults as well as children during this pandemic. This Toovren set is just perfect. It has loads of attachments to be able to do the job professionally and quickly. Parts are easy to switch out and clean. Fits well in my hand and makes hair cutting a breeze (even when my two young grandsons are squirming on my kitchen stool, lol). Highly recommend if you are in the market for a new hairclipper.

title: My skin feels soft and super clean. Love this!
text: Larger size bottle works great in my kitchen where, with the pandemic, I find myself washing my hands many times a day. This Dead Sea brand is great in helping keep my skin clean while also supplying my skin with minerals and nutrients. I love the light fragrance, too. My hand feel soft and smooth after using this almost continuously for the past three weeks. Again, this is a large size and would work well in a work place/ high traffic bathroom as well. I highly recommend.

title: Perfect sunscreen stick to take on the go!
text: This is an absolutely perfect sunscreen stick. First, it is a great size, easy for me to carry it in my purse at all times. Second it goes on light and smooth. Like most sunscreen, it does feel slightly greasy, but it does absorb fairly quickly. The fact that this is an SPF 50 makes it all the better (especially since I live in Florida and I am constantly applying some kind of sunscreen to minimize the impact of our super strong sun). I highly recommend this for all, even school age children since this will fit in a backpack easily.

title: Really love this mango scent!
text: Nice light mango fragrance, which lasts for a long time. Thick, easy to apply and absorbs readily into my skin. I have super dry legs and feet (blame the Florida sun) and this body butter is great. My legs feel soft and smooth after using this for the past two weeks. I even rub my hands and arms after I apply to my legs so I get the full benefit. This is a great moisturizer and I highly recommend.

title: Nice way to moisturizer and keep your skin looking its best!
text: Nice berry fragrance, which lasts for a long time. Thick, easy to apply and absorbs readily into my skin. I have super dry legs and feet (blame the Florida sun) and this body butter is great. My legs feel soft and smooth after using this for the past two weeks. I even rub my hands and arms after I apply to my legs so I get the full benefit. This is a great moisturizer and I highly recommend.

title: Sturdy small emery boards in a value size package
text: These are nice, on the smaller size, emery boards. They are good for one use (two maximum) as they do wear easily. But, I guess that is why they come in a handy value size. They work well (especially on thicker nails) and fit easily in my pocketbook. Great for travel.

title: Well made and multi-functional!
text: This is an amazing two in one iron. I have naturally wavy hair and it never seems to do anything on it's own. I regularly use an iron to straighten it, but I had not tried curling it until I received this device. I absolutely was thrilled with the results (although I certainly need additional practice). I like that I can go from straight hair to curled hair with a simple device. This is well made, heats up quickly and fits well in my hand making styling a breeze. I highly recommend this to everyone looking for a diversified iron.

title: Really nice cleanser for every day use, packed with nutrients
text: I have myself on a daily beauty regimen of washing my face at least twice daily (and then applying serums and moisturizers/creams). I was looking for a good facial cleanser and, when I saw this had Vitamin C and retinol I had to try it. I have been using this exclusively for over two weeks now. I can see the difference in my skin mainly from a glowy healthy appearance. Light fragrance, it cleanses my skin and supplies nutrients. I highly recommend this to everyone who is looking to keep their skin healthy and youthful.

title: Great gental facial scrub, good for every day use!
text: I have been using this almost daily in the mornings before I shower for almost three weeks now. I can honestly say that my skin feels softer, smoother and definitely brighter. I love that this scrub is mild enough to use on the face but strong enough to remove the dead skin and keep my skin looking optimal. I also love that it has green tea extract which I know is an antioxidant which makes me feel good about using this. This scrub smells great and is reasonably priced and I will be purchasing more once this is done. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a facial scrub.

title: Great way to remove facial hair easy and flawlessly!
text: This is a great facial hair remover. Since I am now using this I figure I am saving $10 a month (at least) on getting my upper lip waxed. This is super easy to use and in seconds the peach fuzz is gone and my skin is smooth. I think this makes a great gift for the woman in your life who seems to have everything. I highly recommend.

title: Every household should own this clipper set!
text: I am writing this in the midst of the current pandemic. Both my husband, son and two grandsons were desperately in need of a haircut by the time June came. When I got this clipper set I was a little hesitant as I have never given a haircut before (nor even used a set like this). I decided to start on my two grandsons (in the likely event I screwed up, my grandsons might not notice, lol). Surprisingly, this was super easy to use. It has a lot of changeable heads which are easily interchanged and make customizing a cut easily. These clippers fit well in my hand and are easy to maneuver. I highly recommend these to everyone.

title: A must have for every household!
text: Nothing like having a pandemic strike your community and it turns out that after months in quarantine the men in your life desperately need a haircut and nothing is open. This hair clipper set is great. I had my two grandsons visiting several weeks ago and luckily I had just received this. Easily (and this is coming from someone who has never cut hair before) maneuverable, this trimmer fits ergonomically in your hand and makes cutting a breeze (even on a wiggly 3 year old). After I was done both the boys, and their mom, told me how great the hair turned out. My daughter-in-law even joked that she is going to bring them back next month for a trim (and I lovingly told her it would be my pleasure). This clipper has lots of changeable parts to assure you can cut accurately and easily. I highly recommend!

title: Wonderful facial brush that works amazingly!
text: I love this UMICKOO facial brush. I keep it in my shower and every morning while I shower I use it to keep my skin super clean. It has multiple speeds to I can concentrate on areas that I need to (like the enlarged poors on my nose). During this pandemic I haven't been able to get facials at the spa, so this is a great alternative. The vibration helps stimulate the collagen in my skin and the brushes really get in and clean off all makeup and dirt. I highly recommend this for men and women and it would make a great gift!

title: Works best for curling hair
text: Versatile hair styling tool, can straighten or curl hair with simple change of attachments. I typically have to straighten my hair every morning so I was excited to use this. I honestly didn't care for it as much as my regular 2 inch ceramic straightener. It took me a lot longer than usual since this surface was a little smaller than what I am used to. I feel this would probably be better used as a curling tool, but just my opinion. Well made and will last for years.

title: Great conditioning hair set for everyone!
text: This is really an amazing shampoo and conditioner combination. Not only does it get your hair clean, it also has argyle oil which helps keep your hair smooth and shiny and in great condition. By keeping your scalp hydrated it helps minimize dandruff. To me this new Head and Shoulders variety is one of the best in the market today. It also has a light fragrant rose essence which makes your hair smell great as well. Highly recommend this for all people, young or old, male or female, whether you have dandruff issues or not. This is great hair care!

title: Salon results in my home!
text: I have been going to the nail salon for probably 20+ years now. Starting with acrylic and powder nail extensions, I finally decided to have them removed and let my natural nails recover. In the past few years I began using gel nail polish as a means to keep my polish lasting longer. So, every two weeks I was off to the nail salon do a basic manicure and gel polish (and it would run me $25). When I saw this dryer, I thought I would try to do a home nail salon experience. To my surprise, this works great! I do my nails myself and use this gel dryer and it is just like being in the salon (minus the salon germs, lol). I still will probably go to the salon every 4-6 weeks or so because I do like the way the salon works my cuticles. However, I feel I am easily saving $25 a month now doing every other application from the convenience of my own home. Highly recommend!

title: Great full service hair clipper kit
text: This is a really high quality clipper set. I got this during the 2020 pandemic and thought I would try to give my two grandsons haircuts. To be honest, I never gave a haircut before so I was a little nervous (luckily they are only ages 3 and 6). I was amazed how easy this was to use. Their hair came out neat and even and I really had no difficulty at all. In fact, my daughter in law asked if she could bring them back to my house when they need their next trim, lol. Anyway, I highly recommend keeping a set like this in your home, you may find it comes in handy. I can see using this for a man's neck trim between cuts which helps save money and extends the time between salon visits.

title: Really nice moisturizer!
text: This is a really nice daily facial moisturizer. I use it daily after showering. It absorbs quickly and leaves y face feeling soft and smooth all day. It is non-greasy and applies easily. My face glows when I use this. I love the fragrance and will definitely be purchasing more when I have depleted this jar. I highly recommend for men and women of all ages as a great way to moisturizer your skin.

title: Expensive but does keep skin moisturized
text: I have been using this oil for over two weeks now on a daily basis. Jury is still out on the pure benefits. On the plus side there are vitamins in this oil (but no retinol) so it is good for my skin. Goes on a little oily, takes a while to absorb. My skin does feel softer since using, haven't really seen a significant difference in elasticity or in the fine lines (crow's feet) around my eyes. On the negative side, at over $40 I don't think this is worth it. I have some really great facial serums at 30% of the price that, in my opinion, work much better.

title: Great compact eye shadow set
text: Super cute compact eye shadow. Fits perfectly in my handbag (or make up case) and makes it super convenient for mid-day touch ups. Great variety of colors, from light to darker for highlighting.  Lasts for several hours without needing reapplication. Some of the colors are lightly frosty, too, so makes my eyes pop with color. I really love this mini palette and I highly recommend to everyone.

title: Perfect set of clippers, couldn't ask for better
text: I was looking for something to help aid my family during this pandemic and this set of clippers is just what I was looking for. Easy to use, easy to change heads, this clipper makes it easy to cut male hair (and trust me, I didn't have a lot of confidence in my own hair cutting skills). Fits well in my hand and is able to maneuver easily. I believe every house should have this clipper in their house to have in the event they are either unable to get out for a formal cut or simply to do a quick clean up between formal cuts.  Highly recommend.

title: Great daily skin care aid to a beauty regimen!
text: Nice basic serum to be used daily to help diminish signs of aging. I have been using serums every day in my beauty routine and this hyaloronic serum is really nice. The fact that it also contains vitamin C is a definite plus for my skin regimen and I know that this is good for me.  This is also super reasonably priced. No woman over the age of 30 should be without this in their bathroom. Highly recommend.

title: Seems to work well, booties are super slippery, though
text: I have extremely dry feet, especially in the heel area. I was excited to see how this foot mask would work. I have used three of these already and I have seen a difference in my feet. They are softer and less dry and do appear to work. I have deducted a star simply because these are step in plastic booties with liquid inside and can be messy. I did have to massage the booties while they were on my feet to be sure they were fully covered (and not sure if I got it all). Also, while they are on, be aware you cannot stand or walk in them (unless you want to slide and potentially fall) so be sure you stay in place while wearing. I think this concept would have been better with applying the liquid to my feet first and then putting the booties on (rather than having the liquid already in them and trying to cover all the areas by massaging.

title: This should be a beauty staple for every woman!
text: If you are in the market for an eyelash curler, this is the one. First, it works great curling my usually straight eyelashes. Second, it fits well in my hand, is easy to maneuver and my lashes do not stick to it. Last, it's super cute in color and looks great in my bathroom. Highly recommend.

title: Putty is a daily part of my son's regimine!
text: This is a fabulous hair aid. My son has hair that is a little longer on the top than it is on the sides and he always uses some kind of control gel to keep his hair in place. He absolutely loves this Head & Shoulders product. It is strong, but it is barely noticeable in his hair (leaving his hair natural looking). It has basically an odorless formula and it doesn't flake at all after hours on his hair. To top it all off, it helps keep his scalp moisturized and helps minimize dandruff. He highly recommends this for anyone who is looking for a strong control and also is trying to reduce dandruff.

title: Another great Amazon Solimo brand!
text: I try to get keratin treatments to keep my hair smoother and minimize frizz several times a year. When I do, I have to always use shampoos that are paraben and sulfate free. And, you guess it, the shampoos are usually more expensive than regular shampoos. When I saw this Amazon brand shampoo I wanted to try it. Usually, Solimo products are just as good as named brand varieties. This shampoo did not disappoint! After using this shampoo for almost a month now, several times a week, my hair is smooth and silky and is just as good as shampoos I have spent three times more for. I also love this coconut fragrance, too! Highly recommend this quality shampoo for all hair types, but particularly for those who want their hair shiny, frizz free and smelling great!

title: Great straightening iron!
text: Nice ceramic iron, use this daily for straightening my hair. Fits in my hand nice (ergonomic), evenly distributes heat along the device and makes styling a breeze. Doesn't transfer heat to my countertops. Looks very modern, too, and the crisp white color looks great on my bathroom countertop. Highly recommend this iron if you are in the market for buying one.

title: The jury may still be out...
text: I have been using this for about 3 weeks now. Goes on like water, takes a bit for the skin to absorb it. After it dries, I finish it up with a Glo Skin moisturizer. I am used to getting microderms and even peels to help keep my skin fresh. I can't really say that I see a major difference with using this liquid, however, I do know my skin feels smooth and has a glow to it. I will continue to use this in conjunction with my regular beauty regimen and will update this review if my results substantially change.

title: Great compact bag, stores a lot!
text: This is a really nice compact travel toiletry bag. Loads of compartments, great for my make up, medicines, vitamins and hair supplies. I love that it folds up into a neat compact case and that it can open up and hang (I usually put it in the hotel bathroom on the back of the door on a towel hook). This isn't for very large items, but is great for probably 90% of my items. Quality made, zippers are strong. Highly recommend!

title: Great beauty mask, really works!
text: I have been using this retinol mask for a few weeks now, twice a week. My skin is softer, and fine lines (particularly around my eyes) have been greatly diminished. This all natural mask goes on smoothly and rinses off easily. I also use retinol at night when I go to bed, so I get the optimal impact of the mask and the serum. I am a 60 year old woman and my skin has never looked better. Highly recommend this for all ages to keep your skin looking its best.

title: Great, pretty tweezers!
text: These are a super nice pair of tweezers. Fit's well in my hand, makes doing a tedious job easier. This tweezer comes with a little case, too, which makes it nice for traveling or just for keeping in my handbag. I love this rose gold color, too, makes them look super fancy. I bought another one for my mom and plan to give it to her next weekend as a little surprise gift. Really nice and I highly recommend!

title: For the money you can't go wrong!
text: For the money (at the time of this review this palette is around $6) this is a great eye shadow palette. Loads of colors which blend easily and last for several hours. Of course, I have had much better, but most times the Sephora brand has cost me over $50. I think this would make a great gift for a young girl, but reality is it can work for anyone. Highly recommend for the price.

title: Wonderful way to keep your lips soft and smooth!
text: I love this Nivea blackberry lip care stick. First, the fragrance is wonderful (reminds me of 'flavored' lip glosses I used to use when a teen. Secondly, it keeps my lips soft and smooth. I live in Florida where the sun and beachside winds can sometimes wreak havoc on my skin. My lips are always feeling dry and this Nivea product, in my opinion, is better than any typical Chapstick ones. Nivea has always been part of my daily skin regime and now I can add lipcare as well. Highly recommend!

title: Super great shimmer lip balm!
text: I have been using some sort of a 'chapstick' for years (starting from when I was a kid). My opinion used to be that it is used for when either it's very cold and dry out or if your lips are just overly chapped. Since I found this new Nivea Shimmer Lip variety, I am now using it daily as part of a makeup routine. It is light and shiny and makes my lips look super natural but with a shine.  Instead of a 'regular' lipstick/lip gloss, this Nivea aid keeps my lips soft and smooth at all times and gives me the added benefit of being like a lip gloss. I highly recommend this to anyone with dry, chapped lips or anyone who just wants to look their best (while doing good for skin).

title: Great hyaluronic acid serum for daily use
text: Really nice serum. Goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly. I have been using hyaluronic acid serums daily for 10+ years now (ever since my dermatologist recommended it). My 60 something year old skin looks far younger than it did (even after loads of sun in my youth). Of course, there are loads of products in the market, many less expensive than this one, however, this is one of the best I have used. I love H20 products in general and use them every day. I love all the quality ingredients in this one (check labels, folks) and will stick with this serum on an on-going basis. Highly recommend.

title: Just as good as the named brands at a reduced cost!
text: I get keratin treatments for my hair probably 3 times a year. As such, I always have to use shampoos and conditioners that are sulfate free. Typically, most of the products I use are expensive, so I was looking for an alternative. I absolutely love this Amazon Brand product. Just as good as using a  more expensive salon brand, this shampoo leaves my hair soft and smooth and because its paraben and sulfate free, I  can keep it that way at much less cost. Kudos Amazon for creating another great generic product which is just as great as the named brand products. Oh, and I love the fragrance of this Argan Oil, too!

title: Moisturizes well
text: This is a good moisturizing mask. I say good and not excellent just because I have been using it for three weeks now, twice a week, and haven't seen a really noticeable difference in my skin. This small tube does seem to go a long way. It goes on smoothly and evenly. When it dries, it is easy to remove. Does not leave your skin feeling tight (I kind of like that feeling when I use a mask because I feel it is closing my pores). After using, my skin does feel soft so I do know it does provide a good moisturizing effect on your skin. Not sure if I will be buying more as I was really looking for more of a pore tightener.

title: Great basic line razor!
text: I had my husband use this for almost a month so this review is largely based on his feedback. First, it comes in an attractive box, perfect for gift giving. Second, it's reasonably priced as a baseline razor. There are far better models of electric razors on the market, but for more than twice the cost. This razor is lightweight and fits very well in his hand (ergonomically correct). He maneuvers it easily and the shave he receives is surprisingly as close as the more expensive Braun models. Although he said he will be primarily using his better models, he will keep this one around mostly for business travel (due to its compactness) and as a back up to his 7000 series. He highly recommends this model, especially for those men who have not used an electric razor in the past and want to try it.

title: Absolutely fantastic shampoo and conditioner!
text: This is one of my favorite shampoos and conditioners on the market today. First, I love the light fragrance, like no other I have tried. Second, it cleans my hair and leaves it soft and smooth and prepares me for my straightening regimin. I love how my hair feels and smells and this convenient larger pump size is fantastic and makes washing my hair a breeze. I highly recommend this shampoo to keep your hair looking it's best and keeping it healthy by moisturizing down to the cuticle.

title: Great under eye moisturizing and refreshing cream!
text: This is a really nice eye cream. I apply it in the morning when I wake up and again before I sleep at night. I can noticeably see the results since I have been using it. Especially in the morning, I see my eyes look refreshed and dark circles have been definitively reduced. The intensive moisturizer is just what my under eyes needed and I am so glad I found this cream. I have purchased another one to keep in my handbag to use for mid afternoon application or if I am planning on going out after work to keep me looking younger and healthier. Highly recommend for all ages and all skin types.

title: Great facial cleanser, but really so much more!
text: I really like this CellDetox product. First, it is light and foams right out of the bottle. Second, it applies easily to the skin and allows me to gently massage to remove all my makeup. Third, it leaves my skin feeling clean and smoother than it did before I started using it. I never thought I could find a facial cleanser that actually softens and improves the elasticity of my skin and helps moisturize. I am in my 60's and living in Florida and have been looking for a cleanser just like this. Highly recommend!

title: Great shampoo and conditioner for men!
text: I will say that for people of a 'certain generation', they may not like this. I originally asked my 35 year old son to try and review this, but he said he didn't like 'Old Spice'. So, I had my 70 year old brother try it. In regards to my brother, he absolutely loved this pairing. He loved the fragrance and the way his hair was clean and super soft after using the shampoo and conditioner. I guess the stigma of Old Spice is still out there as an 'old man' fragrance, but I don't understand it. I found the fragrance to be pleasant and my brother's hair looks great after using this exclusively for several weeks now. Old Spice will need to change some of their marketing ploys to begin catering to a younger group of men, but I will say that for my brother, he loved it.

title: Great, gentle but thorough cleanser for your skin
text: I love Vichy products and have a lot of them in my every day beauty regimen. This new cleansing water is amazing. Light and refreshing, it gets the job done and removes all my foundation and shadows while leaving my skin soft, smooth and clean. I like this so much better than most sudsy cleansers I have used and my 60-something skin has never looked better since using it every night for the last month. Highly recommend this for anyone at any age.

title: I guess you truly get what you pay for
text: I typically use Thrive mascara which has fibers in it to give the appearance of longer lashes (almost like you had extensions put on). When I saw this, I was hoping it would be good as the other mascara is super expensive ($35). I was really disappointed. First, it is really thick and gooey. I found my lashes sticking together and instead of really lengthening, they just became fuller. Next, I found it easily smudged and left me with some circles under my eyes after only a couple of hours. I guess, for the $10 price, it might work in a pinch to give you thicker lashes but I won't be using it again.

title: Great sulfate free shampoo with a wonderful Herbal Essences fragrance!
text: I get Keratin treatments a few times a year and I typically buy some pretty expensive shampoo to help retain and prolong the keratin. One thing I cannon use on my hair is sulfates (or it strips the keratin). When I saw that this Herbal Essences shampoo was sulfate free, I thought I would try it. I always loved Herbal Essences and used to have it exclusively in the shower back many years ago. This shampoo is wonderful, leaves my hair soft and shiny and smells wonderful (lightly coconut fresh fragrance) and I don't have to worry about stripping my hair. Highly recommend for anyone who wants the best for their hair!

title: Definite improvement in my skin
text: For the positives, my skin, after using, feels smooth and soft and definitely hydrated and glowing. For the negatives, I didn't find the application that easy (sheets are wet and sides stick together making it awkward to get it on my face) and the fragrance to me (during application) was kind of strong. I will recommend to anyone who wants their skin to feel and look better, just think they could have done a better and easier way to apply it (and toned down the scent a bit).

title: Nice to use on bare skin, my skin looks noticeably healthier!
text: This is a really nice, unique serum (when compared to others I have been using). I mostly use it on bare skin and add it on before I walk the dog in the morning and then reapply mid day. I really like the way my skin has been looking since I have been using it daily for a little over 3 weeks. My 60 year old skin has a youthful, healthy glow and feels soft and smooth and healthy. Highly recommend this for anyone looking to add a boost to your normal skin care routine!

title: Great reasonably priced electric razor!
text: My husband loved this Philips Norelco model. First, it's a compact size, nice to travel with or just store in your bathroom between uses. Second, it does the job and keeps his shave close. Third, it's a really reasonable price (at the time of this writing Amazon didn't have a price on this, but I did find it on the open marketplace for less than $50). The box it came in is attractive and this would make a great gift for someone in your life. There are far better models out there in the market today, but for the money, this is a great choice!

title: This is the foundation I have been waiting for!
text: I have used a lot of makeup and foundations over my life. I honestly can say that, by far, for the money this Revlon PhotoReady foundation is some of the best I have ever used. It applies easily and smoothly, covering all my skin imperfections. The vitamin E and pear oil moisturizes my skin and, however it works, truly leaves my skin softer and radiant. The first night I wore this out to dinner I received a lot of compliments (something I have never received before when it comes to any makeup). I highly recommend this foundation for all ages and skin types. Just perfect!

title: Nice moisturizer, but expensive for what you get
text: For pluses, this is a nice moisturizer, 100% vegan and made with all natural ingredients.  I have been using it almost daily after I get out of the shower, particularly on my hands and face and my skin is noticeably softer. For minuses, this is a really small bottle for the $30+ price they are charging. It does come with a pump (which may be over kill considering the size of the bottle.  Scent was ok for me but would have liked it if it was a little lighter (once it is absorbed, though, the fragrance significantly diminishes). Bottom line, I probably won't be buying again due to the cost vs. volume.

title: Great moisturizing lip gloss!
text: Really nice lip gloss. I love the Short Change color. I put it on in the morning before I go to work and it does seem to last for a couple of hours before I need to reapply. Nice and shiny, your lips will look great when you have this Exhibitionist gloss on. Also find this to be great at moisturizing as my lips feel much softer and smoother since I have been using this in the cold weather for the past few weeks. Highly recommend.

title: Wonderful moisturizing blush!!
text: I love L'Oreal makeup products. Always a quality product at a super reasonable price. This Radiant Stain Blush product is no exception. It goes on light and it has a moisturizing impact with the camelia oil added in. Lasts for hours, looks great and it's just what I was looking for for my sixty-something old face. Highly recommend this for anyone, particularly anyone with drier skin.

title: Nice blush to use on skin without makeup
text: My new favorite makeup accessory. This is a great light blush that I use (to look more natural) on my own skin (without a foundation). Goes on easily, stays present for hours. Does leave your skin looking fresh and clean. Highly recommend for those times when you don't need a foundation and just want a nice healthy glow to your skin.

title: Great hair waver but is a tedious chore
text: This is a great ceramic waver for hair. It is fairly easy to use, but it took me almost an hour to do my entire head of hair (despite the fact that this has a larger plate for more hair at a time than other curler/wavers. This fits well in my hand (ergonomically easy) and it was easy to maneuver. Not sure how often I will be using this (I typically prefer my hair on the straight side) but I will use it for special occasions since it seems so tedious to go section by section. This would be easy to use on someone else in lieu of doing my own hair. Might ask a friend to help me with mine next time for sure.

title: Score another home run for Cover Girl!
text: This is a great eyeliner. Super easy to apply and lasts for hours (I applied it at 4:00 PM for a night out and it was still looking fresh on my eyes when I returned at midnight). Full coverage, it's one stick that will solve your eyeliner needs. I really love this Emerald Metallic color, it's unique and I have received a load of compliments while wearing it (especially at holiday parties this year). I highly recommend!

title: Great brush set, perfect for everything
text: This is a great brush set. Not sure why they specify this for travel because I think it's great for all the time. I keep this in my bathroom and use it daily when I apply makeup and then, if I am going somewhere after work I stash it in my purse for use later. I have taken this set while traveling as well. This would also make a great gift or stocking stuffer during the holidays. Just a perfect set of brushes for all your needs from blush to shadow. Highly recommend!

title: Great facial cleanser brush!
text: This is a small, quality made facial brush. I love the size of this, in minutes my face is fresh and clean. Easy to charge using the USB port, set up and clean the brush. I love how my skin feels after using this, cleaning and stimulating collagen production in my 60 something year old skin. I have been using this twice daily for a few weeks now and I highly recommend to all.

title: Really nice facial cleanser, great for sensitive and problem skin
text: I have extremely sensitive, dry skin, exacerbated by some moderate psoriasis. I am always on the look out for skin products I can use which will not irritate my skin and will improve the overall appearance of my skin. When I saw this cleanser I wanted to try it and I am glad I did. First, I love the light (almost indistinguishable) fragrance and second I love how clean and fresh my skin feels after using it, removing all makeup. I have been using this twice daily exclusively for over 3 weeks and I can tell you that this is one of the finest products I have used on my face to date. I highly recommend!

title: Great toning water. A must have for your daily skin regimine.
text: I love this. A quick spritz in the morning and evening on freshly washed skin keeps my skin looking optimal and feeling great. I use this before applying my hyaluronic acid serum and it preps my skin like a toner and allows all my other beauty treatments to quickly absorb and optimize their impacts. I have been using this now for almost a month and it is great for my 60 something year old skin. I highly recommend!!!!

title: What a great, easy to use device!
text: I wasn't sure what to expect when I ordered this. I have slightly wavy hair which leaves me having to do something with my hair every morning (either flat iron to straighten it or use curlers to get curls). This is super easy to use and, instead of my having to wait for curlers to do the job, I can curl my hair within minutes! My hair comes out super shiny, full bodied and I can make the curls as tight or as loose as I want. The ceramic material prevents damage to the hair, so this is safe to use daily. I will never go back to standard curlers again! This would make a wonderful gift for the holidays!

title: Not truly a glossy finished, difficult to remove
text: This didn't work well for me. First, it is definitely more of a matte color than a gloss. Second, the color (in my case purple) was next to impossible to take off without make up remover. I actually touched my lips with my forefinger to try to smooth out a missing area and I couldn't get the color off my finger without scrubbing. So, if you are looking for a more matte color that is super longlasting, than this Revlon Ultra HD Vinyl is for you.

title: Super shiny lip gloss!
text: I really love this gloss (Glace). It's clear and makes a perfect addition to any matte lipstick to bring out the shine on your lips. I used it this weekend and got a lot of compliments on my makeup. Long lasting, super shiny, full coverage, this is great either as a standalone gloss or over your favorite color. Highly recommend!

title: Good as an extra set of brushes
text: This is a cute, inexpensive way to get multiple brushes in one handy applicator. It's perfect as a travel pack. Reality is, these are not high quality brushes (and they will not be replacing the nicer ones I bought at Sephora a few months ago). However, for the money, these are a great way to get a variety of brushes at a reasonable price. That's why I think these are good for a young girl or, like I said, useful for travel when you don't want to carry your best brushes with you. They do apply blush and shadow ok. Might make a good stocking stuffer for a younger girl for the holidays.

title: Nice looking, reasonably priced wig. Runs small.
text: Got this thinking I could use it for Halloween. I will say that it the appearance is like the pictures. Was a little small on my head (I wear a 7 3/4 hat) so I had to give it to a friend. Fit her perfectly and looked really good on her. Just be sure if you have a larger size head you take that into consideration before ordering. Overall, for the money, this is a good wig.

title: Great for volumizing and giving your hair incredible shine!
text: Very nice moisturizing shampoo. Chock full of vitamins (Vitamins C, E and B5) this shampoo leaves my normally fine hair soft and fuller. I love the light scent,  my hair looks like I just came out of a salon with enhanced volume and shine. If I had any complaints at all, it's the size of the tube (like a tube of toothpaste). Typically, I prefer a larger bottle, especially for the cost/oz., but I guess you get what you pay for. Outside of the size and the value, this is a really good shampoo (sulfate free as well).

title: Fantastic curling iron, best I have ever used!
text: Great curling iron. Perfect blade width/size for my shoulder length hair (1 1/2 inch). This heats up quickly and is easy to maneuver around my hair. Makes it easy to curly my typically straight hair in just a matter of minutes. I use this daily after showering and drying my hair and works as well as my old curlers that I used prior to using this iron (in 1/10th of the time). This gold tone is really nice, too, and looks attractive on my bathroom countertop. Highly recommend to anyone who wants an easy, flawless way to curl your hair.

title: Really nice hand moisturizer!
text: Great smelling, super moisturizing hand cream. I keep this tube in my purse and use this several times a day. As a teacher, I am always using hand sanitizers and it is necessary to keep my skin moisturized to combat the drying effect of the sanitizers. I just love the way my hands smell (lightly fragranced and fresh) and feel after using. Highly recommend!

title: Great tear free shampoo!
text: Great kids shampoo. Leaves hair clean, fresh smelling and conditioned. I love the way the shea butter leaves the hair shining and feeling great. Also this is tear-free so no worrying about my grandchildren's eyes burning after use. I love Johnson's products for their quality and care in producing products for our families. I highly recommend!

title: Nice facial cleansing brush but needs a few improvements
text: I used to go for facials a minimum of 2-3 times a month and occasionally a microderm. Now that I am retired (April19), I have had to cut back to only once a month (to save some money). So, when I saw this cleansing tool by Revlon, I thought it could be a great alternative to expensive facials and be able to stimulate collagen and cleanse my face. For positives, this is easy to hold and maneuver, brushes are easy to exchange out and it is small and portable (great if I travel). For negatives, the speeds don't really go fast enough for me to get a really good cleansing and the battery doesn't hold a charge for more than two days worth of use. I also think that having to replace the brush heads is eventually going to get expensive if I do it regularly (like they recommend). Anyway, it's a nice brush but they have somethings they could improve.

title: Great daily body wash for men with the added benefit of exfoliating!
text: Both my 35 year old son and husband have been using this daily for the last almost 2 months. They both absolutely love it. For years I have been expressing to them the benefits of exfoliation and I guess they thought the idea fairly effeminate. With this Nivea product, they are finally reaping the benefits of exfoliating and smoothing their skin (face and body). I can honestly say that my husband (who will be 67 in October) has never looked better. I know now they are both sold on this product and I highly recommend it not just for exfoliating but for a terrific body wash that leaves one feeling revived and smelling great. Highly recommend!

title: Really bright and great to have around!
text: Great vanity mirror and a really nice size. It works off batteries and packs a punch when it comes to lighting (almost scary to see my skin that close up, lol). Not sure if I would travel with this (it's a little big for packing in a suitcase for my taste), but it's great for use in my bedroom when I want to finish up makeup applications (while my husband uses the bathroom). I also really like it for eyebrow tweezing as I can find little hairs I had never seen without this close up lighting available before.Highly recommend and I could see this as a great stocking stuffer/gift for the holidays for the person in your life who has everything.

title: Didn't really work for me at all
text: Didn't really like this at all. I have naturally wavy hair and my usual routine is to wash my hair, blow dry it and then to finally use a flat iron. When I saw this brush I had high expectations thinking it would help dry and straighten my hair at the same time. I found it to do neither. It does get hot but that was about it. It's not easy to maneuver and I found it kind of awkward to hold in my hand. Maybe it's just that my hair needs a hotter, firmer iron to straighten but this didn't work for me.

title: The little steamer that really could!
text: When I was younger, I used to use a large (at least 15 inch) device where I would place my face inside to use the steam. It was big, bulky, tough to store and I didn't use it as often as I wanted (or should have). When I first saw this one I thought I would give it a shot, not expecting much. Boy, was I pleasantly surprised! This is a compact device that really packs a punch. Takes about 30 seconds to heat up but when it does it helps me keep my skin and pores clean and refreshed. Only advise would be to rinse your skin with cool water and use a toner afterwards to help close your pores. This would make a great Christmas gift to the woman in your life (think even teenagers to help keep skin clean from acne). Highly recommend if you want to keep your skin in optimum condition!

title: This is a magic bullet for my dry skin needs
text: I love Curel products. They always perform as expected and have quality products. I have extremely dry skin. Besides having some psoriasis on my elbows, my shins and feet tend to get try and flaky all the time. I really love this Extra Dry Skin Therapy variety of Curel. I apply it every morning after I shower and then at night before I go to bed. My legs and arms have never felt so smooth and soft. It is non-greasy and absorbs quickly. I highly recommend.

title: Nice facial mask
text: This is a really nice facial mask by Erno Laszlo, Easy to mix (I didn't have clumps like another reviewer stated0, easy to apply. I am deducting a star as I didn't see very dramatic results (I have used 4 of these already), but I will say applying the mask and having a half hour of 'me' time is worth it all. I love the relaxing aspect of the mask. This is also easy to peel off (don't apply too much or it will take a while to solidify).

title: Works well, it is oil based
text: I have been using this for over a month now. I do like the way my 60-something skin feels softer and it does appear plumper. I am eliminating a star as I do find it oily (well, it is oil based) and I do need to wait a good 10 minutes before applying makeup (to assure it is absorbed). I usually really like Vichy products and although this does work, not sure if I will be buying more.

title: Good light exfoliating skin cleanser
text: This is a great all natural facial cleanser with a touch of exfoliation. It is made in the USA and helps me keep my skin in optimal condition after a full day of wearing sunscreens and make up. I use it morning and evening and it has a surprisingly light scent that helps make me feel clean and refreshed. I highly recommend this to everyone to have as part of their daily skin care regimen.

title: Great eyeshadow palette!
text: This is a great little eye shadow palette, perfect for keeping in my purse with all the warm/brown shades I need. Easy to apply, lasts for hours, includes highlighting colors as well as dark for contouring. I highly recommend this NYX brand for anyone looking for some great neutral colors in a compact case.

title: Great coconut wash, cleans well and smells great!
text: This Tom's body wash is my new favorite. I love the coconut scent, very light but smells great and stays on your skin for hours. I keep a bottle of this in my and my guest bathroom showers for daily use. The moisturizing quality keeps my skin soft and smooth and I feel totally clean and refreshed after using. The light coconut fragrance reminds me of my travels to the Caribbean so every time I take a shower I'm taken away to a vacation island, lol. I highly recommend this Tom's body wash for everyone. Really nice!

title: Nice reasonably priced moisturizer with light SPF protection
text: I love Amazon Brand and particularly Solimo products. First, they are super reasonably priced. Second, they are comparable in ingredients as more expensive name brand products. This facial moisturizer is no exception. Similar to other brands, this is a nice light moisturizer which has a pleasant fragrance. It does contain minimal sunscreen protection (SPF 15) which is good right after I come out of the shower to build a base on throughout the day. Of course, in Florida my SPF needs are far higher than 15 but this product does give you that base and the moisturizer is quality and helps keep my skin hydrated. I usually use additional products in my morning routine but this is a nice product to keep in your bathroom.

title: Shiny gloss, not my favorite color
text: Didn't really like this (color or consistency). The pink was way too overwhelming, looked almost like super shiny pepto bismol on my mouth. I will say it does last (I tried removing some of it to bring the color down a notch but it was almost impossible to get it all off easily). Not for me. It is shiny and if this is a color you may be looking for maybe you should try it.

title: Revlon quality eyebrow liner
text: Nice eyebrow pencil, but it is fairly thin and not the way I typically like a brow marker to be. Might work for others and I really like Revlon products so I am rating this as 4 stars. Color is really nice (soft brown) and it does cover well, just because it is thin I need to apply several times to cover fully. Probably will work well for others.

title: Handy, well made, perfect mirror with light
text: This is a great 5 inch mirror that lights up. Perfect for keeping in my purse and using when I am out and about (doing makeup touch ups). Also great for travel as it fits almost flat and is perfect for when you need a mirror. Case is sturdy and durable and no need to fear of the mirror cracking/breaking if dropped. This would make a great stocking stuffer during the holidays for the woman/girl you love in your life.

title: Absolutely fantastic, I really love this!
text: I love this Neutrogena product. I use it in the shower every morning (while I condition my hair) and my facial skin has never been smoother or softer. I love the way it makes my face feel, too, invigorating it (almost like a menthol tingle) which lasts even after I rinse. If you love your skin, you need to take care of it, and regular exfoliation is key to keeping your skin youthful and fresh. I highly recommend this facial scrub for everyone!

title: Great super shiny gloss
text: This is a super lip gloss. My lips are hydrated while using it and the shine is amazing. Just what I was looking for. If I had to complain about anything it's that I do have to reapply during the evening, wish it was a little more long lasting. But, outside of that, it's a nice compact applicator and it makes your lips look great.

title: Great eyeliner/eyebrow pencil for all women!
text: Great for eyebrows or eyeliner, I love Revlon products. Easy to apply, long lasting and looks terrific on. Fits well in my hand and allows for ease of application and a little goes a long way. I love this rich dark brown color too. Highly recommend for all woman who want a quality liner/pencil but doesn't want to spend a fortune for it.

title: Really nice type of eyeshadow
text: As far as this eyeshadow brand goes....eyeshadow is super easy to apply, pencil is ergonomically fit in my hand and is easy to maneuver. Shadow is long lasting. I am deducting a star for the color of angelic. It is very pale, difficult to see, and not light enough to be used as a highlighter (it's almost a flesh color). I recommend this brand and the stick style of application, but I think if you are looking for something to highlight your eyes, you might want to chose another color in their palette of choices.

title: For the money, this is a good facial mask
text: This is a decent moisturizing mask for the money. Not quite as flimsy and 'wet' as other facial masks, so it easier to put on your face. However, I didn't find it fitting my face as well, so I am not sure the ingredients will get the same opportunity to be absorbed as other masks might be.
