I do like the way my face feels after using it and the fragrance is light and fresh and provides a relaxing aromatherapy experience when the mask is on. I

title: Another great Vichy facial care product!
text: This is a really nice serum at much less a cost than that on other quality products. I love Vichy products in general and this serum is no exception. Goes on easily, absorbs quickly and I see a definite brightness in my skin and complexion after just using for less than a month now. I highly recommend Vichy for all your skin care needs. Don't spend hundreds of dollars when you spend less than $50 and get the same results!

title: Great razor for every day use!
text: I exclusively use my Venus razor on a regular basis (usually in the shower) Are they more expensive than store brands? Absolutely, but in this case you truly get what you pay for. Quality made, shave flawlessly catching all hair and leaving my skin soft and smooth. This blade which is made for sensitive skin is also one of my favorites as I have no blotchiness after using, nothing but flawless skin, even when using in the bikini area. I highly recommend!

title: Facial hair remover, could have been made better
text: This is a facial tool made for removing fine hairs. Although it is technically a razor, I honestly had some trouble navigating it over the curves of my face. They really should make this more ergonomic allowing for easier manipulation and control as I found it difficult being sure to get all the hairs, especially in my lip area. Found myself going over certain places several times at different angles. I typically use a round head batter operated hair removal system which seems to work much better. I am still leaving this at 4 stars as it does work and perhaps it's just me having difficulties.

title: Great non-sticky pomade for men!
text: This is a really nice pomade for men's hair. First, it has a gel like consistency (which in my opinion gives it a cleaner feel) and it is super easy to apply and massage into hair. Second, after application your hair is non-greasy or sticky and hair is perfectly controlled. Highly recommend this pomade for the man in your life. My son, who is 35, has been using this exclusively since I received it and his hair looks great!

title: Great way to hydrate your lips and look great!!
text: This is a great way to keep your lips in great condition. Typically, I am always taking care of the skin on my face, but I never think of the lips (except when I apply gloss/color during makeup applications). This is a great way to hydrate your lips and after just a few minutes of applying, you will see an immediate difference. My thinner lips looked fuller and slightly plumper and the fine lines immediately around my lips seemed to fade away. I highly recommend this to everyone who wants to look their best, particularly before special events where you want to look your best.

title: Great convenient size way to protect your skin!
text: Great convenient sunscreen stick. I keep it in my purse and use it during the day when I am out and about in this Florida sun. It's a perfect 50 SPF which is perfect especially when I am out on the water and the sun is extra strong to protect my sixty-something skin. It glides on easily and has a light fragrance. I am deducting 1 star because it is a tad on the greasy side but overall, it's a great way to protect your skin.

title: Great palette of red shades, look amazing and long lasting!
text: I do love Covergirl products and this Quad Palette is one of my favorites to date. I didn't think I would be a big fan of this color combination because it Is mostly red shades (something I normally would not wear), but surprisingly I really liked the way these look. They go on easily and smoothly and they last me even in the summer heat and humidity when I am outside. I love the applicator as well. No complaints, just compliments. I will be trying a different color combination because I am so impressed with this palette to have some alternative colors in my wardrobe.

title: Good body wash if you are willing to pay the price
text: This is an ok body wash which does contain some vitamins (that other washes don't). Does not wash like other soap based washes (no foam). Fragrance is also ok (light, not overwhelming). I am deducting a star simply because of the price. I mean, 12 ounces for $13? I can buy two Dove body washes (which make my skin really feel moisturized after using) for the same price of this one small bottle.

title: Great lip color!
text: This is my first time of using Measurable Difference makeup and I am impressed. Beautiful color, comes in a handy applicator container, easy to apply and long lasting. I am deducting a star (although I probably shouldn't because it does call itself a matte lipstick) because there is no shine at all (something I really like in my lip wear) so I do need to dress it up a bit for my use. I do apply an over coat of clear gloss and it does work great. If you are looking for a gloss and lipstick in one, this is not for you. But if you like your lips without a sheen, or you don't mind applying a top coat, then you will love this!

title: Great serum to be using daily!
text: I love this Cerave Hyaluronic Acid product. I use it daily after showering on my 60 something skin and also at night before I go to sleep.  Not only does it have the hyaluronic acid my face needs, but it also contains vitamin B5 and helps to keep my skin hydrated. Reasonably priced (when compared to other expensive brands) this Cerave delivers on all counts. I definitely see a difference in using it for a few weeks now, my skin is plumper and looks far more youthful. I highly recommend!

title: Great shave, great price, great razor!
text: My son actually was quite impressed with this Solimo razor. He normally uses Gillette products and has for the past 15 or so years, so for him to tell me he liked this really means something. He told me that he got a really close shave and the moisturizers left his skin feeling soft and smooth, one of the best shaves he has ever had (his words). For the money, this is a great alternative to other name brands!

title: Gentle and thorough facial cleanser!
text: This is a super gentle, lightly fragranced, cleanser that I absolutely love. I tend to use keratin treatments quite often in my hair which forces me to use sulfate free shampoos. I love that this facial cleanser is also sulfate free which allows me to use it in the shower as well as at my sink without fear of getting something into my hair which will ruin my treatment. On top of it, this is a very reasonably priced product as well, which thoroughly cleans and removes my makeup. I highly recommend.

title: Nice moisturizer - not strictly hyaluronic acid
text: I use hyaluronic acid products daily so when I saw this I wanted to try it. For the positives, it contains not only the hyaluronic acid, but also a moisurizer. It has a light fragrance and is easy to apply. For the negatives (in my opinion) I didn't like the consistency of the cream, I found it more of a moisturizer than an HA product. Usually HA is more of a serum, and is light and absorbs quickly. This definitely is more of a moisturizing product with the benefit of having hyaluronic acid as a side ingredient. Anyway, for the money, it is not a bad product. I will just be using this a lot more for overnight bedtime cream than a morning/daytime product.

title: Great at home product to use!
text: I love taking care of my skin. I try to get a microderm or peel at least once a month from my local spa to try to keep my 60 something skin rejuvenated. When I saw this Necessity Skincare product I couldn't imagine what this product could do costing less than $25. Surprisingly, it works really well (at least as good as the pumpkin peels I have been getting) and at much less cost. Slightly tingly when applied, my skin feels great and soft afterwards. I think this is a great alternative to more expensive spa procedures, you should try it!

title: Another home run for Amazon Basics!
text: I love Amazon Basics products and this body wash is no exception. I find it comparable to Old Spice and my husband and sons are crazy for it. We have been using it in our houses for a month now. It is an amazing body wash with a light scent and makes them feel refreshed long after the shower is over. It cleans great and is now a staple in my house for all the men in my life. I highly recommend for anyone who wants something on par with the named brand products but at a significantly lower cost. Kudos!

title: Great glycolic acid and exfoliator combination product
text: I have been using glycolic acid on my face for several years now at the recommendation of my dermatologist. When I saw this Necessity product I decided to try it as they called it an exfoliator gel. I have been also using exfoliating products separately so to be able to get both products in one single application was intriguing for me. I have been using this for almost a month now and I can say that my skin is noticeably smoother and softer and the time of my nightly regimen has been dramatically reduced. I will continue to use and purchase this Necessity product after this initial gel bottle is gone. Great, convenient product.

title: Great attractive and fresh smelling
text: I love Dial products and I have used them for most of my life. This foaming handwash is a must have for any household. Antibacterial, I keep it on my kitchen and bath sinks and it helps me and my guests stay healthy and clean. I love the scents of this package, particularly the lavender as it makes me feel fresh as well, and the containers are attractive and look great on my countertops. If you care about your family and friends, drop the bar soap and keep these instead near your sinks for daily use.

title: Another great Solimo product!
text: First I have to state I love Amazon Brand (Solimo) products. They are true to the more expensive name brand products and this body wash is no exception.  This Deep Moisturizing Body Wash is similar to Dove body wash, but at a lesser cost. I have been using this exclusively now for the past 3 weeks and I love the way my skin feels and smells. I have very dry skin and I see a noticeable improvement in my skin already. I love how clean I feel after using it as well. I highly recommend this to anyone!

title: Great makeup remover aid
text: I have been using this ICREOS device for several weeks now nightly. I really like the way it helps remove my makeup and deep cleans my large pores. I used it once with a mask I had and it did appear to work well and it actually felt really good (I am assuming that the moisturizing was driven deeper into my skin than it would have been had I not been using it). My primary review here is as a makeup remover and I think it works well and left my skin soft and clean.

title: Great product for my wavy crazy hair!
text: This a great leave in conditioning product for my hair. I have naturally wavy hair and try to get keratin treatments every couple of months to keep my hair under control. I had doubts about this product wondering how a $20 product could have any impact. Boy was I surprised the first time I used it. First it applies lightly and does not weigh down your hair or make it greasy. Second, it made my hair super soft and shiny. Third, my frizzing and waves seemed to be more under control after using this. I absolutely recommend this to anyone with hair like mine that is looking for a salon finish on unruly hair!!

title: Probably the best sunscreen out in the market today!
text: I love La Roche-Posay products and almost exclusively use them in my daily beauty regimine. I was excited when I saw this sunscreen not only because of the manufacturer but also because of the 60 SPF protection. I live in central Florida where sun is the biggest enemy to your skin and I typically use a 50 SPF, but having a higher SPF was something I really wanted to try. I applied this the first day before I spent the day on a neighbor's boat and I was thrilled with the results. First, it goes on smooth and absorbs quickly. It is non-greasy and I wore it on my plain non-makeup'ed skin. I did not reapply it and after 4 hours on the boat (in and out of coverings) I came home with no noticeable color on my cheeks. I will be using this exclusively as it is a great protection and my skin feels soft and smooth without feeling greasy.

title: Not something I really liked
text: Sorry, I wasn't overly thrilled with this mask. I was really hoping for something different. I love patchouli and I was hoping for a patchouli mask. I did not smell patchouli at all, to me it almost seemed medicinal (like iodine). Taking it out of the wrapper it is a wet patch, got it all over my countertop trying to get it out and then on my face. Left it on according to directions, but couldn't keep it there the whole time because of the smell. Even after I removed it, I could still smell it. I did rate this as three stars (and not less) because I did like the moisturizing benefit it brought to my skin. But overall, it is slimy, wet and smelly. I just didn't like it at all.

title: Great sunscreen for the money!
text: Another lower cost product from Amazon with comparable qualities to name brand items (like Banana Boat). This sunscreen is a lower SPF (but still much better than using no sunscreen) and is perfect for using when I am playing tennis or running as it is resistant to water and sweat. Does not feel overly greasy (although all sunscreen seems to have some greasy feel to it in my opinion) and seems to last for hours without the need to reapply. In fairness, I tend to use a higher SPF when I am going to be out in the Florida sun for prolonged periods of time, but when it is cloudy or late/early in the day, this 30 SPF is just perfect. And at less than $5 a bottle, it's a steal!

title: Great between pedicures to keep your feet looking beautiful!
text: This is actually one of the best things I have ever gotten from Amazon. First, I go to get pedicures at least 2-3 times a month. I have awfully rough heels and the balls of my feet that the pedicure people try to address. And, although my feet feel pretty good and smooth for a few days after my pedicure, it isn't long before the bottoms of my feet are rough, scaly and peeling again. In comes this Denicer foot file. I am now using this once or twice a week between pedicures. It's a quick and easy procedure and the results are amazing. My feet stay soft and smooth all the time now (not just a couple of days a month) and they look, and feel healthier. I am thrilled to have found this product and I know there are other brands out there. I don't know if other systems could possibly be better (as I have never tried any others), but this one is great. It is powerful and it works. I highly recommend this to anyone who has rough and scaly feet like me.

title: Great generic brand, works at removing makeup magically!
text: I have to start by saying I love Amazon named products. They always seem to produce a quality product, basically little to no difference between them and their specific brand counterparts. These facial wipes are no exception. Great quality and strong, removes most of my makeup in a single swipe and make my skin feel refreshed and clean after using them. I tend to use waterproof mascara and surprisingly these wipes help clean my eyes flawlessly. I will never buy a named brand product again and will stick with this Solimo product. I highly recommend!

title: A great new addition to my skin care regime!
text: This is my new favorite body wash! I have been using Dove for years now, but this exfoliating body wash really has made a difference in my skin! After using it for almost a month now, my skin is radiant, softer and smoother than it has been in years. I typically use exfoliators for my face, but when it came to my body I never tried using them. I love the way my skin feels and looks, and the fragrance is light and lasts nicely. As far as the bodywash component, I feel clean and fresh after every use. No complaints, only praise for a great exfoliating body wash!

title: Great for getting those hard to reach areas
text: I love this Body Groomer and my husband does, too. I can use this for my bikini lines and he uses it as well for his manly trims. No problems, no fear of cutting or knicking. This fits very well in my hand and is very easy to maneuver. I will never go back to using disposable razors again now that I found this Norelco. Kudos for a great product that I can use easily in or out of the shower!

title: Amazing sunscreen helps soften your skin and protect you from the harmful effects of the sun
text: I really liked this Olay product. First, it is non-greasy (unlike most sunscreens). It also has anti-aging factors that help protect and moisturizer my 60 something year old face. If I have any complaints at all it's that I typically use a higher SPF on my face (50+) to help protect me from signs of aging and to help fight the effects of the sun on my exposed areas of my face. However, all in all this is really a nice serum and my face feels great after applying it.

title: Great exfoliating aid, really works well.
text: I typically use an exfoliator (sugar based) for my face and a stronger one for my body. I never used a cotton pad to assist in the exfoliating, so I was interested in how these would work. Surprisingly, these are great. Instead of using my fingers to massage, I use these and they work really well, giving me the extra exfoliating I need. I do not use them every day as I am afraid of it being too strong a mix, but twice a week is working well for me.

title: Great nail trimming kit
text: This is a quality nail trimming set. Perfect to give as a gift, particularly to the man in your life. I actually bought another of these to give to my college age son for Christmas. Makes a great impressive extra gift for someone you love. Very impressive kit with everything one would need to keep finger and toenails trimmed and in healthy condition.

title: Smells good but not a great cleanser
text: Ok facial cleanser but wayyyy overpriced. I like the cucumber mix and the fragrance. Didn't feel it removed my makeup very well and it actually didn't make me feel clean. It is very water based and I found it better as some kind of a toner or something other than a facial cleanser. And $30 for this small bottle? No thanks, I can do better with my other facial cleansers.

title: Great body wash, my new bathroom staple!
text: This is a great body wash. First, and most importantly, is the fragrance of coconut. It is light and makes me feel like I am in the Caribbean every time I shower, lol. Secondly is the overall fact that it is a great body wash. I am left clean and fresh and my skin is smooth and nourished. I have no complaints, but lots of kudos for another great Amazon product. The fact that it is reasonably priced and comes in a handy 6 pack is icing on the cake.

title: Another great product from L'oreal!
text: I am 63 years old and am currently experiencing really sparse eye brows (this is a relatively recent problem within the last few years). Anyway, I love this Unbelieva-Brow product. It is super easy to apply and it covers everything (including my grays). It helps me fill in my aging 'gaps' in eyebrows. I will never use another brow product (unless of course L'Oreal comes out with something newer or more advanced. Just love this and highly recommend!

title: If you normally use Head and Shoulders, now is the time to save money.
text: Exact same ingredients as Head and Shoulders and, wow, what a great price. As of today's writing, with a $1.00 available coupon, the cost of this works out to a little over $2.00 a bottle. Why spend a lot more money for a name brand? I love Amazon's line of generic health and beauty aids and this Solimo Dandruff Shampoo is no exception. My hair is soft, shiny, conditioned and my scalp is far less itchy and flaky after 3 weeks of continuous use. I love this shampoo!

title: Love these colorfull files!!!
text: Nice larger size files. I love the neon colors. Works well on my nails, easy to maneuver and my nails file evenly and smoothly. These are a great size and will last a while (much longer than the standard brown files of the past). I love the price on these and will be buying more when these run out.

title: Good for upper lip hair
text: This worked great for my upper lip peach fuzz. It did take off all of it, which is definitely now going to save me waxing dollars each month. Where it didn't seem to work well was in other areas (like eyebrows). Seems to only be good on light hair (not courser hair). Rating it as 4 stars because, for me, it can only be used on one part of my body to work well. Also not sure how well it is made, seems kind of flimsy and top (blades) seem to come off too easily.

title: Great hair dryer, works excellent!
text: Not just your basic hair dryer. I do love the way it fits in my hand (ergonomically correct) and it is a powerful 1874 watt dryer so my hair dries fast. It is easy to maneuver and dries my hair flawlessly and my hair looks and feels great. No complaints, only Kudos to Revlon for another great styling product. Give your hair an upgrade and toss the old dryer you have been using for years and get a new one.

title: Great hair pomade, son uses it daily
text: This is a great styling cream for men and my son uses it all the time. This goes along with the Redken Brews line of products and it is all he uses. Great holding, not sticky and hair stays soft and pliable. Light fragrance and reasonably priced. Nothing but kudos for Redken in making another great hair product. This makes for a great Christmas stocking gift and I always fill up their stockings with things which they need and enjoy.

title: Refreshing, great smelling shampoo
text: This Redken product is pretty cool. First the bottle in comes in is cleverly disguised as a bottle of beer, which makes it a fun gift to give and a wonderful conversation breaker for houseguests. Secondly, the fragrance and minty aroma makes showering fun and you feel refreshed just breathing in the fragrance. Lastly, the menthol in the shampoo is great for scalp stimulation. If I had any complaints at all it's in the size of the bottle (10 ounces) and the price that goes with the size. While I really loved this, I can see where it would get super expensive to keep this in my household with three men using it every day.

title: Good lipstick but not that shiny and no fruit taste
text: I like this lip gloss. The color is light and the consistency is great. Yes, the applicator is a little weird to use at first, but I got used to it fairly quickly. I am deducting a star for two reasons: although it's called a 'gloss' I didn't find this product was a shiny on my lips as other lipglosses are and second there is little to no fruity flavor.  Other than that, I really do like it and I am using it daily.

title: Another great Almay product!
text: These are great makeup remover towelettes. I took them with me on a recent cruise and every night before going to bed I was able to remove all my makeup with just one pad. Almay makes great products and they don't irritate my skin. No complaints, just compliments for this product. Works great and won't irritate your skin.

title: Great body trimmer for men!
text: The Remington Head & Body Grooming Kit is a great low cost trimmer set. I had my son use this for almost a month now and he had nothing but glowing things to say about it.  Lightweight, ergonomically fits well in his hand, and does the job of precision trimming (particularly with his facial hair) perfectly. I think this would make a great holiday gift for the man in your life who wants to look their best!

title: Just ok set of products but a tad costly
text: This is a good combination set of skin anti-aging products. I really liked the serum (more than anything else in the kit).  I did not like the mask and only used it once (it was difficult to remove). Rating this as only 4 stars as it pertains to the cost. I have purchased a lot better products for less money. This is not doctor/dermatologist grade products and I honestly would think anything over $50 it's not worth it. Unlike others the scent (and there is some fragrance) is minimal and did not bother me at all.

title: In this case, you really do get what you pay for
text: I was originally hesitant as to how good a product like this being sold for over $100 without a prescription would work. I have been using this 1% retinol product now for 3 weeks. I apply it in the morning and in the evening and I can see an amazing difference in my skin. I am a 63 year old woman and my skin appears full, has regained elasticity and I see a big difference in the small lines around my eyes.  I absolutely recommend this to anyone who needs to regain the youthfulness of their skin as this Revision product really works!!!

title: Another great Revision product! Love your skin!
text: I live in Florida and I am in my 60's. After years of ignoring my skin, I have finally understood the need to shade my skin from excessive sun damage to avoid excessive aging. So, in addition to always applying sun block, I am now using retinol products first thing in the morning when I wake up and in the evening before I go to sleep. I really like this Revision retinol product. It is non-greasy and absorbs quickly into the skin and it makes my skin glowing and youthful all throughout the day. I highly recommend this Revision product for anyone who loves their skin. No need for a prescription, you can now get clinical strength on line for optimal results.

title: Great facial product, needed every day for optimal skin
text: This is a very light, quickly absorbing, Vitamin C lotion. I live in Florida where the sun totally impacts my skin, and not in a positive way. Using this Revision product first thing in the morning and right before I go to bed, is helping my skin heal and minimize damage. I will say, it is expensive, but I know comparable items in the market today are as expensive and more so. I am in my 60's and am very pleased with the results of using this.

title: Great brow pencil for daily use
text: Another great L'Oreal product. Easy to use eyebrow pencil. Full coverage, easy to apply. I use this daily to help fill in my aging (I am in my 60's) sparse brows. Nothing but kudos to L'Oreal for a quality product.

title: Most amazing eyeliner in the market today!
text: I am so impressed with this eyeliner. Typically, I have a difficult time with eyeliners. I really like a pencil type eyeliner, but often times it doesn't color the way I want and I find myself using it on paper or something to get it to start. Then I will try liquid eyeliners which I find messy, hard to manage and not lasting as long. In comes this L'Oreal Infallible pencil. It fits the bill from a standard pencil usability basis, but unlike a pencil, it colors flawlessly. It is creamy, smooth and is long lasting. I will never switch to another brand of eyeliner. This is simply the best one out there.

title: Great every day hair brush
text: This is my new favorite addition to my master bathroom. This is a sizeable, sturdy brush, with strong yet flexible bristles for keeping my shoulder length hair looking great. I do not use this for styling (it's too big to handle the way I straighten my hair with an iron). However, once my hair is done, this is a great way to keep my hair looking it's best throughout the day. Fits ergonomically well in my hand and covers a large portion of my hair at one time. I really like this Revlon brush.

title: Another great Revlon product - a real quality straightening iron!
text: This is a perfect flat iron for me. I have naturally wavy hair and I need to use a straightener every time I wash it. This Revlon iron is a great size and width and helps me straighten my hair quickly in the morning before leaving for work. Revlon makes quality items overall and this ceramic flat iron is no exception. Heating element heats up quickly and evenly throughout the bed of the iron. No complaints, just good things to say. Kudos!

title: Small but work great!
text: I love these fragrance sticks! I am currently in a two bedroom apartment (between houses).  When I first saw these, I thought they be way too small to fragrance the apartment.  Boy, was I wrong!. With these fragrance sticks, a little goes a long way. The fragrance is very light but helps me with a small space and keeping a feeling and smelling fresh and clean.  I also love the size of the container I can put it easily on one of my end tables and it’s very unobtrusive. Nothing but great things to say about it.

title: Great, easy to apply, sport sunscreen spray
text: Great reasonably priced sunscreen. I live in Florida and always keep a couple of these bottles around primarily for my grandbabies. To me, the spray on variety works well and is easy to apply (especially with the way they are fidgeting and jumping around all the time). The 30 SPF is a good overall protector (some times I will use 50+ on their faces). I am deducting a star just because I find that the spray doesn't seem to last as long as the regular tube applications. I think it might be simply because I can see the product better and I can spot easier places I might miss. But I will make up for it by applying it a few times when we are outside. Honestly, for the little ones who won't hold still for more than a few seconds at a time, this is the way to go when you want to protect them.

title: My son liked it, applies it sparingly
text: My husband wasn't interested in this, so I had my 35 year old son try it. He actually liked it, although he said he thought it was a little strong, so he applied it sparingly. He was most impressed with the box (which is probably why the cost of this is high). I did smell it on him and I did like the musky scent. This would probably make a great gift for the holidays for the Mercedes owner in your life (or for someone who wishes they owned one).

title: Nice effective sun protector for your skin!
text: This was a first type of moisturizer like this I have ever tried. I wasn't sure how the tinted feature in this would work, but actually I liked it. For an every day moisturizer it's great. I put this on in the morning and reapply in the afternoon when I walk my dog. The SPF 45 gives me some minimal protection from the sun, the moisturizer helps keep my skin supple and the tint helps me look my best (without having to apply any foundation). I like the tint feature, it's light and blended well into my skin. I am deducting a star as I really think this is over priced. Although it is small in size, a little goes a long way, but I think I can do better (with a higher SPF factor) for less money.

title: Best skin cleanser on the market today!
text: This Revision Skincare Papaya cleanser is my new favorite addition to my daily beauty regimen. A little goes a long way and my skin feels amazingly clean, soft, smooth and doesn't leave my skin dry after using it. I am a 62 year old female who is very active and after I visit the gym or play a game of tennis, this is my go-to facial wash. I also really love the fragrance of this as well, leaves my feeling fresh and revitalized. I highly recommend this for all skin types and ages.

title: Nice pomade but you can probably do better in the market
text: Had my 35 year old son who typically uses pomades try it. His review gave it an 'ok' rating. He said that the pomade did not control his hair as well as his usual hair products, however he did like the smooth texture of it and how his hair felt while using it.  The container is attractive and very masculine looking. I deducted a star simply because of the $25 price, not sure it's honestly worth it, especially when there are other products out there that do the same at a lesser cost (or with more product).

title: Great disposable razors, come in a convenient 6 pack
text: These are great disposable razors. They seem to last a long time and are very well made. They fit ergonomically in my hand and are easy to maneuver. Blades are sharp and get the job done. I like that they come in a 6 pack which makes it convenient for keeping in my medicine cabinet. These do not look 'junky' like other disposable razors do and perform well, so I think they are great to even make stocking stuffers for during the holidays. Highly recommend.

title: One of the best Sunscreens on the market today!
text: This is another great sunscreen product from Hawaiian Tropic. I love the fact that this contains antioxidants. Being that I live in Florida, I am constantly trying to avoid the sun and keep myself covered as much as I can (not just because of my fear of cancer, but also because of the terrible aging which occurs when one has too much sun). I use this 30 SPF on those days when I don't need optimum protection (late in the day, when it is cloudy), otherwise I typically use 50SPF (or higher). This goes on lightly, is not greasy and has a light fragrance. Like I mentioned, the antioxidants are just icing on the cake to prevent damage and cancer.

title: Great shaving kit but overpriced for what you receive
text: This was a great old-school shaving kit that I got for my 35 year old son to try. He absolutely loved it but complained, as others did here, that the sizes of the product are super small and he didn't get more than 3-4 uses out of the products. Of course, the case and brush are still usable, but it is costly for what you receive. The products themselves are great, he loved the shaving cream and balm and I did go on Amazon and order him a full size version of the shaving cream as a gift for helping me review this. I would think that if the Art of Shaving was trying to entice more people into using their products that they would make this intro pack more affordable (less than $20 would be more like it). Deducting a star for the price, but the product and presentation itself were a big hit.

title: Wonderful, light smelling soap. Great cleaning quality and wonderful invigorating fragrance!
text: I love this soap. I love the fresh earthy smell, the way it makes my skin feel (not dry, but super clean). The shower smells wonderful while I bathe and it does make me feel good. Not sure about the 'energy boosting' qualities but I love the way it makes me feel and smell during and after my shower. This is my all time favorite bar soap and I will not be switching any time soon to another brand.

title: Too strong for my taste
text: I was hoping I would have loved this Kenneth Cole perfume, but unfortunately, I didn't. I was thrilled when I saw the jasmine and other light floral scents which I thought would make a discreet soft smelling fragrance. I was totally wrong. I find this to be too strong for me, I like perfumes that are barely there and even when I applied this sparingly it was too strong for my taste. Disappointed to say the least. Maybe it's my skin type or body chemistry, but this didn't work well on me.

title: Great soap, high priced but so worth it!
text: This is an amazing bar of soap. First, it cleanses thoroughly and removes my make up easily. I tend to have sensitive akin and this soap is gentle and leaves my complexion looking youthful and radiant. I agree with one of the other reviewers, I am not sure I would ever have spent $30+ for a bar of soap, but now that I have used this for about a month now, and see the impact, I will be buying a second bar. As an FYI, after using this for a month, the bar of soap still looks as if most of it is still there, so a little goes a long way with this Erno Laszlo product. This is truly a case of ‘you get what you pay for’ with this soap. Highly recommend.

title: Great man's moisturizer to keep after shaved skin looking and feeling it's best!
text: My metrosexual son loves CW Beggs products and this moisturizer is one of his favorites. He uses it after shaving to keep his facial skin soft and smooth. I love that men are now taking care of their skin after all these years of ignoring it. The CW Beggs line of products are masculine looking and have a very soft fragrance so as not to smell like it was made for a woman. If I had any complaint at all, it would be in the size of the container for the almost $25 price. Honestly, Nivea would probably work just as well at about 1/3 of the price. However, if my son uses this daily, then to me it's worth the price to keep his skin in optimal condition.

title: Great body balm, perfect for regular use!
text: I love this ale Petit Marseillaise Hydrating Body Balm. I leave one at my desk at work and one by my television at home and I find myself regularly applying to my hands and even my feet. After using this for the better part of a month now, and my skin has never felt better. I am 62 years old and my hands have a tendency to look almost ‘scaly’. Using this body balm religiously (particularly after washing my hands) has made a noticeable and youthful improvement in my skin. I highly recommend this to everyone and the fragrance is light and great smelling as well!

title: Great nail polish, great color, what else do you need?!!
text: Love Essie nail polishes, my favorite. How can you go wrong with L'Oreal? This is a pretty light pink color, perfect for a natural looking finish on my relatively short nails. Full coverage, easy to apply, lasts for days with no chipping. Just beautiful, no issues, perfect.

title: Great lipstick, long lasting, full coverage!
text: FIrst, I have to say that I love this style and make of lipstick. First, it fits easy in your hand and allows you total control when applying. Second, it lasts and lasts. I am hard on lipstick color as I have a tendency to drink a lot of water (or whatever else is around) and between talking on the phone all day and licking my lips, I tend to have to reapply often. This FocusOn brand is different, it lasts me all day with only a quick touch up usually after lunch. I actually did not care for this color (too dark and copper looking for me). However, I did order another color shortly after receiving and trying this and I am using this brand exclusively now. I highly recommend FocusOn (a brand I had never heard of before) Color Sticks and know it will become your new favorite go to lip color.

title: Terrible for my hair, might work for you.
text: This product left my hair feeling, and looking, hard and stiff. Maybe other hair types will respond better, but I found this to be awful on my hair. I didn't experience what others mentioned here (about the streaming of the spray). Mine did mist well. However, it's the way it made my hair look and feel that was a turn off for me. Plus the price is super high for something like this. You can do much much better if you are looking for a product to keep your hair manageable and looking it's best.

title: Good Calvin Klein fragrance, long-lasting and pleasantly (although strong) scented
text: This is a fairly strong scented fragrance for woman. I liked it, but had to apply it sparingly so it didn't overwhelm my coworkers. I typically love Calvin Klein products (I have a closet full of clothes from them), but the verdict is still out as to whether I will be making Obsessed my new go-to fragrance. I did get compliments from my husband, so he really did like it. Long lasting as well so a little goes a long way. Go to your local Macy's (or pick your favorite department store) to sample this before purchasing to be sure it is right for you.

title: If you love your skin, you need Coppertone Defend & Care!
text: This is my new favorite when it comes to sunscreens for my face. I am relatively fair (Irish bloodlines) and also 60 something. I worry about things like cancer more and more these days (along with the impact that excess sun has on aging skin. Along with trying to eat right, exercising and doing spa treatments occasionally (microderms, facials), my skin looks terrific. And I know that, for my age, I look younger than many of my younger (in age) neighbors here in Florida. Sun damage wreaks havoc on your skin and this Coppertone Defend and Care works great. SPF 50, I apply it under my makeup each morning and I am good all day at the office. I particularly like this brand of sunscreen as it is non-greasy and absorbs quickly so it doesn't mess with my makeup. Nothing but great things to say about this, every home should have at least one of these on hand at all times.

title: Don't waste your money on this product.
text: I saw no benefit out of this product. I have very sparse eyebrows, probably due to my age (61). I was thrilled when I saw this Dermablend product, but what a disappointment. At first, when I saw nothing happen as I was applying it, I assumed the product was old/dried up. Of course, I ended up realizing that was not the case as my eyebrows were damp. I had no coverage over any of my gray hairs, nothing helped with the thin brows, I didn't even notice a color on the brows I did have covered. I got the light brown color which should have been fine for my coloring, but maybe one needs a dark color to make it noticeable? Anyway, I would never order this again. As an fyi, I usually like Dermablend products, this one is not up to their usual standards.

title: Great basic eyebrow pencil!
text: This is a great brow pencil. It applies easily and stays on for hours (if I put it on at night, I do not need to re-apply as the evening progresses). Easy to use, goes on easily, easy to outline and colors and covers well. No complaints, just good things. If you need a new pencil, this Cover Girl brow pencil really fits the bill. Don't spend a lot of money on other brands, this is a reasonably priced product and does the job for a lot less than the others.

title: Great facial wash, was a big hit with my 12 year old grandaughter!
text: I love Garnier products. This Foaming Face Wash was a hit with my tween grandaughter. She loved the foaming factor in this and the easy dispenser. As she is prone to beginning acne, her skin is naturally oily. Without drying out her skin, this Garnier keeps her complexion clear and smooth. I am not sure if it's the product itself or if it's just the fact that she is washing her face more faithfully now but, either way, I am sold on this and have already ordered a second bottle for her. I can highly recommend this for folks with oily to normal skin types.

title: Great variety of brushes for an excellent price!
text: This is a great,economically priced,set of brushes. I keep them in my overnight bag as a nice way to travel without having to take my more expensive home makeup brushes, but I could just as easily use these at home. Lots of versatility and a variety of sizes. With this set you have something for every one of your makeup needs. They are well made, durable and easy to clean. What's not to like? Perfect for me.

title: Great for the metro-sexual male in your life who is looking to improve and assist in slowing down skin aging.
text: I had my nephew use this for three weeks and what follows are what he told me. He was never one to really worry about his skin in the past, but now that he is 34 he is seeing the benefit to trying to begin (and maintain) a new skin regimen. He told me that he really likes the way his skin feels, and looks, and that he finds he is getting a much closer shave then he did before using this. He did say he didn't feel it was truly worth the $169 price and that he could probably do better with other types of skin cleansing machines, but overall he liked the results and will continue to use it every morning before shaving.

title: Great daily skin cleanser, reasonably priced, reduces acne flare ups
text: I have to start by saying I am really impressed with Mountain Falls products. First, they mimic more expensive brands at the same quality without the price. I have several of them in my daily beauty and health regimine. This cleanser is great. It works best on oily skin. I had my daughter use this exclusively over the past three weeks and her skin looks amazing. Gone is the oily sheen to her skin, acne breakouts are noticeably reduced and her skin looks glowing and healthy. I have already ordered more of these (they are currently running a promotion to get $6 off). Highly recommend this for every household, but especially for ones with teens.

title: Great man's moisturizer, fragrance free and leaves skin super smooth
text: This is a great man's moisturizing cream. Goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly into the skin and is fragrance free. My husband applies this after shaving in the morning and his skin is silky smooth and, to me, looks healthier than ever. I did ask him about how the caffeine worked and if his skin felt 'energized, and he told me he could find no discernible difference in his skin to support the 'energize' claim fo this cream. I am deducting one star from this review due to the price factor. I mean, for half the price of $24 I would have him use Nivea and I am sure he would see the same result for less.

title: Great body wash, leaves my skin feeling clean, soft and moisturized
text: I have to start by saying that I have been using Dove products for years. They always make quality products focusing on a woman's skin. I am a 63 year old woman and my facial skin has a tendency to be dry in some areas and oil in others and my body skin tends to be dry. I love this new Dove Body Wash. I keep it in my shower and use it daily. First, it works for all areas of my skin so it easily keeps my skin in good health. Second, my skin feels amazing when I come out of the shower, clean and refreshed. Third I love the new style container it comes in with the pump. The pump keeps the dispenser clear from clogging and works great to dispense the was easily onto my washcloth. This is, by far, one of the best body washes I have ever used. I highly recommend this to all woman with all skin types.

title: Color is too light for my liking, but it is a great eyeliner
text: I usually love Oreal products. I found this grey eyeliner a little too light for my liking around my eyes (which is why I am deducting 1 star). It is easy to apply and it did last for an entire evening. L'Oreal makes a safe eye product, not tested on laboratory animals. Just keep in mind, if you are looking for a stronger contrast in your eye wear, go darker than this color. Other than that, I recommend L'Oreal for all your makeup needs.

title: A bit pricey, but a great overall moisturizer
text: Great lightweight moisturizer with added minimal SPF protection. It goes on smoothly with no greasy after feeling and my skin readily absorbed it quickly so I could apply my foundation and makeup. After using it exclusively for over a month, my skin is noticeably softer and looks fuller. I am deducting one star for my own purposes as to the pricing on this. I know Laslo makes quality products but you often are strictly paying for the name.I think that is the case here. I think you can get products priced less that perform as well. But, if you want to pamper yourself, or someone else in your life, this is a great every day moisturizer.

title: Great matte lipstick, lasts all day.
text: Great long lasting lipstick. Rated this as a four star simply because I send to prefer more glossy lipsticks (I actually apply a clear gloss over this when I use it). This is a flat full coverage lipstick, made by Maybelline so you know the price will be good and the quality is there. It does last throughout the day (I apply it in the morning and it does last until I am finished from work in spite of eating and drinking). I recommend this to anyone who wants a matte finish lipstick in a handy applicator package that will last them throughout the day.

title: Great sunscreen, long lasting, feels and looks great
text: This is a fantastic sunscreen. Light, easy to apply, with minimal oiliness, this provides my face with loads of skin protection and lasts most of the day (unless I am at the beach or pool and in the water).i love CeraVe products, they understand the needs of a woman (particularly one like myself who is 60, living in Florida and exposed to extreme sunshine most days of the year). I wouldn’t trust my skin to any other sunscreen.

title: Grerat all natural product that really works!
text: This is a great, non-greasy treatment for hair. I live in an area where I tend to get a lot of static electricity in my hair, particularly during the winter months (while walking on carpeting).I also tend to have wavy hair that can easily get out of control unless I use strong conditioners. I use this Argon Oil for everyday use and I couldn't be happier. Basically fragrance free, I find my hair does not go limp but instead looks great and healthy. Highly recommend this treatment for anyone who has frizzy hair needing control or who lives in an area prone to static electricity.

title: Rich in hyaluronic acid, noticeable imprvoement in my skin
text: For the positives, this is a good moisturizing facial serum. Rich, absorbs quickly and contains hyaluronic acid (something both my dermatologist and my local spa technicians recommend greatly for younger looking skin). I have been using this now for almost a month and I do see a nice, one improvement in my complexion, skin looks glowing and hydrated. For the negatives, at close to $100 this is very expensive, you can purchase hyaluronic acid in other products at a substantially less cost. I also don't care for the fragrance, I find it a little overwhelming for me. Of course, given 5 minutes or so, when absorbed, the fragrance is basically gone. For the two negatives I am taking away a star in my review of this product.

title: Wonderful skin protection for your body
text: I need to start by saying I am 60 years old, live in Florida, and try to avoid sun exposure as much as possible (primarily to help minimize aging impacts). I have used CeraVe sunscreen for my face in the past, this is the first time I used the skin lotion. I love how smoothly it goes on, absorbs fairly quickly and does not leave a real greasy feeling on my skin. The 50 SPF factor is icing on the cake and helps my arms and legs (primarily exposed) stay protected even while I am out for hours. This is also fairly water resistant and I have tried it at the beach and it maintained its protection even after skin is wet (didn't immerse myself, just dipped my feet and legs). I love CeraVe as they make great products and are always competitively priced (much better than the designer skin protection and just as effective).

title: Another great Pre de Provence product!
text: To be honest, as of two months ago I had never heard of Pre de Province products. Introduced to the brand by the use of their hand creams, I was immediately smitten with the brand. They seem to always know exactly the kind of products my aging 60 something year old skin is craving. This soap is no exception. Loaded with Shea butter, this soap keeps my skin feeling like silk and the light flowery fragrance. Taking a shower has become an event I truly look forward to because of the way this soap feels. And the beautiful packaging on this Van Gogh is breathtaking and would make a great stocking stuffer gift this year for the woman you love in your life!

title: I use this exclusively now, this is a great soap from Italy!
text: I need to start out by saying I love all things Italian (I am Irish by heritage but was raised in a predominantly Italian neighborhood in NY). Having been to Italy on vacation 5 times now, I am always looking to buy and bring things home with me as a remembrance. When I saw Amazon was now selling Via Mercato products I was elated! I love the fragrance of this soap. It lathers richly and is gentle on my skin. I must say that after having used it for almost a month now, my skin glows, looks healthier and as softer and smoother to the touch. This is now a staple in my house and I have it in my master as well as guest baths. Great product, wouldn't use anything else now.

title: How did I live without this before?
text: This was my first experience in using an automated makeup brush. I have to say I was at first a bit skeptical reading the other reviews on here. I pictured this being another useless gadget which probably would end up collecting dust in my powder room. How wrong I was! This is great and I will no longer go back to my old manual application modes (typically my fingers and usually a non-automated brush for applying brush). Using this Allstar Innovations rotating brush has changed everything. Easy to set up and get going, this brush is ergonomically built to fit my hand perfectly. Applying small dabs of foundation in a few places on my face, I begin the automated brush process. My makeup is applied flawlessly and smoothly, helping to cover imperfections and even bringing out a glow in my complexion! You will love adding this to your makeup regimen. Would make a terrific holiday gift to the woman in your life (even if it's just to spoil yourself!

title: Great foundation, a little heavy on my skin, but does make my skin look flawless
text: I have been using Dermablend products for years now. On the plus side, makeup goes on flawlessly and covers all imperfections making my skin look smoother and younger (and does an excellent job of hiding age spots). On the negative side (which is why I deducted a star from the overall rating), it did make my skin feel slightly greasy and made applying blush a little difficult. I am assuming it might be the way this foundation was interacting with my complexion, so I don't want to be too harsh as others might not have the same problem I did.

title: Great sulfate free shampoo for treated hair!
text: With my typically wavy hair, I tend to get Agave (preferred) or Keratin treatments at least every 3 months. With treated hair, I have to use sulfate free shampoos and the ones I typically get are very expensive and don't always work as well as they should to keep my hair optimal between treatments. I was pleasantly surprised and pleased with this Carols Daughter product. My hair appears smoother and softer than it has in weeks. Only complaint I might have is that this is not in stores around me, so I guess I will continue to purchase through Amazon.

title: Great nail polish, perfect for me. Really builds strength in nails!
text: This is the perfect color for my nails and has the added benefit of being a nail strengthener as well. I use two coats with every manicure. Makes my nails look natural ( this is not a bright pink, but goes on very light) and helps strengthen their typically fragile consistency. I have notice a marked improvement in my nails not splitting or cracking as much as they had. I highly recommend essie products for all nail care and this strengthener variety really works to help build strength in your nails to deter brittleness and breaking.

title: Wonderful addition to your skin care regimine!
text: I absolutely love thisPre de Provence Argan Oil product. It is my go-to product when I leave my shower and apply it to my face and hands while my skin is till damp. My skin glows since I started using this two weeks ago and it is softer and more hydrated than ever before. I will be purchasing more in about a week since I can definitely see a difference in my appearance. I love the fragrance, too, with a light lavender scent it definitely gIves me a bit of peace and calming just smelling it after application. Goes great with my Pre de Provence lavender riche hand cream.

title: Nice petite little soaps, did not care for the fragrance upon opening them.
text: These are little guest soaps. I did not like the smell of the ones I received. Reminded me of citronella. I did unwrap a couple and left the out overnight and the smell did change to a lighter citrus scent. I am deducting one star since I did not care for the fragrance of these. However, they are made with shea butter and are good for your skin, just would have preferred a lavender or floral scent.

title: Great hand moisturizers, one of the best around today
text: I keep these in the office and find myself applying this multiple times a day to my dry,aging hands. I love Pre de Province products. Moisturizing, easy to apply and quick absorbing, this hand cream is great. I love the variety of fragrances, too. My favorite is the lavender, but all of them are lightly fragranced and will not interfere with any perfumes or other scents you may use. The size of these makes it perfect for traveling and a little goes a long way. Highly recommend!

title: Great alternative to traditional iron straighteners for your hair
text: This is a great product. I have been using straightening irons for years now to keep my typically wavy shoulder length hair. So, using a heated brush was anew experience for me. I admit it works a little different than an iron. So if you are looking for a super straight look, stick with the iron. But if you are trying to minimize the wave in your hair and do multiple layers at one time, you really need to try this. I find my hair looks flawlessly smooth and the brush really makes my hair more manageable and easier to dry. I highly highly recommend if you are looking for an alternative to a damaging iron (tends to give me split ends and dry hair), try  this.

title: Amazingly softer, smoother and healthy skin after 2 weeks of daily use!
text: I am a 62 year old woman who has been trying a variety of creams and lotions to help diminish the signs of aging on my hands to no avail. Although I have only been using this daily for a little over 2 weeks, I an honestly say the skin on my hands is visibly plumper and smoother (and definitely a lot healthier looking). This Pre de Provence product has a terrifically light citrus fragrance, goes on full but absorbs quickly into the skin (not sure if it's because my skin is so dry it 'drinks' it up readily) and overall is a great product to use. The argan oil assures that your skin will be soft and smooth. I love someone's review on here that talks about the price of this product. Honestly, if $15 is too much to keep your skin looking youthful and healthy, then I guess you shouldn't be buying any skin products. This Pre de Provence is a great product and a little goes a long way.

title: Great artisanal soap! Shea butter makes my skin soft and smooth! Great fragrance, great soap!!!
text: To be honest, I have been using liquid body wash for the last 2-3 years exclusively. This is the first time I have used bar soap (ok, except for maybe hotel stays) since that time. I am super impressed with this soap. First, it is very sizeable and heavy. I have been using it daily for the last 2 weeks and it still looks like the same size as when I took it out of the wrapper (so my assumption is this will last a long, long time). Glorious lavender mix fragrance (which I love). I feel cleaner than I have in years and my skin feels amazing (I assume it's the shea butter). This is my new favorite soap and I love it. No more body washes for me, I will be using these European soaps going forward. Kudos to Pre de Provence!

title: Perfect compact travel companion. A must have!
text: This is a great travel hair dryer. Compact, folds easily and stores in my suitcase with little room for space. I tend to always carry a travel hair dryer with me even if I plan to stay at a hotel which supplies them in rooms. Particularly in Europe, I never know what I will be getting, but with this Revlon I know it is reliable, has the strength to easily dry my shoulder length hair quickly and will provide me with consistent performance whereever I travel. This is a must have for anyone who likes to travel!

title: Great for hands which are dry and need some TLC
text: This is a great soothing moisturizer. Have to admit, the idea of using snail goo really kind of grossed me out. But once I looked at the ingredients and saw all the great natural ingredients I was sold. Aloe vera, lemon and orange oils, apple and carob seed extract and hyaluronic acid (something my dermatologist swears by), I decided to try this. I am thrilled with how great my skin feels after using this for almost 2 weeks. I exclusively used this on my hands and I can see an incredible difference. I highly recommend this for extremely dry skin. My hands are 62 years old and and after using this for almost 2 weeks I see less crepeness and my dry skin seems to be improving dramatically. I will be buying more when this is finished as I am so impressed with the results!

title: Great priced and great moisturizer!!!
text: This is a great skin care product that is very reasonably priced (especially when compared with the more expensive brands). It is light and absorbs quickly and is non-greasy. In fact, I was very impressed at how quickly my skin 'drank' this up and my arms (in particular) feel amazingly soft and smooth. I am now using this as my go-to after shower full body moisturizer. Very light fragrance, it will not overpower any other perfumes or lotions you might use. This is the best $5 or so you will ever spend and you will find it quickly becomes an every day product in your home as well!

title: Great reasonably priced razor that performs like more expensive brands!
text: This is a great wet/dry razor at a great cost. My husband has typically used a Remington razor on and off for the past 5 years and has even opted for standard non-electric razors when he was attempting to get an even closer shave. When I saw this Braun I thought I would let him try it and I am happy to say he is thrilled. He now has one of his closest shaves ever and he loves that he is able to use it in or out of the shower and that it keeps his skin feeling optimal, soft and smooth. This unit fits ergonomically in his hand and the rotating head makes it easy to manuever around some of the most delicate areas on his face. As I mentioned, he is thrilled with the way this razor performs and I know he will be using this for years to come.

title: Perfect polish, darker than the picture
text: Essie nail polishes never disappoint and I use them exclusively. Easy to apply, long lasting, resists chips, I love Essie products way over Opi brands. I deducted a star simply because of the color. I found this to be darker, greyer almost with a slight purple tint (from the picture it looked to be more of a blue which is what I was looking for). So, please keep that in mind when picking this.

title: Great shampoo! Less flakes and hair feels silky smooth and clean!
text: I and my family have been using Head and Shoulders for years and have been typically happy with the results. Mountain Falls is a new shampoo to me (had not heard of it before). I was hesitant to try it, but to be honest I absolutely loved it! Same primary ingredient as H&S (pyrithione zinc) but with a wonderful apple fragrance. It is a full bodied shampoo, lathers up great and my hair is squeaky clean after use. I think this Mountain Falls product actually makes my scalp less itchy and I do notice less flakes than usual. I do use an additional conditioner with this product as the 2 in 1 formula is not enough for me. But outside of that, I couldn't be happier with this shampoo!

title: Great camo - a little lighter than expected- but covers imperfections flawlessly!
text: I really do love these Thermoblend products. Great makeup. This 'camo' is easy to apply and covers all skin imperfections (i.e. I have some skin damage from the sun with age spots). I did deduct one star simply because I thought this was a little lighter than I was expecting. I ended up smoothing it out and covering it with my standard foundation so the lightness blended easily away. I do recommend Thermoblend overall because of the way my skin looks (virtually flawless) after using these products.

title: Nice makeup for darker skin tones.
text: Nice full coverage makeup. A little darker than I expected (I was hoping it would be a slightly tanned look, but it is darker than that). Light matte finish which blends nicely with other makeup that I wear. Had to deduct a star simply because it is too dark for my complexion and I won't be able to use it. :(

title: Great set for your oily skins daily health!
text: This is a great combination system to help with oily skin. I am 60 years old and, believe it or not, still have fairly oily skin. I love this Fresh Foaming cleanser as a little goes a long way. It removes everything from my skin at the end of the day (sunscreen, foundation) and does it gently and thoroughly. A few times a week I am using the exfoliating powder and I will say that my skin not only feels clean after using it but super silky smooth as well. I do have large pores (particularly on my nose) and I feel the Pore Refining Primer works like a light refreshing toner to help minimize and tighten them. I have been using the Detox Clear Complexion Mask at least once a week and it does help minimize black and whiteheads on your skin. I love the tingling my skin feels when it is on as well which to me means it is tightening and firming (and basically doing it's job very well). Overall, I think this is a great set. A must have for anyone with problematic skin as it covers all the bases and needs that your skin my have. Whether you are a teenager with acne issues or a boomer with adolescent skin issues, this NxN set fits the bill for Flawless Perfection (as the name says!).

title: Wonderful light foundation that covers all your skin flaws!
text: This is a great, lightweight full coverage foundation. Goes on smoothly and does not look cakey or flakey on my skin. I am typically fussy when it comes to my facial products, so I was skeptical when I first ordered this. However, I was pleasantly surprised to see how flawless this product worked for me. It smoothes my skin, minimizing poors and making me appear to not be wearing foundation (but my face looks amazing). I had never heard of DermaBlend before I ordered this, but I am definitely sold. This will be my foundation of choice going forward. Absolutely love how it makes my skin look and feel.

title: Great value for the money and a terrific, attractive hair dryer for all hair types
text: Great, powerful hair dryer. I love the modern design, looks great in my bathroom. Dryer has multiple settings and can work on any hair type. I have wavy hair that I like to blow dry straight. This dryer fits the bill entirely. Ergonomically fits perfect in my hand and the tip attachment helps me in straightening my hair using dedicated sweeping brushes. I love Revlon hair products they are typically very reasonably priced and this Perfect Heat model is terrific and does seem to dry my hair faster than any previous model I have owned.

title: Great, light moisturizing product for daily use!
text: I have heard about Vichy products, but have never tried them until now. I actually loved this Mineral 89 formula. Goes on light and absorbs into my aging skin quickly. I have been using it daily twice a day for the past month (in the morning and before I go to bed). My skin is actually glowing and has a more youthful appears and glow. I find this to be a great moisturizer which does not interfere with my other beauty products (i.e. sunscreen, foundation, etc). This is a reasonably priced product compared to other moisturizers out there and I think it does a much better job than most. I am sold on Vichy now and will be expanding my knowledge of the product line and bring more into my daily beauty regimine.

title: Another great Garnier product!
text: I typically use Brazilian Blow Out as my shampoo/conditioner of choice in order to maintain my quarterly keratin treatments for as long as possible. I figured I would try this new Garnier product and I have to say I am pleasantly suprised. First, the fragrance is amazing. Second,  the fact that is ti s paraben-free and contains vitamins B3 & B6 are just icing on the cake. My hair looks smooth, taming the frizzies and it feels and smalls amazing. I have also ordered the shampoo (although I have not yet received it to review), but I am thrilled with this conditioner. In addition, it is probably 25% of the cost of Brazilian Blow Out. So, if the shampoo works out as well as the conditioner, this will now be my go-to hair treatment going forward. A great product at a reasonable cost.

title: Great moisturizer for the non-metrosexual in your life!!
text: My son has been using this now for several weeks and has nothing but positive wonderful things to say about it. Considering he has never been one to feel it is 'manly' to use cosmetics and creams, it is an amazing testimonial to this L'oreal product (he is far from a metrosexual male). He maintains a light scruffy beard and has for several years now. His testimony to me is it is light and applies easily and keeps his skin and beard soft and smooth to the touch. WIth a light basically unobtrusive fragrance-free cream, he uses this in the morning after he showers and at night before he goes to bed (to add moisture to his face while he sleeps). Nothing but great things to say about it, in fact he asked me if I can order him more since he is running low, and I will. Kudos to L'Oreal for making products that men will use as part of their daily routine.

title: Great, long lasting mascara!!!!
text: This is a great mascara. As usual, L'Oreal produces some of the best cosmetic products out there and this new mascara is no exception. I am a 60 year old woman with thinning lashes and brows. I use this Voluminous Lash Paradise exclusively now. It fills out my lashes and makes my eyelashes look fuller and longer than they did 20 years ago. It also is easy to remove (with my makeup removal pads) so I do not wake up in the morning with raccoon eyes. At the same time, it lasts all day and holds up to hard wear. Kudos to L'Oreal for another great product!

title: When at first you don't succeed, try try again
text: Ok, so although after several disasterous attempts, I got it to work somewhat. I am rating this as three stars for that very reason. Honestly, this is just too much work for day to day makeup. I guess if I really wanted something special for a special occasion, I might go out of my way to set this up and use it. I found myself applying and reapplying as I couldn't get it to go on even (needed to smooth it manually afterwards). I hate to criticize this too much and maybe others may have a much easier time with it. However, when I finally was able to get it on halfway decently, I did see the benefit of using an airbrush (over using a standard foundation). However, I still think it's a lot of work and I will save it for times where I really want to look professionally done (wedding, New Years, Christmas, etc).

title: Nice, light conditioner. A little on the costly side per ounce.
text: Rating this as a high just ok. I mean, it did work well on my thinner hair, left it smooth and manageable, as good as other conditioners I typically use. On the other hand, this is a relatively small bottle (10 ounces) at a high price. I usually by 32 ounce conditioners (typically Agave products) which per lower ounce cost, work much better. I also didn't care for the fragrance right out of the container (thought it was too strong smelling). After applying and rinsing it I found my hair smelt much nicer (and not as strong as immediately thought). I do like the impressive little container and the applicator plunger. Just think that for the cost per ounce you can do much better.

title: Made for thicker eyebrows - not for thinner brow lines
text: Not sure who this brow crayon is truly meant for. I have relatively normal, thin brows. This pencil/crayon is thick and would work well, maybe on someone, with a thicker, bushier, brow line. But, on me, I found it hard to use applying shading where I didn't want it which meant I spent time cleaning off the exces. I am rating it three stars because I am sure there are others who will love this, but honestly, this did not work for me. I did like the idea of the brush applicator so if they decide to scale down the crayon/pencil to a little bit thinner side, I might try this again.

title: Great greaseless full coverage sunscreen!
text: Really cool concept for a sunscreen. I have a tendency to use sun screen primarily on my face and neck simply because of application problems (and enormous amounts of sunscreen needed). This is the first time I have ever used a sunscreen, and in Florida I really needed it. I actually took it with me on a recent Caribbean cruise and I am glad I did. Easy to apply, I quickly (and effortlessly) sprayed it on my legs and arms. Non-greasy, odor free and SPF 50 all combined to an easy to use sun screen. I think this is a must have for beach and pool goers and especially for those with young children. Organic and good for the environment as well, I loved how easy it was to cover myself with and the protection it gave me. I will be buying more to keep on hand for when the children and grandkids visit. Must have!

title: Sheer luxury for your face!
text: This is one of the best skin cremes I have ever used. Yes, it is expensive. But this is one of the times I can honestly say you get what you pay for. A little goes a long way, this should last you for months, so it is well worth it. Goes on rich and luxurious, absorbs super quick into your skin. I use it immediately after I shower to lock in moisture and I can say for the few months I have been using it now, my skin looks and feels fresher and softer. I love the fragrance and the way it applies. I can highly recommend this IS Clinitcal creme to anyone with 40+ skin. Minimizes wrinkles, adds moisture back to aging skin and makes your skin glow and feel wonderful. Takes years off your face!

title: Wonderful shampoo, terrific light fragrance!!!
text: I love Herbal Essences shampoos, have used them since I was in my 20's. Great product, wonderful fragrance (I don't see it overwhelming at all). I particularly love this coconut milk hydrating variety as it truly made my hair soft and managable and easy to style (I also bought the coconut milk conditioner variety as well). This has a rich lather, is able to be used in all water types and keeps my hair smelling fresh and yummy all day. I have had a lot of compliments since I have been using this (friends have commented on the great fragrance). Kudos Herbal Essences for another great shampoo variety!

title: Definitely not for me!
text: Unlike others, I found this awful. First, I used it sparingly on my legs after showering twice (two days in a row). I will say, the moisturizing was great, went on smooth and had a very light fragrance and there was nothing visible to be seen upon the initial application . I didn't notice until the following morning (after the two applications) that the coloring was dramatic and the top of my feet (where I hadn't put any on) were a stark white when compared to a dark brown legs (with streaks). I also saw in between my fingers, some brown coloring. I ended up using a wash cloth to try to clean up my legs and my fingers and ended up making the streaks even worse. I am not sure who can use this or why. I would prefer to spend $10 and get a spray tan as this is way too difficult to see what the impact will be until a day or two after the application and at that time, it will be too late. Might be good for someone else, but not me.

title: Great shower product, a bit expensive
text: Great shower aid. I agree with some of the others, think it is better to take with you on an extended trip (think 10-21 days) than to be using daily in the shower. As positives, I loved this light fragrance and the buffer makes my skin feel silky smooth. My issue with this, if there is any, is the cost and the fact that when I hang this in my shower, the water from my shower keeps running on it even when I am not using (using up some of the soap). Maybe it's my shower set up, but I have to place it where the water pours and I found this will probably last me a lot less than maybe others. To me, I would probably only get a good 10 uses out of it and it becomes way too expensive for my use. Rating it as a 4 star because I think it will work well for others. And, like I said, I felt great after using it and my skin was fantastic. I will definitely get one of these for my Mediterranean cruise in May 2017 to take along with me.

title: Pricey but well worth it. Skip the spas and do it yourself at home
text: Another home run from La Roche-Posay. After using this for almost a month, I can testify to the amazing effect it has had on my skin. I have found the small lines around my eyes have all but disappeared and my 60 year old skin is plumper and fuller and way softer to the touch. I do think $65 is a high price for a small amount of serum which is not coming directly from a physician's prescription. But, after having used this now for a while I think it is an amazing serum and a must have for anyone's aging skin. Skip the doctor's office and spas and try this first. You will be amazed at the results.

title: Great lip color - moisturizing and colorful. Great for the holidays!
text: Great long lasting lip color. Goes on smoothly and makes my lips feel soft and smooth. Little deeper red color than I was expecting, so you might want to check it out in the stores before purchasing (if you are unsure of the color). If I had any complaint at all, it would be that I wish it was glossier (as I really like a strong glossy lip color). But, I know this is technically a lipstick (ok, so they call it a 'crayon'), so I cannot in good conscience deduct any points. Great price, too.

title: Wonderful wet/dry razor! Would make a great holiday present for the man in your life!
text: This is my husband's new favorite razor. He originally said to me that he really didn't need this, but after reading all the positive reviews, he was sold. This shaves closer than his old Remington and holds a charge longer than any razor he has owned and used. The LED display is clear and bright and easy to read. He also loves the low battery indicator and the pop up trimmer (somethings his old razor didn't have). If you are on the fence to switching from a standard non-electric razor to an electric, this is the model to pick. You will never return to a standard or disposable razor again. Couldn't be happier.

title: Nice mascara, not waterproof
text: Not waterproof, comes off easily. That is why I am deducting a star. Outside of that, I found that this mascara applied easily and it did make my lashes look fuller and longer. I made the mistake of going to sleep with my makeup still on (yes, I know, my bad) and woke up with some of the worst raccoon eyes I ever had. So, for the remainder of my use of this product, I will need to be sure I use my makeup remover every night. I cannot really recommend this product as I honestly prefer a waterproof and tend to lean towards Almay products. However, for other folks this may work great. As I mentioned, it does do an amazing job of building up your lashes and makes them look amazing. Just be sure you remove it nightly and don't plan to wear it if you may be exposed to any moisture (working out, weather, etc).

title: Nice lip color, lighter/pinker than anticpated.
text: I was hoping this lip color would have been a little darker/redder as the picture seemed to indicate it would be. It is definitely a pink color. Would have also liked it a little more glossy as it is a flatter sheen. Rating it as 4 stars as it is L'Oréal and I normally love their products given the quality.
