I found this to be pretty long lasting. Just wish it were shinier and darker.

title: Ahava hits another home run! This time for my eyes. Love it, love it, love it!
text: I am a pure Ahava enthusiast having first found their products while touring Massada in Isreal back in 2009. I love the mineral ingredients which specifically come from the Dead Sea. My skin, and under eyes, have improved dramatically in the last 3 weeks since using this Time to Revitalize. Less puffiness and dark circles are beginning to fade. I will be purchasing more!

title: Another fantastic Ahava product. Love, love, love!
text: I have written a load of reviews about Ahava products and almost all have been 5 star. I was first introduced to Ahava on a trip to Israel about 6 years ago. When we visited the Dead Sea and then Massada, I went into the gift shop at Massada and saw some creams made by Ahava. Always looking for new skin care items, I read the boxes and saw all the benefits of the Dead Sea minerals and bought several of them. I have been hooked since. I think I have or have had, every one of their products. This night serum was new to me. It goes on smoothly, has a very light fragrance and my skin feels amazing when I wake up in the morning. Everyone over the age of 40 has to try Ahava products. My skin (at age 61) looks better and feels better than it did when I was in my mid-30's. There are definite benefits and results are quickly realized. You will love Ahava, the way I do. And this night serum is perfect as an introduction to the entire line.

title: Attractive but not powerful
text: I am not absolutely thrilled with this dryer. It is quiet, but not as strong/powerful as I would like it to be. Seems to take me longer to do a normal hair dry when compared to my previous dryer (Remington). On the plus side, it is attractive/modern and looks great on my vanity. It fits well in my hand (ergonomic) and as I mentioned runs quietly. I think this would be best for a person with shorter/thinner hair. But, with my thicker shoulder length hair, I am returning to my previous dryer and moving this into the guest bathroom.

title: Clean up is a breeze! I love these makeup remover pads!
text: To be honest, I have never used eye makeup remover pads before. Typically, I use a gentle cleanser and a washcloth and just hope for the best. But usually, I get little of the mascara that is on my lashes and through the day I start to see little black specs on my skin. I was really pleasantly surprised with these Kleenex removers. First, they are soft (not like a washcloth) and they smoothly remove all my eye makeup with no residue. I am sold and will be keeping these on my bathroom counter permanently now. And on top of it, the little dispenser is so cute it looks great there as well. If I had any complaints at all it would be with the size of the pads. Wish they were a little bigger. But all in all, great product!

title: Florida humidity has nothing on this Frizz Fighter Revlon hair dryer!
text: I live in Florida where the humidity during the summer wreaks havoc on my hair. I even splurge twice a year (at least) to get Agave treatments to help with the frizz. Although the Agave treatments really help, I often need more than the strong conditioners. When I first saw this Frizz Fighter hair dryer I must admit I was skeptical. However after using it for 3 weeks now I can honestly say that my hair looks so much better and I get less frizz and flyaway hairs and helps the Agave in my hair stay sealed in and makes my hair more manageable. On top of the way this dryer works, I love the styling of the dryer itself. It looks wonderful on my bathroom counter with its sleek smart styling and beautiful red color. In addition, it is a powerful drying mechanism and is relatively quiet considering. I highly recommend this dryer to assist in all your hair needs.

title: Wonderful product! Highly recommend!
text: I need to begin by saying I absolutely love Ahava products. I found Ahava on a pilgrimage I did to Israel in 2008 and a visit to the site of Masada at the Dead Sea. I picked up a gift package of a few of their products and I was immediately hooked. Every day I use their Mud exfoliator, at night I use their night cream and at least once a week I use one of their Mud Pack facial products. I am 61 years old and am often told I look to be in my low 50s. I was thrilled when I saw this new Ahava Osmoter product. I have been using this daily now for about a week and I will say my skin feels and looks like it is glowing. It goes on like silk, has a nice subtle fragrnace and my skin feels amazing throughout the day (even after I put on makeup and/or sun screen). I know this is pricy and you might be able to do better purchasing elsewhere (if you find it cheaper). You won't find a product line that is better for you than Ahava, feeding your skin richly with Dead Sea minerals and keeping you looking young and vibrant.

title: Another great Essie product!
text: I must begin by saying I love Essie products. I usually purchase them exclusively (like them much better than OPI) and bring them to the nail salon when I go for manicures (I don't like using the salon's reused colors, so I bring my own). Usually only needing one coat, Essie polishes my nails completely and beautifully so that after one coat, all I need is a top coat and I am done. This new color Taj is no exception. I will say, that I didn't care for this color as much as others, find it not as shiny and is more matted in color than I would like. However, I need to rate it 5 stars because of the quality and because it may be the color you are looking for to match your needs. I do love the Resort Trend line of colors and own several of them for summer wear.

title: Nice blush, only wish it had come with a brush for applications on the go
text: This was my first use of Julep makeup. I will say that I was happy to see that the 'petal pink' color does apply lighter on the skin than it looked in the box (I thought it was going to be dark). I was a little disappointed to see that this compact comes with a mirror (nice to have when you are away from your vanity) but doesn't come with a brush. Luckily, I have several makeup brushes that I keep when I apply at home which I used. I will have to purchase a smaller brush to keep with me if I expect to take this in my purse when I go out. This goes on smoothly, light and has a nice finish on my skin.

title: Another fantastic Nivea product! This time it's just for men (lol, well, I think woman can easily use it, too!)
text: Wonderful product. I must admit I was slightly skeptical given the low price, but reality is Nivea always exceeds expectations. I love the fact that this is made for men. Pleasant, not overly bearing, fragrance. Great little container makes it handy to travel with. And the product itself is non-greasy and keeps my husbands skin soft, smooth and touchable. I love this for after shaving to keep his skin optimal. No man's bathroom should be without this. Would make a great stocking stuffer over the holidays for all the men in your life!

title: Great Essie Summer Collection color! Perfect for every day, casual or dress up occasions
text: I love Essie products and this beautiful color is no exception. Nice rich light red color, goes on smoothly and makes my nails look shiny like glass. I find that with Essie my nails chip less and the color lasts longer. This is a great shade for a pedicure, looks so cute with my sandals!

title: Great finishing spray that everyone can and should have in their cabinet!
text: Absolutely must have for prolonging the life of your makeup. I have mixed skin (nose oily, cheeks dry) and I find this works incredibly well with my skin. I love using this when I know I will be facing some uncomfortable elements. For example, I have a friend with a boat and whenever I sail, I always finish my make up with setting spray (given the wind and mist on the sea, this setting spray keeps my protected and look like a million bucks hours after application). It's also great to spritz at night before you go out dancing (as it protects your make up from sweat as well). This Maybelline product is a light spray with a light fragrance. Love it!

title: Nice product, but super expensive for the size
text: Ok, so assuming money is no object, this is a decent product. Exfoliator works well (not really for the face, more for the neck, chest, arms and body). I do love the moisturizer (body repair) it's thick and creamy (almost reminds me of my mother's old Ponds face cream). I will say that my skin feels great after a couple of weeks of use. Didn't really have a crepe problem, but I do have dry skin and some fine wrinkles. This duo does the job. However, the 4 star rating is discounting for the cost. This is really a 'trial' size, yet it is over $60 in cost. You can do better on your own using other products (I love Ahava products as well as Olay). I say shop around a bit or wait for the price to come down a bit.

title: Great addition to your beauty regimen. Amazing results for your lips and surrounding areas
text: Absolutely loved this lip treatment. I typically use moisturizers on my face, but I guess I never thought of how my lips probably are one of the first areas that show my age. This cream is a smoothing addition to my daily beauty regimen now. I use it at night before bed and in the morning when I wake up. I can honestly say that after using this for almost two weeks now, the results are amazing. I see my lips looking fuller (I typically have thin lips) and the skin around them is smoother. If there is any down size it's the size of the product and the cost. I mean, I will probably be through this little jar in less than a month. Not sure I will spend $60 a month or so for this. But, maybe in this case, you do get what you pay for.

title: Nice exfoliator - overpriced for my needs
text: This is a gentle exfoliator. Rating it 4 stars mainly because I didn't care for the aroma (somewhat strong) and I think it is way over priced. I am 60 years old and do not have crepe issues, but I do have aging skin and sagging issues. I have used this for two weeks now. I will state that my skin is a lot smoother than it was before I used it and it does appear to be more hydrated (considering I am in Florida, that is a strong plus). However, for the money, I could buy Ahave products for exfoliating and get the same or better results (and much less a cost). As I do not have major creping issues, I cannot say whether this products works (which may justify the cost), but for my needs it is an excellent exfoliator and I know I could do better price wise for same

title: Great brush - every woman should own one!
text: Absolutely fantastic buffing brush. Besides being a perfect smaller size (will not take up that much room in your makeup case), it fits wonderfully in your hand allowing for expert applications. The bristles are strong, yet oh so soft. Use this for my blush application and the results come out professionally every time. I cannot recommend a better brush for this purpose. Japonesque is known for they high quality products and this buffing brush is no exception.

title: I love this product!
text: One of my largest skin problem areas since I have passed age 50 is my legs. No matter how often I try to use lotion on them, I still tend to find (particularly after shaving) to find my legs having that repulsive 'alligator skin' look. I started using this Vichy product immediately after showering daily and now I see a noticeable difference on how my legs look. I have no idea what the other reviewers are saying out here. I found the fragrance very light and the lotion itself also light (not sticky) and it absorbs quickly Into my overly dry skin. I am now using it on my arms as well and I see an amazing difference simply after a week of use. I highly recommend this body lotion for over age 50 skin, particularly those with skin which may be prone to the elements (either very cold or very hot/sunny environments).

title: Great little trimmer!
text: Compact, efficient and does the job. Rating it as a 4 star simply because as it pertains to using in nostrils, the head tip seems to be big (for me anyway), for others it might work well. I will not use if for this any more. Instead, as an eyebrow trimmer, and even for ear hairs, this works well. I love the lightweight design, it's great for taking with you when you travel. Uses a AAA battery.

title: Great sunblock - a little greasy, but does the job
text: Slightly oily (why I rated it 4 stars), but it is light. Needed to wait a bit before applying my foundation (to assure it was absorbed in). Works well, love that it is an SPF50 for my face. Lasted hours while I was outside (used this on a cruise where the sun was brutal). This bottle will last a long time as a little goes a long way.

title: I really like this Perfect Hydra lotion!
text: Contrary to other reviews on here, I really do like the fragrance of this oil. I find it light and youthful (yes, I think it is the olive oil ingredient). Goes on smooth, my 60 year old skin is glowing after using it each morning. Make sure it dries thoroughly before applying any regular makeup. Although, I find just using this with some blush seems to be fine for when I go to work in the morning. I see a definite improvement since using this in the dryness factor of my skin.

title: Great UV protection in a convenient spray!
text: I need to begin by saying I love La Roche and Ahava products. Use both exclusively in my daily skin regimen and my 60 year old skin looks better than it did 20 years ago (no kidding). I love this light spray. Easy to apply, strong enough to block UVA rays, and is non greasy. I had never used a spray UV product before and I must admit I am sold. I love the way I can apply it quickly to my legs and arms. For my face, I sprayed it into my hand and applied. No residue, nice smell. Very pleased.

title: I love La Roche - always delivers quality!
text: Another wonderful product from  La Roche-Posay. Goes on light and smooth, perfect to apply after a shower and prior to makeup. I have always loved La Roche, it used to only be available from dermatologists but now you can buy the product everywhere. I love the UV protection as well as it is non-greasy (as most UV products are). Might be a little over priced, but most La Roche is, then again you do get what you pay for. A little goes a long way with this tube, will last a few months.

title: Not what I expect from Burt's Bees
text: Typically I like the Burt;s Bees product, but I have been using this now for a few weeks and haven't noticed any difference. I also find the fragrance to be a bit strong for me. I am rating as three stars simply because they typically make great products and I am thinking it might be my skin type where I am not seeing a difference. It does go on light and smooth and it is reasonably priced. I guess you could try to see if it works for you, but it didn't for me.

title: Absolutely loved the Gourmet variety
text: Wish I knew where this was made (I couldn't find the origin on the bottles unless it was in super tiny print that I couldn't make out). Anyway, giving it 4 stars mainly because of the Gourmet variety. I love the mango scent and the gel does a great job of cleaning. I felt refreshed and revitalized the entire day. I didn't particularly care for the scent of the other two bottles. Shine was way too strong and Perfume had a rich rose fragrance (too overbearing for my tastes). Anyway, these are reasonably priced. The scents are definitely for women (not men for sure) and they do a great job of making you feel clean. I will use the Gourmet until the bottle is finished, not sure about the other two as they are too strong for me

title: Great roll on protection, not to be worn with a sleeveless black d
text: Rating this as 4 stars. Although I love the clean, fresh fragrance, I am not a fan of the residue or film that this product leaves on you after you apply it. For that very reason, I usually steer clear of anything but gels for my daily use. However, I will say that this Dove deodorant did apply easily, is beautifully designed and as I mentioned earlier has an amazing fresh scent. I know there are people out there that love this type of rollon, but since I often like to go sleeveless, I prefer a product that you can not see if you raise your arms. This is a great protector, though, as I wore it while playing tennis and I did feel fresh and clean when I was done (just as well if not better than any gel deodorant I may use.

title: Great coverage, light, non-greasy.
text: I have no idea why someone complained about this new Superstay. I got this through the Vine program. I found it light, not greasy, and full coverage (covered my pores without being too heavy). This Natural color blends perfectly with my skin tone (I am Irish heritage but I do have a medium complexion). I honestly couldn't be happier with this and I do plan to purchase more when I run out. It has solid coverage, but is not greasy or heavy. Very natural looking.

title: Smells great, great quality overall (but still need a standalone conditioner).
text: I will start with the positives. I love the smell of this shampoo, reminds me oddly of the old Herbal Essence, so in that point, it's my new favorite shampoo. It does clean my hair well, haven't noticed any major change in the last week of using with dandruff (although maybe I haven't used it long enough). However, if this is like other H&S shampoos, I am sure it is working. I deducted one star, not necessarily because of this brand, but because of all of these 'combination' shampoos. I still use a conditioner as none of these ever seem to do the trick on my hair on their own. I like to leave the conditioner in for a few minutes and you can't do that with this. I really wish someone would make a better product that would allow me to truly only use one type of product (in lieu of having to always use a conditioner on top of it).

title: Great shower gel.  I was skeptical at first, but now I love it!
text: Normally, I don't prefer too much of a scent on my man. Usually, a little cologne if we go out is all he needs. When I first saw this Biagiotti Gel I hesitated. But, being how I am headed back to Italy (Rome) in May, I was lured into getting this. And, how pleasantly surprised I was. My man loves the gel, foams up nice in the shower and he feels fresh and clean after using it. And, I, who wasn't sure why I was even taking this, was pleasantly surprised how good he smells just getting out of the shower. Not perfumey at all, and very masculine. I really love this Roma Uomo scent and I would recommend it for every day use for the man in your life.

title: Great for face protection, light tint seals the deal!
text: At first, I wasn't sure what to expect when they mentioned in the product that this is tinted. I was waiting to see a color choice, or something that would replicate a chart of some kind to match a skin tone. Well, when I received it I know why. It basically is a light tint, used for a minimal foundation for your face, but really does the trick and adapts to all tones. I love the fact that, if I am spending the day outside (as I do very often in the Florida sun with golf, tennis and just being outdoors) I do not need to use a foundation and layer it with sunscreen (I never know which to apply first). Fallene solves this problem with protecting your skin with an SPF 50 and also providing a light foundation for your skin. As others mentioned,, it does tend to be a little greasy (as do many sunscreen products), which is why I rated this 4 instead of 5 stars. But I honestly think the pros outweigh the cons with this product. Use this only for when you are spending the day out in the sun and you will love it!

title: Wonderful miracle hair regrowth product!!!
text: I always remember my ex-husband using Rogaine years ago and I used to laugh at how vane he was, lol, to want to grow hair back. Well, I find myself now using Rogaine. I am using it on my eyebrows (my salon hairdresser had recommended it since I am getting older and my eyebrows were thinning). Although it's not recommended for contact that close to the eyes I have been very, very careful to use limited amounts and that none of it 'leaks' down. I love the foam application, it makes it simple to apply. As others have mentioned it has minoxidil which does have it's side effects, so carefully consider before using. I have started to see some growth in areas of my brows where no hair had been coming in for years now. I think this is great and will most likely not be using this for the full 4 month supply. I will update this again as I use it longer some time next month to see if it continues to work as well as I think it will.

title: Excellent flat iron!
text: I always use an iron of somesort on my hair (just prefer my hair straight in contrast to the natural wave that I have). I previously had used the Remington Shine Therapy model so I thought I would compare the Frizz Therapy to it. I actually prefer the S8510DS Frizz therapy iron over the Shine therapy. I find my hair to be sleek and looks like it was keratin conditioned every time I use it. I love the way my hair shines. If I had any complaint at all it would be in the 1" size. I have previously used 1.5 and 2 inch irons and I feel they are easier to use for me. But all in all, the Remington Frizz Therapy is a great product and I highly recommend it.

title: Great disposable shaver if you don't mind the cost
text: Of course when I think of disposables, I think of those little cheap ones I used to get 10 for a dollar or two. These new BIC Flex4's do the job of a solid razor with the benefit of being disposable. I gave these to my 24 year old son to try out for me. He gave them a 5 star ratin. First, they lasted longer than a typical disposable (he told me one of the razors lasted him over 2 weeks of daily use). Secondly, the shave was really close with the 4 blade technology. He highly recommends these for anyone looking for an upgrade for a traditional disposable. They would be wonderful to take on vacation this year to use in place of your every day razor and you can throw it out before you leave the islands to come home (less to pack). These disposables come as close to a traditional razor as you can get.

title: Cheaper than a plastic surgeon
text: I have been using the Olay Anti-Aging protocol for just about a month. I admit I do see a difference in my skin. I am 53 years old and have been finding my skin getting drier and drier as I age. The protocol system is complete and is beginning to restore the moisture and suppleness of my skin. I particularly like the impact the Eye Restoration Complex has had on the dark circles and crows feet which had been surrounding my eyes. I have noticed that minor wrinkles are beginning to diminish. The only reason I didn't rate this product 5 stars is because I think it is very pricey for what you get. I also have used the Biomedic line of products in the past and have found them to be even more effective. For a product sold by Oil of Olay to cost over $60 seems unreasonable, as I see O of O to be more of a drug store/ supermarket product and shouldn't warrant the price. If Amazon is offering rebates or specials on this product, then definitely buy, buy, buy.

title: Four Stars
text: Wasn't like the scratch and sniff patch that I had used.  However, a wonderful fragrance.

title: Four Stars
text: Liked this very much.  Goes on smooth and the color was just what I wanted.

title: My new favorite!
text: I ordered this because I was ordering groceries and Whole foods didn’t have any of my regular choices. Surprise! I love it! Lightweight and very moisturizing! I have a new favorite. This is really good stuff! Try it!

title: Floratta Rose
text: Beautiful! Nice and light Flowery scent. I wear Coco Mademoiselle and Flowerbomb by Viktor and Rolf- And this is similar to those, in that same scent family, I would say. Very happy with this purchase! Try it!

title: BUY IT!!
text: This stuff is AWESOME! My face is so clean and my pores are clean and clear! I love it! My skin is Super smooth after just one wash! Buy it!!

title: Get this for clean, glowing skin!
text: I love this! It gets my face so much cleaner- and my pores as well. My face is shiny clean and glowing afterwards. Very small- so I will get the larger one. The silicone stays bacteria- free, and it is soft on your skin. The massage vibration helps circulation and gets the blood flowing for glowing skin. I can tell it has gotten rid of dead skin off the surface and in my pores. Love it!!

title: Smells great!
text: This item arrived quickly and packaged well. It is a nice sized bottle too. I put it in my aromatherapy diffuser with a little lemon grass oil and my house smells like a spa! Great buy.

title: Excelente
text: Huele rico y es super grande y vino sellado

title: Super Moisturizing

title: Finishing touch hair remover
text:
I was very disappointed that this didn't come with some kind of case! But here is what I think on my use so far..
PROS-
-Mostly painless - a little pulling. I am guessing this feels like what my husband describes as a man using a man's electric razor on his face - sometimes it's uncomfortable.
-Easy to use
-Comes with a little brush to "clean" the head off with.
-Didn't leave red bumps or rash - but that is more evidence it's just "shaving" the hair - so it will be a daily routine if you're really concerned or have really dark hair - which I should maybe move to the "con" section... but I'll leave here for the moment.
-It does remove most of the hair - but.. see below.
CONS -
-this does not make the skin smooth. You can feel the hair - running your hand up the opposite direction of growth. You move the shaver in circular motion - and it shaves the hair - so it's less visible than a long hair, but still can be felt. - I have one hair that grows on my chin.. I pluck it and I'm covered for months. With this method, I can see having to do this many times a week in order to control the "stubble."
- Stubble, not "smooth skin"
- NO CASE!!! Eh. There is the shaver itself and a tiny little plastic brush to keep track off. A case would be nice.
-NOT rechargable - AA battery (One no-name Asian brand battery included)
I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I am interested to see how long I can go between "shaves" and how long the battery lasts. In my opinion the combination of price, actual results and lack of a case - I would not purchase again. I think my tweezers are a much for effective method for me. Now, in full disclosure, I am naturally blonde. I do have tiny, largely invisible hairs on my upper lip - so that is where I tried it. I wish I hadn't.

title: short french tips
text:
UPDATE BELOW.....I purchased these because I in this time of virus, no one (smart people that is) is getting mani/pedis right now. Additionally, you have to ask yourself - that also means you aren't being seen that much either.. But on occasion - I do really mourn my beautiful nails...So... I am trying to do whatever I can. I've had a french tip manicure every 2 weeks for over 20 years. It has been a very rough 6 months. With no hope in sight for a reasonably safe mani/pedi - I've decided to try a few things on my own. This is one of them. The tips are nice. The flower tip to hold onto while you apply it is useful. Then clip the flower tip off and file. The white tips themselves are not very thick, so I you are able to apply a nice, thick coat of clear over the top and you do not have to deal with the dip, gel, or acrylic powder. Which I am very happy about. I use OPI for soft and thin nails. It's clear and thick. 2 coats do it. Works like a dream. The white tips are short, so they grow out easily and you can reapply - or save for special occasions. In fairness, I also purchased tape guides and white polish too. Either works, but I think these tips look a bit better - just in the perfect moon shape. You will need some good nail glue. I purchased a type with a brush applicator. Good for the non-professional. Look, it's not perfect, but until we can safely get back to our salons - this will work for the rare time someone may actually see you OR you just want to feel better for a few days. Having said all of this, I was very disappointed to receive a set with a broken case. So it will not close. I have to rubber band it so they don't all fall out in the drawer. Eh. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE 2/27/2022 I still LOVE these. Easy to use. And a good option to salon nails. Who knew it would be 2+ years (out of salons) - but I have come to just get used to a new normal. I really love not doing the gel/acrylic any more. If I didn't have these tips - I'm not sure.. Easy to use, flexible when applying, last well. I gave up on the polish/curved tapes. title: wave hair iron
text: Wow. This wave iron is amazing.  Let's get to it.  I could have included pics, but honestly, there are a lot of examples of that already.  I have fairly thick hair, with medium course texture - natural dark blonde, about shoulder length.  The handle is a combo of purple metal and black plastic.  The on and off switch and the temp guides are inside the pinch of the handle.  VERY, very smart.  I don't how many times I've used my regular curling iron and turned it off over and over again because the switches are placed exactly where you hold the iron - even on my flattening iron.  So bonus on the well placed switches.  There is a twist knob on the other end of the iron that allows you basically change the dimension/pattern of your wave... they can be more uniform, or more wild depending on the middle wave iron.  There are three barrels as you can see in the diagram.  The cord is long and convenient with the most important "swivel."  It has 6 heat settings 250 degrees up to 400 degrees.  Now, let's talk heat - it gets HOT.  I would recommend using the lowest heat and testing one step at a time to find the level that doesn't fry your hair - especially if you have color treated or chemically processed hair.  Lower heat, for just few seconds at the very most is all it takes.  I have a pretty full head of hair and I was done in about 15 minutes. The other thing to note about the heat part is that the iron works on a "pinch" system as you would guess.. there are 2 barrels that are completely open and branding hot.  So BE CAREFUL!  I accidentally burned my left thumb pretty good - happens so fast!  I purchased the "suggested" hot glove - I now use it every single time I use this iron.  And be careful when you get close to your skin, around your face.  Having fully covered the safety suggestions, I will say that the waves I did lasted 4 days (I wanted to see how far I could go) and probably would have lasted longer with NO other products in my hair. The finer strands around my face needed a slight touch up, but the rest totally stayed wavy!  It was sort of like getting a wave perm or something. I was amazed.  I don't get greasy looking hair, but you could use a dry shampoo to extend wear to a day or two easily.  The wave "action" gives you body and fullness - like a crimper iron - but so much softer.  I have "sold" so many of these in the last few days - so many people asking if I'd had a perm... what salon did my hair...  and when I told them about the wave iron, where can I get one??  I've purchased sooo many hair "tools" in my life... but this is honestly one of my favs.  Just remember to use extreme caution when it gets hot with the open barrels .. and use lowest temps - going up one step at time to find the perfect temp for your hair type.  Don't leave on one spot too long and you'll be amazed at the result and then the staying power of the do!  Having said all those things, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I will be ordering another one for travel soon.  Would be out of this world if they included a heat proof sleeve!

title: braun epilator hair remover
text: I have been using this types of hair removers since they were first offered.  I was in the market for a new one and this one drew my attention because it was cordless - recharging remover.  It has a very useful light - makes fair hair more visible and the cordless aspect of it is awesome.  However, I learned a few things about using this particular epilator. .. One, it doesn't work as effectively if you move in a circular motion - like with the original older style removers.  I found it barely removed any hair using that age old method.  What worked better was going in a slow, steady straight line.  It's a bit more painful this way - but if you want the hair to come out with this particular hair puller, you gotta do that.  You may be wondering about how long the charge lasted... it lasted long enough for me to do both calves... but couldn't last with enough power to add your upper leg (thighs)..  Now... of course this will be different for everyone I think - depending on how much hair you have.. how long you linger to remove that hair.. how much hair you want to remove... etc.  Also, to be fair, you should know that exfoliating before pulling hair definitely helps the process be more effective, however, you will never get a smooooth finish... like with a razor shave.  But it will remove the bulk of the hair. It takes a couple of hours to fully charge and comes with its specific charger.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And I hope this info was helpful to you!

title: collagen eye masks pads
text: I purchased these thinking... well... they are inexpensive, how well can they work??  They are simple, very low key... but I believe, after about 2 weeks of use, approximately every other day or so (different times, morning, afternoon and just before bed)... I believe I notice a visible reduction in the puffiness under my eyes. I started to see that I looked more rested... way less puffy. First thing I've tried that is actually showing results and I am all about ACTUAL results. As you can see by other reviewers pics, they are white... individually they are a thin cloth like material that are moist.. apply and let sit while you relax - not vigorously doing anything. After about 15 mins they sort of dry out.. gently remove and gently pat what remains on your under eye area...  NOTE:  Be careful as you are pulling them apart that you get only one at time.  Because they are "stacked" together, you might get more than one and waste an application.  I just really wish I had done a before and after shot.  I was so certain they weren't really going to be very effective that I didn't.  That's a shame.  These are an amazing thing and SOOOOO reasonably priced - I enjoy them as often as I'd like - but typically only once per day.  I would say if you have tried any other type of under eye treatment with "meh" results, try these.  They are affordable and I believe that after just one pak of use, you WILL see results that you can notice. I just went back and ordered several more - I never want to run out.  Shhhhhhh. title: magnetic eyelashes
text:
PLEASE SEE UPDATE BELOW: So, I am 57. After 3 hours, I gave up. I have included a pic showing the brief instructions. Honestly, I would have needed a third hand to get this done. I admit that some people may have more luck than I did... but I feel I need to honestly provide an accurate review of my experience. I really was NOT successful in 'setting the top lash on' and then retrieving the bottom lash underneath my natural lashes as the top lash would not stay no matter how still I remained. The set I purchased was filling out just the outer lashes which is how I usually do my mascara, so I was ok with that. I am questioning whether a "full set" may have been easier to install?? But I after the hours I spent trying to make these work I'm really not going to go there. I would just say that if you are considering them, I might suggest a full set rather than the smaller - harder to handle in my opinion half set. I will also say the the tiny magnets are VERY strong. Once coupled, they are very difficult to separate without causing the fake lashes from going in crazy directions. So even had I been able to get the properly installed, it would be a very difficult task to remove them without too much damage to the direction the individual faux lashes go - therefore rendering them really not reusable. I did find that a good pair of tweezers was somewhat useful in helping to separate the magnetic. Also tricky so close to your eyeball! Be careful! The brushes provided (not shown in my photo - several of them with multi colored heads) - were not super effective in re positioning lashes that had been misplaced. I will happily use the brushes on my eyebrows - that is about all I can use out of the kit. They are a good quality disposable brush. It also came with a round, clear case (shown in my photo - very different that the one shown in the ad) that is apparently magnetized a bit to store your lashes in and a lovely gold cloth drawstring bag. I really WANTED these to work - wanted to believe the glowing reviews... however, for some of us I just don't think they will be a successful experience. I do my best to provide honest, full info reviews - reflecting my actual experience and my opinions. While I much prefer to write 5 star reviews, I hope even my 1 star reviews can be helpful.
UPDATE: 11/16/2017.... Seller immediately contacted me and offered assistance and a replacement set of lashes. Oh and some plastic tweezers. HELPFUL NOTE: Seller says that when you are trying to remove them.. move them side to side slightly, not up and down - as you fighting the very strong magnets. The plastic tweezers don't attach to the magnets.. however, I didn't find that to be a problem. I promised to try again and let them know. I have to say that I am very much appreciative of a seller who tries very hard to make things as good as they can be for everyone. So... I have revised my review rating and I will update when I have made a new attempt.
UPDATE: 11/19.... new set of lashes and plastic tweezers arrived... AS PROMISED. I think it's important to note that. I have not tried again, but will after the holidays... too much going on to focus on these just now. BUT... I WILL update as soon as I do.
UPDATE: 11/25.... So... these just won't work for me. Had my daughter helping.. but not even with her extra hands and efforts and special tools..... we were not able to make them work! I am soooo happy for those who get it to work! Best to all!

text:

title: voloom crimping iron
text:
I am not leaving a review with "before" and "after" shots as those have been well covered and mine looked like everyone elses...I really appreciate it when people leave pics. That is really helpful.
Here is what I think about this "volumizing" iron... my opinion may differ from yours, but that is ok!
1. It takes a few tries to get the best effective technique down (making sure to get just the under layers and leave enough top layer to cover the crimping), but it is fairly easy eventually - it comes with the really nice, strong clips and a rat tail type brush that helps you separate your layers. My hair is medium thickness in my opinion and the clips held large volumes of my hair to the side as I worked with the under layer. The iron has a power on/off button and a "+" and "-" to raise and lower the temperature. They give you an idea on what temp to use by what your natural hair thickness is. It does NOT have an "auto power off" feature, so do remember to turn it off. It did take quite a long time to cool off too. So I wouldn't leave it near anything delicate while it cools.
2. It is basically a crimper.... a waffle style crimper. The waffle crimps are what gives you that "volume" or body. The "waffle" crimp pattern spreads the hair out below the crimp - and adds some, but less volume where the waffle crimp actually is. You definitely want to avoid the front 1" to 1 1/2" around your face to avoid the crimp showing, as they recommend. It also comes with a very helpful instruction/FAQ booklet to help you get started. In addition, it comes with a very handy heat resistant travel pouch. All nice additions. But at this price, believe me you paid for every single item included at SUPER high prices!
3. While it did provide some body without backcombing/ratting... it is kinda of labor intensive I think. I went back several times to re-crimp areas to build up the desired body. I am just not sure it's something I would do every day. But that is just me. I am at a point in my life where I want to simplify my life and my routines... But I might do it for a special occasion. Side note: It didn't last more than one day in my hair. I would need to redo the crimping everyday. Mostly I just used at my crown area... I like just a little volume there and a "little" volume is basically all you can do in the crown area because the only "volume" you can get is the waffle pattern.
4. Also, it seems to really dry my hair out - maybe that's part of the "volume" ability? But those with more oily hair may find that appealing (?) Others had said that it also worked as a "straightener".... Hmmm... It just really frizzed/fuzzed out my ends and it wasn't really smooth either... I think it works best as a waffle crimper. I would NOT agree that it doubles as a straightener or flatner.
5. The price is really ridiculous. (one star off for that) - Their marketing works... I mean, I bought it... along with hundreds of others... but let's face it.. it's worth about $50 tops even with the clips, the brush and travel case! They ARE making bank and good for them.
All in all, I am keeping it. I will use it for those special occasions that I feel I need a "lift." It arrived in perfect condition, unopened and quickly (I have prime). At this price point I can't really recommend it because it is seriously overpriced. It's just too expensive for what it does in my opinion. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new information seem useful!

title: Does pull hair out
text:
First, I've been an epilady user since the dark ages... I am not sure the "legend" is an improvement... Here's the truth of it..
1. It DOES pull the hair out, sort of. Mostly the hairs are broken off.... It stings, but it's not deathly painful. I consider it MUCH less painful than waxing. Once you get started you get used to it.
2. Your legs will NOT be silky smooth. They are prickly, because most hairs are broken off instead of actually being "plucked" out. The up side of this is that with regular use, their are fewer hairs. And as a whole it lasts a little longer than razor shaving. The more you use it, the longer it seems to last.
3. I do not recommend using on your under arm or bikini area as your skin is looser there and naturally less dry, so the epilady tends to get caught up in the tender skin there. THIS IS painful. While we're talking about the bikini area, the included bikini trimmer gets a MINUS 5 stars. I loaded the batteries, turned it on ONCE and it would never start again. So it's just added weight to throw into your trash bin. I'd rather have $20 off the price and they keep the trash trimmer.
4. The fact that the legend can be used cordless is... just ok. I did both my legs within the charge time allowed of 45 to 60 minutes. It has a charging light, but it stays on all the time, charged or not, (by design) and must be charged at least 8 hours before using each time. However, they say that leaving it plugged in will lessen the life of the battery. Hmmm. Ok if you're really organized and know exactly WHEN you'll be buzzing your legs. Otherwise, unplug it and just use the cord when you want to use it.
5. The shape IS an improvement... the old ones were odd shaped, more difficult to hold. The legend is easier to hold and not nearly as heavy (less quality? I don't know).
6. It has a "guard" on it to "help" you hold the epilady at the proper angle. I did NOT find this to be terribly effective. I used it on one leg and without on the other. Could not feel the slightest difference. Good news? It's removable and regular head is provided.

I had my original epilady for years. I have feeling this one won't last nearly as long, but it is also much less expensive than the first ones, so I guess you just replace them. The head area is also much smaller than the original, so it takes longer. Hope this is helpful.

title: Nice product
text:
I'm very conflicted on how to rate this product. It did not work out at all for the purpose that I bought it for, but that may just mean that I was expecting a result that I just can't get from using argan oil alone.

I bought this after using the Moroccan oil hair treatment (that super pricey stuff with the bright blue label). That oil worked amazing in my hair and I was sad to see just how expensive a large bottle of it was. So I figured just getting regular argan oil would give me the same result, made sense to me at the time since I thought that the Moroccan treatment was just argan oil, scent and some other non-essential ingredients. Well I was very wrong.

So the pros of this particular product: there is no scent/very little scent. I couldn't pick up on a scent at all. This for me is a huge plus because I hate the scent or argan oil products. That heavy, perfumey scent about makes me want to gag. I thought that was just the normal scent of argan oil, but apparently it is some kind of added fragrance that companies like to use with it because this product has none of that grandma stink to it.
Another plus is that its clear. So it isn't that dark gold color that you will often see. Its a nice sized bottle for the price and it comes with a pump. The pump is admittedly what made me choose this particular brand.

Alright, so the cons. This did not absorb into my hair well at all. I applied a few pumps today after washing and I immediately could tell a difference between this and other oils/serums I've tried in the past. Normally I can distribute a few pumps through my thick, coarse hair pretty well. This stuff was immediately sucked up though. Like I rubbed my hands together and started applying it, and the oil was just gone. That is when I knew that it was either going to A. absorb really well and turn out exactly like I wanted. Or B. I was going to have oily, coated hair.

Well its a few hours later and my hair has dried into a greasy looking, stringy mess. I really don't know how to make this work in order to get the result that I want. I know that it isn't a matter of using too much product, if I were to use less, it would still just instantly stick to wherever I put my hands and not be able to be distributed well. I do think that I will keep it though because I know that I can use it as a general moisturizer for skin and cuticles/nails and I bet that my hair will feel nice once I wash it out. So I won't be able to use it as a leave in product like I was wanting, but I think that it can be used as a deep conditioning oil treatment where you apply a bunch and let it sit for awhile before shampooing.

So while I am disappointed with it, the fact that it doesn't have that heavy scent means that I can use it still in other ways. If my hair magically dries and turns non greasy soon or if it feels amazing after washing it out, then I will update this review.

title: I have pretty thick and textured hair
text:
This review really is for the 4 different Renpure scents i've tried so far: Pomegranate, Coconut cleansing pudding, Rosemary mint and Lavender.

The pomegranate and the coconut both performed well for me. I have pretty thick and textured hair. These both left my hair softened, they left it clean and had no buildup. I have to use quite a bit, maybe 30 pumps or so to get through all of my hair and really work it in, but for the price that really isn't a downside for me. The con of these two is the scent. The pomegranate one is super sweet. When I first smelled it, it kind of put me off. If you like really sweet scents, this might not bother you. To me though, it doesn't smell like pomegranate at all.

The coconut cleansing pudding smelled like straight up Play-doh. I bought two bottles at the same time at TJ Maxx. If I hadn't, it definitely wouldn't have been a re-purchase for me after getting through the first bottle. If you can go locally to smell these for yourself first, I would really suggest that. And then come back to Amazon to order, I can get them for an average of $6.99 a bottle and its about $4 higher in the very few places that actually carry these products.

Now for the other two, the Rosemary mint and the Lavender. I like the scent of both of these. The rosemary mint is just that and its super minty. So if a strong mint scent is your thing, you will probably like it. The Lavender is not a sweet lavender that you would find in a body spray, bubble bath etc... but its a medicinal, natural lavender. Like if you opened a bottle of essential lavender oil, this is what it smells like. Again, a good thing in my book. The negative though is that both for some reason left my hair kind of rough and prone to tangling. I've tried each multiple times and due to that and the burning issue, which I will address next, I may just throw the rest out which is rare for me to not use a product up. These both irritate my scalp quite a bit. I normally work it into my hair first, then wash face and body and rinse it out at the end of the shower. With these two, I start to get a pretty strong burning sensation on my scalp about halfway through the shower. Its not like a refreshing minty tingle either, more of an alarming burn. It does fade of course after some time but its strong enough that I don't want to use the bottles up.

So after using these 4 different scents, I really don't think I will buy any more Renpure products unless I find the coconut one at a super good price. That one performed well enough for me to ignore the funky smell. But the others just have too many negatives to re-buy. One cleansing conditioner that I have purchased multiple times and will continue to re-purchase is the As I Am coconut. It smells good and works great for me.

title: Does NOT work with fine 1C/2A hair, thick density.
text:
I did a lot of research on brushes for fine, thick density type 1C-2A hair and they all pointed to boar bristle brushes. Then I did research on which boar bristle one would work best and, coupled with the reviews, settled on this one.

The brush itself is a sturdy design, weighted by the natural wood construct (+1 star). The bristles looked great in so far as I can tell and had enough give to not worry about putting this brush through my hair and potential breakage (+1 star).

Then I brushed. And brushed. And brushed. Or, should I say, I was merely stroking the very top, outer layer of hair with it because there is ZERO penetration of my hair by these bristles. This is not an exaggeration at all. My hair isn't *that* thick as to have ever repelled brushes, but this brush would only rest atop the surface.

I tried again. No penetration and now all the brush was doing was pumping static electricity into my hair and it was looking like it. That means that it is also agitating my hair cuticles instead of easing them in the "shine" process of stroking like it was. If I wanted to brush my hair, I would literally need to section it off as though I were giving myself highlights and work baby section by baby section for this to "caress" my hair shafts because it absolutely will not brush nor penetrate even the slightest density of locks. Worse, after I stopped, I ran my hand over my hair and it felt very rough and tangled, whereas my hair is usually silky/supple and not difficult to de-tangle. The only possible upside I can find to this is that the bristles were soft against my head as I brushed.

This would normally earn an auto 1 star review because if a hair brush cannot brush your hair then it serves no purpose. However, I do like the company's message and design, so I will subtract only 3 stars overall. More so, I would not hesitate to buy another alternative brush from them again because the packaging is cute, the price is right, the shipping was quick and I really like the naturalness of their brushes. I just wouldn't buy a 100% pure boar bristle brush again because it is useless with easy-going hair. Lack of stars in this review is for the brush alone, not the company.

title: Incomplete product per listing, not magnetic either.
text:
Product does not come with the metal pans as pictured in all its ads on the listing (-1 star). So, if you think you are saving money getting this because it falsely advertises it does come with them, realize you will need to spend extra to buy a whole bag of the pans elsewhere.

The casing is sturdy and not bad looking at all, but picks up fingerprints like crazy (-1 star). You will need to wipe this down after every use because it looks awful. The closure is actually very difficult to snap open, I have to jam my thumbnail in the underside to separate the closure and I've no desire to break my fingernail doing this every time I wish to open it (-1 star).

I tried using all sorts of different items to test the magnetic ability of the tray and absolutely nothing stuck to it (-1 star). Not make up pans of any nature, not any of my tweezers, not even other strong magnets (which holds up to 22 lbs). I do not believe this would keep your cosmetic pans in place and that they would fall out unless ultimately glued.

What I DO appreciate about this product is the sturdy casing if they fix the closure, the very large and very clear mirror (peel off protective film layer!), and the spacing for the pans within the compact. It arrived this afternoon and I am already returning it. So sorry, I just can't work with this and feel the entire product listing was very misleading and dishonest.

title: If I had known, I never would have bought it.
text:
My brush arrived after several weeks in limbo. I was not very happy upon opening the soft padded envelope it was sent in as the packaging was broken and fairly mauled. Upon withdrawing the brush from the package, did notice a bit of 'gunk' on the handle. However, upon closer inspection did realize it was not 'gunk' at all.

The brush itself has a fair weight to it, I actually appreciated that aspect of it. It is entirely plastic, however, and wrapped in a bronze colored plastic coating atop the structure. It is this additional plastic coating which was torn (presumably when the packaging received its damage, though nothing in the package could have caused this in my estimation and thus was possibly damaged prior to shipping). Not just torn, but possibly melted? I am not sure what that dark drag/ripping is along the handle, but you can see a hole gouged out in it in that vicinity. This is exactly where your fingers would wrap around the handle, so there is no ignoring the damage this brush has received.

After disinfecting the brush with a mild vinegar/baking soda bath to see if it was even worth keeping at this point, was able to better inspect the bristles. The "boar bristles" are why I purchased this brush model, not only because they are marketed with the ability to "shine your hair," but because this brush resembles the wooden paddle brush I currently use but with the boar bristle addition - how could I go wrong? Well, apparently very wrong.

The "boar bristles" are very cheaply made and are literally falling out - in the package, in the disinfectant bath, in my hair, on my counter. The bristles have a lot of stringy failed bristles among them which are wisps of plastic draped throughout, both white and black (see photos - that's not lint, those are the crazy bristles!), and go every which way in absolute mayhem. I had figured they would be plastic, as well, but not to such low quality.

Brushing my hair with this thing was an act of masochism. I tried on three different days at three different points of my hair cycle (freshly washed, next day, second day). I have never had a brush literally rake my scalp and cause me pain, and I was not applying pressure. Using this brush actually hurt my scalp. The boar bristles were ineffective and only the taller/harder plastic bristles with balls on them were being used with each swipe of the brush - and they were what was hurting. My hair did not get shinier, it got fluffier due to static-charge, and thus my head was one giant mess of flyaway hairs (usually quite silky). I am assuming the 'shine' claim is the boar bristled sweeping the oils from your scalp and deposits it down the shaft of hair. That's not shine, that is oil.

Needless to say, this $20 nightmare is being sent back immediately. Unless you want to experience the pain and low quality yourself, I'd steer clear of this lemon.

title: Overpowering Synthetic Powder Smell
text:
Bought this product due to reviews of its efficiency despite smell, and boy were they not wrong about the smell. It is overpowering and lingers for hours after application. It is a very synthetic, cheap sweetness of baby powder combined with chemicals and it does not smell "clean" or "fresh" by any stretch of the imagination. I've used it on two different occasions now, and the smell just engulfed my head and I could not escape it. I couldn't even smell my own perfume anymore, it was that potent.

On the efficiency of the product outside of the scent factor, I found that it made my hair feel very dry and gritty to the touch - which, in turn, made application of other products to revitalize necessary. My hair is usually quite silky and supple, cool to the touch. One application, however, and it made my hair texture clumpy, unpleasant and not nice at all - it was just a fluffy mess and felt coated with grime (not tacky). I had zero issue with flakes of the dried shampoo coming out hours after use, but then I did brush after spraying to avoid fallout as the instructions stated to.

I'm going back to my tried and true unscented corn starch baby powder because this dry shampoo was not the answer I was looking for at all. The convenience of the aerosol spray is just not worth it, in my opinion, when you have to consider the very obvious drawbacks. Plus, I don't want to smell like that!

They are as thick as the regular sized bottles so it is incredibly difficult to get the product out of the bottle.

I struggled a lot and had to turn them upside down for a day to get the product near the opening, and successfully squeezing the product out is a near impossible. After so much fuss and fumbling to try to get the product out, half the product was stuck in the container and would not budge. I had to dig it out with tools and was one step away from getting proper shears to cut the bottle open. Way to go, Biolage.

-1 star for not communicating to their customers better about the discontinued status of this product despite all the questions posed.
-2 stars for the packaging/price point.

Coincidentally I have psoriasis and am in the midst of a nasty breakout on my hands (long wait for my dermatologist). I rubbed a few drops onto each hand twice a day for the last three days. My lesions have reduced dramatically in inflammation (from angry red to pink) and there's no itchy skin build up over the lesions as they are prone to do if untreated.

I don't believe it is a cure to put psoriasis into remission, but it is helping with the state of my breakout tremendously until I can get in to see my doctor. I absolutely suggest others with lesions to give it a go and see how your own condition fairs while using this. You will notice that when there is no oil on your lesions, they will return to a somewhat dry state, but it's not uncomfortably dry (for me).

Works well for thin / fine hair. Not too heavy. If you have fine hair then you know how those thick conditioners that leave a residue builds up and after a while your hair isn’t as full. And when you have fine hair, you don’t want that!
What works best for my hair care routine is to always have 2-3 shampoos and 2-3 conditioners I’m my shower at all times to rotate. About 2 times a month I use a clarifying shampoo by Neutrogena which removes all the build up residues from all your hair products. It can dry out your hair, so just use once every 2-3 weeks. Also, for longer hair if you can wear your hair up in a towel till almost dry, then you can finish off with a quick blow dry if desired. My hair is always fuller from that method. Kinda like the same effect of adding hair spray to your roots for a lift, but without the extra product.
And... my new go to is gummy candy. Love the stuff, and found when I eat a bag a week or so, my hair definitely grows faster then when I don’t eat them for months. I know, I’m forced to eat candy for my vanity. Such a bummer!
Basically it’s the gelatin. Hair products with it don’t work the same as eating it. You can buy plain gelatin and add it to your smoothie.
For whole it may concern: Gelatin is not vegan or vegetarian. It’s an animal product. Hope this information helps someone :)
Blessings :)

3. It has a rechargeable NiMH battery that charges relatively quickly.
4. It has a rubberized grip zone for easy handling even in wet conditions.

Despite these positive features, I think this electric shaver would probably be best as a first razor for someone that is just beginning to shave and whose beard is still relatively light. It would also make a good travel razor for anyone using it on short trips, camping, etc. because it is rechargeable and portable (it does not, however, come with a travel case, which would have been nice). I'm not certain that most people would want to use the Braun 310S shaver as their everyday razor for the following reasons:

1. Anyone with a moderate to heavy beard will find that this razor may require them to go over the same area repeatedly to get the closest possible shave.
2. The light construction of this razor makes me wonder if it will have the durability to stand up to the rigors of everyday use for a prolonged period of time.
3. It is a relatively noisy shaver. Foil shavers generally tend to be more noisy than their rotary counterparts, and the Braun 310S is certainly no exception.

title: So fresh!!! Leaves the skin feeling soft and clean!
text: I really bought this not expecting too much of it although at first I did notice that the colour was slightly off, because all the instructions are in korean (I think), I wasn't really able to tell if the product was past due or not because it didn't look blue in fact it looked transparent and kind of greenish in colour, I will attach a picture later if possible. It did not smell bad though so I just assume that it is in good condition and it's just the picture that looks different here. The mask itself is nice though, the package is also good and the container is very sturdy and good quality glass, what I did notice right away was the applicator brush since it's very soft and easy to use and clean. The mask itself feels very fresh on the skin and it's a nice refreshing cool sensation, you can definitely tell after putting it on once it starts to dry because you can feel it drying on your skin as it becomes ready to remove, by then it is not slimy anymore but clear and translucent. Afterwards it is a little difficult to remove completely because of the consistency of the mask it tends to stick to the face more but once you remove it completely it leaves the skin feeling soft to the touch and very clean also leaves a cool and fresh feeling on it. I am unsure about how good it is afterwards particularly if you fail to remove it completely once you take it off. I think you have to remove it with enough water and properly in order to avoid it sticking to your face and clogging your pores maybe. I may change my review after using for a few days, but so far I cleaned my face in the morning with this and it's 8.00 p.m. already and I can still feel my skin soft and fresh so I will give this 5 stars just for this! Very good quality and good price! I really dig the softer feel on the skin as well!

title: Terrible! I wouldn't buy again. Will BURN your eyes if accidentally you get it in them!
text:
This product has all good reviews and says it's completely vegan and has no alcohol but even on the package it says that it contains perfume. Technically anything that has perfume on or "parfum" which is just french for perfume has to have alcohol in it, to this point everything is fine right but not really, supposedly when you apply this it says never to get it in your eyes, normally I close my eyes but seeing as this product had perfume in it and I assumed it had alcohol (even though the package clearly states it has " no alcohol" but that is not true since it has perfume!) my point being I sprayed it on normally and it accidentally got in my eyes just a little bit and I honestly had the worst experience with this I washed it off with water immediately after and it wasn't even that much that got in my eyes besides I had my hand on my eyes so in some way it just got in there after I washed it with water the pain did not go away. It BURNS YOUR EYES! The whole day my eye was red and irritated I assumed once I take a shower it will go away. Big mistake! I took a shower and the actual product just slid down my face and got even more in my eyes, now both eyes were screaming with pain and I had no way to stop the pain. To this point we have established that I thought it was the alcohol or the perfume in it that was burning my eyes like hell. But another surprise came at me when I Reread the ingredients on the box and it says it contains vinegar, now we all know vinegar is fine and dandy and it's vegan but HOLY HELL IT WILL KILL YOUR EYES of COURSE! To top this off it does not look like the product in the description at all doesn't look pink and cute it technically looks as something you could make at home or like actual vinegar dressing it even has the separation between the product and what I can only assume is the vinegar in it. I will attach a picture later on tonight to show the consistency. Honestly I have tried many different face sprays and never had an issue like this before even with others that I've bought by mistake containing alcohol and I really do believe it might have been the vinegar itself or both things really this product does NOT and I repeat DOES NOT easily wash off with water in fact it may stay on all day and when you shower it will burn your eyes like crazy!

*Something else I forgot to mention actually one day after using this I got a terrible rash and acne appear on my skin also I got a few blemishes as well, but what really got my attention were the acne I got a few pimples where I used this, I have never gotten a rash from any other product I've ever used online ever, and my skin is not that special honestly I thought it was worth mentioning as well because I don't have sensitive skin and this product literally made a lot of acne appear on my face.

Overall this is NOT WORTH YOUR MONEY 30 DOLLARS FOR THIS IS CRAZY! Save your money and buy something else.

I do like the sizes and it really is good for traveling. But overall, this didn't impress me and I feel just meh about it.

title: Lengthens Well
text: This mascara is a good & decent drug store mascara. I received 2 tubes of mascara. It lengthens well. I have had minimal clumping, if any at all. I tend to rub my eyes a lot during the day, so it didn't last all day, but that's the norm for me regarding mascara and eye makeup.

title: Non-Irritating!
text: This is a non-irritating, unscented face toner. It dispenses quickly out of the bottle, so I have learned to be careful about putting some on my cotton round. I haven't really noticed any difference with it as an exfoliator, but it does help dean clean my skin and remove what's left behind after washing my face.

title: A Little Over Drying
text: I like the Goldfaden MD brand, so I was eager to try this out. It's okay, but I found it to be a little over drying. I do like the foamy consistency. I don't really notice any kind of scent to it. The description says it has a citrus scent. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin which is always a plus.

title: Absorbs Well
text: This brightening serum by GOLDFADEN MD is a pretty good serum. It absorbs well. I don't notice much of a scent. It's not sticky or tacky, after drying. I haven't really noticed any brightening effects. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. While it is good, there are other Vitamin C serums that I like better.

title: Fast Absorbing
text: They say your skin is your largest organ, so you should take care of it. Especially when the weather changes like it is now. I use body lotion in both morning and evening. After using this lotion, my skin feels noticeably soft. One pump is enough for each arm. It's fast absorbing once you have it rubbed in so the whiteness disappears. Regarding the smell, I like it. To me it smells like plants. That's the best thing I can describe it with. I know scent is subjective and what I like you may not. I have been using it in conjunction with my Derek Lam 10 Crosby perfume and I have been pleased with the results. Overall, I really like this lotion.

title: Refreshing!
text: I'll start by saying that I like this face scrub by KOA Life. The eucalyptus scent is refreshing and invigorating. It has a fine grit which is pretty gentle. I was surprised by the small size. It is no bigger than a travel size product. With that being said, it doesn't take a lot of product per use, so I think it will last a little while.

title: Works Well
text: This past summer, I noticed a rash in the underboob area. I had never noticed that before. I ordered another (similar) product that I had seen advertised and that helped a lot. This product is very similar. It is unscented. I usually apply it with my fingers rather than applying it directly with the container. I really haven't noticed much difference between this one and the other one. This one doesn't dispense as nicely as the other, but that's the only thing I have noticed. The other one has 3 or 4 holes that the product squeezes out. This one seems to have more holes and it comes out a little faster. It's not a deal breaker and I can live with that. Ever since I started caring for the underboob area, I have not had any more rashes.

title: Moisturizes
text: This is a heavier serum than what I usually use. It's morel like a runny gel consistency. I really don't notice any scent, which is a bit disappointing as the description says it is cherry scented. It moisturizes well. I've been using it after toning but before my moisturizer. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't bother me.

title: Eco Friendly
text: I really like using soap tablet refills. There's so little trash produced from them. As a soap, it works as it should. It produces a light foam and cleans fine. The scent is not very noticeable. That's okay and I will keep using them, but I would prefer a stronger scent.

title: Excellent Quality
text: This Tweezerman set of nail tools is an excellent quality and what I would expect from the Tweezerman brand. All of the tools are sturdy and durable. On top of that, they look pretty nice too, at least for nail tools!

title: Light Scent
text: The weather is changing and I've noticed my skin has been much drier than usual. I apply lotion to my arms every day, but I don't usually put it on my legs. But now my legs have been super dry feeling, so I'm back to applying it all over again. This has a light scent. I like that it's plant based. I have found that when it comes to my arms, one pump is too much. It doesn't absorb as well and I have to work at getting the whiteness to dissipate. I have learned to not totally press down on the pump in order to get the right amount for my needs. It's definitely hydrating and it keeps my skin moisturized for the day.

title: Foaming Soap Tablets
text: I like using foaming soap tablets with a reusable glass dispenser. These foam tablets are the perfect size to go in my dispenser. The dissolve well. I was a little disappointed in the smell. I expected Meyer Lemon to be a citrus scent. However, what I detect is more of a floral or perfume scent. Plus the scent is pretty mild. Other than that, these are good refill tablets.

title: Glass Spray Bottles
text: Aesthetically, these spray bottles are quite nice. I love the colors of the silicone sleeves. Functionally, they are good. I haven't had any leakage or problems with performance. I did find it kind of a pain putting them together. There are 2 types of spray nozzles, 3 of each type for a total of 6. Then there are 6 hoses/tubes for them, with 2 different sizes of those. Some of the tubes/hoses were way too long. We had to arrange them to make sure that they could take in the liquid we use. The different types of nozzles gave different types of sprays. One had 2 different mists where the other had spraying & streaming. It would have been easier to have one nozzle that did both mists and streaming. Also, I found it a bit ironic. The glass bottles are a good choice for the environment, but then there are extra plastic nozzles so the amount of plastic is greater. Oh well....baby steps?

title: Unscented
text: This Olay Regnerist Hydrating Gel is very similar to the water gel products out there. It's unscented. I have only been using it at night. It feels slightly sticky at first, but that goes away pretty quickly. It absorbs much faster than the water gels I have used. It does seem to diminish fine lines, or at least it does on the back of my hand. I find it difficult to see results on my face with my poor eyesight.

title: Good Hair Clips
text: These are good hair clips. My daughter has long hair and likes wearing it up during these hot months. Her hair is neither thick or thin.  These clips hold up her hair without any struggles. The clip works as it should. It seems to be pretty durable -time will tell!

title: Nice Healthy Glow!
text: I am loving this Australian Glow Berries Intense Glow Moisturizer. It leaves such a nice healthy glow to my skin! The moisturizer comes in a glass bottle with a pump dispenser. One pump is enough to cover my face with a thin layer, but I usually do 2 pumps so I can extend it to my neck area. It  has a wonderful, fruity scent that isn't very strong. I have sensitive skin and this has not irritated me at all.

title: Soft Bristles
text: First of all, this brush is a bargain! At the time of writing this review, it's listed at $5.69. That's way less than I would expect for anything by LORAC! The brush is pretty good. There has been some shedding, but not too much. Most make up brushes that I have used have at least some shedding. This one isn't too bad. The bristles are soft. It seems to hold onto powder well for application. I would recommend this.

title: Daily Toner
text: I've been using this daily toner twice a day for over a week so far. I don't notice any smell or scent to it. The bottle is glass so I find that I have to shake it a little to get enough liquid out and onto the cotton pad because I can't squeeze it. It doesn't irritate my skin. It seems to remove the dirt left behind after cleansing. I thought with the description of "glow boost" it might leave my skin looking like it has a healthy glow, but I haven't noticed anything like that.

title: Unscented
text: I am in my mid-50's. Retinol products have been part of my skincare routine for a few years now. I use them in my evening routine. This one is unscented. It has the consistency of a runny lotion. Since I have been using Retinol for a while now, I have acquired a tolerance for it. New users should start slowly and use it only a couple of times per week. This has not annoyed my sensitive skin. It has a pump dispenser. I have found that one full pump and then a half pump (not pressed down as far) is enough to cover my face and neck area.

title: Refreshing
text: I didn't read the description very well before ordering this. I thought it was a foot cream. It may be, but the instructions say to leave it on for 15 minutes, then rinse off. The first time I used it, I applied it right before bed. I had to walk across the floor to go to the bathroom so I could rinse it off.  I guess the best way to use it would be to apply it to your feet in the bathroom, then wait in the bathroom so you can rinse it off. It does have a pleasant refreshing quality to it. But really want I want is a foot lotion or cream that will just absorb into my skin and not require any rinsing.

title: Good Set!
text: I am not a regular eyebrow tweezer, but every once in a while I will notice a crazy long eyebrow hair that won't stay in place. I recently noticed one of these crazy long eyebrow hairs, but couldn't find my tweezers. My family members tend to "borrow" them and they never get returned. This is a good set. They did the job. Now I need to put them somewhere where they won't disappear!

title: Nice Lather
text: So far I am really liking this daily cleanser. It smells good. It reminds me of IT Cosmetic's Confidence in a Cleanser the way it smells. It lathers nicely. It doesn't take a lot of cleanser to do the job.It hasn't irritated my sensitive skin. My skin feels soft after using it.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: The first time I used this vitamin C oil, I applied it after cleansing & toning which is when I normally apply my vitamin C serum. It is an oil and like oils, it's heavier than most serums, so it needs to be applied after the thinner & lighter products. Since then, I have been adding it later in my skincare routine. It has a pleasant scent. And while it is an oil, it's not super oily and greasy, thankfully. It does take a little longer than serums for it to absorb.

title: Nice Variety
text: I like using eyeshadow sticks because they're easy to use. This is a nice set of eye colors. They're mostly neutral colors. They're somewhat pigmented, but not super pigmented. They glide easily on my eyelids. I love the brush on the ends! That's a new feature of eyeshadow sticks for me. The brush allows you to blend well. The shadow lasts a decent amount of time. I applied some in the morning and when I washed my face that night, there was a little shadow left that ended up that ended up on the cloth.

title: 2 Pack
text: I've been using this micellar water after washing my face, as a toner. I have found that it comes out quickly and I tend to get too much on my cotton round. When that happens, it leaves a filmy or almost soapy substance on my face, so I have been rinsing it. On the occasions when I have had better control on the amount that is dispensed, it's not a problem. I don't notice any kind of smell or scent. It doesn't bother my sensitive skin.

title: A Favorite of Mine
text: This serum is a favorite of mine. I started using it about a year ago. I had gotten a travel set of the rose skincare products and this was in it. It smells wonderful. I'm not a big fan of rose scents, but this is mild and pleasant. The serum feels good going on. It isn't greasy or oily. It absorbs well. It also leaves a nice, healthy glow or sheen. This is the same size as the travel one I received. It is not the full size. From my experience, this size bottle will last for 2-3 weeks if used every day. I personally only use it in the morning since I'm not looking for the healthy glow at bedtime.

title: Good Sunscreen
