text: This is a good sunscreen. It's fairly thick and takes a while to rub into the skin, but once you've rubbed it in, the white is gone. There's no smell to it. It doesn't even have the usual smell that sunscreen has.

title: Night Cream
text: Retinol has been part of my bedtime skincare routine for years. I like having it in a cream form rather than a serum. I feel like that permits me to use other serums instead. It doesn't have any added fragrance, though it does have a slight scent to it, which I am assuming is just the ingredients. It is a heavier face cream which is great for bedtime. I have sensitive skin and this hasn't caused me any problems. My skin has been feeling pretty soft in the mornings.

title: Nice Palette
text: This is a nice palette for contouring & highlighting. The colors are pretty and not too out there. I'm not very experienced with contouring, but I am trying! There are some good videos out there that are targeted to my age group.

title: Collagen Peptide Serum
text: I have tried all kinds of serums in my skincare routine. This one is a Collagen Peptide one. It comes in pump dispenser. One pump is enough for my face. There's no scent. It's just slightly tacky feeling, but that disappears quickly. It's fast absorbing. When used on the backs of my hands, it immediately fills in all the lines creating a smooth surface. I would assume it does the same for my face! I just find it harder to examine that closely on my face. I haven't had any sensitivity issues with it.

title: Gorgeous Color!
text: I ordered the color Paradise. It's a gorgeous rosy nude color that is very flattering. It's a tad darker than I would normally wear, but I think I can get used to it. It's a very creamy lipstick. It is very hydrating and doesn't dry out my lips. I don't notice any taste or smell. It seems to last a few hours, but it does transfer onto things. I was wearing it for over an hour and I kissed the back of my hand. I had a very noticeable lip print. I was actually a little impressed that it was still on because a lot of lip products would have been worn off by then. Overall, I do like it.

title: Nice container
text: This face cleanser comes in a nice container. It foams up and dispenses easily. It's a small size which makes this great for travel. The cleanser itself is fine. I do like it but I don't love it. My main issue is with the smell or scent of it. I totally get that scent is a personal and subjective thing. What I like may not be the same as someone else. I was hoping that this would have a citrusy scent since it is a vitamin c cleanser. Instead, it has more of an herbal or earthy scent, which I assume is from the ingredients. It cleanses well it and doesn't strip or dry out my skin.

title: Gentle
text: I have sensitive skin, so one of the first things I look at when trying a new product is whether or not this irritates me. This serum is gentle and doesn't annoy or bother my skin at all. It is a thicker serum than most Vitamin C serums I have used. It doesn't have the usual citrusy scent either. Instead it smells a bit perfume-y. It isn't greasy or oily. I've been using it only in the morning because that's when my skin care routine calls for Vitamin C.

title: Smells Wonderful!
text: I wasn't sure what to do with a texture spray, but I love the brand, so I ordered it. After learning about it online, I decided to use it for the 2nd day hair refresh. I watched some videos online on how to use a texture spray before attempting myself. I haven't noticed a big difference in it, but I have been pleased with how my hair has been looking. Plus, this stuff smells wonderful!

title: It Deep Cleans
text: This toner deep cleans and removes dirt left behind after cleansing. It doesn't really have much of a smell. It isn't sticky. It's gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It's fine, but there are other toners out there that I like much more, so I don't think I would purchase it again.

title: Doesn't Sting or Burn My Eyes!
text: My eyes are super sensitive. A lot of brand name products cause my eyes to sting or burn. Of course I have become very careful when applying anything near my eyes, but sweating will cause product to get too close to my eyes. There's a mild and pleasant scent. The pump dispensers dispenses way too much eye cream. I've learned to not fully press down on the pump to get the right amount. It does leave a little sheen behind. It absorbs well. So far, so good!

title: Earthy Scent
text: I had never seen this brand before ordering. Now I see it advertised all the time. Evidently Reese Witherspoon uses it. This serum looks and feels more like a lotion than a serum. It has a pleasant earthy scent. It's quick absorbing. There's no stickiness left behind. I have sensitive skin and it doesn't aggravate me at all. I'm a regular user of anti-aging products and I rarely notice any results. If it is doing something, it's pretty subtle. I figure that because of all the products I've been using over the last few years, I've already been getting results and anything new just continues what's already started.

title: Hydrating!
text: I love trying new skincare products. I had never heard of The Route before ordering this, but I have since seen that it is available at Ulta so that sold me! It comes in a fancy bottle. It has a slight scent, but I think it's the ingredients and not a fragrance. It has the consistency of a lotion. My fingers don't feel sticky or greasy after applying it. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me at all.

title: Effective
text: Your hands can definitely tell your age. They can also add years to your age to those who don't know you. I remember a long time ago when I was with a new friend, trying to guess her age. I placed her at at least 10 years older than I was, but in reality, she was a few months younger than me! My guess was based on her hands! Because of that, I have always paid extra attention to my hands and use various serums and creams on them. This hand lotion doesn't have any noticeable smell to it. It immediately smooths the skin and gets rid of the fine lines. It leaves the back of the hands feeling pretty soft. It is slightly greasy so I have been trying to keep it only on the backs of my hands. I would say this is pretty effective.

title: Just Okay
text: This face moisturizer is just okay in my opinion. It's not bad, it's just that there are so many others that I like better. There's no noticeable scent. It does hydrate my skin. The absorption is okay. I probably wouldn't order it again.

title: Under Whelming
text: I found this face cleanser by Beauty Bakerie to be under whelming. The packaging is so cute. It looks like a little milk carton! The bottle is just average in looks. The actual cleanser is okay. It is gentle. It produces a little bit of lather. It seems to be unscented. There's nothing wrong with it, it just doesn't live up to the cute packaging.

title: Non-Irritating!
text: One of the most important features to me when it comes to eye creams is that it doesn't sting or burn my eyes. My eyes can be super sensitive, though I haven't been able to pinpoint the exact ingredient or ingredients that are problematic to me. This eye cream is non-irritating, so that's a great start! I don't notice any smell or scent. It has a good creamy consistency. It's not heavy. It absorbs well. I'm pretty lucky as my eyes don't usually get puffy, so I can't comment on that. It does hydrate well.

title: Good Serums
text: These are good, affordable serums. They both have a slightly thicker consistency than some serums. Neither of them are tacky or sticky feeling.  There is no scent or smell to them. I've been using them together and they seem to be working fine. I haven't noticed any difference with my skin, but I'm a regular user of serums, lotions, and potions, so that's normal for me. I have sensitive skin and neither of these products bother me.

title: Not a Fan of the Scent
text: I love Kopari products, so I was very excited to try this sunscreen. I truly expected it to have a coconut scent to it since so many of their products do. But unfortunately this one does not. I'm not sure what the smell is, but I am not a fan of it. It is different from the typical sunscreen smell. If that was it, I would be okay with it. Since this is a product for the face, there's no way I could endure it. It does absorb well and it doesn't leave any white haze.

title: Quick Absorbing
text: I use vitamin C serums as part of my morning skincare routine. The Super Bloom Brilliance Serum includes vitamin E in addition to C. The consistency is not too runny nor is it too thick. It has a light, floral scent. It is quick absorbing, but it does leave a slight tacky feeling afterwards. It is non-irritating and non-greasy. I was not familiar with the brand, but since ordering it I have seen it mentioned with other natural products. I don't love it, but I do like it.

title: Not Seeing Any Difference
text: I've been using this spider vein treatment for about 10 days so far. I don't have a lot of visible spider veins, but I do have a few areas with noticeable veins. I really haven't noticed any difference in them since I've been using it. I will say that the product description was very vague to me. It says it targets the red threads and appearance of broken capillaries, but it doesn't really say what to expect from this cream. Are they supposed to just fade in color or completely disappear? The jar is a good size. The cream absorbs well. I don't notice any smell to it. I plan to keep using it and if I do notice any changes, I will update my review.

title: Easy to Use
text: This is an easy to use sunscreen that seems to provide adequate sun protection. It has the typical Coopertone scent. It sprays a fine mist. It doesn't leave a white cast unless you spray too much. So far this summer we've had minimal sunburning! It only works if you remember to apply it in the first place!

title: Nice Mirror
text: This is a nice mirror. The base isn't too large and doesn't take up too much space on the counter. It can be powered by batteries (not included) or a USB charger. I personally haven't been using the light as the lighting in my bathroom is very good. The magnification is good.

title: Wonderful Scent!
text: This body lotion by Kopari has a wonderful scent. The blend of coconut and vanilla is very nice. The lotion has a pump dispenser. The container is partially translucent which is helpful in letting you see how much you have left. The lotion is a good consistency. It's not too thick or too thin. One pump is enough for one arm. It isn't greasy at all. It absorbs well and leaves behind soft and supple skin.

title: Cute!
text: My daughter swears by pimple patches. She has tried several different ones. She's a big fan of the brand already. She thinks these patches are super cute. They adhere well and stay in place all night long. She says that they have been helping and that she has seen improvement when she's worn them.

title: Light & Airy
text: This is a light & airy foam bath wash. It has a lovely fruity scent that I find to be uplifting.  It has a pump dispenser that works well.

title: Good Results
text: I'm always skeptical when trying a product that claims to tone your body. Well, this one does have good results. The results are temporary, but they are there nonetheless. I don't notice much or any smell to it. It absorbs well. It's nice to see smoother and firmer skin, even if it is just for a short while.

title: A Natural Looking Color
text: This blush is a natural looking color. It's a combination of multiple colors. A small brush is included in the bottom of the compact, but I prefer to use my own make up brushes.

title: Good Shape
text: I've been having professional laser hair removal at the dermatologist office over the past few months. The laser treatment is most effective on the darker hairs. So I use hair removal tools such as this to remove the lighter ones not affected by the lasers. This does come with the battery, which I appreciate. The shape of it is good. It seems to work okay, though I do have to go over some hairs multiple times to get them. In my personal experience, this type of hair removal tool works well until the blade needs to be replaced. I have never had success with them after replacing the blade. Usually, it's difficult or impossible to find the right one to replace. They are not a standard size. So unfortunately I find these to last for several months before needing to find a new one.

title: Good Lather!
text: This body wash has a pleasant herbal/woodsy scent. It reminds me of some aftershave my grandfather used to wear. It makes a good lather. My 24 year old son has been using this and likes it.

title: Leaves a Healthy Glow
text: I have seen this brand at Ulta before, so I was happy to give this a try. My mature, 50 + skin has been responding well to it. I've been using it in the morning because it leaves a healthy glow which I like. I haven't been wearing much make up these days, so I am happy with a dewy look. The scent is nice and not artificial. The absorption is pretty quick. My fingers don't feel sticky after applying it. It's a little out of my price range, but I do really like it.

title: Fruity Scent
text: I am a longtime fan of Hempz body lotion. This is a pleasant fruity scent. I wish I had the body lotion in the same scent so I can layer my products, but I don't currently have this one. So I have been using it with an unscented lotion. The scent is light and refreshing. It doesn't linger for very long. I like it!

title: Nice Set
text:
I'm in my mid 50's and I'm always looking for new products to help my age more gracefully. I was interested in this brand after learning that the Duchess of Cambridge uses Biotulin products. This is a nice set that is intended to last for a month. It's broken down into 4 - 5 day treatments. The daily treatments are in little glass vials. There's a plastic tool that you slide onto the neck of the glass vial to make it easy to break it open. I have not had any difficulties with opening the glass vials. I am only on week 3 out of the 4 weeks. So far the experience has been pleasant. The 3 that I have used so far are all a runny, liquid consistency. I would compare the consistency to water. There's enough serum in each vial to completely cover my face, neck and even my decollete. I haven't noticed any smell or scent to any of them. Directions are provided in a few different languages and are easy to follow. It recommends waiting at least 2 minutes before applying your next step in your personal skincare regiment to allow this serum to do its magic. I really haven't notice any difference in my skin since using this, but as a regular anti-aging product user, I can't help but wonder if I have maxed out the noticeable benefits and am now in maintenance mode. Just a thought. I have fairly sensitive skin and this did not bother me in any way.

I do want to point out a concern I have that's not related to the actual product. The vials are packed in foam inside a box that secures with a magnetic closure. This was not put into any additional packing material. The shipping label was put directly on the product. It would have been easy for the magnetic closure to be opened during travel which could have resulted in tampering or breakage.

title: Leaves My Hair Soft & Manageable
text: I was first introduced to Orlando Pita Play products through a beauty subscription box. It was their Atmos Shield and it did wonders to my thick, coarse hair. I have been using this hair mask with their Uncompromised Intensive Repair shampoo. This hair mask is really thick. It has a pleasant, perfume-like scent, but it's noticeably lighter than the scent that the repair shampoo has. It works well and leaves my hair soft and manageable. It's also not too expensive that I could justify purchasing it again.

title: Unscented
text: As many 50 some year old women, I am also looking for products to help me look a little younger. I was unfamiliar with this brand, but when I looked it up online, it was a brand used by the Duchess of Cambridge, so I was eager to give it a try. The tube has a long lid on the tip. For the first couple of days, I was sure I was unscrewing the lid wrong and that there was a super long applicator tip to it, but no, after looking at the product pictures, I wasn't opening it wrong. The cream is the consistency of lotion. It's unscented, but there is a slight smell which I attribute to its ingredients. It leaves the skin around my eye feeling pretty soft to the touch. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes either. I haven't noticed any miraculous change in my wrinkles, but I do believe it's hydrating the delicate skin around my eyes which is a good thing.

title: Awesome Serum!
text: This is my first time using anything by Innisfree. I have seen them at Sephora and was very excited to give this serum a try. After using it for a few weeks, I can say that I really like it. Hyaluronic Acid is part of my regular nighttime skincare routine already, so it was easy to switch to this one. At first I didn't notice any scent to it, but when I rubbed it in, but then I started to catch a light, fruity scent that smells nice. This serum isn't too thick or too runny. It absorbs quickly. There's no tackiness or stickiness left on my finger tips. This serum hydrates and plumps nicely. I will also note that I have pretty sensitive skin and this doesn't bother me in anyway.

title: Refreshing
text: I became familiar with the BLAQ brand through a beauty subscription box. It's a well loved brand in the beauty world! These eye masks are the thin, gel type ones that you stick onto your face, right below the eye area. I found them to stay in place, though the edges did seem to be loose. They are refreshing and cool to wear. I have very sensitive eyes and they didn't irritate me at all. There are 5 pairs of eye masks in this set.

title: Brings Back Memories
text: This powdered soap brings back memories. The bathrooms at my childhood schools all used powdered soap. This soap smells pretty good. I like the fruity scent a lot. It doesn't linger after you're done washing your hands. I like the idea of using containers that are more likely to be recycled. That may not be the best solution, but it's definitely an improvement over using plastic. This soap lathers well. It shakes out easily. I would love to see more scents!

title: Hair Protein Spray
text: I have never heard of a hair protein spray, but I am familiar with the Orlando Pita brand. I've been using this after shampooing but before conditioning. There's no way I can use this without conditioner. My hair is just too thick & coarse. This smells like it has apple cider vinegar in it. The shampoo from the same product line smells like flowers and perfume which is much different than this. It's a liquid consistency and sprays in a mist. I usually end up spraying some into my hands and applying it that way so I can tell how much I am using. When I spray it directly to my hair, I don't know if I have used enough. It seems to rinse fine. I'm not sure if I am noticing any difference yet. It's so hot right now that I have been wearing my hair up all the time.

title: Lathers Well
text: I have long, thick, coarse hair. I stopped coloring it during the pandemic so I could embrace my gray, but I ended up only with a handful of gray hairs. This shampoo has been gentle on my hair. It cleans well. It produces a decent lather. It is a runny consistency. The scent smells like perfume. It rinses easily. My hair has been fairly manageable since using this.

title: So Cute!
text: This clear Vera Bradley cosmetic bag is so cute! I have been using it for storing markers to use in my planner when I'm on the go. I can see everything easily. The pink floral trim is dainty. The zipper closure works very well. It's helping me to be better organized, so I love it!

title: Cute Ditty Bag
text: This is a cute ditty bag. The style is very similar to the classic ditty or toiletry bags out there. The floral pattern is darling. The inside is vinyl or some other similar material which makes it super easy to clean. The zippers are sturdy and works very well.

title: Reminds Me of a Ring Pop!
text: When I first saw this in person, it reminded me of a ring pop! That brought back lots of fond memories from my childhood. This face roller does a good job of cooling my skin. I have been using it after applying my serum so it's helping the serum to penetrate my skin. It's fun to hold and grip. I'm going to get one for my daughter!

title: Powdery Feeling
text: I have been using this targeted treatment primarily around my mouth where wrinkles are beginning to form as well as near the outer corners of my eyes. It feels powdery and leaves the skin feeling very smooth and soft. I am not able to see the blurring effect yet. I can't see things close up at all and I keep forgetting to look in the magnifying mirror. It doesn't seem to have any scent to it. It's not tacky or sticky feeling at all.

title: Leaves a Pretty Sheen Behind
text: What an interesting serum! It not only contains hyaluronic acid which I already use on a regular basis, it also leaves a pretty sheen behind. This serum has a good consistency. It's not too thick or too runny. It does have a slight scent to it which smells flowery. It seems to plump up the skin upon contact and leaves it very smooth. I haven't had any irritations from using it.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute shower cap and a lot more fun looking than the traditional style. I have a big head and lots of thick hair. It fits fine without any problems. The material is thinner than I expected. I like the colorful design.

title: Stings My Eyes
text: Not only do I have sensitive skin, but I have super sensitive eyes. I am very careful when using products and keep them as far as  I can away from my eyes. Of course, products specifically for the eyes do have to be somewhat near them. This eye cream has something in it that burns and stings my eyes. It's not noticeable at first, but over the course of the day, it would happen. I tend to rub my eyes a lot and I have dry eyes that water a lot which don't help. It's also summer time, so sweat sometimes causes products to get too close to my eyes. This eye cream has a creamy consistency. There's a slight smell which I think it's just the ingredients. I am disappointed that I am not able to use this.

title: Gentle
text: I use face scrubs twice a week as per my aesthetician. This one is fairly gentle. It has a clean, soapy smell to it. The grit is very fine and mild as far as grits go. It doesn't annoy my sensitive skin.

title: Smoothing
text: I'm in my mid fifties. My skin is pretty sensitive.  I have been using anti-aging products for several years now. I don't tend to notice results unless they're dramatic. This serum has a light consistency. It's not as runny as I expected. I put a drop on the back of my hand and it didn't immediately start dripping down my hand. There's no scent. It's slightly tacky at first, but it goes away quickly and doesn't leave my finger tips sticky at all. It has a smoothing effect on my skin. It doesn't irritate me. I like it so far.

title: Gentle Cleanser
text: This is a gentle cleanser. It smells like plain, regular soap. It has a creamy consistency. It doesn't foam up very much, but it does produce a minimal amount. It's gentle and doesn't aggravate my sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.

title: Gets The Dirt!
text: This cleansing water gets the dirt and make up left at the end of the day. It's gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It has a light scent that I found to be pleasant. It does a good job of cleansing my skin!

title: A Good Serum
text: This is a good HA serum. I'm not sure it warrants the high price tag, but I do like it. It's a clear serum that has a thicker yet runny consistency. It's also a bit sticky or tacky. There's no noticeable smell to it. It absorbs right away and immediately hydrates the skin. When applied to the back of my hand, I could see the difference in the skin right away. I don't notice it with the skin on my face but I can't easily stare at my facial skin like I can with my hands.

title: Slight Citrus Smell
text: I enjoy using a variety of serums in my skincare routine. I try not to use more than 2 per time. I always allow time in between application to allow for absorption. This one seems to be pretty thin as far as consistency goes. It has a slight citrus smell to it that is rather pleasant. It absorbs quickly. It does leave my skin or fingers feeling sticky.

title: Nourishing
text: This is a nourishing and hydrating face serum. It's a thicker consistency than some serums, but it is quick absorbing. Because it's a thicker serum, I've been layering it with an serum and putting this one on after the other one which is a runnier consistency. It isn't sticky or tacky. On the back of my hand, I saw almost immediately results as it moisturized the delicate skin. There's no scent to it.

title: Nice Cleanser
text: This Matcha Cloud Hydrating Cleanser is pretty nice. It has a clean, soapy smell. It makes a really good lather. It doesn't dry out my skin either. It comes in a recycled aluminum tube which is eco-friendly. I've been keeping it in the shower area. I had to wedge it in between other products because it won't stand up on its own.

title: As Expected
text: This Neutrogena Acne Cleanser is one that I have used on and off for years. It's as expected. It foams up nicely. It doesn't irritate my skin. I don't use it regularly, just as needed. I do like the Pride packaging!

title: Great for Travel!
text: This Urban Skin RX is great for travel! Or just to try it out. The set comes with a cleansing face soap, serum, retinol cream and sunscreen. Of the 4 items, my favorite is the sunscreen. It doesn't have the typical sunscreen smell to it. It's not greasy or oil either. The serum isn't bad. It does leave a nice healthy glow. The soap is in a small tub and has a sponge to apply it with. It does lather up well, but overall, I just thought it was okay. The retinol was my least favorite, but there really isn't anything specific that put it there. I guess I just had stronger feelings for the other products.

title: Eco Friendly
text: I like that this hand soap is eco-friendly. The set comes with 2 glass bottles. Each bottle has a silicone sleeve to protect it. There are 4 soap tablets. The directions are easy to follow. I really like the smell of the hand soap. The soap foams up well. I do think it's a bit pricey. At $39 for 2 pump bottles & 4 tablets. That's equal to 4 bottles of hand soap. I often buy mine for $2 or $3 a piece. These are better for the environment of course, but I will have to buy more tablets sooner than later.

title: Lathers Well
text: This body wash has a pleasant fruity scent. It wasn't exactly what I was expecting, but it's still good. It lathers well. It does a good job of moisturizing my skin.

title: Silky!
text: Our guest room doesn't have black out curtains, so I keep a little basket next to the bed with new sleeping masks. I tell my guests to pick one and then they can take it home with them. These are silky and soft masks. They are adjustable. They're not high end or an excellent quality, but they are more than nice enough for my purpose.

title: Excellent!
text: I use at least 2 cotton rounds a day, so I consider myself to have some experience with them. I consider these to be excellent! They are soft and have a slight texture. When I have pulled one from the stack, I get only one. I have had some that end up separating so I'm only getting half of a cotton round or they're just way too thin. I like these a lot and would definitely reorder them.

title: Non-Irritating!
text: This is a pleasant, non-irritating wash for your intimate parts. It is unscented so it's not leaving your parts all flowery smelling. It produces a little bit of lather. I have no complaints!

title: Great for Travel
text: I have recently started using these serums in full size bottles, so I am very excited to have these smaller sized ones which are great for travel! These serums are an excellent quality. They are pretty much unscented, or at least if they are scented, I can detect anything. They are very hydrating and non-irritating.

title: Nice Color
text: This nail polish is a nice color. I don't usually like brown nail polishes, but this one is okay. I only had time to put one coat on my toes and it looks pretty good. I will go back for a second coat tomorrow. I noticed that the brush was flat which made it easier to work with as far as nail polish goes.

title: Heats Nicely!
text: I have dry eyes that water all the time. One of the suggested treatments is heat. I've gotten some of those disposable one time use ones, but this is way much better. I really like it. The cable isn't very long, so you do have to position yourself near an outlet. That is the only thing I didn't like about it. I may just get a portable power brick to use with it. There are different time settings for the heat and different heat settings, too. The mask can be adjusted for head size. It felt very relaxing to have it on for a short while. I hope this helps my dry eyes!

title: Unscented
text: This serum comes in a sturdy glass bottle with a dropper. It's unscented and doesn't seem to have any kind of smell to it. I've been using this in the mornings. To be totally honest, I can't tell if it's minimizing my pores. I'm just not very observant about that. I would like to think that its doing what is promised! I haven't had any breakouts, so that's good. I have fairly sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate me. It doesn't leave my finger tips feeling sticky.

title: Nice Dispenser
text: I like the dispenser that this cream comes in. It's mess free! This has a light consistency, similar to gel water creams. The scent is really faint and barely noticeable. In fact, I can't detect when I am applying it in the morning because of all of the other products I'm using. I only smell it when it's all by itself. I've been using this only in the morning because I use a heavier cream at night. Plus morning time is when I use vitamin C products anyway. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. One pump is usually enough to cover my face.

title: It Does Help
text: I have hooded eyes. My eyes look really small and I can't enjoy a good smoky eye. I thought I would give these a try. There is a learning curve involved. I tried this for about 20 minutes and I was beginning to get the hang of it. It definitely took several mistakes before I was even slightly satisfied. Fortunately they give you tons of these stickers to play around with. You have to get it in the right spot. That was where I was having difficulties. I would put it slightly higher than it should then it would be visible to the naked eye. The goal is for it not to be seen unless you are closing or shutting your eyes entirely. I have included pictures.

title: Sturdy!
text: I am very impressed with this hair clip. I have thick hair and a lot of clips just can't hold all of my hair. This one doesn't have any difficulty with it. It keeps my hair up until I take it down. It has a sturdy feel to it and doesn't feel cheap. I would definitely recommend this hair clip!

title: Holds My Thick Hair
text: A lot of scrunchies won't hold my hair. I have a lot of thick, coarse hair, but this one holds it! I can put my hair in a bun and wrap it around it a couple of times and it stays in place all day. I love the animal print fabric. It's so cute!

title: Soothing
text: This eye cream is soothing and cooling. It's very similar to water gel skin products. It's light weight. It absorbs well. So far I have found it to be non-irritating to my sensitive eyes.

title: Moderate Grittiness
text: I enjoy using body scrubs and polishes to exfoliate my skin a couple of times each week. This scrub had an unexpected and amazing scent to it! It smells sweet and fruity! It has a moderate grittiness to it. I've had some scrubs that barely had any grittiness to it and some with that were a bit harsh. This is a good compromise. It exfoliates well and leaves my skin feeling soft.

title: Love the Pride Design!
text: My son has used this face cleanser for years. He just happened to be out when this arrived. It's exactly as he expected. It doesn't over dry his face. It foams up well. One of the pumps was broken upon arrival. I gave both of these bottles to him, so he will just take out the bad pump and replace it with the other when he has finished. We love the Pride design!

title: Moisturizes Well
text: I apply body lotion to my skin every morning and night. I really thought this one was unscented because I can't detect any kind of scent to it. I wish the vanilla/coconut scent was a little stronger because I like that scent. This is a thick cream. It absorbs well. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized.

title: Minimal Shedding
text: This is a very nice blush brush. I like the angled bristles. They bristles are very soft and I've noticed minimal shedding. The handle is comfortable to grip. It works well.

title: Leaves My skin Feeling Soft and Smooth
text: This is a light, gel moisturizer. It doesn't have any scent. It's in a purple glass jar which makes it look purple. The gel itself is a pale purple color. I have found this to be quite gentle on my sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth in the morning. The jar is an average size and should last a while because you don't need to use a lot.

title: Holds My Thick Hair
text: I have thick, coarse hair that goes just below my shoulders. In this hot summer heat, I end up putting it up a lot. This clip actually holds my thick hair easily. I put it in and it stayed in place for hours and didn't require redoing. I love that it's made from recycled materials!

title: Love the Scent!
text: Prior to writing this, I was looking at the other reviews. One reviewer hated the scent. I absolutely love it! Scent is definitely a subjective thing! I have tried another cream in the same brand and I strongly disliked it. I'm just putting it out there because what I like, someone else might not. I think it smells almost like orange blossoms - a bit floral with a hint of citrus. The jar I got is only 15 ml. It's pretty small and I don't think it will last long. The description is for a larger jar. It's a creamy consistency. It absorbs well. It doesn't leave behind any stickiness. It leaves a nice smooth surface when applied to the back of my 50+ hands. It doesn't annoy or irritate me. It does seem like a heavier cream which might be better for nighttime. I like it a lot!

title: Gentle
text: This is a gentle serum that does a good job of hydrating my skin. It absorbs in a timely matter. It has a slight sticky feeling at first, but it doesn't last long nor does it leave me desperate to wash my hands immediately afterwards. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. There's no noticeable scent to it. It only takes a little bit of serum to cover my face, so it should last a while.

title: Temporary Improvement
text: Sonage is a favorite skincare brand of mine. This contour cream is new to me. It has a strong earthy scent which I assume is from the eucalyptus. The scent is okay, but I definitely don't love it. The cream does seem to smooth out the skin. I've been using it on my upper arms, though the results are only temporary. I do have to follow it with something that smells better so I'm not smelling the eucalyptus for very long.

title: Hydrates!
text: I am a serum type of woman. I find this to be a nice, hydrating serum. It has no scent that I can tell. It is fast absorbing. It's not sticky or tacky. I like how it makes my face feel after applying it. I have been using this serum prior to applying my moisturizer.

title: Beautiful Brushes!
text: These Moda makeup brushes are beautiful! I love the pastel colors! The brushes are a very good quality. The bristles are very soft and I haven't noticed any shedding. They seem to do a good job of picking up the powder from the palettes. This is a nice set. There's a brush for just about everything!

title: Good for Sensitive Eyes!
text: My eyes are super sensitive. I'm always careful to avoid getting products into my eyes, but if I sweat or rub my eyes, some products will cause my eyes to sting or burn. This eye cream hasn't bothered my eyes at all. It's a light creamy consistency. I don't notice much or any scent. It's cooling when applied. I haven't noticed any difference in the delicate skin around my eyes, but I am a regular user of anti-aging products and have been for years, so I wouldn't expect to see anything major. I like it!

title: Can't Get Past the Scent
text: Scent matters to me. I want my skincare products to either smell amazing or have no scent at all. When I opened this, I got a strong earthy smell. It kind of reminded me of some essential oils. I didn't love it, but I didn't hate it either. The more I smelled it, the more I disliked what I was smelling. I finally decided it smelled like dirt! I'm meaning literally like dirt. Maybe that's what ginseng smells like, I don't know. But I just couldn't get past the scent. It has a nice, creamy texture. It felt cooling when applied. It's not greasy or oily. It absorbs well. But because I don't like the way it smells, I can't keep using it. I have tried another product by the brand and it smells very pleasant. Smells can be subjective and what I like may not be the same as what others like.

title: Good
text: This neck cream is nothing extraordinary, but it's good. I don't love it, but I do like it. There's little to no scent. It absorbs well. It doesn't take a lot of product to cover the targeted area. I haven't seen any changes in that area, but I have been using products like this one regularly for years. I have seen improvement over the years though, so I know these products do work!

title: Fast Absorbing
text: I have been following a multi-step anti-aging skincare routine for several years now. I don't usually notice any new results unless they're major. This serum is light and fast absorbing. It moisturizes my skin quickly. There's no scent to it. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It seems to work well with my skincare routine.

title: No Scent
text: I am in my 50's and use various serums in my skincare routine. This one has no discernible scent or smell. It's a fairly thick liquid or a runny gel consistency. It absorbs quickly leaving my skin feeling hydrated. It also leaves a slight sheen or glow. It's not greasy or oily feeling.

title: Gritty!
text: I use scrubbing products twice a week, as per my esthetician. This one has a very good level of grittiness to it. It's not harsh, but it has a lot of grit. I found that I need to rinse more than usual after using this to get all the remaining grit off of my skin. It does a good job of removing dead skin and leaving softness behind. I do feel that the scent is too strong. It reminds me of men's cologne. Scent preferences are personal and while I do like the actual scrub, the scent is the reason I will be passing this on to my sister.

title: Non-Irritating!
text: First let me start by saying the Ellen's video on the product description made me laugh! I love her sense of humor and approach toward aging! I've never been too worried about wrinkles and lines, but I do find the routine of caring for my skin to be enjoyable. And if I look a little younger than I am, I can live with that. This is a very gentle skin cream. There's no scent to it. It's non-irritating and doesn't bother my sensitive skin. It does a great job of hydrating my skin. My skin just drinks it up! It feels cool when applied. I am liking this product line.

title: Creamy
text: The first couple of times I used this, I felt "meh" about it. It was okay, but I didn't really like or love it. I tried it again about a week later and I loved it! When I felt "meh", it was mostly attributed to the scent. I love products that smell amazing. My early impression just wasn't feeling it. Then when I tried it later, I loved the scent. It's a light citrus scent that isn't overwhelming. I'm wondering if when I first tried it if it was competing with other product scents because I was getting ready and using multiple products. When I tried it again, it was at least an hour after I had gotten ready for the day and it was the only product I was applying. Whatever the reason, now I really like it! It's a creamy consistency and it can be used on your face or body. It's also fairly affordable, so that's always a good thing.

title: Great Brushes!
text: I love this set of brushes! They are all great for detailing! They are color coded. I am very pleased with the variety. The bristles are soft. They do a good job. I have not noticed any shedding.

title: Great Orange Scent!
text: This face toner has a great orange scent. It's a good size bottle. The bottle is rigid so I'm finding that I have to shake it a little bit to dispense it. Some bottles are softer and allow you to sort of squeeze it. I guess it's probably better this way because I'm not over squeezing it. It does a good job of deep cleaning my face. I haven't had any difficulties with it on my sensitive skin.

title: Soft Brown Color
text: In my old age (I'm in my 50's now), I've noticed that my eyebrows are becoming sparser. I have never been a plucker except for the random stray every once in a while. My brows are about as natural as you can get. This pencil has a good soft brown color. The pencil does not automatically sharpen, so I will need to dust off my cosmetic pencil sharpener. The other end of the pencil has a spoolie for blending or softening. I am very pleased with this.

title: Comparable with High End Mascaras
text: I ordered this after buying a tube of UD brand mascara at the local beauty cosmetic chain store. I got the UD mascara on sale, but it was horrible! I used it twice and decided to throw it away. I was in need of a new mascara and found this. This tube is 100 times better than the premium UD mascara I had. It doesn't clump at all. It noticeably lengthens my stubby eye lashes. It seems to last all day so far. This is comparable or even better than high end mascaras!

title: Love the Scent!
text: I think I first heard about Juice Beauty through FabFitFun. I may have gotten a travel size of one of their products, but I really don't remember much about it. I will definitely not forget about this serum! I love it! The lemon scent is amazing! It isn't sticky or tacky. My skin just drinks it up! I apply this before my nighttime moisturizer. It leaves my skin feeling super soft! It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin!

title: Small Jar
text: This luminzer has a nice, creamy texture. It's a pale nude blush color. It does have a slight shimmer to it. It is easy to blend. It comes in a really small jar, but fortunately a little goes a long way.

title: Light Rose Scent
text: This glow face balm has a light rose scent. The balm comes in a lip balm style tube, just a little larger. It is very emollient and feels a bit greasy when first applied, but I found that if I rub it in for a moment with my finger tips, the greasiness disappears leaving soft, hydrated skin. It doesn't have any shimmer to it, but it does leave a little sheen to your skin. I have fairly sensitive skin and this doesn't annoy or bother me at all.

title: Creamy
text: This creamy eye shadow goes on easily with a brush or finger tip. The color was pretty close to a shimmery copper. It lasted several hours. After that, I lost track. It didn't irritate my eyes.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I'm in my mid 50's now. I used to be a teacher and didn't bother wearing sunscreen at recess time. My upper chest area definitely got too much sun. I've been using products targeted to that area regularly for at least the last 5 years if not more. I have seen improvement since using these products. I like the applicator for this one. It's a roll on. It has a pleasant lemon scent to it. It is a little greasy feeling. I have learned to only apply a little bit and then I rub it in with my hands. It does absorb well but it does leave my hands greasy.

title: Soft Bristles
text: I love Laura Geller products! This Kabuki brush is wonderful. It's great for traveling because it retracts. The bristles are very soft. They do a good job of picking up powder and dispersing it. It doesn't take up a lot of room, so it fits in my regular cosmetic bag which is convenient.

title: Easy to Set Up
text: This pedicure foot rest is easy to set up. It definitely makes it easier to paint my toes than without. I still struggled a little bit, but I think that's due to my age and being overweight. But it really does improve the painting my toes experience.

title: Smells Good!
text: This sunscreen smells good! It doesn't have the typical sunscreen smell. It is a runny lotion consistency. It absorbs well and doesn't leave white marks. It's not greasy either. The tube is rather small, so it is easy to carry with you.

title: Feels Good!
text: I have another set of ice globes that are much larger. I like the smaller size of these Sonage ones. They roll around the eye area much better than the larger ones. They feel really good on my face. It's quite soothing as well as energizing. Great for mornings!

title: Amazing Scent!
text: I was first introduced to Kopari products through FabFitFun. It seems to have a cult following. The coconut melt is pretty much just coconut oil. It melts into your skin. I was quite surprised that it didn't leave my skin feeling greasy at all. It has an amazing coconut smell. The scrub has a coarse consistency so it removes dead skin well. This gift set also includes a beauty tool for application. This would be a fun gift to receive!

title: Great for Travel!
text: I was first introduced to the Trestique brand through Ipsy. I really like their eye shadow crayons. This set has eye liners and lip sticks. They are mini sized and would be great for travel. I split the set with my 20 year old daughter. The eye pencils glide well and don't tug on the delicate skin. The lip stick pencils are very smooth and go on easy. We like the assortment of colors. This is a fun way to try a lot of different colors.

title: Smells Great!
text: My daughter is a fan of I Dew Care skincare products. She was excited to try this wash off mask. It's a gel consistency and it smells great! It has a grape or fruity scent to it. It doesn't dry or harden like some masks. After the suggested time, you rinse it off with warm water. It didn't irritate my daughter's sensitive skin. She said overall, she enjoyed it as far as face masks go.

title: Lightly Scented
text: There are definitely times when I'm feeling sweaty and gross, but there's just not time for a shower. Or, maybe I have already showered once that day and don't want to take another one. These wipes are just perfect for those days! They are lightly scented. The cucumber scented one is my favorite. The wipes are a decent quality. They aren't too big, but they're large enough. They are individually wrapped so it's easy to just toss one in your bag on the go!

title: Fast Acting
text: These mattifying booster drops by Cover FX is fast acting. It gives a nice, matte appearance right after application. It makes my skin feel like it has a thin layer of powder on it. The results seem to last for hours if not longer. I'm impressed!

title: Fine Consistency
text: This face powder has a very fine consistency. It goes on evenly and not cakey. It reduces any shine and helps create a smooth appearance. It does not settle into my face lines and wrinkles. I don't notice any scent to it.

title: Subtle Color
text: I don't wear a lot of make up, so this is right up my alley. It is a liquid blush pen that is very subtle. It gives a natural pink with a slight glow. It has a pleasant scent that isn't very strong and it dissipates quickly. The color is fairly translucent. It's gives a nice, natural look.

title: Nice Gift Set
text: I was introduced to Kopari through a beauty subscription box. The Coconut Melt has a cult following! It's somewhat solid when you scoop it out, but as you rub it on your skin, it just melts into it. It always seems like it's going to leave a greasy feeling afterwards, but it doesn't. Plus it has an amazing coconut scent. The scrub is really good. It's not too harsh. I like using it on my hands to soften them while in the shower. The lip gloss is good, too. It's really a nice gift set!

title: My Hair Looks and Feels Great!
text: I first discovered Living Proof hair products through FabFitFun. People would go crazy for it! So naturally, I had to give it a try. I think I got the Full formula from FFF. This formula has the same smell as the Full does. It's a floral, almost perfume like scent. It's a little on the strong side, but I really like it, so there's no problem there. The shampoo lathers well. It's easy to rinse. As with all shampoos, the second application does better than the first. My hair has been looking and feeling great! I'm a fan!

title: Nice Face Cream
text: I am picky when it comes to my skincare products. One thing I really like, is the way it smells. I don't mind added fragrance, as long as it's pleasant. This smells a bit floral or perfume-y, but I do like it. It has a nice consistency. It absorbs well. It has a soothing, cooling effect when applied. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate. I really like it!

title: Love!
text: I've been using this conditioner and the matching shampoo for the last month or so. I use twice as much conditioner than shampoo, so I was on the verge of running out when this arrived. I was very excited to see that it's the exact formula that I have been using. It smells wonderful! It's got a light, floral scent. It's not heavy. It rinses cleanly and leaves my hair feeling soft. For the record, I am in my early 50's. I don't color my hair. My hair is thick and coarse. Currently it's a few inches below my shoulders.

title: Lathers Well
text: This body wash lathers well. It makes a nice, foamy lather. I was a little surprised by the smell. It was supposed to be oat milk & vanilla. I thought it was a pretty strong floral perfume-y scent. I didn't have any issues with skin sensitivity. I received 4 bottles.

title: Leaves My Hair Soft & Manageable
text: This Matrix conditioner works well with the shampoo in the same product line. They both have a lovely floral scent. This conditioner doesn't weigh down my hair. It leaves my hair feeling very soft and manageable. I did have to go pick up some pumps to use with these hair products. They have flip tops and they're really too big to be picking up and squeezing out. The pumps are much easier to use!

title: Smells Great!
text: This shampoo smells great! It's a floral scent that is strong enough, but not over powering. It also doesn't seem to linger around much later. It creates a nice lather. It rinses cleanly. I haven't noticed much difference yet as far as hair breakage goes, but I'm not the most observant person. I'm in my early 50's and in menopause which can cause hair loss. I do have very thick and coarse hair. I shed all the time, and that's been the case most of my life. I wash my hair every 2 to 3 days. This shampoo has left my hair feeling good.

title: Quick Absorbing
text: This serum is quick absorbing. It does leave a slight stickiness to my finger tips after applying it. I'm not crazy about the smell.I'm assuming it's just the ingredients that I smell.  It's not foul, but it reminds me of something, but I can't recall what that is. Smell is really important to me when it comes to products! When I tried this on the back of my hand, the skin immediately smoothed. The lines practically disappeared!

title: Light Citrus Scent
text: I was expecting this to be more like a serum, but it's a moisturizer. It has a light citrus scent which is quite pleasant. It absorbs well. It's easy to dispense. I have very sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate me at all.

title: Hydrating!
text: The Hydro Screen Intense Hydration Face & Body Souflle is very hydrating. My skin rapidly drinks it up! It has a pleasant, fruity scent that's not very strong. While it's not sticky or tacky feeling, it does leave behind something on my hands that is slightly sticky and it requires hand washing after application. I've been using it primarily on my body and not my face because I have face moisturizers that I really like better. Overall, it's a nice product.

title: Fine Tip
text: This brow pen has a fine tip. It makes realistic hair like strokes which blend in well with my natural brow hairs. The color is perfect! It seems to last all day, too.

title: Works Well!
text: Let me start by saying once you open it properly, it works well. If you don't open it properly, well....it makes a mess. I wasn't paying close attention to this when I opened it. I unscrewed the base from the top. I got powder all over my desk, clothes, and laptop. I cleaned things up, then found out that you just remove the cap off of it and you have the powder puff applicator. The powder doesn't really smell like much. I didn't notice any artificial scent. It's a soft powder and doesn't feel sticky. I tried it on my hair after the earlier debacle and it worked fine. I have brown hair and it didn't seem noticeable.

title: It Helps!
text: I have a nail that has some unknown damage/problem. The edge of the nail always splits in the same spot. I have to keep it trimmed very short or it snags on things. This nail product is helping to solve the problem. I've noticed that I don't have to trim it as often. It seems to be fortifying the weak spot.

title: Long Lasting!
text: This is a long lasting eye liner. It has a brush tip that marks very fine thin lines which is perfect for me to line my upper and lower lashes. My daughter showed me that you can also use the brush to make wider lines for trendy wings. That's not my thing, but it's nice that it's dual purpose.

title: Nice Neutral Colors
text: This is a cute, mini palette. I think the price and quality is on par with the Lorac brand. The colors are all nice, neutrals. The top row is matte and the bottom row is sparkly. So far I have been using primarily the matte colors. The sparkly ones are for evening or going out in my opinion.

title: Mild Grit
text: I exfoliate my face twice a week as per my esthetician. She said that more than that could cause pore congestion This cleanser exfoliant combo has a mild grit. It would probably be non-problematic to use it even more frequently. It has a perfume-y scent to it. It produces a good lather. I have very sensitive skin and eyes and neither of them have had any problems with this product. While this is the smaller tube, it's a decent size. And with using it just 2 times per week, it should still last a while.

title: Moisturizing
text: I have thick, coarse hair that's a couple of inches past my shoulders. I haven't colored my hair in a couple of years. I have very few grey hairs. I tend to switch hair products regularly. I find that products stop working well after continued use. I usually rotate through a few different brands. When this arrived, I was already using Living Proof Full Shampoo & Conditioner. Because of my thick long hair, I go through conditioner a lot faster than I do the shampoo, so I was almost in need of conditioner. I realize that this is not the same formula as my shampoo, but they seem to work well together. This conditioner has the same scent as the Full Shampoo. It's a thick consistency. It is very moisturizing. It leaves my hair soft and manageable. I am a fan!

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I have been a fan of Kopari products for a few years. They smell amazing! If you don't like coconuts, well, then you might not like the smell, but if you do.....you will love these! This comes with a scrub and a melt. They are small jars, but the melt will last forever. You really don't need much. It's hard at first, but it literally melts as it comes into contact with your skin. From personal experience, it will be softer during summer months. I love using it on my lips. The scrub has a great grit to it. It sloughs dead skin well. This one I estimate will run out before long since I use more of it each time. The price is reasonable for the brand and it allows you to try out 2 products instead of just one!

title: Not My Favorite, but It's Okay
text: This serum is not my favorite, but it's okay. I do like the dispenser.One squirt is enough to cover my face. The consistency is a runny liquid.  I like the ingredients. It has an acidic, almost sour smell to it. That's often something I notice with products containing types of acid and this one does have Caprylyl Glycol, so that could be where the smell comes from. There are ingredients such as pink grapefruit peel oil, which I would assume smells better, but I don't detect it. It doesn't feel sticky or tacky. It absorbs quickly. When used on the back of my hand, I immediately see an improvement in the texture. The product description says it takes 90 days for cell turnover to see results, so I'm not there yet. My eyes and skin are sensitive and this doesn't irritate me. If it smelled better, I would probably like it more.

title: Noticeable Difference
text: I have used this pre-shampoo twice now. The first time I wasn't that impressed with it. I thought it added a lot of extra time to my shower as you need to leave it on for at least 10 minutes. I also didn't notice any difference. A week later, I tried it again and there were noticeable differences. The first thing I noticed was when I was finished with that step and was actually shampooing my hair. I was able to use less shampoo. I have thick coarse hair that is a few inches below my shoulders. I always shampoo twice. It seems like I need a large amount, at least the size of a quarter if not larger, to work it into my hair. After using this, I was able to use closer to a dime size. I also noticed my hair was dealing with fewer tangles during the shampooing process. After conditioning my hair as usual, my hair was very manageable and easy to work with. The product has a fairly thick consistency, similar to conditioner. It has a pleasant fruity smell to it. I am not using the shampoo & conditioner from the same product line. I would recommend this.

title: Moisturizes Well
text: Your hands can be a telling sign of your age. Many years ago, I incorrectly guessed a friend's age. I placed her at least 10 years older than me because of her hands. It turned out that she was a few months younger than me! Because of that, I have always paid a little extra attention to my hands. This hand lotion moisturizes well. According to the product description, results are noticeable after 5 weeks of use. I've only been using this for about 2 weeks and I haven't been using it 2 times per day as recommended. I'm not crazy about the scent at all. Luckily it doesn't linger. Though personally, I enjoy a lovely scent that sticks around for a while. I also found it to have a hefty price tag. The tube isn't that big and if you use it twice a day, you're going to run out quickly.

title: Non-Irritating!
text: I have hooded eyes and I have been wanting to try eye lid tape. I have used these wipes a few times. They are non-irritating which is important to me. I have super sensitive eyes and these don't bother me at all. I haven't mastered using the eye lid tape yet. I'm not really sure that these are helping ( or not). I'm not ready to give up yet!

title: Dewy!
text: Let me start by saying that I like this product. With that being said, I'm not sure I got the right thing. I have heard of Cover FX, but I haven't used it before. These Booster Drops (or whatever it really is) have a slightly oily feeling when I first put it on, however, it doesn't leave my hands or face feeling oily. I have been using it by itself rather than mixing it with another product. It does make my skin look dewy and gives it a nice glow. I've been following this with my moisturizer. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I don't really notice any smell or scent to it. It says it has SPF in it. It also claims to have a mattifying effect. I'm not getting a mattifying look from using it. That sounds like the opposite of dewy and glowing. Regardless, I do like it and will continue to use it.

title: Spa Time
text: I enjoy nice smelling bath products. So it makes sense that I would like nice smelling shower products too. These shower steamers come individually wrapped. There are a variety of scents. They smell good but not exactly what I was expecting from their names. They dissolve and do not leave a mess. They're usually completely gone right around the time my shower ends. I do think these would be nice to add to favor bags or small gifts.

title: Sun Protection
text: This sunscreen by coppertone contains zinc oxide. You get three spray bottles of sunscreen. It goes on white but if you rub it in to your skin it's less noticeable. It doesn't feel oily or greasy. I was surprised that it was nearly dry going on. It offers good if not great sun protection. It does require reapplying as needed.

title: Soothing
text: I have very dry eyes most of the time. My left eye frequently waters which makes it look like I'm crying. I sometimes use eye drops, but I'm not really a fan of them. Plus I tend to misplace them. I was hoping these would solve my problem. I found them to be easy to use. They warm up quickly. It was soothing and relaxing to use them. I listened to a podcast while wearing them. I didn't really notice any difference in the dryness of my eyes after using them. I will probably keep using them because it was kind of spa-like.

title: Exfoliates
text: This exfoliating mitt does a nice job of scrubbing your body without being too harsh or abrasive. It fits my hand well. There's a little hanging loop so you can let it hang dry. I do with the loop was a little larger which would make it easier to hang, but it does function as is. The leopard print is fun.

title: Nice Toner!
text: I use a toner twice a day as part of my skincare routine. I like my toners to have a pleasant but not over powering smell. This one has a light, rose scent that's very nice. I'm not crazy about rose scents, but this one is quite good. It is easy to dispense. The bottle can be squeezed a tad to help. I've gotten some toners that come in such rigid bottles that you have to shake the toner out. My skin feels good after using it. I have really sensitive skin and this has not irritated me in any way. The price is fairly reasonable, too. This is one that I would definitely reorder.

title: Nice Scent
text: My first thought of this deodorant and its scent, was that it was a strange combination. But the more I use it, the more I like it. It's not a minty fresh breath type smell but more of a natural, mint plant smell. So far this deodorant has been keeping me dry. We just had a busy weekend moving my elderly father into an assisted living place and I didn't feel gross or sweaty at all. I wasn't doing the heavy moving, but I was on my feet all day unpacking and running errands. This set comes with 4 full size deodorant sticks. I am very pleased with them.

title: Individually Wrapped
text: These shower steamers are individually wrapped, so if you wanted to share with others, it's easy to do so. They would be a good addition to a gift bag or as favors. It does take a minute to unwrap. There's a small perforated place which isn't always easy to see. I suppose it could be my eyesight isn't that good these days. The scents are pleasant. It's good at creating a relaxing shower experience.

title: Great Quality!
text: I have been a fan of Moda brushes for a few years. I was first introduced to the brand through a subscription box. They are good brushes at an affordable price. These brushes are hot pink and black. The bristles are soft. I've noticed minimal hair loss from the brushes. The brushes are labeled with their suggested uses, which I appreciate. I hate it when I'm looking for a particular one for a specific job and then I'm not sure if I found it or not. This set also includes a silicone cleaning mat for easy color switching and cleaning. These are a great quality of brush!

title: Eco-friendly
text: My 20-year-old daughter is very eco-conscious. She tries to use reusable products whenever she can. She has reusable cotton rounds that she likes so I thought this would be good to have specifically for her nail care. These pads seem to be a little thicker than the other pads that she has to use with face toner. The quality of the products is excellent just as I would expect from the brand. The pads are to be hand washed which I totally agree with because of the potential to harm other items in the wash with any nail polish solvent or remover that may be used with these. The pink color for the set is very nice. I think this would make a great addition to a gift bag or as a stocking stuffer.

title: Reliable
text: Coppertone sunscreen is a good, reliable sun protection product. This sports version is no exception. It has a good, creamy consistency that absorbs well. It has the light smell that I associate with most sunscreens. It provides a reasonable amount of protection while you're active outside. This is a set of 2 bottles of sunscreen.

title: Easy to Apply
text: This is a great idea! It's a face powder with SPF. It's an all in one applicator/powder unit. It was messy the first time I opened it. Powder was everywhere! I think it had shifted during transportation. Once I got that cleaned up, I was able to get just the appropriate amount out as needed. It smells tropical. It's a translucent powder. I don't think this is something I would use if I was going to the beach or pool necessarily. Rather it would be used for regular, daily activity. It's an easy way to get your sunscreen on. My eyes are super sensitive to sunscreen. Even products that include SPF. If my face sweats, then I end up getting it into my eyes and stinging. That's not a problem with this. So that's a really good thing! Because of my sensitive eyes, I will often skip sunscreen on my face on the day to day basis. Problem solved!

title: Decent Lather
text: I am a fan of Moroccanoil's original scent. I don't care for this spicier, earthy scent. I can detect strong notes of clove. The original scent is lighter and more appealing to me. I understand that scent is a personal issue so what I like may not be what you like. The quality of this shower gel is good. The container is a bit rigid so as the amount of gel gets used up, it could become more difficult to get it out of the container because you can't squeeze it. It creates a decent lather. It rinses cleanly. It does leave some of the scent behind. I may give it the original scent shower gel a try.

title: Quick Absorbing
text: I am a fan of Moroccanoil. I love the original scent. I don't really like this scent. It is a spicy fragrance with strong clove notes. It's just not something I care for. I get that fragrance is a personal and subjective thing. What I like others may not. The quality of the lotion is fine. It's quick absorbing. It's lightweight. It's not greasy or oily feeling. It comes in a small pump dispenser that's easy to use.

title: Banana Scented
text: I first was introduced to the Wander Beauty brand through a beauty subscription box. I really like the products that I have tried so far. This is my first time trying any skincare products of theirs. This is a balm cleanser. It is a waxy consistency. When you rub it between your hands with a little water, it melts into a slight lather. It's not a big foamy lather, but it is a lather. It has a pleasant scent of bananas! The banana Runts candy, specifically. I like it a lot. Though it's subtle and I don't really notice it unless I bring it close to my nose. It cleans well. I haven't been wearing a lot of make up lately, but it does seem to get whatever makeup I am wearing.

title: Decent Hair Brush
text: This is a decent hair brush. My daughter needed a new barrel brush and this one has been working fine for her. It's not her favorite brush, but she likes it. The grip is comfortable to hold. It doesn't hurt her scalp. It does the job!

title: Pours Out Easily
text: I like this face toner by skin and lab. It does a good job of deep cleaning my face. The bottle is a good size. It's a rigid and firm bottle so it can't be squeezed, however the toner dispenses quite easily so that's not an issue. It smells like witch hazel or similar ingredients. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin overall I am satisfied with it.

title: Amazing Scent
text: I love Sol de Janeiro products. I was excited to see that they now have a nourishing hair oil. I often use hair oil since my hairdresser has recommended it to me. This one has the amazing scent that their other products have. I just use a drop or two of the oil and rub my hands together with it before working it in to my hair. It helps tame the frizzies and gives my hair a smooth look. It also leaves a nice shine. I am careful not to use too much so it doesn't weigh down my hair or give it an oily look or feel to it. Since it takes so little each use, it should last quite a while.

title: Creamy Consistency
text: This eye product is called a balm, so I was expecting a very emollient and more solid product. It's actually a thick, creamy consistency. The directions say to apply around the orbital bone which I took it to mean around the brow bone which didn't make sense. Then I watched the short video in the product description which cleared that up for me. It's very cooling and moisturizing. My eyes are super sensitive and a lot of products will cause stinging and burning in them. So far, I have not had any trouble with this. I haven't noticed any difference in the delicate skin around my eye, but it does say something about 8 weeks of use for results plus I am a regular user of various anti-aging products already. I don't really notice much scent or smell. If there is one, it's not bad, as I think I would notice any bad smells! The jar is a decent size and you only use a little bit of product, so it should last a while.

title: Needs to Be Reapplied Frequently
text: My daughter gets cold sores frequently. I liked the idea of having a preventive lip product for her. It has an earthy/natural smell  and taste to it. She feels neutral about that. It does absorb or disappear quickly and needs to be reapplied frequently. It does moisture fine. She does like the cooling sensation it has. It's a liquid with a roller ball applicator, so she's been leaving it in the car since she doesn't have to worry about it melting.

title: Smoothing
text: This eye serum has a gel consistency. It's clear. It does not leave any oily residue. It absorbs well and feels soothing when applied. It does not irritate my sensitive eyes. It's not sticky to the touch. I don't notice any smell or scent to it. So far so good.

title: Works with your own cleanser
text: I like to exfoliate my skin 1 to 2 times per week. This is a unique product designed to with with your own cleanser. The container has a scoop attached at the top of the lid. The crystals are soft and sand like. You scoop and add to your cleanser. Combine. Then wash your face as usual. I found it to be a gentle exfoliant. It's not harsh. I have sensitive skin and it didn't cause any irritation. You only use a little amount so it should last quite a while. I used this in the shower and I found it a little difficult to maneuver everything but it worked.

title: Large size
text: I wasn't sure if this hair towel was going to work for me. I have very thick hair that is a few inches below my shoulder. I have tried other hair towels and they aren't big enough. This one claims to be a large size and I attest that it is indeed a large hair towel. I can get it to cover all of my hair on top of my head and it doesn't fall off. I love the pink color. It seems to do a decent job of absorbing excess water. I am pleased.

title: Interesting
text: I have heard a lot about this brand of skin care, but I haven't tried very much of it. I think this is my second product though I'm not certain. This is a solid cleanser that melts in your hands as you rub them together. It lathers a little bit. I haven't really been able to depict any smell or scent. I was worried it might leave my skin feeling greasy but it doesn't. I don't wear a lot of makeup so I can't attest to its ability of removing makeup but it does leave my skin feeling clean. I have very sensitive skin and this is not caused any irritation or annoyance.

title: Decent
text: This face toner is pretty decent. It has a witch hazel scent or smell to it. It does a good job of getting dirt left behind from cleansing. It's non-irritating. Well I don't love it I do like it.

title: Nice Cleanser
text: I know that the female body is designed to pretty much clean itself and that you don't really need products for down there. However, I do tend to use vaginal washes every now and then. It makes me feel cleaner. This product has an interesting smell. It's not bad  and it's not strong. It took me a little while to figure out what it smells like. Then I had my "a-ha" moment. It smells like honey! I don't usually think of honey as having a smell, but it does. And that's what this smells like. The name should be a give away! It dispenses in a light and airy foam. It really is a nice cleanser. I only use it once or twice a week. It doesn't irritate me.

title: Earthy Scent
text: I have been using this conditioner along with the moisturizing shampoo from the same product line. It has a light, earthy scent to it which is pleasant. It does a good job of coating the wet hair and moisturizing it. It detangles well, too. I like the aluminum bottle which is good for the environment. So far it hasn't been a problem, but there was no pump dispenser included. Since the bottle is aluminum, you can't squeeze it to help the conditioner move along. I imagine as the remaining amount decreases, it will become more challenging to get it out.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: This shampoo has a pleasant scent. It is an earthy and natural smelling product. The first time I used this I had not washed my hair in 4 days. My first application barely lathered at all. I always rinse and repeat and the second time was a little better. It rinses cleanly. My hair didn't seem any different from the use I get from my usual products. I like the aluminum bottle. The pump dispenser works well. The price is comparable to other hair products that I buy.

title: I like the dispenser
text: The Uncovered Soothe and Protect Balancing Facial Toner comes in a nice dispenser. You put your cotton round on the top and press down for the toner to dispense. The toner is good at getting the dirt left behind after cleansing. It smells a lot like witch hazel. It does not irritate my sensitive skin. Overall I like this toner but there are others that I like better.

title: A decent cleanser
text: The Uncovered Soothe and Protect Refreshing Cleanser is a decent cleanser. It doesn't have much of a scent or smell. It produces a light lather. It cleans well. So far I have not had any negative reactions to it with my sensitive skin. I like it but I don't love it.

title: Thick cream
text: I am in my mid-50s now and anti-aging products are a must for me. I have tried other products by this brand, some I like better than others. This neck cream is a thick and creamy consistency. It has a medicinal scent to it which I'm not crazy about but it's not so off putting that I would not use it. It seems to absorb well. It's not sticky or tacky. I have been using neck creams for the past several years now so I am not noticing any new benefits from using this product but things have not worsened either. I like to think of it as a continuation of what has already begun.

title: Non-irritating
text: Let me start by saying that I have been using various anti-aging products for the past several years. Because of that, it is doubtful that I would see any new results. I like to think of this as a continuation of what has already begun as far as results go. This wrinkle cream is very emollient. It has a mild yet pleasant scent. It does a decent job of absorbing into my skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. It is non-irritating. I do think it's a little pricey.

title: Great Smell!
text: I ordered this shampoo/conditioner set for my daughter. She gets her hair colored regularly so I thought she would be up for trying this out. She loves the scent. She made me smell it after her hair dried. It does smell great! And it lasts. The set works well and does a good job of cleaning and conditioning. It also leaves her hair feeling soft. As a college student, this set is fairly reasonably priced which is important.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: This serum has a light, pleasant fruity scent. It has the consistency of a runny lotion. It has a good absorption. There's no stickiness left behind after applying it. I haven't seen any amazing results yet, but I am already a regular user of many anti-aging products that unless there's a major difference, it's unlikely that I will notice. Also, it doesn't annoy or irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I like this facial serum. It has a pleasant scent that is not overwhelming. The consistency of the serum is very good, neither too thick or too thin. It absorbs well. It leaves a slight glowy look after applying it which makes for a healthy glow. It is not sticky or tacky. I have fairly sensitive skin and this has not caused any problems for me.

title: Lemon Scent
text: This face scrub has a mild grit to it. It is gentle and non-irritating. I love the lemony scent it has. It is very refreshing. I have very sensitive skin and this product has not bothered me at all.

title: Large Wipes
text: These makeup remover wipes are very large. They are sufficiently moist and thick. One side has little raised dots which help exfoliate. The wipes do smell somewhat like witch hazel but it is not very strong. They do a great job of removing makeup at the end of the day. They are non-irritating.

title: Lip Kit
text: This lip kit by Mally comes with one lip liner and two lipsticks. The lip liner is a neutral color but it doesn't glide easily. The lipsticks do glide really well. They are not dry and they feel moisturizing. I like the color vintage pink as it is more of a nude / neutral color. The rich orchid is too bright for me. I don't notice any smell to these products. They seem to last comparable to other average lip products though it does leave behind a stained effect. They do not irritate me.

title: Deep Cleans
text: Toner is one of my regular skin care steps. This one is an AHA/BHA product. The smell is slightly acidic, but on par with other AHA/BHA products I have used. I don't love the smell, but it's tolerable. It does seem to deep clean my face. My skin feels soft after using it. I have sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate me at all. I don't use AHA/BHA products daily, but I will continue using this.

title: Lemony!
text: I am liking this facial moisturizer a lot. The price is pretty reasonable when you compare it to a lot of other skincare products. It has a lemony scent which I just love! It absorbs well.
