I've noticed a slight sheen left afterwards which gives a nice healthy glow. I have really sensitive skin and this hasn't irritated me at all. I would consider buying it again.

title: Nice Quality
text: This beauty tool is a must have item. It's slightly cool to the touch. It is very smooth and when you glide it across your skin, it's very relaxing. I've been using this after applying serum to help with the absorption. I love the pink color. I haven't really noticed any major improvements since using this, but it sure does feel good!

title: Creamy
text: This creamy blush set has 2 different colors. The colors are both great! I've been applying them with my finger tips so I can control the intensity of color. It seems to last a decent amount of time, but by the end of the day there's barely any evidence of it left. I have sensitive skin and I found this to be non-irritating.

title: Yummy Scent
text: This powder has a very yummy scent. It has a glowing effect to it. The first time I applied it, I must have put way too much on over my nose area. It had too much of a reflective shine. I've been careful to apply it carefully and lightly since then. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I love lightly scented products, but I haven't really noticed cosmetics being scented. This smells very tropical. I've had to play around with this powder and the best way to apply it. The first time I used a brush of mine, but it picked up too much of the powder and it looked a bit cakey. I'm also trying to use a lighter hand when applying it. When I get the right amount on, it seems to last most of the day.

title: Amazing Scent!
text: I ordered this shampoo/conditioner combo for my college aged son. He has thick, curly hair. He has noticed a big difference (in a good way) when he uses hair products specifically for his hair type. This set has an amazing scent. He really likes the smell of it. It does linger for a little while. The products have aren't runny or thin. They seem to work well together. He says his hair feels moisturized after using it. He doesn't shampoo every day as per his hair dresser, but he does condition daily. He will probably run out of conditioner fairly soon. He says it's a good set of hair products, but not the best. He also said he would probably buy it again.

title: Nice
text: This facial toner comes in a spray bottle. I think I prefer the bottles that squirt or pour directly onto the cotton round, but this is fine. It takes several spritzes to get enough liquid onto the cotton round for usage. It has a light scent which I found to be pleasant. It doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. Overall, it's a nice toner.

title: Pretty Palette
text: This is a pretty palette. I appreciate that it comes in a cardboard case rather than plastic. The colors are beautiful. There are a couple of bronzers, a couple of blushes, a highlighter, and a pressed powder. They have a light tropical scent, which I wasn't expecting. There's no brush included, which is fine by me. I always prefer to use my own make up brushes anyway.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: This body wash/scrub combo smells amazing! It has a thick, creamy consistency. The scrub is pretty gentle and not very abrasive. It makes a decent lather. The bottles are large and should last a while.

title: 3 Step Hair Care
text: My 24 year old son has a head full of thick, curly hair. We have discovered that hair products designed for curly hair really do work better! I immediately noticed the difference after just one day of his using this. His curls were bouncy and slightly defined. He has never really used leave-in conditioners before, but he has been using this one in the final step. He likes the smell of it. Because he has thick hair, he does tend to go through more conditioner than shampoo. Plus his hair dresser has told him that he doesn't need to shampoo daily, but he does need to condition it or else his hair tends to get matted. We will probably have to get another bottle of conditioner soon.

title: Nice Scent
text: The men in my household prefer using body wash over soap. They also don't care for the girly scents that I like. These Irish Springs body washes have a clean, fresh scent that they like. It lathers well and leaves them feeling clean. This is a set of 4 bottles. A lid on one of the bottles popped open during shipping, so when it arrived, there was a little leakage. A small piece of tape on the top of each bottle would have probably prevented that.

title: Unscented
text: This serum has a lotion like consistency. It's unscented. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It's hydrating and leaves my skin feeling soft.

title: Nice Color
text: This blush by Physician's Formula is a nice color. I really like the flowery design it has. It goes on nicely with a brush. Speaking of brush, it does include a small brush, but I prefer to use my larger brushes. It has a light, vanilla-y smell to it which I found surprising.

title: Satisfied
text: When it was recommend to upgrade our masks, I tried an N95 one and found it to be too tight on my face. Plus, I am not crazy about the pointed beak style. So I've been wearing KN94 ones. These are decent ones. They are comparable to others that I have gotten. I like the variety of colors. I don't go as far as to coordinate my masks to my outfits every day, but I do like options. And there have been a few times when my masks matched my outfit. I do try to avoid major color clashing! These masks are comfortable and fit well. They don't gap on the sides. I have not had any problems with the ear elastics coming off like with some basic medical mask ones. I like the shape of these a lot better than the 95's. I am satisfied.

title: Rich & Creamy!
text: I didn't know that Sun Bum had a skincare line! How fun! And it's priced reasonably, too! This cleanser has a rich and creamy consistency. It lathers up really well. It has an amazing banana scent to it, just like their sunscreen. I personally love products that are scented as long as it's not a perfume type scent. So if you're someone who doesn't like scented products, this may not be for you. The banana scent takes me back many summers ago. It does a good job cleansing and leaves my face feeling soft.

title: Great Lather
text: My 24 year old son prefers using body wash over a bar of soap. He likes the scent of this one. He described it as smelling fresh and clean and not too strong. It lathers well. The bottle is generously sized and should last a while.

title: Nice Mini Perfume Atomizer
text: This is a nice mini perfume atomizer. I really like it. I do have a gripe about it though. There were no instructions included. I couldn't figure out how to fill it. I even had my husband look at it to see if he could help me. Finally, I went back to the product description here and saw the video. It was very helpful and I was able to get my atomizer filled easily. However, I shouldn't have to work that hard to figure out how to use something that I ordered! There could have been a "watch the video at blablablah" on the box or a piece of paper with pictured step by step.

title: Nice Serum
text: Vitamin C serum is part of my regular morning skincare routine. This one doesn't have much smell to it. Usually vitamin C serums that I use have a citrus smell to them. I don't smell that with this one. Another observation is that it doesn't cause any stinging on cuts. I only notice that with Vitamin C serums, but this one didn't bother the little cut on my chin. This serum has a nice pump type dropper. It absorbs well. It's not sticky or tacky. Overall, it's a good vitamin C serum.

title: Creamy
text: I am obsessed with shower frosting, so I wanted to see if this was similar to it. This has a thick, creamy but firm consistency. It scoops out easily. And once it's out of the jar, you realize it's not really that firm at all. It lathers nicely. I was a little disappointed with the scent. I had grand expectations because I love the scent of grapefruit. It's not strong at all and I could barely smell anything at all. At first I was worried since the loss of smell could be bad, so I opened another shower product that I knew had a strong smell, and I could smell it as usual. I know the subject of smell related to beauty products is personal. There are some scents that I don't care for at all, but I do love a good, strong fruity scent, which this does not have.

title: Nice Scent!
text: This face cleanser has a very nice scent. I really like how it smells. The consistency of the cleanser is creamy. It lathers a little bit. I like the way it feels on my face. I've used it for several days now and on one occasion, it did get in my eyes and caused some stinging. I have really sensitive eyes and some products bother me more than others. Because of this, I am really careful about keeping products away from my eyes, but I guess I wasn't too careful that day. The stinging wasn't too bad. It wasn't bad enough that I would not use it any more.  I really like this cleanser. I

title: Gel Cleanser
text: This is a gel face cleanser. It doesn't foam or lather much. The smell is slightly citrus-y, but also a tad medicinal. It actually reminds me of the dishwasher detergent that I use, and I don't mean that in a bad way. The detergent smells really good! This cleanser doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I don't feel that it moisturizes my skin, but it doesn't seem to strip it either.

title: A Bit Greasy
text: This serum smells nice. It has a light fruity scent to it. I found the consistency to be oilier than I expected and it left me feeling greasy. The greasiness doesn't last too long, but it did linger on my finger tips for a while. It really reminds me more of a facial oil than than a serum, but then again, it's called a hydration enhancer, not a serum.

title: Individually Wrapped
text: These shower steamers are individually wrapped which makes them great for using as favors or gift bags. They have a perforated seam for easy opening. There's a variety of scents. They smell nice though they aren't very strong. One steamer lasts for the duration of a typical shower.

title: Has a Fine Grit
text: I love using body scrubs. This one has a very fine grit to it. The gritty particles are small, but still slough away dead skin. It has the typical acidic smell that many AHA products have. It's not a bad smell, but it's not a great one either. I can't detect any additional scent to it. It rinses easily. I like it!

title: Gentle
text: Milk is a good name for this moisturizer. It's basically a runny lotion consistency. It's very gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. There's no noticeable scent. My dry winter skin just drinks this up! However, this same dry winter skin needs more moisture than this product gives me. I usually follow with another moisturizer.

title: Fun Set!
text: I first discovered the Rose' products by Physician's Formula last August. I was getting ready to go out of town and bought a set of travel products. I fell in love with the Rose' All Day serum! It adds a nice healthy glow. This set has some of the products that I got to try in the travel set. The cleanser is good. It makes a minimal amount of lather, but it cleans well. The moisturizer with SPF is a great product. It doesn't have the strong sunscreen smell that many products have. I can tell it's got sunscreen in it, but it's pretty light. The Set & Glow is new to me. It's a compact with setting powder and a dewy balm. I am enjoying it! It's a great value for this set of items.

title: Smells Good!
text: I am in my mid 50's now and follow a multi step anti-aging skin care routine. This brand was unfamiliar to me. I do enjoy luxury skin care products, so I was excited to give it a try. The jar is pretty small. The cream has a good thickness to it. It rapidly absorbs into the skin and leaves the skin feeling smooth and soft. It has a light, pleasant scent. I can't tell if it's fragrance or just the ingredients. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me. I do like it a lot, but it's out of my price range.

title: Melts Nicely
text: The Honest Beauty Calm & Renew Melting Eye Balm melts nicely. It doesn't have much of a smell to it. It doesn't irritate my eyes which is good. Some eye products cause my eyes to sting. It does leave my fingers feeling a little greasy. It does hydrate the skin area around my eyes.

title: Great for Travel!
text: I am always looking for good travel sized skin care products. This set is the right size! There are 4 pieces in the set. They are labeled well as to when to use which product, both with AM/PM and which order to use. The cleanser has a nice minty smell. I found it painfully difficult to get any product out. It has a pump dispenser and it wasn't dispensing well at all. I finally took the pump off and tried to get it out and still had difficulties. Maybe it's a thicker consistency and should be in a squeeze tube instead. I did like the actual product once I was able to get some. It took a while to get out just a dime sized portion. It does lather nicely. It was gentle on my skin and rinsed cleanly. I do wish it was a larger size because I don't think it would last a whole week. The serums were good. I think serums are one of the harder items to find in travel size. They were labeled as step 3. For the record, there were no step 2's. I use a toner for my step 2, but there was none  included. The final step 4 item is a moisturizer. I liked the smell of it. It seemed fine. It's not my favorite moisturizer, but it is good. The items all come in a cute little bag.

title: Deep Cleans
text: I use toner after cleansing. This one comes in a good sized bottle. It has a slight medicinal scent which I found to be tolerable. It's hardly noticeable. It deep cleans well, but it doesn't seem to do much for the blackheads as mentioned in the product description. I have fairly sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me.

title: Vitamin C Serum
text: I added Vitamin C serum to my morning skincare routine a couple of years ago. This serum by Youth to the People is a good one, though not my favorite. My favorite is by Sonage. I would go as far to say that this is a close second. There is a scent to this. It's not too strong. The Sonage serum has a really pleasant orange scent which is very uplifting. This barely smells like citrus. It's not a bad smell or anything like that, it's just barely anything.If you prefer unscented products, you might like this one more.  I had a small cut on my face and this serum caused some stinging when it came in contact with it. Unfortunately, that's on par with every other Vitamin C serum that I have tried. I'm assuming it's the acid. This serum absorbs well. It doesn't feel sticky or tacky. I like this and would be interested in trying some of their other products.

title: Fast Absorbing
text: This serum by Honest Beauty is a fast absorbing serum. It doesn't leave any greasiness behind. It's very hydrating. In fact, my skin feels hydrated for hours after applying it. It doesn't bother my sensitive skin. It doesn't really smell like anything. I like it!

title: Great for Bringing the Spa to Your Shower!
text: Shower steamers are great for bringing the spa to your shower. These are a good size. There 3 different scents and 4 of each variety. If you don't put them in direct stream of the water, they will last longer. The scents are pleasant, but not very strong. They don't seem to leave behind any residue. The steamers are individually wrapped and have perforations to help you open them which I didn't discover until my second one!

title: Love Love Love!
text: I enjoy trying different skin care products. There are a lot of them out there to try! Most of them are fine. A few are duds. And every once in a while I find one that I love, love, love. This is one of those that I love! Retinol is something that I use regularly at nighttime, so I have been using this in the evening, though it says you can use it morning as well. It's a true cream consistency. It isn't greasy or sticky. It absorbs pretty quickly and leaves the skin feeling soft. It has a light lemony scent that is amazing. This cream doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. I do think that it's a bit pricey. Fortunately, it doesn't take much to cover my face.

title: Moisturizing
text: I have recently started using some Philosophy skin care products and so far I have really liked the ones I've tried. This eye cream is good. It is a light weight, lotion consistency. It absorbs well and isn't greasy. I have sensitive eyes and it hasn't bothered me. It's moisturizing. It doesn't have much of a smell to it. It comes in a pump dispenser and it doesn't take very much to cover the area around my eyes.

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: I am in my fifties. In addition to mature skin, my skin is also sensitive and is easily irritated. This toner by CeraVe doesn't irritate or annoy me in any way. There's no scent to it. It doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or too dry. It's a good, basic toner.

title: Leaves My skin Feeling Soft and Smooth
text: This Philosophy Skin Reset serum can be used both in the AM and PM. It's a thicker serum consistency and similar to a runny lotion. I found that it was difficult to dispense very much of it from the dropper at a time. I guess that's not terrible because then it limits how much you're using and will help it to last longer. There's no fragrance to it, but it has a very slight, soapy smell to it. It absorbs quickly. I found that it had a slight tingly effect after applying it. My skin is pretty sensitive and it didn't irritate me. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth.

title: Great Cleanser!
text: I am picky about my face cleansers. There are so many out there that just don't do it for me. This one is great! The only thing I would improve upon would be for it to lather more. It doesn't produce much foam or lather. It smells awesome! It's kind of fruity, but very light. It rinses well. It feels luxurious on my skin. It doesn't irritate or over dry my skin. I really like it!

title: Gentle
text: I love trying new skincare products. This Farmacy set comes with 3 products in their Honey Harvest line. There's a daytime serum, night time serum and a cream moisturizer. They all have the pleasant honey scent. The products are gentle and don't irritate my sensitive skin. I was a little confused as to when to apply what at first, but I've since figured it out. The cream is a small container whereas the others seem like they could be full size. This would make a great gift for someone.

title: Wide Plates Speed Up the Process
text: My daughter's hair straightener recently failed. I ordered this as a replacement for her. The wide plates speed up the process of straightening her hair which is greatly appreciated. It heats up quickly. It works well, so far. It's priced fairly.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I am familiar with the Farmacy brand, but I haven't used many of their products before. I have tried a travel set of one of their different product lines, but this is my first time trying their Honey products. This lotion is meant for your body and only to be used 2-3 times per week. It has a pleasant scent and really smells like honey. I don't really think of honey has being a fragrant item, but it does have a smell that is recognizable. The lotion absorbs well. It's not sticky or greasy. I haven't noticed any difference in the texture of my skin, but in all honesty, I'm not always very observant with things like that unless it's super obvious. It does moisturize well.

title: Lengthens Well
text: This mascara lengthens my lashes well. It does clump a little, but nothing bad. Plus, the clumps are easy to remove by just going over them again with the applicator brush and no special tools needed. It has a decent staying power and lasts for several hours. I haven't noticed any smudging. I would say it's a good, basic mascara.

title: Love Love Love!
text: I have tried a lot of skin creams and moisturizers. I have gotten pretty picky about them. There are a lot that I like, but there are very few that I love. I absolutely love, love, love this one! I have tried Philosophy hand creams and the body wash/shampoo combo before, but never anything for the face. This is a thick lotion consistency. It has a very light, fruity scent. My skin just drinks it up! It feels good to rub it in to my skin but it also leaves my skin feeling good. It doesn't take a lot of product to cover my face. It absorbs well. For a night time moisturizer, it's pretty light which I like. It is a little pricey, but not too much like some brands. I am definitely going to reorder this!

title: Nice Neutral Color
text: This lip gloss is nice neutral color. It's not sticky at all. It's not particularly long lasting, but that's pretty average for most lip glosses, especially the ones that aren't sticky! I don't really notice any smell or taste to it. I like it!

title: Refreshes!
text: This Mario Badescu eye serum refreshes tired eyes! It has a slight shimmer to it which reflects light and makes your eyes brighten. I have super sensitive eyes and this has not bothered me at all. It's a thin, lotion type consistency. It absorbs well. I really like it!

title: Smells Good!
text: This youth serum is a nice serum. The consistency isn't too loose or runny, but it's definitely a serum not a cream or lotion consistency. It smells good. It leaves a very slight tingly feeling after applying it. I haven't had any irritation from using it. It does fill in lines and creates a smooth surface.

title: Great Color!
text: I am in my mid 50's. Just recently, I've noticed that my eye brows are not as full as they used to be. I have never had them waxed or treated other than a random self plucking. I pluck so little, it's probably less than once a year. This pencil is a great color. I love that I don't have to try to match it to my hair color. For the record, my hair is medium/dark brown with a couple of grey hairs. This pencil is triangle shaped. It's easy to use. I love that it has a spoolie on the other end. That helps you to soften the pencil marks and blend them with your brow hairs. I really like this!

title: Like the Face Cream!
text: I like the derma Geek face cream more than I do the serum. The serum was over drying in my opinion. I like my face to feel soft and supple after applying my skincare. This serum made me want to go slather on more moisturizer after. Maybe it was a tightening effect or something. I do have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate me in any way. So I like the face cream, but feeling meh about the serum.

title: Gentle
text: This gel cleanser is gentle and does not annoy my sensitive skin, which is a plus. It's a clear, runny gel type consistency. It produces a little bit of foam. It has a light smell to it which I can't identify. I feel pretty neutral about the scent. It rinses easily and doesn't leave anything behind. I like this, but there are a lot of face cleansers that I like more.

title: A Unique Primer
text: This is a very unique face primer. It has a creamy lotion type consistency where as most primers have a slightly thicker, silky consistency. As far as I can tell, this doesn't contain silicone or other waxy substances that attribute to that typical silky feel. This goes on like a face lotion and leaves behind a soft surface. It has a light pleasant scent. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It can be used day and night. The tube isn't very big and is much smaller than other primers that I use. It dispenses easily. I have found that it doesn't take a lot of it to cover my face.

title: Not Sure About This
text: I'm not sure about this tight peeling mousse by Dermalogy. I follow the directions. The foam dissipates very quickly and absorbs into the skin. It makes my skin feel dry, which I suppose could be tightness instead. I can't say that I am noticing any improvement with my skin. I do have sensitive skin and have not had any problems using it.There's a very light scent that's barely noticeable. I've used it a few times over the course of a week. I will continue a few more times, but I'm not inclined to add something to my regular skincare routine if I'm not seeing or feeling any benefits.

title: Super Cute!
text: My daughter is a college student. She lives in an apartment and keeps her make up in a bag under the sink because there's not a lot of counter space. She had recently outgrown her one bag and asked me to find another one for her. I ordered this set for her and she couldn't be happier. She loves the cow print! There are 3 bags of varying sizes. She is able to actually organize her make up much better and doesn't have to keep everything in the one bag. The bags are sturdy and they seem to be durable. What a fun set!

title: Sharp Blades
text: I usually use the Venus razor and blades, so I was happy to try a compatible one. This handle is light weight and easy to grip. My Venus one is a metal one and a bit heavier. It also feels sturdier than this one. I also get the Venus blades with the comfortglide feature which I really like. These blades are more similar to the more basic ones. I did swap blades with them. I could get the original Venus handle to fit onto the Amazon Basic blade, but I could not get the Amazon Basic blade on to the Venus handle. For a store brand razor, I found this to be satisfying.

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: This resurfacing serum doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It's a thicker serum. It absorbs well. I immediately noticed how soft it left my skin feeling. It doesn't feel oily or sticky. I haven't really noticed any improvements with my skin yet. It hasn't been very long and I use a bunch of different anti-aging products daily which makes it difficult to notice any single product doing magical things. I'm in my mid-50's and overall my skin looks pretty good.

title: Moisturizes
text: I have been using this conditioner with the coordinating shampoo. It has a mild scent that reminds me of baby powder and cinnamon. It's a medium consistency. It rinses well. I haven't noticed any difference yet in the amount of shedding or breakage. It does leave my hair soft and manageable.

title: Amazing Scent!
text: When it comes to hand soap, I'm all about the scent. If it smells good, then I am a fan! This soap has an amazing lemon scent. The mint is not very noticeable, which is fine with me. I'm a lemon girl! The soap lathers well and does a fine job of cleaning. I was a little unsure about the fiber shell container, but so far it's holding up. I was worried it would get wet easily and fall apart. I do appreciate the company's efforts to be Eco Friendly.

title: Good Shampoo
text: I have thick, coarse hair just slightly below my shoulders. I haven't colored it in over 2 years. I have minimal grey - just a few strands. I do experience a lot of shedding and hair loss, though you can't really tell because I still have so much of it. I don't wash my hair every day - closer to every other day. This shampoo has been pretty good so far. It has a light scent that reminds me of baby powder and cinnamon (or some other spice). It's not very strong smelling and it doesn't seem to last. It lathers easily and well. It is easy enough to rinse it. I'm not noticing any difference in my hair shedding, but it does leave my hair feeling manageable.

title: Hydrating!
text: This is a very hydrating serum. It's unscented. The consistency is a little thick, definitely not runny. It doesn't seem to be anything special at first glance, but I have found myself spending a little more time with it than other serums when it comes to massaging it into my skin. I think it's because it immediately leaves behind super soft and supple skin. I follow up with my moisturizer. I have only been using this serum at night. But when I wake up in the morning, my skin still feels really soft. Hyaluronic Acid is something I have been using regularly for a few years now as part of my bedtime skincare routine. This one is my new favorite HA serum!

title: Gentle
text: I have fairly sensitive skin and this cleanser was gentle enough for me. I didn't have any irritations from using it. It's a clear and thick gel type consistency. It doesn't really foam or lather much. It rinses well. It does have an acidic smell to it that I have noticed in other products containing Gylcolic Acid.

title: Gritty!
text: I use face scrubs daily. I rotate between 2 different types. This scrub is a gritty one. I use ones that are gritty like this, twice a week. On the other days, I use a milder one with minimal grittiness. This scrub has a mild, minty scent to it. It may not be mint, but that's the closest thing that comes to mind when I smell it. It does smell natural rather than artificial. It's a very affordable face scrub and I would definitely consider repurchasing.

title: Leaves My Skin Soft
text: This overnight transformation complex is a light blue, creamy lotion. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft. It has a light fruity scent. I have really sensitive skin and it does make my skin tingle a little bit, but it doesn't hurt. It's pretty moisturizing and does a good job making my skin look younger.

title: Not a Fan
text: I love trying new skincare products. Unfortunately I am not a fan of this one. I have pretty sensitive skin and this was just too harsh for me. It has an acidic smell which I didn't care for. The caution message says that sensitive skin may notice some tingling. I found it to be more like a mild burning feeling. I had a small cut on my chin area and it caused some painful stinging for a moment. My sister doesn't have sensitive skin, so I will probably pass it on to her.

title: Smells Good!
text: I use a face toner every morning and night. This one smells really good! The scent is light and not over whelming. It doesn't over dry my skin and does a good job of removing any dirt or make up left behind after cleansing. I would order it again.

title: Wow!
text: I am very impressed with this mascara. When it first arrived, I really thought it was a liquid eyeliner rather than a mascara because of the way it looks. The wand is very thin and narrow, but it does a good job of applying the mascara to the lashes. I like the brown color a lot. The mascara doesn't clump very much and any clumping I did experience was easy to break with another wave of the wand. It lasts all day without needing to be reapplied.

title: Works Well
text: I ordered this facial cleanser for my 20 year old daughter who has oily to combination skin. It has been gentle and it doesn't irritate her skin. It makes a decent lather. She really likes the scent of it. It's light and not too strong. She says it leaves her face feeling soft and clean without over drying it.

title: Pamper Time!
text: This set of beauty products is great for a little pamper time. There are products for brows, lashes, and lips. I found them to be gentle and non-irritating. I haven't noticed any results since using these products, but I haven't been using them for very long. This would make a nice gift for someone.

title: Good Mascara
text: I was first introduced to the Wander Beauty brand through a beauty subscription box. I really like this mascara. It didn't clump very much. It definitely lengthened my stumpy lashes. It lasted for most of the day. It doesn't irritate my eyes.

title: Silky!
text: This all in one product is great for those make-up free days. It gives my skin an even and smooth look. It's very natural looking. It has a silky feeling to it and makes my skin feel soft. I have pretty sensitive skin and this doesn't bother me at all. It hardly takes any product to cover my face.

title: Seems to Be Helping
text: I have been using this product for about 2 weeks. However, I have been inconsistent with using it. I will remember one morning, then forget to apply it in the evening. I feel that it's a bit messy to apply. I pump some product on my thumbnail, then I use my opposite pointer finger to put it on the rest of the nails on that hand. Then I switch. I wish I didn't have to use my fingers to apply it. As soon as I am finished, I want to wash my hands to get it off my fingers, but the directions say to wait a minute to allow the product to soak in. If it had a brush applicator I could apply it without getting it on my fingers. The product isn't sticky or tacky. I am not a fan of the smell. It smells kind of medicinal. It seems to be helping. The overall condition of my nails is looking better.

title: Nice Lather
text: This face cleanser has a nice lather. It's very gentle and doesn't cause any irritation to my sensitive skin. The scent is okay, but I was expecting something amazing after reading some of the other reviews as well as an expectation from the presence of melon. It's not bad or off putting, it just wasn't what I was had expected and hoped for. The bottle seems to be glass which is something that does concern me since my shower is tile. I do like it and it does seem to clean my skin well.

title: Non-Irritating!
text: I'm in my early 50's so eye cream is a regular part of my skincare routine. I found this to be non-irritating. My eyes are super sensitive, though I haven't been able to pinpoint what ingredient(s) cause their irritation. This one doesn't cause any problems, so that's a good sign. The cream has a glowing effect which helps make the eyes look brighter. The jar is pretty large so there's a lot of eye cream in there. I don't notice much scent. It isn't greasy. It absorbs well.

title: Glides on Smoothly
text: This eye pencil glides on smoothly. It doesn't tug on the delicate skin around the eyes. It lasts for several hours which is acceptable to me. I really like the color!

title: Non-Irritating
text: I'm in my early 50's. My eyelashes used to be much longer, but now they're short and slightly sparse. I've been using this set for a little over a week now. The lash enhancing serum is easy to use. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes. I haven't noticed any major difference, but I know that can take time. It does seem that my lashes look less sparse. I really like the mascara. It does a great job of lengthening my lashes. It doesn't clump either. And if it did, there's the lash separator. It's a wonderful tool and works very well. This is a great set and I am very pleased with it.

title: Convenient
text: This loose powder brush is an all in one piece. It's your brush and the loose powder in a convenient container. It's easy to use. The powder is a good quality and leaves my face looking natural. I am a fan!

title: Fun Face Masks
text: I like wearing fun face masks. These disposable ones have fun, colorful prints. They are soft and not scratchy. The ear straps are comfortable. They have the much needed nose wire pieces. Overall, they are good decent masks.

title: Absorbs Well
text: There are a couple of Elizabeth Mott products that I really love, so I was excited to try this eye cream. It has a pump style dispenser. I find that 1 pump is almost too much, but it's hard to get less than a pump of product dispensed. I don't notice any scent or smell. It absorbs well. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes which is really important to me. I haven't noticed any difference in the skin around my eyes since using this, but I do regularly use eye creams and serums, so they are being treated already, so unless it's something major, it's not likely that I would notice any changes.

title: Nice for Travel
text: I am always on the lookout for travel size skincare items. This is perfect for that! I have tried everything and there are some hits and misses as one might expect. I love the Purifying Cleansing Gel. It is my favorite of the set. It smells light and pleasant. It foams up really well and leaves my skin feeling clean and soft. I will probably be ordering this in a larger size. The Apple Cider Vinegar toner is my least favorite. It made my skin sting. I guess I need something a bit gentler. The serum is good. I liked it. The Cactus Water moisturizer is a gel consistency, but it was refreshing and moisturizing. The black mask was a little messy. I've started primarily using sheet masks because they're clean and neat. The cleansing oil was okay. I don't love it but I don't hate it either. It's fun to try new products!

title: Meh
text: I have been a fan of Hanalei lip products for a few years now. Their lip scrub is amazing!! This lip treatment just leaves me feeling "meh". It's very thick and difficult to dispense. The pumpkin spice scent is minimal. It doesn't feel any different than just applying Vaseline on my lips. It's definitely not the worst product out there, but to me, it's just okay.

title: Cute Hair Ties
text: These are cute hair ties. I really like the assortment of colors. I have long & thick hair and I can get these to go around my ponytail 2 times, but they won't go around a bun. I have started wearing my hair in buns when I sleep so my hair isn't getting in the way.

title: Smells Like a Dreamsicle!
text: This hand cream smells like a dreamsicle! Yum! The orange vanilla scent isn't too powerful nor does it linger long. The cream is very thick and a little goes a long way. It needs to be rubbed in well to help with absorption. I'm not crazy about the tube. I'm guessing it's aluminum. It's difficult to squeeze the cream out compared to plastic tubes. I understand that it's better for the environment, so I won't complain any more.

title: Love!
text: I discovered Moroccanoil hair products a few years ago and fell in love with their scent. This body souffle has the same scent and smells amazing. I describe it as a powdery Argan oil scent. It's wonderful! This product is thick and creamy. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling soft and pampered. The scent does linger around for a while and I enjoy catching whiffs of it throughout the day.

title: Moisturizing
text: I discovered Sol de Janeiro a couple of years ago. Their Bum Bum Cream is a favorite of mine. I love the scent. I have purchased their hand cream before, but there have been some changes. First of all, the scent is as expected if you're familiar with the brand and other products. The consistency is creamy. It takes a few moments before it fully absorbs into the skin, but once it has, it leaves my hands feeling very soft and moisturized. It seems like I'm washing my hands dozens of times a day, so they are in rough shape. As for the changes, the tube is different. This one says "new" on it. It also says "Cheirosa 62 Fragrance". The color of the new hand cream is closer to white where as the old one is more yellowy. The old one may be expired, I've had it for a while. The old one has a runnier consistency, too. I've included pics of both. The list of ingredients is different. There are some of the same ingredients, but different ones, too. I do like the new one better and would say that it is improved!

title: Gorgeous Neutral Eye Shadow
text: I have been a fan of theBalm product line for a few years. I love their Eco friendly packaging. This palette has gorgeous neutral eye shadow colors. Some are matte and some are shimmer. They are all nicely pigmented and long lasting. They are non-irritating to my sensitive eyes.

title: Double Duty!
text: I do like products that do double duty! This hand lotion moisturizes and sanitizes your hands at the same time. The lotion has a slightly runny consistency. The eucalyptus scent is pleasant and not too strong. It leaves my hands feeling a tad sticky for a few minutes, but within 5 minutes, the stickiness was gone and my hands were left feeling soft. By the time my hands were dry, the smell was mostly gone. I was tempted to go wash my hands during the sticky phase, but I'm glad I didn't because I really liked the way they felt afterwards.

title: Unscented
text: This toner arrived just in time. My previous toner was down to the end. It's unscented and I can't detect any type of smell or scent to it. It doesn't strip or over dry my skin. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I haven't noticed any difference in my pores. I'm not always the most observant person. It does clean my face. It gets the stuff that washing my face leaves behind.

title: Lovely
text: This perfume by Oscar De La Renta is a lovely scent. It's a sweet, floral that's not too over powering. The bottle is beautiful, however, I find it a little wonky. There's a clear plastic piece that is holding it in place while in the box. You're supposed to remove it, so I did. I found that the lid that you're supposed to press down on to get the perfume to spray isn't very stable. It even comes off easily. I think for a $100+ bottle of perfume, you shouldn't have to fix or adjust the lid after using it.

title: Eco Friendly!
text: I have been trying to make more Eco-Friendly choices. This is one of them. I've used some other brands of the tablets, but this is my first starter set. I was using the other tablets in empty plastic hand soap containers. The concept is great. The execution is good. The foamy soap is not quite as foamy as most of the other brands of foam hand soap. It's okay and certainly usable. The scents are good, but I would love to see more options and stronger scents. The bottle is nice. I really like that this is a plastic free set.

title: Refreshing!
text: This is my first time using ice globes. They are so refreshing! I have a beauty refrigerator that maintains a 50 degree temperature. That's a little higher than the suggested temperature, but I find it to be more than suffice. The handles have silicone grips which make them easy to hold. I am really enjoying this new addition to my skincare routine!

title: Bargain!
text: These hair clips are a bargain at less than a dollar a piece. They are fairly sturdy. I have very thick, coarse hair that goes a little past my shoulders. The clips easily hold my hair up. I did find them just a little difficult to open one handed while my other hand was holding my hair in position. It's possible that would be a problem with any similar clip. There is a nice variety of colors to choose from.

title: Purse Size Spray
text: I am familiar with the Oribe brand, but I don't think I've tried anything of theirs. This perfume comes in a travel or purse size spray bottle. The scent is a musky, powdery scent in my opinion. It's pretty gender neutral. I didn't think it was a very long lasting scent, but I just checked my wrist and I can still smell it, 8 hours after applying it. It could probably benefit from a refresh. I really like this size of perfume because it allows me to use one long enough to decide if I really like it or not and not be stuck with a large bottle. Plus, I can have several to choose from because of the price point.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I have sensitive skin, so one of the most important features that I look for is one that is gentle and non-irritating. This doesn't cause any irritations, so I am pleased with that. It has a light, pleasant scent that smells like a botanical smell which makes me think it's just the ingredients. It absorbs quickly into the skin. My fingers don't feel sticky or greasy after applying it. I haven't noticed any differences with the skin on my face yet, but when I have put some on the back of my hands, the skin plumped up and looked very moisturized. I like the brand and have used several other products in their skincare line. I consider them to be fairly affordable.

title: Silky!
text: Retinol is part of my nighttime skincare routine. This Retinol serum has a slightly oily consistency. It goes on silky though, rather than oily. It's actually less oily than I expected. I tend to dislike facial oils, but I don't mind this one. I don't notice any scent to it. I've been using this as the last step in my routine and by the time I go to bed, it has absorbed well and my skin feels super soft. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't affect it. Overall, I'm really liking it!

title: Fun Scent
text: While I was expecting more of a fruity scent, this perfume is still a fun scent. The fruitiness is there, it's just not very strong. I also detect some floral notes. It's an uplifting scent. The rollerball feature works well, though I think I prefer s spray. This would make a great stocking stuffer!

title: Strange, But It Works
text: This color changing blush oil is strange, but it does work, at least for a little while.  It's a lime green in the bottle, but it goes on pink. The pink looked a little dark at first. I was a bit worried because I had applied it in the car and didn't have anything with me that could remove it. (my husband was driving - I wasn't doing this at the stoplight!)  However, it quickly lightened up. It did give a natural flush look. It didn't seem to last all day. It's definitely oily feeling. I used the wand to apply it on my finger and then used my finger to apply it to my cheeks. It didn't leave my fingers feeling icky thankfully, since I was in the car. It didn't irritate my sensitive skin. My 20 year old daughter is trying it out now.

title: A Favorite Of Mine
text: Sonage Skincare products are some of my favorite products. This C Shield Smart Serum is awesome! It has a fun, citrus scent that boosts my overall mood. One pump of the serum covers my face and neck area. It's a thicker serum, but it absorbs well. I will say that it does burn if you get it on a cut or wound. I had a small cut on my chin and it hurt a little bit when it got on it. Now that I know, I am careful. This happens with some other products, too. I think it's the acid from the Vitamin C. I really do like this serum!

title: Silky Skin
text: After using this serum for a few days, I started noticing my skin was feeling very silky and soft. It's a thicker serum and I have been using only at night. It has a pleasant smell that's not too strong. Of course, that is totally objective those with sensitivities to scent may have issues with it. It absorbs rather quickly. I have sensitive skin which has not been effective by the use of it. I regularly use a variety of anti-aging products and don't usually notice results unless they're dramatic. I have not seen any dramatic changes with this one, but that isn't to say that it's not improving my skin's appearance.

title: Goes On Smoothly!
text: I love using eye shadow crayons. This one by Trestique is a nice one. It goes on smoothly without tugging on the delicate skin. The color is great for all over the lid. I have hooded eyes, so I use this color all over the lid, then a darker one in and above the crease. There's a slight shimmer to this without being too shiny. I put this on for a date night and it lasted through the evening to my satisfaction. I like that it's refillable, too!

title: Doesn't Annoy My Skin
text: I have sensitive skin and I found this cleanser to be gentle and does not annoy my skin. I like the smell of it. It has a light, fresh scent. It doesn't really lather much or at all. The pump dispenser works fine, but I found that I needed multiple pumps to get enough to clean my face. I like it, but don't love it.

title: Minimal Clumping
text: This mascara comes in a squeeze tube rather than a traditional mascara tube. It is easier to load the wand in my opinion. I found that there was minimal clumping with this brand of mascara. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes. At the end of the day, the mascara is still on my lashes and hasn't rubbed off. It doesn't lengthen my lashes as much as I like, but other than that, I am pleased.

title: Absorbs Well
text: I thought this Retinol moisturizer from Bliss would be like a water gel mask, but it absorbs pretty well. I am a regular user of Retinol products at nighttime, so I started using this nightly. Some products suggest starting slowly until your skin adjusts to the potent ingredient, but this one did not say anything about doing that. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't cause any redness or irritation. It's fragrance free and I can't detect any scent or smell to it.

title: Easy to Use
text: My 20 year old daughter started using color depositing conditioners a few months ago. Her natural hair is medium to dark brown and she has been wanting to change her color. Her hair dresser talked her out of stripping and bleaching her hair. The color depositing conditioners have been a smart choice. She has been using similar red colors or darker browns. It's different enough to her that she's satisfied. She has used this product once so far. It's been a couple of weeks since the application. Her hair has a nice reddish cast to it. It's easy to use, although it is a little messy. She makes sure to use disposable gloves and an old towel. The condition of her hair is great! Her hair has been soft and manageable. She has been very pleased with the results.

title: Pretty Hair Dryer!
text: This is a very pretty hair dryer! I love the pink and the rose gold combo. The dryer works fine. It's light weight and easy to hold. I usually let my hair air dry, but there are days when I don't have the time to do that. I think I prefer my BaByLiss  hair dryer better. It seems to work a little faster. This one will go in my daughter's bathroom for her visits home from college. She keeps her hair dryer in her apartment and when she visits us, she ends up stealing mine!

title: Nice Neutral Color
text: This lip product is a cross between a lip balm and a lip stick. It glides on well. The color is good and it's a very nice neutral color. It doesn't seem to last very long at all.

title: Nice Gift Set
text: Erno Laszlo skincare is a high end brand that has been around for years. I have tried a few of their products and have enjoyed most of them. This is a nice gift set that includes a sleeping mask gel, eye gel masks, and a fancy rose quartz skincare tool. I use water gel/sleeping masks regularly. I don't like this one as much as some of the other ones that I have tried. I don't dislike it, but I don't love it. It has a strong scent that is perfumey. I love scented products, when it's a scent that I love. The mask is a thicker gel consistency than other masks. It absorbs quickly whereas others tend so absorb more slowly. It does leave my fingers feeling a little sticky and tacky. The eye gel masks are good and work well. I have seen the gua sha facial massage tool before, but I have never owned one. It's nice, though I'm not 100% sure that I'm using it correctly. Overall, this is a good set and would make a nice gift.

title: Saves Steps!
text: I follow a multi-step skincare routine. This all in one product by Garnier saves steps! I cleanse first, then tone. Then instead of using a separate serum, moisturizer and eye cream, I just use this. I am a regular user of Retinol, so I started using this daily rather than starting just once a week. I do have sensitive skin but haven't had any problems with this one. It's unscented and absorbs well.

title: Easy to Use
text: I have a had a couple of different hair dryer/blow out brushes. They're game changers and make it much easier to do my own hair. I love the pink and rose gold color combination. I was hoping that this would be a more travel friendly one because of the wording. It is labeled as "mini" but it's not at all mini in my opinion. The length of it is the same as the others that I have (Dry Bar, Adagio California, & Bed Head). The handle/base is much lighter in weight. I found it slipped around in my hand a little while using it. The head of the brush is much narrower than the others by at least an inch or two. Everything else is pretty much the same. It's easy to use. The process of using it is similar to the others. It's not my favorite one, but it's still good and I like it.

title: Healthy Glow
text: This set By Terry comes with a brightening CC serum and eyeshadow pen. My first attempt with the serum was a huge fail. It's tinted and shimmery which resulted in a sparkly bronze effect. The second time I used it a lot more sparingly. Used that way, it wasn't too bad. In fact, it was more like a healthy glow. The eyeshadow pen is awesome! It is small though, about half the size of regular eyeshadow pens, but it is labeled as a travel size. The color is a good, neutral brown. It glides on easily and lasts a while. This is a nice set that comes in a zippered travel bag.

title: Great Size!
text: This perfume bottle is a great size! It is more than just a sample size. It's more like a purse or travel size. The bottle seems to be aluminum which I think is great. It's more durable than glass and easier to recycle! The scent is a light fruity, floral one. It's not one I would normally gravitate toward, but I like it.

title: Light Weight Moisturizer
text: This is a light weight moisturizer. I don't notice any smell or scent to it. It doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or oily. It's a fast absorbing lotion. It has a creamy, lotion consistency. It doesn't annoy my sensitive skin. It has not caused any breakouts. I've been using this for about a week now and my face is soft and hydrated.

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: I have ultra sensitive eyes and this eye repair by Cult 51 does not irritate or annoy my eyes. I don't notice any scent to it. It has more of a lotion consistency than a serum. It absorbs nicely. It doesn't leave my finger tips sticky or tacky. I haven't really noticed any difference since using this product but that could be for a multitude of reasons. For one, I'm not always very observant, especially with minor differences. Second - My close up vision sucks and I can't see anything  up close without my glasses and the glasses tend to get in the way when looking at my eye area! And finally, I regularly use anti-aging products around my eyes, so maybe they're already at their best! Anyway, I do like this product and will continue to use it for the time being.

title: Use Sparingly!
text: This is my first time using any product by Deborah Lippmann. This body shimmer/highlighter comes in a tube. You don't remove the cap to access the cream. Instead, you twist the cap slightly, then squeeze and the lotion comes out. Use sparingly! The first time I used it, I squeezed a large amount of it. I treated just like any other body lotion. Well, it was not pretty! It was like a bronzing effect. Bronzing with lots of shimmer. I had to use 3 or 4 makeup remover wipes to get it off my arms. Then I waited a few minutes and tried again. This time, I only used a small amount. This was much better. It gave my skin a healthy glow. I didn't find it to be very hydrating, but it wasn't drying either. There's a very light scent. Because of the shimmer, this is something I probably wouldn't use on a daily basis. but rather use it for special occasions.

title: Nice Set
text: My daughter has been wanting to dye her hair. She's been using color depositing conditioners, but was ready to try something more permanent. This is a nice set and comes with everything you need to do the job, sans an old towel. My daughter had no problems following the directions. She did have a friend assisting her. She has medium to dark brown natural hair color. The new color is mostly just a dark version, though in certain lighting, you can see a bit of violet. Since she didn't want to bleach or strip her hair, she was satisfied with the results. There's not a whole lot you can do when you have dark brown hair!

title: Two Products in One
text: I follow a multi-step skincare regiment. My nighttime routine calls for both Retinol and a moisturizer. This is like having 2 products in one which makes for fewer steps! It doesn't have any added fragrance, but it does have a very light smell to it. It absorbs well leaving my skin feeling soft and supple. My hands don't feel sticky after applying it.

title: Nice Pigmentation
text: I was introduced to the Dose of Colors brand through a subscription box. This is my first time trying their eye shadow. The palette has 5 different colors. The lighter colors are sparkly. Maybe a little too much sparkle for me. I used some other brand highlight colors to help out. The colors have a nice pigmentation. I also found them to be pretty long lasting. After several hours, there was still plenty of eye shadow on my eyelids. I do like the double ended brush that came with the set. One end is a fine tip which is good for drawing lines along the lash line. Overall, I find this to be a good palette.

title: Lotion Consistency
text: I am a fan of Retinol and use it daily in some form or another. This serum is a lotion consistency. It absorbs easily and doesn't feel sticky or tacky. It's quite moisturizing. There's no noticeable scent to it. I follow a multi-step skin care regiment and it calls for Retinol in the evening, so in keeping with that, I have only been using this in the evening. I haven't had any kind of irritation from it.

title: Nice Set of Skin Care!
text: I remember the Princess Borghese  line from back in the 1980's. It was one of those fancy makeup/skin care companies in the department stores. I think I had a lipstick from them. I didn't even know they were still around, but they are! This is a nice set of skin care items. I don't think they are all full size products, but they're not sample sizes either. The mud mask is probably full size. The cleanser and the cream seem like they'll last for a few weeks if not longer. The cleanser is my favorite of the items. It has a light, fruity scent. It lathers really well. It's actually an enjoyable experience to clean my face with it! The mud mask is good. It's not one that cracks and hardens. I really like that you only have to wait 2 to 5 minutes before rinsing. I don't have time to wait 20 minutes for my face mask to do its thing! The time factor is probably the biggest reason I don't use masks very often. Maybe that will change with this one! I rinsed it off in the shower which was easy. The cream is lightly scented. It's more of a perfume type scent. It's not bad. I just like fruity scents better. After using all 3 products, my skin was left feeling very soft. I didn't have any negative reactions to any of the products. I do have sensitive, mature skin.

title: Cleans Well
text: My 20 year old daughter loves I Dew Care products. She was very excited to try this new cleanser. It's very gentle. Her skin isn't usually sensitive, but every once in a while she will find that a product irritates her. This one did not. It produces a great foam. She and I both like cleansers that foam up nicely and this one does. It doesn't have any added fragrance, but it does still have a pleasant smell to it. It doesn't over dry her young skin. She's a fan!

title: Gentle
text: This is a good, gentle cleanser. It produces a minimal lather. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. There's no scent to it. It doesn't over dry my skin. The pump dispenses well. Everything is fine with it, I just found it to be a little boring. But boring isn't a bad thing. This is a good, reliable cleanser.

title: Not What I Expected
text: This Neutrogena Hydro Boost Moisturizer is not what I expected. It's basically a facial sunscreen, albeit a fancy one with Hyaluronic Acid. It mentions that it's a water gel product, but all products that I have used that claim to be water gel are quite different in their consistency and appearance. This is a white, creamy lotion (just like sunscreen!). It smells like traditional sunscreen, too. I'm not saying that's a bad thing. It's just not what I expected. It does absorb well and doesn't leave behind a white haze. I have to be very careful when using sunscreen products on my face because of my sensitive eyes. If I get sweaty, and I have sunscreen near my eyes, it will often run into my eyes and cause a lot of stinging. So I have been primarily using this on my decolletage area. I have been applying it carefully on my face, but at least an inch away from my eyes and not above my eyes. It's definitely an affordable product. It does moisturize a bit. I really need to find a sunscreen that doesn't irritate my eyes!

title: Unscented
text: I was unfamiliar with this brand of skincare. However, I saw that it sells at Sephora, so I was excited to give it a try. It's unscented and really doesn't have any smell to it. I like naturally scented products, but I dislike products that are unscented that still have a smell to them, because usually it ends up being something I don't like. This one doesn't, so that's good. It's a bit heavier than I expected. I first tried this in the morning and after using it, decided that it is really too heavy for daytime use. It has a greasy feel to it and left my face feeling greasy for several minutes after applying it. It did go away, but it was tacky and greasy for a little while. It left a glow behind which I liked. Overall, it's good. I don't love it, but I do like it.

title: Affordable
text: This facial toner is gentle and non-irritating on my sensitive skin. It doesn't have any scent or smell to it. My understanding is that it's not a product with immediate results, rather one that produces results over time. The bottle is a good size. It doesn't dispense too much, too fast. It's definitely an affordable toner. I like it!

title: Non-Irritating
text: I'm in my early 50's. I have large noticeable pores on the bridge of my nose. I've been using this for about a week so far. I'm not sure that I'm noticing smaller pores yet, but I have found it to be non-irritating to my sensitive skin. It goes on smoothly and doesn't leave my fingers feeling sticky or tacky. It doesn't have much of any smell to it. The texture of my skin is very soft after applying it. I will continue to use it because I like the product and I approve of the ingredients.

title: Battery Not Included
text: I usually use a Flawless hair trimmer, but I saw this and thought it would be a nice one to keep in my travel bag. The design and colors are fun. The package says that it uses a USB charger/cable, but that's wrong. It uses a battery which is not included. It was actually a bit challenging to get it open to insert the battery. I had to have my husband help me and it was difficult for him too. The Flawless one is pretty simple to open, this one was not. It does a decent job of trimming. If you need to trim the eyebrows, it does have the option to do so. I primarily use it for trimming facial hair so I don't need the eyebrow piece. So far, it's working fine and I will keep using it.

title: Fun & Fruity!
text: This oxygenating bubble mask is both fun and fruity! I love the fruit scent, though I can't tell if it's apple or pear. Maybe neither? The mask is easy to apply. It started bubbling up almost immediately. It doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. It's not messy like many face masks. I like it!

title: Just What I Wanted!
text: I was looking for a wide tooth comb to use in the shower to help spread out the conditioner on my hair. The combs are durable. They do flex a little bit, but not much. The teeth are wide and it goes through my thick hair pretty easily. Plus, it's pink, my favorite color!!

title: Non-Irritating
text: This serum is non-irritating. It's a light purple color and has a pleasant floral scent to it. It absorbs well. I haven't noticed any tightening, but unless it's super obvious, I don't often notice things like that. It has Vitamin-C which is something I regularly use every morning. I like it!

title: Great Applicator
text: I am in my early fifties and regularly use anti-aging products. This serum has a great applicator. I really like it. It has a cooling effect from the metal. I have found that I don't want to apply too much serum. When I go heavy on the serum, it tightens up a lot. More than I need or want. I have never had any product tighten up that much!! The skin under my eyes is loose and needs a little firming, but a little bit of serum is enough!! The serum doesn't hurt or irritate my sensitive eyes. It's a good serum.

title: Nice Set!
text: This is a nice set of hand soap and lotion. I have picked up Savannah Bee products before at Whole Foods and local boutique shops. I really enjoyed the honey scent of these products. The soap produces a light lather. It cleans well. The lotion is very moisturizing. I am a fan of both of these. They look good on my bathroom counter!

title: Better Than Other Methods
text: I found this gel polish remover to be okay, but it was definitely better than other methods. I've tried soaking my nails and wrapping them in soaked cotton and foil. This was much easier than those. I did have to apply it 4 or 5 times to get the polish off and even after that, I think there was still a little bit of polish on some of my nails. It does say that it takes longer depending on how many coats of polish. I had my nails done at the salon and I thought I had 2 coats of polish in addition to the base coat and top coat. It's easy to apply.The polish starts to bubble after a minute or two. I lightly filed the surface as instructed. I did find it easy to do other things while letting this work, unlike the other methods where you can't do anything involving your hands. I was able to play games on my phone while I waited. Overall, I did like it, but I would love to find an even faster way to remove gel polish!

title: Hydrating!
text: This eye cream is a lotion type consistency. One pump is enough to thoroughly cover the delicate skin area below my eyes. Often there's enough extra to go up under the brow area, too. It doesn't have any noticeable scent. It absorbs nicely and leaves my skin feeling hydrated. It doesn't irritate my super sensitive eyes which is a big plus!

title: Doesn't Smell Like Typical Sunscreen!
text: I am trying to be better about applying sunscreen daily, even if I don't plan to be outside much. I don't care for the typical sunscreen smell so I try to find ones that smell either tropical or have no smell at all. I don't think this one is scented. It does have a slight smell which might be from the ingredients, but it doesn't smell like typical sunscreen. It goes on white but absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any whiteness behind. The only issue I had with this was figuring out how to open it! My instinct was to twist the cap off! It took me a couple of times to figure out that all you have to do is pull it off!

title: Non-Irritating
text: I'm in my early 50's. I usually use Stri-Vecten neck cream, but I was happy to give this a try. For the most part, I really didn't notice any difference between the 2 products. They both have a similar, thick consistency. Neither of them irritate my sensitive skin. They are both moisturizing. This one is a little more affordable. I don't really notice any scent or smell from this. I really like that there was a 7 day supply of their Retinol serum included. I would purchase again.

title: Just What I Needed!
text: OMG! This is just what I needed! This is such a great idea. I have a standard sized walk in shower. There's a ledge at about the height of my mid-section. I tried once to put my foot up there to shave my leg and let's just say I'm lucky I didn't hurt myself! This little footrest allows me to easily access my legs in order to shave them and maintain safety. It's very sturdy and has some little bumps on it to prevent slipping. It's really a must have item!

title: Neat Applicator
text: For the first 4 days, I had no problems with this eye cream. On the fifth day, I decided to apply it above the eye, under the brow area, in addition to the delicate skin underneath my eyes. A little later that morning, my eyes were stinging. My eyes are super sensitive and probably about half of the eye products I've tried, irritate my eyes somewhat. Now onto the rest of my description. I absolutely love the applicator. It's easy to use and apply. It dispenses just the right amount of eye product. The consistency is like a lotion. It's not runny. I haven't noticed any scent or smell to it. I do plan to keep using it, but I will only apply it below my eyes to risk irritation.

title: Gentle
text: This is a gentle toner. I have sensitive skin and this has not irritated me at all. I don't notice any smell to it, so if there is a scent, it's very light and not noticeable. It does a good job of deep cleaning my skin without over drying or stripping it.

title: Light Lemony Scent
text: I was first introduced to Kate Somerville products through a beauty subscription box. I absolutely love the Exfolikate Intensive Exfoliating Treatment which I have purchased multiple times. I've tried a few other products, but most of them haven't wowed me like the Exfolikate. While, I'm not wowed by this (yet -it's only been a week and it often takes anti-aging products longer than that before you see results), I do really like it so far. The way a product smells is very important to me. The Exfolikate has a clove or some similar spice scent to it that evokes childhood memories. This product has a light, refreshing lemony scent to it. I don't care for overpowering, artificial scents. And products don't have to have any scent for me to like them. It's just if I don't like the way it smells, I'm not going to keep using it. I like the way this one smells! The serum has a thicker consistency than some serums. It absorbs well without leaving a sticky or tacky feeling. I haven't noticed miraculous results yet, but in addition to the fact that it's only been a week, I am a regular user of anti-aging products, therefore, I don't always see new results. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I like it enough to continue using it, which says a lot!

title: Moisturizing
text: This Rescue & Repair cream comes in a small bottle. The first couple of times I used it on my face. It does have a strong herbal smell to it. I don't hate the smell of it, but I don't love it either. I read a little more about it and decided to start using it on my decolletage area. My skin there is thin and crepe papery. I blame myself for not putting sunscreen regularly when covering recess duty back in my teaching days. Because there's a greater distance between my decolletage and my nose, the smell doesn't bother me. It absorbs well and immediately creates a smoother surface. It moisturizes without making the skin feel greasy. I am pleased with the results so far.

title: Hydrating!
text: I am in my early 50's. I enjoy trying out different anti-aging skin care products. This one is quite nice. It has an easy to use dispenser. You remove the lid and then press down on it. A pre-measured amount of cream is dispensed. It has a light, refreshing scent that's very pleasant. It's very hydrating and absorbs well. It leaves my skin feeling very soft. It's a little thicker than what I usually use in the daytime, so I have been using this at nighttime. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. I am very happy with it.

title: Huge Bottle!
text: This cleanser comes in a huge bottle. It has a pump dispenser which makes it very easy to use. Right now I am keeping it at the sink for nighttime use. It foams nicely. I have been giving it 3 pumps per use to get enough suds to cover my face. It's not irritating. I have sensitive skin and I have not had any issues or concerns with this cleanser. It doesn't over dry or strip my skin either. Plus, it has a wonderful lemon scent to it!

title: Thin Consistency
text: I have been using anti-aging products regularly for the past few years. I'm in my early 50's now and I've started to notice loose skin underneath my eyes. I had great hopes for this eye contouring cream because the description specifically noted that it has a firming quality. After over a week of use, I haven't noticed any difference with the skin underneath my eyes as far as firmness. I have had success with some products before, so I know they're are some that work. This cream has a very thin consistency. It's easy to squeeze too much out of the tube. It took me a few days before I could control the amount of pressure required to get the right amount out. It absorbs quickly and does seem to hydrate the delicate skin area. I did have some irritation and stinging in my eyes one day. I was outside doing yard work and I was sweating a lot. I didn't have any problems during normal days. I do want to share that my eyes are ultra sensitive and many products cause stinging. Overall, I just feeling "meh" about this product. I really didn't notice any difference.

title: Light Scent
text: I'm not completely sold on the use of facial oils, but I do have some and use them at least half of the time. I am already a fan of the Winky Lux brand and was interested in giving it a try. It has a light, fruity scent to it. It reminds me of peaches, but I'm not sure that's what it actually is. Regardless, it smells nice. It is oily and takes a moment to fully absorb, but once it's has absorbed, it leaves the skin feeling soft and not greasy. I have been using this only at evening, because it is a little heavy. It's the last step in my nighttime skincare routine. I haven't noticed any changes to the condition of my skin, but I will say that I regularly use all kinds of anti-aging products, so I'm not sure I would even notice anything different unless it was major! I have sensitive skin and found this to be non-irritating.

title: Nice Scent
text: When I first got this, I assumed it was the wrong item because it's so small! I thought maybe I had an eye cream instead. So I was surprised to see that it wasn't the wrong item - it's just small! It does have a nice, light scent to it. It absorbs well. I have sensitive skin and I haven't had any problems with stinging or irritation. While I do like it, I probably wouldn't purchase it again because for the size, it's pretty costly.

title: Slow Absorbing
text: I'm always on the lookout for anti-aging products that work well. The jury is still out on this, but since I'm a regular user of similar products, it's really difficult to notice any changes in my skin most of the time. This serum is pretty runny. I don't care for the smell of it too much. It's a strong medical alcohol smell. It is slow absorbing. It takes a few moments of gently massaging it for it to disappear, which is significantly longer than most serums that I use. It immediately hydrates the skin. I applied some to the back of one of my hands and I could see a difference in the smoothness and texture of the one with the serum. I haven't had any noticeable irritations.

title: Didn't Work with My Hair
text: I have thick hair that goes at least an inch or two below my shoulders. It's cut in layers. I tried to use this on multiple occasions without any success. I don't know if it's user error on my part, or if my layers caused the trouble. I had my daughter give it a try, too. Her hair is much longer and she "sort of" got it, but it didn't look very good. It's possible that she needs more practice. The piece is much bigger than expected and has wire inside to stiffen it. There are pictures on the description that shows how to work it, but it still was a little confusing. I frequently wear my hair in a sloppy bun on top of my head, so I know my hair is long enough for that. Unfortunately it didn't work for me.

title: Meh
text: This cleanser is more like a toner than a traditional facial cleanser. It's very thin and runny. It doesn't foam up at all. While it the smell is not too strong, it isn't very pleasant. I will say that it doesn't irritate my skin at all. It also does leave my skin feeling stripped or dry. My overall feeling is just meh.

title: Great Idea!
text: These hand soap refills are a great idea! I love the concept. So far I have only used one and it worked like a charm. The scent was okay, but not my favorite. I do like the combinations of scents included in the set. I love how Eco friendly this is!!

title: Nice Dispenser
text: I use toner regularly, but not usually exfoliating ones. I have used a few  though and they all have a similar smell. It's not foul, but it's not pleasant either. I'm guessing it's the acid that's used in it that makes it smell that way. I don't love it, but I can tolerate the smell. I do really like the dispenser. You press down on it with your cotton round and it saturates the cotton. It's mess free and easy to use. The bottle is a bit small and only holds 3.5 ounces of toner. I haven't noticed any difference in my pores yet, but I will keep trying!

title: Dries Clear
text: I'm in my early 50's and still get the occasional zit. My daughter is away at college and she took my last tube of acne treatment with her, so I was happy to give this a try. I like that it dries clear. It doesn't aggravate my skin or overly dry it out. It does seem to be fast working.  I applied it to a pimple one night and the next morning it was less noticeable. It wasn't completely gone yet, but it was not as red or big as it had been. I approve!

title: Very Small
text: This brow topcoat is very small. I guess that's good so it makes it easier to find among my other eye products. It's about the size of a sample mascara. It's clear. You apply it to your brows after you have filled them in with your pencil. It also works at keeping stray brow hairs in place. It doesn't dry white or flaky. It does a good job of keeping my brows looking "done" for the whole day.

title: Light Citrus Scent
text: I've been using creams for my neck & decollete area for years. I like this one a lot. It has a light citrus scent to it. I haven't really noticed any difference in my skin in the targeted areas, but I'm attributing that to the fact that I regularly use special products for that purpose. I've most recently been using StriVectin. This cream is a little thinner than the StriVectin as far as the consistency goes. It absorbs well. It doesn't leave the skin area feeling sticky or tacky. It is very moisturizing and doesn't irritate my skin.

title: Tightens!
text: This serum has a thin consistency. I'm not crazy about the immediate smell it has when I first apply it. The best description that I can give to the smell is sour soap. Luckily, it's not too strong and it does dissipate after a minute or two. The skin tightens up almost immediately after it's rubbed into the skin. It does leave my skin feeling tacky, but not sticky. The tackiness goes away after a few minutes. The bottle is a decent size and should last a while.

title: Absorbs Quickly
text: I like having products that do dual duty. This moisturizer also has sunscreen, so that's one less product I have to deal with. The lotion dispenses easily. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any whiteness like some sunscreens. It does have the traditional smell of sunscreen, but it's not strong. In addition to the moisturizer with sunscreen, it also included a week's worth of overnight serum capsules. I haven't noticed any difference in the appearance of my skin, but I am already a regular user of anti-aging products. I have not had any issues with skin sensitivity with either of these products.

title: Mess Free Application
text: This overnight lip treatment comes in a squeeze tube so it is a mess free application. It has a thick, ointment type consistency that isn't sticky. It seems to last a while, too. It hydrates nicely. I like it!

title: Great for Travel!
text: This Vera Bradley cosmetic bag is great for traveling! It's large and can easily accommodate all of my skin care or make up. The interior is lined with clear vinyl which is super easy to wipe clean. There's a pocket on the outside which zips. The gray pattern is dotted with some yellow and pink in the floral design. The bag is sturdy and well made. It's a great addition to anyone's travel gear!
