title: Excellent Facial Sunscreen
text: I was a bit worried when I first tried this because it is tinted. However, when you rub it in, any color it has disappears leaving a smooth, matte finish behind. It doesn't have the traditional sunscreen smell to it. It has a light, almost soapy scent. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin which is always a plus. I've been using it on my decolletage  area as well. The size of the tube is small, but most facial sunscreens are similarly sized.

title: Smells So Good!
text: This beauty cream smells so good! I have been enjoying it a lot. It leaves a nice glow behind on my face. It actually reminds me a lot of Charlotte Tillsbury's Magic Cream, in both the smell and the performance. The smell is a faint, crisp rose scent. I normally don't care for rose scented products, but this is light and pleasant. It absorbs well. It does give the appearance of smooth pores. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't give me any problems.

title: Smells Nice
text: This moisturizer smells nice. It doesn't have the usual sunscreen scent to it. The scent is light and sweet. The cream is a little thicker than some moisturizers that I use and it takes a little longer to get it to fully absorb. It also feels a little tacky for a while after applying it, though not sticky. I have sensitive skin and it does not irritate me. I've been applying it to the backs of my hands in addition to my face and upper chest area.

title: Love the Smell!
text: I love Sol de Janiero's Bum Bum Cream and products. This has the wonderful smell that I love, though it is not very strong. The dry shampoo works as other dry shampoos. It doesn't leave a white haze on my hair. It does allow me to get by without washing my hair every day.

title: Cute Set
text: This spa set by Vera Bradley is very cute. The clear vinyl bag is trimmed in the purple Butterfly print. The set includes a head band and a pair of wrist bands. The wrist bands keep your sleeves dry when washing your face. I don't wear long sleeves to bed, but my daughter immediately thought it was a good idea. The headband is nice. I have a large head and it stretches to fit on me without being tight. But my daughter has a smaller head and it fits her fine, too. This would make a good gift!

title: Magic in a Bottle!
text: I don't usually use face oils. I don't like the feeling of it on my skin, but this one is not very oily feeling. It absorbs pretty fast and leaves my skin feeling very soft. I have only been using this in the evening. It's the last step after cleansing, toning, serum, moisturizer, and retinol. There's no noticeable smell or scent to it. It only takes a couple of drops to cover the surface of my face. I am very pleased with it.

title: Easy to Use
text: This is a 2 pack of green tea stick face mask. It is very easy to use. You can apply it without getting your hands messy, which I like. It glides on easily. I let it dry for the recommended 15 minutes or so. It doesn't make your face crack or harden. Rinsing is simple, too. It comes off with water. I have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate me. I was hoping for some improvement with the pores around my nose, as the picture shows, but it didn't have any effect on my pores. I don't dislike it, but I don't like it either, hence the 3 star rating.

title: Received the Wrong One
text: I was expecting to receive the Red light face brush by Vanity Planet specifically for anti-aging. However, I received the blue light one (it says on the box) which targets acne. I'm in my early 50's and I can really use the anti-aging feature. Because I don't need the acne feature, I haven't used it. However, I have used this as a cleansing brush. There are 2 silicone heads to use. They are both very soft and non-irritating. The unit comes with a USB charging cable so no separate batteries are required!  It's easy to hold and use. It comes with a little stand and lid. I like the unique shape of it. So while I didn't get the one I wanted or expected, I do like this brush. I have a 20 year old daughter and I may see if she wants it because she does deal with acne every now and then.

title: Comfortable to Hold
text: I've seen a lot of articles about scalp care recently, so I have started paying more attention to mine. This scalp brush is comfortable to hold. It looks like it might be prickly, but it's surprisingly  gentle on my scalp. I have been using it after applying a little bit of shampoo to my hair. Then I work it around on the scalp area with this brush. It feels very good to do it and I'm sure it's benefiting my hair and scalp as well. This is one of those things I didn't know I needed!

title: Nice Lather
text: This is a good size bottle of hand soap. It has a pump dispenser that works well. The soap is clear and lathers nicely. The scent reminds me of men's cologne which I'm neutral about. I found the scent to be too strong for one that I didn't love, but I totally get that that's just my personal opinion and doesn't reflect on the quality of the soap. I will say that every time I use it, my hands feel different and better than when I use regular soap. I can't pinpoint what it is that makes me feel that way, but it's been consistent every time I've used it. So while the scent is not my favorite, I do love the way my hands feel afterwards!

title: Leaves My Skin Feeling Soft
text: This is basically a gel moisturizer. It's slightly cool to the touch. It isn't greasy or oily. It absorbs nicely. I have added this to my nighttime skincare routine. I use it after my regular serum and moisturizer but before my face oil. It leaves my skin feeling soft. It has a clean, fresh smell to it.

title: Quick Absorbing
text: This bottle of face cream is pretty little. However, one pump is enough to cover my entire face, so I'm not worried about it running out too quickly. I don't notice much of a scent to it. It is quick absorbing and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or greasy. I've added this to my nighttime routine for the past few weeks. My skin is pretty sensitive and this has not irritated me at all. I haven't seen any miracle results from it, but I have been following a multi-step skincare routine for several years now, so I really don't think I would see anything new.

title: Great Clips!
text: I have started clipping some of my hair while I'm blow drying my hair. These clips are durable and work well. They don't feel cheap like they're going to break. They're easy to use. I like the assortment of colors. It really does help with my home blow outs!

title: Comfortable Grip
text: I've recently started using scalp specific scrubs after reading about the benefits. I saw this brush and thought I would give it a try. I am really liking it. It's easy to hold and use. I am tender headed, but it doesn't hurt at all. I like the feel of it on my scalp. I have used it with scalp scrubs and regular shampoo. It seems to increase the lather a bit. I have been using it a couple of times a week.

title: Mild Grit
text: I have used other scalp scrubs on occasion. I use them about once a week or so. This one has a mild grit to it. I've used some that are very gritty. I don't know enough about the process to know which ones are better. I also used this with a scalp scrub brush. It lathers a bit. It didn't irritate my scalp. It was easy to rinse out. The grittier ones seem to be more difficult to fully rinse. This one has a pleasant scent to it. I didn't detect the ginger or mint smell. It seemed floral to me, but not a perfume floral. I like it.

title: Gritty!
text:
I love coffee scrubs so I was excited to try a new one. This one is what I consider to be a dry scrub. Some scrubs have a greasy or waxy additive, this one does not. So when you scoop it out, it's loose. I like this kind better. It doesn't leave me feeling greasy. There is a coffee smell to it, but it's not very strong. I enjoy the stronger scent personally. This smells fine though. It says this is a face and body scrub. I tried it on my face first. It's a little too gritty to use on my face I have decided. Plus, it took a while to get it fully rinsed. I used this on a day that I wasn't washing my hair and I wore a shower cap. There was a lot of grounds around my hairline that I had to rinse away later. I liked it better using it as a body scrub. It exfoliates nicely. While it didn't leave behind any greasiness, it did feel like there was a film or layer of something left behind. It wasn't bad and I didn't try to remove it. Overall, I like it.

*Updated 9/23: I've had this since July. I used it every couple of weeks. I went to use it yesterday and it was all moldy. I did take one star off today because of that. Don't let it go that long without using it!

title: A New Favorite!
text: I use facial scrubs daily. Twice a week I use one with a more abrasive grittiness to it whereas the other days I use a gentle one. This is one that I consider to be a gentle one. It has a very light, pleasant fruity scent. The grit in it disintegrates rather quickly. I have never noticed that happening with other exfoliating scrubs. It starts out with as a scrub, but turns into just a cleanser. It does foam up a teeny bit. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. This has become a new favorite of mine!

title: Very Nice Toner!
text: This Beauty Water makes for a very nice toner. I am really enjoying it. First of all, it's a large bottle. I imagine it will last quite a while, even at using twice a day. Secondly, it has a very light and pleasant fruity smell to it. Smell is very important to me. If I don't like the way a skincare product smells, then I won't use it. I prefer light and natural scents as opposed to artificial fragrances. I have been using this with cotton rounds. It seems to do a good job of getting dirt left behind after cleansing. It doesn't to over dry or strip my skin either. I am very happy with it.

title: Smooth Lines
text: This eye pencil gives smooth lines. It doesn't tug or pull on the delicate skin around my eyes. I tend to rub my eyes a lot, so by the end of the day it's pretty much gone.

title: Smells Nice
text: Summertime is the best time to put your deodorant to the test! We've had a lot of hot summer days so far. This glides on easily. It smells very nice. It says it's rose & geranium, but it smells very much like lavender to me. I do know the difference between rose and lavender!! I have taken many double takes as far as smelling it and it's lavender. I have had to reapply it a few times, but in all fairness, that's something I often do in the summertime. I do like that it's aluminium free.

title: Cute Style
text: This Vera Bradley toiletry bag is a cute style. I like that it stands up. The inside is vinyl so it will clean easily. The interior space is pretty large. My only complaint is that I can't pull the drawstring to close it as tightly as shown in the picture. I can get it until there's about a fist size opening, but that's it. As long as I don't fill it with lots of small items, there's no problem. I like the idea of using it for your wet swimsuit. I'm using it for hair stuff right now while I am out of town. I have my shampoo and conditioner in it, a shower cap, head band, a few hair ties, and my hair brush. I do like keeping all of that stuff together. The quality of the bag is good. Overall, I do like it.

title: Easy to Use
text: This Patchology eye roller is easy to use. It has a roller ball dispenser that is cool and refreshing. I have found that it's helpful to store it upside down so the serum is ready to go otherwise you're waiting for gravity to take place. I've been using this a few times a day to add extra hydration to the delicate skin around my eyes. My eyes are very sensitive and this doesn't irritate them.

title: Travel Set
text: My 20 year old daughter loves the I Dew Care line of products. This set of a toner and gel moisturizer is a travel or trial set. The toner is fairly gentle. It's refreshing and cleans the skin well. The moisturizer hydrates nicely. Both products are non-irritating. Neither of them are fragrance free, but they do seem to be free of added artificial fragrances.

title: Easy to Apply
text: This sunscreen is easy to apply. It has a spray nozzle. I could spray my body without having to ask my husband to help. It goes on clear. It smells like regular sunscreen. I was a little concerned because of other reviewers who complained about the fragrance, but it's just like most other sunscreens that I've used. The only exception is the ones that smell like coconut. I have been hanging out at the pool a bit recently and I haven't gotten sunburned yet, so it must work!

title: Great Color!
text: I'm in my early 50's and I've never had my eyebrows shaped, waxed, etc. I have plucked super long brow hairs that won't lay flat and a few here or there that were spaced away from the rest of the brow hairs. In the last year or so, I've noticed that my full natural brows have become a bit sparse, especially at the narrow ends. So after all these years, I've started doing something to my brows whenever I do my make up. This brow pencil is a great color! I like the pencil tip shape. It's a lot like a triangle shape rather than circular. The marks look pretty natural looking. The other end is a sponge with brown powder. It goes on easily. It also looks natural. I usually use a spoolie after applying my brow pencil which I find just helps it look more natural. It seems to last a decent amount of time. Overall, I am pleased with it.

title: Not Enough Coffee Smell
text: I love the smell of coffee, so I was excited to try this cream out. It has a nice, thick, creamy consistency. It is easy to work into the skin and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. The scent is more chocolate than coffee, not the cocoa butter smell that I'm used to, but just chocolate. I love chocolate but I don't like the smell of it on my body. I applied this at bedtime and then I kept getting whiffs of it while I was trying to fall asleep. There's not enough coffee smell in my opinion. So I liked the quality of the cream, just not the scent of it.

title: Refreshing!
text: These eye gel pads are quite refreshing. I don't notice much of any scent to them. They are very wet and I found that they moved around a little bit when I was wearing them. They do a good job of hydrating the delicate skin around the eye. I haven't noticed any other benefits but I am a regular user of similar gel pads and all kinds of anti-aging eye products that I realize I many not see anything new there. I didn't have any problems with irritation from using them. A lot of eye products cause stinging or burning in my eyes, but these did not. I like them!

title: Impressed!
text: I am surprisingly impressed with this Ivory deodorant. First, it smells quite nice. That's a good way to start things. I put it on in the morning and forgot about it. It was a very busy. I was running all over the house doing major cleaning in anticipation for weekend company. Usually on a day like that I would feel wet and gross. With all the trips up and down the stairs, I felt fresh and dry! That's pretty impressive to me. Especially since this is aluminum free! I am a fan for sure!

title: Great Function!
text: I was unfamiliar with this Vera Bradley style of bag. When I first opened it, I thought it looked like a very large lunch box. It's about 3 inches deep. There are 4 different compartments in the main section. They are lined with a vinyl type coordinating butterfly print. There's a mesh cover on it that zips around on 3 sides  of it. The other side is the lid of this 3 inch deep box. It is covered in the same material. There are compartments for 5 brushes with a clear vinyl flap that protects the rest of the bag from any remaining powders on the brushes. There's also a smaller mesh pocket that zips. The case has a handle as well as a carrying strap. It has the quality of what I expect from Vera Bradley!

title: Works Well!
text: My daughter has medium to dark brown hair. She would love to be able to color it with some bright and vibrant hair color, but her hair dresser and I have talked her out of it for the time being. It just seems so harsh! So she has gotten semi-permanent color down at the salon a couple of times. Those have been just darker brown or nearly black. She has expressed interest in the color depositing conditioners and was excited to try this. It was easy to use. The directions were clear. It was a little messy. She wore gloves and still managed to get it everywhere. You definitely want to use an old towel! She has been very pleased with the results. The burgundy red is not obvious, but it's noticeable. She doesn't wash her hair every day so it's lasting several days so far. She's excited to be able try out other colors. I like that it's not permanent and it isn't harsh on her hair.

title: Hydrates
text: I am on the cusp of menopause. If things continue as they are, I will officially be in menopause at the end of the month. With the summer months, my skin has been very dry lately. I find myself reapplying face moisturizer throughout the day. This one doesn't really have any scent to it. It's creamy and a little on the thick side. It absorbs well. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It seems to hydrate nicely.

title: Affordable!
text: I use cotton rounds daily. These are okay. You definitely get a lot for your money with these. I find that they pull apart and separate really easily. At first I thought they were super thin, but then I realized that it was just one half of one. Now that I'm aware of that, I am more careful taking one out of the package. They seem to be decent. They don't fall apart when using them.

title: Leaves My Skin Feeling Silky
text: I regularly use a similar Retinol capsule. This one is about the same price, though the capsules are slightly larger. I have found these to be a little more challenging to open. The neck of the capsules that you are supposed to pinch or twist to open is a little thicker than my other ones. I keep my nails trimmed pretty short so it has been difficult to get these opened. I've been using scissors to cut them open and that works well. The premeasured serum is enough to cover my face and neck. It leaves my skin feeling very silky. It doesn't cause any irritations on my sensitive skin. Overall, I am pleased with these and would consider purchasing them again.

title: Seems to Work on Blackheads
text: I've started seeing a lot of blackheads on my face. I'm in my early 50's and really haven't had to deal with many over the years. This tool does seem to work on them. It comes ready to use. It's easy to turn on and off. It seems to heat up a little while using it. I do believe that this is better for my skin than squeezing the blackheads.

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: This face lotion is a little thicker than what I usually use in the day, so I have been using it at nighttime. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It goes on easily and quickly absorbs rapidly. It doesn't have any noticeable scent. I haven't noticed any improvement in my skin, but I do regularly use anti-aging products so I would not expect to see anything new at this time.

title: Very Hydrating!
text: This body butter is very hydrating. It's a thick, creamy consistency. It takes a moment to get it fully rubbed in, but it doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy at all. The cream has a pleasant banana scent. The smell doesn't linger too long. I am really enjoying this new body butter!

title: Pleasant Scent
text: This spray antiperspirant/deodorant has a pleasant powdery scent. It does a good job of keeping me feeling dry and fresh. I haven't used a spray antiperspirant in years, though, and I now remember why I haven't used them in a while. After spraying it on, I get into a coughing fit! It's hard to not breathe it in. I'm trying to be more aware and careful while I am applying it. Yesterday I sprayed it into the sleeve of my shirt onto my pits and that worked better and didn't cause any problems with coughing or breathing.

title: Cool & Refreshing
text: This roller ball eye serum is cool and refreshing. There's no noticeable scent to it. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes any. The metal roller ball glides gently on the delicate eye skin. I have found that I need to store it upside in order to get the serum to dispense well.

title: Effective
text: I like to use a face scrub daily. However, I vary them so I am not using harsh ones every day. This one has a good grit to it. It's not too abrasive, but because of the grittiness, I only use this about two times a week. I use ones with more milder grit on the other days. I don't really notice any scent or smell to this. It is pretty effective at removing dead skin. I have really sensitive skin and this hasn't irritated me.

title: Amazing!
text: This makeup setting spray is amazing! I have never seen results like this before! I don't wear a lot of makeup these days, but one day this week I went out to lunch with friends. I even put eye makeup on! I spritz this when I was finished applying the makeup. We dined outside at a cafe. It was sunny and pretty warm. I was sure that my makeup would melt off. I didn't think anything of it until night time. I was getting ready to wash my face and noticed that my makeup was still noticeable. I wear pretty natural makeup. I use a light tinted moisturizer, blush, face powder, plus on this day I wore eye shadow, brow pencil, mascara, and eye liner. My eye shadow was still all there! I was very impressed. So before washing my face, I actually used a makeup remover wipe to get all the eye makeup off. So needless to say, I am a FAN!

title: Pleasant Scent
text: This men's face wash has a pleasant scent. It reminds me of a men's cologne. It's manly, but not overpowering. The cleanser lathers well. It moisturizes and doesn't dry out the skin. My husband and my college age son are both using it and they both like it.

title: Holds A Lot!
text: This small bag is designed to hold make up brushes. I found that it holds a lot! The round shape doesn't flatten the bristles, which I appreciated. The whole thing has a magnetic closure. The main compartment has a zipper closure. There's also a small, clear vinyl pocket that also has a zipper. All zippers zip well. The Rainforest Canopy print is cheery and reminds me of Florida. The overall quality of this bag is what I would expect from Vera Bradley.

title: Foams Nicely
text: This Indeed cleansing cream foams nicely. It's silky feeling against my face. It rinses easily. It doesn't irritate my eyes nor does it dry out my skin. My only complaint is that I don't like the smell of it. It's not a foul scent, it's just not something I like. Scents very important to me. I either want it to not smell like anything or smell amazing. I realize that scent is subjective and what I like may not appeal to others and vice versa.

title: Tons!
text: There are tons of hair scrunchies in this set! It should be easy to match one to your outfit! Some are velvety and others are satin. The quality is okay. Some of the stitching is white and a bit noticeable against the colored fabric. You're paying for quantity not quality. They're not bad, just not high end. I do like having options and with this many scrunchies, you have options!

title: Wonderful Bar of Soap!
text: This is a wonderful bar of soap! It has a very light, sweet smell. I personally can't detect the coconut scent to it - it's that light. But it does smell very good. It lathers up well. It rinses cleanly. I've been enjoying this new bar of soap a lot! My husband likes pretty basic soaps. He will complain if the scent is too perfume-y or strong. He hasn't complained about this soap at all.

title: Colorful Set
text: This is a colorful set of tools for the treatment and care of blackheads and pimples. The quality of the tools is quite good. They come in a nice carrying pouch.

title: Mineral Sunscreen
text: My son used this sunscreen yesterday at the pool. I helped him apply it on his back. It sprays out a creamy white sunscreen, not a clear, thin one like many. You do need to rub it in. The directions say to allow it 15 minutes to absorb before exposure to the sun. It doesn't have the typical sunscreen smell. I personally thought it was fairly neutral, but my son said that he didn't care for the scent that lingered. Scent can be a very personal and subjective thing. My son did not get any sunburn during his swim.

title: Blendable
text: I have hooded eyes. I recently discovered that I could create a smokey eye using eye shadow sticks pretty easily. These shadow sticks have a nice glimmer to them. They glide easily. I was able to blend them nicely with a brush. The shadow sticks are pretty good, especially for the price. I'm just not a fan of the colors. The colors are a little more gold and orange than I would like. It's very hard to get the right colors when ordering online.

title: Large Size Tube
text: This tube of lip balm is pretty large, especially when compared to similar products. It squeezes out easily. It's not sticky or tacky. The consistency and texture is similar to Vaseline. It doesn't have any taste or scent to it. I find that it's not particularly long lasting and needs to be reapplied more frequently than some lip balms.

title: Comfortable
text: I let my hair grow during quarantine. It's the longest it's been in years. It's been a long time since it's been long enough to wear up! These hair ties are comfortable to wear. I have really thick hair, though, I can't get these to go more than twice around my pony tail. My pony tail ends up being a little looser than I would like. It's fine for around the house. The bands are cute. Although they do have the name of the company on them, you can't really see them when they're in place.

title: Nice Scent!
text: This men's shower gel has a nice scent. It's a manly floral scent that smells invigorating. The scent lingers for a while so I would notice whiffs of it throughout the day after just testing it out on my hands. The gel lathers well, too. My son has been using this and likes the way it smells. The bottle was a little disappointing, but the product is great!

title: Nice Gift Set
text: This gift set comes with hand soap, hand lotion, and a soap refill. The bottles have pump dispensers. The products are nicely scented with a floral type scent. The hand soap lathers adequately and rinses cleanly. The lotion absorbs well and doesn't leave my hands feeling sticky. This is a nice gift set and would make a great gift.

title: Pink Body Mask
text: I have used Kopari products before, but this is my first foray into body masks. It's a light, whipped consistency that feels cooling when applied. It has a light almost fruity scent to it. I've only used it on my upper chest area so far. That way I can sit somewhere for the 10 minutes. If I applied it everywhere, I would have to stand for that time. It doesn't harden when it dries. It does rinse pretty easily with some assistance from a wash cloth or hand. I am not sure if I've seen any improvement yet, but I'm looking for improved texture in that area. Overall, I like it.

title: Light Floral Scent
text: I didn't wear perfume for years when my kids were little. Then a few years ago, I started wearing it again. This one has a light floral scent. It's slightly sweet. It's not too floral which I am glad. It's not overpowering. The bottle is attractive and easy to spray. The perfume doesn't fade too quickly, but by the end of the day it's hard to tell if it's still there at all. Overall, I am enjoying this new fragrance.

title: Gentle
text: I have been using this hyaluronic acid serum in the evenings. It's gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It's slightly oily to the touch, but that disappears pretty quickly. I don't notice any smell or scent to it. I haven't experienced any noticeable tightening or improvement of wrinkles, but I regularly use anti-aging products and I believe that it's just continuing the results that I have already achieved.

title: Smells Just Like the Bum Bum Cream!
text: I am a fan of Sol de Janeiro's Bum Bum cream. I have several of their products because I like it so much. I was very excited to give the Reo Deo a try. It smells just like the Bum Bum cream! It glides on easily. It's a deodorant not an antiperspirant, so when we were helping friends move over the weekend, I chose to wear something else instead so I would not feel wet. On the days I am wearing it, I haven't noticed any excessive wetness. I do like that it's aluminum free! I am very pleased with it.

title: Gentle
text: This is a gentle, non-irritating face cream. I personally don't have any problems with Retinol, but it's great that there's natural alternatives for those who do. This face cream is a light purple color. It has a pleasant, sweet smell. It kind of smells like grape, but that could just be a trick my mind is playing on me because of the purple color. It is a little slower to absorb than most creams that I use, but it does absorb in a decent amount of time. My daughter is a big fan of this brand so I was excited to give it a try. I haven't noticed any difference in the firmness of my skin, but since I'm a regular user of such products, I don't think I would notice anything unless it was major.

title: Fun Blue Color!
text: My 20 year old daughter loves I DEW CARE products. She was excited to try their clay mask. In a time when sheet masks are plentiful, my daughter prefers this type of mask. The mask is a fun blue color. It has a slight exfoliating texture. It doesn't irritate or annoy her skin. She feels neutral about the scent of it, but likes how it feels when it dries. It rinses pretty easily without harsh scrubbing. She likes this face mask.

title: More of an Oil than a Serum
text: This Clearing Healthy Complexion Booster Serum is more of an oil than a serum in my opinion. The first time I used it, I put it on right after cleansing and toning. I applied my hyaluronic acid serum afterwards. I switched the order after that. My research says you can apply multiple products, but you start with the lightest first and since this is an oil consistency, it is heavier than my serum. I follow it with my moisturizer. I haven't noticed much difference in the texture of my skin, but it does leave my skin feeling soft. Another thing, it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin which is important to me. It smells nice, but I can't identify the scent.

title: Works Great!
text: I love Laura Geller make up! I use several of the products regularly. This is my first time using the eye shadow primer. After a few days I can say that I love the primer, but not the applicator so much. It uses a brush with a twist technique. As your twist, the product dispenses into the brush bristles. I used to have nail polish pens that worked this way. I just find that it's difficult to get the right amount of product and it seems that you end up wasting some. The color is spot on! When it's on and before any eye shadow is on, it looks just like I'm not wearing anything on my eye lids. It is a creamy type consistency. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes either. It does keep eye shadow in place for a good portion of the day.

title: Hydrates Nicely
text: I am in my early 50's. I use serums daily as part of my skincare routine. This one is a slightly thick serum that is a little difficult to dispense with the dropper. I have to refill the dropper at least 2 times to get enough (small amount) to cover my face and neck area. I think it's the thickness that's clingy to the dropper tube and not dispensing easily. The serum has a light scent that I'm unable to identify. Slightly sweet, but slightly floral and fruity. Regardless, it is a pleasant smell. It hydrates nicely. It's not sticky or tacky at all. I don't feel the urge to immediately wash my hands like I do with some serums. Overall, I like it.

title: Softens Hair
text: I use a hair mask once or twice a week. My hair is thick and coarse. One packet was more than enough to cover my hair. I was surprised by the scent of it. I expected something totally different since it's called Nature Nut. Instead, it has a very strong floral scent to it. I love great scents and if given a choice between scented and unscented, I usually for the scented one. However, this is a bit overpowering. The product does a nice job of softening my hair and for that reason, I will keep using it for the time being.

title: Affordable
text: I have been using this neck cream for the last several days. The delicate skin on my neck and decolletage areas is an area I have been working on. I deal primarily with loose skin on the neck and a crepe appearance on the decolletage. This is affordable when compared to other similar products. The cream is a thick consistency. It doesn't take very much to cover all the needed skin. It has a light, lemony scent to it. It absorbs in a decent amount of time. I'm not noticing any improvement yet, but at the same time, the skin in those areas aren't looking worse either.

title: Quick Absorbing
text: I'm in my early 50's and I have gotten pretty serious about my skincare in the last few years. I am a fan of Hyaluronic Acid products. This moisturizer is a thin consistency. I have been using it morning and nighttime after cleanser, toner, and serum. It is pretty quick absorbing as long as I don't use too much product. One to two pumps is all I need. I usually follow with a thicker cream that targets different needs. I know it says that this has a scent to it, but I can't really notice any. My skin can be very sensitive and I have not had any negative reactions with this.

title: Lightly Scented
text: I have used Hask products before and have liked them. The body wash lathers nicely and moisturizes well. It has a light, powdery scent that is pleasant. It has a pump dispenser that works well. I would be interesting in trying out some of their other scents.

title: Cute!
text: This Vera Bradley cosmetic case is quite cute. The top section is for brushes and the lower section for everything else. The bag is well made and durable. I was surprised to see that the section for the makeup was not laminated or water resistant. Instead, it's the same fabric the rest of the bag is made from. My make up bags tend to get dirty. The material is washable, it just would be easier if you could just wipe it clean.

title: Science Lab!
text: This Wellage Real HA Bio Lift Serum Kit is almost like having your own science lab at home! I followed the directions and used it on clean/toned skin. I didn't notice much of any smell to it. It's a slightly thick consistency after mixing it together. It does feel tacky and sticky at first, but once it dries, that goes away. There's enough serum in each use to cover my face and neck area. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me. My only issue with this product is that it doesn't mention the frequency of use. I used it for 3 consecutive days but is it something you should use once a week? or even less frequent? I don't know. If you're using it daily, then it's way out of my budget to keep using it. I would need some clarification before continuing to use it after I have used all of what I have.

title: Budget Friendly
text: I am always looking for budget friendly skincare tools and the True Glow Silicone Cleansing Brush is definitely affordable. I have a Foreo Luna Fofo, so any comparisons that I make will be with that. One thing I like about this one is the shape of it. It's actually comfortable to hold whereas I find the Fofo to be awkard to hold. This one requires batteries. You have to twist it to get to the battery compartment. In doing so, the silicone layer came off the edges. (Kind of like bed sheets coming off the corners). It was a little tricky to get the silicone back in place. Then I had to get the lid back on and that was difficult, too. Hopefully the batteries last a really long time so I don't have to do that again! The True Glow doesn't seem to have any timer like the Fofo. It did seem like you could change the speed. Another thing, this one has 3 different types of surfaces - one in each corner. However, they're not labeled, so once I was in the shower, I couldn't remember which one did what. The Fofo only has one type of surface. They both do a good job of cleaning my skin. I would really like to see this use a different type of power source such as a charging cable. I think that would simplify things and make it easier.

title: Tons of Hair Ties!
text: There are tons of hair ties in this bundle, so my daughter and I should be set for a while. They are decent hair ties. I have really thick hair and I can get it to go around my ponytail only 2 times and then it's not as tight as I would like it. My daughter can get it to go around 3 times with her thinner (average) hair thickness. We have been using them for a few days now and haven't had any breaking.

title: Perfect for the Shower!
text: These are good mesh bath sponges. They are perfect for the shower. They help exfoliate your skin. These are comparable to other mesh bath sponges, though the colors are darker than ones I've used before. Usually the ones I see are pastel colored. It's nice to see something different.

title: Interesting
text: Let me begin by saying that I follow a multi-step daily skincare regiment. I enjoy trying new products and if it's something I love, I will often add it to my routine. With that being said, I don't usually notice differences in the condition of my skin. It's is a radical difference, I will notice, but most of the time, I say it's just continuation of what I have been doing or seeing. So basically, I didn't see anything new with this. However, I did find it an interesting product. It requires mixing some liquid with a capsule that dissolves. It has a slight medicinal scent to it which I found to be neither good or bad. There's enough of the combined product to completely cover my skin and neck. It's slightly tacky at first, but it's not sticky and the tackiness disappears quickly. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate or annoy me. The instructions weren't very clear. I used it in consecutive days until it was gone. It's very possible it is meant to be used once a week. Using daily, it's out of my price range at $33 for 7 applications. I definitely don't love it, but I do like it. My skin did seem to drink it up and feel soft after using it.

title: Long Lasting
text: This perfume has a lovely sweet floral scent to it. I tend to avoid floral scents, but this one is almost fruity smelling. It's very pleasant and not overpowering. It's long lasting. I find myself sniffing my wrists throughout the day. The bottle is huge and has a modern look to it. I am pleased to have found a new scent.

title: Moisturizing
text: This body lotion is moisturizing and quick absorbing. As soon as I start rubbing it in to my skin, it's dry. It's not greasy or sticky. There's no scent to it to conflict with my perfume. The bottle is kind of on the small size and I find that I have to shake it down a few times to get the lotion to come out.

title: Quenches My Mature Skin
text: This Drench & Quench Rich Water Cream really quenches my mature skin! It's light and goes on easily. My skin just drinks it up! It isn't heavy or greasy. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't bother or irritate me. It has not noticeable scent. I love it!

title: Nice Color
text: I first learned about bellapierre cosmetics through Ipsy. I was excited to try their blush. It comes in a nice, large compact. I found it to be a bit tricky to open. When I press the button, the mirror part opens out. The only way I can access the blush is by using my fingernail on the rim of it to open it. I tried and tried otherwise and was not successful. So I'm knocking off one star for the difficult compact. The blush, however, is very nice. It doesn't go on too heavy. It's easy to build up. It is a nice, natural peachy color. It really does give a healthy glow! It didn't irritate or annoy me. I like the blush, but not the compact!

title: Holds A Lot
text: This nail polish organizer holds a lot! I was able to get all of my bottles of polish and most of my tools in it. My UV light is a regular one, so it doesn't fit. I like having all of my stuff in one place. I was using a basket, but this is better because it keeps the bottles of polish separated.

title: Great Applicator Brush
text: This is a pretty and bright pink color of nail polish. One coat is vibrant, but a second coat is needed for full coverage. The color lasts several days without chipping. The applicator brush is awesome! It's flat so it goes on smoothly and covers more surface area in each brush motion. The polish comes off easily with regular nail polish remover!

title: Quality Brush
text: I've used Conair round brushes for years!! The bristles on my old one have started to flatten, so I was needing a new one. I've included a picture of the old and new one side by side. The only feature that I like better on the old one (left) is the handle. It had some squishy gel type covering which is very comfortable to grip. The bristles on the new one are a little firmer. They don't hurt when using. I have found that they seem to do a better job with blowouts than the old one. The size seems to be the same on both.

title: Nice Pale Color
text: This nail polish has a nice pale color. One coat gives it just a tad more color than natural polish. Two coats is a little more opaque. I'm really impressed with how easy removal is! It is literally as quick as described. I used regular acetone polish remover and it didn't take multiple attempts either. After 4 days, I didn't see any chips. After that I forgot to pay attention to when the chips started showing up. I'm pretty hard on my nails, so I was pretty satisfied with at least 4 days. The brush is a good, flat one that seems to be better at applying than rounded ones. Overall, I am very pleased with this nail color!

title: Quality Bag
text: This medium cosmetic bag by Vera Bradley is the perfect size for my skin care items when I travel. The main compartment has PVC lining so it will wipe up easily. There's also a non-lined pocket on the outside of the bag. The zippers glide smoothly. It's a quality bag that looks beautiful!

title: Clear Vinyl Lining!
text: This mini cosmetic bag by Vera Bradley is perfect for touch ups. It can easily hold eyeliner, mascara, lipstick, and a small compact. The inside has a waterproof lining that is clear so it doesn't cover the pretty print fabric. There's a side pocket that isn't lined so that would be best for tools such as tweezers, nail clippers, or hair bands. The zippers all function well. The Rain Forest Canopy fabric is perfect for summertime!

title: Love Love Love
text: Where has this toner been all my life? I absolutely love it! It has quickly become my favorite toner. It smells amazing. It kind of reminds me of Fruit Loops! It's a thicker consistency than some toners. It feels slightly cooling and very soothing when applied. It doesn't irritate my skin. My skin feels so clean and healthy after using it. The only thing I don't love about it is that the bottle is rigid. I tend to want to squeeze a bit, but I can't. Overall, this toner is a winner and I will be ordering again!

title: Pretty Colors!
text: I love spiral hair ties! These are pretty colors. They stretch easily to accommodate my thick hair, but the shrink back up when you take them out. They are gentle on my hair and don't cause any gnarls or tangles.

title: Gentle!
text: This vitamin c scrub is the first product I have used by Elizabeth Mott Skincare. The lemon packaging is very appealing. Though it did lead me to think that the scrub would smell lemony, but I didn't detect any citrus scent to it. It smelled a bit more flowery to me. It's a nice scent, just not what I expected. The scrub has a very fine grit to it. It's not one of those scrubs that hardly has any grit in it. It reminds me of a sandy scrub. It's gentle and not abrasive. When you put it in your hands and rub it together, it gets warm. I was surprised by that. Then when I went back and read the product description, it mentions that. I found it to be a bit fun. Overall, I am pleased with this scrub.

title: Not a Fan
text: I will start with the positives. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It rinses well. I like the dispenser which involves twisting the cap and then squeezing. Though it does take a few trial and errors to get the correct amount dispensed. Now the things I didn't like. It does not foam at all. I personally like some foaming action. The smell - it reminds me of some art supply from my childhood. I don't care for the scent at all. The scent is important to me. It needs to have no scent or something pleasant. This was neither. I realize scent is a personal thing and what smells good to me may not smell good to someone else.

title: Multiple Coats Needed
text: This is almost, but not quite white nail polish. It's very close though. It does take multiple coats to get good coverage. I did start noticing chips on day 3. While that's not terrible, it's not great either. I do like it enough that I will try again!

title: Great Assortment of Colors and Styles
text: This is a great assortment of colors and styles. There are hair ties, head bands and scrunchies. The material is soft and pretty. The quality seems to be good. I have shared them with my daughter.

title: Not For Me
text: These bands are not as thick as others that I have gotten. They're actually quite thin and similar to a regular hair band in appearance except for the coils. I have thick, coarse hair that goes just past my shoulders. After trying these out, I have decided that these bands are not for me. They stretch well, but to hold my hair up, I have to go 3 times around my ponytail and that's still not enough to hold my hair securely. I'm afraid to go around a 4th time out of fear that it will break. They go back to their original shape quickly. I'm going to give these to my daughter. Her hair isn't as thick as mine. She also wears pig tails sometimes and they might work better with that style.

title: Thick & Creamy
text: At my age (50's), skincare is pretty important. I wish I had started earlier, but I have shared this insight with my 20 year old daughter. This is a thick & creamy product. It's a little heavier than what I use for daytime, so I have been using it as part of my nighttime routine. It has a light scent to it, but it's barely noticeable. The cream absorbs well and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I'm not a fan of the shape of the jar. The mouth of the jar is much smaller than the body. That means as the product gets consumed, it will be more difficult to access the remaining product. Most face creams have wider openings. Other than that, I am satisfied with this skin cream.

title: Effective!
text: I don't always wear makeup, but on the days I do, I always use a makeup remover wipe before washing my face. They seem to do a better job of removing the eye makeup especially. These pads are very effective! They are thicker than I expected. Soft, too. They don't really smell like anything. They don't irritate my sensitive eyes. It's a win!

title: Lightly Scented
text: This shampoo has a lightly scented coconut smell to it. It's not strong and is more like coconut milk than actual coconut in my opinion. It has a pump dispenser that works well. One pump is enough per application on my thick, coarse, shoulder length hair. It produces a minimal amount of lather. It rinses well. I haven't noticed my hair feeling super soft after it dries, but it is smooth and slightly soft. I wish I had the matching conditioner to use with this.

title: Refreshing!
text: This eye cream is very refreshing! It has a cooling sensation when applied. I use this after applying an eye serum. It absorbs well. It doesn't sting or burn my eyes. Some products cause my super sensitive eyes to burn or sting just from being in close proximity. No issues with this one. There's no smell or scent to it. I'm liking it a lot!

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I am in my early 50's. I started using neck firming creams in the last couple of years. This is my first time trying any product from Kleem. The first thing I noticed about this was the amazing smell! It is a light, citrus smell that is uplifting. The cream has a lotion consistency. It absorbs well. The dispenser works nicely. One pump is usually enough to put a thin layer on my neck and decollete. It does moisturize my delicate skin. I haven't noticed any difference in the skin area there, but I attribute that to the fact that I regularly use neck firming creams already so hopefully that means it's continuing with the positive effects.

title: Gentle
text: This eye elixir cooling treatment has a neat metal applicator that feels cool to the touch. When dispensing the eye cream, the applicator feels pleasant and refreshing. The cream doesn't irritate my eyes. I don't notice any smell to it. I am a regular user of eye creams and serums, so I haven't noticed any new or different results around the eye area.

title: You Only Need a Little!
text: The first time I used this, I mistakenly dispensed about the size of a quarter. That's way too much. It foams up nicely and the application was just too heavy. It also got into my eyes and stung. I did give it another try and used only a dime's worth. That was much better! It didn't get into my eyes. It still foamed up nicely. It has an almost buttery feel to it when using. I haven't really noticed any scent to it. It doesn't over dry or irritate my skin. I haven't had any more problems with it stinging my eyes. I truly believe it was because I had too much at once. Overall, I am pleased.

title: Good Assortment
text: I have thick coarse hair that goes just past my shoulders. For exercising and hanging out at home, I like to pull it up into a messy bun or pony tail. These are perfect. There are some spiral elastics in the set. They stretch adequately to accommodate all of my hair. I can easily double loop them. When they come off, they slowly reshape back to their original size and shape. There are also some soft covered elastic bands too. I like the assortment of colors.

title: Works Great!
text: I don't usually do a whole lot to my eyebrows, but they do need the occasional taming. When I spot a stray brow hair that won't cooperate, I like to use a clear brow gel such as this. I really like this one. It doesn't flake or leave any white bits. It really goes on clear. It also doesn't leave your brows feeling crunchy or sticky. I do think it's a little pricey, but it works great!

title: Great Value!
text: I discovered Hyaluronic acid a few years ago. It's been a regular part of my nighttime skincare routine ever since. This one is gentle on my sensitive skin and does not irritate me at all. The serum is fast absorbing. I use it after cleansing and toning but before moisturizing. I don't really notice much scent. It is really a great value when compared to other similar serums.

title: Quick Absorption
text: This is serum is a thin consistency. It has quick absorption which is important to me when I'm waiting in between applications of products to apply the next one. I don't notice any scent to it. It isn't irritating to my sensitive skin. It doesn't leave behind any stickiness. It seems to be hydrating.

title: Super Soft!
text: I don't wear make up every day, but on the days I do wear it, I like using a make up remover wipe before cleansing my face. These wipes are super soft. They are also surprisingly strong and durable. I don't notice much of a scent to them. I have sensitive skin and they are non-irritating. These wipes are black which makes it difficult to see how much mascara and eye make up it has removed. I usually go over my lashes (especially) multiple times to until I don't see any more product coming off. You can't do that with these because you can't see anything on the black wipe. Other than that, I am very pleased with these.

title: Works Well
text: My husband and 23 year old son have been using this deodorant for a few days. They both like the scent of it and say that it's not too strong. It keeps them dry and prevents them from bad B.O. My son said he would buy it again. My husband leaves it to me to purchase such items for him but he said he would willingly use it.

title: Hydrates Well
text: I am in my early 50's. My multi-step skincare regiment calls for Hyaluronic acid to be applied at nighttime. I apply it after cleansing and toning. After it has absorbs, I use moisturizer, followed by Retional. This serum absorbs nicely. It hydrates well. It's not sticky or tacky. I have sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate me. I like it!

title: Great Color
text: I'm in my early fifties. I've never done more than pluck a random stray hair when it comes to my brows. I've never waxed or shaped them at all. I'm kind of afraid of it! My aunt did so much to her brows that she hardly has anything left and all you see is whatever she's drawn on!  However, I have noticed that my brows are thinning a little bit as I get older. It's especially noticeable on the outer ends. So recently, I've started using an eyebrow pencil to make them a little fuller. This brow pencil is decent. It's a great brown color which is very natural looking on me. After a few pencil marks, I use a spoolie tool to blend it a bit. Overall, I am pretty pleased with the results. It seems to last all day and removes easily at night.

title: Fun Colors!
text: These gel nail polishes come in fun, spring colors. The quality of the polish is good and comparable to other gel polishes I have used. I'm fairly new to the self-manicure things, but I'm having success with these. This is my 2nd set of polishes from the same brand. These are lasting a little longer than the first ones (same brand) that I used because I did a better job of prepping my nails before applying the polish. I'm still learning! Overall, I am satisfied with these polishes.

title: Keeps You Dry!
text: My husband and adult son have been using this Axe Antiperspirant for over the past week. They both like the smell. It's a masculine scent that is on par with the Axe line. It does a good job of keeping them dry. My son has noticed it the most because he's outside more walking on campus. Both of my guys would be happy continuing to use this.

title: Creates a Nice Base
text: This is a wonderful primer! It creates a nice base before applying mascara. It has a pinkish tint so it's easy to see where you have applied it. It's also easier to see if you need to separate your lashes any. I like the unique applicator that tilts for easy application. I am a fan!

title: Pretty Color
text: My daughter is a fan of the Sally Hansen Insta-Dri nail polish line. It's fast and easy to apply. This moonstone color is a pretty, sparkly color. She was hoping for something with more of a white base as this is more of a milky clear base. Regardless of that, she does like the color. It is comparable to the other Insta-Dri polishes that she has. This will be fun for summer!

title: Works Wonderfully!
text: I am really happy with this deodorant. It works wonderfully! It smells very nice. I usually shower about 4 days a week. So on those off days, I usually still apply deodorant, but it might not be until the middle of the day. (I have the luxury of being able to stay at home full time). On those days, I have not had any issues with odor or wetness. There are 4 sticks of deodorant in this set. My daughter and I are both using it and are both pleased with its performance.

title: Light Citrus Scent
text: I am a fan of Sonage skincare products and use several of them. This is my first time using any cleanser by them. It's got a pump dispenser that works well. One pump is enough product to clean my face. Two pumps is way too much. The cleanser has a thick, creamy consistency. It doesn't lather much, but it does foam a little. It takes a little more rinsing to fully remove it. It has a nice, light citrus scent. It doesn't irritate my skin or eyes.

title: Nice Thick Headbands
text: These are nice, thick headbands. They fit my head fine. They have a good stretch to them. I like the assortment of colors. Overall, I like these.

title: Gorgeous Colors!
text: These gel nail polish colors are gorgeous! I like the assortment a lot. The polish seems to be comparable to other gel polishes that I have used. I do like that the color is identified on the bottle. I have one set where there was absolutely nothing other than a number to identify the colors. I have a heavy hand so I think I may have applied too thick of coats. I did let my nails cure for over a minute per coat. I didn't have any chipping for the first 3 days, but then after that, one of my nails lost about half of the polish. I am a bit rough with my hands, so I accept partial responsibility. I was actually surprised that I was able to get 3 days before any chips! Overall, I am satisfied with this polish.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: My 23 year old son was very happy to give this deodorant a try. He's a big guy and often worries about offensive body odor. This has a pleasant scent of woodsy and fruity. It does a great job of keeping you dry and odor free for the day. My son showers daily and didn't want to try skipping it so he could test the 48 hours. He did however wake up late on day #2 and delayed his shower a bit. I think it was close to 34 hours and he didn't smell foul or feel too gross. He doesn't appreciate that this doesn't have aluminum, but I told him that he should. My husband is trying it out, too, but he hasn't had much to say other than it seems to be working.

title: Expired Product
text: Aveeno is a brand that I trust. I used this gel moisturizer for the first time without reading the jar. It was nighttime and I was hurrying up so I could go to bed. I did notice that there was no safety seal on it which I thought was odd. It wasn't in a box either. I liked the smell - it has a fresh, clean scent to it. It absorbed nicely. It's hydrating. I really liked it. Then the next day when I was not so tired, I read the jar to make sure that I was using it correctly. I found it alarming that it was already expired. Plus, there's wording on it that it's for sales demonstrations only and not for sale or resale. It's very upsetting to learn that expired products are being sent out.

title: Nice Assortment
text: During the pandemic, I let my hair grow out. I had minimal hair cuts, so my hair is the longest it's been in years. It's a couple of inches past my shoulders. I like to put it up sometimes so I've started using scrunchies. These are nice, soft ones. My hair is pretty thick and these stay in place well and hold my hair up as styled. I like the assortment of colors.

title: Easy to Use
text: This UV light nail dryer is easy to use. There are buttons on the top which you can use to determine the amount of time the dryer is on ranging from 30 seconds to 90 seconds. It automatically turns off when it's done. I had no problems setting it up and using it, right out of the box. The size is good. I can even fit both hands in at the same time if I position one hand over the other. I am happy to have found this dryer!

title: Versatile
text: I like that these hair scrunches are versatile. If you stretch them enough they can be worn as a headband. I found that my head was a little too large to wear it in that way, but a child or teen would not have any difficulties. The inside of the scrunchy seems to have one of those stretchy plastic coil hair bands. The outside is a soft velvet material. I usually use them for putting my hair up in a messy bun for around the house. I have thick hair that's past my shoulders and I can get this to go around 3 times.

title: Great Fruity Scent!
text: My son has naturally curly hair, so I try to buy him hair products designed for his specific hair type. This set of products by Herbal Essence smells great! He likes the fruity scent. The shampoo lathers well. The conditioner is a good consistency, not too runny, not too thick. The cream is just okay. My son doesn't shampoo his hair daily, but at the advice of his hair stylist, he gets it wet and conditions it every day. His hair is pretty long and thick so he goes through conditioner a lot faster than shampoo. I like that this is an affordable option so I don't mind buying him more conditioner as needed. He has tried the cream but didn't like the way it worked in his hair.

title: Effective
text: This spiral brow and eye brush is basically a long mascara wand. It is effective at combing your eyebrows and eyelashes, like a mascara wand would do without getting mascara on you. The description says it is a 3 count, but I only received one. I wasn't expecting more than one, but did want to note that I only got the one.

title: Gentle
text: I have sensitive eyes. Many eye creams cause irritation but this one is gentle and does not irritate my eyes at all. I am a regular user of eye creams and anti-aging products. I'm not seeing any new results, but because I am a regular user of such products, I don't expect to see anything different. Consider it a continuation of the results that I have been having for the past few years. I don't notice much of a smell to this. It is a thicker lotion type consistency. And as I said, it doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes!

title: Burns
text: I am in my early 50's and regularly use anti-aging products. I don't often use acid peels, but I do exfoliate a few times per week. My skin can be sensitive to some products, but I have not figured out what specific ingredients trigger a reaction. Immediately upon wiping this product on my face, it started to painfully burn. I had to start rinsing it off right away. None of the other acid peels that I have used before have burned like this. It hurt! The burning sensation did subside after a few minutes. I was afraid to continue with my usual skincare routine and opted to just apply a mild moisturizer and call it a day.  I was surprised that there was no safety seal on the jar. That seems like a pretty standard thing these days.

title: Runny Consistency
text: This face serum has a runny consistency. It's thicker than a liquid, but definitely a thin serum. It has a light pleasant smell to it. The dispenser works well. I find that 2 pumps is a good amount to cover my face and neck. It absorbs well. It doesn't leave behind any stickiness or tackiness. I've been using this before my moisturizer which is a thicker cream product. I do have sensitive skin and this doesn't bother me at all!

title: Non-Irritating
text:
See Update below: I have very sensitive eyes so the first thing I look for when trying eye serums or creams is does it irritate my eyes? I am pleased to say that this does not irritate them. It's a thick consistency for a serum (as opposed to runny). It absorbs well. I haven't noticed much difference from this serum over others, but I use all sorts of anti-aging products on a regular basis and I'm not very observant. Plus, my close up vision is horrible, that I would have to have my glasses on and have a magnifying mirror to notice anything. The only complaint that I have with this product, is that it's very difficult to dispense. I'm actually wondering if the tip is actually clogged. I plan to get a needle and poke it in to see if that helps. I can barely get any serum out and that's with squeezing pretty hard. I actually worry that I'm going to accidently dispense too much! Other than that, this seems to be a good product.

Update: So I have been using this regularly for nearly a month now. I am seeing improvement!! Prior to using this, I had noticed that I had loose skin underneath my eye. I could literally push it around and it would stay. It kind of freaked me out because I am so good about my anti-aging skincare routine and pride myself in younger looking skin. Well this morning I noticed a major increase in the firmness of the skin there. And I don't have the loose skin that can move around! It's not completely tight like you would find on a younger person, but it's significantly improved. And since I'm not usually very observant, this is MAJOR!!! I have increased my rating from 4 stars to 5. The tube does seem to clog up easily, but the results make it worth the trouble! I am definitely ordering more of this!

title: Thick Consistency
text: This is a thick, cream consistency. It's heavier than a lot of eye creams that I use, so I've been using it primarily for nighttime. It doesn't absorb quickly. I have very sensitive eyes and this doesn't bother me at all. It has a pleasant citrus scent. I have been applying it underneath my eyes as well as above to the brow area. Overall, I am pleased.

title: Cleanses Nicely
text: I use toner after washing my face in the morning and evening. This one cleanses nicely. It's a little thicker consistency than some other toners out there. It's cooling and smells lovely. It doesn't irritate my skin nor does it leave me feeling sticky or oily. The only complaint that I have about it is the bottle. It's very stiff and rigid which prevents you from gently squeezing it. So instead, in order to dispense it, you have to shake it or just let it drip. Both of those options are slower and when time is of the essence, every second counts! Other than that, I really like this toner a lot.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I am in my early 50's. For the last few years, I have been following a multi-step skincare routine that I found on a beauty site. I have it taped to my mirror, but I know my routine pretty well by now. The evening routine calls for Retinol so I've been using Retinol products regularly for a while now. This light cream has an easy to use pump dispenser. I've been using just one pump per evening. It has a very light, pleasant smell to it. It absorbs well. It leaves a luminous look to my face. I didn't see that as one of the descriptions for it, so it may just be a coincidence. It's non-irritating. It doesn't leave any stickiness or greasiness feeling behind. It's a lot easier to use than the little pearls that I have to break open, so I like this a lot!

title: Great Lather!
text: This shampoo smells really nice. I detected light floral notes, but not girly or perfumey. The shampoo is a clear slightly runny consistency. It has a great lather. I didn't notice any change in volume after using it, but it did leave my hair feeling soft and manageable. The bottle looks great and the pump dispenses well.

title: Cute Tweezers!
text: My 19 year old daughter loves the I Dew Care line of products. She was delighted to get these tweezers. For tweezers, they're really cute. They're a bright neon color and they have a smiley face on them. They grip well. They do a good job of tweezing stray eyebrow hairs. They have a good feel to them.

title: Non-Greasy
text: I am a fan of Sonage skincare products. I was excited to try this vitamin C serum. I'm in my early fifties and I have been following a multi-step skin care regimen for the last few years. Vitamin C serum is one of my regular morning products. This serum smells like oranges! It's not too thin of a serum. It absorbs well. It's non-greasy and doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or sticky. I use it after cleansing and toning, before moisturizing. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I haven't seen any new results since using it, but I wouldn't expect to see anything different since I'm a regular user of anti-aging products.

title: Leaves My Hair Feeling Soft
text: I have thick coarse hair that is just past my shoulders. I haven't  colored it on over a year and a half. I have a few grey strands which aren't very noticeable yet. I like to rotate between 2 to 3 different brands/sets of shampoo/conditioner sets. I have found that by changing it out regularly, my hair does better. When I use the same ones all the time, they seem to not work as well and weigh down my hair. I also like to use the coordinating products, so in order to best review this shampoo, I purchased the conditioner to use with it. The shampoo has a light, fruity & floral scent. It's not overpowering nor does it linger much after. The shampoo is a good consistency. It lathers nicely. It rinses well, too. I shampoo twice and then condition. I also have the luxury of working at home, so I can let my hair air dry for a while before styling. This hair duo leaves my hair feeling very soft. I can run my fingers through it without snagging or getting caught. I don't notice much shine, but  I do love the softness!

title: Caused Redness
text: I was a bit hesitant to use this after reading some of the other reviewers saying that it caused redness. I have sensitive skin and have had issues with other products causing redness in the past. This mask is not one that dries or hardens. It does dry a little bit in the sense that it wasn't as gooey or wet, but it does differ from many masks that fully dry. I don't recall any noticeable scent to it. I applied a thin layer as directed. I did not apply any to my forehead region because I had my wet hair in a towel and the towel kept getting in the way. I set a timer for 10 minutes and waited. I noticed after about 9 minutes that my face was reddening a little, so I went ahead and washed it off with the warm water at that point. The redness was noticeable but it wasn't terrible. I had one product that left my skin looking like a tomato! I just had some splotchy areas, primarily on one cheek. It did not burn or sting, though I felt a bit flushed. After rinsing my face, I went about my day. I did check on it after about 20 minutes and for the most part the redness was gone. My skin was feeling very soft at this point and I felt okay to finish my morning skincare routine. None of the other products that I used had any reactions to anything left behind by the mask.

title: Great Face Cream!
text: I am in my early 50's and I follow a multi-step skincare regimen. I've been using this cream at both the AM and PM times. It's a thick consistency that absorbs quickly. It doesn't leave my face feeling greasy or oily. It has a light pleasant smell. It actually reminds me of my favorite skin cream by Sonage called Botanica Souffle in the way that it smells and works. It's much more affordable than Sonage, so that's a big plus for me! I have sensitive skin and this doesn't bother me at all. I am really liking this skin cream!

title: Lovely Scent
text: This shampoo/conditioner set has a lovely scent. It's a light, floral smell that isn't overpowering or too feminine. The bonus rescue shot has a stronger, fruity smell to it. The shampoo lathers nicely. The conditioner has a very thick consistency. It took a little longer than usual to fully rinse the conditioner out of my hair. After using it, my hair was soft and shiny. It didn't smooth or tame the frizz. My hair is just past my shoulders and is very thick and coarse. It's currently natural with no color. I would consider adding this to my regular shower routine.

title: Small Jar
text: I use face scrubs a couple of times a week. This one has a very light, citrus scent to it. The actual face scrub has minimal grit to it and what it does have is not abrasive. I have a tendency to get sebaceous filaments and a more abrasive scrub helps get rid of them and keeps me from wanting to squeeze them. The jar is very small, plus when you open it and start using it, it seems to be even smaller because the bottom of the jar is raised. The price is very reasonable but if it was more expensive, I would be upset about how little product is actually in the jar. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate or annoy my skin. Overall, it's okay.

title: Great for Travel!
text: These double tipped cotton swabs are excellent! The packaging is great for travel. I personally couldn't any difference between these and the name brand ones. The plastic cases keep them clean and dry. When I travel, I keep these in a mesh zippered pocket inside my toiletry bag. When you remove the sticky label off of them, it doesn't always shut completely, but since they're in the mesh pocket of my bag, the lid is kept closed securely so the swabs are protected. There are 8 individual packs, so I've shared them with my family so they all have some for their travels. The swabs don't flex too much. The cotton doesn't come off too easily during use. I'm serious that I couldn't tell them apart from the name brand ones!

title: Fresh Scent
text: I am in my early 50's and regularly use anti-aging products. I was drawn to this because of the addition of hyaluronic acid which is one of the specific ingredients that I try to use daily. This is thicker than a lotion, but not as thick as a butter. I would call it a thin cream. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It absorbs well and doesn't leave me feeling sticky or greasy. It moisturizes well. It has a light, fresh scent to it which is barely noticeable. I don't think it's a fragrance, but rather the smell of the ingredients. Nonetheless, it smells pleasant. This comes with a sample of the whipped lotion/cream. I didn't like that as much as the larger cream.

title: Just As Good As High End Brow Pencils
text: I'm in my early 50's. I've noticed that my eyebrows are beginning to thin and look sparse. I have never done more than pluck a random brow hair now and then (which means just a couple of times a year at most). I have been using this and I'm very pleased with it! It's easy to use. The pencil tip is fairly fine. I've been making simple strokes to resemble the brow hair. Then I use the other end to brush it a bit to soften the marks. It looks very natural. I was staying with my sister recently and she decided to give this a try. She had recently purchased a $40 brow pencil set a a chain cosmetic store. She really liked it and said it was just as good as the high end brow set she had just purchased.

title: My Favorite Primer
text: This primer by Laura Geller is my favorite primer! It has a light, spicy (like cinnamon) scent to it. It creates a very smooth surface. I don't apply makeup every day, but this leaves a really healthy looking glow behind that it's perfect without makeup. It's not too shiny or sparkly. I'm in my early 50's and it just looks healthy. I love it!

title: Great Texture!
text: I exfoliate the skin on my face twice a week. As an exfoliator, this is great! There are lot of scrubby particles in it. I have used some scrubs that have minimal grit to it, but this has a lot. It's also surprisingly gentle as far as the grit goes. So I really like how it works. I don't care for the scent though. It has a spicy/herbal smell to it. It's not foul, it's just not anything I care for. The way a product smells is really important to me. It can be natural and fragrance free, but if it's something I don't like, I tend to not use it.

title: Pleasant Smell
text: This skin cream is very thick. It's a little heavier than what I use for daytime use, so I have been using it primarily at bedtime. It has a pleasant smell. It's like a light, fruity scent. It absorbs well. I haven't had any irritations with it. Overall, I like it  a lot.

title: Great Size!
text: My daughter likes to straighten her hair on some occasions. She has long somewhat straight hair that has a natural wave to it. This hair tool is easy to use. The width is good and larger than her previous flat iron which allows her to fully straighten her hair in less time.  It works well and she is pleased with the results that she gets from it.

title: Non-Sticky
text: I don't really do much with my eyebrows other than a random pluck when I have a stray hair that won't be tamed. Before plucking, I do try to tame with a gel type product such as this. This one looks white when you apply it and then becomes clear as it dries. The tube is pretty small  so I don't know how long it will last. Luckily I don't have the need to tame my brows that often. This doesn't leave my brows feeling sticky or crunchy. I like having an affordable option for brow gel.

title: Silky Feeling
text: The Laura Geller Spackle Mattify Primer is wonderful! It has no discernible scent or smell to it. It has a slight color to it, but that color doesn't transfer onto the skin. It leaves my skin very silky feeling after applying it. It leaves your skin ready for makeup.  It reminds me of the Pore Fessional by Benefit. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I love it!

title: Smells Nice
text: This exfoliating cleanser is different from any other cleanser that I have used. I have used exfoliating cleansers, but they've been different. This one seems to be a gel like consistency with grains mixed in. The amount of grains is not too many and they do have a good grit to them. The cleanser doesn't foam up when you work it into a lather, but it does produce a slight lather. It has a very nice fruity smell to it. I wasn't sure what to expect since it's a blueberry & coffee bean cleanser. I like both scents separately and was worried that it would be combined, but I only detect the blueberry. I have super sensitive eyes and a lot of cleansers irritate them. I only noticed a teeny tiny reaction with this and since then, I just make sure that I avoid the eye area even more so and that's worked. I also have quasi sensitive skin. I'm not sure what products or ingredients irritate me, but some cause redness. This did not bother me. Overall this has been an effective combo product.

title: Silky!
text: I haven't been worn much eye make up other than eyeliner and mascara for years. However, with the mask wearing these days, I have recently started wearing more eye makeup lately. This eye shadow goes on very silky. It's easy to apply. The shadow blends nicely. I've used a cotton swab for touch ups and a make up brush for blending. The color is beautiful! I have hooded eyes and this shadow is easier than powder shadows when it comes to creating a quasi-smokey eye. It's also pretty long lasting. When I remove my makeup at bedtime, there's quite a bit of eye shadow coming off on to my cloth. I am excited to try other colors!

title: Pleasant Clean Scent
text: This 3 pack of Dove body wash is great to have on hand. I'm a big believer in keeping my body's largest organ (skin) moisturized. I'm in my early 50's and I live in the south. My skin is always dry. This body wash has a thick & creamy consistency. It produces a wonderful lather. The first time I used it, I put 2 pumps of it on my bath pouf. That was almost too much! I had lather everywhere! Since then, I have only used 1 pump and that has been more than enough for my whole body. It has a pleasant, clean scent. It rinses well. It doesn't irritate my skin. And the bottles are large sized! I would definitely order this again.

title: Very Effective
text: This comes with 4 packages of masks. Each package has a pair (left/right) foot or hand masks. There are 2 of each type. I started with one of the foot masks. The directions are easy to follow. Once my feet were masked up in the booties, I put the hand ones one. Allow the booties/gloves to do their magic for 20 minutes. I chose to watch some TV during this time. When the timer went off, I removed the gloves, then booties, rubbing any extra product into my skin. I didn't have any irritation or problems. My hands were noticeably soft and smooth afterwards. I am impressed with how effective this is! I'm glad I have another full set. I will definitely have to buy more of these!

title: Works Well
