text: This eyelash separator works well. The teeth of the comb do a good job of removing clumps of mascara left behind after application. The handle folds down when not in use. The handle is light weight, but sturdy enough for typical use. It's easy to clean.

title: Strong Scent
text: My 23 year old son has very curly hair. We didn't know he had curls until he started to let it grow out in high school. You can see actual corkscrew curls in his hair! He doesn't wash his hair every day per instructions from his hair dresser. But he does shower daily (thankfully!) and on the days he doesn't shampoo, his hair dresser instructed him to use conditioner. So he has been using this on the days when he doesn't  shampoo since the conditioner is the only product in the line that he has. It does have a strong scent. It's a flowery/perfume like smell. When it's rinsed, the scent doesn't linger much.  It rinses well. His curls have been looking nice!

title: Nice Assortment of Brushes
text: I've started wearing eye makeup again. I figure that with the pandemic, I might as well focus on my eyes since they're visible while wearing my face mask! My previous eye shadow brushes were in need of replacing, so these arrived at the perfect time. This is a nice assortment of brushes. They are soft and hold the makeup adequately. I haven't noticed any shedding. I like having the variety of brushes with their specific purposes.

title: Gentle!
text: I have used Farmacy products before and have been pleased with them. These mini sized products have been just as good. The products are gentle and don't irritate my sensitive skin. They smell nice and fresh. The sizes are perfect for travel!

title: Great Hair Tool
text: I discovered the Bed Head Dryer Brush over a year ago and loved it. However, over time, the bristles became bent. This dryer brush is comparable to the Bed Head one. I haven't noticed any difference between them, with the exception that the bristles on this one are still straight. Dryer brushes are game changers for me. I found it difficult to juggle a separate hair brush and dryer to get a decent blow out. This single tool does a great job and it's so much easier to manage! I let my hair air dry for at least an hour most days. It takes me less than 10 minutes to get my hair smooth and dry. My hair is thick and coarse. If I let it air dry all the way, it is wavy and frizzy. I am very pleased with the results from this.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I am a fan of Laura Geller products. I am currently using Laura Geller Spackle, Tinted Moisturizer, eye shadow and eye liner. They're all great products. This Spackle Mist is also wonderful. First of all, it smells amazing! If you don't like the smell of coconut, you're not going to like it. However, if you are a fan, then this is for you! It's also very refreshing. I use it after I put the Spackle (cream form). Then I put my make up on and give it another spritz to set it. I work at home and I've often given additional spritzes during the day to revive. I'm looking forward to trying more Laura Geller products!

title: Smells Nice!
text: The Cuvee' Beauty Blowout smells really nice. You has a fruity champagne smell to it. If you have any doubts that there's really champagne in it, all you have to do is take a whiff! This really helps to tame the frizzies! However, you only need a small amount. If you use too much, then it weighs your hair down and makes it look a bit greasy. I squeeze a small amount into my hands, then rub my hands together. Then I work it into my hair, concentrating on the ends. I let my hair air dry before doing this and apply it when it's about 75% dry. Then after it has been applied, I use a blow dryer brush to finish the job.

title: Must Have Item
text: This brush cleaning set is a must have beauty item. It has a sponge side which is perfect for changing colors in between cleanings. The other side is used to clean your brushes with soap and water or a special brush cleaner. They're easy to use and do a great job!

title: Smells Nice
text: I like the smell of the Cuvee' Beauty conditioner. You can detect the fruity champagne scent. The conditioner has a thick consistency. It does a nice job of detangling my thick, coarse hair. It rinses well. My hair is left soft and manageable. What I don't like about it is the bottle. While it looks cool, the conditioner is nearly impossible to squeeze out one handed. I usually dispense conditioner into my hand before applying it to my hair. I had to use both hands and squeeze it out onto my raised thigh. Other than that, I did like it.

title: Lovely Lavender Scent
text: We have been going through so much hand soap in the last year. This soap has a lovely lavender scent. It's a clear soap with a moderately thick consistency. It produces an adequate amount of lather and rinses well. This came with 3 bottles of soap which should last my family of 4 at least a month or so. I would consider ordering it again.

title: Directions on Box Do Not Match Product Description
text: After a week of using this, I sat down to write my review. I always look through the product description online first to make sure that I wasn't missing any pertinent information. I'm glad I did, because I discovered that the directions on the box did not match what was written in the product description. The box says to "gently spread to the entire face and absorb. Use it by 1-2 pumping actions". I was finding that I when I thought I had rubbed in it, it would start showing up in white patches and I would have to rub it in some more. I thought that was pretty weird. So then after a week of doing that, I learned from the description, you let it set on your face for a few moments. Then it starts to foam up. Talk about weird, you can hear it bubbling and you feel it too. It's almost like a light tickle! Then you rub into your skin. It absorbs fine after that with no white patches popping back up. This is considered an Essence. I've used Essence before, but I did have to refresh my memory on where to add it in my skincare routine. I used it after toning. I did use my usual serum first. Then after the Essence, I followed up with my moisturizer. I really didn't see any difference in the condition of my skin. However, in all fairness, I regularly use anti-aging products and have been for the last five plus years, so I wouldn't expect to see anything new unless it was some drastic change. After I started using the product correctly, I did kind of enjoy using it. It didn't cause any issues with my skin sensitivity which is always a plus!

title: Leaves Hair Manageable
text: I have shoulder length, thick, coarse hair. I haven't colored it in over a year, so it's in its natural state. I have a few strands of grey, but not very noticeable yet. This champagne infused shampoo smells pleasant. I can definitely identify the scent of a dry, fruity champagne. It produces a minimal amount of lather. The second application lathers up more than the first. It rinses cleanly. I let my hair dry natural for the most part. This shampoo leaves my hair manageable, but not as soft as some other shampoos do. I like it but I don't love it.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: After using this a few times, I realized that this is a combination product. I thought it was just a heat protectant and smoothing product, but I learned that it's also a holding spray. That is why the hair on my crown felt weird after it dried. Once I realized that, I started applying it differently. I mainly sprayed it on the ends of my hair instead of all around including the crown. It has a pleasant scent that's not too strong. I usually let my hair mostly air dry, then I use a blow dryer brush to lightly style it. I did notice that my hair retained the smoothness and style for the entire day when using this. I did have problems with the pump at first. After holding the nozzle under warm running water for a few moments, it did start working.

title: Eyelash Curler
text: This is a good eyelash curler. It has a lash comb/separator which is a nice feature. It comes with 2 regular replacement pads. It works as expected.

title: Shower Steamer
text: I'm more of a shower person than a bath person, so I used to feel almost left out because bath bombs. I think they're wonderful, but I rarely use them. So when I started seeing shower steamers, I was eager to jump on board. I have tried several and some are better than others. This one is just average. The scent is supposed to be pink grapefruit, but I couldn't detect any grapefruit scent to it. There was a floral scent. Once the shower was on, I couldn't even smell that scent. It's possible that the scent from my shampoo and other products over powered the scent from this shower steamer. It was a bit crumbly and powdery when opened. It dissolved very quickly, especially when compared to other shower steamers that I have used. There's a gemstone inside which was fun to receive. Overall I found it under whelming.

title: Nice
text: I'm in my early 50's and my near vision is awful. I can't read anything without glasses. Putting on makeup, especially eye make up is nearly impossible without my vanity mirror. I have a similar mirror but it doesn't have a light, so I wanted to give it a try. I assumed that the magnification on my old mirror was x10, but this gets up even closer which can be good, but also bad! All those imperfections are more noticeable! The light works well. The mirror doesn't come with batteries, so you need to locate 4 AA batteries for the light to function. This mirror looks very nice. I really like the rose gold color.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: If you're a coffee lover, then you're going to love this face scrub! It smells amazing. The consistency of it is pretty creamy with coffee grinds in it. It's an exfoliating dream! The first time I  used this I was at the sink and after I rinsed my face, I noticed it was red in areas. I thought maybe this was too abrasive. The redness disappeared quickly and everything was fine. Then I moved it to the shower. When I get out of the shower, my face has had no redness, so if it did cause some reddening, it was short lived. I tend to get some sebaceous filaments around my brow area so I like to exfoliate at least twice a week. And did I mention that this smells amazing??!!??

title: Easy to Use
text: I am loving this eye make up brush. It's very unique. The bristles are a little firmer then a lot of brushes so that makes it more like a pencil so you can draw with it. I've been using both sides to apply brown eye shadow as my eyeliner. I'm pretty novice when it comes to make up, but I found this to be very easy to use.  The "v" side seems a little large, but it does seem to line up well with the outer corners of my eyes. I have hooded eyes and I use the other end to apply dark eye shadow along my upper lash line to make my eyes more pronounced. I find this brush to be pretty accurate and I haven't had to re-do any time that I've used it. I am very happy to have found this tool!

title: Best Cotton Swabs!
text: I am very impressed with these cotton swabs. I didn't even know there were bamboo ones available. I love the idea that they are Eco friendly. My 19 year old daughter is always trying to get me to make small changes for improving the environment. She is thrilled with these! These are much sturdier than the other swabs I've been using. I don't think they were plastic, but cardboard. Also, the cotton ends stay intact and don't come off. 2000 swabs should last quite a while! These are without a doubt the best cotton swabs I have ever used.

title: Absorbs Well
text: First about me - I'm in my early fifties and I am a regular user of anti-aging products. My skin is in pretty good condition. It's not too dry but I do get the occasional zit which I attribute primarily to wearing face masks. I do have sensitivity issues to some skincare products, but I have not been able to pinpoint a particular ingredient. Now on to the serum. It has a fresh, floral scent to it. I personally like it, but if you are sensitive to fragrance, you may want to reconsider. I haven't had any issues with sensitivity. It absorbs well into my skin. I use 2 pumps to cover my entire face and neck area. It is a creamy opaque consistency. I have been using this twice a day after cleansing and toning and before applying my moisturizer.

title: Slow Absorption
text: I am in my early 50's and I follow a regular skincare regimen. I have been using this as part of my morning routine. I cleanse, then tone first. I don't notice any smell or scent to this. It's a thicker consistency than most serums that I use. It has a slow absorption rate, so I usually have to wait a minute or two before continuing with my routine. It doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or tacky. It also doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. After it I apply a moisturizer. I haven't noticed any difference in the appearance of my skin. However, I have been using assorted anti-aging products regularly for the last several years, that I wonder if my skin is as good as it's going to get for the time being and any products that I currently use are just continuing with what has already been done. I could totally be wrong, but it does make sense to me.

title: Sheer
text: I don't wear a lot of make up, especially during the pandemic, but when I do, I always wear a setting powder. This one has the cutest packaging! It is sheer and translucent. It doesn't settle into lines or appear caked on. It's a light coverage and a little goes a long way.

title: Cooling
text: I am terrible about reading directions when it comes to beauty products. Usually I blame it on not being able to see them without my glasses. But a lot of it just seems self-explanatory. Well, I didn't read all of the directions for this Aqua Jelly. I did read enough to know when to apply it during my beauty routine, but I didn't read how much to apply. It says to apply a pea size amount. I probably used more like a raspberry or grape size amount. That's way too much! My face was sticky and tacky for at least 30 minutes after applying it. Yuck! I then learned about the pea size amount, so you can bet the next time I used it, I used the correct amount. That next time was much better. It has a pleasant cooling effect. It smells nice, but I'm not able to describe it. It's not overpowering. I have only been applying this at night and I'm using it instead of my water gel moisturizer. My skin isn't particularly oily, but I've been dealing with a lot of "maskne" lately. I'm in my early 50's and have more acne than I have had in decades! It absorbs in a short amount of time and leaves my skin feeling soft.

title: Gorgeous Colors!
text: The colors in this eye shadow palette are gorgeous! I'm pretty conservative when it comes to makeup and these colors are fairly neutral and natural. The two lighter colors have a pretty shimmer, but aren't very pigmented. I had to apply a lot in order to see it. The darker colors are somewhat pigmented, but still it takes more than one application. I found the colors to be non-irritating on my sensitive eyes. The mirror is small, but decent.

title: Helps Tame
text: At 53, I still have natural brows. I am too much of a wimp to get them shaped and trimmed. I do pluck the random stray, but for the most part, my brows are untouched. I do use clear gel products such as this to help tame my brow hairs as needed. I found this to work well. I haven't had any crunchiness after the product dries. Just a little bit is all that I need to deal with unruly brow hairs.

title: Lovely Peachy Scent
text: I was first introduced to Harper + Ari exfoliating sugar cubes through Fabfitfun. These cubes have lovely peachy scent. One cube is more than enough to scrub my body. As you use it, the cube starts to soften and become compressed. Eventually it comes flattened, but it stays together and not separated into pieces. The consistency of it starts out firmer, but becomes slightly waxy, for a lack of a better description. It doesn't leave my skin feeling waxy though. After exfoliating my body, I use the rest to thoroughly scrub my hands and/or feet to get rid of the dead skin. One thing I really appreciate is that these come in a plastic tub. I've gotten some that come in a glass jar and that worries me that it will bring in my tile shower.

title: Gentle
text: I have sensitive eyes. This eye cream is gentle and didn't cause any burning or stinging. I discovered that if I lightly press on the pump (and not a full pump),  it gives me the right amount of cream. I apply it under my eyes and under the brow area, too. There's no scent to it. It moisturizes nicely.

title: Soothes
text: This is a set of 3 items - an eye roller and 2 small beauty spatulas/scoops. The roller is smaller than I expected. I have a jade roller and I thought this would be closer to that in size, but it's not. I've been storing my roller in my beauty refrigerator so it's chilled when using it. It soothes the delicate area around the eyes quite nicely. The spatulas are nice to use so your creams aren't contaminated by things. The items are made from some type of metal. I really like the rose gold color.

title: Nice Set
text: I have thick, coarse hair. It's been about a year since I've had any color. I shampoo my hair about 4 to 5 times a week. The shampoo and conditioner have a nice, light scent. It's lightly floral, but not overpowering or strong. The shampoo lathers up well. The products rinse well. I was a little unsure about the rescue shot. It's a small tube. The directions say to apply it on the ends then rinse. It doesn't say how long to leave it or anything else. My hair has been very soft and shiny since using this. I tend to rotate between 2 to 3 different brands of hair products at any one time. For a drug store brand, this is pretty good.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Sensitive Skin
text: I am in my early 50's. I've been regularly following multi-step skincare routines since my late 40's. Before then, I primarily used only a moisturizer. I like this moisturizer a lot. I don't notice any scent to it. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or my sensitive eyes. My eyes water a lot and I tend to rub my eyes frequently, both of which often get skincare products into my eyes. I'm not crazy about the pump top dispenser. I've had other products use that type, too. I just preferred a traditional pump or a tube that you squeeze. This cream is not runny or thin. It absorbs well. My skin feels soft after applying it.

title: Good Absorption
text: I am in my early 50's and follow a multi-step skincare routine with a focus on anti-aging. This eye treatment doesn't have any noticeable scent to it. It has a good absorption and hydration quality. I have super sensitive eyes and I haven't had any problems with this. Skincare products often get into my eyes either by rubbing or sweating. I have not had any stinging or burning with this and I have been using it twice daily for a little more than a week. I haven't seen any difference in the skin around my eye area, either. However, I usually don't see any new results when trying out new products. I believe that is because I am a faithful user of such products to begin with.

title: Exfoliates Well
text: This body scrub came as a surprise. I didn't expect it to be something that I would have to mix myself. I thought I was ordering a pre-mixed one. All that aside, it is a nice product. When you open the pouch, you find another smaller pouch inside as well as a wooden spoon. You mix the oil with the salt grains and rub it into your body before you get into the shower. I was afraid that would make a huge mess. So I turned the shower on until it got to the desired temperature, then I stepped into it. Then I turned the shower off. That allowed my skin to get slightly wet and it wouldn't take as long to get the shower warm again when I was ready. The scrub exfoliates well. It has a pleasant floral scent. It does leave your skin feeling oily. I used it on the bottom of my feet and that made for a slippery shower, so be careful! Once I had rubbed the scrub all over my body, I turned the water back on and rinsed off. My skin was a little oily feeling for a while afterwards.

title: Festive Assortment of Hair Accessories
text: This is a festive assortment of hair accessories. They are all good quality pieces. The fabric is soft. There are a couple of sparkly ones scrunchies, a velvety one, and more. The picture accurately shows what's in this set and what they look like. It's fun deciding which one to wear!

title: Fun Gift!
text: There's a bit of nostalgia for me when it comes to Lip Smackers! I grew up in the 70's & 80's and owned several over the years. My now 19 year old daughter likes them, too. I let her and a friend choose a few from this set. They had fun going through them and selecting theirs. They have great scents. The girls said they tasted good, too, though they made sure to clarify that they only tasted what was on their lips and they did not actually eat the product. My daughter's friend didn't remember Lip Smackers to be so moisturizing, so that's a plus. The girls had a lot of fun with these. I think this would make a fun gift for kids of all ages.

title: It Works!
text: I wasn't sure what to expect from this hair tie, but it works! I have very thick hair and I am able to get this band to go around my pony tail two times. It keeps my hair in place with minimal sliding. The coils were very stretched when I took my hair down, but they slowly returned to their original shape.

title: Nice Quality, But Didn't Fit
text: These hats are a nice quality, but unfortunately they didn't fit my son's head. My son is a big guy with a large head. I didn't measure his head before hand, so that's on me. He wears a satin cap when he sleeps to keep his curls from tangling and knotting. I thought he would like this because it looks more masculine.

title: Love the Scent
text: My favorite thing about Aussie hair products is the lovely fruity scent. The shampoo is a thick, clear consistency. It lathers nicely. I have thick, coarse hair that goes just past my shoulders. I've been using 2 pumps of shampoo at a time and I repeat. The conditioner is a fairly thin consistency which is unusual for conditioner. I use 4 pumps of conditioner. I let the conditioner do its thing while I wash my face and body, then I rinse. I have been pleased with the softness of my hair while using them. I haven't noticed any difference in my hair's volume. I have only used the mousse a couple of times. I apply it to damp hair and work it in. I only use it on days when I am drying and styling my hair. Most days I let it air dry, so I don't use it on those days. The bottles are large and have pump dispensers. I like!

title: Moisturizing
text: I have been using this Laszlo firming cream primarily at night, though it does say that it can be used mornings as well. It has a light, refreshing scent that doesn't last. It's very cooling which I like. It doesn't take a lot of product to cover my face. If I use too much, it takes longer to absorb. I've been getting better at estimating the correct amount. I have sensitive skin and this hasn't caused me any problems at all. It is a bit expensive. Would I continue using it at the set price? Probably not, but then again, when I do really like a product, I will splurge.

title: Great Colors - Just Not for Me
text: I was really excited to try this. The videos that I have seen of people using the powder dip method make it look so easy! I found it to be very challenging with awful results! I don't do much with my nails. Even painting them with traditional polish looks just so-so on me. This comes with an instruction booklet that was easy to follow. I just found it to be messy, both on my hands and on the work surface. After the second coat of the powder, it looked like I had taken chewed up gum and tried covering my nails with it. I ended up getting lots on my skin and not just on my nails. Powder was all over my desk. It really was just a big mess! The kit comes with everything needed, but the quantities are small. The colors are great!  For a more experienced nail person and someone with a steadier hand, this may work well for you. It's just not for me.

title: Fun Assortment of Headbands!
text: My hair gets in my face when I'm doing household chores. All the bending down and up causes my hair to fly around. It takes me too long to get a hair clip to look good, so I usually just grab a headband. This is a fun assortment of plaid ones. They are a good quality and they do a great job of keeping my hair out of my face!

title: My Preferred Setting Powder
text: This translucent setting powder is now my preferred setting powder! It's light and airy. It doesn't cake on. It takes away any shine and leaves my face looking flawless! It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin either. I'm a fan!

title: Smells Nice
text: This all in one product smells so nice! It's a pleasant fruity scent. The consistency is thicker than most serums. The first time I used it, I used 3 pumps which was way too much. Since it has sunscreen in it, it's got the white haze until it's fully absorbed. On the same day that I used 3 pumps, I had problems with my eyes stinging which I attributed to the sunscreen. Every day after that, I have used much less and haven't had any problems with it getting in my eyes. I haven't noticed any difference in the appearance of my skin (such as plumpness, etc), but I am pretty religious about my skincare routine and use many anti-aging products regularly already. It hasn't annoyed my sensitive skin in any way. I like that it contains sun protection.

title: Lathers Well
text: I really like the scent of Aussie hair products. This smells just like I expected it to - a pleasant fruity scent. The shampoo is a decent consistency. It lathers well. I have been using it with the Aussie On the Mend Deep Conditioner. My hair has been very soft and manageable since I've been using it.

title: No Scent
text: I follow a multistep skincare routine. The morning one is slightly different than the evening. They both have facial oil as the last step, but I don't use it in the morning. I've been using this one for the past week or so. There's no scent to it. Although it's called an oil, it's not super oily and doesn't leave me feeling greasy and icky. I use it after I apply my night cream. It slowly absorbs into my skin and after a short while, it's undetectable by touch.

title: Scrumptious!
text: I have been a fan of Sol de Janeiro for a few years now when I discovered their Brazilian Bum Bum Cream. Their products smell amazing. This new fragrance is scrumptious. I already have a bottle of their Brazilian Crush fragrance. I found this to be very similar, yet different. This one is a little more caramel-y scented in my opinion. It's definitely a sweet scent. It's also pretty long lasting but not over powering. I will spritz it in the morning after my shower. Then hours later, I will still catch whiffs of it. Love it!

title: Does Wonders for My Hair!
text: Due to the pandemic, I have not had a hair cut or trim in over eight months. My hair is doing okay, but I have noticed that the ends are a bit gnarly and my fingers don't run through it as easily as usual. This deep conditioner has done wonders for my hair. The container is a little different. It has a hole in the bottom that is covered with a sticker. You remove the sticker, then when you want to use the product, you squeeze the bottle. I haven't had any problems with product leaking out when it's not in use. The conditioner has a strong fruity smell to it. I personally like it, but it is strong. The consistency is a bit runny and not thick at all. It rinses well. I let my hair air dry, but once it's dry, it's been super soft. I can run my fingers through it and they don't get snagged in the ends. I have been using it with the Aussie Get It Together Reconstructing shampoo.  I am very pleased! Usually I buy the expensive salon brand hair products, but I am happy to find affordable options.

title: Great Storage for Brushes!
text: I am a long time fan of Vera Bradley. This is a great storage for brushes when you travel! The outer fabric is a black, grey, tan, and blue plaid. The interior has a floral print in the same colors. The case is divided into 2 compartments. The top one has a mirror and a netted pouch on one side and the other side has some slots for brushes as well as a pocket. That side is made of an easy to clean vinyl or plastic material whereas the side with the mirror has cloth. The second compartment has a netted zippered compartment on one side and about a 1 to 1.5 inch deep storage area on the other side, with both sides having the cloth covering. All zippers glide well. There is no type of handle on the bag. Overall, it's really cute and helps with you to organize your items when traveling.

title: Great for Sensitive Skin
text: I use toner twice a day as part of my skincare routine. This one smells like Fruit Loops for a brief second when I first apply it, but then it switches to natural smell that reminds me of eucalyptus or menthol. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It doesn't over dry my mature skin either. It has a pump dispenser so I don't have to worry about using too much or spilling.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I've reduced my make up wearing a lot during the pandemic. There's no point in wearing much when you are wearing a mask. Plus,  I don't want to get makeup on my masks! With that being said, I have started wearing more eye makeup. Brown eyeliner is my favorite. This is a liquid one. The color is good. It takes some practice getting it to look good. I have to use cotton swabs to fix it after my messy applications. It doesn't seem to last very long though. I do tend to rub my eyes frequently which could definitely impact the longevity of it. My eyes are very sensitive and this has been non-irritating.

title: Not What I Expected
text: This exfoliating gel was not at all what I expected. I am a fan of Sonage products. Their Botanica Souffle cream is my absolute favorite day time face cream. This comes in a tube. The product is a clumpy gel. I liked the smell of it. It has an invigorating menthol smell to it. When I spread it on my face, there were clumps of product scattered around my skin. I let it set for a couple of minutes, then rubbed it off. I've used it a couple of times so far and I haven't decided if I like it or not. I haven't used anything like it before. It's not abrasive and I haven't had any negative reactions to it which is a plus. I have sensitive skin and it hasn't been irritated by it. Luckily it's a small tube and I won't have to deal with it for long. I think I will stick with my usual exfoliators.

title: Invigorating
text: This is the first scalp scrub that I have ever used. It's very invigorating and refreshing. It's easy to use, but difficult to rinse. It's like getting sand in your hair at the beach. I've been using this about every 5 days. I shampoo and condition my hair after using it. I have also been using it as a hand scrub in the shower and I really like that.

title: Non-Greasy
text: This neck creamy is non-greasy. It absorbs quickly and leaves the delicate neck area feeling moisturized and soft. It does seem to be helping to firm up the skin in that area, at least temporarily. I don't notice any scent or smell to it.  It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin either.

title: Gentle!
text: I have sensitive, mature skin. I'm in my early 50's. Moisturizer is must have product for me. This one has a light, refreshing scent that's not over powering. It's barely noticeable at all. It dispenses nicely without any mess. It absorbs quickly leaving minimal trace of it behind. Once it's on, I can barely tell that it's there. It leaves my skin feeling soft and supple without feeling greasy.

title: Fun for the Holiday Season!
text: These lip balms are fun for the holiday season. The variety of flavors is good. My favorite is candy cane, but they're all nice. They're not too waxy and glide on easily. They do a good job of moisturizing my lips, though it doesn't last a long time. These would be great as stocking stuffers.

title: Soothing
text: I have been using these in the morning. I put them underneath my eyes after showering and before putting on my serums and moisturizers. They are gel type eye pads. They feel very soothing. I don't have a lot of puffiness in the morning, but I do find these to be refreshing. My eyes are very sensitive and these haven't irritated me in any way.

title: Love!
text: I was surprised at how much I love this primer! I've been wearing it alone, without make up because I like it so much. It leaves a subtle glow without sparkles or shimmer. The product has a pleasant smell that reminds me of fall spices. I swear I can detect a hint of cinnamon! It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. And it's a bonus that it's got anti-aging properties. I am thrilled to have discovered it!

title: Fresh Light Scent
text: I have been familiar with the Philosophy brand, but I have only tried their shampoo/body wash/bubble bath all in one before. This is a decadent cleanser. It's a thick, clear consistency with some shimmer. My first time using it, I used a big glob and it didn't lather well. The next time (and subsequent times), I used just a small dab and it does lather nicely. It's not a foamy lather, but it is lather. This has a nice fresh, light scent. I would classify it as natural not perfumy. It cleans really well and literally leaves my skin feeling squeaky clean. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate or annoy me. I also have sensitive eyes and a lot of cleansers end up irritating them, but this does not. Overall, I am very happy with discovering a new cleanser!

title: Mess Free
text: This fifty something woman has been dealing with mask-ne just like a lot of other people out there. I was excited to see something to help. The directions say to wear this under your mask, so I tried it that way. This treatment mask showed through my cloth mask. I have other masks that probably cover more area, which I could use instead. The mask is a gel one that stays in place well without wearing your cloth face mask, so I probably won't wear them together next time. It's not a wet consistency either. The good stuff is infused in the gel so it's a mess free experience. It doesn't leave behind any excess goo like some sheet masks do. I have sensitive skin and this mask did not annoy or irritate my skin. I didn't really notice any results afterwards either. I applied it to my clean skin and when I was finished, I applied my usual serum and moisturizer. Luckily I work at home and don't go out much, so I am not wearing my masks as much as some people.

title: Nice Gift Set
text: I have heard of Frank's Body products, but this is my first time using them. This gift set comes with 2 different scrub type products. The coffee scrub is my favorite. I classify scrubs into 2 groups - dry ones and wet ones. This coffee scrub is what I consider to be a dry one. It's basically just coffee grounds. They're loose and not clumpy. The snow scrub is what I consider a wet scrub because it has some type of binding to it. Some wet scrubs have a watery consistency and some have a waxier consistency. This one has a waxy one. The first couple of times that I used it, I really couldn't smell anything other than whatever the waxy substance was. It reminded me of solid cooking shortening. I didn't really like that, but after a few uses, I squished and kneaded the tube for a few moments and that seemed to help get rid of that smell and I was able to smell a more pleasant scent. Both scrubs exfoliate very well. The snow scrub leaves a waxy feeling behind and I found that I needed to rinse myself off with warm water to remove that film and feeling. The coffee scrub rinses cleaning and doesn't leave any residue. This would make a very nice gift!

title: Adequate
text: This is a bag of 6 packages of cotton rounds. The rounds are a bit thin, but adequate. They have a different texture on each side. I don't think I have ever noticed that before with cotton rounds. I checked the ones I already had at home and they did not have that feature. I use cotton rounds primarily for my toning step of my skincare routine. This should last quite a while.

title: Pleasant Uplifting Scent
text: This body wash has a pleasant uplifting scent. It's very natural as far as the smell goes. It has a runny gel consistency. It produces minimal lather and doesn't leave behind any residue. I am enjoying adding it to my morning showers.

title: Leaves My Hair Soft
text: I have thick, coarse hair that is currently shoulder length. The color is natural but I am beginning to gray. I've been using this with the matching shampoo. It has a perfumy smell to it that is pleasant and not too strong. The shampoo has a stronger scent in my opinion. It has a thick consistency. It rinses well. It leaves my hair very soft and manageable. I'm not noticing much difference in the volume, but because I'm pleased with the results I'm getting other than that, I am happy with it.

title: Nice Duo!
text: I haven't worn much make up since the pandemic. I don't really go anywhere and when I do, there's the mask thing. I got this and started wearing eye makeup again and realized how much I missed it! And how much it improves my look. Just a little eye liner and mascara helps my eyes to pop a little more. This duo comes with an eyeliner and a mascara. The eyeliner glides on easily. I think I would prefer a finer tip, but it's not too bad. It blends well. It is also long lasting. The mascara has a built in eyelash curler which is pretty unique. It took me a few moments to figure it out. The actual mascara goes on without clumping. It defines my lashes nicely. I haven't noticed much smudging and both products are easy to remove. I have sensitive eyes and neither of these bother me. I would definitely reorder these.

title: Quick Results!
text: I am seeing quick results with this neck cream which really surprises me! I've been applying it to my neck and upper chest area two times a day. The results aren't long lasting, but almost immediately after applying the cream, my skin is tighter and smoother. I am a former teacher and spent lots of recess duties without sunscreen. As a result, my upper chest area resembles crepe paper. My neck area is an age thing. I don't notice any scent to the cream. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It absorbs quickly. The jar is not that big but you don't need a lot of product per use. As much as I am loving the results, this is out of my budget.

title: Smells Great!
text: I have coarse, thick hair. It's usually pretty flat and could benefit from some volume. I found this shampoo to be pretty good as far as cleaning my hair. It leaves my hair feeling soft. It smells great! It has a perfumey scent to it. It lathers okay the first time but definitely better the second time. It rinses well. I haven't noticed much difference in the volume, but since it is noticeably shiny which I like.

title: Glossy!
text: This lip gloss is a thick consistency. It's long lasting and a bit sticky. It has a pleasant scent.  It's very moisturizing and adds a nice shine.

title: Amazing Scent!
text: I have been using Bum Bum cream for a couple of years after learning about it from the Fabfitfun Community. I love it! The scent is amazing. The tub of Bum Bum cream is the large size. The cream has a thick consistency and melts into the skin nicely. The scent lingers all day. I have not used the perfume before. It has the same delicious scent. I love being able to layer my favorite scent! This is a wonderful gift set and I would be thrilled to receive it from my family this holiday season!

title: Leaves My Skin Feeling Silky!
text: Serums are a regular part of my multi-step skincare routine. This is my first time using a Farmacy serum, though I am familiar with the brand through my Fabfitfun subscription. This serum is a runny consistency. It's not sticky or tacky. I don't feel the need to have to wash my hands right after applying it. It has a pleasant cherry scent that reminds me of cherry Chapstick. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling silky afterwards. I haven't noticed any improvement (or not) since using this, but I regularly use all sorts of anti-aging products so it would be difficult to notice any difference unless I completely stopped using everything else. Overall, I like this serum.

title: Nice Lip Scrub
text: I love a good lip scrub. This one is easy to apply because it's in a tube rather than a jar. However, I find it's more effective to scrub with a finger rather than just rubbing my lips together. It has a very appealing lemon scent and flavor to it. It's not the grittiest  lip scrub that I've used, but it has a decent amount of grit to it. I always follow up with some type of lip balm. My lips are super soft!

title: Gorgeous Hair Clip!
text: I have not gotten my hair cut since right before the start of the pandemic. I'm in my early fifties and for the last decade or so, my hair has been somewhere between shoulder length and chin length, usually closer to chin length. Since I haven't gotten it cut since March (it's the end of October now), it's a little past my shoulders now. A few months ago, I discovered that it's long enough to clip it up into a messy bun type hair-do. Since I work at home and rarely leave the house, it's the perfect hair style for me! I bought a few similar (but cheap) hair clips, but this one is so much nicer. Plus it's absolutely gorgeous. The others look like plastic. This resin one looks like it could be something expensive and rare! The clip comes in a nice box and could easily be given as a gift because the presentation is so nice. The clip is sturdy too, and doesn't feel like it will break. I really love it!

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I like the highlight trend, but at my age (early fifties), it's not really appropriate. Or at least it's difficult to get it to look good. This is a great alternative to that technique. This creates a light glow or dewy look which looks quite natural and looks age appropriate. It sprays a light mist that doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. It smells amazing! It's a pleasant fruity blend. I am very happy with this glow spray by Tula.

title: Amazing Lip Scrub
text: The lip scrub is amazing! It smells yummy! It isn't a waxy consistency like some lip scrubs. It's what I would call a dry scrub because it doesn't clump together like some scrubs. It exfoliates well and keeps your lips smooth and soft. The lip gloss is okay. I personally found it to be a little sticky. It's long lasting. I've been wearing it for a couple of hours now and I've even eaten a snack and it's still there. It doesn't have a bad taste or smell. These come in a nice little package, ready for gift giving!

title: Lovely Scent
text: Morrocanoil hair products have been a favorite of mine recently. I am quite fond of its lovely scent. It reminds me of baby powder. These products come in a gift tin. They are decent sized travel products. The oil will probably last the longest because you use so little of it each time. The oil and the hairspray both have the wonderful scent that I love. I don't notice the scent with the styling cream. None of the products cause my hair to look greasy. I'm not quite sure of the Mrs. Maisel tie-in, but I do like the gift set.

title: Fast Absorbing
text: Serums have become an important part to my skincare routine. I use them twice daily after cleansing and toning. This one seems to be okay for both morning and evening. It comes in a dropper style bottle. A few drops is all that is needed to cover my face and neck. It's fast absorbing. There's no oiliness or greasiness left behind. It has no noticeable smell. It doesn't cause any issues with my sensitive skin. I appreciated getting a sample of the Whip.

title: Moisturizing
text: This skin care product is very similar to a sleeping or gel mask. It's a greenish clear gel consistency. It has an earthy, natural smell to it. I'm not in love with the smell of it, myself. It's not a foul smell, just not one that I care for.  It is a little slow to absorb into the skin compared to other skin creams and products, but it's not sticky or oily. I haven't noticed any plumping effect, but it is moisturizing.

title: Refreshing!
text: I always use a toner after cleansing my face. This one is a good, gentle one that doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. It has a light, pleasant cucumber scent and is very refreshing. The only complaint that I have about it is that the bottle doesn't have any thing in place to slow down the flow of the liquid. As a result, I frequently over saturate my cotton round. At this rate, I will probably run out of toner sooner than I should.

title: Gentle Cleanser
text: My skin can be sensitive at times. I haven't been able to pinpoint the cause of my skin sensitivity, but some products cause redness. This cleanser is very gentle and doesn't irritate at all. It has an adequate thickness and reminds me of just liquid soap. It produces a decent foam. It's not over drying or stripping. It doesn't taste good either. Though I don't usually test that out on skin products, I accidently got some in my mouth while I was washing my face one night and therefore I can attest to the fact that it tastes awful! Of course, my rating does not reflect that. I do like the idea of having a single product that cleans your face and your body. Less products in the shower! However, I am using this at the sink so I'm using it primarily on my face right now.

title: Light Clean Scent
text: I've been using this serum in the mornings for the last several days. It has a pleasant, light clean scent to it. It's very hydrating and smoothing. When I applied some to the back of my hand, it immediately erased the fine lines there. I was impressed with those immediate results. As far as my face goes, it's harder to notice any results but I attribute that to the fact that I have been using so many different anti-aging products regularly for the last few years, that my skin is in pretty good shape. This serum isn't greasy or oily. It is fast absorbing. And most importantly (to me), it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin! It doesn't take much product. 2 pumps completely covers my face and neck.

title: Fun Assortment
text: This is a fun assortment of small embellishments. We've been using them for resin jewelry. The small size works nicely for that. There is a box of shiny gold foil pieces, 2 boxes of dried flowers, and 2 boxes of sparkly butterfly sequins. The boxes are kind of like weekly pill boxes. They are easy to open and shut. When closed, they keep the contents secure.

title: Good Sleeping Mask
text: I started using gel sleeping masks a few months ago. Now they're a regular part of my nighttime skincare routine. This one has a very light and pleasant natural scent. It is a thick, gel type consistency. I use it as the last step in my routine and it makes my face look really wet, but it does absorb. Usually my husband and I watch TV for an hour or so after I have completed my nighttime routine and it's always completely absorbed by then. It doesn't irritate or annoy my skin. It feels a little sticky when I first apply it, but if I wait a few moments, the stickiness is gone, including my hands.

title: Love!
text: I was first introduced to "This Works" products through FabFitFun. I think it was the pillow spray. I gave that one to my daughter and it seemed to work. Then a few years ago, I got her the Cocoon lotion, also through FabFitFun.  I started using the products for myself later. I really do love them! They have a stronger lavender smell than other similar products. The scent also lingers for a good while which makes it more effective. I only apply the lotion to my arms. I catch whiffs of the lavender throughout the night. The lotion is non-greasy and absorbs nicely. I give my primary pillow a couple of mists before I get into bed. It doesn't seem to last as long as the lotion, but it's very nice when I first go to bed. I wouldn't say they're a magical sleep aid, but they are helpful in creating a relaxing and calming atmosphere for sleeping.

title: Fast Absorbing
text: For the last several years, I have been regularly using multiple anti-aging products. I think my skin looks a lot younger than my 52 years. There is no noticeable scent or smell to this serum. It is fast absorbing. The skin just drinks it up. It leaves my fingers feeling a little tacky at first, but that does go away after a short while leaving behind soft skin. I haven't noticed any difference since I've been using this, but I always try my serums out on the back of my hands and that shows some immediate results. The serum does not irritate my sensitive skin. Overall, it's a good serum.

title: Great for Sensitive Skin
text: This set by Eucerin comes with a day and a separate night cream. They have a thick consistency with no greasiness. I don't notice much of any smell or scent to them. They don't irritate my sensitive skin. It doesn't take much to cover my face and neck. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling soft. I have been using it after cleansing and toning and my serums. I do follow up with a water sleeping mask at night.

title: Pleasant Smell
text: I must admit, I didn't know what Essence was.  I just ordered this because I was familiar with the brand from one of my subscription boxes. In fact, the first couple of days, I was using this as a toner. I was going to write my review saying that it was basically a fancy toner. Then I decided to look into what Essence actually is. I learned that it's an important step in Korean skincare. It is to be used AFTER the toner but BEFORE moisturizer. I have been using it that way for the last week or so. It is supposed to help with the appearance of wrinkles. The consistency is like a toner. It comes in a sturdy glass bottle. It has a pleasant smell that is very natural and not artificial. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I haven't noticed any new results from using it, but with most anti-aging products, I don't really notice results because A) I have been using anti-aging products consistently for several years and B) I'm not always the most observant person and C) my close up vision is worthless and I can't see anything without my reading glasses! Overall, I am enjoying this additional step to my skincare routine. I probably wouldn't purchase this again because it is a bit pricey, however if I start to see major results, I would consider it and I will come back and update this.

title: Clean Scent
text: This is a gentle serum. It doesn't annoy my sensitive skin. It has a milky look to it and the consistency is not too thick or runny. It has a very light clean scent to it. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave the skin feeling sticky or tacky. It does a great job of leaving my skin feeling very soft and smooth.

title: A Gentle Cleanser
text: This is a gentle cleanser that is non-irritating to my sometimes sensitive skin. It produces a light lather/foam and rinses cleanly. It doesn't strip or dry my skin. There's no added fragrance. It has a clean, non-identifiable smell to it, but it's probably just the ingredients. Overall, it's doing a good job!

title: Pleasant & Soothing
text: I am a big fan of the "This Works" products. My teenage daughter has anxiety issues and their products can help alleviate some of them that interfere with her sleeping. If you've used their pillow spray or other products, you'll be familiar with their scent. It's a strong lavender smell. It's not off putting, but it is stronger than other brands of lavender scented lotions and stuff. I find the smell to be quite pleasant and soothing. The shower gel has a thick consistency. It doesn't produce a lot of lather. It's perfect for those who shower at bedtime. I've been using it for the past couple of days to try it out. However, I shower in the mornings, so it would be more beneficial at nighttime. My daughter does shower at bedtime, so it will be great for her!

title: Love!!
text: I like bath bombs, but I take more showers than baths, so I rarely get to use them. These are made for showers, so I have been using them daily this week. The bag comes with 12 individually wrapped shower steamers. There are 3 different citrus scents. My favorite is the grapefruit. The first one I used, I put it in the shower right after turning it on so I could enjoy the scent as the water heated up. Bad idea. It used up a lot of the product before I even got in there! I have learned that it's best to put it on the shower floor when I'm getting into the shower. If I do that, it lasts about the whole time I'm in there. I try to put it in a location where it gets hit by a little bit of water, but not too much that it dissolves quickly. The scent is uplifting and invigorating, however, I have learned that I should  not use my most fragrant shampoo when using these. When I use my Herbal Essence shampoo, the smell of the shampoo overtakes the smell of the shower steamer. I rotate between 3 different shampoo/conditioner sets and it's really only an issue with the Herbal Essence one. My showers take about 5 minutes and the last few showers I've taken, the steamer wasn't quite dissolved all the way yet. I stepped on it to break it down a little and help it disintegrate all the way. I think these are fun and I love them!

title: Absorbs Well
text: This is a clear serum. It's a thin, almost runny consistency. It's not sticky or greasy. There's no noticeable scent to it. It absorbs well and doesn't leave my skin feeling tacky. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I really like the bottle. It twists upward.

title: Nice Fit!
text: I have a large head and have trouble finding hats that fit me, so I was pleasantly surprised that these shower caps fit my head well. My hair is shoulder length and very thick. I can easily fit all of my hair in the cap, too. It does a decent job of keeping my hair dry, though I have noticed some damp hair around the edges. The cat design is really cute! I am pleased with them.

title: Gentle!
text: My daughter is a fan of the I Dew Care product line and has been wanting to try these out. They are probably travel size (and not sample size) products. The cleanser and serum will last longer than the mask. They are gentle and non-irritating. She did notice that they left her skin feeling tight after using them.

title: Soothing
text: This lip repair has a thick, ointment consistency to it. It does require a little pressure when squeezing the tube to get it to dispense. It's not greasy or sticky. It has a soothing feel to it. It moisturizes well. It lasts a decent amount of time, of course that depends on whether or not you're eating or drinking. I don't notice any smell or taste to it.

title: Pleasant Scent!
text: My daughter started using natural deodorants not too long ago. She really likes how these smell. The containers are fairly small, but it seems that she is not using a whole lot of the product with each use. She isn't a fan of how she has to push up the product in order to apply it, but she does like that the container is environmentally friendly. This doesn't stop the wetness, but it does help keep her from having foul body odor. She's in college and has to run for a PE type class. She said she may start using a different deodorant for running and keep this for non-running days.

title: Unscented
text: This cleanser comes in a nice pump dispenser. I have it set on my counter next to the sink. I usually get 2 pumps of cleanser and add a little water to it. Then I work it into a lather. The lather or foam is minimal. It is unscented but does have a light smell of the ingredients. It's non-irritating and doesn't annoy my sensitive skin. It doesn't cause my skin to feel over dry either.

title: Sweet Smelling!
text: I became a fan of sugar scrub cubes after I got some in a subscription box last year. I like to exfoliate my skin a couple of times a week. These  smell very sweet and almost like a treat. The cubes have a good grit to it. As you use them, they start to disintegrate or melt.  As they disintegrate, they become a bit waxy in texture. When you're near the end, it starts to break up into pieces. I like to use them to scrub my feet, but just be aware that that can be a little slippery until rinsed well,  as noted from personal experience. The only think I really don't like about these, is that they're in a glass jar. I don't mind the glass, but because it's breakable, I don't want to leave them in my tile shower for fear of it breaking.

title: Lovely Scent
text: This Dove soap has a lovely smell. I didn't recognize it as warm vanilla, but it's lightly sweet and very pleasant. It smells stronger when it's dry. When I'm using it, the scent is not as noticeable. The soap produces a good lather. It rinses cleanly. It's not over drying. It's a good bar of soap. There are 14 individually packaged bars, so you should be good for a while.

title: Smells Wonderful!
text: My nightly skincare routine includes a serum after cleansing and toning and before applying a night cream. This serum smells wonderful. It's a light sweet/fruity scent that smells yummy! The serum isn't sticky or tacky. It absorbs well. Usually one dropper full is enough to cover my face and neck. It's also non-irritating to my sensitive skin. I am a fan of it!

title: Sturdy Clips
text: Because of the pandemic, I haven't been to the hair salon in a while. My normally chin length hair is to my shoulders now. I haven't been able to wear it up in a while. One day I was playing around with my hair and noticed that it might be long enough to put it up. I didn't have any clips to do it, so I concocted a temporary thing out of an elastic hair band. I was excited to give these a try! While my hair isn't super long, it is very thick. I've always had issues with hair accessories not being able to accommodate my hair. These clips are big and sturdy. They do a decent job with keeping my hair up. I do get some loose pieces now and then that require redoing it, but that may be due to the length. Also, I'm not very good with hair-dos. My poor daughter had to learn how to do her own hair early on. Overall, I am pleased with how these clips work and I'm excited to have a new hair look!

title: Moisturizing
text: I was intrigued by this product. Usually, I only use lip balms to hydrate my lips (or lip gloss/lipstick). I had never seen a lip specific serum before. It's very moisturizing and lasts a long time. The watermelon scent is barely noticeable and I haven't noticed any kind of taste to it. I don't really need a lip plumper, but as I age, I have noticed my lips are not as full as they were when I was younger. On one occasion, I did feel some slight tingling after applying it, but I haven't noticed any since then and I've been using it once or twice a day.

title: Lightweight Serum
text: I'm in my early 50's and I follow a multi-step skincare routine. My morning routine calls for Vitamin C serum. This is a good, lightweight serum. It goes on a little oily, but the oiliness quickly disappears. The serum in absorbed well into the skin. There's no scent to it, nor does it have any noticeable smell at all. Some unscented products still have the scent of some of the ingredients, but I can't smell anything with this serum. It leaves my skin smooth and supple. It does not irritate my sensitive skin either.

title: Non-Irritating
text: These strips are non-irritating. They adhere well and they don't hurt when removing. They work as well as the original Biore strips work. I didn't notice any difference between the varieties.

title: Moisturizing
text: I usually apply lotion to my body before bedtime. This lotion is pretty no-nonsense. It's a thin, almost runny consistency. It absorbs quickly and moisturizes well. It doesn't leave me feeling greasy. It doesn't really smell like anything to me. It just smells plain. I love scented lotions, but as long as it doesn't smell bad (and this doesn't), then I'm okay with it.

title: Smells Wonderful!
text: I'm in my early 50's. I like to use face scrubs a couple of times a week. This one smells amazing!  It's like a tropical vacation! The consistency is a little odd - it's thick and a bit waxy. It's pretty thick, too. It leaves a slight greasiness to my skin, and it requires a little more rinsing than most other products. It has a good grittiness as far as scrubs go. I have found that I like it better as a hand scrub than a face scrub. It leaves my hands feeling super soft!

title: It's Okay
text: Scent is very important to me when it comes to skincare products. I either want something that smells amazing or it has no scent at all.  I don't like the scent of this at all. It's not gross or off putting, but it's not what I would consider an enjoyable scent. I realize that scent can be subjective and while I don't care for it, others might like it. The serum comes in a nice bottle. It's slightly tacky at first, but it's not sticky. It's not something that makes me feel like I have to wash my hands right away after using it. It has a decent absorption rate. It doesn't irritate my skin. Overall, I found this serum to be okay.

title: Love!!
text: I absolutely love this toner! In fact, it has quickly become my favorite toner! It's non-drying and non-irritating. My skin is sensitive to some products, but I don't have any problems with this. It has a light, pleasant floral scent. The bottle is generously sized and should last a while. It really is a wonderful toner!

title: Lightly Scented
text: I apply body lotion every morning and night. This is a thick, but runny consistency. It feels a little oily. My skin drinks it up, but it seems to have a slow absorption rate. It leaves my skin looking shiny (not sparkly) for quite a while after applying it. I also feel the need to wash my hands afterwards because of the oiliness. It is lightly scented. In fact, when sniffing it right out of the bottle, I can hardly detect anything. But a few hours later, when in bed, I caught a lovely floral scent where it had been applied. I like it, but I don't love it.

title: Nice Shaving Brush
text: My husband has been using the same shaving brush for at least four or five years. He didn't think he needed a new one. In fact, part of the base chipped off and so he glued the piece back in place. When I compared the new one side by side with the old one, he finally admitted that maybe he needed a new one. The old one had half as many bristles as the new one! It didn't seem to lose hair bristles very often, but over time, it was a significant loss. This new brush is full of bristles! He uses it with shaving soap. This brush does a good job of picking up the soap and lathering it up. He's also enjoying the stand that comes with it!

title: Weak Scent
text: This is a set of 2 large bottles of hand soap. They come with pumps, but you have to put them in yourself. The pumps work well. The soap is a thick, clear liquid. It has a very weak scent to it, which was disappointing. I am all about the scent when it comes to hand soap. It does lather up, but produces a minimal amount. It rinses well. It does leave my hands feeling soft, which surprised me. That's not something I usually notice with hand soap. With all the hand washing going on these days, it's good to have a lot of hand soap!

title: Liking it So Far
text: I am in my early 50's and have been dealing with unwanted facial hair for at least the last 10 years. I'm a wimp when it comes to dealing with it. I usually have a high tolerance for pain, but not when it comes to my face! I've tried waxing (ouch), plucking (double ouch), creams (skin burns - ouch!), strange tools (ouch), and more. For the last several years I have been shaving my chin every morning and then using one of those lipstick shaped painless hair removal gadgets on my upper lip. I have tried it on my chin, but it didn't work as well as the shaving. I was a bit skeptical about this. But so far I am liking it! The instructions are not well written. Plus, I found that they're incomplete. I found a YouTube video of someone reviewing an earlier model of this tool and I watched that. It helped me a bit. I have been using this about every 5 days for the past 3 plus weeks. The first time I used the "1" setting. The next time I went to "2". I stayed at "3" for a couple of times and then the most recent time I used "4".  I have been using it on my chin and upper lip area. I shave my chin first as instructed. There has been no pain at any of these levels.  At the "4" level, I did notice a smell (burning??) that I have not noticed before, but there was still no pain. I have had no skin irritation either. I do feel warmth/heat when it's working. This morning was the first time that I noticed any difference. I'm not the most observant person, but this morning I was surprised at how smooth my chin was feeling. I had not shaved it since yesterday before I used the Fasiz Hair Removal gadget. So I know it's working! As the day wore on, I started to get my stubble, but it definitely slowed down the growth. I know it's going to be a slow process. However, I am excited to start seeing some results and I am thrilled that this doesn't hurt!!

title: Cute!
text: My 19 year old daughter likes wearing scrunchies. The quality of these is pretty good. There are 3 in this set and each one is different. In person, they look just like the pictures in the description. The solid color one is a thinner one. Then one of the floral ones has "bunny ears" and one does not. They are cute!

title: Silky
text: Eye serums are a regular part of my skincare routine. This one has a very high end look about it with it's metal (aluminum?) bottle. It has a pump dispenser that works well. One pump is enough to work around both of my eyes. This eye serum feels very silky and leaves no stickiness behind. It has a light, faint scent that's not very noticeable.  I have very sensitive eyes and this doesn't bother them at all. Sometimes something simple like sweating will cause skin products to get into my eyes and many of them cause stinging or burning. There have been no problems with this one!

title: Hydrating
text: I'm in my early 50's and follow a multi-step skincare routine primarily for anti-aging purposes. This is a mid-weight skin cream. It's neither light or heavy as far as creams go which makes it good for day or night.  The smell is okay. I don't love it, but it's not bad either. I really like the smell of the Emma Hardie cleansing gel, so I was hoping it would be similar, but it's not. It absorbs well and is very hydrating. It does leave my finger tips feeling a bit sticky afterwards.

title: Strongly Scented
text: I got the Alterna conditioner, not the shampoo. They share a listing, so I'm reviewing it instead of the shampoo. It comes in a pump dispenser bottle. I was unable to get the pump to work. I was able to get it to pop up into position, then I was able to prime. I tried it for quite a while without any luck. Then I decided to prime it some more, but this time I counted. I pumped it 50 times and still nothing. I had to unscrew the top, but I've been able to use it. The conditioner is strongly scented. It's a strong perfume smell. It's not bad, but it's borderline what I would consider over whelming. It conditions really well. I was very happy with how soft and smooth my hair felt afterwards.

title: Great for Traveling!
text: I've gotten hand sanitizer in the same kind of container/holder, but I like the idea of having empty ones. I think it's great for sunscreen so you don't have to take a full size bottle with you. Travel size sunscreen is hard to find. I received no color duplicates. I am very happy that it came with a small collapsible funnel. That makes filling them less messy! I really don't think I need this many little containers, but I'm sure that I'll find a use for them.

title: Gentle Cleanser
text: This is a gentle cleanser that doesn't irritate or annoy my skin. It has a very light scent to it that reminds me of orange blossom. It's not a citrus orange fruity scent, but more of a floral one and it reminds me of a trip to Spain where the streets were lined with orange trees. The first few times I used it, I used 2 pumps of product. When mixed with water, it didn't foam or lather at all. I found that if I did a 3rd pump, I did get a little bit of foam/lather. It doesn't over dry my skin. It rinses cleanly. The bottle is very nice and what I would consider high end.

title: So Soft!
text: These make up brushes are so soft! The set comes with more than what I could possibly need as far as make up brushes go. There's got to be one for every job! The handles are sturdy. The brush hairs are secure. I haven't noticed many loose hairs coming out. They do a good job of holding onto the powder make up and applying it to my face. Overall, I am very happy with these.

title: Stings My Sensitive Skin
text: I have sensitive skin and this caused some stinging on my face. I tried it a couple of times just to make sure that it wasn't a one time issue. It did not cause any redness or anything like that. The product has a unique scent to it. I can detect the pineapple smell, but there's something else, too. I am neutral about how it smells - it's neither good or bad in my opinion. Other than the stinging, I didn't have any other reactions. There's a little bit of grit to it, but it isn't harsh. It feels a bit sticky and I had to wash my hands after applying it. On the few times I used it, I didn't notice any "wow" results, but I am a regular user of all kinds of anti-aging products that my skin is in pretty good shape for my age. The bottle/dispenser is nice and it gives the feel of a high end product.

title: Great for Daytime!
text: This is a wonderful, light weight moisturizer. It's great for daytime! It has a pleasant natural smell to it that I really like. It's fast absorbing and non-greasy. I haven't had any sensitivity issues with it either.  It has a pump dispenser that functions well. The bottle is a good size, too, so I imagine it will last a while.

title: Nice Conditioner
text: This conditioner has a very pleasant scent. It's a light, powdery perfume smell. It's not overpowering nor does it linger around after it's rinsed. It's a good consistency, not too thick or thin. I leave it on, then I wash my face, shave my legs, etc. It rinses out easily. My hair feels soft and tangle free after using it.

title: Good Size for Travel
text: This travel set of Moroccanoil hair products is a good size. For me, I estimate that they would last for at least a whole week. I usually shampoo/condition my hair daily, though every once in a while, I'll skip a day if I wake up without too much bedhead. The shampoo and conditioner smell just like the full size bottles of the same products that I use. I find this duo to be very moisturizing. It also leaves my hair very soft and manageable. The  set includes a third item which is hair oil. That will probably last more than a week. I don't use hair oil every day. I find that it takes hardly any oil or else it gives my hair an undesired oily look. I do buy a lot of premium travel sized products and this set does cost more than a lot of the others but my review is on the products not the price.

title: Easy to use
text: I love a good hair blow out, but it's nearly impossible to do it at home. If I had an extra set of arms, it might be doable. This item definitely improves upon the whole process! It's easy to use (by myself!) and has good results. It's still not the same as what I would get at the hair salon, but I am very happy with the results. I let my hair air dry to at least 50% if not more before using. If I am in a hurry, I will use my traditional hair dryer first to get a lot of the water out. In my opinion, this is more a styling tool than a blow dryer, but it needs to have damp hair for best results.

title: Products are Nice, but....
text: This is a set of 4 items. They are all different scents and they are not in a nice gift set. The items are attached together with an adhesive and wrapped in shrink wrap. The lotion is cherry blossom scented which is a floral scent. It moisturizes well. The cream is more of a sample size. It doesn't have any scent at all. It's non-greasy and absorbs well. The lip balm is cherry scented and lightly tinted. It's not particularly long lasting, but it's fine. The body wash is fruit scented and smells good. It is a thick, pearly consistency and produces a good lather. Overall, the products themselves are nice, but I received a broken pump dispenser for the lotion that makes using it quite messy. It would also be nice if the scents were better related.

title: Giftable
text: This gift set has a facial theme. It comes with a headband, face puff, jade roller, make up sponge, and a make up remover cloth. The items are decent and range in quality. The jade roller is the nicest item in the set and is very nice. I compared it with another jade roller that I have and this one is made better and much sturdier. The headband is okay. I found it to be a little snug in fit. The face puff reminds me of a sponge like tool that my mom used to use many years ago called the Buf-Puf.  The makeup remover cloth has a pocket to fit over your hand/fingers so you can apply pressure as you scrub. The make up sponge is pretty basic.

title: Nice Shampoo!
text: This Drybar shampoo is pretty nice. I have seen it at Ulta, I think, but this is my first time trying it. It has a thick, pearly consistency. It smells nice - kind of like sweet baby powder. It makes a decent lather. It leaves my hair feeling good and manageable. While it does leave my hair soft, it isn't the softest that it's been . I can't say that I've notice any difference in the amount of frizziness. My frizz is usually limited to the crown area. It may be a little less frizzy, but it's not as smooth as I would like. Overall, I am pleased with it.

title: Great Serum!
text: This is a great serum! It's thicker than some and not runny. It has a pleasant, natural scent that is familiar, that I am unable to place. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave behind any stickiness. I'm a regular user of serums, lotions, and creams designed for anti-aging, so I am not noticing any major results just from the addition of this to my skincare routine.

title: Lovely Color
text: I'm a lip gloss kind of girl, so I was excited to give this a try. It's a lovely pink color that looks very natural on me. There's no noticeable scent to it. It's a fairly thick gloss that lasts a long time. It's a bit sticky. The container is a fun, modern shape.

title: Moisturizing
text: This is a light gel-cream. It is very moisturizing and takes a while to fully absorb. It reminds me of the sleeping or water masks that I have used which are similar. I only use it at night because it does take a while to absorb. Once it does, my skin is super soft. It doesn't bother my sensitive skin. I don't notice any kind of scent to it. Overall, I like it.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Sensitive Skin
text: When I squeeze a little cleanser into my hand and bring it up to my nose to smell, it smells really nice. It's a light, sweet watermelon scent. But when I start using it on my face, the smell is artificial and slightly unpleasant. It makes me want to wash my face as quickly as possible to get it away from my nose. I don't think I've ever had a skincare product that did that before. Very strange. I've been using this for several days now just to make sure that it wasn't just a one time thing, but it happens every time. Now the actual cleanser (minus the scent) seems to be pretty gentle. My skin can be sensitive at times, but this did not cause any irritations or problems. I had troubles with one of the products in the same brand's Tomato line which caused my face to turn red after using it, but no problems with this. The cleanser is a clear and foams up well. It does a good job of cleaning my skin without over drying it. But because of the issues that I have with the smell of it, it's just an okay product for me. Product scents are important to me!

title: Nice Cleanser
text: Let me begin with saying that I really like this cleanser. It reminds me a lot of IT Cosmetics' Confidence in a Cleanser in both consistency and scent. It's not an exact duplicate, but there were similarities. The scent is a light, citrus smell. It makes a moderate amount of lather. It rinses well. I did have one small issue with it. I have very sensitive eyes. I would estimate that at least a third of all cleansers cause some amount of stinging in my eyes. Because of that, I am super careful about using products near my eyes. However, sometimes they will burn or sting just because of a close proximity. I'm guessing there must be one ingredient that I haven't been able to figure out, that causes it. This cleanser does cause a slight stinging. I have tried it daily for nearly a week and it happens every time. There were times when I didn't even use it on my forehead, nose or temples just to make sure that I kept it away from my eyes and it still stung. It isn't a strong stinging sensation and it's something that goes away by just blotting my eyes with my towel. Most of the time, if I find a product that does that to me, I just toss it or give it to my sister. I like this one so much, that I would rather deal with that problem and keep using it. In my opinion, that says a lot about the product.

title: Hydrates Well
text: I am in my early 50's. I started using various anti-aging products sometime in my mid-40's. I'm really liking this eye cream so far. First of all, I have very sensitive eyes. So because of that, I am extremely careful when it comes to applying skincare products. Sometimes, it's just something that wafts into my eyes and doesn't directly come in contact with them, that can cause stinging or burning. This has not caused any irritations or other issues with my eyes. That's a great start! Next, it's a wonderful consistency. It's like a gel-cream. I dot it around my eye area, then I gently pat around the area until it's not visible any longer. Lastly, it hydrates well. My skin just drinks it up!

title: Great Set of Brushes!
text: This is a great set of brushes! There are so many brushes that I wasn't even sure what to use them for! It's a good thing that I  ordered them for my 19 year old daughter instead of myself. There are 25 brushes in a wrap case. The brushes are very soft and the handles have a good feel to them. There has been minimal shedding. They pick up and hold make up nicely. My daughter was very excited to get them because she's seen them on make-up tutorials.

title: Lovely Lavender Scent
text: My 19 year old daughter already loves the Love Beauty and Planet Lavender Hair Products, so she was thrilled when this arrived. The bottle is a generous sized one with a hand pump. It has a lovely lavender scent. My daughter showers before bed and the lavender helps her sleep at night. She has noticed that it really helps control fly aways and gives her hair a smoother look to it.

title: Gentle!
text: This is a gentle cleanser with a lovely light lemon scent. It makes a mild lather. It doesn't leave my skin feeling overly dry or stripped. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes or skin.
