It comes in a nice, glass pump dispenser. I have been keeping it on my sink to use before bedtime. Because it's made of glass, I don't feel comfortable using it in my tile shower. My shower is small and products get knocked down every once in a while and I would hate for there to be broken glass on the shower floor.

title: Moisturizing
text: The delicate area around the eyes requires special attention. This eye cream comes with a little applicator that allows you to apply the cream without directly touching the fragile skin. It also has a soothing and cooling feel to it. The cream itself is a true creamy consistency. It melts into the skin and doesn't leave behind any visible signs of itself.  It is very moisturizing. It has a delightful fruity scent that's not very strong. Most importantly, in my opinion, it doesn't sting or burn my sensitive eyes!

title: Cleans Well
text: I use a few different shampoo/conditioner sets regularly. I find that they work best if I alternate every few days between the sets. If I use the same one for weeks and weeks, I start to notice that my hair doesn't react as well and starts looking dull and weighed down. This is a good shampoo. It's a fairly thick consistency and lathers nicely. It has a light, almost floral smell to it. It is easy to rinse out. It doesn't dry out or strip my hair. I don't have the coordinating conditioner to use with it, but I am using another one by Love Beauty & Planet. So far I am quite pleased with it.

title: Slightly Tacky to the Touch
text: I am in my early fifties. I have been using a variety of anti-aging skincare products for the last several years. I have different regiments for the morning and evening. I have been using this as my serum in the morning. I use it after I cleanse and tone, but before I moisturize. It comes in a fairly good sized bottle and has a dropper style applicator. It has a light, pleasant scent to it. It reminds me of the banana shaped Runts candies as far as the smell goes. It's a runny consistency. It absorbs nicely. It doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky, but my fingers are left feeling slightly tacky afterwards and I have to wash my hands before continuing with my routine. I haven't noticed any changes to my skin since using this, but I believe that's because I am a regular user of similar products. It's just continuing the work that has already been started. I have not had any issues with skin sensitivity either. It's a fine addition to my morning skincare routine.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I'm in my early fifties. My shoulder length hair is pretty coarse and thick. In the last year, I have been getting semi-permanent color in order to allow my natural hair color to return. However, I have not had any color in the past five months. I have minimal gray. I like to switch shampoos regularly because after a while of usage, I notice that my hair stops feeling soft and looking shiny. This is my first time using any Love Beauty & Planet shampoos. I picked up the matching conditioner at the store a few days ago so I could use them together. The shampoo bottle is very large. It has a pump dispenser that works as it should. The consistency of the shampoo is thin and a bit runny. it does produce a decent lather. I repeat shampooing and on the second application, it makes more lather. It rinses cleanly. When I first opened the bottle to smell it, I detected a coconut scent. However, when I actually use it, I detect the ylang ylang more. It's a pleasant, mild flowery smell. I let my hair air dry most days. After it's dried, this has left my hair very soft and manageable. I can't help running my fingers through it.  I am happy to have found a good drug store brand shampoo that I like.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: This face scrub smells amazing! It has a invigorating fruity smell that reminded me a fruity beverage. It has an average grit that I found to be gentle on my sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling very soft!

title: Great Toner!
text: I use toner regularly as part of my skincare routine. This one has a thicker consistency than any other toner that I have used before. It gets any dirt left behind after cleansing. It smells pleasant. It's not a strong watermelon scent, but more of a weaker one or even slightly like cucumber. It's a little tacky right after you apply it, but it does absorb after a few minutes. I haven't noticed any difference as far as my pores go, but my close up eyesight is poor and I do not notice things like that. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Overall, I like it.

title: Works Well
text: I don't use hair oil daily, but I do now and then. I've had some that I really like and some that I didn't. This one is pretty good. It has a pleasant and unexpected peppermint smell to it. I found that it works best if I only apply it to the ends or underneath side of my hair. The one time I applied to all over, including the crown, my hair looked greasy and felt icky. As long as I apply just a little and work it into the ends, it's great and doesn't look oily. It leaves my hair feeling soft and healthy.

title: Fresh Smelling
text: This men's body wash has a pleasant, fresh smell that lingers. It is a masculine smell, but not too manly, in my opinion. It lathers well and rinses clean. My 22 year old son has declared this his favorite body wash!

title: Leaves My Hair Feeling Soft & Manageable!
text: I am in my early 50's. My hair is currently shoulder length. I haven't colored it in 8 months and probably won't any longer. It's still very thick and coarse. This shampoo has a thin and almost runny consistency. It produces minimal lather, though it does lather up a little more during the second wash. The smell is light and very pleasant. The smell reminds me of a faint sunscreen. It rinses cleanly. I personally like to use the coordinating conditioners to my shampoos, but I couldn't get the one for this, so I did purchase the Silk Venom keratin mask by the same company to use with it. I am loving the results that I am getting with this! It leaves my hair feeling soft and manageable. I keep running my fingers through my hair! This is my first time using L'ange hair products, but it won't be my last!

title: Lovely Grapefruit Scent
text: I only received 1 of these body butters, but it's a good size jar. It has a lovely grapefruit scent, but it is a bit weak and doesn't last long. It's a thick consistency and goes on creamy. It's not greasy or waxy.  It does a nice job of moisturizing my skin.

title: Emollient
text: This is a thick and emollient face cream. It's heavier than what I usually use during the daytime, so I have been using it primarily at night. It has a mild, pleasant natural scent to it. It doesn't leave my hands feeling sticky or greasy. I have been a regular user of anti-aging products for a few years now, so I don't see any new and radical results, but I wouldn't expect to see any. Overall, I am liking this face cream.

title: Scrumptious Vanilla Scent
text: Winky Lux is a brand that I've seen on Fabfitfun, but have never personally tried it. I recently saw that Target has started carrying the brand, too. This is my first product from them. The Matcha Lip Balm smells quite nice. It has a scrumptious vanilla scent to it. The lip balm container is bullet shaped. If I wasn't worried about melting it with body heat, it would be perfect to slip into pockets. It's not waxy at all. It glides on easily. It keeps my lips moisturized for a while. I was keeping a non-official time of how long it lasted and it lasted well over an hour which is pretty good. Many lip balms don't last that long! I love it!

title: Thick Serum
text: I am in my early fifties and have been using various serums regularly for the past few years. This one has a pleasant scent, though it does smell a bit artificial. It absorbs well, but it does leave my fingers feeling sticky. My skin can be sensitive but I have not had any issues with this product. It moisturizes well. I like it well enough to continue using it for the time being.

title: Foamy Lather
text: This cleanser has a nice, fruity scent. I also detect an almost minty tone to it, too, but I can't figure out what it is. It's a clear, orange cleanser that produces a foamy lather. The quantity of lather isn't too much. It rinses nicely and leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. The reason for the 3 stars is that it stings my eyes. I have pretty sensitive eyes. I'm very careful to avoid the eye area when using skincare products. I have tried this multiple times and I'm confident that I did not get any cleanser in my eyes on each of those occasions. I'm assuming one of the ingredients in it is wafting up to my eyes and causing the stinging. It's happened with other products, I just haven't figured out what that ingredient is or if it's only one single ingredient. My skin can be sensitive, too, but I didn't have any troubles with that. It did not cause any redness or dryness.

title: Great for Sensitive Skin!
text: This is a creamy cleanser. The consistency is similar to a lotion. It doesn't lather up. I was really excited to smell this because it has lavender and grapefruit extract, but it doesn't smell like either of those. It doesn't smell bad, it just smells "meh". When I think about my favorite face products, I tend to like ones that have amazing natural scents. I'm in my early 50's and my skin is fairly sensitive. It didn't irritate at all. I'm also dealing with "maskne" from frequent mask wearing and it does seem to help with that, or at least it doesn't aggravate my skin. Overall, I found this to be okay.

title: Calming
text: I was first introduced to this lotion through a subscription box. I gave mine to my daughter. She was having a lot of anxieties her freshman year of college. I've been a longtime fan of aromatherapy and the effects of lavender and thought it would help her fall asleep. She found that when she did apply this to her arms before going to sleep, she did feel calmer.  Now this bottle of lotion is for me. I've been using it for a couple of weeks. I like the scent. Some lavender scented products don't smell that great in my opinion, but this one (possibly because of the other oils blended??) smells pleasant. It isn't a thick lotion, but it's not runny either. It absorbs quickly.  I can't say for sure that it helps me fall asleep, but it does help me to relax. I am a fan!

title: Works Well
text: My 19 year old daughter is waitressing this summer. She's required to wear a face mask and as a result she's been experience more acne than usual. They're calling it "maskne"! She is liking this moisturizer so far. It doesn't have any added scent to it, but it does smell pleasant. It absorbs well. It doesn't irritate her skin. She's noticed some improvement with her acne, though she is still dealing with it and probably will all summer because of the combination of the heat and the mask. She likes it!

title: Nice!
text: I am in my early fifties. I have thick, coarse hair that's currently shoulder length. I use a hair mask twice a week. I've used Moroccanoil shampoos and conditioners in the past and I have been pleased with them. This hair mask smells just like the shampoo/conditioner. I personally like it, but I know that scents and smells are subjective. It reminds me of baby powder or a soft perfume. It is a noticeable scent and it does linger. I will catch whiffs of it throughout the day. It's a thick consistency. It rinses well. I love how soft and manageable it leaves my hair!

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: After several uses, I'm feeling pretty neutral about this cleanser. It doesn't irritate my skin or my eyes. The smell is not horrible, but it's not something I am excited about either. It doesn't remind me of any particular scent or smell. The cleanser produces hardly any lather. My skin doesn't feel dried out after usage. Overall, it's okay.

title: Soothing
text: I'm in my early fifties. I started using eye creams a few years ago. This one feels cool and soothing when applied. I dab it around my eyes as well as around the brow bone area. I have very sensitive eyes. Some eye creams will cause stinging and burning in my eyes. I have not experienced any problems with this one. I don't notice any smell with it. So far I am liking it.

title: Lovely Fruit Scent
text: I'm all about how a product smells when it comes to skincare products. If it doesn't smell good, I won't use it. I don't want strong artificial scents either. Natural scents are fine, too. I don't mind if there's no noticeable smell, either. Performance is important, too, but if I don't like the way it smells, it's a non-start issue. This has a lovely fruit smell to it. It's not too strong and dissipates rather quickly. The consistency reminds me of gel moisturizers. It is a little sticky and I feel the need to wash my hands immediately after applying it. It absorbs nicely into the skin over the course of a few minutes. I follow a multi-step skincare routine, so I find it difficult to single out how this one product is working, but my skin is very soft and moisturized. This comes with 4 small jars of product. It doesn't irritate my somewhat sensitive skin. Overall, I like it.

title: Lovely Scent
text: The Georgette Klinger Grapefruit Cleansing Gel has a lovely fruity scent. It's a gentle cleanser and hasn't irritated my skin or eyes. It does foam up a little, but not very much. It rinses easily and doesn't leave my skin feeling overly dry.

title: Leaves Skin Feeling Soft
text: I have used face oils as part of my evening skincare routine, but this is my first time using an oil as a primer. It has a pleasant smell to it that reminds me of essential oils. The first couple of times I used it, I used 2 pumps when applying it, but really, 1 pump is adequate. It does leave my skin feeling a little oily at first, but that does go away after a while. I noticed a glow at first, but I didn't notice it after a while and instead it was more of an oily shine than a glow. I haven't been wearing make-up lately because of wearing face masks all the time, so I am not sure about how it works as a primer. It does give a nice, natural look.

title: Gentle
text: This is a gentle face cleanser. I have somewhat sensitive skin and this hasn't irritated or annoyed my skin at all. It comes in a nice bottle and has a pump dispenser that works well. You apply it to your dry skin and massage it in to your skin before rinsing with warm water. It doesn't foam. It doesn't over dry my skin either. There is noadded fragrance, but it does have a smell to it. I've had a boutique bar of soap that smelled the same so I think the smell is due to some of the ingredients. While the smell is not foul, I personally do not like it. Smell  influences whether or not I like a product or not.

title: Non-Greasy Hand Lotion
text: With all the hand washing going on right now, my hands have become very dry. Hand lotion is my friend! This is a nice lotion. It's non-greasy and absorbs well. The scent is light and clean. It moisturizes my hands nicely and leaves them feeling soft.

title: Gentle
text: I am in my early fifties. I've been using Retinol products regularly for the last couple of years as part of my nighttime skincare routine. This serum has not discernible smell to it. It has a quick absorption rate. I haven't had any issues with irritation on my sensitive skin, but that is probably attributed to my regular use of similar products. I haven't noticed any new and different results since using this, but since I regularly use similar products, I wasn't expecting to see any.

title: Love the Color!
text: I wear minimal make up these days, but I try to always wear eyeliner and mascara. I love the color of this eyeliner. It's a smokey grey color which isn't as harsh as black. I found it easy to apply and it only took one attempt to get an even, thin line on my lower lashes. Sometimes with liquid eyeliner, I find that it takes more than one try to get a smooth line. It takes a little while before it's fully dry. I tested it on the back of my hand to see if it smudges easily and it does if you don't wait long enough. Once it is dry, I found that it lasted for most of the day. Overall, I am happy with this product.

title: Nice Fresh Smell
text: I love using body washes in the shower. They're usually more moisturizing than a bar of soap. This one has a nice, fresh smell to it. It is a creamy consistency and lathers well. It doesn't dry out my skin. I haven't had any skin sensitivity issues with it. This set comes with 4 large bottles of body wash that should last a while.

title: There's a Learning Curve
text: My 19 year old daughter loves the look of false eyelashes, but doesn't like the whole process of gluing them on. She's been wanting to try magnetic ones for a while. There's definitely a learning curve to these. Her first several attempts were frustrating. The results were not pretty. She kept trying, though, because she wanted them to work badly. So with a lot of patience and many failures, she finally started getting the hang of it. She got to the point where they looked good enough to wear out in public. Keep trying!

title: Great Exfoliator
text: I have been a fan of Dove's exfoliating polish for a couple of years now. I was excited to try out new scents! My favorite is the macadamia nut one, though the fruity ones are nice, too. The scent of this is very pleasant without being over powering. It does seem like an artificial scent, but I still like it. It's a thick, whipped consistency with some grit to it. It's not too harsh and it does a great job exfoliating dead skin. I recently had some peeling from a sunburn and this gently helped get rid of the flakiness. There are 4 tubs of body polish in this set.

title: Pretty Color
text: I have always wanted to try a lip balm that changes color according to your pH levels. I was surprised at how nice the color was. On me, it's a very natural, light nude-pink. It is basically about a shade darker than my natural lip color. I have noticed that if you reapply it, even after an hour or so from the first application, it becomes even darker, which I didn't like. It wasn't a garishly dark color, just a little darker than I prefer. So as long as I don't reapply it, I'm happy. It's moisturizing and leaves my lips feeling soft. It's not particularly long lasting as far as the moisture goes. It has a nice smell to it.

title: Moisturizing!
text: I prefer lip gloss over lip stick. This one is not sticky and actually feels good. It's very moisturizing and lasts a decent amount of time. The color is a nude shade that looks very natural. It has a scent to it. It's okay. I don't love it, but it's not foul either. I would consider ordering this again.

title: Smells Heavenly!
text: This is my new favorite lip balm. It smells heavenly. It does have a gritty texture, which seems like sugar, though I'm not 100% positive. I like the feel of it on my lips. It lasts a decent amount of time before it absorbs and disappears. My lips are usually pretty soft afterwards. It doesn't taste bad either. Not that I am eating it, mind you. It's just a result of being on my lips. I'm a fan!

title: Gentle
text: This is a very gentle lip scrub. There's barely any grit to it, but it is there. It's wider than the typical lip balm which I like. You leave it on and don't have to wipe it off. It actually keeps your lips moistened for quite a while after applying it. I like it!

title: Comfortable
text: So far, I haven't had to wear a mask all day long, but if I did, this would definitely be something that I would consider. It's comfortable to wear. There's adequate stretch in the material to accommodate my head easily. Every time I have put it on, I haven't been able to line the buttons up correctly and have to adjust it quite a bit. The buttons are flat and sewn close to the fabric so once your mask is secure, it's not easy for it to slip off over the buttons at unwanted times.

title: Pretty Peachy Nude Color
text: I prefer wearing lip gloss over lip sticks. The consistency of this lip gloss is very good. It's not sticky at all. It's moisturizing. With minimal eating and drinking, it is long lasting, too. It has a light pleasant scent that's not noticeable when wearing it. It's a pretty peachy nude color. I like that it has a wand applicator, even though it looks like would be just a tube applicator. Overall, I like it.

title: Moisturizing
text: My favorite daytime moisturizer (botanica souffle)  is from Sonage, so I was excited to try this facial oil by the same brand. This oil has a dropper style applicator which is easy to use. The oil has a pleasant, natural smell to it which is most likely the essential oils/natural ingredients in it. While it is an oil, I found that it didn't leave my fingers feeling overly oily after applying it and was easy to wash off my hands. It does leave my face feeling a little oily at first, but it does absorb well and leaves behind soft skin. I don't like it as much as my moisturizer, I do like this facial oil.

title: Moisturizing
text: A few months ago, I started "Mask Mondays". Every morning after my shower, I apply a sheet mask, then relax on my bed and work on a word puzzle. I have been a fan of the Hanalei brand for a few years. They have the most amazing lip scrub! These masks are pretty good. They open/unfold pretty well without getting stuck to itself. I've used some sheet masks that are nearly impossible to open up. The eye/nose/mouth holes lined up fine. They have been pretty moisturizing and I haven't had any issues with them being sticky. I expected them to smell fruity, but I didn't notice much of a scent to them. Overall, I like them.

title: Works Well
text: I was excited to give this sunscreen a try. I first saw this exact sunscreen in my Ipsy subscription box, but it hasn't arrived yet. So when this arrived, prior to a day of being out on the lake, I knew this would be a great time to try it out. My first impression, is that the tube is pretty small. It is a high end skin care brand, but for the size you get, it's probably not something I would buy again. Now looking past that, It does smell good. It's basically a milder version of the typical sunscreen scent. The lotion is fairly creamy, but it's not as thick as some sun care products which I would attribute to the gel consistency. I wasn't sure what to expect with the "glow" feature. I thought it might be sparkly or something. It was fine. I have some skin creams that have similar "glow" ingredients and it just  gives what I would call a healthy glow. I didn't hesitate to let my husband use it where had it been sparkly, I would not. It absorbs well and doesn't leave any stickiness. It works well and those of us who used it didn't have any problems with too much sun.

title: Not Abrasive
text: I like to use body scrubs a few times a week to remove dead skin. This one is not too abrasive. It has a mild grit to it, but there's a lot of it. It's not a body wash with a little bit of grit mixed in. It has a pleasant smell, kind of sweet, but I was unable to identify it. It rinses well and doesn't leave behind any film. Overall, it's a nice body scrub.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I wasn't sure what to expect from this lip oil. I have tried another brand of lip oil and I found that the color deepened as I wore it and after a couple of hours, my lips were much darker than I prefer. I didn't know if that was something that was typical with all lip oils or not. Thankfully, it's not. The color of this lip oil didn't change throughout the day. The consistency is like a lip gloss. It's not sticky nor is it cakey. The coral color is okay and actually looks pretty natural and almost nude. It's very moisturizing. I love that it protects against the sun! Oh and did I mention that it smells amazing!! I am definitely going to check into the other colors!

title: Nice Lather
text: Like most people these days, we find we're washing our hands way more than pre-Covid 19 days. My family of four has gone through many bottles of hand soap. This bottle is average size. The soap has a thick, creamy consistency. It produces a nice lather. It's a little more slippy feeling than other hand soaps. The Bergamot smell is pleasant and not too strong. It does cost a bit more than what I usually pay for hand soap.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I am in my early fifties. I follow a multi-step skin care routine. Retinol is part of my nighttime regimen. The consistency is similar to other serums that I have used. It isn't greasy or oily. I don't notice much of any smell to it. It has an adequate absorption. My skin is inconsistently sensitive and this has been non-irritating for me.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I like trying new facial cleansers. This one is pretty good. It has a pleasant scent that may be a "tea" scent, but I'm not sure. It's not a strong smell nor does it linger. The cleanser is very creamy and produces minimal lather. I found it to be fairly gentle, but I did have a little mild stinging in my eyes. My eyes are very sensitive and I am super careful to keep products away from the eye area. It didn't dry out my skin either. Overall, I liked it.

title: Leaves My Hair Feeling Super Soft!
text: I am in my early fifties. I have thick, coarse hair. My hair is color treated. I am currently getting semi-permanent color all over to transition into going back to my natural hair color after years of highlighting it. I have just a few strands of grey coming in. I have been using this rehab conditioner for a few days now. The smell is just okay. I have tried pondering over what it reminds me of, but I'm having difficulties pinpointing what it is. My first reaction was that it was mildly floral, but upon subsequent uses, I'm not sure that's what it is. There are other times that I think it smells like perfume. It's not a bad smell, nor is it very strong. I'm just neutral about it. It's a thick and creamy consistency. It rinses nicely. It leaves my hair feeling super soft! I keep running my fingers through my hair because it feels so soft! I really like it!

title: Nice Lather
text: My college aged son who lives with us uses body wash daily and prefers it over soap. This is a set of 4 bottles that should last him a while. It has a nice lather and rinses clean. It has a great scent to it that's strong, but not too overpowering. It is a bit masculine smelling, but not as much as some of the other brands of body wash such as Axe or Old Spice. My son likes it, so I will definitely consider reordering this.

title: Moisturizing!
text: This body wash is a thick and creamy consistency. It's slow to lather, but it does lather nicely. It has a light, clean scent to it. It doesn't irritate my skin. I find it to be very moisturizing. It leaves my skin feeling soft without any residue.

title: Refreshing!
text: I am a big fan of sheet masks because they are easy to use and significantly less messy than face masks that come in a tube or jar. I didn't run into any difficulties opening and unfolding this mask. There is a lot of excess serum or product that remains behind. The eye/mouth/nose holes lined up pretty good. It seems like all face masks are not perfect in that area but these are good enough. The mask was refreshing and cooling. I didn't have any issues with irritation. Overall, it was a nice experience.

title: Great Toiletry Bag
text: This is a great toiletry bag! The main compartment can open up all the way to lay flat. The interior areas have a vinyl covering on one side and has a mesh zippered on the other, for two exact storage areas. Then there is an outer zippered pocket without any special covering. The vinyl covers a lovely black, white, and pink floral print. The outer fabric seems to be weather resistant and it is quilted. The zippers are all sturdy and work well. There's enough room inside for me to put all of my skin care and makeup in it.

title: Just the Right Size!
text: The Vera Bradley Performance Twill Mini Cosmetic is just the right size to hold your makeup for touch ups! It The exterior of the bag is a quilted, waterproof material. The main compartment is lined with a cute, black, white, grey, and pink floral print that is covered in clear vinyl. It's super easy to clean. Then there's an side pocket that has the same floral print, but there's no vinyl covering. The zippers are high quality and work well. This mini bag can easily fit in your purse or backpack.

title: Great Size!
text: This is a great size toiletry bag. It has a large inner area that has the sweet floral print lining that's covered in an easy to clean clear vinyl. Then there's an outer pocket that has the same fabric print, but does not have the vinyl covering. The zippers glide easily. I am impressed with the quality of the bag!

title: Irritates My Eyes
text: I am always looking for good, gentle face cleansers. This one sounded promising. It has a light, refreshing citrus scent to it which smells very nice. It doesn't produce much of a lather which I don't mind. It didn't irritate my skin which is somewhat sensitive. However, it did irritate my eyes. I did not get any of the product into my eyes, but I did get it near my eyes. It caused some stinging (not burning) and I did have to blot my eyes with a towel before I could continue with my shower.

title: Woodsy Scent
text: I use a toner regularly, so I thought my husband might benefit from one. I did give it a try though, because he's not really good with describing skincare products! It has a pleasant woodsy scent to it. It definitely smells like essential oils, but I'm unable to identify which ones. I personally didn't detect the scent of lavender. It doesn't over dry my skin. It gets the dirt left after cleansing. It is non-irritating. My husband said he liked it, but he is pretty simple when it comes to his skincare, so the jury is still out as to whether or not he will continue using it.

title: Nice Scent
text: I use a lot of lip balms. While this is labeled a lip treatment, it is a similar consistency. It has a nice scent. It's a little waxy, but not too bad. It is soothing and does a decent job of moisturizing. I have had a little difficulties opening the tin on some of the occasions. It's not long lasting, but it does soften my lips well.

title: Light Weight
text: This is a light weight, fragrance free moisturizer. It's more of a gel like consistency than a cream. It's a little sticky when you first apply it, but after several moments (less than a minute) after it has absorbed, any tackiness or stickiness is pretty much gone. There's no scent to it. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Great Variety!
text: I don't remember how I got along before sheet masks! They make facial masks so much easier and way less messy. These masks open up easily and doesn't stick to itself because it's got plastic liner that you peel from the mask. I found the mask to be non-irritating and quite refreshing. When the time was up, I just rubbed the excess serum into my skin. I would definitely order these again.

title: Gentle for Sensitive Skin
text: This daytime face cream is gentle for sensitive skin. It doesn't irritate or annoy my skin at all. It has a light, fresh scent to it with a hint of the traditional sunscreen smell to it. I like that it has double duty and I don't need to apply a separate sunscreen. A little goes a long way. My first time using it, I used 2 pumps of the product which ended up being too much and difficult to get it worked into my skin. With one pump, I didn't have any problems. When you use too much, it's very similar to sunscreen in the part that it's hard to get the white lotion to disappear when rubbing it into your skin.

title: Cleanses Nicely
text: I ordered this for my husband, but I decided it was easier if I tried it myself rather than ask him for his help describing it. This cleanser is a creamy consistency. It doesn't really lather up very much, which is fine with my husband. It has a woodsy smell to it that reminds me of essential oils, though I can't pick out what exactly it smells like. It is definitely a masculine or gender neutral scent. It did sting my eyes a little bit. I have really sensitive eyes and a lot of products will cause stinging or burning. It was definitely tolerable and not the worst I've ever had. It was annoying more than anything else and I had to reach for my towel to dry my eyes. My husband did not have any issues with his eyes. Overall, my husband likes it.

title: Gentle
text: I use multiple products daily for my skincare routines. I use serums such as this after cleaning and toning. It has a dropper style lid. One dropper full is enough to cover my face. I use a second dropper for my neck and decolatage area. It absorbs quickly and stays tacky for a moment, but then that fades. It doesn't have any smell or scent to it. It is very gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Creamy Consistency
text: This eye butter is aptly called that. It's thick and creamy, like butter. It doesn't really have any scent or smell to it. It is very hydrating and absorbs well. It immediately (and temporarily) fills in wrinkles creating a smooth appearance. I have really sensitive eyes and haven't had any issues with stinging or burning of my eyes.

title: Very Emollient
text: I make sure to apply body lotion or cream all over every morning and night. This body butter/cream is very thick and very emollient. If you use too much, it takes a long time to get it worked into the skin. It's not really greasy, but it is a bit waxy feeling. The smell is a bit old fashioned and medicinal. I thought I caught a whiff of eucalyptus, but that's not listed in the ingredients. It kind of reminds me of a product that my grandmother used as far as the scent goes. I think it would be best for use on problem areas such as dry elbow patches or heels rather than all over body moisturizing in my opinion. I need a lighter lotion for daily use.

title: Nice Mist
text: This setting spray has a nice mist. It works best if you spray from a slight distance. It is scented lightly and smells like a floral perfume. The size of the bottle is generous and a little larger than some of the other setting sprays out there. I don't wear a lot of make up, but it does seem to help my make up last a little longer. By the end of the day, I can never tell that I had any make up on to begin with, no matter what setting spray I use!

title: Soft Cloths!
text: These reusable make up pads are pretty nice. They are soft and have enough texture to them to have a gentle scrubbing effect. I've been using them with water, micellar water, and toner. I really like the idea of reusing them. They come in a tin storage container, but they don't fit in it very well. I wish there was a better way to store the used ones so they can be kept together until it's laundry day.

title: Light Pleasant Scent
text: This primer is different than most primers I have used. Others have a creamy consistency, similar to lotion, but this is a liquid. It has a dropper style applicator. It only takes a couple of drops to cover my face. It has a light, pleasant floral scent to it. It isn't greasy, but it does leave behind a slight tacky feeling. It does give a smooth finish for make up. I don't wear a lot of makeup, but it does seem to help with longevity a bit.

title: Creamy Consistency
text: This has a nice creamy consistency, similar to lotion. I don't notice any scent or smell to it. It absorbs easily and doesn't leave behind any stickiness or tackiness. It contains many of the proven anti-aging ingredients such as Vitamin C, Retinol, and Hyaluronic Acid. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. I have been using similar anti-aging products regularly for the last few years. I don't see any new dramatic results, but since I regularly use these kinds of products, I wouldn't expect to see anything different.

title: Cute!
text: I am a longtime fan of Vera Bradley. I have owned many purses and bags, but never a cosmetic bag. I absolutely love this one! It's made from the performance twill which is perfect for beauty products. The inside has a plastic covering/coating, too, that can be easily wiped clean. The zippers work well. I absolutely adore it!

title: Non-Irritating
text: This natural spray deodorant is non-irritating. It has a pleasant natural scent. It smells like essential oils, primarily lavender in my opinion, but I'm really bad at identifying my essential oils. It's easy to use. It has a cooling effect. It seems to do a good job at masking any unpleasant arm pit smells. It's not an antiperspirant, so it doesn't do anything for wetness. As the weather gets warmer, I may find that I need more coverage.

title: Pleasant Natural Scent
text: My eighteen year old daughter has been using this moisturizer for the past week or so. It's non-irritating. It absorbs quickly and leaves her skin feeling a little dry afterwards, rather than moisturized. Her skin does feel soft though. We love that the company uses eco-friendly packaging!

title: Smells Pleasant
text: I have used cleansing oils a couple of times, but I'm really a novice with it. This oil has a very pleasant earthy smell. You can detect the essential oils that go into it. I'm in my early fifties and  I don't wear a whole lot of makeup.  I only wear eye makeup for special occasions. I do wear a tinted moisturizer, blush, and powder in addition to some lip color on a daily basis. This cleansing oil had no problem getting my make up off. It didn't leave my face feeling super oily, but I did feel that need to do more than just rinse with a warm washcloth. After using, I followed up with a toner. I think I personally prefer traditional cleansers, but I did like this. My face did feel clean after using the toner.

title: Non-Drying
text: I have been using this micellar water as a toner. I wash my face first, then use this to get what cleansing left behind. I've used micellar water in the past and this one smells a lot better than the others. There's usually not any scent that I can discern from micellar water, but this has a very pleasant citrus smell to it. The bottle is rigid and can't be gently squeezed much, so I have to shake the bottle a little to get the liquid to come out. It is non-drying and non-irritating. I have been enjoying  adding this to my skincare routine.

title: Works Well
text: I have used similar face cleansing brushes before. I am a fan of them. Most of them just vibrate, but this one has a rotating feature which is nice. I found it easy to hold and grip. I have had issues with some slipping out of my hand, but the curves help that from happening on this one. It comes with a charging cable. There are 4 different modes. The only issue that I have with this is the power button. I'm in my early fifties. My close up vision is horrible and I can't see much without my reading glasses. I found it very difficult to find the power button while I was in the shower (without my glasses!). Even out of the shower with my glasses on, it's not easy to see. Other than that, I really liked this one.

title: Cleanses Well
text: Finally a skincare product line that is actually geared toward me! I'm in my early fifties and I'm not quite in menopause yet, but I'm getting closer. This is a light, refreshing cleansers that cleanses well. It has a subtle citrus scent that's barely noticeable. I personally wouldn't mind if it was a little stronger, but I know all of people have sensitivities to strong smells. It's not irritating and doesn't annoy my sensitive skin. I don't feel that it moisturizes my skin, but it doesn't over dry it either. I'm very interested in trying out some of the other products in this line.

title: Moisturizing
text: This daily moisturizer is great for daytime. It has an SPF of 30 in it so there's no need to apply a separate sunscreen. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling pretty silky afterwards. It does have the typical sunscreen smell to it. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate or annoy my skin.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Sensitive Skin
text: I have sensitive skin and I found this to be non-irritating. I've been using this Retinol cream primarily at night time as part of my evening skin care routine. It doesn't really have much of a smell to it. It is a creamy consistency and it absorbs well. It smooths and evens out the texture of my skin.

title: Smells Yummy!
text: I know this isn't edible, but it smells absolutely yummy! I love fruity scented skincare products!! My 18 year old daughter is a fan of the brand (she loves the Disco Kitten mask!), but I wanted to give this a try before I handed it to her. It is a pretty thick, almost solid consistency. It's very much like other balms. It literally melts as you massage it into your skin. It's very emollient. The water at the sink in my bathroom takes forever to warm up, so I used cooler water to rinse it off.  That didn't do as good a job rinsing it as warmer water would do. I was just impatient! My daughter has been using it right before getting into the shower and rinsing in there. I have fairly sensitive skin and found this to be gentle and non-irritating.

title: Wonderful Body Wash!
text: I love this body wash! I wasn't sure what to expect, but it's wonderful! It's got an earthy/musky scent to it that's not over powering. It could easily be unisex. It lathers nicely. It has a mild grit to it for some exfoliation. It doesn't dry out my skin.

title: Moisturizes Well
text: I've been using this eye mask at bedtime. It has a mild, pleasant scent to it. I don't follow the directions for it. Instead I just massage it around my eyes until it's absorbed. It moisturizes the delicate skin around my eyes pretty well. I haven't noticed any improvement yet, but I wouldn't expect anything since I'm a regular user or eye creams and serums.

title: Good Masculine Scent
text: This Old Spice has a good masculine scent and reminds me of my dad. It works as expected. It's not really sticky, but it does require hand washing after application. It keeps my husband's short, curly hair styled as he likes it. We haven't noticed any white flaking after it dries, but my husband's hair has a lot of grey in it and it wouldn't be noticed.

title: Light and Creamy
text: I've been following a multi-step skincare routine for the last year or so. It calls for Retinol at bedtime. This Retinol serum is light and creamy. It absorbs adequately and doesn't leave behind any stickiness. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't agitate it at all. It has a nice pump dispenser and it takes about two pumps to cover my face and neck.

title: Foamy Cleanser
text: This foam cleanser is light and airy. I was hoping it would have a refreshing cucumber scent to it, but I couldn't detect that. It smells fine, but unrecognizable to me. It doesn't over dry or strip my skin. It rinses clean. It's a good skin cleanser.

title: Light Citrus Scent
text: This face mask has a light citrus scent that is really nice. The mask does not dry out like some, so don't keep waiting for something to happen. It does become less wet, but it's still wet when the time is done. It rinses easily. I'm fairly new to chemical exfoliating. It doesn't have any grittiness to it, but supposedly there is acid in it which causes exfoliation. It didn't irritate my skin which is good because my skin can be pretty sensitive.

title: Doesn't Last Long
text: I hate the feeling of dry lips, so I am a frequent user of moisturizing lip products. I do like that this one is a fairly natural product. It has a pleasant, essential oils smell to it. You do have to use your finger to apply, which I'm not crazy about, but that's not a deal breaker. I have found that it doesn't last as long as another lip balm that I use. I have to reapply this a lot. Overall, it's okay and I would use it, but I prefer other ones over this one.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: This hair mousse has a very pleasant scent. It is light and airy. It doesn't weigh down my hair nor does it leave it crunchy. I can't really say that it is making my hair look fuller.

title: Cleans Well
text: This is not like most toners that I have used. It has a very high viscosity. The bottle is pretty rigid and because it's a thick consistency, it's a little difficult to get out of the bottle. You can't just squeeze the bottle. It's almost like trying to get ketchup out of the bottle! The toner does not have any noticeable scent or smell. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It cleans well.

title: Smells Wonderful!
text: For a travel size jar, this is pretty generously sized. This cream has a fabulous fruity scent. I can detect grapefruit for sure. It's pretty light and it's not greasy. It absorbs fast and leaves the skin feeling soft. It does a decent job moisturizing. I like it.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I am really enjoying this hair conditioner. First of all, it smells amazing! It has a very pleasant fruity scent. The consistency is pretty average for conditioner, neither too thin or too thick. It rinses well. I haven't noticed any difference in the amount of shine my hair has, but it does leave it feeling silky and soft. I can just run my fingers through my hair without catching on gnarls or knots.

title: Moisturizing
text: This is a moisturizing eye cream. It absorbs well. I apply it all around my eye, including the eye lids. I've read that helps with dry eyes, though I can't say I've seen any difference. I don't really notice any smell to it, good or bad. It doesn't sting or burn my sensitive eyes which is a huge deal to me.

title: An Interesting Make Up Remover
text: This is an interesting make up remover. It goes on like petroleum jelly, but as you work it, it changes to more of a cream. I thought for sure that it would leave my fingers feeling sticky, but it doesn't.  I don't really notice any kind of smell to it. When I used it to remove mascara, I found that I had to really work it onto my lashes for a minute or so to break up any mascara clumps. I did have to follow it with a cotton round to get the stuff off of my lashes. Overall, it does a good job.

title: Light Weight and Flexible
text: This hairspray is light weight and flexible. It doesn't get crunchy or stiff. It's hold power is average, as I would expect from a flexible hairspray. Oh, and it smells wonderful! It's a large bottle and should last a while.

title: Not Gentle Enough for My Sensitive Skin
text: I have sensitive skin. If a product irritates my skin, I may have some burning or stinging sensation to it or it might leave behind some redness. I did experience a little burning with this, but it really wasn't that bad and it wasn't continuous. I followed the instructions. I didn't apply it all the way up to my forehead because I wanted to be able to put my reading glasses on without getting product on them. After almost ten minutes, I hopped in the shower and washed the mask off. I followed with a gentle cleanser. When I got out of the shower, my face was bright red, but only in the areas where I had applied the mask. I was sure it was a chemical burn. It didn't hurt, but it looked bad. It was so bad that I decided not to go to the grocery store as I had planned. I didn't put anything any of my serums, lotions, or creams over it. Fortunately, after an hour or so, my skin color was back to normal. So because of that, I don't think it was a chemical burn. I usually don't do the suggested patch test, but you can be certain that I will next time! As for the actual mask, it is a creamy lotion type consistency. I didn't notice any scent or smell to it. It doesn't harden or dry out like some masks. It's just not gentle enough for my sensitive skin.

title: Gentle
text: I have somewhat sensitive skin and I found this cleanser to be gentle and non-irritating. It has a sweet, pleasant scent that's not over powering. I can detect the scent of the honey, but it's not strong at all. The cleanser is a light and airy foam. It doesn't dry out my skin but it doesn't moisturize it either. It does a decent job of cleaning my skin. I follow up with a toner to get anything left behind.

title: Wonderful Scent
text: My husband keeps his thick curly hair pretty short. He uses gel on it daily to keep the curls under control. He found this gel to work nicely. It doesn't get crunchy like some gels nor does it flake. His hair looks more groomed with it than without. Plus it has a wonderful scent.

title: Leaves a Smooth Surface
text: This mask was not what I expected. You apply it and let it dry. Then go ahead and apply your makeup over it. It does leave a smooth surface and works nicely as a primer. I haven't really noticed any tightening, but it does leave my skin very soft. There's a natural scent to it. It leaves my finger tips just slightly tacky.

title: Works Well!
text: These nail polish remover wipes work well. The wipes are pretty sturdy and don't tear easily. One wipe is enough for all ten nails. These are perfect for times when it's not really convenient to take the whole bottle with you to remove your nail polish. I also felt that they didn't over dry my nails and instead they felt a little moisturized from the oil.

title: Gives Just Enough Hold
text: This "airspray" is pretty unique and not what I expected. It's a pretty dry spray. It's like spray air. It gives just enough hold and doesn't leave behind any crunchiness. It doesn't last all day, but it does seem help keep my hair styled for a good while. It smells nice, too.

title: Perfect for Traveling
text: As far as travel sizes go, these are good. I've had many a travel size product that didn't have enough inside to even last my whole trip! These should last a little while. The lip/eye cream hardly uses any each time, so it should last a couple of trips. Same goes with the face oil. The face/neck cream might be the first to get used up. I have tried all the full size products and find them to be good. I'm not crazy about the scent/smell of the face/neck cream, but it's not foul or off putting. It just smells like Crisco to me. They do a good job of keeping my skin hydrated.

title: Pleasant Clean Scent!
text: I was a bit skeptical that this would truly be a unisex lotion, but it really is! It smells wonderful. The best description that I can give is that it smells clean. It is a thick consistency and rubs in to the skin pretty quickly without leaving behind whiteness. It's not greasy either. It's just a good, effective lotion!

title: Smells Yummy!
text: I have very sensitive skin. Unfortunately, I found this to sting or burn a little bit while it was on my face. It wasn't so bad that I had to remove it right away. When I was finished, there was no signs of redness or anything like that. The mask is a soft, creamy one. It smells yummy! It doesn't dry out like some masks. It does leave behind soft, moistened skin.

title: Gentle!
text: I have super sensitive eyes and a lot of eye products will cause stinging or burning, so I am always on the lookout for gentle eye products that don't irritate my eyes. This eye cream doesn't bother my eyes at all. Yay! It doesn't really smell like anything. It absorbs into my skin well. It is very hydrating. I haven't noticed any fewer wrinkles around my eyes, but since I'm a regular eye cream gal, I wouldn't expect to see anything new as far as results go. If I wasn't using anything, I would be more likely to expect a difference.

title: Cute Toiletry Bag
text: This is a cute toiletry bag. I really like the leopard print. It's made from a vinyl type material that will clean up easily if any of your products leak inside. There are removable dividers inside to help you better organize your stuff. This bag is shorter than another make up bag that I own which allows it to fit inside my suitcase better.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I found these feminine cleansing wipes to be larger than I expected. They are also pretty soft. They are non-irritating. I assume they work well as it's kind of hard to examine the area!

title: Smells Nice
text: I just recently stared using hairspray regularly. Before then, it was not very often. Now, it's almost every day. I've been growing my bangs out over the last few months and I spray a little to help keep the part over to the side until it can reach behind my ears. This smells nice. It does leave a little crunchiness at times. It's possible I'm using too much. It does help keep my hair from falling into my eyes a bit.

title: Interesting....
text: My decolette area has suffered over the years. I'm a side sleeper plus years after not applying sunscreen while I had recess duty, my upper chest area looks like crepe paper. I'm doing a better job of carrying for that delicate skin now, but it's a slow process. Or so I thought. These silicone pads just may be the answer! While I found them easy to use, I found that the directions on the package were too basic. I would have preferred a little more information. Also, I found that the product description didn't answer my questions about how this works. I did some research and found some interesting articles about the process and now I feel that I understand why they work. First of all, they keep the skin taut while you sleep, preventing new wrinkles from forming. Silicone pulls moisture from within the skin and helps hydrate it. I wanted to understand why this should work for me. For the most part, the silcone pads have stayed in place pretty well. Every morning, I find that they have repositioned or come off, but I have checked on them during the night in the wee early hours when I've had to use the bathroom and they've been in place then. So I do believe they make it through most of the night. I have had to change my evening routine and skip lotions/creams before using. I have noticed smoother texture in that area, so I really do believe that it's working.

title: Spa Kit
text: This spa kit has a variety of skincare items. The bottles/tubes are a little bigger than what I would expect travel sizes to be and much smaller than what I would expect full size. They all have the same scent that I was unable to identify. It reminded me of one of my essential oils. At first I thought it was a weak eucalyptus scent, but I'm not sure. The scent is okay, but there are many other scents that I like much better. The cleanser lathers adequately. The scrub is fairly gentle and has a smaller grit than some. The oil was as expected. The lotion was fine, but with as much as I use on a daily basis, it won't last very long at all. I liked the back scrubber tool. It helped to reach areas that I can't regularly reach. The mask works nicely. It doesn't crack or become super stiff when it dries, instead it just becomes dry to the touch. I do like having sets of skincare products with the same scent.

title: Light and Creamy
text: This is a light and creamy skin cream. It's not at all heavy like some night creams. It truly is fragrance free and doesn't have any scent, natural or artificial. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me. It does a good job of moisturizing my fifty something skin.

title: Moisturizing
text: This is a generous size for a travel size jar in my opinion. This night cream has a fabulous fruity scent. I can detect grapefruit for sure. For a night cream, it's pretty light and it's not greasy. It absorbs fast and leaves the skin feeling soft. It is very moisturizing and smooths the skin right away. Though the jury is out as far a long term results. It's a good, cream to use before bedtime.

title: Nice Moisturizing Serum
text: I use hyaluronic serums daily as part of my skincare routine. This one has a light, clean scent which is barely noticeable. The pump dispenser works nicely and it takes about two pumps to cover my face. It isn't heavy at all. It absorbs pretty quickly. It's not tacky or sticky feeling. I have sensitive skin and this has not caused any irritations.

title: Lovely Lavender Scent!
text: When it comes to washing my hands, I'm all about the scent! It enhances the whole experience. This lavender/lime soap smells wonderful! I really don't detect the lime, but the lavender is lovely! The soap lathers nicely. It doesn't seem to dry out my skin too much. This set came with 3 bottles of hand soap.

title: Gentle on My Sensitive Skin
text: I follow a multi-step skincare routine, one for morning and another for night time. The last step for both of them is face oil. I don't usually use one in the morning because I find it to be a bit heavy for daytime, but I have started using it at night. This oil is pretty gentle on my skin. I haven't noticed any breakouts or irritations. It absorbs quicker than I would expect for an oil. It leaves my face pretty soft, too. I doesn't have much of a smell to it, but I can detect something similar to what vegetable oil smells like. It's not bad, it's just not expected.

title: Fun Scents!
text: My eighteen year old daughter loves bath bombs and dinosaurs! So this was a win-win. The bath bombs are a good size and fizz for several minutes. The fun scents smell good. The dinosaur prizes are pretty cheap, but the experience was fun. The bath bombs do tint the water, but we there was no stains left on the tub. She didn't have any issues with it.

title: High Quality
text: This is a high quality night cream. It has a luxurious feel to it. It is fragrance free and has a barely noticeable light clean smell to it. It's not too heavy like some night creams. It slowly absorbs into the skin and doesn't leave any oil stains on my bedding. I have sensitive skin and it hasn't caused any redness or stinging/burning. I have noticed the feel of my skin has been very soft and I've noticed a little improvement to the texture of my skin.

title: Hydrates Well
text: I am in my early fifties. I take skincare pretty seriously these days and follow a multi-step regimen in attempts to foil the natural aging process. This is a nice daytime cream. It smells pleasant, a lot like an essential oil that I can think of at the moment. It absorbs pretty quickly, but it does leave a slight tacky feeling afterwards. Though that disappears after a short while. It hydrates well and leaves my skin feeling and looking supple. I have fairly sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate me at all.

title: Great Idea!
text: These scrunchies are a great idea! A lot of clothing doesn't have pockets, so you're left trying to figure out where to put your keys or some cash. They quality of these is okay. The zippers work fine. The zippers do stand out a little because they're white, so you can't really call them hidden pockets, but they are quite functional.

title: Already Seeing Positive Results!
text: After just a little more than a week, I am already seeing results. The first noticeable result is that there is less hair in the shower drain. Usually I would see a clump of hair in the drain, about the size of a quarter. For the last several days, there's been much less, closer to the size of a penny at most. The second noticeable result that I have had is the presence of at least three baby hairs coming in where my part is at. One of them is gray! (Which I'm not afraid of!) The shampoo has a mint or menthol type scent. It lathers well. There's some tingling at the scalp. The conditioner is thinner than a lot of conditioners. It has a stronger mint/menthol scent and tingling experience. The set also comes with two bottles of a spray serum that boosts follicles and a spray that protects against heating tools.  The set has been leaving my hair feeling soft. I am also noticing a lot less shedding throughout the day. While I don't have thin hair, I do deal with a lot of hair breakage, so I am quite pleased with these results.

title: Mild Grittiness
text: I use body scrubs regularly in the shower - at least twice a week. As far as the grittiness of this scrub, I would classify it as a mild grit. It does exfoliate gently. It would probably be okay using it on your face. The smell is okay. It's earthy in my opinion. I prefer fruity scents, but I realize that is a personal preference. It is a thin consistency and every time I use it, too much product comes out of the tube.

title: Non-Oily!
text: I follow a multi-step skincare routine for morning and evening. Both of them have facial oil as a final step, but I often skip that step because a lot of oils feel heavy and super oily. I was surprised that this one is pretty non-oily for an oil. It absorbs quickly leaving behind soft and supple skin. It also has a lovely, natural scent. I can detect some Essential Oils, but I can't single out what Essential Oils I'm smelling. I have been very pleased with this.

title: Cute Leopard Print
text: I wear a headband when doing my skincare routine. It keeps my hair out of the way. I hate it when I get creams or serums on a wisp of hair! This headband has a cute, leopard print. It's adjustable, but even at the maximum, it's tight on my head. I have to fasten it before putting it on or else it is near impossible to attach the Velcro together. It fits my 18 year old daughter better, so she has been claiming it. She likes the pony tail hole, however, the headband alone seems to be adequate enough to keep the hair out of the way.

title: Lovely Lavender Scent
text: My daughter has had a rough first year at college.  I don't think she was prepared for the amount of work it was going to be. I am a believer in aromatherapy and thought this would be helpful to her.  She loves all things lavender and finds it to be a calming scent. When I gave her this gift set, she was thrilled! The lavender smells authentic and not artificial. The quality of the products is good. Her favorite items are the bath bombs, sugar scrub and the candle.

title: Nice!
text: I was worried that this face cream would be too heavy for day use, but it's really quite light. It absorbs quickly. It feels luxurious for a skincare product. It has a light and very pleasant scent to it. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin either.

title: Basically Sunscreen
text: This is called an SPF Booster, but basically it's just sunscreen. The first time I used it, I added it to my moisturizer before applying it to my face. It did okay, but it took a long time to absorb into my skin. The next time and every time since then, I've just applied it separately and it seems to absorb in a reasonable amount of time. It has the typical sunscreen smell. It doesn't irritate my skin. Sunscreen is an important part of one's daily skincare routine.

title: Doesn't Sting My Eyes!
text: I have extremely sensitive eyes. Some skincare products, even those not targeting the eye area, can cause my eyes to sting or burn. If I sweat, products will get into my eyes hours later after application. It's frustrating and painful! So the first thing I look for in beauty products, especially ones specifically for the eye, is it gentle enough for me to use. This one has not caused any stinging or burning, so that's one less concern for me. It doesn't have much of a smell to it. It is a light, creamy consistency that absorbs well. I have been using eye creams and serums regularly for the past few years. I don't notice anything different with this, but since I'm a regular user of similar products, I don't expect to see anything different.

title: Soothing
text: I use serums and creams targeting the eye area daily. This eye gel is quite soothing because it has a pleasant cooling effect. It doesn't burn or sting my eyes, which is a biggie. One squirt is enough for me to cover both eyes, below the eye and up to the brow area. It's not sticky. It does a good job of moisturizing the delicate skin around my eyes.

title: Very Hydrating
text: This body lotion is different than most lotions I have used. I don't think I've ever seen one like this. While traditional lotions are opaque and stay opaque when you rub it into your skin, this one starts opaque, but becomes almost clear when you start rubbing it in. It's like it melts into your skin right away. There's no white cream that you have to keep rubbing in until it's gone. It's really different. It's not quite as thick as some lotions, but it's a decent consistency. It's very hydrating. My skin drinks it right up. It's fast absorbing and leaves my skin feeling supple. Oh, and it smells nice, too. I am really enjoying this body lotion!

title: My Hands Are So Soft!
text: The skin on your hands can show your age whether you want to or not. I have found that regular scrubs such as this one can help. It helps to shrink the appearance of the large skin cells and pores. This salt scrub is wonderful. It isn't too oily, like some scrubs, but there is some level of oiliness to it. I don't feel like I have to wipe my hands on immediately after using it. Using warm water helps with that, too. The almond smell is amazing! The scrub comes with a little dish and lid too, though I've been using it right out of the jar. It's a very nice set and would make a great gift.

title: Lovely Scent
text: I am fascinated with this cream/toner combination product. It's fun to use. I follow a multi-step skincare routine and after cleansing, I use a toner. I've been using this in the place of my traditional toner. I still follow up with serum and cream/moisturizer. My fifty year old skin needs all the moisture it can get! It's very gentle and doesn't agitate my sensitive skin. And it has a lovely, fruity scent which enhances the experience.

title: Gentle Cleanser
text: This cleanser is a very thick gel consistency. The first time I used it, I pumped and pumped the dispenser to no avail. I took the pump off and squeezed some of it out to use. The second time, I pumped it even longer and still nothing. The third time, I thought I would give the dispenser one final time. On the first pump, the gel dispensed! It takes patience! Now the actual product is kind of fun. It starts as a gel, but when you rub it, it becomes a foamy/creamy consistency. It's really gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. It doesn't over dry my skin and it leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. On subsequent uses, I still struggle with the pump at times. I think a different type of dispenser would be better, but the cleanser is really nice.

title: Immediate Results
text: When I'm trying out new skincare products, I usually don't comment on the results, especially after using it only for a few days. If I do see something, I will call it, but because I regularly use several different products and I have been for years, I don't usually see anything new. But I have seen immediate results with this eye serum, but not in the eye area, which is not to say there isn't anything happening there, but I haven't been able to see any yet. So where are these immediate results happening? I like to try out skincare products on the back of my hand in conjunction with the area it's specifically designed for.  It allows me to see better up close. After applying this serum to the back of one hand, I noticed an immediate smoothing of the skin. The lines disappeared right away. You can't see the individual skin cells like before. I was really impressed. That's not something that often happens when trying out beauty product there. It's possible the same thing is happening in my eye area, but I have really poor close up vision, so I have to wear reading glasses to see and the glasses always obstruct the view.  The serum isn't greasy or oily. I can detect a faint orange/citrus smell to it. I have been applying it under the eye and on most of the eye lid up to the brow area. I have really dry eyes, so I read that keeping your eyelids moisturized can help. My eyes are very sensitive to a lot of products and this hasn't caused any stinging or burning. I do think it's a bit pricey, but maybe it's justified since I'm seeing such positive results on the back of my hand.

title: Moisturizing!
text: I've been a fan of the Hanalei Sugar Lip Scrub for a while. Then recently I discovered the Sugar Body Scrub, which I love! I was a little disappointed that this lotion didn't have the same amazing scent that the sugar scrubs have. The scent is very light and barely noticeable. It moisturizes well. It absorbs into the skin pretty quickly and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. The tube is about the size of hand lotions rather than body lotions, so unfortunately for me it's not going to last very long!

title: Morning Glow
text: I have a multi-step skincare regimen for both morning and night. Both call for facial oil as one of the last steps. I have used a nighttime oil, but never a daytime one. I was disappointed that this facial oil doesn't really have much smell to it. The first time I used it, I think I used too much and my skin felt greasy. The next day I only used about two drops. That was a better amount. After massaging it into my skin, it seems to absorb after a little while. It does leave my skin feeling soft. And there is a bit of a glow or shine left.

title: Take Me to Tahiti!
text: I have thick, coarse hair. I use a conditioning mask a couple of times a week. This one smells heavenly.  It's not a heavy coconut smell, as I thought it would be, but it's definitely a tropical scent. It rinses easily. It didn't leave my hair feeling heavy or greasy. It left my hair very soft afterwards. In fact, I actually had one of my best hair days after using this!

title: Gentle Cleanser
text: This cleanser is gentle and doesn't dry out my skin. It has a creamy consistency. It doesn't produce a lot of lather, but it's adequate. My skin is pretty sensitive and this doesn't irritate it. It has a light, lemon scent that smells quite pleasant.

title: Exfoliates Well
text: This is the way a body scrub should be! Some scrubs I've gotten have minimal scrubbing abilities because they barely have any thing in it (sugar or salt crystals, etc) that exfoliates. This has a lot of sugar crystals and is effective at sloughing away dead skin. It has a really pleasant, light fruity scent to it. It doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy either. The only issue that I had with this is that it was difficult to squeeze out of the tube because it's pretty thick. Other than that, I think this is a great exfoliating scrub!

title: Moisturizing
text: I usually wear lip balm, but was curious to try a lip butter for comparison. This actually comes with 6 tins of identical lip butter. I was able to give one to my daughter and her college roommate and other to a friend of mine, still leaving me with three. This comes in round tins that are larger than I anticipated. I just had memories of the Village Lip Smacker tins from the 80's which were smaller. The butter is really creamy and not waxy at all. It has a pretty strong lavender smell to it. The first time I used it, I got way too much product on my lips so moving forward, less is best! I wasn't crazy about the taste. I don't normally try to eat my lip products, but when you put too much on, it happens. It wasn't foul, it just wasn't good either. It does feel moisturizing and leaves my lips soft.

title: Amazing Scent!
text: Great scents really enhance the whole hand washing experience for me. When a hand soap smells amazing, like this one, I can't help but sniff my hands when I'm done. This one has a lovely, citrus scent that really makes me happy. I wonder if they make other products with the same scent. I'm going to have to check into that. Anyway, the soap produces a good lather. It rinses well. It is very gentle and doesn't irritate my skin, nor does it dry it out. The bottle size is generous, too.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I've been growing my bangs out for the past several months. I use a hair dryer to help train the longer bangs out of my eyes. I've added this mousse to my routine. I apply a little just to the roots where I've been working on training the hair before I start blow drying with a round brush. I add some flexible hair spray after I'm done styling my hair. It seems to be doing a good job. I've noticed that my hair is staying out of my eyes a little better than before. It doesn't leave my hair crunchy or my fingers sticky. And best of all, it smells amazing!

title: Part of My Skincare Routine!
text: I am in my early fifties. I have a multi-step skincare routine that I follow. I have been using this serum after applying my vitamin C serum (morning) or hyaluronic acid (evening). Previously, I was using Vichy Mineral 89 with similar results. Then after allowing it to dry, I follow with my moisturizer (morning) or night cream (evening). It takes a few moments to absorb into my skin. It's not sticky or tacky feeling. It works well with the other products. My face is very smooth and soft, which is important at my age! It comes in a fancy box. The serum smells very pleasant, but not too strong. It's a nice, light, natural scent.

title: Good Absorption
text: As I have gotten older (I'm in my early fifties now), I've become more vigilant about my skincare routine. I have a multi-step routine for both morning and evening. The evening routine calls for Retinol, so I am always looking for good Retinol serums to use. This one comes in a small amber bottle. There's not much smell to it. It has a good absorption. When trying new serums, I like to try them out on the back of my hand. This does a good job of softening the skin and creating a nice smooth surface. I haven't noticed any difference in the quality of my skin but since I have been using assorted anti-aging products for so long now, I wouldn't expect anything new.

title: Gentle
text: I am in my early fifties. I've got a multi-step skin care routine for both morning and night. I have been using this serum at both times. It's gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. When I applied it to the back of my hands, it created an almost immediate smooth surface. It isn't sticky, but it does leave behind some tackiness for a while. The scent is okay, but not my favorite. It is a natural smell with a slight acidic twinge. I like it!

title: Good Shade
text: The shade of this foundation was pretty good. It will probably be too light for summer wear, but for the time being, it's a good match. It is a heavier foundation than I expected. It's definitely a full coverage product. The first time I applied it, I put it on as is. It was too heavy for me. I cleaned my face and tried again. This time I used less and mixed it with some moisturizer. It was still too heavy for me. I'm in my early fifties and I typically use a tinted moisturizer or BB Cream rather than straight foundation. This may be better suited to younger skin. I had settling in my fine lines. I also found it a little greasy feeling which I've never experienced with foundation. It took hot water and soap to get my hands cleaned after applying it. The bottle is lovely and I like the brand. My daughter is coming home this weekend, so I am going to see what she thinks of it.

title: Very Soothing!
text: The first time I used this set, I wasn't aware of the specific order, so I switched step 2 & 3. Then I watched the product video by the seller (who was delightful to watch!) and became aware of the intended use of these three products. I assumed that they were specifically for the feet, but they can be used anywhere. The video says to basically use just a dime size amount of each product. I tried using the scrub in the shower which was wrong, too. I should have used it before the shower and then rinsed in the shower. Using it in the shower, I found that it wasn't very exfoliating and it required a lot of the product because it kept getting washed away. Using it before the shower definitely works better. It's not a very gritty scrub, but when you take the time to massage it in for a good minute or so, it does do a good job. The cream is nice and moisturizing, but my favorite of the three products is the salve! I normally don't like products like this because they're often greasy, but this one isn't. It literally just melted into my skin and was very soothing. After putting on my socks for the day, my feet felt lightly tingling and very invigorated. I really liked it. I can see why Oprah chose this to be one of her favorite things!

title: Nice Travel Set!
text: I really like these travel bottles. They are very clever. The silicone flexes and squeezes well so you can actually get all of the product out of the bottle. This one little set comes with 8 containers and there are 3 different styles. It accommodates just about everything I would need to take with me on a trip. The storage bag that it comes with is not very sturdy, but there is an extra one just in case.

title: I'm Impressed!
text: I am in my early fifties and have noticed hair thinning due to aging. I've been trying many different hair products targeted to this. This is a nice, complete set. It comes with shampoo, conditioner, a serum, and heat protectant spray. The shampoo is really thick and has the consistency of honey, without the stickiness. It lathers well. It has a fresh, clean smell. The conditioner is not as thick, but definitely adequate. I really like the serum. It has a mint/menthol type effect and causes a pleasant tingling. I like having the heat protectant to protect my hair from the heating tools. I haven't noticed any new hair growth lately, but I have noticed less hair loss in the shower. My hair has been pretty soft and manageable, too. Overall, I am enjoying this set of hair products!

title: Decent!
text: I used this organizer to replace an even larger one that I had. I felt that the other one had too large of a footprint and took up too much of the limited counter space. Overall, this is decent. The quality is average. The edges and shelves are thinner than the other one that I had. The other one was made from thicker plastic and felt more heavy duty. The edges or lips of this organizer are short and doesn't keep items from falling off as easily as my older one. I do like the part that allows you to store brushes, though I found that the thinner brush handles need to be stored in the corner section or else they slide all the way out. The thicker handled brushes seem to do okay in there. It spins slowly, which I prefer. My other one spun too fast and things would often fall off in mid-spin. Putting it together was easy and quick. I like it.

title: Smells Nice!
text: When I'm selecting a shampoo/conditioner set, I'm looking for a few things. First of all, I want it to smell nice. A bad smelling shampoo is the worst. If it doesn't smell good, I either pass it along to another family member or throw it away. Second, I want it to leave my hair feeling soft. I want my fingers to be able to run through my hair without getting caught. Thirdly, I want it to be gentle on my color treated hair. And lastly, as a bonus, I want it to help with the hair loss that I'm beginning to deal with related to aging. This set has a very nice, lightly fruity scent. It doesn't linger, but it smells really good while in the shower. I can easily run my fingers through my hair. It leaves my hair very soft. I haven't noticed any improvement with hair loss, but it's not claiming to solve that anyway. Overall, I am pleased with this set.

title: Quality Serum
text: I have a multi-step skin care routine for both morning and night. My nighttime one calls for Retinol, so I'm always looking for good serums with Retinol for my routine. This one has a very pleasant scent. It's not tacky or sticky. I give a moment to absorb before following up with a night cream. It seems to be a quality serum.

title: Moisturizing
