text: I like the ease of use that goes along with sheet masks. This is the first time I've used one specifically for the neck area. I received a set of four masks. They have minimal English included and no instructions on how to use it. I had to go by the picture on the packet. The mask is fully saturated with serum (or whatever it is) and I had to squeeze some of the excess out. It doesn't stay in place very well and kept slipping down my neck. I tried to limit my movement in order to keep it in place. While I haven't seen any miraculous results from it, I did find it to be very moisturizing. I massaged the remaining serum into my skin afterwards. Overall, it was okay.

title: Nice Variety!
text: This is a nice variety of beauty blenders. The color is dark enough that they don't look stained as much after use. They seem comparable to other brands of similar type blenders.

title: Gentle!
text: This bar of soap is gentle and doesn't dry out my skin. I got the mandarin one, but I couldn't tell that by the scent. It smells like unscented soap to me. It produces a moderate amount of lather. I like that it's made from just a few ingredients!

title: Nice Storage!
text: This provides nice storage for my lipsticks. It definitely makes it easier to see my lipstick options. Most of my lip glosses and liquid lipsticks stick out too much and then get knocked out easily, so I won't be keeping them in there. If I stored it on horizontally, it would work, but I don't have that much free space on my counter. My Fenty lip gloss base is too large and won't even fit into any of the slots. The unit is sturdy and doesn't require any assembly.

title: Disappointing
text: I was very excited to give this a try. However, I found the experience quite disappointing. I've tried it twice. The first time I tried it, after about five minutes into it, I realized that I hadn't completely thought it all out and needed one of my hands. I tried to speed things up by using a fan, but it didn't show any signs of hardening, so I had to wipe/wash it all off. So that was all my fault. I tried again, and was prepared to just sit on the bed and watch TV while allowing it to harden. After 20 minutes, my hands still didn't show any signs of hardening. They were sticky and tacky. I gave it another five minutes before giving up. I tried washing it all off but wasn't having a lot of luck. I had to use a sugar scrub to exfolilate it off of my hands. So overall, very disappointing. The product itself looks like honey but a little clearer. It has a mild, pleasant scent. I'm not sure if I will try it again, but if I do and I have better success, I will update my review.

title: Gentle!
text: I am in my early fifties and have been following a multi-step skincare routine for the last few years. This is not a heavy cream, but more like a light lotion. It is gentle on my skin and doesn't irritate me. It absorbs quickly into my thirsty skin. It has a pump dispenser and it takes about 3 or 4 pumps to cover my face, neck, and decolletage.

title: Softens Dry Skin
text: This is a fairly light face cream. It does a good job of softening dry skin. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. The scent is a light, woodsy scent which is okay, but not my favorite. It's not foul smelling, so I can deal with it. I haven't noticed any new amazing results since using this, but I wouldn't expect that since I've been regularly using anti-aging products for the last few years.

title: Pleasantly Surprised!
text: I usually use salon brand hair products, so I was pleasantly surprised with this drug store brand. I tried an Herbal Essences set many years ago and wasn't impressed. I am very pleased with this one. It has a nice, light floral scent. I expected something stronger as far as scent goes, but it's not very strong. It has a nice lather. The consistency of the shampoo is thick and creamy. The conditioner is also a good consistency. It rinses well. Lately I have been using hair products targeting hair loss. I'm in my early fifties and the amount of hair left behind in the shower drain has increased lately. I was surprised that the amount of hair left behind with this set has been pretty small and it doesn't claim to help with hair loss! It also left my hair very soft. That's one of the things I look for in my hair products, so that was good. It's a great find!

title: Nice Serum!
text: I have a multi-step skin care routine for both morning and night. I found it online and have been following it for almost a couple of years now. Vitamin C serum is part of the morning routine. This one is a good serum. It's a thicker consistency than many similar serums. It's a little sticky at first, but it dries quickly and leaves no stickiness or tackiness behind. At first I really didn't notice any scent, but I applied some directly to the back of my hand and could detect a faint grapefruit scent. It doesn't last long, but it smelled quite nice. My teenage daughter is a fan of the brand and likes their Disco Kitten mask!

title: Quick Absorption
text: I use vitamin C serums every morning as part of my skincare routine. This one has a mild scent. It doesn't smell a lot like citrus fruit as some vitamin C serums. Instead, I detect an herbal or essential oil smell to it. It has a quick absorption rate. It doesn't feel tacky or sticky after it has been applied. It is comparable to other good serums that I have used.

title: Nice, Light Cream
text: This face cream is becoming a favorite of mine. It's light and almost airy. It absorbs really quickly and doesn't leave behind a heavy or greasy feeling. It smells amazing. It's a very light, sweet and fruity scent. The scent doesn't linger. My face feels moisturized with it where after some day creams, I still feel the need to apply a moisturizer after the application.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: This coffee scrub is different than I expected. I have tried other coffee scrubs and they were drier and more like loose coffee grounds. This one is a thicker, waxy substance. It exfoliates nicely, but also moisturizes. It smells amazing! It's a chocolaty coffee scent with a hint of orange. It reminds me of those chocolate oranges that they sell at Christmas time. Because it's a little waxy, it does take a little longer to rinse. It's a nice addition to the shower routine.

title: Perfect Travel Set!
text: This sample set of Ursa Major's skincare line is perfect for traveling or as an introduction to their products. I have enjoyed giving them a try. The face wipes are larger than I expected and did a nice job of cleansing. I liked the face toner a lot. It's a spray bottle and I sprayed it onto a cotton round. All of the products have a natural, earthy scent which I assume comes from essential oils. It's not my favorite scent, but it's not foul or off putting. It says that this is a two week trial, but it lasted not quite a week for me.

title: Goes On Smoothly
text: Luckily for me, I don't need to use concealer every day, but every now and then if I don't get enough sleep, I dab a little underneath my eyes. This a creamy and light concealer. It doesn't have any discernible scent or smell to it. It blends nicely. My eyes water a lot and it doesn't sting my eyes when I do. I'm not sure the color is right for me, but it probably will be better in the summer when I've got a little more color. Overall, it is a good, reliable product.

title: Works Nicely!
text: I am in my early fifties. I've recently started having skin sensitivities to some face products. I've experienced redness, splotches, burning and stinging at different times. I haven't really been able to pinpoint what triggers my sensitivity issues. I would estimate that it happens about 10 to 15% of the time. This cleanser has been very gentle. It has not caused any irritations. It has a clean, soapy smell to it. It doesn't lather, but it does seem to cleanse well. It doesn't leave my skin feeling overly dry or tight. It's a good, gentle cleanser

title: Nice Night Time Cream
text: I am in my early fifties. I've been following a multi-step skin care routine for morning and a different one at night. This is a heavier cream and designed for nighttime. It seems to be unscented and doesn't really smell like anything. It is a little greasy, but in the morning, my skin has been hydrated and supple.

title: Very Nice Eye Cream!
text: I'm in my early fifties. I added eye creams to my skincare routine a few years ago. This one is a very nice one. My eyes are very sensitive and often sting if a skin product gets even close to my eyes. That makes it difficult to find something that I can actually apply around my eyes! This one doesn't sting, burn, irritate or annoy my eyes at all. One pump is enough to cover the area below my eyes and all the way above to the brow line and eyelid. I don't really notice any magical results, but to be honest, since I've been using eye creams for a few years now, I think it's just continuing what has already been started. Oh, and I didn't mention the bottle. It is a very pretty gold glass bottle. It's one of the fanciest looking eye creams that I have ever seen!

title: Nice Clean Scent
text: This toner has a nice clean scent. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It does a good job of getting the dirt that gets left behind after cleansing my face. I don't notice any exfoliating results, but I'm not always the most observant person. I am pleased with how it is deep cleaning my skin.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I have a multi-step skin care routine for mornings and a different one for evenings. This is a heavier cream, so I have been using it at night. It's not too heavy, though, and could be used in the morning, too. It has a light, pleasant herbal scent. It absorbs pretty well. It's non-irritating to my sensitive skin. I haven't noticed any new amazing results, but since I've been using an assortment of creams, serums, and lotions geared toward anti-aging for the last few years, I wouldn't expect to see anything new and radical. It does a good job of hydrating my skin. Overall, I like it.

title: Weird, But In a Good Way
text: I had never heard of shower jelly before, until I saw this. I found it  to be weird, but in a good way. It looks and feels just like jello. You rub it on your skin and it becomes more like a creamy body wash. It does take a bit of working at it to get it to finish rinsing. A loofah sponge would be helpful at this stage. It's very moisturizing. Oh, and it smells amazing! It's a wonderful, orange scent that doesn't smell artificial. I will definitely be on the lookout for more shower jelly in the future!

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I have tried a couple of the CannaSmack body lotions and this is my favorite. It has a pleasant peachy scent. The lotion is a good consistency and absorbs nicely. The winter months can be very drying and my skin just drinks this up! It leaves my skin feeling soft and supple.  It comes with a pump dispenser. It takes several pumps to get enough lotion to cover my body.

title: Exfoliates Nicely
text: I have had a few other face peel products and this was not what I expected. The others that I have used leave little pieces of dead skin in little clumps and you have to wipe that off. I'm not a fan of those personally, but that's what they've done. This one doesn't do that, but it does exfoliate nicely. This morning I woke up and my husband asked me if I had bruised my face. Well, I just woke up and didn't remember doing anything that would leave a bruise, so I went to the mirror and noticed some black patches of something. I washed my face with soap and water and it didn't come off. By then, I realize that the black came from a new sleeping mask that I had worn to bed last night. (I guess I won't be wearing that again!) So I got a face scrub out and washed my face with that. The black stuff didn't come off. I was beginning to panic because the black stuff was quite noticeable! I thought I would give this a try. I had used it a few times already and didn't have any skin sensitivity issues with it. One pad actually got rid of at least 90% of the black stuff. It really does exfoliate!!  I've been using face scrubs and exfoliants regularly a couple times a week for the past few years. While this one is different, it does a good job.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: This vegan face cleanser is gentle on my skin. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me at all. I also have sensitive eyes and even though I keep cleansers out of direct contact with my eyes, sometimes just being in the vicinity of my eyes causes them to burn or sting. This does not bother me at all. It produces a minimal lather. It has a clean, soap like smell to it. It doesn't dry out my skin either. I like the pump dispenser. Overall, it's a good, basic cleanser.

title: Hydrating!
text: Hyaluronic serum is a regular part of my bedtime skincare routine. This specific serum has a clean, barely noticeable scent. It is a thicker serum and does take a little longer to absorb than some others that I have tried. It is very hydrating. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate, burn, or sting my face. I've been using serums like this for at last several years, so I wouldn't expect to see anything new as far as results go because I've probably already achieved them. This is a good product to continue to see those results.

title: Nice Absorption!
text: I have been using vitamin C serums every morning for the last few years. This one seems to be a good one so far. It has a light, citrus smell to it, like most other similar serums. It has a nice absorption rate and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or tacky. While I haven't noticed any new results from using this serum, I have been trying it on the back of one of my hands. Right after applying it, my hand feels soft and the pores and skin cells seem smaller. Since I am a regular user of this type of serum, I wouldn't expect to see anything radically different in the overall or general appearance of my skin. I have sensitive skin and this product doesn't burn or sting.

title: Wow!
text: I have thick, coarse hair. I get it colored with a semi-permanent color every couple of months to transition back to my natural hair color after years of highlighting it. I'm in my early fifties and have started to notice some gray hair. I like to deep condition my hair at least once a week. This hair mask smells nice. It's a thick cream consistency. I didn't follow the instructions and leave it on for thirty minutes, but I was pleased with the results anyway. I left it on my hair for about 10 minutes in the shower. I was very surprised at how soft my hair was after it dried. I kept running my hands through my hair because it was so soft!! I am very pleased with the results!

title: Comfortable!
text: I've recently grown out my bangs and that's opened up the world of elastic headbands! I could never get them to look good on me with my bangs. This set comes with a variety of solid colors. They stretch enough to fit comfortably. The rabbit ears have wire in them to keep them positioned nicely. My daughter and I have split this package up between the two of us and we are both happy with them.

title: Smells Wonderful!
text: This hair oil comes in a small vial. It only takes a small amount of oil per use, so I should be able to get several uses out of it. The oil smells wonderful! I can't pinpoint the scent, but it reminds me of a light fruity, vanilla, coconut blend, but of course, I could be way off base there! Regardless, it smells nice. The oil is easy to work into my damp hair. I use a blowdryer styling brush to style my hair after it's mostly had time to air dry. I notice a little more shine to my hair. I grew up with the belief that shiny hair is healthy hair! It doesn't weigh down my hair nor does it make it look greasy. I am pleased with it.

title: Moisturizing
text: It's winter time which means it's time for dry lips! I found this lip oil to be very moisturizing. I liked the feel of it on my lips and I found it to be long lasting. I didn't notice any scent or flavor to it. It's not sticky either. What I didn't care for was the color. At first, it didn't seem to bad, but it actually started staining my lips. The color is a fuchsia and too bright on me. I reapplied it a couple of times during the day and the color just got brighter and brighter. I had to use a lip scrub to get the color lightened. So while I wasn't crazy about that color, I do like what it does to my lips. I am limiting myself to no more than one application a day. I'm interested to learn if they have any more natural colors.

title: Even Cuter in Person!
text: This assortment of hair clips looks even cuter in person! I am so pleased with it. There are a variety of styles and types of clips. I wasn't sure how the sizing would be from the pictures, but they are sized for adults, not little children.

title: Cute!
text: I've recently grown out my bangs and I can finally wear head bands and wraps now! This is a cute assortment of knotted ones. They are all in a bandanna print, each a different color. They stretch well and are very comfortable to wear.

title: Lovely Scent!
text: My 22 year old son has a mass of long curly hair. He basically has Bob Ross's hair style.  It does get frizzy a lot, so I thought this might be helpful. He loves the smell of it. It's a strong, coconut scent. The set comes with a shampoo, conditioner, and leave in conditioner spray. My son goes through twice as much conditioner as he does shampoo, so I will have to buy him an additional conditioner. His hair dresser recommends that he doesn't shampoo every day, but on the days he doesn't shampoo, she has him apply conditioner. The shampoo has a nice lather. It rinses well. The conditioner is a good consistency. He doesn't always remember to use the leave in conditioner. If it was in the shower, he would, but since he needs to towel off his hair first, he keeps it in his medicine cabinet. I haven't noticed much difference in the frizz levels, but he has and is pleased with it. He says he has also noticed that his hair is pretty soft.

title: Refreshing!
text: This setting spray has a nice spray mist. It's refreshing. I don't notice any difference in the longevity of my makeup, but that's the same with all setting sprays. I'm not very observant! It does give a light dewy appearance.

title: Well...
text: Well....this is a hard one. I like how this leaves my skin feeling after applying it, but the smell is so bad I'm not sure I can continue using it. It smells like nail polish remover. And it's a very strong smell. It doesn't linger, thankfully. I'm wondering if I got a bad batch.  With ingredients listed such as grapefruit oil, I was expecting a much more pleasant scent. I've tried many different vitamin C serums and they usually do smell a little citrusy. It has a slightly oily feel to it but it doesn't leave behind any oiliness. It leaves my skin feeling very soft afterwards. I put some on the back of one of my hands and the side with the serum not only feels softer, but it looks smoother, too. So right now, I'm undecided as to whether or not I will continue using.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I am in my early fifties. I have coarse, thick hair. I have started getting semi-permanent color from the salon to transition back to my natural hair color after years of highlights. I have a couple of grey strands of hair, so I'm expecting more to come. I have noticed more shedding recently. This shampoo and conditioner set has a pleasant, mild floral scent. The shampoo produces a slight lather and rinses well. The conditioner is thinner than most conditioners. It's probably about the same consistency as the shampoo. I haven't really noticed any difference in the amount of hair left behind in the shower drain or in my shedding. I've tried their hemp line geared toward hair loss and I did notice an improvement with that. It does leave my hair feeling very soft and manageable.

title: Hydrating!
text: I do like this body lotion, but I don't love it. It's very hydrating and does a good job of moisturizing my skin. I'm just not crazy about the scent. I love citrus scented products, but I can barely detect any citrus notes. I also detect spices - not sure if it's clove or cinnamon. Luckily the scent doesn't linger around much. The lotion is very thick, almost a cream. I have been unable to get any of the product to dispense from the pump. So either the pump is defective or it's too thick. I unscrewed the pump and have gotten it out that way.

title: Trusted Brand
text: I am in my early fifties and over the last few years, my eyelashes have become sparser. I have very sensitive eyes and am hesitant to use some products because of sensitivity issues I've had with similar products. Neutrogena is a trusted brand that I was willing to try. The first time I used this, I had a slight burning sensation in my eyes, but it was tolerable and not that bad. On subsequent applications, I did not experience any burning. So either I was better about the application and didn't get any in my eyes or it was something else that cause the burn. I've been following the directions and applying at night. I must say that I really haven't noticed any changes in my lashes, but I realize it may take time and patience. If I do see any growth, I will update my report.

title: Absorbs Well!
text: I am in my early fifties. I've been using various serums and creams specifically for anti-aging regularly for the past few years. This serum is one of the better ones that I have tried as far as the product itself. It's difficult to pinpoint the actual individual items and their effectiveness since I use several different products concurrently. But as an individual product, I really like this one. It has an amazing scent to it. It's a pleasant citrus smell - possibly grapefruit. The consistency of the serum in really good, too. It's thick, almost gel like, but it's not sticky and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. It absorbs well and my skin feels moisturized afterwards. It doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. This serum comes in a dropper style dispenser. That's not my favorite type of dispenser, but it's okay. Overall, I really like this one!

title: Very Minty
text: I love mint lotion, but this was mintier than I expected. I apply lotion all over my skin every morning and night. I used this lotion as an allover body moisturizer and was a bit surprised by the tingly sensation. My body was still tingling twenty minutes after application. It actually reminds me of my favorite peppermint foot lotion. I like my tired feet and calves to tingle, but it was weird for my arms and thighs for so long after. I'm not crazy about the strong mint smell either. There's another note that I can detect that interferes with the mint and makes me not like it. The lotion absorbs well and doesn't leave me feeling sticky or greasy. I probably won't use this as a body lotion any longer, but it will be great for a foot lotion!

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: I love the Vichy brand and have been pleased with all of their products that I have tried. This micellar water does a good job of getting what the cleansers leave behind. I don't notice much of a scent to it. It doesn't over dry my skin nor does it irritate it. The bottle size is quite generous and should last a while. The only thing that I don't like is the dispenser. It has a pump style dispenser which works fine, it's just that since it's a fairly liquid consistency, it's sprays out further than the width of my cotton ball thus making a mess every time I use it.

title: Works Nicely!
text: I am in my early fifties and deal with unwanted facial hair. I'm a wimp when it comes to hair removal. I've tried all kinds of products to remove hair and this type of hair remover is by far the best.  I've tried others that claim to be pain free, but they really aren't! There is literally no pain at all from this. It is comparable to the "seen on TV" one that I've purchased. I have a couple of slightly raised moles on my face and this works nicely to remove the hair that grows around it without hurting the surface of the mole. It's pretty quiet and easy to use. The only issue with these types of hair removal products is that the blades wear down after a while. I have tried replacing the blades, but haven't had any luck with that. There are different sizes and each one seems to use a different one. So as wasteful as it is, I end up replacing mine once or twice a year.

title: Light Pleasant Scent
text: I use a toner daily in my skincare routine. I've used other rose water toners, so I was excited to try this one. This one is a spray mist toner. I've never used a spray one before. The first time I used it, I did mist my face with it, but I didn't really like that. Since then, I've been spraying a cotton ball and then wiping it on my face and I have been happy with that procedure. It has a light pleasant rose scent. It's non irritating on my sensitive skin, which is a huge plus for me. It doesn't seem to dry out my skin. It removes dirt left from cleansing. I will probably be going through it a lot faster since I'm not spraying it on my face directly!

title: I Found it to Be Drying
text: I have a separate morning and evening skin care routine, so I was happy to find a serum specifically for nighttime. I also tried their morning serum. While I really liked the morning one, I'm not crazy about this one. I found it to be a bit drying. I am neutral about the scent. It's not bad, but it's not good either. It absorbs really quickly into my skin. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It isn't sticky. After using the serum, I put a night cream on my face and it seemed to absorb more than usual after applying it on top of the serum. Overall, I think it's just okay.

title: Gentle!
text: I am in my early fifties. My skin has sensitivities to some skin care products. This face cream is thick enough that I agree with it being called a cream, as opposed to a lotion. It has a light rose scent that doesn't over power or linger. The cream absorbs well, but it doesn't leave my face feeling moisturized or supple. At the same time, it doesn't seem to be over drying it either. It's gentle and I have not had any issues regarding sensitivity with it.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: I find this cleanser to be gentle on my skin. Some cleansers leave my face red and this does not. It also doesn't sting or burn my eyes which some products do even without getting the product directly in my eyes. It has a light, rose scent that's not over powering nor does it linger. It does seem to leave my skin feeling a little dry afterwards as opposed to feeling moisturized. I really like the pump dispenser. It's easy to use. The cleanser has a moderate amount of lather. It rinses clean. Overall, I do like it.

title: Leaves Hair Feeling Soft!
text: I am in my early fifties. My hair is thick and fairly coarse. I have minimal gray - just a couple of strands so far. I have recently started having it colored with a semi permanent color so I can transition back to my natural brown hair color after years of blonde highlights. I have noticed an increase in the amount of shedding lately. This shampoo and conditioner set has been pretty gentle on my hair so far. It has a natural, herbal scent to it that's not very strong. The shampoo is a thick consistency and lathers nicely. The conditioner is not as thick as I expected. It's a thinner consistency but it's not runny. They leave my hair feeling very soft. It hasn't stopped all of the shedding, but I've noticed less hair in the shower drain which is a win for me!

title: Nice Neutral Color
text: I prefer lip glosses over lipsticks. I find them to be a little more moisturizing. This is a new brand to me. It's a nice neutral color. It's not sticky or gooey. Lasting power is comparable to other regular lip glosses and depends on whether or not you are eating or drinking. It's a little on the small size, but it's seems to be good.

title: Absorbs Well!
text: I am in my early fifties and use face serums daily. I like that this one is specifically designed for morning use. It has a light, refreshing scent. It absorbs well and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. I use this after washing and toning my face. I follow up with my moisturizer. I really like the brand!

title: Very Aromatic!
text: This body wash is very aromatic! It has a strong eucalyptus scent that really does clear your sinuses! The wash is a moderately thick consistency. It doesn't produce much of a lather. It doesn't dry out my skin. Overall, I like this body wash.

title: Good For Travels
text: These clear bags are good for traveling. They seem to be sturdy enough, but time will tell. The zippers glide easily. I've tugged on them and there has been no indication that they will break anytime soon. The bags hold a decent amount of products and look much nicer than quart size freezer bags. For a set of three, this is a good value.

title: Doesn't Smear
text: I don't wear mascara every day, but it is something I will put on if I'm going out. But if I am just hanging out at home, I don't bother with it. One coat is adequate, but if I am trying to get really noticeable lashes, then I apply an additional one or two coats. It doesn't smear or rub off very easily. I don't think I have the water proof version. Some mascaras leave black smudges underneath my eyes and I haven't noticed that with this mascara. I've had minimal clumping with this. It hasn't been completely clump free, but it most of the applications don't end up with clumping. Overall, I am pleased with it, but it doesn't seem to be better than other drug store brands.

title: Smells Nice
text: I am in my early fifties and have been noticing more hair loss. I know it often has to do with aging. This shampoo smells nice. It produces a good lather. It's a big bottle and it comes with a pump dispenser. So far I have not noticed any difference in the amount of hair I have been losing. If I notice any less hair loss after continued use, I will update my review.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I am in my early fifties have had been noticing some hair loss, primarily seeing hair in the shower drain. This conditioner has a pleasant scent. It's a nice creamy consistency. It rinses fine. I haven't noticed any less hair loss so far, but if that changes, I will come back and give an update. It doesn't leave my hair feeling soft either. Those two issues make it just okay in my opinion.

title: Good Cleanser
text: This is a good cleanser. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It doesn't over dry my skin either. It's not a foamy cleanser and leaves my face feeling clean and soft.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I have really sensitive eyes and I found this eye cream to be non-irritating. I haven't had any stinging or burning with it. It's a thick, cream and absorbs nicely. One full pump of the product is too much for both of my eyes, so I have been pressing it lightly so I only get about half of that amount. I apply it underneath my eye, as well as around the lid to the brow. I haven't noticed any major improvement with my fine lines and wrinkles, but I'm realistic and don't expect any magical results. Overall, I am pleased with it so far.

title: Nice Consistency
text: This foot scrub has a nice consistency, but I found that it wasn't very gritty. Because of that, it didn't really do much as far as exfoliating goes. It smells pleasant. My feet do feel moisturized after using it.

title: Good Absorption
text: This serum has a pleasant citrus scent to it. It has good absorption and doesn't leave my fingers or face feeling sticky. The dispenser works well. I've been using two pumps to cover my face and neck area. I haven't seen any new miraculous changes to my skin, but I wouldn't expect that anyway. I'm a regular user of various serums already. Overall, I like it.

title: Sturdy!
text: These nail clippers are very nice. They are much sturdier than the cheap ones I've picked up at the store. They just feel heavy and solid. They cut well. They come in a giftable tin and would make a nice stocking stuffer.

title: Leaves Hair Feeling Soft!
text: I'm in my early 50's and in peri-menopause. I've always had thick, coarse hair and so far, I still do. Currently it's about chin length.  I had it highlighted for the last several years, but I've grown tired with the root maintenance. I recently started getting semi-permanent color so my hair can transition back to its natural color. I have minimal gray, but I am not afraid of it. Once I've gotten to the point where my highlighted hair has grown out, I will stop with the semi-permanent color. Because of the thickness, I've always had some daily hair loss as noted by the shower drain catch but I have not noticed any thinning of my hair. This shampoo and conditioner set has a light, pleasant scent. The peppermint isn't very strong, especially when compared to the Pureology shampoo that I used before this. I don't notice any tingling either. It's a somewhat thick consistency and not runny. It doesn't produce much of a lather. Though there is more lather in the second application than the first. It rinses fine. I don't notice a "squeaky clean" sensation. The conditioner is a thicker consistency. It also rinses well. There has still been hair loss, of about the same amount as my previous shampoo. It's been about a week into using it so far. If I notice a significant change in the amount of hair loss after more use, I will update my review. It does leave my hair feeling noticeably soft and manageable. I wash my hair every other day and haven't noticed any drastic changes in my hair color. Since my color is semi-permanent, it does slowly fade. So as a shampoo/conditioner set, I am pleased with it. The jury is still out as to whether or not it reduces hair loss.

title: Large Size!
text: I've bought jumbo sized cotton balls before and have been disappointed in their size. These cotton balls are really jumbo! I was very pleasantly surprised by this. They're very absorbent. I have to watch how much product I put on them because it's easy to over saturate them. I have had a few of them pull apart a little too easily, but they're still usable. Overall, I am very pleased with them.

title: Nice Color!
text: This lip gloss is pretty good. It is comparable to other drug store brands. It's not sticky. I was worried that the pink color would be too bright, but it's not. It's a natural looking pink. There's a slight shimmer or sparkle to it.  It doesn't taste like anything, nor do I notice much of a  scent. It lasts as long as other regular lip glosses and does transfer onto glassware.

title: Nice Color!
text: This skin milk reminds me a lot of BB Cream. It's lighter than traditional foundation and very moisturizing. It does have a scent to it which I can't place. It reminds me of almond milk, but different. (I know that's vague, but it's the best I can do!). I've used it several times so far. 4 out of 5 times it looked great. The fifth time, it was cakey and I ended up removing it and reapplying. I'm in my early 50's and realize that the issues I have with my aging skin may not be the targeted audience. Before I apply it, I put on serum and moisturizer and sometimes a primer. The color is nice on me. I would definitely consider reordering this.

title: Non-Sticky
text: I tend to wear lip glosses more than lip sticks. This one is not sticky at all. It's a very pale, neutral peachy color. It doesn't really have any taste or scent to it. It lasts a while and doesn't absorb into my lips quickly. Of course, eating or drinking shortens that amount of time. Overall, I do like it.

title: Great Neutral Shade
text: I don't usually wear matte lipsticks, but this one is quite nice. It's not over drying in appearance. The color is a great neutral shade. It lasts fairly long, too. There was a sticker on the case which was difficult to get it off. Other than that, I am pleased with it.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: The first thing I noticed when using this toner was the smell. It has a very strong alcohol smell to it. Fortunately the smell does dissipate rather quickly. Once you get that past that, it's a fine toner. It doesn't sting or burn my sensitive skin. It removes dirt and oil. It doesn't over dry or strip my skin.  Overall, I am pleased with it.

title: Nice Red Lipstick!
text: This is a very nice red lipstick. The red color looks a bit red-orange in the tube, but when applied it has more of the blue undertones which is more flattering. It applies well and with only one swipe on the lips. It's nicely pigmented. I  was surprised at how much sparkle it has! The color is difficult to wipe off and leaves flecks of glitter. I have had to use a lip scrub to get it totally off.  Overall, I am very impressed with this new lippie!

title: Smells Amazing!
text: This facial cleanser smells amazing!! It's a wonderful citrus fruit scent. It lathers nicely and does a good job of cleansing. It's gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin either. I am very pleased with it.

title: More Purple Than Expected
text: The color of this lip gloss is more purple than I expected. I thought it was going to be more of a berry color.  It's a little sticky, but it's not too annoying. The glossy part wears off, but it does leave behind a little bit of color. It doesn't have a bad taste.

title: Nice Scent
text: This hair serum for split ends has a nice scent. It isn't overpowering and smells slightly sweet. The smell doesn't last long. The serum is creamy and more like a lotion than the serums to which I am accustomed. I have been applying it to the ends of my damp, towel dried hair. It leaves my fingers slightly sticky, but it's not too bad. I haven't noticed any difference in my hair, specifically the ends since using this, so I can only assume it's doing the job. It doesn't weigh down my hair or leave it stringy.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: This is a nice face toner. It comes with 2 bottles. The larger one has the toner and the small one has powdered collagen. The box has some instructions in English telling you to combine them, but it didn't give more details about doing so. I added the powder to the larger bottle and then shook it up. It seems to work, but I am not positive that I did it correctly. I shake it up before using it to make sure that there's no settling. The toner doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I seems to do a good job of getting rid of any make up or dirt left behind after cleansing. I haven't noticed any difference to my actual skin's appearance, but I'm pretty consistent about using anti-aging products, I wouldn't expect to notice any thing. Overall, I like it.

title: Slips Out of Hand Easily
text: I love using facial cleansing brushes! They do a great job of cleaning my face. I was excited to try this one because of the unique shape. I like the shape of it, but there is nothing to get a grip on so it slips out of my hands rather easily. It would be nice if there were little indentations to grab onto or if there were ridges along it to help prevent slippage. The brush head is pretty easy to remove. It comes with one replacement brush. The brushes are different from others that I have on hand, so I'm not sure what I would do when I need to replacement mine. It doesn't appear that the company sells them. The brush is easy to use and has two speeds. I really like the lid that goes over the brush head because it has little holes to allow water to drain. Overall, it's okay, but not great.

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: I am in my early fifties and use a plethora of creams, serums, and lotions on my face. This is a night cream. I found it to be a good consistency. It doesn't absorb right away and it does leave the skin feeling slightly greasy, but that's on par with lots of night creams. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I am not crazy about the scent. It's not foul, it's just not something I like. It's kind of a woodsy scent. I know scent is a personal thing, and just because I'm not crazy about it, others might really like it. I personally prefer fruity, floral, or unscented. I haven't noticed any changes to my skin, but since I am a regular user of such products, I wouldn't expect to see anything different.

title: Nice!
text: I use a gel eye liner. This brush is so much nicer than the ones that I have been using! The hairs are stiff enough to draw a smooth line. The double end gives you options for applying the eye liner. I haven't noticed any brush hair loss. It has covers to protect the ends which is especially nice if you store the brush upright. I am very impressed with this make up brush!

title: Cute But Impractical
text: This lipstick case is darling! I really do like the kitty design. However, when I ordered this, I thought it was a universal lipstick case, but it's not. It's designed to fit the Paul & Joe lipsticks and only ones from 2017 or newer. Well, of course I ordered one of their lipsticks so I could properly try out this case. It does fit the case, but it does come out a little too easily. The case is cardboard and will not last long term. It reminds me a lot of the Tarte lipsticks. Their lipsticks are in a similar tube type container, but you don't have to purchase theirs separately. So while I do think this is cute, I also think it's very impractical.

title: Good Basic Tweezers
text: Tweezers disappear at my house. I'm sure there is a stock pile of them somewhere, probably in my teenage daughter's bedroom! These are good, basic tweezers. They have the slanted tips. There is nothing on them to keep them from slipping. I have one pair that has rough sides so they are easier to grip which is nice.  They feel sturdy enough. There's nothing really fancy about them. They're just good tweezers.

title: Non Irritating
text: The Pretty Vulgar cosmetic line is pretty new to me. I received an eye palette in a subscription box last year, but other than that, I am unfamiliar with them. This blush is pretty good. The color looks bright pink in person, but fortunately it goes on lighter and more natural looking. With a heavy hand, you can get a darker, pinker color. It lasts a few hours. It doesn't irritate my skin. Overall, it's a nice product.

title: Pleasant Masculine Scent
text: I wasn't sure what to expect from this lotion. I thought maybe it would be unscented, but no, it has a definite men's aftershave scent to it. It's pleasant and not very strong. It doesn't have a pump dispenser, but the top pushes up so you can squirt the lotion out without altogether removing the top. It absorbs well and doesn't leave your hands feeling too greasy, though they do feel slightly slippery after applying it.

title: Gentle Cleanser
text: This is a light facial cleanser. It foams nicely and leaves behind clean, soft skin. There's a pleasant, but light natural scent. I have really sensitive eyes that some face cleansers irritate, but this one does not. It also doesn't leave my skin looking red or splotchy. I like it!

title: Gentle Exfoliant
text: I exfoliate my skin a couple of times a week. I'm always on the look out for good facial scrubs. This is fairly gentle and would probably be fine as a daily exfoliant. It has an amazing, fruity scent that doesn't linger. The scrub foams a little bit. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or eyes. It doesn't over dry or strip my face. I am a fan!

title: Not a Creamy Mousse
text: This is not a creamy mousse. It does foam a bit, but the foam dissipates almost immediately when you touch it. I've tried shaking it and shaking it and that doesn't change the consistency. I have found that it works best when I apply it directly to my roots, rather than to my hands first. Then I work it into my hair. It does seem to give my hair some lift to it. It does leave my hair a little crunchy where it has been applied. It doesn't irritate my scalp or burn my eyes. Overall, it's okay. However, at the price point, it's not something I would continue purchasing.

title: Light Weight Moisturizer
text: This is a light weight moisturizer. It absorbs quickly and leaves a smooth finish. It has a mild scent that's barely detectable. It doesn't annoy my sensitive skin nor does it feel greasy.

title: Non Greasy
text: This body cream is light and non-greasy. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave your hands feeling sticky. The scent is not very strong, but it has light fruity notes to it. It does a good job of moisturizing my dry skin.

title: Nice Set of Products
text: I am in my early 50's and I take my skincare routine very seriously. I keep a list of all the steps/product types on my mirror so I don't forget something. In addition to my daily routine, there are a few things that I do twice a week, such as exfoliating scrubs and masks. This scrub is pretty gentle and I don't think it would be a problem to use it daily. You can barely feel the grains in it. The scent is light and refreshing. It did not leave any redness or irritation to my somewhat sensitive skin. The mask is a one time use thing. It's pretty goopy. The directions say to leave it on for 15-20 minutes. I left it on for 20 minutes, but some of the edges weren't dry yet. I waited a couple more minutes, then started to remove it. It peeled off pretty well. I've had better ones as far as peel-ability, but this did come off mostly in just a couple of pieces. I had to use a washcloth to get some of the pieces off. It did leave behind some redness to my face. The bottle of drops is pretty small. I'm assuming it's more of a sample. I liked it. I used it before putting my moisturizer on. It absorbs well and doesn't leave behind any stickiness. Overall, it's a nice set of products. The presentation is not really suitable for gifting.

title: Great Flavors!
text: This set of lip balm has some great flavors! My favorite is the orange. They glide on easily and immediately moisten the lips. It's not waxy or greasy. It does absorb pretty rapidly which requires additional applications.

title: Great Blades
text: My husband recently started using the Gillette Fusion 5 blade razor after getting his razors and blades from the Dollar Shave Club for years. He has been pleased with the closer shave that he gets from this. The refills seem comparable to what I can get at the local store. Overall, we're happy with these.

title: Beautiful Presentation!
text: This cleansing cream has beautiful presentation. It's probably the prettiest jar that I've ever seen. It looks very high end. The product itself, is just okay. First of all, the smell is pretty strong. I don't mind strong scents, but this was a very familiar one with notes of lemon. I love lemon scents, but this one is artificial. And when I finally figured out what it reminded me, that was a huge turn off. It smells just like dishwasher detergent! I had difficulties getting past that. The cream is very oily. I tried using it both ways - rinsing it with warm water and wiping off with a tissue. In both instances, my face didn't feel clean afterwards. This type of cleanser is not for me.

title: Absorbs Well!
text: I am in my early 50's and have been regularly using anti-aging products for the last few years. One of my areas of concern is my neck and decolletage. I decided to use this primarily on those areas since I have lots of facial creams and moisturizers. This absorbs well and doesn't have any noticeable scent or fragrance. I haven't noticed much difference in decolletage area, but this does work very well on my neck/throat area. It has an immediate firming effect on my neck. It is a temporary effect, but very noticeable. The dispenser requires you to press down on it and it releases a set amount of product. This is helpful in not overusing the product and makes it last longer. Overall, I like this cream.

title: Fragrance Free!
text: I am in my early 50's and have been pretty meticulous about my skincare routine in the last few years. I was unfamiliar with Sake Treatment water prior to this, but I have heard of the Boscia brand. The consistency of this is just like water. It says it preps your skin for serums, so that's where I have added it to my routine - after washing my face, and before I apply my serum. I was using Vichy Mineral 89 for similar purposes. I haven't noticed any difference in my skin texture or appearance, but I think my skin is already in a really good place right now, so it's likely continuing the good results that I have been achieving. It's fragrance free and doesn't really smell like anything. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin either.

title: Nice Lather
text: My family likes to use body wash in the showers. It seems like every few weeks I am buying another bottle for someone. This set of 3 is fairly priced and comparable to other brands that I would purchase at the store. I got the Rain Water Scent. It's a very pleasant, uni-sex scent product. It lathers nicely, but not too foamy. It rinses well and leaves behind a good, clean scent. It's not over drying and does seem to leave my skin feeling soft. I love that the company doesn't test on animals!

title: Light, Pleasant Scent
text: This hair mist has a light, pleasant scent. I have the time to allow my hair to mostly air dry every day. I've been spraying this on my hair right before I dry/style it. I do appreciate that it is also a heat protectant. I'm not really noticing any difference in volume, but it's definitely not weighing my hair down. My hair is pretty thick and coarse to begin, but I have always wanted more volume.

title: Good Set!
text: My 21 year old son recently grew a beard. He lives at home so my husband and I have been going over beard care tips with him. This set arrived just in time. He's been using these products for the last week or so. He uses cleanser and conditioner the most because he keeps them in the shower. They have a mild scent that smells unisex to me. I was expecting a strong masculine scent, so this was a pleasant surprise. I tried some of the moisturizer on the back of my hand.  It wasn't greasy or oily and absorbed well into my skin. Overall, my son likes these products.  I'm happy to see him taking care of his beard!

title: Nice Magnification!
text: This mirror requires some assembly. It was easy to put together and took just a few minutes. The mirror has nice magnification and swivels well. The base is clear acrylic. It seems sturdy enough to support the weight of the mirror, but it doesn't look as nice as a solid stainless (or other metal material) base would look. I put this in my 18 year old's bathroom because she is not as concerned with the appearance (acrylic base) as I am.

title: Soft Hair!
text: I have color treated hair and try to use hair products especially for that. I've been using this conditioner with the shampoo from the same line. While the shampoo has a spicy/earthy scent, this one has a minty scent. It's not peppermint, but probably the tea tree oil that has a eucalyptus smell to it. It is a thick consistency and rinses well. My hair has been super soft since using this duo! I keep running my fingers through my hair!

title: Leaves My Hair Soft & Silky!
text: I started using salon type shampoos and conditioners a few years ago and have been pretty pleased with the results. My hair has been much softer than before I made the switch. I've been using this conditioner with the same brand of shampoo. It has a mild, but pleasant exotic scent. I can get by without having to use a whole lot of product. It rinses well. And most importantly, it leaves my hair soft and silky. It is a little more expensive than my usual ones which would probable impact whether or not I purchase it in the future.

title: Great Selection of Colors!
text: My daughter got a UV manicure light for Christmas a couple of years ago. The gel polishes that she had were all light, springy colors. She is very excited with her new darker, fall colors. We bought a set of colors shortly after she got the light. You couldn't tell what the colors were in that set without opening the bottles up. I ended up putting a small blob of polish on the bottles (then covering with tape) so we could see what colors they were. This set has a color sticker on each bottle on the top of the lid!! That really is a wonderful and probably simple feature to add! One coat is okay, but a second coat is pretty vibrant! It's been a few days so far, and it looks day one perfect!

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I am in my early 50's. I have chin length coarse, thick, highlighted hair. My first impression of this shampoo was that the bottle was on the small size. It's larger than travel size, but it seems much smaller than most shampoo bottles. Comparable shampoo bottles seem to have a 10-12 ounces whereas this one has 6.8 ounces. The consistency of the shampoo is fairly thick and not very runny. It produces a small bit of lather. The scent is pleasant, but also hard to pinpoint. It's not a floral or perfume scent. It's not very strong either. I used this with the coordinating conditioner and it had a stronger smell to it. It rinses well. It left my hair feeling fine, but not as soft as some other shampoos do. My hair was manageable. I do like that it's sulfate free and gentle on color treated hair, though I'm not sure I would order it again.

title: Gentle
text: I have somewhat sensitive skin. I'm not really sure what ingredients annoy my skin, but there are some that do. These facial cleansing wipes did not irritate my skin. I haven't been wearing mascara for the past few weeks, following an eye infection, so I can't comment on the ability to remove mascara, but as far as standard daily makeup, it works well. I've used a cotton round with toner after using this and there was no makeup on the round so I think they work really well. The size/thickness is comparable to other wipes out there. There's no scent. I am pleased.

title: Mild Scent
text: I am in my early 50's and have coarse, thick, highlighted hair. I don't have much grey yet - just a few strands. For the last year or so, I've been in the habit of using a hair mask twice a week. I've been really pleased with the results. My hair has been in the best shape ever! I used this with a shampoo for color treated hair by the same brand. The conditioner has a mild scent. I really couldn't figure out what the scent was, but it wasn't a perfume or floral scent. The mask itself is thick and creamy. It rinses well. It left my hair manageable and very soft. The only thing I didn't care for was the actual dispenser. You press on the top for it to dispense and it was really awkward to do so. I have never seen a hair shampoo/conditioner product with that kind of dispenser.

title: Leaves Hair Feeling Soft!
text: I have medium length, coarse, thick, highlighted hair. This shampoo leaves my hair feeling very soft. It is a thick, creamy consistency. At first I thought I might be a conditioner instead, but it's not. It lathers well. The scent is pleasant -kind of a spicy, earthy scent. It's not very strong and the scent doesn't linger. It's gender neutral as far as scents go. Overall, I am pleased with it.

title: I Like the Bottle!
text: This is a pleasant perfume. It's a musky, floral scent. It's not too strong. It sprays a nice mist. It lasts for a few hours before becoming undetectable. I was expecting something more sweet and vanilla scented because of the praline name. I thought maybe it would fade away to a praline scent, but it did not. I still like it, it's just not what I expected. I do really like the bottle. It's different.

title: Great Scent!
text: I use a blow dryer/brush combo every day. I let my hair air dry for a while before doing so, but I like the added protection that my hair gets from sprays designed for that purpose. This has a great scent. It's the one that most of the products in the Moroccanoil line have. It reminds me of a perfumed baby powder. It sprays well. It doesn't leave my hair feeling gross. I apply it when my hair is mostly dry, but before I start styling it with my dryer/brush tool.

title: Goes On Smoothly
text: I don't wear much foundation anymore. I tend to go with a BB Cream or Tinted Moisturizer. This one goes on smoothly. It does settle in my fine lines sometimes and has to be removed and reapplied. The color is pretty good. It tends to stay on for a while, though not all day. By the end of the day, I can't tell that I even put make up that morning. There's not much of a scent. Overall, it's a decent foundation.

title: Detangles Nicely!
text: I have thick, coarse highlighted hair. Conditioner is a must! This Moroccanoil conditioner has a rose scent. While it's fine and not too strong, I prefer the usual Moroccanoil scent. This conditioner detangles nicely and leave my hair soft. It rinses well. It doesn't weigh my hair down. Overall, I am satisfied with it.

title: Good Brush!
text: My hair is not quite shoulder length. It's thick and coarse. I let it air dry for at least an hour, then I blow dry with a round brush. This is has a larger barrel than my other round brushes. I prefer larger barrels because I prefer a looser curl. I found it as easy (or should I say difficult) as any other round brush. I do tend to struggle with using them with a blow dryer. If only I had an extra hand! The handle has a nice grip. Overall, I am pleased.

title: Nice Hand Cream
text: This is a nice hand cream. It's thick and creamy but does not leave behind any greasiness. It absorbs well. It has the pleasant Moroccanoil scent that isn't over powering. It costs more than I would normally spend on a hand cream, but it you don't need to use a lot to hydrate your hands, so it should last a while.

title: Thick & Creamy
text: I have thick, coarse hair. It is highlighted a couple of times per year. I am beginning to see a few grey hairs now and those random greys are frizzier than the rest of my hair. I use a hair mask every Saturday morning. I've been using this one for the past couple of Saturdays. It's thick and creamy. I have used several other Moraccanoil hair products and I've found this one to have a stronger scent than the others. I think I prefer the more subtle smelling ones over this one. It does a good job of leaving my hair soft and silky. I have noticed that my grey hairs are better controlled after using it and not crazy. Overall, I like this mask.

title: Leaves My Hair Soft & Silky!
text: I am a fan of the Moroccanoil hair products. I really love the standard scent on their products. To me, it smells like baby powder with a hint of perfume. This is a creamy shampoo. It lathers nicely. It rinses clean. I've been using it with some of the Moroccanoil conditioners and the results have been soft and silky hair. I find that I am running my hands through my hair throughout the day because it's so soft!

title: Moisturizing
text: I do wear lip balm all the day. I can't stand to have dry lips. This is pretty moisturizing. It's a squeeze type balm. I really don't notice any scent to it at all. I like that it includes an SPF. It lasts a little while, but it does have to be reapplied. I like it, but it's not my favorite.

title: Thick & Creamy
text: This shower milk is thick and creamy. It does lather nicely. It has a nice, smell to it which is typical to Moroccan Oil. To me, it smells like a blend of baby powder and perfume. It rinses clean. It feels more luxurious than typical body washes.

title: Smells Nice!
text: I enjoy face mists, especially in the hot summer months! This couldn't have arrived at a better time with the temps being in the mid to upper 90's lately. Plus, I'm in the early stages of menopause, so I'm always feeling on the warm side. I use them to spritz my face and body. This has a nice, temporary cooling effect. This smells really nice, which is a plus.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: This overnight mask has a very pleasant citrusy scent to it. It's a thick gel consistency. It doesn't immediately absorb into the skin, but within a few hours, it does. I haven't noticed any of the product wiping off onto my pillow case. By morning, it's completely absorbed and you really can't even tell you had anything on your face. The directions say to rinse off in the morning. I haven't really noticed any difference regarding brightening, but I'm not really very observant when it comes to my skin. My nearness vision is horrible so I have to use a high magnification mirror to see anything! My face has felt really soft in the morning. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, either. Overall, I like it.

title: Nice Dispenser
text: This sunscreen is a thin, cream. It absorbs well into the skin and doesn't leave behind oiliness.  It comes in a easy to use dispenser. It smells good. It's like the traditional sunscreen scent with Moroccan oil blended together. So far, it seems to offer adequate sun protection.

title: Light Weight
text: This is a light weight paddle brush that's easy to hold. The brush handle has a comfortable grip. I have thick, coarse hair and this goes through my hair without any tugging or catching. It lightly massages my scalp which my old brush didn't do. Overall, I like it.

title: Leaves Hair Feeling Soft!
text: This Moroccanoil conditioner leaves my hair feeling soft. I've been using it with one of the shampoos by the same brand. The scent is pretty much the same as other Moroccanoil products. It reminds me of a lightly perfumed baby powder. It's pleasant as long as it's not too strong. I've been leaving it on my hair for a few minutes while in the shower. It rinses easily. My hair has been very soft and manageable afterwards. I like to run my fingers through my hair when it's soft, and my fingers don't get tangled or stuck.

title: No Mess!
text: I love that there is no mess with this face mask! I thought the product would be firmer, but it really just glides on without any effort. I put it in the morning. I let it sit for 10 minutes, then I hopped in the shower. I find it easier to wash clay masks off in the shower! My skin is sometimes sensitive to facial products, but it didn't have any reactions to this. Because of the no mess factor, I will probably use it at least once or twice a week. If it's too much work, then I find that I don't use it that often.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Skin!
text: I have a multi-step skin care routine that I found on a beauty website. After cleansing and toning, comes the serum. In the morning I use a vitamin C serum, but in the evening I use a Hyaluronic Acid serum. This is a thick, gel type consistency. It absorbs quickly. It's not sticky. It doesn't really have a scent. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. After applying this, I follow up with my moisturizer. I haven't noticed any new results, but I've been using similar serums for many years now, so I would be surprised if I saw anything different. It seems to be comparable to what I've used in the past.

title: Love the Scent!
text: I love the scent of this perfume. It's a nice, fruity scent. It acts more like a body mist rather than a perfume. By that, I mean it's a lighter scent and not heavy. It doesn't linger very long, but I do catch whiffs of it now and then. It's refreshing and does help me cool down.

title: Okay
text: This lip serum is really thick and not what I consider to be a serum. I thought serums were more liquidy - but that's just from my personal experience. It is very thick and a bit difficult to get out of the tube. I find that I have to squeeze really hard to dispense it. That actually surprised me a bit because it's summer in Atlanta and my solid coconut oil is pretty much liquid right now. It has a very faint, almost medicinal scent. I haven't noticed any changes yet in my 50 plus lips, but I will continue using it.

title: Large Size!
text: This is a large size jar. It doesn't take a lot of product to cover your face, so you should get a lot of uses out of it. I was almost able to completely cover my face with what was stuck to the inner lid. It's fairly thick. I applied a mid to light layer. I left it on a little longer than the recommended 10 minutes. It doesn't dry or harden like some masks. I took it off in the shower. It took a good couple of minutes to get it all off. It didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all! It left no redness. My skin felt a little tighter and drier after the use. Overall, I like it.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I get my hair highlighted quarterly. I started using a purple shampoo this past year and I've noticed a difference. It really does help prevent brassiness! The Nexxus purple shampoo has a pleasant scent and doesn't irritate my eyes. Some shampoos irritate my eyes even without coming in contact with them. This one does not. I use it once a week and leave it in my hair for a few minutes as directed. I would definitely consider purchasing again.

title: Love the Scent!
text: I tried the Hempz body scrub in the same scent first and loved it. In fact, I loved it so much that I bought the body lotion in the same product line. Now I have the mist! I really enjoy layering my scents. I've been using this as a body mist rather than a face or hair mist. It's got a light shimmer which is barely noticeable in my opinion. I'm actually glad that it is subtle because at my age, I don't need extra shimmer! It gives a good mist. It's very cooling and a great pick me up in the middle of a hot summer day! I am so happy to have found this!

title: Wonderful Scent!
text: I am in my early 50's and was excited to give this a try. It is a fairly large bottle, so it should last quite a while. It has a wonderful peach scent to it which is very uplifting. It lathers nicely. I wouldn't consider my skin to be sensitive, but it does react to some products. I haven't had any issues with this regarding my skin. On the other hand, I have had some eye irritations. My eyes are very sensitive, so I'm pretty careful about using products near them. Every time that I have used this cleanser, my eyes have stung a little bit, even without getting the product in my eyes. It's not a bad sting or burn and it is quickly remedied by blotting and drying my eyes with my towel. As I said, my eyes are very sensitive to begin with. I have had far worse stinging from some skin products than this. So far, I haven't really seen any of the anti-aging benefits, though I would assume it is more of a long term result. Overall, I do like it and will continue to use it.

title: Nice Neutral Color
text: I don't wear a lot of eye shadow and when I do, I go for neutral and nude colors. This eye shadow is both neutral and a nude color. It doesn't show up very much, but it does give a smooth finish to my eye lids. It's a very natural look which I feel is age appropriate at my 50 some years. I like the idea of creating my own palette because there are always shades and colors that I don't want but I'm stuck with.

title: Love the Scent!
text: Body scrubs are a part of my regular beauty regime. It helps to slough away the old skin and leaves soft skin behind. This scrub smells amazing! I love the scent. In fact, I went online and bought the Hempz body lotion in the same scent so I could layer it. The consistency isn't too thick. It's easy to scoop out of the jar. The jar is a little on the small side and the product doesn't fill the jar. I would estimate that the jar is about 2/3rd full upon opening. Since the jar is small, I'm only using this once or twice a week to make it last longer.

title: Beautiful Color!
text: This blush is a beautiful color. I was a little hesitant at first because it does look darker than I usually wear, but with a light hand, it is a very good match. It doesn't come with a brush or mirror, which is fine with me. I'm picky about my make up brushes and rarely ever use ones that come with products. It is a nice quality and what I would expect from Buxom cosmetics.

title: Great Fine Mist
text: These little bottles are just what I needed! I've been traveling a lot this summer in the heat! One of my favorite ways to cool down is with rose water. I find it to immediately cool me down and it's lightly scented so it helps with any odor. These bottles are travel sized. So far there hasn't been any issues with leakage. They give a great, fine mist.  I am very happy with them.

title: Decent!
text: This is a decent mascara. It goes on pretty easily and it doesn't clump. I'm noticing any "wow" results, but it's a good, basic mascara.

title: Smells Yummy!
text: I am 51 years old and I have thick, coarse, highlighted hair that I wear chin length. When I got this, I decided that I needed to try it with the coordinating shampoo, so I quickly ordered some so I could try them together. I appreciate that many hair products are formulated to work together with their specific counterparts. The conditioner smells yummy! It's a nice, fruity smell. The conditioner smells stronger (and better) than the shampoo. The conditioner is a thick but creamy consistency. In fact, it's unlike most conditioners that I have used.  It really felt luxurious! I usually let my hair dry naturally for at least an hour (unless there's a time issue) before drying and styling it. This hair set leaves my hair feeling so soft! I can't stop running my fingers through it! I am very pleased with it. With coarse hair, it usually doesn't feel soft at all, so I'm loving this!!

title: Pretty Color
text: This lip plumper lip gloss is a pretty color. It's more pink than I expected, but it looks fairly natural when wearing it. I haven't really noticed any plumping effects or tingling with it. I don't tend to notice that on similar products either. It's not too sticky and seems to last a little while as long as you don't drink or eat.

title: Nice Color!
text: I really liked the color of this plumping lip gloss. It's a pretty peach color with lots of sparkle. It's a little too sparkly for me, but I can't fault the product for that. It is a very sticky gloss. It started out with a mild tingling, but after a short while, it was more of a burning sensation. I assume it was the plumping action, but I didn't notice any plumping. It was a little bit difficult to remove, too. Wiping it off with a tissue didn't work. I ended up using a lip scrub to help take it off.

title: Sparkly!
text: I thought this Hypnotic Lights Eye Topper was pretty interesting. Unfortunately I have decided it's not really appropriate for my 50 year old self. However, my 18 year old daughter was thrilled with that because she liked it. The container is a little small, but it doesn't take a lot of product to get a sparkly look. You can definitely play around with the amount of product you apply to create more dramatic looks. It is slightly sticky feeling, but it seems to stay put pretty well. It can be worn alone or over eye shadow. It doesn't irritate. Overall, a fun product to use.

title: Sheer & Subtle!
text: I am in my early 50's and have found that I have to be careful with highlighting products. They just don't look good on me! This Nude Glow Complexion Enhancer does look quite nice on me! It's sheer and subtle. I've been playing around with it. I've worn it underneath my BB Cream and I've worn it alone. It gives a nice, soft, dewy look. It only takes a couple of pumps to cover my face. I am very happy with it and will be reordering this for sure!

title: Works Well!
text: A few years ago, my hair dresser started having me use finishing oils on a regular basis. I've tried several different ones since then. This one works well, though I'm not crazy about the masculine smell. Fortunately it doesn't linger. I dispense a little bit of product onto my hands and then I rub my hands together and work it into my hair. My hair is chin length and fairly coarse and thick. It does seem to control some of the flyaways. It also leaves a nice shine.

title: Excellent!
text: My daughter is going off to college in a few weeks and I wasn't about to let her take my BaByliss Ionic Hair Dryer, so she needed one of her own. This Hot Tools brand seems to be pretty equivalent to mine in performance. My daughter has pretty long hair and it can take a while to dry. This dries her hair in record time but at the same time, it seems to be gentle on her hair. It's a good size and feels good in your hands. The buttons are easy to use and don't get knocked accidently. Overall, we're very pleased with it.

title: Good Variety!
text: My daughter loves wearing scrunchies. She likes to coordinate them with what she's wearing. This is a set of 22 pieces so there's lots of possibilities as far as her scrunchy needs. There are different fabrics/textures, colors, and styles of scrunchies in this set. They seem to be a good quality so far.

title: Nice Duo!
text: This blush/highlighter set makes a nice duo. The colors are natural looking and will work with a lot of different skin tones. The brush that comes with it is just okay. I prefer using a full sized brush, but this was easy for traveling.

title: Smooth Lines!
text: This gel eyeliner pencil gives really smooth lines. It goes on nicely the first time so I don't have to go back and reapply. It also seems to last pretty long. I'm an eye rubber and often rub away any signs of my eyeliner, but this one seems to be staying put longer. The pencil glides easily and doesn't tug or pull on the delicate skin around my eyes. I am very pleased with it!

title: Game Changer!
text: I am in my early 50's and I have chin length, coarse, thick hair. I struggle with giving my own hair blow outs at home. Using a separate hair dryer and round brush has really been a challenge. My hair never looks as nice as it does at the salon! Well....this hair tool is pretty darn close to what I get at the salon. It is easy enough that I can use it by myself and get results that I am satisfied with. I did have to go purchase some hair clips so I could move some of my hair out of the way while styling. I usually let my hair dry naturally for about an hour before I style. That's been my routine for years! I do the same with this, but instead of using the hair dryer and brush, I can get by with this gadget. It doesn't take that long to do my hair. I even do the back of my head which I always neglected because I found it to be near impossible before! The power switch is a bit odd. It is a twist style. The brush does get hot and I found that it retains the heat for a little while after so I had to wait a little before putting it in my suitcase the other day. I have been so pleased with it! It's been a game changer for me!!!!

title: Beautiful Colors!
text: This eye shadow palette has beautiful, natural colors. They are nicely pigmented and blend well. The compact is a nice size and includes a large mirror inside. I'm very impressed with this palette!

title: Good Brushes!
text: These are good make up brushes. They are not high end ones, but they seem pretty good so far. I haven't noticed any shedding. The bristles are soft and dense. They pick up a good amount of make up.

title: Nice Shine
text: I have been using this for a couple of weeks.I have been giving my hair a couple of spritzes after it's styled. It does have a strong perfume smell to it, but it doesn't last very long. It doesn't make my hair look greasy and it does leave a nice shine.

title: Refreshing!
text: I found this setting spray to be very refreshing feeling. I didn't have any issues with the sprayer. It sprays a heavy mist (as opposed to a light one), but it's definitely a mist not a stream. I does leave my face looking dewy. I don't really notice much difference in the longevity of my make up compared to not using a setting spray, but I do like it. I haven't found any setting spray to make a difference with my make up lasting all day.

title: Good Quality!
text: This is a good, complete set of make up brushes. I've gotten some so called sets that don't have as many brushes as this set. This one comes with a brush for all your needs. The bristles are pretty soft, but not as soft as some brushes. They're not firm or stiff. I've noticed minimal shedding which is good. I like the color of the brush handles a lot. Overall, this is a good set of brushes.

title: Leaves Hair Feeling Soft!
text: I have coarse, thick highlighted hair.  Over a year ago, I started using hair masks regularly, twice a week. The consistency of this was thinner than I expected. I can't say whether that's good or bad, it's just different. It has a strong perfumey smell to it, which I wasn't crazy about. I will add that the scent doesn't seem to linger around afterwards. I prefer more natural scents to my hair products. That's totally a personal preference. It rinses well. It leaves my hair feeling soft and that's something that's really important to me. It's not my favorite hair mask, but I do like it.

title: Nice Variety!
text: This is a nice variety of hand soaps. Each one is a different scent/fragrance. The bottles seem larger than what I've purchased in the past, specifically taller than the old ones. They lather adequately. The scents are nice, but not too strong. They work as expected.

title: One of the Best Primers I've Ever Used!
text: This is one of the best primers I have ever used! It glides on easily and feels like silk! It reminded me of the Benefit Poreprofessional or Maybelline Babyskin, but better. I like the pump dispenser a lot!  A little goes a long way with this primer. It does a great job of leaving my skin all prepped for makeup!

title: Really Thin
text: I have a similar style bag for my toiletries. I liked the brush holder spots in this one and thought it might be good for makeup. The bag is a little smaller than my other which is fine, but the material is extremely thin and just feels cheap. The zippered netting compartment was very difficult to unzip and it wasn't easy to put items in. I was going to take it on vacation with us this past week, but in the middle of loading it with my items, I stopped and decided to use my old make up bag instead.

title: Smells Good!
text: I'm not crazy about the color, but the formula is pretty good. It has a nice smell. It doesn't really taste like much. The color is a little more orange than I had hoped for - I was looking for something a little more peachy. I'm considering trying a different color.

title: Nice Selection of Colors!
text: This set of liquid lipsticks comes with a nice selection of colors. My 18 year old daughter and I split the set between the two of us. She prefers the darker, berry and brown colors whereas I prefer the more nude and peach ones. The lipstick goes on smoothly and seems fairly comparable to other liquid lipsticks. They are long lasting and once dried, there is minimal transfer, if any at all. They smell nicely and don't really have any taste. The tubes are smaller than a lot of lipsticks, but larger than sample size.

title: Great Color!
text: I am a big fan of this lip polish! First of all, the color is perfect. It's a little more mauve/pink than my natural lip color. It's pretty shiny and moisturizes my lips pretty well. It's not sticky or tacky. I haven't noticed any scent or taste to it, so if there is one, it's mild and goes undetected. If I'm not eating or drinking, it easily lasts a few hours. It does transfer on to glassware, so I have been wiping it off before drinking because my husband doesn't always notice left behind lipstick when he's doing the dishes and it sometimes gets  left behind. I am very happy with it!

title: Nice Set!
text: I love bath products and lotions. I always try to get coordinating scents so I'm layering any fragrance or scent that I am using.
