These Cocoa Butter products have the traditional scent that goes with cocoa butter. It's not too strong. I would notice whiffs of it every now and then throughout the day. The body wash lathers well and rinses clean. I've never used the lotions that one uses/rinses in the shower. It seemed a little weird to me, but I have been following the directions. My skin isn't noticeably soft right after the shower, however, I've noticed it's soft feeling about half an hour afterwards after my skin has fully dried. I like this set and would consider ordering it again.

title: Love the Color!
text: I usually wear brown eyeliner, but I've had difficulties finding one that I really like. This one is pretty good. It glides on easily. The last one that I had been using prior to this one required multiple applications in order to see anything. This is a one time across. I don't notice any "shininess" to it as indicated in the vinyl name, but I have terrible close up vision, so that's probably on me. I have a stand up makeup mirror on the x10 side that I use when applying my eye makeup. As far as longevity, it seems to last at least a few hours. I have dry eyes and they water a lot during the day. Add the fact that I tend to rub my eyes a lot, too, eye makeup never lasts as long as it should on me. Overall, I do like this a lot and the results that I get from it.

title: Soothing!
text: These are really interesting! They remind me of the disposable hand warmers. Once you open them, it takes a few minutes for them to activate and warm up. They are definitely warm and not hot. It feels very soothing when you're wearing the mask. It has a pleasant, floral scent. I haven't noticed any lessening of wrinkles around my eyes yet, but they have helped with my dry eyes. I've noticed that my eyes water a lot less after using. There's 10 masks in this set which is nice.

title: Gentle!
text: This shaving cream is really gentle! It doesn't irritate my husband's sensitive skin. It foams nicely and works well with a razor. It has a nice, earthy smell to it that does linger a bit after use. My husband likes this more than his usual gel shaving cream.

title: Nice for Travel!
text: These little bottles are great for travel. I have a big bottle of face cleanser that's pretty liquidy. I put some of that in one of the bottles and it dispenses my cleanser in foam form now, which is easier to cleanse with. I always loose some of the cleanser because as a liquid it just rolls off of my hands. There are 12 little bottles in this set. I haven't had any troubles with any of the pumps or dispensers.

title: Fun Activity!
text: This is a fun activity for young girls. My 18 year old daughter did this with her 10 year old cousin recently. It comes with everything needed to make 3 little containers of whipped body butter. You can customize them with the color and fragrance and shimmer. While they did have fun with it, I think it's a little over priced. At the time of my review, the set cost $18. For 3 little finished products, that comes to $6 each. You could go the local bath product store and purchase larger sized lotion bottles for the same price. You are basically paying for the experience. It was a fun way for the girls to spend time together.

title: Gentle on My Eyes
text: I've used other mascara primers and found this to be pretty comparable to them. When used, it conditions your lashes and helps provide a good base before adding the mascara. I didn't find it clumpy or cakey. I did notice that my lashes looked a little fuller. It's gentle on my sensitive eyes.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Eyes!
text: I have been using this for about 3 weeks now. The applicator has a twist feature on one end that dispenses the liquid through a brush at the end. Then you apply it at the edge where the lashes extend from the eye lid and then you can also apply it directly on the lashes. I have really sensitive eyes and this hasn't irritated my eyes at all, for which I am very pleased. The last time I tried a similar product, my eyes burned. I'm in my early 50's and my eye lashes are not as dense as they used to be. I am beginning to notice them filling in a bit. So far, so good!

title: Not Your Usual Conditioner
text: I have been using this conditioner, along with the matching shampoo for a few days now. This is not your usual conditioner. It's not what I expected at all. It's thin and runny. Usually conditioners are pretty thick, but not this one. It has a great grapefruit scent. When I put it on my wet hair, I could barely even tell that it's there. When I rinsed it, it seemed like there's nothing to be rinsed. It's really not like other conditioners. My hair just didn't feel like it was conditioned after I got out of the shower. The brush did go through my hair and it wasn't tangled though. I really was ready to leave a negative review. Then after my hair dried (air dried for an hour, then blow dried to finish), I was completely amazed and surprised at how soft my hair was! It's also very manageable. My fingers can run through my hair without any difficulties. Even the next morning, my hair was still super soft. I am loving the results!! I haven't noticed any difference with hair loss yet. I have really thick coarse hair. Usually I have to clean the shower drain daily because of hair left behind. I would order this again.

title: Smells Great!
text: I am very happy to have found a foaming soap refill! In the past, I've had to use a combination of  regular formula liquid hand soap and water to refill my soap dispensers. This is much simpler to use. It smells great! I really like the pear scent. It lathers well and does a good job of cleaning.

title: Good Formula
text: I have tried a few other matte liquid lipsticks. This one is a good formula. It goes on easily. It does dry and transform into a matte finish, but it's not over drying. It long lasting and lasts most of the day. It doesn't transfer onto your cups. It really is a good lip product. I'm not crazy about the color, but I can't fault the product for that. It can be difficult to find the right lip color without actually trying it on. I found the color to be darker and more brown than I would like. I definitely want to check out some of the other colors in the product line.

title: Great Color
text: This concealer is a great color and perfect for my under eye circles. It is a little thick, but blends in well. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It lasts for several hours. I am pleased with it.

title: Darker Than Expected
text: The color is a little darker than expected, but I feel that can happen when you don't get to see the colors in person sometimes. The quality of this liquid matte lipstick is good. It isn't sticky or tacky. It goes on smoothly. It lasts a few hours. I can't fault it just because it's not the right color for me.

title: Non-Sticky
text: This matte lipstick is non-sticky. It goes on wet, but quickly turns matte. The color is just a shade darker than my natural lip color. It seems to last a few hours and once dried, it doesn't transfer on to glassware.

title: Nice Lip Stain
text: This is a nice lip stain. I like the product a lot, but I am not crazy about the color. The color is a little too dark for me, but I found it's okay if I blot some and add a lighter color on top. It goes on pretty wet. Not at all what I expected from a matte lip stain. It does dry and become matte after a little a short while. After it's dried, it doesn't transfer very much. I really like the applicator. It's designed so that it can reach the corners without spilling over.

title: Lasts Most of the Day
text: This concealer lasts for most of the day. The color is a pretty good match. I've been using it primarily underneath my eyes.  It doesn't sweat into my eyes and cause any irritation. It blends well and looks pretty natural. I am pleased with it.

title: Nice Neutral Color
text: This matte liquid lipstick goes on smoothly. It dries pretty quickly. It's not sticky or tacky. The color is a nice, neutral one with some pink undertones. It's practically the color of my bare lips. It doesn't transfer very much onto glass or cups. It lasts for a few hours, but not all day.

title: Nice Shimmer
text: This highlight powder has a nice shimmer to it. It's pigmented and it doesn't take much to achieve a good highlight. It lasts for a few hours. It's pretty comparable to other highlighter powders out there. I would recommend it.

title: Non-Sticky
text: This is a wonderful clear lip gloss!  I have some Lip Sense liquid lipsticks that I like to wear. It's a 2 part step that follows up with a clear lip gloss. I've got one of their clear glosses, but I like keeping one in my purse and it's an expensive product. This clear lip gloss works just as well as theirs for less. It's non-sticky and seems to last a couple of hours before reapplying.

title: Lasts a Few Hours
text: This liquid matte lipstick is pretty comparable to other liquid matte ones that I have tried. The color is a dark, chocolate berry shade. It dries pretty quickly leaving behind a stained lip look. It lasts for a few hours with minimal transfer on cups, etc. If you want to remove it right away, I found that I needed to use a lip scrub and even then I couldn't get it all off. It's not sticky or tacky.

title: Comes with Batteries
text: My daughter participates in her school's color guard/winter guard. That involves a lot of make-up for the girls. As a guard mom, I like to have extra compact mirrors with me for the girls because often they have to put their make-up on the buses or while sitting on the floor without access to wall mirrors. This compact mirror is perfect for the girls! It has a magnification side and a light-up side. It comes with batteries, so it's ready to go! This is a good size. It's slightly larger than the palm of my hand. There's a switch on the bottom that turns the lights on. I am very pleased with this!!

title: Nice Neutral Color
text: I almost always choose lip gloss over lipsticks. They feel more natural to me and leave my lips feeling moisturized. This lip gloss is a pinkish brown color that is pretty neutral. It's not sticky and it lasts for a few hours unless drinking or eating.

title: Natural Looking
text: This brow pencil/highlighter is pretty natural looking when applied. The color is a good, medium brown. It has a marker type tip that works best with small, short marks. It glides on easily. It stays put well and seems to last for most of the day.  For a drug store brand, it's pretty good.

title: Non-Sticky
text: This is a non-sticky lip gloss. It lasts for a couple of hours if you don't eat or drink. The nude color has brown/tan undertones. I personally prefer a pinker nude color, but this is fine. I have a few different colors of these lip glosses and they're pretty good.

title: Light Scent
text: My 21 year old son has curly hair. We didn't even know he had curls until his senior year of high school when he was too busy to go get it cut! Now he wears it in a big Afro style. It is usually pretty out of control and frizzy because of his laziness when it comes to grooming habits. He has noticed improvement when using hair products designed for curly hair so I thought we'd try this. It has a nice, light scent. I noticed whiffs of coconut, but it's not strong. It has coconut oil in it and usually coconut oil doesn't smell a lot like coconut in my opinion, so that goes along with that. It's pretty creamy and lathers pretty good. He's been using both the shampoo and the coordinating conditioner. The frizz has been reduced. He really needs to get his hair trimmed!! I don't notice any difference in the softness of his hair. Overall, it's a good shampoo and conditioner set. We've seen better results with a more expensive set, but at this price it does a decent job.

title: Works Well!
text: I have natural eyebrows and have never done more than pluck an out of place hair on the rare occasion. This works well at taming or controlling hairs that are being stubborn and not laying flat. It's not sticky nor does it try and leave any crunchiness either. Plus, you don't have to worry about matching the right color! I like this a lot!

title: Light Scent
text: I was excited to give this citrus scented soap a try. Unfortunately, the scent is really light and not very distinguishable. It smells nice, when you get a whiff of it. The soap produces a good lather. It's a gentle soap. I am a fan of the company. I do like the soap, but would prefer a stronger scent. But if you're not a fan of strong scents, you may want to give this a try!

title: Absorbs Well!
text: I love finding new serums and this one is advertised as taking care of multiple skin issues which sounds wonderful! It is a clear serum and absorbs well.It's not sticky or greasy.  I know it says that it's supposed to be scent free, but it has a very strong smell to me. It's a strong alcohol smell. I have tried this serum for a couple of days and I just can't get past the smell. The smell doesn't last after putting it on, but it's so strong smelling that I don't even want to put it on.

title: Pretty Color
text: I prefer the look of lip gloss over lip stick. I think it's a more natural look overall. This one is a really pretty color. It's fairly neutral. It's darker than a nude color, but it's very natural looking. It isn't sticky or tacky. It seems to last a decent length unless eating or drinking. It has a light (but nice) scent. It's rather small for a lip gloss tube, but I do like it.

title: Absorbs Well!
text: I am in my early 50's. I follow a multi-step skin care routine every morning and night. Vitamin C serum is on the morning routine list and Hyaluronic acid is on the evening routine. This serum by CeraVe has both of those ingredients, so I have been using this at both times. It is fragrance free and really doesn't smell like anything. It absorbs well. It's non-greasy. I have fairly sensitive skin and it does not irritate me at all. The only thing that I don't like about it is the tube that it comes in. It comes in a metal, ointment type tube. The lid is really big and pointed so it can invert it and break the seal. Since it's metal, when you squeeze the tube to dispense the serum, the tube stays bent. So as the serum is getting used it, it gets harder to squeeze it out. Most serums that I use come in a glass bottle with a dropper dispenser which I prefer much more over this.

title: Nice Selection of Scents
text: My daughter and I love bath bombs. This set has a nice selection of scents. The bombs are a good size and larger than some of the ones that I have gotten in the past. They fizz as expected. They don't stain the bathtub or leave behind any oily residue. We've been very pleased with the ones we have tried out so far.

title: Nice, Nude Color
text: I prefer lip gloss over lip stick in most cases. This is a pretty good gloss. It's not sticky or tacky. It stays in place for a while - it's not all day, but it does seem to last a couple of hours unless eating or drinking. The color is really light and looks pretty nude on me. My only complaint is that it's rather small!

title: Great for Traveling
text: First of all, like many of the other reviews so far, I only received the brush cleanser, not the mat, but I really do like it! I find it easier to use then liquid brush cleaner. It's a solid soap bar, kind of like shaving soap. It comes in a little plastic container. If you remove the soap, there are bumps/grooves on the inside bottom of the container that you rub your brush against that works to clean the brush. There were no instructions, so I wasn't sure exactly what to do, but I added a little water to the brush, then rubbed it onto the soap. Then I discovered that the bottom had the ridges. It worked. The soap doesn't get too wet. It is satisfying to see the makeup coming off of the brushes! This would be great for traveling because it you don't have to take anything else with it.

title: Amazing Scent!
text: This body wash has an amazing grapefruit smell. It's pretty comparable to the name brand and when I compared them side by side, I really couldn't tell any difference between them. It's gentle on my skin. It produces a good lather.

title: Fairly Gentle
text: My 17 year old daughter has had acne issues recently, mainly on her chin area. She hasn't really had much more than the occasional hormonal acne, but this has been more prevalent lately. She's had sensitivity issues with salicylic acid which tends to be found in most acne products these days. This has been fairly gentle on her skin and she's had no negative reactions to it. It seems to be pretty effective, too. Her chin area has shown improvement and looks much better now.

title: Interesting!
text: I've personally never had any luck with the traditional blackhead strips, so I was eager to try these. They are very different from the other strips.  I personally never got a speckled strip when I pulled mine off in the past, so when I learned that these don't work that way, I wasn't really disappointed. The strips are actually the cleanser and when you add some water, they sort of dissolve and clean your skin. I immediately thought how great these would be for travel. Since they're not a liquid cleanser, they won't count in your TSA liquids restrictions. They do a good job of cleansing. I have somewhat sensitive skin and these didn't irritate me.

title: Great Assortment!
text: This set comes with a ton of hair scrunchies. It has a great assortment of colors! My teenage daughter was thrilled with them. They're soft and velvety. They don't cause hair breakage which is the number one reason my daughter likes to wear them. She's been wearing them frequently. She did have one snap on her the other day. She said there was a note in the package that said the company would replace any should there be any problems. There was another similar color, so she decided not to worry about it. But it was nice to see that the company wants to take care of such problems should they arise.

title: Difficult to Apply
text: I found this eyeliner to be difficult to apply. The brush was good enough - a mix of firm/flexible, but it holds a lot of product which comes off unevenly when applying it. When playing around with it, I was able to get a thin line at my lower lashes, but I couldn't get a smooth line at all  instead I kept getting a choppy line. It requires precision which I'm not good at with eyeliner. While it didn't sting or burn my eyes, I did notice that my eyes were a bit sensitive to the liquid eyeliner. It came off easily with eye makeup remover.

title: Good Mascara
text: This is a good, basic mascara. I haven't had any issues with clumping or smearing. It has a unique brush which does a good job of distributing the mascara to the lashes. It doesn't create super long lashes, but it's good for every day use. For weekends and special occasions, I will use one that  is formulated for much longer lashes.

title: Gentle
text: By the end of the day, most of my make up has worn off, but I've been using this eye make up remover anyway. It's an oily make up remover, but it's very gentle. It doesn't leave my eye area feeling overly oily or greasy after using it. It is effective at taking off the remnants of mascara at the end of the day. It has a pleasant, light scent to it. And best of all, it doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes! It came with 4 bottles of eye make up remover, so my teenage daughter and I are set for a while.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Eyes!
text: I am 51 years of age and I have been using various anti-aging products for the last several years. My eyes can be very sensitive and will often sting or burn when using some products targeted to the eye area. This has not irritated, burned, or stung my eyes. This bottle is very generous and should last a long time. It's the consistency of a gel. One pump will cover the area all around both of my eyes, including the brow and lid areas. It has a cooling feel to it. It does feel a bit tacky, but not sticky. I really haven't noticed any changes in the way the skin around my eyes looks. However, because I already use all kinds of anti-aging products, it makes sense that I won't see any, but instead, I should have a continuation of what I have already been achieving.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: I follow a multi-step beauty routine in the morning and at night. Face oil is one of the last steps, but I choose only to use it at night because it does seem heavy and oily. I've been using this oil since it arrived. It's been pretty gentle on my skin. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It smells nice, but not over powering. It also seems to absorb well and doesn't make my face look too oily. The bottle is generously sized.

title: Interesting!
text: I found this treatment device to be quite interesting. I am already a fan of facial sheet masks, but I do have difficulties finding the time to use them. This makes it much more efficient. The directions were not easy to follow. I ended up having to search online for similar devices to figure out how to use it. I have a lot of regular sheet masks, so I have been using them without any problems. I have found that I do have to cut them to fit the device. I can get 3-4 separate pieces out of one mask so I put the leftover pieces back into the original packaging, then I put that inside a resealable baggie. Using the device has been pretty easy. I love the heat modes! The only issue that I have had is turning the device off. I usually end up cycling through all the modes multiple times before I successfully shut it off. This has definitely been a unique way to use sheet masks!

title: Glides Easily
text: This silver eye liner pencil glides easily. It doesn't tug at the fragile skin around the eyes. The silver color shows up more than I expected. However, it does seem to smudge/smear pretty easily. It doesn't irritate sensitive eyes either. My daughter and I tried it out and it didn't last very long on either of us. I tend to rub my eyes a lot and have similar issues with most eye liners. Silver is probably not the best color for me, but it does work as a brightener and eye highlighter, too.  Overall, we like it.

title: Refreshing!
text: This was my first time using a mask designed for the neck area. I regularly use special creams and serums for my neck. This mask has to be removed from its backing. It's thicker than most sheet masks that I have used. It stayed in place pretty well for the 5 minutes it remained on my neck. It was very refreshing. It did leave my neck feeling a little tacky afterwards.

title: Prettiest Sheet Masks!
text: These are definitely the prettiest sheet masks that I have ever used. They have gold and silver flowers all over it. The mask was a little difficult to fully open, but I did manage to do so without tearing it. I put it on after getting out of the shower and left it on for the suggested 5 minutes. There was plenty of serum or goo to rub in afterwards. It did leave my face feeling a little tacky afterwards. It didn't sting or irritate my skin. It was very refreshing. And I really liked that it only took 5 minutes! That can definitely work into my busy schedule.

title: Doesn't Leave My Hair Looking Greasy
text: My biggest concern for using this hair lotion was that it would leave my hair looking greasy. It doesn't, so that's a relief! I apply it after towel drying my hair. I have chin length hair, so I have been adding a little less than recommended. I work it into the damp hair, then I usually let my hair air dry for about an hour before blow drying it. While it doesn't make my hair greasy, I really don't notice any difference in the thickness. My hair is pretty soft, but not softer than usual. I will continue to use it until it runs out, but as of now, I'm not seeing any difference.

title: Smells Nice
text: I love the convenience of sheet masks! They're easy to use and not very messy. This one smells really nice and uplifting. The mask has plenty of serum on it. I could have even used some of the excess from the package if needed, but there was enough that stayed on the mask that was more than enough for me to rub into my skin afterwards. The mask left me feeling refreshed.

title: Okay
text: I have tried several different hair trimmers for removal of facial hair. This one is just okay. It does come with a battery, which I do appreciate. It also comes with 2 different blades, one for facial hair and the other for eye brows. It just doesn't seem to work as well as some of the other trimmers that I have tried. It's not bad, it's just that there are others that are much better.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I love using high end shampoos, so I was excited to give this a try. It has a soft, pleasant scent. It reminds me of baby powder. I've noticed that particular scent in other Moroccan Oil hair products, too, so it must be typical of the Moroccan oil. The shampoo is pretty creamy. It lathers nicely. It rinses well. I purchased some conditioner from the same brand to try with it since formulas are often made to work well together. My hair has been pretty soft and manageable, but it's not the softest I've had from hair products. I haven't really noticed any difference regarding the smoothing properties. I do like the shampoo and I will continue using it until it's finished.

title: Nice Scent
text: I enjoy using facial sheet masks. This one is good and fairly comparable to others that I have tried. The holes are big enough and line up pretty well. There is pretty of "goo". It feels refreshing. I rubbed the excess serum in after I was done. I didn't notice any difference in my skin tone afterwards, but honestly, I wouldn't expect to see any miraculous results after just one use either. The product didn't irritate my sensitive skin. The scent is nice.

title: Portable!
text: My daughter and I had 1 LED light for gel nails, but she'll be going off to college in a few months and I was getting concerned that she would want to take the light with her. Now, it's okay because we have 2. This works as expected. The directions are pretty basic, so if you're not familiar with the process, I would suggest doing some research. I really like that this has different time settings so you can adjust it. The size is good and easily accommodates toes. The cord is way too short and we've had to use an extension cord with it. It's portable and doesn't have too large of a footprint.

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: My daughter has had sensitivities to salicylic acid products in the past. She seems to have grown out of that as she has not had issues in the recent past. This doesn't irritate her skin. She was a little disappointed in the feel of these because she was expecting a more cooling effect because of the "ice" in the name. It does a good job of cleansing. It doesn't over dry her skin. She was happy that this came with a nose pore strip!

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: This replacement brush head fits my Clarisonic Mia Smart nicely. It's a lot softer than the original brush that comes with the gadget. It's gentle on my skin and doesn't leave redness behind.

title: Fun & Gross!
text: My teen daughter enjoys these pore strips. They're both fun and gross. I tried one and there didn't seem to be any blackheads pulled, so I must not have had much to begin with. They don't hurt when removing. They seem to stay in place long enough.

title: Okay
text: I use spray on conditioners daily. This one is just okay. The smell is natural. I can detect some of the individual items. I swear that I smell cassia/cinnamon, but it's not listed as one of the ingredients. The smell isn't bad, it's just spicy/natural. The product combs well in my hair. I don't notice much difference between using this or nothing at all though.

title: Cleans Well Without Over Drying
text: This cleanser cleans well without over drying your skin. It's black when you pump it out, but foams up white. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I like that they included a pore strip which was fun to use.

title: Good for Occasional Use
text: I have used a derma roller once prior to this one. I was weirded out by the whole concept at first, but after learning more about it, I do think that they are good for occasional use. Evidently most of the creams and serums that we use don't really penetrate the skin, so items like this can help. Before using, I watched a few videos and read up on the subject. This set seems to be decent. The needles are sharp, so there's a learning curve required to get the hang of how much pressure to use. I haven't seen any improvements in my skin tone, but I do feel like the serums are penetrating now.

title: It's Okay
text: It's okay, but I am not crazy about this leave-in conditioner. I was very concerned that it would leave my hair feeling greasy. I use spray leave-in conditioners daily, but not cream ones. I have coarse, thick hair and conditioner is a necessity. This did not leave my hair looking greasy, but it felt greasy to me. It got better the more I ran my hands through it as the day progressed, but it still felt heavy and just different. It has the consistency of a runny lotion, not thick like most wash-out conditioners. The smell reminds me of perfume. Overall, this just leaves me feeling lukewarm.

title: Interesting Design
text: This organizer has an interesting design. It's 2 separate pieces. The base is long and divided. Then there's a square piece that rests on top of the longer bottom piece. It's raised so you can still store items underneath it. The square has silicone strips going across it to create individual spots so you can store things such as lipsticks and mascaras. The silicone pieces flex to accommodate various sized items. I have limited counter space in my bathroom, so I am not sure that this work for my make-up, so I think I am going to use it at my desk to hold office supplies.

title: Great for Sensitive Skin
text: My daughter has sensitive skin. She is especially sensitive to salicylic acid which is found in a lot of acne products. Fortunately she doesn't deal with a lot of acne, and when she does, it's usually hormone related. This clear product doesn't irritate her skin. It is easy to use and dries clear. It does seem to help reduce the appearance of her acne.

title: Love the Applicator!
text: The first time I tried this, I used it as concealer to hide a blemish. I wasn't too impressed with it. I found it to be a little too thick. But then I read that the applicator is designed to go under the eyes to cover dark circles, so I tried it under my eyes. It worked beautifully! I love the applicator! I didn't have any issues with the consistency of the product when using it under my eyes. I use the applicator and dab some spots underneath my eyes, then I use my ring finger and gently work it in. I am very pleased with how well it works! I also have a tendency to get foundation or eye creams into my eyes during the day from either sweating or rubbing my eyes. Some products end up irritating or stinging my eyes greatly, but this does not.

title: Unique Style
text: This make up organizer is perfect for holding your make up brushes and tools. It's got a unique style to it. It's a bunch of round cup-like containers that are attached together. As much as I like the look of it, I was disappointed in the quality. The containers are not very stable. When I first held it, I thought that the pieces might be removable because some of them flexed and moved a bit. Also, it doesn't completely lay flat. It should be okay if you are keeping it on a flat surface and don't move it much.

title: Mild Soap
text: This is a good, mild bar of soap. It has a light, lavender scent. The soap has a moderate amount of lather. It cleans well. It doesn't moisturize or dry out the skin. My skin is sometimes sensitive and this does not irritate me at all.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: This hand lotion has a pleasant scent. At first I thought it was lemony, but then I realized that it must be the white tea that I was smelling. The lotion absorbs quickly and doesn't leave your hands feeling greasy. I did find that I had to reapply a few times throughout the day. The tube is a little on the small size. Overall, it's a good lotion.

title: Good Coverage
text: Lately I've been wearing BB Creams and tinted moisturizers instead of full foundation. This goes on pretty smoothly and is very blendable. I thought the color might be a little dark on me, but it seems to be just fine. By the time I get home from work, I can't tell that I put any make-up on at all, but it does last for a good part of the day. It doesn't irritate my skin or eyes. I would consider buying this again.

title: Refreshing
text: I started using facial mists in the last year. They're another way of keeping your face hydrated and moisturized. This set comes with 3 different varieties. My daughter claimed one and I am using the other. They are all very refreshing. The mist is pretty fine. The products don't irritate, sting or annoy my sensitive eyes. It doesn't feel like they are running or dripping down my face either. I have been adding a spritz to my morning and evening skincare routines. I spray before putting on my make up and then later in the day if I need a pick me up. Overall, I like these facial sprays.

title: Great Color!
text: It's winter time combined with my aging skin, I've been wanting to try a cream blush rather than powder. I have had some issues with powder blush looking a little cakey or streaky. This blush is nice and creamy. It is easy to blend in for a smooth and seamless application. It seems to last most of the work day. By the time I get home at the end of the day, most of my make up has worn off, regardless of what brand I use. This is a great color and I am pleased with how it looks on my skin tone.

title: Pleasant Scent
text: I participate in some online beauty forums and many of the other participants are fans of the Elemis line of products. I have tried one of their beauty oils before and I was pleased with it, so I was excited to try another one. I am 51 years old. My neck and decolette area have a crepe like appearance. I blame it on years of teaching and going out for recess without applying sunscreen. I have been regularly using products for that area over the past few years. in the attempt of reversing some of that damage.  This neck balm has a pleasant scent. It does not irritate my sensitive skin. It absorbs quickly and does not leave behind any stickiness. I have noticed an almost immediate tightening of the skin after applying it. I have been using this for about two weeks so far. I'm not seeing any miraculous smoothing of the skin, but it does seem to be improving a little bit. The product description says you should see results after 28 days, so I'm not there yet. It is a bit pricey compared to what I normally use. However, if the results continue, I will try to work this into my beauty budget.

title: Noticeable Difference in My Son's Hair
text: My 21 year old son has a head full of curly hair. We didn't even know he had curly hair until he was in high school and let it grow out a bit. Now, he wears it in an Afro. My biggest complaint is that it is unruly and frizzy most of the time. I recently decided that I needed to get him specialized hair products to help with those issues. These hair products have made a noticeable difference. He's been using the shampoo, conditioner, and the styling cream in the curly hair formulas. First, I have to mention that he loves the scents of these! The products work well together. He has a lot less frizz now. It's also a little softer. You can see the ringlets of curls. Best of all, he's really happy with the way his hair is now.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Skin
text: This Glow Dew Mist reminds me of Pixi Glow Mist. I spray it over my makeup. It does give a slightly dewy look, though it seems pretty temporary. It doesn't irritate my skin or my eyes. It's actually a bit soothing and cooling. I've spritzed it again later in the day as a pick me up.

title: Nice Set!
text: This is a nice set. The make up sponges are pretty basic. They are comparable to other ones that I have used. What I really like about this set is the sponge holder. I think it's a great idea. It looks like an egg holder. It's large enough to hold the sponge when it has expanded when wet. It allows the sponge to dry because of the coils. My daughter wants me to order a set for her!

title: Love It!
text: I discovered this booster serum a while ago and I love it! It is one of my most favorite skin care products. I have added it to my morning and evening skin care routines. I apply it after my serums (Vitamin C serum in the morning and hyaluronic acid in the evening) and before moisturizer. It's a gel that absorbs quickly into the skin. It is scentless and non-sticky. My skin just drinks it up! I'm 51 years old and am noticing that my skin is drier now than when I was younger. I'm also dealing with the typical signs of aging. I can't say that I'm seeing any miracles that I can attribute to this product, but I have been regularly using anti-aging products for the past several years. I can say that I have noticed that my skin is usually pretty hydrated. It doesn't irritate or annoy my sensitive skin. I love it!

title: Pleasant Scent
text: My 21 year old son has big curly hair. It gets frizzy easily. He's been using this daily for the past week and a half. It's done a great job of reducing the frizz. It has a pleasant scent which he likes. It doesn't leave his hair looking or feeling greasy either. Overall, he likes it.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I always use a spray leave in conditioner product after I shampoo/condition my hair. This one smells amazing! It reminds me of banana scented sunscreen. I haven't noticed much difference in split ends, but my hair has been super soft since using this. Some leave in products leave my hair looking greasy, but this one has not. So far, I really like it!

title: Smells Nice
text: This shampoo smells nice, albeit a little artificial, but it's pleasant. The shampoo is not very thick, but it lathers well. My son has super curly hair and wears it in an Afro type style. I purchased the coordinating conditioner for him to use with this. It does a good job of cleaning his hair, but he has noticed that his hair is requiring more conditioner than usual, so he's guessing that the shampoo is not very moisturizing.  He likes the shampoo, but doesn't love it.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: I have tried several different brands of Micellar water. I would say that this is fairly comparable to the ones that I have tried before. It's gentle on my skin. It does a good job of removing dirt left behind after I cleanse my face. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It doesn't have any added fragrance or scent. I really like that it comes with a travel size bottle, too!

title: Controls Fly Aways
text: I’m pretty picky about hair serums. I’ve tried some that have left my hair looking greasy. My hair has not been greasy looking at all.  This one doesn’t seem to have much of a scent, which is fine. I’ve been working a small amount into my damp hair after I’ve towel dried. I’ve been concentrating primarily on my ends, but I do make sure to get it a little all over, including the crown. Since I’ve been using this, my hair has been super soft. I do use a high end shampoo/conditioner duo which does a good job of giving me soft hair. I have noticed fewer fly aways. Overall, I am pleased with it.

title: Lathers Well
text: I received only 1 bottle of this men’s body wash rather than the 6 I was expecting. It has a strong, manly scent. The scent doesn’t linger around much after use. It does lather well and is what I would expect from a body wash. It is comparable to other body wash brands out there.

title: Does Not Sting My Eyes
text: I am in my early 50's and have been using assorted anti-aging products regularly for the past few years. Some eye creams in the past have either sweated or rubbed into my eyes during the day and have caused stinging and burning. This cream has not irritated my eyes in any way. I can't detect any scent, so if it is scented, it's very mild. The cream absorbs well into the delicate skin around my eyes. One pump is enough to moisturize under the eyes as well as around the brow bone area and eye lid. It does a good job of hydrating the skin in that area. I really haven't noticed any changes in my crows feet but I do realize that may take longer to achieve. I also believe that since I have been using similar products for so long now, that I may just be getting a continued result rather than something new. I would consider ordering this again.

title: Nice Scent
text: My son has thick, curly hair. It's been crazy frizzy lately, so I wanted to get him a product that would help with that. This has a nice, light scent. It doesn't take a lot of product to do the job. Because he has so much hair, it takes a little while for him to work it all in. It doesn't seem to weight his hair down. And it does cut down a lot of the frizz. Overall, he likes it.

title: Non-Greasy
text: This primer is fairly thick for a primer. It is non-greasy, but it does seem to take a little longer than other primers to get it absorbed into the skin. It's white, so you do need to blend it in so that disappears. It doesn't irritate. It does leave a good surface before applying your make up. I don't really notice any difference in the longevity of my makeup when using this. By the time I get home from work, my makeup is pretty much non existent with any primer that I use.

title: Bold Lines
text: This eyeliner glides smoothly and easily. It doesn't tug on the delicate skin around the eyes.  It creates bold lines which are a bit thicker than I personally prefer. It does seem to stay in place for most of the day.

title: Smells Nice
text: This micellar water shampoo & conditioner set smells nice. It's a light scent that is ever so slightly floral without being feminine. I think it could easily be gender neutral as far as its scent. The shampoo lathers really well. It doesn't feel like it's stripping my hair. The conditioner detangles well and leave my hair easy to comb/brush through afterwards. My hair feels manageable afterwards, but it doesn't leave it as soft as some other shampoo/conditioner sets do, but it is okay as far as the softness level. I can easily run my fingers through my hair without any difficulties. Overall, I do like it, but it's not my favorite. I like to alternate shampoo/conditioner sets every so often and I would consider using this again.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: I love these Erno Laszlo skin care products. They are gentle on my skin and non-irritating. My favorite is the mask. It is a honest to true peel off mask where most masks that I have tried over the years that claim to be peel ones, are not and just make a mess. This is a starter kit, so the product sizes are small, but they are larger than travel or sample sizes. I'm guessing that they should last me at least a month or longer. I haven't noticed any miraculous changes since using these, but I have been using anti-aging products regularly for the last few years. I can tell that they are keeping my skin hydrated and soft. I am very pleased with this product line.

title: I Like!
text: I was skeptical and somewhat frightened of derma rollers. But after trying this one, I can honestly say that I like it! This kit comes with enough for 3 applications. You mix the contents of 2 little bottles and then attach the roller to one of the bottles. Then you roll it around on your face. I thought it might hurt, but it really doesn't. I have a low pain tolerance and so if I say it doesn't hurt, then it really doesn't. I won't tweeze or pluck because of the pain! The first time, I didn't quite understand and I did not use up the whole bottle. I just rolled it around my face a few times and stopped. Then I reread it and found that you keep rolling until the bottle is empty. I do wish the instructions were a little clearer. There are pictures with some instructions, but they just don't explain everything about the process. I haven't seen any miraculous results from using this. However, I have been regularly using anti-aging products for the past few years that there may not be room for improvement! Overall, I would definitely try this again down the line.

title: Very Fine Line
text: I'm not usually a fan of liquid eyeliners because they go on a bit thick. This one has a very fine brush and gives a nice fine line which looks natural. The thicker lines always look out of place on my face, so I'm very happy with this. It's not harsh looking.  It doesn't irritate my eyes. I haven't had to fix it after applying it, it looks good the first time. It lasts for most of the day. I do tend to rub my eyes a bit, but the longevity is acceptable.

title: Large Bottles
text: These are large spray bottles. My spray nozzle on my laundry stain removal spray just broke, so I poured the remaining contents into one of these bottles. I didn't have a lot left in my original spray bottle, so I also added some of the refill that I had to it. The refill size usually allows me to refill more than 2 times. The capacity of this bottle accommodated a lot more than the original did. It almost took up my entire refill bottle! The spray nozzle can be adjusted for stream and mist spraying, however, I found that the mist setting was as fine as I prefer. It may require more adjusting and playing with it, but so far, the mist setting was just okay for me. The stream setting worked as expected. I've labeled my bottle with a permanent marker and so far it seems to be staying. Overall, these are good, basic spray bottles.

title: Conditions Well
text: My usual shampoo/conditioner is the Biolage Matrix Color Last line, so since I am already a fan of the brand, I was excited to give this a try. I'm 51 years old and I have thick, coarse hair that is between shoulder length and chin length. I do get highlights a couple of times a year. I immediately ordered the shampoo that goes with this conditioner so I could get the full experience. The products have a nice, natural scent to them. Both the shampoo and the conditioner are a thick consistency. My hair is soft and manageable after using these for the past two weeks. I really haven't noticed any less breakage or hair loss which I mainly notice after showering and see the hair that has collected in the drain. Overall, this conditioner conditions well and I like it.

title: Comfortable!
text: This is a curling wand, not a curling iron, so there is no clamp. It has adjustable heat so you can fine tune the temperature setting that works best for your hair. The best feature of this curling bar is that it's comfortable to use when compared to regular styled hair appliances. It's not any faster than other hair styling appliances. It did take some getting used to, but once the learning curve was done, it became easy to use. Overall, it's a good product.

title: Absorbs Well
text: I have been using various anti-aging products regularly for the last few years. I am 51 and my skin looks much younger than that. I have added this serum to my daily skin care routine for the past couple of weeks. It absorbs well into my skin and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. It has a light smell which dissipates quickly. I apply serums usually right after cleansing my face after I've allowed my skin to dry for a moment. I follow with a moisturizer, eye cream, and targeted wrinkle cream and then finally sunscreen. I really haven't noticed any new results, but considering I have been using such products regularly for so long, I am not surprised. It doesn't irritate my skin at all. Overall, I like this serum.

title: Works Well as a Concealer
text: The natural ivory color is as expected. It is a good match. This has worked well for me as a concealer. It doesn't glide on really easily, but it does dab onto my skin. Then once on my face, I blend it with my finger tips. It feels dry going on, but it doesn't look dry or caked on. I tried this as a foundation at first, but it just doesn't apply easily enough to cover my entire face, therefore I changed to using it the concealer.

title: Soft!
text: My daughter and I use cotton rounds for all kinds of beauty needs. These are definitely comparable to others that we have tried. They are 100% cotton and very soft. They don't fall apart when using them. I would order these again.

title: Smells Nice
text: I have shoulder length coarse and thick hair. This shampoo and conditioner set smells nice. It is a light powdery floral scent.  It produces a good lather. I have noticed a slight decrease in the amount of hair loss this using this shampoo set. This has been measured by the amount of hair collected on the shower drain. Usually I have to clean the hair out of the drain every other day. While using this, I was able to go an extra day or even two before the clump of collected hair was noticeable enough that I needed to remove it. My hair isn't as soft though as with my usual shampoo. The first day after using this, my hair was actually not soft at all. I have noticed after a few days of use, it was softer than the first day, but still not as soft as I am used to. Overall, it's a good shampoo and conditioner set. I do find that when I use the same shampoo and conditioner every day, it doesn't work as well, so I do alternate between products now and then.

title: Dries My Hair Quickly
text: My sister bought me a high end hair dryer a few years ago, so my comparisons are with the BaByliss Pro 3000 that I have been using. I would say that this hair dryer is pretty comparable to the BaByliss one. They both dry my thick, shoulder length hair pretty quickly. It's definitely faster than a basic $25 hair dryer. The control buttons are placed similarly on both driers. I think because the BaByliss buttons were frequently getting messed up because of their location, the same issue with this Hot Tools model doesn't bother me because I'm used to that. I think this one is just a little quieter than the BaByliss one. It's not silent, you do hear it, but it's not as noisy as a lot of hair dryers out there. This one came with more attachments than the BaByliss one did. Overall, I am pleased with this dryer.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: This facial sunscreen is very gentle on my skin. I have added it to my morning beauty routine. I apply it after my moisturizer, though it is a bit moisturizing itself, and before my foundation. It doesn't irritate my somewhat sensitive skin. It has a light scent, not the typical sunscreen smell. Overall, I like it.

title: Strong Smell
text: I love a nice, strong scented lotion, but I wasn't crazy about this berry scented lotion. The scent is strong and a bit artificial in my opinion. It's not a foul smell, but it's over powering and lingers for a while. The lotion is thin and a bit runny. It does absorb well and it does leave behind soft hands. It's okay, but the strong scent is just too much for me.

title: Soft & Strong
text: These are some of the softest and strongest cotton rounds that I have ever used. I compared these side by side with the premium organic ones that I have been using and these were a definite winner. The first thing I checked was their origin. They are made in the USA. I am careful about where my beauty products come from these days. They are thicker than the other rounds, too. I use them with Micellar water after cleansing my face. These don't fall apart at all during use. I am very pleased with these and I'm thrilled to have so many!

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: This exfoliating scrub is gently on my skin. It lathers a little when scrubbing, too. It's not a harsh scrub at all and could probably be used more than once a week like my usual exfoliant. The scent is stronger than I prefer. It has a very strong grape smell which reminds me of grape kool-aid. It's not a bad smell, but definitely seems like more appropriate for a younger target audience.  It does a good job as an exfoliant.

title: Pretty Good for Disposable Razors
text: My husband usually uses a refillable razor. However, when he travels, he likes to just throw in a disposable one (or two) to use while away from home so he doesn't misplace his good one. This has been pretty good for a disposable razor. It gives a clean cut and leaves behind a smooth face. He likes having these on hand and would buy them again.

title: Smells Great!
text: Bath bombs have become very popular! This item is compromised of 4 sets of 6 bath bombs. Each set is is individually boxed so you can easily use them as gifts. These bath bombs are much smaller than ones that I have purchased before. They smell great, but the scent isn't long lasting. They dissolve pretty quickly and leave behind colored bath water. They do leave a little oiliness, but it does a nice job of softening skin. I haven't had any issue with staining the bath tub. I would definitely considering ordering more for gifts.

title: Great Gift Idea!
text: This is a great gift idea! It's the perfect kit for the bearded man in your life. The gift box is covered in a fun, cheeky drawing. The witty drawings continue inside the box. The products have the familiar Old Spice scent. It includes a beard wash, beard conditioner, beard oil, and beard balm. It's a lot of steps. And to be honest, I don't think my husband is following all the steps every day!!  It does a great job of softening the usual scratchy beard! I am going to order one of these kits for my father for Christmas!

title: Basic Disposable Razor
text: These are your basic disposable razor. They do the job. They really only last a couple of days before needing replacement. My husband likes to use disposable ones when he travels so he doesn't have to bother with replacement blades for his everyday razor. I do want to note that these arrived in a padded envelope and 3 of the razors were broken because there was nothing to prevent them from being crushed.

title: Silky Soft!
text: I am 50 years old and have been using anti-aging products for the past few years. These Retinol Ceramide capsules have become part of my bedtime beauty routine. I apply this to my clean face, before applying a night time cream, but after putting on some serum. This is silky soft! It reminds me of the way Benefit Porefessional Primer feels. It doesn't leave any greasiness at all. I don't usually use Rentinol, but I have not had any issues with it, such as redness or irritation.  I haven't noticed any less wrinkles, but my skin's overall condition continues to improve.

title: Decent Quality
text: I have been using a jade roller for several months. I use it after applying my serum and face cream to help get the product worked into my skin. My roller is significantly larger, so I was looking for a smaller one that could travel with me. This one is much smaller and fits the bill. It's a decent quality, though not the best. I would consider it a mid-quality in the world of jade rollers. And that would be mainly because of the metal pieces. But for the price, it's decent.

title: Good Variety
text: With the winter season approaching, I like keeping Chapstick (or lip balms) readily available.  So I went through all my usual lip balm spots and replaced them with these. When I started thinking about some of the lip balms that I had, I realized that some of them were at least a couple of years old or more. I'm not exactly sure what the shelf life of lip balm is, but I do try to go through my make up and beauty products regularly and discard old products, so it makes sense that I would do that with lip balm, too. This is a good variety of Chapsticks. My favorite is the moisturizing one. It is the only one with an SPF. I like that it does more than just coat my lips. Overall, these are what I expect from the Chapstick brand.

title: Beginning to See Results
text: I am 50 and have been using anti-aging products regularly for the past few years. I've been using this for a couple of weeks now.  I use the exfolitaing cleanser first in the morning. Then I apply a facial serum which is a different brand and not part of this kit. Then I use the targeted fine line cream around my eyes and mouth where my most obvious lines are present. Next, I use the heavier cream. I then use my jade roller. Lastly in the morning, I also add the moisturizer with sunscreen.  My face has been noticeably soft and moisturized. Unfortunately, I've also noticed some acne which I'm wondering if it's due to the heavier cream. I'm not having any issues with my sensitive skin (other than the acne). I'm beginning to see results around my lip/mouth area. The fine lines seem a little less noticeable. I think I'm going to stop using the heavier cream during the morning and use it only at night to see if that helps with the acne. Overall, I do like the set. They seem to work well together.

title: Difficult to Sharpen
text: While I was opening this up, the tip broke off the pencil. I have a make up pencil sharpener, but it has been very difficult to sharpen it. I have not been able to get a sharp point again, like when it arrived. It does glide on well. It actually looks black with just one coat. Many eye liners that I have used require multiple attempts in order to leave a dark line. Plus, once it was on, it seemed to stay put for the whole day. It removed easily with my magic eraser cloth. So I do like it, but I'm disappointed that I can't get the tip sharp.

title: Pleasant Light Scent
text: With the drier weather right now, I find myself reaching for hand lotion several times a day. I keep them located conveniently so I have access to them when needed. This one has a pleasant, light cucumber scent. I can also detect notes of some floral scents. The scent does linger a little while which I enjoy. The consistency is more what I would call a lotion, not a cream, meaning it's thinner than what I would expect from a cream. It absorbs into the skin quickly and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. My hands feel soft after using it.

title: Decent Magnifying MIrror
text: I have a large, pedestal type mirror in my bathroom with the same magnification. It's so large that it's not really something you pick up and hold if you need something closer. I have been using this one for those times when I need to get up close and personal to my mirror. It's also a good size for travel. It fits easily inside my cosmetic case. It comes with an "S" hook so you can hang it, though I prefer to hold it in my hand. There is also a plastic stand at the base of the mirror. Overall, it's a decent magnifying mirror.

title: Works Great!
text: Several years ago, I purchased some True Blue Gel Socks from Bath & Body Works. These are very similar to those. In fact, these are the closest thing I have found to them. My feet get really dry in the winter months. It gets to the point where I can't sleep well at night because my feet are too dry! Gel socks help a lot. I put some peppermint foot lotion on my feet then slip the socks over them at bedtime. I try to keep them covered for at least half an hour. I can't keep them on all night, but I've had them on for a few hours before. You can't really walk in them. If you do, please be aware that your feet might slide around inside the sock. Sizing is good. I wear a size 10W shoe and they fit me. I don't know if you could stretch them much more to accommodate a larger foot size, but they feel comfortable on me and not tight or restraining. There is a slight smell to these that I don't recall with the True Blue ones. It's not foul, but it is something I have noticed. In addition to the socks, it comes with a thinner heel sleeve as well as hand gloves. My hands are large. They're smaller than my husband who has average size man hands, but they are large for a woman. The gloves fit comfortably on me. Overall, these work as well as the True Blue ones plus you get the gloves and heel sleeves for a comparable price. They leave behind some softer feet, too!

title: Doesn't Look Cakey
text: This finishing powder comes in an easy to dispense jar. It's designed so you won't have spillage or messes. I apply it after my foundation or BB cream and it covers any shine and doesn't settle into any fine lines that I may have. It does have a slight powdery smell to it that I don't notice with other finishing powders. It's not bad, it's just noticeable. Overall, I like it and am pleased with the results.

title: Love it!
text: I turned 50 earlier this year and have been using anti-aging products regularly for the past few years. I already love several other Vichy products, but this is my first time using this serum. I've been using this for a couple of weeks and love it! The unique dispenser is easy to use and disperses enough serum to cover my face. It really isn't very much and it will cover my face and neck. It absorbs quickly, leaving behind an extremely smooth surface. It isn't sticky or greasy at all. There's a slight pleasant scent, but it dissipates rather quickly. My skin is a bit sensitive at times, but this has not irritated my face at all.  I'm very happy to add this to my beauty regime and will probably purchase this when I run out.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: This primer was not what I was expecting. It is more like a heavy cream and definitely not the consistency of other primers that I have used. However, I am really liking it! I put it on after I've put on my morning serum and moisturizer. I then wait a while before I put on my make up, so I allow my hair to air dry a bit. It creates a nice surface for my make up. I use a BB Cream instead of traditional foundation. It goes on smoothly. It doesn't settle in my wrinkles or fine lines. I don't notice any difference in how long my make up lasts, but once I've put it on, I really don't look at my face in the mirror! It has a light scent to it which I think is aloe. It doesn't irritate my sometimes sensitive skin, which is a huge plus to me. Overall, I like this product.

title: No Negative Side Effects
text: It's hard to review supplements. I've been taking this for close to 2 weeks so far. It's easy to swallow. There have been no negative side effects. I take Biotin supplements regularly, so I haven't really seen any differences in this or the previous supplement. I have seen some results since I've started taking Biotin, but I can't attribute them to this specific one. Since taking Biotin, I have seen improvement with my fingernails. The dosage of this is 2 tablets per day so it only comes with a month's supply.

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: Sometime during the last few years, my skin has become sensitive to some facial products. I haven't really taken the time to figure out what may be causing this new sensitivity, but some products make my face turn red. The effects are usually temporary, but there's got to be some reason that it's doing that. I've even had one or two products cause stinging or mild burning. Therefore, I tend to gravitate toward products geared toward sensitive skin. This one has been gentle on my skin and has not caused any reddening or stinging. I've been using it as a twice daily moisturizer. It has a very slight clean scent, but there is no added fragrance. It absorbs easily into my skin and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. It doesn't have any sunscreen, so I do have to add that to my morning routine. I often use a moisturizer that includes some kind of SPF. I am pleased with it.

title: Nice Scent!
text: I get my hair highlighted every couple of months. I usually use shampoo/conditioner for color treated hair, but after my last hair appointment, my hair dresser had to "tone down" my hair after she was finished with the highlights. That was a first for me. So then I saw this and thought I would give this shampoo a try. Before I started using it, I saw the same product line at the store, so I bought the conditioner to go with it.  The shampoo is a little thicker than other shampoos and has a nice scent. It lathers nicely. My hair didn't feel squeaky clean after rinsing like it does with my daily shampoo. It did seem to take longer rinsing before the water was clear again. I was a little disappointed in the instructions. When I read the directions on the product description, it mentioned different times to allow the product to work depending on the the results (warm blond or cool blonde). I didn't see anything on the actual bottle other than shampoo and rinse. I used this set for about 3 days in a row to start with. I didn't know if i had warm blonde or cool blonde, so I didn't leave the shampoo on for too long, but I did leave it on for longer than I would normally leave shampoo on. After the third day, I remembered that seeing the directions online so I went and read them. I also researched purple shampoo in general. I learned that you really shouldn't use it every day. So now I am using it once a week. I really wish more instructions were included on the bottle. If they were there, they were too tiny to read! No as to my hair, it did leave my hair soft. I really didn't notice any difference in the color of my hair, but I'm really not very observant . I do believe in using products for color treated hair. My hair dresser sells this line in her upscale salon, so I trust that it does what it's supposed to do. My highlights are beautiful and that makes me happy!

title: Gentle on My Skin
text: The Foreo Luna fofo does a great job of cleaning my skin. It's gentle on my skin and does not irritate. I just put a dab of cleanser on it and it gently exfoliates in a timed routine. There's an app that you can download that works with it. It connects via Bluetooth. There are sensors on the fofo that supposedly read the condition of your skin. However, I found the app to be glitchy. It took multiple attempts to get it to even analyze my skin. It would get stuck after the right cheek which is the first spot it scans. I kept restarting it. I finally deleted the app from my phone and reinstalled it and that did seem to help. I am still having some glitches, but it eventually does works. The app doesn't really tell you much in my opinion. It keeps track of how many times you cleanse your face using the app. It shows you the steps of our personalized cleansing routine. It's telling me that my face has low moisture and that I've added 2 years to my skin age. The results have not changed since I started using it and I have been meticulously moisturizing both morning and night since I got my first analysis. It also gave me a skin score of 50/100 which has not changed either. Maybe I'm really not improving my skin situation at all, but I feel like I am. I would like to see some suggestions that I could follow that would help improve my skin. One thing I don't like about using the app, and I feel the same way with my Clarisonic Mia Smart is that it's a pain to use because I use the device in the shower. When I am showering, I wash my hair, then add conditioner. While my hair is conditioning, then I wash my face, etc. So to use the app, I have to step out of the shower, drip water everywhere to start the cleansing routine on the app, then return to the shower. I've been getting water everywhere, including my phone! It's a little less awkward in the evening when I'm washing my face at the sink. However, I usually don't take my phone into the bathroom at all! In addition to the fofo, this also included a small tube of day time face cleanser and one of night time cleanser. The tubes are larger than a travel size. The cleansers smell good and do a good job of cleansing. Overall, I really do like the gadget, but the app just seems too much.

title: Helps My Eyes Look More Rested
text: I turned 50 this year and have been using various anti-aging products for the past few years. I do have some fine lines around my eyes.  I do have the occasional dark circles under my eyes. This product is tinted a yellowish tan. The first time I used it, I applied way too much and the eye cream settled into my fine lines and made them more obvious. I had to immediately remove it and start over. I used about half of that amount after that which is actually the recommended amount. The applicator was a little tricky to figure out, but once I understood how it worked, it was a cinch. It is effective at making my eyes look a little brighter which I believe makes them look more youthful as well as more rested. My eyes are really sensitive to a lot of eye creams and eye products out there. This did not irritate my eyes at all.

title: A Nice Accessory for the Clarisonic Mia!
text: I love my Clarisonic Mia Smart! I've been wanting to try some of the attachments that go with it, especially this one. While I really do love this eye massager, I'm not crazy about the app for the device. In order to use this with one of the 3 eye routines, you have to use it with the app. You can use the massager on it's own (without the app, but on the Mia Smart), but then you don't get the routines and various lengths of time that are in the apps. I've been using a jade roller recently, so I've been using this instead. So far I have been pleased with it. I use it with my eye cream and it does a good job of getting the product where it needs to go.

title: Doesn't Hurt!
text: Hair removal can be painful! This, however, is not. I have sensitive skin and hair remover creams irritate and annoy my skin greatly. I have tried tweezing, but I don't have the pain tolerance for that. I've tried the wand that you flex and rub against your skin and that hurts as much as tweezing. I was skeptical about this, but it really does work. It's similar to the "Seen on TV"  one. It requires a battery which is not included. One thing I didn't like about it is that to turn it on, you have to twist the battery cap. Almost every time I turned it on or off, the whole cap ended up coming off. The "See on TV" one has a slide switch that turns it off or on. I've been primarily using it on face - specifically my chin, upper lip, and around a mole that I have near the side of my lip. You really can't feel it at all.

title: Nice Lather!
text: As far as a body wash, it lathers nicely. It has a good consistency.  It's gentle on the skin and it doesn't dry it out. I personally don't like the scent though. It's not an over powering scent or foul scent. I just didn't like it and I realize that's a personal preference and took that into consideration of my review. I will keep this in my guest bathroom.

title: Great Color
text: I really like the color of this lip oil! It's very flattering. The oil is easy to apply. It's not sticky at all. It does come off pretty quickly and needs to be reapplied. I like it, but wished it lasted a little longer.

title: No Clumps!
text: I've been having issues with mascara lately. The last few ones that I have tried have been less than stellar. The issues that I have been having are mostly related to clumping and smearing. My issues started out when I replaced my high end mascara (after the suggested length of time) and went with a cheap store brand. I've had cheap ones that work well, but this was not it. It was a free one that I received in a beauty box. Every time I rubbed my eyes, I ended up with smears. I looked like a raccoon!  I then picked up another drug store type brand and it was leaving huge clumps on my lashes with each application. That one immediately went in the trash. Then I tried some high end samples that I had. The results were similar. Talk about frustration! Then this arrived. It doesn't give you super long lashes, but it is adequate. I just want my lashes to be a little longer than they are without. Without mascara, they are short and stubby. There have been no clumps and no smearing! It comes off easily enough with an oil-free eye make up remover pad. I have been very happy with this mascara. I am still on the lookout for one that gives me the really long lashes that I want for special occasions, but this is perfect for everyday use.

title: Non-Greasy
text: We go through a lot of sunscreen. My daughter is in her high school marching band and they spend hours out in the sun each week. She's fair skinned, so it's imperative that she uses sun protection. This one isn't greasy and absorbs quickly. It has the typical sunscreen smell. It's affordable enough that I encourage her to share with her teammates who forgot their own sunscreen. I personally have used it myself, too. It sweated into my eyes and stung a bit, but that's typical of most sunscreens. I try to remember to use special face sun screen for that reason. Overall, I like it and it does a good job.

title: Gentle Exfoliant
text: I have recently added exfoliating to my morning skincare routine. I usually exfoliate twice a week. I tend to prefer ones that are gentle and this one definitely fits that bill. I have found the original St. Ives Apricot scrub to be too harsh on my skin. I know that some of the other reviewers didn't like the smell of it. I thought it was rather pleasant. It's a fruity scent and I think it smells better than the St. Ives product. It leaves my skin soft and fresh without over drying it. I am a little concerned about it being manufactured in China. That may necessitate further inquiry if I were to reorder this, but for the time being, I do like this product.

title: Great for Travel!
text: This is a set of 3 small hotel sized bars of soaps. Each bar is targeted to a different skin type. This could be considered a sampler set. It comes with a travel case that fits one bar of soap. I've been using the Rose Geranium one which I thought was a good fit for my mature skin. My teen daughter is using the Lemongrass & Sweet Orange bar which is geared toward oily/acne prone skin. The bars are scented lightly and not overwhelming. The unscented one just smells a bit soapy. They produce an adequate amount of lather. They are gentle and non-drying. I think this would make a nice addition to a gift basket.

title: Best Tasting Vitamins Ever
text: My daughter and I have been taking these vitamins for over a week now and we're already seeing results. The first observation that I have noticed since taking this is that there has been less hair shedding. It's most noticeable in the shower because I'm not seeing as much hair left in the drain as I used to. In the past, I would have to clean out hair from the drain just about every day. Now I am going days before I notice the hair collecting there. The second observation is with my nails. One of my nails is split at the top and just won't correct itself. Every few days I have trim it down because when the split area get's long, it snags on everything. I haven't had any issues lately with it. I can still see the split, but the nail seems to be stronger now and when it grows out, the gap is closer together and not snagging. My daughter says her hair seems to be growing faster, but I have not noticed that with mine. These gummy vitamins taste great. I would say they're the best tasting vitamins ever! I have not had any issues with any side effects with these. I will definitely be reordering!

title: Gentle
text: On late nights, I opt for cleaning my face with make up wipes so I can get to bed sooner. These wipes are thicker than a lot of the ones that I've used and they don't rip when pulling one out. They are gentle and non-irritating which is important because I have sensitive eyes and skin. They do a good job of removing makeup, including mascara. The package reseals well so they won't dry out. Overall, I am impressed with the quality of these.

title: Long Lasting
text: I have only been recently introduced to Dermablend products. The banana powder is a nice neutral color that works with all kinds of skin types and skin tones. While easy to use, I do find it a bit of pain because it requires a 2 minute time period between application and buffing. I'm on a tight schedule in the mornings, and I've been trying to rearrange my morning routine to accommodate the extra 2 minutes. The powder does not irritate. It leaves a smooth, finished look that lasts for most of the day. By the time I get home from work, there's little evidence left that I was even wearing make up. That's usually the case with whatever make up I wear. Overall, I like it and would probably purchase more when I run out.

title: Non-Irritating
text: My skin can be sensitive to some products. I haven't figured out if it's just certain ingredients or not, but it's something I don't have to deal with all the time fortunately. Some products will sting or burn. Others leave my face red. I don't have any issues with fragrance, but this product is fragrance free. It's been gentle and non-irritating. It seems to be a good night time moisturizer. It's not a heavy cream nor is it greasy.

title: Not What I Expected
text: This primer wasn't at all what I expected. All of the primers that I have used before have been the soft, smooth ones that practically melt onto your skin. This one is strangely tacky and sticky. I don't spend a lot of time putting my make up on, but this one requires an additional minute or so to allow the product to dry. I found that it does give a nice base before adding my foundation. I put my make up on in the morning and don't touch up during the day. I go for a fairly natural look, but by the end of the day, I really couldn't tell any difference with this primer or any other. Most of my make up was worn off, even with setting powder and setting spray. So, I do like it, but I'm not a believer that it will keep my make up any longer.

title: Requires Patience
text: This is an interesting, but effective loose powder. It does require some patience. My beauty routine takes all of just 2 or 3 minutes in the morning and now when I use this, I have to add another minute or two. The travel size does not come with any type of applicator, so I have been using it with my own brushes. It does seem to do a great job of setting my make up. I have noticed that my make up is not wearing off as quickly with this. It does not irritate my skin. Overall, I am liking this and will probably order the full size one when I am out.

title: Does Not Irritate
text: My eyes have become pretty sensitive to products. Some products will cause my eyes to burn or sting either caused by rubbing my eyes or from sweating. This eye cream does not sting or burn my eyes. This is the first eye cream that I have used that says to apply it to your eye lids. It took a little while to figure out how to dispense the cream, the applicator style is one that I have never used before. The cream does do a good job of moisturizing the delicate skin around my eyes. I'm not really sure if this is an anti-aging product or not or just a moisturizer. I have been using it alone so far, but I do normally use anti-aging products geared for wrinkles around the eyes. It's not greasy or oily and doesn't have any fragrance.

title: Great for Highlighting!
text: This small palette has 4 shades of the same color. Each one is just slightly different. They are fairly light and moderately pigmented. I've been using them as a highlighter near the brow and a dab in the corner and it works well. The color seems to last most of the day. It doesn't irritate my eyes. Overall, a decent eye shadow.

title: Unique Green Corrector
text: I was quite surprised at how this green corrector powder worked. It magically turns into a cream from a powder right before your eyes.
