I found that once it is in the cream state, it was a little dry and difficult to blend in, but it seems to be getting better with practice. My daughter likes using green to cover some of her redness and this is doing a decent job of it. It comes in a small jar and it has a special lid that you lift up so you can sprinkle some of the powder out. I am still fascinated by it!

title: Non-Irritating
text: This morning I sneezed right after I applied my mascara, so it didn't have time to dry. I had black mascara marks below my eyes and on my eyelids, too. I was able to remove all of the black mascara smudges with one of these applicators without messing up the rest of my makeup. These are easy to use and they do not irritate my sensitive eyes. I will definitely be reordering these in the future.

title: Soft Bristles
text: These eye makeup brushes are lightweight. The bristles are soft. I have not seen any shedding yet which is good. I don't have any cream eye shadows, so I used the larger one on regular eye shadow and it did a decent job. The smaller brush is really good and seemed to hold a fair amount of powder on it. I would say that these are comparable to other brushes in the mid-price range.

title: Gentle & Non-Irritating
text: My husband gets athletes foot fairly regularly. This has been wonderful at helping to control it. We keep this in the shower and he has been using it daily. It lathers a little bit, but not as much as other soap products. It's gentle and non-irritating. It is unscented and only has a slight soapy smell. Since he has been using this, he's noticed quicker improvement with his condition than the times when he uses just a cream or powder to treat it. And because he uses it in the shower, there's no mess!

title: Does Not Sting or Irritate
text: I wash my face every evening before bedtime to remove dirt and makeup. I always think I'm doing a good job of cleansing until I follow up with a toner! This one does not irritate or sting my sensitive skin. It doesn't dry out my skin either. It does have a slight scent that is okay and not over powering. Overall, I do like it, but it's not my favorite toner out there, but it's reasonably priced, so I would consider ordering it again.

title: Nice Hair Brush
text: My daughter has fine hair and prefers paddle brushes. This one is interesting because it has a few rows of nylon bristles in the center and then the rest of the brush has ball tipped bristles. The handle is curved and easy to hold. There are no ridges to keep it from slipping, though that really hasn't been an issue yet. The brush works well and does a good job of detangling and smoothing my daughter's hair. She lets her hair dry naturally, so the vented feature doesn't matter. Overall, it's a nice brush. It's not her favorite, but it's perfect for her to keep in her color guard bag for touch ups before competitions.

title: I Love the Brush!
text: I've been using facial scrub brushes for the last year or two. They've been in the $25 range. I definitely notice a difference in the quality of this brush compared to the cheaper ones. I love this brush! I downloaded the app that comes with it and I don't love that as much. First of all, I don't like to use my phone in the bathroom. I've tried this app a couple of times and I get water all over my phone! I tend to use the brush in the shower. I get the app all ready to go, get in the shower, then wash my hair, rinse, apply conditioner all before I'm ready to scrub my face. Then I have to open the shower door and step out to reach my phone and press the start button on the app. Not only is there some water on my phone, but water's all over the floor. The brush itself is awesome! Though I do wish it came with some of the other attachments! I was so excited to learn about the massaging/anti-aging routines that the brush can do. Well, you have to purchase these other brush heads for $50 or so to be able to utilize those routines. It would have been nice to have one set that came with everything I needed. So I would give 5 stars for the brush, but the app and not having any of the other brush heads included, I am giving this 4 stars.

title: Nice Set of Brushes
text: I started using gel eye liner in the past year. I had a small tiny brush that came with my liner, but I have been wanting a longer handled one. This set is pretty good. The angled one is a more narrow brush which works better for me. I don't do any fancy cat eyes or other trendy looks with my eye liner, so it's all I need. I've actually been using the other brush for eye shadow and it works well for that purpose. I haven't noticed any loose hairs after using it. The brush is pretty easy to hold and control. The bristles are fine and firm enough. Overall, these are good brushes.

title: Leaves My Face Feeling Soft!
text: This is my 4th facial brush in as many years. I started with the Olay ProX one until it stopped working. Then I had some no-name one that didn't last very long at all. The one before this one was the Conair True Glow. This one seems to be pretty close to the Olay and the Conair one in its performance. I was pleased with both of them, so that's been good. All of the ones that I have tried are pretty similar in price range. I have not tried any of the expensive ones like the Clarisonic ones. I like the timer feature so I know when to go to the zone. This one comes with batteries so it's ready to go out of the box. My skin has been pretty soft since using this. It cleans well. So for the price range, I think this is pretty comparable to the others.

title: Easy to Get the Right Color
text: It's really nice not to have to worry about what color of foundation to pick. This magically matches your skin tone. It is non-irritating and easy to use. It goes on almost white, but quickly transform into the right shade for you. I felt that it did settle into my large pores and draw attention to them if I wasn't careful about applying it to my moisturized skin. On more than one occasion I had to completely wash my face and start over and apply extra moisturizer in troublesome areas so it would go on smoothly. I do like it, but it's not my favorite skin coverage product.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I am pleasantly surprised at how much I am liking this mascara! The biggest issues for me when it comes to mascaras are does it irritate my sensitive eyes and does it smudge. I have not had any irritations at all since using this product, therefore I am quite pleased in that regard. As far as smudging, I have not noticed any of that. I rub my eyes at least a couple of times a day and I hate it when my mascara transfers from my lashes to the skin beneath my eyes!  Now looking at other aspects of the mascara, it does lengthen my lashes appropriately. By appropriate, I mean, not too long. I do like super long lashes at times, but not for everyday use. I save that for special occasions. It doesn't smear and leave raccoon eyes! The primer is a nice bonus. I haven't noticed any difference without or out the primer, but I am a fan of cosmetic primers and use them, so I assume it's making a difference. The one thing that I don't like is that when I take the mascara wand out of the tube, I always end up with it in the wrong hand and I have to switch hands. That's because of the way the primer and mascara positioned to get the most storage room. I understand it, I just hate having to switch it! Other than that, I am very pleased with this and will consider ordering more when I run out.

title: Messy, But Fun
text: My 17 year old daughter has made lots of bath bombs in the past few years. We've never purchased kits before, instead we've looked up recipes and directions online and made them from scratch. I thought a kit would be fun for her to do with her 9 year old cousin. First of all, they did have fun. It was a bit messy, but that didn't deter them. The finished products were okay, but a little disappointing for my niece because they didn't look as nice as the pictures or store bought bath bombs. The kit only allows you to make up to 4 bath bombs so in my opinion it's a lot of effort (and mess) to only result in 4 finished bath bombs. I would probably be okay with giving this as a gift, but I wish you could purchase refill kits to go along with it.

title: Non-Greasy
text: This is not what I expected at all. When I saw that it was a gel, I expected it to be a little on the sticky side and a bit wetter. It is actually more like a creamy lotion. It absorbs well into the skin and leaves you feeling soft and moisturized. I am very surprised by it! I have not used anything like this before. I moisturize my body every morning after I shower, then again at night before bed. I don't use the same lotion or product every time, I usually rotate between a few different ones depending on my mood. Sometimes I prefer a scented one but if I am going to wear perfume, I use one that is fragrance free. This one doesn't leave behind any oiliness or greasiness as I thought it might. There is pretty much no scent in it, so it's a good option on days where I want to wear fragrance. I have even used this on my feet before going to bed and although it doesn't have the peppermint oil in it like the foot lotions I use, it does a decent job of cooling my feet and keeping them moistened. This is probably not a product I would have picked out at the store, but I am so glad that I ordered this! I will definitely be getting this again!

title: No Pain!
text: I am a 50 year old woman and I have been dealing with some unwanted facial hair for the past few years. The hairs are mostly on my upper lip and around a mole that I have near my mouth. I have tried some different facial hair remover creams, but I ended up with a bad skin burn. My skin is pretty sensitive and it didn't even remove all the hairs! I've been using one of those battery operated personal razors, but even then the results are just so-so. I tried one of those coiled wands that you run along your face and that hurt! I finally saw a youtube video of a woman testing this product in an unboxing video. She was pretty funny and seemed honest when trying it out. I was carefully watching for any signs of pain and she didn't show any. She really liked it, so I decided to give it a try. This really does work! It doesn't hurt at all. It is the easiest way to get rid of unwanted facial hair that I have ever tried. It comes with batteries, so you can start using it right away. I would not have tried it if I hadn't seen the video first because I had become very skeptical of any method that claimed to be pain free and easy to use. But this one really is!!!

title: Nice Floral Scent
text: Calvin Klein Women parfum is a very nice, floral scent. It's not overpowering (unless you spray too much!) and lingers allowing you to catch whiffs of it throughout the day. It's fairly light for a parfum, so it is appropriate for daytime as well as evening. The bottle is heavy glass, but the top is plastic. When I first saw the picture of the product online, it looks like a nice glass bottle with a drawing of an eye behind it. That so-called drawing is actually the lid. The drawing is nice, but on the bottle it's just a bit strange and out of place. I would expect a fragrance with the Calvin Klein name to have a more professional looking lid.

title: Easy to Use
text: I love how easy sheet masks are to use. This was my first mud mask using the sheets. The mask is 2 pieces instead of one. At first I thought it was broken. Two separate pieces allows for a much better fit than one piece. You have to remove the plastic white side of the mask to expose the mud side. Then you have to remove another layer of clear plastic from the side that is away from your face so it allows the mask to conform to your skin. The openings of the mask were pretty adequate except around the eyes. The holes were big enough for the eyes only, so I had to cover my eyebrows which I wasn't thrilled with. I usually don't apply jar or tube masks to my eyebrow area. The mask has a light, pleasant scent. It had a cooling feeling when it was on my face. When the timer went off, it was easy to remove. There wasn't a lot of mud left on my face, but it still required a good rinsing. My face felt good after the mask. I didn't notice any miraculous results, but it didn't leave any redness or irritation either. As far as mud masks go, it was definitely the easiest and neatest experience.

title: Leaves My Skin Soft!
text: This cream by Erno Laszlo is my new favorite. It has a very light, but pleasant scent that does not linger. The cream itself is a pale peachy color and is non-greasy. It absorbs pretty quickly and immediately leaves my skin feeling soft. It's a heavier product than what I usually use, so I use this at night. I am 50 years old and I have been using anti-aging products regularly for the past couple of years.  As far as brightening and lightening, I am fair skinned and don't really have any dark spots yet. I have noticed an improvement in my skin's texture. It's also doing a great job of moisturizing my skin. It is a bit pricey, but it's definitely what I would consider a luxury skin care product.

title: Lasts a Few Days Before Chipping
text: The Pure nail color is a good, bright white color. It's a tad thick and clumped a bit when I applied the first coat, so I shook it a little more vigorously and that seemed to help. It dries quickly. Immediately after applying the first coat, I put on my flip flops and ran to the store. I wasn't particularly careful, but when I got home, there were no smudges. I applied the second coat when I got back home. I did not use any top coat or base coat with it on this first application. I didn't see notice any chips for at least a few days. The lid of the bottle is not attached to the larger lid cover. I thought it was all one piece, but when you twist it, the wide piece comes off leaving you with the standard thin, round lid with the attached brush. I thought it was a bit strange that it was there for just decoration.  Overall, it seems to be a good, nail polish and it is comparatively priced.

title: Gentle and Non-Irritating
text: Since I recently turned 50, I have been trying to be more regular with my skincare routine. I have been using anti-aging products for years, but it was usually just in the morning. Now, I have a regular morning and evening skincare routine that I have been following. I have been using this Erno Laszlo Radiance Emulsion at bedtime. It absorbs well, though I do give it about a minute before I apply anything else. It has a very light pleasant scent that's not artificial or perfumy. I don't have much in the way of dark spots yet, but I love that this serum also works to prevent future environmental damage. It isn't greasy or sticky. The pump works and makes for easy dispensing. It takes just one pump to cover my face. If I want to apply it to my neck and upper chest area, it takes two pumps. It does not leave my skin red or splotchy. I have somewhat sensitive skin and some products do leave a temporary redness. It also doesn't sting my eyes. I try to avoid the eye area when applying all creams and serums, but I do have to rub my eyes a lot and that does cause some products to get in my eyes. Overall, it's a nice addition to my evening routine.

title: Gentle & Effective Cleanser Set
text: I was pleasantly surprised by this travel duo. First of all, the directions were very hard to read. It comes with a multi-page guide which gives usage instructions for several of the Erno Laszlo products in the White Marble line. I also received the Radiance Emulsion which also came with an instruction guide. The print in these is very small and was difficult to read even with my reading glasses. The instructions for the soap and oil set were different in the two pamphlets. In one it said to collect hot water in your sink then dunk the bar of soap into it. Then it said to splash the soapy water onto your face twenty times. It was really complicated. The second pamphlet basically said to use it directly on your face and then rinse. I went with that one. Other than that, I really loved these products. I use the oil first. It has a nice pleasant scent. It's not oily at all. I've never used a cleansing oil before and was pleased with how it worked. You massage it into your skin then rinse. The soap has a different scent, but it's also very pleasant. I loved the soap so much that I even bought a full size bar of it to use when this travel size is gone. These products left my skin feeling soft and clean. It didn't over dry at all. I have really sensitive eyes and although I kept the products away from my eyes, if any accidently got in there, it didn't sting or burn. Neither of the products left my skin red either. Overall, I am in love with this set of cleansing products.

title: Decent Moisturizer
text: I always use a moisturizer with sunscreen in the morning. This one is unscented, but there is a light sunscreen smell to it. It's not off putting or over powering. In fact, compared to other moisturizers with sunscreen, the smell is less noticeable. It absorbs quickly into the skin. I have also been using this on my upper chest area because that's an area that I often forget about. I work in a school and have to help with bus duty in the morning. I don't apply regular sunscreen every day, but at least those delicate skin areas are covered. This is non-greasy which is a must for me. I have combination skin at it hasn't caused any breakouts since using it. I also have very sensitive eyes and sometimes I have issues with moisturizers sweating into them and causing painful stinging. We're having 90 degree days right now and that hasn't happened, so that's good. Overall, it's a decent moisturizer. I don't love it, but I do like it.

title: Easy to Use
text: I've been using sheet masks for the past couple of years. They are very convenient and easy to use, plus they're not too messy. The material for the masks is different than most of the ones that I have used. It's more like a heavy paper towel and even has the texture of paper towels. That may be more eco friendly, I don't know. I didn't like or dislike it better than the others. It didn't rip easily like some do.It was a little difficult to get it to lay flat on my face and I had to keep pressing down on parts. That is also pretty common with sheet masks. These are very saturated and dripped a lot while I was wearing it. They left my hands feeling a little sticky, though I didn't feel the stickiness on my face. I didn't notice any tingling while wearing it, but it did have a nice cooling affect which was more noticeable when I removed the mask. It didn't irritate my skin or eyes. Overall, I found it to be just okay. I didn't hate it, but I'm not sure I would order these again.

title: Pleasant Vanilla Scent
text: I like this style lip balm over the EOS sphere shaped ones. You can't slip the sphere ones into your pocket!  The vanilla scent is very light and hardly noticeable. The twist mechanism of one of my lip balms doesn't work all the time. On several occasions, I have had to push on the balm directly to get it to go back down. It's not a consistent issue though. The actual lip balm glides on well. It coats the lips and doesn't absorb. It seems to stay on for a little while, but it does need to be reapplied more frequently than some lip balms.

title: Great Color Match!
text: This concealer is creamy and light weight. A little goes a long way. I've learned that you need to dab/blend it in well or it looks a bit cakey. I've been following up with a blending sponge and the results have been very good. The color is a good match for both my teenage daughter and me. It has an almost powdery finish, but it feels a bit oily when applying it. It doesn't seem to settle into fine lines and wrinkles thankfully. I've been pretty pleased with it.

title: Nice Assortment of Bath Soaps
text: This assortment of bath packets is great for home baths. There are four packets of different scents. Each packet has a "sniff" corner, but I couldn't smell anything on any of the packets. The soaps dissolve well in the bath water. I've used the lavender one so far and it smelled wonderful! It was very relaxing and perfect for my bedtime bath. They come packaged in a collapsible box, but since it arrived in a padded envelope, the integrity of the box didn't hold up well.

title: Dries Clear
text: This sunscreen doesn't have the usual sunscreen smell. There's a slight scent, but it's light and it dissipates quickly. It sprays on evenly and is clear. It dries quickly and I found that I didn't have to rub it in. It has a continuous spray that works well. No sunburns so far!

title: Goes On Smoothly
text: The description says this is a plum shade and I would agree with that. It's darker than some other mauve colors that I have used. It looks okay on me, but it looks dressier than I usually wear. My 17 year old daughter tends to wear darker shades and she loves the color. It goes on smoothly. It's not as creamy as some lipsticks but it's not dry either. It's not particularly shiny either, but it's definitely not matte. For a glossier look, I just added some clear lip gloss. It does transfer on to glassware. It lasts for about a couple of hours with minimal eating and drinking.

title: Not Cakey Or Dry
text: I've been dissatisfied with my foundation for a while. I've been trying all kinds of different ones, ranging from drugstore brands to more expensive brands such is IT Cosmetics and Tarte. I've also tried several geared toward mature skin, since I am 50. Lately I have been most satisfied with tinted moisturizers rather than actual foundation products. Foundations either look cakey  or emphasize my pores plus they never last long. I've never used a stick foundation before. I really expected it to look dry and cakey. I thought I would have to wash it off immediately and replace it with something else. I was quite surprised that I didn't have to do that. Although it is a stick product, it's still pretty creamy. I have used the sponge applicator with it, but I find I get a little more control with just using my finger tips. It does not settle into my wrinkles or pores. It does seem to last longer than some of the other foundations that I have used, but it's not lasting all day. By the end of the day it's mostly worn off. It doesn't irritate my skin. Another problem that I have with some foundations is that when I sweat or rub my eyes, it causes stinging in my eyes. I have not had any issues with that even though we've been having 90 degree weather lately. The biggest complaint that I have with this foundation is that there's not very much product and will have to be replaced sooner than a lot of the other foundations that I use.

title: Great Natural Color
text: I love this color! It's very natural looking, which is great for everyday use. It's very creamy and moisturizing as far as lipsticks go. It lasts for a couple of hours with minimal drinking or eating. It does transfer onto glassware and such, as expected. The color has a slight frost to it, but it's not like some 1980's frosted lipstick. I'm 50 and I think it looks appropriate. I wouldn't want to attract a lot of attention, so if it's something that I will wear, it's got to be subtle.

title: Dries Clear!
text: My daughter participates in marching band and goes through a lot of sunscreen during practice season. She prefers spray sunscreens because they are fast and easy to use. These are the bigger sized cans. During band camp she can go through one of the smaller canisters in about two days. I'm hoping this larger size will last her a full week! She just used it on a recent trip to Six Flags. I sprayed her before she left. The spray is a good, continuous mist. It dries clear. It smells just like regular sunscreen (not the tropical ones). This was too big to take with her to the amusement park, so she took a travel size lotion with her for reapplications. She did not burn, so I consider that a success.

title: Leaves My Hair Soft
text: I have thick, coarse hair. I usually add some Argan Oil to my hair after I get out of the shower and have towel dried it. I've been using this for the past couple of weeks instead. I am using this in addition to the rinse out conditioner that I usually use. This is a white, milky liquid. The spray is more of a stream than a mist. I think I would prefer a mist action. Since it is less directed of a spray, I use my hands to work it into my hair after spraying it. I don't really detect much of a coconut smell to it at all, but I can smell some pineapple. I was a bit surprised by that, but I read the ingredients and it does contain pineapple extract. Since it's summer vacation, I let my hair air dry on most days. I'm not really noticing any difference over the Argan oil since I've been using it which is good. The Argan Oil has been leaving my hair really soft, so this must be doing the same. It doesn't leave my hair greasy nor my hands sticky. Overall, it's a good product.

title: Long Lasting
text: I haven't had much experience with liquid lipstick, but my 17 year old daughter loves it. One coat does a surprisingly good job.It provides total coverage. The color is better than I expected. I'm 50 years old and thought that a metallic color would be inappropriate for me. But it's not as metallic as I was expecting. It has a slight metallic shimmer, but I felt that it wasn't too flashy. The color is also more neutral than I thought it would be. It's definitely a matte product and offers no shine. It feels a bit dry and does emphasize some of the natural lines on my lips. I didn't notice any lip transfer on my cup. The color stayed on my lips for quite a while without needing to be reapplied. Several hours later, I was able to just add some clear lip gloss and still have color on my lips. In the end, my daughter has claimed it for herself, but I'm actually considering checking into some of the other colors in the this product line for myself.

title: Lovely Scent
text: Applying lotion or body cream after I shower is part of my daily routine. This body cream is fairly thick and definitely a cream rather than a lotion. It absorbs well and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. The smell is a bit strong, but I actually like it. It has a nutty caramel-vanilla scent which reminds me of Sol de Janeiro's Bum Bum Cream. The scent lingers for a while, but it does not last all day. It's a gentle cream that doesn't irritate my skin. I'm a fan!

title: Gentle & Non-Irritating
text: These facial wipes come individually packaged which makes them great for on the go refreshening. I also keep some in the guest bathroom. They are lightly moistened and not over saturated. The have a very light almost citrusy scent.  The scent reminded me a lot of the wipes that they give you in Delta international flights, only they weren't warmed up first. They adequately clean and remove makeup. They are a bit thin, so be careful when handling so it doesn't rip or tear. I have somewhat sensitive skin and these don't irritate.

title: Light Weight Moisturizer
text: I am 50 and I have been using anti-aging products regularly for the past several years. This is a light weight moisturizer that absorbs quickly without leaving any greasiness behind. It does have a light scent. It reminds me of the liquid Vitamin C vitamins that I used as a child. It's more of a lotion consistency than a cream. It doesn't take a lot to cover my face. I haven't noticed any improvement in my skin's texture or elasticity, but since I have been using various anti-aging products for a while, that doesn't surprise me. For daytime use, I do prefer to use moisturizers with sunscreen, so I don't have to add another product to my beauty routine.

title: Gentle & Non-Irritating
text: This is a thick and heavy cream. It has a pleasant scent that reminds me of soap. It's not an overpowering scent, but it is noticeable. It absorbs nicely and fairly quickly. It doesn't leave behind any greasiness. I don't have much unevenness in my facial skin, so I haven't noticed any changes in that regard, but it does do an adequate job of moisturizing. I have also been applying it to the back of my hands and I have noticed a difference there. The thin skin in that area has improved in texture and appearance. I'm 50 years old and my hands are beginning to show their age. I have found this cream to be gentle and non-irritating.

title: Gentle Exfoliator
text: I turned 50 this year and have been using anti-aging products for the past several years. I do enjoy a good facial exfoliator and try to use them a couple of times a week. I'm not sure how they describe different exfoliators, but compared to others, this has a "mid-grit" to it. I've had some that are harsher and some that are gentler. It doesn't take a lot of product per use. It has a mild, pleasant scent that's barely noticeable. It rinses easily after use. I have somewhat sensitive skin. Some products leave my face red for a while. I had no issues with this after using it. I haven't noticed any difference as far as the age defying, but since I am a regular user of such products, that doesn't surprise me. It leaves behind soft skin.

title: Fast & Easy Curls!
text: My  17 year old daughter loves it when her hair is curled, but she doesn't usually take the time to do so because it is so time consuming. The CHI Air Spin N Curl is fast and easy. She started by watching some videos online. That gave her enough confidence to give it a try. You put a small section of hair and put it into the curler. It does some magic and spins the hair into curls. It amazes us how fast and easy it is. The outer chamber doesn't get hot. It beeps when the hair is done. A couple of times the hair doesn't go into it correctly but it beeps to tell you that you need to reinsert that bit of hair. She's tried curling wands, curling irons, curlers, and straighteners and nothing has been this easy or successful.

title: Nice, Neutral Color
text: I prefer lip gloss over lipstick. This Tres Leches color is a good, neutral color. It's almost in the nude shade range, but there's a little more color to it. It goes on easily. It has a buttery feel to it. It's slightly sticky, but not in an annoying way. It smells amazing! It does transfer onto your cups, utensils, etc, so you do need to reapply it during the day. But if you're not eating/drinking/kissing, it does stay in place for a while and doesn't just absorb into your lips. It's not too large, so I can keep it in my pocket so I can reapply as needed.

title: Good For Younger Skin
text: I find it difficult to find the right foundation. While I found this one to be good, I don't think it's the one for me. First of all, I love the dispenser. One pump covers most of my face. The foundation goes on smoothly and has an almost powdery feel to it. There's a slight, pleasant scent that reminds me of a moisturizer that I used to use. The overall look isn't cakey, however, it does seem to draw attention to my wrinkles and fine lines. I do like the glow or sheen that is left after the product is absorbed. The coverage is good, but it doesn't last all day. By the time I get home from work, you can't tell that I was wearing any foundation at all. I let my teenage daughter try it and I think it worked much better on her younger skin. She doesn't wear foundation regularly, but was pleased with how it looked on her. I'm 50 and need to start looking at foundations geared toward more mature skin.

title: Natural Way to Thicken Lashes
text: I'm 50 and over the years, my eye lashes have thinner. I never had full, long lashes, but I have noticed a difference compared to what I once had. I'm hesitant to try some of the products out there marketed toward fuller lashes. My eyes are very sensitive and those products can be very pricey. I love natural remedies when I can find them, so I was very happy to give castor oil a try. I've been applying the oil to my lashes before bedtime most nights for the past couple of weeks. I like that this set came with a small mascara like tube and lash applicators. It was a little messy pouring the oil into the tube. And I make a mess almost every time I use the oil on my lashes. The brush gets too much oil, so I have to wipe the sides of the brush back into the tube. I have to wipe the tube every time or I end up with oil on my counter. It's pretty easy to apply the oil to the lashes. I haven't noticed any difference in the length of my lashes yet, but they are beginning to seem fuller and thicker. There is a slight scent to the castor oil. It kind of reminds me of how olive oil smells, but not as strong as that at all. It doesn't irritate my eyes at all. I will continue to include this in my bedtime routine.

title: Very Hydrating!
text: I have been pleasantly surprised by this Hyaluronic Acid Serum. I've tried other serums before, but this one stands out. It has a gel like consistency that really hydrates the skin. I am 50 years old and have combination skin. I've been using assorted anti-aging products for several years now. This serum absorbs quickly into my skin and doesn't leave behind any stickiness or greasiness. I've been using 2 pumps per application, twice a day. The covers my entire face and neck area. I follow up with my jade roller to help it soak into my skin. Then in the morning I use a moisturizer with sunscreen afterwards and at bedtime I put a night cream on. My skin has been feeling super soft since adding this to my skincare regimen. I especially notice it feeling a little moist in the morning. It has no scent or smell. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. At the time of this review, it's listed at $19.99 which is very reasonable. I will definitely be adding this as a regular part of my skincare routine.

title: Nice Variety of Colors for Teens
text: I found this eye shadow palette to be a little too shimmery for my 50 year old self, but my teenage daughter loves it! The colors are reasonably pigmented and they last for several hours. They are fairly neutral shades and they have a variety of finishes. As for the scent, I personally think it's a little strange to have scented eye shadow, but my daughter said it was a thing these days. She compared it to the Too Faced Sweet Peach Eye Palette. There are fewer color choices than the Too Faced palette, but the colors are more appropriate for teenagers in my opinion. This is significantly cheaper than the Too Faced one! I found the scent of this palette to not be very strong, and it definitely isn't off-putting. And finally, it doesn't irritate my daughter's eyes. Overall, I think it's a good, palette for teens.

title: A Gentle & Effective Cleanser
text: My daughter is almost 17. She has been fortunate in the skin department for the most part, but she has had her share of acne now and then. Recently, she's had a few pimples on her chin that she just couldn't get rid of. She has tried several different acne face cleansers without any luck. This Biore cleanser has worked wonderfully! Within a few days, the acne on her chin was completely gone. This cleanser is super foamy. We expected it to be foamy, but it was even foamier than we expected. It has a light, pleasant scent. It rinses cleanly and didn't dry out her skin. I will definitely order this again for my teen.

title: Leaves My Skin Soft!
text: I turned 50 this year and have sensitive combination skin with a tendency to be dry. I use the micellar water after cleansing my face with water. It does a good job of removing anything left. I tried it once to remove my eye makeup, but my eyes are super sensitive and left them stinging so I avoid that area now. Most products, even ones that are gentle or for sensitive skin do that, so that was not unexpected. I also used it to help remove some lip stain that I had applied but wanted to remove it because it was too dark. It did help remove the color, but I ended up getting some in my mouth and tasting it. Yuck! It tasted awful! Lesson learned! As far as the other serum and moisturizer, I love them! My skin is also pretty sensitive and these have not irritated me or caused any redness. I have been using them regularly at night time. I need to use moisturizers with sunscreen during the daytime.  It takes about two pumps to cover my face and neck area. I follow up with using a jade roller to gentle massage it into my skin. My skin has been a lot less dry in the morning since using these products.

title: Controls Shine & Oil!
text: My teenage daughter has been using this cream for a couple of weeks. She has noticed a huge decrease in the amount of oil on her face in the t-zone area by the afternoon. She doesn't wear a lot of make up, so she comes by her shiny face naturally. The cream is gentle and doesn't annoy or irritate her skin. She hasn't noticed any difference in the size of her pores though. She hasn't had any unusual breakouts either.

title: Natural Look!
text: I am 50 and my eyes look it. I have been searching for a product that would work well at making my eyes look a little younger, so I was excited to give this a try. First of all, I was a little disappointed to receive a sample instead of the full size. The sample size is .1 oz and does not come in the pump bottle. I've been using this for about a week and a half and it's just about empty. The cream is thin and lightly tinted. My skin color is fairly light, and it goes pretty well with my skin tone. I apply it after I my regular eye cream. It blends in pretty well and looks natural. I don't notice any difference with my wrinkles, but it does do a good job of making my eyes look better rested and hiding the circles under my eyes. My eyes are pretty sensitive to a lot of eye products and this doesn't seem to irritate them. Sometimes products will sweat into my eyes or get rubbed in and will cause burning and stinging. I haven't had that issue with this cream. Although I do like this, I probably wouldn't buy it again at the high price it's currently listed at. It doesn't work any better than other products that I have tried using for the dark circles.

title: Pores Are Less Noticeable!
text: My teenage daughter has combination skin. She has been using this for a couple of weeks and has definitely noticed a difference in the presence of pores around her nose area, especially. It's light weight and doesn't feel heavy. It absorbs up any oil that's left on her skin after cleansing it. It doesn't irritate or leave any redness. This has become a regular part of her morning routine since discovering it.

title: Gentle But Effective
text: I have been very pleased with this facial cleanser so far. This foams well. The foam is airy and light weight. It has a light, pleasant scent which doesn't over power your senses. The cleanser rinses cleanly. I have somewhat sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate at all. It doesn't sting my eyes either. This is a good, mild cleanser.

title: Lasts All Day!
text: I don't always put on full make up, but I do put on eyeliner everyday. This eye pencil is really good. I've been very impressed with how long it lasts. Usually, eyeliner is gone by the end of the day, but this one is present until I take it off. It washes easily with water when I want to take it off. It goes on smoothly without tugging on delicate eye skin. The one issue that I had with the pencil was that it was tightly wrapped in plastic and it was difficult to remove. Then when I finally removed it, the sharp point of the pencil broke off as I took the lid off. The pencil does have to be sharpened so I had to track down my makeup sharpener before I could use it. It sharpened well without any problems. Overall, it's a good eyeliner and I am pleased with it.

title: Good Value!
text: Classic ChapStick is just how I remember it. It does a good job of coating lips and offering relief. The classic ones  don't seem to moisturize them. It's more of creating a barrier or layer of protection to them. It does soothe dry lips. The moisturizing one does seem to leave lips feeling a little moisturized. There are 6 tubes in this set, 2 of each variety. This is a good value for what you get.

title: Mild Scent
text: This shaving cream was not what I expected. I thought it was going to be a somewhat solid consistency that required some water and a brush to get some foam, but it's not. In the jar, it's a light, airy cream. It reminds me of the consistency of Reddiwhip. I was a little worried that the cream might smell a little stronger or fruitier than I thought my husband would like, but the scent is very mild and not feminine at all.  A little cream goes a long way. The jar is pretty big so it will probably last my husband a while. It doesn't irritate and leaves the skin feeling soft.

title: Dry Feeling After It has Been Applied
text: I have been impressed with this sunscreen so far. It doesn't have the usual sunscreen scent that most sunscreen products have. There is a slight smell, but it's light and clean. The sunscreen is pretty thick and absorbs very well. It doesn't leave behind any greasiness. In fact, it feels dry after it has been rubbed into your skin. I have sensitive skin and this hasn't irritated me at all. Sunscreen products that I use on my face will often sweat into my eyes and cause irritations and stinging, but this hasn't. We had a beautiful warm and sunny weekend and this product provided excellent coverage and kept me from burning.

title: Gentle & Non-Irritating
text: The applicator of this eye cream is some type of metal. It is cool to the touch and dispenses the cream to the delicate area under the eye without pulling or tugging. It feels very refreshing because of the metal. I usually have to go and gently pat the cream in afterwards otherwise I end up with spots of cream that hasn't been absorbed. It doesn't leave any greasiness. There's no noticeable odor or scent.  I have sensitive eyes and some eye cream products will sting my eyes. One of my eyes waters a lot and will end up stinging hours after application with some eye products. The Marcelle Hydra C Gel-Cream has not irritated my eyes in any way. I haven't noticed much difference in the skin around my eyes since using this. I am 50 years old and have been regularly using eye creams for the past several years already, so that doesn't surprise me. Overall, I really like this product and would definitely consider repurchasing it.

title: Great Color!
text: I love this color of nail polish! Although it's not as dark as I would expect raisin to be, it's a beautiful color. It's a shimmery color that is perfect for my spring and summer pedicures. My first application was just one coat. I ran out of time and didn't get around to the second coat for a couple of days. One coat was nearly enough. It did look much more vibrant with the second coat. I've had this on my toes for about a week and an half so far and the chipping has been minimal. I've been quite pleased with how well it's holding up. I really like the brush for this polish. It's flat and I found it easier to apply the polish with it.

title: Gentle Cleanser
text: In recent years, I've been on the lookout for plant based products that work well that I can replace with my less environmentally friendly products. Most of the items that I have been using have been geared toward the house. I was excited to give a skincare alternative a try. The Honest Beauty Refreshingly Clean Gel Cleanser has a light lavender scent. It lathers nicely and doesn't leave behind any residue. My skin doesn't feel moisturized after it and it is borderline dry.  I have been using it with my sonic brush without any problems. I usually use 2 pumps of the cleanser each time I use it. My skin is somewhat sensitive and hasn't had any issues or redness since using this cleanser. Overall, I think this is a gentle and decent cleanser.

title: Does Not Irritate
text: I am a regular user of Aveeno moisturizers. My skin is somewhat sensitive and in the last year or so, I have had frequent redness issues. I think my redness is related to peri-menopause more than anything, but it is something that I am dealing with. This moisturizer has a light sunscreen scent to it. There are no added fragrances. It is a little thick and does take a little more rubbing in than other moisturizers for it to be fully absorbed. It does not irritate my skin in any way. I have not noticed any difference in my redness. It is easy to dispense. It takes at least two squirts to get enough product to cover my face. Overall, it's okay, but I prefer some of the other Aveeno moisturizers over this one.

title: Noticeable Results on the Backs of My Hands!
text: I am 50 years old and have just started noticing a few spots beginning to pop up on the backs of my hands. The area on the back of my hands is definitely an area that gets neglected. I've been using this cream at least a couple of times a day. It's been more than a week and I can easily see a difference. The overall appearance is dramatic! I wish I had taken pictures before I started. My hands are looking younger. The size of the spots has shrunk. The large obvious lines have diminished. I believe that your hands can be more telling about one's age than one's face, so I am pleased with the results. Plus, this cream contains sunscreen and my hands are usually forgotten when it comes to sunscreen. It doesn't take much of the cream to cover the areas on the back of my hands, so it should last a while. I may even start using this instead of my usual hand cream since it does have the sun protection. It doesn't have a strong smell. I can detect the sunscreen, but it's not as strong as a typical sunscreen. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. It also does not irritate my somewhat sensitive skin. Overall, I have been impressed with this cream!

title: Non-Irritating
text: By the time I get upstairs to my room each night, I am too exhausted to go through with a lot of steps with my routine. Makeup wipes help speed up the process so I still have time to put on my face creams and such. These wipes are lightly scented with lavender. The smell does not overwhelm. Lavender is the perfect scent for nighttime! The wipes are average sized and thickness. They are moist without being overly wet. They seem to do a decent job of removing my makeup each night. I don't feel like I have to rinse my face after these. I have sensitive eyes and they don't irritate my eyes at all. They don't leave any reddening behind on my face either. They do seem to be a little pricey and more than I would probably spend on cosmetic wipes since there are other options out there for less. But they are good wipes and do a nice job.

title: Pleasant Scent & Great Lather
text: This facial cleanser has a nice, citrus scent. It's not too strong and doesn't linger. The pump was a little difficult to fully open. I twisted it multiple times without any luck, but then I asked my husband to try and he got it open. I think I had just given up too quickly.  The cleanser lathers up really well. One pump provides plenty of the soap.I use this with a battery operated scrub brush which may have increased the amount of lather. I did get a little in my eyes the first time I used it. It stung a little bit, but I was able to just dab them with my towel and it went away. I did notice that my skin was nice and soft after using it. Overall, I think this is a good cleanser.

title: Doesn't Leave My Skin Oily
text: This is a unique anti-aging product. The contents in the bottle looks just like the picture. The colors are separated and don't blend when gently shaken. I am fascinated with the beautiful separation of colors. The directions say to massage 3 to 4 drops of the oil onto your face and neck. I have found that I have to add a little more than that because it absorbs pretty quickly and that amount wouldn't stretch to cover all the suggested areas. I have bee using about a third of the dropper. The oil has an almost earthy smell and reminds me of some of the Essential Oils that I use. The ingredients are listed on the bottom of the box, but the product sticker label was placed there and I haven't had any success removing it to read it. It doesn't leave my skin feeling oily which was something I was afraid of before using it. I follow up with my daily moisturizer and there has been no problems with that. I haven't noticed any fewer wrinkles, however, I have been using anti-aging skin care products for a few years now, so that doesn't surprise me. I haven't had any issues with skin sensitivity since using this oil either.

title: Effective Skin Care
text: My teenage daughter has mild acne. She'll often be acne free, but lately she's been dealing with some on her chin that won't go away. She has seen some improvement since using this exfoliating cleanser. She used to have sensitivity issues using products with salicylic acid, but she has not had any irritations using this, so I'm hoping she has grown out of that. The exfoliating isn't too harsh, though she is only using it once a day. It hasn't over dried her skin either. It's a nice sized bottle that should last a while.

title: Gentle on My Sensitive Skin
text: I am 50 and have been using anti-aging creams regularly for the past several years. This is a heavier face cream, so I have been using this at night. It's thick and absorbs quickly into my skin. It leaves my face soft and moisturized. There is no strong or off putting fragrance. It does have a light, natural scent which I attribute to the ingredients in the cream. I have fairly sensitive skin and I have not had any issues or problems with this. Some creams and moisturizers leave my face reddened, but this one has not. I am not noticing any difference in the appearance of wrinkles, however, since I regularly use anti-aging creams, I wouldn't expect any immediate miracles or results.

title: Gentle & Effective
text: This is a gentle and effective non-soap cleansing bar. It's a little smaller than the bars of soap that I usually use. It's about the size of the palm of my hand. It does produce a lather, maybe not quite as much as soap does, but it does lather. It is fragrance free and has a mild, clean smell. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin nor does it leave it over dry. It leaves me feeling clean!

title: Great Size for Traveling
text: Coppertone is one of the leaders in sunscreen. It's come a long way from when I was a child in the 70's. This sports sunscreen has an SPF of 100! I didn't even know there were SPF's that high. The bottle size is only 3 ounces, so it's a little on the small size. Its size makes it great for traveling. It's larger than the travel size products which hardly last at all. It has the typical sunscreen smell to it. It absorbs well into the skin. You do have to reapply it after every 80 minutes if you remember. I love that it doesn't sting your eyes because that's one issue that I always have with sunscreens. This lotion easily lives up to the Coppertone brand name.

title: Very Small
text: I was excited for this eye contour palette. It says that it's great for widening eyes which is something I need. The palette is a little on the small size. The size of the whole thing isn't bad, but the size of the actual shadows is way too small. My eye shadow brushes can fit in the larger, eyelid base color, but not in the smaller colors. The size is great for carrying in your purse. The pigmentation of the colors is okay. You do have to apply a lot and build upon it to achieve the desired look. There are instructions on the back of the palette, but I found it easier to read it online because it's so small. I wasn't really able to achieve the wide eyes that I was wanting.

title: Best Lip Balm
text: These have become my absolute favorite lip balms! They leave my lips moistened for much longer than usual lip balms, even after drinking or snacking .The peppermint and the lemon lime are my favorites. My least favorite is the orange ginger.

title: My Daughter Loves This!
text: My sixteen year old daughter loves this facial cleanser. She had a sample that she used a few months ago and was happily surprised when I ordered a full sized one. She has sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate her. It leaves her skin clean and does a great job of getting the impurities out. She now wants to try other products in the same line.

title: Smaller Than Expected
text: I ordered these for an upcoming trip. I didn't pay attention to the measurements given. They ended up being smaller than I expected. I was hoping for the larger of the two (the medium one) to be quart sized for my toiletries, but it's smaller than the quart sized bags. Since I can only take one quart bag filled with my liquids, I want to go with the largest that falls within the maximum measurements. So the sizing issue is really my fault because I didn't pay attention when ordering. However, the quality of the bags is just mediocre. The plastic is thinner than I anticipated. It's also stiff and it was difficult to reshape it. The zippers seem weak and I'm not sure how long they will last. Overall, the bags are okay, but not great.

title: Gentle and Non-Irritating
text: I have somewhat sensitive skin, so I need my face wash to be gentle on my skin. This has not irritated my skin at all. It produces a nice foam and does a great job of removing whatever make-up is left on at the end of the day. It's winter time right now, so my skin has been a little dry anyway, so I can't really tell if it's over drying my skin. It doesn't take much of the product to cleanse my face. One pump has been enough for the job.

title: Gentle on Sensitive Skin
text: This is one of the best spray sunscreens out there! Instead of an oily mist, it dispenses a thicker spray of lotion. It still needs to be rubbed in, but it does a good job of spreading the lotion out when it is sprayed. It is definitely easier than using a bottle of lotion. It doesn't leave behind any greasiness. It smells like baby powder. The dispenser worked without any problems. It did not irritate my sensitive skin so I would not hesitate to use it on a baby.  I would definitely purchase this again.

title: Non-Greasy
text: This oil nutritive serum was not what I expected. I have used various oils in my hair such as argan and others, but this one doesn't look like an oil at all. The consistency and color is similar to a lotion. I was worried that it would leave my hair greasy, but it doesn't. I usually put two pumps of the serum into my hands, rub my hands together, then work it into the ends of my hair. It doesn't have much of a smell to it. My hair has been pretty soft since using it. I haven't noticed any fewer split ends, but I get my hair cut regularly. My daughter, who has much longer hair is using this also and seems to like it.

title: Very Thick Conditioner
text: The oil nutritive hair repair conditioner is very thick. It's much thicker than most conditioners that I have used from a bottle. It has a very light, mild scent that reminds me of baby powder. The smell doesn't linger around much. It rinses easily out of my hair and doesn't leave my hair greasy. Instead, it leaves behind untangled, soft hair.  This comes with 3 bottles of conditioner. My daughter is using it as well. She has very long hair and does get a lot of split ends over time. She recently had her hair trimmed so she's not seeing any split ends right now. We're using this along with the coordinating shampoo and we both like the conditioner more than the shampoo.

title: Nice, Mild Scent
text: My daughter has very long hair and is prone to split ends. She just had her hair trimmed recently, so she got rid of those split ends, but she was very excited to try this shampoo in hopes of preventing future ones. I have shoulder length hair and thought I would give it a try, too. The first thing I noticed is that it has a mild, scent. It's hard to describe what it smells like, but it's not a strong, perfumey scent nor is it fruity. It has a decent lather - not too little or too much. It rinses cleanly and hair manageable. I can easily run my fingers through my hair after it has dried. As far as softness goes, it's soft enough. I've had some shampoos leave behind much softer hair, but this is still pretty good. This comes with 3 full size bottles so it should last a while. Overall, it's a good shampoo.

title: Great Body Lotion!
text: This is a unique scent. It's more fruity than coconut. It absorbs nicely into my skin and keeps me moisturized for a while. The scent does linger for a little while, but it's not overwhelming. It doesn't leave behind any greasiness.

title: Perfect Shade!
text: I find it near impossible to find the right shade of foundation. The Almay Smart Shade is great! It goes on white, but when it blends in, it changes to the perfect shade. I have no clue how it works, but it does. I put dots all over my face and blend with a beauty sponge. It doesn't look too heavy or cakey.  I am very pleased with it. I tend to use a powder foundation in the summer and spring, but my skin is so much drier in the winter that I needed a liquid one.

title: Requires a Learning Curve, But Results are Amazing!
text: This eyeliner applicator is really unique. It literally rolls the make up where you want it to go on your eyes. There's definitely a learning curve involved. And it requires a steady hand, too, but if you can get it on in one smooth motion, the results are amazing! I have sensitive eyes and it doesn't irritate them at all. My eyes also have a tendency to water a lot during the day and for the most part it stays put. I have noticed a little gets worn or rubbed off during the day, but not to the extent where others do when it looks like I wasn't wearing any eyeliner at all. So if you have time to practice, this is worth it.

title: Light, Pleasant Scent
text: I only use daytime moisturizers that contain sunscreen, so I am using this during the day, not evening. One thing that I noticed right away with this cream is that it doesn't have the usual smell that sunscreen products have. It does have a light, almost fruity scent, but it's very pleasant and it dissipates rather quickly. The cream is rightly called a "whip". It is very light and airy. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave behind any greasiness. I tend to put it on after I get out of the shower. I don't put my makeup on for at least another hour, so sometimes I put another application of it on because I love the scent and feel of it so much. It hasn't irritated my skin or left any redness at all.

title: Does Not Irritate
text: My 16 year old daughter has occasional acne. Usually it's related to hormones. She has had issues with products containing salicylic acid in the past. They sometimes cause her face to redden for days. This set has not irritated her skin at all. It has left some patchy dry areas, but that is to be expected. It has done a good job of clearing up her small amount of acne in just a few days. She is using it as needed and not daily because she doesn't want to over dry her skin, especially since the winter weather is here and drying her skin, too. I used to buy ProActive for my skin and this is a much more affordable option.

title: A Good, Gentle Cleanser
text: The Mountain Falls Daily Facial Cleaner is a fairly mild cleanser. It has a clean, soapy smell that is not too strong. I use it with a sonic face brush in the shower. It doesn't irritate my skin or eyes. Some cleansers cause my eyes to sting, even if it's kept away from my eyes, but this does not.  It doesn't leave my skin feeling too dry either. It's just a good, gentle cleanser.

title: Mild Peppermint Scent
text: I use a peppermint foot lotion every night on my tired feet. I love that this one has a pump dispenser. It really makes it easier to use, especially when it gets down to the bottom. It has a mild peppermint scent. One pump is usually enough per foot. It is not a tingling peppermint, but it does soothe and refresh.

title: Leaves My Hair Soft
text: I have thick, coarse hair. I've had a lot of breakage over the past few years, so strengthening products are perfect. The jar is a little on the small side. I can't imagine it lasting more than a few times. The banana scent smells good, but artificial, like banana candy. There are three different ways to use this product, but I have been going with the one minute mask. It does leave my hair soft and manageable. It rinses well. It doesn't leave any heaviness to my hair. I haven't noticed any difference in my hair's strength though.

title: Gentle on My Highlights!
text: This shampoo is pretty thick and produces a great lather. A little bit goes a long way. It has a mild scent which isn't overwhelming, but it is more of a floral/perfume scent rather than a fruity scent which I prefer. But as I said, it's a mild scent and it doesn't linger. I have super sensitive eyes. Some shampoos sting and burn my eyes even without actually getting in my eyes. I haven't had any issues with that, so that pleases me. It rinses well. It leaves my hair fairly soft and manageable. I love that it's gentle on my highlights. With as much money as I pay for them, I don't want them fading early. For the price, I think this is a decent shampoo.

title: Heavy Moisturizer
text: Moisturizer is an important part of my daytime and night time beauty routine. I do like that this is one product that can be used for both occasions. It's a thick cream but it absorbs pretty quickly. It is definitely heavier than what I usually use in the morning and more similar to my night time creams. I have used facial masks like this before, so I knew that it wasn't going to turn into t a peel off mask or harden. It has a soft, light scent. I love that it's a plant based product. I tend to gravitate toward those. Some moisturizers leave my skin red, but this did not. I did however, have issues with acne after using this. I'm almost 50 and I do tend to get a zit every now and then. Usually it's related to hormones and my time of the month. I realize that at my age, I am approaching perimenopause, but these came mid-cycle and were completely unexpected. It is a much heavier cream than I usually use, so that's the only thing I can attribute to this unwanted acne.

title: Non-Irritating
text: I try to use a light weight moisturizer with sunscreen daily. This one has a pleasant, clean scent. It takes about two pumps to adequately cover my face. It absorbs okay, but it does take a little rubbing than some other moisturizers that I have used. It leaves my face feeling soft afterwards. Some facial moisturizers leave my face red, but I didn't have any issues with this one. Overall, I think this is a good, everyday moisturizer.

title: Refreshing Facial Mask
text: I was skeptical at first. I've tried lots of facial masks that I found to be just okay. But this Erno Lazlo mask is awesome! First of all, I wasn't thrilled that I had to mix this myself. You take one of each of the packets and mix together. The first one is similar to the consistency of honey. The second packet is a powder. I found the powder to be a bit messy and I will have to use a deeper bowl next time. It ended up being a thick goo. I used the plastic applicator to apply it onto my face. It was a little difficult because it was so thick, it kept running down. I felt like Robin Williams in the movie Mrs. Doubtfire when he puts his face into a cake and pretends the frosting is a face cream. Although the mask did drip, it did stay on my face. The directions said to leave it on for about 15 minutes. It was ready to pull off in less time. While it was on my face, it was very cool and refreshing. I really didn't expect it to pull off easily, but it did! I didn't get it all in one piece, but in just a couple of pieces. Once it was dried, it was rubbery. It didn't irritate or redden my face at all. My skin felt very soft afterwards. I'm not sure that I noticed any firming, but because it was so refreshing, I really liked it!

title: Great Colors!
text: This is a great assortment of fall/winter colors! The nail polish is what I expect from the Essie line of products. Drying time is comparable to most nail polishes. The colors are dark and rich enough that two coats look best. Single coats just aren't as vibrant. The bottles are small, not full sized. I wouldn't say the colors are matte, but they don't have the typical shiny polish look.

title: Quieter Than My Old Dryer
text: The first time I used this hair dryer, I thought something was wrong with it because it was much quieter than what I am used to. It's not silent, but the sound it makes is what my old hair dryer made when it was on low. It doesn't get as hot as my old hair dryer, but it gets hot enough. I only partially dry my hair, so it works for my purposes. I like the gold color. It gives it a contemporary look.  The size is comparable to my other dryer, but it's definitely lighter weight.

title: Keeps My Skin Moisturized All Day
text: This jar of moisturizing cream is larger than I expected. I've been using it primarily on my legs and arms. It doesn't take a lot of cream per use, so it should last a while. The cream is a thick consistency and what I would expect from a cream. It's a bit heavy, but it's not greasy or oily.  It's non-irritating and it has no scent or smell to it. I usually apply it just in the mornings and it keeps my skin hydrated and moisturized for the entire day. I tend to get rough, dry patches on my elbows and I've already noticed that the skin in that area is softer.

title: A Bit Drying, But Effective
text: My teenage daughter doesn't usually have a lot of acne, but does get the occasional (usually hormonal) acne. She has had issues with salicylic acid, so she tries to stay away from products that contain it. Ones with benzoyl peroxide are preferred by her. She really enjoyed the scent of this cleanser. It's very thick and a little goes a long way. She also really liked how it made her face feel after using it. It left a slightly tingling and refreshing feel to her skin. She did find that it dried out her skin a lot and she had to follow with a moisturizer. She started out using it twice a day, but has scaled back to about once every other day. She said it quickly cleared up the little acne she had when she started using it. Acne products that are affordable and  without salicylic acid are difficult to find, so I will definitely be ordering this again.

title: Doesn't Feel Greasy or Oily
text: I usually moisturize at night time, but I don't usually use a night specific cream. This night cream is heavier than a day cream or moisturizer. It absorbs well into my skin and it doesn't leave my face feeling greasy or oily. I haven't noticed any issues with acne since using this. I have fairly sensitive skin and many facial creams and lotions leave my face red. I haven't had any redness at all with this cream. The jar is on the small side, but it doesn't take much to cover my face, so I think it will last a while. There's no scent whatsoever. I have noticed my skin has become pretty soft lately.

title: Love the Built in Timer Feature!
text: I've been a fan of sonic facial brushes for the past few years. I have used the Oil of Olay Pro-X as well as a no-name one. The True Glow by Conair has been my favorite. First of all, I love that it beeps every ten seconds to remind you to move to another area of your face! Before this, I know I must have been neglecting some areas and possibly over scrubbing other ones. I start with one of my sides/cheeks then work around, doing the area between my mouth and nose last. I do that last because the brush causes the cleanser to foam up well and I have gotten some cleanser in my mouth because of all the foam! It doesn't taste good at all! When I do it last, I immediately rinse my face when the brush turns off and I haven't had any issues with tasting the foam. There are 3 speeds. It starts on the highest speed, but you can press a button to get the lower ones. I don't notice a lot of difference between the different speeds. I've been using this daily for almost two weeks without the battery dying. So I decided to try to run the battery down by pressing the button and running through the cycle multiple times when not really using it. I did that for more than a dozen times and I never noticed any change in the speed or battery life. My other facial brushes use replaceable batteries which was a pain. It's much easier to just plug in the charger and leave it over night. The brush does an excellent job of gently exfoliating my face. I have noticed an almost immediate difference in the smoothness and softness of my skin. I've also been using it on the back of one of my hands (just one so I can compare it with the other) and the hand that has been on the receiving end of the brush looks much younger. The size of the pores and skin cells are smaller. I plan to continue to use it on the backs of both of my hands! I am very pleased with this and how well it's working.

title: Nice Size!
text: The Revlon Invigorating Pedicure Foot Spa has filled a need that I had. I enjoy soaking my feet, but I have not had much luck finding portable tubs that do the job. I have size 10 W feet and unless I use a really large storage tub, I find that regular portable tubs don't allow my feet to be in a flat position. My teenage son has very large feet and they fit in it, too. He gets ingrown toenails every once in a while and has to soak his feet in epsolm salt. This works well for him. This definitely accommodates my feet without having to squish them. So for the size of it, I am very pleased. I also felt that it does a decent job with the jets. They aren't super powerful, but when I am finished, it does feel like I've had a mini foot massage. I like the roller feature and utilize it often. The pumice stone was a little more awkward to use. It does seem to lose the heat pretty fast. I start with pretty hot water as suggested, but it doesn't take very long before it's cool. I wish it would keep the heat a little longer.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Sensitive Skin
text: I try to always wear a face cream with sunscreen. This one has an SPF of 50.  Face creams with sunscreen usually have a stronger scent to them which is the ingredients used for the SPF. I can smell the sunscreen in this one, but it's actually pretty light and not as strong as other products I have used. In fact, I can barely detect the scent of sunscreen at all. There's no perfume smells either. It's really a light smell and it doesn't linger around either. The cream does a nice job of moisturizing. It absorbs quickly into my skin. As far as brightening, I haven't noticed any difference. I have fair skin with a few freckles, but haven't seen any changes yet. I also have sensitive skin and many moisturizers and creams cause my face to redden temporarily, but I haven't had any issues with this cream.

title: Not the Fruity Scent I was Hoping For
text: I was very excited to try this night cream. It seems to be working okay. I have been using anti-wrinkle creams for the past few years. I'm not seeing any new amazing results, but it seems to be a continuation of what I have been doing already. It absorbs alright. It does feel a little heavy, but I have noticed that about other night creams, too. The scent/smell isn't what I expected. I was hoping for a nice, fruity scent. I don't notice any fruitiness at all. It's more of a light, floral scent, almost like perfume. Overall, I like it, but I don't love it.

title: Fine, Gritty Cleaner
text: I have never used GoJo before and was unfamiliar with it. My husband is a big DIY guy and gets his hands dirty all the time. The first thing I liked about this is that it is an Eco Friendly product. I do tend to gravitate toward natural or bio friendly products when possible. Of course, those products don't always work as well as non-Eco ones. So I was pleasantly surprised at how well this works at cleaning hands! It's a gel that has a pleasant citrusy smell to it. It has a fine, gritty texture to it that helps with the scrubbing. You squeeze a little into your hands and rub together. Add a little water and continue rubbing. Rinse, then dry.  I first tried this on fairly clean hands.  Then I had my husband use it on grimy, greasy hands. He did have to apply a second squirt of gel, but it successfully removed all of the grease.  We haven't tried it on anything else yet, but so far we are very happy with it.

title: Sets Well
text: This is a good, decent finishing powder. It goes on easily. It does a nice job of setting my make-up. There's no irritation. It does have a clean-soapy smell to it. The smell isn't bad or annoying, but it is unexpected.

title: Delicate Sweet Color
text: Lighten the Mood is a very pale, almost nude color. It's definitely a two coat color. I haven't noticed any chipping yet on my toes, but my fingers have started chipping after a couple of days. However, that tends to be normal in my personal experience. Overall, it seem comparable to other nail polishes in the same price range.

title: Good, Basic Mascara
text: This is a good, basic mascara. It doesn't leave clumps or over exaggerated lashes. I have somewhat sensitive eyes, and I haven't had any issues with this product. I do tend to rub my eyes some during the day and if I'm not careful, it will rub off on to the area under my eyes. I usually use waterproof mascara to keep that from happening. It is easy to wash off with a wet washcloth.

title: Great Color Assortment!
text: I love the colors offered in this nude pallet. You get the lightest color for highlighting, the middle color for covering the eyelid and the darker color for the crease. They have a moderate level of pigmentation. The shimmer doesn't show up too much, but I prefer. I'm in my late 40's and  I try to avoid highly shimmery cosmetics. By the end of the work day, it has mostly worn off and needs to be reapplied if going out. It doesn't come with any type of applicator, but I never use the little brushes or sponge applicators that come with eye shadows anyway, so that's not an issue. I use my own make up brushes. It doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes.

title: Nice Smell, But the Scent Doesn't Last Long
text: The lemon butter is a nice quality. It smells wonderful, but the scent doesn't last very long. I prefer to catch whiffs of my favorite moisturizers throughout the day. The jar is very small and won't last long at all. I've been using it sparingly for the last week or so and I have less than half left. It does do a nice job of softening my skin. I buy at lot of beauty sample boxes to try out new products and this is the size of a lot of the samples that I get. They did include two tiny (even smaller) samples of other products. Those containers were the size of the little paint tubs that come in a child's craft kit. I did enjoy trying out those products.

title: Clears My Skin & Smells Wonderful!
text: I was a bit skeptical toward this moisturizer, but I am a huge believer now. I was first drawn to this moisturizer because of the pink grapefruit scent (which is amazing by the way), but it really cleared up my acne!  I am in my late 40's and still deal with acne. It's usually hormone related, but it sucks nonetheless. I have been using this every morning for the past couple of weeks and the two zits that I had when I started using this are long gone and no new ones have popped up. My skin is somewhat sensitive. Some facial moisturizers will leave redness. It's usually temporary, but I haven't had any redness with this. It absorbs quickly into my skin and leaves it smooth and ready for my makeup. IT doesn't take much, I just apply one pump's worth to my face and that covers my entire face. The only thing that would make this better would be if it had SPF. Fortunately for me, my foundation has some SPF, so I'm covered there.

title: Really Lasts!
text: This gel eyeliner stays in place for most of the day. I put it on in the morning, and it's mostly still there at the end of the day. It comes with a small brush which I have been using to apply it. I don't do anything special with it - just a thin line near the lash line of my lower lashes. It doesn't irritate or annoy my eyes at all.

title: Too Strong of Fragrance
text: I was looking for a salt scrub to use on my hands.  I have tried several different salt and sugar scrubs over the years. I've classified them in to two different types. There are the dry ones and wet ones. This is one of the wet ones. When you scoop it out, it's dense and a bit solid, like Crisco. The amount of salt is decent and allows for adequate sloughing. But the consistency is greasier than what I wanted. After I rub it in to my hands, I rinse it off with warm to hot water. Even after I had removed all of the product, I had to keep rinsing because it leaves greasiness behind. I was satisfied with how the product left my hands feeling though. I was also disappointed with the fragrance. I was expecting a more cherry/fruity scent with a bit of floral to it. Instead it's more of a flowery perfume and a bit too strong. I love a strong fragrance, but not this one. It isn't a natural scent. The price was good, but not what I was wanting.

title: Amazing Honey Scent!
text: My mom used to put out little guest soaps in our half bath. I always thought they were so cute. I still think they are cute! This set of honey gift soaps is very nice. The first noticeable thing about them is the smell. I never really thought about honey having a scent, but it does. It smells just like honey. The soap has a great lather. I'm enjoying using them. One little bar has lasted nearly a week, but it's almost completely gone. I would happily give these as a small thank you gift.

title: Better Than Expected
text: I have been using hot rollers for years and I've gone through many different brands. I currently use the Instant Heat rollers by Conair for every day. The whole unit is too large to take with me when traveling, so I was happy to give the Revlon Curls to Go a try. The size of the rollers was a little smaller than I expected. I don't like tight curls at all, so I was a little afraid of how it was going to work out for me. However, I was pleasantly surprised. I used all of the larger curlers, plus 2 of the medium sized ones. I used the smaller, medium ones for the lower layer of my hair just in case the curls were tighter. I plugged the curlers in right before I started drying my hair. I didn't time them to see how long it took for them to heat up, but by the time was hair was dry, the indicator (on the top of the curlers) said they were ready. The curlers were hot, but not to the point where they couldn't be handled. I don't like using metal clips such as these, but I did use them for my first try and they did fine. I found some clips that work really well with my curlers that I use instead, just because they are easier and faster. While the curlers were in my hair, I put on my make-up and finished getting ready for work. They were probably in there for about ten minutes. I was pleased with how my hair curled. The curls weren't too small and tight. They were wavy, loose curls, just the way I like them. I will definitely take these with me when I travel.

title: Great Way to Try Out Different Scents
text: My mom used to always put guest soaps out for company. I like the idea of doing so. This is a set of 9 different scents of soaps. They are mini sized high quality soaps.
