The scents all blend in together since they are not individually wrapped, but when using just one, the scent does come through on its own. This is like a sampler of scents, so you can try many different ones. The soap bar that I have used so far, has a nice lather.  I think this would be a nice hostess gift.

title: Perfect Gift
text: This hand cream/soap set comes ready to gift. The duo has a lovely mirabelle scent. I wasn't familiar with mirabelle, so I had to look that up. It has a fruity/flowery smell to it. A mirabelle is a type of plum. In my opinion, the fragrance is strong, but not over powering. It does linger for a while, which I enjoyed. The lotion is a creamy consistency and absorbs well. It doesn't leave behind any greasiness or oiliness. It comes in a small, plastic tube the has the aluminum look to it. The soap lathers up nicely and doesn't leave any residue.

title: Love This!
text: This creamy body butter is amazing! I've used other brands of so called body butter, but this one is the most like butter to me. The consistency is just like the softened butter I use for baking. It doesn't take a lot of product to nicely moisturize my skin. The Verbena scent is wonderful. It's a fairly strong lemony scent, but it's not overpowering or off putting. The strength of the smell does dissipate over time, but it it does leave behind a little bit of the scent. It's non-greasy and non-irritating to my somewhat sensitive skin. It leaves behind soft, supple skin. I absolutely love this!

title: Exfoliates Well
text:
The loofah arrived in a compressed, flattened state. When I added water to it, it started to expand and sometime after my shower, it was fully expanded. The loofah has a ribbon for hanging and a suction cup. It provided a nice exfoliation. I have been using it every other day, but will probably start using it less frequently now that I have sloughed my skin sufficiently. I did see a few seeds on the bottom of my shower after the first use. They looked like pumpkin seeds in size and color. I had incorrectly assumed that loofahs were made from a sea plant, but upon a quick Google search, I discovered it comes from a vegetable. This is my first loofah and I am enjoying the loofah experience.

*I've tried a few other items by Urban Spa and unfortunately they are all lumped together on the same listing.

Nail Brush - I give this 4 stars. I love that it has a row of brushes on the top and the bottom of the brush. The top row is firmer and denser. It does a great job of cleaning nails. The bottom row is softer and doesn't get into the nails as well. The bristles seem to be natural as opposed to man made. The brush shed quite a bit during the first few uses, but seems to have slowed down a bit. The base of the brush is wooden. My experiences with other wooden brushes are that they look good, but don't hold up as well as plastic bases. I used to keep a nail brush in the shower, but because this is wooden, I won't keep it in there in hopes of it lasting longer.

Bath Pillow - 5 stars. This is one of the nicest bath pillows I've ever had. One side is a soft terry material and the other is vinyl. It was fairly easy to inflate. There are four suction cups on the vinyl side, one in each corner. It is very comfortable. It seems to dry in a reasonable amount of time.

Foot Paddle - 4 stars. It's surprisingly sturdy. I had one wooden foot paddle that broke the first time I used it. This is very well made & doesn't bend or budge when using. The pumice part is large and can cover a big area of the foot. It does a good job of sloughing. I don't keep it in my shower because it is wooden and my experience with other wooden handles is that the wood gets weathered or splintered when left in and around water. There's a ribbon for hanging. I would rather see something thicker and heavier than just a regular ribbon.

title: Interesting Fragrance
text: The cardamom, absinthe, & sandalwood is a unique combination of scents. It's a masculine, woodsy scent. It's not too over powering. I have been burning it in the living room on the main floor of the house and I can catch whiffs of it upstairs in my bedroom.  It burns evenly and without producing any smoke. It's comparable to what you might find at a boutique or nice gift shop. This would make a nice gift.

title: Refreshing Foot Cream
text: Peppermint foot lotions have been a regular part of my bedtime routine for years and years. I have used many different brands and formulas of peppermint foot lotions. This one has a light peppermint scent which is barely noticeable. The lotion is thick and creamy. It absorbs well and doesn't leave my feet feeling greasy. I've used some foot lotions that make my feet slippery so if I have to get up for any reason after I'm settled in bed, I have to be careful so I don't slip. This doesn't create any problems with that. The tube is a metal one and so far I haven't had any issues dispensing the lotion. Sometimes metal tubes are more difficult when trying to get the last dredges out. The lotion doesn't leave any tingling feelings like stronger peppermint foot lotions do, but it is refreshing nonetheless.

title: Not Sticky!
text: I recently started using Lipsense lip color. I do have the Lipsense Gloss to use with it, but I was looking for a cheaper alternative because it didn't look like it would last a long time with multiple reapplications each day.  I bought this to see how it worked with it. I am very pleased with it. I don't really notice any difference between this and the Lipsense one. Well, except for the price!!! It's not a sticky lip gloss at all. It moisturizes well. I am very pleased with it and I will definitely be reordering this.

title: Lovely Set of Hand Creams!
text: This is a lovely set of hand creams! It comes with three small silvery tubes of cream.The tubes look like the metal ones other companies use, but upon closer examination, I think they are plastic. The label is printed directly on the tube and it doesn't crease like the metal ones.  It looks a lot like the L'Occitane en Provence products. The hand cream is nice and thick. It doesn't take very much to cover both hands. It leaves a slight greasiness behind, but that doesn't last. It gradually disappears and doesn't leave any greasiness after a few minutes. It leaves behind a nice soft appearance. I love the scents. My favorite is the lavender and I normally don't really care for lavender. The original scent reminds me of baby powder. The verbena is a nice lemony smell. The scents do linger a while, but they are not over powering. This would make a nice gift.

title: Nice, Subtle Scent
text: I love deluxe, artisanal soaps. This one has a subtle, herbal scent to it. The combination of Rosemary and Peppermint isn't very strong, which I was glad. The two scents create a nice blended fragrance that doesn't overpower the senses. The rosemary gives a slight sloughing effect and helps remove dry skin. The bar of soap has a wonderful, rich lather and leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. This would make a great gift! I would definitely consider trying out different varieties of Pre de Provence soaps.

title: Cleans & Softens
text: The Vichy Multi-Masking Gift Set comes in a cute tin for a nice presentation. There's a full size (6.7 oz) bottle of Micellar Water and 3 small 1/2 ounce jars of different mask products. The Micellar water cleans my face very well. I use it with a cotton ball. It says that it can be used to remove eye make up, but it stung my eyes a bit. I have super sensitive eyes, so that didn't surprise me. Some shampoos will cause my eyes to sting without even getting in my eyes! I enjoyed trying out the different masks. Only one, the pore purifying clay mask, was a traditional mask that I am accustomed to using. The double glow peel mask is more of a scrub and the quenching mineral mask is a thick moisturizing gel type product. All of the masks are 5 minutes or less. Each one says to use it once or twice a week. They all left my skin feeling soft and clean.

title: Great Idea!
text: Great way to keep track of your lip balm.  I wanted to clip this to my lunch bag, but the clip is fairly small and a little difficult to pry open. It was very easy to clip it on my ID lanyard though. My lip balm stays in it and doesn't slide out. It's definitely easier than digging through my purse for my lip balm!

title: More Sanitary Than Make Up Sponges
text: I am currently using a powder foundation, but my daughter uses a creamy liquid one. She was using the tear drop shaped sponge applicators, but even with washing them out, they needed to be replaced every now and then. She loves these silicone ones! First of all, she's using less foundation now. The foundation doesn't absorb into the applicator like the sponge ones. Clean up is super easy - just rinse with soap & water.  Sponges now seem so unsanitary. These flex and move easily to provide good coverage all over the curves of her face. These three pack should last her forever!

title: Glides Smoothly!
text: I am very impressed at how well this eyeliner glides. It's like a felt tip pen the way it smoothly writes. It was a bit too harsh looking for me without blending it. After some trial and error, I did learn that you have to smudge it pretty quickly before it dries/sets. It did seem to last a while, but by the end of the work day, it didn't look like I had just put it on. One of my eyes waters a lot during the day, so I do rub and blot my eyes frequently which could be the reason for it looking less fresh. My teenage daughter has claimed it as her own and really likes it.

title: Mighty Powerful!
text: Usually I don't have to take a hair dryer when I am traveling because they are usually standard in most hotels. But whenever we go stay with our parents, it's either use a small, low wattage blow dryer or take my full size, powerful one. I am very excited to have a powerful travel sized dryer for those trips. This one folds up so it takes up less room in your suitcase. It is a little larger than the small travel ones, but it's worth it because of the power output. This dryer has the same wattage as my everyday dryer, so it doesn't take any less time to dry my hair. It's a little noisier than my every day dryer, but I have a high end one that's pretty quiet. The cord is an adequate length.  This is definitely an improvement over the tiny compact travel dryers.

title: Intense Color!
text: This is my first Infallible Paints Eye Shadow. I have been pleasantly surprised by it. It's much more intense than I expected. It's got a very metallic finish to it. The first time I wore it, I had to add a softer, lighter color to make it a bit subdued. The color lasts a while, but it does fade over time. However, when I washed my face before bed, there was still quite a bit still on my lids.

title: Creamy & Soothing Foot Lotion
text: I regularly use foot creams or lotions before bed time. It's part of my night routine. This is definitely a cream consistency. It's thick and absorbs into the skin fairly quickly. It feels nice and soothing. The scent is not very strong at all. I don't even notice the lavender at all. The mint is not a tingling one, but it does cool a bit. It softens my feet pretty nicely. I would definitely consider purchasing this again.

title: 3 Products in 1, Saves Time in the Morning
text: I love that this moisturizer not only contains sunscreen, but also hyaluronic acid, as well. I'm a busy, working mom in my late forties. I like to shave off time from my morning routine whenever I can. Instead of applying three different products in the morning, I can apply this and save time. My skin is somewhat sensitive and many products leave my face temporarily reddish. This one does not cause any redness or irritation. It doesn't sting my eyes when I sweat. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any greasiness behind. It does have a slight scent, but it's basically the smell of the sunscreen that I detect. There are no additional fragrances.

title: Leaves Hands Soft!
text: This generous sized bottle of hand soap is perfect for refilling decorative hand soap dispensers. It's really too large to use by itself, though of course, you could if you wanted to. The soap produces a nice, rich lather and leaves hands feeling soft. The cucumber melon scent is very pleasant.

title: Strong Almond Scent
text: I am already a fan of Carol's Daughter's products. I love that they tend to be more natural without parabens & sulfates. The Almond Cookie Body Wash has a pleasant, almond scent. I don't notice any "cookie" part to the scent, just almond. And the almond scent reminds me of the almond extract that my mom used to add to her Christmas cookies.  It's a little strong smelling, but it doesn't linger around. It has a moderate level of foaming when used. It rinses cleanly. I would love it if it came with a pump dispenser!

title: Not Seeing The Results Yet
text: I've been using this neck tightening cream for a month now and I'm not really seeing any results. I've lost over forty pounds in the past six months and my neck skin is pretty saggy. I will keep trying it and if I do start to see any changes, I will update my review. It does not irritate or burn my sensitive skin.

title: Gentle On My Sensitive Skin
text: I am 49 years old and have been using anti-aging skin products regularly for the last few years. I've been using this retinol night cream for a couple of weeks now. I'm not seeing any changes to my skin, but that could be because I have only been using it for a couple of weeks OR because I regularly use anti-aging products already. I can attest that it has been gentle on my sensitive skin. Some facial products cause my face to turn red for a short while. I haven't had any redness at all. It doesn't irritate or burn at all. It absorbs pretty well into my skin and doesn't leave behind any greasiness.  The bottle is a little sticky, but it doesn't leave my hands or fingers sticky. It's the consistency of a lotion and it's fragrance free. I don't notice any scent at all.  The directions say to apply it liberally, but I find that one pump usually covers my face adequately.

title: Takes Practice, But Works!
text: This is definitely an improvement over the pink sponge curlers that I used back in the 80's! It took some practice, but my teenage daughter was able to get the hang of it and put them in her hair on her own without any assistance. It was a bit slow the first few times, but it does get faster the more times she's done it. The curlers are soft, but you can feel them when you're sleeping. I did try them, too, and it's nothing like those pink sponge curlers - it's much more comfortable. My daughter has been using this on dry hair and has been satisfied with the results. The description of beach waves is pretty accurate. Her curls/waves stayed for several hours before falling which is no different than what happens when she uses a heated hair tool to get curls. It doesn't leave any hair creases. I like how it is gentle on the hair and doesn't damage it with heat.

title: Does Not Irritate My Skin or Eyes
text: These are decent and gentle make up removing cloths. I have very sensitive eyes and these do not cause any burning or stinging. Some facial products leave my face red and I haven't had any issues with that either. They are soft and fragrance free! I don't wear heavy make up, but I do wear foundation, blush, eye liner, and mascara regularly and sometimes eye shadows. These have done an adequate job of removing the majority of my makeup. Mascara is sometimes more difficult to remove, but it so far it's done a pretty good job of removing that.

title: Amazing Scent!
text: This lip balm smells amazing! I love the peach scent! It leaves a sheer, light peachy color. It's definitely a lip balm as opposed to a lip gloss or lip stick It doesn't have any taste to it. I love that it has sun protection with the SPF 20. This would be great for a tween girl who wants to wear makeup, but isn't quite ready for it yet.

title: Leaves Hair Super Soft!
text: I debated giving this 3 or 4 stars. As far as a shampoo/conditioner set, I like the end results. My hair has been super soft and manageable. My hair is not tangled or gnarly. But as the claims of reducing hair breakage and hair thinning, I am not seeing any of that. I have thick, coarse hair. I shed all the time. My daughter is constantly picking stray hairs off of me, the way a baboon picks bugs off another baboon. I have not noticed any difference in the amount of shedding since using this. Every morning, there's a clump of hair in the shower drain. I clean it every day, so I know it's my hair and only from one day. The amount of hair in the shower drain may be a tiny bit less, but I really can't tell a difference. I've used shampoos before that were formulated for preventing hair loss/breakage and I noticed a huge difference in one of those shampoos. I'm not noticing any difference with this one. The shampoo has an earthy, lemony smell. You can definitely smell the Rosemary oil. The conditioner has a different scent. It's a sweeter, fruitier smell which I really like. The shampoo has a nice lather and rinses well. Aside from not seeing a difference with the hair breakage, I do like this shampoo/conditioner set.

title: Smooth & Easy to Blend
text: I think this is a good concealer, but it wasn't what I was wanting. I ordered this for my teenage daughter. She just wanted a product to cover the occasional blemish. The consistency is smooth and blendable, but it is a little heavier than what my daughter needed. It was difficult to get a light covering. I think this would be better for larger areas needing to be concealed. The color was a good match. The product stays in place and doesn't sweat off, yet it is easy to wash off at the end of the day.

title: Fun Assortment!
text: This is my second Amazon Beauty Sample Box and I've been pleased both times. I have a subscription to Ipsy, plus I get the Wal-Mart & Target Beauty Boxes when they come out. The types of samples is comparable to all of those. Plus, you get credit toward a future beauty purchase! I like the assortment of items. Between my teenage daughter and me, we can use just about everything.

title: Soft & Shiny Hair!
text: I have thick, coarse hair. I've been using this for a couple of weeks and I have noticed a huge difference already in the texture of my hair. The biggest thing that I've noticed since using this is how soft my hair is now. I use one pump of the oil and apply it to the middle/ends of my hair. The first time I used it, I also applied it near my scalp, but I didn't work it in well and I had some flakiness later. Since then, I have only used it on the middle and ends and haven't had any issues with flaking.  The scent is a mild floral/fruity smell. It's not overly oily or greasy. In fact, when I am finished working it through my hair, I just rub my hands together and my hands aren't greasy at all. If I don't have to wash my hands to get the product off. I haven't noticed any difference in the amount of time it takes to dry my hair. It's summer vacation, and I am letting it air dry most days. In addition to softer hair, I can run my fingers through my hair without any difficulties. My hair is also shiny and healthy looking since using this oil.

title: Practice, Practice, Practice!
text: My sixteen year old daughter has been shaping/plucking her eyebrows for several months now. She actually does a good job with them. I personally have never done more than pluck a few out of place hairs on my own eye brows. She uses brow pencils to fill in some, so I thought this might be a fun and quick way to do her eyebrows. There's definitely a learning curve to it. As the video says, practice makes perfect. One of the pairs of stamps resembles her brow arch pretty well. The color is a little on the dark side, but with practice, she learned not to stamp it too firmly and that helped a lot. She has to use the rolling technique when stamping and has had good success with that. It has taken a lot of trial and error for her, but she's got the hang of it now. She did allow one of her girlfriends to try it one night and neither of the stamp sets worked with the friend's brow shape. Plus, the friend is a blonde and the color was much too dark for her, even when applying it with light pressure. It seems to last well and she hasn't had any issues with it wearing off too quickly.

title: Nice Lather
text: My husband discovered shaving soaps last year and now he prefers them over traditional shaving cream or gel. This one comes with a nice bowl to store it. My husband keeps it in the shower and so far he hasn't dropped it on the ceramic tile! It lathers well and has pleasant, masculine scent. It's not an over powering scent like some shaving products. My husband has been very pleased with this soap. Right now he's wearing the "five o'clock shadow" look as opposed to a full on beard, so he has been shaving his neck and cheeks.

title: Very Long Lasting!
text: I've tried several different lip products that claim to last all day and this one has the best lasting power. I am amazed at how long it lasted. I even had difficulties removing it at bedtime. At first I tried using a make-remover wipe and it didn't budge. Then I tried a lip scrub - nothing. I finally had success when I used a wash cloth and applied some pressure while I scrubbed it off. It's fairly easy to apply. The applicator wand is a little big, but you can use it on the side or tip to apply if necessary. I did have to try to go over the edges to smooth it down because there was a slight build up which was noticeable. It's pretty sticky. It took over thirty minutes to fully dry and lose that sticky feeling. I did drink my morning coffee before it was completely dry, but none transferred to my mug. The color was a little too pink for me. I prefer a more natural color, but I do plan to try another color such as Lover.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I am in my late forties and not the target audience for this belly butter, but I am enjoying it. The orange creamsicle scent is amazing. This is a gentle, yet effective moisturizing butter. I started using it on my belly area, but I haven't noticed any reduction or fading of my stretch marks. I figure mine may be too old to see any changes. However, it does moisturize well.  I do have occasional itchy skin in the abdomen area and I haven't noticed any itchiness since I've been using it. I don't usually moisturize my stomach, so I guess that's what I've needed! It is a little bit greasy feeling, but not to the point where you have to wash your hands immediately. My hands just feel super moisturized after applying it. It's thicker than I would prefer to use on my hands or arms, but the balm consistency is good on rough skin such as elbows. I am going to try it on my heels, too. I do really like that it's organic and is made from natural ingredients. I think this would make a nice shower or baby gift for the new mom.

title: Needs To Be Reapplied
text: The color is a darker, but pretty shade of lipstick. The picture in the description is pretty accurate. My teenage daughter has to wear a similar color for color guard performances, so she is excited to have this.  It doesn't really look metallic, but for her performances, that's fine. It doesn't last very long and has to be reapplied frequently to maintain the intensity. Overall, it's an average, decent, drug store quality lip product.

title: Feels Refreshing!
text: I usually don't have too much trouble with bags or dark circles under my eyes, but I am getting older, so I do like the idea of firmer skin around my eyes and reducing the appearance of fine lines. These gel eye masks feel so nice! They instantly cool the skin and start hydrating right away. They have a pleasant, though very light, fruity scent. They are easy to put on. I am a side sleeper who sometimes switches to my stomach during the night. Every time I've tried these, they've come off during the night. I've tried similar eye masks before with the same results. I really think it's because of my sleep positions. So I put these on a little before I go to bed. I usually get into bed about an hour before I go to sleep. Then I know that there in place while I'm reading or watching TV. I usually wake up once in the middle of the night to use the bathroom. Most times, I'm down to just one eye mask at that time and by the morning, they're both gone. I'd rather get some benefit from them, than none at all. But I feel that if I slept on my back, they would stay in place much better.

title: Doesn't Irritate My Eyes!
text: I like the quality of this eye shadow. It's an affordable, product. The color is a little too light. I thought it might work as a highlight, but it's not noticeable at all on my eyelids. So instead, I've been using it as a base coat. I wear a lot of color on my lids to begin with, but this one is like wearing no color at all. I can't really tell if it lasts 14 hours or not, because I can barely even tell when it's on. It doesn't irritate my eyes. It's priced very well, so I am going to order another color or two.

title: A Very Gentle Cleanser
text: I am so glad that I have found this cleanser! I am 49 years old and still deal with acne. Usually it's just hormonal, but recently I had more than the usual once a month flare up and went to the drugstore to pick up an acne cleanser. The one I ended up with was really harsh on my sensitive skin and caused excess dryness and redness. I stopped using it after a few days and it took about a week to get my skin texture back to normal. This cleanser is super gentle! I've been using this twice a day for over a week now and I have not experienced any dryness or redness at all. It contains the same salicylic acid as the other cleanser that I was using! Since this came with three bottles, I gave one to my teenage daughter. She has had issues with salicylic acid in the past leaving her skin red and irritated, but this cleanser hasn't given her any troubles either. It has a pump dispenser. I usually have to pump it about three times to get enough product to clean my face. It has a light, clean scent.  The price seems a little expensive, but when I was at the drugstore comparing all the acne cleansers, this is pretty comparable to what I was finding, especially when you purchase this in the 3 pack.

title: A Nice, Light Weight Moisturizer
text: I am 49 years old. I still deal with acne, but I don't have oily skin.  I would say it's a mix of normal and dry.  Anti-aging moisturizers are a part of my daily routine. However, in the last year or so, my skin has also become very sensitive. Most products will leave my skin red after application. It usually goes away fairly quickly, but it does concern me. This moisturizer is amazing! It absorbs really fast and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or oily at all. It also doesn't leave any redness either. There's a very light, fruity scent which smells very nice. The only thing it's missing is sunscreen, but that would alter the lovely scent. I don't mind applying that separately. The jar is a little on the small side, but it really doesn't take a lot to cover my face.

title: Soft & Silky
text: I have tried several different make up primers. My favorites have been The Porefessional Face Primer by Benefit and Baby Skin Instant Pore Eraser Primer by Maybelline. The NxN Flash Matte Primer is comparable to both of those primers. It is the same consistency & same silkiness that they both have. It leaves a soft and smooth surface before putting your foundation on.  It has a pump dispenser. I have found that it takes about two pumps to adequately cover my entire face. It has a light, almost fruity scent. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. The bottle is generously sized and should last a while.

title: Gentle Product
text: This serum is light weight and non-greasy. It has a pleasant, mild scent. The dropper dispenses an adequate amount and it usually only takes one drop to apply to my face. I've been using this after cleansing my face, but before moisturizing it. I have sensitive skin and this does not sting, burn, or cause any redness. During the first couple of weeks I did not have any issues with breakouts, but during the third week, I did. I assume my breakout was due to hormones, not the product.  It hasn't cleared up the breakouts yet.

title: Unique Travel Tubs
text: These are cute and unique travel tubs. They are made from a food grade flexible silicone. The lids securely fasten, but since they can be removed very easily from squeezing, I am hesitant to fill them with any liquids. I have put a thick cream in one without any issues, but I would not store thin, runny liquids in them. There are three containers, all a different color. They have a Lego type tops/bottoms so you can stack them for easy storage. Although small, they can hold a decent amount.

title: Nice Natural Scent
text: I try to use moisturizers or make-up with sunscreen because otherwise, I don't think to apply it to my face. This combination product has an organic sunscreen as well as a primer. It's a lotion but it takes a little longer than most lotions to absorb into the skin. I usually have to rub it in twice as long as other moisturizers. The smell is nice. I think it's the Helichrysum oil what I am recognizing which is much more pleasant than the traditional scent of sunscreens. It's not at all like other primers that I use regarding texture. Most of them leave a super silky surface - this one does not. I also have noticed any firming of it either. Overall, I like it as a facial sunscreen, but I'm not sure I'm seeing any changes in my wrinkles or longer lasting of my make up.

title: Smells Amazing!
text: I have gotten lazy with my bedtime routine. I've started using cleansing wipes to remove my make up. These wipes smell amazing! They have a very pleasant coconut scent. The wipes are soft and non-irritating. They don't leave my sensitive skin red either. So far, I have not had any troubles with more than one dispensing at a time, as I have run into with some other brands of cleansing wipes.

title: Love the Lavender Scent!
text: I like the idea of a natural sunscreen. I was quite pleased with the list of ingredients! It has a very pleasant, lavender scent. I'm not crazy about the usual scent that most sunscreens have, so I always try to ones that don't smell like that. This one smells very nice. It is a little thinner than other sunscreen lotions that I have used. The first time I used it, I squeezed out more than I needed and it took a while to rub it in to my skin. Now I know to start with less and apply more as needed. It absorbs pretty well. It does leave my fingers a little tacky - but not sticky. So far it seems to be doing find in preventing sunburns.

title: Gentle Cleansing Wipes
text: I have been having issues with facial products leaving my face red after using it. I don't know if my skin has suddenly become sensitive to products or I've been using harsh products on my skin. I am not very good about washing my face before going to bed, so I have started using cleansing wipes to remove the make up and dirt. These wipes have been pretty good so far. They have not left my face red, nor do they irritate my skin. The cloths are soft to the touch. The only thing that I don't like is that when I take one out, often more than one comes out. Then I have to try to get the extra one back into the package.

title: Leaves No Redness!
text: I've had issues with some moisturizers lately leaving my face red. The redness goes away, but I wasn't sure if it was a sensitivity issue or not. I decided to try moisturizer specifically for sensitive skin. First of all, this does not leave any redness on my skin. It does have sunscreen in it, which I need, but it doesn't have the usual sunscreen smell that some products have. That makes me very happy! It absorbs fast and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. I have not had any issues with it causing acne or blemishes. This is a great, daytime facial moisturizer! The only thing I don't like is that the lid is not attached. You do have to completely unscrew the lid to access it. A lot of facial creams and moisturizers that I have used recently are easier to get into.

title: Practice, Practice, Practice!
text: I had been wanting to give this a try for a while. I have been very unhappy with my foundation for the past few years. I've tried all kinds of foundations, expensive ones, drug store ones, and more. I've tried powders, creams, mousses, and liquids. The main thing that kept me from trying the Luminess Airbrush system was the price. I've been playing around with it for a few weeks so far. I downloaded the app and watched the tutorials. I would pause it and try it on my own. The tutorials were especially helpful in learning how to hold the stylus and use it properly. The set comes with a DVD, but I haven't been able to use it yet. My laptop doesn't have a DVD player, nor do I have a DVD player anywhere near my bathroom or in my bedroom. It comes with several small, samples of five different foundation colors. Most of them are darker than I would prefer, but there are two that work well for me. I had the Tan shade. I really like the moisturizer/primer. I have had some success with the system, but I have not perfected it yet. I tried it one morning when I was getting ready for work, but wasn't happy with the results at all. I've decided that until I get really good with it, I need to use it when I'm not rushed for time. A lot of the times, I can barely tell that I have applied any at all. It's a little difficult for me to tell when it's actually spraying product.  However, when I use a facial wipe to clean my face, there's definitely foundation on the wipe. It takes some practice (and I still need some of that!), so I definitely suggest you give it some time and watch the tutorials! It's a little noisy when in use, but not as loud as a hair dryer. It's easy to clean by adding a little water to the stylus and running it until it sprays clean. I like the foundation. It doesn't sting my eyes when I sweat, which is really important to me. Overall,  I don't love the system yet, but I do like it and I'm going to keep practicing.

title: Dries Super Fast!
text: I have been a fan of Alba Botanica products for a few months. I love their earth friendly approach to body products. This is my first time using their sunscreen products. The first thing that stands out to me is that the smell is pretty mild. It doesn't have the typical strong scent that goes along with a lot of sunscreens. And once it has absorbed into your skin, it's difficult to distinguish any scent at all. I was surprised at how fast it dries. It's a clear spray and absorbs/dries really quickly. It does not leave behind any greasiness or oiliness either. It also left my skin really soft. I haven't noticed that with other spray sunscreens so I don't know if that's unique to Alba Botanica or not. The spray cap can be locked so it doesn't accidently spray when it's not in use. I am very pleased with this sunscreen so far.

title: Good Peppermint Lotion, But Not as Cooling as I Would Like
text: It's been years since I have used the Body Shop Peppermint Cooling Foot lotion. I've been trying various brands of peppermint lotions and most have not been cooling enough for me. I had fond memories of this lotion being very strong in the cooling department. The bottle has changed over the years. I'm not sure if the formula is the same or not, but overall, it's not as strong a peppermint lotion as I remembered. It's difficult to dispense the lotion when it's half full or less. The lotion is an adequate thickness and absorbs easily. It does have a cooling effect, but it's not as strong as I would prefer. It's a good lotion, but I think that Burts Bees peppermint foot lotion is a stronger mint.

title: Great Neutral Color!
text: This Maybelline lip liner is a great, neutral color. It's a twistable pencil that doesn't need to be sharpened. It is easy to apply. I've tried it as a liner only and I've filled in my entire lips. It lasts for a few hours before needing another application. It doesn't smear. I am very pleased with it.

title: Great for Sensitive Skin
text: My skin has recently become a bit sensitive in my old age. I've also started noticing a lot of redness on my face. I haven't pinpointed the source of the redness, but when I saw this night cream, I thought it might be helpful. It does not claim to reduce redness and I have not noticed any difference in the amount of redness on my face. It is designed to help sooth irritation and redness due to dry skin. It does not irritate my skin in any way. It does a nice job of moisturizing, plus it leaves my skin feeling soft. It absorbs fairly quickly and does not leave any greasiness behind. There is no fragrance  and it does not clog my pores. I can't say for sure whether or not it is soothing my redness, but it is a good moisturizer and doesn't seem to increase any of my redness.

title: Not As Powerful as My Former One
text: I ordered this to replace a Lady Remington trimmer that I have been using for the past couple of years. This one is okay, but it's not as powerful as the Lady Remington. It was difficult to open to install the batteries. I had to get my husband to do it. I mainly use my trimmer to trim hair around a facial mole that I have and above my lip. I find that with this one I have to go over the same hair a couple of times before it gets it sometimes. It's pretty quiet which is nice. Overall, it's okay, and I will continue to use it, but when it needs to be replaced, I will probably go back to the Lady Remington one.

title: Easy to Use Bottle
text: I am in my late 40's and have combination skin. I still get the occasional breakouts - but those are usually related to hormones and my time of the month. My skin has been a little drier lately because of the colder weather. Sometimes my skin is very sensitive to skincare products and will leave my face red and splotchy for hours after using a product. I've been using this toner for almost a month now. I haven't had much problems with the sensitivity of it while using it. My face is a little red at first, but it's very temporary. And it's not an all over redness. It doesn't sting or burn my skin on a regular basis. I did have a small cut on my chin one day and that did burn when it came in contact with this toner. Once the cut was healed, I didn't have any more problems. Plus, I kept away from that area until it did heal. The bottle is very easy to use. I love that it's so simple. You just have to put a cotton ball on and press down to get the toner. It's one of the easiest dispensers ever! I am amazed at how much dirt it gets, even when I think my face is clean. Yuck! I haven't noticed any over drying of my skin - but it is winter and my face is drier overall right now. I like the smell - it reminds me of Sea Breeze that I used to use in the eighties.

title: Nice Masculine Scent
text: My husband made the switch from shaving cream to shaving soap about a year ago. I think one of the reasons that he likes using shaving soap is for the whole shaving ritual. He is pretty easy going about what kind of shaving soap to use. As long as it has a decent lather, he's usually pretty happy. He prefers ones that don't have a super strong smell to them. This shaving soap by Royal Shave has been comparable to other brands that he has used. It lathers well without too much effort, but at the same time, it doesn't melt too quickly either. The lemon sandlewood scent is very nice and masculine. My husband isn't a fan of smelling like fruit, so I was a little concerned about it being too lemony, but the scent is fairly mild and not over powering at all. It also doesn't linger on him too much either. My husband keeps his shaving soap in the shower, so since this comes wrapped in paper, he had to put the refill disc into an empty container with a lid. He's learned that if he keeps it in an open bowl in the shower, it dissolves and melts faster. He's been very pleased with his shaves since using this. So far, he's barely made a dent in it, so I would expect it to last a good couple of months easily.

title: Great for the Shower
text: This wide tooth comb is perfect for my daughter to keep in the shower. She has long hair which used to get knotted easily. Her hair dresser recommended that she comb her hair in the shower, so she's been doing with success. It's exactly as pictured.

title: Decent
text: These microfiber scrubbers are pretty small. They do a decent job of scrubbing, but the rougher side is not has coarse as I need for some areas. I have found that they dry over night. I haven't had any issues with mildew or foul smells. It would be nice if they had a small loop so I could hang them. They fall through the stainless steel shower organizer unless I position them just perfectly at an angle so they are positioned across the wire bars. I'm afraid that they won't dry well if I just leave them on the shower ledge. I received the green ones, but would have preferred any of the other colors over the green.

title: Just as I Remembered
text: I ordered this for my teenage daughter. I had fond memories of using it when I was a teen, but it's really hard to find. This is the original formula that I used in the 1980s, but in an updated bottle. I tried this out and it brought back lots of memories. It still gives you the light tingling sensation that was great for helping you to wake up in the morning.

title: Perfect Amount of Exfoliation!
text: I ordered a different brand facial sponge that was too rough and coarse for me. This Gentle Buf Puf is so much better. It is just what I wanted. It exfoliates my face without hurting or scratching. I just add a few pumps of my cleanser to it and scrub away.

title: Natural Looking
text: I am in my late forties and I have noticed that my eyelashes are much thinner than they used to be. I have tried several different high end and drug store brand mascaras to give me fuller and/or longer lashes. This mascara does a great job of lengthening my eyelashes. With one application, they have a naturally longer look to them. It doesn't really thicken them much, but to be honest, I think they look more natural that way. I really don't like the super thick, bushy eyelashes that look too much like false eyelashes. I want a mascara that I can wear daily. I haven't had any issues with clumping or eye sensitivity. It dries pretty quickly and it can be removed without too much effort.

title: Too Abrasive For Me
text: I ordered these for myself. I was excited to find a large bag of them at such an affordable price. The shape and size is very good for using on your face. I personally found these to be way too abrasive. I don't consider my skin to be that sensitive, but these are just too rough for me. It leaves my face red after using it.  I've tried using different levels of pressure to see if that helped. If I apply minimal pressure, I don't feel that it does anything for my face at all. I need some kind of exfoliation which is why I ordered these.  I really wanted to love them!! I ended up ordering a Buff Puff Gentle and have found that to be much better for me.

title: Fun!
text: The luxury beauty box is filled with lots of samples! These are more high end products as compared to the standard beauty box. My teenage daughter and I had fun going through all of the samples. A few days after ordering, I received my promised beauty credit to be used on select beauty products. That definitely makes it worth the price. I can't wait to order the next one!

title: Fun Sample Box!
text: This is my first Amazon Beauty Sample Box! It's filled with all kinds of samples. These samples are more basic brands.  My teenage daughter and I had fun going through it. The best part is that you get the full price of the box in credit to be used on a future beauty purchase.

title: Fast & Convenient
text: I have been a fan of the Schick Intuition for several years now. It's so much more convenient to have an all in one product. Not only is it easier, but it's faster, too. My teenage daughter has started using these, too.

title: Not the Color I Was Looking For
text: I like using this type of lip product. It's a sheer, lightly colored balm type product. The color does have to be reapplied more frequently than a lip stick. This shade was a little darker than I expected. I was looking for something a little lighter in color.

title: Works Well
text: I bought this to help with the occasional wild brow hair. It is easy to apply. I haven't had any issues with it being visible (white) after it dries or with it feeling crunchy.  I usually have just one hair on one of my eyebrows that needs taming, so I don't put on much - just enough to do the job. For the price, I am very pleased with the job it does.

title: Not Quite the Color I Wanted
text: I like the Cover Girl Jumbo Balm Glosses. The first time I bought one, I didn't realize that they are retractable pencils and broke mine. This time, I knew what I was expecting. It's basically a tinted lip balm. The color on this one was more pink than I expected. The picture lead me to believe that it was more peachy. I doesn't last very long and has to be reapplied throughout the day, but I like that it is a more natural color than a lot of other lip colors out there.

title: Not Very Noticeable
text: I purchased the white water line pencil to brighten my eyes. It glides pretty well, but it's not very noticeable at all. For the most part, I can't even tell that I have it on. It doesn't cause any irritation to my eyes.

title: Nice Scent
text: My husband started using shaving soap over a year ago. He enjoys the whole shaving ritual now. This shaving soap looks like it would be soft and creamy, but it's solid. It lathers adequately. The scent is a nice, masculine fragrance. My husband shaves in the shower. He likes that this comes in a plastic tub so it can stay in there without melting away.  He likes this shaving soap much better than other brands that he has tried.

title: Non-irritating!
text: I have used other brands of fiber lashes and found this to be comparable to them. They do clump a little bit, but so did my other fiber lashes. One thing I really liked about this one is that the fibers are black. My other ones were white and more noticeable when they flaked. My eyes are often sensitive and I didn't have any issues with this product irritating my eyes at all. I found that the finished look was a bit over exaggerated and not what I would like. I want longer lashes that look more natural. Overall, I like this, but I don't love it.

title: Good Translucent Powder
text: This is a nice, translucent pressed powder. It comes with a sponge applicator, but I have been using it with a brush instead. I apply this over my powder foundation and it keeps my skin shine free for most of the day. I do find that I need to reapply it again at  the end of the day if I am going out again. I haven't noticed much difference in the appearance of my pores, but for the price, I am very pleased with as a powder.

title: Doesn't Irritate
text: I'm in my late forties and have been dealing with unwanted facial hair. I've tried this on my upper lip and chin. The balm goes on easily and reminds me of lip balm. My skin can sometimes be sensitive and the cream does not cause any irritation at all. There is a slight smell to the cream, but it's not even close to the smell of other facial hair removal products. I have used this set a couple of times so far. It worked well on the hair on my upper lip and it lasted for about a week. I did not have any luck with the hairs on my chin. I didn't notice any difference before or after using it. The second time I tried it, I even kept it on for a little longer which didn't make a difference. The chin hairs weren't very long, so maybe they need to be longer for better success. I am very happy with how it works on the upper lip hair!

title: Takes Up Less Room than My Large Em Palettes!
text: I bought a couple of the em palettes recently when they were Today's Deals. I am really enjoying them, but they are large and take up a lot of room. I ordered two of these travel compacts to use with them. So far, I have put my two favorite color sets into them, but there are some sets where I really like just one or two of the colors and I was mix/matching them so I plan to make my own sets of those colors. The compacts are small and don't take up much room at all. The spots are small, but they fit the colors from the em palettes perfectly. I wish there was a small spot for the little brush that comes in the palette. I am very pleased with these.

title: Very Different From Other Primers I Have Used
text: This primer wasn't at all what I was expecting. I've tried several different high end primers before and they all have a similar texture and consistency. This one is very different. It comes out white instead of translucent. The color rubs into your skin clearly, so there's not whiteness once it's absorbed. It does leave a sheen behind. It feels like a thin lotion or moisturizer. Other primers that I have used have a silky, thicker feel to them. I don't notice much difference in my pores. It does give you a smooth surface before applying your foundation which is the purpose of primer. I haven't had any issues with sensitivity. It is definitely cheaper than the other primers that I have used. Overall, it's okay. I will continue using it, but I'm not sure it's something I will order again.

title: Lengthens Lashes Well
text: This mascara is very different from what I normally use. I have two mascara tubes - one for everyday use and one for special occasions (longer lashes). The wand/brush on this is not like any that I have ever used before. It is very thin and curved. I found it to be a little strange using it. It definitely lengthens lashes, but I'm not sure it's the look for me. I did have a little bit of clumping on my lashes when I used it. I let my teenager daughter try it and she was very pleased with it. I didn't have any problems with smearing, or smudging once it was applied. I liked it, but I didn't love it.  I personally prefer a more traditional brush for my mascara.

title: Nice, But I Prefer Strong Mint
text: Applying mint foot lotion or cream at the end of the day before I go to bed is part of my regular bedtime routine. This lotion is refreshing and not greasy, but the mint is not as strong as I would prefer. There's not much tingling going on after it is applied. So far, the best peppermint foot lotions that have the strongest tingling effect are Burts Bees and The Body Shop.

title: Love It!
text: I first saw the em palette as a special offer on Ipsy. I was interested in it, but it was priced more than I wanted to spend. I was thrilled to see this as an Amazon daily deal recently, so I snagged it. I've been using the this make up palette daily since it arrived. There is a great variety of colors. A lot of them are natural and subtle which is what I prefer. I have been impressed with how long the color lasts. I apply my make up in the morning before going to work. I often notice that by lunch time it hardly looks like I have any make up on at all. I've been able to tell that it's still there (in a good way) well into the afternoon. I do have to reapply after work if I have plans out, but that is pretty normal anyway. I love using some of the colors as my eyeliner. I tend to rub my eyes a lot, so the powder doesn't last as long there, but the eye shadows and blush are good for most of the day.

title: Vibrant Color
text: My teenage daughter is in her high school marching band color guard. They were instructed to get some gold eyeliner for their show this season. This was an affordable option. The color is very highly pigmented which is just what my daughter needed. She applies it once before show time and it stays put during the performance. It doesn't irritate her eyes which is another plus.

title: Great Storage for Make Up!
text:
This make up bag is wonderful and it couldn't have come at a better time. My teenage daughter loves makeup. She has quite a collection. She recently went through her collection and got rid of items that were too old or yucky. She doesn't have a lot of counter space in her bathroom, so she put just the basics that she uses daily on her counter, but she put the rest of her stuff in this case. First of all, this case can be customized to accommodate your needs. She had fun trying to figure out the best way to set the case up so it could hold her makeup. The compartments can be changed as your needs change. The case is a firm one so it protects the contents well. There are pockets for the brushes and it covers them to keep them clean. There's a strap so you can carry this on your shoulder when traveling. It's well made and sturdy. My daughter absolutely loves it!

*I received this for free directly from the company in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Good Neutral Lip Gloss
text: This is a nice, neutral colored lip gloss. It's not sticky or gooey. It does have to be reapplied throughout the day, but that doesn't bother me. I have found that the ones that last all day are sticky which I don't like. Overall, I like this and like the way it looks on me.

title: Good Foot Moisturizer
text: I cannot sleep well if my feet are too warm or too dry. Peppermint foot lotions have become a regular part of my bedtime routine. I have developed a preference for the ones that tingle and re-energize my feet. It's not enough that a lotion moisturizes - that's just part of it. I need them to be cooled down, too. This lotion gives an immediate cooling feeling, but it's not as long lasting as I would prefer. There's minimal tingling. It's not bad by any means, just not enough tingling. Burt's Bees and The Body Shop have good, strong peppermint foot lotions. This is better than some peppermint foot lotions that I have tried. The scent is nice.

title: Good for Skin!
text:
I recently purchased a vanity mirror with 5x magnification. My close up vision is not really good these days, so until I got that mirror, I was oblivious to the fact that I have blackheads on my temples. The first thing I did when I saw them, was research ways to get rid of them. Facial steaming is supposed to be effective, so I needed a facial steamer. The directions were pretty easy to follow. It calls for distilled water, so I had to go purchase that before I could use it. It does not take very long for it to start steaming. The steam is pretty hot. The directions say to keep your face 7-8 inches away from it and that's not hard because it is hot! I need to find a better location for my steaming. I had it on my bathroom counter, but then I had to hunch over it while it worked. A seated location would be more comfortable. The steamer comes with a dust cover which is good because my bathroom is a dust magnet! I am going to research to see if I can add a few drops of Essential Oils into the water before steaming. I think that would be pleasant.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Decent Mascara for the Price
text: In its price range, this is a decent mascara. I am in my late 40's and over the years I have noticed that my eyelashes are not as long or full as they used to be. I have tried lash serums, but haven't had much luck. I want longer lashes, but I don't really need super long ones. With one coat, I can get long natural looking lashes. I have purchased the $25-$30 mascaras that do a good job of lengthening my lashes, but it's hard to justify spending that amount. When I am going out or getting dressed up, I use more than one coat and then they do look more like false eyelashes. But for everyday use, one coat is adequate for me. It doesn't irritate my eyes or flake off.

title: Great Foot Soothing Lotion!
text:
My feet are picky when it comes to lotion. I tend to buy peppermint lotion to help soothe my feet, but I thought I would give this a try. I am a fan of tea tree oil, but I wasn't sure how it make me feet feel. I was pleasantly surprised that it was able to cool my feet a bit. It wasn't as cooling as a strong peppermint, but it was very refreshing. My feet approve! It absorbs well and didn't leave my feet sticky or greasy afterwards. Peppermint foot lotions can get pricey, so I am happy that I have found a good alternative that is reasonably priced.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Immediate Sunburn Relief!
text: I took my daughter to the water park earlier this week. I usually get a spot in the shade, but we arrived late and the only chairs available were in direct sunlight. I thought I was very thorough about applying sunscreen and reapplying, but apparently not. I got a very painful sunburn on my upper chest and shoulders. I haven't had sunburn this badly in years. It interfered with sleeping because it hurt so bad! I didn't have any Aloe or sunburn gels at home, so I ordered this the day after the water park. It arrived the next day. It is amazing!!!! It doesn't leave my hands super sticky. It absorbs nicely. It takes the sting or burn away immediately. I've only had to apply it a couple of times a day.  I totally recommend this!

title: Better Than Cheap Drugstore Clippers!
text:
As far as toe nail clippers, these are pretty good. I've used better ones, but this is definitely better than the cheap drugstore clippers. The product description says it comes with a catchall for the clippings, but I don't see anything that would catch the clippings. The description also refers to a nail clippers by Simply Essentials which is not the brand these are - so maybe there's a mix up on products. Anyway....as I said, these are decent clippers. I really do like way the curved shape feels in my hand. But at the same time, I found the curved shaped was a little more difficult to apply pressure to do the clipping. The clippers are sharp enough to cut through regular toe nails. I didn't have to make any double cuts. The nail file is pretty sturdy. I don't usually use nail files, so I can't really comment on the quality of it or how it works.

*I Purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Refreshes Feet!
text: I can't sleep at night if my feet are too hot or dry. I've been like that for years. Peppermint foot lotions are a daily part of my of bedtime routine. This mentha foot cream is awesome! The product consistency is more like a lotion than a cream. It doesn't take a lot of it to cover the soles of my feet. The tingling sensation is immediate. It is very soothing and refreshing. It cools down my feet nicely. Unfortunately, the effects only last a short while - maybe 10 to 15 minutes tops. Compared to other peppermint foot lotions, this one is really good. Most don't have a tingling sensation or the refreshing feel lasts even less.

title: High Quality Hair Appliance!
text:
[[VIDEOID:228b4da4f90c10a17e3f6d5ffe746554]]My daughter has thick, wavy hair. Since she entered her teen years, she has also gotten random curls too. So she either straightens it or curls it most days so she has consistent hair all over. She has a flat iron that we purchased a few years ago and a "tween" store, so this is a huge improvement over that. This heats up really quickly. That really impressed me. It is fully heated in less than a minute. The degrees are shown on a digital display on the top of the appliance in Celsius. My daughter is very aware of the heating temperatures and taking care of her hair, so she had to convert the Celsius to Fahrenheit which was a slight pain. The cord has a nice swivel feature and there is a locking mechanism for safety. We've only used it on dry hair so far, but the results have been good. My daughter is very happy to have a "grown up" ceramic flat iron that looks nice, rather than the "cutesy" one she has had for the last few years.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Super Soft
text:
I have never heard of oval toothbrush makeup brushes before. Prior to trying them out, I couldn't imagine that they would be good makeup brushes. But after a few days, I am really digging these! The brushes are super soft. I have some traditional style makeup brushes, but these are softer than anything I have ever used before. They do a good job of applying my powder foundation and my loose face powder. I also like how it works with my blush. I find that I'm holding them differently than I hold a toothbrush. I am actually holding it closer to the head of the brush rather than the handle. I get a lot of control that way. The handles are solid, but not as firm as traditional style brush handles. I haven't quite figured out how to use the smaller, detail brushes yet. I wish it came with some kind of storage container, whether it was a nicer box or a specialized vase-like container. They arrived in a plastic box inset which has already cracked. It's not something I would like to leave out on my counter. Since I use my makeup brushes daily, I do want them kept where I can access them easily. I also would like it if it came with suggestions on what brush to use for what type of application. On the outer box they are numbered, but it doesn't say which brush is best for foundation or which one works best for blush. As I said, I'm not really sure what to do with the smaller ones yet. I haven't noticed any shedding or odors from the brushes. Overall, I really like these brushes and I'm glad that I discovered them!

*I purchased these at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: A Must Have Item when Using Heating Appliances
text: I ordered this for my teenage daughter after she burnt her hand while curling her hair. It fits well. It keeps her hand safe from burns, but she says she can still feel the heat from the appliance. But as long as she isn't getting burned anymore, we're happy. Her hand is medium sized. The glove does stretch some, but overall it fits well on her. It fit my large hands, too, but it was a little tight.

title: Nice Size Molds
text:
My teen daughter and I have been making a lot of bath bombs lately. We have a couple of sets of aluminum molds and a set of plastic ones. While we do have several molds, we have found that you need a lot or otherwise you are waiting around for your bath bombs to be ready to come out of a mold. We've had decent luck with all of our molds so far. These stainless steel ones are no exception. Any failures that we have had are usually attributed to our bath bomb recipe and the addition of too much or not enough water. We have not had any difficulties with the bath bombs sticking to these molds. The molds are not as thick as I expected. They do flex a little, but they have not gotten bent or dented. The size is pretty good and they don't leave much of a seam.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Made Great Bath Bombs!
text: I bought this so my daughter & I could make bath bombs. It worked well for our purposes. I probably could have purchased it cheaper in the store, but the convenience of ordering online appealed to my busy life. The only complaint that I have is that the container is not resealable. We only used a small bit and would like to save it for future uses. I don't know how long it lasts after opened.

title: Shimmery
text: My daughter needed silvery eye shadow for Winter Guard. I didn't have time to go shopping, so this was the best choice that I could find online. It is a beautiful color duo. It is a little lighter than what we were looking for, but it is a pretty shade. She usually has to put her make up on a couple of hours before performance time, so it does usually need to be reapplied for best results. It doesn't irritate her eyes and it's easy enough to remove.

title: Heavenly Scent!
text:
I enjoy using sugar scrubs to exfoliate, especially in the winter months. This sugar scrub/polish is unique because of the addition of shea butter. It's almost creamy in texture. I ordered the blackberry & plum scented polish which smells incredible! I've been using this on my elbows and upper chest area. It's not particularly oily, but it does leave behind a slight oily residue behind, even after rinsing well with very warm water. In addition though, it does leave your skin moisturized. It doesn't require a lot of product per use, so a little goes a long way.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Just as Expected
text: I have 2 sets of Essential Oils in my home - one for upstairs and one for downstairs. I have some larger 4 oz bottles of oils that I purchased so I could transfer some of the oil into small bottles for my sets. These bottles are perfect! I prefer the 10 ml size over the smaller 5 ml ones. They have the euro style droppers which I also like. These are very similar to the bottles that many of my individual oils have come in. I need to order some more so I can start creating some blends.

title: Great for Home Spa Time!
text: This Dead Sea Salt foot soak is wonderful! I work full time and my feet are often sore and tired at the end of the day. This foot soak brought life back to my feet. The combination of peppermint and tea tree oils was invigorating. The jar is generously sized and comes with a cute little wooden scoop. It only takes 2-3 scoops per use, so it should last a while. The salts were mostly dissolved by the end of my soak. I didn't have a very good bowl to use, so I need to find a small basin or something. Other than that, my experience was relaxing and enjoyable. The pumice stone was a nice little extra that came with it. I was able to slough off some skin on my heels with it. During the winter I don't usually spend as much time and care on my feet, so this was definitely a treat! I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great Quality Sponge!
text:
My daughter loves charcoal Konjac sponges. She has noticed an improvement with acne when using them. This one is a nice quality. I use Konjac sponges, too, so we've been comparing different ones. Not all of them have the same texture. I have used some that are spongier than others and I personally prefer ones that are firmer. Yes, they get softer when you add water to them, but some are squishier than others and I prefer less squishy. This one leans toward the firmer. It comes with a little suction hook which is nice. My daughter has been very happy with it so far.

*I purchased this sponge at a reduced price for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Fun for Spa Night!
text: During the winter, my feet are dry and cracked. It effects my sleep at night because I can't stand the way my rough sheets feel against my sheets. I've tried another Korean style foot sheet mask before and was pleased with it, so I was eager to try this. This foot treatment comes with 2 parts. There's the sheet mask that is shaped for your foot to slip into and then plastic covers that go over that. I have large, wide feet (size 10 W) and the sheet masks fit on them without being too tight.The directions state to wash your feet first, so I did that.  The mask is wet, but not dripping. It would probably be nice to have refrigerated the package in advance for a nice cooling effect. I left them on for 30 minutes. When I was finished, my feet were soft and smooth. Of course, the results aren't as long lasting as a full on spa pedicure, but they were definitely improved for a couple of days. I read one negative review that complained that they did not have any peeling at all. I'm not sure why, but no where in the description was I led to believe that this was a foot peeling treatment. I was happy with the results, and I will probably purchase more of these.

title: Leaves Lips Nice & Soft
text: This lip scrub is generously sized. The scent is nice. It does a good job of sloughing off the dry skin off of my lips. It leaves my lips feeling super soft. The only reason that I am giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that that although the item was packed well, it still managed to leak. There were oil spots on the actual box. Then container was oily but at first glance it seemed to be well sealed. However upon closer examination, the insert that covered the top of the product was not completely sealed. I had to mix up the scrub before I first used it because the top part of it was more dry since the oil had leaked.

title: Great gift idea!
text: This is one of the best handmade soaps that I have ever used. I used to make my own soap and this one is an excellent product. The scent is strong, but not overbearing. When I first opened it and put it in my bathroom, I could smell it every time I walked into the room. I must have gotten used to it, because it's not as noticeable now until I am actually in the shower. It lathers nicely & does not leave any film or residue behind. My skin feels soft and clean after using it. This would make a great gift for a friend. I know I would love receiving it!

title: Would Make a Wonderful Gift!
text:
[[VIDEOID:3a14e2c52be8b4865d26a9367f7353e6]] [[VIDEOID:89b1a8576e42e4e483e4aa86f413964b]] My daughter is obsessed with bath bombs! She has purchased some in the last few months. She has also attempted to make her own, which didn't work out as well as she had hoped. She was absolutely thrilled when this arrived recently. The box is sturdy and very professional looking. There are 2 layers of bath bombs separated by crinkled basket filler. One bath bomb fits perfectly in the palm of my hand. Each bomb is wrapped in a layer of colored tissue paper and underneath that, they are shrink wrapped in plastic to protect them from moisture. The bombs fizz as they dissolve in the water. There are some dried flowers inside that float in the tub after they've emerged from the bath bomb. They create a lovely fragrant bath experience. It leaves your skin soft and fragrant, too. It doesn't take very long for a bath bomb to dissolve. It took about 2 minutes for the first one we used to be completely dissolved. These are a very nice quality and provide a spa-like bathing environment!

*I purchased this at a reduced price for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Holds A Lot of Nail Polish!
text: My daughter got an Amazon gift card for Christmas and wanted this to organize her nail polish. It arrived much quicker than expected which is always a plus. It did come with screws, but my husband said they wouldn't be adequate. We installed it on her bathroom wall, so he used some wall anchors and heavier screws. He said if he was installing it on wood, he could have used the screws that came with it, but they weren't strong enough to hold it onto the wall. The acrylic is not particularly strong and he was worried about screwing it in too tightly & cracking it, but it worked out fine. My daughter is very happy with this and her nail polish is well organized and visible now.

title: Strangely Satisfying!
text:
My sister suggested that I get an acne/blackhead remover tool kit and I'm glad I did! I am in my late 40's and still deal with acne and blackheads. I was amazed at how well it worked on my blackheads. It was strangely satisfying to remove them with these tools! The tools are made of a sturdy stainless steel and look very professional. I love that they come in a zippered storage bag! It did not come with any instructions, so I had to do some research online to learn how to use them. Other reviewers have mentioned receiving a PDF, but I have not received one yet. I even made sure to check my spam folder just in case. I will probably need to order another set because my teenage daughter has claimed this one as hers.

*I received this for free for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Leaves Skin Soft!
text:
I am in my late 40's and have been using anti-aging products for the past few years. This is my first experience with Marula Oil. The first time I used it, I applied several (4 or 5 drops) to my face. The smell was a bit overwhelming to me. It's not a foul smell, it's just a strong earthy smell. Ever since then, I have tried to limit it to just 1 or 2 drops at a time which is plenty. One drop can cover the backs of both of my hands easily. The oil absorbs pretty quickly and does not leave my hands feeling oily. I've been using it both on my hands and my face. It leaves my skin feeling super soft! I can't notice much difference in my facial skin yet, but the skin on the back of my hands is looking much smoother.

*I purchased this at a reduced price for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Good, Complete Set
text:
This is a good, complete men's grooming set. I would say that these are a mid-range quality. They are better than what you would find at the dollar store, but not the super high quality you might get at a high end department store either. I plan to put this in my teenage son's Christmas stocking. It comes in a box with a window in so you can see everything. I have taken it all out and put it inside the storage bag for my son's stocking. The nail scissors, clippers and shoe horn are made of stainless steel. The comb is a simple, plastic one. It reminds me of what you used to get from school on picture day. The nail brush is also plastic.

*I received this for free for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great Stocking Stuffer!
text:
This is an awesome tweezers set! It comes in a cute, shiny silver zippered case. There are 2 different tweezers - a slanted tip pair and an ultra fine precision pair. Both pairs are made from stainless steel and are sturdy & strong. It also comes with an eyebrow comb/brush. I plan to use this as a stocking stuffer for my teenage daughter so she won't need to borrow my tweezers any more.

*I received these for free for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: My New Favorite Blush!
text: This is my new favorite blush! My skin is pretty fair - not ivory, but on the light side. I was afraid this would be too bright, but it's not at all. So far I have been applying it with my finger tips because I haven't figure out what kind of brush I want to use. It's really unique. It feels like a solid cream but when you put it on, it becomes powdery. The shade is like a natural blush color. I've only been using this for a few days now, but so far it's been lasting all day.

title: Easy to Use, Great Color!
text: I really like the color and for the price, it's a great value. It blends easily. It did break the very first time I used it. The whole stick broke off. I still use it, but I haven't be careful because it's loose now.

title: Great Mineral Powder Foundation!
text: I've been using Bare Minerals for years. I usually go through at least 3 jars a year. I recently ran out & wasn't in a financial position to purchase a new jar. So I looked into alternatives & chose this one. And to be totally honest, I can't really tell any difference between the two brands. This one covers well without looking too powdery. It doesn't irritate my skin. I actually prefer the little plastic cover that goes over the sifter because it keeps the powder from spilling out in transit. I hated taking my Bare Minerals on vacation and then opening it up to discover all the powder was now in the lid. I am very pleased with this affordable mineral powder foundation!

title: Love Love Love the Color!
text: I have been looking for a blush to replace my Too Faced blush that I recently broke. I was a little skeptical at first because it was pretty inexpensive, but I have been proved wrong. The color is a beautiful peachy color. You don't have to apply a lot for nice coverage. I use an angled brush with this rather than the small one that comes with it. The color is nicely pigmented and lasts all day. The compact fits easily into my hands without slipping - this was my major complaint with my Too Faced blush. I am very happy to have discovered this brand and product!

title: Beginning to See Some Firming!
text:
I've been using this cellulite cream for about 2 weeks. I am not seeing any drastic changes to my dimpled thighs, but I think I am starting to see some firming in that area. The cream absorbs quickly into my skin and it does a nice job of moisturizing. I have been applying it after my morning shower. It has a citrusy smell that smells more like citric acid as opposed to a fruity citrus scent. I will update my review after continued use.

*I received this for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great Quality!
text:
Thisi s a lovely set of makeup brushes! Not only are they beautiful, they also work well. The hair is super soft. I've been using these for about a week now and I have not had any issues with the hairs coming off the brush. I use mineral foundation and the powder loads well onto the brush and it gives a pretty good coverage. There are no fine tip brushes that you might use for eyeliner or other details. It comes with a card that explains what each brush is to be used for, but it would have been wonderful if that info was imprinted onto the handles. My Bare Mineral brushes are labeled and that saves a lot of time. I've ordered inexpensive brush sets before and these are definitely higher quality. One set that I ordered had 3 broken brushes when it arrived. I had to reglue them which was an inconvenience. These are nice & tight. The plastic handles are surprisingly nice, too. I have had some wooden handles that got damaged when washing them, so that is one less thing you have to worry about. These are a great addition to my cosmetics!

*I purchased these at a discounted price for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Love the Color, Not Pleased with the Compact
text: I purchased my Too Faced blush as a beauty splurge after going back to work. I absolutely love the color (Love Hangover) and the actual blush. I found the compact to be cute at first, but the shape of it is not particularly easy to hold and open. I am not usually a clumsy person. But the shape of this product does not fit naturally into your hands. After a couple of weeks, it slipped out of my hands. About half of the blush broke & fell out. I was thankful to have been able to save the rest of it. Then a few weeks later, it slipped out my hand again and this time, it's now just a bunch of crumbled, broken pieces. I think the product is good, but the design of the case needs to be reworked.

title: Different From Other Hyaluronic Acid Serums!
text:
First of all, I love that this is alcohol free, paraben free, fragrance free and not tested on animals!! I have used other hyaluronic acid serums, but this one is definitely different.
