The directions say to either use it on moist skin or to add water to it. I add a pump or two to my hand, then I add some water. I rub it together to combine, then I apply to my face. It absorbs really quickly and leaves my skin feeling super soft. It doesn't leave any stickiness behind on my fingers or my face. There is a slight citrusy smell to the serum which is probably from the ingredients.I have not had issues with stinging or burning. It also doesn't have any problems with the acne product I am using. Anti-aging products have been a regular part of my beauty routine for the last few years, so that, along with the fact that I've only been using this serum for almost 2 weeks, I'm not sure if I am seeing new results, but I do seem to be getting a continuation of the results. I will update my review if necessary after continued use.

*I purchased this at a reduced price for the purpose of trying out and reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: A Great, Complete Set!
text:
I ordered this shaving set for my husband and I am very pleased with it. He started using a shaving brush & solid shaving soap a few months ago & has really enjoyed it. Plus, in the long run, he's using a lot less compared to shaving gel cans. The badger hair brush has a solid chrome base. The badger hair bristles are full and secure. We do not notice any unusual smells from the bristles. The shaving soap is a brand that my husband has used before and like. The scent if Bayrum which is a little old-fashioned in my opinion, but goes well with this old-fashioned set. My husband has never used a safety razor before. There were no instructions included, but he was able to figure it out. He did end up with some cuts his first time or two using it, so it took him some time to figure out the learning curve on it. But now, it's second nature for him. The soap dish is solid, but not too heavy. Overall, this makes a great holiday gift!

*I purchased this shaving set at a discounted price for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Gift Set!
text:
What a great gift for the men in your life! This shaving gift set comes in a sturdy gift box. The chrome stand is heavy & classic. The badger hair brush fits perfectly. The safety razor is also heavy & durable. The text so if you have never used an old fashioned safety razor, that may give you a little trouble. This gift set is on par with the holiday gift sets you would find at a high end department store before Christmas.

*I purchased this gift set at a reduced price for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Surprisingly Soft on My Skin!
text:
This is a 3-pack of vegetable fiber puffs. Prior to ordering this, I had never heard of Konjac sponges. I really like the fact that they are eco-friendly and 100% biodegradable. They arrived individually wrapped in plastic wrap and in a small tube container. The interior of the plastic bag had visible moisture which I wasn't expecting. I thought it might have an off smell or something, but it didn't. Because the sponge was already moist, I made sure to thoroughly rinse in in water before using. These sponges are pretty small - about the size of a young child's palm of his/her hand. I gave one to my 14 year old daughter to use & I took one for my own use. My daughter absolutely loves it! I am a fan of it, too. It wasn't anything like we expected. Because of the fiber material, we expected more of an exfoliating experience, but instead it's super soft on your skin. So far we have been using it with just water, no products and have been pleased with the results. Our skin feels soft & clean! I haven't noticed any difference with acne. It says that the sponges kill acne causing bacteria. It also says that it balances your pH levels which I really can't measure either. But as far a tool for cleaning your face, it is doing a very good job.

*I received these for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Definitely a Luxury Beauty Product!
text:
I love to try out new anti-aging products. And since I am in my late 40's, these products have become part of my regular skincare routine. These eye pads were really fun to try! The gel eye pads feel cool against the skin. It is a refreshing sensation. I have had to play around with where I put these. If I am too close to my eye, then it annoys my lower lashes. I have super sensitive eyes and on one occasion, it did sting my eye. It wasn't particularly close to my eye when it was irritated. The other times I have used it, I haven't had that problem. I tend to sleep on my stomach/side and have found that they won't stay put all night. My husband suggested that I wear a sleeping mask over them and that did a great job of keeping them in place. Since I have been using anti-aging products regularly, I am not noticing much difference in the appearance of lines around my eyes, but the skin is noticeably softer in that area. And on the mornings when I have worn these all night, the skin around my eyes looks fresher.

*I received these for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Best Results on My Upper Chest/Neck Area!!!
text:
I LOVE LOVE LOVE this cream!! I have had the opportunity to try several different InstaNatural products recently and this one is by far my favorite! I am a teacher and I have suffered skin damage on my upper chest area from not wearing sunscreen at recess time. Recess is only 15 minutes, so I never thought to apply some sunscreen. I always put sunscreen if I am going to be at the pool or out all day, but for the short recess time it never occurred to me to use it. I tend to wear a lot of V-Neck shirts that expose the skin of the upper chest area. The skin in that area has looked much older than the rest of me. I'm in my late 40's, but my lower neck area/upper chest area has looked much older. It had kind of a pebbly appearance. I have only been using this product for close to 2 weeks, but I started seeing results after just a few days. The skin on my chest area is super smooth now. You can still see some of the pebbly appearance, but it has diminished immensely. I am simply amazed by the results. I have been using this after my morning shower & again before bedtime. The orange color threw me off the first time I used it. It is a bright orange color. It smells incredible - a fresh citrus scent. It absorbs easily into the skin and does not leave any stickiness or greasiness behind. I will definitely be ordering this again.

*I did receive this for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Like the Results, But Not Crazy About the Application Method
text:
This is definitely a unique acne spot treatment. I do like the list of ingredients that goes into making this. I am in my late 40's and still have to deal with acne. This does clear up my acne quickly.I have not had any issues with skin sensitivity with this product. Nor has it caused any excessive drying of my skin. The bottle says that there is cucumber fragrance, but all I can smell is the Isopropyl Alcohol. I am not a fan of the application method. Regular cotton swabs can't reach the bottom of the bottle. I am glad to see an expiration date on the product and it is easy to find, too! I have found that it's best to apply a nighttime. When it dries, it turns white, so when I've used it in the morning, I've had to deal with white spots.

*I was provided with this acne spot treatment for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great Carrier Oil!
text: I have been dabbling in the world of Essential Oils for a few months now & wanted to try a new carrier oil. Prior to purchasing this sweet almond oil, I had been using fractionated coconut oil as a carrier oil. It doesn't really have much of a smell, which is important to me because I want to smell the Essential Oils not the carrier oil! When comparing it to my coconut oil, I don't really notice much difference regarding the absorption rate or moisturizing effects. This oil was actually more affordable than the coconut oil I've been using. I'm pretty excited to have a choice now when I want to use my oils!

title: Adequate for Personal Use
text: I ordered these containers to store some shea butter cream that I wanted to make. These containers look a lot like ones that high end skin products come in, but they are lighter weight & not as sturdy. They are more than adequate for my own personal use, however, I would not use these if I were selling or gifting my home made creams.

title: Mild, Masculine Scent
text: My husband started using shaving soap a few months ago. When he ran out, I ordered the Colonel Conk Bay Rum soap to replace what he had. It's  small, but it's lasted over a month so far. It lathers nicely and has a mild masculine scent. It doesn't dry out his skin either. He doesn't like it as much as the other one that he used, but considers it to be good.

title: Happy to Have Found a New & Effective Foot Lotion!
text: I purchase a lot of foot lotions and this one is a great one! I can't sleep if my feet are dry & cracked, so applying foot lotion is part of my nightly routine. I found this one at a discount store for a great price & decided to give it a try. This one is tea tree oil & mint. I usually prefer strong peppermint lotions, but the combination of the tee tree and the mint (although mild) is surprisingly refreshing. I massage it in for about a minute or two and afterwards my feet are extremely happy! I've just started becoming aware of parabens and appreciate that this is a paraben free product. The scent is pretty mild, but pleasant. I will definitely be purchasing this lotion again.

title: Great Primer!
text: I ordered this for my teen daughter as a primer. We haven't noticed much difference with the appearance of her pores, but as a primer, she's very pleased with it. It feels a lot like the more expensive primers that I use.

title: My Eyeshadow Stays On Longer, But Not as Long as I Would Prefer.
text: This is a decent eyeshadow primer for the price. It's easy to apply on my eyelids. Eyeshadow stays put longer than without any primer, but I find that it still doesn't last all day. I would estimate that it lasts up to 5 or 6 hours, but by the time I get home from work, you can barely tell that I have any eyeshadow on at all. I will continue to use this, but I will also keep searching for a better primer.

title: Amazing Product!!! Love IT!!!!
text: I absolutely LOVE the Eye Bright Kit by Pixi! It has become one of my favorite make up items!!! I went back to work this year and my eyes have definitely been looking tired lately.  Prior to purchasing it, I did watch the video made by the Pixi company about how to use the kit. Without it, I think I would have been totally clueless on how to use it, although there are some instructions on the box.  I use a thin make up brush to apply the light green into the corners of my eyes, then pat the green gently with my finger tip if needed. It makes my eyes look brighter instantly. I only use the concealer colors as needed, not on a daily basis. Same with the highlighter. The colors are a creamy consistency and blend easily. I've been using it for about a month now and I have barely made a dent in it. It is definitely one of my must have beauty items now!!!

title: Lasts Long, but Sticky.
text: My favorite lip gloss was discontinued a few years ago and I have been searching ever since for a new favorite. I ordered the Everlasting Blossom shade which was a little lighter than I expected, but not too bad. It stays on for a while, but it feels sticky. And since it lasts a while, so does the stickiness. I was pleased that it lasted as long as it did, but I really didn't like the stickiness. It does have to be reapplied, but not as often as some lip products. It has a very pleasant scent - a mild fruity one.

title: Long Lasting Color!
text: My favorite lip gloss was discontinued a couple of years ago and I have been on the search for a new favorite. I ordered the Istanbul shade, but it ended up being darker and more pink than the picture. I was wanting a lighter, peachy color, but it's a "pink" pink. As far as the product, it glides easily onto lips. It feels like a moist lipstick if that makes any sense. It reminds me of a lip stain. I personally was looking for more of lip gloss type  product. Since the color is a little darker than I wanted, I let it dry a bit, then I blot and add lip gloss. The color does last a long time. It has a nice smell. Overall, it's pretty good, just not what I was looking for in a lip product.

title: Absorbs More Water = Less Time Using Hair Dryer!
text:
I am a fan of microfiber towels for cleaning, but I have never used them on my hair. So when I was asked to try one out, I was intrigued. The towel is not much larger than a hand towel. I have thick, shoulder length hair and upon seeing this towel, I had some doubts that it would even fit around my head. However, much to my surprise, it did fit! I was able to wrap my hair into a turban. I couldn't tuck it into place, but I have some alligator styling clips on hand and was able to secure it in place with one clip. Microfiber towels are pretty thin, but this towel did an amazing job of absorbing the majority of the water that was left in my hair. I left the towel on for just 5 minutes or so, but when I took it off, I could immediately tell the difference compared to a regular towel. My hair was damp, but significantly drier than usual. As far as the black dye issue that I noticed in some of the other reviews, I must share my experience. I did not bother to wash the towel prior to using. I wasn't wearing my reading glasses at the time & could not read the instructions. So I used it without washing. I did not have any issues with black dye at all. Then after learning about those instructions, I took my towel and rinsed it in cold water. There was a little grayish color in the water, but no black water as described by some others. I have since washed it in the machine & took care to wash it with similar colored items & still no problems at all.

*I received one Salon Towel directly from the Salon Guys for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Excellent Quality!
text:
My teenage daughter has long thick hair & these clips are perfect for her to section her hair when she is curling or straightening it. They are sturdy & easy to use. These are definitely a high quality, professional hair clip. They keep the hair in place without slipping. There are little bumps inside to help grip the hair and keep it in place. My daughter is thrilled with these clips!

*I received these clips directly from the Salon Guys for the purpose of trying them out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Works Great on Wet Hair!
text:
I have thick, coarse hair and appreciate a good detangling brush. The Hair Tamer Ergo Detangling brush does a great job of getting the tangles out of wet hair! I wish this brush had been around when I was a child! The brush is easy to hold and effortlessly goes through wet hair. When looking at the bristles, they vary in two different sizes. The bristles are made out of a flexible plastic type material. As far as going through dry hair, it feels a bit rough. It doesn't hurt, but the bristles seem to scrape my scalp a little.

*I was provided with a Hair Tamer Ergo Detangling Brush directly from the Salon Guys for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great Pressed Powder!
text: I usually use loose powder, but was looking for for a pressed powder compact for less mess when traveling or on the go. I use it with my own brush instead of the small one that came with it. It doesn't take much to load the brush, so if I'm not careful, I get too much. The coverage is natural and looks great!

title: Decent Peppermint Foot Lotion for the Price!
text: Applying peppermint foot lotion to my feet is practically a daily thing for me. Between seasonally dry feet & being on my feet a lot during the day, this has become a part of my bedtime routine. I have tried many different brands of peppermint foot lotion over the years. This lotion is thick & creamy and has a light peppermint scent. I really like that there are lots of natural ingredients in it and that it's not tested on animals. The lotion does do a decent job of soothing tired feet. I would say it's better than a lot of the similar products out there. I personally like a stronger peppermint presence and one that leaves my feet tingling more than this one. However, for the price, I am pretty pleased. And because I go through so much peppermint foot lotion, I would definitely repurchase this one. Others in the same price range are not as good.

title: Great Palette for Natural Looking Eyes!
text: I purchased this palette for my 14 year old daughter this summer at a local store. I actually loved it so much, that I purchased one for myself a few weeks later. I am in my late 40's and I want my eyes to look pretty natural. Same with my daughter. The colors in this palette fit the bill. They aren't super pigmented, but at the same time, you don't have to apply a whole lot to see it. They do shimmer a bit, but it's not overwhelming. I wear these colors for daytime use and I am very happy with how it looks. I have noticed that it's still there at the end of the day when I get home from work. That rarely happens to me with eye shadow. It comes with some sponge applicators, but I prefer using brushes to apply it. I am extremely happy with this!

title: Great Facial Mask for Tweens & Teens!
text: My teenage daughter loves to do facials at her sleepovers, so I ordered this for her. I have lots of fond memories of using the cucumber peel off masks when I was her age. We used to challenge ourselves to try and peel it off in one piece. You have to wait until it is completely dry to do so. The formula seems pretty gentle and leaves no redness. It has a light, clean scent.

title: Love this Facial Mask!
text: I love trying different skin care products, so when the ATAL Clay Facial mask was available through a recent promotion, I was more than happy to give it a try. First of all, it comes in an elegant looking jar packed inside a nice box. It comes with a little scoop so you don't have to waste any of the product by getting it on your hands. The consistency is similar to children's finger paint and the color looks like Army Green. It has an earthy scent with a tinge of mint. The first time I used it, my teen daughter joined me for the facial. It didn't take much to cover our faces which means it should last a while. It was dry within 10 minutes, but we left it on for 15 minutes. My daughter said it slightly burned, but what I felt was more of a tingling sensation. It came off easily with warm water & a wash cloth. Our faces were left nice & clean. We had no redness which happens from some facial masks. My skin felt a little tighter after the use. I have used it a couple of times since then. I have not noticed any difference with my adult acne, but my skin feels smoother & looks great! I will continue to indulge my skin with this facial mask!

title: Great Deal for Tweezerman!
text: It's taken several years, but I've stopped purchasing the cheap nail clippers that are available at the drug store. They never last long and often fall apart before too long. It's one of those "you get what you pay for" items. Although I have never purchased Tweezerman brand items before, I am familiar with their products and their reputation. So when I was recently looking for some new nail clippers, I found this set and was actually surprised that the price tag was reasonable. They are sturdy & strong. They cut easily, too. Just holding them in your hands, you can tell that they are a quality product. My husband was very pleased with them, too. I promise never to go back to the cheap nail clippers again!

title: 3 Different Types for a Variety of Tweezing Needs!
text: My husband is a magnet for splinters! Prior to this purchase, I had one really nice set of tweezers that I kept in my bathroom. Of course, he doesn't get splinters upstairs! So whenever I hear him say "Honey, can you help me get a splinter out?" I have to run up 2 or 3 flights of stairs depending on where he's located. So when I was given the opportunity to purchase this set at a reduced price in order to try it out & give my feedback, I was more than happy to do so! These tweezers are nice & heavy duty. They have a good, solid feel to them. The tips all seem to meet up well which is very important! There are 3 different types for a variety of tweezing needs. The pointed one is great for splinter removal! I've had some tweezers that have more of a needle-like point, but these are more than adequate for removing most splinters. The storage case is a nice bonus.

title: Decent for the Price, but Disappointed that Some Brushes were Broken.
text: After purchasing a set of brushes that were too small for my needs, I decided to try these out. These were not too small, but I was very disappointed with the quality. Three of my brushes were not attached to their handles. I was able to glue them back together, but I should not have to do that. The brushes are very soft & so far I have not noticed much shedding. I really like the color of the white & pink bristles. The storage bag is very nice and sturdy. As far as performance, the brushes are decent, especially for the price. I've had better and I've had worse. My biggest issue or complaint is that some of the brushes were broken as I detailed above.

title: Great Set of Brushes for Teens!
text: I was looking for a nice set of make up brushes that I could take with me on a recent trip. When I got them, my first thought was that they were too small. The bristles are nice & soft and all of the brushes were sturdy & well made. The colors are fun, too.  Since they didn't meet my needs,  I decided to give them to my 13 year old daughter who had been wanting some make up brushes. She absolutely LOVES them! She uses them all the time now. I use make up brushes to apply my mineral foundation, blush, powder, and eye shadows. The larger brushes just weren't large enough for my needs. But just because they didn't work for me doesn't mean that they aren't good brushes.

title: Love the List of Ingredients!
text: It seems like my husband runs out of shaving gel pretty frequently, so when I had the opportunity to purchase this at a discount during a promotional period, I was happy to give it a try. After using this shave cream & lather for over a week, my husband has hardly made a dent in it. It looks like this is going to last a lot longer than the shaving gel. Another plus is the ingredient list - aloe, coconut oil, chamomile and more. It has a very light, pleasant scent that is fairly gender neutral. He uses it with a brush and it doesn't take much to lather. It's very gentle on his face & leaves his skin nice & smooth. I'm enjoying being a spectator to his shaving ritual now!

title: Part of My Daily Beauty Routine!
text: Rosehip Oil has been part of my daily beauty routine for several months now. I primarily use it on a burn scar on the back of my hand, but I also like to rub it into my cuticles and nails as well. My previous bottle was running low, so I needed to purchase some more. I came across a coupon for this one, so I decided to give the Better Shea Butter brand a try. The oil is a golden color & does have a mild scent. It reminds me of olive oil.  As far as Rosehip oils go, I'm pleased with it. The last one I used had a much stronger scent & a darkish orange color, so I like this better. I use a drop or two on my scar at least 2 or 3 times a day. It rubs in easily & does not leave any greasiness behind.  It leaves my hand feeling surprisingly soft and since it moisturizes, too, the skin on the back of my hand is looking younger. I've had to start using it on my other hand to keep them more consistent. It gives my fingernails a nice, natural shine. Over the course of several months, my burn scar has diminished. It's still visible, but has definitely lightened up quite a bit.

title: Great for Sensitive Eyes!
text: I have been a fan of the Atal Anti-Aging Serum for a while now, so I was very excited to be able to try their Eye Serum during a promotional period. The product is beautifully packaged and looks like something you would find at a high end beauty store. The serum has a light, neutral scent. It is non-greasy and absorbs quickly into the skin. The pump is easy to control with the amount of pressure you apply, so you can limit the amount of product you dispense since it doesn't take very much for each use. My eyes are very sensitive to skin care products and cosmetics. In recent years, my eyes will often water a lot & then when I rub them, any products that I have been using sometimes gets into my eyes. It's only a big deal if the product causes my eyes to sting. The Atal Eye Serum does not sting my eyes at all! I've only been using this for a couple of weeks. I don't usually have puffiness or dark circles around my eyes, but I do have plenty of fine lines. Since using this serum, I am beginning to notice the diminishing of those fine lines. I will update my review later if necessary.

title: Nice Mint Scent & Slight Tingling
text: I cannot sleep well at night if my feet are hot, rough or dry. Peppermint foot lotions are a MUST for me. This one does a pretty good job. The mint scent is nice and it does leave a slight tingling feel. It's not greasy & absorbs well. It does a good job of cooling down my feet. My favorite preferred foot lotion is Burt's Bees, but this is a decent alternative. I especially like that this comes in a generous size. I dislike it when all you get is a small tube or bottle!

title: We are very happy with our new hair brushes!
text: When I was a child, I had a terrible time with tangles or "rats' nests" as my mom used to call them. Because of this, I try everything possible so my daughter doesn't have the same troubles. The Ezzy Glide brush is awesome! It's the closest thing I've found to "The Wet Brush" that our hairdresser recommended to us, but not as expensive. My daughter loves how easy it goes through her hair! She has a tender scalp & has been very pleased with how gentle it is. Since this set came with 2 hair brushes, I decided to use one, too. To me, a brush was just a brush. I've been using a plain vent brush for years & thought it was adequate. I am surprised at how better this is. My hair is very thick and it really seems to make my hair softer and shinier. The vent brush actually pulls on my hair & feels much rougher than my new brush. We are very happy with our new hair brushes!

title: Great Variety of Nude Eye Shadow Shades!
text: My young teen daughter has been wanting the Urban Decay Naked eye palette for several months now. I purchased this as an alternative for her. It contains a great variety of nude/natural eye shadows. The case is adorable. I love the black lace and blush ribbon. The lid is magnetic so it stays closed when you want it to. The palette is very small & easy to fit in your purse if you need it to. I had seen it in the stores on several occasions, so I knew what to expect. Maybe when my daughter starts earning her own money, she can purchase the larger Urban Decay palette herself. But until then, this set is perfect for her.

title: Does not Sting my eyes!
text: I have super sensitive eyes. I have used several different products for the eye area that have either rubbed into my eye later in the day or "sweated" into my eyes because of the heat & have all stung my eyes. Because of that, I usually don't use eye repair products.  I am pleased to say that the Amara Organics Total Repair Eye Gel has not caused my eyes any pain! Yay!!! Of course, I am not putting it directly in my eyes, but I have purposefully rubbed my eyes a lot to see if there was any issues and there have not been. The lines around my eyes have started to fill in a bit since using it. There's a slight, natural scent that doesn't linger very long. The gel is nice & thick. It absorbs quickly into the skin and leaves no stickiness behind.

title: I LOVE this moisturizer!
text: I absolutely love this moisturizer! It has a light, pleasant scent. It absorbs quickly into my skin. It's not greasy or sticky. I use it with conjunction with some of the other Amara Organics products. In addition to my face, I have been applying it to the back of one of my hands and that's where I have been seeing the biggest difference. After applying it, the skin cells & pores look so much smaller. The skin on that hand is so soft. My left hand looks much younger than my right one. Now that I've seen the results, I will now use it on my other hand so they both look younger! Seeing the results on my hand make me confidant that I'm getting the same results on my facial skin.

title: Works well with the Amara Organics Advanced Age-Defying Moisturizer!
text: I love that this is a plant based product. It's very gentle on my skin. There's a pleasant, citrus scent which dissipates quickly. It is not greasy or sticky. I use this before I use the Amara Organics Advanced Age-Defying Moisturizer. The pump dispenses the perfect amount of serum for each use. My skin feels well moisturized and super soft. I have only been using this serum for a couple of weeks and will update my review later if necessary.

title: Love that it's made from Plant Based Products!
text: I have been using various Vitamin C serums for several months and have been pleased with the results. I was drawn to this serum because of its plant based ingredients. I have only been using this for a couple of weeks, but as far as serums go, I am very happy with it. First of all, the other Vitamin C serums I have used are all a golden/orange/brown type color. The color disappears when you rub it into your skin, but after a while, I noticed that my white pillowcases had orangish/brown marks where my face touched the pillow. The color washed out in the laundry, but it was weird seeing the color end up on my pillows. This serum is clear so this hasn't been an issue at all. Yay! This serum is fragrance free. One of the other serums that I used smelled like infant's liquid vitamins. Another thing is that this serum does not sting. The other ones would sting my face on areas where I had acne or small cuts. Since I have been using Vitamin C serums regularly for a while, I have not noticed any changes in my skin with the use of this serum, so it seems to be working just as well. My skin continues to be super soft!

title: No More Tangles!
text: When I was in elementary &  middle school, I remember having to sit on the floor in front of the couch while my mother tried to work on the tangles in my hair. It was a long & painful experience. I've always been proactive with my daughter and her hair so she didn't have to go through the same thing, but she would still gets tangles. Since using a detangling brush, she hasn't had any tangles. The brush does a wonderful, pain free job of getting rid of tangles! I so wish they had these brushes back when I was young! I ordered this set mainly for the detangling brush, so the nylon hair brush is kind of a bonus to me. It's a nice, solid, basic hair brush.

title: This brush is a great deal at the 50% off price!
text: This brush is a great deal at the 50% off price! The bristles are soft & dense and so far there has been no shedding. I've been using it with my Bare Minerals make-up, and have been very pleased with it. The brush loads well with the make up powder and blends nicely.

title: I LOVE the ATAL Age Defying Face Serum!
text: I LOVE the ATAL Age Defying Face Serum! I was first impressed with the bottle & packaging. The product looks like something you would get from a high end department store. It has a very light, almost citrusy scent. The serum is more like a cream or thick lotion. It absorbs quickly into the skin & does not leave any greasiness behind. I have been using this twice a day for about 3 weeks now. I use one pump per application & it looks like I've used just about a third of the bottle in the 3 weeks.  I am 46 and have been unhappy with the texture of my skin for a while. My skin has never looked better. My face is not only super soft, but very smooth, too. During this 3 week period, I decided to put apply some serum to the back of one of my hands so I could see the results when compared to my other hand. The biggest difference is that the hand that had the serum has smaller pores and much fewer lines. It really is amazing to see the results!

title: The Natural Bristels are Nice & Soft!
text: I have been using this brush for about a week. I was a little concerned with how well the wood would hold up in the shower, but so far, I have not seen any signs indicating that it would not last. It's a nice length & is easy to get to those hard to reach areas. The natural bristles are nicer & softer than plastic bristles. It's easy to separate the handle from the brush when you need to. I have had the brush head come off the handle on 2 different occasions, but I think that was due to my error, not the brush. When you are putting the brush head back on, you need to make sure to slide it in all the way tightly. When I put it in securely, I have not had any problems with the head falling off.

title: I am genuinely surprised at how much I like this!
text:
I am genuinely surprised at how much I like this! Recently I have noticed that the eyelashes on my left eye are not as long as the ones on my right eye. I used to use a high end $30 mascara to get longer lashes, but it was getting too expensive to continue. I got these fiber lashes for half the price & they do an even better job of lengthening my eyelashes. It really seemed weird putting these on for the first time. You put your regular mascara on, then you apply the fibers, then a second coat of mascara. The fibers are white & like stretched cotton. They don't seem to last all day, but they don't smear either -both of those could be related to the mascara though and not the fibers. When I apply them in the morning, I can barely tell that I have them on when I'm getting ready for bed.

*Update - I have really liked these a lot. I just ordered another bottle. Before I ordered, I looked at some of the other products out there and most of the fiber ones came with a separate gel too. But what was disturbing is that there were lots of reviews about how people were losing some of their lashes with it. I have NEVER had any troubles with that with the Pro-Lash ones. I'm a happy repeat customer!

title: My Absolute Favorite Foot Lotion!!
text: Burt's Bees Peppermint Foot Lotion is my absolute favorite foot lotion of all! I have tried many different brands of peppermint foot lotion & I keep going back to this one. This may sound weird, but if my feet are dry & tired, I have difficulties sleeping at night. Many foot lotions only moisturize your feet and I find that I have to apply more lotion thirty minutes later because my feet are still tired.  This one really goes beyond that and soothes the feet. The peppermint oil & menthol leave a pleasant tingling sensation as well as a nice scent. It leaves my feet feeling refreshed. Unfortunately, I have had difficulties finding this in the stores lately. I really hope it hasn't been discontinued. I am thrilled to find that it's available on Amazon! The only other foot lotion that I've liked as much as this one is The Body Shoppe's peppermint foot lotion which is a bit more expensive.

title: Finally, a high quality bath pillow!
text: I've had a couple of inflatable bath pillows in the past and they've never really lasted. This one is different. It's made out of waterproof foam. It reminds me of the solid foam stress balls that you get from a vendor fair. It is nicely contoured & offers nice support to your neck & head. The suction cups grip the tub well.  I've used it in my garden tub & plan to try it in my hot tub, too. This would be an excellent gift.

title: Smells nice, but not very strong
text: The smell is nice, but not very strong. I've used it 3 times so far. The first time I used one cap full & I didn't notice the scent at all. So the next time I used 2 caps full. I could smell it, but it was weak. The 3rd time I used 3 caps full and it was better, but still not as strong as I would like it to be. I will probably continue to use 3 caps full for future uses. I have not noticed any residue or build up in the hot tub after using it. My husband isn't a big fan of scents, especially strong ones, so I was afraid that the fragrance might linger around for a while, but it does not. It's not an overpowering smell, so it did not bother him.

title: Massages Well
text: This is the 2nd cellulite massager brush that I have owned. The biggest difference between the two of them is that this one has flexible brushes and I really like that. They "wiggle" whereas the other one that I owned the brushes were stationary. My other massager was a "gift with purchase" and seems to be cheaply made. This one is higher quality. I've been using this for about a week now, mainly on my thighs. It has become part of my evening routine. I use it with some body lotion & it massages very well. I usually have to reapply lotion at least one more time during my massage. I have used it without lotion & it does okay, it's just better with the lotion. Plus, my skin is getting hydrated. The directions say you need to use it for 5-10 minutes for best results. To be honest, I usually stop after about 5 minutes because my arms get tired. Though I guess you can say that my arms are getting the benefit from the extra exercise! Sometimes I think I can see some improved firmness in my thighs and other times I'm not sure. I will definitely update my review after extended use.

title: Solid, High Quality Nail Clippers
text: I have never spent more than a few dollars on a pair of nail clippers. Usually I get just the cheapest one I can find at the drug store. And of course, after a few months of use, those cheap clippers break. I have never been so impressed with a pair of nail clippers before! They are a solid, high quality stainless steel product. They just feel better than the ones I usually use. I love the gripper ridges that help with leverage. The catchall is a plus! I had a little difficulties with the catchall at first. You have to slide it up under the screw firmly in place, but once it's in place, it does an excellent job of catching all the clippings. text: OK I’m gonna leave my review I’ve never used  this before myself but during quarantine my hairstylist has been in and out of the shop and I had to get these extensions out of my head they were driving me insane.  I read the other reviews and I am thinking to myself they must’ve of done this incorrectly because I had zero problems And anyone can do this and it will work for anyone’s type of hair it’s the ingredients in this bottle that will get the glue out of anyone’s hair, this is what I did that made it very easy by the time I was done I was a pro. Saturate the tape really really well with the tip of the needle on the bottle it comes with, take your index finger and your thumb and move them back-and-forth together to get The liquid in there &  rub the tape against each other then once it starts sliding you’ll know you have a good amount in then if you need to put a little bit more in it’s fine you don’t want to pull your hair out so really saturate the tape let it start to work give it’s about 30 Sec to start to feel the glue getting sticky so just get the tape nice and wet you can either slide down or pull one piece of tape off one at a time, this small bottle goes a long ways I had 19 pieces of extensions in my head and I still have some solution left in my bottle. Now afterwards you’re gonna have a sticky sticky head, if you want to get Aegean oil put that in your head before you wash your hair put a few drops around your scalp and kind of rub it in then go ahead and wash your hair with shampoo then condition & comb it through with the conditioner in it then oil, wash & condition one more time then you should be good to go❤️

title: New label AND new formulation
text:
This product "Medline Remedy Phytoplex Hydrating Cleanser Shampoo & Body Wash Gel" is a replacement for the prior version of this product called "Medline Remedy with Phytoplex Hydrating Cleansing Gel". The SKU number and product number is identical for both. So if you reorder based on those numbers you don't know if you're getting the older version of the newer version.

Not only does the label look different now the ingredient list and formulation of the product is also different. Six ingredients are removed and eight new ingredients have been added. The new product definitely smells different it feels different it has a glossier texture and and lathers up more. Nowhere on the new label do you find the term "low sudsing" as was on the prior label.

While vanilla is still in the list of ingredients, the scent as best I can characterize is the scent of inflatable toys in a swimming pool (which fortunately doesn't linger on you after rinsing, and I prefer no lingering scent to the lingering vanilla of the prior product). But let's face it - for those of us with sensitive skin we select a body cleanser not for the scent but because it will not irritate our skin.

My main concern is, as with most consumers with sensitive skin, I don't know if I have a sensitivity to any of these new ingredients. The #3 ingredient of the prior product was Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate, replaced in the new product with Cocamidopropyl Bentaine, which I discovered was declared 2004 Allergen of the Year by the American Contact Dermatitis Society.

I wish Medline would have provided some explanation regarding the reformulation of this product.

On the advice of my hairdresser, I never used the same shampoo twice in a row. People who saw my bathroom said it was better stocked than a drugstore!

Now I shampoo only once a day, and I found that I love TRESemme shampoo. I can use it two or three times in a row, and I find that I keep going back to it. It makes my hair silky, shiny, and smooth every time I use it. No more shampooing twice a day! I will definitely buy this product again.

Try it. I would not mislead you. And the icing on the cake is that it is made in the USA, a definite plus!

After ten min I showered again and rinsed the soap off then used the mitt in an up and down motion to make the dead skin start peeling and I was quite shocked how much came off. It takes a bit of rubbing to get it going. I then showered off to rinse off all the dead skin and dried off and applied arcane oil over my body. title: Didn’t work for me
text: I love the idea of a clenditioner, but it left me a bit underwhelmed. From the reviews it sounds like it works great for some and not for others. For me it left the back of my head feeling greasy and weighed down. I followed the directions exactly as written. Maybe I needed to repeat the process or leave it in longer since my hair is on the slightly thicker side. My scalp also felt a bit itchy after. It smells really nice though.

title: Smells great
text: I have switched all my beauty and cleaning products to natural ones except my shampoo and conditioner. I love all the truly natural ingredients in this product. I love the lavender scent which smells natural and long lasting. My hair felt clean and not dried out after. I’m going to give this some more time to see how my hair likes it long term. I’m hoping it works out because it seems like a great product.

title: Pretty color
text: Nice sparkly nail polish that also strengthens nails. I usually buy Zoya or Essie brand nail polish because they have less harmful ingredients. But this one works great and is semi sheer with the first coat but covers the nail completely after a second coat. All the girls in the family like this color and polish.

title: Nice gloss
text: I have several of these lip glosses and so far my favorite color is sweetie, because it is nice and sheer, shimmery and shiny with just a touch of color. Daydream has a bit more pink color but is still pretty sheer and nice as well. These glosses are pretty good, a little sticky like lip gloss, but not bad.

title: Works great
text: Great conditioning hair mask. Easy to use. Pleasant scent. Leaves hair soft and moisturized and not greasy.

title: Great quality
text: I have always heard great things about Chi products and this flat iron does not disappoint. It is easy to use and it left my hair shiny and smooth. I like that it gets hot and stays hot but not over 400. Perfect temperature.

title: Excellent curling iron
text: Great curling iron. I was very skeptical that it would be any better than my $100 curling irons and wands, but it does do a better job in my opinion. It heats up fast and doesn’t get as hot as some of my other irons, but works even better. It is very consistent which I noticed in making great curls. I believe because it regulates the heat better. It also produces very soft feeling curls and waves. I prefer using it as a wand and just wrapping my hair around it instead of using the clip. My curls were still going strong after 3 days. It feels well made, is comfortable to use.

title: Great curling wand
text: This is a great curling iron. Heats up in seconds. Makes soft waves that are long lasting. What I noticed also was that it remained the same hot temperature the whole time and each curl was just as good as the first. It isn’t as hot as other curling irons out there that go up to over 400 but I didn’t feel like it needed to. The curls last over 3 days without hair spray. It is also extremely comfortable to use and hold. The barrel is like a flattened cylinder.

title: Sheer
text: This is a nice neutral sheer shade of lip gloss. It is adds a nice shine and shimmer to lips while moisturizing them. It has a bit of a sticky feel like most lip glosses do, but still a nice lip gloss.

title: Works great
text: Great sunblock. I prefer mineral sunblock and this seems to do a good job protecting skin. It is also easy to apply and runs in easily. Doesn’t make skin look white. Didn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Good brand

title: Granddaughter loves the color
text: Icicle is a great lip gloss color. It is very sheer but shiny and has some shimmer. My granddaughter loves it. It has a slight sweet taste and a bit of a sticky application but overall a good lipgloss

title: Works well
text: Nice lipgloss. Has a bit of the sticky lip gloss type feel. Perfection is a nice pink color that has a lot of color to it and isn’t very sheer. Has a subtle sweet taste. I prefer more natural glosses like Burt’s bees. But this seems to be decent quality.

title: Works well
text: I normally use a Tresemme brand heat protector spray and have been happy with it. This product works good to protect hair and make it shiny and control frizz. The scent is pleasant.

title: Great value
text: Seems comparible to Vaseline lotion. Works well to hydrate skin. Has a pleasant scent and is a great value.

title: High-end
text: Nice high-end electric shaver that delivers a nice smooth shave. Has a trimmer attachment. I get by with less expensive ones but this is a nice upgrade.

title: Works well with my skin and provides good protection
text: Great value pack of lotion sunscreen. I've used this for myself and on the kids. I usually get the spray on sunscreen but it always runs out so fast it's good to have lotion as a backup. Did a great job at the beach for 4-5 hours in the sun with only one application, and that was with going in the water a couple times. Very pleased with the protection performance.

title: Nice simple soap
text: Great unscented hand soap refills. One of the three bottles fills up about 3 of our smaller bathroom dispensers. It’s nice that there is no artificial colors or dyes. Cleans well as all other hand soaps I’ve tried.

title: Scent is nice.
text: There is a medium to heavy musk sent with this cologne. It lasts all day. One spray is more than enough, as it’s a more powerful sent. I like it but my wife likes it more, which I guess is kind of the point. I will use it casually to work or business engagements. I did have an issue taking the top off as the whole sprayer part came off with the lid. After a bit of work and some pliers I was able to get it back on. Over all pleased with it.

title: Works well
text: Good hairspray. Disperses well to give a good even hold that isn’t crunchy. Has a pleasant scent that isn’t overly masculine or feminine.

title: Works great
text: Great curling wand. Works great to hear fast and make nice waves and curls. I have a hard time telling a difference between high end and drugstore curling irons. This works just as well as more expensive ones. Makes long lasting waves.

title: Smells good
text: Great for all hair types. Feels like a leave-in conditioner. Smells good. Leaves hair soft, shiny and manageable.

title: Smells and works great
text: Smells great and leaves hair soft and shiny and hydrated. Absorbs quickly. Great for right out of the shower or after straightening. Nice large bottle.

title: Works well
text: Good for small areas that need coverage. Use sparingly and follow directions. Color matched my dark brown.

title: Nice curling iron
text: Great curling iron. Perfect curling iron. Heats fast. Makes nice long lasting waves and curls. Seems well made and durable.

title: Nice sunblock.
text: This is a nice sunscreen if you want to add shimmer to your body. It has a lot of sparkle to it. It rubs in easily and protects well from the sun. Pleasant mild scent. Not thick or greasy. My granddaughter loves the sparkle.

title: Works great
text: I’m glad to see all the harmful chemical sunscreens finally out of a lot of sunblocks. This is a good sunblock that goes on easily and provides protection from the sun. Absorbs quickly and works great.

title: Very bright and very long lasting
text: I thought this was a lipgloss and was very wrong. It is what it says it is, liquid lipstick. It is very bright purple, and very heavily pigmented and lasts an incredibly long time on lips. I have never heard of this brand so have no idea if it is a quality brand, but it gets the job done if you want a purple long lasting lipstick.

title: Works well
text: This works well to remove peach fuzz from face. Easy to operate and use and doesn't pull or cause any pain. Leaves skin soft and smooth.

title: Good razors
text: Good generic brand razor. Better quality than other generic brands I’ve tried like target and Walmart. We usually buy Mach 3 razors and have used them for a lot of years. Comes with 2 blade heads. They are a bit different than Mach 3 style, but I didn’t notice a difference in the quality of my shave. Seemed to work just as well.

title: Works great
text: Nice looking and small personal groomer. Comes with battery and works well to get rid of peach fuzz and trim other areas. No pulling and pain free.

title: Good sunblock
text: Good generic sunblock. Goes on easily and absorbs quickly. Provided protection from the sun while I was outside today. Has a very light scent. Skin also felt moisterized after which was nice. Seems comparable to name brands.

title: Works great for small amounts of gray
text: I don’t have enough greys to dye all my hair but enough that I’d like them to be covered up when my hair is pulled back on a ponytail and they are noticeable. This works perfect for me since I don’t have to commit to anything expensive or damaging to the rest of my hair. It goes in easily and even though my hair is dark brown the medium brown covered the grey great. I probably wouldn’t use it if I am planning to go swimming or be in the rain as I it seems it would run. It doesn’t dry stiff and I’m able to brush my hair after using it.

title: Works great
text: I normally make my own sunscreen with zinc, Shea butter, coconut oil and beeswax but like something premade every now and then and this seems to be a good gentle but effective sunscreen. It is easy to apply and didn’t irritate our skin.

title: Leaves skin soft

title: Works great

title: larger than expected

title: Works great

But every now and then I use a premade one, so I keep some more natural ones on hand and this seems like a great backup. It rubs in easily, protects from the sun, has more natural ingredients, and didn’t irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Works well
text: Seems to be a good product. I like that it is more natural. Keeps curls soft and not frizzy. Took a star off for the container. I don’t know if anyone enjoys this type of container, but I would prefer a squeeze bottle or pump dispenser. I also thought the scent wasn’t as good as other fructis products, but still decent

title: Works great

title: Works great

title: Smells good

title: Fun
text: Fun hair color that my 7 and 3 year old granddaughters were excited to test out. I brushed their hair and then took a pea sized amount and smoothed it onto small sections of hair with my fingertips and it came out great. When it dried I brushed through it a bit. As you can see it is visible even on medium brown hair. It has lasted all day and we’ll see how it washes out or if it transfers onto clothing or furniture. But so far it hasn’t faded or gotten on anything besides where I put it. It has a nice light scent and will be fun to play around with.

title: Nice product
text: This is a nice highlighter stick. It's like a chapstick with some shimmer and shine to it. Nice for tops of cheekbones, under brownbone and on lips even. Didn't irritate my skin. I like Honest company products, they seem to be good quality.

title: nice hand lotion
text: I have this on my bathroom counter to use after washing hands. It seems to be good with mildly dry skin. Left hands feeling moisturized. It has a nice pleasant light scent that wasn't overbearing.

title: Straightens well
text: I have tried a lot of flat irons and although this did a great job straightening my hair, I didn't notice that it did it any better than less expensive flat irons I have. It looks nice and sleek and is easy to use and beeps when it is ready to use. It is comfortable to hold and heats up within seconds. Also works great to make curls.

title: Scrunchies are back!
text: I didn't realize how much I have missed scrunchies. This is a nice set of well made and pretty looking velvet scrunchies. They are great to keep around your wrist until you need to put your hair up. They are also really comfortable to sleep in and don't leave a line on your hair like the rubber band holders do. Comes in a nice box with a mesh bag to put them in as well.

title: Works well to get rid of dandruff
text: I’m not a big fan of dandruff, and it seems to be something my head likes to do. This seems to be made with natural ingredients. It smells good and sprays in easily. Between using this and a dandruff shampoo I can wear black again without having to clean dandruff off every other hour.

title: Works great
text: Great moisturizing conditioner. Worked well on my long hair. Left it soft and manegable. Smells like coconut tanning lotion. Will be perfect to bring to the pool or beach during the summer.

title: Perfect for beach or pool
text: Perfect to throw in beach or pool bag. Works good for detangling after swimming or putting on hair before to protect it from the sun and water. Has a classic suntan lotion coconut smell.

title: Nice leave in conditioner
text: Leave in conditioner type product for curly hair. Has a nice fruit like scent that isn’t too strong. Easy to apply and rub into wet hair or use after hair is dry to add some shine and reduce frizz. I prefer a pump type dispenser or tube so I don’t have to dip my hand in a big jar.

title: Works well and smells good
text: Adds shine to hair. Has a nice light vanilla scent. A little goes a long way. Seems to have quality ingredients and be free of harmful ingredients.

title: Works great
text: Great body wash. Lathers and cleans well but doesn’t dry out skin. Has a nice light and natural watermelon/rose scent that doesn’t smell artificial or overly fragranced.

title: Smells like cologne

I have never smelled a hair serum like it. Although it smells good for a men’s cologne it’s not how I would want my own hair to smell. My hands also smelled very strong after using it. The pump is also a little awkward to dispense. It looks like a perfume spray top but it only squirts out a few drops at a time. Aside from these things it worked great to add shine to my hair. And seems to be a quality product.

title: Smells good
text: First thing I noticed is how good this product smells. It smells like a good quality perfume, but not in an overly perfume-y way. It also works great as a leave in conditioner or to add shine after styling.

title: Works well smells good
text: I like John Frieda products and have purchased their hair gloss in the past and their shampoo and conditioner for brunettes. Both I really liked. This conditioner works well and smells really good, but not sure if I would switch to it permanently.

title: works well
text: I normally use jojoba oil to cleanse and moisterize my skin and will probably never switch back to anything else, but this does work well if you like a foaming cleanser. My skin felt clean after using it.

title: Smells good

title: Unique product
text: I have never used a product like this. You mix it in with your shampoo and then condition as usual. My hair seemed more conditioned and sleek but not super noticeable. It seemed to take about the same amount of time to dry and style. My hair felt a bit more thick like it was coated in product. I think it will take a few more uses and not using it to see if it makes a huge difference.

title: Quality mineral sunscreen
text: I like this sunscreen. It is perfect for my face. Works well under makeup. Rubs in clear. Not greasy. Kept me from getting a burn.

title: Great sheer lipgloss
text: I really like the Honest Company product line. This lip crayon has the perfect amount of color and gloss to it. I thought it might be too dark based on the color but it goes on very sheer and adds the perfect amount of color. Perfect if you do not like lipstick. Feels more like a lip gloss.

title: Works great
text: For some reason I expected this to be a spray leave-in conditioner, but it is a pump with that dispenses a product that is like a cross between a conditioner and serum. It smells good, and not too strong which is nice. It is easy to apply. I applied it to my hair after a shower. Once my hair dried it seemed more moisterized and manageable. I also used it on my daughters set hair to smooth it out and add some shine and it worked well for that. We’ll see if over time I find I can’t live without it.

title: Easy to apply
text: Great sunscreen. I like that it is a mineral sunscreen but it doesn’t feel as natural as others like Badger. However it works great and is easy to apply and run in. It has a nice coconuty scent. I didn’t notice much of a tint to the color of it. It kept my skin from getting burned while outdoors.

title: Work great
text: Nice temporary tatoos. Look just like the picture. They are a bit larger than I expected. Very colorful and shimmery. Easy to apply like all other temp tatoos I have used. Cut out the one you want, remove the plastic, lay on skin, press wet paper towel over for 30 seconds. They last a while on skin, but can be removed with baby oil or any type of oil. Also come off with a little scrubbing in the shower. Nice variety of designs. Fun for a party.

title: Moisturizing
text: I’ve been wanting to try some products from Jane Irendale because they are some of the safer products out there according to the EWG. This serum feels more like a gel and feels nice and cool when applied to skin. I first tried it on my hand to make sure I liked it. I like that it has almost no scent. It absorbed quickly, but left my skin really soft and not greasy at all. According to the internet hyaluronic acid is a great moisterizer because it can hold up to 1,000 times it’s weight in water to keep cells moisturized. I says it takes 8 weeks to see results so we’ll see how much of a difference this makes. But overall it seems like a good product.

title: Work great and hold a lot of hair
text: Versatile clips that work great. I was surprised at how well a single clip can hold up all my hair in a quick bun or twist and keep it their without slipping or losing grip. Great for when you need to section hair for coloring or cutting. Also great to keep by the sink for pinning up hair to wash your face.

title: Nice ionic flat iron
text: Nice flat iron. I received a different one than pictured, but I really like the one I received. It is a narrow flat iron with a feature that dispenses ions as you use it. You can hear the ionic feature as it makes a quiet sound. I like that this beeps when it is ready to use which is a few seconds after you turn it on. It did s great job straightening my hair and also works to make curls. Comfortable to hold and looks nice.

title: Nice brush
text: Nice brush that is comfortable to hold and works well to brush my long hair. It seems to smooth it and it grips well to the hair to make curling it easier while drying. I’m not coordinated enough to do curls as well as they do it in the salon.

title: Nice travel bag
text: Nice travel toiletry bag. It appears well made and just like the picture. Holds a good amount of items. The material reminds me of an insulated lunch bag. Only downside for me is that I can’t bring it on a carry-on since it doesn’t meet TSA requirements for liquids. But it will work well for local trips or flights where I can check my baggage.

title: Nice complex scent
text: Nicely scented perfume. Somewhat unique and complex scent that smells a little different every time I try it. It is subtly sweet and spicy. It is a bit on the perfume-y side for me as I prefer something more light, sweet and fresh. But it seems to be a quality perfume. The scent last all day on and the bottle is also very pretty.

title: Great curling iron
text: I really like all the Hot Tools hair styling products I have tried. This curling iron seems to be great quality. Heats up and is ready to use within seconds. Has a nice long cord and swivel at the end of the iron. It makes perfect curls that hold all day and through the next. I used it on 400 for medium thickness hair. It is comfortable to hold and use and I didn’t have any problems with hair slipping out of the clip which someone else had mentioned. In fact it held my hair better than other curling irons. (From my daughter)

title: Works good as a concealer
text: Just ok for me. I prefer my current Burt Bees Foundation. It is much easier to apply. This one is a bit cakey for me and would work better as a concealer. (From my daughter)

title: Works well
text: Works well to add some shimmer to cheekbones and brow bone, subtle but effective. Feels very light on, almost like a powder and is easy to blend in. Didn’t irritate skin. I like it but don’t know if I am ready to add this extra step to my daily makeup routine. (From my daughter)

title: Works great
text: I like this a lot better than the dry shampoo spray. I was pretty doubtful that this would work as others also said because it goes on wet and makes your hair look more greasy but it goes away quickly and leaves hair looking clean and with a bit of volume.

title: Smells good and hydrated well
text: I currently use pure jojoba oil to clean and moisturize my face and have been using it for the last 3 years. It has been the best thing I have ever used for my skin. I like a lot of the ingredients in this repair oil. I have heard a lot of good things about sea buckthorn oil. However, I have never heard of the first ingredient but it checks out according to google. I am uncertain what chamomile essence is. But overall this felt nice on my skin similar to the jojoba oil. It didnt irritate it and it smells really good like chamomile. I also like the flowers in it. It’s a nice touch.

title: Works well
text: This dentagler works well and smells good. I used it on my 2 granddaughters hair and it made it easy to brush through and dries quickly without leaving hair greasy. It has a strong scent that smells similar to Pantene dentangler. It has a lot of ingriendents that I don’t know what they are, but seems like a good product.

title: Reasonably priced
text: This is a good razor. Normally buy Gillette Mach 3 but this is almost as good. The cartridges are a little tricky to put on sometimes. They shave well but not as smooth as the Gillette. But I would consider buying these since they are less expensive and do a good job.

title: Smells good
text: Nice dry shampoo. I usually opt for some of the cheaper brands, but I like John Frieda products and this works well and has a nice scent. Works similar to other dry shampoos.

title: Most hydrating face cream I have tried
text: I first tested this cream on the backs of my hands to make sure it didn’t irritate my skin. I was pleasantly surprised by how well it moisturized my cracked dry skin instantly. It went on so smoothly and had a very pleasant light scent. It absorbs quickly as well. After a day of doing dishes and laundry and various other things, my skin is still hydrated and soft.  I normally just use jojoba oil on my face to moisturize, but I am looking forward to using this when I need something more hydrating.

title: Multipurpose and durable
text: Great cotton rounds with smooth side and exfoliating side. Multipurpose. Great for nail polish or makeup removal. These are durable and don’t fall apart while using. The soft side is soft and the exfoliating side works great, not too rough, but effective.

title: Unique Scent
text: This is a very unique scent. I didn't care for it personally as I prefer something more sweet and fruity. And I usually don't care for patchouli scent but I couldn't smell it in this anyway. I mostly smell a pine like scent...sharp, clean and earthy. While this scent wasn't my favorite, I like that it is a natural perfume with some good company ethics from what I can tell. I would definitely be interested in trying some of the other scents as they look more appealing to me. It also comes in a nice looking bottle and is packaged nicely which would make a nice gift.

title: Great liner
text: Works great. Color is rich and lasts all day. Easy to remove with makeup remover or jojoba oil. Easy to apply.

title: Dries hair more efficiently

title: Works well

I still haven't found the exact way to make a perfect curl, but I'm sure with a little practice it shouldn't be too hard.

title: Works well

title: Basic dryer

This heats extremely fast and gets really hot and the material seems to help make hair smooth and shiny.

title: Nice set

But after my hair dried it didn't appear any more conditioned than with my regular Pantene conditioner. I also didn't care for the strong sandlewood/musky type scent.

title: Feels great on skin

I rub it on my face, it has a bit of a coarse texture like a scrub, and then I wipe it off with a wet, warm washcloth a few times. Then rinse and dry. It also has a mild pleasant scent.

title: Nice set

title: Smells great

title: Great quality

title: Works well

title: Versatile glitter

title: Great basic conditioner

title: Heats fast

title: Sandalwood, vanilla and musk
