text: These are quite thick and work well for a quick cleanup and refresher. Would be good for traveling. They smel is good withybeing overbearing.

title: Nice lipstick
text: From my daughter: Great lipstick that goes on super smooth and has a nice color. I put Shea butter on my lips before using it to make it more glossy and hydrating. It has a fruity scent/taste to it. I like more natural beauty products and this product line seems like a quality one.

title: Works great
text: From my daughter: Great foundation. It goes on really smooth and has a buildable amount of coverage. It feels very lightweight and didn’t irritate my sensitive skin, the color blended great and matched my light/medium skin. I would say it’s more of a medium coverage foundation.

title: Works great, nice color
text: From my daughter: Great hydrating lip gloss. Perfect amount of color and shine. Perfect for someone who isn’t a fan of lipstick but still wants some color. Has a hint of fruity watermelon taste/smell to it.

title: Works as claimed
text: From my daughter: One of the more interesting products I’ve tried since it’s made from snail slime. But grossness aside, it does what it claims and has a price tag similar to cosmetic procedures and peels that offer the same results. It evens skin texture and tone and minimizes fine wrinkles. As others mentioned the product itself feels a bit weird on but washes off fine leaving skin soft and smooth. I’ve only used it for a few days but looking forward to the results at the end of 6 weeks.

title: Adds nice shimmer/glow
text: From my daughter: I have tried several dermablend products and they all seem to be great professional quality. This highlighter works well for a subtle glow or a dramatic one. I am not great with makeup but this is easy enough to figure out how to use and where to put it. I do think a small amount above my cheekbones and below much eyebrows and blend it in. Lightweight and adds nice shimmer/glow.

title: Works great
text: Great reasonably priced flat iron that also works great for making curls since it is smaller and has rounded edges. Heats up quickly as advertised and leave some hair smooth and shiny. Easy to use and seems well made.

title: Works great
text: Nice trimmer for ears and noses and places where you need a quick touch up. Seems well made. Easy to use. Quality brand.

title: Nice shaver
text: Works well for a budget electric shaver. Good value but not sure how ling this will last as it feels pretty plastic and light weight. That being said the shaving aspect works well for my face. Nice LED screen for battery life but I usually always charge every time so not a big function for my use.

title: nice bb cream
text: From my daughter: Nice bb cream that has a light/medium coverage. Feels very lightweight and has a matte finish. Goes on a greyish color but quickly changes to match your skin tone. Has no spf in it, so not as versatile as some of the other ones I have since I prefer spf.

title: Makes hair shiny
text: From my daughter: makes hair shiny and smooth. Has a minty smell to it. Doesn’t weigh down hair or make it look greasy. Seems to have lots of benificial oils in it. Looks a little slimy coming out of the bottle but goes on easily.

title: Good mascara
text: From my daughter: This mascara and primer work well, but I can’t say it is my favorite with so many other ones out there. It extends well and the Black is nice and dark and makes eyes pop. I did have some clumping and had a hard time separating my lashes. I currently use Lash Blast and really like how non clumpy it is. I have also heard good things about the double extend tubes mascara. This one washes off easy and isn’t bad, just not my favorite.

title: Great brushes
text: From my daughter: Great brushes. Very soft and efficient at applying makeup. I used one of these to apply blush and thought it did a great job. Seem like quality brushes.

title: Versatile eyeshadow set
text: From my daughter: nice eyeshadow set. The colors are versatile and I like that it includes black to use as an eyeliner. They are long lasting and apply nicely. The container is a bit awkward like a paper box, but other than that I like this set.

title: Good primer
text: From my daughter: I like the honest product line and use some of the products. This primer works the way you would expect it to. It makes skin appear more smooth with makeup or without. It gives a more matte appearance than a dewy one. It feels good on skin and didn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Looking forward to trying other products from the honest beauty line.

title: Works great
text: from my daughter: Nice straightener that heats very fast and is ready to straighten hair in 10 seconds. It comes with a comb attachment to help smooth hair as your straighten. I found that it worked great to straighten my hair. Left it looking smooth. My personal preference is for a slimmer straightener so that I can use it to curl as well, but if you are just looking for a straightener, this is great.

title: Great set
text: Great set of lotion and wipes. The lotion is very moisturizing and feels great on skin. Absorbs well and long lasting. The cloths are perfect for washing your face. They are soft and effective at removing makeup and dirt. They leave skin feeling clean and not dried out.

title: Good Flat Iron
text: From my daughter: Heats up fast as advertised. Works great to straighten hair, however I prefer a more narrow one so I can curl the ends slightly. Leaves hair looking sleek and smooth.

title: Good value
text: Good value for the price. It is lightweight and good for traveling. It is very easy to use and don’t need instructions for it. Gives a decent shave, but not as well as higher priced shavers.

title: hand lotion
text: nice hand lotion. has a pleasant, not too strong, orange scent. leaves hands soft. nice looking container that would look nice in bathroom or on dresser.

title: Cool hair dryer
text: This is a neat looking hair dryer that is hollow through the center like one of those dyson fans. On its highest setting, the air doesn't come out with as much force as your would expect, but the hot air still circulates well around hair to dry it. It seems to take a bit longer, but my hair is less frizzy because it's not blowing as hard. It is comfortable to hold and use and is compact. I don't use the attachements that usually come with it, but it's nice to have them.

title: Great generic brand tissues
text: Quality tissues that feel soft and durable. I have liked other items from the Solimo brand as well. Great generic line that is comparable to name brand. Would recommend.

title: Good concept but not for me
text: From my daughter: I like the idea of this product since I have been using jojoba oil to clean my face and moisturize it for several years now. But I didn’t feel like it did a better job than my bottle of jojoba oil for $7. I have had the best results with that. It only takes 3 drops to remove eye makeup by simply rubbing it on eyes and removing the oil and makeup with a wet warm washcloth. Then 3 more drops rubbed over entire face and washed off with a washcloth several times, then I rinse my face and dry it and apply 3 more drops to moisturize. My skin never feels oily after and I no longer have breakouts or dry skin.

title: Feels good on skin
text: From my daughter: This serum feels great on skin and absorbs quickly and leaves skin soft and hydrated. I didn’t notice too much difference in my skins appearance, other than being hydrated, but it does feel good on. The only negative was that the list of ingredients doesn’t look as natural as I prefer. I wish it didn’t have artificial colors in it as I find them completely unnnessary. If an expensive product makes my skin look better then I don’t care what color it is. It also makes me question other ingredients.

title: Helps with shaving
text: This product works like shaving cream, but in a stick that glides and leaving behind a slick lotion that makes shaving easier. It has a nice clean and masculine cologne like fragrance. I just use it for my face but I would imagine it would work well for other areas as well.

title: Works well with lots of variety
text: From my daughter: Wand style curling iron with 3 different size barrels. I have wanted to try the larger one for a long time and like that this includes it. It also includes a tapered one which makes pretty curls. These don't have a clip to hold hair, but you get used to making curls without it. It heats up well and gets hot enough to make curls last. Seems like a quality product.

title: Great lip balm without bad ingredients
text: From my daughter: Great lip balm that contains quality ingredients unlike most chap sticks. This has a slight shimmer to it, but not very noticeable. Has a faint vanilla flavor. Moisturizing on lips.

title: Quality synthetic wig
text: This wig is how I would expect a quality synthetic wig to look like. It doesn't look completely natural, but it is pretty close. The colors are nice on it and it holds it's style well. It can also be adjusted to fit different head sizes and stays on reasonably well.

title: Works great
text: Huge container of spray sunscreen. The kids prefer the spray since it applies quickly. The sprayer works great and covers a large amount of skin effectively and evenly. The scent is rather strong but is tolerable. Worked to protect skin from sun at the pool. Nobody had any negative reactions to it. We usually purchase the Neutrogena Beach Defense Sunscreen Spray from Costco since we have had really good experiences with that particular one and it smells great and works great.

title: Works well
text: From my daughter: This product seems similar to a bb cream. It goes on easily and is light to medium coverage. I like that it has mineral SPF. It also didn't irritate my sensitive skin. It has a fine sparkle to it which creates the "illuminating" effect. It stayed on my skin all day. Would be interested in trying some of their other products.

title: Neat concept
text: I like the concept of this and it works great. It goes on smoothly and washes off easily. It has a fine grit to it, which is perfect for exfoliating. The scent is a bit strong but nice. It is more on the masculine side, but the scent doesn’t linger once washed off.

title: Nice lotion
text: Nice body lotion. The color looks a little odd, but it works great and does it's job well. It feels moisturizing and absorbs well and doesn't leave skin greasy. It has a very mild, but pleasant scent.

title: Fun to try
text: From my daughter: I tried this in the morning and didn't notice a huge difference.  My skin seemed a little bit smoother and softer. The scent of it stung my eyes a bit while I was applying it, but went away quickly as it was drying. It feels nice on skin while it's drying and almost creates a cooling/tingling sensation. After 10 minutes it was dry and I rinsed it off with warm water and applied jojoba oil after since my skin felt a bit dry. It was fun to try and had some small positive results.

title: Does it’s job
text: Nice basic 2 in 1 shampoo and conditioner. Has a manly scent to it and does it’s job well. No complaints.

title: Smells great
text: Smells better than I expected. I thought it would smell like a drugstore cologne, but it smells really good and high quality. It seems like a scent a lot of people would like and similar to popular colognes.

title: Smells nice
text: Normally use the yellow tube of Got2b glued styling paste and I find it has a better hold then this paste. This paste also has a stronger cologne like scent which smells nice.

title: Great lipstick
text: From my daughter: nice lipstick that goes on very smoothly and lasts a few hours. The color is as expected and has a nice shine to it.

title: Smells great
text: First thing i noticed was how great this smelled like almonds. This is mostly due to a natural ingredient called Benzaldehyde. According to my research it is safe and actually benifificial. The oil also absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn’t leave skin greasy. I like everything about this oil except the vitamin e in it which is listed as “tocopheryl acetate”. According to google this isn’t the best form of vitamin e to use on skin and can actually be damaging to skin. It is basically vitamin e with acetic acid added to it to make it last longer without going rancid. Some people might not have any problems with it and I would prefer to use this over many other products to moisturize skin. However I think instead of purchasing this oil in the future I would prefer pure vitamin e, jojoba oil, pure almond oil, and/or pure Shea butter which are all high in vitamin e.

title: Lots of uses
text: Lots of different uses for this product. I have used it in detangling spray with water and essential oils and it works great. Also used it for our fog machine to make a fun dance party for the kids.  Can be used to make foaming handsoap, bubble solution, and many other recipes. I have tried other products from this company and have found them to be of good quality.

title: Baby powder and roses
text:
Baby powder scented perfume/ body spray with a subtle rose scent. Smells and works exactly as described. Scent is light but long lasting.

Product description translated to English:
Body Perfume: Splendidly splashed or lightly sprayed, you will fall in love anyway. Our carefully crafted fragrances combine with all our bath and body products. Use your favorite scents together and feel fresh and luxurious all day long. BABY TALK: Feel the fragrance of a baby with notes of rose petals, sweet vanilla and soft powder

title: Good pomade
text: Good product. Has a nice scent to it and works as expected for a pomade. A little goes a long way.

title: Fun product
text: From my daughter: I like the Honest Company product line and I like this Hydration mist. It smells great, herbal, like lavender and lemon, and feels great on skin. I wish the mist were a little finer when it sprays out. I can't tell if it's improving the look of my skin, but it absorbs quickly and doesn't seem to irritate my skin.

title: Good minty conditioner
text: Conditions well and has a nice invigorating minty scent. It is a lightweight conditioner that works well for mens hair. The conditioner is a light blue color.

title: Feels nice
text: Hydrating serum that goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. Has a citrus scent. Left skin noticibly hydrated. Feels nice on skin and didn’t experience any negative side effects.

title: Smells nice
text: Product feels nice on skin and has a nice lemony scent. Hard to tell if it really tightened as much as it claims, but skin does look moisturized. Didn’t experience any negative side effects.

title: Would make a nice gift
text: This would make a nice gift for a guy who likes to use razors like the Gillette Mach 3. It comes with a Gillette Mach 3 razor head/ cartridge on it. It also comes in a nice box. It can stand upgright on the counter or in a medicine cabinet which is nice. I took a star off for the price. To me it looks like something that should cost under $30 and I couldn’t find anything in the description to justify paying $100 for it. I have tried several products from this company, like their facial scrub, and have liked them all.

title: Great
text: My son-in-law and grandson both use this everyday and really like it. It is a very fresh clean scent that is not overpowering. Would work for male or female.

title: Didn’t do much for me
text: From my daughter: I received the soft brown and while it was too light for my dark hair, I still tried it out to see how it worked. It seems to work like a mascara by lengthing each individual hair and in turn making the brows fuller. Since my brows are already full this didn’t do much for me. I prefer the look of a eyebrow pencil to make them darker, this seems to be intended for someone with short eyebrow hairs.

title: Nice basic skin lotion
text: Moisterizing lotion similiar to other products I have used. Hydrates skin well and I haven't had any negative side effects from using it.

title: Nice colors
text: From my daughter: pretty palate of neutral eyeshadow colors. Some have sparkle to them and some don’t. Should last a long time. Works well with eyeshadow brush from the same line.

title: Nice makeup brush
text: Nice makeup brush. Works well to apply eyeshadow. Seems like good quality and like it should last.

title: Great mineral sunblock
text: Great mineral sunblock that goes on smoothly and blends in well. Leaves a slight white sheen but not very noticeable. No noticible scent and didn’t irritate skin. Didn’t get burned while using it

title: Great beard trimmer
text: This review is for the mgk3045 model. It’s primary purpose is a beard grooming/trimming tool and it does an excellent job of that. It also includes haircut clips to do haircuts which isn’t nice. The razor is a nice bonus. It would be great if it included a bag for storage. I have owned other Braun products and they seem to be a quality brand.

title: Cleansing and soothing
text: We usually purchase dove sensitive skin bar soap from Costco. This product is gentle and seems good quality like all the Dove products I have tried. It cleanses my dry skin while soothing it at the same time.

title: Softer skin
text: Gentle exfoliating night cream. Seemed to make skin more soft and didn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Seems like a quality product.

title: Smells good
text: Great smelling shampoo that cleans well and leaves hair soft. Would recommend.

title: Works great
text: Works well to condition hair. Left it tangle free and soft, but not weighted down. While the scent smells good, it’s not my favorite. It has a warm amber scent instead of a fresh or sweet scent that I prefer. I tend to go for Pantene, dove or tresemme.

title: Nice lasting waves
text: From my daughter: curling wand that works as described. Heats up in 30 seconds and was ready to use. Made nice wavy curls that held most of the day. Similar results to my more expensive curling wand. I don’t use the glove. Good value and good results.

title: Nice lotion
text: From my daughter: nice lightweight moisturizer with added sunscreen. Feels nice on skin and absorbs quickly without being greasy. Skin feels soft and hydrated my skin well throughout the day. The only negative for me is I don’t like the fragrance, but it does go away eventually.

title: Full coverage
text: From my daughter: This is a nice full coverage foundation that goes on very smoothly. I would prefer it to be unscented. It has a minty scent and cooling feeling when you apply it. I like as few ingredients as possible in my makeup and I felt like I could live without the cooling and scent. It lasted all day and didn't irritate my skin.

title: Great lotion
text: Noticeably smoother skin after using this. I used it on some rough spots on my feet and arms and after one use they were noticeably softer and smoother. I like that it’s frageance free and not greasy feeling. Would recommend.

title: Good mineral sunscreen
text: Good sunscreen that works and uses mineral sunscreens. You only need a little and it leaves a bit of a white sheen, but this is normal for minimal sunscreens. I prefer other brands like badger which have even less chemicals in them and do just as good of a job.

title: Feels nice
text: From my daughter: kept lips hydrated for a few hours. Feels hydrating and gives lips a nice shine. Doesn’t have much of a scent or taste.

title: Works well
text: From my daughter: worked well to make hair look more shiny but not greasy. Seems similar to results from Biosilk. I think they could have left out the coloring in the ingredients, seems unnecessary.

title: Seems ok
text: From my daughter: Nice lotion that’s feels good on skin and has good sun protection. Light enough to wear under makeup or alone. Didn’t notice a huge difference in the appearance of my skin, but also didn’t experience any negative side effects.

title: Good shave gel
text: Nicely scented and soothing shave gel. Worked well to shave with. Usually use shave cream so this was a nice change.

title: Just like grandmas
text: If you liked the look and smell of the little shell soaps your grandma used to have by her bathroom sink you will love these. They have a very strong soapy/perfumey scent.

title: Great scrub
text: The scrub is nice and smells sweet like honey. It is not overly abrasive, but just enough to exfoliate. Seems to have quality ingredients and leaves skin soft and moisturizer.

title: Moisturizing
text: Great body butter with quality ingredients and scented with just lavender oil. The scent is very soothing. Appreciate that it is not overly scented with perfumes. The texture is thick and goes on smoothly. It does a great job of moisturizing and creates lasting moisture.

title: Smells great!
text: Pleasantly surprised by how great the scent is. Orange, clove, vanilla smells like chai tea. Doesn't smell like perfume like most soap bars. Great for fall and winter or whenever. Lathers well and doesn't dry out skin.

title: Great product, wish it was unscented
text: From my daughter: This is a nice scrub that is similar in texture and applicatoin to the apricot scrub you can buy at the drugstore. The rose fragrance is nice, but a little too strong. I wish it had a more natural scent or was unscented since so many people are sensitive to fragrances.

title: Strong fragrance, but nice product
text: From my daughter: I can't get past the strong fragrance. It smells good, but overpowering for me. It smells similar to some burt's bees products I have tried. It goes on easily like a lotion, then dries like clay and can be washed off. It feels nice on skin and left my skin soft. It seems to be a quality product with lots of beneficial ingredients, but I wouldn't purchase in the future due to the strong fragrance.

title: Similar to BB cream
text: From my daughter: comparable to other drugstore BB creams. It surprised me when it came out of the tube whitish grey colored but changes to a light/medium color when applied. It matched my light/medium skin well but it is a very light coverage. I like that it has spf in it so I don't have to use a separate product. It feels nice on skin and didn't irritate it.

title: Great all body makeup
text: From my daughter: Works as expected. Covers skin blemishes nicely. Didn't irritate my skin. Lasts long if you let it dry for a bit. Would recommend.

title: Long lasting
text: From my daughter: this concealer goes on smooth. I used it under my eyes and it stayed their nicely all day. It didn't have as much coverage as I expected, but it covered just enough for me.

title: Nice makeup
text: From my daughter: nice makeup for a reasonable price. The color wasn't a pefect match, but I still tried out the powder on my face and it went on nice and smooth and had a good amount of coverage. I also like that there isn't any fragrance and it didn't irritate my skin at all.

title: Makes skin soft
text: From my daughter: Nicely scented night cream. Felt great on skin and didn't irritate. Didn't brighten too much for me, but it did make my skin nice and soft so I will continue using it.

title: Smells great and works
text: Sprays nice and evenly on skin. Rubs in easily and drys quickly. Smells great with a subtle suntan lotion type smell. Protected my skin while I was out in the sun today running errands.

title: Great smelling shampoo plus conditioner
text: Great shampoo plus conditioner. I usually follow with a separate conditioner after. Has a great scent and left hair feeling clean and manageable.

title: Great scent
text: Great, sweet scented body wash. Nice large bottle perfect for the whole family. Didn't dry out skin.

title: Nice foundation
text:
Pros-
Felt good on skin all day
Goes on smooth
Light-medium coverage
Didn't irritate sensitive skin

Cons-
No spf
Hard to tell if it plumped my skin

Overall a nice foundation, however I prefer using a bb cream or tinted moisturizer type product most days.

title: works well
text: I generally buy dove or Pantene, this works just as well, but I prefer the scent of other shampoos. The scent smells good, but is a bit too strong and perfume-y for me. I like a more sweet, fruity or clean smelling scent.

title: Does it's job well
text: This hair dryer dried my long hair a bit quicker than my old cheap dryer. My hair appeared a tiny bit shinier than before. The dryer feels well made and professional. The long heavy duty cord is nice. I could do without the different colored filter attachments. I'm pretty sure most people would be happy with the black one that comes already on it. All in all a nice dryer that I hope will last me a long time.

title: Good conditioner but strong fragrance
text: Conditioner works great for my long hair, but the scent is pretty strong and on the perfume-y side.

title: Nice conditioner
text: Great smelling conditioner that also moisturizers well. The conditioner is really thick and more moisturizing than my usual Pantene conditioner.

title: Great grooming trimmer
text: Great grooming trimmer. Comes with a bunch of height amusements and does a great job removing unwanted body and facial hair. Not big into facny shaped beards but this would be able to do that easily. I mainly use this for body and use a razor for my face. Takes awhile to charge but never runs out or lose power during grooming.

title: Easy to use set.
text: Easy to use set. Perfect for cutting my 7 year old grandsons hair. Quiet and smooth operation. Comes with a hard carrying case.

title: Nice shine and smoothing oil
text: A little bit goes a very long way. I put 3 drops on my very long hair and it was plenty to smooth it and give it a nice shine. Very lightly scented almost unnoticeable. Hard to say yet if it's something that I couldn't live without or makes a huge difference compared to plain coconut oil or jojoba oil.

title: Nice smelling conditioner.
text: Nice smelling conditioner seems to work just as good as other conditioners.

title: Great mascara
text: Great mascara. I recently became a fan of the cover girl lash blast which is amazing and thought this was almost just as good. The brush seems really awkward but it actually works pretty well and does the job. It really lengthens the lashes. My only complaint is that it clumps a tiny bit which isn't a problem at all with lash blast. I love how easily this washes off too.

title: Scent too strong for me
text: Comes well sealed. Hard to get lotion out through little hole on top of bottle. Feels nice and moisturizing on my hand. Smells nice but too strong for me.

title: Not my favorite
text: Gave a decently smooth shave on my legs, but felt a bit rough in doing so. Seems to be about the same quality you might get from disposable razors from the dollar store. i'll stick with my Gillette refillable razor that lasts me a really long time.

title: Nice body wash
text: I've been very happy with all the products from this line. Unscented is great for people sensitive to fragrances. Worked well as a body wash and didn't leave skin dry.

title: Great deal
text: Curling wand works as expected. Heats quickly and makes great curls. Only has one heat setting which works for my hair which is average thickness. No reason to spend more for me. I use dove hair spray to help make curls last longer.

title: Works as expected
text: Heats quickly and made nice looking curls. Directions are straightforward and this is a good replacement to my old cheap set of curling irons. Works as expected. No complaints.

title: Great smelling products
text: The best thing about these products is the scent. The moisturizer and serum felt nice on my face. The microdermabrasion was gentle and effective. Overall nice products, but not sure if I would purchase in the future.

title: Moisterizes well
text: This works well as a moisturizer, but it takes some getting used to applying while wet than drying off. Scent is nice, pretty mild and pleasant. While this product works well, I probably would rather stick to regular lotions and oils.

title: Heats quickly and straightens pretty well
text: I love how fast this heats up, literally in seconds, and it straightened my hair better than I expected. The two drawbacks for me are that it didn't give my hair the same shine and look as a flat iron and it can't multitask as well as some of my other instyler products. I really like the instyler hot round brush and straightener combo. You can do so much with that. But this product might work better on different hair types and lengths.

title: Great but scent a little too strong for me
text: Great conditioner. Only downside for me is that the fragrance is so strong and I wish it were a little more mellow and subtle. Other than that it made my long hair extremely soft and manageable without weighing it down.

title: Great cologne
text: Great cologne. Long lasting. Smells great, like a quality cologne. Clean, fresh, classy, and masculine.

title: Interesting scent
text: This perfume smells interesting to me. Doesn't smell like any other perfume I've smelled. Hints of cotton candy, pineapple and Christmas? Can't decide yet if I really like it or really don't.

title: nice sweet scent
text: Sweet smelling perfume, but not overly sweet or fruity. My 35 year old daughter liked it and said it could probably be worn by any aged woman. It only lasted about 4 hours with one spray rubbed between both wrists.

title: Nice hand lotion, just a bit pricey
text: Nicely scented hand lotion. Smells fresh and lemony to me. Feels nice on hands. Absorbs quickly and leaves hands moisturized. Comes in  little tube that looks like a tube of paint. I took a star off for price since there are so many other lower priced options out there.

title: Seems fine
text: This body wash seems fine, both in aroma and in the feel to the skin. As for its technical claims (anti-toxin, protein, etc), all I can say is that I didn't have any bad reactions. The only negative for me, is what I consider its high cost.

title: Great scent, but prefer Dove bar soap
text: This is a nice body wash, however I prefer Dove sensitive skin bars over this. It has a very nice scent that is very light and smells more natural than I expected. It lathered nicely and didn't leave skin too dry.

title: Great color
text: Review for Peach Side. Quality nail polish and the color is really nice for spring and summer. Goes on smoothly. Perfect color for my 4 year old and myself. Only wish it were 5 free like Zoya nail polish which I love.

title: Seems to work well
text: This was my first time using dry shampoo. I used it on my hair that I washed about 3 days ago and was only starting to get slightly oily. I sprayed it at the roots and then brushed my hair. There wasn't too much of a difference, but it didn't leave any residue and my hair felt clean after. The scent is baby powdery, which isn't my favorite but it's not overpowering.

title: Moisterizes well and has a nice scent
text: Conditioner works great and has a nice scent. Worked similar to other brands like pantene and dove.

title: Great body wash
text: Great working body wash that leaves skin moisturized and with a clean masculine scent. Probably prefer regular dove bar soap though.

title: Rosy is nice
text: Review by my daughter: I like the Rosy color. It is very light, but just enough to give you some color. It isn't overly sparkly either. I usually just wear Leven Rose Jojoba Oil on my face, eyeliner, blush and lip gloss. The other colors that came to test out were Luminous and Bronzed. Both of those were extremely sheer and could barely be seen. I might consider purchasing the Rosy in the future if the price were right.

title: Moisterizes and smells great!
text: Love this body wash. We normally purchase the Dove sensitive skin bars of soap from Costco, but this was a nice change. It's easier to use if you use a loofa and the smell is great. It leaves skin moisturized and with a very light orange scent. You can even get by without using lotion after using this which is nice.

title: Nice styling paste
text: Works well to style my 6yr old grandson's short hair. Has a nice scent to it and washes off hands easily after application.

title: Great Head and Shoulders shampoo

title: Conventional vs. Linear motor
text: Here’s the low-down on Panasonic conventional vs linear motors.  I've owned at least 3 other Panasonic razors and loved them all.  They all had the high-RPM linear motor.  When it was time to replace the cutting blades on my ES8103 this razor was the same price so I figured I'd try it.  Bad choice.  The motor isn't as strong, you have to struggle to get an equal shave, and you have to recharge it before the batteries go down below 60 percent or else there's a noticeable reduction in power.  Stick with Panasonic but spend the extra for the one with the linear motor.

title: Panasonic wet/dry are the best
text:
This is my 4th Panasonic razor and I think they're great, mainly because the motor is just stronger than what I've experienced in other electrics. The Panasonic 13,000 RPM motor cuts right through with no grabbing or tugging, whereas my last Braun would freeze up because it wasn't powerful enough. The shave is close and comfortable too and of course you can use it wet, even in the shower if you want.

Don't get a Panasonic with the cheaper 10,000 RPM motor. And don't get the docking/charging/cleaning stations that are a waste and force you to buy supplies you don't need. This is very easy to clean and it says when it needs charging, which takes less than an hour. One charge lasts me over a week.

The only reason I've had four of these is that I'll replace the blades once after about 18 months or so, but then 18 months later I'll just buy a new one if it's a good price. This one's about half as loud and heavy as one from a few years ago. The only complaint is that the charging indicator isn't very accurate. When it says 10% there's still probably over 25% of a charge remaining. But still, highly recommended.

title: Makes it like new again
text: $35 may seem a bit steep for a replacement foil and blades, but installing these made my razor work like new again.  If you can get a new Panasonic wet/dry with the 13,000 rpm motor cheap then it may be worth it to buy a new razor instead of new blades.  The picture may show one cutting blade but there are two in the package.

title: Powerful and comfortable
text:
This is my third Panasonic electric razor over the last ten years and I've liked them all. I have an ES8066 that I would still be using except that it was time to replace the foil and cutting blocks and I found that for just $15 more I could get this model brand new from Amazon. (I paid $57 a month ago but the price today is up to $85! Check often because Amazon prices fluctuate a lot.)

I've had two different Brauns, but the motors were just too weak. My second Braun would actually freeze up on my face while shaving because it just wasn't strong enough to cut through my beard. Never any problems like that with Panasonic. Maybe Braun has upgraded their motors by now but it's too late -- they already lost me as a customer and I see no reason to leave Panasonic.

This model, the ES8043, gives the same great, quick, close shave as my other Panasonics. Wet/dry is the way to go. It's also easy to clean -- just open it up and run some water over it, no brushes or fancy docking stations required. The floating head is a little odd as it rotates side-to-side and not front-to-back. It's good around my chin and jaw but I find I get a better shave elsewhere if I just lock the head so it doesn't rotate at all.

I would give this razor five stars except for one thing: the trimmer is too thin and located in a weird spot. This trimmer is around half the width of the trimmer on the ES8066. More importantly, it pops out from the side whereas the trimmer on the ES8066 (and other Panasonic and Braun razors I've used) can be aligned with the foil and can be used at the same time as the foil cutter over your entire face. That makes it easier to shave when you haven't done so for a while and your beard is grown out. With this 8043 model the trimmer works fine for sideburns, but you can't use it on the rest of your face or neck.

BTW, don't take Panasonic's recommendation to replace the blades and foil once a year too seriously. You can use them for longer.

title: Great product!
text:
[[VIDEOID:fde8b4b5cd236bb5544ce0ab4c3acaa1]] I truly LOVE this product! The wipes are the perfect size to completely wipe down face and neck, and it leaves the skin feeling CLEAN! It smells a bit like fireplace charcoal, maybe mixed with something I can't identify, but it is not a bad or overwhelming scent at all. It really cuts the oil on my skin without leaving my skin feeling dry. These are so much better than any other wipe I've tried!

However... I absolutely HATE the packaging! (see pics). The clear layer of cellophane connects the pop-top closure to the rest so when it pulls away from the package -as it always does- it takes the convenient closure off with it and the wipes dry out. :-( Also the wipes are folded individually and stacked (reminds me of travel tissues) so it's really hard to find an edge to get a proper hold to pull out just one at a time. I wish they would fold them into each other like most wipes packaging where pulling one out pulls up the edge to the next one waiting, you know? Shoving that little bit out of the way to close the lid is much preferred over trying to shove a whole wipe back into the package as I usually end up doing.

title: Not as expected
text:
Fine for a typical face wipe, maybe, though they only do a mediocre job at cleaning off the skin at all (oil, dirt, makeup). Then, claiming the benefits of charcoal seems a stretch. My first thought was these wipes are very, very white, so any charcoal content at all must be minimal at best since there is no whitening agent, such as titanium dioxide, listed in the ingredients. Of course, if the charcoal went through a bleaching stage, that would negate the Number 1 benefit charcoal can offer: detox. Aside from all that, the wipes are fairly soft, smell more like a face wash than the near-odorless scent of standard wipes, especially charcoal since deodorizing is another benefit.
If held up against a standard baby wipe, these are nice and soft - though the fabric pulls and begins to shed quickly (I wouldn’t recommend the other uses standard baby wipes are often used for). The price would be great if these were as claimed, but too expensive when compared to a standard wipe. Overall I’d say these are not as advertised and less than ideal for a standard wipe. I will not be buying these again.

The date reads from when it was made, and lasts about 3 yrs. I have had this before, and it lasted longer, and got the dirt off my sons hands just fine.

title: Doll is not petal pink, more peach
text:
I got the Doll that is suppose to Be more of a petal pink.
This went on my lips easy, and felt and looked smooth.
I’m Fair , blonde, Blue eye, this was not pink on me, it was a Darker Peach.
Just not My color.
But it works for my daughter that has dark hair and eyes, although fair skin.

title: Scalp does Not itch anymore, hair is soft. Love this.
text:
I have been using beauty & Planet conditioner (and shampoo) for about
A year , and I love it, also has a nice scent.
I have a auto immune decease that I get a itchy scalp, and my scalp does Not
Itch using this. I usually wash my hair everyday, but if I don’t I still do not get
A itchy scalp, and my hair is nice and soft.

My hair got damaged from a bad blonde weave a couple of months ago, my new
Hairdresser did a Olaplex conditioner on my hair that was expensive, it only lasted
Two days.
This conditioner does more conditioning for my hair then olaplex, and last longer.
I also have allot of bottles and jar of Pureology shampoos & conditioners which
Are expensive , but my scalp itches from all of my pureology , and does
not condition my hair As well as Beauty and Plant does.

My hair is pretty thick , Almost Shoulder length , and as I get older it has a
little curl in it. I blow my hair dry, and I notice how my hair is shinier using
B & P, and I can keep the curl, or it blows out straighter using this conditioner.
I would say if you have curly hair, your hair will be softer and more relaxed using this.

The B & P does not have Silicones, parabens, and dyes.
No Animal testing , safe for colored hair, etc.

If I could give this more then 5 stars I would .

title: Under my eyes look smoother, gives a dewy look. I’m older and notice a difference.
text:
Didn’t know what to expect with this Tea & Tonic for under my eyes.

I have always use eye and face creams since high school ( my mother taught me) but using this underneath my eyes they look smoother!
I have also put this on my face under my face cream, and I get the same looking smoother effect.

I’m a very active great grandmother and I use a light make up and blush, I like the dewy youthful look this gives under my eyes and on my face.
So far I have been getting allot of complaints since I have been using Urbana, wish it came in a bigger tube.
Has a Very slight lovely scent that does not last long unfortunately.

title: Leaves my hair smooth with body.
text:
I love this on my blonde weave that was dry, and is not anymore after using this.

Since using this on my hair it blows out smooth, and has allot of body.
On the jar it says to use this as a leave in on damp or dry hair without rinseing out..Although on Amazon it says to
Leave this on for 3 mins then rinse out, that I didn’t do.

This coconut and hibiscus curl enhancing smoothie works better for my hair then Pureology shampoo and conditioner .
Great price for 10.19 for a large jar.

title: Very clear mag, and reg mirror..plug in, or Batteries .
text:
Very nice looking brush stainless magnifying mirror on one side, and the other side is the regular mirror.
The mirror is very clear, not wavy on both sides.
This comes with a plug, or use 4 AA batteries, does not come with batteries.
At the bottom is the switch for on , and off.
With The light plugged in it’s Very bright.
I like that I can pick up this mirror, flip it over, and look at the back of my hair in my big bathroom mirror.

I like this but I find its too big for my bathroom counter, and my dressing room is a double sink, with cabinets but I probably
Have too much stuff on the counter for this, or I’m just use to my smaller magnifying goose neck mirror on the counter, that I also travel with.

I’m not taking any stars off cause its big for me, as Most people would like this mirror, there is nothing not to like about it.
This was packaged very well.

title: Too thick a texture for me,covers a scar on ankle, and acouple of age spots on my hands.
text:
First I want to say, I was surprised when I received this, as it is such a small container!
I’m not a women that uses allot of blending brushes, and do not have long finger nails, although have manicures
Every week. This is the size of a eye shadow container, and is hard to get the pad of my finger to get the foundation out. I Have thin fingers.

I don’t wear heavy makeup, but this does cover nice when I use it right over my day face cream, It moves around better.
I have a darker scar near my ankle, and it covered good, and the couple of age marks on my hands also.
Although the color on me looks peachy compared to the color on my screen that looks more like a flat brownish!
I’m fair with blue eyes, lite hair.

I’m a fan of Bobbie Brown makeup in a tube, and sometimes revlon pump, For me those are lighter in texture and I'm guessing that is What I like..

title: My skin  looks smoother
text:
I Have been using No 7 lift for about two weeks, and have to say I notice the fine lines around my mouth look better,
And my face looks smoother.
I’m a older women.
But I think its a bit drying, and for my age I do not have dry skin.
After I put this on, I wait a few minutes and it absorbs well, then I use another day cream, and light make-up and blush.

I would buy this again.
Wasn’t this at one time called, Boots no.7?

title: Very nice scent. No more crying combing 4 & 6 yr hair out, and my hair is smoother ..
text:
Very nice Scent.
I like the Pantene conditioner detangler. It works very good on the girls, 4 & 6 that have long hair with a slight curl that gets to be a dantangled mess By the end if the day, and after there bath and hair washed.
After its toweled dry just spray it on, and the come goes right through like butter.

I have a blonde weave in my shoulder length thick hair that is damaged. I do use Pureology shampoo & conditioner , but this
Does give a extra smooth look after spraying it, and I do not use much.

My complaint is the spray comes out in a long stream, not a mist, or a full type of spray!
I have to admitt I have not tried the other bottles.

title: Hair felt and looked like straw using a small amount .
text:
Maybe this mousse is for curlier hair then mine!
Although I thought this would give my soft curl more definition, that didn’t happen either.
I have a blonde weave in my hair.

After washing my hair and towel drying I put a small amount of this Pantene curl mousse on my hand, then my hair, mainly put
More at the bottom of my hair where the curl is..My hair is not what I would call curly, I have a soft curl at the bottom, and a little wave .
My hair is shoulder length with allot of body, and gets a little frizz.
I kept scrunching my hair while drying.
After my hair drying my haur looked dry, and my curl in the side of my hair felt stiff which I hate..Maybe put more there!
Then comb it out with a thick comb and sprayed it with aussie sun touched shine hair spray, which is not really a holding spray, (love this spray it keeps frizz down)..then to give my hair more shine, I used Bamboo luminous shine mist. My hair was Not oily , it was back to not looking like Straw..

For my hair I’m Not a fan of this mousse.

title: No frizz, light shine. Love this .
text:
I didn’t know what to expect from this Aussie shine spray!
But it is Not stiff, but keeps my hair in place, yet lets it move.
My hair comes to my shoulders, has a very Natural lose curl as I have gotten older, although can blow it straight , and has a blonde weave.
It gave my hair a slight shine, but also there was No frizz at all or was that from my Pureology shampoo, and conditioner!
I wash my hair everyday, but the next day my hair looked great.

I love this, and 3 for a very reasonable price...

title: Love the scent, No sulfates
text:
I love the scent of roses in this .

The word on the bottle says, Sans sulfate, which Sans in french means, Without..
The Pantene rose water shampoo and conditioner is Free of sulfate that drys out your hair, and coats your hair that it loses all the moisturize.

My hair has a blonde weave ,and I noticed the color has stayed the same since I had it weaved acouple of weeks ago.
That said I did not care for the texture of my hair after I shampooed, and condition with this Pantene!
This is a good price for this set of shampoo, and conditioner, but it just does not leave my hair the same as soft and frizz free as Pureology does, although I sure wish it did, as Pureology is pricey.

title: Dyes & sulfates in this. Itchy scalp.
text:
You get allot of shampoo and conditioner for a good price.
The shampoo suds up well, and conditioner leaves your hair soft.

That said I’m disappointed by all the chemicals that are in both the shampoo and conditioner.
The ingredients are written So small and run together your get the message they do not want you to know what is in this!
And I can’t pronounce them!

The second ingredient in the Shampoo is Sodium laureth sulfate, and the 3rd is the same..
Also Yellow #5, Red # 33, Blue #1 !
Why are there any dyes! They cause cancers.

The conditioner has Yellow #5,and Red #33! Why?
The chamomile, aloe, and passion flower, are just Extracts which to me doesn’t say much!

With all the chemicals and dyes could be the reason my scalp itches from using these!

title: Scent is great, A light detangler works great for kids.
text:
A wonderful scent of fresh green apples.

The 4 and 6 yr. old girls have long hair with a curl ,and they cry when having there hair combed out after a shampoo and a bath everynight..there hair has a curl.
I didnt want to use a heavy conditioner on there hair.
This Aussie kids detangler works well for there hair, not too heavy, just enough to comb there hair out
With a large tooth comb and,
No more crying.

Aussie works well on adult hair also, and not too heavy.

title: Great product, be careful using it every shampoo.
text:
The celeb gem colorwash shampoo is very pigmented.
I don’t suggest using it everytime you wash your hair because it will just keep adding pegment.
It’s great if that’s what you want, but for a toner wise, just be careful.
It is a great product though.

title: Drys fast, love this color, goes on same color as bottle shows.
text:
Love this color. It is “400 Lava Rocks”., and it Rocks.

Its a steel gray , on the dark side. The color it shows in the bottle is the same color on my nails.
There is a very slight bit of frost to it, and I never would wear a frosted polish, but it doesn’t show, or its why this is shiny!
It does say to use two coats, and you have too. I always use a base coat (opi) and two coats of polish and opi Rapi dry.
By just giving this a try this has allot of shine, and drys super fast.
The polish is thin.

It says its Vegan, and I’m vegan , but not so sure the wording on this is just a hype to sell this!
Or it means there is no animal product in this, or no testing on animals!
I would hope there has Never been before,no animal testing.

I’m usually not a fan of Sally Hansen, but I would buy this again.
I do not know if this is a good value, as it Does not show the prices!
10ml. O.33 fl. Oz.

title: Made my skin Dry!
text:
The Revlon prime is suppose to make your pores smaller.

Before putting this on my face, I applied two different moisturizer I use everday when I come out of the shower.
I have tried this revlon Prime a few times ,and it seem to dry my skin.!
When it got on my lips They became very dry also.
That said I have used other products for making pores smaller, and then my face looked smoother, but not with this Revlon
Prime plus for me.

title: Nice scent not strong, To many chemicals,dyes, my scalp felt itchy.
text:
This has a nice scent to it, and not strong.
Not tested on animals.

The shampoo is thin, Not a Rich shampoo that I usually use, but did lather up..
The regular conditioner is silky after I blew my hair dry, and had a shine, but did not leave my hair with much body!

My hair is to my shoulders, and has a blonde weave which gives body to your hair. By the end of the day my hair was limp.

My main complaint is, there is Some many chemicals , Dyes in the shampoo, and conditioner.
The second time I used this my scalp was itching me.

title: Not a gel, Not slimy, its a cream, it smoothes out fine lines on lip, also on chest.
text:
I was hesitant to order this and use it!
The name threw me off, but I was curious, and so glad I gave this Snail Gel a chance.
Btw this is not a gel, and it’s not slimy.
It is a wonderful thickish white cream for my aging face, neck, and chest. This definitely a night cream.

I’m older and see positive results. Above my lip where I’m starting to get lines etc. this has smoothed it out, and
Between my eyebrows where allot women get there first botox..

I’m looking good, and the price is fair..
5 stars

title: Keeps my skin hydrated, I like the rose scent..
text:
With winter here with rain, a little snow , and the fireplace my skin has been dry.
I have been using the Kai Rose body butter, and I love it, and there oil spray.
This is a different scent from the oil spray that I can’t get enough of. This Rose scent is a little strong but doesn’t last long,
Although the Butter does.
There is allot of natural ingredients in this, and it proves its self with keeping my skin hydrated.

If your not a fan of the Rose scent this might not be for you!

title: Love, Love, love this Scent.
text:
Update. The more I use the Kai body glow I notice my skin is feeling smoother, softer, and my hands look younger ! I’m a older women , and notice any new line lol.
————
I’m in Love with this scent.
This has a scent that I could Not belive how Beautiful it is. It’s light airy refreshing, and not overpowering.
I would not change anything about it.

After a shower I put my scentless moisturizering lotion on, then after a few minutes, I then sprayed on
Kai body glow..I love the scent, I just wished it stayed on longer. Although I usually wear an expensive perfume that
I get allot of compliments on, but I don’t smell it after acouple of hours as I think we get use to a scent
I’ll be using this Kai body glow more often now.

The oil is light, absorbs in your skin fast, although I don’t notice it on my skin,
And I don’t care for the oily shiny look on my skin..

Definitely 5 stars

title: Plant based, not plastic, glides through his beard.
text:
The wahl Comb is different for your beard- moustache then other regular plastic combs.
The comb does not feel like a cheap plastic comb. It’s quality, it is plant based, is hand crafted as the teeth have round edges, and are very smooth.

My husband has been using this comb for a while, and it does not pull on his beard, or moustache, it glides through.
The comb makes it easier for him to trim his moustache and beard.

He would recommend this comb to anyone that has a beard.

title: I’m older using this the lines above my lip is disappearing away 👍
text:
I have a few fancy expensive face creams, and when I received this I was thinking, I hope its not all about the looks of
The Packaging , as I have noticed with the other ones it is.
Well, it’s Not with this one.

I’m older, and my skin is not dry, but not oily as when I was younger.
When I opened the jar I noticed this is thick, Not watery. When I put my finger in the jar put a little on my face it went right in.
Put this all over my clean face, and again my skin drank it up.

I’m not a smoker but Above my upper lip I’m getting those fine lines that I'm Not happy about.
Using this for a few days, about 3 times a day, and before going to bed on my upper lip around my mouth those lines are Melting away! Yes they are.

I don’t have dark spots on my face, but have a few on my hands so I’ll be trying this on the top of my hands, and on my husbands
Dark spots on his face, and hopefully with a little time they will start lightening up..

But for the fine lines on my face I’m Very Impressed, as I saw those melting away right away.

There are no harsh ingredients in this .
5 stars..

title: Metallic colors do not show up good, plastic bag .
text:
Large plastic looking makeup bag.

All the metallic colors in the pictues is not what I recieved, or mine is different!
It will show a little bit of the colors if you move the bag the right way, or its basically white. The inside is white plastic.
This bag is big and square with the only zipper is at the top, it zips just, ok.

This bag looks like it was a give away if you bought a certain about if there products.
Not a fan that cover girl is written on ithis, or this bag.

title: At first it feels like silicone, then dries fast, and my lips feel dry.
text:
The tube the Zing lip color comes in looks good. It is a black square with Zing on it, a clear line
Down the middle that shows the color, and I’m guessing shows how much is in the tube when you keep using. I like
That idea.

I’m fair and wear light color lipsticks, but at first this looks like it has a white frost when I put it on, or it’s too light for me.
On my lips it feels like a thin silicone, then dries fast, and my lips feel dry.

I’m not a fan of this product for me.

title: Looks thick in jar, but was too thin for me, but my neck likes it..
text:
Love the Rose scent.

In the jar this looks like a thick cream, and a little does goes a long way.
I found for my face it was not thick, but more on the thin side, but absorbed Pretty good, but was not as moisturizing for my skin as I need.
I’m older and my skin can be dry depending on the facial wash I use, or oily., and my face absorbs facial creams very well so this
Was not my problem.
This was not a thick enough cream for my face, it felt watered down!

I like it for my neck, and will continue to use it.

title: Look too pale, like it on my eyebrows it keep the pencil color from smudging off.
text:
This cames in a lovely little round box, with a pink puff inside.
The powder has a soft texture to it.
I’m older and my skin is not dry, but this is too dry for me, and I look too pale, although I put my blush on after.
What I do like this for is, I do like to put this on My eyebrows before using the eyebrow pencil, as it keeps the pencil color from smudging off.

Glad to see this is cruelty free.

3 1/2 stars

title: Lips,  mouth , hands look hydrated after two weeks.
text:
I have been using Embryolisse skin cream around and on my lips for over a week.
I notice the fine lines are looking a little better, and my lips feel smoother.
At first this does sting a little on my lips, but they are smoother.

It is a white cream that absorbs quickly, leaves a little film on my hands, and my older hands hydrated, and smoother looking.
I did not notice anything at first, but after a couple of weeks I can see abit of a difference.

title: Shaves close, can use same razor about 10  times.
text:
Theses Gellette razors are good razors, and gives you a close shave.
It says there disposable, and gives 10 fresh shaves, that is pretty much true my son said, and he has to shaves every day.
The pivot heads do adjust to the shape of your face, and so far no nicks.
Has the lube-strips that give a close shave with a easy to use none slip handle.

8 comes in a pack. Good value.

title: Great clear mirror, with 1x and 5x magnify.
text:
I love this mirror in my dressing room.
My husband who is not handy put this on the wall next to my sink.
The arms where a bit stiff at first, there long, and I can see the back of my hair, and give it a quick snip!

Actually I can see allot with this mirror.
One side is 1 x magnify, and the flip side is 5 magnify . Great the 5 x for putting on eye makeup, makeup etc I can really see what I’m doing, And how I’m doing it.

I would recommend this mirror.

title: Messy but works
text:
I do like this school egg mask.

I washed my face, then put it on, and laid down on my back for about 20 mins.
My face looked and felt smoother, and the pores seemed allot smaller.
It is a bit messy but it’s worth it, although for abour 7 bucks for one mask I think it is pricey.
I’m a older woman, and if I notice a positive difference right away I’ll be buying these.

I also noticed on Amazon there is one seller, with only one for sale!

title: This will Last you for Halloween..
text:
This Wig comes with a net, and instructions.
I realize this wig is a good price, but it doesn’t fit right.
It will look good for Halloween, it’s scary looking, and a one time wear only.

Looks good on my Husky!

title: Like it on my neck, use it on my legs when wet out of the shower.
text:
There is not any parfume scent to this Carrot Seed Oil, and it is not thick, which I like..
The oil is 100% pure, natural, cold pressed & unrefined.

Its a little heavy for my face, but I like it on my neck, chest, hands, feet, nails etc..
This is a small bottle 1oz. With a dropper to apply. I put this on my hands to apply.
I have used it on my legs , arms when there wet coming out of the shower.
This spreads farther when my skin is wet.

title: Has Acetone, hard to take my polish off with this., pricey.
text:
I use a base coat, then two coats of Opi polish, and Opi RapDri top coat every night, and my polish stays fresh and shinny for
Over a week.
That said if I don’t have a acetone in my polish remover it takes forever to get my polish off.
This Mountain Falls does have Acetone in it, but not much, seems like this is watered down.

My other polish remover is a larger bottle, does have acetone, plus other things in it, is 1/2 the price, takes the polish off in less time, and I think my nails are in better condition.
Although this does take my polish off easier then targets Acetone polish remover, but that is only a dollar or two!

title: I like the scent of the Charming Rose, and does not make me sick. Not a fan of the bottle.
text:
I received Charming Rose, and I really like it.
I’m sensitive to some perfumes since I had Pneumonia about 3 yrs ago, and in the hospital for 4 days, and this scent did not bother me.
It is hard for me to discribe the scent but I can smell the rose in this, and other delicate scents.

On my body the scent lasted over two hours, and on my clothes longer...

I usually wear Givenchy Organza , and on me I get allot of compliments, and what is it your wearing ?, although I do
Not smell it..Some of my friends love it on me, but not on them selfs, and there disapointed.
That said, we all have our own body chemistry, and what has a nice scent on some, will not smell the same on someone else.
So it is hard To know how this will smell on you.
For me, I’m happy with the scent.

What I don’t care for is the bottle with that stripe down the middle! And the look and feel of the bottle.
To me it’s Plastic, but I can’t imagine that it really is. Its just cheesy .

title: Hair did Not get frizzy, great for traveling.
text:
This compact blow dryer is perfect for traveling.
I love the color as well.
Has a good amount of power. Easy to read the buttons.
Did not make my hair frizzy at all.
Definitely would prefer any hot tools blow dryer to anyone.
I have not had any issues with any Hot Tools or Dryers.
Great company, and the price is right.

title: Left a soft curl. Nice scent
text:
This has a nice soft scent to it.

My hair is not that curly, and my hair dresser cut my hair too short trying to cut off my old weave.!..
That said I put this on my hair after I toweled dryed it..I did not use much, but it did Not leave my hair a crunchy mess after I
Dryed it with a defuser on my hair dryer.
My hair felt soft after, has a curl to it, but the next day before I got in the shower, my scalp itched me. Although there are
Allot of other products that do also.
If your scalp is sensitive I would pass.,

title: Covers my dark sun spots as I get older. The light color is perfect for me.
text:
I have tried a few different concealers to cover some dark spots on my face, hands and chest as I get older.
None have worked as good as this Almay concealer.
This last longer, and does cover, and blend in perfect for my skin color.

I’m fair with blue eyes.. I have tried this on some sun spots on my chest also, looks great, you can’t see it on my skin.

For me it did not conseal as good for my dark circles under my eyes as good as, Loreal true match does.

That said, this Almay is the best I have tried, in the color Light..this goes on smooth, does not cake, and I bearly have to blend it in, and its Not heavy. I do not wear this all over my face.

I put on two different types of moisturizer, then a light weight make up, then I touch up any dark spots with Almay, then a light blush.
This works for me.

Btw, when I first saw this I was disappointed as I thought, omgosh this is so light, but once I used it , I was surprised how great it is.

title: Use right before getting out of shower.Body feels smoother.
text:
I use this in the shower right before getting out, and still wet.
I start rubbing this into my legs, body, arms..I do feel soft.But I always used body lotion after showering, and
on my hands and during the day.
I do notice the bottom of my feet are smoother, but be careful you do not slip in the shower .

I notice this body oil does not absorb as fast as lotion does at all, or I’m using too much oil!
Some people like the oil shinning look on there body, I’m not a fan of that look. After I apply this I wait awhile, and still
put on body lotion..

If scents bother you, this might be too strong for you.

title: Blonde looks Auburn, and a bit shinny. Not a good look.
text:
I ordered the Blonde, and on my eyebrows it comes out looking Auburn! Not a good look.
I have never had this happen before using any eyebrow blonde pencil before..

It also does not go on looking like small strokes. but more of a shiny wax type of pencil.
The price was too good to be true!

title: Comes with pencel sharpener, pencel lead is thick. Ended up with black eyes underneath.
text:
This eyeliner pencil comes with a sharpener, although its a little hard to find, but it’s in the box.
The sharpener has a thin pin that I think is to get the left over lead out after you use the sharpener.

But I ended up with black eyes under my eyes..Not a pretty !

title: This makes my hair Silver Not blue or purple. Hair is soft , Not limp
text:
Up date. Still love this, but hated my white hair, and now it’s back to brown with. Blonde weave. My hair grows fast, in 8 months it grew out, now back to shoulder length And longer.
———————
I’m finally letting my blonde weave grow out to my natural white Silver color.
My hair is shoulder length.

I have used the purple shampoo’s and conditioner’s . Some have made my scalp itch, but all have made my hair have a slight blue look, which is Not pretty to say the least.

Keracolor is the only shampoo Conditioner in one , But has given my hair the Silver color , not blue.
I love this Silver color and I’m getting compliments.

In the bottle This is not Purple, it’s more of a thick darker gray Silver color. When I get in the shower I wet my hair then put this on my hair as a shampoo, Leave it on till I finished washing , then everything washed off while I’m still in the shower. It’s so easy.
You don’t need to use much, but that depends on how long your hair is.
I do Not need to wear gloves it comes right off my hands, Nothing stains your body.
I do not have to use another conditioner . It leaves my hair soft, but Not limp, and gives my hair body.

This is thick and has a pump, I do not have to use it everyday, and the silver color stays in. I wash my hair almost everyday with shampoo for color treated hair and a good regular conditioner.
But truthfully my hair looks and styles better using Keracolor.

Hope this helps. 5 stars

title: Big bulky , good for long thick hair.
text:
I wasn’t expecting such a Large brush, hair dryer.and handle!

This is good if you have at least shoulder length thick hair, but I can not actually curl my hair with this, as it’s bulky.
I found it very good to put this threw my hair to straighten it, or a slight curl. Since this is bulky to use, it took a few times to get use to it.
This does work good .but If it was a smaller heat brush I would use it.

The dial is on the largest part of the handle. When you twist it, it goes on,,
The dail reads, off, cool, low, high..

title: Scent is not great, but if it does what it says, I’ll be happy.
text:
This is my first bottle of Jamaican Black Castor Oil..
I have another castor oil, but its thinner then this oil, and the scent is allot different, but if this does what it says about
the benefits, for hair, joints, skin and more, I’m all right with it.
The scent is NOT my favorite!

When I put this on my hands, nails, a little on my body it takes a little time to absorb, and for the scent to go away.

title: Love the scent, and my older hands feel and look smoother.
text:
Scent is heavenly and light,, and the texture for hand and body lotion is just right.

I have never heard or knew about this before, but going to look at more of there beauty products.

title: Covers dark spots, creamy. Blends nice.
text:
I’m fair, and usually consealers are too dark, or too light.
For me this blends right into my coloring, and covers acouple of darker spots I have.
I also put this on my hands, then I covered my hands with a light powder, which kept it from coming off..Although once I wash
My hands or put lotion on, it does come off. Then Reply.

title: Big nice mirror is not Magnifying, , comes with a tiny little magnifying mirror on the back.
text:
Nice clear mirror that has 3 different color led lights around the whole mirror.
The mirror was a no brainer to put together..very easy.
Seems steady, but kind of cheesy!
The base is large.

When the lights are on, there is are white circle around the black pupil of my blue eyes, its a bit strange.

2. Brightness UP.
