The big mirror is a bigger size then I thought it was going to be! It moves back and forth for your convenience.

title: Black under my eyes!
text:
I expected more from this mascara.
It went on ok, but I got little specks that come off on my face, and did not use allot, not a pretty sight!
The black color is good.
I use Merle Norman water proof mascara, and sorry but this does not come close, and I had black under my
Eyes in a short time.

title: Nice travel case for small items, and the motor home, camping etc.
text:
Love the red color.
The zippers work well, and there is NOT a strong chemical scent to this as other material travels bags I have had, and had to throw out.

This makes a nice travel bag for small containers , eye make up, and blush, tube of make up, eye liner, mascara, small jar of
Moisturizer etc.
There is a few little netted holders space in this, that you can see what you have.

I hang this by the plastic hook, and leave it open, which makes it more convenient for me.
There is a top handle to carry this when it’s zipped together, closed.

I Do Not find this handy for my shampoo, and conditioner. It depends how long your hair is, how long your going to be gone, and pouring them in small bottles is not enough shampoo, and conditioner for me.. this also does not hold your brushes, or hair sprays. Although there are larger cases that do.

I also like this case for short trips, and for our motor home.

title: Body and feet feel smooth.
text:
I have been using this set of Eucerin body wash, and body Lotion for over a week every day, but the body lotion
For my hands, and arms at least 3 times aday, or more..

I notice my feet, And bottom,of my feet are smooth, Although I have nice feet that are not rough on the bottom etc.

I do not like that the body wash does Not have a pump, It’s a pain in neck . The body lotion has a pump that works very good.
I also use another body wash, and body lotion, and at this point I think I like it better, as my body wash is more moisturizing, and might be less money!
Although I do like this Eucerin.

title: Too Thick, not natural looking for me.
text:
The compact is nice, but not great looking, with a sponge underneath.

This said, Light weight to medium coverage.
I’m light, blue eyes, and it did not say the color, and this shade is white, and is too thick of a coverage for me. I’m also a older women, and do not need to put thick make-up over my face.
Maybe I’m just use to wearing Bobbi Brown liquid that is sheer, and looks more natural.

That said, Bobbi Brown does not made my make up anymore, and I am looking for something else to replace it,
and this Honest makeup is not for me.

title: A little heavy..Better for your hair then a hot iron.
text:
This electric hot brush is only on one side.
In-between the hard plastic bristles is the medal part that heats up.
Push the button two times and it will turn on.
There is high, medium and low. I used the medium, and do not touch the medal as it gets hot.
The back has ridges that did not work for my hair, what ever it was suppose to do!

I’m not a sleeper then toss and turns, and actually my hair looks pretty good in the morning, I and my husband said..lol.
And I wash my hair everyday, although trying to get out of that habit. My hair dresser said wash your hair every other day.

My hair is almost to my shoulders, and after washing and blow drying my hair, I used this to kind of get any
any frizz out, and shape my hair a bit..
This is kind of heavy. I usually use a large round brush and hair dryer to dry my hair.
As I said, I dried my hair then used this to get some hight in the top of my hair.
Its ok, Or I need to use this more to get use to it!

It is less damaging to your hair then a hot iron.

title: Does not have cosmetic pockets, not a fan.
text:
This is a type of material you just have to wipe down, do not put it in the washing machine, and for sure Not the dryer.

This looks to me like its a plastic type of material, but its not..The color pink is ok..
When I travel which is allot, I like to have my things stand up, such as my bottles etc. in thisI have to lay them down. Such as my blush brush, mascara, lipstick, makeup, tubes ,face cream should fit into something that is not with everything else.
That is the problem I have with this, everything basically is all together laying down.
This would Not hold my shampoo, conditioner, face wash, hair brushes, as I don’t want my hair brush with my tooth brush, and cosmetics etc.
I think it needs some pockets in this, as I guess that is what I’m use to..

It does have a larger bottom part, and the top is not deep either.It is light weight, you cannot open this and hung it . Lay it on the counter in the bathroom.

Its good for kids for a sleep over. They can roll there clothes and put it in etc.

title: Blonde came out Dark brown on my eye brows, I looked like I had man brows.  A joke!
text:
I’m fair with light eyebrows. When i used this revlon blonde eyebrow marker my eye brows where a very dark brown,
And looked like I had thick dark brown Mens eye brows.
It was laughable.

The other side of the stick you unscrew, and has a very small round sponge, I think that might have powder on it to be used under your Eyebrow to look good!
I could not tell that I put anything on my brow bone!

I put this on the inside if my wrist from this pencil, looks to be some type of a light color liquid that dries fast.!

Might work well for someone else, but not me.

title: A Bright Pink
text:
Tube is nice, and it unscrews, does not pull off.
The lipstick went on soomth.

I’m fair with blue eyes, and This color is awful for me. It is a bright, bright, Pink.
I tried to put a lighter color lipstick over this, but it didn’t work , it would probably be a nice color on someone with
A darker skin color then I have.

title: Not sticky, or thick, very light color.
text:
I like this lip gloss. It’s NOT thick and sticky.
I would have liked it better if it was the color it showed. I’m fair, and this just gave me a little color, but more of a shine. I did not
Notice this plumming up my lips!
I do not Wear bright lip sticks.

This comes in a nice looking square clear looking glass tube, with a thin stick of gloss inside down the middle.
If you wear a small purse I think this tube takes up too much space, and is not necessary for the small amount of gloss your getting,
But does look classy.

title: A nice delicate Rose scent, Not a cheesy scent. I like it.
text:
Wild Rose.

I can remember my mother using different Elizabeth Arden facial items , and perfumes when I was a child as they have been
Around for many years.
I recieved the Wild Rose perfume., and also there Vanilla Orchid.
The packaging is a nice presentation, and nice to give as a gift.

This Wild Rose is the one I like. When I first sprayed it on my wrist I thought it was strong, but after waiting about 5 mins
It started it’s magic, and it has a lovely scent.
I like the Rose scent, it is not too strong. I wish it would last longer then about 4 hours!

I usually use a different perfume that I have had many complaints on, even hours later, so I’m thinking
This scent can be lasting longer, but I’m use to it, and I’m not smelling it, but it is still senting out a scent!

title: Doesnt have any nasty stuff, is vegan, didn't work for me.
text:
I have used Biolage shampoo and conditioner before, and have always liked them, but not RAW color care like this one, and I’m assuming its new!
The R.A.W conditioner does not have any nasty stuff in it, and is Not tested on animals as it’s Vegan.

I have been coloring my hair since high schools with blonde weaves, and now have Grandkids etc. My hair is not in the best condition, and I decided to Let my natural color grow out. Its only grown out about 3 inches or more, to a shinny nice silver color.
That said I thought this would make my dyed hair shinier. And even my natural color, That did not happen.
I do have thick hair with a slight curl.
My hair felt matted down, and dirty!
I wash my Hair everyday, it is to my shoulders.

I might be the only one this happened to, but it just didn’t work for me.

title: On me has a vanilla scent.
text:
The bottle, packaging, and presentation are lovely.Nice to give as a gift.
The sprayer work great, it goes where you direct it, but allot comes out.
I can remember Elizabeth Arden from years ago, when I was a child, and liked there products as I grew up.

One of my daughters loves this Vanilla scent, as she likes vanilla.

After a few minutes I just smell vanilla on me, and I'm not a fan of wearing vanilla!
I have a Orchid plant in my home, and I have never noticed Orchids to have a scent, there just beautiful.
I also think the scent is strong, and does last a long time.

That said, I have found almost every perfume smells different on just about everyone..
I have been wearing the same perfume for years, and get many compliments, and some of my friends have bought it, and it does not smell The same on them as they say.. It is pricey and I don’t think perfume can be returned!
Btw, there are times I do buy and wear other perfumes, but my favorite is still what I wear just about everyday. For me it works.

Vanilla is just not my scent, but I’m sure others will love this scent.

title: Does moisturizer my skin.
text:
I like this Tom of Maine Moisture body wash.
It does moisturizer my body, but I still use body lotion after a shower..
I’m older and I do notice that my skin is not as dry.

I’m not a fan of this Scent, although I do like the scent of lavender, and grow lavender plants in my garden.
That said I I’ll continue to use this, as I notice it does help my skin.

I’m Not taking off a star , as it does what it says it does..
5 stars.

title: Covers  streaky..
text:
I like the color, but the polish goes on streaky, and polish is thin.
It takes 3 coats to look good, and a long time to dry.

I used a base coat, and Opi rapi dry.
As far as this Sally Hansen strengthening my nails I didn’t notice that.

Do not recommend.

title: Dragged across my face, faux hairs are not soft.
text:
I was excited to get this powder brush, as the brush I was using was 25 yrs old. I didn’t need a new brush, as my Sable brush
Is still Like New after using it everyday, and many hand washes. Think the old brush was under $10.00 new
I wanted this new Revlon brush as a animal was not killed so I could have a new makeup brush.
Btw my family are hairdresser for the film industry, and I have owned a large hair salon, and beauty supply in Ca.

After using the revlon brush just the first time I noticed it dragged across my face, this new brush is not nearly as soft as my old brush and The hairs are not nearly as long..
I was not happy to read the new revlon brush has anti-bacterial on it. Sounds like a gimmick to me, as we are finding we are getting too much Anti bacteria products that are killing the good bacteria.
I just washed the new, and my old brush. I noticed the new revlon brush had some faux hairs come out, but none from my
Old brush . That just said to me, the new brush is not put together as good, its All plastic, and it is heavier then my old brush.

I would not buy a animal brush again, but I have found there are other faux brushes that are softer then this revlon brush is,
Not as heavy, and has longer faux hairs on it. But this revlon brush looks good!

2 stars

title: Works good for flatter items, not  jars etc. Not heavy.
text:
This is a cute bright pink Toiletry Bag.
The zippers work pretty good, and there is a hook to hang this.

I wanted to use this when I go back and forth to my summer home. But this is rather small.
It does not hold small jars for face cream, eye cream, etc. I do not wear allot of make-up.
it will hold small tubes for eye liners,eye pencils, brushes, make-up tubes, mascara, lipstick etc.
Everyone uses different toiletries.
The fabric is not great, and the inside netting is stiff.. I’m not sure how long this will last for!

I took a chance getting another one .
This bag came wrapped very nice, and there is No odor.
Glad I did get it..

title: Made my white hair darker, Not silver, Not  a fan.
text:
My hair is growing out natural after years of dyes, and weaves. Its white, silver and a little salt and pepper on the sides and back ( so far!)

So I got this whole sale and not from Amazon, which I love.

I, or my family has Nothing to do with Pureology

title: Scent is beautiful.
text:
The scent is heavenly.
Jasmine is one of my favorites.
This Softsoap not only has a good scent, but leaves my hands feeling good, and the scent lingers, but
Does not take over my perfume.
I like this is Not a Antibacterial soap that leaves your hands dry, and it’s been proven if you wash your hands for
20 to 30 seconds you will kill more bacteria, then a quick wash with Antibacterial soap...
Also we are killing some good bugs using antibacterial soap.

Con:
I don’t care for the looks of the bottle, I think its cheesy looking.
I poured this soap into a stainless soap container with a pump.
I also do not care for the additives in this.
That said, I’m giving this soap a 4 star.
Like the scent & hands feel soft.

title: Did Not burn my dyed and bleach hair. Its smooth, love this.
text:
Before using this flat iron my daughter came over, and asked why did you get this, as there is no temperature gauge on these!
As I did complain about another flat iron I have with no temp gauge, I threw that one out, but To my Surprise I’m really impressed with this iron.

First let me say, my hair is dyed, and with a blonde weave, and for the first time since I was in high school I decided to let my hair grow out natural, Silver...It has grown out about 3 inch , and I have to say I didn’t realize how damaged my dyed hair is compared to the feel of my natural silver hair.
I was afraid this iron with out a temp gauge was going to burn my dyed hair , and my silver natural hair..as my other hot iron
Burned my hair.
This CHI did Not burn my hair, it glided threw my hair and even the dyed mess was smooth to my surprise.
My hair is about to my shoulders.

Before ordering this iron, I Thought saying this is a Lava , blah, blah , bluh etc. was just new type of hype to sell these!
Not for me it isn’t. As I said, my damaged hair is smooth with allot of body and swing to it.

title: Love this brush. Hair dried real fast. Bristle grab hair easy.
text:
I have been using a natural boar bristle round brush forever, and I thought I loved it!
Just using this brush one time, I’m in love with this ghd brush..At first I noticed it was a bit heavier then my boar brush with the wood handle, but got Use to this real quick, as my hair dryed faster with this ventilating brush, and my hair looks good.
I also thought it might be too big, but My hair is almost to my shoulders . The size is just right, almost the same size as my other brush.

The one problem I have with this brush is, are these types of nylon bristle going to split and ruin my hair?
It’s too soon to know, but if I notice that it does, I will be back with a up-date

title: Nice scent, its a gel not a fan!
text:
I like the scent of this Hydro light gel, and it does last awhile.

Being this is a gel, When I first put this on my hands it feels like it won’t absorb, but it does pretty fast, but its sticky for awhile, but not long, then My hands feel soft, but they don’t look soft, or any different before I used this, if this makes sense!
There is some good ingredients in this, but there in a very small amount in this!, and other ingredients I’m not a fan of.

Guess I’m more into body butters, and cream lotions then a gel!

title: Has thin pencil, brown powder tip ,& brush. Good idea.
text:
The color is pretty good but could be lighter for me. It is blonde.

At one end you pull the cap off, and there is a thin eye brow pencil that you do not have to use a pencil sharpener, which goes on good. Use gentle strokes.
The other side is what they call a spooley to brush blend your eyebrows. The spooley is like your mascara brush, and I have
A few of those with nothing on them like this one is.
But the kicker is, when you unscrew the middle if this, there is a little tip that has a powder eye brow color on it to
Match the pencil.
I personally, like that the best. Or you can just use that little powder tip.
Then use your so called, Spooley brush and blend it in.

This does work good, and I do like the idea if it. Also a good price.

title: Nice for a regular shampoo
text:
My husband has been using this Catalase shampoo, and likes it.
Although if your gray hair is suppose to darken that is not happening.
I have been reading about Catalase and it seems it can bring back,your natural color hair,
Keep it from getting gray! Not sure how long that takes?

I’m letting my light br, and blonde weaved dyed hair grow out to my natural silver color, and don’t want to
Take a chance of this darkening the Silver..

3 star for a regular shampoo

title: Lips feel moisturized, no reaction, have not notice anything yet.
text:
I like this Beauty Bio lip plumper. but I’m not in love with it
I’m older and My lips are not as plump as they use to be, but there not thin..

The Lip Serum has ingridiance I have never heard of before!
It is kind of sticky like a lip gloss would be , and it keeps my lips from feeling dry. You do not need to use allot of this.
The serum comes out of the tube that has a stainless applicator with a little hole that the serum comes out off.
You can apply that directly to your lips or use your finger.

I have not notice any type of reaction from using this, and I’m not sure my lips are plumper!!
I will continue to use it, as I like that my lips feel moist, and if my lips look plumper I will be back to report it.

title: Amazing, tells you everything about your face and the products your using on your face.
text:
This HiMirror is the mini. They make a larger size, although I can’t imagine why!

This mirror does maybe more then I want to know about how my face is doing everyday!
You have to have a WiFi connection to use this.
The mirror will track your skins condition, and health, measure your products effectiveness , gives you personalized skincare tips.
Manage your skincare products, application for various needs,.
Will support 2 registered users, and guest users.
Lighting , magnifies , the lists goes on, and on etc..

This Has more information then I want to know about my skin!

That said, my daughter is in the film industry, and has the larger mirror and loves this, as others do.

The light, and magnifying is what I like the most so far!
The base is a bit heavy where your info is stored, and there is a camera to this, and other goodies. Some I cannot figure out.
This is not too big to travel with, but wrap it in a towel for traveling.

title: Works very good, does not pull his beard.
text:
I would say for $20.00 bucks this is a good value, and rechargeable, with out draging a cord while grooming.

I have been buying Wahl products for years, and also there clippers for my dogs, and Never had any problems.
This Wahl does a desent job, but not the top of there line.
It comes with more types of attachments for shaving your beard then you would probably need, and allot of extras, but good To have.

One of my sons keeps a short not bushy beard and is very glad to have this Wahl. It works great for him.

title: No itchy scalp, hair is smooth, and shinny after shampoo & conditioner.
text:
I like Hair Food shampoo, it has a light scent of coconut, and a flowery scent, although it doesn’t last long.
Washes my shoulder length hair well, and leaves it clean. I might add the conditioner is awesome. My hair is shinny, and smooth after
Using both the shampoo, and conditioner.
The pump is a added bonus. I dislike having to put a lid back on with a handful of shampoo in my hand, then most of it falls off on the floor of the shower instead of on my hair.

The hair food , is sulfate free, dye free , and the coconut oil, and spices are healthy for your scalp, and hair.

I have a autoimmune decease that causes my scalp to itch.
Using Hair Food, I do not notice my scalp itching...

The Hair Food is a win, win for me. My dyed hair is smooth & shinny, and No itchy scalp.

5stars.

title: Gave my dead dyed hair some life . Minimal ingredients. has more swing to my hair.
text:
I’m liking this conditioner.
My natural silver hair has been growing out for almost two months, and my dyed and weaved blonde hair is dead!
This hair food has actually given my dyed hair some life back. I can see the difference between my natural hair, and dyed hair.
After using Hair Food conditioner my old hair is soft, and does not have the look of as much damaged hair it was.
I Always use a conditioner everytime I wash my hair which is everyday, and I usually use Pureology that is expensive.
Using the hair Food conditioner I would have to say feels as soft, and looks just about the same as using my pricey Pureology ..

No Sulfates, or artificial colors , no paraben, or mineral oil.
There is a minimal amount of artificial junk in this, and not allot of ingredients, not saying this is petfect, but Allot better then most.

title: Made my hair soft, and itchy.
text:

Styling foam usually does give your hair body , and makes it a bit stiff. ( I use pureology).

This Nioxin I used mainly on my roots after shampooing & Conditioning, and towel dryed hair.
The only thing Nioxin did was, it made my hair soft like a conditioner would, and later that night my scalp started to itch!!

title: Mediocre shampoo..allot of suds. Tube is good for traveling.
text:
This L’oreal shampoo is Sulfate free, which I prefer .
This suds up pretty good with out having to use allot of shampoo.
I still had to use a conditioner after shampooing with this.

The tube is good for traveling, although I would still put this in a zip lock baggy.
I prefer a pump shampoo in my bathroom.

This is a mediocre shampoo. For the price this L’oreal is good value.
Had allot of ingredients I cannot pronounce!
This does not say if its tested on animals or not?

title: Good value, No Triclosan, lite scent.
text:
A good Amazon brand Antibacterial liqued hand soap.

The scent is pleasant, not strong. This is not real sudsy, but if you use more it is.

I put this soap in nice soap dispenser, and put them in my three bathrooms. In my guest bathroom I got compliments on the soap.

A very good value.

title: Works smooth, does not show temperature, just some odd numbers to dial in.
text:
Heats up Fast, glides threw my hair.
On the side of the top is a on- off button. Then a dial of some numbers!

When using the Remington flat iron keep your hands on the lower top that does not get hot. As it gets hot above and below

Hair type and dial.

Color treated 10-15.
Textured 16-24.

Still would like to actually see how hot those temps are.

title: Works good..A bit different..
text:

title: Absorbs, is not oily, No break outs,  face looks smoother.
text:

5 star.

title: Razor set for women and men.

title: Easy  de-dangler for fine curly kids hair, use wet or dry.

Girls are happy, I’m happy.

title: No Almond scent, and thin lotion.

Or guest bathrooms.

title: Blonde is draber., silver roots brighter.

title: Works on course beard..No pulling, cleans easy

title: No more frizz, hair is soft and shinny.
text:

text:

Use twice aday.
This a 5 star..

I do blow dry my hair, and tried to scrunch the bottom of my shorter hair. I think this did help , but not allot!

I have color on my hair, and a blonde weave. My hair is a bit thick. I use a conditioner, but this did not seem
Like a strong conditioner for my hair, although my hair is in good condition.
I did not notice any new shine in my hair!

My daughters hair is long, she likes this for the light curl in her hair.

title: Hair come out nice after color..Great Scent.
text:
Nice Jasmine scent that is one of my favorites. It is Not over powering and does not last long. (wish it was stronger)

My hair is fairly thick, not long. I use to have straight hair, but since I have gotten older its gray, Yuck.
I have a blonde weave, and color my roots every 2 1/2 weeks...
That said, since it turned gray it has a curl lite frizz to it, although I can straighten it with a round brush, easy.
My hair is in pretty good condition, but I use this HairRx Anti Frizz too shampoo the color out I just did,, and my hair
came out looking good, not any fly aways...Although I do use conditioner also, and blew it dry..

I like this shampoo and like how my hair come out...I Will be using it.
4 Star

title: Nice scent, didn’t notice much softness.Although shoulders & back felt softer.
text:
This Is a shower oil.
It pumped good on my shower mit, but I had to pump it at least 3 times a few times while showering.
I didn’t notice much suds, but my back skin felt smoother later.
I thought the cedar was a bit strong, but the orange had a nice scent.
Although the scent did not last long once out if the shower.

I have only used Happy Buddha a few times, and after I showered using it, I really did not notice a improvement of
The softness of my skin, but later I noticed my shoulders, and back felt softer..
I still used my body lotion after showering that I love.

title: Girls had fun with this set. Good price.
text:
Cute set for the 5 yr. and the almost 3 yr.old.
There is enough of everything in this set that the girls could share.
I layed out allot paper for the kids to make the perfume rollers, and glitter, and being its been such a hot
Summer and fires in California this kept them busy and not complaining having to stay in the house, and
away from the smoke and ashes.
This is also makes a fun set for the rainy winter.

The girls liked the scents, and decorating the bottles.
The clitter was a little messy, but that is what the paper was for. A easy clean up.

Good price. Would make a nice Birthday party gift for a friend.

title: Rich most lotion, strong scent.
text:
Rich moist body lotion.
I like this lotion, its thick and my hands look younger, my legs feel smooth.
As others have mentioned about the scent.. it is a bit strong.
My daughter said it smells like a baby lotion!

If your looking for a body lotion that is not strong, this will not be for you.

title: Did not not look good with my fair skin, although moisturizing.
text:
I recieved the Nude. It is very creamy, comes in a good looking lip-stick tube that has a little click when you close it.
It should not open Up in your purse.
I’m have fare light skin, light hair and this did not look good on me. It just blended in, and I looked totally washed out.
When my daughter tried it on, it looked mave very lite pinkish on her, and did look better, Although not her favorite.

This color is not for everyone

title: Tight cotton wrap, make-up artist will find many uses for these.
text:
This is plastic about the size of a Q-tip, but has different uses’s.
The tip is tightly wrapped in cotton with a pointed tip, and works good for having doe eyes that you sweep up-ward with shadow.
Ot use if you make a mistake to clean up.
The flat end is also tightly wrapped with cotton, but not as much as the other side.
Its good for the smudge look, and all to touch up, for lipstick blending etc.

If your a make-up artist you will find many uses for these.

title: Looked like a frosted silver color to me!
text:
I’m not into frosted nail polish, but I was courious about Paris & Vine from the reviews here.
The polish goes on smooth, but to my eye this was Silver and Not a rose gold color that I was expecting.
I usually wear Opi polish, and the paris & vine polish seemed to dry as fast as Opi.
Over this color I use Opi RapiDry, and it went on fine and dryed fast.

The large square black lid top was too big and would not open this polish , it just kept spining around, and came right off to expose
A little lid cover that I had to open this with!

title: Cleasing oil & face bar work good together.
text:
Didn’t know what to expect with this cleansing oil !
I’m older, and my face gets oily.

I washed my face with this in the shower, using my fingers to circle my face. Then rinsed my face.
Then used Erno Laszlo Firmarine face bar soap ( that I didnt care for till I used with the oil)
Just using the two, Two times, I have to say I’m impressed.

After drying my face, it does feel softer,and I think my skin looks more youthful but I could feel my face had something on it, but not heavy.
I then use eye cream, and a moisturizer ,my face is not oily. Then put on a light make-up, blush etc.
I do like this now.
I was not a fan of the face bar (gave it a bad review), but these two go together, and personally should be sold as a set for a better price!

title: Amazing, curls are soft.
text:
This is an amazing curl enhancer.
It’s a white cream in a large jar, nice scent not strong, that looks and feels like a conditioner, and to some extent it is. My daughter has color on her hair, and She has to use conditioner.
My Daughter has longer hair with a gentle curl, and to get the curl to look good she has to use a curling iron.
She put this in her hair while it was still damp while blow dry her hair, then put more in after her hair was dry.
The curl came in with shine, and does Not look greesy, or stiff.
Later after she came home, she put a little more in to freshen up the curls.
Her hair was soft, has shine, does not look dirty or greesy..( she washes it everyday & conditions it).

I tried Carols Daughter on my short hair, has color on it, is thick straight in places, but has a wave in other, also has curl in the back of my hair.
For my hair its like a leave-in conditioner. Makes my hair softer, and gave it more body...(Wash my hair everyday use a heavy conditioner)

This is different then other curl Enhancers as it does Not weight down your hair, or leave it dirty looking.

5 stars.

title: Comes in a nice case, it’s ok, I do not notice much yet!
text:
I have never used or heard of Erno Laszio products before, so this is new to me.

This says its a firming face bar of soap. I use it for my face to give it that extra left, but my body could use a little lift also.
So I’m also gently soaping my body. This gets sudsy. Guess I’m wasting it, and this is pricey!
After washing my face and body , everything feels Squeeky clean like cheap bar soap .
I prefer a pump soap for my body, and pump cleaner for my face.

I’m not impressed with this scent at all. I’m not sure what this smells like, just has a lite scent to it that does not last.
I have a beach home, and mountain home in Ca.and this does Not smell like Either one..Does not smell like any fresh mountain scent,
Or any beach breeze to me, although it is some what the color of the Ocean.

After I use this on my face in the shower in the morning, and evening, I use eye cream, I then put on my face Hyaluronic firming serum.
Wait for that to dry, then use rich moisturizing hydratant cream! After all this, I should look 25 yrs again, I wish.. Right now, I’ll take 50 yrs.

The truth is, I think I might look a little more youthful, Maybe!
Also for a moisturizer, I’m finding Eucerin Q10 Anti-Wrinkle cream works just as good or better as
Other more expensive moisturizers that I have..

title: Very nice thick body cream, legs & feet etc. feel smooth. Scent ,meh!
text:
I’m not familiar with Ritual Ayurveda body cream before.
But its not a body cream I want to use up fast, As my body, and feet feel very smooth from using this.
But its over $40.00 a jar! And I could through a jar a week or so.

This is a thick cream but goes on smooth, but you do have to use allot.
Other thick creams take awile to absorb.
Although my skin feels smooth, I wish there was a body cream that also firmed up my skin! Wishful thinking lol.

The jar is lovely, but I personally like a pump better then getting my fingers in the jar, and a pump is easier to use.
I have a thicker cream that is in a pump jar, so it could be done, but not as classy looking.

That said, this is lovely body cream. I’m into scents, and for me this is not my favorite!

title: Nice scent, cleans our hands.
text:
We like this Antibacterial soap. Yes it does not lather as much as other hand soaps,
But our hands are coming out clean, and feel pretty good after using this.
There is a lite scent that I really like, wish it lasted longer.

I would have liked to see this big bottle with a pump for the sink in the garage.
Although I put it in a dispenser in my 3rd bathroom that the kids use the most.

The price is good.

title: Works good for eye brows, and roots.
text:
Review for blonde, and brown.

Very nice black compact with a good applicator small brush
I recieved the blonde and the Brown for a temporary , powder to cover up my gray roots, or use for my eye brows.
The blonde looks like a very light brown, and the light brown looks a bit darker. When applied, the right colors show up.

When I went to use the blonde for my eye brows it came up a bit darker and perfect color.
On my gray roots, the color looked lighter, but I also ordered the brown, and when using that on my
Roots it covered pretty good. Although too dark for my eye brows, and blue eyes.

I like these two temporary colors. Does not run.

title: Seems like other shampoos, my scalp did Not feel itchy. I like this.
text:
First I’m going to say I called Procter & Gamble that makes Pantene, and many other products,
And they Do Not do Any Animal Testing..They promote No animal testing.
If they did, I would not be buying there Pantene, and other products.

That said, I did not know what to expect with this shampoo,by calling it a cleansing water!
Its a regular thick shampoo folks!
Has a nice scent that does not last long.
The pump works good.

I have Thick hair with a very slight wave-curl, with a Blonde weave. I figured if this is a gentle shampoo for fragile hair, it would
Be good for my bleached hair, although my hair is not in damaged condition.
My hair is not long, and with one pump I got allot of suds. My hair felt after I rinsed this off that the shampoo left a light coating
on my hair, or the shampoo did not clean my hair very good! I wash my hair everyday.
I used a rinse out conditioner , towel dryed, blew my hair out, and it looked good, and felt soft that I like.

My scalp is usually itchy after shampooing . But Once my hair was blown dry my scalp has not Felt as itchy! A real plus for me, as I
Have a lite case of Lichen Planus. (Autoimmune disease, only last 2yrs! BS!)

I’m not a fan of the artificial ingredients in this, and there is allot. ( took off one star for that)
I’ll continue to use it, but I do not notice much difference then my other shampoo’s that are more expensive.

If you have fine hair I would give this a try.

title: Blends in to my fair skin.light sunscreen. I’m happy.
text:
I was thinking this might be too dark for my fair skin, But this is moisturizing, and blended in very nice.
Its a light sun screen which I like for everyday driving. and I also put it on my hands, as even though my windows are tinted
I seem to get too much sun on my hands, and face.
When I use the, The Beauty Rules , I do not have to use other make-up except blush..
This looks natural, and covers good for my skin.
I’m a older women..

title: Nice mist spray. Scent is over whelming for me!
text:
A Bigger nice looking bottle then I thought it was going to be.
Has a good fine mist sprayer.
You spray Happy Buddha oil on you body, and lightly rub it in.

I think the scent is too strong, it’s not my favorite, and last for a long time. I’m sneezing from this!
My Daughter liked the scent as my friend does.

My friend has a tattoo. When my friend sprayed this on her tattoo it looked fresh.
My hands feels smoother, but does not look smoother !

The more I use this, the more it bothers my throat, and my nose.
Maybe I’m allergic to this, which has never happened to me before!!
But the scent is too over whelming for me...

title: Nice scent but not the best, the scent last longer then other ones I have used
text:
I think this would be nice to use before leaving the gym. You smell fresher.
I have not found a Mist that last long, but this does last a little longer, although still not very long!
The Scent is ok, kind of fresh., and there is not as many chemicals in this that I have with other other Mists I have.

title: Love the scent, refreshing. No side effect.
text:
Love the scent of this Facial Rose Mist.
It’s refreshing, and I have sprayed this on my hair lightly also.
This has not caused my face to break out.
But the scent does not last long once it dry’s.
I think I’ll be keeping this in my car for hot days, although my car has air conditioning, but the scent is so refreshing.

title: Love this, comes with pouch of mascara tube & 3 more brushes.
text:
I like this Viva Organic Hexane free Castor Oil better then another one I bought.
This works great on eye lashes, eye brows, for dry elbows, body, finger and toe nails, work a little into
Your hair at night.
I’m a older women, and it works for me. Longer thicker lashes etc. does not happen over night, but keep using this every night,
Or day..

My Daughter is in the film industry and Organic Castor oil has been there little secret for a long time.
It does work, and you do not need allot.
This comes with a clear plastic thick pouch with a mascara tube and brush, then 3 other different brushes, and a little type of
Plug that goes into the top of the bottle. It has a little hole in the plug that takes the excesses oil off.
This does not come with a little funnel to pour this into the tube, but with this type of small flip led you don’t need it.

title: Amazing, No dark circles under my eyes anymore. Love this.
text:
I have tried other types of consealers for the dark circles under my eyes from allergies.
To my surprised this covered my dark circles on the first application.
I’m fair, and this matched perfect.

To open this, seemed a little tricky to me. You have to turn the bottom after getting all the cellophane peeled off, till it pushed the consealer to the top where the sponge applicator is.
Be careful you do not twist too much to the sponge. Once the consealer is there, you really do not have to keep turning, or you will have to
too much consealer on the sponge.
I so not wear heavy make-up, but you do not need to use much consealer.

That said, I love this L’Oreal for my dark circles, and my eyes and do not look wrinkly.
Does not irritate or feel dry under my eyes.

title: Love the lite scent, use very little on my face but  the lines above my lip disappeared! No BS.
text:
The scent is light , clean & wonderful. This is a thick white creamy moisturizer, I just use a very small amount at a time.
I’m a older women, my face is oily. I use Bioderma lightly on my face,not under my eyes.
I notice my face looks more youthful and smoother. Maybe plumper! I’m Not a smoker but have some fine lines above my
Lip. After using this, those fine lines do not show up! I’m thrilled. Right now I’m not thinking about Botox! Lol.
I use a small amount on my chest, toes, and hands they feel softer, and look younger. I love this.
So far 5 star.

title: Legs are not dry & scaley, Lichen planus less itchy.
text:
I’m a older wonen and the skin on my legs lately has looked and felt lawfully dry. I have So many body lotions, and Body butters etc. but
The bioderma has worked the best. I have to say, I’m amazed!
I also have Lichen Planus , which is itchy little spots on my legs, and a little on my arms, and neck.
So far my legs do not look scaley, dry, and Biodema has cut down on The itchiness! I’m thrilled.
My hands also look and feel smoother, and not dry.
I have not put this on my face, as my face is oily, and I have other creams for my face.

5 star

title: Not hardly any color, greasy.
text:
I wish the color it showed as, Honey Kiss, was the color of the Lip crayon.
The color was so light it looked like a light vaseiline with a little bit of a white color.
I’m fair, but the color did not show up, too white, and greasy,

The ingredients seem healthier then most other Lip crayons,

title: Is a bit Luminizer, Not shimmering, does not come with puff, or brush. Nice natural look.
text:
The Honest Luminizing powder is not to be used all over your face I think, but its more of a highlighter..A liitle here and there.
Says to use brush. It does not come with a brush, but I had a new brush that I used. I’m fair, but I would have liked this color a little darker,
This comes in a nice shinny chrome looking case that has a magnetic closure, and shows every finger print!
The top inside is a full mirror, Which is very nice.
My face did not break out from this.

title: Keeps you from burning your fingers when using a hot curling iron
text:
If your burning your fingers when your using a hot curling iron, you will like this.
This will protect your fingers while using a hot curling iron. Although I think it works better at a temp of about 375 degrees.
You can also use these for cooking, when grabbing a pot full of pasta to pour off into a colander.
I have thin fingers, and they fit, but they stretch and are flexable for larger fingers.

title: This lip shine looks awful on me, it is a pinkish/ frosty white, but my lips are moist after. Updated..
text:
Update..
I have been wearing this more , lightly over my lipstick. It gives a light shine, and does look good, and my lips feel hydrated.
Going from a 3 star to a 4 star.
————————
The color is, Ballet Pink.
What you see in the tube, is not the color you get. This is a very light Translucent pink/white.
I would not wear this outside cause it looks awful on me, but over lipstick ok maybe! Would wear in the house.
I’m older and fair.
But it is a lip shine , and a hydrater. Its a bit sticky, but better then most.
After it wore off my lips did feel more moist, not as dry.

The applicator is a flat oval thin sponge.
Love the color it shows in the tube.

title: Not clumpy, not water proof, but no black eyes.
text:
Nice black mascara. Not clumpy. Not water proof-but not messy also, and I didn’t get black under my eyes from this, but I also
Did not put it on my lower lashes. Put a little liner on my lower lashes.
I’m a older women. This did Not curl my lashes in any way. I had to use a eye lash curler to get any up left to my lashes.
Put this mascara on before puting on liner. I got a bit of mascara on my eye lid, wiped it off, but and when I did put
Liner on, it would not go on where I wiped the mascara off!!
Never thought my eyes were sensitive to eye make up, but my eyes are a Little itchy the next day.

This is not my favorite mascara, but better then most.
3 1/2 stars..

title: Very nice Light scent. Not heavy.
text:
They could not have choosen a better name for this Calvin Klein "Air".Parfum.
It is a soft fresh Airy scent on me, and I really like it.
I think Parfum's have a little different scent on most people. What smells good on one, does not on others.
Although this seems to be pretty consistent. The scent was delightful on me, and my two daughters, Not heavy.
Although after two hours on me, the scent is too light, I can't smell it!

The price is a lttle less money then what I usually use for my everyday parfum, but seems my usual scent last longer wearing it, then "Air" did.
That is the reason for the 4 stars, not 5.

title: Too dark and mixed it with a lighter shade..its thin shake tube.
text:
I knew this was going to be too dark for me, but I figured I would mix it with my too light Dermablend.
Worked good. I'm very light, and I just used a small amount on my fingers, then used more Dermablend.

I shook the tube before using it, as it first came out too watery. After shaking, it was the right consistencies.
I put a small amount of this on my fingers, then rubbed it into the back of my hands.
My hands took on a little darker shade. This Gigi hadid tint looks very natural. Might try it on my legs!

title: One end is mascara, other end is fibers to make lashes longer.
text:
Interesting concept for longer looking lashes.
One side of the tube is white lint-fibers, and the other side is a black mascara.

First you put on the mascara, curl your lashes, apply the fibers, and more mascara,Go back and forth
With this prodedure till you get the look you want.
Your lashes do look longer.
I applied this two times. I don't wear heavy mascara or makeup.

That said, the mascara is not water proof. At first I got some of the fiber in my eye. I had to pick a little
Off the end of the wand, then apply it.
For me I found the mascara abit messy.. it might of been it was new, and a different brand then I usually use!
At night before washing this off, I rubbed my eyes, and the mascara came off in little flakes. I'm thinking,
With the mascara comes the fibers and leaves a little mess on my eyes, and face.

3 stars

title: Shower safe, rechargeable, No Trimer.
text:
Nice Braun Razor for the price.

First I want to say, this does Not have a trimer, its just a straight electric rechargeable shaver.
This can be used in the shower 100% water safe.

My grown son has a average beard he usually shaves everyday. He likes a clean shave.
He has not used this in the shower, although its water proof, and can be use in the shower safely.
What he finds is, he has to use this Slow to get the close shave he likes. Using it fast he is not happy with the results.
This Braun razor does not pull his beard out while shaving, which his other More expensive razor does.

This is a nice middle of the road razor.
Taking off 1 1/2 stars for not having a trimer on this.

title: Too many artificial ingredients, & dyes.
text:
My hands felt ok after using this, but there is allot of dyes in this, and too many artificial ingredients for me to buy this again.
My daughters hands where chaped and starting to crack from her hands being in cold weather while fishing for the day.
When she Used this Suave body lotion it started to burn her hands.

title: For thick damaged hair.
text:
This Gliss is a heavy duty rinse out conditioner for thick damaged hair. My hair is dyed, thick, and is damaged from a blonde weave.
As I have gotten older My hair has a curl in it, in the wrong places. This Gliss smoothed out my hair,
And its softer. I personally do not care if my conditioner takes some color out of my hair, as the blonde shows up more,
And I like the color better, its not as drab.
I did not notice any color change with this conditioner.

If you have thin damaged hair, I think your hair would be too limp, and soft using this Gliss!
Gliss makes other conditioners for fine hair.

I'm giving it 5 stars cause it worked good for my hair, but its not a conditioner I would use everyday..Too heavy.

title: Very nice Rose Scent, Hair looked shinny..
text:
I love shampoo and Conditioner that has a good scent, and this one does. It was Not over powering for me, and I have a lung problem.
This was a Rose scent.
My hair got a bad blonde weave, and I usually use a shampoo etc. for damaged hair.
This was not as sudzy as other shampoo’s, and had to use more for my hair. My hair is thick, but not that long It comes about a
inch above my shoulders.
I like the conditioner , but for me it was not strong enough.
After I towel dried my hair I sprayed it with GLISS Hair Repair Leave-In Conditioner.
My hair had body in it , and looked good after using shampoo, blowing my hair dry.

title: Love the Silver. Shampoos out. Can use this while gray grows in.
text:
Love this Silver color spray.
My hair is colored light brown, with a blonde weave.
I have been seriously thinking of letting my hair grow out gray, but I do not like gray or white hair,
But this silver color I would Love. Although if I let my hair grow out, I could use this to help with the look of the grow out !

I, and my daughter sprayed this Silver on our hair. Mine snd hers with a look of a silver weave. We both thought it looked good.
Style your hair before spraying this on. If you want the color to last for the evening, do not brush or come your hair after spraying.
The color comes off a bit on your brush.
When you spray this on, cover your self with a old towel.
This shampoos out , although would hope it would not.

title: Face was smoother looking, Has a nice scent.
text:
Although I have not used this for a long time I notice a positive difference.
I'm a older women.

Before going to bed I washed my face, used a eye cream, then put this on my face lightly.
The next morning before getting into the shower, I notice my face looks and feels softer.
I think this plumped up my lines a bit! This also seems to be a exfoliant..
Has a nice scent..
That said, it's good, but not the best I have used..
4 star

title: This did not work for me ..too shiny, showed lines.
text:
I did not care for this,
My face looked Too Shiny, and Not youthful. Actually showed every little mark and line in my face!
I do not think I used to much.
I have another natural glow by a different company, that makes my skin look younger and dewy.

title: Love it. No burned ends on damaged hair, & felt softer.
text:
This is a good size ceramic iron. On the side of the iron, and out of the way,is 3 little buttons to press. The bigger one, turns it on, the other two
Are for going lower, then higher in heat.
I used this on 300'degrees, and was perfect for my damaged hair. At 300 it was hot.
This is the first flat iron that has Not burned my already damaged hair from a bad blonde weave.
After I used this, my hair even felt softer! No burned ends, as other irons have done.

This Revlon iron is a winner for me.

title: Used this one time, and now does not work, and no more pencil
text:
I received L'Oreal infallible black eye pencil, and a very nice double pencil sharpener, which was a big mistake!
I put the eye liner on, and it went on pretty smooth, looked good. This pencil color of black is very dark.
I decided to use the sharpener! It ruined the pencil as after I used it, I realized this pencil is plastic cut into it, and has nothing to
Do with this pencil, and After I was wondering why the sharpener was included in the packge!
The top of the pencil turns, and I expected more pencil would come out, it did not!

My eye pencil is Ruined, and there is no black pencil in it to use.
I hope this does not happen to anyone else.

title: Strong scent, works ok,  but allot of bad ingreds.
text:
Not a bad body lotions, but if your sensitive to a scent, I think its strong.
That said there is allot of ingredients that I do not think are health for the body.
Although my hands feel good using this.
Its only greasy for a short time, but that scent remains!

title: Goes on smooth, these are more brown colors. No brushes. Hard to open.
text:
What I received is not exactly what this Maybelline showed! Although nice, but disapointed!
The two large eyeshadows in the middle are not what it shows.
The one on the left its frosted gold, the one on the right is a very shiny frosted brighter gold.
My picture showed left side, gold & lighter gold, right side is a lavender pink with a lighter pink swirled.
All the colors look swirled with a lighter color. Not what I got!
Most of the colors are frosted. The four on the bottom at each side are not really frosted. The black or gray on the right bottom is
Just a hint of frost compared to the other frosted colors.

You do not need to use much, there soft and go on smooth.
I do not know what this sells for, but I think this should of come with a couple of nice small brushes.!

I'm giving this a 3 star, as I'm not a fan of frosted colors, and I did not get the colors for my coloring I thought I was getting.
Hard to open.

title: The back of my hands felt tingly after puting this on. Not a thick lotion, did not turn my hands white..
text:
I put a small amount of the CeraVe sunscreen on the back of my hands, and with in a couple of minutes there now tingley!
I shook the tube before using this. This is not thick, and it went right into my skin, and feels dry. Its not greesy, and
Did not turn my skin white.

There is 45 other InActive Ingedients in this. All I cannot pronounce!
I would Not put this on my face.

It says to put this on 15mins. Before going into the sun.reapply after 40 mins. If swimming, or sweating.

I had some questions I wanted to ask this company about the use for my grandson who is a 3yr old red-head, and we
Live on a river in Ca.
I Called the company, pushed all the right buttons, and was on hold for 10 min. Then it went into a recording asking if I liked the product,
Would recommend it, and then hung up!
What a waste of my time. This is a company I personally will not do business with now.
I have owned busneses, and customer service is number one.

title: Great brush for long hair. Does not pull hair out.
text:
My daughters have very long thick hair. One has straight hair, and one a little curly.
Since the bristles are not real long, the brush does Not pull the hair out.
Just gives it a smooth look.
The handle gives you a good hold on the brush.
This feels great on your scalp, its like a scalp massage when your hair is dry.

I'm surprised the price is so reasonable.

title: Just had a damaged weave on my thick hair, this felt stiff, and tangled my hair.
text:
I love all my Purology products that I have bought , but this Mousse that I received!
My hair is thick, and has a slight curl to it as I get older.
I just had my hair cut too short for me, and a blonde weave that Damaged my hair, the first time that has happened!!
When I got home I shampoo my hair with Pureology shampoo, put on Pureology condtioner for damaged hair,
Towel dried, gave this a one shot that filled my hand with mousse, put my head down ,and put it threw my hair, blew it dry.
My hair felt tangled, and stiff. The next day before getting in the shower, I couldn't get my fingers threw my dry hair!.
That said, was my hair problem from the damage from my blonde weave?
If that was the problem, I would not recommend this for damaged hair.
From reading other reviews people liked this that have thin hair, that is probably in better condition then mine is right now.

For me, I can only give this a 3 star, but I love all my other Pureology products.
In a couple of weeks when my hair is in better condition, I'll use this again, if there is a change I will be back with a update.
(My bottle came in dented, at the bottom, and top. Needs better packaging.)

title: Orly bonder rubberized basecoat keeps your polish on.
text:
Finally found a Base coat that does work.

I put this on clean nails. Put it on under nails, over the top, and edge. Wait for it to dry a bit.
Put on two coats of Opi, or essie nail polish..let it dry some.
Then put on, Opi Rapidry top coat , again under nail, over top and edge..
Done..
Next night, put another coat of Opi Rapidry top coat.
Your polish will have a nice fresh shine, and will stay on over a week.
During the week if I going out etc, I freshen up the shine again I use Rapidry

title: Has a scent.
text:
Not that good. It does have a scent to it, which I wanted a scent free hairspray cause I have some Allergies.
I have thick hair, it does hold my hair, but when I comb it out with a large wide tooth comb my hair felt knotted up, like my hair was being pull out

I usually use Sabastian Shaper plus, that is stronger , but my hair never feels knoted up, but the scent was getting too strong for me.

title: Pump does not come off to get allot left on bottom..
text:
I do like this Vaseline lotion.
I use it for my body when I come out of the shower everyday, and keep a bottle in my kitchen.

The three stars are because nothing comes threw the pump when there still is allot of the lotion left at the bottom.
I have to smack it down on the counter so,the pump can get to it but still allot is left at the bottom, and the top does Not un-screw to get the rest of the lotion out.
A big waste.
I will not be buying this again.

title: Not long enough for me, weigh  135 lbs.
text:
Seems to be made good.
I wet this, put my french soap on it, But,
I'm a women that weights 135 lbs, and did not find this spa back scrubber long enough!
The handles are too short, and I had to strech my hands, arms behind me to far to use this.
Very uncomfortable.

title: Shaves smooth, and the scent is very nice.
text:
I Love the scent of this shaving soap when my Husband shaved with it., and my My husband also likes it.
He said he gets a smooth , close shave . He has a heavy beard, and if we go out special in the eveing he has to shave again.
But using the No. 63, shaving soap he can sometimes get away with out shaving twice.
That said, this seems to not get as foamy as other shaving soaps do, but do not let that fool you. Its gets the job done.
I would like the scent to last longer, but when I get close to him its there.
The scent does not interfere with other cologne.

I also bought him a new Badger shaving brush from Amazon.
This makes a very nice gift with the holidays coming up.

title: 4 Refill brushes for a Clarisonic machine / device.
text:
There are 4 refill brushes in the box to be used with the Clarisonic facial device .
Comes in a cute candy like twist gift box with a snowy theme on it.
This can be refills brushes for you, or a very nice gift if they already have the Clarisonic mashine/device.

In the box is;
2 radiance brush heads. ( Everyday)
1 Deep pore brush head.
1 Sonic Fountation brush. (Makeup looks natural)
4 small cups for each brush to keep your brushes dry, or use as a holder.

These do not come with any instructions .
Does not say what material the brushes are made from!

title: Mint is a lite color, till you spray it heavier. Hair did NOT feel stiff. Washed out no damage to hair.
text:
This is a small can, but just enough to spray it threw your hair to get a noticable color. More for a weave look.
My hair is brown with a blonde weave.
The mint is light in color, more of a drab color on my blonde till I sprayed it on heavier then the Mint color showed up.
The spray nozzle is NOT like a hairspray sprayer. This has a small thin sprayer that sprays basicly in the area of
Your hair your aiming at.
My hair did not feel stiff ater spraying this, but it does have kind of a paint smell to it that did not last long.

I think using this for a fun color is much healthier for your hair then a permanent color that your hair has
To be bleached out for.
Would be fun for Halloween also.

title: Love this, scent is luscious, hands feel soft, no additives .
text:
Oh, I love this hand cream.
The scent alone would be a reason to buy it, but my hands and elbows feel so soft After using this.
You only need to use a small amount. No greasy feel after using this.
The jar was bigger then I expected , and should at least 6 months for me, or Longer.

title: Love the scent, and do not think its too strong..Pure Luxury.
text:
I love the scent of this De Provence soap, and feel good after showering with it,
Some people think it has too much scent, I do not think so,
This is a luxury soap, that I would buy again..
This doesn’t have any additives that you get from your market soaps.

I also like that the bottom has Nubs for this to sit on, and doesn’t waste this wonderful soap.

title: Luxury, nice scent. love’em
text:
I love these soaps, and there is no additives in them.
Just Luxury, scent, and suds.
I use this in my shower, I’m not a bath person..

If you love a Rose Scent as I do, you will love this wonderful soap.

title: Scent came back after soap was sitting in my shower over night!
text:
Loved the scent of this bath soap in the wrapping, but after unwrapping, and washing my hands, the scent was not there!!

That said, After I put the soap in my shower. The next day I used this soap to shower with, and the scent came back,
and I could smell it on my body after coming out of the shower!!
Amazing, love the scent.

title: LOVE the scent, hands felt good. Keep in purse, & car.Many reason to give this for a gift.
text:
In the package is a bar of this soap, and a lovely 1. Oz . Tube of hand cream.
The soap lathered up very nice.
The soap left a nice scent on my hands.

LOVE the hand cream. I'm keeping one in my purse and car.
Hard to describe the scent, but its sweet, yet smells soft, and lovely.
Even though the tube is small, this should last you for a long time, as you do not need
much. Just a Dab, as this spreads far on your hands, and wrists.

I would give this to a friend as a little birthday gift, to the host for dinner, someone one who is sick, someone I have not seen in a long time, sent it to my Daughters-with a I love you card, to a friend that has helped with the kids, or just because I like you for a friend.

title: Will curl hair also. Has only one heat 385 degees . Too hot for my thick dyed hair.
text:
This curling iron will also curl your hair. Very easy to use.
There is no choice on the temp. You plug it in, it goes to 385 degrees only.
My hair is short, thick, and has a blonde weave. My hair is in very good condition.

After using this, I noticed the ends of my hair felt damaged, and my thick hair would slip out of
The iron?
I know the iron should let your hair gentle move to straighten , but this was to slick for my hair.

title: Great for my Hubby’s bald head, and the family.
text:
We have been using the Mountain Falls SPF 30 sunscreen which we have been getting great results with..No more Sun Burning.
This is there 50 SPF Sunscreen that give us that extra sun protection, and does work.
We live on a river in California, and its been very hot here, Lots of Sun shine, so we have been in the river a few times a week.
My husband does not have much hair, wears a ball cap, but still gets too much sun.
This SPF 50 seems to be helping him..He has had some pre-cancer removed from his head. He Showed this to our
Dr. and he was impressed with what is in this, and that it is a 50 SPF.

Also using this on the kids, and everyone that is coming over to go in the river. No complaints.
The scent has a little mint smell to it, but Not strong.

5 star.

title: I'm shocked , hair went right into place using hair dryer. Although not shiny, used a spray shine.
text:
I'm surprised I like this hair conditioner so much.
I usually use a heavy conditioner from the beauty supply that I have been using for years, that keeps my thick hair with a blonde weave soft, (gray roots) and straight. my hair is not long. Above my shoulders, and I'm older.
This is organic and doesn't have allot of artificial junk in it that just coats your hair .

When I washed my hair, then used Dr Organic cond, rinsed it out, I thought, ok my hair does not feel as smooth, but give this a chance, and comb it out first with a wide tooth comb. Or I thought when I got out of the shower, I would just put a good leave on cond through my hair.
But the comb went threw my hair, and I started using the hair dryer, and big round brush to pull my hair straight.
WOW, my hair had more body, went right into place. Although My hair does not feel as soft or shiny with this conditioner.
After styling I sprayed my hair with a lite spray shine.

I'm sold on Organic Dr. hair Conditioner.

title: Cover blemishes for me. Love it.
text:
This is creamy, and the color Sand, is a little yellow.
I use this to cover a blemish, and when I put blush on it all blends in very nice.
I really like the Dermablend products.
I’m not really sure this would cover tattoo’s !.

I’m fair, blue eyes, and blonde weave.

title: Like it if it was Lighter in color. Way to dark for me.
text:
I received the Dermablend in a Deep Golden 70w..
I didn’t realize how deep a brown this color is, which is way to dark for me.
For me it was like a dark tanning lotion.
I’m blue eyes, blonde weave in my hair, and fair skin.

I put a little on a few brown marks I have on my legs, but it did not cover. I think cause the color was too dark to even blend in right.,
I kept rubbing it in. I finally had to use allot of body butter to get it on my legs for this to look smooth, and then my legs looked like a nice
tan.
I’m afraid to try this wearing white crop shorts on, as it might come off on the white pants while I’ll wearing them.
What a mess that could be.
I’m giving this a 4 star, as I love Dermablend, and if this was a much lighter color I think I would really like it..

title: Great under eyes, and touch ups.
text:
This Dermablend is not very creamy. I use a good moisturizer before applying, although I always use eye cream and a moisturizer twice aday.
As I get older ( I'm older) under my eyes I'm getting dark circles ,This covered great.
This comes with a little spatula if your nails are long, or not to contaminate the foundation on the jar.
I'm fair, blue eyes, blonde weave,
The color blends well for my face/ coloring.

Since this has a SPF 30, I also put this on the back of my hands after putting on hand lotion. My hands look smoother, and minimalize any brown spots .

title: Too dark of color for me, Very creamy, its liquid.
text:
I did not realize this concealer is too dark for me.
I'm fair, blue eyes, blonde weave .
Its very creamy, as it says it is Liquid, which I find odd for a concealer. It does not stay put!
A very small amount goes Far.
I tried this on the back of my hand to cover a couple of brown spots, this Dermablend did not cover at all.

That said, I love my other Dermablend products.

title: Face looked smooth, and younger.
text:
I do not wear heavy make-up. This was heavier then expected, but after putting it on, Blending it good, I thought it was more of a yellowish color on my skin!
I’m fair, blue eyes, and blonde weave. I’m also older.
That said, before putting this on, I used a nice moisturizer. After the Dermablend I put on a pink powder blush. I didn’t notice the yellow then. It does cover very good.
If I had anything under my skin, it did Not show up. My skin looked smooth. Btw, this is a SPF 25, I also put a little on the top of my hands. Looked good.
I went to the grocery store, and bumped into two friends separately, I have not seen in a long time. One said, You never age, what is your secret!. I could not agree lol.
Then another friend that I saw said, you look good, you never get older!!!..Ok, we now know this Dermablend does make me look younger, I have to say!
My Granddaughter was in a bad car accident a few years ago (drunk driver hit her head on). She tried this Dermablend, and her face looked very smooth, and I could not see any glass marks on her face. That said, she does have nice skin, but after a few years she still will have glass come out of her skin!..

This is not a make-up I will use everyday, although its very nice.
Although if you want good coverage, I think this would work good.
Giving it 5 stars.

title: Shampoo is ok, with a good scent, dry shampoo felt dry & sticky on my hair.
text:
Before taking a shower, I sprayed the dry shampoo into my hair.
My short thick hair went into place, but felt dry, and a kind of sticky. I do not think I would use it again.

When I take a shower every day, I also wash my hair then blow dry it with a round brush, and sometimes use a curling iron.
The shampoo suds up allot, had a good scent. I also used my heavy conditioner.
I liked the shampoo, but its not for color treated hair, and after I used this my hair seemed dry, but not as dry as the dry shampoo. That is too drying for my hair, that has color and a weave.

title: My face feels smoother, and No breaking out. Eyes starting to feel stinging  in the morning!
text:
Lumene sleeping cream has a wonder scent, although it does not last long.

I noticed since using this the first time my face had a slight sting to it the next morning and now every time I use it till I go in
The shower.
I'm thinking with the fruit acid in this also the Lumene sleeping cream is also a exfoliant , and a moisturizer!
My face is Not breaking out using this.
My face feels smoother the next day, and hydrated , but I don't look any younger lol.

I'm really on the fence with this night cream, as my eyes are starting to feel sensitive using it, a bit burning and i'm Not
Using it near my eyes.Before putting this on my face, I always use my eye cream.

I have never had a reaction like this before, and I do not have sensitive skin!,
Right now I'm giving this a 3 star.

title: Does not help my thick colored hair with a little curl. Good for thiner,& kids hair.
text:
My hair is colored med br., and has a blonde weave. I have thick hair that use to be straight. As I have gotten older, my hair has
A bit of a curl to it. I wash it ever day, and use a thick expensive conditioner.
That said I used this Carols Daughter conditioner a few times, and have not noticed it was better then the
Conditioner I have been using.
After using this , I had to use an other leave in conditioner, cause this one did not help my hair to be smooth while
Blow drying, and did not feel that great.

I think this would work for detangling thin hair, or children's hair, which my hair is not .

title: Very nice, love the scent, noticed a difference. Up-dated.
text:
Since I have been using this for a few weeks after I come out of the shower , I love it.
I put it on my face, wait a few minutes, then put on my moisturizer over this.
What I notice is, the fine lines above my lip is disappearing, and the lines on the side of my face near my mouth is also..
I’m going from a 4 star to a 5 star.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
This lumene Serum surprised me. At first it felt sticky, but then went into my skin, and my face looked better.( didnt think that was possible!).
I also put this on my neck, didn't notice much on my neck, but I have to say my neck looks pretty good anyway.
I'm older and also put this on the back of my hands, which really made a difference. Looked young.
Lumene serum is a thick yellow oil, sticky , but once its absorbed, its not tacky.

In side the bottle is a rubber stopper, with a dropper. The serum is thick. By accident I did knock the bottle over, and nothing came out, although I got it right away.
Love the scent.

title: Good moisturizing, Bottle  needs  a pump.
text:
My skin feels more moisturized when i come out of the shower. The scent smells stronger from the bottle, then on my skin,
And did not last a long time.

My complaint about this Le Petit shower cream is the bottle.
It is Not user friendly. Once you open the cap, and turn it over it pours out, and its heavy.
A pump cap would solve the problem, and nobody would have to pick it up, just pump.

title: Skin feels soft and moisturized.lid needs a pump.
text:
After using Le Petit Marseillais vanilla shower cream my body feels soft and moisturized after.
I think the scent was strong the first time I used this, but after using this a few times, its not nearly as strong of a scent!
I like scents.

The lid needs to be redesigned .When you open the snap lid to use this, the shower cream pours fast, and it's wasted.
I would have liked a pump on this, and also a lid you can screw on after, then turn this over.

I'm in to recycling, and trying not to waste much. as the pump leaves allot at the bottom, but would also make this easy to use.

title: Has a grit that exfoliates, and neutralized my face.
text:
My Dermatologist gave me samples for my face that dried it so bad I had a red itchy painful peeling mess on my face last week .
So itchy it kept waking me up at night.
I just received the aveeno radiant , and used it in the shower , and what a great relief .
No more itchy mess, but still red in places on my face..
This Aveeno has a grit to it that has a good exfoliant . Which help gently to exfoliant the mess on my face , and left it more moisturized .

I'm a older women with a more oily then dry skin. This Aveeno neutralized my skin, and left it clean, and soft.
I still cannot give this a 5 star. If it keeps giving me good results i'll up date this to a 5

title: A Very Black color of Mascara, and thick.
text:
This did Not take my eye lashes to Paradise as it claims, but If you want a Black mascara this is it..Really thick and black.
It is thick, did get clumpy, but it might be, because it's new. I Had to use my eye lash comb to separate my lashes right away.
I thought this is a fast drying mascara, which can be a good thing!!

title: My face feels smooth, wonderful after using this, and this has a very nice soft scent.
text:
I really like this Neutrogena Hydro boost. My skin is a bit oily , and I'm older. My face feel smooth, but
Not oily after. This almost feels a little like silicone!
So far my face has not Broken out.
Has a very nice soft scent.
This is a pump, and the cream is a bit watery , not thick.
This says there is Hyaluronic acid in this, but I cannot find it in the ingredients unless it is under a different name!
I have used Hyaluronic acid before, and liked it. Also it's usually pricey. This is a good price from what I have paid for a
Nice face cream with hyaluronic acid.
I like this well enough to buy to buy more.
5 stars.

title: Skin feels good after using this from being in the sun all day .
text:
We live on a river in Ca, and this past week-end the weather was spring warm enough to be in the river with family and friends .
Everyone got sunburned, and I was able to give this a fair try I think.
Everyone loved the scent, and felt the, Goddess Garden undone sun repair felt , good on, and seemed to keep our skin from feeling tight , and dry.
Not so sure it took the pain away, but it did feel good as my daughter said after putting it on, and she has lived in Hawaii for 8 yrs.

title: Not much SPF, does moisturize.
text:
L’Oreal Sunscreen for men, has a very nice fresh Scent for men, and women I think.
On the box and the label on the bottle it says this is a daily Moisturizer, anti-wrinkle and firming Cream!

My husband feels this is a really light SPF15 sunscreen. Our Dr. says we all need SPF30 at least, if we are going to
be out in the sun for the day.
But using this everyday on your face and hands while driving can help protect you from age spots, I hope!
It does give moisture to your face while being in the sun.
My husband does not notice he looks any younger, or firmer.
Do not use this under or around your eyes, it is Not a eye cream, and can cause irritation.

title: Nice scent, it's like a good conditioner!
text:
I use to have a little curl to my hair, but as I have gotten older with gray, and color & weave , my hair,has gotten a curly, and wirey!
I use a pricy heavy conditioner, like this feels like, and this left my hair soft, and it is easy for me to use a brush to straighten, or let it get a little curly.

That said I used Opliphica on wet hair after it was shampooed , conditioned .
I used one pump full through my hair, and used a brush, and hair dryer to style.
Yes my hair is soft, and might be more manageable!! but not so sure it's from Opliphica curl control, or my Conditioner!

This has a nice scent,

I will be back for a update.
Update. I notice my hair feels a bit oily the next day after using this. I also shampoo my hair everyday.

title: Lite hair spray, but goes right back into the style.
text:
This a lite hair spray, but it holds your hair in the style it was when sprayed. It is easy to comb out, but goes back in place.
My hair does not feel dried out, or looked dried , and not crunchy feeling. I have thick hair.
Obliphica is a hair spray I have not heard of before, and some of my family members are hairdressers in the film industry.

I do like it,and will be using it, but it has a strong lasting nice scent, but I think it over powers my perfume for quite a while.
That is the reason for the 4 star.

title: My skin is getting dryer!
text:
The more I use this Aveeno Hydrating body wash, the more I notice my skin is getting dryer!
I do use body lotion when I come out of the shower, but still dry.
I will not be buying this again...

title: Using Gliss my itchy scalp is gone. Great shampoo.
text:
My head was itchy from the expensive shampoo I have been using for years, but didn't realize it was from the
Shampoo till I started using Gliss .
This shampoo gets sudsy, but I do have to use more then my old shampoo.
But after using Gliss for a couple of weeks, NO more itchy scalp. Yay.

My hair has color on it, but I have not noticed that Gliss has taken the color out.

title: All three Obogi work well together. Face looks smoother.
text:
My daughter really likes all three of this Obagi systems. They all three work together.
Her skin is more dry then mine is. ( I use Obagi retinol 1%), she likes the o.5 % it's not as drying.
The cleanser is exfoliating and seems to clean all make off , and leaving her skin soft.
The moisturizing with 30 SPF leaves her skin feeling Smooth, and smile and eye lines are looking less that
I notice also.

I know she will be buying this again. A good amount comes in this kit.
If anything changes, I will be back with a update.

title: Moisturizes, and Love the pump.
text:
I love that a Inexpensive body wash has a easy to use pump on it. Its about time that more body washes have it, which is a plus to me.
The more I use this body wash, the more I like it.
My skin does not feel as dry.
Although When I come out of the shower everyday I do use a body lotion.

title: Skin felt smooth, and no pilling.
text:
My face feels softer and smoother using this double repair moisturizer .
My make up went on smooth over this. But i waited a few mins before putting on makeup.
I do not use heavy make up.
I don't seem to have the pilling some talked about.
I'm a older women, and do not have dry skin, but this did Not make my skin feel oily,
And I did not break out.

title: Face looks smoother and softer.
text:
I really like this foaming gel face wash.
But first i wash my face with a sugar cleanser , as I feel that is exfoliating .
Then I use this purifying gel..my face feels Clean, and softer then it has felt in a long time.
The foaming gel has a wonderful scent to it, and has Not caused my face to break out.
That said I have used it by it self, and my face does feel soft, but I feel the sugar wash adds a little something extra .

After I put on La Roche- Posay double face moisturizer . I'm a older women and my face looks smoother and the
Lines look like there smoothed out.

title: My skin feels softer, & clean. Cruelty Free. Love this.
text:
Update...I'm disappointed after using this for a short time!
When I now start to use this, Oil comes out of the tube, not the sugar face wash... The tube is starting to get stuck together, and it's a mess to use this...I have Never experienced anything like this from any product I have ever put on my face.

I want to say, I have never heard of or used this product before.
After using this, and reading more about this Co. I will be buying more of there products. ( I'm impressed).

Use this on my face, and it feels softer, but not dry.
I also use it on the dry skin on my legs. They look better. But I always use a good body lotion,although now
Using both my skin is softer, and not dry looking.

Put a small amount on your wet fingers , and wash your face. It's wonderful,
Takes off make-up. All day dirt we do not see. Has a soft sugary scent and my skin feels renewed, and looks better.

Vegan, Cruelty Free, and recyclable.
