title: Goes on smooth. Do not like the plunger applicator.
text:
I received , Natural Beige, and it matches my skin color perfect. I'm fair, blue eyes, blondish hair.
This says it is a Hydro boost hydrating tint, has Hyaluronic Acid, and moisturizers & Plumps!
I have not found this to plumped my smile lines or any other lines in my face, although I wish it would.
Also have Not noticed it moisturizers either. I do moisturize my face before putting make up on.

That said it does not feel heavy, blends well, and the color is perfect for me.

This did not come in a box, and there was not any instructions, which this needed, as this is thick,
Does not have a pump, and does not pour out.
When you take the lid off there is a hard sponge type of plunger that comes out with the make-up on it.
But not much makeup. You have to keep putting the plunger back in to get more make up.
I want to say, I Do Not wear heavy make up, and usually when I do, it's thiner and light weight .
The plunger for me is a deal breaker for me to buy this. Although if I get use to the plunger, I'll be back to
Update my review.
The plunger is the reason for the 4 stars and not 5.

I actually like makeup in a tube better, as you can get as much, or as little of it as you want to apply .

title: Thick like greek Yogurt, absorbs, Strong Scent.
text:
I received the Vanilla and Oats Lotion in the Jar, not the Apricot & Honey. .

This Lotion is the consistency of Greek Yogurt. The Scent is long lasting on my hands, as that is where
I smell it the most.My hands look smoother using this.
I do not love this scent.Its too Vanilla for me, Although its not like the regular Vanilla scent to me!
I use it on my body, but the real feel for me is on my hands..It absorbs in, but I can still feel it, which is
not a bad thing.
It is thicker and last longer then the regular Aveeno pump hand lotion, but its
Not as thick and nice as Body Butter. But Body butter is allot more expensive then this is.
After using the Yogurt lotion, I will be buying this instead of the Aveeno Pump thinner lotion.

title: Bleached hair is smooth, thick, & no split ends..Love this.

Having never used a salt spray before, I bought this to try and minimize the use of hairspray. I also chose this one because the reviews said it works, and that it smells "amazing". I find it smells good, but definitely not "amazing"-although it's hard to tell because I'm pregnant and hypersensitive to smells.

With all that being said, I pumped about 10 sprays all over my towel-dried hair last night after washing. I was worried it might have been too much. It definitely didn't give my hair any sort of "instant wave". I let it dry overnight, and now my hair feels like nothing happened. It is still straight and fine-almost like the oil in it conditioned my hair(I also NEVER use conditioner). I went about my usual styling routine with the light hold hairspray and hot iron. If the spray is good for anything, I guess it helped to give my hair a "second-day" styling hold, which is ideal, except I used the same amount of hairspray as usual. Maybe I didn't use enough salt spray? I'll have to try one more time.

I will continue my search for a good salt spray for bulking up my hair(if that is indeed what a salt spray is used for), and I will keep this one in the guest bathroom for now.

Thanks for reading!

title: Heavy Felt Bags Hold Soil, Support Plant Roots
text:
These PLANT GROW BAGS WITH HANDLES (5 Pack, 5 Plastic Stake-Type Labels) are made of heavy black felt cloth. For holding the soil that supports plant roots, they work as well as plastic or earthenware pots. However, because the bags are soft-sided, plant roots are more susceptible to damage if the bags are kicked or knocked over. The grow bags are lightweight, compared to earthenware pots.

The bag handles make the plants easy to pick up and move around. The 5-gallon bags appear to be the same size as standard hard-sided 5-gallon containers. The bags are folded flat for shipping. They do NOT have drainage holes, but probably don’t need them because the fabric lets water drip through slowly.

title: Not Ideal for Grinding Natural Nails
text:
This PROFESSIONAL ELECTRIC NAIL DRILL (35000RPM, with 6 Drills for Acrylic Gel Nails, Home Salon Use) has both a manual control and a foot pedal control. As the product page states, using it takes some practice. It’s really intended for grinding acrylic nails, and for other serious grinding applications.

It was my intention to use the device to grind natural nails (in particular, one toenail that has nail fungus, that would benefit from thinning). However, the machine runs so fast, and my hand/eye coordination is so poor, I’m afraid to use it. For me, ordering this sophisticated grinder for use on natural nails was a mistake.

title: All Tools Needed for Pampering Feet
text:
This URAMOTO PROFESSIONAL PEDICURE KIT has all the tools you need to pamper your feet. The cuticle removers are particularly helpful to me, as I have a couple of toenails that need to be carefully monitored to prevent ingrowth and possible fungal infections. The only additional foot care item that you might want would be [[ASIN:B07TXPRC9F corn/callus remover pads]].

This is a budget-priced (about $7 on Amazon) foot care kit, with hand tools only. (The tools are small, with short handles, and the knives don't have handles at all.) If you want to get really serious about your pedicures, there are many powered nail care devices available on Amazon (e.g., [[ASIN:B000NY66DS Medicool pedicure station]]). Still, you can get excellent results with this kit, if you use it regularly and don’t neglect your feet for long periods.

title: Label Lists No Germ-Killing Ingredients; Not Made by Tea Tree
text:
This ANTIBACTERIAL TEA TREE MINT HAND SOAP (with Spearmint, Jojoba and Olive Oil; Multipurpose Liquid Soap in Pump Dispenser; 16 oz) lathers reasonably well, but it does smell a lot like gasoline (as another reviewer noted). The pump is very difficult to open up.

This is NOT a Tea Tree brand product--it is a Buena Skin Cosmeceuticals product with a label that emphasizes just one of its many ingredients (tea tree leaf oil).

I think it is false advertising to label this hand soap as “antibacterial” soap (in the title of the product page). According to the label, the soap “helps wash away bacteria”. Well, so does water!

The ingredients are all “natural” ingredients. The listed ingredients do NOT include alcohol or any other germ-killing chemical. When you’re using this, you’re probably getting the same “antibacterial” effect that you get with ordinary soap and water. (My web research says that tea tree oil MAY be antibacterial when applied to the skin.)

title: Inexpensive, Effective for Repair of Chapped Lips
text:
These AQUAPHOR LIP REPAIR STICKS (Two 0.17 Oz. Sticks) are inexpensive (about $8 for a 2-stick pack on Amazon), and much more effective than petrolatum or regular Aquaphor for repairing my chronically chapped lips. The unflavored sticks don’t seem to contain any of the drying ingredients (e.g., alcohol, glycerin) that are included in some lip repair products (and that make chapped lips worse than before). The included ingredients are mostly seed oils and beeswax.

Because the Aquaphor product is packaged in stick form, I don’t have to apply it by dipping a finger into a small tub or metal tin. (I don't know whether the solid stick product will gather germs over time.) It is important, of course, to NOT share products like this with others. The sticks are cheap enough that it’s easy to buy one for each member of the family.

title: Performance is Comparable to Much Cheaper Beeswax-Based Lip Sticks
text:
When applied to my chronically chapped lips, this DR. HAUSCHKA LIP CARE STICK (0.17 Ounce) seems equivalent to, or maybe a little better than, other good beeswax-based lip care products (e.g., [[ASIN:B005MYW3TU Honey House Naturals Lip Butter]]). The long ingredients list contains beeswax and many different oils (e.g., castor oil, jojoba oil, shea butter, etc.).

The stick doesn’t contain any obvious humectants (e.g., hyaluronic acid and glycerin), which will dry the lips if not adequately counterbalanced by occlusive ingredients (e.g., beeswax, shea butter). Occlusive agents form a protective barrier to hold in the water drawn to the lips by humectants. The Hauschka stick contains cetyl alcohol, but cetyl alcohol is NOT a drying agent.

I have stopped using Chapstick products, which contain both humectants and occlusive agents, because they don’t achieve the right balance for my lips. They actually make my lips peel worse, which just goes to show that one size doesn’t necessarily fit all when it comes to cosmetics.

The Hauschka stick has a mildly fruity flavor. It's not unpleasant, but I'd prefer an unflavored stick.

The Hauschka stick seems to require fewer applications during the day than other effective-for-me lip care products. However, it is very expensive (about $15 on Amazon for a single stick). I don’t think that it is enough better than other non-drying lip care products to justify buying it regularly.

title: Good Brand for Persons With Sensitive Skin
text:
Long ago, on the advice of his dermatologist, my husband started using Philips Norelco shavers. They don’t give the best, closest shave, but they’re a great choice if you have sensitive skin. There are many, many different models--the classic model has a triangular head with three rotary cutting blades.

This PHILIPS NORELCO CLICK & STYLE S740/80 WITH BEARD STYLER AND NOSE TRIMMER isn’t a good choice unless the user needs the beard styler. A clean-shaven person will be better off choosing a more traditional model with three shaving blades (e.g., the [[ASIN:B00JITDVD2 Philips Norelco 4500 easy-cleaning shaver]]).

title: Extremely Thick Cream Leaves Greasy Film
text:
This Amazon Brand SOLIMO DRY SKIN CREAM (Fragrance free, Paraben free, Phthalate free, 16 Ounces) is an extremely thick cream that contains petrolatum , mineral oil, and lanolin, among other things. (Petrolatum is the main ingredient in both Vaseline and Aquaphor.) Because it’s so thick, the cream needs to be rubbed in--it isn’t easily absorbed into your skin.

After it’s rubbed in, the cream leaves a greasy film atop your skin. If you apply the cream to your hands, you will want to wipe off the residue. Otherwise you will transfer the film to keyboards, touchscreens, kitchen utensils, or anything else that you touch, for quite a while. If you apply the cream to your body, you will want to wear some sort of clothing over it to avoid transfer.

The cream is white, and totally fragrance free. The big 16-ounce jar will last a long time. I think that the product is best used as a night cream on dry feet, arms, or legs (covered by sleepwear). However, I prefer dry skin creams that are much more easily and quickly absorbed.

title: Thick Cream Doesn’t Moisturize, Absorb Quickly
text:
This O’KEEFE’S HEALTHY FEET NIGHT TREATMENT is a thick cream that squeezes out in a thin (about 1/8 inch wide) strand--probably so that you won’t be tempted to use too much. The directions say to start with a small amount because a little is all you need.

My experience is that I need quite a bit of cream for each foot, because the product isn’t absorbed quickly. Also, the thick cream doesn’t seem to be as moisturizing as other overnight foot creams that I’ve tried. I don’t feel like the cream softens the hard areas of skin on my feet as well as other products. The cream has little noticeable fragrance, which is good.

I think that I’ll be using up a tube of this product very fast, which will make it kind of expensive for regular use.

title: Pleasant-Smelling, Pleasant-Textured , Non-Irritating Aloe Vera Gel
text:
This “Captain Thug” REDUX ALOE 99% PURE MOISTURIZING ORGANIC ALOE VERA GEL (for Face, Body, Hair; All Skin Types; No Added Colour, Fragrance; Coldpressed; 7oz) is a pleasant-smelling, pleasant-textured, non-irritating aloe vera gel. I love that it has so few ingredients other than the actual moisturizing ingredients. (The listed active ingredients are aloe vera gel, xanthum gum, Moroccan argan oil, jojoba oil, tocopherol acetate, and vitamin C.)

The label directions say to apply day and night to cleansed face, neck, and decolletage; leave a short while until absorbed; follow with day/night cream. The gel is absorbed very quickly, and a little goes a long way. As another reviewer pointed out, this product is NOT odorless; the label says "no added fragrance". "Captain Thug” in the product page title apparently refers to the seller; the label only says "Redux".

This aloe vera product is far preferable to the “organic” [[ASIN:B00014E1EQ Jason Gel Aloe Vera]] that was recommended when I needed an aloe gel for extra dry skin. The Jason Gel has an unpleasant odor, and makes my skin sting/burn. (The Jason product has so many obscure chemicals in it, one wonders how it can be marketed as “organic”.)

title: Not Exactly “Sheer” Sunscreen; Protects Adequately
text:
This SOLIMO (Amazon Brand) SHEER FACIAL SUNSCREEN (SPF 30, 3.0 Fluid Ounces) is an effective sunscreen, but I wouldn’t call it a “sheer” sunscreen. When you apply it, it goes on smoothly and spreads easily into a thin layer on your face. However, it still dries with some visibly white areas. It also feels mildly greasy on your face.

My favorite “sheer” sunscreens are both Neutrogena products (see [[ASIN:B00HNSSV3U Neutrogena Ultra Sheer Non-Greasy Sunscreen Stick]], and [[ASIN:B0037LOQQI Neutrogena Age Shield Face Lotion Sunscreen]]. The Neutrogena products actually have much higher Sun Protection Factor (SPF) numbers than this Solimo Sheer Facial Sunscreen (30 SPF). However, any sunscreen rated at 30 SPF blocks about 97% of harmful UVB rays, so the Neutrogena products don’t offer substantially more protection than this one.

What is most important to me in a sunscreen is that (1) it shouldn’t feel greasy, or (2) go on thickly so that it runs into my eyes when I sweat, or (3) go on thickly so it dries white (and looks awful when I put it on outdoors without a mirror). For me, this Solimo “sheer” sunscreen is acceptable, but barely; I’ll use it up and go back to Neutrogena.

title: Light Fragrance; Works Well in Sensor-Activated Soap Dispenser
text:
This SOLIMO (AMAZON BRAND) ANTIBACTERIAL LIGHT MOISTURIZING LIQUID HAND SOAP REFILL (Triclosan Free, 56 Fluid Ounces) works well in my [[ASIN:B0798JF34D Wimaha automatic soap dispenser]]. It has a light, pleasant fragrance, and gets my hands clean.

My hands feel a little dry after I use it--it only promises “light moisturizing”--but it doesn’t seem to irritate my skin the way that some liquid soaps do. Light moisturizing means that the soap liquid is thinner, and thinner soaps work best in sensor-activated dispensers.

title: Vitamin E-Infused Socks Carry Warnings, No Instructions for Safe Use
text:
These GAIAM RELAX MOISTURIZING SOCKS fit my women’s size 8 feet comfortably and snugly, but not so snugly that they make me think I’m at the top of the size range. They’re open-toed, and just barely cover the heel, so they won’t work as liner socks. They have a gel liner inside, on the heel and soles of the feet only.

Sadly, I won’t be using these socks, because they come without ANY instructions on how to use them. All you get is a flyer with warnings how NOT to use them: (1) without consulting your doctor, if you have heart disease, high blood pressure, “or any other disease or condition”; (2) if you have diabetes, nerve damage, circulatory conditions, sensitive skin, or damaged or broken skin; or (3) if you “are unable to remove the product from the packaging, such as infants, children, and some older persons”.

Isn’t the cracked skin that they’re supposed to heal considered broken skin? Whatever, the gel may not be safe for everyone, because it is “infused with slow release vitamin E” (along with mineral oil, jojoba oil, olive oil, and grapeseed oil). There are side effects caused by too much vitamin E (try Googling WebMD for vitamin E). In the absence of general use instructions, it’s impossible to know how much vitamin E you are getting.

title: Strange Product Has Warnings Without Directions for Safe Use
text:
These GAIAM MOISTURIZING GLOVES are a rather strange product. The retail packaging has no instructions on how to use them. Inside the box is a flyer with warnings NOT to use them: (1) without consulting your doctor, if you have heart disease, high blood pressure, “or any other disease or condition”; (2) if you have diabetes, nerve damage, circulatory conditions, sensitive skin, or damaged or broken skin; or (3) if you “are unable to remove the product from the packaging, such as infants, children, and some older persons”.

What’s the deal with the warning NOT to use the gloves with damaged or broken skin, when the product is supposed to treat dry and cracked hands and fingers? (I wanted them for treating hangnail-producing cracks around my fingernails.) The warning flyer also says to “use product only as directed”, but as previously mentioned, there are NO directions on how to use them (e.g., how long to wear them per session).

The gloves consist of stretchy polyester/spandex fabric with a gel lining. They fit my women’s size 8 hands with some room to spare. However, the gel may not be safe for everyone, because it is “infused with slow release vitamin E” (along with mineral oil, jojoba oil, olive oil, and grapeseed oil). Before using these gloves, try Googling WebMD for the possible dangers, side effects, and drug interactions caused by too much vitamin E!

Probably you won’t get sick from wearing these for a short time each day, but who knows? I wore mine for about half an hour, and found them pleasantly comfortable; however, I didn’t care particularly for the mild fragrance. After the session, my hands and fingertips felt lubricated (but less so than after using hand lotion). Then, after a short time, my fingertips felt dry--definitely not moisturized.

I will be discarding these gloves, for two reasons. First, I don’t know how much vitamin E they are dispensing. Second, the warnings on the flyer make me uneasy, given the lack of recommendations for safe use.

title: Made Little Difference With Short Hair
text:
This GARNIER HAIR CARE WHOLE BLENDS LEAVE-IN MIRACLE NECTAR HONEY TREASURES TREATMENT (5 Fluid Ounce) left my short hair looking pretty much the same as always. I added it after using my regular shampoo and regular conditioner. If anything, it made my hair feel less soft, and look less shiny. The ends of my hair seemed unchanged. it’s possible that the treatment made my hair easier to comb.

The fragrance of this treatment is similar to the fragrance found in other Garnier hair care products. It’s reasonably pleasant, fairly light, and doesn’t hang around for hours. This is essential for any product that is intended for you to leave in your hair. You work in a very small amount--the size of a quarter or less--with each use.

title: Label Recommends Use With Styling Products
text:
This MYSTIC BOTANICALS HYDRATE AND NOURISH CONDITIONER (Babassu Oil/mango/shea Butter, 8 Fluid Ounce) leaves my short hair looking shiny, with reasonable body. However, it doesn’t seem to hydrate much--it leaves my undamaged hair feeling dry (compared to most other conditioners that I’ve used).

The instructions say: “Follow with one of our amazing styling products.” I didn’t do this, as my haircut is strictly “wash and wear”. However, I did leave the conditioner on for at least 2 minutes (the label says to leave it on for 1-5 minutes). Overall, I was disappointed in the way this product performed when used all by itself as a conditioner.

The conditioner has a light, pleasant fragrance. The scent goes away fairly quickly.

title: Body Wash Is Hard to Wash Off
text:
This NATURE BOX SENSITIVE SKIN BODY WASH (with 100% Cold Pressed Almond Oil, 13 Ounce) has a mild almond scent, and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. However, it goes on as a thick, slick layer that’s hard to wash off.

After I got the body wash off, I didn’t feel particularly clean (as I usually do after showering and applying soap, shower gel, or body wash). The scent is nothing to shout about; fortunately, the fragrance doesn’t hang around for hours.

I don’t care for this product, and will be discarding most of it.

title: Leaves Hair Shiny, Soft, With Body--My New Favorite!
text:
This PANTENE SHAMPOO & CONDITIONER WITH ACTIVATED CHARCOAL, PRO-V BLENDS (35.8 fl oz) is my new favorite shampoo and conditioner! It leaves my hair looking really, really clean and shiny, and also soft, with reasonable body. What more can you ask for?

The shampoo and conditioner both have a light, pleasant fragrance that doesn’t hang around for long. They come in pump bottles that work well.

title: Seems to Help With Bags Under Fatigued Eyes
text:
This BEST DEAL EYE CREAM WITH ROSEHIP & HIBISCUS (1.7 fl oz) definitely seems to help with the puffy bags under my fatigued eyes. It works (like all the eye creams that I’ve tried) by hydrating the skin. It has almost no fragrance, and has a pleasant consistency. It’s basically a thick, quickly-absorbed lotion.

The eye cream comes in a small pump dispenser that I like a lot. The dispenser makes it easy to get a small amount--which matters when you’re applying something around your eyes. The instructions say that you can use it on your face and neck, if you wish. I use it on the lines around my mouth, as well as under my eyes, because it feels good on my face. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Strong Fragrance Reminds Me of Christmas Cookies
text:
Like other Garnier products, this GARNIER HAIR CARE WHOLE BLENDS GINGER RECOVERY STRENGTHENING CONDITIONER (22 Fluid Ounce) has a strong fragrance that hangs around for quite a while. I love the fragrance, which reminds me of Christmas cookies, but it’s potent enough to compete with perfume.

The conditioner, used in combination with the shampoo from the same Ginger Recovery Strengthening line, leaves my hair looking plump, healthy, and shiny. It doesn’t leave a coating, and doesn’t alter my hair color.

The conditioner bottle is designed for cap down storage, so that the thick conditioner is always ready to dispense.

title: Shampoo Gets Hair Squeaky Clean; Conditioner Leaves Hair Silky Soft
text:
This PANTENE SHAMPOO AND CONDITIONER WITH MICELLAR WATER AND MICELLAR MILK (10.1 fl oz, Kit) leaves my hair glossy and silky soft. The shampoo literally makes your hair “squeaky” clean; it strips off oiliness almost instantly. The shampoo and conditioner have a light, fresh fragrance that doesn’t hang around; it won’t interfere with or overwhelm your perfume.

This shampoo/conditioner combination does NOT improve your hair’s body. My hair has less body after I use it, but is much softer, silkier, and shinier.

title: Makes Your Hair Smell Like Christmas Cookies
text:
Like other Garnier products, this GARNIER HAIR CARE WHOLE BLENDS GINGER RECOVERY STRENGTHENING SHAMPOO (22 Fluid Ounce) has a strong fragrance that lasts for a couple of hours. It makes your hair smell like Christmas cookies! I love the fragrance, but wouldn’t wash my hair with this shampoo just before going out if I was planning to wear perfume.

The shampoo leaves my hair looking plump, healthy, and somewhat shiny, even when used alone without conditioner. It doesn’t leave a coating of any kind, and it doesn’t alter my hair color. I like this shampoo a lot, and expect to like it even better when I use it with the conditioner from the same Ginger Recovery line.

Be a little cautious when you use the shampoo for the first time--the bottle dispenses a LOT of shampoo when you tilt it.

title: Excellent Sprayers Deliver Fine Spray or Stream
text:
These E-LIVING GLASS SPRAY BOTTLES (for Cleaners, Essential Oils, Beauty Products, Aromatherapy; Set of 2, Amber, 8 oz. Each, with 2 Chalkboard Labels) have excellent sprayers that can deliver either a fine spray or a fairly powerful stream. The amber glass is an attractive color, and probably protects the contents to some extent from exposure to light.

The reusable chalkboard labels are a nice extra. You’ll need a liquid chalk marker (e.g., [[ASIN:B01LXTP755 Kassa White Chalk Markers]]) to write on them; a marker is NOT included.

My bottles arrived unbroken (individually wrapped in bubble wrap). The sprayers do NOT leak when turned upside down and shaken. (A package insert recommends turning the sprayers to “X” (meaning “Off”) to prevent possible leakage.)

The amber glass bottles are dishwasher safe; the sprayers are NOT dishwasher safe. The screw-on part of the sprayers seems a little bit flimsy, but I don’t expect mine to break with normal use. The 8 oz. bottles are smaller than I expected, because the product description says “16 oz.” (which is correct for 2 bottles).

title: Relaxing Fragrance, Leaves Skin Feeling Nourished
text:
This CRABTREE & EVELYN SOOTHING SHOWER MILK (Goatmilk and Oat, 8.5 fl. oz.) has a fairly strong but pleasant fragrance, and it's quite relaxing. It can be used in either the bath or the shower, and it leaves your skin feeling nourished.

I have sensitive skin, but I can use this product without any problems. The “Goat Milk” products have long been my personal C&E favorites for use at bedtime.

title: Lighted, 3-Mirror, Folding Travel Mirror Has It All
text:
This MAGICFLY TRAVEL MAKEUP MIRROR (10X/5X/1X Magnification, with LED Lights, USB Rechargeable, Black) has it all—a standard 1X mirror, a 5X magnifying mirror, a 10X magnifying mirror, and LED lights surrounding the two magnifying mirrors. Folded, the mirror is a little larger and thicker than a woman’s powder compact.

The 5X mirror is right for applying eye and lip makeup, and the 10X mirror is right for examining pores or blemishes. The lights around these two mirrors are bright enough to make the mirrors useful in any situation, and the lights can be dimmed by holding down the button that turns the lights on and off.

I love having three different mirrors available in a single, compact, folding case. The battery inside the case is rechargeable, by using the included USB cable. The folding travel mirror also comes with a silky drawstring bag that’s large enough to hold both the mirror and the charging cable.

The non-removable 300maH rechargeable battery is a “high quality lithium battery”. My mirror set arrived fully charged. The instructions say that first-time charging takes 8 hours, and subsequent charges take 5 hours. The charge should last 1 to 5 weeks, depending on how often you use the LED lights.

title: 54-Ounce Size Really Does Represent Good Value
text:
This “value size” VITA COCO ORGANIC VIRGIN COCONUT OIL (54 Oz., Cold Pressed, Unrefined, Non-GMO) arrives in a big plastic jar that reminds me of a sandwich-shop-sized mayonnaise jar. It really does represent good value.

The coconut oil is solid at temperatures below 77 degrees Fahrenheit, and it does NOT require refrigeration after opening. There is a “Best Before” date on the label, but the date on the jar I ordered in early 2018 says “05/FEB/20”, which gives me plenty of time to use it up.

I tried some on my hands as skin conditioner, and it worked fine. It melts on contact with your skin, so you’re basically putting oil on your skin. (If you go outdoors without sunscreen, it may act like suntan oil.) It has a mild, pleasant coconut odor that’s very much like coconut-fragrance soap.

Mine will be used in cooking and baking, so I was most interested in the nutritional information. One tablespoon has 120 calories (all calories are from fat). One tablespoon has 14g total fat (12g saturated fat, 1g monounsaturated fat). If you taste it straight from the jar, it has a mild coconut flavor that’s pretty much the same as it smells.

title: Skin Feels Softer, Smoother in Morning
text:
This NEUTROGENA HYDRO BOOST MOISTURIZING OVERNIGHT GEL CREAM FACE MASK (with Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid, 0.3 fl. oz (12 single-use masks)) works as advertised for me. When I apply it at night and rinse it off in the morning, my face feels more hydrated—smoother and softer. Water removes the mask.

Usually I’m sensitive to fragrance, but the mask’s mild, vaguely floral scent doesn’t bother me, and it doesn’t hang around. (At least that’s true if you don’t slather the gel on, and only use about half of what’s in the plastic cup.)

The plastic cups have a peel-back label that lists the ingredients and gives directions for use. The directions are simple: “Apply after your normal skincare routine at night to give your skin an extra boost of hydration. Apply evenly onto the face and leave it overnight. Rinse it off in the next morning.”

title: Heady, Complicated Fragrance Is Hard to Describe
text:
With any fragrance, it’s all a matter of personal taste and style. I like this BURBERRY BRIT EAU DE PARFUM SPRAY (3.3 Fl Oz) quite well—it’s heady and complicated, very hard to describe. First impression is citrus (lime), but then along comes vanilla, cinnamon (?), and then a bit of floral (gardenia?).

I’d say this is a daytime fragrance. It’s NOT particularly sexy (unless your other thinks so), but it’s extremely pleasant. It’s feminine, though not as “tailored” as I would like (and was expecting from a fragrance from Burberry named “Brit”). I’d say it’s a reasonably memorable fragrance, but it’s expensive for what it is. You need to really love it to pay $100, even for a large 3.3 fl. oz. bottle (a [[ASIN:B00FPQOJWE smaller 1.6 fl oz. size]] is available).

The rather plain bottle is heavy glass, with a square block of clear acrylic forming the cap. The cap lifts straight up to expose the atomizer. The atomizer delivers a lot of perfume, so you want to hold it well away when you spray, or you’ll get too much. A little goes a long way.

Unlike many perfumes, this one does NOT make me sneeze. It also retains its perfume identity for me. (Many perfumes—including some rather famous and expensive ones—react to my body chemistry by smelling soapy after a few minutes.)

title: Pale Green Mask/Cleanser Delivers Deep Cleansing, Is Drying
text:
The active ingredient in this NEUTROGENA DEEP CLEAN MASK/CLEANSER (Purifying Clay 4.2 Ounce (124ml)) is salicylic acid, which is used in doctor-prescribed formulations to treat acne, psoriasis, and warts. The Neutrogena product is intended for acne treatment, and may cause irritation if used simultaneously with another acne treatment product.

The clay mask is pale green when applied—you look like someone seen at a spa in a movie comedy in a cucumber mask! (Not a problem—it’s kind of fun.) You can use the product as a daily deep cleanser, or as an overnight mask. In either case, it rinses off easily with water.

When I used this as a deep cleanser, it left my face feeling clean, tight, and very dry. The ingredients list says the product includes fragrance, but this is minimal and doesn’t hang around. The mask doesn’t seem to irritate my sensitive skin (after a few uses). It contains an ingredient that makes you more susceptible to sunburn, so it should be used with sunscreen.

title: Dermatologist Recommends CeraVe Products
text:
My dermatologist recommends CeraVe products for calming dry, irritated skin (and the red rash and/or bumps on my legs); and in my experience the products are quite effective. This RENEWING SA BODY CLEANSER (with Salicylic Acid, 8 oz., Normal Skin) is no exception.

Salicylic acid helps smooth my rough skin patches. The product formula cleanses without drying or irritating. Also, the product is fragrance-free, which is always a big plus. (Most scented beauty products irritate my sinuses and make me sneeze.)

title: Excellent Cleansing Gel for Sensitive Skin
text:
This AVEENO ULTRA-CALMING HYDRATING GEL FACIAL CLEANSER (for Dry and Sensitive Skin, 5 oz) makes my face feel really clean, and it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. It has no fragrance, which is always a big plus.

You smooth the gel onto your face, forming a gentle lather. (A little of the gel goes a long way.) Then you rinse your face with water. The gel rinses off easily and completely, leaving no residue.

title: Thick Almond-Scented Cream Is Quickly Absorbed
text:
This LE PETIT MARSEILLAIS NOURISHING BODY BALM (Shea Butter/Sweet Almond/Argan Oil, 8.4 Fluid Ounces) is a very thick cream, but it’s quickly absorbed by your skin. It feels very luxurious when you’re applying it. I use it for my hands, which dry out at the fingertips (because of dishwashing, vegetable washing, etc.). It does a good job of remoisturizing my hands.

The cream has a moderately strong almond fragrance that hangs around for quite a while. That’s not a problem for me, because I like almond-scented soaps and lotions. The price (about $25 on Amazon) seems reasonable, because you get a good-sized jar of cream that should last for quite a few applications.

title: Lives Up to Advertising Claims
text:
This VMV HYPOALLERGENICS ARMADA SPORT 50 SUNSCREEN (3.0 Fluid Ounce) lives up to the advertising claims. It doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin, and it’s a light cream that goes on fast and doesn’t leave a greasy residue on my face or hands.

The SPF (sun protection factor) rating on the label is the maximum allowed by the FDA (since February 2017). (There is little evidence that higher numbers provide more protection. They reflect the time it takes to develop a sunburn, and sunscreens generally must be applied every 2 hours.)

This is a broad spectrum sunscreen; it protects against both UVA and UVB rays.

title: Hydrates Skin Quickly, Feels Wonderful on Face
text: This OLAY REGENERIST WHIP FACE MOISTURIZER (1.7 oz.) is expensive (about $29 on Amazon), but it feels wonderful on my face.  It’s “lightly scented”, but the scent is pleasant and disappears quickly.  The whipped lotion is absorbed very, very fast, and really hydrates your skin.  It doesn’t feel even the tiniest bit greasy.  I love this product, which seems worth the price.

title: Dries Clear, Isn’t Greasy, Provides Decent Sun Protection
text:
This COPPERTONE DEFEND & CARE CLEAR ZINC SUNSCREEN (Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Lotion, 6 Fluid Ounces) lives up to its advertising claims. It comes out of the bottle as a white lotion, but it dries clear (as long as you wipe off any really thick excess).

Most importantly for me, it doesn’t feel like you have a thick, greasy coating of something on your face after you apply it. Far from feeling greasy, it makes the skin on your face feel soft. Also, the sunscreen doesn’t run into your eyes (as you perspire normally) after it’s been on your face for a few hours.

As I understand it, the latest research says you don’t need a really high SPF number (over 100, say) to get reasonable sun protection. Whatever the current received wisdom is about SPFs, this keeps my fair skin from burning when I’m outdoors for 30-45 minutes at the local farmer’s market.

title: Battery-Powered, Exfoliating Facial Cleansing Brush
text:
This FOREO LUNA PLAY PLUS is a great little device—it’s a battery-powered, vibrating, portable facial cleansing brush. It’s gentle, but really good at exfoliating (removing dead skin cells from your face) as you cleanse your face.

You start by removing your makeup. Then you wet the Luna Play Plus, add your usual cleanser to your face, press the power button, and move the device gently in circles across your cheekbones, forehead, nose, and chin. You clean the Luna Play Plus by rinsing it with water.

The “Plus” model of the Luna Play series of devices comes with an AAA battery already installed. The battery is replaceable (but you’ll need a very small Phillips screwdriver). There is also a [[ASIN:B018T7DHVY rechargeable Luna Play model]] available, and a model without a replaceable battery.

title: Works for Short Hair
text: This L’OREAL PARIS ELNETT PRECIOUS OIL SATIN HAIRSPRAY (11 Ounce) works well for me.  I have short hair, and it holds down the occasional morning “cowlick”.  I love the super-fine mist and mild fragrance.  The hairspray doesn’t leave my hair feeling stiff or lacquered, and it combs/brushes out easily.

title: Fragrance-Free Hand Cream Is Thick, But Quickly Absorbed
text:
This CERAVE THERAPEUTIC HAND CREAM (3 oz; with Hyaluronic Acid and Ceramides for Skin Protection, Restoration and Repair) is thick enough to make a difference to dry skin, but is absorbed quickly (within a minute or two). Fast absorption is important to me, because I don’t like being unable to use my hands when they’re covered with glop. This hand cream helps to hydrate my fingertips, which dry out even from gentle soaps.

This hand cream is totally lacking in fragrance (a very good thing, in my opinion). The active ingredient is dimethicone; extras are hyaluronic acid (helps retain collagen, improves skin texture and appearance), and ceramides (skin barrier effect).

title: Oil-Free Sunscreen Gives High Level of Protection
text:
This CERAVE SUNSCREEN FACE LOTION (SPF 50 2 oz with Zinc Oxide, Niacinamide, and Ceramides for Broad Spectrum Sun Protection) is formulated to protect against both UVA and UVB rays, so it provides “sunblock” protection (helps protect against melanomas as well as common skin cancers). Active ingredients are zinc oxide and titanium dioxide; unlike many “sunblocks”, it is oil-free.

The face lotion is lightweight, and dries quickly. It does NOT dry completely clear—my fair skin is faintly white after application. (However, I do tend to slather sunscreen on.)

The “low” SPF 50 designation does NOT mean the lotion provides less protection than a product with a higher SPF number. Current thinking is that SPF 50 provides as much protection as anyone needs.

title: Goes on Smoothly; Repairs Severely Chapped Lips
text:
This JUNETICS PURE ENERGY LIP BALM (0.37 Ounce) goes on smoothly—the tube has a great applicator tip. The balm is about the same consistency as petroleum jelly (in tubes, not jars). It’s pleasant-tasting. I think it’s effective for repairing dry, distressed lips, as it claims, but I’m not so sure about the “energizing” claim.

Specifically, the box states: “Harnessing skin’s most powerful age-defying secret, Junetics’ revolutionary E24 Complex works day and night to boost cellular energy and cell-to-cell communication deep within skin, combating life’s aging aggressors to help restore the appearance of more youthful, ageless skin.”

I didn’t notice any real difference in the skin of my lips, other than the moisturizing and repair of severely chapped lips. The tube says to apply the balm liberally morning and night, and as needed during the day.

title: Large Block With Spicy Fragrance Should Appeal to Men
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE NO. 63 MEN’S 200 GRAM CUBE SOAP (Aromatic, Warm and Spicy) comes as a block, not an actual cube (like some Pre de Provence soaps). That's a good thing, because it's easier to hold and use than a cube is. The soap has a mild but distinctively spicy fragrance that most men (and their women) should like.

This is a large slab of luxurious French soap. It produces a thick lather, and the fragrance never lingers too long. The soap is very gentle, and doesn't irritate sensitive skin.

title: Luxurious French Soap With Musky Masculine Fragrance
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE “PATCHOULI” SHEA BUTTER ENRICHED SOAP (250 Gram) has the mild, musky fragrance that many women find sexy, but the fragrance is risky. To some people (including me) it smells like “fungus” or “damp basement”. Still, this soap may appeal to male household members, because it's so different from most other Pre de Provence soaps (with their fairly strong, flowery fragrances).

This is a large bar of luxurious French soap. It lathers beautifully, and the fragrance never lingers too long. The soap is very gentle, and doesn't irritate sensitive skin.

For men, a much safer Pre de Provence soap is the “Sandalwood” bar (see [[ASIN:B01LWWOLW2 Pre de Provence Sandalwood]]).

title: Luxurious French Soap With Mild, Masculine Fragrance
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE “Sandalwood” SHEA BUTTER ENRICHED SOAP (250 Gram) should appeal to the male members of the household, because of the mild, woody fragrance. (Most Pre de Provence soaps have fairly strong, flowery fragrances.)

It's a large bar of luxurious French soap. It lathers beautifully, and the fragrance never lingers too long. The soap is very gentle, and doesn't irritate sensitive skin.

title: Luxurious French Soap Has “Fresh Sea Breeze” Fragrance
text:
I love Pre de Provence soaps, but was intensely curious about the “Sea Salt” bar. What would it smell like? Why would I want to wash my hands with sea salt? Happily, this PRE DE PROVENCE SEA SALT FRENCH SOAP BAR (150g, 5.2 Ounce) is no different from the other Pre de Provence soaps--it smells wonderful, and produces a rich, thick lather.

The fragrance is hard to describe. It’s kind of floral, but maybe is best described as “fresh sea breeze”. It makes one think of fresh air and sunshine. The fragrance doesn't linger overlong. The soap doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, but may be a little more drying than other Pre de Provence soaps (unless it's my imagination working overtime).

The soap definitely contains salt. The ingredients are: sodium palmate, sodium palm kernelate, water, fragrance, palm acid, titanium dioxide, glycerin, palm kernel acid, SODIUM CHLORIDE, shea butter, sodium hydroxide, tetrasodium edta, tetrasodium etidronate, benzyl salicylate, linalool, geraniol, citral.

title: Luxurious French Soap With Strong Spice Fragrance
text:
Unlike the other Pre de Provence soaps that I’ve tried, this PRE DE PROVENCE SAVON DE FETE “HARVEST SPICE” SHEA BUTTER SOAP (100g) has a very strong fragrance. It smells like a cinnamon stick plus other blended spices (something like pumpkin pie spice). I like it, but it's NOT subtle--no, not subtle at all.

The gift-boxed soap cake is round, and it has a pretty molded chrysanthemum design on both sides. The soap lathers beautifully and feels luxurious. The soap is gentle; it doesn't dry out or irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Beautiful Gift Package, But Eucalyptus/Mint Scent Isn't for Everyone
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE PRIVATE COLLECTION FRENCH SOAP BAR (Eucalyptus & Mint, 110 Gram) comes in an attractive heavy paper envelope with a “figure-eight” closing--so European! It’ll make a great gift, but the eucalyptus & mint” fragrance certainly isn't for everyone. The mint takes the medicinal edge off the eucalyptus scent, but the soap still smells a lot like Vicks topical ointment.

I love the smell of eucalyptus leaves, so I really like this soap--but I wouldn't wash with it when getting ready for a date! The French soap lathers beautifully and feels luxurious. The soap is gentle; it doesn't dry out or irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Wonderful Gift of Luxurious French Soap for Friend
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE FRENCH SOAP ASSORTED BOUTIQUE LUXURY GIFT BOX SET (“Spring Citrus”; Set of 9 Guest Soaps) is a wonderful way to introduce a friend to this luxurious French soap. It lathers beautifully, and the delicate fragrance never lingers too long.

The small (1-½” x 1-½” x ½" ) sampler soaps come in the following fragrances: peony, violette, starflower, raspberry, mirabelle (plum), juicy pomegranate, lemongrass, angels trumpet, and rosemary sage. (The names of the scents are molded into the backs of the soaps.) The soaps are square bars, not cubes (as they appear in some product page photos).

The soap is very gentle, and doesn't irritate sensitive skin.

title: Delicate Orange-y Scent Creates Happy Mood
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE MOROCCAN ARGAN OIL DRY BODY MIST (CITRUS) has a delicate orange-y scent that makes me happy. Basically it's a spray-on body oil--a very fine mist. Be warned that it leaves behind a thin coating of oil that may take your skin several minutes to absorb.

You can use it at pulse points for aromatherapy if you like. I’m using it on my fingertips to help with dry hangnails.

Bear in mind that this an oil treatment--if you sunburn easily, you should use it carefully on skin that's exposed when you go outdoors. It will have the same effect as suntan oil without sunscreen.

title: “Vanilla” Balm Is Perfect for Dry, Chapped Lips
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE MOROCCAN ARGAN OIL BALM FOR DRY SKIN (Vanilla) is what I would call a “lip balm”. It's packaged in a small, purse- or pocket-sized tube. The beeswax-like balm goes on smoothly, and provides lasting protection. (I was very surprised at how long a thin layer of balm remained on my lips!)

The stick of balm advances when you twist the lower part of the cardboard tube. As the printed package instructions say, the “Vanilla” flavor is absolutely perfect for dry, chapped lips.

title: Lemony "Verbena" Guest Soap Makes Lovely Small Gift
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE LUXURY BOX OF GUEST GIFT SOAP (“Verbena”; Set of 5) makes a lovely small gift for a friend. The lightweight cardboard box has a pretty floral design, and is exactly the right size to hold five little bars of guest soap. The soap itself lathers beautifully, and feels luxurious.

I love the lemony “Verbena” fragrance, which smells fresh and clean (and not at all like lemon-scented household cleaners!). The soap is gentle; it doesn't dry out or irritate my sensitive skin.

title: Thick Cream With Delicate Rose Fragrance Absorbs Quickly
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE “ROSE DE MAI” BODY CREAM is a thick cream with a delicate rose fragrance. It's very soothing to apply--at least if you like rose-scented toiletries as much as I do!

The cream is quickly absorbed, and it's not greasy at all. The fragrance lingers for a while, but not overlong. The body cream goes very well with the [[ASIN:B00I06ZTFM Pre de Provence “Rose de Mai” Shower Gel]].

title: Travel-Size Hand Cream Leaves Hands Feeling Silky Smooth
text:
This PRE DE PROVENCE TRIPLE BUTTER RICHE HAND CREAM FOR SOFT SKIN (“Amande”; Travel Size (1 fl oz)) is a thick, nongreasy cream that's absorbed quickly. It has a wonderful, delicate almond scent that doesn't linger for hours. And It really does leave your hands feeling soft and silky.

On my skin, unfortunately, the cream smells soapy after a while. This happens to me with perfumes, too--it's just a matter of skin chemistry. This is a small-size travel tube, but there is a lot of hand cream in it.

title: Thin, Very Wet Body Cream With Neutral “Cold Cream” Fragrance
text:
PRE DE PROVENCE ULTRA-HYDRATING EAUX FRAICHES BODY CREAM FOR MOISTURIZING DRY SKIN (Oh Fresh) is a thin, very wet body cream with a mild, neutral “cold cream” fragrance. Unfortunately, the fragrance hangs around, and on my skin it quickly begins to smell unpleasantly “soapy”.

It does NOT irritate my sensitive skin, and it does make my dry skin areas feel silky smooth. A little goes a long way in coverage, probably because it's designed primarily to hydrate skin. It seems to hydrate my skin really well.

However, my personal preference is for a thicker body cream (e.g., Lubriderm) that gives the impression of providing deeper moisturizing and leaving behind a layer of skin protection.

title: Feels Luxurious, Doesn't Dry Out Sensitive Skin
text:
This EUROPEAN SOAPS (PRE DE PROVENCE) SHEA BUTTER ENRICHED FRENCH SOAP BAR (Lime Zest, 250 g) lathers beautifully, and feels luxurious. It has a delicate, delightful lime fragrance, very light.

The soap doesn't dry out or irritate my sensitive skin, so I can use it every day. This is a large bar that gives good value for the money (about $9 on Amazon).

title: Favorite Lavender Fragrance, Color; Elegant Cube Shape
text:
Lavender is my favorite fragrance for hand soap, so how could I not love this PRE DE PROVENCE MARSEILLE SHEA BUTTER ENRICHED SOAP (Lavender Sage (150 Gram))? It lathers beautifully, feels incredibly luxurious, and doesn't dry out or irritate my sensitive skin. I can use it daily!

The cube looks great as an elegant bathroom or guest soap. Mine arrived with slightly banged-up edges (showing white), but it looked fine after the first use. The cube shape is more awkward to handle than a conventional bar shape, and is easier to drop. However, the delicate lavender color with brown flecks of sage is very attractive.

title: Feels Luxurious, Doesn't Dry Out Sensitive Skin
text: This PRE DE PROVENCE SHEA BUTTER ENRICHED ARTISANAL FRENCH SOAP BAR (Olive Oil (250 g)) lathers beautifully, and feels luxurious.  It doesn't dry out or irritate my sensitive skin, so I can use it every day.  This is a large 250 gram olive oil bar that gives good value for the money (about $7 on Amazon).

title: Wonderful for Dry Skin on Legs, Shins
text:
This budget-priced MOUNTAIN FALLS EXTRA-DRY SKIN LOTION (16 Fluid Ounce) is really wonderful for the dry skin on my legs (particularly the shins). It's a thick, soothing lotion that's absorbed fairly quickly (unlike the many dry skin lotions that take 10 minutes or more to be absorbed).

It has a mild, pleasant floral fragrance that doesn't hang around. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, and even seems to be helping with a rash that came on recently when I switched laundry detergents.

title: Eyes Tired by Reading Look Better Almost Immediately
text:
This OLAY EYES DEEP HYDRATING EYE GEL (with Hyaluronic Acid, 0.5 fl oz) really works! When I apply it, my reading-tired eyes look better almost immediately. There are limits, of course, to what it can do to “erase” bags under the eyes, but this product works better than any other product of this type that I’ve ever tried.

OLAY EYES is a gel containing a lot of water. It is quickly absorbed, but it does leave a thin, invisible film on the face. The film easily washes off at night with plain water. This product doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. It has no fragrance, which is always a plus for me.

title: Mild Fragrance; Leaves Hair Soft, Hydrated; Budget Priced
text:
The bottle says that this MOUNTAIN FALLS SOFT AND SLEEK CONDITIONER (28 Fluid Ounce (Pack of 4)) compares to TRESemme brand conditioner, which I haven't tried. However, it's a pleasant-smelling conditioner that leaves your hair soft, with some body. The mild fragrance doesn’t hang around, which is a plus.

Unlike the John Frieda conditioner I’ve been using, it does NOT leave my hair shining. It does leave my hair feeling hydrated--not dry like it feels when I shampoo and skip the conditioner. The price is extremely attractive (about $13.00 for four big bottles, on Amazon).

title: Mild Fragrance; Lots of Foam; Leaves Hair, Scalp Clean; Budget Priced
text:
The bottle says that this MOUNTAIN FALLS DANDRUFF SHAMPOO (Dry scalp, 23.7 Fluid Ounce (Pack of 4)) compares to Head and Shoulders brand shampoo, and that's probably accurate. It's a pleasant-smelling shampoo that gets your hair and scalp clean, and that's about it. I still prefer the John Frieda products for leaving my hair both clean and shining.

This shampoo produces tons of foam--way more than any other shampoo that I’ve tried. The mild fragrance doesn't hang around, and that's a plus. The bottle directions say to shake well before use. The price is extremely attractive (under $14.00 for four large bottles, on Amazon).

title: No Secret, It's an Olive Oil Product
text: This ABEAUTY EYES AND LIPS ULTRA NOURISHING SERUM (0.5 Fluid Ounce) consists of a slender tube of fragrance-free white “lotion” that's dispensed evenly and sparingly from a tip holding 3 tiny silver roller balls.  It's an olive-oil product, so it works on reducing eye and lip wrinkles by restoring oil to the skin.

title: Overnight Product Goes On Smoothly, Effectively Hydrates Skin
text: This AVEENO OVERNIGHT HYDRATING FACIAL (1.7 Ounce) goes on smoothly, in a thin coating that's quickly absorbed.  It's cooling, and feels great.  The light, sort-of-floral fragrance is very pleasant, and doesn't hang around for hours.  It seems to be quite effective at hydrating my skin overnight.  One jar contains enough product for many applications, and the product needs to be applied only about three times per week.

title: Light, Refreshing Fragrance Is Welcome Change From Floral
text:
This HERBAL ESSENCES BIORENEW CUCUMBER & GREEN TEA SHEER MOISTURE CONDITIONER (13.5 Fl. Oz.) has a light, refreshing fragrance that is a welcome change from the floral fragrances used in most hair care products. The fragrance doesn't hang around for hours, either.

This product leaves my hair looking shiny and well-conditioned. My short hair combs easily and doesn't fly away or tangle. I like this conditioner a lot.

title: Works Amazingly Well on Severely Chapped Lips
text:
This NEUTROGENA HYDRO BOOST LIP TREATMENT (0.10 oz.) works better than anything else that I’ve tried (e.g., petroleum jelly, beeswax lip balm, Chapstick, etc.) to treat my perpetually chapped lips. It comes in a clear plastic case that holds a tiny, tiny amount, so it's NOT intended to be slathered on your lips like ordinary lip balms.

Instead, you need to use a very small amount for each application--just enough to cover your lips. I find that it restores moisture and smoothness to severely chapped lips, and that an application lasts for 12-24 hours. I like this product so much, I was delighted to learn that it's eligible for the Amazon Subscribe & Save program. I only wish that it weren't packaged in such a deceptive, wastefully large, hard plastic case.

title: As Advertised: Non-Greasy, No Rinsing Required
text:
I like this VICHY PURETE THERMALE 3-IN-1 ONE STEP CLEANSER FOR SENSITIVE SKIN a lot, because it really IS non-greasy, and it really DOESN’T require rinsing. You just apply it with a cotton pad to remove your makeup (including eye makeup).

This cleanser doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It has a pleasant fragrance, though it would be even better if there were no fragrance at all. The tubes are generously sized, and a small amount of cleanser goes a long way.

title: Overpowering Floral Fragrance Negates Good Qualities
text:
This SUPER-MAX CARE COLLAGEN CREAM is thick and does a good job of rehydrating and rebuilding aged or sun-damaged skin. Unfortunately, it has an overpowering floral fragrance that lasts for hours.

The fragrance does NOT make me sneeze (unlike many perfumes and perfumed products), but breathing in the fragrance makes me feel kind of sick after 15-30 minutes. The cream doesn't wash off easily, either. Because of the strong fragrance, this is suitable for night-time application only, and it's unsuitable for anyone who is sensitive to fragrances.

title: Silver & Pearl Pump Displays Pale Green Hand Soap Beautifully
text:
This SOFTSOAP LIQUID HAND SOAP PUMP, WILD BASIL AND LIME (8 Ounce, Pack Of 6) is filled with lightly herbal-scented, liquid hand soap. The "decor" pump is very attractive--the cap is bright silver (chrome), the pump itself is pearlized plastic, and the transparent bottle displays the pale green color of the clear soap beautifully. There is a leaf design on the back of the label that shows through the soap.

The lime-basil fragrance is unusual, and it really grows on you. The soap is mild--it doesn't irritate my hands. The 8-ounce size contains a lot of soap without taking up a lot of space around the sink.

title: Shampoo With Pleasant Citrus/Floral/Coconut Fragrance
text:
This HERBAL ESSENCES BIORENEW GOLDEN MORINGA OIL SMOOTH SHAMPOO (13.5 fl oz) has an unusual citrus/floral/coconut fragrance that's light and pleasant. A small amount of shampoo lathers quickly, it rinses off easily, and one application makes my hair feel clean. The fragrance lasts about as long as it takes your hair to air dry.

This shampoo is designed to be followed by [[ASIN:B01MSSX7JE Herbal Essences Conditioner, Golden Moringa Oil]]. Used together, these two products don't add body, but they leave my hair looking very healthy and shiny. (Body is not an issue when I blow dry, rather than air dry, my short haircut.)

title: When Used With "Ever Pure Frizz Defy" Shampoo, Conditioner Doesn't Add Much Shine
text:
This L'OREAL PARIS EVER PURE MOISTURE CONDITIONER (8.5 Fluid Ounce) leaves my hair looking shinier than does [[ASIN:B01NBCCMTY L'Oreal Ever Pure Frizz Defy Shampoo]] used by itself, but there still isn't much shine.

The conditioner is a thick foam that works into a good lather. It has a mild, pleasant, unusual fragrance that's a cross between citrus and evergreen. Perhaps it is the rosemary in it that imparts the "green" scent. The fragrance does NOT linger for hours.

After trying a couple of L'Oreal "Ever Pure" shampoos and this conditioner, I'm not at all sold on the "Ever Pure" line of hair care products. Other non-L'Oreal products leave my hair looking shinier and healthier.

title: Truly Fragrance-Free, Leaves No Greasy Residue on Skin
text:
This OLAY REGENERIST NIGHT RECOVERY CREAM & FACE MOISTERIZER (1.7 Ounce) makes my face feel really good. It's absolutely fragrance-free, and it's absorbed very quickly. Unlike most moisturizing lotions, it leaves NO greasy residue on your skin's surface.

My only complaint is that the box contains 1-1/4" of empty vertical space, which makes it look like there is a larger jar inside. The actual size of the jar is the gray portion of the box front, so this isn't the worst example of deceptive packaging that I've ever seen.

It only takes a small amount each night, to cover your face and neck (per the directions). Thus the 1.7 ounce jar contains a lot of nighttime applications, and the price (about $25 on Amazon) is fairly reasonable. I really like this product!

title: Sensitive Skin Needs 3-4 Weeks of "Conditioning"
text:
This WAHL SPEED SHAVE RECHARGEABLE LITHIUM ION WET/DRY WATERPROOF FOIL SHAVER (#7061-500) performs well, has a slide-up trimmer, and rinses clean under a bathroom faucet. It's simple to take apart for cleaning, and it comes with a cleaning brush and a vial of oil for occasionally oiling the cutter blades.

ThIs 7061-500 model is NOT shockproof. A red LED light warns you when the charge is low, and a blue LED light tells you that the shaver is charging. The blue light turns off when the shaver is fully charged. A well-fitting plastic foil guard protects the shaver head. There is a nice travel case. There is NO separate "styling guide"--only an instructions sheet with some tips for getting the best "precision" shave.

***CAVEAT: This shaver is probably not a good choice if you have sensitive skin. The instructions warn: "If you are using an electric shaver for the first time, your skin will probably need to condition itself to this new shaving technique. ... Shave with a light touch and use your Wahl shaver exclusively for three to four weeks, or longer if you have sensitive skin or if your whiskers grow at different angles in certain areas. Initially your shaves may not be as close as you would like, and your skin may get a bit irritated. But if you stick with it, you will eventually get great shaves."

title: Leaves Hair Shining, But Fruity Fragrance Lasts for Hours
text:
I believe the “moisture lock” claim of this GARNIER FRUCTIS MOISTURE LOCK CONDITIONER, because the conditioner really clung to my hair and face when I shampooed in the shower. It took a lot of rinsing to get it off!

Of course, the important thing is whether your hair looks good after you use the product. Well mine looks wonderful—shining and glowing, with good body. However, I probably won’t go on using this product after the bottle is empty, because of the extremely strong, fruity fragrance that lasts for hours. The fragrance will easily overwhelm any perfume you might want to wear.

title: Well-Designed, Attractive Razor, Limited to Features You Need
text:
In my experience, Panasonic products never disappoint. They are always well-designed, attractive, and limited to the features that users actually need (making them simpler to use, and less susceptible to software glitches). This PANASONIC ARC3 CORDLESS ELECTRIC 3-BLADE RAZOR is no exception.

The razor comes with a charger that can be plugged directly into the razor or into a stand holding the razor. It only takes about an hour to fully charge. The razor has a popup trimmer for sideburns, mustaches, etc. The razor is a wet/dry razor that shaves with or without lather, and at the sink or in the shower. The razor is easy to clean by holding it under a faucet and letting water run through it. The razor's foil heads last for a year without needing replacement. And the razor comes with a clear plastic guard that protects it during transport, or works as a stand if you don't like the upright charging stand.

What else could you possibly want in a razor? Oh, yes, a close, comfortable shave! And this razor delivers that, too. It's a really nice package, and it's reasonably priced (under $90 on Amazon).

title: Gently Exfoliates Skin; Suction-Cup Hook Included
text:
Konjac root sponges are known for their ability to exfoliate skin gently, which makes them ideal for daily facial exfoliation. This little JULEP KONJAC SPONGE (with balancing green tea powder) is indeed very gentle on my sensitive skin. Green tea powder is supposed to help acne and generally produce prettier, more radiant skin. My skin didn't look very different after I used this sponge, but my face did feel clean and energized.

The sponge comes with a suction-cup hook that fastens to a mirror; the hook holds the sponge by its hanging cord to allow it to dry between uses. The instructions say to replace the sponge every 1-2 months. (Konjac sponges cannot be cleaned.)

title: Odorless Cleansing Water Doesn't Irritate My Sensitive Skin

My face feels a little tight afterwards, but it doesn't sting or burn. The cleansing water is odorless (or has only a faint fragrance)--which is really great in a product frequently applied at bedtime!

title: Skin Moisturizer With Strong Fragrance, Nice Dispensing Jar
text:
According to the box, this H2O PLUS WATERBRIGHT ILLUMINATING NIGHT CREAM (1.7 ounce) is "clinically proven to enhance skin's radiance, clarity, evenness, complexion, brightness, and texture, all while reducing the intensity of dark spots." If the company says it, it must be true--and I certainly want to believe it. But I can't help wondering how you clinically test things like "clarity", "radiance", and "brightness" of skin?

When I applied this cream to my face at bedtime, it felt fine at first, then it started to sting. (I do have sensitive skin, so a lot of products produce this effect.) The stinging subsided after 5-10 minutes. However, the strong floral fragrance stuck around for hours, and made me even consider getting out of bed to wash it off. (One does hope that regular boyfriends and husbands generally like this fragrance.)

The next morning my face looked about the same as always, but I'm sure you need to use the cream regularly to see any beneficial results. Also, the box says, "For optimal results use with Waterbright Illuminating Serum." The serum is also available on Amazon (about $50 for 1 ounce).

The night cream's dispensing jar is nice, though it's confusing if you haven't encountered one like it before. You remove the flip-off top, then push down on the screw-off top until cream comes up through the center hole. One push dispenses enough for a single application, so you don't waste this expensive cream (about $54 for 1.7 ounce on Amazon).

If you can afford this H2O PLUS line of skin care products, then I say go for it. Because this night cream appears to be an effective skin moisturizer, I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Conveniently Placed Rocker Switches Make This Styler Easy to Use
text:
This REVLON PERFECT HEAT FRIZZ FIGHTER STYLER is the first blow dryer that I’ve ever been able to handle effectively. My first dryer, a Conair model, was far too heavy to hold in one hand. My second dryer, a lightweight Vidal Sassoon model, had a heat/speed slider control that was inconveniently placed on the side of the handle. You couldn’t change the settings without laying the dryer down.

But this lightweight Revlon styler has rocker control switches that are placed conveniently on the pistol-grip handle. You can easily hold it in one hand, and change the speed and heat settings while you’re drying your hair. I have short “precision cut” hair that looks good with air-drying, but it looks better (more body) with blow drying, so I’ll definitely be using this styler in the future.

The blow dryer’s electrical plug has “test” and “reset” buttons for added safety. You have to press the “reset” button after you plug it in, or the dryer won’t turn on. The instructions carry the usual warnings about the possibility of electrocution if you should drop the turned-on dryer into water.

title: Heats Really Fast; Included Barrel Is Suitable for Creating Relaxed Waves in Very Long Hair
text:
This T3 MICRO TWIRL CONVERTIBLE CURLING IRON comes with a 1.25" straight barrel with clip that is suitable for creating glamor waves, tailored waves, or volume with curl in very long hair. (The included barrel is totally unsuited for use with my short hair and bangs.)

The handle can be used with any of four other available barrels (currently priced at $85 each on Amazon). For classic, full length, bouncy and defined curls, you need the 1" straight barrel with clip. For bombshell, full-bodied, sexy-style waves, you need the 1.5" straight barrel. For uniform spiral curls, or mermaid or defined waves, you need the 1" straight barrel. For beachy, textured, natural-looking waves, you need the 1.25"-0.75" tapered barrel. The barrels are easy to insert, and are locked in by a sliding ring at the top of the handle. The barrel clicks when properly locked into place. The locking ring has "padlock" markings that indicate whether the barrel is locked (for use) or unlocked (for removal and swapping of barrels).

WARNING: This curling iron heats up really, really fast! Being unfamiliar with curling irons, I burned my fingers by briefly touching the barrel (accidentally) before the LED lights stopped flashing to signal that the barrel was heated and ready for use. Unfortunately for me, this Twirl Convertible model does NOT come with the heat-resistant protective glove that is included with some other models. Because of the high temperatures achieved, this appliance should be kept under lock and key in households with children.

There are five temperature settings, ranging from 260 degrees F. (for damaged or chemically treated hair) to 410 degrees F. (for normal to thick hair). It's easy to change the settings by double-clicking the power switch and then clicking to cycle through the LED lights indicating the temperature settings. To turn the curling iron off, you hold down the power switch until the LED lights go out. (Oddly, the instructions do not say how to turn the appliance off.)

Using the curling iron requires holding the handle upside down over your head, and then wrapping a strand of hair around the barrel by holding the end of the strand with your other hand. Some manual dexterity is definitely required!

The curling iron has a built-in stand--flat projections on the top of the handle and the tip of the barrel--that allows it to be placed on a level surface. Also included is a pad that is probably intended to further protect any table or countertop when the curling iron is set down on the stand. This is a good thing, because the stand is clumsy to use--the curling iron has to be placed "just so" for the stand to keep the hot barrel off the level surface. There is an auto shutoff feature that turns the curling iron off after one hour.

This is a beautiful curling iron, one that works fast and creates nice waves. However, because the stand is clumsy and there is no protective heat-resistant glove included, I rate it at 4 stars ("I like it" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Odorless Moisturizer Doesn't Irritate Sensitive Skin, Fills in Fine Wrinkles
text:
This EB5 FACIAL CREAM is fragrance-free, and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. You don't need to slather it on--it's quickly absorbed, and a small amount gives you a lot of coverage. It leaves a thin film, but doesn't feel greasy like sun screen/moisturizer products. The label recommends preparing your skin first with [[ASIN:B00LHZC4PG EB5 Cleanser]] and [[ASIN:B00P8F3MRK EB5 Toner]] (a step that I skipped).

EB5 Facial Cream does fill in fine lines and wrinkles, as does any reasonably effective skin moisturizer. This product is marketed as an anti-aging cream (impossible to test). Because it's odorless, hypo-allergenic, and works reasonably well even without the companion products, I rate EB5 Facial Cream it at 4 stars ("I like it" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Works as Advertised on Soles of Feet; Requires Frequent Roller Replacement
text:
This DR. SCHOLL's ELECTRONIC PEDICURE FOOT FILE is a battery-operated sanding device for removing calluses and hard skin from the soles of your feet. When you switch it on, the gritty "antimicrobial treatment" roller spins rapidly, and gently grinds away at the surface of your skin, producing dust-like dander particles. Because of the wide, electric-shaver-head design, it's not useful for smoothing away the hard skin that sometimes forms at the sides of your toes (when you wear tight shoes).

This was painless when I used it on the heels and soles of my feet. It has a "safety stall" feature that stops it if you apply too much pressure. But when I inadvertently touched my thumb against the spinning roller, it hurt! Fortunately the roller didn't break the skin or leave a mark. You need to be careful with this device--especially if you have thin or delicate skin.

The instructions recommend that you NOT use it on children under 12, over sensitive skin areas, or in the presence of poor circulation. It has batteries (included), so it shouldn't be used in the bath or shower; also, you don't want to drop it in a water-filled sink. It's easy to clean--the roller comes out with the click of a button, most of the dander falls out right away, and a soft brush will remove any dander that sticks inside.

Replacement rollers are available from Amazon (e.g., [[ASIN:B00O51FGG8 Dr S Exp Pedi Foot Smoth Refil]]), or from Target, Bed Bath & Beyond, and other sources (prices start around $15 for two rollers). The instructions recommend replacing the roller every 60-90 days.

This Dr. Scholl's Express Pedi Foot Smoother works as advertised--at least on the bottoms and sides of the feet. However, it's kind of expensive to use regularly, because of the need to replace the roller every 2-3 months. I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

title: Softens Deep Creases on Soles of Feet

I slather it on at bedtime, when I'm sure that I won't be getting up right away, because it takes a little while to absorb. The fragrance--which I'm not too fond of--disappears fairly quickly, and is odd rather than unpleasant. I've used this foot cream occasionally as a hand cream, when my hands were extremely dry and I was out of regular hand cream.

This is the same Dr. Scholl's Foot Cream sold in drug stores. The price (about $20) is reasonable, because you get four tubes.

title: Needs Other Products to Make It Work
text:
I have 4a type hair. I usually use Kinky-Curly products but became intrigued about what Miss Jessie's Pillow Soft Curls claimed to be able to do. For my first attempt, I decided I would use it on its own because I think a product that costs $22 should be able to work a little magic by itself. Well, I was wrong. I washed and deep conditioned my hair, then applied the Pillow Soft Curls. Yes, the curls were a little fluffier than when I use Kinky-Curly, but they were not big. They were soft once dried however on that first day. I didn't feel the smell was too strong but that may be because I only used a dime-sized amount per section of hair (I divided my hair into 8 sections). The next day, the curls were dried out completely. So all in all, my first attempt rates as an epic fail.

For my second attempt, I decided to use the LOC method (leave in, oil, cream). I co-washed with Shea Moisture Deep Treatment Masque conditioner. I separated my soaking wet hair into 8 sections. I applied Cantu Shea Butter Leave In Conditioning Cream, then Trader Joe's jojoba oil, then a dime-sized amount of Pillow Soft Curls. Well, my curls are poppin'! There has been a lot of shrinkage, and I would not say my curls are a lot looser, but the definition and shine is amazing. They are less on the ramen-noodle side and more on the corkscrew side. It was a little crunchy as it dried. Today is the 2nd day and my curls are still defined (I pull my hair straight up into an old pair of stockings to sleep in), they are moisturized, and soft (any crunchiness is gone).

So, two thumbs up for the second try. However, for me, this product takes a few other products to make it work. Hence the four-star review.

title: Better than my Kiehls Ultra Facial Cleanser
text:
My go-to face wash for years was always Kiehls Ultra Facial Cleanser. I recently got this cleanser to try, and I have been very impressed. This might actually dethrone the Kiehls for me.

There are a few things I really like about this. Firstly, this does not dry out my face as much as the Kiehls; this also feels much less viscous than the Kiehls, which is nice. Secondly, I really enjoy the eucalyptus smell, which gives fresh vibes. Lastly, there is a nice menthol feeling on your face after using this cleanser. Beyond that, my face feels very clean and fresh after using this.

The biggest drawback with this (the only drawback, really), is that it is quite a bit more expensive per mL vs. the Kiehls. If the price doesn't bother you, grab it.

title: Decent mirror. A bit annoying to set up
text:
This is my second fogless mirror, and the first one that required any setup beyond just sticking it to the wall.

When you get the mirror, you need to peel the cover off the mirror, then wet and apply an anti-fog peel to the mirror. A bit annoying, but at least it comes with 3 anti-fog covers, so when the first one wears out, you don't have to buy another mirror right away.

The first time I used the mirror, it began fogging after 10 or 15 minutes, which was annoying and disappointing. However, the fogging came right off after running some water over it.

However, the mirror has been better since then, staying fogless for the duration of my showers. Not sure if the first time was a fluke, or if I did something wrong, but it appears to be working well now.

I haven't had any problems using the suction cup to mount it. I hung it up about a week ago and it hasn't fallen (and I've taken 5 showers with it hanging).

Overall, not a terrible mirror. I appreciate that it's rectangular and not circular. Not a bad value given it comes with 3 anti-fog peels.

text: Love this and it works good.  Got a sample in my ipsy bag and had to order a bigger one.

title: Great for my curly hair
text: This stuff is great for curly hair! Creates a strong cast and my hair stayed curly for days. The only negative is how it smells. Smells like men's cologne. Please work on the fragrance!

title: Light hold, smells nice
text: Nice, typical feeling mousse, not sure its heavy duty enough for my hair. I like the feel and smell. Will keep using until I figure out where it best fits in. Probably best for crown and roots, like most mousses - and use a harder hold gel for the rest of the hair.

title: Great mascara for eyelash extensions
text: Love the ease of application. Two different brushes for different looks. Never looks clumpy and washes right off, cleanly, with micellar water.

title: Where has this been all my life?!
text: This is a MIRACLE! I have the worst vertical splits (lengthwise) on both of my middle fingers. They keep splitting because every day I snag them on something. I garden and cook, so my nails take a beating. When I got this product, I sat down on my couch, no special tools or set up required. I peeled off a nail bandage and stuck it to my nail over the split. It looks like I perfectly painted the nail with high gloss polish! And its been on for days with me showering, gardening, washing dishes. Haven't snagged it one time! I clipped off the excess with a nail clipper and filed edges smooth. Done! This is the easiest nail product you will ever use! I'm seriously considering using it on all my nails, so they look glossy and perfectly polished and are protected, too. Not sure how long it will last, but so far its been about 3 days and edges are not pulling up at all. Still looks clear and glossy. If you have splitting nails, get this today!

text: My nails have always broken at the base so I have not had nails in over 30 years. If I read this I would think it was BS, but I really have nails now & I highly recommend this great nail strengthener!!

title: Great to use for shampooing hair!
text: I really like the easy to hold scalp massager!

title: Split bath soap
text: This could have been a great birthday gift for my mom. Instead the bubble bath bottle had leaked all over everything and ruined the gift. The only think salvageable was the socks, diffuser oil, body lotion  and rose. She had to clean everything and it took away from the gift. Not satisfied

title: Not the same as the deodorant you buy directly from Acure. Not at all
text: This is NOT the same product you get if you order from the company direct. This product clumps as you apply it and you end up with a huge layer of sticky deodorant all over you and the outside of the container.

title: Five Stars
text: Works great and has ZERO fragrance.

title: Fantastic soap with ZERO artificial ingredients
text: Fantastic soap with ZERO artificial ingredients. I am highly sensitive to chemicals and artificial fragrances. I can use this with NO adverse effects. I also use it as shampoo and it leaves my hair clean, shiny, and super healthy. I would recommend this to anyone and everyone!

title: Gorgeous bonnet & scrunchie but not for fine short curly hair
text:
I absolutely love the peacock color of this bonnet and scrunchie. The color is vibrant and attractive. The scrunchie works well and has a tight elastic. Unfortunately for me, the bonnet does not stay on my head even if I cinch the string in the back. I have short-to-medium fine curly hair and it will not stay on when I lay down. Otherwise this would be perfect. I suspect this will work very well for someone with thick curly hair.

The current price of $15.19 ($18.99 minus 20%) is competitive for one sleep bonnet and one scrunchie. Note the bonnet has a long shoelace-type tie in the back.

title: Cleans & lathers well; smells nice to me; mediocre results; not sure about anti-breakage
text:
I actually thought I was going to like this more than I do. I do like the fragrance a lot as it is atypical but hard for me to describe. It also lathers and cleans well but only time will tell how well this works to stop hair breakage.

I have fine, short-to-medium curly locks. My hair dried feeling soft but did look just a tad lackluster compared to my other shampoos and my curls were not as defined as usual.

The current price of $11.99 ($15.99 minus 25%) is competitively priced for 13.5 fluid ounces. I like the fragrance the most and the lather and cleaning ability but I am not ecstatic about the results. It is okay but not great and not a shampoo I would order again.

title: Rapidly absorbing light pink face & neck cream; dries to an almost silky finish
text:
I applied this to my face and neck after a shower but avoided my eye area. This is a medium-weight cream that appears scentless to me and absorbs rapidly. After about two minutes, my face and neck felt almost silky.
