The current price of $48.91 for 1.7 ounces of cream with a plastic "scoop" is a bit pricey. I could care less that it is enriched with 24K gold. It works well but some cheaper creams produce the same results.

Note that I usually only like white creams but this light pink cream is not offensive to me. I really like this cream but am not sold on the high cost or the benefits of 24K gold.

title: Really nice travel brush set with clamshell case; brush heads have slight odor
text:
There are five small foundation / eyeshadow brushes in this set along with a clamshell case. This set is perfect for travel. The case has a mirror. I had to remove the plastic covering the mirror before use. The case opens relatively easily and holds the brushes well. The brushes are soft but not super soft and they feel great against my skin. These are perfect for applying blush or foundation powder or eyeshadow as there are five brush head sizes. The bristles also do not fall out, which is lovely. Note that the bristles do have a slight odor to them.

The current price of $7.99 ($8.99 minus $1) is reasonable for this set. The only concern I have is that the case does not have a strong hinge and I can envision where the top shell will break apart from the brush storage area. Nevertheless, if I am careful when opening this, breakage might be avoidable.

title: Lightweight eye cream; leaves my eyes feeling silky; vegan
text:
This eye cream is lightweight and hydrating. It is also scentless. I applied it around my eye area after a shower. It absorbed rapidly. At first I was not too impressed because I felt the cream was too lightweight but after it dried, my eyelids and under my eyes felt silky. It is very good cream and does smooth wrinkles as does any moisturizer. I found no other benefit. The claim that this is anti-fatigue is just nonsense to me. Also, the current price of $38 is insane for just 0.5 fluid ounces.

The box claims this is vegan. I like this eye cream but not enough to buy it. My current favorite eye cream is this [[ASIN:B09NNB8VYJ SCINIC Collagen Eye Cream]].

title: 10 large budget clips with decent hold; nice colors; some have matte finish - 3.5 stars
text:
There are 10 large claw clips in this package in various colors. They are definitely budget clips and not ones that will last long. However, I like the colors and they do grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly. Of course, since these are large, they are better for those with longer hair. What I really like is that some, not all, of the clips have a matte finish that makes them easy to grip.

At the current price of $6.99 it comes to a competitively priced $0.70 cents per clip. The quality of these clips is low-end but they are functional.

title: 8 sturdy, well-made rectangular clips that hold well in my hair; 2 sizes (small/medium)
text:
There are eight rectangular claw clips in this package in two sizes. There are four small and four medium-sized clips. They are neutral in color and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly but the larger clips would work better with longer hair. What I really love about these clips is that they feel sturdy and the matte finish makes them easy to grip.

At the current price of $9.99 it comes to competitively priced $1.25 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are attractive as well.

title: 14 budget clips that hold a decent amount of hair; nice colors
text:
There are 14 medium-small claw clips in this package in various colors. They are definitely budget clips and not ones that will last long. However, I love the colors and they do grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly.

At the current price of $5.99 it comes to reasonably priced $0.43 cents per clip. The quality of these clips is low-end but they are functional. At that price, I also consider them disposable.

title: Nice selection of items but I do not care for the fragrance
text:
At the current price of $35.69 for the below 7 items, this comes to $5.10 per item, which is competitively priced. This is nicely packaged and very presentable. The gift box comes with:

- 3.52 ounce cleansing soap for the hair
- a soft washcloth folded and tied in the shape of a teddy bear
- citrus chamomile deep sleep pillow mist, ounces unmarked
- 12.35 ounces of bath salts, subtle scent unknown
- 5.29 ounces body scrub, subtle scent unknown
- 7.76 ounces coconut soy candle
- 4.23-ounce large bath bomb that smells great but is gold & glittery and will leave that glitter behind on the skin

Although this is a nice gift box, I do not care for the scent at all, except for the bath bomb, which smells great. The scent is either too subtle on everything else or smells a bit sweet and not as expected, such as with the coconut-scented candle. I tried the hair soap and it feels oily but lathers well. The scent is almost non-existent.

Scent is such a personal characteristic that some people might like this and others will not. I think there is a nice selection of products but the aroma is not one I will enjoy.

title: Nice & large basic clips with a great hold & non-slip grip; best for long hair
text:
There are eight large claw clips in this package and except for the blue one, come in neutral colors. The clips are sturdy. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center. What I really love is the matte finish and non-slip grip. That makes them easy to open.

At the current price of $5.99, this comes to a reasonable $.75 cents per clip.

title: Soothing toner with an extremely subtle rose-like scent
text: This is a very nice toner duo. Both bottles are the same toner in different sizes (4.2 and 6.7 fluid ounces).  I applied this to my face and neck with a cotton round and felt incredibly soothing even after a shower and is not astringent like some toners. The fragrance is almost scentless to me but I do detect a rose-like whiff of scent. Note that to dispense this, I had to remove the plastic tape. It dispenses one tiny drop at a time. The current price of $48.50 is pricey but competitive for two bottles.

title: My neck feels moisturized & a tad bit firmer but not much better than my face cream; too $$$
text: I applied this medium-weight scentless cream to my neck after my shower. My neck felt moisturized and only a little bit firmer than usual. However, I always apply my face creams to my neck and did not find too much difference between that and this other than the slight firmness. To me this is not worth the $60 price tag.

title: Thick, hydrating vegan cream; leaves my face moisturized; light scent; pricey
text: I usually do not like vegan creams. However, this one is very nice. I love the pump bottle it comes in. After my shower, I just applied this to my face and neck (avoiding the eye area) and it absorbed quickly. There is a very subtle scent to this that I cannot describe but I neither like it nor dislike it. My face felt well hydrated after applying this; however, at the current price of $58 this is a bit expensive.

title: Great for washing cats or dogs, or massaging scalp; best on short hair
text:
There are three lightweight brushes in this package. They are good for shampooing short hair and washing pets and can also be used to clean large vegetables like corn. They also act like gentle scalp massagers. However, those with longer hair might find that it tangles the hair if scrubbed too vigorously. As long as I scrub gently and try to avoid tangling my hair, this works on my short to medium fine curly hair.

I particularly love how easy this is to hold by slipping the nub on top between the fingers and having it rest in the palm of my hand. I also love the teal-colored one the best.

The current price of $11.99 comes to a competitively priced $4 per brush. If the price were any higher, it would be too much as these are lightweight, cheap brushes that do the job they are supposed to do.

title: Scentless, skin/hair moisturizing avocado oil for external use only; from Mexico - 4.5 stars
text:
My favorite skin and hair oil is Biosilk and that is still the best oil on the market to me. However, this avocado oil is excellent and a close second. It is also cheaper than Biosilk.

This comes in a large 28-fluid ounce bottle with a press cap. A pump is also provided. It is for external use only on the face, skin, and hair and it's from Mexico. After a shower, I applied this to my skin and hair and it absorbed mostly with a small not-too-greasy hydration barrier on my skin. It also gave my hair a nice shine. My skin felt like silk after using this. I really love this second to my Biosilk.

At the current price of $24.95 for 28 fluid ounces, this is competitively priced.

title: Fragrant when dry, subtle when wet; lasted 8 min & left no stains but particles go down drain
text:
There are eight (8) shower steamers (mint, lemongrass watermelon, eucalyptus, rose, strawberry, lavender, and orange) in this package with a plastic cutter. They all smell nice and as I expected.

I tried the strawberry one in my shower and made sure to put it away from the full stream of water. Initially a very light scent was generated but once I started washing with my scented soaps, I smelled nothing. It lasted the entire long shower and dissolved in about 8 minutes. Besides the non-existent scent once the shower starts, I really hate that the particles in the steamer wash down the drain. I had to put a strainer over the hole to catch all the debris (flower pieces, etc.).

One thing I love is that it did not stain my tub. The red color just washed away.

The current price of $15.99 comes to $2 per steamer. This is competitively priced.

title: Very hydrating; scentless; left my face feeling rejuvenated; from China
text:
There are seven individually wrapped masks in this package along with two 3ml bottles of oil. The masks are very messy and moist. The Camellia Repair Essence Oil is ok and almost scentless. In total, there are 9 items at the current price of $39.99, which comes to $4.43 per item, which I consider expensive.

The package instructions are in Chinese or a language similar; however, the plastic packaging has a sticker with the English directions. I applied some oil as a base before applying a mask to my clean face -- there are holes for eyes, nose, and mouth. It was dripping wet. I personally prefer less solution. I let it stay on for exactly 20 minutes (instructions say 15-20 minutes) and then removed the mask and rubbed the excess into my skin and let it seep in. My face felt intensely moisturized. I woke up the next morning to a soft face. However, the claims that it tightens or firms the skin is unfounded in my opinion.

In summary, I do not feel that I get any more hydration from this process than from a good face cream. To me this is too expensive for the amount received and the work required. Nevertheless, the results are good but this is not something that I would actually order again because it is just too much work, mess, and price for the same results I get otherwise.

title: Korean eye cream; no English on the package; nice subtly scented cream
text:
This is a very small tube of eye cream no size listed except for what is on the Amazon site (20ml). The writing on the package and tube is all in Korean. Since this is an eye cream, I applied this after a shower to my lids, under the brow, and under my eye. It has a nice thick texture that absorbs quickly and has a subtly pleasant fragrance. I would not say it is brightening but it is anti-wrinkle.

However, at the current price of $33.76, this is pricey for such a small tube. Also, I hate that there is no English anywhere on the package. In fact, I would not even know this was eye cream without the Amazon UPC tag that says so.

title: Scentless, barely rejuvenating gel; no English instructions; pricey Korean skin care - 2.5 stars
text: Korean skin care products are usually very good. However, this scentless gel that comes in a pump bottle is barely rejuvenating. I used this on my face and neck after a shower. It absorbed quickly and my skin felt smooth and subtly soft but after a few hours and the next morning, my face felt on the dry side. It's okay but nothing great. At the current price of $45.99, this should be sensational. Also, the package has most of the writing in Korean and, except for warnings, there are absolutely no English application instructions.

title: ightly plumping but nothing spectacular
text:
This is the first time I ever tried a face mist and I do not find this spectacular. At the current price of $56, this should be outstanding.

After my shower, I closed my eyes and sprayed this on my face and neck. My skin felt a bit hydrated and I did like the subtle flowery fragrance. My face and neck also felt a bit softer. However, I do not feel this brightened or improved my skin elasticity in any way. To me this is just not worth the price. If it were $13 or less, then I would feel this is worth applying for extra hydration in addition to applying a face cream; however, I am not personally wowed by this mist. 

This is made in the USA.

title: Medium-weight cream that is moisturizing but not firming to me
text:
This is a 1.69 ounce jar of firming-lifting cream; however, it does not feel firming to me. It has a nice but subtle rose-like fragrance and is of medium-weight. It goes on easily and took about five minutes to mostly absorb but left a hydration barrier on my skin. I like how soft and moisturized my face and neck felt after using this.

In summary, as a regular face cream, I like this but do not love it because it does not firm. Also, at the current price of $40 ($45 minus $5), this is a bit overpriced. This is made in France.

title: Thick, adjustable hair ties that are not worth the high price
text: There are three hair ties for the current price of $15.95, which comes to $5.32 per tie. These ties are thicker than the standard elastic hair ties and they have a bead on the end that can be moved up or down to adjust the amount of elastic being used (see photo with adjustment). They work well but if the knots on the ends come apart, then the hair tie will become useless. I prefer to use them as is. However, these are not worth more than $1 per tie. These are like scrunchies but tremendously thinner. My 3-star rating is due to the high cost of these not too exceptional hair ties.

title: Not 4 moisturizing; thin disposable gloves of the kind that are sold in boxes; a joke for the PRICE
text:
At the current price of $3.51 for one pair of thin disposable gloves, this must be a joke. Not only are these outrageously expensive, but they are no better than the disposable ones that come in boxes of 100 at less than $.50 cents per pair.

I have no idea what it means to dry moisturize as these are not moisturizing at all. They just protect the hands for dirty jobs that do not require strong gloves. Mine also arrived with spots on one glove. They are functional but I would pass on these.

title: Good cuticle trimmer & pusher; colorful too
text:
There is one cuticle trimmer and one cuticle pusher in this package. Note that the pusher is larger and I found it rolling around in the package because it broke through the plastic packaging. At first I thought it was missing.

I love how colorful this set is. I tried both on my nails and the trimmer is sharp and cuts my cuticles very well. I am also able to cut easily along the side of my nails. Both ends of the pusher work well too to either lift up the cuticles or push them down depending on what is desired. Unfortunately, there is no current price listed but I would not expect this set to sell between $6 to $8.

title: Refreshing, moisturizing, & scentless toner; less astringent than others
text: This is a very basic toner. I applied this to my face and neck with a cotton round after my shower and it felt refreshing and moisturizing and not as astringent as some toners. I do wish it had a fragrance as it is scentless to me. I consider this a basic toner from Korea. I like it and apply it before my facial moisturizer. The instructions are both in English and Korean. The current price of $17.99 is competitive.

title: Medium-weight vegan hand cream that is hydrating but way too EXPENSIVE
text: This is a medium-weight vegan hand cream. It took a few minutes to absorb into my hands and left behind a "thick-feeling" hydration barrier on my hands. The scent is acceptable but not super enticing to me. At the current price of $25 for 2.54 fluid ounces, this is also way too EXPENSIVE. If this were $12.50, I would have rated this 5 stars because I like the results. At the price of $16-$18, I would have rated this 4 stars. However, due to the high price and only an okay scent to my senses, this is just okay and is the reason I rated this 3 stars. At this price and fragrance level, I would pass; however, the hydration results are very good.

title: Absolutely beautiful large satin hair bows; arrives unwrinkled
text:
I love these bows and they are perfect to accentuate an outfit. There are three large bows in this package and they arrive unwrinkled, which is superb.

The clip clasp in the back is easy to undo. The only issue I had is holding the other end of the clip to affix this to my hair. It is a tad awkward to do that because the bow is glued to the clip, so I have to grab the bow material around the edge of the clip as I use this to grasp my hair. Nevertheless, this is to be expected. It falls down nicely on the back of my head. Unfortunately, I have medium-length hair in the back (that comes to the top of my shoulders), so I cannot use these. This is best worn by someone who has mid-back to waist-length hair (what most people consider long hair).

Of course, these do not have to be used on one's hair. They can be used to decorate a Christmas tree or a present.

The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced at $3.33 per bow.

title: Small colorful clips w/good hold for a little bit of hair; 2 tiny extras included are accent pieces
text:
There are 10 small medium claw clips in this package with two tiny extra clips included that are more like accent pieces than clips. Those tiny clips are useless to me. I love that this comes in its own plastic container.

The clips are colorful and sturdy. I love that most of the colors are neutral / light . They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on. They are perfect for shorter hair or for when I want to clip just a little bit of hair.

At the current price of $8.05 this comes to $0.81 cents per clip if counting only the 10 clips advertised and not the two extra pieces included. Since these clips are small, they are on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Excellent nest holder but no instructions; Khaki color looks like a pasta nest
text:
First of all this Khaki colored nest looks like some sort of edible pasta that has to be cooked. It comes with absolutely no instructions either when received or online. I almost was going to throw this out. However, after manhandling it for a few minutes, I had to strongly pull it apart. Once I opened it like an accordion, I understood how to use this.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and I was able to roll my hair up in a bun and then close this over the bun while holding my hair with the other hand. This then formed a nest. I tried unsuccessfully to take photos of it in my hair, so I only got a photo of one side. However, it holds exceptionally well because it is very strong.

If using this with a ponytail, I recommend holding the ponytail with an elastic first and then pulling it through and clamping this over the hair. This is both unique and a wonderful hair implement. I do not love the khaki color, but I love the design. It also appears to be well-made. I would have rated this 5 stars had it come with instructions.

The current price of $4.99 appears to be competitively priced for such a unique design and strong holding hair nest.

title: An excellent, strong & rough set of 2 fingernail brushes; there are other uses
text:
There are two well-made fingernail brushes in this box. Each brush has a rope loop for hanging and each is dual-sided with a smaller brush on one side and a larger one on the other. The bristles are rigid enough to clean dirty nails and hands but not too rigid as to hurt my hands. They worked well on me and there was no shedding.

These are good for more than just fingernails. For instance, they can be used to fresh up the grain in suede boots or brushing off mud on them.

The current price of $9.99 comes to $5 per brush which is competitively priced.

title: The sandy feel of this conditioner must be a mistake; softened my hair but weighed down my curls
text:
I do not expect exfoliating pieces of sand in my cream rinse/conditioning treatment. This was off-putting to me as it seems to be more like a shampoo or body wash. Nevertheless, I rubbed this into my clean wet hair and left it on for two minutes then rinsed it off. I love the "perfumy" fragrance. It did leave my hair feeling very soft but weighed down my curls. I have short to medium fine curly hair and my hair was a little flatter after using this.

In summary, at the current price of $45, this is a pricey 6.76 fluid ounce conditioner. I really do not like the gritty particles inside but I do love how soft this makes my hair feel even though it weighs down my curls a bit. Get rid of the grit and lower the price, I would rate this 5 stars.

title: Leaves my face and neck feeling silky
text:
This lightweight face cream (a.k.a. emulsion) is very nice. I used this on my face and neck after a shower and it absorbed rapidly leaving behind a silky feeling on my skin. It also has a nice subtle fragrance. I like this cream.

The current price of $24 for a 3.88 fluid ounce pump bottle of face cream is on the low side of competitively priced. Note that there is a panel of English on the side of the box with one line of instructions. Everything on the box and container is written in Korean.

title: Directions & package details all in Korea, except for name; works fine
text:
This face cream would have received 4 stars from me except for the fact that everything on the box and container is written in Korean except for the name of the product.

I used this on my face and neck after a shower and it absorbed  mostly leaving behind a slight hydration barrier. It also has a subtle fresh fragrance that is almost scentless. I like this cream but dislike the non-English instructions.

The current price of $25.20 for a 2.70 fluid ounce pump bottle of face cream is on the low side of competitively priced.

title: Strong synthetic brush head rips out hair as it detangle; brush head is somewhat easy to clean
text:
There is one large brush in the box but the plastic tines are super strong and rigid. As a result, this has a tendency to rip out my hair as it detangles. Nevertheless, this is easy to hold. Note that I have fine short to medium curly hair but the nylon bristles on this brush are way too rough for even that length of hair.

I do like that the brush base can be removed from the handle and disassembled so that the brush can be cleaned. This is its best feature.

The current price of $3.50 (6.99 minus 50%) is reasonable but after trying this, it is not a brush I would use. It is best for a person with very short hair since the stiff tines will rip out the tangles in longer hair.

title: Not as long or soft as Q-Tips but these work well
text:
There are 3 boxes of 350 bamboo cotton swabs for a total of 1,050 swabs. The tips on these are not as soft and the length is about a one quarter inch shorter than the Q-Tip cotton swabs. Nevertheless, these work well. Just make sure not to press too hard and break them in half during use. I tried these and felt they were good but not great. I personally would buy the Q-Tip brand over these simply because I like the length and plushness of those. However, these are second best.

The current price of $9.99 comes to less than $.01 cents per swab.

title: Nice, colorful clips with a great hold & most with a non-slip grip; best for thick long hair
text:
There are 12 medium claw clips in this package. The clips are colorful and sturdy. I love that most of the colors are neutral (black, brown, clear, white, etc.). They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center. What I really love is the matte finish on 10 of the clips which provides a non-slip grip. That makes them easy to open. The clear and tortoiseshell clips do not have such a finish, but they are still easy to use.

At the current price of $9.99, this comes to a reasonably priced $0.83 cents per clip.

title: Works no better on me than creams or oils that are $60 cheaper
text: At the current price of $90, this is outrageously priced. If I saw extreme results, I would have rated this 5 stars. I take two showers per day and always apply face creams (with retinol and without) and oils to my face and neck afterward. After using this, I noticed no difference in my face or neck compared to the creams and oils I use twice per day that are about $60 cheaper. In fact, my face looks a bit wind burned after using this and feels on the dry side. This is not an oil I would order again.

title: This is very cleansing but it is almost scentless to me and I love fragrance
text: This is a very nice toner. I applied this to my face and neck with a cotton round and felt incredibly cleansing even after a shower yet it does not feel astringent like some toners. I do wish it had a fragrance as it is almost scentless to me. Note that to dispense this, I had to remove the plastic plug. It dispenses one tiny drop at a time. The current price of $30 is pricey but competitive. Everything but the label is in written Korean.

title: Coverage is highly transparent and lacks the cover-up of some liquid foundation
text: I have fair skin and chose the "201 creamy natural" shade. The pump bottle easily dispenses the foundation and the coverage is highly transparent. If I had a flawless face without any blemishes, then this would be perfect because the finish would look even. However, since I do have blemishes, this does little to cover them. For me, this is just okay. Also, the current price of $17.99 for a one-ounce bottle of foundation is very pricey.

title: OK mesh puff back brush with uneven head; handle is sufficiently long
text:
There is one mesh bath mesh back brush with rope loop for hanging in this box.

I love mesh puffs because they lather well and that has become my goto shower "sponge." This puff with a handle offers the same sudsy experience and the handle is long enough for me to reach all areas of my back when working from both the top and bottom. The airy mesh allows copious suds to be produced in the shower. The only thing I do not like about this brush is that the mesh is uneven and looser in some spots than in others. Other than this it works the same as others. Due to the unevenness of this puff, however, I am concerned it will unravel sooner than I expect. To me, brushes like this should last about 3-6 months before they have to be thrown out. I'm not sure this will last that long.

The current price of $7.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Feels hydrating and cleansing; love the fragrance which smells like grapefruit to me
text: This is a very nice toner. I applied this to my face and neck  with a cotton round and it felt hydrating and a bit cleansing. I absolutely love the fragrance. I have no idea what guava smells like but I suspect that is the aroma. It actually reminds me of a sweet grapefruit. The current price of $27.99 is pricey but competitive. Note that the top is very tight and it takes a lot of strength to open the cap on the bottle the first time.

title: Typical lightweight eyelash curler; feels cheap; not giftable
text:
This is a simple eyelash curler. The curler is lightweight and all metal like most typical cheap eyelash curlers on the market.

It is easy to use and curls well and gently. Since it comes in a plastic wrap, this is really not giftable.

I personally prefer my old metal curler to this because it is heavier and feels more substantial. This curler feels very cheap. The current price of $6.08 is on the high side of competitively priced for such a cheap curler.

title: Great for cleaning in tight spaces; good for highlighting eyes but has long strong handle
text: I am actually impressed with these. These are 5.9" in length from tip to tip. These are great for cleaning in tight spaces. They are also good to use to apply eyeshadow highlights, although the handle is a bit long. I used these on my pump filter for my cat water fountain and they work well. I expected the wooden handles to be weak, but they are not. Overall I am pleased. The current price of $4 comes to a very reasonable $.04 cents each wand.

title: I like that the brushes are angled and decent for precision work but not for thin brows
text: At the current price of $13.99 for two tiny angled eyebrow brushes, this comes to $7 per brush which I consider a bit pricey. Although the brushes can be used on to apply concealer or to highlight the eyes, these are best for the eyebrows. The angle of the brush allows for precision and these cover my bushy eyebrows well. I doubt someone who has thin brows would find these brushes useful. I also like these for powder eyeshadow but not for much else. I do not like that the handle colors are not the same. It looks like a mismatched pair because of that. Overall, these are okay but I'm not overly impressed. Note that the bristles do not shed.

title: Attractive large clips; holds a lot of hair but best for long hair; clips have matte finish
text:
These hair clips are large in size and come in a presentable package. There are five clips in total in various shades. I was actually surprised at the size and style. These are regular standard claw clips with regular teeth and only have a zigzag pattern on the side. See my photo that shows the bottom, top, and sides of the clips.

These are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like the matte finish. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge. However, they are obviously better with longer hair.

The current price of $9.99 is a competitively priced $2 per clip.

title: 6 files and 6 four-sided buffers; they work well but buffers are all the same coarseness level
text:
There are six coarse nail files in this package with a coarse and very coarse coarseness level. There are also six four-sided buffers but they all have the same coarseness level which is the only reason I rated this set 4 stars.

These are great for those who want to use these to file their own nails. The grit on these is very coarse, which I love. The files are good for many uses until the paper surface becomes marred. The buffers are all of medium coarseness to my sense of touch. There is no polishing to a manicurist finish with these. I have to use a chamois cloth buffer or another buffer for that. Nevertheless, I still love this set.

The current price of $8.99 comes to $.75 cents per file which is competitively priced. My favorite part of this set is the six coarse files.

title: Lightly tightening, dries a little sticky; must avoid eyelids
text:
I put this under the contour of my eyes. It is a cool creamy gel that dries a bit sticky. It does tighten and feels slightly moisturizing. It also only slightly improves my eye bags. What I do not like is that I cannot use this on my eyelids. I was looking for an eye cream and this is for under the eye area. Also, I found it difficult to pump out of the bottle. I had to prime the pump about 25 times before any cream gel would be dispensed.

The current price of $44.20 ($52 minus 15%) is pricey for this.

title: Horrible quality & more like lip liner brushes
text:
To me these are not mascara brushes. The tips are so thin it is a disgrace and the wands are weak. These would work as lip liner brushes. I do not like them. There is barely any cotton at the tip to soak up anything.

The current price of $6.99 comes to $0.07 cents per wand since there are 100 wands in this pack.

title: Almost impossible to open once folded; otherwise, they work for both eyebrows and eyelashes
text:
At the current price of $11.99 for six folding eyebrow / eyelash combs, that comes to $2 each, which I consider expensive. The combs work well and are comfortable to use but the problem is that it is almost impossible to unfold the comb once folded. The reason is that the head of the comb sometimes goes too far down in the handle and there is nothing to grip on to. I had to use a tool to release the head. If the comb is not pressed down far, then it is easier to unfold. I am very disappointed because of this. If it had a silicone grip, perhaps that would make these better.

I was going to rate these five stars because they can be used to both separate eyelashes that have mascara on them or used for the eyebrows. I would use these for both. If one is not going to fold these, then the work.

title: Attractive medium clips; holds a lot of hair but best for long hair; clips have matte finish
text:
These hair clips are medium in size. There are six clips in total in a nice set of muted colors.

These are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like the matte finish. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge. However, they are better with longer hair as I had to put my short length in a bun to have this grab onto my hair. They do take some finger strength to open, however.

The current price of $12.99 is on the high side of competitively priced at $2.17 per clip.

title: Good as disposable or temporary brushes; short handle
text:
There is no question these brushes are cheap--both in price and in quality. However, for the current price of $9.99 for 12 brushes, it comes to $0.83 cents per brush, which I consider disposable.

Each brush has seven rows of widely spaced bristles. This brushes through my short to medium-length hair just fine. Unfortunately, the handle is a bit short, making this a little uncomfortable to use as a daily hairbrush forever. I consider these brushes good for when one has visitors who need a brush, for EMS workers to give out during a disaster, or for use with the homeless.

Since these are vent brushes, they are also decent for blow drying. If the handles were about one to two inches longer, I would have rated them 5 stars.

title: 5 dense egg-shaped blenders for make-up application & I love the colors; metal holder included
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. There are 5 multi-colored egg-shaped sponges in total. I LOVE THE COLORS. The large round edge is good for make-up application on the cheeks and the pointed tip is great for blending around the eye area or cheekbones. I love how soft these are against my skin. They also do not have a bad smell like some others I tried previously. What I really love is that they are a denser sponge, which means liquid does not soak in as easily.

The current price of $8.99 for 5 blending sponges and one metal hold comes to a competitively priced $1.60 per item.

title: Excellent set of 6 eyebrow brushes/combs; hinges are their weakest point
text: At the current price of $3.97 for six double-ended eyebrow brushes/combs, I consider this good enough to be disposable as it comes to $0.66 cents each. The hinges on either side are plastic and have to snap in place. I used both the comb and the brush ends and they work great. I then folded both ends back into their plastic handles. I do feel the hinges are the weakest point but since this is so cheap, I did not deduct one star off like I normally would have. I folded this several times already and the hinges held. Overall, I think this is a good deal for a low-end brow comb/brush combo.

title: Fits my eyelash curler perfectly; mine came with 23 refills
text:
There are 23 refills in the plastic case of eyelash curler refills I received. The Amazon site does not say how many are supposed to come with this. Nevertheless, this is more than enough and it fits in my standard-sized eyelash curler and works as well as the one I had in the unit.

At the current price of $4.56 it comes to $0.20 cents per refill.

title: Bows come in 6 graduated sizes; more of an accessory for the hair or a package
text:
There are six blue bows in this package from small to large. At the current price of $6.49, this comes to $1.08 per bow.

The pinch clips on the bow are small and only provide a marginal hold more to accessorize the hair and not to put up the hair. This is best on hair that already has a band holding the locks needed in place. They look great to accessorize my hair. They are also perfect to use on packages or just to decorate the tips of a Christmas tree.

I give these 2 stars for holding the hair, 3 stars for accessorizing the hair, and 4 stars for putting on a tree or a package.

title: Three large bars of wonderful smelling soap with good lather; a bit pricey
text:
There are three 7-ounce bars of soap in this package. At the current price of $35.99, that comes to an expensive $12 per bar and is the only reason I deducted one star.

The citrus and cedarwood scent is wonderful. The soap produces a good lather and cleanses well. I use it for my body and not my hair. I do not care that it is marketed as a men's soap because I feel it has a stronger scent that lasts compared to the women's soaps. I love the soap but the price has to be $8 or less per bar for me to give this 5 stars.

title: Eight lovely Christmas clips to accessorize one’s hair, gifts, or tree
text:
There are eight small Christmas barrettes in this package. At the current price of $14.09 ($14.99 minus 6%), this comes to $1.76 per clip.

These clips are small but heavy. They look great to accessorize my hair during the holidays. They act more like a hair accessory than a clip that holds a lot of strands. They are also perfect to use on packages or just to decorate the tips of a tree. These are just lovely and festive.

title: A nice birthday gift basket w/items most receivers would use; a bit over packaged
text:
At the current price of $43.65 ($45.95 minus 5%), this gift basket is expensive but competitively priced.

There are eight items in this box along with an index card that says "Happy Birthday to you."
The items are:

- a 7-ounce jar of Asian Tea Blossom body butter
- one standard-sized white bath bomb
- a small tumbler that says "not a day over babulous"
- a metal straw with silicone cap
- a pipe cleaner for the metal straw
- one 4.3-ounce bar of oatmeal milk and honey handmade soap
- one 4.3-ounce bar of cherry almond handmade soap
- a 100% natural soy lavender candle

The fragranced items have a light aroma that are nice but not overly intoxicating. I tried the body butter and love it. It is thick, smells nice, and is hydrating.

This is definitely a decent birthday gift that many women who like candles, soaps, and body butter would like. It is a bit over packaged. Mine came in a box, then another outside protective box, and then the actual Kraft brown birthday box that says "It's your birthday" on it.

title: Very nice scentless sunscreen; rubs in and absorbs easily; leaves my face feeling silky
text: I really love this face and neck sunscreen. It is thick and creamy but light enough to spread easily and provide good coverage. It also absorbs quickly and leaves my face and neck feeling silky smooth while also offering protection. What is odd about this sunscreen is that the SPF is listed as SPF 32; I've never seen that before. The active ingredient is Zinc Oxide 20%. The current price of $28.95 is on the high side of competitively priced for this two-ounce tube. If this ever makes my eyes water, I will update my ranking and review.

title: Very nice mineral sunscreen; rubs in and absorbs easily; has a light scent
text:
I really like this mineral sunscreen. It is creamy and thick but light enough to spread easily and provide good coverage. It also absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling smooth while also offering protection. The active ingredients are titanium dioxide (6.6%) and zinc oxide (18%).

The current price of $15.63 for 3 ounces is also competitively priced for this.

title: Sponges need water to expand; they're a decent heart-shaped size
text:
There are 50 heart-shaped sponges that fit in the palm of my hand. They expand when wet and are about one-third the size and half the height of a regular sponge.

These sponges are great for washing make-up off my face or just to use around the bathroom sink. Since sponges tend to mold easily, I do not feel bad throwing these out after two weeks.

The current price of $11.99 comes to $0.24 cents per sponge which seems pricey for the size.

title: Beautiful clips to accessorize the hair more than hold the hair
text:
This is a nice collection of three small hair clips. They are attractive and fasten almost anywhere on my hair. However, they do not hold hair like a big hair clip does. These are clips to accessorize the hair and highlight certain areas. These are like bobby pins on steroids.

The current price of $11.39 ($11.99 minus 5%) for this set comes to a $3.80 per clip which is pricey.

title: Light, scentless moisturizer with mild hydration
text: This is a 10.2-ounce bottle of light, scentless moisturizing cream that provides mild hydration. It is perfect for all seasons. I do prefer a heavier moisturizer for winter, however. Nevertheless, this left my skin moisturized. It absorbed quickly and was non-greasy. Also, the current price of $9.99 is reasonable for this.

title: Thick barrel curling iron that heats fast & is simple to use; don't like thin cord & $$$
text:
[[VIDEOID:45c77314e6a061b20366ba53f49c3839]] In the box is one curling iron, heat protective glove, a user pamphlet and two hair clips.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and I get a light curl with this iron as this is best for those with long hair. This iron is simple to operate and simple to use. Just "press hold" the ON/OFF switch to turn it on or off. Just lightly press the same switch to cycle through the temperatures. Despite what the manual says (which is wrong), the temperatures available are 290, 330, 370, 410, and 450 degrees Fahrenheit. The kickstand is sturdy to keep the barrel from coming in contact with the counter.

The cord is a 360 degree swivel cord to prevent tangling. There is also a loop at the base of the cord for hanging on a hook or nail. What I dislike is that the cord is very thin. I also dislike the price.

The current price of $45.04 ($52.99 minus 15%) is outrageously priced for this. Any price over $29 is too much. Nevertheless, this works well on my hair but would work better on someone with longer hair since this has a 1.25" barrel.

title: This wrinkle cream is a typical, hydrating facial moisturizer
text:
I love this cream, although I wish it was a little thicker. It smells nice and is rich. It also absorbs well. I applied this to my face and neck and after a little while my face felt subtle. However, this is typical of most creams that smooth out the skin.

The current price of $28 is competitively priced.

title: Highly fragrant bath bombs with mediocre suds-lasting performance - 3.5 stars
text:
[[VIDEOID:f926e1d2d7836e6d8b820d0537e88134]] There are eight different and individually wrapped bath bombs in this set in supposedly different lovely fragrances. The fragrances are strong and last for 15 minutes in my foot bath. The eight fragrances listed are rose, peach, lotus & white tea, freshwater perfume, lavender, lazy Sunday perfume, freesia perfume, and vanilla & coconut. I picked the freesia perfume for my foot bath.

The bombs dissolve in about 5 minutes and the suds hold just as long; at least in a foot bath. The bath fragrance is very nice and is long-lasting. The bomb dissolved into green-colored water.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I used this in a foot bath. The color of this bomb, did not adhere to my skin, my foot bath, or my towels-- at least the color of the one I tried.

In summary, these smell great but the suds performance is good but short-lived. The current price of $21.99 comes to $2.75 per bath bomb which is competitively priced.

title: Cheap feeling clips that only hold on one side
text:
There are four blinged out clips in this package. The clips look and feel super cheap. Also, they do not hold my hair well at all. They either hold on the left or right side of the clip but not on both sides and I cannot explain why. I used this on the back of my hair and when I seated it fully, the tip side of the clip provided no hold even though there are teeth throughout. I then tried the tip end only and that gripped onto my hair. I tried all the clips and they are all like this.

At the current price of $9.58, this comes to a very expensive $2.40 per clip. I do not like these at all. It feels and performs like I got this from the dollar store.

title: Love the floral scent of this thick conditioner; nice crème rinse but not particularly volumizing
text:
I would not call this conditioner ultra volumizing. I have short to medium fine curly hair and used between a five-cent and twenty-five-cent size dollop of this. The fragrance is very nice and floral.

It conditions relatively well and rinses out like any other conditioner. I air-dried my hair but this did not result in any additional volume. The only thing it did not do was weigh down my curls. 

The current price of $13 is competitive for 15.2 ounces.

title: Medium-weight cream that is moisturizing and has a nice scent but doesn’t absorb well
text: I like the pump on this cream. I just press the top and it dispenses upward. Then I scoop the cream from the top to apply. The fragrance is lightly perfume-like and pleasant. It is medium weight so that it is perfect for fall, winter, and spring. However, even though it is moisturizing, it doesn't absorb fully. My face still felt tacky even 15 minutes after application and it never fully absorbed.

title: Attractive medium clips; holds a lot of hair but best for long hair; clips have matte finish
text:
These hair clips are medium in size and come in a presentable package. There are six clips in total with one in black, three in various shades of brown, and one white.

These are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like the matte finish. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge. However, they are better with longer hair as I had to put my short length in a bun to have this grab onto my hair.

The only negative is that the black one came with some surface damage to the "paint" - see photo. The current price of $9.99 is a competitively priced $1.67 per clip.

title: A bit on the large side but keeps a dirty blender sponge from soiling everything
text: This is a large silicone holder for a blender sponge. It is a bit large but fits the typical blender sponge and keeps it from soiling my counter or other items. The only negative besides the size is that the silicone picks up lint and pet hair easily. The current price of $5 ($9.99 minus 50%), is pricey for this as well. Unless this will be carried around, I actually recommend [[ASIN:B0BBRCJZ9V these holders]] for the counters.

title: Finally a gift basket with items most receivers would use in its entirety but not a SPA gift
text:
At the current price of $17.99 ($19.99 minus 10%), this gift basket is a steal even if the receiver were to use only the metal water bottle.

There are six items in this box along with a card that says "Thankful to have a sister and friend like you."

The items are:

- a squat 20 fluid-ounce (2.5 cups) metal screw-top water bottle
- a small 10g size of shea butter lip balm
- a small 1.8-ounce jar of vanilla, cinnamon, and honey hand balm
- a small pocket-sized blank notebook
- a nice but thin 100% viscose cotton scarf in a deep purplish blue
- a small 3.9 ounce jasmine soy wax candle

The fragranced items are intense and intoxicating to me. I love that the fragrance transfers to the notebook and scarf also. The notebook does feel damp due to being in the box with the other items; however, it is highly usable. I tried the lip and hand balms and love them.

This is definitely an excellent purchase at the current price of $17.99 even if one is buying the box for themselves and not as a gift. BTW, I would not call this a spa gift because there is no soap or bath salts or anything like that. Only the candle is spa-inspired.

title: Very small half-sized tissues with lotion; way too expensive
text:
There are five packs of 40 tissues each but the packages are not marked for the quantity. At the current price of $6.99 for 200 tissues, this comes to almost $0.04 cents per half tissue as these are the size of half a tissue. This makes these VERY EXPENSIVE TISSUES.

These are nice and strong and soothing. They do feel damp, however, due to the lotion but not wet. I like them and the portable packages they come in but just a box of Puffs Lotion Tissues would be even better.

title: Absorbs quickly; not too greasy; moisturizes lightly; leaves skin feeling smooth; dislike fragrance
text: This is a tall 5-ounce pump bottle of hydrating body oil. The fragrance is not to my liking; almost like a bad coconut. A little oil goes a long way. It  absorbs quickly and is not too greasy. The moisturizing effects are light and it leaves skin feeling smooth. It is the fragrance that has me disappointed. The current price of $8.35 ($8.79 minus 5%) is reasonable for this.

title: The four metal holders are great; NO Blender is included
text:
These four metal holders are great for holding blender sponges on the counter. I like that I have the option to have several sponges in use and elevated off the counters. Note that no blender is included as is pictured on the Amazon site; the photo is misleading.

The current price of $7.99 comes to $2 per metal holder.

title: A bit too tiny sponges with handle for applying liquid foundation or cream blush
text: There are 12 small round with tear drop tip foam sponges with ribbon handles in this package with one plastic carry case for the used sponge. They are a bit too tiny in size as the handle can only be slipped over two of my fingers. Nevertheless, this works well to apply cream foundation or for blending cream rouge (cheek creams/blush). The current price of $9.99 comes to a pricey $0.83 cents per sponge. If these were a little bigger I would have rated them 4 stars.

title: Two decent-sized bars; produces light lather; cleanses well; not exfoliating
text:
There are two 5-ounce bars of soap in this package. At the current price of $18, that comes to an expensive $9 per bar.

There are two different scents. The fig leaves and white musk bar doesn't smell great to me. However, I like the fresh citron and driftwood fragranced one. That is the bar I tried. It produced a light lather, cleansed well, but did not feel exfoliating at all.

After having tried these, I do not feel they are any more special than store-bought soap. Therefore, paying a premium for them seems foolish.

title: Low lather but wonderful smelling soap
text:
There are two tiny bars of soap in this package and they smell great. The soap lathers mildly but cleans well. I did not notice any bump reduction or skin brightening, however. Nevertheless, I like these and am particularly fond of the fragrance.

The current price of $9.95 is pricey for two 2.8-ounce bars as it comes to $4.98 per bar.

title: Moderate lather unscented cleanser; not my favorite
text: This is a moderate lather clear gel cleanser. It feels somewhat cleansing and is good for my sensitive skin but it is not my favorite cleanser due to the moderate lather, gel-like nature, and lack of scent. It is also unscented. The current price of $19.50 is pricey for 250 ML (8.45 ounces).

title: Lovely loose-fitting, extra-wide, sweater-type headbands; perfect for the winter
text:
There are four quality headbands in this set. The headbands are soft and loosely sized but fit me well. They have a knot that goes in the back and are extra wide. Since they are sweater-type headbands, they are perfect for the winter. They als look great on and there are four neutral solid colors that will go with most outfits.

I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and these work for me and are even better for someone with long hair. I love these.

The current price of $12.99 is a competitively priced $3.25 per band.

title: I love this soap simply because it smells so good and is colorful; good for a gift
text: This soap smells absolutely amazing and fresh. It is also colorful and comes in a nice box for gifting. Since there are stones inside, I find myself putting a drain cover over my drain so they do not accidentally go down the drain when they are released from the bar. This soap is cleansing but slippery. What I do not like is that some of the nesting material sticks to the soap even though it is covered with plastic that has to be removed before use. At the current price of $18.99, this is an expensive bar of soap; however, I consider it a treat and a great gift idea. for someone who is into crystals, color, and scent.

title: Long-lasting soap with interesting fragrance & mediocre lather; foaming nets included
text: There are three small bars of soap (ounces unknown) each with its own foaming net.  The fragrance of these bars is nice with what to me smells like a hint of fresh linen and smoke. I actually never encountered such a scent on soap before. The bars cleanse well but produce a mediocre lather. These bars are also long lasting At the current price of $17.99 ($19.99 minus 10%), this comes to $6 per bar which is competitively priced based on the prices of specialty soaps these days.

title: Two bars of delicate soap w/one foaming net; light lather ; way too $$$
text:
There are two 3.25-ounce bars of soap in this package along with a foaming net to use with each bar. This soap is touted as one for personal/private areas of the body. There are two different versions--exfoliating cranberry and daily ritual oatmeal. I do not care for the smell of the cranberry but the daily ritual oatmeal bar smells nice.

The soap provides only a light lather but it does gently cleanse. However, the current price of $29 comes to $14.50 per 3.25-ounce bar which I consider prohibitively expensive even with a foaming net. This is the main reason I rated this 3 stars besides my dislike of the cranberry aroma. I personally prefer this 5.3-ounce [[ASIN:B09SY55FKJ bar]] of intimate soap with foaming net that currently costs $5.99 over this.

title: Strong smelling soap w/good lather; cleanses well but smells falsely like tea tree oil or eucalyptus
text:
I love men's deodorants, colognes, soaps, etc. There are three bars of strong-smelling soap in this package. The soap smells a lot like tea tree oil or eucalyptus oil even though there is none of that in the ingredients. I suspect it is the strong peppermint oil that is giving the bars their overall aroma.

This soap lathers and cleanses well. It is not my favorite due to the fragrance. It is not at all what I expect of peppermint.

The ingredients are coconut oil, canola oil, soybean oil, organic shea butter, water, sodium hydroxide lye, olive pomace oil, sunflower oil, goat's milk, ground oatmeal, peppermint leaves, and fragrance.

The current price of $25.19 ($27.99 minus 10%) comes to a pricey $8.40 per bar.

title: Does the job it is supposed to do but is not rechargeable; top is awkward to reseat – 2.5*
text:
I absolutely love razors like this and have two, gave away a few, and wanted another one. However, I am disappointed with this one. Personally, I prefer that it be rechargeable like this [[ASIN:B08ZLLCQWH one]]. 

This facial razor comes with the razor unit itself, a cleaning brush, a zippered carry case, and a user pamphlet. It requires one AA battery (NOT included). It is tricky to find the battery compartment and open it. I actually had to wedge my nail under the top rim of the razor and pull upward. To use this, all I had to do was press the power button on the front. I shaved my chin, under my lips, and the sides of my cheeks and it did a decent job but did sometimes get caught up on hair whereby I had to stop and clean the razor. The circular top screws off as is typical of all pocket units like this but the top on this one is difficult to reseat.

The hairs can be blown as well as brushed out with the provided cleaning brush.  The current price of $10.99 ($12.99 minus minus $2) is competitive. The reason I rated this two stars is because it is not rechargeable, the battery compartment is tricky to open, the razor gets hung up on hair easily, and the circular head is tricky to reseat after cleaning. However, it does a decent job of shaving--not like a straight edge razor but good enough. It is also very pretty but is not as good as I expected or like my rechargeable ones.

title: Excellent brush for applying full face translucent powder
text:
I love this brush for applying finishing powder (translucent powder) to my face which helps set make-up. I also love that the bristles are soft and do not fall out of the brush like some other brushes I tried previously.

The current price of $10.49 ($14.99 minus 30%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: These medium-sized clips are STUNNING and hold my hair well; best if used at base of neck
text:
These clips look like a small octopus or squid and each one has teeth in the center that grips my hair well and provides me with a great hold. In addition, they are absolutely stunning and perfect for an elegant outfit.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and these work in the back of my head where my hair is longest. The best place for me to use these is at the base of my neck. If I put them in the center of my head, they are not as comfortable to use due to the curve / concave shape of the clip. However, for someone with thicker hair, that would not be a problem.

There are five clips clipped in this set and the purple one is my favorite. As can be seen from one of my photos, each clip is the size of a standard computer mouse.

The current price of $14.39 ($15.99 minus 10%) comes to $2.88 per clip which is on the low side of competitively priced. I have others sold under a different vendor name that were $3.50 per clip.

title: Lightly fragrant bath bombs with surprise jewelry inside; decent performance but staining
text:
[[VIDEOID:9faeeb655f0c302a58df3fb857db320a]] At the current price of $23.99, these bombs come to $4 each which is slightly expensive. Each bomb has a surprise stretchy bracelet inside that is encased in a plastic bubble.

I tried the rose bath bomb in my foot bath. The fragrance is nice but subtle. The suds lasted only eight minutes but the fragrance lasted the entire bath. The bomb dissolved to release the surprise in about five minutes. The color of the water was a cranberry red and the color stained my feet and towels but not my foot bath.

In summary, the performance of these bombs is decent and the suds are not as long lasting as I would like. The colored water stained--at least on the bomb I tried. The fragrance, however, is subtle but very nice. A young girl will love the surprise bracelets and acceptable performance of these bath bombs. However, at $4 each one--there are six of them, this is expensive. The six bombs are lavender, rose, lemongrass, jasmine, chamomile, and rosemary.

title: Lovely little sponges with handle for applying liquid foundation or cream blush
text: There are six small square foam sponges with ribbon handles in this package. I like the small size and the fact that the handle is easy to slip over my fingers. I also love the color of the sponges (although that gets dirty with use), as it matches my purple bathroom. This works well to apply cream foundation and because of the size, it gives me good control. It is also useful for blending cream rouge (cheek creams/blush). The current price of $12.59 ($17.99 minus 30%) is very expensive for these sponges and is the only reason I took off one star.

title: Acts more like a toner; bottle does not dispense well; hence rating
text:
Even though this is an oil it feels more like a toner on my skin. After washing my face, I applied a couple of drops of this to a cotton round, and it feels cleansing but also tightens my face after using this. The only issue I had is that it took over one minute of pounding this jar on my counter upside into the cotton round for me to get two drops of this product to use. Until they fix the issues with dispensing this from the bottle, I cannot recommend this. Had I not had this problem, this would have received 5 stars from me.

The current price of $31.99 is competitively priced.

title: Hand & foot moisturizing oil that works well; the warnings makes me pause
text:
This looks like a face serum but is actually a hand and foot oil. I tried a tiny bit on my hands and a little goes a long way. It absorbs quickly and feels silky and non-greasy. It left my hands feeling smooth and hydrated. I like the results but the warnings make one question whether it should be used at all.

The ingredients are caprylic/capric, triglycerides, isopropyl myristate, Di caprylyl, carbonate, Argania spinosa kernel oil, Vitis vinifera seed oil, citrus limon peel oil, Lavandula angustifolia oil, Cymbopogon martini oil, Cananga odorata flower oil, Daucus carota sativa seed oil, limonene, linalool, and eugenol.

Precautions
- Not recommended during pregnancy.
- Avoid exposure to the sun after use.
- Keep out of reach of children.
- Avoid contact with the eyes. Rinse immediately in case of contact.
- Do not ingest.
- Store in a cool place & protect from light.

The current price of $17.99 for this 1.01 fluid ounce bottle with eyedropper dispenser is competitively priced since a little goes a long way.

title: A sampler pack of 16 hand creams in different scents; each tube 0.99 fluid ounces or 28 grams
text:
There is not much in these tubes of hand cream but it is a nice set. There are 16 0.99-fluid ounce or 28-gram tubes in this attractive package. This not only makes a great gift, but the cream itself is actually moisturizing, of medium-thickness, and contains enough scents that most people would find several they like. This left my hands very nice, smooth, and hydrated.

The scents are:
- blossom
- lavender
- rose
- strawberry
- orange
- almond
- calendula
- neroli
- blueberry
- coconut
- chamomile
- honey
- green tea
- lemon verbena
- vanilla
- shea butter

In summary, this is a decent sampler set for the current price of $11.99 ($14.99 minus 20%). At that price, it comes to $0.75 cents per tube.

title: Gentle, cleansing, 7-ingredient baby soap w/nice scent; nice gift but way too $$$$
text:
This soap is 100% natural and handmade. It has seven ingredients of saponified organic coconut oil, saponified organic olive oil, organic castor oil, organic shea butter, organic chamomile floral water, lavender essential oil, and purified water. It is vegan, organic, cruelty free, and non-GMO. The bar is only 2.5 ounces.

I love the lavender scent. It lathers moderately well and is cleansing and moisturizing. However, at the current price of $9.99 this is only a bar to be purchased as a gift for a new mom as it is way too expensive in my opinion. If it were $5 or less, then I would have rated this 4 stars. If it were $4 or less, I would have rated it 5 stars.

title: Subtle fragrance like tomato) lathers lightly; cleans but feels like film is left on my skin
text: This gel-like bar has a subtle but nice aroma to it that is a bit earthy, a bit fresh, and is almost like a tomato scent. It lathers lightly, is cleansing, but after using this feels like I have a waxy film left behind on my skin. At the current price of $8.99, this is also expensive for a 4-ounce bar. I also do not notice any skin brightening. It is the waxy feeling and the high price that has me rating this 3 stars.

title: Nets are really exfoliating & better than ones I purchased previously; not uniform
text: I use nets like this when I want to use up the last bit of soap without wasting it. I've purchased nets like this previously but these are much better in the sense that they are really exfoliating. They foam up okay but are never as good as mesh body puffs. I do like how they cinch the soap in the bags. However, the two nets provided are not uniform. One is a tad larger than the other.  The current price of $6.99 is competitively priced for this as it comes to $3.50 per net.

title: Comfortable sleep mask with eye sockets; blocks out MOST LIGHT
text:
In the package is one soft adjustable mask with eye sockets, a zippered carry pouch, and reusable ear plugs that are attached via a string. The mask is very soft, lightweight, and very comfortable to wear. There is also an adjustable strap in the back. Since there is an eye socket channel, I can open my eyes underneath without touching the front of it and it blocks out most light. If I look down, I can see just a tiny bit of light seep through the bottom but that is not a problem for me.

It is comfortable to wear and fits me very well and is not too snug. It does not move around when I lay down with it. Overall, I really love this mask.

However, the current price of $18.99 is a bit pricey for this set.

title: Smoothly glides on and protects me for 12 hours until my next shower; absolutely love the fragrance
text:
I absolutely love the perfume fragrance. Although I specifically love men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me, this deodorant is wonderful. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. This stick does not have that ingredient but still protects me for 12 hours until my next shower. In fact, I've tried a few products like this recently without aluminum that actually works for me.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. The fragrance reminds me of a wonderful perfume that is fresh and floral. The Amazon site says this has a blend of Sandalwood, Moroccan Jasmine, Amber Floral, and Lily of the Valley and the Jasmine seems to come through the most.

The current price of $30 for a 1.7 ounce tube is Donna Karan boutique pricing. Since consumers know this is a luxury brand, the expectation is that it will cost much more than regular deodorant; therefore, I did not deduct one star for the high price. Protection-wise this works even though it is aluminum free. Fragrance-wise it is divine.

title: Comfortable mask made of all foam with eye sockets; blocks out ALL LIGHT
text:
In the package is one adjustable mask. This is a soft cloth covered foam that is lightweight and sleek. This mask has eye cutouts. There is also an adjustable strap in the back.

Since there is an eye socket channel, I can open my eyes underneath without touching the front of it and it blocks out all light well.

It is comfortable to wear and fits me very well and is not too snug. It does not move around when I lay down with it. Overall, I really love this mask.

The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced for this. Note that a pair of disposable ear plugs are provided with a plastic case. I could do without those.

title: The intense fragrance combination is wonderful; a bit pricey
text:
I love this soap. It lathers moderately and cleans well. The fragrance is intoxicating to me. It is intense and the combination of jasmine and geranium smells wonderful. It also feels moisturizing. Of course, the current price of $7.99 is a bit steep for a 4.5 ounce bar and is the only reason I took off one star. This is boutique pricing.

Note that I received this bar on Sept 30, 2022 but the manufacture date is April 2022. There is paper covering the bar and it was really sticking to the soap by the time I opened it tonight on Oct 25, 2022.

title: “Tissue-sized” wipes that are as strong as baby wipes but they are dry; they hold up well when wet
text:
There are two packs of 50 tissues each for a total of 100 tissues.

They look and almost feel exactly like unscented tissues. However, they perform very well. These are strong and hold up when wet to pick up messes, clean urine off a litter pan, etc. They are perfect for cleaning a baby's bottom or pet's bottom as well. I use these to clean my cat's urine off the walls of the litter pan but I wet the wipe first. They can be used to remove make-up with soap and water.

These are expensive. At the current price of $20.99 it comes to $.21 cents per wipe, which is about $.17 cents more than wet baby wipes can be purchased for. Note that the first wipe is difficult to remove from the box because each box is so tightly packed. The high price is the only reason I lowered my ranking.

title: Overpriced silicone body scrubber; best for cat hair pick-up
text:
The current price of $29.99 is INSANE for this scrubber. There is one hand-held silicone brush in this package along with a quick start guide describing how it should be used. It did not work well for me. It is awful with regular soap and better with liquid soap. The liquid soap goes in the center. I like the feel of this against my skin but I do not feel clean. I'll go back to my mesh body puffs which produce copious amounts of suds and cost less than $4.

Nevertheless, I do like the quality, look, and feel of this. It holds easily in the palm of the hand and has a hanging hole too. What this is good for is grabbing hair off surfaces my cats laid on (see one of my photos). It is also good to provide my cats with a massage while using it to brush their hair. Despite the quality of this scrubber, any price more than $12 is beyond ridiculous for this.

In summary, I love the color, quality, and design but it is not useful for what it was intended.

title: Nice earthy-smelling soap; cleans well & lathers moderately; NO “evening” of skin tone
text:
This bar of soap has an earthy aroma that I actually like. This soap lathers moderately and cleans well. Due to its small size, it is easy to hold. Note that I did not notice any skin brightening ability or toning down of scars. I wish they would not make claims like this.

The current price of $4.79 ($5.99 minus 20%) is competitively priced for a 4-ounce bar.

title: Divine, lightly sweet scent with floral notes; long lasting - 4.5 stars
text:
This fragrance is divine. It has a lightly sweet scent that is not overpowering but contains floral notes. Although this is a mixture of lemon, orange, mandarin, lavandin, green apple, melon, sage, cinnamon, coriander, cardamom, pepper, freesia, ginger, nutmeg, jasmine, patchouli, amber, musk, vetiver, sandalwood, labdanum, ad cedar per the Amazon site, I can't detect any of these individual aromas. However, this combination is wonderful. The perfume is long lasting as well and is still detectable after a few hours.

The current price of $49.99 ($54.99 minus $5) is competitively priced for a scent of this quality. It also comes in a lovely box and beautiful red bottle.

title: Really nice body wash with a clean fragrance; leaves a barrier on my skin
text: I really like this body wash. It smells a bit like sandalwood but nothing at all like tea tree oils, which I am grateful for. The soap lathers decently (moderate to heavy lather when using a mesh loofah) and I feel clean after using this. There is a slight moisture barrier left behind on my skin. I haven't used this for my hair but I love this as a body wash. The current price of $12.45 ($24.89 minus 50%) is reasonable for this 32-ounce bottle.

title: Nice spa kit with 10 items
text:
This is a nice spa kit. There are the following 10 items included:

- bubble bath

- shower gel

- body oil

- Epsom salt

- bath bomb soak powder

- soy candle

- lip balm

- pink lipstick

- gel eye mask

- bath bomb

The bubble bath and shower gel lathers and cleans well. The lip balm is very nice. The pink lipstick glides on but I don't use lipstick anymore so I was disappointed that it was actually lipstick.

The basket is top heavy since the entire contents sit high on a foil covered Styrofoam block. The basket itself is nothing to write home about. However, the products are nice. I like the berry aroma. I do not care for the gel mask or lipstick but everything else is nice. This reminds me of the packaged sets that can be purchased at local stores during the holidays. The arrangement is nothing special but it is a little better than the gift baskets I can purchase at Walmart. The current price of $30.59 ($35.99 minus 15%) comes to $3.06 per item which is competitively priced.

The biggest negative about this entire ensemble is that the glue they put on the items to keep it stuck to each other and the Styrofoam block is immensely hard to get off. I find that the bottles stick to my tub, my cabinets, etc. because I can't get it all off. One other thing I do not like is that the bubble bath and shower gel require the cap be screwed off in order to use. It would have been nice to have a flip-top cap on those items.

title: Good travel-sized bottles for both home or travel; wish they were see through
text:
There are four bottles in this set. They are not made of soft silicone like other travel bottles but are a harder plastic that is still pliable. They are good for liquid lotions, shampoos, and creams. What I love about those bottles are that they are easy to fill and easy to dispense. I do wish they were clear so that I could see the contents.

The current price of $8.99 is a bit pricey for this especially when I can order this [[ASIN:B085WSPLP3 16 pack]] for only a few dollars more. They do come in a clear pouch and have some English/Chinese labels.

title: Way too strong spicy fragrance; no floral notes to me
text:
I wish I liked this. This is a nicely packaged perfume in an attractive bottle. The scent does not smell like bergamot, rose, or peony as described but it has a strong spicy aroma. It is a bit too strong and offensive to me. It does last all day until my next every-12-hour shower.

The current price of $49.99 ($54.99 minus $5) is competitively priced for perfume like this but it is not one I would order again as I have to really love it to pay that much.

title: Shampoo lathers & strips my hair clean but stinks; conditioner hydrates & smells nice
text:
I have short to medium-length fine curly hair. This shampoo lathers and cleans well and leaves my hair squeaky clean. The conditioner hydrates well. The fragrance of the shampoo is absolutely repulsive to me. The fragrance of the conditioner is subtly nice and fresh.

As to its ability to thicken hair, I will not be using it again because I cannot stand the shampoo. Yes it is for men but I use men's products and women can use this too.

The current price of $19.91 ($24.89 minus 20%) is competitively priced for this as it comes to $9.96 per 8-ounce bottle. Not each bottle comes with a snap up cap and a pump.

title: Scent is okay; it’s a bit spicy; aroma lasts several hours
text:
I wish I liked this more. This is a nicely packaged perfume in an attractive bottle with a lacy top. The scent does not smell like lemongrass or rose as described but is spicy and vintage. It is okay but definitely not my favorite.

The current price of $44.99 ($49.99 minus $5) is competitively priced for perfume like this but it is not one I would order again as I have to really love it to pay that much.

title: Smells like an old lady perfume from the 1960’s; I don’t like this
text:
I never heard of this perfume but I always like to try new scents. This smells like an old lady perfume from the 1960’s. It also is long lasting in the sense that it lasts a few hours. I don’t like this at all.

The current price of $29.99 would be typical if I liked it. It says it is a blend of wood, spicy, and leather and I smell none of that.

title: Lovely intoxicating scent of honeysuckle and jasmine; long lasting
text:
I absolutely LOVE this fragrance. It is lovely and definitely an intoxicating mixture of honeysuckle, jasmine, and some other floral notes. The perfume is long lasting as well and is still detectable after a few hours.

The current price of $49.99 ($54.99 minus $5) is competitively priced for a scent of this quality. It also comes in a lovely tin but the top of my tin was damaged. The bottle this comes in is attractive as well.

title: 10 files and 2 four-sided buffers; they work well
text:
There are 10 coarse nail files in this package with a coarse and very coarse coarseness level. There are also two four-sided buffers from fine to very fine for polishing.

These are great for those who want to use these to file their own nails and then buff them to a manicurist shine. The grit on these is very coarse, which I love. The files are good for many uses until the paper surface becomes marred.

The current price of $6.99 comes to $.58 cents per file which is competitively priced. My favorite part of this set is the 10 coarse files.

title: Nice scent; copious suds; cleansing
text:
I love this body wash. I don't care that it is for men. It has a nice scent--not necessarily that of cedar and pine but very nice. It also produces a generous lather and I feel very clean after using this.

There are two 12-ounce bottles of body wash in this set. The current price of $19.99 comes to $10 per bottle.

title: Moisturizes well; not too greasy; absorbs in a few minutes; not crazy about spicy aroma
text:
This body oil absorbs in a few minutes. It moisturizes well and is not too greasy. However, I am not crazy about the spicy aroma.

The current price of $35 is very pricey for this 8.75 fluid ounce pump bottle.

title: Jury is still out on hair strengthening but it lathers & cleans relatively well & smells okay
text:
Only time will tell how well this works to strengthen my fine curly locks. However, this lathers and cleans relatively well and smells okay.

The current price of $15 is boutique pricing for 8 fluid ounces.

title: A precision tweezer set
text:
There are four different types of tweezers with a case. They are:
- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they work with absolute precision. I am truly impressed.

The current price of $12.99 is pricey for this, however. The same pair of tweezers in black can currently be purchased for $6.99 ($9.99 minus 30%) under Amazon Product #B0B54VM7QL. This is the only reason I took off one star; otherwise this set is 5 stars. Note that the case has an extra folder pocket behind the tools in case someone wants to store some bills or files behind the tweezers.

title: Nice hand wash but the pumps don’t work; cannot be used from its current bottles - SEE UPDATE
text:
At $24.99 for 3 16-ounce bottles, this hand wash comes to $8.33 per bottle.
