I used a generous amount on my hands and it has a slick and jelly consistency to it but lathers reasonably well and cleans gently. What is very disappointing about this is that none of the pumps work. As a result, I cannot recommend this as this has to be dispensed into another bottle. Both my boyfriend and I tried to open all three pumps without any luck.

UPDATE Nov 5, 2022 - I tried on and off for three days to get all three pumps to open and could not. Then I used a funnel to dispense this into another bottle. Well that also is impossible because this is a gel soap that just slips and slides all over the place. I gave up and on the fourth day (today), I decided to try the pumps again. I finally got one pump to pop up and work. I put the bottle with installed pump in a deep sink and pressed down really hard on the top then turned the pump to open and it worked. As a result, I raised my ranking from 2 to 3 stars. However, even though this soap washes well, I would never order it. First, the trouble I had with the pumps was most annoying. Second, the soap slides ride off my hand if I am not careful as it is like handling Jello.

UPDATE Dec 28, 2022 - I decided to lower my rating from 3 to 2 stars. I really hate this soap. I am almost done with the second bottle. Although it is cleansing, the gel-like texture causes the soap to run down the drain unless I smash it into my hands without sliding off. I would never buy this. I don't like waste, so I'll finish it but I almost want to throw this out.

title: Wonderful angled contour brush with case
text:
There is one brush in this set along with a plastic case that covers the brush head. This brush is great for applying brush or dusting powder on the face. The bristles are soft and almost feel like hair even though they are a soft nylon. It provides good coverage. It feels great in my hands and is easy to work with.  I also love that there is a cover to prevent the dirty brush from messing up others in my make-up case.

The current price of $15.99 is slightly pricey but this is a really nice and very functional brush. Also, the bristles stay put.

title: Both brushes glide & detangle my fine curly hair; brushes are easy to clean
text:
There are two brushes in this set. Both glide through my hair wet or dry and detangle it as well. It also feels great in my hands and does not slip out like some brushes do. Note that I have fine short to medium curly hair. The nylon bristles on this brush are thin and very pliable. What I really love is that the brush base can be removed from the handle and the tines can be removed so the brush can be cleaned. This is a wonderful feature of these brushes.

I like these brushes even though they feel and look on the cheap side. Note that the current price of $13.99 is slightly pricey as it comes to $7.50 each brush.

title: Nice gift set but I hate the colors of the creams
text: This is a nice foot set. It includes a washable foot file, a foot scrub, a foot butter, and a pink case. The set is nice and a good gift. The current price of $49.99 is a bit pricey for this. However, I absolutely hate that the scrub has black seeds and the butter is a hard yellow. I have an extreme aversion to creams and scrubs that are anything but clear or white and this is my only gripe but I would never order this again as a result. Had I realized this before I ordered it, I would never have ordered it. Otherwise, it is a nice gift set.

title: Good for light filing; washable; comes with protective case
text:
There is one attractive glass file in this set with a black protective case. The file works gently on my nails and can be rinsed off. This is not for extensive filing.

The current price of $6.88 is competitively priced for this file.

title: Wonderful selection of three body/hair washes; like a spa experience
text:
There are three different body/hair washes in this set (turbo wash, black reserve, and all-over wash). The all-over wash is my favorite, followed by the black reserve, and then the turbo wash. The black reserve produces less lather than the other two. The other two washes produce a lot of lather. All of them cleanse well and the fragrances are intoxicating making me feel like I am having a spa experience.

The scents are typical of what I find in men's body washes. However, I really love these. The current price of $25 comes to $8.33 per 3-ounce tube which is pricey but still competitive.

title: 4 cute gel soaps w/surprises; light lather/light scent
text:
Kids will love this. There are four gel soaps in this box with a toy animal in each bar. Each bar is a different scent and the scents are lemon, green apple, strawberry, and baby shark. I am not sure what scent "baby shark" is but it smells nice. There is no "rose scent" in the box unless the "baby shark" one is actually rose but it doesn't smell like rose to me.

The soap is soft and lathers very lightly, yet is still cleansing. The current price of $21.99 comes to $5.50 per bar which is pricey but competitive. Young kids will definitely love this.

title: Gloves are snug, stiff, and highly exfoliating
text:
The current price of $5.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for one pair of exfoliating gloves. However, these are a tad better quality than some cheaper versions because they are thicker and more rough.

I take a size large and these gloves are a snug fit but still fit my hands perfectly. They do stretch but I doubt they would fit a man's hand. In addition, the color is better than I expected. I expected a dull gray but it looks more like a gray blue. It is even bluer in my photo.

These work and act like my other exfoliating gloves. They are slightly thicker than my others and have a good scratchy surface. They are just rough enough to cleanse well. These can be used in the shower with a bar of soap. They definitely exfoliate but the gloves themselves reduce the amount of suds created. I love a lot of suds, which is why a mesh body puff is my "go to" shower accessory.

title: Very nice shampoo; highly cleansing; smells a little bit like Garnier Fructis to me
text:
I really like this shampoo. It smells wonderful. The aroma reminds me a little of Garnier Fructis. This shampoo is super cleansing and has a nice lather. I have short to medium fine curly hair and my hair looked really nice after using this. It smelled nice too.

The current price of $11.99 is reasonable for this.

title: Very nice conditioner; smells a little bit like Garnier Fructis to me
text:
I really like this mask. What I do not like is the flip top container which causes a lot of leakage as it is not water tight. I also do not like that there are no directions on the package.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and used this like a conditioner after using their shampoo. I love the smell. The aroma reminds me a little of Garnier Fructis. It left my hair hydrated without weighing down the curls.

The current price of $12.99 is reasonable for this.

title: Looks like, feels, and moisturizes like hard Vaseline
text:
This looks like a sheet of glass but as I dig in, it reminds me of a harder version of Vaseline. It moisturizes well and absorbs some, but does leave my skin feeling greasy. I use it only on the problem areas because of that such as elbows, heels, and hands.

The current price of $9.99 for 4 ounces comes to $2.50 per ounce. Note that it does include sunscreen with the active ingredient of zinc oxide 20% and allantoin 2% as a skin protectant.

title: Mediocre foundation set
text:
This set includes three implements - a hexagon Brush with its own plastic case, double-side blush brush, and a blender sponge. The bristles are synthetic on the brushes. I actually do not care for the hexagon brush because the bristles are tightly packed and stiff and it does not feel good against my skin. Of course, the packed bristles make this easier to spread liquid foundation.

The double-sided blush brush is very nice and provides good coverage. The blender sponger is dense and has a side with a flat angle that is good for precision and clean blending details.

In summary, the blender is good with liquids. The hexagon brush is good with both liquid and powder, and the blush brush is good with powder. This set is giftable.

For someone who likes to change their brushes and blenders frequently, this is an okay set. The current price of $14.99 ($15.99 minus $1) comes to a pricey $5 per item.

title: Cute, portable, and functional hair brush; as a cat lover I absolutely love it
text:
This is a nice, cute, small brush for young children or for young-at-heart adults that want to travel with a small brush. The handle is small and not as easy to hold as a full length brush, but that is to be expected. The brush head is cute and shaped like a cat's face. It glides easily through my short to medium-length curly hair when both dry or wet. I love the nylon only bristles as it helps to detangle my hair but yet is not too harsh.

This comes with a cloth carry case that fits the entire brush.

The current price of $9.99 ($14.99 minus $5) is competitively priced for this. If it were priced more than $11, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: Body wash has an intoxicating rose aroma & voluminous lather
text: I really love this body wash. It has an intoxicating rose aroma and produces a fantastic lather. I feel very clean after using this. There are two 2.5-ounce tubes of body wash in this package for the current price of $19.78 ($21.98 minus 10%), which comes to $9.89 per tube.

title: Eight soap refill tablets for a foaming soap dispenser
text:
Unfortunately, I do not have the correct dispenser for this. Nevertheless, there are eight Tum-sized tablets in this set. I actually had to cut it in half to get it in my dispenser. The lather is light but good and the soap is unscented. It is also cleansing. All I had to do was add water, which is tricky when the soap starts to bubble. The tablet takes a while to dissolve.

For the current price of $19.99, one essentially gets the ability to make eight 12-ounce bottles of hand soap, which comes to $2.50 per bottle. All that has to be done is add water.

title: Great to soften skin and keep it supple; balm smells like tire rubber
text: The product label says this is good for cuts, tattoo care, and can be used for everyday moisture. I agree that this is good for the skin in general. The first ingredient is shea butter. It is a solid stick like underarm deodorant. It is hydrating and is great to quench the skin of cracked elbows and heels. This is not only good for tattoo care. A little goes a long way and rubs in easily on my skin as well as absorbs quickly. Unfortunately, the balm smells like tire rubber to me and I really do not like that. This is the only reason I took off two stars. The current price of $11.06 ($11.89 minus 7%) for a 2.6-ounce tube is competitively priced.

title: Good for acne prone or oily areas; works well; mild lather
text:
This soap is recommended for those with acne or oily skin. This produces a very light lather, has an okay lemongrass scent, and works well on the oily areas of my skin; particularly on my face, neck, and arms. There are two bars in this package.

The current price of $10 comes to $5 per 4-ounce bar. I do wish it had a better lather and scent.

title: Fragrant bath bombs with lackluster surprises inside; suds lasts about 10 minutes
text:
[[VIDEOID:6bed4b7eb5e864030fdc53c609dacf3e]] This is an attractive and giftable set of eight bath bombs in eight fragrances (peach, rose, blueberry, mint, vanilla, lavender, strawberry, and coconut). Unfortunately, even though the bombs each smell different, I cannot tell which is which because they do not have the aroma I expect.

I tried the yellow bomb in my foot bath. The fragrance of this really comes out in the bath. It is very, very nice but I still could not guess which one of the eight fragrances it is. I used hot to tepid water and suds were created in the foot bath and the bomb fizzed and dissolves in about about 5-10 minutes with the suds lasting about 10 minutes. I felt clean and loved the scent. My feet also came out feeling soft.

The yellow color of the water did not stain my feet, towel, or foot bath. The surprise was only revealed when the bomb fully dissolved; however, it is important to have a drain cover on the drain to avoid the "toy pieces" from going down the drain. As can be seen from my photo, the toy came apart in the water. The metal circle (which is a magnet) came unglued from the small duck. The pieces present a choking hazard for young children and may also clog the drain if it is not captured in a mesh drain cover.

Although the performance of these bombs from a suds perspective is decent and the fragrance and fizz are enjoyable, the surprise is lackluster. At the current price of $22.07 ($23.99 minus 8%), they come to a competitively priced $2.76 per bath bomb. These bombs are 4 stars for performance but I took off an additional star for the two-piece lackluster surprise. Note that if the circular magnet does not stay stuck to the duck, then it cannot be stuck to the fridge.

title: ice nail hand rest but it is NOT leather; mat needs to be a few inches larger; assembly required
text:
At the current price of $39.89, this manicure bench is overpriced because it is NOT leather as it says in the title. It is made of microfiber leather which is a synthetic leather made of high performance PU (polyurethane) resins. Nevertheless, this is a very nice, very functional, and sturdy nail hand rest. It comes with a silicone mat that prevents slipping but the mat needs to be a few inches longer to fit the legs of the bench securely.

The quality of the workmanship is good but the legs elevate this bench about 5.25 "off the ground. I love that this bench is wider at the top than typical, which reduces the tendency to tip this over. In addition, it has rubber feet on the "legs" so that the bench does not slip.

Note that assembly is required. There are eight screws provided but only six are needed. An Allen wrench is also provided to tighten the screws to the legs.

In summary, this bench is very nice and functional. However, I feel it is overpriced by about $10, especially since it is not leather. I suppose it could double as a child's pretend ironing board.

title: Delicious strawberry shake flavored lip balm in a very nice "Hello Kitty" tube
text: This lip balm tastes delicious as it is strawberry shake flavored that is also very moisturizing. It also comes in a very nice "Hello Kitty" tube that young girls would love. The current price of $5, however, is very expensive. For less than $10, I can get 10 of their lip balms (without the fancy tube). In fact, one of the 10 (i.e. strawberry love) tastes almost exactly like this flavor. However, for those who want a lip balm in a nice container, this makes a perfect gift, stocking stuffer, or Easter Basket "surprise." I only rated this 4 stars because of the high price.

title: Copious suds & cleansing but burns eyes & aroma almost like Play-Doh to me
text:
This body wash produces a very good lather and feels cleansing. However, I do not care for the aroma, which reminds me of Play-Doh. Also, it burns the eyes. I accidentally got some suds in my eyes and did not like the sting.

The current price of $26 is also pricey for 13 ounces. If I loved the aroma and it didn't burn my eyes , I would have felt as if I was having a spa experience and rated this 5 stars.

title: Good medium-sized buff puff that creates copious suds
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only thing I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. To me this is a medium-sized (not large sized) mesh puff and similar to the ones I buy at Walmart for $2 each. This works like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. I notice no difference in sponge quality or performance over my typical Walmart sponges. Note that this is tightly wound.

The current price of $4.05 is somewhat pricey. It is a very nice loofah in a medium size but too pricey. I took off one star for the price and for it not being a large size. It would have been a 5-star puff otherwise.

title: Love the pump bottle; lightweight lotion absorbs quickly & leaves skin silky; a little slick at 1st
text:
I really like the scent; it is odd but nice to me. However, I think this scent will be hit or miss as not everyone is going to like it. I wish I could describe the fragrance but I can't.

This lightweight lotion is a bit slick and slippery when first applied. It is best to use very little. I used just a tad too much the first time. It takes less than a minute to absorb and for the slickness to go away. It leaves my skin feeling very silky with the feeling of a moisture barrier. In addition to the lotion, I also love the pump bottle that makes dispensing this very easy.

The current price of $14.99 for 4 ounces is competitively priced.

title: Super cleansing & scentless but not hydrating at all
text:
I really like this clear gel shampoo because it is not intensely hydrating. In fact, it feels just the opposite. It stripped my hair of all the oils and my hair felt incredibly clean. I had to use a conditioner afterward. I really like this shampoo and it did enhance my curls; I have short to medium fine curly hair. 

The current price of $15.95 is competitively priced. I only rated this 3 stars because it does not live up to its claims but it is a 4-star shampoo to me. If it had fragrance, then it would be a 5-star shampoo. Note that it is vegan and gluten free.

title: Great to soften skin and keep it supple - PRICEY
text: The product label says this is good for cuts, tattoo care, and sunburn. I feel it is good for the skin in general. The first ingredient is shea butter. It is thick and hydrating and is great to quench the skin of cracked elbows and heels. This is not only good for tattoo care. A little goes a long way and rubs in easily on my skin as well as absorbs quickly. The Eucalyptus scent smells nice but medicinal. The current price of $21.93 for a 2-ounce jar is pricey.

title: Nice matte clips with a good hold & non-slip grip
text:
There are eight large claw clips in this package. The clips come in autumn colors of black and browns and are sturdy. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center. What I really love is the matte finish and non-slip grip. That makes them easy to open.

At the current price of $9.99, this comes to $1.25 cents per clip which is on the higher side of competitively priced for a bulk box.

title: Light moisturizer/cosmetics base; no ingredient listed; label food grade / avoid skin contact?
text:
This is supposedly one gallon of mineral oil. The bottle says massage oil but does not list the ingredient(s) on the label. However, it smells petroleum-based so I accept that it is mineral oil.

In addition to this, what I do not like is that the label also has conflicting information. It says this is food grade mineral oil, so it can be used in cosmetics (lotions, body butter, etc.). However, on the same label it implies that you should avoid skin contact via the following warning verbatim. "Skin Contact: Rinse/wash with lukewarm, gently flowing water (and mild soap) for 15-20 minutes or until product is removed. Remove contaminated clothing. If skin irritation occurs or you feel unwell: Get medical advice/attention." Really???? This is a skin moisturizer.

I tried it and it works as designed to moisturize my skin but they need to get the label straight. It absorbs quickly and does not leave my skin too oily.

The current price of $32.49 comes to .25 cents per ounce since there are 128 ounces in this bottle.

title: Love the pump bottle; lightweight lotion that absorbs quickly and leaves my skin silky
text:
I didn't think I would like this lotion because it is so lightweight. However, after trying this, I really like it. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling very silky. I also love the pump bottle that makes dispensing this very easy.

The current price of $14.99 for 4 ounces is competitively priced.

title: Nice clips with a great hold; works even on short hair even though these are best for long hair
text:
There are six large claw clips in this package in two colors and three designs/sizes. The clips are sturdy. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair.

At the current price of $13.99, this comes to a high priced $2.33 per clip.

title: Soft headbands that feel great on and look good too in perfect autumn colors
text:
There are six quality headbands in this set. The headbands are soft and sized well. They look great on and the colors are autumn-inspired and will match with most fall outfits.

I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and these work for me and are even better for someone with long hair. All the headbands are sized the same, which is great.

The current price of $9.99 is a competitively priced $1.67 per band.

title: Lightly fragrant bath bombs that smell the same; good performance; bomb & suds lasted 15 min
text:
[[VIDEOID:a4218a1871d89436b05a79cf0b8fa62f]] There are 12 individually wrapped standard-sized bath bombs in this set in supposedly different fragrances. The fragrances are subtle and the bombs smell almost all the same to me. The nine fragrances listed on the back are rose, jasmine, grapefruit, mango, mint, lavender, vanilla, lemon, and orange. It was impossible for me to tell them apart. Nevertheless, I believe I picked the rose one for my foot bath.

The bombs dissolve in about 15 minutes and the suds hold just as long; at least in a foot bath. The bath fragrance is faint, however. The bomb dissolved into electric pink-colored water.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I used this in a foot bath. The color of this bomb, did not adhere to my skin, my foot bath, or my towels-- at least the color of the one I tried.

In summary, these smell nice but subtle and it is hard to tell the difference among the fragrances. Nevertheless, they perform very well. The current price of $19.99 comes to $1.67 per bath bomb which is reasonably priced.

title: Nice variety of 18 steamers; fragrance too subtle; short-lasting
text:
In the box are six boxes of three shower steamers each box. The six fragrances are:

- #1 Lavender (light strength)
- #2 Mint (light+ strength)
- #3 Eucalyptus (medium strength)
- #4 Watermelon (medium+ strength)
- #5 Grapefruit (strongstrength)
- #6 Orange (strong+ strength) - note that one side of this box says orange and the other side says tangerine but all of them are orange that are in the box)

When dry, each one smells nice with a good aroma. I've been disappointed with shower steamers and I have tried many and this set is no different. I used one of the strong grapefruit discs  in my shower and the fragrance was subtle for the first few seconds. However, after I started showing with my fragrant soaps, I could smell nothing. Also, the steamer only lasted for 90% of the shower time and I do not take very long showers.

In summary, this is just a way to watch money flow down the drain. The scents are too subtle in the shower to be enticing and any scented soaps or shampoos overpower any scent from a steamer.  At the current price of $23.99 ($29.99 minus $6), comes to $1.33 per steamer. This is nicely packaged and presented and certainly giftable but the scents are not even close to being strong enough for me.

title: Lathers lightly & cleans well; I did not notice any acne reduction but I like this soap
text:
There are three small bars of soap in this package. They have a nice lemony aroma to them. This soap produces a light lather and cleans well. Due to its small size, it is easy to hold. I did not experience any less acne after using this but I do like this soap.

The current price of $16.99 comes to a pricey $5.66 per tiny bar.

title: All three bars are full of mold; this went right in the garbage
text: This soap is repulsive. All three bars arrived with mode on them. I threw them out immediately.  The current price of $14.99 for 3 bars of moldy soap is a travesty.

title: Typical disposable nail files that get the job done; 30 pieces w/10 pieces each variety
text:
There are 30 nail files in this package in 3 different sizes with 6 different grits (due to being double-sided).

These are great for manicurists who want a disposable nail file to use with customers or just for someone who wants to use these to file their own nails. The grit on these goes from buffer quality to light and various levels of coarseness. The small gray one is the buffer on one side with the finest grit on the other. The orange one has an intermediate and the large gray file has the coarsest grit. These are good for many uses until the paper surface becomes marred.

Note that the small fine buffers were difficult to separate as they are stuck together in groups of two.

The current price of $9.96 comes to $.33 cents per file which is reasonable.

title: Hydrating face and neck cream with lemony scent
text: I really like this face cream. It is very creamy and goes on smooth. It does not absorb fully as it leaves a slight barrier on the skin. Nevertheless, I like such a barrier for winter. My face and neck felt very hydrated after using this. I also like the fresh lemony fragrance; at least it smells lemony to me.  The current price of $45 is a bit pricey, however.

title: Absolutely gorgeous and lightweight clip for the bride; an accessory only
text:
This is a work of art. It is absolutely gorgeous and the design is lovely. What I really love is that the piece moves with the person because it is wire and metal. It has a clip on the back making this an accessory piece only. It is not designed to hold hair but to elevate the updo or a person's locks.

I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and this looks great on the side or in the back. It is perfect for any elegant occasion and not just for a bride.

The current price of $9.99 is very reasonable for this piece.

title: Six decent combs that work well
text: These combs are decent for the reasonable price of $5.99 which comes to $1 each. They work as designed and do not feel as cheap as I expected. They hold up when combing through my short to medium fine curly hair. I particularly like the ones with a handle.

title: Lovely lightweight hand cream; love the scents
text: This hand cream is wonderful. It comes in a giftable package with three 1.7 ounce tubes. There's rose petal, cherry blossom, and shea butter. The cream goes on smooth and absorbs rapidly. It is lightweight and leaves my hands silky. My favorite is the shea butter, followed by the cherry blossom, then the rose petal. I do feel the current price of $19.19 ($23.99 minus 20%) comes to $6.40 per tube which is pricey but still competitive. If this were priced at $18 or less it would have received 5 stars from me.

title: Nice, colorful clips with a great hold & non-slip grip; best for thick long hair
text:
There are 10 large claw clips in this package. The clips are colorful and sturdy. I particularly like the four with the print design on them. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center. What I really love is the matte finish and non-slip grip. That makes them easy to open.

At the current price of $11.99, this comes to a competitively priced $1.20 per clip.

title: Soft quality headbands that feel great on and look good too
text:
There are six quality headbands in this set. The headbands are soft and sized well. They look great on and there is a solid color that will go with most outfits.

I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and these work for me and are even better for someone with long hair.

The current price of $9.99 is a competitively priced $1.67 per band.

title: Soft and usable but a little bit tight on my small head
text:
There are three soft and slightly cheap feeling headbands in this set with a center bow. They work well to keep my hair back when applying make-up or a mask product. The one main issue I have with these is that they are tight on my small head. They do stretch to fit but if I had a larger head, these would be uncomfortable to use. These are functional and work as designed.

At the current price of $9.99, this comes to $3.33 per headband which is competitively priced.

title: “Tissue-sized” wipes that are as strong as baby wipes but they are dry; they hold up well when wet
text:
I ordered one pack which only has 70 tissues. Note that it says a six-pack no matter the pack size and that is incorrect.

They look and almost feel exactly like unscented tissues. However, they perform very well. These are strong and hold up when wet to pick up messes, clean urine off a litter pan, etc. They are perfect for cleaning a baby's bottom or pet's bottom as well. I use these to clean my cat's urine off the walls of the litter pan but I wet the wipe first. They can be used to remove make-up with soap and water.

These are expensive. At the current price of $9.90 it comes to $.14 cents per wipe, which is about $.10 to $.12 cents more than wet baby wipes can be purchased for. Also a big negative to me is that there is no perforation in the package. Instead I have to cut the side open to extract the wipes.

title: Results are superb but it takes 15 minutes to absorb on my skin
text:
In the package is a 0.247 ounce whip hydrating moisturizer and a 1.7-ounce jar of regenerist. I tried the regenerist cream and it is lightweight--almost airy. It goes on slick and takes 15 minutes to absorb on my face and neck. However, once absorbed my face feels great and my skin feels super hydrated and plump with moisturizer. I love the cream but hate the absorption rate.

The current price of $29.99 ($34.99 minus $5) is competitively priced for this.

title: This supposed to be fragrance free but it smells absolutely awful
text: This is a lightweight cream for the face and neck in a large 5-ounce tube. The cream absorbs rapidly and is mildly moisturizing. However, the smell is horrendous to me. I absolutely hate it. It is supposedly fragrance free but by that it means they do not add fragrance. The natural aroma of this product has me looking the other way. The current price of $9.09 is reasonable for this but too bad I hate it due to the smell.

title: Nice small brush; huge comb; set is not proportional
text:
This is a very odd set which I do not consider giftable. There is a lovely mini boar bristle and nylon brush with a tiny handle. It is a brush for an adult purse or for a toddler. I love it. This tiny oval brush glides through & detangles my hair easily.

The negative is the comb. The comb is huge and is not proportional with the tiny brush. It is big and bulky to hold and the finish does not even match. This is the reason I do not consider this giftable. The comb works, but I personally do not care for it.

I love the brush only and the current price of $6.99 ($9.99 minus $3) is reasonable for this ensemble.

title: Thick barrel, attractive curling iron that heats fast & is relatively simple to use
text:
In the box is one very pretty curling iron with a pink handle that fades to black. In addition a user pamphlet and two hair clips are included.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and I get a light curl with this iron as this is best for those with long hair. This iron is simple to operate and simple to use. On one side is an ON/OFF switch (slight hold press to turn on and off) and a plus and minus button which increases or decreases the temperature. The temperatures available are 248, 284, 320, 356, 392, and 430 degrees Fahrenheit. There is a lock feature that can be engaged or disengaged by pressing the ON/OFF button two times in quick succession. There are only tiny plastic protrusions that act as a kickstand of sorts; however, the tip of the barrel does come in contact with the counter but that part is not hot.

The cord is a 360 degree swivel cord to prevent tangling. There is also a loop at the base of the cord for hanging on a hook or nail.

The current price of $23.79 is competitively priced for this. It works well on my hair but would work better on someone with longer hair since this has a 1.25" barrel.

title: Ingenious brush design w/telescoping handle but unstable when fully extended
text:
This brush has a large almost oval head with bristles on one side and silicone massaging nubs on the other. The bristles are a little coarse and there is not much bristle shedding. The handle is telescoping and is embedded into the brush. I have to press the silver release on the side to pull out the handle part way. The handle then has to be released totally but pulling up the clip (see photo).

When fully extended, it provides me with a good reach. However, it is unstable and due to that the scrubbing ability is reduced. I prefer when the handle is halfway but then I cannot reach my back. The full length from tip-to-tip is 11" half way and 15.5" fully extended. As a result, this brush is not as useful to me.

There is a loop for hanging and it is the same loop that has to be pulled to release the handle. There is also a stick on hook provided..

In summary, this is a good back brush with a short reach and exfoliating bristles. It is an unstable brush when fully extended as a back brush. The current price of $15.99 ($19.99 minus 15%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this. I love the ingenious design but the handle has to be made sturdier for me to rate this 5 stars.

title: Beautiful & functional brush; large coverage and no bristle shedding
text:
This is an impressive and beautiful foundation brush. It works exceptionally well for dusting translucent powder over the face or applying a bronzer. The brush feels great in my hands--although I do wish it had a silicone grip on it. The bristles do not shed and the head provides great coverage. It is also soft against my skin. I can even use it to apply blush as long as I want wide coverage.

The current price of $9.99 is reasonably priced for this. The only negative is that the shiny rose gold finish I chose shows all fingerprints.

title: Attractive brush that is best for peach fuzz or very short men's hair but sheds a lot
text:
This is an attractive boar bristle hairbrush for men with peach fuzz or very short hair. It has stiff bristles but it does not detangle and it only passes lightly through my short-to-medium fine curly hair. It passes through my boyfriend's hair well, however. This brush is best for those who have peach fuzz or a little more than peach fuzz for hair, which is why it is advertised for men. The handle is easy to hold, so it provides a good grip. The handle does feel a little cheap. Also, the boar bristles shed a lot. I know boar usually sheds but this sheds a lot and that coupled with the cheap feel of the handle is what caused me to rate this 3 stars.

The current price of $12.99 is competitively priced for this. It is only functional for very short hair.

title: Ordinary relatively scentless soap that is highly moisturizing; not just for tattoos
text:
This soap is really nice. There are three small 4 ounce bars of soap in the box. There is sea buckthorn berry, hemp seed (i.e. hemp-infused) oil, and shea butter. They smell almost all the same and I would call them almost scentless as there are no fragrances in this soap.

I tried the shea butter bar and the soap lathers well. It is very mild and non-irritating and cleanses as well. This makes it perfect for anyone who just got a tattoo; however, it is also perfect for any and not just for those with tats.

The current price of $17.99 ($19.99 minus $2) is expensive for three small bars of soap as it comes to $6 per 4 ounce bar.

title: Very nice sunscreen; rubs in thick & white but absorbs easily and it is scentless
text:
I really like this sunscreen. It is thick and creamy and goes on a pasty white but is easy to spread and rub in. Once it is rubbed in, it absorbs easily and it leaves my skin feeling like it has a protective barrier on it and is moisturized. It also provides good coverage. The active ingredient is zinc oxide 24.5%.

Unfortunately there is no current price listed for this but I would hope it is not priced more than $12 because there is only a very small amount of 1.7 ounces in this tube.

title: Nice after shave balm; fresh and lightly sweet scent
text:
This is a 2.53 fluid ounce tube of after shave balm. It has a lovely fresh and lightly sweet scenter.

Although I know this is specifically geared for men, I use men's products because I like them so much. It definitely moisturized my face after using this around the upper lip and chin. It also absorbs quickly.

In summary, this is very nice after shave balm and the current price of $14 is competitively priced, especially since this comes from Milano Italy. Note that there is only one tube in the package and not two. The Amazon description says one but the photo makes people think two are supplied.

title: Tiny handheld brush that glides & detangles my hair, wet or dry; PRICEY
text:
First of all, I love this brush. The brush is tiny and perfect for travel or to carry in a purse. It glides through my hair wet or dry and detangles it as well.

The small size makes it easy to grip because I can wrap my hand around the top. Note that I have fine short to medium curly hair. The bamboo pin bristles (which actually feel like nylon or plastic) on this brush are sturdy enough for both fine and thick hair.

I love this brush; however, the current price of $11.69 ($12.99 minus 10%) is a bit pricey as similar brushes like can be purchased at my local Home Goods for about $6.99. This is the only reason I took off one star.

title: Excellent rough skin buffer; I used on my elbows & heels; needs nearby plug
text:
This is a good set for smoothing calluses or cracked heels and elbows. It comes with the grinder itself, an A/C power cord, 60 sandpaper discs, an instruction pamphlet, and a plastic nail brush. The grinding heads are all the same but there are several speeds on the power cord that are dialed in..

Operation is super simple. First I had to remove the adhesive off one sandpaper disc and stick it on the head of the unit. Then I just plugged it into an outlet and pushed up the button on the power cord. I then dialed the speed I wanted. The rotation goes from slow to fast. I prefer the slow for my elbows and medium for my heels. The head just sort of rotates around on the skin during use. It did a great job and I moisturized when I was done.

The current price of $31.99 is competitively priced. I could do without the garbage plastic nail brush. I wish they left that out and reduced the price by $2 or so. What's great about this is that it is electric; however, that is also what is bad about it. I have to sit near a plug to use it. The cord is long but I would have preferred longer as it is difficult to sit on my toilet and use when it is plugged into the wall out by my sink. Nevertheless, I really like this unit.

title: Scentless suntan lotion in a stick; good for one’s purse; small amount
text:
This 0.52-ounce SPF 30 tube of suntan lotion is small and SUPER expensive at the current price of $15.40 ($22 minus 30%). However, it is good to carry in a purse for spot protection when needed.

It has no fragrance and does protect well. The stick glides on and I do not have to do much rubbing to get it to absorb. In fact, my skin not only feels protected but also moisturized with this. I wouldn't use this as my "go to" lotion due to the expense and quantity; however, it is good in a pinch or for when I do not want to travel with a large bottle of suntan lotion.

For a similar item in what looks like a deodorant tube, this [[ASIN:B08WCPBCCN lotion]] is three times cheaper but still expensive for a 0.48 ounce tube with SPF 50 which also works just as well although it goes on white and has to be rubbed in more.

title: Creamy & moisturizing; leaves skin silky; do not care for aroma
text:
I have a lot of scars and am always moisturizing. I used scar cream before and they just moisturize the area to make the skin look better but are no different than any other good moisturizer.

This is very creamy and hydrating and leaves my skin silky. Unfortunately, I do not care for the aroma. The current price of $19.99 is also pricey for 3.53 ounces. If it had a great fragrance, I would have rated this 4.5 to 5 stars even at that price.

title: Well-made & attractive brush that is best for peach fuzz or very short men's hair
text:
This is a really beautiful boar bristle hairbrush for men with peach fuzz or very short hair. It almost feels like this has very hard nylon bristles but it does not detangle and it only passes lightly through my short-to-medium fine curly hair. This brush is best for those who have peach fuzz or a little more than peach fuzz for hair, which is why it is advertised for men. The handle is easy to hold, so it provides a good grip.

The current price of $11.99 is competitively priced for this. It is certainly beautiful and only functional for very short hair.

title: Smells like candle wax, has a moderate lather; is moisturizing
text: I am actually disappointed in this bar of soap. This is a small 3.4-ounce bar that is supposedly in a calming lavender fragrance. I do not smell lavender. Instead it smells like plain candle wax to me. The lather is moderate and I like a lot of suds. The best thing about this is that it is very moisturizing. For that it gets 5 stars.  The current price of $5.99 ($6.99 minus $1) is expensive but competitively priced for this. Unfortunately, this is not a bar of soap I would order again. I prefer a high lather and a good fragrance, which this does not have.

title: Very nice body soaps; moderate lather w/wonderful fragrance; a bit PRICEY
text: There are three almost 4.23-ounce black-colored (really a dark blue) men's body wash soap in this package. I absolutely love the fragrance even though it's a men's soap. The soaps lather moderately and wash well. I feel clean after using this soap. However, the current price of $18.99 for 3 small bars comes to an expensive $6.33 per bar, which is actually competitively priced if I consider these craft/artist made.

title: Thick barrel curling iron that heats fast & is relatively simple to use; good value for $25.19
text:
In the box is one very pretty curling iron with a metallic silver handle. In addition a user pamphlet and one heat protective glove are included.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and I get a light curl with this iron as this is best for those with long hair. This iron is simple to operate and simple to use. There is a light telling the user when it has reached a certain temperature. Everything is done via the ON/OFF switch. Each press increases or decreases the temperature, which means I had to cycle through all the temperatures to get to the one I wanted. The temperatures available are 290, 330, 375, 410, and 450 degrees Fahrenheit. The kick stand is sturdy but it does not stay propped up without touching the barrel.

The current price of $25.19 ($27.99 minus 10%) is excellent for this. At this price, it is a 5-star iron. If it were more than this, I would have rated this 4 stars. I really like the simplicity of this curling iron, its length, its hold, and the 360 degree cord swivel. It also works well on my hair but would work better on someone with longer hair since this has a 1.25" barrel.

title: Zodiac-inspired lip balm; this Aries blend is spicy
text: This zodiac-inspired lip balm is a blend of orange, berry, and spice. It tastes all spicy but it is very nice; almost like a chai tea. The current price of $8.95 is a bit pricey, however.

title: STUNNING clips that do not stay in my hair well; best for someone with thick long hair; odd closure
text:
These clips (3 of them) are absolutely stunning and perfect for an elegant outfit. Unfortunately I have short to medium fine curly hair and this barely works in the back center of my head if I roll my hair up into a knot. This is definitely for someone with long thick hair. Note that the clips have an odd but easy closure via an S hook in the back.

The current price of $13.99 comes to $4.66 per clip.

title: Great lotion applicator with good buff puff
text:
This set comes with a long handle for the four lotion applicator heads, a handheld body brush. a mesh loofah, and a stick on hook.

The applicator heads are excellent due to the textured surface and long handle. Years ago I purchased two of these type applicators and originally hated them due to the Styrofoam cup feel to them. However, this one is the same except the applicator area is textured which helps lotion to adhere better and it doesn't feel like I'm applying lotion with a Styrofoam cup.

The handle is long enough to provide a full reach of my back from the top and the bottom. The rope loop allows me to hang this. It is also easy to clean except for the ridges around the applicator. The silicone at the top of the handle provides a good grip.

I find that these lotion applicators almost last forever. I still have my two other applicators that I use daily and they have not broken or become worn yet.

The mesh puff is also excellent. Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. The puff is medium in size and is wound loose enough to generate a lot of suds. There is a ribbon on the end for hanging.

The current price of $11.99 is excellent for this set.

title: Provides good powder blush/foundation coverage; bristles do not shed; decent grip; handle smudges
text:
These brushes are very nice. They provide good powder blush and powder foundation coverage. I prefer it for setting (a.k.a. finishing) powder or powder bronzer. I also love that the synthetic bristles do not fall out. The only negative is that the tiny nub of a handle is harder to hold than a typical foundation brush but it still provides a decent hold due to the thumb indentation. The bulbous handle base is hollow as seen in my photo. Since the handle is glossy, it does show all make-up smudges.

The current price of $6.99 comes to $3.50 each brush which is competitively priced.

title: Wonderfully packaged & lightly fragrant bath bombs w/great performance but color bleed
text:
[[VIDEOID:1a834c73e86410ccc9eefec49b6d92e]] There are eight individually wrapped large-sized bath bombs in this set. The fragrance is subtle but nice and they smell mostly the same to me. The packaging is wonderful--almost like a puzzle box.

I tried the blue bomb and it had great suds (see video and photos). The suds and bomb lasted 20 minutes, which is about 4 times longer than most bombs on the market. Performance-wise, these are excellent--at least in a foot bath. 

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, this is why I used this in a foot bath. The water turned an indigo blue color and that color did not adhere to my skin or my foot bath but it came off onto my towels. This is the only negative of this set.

In summary, these perform well and are long lasting; however, there is color bleed and it will most likely stain towels, which is why I use old towels when testing bath bombs. The current price of $27.99 is expensive but still competitively priced for this as it comes to $3.50 per bath bomb, which is about what I would expect to pay for bombs of this size. The only reason I rated this 4 instead of 5 stars is because the color bleed.

UPDATE: The color staining on my towels came out in the wash.

title: Large colorful clips with a great hold; a tad pricey
text: There are six gator clips in this package in various colors. What I love is their strong holding power. I have short-to-medium fine curly hair and this holds my hair very well in the back. I also like the selection of colors. For the current price of $9.48 ($9.98 minus 5%), this comes to $1.58 per clip which is a tad pricey.

title: Thick barrel curling iron that heats fast & is simple to use
text:
In the box is one very pretty curling iron with a metallic pink handle and a metallic black barrel. In addition a user pamphlet, one heat protective glove, and two gator clips are included.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and I get a light curl with this iron as this is best for those with long hair. This iron is simple to operate and simple to use. There is a light telling the user when it has reached a certain temperature. The switches are on the top side. There are three switches -- on/off and temperature up and down. The temperature goes from 225 to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. To turn the unit on, I have to press the on/off switch. To change the temperature, I have to press either the plus or minus buttons several times until it shows the temperature I prefer. The kick stand is sturdy but it does not stay propped up, which is disappointing.

The current price of $34.15 ($42.69 minus 20%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this. I really like the simplicity of this curling iron, its length, its hold, and the 360 degree cord swivel. It also works well on my hair but would work better on someone with longer hair since this has a 1.25" barrel.

title: I use this to put toner on my face & for removing nail polish
text:
There are150 almost indestructible pads. I did not count them. They arrived in a cracked plastic storage tub.

These are perfect for removing nail polish, applying toner on the face, etc. I use them for toner and removing nail polish. They are absorbent and stand up to use very well. I also like that it comes in a plastic case but I dislike that it was damaged in shipment.

The current price of $5.03 ($6.29 minus 20%) is competitively priced for this. At that price this is a little over $.03 cents per cotton square.

title: Does not feel exfoliating; leaves a barrier on my skin; avoid contact with eyes
text:
I avoided using this on my face but otherwise, I washed my entire body in the shower with this. The soap is creamy and has a fragrance that smells like tea tree oil even though that is not in the ingredients list. It lathers well but I feel as if it left a barrier on my skin. This is not a body wash I would ever order again.

The current price of $11.49 ($12.49 minus $1) is expensive for 8 ounces of body wash. I am not convinced it is exfoliating or anti-aging.

title: Relaxed my curls a lot but did not straighten them completely
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this straightener relaxed my curls a lot. The tines get hot, so I have to be very careful not to lay this against my scalp because there is nothing to protect me from burning myself from the high heat. This turned my curly locks into a subtle wave.

This is an attractive, not totally mini, comb straightener. There are only two heat options of 430 and 450 degrees Fahrenheit. There is no way to know when it reaches the appropriate temperature but the manual says to wait two to three minutes. The on/off button is in the middle of the two temperatures. The cord swivels 360 degrees to prevent tangling.

The current price of $22.99 is competitively priced for this. I love the metallic pink tines as that matches my pink bathroom.

title: Extremely hydrating and does soften rough heel & elbow skin; nice scent
text:
This one-ounce tube of balm is made of mango butter and plant oils. I used it on both my heels and dry elbows and it was extremely hydrating. It has a nice scent that reminds me a little bit of chamomile.

This does roll on oily looking but it absorbs quickly and leaves an hydration barrier behind. I really like the results. It's like lip balm for the heels of the feet and it's good for dry elbows too. The current price of $15 is a bit pricey, however.

title: Beautiful 1920’s flapper headpiece; comes with 4 bobby pins
text: This is a beautiful flapper headpiece and comes with four bobby pins. Luckily I had the photo on Amazon to figure out how to put this on because it does not come with instructions. I just put this over my head as if it were a crown with the feather up. I did not even need to use the bobby pins. This is a very nice headpiece and I consider the current price of $16.99 competitive.

title: 8 very pretty, soft, & comfortable headbands that fit well
text:
The colors and design of these eight headbands are super attractive to me. They are all wide and have a sort of a "knot" in the middle that can be worn in the center of the head or at the base of the neck. I personally do not like knots in my headbands but these are versatile enough to position the knot away from the forehead without losing the great look of the band. The colors are great and there is a design for almost every outfit. The bands are also comfortable to wear and are very soft.

The current price of $9.99 comes to a reasonable $1.25 per band. These are definitely pretty and functional and they fit well.

title: Tower-shaped shower steamers that smell similar; they are long-lasting but almost scentless
text:
When I ordered this, I first thought I was getting soap because I did not read the product correctly. That, obviously, is my fault. Since the company name is "Hidden Gem Soaps" and that is the title that is written in the Amazon page for the product, I doubt I will be the only one making that mistake. In fact, the box it comes in says "Hidden Gem Soaps and doesn't even mention shower steamers. To me that is a BIG marketing mistake. Nevertheless, since I received these, I tried them.

In the box are six shower steamers shaped like a tower. The six fragrances are:

- Alexite Gem (Lavender)
- Grey Onyx (Sandalwood, Patchouli, & Musk)
- Watermelon Tourmaline (Citrus)
- Opal Lake (Breathe)
- Blue Moonstone (Cedar & Orange)
- Jade Garden (Lemongrass & Lavender)

Unfortunately, each one smells almost the same to me and they have a very subtle aroma. I've been disappointed with shower steamers and I have tried many and this set is no different. I used the Opal Cake one in my shower.

There are two ways to use this (wet to activate and then elevate or put in the corner of shower or put in a direct stream). I did both and eventually put it in the direct stream. These are long-lasting (lasting almost three showers) but I can barely smell a thing. I have the nose of a bloodhound and I did detect some fragrance but it was so subtle as to be almost non-existent. However, once I began my shower with my scented soaps and shampoos, this just became a shower companion that did nothing for me.

In summary, this is just a way to watch money flow down the drain. The scents are too subtle and similar to be enticing and at the current price of $29.99 for 6 towers, this comes to a very expensive $5 per steamer. If the aroma flooded through my bathroom, I would have rated this 4 stars at this price because they last almost three showers. If the box and product also said what this was instead of confusing consumers. this would have received 5 stars.

title: Sturdy massage brush good for sudsing short-haired people or pets or cleaning corn silks
text:
This silicone massage brush is super sturdy with strong nubs and is great for shampooing short haired pets or short-haired people and can also be used to clean the silks off corn. This is not as good with longer hair due to the risk of some tangling if hair is scrubbed too vigorously.

I absolutely love this brush and would have rated this 5 stars except that it is a little pricey and way over packaged--a small brush in a box double the size and then shipped in another box. I do love the hold on this brush as it is easy to use.

The current price of $9.90 is pricey for this. I would not expect to pay more than $8 for this. This [[ASIN:B08VDDFPJ9 silicone scrubber]] that currently sells for $6.99 is just as effective as this brush (even though it does not have the same hold).

title: Gloves fit my large hands & are exfoliating; love the beautiful color
text:
There are two pairs of thick, exfoliating shower gloves with one adhesive hook.

I take a size large and these gloves are a comfortable fit. Compared to other gloves of this type I tried, I consider these generously sized. They would even fit a man's hand. In addition, the teal blue color is extremely enticing.

These work and act like my other exfoliating gloves. They are slightly thicker than my others and have a good scratchy surface. They are just rough enough to cleanse well. These can be used in the shower with a bar of soap. They definitely exfoliate but the gloves themselves reduce the amount of suds created. I love a lot of suds, which is why a mesh body puff is my typical "go to" shower accessory.

The current price of $9.99 comes to $5 per pair.

title: Exfoliating but way too large to hold comfortably; only a 3 pack not a 6 pack
text:
In one burlap bag are three SUPER LARGE loofahs and two self-stick plastic yellow hooks. The loofahs arrived flat as a pancake but are humongous when wet (see photo). These are definitely exfoliating but they are impossible for me to hold.

Also, there are supposed to be six loofahs in this package and instead there are three super-sized ones. The current price of $13.93 ($16.99 minus 18%) comes to a competitively priced $4.64 per sponge.

title: Hydrating but have no idea if it works; HATE the burnt coffee smell
text:
I am surprised at so many 5-star reviews. I tried this on my face and neck and it felt hydrating. It did not feel cooling to me and I have no idea if it calms sensitive skin. Initially, I thought it had a nice fragrance but after a few minutes, it smelled like burnt coffee. The odor is so repulsive to me, that I had to wash my face and neck to remove it. Even then the odor lingered. I absolutely HATE this due to the odor.

The current price is $32, which is expensive, especially if one can't use this.

title: Well-made back brush with long handle; not much bristle shedding; handle holds tape residue
text:
This brush has a large oval head with bristles and silicone massaging nubs. The bristles are a little coarse and there is not much bristle shedding. The handle is long, so it provides me with a good reach. I love the silicone grip at the top as it does not slip out of my hands. This brush is sturdy and is perfect for soaping up my back. I love that this is one piece and that the head does not come off. In addition, there is a loop for hanging.

In summary, this is a good back brush with long reach and exfoliating bristles. The current price of $14.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this. One thing I do not like is that the plastic cover over the bristles is taped to the wood and that leaves a mark as well as a sticky residue. I was able to remove it mostly but using the sticky side of tape to pick up the residue. They need to not use tape.

title: Smells terrific; super hydrates my skin and leaves a hydration barrier behind
text: If I could give this 10 stars I would. This cream is wonderful and has a fantastic fragrance. It is also thick like body butter but not greasy. It absorbs quickly, incredibly moisturizes my skin, and leaves a hydrating barrier behind. I LOVE THIS. Also the current price of $8 is reasonable for this 16 ounce jar.

title: Smells wonderful; feels hydrating; leaves skin silky & protected; unsure of its anti-sting ability
text:
The current price of $19.99 is pricey for this as it comes to $5 per ounce.

This is a really nice lightweight suntan lotion that is also super moisturizing. I love the fragrance but cannot describe it but it is more along the lines of talcum powder. The active ingredients are avobenzone 3%, homosalate 10%, octisalate 5%, and octocrylene 10%. What I find interesting about this lotion is that the active ingredients are exactly the same for both their SPF 50 one as it is for SPF 30. I would think the percentages were supposed to be different, but they are not as I have both bottles in front of me.

The SPF 30 provides good protection. It rubs into my skin easily, absorbs quickly, and I absolutely love the soft feel to my skin after absorption.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection, including this one.

Unfortunately, I have no idea if it lives up to its anti-sting claims.

title: Smells wonderful; feels hydrating; leaves skin silky & protected; unsure of its anti-sting ability
text:
The current price of $19.99 is pricey for this as it comes to $5 per ounce.

This is a really nice lightweight suntan lotion that is also super moisturizing. I love the fragrance but cannot describe it but it is more along the lines of talcum powder. The active ingredients are avobenzone 3%, homosalate 10%, octisalate 5%, and octocrylene 10%. The SPF 50 provides good protection. It rubs into my skin easily, absorbs quickly, and I absolutely love the soft feel to my skin after absorption.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection, including this one. I particularly like to use lotion designed for children.

Unfortunately, I have no idea if it lives up to its anti-sting claims.

title: Well-made, attractive, and functional pumice stone
text: This is a pumice stone with a handle and a rope hanging loop.  The stone functions well like any other stone I tried previously. I love that it has a handle because it provides a good grip with which to "file" my heels. The current price of $9.97 is reasonable for this quality foot scrubber.

title: Silicone back scrubber is junk but the puff is nice enough; PRICEY
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. This puff is medium in size and wound perfectly. It works like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. There is a ribbon on the end for hanging.

In addition to the mesh loofah, there is a silicone tipped back brush enclosed. That is just total garbage. The handle is short and the silicone "catches" on my skin and makes it hard to move it around. I hate it.

The current price of $12.99 comes to $6.50 per item which is extremely overpriced. I only like the puff and can buy one like it at my local store for less than $3.

title: Nice, colorful clips with a great hold & non-slip grip; best for thick long hair
text:
There are eight large claw clips in this package. The clips are colorful and sturdy. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center. What I really love is the matte finish and non-slip grip. That makes them easy to open.

At the current price of $8.99, ($12.99 minus $4), this comes to $1.13 cents per clip.

title: Interesting clips with non-slip matte finish; large; best for thick long hair; a bit tricky to open
text:
There are five large claw clips in this package. The clips are colorful and sturdy. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center. My only gripe is that they are a bit tricky to open because there are no "wings" or lip to hold onto to open.

What I really love about these clips is the matte non-slip (what feels like silicone) finish.

At the current price of $7.99 ($9.99 minus $2), it comes to $1.60 per clip which is reasonably priced.

title: Stylish neutral-colored clips with a great hold; best for thick long hair
text:
There are four large claw clips in this package. The clips are in basic colors and they are sturdy. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center.

At the current price of $12.99, it comes to $3.25 per clip which is on the high side of competitively price. However, I love the clips so much and they are so stylish, that they are nothing but 5 stars to me.

title: I am not impressed w/this ensemble; the packaging is the most impressive
text:
The title and description are misleading for this product. In a beautifully packaged box, one gets a 5.27 ounce pump bottle of shave cream and not very good shave cream at that. In fact, it does not have a silky and thick texture. The shave cream is such a light foam, like the foam I skim off the top of peach preserves when canning. The foam disintegrates almost immediately and barely anything is left behind for a good shave. I do love the scent of this, however.

Then there is also a 15ml bottle of aftershave that is scentless and feels like nothing going on after a shave. Normally aftershave feels tingly and refreshing, this does not. It is like dousing with water.

Next is a 5ml size woody and herbal scented repair lotion for the face. I love the thickness of this cream but it stinks and smells like bad coffee beans to me.

Finally, there is a 3ml dropper bottle of anti-aging serum. It is scentless to me and hydrating but not much else.

This entire set is disappointing. I thought it was mostly shave cream but it is other stuff neither I nor my boyfriend use and not very good products at that. However, the packaging is 10 stars but it is a gift that does not deliver.

title: These dense blenders work well but the brushes are impossible to use
text:
There are three blenders in this set and a compact brush two-in-one set. I love the sponges as they are dense. The two with the flat / angled side are great for smooth applications. The typical egg-shaped blender is good for blending or any large make-up application. Since these are dense, they do not soak up liquid foundation as much as others of lesser density.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin.

Unfortunately, the combo brush is horrible. In the one closed unit, I have to pull up the tab and push down to release the cover. Under the cover is a tiny brush that has to be angled up for use using the cover itself as the handle--definitely awkward. The bigger brush has nice bristles but I cannot get the brush to stay put. It keeps collapsing into the case. There does not seem to be a way to lock it in place.

As far as I am concerned there are only three usable pieces in this set and those are the blenders. At the current price of $9.99, that comes to $3.33 each. If all the pieces were usable, it would come to $2.50 each. This set is a disappointment to me.

title: Mild lather & hydrating; scents uninspiring; reminds me of Castile laundry soap bars
text:
There are a variety of three large bars of soap in this package (vanilla coconut & oats, peppermint coconut & lavender, and coconut ginger & lime). All the soaps smell pretty much the same to me and do not have the aroma of the name. I can't describe the smell except to say that these bars remind me of Castile laundry soap bars.

I tried the vanilla coconut & oats and the bar is slippery to hold. The lather is moderate but it is hydrating. I feel clean using this but am not crazy about the aroma.

At the current price of $29.95, this comes to $9.98 per bar which is on the high side of competitively priced. Each bar is 7 ounces (200 grams), so they are large but it is still expensive.

title: Beautiful & functional dual-sided brush; decent coverage for eyes not foundation
text:
This review is for the Flat Kabuki Foundation Brush (double-ended). This is a beautiful brush but to me it is better for eyeshadow or check highlighting. The larger end works well for blending eyeshadow powder over the lids and the smaller end works well for applying eyeshadow to the upper or lower lid but not the crease.

In summary, this is best for smaller applications like blush or eyeshadow. This brush feels great in my hands and is relatively easy to hold. The bristles do not shed. It is also soft against my skin.

The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced.

title: Unique design is helpful for a good grip; clippers are not as sharp as my regular ones
text:
There are two clippers and a tiny carry satchel in this set. The clippers can be used like regular clippers in the straight position or the head can be angled. I tried them on my toenails and it did take some getting used to the configuration to cut my nails. What I do love is that I have a better grip on the clipper due to the angle. However, I do not feel the cutting edge is sharp enough. My regular nail clippers are sharper or at least work like they feel sharper.

The current price of $14.99 comes to $7.50 per clipper.

title: Does not spread the lotion at all; foam will disintegrate over time; handle weak point
text:
This lotion applicator comes with a folding plastic handle and two rollers. I just forcefully pried open the handle and then slid the roller onto the track on top. I just use the release button to release the roller when I want.

I utterly dislike this and feel it is a waste of money after having tried this.

LIKES
- None

DISLIKES
- It does not work. All it did was soak up lotion and did not move it around on my body.

- At $20.39 ($23.99 minus 15%) this is outrageously priced.

- The foam rollers will disintegrate over time just like rubber bands.

- The handle has to be pried open with force and it feels like it is going to break. When collapsing it feels the same way.

I cannot recommend this. Applicators like [[ASIN:B093BF3FB3 this]] are far superior to this one, last for years, and cost much less.

title: Nice body brush but not as easy to hold as others I tried
text:
This "brush head" with a hanging loop is not as easy to hold as others I tried because there is no handle or cloth loop around the brush head. Nevertheless, this is still functional. The brush bristles are soft/medium and are sturdy enough to be exfoliating and cleaning yet somewhat gentle enough not to be irritating.

I love brushes like these as wet brushes for the shower even though these are not what they are designed for.

The current price of $12.99 is a bit pricey for this as there are others with a handhold that are much cheaper, such as this [[ASIN:B0B28QKRLN set]].

title: Basic trimmer but am not crazy about the “play” in the ON/OFF button
text:
[[VIDEOID:9d67c538f01da31ac9da512b473049d9]] This is a very basic trimmer that works as designed. It comes with a carry case, a base, USB charging cable (no A/C adapter), cleaning brush, the shaver unit, and a guide comb.

I charged this about two hours before use until it said 100%. It can be charged either on or off the base.  I then tried this both with and without the guide comb. I like using it on my boyfriend's sideburns without the comb. It gives a good shave then.

There are two things I do not like. First, I do not like the power button. Every time I press it, the case cover bends in. Also, it is tricky to use. I have to press hold to turn on the light. If I don't press hold again, then the light stays on after I turn off the unit. I just find ON/OFF operations tricky and something I have to get used to. In addition, I found the razor itself hard to reseat after cleaning it. Other than this, it works as designed.

The current price of $21.59 ($26.99 minus 20%) is competitively priced for this.

title: Excellent multi-purpose razor with four body groom accessories
text:
I am one of the very rare people that likes these types of small razors. I actually keep two of a smaller version of these type razors active at all times in both of my bathrooms.

This is a little better than my others and is an excellent 4-in-1 razor. It comes with four heads, a USB charging cable (A / C adapter NOT included), a cleaning brush, and a user pamphlet. I charged it for about two hours before the first use until all the lights stopped blinking.

HEADS
- A flat head for facial hairs.
- A bullet head for nose hairs.
- A thin comb style head for eyebrows.
- A long shaving head for body hair.

I tried all the heads. The only head that uses the extra base plate inserted onto the razor is the flat head. This base plate has to be removed for the other heads. Seating of the heads can be tricky but is made easier by lining up the arrows on the rim of the razor. All the heads work well for me. No electric razor gives a close shave but the results are good enough and are typical of what I expect from an electric razor. All I had to do was insert the head, press the power button, and shave.  I cleaned the heads after use. The large body hair razor comes apart for cleaning and there is a small foam piece inside. I made sure not to lose that.

What I don't like about this razor is that it can be tricky to get the heads seated and I hate the manual. The instructions are terrible. Other than this, I love this grooming kit and feel the current price of $22.69 is competitively priced for this. It is perfect for touch-up and very small shaving needs and shaves close enough but will never be as good as a manual straight edge razor.

title: Excellent body brush for wet or dry brushing; easy to hold
text:
This "brush head" is nicely crafted and the brush is easy to hold. I love that the rope for the handhold is not oversized like previous ones I tried.

The brush is one solid piece and has medium bristles that are sturdy enough to be exfoliating and cleaning yet somewhat gentle enough not to be irritating.

Also, I love brushes like these as a wet brush for the shower even though that is not what it is designed for.

The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced for this.

title: Does reduce wrinkle depth but this is only a partial eye cream – 2.5 stars
text:
When a product is advertised as an eye cream, I expect to be able to use it on my lids, under the brow, and under my eye. This cream CANNOT be used on the lids. It is a nice cream that appears to be scent free to me. It does tighten a bit to give an appearance of less wrinkles but I could not use this on the lids, which is a BIG disappointment to me.

At the current price of $33.60 ($42 minus 20%), this is competitively priced.

title: Typical oversized organza scrunchies
text:
There are four oversized organza scrunchies in this package. The material is not soft, nor should it be. The colors are muted and will go with almost any outfit. These stay in my hair but are best used by those with very long locks.

At the current price of $7.99 this comes to $2 per scrunchie which is a little bit pricey but still competitive.

title: Fragrant and hydrating face lotion – not just for men
text:
Although this is made for men, I got this for razor bumps at the bikini line. I used this on my face and at the bikini line. The lotion smells very nice and I did not have the usual amount of bumps at the bikini line. I also had no irritation from this product. I really love the moisturizing ability of this cream the best.

The current price of $8.33 ($10.42 minus 20%) is very reasonable for 3.5 fluid ounces.

title: Great lather, subtle scent, & doesn’t sting my eyes
text:
This baby body wash produces a good lather and does not sting my eyes, so it is perfect for a baby. The aroma is subtle and clean and I feel clean after using this.

The current price of $10.39 for 18 ounces is competitively priced.

title: I do not care for the lemongrass fragrance but the soap washes and lathers well
text:
There are six bars of Lemongrass soap in this set. The fragrance is a bit too Lemongrass strong but the soap washes and lathers well. I also like that the bar is hard. Some soaps are softer (like the boutique bar soaps) and this one holds its shape.

At the current price of $25.99, this comes to $4.33 per bar which is slightly pricey but still competitive. If I liked this fragrance, I would have given it 4 stars.

title: Intense musky floral fragrance; very nice
text:
This has an intense musky floral fragrance. I like it. The cap has an extension stick that can be used to apply this to the neck and wrists.

The current price of $23.95 is competitively priced. I do wish it came with a label or ingredients list. Although the satchel is nice, this is not giftable without it being fully labeled in a box. Also, the photo on the Amazon site shows two different bottles which makes it unclear which one (or both) someone is going to get. I took off one star for lack of box with ingredients list and ons star for the unclear listing.

title: Lotion smells incredible; leaves a hydration barrier on the skin; color stains
text:
Besides the violet lotion that comes in an 8 ounce pump bottle, a pen (annoying to use) and a sample serving of another body lotion is included. The body lotion smells fabulous. It is violet in color, absorbs mostly, and leaves a light hydration barrier on the skin. It is also vegan and has none of the fragrances listed on the front in the ingredients list. It also lists at boutique pricing of $16.95, which comes to $2.12 per ounce.

The light violet color does stain. I also used the pink sample lotion and that stained my white underclothes a light pink in spots. I believe it will wash off. If it doesn't, I'll update my review.

UPDATE Sept 23, 2022 - I finally finished this lotion. The staining does appear to wash off. What is weird is that a stone is in the bottle. As I was using the last of this a purplish black stone fell out, which I found weird and did not expect.

title: A precision tweezer set with a crooked strap on the case – 4.5 stars
text:
There are four different types of tweezers with a case that has a crooked front strap. They are:
- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they surprisingly work with absolute precision. I am truly impressed.

The current price of $6 ($11.99 minus 50%) is excellent for this as well. Note that the case has an extra folder pocket behind the tools in case someone wants to store some bills or files behind the tweezers.

title: Very nice brushes but hate the foul smell of the case
text:
There are 13 make-up brushes in this set along with a very foul-smelling case.

The brush bristles are soft and there was no shedding. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously.

This set has all the brushes I needed except for a fan brush and lip liner brush. There are several for foundation, cheek powder, eyeshadow, and lips or cream eyeshadow. Thankfully, the brushes do not smell to me but the case is so offensive, that it almost ruins this set. The current price of $18.19 ($25.99 minus 30%) comes to $1.40 per brush and I am not counting the case. This price is certainly excellent and the brushes are very good for the price but I just wish the case was not so stinky.

title: Highly fragrant bath bombs; plastic egg surprise; decent performance
text:
[[VIDEOID:597ac176d11410bc58188c91da6b9894]] There are five small, highly fragrant, and individually wrapped bath bombs for kids in this set, along with a squeaky dinosaur toy. There are also a plastic dino surprise in each bomb.
