I tried the hot pink bath bomb.The fragrance is outstanding and the suds mediocre. Although, the bomb dissolved in a couple of minutes in my foot bath, it is the fragrance I love most. There was a tiny plastic ball with a little dino inside (see photo). These balls are a choking hazard so I would not let children under 4 years use these without supervision.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I use them in a foot bath. This bomb turned the water hot pink and that color did not adhere to my skin, foot bath, or my towels.

The current price of $9.96 comes to $1.99 per bath bomb. This set is nice for children and even for adults who are young at heart. However, do supervise due to the ball surprise that is enclosed. Note that it also comes in a nice tin. Also note that what is pictured on the Amazon site is not exactly what is received with regard to the tin design and big toy color.

title: Solid glides on and protects me for 12 hours until my next shower; love the citrusy fragrance
text:
I love intense fragrance and specifically love men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. However, this stick does not have that ingredient but still protects me for 12 hours until my next shower.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. The citrus and eucalyptus fragrance is very nice and smells mostly citrusy.

The current price of $15 is really boutique pricing for this 3-ounce stick. Protection-wise this works even though it is aluminum free. This is also labeled vegan and cruelty free. I love the fragrance as well.

title: Solid glides on and protects me for 12 hours until my next shower; wish fragrance was stronger
text:
I love intense fragrance and specifically love men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. However, this stick does not have that ingredient but still protects me for 12 hours until my next shower.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. The sandalwood and black pepper fragrance is not as powerful as I would like, however. Nevertheless, this works.

The current price of $15 is really boutique pricing for this 3-ounce stick. Protection-wise this works even though it is aluminum free. This is also labeled vegan and cruelty free.If the fragrance were stronger, this would have received 4 stars from me.

title: Lovely body cream; absorbs instantaneously & leaves silky skin behind
text: At the current price of $30, this is very expensive moisturizing cream. However, it is lightweight, absorbs instantaneously, and leaves my skin feeling silky. It has a clean scent too. I love it!

title: Medium-sized buff puffs that create copious suds and are perfectly wound
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are medium in size. There are four puffs in various colors. They work like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. They are wound moderately, which I consider absolutely perfect. There is a ribbon on the end for hanging.

In addition to the four mesh loofahs, there is a silicone brush enclosed. It is a nice brush but I have several in service already like this brush to clean vegetables and pick up cat hair off material. I do not use them for washing. This will get put to the side for future use.

The current price of $9.99 comes to a reasonable $2 per item since there are 5 items. The combination of the good price and perfect puffs has me rating this 5 stars.

title: Nice surprise inside but ZERO performance
text:
[[VIDEOID:7d36fadf815b1780d22596256c577865]] There are 12 colored and individually wrapped bath bombs in this set in different fragrances. Each bath bomb contains a surprise. The one I tried had what looked like a soft shark inside (see photo) and I suspect the others have a similar prize.

The fragrances are subtle and smell only slightly different to me. The fragrances are lily, eucalyptus, mint, lavender, rose, tea tree, lemon, green apple, orange, ocean, blueberry, and chamomile.

I decided to try the lily. The bomb dissolved in less than 45 seconds and did not fizz. All it did was turn the water an orange color like Tang and pop out the prize. It gets zero stars for performance. The prize is nice and I suppose kids will like this, but I would take a pass. It also lacks any aroma in the bath.

Although the water turned orange, that color did not stain my feet, my towel, or my foot bath.

In summary, these are non-performing bath bombs but youngers kids would might like them due to the surprise. My recommendation is to pass on these. At the current price of $19.99, this comes to $1.67 per bath bomb.

title: Small & cute foot file; hold like a computer mouse - too pricey
text:
For the current price of $15.99 this is a very expensive foot file that is overpriced by about $11. If it were priced $6 or less, this would have received 5 stars. I doubt this cost more than $1.50 to make as it is cheaply made.

In order to use this, I have to hold this in my right hand like a computer mouse by grasping the outside and placing my forefinger in the center. This works gently but effectively on the dry skin on my heels. If held correctly, this file is relatively easy to hold and easy to work with. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler.

This is a cute foot file but it is way too expensive for what it is.

title: Clean fragrance, washes and lathers well
text:
There are six bars of Juniper and Sandalwood soap in this set. The fragrance is clean and it washes and lathers well. I also like that the bar is hard. Some soaps are softer (like the boutique bar soaps) and this one holds its shape.

At the current price of $25.99, this comes to $4.33 per bar which is slightly pricey but still competitive.

title: Medium-sized buff puffs that create copious suds and are tightly wound
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are medium in size. There are three puffs. They work like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. They are wound tightly and I prefer a looser winding. However, these will loosen use. There is a ribbon on the end for hanging.

The current price of $8.99 comes to a slightly pricey $3 per puff. I do wish they were a little loosely wound and a little larger but I love them.

title: Very nice, lightweight cream with fresh scent; comes in a beautiful jar
text: This is a very nice, lightweight cream with a fresh scent. It goes on smoothly, absorbs rapidly, and leaves my face and neck feeling hydrated with a slight feeling of a hydration barrier on my skin. It also comes in a beautiful jar. The current price of $54.14 ($56.99 minus 5%) is pricey for this, however. This cream is good for all seasons

title: Nice fragrance; goes on shiny but rubs in easily; has direct stream
text:
This is a nice light and shiny suntan lotion that sprays on easily and rubs and absorbs well. I like the fragrance. I usually do not like sprays because they go everywhere but this has a more direct stream.

Per the bottle, it is free of oxybenzone, octinoxate, dyes, and PABA. It is water resistant up to 80 minutes but I did not test that claim. It also provides broad spectrum SPF 50 protection and supposedly stops up to 98% of the UV rays. The active ingredients are avobenzone 3%, homosalate 10%, octisalate 5%, and octocrylene 5%.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection. The current price of $7.99 for a 5.5 ounce can of SPF 50 spray suntan lotion is competitively priced.

title: Lovely eye cream in a pump bottle; leaves a hydration barrier on my lids
text:
I love this eye cream as it is moderately thick, glides on easily, absorbs quickly, and is super hydrating. It also leaves a hydration barrier on my lids and is very smoothing. 

The current price of $65 is super expensive for 0.5 fluid ounces. Although I would normally deduct one star for such a high price, I did not do that because I love the cream so much.

title: Two brushes (one stiff / one soft) with two hooks
text:
There are two "brush heads" with a rope that allows my hand to slip through for easy gripping.

One brush has soft bristles and the other medium bristles. The bristles that are sturdy enough to be exfoliating and cleaning yet somewhat gentle enough not to be irritating.

I love brushes like these as wet brushes for the shower even though these are not what they are designed for.

The hooks have an adhesive for hanging from the cloth hand loop.

The current price of $3 ($5.99 minus 50%) is a steal for these but I bet that price won't last long. These are not top quality but they are not bad either at that price.

title: Sticky – I do not care for this at all; price is insane
text: This smells like old citrus and the lotion is of medium thickness and dries sticky. I do not like this at all. The current price of $74.99 is insane.

title: Provides good powder blush/foundation coverage; bristles do not shed; small handle
text:
This brush is great. It provides good powder blush and powder foundation coverage. I prefer it for setting (a.k.a. finishing) powder or powder bronzer. I also love that the synthetic bristles do not fall out. The only negative is that the tiny nub of a handle is harder to hold than a typical foundation brush. Other than this, this brush is lovely.

The current price of $11.99 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Very nice eye cream in a pump bottle; I can do w/o the massager; pricey
text: I love this eye  cream as it is thick, goes on easily, absorbs quickly, and is super hydrating. I have no use for the eye massager wand, especially when no instructions are provided. I say do away with the wand and charge less than the current price of $48.98, which I consider pricey for this 0.5 fluid ounce pump bottle.

title: First Pumice stone arrived cracked but vendor sent replacement - 4.5 stars
text:
SEE UPDATE AT END:

This is a double-sided foot brush with one side a brush and the other a pumice stone. Unfortunately, my pumice arrived cracked/broken and it also looked a little bit used. The box arrived smashed up too. If this did not arrive cracked, it would have received 4 or 5 stars from me at the current price of $9.97.

UPDATE - The vendor contacted me due to the broken pumice and sent me a perfect replacement (see latest photos). As a result, I changed my ranking from 2 to 4.5 stars and rounded up to 5 stars. Note that I've been using the other one. The brush is on the softer side and I did lose one tiny bristle, but it functions well otherwise and the price is reasonable.

title: Manual operation; barely cuts; pinches while it cuts---a conversation piece
text:
For the current price of $27.80 ($34.75 minus 20%), one gets a hefty but barely functional conversation piece. There is one manual nose trimmer in a very unusually designed but very giftable box. The problem is, I tried it and it pinches as it is cutting the hairs and doesn't do a very good job of it.

The tiny cap has to be unscrewed and the tiny nozzle inserted up the nose. Once that is done, the user has to pinch the two circular buttons on both sides of the trimmer. The hairs get pulled (hence the pinching) as it tries to cut them. Then the user moves the trimmer a little bit over and repeats the process. I did this and found this to be an unpleasant and unsuccessful experience. This can also be used for long ear hairs. Thankfully, I am not endowed with those.

I got this for my boyfriend as he is always complaining about long nose and ear hairs. However, he is unable to operate this because he has Parkinson's and has dexterity issues using his hands. Had I realized this was not battery operated, I would have never ordered it. It is like a dull nail clipper for the nose hairs.

This is definitely a gorgeous and attractive conversation piece but I consider this almost non-functional expensive art.

title: Solid goes on thick and a bit sticky; fragrance is very nice to my senses
text:
I love intense fragrance and specifically love men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. However, this stick does not have that ingredient but still protects me for 12 hours until my next shower.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. The bergamot, geranium, and lavender blend is a very nice blended fragrance.

What I really do not care for is that this goes on thick and the solid is softer than some other deodorants, so the balm gets all over the outside lip. It also feels a bit sticky to me but that feeling goes away. Nevertheless, this keeps me pretty much odorless (other than the wonderful fragrance) between showers, which means it works.

The current price of $11.95 is really boutique pricing for this 2.65-ounce stick. Protection-wise this works even though it is aluminum and paraffin free. It contains only eight ingredients: coconut oil, aluminum free baking soda, arrowroot powder, beeswax, shea butter, geranium, bergamot, and lavender essential oils.

title: Cute, portable, and functional hair brush; brush rake okay
text:
This is a nice, cute, small brush for young children or for young-at-heart adults that want to travel with a small brush. The handle is small and the head is cute, circular, and looks like a cat's face. The brush glides easily through my short to medium-length curly hair when both dry or wet. I like that there are both boar bristles and nylon ones together as it helps to detangle my hair.

This comes with a clothy carry case that fits the entire brush except for the very smallest tip of the handle. It also comes with a brush cleaner that actually works better than others I tried previously but is still just okay.

The current price of $9.88 ($12.88 minus $3) is reasonable for this.

title: These bandages have many uses; sticks to itself and not to skin or fur; not only tattoo grip tape
text:
These bandages have many uses. There are 6 black rolls that are individually wrapped and each roll is 5 yards apiece and 2 inches tall. These self-adhere as the bandage is wrapped around a hand, leg, arm, etc. This sticks well to itself. The stretch allows this to be used like kinesiology tape with the exception that one cannot shower with this successfully and each wrap is for one-time use. There are just so many useful possibilities besides using this as tattoo grip tape. Tattoo grip tape is used to cushion the grip on tattoo grip tubes to provide the artist with a more comfortable grip.

The entire roll does not have to be used at once as it depends on the amount needed. This is perfect to use as a lightweight version of a carpal tunnel brace by wrapping it around a bad wrist, hand, and thumb as I did in the photo. It does not stick to my skin nor to a pet's fur, which is wonderful. It is also versatile enough to wrap around the handle of a tennis racquet to get a good grip or an umbrella or cane handle.

In summary, this is not only good as tattoo grip tape. I feel these are good bandages to also have in one's medicine cabinet. At the current price of $8.49 ($9.99 minus 15%) comes to $1.42 per roll. Realize that most bandages like these sell for $.80 cents per roll, so this is a bit on the high side.

title: Excellent brush for applying full face translucent powder
text:
I love this brush for applying finishing powder (translucent powder) to my face which helps set make-up. I also love that the bristles are soft and do not fall out of the brush like some other brushes I tried previously.

The current price of $12.74 ($14.99 minus 15%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Large-sized buff puffs that create copious suds and are tightly wound
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are large in size. There are four puffs in various pinkish/red/orange colors. They work like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. They are wound tightly and I prefer a looser winding. However, these will loosen use. There is a ribbon on the end for hanging.

The current price of $12.99 comes to a slightly pricey $3.25 per puff. I can get puffs of this size for $3 or less at my local store. Although I wish they were a little loosely wound, I love them and they are excellent.

title: Small bar; hardly any lather; nothing special; bar arrived w/partial fingerprint on it; PRICEY
text:
At the current price of $11.99, this small bar of soap is way too expensive. I do like the earthy aroma of the soap. However, there is hardly any lather and lather is very important to me. It cleans but is nothing special.

Note that my bar (see photo) arrived with an indentation with a fingerprint on it along the edge as if it was touched heavily when it was molded.

title: Four nice scents that subtly come through in the shower; crumbles out of package - 2.5 stars
text:
I've been disappointed with shower steamers and I have tried many. However, these do have a subtle smell in the shower.

There are 16 steamers in this package in 8 colors, and 4 fragrances (Jasmine, Mint, Marshmallow Rose, & Eucalyptus). Unfortunately, the steamers crumble when extracting from the package--at least mine do. Each tablet is half the size of a hockey puck. I elevated this tablet in the shower and let the steam and water droplets hit it. It slowly dissolved and leaked an electric purplish pink color all over my tub that (thankfully) washed away with little effort.

I have the nose of a bloodhound and I did detect some fragrance. The Jasmine scent came through until I used my highly fragrant soap, after which the aroma faded into the background. I then decided to dissolve this in the bottom of my shower as if it were a bath bomb. There was no change in aroma.

This dissolved entirely before I was done with my shower. I already wash my hair and soap up my body with very fragrant shampoo and bath soap, so there really is no need for a steamer in my shower. These are best for people who use scentless soaps on their body but want some fragrance in the shower.

In summary, these smell good dry and have a nice scent when wet as long as one does not use fragrant shampoos and body wash. However, the scent is subtle in the shower. At the current price of $13.99 for 16 tablets, this comes to almost $0.88 per steamer. These are not bad but not great; however, they are better than most but not good enough for me to enjoy.

title: Smells nice; leaves my skin feeling silky; VEGAN & not tested on animals; PRICEY
text: This cream is vegan and not tested on animals. It is creamy, lightweight, and has a lovely scent. It is also hydrating, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling silky. However, the current price of $25.50 for a 3.53 ounce pump bottle is very pricey.

title: Functional foundation blush that is a work of art even though it is plastic
text:
I love this brush for applying finishing powder (translucent powder) to my face which helps set make-up.It is also good for creams. I also love that the bristles are soft, densely packed, and do not fall out of the brush like some other brushes I tried previously.

This is also a work of art to me. The swan image is just gorgeous even though it is molded of very cheap plastic as the neck and head are its most breakable points.

The current price of $9.99 is pricey for this but it is a bit unique.

title: Lovely soap with great lather and nice fragrance; a tad pricey
text: This soap is wonderful, creamy, with a great lather and has a nice fragrance. It is also a generous hockey-puck size and easy to hold in the shower. I love it. The color is a sage green and not tan as the photo shows on the Amazon site. If this were priced at $5.99 or less, it would have received 5 stars. At the current price of $7.99, I consider this a tad pricey.

title: Stunning clips with a great hold; very stylish
text:
There are six claw clips in this package. The clips are absolutely stunning with their marbleized look and very sturdy. They are large-sized and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on. They would work even better with longer hair.

At the current price of $13.29 ($13.99 minus 5%) it comes to a reasonably priced $2.22 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well. I just wish they came in a better box.

title: Excellent tweezers; the entire set is perfectly aligned
text:
This tweezer set is excellent. There are four different types of tweezers in the case. They are:

- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

The slant tip is not much different from the flat tip and the slant is ever so slight. I expected more of an angle. The point slant is my favorite and does a fantastic job of extracting hairs.

I tried all four and they worked perfectly. The ends are perfectly aligned so that I can easily pull any wayward hairs with any of these four implements. The case has an open front and a nice alligator look to it.

The current price of $9.99 is reasonable for this tweezer set. My most favorite set of all, however, is this [[ASIN:B08RX9FJBD PAFASON Precision Tweezer Kit]] I use regularly. That set costs the same as this and has a better case and a slant tip tweezer with slightly more slant.

title: Barely any scent in the shower; fizzes like a bath bomb; hate the particles down my drain
text:
There are six steamers in this package in Strawberry, Lavender, Vanilla, Peppermint, Eucalyptus, and Rose. Each tablet is half the size of a hockey puck. I tried the rose and elevated this tablet in the shower and let the steam and water droplets hit it. It slowly dissolved and leaked a bright pink color all over my tub that (thankfully) washed away with little effort. However, since there are particles in the bomb, those particles (rose petals, etc.) washed down my drain and I hate that. It is important to have a fine strainer over the drain with these.

I have the nose of a bloodhound and I could not detect any scent. I could barely detect the scent before I put it in the shower. I then decided to dissolve this in the bottom of my shower as if it were a bath bomb. I still barely detected a fragrance. This did nothing for me. I already wash my hair and soap up my body with very fragrant shampoo and bath soap, so there is no need for a steamer in my shower.

At the current price of $7.99 for 6 tablets, this comes to a reasonable $1.33 per steamer if they worked.

title: Barely any scent when dry; no scent in the shower; dissolves like a bath bomb but takes longer
text:
There are 12 steamers in this package in 6 scents of Jasmine, Lavender, Rosemary, Orange, Vanilla, and Rose. Each tablet is half the size of a hockey puck. I elevated this tablet in the shower and let the steam and water droplets hit it. It slowly dissolved and leaked a pale green color all over my tub that (thankfully) washed away with little effort.

I have the nose of a bloodhound and I could not detect any scent. I could barely detect the scent before I put it in the shower. I then decided to dissolve this in the bottom of my shower as if it were a bath bomb. I still barely detected a fragrance. Why anyone would use something like this is beyond me, especially when very little fragrance is present. I already wash my hair and soap up my body with very fragrant shampoo and bath soap, so there is no need for a steamer in my shower.

Nevertheless, this lasted two showers but did nothing for me.

At the current price of $15.99 for 12 tablets, this comes to a reasonable $1.33 per steamer if they worked.

title: One is not the flavor advertised; I also only liked one of the three balms
text:
This is a very nice set of three lip balms in a round tin that is marked $6 (via a sticker) for resale. It might be geared toward kids but I got them for me because I love fun flavors. The balm goes on smoothly and is moisturizing. I felt like it provided a nice hydrating barrier on my lips.

There are three flavors and I tried all of them but only liked the candy cane. The other two tasted horrible and burnt. The Amazon site says that the flavors are gingerbread, caramel, and candy cane. There is no caramel. Instead it is butterscotch.

The current price of $4.98 is pricey for this especially when it is marked $6 for retail; otherwise this is a reasonable price if one loves the flavors. I do love that it comes with its own storage tin.

title: Smells wonderful; like talcum powder; super hydrating; leaves my skin silky & protected
text:
I have no idea how much this will cost but my five-star rating is based on a price of $12 or less for this 1.69 fluid ounce tube.

This is a really nice lightweight suntan lotion that is also super moisturizing. I love the fragrance as it reminds me of talcum powder. The active ingredients are avobenzone 2.5%, homosalate 9%, octocrylene 9%, and octisalate 4.5%. The SPF 50 provides good protection. It rubs into my skin easily, absorbs quickly, and I absolutely love the silky feel to my skin after absorption.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection, including this one.

title: What a cutie; simple 450F fix temp curling iron w/tight barrel clip
text:
This is an absolute cutie. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this iron allows me to get a decent curl that sticks. There is no temperature control as it is set at a fixed temperature of 450 degrees Fahrenheit. Just slide the OFF switch to ON, wait a few minutes, and then styl away. The kickstand is decent but mostly touches the hot barrel. There's a cool touch tip that moves/turns to avoid burns. I do love the 360 degree swivel cord ability as it keeps it from tangling although there is no loop at the base of the cord for hanging. I did not expect it to have a loop since this is a mini. What I really love is that the clip for the barrel is SUPER TIGHT and holds my hair exceptionally well. In fact, there is the only curling iron I ever tested that has such a good grip. I love that.

In summary, this one inch iron is perfect for slightly short to medium hair. It is extremely portable. The current price of $18.39 ($22.99 minus 20%) is competitively priced. I do wish it came with a velvet cloth satchel for travelling but it does not. I love the baby pink metallic barrel and how simple this is to operate and how well it performs. However, do realize that if one needs a lower temperature than 450 degrees Fahrenheit then look for something else.

title: Love the colors in this sponge set; sponge texture is dense; metal holder is great
text:
This is a lovely set of three sponges in the Easter color of hot pink. It also comes with a great metal sponge holder. The sponges are dense unlike most sponges like this on the market. As a result, liquid make-up does not soak in as easily.

One sponge with a flat side is great for smooth applications. The typical egg-shaped and the hour-glass sponges are good for blending or any large make-up application. The hour-glass one is easy to hold in the center.

These feel good in my hands, blend reasonably well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar in style to all of the others that I tried before this with the exception that the sponges are on the dense side instead of airy. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too - at least to me. This color also makes it perfect for the Easter Basket and I like that each one is encased in its own plastic carton.

At the current price of $11.99 this is on the high side of competitively priced as it comes to $3 per item (3 sponges and a metal holder).

title: Basic foundation set; definitely NOT giftable - 2.5 stars
text:
These arrived all squished in a plastic bag. In fact, I could not get the creases out of the brush or sponge. This set includes three synthetic blush brushes, two larger hand held kabuki brushes for foundation that each come with their own case, four blender spongers each with a flat angle, and one oval powder brush which is my favorite.

The blenders are good with liquids and the rest of the brushes are good with powder. I like the larger brushes for dusting on translucent powder or bronzer. I prefer using everything but the blenders with powders only.

This is a basic set but the presentation is awful and definitely not giftable.

For someone who likes to change their brushes and blenders frequently, this is an okay set. However, the current price of $21.98 is too pricey for this as it comes to $2.20 per item for this 10-piece set. I expect better for that price.

title: Simple but heavy blow dryer; works well
text:
In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user guide, two concentrators (one narrow and one wide), and a diffuser.

Besides the RESET button on the plug, there is a slider for cool dry, warm (47C / 116.6F) and hotter (65C / 149F) air dry. A quick press of the cool shot button provides cool wind.

The tools snap screw on and off the head of the unit moderately well but can be tricky. It is important to line up the lock notations.

Note that the cord is not a swivel cord but I find that is not needed. There is a loop at the end of the cord for hanging. The only true negative to me is that the unit is heavy.

In summary, I love the results this dryer provides. It dried my hair quickly and beautifully without the frizz. I have short to medium fine curly hair and it looked good after using this. I love the simplicity of this unit.

The current price of $31.15 ($44.50 minus 30%) is priced right for this.

title: Large-sized buff puffs that create copious suds and are perfectly wound
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are large in size or what the vendor refers to as extra large. There are three puffs. They work like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. They are wound perfectly meaning the mesh is not too loose and not too tight. There is a ribbon on the end for hanging.

The current price of $12.99 comes to an expensive $4.33 per puff. I can get puffs of this size for $3 or less at my local store and that is the only reason I took off one star. Otherwise, I love these and they are excellent.

title: Delicious flavors of lip balm in a very nice tin; flavors not as listed
text:
This is a very nice set of six lip balms. It might be geared toward kids but I got them for me because I love fun flavors. The balm goes on smoothly and is moisturizing. I felt like it provided a nice hydrating barrier on my lips.

There are six flavors (see below) and I tried the orange creme delight, which tastes delicious.

Winter Berry Frost
Strawberry Glow
Frozen Banana Pop
Mint to be Together
Blueberry Icy Pop
Orange Creme Delight

Note that the flavors listed on the Amazon site differ COMPLETELY than what is actually received. The Amazon site says the flavors are cool vanilla mint, chilled cranberry grape, strawberry shake, ice pop, berry slush, and coconut snowball. The flavors received are COMPLETELY different. I would have rated this 5 stars if the flavors were advertised correctly as I love this set.

The current price of $3.90 ($5.20 minus 25%) is super reasonable as it comes to $0.65 cents per lip balm. I also love that it comes with its own storage tin.

title: Delicious flavors of lip balm in a very nice tin
text:
This is a very nice set of 10 lip balms. It might be geared toward kids but I got them for me because I love fun flavors. The balm goes on smoothly and is moisturizing. I felt like it provided a nice hydrating barrier on my lips.

There are 10 flavors (see below) and I tried the strawberry, which tastes delicious.

Jolly Soda Pop
Gingerbread
Candy Cane
Butterscotch
Candy Apple
Holiday Punch
Cherry Kiss
Strawberry Love
Vanilla Bean
Lime Soda Pop

The current price of $7.24 is super reasonable as it comes to $0.72 cents per lip balm. I also love that it comes with its own storage tin.

Note that this must be for resale because the tin had an $11 price tag on it.

title: Hydrating cream w/a subtly nice scent; my face/neck feels incredibly moisturized & silky soft
text: I can't believe this face cream is just $9.99. This is super hydrating and leaves my face and neck feeling incredibly moisturized and silky soft. I also like the nice scent and the thickness. This cream is perfect for winter and fall.

title: Kids will love these; they perform well but are color staining
text:
[[VIDEOID:a1eec2a86be0cdc337f778b875116fe5]] There are nine colored individually wrapped bear-shaped bath bombs in this set in different fragrances and a baby girl's bracelet (see photo). Each bath bomb contains a surprise. The one I tried had a little clear bear in it (see photo) and I suspect the others have the same prize.

The fragrances are subtle and smell only slightly different to me. The fragrances are lavender, chocolate, rose oil, coconut, lemon, green apple, blueberry, chamomile, and strawberry.

I decided to try the blueberry. The bomb dissolved in about 5 minutes and had a good performance of suds (bubbles) that lasted about 10 minutes along with the mild fragrance. The water turned a smurf blue and that color bleed stained my feet and my towels and would have stained my foot bath if it weren't for the fact that the bath container was the same color blue as the bear. A loose clear bear was in the water so be careful not to let them escape down the drain.

In summary, these are good performing bath bombs and kids would love them. Except for the bracelet, these bombs can be used for boys or girls that are three years of age or above. Of course, the bears have a hole to attach to the bracelet but that is not necessary if used for a boy. If these did not stain, they would have received five stars from me. The current price of $21.99 comes to $2.44 per bath bomb which is competitively priced for these type of bombs.

title: 16 lovely headbands in earth tone colors
text:
The colors and design of these 16 headbands are subtle but attractive in what I call earth tones. They are all wide and have a "knot" in the middle that can be worn in the center of the head or at the base of the neck. I personally do not like knots in my headbands but these are versatile enough to position the knot away from the forehead without losing the good look of the band.

The colors are nice and the bands stretch to fit my head. They all feel great on my head and around my ears and they stay put.

Also, the current price of $16.99 comes to a reasonable $1.06 per band.

title: Smells great dry but there's barely any scent in the shower; last two showers
text:
There are eight steamers (jasmine eucalyptus, mint , lavender, rose, chamomile, lemon, grapefruit, and rosemary) in this package. Each tablet is the size of a hockey puck but half the height. These smell absolutely fantastic dry (except for the grapefruit) but in the shower I barely smell anything until I turn the water off.

I kept this tablet in the shower away from the direct stream of water. It slowly dissolves but it is not noticable and one tablet lasts me two showers. I tried the Jasmine and it did not stain my tub.

I have the nose of a bloodhound and I could barely detect any scent. Why anyone would use something like this is beyond me, especially when very little fragrance is present. I already wash my hair and soap up my body with very fragrant shampoo and bath soap, so there is no need for a steamer in my shower.

At the current price of $16.99 ($19.99 minus 15%) for eight tablets, this comes to a pricey $2.12 per steamer which I consider an expensive mistake. Note that they come with a mesh bag for the steamer and a plastic cutter.

title: Basic manicure set; tweezer no good & cuticle nipper has slippery handle; scissors cut well
text:
This set contains more implements than I will ever use.

For the current price of $16.14 ($16.99 minus 5%) one gets 20 tools with a beautiful blue case. However, this is not a high end set but many of the tools work. The nail cutters are sharp and the scissors cut. Unfortunately, the cuticle nipper works but feels cheap and the blue paint on the handle makes it slippery to use. The tweezers are precisely aligned but they do not work well at all because the tips are too flimsy and the curve of the grip is not right. It will only work on the biggest hairs.

There are some items in this set that I will never use (such as the heel scraper blade and ear picks, which seem to be all the rage these days). It is a good basic set except the two most used implements do not work for me. They do include a tool list with the manicure set, so if one needs an acne needle or ear spoon, this set has that.

If it were not for the two poor tools, I would have rated this 4 stars. This set is very functional otherwise and comes in a zippered and very presentable carry case.

title: Bottle design a nice idea but not practical; shampoo/conditioner very nice
text:
The bottle design is a nice idea but it is not practical for several reasons. First, the bottle is easier to tip over due to the hourglass design. Second, as the product is used, the design does not allow the product for both items to pool toward the spout. Instead, one is either waiting for the shampoo or conditioner to be dispensed depending on which one was face down first. However, it does seem that the bottles can be separated at the seam.

The shampoo and conditioner are very nice. I like the fresh fragrance, the lather, and how well it cleans. I also like how soft it leaves my hair when dry. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this did weigh down my curls a little bit.

The current price of $13.20 ($22 minus 40%) comes to $6.60 per bottle which is reasonably priced. Note that I also like the blue case it comes in.

title: Incredibly soft potholder-sized washcloths (5” x 5”) with hanging loop; has other uses
text:
These washcloths remind me of super-soft potholders as that is exactly what they look like. There are 12 in this set. They work well as a washcloth. There is no lather to any washcloth and these are no exception. However, these are super soft on the face. I also like that I can hang this in the shower via the attached loop. In addition, they wash well in the washer BUT I lay them flat to dry because I feel the dryer would destroy the material.

Besides acting as washcloths, since there are so many I also use them as soft spacers between delicate dishes to prevent breakage. I suspect these can be used to wash delicate dishes as well if washing by hand. They are small at 5" x 5" but they are easier to handle than a regular washcloth when washing my face.

The current price of $7.19 ($7.99 minus 10%) is reasonable for this set as it comes to $.60 cents per cloth.

title: Smells like typical tea tree oil; lathers & cleans well; moisturizing too
text: This bar has tea tree oil in it, which gives it its antifungal properties. It definitely has that medicinal aroma that is exactly like tea tree oil should smell. It cleans and lathers well and is also a bit moisturizing.  The current price of $9.98 for two smally bars is competitively priced as it comes to $4.99 each bar.

title: Excellent large-sized but not XL buff puffs that create copious suds that are tightly wound
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are large and similar to the ones I buy at Walmart for $2 each. There are four puffs and they work like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. They are wound tightly meaning the mesh has not much give until after it is used awhile. I like when they loosen up a bit.

I love the colors of these four puffs. However, I consider them large and not XL.

The current price of $11.99 comes to a pricey $3 per puff.

title: Thin hair towel and thin exfoliating glove; functional but not high quality - 2.5 stars
text:
I am not impressed by this towel and glove. These items are functional but they are not the best quality.

The towel is large and thin. It has a button and small cloth loop at the tail that allows me to twist the turban and then secure the excess to the back button. However, since this is large, there is a little play in the turban and it is not as tight as I would like. It is absorbent, however.

The exfoliating glove is scratchy, or a bit rough, and very thin. This also works but it is not high quality.

Overall, I am not impressed by this set. They are functional and work as designed, so in that sense they are okay. I personally consider [[ASIN:B09VL1JQGF these]] Poday towels exceptional compared to this--of course, those do not come with an exfoliating glove but then one gets two towels for almost the same price minus the glove. The current price of $9.99 is insane for this.

title: Hydrating hand and body lotion but smells a little like a new shower curtain - 2.5 stars
text:
I know this is marketed to men but I love men's products and use them regularly.

This is a body lotion (6.5 fluid ounces) and hand lotion (2.5 fluid ounces) combo pack. Both lotions are thick and moisturizing with the hand lotion the thickest. However, I do not like the fragrance at all as it smells a little bit like a new plastic shower curtain.

The current price of $29.90 is pricey for this duo.

title: Relaxed my curls but did not straighten them
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this straightener only relaxed my curls. There are two sides. The long tines on the scalp guard is to protect the scalp from high heat but it also prevented my hair from straightening. The small back teeth help to straighten my hair a bit better as that straightens it from the roots. However, it turned my curly locks into a curly wave.

Besides the unit itself, there are two anti-scald combs of the exact same size (one is already installed). It is a bit difficult to pop it off (see photo). The temperature gauge is a dial that goes from 200 to 500 degrees Fahrenheit. There is no way to know when it reaches the appropriate temperature but the manual says to wait two to three minutes. The on/off button is at the end of the handle. The cord swivels 360 degrees to prevent tangling.

What I do like about this is that it warms my dry hair and just makes my hair feel good. However, for a true straightening, I would pass on this. It is great as a warm comb and turns curly hair into wavy hair; at least it did that to my fine curly hair.

The current price of $28.99 ($31.99 minus $3) is competitively priced for this.

title: Love the blenders; sponges are okay and need water to expand; not giftable
text:
This set arrived all messed up in the box with the center of the box broken. For that reason, I would not consider this giftable as the box is a little too big for the contents, so it just moves around.

There are six blenders with two of each color (black, yellow, pink) in two sizes. There are also 40 sponges that expand when wet.

All the blenders are egg-shaped, which is the most typical blending sponge on the market. These are good for make-up application particularly liquid foundation since they are dense. The tiny ones are perfect for my eyes. They feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. The blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed and since they are in clear egg cases, they can be separated and used for stocking stuffers or Easter baskets.

The sponges I do not care for. I originally thought these were regular circular make-up sponges but these are more for make-up removal and washing one's face. They need to be wet with water to expand and use.

The current price of $13.99 ($19.99 minus 30%) is competitively priced for this set but I like the blenders the best.

title: Brush & comb are slippery; plastic rake is useless; scissor is good; headband is functional
text:
At the current price of $24.99, this set is expensive for a total of six items. Included in this set are one large boar / nylon bristle brush with what looks like a linoleum covered handle, one small wooden comb, one plastic brush cleaner rake, one headband, a scissor, and a carry pouch.

The brush glided through my fine curly short to medium-length hair with ease and so did the comb. Unfortunately, they are not easy to hold because the finish is very slippery--particularly on the brush.

The only item that is absolutely useless is the plastic rake. I was unable to get any hair out of the brush using this. Nevertheless, the scissors cut well and the headband is functional. This set is a combination of cheap and decent materials and feels mismatched.

title: Absolutely excellent barrel brush; love that it has both boar & nylon bristles
text:
This barrel brush has both boar and nylon bristles. This works on my short to medium fine hair. I love the silicone grip at the base of the handle as it really provides me with a good hold.

So far I have not had any shedding of the boar bristles, although when a brush is made out of boar hairs, they do normally shed a little at first.

There is also a brush rake included as well as a cloth carry case. The brush rake is just okay but the carry case is very nice.

The current price of $14.99 is excellent for this.

title: Sleek facial steamer that produces cool steam immediately & hot steam in under 2 minutes
text:
[[VIDEOID:788f2b407c5887843d68ded9289c310f]] I've tried several facial steamers over the years and have always been disappointed. However, this one finally meets most of my expectations.

It is a sleek table top unit. Besides the unit, it also comes with an extension wand, a double sided facial brush, a set of acne tools, and a user guide. Setup is simple. I just removed the cap covering the outlet port, added distilled water to the reservoir, plugged it in, and turned it on either hot or cold. The hot steam is generated in less than two minutes and the cool generates immediately. There is an aromatherapy basket where dried flowers or essential oils can be added but I do not use that. I did try the extension wand and do not care for it because it does not direct the steam to my face unless I turn it to the side. I find putting a towel over my head during steaming is best. It is important not to get close to the nozzle when hot or it will burn the skin; I accidentally almost burned my hand getting close to the nozzle.

The hot steam is generated in less than two minutes and the cool generates immediately. There are only two other negatives besides the extension wand. One is the operational slider. I have to hold the unit to change the setting to the middle option (cool). It is easier to flip it to hot or off as that slider goes to either extremes but to set the button in the middle is not so "one-handed" easy. The second, is there is no way to see the reservoir low level other than seeing it run out of steam.

This can also be used as a quick and short room humidifier but that is my opinion only. The current price of $47.69 is a bit pricey for this but then again this is the first facial steamer that actually works well for me. I can fit it easily on the side of my bathroom sink as shown in my photo.

title: Not good for a close shave; only works on hairs about ¼” or more
text:
At the current price of $30.99 I expected a bitter razor. This set includes one trimmer with base, two double-sided guide combs (9mm/12mm and 3mm/6mm). a brush to clean the razor, one USB power cord for charging, and a user guide.

After charging this for several hours, the clippers by themselves work only if the hairs are about 1/4" or more. The on/off button has to be "press held" to operate this razor. What I do not like is that I kept accidentally turning off the unit during use because the on/off button is right where one would hold the razor when cutting. This is a big negative to me.

The head can easily be pushed off for cleaning and then snapped back in place.

In summary, I expected this razor to cut closer without the combs, so this is a bit disappointing. I also did not expect that it would keep shutting off during use due to the placement of the on/off button.

title: Super silky face cream
text:
This face cream is incredible. It looks thick but goes on light and leaves my face and neck feeling super silky. It is also scentless. I love it.

This is from Korea and is animal test-free. Also, the current price of $28 is competitively priced.

title: Nice small  basic curling iron; good for tight curls on very short hair
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this iron allows me to get a slightly tighter curl. This is a very nice curling iron with simple controls. There is a light telling the user when it has reached a certain temperature (meaning it stopped blinking). The temperature control goes from 60 to 230 degrees Celsius (i.e. 140 to 446 degrees Fahrenheit). The kickstand works. There is a 360 degree swivel cord to keep it from tangling and a loop at the end of the cord for hanging. It also heats up and cools down quickly.

In addition to the above, one glove, two clips, and a comb are supplied

In summary, this is perfect for short hair and makes my curls tighter because of the small barrel. If one is looking for a tight curl, then this is it. The current price of $19.99 is reasonably priced.

title: Excellent body brush for wet or dry brushing; love the hold
text:
This "brush head" is exquisitely crafted and the handle hold is wonderful.

The brush is one solid piece and has medium bristles that are sturdy enough to be exfoliating and cleaning yet somewhat gentle enough not to be irritating.

Also, I love brushes like these as a wet brush for the shower even though that is not what it is designed for.

The current price of $19.99 is expensive but the craftsmanship is exquisite. It also has a rope loop for hanging.

title: Nice vent brush w/nylon & boar bristles; a bit too curved; OK for blow drying
text:
There is a nice boar/nylon vent brush with synthetic bristles. The brush is attractive and functional as a brush. The curve of the brush cradles my scalp when detangling but I do find it is a little bit too curved for my taste.

The brush is easy to hold and passes through my short to medium-length curly hair relatively easily. Since this is a vent brush, it is good for blow drying as well and would be best used by those who have very long hair. However, the vents are not as wide as some other vet brushes I tried previously.

The current price of $8.99 is slightly pricey for this.

title: Average-sized bars; moderate lather; cleanses well; slightly moisturizing
text: There are two average-sized bars of soap in this box. The soap has a moderate lather but cleanses and moisturizes well. There really is not much of a fragrance to this; I neither like or dislike it. It is nice soap that is a bit pricey at $13.99 for two, which comes to $7 per bar.

title: Nice blenders for liquid, cream, or powder make-up
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. There are 6 egg-shaped sponges in various colors. The round edges are good for make-up application on the cheeks and the pointed tip is great for blending around the eye area or cheekbones.  I love how soft these are against my skin. 

Another plus is that these sponges do not have any smell to them like their colored version has. The light pink one feels less dense than the others. I prefer all of them to be dense because it soaks up less liquid.
The current price of $6.99 ($9.99 minus 30%) for 6 blending sponges comes to a reasonable $1.17 each.

title: Low-end plastic mirror; no magnification but very functional; too pricey
text:
This mirror feels a bit cheap. It is a bit larger than I expected and can be held by the handle or hung by the hand. There is no magnification but it is very functional.

The current price of $12.99 is about $5 too much for a mirror of this quality. I do not feel this is worth more than $8.

title: Love the scent but this lotion is too sticky to me & takes long to absorb
text: I do not like this. First of all it is a gel. The scent is lovely but after applying it to my hands and feet, it didn't fully absorb and it left my appedage sticky. I'll pass.

title: These seem all the same moisture wise but they have different scents/flavors; boxes hard to read
text:
At the current price of $34.99 this is a pricey way to soothe my lips, heels, hands, chin, etc. as it comes to $11.66 per tube and each tube only has 1.25" of balm in it. Nevertheless, this is moisturizing and soothing and a little bit glossy.

I used this on my lips, heels, and hands and it was hydrating. This is good for when one wants to carry a small lotion without having to take a bottle with them. However, I just feel this is way too pricey even though it works well.

It is impossible to read the white writing on the pale pastel boxes and I took off one star for that and the price and the fact that each balm seems exactly the same except for the flavor/scent. For example, the jasmine flower is supposed to be glowing, the rose flower soothing, and the Babassu Oil one rejuvenating. They all seem to have those properties.

In summary, I really like these but they are overpriced and it is impossible to read the writing on the boxes.

title: Unique dial straightener with temp from 270 to 450 degrees F in 10-degree increments – 4.5 stars
text:
The current price of $25.19 ($35.99 minus 30%) is competitively priced for this flat iron. Included in the package is the flat iron, one protective glove, two clips, and a velvet carry bag.

This one is unique in that the temperature is reached by dialing the base of the handle (meaning turning it left or right to either turn the unit on or off or increase or decrease the temperature).

The iron's controls are around the base and easy to use. Just turn the base and dial in the temperature in 10 degree increments from 270 to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. It heats up quickly and does a good job straightening my hair. I have short to medium fine curly hair. There is a lock on the front for storage and the cord has a 360 swivel to prevent tangling, which I love. Also, the alignment of the plates is spot on once I squeeze them together with my hands during use.

In summary, this is a good flat iron and the results are as expected. The clips that are thrown in this package hold well.

title: Small, lightly fragrant bath bombs with lackluster performance
text:
[[VIDEOID:ad61558ee8e2b33009b683bc2fac51fa]] There are nine one-ounce bath bombs in this container that are made of sodium bicarbonate, sodium carboate, citric acid, polyethylene glycol 400, ginger extract, lavender extract, tea tree essential oil, rose essential oil, and perfumes. I used one in very warm water. The bomb originally had a nice foam when adding water to the foot bath but it fizzed out in less than five minutes after which the foot bath looked like it only had water in it. The water was clear and non-staining (see photo).

I do like the fragrance of these and that lasted the entire foot bath. I only bathed my feet for ten minutes and the results were softening.

The current price of $18.99 ($19.99 minus 5%) for this is too expensive as it comes to $2.11 per baby bomb.

title: Super attractive curling iron; good for tight curls; kickstand okay - 4.5 stars
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this iron allows me to get a good curl that sticks. The temperature control goes from 225 to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. The kickstand is okay but wants to collapse periodically. Therefore, it is important to wear the supplied glove when using this. I do love the 360 degree swivel cord ability as it keeps it from tangling. There is also a loop at the base of the cord for hanging.

In summary, this 3/4" iron is perfect for slightly short to medium hair. The current price of $22.49 ($24.99 minus 10%) is competitively priced. I love the Champagne Gold barrel and controls and how well that contrasts with the metallic white finish of the iron chassis.

title: 12 lovely headbands in earth tone colors
text:
The colors and design of these 12 headbands are subtle but attractive in what I call earth tones. They are all wide and have a "knot" in the middle that can be worn in the center of the head or at the base of the neck. I personally do not like knots in my headbands but these are versatile enough to position the knot away from the forehead without losing the good look of the band.

The colors are nice and the bands stretch to fit my head. Note that the black band is a bit smaller than the others but still fit.

Also, the current price of $12.99 comes to a reasonable $1.08 per band.

title: Beautiful & functional dual-sided brush; decent coverage; no bristle shedding; sparkly handle
text:
This review is for the Double Ended Foundation Powder Brush. This is a beautiful foundation brush. It works well for dusting translucent powder over the face, applying a bronzer, or powder blush. Since the larger end is not as large as other foundation brushes, this is best for smaller applications like blush. The other small brush end is great for powder eyeshadow or for highlighting the top end of the cheeks with a darker blush powder.

This brush feels great in my hands. I love the yellow sparkle on the handle.The bristles do not shed. It is also soft against my skin.

The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced.

title: Glossy, tasty, and slightly sticky lip butter
text:
I love lip balms and lip butters and have them all over the house and in my purse. These tubes of lip butter are nice. They are tasty too. I tried the watermelon and I can taste that flavor on my lips. I expect the strawberry and pineapple to be just as good. They add a gloss to my lips and keep them moisturized. I just feel a tiny bit of tackiness but not enough to bother me. Even after drinking a cup of tea, they still stayed on.

There are three .52 ounce tubes in this package for the current price of $16.99, which comes to $5.66 each. I consider this on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Decent hot and cold blow dryer w/3 attachments; one attachment connects loosely
text:
At the current price of $35.99 ($39.99 minus 10%), this is competitively priced. In the box are the dryer unit itself, three attachments (diffuser, concentrator, comb concentrator), a user guide, and two types of cheap plastic hair combs.

Before first use, the red button on the plug may have to be pushed in or it may not turn on. I did not have to do that. There are three controls on the front. The cool shot button can be depressed for cold air or left up for hot air. The middle button is the on/off, low, and high for the speed. The last button is the high, medium, and low for the heat or cold. What is interesting about this dryer is that I was able to operate all buttons on the cold setting. This means this is either a cold dryer or hot dryer. I never encountered one of those before.

The cord is NOT a swivel cord but I do not find I need that. There is a loop at the base of the cord for hanging. This dried my hair well. The attachments require a bit of elbow grease to attach, except for the comb attachment which is too loose and wants to fall off during use.

In summary, this is a nice basic HOT or COLD blow dryer. The attachments work relatively well except for the comb one that is loose. If the attachments were easier to attach and all fit snugly, then this would have received 5 stars at this price point.

title: Gloves are snug and exfoliating; love the beautiful blue color; a bit pricey
text:
The current price of $6.99 is expensive for one pair of exfoliating gloves as I can buy 12 pairs [[ASIN:B08GLMLX2C here]] for $15.99. Even though these are a tad better quality because they are thicker and more rough, the other gloves are a close second.

I take a size large and these gloves are a snug fit but still fit my hands perfectly. They do stretch but I doubt they would fit a man's hand. In addition, the color is extremely enticing.

These work and act like my other exfoliating gloves. They are slightly thicker than my others and have a good scratchy surface. They are just rough enough to cleanse well. These can be used in the shower with a bar of soap. They definitely exfoliate but the gloves themselves reduce the amount of suds created. I love a lot of suds, which is why a mesh body puff is my "go to" shower accessory.

title: Complete and utter junk; went in the garbage
text: I had high hopes for this razor. It comes with a base tray, the main razor body with the nose trimmer installed, an eyebrow trimmer cap, and a precision trimmer cap along with a user guide. It takes one AA battery (NOT INCLUDED). The battery cap does not want to stay on. It took me about 10 minutes just to seat the cap and after I had, it kept wanting to fall off. The precision trimmer head also wanted to keep falling off. I was barely able to try this and it did not perform well at all. The precision trimmer requires more than razor stubble to use. This is complete junk; I threw it out.

title: OK ear/nose trimmer; takes one AA battery NOT included
text:
I am one of the very rare people that likes these types of small pocket razors. This is what I call a bullet head razor. This one is just okay. The razor is a bit wide compared to women's pocket razors. It does trim the nose and ear hairs but they have to be long. There is also a slight burning smell with this razor.The head is removable for cleaning.

This comes with a cleaning brush and a user pamphlet. One AA battery is needed but NOT included.

The current price of $10.99 is competitively priced for this "pocket" razor but I do wish it came with a tiny cloth bag for carrying both the razor and cleaning brush.

title: Luxurious cream but brush is not supplied
text: This cream looks thick but goes on light and smooth. It also has a wonderfully fresh scent. It left my face feeling smooth and silky. Unfortunately, the brush mentioned was not included and the $53 price tag is overpriced for this. Otherwise, this is a luxurious cream.

title: Basic blow dryer; no user guide, no attachments shown, no swivel cord - MISSING PARTS
text:
At the current price of $28.14 ($29.62 minus 5%), this is overpriced. The reason is that the two attachments shown are missing and there is no user guide. The cord also does not swivel. This is just a basic blow dryer with nothing else.

This dryer is very attractive with its metallic red color. In the box is just the blow dryer unit. The dryer works well.

Before first use, the red button on the plug has to be pushed in or it won't turn on. There are three controls on the front. The cool shot button is more like a cool shot toggle. The middle button the on/off, low, and high for the speed. The last button is the high, medium, and low for the heat.

The cord is NOT a swivel cord but I do not find I need that. There is a loop at the base of the cord for hanging. This dried my hair well.

In summary, this is a very nice basic blow dryer and I love simplicity but with missing parts, it gets 2 stars from me as the unit is incomplete.

title: Bottle design a nice idea but not practical; shampoo/conditioner very nice
text:
The bottle design is a nice idea but it is not practical for several reasons. First, the bottle is easier to tip over due to the hourglass design. Second, as the product is used, the design does not allow the product for both items to pool toward the spout. Instead, one is either waiting for the shampoo or conditioner to be dispensed depending on which one was face down first. However, it does seem that the bottles can be separated at the seam.

The shampoo and conditioner are very nice. I like the fresh fragrance, the lather, and how well it cleans. I also like how soft it leaves my hair when dry. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this did weigh down my curls a little bit.

The current price of $15.20 ($19 minus 20%) comes to $7.60 per bottle which is competitively priced.

title: Turns my short curly hair into waves; best for thick curly hair
text:
I have short to medium length fine curly hair. This brush straightener turned my curls into waves at 380 degrees Fahrenheit. The temperature goes from 180 to 450 degrees but the manual does not have that information. I find this so much easier to use than a flat iron; however, a flat iron works better on fine hair like mine. I just plugged it in, set the temperature, waited until the desired temp stopped blinking, and then brushed my hair until I got the look I wanted.

The cord is a swivel cord to prevent it from tangling. There is a tiny loop at the base of the cord for hanging.

This is a gorgeous metallic blue brush straightener with a cloth carry case and lackluster instructions. The current price of $35.99 is competitively priced. Overall, I really like this but this would definitely work better on those with thick curly hair.

title: Love the serum but hate the pump mechanism
text:
This serum is great. A little moisturizes a lot of skin. I used this on my arms and legs. I also do not feel greasy after using this. It also appears to be scentless. However, I absolutely hate the pump mechanism. Unless I hold the bottle at an angle, the pump makes a mess when dispensing the serum.

The current price of $44 is expensive for 3.4 ounces but this will last a while. The reason I rated this 3 stars is because of the dispensing pump and how pricey this is.

title: Lovely hand cream that absorbs quickly & leaves my hands hydrated and silky; PRICEY
text: This hand cream is lovely. It absorbs quickly and leaves my hands moisturized and silky. Only a little bit is needed. However, at the current price of $15, this is pricey for 1.69 ounces but such a price is typical of creams with shea butter. Therefore, I did not take off any stars for the high price. I absolutely love this cream and would purchase it if I needed more simply because the results are so good.

title: Medium-sized buff puffs that create copious suds and are perfectly wound; good for stocking stuffers
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are medium in size and a bit smaller than the ones I buy at Walmart for $2 each. There are four puffs that come wrapped in its own cardboard sleeve. They work like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. They are wound perfectly meaning the mesh is not too loose and not too tight. There is a ribbon on the end for hanging.

The current price of $8.99 comes to a competitively priced $2.25 per puff. Since each puff comes in its own wrapper, these are perfect as stocking stuffers or something to put in the Easter basket. Of course, since these are black, I would choose their pink color for the Easter basket.

title: Decent blow Dryer & Brush Combo for those with long hair - 3.5 stars
text:
At the current price of $26.09 ($28.99 minus 10%), this is a decent blow dryer / brush combo unit. I love its simplicity and function and the attractive black and dark pink color. This is perfect for those with long hair.

In the box is the dryer unit and a user guide. The dryer works well. It is also relatively easy for me to hold even though it can feel a bit bulky.

Besides the on/off control, there are three turn controls on the handle of cool function, medium heat at half power, and high heat at full power. I have short to medium length hair and this worked well on the hair in the back of my head but this is really designed for someone with long hair. I wish I had this unit when I had long hair; it would have been perfect.

What is also great is that the cord is a swivel cord, so the cord does not get tangled.

In summary, this is a nice basic brush blow dryer and I love its simplicity. Dryers such as this are not for everyone. Those who are adept and using a vent brush with a regular blow dryer will probably not feel these type units are effective. However, I love brush dryer units. I do feel that this is best used by those with hair beyond shoulder length.

title: Beautiful brush w/flawless finish; handle a bit slippery & slight smell from finish
text:
This is a beautiful brush. The handle finish is flawless and rustic looking to me. It is easy to hold but is a little slippery since the handle is so smooth. There is a slight odor from the recently made finish that will dissipate over time.

This brush glides through my short to medium-length fine curly hair easily. I love the combination of boar bristles with nylon bristles because the nylon bristles are needed for detangling. Without that, this would not work for my hair.

The current price of $21.99 is competitively priced for this.

title: Puffs are the only tissues I use; these are thin but still strong and soft
text:
There are eight boxes of 124 two-ply Puffs tissues in this order. The tissues have no lotion but they are still soft. They are thin but strong because they are two-ply. I love them and have Puffs boxes all over the house. It is the only brand I buy.

The current price of $16.99 comes to $2.12 per box or $.02 cents per tissue. BJs sells a 10-pack of these for $15.99, which comes to $1.60 per box but one has to have a membership. Therefore, I consider this online price competitively priced.

title: Good Blow Dryer & Brush Combo for those with long hair
text:
At the current price of $32.99, this is the exact same brush dryer that can be purchased [[ASIN:B09WDV9D8R here]] for $27.99, which is obviously a better deal for this blow dryer / brush combo unit.

I love its simplicity and function. This is perfect for those with long hair.

This brush dryer is attractive. I love the black and dark pink contrast. In the box is the dryer unit and a user guide. The dryer works well. However, it is not as easy for me to hold as some other dryers I tried because the handle is almost the same width all the way through.

Besides the on/off control, there are three speed settings on the handle of room temperature and high speed, medium heat and low speed, and high heat and high speed. I have short to medium length hair and this worked well on the hair in the back of my head but this is really designed for someone with long hair. I wish I had this unit when I had long hair; it would have been perfect.

What is also great is that the cord is a swivel cord, so the cord does not get tangled. In addition, there is a loop at the base of the cord for hanging on a nail or hook.

Note that there is a burning or off gassing smell during initial use. That should dissipate over time and is typical of new appliances.

In summary, this is a decent basic brush blow dryer and I love its simplicity. The colors are attractive. I do feel that this is best used by those with hair beyond shoulder length. The only two negatives is that the handle is not as easy to hold as some other brush-style dryers I tried previously and there is a slight off-gassing smell during initial use.

title: Perfect for travel; only one temperature of 390 degrees Fahrenheit - 4.5 stars
text:
The current price of $13.49 is reasonable for this miniature flat iron. It comes with the unit itself, a carry case, and the user guide.

The iron's controls are on the top and all it is an ON/OFF slider. There are no temperature controls. It only operates at 390 degrees Fahrenheit but there is no LED readout. This means I never know when it reaches that temperature because the white light stays on all the time when the unit is turned on.

The cord has a 360 swivel to prevent tangling, which I love. Also, the alignment of the plates is spot on--not too tight or too loose. As long as I hold the plates closed at the tip (with gloves, of course), this works perfectly. The plates are 2.5" long and a little over 1/2" wide. I used it to straighten my hair and it did a decent job. Of course, I have short to medium fine curly hair. If I had lots and lots of hair, this would require lots of patience.

In summary, this is a cute mini flat iron that works well when one is traveling. I would not use this as a daily iron, but for travel it is perfect. The iron is super basic. It does not even have a swivel cord but it does have a wonderful locking latch at the back end for storage.

title: Thick, hydrating cream w/a subtly fresh scent; leaves hydration barrier on my face/neck
text:
This face cream checks all the boxes for me. It is thick, which I love. It is incredibly hydrating and leaves a nice hydration barrier on my face and neck. This cream is perfect for winter and fall.

The current price of $23.99 ($29.99 minus 20%) is competitively priced for this 30ml jar.

title: Beautiful brush set but doesn't match--travel brush has a different color finish
text:
This is an absolutely beautiful brush set. There is one large paddle type brush and one small oval one. They are easy to hold and grip and perfect for brushing or just detangling. Note that the bristles are a combination of boar and nylon and that is the perfect combination to me.

The brushes glided through my short to medium-length fine curly hair easily. This set is easily five stars except that the wood finish on both brushes do not match. The travel brush has a slightly darker finish (see photo of the back of the brushes where it shows most). I personally do not care because they will not be seen together, but others might not like this. It is typical for a set to have the same coloring.

The current price of $12.58 ($13.98 minus 10%) is reasonable for this set. It also comes in a giftable box.

title: Has typical tea tree scent; cleanses well but stings the eyes
text:
This comes in one 32-fluid ounce pump bottle and one 2-ounce travel-sized bottle. Note that the plug has to be removed from both bottles before use.

As a body wash this lathers moderately and cleanses well. It also has that strong tea tree aroma. I do not smell any peppermint. It does burn the eyes, so avoid that area.

Tea tree oil is a natural antiseptic, so it is perfect for those that have fungal infections or athlete's foot.

The current price of $24.99 for 34 total ounces is competitively priced.

title: Lathers moderately, cleanses well, and very moisturizing
text:
There are three small bars of soap in this package. I love the ginger fragrance. The soap lathers moderately, cleanses well, and is very moisturizing. It is almost too moisturizing because it took longer to wash off.

I personally do not believe in soap being detoxifying; to me that is just hocus pocus. Nevertheless, this is nice soap.

The current price of $16.99 coms to $5.66 per bar, which is a bit pricey for such a small bar of soap.

title: Good Blow Dryer & Brush Combo for those with long hair
text:
At the current price of $27.99, this is an excellent deal for a blow dryer / brush combo unit. I love its simplicity and function. This is perfect for those with long hair.

This brush dryer is attractive. I love the black and dark pink contrast. In the box is the dryer unit and a user guide. The dryer works well. However, it is not as easy for me to hold as some other dryers I tried because the handle is almost the same width all the way through.

Besides the on/off control, there are three speed settings on the handle of room temperature and high speed, medium heat and low speed, and high heat and high speed. I have short to medium length hair and this worked well on the hair in the back of my head but this is really designed for someone with long hair. I wish I had this unit when I had long hair; it would have been perfect.

What is also great is that the cord is a swivel cord, so the cord does not get tangled. In addition, there is a loop at the base of the cord for hanging on a nail or hook.

Note that there is a burning or off gassing smell during initial use. That should dissipate over time and is typical of new appliances.

In summary, this is a decent basic brush blow dryer and I love its simplicity. The colors are attractive. I do feel that this is best used by those with hair beyond shoulder length. The only two negatives is that the handle is not as easy to hold as some other brush-style dryers I tried previously and there is a slight off-gassing smell during initial use.

title: Love the citrus fragrance of this wash; lathers and cleanses well but a bit difficult to rinse off
text:
There are two 8 fluid ounce pump bottles of "morning burst" facial cleanser in this set. The fragrance is great and smells like citrus orange. This wash lathers very well and is gentle on my face. It also cleanses well. After using this, my face felt incredibly clean and soft. I have sensitive skin and this wash did not irritate my face. The only thing I did not like about this wash is that it takes several rinses to wash off. It is sort of a slick gel and takes a few rinses. If this were not the case, this would have received 5 stars from me.

The current price of $13.74 comes to $6.87 per bottle which I consider reasonably priced.

title: Great acne wash; moderate lather, fragrance okay, left my face feeling cleansed
text:
There are two 9.1 fluid ounce pump bottles of acne wash in this set. The fragrance is just okay; I'm not really crazy about it. However, this cleanses well. It has a moderate lather and after using this, my face felt incredibly clean without being dry. The active ingredient is salicylic acid 2%. This will help curb my acne that I still get in middle age. I have sensitive skin and this wash did not irritate my face.

The current price of $15.78 comes to $7.89 per bottle which I consider reasonably priced.

title: Excellent Blow Dryer & Brush Combo for those with long hair
text:
At the current price of $49.99, this is a slightly pricey blow dryer / brush combo unit. However, I love its simplicity and function. This is perfect for those with long hair.

This brush dryer is attractive. I do wish it were a darker pink instead of ballet pink, however. In the box is the dryer unit and a user guide. The dryer works very well. It is also easy for me to hold.
