Before first use, the red button on the plug has to be pushed in or it won't turn on. Besides the on/off control, there are three turn controls on the handle of room temperature and high speed, medium heat and low speed, and high heat and high speed. I have short to medium length hair and this worked well on the hair in the back of my head but this is really designed for someone with long hair. I wish I had this unit when I had long hair; it would have been perfect.

What is also great is that the cord is a swivel cord, so the cord does not get tangled.

In summary, this is a very nice basic brush blow dryer and I love its simplicity. The ballet pink is attractive but I would have loved a darker pink. I do feel that this is best used by those with hair beyond shoulder length.

title: Beautiful Razor with 10 straight edge blades; shaves exceptionally close but be careful
text:
The razor handle/holder is heavy, gorgeous, and well-made. There is also a package of 10 straight edge blades. The blade has to be installed into the head and simple instructions are provided. I shaved my face with this and it left my skin feeling like a baby's bottom--just smooth and soft. It is important to use shave cream with this and to work gingerly and be careful. It was easy to wash off when done. However, this is a lovely razor blade / razor set and only the blades will have to be replaced in the future.

The current price of $21.59 ($23.99 minus 10%) is competitively priced for this. For those men (or women) looking for this type of razor system, this does not disappoint in my opinion.

title: Only for acne prone areas; works well to reduce acne; good lather
text:
This soap should only be applied to areas with acne. This does produce a good lather, has an okay scent, and works well to reduce but not eliminate acne on my skin. This will last me a while.

The current price of $14.89 comes to $7.45 per bar.

title: Really nice straightener with three preset temperatures
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this flat iron works even on my length hair.

I used this on my dry hair. I then set this to about 270 degrees Fahrenheit. The degrees go from 170 to 450 Fahrenheit. There is a preset button that has three defined presets of 270, 350, and 410 degrees Fahrenheit. The four buttons on the side of the iron do not get in the way. There is an ON/OFF button that has to be "press held," temp up and temp down buttons, and the preset button. The cord is a swivel cord and has a nice Velcro wrap to tie it up when not in use.

I used this on my hair and it did an excellent job straightening my curls. The irons come together nicely and hardly have any space between them, which is good. The grip is also good. The unit is hefty and easy to hold

Overall, this works as designed and better than I expected. The swivel cord is a nice feature. It also has a lock button at the end to keep the blades together for storage. I was able to straighten my hair fine with this as it has a 1" plate. This is a decent straightener for the current price of $29.99.

title: Overpriced facial brush; heat drains battery immediately; brushes are decent
text:
For the current price of $36.89 ($40.99 minus 10%), this is an expensive facial cleansing tool with two brush heads and a heating mode (can only be used when brush is NOT in operation) that drains the battery immediately.

IN THE BOX:
- Cleansing wand 
- USB charging cable
- Two cleansing brushes (soft/sensitive brush and normal/deep clean brush)
- User guide- Soft Shell case

Note that the instruction manual is very basic. I charged this for about three hours until the name had a steady white light in the front. In order to use this, I had to snap in the brush head I wanted to use. To start the unit I just press/held the power button until the brush head rotated slowly. I then pressed the button one more time to set it on the fastest speed. It has two speed modes. I did a press/hold to turn the unit off. The two cleaning speeds are where the brush head rotates slowly or a little bit faster than slow. I ran the entire unit under water to clean since it is waterproof.

The heat requires me to press/hold the heat button on the opposite side. Note that it is unclear from the manual what the heat mode is. It does say the cleaning brush mode cannot be used at the same time. So it is either heat and no brush or all brush cleansing. Based on my tests, the heat radiates not through the brush but through the chassis side of the unit and if I hold that up to my face, I feel heat. Unfortunately, the battery is drained in about 30 seconds in this mode and I get the blinking red light to indicate a low battery. I tried this several times after full charges and the same thing happened. I personally do not care about the hat function but this is a big negative.

In summary, this is a lackluster facial cleaning brush for such a high price. The heat function is useless and cannot be operated in the cleansing mode. The battery drains repeatedly with the heat function. I found it difficult to remove the brush heads and had to use a metal nail file each time to pry them off. I do like that this is waterproof and comes with a case. The cleaning brushes work well when in use but there are many other brushes on the market that offer more functionality for a little cheaper price.

title: Leaves my face & neck silky; scentless; made in Korea; doesn’t say what this is on the package
text:
If it weren't for the Amazon site, I would have no idea this is a face cream as it comes in a tube like hand cream. It also does not say what this is on the box or tube. This is made in Korea.

I applied this to my face and neck and it feels like I put a sheer product on my skin. My skin felt very silky and smooth. I do love the results. However, the current price of $43 for 2.46 fluid ounces is pricey for this, especially when the box is not appropriately marked.

title: Good hand cream; very moisturizing; scent is mild but not my favorite
text: This hand cream is very nice and it is very hydrating. It feels like it creates a nice barrier on my hands. The fragrance is subtle but not my favorite. It smells a bit like flowers that are about to wilt. The current price of $27 is also expensive for this 1.69 fluid ounce tube.

title: Lovely and whimsical cat ear scrunchies; stays in well
text:
These two cat ear scrunchies are just wonderful. They are well-made and great for little girls or those who prefer a whimsical "talking point" in their hair. I have to make sure the ears stay up and the bow faces backward when using this. They also stay put. They are better suited for longer hair than mine, however.

The current price of $6.29 ($6.99 minus 10%) comes to a competitively priced $3.15 per scrunchie since there are two of them in this package.

title: Decent facial razor; does the job it is supposed to do; cable is short
text:
This is a decent facial razor. It comes with the razor unit itself, a micro-USB cable (A/C adapter NOT included), a cleaning brush, and a user pamphlet.

I charged the razor for about one hour before first use as it was already partially charged. Once the blue lights stopped blinking, this was ready to use. All I had to do was press the power button on the front. I shaved my chin, under my lips, and the sides of my cheeks and it did an excellent job without pinching me.

When I was done, I unscrewed the tiny circular top and blew out the hairs as well as brushed them out with the provided cleaning brush. I really like this razor and I love the electric blue color. I do wish the USB cable was longer and the razor body was a bit thinner, however. Most razors of this type are a bit shorter and thinner.

The current price of $9.99 is reasonable for this. Note that not everyone is going to love a razor like this. I already have several and love them. They do a good job for removing small facial hairs between shaves, which is what I use them for.

title: Thin but very functional and attractive scrunchies; stays in well
text:
There are five thin and average-sized scrunchies in this package. I love the fall colors. Two are made of slinky material and two of velvet type material and the gold one is made of a scratchy cloth.

These stay in my hair well and are attractive.

At the current price of $9.99 this comes to $2 per scrunchie which is a little bit pricey for these.

title: Absolutely gorgeous brush but best for peach fuzz or very short hair
text:
This is a really beautiful hairbrush. In the package is a boar & nylon bristle brush but it is not typical of most brushes with that mixture. It almost feels like a very hard boar bristle brush because it does not detangle and it only passes lightly through my short-to-medium fine curly hair. This brush is best for those who have peach fuzz or a little more than peach fuzz for hair.

The handle is easy to hold, so it provides a good grip. I also love the blue green color of this brush.

The current price of $11.99 is competitively priced for this. It is certainly beautiful but not as functional for my hair as I expected.

title: Excellent, lightweight slant-tip tweezers that work with precision
text:
These slant-tip tweezers are excellent, especially for the current price of $4.99. They are lightweight with superb precision as they come tightly together. I was able to easily pull eyebrow, chin, and lip hairs with these. In fact, since the ends are thinner than some tweezers, extraction of very fine hairs was even easy.

It comes with a case but I am unable to open that without a tool because I have no nails, so I wish the latch on that was easy to open.

title: Nice vent brush w/nylon & boar bristles; good for blow drying
text:
There is a nice boar/nylon vent brush with synthetic bristles. The brush is both attractive and functional. I love the way the curve of the brush cradles my scalp when detangling.

The brush is easy to hold and passes through my short to medium-length curly hair easily. Since this is a vent brush, it is perfect for blow drying as well and would be best used by those who have very long hair.

The current price of $9.98 is a bit pricey for this.

title: Very nice lavender soap set with plastic soap saver
text: This bar of soap has a subtle but fresh lavender fragrance. It lathers and cleans well. Also, supplied is a plastic soap saver, which is basically a sponge with holes that helps keep the soap dry after use. Overall, I really like this set but the current price of $12.99 is just a tad too much.

title: It feels like this leaves a film on my hair; I’m not crazy about this duo – 2.5 stars
text:
There are two 16.9 ounce bottles in this set of shampoo and conditioner. Although there is the typical medicinal fragrance of tea tree oil, it is not overpowering as I expected, which is good. However, the shampoo does not lather copiously and it does not spread easily. I feel like a film is left behind on my hair. The conditioner also feels the same way but not as bad. My short to medium fine curly hair turned out lackluster after using these products.

The current price of $23.95 ($25.95 minus $2) comes to $11.98 per bottle, which is reasonable. I just wish I liked this more.

title: Absolutely gorgeous brush but best for peach fuzz or very short hair
text:
This is a really beautiful hairbrush. In the package is a boar & nylon bristle brush but it is not typical of most brushes with that mixture. It almost feels like a very hard boar bristle brush because it does not detangle and it only passes lightly through my short-to-medium fine curly hair. This brush is best for those who have peach fuzz or a little more than peach fuzz for hair.

The handle is a bit wide and not as easy to hold as other brushes but still provides a good grip.

The current price of $10.99 is competitively priced for this. It is certainly beautiful but not as functional for my hair as I expected.

title: I should have known not to dry this; soap is brown & barely lathers; has earthy smell
text:
For some reason I thought this would be different from the African Black Soap Bar I tried previously. However, I do not care for the earthy smell nor the dirt colored solution that barely lathers. I really thought I would give this soap another try but now I will steer clear. I figured the liquid version would be somewhat different than the bar but it is only a little better.

I hate using this to wash my face. I will repurpose this as hand soap. The current price of $22 is also pricey. This is definitely not for me and I will avoid such soaps in the future.

title: Pretty hair bows; stays put as long as it holds only a little hair
text: These hair bows are very pretty and come just below my neck if I place them in the middle of my head in the back. The clips open and close easily. As long as I do not put too much hair in these clips, they will stay shut. This is more for a decoration than to hold a lot of hair. The current price of $6.99 is a competitively priced $3.50 each.

title: Intense fragrance I really like but cream is thin & runny but moisturizes well; INSANELY priced
text: This lavender patchouli scent is really intense and smells wonderful with floral and slightly sweet notes. Nevertheless, the lotion is very liquidy. I expected this to be more body butter like (meaning thick). It moisturizes well and absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling silky. The current price of $25.20 for 4 ounces is also insane. I took off one star for the insane price and one star for the thin texture. If this lotion were a bit thicker and cheaper, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: These are difficult for me to use and tricky to stay put in my hair
text:
I find that these clips are difficult to use and stay put in my hair. I had to try several times to get these from falling out. I wish there were some instructions or photos, in case I am doing this wrong. However, I have medium-length hair in the back and it only provided a light hold once I got this seated. Perhaps it would work best with someone who has longer hair or who has their hair already tied up and wants to use a clip to tie up loose ends into an existing bun.

The current price of $9.99 comes to $2.50 per clip, which I consider expensive for these types of clips.

title: Smells awful, has orange tinge, & is sticky slimy; disgusting; went right in the garbage
text: This pack of four anti-aging serums smells so bad that I had to suppress a dry heave. In addition, the gel has an orange tinge to it. It goes on sticky and slimy and is absolutely disgusting. I threw this right in the garbage.

title: Smells awful, has orange tinge, & is sticky slimy; disgusting; went right in the garbage
text: This pack of three anti-aging serums smells so bad that I had to suppress a dry heave. In addition, the gel has an orange tinge to it. It goes on sticky and slimy and is absolutely disgusting. I threw this right in the garbage.

title: Smells awful, has orange tinge, & is sticky slimy; disgusting; went right in the garbage
text: This pack of two anti-aging serums smells so bad that I had to suppress a dry heave. In addition, the gel has an orange tinge to it. It goes on sticky and slimy and is absolutely disgusting. I threw this right in the garbage.

title: Love the fragrance and attractive bottle but not the screw top
text:
This fragrance is fresh and smells almost like cucumber. I also love the attractive bottle. However, the only thing I do not like is that it is hard to close the top fully where it lines up with the bottle. I actually feel like I am going to break the neck of the bottle as I screw on the cap.

In summary, I didn't think I would like this perfume but it is great. The current price of $29.99 is competitively priced.

title: Love the fragrance and attractive bottle but not the screw top
text:
This fragrance is fresh and smells great. I also love the attractive bottle. However, the only thing I do not like is that it is hard to close the top fully where it lines up with the bottle. I actually feel like I am going to break the neck of the bottle as I screw on the cap.

In summary, I didn't think I would like this perfume but it is great. The current price of $29.99 is competitively priced.

title: Large soft washcloths that are not only for removing make-up
text:
At the current price of $12.10 ($14.24 minus 15%), this comes to $1.01 per cloth. There are 12 vibrantly colored washcloths in this package with three of each color (black, purple, blue, pink). These are super soft and I like that the color does not seem to bleed. These can be used as washcloths for removing make-up with soap and water or for protecting the neck during a hair color. There are just so many uses.

I love the color, the soft and plush feel, and versatility of these and the current price is excellent too.

title: Soothing foot soak and fragrance is divine
text:
I used about two tablespoons to one gallon of water to bathe my feet. This dissolves faster than Epsom Salt so that what I am left with is a bath of almost clear water.

The secret garden fragrance is intoxicating and lasts the entire bath. The soak is soothing to my feet. My feet came out feeling clean and refreshed. The scent made me feel like I was having a spa experience.

The current price of $13.95 for 12 ounces is pricey but the experience is worth it. I love this foot soak and it is the fragrance that really has me hooked.

title: Hard to hold; odd holder that doesn’t stay put; brush bristles do detangle
text:
This is a very odd brush. It is lightweight but the handle is so wide that I find it difficult to hold and brush with. The bristles do detangler but  without a good handle, it is a moot point to me. Also, the holder is round. Note that a round object does not stand up on its own. This does not stand up in the holder; instead it rolls over onto its side. The only way it will stand up is if I put the base of the round hold down and then  balance the brush in the other hole (see photo). It comes with an adhesive that fits on the bottom but it makes no sense to use this.

In summary, the entire brush is odd, the holder is non-functional, the handle is too thick on the brush to use comfortably, and the double-sided adhesive makes not sense to use. The current price of $16.90 is also way too expensive for this lightweight plastic brush ensemble.

title: Nice set of five absorbent hair towels; more medium than large sized
text:
There are five velvety soft microfiber hair towels in this package. They are basic hair towels and do not come with a button to secure. Instead there is an elastic loop on the top of the head side that the tail of the turban has to be slipped through.

I would consider these medium in size. After putting this over my head, I twist the turban and then secure the excess tail to the loop at the top of the head. These are also absorbent when I did not think they would be. Microfiber is normally not that absorbent but these are different. I am used to terry cloth turbans but I must admit these are good. I tried other microfiber ones before and did not care for them, so I am pleasantly surprised. I would not put these in the dryer unless it was very low.

The current price of $18.99 comes to a reasonably priced $3.80 per towel. These [[ASIN:B09VL1JQGF Poyday microfiber hair towels]] are my favorite but these are a close second.

UPDATE - I washed these and they wash well. All I did was dry them on low and they come out looking like new.

title: I love the Jasmine Lime scent but the body butter needs to be thicker
text: They hit the mark with the scent on this Jasmine Lime lotion. It smells slightly sweet and floral with a hint of citrus and all around fresh. Unfortunately, the lotion is moderately thin. I expected this to be body butter thick  (meaning thick like other body butters on the market). It moisturizes well and absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling silky. If the lotion were thick, I would have rated this 5 stars. The current price of $13.64 ($18.19 minus 25%) for 8 ounces is competitively priced for this.

title: Lathers and cleans well; love the coconut scent; does relax my curls a bit
text: I really love the coconut scent of this shampoo. It makes washing my hair with this a pleasant experience. This shampoo lathers copiously and cleans well--in fact, almost too well. I have short to medium fine curly hair and my curls were relaxed a little when dry after using this shampoo. Nevertheless, I really like this.

title: Utterly sweet and thin, runny lotion but moisturizes well
text: They hit the mark with the scent on this cherry vanilla lotion. It smells utterly delicious but super sweet. I feel like I should be eating this instead of putting it on my body. Nevertheless, the lotion is very liquidy. I expected this to be more body butter like (meaning thick). It moisturizes well and absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling silky. If it were a bit thicker and less cloyingly sweet smelling, I would have rated this 5 stars. The current price of $10.61 for 4 ounces is on the high side of competitively priced based on how thin this lotion is.

title: These bandages have many uses; sticks to itself and not to skin or fur; not only tattoo grip tape
text:
These bandages have many uses. There are 24 black rolls that are individually wrapped and each roll is 5 yards apiece and 2 inches tall. These self-adhere as the bandage is wrapped around a hand, leg, arm, etc. This sticks well to itself. The stretch allows this to be used like kinesiology tape with the exception that one cannot shower with this successfully and each wrap is for one-time use. There are just so many useful possibilities besides using this as tattoo grip tape. Tattoo grip tape is used to cushion the grip on tattoo grip tubes to provide the artist with a more comfortable grip.

The entire roll does not have to be used at once as it depends on the amount needed. This is perfect to use as a lightweight version of a carpal tunnel brace by wrapping it around a bad wrist, hand, and thumb as I did in the photo. It does not stick to my skin nor to a pet's fur, which is wonderful. It is also versatile enough to wrap around the handle of a tennis racquet to get a good grip or an umbrella or cane handle.

In summary, this is not only good as tattoo grip tape. I feel these are good bandages to also have in one's medicine cabinet. I have no idea what this will be priced at but most bandages like these sell for $.80 cents per roll, which means this should be priced at less than $20 for the 24 rolls.

title: Very nice sunscreen for the face; rubs in and absorbs easily and it is scentless
text: I really love this face and neck sunscreen. It is creamy but light enough to spread easily and provide good coverage. It also absorbs quickly and leaves my face and neck feeling smooth while also offering protection. The current price of $14.99 ($24.99 minus $10) is also excellent for this.

title: Lovely skinny push-up stick deodorant; the lavender fragrance is subtle; keeps me fresh for 12 hours
text:
I love intense fragrance and specifically love men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. However, this stick does not have that ingredient but still protects me for 12 hours until my next shower.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. I can barely smell the lavender scent and I have a very sensitive nose. I really would have loved a stronger fragrance. Nevertheless, this keeps me pretty much scentless between showers, which means it works. Note that the balm is very hard so it does not roll on thick like other deodorants. It also has to be pushed up from the bottom of the tube. I personally prefer deodorants that have to be dialed up.

The current price of $7.98 ($9.97 minus 20%) is just slightly pricey for this 2.8-ounce stick. This is a very nice deodorant with only four ingredients of sweet almond oil, beeswax, magnesium oxide, and lavender oil.

title: Toner leaves my face/neck feeling smooth and cleansed; less astringent than my normal toner
text:
I used a cotton round to apply this to my face and neck. It took awhile to pump this out the first time. The toner feels less astringent than typical and my face and neck felt cleansed and clean after using this without being dry. Overall, I really like this toner.

The current price of $18 is competitively priced for this 100ml (3.381 fluid ounce) bottle. Note that this is made in Hong Kong.

title: Excellent Blow Dryer & Brush Combo for those with long hair; smells during initial use
text:
At the current price of $79.99, this is an expensive blow dryer / brush combo unit.However, I love its simplicity and function. This is perfect for those with long hair.

This brush dryer is very attractive. In the box is the dryer unit, a user guide, a rake (to rake out the hair from the brush), and a SUPER SOFT velvet carry bag. The dryer works very well.

Before first use, the red button on the plug has to be pushed in or it won't turn on. Besides the on/off control, there are three turn controls on the handle of low, medium, and high. I have short to medium length hair and this worked well on the hair in the back of my head but this is really designed for someone with long hair.

Note that there is a burning or off gassing smell during initial use. That should dissipate over time and is typical of new appliances.

The cord is NOT a swivel cord but I do not find I need that.

In summary, this is a very nice basic brush blow dryer and I love its simplicity. The white and gold finish is attractive and I love the feel of the carry satchel. I do feel that this is best used by those with hair beyond shoulder length.

title: Razors are beautiful; works best without clips; clips bend when securing – 3.4 stars
text:
At the current price of $49.99 ($69.99 minus $20), there is a lot that comes in this set. This set includes two trimmers (large and small), 13 guide combs. a brush to clean the razor, a scissor, two USB power cords for charging, a cape, instructions, and a case. The small guide combs are 1, 2, 3, and 4mm. The larger guides are 1/16", 1/8", 3/16", 1/4", 3/8", 1/2", 3/4", and 1". I was surprised no oil was provided to lubricate the trimmers.

The clippers by themselves work wonderfully. However, the clip on guide combs bend a bit immediately when trying to affix it to the top of their appropriate trimmer. In addition, once the guide combs are in place, the trimmers do not cut as well. Perhaps it is the angle I used. I love the trimmers by themselves without the use of the combs. The cape is a cheap one and so is the scissor (made of cheap plastic handles) but the scissor does cut, which is good.

Note that both trimmers arrived fully charged. When I was done, I charged the trimmers with the provided USB cables (USB wall plug adapter not included). The LED shows 100% when it is fully charged.

In summary, these two razors are absolutely gorgeous. I love the artistic design on the front of each. I consider these good for precision work without the guide combs. The guide combs are okay. The larger combs work better than the smaller ones which bend. In addition, there is no way to easily remove the head for cleaning without a screwdriver. The supplied brush is good temporarily.

title: Multifunctional facial cleansing brush; have no idea what the lights are for
text:
[[VIDEOID:5246431246183033c1732730295a3346]] For the current price of $23.59 ($30.59 minus $7 off), this is an excellent facial cleansing tool with many functions.

IN THE BOX:
- Cleansing wand with cap cover
- USB charging cable
- Stand
- Five cleansing brushes (exfoliating brush, soft brush, silicone brush, soft sponge brush, and pumice brush)
- User guide

I charged this for about two hours until the charging light turned from red to blue. In order to use it, I had to remove the cover on the wand and insert each brush I tried. There are three cleaning modes: gentle, daily, and deep cleaning. There are also two light modes. I have no idea what they are for because there is no mention of it in the manual. However, I tried another brush like this where the manufacturer made claims that when the red light is engaged, it is supposed to stimulate collagen growth and reduce wrinkles. When the blue light is engaged, it is supposed to eliminate bacteria and prevent acne and blackheads. I do not believe in such stuff but at least they did not make any false claims that I could see.

Note that the instruction manual is not very good. To start the unit I have to hold the mode button until it turns on. The same thing goes with the light button. Once these buttons are engaged, then a quick press changes the mode or the light. To turn off, once again it is a long press of both buttons.

There is only one brush head I hate and I think it is best used for the heels of the feet instead of the face. That "brush" is the pumice stone. I tried it on the tip of my chin and it felt like it was going to rip my skin off, so be careful.

The base cup is only good to hold the unit and it cannot be charged when sitting in the base. To me this is a negative.

In summary, I really love the number of brushes provided and the function of this unit. It charges fast as well. The pumice "brush," in my opinion, should never be used on the face. The current price is reasonable for this unit's features. I tried other wands in the past that were in the $99 to $120 range that were less robust than this. Note that I have no idea how long these brush heads will last with use.

title: Excellent blow dryer for $19.99; attachments are slightly tricky to seat; cord is not a swivel cord
text:
At the current price of $19.99, this is an excellent blow dryer. If it were priced higher than $25, I would have rated this 4 stars simply because of the price for this basic dryer.

This dryer is very attractive. In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user guide, a concentrator, and a diffuser. The dryer works very well but attaching the tools takes a little bit of finagling but it's not too bad. Detaching is easy.

Before first use, the red button on the plug has to be pushed in or it won't turn on. There are three controls on the front. The cool shot button is more like a cool shot toggle. The middle button is the high, medium, and low for the heat. There is also an on/off, low, and high for the speed, which is the last button.

The cord is NOT a swivel cord but I do not find I need that. There is a loop at the base of the cord for hanging. This dried my hair well.

In summary, this is a very nice basic blow dryer and I love simplicity. The black and gold finish is attractive. It functions well as it was designed to do and the current $19.99 price is spot on for this.

title: Great hairbrush; love that it's not only boar bristle; makes a wonderful gift
text:
This is a really nice hairbrush. In the package is a boar & nylon bristle brush, a brush cleaner, and a cloth case that covers the brush head.

I was worried the brush head was going to be all boar bristle but there are some nylon bristles interspersed in the head. When I ordered it, nylon was not mentioned in the title but now it is. This makes it easy to glide through my hair yet provides the gentle touch of boar bristle. Although the brush works well, the only thing I do not like is the brush cleaner. I always find cleaners do not work well and this one is no different. It is okay but not great.

I love that this comes with a nice cloth pouch to cover the brush head.

The current price of $12.95 is competitively priced for this set.

title: Typical thin, small satin scrunchies; don’t like that they are tied together
text:
There are three thin and small satin scrunchies in this package; two in black and one in mauve (pinkish).

These hold my hair well but as is expected of satin, can easily slide out. These are best on long hair because the potential to slide off is not as great.

The current price of $10 comes to $3.33 per band which is insanely priced and the reason I took off one star from the four-star rating I was going to give. Note that they need to do away with the sewn ribbon around the three scrunches that has to be cut off. They can save some money there and pass that onto the consumer. I actually needed a scissor to separate these scrunchies because of the ribbon.

title: Lovely full-sized deodorant; the rose & lavender fragrances are subtle; keeps me fresh for 12 hours
text:
I love intense fragrance and specifically love men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. However, this set does not have that ingredient and each one protected me for 12 hours until my next shower. Of course, it is still spring, so the real sweat fest hasn't yet started.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. I can barely smell either the lavender or the rose scent and I have a very sensitive nose. I really would have loved a stronger fragrance for both of them. Nevertheless, this keeps me pretty much scentless between showers, which means it works. Note that the balm is very hard so it does not roll on thick like other deodorants.

The current price of $26.99 ($29.99 minus 10%) is a bit pricey for this but not as bad as the price per ounce of their travel size I tried previously. This comes to $13.50 per stick. I took off 1 star for the price and too subtle a scent because now I am very used to their very hard balm. Otherwise, this is very nice deodorant.

title: Typical thin satin scrunchies; I wouldn’t call them jumbo
text:
There are six satin scrunchies in this package in different muted colors. They are thin and are definitely NOT jumbo but they are typical of what I expect of satin holders.

These hold my hair well but as is expected of satin, can easily slide out. These are best on long hair because the potential to slide off is not as great.

The current price of $5.99 comes to $1 per band which is a bit pricey especially since they are not jumbo size.

title: Not as smelly as most other unrefined shea butter; it’s ultra-moisturizing but really pricey
text:
This shea butter smells natural and unrefined so it does have a little bit of that "burnt tobacco" smell. However, it is not as bad as some unrefined shea butters I previously used in a body butter recipe and the "natural fragrance" is almost imperceptible.

I got this to use "as is" as a moisturizer. It is super moisturizing and makes my hands and body feel incredibly hydrated. Since I have been using shea butter for a while now, I am getting used to the smell. I love shea butter's antibacterial properties. I have dry patches on my elbows and this helps reduce that. Of course, since this is in a solid square of a tub, I have to dig it out to use or let it melt with the heat of my hands.

In summary, this shea butter is great. It is perfect for use in body butter recipes or by itself. This is ultra-moisturizing and absorbs well. The current price of $55 for 12 ounces is super expensive, however, and that is the only reason I rated this 4 stars. I purchased this [[ASIN:B01M0IH7L5 Ashanti shea butter]], which to me works equally well, for $9.99 for 10 ounces. BTW, I really do not like the sticky white label they put across this tin as it cheapens the butter and covers the usage directions.

title: Dense soap bar; nice fragrance; yellow color rinses off; I don’t believe slimming claims; pricey
text:
This is a small bar of soap. The soap is dense and the yellow color comes off during use, which I do not like--meaning it doesn't wash clear. What I also do not like is that there are what look like wire hairs in the soap. However, I really love the fragrance. The soap lathers moderately and cleans well too but the yellow color that comes off is a turnoff to me. I do not believe the slimming or lymphatic/detoxification claims---that is just ridiculous to me.

The ingredients are ginger extract, olive oil, shea butter, glycerin, coconut oil, wormwood, and etc. Who knows what "etc." is.

The current price of $9.99 is expensive for this small bar. After having tried it I would never order it again as the fragrance is pretty much the only thing I like about the bar.

title: One comfortable mask that blocks out all light & does not irritate my eyes; earplugs included
text:
There is one relatively soft, but full-bodied sleep mask in this package along with one package of reusable ear plugs and a carry case. This mask has eye cutouts. It also has a Velcro adjustment in the back.

Since there is an eye socket channel, I can open my eyes underneath without touching the front of it and it blocks out all light.

This is very comfortable to wear and fits me very well. I also do not sweat in this. In addition, it does not move around when I lay down with it. Overall, I am very pleased with this.

The current price of $12.34 ($12.99 minus 5%) is competitively priced.

title: Very cleansing, nice fragrance, copious suds
text:
I love men's body washes, perfumes, and deodorants. This shower gel/shampoo is very nice. It has a manly or slightly musky scent I like. I used it as a shower gel and not a shampoo. However, it produced a lot of suds and I felt totally cleansed and refreshed after using this.

The current price of $14.90 for a 500ml (i.e 16.907 fluid ounces) bottle is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Lightweight basic razor good for straight areas like legs; pinches on curved areas
text:
This razor is good and simple to use. It comes with the unit itself, a charging base, a USB cable but NO A/C adapter, a cleaning brush, a protective blade cover, and a manual. I charged this about two hours before first use until the red light went out.

Operation is simple. Just press hold the power button until it turns on. There is only one speed and a light. I was able to shave my legs but other curved areas such as the chin or under the lips either pinches or the results are not as good. This is best on the straightaway.

The head is easy to remove for cleaning by either blowing away the hair or with the brush.

Even though this says it is a wet/dry razor, I only use it dry.

In summary, no electric razor shaves close to the skin unless it's a bladed manual and this one is no different. However, it does do a good job on what I call the straightaway areas like the legs and thighs. The biggest negative is the angle of the razor with the small charging base. Due to this, the razor unit is easy to tip over during charging. The current price of $16.89 ($25.99 minus 35%) is reasonable for this.

title: Goes on smooth with matte finish; color is light
text:
There are 12 liquid color wands in this set. The colors are numbered on the bottom and not named. They are difficult to remove from the package without prying them up with a nail file or something similar.

The color glides smoothly onto my lips but it is a matte finish. I need lip gloss or Vaseline to go on top. The colors are also light and not too deep. The color does have some staying power.

Overall, this is a nice set for those who like matte pinks / reds. The current price of $12.99 comes to a reasonable $1.08 per wand.

title: Definitely disposable & not for major tangles but they do what they claim
text:
There are 50 individually wrapped disposable combs in this set for the current price of $14.09 ($14.99 minus 6%), which comes to $.28 cents each.

The combs are small and hard to grasp and they are not even very strong. They can be reused but they will not last long. I was able to comb my short to medium hair with one of these but I had to be careful. However, these are designed to be disposable and unless one has a tangle, this will work. Of course, they are best for short hair.

What I do not like is that they come in a stinky plastic bag.

title: Lovely set of two hair towels; absorbent & has secure hold
text:
I did not think I was going to be impressed by these towels but they are lovely. They are large and have an elasticized edge. They also have a loop at the tail on the inside bottom that allows me to twist the turban and then secure the excess to the back button. These are also absorbent when I did not think they would be. Microfiber is normally not that absorbent but these are different. I am used to terry cloth turbans but I must admit these are great. I tried other microfiber ones before and did not care for them, so I am pleasantly surprised. I would not put these in the dryer unless it was very low.

The current price of $9.34 ($10.99 minus 15%) comes to a reasonably priced $4.67 per towel.

UPDATE: I just washed these towels and they came out like new. I did tumble dry them on low. I absolutely love these hair towels.

title: Small mesh buff puff with no hanging ribbon; still creates copious suds
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only thing I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. This is a SMALL and NOT a LARGE one. I can get larger at Walmart for $2 each. 

This still works like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. However, another issue I have with this one is that it has no hanging loop. This is a first for me. All puffs come with a loop but this one does not.

The current price of $5.19 is insane for this. I took off one star for the lack of loop, one star for the small size, and one star for the crazy price in its current condition.

title: MOLDY body cream; went right in the garbage; this gets an F-
text: How about some mold with your body cream. This is disgusting. I just got this today and opened it and was presented with a jar of modly cream. This went right in the garbage. If I could give it zero stars I would.

title: Interesting clips with good hold; very stylish; a bit pricey
text: There are two checkered small claw clips in this package. The clips are interesting with their checkered pattern. They are a small/medium size and relatively well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on. They would work even better with longer hair. However, at the current price of $12.99, this comes to a very expensive $6.50 per clip. The quality of these clips is good and they are attractive but they are not worth that price in my opinion. This is the only reason I removed one star from my rating.

title: Well-made back brush with long handle but too much bristle shedding
text:
This brush has a large round head. The bristles are a little coarse and they do shed -- a lot. The handle is long, so it provides me with a good reach. This brush is sturdy and is perfect for soaping up my back. I love that this is one piece and that the head does not come off. The rope on top provides me with a good grip. In addition, there is a loop for hanging.

In summary, this is a good back brush with long reach and exfoliating bristles but due to the constant shed of the bristles, it is not one I would order again. The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced if the bristles did not shed so much.

title: More of a runny liquid than a gel but soap lathers & cleans well & smells nice
text:
When the bottle says this is a gel, I expect a soap that has more viscosity or body to it. However, this is very liquidy.

This smells very nice and lathers and cleans well. I just wish it was thicker. The current price of $3.74 ($4.98 minus 25%) for a 13.53 fluid ounce bottle is competitively priced for this.

title: Nicely fragrant; as good as plain Epsom Salt; particles will clog drain if no strainer is used
text:
At the current price of $12.95 for 10.5 ounces of bath salts with flower particles, this is expensive. However, the fragrance is very nice both dry and in the bath but I have to put a strainer in my sink to prevent the flower particles from going down the drain.

I bathed my feet for 10 minutes with about 1/4 jar of these bath salts. The salts took about 5-7 minutes to dissolve in the almost hot water. The experience is relaxing and the fragrance subtle but good but the results are no different than just plain Epsom Salt.

The high price is prohibitive enough to make this a once in a while treat for some people. As long as one does not mine straining their bath water for the particles and loves this fragrance, this is a nice jar of bath salts.

title: Nail clippers cut well and provide a good grip but clip fell off on first use - 2.5 stars
text:
At the current price of $13.99 ($19.99), this manicure kit is a heavy duty kit. It has two nail clippers (large and oblique) with their own nail file on the handle, a heavy duty toenail clipper, another clipper, two glass nail files, a nail pick/toenail lifter, and a cuticle trimmer.

All the items cut my nails well. The files work well too and the glass ones can be rinsed off. The toenail clipper is heavy duty but one of the spring clips fell off immediately (see photo). It actually operates better without it but I was able to put it back on.

This is a basic kit and I would have rated this 5 stars at the current price point if it were not for the spring clip falling off.

title: Attractive and functional basic manicure kit at a reasonable price but tweezer grip not good
text:
At the current price of $7.99, this manicure kit is a perfect basic kit. It has two nail clippers (large and oblique), an eyebrow scissor that can be used for the cuticles, a nail file, a nail pick, a tweezer, and an ear pick. The only item I do not use is the ear wax cleaner (a.k.a. ear pick). The scissor cuts well and both nail clippers do too. The tweezer is aligned correctly and works on removing hairs with precision but it DOES NOT have the grip I like. Most tweezers are bowed in the center for a good grip and this one is just flat all the way through (see photo). The case is a nice touch and is perfect for travel. It feels great in my hands, has a good clasp and holds all the tools effectively for easy retrieval.

This is a basic kit and I would have rated this 5 stars at the current price point if it were not for tweezer grip.

title: Shampoo lathers and cleans well; conditioner hydrates; does relax my curls a little – 3.5 stars
text:
I have short to medium-length fine curly hair. This shampoo lathers and cleans well and leaves my hair clean. The conditioner hydrates well. The fragrance of both is very nice. Unfortunately, it does relax my curls a little bit.

As to its ability to prevent hair loss, I have not noticed any change there. What I really do love about this combo is the fact that the pump top opens and closes with the twist of the head.

The current price of $16.99 ($19.99 minus 15%) is reasonable for this as it comes to $8.50 per 20.28 ounce bottle.

title: Love the multi-colors & angles in this sponge set; holder okay; slight smell
text:
This is a nice set of 5 sponges in multi-Easter pastel colors. It also comes with a cheap plastic sponge holder. There are various styles - one egg shaped, two hourglass, and two angled sponges. The sponges are dense. Less dense sponges soak up more liquid make-up than the denser ones.

I love the ones with a flat side which are great for smooth applications. The typical egg-shaped one and the hour-glass sponges are good for blending or any large make-up application. The hour-glass ones are easier to hold in the center.

These feel good in the hands, blend reasonably well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. The sponges do smell a little like pencil shavings but that will dissipate over time.

The sponges are similar in style to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too - at least to me.

The plastic holder is okay but cheap.

The current price of $7.19 comes to $1.44 per sponge, which is a little pricey, if considering the plastic holder a freebie.

title: This is a bare bones basic curling iron; good for tight curls on very short hair; kickstand lousy
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this iron allows me to get a slightly tighter curl. However, it is a bare bones model. There is a light telling the user when it has reached a certain temperature (meaning it stopped blinking). The temperature control goes from 225 to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. The kickstand is awful as it keeps collapsing. Therefore, it is important to wear the supplied glove when using this. I do love the 360 degree swivel cord ability as it keeps it from tangling.

In summary, this is perfect for short hair and makes my curls tighter because of the small barrel. If one is looking for a tight curl and wants a super basic curling iron, then this is it. The current price of $24.99 is competitively priced.

title: Love the colors, angles, & sizes in this sponge set; various density; holder okay; slight smell
text:
This is a nice set of 12 sponges in Easter pastel colors. It also comes with a cheap plastic sponge holder. There are various sizes and various densities in each style of egg shaped, hourglass, and angled sponges purple sponges. Less dense sponges soak up more liquid make-up than the denser ones.

I love the ones with a flat side which are great for smooth applications. The typical egg-shaped ones and the hour-glass sponges are good for blending or any large make-up application. The hour-glass ones are easier to hold in the center. I also love the various sizes as they allow for different applications to areas of the face like around the eyes.

These feel good in the hands, blend reasonably well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. The sponges do smell a little like pencil shavings but that will dissipate over time.

The sponges are similar in style to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too - at least to me.

The plastic holder is okay but cheap. It fits the largest pink sponge in the batch the best.

The current price of $10.79 comes to $.90 cents per sponge if considering the plastic holder a freebie.

title: Love the blue & pink colors & angles in this sponge set; the sponges are dense
text:
This is a lovely set of 10 sponges in two nice Easter colors. The sponges are dense. Less dense sponges soak up more liquid make-up than the denser ones. The blue ones have an angled side and the pink ones are egg shaped and there are five of each color.

The ones with a flat side are great for smooth applications. The typical egg-shaped ones are good for blending or any large make-up application.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These sponges are similar in style to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too - at least to me.

The current price of $8.39 is a great deal for these as it comes to $.84 cents per sponge. This would make a great gift for the Easter basket.

title: Moisturizing lip balm from Korea; a bit pricey
text:
At the current price of $11.99 ($12.99 minus $1), this lip balm is a bit pricey. I would expect that it would be $6 or less for this amount. Nevertheless, this is moisturizing and feels good on my lips. It does not feel waxy like other lip balms but more like Vaseline on the lips. I have no idea why they put a tab on the label so that it can be peeled off. I like that feature but others might not want something with no label on it.

In summary, this is nice lip balm but way too pricey.

title: Simple but heavy folding blow dryer; works well; love the magnetic attachments
text:
In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user guide, one concentrator, and a diffuser.

Besides the RESET button on the plug, there are four options on the handle ( ON/OFF button, cool fan button, low, and high temp).

The tools are magnetic and snap on and off the head of the unit easily. In fact, I absolutely love this feature.

Note that the cord is not a swivel cord but I find that is not needed. The only true negative to me is that the unit feels light at the beginning but gets heavy during use.

In summary, I love the results this dryer provides. It dried my hair quickly and beautifully. I have short to medium fine curly hair and it looked good after using this. I love the simplicity of this unit. The fact that it folds is unimportant to me. I suspect the unit will not last long if it is folded repeatedly. I never trust folded designs.

title: Fits in the palm of my hand; the rose fragrance is subtle; this keeps me fresh for 12 hours; pricey
text:
I love intense fragrance and specifically love men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. However, this one does not have that ingredient and it protected me for 12 hours until my next shower. Of course, it is still spring, so the real sweat fest hasn't yet started.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. I can barely smell the rose scent and I have a very sensitive nose. I really would have loved a stronger rose scent. Nevertheless, this keeps me pretty much scentless between showers, which means it works.

Note that this is a travel size and the balm is a little harder than I am used to. Most balms spread easily. This one takes several swipes. The current price of $3.99 is a bit steep for a .05 ounce solid stick that fits in my hand. I took off 1 star for the high price and 1 star for the too subtle scent and very hard balm. Otherwise, this is very nice deodorant.

title: Excellent 2-in-1 razor; does the job it is supposed to do; wish it came with a carry pouch
text:
I am one of the very rare people that likes these types of small pocket razors. I actually keep two of these active at all times in both of my bathrooms.

This is just like my others and is an excellent 2-in-1 razor. It comes with two heads, a micro-USB cable (A / C adapter NOT included), a cleaning brush, and a user pamphlet. I charged it for about six hours before the first use until the red light turned green.

There is what I call a bullet head that I used to clean between my eyebrows and under my nose and it did an excellent job. I even use it to clean a wayward hair below my knuckles.

I used the flat head for my entire face but mostly it's for above my lip and my chin and that also did an excellent job without pinching me. The only negative is that it is difficult to remove and re-attach the bullet head as there is not much leverage to do that.

In summary, I love this set. It is perfect for touch-up and very small shaving needs. The current price of $12.99 is competitively priced for this "pocket" razor but I do wish it came with a tiny cloth bag for carrying.

title: Cleansing w/light lather; fragrance too subtle; bar is slippery like many vegan soaps
text:
The pink color of the bar is not as rich looking as it is in photos--just beware the color is more dull in person despite what my photo and the Amazon photo shows.

This bar is cleansing but the lather is very light and the fragrance is too subtle for me. Also, the soap is slippery like many vegan soaps I tried previously. It sometimes slips out of my hands. What I also do not like is the rose petals in the soap as they go down the drain. I'm not partial to soaps with particles that can actually clog one's pipes.

The current price of $9.99 is also expensive for this small bar.

title: Thick barrel curling iron that heats fast & is simple to use
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and I get a light curl with this iron as this is best for those with long hair. This iron is simple to operate and simple to use. It comes with one heat protective glove and a user guide. There is a light telling the user when it has reached a certain temperature. The switches are on the top side. There are three switches -- on/off and temperature up and down. The temperature goes from 225 to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. To turn the unit on, I have to press the on/off switch. To change the temperature, I have to press either the plus or minus buttons several times until it shows the temperature I prefer. There is a bit of give in the controls, meaning they sink in or move and I press them but I believe it is supposed to work that way.

There is a little prop in the middle that keeps the hot iron off my counter by a little bit.

The current price of $19.99 ($24.99 minus 20%) is reasonable for this. I really like the simplicity of this curling iron, its length, and the 360 degree cord swivel. It also works well on my hair but would work great on someone with longer hair.

title: Very nice beard kit with a great pair of scissors
text:
At the current price of $29.74 ($34.99 minus 15%), this is a nicely packaged beard gift for a bearded man. In the beautiful wooden box is a pair of scissors, a burlap pouch, a beard brush, a double-sided comb, beard wash, beard growth oil, beard balm, and beard wax. The only negative thing about the set is that the brush sheds.

Overall, this is a really nice set and I definitely would not feel ashamed giving this as a gift.

title: Love the artistic look & feel of this bar; also cleans and lathers well;  pregnant woman precaution
text:
This bar of soap comes with a warning of "If under the age of 18 or pregnant, consult your doctor before use." I have no idea why that warning exists. Perhaps it is due to one of the ingredients.

Nevertheless, I absolutely love the look of this bar. It is hard and feels like a piece of molded stone. This is so artistic that it would look great in a home with marble or granite countertops. As for performance, it lathers and cleans well and I noticed no irritation or ill effect from using this. This can be used on the face and body.

The current price of $18.99 is outrageous, however. This and the warning are the main reason I marked this down to 3 stars. Otherwise, I love this soap. The subtle fragrance is nice too.

title: Very nice soap bar; lathers/cleans well; plastic is difficult to remove from soap
text: I love the citrus scent of this soap. The bar is small but that makes it easy to hold. Also, it lathers and cleans well. However, removing the plastic from the bar of soap before use is difficult as it adheres to the bar. Also, the current price of $9.90 for such a small bar of soap is outrageous.

title: Fragrant steamers when dry; subtle fragrance when wet; lasted entire shower & left no stains
text:
There are 12 sweet orange essential oil shower steamers in this package along with a plastic cutter for the wrappers. I love the aroma when dry as it is intense.

I put this in the shower away from the full stream of water at first and barely detected an aroma. After a few minutes in the shower of being outside a direct stream of water, hardly any scent was generated so I put it almost in a direct stream of water. It lasted the entire shower but the fragrance was subtle and it was only noticeable when the shampoo, body wash, and soap that I used in the shower were unscented. If my soaps had a fragrance, then I smelled nothing.

One thing I love is that it did not stain my tub. The orange color just washed away.

The current price of $16.19 ($17.99 minus 10%)comes to $1.35 per steamer which is very reasonable. The performance is average. I was surprised since others rated these so highly.

title: Uniquely designed combo straighten/curling iron w/temp from 330 to 430 degrees
text:
The current price of $28.45 is reasonable for this two-in-one iron. I love its unique design. The iron is curved so it allows me to either straighten my hair or curl it. The iron's controls are on the exterior of the blade, so it is easy to turn on the unit and adjust the temperature with the + or - buttons. The temperature goes from 330 to 430 degrees Fahrenheit and when the LED readout stops blinking, it has reached its temperature. There is a lock lever on the opposite side of the blades.

There is some spacing between the blades but not enough to affect performance. The cord has a 360 swivel to prevent tangling, which I love.

I used it to both straighten and curl my hair and it did a decent job. I like that the heat plate is four inches long if measured straight from outside tip to tip.

In summary, this is a really nice one-inch straightener / curling iron. The design, its simplicity, and ease of operation make this easy to fall in love with. It also comes with a 36-month warranty.

title: Runny, sticky, disgusting lotion – I need a shower after using this
text: This lotion is absolutely yucky to me. I tried this on my skin and it is runny, sticky, and feels like I spilled lemonade or another sticky substance all over my body. I could not wait to wash this off. This is so bad, it went right in the garbage. I can't believe they are charging $32.40 for this stuff. It's gross.

title: Pretty detangling comb/brush combo but cheaply made; too expensive
text: The current price of $16.99 for this set is outrageous. This feels cheap. The tines on the brush feel like they are made of dollar store plastic. This does detangle but sort of rips at my hair. It is best used in the shower. The comb has a wide tooth and is okay but is also cheap. The set is pretty but it is not worth the price. If this were $4 or less, it would have received 3 stars as just an okay set for occasional use. At its current price, I would say pass. Note that fingerprints show up easily on the faceplate of the brush.

title: Fragrant steamers when both dry & wet; lasted entire shower & left no stains
text:
There are eight (8) shower steamers (sweet orange, peppermint, rose, lavender, lemon, vanilla, eucalyptus, and grapefruit) in this package along with a plastic cutter for the wrappers. I do not like the aroma of the peppermint or grapefruit ones but the others smell nice.

I tried the rose one in my shower and made sure to put it away from the full stream of water at first. After a few minutes in the shower of being outside a direct stream of water, hardly any scent was generated so I put it almost in a direct stream of water. It dissolved in about 7 minutes and the fragrance was great; however, the aroma was limited to my shower area only and did not extend to the rest of the bathroom. Nevertheless, that was enough. My shampoo, body wash, and soap that I used in the shower did not overpower this steamer like others I tried previously.

One thing I love is that it did not stain my tub. The pink color just washed away.

The current price of $16.99 comes to $2.12 per steamer which is pricey. The performance is surprisingly good relative to others I tried previously.

title: Leaves my face and neck feeling super silky; love this stuff; not only for men
text:
Nowhere on the box or jar does this say this is for the face only. Nevertheless, it says to apply at least 15 minutes before sun exposure. I have no reason why that is. I used this on my face and neck and it absorbed quickly and left my skin feeling super silky. It is 5-star wonderful and not only for men, in my opinion. The only reason I took off one star is because of the confusing application instructions. I want to know why I need to apply this 15 minutes before sun exposure when it is not an SPF lotion. Also, why does the Amazon site say for the face but the jar says just any area of skin but it can be used as an aftershave.

The current price of $24.85 is competitively priced for this if this is truly just a face or aftershave cream.

title: Subtle & nice fragrance; lasts entire shower but scented shower products overpower the scent - 2.5*
text:
There are 12 square shower steamers in this package. Six are citrus and six are lemongrass aroma. The instructions say to put this on a ledge outside the direct shower stream. I did that, but the fragrance was subtle. I then put this in an indirect stream of water from the shower and it was not much better. However, once I used my scented shower products no fragrance was detected. I find that to be the case with 95% of the shower steamers I tried. In fact, I have yet to find one that I love.

The fragrance of both is nice but fleeting. I am glad the color is non-staining. At the current price of $28.47 ($29.97 minus 5%), this comes to an expensive $2.37 per "steamer tablet." At this price money quickly washes down the drain. The one thing I do love very much about this, however, is that each steamer is individually wrapped and also shrink-wrapped inside that. This means these steamers can be used as stocking stuffers or for an Easter basket.

title: Attractive & simple blow dryer with 3 tools; works well
text:
For the current price of$29.59 ($36.99 minus 20%), this blow dryer is reasonably priced. In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user guide, one concentrator, one volumizing brush, and one straight comb. Also included is a wire hanging rack and a stick on square of two hooks to hold the blow dryer. That is not something I would use.

Besides the RESET button on the plug, there are five options on the handle (ON/OFF button, cool fan button, low, high temp, and a cool shot button). The tools are easy to screw on and off the head of the blow dryer. Note that the cord is not a swivel cord but I find that is not needed.

I love the results this dryer provides. It dried my hair quickly and beautifully and without any static. I have short to medium fine curly hair and it looked good after using this. I love the simplicity of this unit. Also the pink and gray color combination is just wonderful. Note that this can get a bit heavy to hold with extended use.

title: Simple but heavy folding blow dryer; works well; love the magnetic attachments
text:
For the current price of $49.99, this blow dryer is competitively priced. In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user guide, one concentrator, and a diffuser.

Besides the RESET button on the plug, there are four options on the handle ( ON/OFF button, cool fan button, low, and high temp).

The tools are magnetic and snap on and off the head of the unit easily. In fact, I absolutely love this feature.

Note that the cord is not a swivel cord but I find that is not needed. The only true negative to me is that the unit feels light at the beginning but gets heavy during use.

In summary, I love the results this dryer provides. It dried my hair quickly and beautifully. I have short to medium fine curly hair and it looked good after using this. I love the simplicity of this unit. The fact that it folds is unimportant to me. I suspect the unit will not last long if it is folded repeatedly. I never trust folded designs.

title: No-frills straightener with temp from 250 to 500 degrees; I am unsure when it reaches temp
text:
The current price of $18.99 ($28.99 minus $10 coupon) is reasonable for this flat iron.

The iron's controls are on the interior of the blades, so it can be difficult to adjust. However, many flat irons have this feature. There is a wheel temperature dial that goes from 250 to 500 degrees Fahrenheit but there is no LED readout. This means I never know when it reaches that temperature because the red light stays on all the time when the unit is turned on.

The cord has a 360 swivel to prevent tangling, which I love. Also, the alignment of the plates is spot on--not too tight or too loose.

I used it to straighten my hair and it did an okay job. I had to do a lot of passes because the plate is only 3.5" long.

In summary, this is an okay one inch flat iron. The iron itself works but it is basic and I do not like that I cannot tell when the plates have heated up to the set temperature. The results are satisfactory but nothing outstanding. The iron's best feature is its swivel cord. It also comes with a 1-year warranty.

title: Useful pedicure stand as long as it is not on its highest two settings
text:
For the current price of $18.99 one gets a pedicure stand and one toe spacer. I personally could do without the spacer.

The stand is adjustable to several levels. However, it is narrow and because of that, it is unsteady when it is on its highest two levels. This works for me when it is only slightly inclined and for that reason I like it. However, if this were about four inches wider, I suspect it would not be so unsteady. This can also be used for those who need to elevate their feet to put on their shoes; however, it really needs to be wider.

If this were four inches wider, then not only would this be a pedicure foot rest but it would also be an assistive device for elevating the feet to put on shoes. It would have received 5 stars from me had this been the case. In its current state, this is good as long as one is not using all the levels.

title: Large, colorful clips that provide a great hold on medium & long hair
text: There are six large clips in this package in colorful designs. What I love is their holding power. I have short-to-medium fine curly hair and this holds my hair very well in the back. I also like the selection. For the current price of $7.49 ($7.88 minus 5%), this comes to $1.25 per clip, which I consider competitively priced given the size, style, and sturdiness of these clips.

title: Subtle fragrance; moisturizes lightly; a bit pricey
text: I had tried this Finn [[ASIN:B09HR4VKQB body cream]] and loved it so much that I was dying to try this. This body oil lightly moisturizes and is not greasy. It absorbs somewhat but leaves a light barrier on the skin. My skin felt soft after using this. I like the subtle fragrance but the aroma is too subtle. I like intense fragrance and the scent always has to be spectacular for me to love it--like their body cream. The current price of $38 is expensive for this 8 ounce bottle that I find is not bad but outstanding either.

title: Body wash fragrance smells like a cheap old lady perfume; washes and lathers well
text:
I had tried this Finn [[ASIN:B09HR4VKQB body cream]] and loved it so much that I was dying to try this. However, the fragrance of this is so intense and cheap smelling that it is a turnoff. It reminds me of perfume old ladies used to douse themselves with back in the sixties when going to Church.

The body wash lathers and cleans well but the scent is terrible. The current price of $30 for 8 ounces is insane for this, especially because the fragrance is so horrid and I love fragrance.

title: Lightweight scentless eye cream that is mildly moisturizing; too pricey
text: I applied this cream to my eyes after a shower. It is lightweight and scentless and only mildly moisturizing. It is perfect for the summer. The current price of $60 is way too expensive for this cream. If it were much thicker and had a nice scent, then it would have received 4 or 5 stars from me depending on the price.

title: Great hairbrush for short hair; makes a wonderful gift
text:
This is an impressive looking hairbrush and it is best used on short hair or men with buzz cuts. In the package is a beautiful boar bristle brush, a brush cleaner, and a cloth case that covers the brush head.

The brush has a light touch. The cloth pouch is nice too. The only thing I do not like is the brush cleaner. I always find cleaners do not work well and this one is no different. It is okay but not great.

The current price of $10.39 ($12.99 minus 20%) is very reasonable for this set. This will make a beautiful gift. The most impressive piece is the lion image on the back of the brush.

title: Wonderfully fragrant soap that cleans & lathers well but avoid washing certain areas; pricey
text:
There is a warning on this package that this is not to be applied on eyes, ears, mouth, and genitals but the Amazon site says this is good for jock itch. Then it says if "wipes" contact these areas, rinse promptly and thoroughly with water. Also, the box says to apply the soap to the skin and allow it to stay on the skin for several minutes. With all these warnings, I would never order this again. Nevertheless, I love this soap.

This bar has tea tree oil in it, which gives it its antifungal properties. However,  it does not smell medicinal like tea tree oil. It smells wonderful. It cleans and lathers well also.  The current price of $8.99 is pricey for this small bar.

title: Smells fantastic; hydrates well; not only for men in my opinion
text: At the current price of $29.99 for a 2.5 ounce tub, this is on par with a lot of women's creams. This facial skin condition smells fantastic and hydrates well. It took about one minute to absorb, but after that my face and neck felt silky. I love it. To me this thick cream is not only for men but women too even though it has an intoxicating aftershave scent.

title: I love the fragrance of this bubble bath and it cleans well but the tops don't work
text: I love the fragrance of this bubble bath. The rose water is my favorite. I also feel clean after using this. This is a very nice set. At the current price of $11.79, this comes to a reasonable $5.90 per 13 fluid ounce bottle. What I also love about these is the tassels that come with the bottles. I can use those to decorate a purse or keyring. However, I am very upset that the tops on either bottle do not work. Instead, I have to remove the caps and pour out the bubble bath. I cannot recommend these for that reason.

title: Both these oils smell absolutely wonderful and are hydrating
text: I love these oils. The fragrance of both the lavender and the coconut body oils is great. Also, these oils leave my skin feeling silky. These are perfect for the fall or winter, which is the time I use body oil. Also, the current price of $10.39 ($15.99 minus 35%) comes to a very reasonable $5.20 per 8.8 fluid-ounce bottle of oil.

title: I only like the soothing cream & can pass on the other items
text:
At the current price of $24 ($30 minus 20%), this comes to $6 per item. There are four travel-sized skincare items in this package. The products are a fresh cleansing oil, facial cleanser, unscented toner, and soothing cream. The first two items are cleansing products. I tried all items and did not care for anything but the soothing cream.

The oil and toner are difficult to dispense from the bottle. I really had to squeeze hard. The cleansing oil did nothing for me, nor do I feel it was cleansing. The facial cleanser is okay but not better than soap. The toner is good but I personally do not use toner much. The soothing cream is hydrating and I like that. It is like a good unscented face cream.

title: Way overpackaged for a gift; decent lather & cleansing wash w/subtle fragrance
text:
My first impression of this set was not good. It comes in a box three times the size of the product with a lot of black paper padding. If a man were receiving this as a gift, I think he would be expecting more product and be a bit disappointed. There are two body washes and two beard/hair washes in this box. If I removed all the packaging I could fit three sets in this box.

The washes and hair washes are all the same. The fragrance is subtle. I used the hair wash on my hair and it really cleans with moderate lather. The same with the body wash. The results of both items do not blow me away. The washes are just okay but the packaging is a big negative. Also, the current price of $16.99 is a bit much for this ensemble. At this price, it comes to $4.25 per travel-sized bottle.

title: Wonderful suntan cream; absorbs quickly & leaves my skin with a silky barrier
text: This is a light, white creamy suntan lotion with an SPF of 30. It contains 21% Zinc Oxide. What I particularly love about this is that it goes on smoothly, absorbs rapidly, and leaves my skin feeling like it has a silky barrier on it. I love this. It is also scentless. The current price of $49.61 is outrageous, however, and is the only reason I took off one star.

title: This is not a hydrating cream; it is a tinted SPF
text: I abslutely hate tinted creams. This is a tinted SPF cream and is not the hydrating one pictured. The current price of $49.61 is also outrageous for this.

title: Love the beachy fragrance of this thick cream; just like lightweight body butter
text:
At the current price of $38, this cream is insanely expensive for 6.7 ounces. However, I love the fragrance so much and the way it moisturizes my body, that I did not take off one star for the high price like I normally do.

I used this on my body and not only did I smell incredibly good but my skin felt luxuriously silky. This is one intense body cream and I absolutely love it. It is like a lightweight body body, I do hope the price comes down because if it does, I would order this again.

title: Very nice beard kit; scissor cuts well but is a bit loose
text:
At the current price of $29.99, this is a nicely packaged beard gift for a bearded man. In the package is a pair of scissors, a burlap pouch, a beautiful comb and brush set, three beard balms and three beard oils both in unscented, citrus, and sandalwood.

The only negative thing about the set is the scissors are loose. I kept tightening them with the knob but they loosen up quickly. However, they cut well when they are tightened.

Overall, this is a decent set--not professional but reasonable. I definitely won't feel ashamed giving this as a gift.

title: Cream packaging not in English; cream is hydrating but acts as barrier; aroma okay
text:
This jar of face cream comes with several small samples of their other products. Except for the tiny sample in the jar that looks half full (see photo), all the samples have some directions in English. However, the main cream does not. Everything is in Korean. This is a disappointment.

I tried this on my face and neck and the cream is hydrating. I personally am not crazy about the subtle odor. It is just okay and I'm glad it is light. Also the cream stays on top of my skin like a barrier and does not absorb much. This face cream is just okay and is not something I would order again. It lacks the instructions, absorption, and wonderful fragrance I am looking for in a face cream. It does have the hydration effect it should, however. I woke up in the morning with my face feeling really moisturized.

title: Complete brow set but wand is like mascara and not clear
text:
This is a nice brow set that comes in a box with a magnetic closure. Included in the set is a brow wand with dark brow mascara for the brows, a brow pencil, and both medium and dark brown powder.

I have very thick brows that are getting paler as I get older. This pencil colors the brows in nicely and glides on easily as does the powder. The medium powder is light and does not show much on my brows but the dark brown works better.
