When I used the wand, I actually thought the gel was going to be a "clear mascara" but it is dark brown.

In summary, this is a nice set but it (mostly the pencil and mascara wand) will not last long with daily use. For the current price of $12, this is competitively priced.

title: Big, oddly-shaped bobby-pin-style bows that cannot be displayed correctly
text:
These bows are pretty but they are oddly shaped with an extra loop on one side and the white of some of the loops are showing. They are clip style bows and hold the hair well. They are more for a young girl because these bows are large at about 7" from tip to tip. I do not feel a young girl will mind too much if these are not perfect but I mind.

The bows I received look nothing like the perfect that is pictured. At the current price of $12.98, these come to $6.49 each and should be perfect at that price.

title: Moisturized my face and neck but I can’t stand the fragrance
text: The fragrance of this cream is such a turn off to me that I only used it once. I rubbed this over my face and neck and it is very moisturizing and absorbs quickly. However, I love fragrance but this one is just terrible. I wish I could describe the scent but I can't. It makes me want to run. The current price of $36 is also pricey for this. If the fragrance was to my liking, I would have rated this 4 stars. If both the fragrance was better and the price was under $30, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Like lip balm for the eyes; lashes transfer cream to glasses
text:
I really like this eye balm. It's like lip balm for the eyes. I just take the stick and rub it across my eyelids. The problem is that it gets on my lashes and I wear glasses. As a result, some of the balm does transfer to my eyeglasses and I wind up having to clean them right after application. Other than this, this is super hydrating. I love it and it is perfect for winter.

The current price of $26.99 is pricey, however.

title: Good antibacterial foot soak but very expensive
text:
I used one ounce of this for each gallon of water to bathe my feet. This dissolves faster than Epsom Salt so that what I am left with is a bath of clear water almost immediately after running the water.

It has the typical tree tree oil aroma mixed with other scents. My feet came out feeling clean but no better or worse than if I had just used Epsom salt which is cheaper. However, I know tea tree oil acts as an antibacterial so this is good for those who need it.

At the current price of $22.97 ($24.97 minus 2), this comes to $11.49 per pound as there are two one-pound bags in this package.

title: The fragrance is almost undetectable but this keeps me fresh
text:
I love intense fragrance and specifically men's deodorants WITH aluminum because they seem to be what usually works for me. I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. Rarely can I get by with a stick that does not have aluminum. However, this one does not have that ingredient and it protected me for 12 hours until my next shower. Of course, it is spring, so the real sweat fest hasn't yet started.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to protection beyond 12 hours. I can barely smell the Coastal Lavender and Sea Salt scent and I have a very sensitive nose. Nevertheless, this keeps me pretty much scentless between showers, which means it works.

This works better than other non-aluminum deodorants I tried previously. The current price of $16 is a bit steep for a 2.85 ounce solid stick. I took off 1 star for the high price and 1 star for the too subtle scent. Otherwise, this is very nice deodorant with a screw top lid.

title: Intense menthol fragrance but still does not overpower my scented soaps - 2.5 stars
text: There are eight(8) methol-smelling shower steamers this size of a kid's bath bomb in this package. The instructions say to put it in a direct stream to activate the steamer and then outside the stream to last the entire shower. Mine lasted for two showers. However, the fragrance is only detectable if I am not actually washing. I have lots of scented soaps and shampoos and I could not smell this steamer at all until I finished my shower and was rinsing. To me this is not worth it. I am also not crazy about the menthol aroma.  At the current price of $13.99 ($19.99 minus $6) this comes to $1.75 per "steamer tablet."

title: Superb blow dryer for home use; less so for a professional due to cord length; pricey
text:
For the current price of $149.99 ($199.99 minus $50), this blow dryer is expensive. In its current condition, it should be priced around $115--see dislikes.

In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user guide, two concentrators (small and large), and a diffuser.

Besides the ON/OFF button and RESET button on the plug, there are 4 icons with a total of 8 LED selections available:

- blow dryer icon - fast dry mode; high air/temp; there's only one LED corresponding to this feature

- mid - middle air/temp for first LED; middle air/high temp for second LED

- low - low air/temp for first LED; low air blow/middle temp for second LED

- recycle or circular air flow icon is the cool/hot air alternating mode that blows various temperature cool air for 5 seconds then hotter air for 7 seconds; the first LED is low air/ temp; the second LED is middle air/temp; and third LED is high air/temp; however, pressing this button all the time dispenses cool air continuously.

FEATURES I LIKE:

- Unit is extremely lightweight--great for both professionals and home users

- Unit folds with the touch of a button and turn of the handle but it cannot be stored in the case that way

- The concentrators magnetically attach to the unit with ease

- The diffuser easily screws on and off the unit

- The unit comes with a nice case that zippers easily

- It has negative ion technology which reduces frizz and allows hair to retain its natural moisture

- The cap on the business end easily screws off for cleaning

MY DISLIKES:

- High price

- Cord is not long enough for professional use unless the chair is close to the socket. The cord from tip-to-tip is 6.5 feet long but I feel a 9-10 foot range is better, especially at this price.

- The cord is not a swivel cord

- Per the box, this is Model MS3002 which is1300W and not 1400W as the Amazon description currently states

In summary, I love the results this dryer provides. It dried my hair quickly and beautifully without the frizz. I have short to medium fine curly hair and it looked like my hair was salon styled after using this. I love that the dryer is lightweight and that it dries my hair quickly. I also love that the attachments attach and detach with ease. I would have preferred a swivel cord. Since this is for personal use, I do not care about the cord length. However, a professional would usually require a cord that is 9-10 feet for comfortably styling their customers. If one can work with 6.5 feet, then this is a nice dryer. The wattage is mislabeled on the Amazon site as I believe what is written on the box is correct but I have no way of knowing for sure. The price is also a bit steep. Certainly this model is the best blow dryer I ever had the pleasure of using even if it is not perfect.

title: Shampoo has almost ZERO lather but it’s moisturizing; fragrance OK; pump terrible to open
text:
I ordered this shampoo and their [[ASIN:B0896V9PB1 combo pack]] at the same time and regretted it. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this left my hair conditioned but flat; I really dislike this. The fragrance is just okay. The current price of $39.57 is insane for this but I would not buy this at any price after trying this.

The shampoo almost has ZERO lather and feels like I am washing with a hand lotion. Their other shampoo was even worse. I did not even feel like this got my hair clean.

Also, it took me about 20 minutes of fiddling with the top (before I got in the shower), to open the pump. Once I got it open, I had to pump it about 9 times before the shampoo dispensed. I had high hopes for this shampoo but they have been dashed based on my results.

title: Spreads easily; has nice light fragrance; am unsure of the claims
text:
This is a nice lightweight suntan lotion that is also moisturizing. I also like the very subtle but floral fragrance. Per the bottle, it is free of oxybenzone and octinoxate. The SPF 50 provides good protection. It rubs into my skin easily.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection, including this one. I also do not go in the ocean, so I cannot attest to the claims that this provides jellyfish sting protection.

The current price of $16.95 for a 3.4-ounce tube is expensive but since this is SPF 50, I expect the price to be higher.

title: Love the clear suave; very hydrating; great for overnight recovery
text: I applied this to my face and neck and it is super hydrating.  It created a barrier on my skin that eventually absorbed it. I like that the cream is clear and has a wonderful fragrance. The current price of $19.50 ($39 minus 50%) is very reasonable for this.

title: Scentless hydrating cream but it has a green tint to it
text: I am so repulsed by creams that are anything other than white or clear. It is some weird aversion that I have. This cream has a light green tint to it that I dislike. Other than this, it left my face and neck hydrated. It is scentless as well. If it did not have that tint, I would have rated this 4 stars. The current price of $29 is also a bit pricey. It's a good cream if one does not mind the faint green color. This is made in Korea.

title: Shampoo has ZERO lather & conditioner doesn’t pump out of the container
text:
This duo comes with shampoo and conditioner. I tried both and absolutely hate them. The fragrance is nice but the shampoo has ZERO lather and feels like I am washing with a hand lotion. The conditioner is so thick that it won't pump out of the bottle. I tried pumping over 30 times and still nothing. I had to remove the pump and hit the bottle against my hand to get anything out. It is thick and conditions well but because I can't get it out of the bottle, that gets 1 star also.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and this left my hair conditioned and flat; I absolutely hate it. The fresh fragrance is the only plus. The current price of $44 is insane for this but I would not buy this at any price after trying this.

title: Bandages have many uses; sticks to itself & not to skin/fur; not only tattoo grip tape
text:
These bandages have many uses. There are 6 assorted colored rolls that are individually wrapped and each roll is 5 yards apiece and 2 inches tall. There is one of each color of red, orange, blue, aqua, black, and purple. These self-adhere as the bandage is wrapped around a hand, leg, arm, etc. These stick well. The stretch allows this to be used like kinesiology tape with the exception that one cannot shower with this successfully and each wrap is for one-time use.

The entire roll does not have to be used at once as it depends on the amount needed. When used where joints open and close, such as a knee or elbow, the wrap may bunch up in the crease as expected. However, this is perfect to use as a lightweight version of a carpal tunnel brace by wrapping it around a bad wrist, hand, and thumb. It does not stick to my skin nor to a pet's fur, which is wonderful.

This is versatile enough to wrap around the handle of a tennis racquet to get a good grip or an umbrella or cane handle. There are just so many useful possibilities besides medical reasons.

In summary, because the wraps are two inches wide and are not designed to stick to the skin, it does have a tendency to bunch up if wrapped around a knee or elbow, so it is not perfect for everything. I feel these are great bandages to have in one's medicine cabinet. At the current price of $8.99 it comes to $1.50 per roll which is on the very high side of competitively priced. These are self-adhesive bandages rebranded as tattoo grip tape. Note that the side of the box shows 8 rolls but there are only 6 rolls--the yellow and camouflage are not included.

title: Smells & lathers okay; cleans well; bar is a bit slippery
text:
There is one thin bar of soap in this package. The aroma is detergent-like. This soap lathers okay and cleans well. Due to its small size,it ordinarily would be easy to hold but since the bar is slippery, it has a tendency to slip out of my hands periodically. Nevertheless, I did not notice it to " minimize expression lines and wrinkles, age spots, sagging skin, and collagen loss and control the premature aging process" as claimed on the Amazon site.

The current price of $8.45 is pricey for this.

title: Battery-operated vibrating shower/lotion brush w/3 vibration levels; gimmicky
text:
This is a take-off on a regular back brush and is a bit gimmicky to me. It is a well-made dual-head back brush or lotion applicator with a long handle. This brush is two-sided in the sense that it has silicone nibs on either side as shown in my photos.

I had to charge this with the supplied USB cable (no AC adapter included). The door to the outlet port is located on the back of the brush and has a silicone plug over it to keep water from getting in. Once the light was solid red, it was fully charged. To use it I had to "press hold" the ON/OFF button. To cycle through the three vibration levels, I just lightly tapped the ON/OFF button.

The silicone bristles are soft but using this is no better than using a regular brush to me. In fact, I find the vibration annoying. It is not like the brush goes in circles to clean, it just vibrates. I would have preferred this brush without the battery because I love the feel of the silicone. I actually prefer this more as a lotion brush but also without the vibration. The handle is long, so it provides me with a good reach. This brush is sturdy and has a hole in the handle for hanging.

In summary, this is a well-made dual-headed shower back brush or lotion applicator with a good reach. The vibration does nothing for me and I find that annoying. Also, the fact that this has a battery makes this brush heavy and more difficult to hold for long periods. Note that the silicone attracts a lot of hair. If this brush came without the battery and as a result was light without the gimmick, I would have rated this 5 stars. The current price of $23.99 ($26.99 minus $3) is competitively priced for this.

title: Cream is fluorescent yellow & it stains; it lightly moisturizes; love the pump container
text: There are only two things I like about this cream. First, it is lightly moisturizing. Second, I love the pump dispenser. However, I cannot stand any cream that has color to it and this one is fluorescent yellow. In addition, it stains (i.e. my tissues). After having tried this, I would never order it again. Had I known the cream was yellow, I would not have ordered it in the first place.

title: Lovely scent; super hydrating; absorbs quickly – AWESOME day cream
text: This cream is superb. It has a lovely scent that is fresh and clean smelling. The cream is thick and it is super hydrating. It absorbs quickly and leaves my face and neck feeling smooth and moisturized. From the moment I tried this, I was impressed. I consider this an awesome day cream. The current price of $35.99 is competitively priced for a cream of this calibre.

title: Tiny oval brush that glides & detangles my hair, wet or dry; price is outrageous
text:
First of all, I love the two-tone color of this brush. It is light yellow with a green pad where the bristles are. The brush is tiny and perfect for travel or to carry in a purse. It glides through my hair wet or dry and detangles it as well.

The small size makes it a bit difficult to hold but that is to be expected. Note that I have fine short to medium curly hair. The nylon bristles on this brush are sturdy enough for both fine and thick hair.

I love this brush; however, the current price of $16.99 is insane as brushes like this can be purchased in my local Home Goods for $3.99. This is the only reason I took off two stars. If it were $5.99 or less, I would have rated this 5 stars as I do expect an online price to be higher.

title: Nice fragrance but dissolves in less than 3 minutes & tray is not included
text: There are 12 coin-sized lavender shower steamers in this package. The instructions say to put it in the provided plastic tray. There is NO tray in the package. I put this in an indirect stream of water from the shower and it dissolved in less than three minutes. The fragrance was nice but fleeting in such a short time. I am glad the color is non-staining. At the current price of $15.99, this comes to $1.33 per "steamer tablet." With this money quickly washes down the drain.

title: Great for cleaning large vegetables, washing cats or dogs, or massaging scalp; best on short hair
text:
These brushes are lightweight and are good for shampooing short hair, and washing pets and can also be used to clean large vegetables like corn. They also act like a gentle scalp massager. However, those with longer hair might find that it tangles the hair if scrubbed too vigorously.

I particularly love how easy these are to hold by slipping the nub on top between the fingers and having it rest in the palm of my hand.

The current price of $4.55 for two of these is excellent and is why I rated this 5 stars instead of 3 or 4 stars. I have another [[ASIN:B09PBBWTJR brush]] which is currently listed over four times the price as this set comes to $2.28 per brush but the other one is $10 for one. These are low-end cheaply made brushes that work as designed. If these were more than $5, I would have rated them 4 stars. If these were $8 or more, it would have received 3 stars from me.

title: Well-made dual-head back brush with long handle
text:
This brush is two-sided. I was skeptical as to whether I would like this brush or not because the photo on the Amazon site does not do this justice.

The clear bristles are soft and the vanilla-colored ones are more coarse. The handle is long, so it provides me with a good reach. This brush is sturdy and is perfect for soaping up my back. The clear handle is also attractive and has ridges on it for a good grip. In addition, there is a loop for hanging.

In summary, this is a great dual-headed back brush with long reach and exfoliating bristles. The current price of $13.98 is a bit steep but this brush is really nice so I did not deduct any points for the high cost. I particularly love the look of the handle and the quality of the bristles on the brush heads.

title: Great for cleaning large vegetables, washing cats or dogs, or massaging scalp; best on short hair
text:
These brushes are lightweight and are good for shampooing short hair, and washing pets and can also be used to clean large vegetables like corn. They also act like a gentle scalp massager. However, those with longer hair might find that it tangles the hair if scrubbed too vigorously.

I particularly love how easy these are to hold by slipping the nub on top between the fingers and having it rest in the palm of my hand.

The current price of $4.87 for two of these is excellent and is why I rated this 5 stars instead of 3 or 4 stars. I have another [[ASIN:B09PBBWTJR brush]] which is currently listed over four times the price as this set comes to $2.44 per brush but the other one is $10 for one. These are low-end cheaply made brushes that work as designed. If these were more than $5, I would have rated them 4 stars. If these were $8 or more, it would have received 3 stars from me.

title: FOR HAIR - Produces mild lather; a bit oily; argan smells the best; dislike the juniper
text:
There are three bars of soap in this set (argan, juniper tar, and coconut oil. The juniper tar bar smells absolutely awful--like burnt cigarettes to me. The coconut is okay but the argan is the best. I really like the fragrance of that bar. These bars produce a mild lather but are a bit oily. As a result they are moisturizing.

Note that I use them on my body as I hate these for the hair. These are rated for the hair only but do not say that on the Amazon site.

The current price of $16.99 comes to $5.66 per bar, which is competitively priced. If these were for the body and smelled better, they would have gotten about 4.5 stars from me.

title: Highly fragrant when dry but not so much when wet; lasted entire shower & left no stains - UPDATE
text:
There are 12 grapefruit tangerine shower steamers in this package. The fragrance is intense when dry and very pleasant to my senses.

I put one slightly outside a direct stream of water and I could detect only a little fragrance because my scented soaps overpowered the steamer. It lasted the entire shower. I love that it did not stain my tub. The pink color just washed away.

The current price of $29.99 comes to $2.50 per steamer. This is overpriced and the performance is just okay. I personally would not order this again after having tried them as the performance does not warrant such a high price. Also, the steamers do not hold together well when removing the plastic as some powder falls off.

UPDATE - I gave these to a friend to try because she LOVES steamers. However, she rates these 2 stars. She says they dissolve to quickly and the scent us subtle.

title: Great on buzzed cut hair or a beard; makes a wonderful gift
text:
This is an impressive set and it can be used on short hair and not only beards or men with buzz cuts. In the package is a beautiful small boar bristle brush, a metal mustache comb, a brush cleaner, and a cloth case that covers the brush head.

The brush has a light touch. The comb is excellent since it is metal. The cloth pouch is nice too. The only thing I do not like is the brush cleaner. I always find cleaners do not work well and this one is no different. It is okay but not great.

The current price of $11.17 ($13.96 minus 20%) is very reasonable for this set. This will make a beautiful gift. The most impressive piece is the lion image on the back of the brush.

title: Cleans well; lather and fragrance just okay; too expensive
text:
I love fragrance and this soap does not smell anything in the way of citrus. It has an okay aroma that I can't even describe but nothing I really like. Also, it lathers just okay but it does clean well. It also comes with a net bag that can be used for washing if I put the soap inside. I personally prefer to use it without the net.

At the current price of $19 ($22 minus $3 coupon), this is way too expensive for what it is. I would not even purchase it for $6 because I'm not crazy about the scent or the suds. It works but is not for me.

title: Great for cleaning large vegetables, washing cats or dogs, or massaging scalp; best on short hair
text:
The brush is lightweight and it is good for shampooing short hair, and washing pets and can also be used to clean large vegetables like corn. It also acts like a gentle scalp massager. However, those with longer hair might find that it tangles the hair if scrubbed too vigorously.

I particularly love how easy this is to hold by slipping the nub on top between the fingers and having it rest in the palm of my hand.

The current price of $10 is about double the price I would expect to pay for this type of brush. It is cheaply made, so any price more than $5 or $6 is way too much.

title: STUNNING that holds my hair well; best if used with a small amount of hair in center of head
text:
This clip is absolutely stunning and perfect for an elegant outfit. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this works in the back center of my head with a small amount of hair.

The current price of $15 is slightly pricey for this one clip and is the only reason I took off one star. I would expect to pay $12 (which is on the high side) or under for this type of clip.

title: Very nice flex brush but not a great detangler; good for blow drying
text: This is a really nice brush. It has a relatively small with an average-sized head like half of a paddle brush and the head flexes. The synthetic bristles are pliable and not as stiff as I expected. This means it does not act well as a detangler. However, it is a great brush to use for everyday brushing or for blow drying. It glided easily through my short to medium fine curly hair. I love how easy this brush is to hold. The only big negative to me is the current price of $21. I would not expect to pay more than $9 to $11 for this brush and this is the only reason I took off one star.

title: Fragrant steamers when dry but not when wet; lasted entire shower & left no stains
text:
There are eight (8) shower steamers (sweet orange, peppermint, rose, lavender, lemon, vanilla, grapefruit, and eucalyptus) in this package. They all smell nice, although they do not smell as I expect.

I tried the rose one in my shower and made sure to put it away from the full stream of water at first. After a few minutes in the shower of being outside a direct stream of water, hardly any scent was generated so I put it almost in a direct stream of water. It dissolved in about 7 minutes and the fragrance was good until I started washing with my fragrant soap which overpowered the scent of the steamer.

One thing I love is that it did not stain my tub. The pink color just washed away.

The current price of $19.99 comes to $2.50 per steamer. This is overpriced and the performance is just okay. I tried [[ASIN:B09PTC1SPH these]] steamers, which may be the exact same but are cheaper.

title: Very nice soap with an intoxicating almond fragrance
text: I love the fragrance of this black forest musk soap; it's intoxicating. This soap lathers and washes well and leaves me smelling great. The $8.99 price is the only thing I do not like and the only reason I rated this 4 stars. If this were $6 or under, it would have received 5 stars.

title: This is a bare bones basic curling iron; good for loose curls on long hair
text:
This review is for the 1 inch Curling Iron.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and I get a light curl with this iron. However, it is a bare bones model. I like simple things, so this is nice. There is a light telling the user when it has reached a certain temperature (meaning it stopped blinking). The switches are on the side. There are three switches -- on/off , low, and high. The temperature goes from 285 to 400 degrees Fahrenheit. To turn the unit on, I have to press hold the on/off switch. To change the temperature, I have to "press hold" either the high or low and then press that button several times until it shows the temperature I prefer.

There is a little prop on the unit that keeps the hot iron off my counter by a little bit.

I was going to rate this 3 stars but the current price of $19.55 is reasonable for this as is, so I consider it 4 stars as long as the price does not increase.

title: Bandages have many uses; sticks to itself & not to skin/fur; not only tattoo grip tape;  splotchy
text:
These bandages have many uses. There are 12 assorted colored rolls that are individually wrapped and each roll is 5 yards apiece and 2 inches tall. There are two of each color for a total of 6 colors. These self-adhere as the bandage is wrapped around a hand, leg, arm, etc. These stick well. The stretch allows this to be used like kinesiology tape with the exception that one cannot shower with this successfully and each wrap is for one-time use. What I do not like about this tape is that it is splotchy, meaning the material has some bare spots compared to other areas. The rolls still work, however.

The entire roll does not have to be used at once as it depends on the amount needed. When used where joints open and close, such as a knee or elbow, the wrap may bunch up in the crease as expected. However, this is perfect to use as a lightweight version of a carpal tunnel brace by wrapping it around a bad wrist, hand, and thumb. It does not stick to my skin nor to a pet's fur, which is wonderful.

This is versatile enough to wrap around the handle of a tennis racquet to get a good grip or an umbrella or cane handle. There are just so many useful possibilities besides medical reasons.

In summary, because the wraps are two inches wide and are not designed to stick to the skin, it does have a tendency to bunch up if wrapped around a knee or elbow, so it is not perfect for everything. I feel these are great bandages to have in one's medicine cabinet. At the current price of $14.99 it comes to $1.25 per roll which is on the high side of competitively priced. These are self-adhesive bandages rebranded as tattoo grip tape; I just wish these were not splotchy.

title: Smells nice, lathers and cleans well, and leaves my hair bouncy
text:
I would not say this thickens my hair but I love the results. I have short to medium fine curly hair and after washing with this, it dried full and bouncy. I also love the scent. This lathers and cleans well and smells nice.

Note that the bottle comes with a cap but also a pump in case dispensing that way is desired.

The current price of $15 is competitively priced for 16 ounces.

title: Nice lightweight summer lotion; love the fragrance; made in Milano Italy
text:
This is a nice lightweight lotion that is perfect for the summer. It is highly perfumed, which I love. The fragrance is also wonderful to me. This lotion left my skin soft and moisturized.

The current price of $18 is pricey for 14 ounces but this is made in Milano Italy.

title: Fragrant steamers when dry but not so much when wet; lasted entire shower & left no stains
text:
There are 15 shower steamers in a lovely lavender scent in this package. All are 30g (i.e. 1.058 ounces) tablets. They smell great and I love that they are all white because they do not leave stains.

I put this in an almost direct stream of water when it would not work in an indirect stream or on the side wall. Normally steamers are supposed to be out of the direct stream of water; however, I smelled nothing then. Although there was some scent once it started dissolving, it was barely detectable once I began my shower with my scented soap and shampoo. I took a shower for about 7 minutes and some tiny steamer pieces were left behind for the next shower.

The current price of $29.98 comes to an expensive $2 per steamer.

UPDATE: I found a way to get these to work better. I just put 3 to 5 steamers at the end of the shower out of the direct stream and the fragrance is more noticeable. I thought one would do it, but it doesn't.

title: Fragrant steamers when dry but not so much when wet; lasted more than entire shower & left no stains
text:
There are 12 shower steamers in three scents of orange, citrus, and grapefruit in this package. All are 40g (i.e. 1.411 ounces) tablets. All the steamers smell great and I love that they are all white because they do not leave stains.

I put this in an almost direct stream of water when it would not work in an indirect stream or on the side wall. Normally steamers are supposed to be out of the direct stream of water; however, I smelled nothing then. Although there was some scent once it started dissolving, it was barely detectable once I began my shower with my scented soap and shampoo. I took a shower for about 7 minutes and some steamer was left behind for the next shower.

The current price of $29.98 comes to an expensive $2.50 per steamer.

UPDATE: I found a way to get these to work better. I just put 3 to 5 steamers at the end of the shower out of the direct stream and the fragrance is more noticeable. I thought one would do it, but it doesn't.

title: Lightweight oil that absorbs quickly and leaves face only slightly moisturized
text: This is made in Korea. I rubbed a few drops into my face and neck. It absorbed quickly and left my face feeling slightly moisturized.  The eye dropper does not pick up much oil but not much is needed. The watery oil has a very faint fragrance that is almost imperceptible but it is a clean aroma. This is just okay. Its performance is average but the current price of $25 is expensive but still competitively priced. After having tried this, it is not an oil I would order again as it does not have enough of a WOW factor for me.

title: Fragrant steamers when both dry & wet; lasted entire shower & left no stains
text:
There are eight (8) shower steamers (sweet orange, peppermint, rose, lavender, lemon, vanilla, grapefruit, and eucalyptus) in this package along with a plastic cutter for the wrappers. I do not like the aroma of the peppermint or grapefruit ones but the others smell nice.

I tried the lavender one in my shower and made sure to put it away from the full stream of water at first. After a few minutes in the shower of being outside a direct stream of water, hardly any scent was generated so I put it almost in a direct stream of water. It dissolved in about 7 minutes and the fragrance was great; however, the aroma was limited to my shower area only and did not extend to the rest of the bathroom. Nevertheless, that was enough. My shampoo, body wash, and soap that I used in the shower did not overpower this steamer like others I tried previously.

One thing I love is that it did not stain my tub. The purple color just washed away.

The current price of $13.47 comes to $1.68 per steamer. This is competitively priced and the performance is surprisingly good. I've tried about four or five other steamers in the past and was always disappointed. This is the first set I really like.

title: Lightweight eyelash curler with small finger holes
text:
This is a simple eyelash curler. The curler is lightweight and the finger holes have a silicone grip but they are really too small to get a good grip on the curler when using my thumb and forefinger.

It is still relatively easy to use and curls well and gently. There are also two extra silicone replacement refill pads provided.

I personally prefer my old metal curler to this because it is heavier and has larger finger holes. Also, the current price of $12 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Beautiful, jumbo clip that’s great for long, thick hair but way too pricey
text:
This is a beautiful clip and it is super large. This is great for long, thick curly hair. I tried this on my short to medium fine curly hair and it held; however, it is really not designed for my hair.

I love the clip, the style, and the marbleized look. What I do not love is the $12 price tag. There are clips that are a bit smaller than this that sell for less than $3 each. A price of $6.99 or lower would be more in line with what is competitively priced. For instance, clips like [[ASIN:B09FXL29KB these]] come to $2 each and they are half the size of this clip which is six times the price.

title: Great for short to medium length hair; very pricey
text:
This small blow-drying brush has very medium bristles. This works on my short to medium fine hair but if I am not careful, I can get my longer strands of hair tangled in this. Nevertheless, this works as designed.

So far I have not had any shedding of the boar bristles, although when a brush is made out of boar hairs, they do normally shed a little at first.

I love the ergonomically designed wooden handle as it feels great in my hands and does not slip. The barrel of the brush is small for short to medium hair.

The bristles are hard as is typical of boar brushes. However, at the current price of $32.95, this is a bit pricey. It is still competitively priced as it is made in Germany, made of wood, and contains boar bristles. Nevertheless, the same results can be achieved with some less expensive synthetic brushes. This one just looks prettier and will probably last longer.

title: Strong disposable DRY tissues; must use soap & water for these to work; they smell & are $$$
text:
There is one box of 50 tissues (a.k.a. dry wipes). These are stronger than regular facial tissues and are a tiny bit padded. One side is more exfoliating than the other. They are also a generously sized 10"x11" and not 10" x 12" which means they are 1" shorter than advertised and the reason I took off one star. I use these with soap but I can also use these with toner or a facial scrub and they work well. They are useless dry unless one is using this to sop up moisture. They are durable so it seems a shame to throw them away when done. They can be re-used to a certain extent.

The current price of $13.01 ($13.99 minus 7%) comes to a super expensive $.26 cents per tissue which is the reason I took off another star. Besides the sizing being wrong and the expensive price, I do not like the smell of these when wet.

title: Large bath bombs with wonderful fragrance but terrible performance; stains everything
text:
[[VIDEOID:43452a65a8898d8f5bce1578de4861de]] There are four (4) individually wrapped large bath bombs in this set in different fragrances and one (1) bar of blood orange sage coconute oil soap. The fragrances are strong and wonderful and they are lavender shea butter, sea salt orchid shea butter, pomelo citrus shea butter, and blood orange sage shea butter.

I tried the pomelo ctirus shea bath bomb. The bomb dissolve in less then three minutes and fizzles out to nothing in my foot bath. The bath fragrance is absolutely wonderful and lasts the entire time but the bomb dissolved into a deep red-colored water with sparkles. By the time I was done, my feet were pink, the towels were pink, and the foot bath was stained reddish with sparkles. In addition, the sparkles had to be caught in a drain strainer or they would have washed down the drain.

My foot bath was very oily when done and even after washing it out several times, I had sparkles on the paper towels I dried it with.

In summary, these bath bombs are terrible. I love the fragrance but not the staining or the performance. The blood orange sage soap is nice, however. The current price of $24.95 is way overpriced for this set as it comes to almost $5 per item. I'll definitely pass on this. Even though it is moisturizing and smells good, it is not enough to entice me to ever try this again.

title: Nice shampoo/body wash that smells like candy; lathers well
text: This shampoo/body wash combo smells like candy but not too sweet. I really like the fragrance and the lather. It also cleans well. However, at the current price of $34, I would never buy this because it is only 12 fluid ounces. To me this is outrageously expensive. If it were $12 or less, then I would consider it and have rated this 4 or 5 stars.

title: Fragrant steamers when dry; barely fragrant when wet; dissolved quickly & left no stains
text:
There are six Lavender with Menthol Crystal shower steamers in this package. In the package, the steamers smell strong but in the shower they are barely detectable.

I tried one in my shower and made sure to put it away from the full stream of water at first. Note that it did start to fall apart some when I removed the plastic wrapper on the steamer. After a few minutes in the shower of being outside a direct stream of water, hardly any scent was generated even though it started to dissolve from some water droplets. I then put it in the direct stream of water. It dissolved in about 10 minutes but the fragrance was still barely detectable. My shampoo, body wash, and soap that I used in the shower generated more fragrance than this.

One thing I love is that it did not stain my tub. The purple color just washed away.

The current price of $23.95 comes to a very expensive $3.99 per steamer. Not only is this too expensive, but it does not perform well from a fragrance perspective.

title: bsolutely wonderful, hydrating and soothing lavender body oil; absorbs quickly
text:
This oil is absolutely wonderful. The ingredients are soybean oil, fragrance, tocopheryl acetate, lavender flowers, phenoxyethanol, coconut oil,shea butter, BHT, vegetable oil, sunflower seed oil, sweet almond oil, coumarin, geraniol, benzyl benzoate, citronellol oil, hexyl cinnamal, limonene, and linalool. I just applied a few droplets to my skin and rubbed it in. It absorbed quickly into my skin and left it feeling super hydrated and smooth.

This is very nice oil and it is cheap at the current price of $6.50 ($12.99 minus 50%) for 3.7 fluid ounces.

title: Beautiful & functional brush; large coverage and no bristle shedding but brush has odor
text:
This is an impressive and beautiful foundation brush. It works exceptionally well for dusting translucent powder over the face or applying a bronzer. The brush feels great in my hands--although I do wish it had a silicone grip on it. The synthetic bristles do not shed and the head provides great coverage. It is also soft against my skin. I can even use it to apply blush as long as I want wide coverage. The only negative is that there is a slight paint odor to the bristles that I feel will go away over time.

The current price of $14.28 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Really nice large but lightweight paddle brush that detangles my hair easily
text:
If it weren't for the current $19.99 price tag, I would have rated this brush 5 stars.

I really love this paddle brush. It is made of wood and has nylon bristles. The brush is incredibly lightweight. It is easy to hold and glides through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily. It acts as a good detangler. It also feels great in my hands and does not slip out like some brushes do. The only thing I do not like is the price tag. I feel a brush like this should not be priced more than $12.

title: Nice shampoo that smells like candy; produces a good lather but does weigh down my curls
text: This shampoo smells really nice; almost like a savory candy. It produces a good lather and moisturizes so well that I do not need a conditioner. I have short to medium fine curly hair and it does weigh down my curls a bit, which is the only thing I really do not like besides the astronomical $34 price tag for an 18 fluid ounce bottle.

title: Very nice soap with an intoxicating fragrance
text: I love the fragrance of this black forest musk soap; it's intoxicating. This soap lathers and washes well and leaves me smelling great. The $8.99 price is the only thing I do not like and the only reason I rated this 4 stars. If this were $6 or under, it would have received 5 stars.

title: Lightly fragrant bath bombs with surprise jewelry inside; good performance
text:
[[VIDEOID:d9acce0ad07bbb054ca6cfb9d022218e]] At the current price of $23.99, these bombs come to $4 each which is slightly expensive. Each bomb has a surprise stretchy bracelet inside that is encased in a plastic bubble.

I tried the ocean bath bomb in my foot bath. The fragrance is nice but subtle. The suds lasted over 20 minutes as did the fragrance. The bomb dissolved to release the surprise in about 10 minutes. The color of the water was an aqua green and that did not adhere to my foot bath, feet, or towels, which is great.

In summary, the performance of these bombs is good and the suds are long lasting. The colored water also did not stain. The fragrance, however, is subtle. A young girl will love the surprise bracelets and performance of these bath bombs. However, at $4 each one--there are six of them, this is expensive. The six bombs are watermelon, lavender, rose, ocean, peach, and green apple.

title: Good medium-density blenders but am not that fond of the slick surface or the high price
text:
This is a nice set of three black blending sponges all with one or two angled sides. I love that the sponges are of medium-density.

The flat / angled side is great for smooth applications. They feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. Since these are of medium density, they do not soak up as much foundation as others that are more airy. The only thing I do not care for much is the slick surface on three of the four angles. Although it does help liquid foundation glide, I still prefer the typical sponge feel.

I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. The current price of $9.80 ($12.80 minus $3) is very expensive for these as it comes to $3.27 per blender

title: A work of art mustache and beard comb that in my outstretched hand at 7 inches
text: This comb is functional art and is absolutely gorgeous. It also feels great in my hands with the wooden handle. It is small and fits my outstretched hand at7 inches but it is large enough to allow for a good hand grip. This comb is strong and the tines are spaced wide apart. I tried this on my hair and it combs well. This is perfect for travel and can be used to comb one's hair, mustache, or beard. The current price of $34.99 is also a bit pricey for this. This is an excellent travel comb that is comfortable to use and hold.

title: A work of art mustache comb that fits in the palm of my hand at 4.5 inches
text: This comb is functional art. It is very small and fits in the palm of my hand at 4 - 1/2 inches. This comb is strong and the tines are spaced thinly apart. I tried this on my hair and it combs well. The only thing is that it is very small, so it has to be held and operated with two fingers. The current price of $29.99 is also a bit pricey for this. This is a good travel comb.

title: Creamy, lightweight lotion with a slight citrus fragrance
text: My boyfriend and I both tried this and we both love it. This lotion is lightweight yet creamy. It absorbs in less than one minute and our skin feels smooth and silky after using this. The current price of $9.56 ($11.95 minus 20%), is competitively priced for 8.45 fluid ounces.

title: Great for cleaning vegetables or picking up pet hair; definitely not skin exfoliating but still good
text:
The brush is very pliable and has two sides. It is good for skin cleansing and can also be used to clean vegetables. I do not consider this exfoliating but it is gentle and the thicker side acts as a gentle massager.

This also works well as a dry brush to pick up pet hair off a couch or other flat surface. Therefore, this is 5 stars as a vegetable or pet hair cleaning brush, 3 stars as a skin cleaner, 4 stars as a skin massager, and 3 stars for the high price.

Note that it has a loop for hanging. I have to add my own rope so I can hang it. If my hook was smaller, I would not need to do that.

The current price of $9.99 is about double the price I would expect to pay for this type of brush.

title: Beautiful looking vent brush w/nylon & boar bristles but comb is plastic junk
text:
This is a two-piece set. There is a nice boar/nylon vent brush with synthetic bristles and a cheap plastic comb. The comb is absolute junk, but the brush is both beautiful and functional.

The brush is easy to hold and passes through my short to medium-length curly hair easily. Since this is a vent brush, it is perfect for blow drying as well.

The current price of $8.88 ($12.88 minus $4) is competitively priced for this brush. I would prefer if they sold the brush only and reduced the price as the comb is not something I will ever use and it cheapens the look of this brush.

title: Beautiful looking vent brush w/nylon & boar bristles but rake is useless
text:
This is a two-piece set. There is a nice boar/nylon vent brush with synthetic bristles and a synthetic bristle rake to clean the hair out of the brush. The rake is absolutely useless, but the brush is both beautiful and functional.

The brush is easy to hold and passes through my short to medium-length curly hair easily. Since this is a vent brush, it is perfect for blow drying as well.

The current price of $9.99 ($13.99 minus $4) is reasonably priced for this brush. I would prefer if they sold the brush only and reduced the price as the rake does not work well.

title: Beautiful & functional synthetic brush; large coverage and no bristle shedding
text:
This is an impressive and beautiful foundation brush. It works exceptionally well for dusting translucent powder over the face or applying a bronzer. The brush feels great in my hands--although I do wish it had a silicone grip on it. The bristles do not shed and the head provides fantastic coverage. It is also soft against my skin. It is a bit too big to apply blush. Note that the bristles are synthetic, so there is a slight "paint" smell that will dissipate over time.

The current price of $12.99 is on the very high side of competitively priced for a synthetic brush.

title: Not as long or soft as Q-Tips but these work well
text:
There are 12 boxes of 200 bamboo cotton swabs in this box for a total of 2,400. The tips on these are not as soft and the length is about a half inch shorter than the Q-Tip cotton swabs. Nevertheless, these work well. Just make sure not to press too hard and break them in half during use. My boyfriend and I tried these and felt they were good but not great. I personally would buy the Q-Tip brand over these simply because I like the length and plushness of those. However, these are second best.

The current price of $18 comes to less than $.01 cents per swab.

title: Excellent large-sized buff puffs that create copious suds that are perfectly wound
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only "sponge" I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are large and similar to the ones I buy at Walmart for $2 each. There are four puffs and they work like any other mesh loofah I regularly use. They are wound perfectly meaning the mesh is not too loose and not too tight.

I really only like the color of two of these puffs and am particularly partial to the blue one. The blush one is not pretty to me.

The current price of $12.99 comes to a pricey $3.25 per puff.

title: Lightweight, moisturizing suntan lotion; but is NOT fragrance free
text:
This is a nice lightweight suntan lotion that is also moisturizing. I also like the fragrance. It is supposed to be fragrance free but it is not and thankfully, it is not because I LOVE fragrance. Per the bottle, it is free of oxybenzone and octinoxate. The SPF 50 provides good protection. It rubs into my skin easily.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection, including this one. The current price of $14.70 for 5 ounces is expensive but since this is SPF 50, I expect the price to be higher.

title: Very nice shampoo and conditioner; love the fragrance
text:
This trio comes with shampoo, conditioner, and a hold and shine moisture mist. I tried the shampoo and conditioner and love it. The fragrance is great and the shampoo lathers well. The conditioner is gentle and does not weigh down my curls. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this left my hair soft but bouncy and overall healthy looking.

The current price of $31.10 comes to $10.37 per bottle, which is pricey.

title: Medium-weight, moisturizing suntan lotion with a lovely suntan lotion fragrance
text:
This is a nice medium-weight suntan lotion that feels moisturizing. I love the fragrance. Per the bottle, it is free of oxybenzone, octinoxate, dyes, phthalates, and PABA. It is water resistant up to 80 minutes but I did not test that claim. It also provides broad spectrum SPF 30 protection and supposedly stops up to 97% of the UV rays.

I tried their [[ASIN:B09KYDKM34 lightweight lotion]], and really liked it but I love this one because it is a thicker cream and has a stronger scent.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection, including this one. The current price of $11.88 ($13.98 minus 15%) comes to a reasonable $6 per 7-ounce bottle.

title: Lightweight, moisturizing suntan lotion; has a nice fragrance
text:
This is a nice lightweight suntan lotion that is also moisturizing. I also like the fragrance. Per the bottle, it is free of oxybenzone, octinoxate, dyes, and PABA. It is water resistant up to 80 minutes but I did not test that claim. It also provides broad spectrum SPF 30 protection.

I am not one that likes to be in the sun but I have a convertible. Therefore, I am always slathering on suntan lotion for protection, including this one. The current price of $6.99 for 7 ounces is also reasonable.

title: Lightweight, hydrating eye cream; perfect for the summer
text:
This eye cream is lightweight and hydrating. It is also scentless. When I applied it around my eye area, it just glided onto my lids. It is very nice cream and does smooth wrinkles as does any moisturizer. I found no other benefit. The current price of $29.99 is competitively priced for this cream. I really like this eye cream. Note that this is made in Korea.

UPDATE March 2, 2023 - It is 16 days shy of one year that I have been using this and I love it. This jar is still lasting. I use this on my eyelids and under my eyes twice per day after my two times per day shower. That area of my face has stayed so soft and plump. This is a great eye cream and the amount in this jar lasts a long time. I've already put this in my cart to order more once this runs out.

title: 120 generously sized and strong disposable DRY tissues; must use soap and/or water for these to work
text:
There are 2 packs of 60 tissues each pack for a total of 120 tissues (a.k.a. wipes). These are stronger than regular facial tissues and are a tiny bit padded. They are also a generously sized 8"x8". I use these with soap but I can also use these with toner or a facial scrub and they work well. They are useless dry unless one is using this to sop up moisture.

The current price of $12.99 comes to an expensive $.11 cents per tissue.

title: Very cheap feeling set of basic brushes that are functional
text:
These brushes look and feel cheap but they do the job. There are three brushes in this set. The round one is good for blow-drying and curling and the other two are decent detanglers. They all work wet or dry. I have short to medium fine curly hair and the plastic hair brush goes through my curly hair easily.

These are not spectacular and they are nothing special, but for the current price of $11.99 one gets three brushes at $4 each.

title: Nice curly hair care trio but pump does not work on conditioner
text:
This is a nice trio of haircare products for curly hair. I have short to medium fine curly hair and used the shampoo and conditioner. The shampoo lathers and cleans well and the conditioner conditions without weighing down my hair. My hair dried curly and bouncy.

Unfortunately, I am extremely peeved because I cannot get the pump on the conditioner to work. It won't pop up. I had to remove the pump and hit the bottle with my hands to even get a little out and it was almost impossible to do that, which means the conditioner most likely will wind up going in the garbage. It's the inability to get to this product that made me want to rate this one star. These items are great but the pump on the conditioner is useless. I actually would not buy this for that reason only.

title: Nice fresh scent; good hand soap with decent lather; not easy to open the first time
text:
I've used this brand's body wash and loved it so I decided to try their hand soap. This is a 34 fluid ounce refill. I had difficulty opening the top and had to use a gripper sheet (rubber strip to get a grip). Also, I had to pry the covering on the top off with a scissor because the foil that covers the top is thick and not easy to remove.

However, once I was able to open the bottle, I used it. It's best not to dispense from this bottle to the hands because it pours out easily as expected of a refill. The fragrance is subtle but fresh and I really like it. The soap has a decent lather and cleans well. I also consider the $6.48 price tag reasonable. Overall, I really like this hand soap.

title: Nice basic caps for those who do not have big heads or big hair
text:
There are three caps in this package (gray, blue, and pink). All the caps are a small size that just barely fit me. The gray and pink ones are smaller and the blue one is a little larger. Nevertheless, I have a small head and short to medium fine curly hair and it is a perfect but snug fit.

These have a double layer as they are lined inside. They are nice caps but are sized more for young adults than typical adults.The current price of $8.99 comes to $3 per cap which is competitively priced.

title: The product is at all what is advertised; only 2 creams and rest are pills
text:
I am very disappointed with what I received. I received a box containing only four packets of face creams (that two dual packets of the red and white as shown on the Amazon site). The rest of the items I received were supplementals - all pills and I am allergic to supplements of any kind.

In addition to the above, the supplements received, which I have to throw out, are:

- 2 packages of 500 mg chlorella supplements with 6 tablets each packet

- 2 packages 200 mg chlorella supplements with 15 tablets each packet

- 1 packet of .21 ounce chlorella supplement powder

- 2 packages of organic eleuthero supplements with 12 tablets each

- 2 packages of rejuv-a-wafers with 2 tablets each packet

I tried the white cream and it is great but I ordered only the box of creams and to receive a box that has only four servings of face cream and the rest in supplements is a terrible disappointment. This is not as advertised and now is going in the garbage because it is not like I can give this away.

UPDATE: I tried the red packaged cream and hate it. Not only does the cream look like tomato vodka sauce but it stains. I threw that out to. Therefore, the only thing I could use from this entire box was the two servings of white cream, which was great.

title: Very functional soft bristle brush set; fan brush skinny & no lip liner brush
text:
For the current price of $22.49 ($24.99 minus 10%), there are 12 brushes in this set and one case and one disposable towelette--at least I assume that is what it is because there is no English writing on this. I will probably throw that out. Assuming the case is free, this comes to $1.87 per brush which is competitively priced.

This is an attractive brush set and the bristles are soft. I particularly love the larger brushes as the design allows them to easily apply and re-distribute powder foundation. There is no shedding. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously.

This set has all the brushes I need (foundation, lip, eyeshadow, etc.) except for a large fan brush and lip liner brush. The fan brush that is supplied is very tiny. However, this set is almost complete, in my opinion. The case is a nice touch and can double as two pencil holders if one does not want to use it for the make-up brushes. Overall, I like this ensemble.

title: Really nice clips with a great hold
text: There are 12 clips in this package in various colors. What I love is the design, the soft non-slip surface finish, and its holding power. I have short-to-medium fine curly hair and this holds my hair very well in the back. I also like the selection of muted colors. For the current price of $7.99, this comes to $.67 cents per clip, which I consider reasonable.

title: This eye serum is wonderful but I do not like the smell - SEE UPDATE
text:
This eye serum is wonderful but I do not like the smell. It is clear like aloe vera gel. I put it on my lids and under my eye and my eye area felt extremely supple and smooth and incredibly hydrated. It was almost like I had a silky barrier on my lids. It is very nice indeed. Unfortunately, I am not crazy about the smell and I can't describe it. If it were not so good, I would not use this. However, because the results are terrific, I'll use it despite the smell.

The current price of $39 is pricey for this .05 ounce tube, but a little goes a long way.

UPDATE: I've been using this for over one week and my eyelids are itchy and one became swollen. This is very disappointing as I really love this gel. Once I stopped this, the itchiness went away. When I went back, it started again. Apparently, I am allergic to the ingredients which is very disappointing.

title: Very nice set of brushes; sponge a bit small
text:
There are two brushes in this set along with a sponge applicator. The brushes are good for a makeup case because the handles are smaller than typical but not yet travel sized.

The bristles are soft and dense and almost feel like hair even though they are a soft nylon. They provide good coverage because of the density of the bristles. They feel great in the hands and are easy to work with. I would have liked the larger foundation brush to have more of an angle and taller bristles. The smaller brush is great for highlighting the cheeks. These are good with powder. I personally would not use these with liquid.

The sponge is just okay. I can only get a couple of fingers underneath the ribbon in the back. It is also a bit small. Personally, I would have preferred a larger sponge with more substance for liquid foundation; even a blender sponge would be better.

The current price of $9.99 comes to $3.33 per item which is slightly pricey but still competitive.

title: Very nice, solid lip brushes; which a lip liner came with it
text:
There are two brushes in this set. One is larger and for home and the other is covered and smaller and is for travel.

The bristles are soft and dense and almost feel like hair even though they are a soft nylon. They provide good coverage because of the density of the bristles. They feel great in the hands and are easy to work with. The only thing to be aware of is that sometimes the bristles get caught outside the cap on the travel brush as I am inserting the cap over the brush. I do wish that a lip liner brush came with the set; nevertheless, these are wonderful.

The current price of $9.99 is a little pricey but still competitive and comes to $5.50 per brush.

title: Smells like tangerine; no English on bottle except front; not as volumizing as expected
text:
This shampoo is from Korea and the label on the back is in a foreign language. The label that says shampoo on the front is the only English on the bottle.

The shampoo smells nice, lathers well, but feels moisturizing to me. I expected it to be a little more cleansing. When my hair dried, it was not as volumized as expected. I have short to medium fine curly hair and my curls were a bit subdued after using this.

This shampoo is not bad but is not one I would buy for the current price of $24 for $16.9 ounces.

title: Controls get activated during use of machine; not enough wax included
text:
I have a [[ASIN:B0047RWN3E Therabath Professional Thermotherapy Paraffin Bath]] that is absolutely excellent. It is simple to operate and works flawlessly. It is slightly smaller than this machine but it is taller, which I find much better for my purposes.

This machine is a good size. It comes with only two pounds of wax, the unit itself, a heat grate, spatula, brush, booties, mittens, several disposable plastic booties and plastic squares to be used as mitts, and an "English as the second language" instruction pamphlet. For the current price of $151.99 ($159.99 minus 5%), more wax should be included as two pounds is not enough to cover one's hands.

The instructions are written in slightly broken English. The controls. however, are intuitive and work as designed. The wax temperature can be set separately or the two or four pound preset option can be used. I used the two-pound preset option. 

I put the heat grate on the bottom and then added all the wax. Then I turned the unit on and lightly tapped the 2LBS button. It immediately began warming and within about 30 minutes all the wax was melted. 

When I went to use this, the lid fell into the wax--this is easy to do. I tried to  submerge my hands but had to flip them over like a pancake because there was not enough wax.  Also, the act of dipping my hands kept causing the different controls to be set. Just getting near the buttons moved the control to 4LBs, then CLEAN, then back to 4LBS, etc.. Besides the lack of wax supplied, this is the most annoying feature about this bath.

Once my hands were sufficiently coated, I inserted them into the disposable mitts. I did not bother using the other mits to cover my hands. The end result was that it helped with my arthritis pain and softened my skin somewhat.

POSITIVES:
- The two pounds of wax melts in about 30 minutes, which is very quick. It is certainly much quicker than my Therabath.

NEGATIVES:
- The unit only holds four pounds of wax maximum which is really not enough for submersion of the hands up to the wrists or feet up to the ankles. 

- The act of dipping one's hands causes the arm that hovers over the touch controls to go haywire. The controls kept changing from 4LBS to CLEAN and back to 4LBS, etc.

- The instructions are written in slightly broken English.

In summary, this paraffin bath is functional but not enough wax is supplied for the price. The vendor should be ashamed of themselves for supplying only two pounds of wax. This unit works but I would have preferred that six pounds of wax could have been supplied and used. This only takes four pounds max for such a big unit. Also, the act of the controls being changed as a result of using the machine is a big negative for me. The wax melts rapidly in this, which is a plus. The instructions are not the best but the unit is so intuitive that instructions are almost not needed. The current price of $151.99 ($159.99 minus 5%) is pricey but competitive. I still feel my professional Therabath is better.

title: Kids will love these but performance is short-lived
text:
[[VIDEOID:3d6697b9aaa69829d270f58e9d59103e]] There are six ocean-themed individually wrapped bath bombs in this set in different fragrances and two different sizes (see photo). It also comes with a plastic cutter to remove the plastic on the bomb.

The fragrances are subtle and smell the same to me even though they are different. According to the insert, the clean shell, active crab, and shy conch are all 70g in size and the fragrance is milk, sweet orange, and green tea respectively. The innocent whale and mermaid's tail are 150g each and are blueberry and Victoria's Secret fragrances respectively.

I tried the shy conch (green tea) bomb and there were sparkles that got all over my hands just from opening the package. It was not easy to wash off. However, the sparkle did not stick to my feet, bath, or towels when dissolved in a foot bath. The performance was nice but short-lived as the bomb and suds dissolved in about 5-8 minutes. The bath fragrance is mild and lasts the same amount of time. The foot bath water turned into a lime green color.

In summary, these are not the best performing bath bombs around but they are nice and kids love this stuff--especially the designs. The current price of $14.99 comes to $2.50 per bath bomb which is competitively priced for these type of bombs.

title: Not nearly as good as my professional Therabath machine; controls & instructions quirky
text:
I have a [[ASIN:B0047RWN3E Therabath Professional Thermotherapy Paraffin Bath]] that is absolutely excellent. It is simple to operate and works flawlessly. It is not as big or as squat as this machine but it is tall, which I find much better for my purposes.

This machine is huge. It comes with three pounds of wax, the unit itself, a heat grate, spatula, brush, booties, mittens, several disposable plastic booties and plastic mitts, and an "English as the second language" instruction pamphlet.

The instructions are written in slightly broken English. The controls are quirky and did not operate for me as instructed. The wax temperature can be set at any temp between 86 to 158. There is a timer feature and the wax door automatically opens when the time is up.

Eventually, I got this to work by putting all the wax inside without the heat grate. Then I turned the unit on, lightly tapped the time button and set it to the time specified. It immediately began counting down. If I pressed any other controls, such as the temperature, this did not work. When the time was up, the door opened and I could use the unit. I inserted the heat grate first, then submerged my hands (dipping several times until I had a thick wax build-up on each hand), and then inserted them into the disposable mitts. I did not bother using the other mits over my hands. The end result was that it helped with my arthritis pain and softened my skin somewhat.

POSITIVES:
- The three pounds of wax melts in 45 minutes, which is very quick. It is certainly much quicker than my Therabath.

- The unit is large enough to use on the feet or hands due to it being squat and wide.

NEGATIVES:
- There are three preset modes of temperature manual setting mode, automatic heating mode, and time reservation mode. I tried for over 15 minutes to get the unit to work as per the instructions. The only mode I could get to work was the automatic heating mode with a countdown timer. Once the countdown is complete, the unit door flips up for use exposing the contents of the wax to room temperature. It does not beep or anything. The quirky controls are a problem. Either the instructions are incomplete or the controls are faulty.

- The door flipping up when the wax timer is up is a problem for those who have cats. It is also a problem for regulating the wax temperature as it exposes it to the cool room. I would prefer a beeping and the door to remain closed.

- I was unable to get the unit to turn off without pulling the plug. The on/off did not work.

- The unit is not tall enough to submerge up to my wrist or ankles--at least not with the wax supplied.

- There is no maximum or minimum wax setting on the unit, so there is no way for me to know if the wax is too much or too little in the unit.

In summary, I am not impressed with this paraffin bath. It is too squat to allow me to submerge up to my wrists or ankles (at least with the wax supplied), the controls do not work as described, and the automatic door presents problems for those with cats and it also cools the wax at the same time. The wax melts rapidly in this, which is a big plus. The unit is large enough for the feet or hands up to a certain point. The instructions are not the best and appear to be incomplete. The current price of $99.99 ($109.99 minus $10) is competitively priced for this but after having tried this, I am disappointed.

title: Eight basic but very functional HOT PINK soft synthetic brushes
text:
There are 8 make-up brushes in this set. This is an attractive brush set especially since it is hot pink in color. The bristles are soft. There was no shedding. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously.

This set has most of the brushes I need except for a fan brush and lip liner brush and brow/mascara wand. The brush heads do have a slight smell to them, since they are synthetic.

The current price of $16.99 comes to $2.12 per brush. There are other brushes on the market similar to this that are slightly cheaper for the quality.

title: Wonderful shampoo with a lovely fragrance that smells fruity like peach to me
text:
I thought this shampoo was going to smell like vinegar and am ecstatic that it does not. it has a spectacular fragrance that smells very fruity and like peach to me. It lathers and rinses well and leaves my hair feeling cleansed. It is almost detergent like in its cleansing but not stripping. I have short to medium-fine curly hair and my hair dried bouncy and soft.

The current price of $11.99 for 5.07 ounces is pricey but this shampoo is fabulous. Note that I did have a little trouble opening the pump top but resolved that after a few minutes.

title: Bath bombs the size of gumballs with lackluster performance
text:
[[VIDEOID:94473f32466d4f7cee7801155aeba475]] There are 35.27 ounces of gumball-sized bath bombs in this container that are made of epsom salts and tea tree, peppermint, and lavender oils. I used one gumball in four cups of very warm water for a hand soak. The ball fizzed out in a couple of minutes and the results were lackluster. The water was a pale pink but there was no staining.

The current price of $29.99 for this container is definitely not worth it. I do not like the fragrance or the performance. Note that my container arrived broken as can be seen in the photo.

title: Medium highly fragrant bath bombs w/good performance; bomb dissolved in 10 min
text:
[[VIDEOID:6f72b1144c32293fdd9d232866bc6239]] There are four individually wrapped medium-sized bath bombs in this set of two boxes in a hemp and lavender fragrance. The fragrance is not great dry but when the bath bomb dissolves the fragrance is wonderful.

The bombs dissolve in about 10 minutes and the suds hold for about the same; at least in a foot bath. The bath fragrance lasted the entire time I was bathing my feet and that was about 20 minutes.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I used this in a foot bath. The water turned a lilac color and that color did not adhere to my skin, my foot bath, or my towels.

In summary, these perform well, are moisturizing, and fragrant bath bombs. However, the current price of $18.99 is really expensive for this as it comes to $4.75 per bath bomb, which is about double what I would expect to pay. This is the only reason I rated this 4 instead of 5 stars.

title: Gel soap that will not dispense from the pump; stings the eyes
text:
As a body wash this lathers and cleanses well. It also has that strong tea tree aroma. It does burn the eyes, so avoid that area.

What I absolutely hate is that I could not get the pump to dispense. I had to remove the pump and turn the bottle over to get the soap out. The soap is like a gel. After showering like this for a while, I then reseated the pump again and was able to get out some product. If I could not get the pump to work, I was going to rate this 2 stars.

I also do not like that this is a gel shampoo--very very thick clear gel. I do love it's antibacterial properties, however.

The current $12.99 price is reasonable for this.

title: Really cleanses / strips my hair; I would not use this more than once per week
text: First of all I do not like the tin bottle because it marks up my acrylic tub with gray stains. Second, I hate having to unscrew a cap to get to the shampoo. It does pour out easily. The creamy white shampoo lathers pretty well and really cleanses. However, it feels like it is stripping my  hair. I will only use this when my hair needs a good cleansing. At the current price of $22, I would never buy this. The bottle it comes in and the detergent-like cleanse is just too much to handle.

title: Really nice large paddle brush that detangles my hair easily
text:
I really like this paddle brush. It is made of bamboo and has rubber bristles. The bristles have an attractive wood grain finish on them. This brush is easy to hold and glides through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily. It acts as a good detangler. It also feels great in my hands and does not slip out like some brushes do.

The current price of $8 is reasonable for this brush.

title: Thick, super hydrating, scentless eye cream
text: This eye cream is thick and super hydrating. It is also scentless. When I applied it around my eye area, I felt like I was applying glue to my lids. It is very nice cream and does smooth wrinkles as does any moisturizer. I found no other benefit. The current price of $55 is pricey. I love this cream but there is not much provided (see photo) for that price. It is all jar and very little cream. Nevertheless, this cream is exceptional to me due to it's moisturizing qualities.

title: More of an old-time intense scent than something exceptional; I detect no rose
text:
The packaging/bottle is exquisite. I love the red bottle as it is very sexy and sensual. However, the perfume itself is not one I would order again. I do not detect any rose overtones. The fragrance reminds me of an old lady's perfume from yesteryear. Even a little is overbearing and is not enticing to me. Unfortunately, this is going to be demoted to an air freshener.

The current price of $79.99 for 3.4 fluid ounces is competitively priced. Too bad the fragrance is too strong and not subtly floral. They certainly hit the mark on the rich scent but it is not one I like.

title: Functional blush brush w/no bristle shedding; would have preferred longer bristles & heavier handle
text:
This is a basic angled blush brush. It works well for applying powder blush. The brush feels great in my hands--although I do wish it had a silicone grip on it and a heavier handle. The bristles do not shed and the head provides decent coverage. I do wish the bristles were just a little bit longer and that the bristles were a little softer. In general, this is a basic but functional foundation brush.

The current price of $18.99 for the quality of this brush is about $10 overpriced, in my opinion.I would have expected a higher quality handle and much softer bristles at that price.

title: Nice, basic neutral-colored clips with a great hold; best for thick long hair
text:
There are four large claw clips in this package. The clips are basic in amber, clear, black, and white and they are sturdy. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on but they would work even better with thick long hair simply because there is a wide channel in the center.

At the current price of $6.99, it comes to $1.75 per clip.

title: Lathers & washes well; teams the itch; has typical tea tree oil aroma
text:
At the current price of $13.48 ($14.98 minus 10%), this is competitively priced for 16 fluid ounces.

This tea tree oil shampoo has that typical medicinal smell. It has a good lather and washes well. It also left my scalp less itchy. 

What I didn't like is that this arrived leaking. There are two openings on the bottle. There is a bottom flip cap and a pump top. The entire shampoo up to the base of the pump is wrapped in shrink wrapped cellophane. However, the pump is not, so it comes undone in shipment and the shampoo leaks into the bag. Luckily, only a little bit leaked out. They need to encase the entire bottle in cellophane.

I do love the two dispensing options but my preference is to do without a pump and just have a flip cap on the bottom. If they only had this option, they could reduce the price of the shampoo and the leakage that results from the pump.

In summary, this is good shampoo. It left my short-to-medium fine curly hair clean and bouncy.

title: Nice brush that glides & detangles my fine curly hair easily
text:
The wooden pin brush is large and glides through my hair wet or dry. It detangles my fine curly hair easily. It also feels great in my hands and does not slip out like some brushes do. Note that I have fine short to medium curly hair. The metal bristles on this brush feel like they are massaging my scalp.

I love this wooden brush. The current price of $7.99 is competitively priced.

title: Nice detangling brushes but too pricey; silicone grip on handles provide me with a good hold
text:
There are two nylon detangling brushes with hollow silicone handles. There is also one cloth carry case.
