title: Lovely bobby-pin-style large hair bow for young girl
text:
This bow is gorgeous and well made. The decorative lollipop in the middle is very attractive. The bow is large and measures 5" x 3.5" so it is not small enough for a baby. However, for a young girl or lifesize doll, this is perfect.

The current price of $12.99 is pricey for this but since it is handmade (per the label on the box), that price is to be expected.

The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because one side is wider than the other--meaning it looks a bit uneven.

title: These medium-sized clips are STUNNING and hold my hair well; best if used at base of neck
text:
These clips look like a small octopus and each one has teeth in the center that grips my hair well and provides me with a great hold. In addition, they are absolutely stunning and perfect for an elegant outfit.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and these work in the back of my head where my hair is longest. The best place for me to use these is at the base of my neck. If I put them in the center of my head, they are uncomfortable to use due to the curve / concave shape of the clip.

They arrived with two clips clipped together in the center (see photo). If one has very long hair, it would look great if a clip is inserted from either side to make it look like one large clip as per my photo.

The current price of $13.99 comes to $3.50 per clip which is competitively priced due to the beauty of these.

title: Generously-sized buff puffs that create copious suds but I do not like the texture & they are $$$
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only thing I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are large-sized and similar to the ones I buy at Walmart for $ 2 each with the exception that they feel more like a cloth than the typical mesh. There are three puffs and they work like any other large mesh loofah I regularly use but they do not feel the same.

Also, the current price of $9.99 comes to a pricey $3.33 each puff. I love the attractiveness of these but not the price or the texture. Only time will tell how long they will last.

title: Pretty clips in nice design & colors, and functional but they feel like they will break
text:
There are four attractive and subtly colorful butterfly clips in this set. These are not only pretty but since they are small, they work well in my short to medium-length curly hair. They are easy to open and close and do hold my hair. I used them in the back of my head.

However, they do feel cheap even though they do not look cheap. I suppose they are sort of disposable but only time will tell how long they will last. I cannot describe it but when I open the clips I am concerned they will eventually break. For now they are good and they come with a plastic case.

At the current price of $6.99, this comes to a pricey $1.75 per clip.

title: Works gently but effectively on the dry skin on my feet; rinse w/water to clean
text:
This file is not as easy to hold as this [[ASIN:B096XV8F8T one]] and it is almost double the price at the current cost of $17.99.

Only one side of this flat file is usable and that is the side without the writing on it. It files my heels gently. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler. When I was done, I just rinsed the file under warm water and the dead skin that was removed was easily rinsed off. The file looked brand new afterward.

There are only two reasons I rated this 3 stars. First, it is not as easy to hold as the same type file with a handle. Second, the ones with handles are about $8 cheaper.

title: These make great stocking stuffers or tree ornaments; pkg is heart shaped; blenders are great
text:
This is a lovely set of 12 sponges in sets of 2 each but they are not heart shaped. What is heart shaped is the plastic holding the two sponges together with the flat side joining into what almost looks like a heart. Each package has a pink ribbon and also a plastic loop as if this were being used for retail sale. The loop can be used to hang on a Christmas tree. These can also be used as stocking stuffers or for the Easter basket due to the pastel colors.

I love these sponges, particularly because they have a flat angled side. Nevertheless, The sponges are of medium density. The flat side is great for smooth applications. These feel good in the hands, blend reasonably well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not. The pastel colors are also attractive.

The sponges themselves are similar in style to all of the others that I tried before.. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too - at least to me.

At the current price of $22.49 this comes to $3.75 per package or almost $1.88 per sponge. Most other blenders sell for between $1.25 and $ 1.75 per piece in a set like this but without the heart-shaped packaging.

title: Light moisturizer that hydrates but smell is highly offensive to me
text:
First off, I would never use this on my entire body. It comes in a small pump bottle that it would both take forever to pump and it would not last long. However, this would be great for the hands if I didn't hate the smell so much.

The cream is lightweight and hydrating. Unfortunately, the lotion smells foul to me; almost like someone's unwashed behind.

title: 12 small bath bombs; nice fragrances; good suds
text:
[[VIDEOID:dcfb9784c59be6145e72a6ac14f908e7]] There are 12 individually wrapped small bath bombs in this set in the scents/names listed below.

- sakura sea
- starry lavender
- happy orange
- summer lemon
- coconut milk
- sleeping eucalyptus menthol
- rose petal bath
- secret of dancing
- mango and papaya
- ocean smell
- vanilla ice cream
- pine wood

Each fragrance is slightly different but only subtly so. The bombs dissolve in about 5 minutes and the suds hold for about 10 minutes. The bath fragrance is subtle and nice. I tried the pine wood fragrance.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I use them in a foot bath. The green color of this bomb did not adhere to my skin, my towel or to my foot bath; at least the color of the "Pine Wood" bomb I tried did not adhere.

The current cost of $15.99 for 12 bombs comes to a competitively priced $1.33 per bomb. These are nice bombs and definitely giftable. I also like that they come in two boxes of six bombs each because they can be used as stocking stuffers or broken out into two gifts.

title: These bandages have many uses; sticks to itself and not to skin or fur; not only tattoo grip tape
text:
These bandages have many uses. There are 6 black rolls that are individually wrapped and each roll is almost 5 yards apiece and 2 inches tall. These self-adhere as the bandage is wrapped around a hand, leg, arm, etc. This sticks pretty well except that the bandage has some splotchy areas but this still works. The stretch allows this to be used like kinesiology tape with the exception that one cannot shower with this successfully and each wrap is for one-time use.

The entire roll does not have to be used at once as it depends on the amount needed. When used where joints open and close, such as a knee or elbow, the wrap may bunch up in the crease as expected. However, this is perfect to use as a lightweight version of a carpal tunnel brace by wrapping it around a bad wrist, hand, and thumb as I did in the photo. It does not stick to my skin nor to a pet's fur, which is wonderful.

This is versatile enough to wrap around the handle of a tennis racquet to get a good grip or an umbrella or cane handle. There are just so many useful possibilities besides medical reasons.

In summary, because the wraps are two inches wide and are not designed to stick to the skin, it does have a tendency to bunch up if wrapped around a knee or elbow, so it is not perfect for everything. I feel these are good bandages to have in one's medicine cabinet. At the current price of $8.26 ($8.69 minus 5%) it comes to $1.38 per roll which is double the price of other brands. These are self-adhesive bandages rebranded as tattoo grip tape.

title: Basic, functional tweezer set; case has imperfections - 3.5 stars
text:
I ordered the Pafason tweezer set under Amazon item #B08RX9FJBD and that set is extremely precise and works beautifully. I also ordered this set in white (Amazon item #B096THKNH8) and black (Amazon item #B096TJX6DG). What I discovered is that, depending on the color of the set ordered, the performance is different for each tool. This set works relatively well and is better than the white and black ones but not as good as the first set I ordered which was ultra precise.

There are four different types of tweezers in the case.They are:
- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they all work somewhat well but are not as precise as I would like and that seems to be because the tips are thicker than my first pair.

The case has a snap closure and there is a pocket behind and in front of the tweezers that can be used to store a couple of bills, credit card, etc. Unfortunately, there are pieces of PU leather that need to be cut off to look finished. Also note that the tools are pinkish and the case is red.

Overall, I give this set 3.5 stars. The current price of $7.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this quality.

title: OK tweezer set; two of the four tools lack the precision necessary to pull hairs easily
text:
I ordered the Pafason tweezer set under Amazon item #B08RX9FJBD and that set is extremely precise and works beautifully. I also ordered this set in white (Amazon item #B096THKNH8) and black. What I discovered is that, depending on the color of the set ordered, the performance is different. This set with the black case is just okay and two of the four tools lack the precision needed to easily pull hairs.

title: Very nice barber bag; can be used as a medical bag too
text:

The front panel has a zippered compartment the entire length of the bag with room for 15 more implements and an additional 3 folder pockets that are a bit wider for thicker tools like barretts, scissors, etc.

It has both a handle with Velcro strap to cinch them together for carrying and also a shoulder strap. The shoulder strap is not well padded and is uncomfortable to use for long hauls. The zippers glide easily in both sections. This bag is well-made and is not only for blow dryers and hair styling products and associated tools. This can be repurposed as a travel medical bag with scissors, bandages, etc.

Overall, this is very nice. It is of medium size and smaller than I expected but still very functional. It is not large enough to carry several blow dryers with diffusers and concentrators but it could carry one blow dryer with both a curling iron and flat iron, along with scissors, hair clips, and some hair products.

The current price of $52.24 ($54.99 minus 5%) is pricey but competitive for this.

text:

title: Wafer-thin portable soap; dissolves instantly; good lather; fragrance lightly comes thru on hands
text:
There are four packages of wafer thin sheets of soap in about 87 sheets each pack. If I divide 350 by 4, it comes to 87.5 sheets each pack but that is impossible, so there must be one pack with two more "wafers."

The wafers are individual and are a bit difficult to single out for use. It is important I handle this while my hands are dry. There is also a sliding top plastic container already loaded with one pack of soap. Be careful not to get them wet as even a drop of water causes them to dissolve. When I washed my hands with one sheet, it created a quick and tiny but nice lather and left my hands clean. Also, the rose fragrance smells great as a whole when sniffing all the sheets together but that fragrance barely comes through on my hands because the soap is too thin to leave much fragrance behind.

The current price of $6.99 comes to $.02 cents per sheet if there are 350 sheets within. I consider these perfect for when using a public restroom that has water but no soap. It is also great for camping or any place where portability is paramount without carrying a full wet bar of soap in a container. One caveat is that the plastic door on the dispenser easily slides open, so I have to put this in a plastic bag to secure it or it will open in my purse.

In summary, these wipes are good for a baby and I love the fresh scent. However, the resealable bag is not sturdy and rips easily and the current price of $6.50 for 60 wipes comes to $.11 cents each wipe which is very expensive for this. As adult wipes, I would say pass on these.

title: Bandages have many uses; sticks to itself and not to skin or fur; 6 colorful rolls
text:

These bandages have many uses. There are 6 colorful rolls that are individually wrapped and each roll is 5 yards apiece and 2 inches tall. The colors alone excite me. These self-adhere as the bandage is wrapped around a hand, leg, arm, etc. The stretch allows this to be used like kinesiology tape with the exception that one cannot shower with this successfully and each wrap is for one-time use.

The entire roll does not have to be used at once as it depends on the amount needed. When used where joints open and close, such as a knee or elbow, the wrap may bunch up in the crease as expected. However, this is perfect to use as a lightweight version of a carpal tunnel brace by wrapping it around a bad wrist, hand, and thumb as I did in the photo. It does not stick to my skin nor to a pet's fur, which is wonderful.

This is versatile enough to wrap around the handle of a tennis racquet to get a good grip or an umbrella or cane handle. There are just so many useful possibilities besides medical reasons.

In summary, because the wrap is only two inches wide and is not designed to stick to the skin, it does have a tendency to bunch up if wrapped around a knee or elbow, so it is not perfect for everything. However, I feel this is an excellent bandage to have in one's medicine cabinet. At the current price of $8.99 this comes to an expensive $1.50 per roll which is more than some other vendors are selling this for. There are a total of 30 yards (5 yards x 6 rolls) which comes to $.30 cents per yard. I personally love this set both because of its functionality and the colors; however, the price is higher than elsewhere and is the only reason I rated this 4 stars.

The only negative is that I have to open the bomb over the bath because the center is loose and falls out before even putting water on it.

The current price of $21.84 ($22.99 minus 5%) comes to $2.43 per bath bomb which is competitively priced. However, they can be purchased about $4 cheaper from this [[ASIN:B095YK7WNS vendor]]. I do not consider these full size due to the soft center. I really like these even though they have a loose center and I cannot tell which bomb is which from the scent listed on the back.

title: Wonderful fragrance; cleans well; non-stinging; love foaming action but no suds & pricey
text:
At the current price of $12 ($15 minus 20%), this 6.7 ounce pump bottle of soap is very pricey. The foaming action is good, it does not sting my eyes, it cleans well, and smells divine. However, there are hardly any suds, so I have to use a lot to feel clean. This would have received 5 stars if it were not for the high price and lackluster lather.

UPDATE - I've used this for three showers already and the bottle is almost gone. I am totally disappointed about the lack of sudsing action as it makes me feel like I'm just washing with water. Hence I lowered this from 3 to 2 stars.

title: Absolutely excellent silicone brush; has a multitude of uses
text:
I never in my wildest dreams thought I would love a brush like this nor did I feel this would hold up to my high standards. However, this is fantastic. The brush is heavy and feels great in my hands. There are two sides -- short thin nubs and longer and thicker ones on the other side. There is also a hanging loop but one either needs a small hook to go through the hole or needs to attach a cord.

USES
- As a cleaning brush for dishes

- Use soap and water to clean under one's fingernails. I did this and it was great.

- Use as a pet hair pick-up brush by rubbing it across a surface the pets lay on. I tried this on one of the pet beds I have and it picked up the hair. The only issue I had was removing the hair from the brush. I had to rinse it out.

- As a horse curry comb for grooming and getting dirt out of a horse's coat.

- As a massager for the scalp or hands.

- As a shampoo brush; this only works well with short hair.

- As a brush to suds up the pets when giving them a bath.

- As a foot scrubber. I used this on the heels of my feet and it felt wonderful.

I mostly use the short nubbed side as it is gentler on my skin, hands, and feet.

In summary, this brush is well made, comes in some great colors, and the current price of $7.99 is a bit pricey. However, should the price go up, this one in [[ASIN:B08T1VM5L1 black]] currently sells for $3.99 by another vendor.

title: Scentless, lightweight moisturizer that leaves my skin silky
text:
This 150 ml (approx 5.072 fluid ounces) tube of lightweight cream is scentless and a lightweight moisturizer. It left my skin feeling very silky. I also felt that I had a slight hydration barrier on my skin.

The current price of $21 for this small tube is pricey, however.

title: Body butter for the skin in the size of a face cream
text: I thought this was a face cream due to the size but it seems to be body butter for the entire skin. The cream is thick and has a nice citrus fragrance. It is perfect for winter and is super hydrating. However, I am disappointed how unclear it is as to whether this is just for the face or not. The directions say to apply this to the skin. If so, this will not last as there are only 1.69 fluid ounces in this jar. It's wonderful stuff but too little an amount.

title: Sweet smelling; incredibly hydrating; nice & thick cream
text:
I really like this body butter because it is thick and creamy. Also a little goes a long way. I applied a little bit to my and my boyfriend's skin and it absorbed rapidly and our skin felt super hydrated. The fragrance is a bit sweet, however and not my absolute favorite but it is still nice. I usually do not like sweet fragrances but I do love fragrance.

The current price of $24.90 is on the very high side of competitively priced for 8.4 fluid ounces of body butter.

title: Love the back brush; handle is sufficiently long & mesh loofah creates lots of suds
text:
There is one mesh back brush with one adhesive hook with a tiny metal prong for hanging.

The plastic handle on the back brush is long enough for a good reach and the mesh puff lathers very well. This is the type of back brush I get at Walmart but for half the price. This back brush will last me about three to six months before I have to replace it either due to the mesh coming apart of the handle breaking (which is more typical). This one is currently replacing an older one whose mesh came loose.

Overall, this is a decent disposable brush. The current price of $6.59 is about $2 to $3 more than what can be purchased at Walmart.

title: This is excellent at smoothing cracked heels but instructions lacking & it's only 2 speeds not 3
text:
This is a good set for smoothing calluses or cracked heels. It comes with the rechargeable wand, a USB cable with a magnetic end, two pumice heads, and an instruction guide. The grinding heads appear to be coarse (black) and fine (white). Note that it is hard to tell which is which because both heads feel about the same but my boyfriend and I think the coarse head is the black one. Neither the manual nor the Amazon site says anything about the head type.

There are two speeds (slow and fast) even though the manual and the Amazon site says three speeds. The power level is displayed during use. Operation is super simple. Just make sure the desired grinding head is fully seated and then press the ON / OFF button. Press again if a slower speed is desired. Press a third time to turn off.

This worked well on my heels and I cleaned the grinding head on water when I was done.

Note that it took about four hours to charge and there is no A/C adapter for the USB cable. I charged it on my laptop. However, the red blinking light never turns to blue as the manual says. The instruction manual is uninformative and actually provides wrong information or no information when needed. Another example of this misinformation is that the Amazon site says this can be used wet or dry and the instruction manual says on dry feet only and not after soaking. I took off one star for the fact that it is only two and not three speeds and another star for the very poor instruction guide.

The current price of $17.99 ($19.99 minus 10%) is reasonable for this.

title: Bath bomb is irritating and left my skin itchy
text:
[[VIDEOID:5f7f9f4edb46825585073574c310b95d]] There is one large individually wrapped bath bomb in this set that can be broken into eight individual pieces. The fragrance is subtle but nice. I used one piece in a foot bath and the suds lasted over 10 minutes. I loved everything about this except that this left my feet very itchy.

There was no color bleed, which is great also. The current price of $8.99 comes to $1.12 per bath square which is reasonable. If this did not cause my feet to itch, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Lightly scented light face cream that forms a protective hydrating layer on top
text: This face cream comes in a pump container. It is a lightweight cream that has a slight scent to it. It goes on easily and provides a protective hydration layer on top. I like this cream for the winter due to the protective layer it provides. The current price of $44.90 is expensive.

title: Love the colors & straight angles on this sponge set; I dislike the plastic holder
text:
This is a lovely set of six Easter colored blending sponges with one CHEAP PLASTIC holder. I love the sponges and even like the name engraving on each sponge. However, I do not like the plastic holder at all. I would have preferred a metal one.

There are four sponges with a flat angle which is great for smooth applications. One other sponge is a typical egg-shaped sponge and the other is an hourglass sponge and are good for blending or any large make-up application.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too - at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $12.99 a pricey $2.17 per sponge if I consider the holder a freebie.

title: Medium-quality bag at a cheap price; spacious enough for a week of toiletries
text:
At the current price of $13.99, this bag is priced competitively as it is of medium quality. I had also ordered the [[ASIN:B08J2LHLYG blue]] one and that one looks more plastic than this one. I like the look of this gray one better because it does not look as cheap.

I feel this is reasonably roomy to store the toiletries for a one-week trip. I was able to get a full-size can of shaving cream, a large tube of toothpaste, a large underarm deodorant, a toothbrush, and a razor into the central compartment and I still had some room to spare. There is one central zippered compartment with six mesh folder slots. On each side of the bag there is another zippered compartment. The right side also has an outside folder pocket on the outside of the compartment. On the inside are three elastic slots for small items and one folder pocket. The same is true for the other side. These do not hold much.

The zippers glide easily even though they are not of the highest quality. There is also a hanger hook on the inside for hanging. In addition, there is a handle on top and also on the side.

Overall this is an okay bag. It won't last forever but it is good enough.

title: Versatile shaver with a multitude of trimmers & guide combs that reasonably cuts - 3.5 stars
text:
This razor is super attractive and comes with many parts for buzzing hair, shaving one's beard, cutting ear and nose hairs, etc.

ITEMS INCLUDED:
- Base razor
- A charging stand that holds all razor components except for body hair attachments.
- An A/C charging cable.
- A bottle of oil
- Foil shaver attachment
- Full size trimmer attachments (all guide combs attach to this)
- Precision trimmer attachment
- Nose/ear trimmer attachment
- Body hair trimmer attachment (all body hair combs attach to this)
- Six guide combs (1/16, 3/16, 1/8, 3/8, 1/4, & 1/2 inch)
- Four body combs, (1, 2, 4, & 6mm)
- A double-sided cleaning brush
- A small bottle of lubricant
- An instruction pamphlet
- A cheap hair cutting cape

FEATURES:
- The instruction pamphlet is comprehensive enough to allow one to learn how to use this shaver.
- The shaver parts are easy to attach and detach.
- Charging takes a few hours.
- Razor is cordless
- There is a lock feature
- LED feature tells time left on battery and RPM

This razor is easy to operate. I tried the foil shaver, nose/ear, body hair, and trimmer attachments on my boyfriend and they work reasonably well. What I did discover is that the attachment being used depends on the length of body hair. For instance, I first tried the foil shaver attachment and that was useless on my boyfriend's razor stubble simply because he does not have a beard and it works better on beard hair. The ear trimmer worked but if the hairs being trimmed were long (as in the case of my boyfriend), it did take me several passes to trim all the ear hairs. The attachment I found most useful was the trimmer attachment. That one worked well on his stubble. No razor gives a clean shave, but this did it as close as possible. Also, it trimmed his neckline with ease.

The combs attached easily on the appropriate trimmer heads as long as I angled them from the top down to hook them onto the blade.

The travel lock feature is great to prevent the razor from turning on accidentally. I just held the ON/OFF for 3 seconds to engage it and did the same to disengage it.

The only major negative I found is that the foil attachment head falls off easily compared to the other attachment heads. If I accidentally touched the top area, I had it pop off several times.

Overall, I think this is a reasonable hair head/beard/body razor for the current price of $49.99. I do like it and feel it has features for many beard, body, and hair cutting uses. The foil attachment is the only one I do not like or feel it's effective. Its efficacy is lackluster but that may be because it is more for a person with a full-grown beard.

title: Great for cleaning vegetables, picking up pet hair, or in the shower
text:
These are good as bath brushes but I personally love them as vegetable cleaning brushes or pet hair pick-up brushes. They are very pliable and are gentle on my vegetables because of that. These also work well as dry brushes to pick up pet hair off a couch or other flat surface. They work as bathing brushes too to suds up my body. The nubs on the other side act as a massager.

Overall, I love these brushes and the colors are great too. The current price of $11.99 comes to $4 per brush which is competitively priced.

title: Lightweight hand cream that’s lightly moisturizing & smells a bit like soap and a bit flowery
text:
This cream is lightweight and is lightly moisturizing. It absorbs rapidly and  leaves my hands feeling silky. It has a very fragrant and flowery scent to it that reminds me a little bit of good soap.

The current price of $17 for 1.76 ounces is very expensive for this.

title: Medium-quality bag at a cheap price; spacious enough for a week of toiletries; plasticky look
text:
At the current price of $14.99, this bag is priced competitively as it is of medium quality. What I do not like about the bag is the plastic look of it.

I feel this is reasonably roomy to store the toiletries for a one-week trip. I was able to get a full-size can of shaving cream, a large tube of toothpaste, a large underarm deodorant, a toothbrush, and a razor into the central compartment and I still had some room to spare. There is one central zippered compartment with six mesh folder slots. On each side of the bag there is another zippered compartment. Overall this is an okay bag. It won't last forever but it is good enough. I just really do not like the plasticky look.

title: Medium-quality bag at a cheap price; spacious enough for a week of toiletries
text:
At the current price of $13.99, this bag is priced competitively as it is of medium quality. I like the pink color and the design.

I feel this is reasonably roomy to store the toiletries for a one-week trip. I was able to get a full-size can of shaving cream, a large tube of toothpaste, a large underarm deodorant, a toothbrush, and a razor into the central compartment and I still had plenty of room to spare. There is one central zippered compartment with four mesh folder slots and two zippered mesh pockets. On the other side of the bag is another zippered compartment.

The zippers glide easily even though they are not of the highest quality. There is also a hanger hook on the inside for hanging. In addition, there is a thin handle on top.

Overall this is a decent bag. It won't last forever but it is good enough and it is cute looking.

title: Scentless suntan lotion in a stick; good for one’s purse
text:
This 0.53-ounce SPF 30 tube of suntan lotion is small and SUPER expensive at the current price of $18. However, it is good to carry in a purse for spot protection when needed.

It has no fragrance and does protect well. The stick glides on but the product must be rubbed in. I wouldn't use this as my "go to" lotion due to the expense and quantity; however, it is good in a pinch or for when I do not want to travel with a large bottle of suntan lotion.

For a similar item in what looks like a deodorant tube, this [[ASIN:B08WCPBCCN lotion]] is three times cheaper but still expensive for a 0.48 ounce tube with SPF 50 which also works just as well with a bit more protection.

title: I hate the forest fragrance; otherwise it works like Epsom Salt
text:
The forest fragrance has notes of fir, cedar, and spruce. Unfortunately, I absolutely hate the fragrance as it smells dirty to me.  Nevertheless I tried this in a hand bath. Since there were no directions on the package, I used 1/4 cup in warm to hot water. It took a long time (about 10 minutes) for the salts to dissolve. My hands came out feeling soft.

The only difference to me between this and Epsom salt is that this has a fragrance and typical Epsom salts do not. However, some of today's Epsom salts have fragrances but they are not as good as this.

The current price of $28 is extremely pricey for this especially when there are probably only four servings in this container. Since I cannot stand the fragrance, I would not purchase this no matter how cheap it was. I am never using this one again.

title: Fragrance is strong and lovely; lotion is lightweight but leaves a barrier on skin
text:
I love the fragrance of this cream. I ordered the grapefruit citrus and it is strong and smells divine to me. The lotion is lightweight but it dries with a film on my skin. By film I mean that it feels as if I have a protective barrier. I would have preferred if it soaked in instead feeling like something is covering my body. This is the only reason I rated this 3 stars.

The current price of $17.10 ($18 minus 5%) is competitively priced.

title: Excellent brush set at a super reasonable price
text:
At the current price of $12.99 ($16.99 minus $4 coupon), this is a superb brush set. Included in this set are one large boar / nylon bristle brush with wooden handle, one travel boar / nylon bristle brush with wooden handle, one plastic comb, and a brush head cover for the larger brush.

The brushes glide through my fine curly short to medium-length hair. They are also easy to hold. The tiny brush is not as easy due to the short handle, but that is to be expected. That brush is perfect for travel or to leave in the car. The carry satchel covers the larger brush's head for traveling or storage. The comb works well but I am not a comb person. I love the design of the brushes and the butterfly etchings on the travel brush are very attractive.

Overall this is a wonderful set. Note that there is a slight odor to the brushes but it is so faint that a little airing them out will help.

title: Clippers & cuticle cutter are great; nail file is not so great
text:
I ordered this nail set because I loved the color of the clippers. There is one sturdy nail clipper, one metal file, and a cuticle cutter/pusher in this set.

The nail clipper is strong and sharp and I LOVE that there is no spring wire to seat to get this to work. It does, however, take getting used to its curved blade. The cuticle cutter is also sharp and the pusher does what it is supposed to do.

I have never been a fan of metal nail files and this one is terrible. This nail file does not file at all as the surface is not rough enough.

I like that this comes in a protective case.

Overall, this is a relatively nice set. Nevertheless, the current price of $19.99 ($23.99 minus $4) is pricey for this set especially with such a lousy metal nail file. I do love the other tools though.

title: I use this to put toner on my face & for removing nail polish; 3 different pad styles
text:
There are three different pad styles. The first column contains 50 very thick, almost indestructible pads. The second column contains 50 cotton pads similar to those sold in cotton rounds at the drugstore. They are softer than the previous row and not as indestructible. The last row contains super thin sheets. I did not count them but there are supposed to be 300 sheets in this row.

These are perfect for removing nail polish, applying toner on the face, etc. I use them for toner and removing nail polish.

The current price of $4.76 is reasonable for this. I also like that it comes in a plastic case as I can reuse that when I run out.

title: Excellent at detangling & I love the color but I like my other detangler better
text:
I love the color of this brush and its detangling ability is good, especially with wet hair. The brush is hard plastic and works very well. It glides through my fine short to medium curly hair and gets out all the knots. It works well on my dry hair but even better on my  hair when it is wet. The hard tines feel as if I am getting a massage on the scalp. The handle provides a good grip. 

The only reason I rated this three stars is because I love my other detangling brush better. I have a [[ASIN:B0836XT7J8 Heeta brush]] and it is easier on my hair and scalp. Also, the Heeta detangler is less than half the price of this. My other brush sells for $6.99 and this one currently sells for $14. This brush feels cheaper as well. Other than this, it's great.

title: Excellent BASIC foot bath when it's not being used as a pet bed
text:
This bath is perfect. It fits my feet and my boyfriend's size 13 feet and has high sides (i.e. 6 inches tall) that the other foot baths I tried do not. It is also lightweight and I love the apple shape. I also love that the white color matches anything.

In addition to the size and function of this bath, there are nubs on the bottom that allow me to sort of get a massage during the bathing process. It also has a hole that will allow me to hang this either by attaching a string through it or by directly facing the foot bath toward the wall to hang it on a thin wire hook.

In summary, this is an excellent basic foot tub and the current price of $ 12.95 is just a little pricey as this used to be sold for $10.95. Note that if I leave this out, I can find one of my cats sleeping in it.

title: Bath bombs disintegrate on opening; produces a volcano of suds
text:
[[VIDEOID:c8185ccb50d5be1e0c6b78b1240c8d6]] There are 12 individually wrapped bath bombs in this set in the scents listed below.

- 2 Jasmine

- 2 Rose

- 2 Lemon

- 2 Lavender

- 2 Strawberry

- 2 Vanilla

Each fragrance is slightly different but only subtly so. The ingredients are listed on the box but at least two ingredients are incorrectly listed based on the scents above. The ingredients are sodium bicarbonate, citric acid, PEG-8, sea salt, shea butter, food colorants, fragrance, and essential oil (rose, lavender, orange, lemon, and peppermint). Whatever happened to the jasmine, strawberry, and vanilla. I think they substituted orange and peppermint for those three.

These are large and a bit dimpled and loosely packed. Unfortunately, when I open the bath bombs, they explode into many pieces. I could tell they were going to do this so I made sure to open this over my foot bath so as not to have a mess. Despite this they perform well and the suds last 10 minutes. In fact the suds are so spectacular that they are almost volcanic. I have been testing a lot of bath bombs lately and never encountered one whose suds triple in size like these.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I use them in a foot bath. One bath bomb dissolves in about five minutes in close to hot water. The fragrance is subtle and seems almost artificial. I also love that the color did not adhere to my skin or to my foot bath; at least the color of the "Strawberry" bomb I tried did not adhere.

The current cost of $24.15 ($25.97 minus 7%) for 12 bombs comes to a competitively priced $2.01 per bomb. My main disappointment with this set is that the fragrance is artificial and subtle and either the ingredients are incorrect or the labels on the bombs are incorrect. Since I cannot tell the fragrance very well, I am not sure which is the problem. In addition, I do not like that they fall apart on opening. Other than this, I love them.

title: Left my skin iridescent; large & lightly fragrant bath bombs; not too much color bled - 3.5 stars
text:
[[VIDEOID:6dd3d42dd631085a413ce9ad461b51a0]] There are 9 individually wrapped bath bombs in this set in the scents listed below.

- Girl's Secret - nectarine & honey

- Fleurs de Cerisier - peony

- Passionate Summer - lily & jasmine

- Opal - pear & freesia

- Fantasy Galaxy - lavender

- Shadow of Water - sea

- Juicy Orange - orange blossom

- Sea Journey - ocean

- Blueberry Juice - do son (I have no idea what fragrance that is)

Each fragrance is unique and all the scents are subtly different. These bombs are made with essential oils and they are large. The ingredients are sodium bicarbonate, citric acid, epsom salt, organic shea butter, coconut oil, essential oils, and FDA approved colorants.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I use them in a foot bath. One bath bomb dissolves in about 10 minutes in close to hot water and the suds last about that long. The fragrance is nice and the results are skin softening.Since I picked the darkest bath bomb (sea journey--which looked almost black), some of the color bled into my drying towels but only subtly so. I have had this happen in the past and the wash usually gets out the color. What I do not like is that all the bombs have an irresdecene to them. This left my skin full of sparkles. Luckily I took a shower afterward. I can see children loving the glitter but I do not.

The current price of $19.99 comes to $2.22 per bath bomb which is typical of many on the market.

title: Love the colors & angles in this sponge set; most of the sponges are dense; metal holder is great
text:
This is a lovely set of eight sponges in nice Easter colors. It also comes with a great metal sponge holder. The purple sponges are light density, the pink ones with the odd tip are medium density, and the rest are dense. Less dense sponges soak up more liquid make-up than the denser ones.

I love that most of these have a flat side which are great for smooth applications. The typical egg-shaped ones and the hour-glass sponges are good for blending or any large make-up application. The hour-glass ones are easier to hold in the center. I am not yet sold on the odd tip on the hourglass sponges. It is slicker than I am used to and the liquid make-up does not soak in as quickly causing it to run if I am not careful.

I still love these sponges. These feel good in the hands, blend reasonably well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

Except for the two hourglass ones with the weird tip, the sponges are similar in style to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too - at least to me.

The current price of $9.99 is a great deal for this as it comes to $1.25 per sponge. This would make a great gift for the Easter basket.

title: Bath bombs explode on opening; highly fragrant & sudsy; love the surprise
text:
[[VIDEOID:8da8860c015b3c51dd8defb384ca48d]] There are 6 individually wrapped bath bombs in this set in the scents listed below.

- ocean
- lavender extract
- aloe
- rose extract
- olay type
- milk

Each fragrance is divine, smells fresh, and all the scents are different but they are only subtly different. The ingredients are listed on the box but they are not made with essential oils. They are large and a bit dimpled. Unfortunately, when I open the bath bombs, they explode into many pieces. I had such a mess on my hands. Despite this they perform well and the suds last over 15 minutes.

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I use them in a foot bath. One bath bomb dissolves in about five minutes in close to hot water. The fragrance is wonderful. I also love that the color did not adhere to my skin or to my foot bath; at least the color of the "Ocean" bomb I tried did not adhere.

I have no idea how much these will cost. I love them in every way, including the light that is a surprise inside. The major problem is that they disintegrate immediately and create a mess. When I order bath bombs, I want them to remain whole and dissolve in the bath. I spent over 15 minutes cleaning up the mess. If they did not explode on opening, I would have rated this 4 or 5 stars.

title: Does create a barrier on the skin; not totally scentless & thin cream - 3.5 stars
text:
This lotion is not totally scentless as it has a faint scent of what I would call artificial rosemary that I am not fond of. The cream is lightweight as well. It is thinner than I expected. I used this on my hands and it did dry so that I had what felt like a moisture barrier on my skin. I personally prefer creams with nice scents. The box says to apply this to the face, but I prefer to use this for my hands.

I do like the locking pump. I turn the pump spout one way to open and another to lock.

In summary, after having tried this I would not purchase this because I only like it somewhat. I do not care for the scent and the fact that the cream is thin. Also, the current price of $30 is expensive for this. This is made in Korea.

title: Good large-sized buff puffs that create copious suds
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only thing I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are large-sized and similar to the ones I buy at Walmart for $ 2 each. There are three puffs and they work like any other large mesh loofah I regularly use.

The current price of $4.99 comes to a very reasonable $1.66 each puff. I really love that these are larger and looser than some others I tried because they work better than those that are in a super tight ball. Only time will tell how long they will last.

title: Large bath bombs w/nice surprise; lightly fragrant; bubbles last about 10 minutes
text:
[[VIDEOID:a81176e5545490245eac6fc301ea2262]] There are 12 large individually wrapped bath bombs for kids in this set and they all have fragrances that are subtly different. Unfortunately, there is no list of the fragrance of each nor the full ingredients list. The Amazon site only says these bombs are made with essential oils. Nevertheless, I really love these. Each one contains a surprise and the surprise in the one I used is cute as can be seen from my photo.

I tried the yellow bath bomb and the fragrance came out in the bath. The surprise was larger than I expected and came out after the bomb dissolved (see photo).

Since I personally do not like the color rings caused by bath bombs in my bath, I use them in a foot bath. One bath bomb dissolves in about five minutes in close to hot water and the suds last about 10 minutes. The fragrance is definitely detectable. I also love that the neon-yellow color of the bomb I tested did not adhere to my skin, my foot bath, or my towels.

The current price of $18.59 ($19.99 minus 7%) comes to a reasonable $1.55 per bath bomb which is cheaper than most on the market. This set is lovely for children and even for adults who are young at heart. I also love the cute animal surprise which is not likely to rinse down the drain unless there is no grate covering the drain hole. These are very nice and definitely giftable.

title: Small & fragrant bath bombs; bubbles minimal & wears out quickly
text:
Only the first few seconds of the video shows the bath bomb in action.

There are 9 small individually wrapped bath bombs in this set. All the bombs are colorful and have subtle but different scents. Based on the Amazon title, these are made with essential oils.

The fragrances included are:
- mint
- lavender
- seaweed
- orange

title: Scentless; love the pink color, cleans but does not brighten; doubt there's SPF in soap
text:
There are two tiny bars of soap in this package and a mesh bag. This is a weirdly advertised bar of soap. I never heard of SPF in soap and I doubt there is any in this and, if there is, I doubt it would work.

This appears to be fragrance free as I do not detect any aroma. The soap lathers mildly but cleans well. I actually feel that they are moisturizing even though there are no claims on the box to that effect. Nevertheless, I did not notice any brightening of acne scars or anything like that. I tried their other soaps and, although there are these brown bits on the top, none were exfoliating. However, with these bars I can feel the exfoliation but the brown bits are only surface level.

I do love the pink color of these bars. Note that the bars are nicely sized and fit comfortably in the palm of my hand but I have trouble keeping them there. I have no idea what is the problem with vegan soaps but these bars are a bit slippery when wet. I have discovered that most vegan soaps are like this, which I consider a falling hazard as the bar ricochets around my tub.

The current price of $8.99 is competitive for this as it comes to $4.50 per bar. Each bar only lasts me about 3-4 days. As a soap, I think this is good. However, it gets 3 stars because I didn't notice any skin brightening and I doubt the validity or usefulness of SPF 15 in these bars.

text:

title: Brushes are excellent as detangler; metal rake is great to remove hair from the brushes
text:

Overall, I feel this is a great set and attractive too.

The current price of $14.99 for 15 fluid ounces is competitively priced.

title: Exquisitely crafted hefty brush with long handle & great grip
text:
I tried several brushes over the last several months but this one is the best so far. This is now my favorite brush. The handle looks exquisitely crafted even though it is probably machine made. I use this in the shower as a back brush with soap and it is great.

The brush is hefty and is one solid piece, which is fabulous as the head cannot fall off the handle like some other brushes I tried previously. The handle of this back brush has indentation grips on it which provides me with a good hold. The handle is also long, which provides me with a good reach.

The brush head is sturdy enough to be exfoliating and cleaning yet gentle enough not to be irritating. I love that there is a rope at the end for hanging in the shower and there is even a canvas bag for storage after air drying if desired.

Overall, I love this as a wet brush for my back. I do not use this for dry brushing. The current price of $24.86 is about twice what most wooden back brushes go for but the quality is also higher.

PS The Smiley Smith engraving with what looks like a monkey is cool too.

title: Excellent BASIC foot bath when it's not being used as a pet bed
text:

In addition to the size and function of this bath, there are nubs on the bottom that allow me to sort of get a massage during the bathing process. It also has a hole that will allow me to hang this either by attaching a string through it or by directly facing the foot bath toward the wall to hang it on a thin wire hook.

In summary, this is an excellent basic foot tub and the current price of $10.95 is competitively priced. Note that if I leave this out, I can find one of my cats sleeping in it.

title: Presentation & color is exquisite; synthetic brushes are good but price is way too high
text:

However for the high price, I would have also expected a larger blush brush, several lip liner brushes, and a mascara wand. Note that the brush handles are slippery because there is no silicone grip on them. This, along with the astronomical $60.99 ($69.99 minus $9) price tag are my biggest negatives.

BRUSHES INCLUDED ARE:

5 - Blending brush
6 - Nose contour brush
7 - Large eyeshadow brush
8 - Medium eyeshadow brush
9 - Small eyeshadow brush
10 - Eyebrow brush

Nevertheless, this is an extremely presentable brush set and the colors along with the packaging makes this an exquisite gift. title: Novelty eyelash curler for pet lovers; 7 extra pads; works but be careful not to pinch eyelids
text:
There are two novelty eyelash curlers in this package. One is tiny and the size of a small nail clipper and the other is regular sized. Each curler's arm can be used as a stand or to squeeze for the curl. Each curler also has one silicone refill located on the unit and there are five additional unattached refills for the large curler. For the tiny one, the one refill is at the top. I could not get that one out, so I'll have to use a tool to remove it. On the larger unit, it is easy to remove the extra one on the back of the curler and the other five are loose in the package as shown in my photo.

The larger curler curls very well. The only caveat is that I have to be careful not to pinch my eyelids because there is no guide on this curler like there is on a regular one. On a standard eyelash curler, the curvature of the wand fits exactly in the eye socket and it is not as easy to curl one's lids. This one has no "safety" built in, so one has to be careful to gently curl the lashes without aggressively going at the lashes with the curler until one is used to this unit.

The tiny curler requires many tries to curl eyelashes because it only takes about 25% of my lash line into the tool. However, it is good for travel. The Amazon site says this is a corner curler but I consider it more for travel as all my eyelashes fit in the larger unit.

The current price of $7.59 ($7.99 minus 5%) is reasonable for this set of curlers. It gets 5 stars for its novelty and 2.5 stars for its safety from pinching and 4.5 stars for its curling ability. This would make a perfect gift for someone who is willing to be careful with this and loves pets and novelty items.

title: Super sweet smelling; incredibly hydrating; looks like half a jar is missing
text:
I really like this body butter because it is thick and creamy. Also a little goes a long way. I applied a little bit to my skin and it absorbed rapidly and my skin felt super hydrated. The fragrance is a bit sweet, however. It is almost borderline cloyingly sweet. I usually do not like sweet fragrances but I do love fragrance. This one is strong and I actually like it.

I do not doubt that there are four ounces of product in this jar, but when I opened the jar it looked like half the product was missing. The jar is oversized for the amount of product inside.

The current price of $15.87 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Good medium-sized buff puffs that create copious suds
text:

These are medium-sized and similar to the ones I buy at Walmart for $2 each. There are four puffs and they work like any other large mesh loofah I regularly use.

The current price of $7.89 comes to a reasonable $1.97 each puff. If these puffs were just a little bit larger, I would have rated them 5 stars. Only time will tell how long they will last.

UPDATE: It's 8/21/2021 and I'm still using these sponges. I do wish they were a bit looser as they are really compact. However, as they wear out over time, they loosen. These are a solid 4 stars due to the tightness. If they were bigger and looser I would give them 5 stars.

title: Nice touch-up / concealer brush; soft enough to be comfortable; sturdy enough to be effective
text:
This brush is good for under eye concealer or just touch-ups elsewhere. The bristles are tightly packed and short as they should be. They are soft enough to be comfortable, yet sturdy enough to be effective.

There was no shedding and the bristles feel good against my skin and work well. The handle is a bit slippery but still good enough to hold.

The current price of $ 6.79 is competitively priced.

title: Three sides are coarse and one side as a buffer; these work well
text:
These buffer blocks are of light to medium coarseness and are perfect for polishing nails, filing nails, or even using on the heels of feet. Three sides are coarse and one is just the sponge itself that can be used for polishing. I particularly like this side because most buffers do not have that. This almost serves as a chamois brush.

There are 10 purple blocks and 5 regular nail files. Three sides of all blocks have slightly different grit.

The current price of $7.75 is competitive for this set as it comes to $.52 cents per piece if I count all 15 pieces in this set (10 buffers and 5 nail files).

title: Functional 3-blade case but is this necessary; instructions hilarious
text:
At the current price of  $21.65 ($22.79 minus 5%) one receives a magnetic box that stores three razor blades and has an indentation on top to lay the actual razor. Also included is an adhesive-backed magnet strip. This strip pairs well with the box top that is magnetic. Therefore, if one affixes the strip to a wall or tile, then the box top can be magnetically attached to that strip so that the user can shave in the miniscule mirror that is underneath the box top.

In my opinion, this is an unnecessary piece of equipment. The best part is that the box holds three razor blades. Other than this, most people will have a mirror at home and do not want to shave in a mirror the size of a Post-it. The only time a mirror will likely be used is during travel. However, there is no suction cup magnet strip from which to hang the mirror, there's only the strip with the permanent adhesive.

Despite the above, this works. It held my extra razor blades. It also held my razor when placed on top but it did not magnetically hold it because all my razors have a plastic handle.

My opinion is that only a certain few men will like this. It depends on if their razor is metal so that it can be held tightly onthe magnetic top and if they like extra  gadgets.

Note that the instructions on the side of the box are hilarious. Below is EXACTLY how they are written - misspellings and broken English included. 

Instrution

•There's one indentation on the top of razor box that can hold 95% of manual razor handles in the market. It can make your life more orderly which save in same holder after shaving.

• Manual razor box is with 3 blade indentation in the bottom of stand. It can be replaced in the box,when the blade is not sharp. This can save much time in your life.

• There's one mirror inside the top of razor box. You can use it when there's no mirror anywhere,to add your life more surprising.

• The bottom and top cover in razor box is magnetic button. Magnet design makes people's experience more cozy.

• The top of razor box is with magnetic design which can be stick on metal like on wall. In order to free your hands, magnet design can be sticked in any metal object.

title: Takes 90 seconds to dry but leaves my hands clean after use; fragrance is weird
text:
There is one 2 fluid ounce flip cap tube of gel hand sanitizer in this package. This sanitizer takes about 90 seconds to dry but leaves my hands feeling clean. I personally do not care for the fragrance as it is a weird smell that I cannot describe. Also, this does not feel moisturizing.

The active ingredient is benzalkonium chloride 0.1%.

I really like the portability of this tube but do not care for the product itself. At the current price of $5.99 comes to $3 per ounce which is very pricey.

title: Creamy shampoo w/intoxicating fragrance; lathers & cleans well; slightly volumizing
text: What I love most about this shampoo is its intoxicatingly lovely fragrance. What I am most surprised about is that the shampoo is creamy white and almost like a moisturizing lotion. However, I got a good lather from it and my hair felt clean afterward. I did expect more volume once it dried but it is just a little more volumizing than regular shampoo. Note that I have short to medium length fine curly hair. Even though it is not as volumizing as I expected, I still love this shampoo and the current price of $8.31 is competitively priced for this 16.9 fluid ounce pump bottle.

title: Typical disposable nail files that get the job done but in lots of fun designs
text:
There are 12 nail files in this package and each one has a fun and festive design that I love.

These are great for manicurists who want a disposable nail file to use with customers or just for someone who wants to use these to file their own nails. The grit on these is light, so the results are gently achieved. These do not have to be disposable as I am able to use mine several times until the paper surface becomes marred.

The current price of $5.99 comes to $.50 cents per file which is competitively priced.

title: Provides nice blush & foundation coverage; bristles stay; handle slippery; case terrible - 3.5 stars
text:
I really like this brush. It comes with its own snap-closure plastic case to keep the brush from smudging the rest of the products in my make-up case. Unfortunately the case is terrible because it is impossible to open unless one has long fingernails, which I do not.

The brush provides good blush and powder foundation coverage. I prefer it for powder but it also works with liquid. I also love that the bristles do not fall out. The only negative is that the plastic handle is slippery in my hands that makes it a tad tricky to maintain my grip. Other than this, this brush is lovely.

However, the price is about $3 more than what some other vendors are selling it for. The current price of $6.55 ($7.99 minus 8%) is pricey for this when the same [[ASIN:B08F58QG32 brush]] with different color bristles sells for only $3.79.

title: Lathers moderately; cleans well; bar is slippery & I dislike pine blend fragrance
text:
The writing on the packaging is all in Korean, which is the first negative. Second, it is difficult to remove the plastic from the "sticky" bar of soap but I finally got it off after working on it for about three minutes.

The fragrance is a mix of pine and something else. I absolutely dislike the aroma. The soap does clean well and spreads well, but lathers only moderately. Also, I found the bar to be slippery when wet and was afraid I was going to have this slide out of my hands. I have no idea if it stops acne because I see no difference.

In addition to the above, the current price of $9.98 ($11.09 minus 10%) is very expensive for this soap.

UPDATE: The vendor contacted me via Twitter and said that they are working on English stickers. Also, the reason the plastic stuck to the bar was due to the humidity and heat. The plastic is on the bar to prevent the moisture from evaporating.

title: Silicone side is best as spot applicator; brush end is best; no air holes for drying
text:
This is a dual-end brush with cover. The tiny silicone end is practically useless for washing but it is great as a spot applicator for acne cream and the like. It just has to be scrubbed off afterward. The brush end is nice for washing by sudsing up that end. Unfortunately, it is very difficult to remove the cover from this unit. Also, there are no air holes in the cover, so the end that is being covered must be fully dried before covering it.

The current price of $8.48 is a bit pricey for this. I like this but do not love it.

title: Pink (not purple) tiny silicone eyelash/eyebrow brushes – 2.3 stars
text:
There are two tiny brushes in this case. I need to use two hands to get at the brushes because the case lid closes on itself. The wider silicone brush is for the eyelashes and the thinner one is for the eyebrow. I prefer to use both for my eyebrows. They are cheaply made and I doubt these will last long, especially when they have to be washed to remove mascara or eyebrow pencil residue.

In addition, I ordered the purple one but it looks light pink and not purple which is a disappointment. The current price of $8.09 ($8.99 minus 10%) is terribly expensive for this as it is not worth more than $2.50 in my opinion.

title: Novelty eyelash curler for pet lovers; 2 extra pads; works but be careful not to pinch eyelids
text:
There are two novelty eyelash curlers in this package. One is tiny and the size of a small nail clipper and the other is regular sized. Each curler's arm can be used as a stand or to squeeze for the curl. Each curler also has one silicone refill located on the unit. For the tiny one, it is at the top. I could not get that one out, so I'll have to use a tool to remove it. On the larger unit, it is easy to remove the extra one on the back of the curler.

The larger curler curls very well. The only caveat is that I have to be careful not to pinch my eyelids because there is no guide on this curler like there is on a regular one. On a standard eyelash curler, the curvature of the wand fits exactly in the eye socket and it is not as easy to curl one's lids. This one has no "safety" built in, so one has to be careful to gently curl the lashes without aggressively going at the lashes with the curler until one is used to this unit.

The tiny curler requires many tries to curl eyelashes because it only takes about 25% of my lash line into the tool. However, it is good for travel. According to the Amazon site, this tiny unit is for curling the corners. That makes no sense to me since all my eyelashes fit in the larger unit. Nevertheless, this is very tiny.

The current price of $6.87 ($8.59 minus 20%) is reasonable for this set of curlers. It gets 5 stars for its novelty and 2.5 stars for its safety from pinching and 4.5 stars for its curling ability. This would make a perfect gift for someone who is willing to be careful with this and loves pets and novelty items.

title: Works gently but effectively on the dry skin on my feet; it's functional art
text:
This file is easy to hold as a result of the curved handle and easy to work with. It also files my heels gently. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler. When I was done, I just rinsed the file under warm water and the dead skin that was removed was easily rinsed off. The file looked brand new afterward.

The current price of $10.80 is a few dollars cheaper than other etched glass (a.k.a. nano crystal) files on the market, which is great. In addition, this is a gorgeous file and a pretty color. To me it's functional art.

title: I love the dense blenders in this "egg-carton" sponge set & that 3 sponges have a flat angle
text:
This is a nice set of four blending sponges with one plastic case that allows the sponges to be displayed like a carton of eggs.

I love the sponges as they are dense. The plastic holder allows the sponges to remain separated from make-up color contamination.

All but one of the blenders have a flat / angled side which is great for smooth applications.The egg-shaped blender is also good for liquid make-up application. They feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are also perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $4.89 these are a reasonable almost $1.23 per sponge if I consider the plastic container as a freebie.

title: Attractive, sharp, & colorful nail clippers but a bit pricey
text:
These nail clippers are very attractive and colorful. They have a long handle that provide a good but slightly slippery grip since there is no silicone grip on them. All I had to do to use this was flip over the metal piece in the center which then created the spring action needed to operate these.

The clippers are sharp and operate well. They are sturdy but I would not call them heavy duty. I actually feel the current price of $15.99 is about $7 too much for these. They are good but not so outstanding that they should command such a high price for one item.

title: Great set of silicone travel bottles; labels must go on tops; jar tops loosen easily
text:
There are four colorful silicone squeeze bottles. These bottles are excellent. Two hold 3.4 ounces and two hold 2 ounces. They are good for holding lotion, hand sanitizer, etc. I love the soft sides because it permits most of the solution to be squeezed out easily. The caps also securely snap on. A sheet of clear labels are provided but the labels do not stay on the bottles that well during use. It is best to affix them to the flip cap tops.

Also included are two tiny jars. The jars have an interior lid and then a cap on top. Note that the cap loosens easily, so it is important to be careful when using them. The jars are also perfect for body butter, face cream, perhaps one's own personal lip balm, etc. Also included are six circular labels pre-typed with conditioner, lotion, sunscreen, shampoo, body wash, and face cream.

This set is very good. The current price of $7.6 comes to a reasonable $1.27 per empty container.

title: These are soft and comfortable gloves to wear w/a bit of stretch; I supply the moisturizer
text:
There are six pairs of white gloves in this package. They are very soft and have a bit of stretch to them which makes them spacious and usable for large hands like mine (with room to spare). They are also very comfortable to wear. I cover my hands with these after applying a heavy moisturizer to my hands and my hands are more hydrated than they would have been had I not worn gloves.

These work well to keep the moisturizer that I apply to my hands from drying out rapidly. Since these gloves breathe, my hands do not shrivel up as if they were in water or plastic.

These gloves will not last long as I have used other gloves like these in the past. With repeated use, any grease like Vaseline and other lotions will stain the gloves and not everything will come out in the wash. In addition, they will come apart at the seams. However, I do not expect gloves like these to last more than two weeks of repeated use.

The current price of $6.99 is competitively priced for these as they come to $1.17 per pair. If they increase the price, then I rate these 4 stars. Note, however, they are selling the exact same gloves for $3.99 for six pairs [[ASIN:B08ZKC7P64 here]]. In fact, I have been using those gloves for a while now and they work well.

title: Absolutely wonderful; highly fragrant & relaxing
text:
The fragrance of this bath salt is absolutely divine. It has a highly fragrant aroma of lavender mixed with chamomile that just goes well together. I used this as a hand soak and my hands felt great after 15 minutes and the scent stayed after I rinsed my hands off.

This is just lovely and it is mostly due to the fragrance. The current price of $18.99 is a bit pricey for 36 ounces but it is better than other aromatherapy bath salts I tried previously. Note that there are about 4.5 cups of salt in this package and if one uses 2 cups per bath, there are only two baths worth. This is one of those products that I consider "spa-worthy" and should be a once in a while treat.

title: Wooden finish is flawless; brush head passes through my hair easily but bristles are a bit stiff
text:
At the current price of $22.99 this brush is slightly pricey. However, the craftsmanship is lovely and the finish is flawless. Per the package, this is made of African rosewood.

The brush head itself passes through my short to medium fine curly hair easily and it is also easy to clean. It is not too large and not too small and feels great in my hands, meaning it is very easy to hold and maintain a grip on. The only negative I see is that the bristles are a strong nylon and a bit stiff. As a result, when my hair got knotted from not wearing my hat in the convertible, this brush ripped out some of my hair while effectively combing out the knots.

In summary, I consider this brush a work of art simply because of the exquisite finish on the wood. I am impressed. I definitely consider this giftable.

title: The fragrance is divine but SUPER PRICEY
text:
For $13.60 ($16 minus 15%) there are 20 towelettes in this package which comes to $.68 cents per wipe which I consider INSANELY expensive. Nevertheless, these wipes have a divine lavender fragrance that I could inhale all day. These can be used to wipe down one's hands, face, countertops, etc. There is a slightly oily feel to them but that dissipates after drying. The wipes are a small size typical of any hand wipe. They are also moderately moist.

The ingredients are water, lavender essential oil, lactobacillus ferment, and polysorbate 20.

If this were one third the price, this would have received 5 stars.

title: Superb combs for eyebrows and eyelashes
text:
I love these metal tined combs. They are perfect for combing out my bushy eyebrows and also for de-clumping my eyelashes after applying mascara. Of course the combs have to be washed after that. Yes, they have a cheap plastic handle but they work.

The current price of $7.99 comes to a reasonable $3.50 per comb.

title: Soothing to my lips, heels, and hands but pricey for what it is - 3.5 stars
text:
At the current price of $9.99 this is a pricey way to soothe my lips, heels, hands, chin, etc. as it comes to $4.50 per tube. Note that the size of the tube is smaller than my lip balm. There are two 0.186 ounce tubes in this package.

I used this on my lips, heels, and hands and it was hydrating. This is good for when one wants to carry a small lotion without having to take a bottle with them. However, I just feel this is way too pricey even though it works well.

The directions say to apply freely to the lips, cheeks, chin, nose, and behind the ears prior to wearing a face mask. The ingredients are *cocoa butter, *beeswax, sunflower seed oil, *olive fruit oil, *rosehip oil, natural vitamin E, *calendula flower, and natural aloe vera. Those denoted with * are organic ingredients.

title: Great set of silicone travel bottles; labels do not stay on bottles so put them on the cap
text:
There are four colorful silicone squeeze bottles. These bottles are excellent. They hold 3 ounces of lotion, hand sanitizer, etc. I love the soft sides because it permits most of the solution to be squeezed out easily. The caps also securely snap on. A sheet of clear labels are provided but the labels do not stay on the bottles that well during use. Instead, they recommend you put them on the cap for better adherence. Other than this, this is a great set.

The current price of $9.99 comes to a slightly pricey $2.50 per empty bottle.

title: Good hair duster for when I cut my boyfriend’s hair
text:
Since COVID-19, I've been buzzing my boyfriend's hair. I have a barber cape but some hair still hangs around. This brush works well to remove the little straggler hairs left behind. It is soft and my boyfriend said he likes the way it feels when I dust his neck with this. It is also easy to hold.

This is a low-end brush with synthetic bristles and plastic handle but it works well. So far the bristles have not shed. I feel $6.99 is a reasonable price for this.

title: Soft and comfortable gloves to wear w/a bit of stretch; one glove missing; also pricey
text:
There are five and half pairs of white gloves in this package when there should have been six pairs, so that is disappointing. They are very soft and have a bit of stretch to them which makes them spacious and usable for large hands like mine (with room to spare). They are also very comfortable to wear. I cover my hands with these after applying a heavy moisturizer to my hands and my hands are more hydrated than they would have been had I not worn gloves.

The current price of $10.99 is too expensive for these as they are selling the exact same gloves for $3.99 for six pairs [[ASIN:B08ZKC7P64 here]]. In fact, I have been using those gloves for a while now and they work well. Also, it is disappointing that one glove is missing from this set. At the current price, they come to $2.20 per pair if 5 pairs are received and $1.83 per pair if 6 pairs are received. These would have received 5 stars if all 6 pairs were included and the price was $6.99 or under.

title: Works gently but effectively on the dry skin on the heels of my feet
text:
This etched glass file is easy to hold and work with. It gently files the dry skin off my heels. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler. When I was done, I just rinsed the file under warm water and the dead skin that was removed was easily rinsed off. The file looked brand new afterward.

I also love that the handle is longer than typical, so it makes it easier for me to work with this.

The current price of $12.96 is the going rate for files like this. This is also a pretty file making it sort of functional art.

title: Brush is a bit rough & sheds a bit but it works well; handle is attractive – 3.5 stars
text:
There is one attractive badger shave brush in this package. Since it is real badger hair, the brush head does stink a bit but that is to be expected. In fact my three cats kept smelling the brush head because they knew it was from an animal. I tried this with my shave bar and it worked well. There were a few hairs that shed but I also expected that. This brush is a bit rough. I did expect a slightly softer brush head and it is mostly for this reason that I rate this 3.5 stars.

The current price of $16.19 ($17.99 minus 10%) is competitively priced for the quality of this brush.

title: Shave bar has nice fragrance but lathers less than a bar of soap
text: I never tried a shave bar before so I was excited to try this. Unfortunately, this reminds me of a low suds bar of soap. I could barely work up a lather with or without the badger brush. The skin on my upper lip and my chin did feel moisturized and super soft after I shaved with this but I still do not like this bar. First of all, the bar is square and does not fit as well in the bowl of a shaving brush set. Secondly, the "lather" is almost non-existent as shown in my photo. It is for these two reasons I'll pass on this no matter how soft it leaves my skin and no matter how wonderful the fragrance.

title: Basic shave set; brush is a bit rough but it works
text:
This is a basic shave bowl (plastic/melamine) with a stand and a badger brush. The stand has a space for a razor and mine fits in the slot as per my photo.

The badger brush is a bit rough, meaning it has coarse bristles. I did expect a softer brush. Nevertheless, this set works as shown but it just does not blow me away with the quality.

title: Love the size, lather, and exfoliating ability of this soap; only mildly scented - 4.5 stars
text:
There are six medium sized circular bars of soap in this package. The fragrance is very subtle. I love the size of the bar because it fits easily in my hand. It lathers very well and is exfoliating. There are specs of something in the bars that provides this exfoliating ability. My skin felt clean and smooth afterward. I would not say it was moisturized but I loved the results. In my opinion, a woman can use men's soap too.

The current price of $15.99 is reasonable for 6 bars of soap as it comes to $2.67 per bar.

title: Pretty blow dryer but 3 of the 5 tools fall off during use - 2.5 stars
text:
For the current price of $39.99, this would have been a reasonable price if everything worked, but it does not. In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user sheet, two concentrators (small and medium), two concentrator combs (large and larger), and a diffuser.

Although I did not have to do this, sometimes before first use the red button on the plug has to be pushed in or it won't turn on. In my case, it just worked. There are three controls on the front. The cool shot button and a high, low, and off for the speed, which is the second button. The last button on the bottom is the high, medium, and low for the heat. None of the buttons are marked but they are easy to remember.

Installing and removing the attachments are a cinch. Unfortunately, only the two concentrators stay seated. The reason is because they get installed inside the nose of the dryer. The combs and diffuser go over the nose of the dryer and they fall off. I cannot use this blow dryer with those three tools because no matter how hard I press to seat them, they are just not secure enough to remain on the dryer.

The cord does turn but I would not call it a swivel cord but it acts similarly.

In summary, this is a nice blow dryer as long as one does not need to use the tools. The controls are easy to operate. However, since all the tools do not work, I rate this 2.5 stars.

title: Lovely gel; very moisturizing; leaves my skin feeling like silk
text:
I used this on my face and hands. It reminds me of hand sanitizer but absorbs quickly and leaves my face, neck, and hands very smooth. I love this gel. I also like that the pump can be locked and unlocked by just turning it to the left or right.

The current price of $27 is competitively priced for this. It's just lovely and it has a nice fresh scent too.
