title: Absolutely excellent silicone brush; has a multitude of uses
text:
I never in my wildest dreams thought I would love a brush like this nor did I feel this would hold up to my high standards. However, this is fantastic. The brush is heavy and feels great in my hands. There are two sides -- short thin nubs and longer and thicker ones on the other side. There is also a hanging loop but one either needs a small hook to go through the hole or needs to attach a cord.

USES
- As a cleaning brush for dishes

- Use soap and water to clean under one's fingernails. I did this and it was great.

- Use as a pet hair pick-up brush by rubbing it across a surface the pets lay on. I tried this on one of the pet beds I have and it picked up the hair. The only issue I had was removing the hair from the brush. I had to rinse it out.

- As a horse curry comb for grooming and getting dirt out of a horse's coat.

- As a massager for the scalp or hands.

- As a shampoo brush; this only works well with short hair.

- As a brush to suds up the pets when giving them a bath.

- As a foot scrubber. I used this on the heels of my feet and it felt wonderful.

I mostly use the short nubbed side as it is gentler on my skin, hands, and feet.

In summary, this brush is well made, comes in some great colors, and the current price of $4.89 ($9.99 minus 30%) is reasonable. However, should the price go up, this one in [[ASIN:B08T1VM5L1 black]] currently sells for $3.99 by another vendor and in this same blue color it sells for $6.99 [[ASIN:B08T1GQ8ZR here]].

title: Ordinary lightweight cream; nothing special except it is scentless
text:
To me there is nothing special about this lotion. It is a lightweight cream that is mildly moisturizing and is scentless. It is no better than a lot of cheaper creams on the market. In fact I like creams like Jergens better because they have a nice scent and are thicker.

The current price of $20 for 6.8 fluid ounces is a lot for this. Also, everything on the bottle is written in Korean. The box is also written mostly in Korean with one side in English. Nowhere on the bottle or box does it say the fluid ounces; that is only displayed on the Amazon site.

title: Beautiful eyeliner selection; pencils glide on lightly
text:
There are 18 gorgeous eyeliner colors in this set. They can be used to line under or over the eye. The colors glide easily on paper; however, when I used them on my eye, I only got a light pigment. This is typical of many eyeliners. If I lightly and quickly pass it close to a flame from a lighter, it glides on thick.

Note that the color is released by turning the tip of the pencil--no sharpening needed. Of course, I have to be careful not to release too much of the color or the tip will break.

Overall, this is a nice selection that can be mixed with shadow, used on the interior line of the eye (where I use it), or the exterior top or bottom.

The current price of $22.49 ($24.99 minus 10%) comes to $1.41 per "pencil."

title: Scentless body wash that stings the eyes and leaves a film on my body
text:
I do not like this at all. It lathers well if I use a large quantity of wash. However, it feels like it leaves a film behind which makes me feel unclean. Also, even if I close my eyes in the shower, it stings my eyes. It is also scentless which is fine even though I prefer a nice scent. I sort of felt clean after using this but I do not like it. I am going to use this as hand soap to get rid of it.

The current price of $10.95 ($12.95 minus $2) is on the expensive for 12 ounces of body wash. It is vegan, however.

title: Functions just like Epsom Salt and dissolves instantaneously
text:
I used this to bathe my feet. This dissolves faster than Epsom Salt so that what I am left with is a bath of clear water almost immediately after running the water.

I did not notice anything special about this salt. Although it is scentless, I did detect a faint aroma that I like. Perhaps it is just the smell of the salt. My feet came out feeling clean but no better or worse than if I had just used Epsom salt which is cheaper.

At the current price of $16.99, this comes to $3.40 per pound. My local Walmart sells 8 pounds of Epsom salt for $8, so that is much cheaper.

title: I love the blenders in this sponge set; the Easter colors are wonderful
text:
This is a pretty set of four colored blending sponges. These blenders are of medium density. Their colors are "Easter" vibrant. All the sponges are hourglass shaped which make them easy to hold and are good for blending or any large liquid make-up application. I personally gravitate toward blenders that have an angled edge but I knew when I ordered this these were round all over.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. I personally never met a blender sponge I did not like unless they stink. Also, the more colorful they are, the more I am attracted to them even though the colors get covered up by the liquid foundation and other make-up.

These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are also perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $5.99 is a reasonable $1.50 per sponge.

title: Conditioner creamy but do not like aroma & left shower floor slippery; love dispenser
text: I have short to medium fine curly hair and wanted to try this on me. Unfortunately, it's just okay. The condition is creamy and hydrating with being too relaxing but it left my shower floor very slippery. I also dislike the fragranceThe only thing I really loved was the dispenser as pressing down on the top pops up the top.

title: Shampoo too liquid & a bit astringent to hair; love dispenser
text: I have short to medium fine curly hair and wanted to try this on me. Unfortunately, it's just okay. The shampoo is very liquid and I felt like my hair was being stripped. The fragrance was okay. The only thing I really loved was the dispenser as pressing down on the top pops up the top.

title: Stunning clips with a great hold; very stylish
text:
There are four boxy claw clips in this package with one scrunchie. The clips are absolutely stunning with their marbleized look. They are medium-sized and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on. They would work even better with longer hair.

At the current price of $7.99 it comes to a very reasonably priced $2 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well. The scrunchie is a nice addition but not as spectacular as the claw clips.

title: Stunning clips with a great hold; very stylish
text:
There are four boxy claw clips in this package with one scrunchie. The clips are absolutely stunning with their marbleized look. They are medium-sized and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on. They would work even better with longer hair.

At the current price of $8.99 it comes to a very reasonably priced $2.25 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well. The scrunchie is a nice addition but not as spectacular as the claw clips.

title: Superb, lightweight rotary brushes for blow drying
text:
There are three rotary vent brushes in this package (3", 2.5" and 2"). What I love about these brushes are that they are lightweight, they have vents for blow drying, and they pass through my hair easily without tangling. The combination of boar bristles with what seems like nylon bristles provides me with a good grip on my hand. I also did not experience any static. In addition, the handles have slight indentations that provide me with a good grip.

These brushes are not high-end but they feel great and work great. The only reason I rated this 4 stars instead of 5 is because I feel the price is too high. The current price of $52.99 comes to an expensive $17.66 per brush. If this set was $24 to $30 it would have received 5 stars from me.

title: Stunning make-up brush & pencil case; I use it for manicure & other tools
text:
This make-up brush and pencil case is absolutely stunning. I love the colors and the quality is superior as I expect from Vera Bradley. The snap closure is sewn in the case so no hardware shows. The zippers on the see-through pocket and interior central compartment glide open and glide close easily. The interior of the central compartment is thick and feels padded. I use this in my purse for manicure tools, a needle and thread travel kit, etc. I am so glad I ordered this.

Although this case is wonderful, I personally would not put make-up brushes in this without some cover as the cloth interior will get stained and dirty. Putting a liner in this would cheapen this; however, because there is no liner, the interior is not protected, so use brush covers.

The current price of $25 is typical of Vera Bradley prices and it's high quality even though it is made from recycled cotton.

title: Perfect set for detangling, blow drying, and normal brushing--a decent very basic set
text: There are three hair brushes in this set. One large paddle brush, one smaller brush, and one rotary brush. These brushes comb through my hair easily. The rotary brush is great for blow drying. The brushes are all easy to hold.  The set is not high-end but it is a basic decent hair brush set. At the current price of $7.35 ($7.99 minus 8%), this comes to a reasonable $ 2.45 per brush. For that price this set is excellent and the good price combined with the basic functionality of these brushes has me rating this 5 stars. If they were more expensive, this set would have received 4 stars.

title: Silky soft lotion perfect for summer
text:
This lotion is wonderful. I wouldn't call it illuminating but it smells lovely and it is very moisturizing. Since it is a light moisturizer it is perfect for the summer. It left my body feeling very silky.

The current price of $14.99 is reasonable for this.

title: Brushes & combs are excellent; plastic rake is useless but everything stinks of burnt rubber
text:
At the current price of $18.04 ($19.99 minus 5%), this is competitively priced for a total of five items. Included in this set are one large boar / nylon bristle brush with wooden handle, one small boar /nylon one small wooden comb, one plastic brush cleaner rake, long wooden rat tail comb, and one wooden wide-tooth comb.

Both brushes glide through my fine curly short to medium-length hair with ease. They are easy to hold; even the small one. The wooden combs work well too but I am not a user of combs.

The only item that is absolutely useless is the plastic rake. I was unable to get any hair out of the brush using this. Nevertheless, the other items are great, particularly the brushes.

The biggest problem I have with this set is that it stinks of burnt rubber. It is for that reason only I rated this 3 stars.

title: Beautiful wood comb with flawless finish; comes with lovely cinch bag
text:
This is a beautiful semi-wide-tooth comb with a flawless finish. It also comes with a super soft cinch-strap carry pouch. The comb also glides through my short to medium length fine curly hair easily.

The polish almost makes this look like a hard plastic instead of wood. Nevertheless, I will take their word for it that it is wood. It certainly sounds like wood when I bang it against a table.

The current price of $11.99 is reasonable for this. This is a lovely comb and the presentation is just as great.

title: Nice brush set; almost all the brushes I need
text:
There are 9 make-up brushes in this set along with 5 brush nets (not sure why that would be included), a super soft cloth, and a brush cleaner.

This is an attractive brush set. The bristles are soft but they are synthetic and shiny. There is no super offensive smell like I have experienced with some other brush sets I've tried previously. Also, there is no shedding which is wonderful.

Their bristles feel good against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried before. Unfortunately, there is no lip, eyebrow, and fan brushes. Those type brushes are not usually included in most brush sets.

In addition to these brushes, one super soft cloth and a silicone brush cleaner are included. I've noticed that on the Amazon site, the cloth and cleaner are different colors. This means one will never know the color they get. I'm glad the cleaner is purple because it matches my purple bathroom and is my favorite color. However, another recipient might not be happy with that.

Also included are brush nets. As to why this would be included is beyond me. Perhaps it is because this should be used to cover the bristles of larger brushes to keep them from getting disheveled. I usually throw these nets out.

In summary, this set is a really nice synthetic brush set. The addition of the cloth and cleaner elevates this to the next level. I personally only use these silicone cleaners on my sponges as I almost never wash my brushes. Nevertheless, such a cleaner works well by rubbing the brush end on the ribbed section to scrub the bristles clean with soap and water.

The current price of $19.28 comes to $2.14 per brush which is competitively priced. I consider this set perfect for the young make-up artist just starting out or for the adult who does not want to make a large investment in make-up brushes.

PS I attached a copy of the image on the Amazon site that lists the brushes.

title: Lathers and cleans well; aroma is balanced
text:
At the current price of $14.99 ($19.99 minus $5) this set of three 4-ounce bars of soap is competitively priced at $5 per bar.

This is a nice size and easy to hold in my hands. It has a nice balance of peppermint and tea tree fragrance with a peppermint fresh scent and a medicinal finish (from the tea tree oil). It cleans and lathers exceptionally well. It is also not too drying.

title: Manicure bench is narrow, tall, slippery, & it smells
text:
At the current price of $15.99, this manicure bench is more reasonably priced than a competitor with the same bench. The quality of the workmanship is pretty good but the legs elevate this bench about 5.25 "off the ground. Since the bench is narrow on top, the person leaning their hands may have a tendency to tip this over. In addition, there are no rubber feet on the "legs." As a result, it is necessary to put a towel under this bench to keep it from slipping when placed on a solid non-stick surface.

Other than this, this bench is very nice. If it were lower to the ground, about two inches wider, and had rubberized feet on the bottom, this would have received 5 stars. In its current state it is functional but not the best it could be. The fact that it smells is also bothersome to me. I suppose it could double as a child's pretend ironing board.

title: Cheaply made nail clipper set; nail file plastic doesn’t come off
text:
There are two nail clipper tools in this set, a nail file (see dislikes), and what looks like a cuticle pusher or toenail lifter is included. I'm not really familiar with that last tool.

LIKES
- Handle of all the toenail clipper feels great in my hands
- The cutting blade on the clippers are good
- The other implements are nice to have

DISKLIKE
- One of the spring clips on the toenail clippers is uneven and looks like it will fall off. It actually will operate fine without it.

- I cannot get the blue plastic off the nail file. I tried scraping it off with a sharp object and even soaked the file. It just won't budge. This means this tool is unusable.

- The fingernail clipper feels super cheap. It is really the casing around the clipper that is awful.

The current price of $17.98 ($19.98 minus 10%) is way too pricey for this, especially since one tool is useless and the small clipper feels cheap.

title: Excellent blow dryer for the price; controls take some getting use to
text:
For the current price of $28.96 ($38.96 minus $10), this is an excellent deal. In the box is the blow dryer unit, a user sheet, a concentrator, a concentrator comb, and a diffuser.

Before first use, the red button on the plug has to be pushed in or it won't turn on. There are three controls on the front. The cool shot button is more like a cool shot toggle. This was the button I was having trouble with. It does not operate as the manual describes. Instead when I pushed it in, it stayed in. I had to hit it again to disengage it. Perhaps this is a quirk only on the unit I received. Mine got cool when the button was out.

There is also a high, low, and off for the speed, which is the second button. The last button on the bottom is the high, medium, and low for the heat. None of the buttons are marked but they are easy to remember.

Installing and removing the attachments are a cinch. I absolutely love that about this dryer.

The cord does turn but I would not call it a swivel cord but it acts similarly.

In summary, this is a nice blow dryer for the price. The controls are a bit quirky but once one gets used to them, this operates fine. However, if this were priced higher than $30, I would have rated this 3 stars since the functions do not operate as described.

title: Cleans and lathers exceptionally well; softens my hair but relaxes my curls
text:
I was not too happy that this shampoo has a greenish clear tinge to it; however, after using this I like it. It cleans and lathers exceptionally well. My hair came out incredibly soft and hydrated but it did relax my curls, which I do not like. I have short to medium fine curly hair and after using this, my hair is more on the flat side.

The fragrance is okay but not my favorite. Unfortunately, I cannot describe the aroma.

The current price of $12.90 for 350 ml (11.835 fluid ounces) is competitively priced for this.

title: Nice hand cream w/pleasant scent but nothing extraordinary – 3.5 stars
text: This is a lightweight cream with a mild but pleasant fragrance. It is mildly hydrating to my hands and more like a summer moisturizer. I like it but it is nothing extraordinary that would have me coming back to order more.  The current price of $8.40 for 50 ml (1.691 fluid ounces) is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Large & floppy vibrantly-colored scrunchies; stays in well; hair ties included- 3.5 stars
text:
There are six very large and floppy scrunchies in this package along with some hair ties. I love the colors. What I do not like is that there is a lot of material on these scrunchies, so it flops around. It is not noticeable when in the hair but these are best for someone with a lot of thick hair than someone who has fine hair like me.

The tiny ponytail holders are okay but nothing special. I actually feel they cheapen the set. However, they can be used underneath the scrunchies.

At the current price of $13.99 this comes to $2.33 per scrunchie if not counting those included hair ties.

title: I love these colorful blenders; they work well
text:
This is a nice set of 18 colored blending sponges with two holders. I love the sponges as they are of medium density. Their colors are vibrant. The plastic holders are cute and allow for the display of one sponge in each one.

There are eight sponges with a flat / angled side which is great for smooth applications. There are eight other sponges that are typical egg-shaped and eight that are hourglass shaped sponges; both types are also good for blending or any large make-up application.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $11.24 ($14.99 minus 25%), this comes to almost $.63 cents per blender if I consider the plastic holders as freebies. At this price, these are incredibly reasonable.

title: I love these colorful blenders but one blender holder was missing – 3.5 stars
text:
I have both a pink and purple bathroom and this was supposed to come with one each of pink and purple blender holders but the purple one was missing, which is disappointing. Other than that, this is a nice set of 18 colored blending sponges with one holder (it is supposed to be two holders).

I love the sponges as they are of medium density. Their colors are both vibrant and muted. The pink plastic holder I received is cute and allows for the display of one sponge.

There are eight sponges with a flat / angled side which is great for smooth applications. There are eight other sponges that are typical egg-shaped and eight that are hourglass shaped sponges; both types are also good for blending or any large make-up application.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $14.99, this comes to a reasonable $.83 cents per blender if I consider the plastic holder (or holders for those who get two) as a freebie.

title: Spacious toiletry bag but not high quality
text:
This men's toiletry bag is spacious and attractive. However, this is not high quality. I personally do not feel the zippers will last. Also, there is white glue outside the gusset on my bag (see photo).

There are three compartments. The central compartment has three folder pockets on one side and three elastics on the other and then a cavernous inside. There is also one zippered compartment on both sides of the central compartment with elastics, folder compartments or zippered compartments as shown in my photos.

The zippers mostly glide easily but feel cheap. One zipper sticks a bit. The bag is large enough to hold a full size can of shave cream, full size deodorant, full size tube of toothpaste, toothbrush, and other incidentals with a little room to spare. There is a sturdy carry handle on top.

In summary, this is just an okay PU leather (fake leather) toiletry bag. The current price of $17.09 ($17.99 minus 5%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Workable blow dryer brush for medium to long hair; lightweight; long bristles can tangle in hair
text:
This is a medium, lightweight blow-drying brush. The bristles are long, so it is easy to get one's hair tangled in this. Also, the handle is smooth, so the grip is not as good as other brushes I tried.

The barrel of the brush is perfect for medium-length to long hair. I have medium length in the back of my head and this works well if I am careful. My hands do not get tired working with this due to how lightweight this is.

The bristles are hard as is typical of all brushes. Although the length of the bristles is not my favorite and the handle is too smooth, this is workable. At the current price of $12.99 ($14.99 minus $2), this is competitively priced.

title: Good blow dryer brush for short hair; lightweight
text:
This is a small, lightweight blow-drying brush. It is easy to hold and the handle does not slip out of my hands.

The barrel of the brush is perfect for my short to medium length hair and works well. My hands do not get tired working with this due to how lightweight this is.

The bristles are hard as is typical of all brushes. At the current price of $11.50, this is competitively priced.

title: It is easy to tangle one’s hair in this brush; otherwise this is a good brush
text:
This large blow-drying brush has very long bristles. As a result it is easy to get my hair tangled in this. I have to be careful with this and I do not have long hair. Nevertheless, this works.

I love the ergonomically designed cork handle as it feels great in my hands and does not slip. The barrel of the brush is medium for medium to long hair.

The bristles are hard as is typical of all brushes. At the current price of $24, this is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Super soft blender sponges; love the angles; not crazy about the case insert
text:
This is a nice set of eight mauve-colored blending sponges with one plastic case that allows the sponges to be displayed like a carton of eggs. Unfortunately, the case is not great because the case insert comes in two pieces and does not stay flat. However, the sponges are great even though they are not as dense as others I tried which means they soak up a little bit more liquid make-up.

There are six sponges with a flat / angled side which is great for smooth applications. The two other sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges that are good for blending or any large make-up application.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $7.99 this comes to a very reasonable $1 per sponge if I consider the plastic container as a freebie.

title: I love the dark blue dense blenders in this "egg-carton" sponge set & their flat angle
text:
This is a nice set of four blue-colored blending sponges with one plastic case that allows the sponges to be displayed like a carton of eggs.

I love the sponges as they are dense. The plastic holder allows the sponges to remain separated from make-up color contamination.

All the blenders have a flat / angled side which is great for smooth applications. They feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $4.99 these are a reasonable $1.25 per sponge if I consider the plastic container as a freebie.

title: I love the blenders in this "egg-carton" sponge set; the colors are wonderful
text:
This is a pretty set of eight colored blending sponges with one plastic case that allows the sponges to be displayed like a carton of eggs.

I love the sponges as they are dense. Their colors are vibrant. The plastic holder allows the sponges to remain separated from make-up color contamination.

There are two sponges with a flat / angled side which is great for smooth applications. There are three other sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges and three that are hourglass shaped, both are good for blending or any large make-up application.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are also perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $10.99 is a reasonable $1.37 per sponge if I consider the plastic container as a freebie.

title: Marvelous body butter; thick and moisturizing; lovely scent
text: This body butter is incredible. It is thick and moisturizing and absorbs quickly. The scent is lovely too. After using this my skin felt incredibly silky and hydrated. Also, the current price of $14.95 is reasonable for this. The only thing I don't like is that the jar is oversized for the amount within. When I opened the jar it looked like one third of the product was gone. Note that there is only 6.8 ounces of product in this large container.

title: Marvelous body butter; thick and moisturizing; lovely scent
text: This body butter is incredible. It is thick and moisturizing and absorbs quickly. The scent is lovely too. After using this my skin felt incredibly silky and hydrated. Also, the current price of $14.95 is reasonable for this. The only thing I don't like is that the jar is oversized for the amount within. When I opened the jar it looked like one third of the product was gone. Note that there is only 6.8 ounces of product in this large container.

title: Very functional brushes(14) but brush heads have slight smell; brushes stand up
text:
There are 14 make-up brushes in this set. This is an attractive brush set. The bristles are soft. There was no shedding. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I like that they stand up (see photo); however, they are easy to knock over so that negates the purpose of that ability. I actually had them produce a domino effect by accidentally tipping over the brushes on several occasions, which I found frustrating.

This set has all the brushes I needed except for a fan brush and lip liner brush. The brush heads do have a slight smell to them; they smell like solvent, which I do not care for. The current price of $9.69 ($11.69 minus $2) is a good buy as this comes to $.69 cents per brush.

title: Functional brushes (10); blender sponges (6) complete the set
text:
There are 10 make-up brushes in this set along with 6 blender sponges and one CHEAP but movable PLASTIC holder. Also included are two stickies - one to affix to the bottom of the holder and the other is extra. Since the sticky is double-sided, this holder can be affixed to a counter, if desired.

This is an attractive brush set but it is not high quality. The bristles are marginally soft and definitely feel synthetic and are shiny. They also smell like paint solvent. However, there is no shedding.

Their bristles feel good against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I love that they include eyebrow and fan brushes as they are not usually included in brush sets.

In addition to these brushes, six blender sponges are included and I consider these the star of the set. There are three sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other three sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges that are good for blending or any large make-up application. These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin and they do not smell funny like others I have used previously. The holder is nice but it's plastic.

The current price of $13.99 ($21.99 minus $8) for 17 pieces (10 brushes, 6 blenders, 1 holder) is very reasonable for this as it comes to $ .82 cents per item. I consider this set perfect for the young make-up artist just starting out. However, do realize that the brush heads are not of the best quality due to the synthetic feel and the paint solvent smell.

title: Strips my hair; is not conditioning; lathers exceptionally well; earthy aroma - 2.5 stars
text:
Shampoo bars seem to be all the rage lately. This is the third or fourth shampoo bar I tried. This lathers exceptionally well which is typical of shampoo bars. However, it strips my hair of everything and it does not condition at all. The aroma is earthy but not the type of fragrance I want in my hair.

The current price of $9.95 ($14.95 minus $5) for this bar is expensive but a lot cheaper than the typical $15 of most bars. I personally prefer liquid shampoo and conditioner; it's a better deal and better results. Now if one could shower with this as well as shampoo their hair, this might have a purpose when traveling. Since I am not crazy about shampoo bars, I repurpose this for the shower or for washing my hands.

title: Very odd-looking clips; they hold well but do not look as good as I’d like
text:
There are three claw clips in the package. They are very odd-looking bow clips and are medium-sized and well-made. Each clip has two bows in the design. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly but they would work better with longer hair. I just do not like how they look.

At the current price of $6.99 it comes to a pricey $2.33 per clip. The quality of these clips is good but the look is another story.

title: Three sturdy, well-made medium-sized (not large) clips that hold a decent amount of hair
text:
There are three claw clips in the package. They are gorgeous, medium-sized, and well-made. I would not call them large but I love how stunning they look. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly but they would work better with longer hair.

At the current price of $4.99 it comes to reasonably priced $1.66 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well; however, they are not large.

title: Very functional basic travel brush set; handles are short since this is portable
text:
There are 5 soft non-shedding make-up brushes in this set. This is a decent set that contains a brush for foundation, cheeks, and eyeshadow. There is no fan, eyebrow, or lip brushes, however.

The bristles are nylon soft and they do not fall out, which is great. The brushes feel good against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously.  I do wish the handles were a tad longer but that is the trade-off needed for a portable travel set. This comes in a folding PU leather pouch that has a small zippered pocket for credit card or cash or both.

Nevertheless, the current price of $30 is way too expensive for this as it is a VERY BASIC low-end set. The [[ASIN:B0919R1CYT Fragrantshare Makeup Brushes]] are a lot cheaper for more brushes and a lot prettier too. They do not come in a carry pouch but one can be purchased separately that is a lot better. If this set were priced at no more than $14, I would have rated this 4 stars.

This is a perfect set for the young teenager starting out on her make-up journey but I do not recommend it for the current $30 price advertised.

title: Brush set that does the job; a selection for every hair length; handles are great; got 1 wrong brush
text:
There are four radial brushes in this brush set that are STUFFED into the box. They are extra small (1"), small (1-1/4"), and two (2) large (2-1/8"). I have no idea why they included two large ones as it would have been nice to have a medium instead. In fact, the box says I was supposed to get one that was 1-5/8" in size but that was not included.

The radial brushes are good for blow drying my hair. Since there are several circumferences, there is a brush for almost every hair length. The bristles are so, so on these brushes and made of hard nylon. They work and go through my hair easily but I have to be careful not to scratch my scalp.

This brush set is functional and works as designed. I really love the handles and the gray/black color. I do wish they included one medium brush instead of two large ones as the box indicated. At the current price of $44.99, these are a bit pricey as they come to $11.25 each.

title: Handle too short and rope in the middle of the puff is annoying - 2.5 stars
text:
This brush is two-sided. The only thing I like is that the bristles on the brush are relatively soft on the back. However, I would have preferred a larger head so that there are more bristles and larger puff.

The other thing that annoys me is that the handle is too short and I have to stretch to reach my entire back. In addition, the rope loop in the middle of the puff is ridiculous and annoying during washing. Why they thought this was a good thing to attach to the puff is beyond me. There is already a hole in the handle for hanging.

In summary, this is functional but is the least favorite back washer I tried so far. The current price of $8.99 is a bit high for this as I can buy something like this at my local Walmart for half that.

title: Lovely statement hair clips for the 4th of July; holds a wisp of hair
text:
These clips are super attractive and very festive for Independence Day (i.e. July 4th). They act more like a statement piece to highlight the hair. The clips hold on tight to just a wisp of hair. I love them. Note that the bows are beautiful but they are not perfectly formed. The slight crookedness is not really noticeable once it is in the hair. This and the price are the only reasons I took off one star.

The current price of $ 9.99 comes to a very pricey $5 per clip.

title: Smells like rice rinse water to me; very earthy; no coconut; too astringent on my hair
text:
I never heard of shampoo bars until recently. This lathers exceptionally well as have the several others I tried previously. However, it strips my hair of everything and it is not hydrating at all. I am also not crazy about the scent--the aroma is not pretty but not offensive either. It actually smells like the water left behind after I wash my rice in it; it's an earthy scent and not at all like coconut to my senses.

The current price of $13.99 for this bar is also very expensive. I personally prefer liquid shampoo and conditioner; it's a better deal with better results and also leaves my hair more vibrant. However, this has a purpose when travelling as it could be used to wash one's hair and shower at the same time. I know I will be showering with this shampoo bar to get rid of it.

title: Love the yellow/orange colors of this sponge set; I do not care for the plastic holder
text:
This is a lovely set of five Easter yellow and orange-colored blending sponges with one CHEAP PLASTIC holder. I love these sponges. However, the plastic holder cheapens the set.

There are two sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this with the exception that they are less dense than others and have a slight tendency to soak up more liquid make-up. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $8.90 it is a slightly pricey $1.78 per sponge if I consider the holder a freebie.

title: No-frills straightener; one temp of 380 degrees but it does not perform as if it is that hot
text:
The current price of $59.99 is outrageous for this flat iron. However, as of this writing if one applies the 76% off coupon, then this brings it down to a reasonable cost of $14.40.

The iron itself is a nice color of pink and white. Besides the color, another nice feature is that the cord has a 360 swivel to prevent tangling. Two hair clips are included in the package but they are completely useless as they do not stay put in my hair.

I used it to straighten my hair and it did an okay job but I do not feel the iron was hot enough. It also may be due to the alignment of the plates. As can be seen in my photo, the plates come together at the tip of the iron but are a bit separated halfway through.

The ON/OFF control is in the center of the iron. In fact, this is the only control. Within 90 seconds, it supposedly heats to 380 degrees. This is also the only internal temperature setting of the iron. In my opinion, it never got that hot. I actually feel it is in the 180 degree range but have no way to test that. I have short to medium fine curly hair and such a temperature would singe my fine hair and this did not. I was also able to quickly and lightly touch the plates several times without getting burnt.

In summary, this is a pretty one inch flat iron. The two pink hair clips are completely useless because they do not grab the hair. The iron itself works with fine hair but is super basic with just an ON/OFF button. I do not believe it heats up to 380 degrees based on my results and those who need higher temperatures would not have satisfactory results.

title: Typical eyelash curler; 8 additional replacements provided; wish it didn’t stay open
text:
This is a simple eyelash curler. What I do not like is that the curler stays open at rest. There is a spring action that requires me to stretch out my thumb and forefinger as far as possible in order to grab the handles to squeeze them closed.

It is still easy to use and curls well and gently. There are also eight extra silicone replacement refill pads provided. In order to close this curler for storage, I have to "install" the clear clip it came with as shown in my photo.

The current price of $8.96 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: My eyelids and under the eye feels totally hydrated after using this; do not care for narrow jar
text:
This cream did not get rid of my dark circles but it did hydrate around my eyes. I love how moisturized my eyelids and under eye area feels after applying this cream. What I do not like is the narrow neck on the jar. It is hard to get my fingers in there. I have no idea what the gold colored rod is for. Perhaps it is to be used to get out the contents but it does not have a scooping edge. Nevertheless, this cream is very nice.

The current price of $20.99 is competitively priced for this.

title: Scentless and gentle on skin; moderate lather; small 4 ounce bar
text:
This is a small 4 ounce bar of soap. What I did not like is that once I opened the package, there was one hair embedded into the soap (see photo).

This soap is very gentle on my skin and has a moderate lather. It is also scentless. I personally love scents but for those with sensitive skin, scentless is the way to go.

For me this is just okay. The bar is too small and I suspect this will be priced very high (meaning over $6).

title: Soft bristles; perfect for cheek and foundation powders
text:
There are two make-up brushes on one wand. The smaller brush is best for highlighting the cheeks and the larger one is best for both the cheeks and foundation or translucent powders.

The bristles on both brushes are super soft and they feel good against my skin. I also like that the bristles do not fall out as happens on some other brushes.

The current price of $12.59 is slightly pricey but still decent for this. The only issue is that this is not as easy to hold as other brushes with longer handles. I have to be careful not to get the make-up from the other end on my hands as I use the opposing end.

title: Main brush is excellent; plastic rake useless & comb just okay
text:
At the current price of $9.99 ($13.99 minus $4 coupon), this is an excellent deal as there are a total of six items. Included in this set are one large boar/nylon bristle brush with wooden handle, one small wooden comb, a brush head cover for the hairbrush, one plastic brush cleaner rake, long plastic rat tail comb, and one spa headband for keeping one's hair back during make-up application.

The brush glides through my fine curly short to medium-length hair with ease. It is also easy to hold. The small wooden comb works well but the tines are sharp. The plastic rat tail comb is just okay. The carry satchel covers the large brush's head for traveling or storage. The spa headband also works well. The only item that is absolutely useless is the plastic rake. I was unable to get any hair out of the brush using this. Nevertheless, the other items make this a worthwhile purchase.

title: Love the fragrance but this is not volumizing at all; it relaxed my curls - 2.5 stars
text: I absolutely love the fragrance of this shampoo. It is very creamy and creates a great lather; however, it  is not volumizing at all. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this relaxed my curls. It feels and acts like a conditioning shampoo more than a volumizing shampoo.

title: Love the Jasmine-like fragrance; eye cream absorbs rapidly and left my lids silky & hydrated
text:
This eye cream comes in a 0.5 ounce tube. It is a creamy-white consistency and smells wonderful. To me it smells like Jasmine. I rubbed in a small amount around each eyelid and under the eye and it absorbed rapidly and left my lids silky and hydrated.

The current price of $11.89 ($13.99 minus 15%) is very reasonable for this. My first attraction to this cream is the wonderful scent and then next the hydration. There are other creams that hydrate as well but I will choose the one with the pleasing scent over a similar moisturizing cream that has no scent.

title: Perfect for my purse; like “lip balm” for the body
text:
This glides on easily and is perfect for when I want to moisturize my hands and elbows on the go. It glides on and is a little shiney like Vaseline but also moisturizing like lip balm. It does add a barrier to my skin. It comes in a tube that looks like an oversized lip balm so it is easy to mistake the two. I also love the lavender bud aroma.

The current price of $15.99 for two 0.5 ounce tubes comes to $8 each which I consider competitively priced. I definitely like its moisturizing ability as well as its portability. Note that I would never use this for more than small areas on my body like hands, heels, and elbows. For a full body moisturizer, I would just buy lotion.

title: Extremely sturdy wands; passes through my mascara tubes easily; great for eyebrows too
text:
For the current price of $8.54 ($8.99 minus 5%), which comes to $.3 cents per wand, I thought this was going to be close to garbage. However, I am pleasantly surprised.

The wands are very stiff and sturdy. They pass through my mascara tubes easily and work well during application. I particularly love these for my eyebrows as I have bushy eyebrows.

I counted one of the packages of wands and there are 50 per package with a total of 300 wands over 6 packages. I also love the different colors even though those colors get covered up by the make-up.

title: The finish on this brush is flawless; the brush head passes through my hair easily
text:
At the current price of $36.99 this brush is pricey. However, after reading and listening to the TAN MUJIANG story on the Internet, I can see why it is so expensive. The craftsmanship is outstanding, so I will let the consumer be the judge as to whether this price is too much for a handcrafted brush.

The workmanship on the brush I received is exquisite and flawless, including the partial pink color. The color is painted on as if it is part of the brush. The brush head itself passes through my short to medium fine curly hair easily and it is also easy to clean. It is not too large and not too small and feels great in my hands, meaning it is very easy to hold and maintain a grip on.

In addition, it comes with a lined cinch strap pouch to cover the brush head (see photos).

The insert that comes with this covers this brush and some other stuff. For this brush, it does say that this is subject to deformation, cracks, and fractures. Therefore (paraphrased from the sheet), it is important to keep this away from blazing sunlight, dampness (PS I wouldn't use this as a detangler in the shower), acid-based corrosion, or slamming this against hard objects.

In summary, I consider this brush a work of art simply because of the exquisite finish on the wood. I am impressed in every way. It even comes in a sturdy box that is giftable.

title: Excellent blow-dryer brush for long hair; handle has great grip; clips are okay
text: This set comes with one large blow-drying brush and four black hair clips with two extra clip elastics. The clips are okay. They do hold the hair a bit but the elastics inside will break easily. However, the brush itself is great. I love the ergonomically designed handle as it feels great in my hands and does not slip. The barrel of the brush is wide for long hair but the bristles are close to the barrel to reduce tangling. At the current price of $9.59 ($11.99 minus 20%), I feel this is competitively priced. I love the brush, particularly how easy it is to hold with the non-slip grip, but I could pass on the clips.

title: Mesh is thin but still makes good suds; opposite side is a little exfoliating
text:
To me there is nothing like a full mesh body puff. It is the only thing I use in the shower outside of a back brush. Nevertheless, these mitts have the best of two worlds. The mesh is thin and sewn onto the glove. The glove has two finger holes for the thumb depending on which side is being used. If I want a sudsy wash, I pull this on like a glove and use the mesh side. If I want to lightly exfoliate, I turn it over and use the rough side. It also has a loop for hanging.

It does not replace my favorite shower sponge but this comes close. Also, these can be used to wash the dishes if one does not want to use them for the shower.

The current price of $6.98 comes to a more reasonable $3.49 per mitt. When I say more reasonable, I mean since I last reviewed their mitts which were selling for $13.98 [[ASIN:B08QG3FBVK per pair]] instead of half that as they are now in this listing.

title: Good basic nail clipper set but 360 degree rotation takes getting use to
text:
This is a functional and decent basic nail clipper set. However, the 360 degree rotation takes getting used to. I used it the regular way and it worked wonderfully to cut my toenails. I did try it once with the rotation and was also able to get it to work but the angle felt odd to me. Nevertheless, it is nice to have that option.

The nail file is small and portable and works like all other metal nail files.

The current price of $3.99 for this set is very reasonable.

title: Gorgeous clips with sensational hold
text:
There are four butterfly-like claw clips in this package and they are absolutely stunning with their marbleized look. They are large and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and have an astonishing hold. They would work even better with longer hair.

At the current price of $13.29 ($13.99 minus 5%) it comes to a reasonably priced $3.32 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well. I do hope they last.

title: Like tiny glass thimbles with a loose metal lid whose rim is sharp
text:
These dappen dishes are tiny; like tiny glass thimbles. There are four to this set with four lids. The lids just sit loosely on top and the underside rim of the lids is sharp in my opinion.

These can be used for acrylic powder, mixing tiny paints, etc. It can even be used to put out a dose of morning, afternoon, or evening pills for someone. I love the glass vessels but the top is only okay.

The current price of $8.99 is reasonable for four as it comes to $2.25 per pair.

title: I love the blenders in this sponge set; the colors are vibrant; the sponges are dense
text:
This is a wonderful set of 20 colored blending sponges. I love that the sponges are dense because they soak up less foundation. The colors are vibrant.

There are eight sponges with a flat side which are great for smooth applications. There are eight other sponges that are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application. There are four hour-glass sponges which are easy to grasp and work just like the egg-shaped ones.

The sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not. I also love that they are individually wrapped because they can be given away as gifts or used as stocking stuffers or treasures for the Easter basket.

The current price of $9.99 is a steal for these as it comes to $.50 per sponge. I highly recommend these.

title: I love the blenders in this sponge set; the colors are vibrant; the sponges are dense
text:
This is a wonderful set of 10 colored blending sponges. I love that the sponges are dense because they soak up less foundation. The colors are vibrant and perfect for an Easter basket.

There are four sponges with a flat side which are great for smooth applications. There are four other sponges that are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application. There are two hour-glass sponges which are easy to grasp and work just like the egg-shaped ones.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The current price of $6.99 is a steal for these as it comes to $.70  per sponge. I highly recommend these.

title: Excellent large buffpuffs that create copious suds; I love them
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only thing I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are just like the large ones I buy at Walmart for $2 each. There are three puffs and they work like any other large mesh loofah I regularly use.

The box says these contain 2-5% activated bamboo charcoal, but I did not notice any difference in the functionality of these puffs based on that. These just seem like ordinary buff puffs.

The current price of $9.99 is an expensive $3.33 each puff. The price is the only reason I took off one star.

title: Basic teasing combs; hard plastic tines are abit sharp
text:
There are five colorful combs in this set. The rat tail on the black one is shorter than the rest of the combs. Also, these are made of hard plastic so the tines are a bit sharp and will most likely break with a lot of use. These are just basic teasing combs that get the job done but they are not high quality. The current price of $5.99 comes to $1.20 each comb.

If these combs were made of a better plastic and were not so sharp, this would have received 5 stars from me.

title: 20 tiny polyester feeling scrunchies; not fo rme – 2.5 stars
text:
There are 20 variable design scrunchies in this package. The material feels like polyester, so it is a bit slick which increases the chance these will slip out of the hair. Also, they are tight, so they will not be useful for a person who has long thick hair as the elastic will probably break.

I have medium length hair in the back and these held for the most part. However, I do not like the feel of these at all and the designs / colors are unexciting.

These come to $.50 cents per scrunchie at the current price of $9.99 so that is competitively priced for the quality received.

title: Pretty cap; well-padded; does not stretch; will work for a child
text:
I love the color of this cap. The exterior is waterproof and the interior feels like it is made of soft fleece. It is certainly a beautiful cap but I cannot use it. The sizing is more for a child because even though the band around the cap has a little stretch, the stitching holding that band in place DOES NOT stretch. I had a hard time getting this comfortably over my head.

If the bottom stretched so adults could use this comfortably, then this would have received 5 stars from me at the current price of $9.99.

title: Tiny, pretty manicure bench but it’s NOT foldable & assembly is required
text:
At the current price of $16.99, this manicure bench is reasonably priced. I ordered this bench thinking it was foldable and it is not. This has to be assembled. There are eight bolts supplied along with an Allen wrench. Only six bolts are needed. It was easy to assemble but because it is not foldable, it takes up more space than I anticipated.

The quality of the workmanship is good and the legs elevate this bench about 5.25" off the ground--about 5" of space is underneath the bench. Since it is narrow on top, the person leaning their hands on it may have a tendency to tip this over. In addition, there are no rubber feet on the "legs." I would have preferred a silicone roll on the bottom rung of the legs to keep this from moving. As a result, it is necessary to put a towel under this bench to keep it from slipping when placed on a solid non-stick surface.

Other than this, this bench is very nice. I was going to rate it 4 stars but I took off another star because it is not foldable as described. If it were lower to the ground, about three inches wider, was foldable, and had rubberized feet on the bottom, this would have received 5 stars. In its current state it is functional but not the best it could be. The red color is certainly very pretty. Note that this could double as a child's pretend ironing board.

title: Set contains more implements than I will ever use; good basic set
text:
For the current price of $12.99 one can't go wrong with this manicure set. Although it is not high end, the tools work. The nail cutters are sharp, the tweezers are precisely aligned, and the scissors cut. There are some items in this set that I have no idea what to do with them or will never use them (such as the ear picks, which seem to be all the rage these days).

There are some tools here I have never seen in any other manicure set prior to this. One looks like a blade of some sort. The big negative is that there is no list of tools on the Amazon site or a list supplied with the case. This is a big disappointment to me.

Other than this, this set is very functional and comes in a locking and very presentable carry case.

title: Smaller than small; more like mini-clips; I love them!
text:
I did not realize these clips were so tiny. All 10 clips fit in a 6 inch long box. However, these are wonderful. They have a matte finish and feel like they have a non-slip silicone coating. They are easy to grasp, easy to use, and hold very well. These are perfect for short, medium, or long hair when one wants to hold just a wisp of hair. I love these!

The current price of $9.99 comes to a slightly pricey $1 per mini clip.

title: Decent brush gift set; bath bombs not very fragrant; dry/back brush & loofah good
text:
[[VIDEOID:b2d64abb0ba074a723c9c046875b636c]] This is an attractive and giftable set of six smally bath bombs, one hand brush with a stick to turn it into a back brush, and one mesh loofah. 

The bath bombs are only lightly fragrant. I tried the orange in my foot bath. The fragrance of this one was too subtle to notice. I used hot to tepid water and suds were created in the foot bath and the bomb fizzed. It eventually (in about 8 minutes) dissolved in the water as I bathed my feet. My feet also came out feeling clean and refreshed. 

What I do love is that the color of the bomb did not turn my nails and feet orange. Also, my foot bath did not have a color ring around it like another high-end bath bomb I tried previously.

The hand brush I do not use but I do use a back brush every day. I am not a dry brusher and this back brush is just like all the other ones I tried before in the shower. The handle slips in easily to the hand brush and it is long enough to reach my back during a shower.  The brush head is of medium softness so it is mildly exfoliating. The handle has a rope loop for hanging.

The mesh loofah is my favorite as that creates copious suds. Due to the plastic the loofah comes in, it does have a smell to it but that will wash off in the shower.

In summary, this is a decent bath set for the current price of $11.19.

title: Soap slippery when wet & disintegrates easily; bars are small but they lather copiously - 2.5 stars
text:
This soap is packaged nicely but, for the size, it is over packaged. There are four bars of soap - rinse (aloe); shampoo (sulfur), body (noni), soap (eoseongcho).

These bars have a great lather. However, all the bars are soft and sticky and they disintegrate easily in the shower. In addition, they are slippery. Luckily this soap is very small as each bar fits in the palm of my hand. Of course at the current price of $40, this comes to $10 a bar which is about $6 too much in my opinion.

Although I like the lather and the fragrance of each bar, I am not pleased with the slipperiness of the bars, the size, and how they turn gunky easily.

title: Attractive brush set with nylon-type bristles
text:
There are 7 brushes in this set. Three are foundation / cheek brushes, two are for eyeshadow, one is for the lips, and one for the brow. The small headed brushes in this set are useful for blending eyeshadow powders or applying concealer.

The bristles are soft but they feel nylon-like which is not as good as brushes that feel like real hair. Also, the brush heads and case have a slight chemical smell. The magnetic closure case is super attractive, however.

This is a decent travel set for someone who is starting their make-up journey. The current price of $11.51 ($12.79 minus 10%) is competitively priced for this set as it comes to $1.64 per brush.

title: Thick pink cream; moisturizes well but does not absorb; more for winter
text:
This cream is not what I expected. First of all, it is pink. I do not like creams that have color to them. Thankfully, there is no color that comes off on a tissue, so it fades away after it is applied.

I applied this to my face and neck. It is incredibly hydrating but the cream never fully absorbs. It just lays on top of my skin no matter how much I rub it in. As a result, I consider this more of a winter cream where one wants protection or a barrier from the cold and wind.

I do love the fragrance of this, however.

The current price of $23.96 ($29.95 minus 20%) is competitively priced.

title: Works gently but effectively on the dry skin on my feet; comes with nail file as well
text:
This file is easy to hold and work with as a result of the finger indentations . It also filed my heels gently. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler. When I was done, I just rinsed the file under warm water and the dead skin that was removed (see photo) was easily rinsed off. The file looked brand new afterward. In addition, this comes with a nail file that gently files my fingernails. I also rinse that off when I'm done.

The current price of $7.19 is reasonably priced. However, this is a very pretty file making it sort of functional art.

title: Lovely statement hair clips for the 4th of July; holds a wisp of hair
text:
These clips are super attractive and very festive for Independence Day (i.e. July 4th). They act more like a statement piece to highlight the hair. The clips hold on tight to just a wisp of hair. I love them.

The current price of $8.99 comes to a slightly pricey $3 per clip.

title: Spa treatment in a giftable box; I love this set
text:
This is a lovely set. There are six 10.6 ounce sea salt packets in rose, peppermint, vanilla, lavender, chamomile, and rosemary. There is also a bottle of argan oil and a tiny scoop.

I tried the rose sea salt and what a wonderful aroma it has. I used this to soak my hands and added several drops of argan oil with three scoops of salt. My hands came out fully soaked but yet soft.

The current price of $16.14 ($18.99 minus 15%) is very reasonable for this assortment.

title: Leaves my skin soft but I’m not crazy about the dispensing method
text:
This product is definitely not for me. There are two calming booster serums in this set. At the current price of $30, that makes this an excellent deal at $15 each. However, I'm not crazy about this. First of all, I do not care for the smell. Second, I do not like that I have to use a dropper to dispense this. It gets messy to squeeze the top and have the serum drip all over my hands.

The end result is that my face felt hydrated after using this but I still will not use this again since there are so many other products that I like better both in smell and function and which are less messy.

title: Smells like nothing; goes on light
text: I shook the can before use and then sprayed it on. First of all, I detected zero scent. There was no fresh scent at all, just a haze of light powder left on my body. I personally do not care for this at all. What I do love is the locking cap on the can. All I have to do is turn the cap to lock it and turn it the opposite way to unlock. As for the product, it's not for me.

title: An elegant assortment of hair clips to fasten and highlight my hair with
text:
This is a nice collection of 8 hair clips. They are elegant looking and fasten almost anywhere on my hair. However, they do not hold hair like a big hair clip does. These are clips to accessorize the hair and highlight certain areas.

The current price of $12.24 ($12.88 minus 5%) for this set comes to $1.53 per clip.

title: 30 velvet & 30 satin scrunchies in a kaleidoscope of colors; the velvets are the best
text:
There are 60 colored scrunchies--30 velvet and 30 satin. The slick material of the satin does increase the chance these will slip out of the hair. However, the velvet ones are wonderful. I have medium length hair in the back and the velvet ones held on tight and the satin ones were looser and had a tendency to slip. Nevertheless, this is typical of all satin scrunchies, not just these.

These are super attractive and the current price of $7.99 for 60 scrunchies is an incredibly cheap $.13 cents per scrunchies.

title: I love the blenders in this"egg-carton" sponge set; but colors are more muted than pictured
text:
This is a nice set of eight colored blending sponges with one plastic case that allows the sponges to be displayed like a carton of eggs.

I love the sponges as they are dense. Their colors are subtle and not as vibrant as pictured on Amazon. The plastic holder allows the sponges to remain separated from make-up color contamination.

There are five sponges with a flat / angled side which is great for smooth applications. The three other sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application.

All the sponges feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

These are perfect as gifts for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $10.39 ($12.99 minus 20%) is a reasonable $1.30  per sponge if I consider the plastic container as a freebie. The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because the colors are not as vibrant as I expected. The photos on the Amazon site have this set being more pink. Instead what I got is mauve and washed out pale pink and pale orange.

title: 7 supremely soft non-shedding make-up brushes; brush heads smell
text:
There are 7  supremely soft non-shedding make-up brushes in this set. This is a gorgeous set that contains brushes for use on the cheeks and around the eyes. I also love the design on the brush which looks very Southwestern to me.

The bristles are velvety soft and they do not fall out, which is great. Their soft bristles feel fantastic against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I particularly LOVE the large blush/foundation brush. The only thing to note is that because the bristles are super soft, these brushes are more suited for powder applications than cream or liquid. The brush heads do smell, however, but I expect that to wear off over time.

The current price of $23.09 ($26.09 minus $3) is competitively priced as it comes to $3.30 per brush.

title: Attractive clips; all but one has a great hold; very stylish
text:
There are six metal claw clips in this package and they are stunning. They are large and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on. The only clip that does not hold well is the boxy one. The only other negative is that the gripping tines are sharp. I scratched my scalp when using this the first time.

At the current price of $13.99 it comes to a reasonably priced $2.33 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well.

title: Works gently but effectively on the dry skin on my feet
text:
This file is easy to hold and work with. It also filed my heels gently. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler. When I was done, I just rinsed the file under warm water and the dead skin that was removed (see photo) was easily rinsed off. The file looked brand new afterward.

The current price of $13.59 is pricey for this. However, this is a very pretty file making it sort of functional art. This [[ASIN:B092S2ZGDJ file]] and this [[ASIN:B08SPXL5FF file]] are the same type files but are  priced less as of this writing and are also artistic.

title: Label on front of each FUNCTIONAL file ruins the beauty of this set; NOT GIFTABLE TO ME
text:
There are two beautiful files in this set with black sleeves. The files work gently on the nails and can be rinsed off. My big disappointment is that they put the label on each file on the front (that is that gold circular thing). I had trouble removing it. However, the files look terrible now because the glue and flecks of gold are left behind. They should have put the label on the back of the file or on the back of the black sleeves.

The current price of $9.45 ($9.95 minus 5%) is competitively priced for these files but I do not recommend ordering these as a gift until they get rid of that label, which just ruins the beauty of the file. There is nothing more irritating to me than a decorative and gorgeous file with what looks like a price sticker on it even though these files are functional and gentle on my nails.

title: Works gently but effectively on the dry skin on my feet
text:
This file is easy to hold and work with. It also filed my heels gently. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler. When I was done, I just rinsed the file under warm water and the dead skin that was removed (see photo) was easily rinsed off. The file looked brand new afterward.

The current price of $10.07 ($12.59 minus 20%) is on the high side of competitively priced. However, this is a very pretty file making it sort of functional art.

title: Gorgeous scrunchies but difficult to set right & will flop a bit as well
text:
These scrunchies are gorgeous and just overall fun to wear. Obviously, it is not easy to use this and have it be perfectly set in one's hair. I know I had trouble getting the ears to be level. Also, if one does not have a lot of hair, the ears tend to flop over as can be seen in my photo. Nevertheless, these are lovely. They are typical scrunchies with a mouse bow on top which reminds me of Mickey Mouse.

The current price of $9.98 is on the high side of competitively priced as it comes to $4.99 per scrunchie.

title: Fabulous cutting power; some guards bent; missing universal voltage charger in pkg
text:
This razor set comes with instructions, oil, cleaning brush, 8 guide combs (A, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, & 6), a comb, a blade cover, and a USB cable. The universal voltage charger (meaning A/C wall adapter) that is mentioned in the manual as a part, was not in my box. I also have a feeling it is not part of the package even though it is listed as a part.

I did not have to charge this as it came already charged at 100%. I just put on the #1 comb and quickly buzzed my boyfriend’s hair. There was absolutely no resistance and the blade with comb just glided through his hair. In fact, I have tried many razors previously (5+) and none have performed with such ease. Buzzing my boyfriend's hair with this razor was a breeze (see before and after photos).

Cleaning the blade is not easy because hair gets stuck in between the chassis and the blade. I just had to keep blowing the hair out and working the cleaning comb in the space. I did not want to mess with unscrewing anything. I did not see instructions for cleaning in the manual.

MAJOR LOVES
- It's cordless.

- Razor cuts through hair with ZERO resistance (at least my boyfriend's hair).

- Battery operation is long. I spent 15 minutes on my boyfriend's hair and it went down to 97% from 100, so that is great.

- The guide combs snap on and off easily and do not feel like they are going to break when doing so.

MAJOR DISLIKES
- Two cutting combs arrived bent, so I couldn't use them. I wanted to use the #2 but did not because the comb was not even.

- The universal charger is not included in the package as specified; there is only a USB cable and I had to supply my own A/C wall adapter.

In summary, we love this razor and it gives a fabulous cut. There are some quality control issues - the missing charger, the bent combs, and the box label showing a silver razor with the label reading "gold" (see photo). The current price of $32.29 ($35.88 minus 10%) is reasonable for this unit; I just wish everything arrived as specified. If two combs were not bent and the universal adapter were included as specified, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Low-end brush set that does the job; it is a selection for every hair length
text:
There are five brushes in this brush set that are STUFFED into a plastic zippered bag. Four of the brushes are radial brushes and one is a paddle / detangle type brush.

The paddle brush is just okay. The bristles are short but the brush is functional.

The radial brushes are good for blow drying my hair. Since there are several circumferences, there is a brush for almost every hair length. These are lightweight and the ribbed grip on the handle is excellent. I do not like that there is this metal blank name tag on the handle that breaks up the grip. I do not understand the purpose of that. The bristles are so, so on these brushes and made of hard nylon. They work and go through my hair easily but they will not keep their shape long.

This is a basic low-end functional set. At the current price of $25.99, it comes to $5.20 per brush.

title: Large lightweight paddle brush with ergonomic handle; love the neutral black/white colors
text:
This is a large lightweight nylon brush that glides easily through my hair whether tangled, combed, or wet. The handle is ergonomically designed and has a non-slip feel which provides for a non-slip grip. The neutral black and white color scheme goes with any decor and is definitely attractive to me. This is a great brush.

The current price of $6.99 ($9.99 minus 30%) is competitively priced  for this.

title: Attractive & super large claw clips that holds a lot of hair; plastic barrettes are just okay
text:
There are four glossy claw clips in this package along with seven bobby-pin style plastic barrettes in various colors.

The claw hair clips are large and very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like the vibrant look to these clips. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

The seven bobby-pin style barrettes are just okay. They feel and look super cheap and are not as pretty as the claw clips. They do hold a tiny bit of hair but not much. They also do not stay as well as the claw clips.

The current price of $9.99 is on the pricey side for this compared to other vendors [[ASIN:B091NTGBL3 like this one]] that sells it cheaper per clip. At this price, the four claw clips come to $2.50 each if I do not count the cheap plastic barrettes. If I count them, then it comes to $.91 cents per item.

title: Beautiful brush with a combo boar bristle & nylon brush head; staticky & way too $$$
text:
The brush handle on this brush is beautiful and feels like it is handmade. The wooden handle is easy to grasp and hold during styling.

This is a typical radial brush usually used for blow drying with a wave/curl. The title on Amazon sort of implies this is all natural bristle and it is not. The brush head itself is a combination of boar and nylon bristles. Unfortunately, using this brush causes my hair to be very staticky. It does work well otherwise and is perfect for blow drying. Note that some boar bristles will fall out during use but this is typical of most boar bristle-type brushes.

What I cannot get past is the $47.50 price tag. That is way too expensive for this brush.

title: Attractive & super large clips; holds a lot of hair
text:
These hair clips are large. There are 12 clips in total with 6 clips in a glossy finish and 6 others in a matte finish.

These are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like the glossy ones for the vibrant color and the matte ones for the feel (non-slip grip). They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

The current price of $8.55 is a reasonably priced $.71 cents per clip. I have ordered many clips exactly like these in the past and they are all the same but have been twice the price.

title: Beautiful brush with a combo boar bristle & nylon brush head; staticky & way too $$$
text:
The brush handle on this brush is beautiful and feels like it is handmade. The wooden handle is easy to grasp and hold during styling.

This is a typical radial brush usually used for blow drying with a wave/curl. The brush head itself is a combination of boar and nylon bristles. Unfortunately, using this brush causes my hair to be very staticky. It does work well otherwise and is perfect for blow drying. Note that some boar bristles will fall out during use but this is typical of most boar bristle-type brushes.

What I cannot get past is the $52.50 price tag. That is way too expensive for this brush.

title: Love the colors but doesn’t really glow in the dark & very small amount of polish
text:
There are five TINY jars of nail polish in this set. Each jar is only .17 ounces of polish. This nail polish goes on sheer and sometimes lumpy even after I shook the bottles. In addition, only two colors faintly glow in the dark -- the yellow and the pink (see photos).

This polish does not live up to its claims. I do LOVE the whacky and vibrant colors but this does not perform as specified. The current price of $8.99 comes to $1.80 per color but it is not worth that price even though they do cover and color the nails with polish. If these performed as claimed, then I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Adorable baby shark clips that hold a wisp of hair; finish wears off easily
text:
These clips are adorable and perfect for a baby girl or a pet that has just been to the groomer. There are eight baby shark clips in various colors. They have a shimmery finish to them. They hold like bobby pins but there is a trick to opening them (see photo). One arm has to be bent in the opposite direction to open, then it can be slipped over just a tiny bit of hair and then bent in the opposite direction to close. 

The biggest negative is that the finish wears off relatively easily. I was just trying these on my cat (see photo) and part of the finish came off two of them as can be seen in one of my pictures.

At the current price of $7.99, they come to a competitively priced $1 each. If the finish did not wear off, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Functional brushes (10); blender sponges(6) complete the set
text:
There are 10 make-up brushes in this set along with 6 blender sponges and one CHEAP but movable PLASTIC holder. Also included are two stickies--one to affix to the bottom of the holder and the other is extra. Since the sticky is double-sided, this holder can be affixed to a counter, if desired.

This is an attractive brush set but it is not high quality. The bristles are marginally soft and definitely feel synthetic and are shiny. They also smell like paint solvent. However, there is no shedding.
