Their bristles feel good against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I love that they include eyebrow  and fan brushes as they are not usually included in brush sets. 

In addition to these brushes, six blender sponges are included and I consider these the star of the set. There are three sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other three sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges that are good for blending or any large make-up application. These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin and they do not smell funny like others I have used previously. The holder is nice but it's plastic.

The current price of $17.99 ($19.99 minus $2) for 17 pieces (10 brushes, 6 blenders, 1 holder) is reasonable for this as it comes to $1.06 per item. I consider this set perfect for the young make-up artist just starting out. However, do realize that the brush heads are not of the best quality due to the synthetic feel.

title: Beautiful set of 5 combs perfect for short to medium hair / beard; not good for tangles
text:
This is a beautiful 5-piece wooden comb set with evenly spaced teeth. Each comb feels great in my hands and I found them easy to pass through my hair unless my hair was tangled. They feel pretty sturdy.

There is a comb for the beard or one that can act like a flea comb for a cat. All but one have finely spaced teeth and one is a wide-tooth comb.

The current price of $12.99 for this set is excellent as it comes to $2.60 per comb.

title: Generously sized & beautifully made headbands with mask holder buttons
text:
I love the fabric design on these headbands and the fact that the band is generously sized. They are also very soft and the center "knot" can be worn on the front of the forehead or put to the back of the neck. In addition, there are matching buttons that I can hook my mask onto. No matter which way I wear this, the buttons still work. They also look great on me.

I have tried many headbands and this is the first set that is generous with the material and paid attention to the button detailing.

The current price of $12.99 for three headbands comes to a competitively priced $4 per band.

title: Love the colors of this sponge set; plastic holder tilts
text:
This is a nice set of six colored blending sponges with one CHEAP but movable PLASTIC holder and two stick-ons for holder bottom. I love the sponges and their colors (i.e. yellow, purple, pink). I also like that the plastic holder can be tilted to display a sponge better but I do not like that the holder is plastic. I would have preferred a metal one. The two supplied double stick circular stick-ons are for the bottom of the holder. This holder can be stuck to a surface. I just chose to stick it to the unit itself and not to the counter.

There are two purple sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The two pink sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application. The two yellow swiss cheese looking sponges are unique. I love unique things and these sponges are good for using the tip to highlight the cheeks. Personally, I find that these sponges are not as easy to work with as the other blenders but I do like their uniqueness. 

All the sponges except for the cheese ones feel good in my hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. The cheese ones are soft but they are awkward for me to hold and blending with them is not easy with the thick side. They also do not sit in the holder. In general, these blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

With the exception of the triangular ones, these sponges are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make them perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $9.99 it is a reasonable $1.67 per sponge if I consider the holder and the base stickies freebies.

title: Moisturizing and almost scentless lip balm with SPF 15; a bit greasy on the lips
text:
There are four tubes of lip balm in this package. The two main ingredients are sunflower seed oil and beeswax with the fourth ingredient being coconut oil. The active sunscreen ingredients are avobenzone 3%, octinoxate 7.5%, octisalate 5%, and octocrylene 5%.

This balm glides easily on my lips and is very moisturizing. It has a very faint spicy scent, but it is so faint that I consider it almost scentless and there is no added flavor. I personally prefer flavored balms. I love that it is rated up to SPF 15. The only negative is that the lip balm feels greasy and it is not waxy like a ChapStick.

The current price of $8.95 comes to a competitively priced $2.24 per tube.

title: Nail clippers cut well and provide a good grip; love the red color; comes w/more tools than I use
text:
There are two nail clipper tools in this set and they are exceptionally sharp. In addition, other implements are included such as nail file, cuticle pusher/cutter, and ingrown toenail lifters (both straight edged and curved edge). In total there are six tools in this set along with the zippered case.

LIKES
- Comes in a protective case.
- Handles of all the clippers feel great in my hands--almost non-slip.
- The cutting blade on the clippers is great
- There is a file on the small fingernail clipper handle and another single file but the nail clippers are the main stars of this set.
- I love the electric red color of the toenail clipper and the feel of the handle.

DISKLIKE
- The red handled toenail clipper takes getting used to as it is a curved blade.

The current price of $9.99 is an excellent price for this set as the tools work well. I do always worry if the spring wires on the toenail clipper will pop off; however, I have always been able to operate them with one wire arm. If they pop off, they can be reseated.

title: Moisturizes my hands; smells nice but like suntan lotion; provides a nice hydration barrier
text:
This hand lotion is non-greasy, absorbs quickly, and moisturizes well. It also has a strong fresh fragrance that smells a little bit like suntan lotion. Once it dried, I felt like I had a light and silky hydration barrier on my hands. Overall, I really like this lotion. However, it still does not beat out [[ASIN:B000LUXO2K Camille Beckman Glycerine Hand Therapy in Camille Fragrance]], which is the best hand therapy lotion I ever tried.

The current price of $14.99 is competitively priced for this.

title: Nice, lightweight clips; they have a mild hold; love the colors
text:
I really like these clips. The marbleized colors on four of the five clips (excludes the black one) are attractive and will match best in those who have black or brown-color variants.  I have short to medium fine curly hair and these clips hold up my hair in the back but they are best for long hair. 

The current price of $10.99 for five clips is on the high side of competitively priced at $2.20 per clip.

title: Stylish clips with mediocre hold; texture of clips is great
text:
There are three boxy / triangle-like claw clips in this package. I like their matte marbleized look and the feel of the clips in my hands. They are medium-sized and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly but the hold is only mediocre as there is a large section of the clip that is nothing but air space. However, these would probably work well for those who have long thick curly hair.

In addition to the three attractive clips, there are two barrettes supplied which do hold a tiny strand of hair very well as an accent piece.

The current price of $4.99 for three clips comes to $1.66 per clip, not counting the two bobby pin like extras provided.

title: Basic eye brush set; case smells; brown brushes too short; fan brush not cut right – 2.5 stars
text:
There are 10 small headed brushes in this set that are useful for blending eyeshadow powders. The bristles are soft on the white headed brushes and feel great against my eyelids. However, the brown headed brushes are too short and one brush has a sharp edge. In addition, the fan brush is not cut right and the case smells.

This set is only partially useful, in my opinion. The current price of $13.99 ($16.99 minus $3) is too expensive for this set as it comes to $1.40 per brush. A better set is this [[ASIN:B08S749XB1 Leung 15-pc eye brush set]] that is $3 cheaper.

title: Nail clippers cut well and provide a good grip but clip fell off on first use - 2.5 stars
text:
There are three nail clipper tools in this set and they are sharp. In addition, a nail file and what looks like a cuticle pusher or toenail lifter is included. I'm not really familiar with that last tool.

LIKES
- Handles of all the clippers feel great in my hands
- The cutting blade on the clippers are good
- The other implements are nice to have

DISKLIKE
- One of the spring clips on the toenail clippers fell off immediately (see photo). It actually operates better without it but I was able to put it back on.

The current price of 18.04 ($18.99 minus 5%) is way too pricey for this, especially since the spring fell off on first use. Even though this set works well, I hate when product pieces fall off. I would have expected that for a clipper set that was cheaper and not this price.

title: Four typical extra large shower caps
text: There are four typical no-frills extra large shower caps (red, gray, light pink, and black). They fit me well with room to spare and they are waterproof due to the inner liner. The current price of $8.49 ($9.99 minus 15%) comes to a very reasonable $2.12 per cap.

title: Like a high-end spa shampoo; I love this!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: I have short to medium fine curly hair and this shampoo did not weigh it down. It lathers and cleans well and smells wonderful too. It also rinses out easily. I actually felt like I was getting a spa treatment. It is expensive at the current price of $22 for 5.07 fluid ounces but it is a wonderful shampoo. I absolutely love it!

title: Manicure bench is narrow, tall, slippery, & it smells
text:
At the current price of $17.29, this manicure bench is more reasonably priced than a competitor with the same bench. The quality of the workmanship is pretty good but the legs elevate this bench about 5.25" off the ground. Since the bench is narrow on top, the person leaning their hands may have a tendency to tip this over. In addition, there are no rubber feet on the "legs." As a result, it is necessary to put a towel under this bench to keep it from slipping when placed on a solid non-stick surface.

Other than this, this bench is very nice. If it were lower to the ground, about two inches wider, and had rubberized feet on the bottom, this would have received 5 stars. In its current state it is functional but not the best it could be. The fact that it smells is also bothersome to me. I suppose it could double as a child's pretend ironing board.

title: An okay brush set for detangling; I prefer the detangler brush over the hair brush
text:
There are two brushes in this set. One regular brush and one detangling brush. These brushes comb through my hair easily. I had to assemble the detangling brush. This brush is perfect for combing wet hair in the shower. It glided through my hair. 

What I do not like about this set is the regular brush. It is very hard and almost rips at the hair. Also, it is irregular as can be seen in my photo. The brush lanes do not line up straight. 

At the current price of $10.44 ($10.99 minus 5%), this is somewhat pricey for the quality of this set. The detangler is good and typical but the regular brush is not good. The handles on both brushes are good, however, as they have a soft grip to them.

title: Very functional brushes (15); blender sponges (3) complete the set
text:
There are 15 make-up brushes in this set along with 3 blender sponges and an insert describing each brush. This is an attractive brush set. The bristles are soft enough even though they are not high-end like a much more expensive set. There is no shedding. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously.What I particularly love is that they include an eyebrow brush and lip liner brush that is not usually included in other sets. In addition, the bevel edges on the handles make these brushes easy to hold and work with compared to the straight handles of most make-up applicators.

In addition to these brushes, three blender sponges are included.There is one sponge with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other sponge is a typical egg-shaped sponge that is good for blending or any large make-up application and an hour-glass shaped sponge that is also great and easy to hold and use. These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin.

This set is actually overkill for me as there are more brushes than I need.  The current price of $13.99 for 18 pieces is an excellent buy as this comes to $.78 cents per brush/sponge. I consider this set perfect for the young make-up artist just starting out.

title: Earthy-smelling soap; cleans well; I did not notice any “evening” of skin tone
text:
There are two small bars of soap in this package.  They have an earthy and almost “cigarettesmoke” aroma to me. This soap lathers and cleans well. Due to its small size,it is easy to hold. Nevertheless, I did not notice any “evening” of skin tone or anything like that.  

The current price of $11.99 comes to a pricey $5.50 per bar.

title: These are soft and comfortable gloves to wear w/a bit of stretch; I supply the moisturizer
text:
There are six pairs of white gloves in this package. They are very soft and have a bit of stretch to them which makes them spacious and usable for large hands like mine (with room to spare). They are also very comfortable to wear. I cover my hands with these after applying a heavy moisturizer to my hands and my hands are more hydrated than they would have been had I not worn gloves.

These work well to keep the moisturizer that I apply to my hands from drying out rapidly. Since these gloves breathe, my hands do not shrivel up as if they were in water or plastic.

These gloves will not last long as I have used other gloves like these in the past. With repeated use, any grease like Vaseline and other lotions will stain the gloves and not everything will come out in the wash. In addition, they will come apart at the seams. However, I do not expect gloves like these to last more than two weeks of repeated use.

The current price of $6.99 is reasonable for six pairs as it comes to $1.17 per pair.

title: Works gently but effectively on the dry skin on my feet
text:
This file is easy to hold and work with as a result of the finger indentations . It also filed my heels gently. Some files are like cheese graters and this one is gentler. When I was done, I just rinsed the file under warm water and the dead skin that was removed (see photo) was easily rinsed off. The file looked brand new afterward.

The current price of $9.34 ($10.99 minus 15%) is on the high side of competitively priced. However, this is a very pretty file making it sort of functional art.

title: These blenders are great; I love the angles and pink colors
text:
This is a lovely set of five colorful blending sponges. I love angles on the flat-sided blenders because these are great  for smooth applications. The egg-shaped sponge is typical and also good for make-up application. The tiny ones are perfect for my eyes.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These shades of pink/orange colors make this perfect for the Easter Basket.

The current price of $8.99 ($9.99 minus 10%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this set but it is truly a nice set.

title: Nice bath bombs; color does not adhere; six subtle but fragrant aromas
text:
[[VIDEOID:f52a030ca29edcadaa530ae94796e46b]] This is an attractive and giftable set of six bath bombs in six fragrances (rose, orange, lavender, lemon, mint, chamomile). They are made with essential oils.

I tried the rose bomb in my foot bath. The fragrance of this and each of the others is subtle but nice. I used hot to tepid water and suds were created in the foot bath and the bomb fizzed. It eventually (in about 10 minutes) dissolved in the water as I bathed my feet. I felt clean and loved the scent. My feet also came out feeling very soft. 

What I do love is that the color of the bomb does not turn my nails and feet pink. Also, my foot bath did not have a color ring around it like another high-end bath bomb I tried previously. Insofar as "performance," these bombs are really good. At the current price of $16.99, they come to a pricey $2.83 per bath fizz.

title: Brush head small & easily misshapen; handle has decent reach; a bit pricey
text:
There are two back brushes in this set.

I use a back brush every day. These back brushes work okay. They have a small brush head that is of medium softness so it is mildly exfoliating. However, the bristles arrive misshapen and get misshapen easily. The handle is long enough for me to reach my back comfortably. The reverse side of the brush has plastic massaging nubs; they are useless to me since they are not made of silicone and do not move.

I like that these have a hole for a hook in the handle. These are definitely not my favorite back brushes but they are functional.

The current price of $13.19 ($13.88 minus 5%) is on the high side of competitively priced for brushes of this calibre as it comes to $6.59 per brush. I personally would not have expected to pay more than $4.50 to $5 for each brush.

title: These look & feel like communion gloves; I supply the moisturizer & let the gloves work overnight
text:
There are three pairs of white gloves that look and feel like elegant communion gloves. These do not only have to be used for moisturizing my hands.

These work well to keep the moisturizer that I apply to my hands from drying out rapidly. Since these gloves breathe, my hands do not shrivel up as if they were in water or plastic.

What I do not care for is that these have an elastic cuff so it leaves a mark on my wrists with prolonged use. Also note that any grease like Vaseline and other lotions will stain the gloves and not everything will come out in the wash.

The current price of $4.99 is reasonable for three pairs as it comes to $1.66 per pair.

title: Absorbs easily; is not greasy; left my face and neck smooth and hydrated next morning
text:
I was afraid I wasn't going to like this because it is a serum which to me is an oil. However, this is wonderful. It comes in a beautiful bottle with a pump dispenser. I just put a tiny amount on my hands and rubbed it into my face and neck. Immediately my face and neck felt hydrated and smooth. It felt the same way when I woke up the next morning.

I absolutely love this serum. It is also almost scentless and the current price of $17.99 ($19.99 minus $2) is reasonable for this.

title: Stunning clips with a great hold; very stylish
text:
There are four boxy claw clips in this package and they are absolutely stunning with their marbleized look. They are medium-sized and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly and really hold on. They would work even better with longer hair. 

At the current price of $13.99 it comes to a reasonably priced $3.75 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well.

title: There are 6 pieces to this set per the photos; these are nice clips
text:
The Amazon title says there are three pieces to this set. However, when I look at the photos it shows six clips. What I received are the six clips shown in the Amazon photo (also see my picture).

These are nice, lightweight clips. They have a mild hold. I particularly love the style and colors of the marbleized ones.  I have short to medium fine curly hair and these clips hold up my hair in the back well. The larger ones are best for long hair.

The current price of $8.99 for four clips comes to a reasonably priced $1.50 per clip.

title: Beautiful brush with an ordinary brush head; way too $$$
text: The brush handle on this brush is beautiful and feels like it is handmade. The wooden handle is easy to grasp and hold during styling. However, the brush head itself is ceramic with typical prickly nylon bristles. This does work well to reduce frizzing and static during blow drying. Although this brush works well, I strongly feel the price of $50 is way too expensive. I know ceramic brushes cost more but it should not be this much more as there are others on the market that I have tried which are excellent and are much cheaper. The price is the only reason I rated this 3 stars.

title: I prefer more height a foundation brush; concealer brush scratched my eye area due to hard bristles
text:
There are two make-up brushes in this set. The smaller brush is for under eye concealer, so the bristles are tightly packed and short as it should be. However, it feels more like a paintbrush due to the hardness. The larger foundation brush has dense SHORT bristles but they are softer bristles. I prefer more bristle height on my foundation brush so that I can get a better "sweep" during application, so that is my second disappointment. Nevertheless, I can repurpose this brush as a cheek highlighter due to the nice angle.

These brushes do not shed, which is nice. The soft bristles of the foundation brush feels good against my skin and works well as a cheek highlighter for me. The concealer brush is terrible and I scratched myself with this one when I tried to use it.

In summary, although I really dislike how short the bristle height of the foundation brush is, I can repurpose it as a cheek highlighter due to the angle. The concealer brush is unusable, in my opinion. Therefore, since only one brush is really good but still cannot be used for the purpose specified, this gets 2 stars from me.

title: Nice pair of brushes but I would have preferred more height on the foundation brush
text:
There are two make-up brushes in this set. The smaller brush is for under eye concealer, so the bristles are tightly packed and short as it should be. However, the larger foundation brush also has dense SHORT bristles. I prefer more bristle height on my foundation brush so that I can get a better "sweep" during application.

Nevertheless, the bristles on these brushes are soft. There was no shedding but the brush heads almost smell like fresh cut wood to me. Their soft bristles feel good against my skin and work well but with a little more effort for the foundation brush.

The current price of $6.99 is competitively priced for this decent quality brush set. The only reason I rated this 3 stars is because I really dislike how short the bristle height of the foundation brush is.

title: Scrumptious looking bath bombs but scent is super subtle
text:
There are 10 pretty bath bombs in this set and 6 of them look decadent (cupcakes, hearts, and donuts) with the other 4  just pretty squares that remind me somewhat of pettifor cakes.

They are made with essential oils but I can barely smell any fragrance.  According to the Amazon site, there are 9 fragrances (sweet orange, rose, coconut, lavender, eucalyptus, ocean, grapefruit, lemon and strawberry) over the 10 bombs but the box lists only 8 fragrances (grapefruit is missing). I personally cannot distinguish the difference in scent among them.

I tried the green cupcake with the sprinkles on top in my foot bath.  I used hot to tepid water and the bomb fizzed and copious suds were produced. It eventually dissolved in the water as I bathed my feet but it took about 15-20 minutes. My feet felt clean and moisturized after the bath.

What I do love is that the color of the bomb does not turn my nails green. Also, my foot bath did not have a color ring around it like another high-end bath bomb I tried previously. Insofar as "performance," these bombs are just okay simply because the scent is almost non-existent and dissolving the bombs takes long. What I did not like are the undissolved "sprinkles" that got caught in the strainer in my sink.  Therefore, I recommend using a drain strainer in the bath to catch anything when done.

The current price of $14.25 ($14.99 minus 5%) comes to a reasonable $1.42 per serving.

title: Four pretty bath bombs; nicely scented; fizzes only; pink one has gunky center
text:
[[VIDEOID:f0f8a5c6428814930e5f34978f235b9a]] There are four pretty bath bombs in this package along with two potpourri scents and one plastic cutter to remove the plastic around the bombs.  

They are made with essential oils and they smell great. I tried the pink bomb with the rose flower center in my foot bath.  I used hot to tepid water and the bomb fizzed. The first thing that happened is the rose floated out and it was gunky instead of salty/sandy like the rest of the bomb. It eventually dissolved in the water as I bathed my feet. My feet felt clean and moisturized after the bath.

What I do love is that the color of the bomb does not turn my nails pink. Also, my foot bath did not have a color ring around it like another high-end bath bomb I tried previously. Insofar as "performance," these bombs are good. What I did not like is the gunky center as that was hard to rinse off. Also, once I was done with the bath, I dumped the contents in the sink and there was a plastic circle and small tiny pieces of undissolved gunk. Therefore, I recommend using a drain strainer in the bath to catch anything when done.

However, for the current price of $11.99 this comes to $3 per serving if not counting the potpourri or plastic cutter. I would have liked it if they did not include those peanuts in the package but used crinkle cut nesting paper instead.

title: Very hydrating shea oil; this is unscented
text:
This shea oil can be used on the skin and hair. I prefer to use this to hydrate my skin.  This is very moisturizing and has no scent. I personally prefer scented oils. It absorbs fully after about 10 minutes. Also, a little goes a long way. My skin was left with a silky feel after using this.

The current price of $17 is a little pricey.

title: Very hydrating shea oil; I love the vanilla scent
text:
This shea oil can be used on the skin and hair. I prefer to use this to hydrate my skin.  This is very moisturizing and has a nice vanilla scent. It absorbs fully after about 10 minutes. Also, a little goes a long way. My skin was left with a silky feel after using this.

The current price of $17 is a little pricey.

title: Very nice make-up brushes; set contains a brush for most uses
text:
There are 11 make-up brushes in this set. This is an attractive brush set. The bristles are soft and they do not fall out, which is great. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. 

This set thought of almost everything for most needs.  There are a few other brushes it does not have, but for the price, I think what is supplied is sufficient. For example, I could have also used a fan brush and several lip liner brushes. 

The main negative is that the current price of $27.54 ($28.99 minus 5%) is just slightly pricey for this set at $2.50 per brush compared to some others on the market that function just as well. For instance, this [[ASIN:B08JGFJZDX BS Mall set]] is over $12 cheaper at the current price of $15.29 and is a better set in my opinion.

title: Very basic travel brush set with case; short handles makes these hard to hold
text:
There are eight very basic and small make-up brushes in this set. The bristles are soft but I do not care for their nylon feel. There was no shedding. Their soft bristles feel good against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. However, since the brushes are small, this is really for travel. Because the handles are short, these can be difficult to hold and work with; however, since these are for a purse or carry-on, that is to be expected.

One of the handles on the brushes I received was chipped (see photo), so the quality is basic. I do love the case, however.

The current price of $7.22 ($8.49 minus 15%) is competitively priced for this set of nine pieces (eight brushes and one case).

title: I love the teal color but the bow looks silly on my head
text:
This shower cap is well-made and double lined. It fits my small head but the bow looks silly on my head and the overall design is not attractive on me at all.

Nevertheless, water runs right off this cap and the cap covers all my hair.

The current price of $13.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this double lined cap.

title: Pretty shower cap but the large size is tight for my small head
text:
This shower cap is mostly well-made and double lined. It also has a cinch cord at the base to pull this tighter around one's head. Unfortunately, their large size is very tight on my small head. I take a size small in a hat and this cap is too tight. I can get it on but it is uncomfortable and gives me a headache.

Water runs right off this cap and if this fit, it would have received 4 stars from me.

The current price of $13.63 ($14.98 minus 9%) is competitively priced for this double lined cap.

title: Lip balm size moisturizing salve; contains several essential oils
text:
This contains tangerine, ylang ylang, and lavender essential oils in addition to other oils. It is a tiny container  the size of a lip balm. I actually ordered this for my dry elbows. I applied a little bit and it reduced the immense dryness but this is oily. Also, the ylang ylang fragrance is predominant and it is not my favorite. In addition, this is no better than some other good moisturizers. Although this works to condition my skin, I personally would use a body cream or body oil that has a different fragrance.

The current price of $7 is on the pricey side of competitively priced.

title: Nice, lightweight clips; they have a mild hold; love the colors
text:
I really like these clips. The marbleized colors are attractive and will match best in those who have black or brown-color variants.  I have short to medium fine curly hair and these clips hold up my hair in the back but they are best for long hair.

The current price of $6.99 for four clips comes to a competitively priced $1.75 per clip.

title: Large & functional amber plastic pump bottles for shampoo/conditioner/body wash
text:
The bottles are clear amber-colored plastic. They are labeled for use for shampoo, conditioner, and body wash but can be used for other soap (like hand soap). However, if used for something else, the label will obviously not be true to what is inside.

I love that the soap level can be viewed easily through the plastic.

The pump mechanism works very well and feels solid. When filling this, it is important that the soap not come above the top rim because the insertion of the pump causes the soap to spill out over the top. 

I feel a price of $2 per bottle (total of $6 for the set) would be reasonable for this. Unfortunately, this is not currently priced.

title: Presentable manicure set; some implements difficult to remove from case & case is difficult to close
text:
This set looks impressive and is extremely presentable. It has a lot of tools, many of which I do not use.

I use all the clippers the most and they cut well. The tweezers are aligned and pull chin and eyebrow hairs easily. Both scissors are sharp and the cuticle cutter and file are good. I do not use the rest of the implements. However, because these tools are packed in the case, the case is very difficult to close and some implements are difficult to remove. Yes the case is gorgeous and rich looking but it needs to be bigger.

The current price of $11.99 is reasonable for this. However, the two negatives with the case really annoy me.

title: Lightweight body lotion with fresh fragrance & silky results
text:
I really love this lotion for the summer. It is a lightweight moisturizer, absorbs quickly, and dries to a silky finish. It also has a nice fresh scent. My body felt very hydrated and soft after using this. 

UPDATE: I loved the fresh bamboo lotion so much that I decided to order the lemon balm version during Prime Day. It has nice fresh subtly lemon aroma. My favorite is the green tea followed by the lemon balm fragrance.

title: Large lightweight paddle brush with ergonomic handle; gorgeous electric royal blue color
text:
This is a large lightweight nylon brush that glides easily through my hair whether tangled, combed, or wet. The handle is ergonomically designed and has a non-slip feel which provides for a non-slip grip. The electric royal blue color is supremely attractive to me.

The current price of $9.99 is pricey for this and is the only reason I took off one star. Otherwises this is a great brush.

title: Large lightweight paddle brush with ergonomic & decorative handle
text:
This is a large lightweight nylon brush that glides easily through my hair whether tangled, combed, or wet. The handle is ergonomically designed and also very decorative with a floral pattern at the base. The center part of the handle is made of soft silicone and provides a great grip when holding.

The current price of $10.99 is a bit steep for this and is the only reason I took off one star. Otherwises this is a great brush.

title: One set of 2 medium-sized clips; no teeth in middle so hold is light
text:
There are two claw clips in the package and not two packages of two clips. They are gorgeous, medium-sized, and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair well but they do not have the hold of clips that have teeth in the center. They would also work better with longer hair. 

At the current price of $9.49 ($9.99 minus 5%) it comes to a competitively priced but pricey $4.75 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well but I just wish they had teeth in the center.

title: Rips the hair if its too tangled; best on wet or already combed hair
text:
This is a basic set of lightweight vent brushes. I prefer the one with the curve as it molds to my head and is good for blow drying. However, both rip out my hair if my hair is really tangled. It is best on wet hair or hair that is almost combed.

I love the feel of the handles on these brushes as they have a non-slip grip to them and feel as if there is a light silicone cover over each handle.

These brushes are cheaply made but functional. I do not feel this set is worth more than $5.99. At the current price of $10.99, it is way overpriced in my opinion. Although I like these brushes, their price and function with tangled hair is the reason my rating is 3 stars.

title: Mildly exfoliating sponges but too large for me to get a good grip
text: I wanted to love these sponges but I do not. There are two in the package and they arrive extremely compressed. I just added water and they expanded as shown in my photo. The sponge is mildly exfoliating due to the rough exterior. However, I find these sponges difficult to wash with because they are bigger than my hand. For me this is a big disappointment. Also, the current price of $9.99 is an expensive $5 per sponge.

title: These medium-sized clips are STUNNING and hold my hair well; best if used at base of neck
text:
These clips look like a small octopus and each one has teeth in the center that grips my hair well and provides me with a great hold. In addition, they are absolutely stunning and perfect for an elegant outfit.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and these work in the back of my head where my hair is longest. The best place for me to use these is at the base of my neck. If I put them in the center of my head, they are uncomfortable to use due to the curve / concave shape of the clip.

The current price of $9.99 comes to $5 per clip which is competitively priced due to the beauty of these.

title: Nice selection of clips; great hold but they feel like they will break
text:
These clips are long and large and have teeth in the center. As a result they provide me with a great hold. In addition, they are beautiful and match almost any outfit. I have short to medium fine curly hair and these are best for those with longer hair. Nevertheless, they hold on tight at the back of my head where my hair is the longest.

Unfortunately, I am not convinced these will last as they feel like they will break when opening and closing them.

The current price of $13.99 for 6 clips is pricey for this as it comes to $2.33 per clip.

title: Low-end, cheap barrel brush; not crazy about the nylon bristles or feel of brush
text: This is a small barrel brush. However, the nylon bristles do not grab the hair as well as a nylon/boar bristle combo. Also, the handle feels plastic. The size is perfect for my short to medium fine curly hair but I find it harder to work with than the combo brushes. The  current price or $7.49 is too expensive for this brush. It is just okay and nothing special.

title: Large, beautiful octopus claw clips with a great hold
text:
These clips are squat and large and have teeth in the center. As a result they provide me with a great hold. In addition, they are beautiful and match my hair perfectly. I have short to medium fine curly hair and these are best for those with longer hair. Nevertheless, they hold on tight at the back of my head where my hair is the longest.

The current price of $16.99 for 6 clips is pricey for this as it comes to $2.83 per clip.

title: Highly moisturizing night cream; not crazy about spicy aroma
text:
This cream is very nice and of medium thickness. I love it's creaminess. I put this on my face and neck. Once it was absorbed, my face and neck felt incredibly hydrated. Unfortunately, I do not care for the spicy aroma that I can't describe--cinnamon or clove? 

The current price of $17.88 is reasonable for this.

title: This provides a long-lasting medium hold
text: I have short to medium-fine curly hair and this gave me a solid and long-lasting medium hold.  My hair was not overly stiff, yet it was stiff enough to stay in place. It also looked like I had a salon finish. I like this spray, although the fragrance is just okay.

title: Flattened my hair more than boosted it; I do not care for this spray
text: I do not care for this spray at all. The fragrance is not great and all this did was make my hair flat, sticky, and dirty looking.

title: Generously-sized balm tins but will dent easily because they are thin
text:
These are nice containers even though they are tin. The lid screws on and off easily and will hold two ounces of lip balm, body butter,  or other lotions. They can also be used to store pills, earrings, etc.

There are 24 containers in total and the lid has a liner on the inside to prevent corrosion.

The current price of $13.99 for 24 containers  comes to a $.58 cents per container.

title: Reasonably priced set; hair brush is the best part
text:
This is a four piece set. There is a nice boar/nylon wooden paddle brush, a comb that is used mostly for teasing hair, a massage brush for the shower, and a metal rake to clean the hair out of the brush.

The brush is easy to hold and passes through my short to medium-length curly hair easily. I like the brush but it does have a smell to it that I do not like. The massage brush is good for those who have short hair. This can be used to suds up the hair and massage the scalp in the shower. With longer hair, one has to be careful not to tangle their locks. I like that the massage is pliable and soft and easy to hold but it is not something I will use.

The comb is okay but nothing I use. It is good for detangling.  The rake marginally works. These usually do not work well to remove hair from a brush; they are just okay and never anything better.

The current price of $9.97 is reasonable for this set but the brush is the best part; I just wish it did not smell.

title: OK starter make-up brush kit for a young girl
text:
There are 10 very basic and small make-up brushes in this set. The bristles are relatively soft. There was no shedding. Their soft bristles feel good against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. However, since the brushes are small, this is not a professional set. I personally prefer larger foundation brushes than this set supplies. The small brushes are fine as there are five of those.

The current price of $11.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this basic set of 10  brushes as it comes to $1.20 per brush.

title: Basic manicure set; it’s difficult to close case & implements are tightly seated
text:
This set is a basic set of decent but not great quality. It has nine tools, most of which I use.

I use all the clippers the most and they cut well. The tweezers are aligned and pull chin and eyebrow hairs easily. The scissors are sharp, although I am not crazy about the curled angle of the blade. I do not use the ear pick. However, my biggest complaint is that the case is hard to close because it really is not big enough for all the tools. In addition, it is difficult to remove the tools from their elastic sleeves due to the tight arrangement.

The current price of $16.99 is too expensive for this due to the case. Nevertheless, the tools work relatively well.

title: Excellent detangling brush for my short to medium length hair
text:
This brush is excellent. It is a full-sized brush that is easy to hold and use. I love the needle bristles as it detangles my short to medium length hair easily. There is a metal cleaning stick supplied to remove the hair in the brush which works relatively well.

The current price of $17.09 ($18.99 minus 10%) is pricey for this but it is a good quality wooden brush with cleaning stick and protective pouch.

title: Brush has huge barrel; perfect for blow drying long hair; lightweight w/excellent grip
text:
This is an absolutely excellent brush for blow drying long hair. It is lightweight and the ribbed grip on the handle is excellent. The only thing I do not like is that there is this metal blank name tag on the handle that breaks up the grip. I do not understand the purpose of that.

The current price of $10.99 is pricey for this; however, the only reason I took off one star is because of that blank metal label.

title: Lovely creamy colors but difficult to wash off
text:
I love the color creme eyeshadows in this set. Most of the colors are subtle except for the black. They glide on easily and blend well. The only negative is that I have to scrub hard with soap and water to remove this as they do not wash off easily.

The current price of $7.99 is reasonable for this set of six creme eyeshadows and one brush applicator. It comes to $2 per eyeshadow if not counting the supplied brush.

title: Decent starter make-up brush kit for a young girl; ceramic holder is best part
text:
There are 10 very basic and small make-up brushes in this set. The bristles are soft. There was no shedding. Their soft bristles feel good against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. However, since the brushes are small, this is not a professional set. I personally prefer larger foundation brushes than this set supplies. The brushes come with a beautiful ceramic holder that has a face image on the front. I love this holder as this makes the set.

In addition to these brushes, three blender sponges are included. The one sponges with a flat side is great for smooth applications. The other sponge is a typical egg-shaped sponge that is good for blending or any large make-up application as is the hourglass sponge. These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. The sponges also come with a metal holder.

 The current price of $16.99 is competitively priced for this set of 15 pieces (10 brushes, 3 blender sponges, and two holders).

title: Nail clippers cut well and provide a good grip
text:
There are three nail clipper tools in this set and they are exceptionally sharp. In addition, other implements are included such as nail files, cuticle cutter, toenail lifter, etc.

LIKES
- Comes in a protective tin case.
- Handles of all the clippers feel great in my hands--almost non-slip.
- The cutting blade on the clippers is great
- The other files in addition to the three clippers are useful but the nail clippers are the main stars of this set.
- I love the electric blue color of the toenail clipper

DISKLIKE
- The blue handled toenail clipper takes getting used to as it is a curved blade.

The current price of 11.99 ($16.99 minus $5) is competitive and reasonable for this set as the tools work well, particularly the clippers.

title: Very functional brushes (18); brush heads have slight smell; blender sponges complete the set
text:
There are 18 make-up brushes in this set. This is an attractive brush set. The bristles are soft. There was no shedding. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I like that they stand up; however, they are easy to knock over so that negates the purpose of that ability. I actually had them produce a domino effect by accidentally tipping over the brushes on several occasions, which I found frustrating. 

In addition to these brushes, three blender sponges are included.There are two sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other sponge is a typical egg-shaped sponge that is good for blending or any large make-up application. These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin.

This set is actually overkill for me. There are more brushes than I needed in this set. The brush heads do have a slight smell to them but nothing that is overpowering. The current price of $15.38 ($16.19 minus 5%) is an excellent buy as this comes to $.73 cents per brush/sponge.

title: Super hydrating hand cream
text: This hand cream is super hydrating. It absorbs quickly and leaves my hands silky smooth.  A little goes a long way. The current price of $6.99 for a 1.1 fluid ounce tube is a bit pricey for this but I love the scent and moisturizing effects so much that I am not taking off one star for the price.

title: I prefer white creams; it's neither firming nor tightening; smells like pineapple coffee - 2.5 stars
text: I like my creams to be white and not almond colored. I found this neither firming nor tightening; however, it is hydrating. I do not care for the aroma as it smells like pineapple coffee. Besides the good hydration, another good thing about this is that the color does not come off on my clothes.

title: Cleans, lathers, and moisturizes well but I feel like it leaves a slight film on my body
text: This cleans and lathers copiously. It also feels hydrating. However, after I get out of the shower, I feel like I have a slight film on my body. Also, the current price of $14.99 for 5 ounces of soap is a lot, in my opinion. The fragrance is just okay to me.

title: This is a quality manicure set in a super attractive case with a giftable box
text:
This is an excellent manicure set. I ordered the one with the orange case (4.75" x 6.5") and I am totally surprised by the larger size of the case and its quality along with the tools within. There are nine implements in total and they are:

- toenail clippers
- oblique fingernail clippers
- fingernail clippers
- scissors
- glass nail file
- slant-tip tweezers
- cuticle pusher/nail cleaner
- ear pick
- cuticle fork

I personally do not use the ear pick, but everything else I use. The scissors are sharp and good considering the small size. All the clippers cut well. The tweezers also align perfectly and have a precision tip that extracts my chin, lip, and eyebrow hairs easily. The only thing I am not crazy about is the glass nail file. I personally prefer the regular sandy files. I can also do without an ear pick. This seems to be a hot item these days but is not something I partake in; besides I feel it is dangerous to pick one's ears with a metal implement.

The current price of $19.99 is excellent for this quality set.

title: Two sturdy, well-made medium-sized clips that hold a decent amount of hair
text:
There are two claw clips in the package. They are gorgeous, medium-sized, and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly but they would work better with longer hair. 

At the current price of $9.99 it comes to a competitively priced $5 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well.

title: Can be used as hair clips or package toppers; beautiful bows
text:
These bows are beautiful. They can be used as girl's hair clips. They look best on long hair. The clips hold a tiny amount of hair and these are more of an accent piece. For instance, one can put their hair in a ponytail and then clip this on top. The bow wires will have to be straightened out a bit.

In addition to barrettes, they can be used as package toppers for wrapped gifts or even as decoration on a Christmas tree. They are great for all three purposes.

The current price of $7.99 comes to $1.33 per clip.

title: Love the color of the brush and its detangling ability, especially with wet hair
text:
I really love this brush. The brush is actually like eight combs strung together and I had to set the extra piece that comes with it to separate the tines. It was not easy to get the bar across the "combs" but eventually I managed. There are only two places the bar should be put and that is where the holes are on the back of the "brush." I  put it lower on the lower "rung." 

Once this is assembled, it glides through the hair and detangles. It works well on dry hair but even better on wet hair.  I love the hard tines as it is like getting a massage on the scalp. The handle provides a good grip. Also, since the combs are separated, this brush can act as a vent brush for blow drying even though it is not of circular design. Hair can be removed easily since the tines are flat with no "ball" tip.

The only reason I rated this four stars is because of the current price of $9.99 which is $3 more than the exact same type brush called the [[ASIN:B0836XT7J8 Heeta Detangling Brush]].

title: Absolutely wonderful lotion; smells fantastic; leaves my body silky
text:
My boyfriend (pictured) and I love this lotion. We both tried it and it left our skin silky soft. The lotion is lightweight but it absorbs quickly. This is a perfect summer moisturizer. The fragrance is divine.

The current price of $14.99 is expensive for 5 ounces but I just love this so much that I did not take off one star for that.

title: Attractive and thick headband but cheaply made
text:
This headband is attractive and looks great on my head. It is also a wide band. Unfortunately, this is cheaply made. One of the jewels arrived dislodged and I had to glue it back on. Also, one other part on the decorative top was loose. This also comes with a moon barrette that acts more like a hair accent piece as it holds a little bit of hair.

The current price of $22.99 is way too expensive for this. I do not feel this is worth more than $8.

title: Cute, portable, and functional detangling brush
text:
This is a nice, cute, small brush for young children or for young-at-heart adults that want to travel with a small brush. The handle is small and the head is cute, circular, and looks like a cat's face. The brush glides easily through my short to medium-length curly hair when both dry or wet. This comes with a burlap carry case that fits the entire brush except for the tip of the handle. It also comes with some replacement bristles and a brush cleaner that actually works better than others I tried previously.

The current price of $11.97 is on the high side of competitively priced for this brush; however, this is 10 stars on the cuteness scale.

title: Unique brush that works well with both liquid & powder foundation
text:
I love unique items and this is certainly a uniquely designed brush in the shape of a tiny iron. I was skeptical if it would work on liquid foundation. However, it works well on both liquid and powder foundation. Due to the closeness of the very soft bristles, liquid foundation spreads evenly. What I really like this for, however, is to use the tapered end with powder blush and work from the jawbone down toward the face to highlight the cheeks with a darker shade of blush. The indentation in the casing makes this somewhat easy to control during application.

In summary, this is a niche brush that is also a conversation piece. It is definitely not going to be for everyone but I personally like the quirkiness and functionality of this little treasure.  The current price of $4.99 is competitively priced.

Note that smudges from make-up will show up on the brush casing due to the shiny finish.

title: Mini lightweight paddle brush; I love the rainbow colors
text:
I am attracted to this brush like a hummingbird is to a flower because I absolutely love the rainbow colors. This brush is small but not super small and is perfect for travel. I would consider it a mini paddle brush but not a tiny brush. The bristles easily pass through my fine short to medium-length curly hair. I also love how the handle feels in my hand even though it is shorter than a regular brush. Also, the design on the front and back is beautiful to me.

The current price of $6.99 ($11.99 minus $5) is competitively priced for this.

title: Wonderful medium-weight cream; absorbs quickly & moisturizes well
text:
I really love this cream. First of all it comes in an attractive jar. Second, six "envelope" samples of other products were also included with this cream which is something I will try when ready.

The cream itself is of medium weight and is very creamy. It is almost scentless. I applied this to my face and neck and it absorbed quickly and moisturized my skin. It feels supple and protective. I would not call it tightening but it is definitely hydrating.

This is reasonably priced at the current cost of $21. Based on my results and the feel of this cream, I consider this an all-season face and neck moisturizer.

title: Foot cream is lightweight, moisturizing, & smells great; NOT FRAGRANCE FREE; pumice is AWFUL
text:
Included in the package is one four-ounce tube of foot cream and a large double-sided pumice. The pink side of the pumice is coarser than the green side.

The foot cream is great. It is lightweight, moisturizing, and smells great. It is no better or worse than any type of cream one uses for their body but I do LOVE the fragrance which I cannot really describe. Unfortunately, the Amazon site says this is fragrance free and that is not the case; therefore, I took off one star for false advertising.

The pumice, however, is awful. It does work to file down the cracked heels and dry spots on the feet. However, the resulting debris left behind feels like sand. Therefore, when I put on the cream, it feels like I am rubbing both sand and cream onto my feet. I threw the pumice out after the first use. I took off another star for this.

The current price of $7.99 is reasonable for this cream. I personally love the cream but dislike that they advertised fragrance free and included a pumice that dissolves into a sand after using on the feet.

title: For small feet only; temperature does not hold & temperature buttons do not operate correctly
text:
[[VIDEOID:e9f77fec7c25d5a8ceff145592ba33df]] Besides the food bath, there is an instruction pamphlet in the package. The instructions are clear but do not say much of anything and I have a funny feeling some information is lacking.

FEATURES of the Foot Bath
- LED display
- LED controls for ON/OFF, temperature UP/DOWN, red light, and bubbles
- Heats from 95℉ to 118℉
- Has massage roller spikes in the bath
- Has a red pumice stone in the bath
- Shuts off after 60 minutes

LIKES
- Pumice stone in the middle is nice for softening heels.
- It has an auto shutoff at 60 minutes or thereabouts.

DISLIKES
- It is only for small feet. My boyfriend has swollen feet and he had trouble getting his feet in this bath. Also, there is a center column in the way that makes this even more difficult.

- He hates the massage roller spikes in the bath as they hurt his feet. Also, since the bath is so small, he can not rub his feet around on them because he cannot move his feet.

- The temperature controls do not operate correctly. Sometimes when I pressed the down arrow, it would increase the temperature. Other times it would lower it. However, the temperature never stayed on what I set it and always went back to 106 and then counted down over several minutes to ......103.....99...98, etc. as if the temperature was lowering.

- The red light feature seems useless. The Amazon site says it strengthens metabolism of blood and cell tissue but it sounds like hocus pocus to me. My boyfriend did not notice anything.

- The manual does not describe what the LED numbers are. It's possible it is a countdown timer but, if so, it does not match with what is described in the manual of a 60-minute shutdown.

In summary, this foot bath is only for small feet. The temperature buttons do not work as designed and it is unclear if the temperature is even operating correctly. My boyfriend and I, after having tried this, do not like this bath. I would rather just soak my feet in a plain non-electric basin that has more room and is no-frills over some high-priced foot spa that somewhat works and is designed for the tiniest feet.

The current price of $45.59 ($47.99 minus 5%) is expensive for this.

title: Nice lightweight cream; absorbs quickly & provides a hydration barrier
text:
I really like this cream. It is lightweight and has a subtle fresh scent. I applied this to my face and neck and it absorbed quickly and provided me with a hydration barrier on my skin that I could feel. Six "envelope" samples of other products were also included with this cream which is something I will try when ready.

This is pricey at the current price of $28.80 ($36.00 minus 20%) but it is a good cream that is perfect for the summer, spring, and fall. I prefer a heavier cream for the winter.

title: Heavy tube of deodorant; works up to 8 hours on me but I hate the smell
text:
This is a 2.8-ounce solid tube of deodorant. I love the container as there is a wheel on the bottom that I can turn to release small increments of the balm.  It  glides smoothly and feels moisturizing. Unfortunately, since this does not have aluminum (which I require), I stink after eight hours. The fact that it even lasted eight hours is amazing because other non-aluminum deodorants last me only two to four hours and one lasted me six hours. Since I take a shower every 12 hours, I do not need long-length protection. 

The results are four stars for me considering my track record with non-aluminum deodorants.. I rated it two stars because I absolutely hate the rosemary witch hazel scent. I cannot even describe the aroma, but it offends my senses. I am glad my nose is not near my armpit because I would have thrown this out already if it were.

The current price of $17.99 is expensive for this 2.8-ounce tube.

title: Goes on like a gel but lathers up and cleans well; love the lavender scent
text:
This dispenses a little bit like a gel but lathers up relatively well and my hands feel clean afterward. I do love the lavender scent. The active antiseptic ingredient is benzalkonium chloride 0.13%.

The current price of $9.99 for 16 ounces is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Super thin, stiff brushes for precision eyeliner, etc. detail
text:
These brushes are actually thinner than I expected. They are great for super precision work. The brushes are stiff but still soft against my skin and have some flexibility but with resistance for "drawing" a fine line.

There are a total of four brushes
#00 - Definer brush
#1 - Tight Liner Brush
#2 - Angled Eyeliner Brush
#3 - Ultra-Fine Liner Brush

These work well with liquid or gel liner per the instructions. I personally prefer to use water mixed with eyeshadow powder to highlight above and below the eye. These brushes are good for that also. It does take practice but these thin brushes make application a lot easier.

There is also an included instruction pamphlet in many languages that explains "the right way to apply eyeliner for your eye shape."

The current price of $13 ($15.99 minus 15%) comes to $3.25 per brush.

title: Gentle on my face; helps produce a good lather; loop for hanging is a nice touch
text:
There are two small face sponges in this package and each one has two sides. Unfortunately, the quality of these sponges is inconsistent. What I mean by this is that one sponge is firmer than the other one because there are air holes in the blue one and none in the yellow one. 

Both sides are soft with the colored side being a bit exfoliating.These sponges also generate a good lather, which I like very much. In addition, it has a loop for hanging.

The current price of $5.94 ($6.99 minus 15%) is pricey for this duo as it comes to $2.97 per sponge.

title: Mildly exfoliating; helps produce good lather; hand elastic is a plus
text:
This sponge has two sides. One side is mildly exfoliating and the other is soft. I love that there is a soft side and also love having the ability to insert my hand behind the elastic so that I have a good grip on the sponge. Note that I have to move the elastic to the opposing side when I want to use the soft side. If I do not move it, the elastic gets in the way of the sponge and the hold is compromised because the elastic will not be on the side I need to grasp.

This sponge also generates a good lather, which I like very much. In addition, it has a loop for hanging.

The current price of $5.94 ($6.99 minus 15%) is pricey for this sponge.

title: Remarkably excellent tweezer set; tweezers are perfectly aligned & hefty; case is thick
text:
This tweezer set is excellent. The case and the tweezers are hefty. In addition to a pair of scissors, which cut well, and an eyebrow/mascara wand, there are also four different types of tweezers in the case. They are:

- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they work perfectly. The ends are perfectly aligned so that I can easily pull any wayward hairs with any of these four implements. The white case feels substantial and has a snap closure. There is a spot for every implement (all 6) in the set.

The current price of $7.76 ($8.17 minus 5%) is a steal for this ensemble. In addition to the quality feel and functionality of this set, I also LOVE the muti-colors of the tweezers.

title: Good, hefty brush with long handle with great grip & two brush sides
text:
I tried several brushes over the last several months and loved the [[ASIN:B08HR2GBHC KOZIS Wooden Bath Brush]] the best until I got this one. This is now my favorite brush.

The brush head on both sides is ample for good coverage and gentle. The lighter bristles are soft and the darker ones on the opposite side are stiffer. The brush is hefty and is one solid piece, which is fabulous as the head cannot fall off the handle like some other brushes I tried previously.  The handle of this back brush has grips on it which provides me with a great hold. It also has a rope loop to hang up in the shower. 

Overall, I love this brush; it is now my favorite back brush with the KOZIS one a close second. The current price of $9.99 is  reasonable for a two-sided wooden brush.

title: Excellent for applying creams, mask products, etc.; I love the finger indentation
text:
I have really been getting into silicone spatulas/brush sets for applying face creams, bacitracin on a scar, etc. There are two large wands in this package. They are single-sided and have a flat spatula end for applying creams or gels. The opposite side has a ribbed end that is good for washing my face with soap and water or also for applying mask products. However, if the large soft nubs are used, there is more cleaning involved to wash off the mask product. What I do love is that the opposite side of the nibbed head has a small indentation (see photo) for my finger. I can use this to press against my skin when washing my face using this or applying a product.

I love everything about these wands except I would have preferred if the arm was a bit stiffer to make it easier to work with and allow me to apply more pressure when using the spatula end.

Overall, this set is excellent and about 7 inches long. It is soft on my skin, pliable, and long enough to hold on to.

The current price of $6.99 comes to a very reasonably priced $3.50 per wand.

title: This is not just for men; it’s a wonderful facial moisturizer for women too
text:
I never listen to marketer's that something is for a man. I've used men's products on and off for years. Therefore, I just had to try this.

This facial moisturizer is wonderful. The cream is of medium thickness, it goes on my face and neck easily, and it absorbs rapidly leaving my skin fully hydrated. I absolutely love this cream. It is almost scentless and does not have any aromas (like sandalwood, musk) that is normally associated with a man's fragrance.

The current price of $27 ($30 minus 10%) is very reasonable for this 4.5 fluid ounce jar.

title: Love the pastel colors of this sponge set; I don ot care for the plastic holder
text:
This is a lovely set of three Easter pastel-colored blending sponges with one CHEAP PLASTIC holder. I love the hourglass sponges; however, I do not like the plastic holder at all. I would have preferred a metal one. 

All the sponges have an hourglass design. These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $5.99 this is a slightly pricey $2 per sponge if I consider the holder a freebie.

title: Excellent make-up brushes; beveled handle sprovide a good grip; handle color differs
text:
There are 8 brushes in total and a gold sparkly clear pouch. The geometric shape of the handles provide a good surface area for gripping each brush during application. The bristles are soft and they do not fall out of the brush. They feel great against my skin.

Based on the Amazon site, I expected the handles to be blue but the ones I received are various colors depending on the light. However, the bristles are the wonderful rainbow color that is pictured.

The brushes in the set are:
- powder brush
- angled contour/sculpting brush
- blush brush
- nasal shadow brush
- eyeshadow brush
- blending brush
- eyeliner brush - I use this as a lip brush
- concealer brush

The current price of $12.99 comes to $1.62 per brush which I consider reasonable. Besides the beveled handles, the rainbow color of the brush heads is immensely attractive to me. Couple the looks with the functionality and this is a great set.

title: Love the unique look of this comb but works no better for me; awkward to hold
text:
This comb gets 10 stars for  its unique look, color, and stand-upright design. It does work well on wet hair. It also combs fine on dry. I have short to medium fine curly hair and it works. However, I find holding this comb very awkward. It is not as comfortable as a regular comb. If I hold it with one finger around the curl in the comb, it works better. Also, at the current price of $14.44 ($16.99 minus 15%), this comb is overpriced.

In summary, I love the artisticness of this comb and it is functional art. I also love that it stands up on its own. What I do not like is that it is a bit awkward to use and anything over $10 for this is highly overpriced.

title: Tweezers are perfectly aligned; love the addition of the scissors
text:
This  tweezer set is very good for the price. There are four different types of tweezers in the case and one small scissor. The tweezers are:

- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they worked well. The ends are perfectly aligned so that I can easily pull any wayward hairs with any of these four implements. The scissor is a bonus and is sharp and cuts well for small jobs. The pale blue case is nice enough and holds all the implements. 

The current price of $5.99 ($7.99 minus $2) is reasonable for this tweezer set.

title: Beautiful & functional brush; great coverage and no bristle shedding
text:
This is an impressive and beautiful foundation brush. It works exceptionally well for dusting translucent powder over the face or applying a bronzer. The brush feels good in my hands, the bristles do not shed, and the head provides great coverage. It is also soft against my skin. I can even use it to apply blush as long as I want wide coverage.

The current price of $5.94 ($6.99 minus 15%) is reasonable for this brush.

title: Attractive barrettes; more of an accent piece since each one holds little hair
text:
These barrettes are really pretty. All four are exactly the same. They open easily by pressing the metal piece at the base on the underside of the clip which is typical of most barrettes like these.  Each one holds a small and thin about one inch section of hair but not much more.

The current price of $8.99 for four comes to a pricey $2.25 per clip.

title: Unique brush that works well with both liquid & powder foundation; smudges show up on casing
text:
I already own this brush in black from NIZJX Store (Amazon item # B08SKJQ5CC) and I love it. It works the same except it is a different color and has the iron-hole marks on the faceplate that this blue one does not have.

I love unique items and this is certainly a uniquely designed brush in the shape of a tiny iron. It works well on both liquid and powder foundation. Due to the closeness of the very soft bristles, liquid foundation spreads evenly. What I really like this for, however, is to use the pointed end with powder blush and work from the jawbone down toward the face to highlight the cheeks with a darker shade of blush. The handle makes this easy to control during application.

Note that because the casing on this brush is a beautiful shiny blue, every smudge is visible. Even wiping it down with a cloth does not get it back to its pristine condition. 

In summary, this is a niche brush that is also a conversation piece. It is definitely not going to be for everyone but I personally like the quirkiness and functionality of this little treasure. The current price of $4.99 is a little on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Sheds; generates static; curve of brush molds to head; pricey
text:
At the current price of $10.99 this brush is about $7 or $8 more than it should be priced in my opinion.

I do love the curve of the brush and how it molds to my head. I also love the purple color. Unfortunately, the brush sheds a lot (see the black lines in my two photos). Also, the bristles are not even; it almost looks like a used brush. In addition, my hair was full of static after using this.

In summary, this brush is functional but the negatives coupled with the high price has me recommending to look elsewhere.

title: Very nice scrunchies; looks good on; stays in well; included hair ties nothing special
text:
There are three very large and very functional scrunchies in this package along with some hair ties. I love the black and white design as they go with almost any outfit and dress up one's hair. They also stay put in the hair.

The tiny ponytail holders are okay but nothing special. I actually feel they cheapen the set. However, they can be used underneath the scrunchies.

At the current price of $9.99 this comes to $3.33 per scrunchie if not counting those included hair ties.

title: Excellent hefty back brush with soft bristles & long handle; versatile
text:
I tried several brushes over the last several months and love this brush due to the soft, dense bristles and how this can be converted into a handheld scrubber.

The brush head side is ample for good coverage. The bristles are super soft and dense. The brush is hefty and the back handle is long enough for a good reach. There is also a rope loop on the handle for hanging.

If I want to use this as a face or body brush, all I have to do is detach the handle. It is so easy to slide on and off, yet stays snugly together when needed. In addition, the angle of the piece on the brush head allows me to hold this comfortably in my hands.

Overall, I love this duo. The current price of $18.89 ($19.99 minus 5%) is a bit pricey for this, however.

title: Love the bath sponges; back brush is okay but would have liked a longer handle
text:
There are two mesh bath sponges and two mesh back cleaners with one adhesive hook with a tiny metal prong for hanging.

I love the mesh puffs as that is my goto shower "sponge." They lather very well and the airy mesh allows copious suds to be produced in the shower. The back loofahs are okay except that I would have preferred a long handle on those. I had several other back brushes like these and they usually only last me two months because the loofah starts to unravel a bit.

Overall, this is a nice set and the current price of $10.19 ($11.99 minus 15%) is a very reasonable $2.55 per item not counting the adhesive hook.

title: These clips are delightful; I love the design, colors, and functionality
text:
There are four super attractive and colorful butterfly clips in this set. These are not only gorgeous but since they are small, they  work well in my short to medium-length curly hair. They are easy to open and close and do hold my hair. I used them in the back of my head.

At the current price of $12.99, this comes to a pricey $3.25 per clip. However, because I love these so much, I did not take off any stars for the high price as they are really super nice with my favorite being the greenish pink one.

title: Would be a great set if the brush didn’t smell of burnt rubber
text:
At the current price of $14.99, this brush set comes with a large boar/nylon bristle brush with wooden handle and decorative floral design on back, a plastic comb,  and a plastic with metal tines brush rake for cleaning the hair from the brush.

This brush passed through my hair easily. The comb is a wide tooth plastic comb that is good for detangling hair in the shower. The rake is useless; I have yet to find one that works. What I absolutely hate is the smell of the brush. It STINKS of BURNT RUBBER. It is probably the finish on the handle, but the smell is extremely offensive to me. This is not a brush I will use, unfortunately due to the terrible smell. 

I aired out this set for hours and the smell did not wane.

title: Nice, lightweight clips; they have a mild hold; love the colors
text:
I really like these clips even though they are delicate. The neutral colors are nice and one barrette was included in the package which matches the darker marbleized clip.  I have short to medium fine curly hair and these clips held up my hair in the back.

The current price of $11.99 for four pieces, comes to a slightly pricey $3 per item. Note that nowhere on the Amazon site does it say a barrette would be included. Therefore, I have no idea if this was part of the package or just thrown in at the last minute. If only the clips are included, the price per item is a very pricey $4 per clip. At this price, I would pass on these clips because they are not worth that much.

title: Pretty clips in three interesting patterns; minor clip-face imperfections
text:
These clips stay put in my hair and hold well. They are easy to open with one hand. There are also extra teeth (see photo)on the inside to grip my hair. Except for the leopard-like pattern, the other patterns are not easily matched with outfits.  Also, if one looks at the clips real close, there are minor imperfections in the glue that holds the pattern on; at least that is what I think it is (see close-up photo of polka-dot one.)

The current price of $9.99 comes to an expensive $3.33 per clip.

title: Nice selection of 8 BIG scrunchies; material can be slippery on hair; long hair required
text:
There are seven purple-colored scrunchies and one white scrunchie. The material feels like polyester, so it is a bit slick which increases the chance these will slip out of the hair. I have medium length hair in the back and these would not stay in my hair because they are very large and also slippery. The main reason is because these are large scrunchies and are really for long ponytails.

I do feel these are really attractive and I do love the large size. If the bride and bridesmaids all have long hair, then these are a decent option. The current price of $14.99 comes to a slightly pricey $1.87 each.

title: Very large paddle brush; feels great in my hands
text:
This brush is larger than I expected. It is really a nice paddle brush with an attractively designed handle. The bristles easily pass through my fine short to medium-length curly hair. I also love how the handle feels in my hand.

The current price of $10.39 ($15.99 minus 35%) is competitively priced for this. This is really a nice lightweight paddle brush that works well.

title: Medium-sized lightweight paddle brush; I love the rainbow colors
text:
I am attracted to this brush like a hummingbird is to a flower because I absolutely love the rainbow colors. This brush is smaller than I expected and is what I would consider medium-sized for a paddle brush. The bristles easily pass through my fine short to medium-length curly hair. I also love how the handle feels in my hand.

The current price of $10.99 ($15.99 minus $5) is a little pricey for this; however, the design on the front and back is beautiful to me.

title: Excellent paddle & detangling brushes; easy to hold; non-slip grip; combs good too
text:
This is a four-piece set that includes a paddle brush, detangling brush, a teasing comb, and regular wide-tooth comb.  The pink color is definitely a girl's color. It is the least favorite of mine compared to the purple and teal colors.

The paddle brush is excellent. It has a medium head that is large enough for most needs. The detangling brush is great too and it has rubbery bristles.
