Both brushes are excellent for dry or wet hair brushing. The handles have a nice feel to them and provide me with a non-slip grip. Both brushes passed through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily.

The comb is a teasing comb that is best used to tease the hair. It was not really good for combing my dry hair but okay on wet. The long point helps position curls when spraying one's hair in place. The other wide-tooth comb passes through my hair easily. However, I am not a comb person, so these combs will not get used unless I use them to detangle in the shower.

Overall, this is a really nice set. I can take or leave the combs. The paddle brush is the best item followed by the detangling brush. I just love the feel of these brushes in my hands. The current price of $12.99 is slightly pricey for this set as it comes to $3.25 per item.

title: Excellent paddle & detangling brushes; easy to hold; non-slip grip; combs good too
text:
This is a four-piece set that includes a paddle brush, detangling brush, a teasing comb, and regular wide-tooth comb.  I love the teal color as it is one of my favorite colors right next to purple.

The paddle brush is excellent. It has a medium head that is large enough for most needs. The detangling brush is great too and it has rubbery bristles. Both brushes are excellent for dry or wet hair brushing. The handles have a nice feel to them and provide me with a non-slip grip. Both brushes passed through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily.

The comb is a teasing comb that is best used to tease the hair. It was not really good for combing my dry hair but okay on wet. The long point helps position curls when spraying one's hair in place. The other wide-tooth comb passes through my hair easily. However, I am not a comb person, so these combs will not get used unless I use them to detangle in the shower.

Overall, this is a really nice set. I can take or leave the combs. The paddle brush is the best item followed by the detangling brush. I just love the feel of these brushes in my hands. The current price of $10.99 is reasonably priced for this set as it comes to $2.75 per item.

title: Excellent paddle & detangling brushes; easy to hold; non-slip grip; combs good too
text:
This is a four-piece set that includes a paddle brush, detangling brush, a teasing comb, and regular wide-tooth comb. I love the purple color as it matches my bathroom.

The paddle brush is excellent. It has a medium head that is large enough for most needs. The detangling brush is great too and it has rubbery bristles. Both brushes are excellent for dry or wet hair brushing. The handles have a nice feel to them and provide me with a non-slip grip. Both brushes passed through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily.

Overall, this is a really nice set. I can take or leave the combs. The paddle brush is the best item followed by the detangling brush. I just love the feel of these brushes in my hands. The current price of $10.99 is reasonably priced for this set as it comes to $2.75 per item.

title: Attractive clips of assorted styles and sizes; holds a lot of hair and grips relatively well
text:
There are six assorted hair clips in this package. Two are medium sized and have the marbleized look, then there are two irresdecent clips -- one in gold and one in red. The remaining two claw clips are large and typical. I love all the clips but particularly love the marbleized colored one and the iridescent red one. 

These clips are very functional for those with thick long hair. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I have short to medium fine curly hair and used this on the longest part of my hair and they all held well.

The current price of $14.59 is on the high side of competitively priced as it comes to $2.43 per clip.

title: Excellent large buff puffs that create copious suds; I love them
text: Mesh buff puffs are the only thing I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. These are just like the large ones I buy at Walmart for $2 each. Since there are two black and two white, the colors go with anything. The current price of $7.88 is also competitively priced as it comes to $1.97 each puff.

title: Excellent flat iron; plates come together throughout; heats quickly; easy to use
text:
I have tried a lot of flat irons and it is not often that I am impressed. However, this one impresses me because it works as it should.

This flat iron comes with a pink "dust" pouch, one glove, and instructions. The gloves should not be used to touch the hot plate; it is only to be used to protect one's fingers in case of accidental contact with the plates.

The controls are on the outside of the iron, so they are easy to access. Most irons have the controls between the blades which is very cumbersome to access without burning one's fingers. Also, these controls are located far enough away from where I put my fingers that there are no accidental changes happening to the temperature during operation.

To turn the unit on or off, I just held down the power button for a couple of seconds. To go to the next temperature, I just pressed the + (plus) on the left or - (minus) on the right. This flat iron heats rapidly. The temperature selections available go from 270 to 450. Note the manual does not mention 270; the manual starts at 280. I used it at 270 degrees because I have fine hair. The instructions say 280 to 330 is for fine, thin hair; 330 to 380 for wavy, medium-textured hair; and 380 to 450 for thick, coarse hair. Because the plates come together fully, I was able to straighten my hair quickly and there was no frizz after I was done.

The cord swivels 360 degrees which prevents it from getting tangled. For storage, the blades also lock slightly in place with the lock that is at the edge of the handle by the base of the cord.

In summary, this is a gorgeous iron. I love how the "blades" come together when squeezed shut and there is no space in-between like some other irons I tried. Also, the current price of $30.40 ($32.40 minus $2) is reasonable for this. The temperature up and down buttons are reversed in my opinion but I can get used to that.

title: Ultra moisturizing but I do not care for the angel food flavor
text:
There are 10 tubes of Chapstick in this package and they are all in the "angel food" flavor. It does not smell like angel food. I personally do not care for this flavor at all. However, I love how easily this glides on and how ultra-moisturizing it is. It actually lays down a thicker layer than their other Chapsticks. If I liked the flavor, this would have received 5 stars; however, since I do not, it gets 3 stars.

The current price of $15.83 comes to a slightly pricey $1.58 per tube.

title: Excellent brush set at a super reasonable price
text:
At the current price of $14.99 ($19.99 minus $5 coupon), this is a superb brush set. Included in this set are one large boar/nylon bristle brush with wooden handle, one travel boar/nylon bristle brush with wooden handle, one wooden comb, a brush head cover for the larger brush, one brush cleaner rake, and one spa headband for keeping one's hair back during make-up application.

The brushes glide through my fine curly short to medium-length hair. They are also easy to hold. The tiny brush is not as easy due to the short handle, but that is to be expected. That brush is perfect for travel or to leave in the car. The carry satchel covers the larger brush's head for traveling or storage. The comb works well but I am not a comb person. I love the design of the brush / comb combo as the etchings are very attractive. The spa headband also works well. The only item that is useless is the plastic rake.

The plastic rake is to be used to clean hair from the brush but I never could get these type rakes to work well. It is cheap and a tiny piece of useless plastic in my opinion. Nevertheless, the other items make this a worthwhile purchase.

title: Attractive and functional basic manicure kit at a reasonable price
text:
At the current price of $7.39, this manicure kit is a perfect basic kit. It has two nail clippers, a scissor, file, tweezer, etc. The only item I do not use is the ear wax cleaner. The scissor cuts well and both nail clippers do too. The tweezer is aligned correctly and works on removing hairs with precision. I also love the blue case. It feels great in my hands, has a good clasp and holds all the tools effectively for easy retrieval.

This is a basic kit and it is 5 stars at this current price point.

title: Love the color of the brush and its detangling ability, especially with wet hair
text:
I really love this brush. The brush is actually like eight combs strung together and I had to set the extra piece that comes with it to separate the tines. It was not easy to get the bar across the "combs" but eventually I managed. There are only two places the bar should be put and that is where the holes are on the back of the "brush." I put it on the lower holes.

Once this is assembled, it glides through the hair and detangles. It works well on dry hair but even better on wet hair. I love the hard tines as it is like getting a massage on the scalp. The handle provides a good grip as it has a non-slip silicone feel to it. Also, since the combs are separated, this brush can act as a vent brush for blow drying even though it is not of circular design. Hair can be removed easily since the tines are flat with no "ball" tip.

The only reason I rated this four stars is because the current price of $12.99 is a bit pricey for this.

title: Nice selection of 8 scrunchies; material can be slippery on hair
text: There are seven green-colored scrunchies and one white scrunchie. The material is like a satin, so it is a bit slick which increases the chance these will slip out of the hair. I have medium length hair in the back and they did slip out easily if I pulled on them. I do feel these are attractive but low-end. If the bride and bridesmaids all have long hair, then these are a decent option. The current price of $13.99 comes to a slightly pricey $1.75 each. For the quality of these scrunchies, I do not feel these should be priced more than $1.25 each.

title: Nice set of 7 elegant scrunchies; love the fabric pattern
text: There are six black scrunchies and one white one. I really like the fabric pattern and the look of these holders. I have medium length hair in the back and they held. I do feel these are elegant and super attractive. If the bride and bridesmaids all have long hair, then these are a good option. The current price of $10.99 is $1.57 each, which is the highest I recommend paying for these.

title: Exquisite design & craftsmanship for comb, brush, & travel bag but boar bristles rough
text: This set is absolutely exquisite in design and craftsmanship. I love the light wooden comb and the design on the brush. I also love the green suede bag this comes in. Unfortunately, the boar bristles are really rough and strong. I feel like I'm brushing my hair with a wire pipe brush because of this. It just does not work with my fine hair. If there was more "softness" to the brush, I would have rated this 4 or 5 stars. The $120 price tag is a bit much for this as well.

title: Good nylon/boar bristle brush; comb for teasing
text:
This is a brush comb combo. The brush comes with a burlap bag to cover the head. The paddle brush is good. It has a large handle that is easy to grip. It passed through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily. Even though I can see the glue lines and other imperfections on the brush face, but that does not take away from the function.

The comb is a teasing comb that is best used to tease the hair. It was not really good for combing my dry hair but is okay on wet hair. The long point helps position curls when spraying one's hair in place.

In summary, I personally do not care for the comb. By far the best item is the handheld brush as it works very well. I can overlook the glue lines on the brush head. I do love the stain color of the handle. The current price of $14.39 is about the right cost for this ensemble.

title: Does brighten but I’m not crazy about the purple color or the subtle aroma
text: I have very brassy looking short to medium fine curly hair. This shampoo lathers and cleans well. After my hair dried, it did look more alive and less dull, so I would say it brightens. However, I do not care at all for the purple color or the subtle aroma. Purple is my favorite color but not in shampoo. The color changes to white when sudsing up so it does not get on my tub. However, for those who do not mind the color or the scent, the current price of $22 is competitively priced for this because it is like a salon product.

title: A bit greasy but moisturizing; subtle flavor; cute container
text:
I love the cute container this lip balm comes in. It is easy to apply with my fingers but I do find it greasy. Nevertheless, it does moisturize. Note that the ingredients are listed in Spanish on the tin.

Unfortunately, I do not like this enough to re-order simply because it is too greasy for my lips. I do like the slim profile container and the .85 ounces of product is  more than double a regular ChapStick tube, so the current price of $7.18 is justified.

title: Hair brush is good; small brush is okay; quality is commensurate with low price
text:
There are two brushes in this set; one handheld and the other a palm brush. There are also two brush covers included.

I like the handheld brush. It glides easily through my short to medium fine curly hair and feels great in my hands. The quality is average in that I can see the glue lines and other imperfections on the brush face but that does not take away from the function.

I personally do not care for the palm brush. The rope that goes around the hand is way too loose so it makes the brush hard to hold. Also, the brush bristles itself are a bit disheveled. Nevertheless, it does brush but not as great as the regular one.

The drawstring jute pouches are a nice touch except one pouch had loose strings as can be seen in the photo.

The current price of $14.39 is commensurate with the quality of this ensemble. By far the best item is the handheld brush as it works very well.

title: Excellent slant-tip tweezers with a bit of heft to them; a bit overpriced
text:
These slant-tip tweezers are excellent. They are solidly built and are heavier than any other tweezers I ever tried. Their precision is excellent as well as they come tightly together. I was able to easily pull eyebrow, chin, and lip hairs with these. Extraction of very fine hairs is a bit more difficult because the business end has thick tips. I would have preferred a thinner edge on these tweezers.

Also, the current price of $16.99 ($19.99 minus $3 coupon) is a bit pricey for these. I recently ordered the PAFASON Eyebrow Tweezers Set (Amazon Item # B08RX9FJBD) and that set is just as functional, has more tools, and sells for $7.99. Of course the tweezers in that set are lightweight but the tool does not have to have heft to be functional. Nevertheless, this is an excellent slant-tip tweezer.

title: Beautiful tiara for very young girl; very snug
text:
This is a gorgeous costume jewelry-type tiara. It is extremely snug, however. This is obviously for a young girl or even a life-sized doll. Because it is so tight, the child will have to have a small head. I can see this being used for a dance recital, wedding, flower girl, Halloween costume, etc.

The current price of $9.66 is competitively priced for this.

title: Excellent paddle brush w/detangler; easy to hold; glides thru my hair; combs okay
text:
This is a two brush and two comb combo. The paddle brush is excellent. It is large and has a curvaceous handle that is easy to grip. It passed through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily. The detangler also works well, particularly on wet hair.

The fine comb is a teasing comb that is best used to tease the hair. It was not really good for combing my dry hair but okay on wet. The long point helps position curls when spraying one's hair in place. The other comb is okay but best used for detangling on wet hair. I personally do not care for combs, so it is the brushes I love.

Overall, this is a nice set. I can take or leave the combs. The paddle brush is the best item followed by the brush detangler. The current price of $7.99 is super reasonable for this set because their two-piece set which has half these items (Amazon Item # B08NWSXG5T) is actually priced at $12.99.

title: Excellent paddle brush; easy to hold; glides thru my hair; comb for teasing
text:
This is a brush comb combo. The paddle brush is excellent. It is large and has a curvaceous handle that is easy to grip. It passed through my short-to-medium fine curly hair easily.

The comb is a teasing comb that is best used to tease the hair. It was not really good for combing my dry hair but okay on wet. The long point helps position curls when spraying one's hair in place.

Overall, this is a nice set. I can take or leave the comb as the paddle brush is the best item. The current price of $12.99 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Sizing is perfect for short hair; awkward positioning of controls; plates closes only at tip
text:
This 1/3" straightener has the profile of a penguin nose to me. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this flat iron works on my length hair. It is definitely designed for short hair, even shorter hair than mine.

I used this on my dry hair. I then set this to about 325 degrees. The degrees go from 122 to 450 Fahrenheit and can be increased or decreased in one degree increments. The iron did an okay job and that is because only the tip of the iron closes tight enough. About two thirds of the rest of the iron does not close tight enough to grip my hair tightly. Below are my likes and dislikes.

LIKES
- Wide range of temperature control
- The iron locks in place for storage
- This is perfect for short hair
- The cord has a 360 degree swivel
- The iron heats up rapidly

DISLIKES
- Only one third of the iron comes tightly together at the tip.

- The increase and decrease temperature buttons are reversed. To decrease the temperature, I press the right control inside the iron and to increase it I press the left control.

- Turning the iron on and operating the controls requires getting one's fingers between the iron.

Overall, this iron is workable and does straighten my hair but it requires extra work on my part due to not being able to use the full heating plate successfully. The current price of $25.99 is competitively priced for this no-frills iron. If the heating plate came together the full length and the up and down temperature controls were reversed so that they are in the typical position, then this would have received 5 stars from me.

title: Nice selection of men’s soaps for the man or woman in your life
text:
I received four bars of men's soap on a rope. It is a really nice selection of soap and nice sized bars. They are geared more to men but a woman can use these too. The fragrance is subtle and they are all similar in scent. 

The current price of $15.29 ($16.99 minus 10%) for four bars is a reasonably  priced $3.82 per bar.

title: A bit like tying up my hair with telephone cord; somewhat tangling
text:
These spiral hair ties are gorgeous and perfect for making small pony tails or tying up one's hair. Unfortunately, they do not slip out of my hair easily and feel like I am tying my hair up with a telephone cord.  I tried the Goomee brand spirals, Amazon Item # B08HQYH3H9, and they are not only half the price but do not tangle my hair and are easily removed.

The current price of these ties is $15.99 which coms to an expensive $1.33 per spiral.

title: Decent nail clipper set considering the cheap price
text:
This is a decent nail clipper set. At the current price of $6.29, it is an excellent deal. However, it is not a high-end set but it works. The nail clippers are sharp, the scissors cut, and the tweezer works well. All the tools are functional.

The negatives are that the case smells and the lower item tools easily fall out of the case since the slots are wider than the tool. However, at this low price, one cannot expect perfection. If the price were over $10, this would have received between 3 and 4 stars from me. My rating is commensurate with the quality of the tools I expect at this price point. They work but I would not buy this for a manicurist.

title: Decent holders that can be hooked on keychain or bag
text:
These chapstick holders are decent and colorful. There are six holders with a key ring attached to each one and a carabiner if there is a desire to hook this on a purse or someplace else. The hole was large enough to fit my wider EOS lip balm stick. This works well and the lip balm stays secure.

The current price of $5.98 comes to $1 per holder.

title: Am not crazy about the fragrance, color of suds, or price but this is cleansing
text:
I am not crazy about the fragrance, color of the suds, or the price tag for a large 7 ounce bar of soap. However, this is cleansing but is not spectacular enough for me to ever order this again.

The current price of $24 for this bar of soap is insane in my opinion. I would not expect to pay more than $7 for this.

title: High-quality boar bristle medium brush; handle relatively easy to grip but minimal leverage
text:
This is definitely a high quality boar bristle brush. It is a medium sized brush with a small handle.  This brush feels great in my hands. Because it is smaller than a regular sized brush, it is a little awkward to hold but that is to be expected. I consider this more of a travel brush. It is neither large nor purse quality. In fact, I keep this in my car when I need to brush out my hair after a convertible ride. It does not get tacky and melt like a previous brush I use to keep in my glove box.  I use this on my short to medium length fine curly hair and it goes through my hair easily as long as it is not too tangled. 

The current price of $34.15 ($35.95 minus 5%) is very expensive for this  brush and is the only reason I took off one star.

title: Provides nice blush & foundation coverage; bristles do not fall out; handle slippery
text:
I really like this brush. It comes with its own snap-closure plastic case to keep the brush from smudging the rest of the products in my make-up case.  The brush provides good blush and powder foundation coverage. I also love that the bristles do not fall out. The only negative is that the plastic handle is slippery in my hands that makes it a tad tricky to maintain my grip. Other than this, this brush is lovely.

The current price of $3.89 is excellent for this brush.

title: Very nice bag; beautiful colors; spacious; zippers work well
text:
This bag is very attractive and the colors of black, purple, and teal go well together. The central compartment is spacious, like a small round clutch. This can be used as a purse, make-up bag, or toiletry bag. If used as a purse, I can get a wallet, phone, tissues, chapstick, and other small items in this bag. The central compartment has one small folder pocket on one side and a small zippered pocket on the other. The exterior of the bag has one small purple pocket that can hold some change or pencils or a chapstick but nothing big. All the zippers glide easily. The bag also sits upright on its own if opened wide and stretched out.  Note that there is a one inch space on either side of the zipper for the central compartment. Those who throw loose change in their bag might wind up losing it through those holes. I do no such thing, so this does not bother me.

The current price of $19.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Leaves my hair hydrated but does relax my curls a little bit
text:
This has a nice aroma with a hint of orange to it. I used a generous amount on my short to medium fine curly hair, worked it through, and then rinsed it out. It lathers very well. I let my hair dry naturally and it dried soft and was hydrated but my curls were relaxed a little bit after using this.

The current price of $8.95 is competitively priced for this.

title: Eight double-banded headbands; knot on top; not for me
text:
The tie-dye colors and design look great in the package. However, all eight headbands in this package double banded which means they come to a knot on top. Those type headbands do not fit me well, nor do they look good on me.

I personally prefer single band headbands over double. The double bands create a thinner line across the forehead than the single banded ones. The colors are great and I would have rated these 5 stars if they were a single band. Unfortunately, I'm not crazy about a "knot" in the center of my forehead.

The current price of $13.59  comes to a reasonable $1.70 per band. These are definitely pretty and if a bump in the middle is what one is looking for, then these fit the bill.

title: Excellent brush with perfect handle length for ease of use; very pricey
text:
This brush is excellent. It is well-made and the bristles are not too hard nor too soft. They are just right for dry brushing. The length of the handle also makes this easy to use. It is best to dry brush before a shower. Of course, if one has skin issues like psoriasis or eczema, dry brushing is not recommended since that can cause infection.

My only complaint is that the price is a very expensive $38.95. If it were not for the price, this would have received 5 stars from me.  I assume this can be used for washing as well, although this was not designed for that.

title: Sturdy, well-made claw clips; tiny barrettes hold little hair
text:
The claw clips are gorgeous, medium size, and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair well. They also come with two tiny barrettes which act more as an accent piece than anything else. The barrettes hold very little hair. I do love, however, that they match the claw clips.

At the current price of $4.48 it comes to an extremely reasonable $1.12 per clip if dividing by the four clips. The quality is excellent and they are super attractive.

title: Absolutely excellent silicone brush; has amultitude of uses
text:
I never in my wildest dreams thought I would love a brush like this nor did I feel this would hold up to my high standards. However, this is fantastic. The brush is heavy and feels great in my hands. There are two sides -- short thin nubs and longer and thicker ones on the other side. There is also a hanging loop but one either needs a small hook to go through the hole or needs to attach a cord.

USES
- As a cleaning brush for dishes

- Use with soap and water to clean under one's fingernails. I did this and it was great.

- Use as a pet hair pick-up brush by rubbing it across a surface the pets lay on. I tried this on one of the pet beds I have and it picked up the hair. The only issue I had is removing the hair from the brush. I had to rinse it out.

- As a horse curry comb for grooming and getting dirt out of a horse's coat.

- As a massager for the scalp or hands.

- As a shampoo brush; this only works well with short hair.

- As a brush to suds up the pets when giving them a bath.

- As a foot scrubber. I used this on the heels of my feet and it felt wonderful.

I mostly use the short nubbed side as it is gentler on my skin, hands, and feet.

In summary, this brush is well made, comes in some great colors, but the current price of $8.99 is several dollars more than can be purchased elsewhere on Amazon. As of this writing, Amazon's item # B08T1VM5L1 is the same item and sells for $4.79 ($5.99 minus 20%). The price is the only reason I rated this 4 instead of 5 stars. Also, that one comes with its own soft cinch-tie carry bag and this one comes with a stick-on hook as shown in my photo.

title: 12 individually wrapped bath bombs; nice scent; color does not stick
text: [[VIDEOID:b48b5b938d9ac44aa6886bfc6c8f43d7]] There are 12 individually wrapped bath bombs in this set. They all have a similar fragrance to me. They dissolve well and suds up like they are supposed to. They are also moisturizing. I bathed my hands using one of these and my hands felt great afterward.  At the current price of $25.99 it comes to $2.17 per bath bomb which is competitively priced.

title: Marginal quality scrunchies; satin ones come terribly wrinkled
text:
These scrunchies come in one flat compressed package. I had to be careful not to cut the scrunchies when opening the airless bag. Inside are 12 hair ties and one plastic bag as shown in my photo. The velvet hair ties are nice and look decent. The satin ones look terrible because they are incredibly wrinkled. There are six of each kind.

These ponytail holders are not plush or substantial like some others I tried before. They hold hair well, particularly the velvet ones; however, they are not high end.

The current price of $9.99 comes to $.83 cents per band which I actually feel is a bit pricey for these due to the quality. I do not feel these are worth more than $.50 cents per scrunchie--particularly the satin ones which look horrible.

title: Three double banded and two single band headbands; not for me
text:
The colors and design look great in the package. However, there are five headbands in this package and three of them are double banded (see photo) and two are a single band.

I personally prefer single band headbands over double. The double bands do not look great on me and the cloth creates a thinner line across the forehead than the single banded ones. Unfortunately, the colors on the single banded ones in this package are not super attractive on me. These bands are just okay but they  are not really my preference as I'm not crazy about a "knot" in the center of my forehead.

Also, the current price of $12.99  comes to a slightly pricey $2.60 per band. These are definitely pretty and if a bump in the middle is what one is looking for, then these fit the bill.

title: Eight beautiful headbands; love the softness &designs
text:
These headbands are stylish and beautiful to me. I love how soft and comfortable they feel. Also, I can stretch them to have a wide or narrow girth. I wear my headbands over my ears and these look great on. I"m partial to the two light colored ones, the black floral one, and the red one; those four are my absolute favorites.

The current price of $11.19 ($13.99 minus 20%) comes to a reasonable $1.40 per band.

title: Quality hairbrush and comb set
text:
There are five items in this set - a boar/nylon bristle brush, a wooden comb, two clips, and a carry pouch to cover the head of the brush if traveling.

The brush glides easily through my short to medium fine curly hair. I also did not notice any shedding of the boar bristles. The comb also passes through easily but acts more like a detangler with the wide tooth gap. The clips are just okay; I don't really care for them. The pouch is well-made and is perfect for covering the brush head when traveling.

The current price of $9.99 ($12.99 minus $3) is a steal for this, in my opinion.

title: Two sturdy, well-made medium-sized clips in a presentable gift box
text:
There are two claw clips in the package. They are gorgeous, medium-sized, and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly but they would work better with longer hair. They also come in a super presentable blue gift box. 

At the current price of $12.99 it comes to a relatively reasonable $6.50 per clip. The quality of these clips is excellent and they are beautiful as well.

title: Lathers wells & leaves my hair clean but I can’t stand the medicinal smell
text:
This produces a good lather and leaves my hair and scalp feeling clean. Also, my curls were not relaxed after my hair dried. Nevertheless, the medicinal smell is too much for me that I will not be using this again. Therefore, I have no idea if this prevents hair loss. I feel it's a nice shampoo if it were not for the smell.

The current price of $28.99 for 14.11 ounces is a bit pricey.

title: Sturdy, well-made small clips in a presentable gift box BUT BUYER BEWARE
text:
These clips are gorgeous, small, and well-made. They grip my short to medium fine curly hair perfectly. They also come in a super presentable blue gift box. However, do realize that I am unclear what I should have received.

The Amazon site says two packs. Does this mean I was supposed to receive two clips or two packages of two clips. What I got were three claw clips in one box as shown in my photo. BUYER BEWARE - because the Amazon site is unclear, I am going to assume only two clips were supposed to be in this box.  At the current price of $12.99 it comes to a relatively reasonable $6.50 per clip assuming one only receives two clips. The quality of these clips is excellent which is why I still rated this 5 stars even though the Amazon site is unclear.

title: Ears are various widths apart depending on headband; these are super cute & soft
text:
BUYER BEWARE that the photos on the Amazon site differ in fabric design than the ones I received.

There are three super soft and incredibly cute headbands in this set. They also work well to keep my hair back when applying make-up or a mask product. There are only three issues I have with these. First, I love the pink one because that one has the ears in the right place. The yellow and blue ones have ears further apart so that they are not on the top of the head. Also, the yellow one is tighter than the other two and also has some stuffings coming out (see photo). Nevertheless, I consider these all minor issues as this does not take away from their functionality.

At the current price of $12.90, this comes to $4.30 per headband which is on the high side of competitively priced.  These are very nice but they are not perfect. I do love their softness and functionality; however, if I were looking for all the ears in the perfect place, then these will not fit the bill.

title: Wonderfully hydrating; fragrance is subtle
text: I applied this to my face and neck (avoiding my eye area) after my shower and woke up the next morning with my face incredibly hydrated. It also absorbs quickly and has a subtle aroma. I really love the results and the current price of $16 is reasonable as well.

title: Smells like detergent from yesteryear; cleans well but has lackluster lather
text: There is one bar of soap in this package.  It smells like a detergent soap my grandmother used to use and is not very enticing to me. It does clean well but the lather is lackluster. There is nothing special about this soap to me. Also, the current price of $8.99 is pricey for this.

title: The solid black with the pearl-type beads is just gorgeous
text:
I ordered the solid black that has pearl-type beads on them. It is just gorgeous and elegant. If this was thinner, it could double as a beautiful necklace.

I had to be careful putting this on because it is easy to get my hair caught when tying it in back. It is best if I flip my hair over first before typing this.

This looks stunning and goes with anything. It is the beads that makes this, however. I would not have rated it as high without those beads.

The current price of $14.99 is pricey but this looks hand crocheted even though it is not. I love this.

title: Nice back brush / back scratcher combo; brush head is removable
text:
The brush head is ample for good coverage and the bristles are of a decent roughness but not too rough. The back brush is a good weight and the arm allows me to reach easily behind my entire back. The fact that it is not in one solid piece means that the brush head can be removed. I had a bit of trouble removing the head because it was tightly seated. Nevertheless, once I got it loose, subsequent removals were easier. The head has a canvas handle so that the brush head can be used as a washing brush.

The included back scratcher is great. It is one solid bamboo piece and works well.

Overall, I like this back brush / back scratcher combo. The current price of $9.99 is reasonable for this set.

title: Gloves are perfectly sized; these are exfoliating; colors are a beautiful pastel
text:
There are a total of 24 gloves (12 pairs) in this set. Of the 12 pairs, there are 2 pairs of each color (yellow, green, purple, pink, blue, and orange). These gloves are appropriately sized and fit my large hands perfectly. They do stretch but I am unsure if they would fit a man's hand. In addition, the colors of these gloves are extremely enticing; I love color and this satisfies my need for a super colorful environment. Note, however, that the blue, purple, and orange ones pictured on the Amazon site are a bit darker than what I received. The colors I received are more pastel and I actually like them better. Of course, when wet the color saturation increases a bit.

These work and act like my other exfoliating gloves. They are also not too rough; just rough enough. These can be used in the shower with a bar of soap. They definitely exfoliate but the gloves themselves reduce the amount of suds created. I love a lot of suds, which is why a mesh body puff is my "go to" shower accessory. These gloves are an excellent buy at $11.29 as it comes to $.94 cents per pair or $.47 cents per single glove.

title: Nice, hydrating foot cream but very pricey
text: This food cream massages into my feet easily and absorbs rapidly. It leaves my feet very hydrated. I really like this. However, it is very expensive for such a small amount at the current price of $16 ($20 minus 20%). This is a five-star product at a three-star price.

title: Similar to a regular dish sponge except it feels like gel; hanging loop is a thread; too pricey
text:
This is mildly exfoliating until its fully wet. It's really just a sponge that feels almost similar to a regular Ocelo kitchen sponge. The only difference is that the consistency feels more rubbery or "gel-like." This holds a lot of water but it does not lather any better than a regular sponge. What I absolutely hate is the cheap thread going through the sponge that one can use to hang it. The thread is so cheap, that it reminds me of sewing thread and will definitely break easily.

The current price of $13.25 is outrageous for this sponge in my opinion. I personally do not like anything but the color. After having tried this, it will be repuprosed as a not-so-good kitchen sponge.

UPDATE 5/11/2021 - I threw this sponge out two days ago. I felt like I was washing with jelly. It has a disgusting feel to me that I just could not use this anymore. I tried using this as a dish sponge but I also could not stand it for that.

title: 36 tiny jars in 3 sizes; perfect to gift spice samples, lip balm, etc.
text:
These jars are small but are perfect to use as gifts for several spice samples, lip balm, and eyeshadow shimmer or as single serving pill containers, etc.

They are tiny - good for a serving of spice, etc. The main issue I have with these is that the caps unscrew easily, so they are not leakproof. There is a chance these might unscrewed in one's purse or pocket.  However, I tried other jars like this and they all operated and function the same way. It all comes down to price and the size desired. I personally prefer the 20g jars in this set the most.

title: Smells like active carbon & cleans well; lather lackluster
text:
There is one bar of soap in this package.  It smells as it should like active carbon which reminds me of the smell of a goldfish water filter I used to use years ago. The lather is okay but not great and it cleans well. The soap is relatively easy to hold as it is not too large or small of a bar. I cannot attest to any skin spot lightening because I do not have any that I know of.

The current price of $8.99 is pricey for this.

title: Relaxes my curls too much; not enough lather; fragrance okay
text: This shampoo is just okay. The lather is minimal and the fragrance is just okay. It smooths my hair too much. I have fine short to medium-curly hair and my curls were too relaxed after using this shampoo. This is not one I will order again.

title: Love the colors in this sponge set; sponge texture is dense; metal holder is great
text:
This is a lovely set of three sponges in Easter colors of yellow, pink, and orange. It also comes with a great metal sponge holder. The sponges are dense unlike most sponges like this on the market. As a result, make-up does not soak in as easily.

The one yellow sponge with a flat side is great for smooth applications. The  typical egg-shaped (orange) and the hour-glass (pink) sponges are good for blending or any large make-up application. The hour-glass one is easy to hold in the center.

These feel good in the hands, blend reasonably well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar in style to all of the others that I tried before this with the exception that the sponges are on the dense side instead of airy. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $9.90 it is a slightly pricey $2.48 per piece if I count the holder.

title: Works well as a versatile light razor / face scrubber brush
text:
This comes with a razor/cleansing brush combo wand, a USB charging cable, a cleaning brush, and a cinch closure cloth carry case.

I charged this for about one hour until the blue light went out. There are two nubbed ends on opposite sides. To use this as a facial cleansing brush, I just powered it on and applied soap and used either silicone side. There is an increase and decrease set of buttons but I did not detect any difference in intensity level when I pressed these.

To use the razor, I just pressed the lower button, unscrewed the cap, and then used to remove hair under my nose and chin. This worked well. I unscrewed the razor top to clean using the cleaning brush.

Overall, I think this is a nice combo unit. At the current price of $19.96, it is also reasonably priced. The only negative I see is that the intensity levels seem all the same to me.

title: Excellent applicators for masks, ointments, foundation, etc.
text:
I have been recently getting into applicators like this to apply ointments on a scar. There are two applicators in this package with a silicone spatula on one end and a brush on the other end. The silicone tip is great for smooth applications. The brush is soft and works well too but it does require more cleaning than the silicone tip. I love that the bristles do not fall out. 

Overall, this is a great set of two mask applicators. The current price of $8.54 ($8.99 minus 5%) is a pricey $4.27 each.

title: Toenail clippers defective but workable; rest of set is okay – 2.5 stars
text:
This set comes with a toenail clipper, a nail clipper, and an oblique or angled clipper. The cutting edge on all are good. However, the toenail clipper spring action arm shot out of the unit on first try and could have hit me in the eye. I tried to reseat the arm but it shot out again. The one arm on the clipper is not manufactured correctly; however, it can be used with only one arm as long as the arm is put toward the top as shown in my photo.  The nail files on the other clippers are also good.

In addition to the three nail clippers, there are also three other implements that I do not know how to use. One is supposed to lift an ingrown toenail.

At the current price of $15.19 ($15.99 minus 5%), this set is not worth the price due to the poor quality of the toenail clippers. If everything worked, this would be a nice basic set.

title: Hard dollar store brush; not worth the purchase; rips hair instead of detangles
text: This brush is terrible. The frame color (yellow) is nice but the tines in the brush are a hard plastic that just rips at my hair. It does not detangle well and feels like a cheap $.50 cent or $1 brush one picks up in the dollar store. The current price of $6.99 for this is outrageous. If the "bristles" were softer, then this could be used as a vent blow drying brush. In its current condition, I'd use it to de-fleece a thick haired dog and then throw it out.

title: Love the back brush but not the sponge pad; handle on brush is great
text:
This set comes with a loofah pad, a self-stick two prong hanging hook, and a loofah back brush. I love the back brush because it has a long handle. The loofah also expands when wet (see photo). Loofahs in general do not hold soap well, but as a back brush they are decent and exfoliating.

I do not like the thin sponge pad and I do not need to use the hook.

The current price of $15.99 is competitive for this set; however, I wish they would leave off that extra pad and charger cheaper because the pad is junk in my opinion.

title: Love the pink colors of this sponge set; I do not care for the plastic holder
text:
This is a lovely set of five Easter pink-colored blending sponges with one CHEAP PLASTIC holder. I love the sponges and even like the "T" engraving on each sponge. However, I do not like the plastic holder at all. I would have preferred a metal one. 

There are two sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $9.41 ($9.90 minus 5%) it is a slightly pricey $1.88 per sponge if I consider the holder a freebie.

title: Nice bath bombs; color does not adhere; only mildly fragrant
text:
This is an attractive and giftable set of 12 bath bombs. There are three different colors (4 green with a white stripe, 4 all white, and 4 yellow with a bacon stripe) wrapped in plastic wrap. They are made with essential oils but all 12 bath bombs smell the same to me.

I tried the green bomb in my foot bath. The fragrance of this and each of the others is very subtle but nice. I used hot to tepid water and suds were created in the foot bath and the bomb fizzed. It eventually dissolved in the water as I bathed my feet. I felt clean and liked the scent but wished the scent was stronger and that each color had their own scent.

What I do love is that the color of the bomb does not turn my nails and feet that green color. Also, my foot bath did not have a color ring around it like another high-end bath bomb I tried previously. Insofar as "performance," these bombs are good. However, for the current price of $13.99, these are an excellent deal as they come to $1.17 per serving.

title: Strips my hair; is not conditioning; lathers exceptionally well – 2.5 stars
text:
I never heard of a shampoo bar. This lathers exceptionally well and I found that surprising. However, it strips my hair of everything and it does not condition at all. I am also not crazy about the scent--the aroma is not pretty but not offensive either.

The current price of $15.89 for this bar is also outrageously expensive. I personally prefer liquid shampoo and conditioner; it's a better deal and better results. Now if one could shower with this as well as shampoo their hair, this might have a purpose when traveling.

title: I got this as a wash brush and not a dry brush
text:
When I ordered this I did not realize this was a dry brush. However, it can be used as a wash brush, which is how I prefer to use this. If using this as a wash brush, it is important to dry this as this brush will crack over time due to the moisture.

It is a very nice brush and is ergonomically designed. I love the curved handle. I was going to use this for my back but it is best for the feet due to the short and curved handle. 

For those who are using this as a dry brush, the bamboo bristles will work to slough off dead skin cells. The brush should then be washed and dried once per week.

Also included in the package is one serving of coconut oil for the skin.

The interior packaging has a nice presentation making this giftable. The current price of $18 is competitively priced.

title: Cheap quality set but surprisingly effective - 3.5 stars
text:
All items are functional and they work. The clippers are sharp and cut well but they feel very cheap. The tweezer is aligned and works well. The scissor cuts very well too. The comb is okay and is difficult to get in and out of the elastic without breaking the tines.

The case is nice and the zipper on the case opens and closes without sticking.

This is a surprisingly functional set even though it is a cheap feeling set. The current price of $16.59 is competitively priced for this.

title: Not a detangler for me but a good brush to massage shampoo into my hair
text:
This is a nice brush for massaging shampoo into my hair during my shower. However, I do not consider this a detangler. It does not detangle my hair at all.

This feels great to hold and work with due to the curve of the handle.

I also might repurpose this to suds up my cats during their annual bath.

The current price of $7.99 is pricey for this.

title: Love the green colors of this sponge set; I do not care for the plastic holder
text:
This is a lovely set of five Easter green-colored blending sponges with one CHEAP PLASTIC holder. I love the sponges and even like the "T" engraving on each sponge. However, I do not like the plastic holder at all. I would have preferred a metal one. 

There are two sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $7.99 it is a reasonable $1.58 per sponge if I consider the holder a freebie.

title: Love the pink colors of this sponge set; I do not care for the plastic holder
text:
This is a lovely set of five Easter pink or mauve-colored blending sponges with one CHEAP PLASTIC holder. I love the sponges and even like the "T" engraving on each sponge. However, I do not like the plastic holder at all. Not only does it cheapen the set, but the top edge of the holder (see photo) has a sharp protrusion that almost caused me to cut myself. It is because of the holder that I lowered the rating of this set from 5 to 4 stars.

There are two sponges with a flat side which is great for smooth applications. The other sponges are typical egg-shaped sponges and are good for blending or any large make-up application.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

At the current price of $9.90 it is a slightly pricey $1.98 per sponge if I consider the holder a freebie.

title: Lovely, sweet & fresh / floral fragrance that lasted me four hours
text:
Fragrance is a very personal taste. This is the third fragrance I tried of theirs (previously I tried the cherry bloom and mystic bliss) and this one is the best. This  perfume  essential oil blend in carrier oils is lovely and has slightly sweet  and very fresh / floral aroma. I applied this to the insides of my wrists and my neck and I had to reapply the fragrance after four hours. 

The current price of $12.95 is competitively priced for this.

title: This fragrance is just awful to my senses
text:
Fragrance is a very personal taste. This mystic bliss perfume essential oil blend in carrier oils smells like stale urine to me. I applied this to my neck and the inside of my wrists and was offended by the odor that I had to immediately wash this off. The fragrance did not come through fully by just smelling the roll on; it was only after I applied it that the full "scent profile" came through.

The current price of $12.95 is competitively priced for this but it has to be a fragrance one loves.

title: Moisturizing and almost scentless lip balm
text:
There are four tubes of lip balm in this package. The two main ingredients are beeswax and shea butter oil. This balm is very moisturizing and glides on easily. I detect a faint aroma but mostly this is scentless and there is no added flavor. I personally prefer flavored balms.

The current price of $8.99 comes to a competitively priced $2.25 per tube.

title: Earthy-smelling soap; cleans well but did not notice any scar fading
text:
There is one bar of soap in this package.  It has a nice earthy / grain aroma to me and lathers and cleans well. I like that the soap is easy to hold as it is not too large or small of a bar. Nevertheless, I did not notice any fading of acne scars or anything like that. 

The current price of $8.95 is pricey for this.

title: Attractive & large clips; holds a lot of hair but does not stay put in fine hair
text:
These hair clips are large. There are six clips in total. There are two clips that do not have any spikes inside and four that do. I love the colors.

These clips are very functional for those with thick long hair. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair but they do not stay put because the spikes are in the wrong place to grip fine hair well. 

The current price of $7.99 is reasonably priced at  $1.33 per clip. I do wish they held fine hair better, however.

title: Excellent brush for blending or just applying eye shadow
text:
This is a great little brush. The brush head is tiny and perfect for applying or blending eye shadow. The bristles are stiffer than typical make-up brushes but that is what makes this perfect for the eyes. What I love is that I no longer have to use those crumbling foam tipped applicators. I am thinking of ordering more of this type of brush. The long handle provides leverage and the small tip is perfect for precision work--even for applying concealer under the eyes.

The current price of $8.99 is pricey but still competitive.

title: Good compress; provides moist heat for styes,etc.
text:
This eye mask is good. I heated it in the microwave for 20 seconds. It should not be heated for more than 30 seconds. The mask came out warm and moist. I found it soothing to my eyes. It can be applied for five to ten minutes. The only thing is that I have to let my eyes adjust after using this because my eyes become blurry after having this press against them. That is typical for me with any eye mask, so it has nothing to do with this product.

Note that the band around the back is adjustable with Velcro and this has to be spot washed. A drawstring carry pouch is included.

This mask is good, comfortable, and provides moist heat to my eyes. It is perfect for styes or when a moist compress is needed for the eyes. Do note, however, that my girlfriend and I tried the H M Hangover Mask (Amazon Item # B08JCK6DWC - sells for $9.99) and it is a much better eye mask for the price.  At the current price of $17.50 this mask is very expensive.

title: Shampoo lathers and cleans well; conditioner hydrates; oil shines
text:
The shampoo and conditioner are more like an afterthought in this set. This comes with two tiny (0.67 ounce) travel-sized tubes of shampoo and conditioner and a 3.52 pump bottle of oil. The oil is the main item of this set.

I have short to medium-length fine curly hair. This shampoo lathers and cleans well and leaves my hair clean. The conditioner is very creamy and hydrates well. The fragrance of the shampoo is okay to me but not great; I prefer the aroma of the conditioner better. I do like the results, but the conditioner does weigh down my curls a little bit. 

The oil is very nice and leaves my hair shiny and glowing. The scent is very subtle and almost floral to me. What I do not like about the oil bottle is that the top cap comes off easily. However, underneath is a nice pump bottle.

The main negative of this set besides the tiny tubes of shampoo and conditioner is that the shampoo does sting the eyes if one is not careful. 

The current price of $6.99 is reasonable for this as one is mostly paying for the bottle of oil.

title: Shampoo lathers and cleans well; conditioner hydrates; does relax my curls a little – 3.5 stars
text:
I have short to medium-length fine curly hair. This shampoo lathers and cleans well and leaves my hair clean. The conditioner is very creamy and hydrates well. The fragrance of the shampoo is okay to me but not great; I prefer the aroma of the conditioner better. I do like the results, but the conditioner does weigh down my curls a little bit. 

The main negative is that the shampoo does sting the eyes if one is not careful. 

PS I had my girlfriend try this set and she loves it. She gives it 5 stars.

The current price of $18.99 is reasonable for this as it comes to $9.50 per bottle. Individually, these sell for almost $12 per bottle. This set comes in a clear plastic carrying bag, which is a nice touch.

title: Leaves my hair hydrated but does relax my curls a little bit
text:
This has a nice fragrance and is very creamy. I used a nickel-sized amount on my short to medium fine curly hair, worked it through, and then rinsed it out. I let my hair dry naturally and it dried soft and was hydrated but my curls were relaxed a little bit after using this.

The current price of $11.95 is competitive.

title: Too thick to work and very uncomfortable
text:
I got this for my boyfriend and it was practically useless. He said the strap was cutting into him. Also, I could not get a good line to use this effectively as a template. The silicone is too thick. If I made it too loose the edges just came up on either side and it did the same even if I made it tight (see photo). It was a complete fail for me.

The price is also too expensive for this. Also, slight assembly is required by feeding the strap into the silicone channel.

title: Not pink but it’s milky; absorbs well but can get messy
text:
There are five 27g (0.952 ounce) packets in this set. The packet tops will break off easily and mess up one's purse if care is not taken with these. Once the packet top is broken off, the opposite side of the cap is screwed on to keep it fresh and mostly safe from leakage.

The white (not pink) milky hand cream absorbs quickly. It is a lightweight cream and just an okay moisturizer. The fragrance is okay. The best feature of this set is that it is portable. However, I recommend the cap be screwed on correctly before traveling with this.

I have no idea how much this will cost but I would hope this would be less than $1 per packet.

title: Lathers and cleans well; leaves my hair clean and hydrated; bottle pump defective
text:
I have short to medium-length fine curly hair. This shampoo lathers and cleans well and leaves my hair clean and hydrated. The fragrance is okay to me but not great. I do like the results, especially since it did not weigh down my curls. What I do not like is that the shampoo does sting the eyes if one is not careful. I also do not like that my bottle pump broke off from the bottle as I went to open the pump. I had to unscrew the cap to get to the shampoo but I was eventually able to make the defective pump work.

The current price of $11.99 is competitive.

title: Thin & lightly moisturizing lotion; nothing special; smells like an old orange – 2.5 stars
text:
I am not crazy about this lotion. There are two 10-ounce pump bottles in this set. The lotion is lightweight and lightly moisturizing. It absorbs quickly but the scent reminds me of an old orange. This is nothing special. After having tried this, I would not purchase this. Also, the lotion seeps out of the neck of the pump at the same time it comes out of the pump.

The current price of $19.99 comes to an expensive $10 per bottle.

title: These brushes are small but great and easy to hold; perfect for my purse
text:
This is a wonderful combo mini nylon and boar bristle brush set. The wooden handles feel great in my hands despite their small size. The  brush glides through my short to medium hair easily. I love the quality, style, and how portable this set is.

As for the package of hair rubber bands included, I consider them absolute garbage. It actually cheapens an otherwise great set. They should leave it out of the package. Also, the current price of $12.99 is a bit too expensive as it comes to a pricey $6.50 per brush. If this were $7 or $8 and they left out those elastics, I would have given this 5 stars.

title: Both sides of this comb are decorative; passes through my curly hair easily
text:
This is a beautiful wooden comb. I love that both sides are decorative. It is small enough to carry, yet large enough to get a good grip on. I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and this passes through my hair easily.

The current price of $3.94 is reasonable for this.

title: Cheery color; brush heads are soft w/no shedding; some are too stiff
text:
There are 10 make-up brushes in this set. The bristles are soft and there is absolutely no shedding.

Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously.What  do not like is that two of the large brushes feel like paint brushes because they are tightly compressed together. I prefer the one large brush that flows with my strokes. It is the same with one of the small brushes. The handles are okay but not as easy to keep a grip on as brushes with an hourglass type handle. These are definitely functional and there is a brush for almost any task but there is no lip brush.

The current price of $14.39 is cones to a slightly pricey $1.44 per brush. This set is not my first choice in brushes. The Daubigny 16Pcs Complete Green Premium Synthetic Makeup Brush Set (Amazon Item #B08PFQQ9FP) is much better and is cheaper per brush.

title: Too small for my small head; barely fits and I have short to medium hair
text: This shower cap barely fits. I have a small head and it fits me snugly. I can get my short to medium-length fine curly hair under this cap, but there is no room left.  I also do not like the way the bow fits on the top. It is waterproof but this is not for me. I prefer a roomier shower cap that does not feel like it is kid-sized.

title: Inconsistent quality and size
text:
I love the fabric design on these headbands but am disappointed in every other way. Of the four bands, one is so tight that I felt like I had a vice grip on my head and actually have a headache from just trying it on. Two others are also tight but not as tight as the first one I tried. Only one headband fits me and that one is nice and looks and feels great on. The quality control is awful and the sizing is so variable that I cannot recommend these.

I have tried many headbands and this is the first set that just is not consistently sized---at least the set that I got.

title: Lovely lavender coconut fragrance; glides on smooth; protection only lasted me 6 hours
text:
There are three 2-ounce solid tubes in this package. The deodorant glides on smooth and  it feels moisturizing. Unfortunately, since this does not have aluminum (which I require), I stink after six hours. The fact that it even lasted six hours is amazing because other non-aluminum deodorants last me only two to four hours. The results are two stars for me. I rated it three stars because I know for a fact that no product w/o aluminum has ever worked 24 or 48 hours for me. They claim this works 48 hours but that might only be for a few people. Personally, I take a shower every 12 hours, so I do not need such long-length protection. I do love the coconut lavender fragrance, however. 

Note that the stick deodorant has to be pushed up from the bottom to expose the balm. This means if too much is exposed, the cap has to be used to squish it back down into the tube. I would have preferred a container that has a turn dial instead.

At the current price of $12.72 ($14.97 minus 15%), this comes to an expensive $4.24 per 2-ounce tube.

title: Back brush is best of the set; puffs are tiny; blue scrubber not for me
text:
This set comes with a wooden handled back brush that has a brush on one side and massaging nubs on the other. There are also two buff puffs included. The buff puffs are so small they remind me of the freebies one receives with a liquid soap gift set. Also, included is a silicone scrubber with handles that has different sized nibs on either side.

The silicone item is too rough for me and it is awkward to use on the back. This might work well for some but it is not for me. The back brush is nice but I only use the brush side and I wish the handle was a few inches longer. I do not care for the massaging end. The buffs puffs would be great if they were bigger. I love mesh shower puffs in general but not tiny ones like these.

I have no idea how much this set will cost but I personally recommend buying the items separately unless the entire set will be used. Also, except for the back brush, the items are not high quality.

title: For decoration only; soap not great smelling; presentation excellent but one wrong word
text:
I was going to rate this one star but increased the rating because there is some quality in this set.

The presentation is superb. The soap roses are delicate and beautiful. The gold foil rose is a nice keepsake. The packaging is attractive but the saying on front is not typed correctly as it says:

Sweet Love
Please always
know that
I love you
mave than
anything else
in the world.

Note that the word should be "more" and not "mave." That is the first mistake.

The second issue I have is that the soap is like glue (see photos). I tried to wash my hands with it and it lathers okay but it is sticky and gunks up my hands and the sponge. Therefore, I would not use this as soap.

The third issue is that I do not feel the soap smells enticing. It has a lackluster aroma that I would not even call floral.

The presentation of roses in the open box is awesome; for that they get five stars. For everything else, this is one star. The current price of $11.99 is a bit pricey for what one gets.

title: Three of the five sponges work exceptionally well for blending make-up but too $$$
text:
Every time I try a new blending set, I am always surprised and delighted by some of the ingenious angles. I absolutely love three of these blending sponges. The dark grayish purple one has such a wonderful angle that I find it great for putting on foundation or blush. I love blenders that are flat-sided in addition to being curvy because they are more useful. The tiny egg-shaped ones are also excellent for the eye area.

I also like the green one, although the bottom flat edge is difficult to work with due to the angle. The only one I truly dislike is the light gray full sized one that has some odd angles. I find that one most difficult to hold and work with. Nevertheless, this is a good set.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves (with regard to texture) are similar to all of the others that I tried before this but it is the angles that determine the use. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not.

The current price of $16.99 is outrageously expensive for this set as it comes to $3.40 per piece (including for each tiny sponge). Unfortunately, I have not seen one yet on the market that has the unique angle of the dark gray sponge that I love so much. Nevertheless, most sponges like this run at $1 to $2 each, so a set such as this should cost under $8

title: Lovely, strong fragrance that lasted me six hours
text:
Fragrance is a very personal taste. This cherry bloom perfume  essential oil blend in carrier oils is very vibrant and has an intense and slightly sweet cherry aroma. I think the fragrance is lovely but a bit strong. I applied this to the insides of my wrists and my neck and the fragrance lasted over six hours. If the scent was just a hair less intense, this would have received 5 stars from me.

The current price of $12.95 is competitively priced for this.

title: Elegant & well-designed toiletry bag but it is NOT LEATHER
text:
This men's toiletry bag would have gotten 5 stars from me if it were not for the false advertising. The description says this is PU Leather but the title of the product says this is leather and that is what I went by when I ordered it. This is NOT leather, nevertheless, it is a gorgeous, elegant, and well designed bag. Also, the current price of $18.99 ($23.99 minus $5) is excellent for this.

There are two compartments. The central compartment has a hanger hook so that this can be hung on a clothing rod during travel.  Inside the central compartment are four pockets. One zippered mesh pocket on the top, a small zippered pocket on the back side, and two tiny mesh folder pockets on the front side that will hold floss and lip balm. On the bottom of the bag is a zippered compartment that has four elastic holders on the right side, five holders on the left, and one zippered mesh pocket underneath the bottom of the central compartment that makes up the roof of the bottom cavity.

All the zippers glide easily. The bag is large enough to hold a full size can of shave cream, full size deodorant, full size tube of toothpaste, and other incidentals with a little room to spare. The bottom can hold a toothbrush, disposable razor, etc. There is a sturdy carry handle on one side.

In summary, this is an excellent PU leather (fake leather) toiletry bag. The bottom can hold a toothbrush, disposable razor, etc. There is a sturdy carry handle on one side.

title: Ordinary shower caps; the large is very roomy; love the colors
text: There are two shower caps of the same design and color. Since I ordered a large, these are very roomy as I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and a small head. I love the color. The caps are ordinary in the sense that they are double layer standard caps. This is comfortable and does keep my hair dry in the shower. I have no idea what this will be priced at but I feel anything more than $8 to $10 would be too much. Caps like these can be purchased at my local store in the $4 to $5 range for one cap.

title: I cannot stand the smell of this shampoo & conditioner set
text: There are two 8 ounce bottles in this set (one conditioner and one shampoo). The shampoo smells like clay or Play Doh and is very liquidy. It does lather well and my hair feels clean after washing with this. However, the conditioner smells absolutely terrible. It reminds me of a mix of tea tree oil combined with some sort of solvent. I like the thick consistency of the cream but that is all. My scalp started to itch after using this set. I personally do not care for the fragrance or the results. This is definitely not for me.

title: Would be a great set if the brush didn’t smell of shoe polish
text:
At the current price of $11.99, this brush set is sort of an excellent deal. It comes with a large boar bristle brush with wooden handle, a wooden comb, a nice satin eye mask, and a "carry" pouch that covers the head of the brush only.

This brush passed through my hair easily. What I absolutely hate is that the brush STINKS of SHOE POLISH. It is probably the finish on the handle, but the smell is somewhat offensive to me. Nevertheless, everything else is fine. The satin sleep mask is comfortable, is slightly padded, and blocks out the light, The carry pouch is nice as well. This set has to be aired out before use, however.

title: Wide bands are nice but extra tiny headband is too small
text:
There are four colorful wide headbands, one tiny elastic headband, and a hair tie with some "bling" on the end. The tiny headband is too small and more for a child's head. It does not fit me well. The ponytail elastic is okay but not great. Nevertheless, those two items are extra.

The four colorful headbands are very nice. I love the width because I can wear it over my ears. Since I have short to medium-length fine curly hair, headbands will not stay on me unless I put them over my ears. Therefore, this is perfect. The material is slinky and not as soft as cotton ones that I own.

The material designs are attractive and the colors in those designs will match various outfits.

The current price of $9.73 ($13.99 minus 30%) is very reasonable for this as it comes to $2.45 per headband if I EXCLUDE the extra child's headband and ponytail holder. That price is reasonable.

title: Very moisturizing; coconut lime reminds me of the beach
text:
This lip balm is very moisturizing to my lips. I cannot attest to its SPF protection as I am not one to go out in the sun much. Nevertheless, I love the feel of this, the hydration, and the coconut lime "flavor" reminds me of the beach and a little bit of Hawaiian Tropic Suntan Lotion.

The current price of $6.99 comes to $3.50 per tube which is competitively priced.

title: Very moisturizing; mango smells delicious
text:
This lip balm is very moisturizing to my lips. I cannot attest to its SPF protection as I am not one to go out in the sun much. Nevertheless, I love the feel of this, the hydration, and the mango "flavor" smells delicious.

The current price of $6.99 comes to $3.50 per tube which is competitively priced.

title: Like a compact brush head without handle; base provides decent grip
text:
This detangler feels cheap. I tried a different brand previously and it had a non-slip base. This one does not but it still provides a decent grip. This brush is like having a full-size detangling brush but without the long handle.

There are two sizes of bristles. It glides easily through my fine curly short to medium-length hair. This is even better in the shower on wet hair. The current price of $6.99 is a little pricey for this brush especially since it is not high quality and feels like cheap plastic. I feel any price higher than $3.99 is too much for the quality of this brush.

title: Ordinary shower cap; fits perfectly on my head; not too small & not too large - 3.5 stars
text: This shower cap is ordinary. It is definitely a medium as I take a size small in hats. I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and this fits me perfectly and there is a little more room for more hair if I had it. The color looks okay but not great on me.  This is comfortable and does keep my hair dry in the shower. I do feel, however, that the current price of $7.99 is a bit too high for this as it is about $3 too much for a double layer shower cap.

title: Back brush provides good coverage but handle is weak; puffs are great
text:
There is one back brush and two large puffs in this set. The back brush has a thin handle. As long as I am gentle with it, I expect to get about six months of use out of it. The long handle provides me with a good reach. The puff itself is only on one side and not double-sided like the ones I purchase locally. However, the puff is puffy enough to provide me with great coverage and lots of suds.

The body puffs are the best part of this set. They lather well and produce copious suds. I absolutely love them.

Overall, I like this set well enough with the body puffs being my favorite items. Just beware the back brush most likely will not last long as I expect the handle to break. The set comes with one self-stick hook. The current price of $15.19 ($15.99 minus 5%) comes to an expensive $5.06 each item. At my local store, I pay no more than $4 for an equivalent back brush and no more than $2 each for an equivalent puff, meaning this set is about $7 too much that what can be had locally.

UPDATE June 2, 2021 - I lowered my rating from 4 to 3 stars because the back brush came undone after about one month of use. I expect to get at least 4-6 months out of a back brush before I replace it and it did not last that long. See the photo.

title: Long handle for good reach; mesh puff produce slots of suds; handle will break if too rough
text:
I usually buy about two plastic handled back puffs per year at Walmart because the plastic handles do not last with rough handling. These back brushes have even thinner handles. As long as I am gentle with them, I expect to get about six months of use out of the puff. The long handle provides me with a good reach. The puff itself is only on one side and not double-sided like the ones I purchase locally. However, the puff is puffy enough to provide me with great coverage and lots of suds.

Overall, I like these well enough. Just beware they will not last long. It also comes with one self-stick hook. The current price of $13.99 comes to an expensive $7 each. At my local store, I pay no more than $4 for an equivalent item.

UPDATE June 2, 2021 - I lowered my rating from 3 to 2 stars because the back brush came undone after about one month of use. I expect to get at least 4-6 months out of a back brush before I replace it and it did not last that long. See the photo.

title: Attractive set of hair clips that can be used as a decoration for curtains, etc. as well
text:
There are three attractive clips in this set. I personally like the butterfly clip as that one holds the hair the best and it is the most stylish of all. The square and half moon shape ones are good but not as great as the other one. Each clip has a double-layer butterfly with a heart hanging down. Depending on how this is used in the hair, it can be difficult to work with these clips. Nevertheless, they did work well in my short to medium-length curly hair.

I personally feel these are even better as package toppers for a gift or to just hang off of a well-ironed hand towel as a decoration. They can even be used to clip curtains together as that would make an attractive statement piece.

At the current price of $6.99, this comes to $2.33 per clip.

title: Would be a great set if the brush didn’t smell of shoe polish
