text:
At the current price of $12.99 ($15.99 minus $3), this brush set would have been an excellent deal. It comes with a large boar bristle brush with wooden handle, a teasing comb, and a "carry" pouch that covers the head of the brush only.

This brush passed through my hair easily. What I absolutely hate is that the brush STINKS of SHOE POLISH. It is probably the finish on the handle, but the smell was so offensive to me, I could not continue to use this. If the brush did not stink, this set would have received 4 stars from me.

title: Very functional brushes; 16 brushes at a great price; brush heads are soft
text:
There are 16 make-up brushes in this set. The bristles are relatively soft and there is absolutely no shedding.

Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I love that they included the list of brushes on the back but I do wish they had a picture of what each one is. I know most of them but not all. I also love the smaller brushes for precision work around the eyes and this set has lots of those.

There are actually more brushes than I need. The current price of $16.19 ($17.99 minus 10%) is reasonable as this comes to $1.01 per brush.

title: Absolutely excellent silicone brush; has a multitude of uses
text:
I never in my wildest dreams thought I would love a brush like this nor did I feel this would hold up to my high standards. However, this is fantastic. The brush is heavy and feels great in my hands. There are two sides -- short thin nubs and longer and thicker ones on the other side. There is also a hanging loop but one either needs a small hook to go through the hole or needs to attach a cord.

USES
- As a cleaning brush for dishes

- Use with soap and water to clean under one's fingernails. I did this and it was great.

- Use as a pet hair pick-up brush by rubbing it across a surface the pets lay on. I tried this on one of the pet beds I have and it picked up the hair. The only issue I had is removing the hair from the brush. I had to rinse it out.

- As a horse curry comb for grooming and getting dirt out of a horse's coat.

- As a massager for the scalp or hands.

- As a shampoo brush; this only works well with short hair.

- As a brush to suds up the pets when giving them a bath.

- As a foot scrubber. I used this on the heels of my feet and it felt wonderful.

I mostly use the short nubbed side as it is gentler on my skin, hands, and feet.

In summary, this brush is well made, comes in some great colors, and the current price of $6.99 is reasonable. In addition, it comes with its own soft cinch-tie carry bag.

title: I would not call it exfoliating but it is hydrating to cracked heels
text:
This is a medium-weight cream. I actually expected it to be thicker. However, it did leave my heels and feet hydrated. I rubbed this in on each foot after my shower and then put a pair of socks on. In the morning, my feet felt wonderful. I do wish the cream was thicker, however. I would not call this exfoliating. To me that means it acts like a pumice on the skin and I do not feel that.

The current price of $6.99 is competitively priced for this.

title: Cleans well but left my curly hair dull & flat; stings eyes
text: I have short to medium-fine curly hair. I used this in the shower and accidentally got this into my eyes and it stings. Nevertheless, it washes and lathers well. However, I hate the way it left my hair looking after letting it air dry. My hair looked dull and my curls were flat. This definitely does not work for me.

title: Hydrating but leaves a feeling of product on my skin; do not care for aroma
text: I love the jar packaging, drawstring bag, and the zinc spatula that comes with this set. The moisturizer is relatively thick like I like my moisturizes to be. However, when I rub this into my face and next, it does not absorb and my face feels tacky. Also, I do not care for the aroma of the cream. It is definitely hydrating but it is not for me.

title: I love these 7 tiny blenders for make-up application around the eyes
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. There are seven tiny blenders that are perfect for blending eyeshadow around the eyes or for any other precision work, like between the brow, around the nose, etc. The round edge is good for spreading and the pointed tip is great for highlighting.

I LOVE THE COLORS.  I love how soft these are against my skin and the easy with which I can work with them. 

The current price of  $7.99 ($9.99 minus 20%) seems a little pricey at $1.14 per tiny sponge but I have not seen a tiny selection like this on the market yet.

title: Colorful and super soft headbands but bun looks silly on
text:
These headbands are soft and attractive. They are so soft that I just wanted to feel them all day. I also love the mixed colors. Unfortunately, I consider this more for a young girl because the thick rose bun at the center looks silly on me. 

I have short to medium-length hair and these do not stay as well as I liked due to the bun on top. If I had longer hair and were younger, these headbands would be perfect. The material is also not wide enough to put over my ears like I do some headbands. 

The current price of $9.95 comes to a reasonable $2.49 per band.

title: Lathers, cleans, & smells great; did relax my curls just a little bit
text:
I really like this shampoo. It has a sweet smell that is not overpowering. It also lathers and cleans well. It did, however, relax my short curly to medium length hair.

The current price of $9.99 is expensive for this.

title: Nice fragrance; glides on smooth; but only lasted me 4 hours
text:
There are three 2.6 ounce solid tubes in this package. The deodorant glides on smooth and what I call "thick." It is moisturizing. Unfortunately, since this does not have aluminum (which I require), I stink after 4 hours with this. I originally thought this had aluminum and not 0% aluminum, which is why I ordered it. Unfortunately, this is two stars for me. I rated it three stars because I read the label wrong and know for a fact that no product w/o aluminum has ever worked for me.

At the current price of $17.97, this comes to an expensive $5.99 per tube.

title: Rich and beautiful nail color; perfect w/a summer tan
text:
This "wine not" nail polish is rich and beautiful with a slight metallic shimmer. It glides on easily and two coats are all I need. I did apply a top coat but it did not seem that I needed that. I love the color and it will look great with a tan.

UPDATE - This polish is long lasting considering I have my hands in water all day. So far it has lasted over one week with some chipping, which is unusual for me. What is interesting is that the polish peeled off my pinkie nails but did not peel off the other nails. I originally thought all of the polish would peel but it does not. Nevertheless, I really love this polish.

title: 1/5th smaller than advertised; great for making lip gloss or giving away saffron strands
text:
There are 50 super tiny plastic containers with screw-on lids. Also included are 128 labels and four plastic "scoops." The Amazon site claims this holds 5g of product. I decided to test this with water and it only holds .004kg (i.e. 4g) of water to the tippy top. This means it holds 1g less than advertised.

Nevertheless, these are perfect for the right purpose. For those who make lip gloss or mix lipstick, these are excellent containers. It is also great for giving away or selling a few saffron spice strands which are very expensive. In addition, they can be used to carry some pills. I was able to get 10 of my Vitamin D 50mcg softgels in this container.

The current price of $9.28 is a reasonable $.19 cents per "jar."

title: Towel-like headbands perfect for when applying make-up, putting hair back in spa, or the beach
text:
These headbands are soft and attractive. They are towel-like in the sense that they are thick and feel like they are made from a cloth similar to terry cloth or bathrobe type material. 

I have short to medium-length hair and these do not stay as well as I liked due to the elastic in the back. If I had longer hair it would be perfect. The material is also not wide enough to put over my ears like I do some headbands. Nevertheless, these are perfect for those with long hair.

The current price of $14.20 ($14.95 minus 5%) comes to a slightly pricey $3.55 per band.

title: Huge paddle brush; good detangling comb & eyebrow brush; brush cleaner useless
text:
This is a nice brush set but because the brush head is so large, I would have expected this to be a woman's set. The brush glided through my short to medium-length fine curly hair easily.It is also good for blow drying long hair. I personally found the brush a bit unwieldy because of the size; nevertheless, it's a great brush. The comb is good for detangling wet hair in the shower and the eyebrow brush/comb combo is perfect for the brows (male or female). There is a wiry brush cleaner which I found to be useless.

The current price of $15.99 is a bit pricey for this set since the brush is not made of boar bristles and only nylon. Overall, it's a nice set but not perfect.

title: Smells nice, cleans and lathers well, and leaves my hair hydrated
text: This shampoo has a very subtle aloe scent. It lathers well and my hair felt very clean and hydrated after using this. I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and this shampoo's moisturizing effects did not weigh it down. The current price of $18.96 is a bit much for this, however.

title: Beautiful brush set; travel brush handle is a bit short – 4.5 stars
text:
This is a beautiful brush set. There is one large paddle type brush and one small one. The small one has a short handle that I sometimes found hard to maintain a grip on. However, that is to be expected for a travel brush. The comb is best for detangling in the shower.

The brushes glided through my short to medium-length fine curly hair easily. A carry pouch is included. It can be used to carry the travel brush or to cover just the head of the larger brush (see photos).

The current price of $14.44 ($16.99 minus 15%) is reasonable for this set. It also comes in a giftable box.

title: Beautifully packaged; attractive bottle; nice long-lasting fragrance; dislike squirt
text:
This perfume is beautifully packaged and the bottle is elegant. The fragrance is sweet and floral and long-lasting, although I do wish it were less sweet. Also, the perfume squirts out instead of sprays out. This is my main dislike.

The current price of $53.97 for a 3.4 ounce bottle such as this is competitively priced. If the perfume sprayed out and was more floral and less sweet, this would have received 5 stars from me. In every other way, it is lovely.

title: Manicure bench is narrow, tall, slippery, & it smells
text:
At the current price of $17.99, this manicure bench is more reasonably priced than a competitor with the same bench. The quality of the workmanship is pretty good but the legs elevate this bench about 5.25" off the ground. Since the bench is narrow on top, the person leaning their hands may have a tendency to tip this over. In addition, there are no rubber feet on the "legs." As a result, it is necessary to put a towel under this bench to keep it from slipping when placed on a solid non-stick surface.

Other than this, this bench is very nice. If it were lower to the ground, about two inches wider, and had rubberized feet on the bottom, this would have received 5 stars. In its current state it is functional but not the best it could be. The fact that it smells is also bothersome to me. I suppose it could double as a child's pretend ironing board.

title: Love the fragrance & how it leaves my hair feeling soft but it relaxes my curls too much
text: I love the fragrance of this shampoo, conditioner, and styling cream trio. The shampoo lathers and cleans well and the conditioner detangles well. Unfortunately, my normally curly hair turned out soft and flat. When I decided to apply the styling cream, I was able to produce some body but was not overly pleased with the results. I personally do not like products in my hair, so if I have to apply a styling cream daily to get good results then this is not for me. The current price of $39.99 is pricey but that comes to $13.33 per bottle. Note that the shampoo and conditioner are both 12 fluid ounces and the styling cream is 8 ounces.

title: Long-lasting fragrance but not my favorite scent
text: This one fluid ounce spray bottle is nicely designed into what I call a double-sided triangle. The fragrance is supposed to be musky and floral. I get a hint of the musky but no floral. It actually reminds me a bit of the aroma of Play-Doh, which I like, but am not interested in having as a fragrance. The aroma is just okay to me. I do like that it is long lasting and I was able to detect it several hours later.

title: Tips are too thick to be incredibly effective
text:
I am disappointed in this set. There are four tweezers in a pleather case. All the tweezers have a tip that is way too thick. The worst one is the slant tip and then the flat tip. The point slant tip is the best as is the pointed tip. Although the blades align, I only find that tweezers with a thin metal edge are best as opposed to a thick edge. I tried pulling eyebrow, chin, and lip hairs with these and my success was 50/50 compared to the  [[ASIN:B08RX9FJBD PAFASON Precision Tweezer Kit]] I use regularly.

To me these are just okay. I also feel the current price of $14.90 is too expensive for this.

title: Holds 17 ounces to the tippy top; sprays in mist or stream
text:
These are nice spray/stream nozzled bottles. I have no idea how much these will cost but I think $1.50 to $1.75 per bottle is the maximum that should be charged for these. This would mean between $7.50 to $8.75 is reasonable.

These bottles are good. There are five in the package and each bottle holds 17 ounces if filled to the base of the top. I was able to insert the spray nozzle without any spillage when full. They spray very well. I use bottles like these for Windex or vinegar and water solution. To get a mist, I just turn the nozzle a little bit.  If I want a a stream then I turn the nozzle all the way out.

The bottles are made of a hard plastic, so they will most likely crack if handled roughly. For me these are perfect. It all comes down to price as to whether these are worth the purchase. I personally think $1.50 to $1.75 per bottle is the outside limit for any empty plastic bottle of this type.

title: I like their foot balm better; this is thin and I do not care for the smell
text:
There are two 3.38 fluid ounce tubes of foot cream in this package. The cream is thin and has a funny smell to it. It is supposed to be rose petals and shea butter but I do not care for the scent. I used this on my feet after a shower and although it is hydrating and silky, it is not as great as their balm, which I love.

I personally do not have very callused feet but they are dry and this is hydrating. I really wish I liked this as much as their [[ASIN:B08RSGFXR6 foot balm]]. I had my boyfriend try this as well and he likes the cream but also prefers the balm better.

The current price of $17.95 comes to $8.98 per tube.

title: Very functional brushes; 16 brushes at a great price; brush heads have slight smell
text:
I recently ordered the Oneleaf Standing Makeup Brushes (Amazon item # B08FQMQNP3) which are priced at $42.99. but I consider this set a better deal and it contains more brushes.

There are 16 make-up brushes in this set. This is an attractive brush set. The bristles are soft. There was a little shedding of a few hairs but the shedding stopped after I pulled out a few hairs. There is one brush in the set that has a slight crimp (dent) but it does not alter the functionality of the brush.

Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I like that they stand up; however, they are easy to knock over as well. I actually had them produce a domino effect by accidentally tipping over one brush which then caused many of the other brushes to fall down.

There are actually more brushes than I needed in this set. The brush heads do have a slight smell to them but nothing that is overpowering. The current price of $11.99 is an excellent buy as this comes to $.75 cents per brush.

title: Gentle face silicone cleaner/massager in 2nd mode only; don't care for other modes; not exfoliating
text:
[[VIDEOID:10a87882f63ce9f1ee12e3617d1ed8ad]] I am disappointed in this brush and it does not operate like the instructions say.

There is one circular face massager, one magnetic ring, a charging cable, and an instruction pamphlet. I charged this for several hours before first use.

Operation is simple. Just press hold the on/off button on front for about three seconds before it turns on. The - and + buttons decrease or increase the intensity. A quick press of the on/off button again, switches among the modes.

The first mode with the blue light turns on the heating (mirror side). The second press with the gyrating green light turns on the vibration cleaning mode. This is the ONLY mode that vibrates even though the manual says the vibration comes on during the next two modes. The third press turns on the red light with heating. The fourth mode with the purple light does something called phototherapy and heating. The sixth mode with the blue light starts the process over again.  Press hold to turn the unit off.

The magnetic ring is used on the metal side with a cotton pad to clean the face of make-up, etc. I did not have a cotton pad for that.

Personally, I only like the vibration mode on the silicone side for cleansing/massaging. I do not care for the other modes and the vibration does not come on in those modes as the instructions say. Therefore, this gets 2.5 stars from me rounded up to 3 stars. The current price of $12.99 is competitively priced.

title: Moisturizing body butter; sinks in and leaves my skin silky; my boyfriend likes it too
text: My boyfriend and I both tried this and we both love it. It has a spicy aroma, is very moisturizing, and leaves our hands and body silky once it absorbs into the skin which takes a few minutes. The current price of $8 for 5.1 ounces is competitively priced with named brands. I would have expected this to be a couple of dollars cheaper since it is a "brandless" body butter. Nevertheless, this is very nice.

title: Attractive & large clips; holds a lot of hair
text:
These hair clips are large. There are six clips in total. There are two with a matte finish and four with a glossy finish. I particularly love the purple one and the other two tone colored ones. 

These clips are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like them all. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

The current price of $12.99 is competitively priced at  $2.17 per clip. There are similar hair clips on the market that are cheaper but have a full matte finish without any color variation and they are the [[ASIN:B08RS3CT5R ABUNRO clips]] which sell for $9.99.

title: Silicone head too wobbly for scrubbing; needs 1 AA battery; vibration not enough
text:
I am disappointed in this sonic facial cleaner. One AA battery is needed (NOT INCLUDED). I was able to easily unscrew the bottom cap to insert the battery; although it seems other users have issues with that. Once the battery is installed, operation is simple. I just pressed the center button and a tiny light (see photo) and a continuous but subtle vibration begins. The button can be pressed again for a change in vibration and again for what feels like a stop / start vibration.

I do find this difficult to use because the arm and head bend easily, so it is almost impossible to get any scrubbing action since the wand does not stay tight to the face.

The "mirror-looking" side is supposed to be used to gently massage wrinkle-prone skin but I have no interest in doing that. It is cooling though.

Unfortunately, I do not care for this facial cleansing brush. The arm needs to be stiffer to hold the brush head against my face. Also, the current price of $24.99 is ridiculous for this. Even if it were an excellent brush, I feel anything more than $10 is too much.

title: Excellent empty glass bottle set perfect for hair coloring, essential oil sprays, etc.
text:
There are two glass spray bottles in this set--one amber and one cobalt blue. There are also two tiny plastic funnels and to screw caps in case one does not want to use the spray top. Note that these are packaged exceptionally well in bubble wrap sleeves for each one.

These are perfect for hair solutions, water, window cleaner, vinegar, etc., etc., etc. The spray nozzles, with a turn of the front dial, dispense a wonderful mist spray or a fine stream just like many store bought spray products. Each bottle holds 16 ounces of liquid. The color of the glass helps protect light sensitive products.

The current price of $17.99 is expensive as it comes to $9.50 per bottle. These [[ASIN:B08GWKYWMP AYL]] bottles are $8 cheaper and they come with extras.

title: I like their foot balm better; this is too sticky and thin
text:
There are two 3.38 fluid ounce tubes of foot cream in this package. The cream is thin and slightly runny. I used this on my feet after a shower and although it is hydrating, it left my hands and feet feeling sticky. I immediately washed my hands, whereas with their balm, I kept it on my hands.

I personally do not have very callused feet but they are dry and this was somewhat moisturizing and has the cooling effect of menthol. I really wish I liked this as much as their foot balm (Amazon item #B08RSGFXR6)

The current price of $17.95 comes to $8.98 per tube.

title: Hard to wash the shave cream out of the razor but leaves my face soft & love the tingle
text:
This is a 5.9 fluid ounce tube of shave cream that is not tested on animals, is vegan, has no harsh chemicals, and the company sends a portion of all proceeds from the sale of this product to the preservation of elephants--hence the name of the product --> Dr. Tusk.

Although I know this is specifically geared for men, I use men's products and love to try shave creams.  I wanted to love this shave cream but I do not and it is only because it is very difficult to wash it out of my razor. The cream is pearlized and reminds me of Noxema and spreads like that as well.

LIKES
- It smells great

- I love the tingle on my face

- It left the areas of my face that I shave very smooth and moisturized

DISLIKES
- After spreading this on my face, it does not foam like shave cream but instead starts to disappear. Therefore, where there was white cream originally, it quickly becomes  hard to see where I put the shave cream.

- It was almost impossible to rinse out of my razor. I had to use very hot and strongly gushing water for about two minutes to remove the cream from between the blades. I almost thought I was going to have to throw the razor out. I remember trying a shave cream last year where I actually did have to throw my razor out after first use. This cream is a little better than that one because I did eventually get the razor clean. However, it requires diligence and patience.

In summary, I would have given this cream 5 stars if it washed off the razor easily. I also feel the current price of $8.49 is pricey. They definitely are supporting a good cause that I am passionate about but I always personally believed that people should donate directly to organizations they love and not through the purchase of a product. This way one always knows exactly what "portion" is actually going to the cause.

PS The package says this is made with dragon's blood. When I looked up what that was, it seems like that is a bright red resin that is obtained from several species of plants.

title: Beautiful & functional brushes; great grip; case smells & definitely not leather
text:
There are three beautiful foundation brushes in this set along with a case. The case smells and is definitely not leather from what I can tell. I do not trust the description. Also, there is no square item pictured. I thought it came with a mirror based on the photos but it does not.

Nevertheless, this set is excellent. The diamond pink handles are extremely textured which provides me with a great grip. The brushes are soft and feel great against my skin. They are perfect for applying blush or foundation powder. The bristles also do not fall out, which is lovely.

The current price of $16.99 ($19.99 minus $3) is reasonable for this set.

title: Super hydrating, non-greasy moisturizing cream for the feet
text:
There are two 3.38 fluid ounce tubes of foot balm in this package. The balm is thick as it should be. I used this on my feet after a shower and it is extremely hydrating. I like that it is not sticky, not greasy, and absorbs within a few minutes. I personally do not have very callused feet but they are dry and this really moisturized. In fact, I like it so much that I left the product on my hands after rubbing this into my feet because it made my hands feel great too.

The current price of $17.95 comes to $8.98 per tube.

UPDATE April 4, 2021 - My boyfriend loves this foot balm. He says it is very nice, absorbs well, and feels great on. He gives this 5 stars.

title: Excellent empty glass bottle set perfect for hair coloring, essential oil sprays, etc.
text:
There are two amber glass spray bottles in this set. There are no labels or funnels or anything else as included in these [[ASIN:B08GWKYWMP AYL bottles]]. 

Note that these are packaged exceptionally well in bubble wrap sleeves for each one and a cardboard insert between the bottles.

These are perfect for hair solutions, water, window cleaner, vinegar, etc., etc., etc. The spray nozzles, with a turn of the front dial, dispense a wonderful mist spray or a fine stream just like many store bought spray products. Each bottle holds 16 ounces of liquid. The amber color of the glass helps protect light sensitive products. 

The current price of $11.99 is competitive as it comes to $5.50 per bottle where the [[ASIN:B08GWKYWMP AYL bottles]] (which use to be much more expensive) are now $2 cheaper and have included incidentals such as funnel, labels, bottle caps, etc.

title: Very nice clips for a girl or large dog who has been just groomed; grips the hair
text:
I would not call these ponytail holders but they are very nice clips. There are four bow clips in total and they are very pretty. One (yellow one) arrived rumpled so it needed ironing but the others were perfect. The clips have teeth, so it gripped my hair well. These are perfect for young girls or long-haired large female dogs who have been just groomed.

The current price of $3.99 for 4 clips is very reasonable as it comes to $1 per clip

title: "Egg-carton" blending sponges; perfect for the Easter Basket; work well for applying make-up
text:
This is a lovely set blending sponges with an "egg-carton-type" holder. I love the holder since it is enclosed. In addition, there are four blending sponges. Three of them have flat-sided blending sides and one is fully egg shaped. I love flat-sided blenders because those are great  for smooth applications. 

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

The current price of $6.99 is competitively priced for this set as it comes to $1.40 per piece (4 blenders and 1 covered case).

title: Nice detangling set; quick assembly required; wish handles were non-slip
text:
This detangling set has four pieces. There are two detangling brushes with two rods that have to be assembled onto the brush.

The rod that gets installed has four nubs on it that connect with the tines of the brush which makes for a securer fit; some brushes like these only have two nubs. This means it stays put. It works well on detangling my short to medium curly hair in the shower and if some hair gets caught, it easily rinses out. In addition, this can be used as a regular brush too.

The handles on these brushes are not non-slip like another detangler I have. I prefer a non-slip handle. Nevertheless, these brushes still work well.

The current price of $9.98 is reasonable for this set as it comes to $4.99 per brush.

title: Complete detangling set; do not care for clips or the unmatched comb; quick assembly required
text:
This detangling set has nine pieces. There is a wide pliable vent brush, a shower detangling brush that comes with one rod that needs to be installed, two combs, and five clips.

I use my other detanglers every other day to detangle my hair in the shower and love them. The detangler with the rod that has to be installed is great on wet hair. The rod that gets installed only has four nubs on it that connect with the tines of the brush which makes for a securer fit; some brushes like these only have two nubs. This means it stays put. It works well on detangling my short to medium curly hair in the shower and if some hair gets caught, it easily rinses out. In addition, this can be used as a regular brush too. 

The vent brush is great for blow-drying. The brush head is pliable and my hair glides through the tines. Both this brush and the other one have a non-slip handle that feels great to hold.

The combs are okay but I do not use combs much. What I do not like is that the larger comb does not match the color of the rest of the set. That is a disappointment.

The clips I do not like as they do not hold my hair well at all.

The current price of $14.99 is reasonable for this set as it comes to $1.67 per item. However, if one only uses detangling brushes, then I recommend purchasing the brushes separately to save some money and pass on a set like this where the combs and clips are not as useful.

title: Soft headbands that feel great on; will pair well with most outfits
text:
There are 6 tie dye headbands in this set. The headbands are relatively soft. They feel great on my head and over my ears. I particularly like the look of the teal, red, and purple bands. Since each headband is in a tie dye pattern, they will pair well with many outfits. 

The current price of $9.99 is a reasonable $1.67 per band.

title: Clips hold a lot of hair; love the tortoise & black-colored ones the best
text:
There are four large hair clips in this package. I love the tortoise and black-colored ones because they go with anything and are super attractive. The other two colors are a bit blah. Nevertheless, these clips open and close easily and hold a lot of hair. These clips stay put in my hair but are best for those who have longer hair.

The current price of $7.99 is on the high side of competitively priced $2 per clip.

title: Too bland of a fragrance for my diffusers & I don't use it for other purposes
text:
For .33 fluid ounces, the current price of $18.99 is very expensive for this. However, based on the description, this is harvested from trees that grow in the South American rainforest. I'm not sure if it actually comes from the Amazon or if Amazon trees are grown elsewhere and it is harvested in another location. Nevertheless, the description said it was sweet smelling. Therefore, I ordered it thinking it would be perfect for my diffuser. After trying this, it is very bland and has almost no scent worthy of sniffing.

Per the Amazon description, this type of essential oil "is a powerful anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antibacterial. The unique aroma and properties of this terpene can be utilized as a food additive, in cosmetics, creams, toothpaste, and other commercial products."  I suppose if one is using it for those purposes, it would be worthy of a higher rating. Unfortunately, I am disappointed as the statement "Copaiba Oil has a friendly, sweet aroma that encourages easy breathing" does not hold true for me.

title: Seems no better than my regular shampoo
text:
This shampoo smells okay and lathers and cleans well. However, my hair did not feel or look extra moisturized. I did not feel my scalp or hair was more hydrated than other store brand shampoos like Mane and Tail, Pantene Pro V, etc. In fact, I would say it was more on the dry side, almost as if I used a detergent like Suave to clean my hair.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and this did not weigh down my curls, so that is a plus. At the current price of $39.99, this is an expensive shampoo for comparable or less than comparable results. I did look this up online and Walmart sells this same 12 ounce bottle for $8.74 so I'm unsure of why it is over four times the price on Amazon for one 12-ounce bottle.

title: Love the colors in this sponge set; do not care for the plastic holders
text:
This is a lovely set of colorful blending sponges with two plastic holders. I personally do not like plastic holders; I prefer the metal ones. These holders are also a bit big and do not display the sponges as delicately as they could be presented. Nevertheless, for the current price of $9.99 for 12 useful blenders, this is a steal. If we add in the two holders, it comes to $.71 cents per piece for the 14-piece set.

I love flat-sided blenders because these are great  for smooth applications. All the sponges in this "Set01" have a flat side, which is my preferred choice. 

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. These colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

text:
