title: Hardly any product; conditioner won’t come out of container; results good otherwise
text:
This travel set is disappointing. For the current price of $32, one gets a total of 7 ounces of product. There is one 2  ounce shampoo, conditioner, and scalp hair masque/scalp detox and one 1 ounce styling foam.

I love the shampoo. It smells great, lathers well, and leaves my hair clean. However, the conditioner is terrible. It will not dispense from the bottle. I actually had to take the cap off and stick my pinkie in and it still wouldn't come out. It was like concrete in the container. I finally was able to hit it real hard against my hands about 15 times and got about a five-cent dollop out of the bottle.  I don't care for the smell at all but it did leave my hair well-conditioned.

The shampoo will only last for three washes for my short to medium-length hair. I used one-third the bottle just with one wash. I cannot remove any more conditioner unless I stick a knife or something into the bottle.  I have not yet tried the hair mask but I did try the styling foam and hate it. It flattens my hair terribly. That one will get thrown out.

This is way too expensive, especially for a product that I cannot remove from the container.  I love the shampoo and do love the results of the conditioner but do not like its scent. If the conditioner dispensed easily, smelled better, and the price of this set was cheaper, it would have received 4 stars from me.

title: Fantastic brush for blush application
text: I was skeptical if I would like this brush or not but I love it. Because the bristles are tightly packed, flat, and close to the base, it has a rigidness to it that is perfect for the application of blush. The bristles are soft as well and I did not experience any shedding. The current price of $7.59 ($7.99 minus 5%) is competitively priced for this type brush.

title: Lovely set of Easter-colored blending sponges with one holder but colors are not as shown
text:
This is just a wonderful set of three Easter-colored blending sponges with one holder. At the current price of $5.99 it is a good deal. Note that I received one vibrant pink, light pink, and light orange sponge and not the green one shown in the Amazon photo.

There is one sponge with a flat side which is great  for smooth applications. The other sponges are good for blending or any large make-up application.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and feel soft against my skin. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. I love that the sponges do not smell. I tried other colored sponges and they smell like pencil shavings or other chemicals and these do not.

The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. This set is definitely a good one and a decent price. The colors also make it perfect for the Easter Basket.

title: Nice manicure set but case holders rip immediately
text:
This set looks impressive and is extremely presentable. It has eight tools, most of which I use.

I use all the clippers the most and they cut well. The tweezers are aligned and pull chin and eyebrow hairs easily. The scissors are sharp, although I am not crazy about the curled angle of the blade. I do not use the ear picks. However, my biggest complaint is that the case is impressive but the holders inside the case are super cheap. One ripped in transit and another was about to rip by pulling out a tool. 

The current price of $19.99 is too expensive for this due to the shoddy case. Nevertheless, the tools work well and are great.

title: The brush heads stink like paint; it would be a nice set otherwise
text:
There are 15 brushes in this set that are perfect for the eyes, lips, blush, and foundation. The bristles are super soft and feel great against my skin. The bristles also stay put in the brush. There are actually more brushes than one needs in this set, in my opinion. Nevertheless, I can't stand the smell of the bristles. They smell like a solvent or paint.

The current price of $15.99 comes to a reasonable $1.07 per brush.

title: Attractive 3 large & 1 medium clip; holds a lot of hair
text:
There are three large hair clips in this package along with one medium square clip. I love the square clip because it holds very well. Two of the large clips have a non-slip matte finish and one is glossy. All the clips open easily. The large clips hold a lot of hair but they do not hold as well as the medium one which really grips the hair due to the design. These clips stay put in my hair but are best for those who have longer hair.

The current price of $7.64 is on the high side of competitively priced $1.91 per clip.

title: Good brush for young girls or travel; however, brush stinks
text:
This is a nice, cute, small brush for young girls or for adults that want to travel with a small brush. The handle is small and the head is big. The brush glides easily through my short to medium-length curly hair. This comes with a burlap carry case that fits most of the brush except for the top of the handle. Unfortunately, the brush smells something awful and that is headache producing. This will have to be aired out a while.

The current price of $11.98 is competitive for a boar bristle brush.

title: Great silicone scrubber for face or hands; not exfoliating but cleansing
text: There is one silicone scrubber in the box. The current price of $8.39 is a bit pricey for this but it is designed well and is very sturdy. I used this with soap and water and it lathers the soap up and scrubs my face and hands easily. It is extremely cleansing but I would not call it exfoliating. I consider it more of a massage and cleansing tool than an exfoliator. I do love it. The handle provides a firm grip on the brush. Personally, I use this for scrubbing my hands with soap and water.

title: Truly fogless mirror but if it falls off shower wall, it will probably break
text:
This mirror is definitely fogless as it did not fog up in my shower. It was easy to apply to my shower wall. However, I do worry that this will eventually fall. I keep pressing on the suction to ensure it stays. If it falls it will probably break. Only time will tell if this falls; right now it is still sticking fine.

The mirror itself is great. I love that I can tilt it a little bit up or down (not 360 degrees) as it sits about two inches away from the shower wall.

The current price of $17.09 ($18.99 minus 10%) is reasonable for this mirror.

title: Highly hydrating to my face and neck but I do not care for the fragrance
text: I love this night cream in every way except for the scent. I applied this to my face and neck (avoiding my eye area) and felt super hydrated after this soaked in. It is a lovely cream in that regard. Unfortunately, the scent is a turnoff to me and is the only reason I rated this 3 stars as the current $19.99 price is reasonable.

title: Attractive & 6 super large clips & 2 medium ones; holds a lot of hair
text:
There are six large hair clips in this package along with two medium square clips. I love the square clips because they hold very well. Four of the large clips have a non-slip matte finish and two are glossy. The glossy clips I found a bit difficult to open. The matte ones opened fine. The large clips hold a lot of hair but they do not hold as well as the medium ones which really grip the hair due to the design. These clips stay put in my hair but are best for those who have longer hair.

Note that the colors of these clips are more muted in person than on the website. For example, the clip that looks pink on the website is actually a muted mauve in person.

The current price of $11.66 ($10.79 minus 10%) is on the low side of competitively priced $1.35 per clip.

title: Large, slim-profile pocket mirror; light not dimmable; USB cable too short
text:
This mirror has a slim profile but is large for a pocket mirror, measuring 5-1/8 by 3-1/2 inches. The USB charging cable is about 11-1/2 inches and very short.

There is no charging light. I charged this for a few hours. The compact has a close-up mirror on bottom and regular one on top. The top mirror has a touch button for the light. It is not dimmable even though the instructions say it is. I tried to dim the light and could not.

Also, closing the mirror does not turn the light off. I had to press the button to turn out the light. In addition, the mirror's surface is difficult to clean. I had a lot of trouble cleaning my smudges off the mirror.

This is functional and I like how thin it is. Also, the larger footprint provides me with more surface area for viewing my reflection. Nevertheless, I consider the current price of $29.98 outrageous for this, especially since it does not dim, has no charging light, and comes with a short cable.

title: Great set for precision POWDER eye blending
text:
There are 15 small headed brushes in this set that are perfect for blending eyeshadow powders. One is a mascara wand that can double for the eyelashes or brow. The bristles are super soft and feel great against my eyelids. There are actually more brushes than one needs in this set, in my opinion. Nevertheless, the current price of $13.99 comes to a reasonable $.93 per brush.

One other thing I like is that the set comes with a user guide describing the use of all the brushes.

title: Small oval brush that is good for highlighting cheeks or blending; love the cover; too $$$
text:
This is a tiny oval brush that comes with a cover. The handle is just slightly flexible but is definitely not bendable as is shown on the Amazon site--unless, of course, one wants to break their brush.

The bristles are soft and feel good against my face. Initially, there were just a few bristles that fell out but that seems to have stabilized. I use brushes like these to highlight my cheeks and to blend a darker cheek powder into the overall blush being used as the main color.

The current price of $6.99 is too pricey for this in my opinion. I feel this brush should not be more than $3.99 based on the quality and function.

title: Brush is easy to hold onto; very much like the  URTHEONE brushes I love; quick assembly required
text:
I already own these [[ASIN:B08BNHZ833URTHEONE detangling brushes]] and love them. However, most are green, pink, and black so I wanted to try this red one. This red detangling brush comes with one rod that needs to be installed, so I installed it on the upper rung. 

I use my other brushes every other day to detangle my hair in the shower and love them and this red one is as great. First of all the handle is non-slip and feels great to hold. I do not lose the grip on this brush. Second, the rod that gets installed only has four nubs on it that connect with the tines of the brush which makes for a securer fit; some brushes like these only have two nubs. This means it stays put. It works well on detangling my short to medium curly hair in the shower and if some hair gets caught, it easily rinses out. In addition, this can be used as a regular brush too. 

The current price of $14.99 is super EXPENSIVE for this brush as most brushes like these range from $5.99 to $7.99. This is the only reason I rated it 4 stars.

title: Hair scrunchies are small; they also smell; works well otherwise
text:
These hair scrunchies are very nice, soft, small, and attractive. There is an elastic beaded center (at least it feels like that) which stretches. The ties have an offensive smell. They are also not as large as I expected.

The current price of $7.99 for two ties comes to a pricey $4 per scrunchie.

title: Attractive & super large clips; holds a lot of hair; more expensive than similar brands
text:
These hair clips are large and come in a presentable package. There are six clips in total. There are four with a matte finish with one each of black, olive, blue, mauve, and light mauve. There are two in a sort of subdued glossy finish with one each in brown spotted with black and tan spotted with black. In addition, there is a tiny and cheap wooden comb which I personally do not care for.

The clips are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like them all. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

The current price of $15.72 ($17.27 minus 9%) is on the high side and comes to $2.62 per clip. There are similar hair clips on the market that look the same and sell for $5 less (minus the cheap comb) like the ABUNRO clips under Amazon item # B08RS3CT5R.

title: Attractive & super large clips; holds a lot of hair; clips have matte finish
text:
These hair clips are large and come in a presentable package. There are six clips in total with one each of black, olive, blue, tanish-orange, mauve, and light mauve.

These are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like the matte finish. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

The current price of $11.66 is a competitively priced $1.94 per clip.

title: Super large and strong clips; holds a lot of hair
text: These hair clips are huge. These are nothing super gorgeous but they are functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair.  They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge. I personally love the colors. Also, the current price of $6.99 is reasonably priced at $1.75 per clip.

title: Love the bath sponges; back brush is good too but would have liked a longer handle
text:
I love these netted bath "sponges" and the back brush. These types result in a lot of suds, which is my favorite thing about these. My only disappointment is that the back brush handle is short. I would have liked it about two to three inches longer.

The current price of $10.79 ($11.99 minus  10%) is priced about right for this ensemble.

UPDATE 5/17/2021 - I had to throw the back brush out because the loofah really loosened quickly. As a result, I lowered my ranking to 3 stars. This only lasted about one month when I expect to get six months out of these back brushes.

title: Good, hefty brush with long handle with great grip & two brush sides
text:
I tried several brushes over the last several months and love the KOZIS Wooden Bath Brush (Amazon item # B08HR2GBHC) the best. However, this one is very good too.

The brush head on both sides is ample for good coverage and gentle. The bristles are of medium softness. The brush is hefty and is one solid piece, which is fabulous as the head cannot fall off the handle like some other brushes I tried previously. However, there is a gap between the brush head and handle on one side where water gets caught. The handle of this back brush has grips on it which provides me with a great hold. It also has a rope loop to hang up in the shower. 

Overall, I like this brush even though it comes in second to the KOZIS I love. The current price of $7.99 is very reasonable for a two-sided wooden brush. Only time will tell if the brush head falls off where the space is located.

title: Soft quality headbands that feel great on; 2 dust masks included
text:
There are 10 quality headbands in this set. The headbands are SUPER SOFT that I just want to feel them all day. They look great on and there is a solid color for almost every outfit. 

I have short to medium-length fine curly hair and these work for me and are even better for someone with long hair.
 
The two masks that come with this are really dust masks. They are just cut out of one cloth. They are nothing great but it is a nice addition to the set.

The current price of $13.98 is a reasonable $1.40 per band if I consider the masks are free.

title: I love the feel of this brush; it detangles well; other items just okay
text:
There is one green detangling brush with one blue hair scrunchie and what looks like a rake that I assume is to use to clean out the hair from the brush.

I love the way this detangles in the shower. It works as a regular brush too. The handle has a nice feel, which allows me to grip this without it slipping out of my hands. Also, since the handle is wide, it feels great to hold.

The scrunchie is okay. I love the electric blue color. The rake is useless. It does nothing to remove the hair from the brush and only cheapens this set. That will be thrown out.

The current price of $11.99 is too much for this set. The brush is the star of the set and I can buy one at the local store for about $5.99.

title: Lovely scent; cream is light and leaves our skin feeling smooth but with a barrier we can feel
text: My boyfriend and I tried this and we both like it. It has a lovely fresh scent. The cream is light. It absorbs after a couple of minutes. When it dried, our skin felt silky soft but with a barrier that we can feel. This lotion is very nice and at the current price of $10.95 for 8.82 fluid ounces is very reasonable.

title: Attractive & super large clips; holds a lot of hair; clips have matte finish
text:
These hair clips are large and come in a presentable package. There are six clips in total with three in black and one each in navy, pink, and olive.

These are very functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. I like the matte finish. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

The current price of $9.99 is a reasonably priced $1.67 per clip.

title: Super large and strong clips; holds a lot of hair
text:
These hair clips are huge. They come intertwined together as can be seen in my photo. I almost felt like I was going to break them as I took them apart. Thankfully, I was able to separate them in one piece.

These are nothing super gorgeous but they are functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair.  They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge. I personally love the clear brown clip as that is my color for hair clips.

The current price of $7.19 ($8.99 minus 20%) is reasonably priced at $1.80 per clip.

title: Jellyfish-inspired clips; unique & beautiful; very tight & difficult to work with – 3.5 stars
text:
These clips are unique and beautiful. They remind me of swimming jellyfish. There are six colorful clips in what I refer to as autumn colors. These do take effort to open. However, these clips hold exceptionally well. I have short to medium length fine curly hair and they held my hair tight. I really love the style to these clips. I am concerned about their longevity because they are so hard to open that I feel they might break if I press too hard.

The current price of $16.99 is on the high side of competitive for this.

title: Clipper edge is sharp & I do not have to set the arms to get spring action
text:
This is a nice clipper. I just removed the cap from the top and used it immediately. I did not have to seat any side arms as is typical of most clippers of this type. It cut my nails easily with this. I also love the handle and how easy it is to hold and maintain a grip on it. In order to close this for storage, I had to seat the clear plastic cap on top.

The current price of $12.39 is competitively priced. BTW, do note that my clippers have a black handle. The clipper pictured on Amazon seems to have a navy blue handle. I assume I received the same clipper but with a different color handle. I hope the vendor is not doing a bait and switch.

title: Typical eyelash curler; no additional replacements provided
text:
This is a simple eyelash curler that is typical of many on the market. There is no spring action; this works with my fingers only as is typical of a very basic curler. I love how easy this is to use. It curls well and gently. There are no extra silicone replacement refill pads provided. It is just the curler and nothing else.

The current price of $1.99 is very cheap but this is a basic cheap curler. For that price and its current function, it gets 5 stars from me.

title: I like these 5 round blenders for make-up application & I love the colors
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. There are 5 multi-colored egg-shaped sponges in total. I LOVE THE COLORS. The large round edge is good for make-up application on the cheeks and the pointed tip is great for blending around the eye area or cheekbones.  I love how soft these are against my skin. What I do not like is that they smell like pencil shavings.

The current price of $9.99 for 5 blending sponges is a tad pricey at $2 each. They sell a 10-pack of sponges for the same price and it comes with 5 sponges like these and 5 with a flat edge which is my preferred style.

title: I like these 5 round blenders for make-up application
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. There are 5 black egg-shaped sponges in total. The round edge ones are good for make-up application on the cheeks and the pointed tip is great for blending around the eye area or cheekbones.  I love how soft these are against my skin. 

Another plus is that these sponges do not have any smell to them like their colored version has. The current price of $9.99 for 5 blending sponges is a tad pricey at $2 each. They sell a 10-pack of sponges for the same price and it comes with 5 sponges like these and 5 with a flat edge which is my preferred style.

title: Super hydrating cream; virtually scentless; takes a few minutes to soak in
text:
I love this cream. It has a nice creamy consistency and is super hydrating. I consider this perfect for winter. It is also virtually scentless. It does take about 10 minutes for the cream to soak in. I used this on my face and neck and avoided the eye area. At the current price of $15.99, this is very reasonable. It comes in an attractive jar with a tiny plastic "scoop" for use with the 1.7 ounces of product.

In addition to the above, this is vegan and cruelty free.

title: I just LOVE this brush; handle is ergonomic; brush is incredibly expensive
text: This brush is incredible. I ordered the one for thick hair even though I have fine curly hair. The thick brush has longer and thicker bristles (per the box). This effortlessly glides through my hair. The handle is ergonomically designed and feels great to hold. It has a soft finish to prevent slippage. I also love the heft of this brush. There are only two negatives. First, the brush smells of chemicals, so I have to air it out. Second, the current price of $35 is insane. For a brush of this caliber, I would not expect to pay more than $18 to $20 simply because it is a synthetic brush and there are no boar bristles or anything that is typically expensive. The price and smell are the only reason I took off one star. In every other way, this brush is beyond fabulous!

title: I love that all these blenders have a flat edge; they work well
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. However, what I really love is that all of them have a flat edge which makes some make-up applications easier. I love how soft they are against my skin. Due to the edging, they are also easier to hold. In addition, I adore the five vibrant colors.

The sponges do have a bit of a smell to them; like pencil shavings. However, it is only obvious if I put my nose up to the foam.

The current price of $9.99 is reasonable for five blending sponges as that comes to $2 each.

title: Love the fragrance of this conditioner; hydrates well
text:
I love the fragrance of this conditioner. I love how this is not too thick. It rinses off well and leaves my hair hydrated but not so hydrated that it relaxes my curls. I have fine curly hair that is now medium-length and I really like the results of this conditioner on my hair.

There are four 16-ounce bottles in this shipment and at the current price of $23.96 comes to  a reasonable $5.99 per bottle.

title: Lacks fragrance; a bit too moisturizing for me; a good shampoo otherwise
text:
There are four 20-ounce bottles of shampoo in the shipment. The shampoo is so creamy that it reminds me of conditioner and not shampoo. It lacks any strong fragrance and I like fragrance. It lathers well enough but not as good as shampoos that are less moisturizing. I have fine curly medium-length hair and this relaxed my curls a touch. After using this, I did not feel like I needed a conditioner. It is a good shampoo otherwise.  It is too soon to tell whether it works on split ends or not. I would have to use this for a couple of months to determine that.

The current price of $19.88 comes to a reasonable $4.97 per bottle.

title: Low-end facial cleansing brush; feels cheap but works & price is excellent
text:
For the current price of $13.29 ($13.99 minus 5%), this is a decent facial cleansing tool with three brushes.

IN THE BOX:
- Cleansing wand 
- USB charging cable
- Stand
- Three cleansing brushes (standard brush, soft/sensitive brush, and soft sponge brush)
- User guide

Note that the instruction manual is very basic. I charged this for about three hours as recommended in the manual. There is no charging light on this unit, so it is impossible to tell when it is fully charged; I have to guess. In order to use this, I pulled off the brush head and inserted the brush I wanted (sensitive). To start the unit I just pressed the center button until the brush head rotated slowly. I then pressed the button one more time to set it on the fastest speed, which is more my style. Pressing the button again turns off the unit. The two cleaning speeds are where the brush head rotates slow or a little bit faster than slow. 

In summary, this is an excellent facial cleaning brush for such a super cheap price. Clean-up is easy by rinsing the wand and then the brush used. I'm careful water does not get into the charging hole. This unit does not have the bells and whistles of other brushes, such as a charging light or a heavier wand but it is perfect for someone who wants to try out a facial cleaning tool like this. Yes it feels cheap, but it works. As for longevity, who knows.

title: Brushes are nice; stand film needs to be removed; stickers must be compared w/photo on Amazon
text:
There are nine brushes in total, a stand that is in three pieces and has to be assembled, a set of stickers, and a carry pouch.

I really love these brushes. The geometric shape of the handles provide a good surface area for gripping each brush during application. The bristles are soft and they do not fall out of the brush. They feel great against my skin.

The stand that is provided appears unfinished but actually is not. The vendor contacted me via twitter after posting this review and told me that the film has to be removed from the stand to reveal the lacquered black finish as shown in the Amazon photo. Note that IT IS NOT EASY to remove that paper film. I actually broke a few of my nails trying to get the film up. Once I got a corner of the film away from the lacquer, pulling it off was easy.

With regard to the stand, I found it impossible to store the brushes upside down as pictured on Amazon. There isn't enough room to seat the brush this way if coming from underneath the stand.

The stickers are provided to label the brushes. However, one must use the photo on Amazon to figure out which brush is which before affixing the labels. I suggest affixing the stickers to the silver part of the brush instead of the handle.

The current price of $16.99 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: More brushes than I need for the eyes; love the color
text: I love the color of these brushes. There are 12 brushes for use with eyeshadow; one of which is a mascara/eyebrow wand. The bristles are soft and they do not fall out of the brush, which is always a plus. They are perfect for powder eyeshadow and blending around the eyes. I personally would only use a few of these and then save some for later as there are entirely too many brushes for me to use. The current price of $12.99 is competitive.

title: Nice moisturizing cream for the winter; love that it has SPF 25
text:
I tried their avocado cream and liked that even though it was a light green color. However, this cream I love. First of all, it is white. Second, it is thick and very moisturizing. I tried it on my face and neck and it soaked in after a while but left me with a nice barrier of hydration. Overall, I love the results and that it has SPF 25 in it. Since I do not go out in the sun much, I cannot say how protective it is.

The current price of $27.99 is reasonable for this 50 ml jar (1.69 ounces) jar. One thing I did not like is that the box mine came in was perfect but the interior cardboard was torn as if someone had tried this cream and returned it. This was the same ratty box interior I experienced with their avocado cream.

title: Presentable manicure set but some implements difficult to remove from case
text:
This set looks impressive and is extremely presentable. It has a lot of tools, many of which I do not use.

I use all the clippers the most and they cut well. The tweezers are aligned and pull chin and eyebrow hairs easily. The scissors are sharp and the cuticle cutter and file are good. I do not use the rest of the implements. However, my biggest complaint is the way these tools are packed in the case. In order to get to the nippers, I have to remove the nail clipper and then work the nippers up and down to remove it from the sleeve. The scissor is also tightly packed in. This really annoys me.

I do love the case. Note that the black plastic lock has to be removed before the case can be opened. 

The current price of $10.44 ($10.99 minus 5%) is reasonable for this. However, the difficulty removing certain tools from this case would have me pass on this.

title: Excellent travel brushes but a bit pricey
text: There are five small brushes in this set. I was attracted to it because of the lilac color, which matches my bathroom. The bristles are soft and do not fall out. The handle on the one blush brush is a bit tiny but still workable. This set is perfect for travel but really only includes brushes that I would use for blush and eyeshadow. I do feel the current price of $10.72 ($11.28 minus 5%) is a bit pricey for this. I would expect this to sell under $8.

title: A good enough travel set for the price but not great
text:
For the current price of $3.99, this is a good enough travel brush/mirror set for the price but it is not great. This set includes a combined brush/mirror, three spiral hair ties, and a large comb.

The spiral hair ties are okay and work to put my hair up into a little pony tail. The comb is big and not something I would travel with but it is a decent detangler for the shower. However, the main item is the brush/mirror combo. The mirror actually acts like the handle of the brush. First of all, using the mirror as the handle is awkward. Second, the brush is really tiny and would not be good for someone with a lot of hair. It passed through my short to medium-length fine curly hair just fine but I had to comb in very tiny strips. Third, it is not easy to collapse the brush into itself. I actually had to collapse it with my fingers. I thought just closing the mirror over the brush would work but it did not. Also, once closed, it wobbles on the counter.

title: Gorgeous shower caps but not adult size; these do not stay put on my small head
text: There are four double-layer shower caps in this set. They are absolutely gorgeous to me. Unfortunately, they do not fit my small head. They do not stay put at all because they are more kid-sized. The current price of $9.99 is excellent for this as it comes to $2.50 each. Unfortunately, these are being marketed as adult caps. If they were listed as kid-sized caps, I would have given them 5 stars. I cannot use these.

title: Perfect set for detangling and travel
text: There are three hair implements in this set. One large paddle brush, one small one, and one detangling brush. These brushes comb through my hair easily. The small one is perfect for travel. I had to assemble the detangling brush. This brush is perfect for combing wet hair in the shower. It glided through my hair. At the current price of $9.85, this comes to a slightly pricey $3.28 per piece.

title: Perfect set for detangling, travel, and updo with clip
text: There are four hair implements in this set. One large paddle brush, one small one, one detangling brush, and a hair clip. These brushes comb through my hair easily. I had to assemble the detangling brush. This brush is perfect for combing wet hair in the shower. It glided through my hair. The clip also holds well. At the current price of $10.89, this comes to a reasonable $2.72 per piece.

title: Presentable but low-end manicure set; clippers & scissor not great; nail cutters good
text:
This set looks impressive and is extremely presentable. It certainly has a lot of tools, many of which I do not use. The tools in the top set are the ones I use the most. The large handle nail clippers are really low end and do not work well. I have to move the arm in place but the spring action to close it is disjointed. Also the scissor is "sticky." The regular angular and other nail clippers are sharp and work well. The file is decent as is the cuticle cutter in the lower tool compartment. 

The case is nice and there is room for a couple of  thin pieces of paper (like some cash, credit cards, etc.) behind the lower tools. The current price of $9.59 ($15.98 minus 40%) is reasonable for this. However, if one uses the large handled clippers, I would say pass because they are faulty. The scissor is also not great.  The blue case and black tools makes this an attractive set for a male.

title: Fantastic for powder blush but not great for foundation
text:
This is a very short and dense bristle brush. The bristles stay in place, which is excellent. Since they are so densely packed together, it works well with powder blush. I do not like to use this for foundation because I prefer a brush that has more surface area.

I personally love the color and quality of this brush. It is also easy to work with. The current price of $6.64 ($6.99 minus 5%) is very reasonable for this makeup brush.

title: Lip balm is hydrating but I do not care for the sandy texture of the balm
text: At the current price of $14.99, this is way too expensive for this. This lip balm is definitely hydrating but I personally do not care for the sandy texture of this salve. After having tried this, I would not order this again.

title: Bare bones masks; elastic is not adjustable; price is right
text:
There were four of these masks in the package I received but apparently only three are supposed to be in the package unless the Amazon description is wrong.

The masks are thin and not really padded much. They do block out the light. My biggest complaint is the flimsy elastic. The elastic is not adjustable, so the mask does pull a little around the eyes.

These masks do work but they are not high end and are not the quality of mask I gravitate towards. At the current price of $9.95 it comes to $3.32 each or $2.49 if one receives four masks.

title: Nice moisturizing cream for the winter; has a light green tint; love that it has SPF
text:
I am usually put off by creams with color, especially when they are green or orange. This cream has a light green color. It is thick and very moisturizing. I tried it on my face and neck and it soaked in after a while but left me with a nice barrier of hydration. I'm glad the green color was not visible on my skin. Overall, I like this cream. I love that it has SPF in it. Since I do not go out in the sun much, I cannot say how protective it is.

The current price of $27.99 is reasonable for this 50 ml jar (1.69 ounces) jar. One thing I did not like is that the box mine came in was perfect but the interior cardboard was torn as if someone had tried this cream and returned it.

title: Strong smelling foot soak; stings my feet a bit
text:
Tea tree oil is extremely strong smelling and this smells like it is loaded with it. This oil has anti-bacterial and anti-fungal properties. I used three tablespoons per the instructions in my foot bath. The soak is both soothing and stinging. It does soften my feet and leave them feeling refreshed. Unfortunately, the tea tree oil fragrance with the other menthol-type oils (eucalyptus, peppermint, spearmint, etc.) added is just too much for my senses.

This is a 20-ounce jar of foot soak that should last me about two weeks as there are about 40 tablespoons in 20 ounces of product.

The current price of $14.48 ($16.48 minus $2) is competitively priced. I would personally prefer to make my own soak with a few drops of tea tree oil to one cup of Epsom Salt and bypass all those other menthol-type oils.

title: Love the clippers but the shield is pure garbage
text:
These clippers are sharp and they cut well. I also like the spring action. However, the red shield that comes with it is useless. It just kept falling off and one would think it is part of the packaging. Not only was the shield cracked but the magnet was stuck to the clippers (see photo). 

Although these clippers are great without the shield, the current price of $16.14 ($18.99 minus 15%) is expensive for these, especially when the red clip is just garbage. Why Revlon would pair such excellent clippers with such plastic junk that cracks and does not stay put is beyond my comprehension.

title: I love the 5 blenders with a flat edge; round ones are nice too
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. There are 10 sponges in total, 5 purple ones with a flat edge and 5 black ones that are rounded. I really love the five with a flat edge because it makes some make-up applications easier. The round edge ones are good too.  I love how soft these are against my skin. The flat ones are easier to hold. 

Another plus is that these sponges do not have any smell to them like their colored version has. The current price of $9.99 for 10 blending sponges is a steal as that comes to $1 each.

title: Multifunctional facial cleansing brush; skeptical of light claims
text:
For the current price of $29.99 ($39.99 minus $10 off), this is a superb facial cleansing tool with many functions.

IN THE BOX:
- Cleansing wand with cap cover
- USB charging cable
- Stand
- Five cleansing brushes (exfoliating brush, soft brush, silicone brush, soft sponge brush, and pumice brush)
- One drawstring carry bag that only fits the wand, cable, and one cleaning brush
- User guide

I charged this for about one hour until the charging light turned from red to blue. In order to use, I had to remove the cover on the wand and insert each brush I tried. There are three cleaning modes of gentle, daily, and deep cleaning. There are also two light modes. When the red light is engaged, it is supposed to stimulate collagen growth and reduce wrinkles. When the blue light is engaged, it is supposed to eliminate bacteria and prevent acne and blackheads.  I am personally skeptical of those light claims.

Note that the instruction manual is not very good but the information on the box is easier to understand. To start the unit I have to hold the mode button until it turns on. The same thing goes with the light button. Once these buttons are engaged, then a quick press changes the mode or the light. To turn off, once again it is a long press of both buttons.

There is only one brush head I hate and I think it is best used for the heels of the feet instead of the face. That "brush" is the pumice stone. I tried it on the tip of my chin and it felt like it was going to rip my skin off, so be careful.

In summary, I really love the number of brushes provided and the function of this unit. It charges fast as well. I do wish the carry case would hold everything comfortably but it does not. The pumice "brush," in my opinion, should never be used on the face. The current price is excellent for this unit's features. I tried other wands in the past that were in the $99 to $120 range that were less robust than this. Note that I have no idea how long these brush heads will last with use.

title: Beautiful hair dryer that does not fully work as designed; also arrived with the finish cracked
text:
The blow dryer is a gorgeous iridescent purple color and of medium heft. Besides the unit itself, it comes with a concentrator, a diffuser, and a user pamphlet. My first disappointment was that the finish is "cracked" at the business end of the blow dryer (see photo).  The crack is only paint-surface deep, but the finish should be flawless for the price they are asking. After use, I discovered my most major disappointment.

There is a cold shot button, a high-med-low heat button, and an off-low-high speed button and they all work as designed. It is important to press the red reset button on the plug before plugging this in or the blow dryer will not work. 

Unfortunately, this blow dryer only works with the diffuser end because once the diffuser end is applied, it CANNOT be removed. I first tried the blow dryer on its own. I then tried it with the concentrator. That is a bit tricky to get on and remove but it does come off. However, the diffuser end is stuck permanently on the unit. I tried over 20 minutes to remove it. This blow dryer is useless to me in this condition even though it does function.

In my opinion, even if everything worked beautifully, the current price of $69.99 is outrageously expensive for this. Had everything worked fine, I would have rated this 4 stars simply because I feel this is overpriced by $20 to $25.

title: I love that all these blenders have a flat edge; they work well
text:
These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. However, what I really love is that all of them have a flat edge which makes some make-up applications easier. I love how soft they are against my skin. Due to the edging, they are also easier to hold. In addition, I adore the five vibrant colors.

The sponges do have a bit of a smell to them; like pencil shavings. However, it is only obvious if I put my nose up to the foam.

The current price of $9.99 is reasonable for five blending sponges as that comes to $2 each.

title: Gorgeous headbands with lots of sparkle; may be uncomfortable with prolonged use
text:
These headbands are just stunning. They have lots of sparkle and it dresses up even mundane outfits. These would be perfect for formal affairs. It also comes with a pink cleaning cloth--I suppose to clean the stones.

The current price of $15.99 comes to a reasonable $8 per band. The only reason I took off one star is because I felt some pressure around my ear area after a bit of use.

title: Basic blow dryer; nothing special; had trouble starting it first few times
text:
The blow dryer is a beautiful pink color and lightweight. Besides the unit itself, it comes with a concentrator and user pamphlet.

There is a cold shot button, a high-med-low heat button, and an off-low-high speed button. The first few times I tried this I could not get this to work. I kept trying to press the reset button on the cord because it arrived sticking out. Finally after several unsuccessful attempts I got it to start.

It works fine like a basic blow dryer. The concentrator is a bit tricky to install at the tip but I was able to get it on and off several times. There is also a vent cover in the back that is easily removed and reseated for cleaning.

In summary, this blow dryer worked well once I got it working. I like that it is lightweight and has a sleek design. I do love the color. However, it is a basic, large blow dryer. I see nothing special about this until.  In my opinion, the current price of $54.99 is outrageously expensive for this especially since it feels cheap. For this price, they should have also included a diffuser head for the unit and not only a concentrator.

title: Unique brush that works well with both liquid & powder foundation
text:
I love unique items and this is certainly a uniquely designed brush in the shape of a tiny iron. I was skeptical if it would work on liquid foundation. However, it works well on both liquid and powder foundation. Due to the closeness of the very soft bristles, liquid foundation spreads evenly. What I really like this for, however, is to use the pointed end with powder blush and work from the jawbone down toward the face to highlight the cheeks with a darker shade of blush. The handle makes this easy to control during application.

In summary, this is a niche brush that is also a conversation piece. It is definitely not going to be for everyone but I personally like the quirkiness and functionality of this little treasure.  The current price of $5.49 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Extremely attractive & large clips; holds a lot of hair
text:
There are two hair clips in this package along with a package of bobby pins and one elastic tie.

The hair clips are just gorgeous. sturdy, and they hold a lot of hair. They also do not feel cheap and they look elegant due to the glossy finish and color. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

Unfortunately, the current price of $14.99 is way too expensive for these as that comes to $7.50 per clip. Even though they look and feel great, I feel they should be priced at no higher than $5 per clip.

title: Nice set; nail clipper is the best part of it
text:
This set includes a really sharp and ergonomically designed nail clipper, a small file, and a cuticle trimmer.

The nail clipper feels great to hold and cuts exceptionally well. The file works nicely too and I usually do not like metal files; however, it is very small. The cuticle trimmer is okay. It does not work on my cuticles because I have thick cuticles and this is best for thinner cuticles.

What I do not like about this set is the container it comes in. The foam holds the tools so tight it is almost impossible to get them out of the display without having another tool to extricate them. Other than this, this is a nice set.

The current price of $12.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this set.

title: Excellent applicators for masks, ointments, foundation, etc.
text:
I have been recently getting into applicators like this to apply ointments on a scar. There are three applicators in this package with a scoop on one end and two with a brush on the other end and one with a silicone tip. The silicone tip is great for smooth applications. The brush is soft and works well too; it does require more cleaning than the silicone tip, however.

I do like the scooped ends because I use that to scoop out the product (mask, etc.). The only problem I have with that is that because of the indentation in the scoop, it is not always easy to get all the product out of the scoop unless I am putting it on my chin. Be aware that some product may be left behind and using one's fingers to remove it, defeats the purpose of the scoop in the first place.

The current price of $9.99 is a competitive $3.33 each.

title: Has almost every make-up brush one needs; case & brushes do have smell to them
text:
There are a total of 18 brushes in this set. Also included is a small silicone disk to be used when scrubbing one's face. The folding case it comes feels cheap but is fully functional.

The selection of  brushes is outstanding. The bristles are soft and the brushes work well. There are 10 thin bristle brushes that are mostly perfect for applying eyeshadow and one for applying lipstick or lip liner. There are four brushes good for powder blush or powder foundation. There is one mascara wand and an eyebrow comb/brush combo.  In addition, my most favorite brush of all is the super large fan brush. This is perfect for dusting translucent powder over the face to set my make-up. In addition, there is one regular fan brush of the type that I use to blend eyeshadow. The bristles stay in the brushes with the exception of the eyebrow brush that had a few bristles that fell out. However, it stopped shedding after the first few.

In summary, this is a nice brush set with a cheaply made case but is typical of what I expect at the bargain basement price of $11.99. The only negative with this set is that the bristles and case smells. If it did not smell, I would have given this 5 stars.

title: Attractive & super large clips; holds a lot of hair
text:
These hair clips are huge. They come intertwined together as can be seen in my photo. I almost felt like I was going to break them as I took them apart. Thankfully, I was able to separate them in one piece.

These clips are gorgeous and functional. They feel sturdy and hold a lot of hair. Even though these are cheaply made banana clips, they look elegant due to the glossy finish and color. They stayed put in my hair. I do not have long hair like some, but still they did not budge.

The current price of $7.55 ($8.99 minus 15%) is a competitively priced $3.77 per clip.

title: Definitely not elegant but very functional clips; holds a lot of hair
text: There are six clips in this package and one cheap elastic that cheapens this set, in my opinion. Four of them have a non-slip finish and the other two (cream and tortoise) have a shiny finish. They are sturdy clips and hold a lot of hair. However, they are not elegant. The only one that looks stylish is the tortoiseshell one. The current price of $10.44 ($10.99 minus 5%) is reasonable for this as it comes to $1.74 per clip.

title: Like a compact brush head without handle; non-slip base provides good grip
text: I like this brush as it is like having a full-size detangling brush but without the long handle. The base is non-slip and has a wonderful feel to it, so that provides me with a good grip. The detangler I received had some misshapen bristles but that did not deter from its function. It glided easily through my fine curly short to medium-length hair. This is even better in the shower on wet hair.  The only reason I rated this 3 stars is because I feel the current price of $8.99 is about $5 too much for this brush. If it were not so expensive, it would have received 4 stars from me.

title: Beautiful nylon boar bristle brush; perfect for traveling
text:
This is a gorgeous brush and it's perfect for travel since it is so small.  Despite its size, It is easy to hold and glides right through my fine short to medium-length curly hair. Everything about this brush screams quality. I also like that none of the boar bristles are falling out like is typical with their brushes.

The current price of $27.45 is expensive for this but that is the going rate for most quality boar bristle brushes.

title: Clipper edge is sharp; file is nice to have esp. with “hook;” adjustment on clippers is tricky
text:
This is a nice clipper set. It comes with the tough and sharp nail clipper and a file with a hook on the end to pull up the nail on the ingrown toenail. I attached photos of how the clipper "internal arms" need to be seated so that they can be used correctly. At first I had trouble adjusting them with the appropriate spring action; however, after I realized the left adjuster goes under the right, it worked wonderfully.

It cut my hard toenail easily but I had to be very careful when I closed the blade around the nail because I did not want to cut my skin.

This also comes in a nice box and is competitively priced at $12.34 ($12.99 minus 5%).

title: I ordered these to apply translucent powder; I would not use this as make-up removers
text:
When I saw these, I felt they would be perfect for applying translucent powder to set foundation. In my opinion, applying talcum powder on the body or translucent powder is all these should be used for.

There are four padding sponges in the set and a lingerie bag is included for washing.  Two sponges are terry cloth and two are furry. They are soft and are great for powders. I personally would not use this for make-up removal due to the thickness and the sponge sewn inside the cloth.  I find these too thick to wash my face with them.

The current price of $11.99 ($19.98 minus 40%) is extremely reasonable for this set, especially since it comes with a small lingerie bag.

title: Excellent & perfectly aligned tweezers; love the addition of the scissors
text:
This  tweezer set is excellent. There are four different types of tweezers in the case and one small scissor. The tweezers are:

- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they worked perfectly. The ends are perfectly aligned so that I can easily pull any wayward hairs with any of these four implements. The scissor is a bonus and is sharp and cuts well for small jobs. The yellow case  is nice enough and holds all the implements. 

The current price of $9.99 is excellent for this tweezer set.

title: Excellent & perfectly aligned tweezers; love the addition of the scissors; exciting colors
text:
This  tweezer set is excellent. There are four different types of tweezers in the case and one small scissor. I absolutely love the multiple colors.

The tweezers are:

- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they worked perfectly. The ends are perfectly aligned so that I can easily pull any wayward hairs with any of these four implements. The scissor is a bonus and is sharp and cuts well for small jobs. The yellow case  is nice enough and holds all the implements. 

The current price of $9.99 is excellent for this tweezer set.

This  tweezer set is excellent. There are four different types of tweezers in the case and one small scissor. The tweezers are:

- slant tip - also good for eyebrows

The current price of $9.99 is excellent for this tweezer set.

title: Remarkably excellent tweezers; the entire set is perfectly aligned
text:
This Pafason tweezer set is excellent. There are four different types of tweezers in the case. They are:

- flat tip - typical tweezers most people know; good for grooming and removing hairs
- point slant tip - good for eyebrows and difficult hairs
- slant tip - also good for eyebrows
- point tip - for precision extraction of fine hairs

I tried all four and they worked perfectly. The ends are perfectly aligned so that I can easily pull any wayward hairs with any of these four implements. The case has a snap closure and there is a pocket behind and in front of the tweezers that can be used to store a couple of bills, credit card, etc.

The current price of $10.99 is excellent for this tweezer set.

title: Cooling & moisturizing; takes a few minutes to absorb
text:
There are two 8.45 fluid ounce pump bottles in this set for the current price of $11.04 ($12.99 minus 15%), which comes to $5.52 per bottle.

This works just like every other aloe vera gel I tried previously. It is cooling to my skin, smells nice, and is moisturizing. It does take a few minutes to absorb. I always find that during that time, the gel is sticky and this one is no different. After about five minutes, my skin feels like silk.

One thing I do not like is that the gel leaks out of the base of the pump rim, so I have to make sure this stays upright.

title: I don’t like the smell or cleaning power of this wash; pump also sticks
text:
I tried this during my shower on part of my body. I could not stand it, that I had to stop. The aroma is unpleasant, the wash does not lather well at all, and I do not feel clean afterward. I definitely do not want to use this anymore on my body and absolutely would not use this for my hair after having tried this. In addition, the pump also sticks on this bottle which is another negative.

Note that it is 99.6% plant based and is considered vegan. The current price of $14.99 is expensive for 250 ml (8.454 fluid ounces).

title: Exceptionally functional brushes; a great set at a great price
text:
I recently ordered the Oneleaf Standing Makeup Brushes (Amazon item # B08FQMQNP3) which are priced at $42.99. but I consider this set is a substantially better deal and it contains more brushes.

There are 14 make-up brushes in this set. This is an attractive brush set. The bristles are soft and they do not fall out, which is great. Their soft bristles feel great against my skin and work like many other brushes I tried previously. I like that they stand up; however, they are easy to knock over as well. I actually had them produce a domino effect by accidentally tipping over one brush which then caused many of the other brushes to fall down.

In addition to the brushes, the pink blender sponge that included is wonderful. It has a wide surface area to provide for a good foundation application. There is also a slant side for more detailed work. Also, a brush scrubber / cleaner is included.

This set thought of almost everything.  There are a few other brushes it does not have, but for the price, I think what is supplied is sufficient. For example, I could have also used a fan brush, a larger blush brush, several lip liner brushes, and perhaps a mascara wand brush. Nevertheless, at the current price of $16.19 ($17.99 minus 10%), this set is a steal and there is money left over to buy those other brushes separately.

title: Beautiful velvet bows that holds a small amount of hair; looks great on
text:
These bows are large, beautiful, and simple, yet elegant and are perfect for those with longer hair. There are four bows (yellow, green, burgundy, and black), a package of bobby pins, and a multi-colored elastic. I feel the bobby pins and the elastic cheapens this set. Nevertheless, the bows themselves are great.

They have a squeeze release type closure. I have short to medium length hair and each bow held on extremely well.

The current price of $13.99 is reasonable for this set as it comes to $3.50 per bow.

title: Tiny, soft wash circles; like a silver dollar pancake washcloth
text:
There are 20 silver dollar pancake sized washcloths in this package along with a lingerie bag and instruction card. These are super soft and velvety and work like washcloths do in that I have to put soap on them to wash my face or use them with the soap to remove make-up. Scrubbing with them is pleasant because of the luxurious feel. Although the instructions say to wash them first, I did not bother doing that. I believe in washing them after use in the lingerie bag and then laying them flat to dry.

The current price of $8.45 ($8.99 minus 6%) is a reasonable $.42 cents each circle with the lingerie bag for washing thrown in as a freebie. Note that lingerie bags are usually around $3 to $4 each, so this is a great deal.

title: Leaves my skin smooth and silky but I do not care for this lavender fragrance
text: This eight fluid ounce bottle of oil is wrapped extremely well in plastic to avoid leakage. The oil is light and thin but does moisturize and leave my skin silky. Unfortunately, I do not care for this lavender fragrance. The current price of $12.97 is reasonable for this.

title: Extremely lightweight detangling brush; feels great to hold and use
text:
In this package is an extremely lightweight detangling brush, a pick, hair elastic with cat face, and some nail art stickers. The elastic and nail art is just thrown in and I consider it marginal. The pick, which I do not normally use on my curly hair, actually feels great in my hands because of the slender top that flares out. My favorite item is the brush. It passes through my fine curly hair easily and feels fantastic to hold due to the matte finish on the handle. The products (brush, comb, etc.) are really low-end items but they work well.

I personally feel $9.99 is too much for this set. Based on the quality, I do not feel this set is worth more than $5.99 as I can get a similar brush at my local store for even less than that. Other than this, I do like both the brush and pick.

title: Tiny, soft washcloths & nothing more; NOT EXFOLIATING
text:
There are six tiny and super soft and velvety washcloths in this package. Three are vibrant red and three are a deep black. They work like washcloths do in that I have to put soap on them and wash my face, make-up, etc. off my face. Scrubbing with them is pleasant because they are super soft. However, they are not exfoliating at all.

The current price of $8.49 is a pricey $1.42 for what amounts to a Kraft singles size square of cloth.  I wash these type cloths in a lingerie bag and lay flat to dry. I do not recommend putting these in the dryer.

title: Low-end set good enough for a young girl just getting into make-up if priced less than $8
text:
I have no idea how much this set will be priced at. However, anything more than $8 would be too much. It is a reasonable low-end set that is good for a young girl just starting to play with make-up.

The case it comes in is cheap but reminds me of a style a ballerina would want. The ribbon is similar to those on ballet shoes.  There is a generous selection of  11 brushes inside. The bristles are soft and the brushes work well. There are seven thin bristle brushes that are mostly perfect for applying eyeshadow and one for applying lipstick or lip liner. There are four brushes good for powder blush or powder foundation. The bristles stay in the brush and have not yet fallen out, which is good.  I remember one time I purchased one brush at CVS for over $20 and the bristles fell out on first use, so it is important to me that they stay put.

In summary, this is a cheaply made set with a cheap case. However, it does the job and is a good set for a young girl just starting on her make-up journey. However, I do not know how much this will be priced at. I personally do not feel this is worth more than $8.  For example, this 10-piece make-up brush set by ZBFYZQ (Amazon item # B08KVYNBRH) is $5.99 and I think the brushes of that set are a tad better but this case has more style, particularly for a very young ballerina.

title: Low-budget, cheap brushes – one brush fell apart during first use
text:
The picture on Amazon looks better than in person. The green is not as vibrant. I also feel the current price of $9.99 is outrageous for this set. 

There are 11 brushes in this set. The brush heads are very soft against my skin and they work like ordinary make-up brushes. I ordered this set because I wanted some very thin bristle brushes and this set has seven of those which is perfect for eyeshadow and the lips. The bristles also stay in the brush, at least so far, which is good.

However, the brushes feel very cheap and the handles are in two pieces. This means they will have a tendency to come unglued and fall apart. The first brush I was going to use fell apart in two pieces (see photo); I had to glue it back together.

In summary, I am not impressed with this set. I do not like how the color is not as vibrant on the Amazon site. The bristles are okay but the handles are not great and can fall apart.

title: An excellent brush but the bristles keep shedding
text:
The brush feels and looks excellent. The bristles are rigid enough to clean dirty nails and hands but not too rigid as to hurt my hands. Unfortunately, from the first moment I used this, the bristles started to fall out. Every single time I rubbed my hand on the brush, more bristles would fall out. If the bristles stayed put, I think a reasonable price would be around $18 and not $27.95 for such a tiny item.

Boar bristle is normally expensive but it is such a small brush for the price. Based on some of my research, animal hair brushes do shed and eventually are supposed to stop shedding after lots of use. I have one of their hair brushes and it still hasn't stopped shedding. Unfortunately, I cannot vouch for this brand's shedding history, so if one is familiar with this type brush and it eventually stops, then I can say this is an absolutely excellent brush.

title: Low-budget but excellent set for the price; love all the small brushes
text: At the current price of $5.99 this set is excellent. If it were priced more than $9, I would not be saying that. The case it comes in is cheap. However, there are a nice set of 10 brushes inside. They feel very soft against my skin and they work well. I ordered this set because I wanted some very thin bristle brushes and this set has seven of those which is perfect for eyeshadow and the lips. So far the bristles stay in the brush and have not fallen out.

title: Odd but wonderful brush; super large and perfect for blow drying long hair
text:
This brush is odd in that it has a slight curvature but is large. I found it a bit awkward to use at the beginning. However, it is wonderful after I got the hang of it. Unfortunately, I have short to medium-length hair and this is best for those with long locks who want to grab hold of their hair and display outward with a vent brush for blow drying.

The current price of $9.99 is also reasonable for this. In addition to the brush, two clips are provided. They are okay but nothing special really.

title: Nice decorative scrunchies but a bit pricey for what this is
text: There are three pretty polka dot organza scrunchies in this set along with a few bobby pins, and three black elastic hair ties. The ribbons are really pretty and well made and they hold well. I can see someone wearing this to an elegant affair as long as they have a complementary outfit.  However, the current price of $19.99 is a bit outrageous for this. Right now with the 42% coupon, it can be purchased for $11.59 but I still consider that pricey. This is the only reason I rated this 3 stars. If this sold for $9 or under this would have received 5 stars from me.

title: I love this for applying blush & fish tail provides a great grip
text:
I love this small make-up brush for four reasons:

1 - The bristles are soft yet firm because they are tightly packed into the fish head. This is just perfect for applying blush because there is a ridgeness to it yet the bristles overall are comfortably soft. The design of this brush does not make this good for applying powder foundation or setting translucent powder.

2- The fish tail allows me to maintain a firm grip on this during use.

3 - The bristles do not fall out; at least they haven't yet.

4 - I just love artistic, colorful, and whimsical items. This is all three.

The current price of $7.99 is competitively priced.

title: Disposable – this brush won’t last because the bristles fall out at every use
text: The brush feels okay in my hands and brushes well but leaves static cling behind in cold weather with low humidity. However, the moment I used this, the bristles started to fall out. Every single time I rubbed my hand on the brush, more bristles would fall out. My opinion is to avoid this. It will probably last several weeks but it is certainly not worth the $29.95 price they are asking.  I would consider this brush disposable and any price more than $1 is robbery as this will have to be thrown out soon.

title: Very nice brush for powder blush or foundation; a bit smaller than I expected
text:
I really like this brush for applying powder or smoothing out translucent powder on my face. It is a bit smaller than I expected, however. So far the bristles are staying in the brush and it is not shedding like some other brushes I tried before this.

The current price of $4.95 is reasonable for this.

title: Absorbs well and moisturizers; I like the retinol PM one the best
text:
There is a 1.7 ounce pump container of collagen and elastin moisturizer for application on the face and neck morning and/or evening. There is also a trial size of Retinol PM which can also be applied on the face and neck. I avoided the eye area for both creams.

The moisturizer absorbs well and is creamy with a bit of light and airy feel. It did leave my face and neck feeling hydrated. The retinol PM is a bit thicker and I really like that. It goes on smooth and is very moisturizing. Both products have a faint aroma but dry scentless.

I personally love Olay Total Effects 7-in-1 Anti Aging Cream more than this combo and it is a lot cheaper. At the current price of $34, this is priced on the high end.

title: Lightly moisturizing to my eye bags but did not improve them; nice fragrance
text:
I know this is for a man but a woman can use this. I like men's products due to their fragrance. This has the nice fragrance of after shave. It comes out in a clear gel. For several days I put this under and around my eyes. I found it slightly moisturizing but it did not improve my eye bags; it only moisturized them. Unfortunately, this product does nothing for me. I have enough moisturizers that will do better.

The current price of $19 would be reasonable if this worked for me.

title: Hydrates my face and neck; love the fragrance
text:
This is a 1.7 ounce pump bottle of face cream. The pump bottle is very similar to Oil of Olay Total Effects in a pump bottle.

The cream has a medium consistency I love and a nice fragrance. I applied this to my face and neck and it took about five minutes to absorb. I would have preferred if it absorbed quicker. Despite this, it left my face and neck feeling hydrated and also soft.

The current price of $14.99 is very reasonable for this cream.

title: Sharp clippers with excellent grip; tiny metal nail file on each clipper
text: I love these little clippers. There's both a toenail and fingernail clipper. The blades are surprisingly sharp, the handles provide a good grip, and there is even a tiny metal nail file on each clipper. I personally do not use metal nail files, but it is good to have one in a pinch. In addition, the colors match my purple bathroom. The current price of $7.99 for this set comes to a pricey $4 per clipper. Overall, I really like these clippers but the price is steep.

title: Good containers for creams, balms, spices, coffee, loose tea, etc.; tops do loosen
text:
There are 21 small containers in total that comfortably holds 1.5 tablespoons of product in the following denominations:
- 3 slightly transparent blue
- 3 clear
- 3 solid yellow
- 4 solid white
- 4 slightly transparent green
- 4 slightly transparent pink

Because these are small, they are perfect for traveling or for use to give away ground coffee samples (for one cup of coffee) or tea samples (for one to two cups of tea), spice samples, small serving of nuts, etc. These do not only have to be used for salves, creams, and lip balms even though that is its typical use.

Each container has an interior lip with tab pull top to keep what is inside fresh. The lids do loosen somewhat if jumbled around in a purse or bag.

Overall, these are super functional for the right application and the current price of $6.80 comes to a reasonable $.32+ cents per container.

title: Like the body sponge but not the shower brush; colors of both items don’t match
text:
This set comes with two self-stick hooks, a silicone back brush, and silicone body sponge. I personally wash with those mesh body puffs in the shower because they lather well. However, sometimes I want a silicone body sponge like this. What I like about the body sponge is that the interior sponge soaks up the soap and the silicone nubs provide exfoliating action. It does not produce the suds of a nylon body puff but this is more for exfoliation and massage. This body brush works well. However, the back brush's interior sponge is too thin and there is so much silicone that it moves around when washing the back. I would have preferred more sponge in the back brush to fill out the silicone holder. Otherwise, it would have been good. The handle is of a good length to reach my back.

Besides the thin sponge in the back brush, I absolutely hate that the brushes do not match. I love the green color of the body sponge but the back brush looks more like a dirty green and does not look part of the set. This is a big negative to me as they should match. The current price of $11.99 is a pricey but still competitive $5.50 per sponge.

title: Nice shampoo/conditioner combo; don’t like that bottles look like juice drinks
text:
This is a nice shampoo and conditioner set. The shampoo lathers pretty good but not excellent. The conditioner leaves my hair nourished and tame. I like the fragrance when I smell it in the bottle but during use it smells different and not as pleasant.

What I do not like is that the bottles look like juice drinks. I can see someone making a mistake and thinking this is a food item.

In summary, I like the results on my short, fine curly hair but not enough to order this again. It would have to smell more fragrant and the shampoo would have to lather better.  I personally prefer the TRESemmé Keratin Smooth combo more.

title: Powder does not dissolve; has nice eucalyptus scent & leaves feet soft but also w/a ring around it
text: There are two four ounce foot soaks in this package which is enough for two foot baths (i.e. two servings). The  powder smells like eucalyptus. It does not look like a bath salt at all but more like flour. It also does not dissolve well in the water even after stirring (see photo). In addition, it leaves a ring around the foot bath and my boyfriend's ankles when he is done soaking with this. It did leave his feet soft, but both he and I do not feel this is anything special. The current price of $14.99 for two servings is a ridiculously expensive price of $7.50 per soak for something that does not dissolve.

title: Leaves my hair looking vibrant and with a sheen; does relax my curls a little bit
text:
This is a four bottle set of 22 ounces each bottle. 

The conditioner feels great going on and is not slick like most conditioners I tried before. I love that because I'm not slipping in my tub. It also smells great to my senses. It left my hair feeling hydrated. My hair dried looking vibrant, shiny, and tamed. My curls were relaxed just a little bit. Overall, I love this conditioner.

Note that I paired it with their Tresemme Shampoo with Marula Oil which is Amazon item # B08C5Q2Z7Z. Although  the picture on Amazon's site says Moroccan oil, that is incorrect. In fact, I wrote a 2-star review on that site because of it but I love their complementary shampoo.

title: Beautiful and giftable manicure set; I absolutely love it!
text:
This is just a beautiful 13-piece manicure set. The presentation is spectacular when giving this as a gift. The box is a bit big for what is inside, nevertheless, the set is just gorgeous. I also like that only simple implements are included.

The following items are in the box:
- 2 nail soaker bowls - (plastic but I love these bowls)
- 2 nail buffer blocks
- kabuki brush (to brush off nail dust)
- fully stocked nail clipper case with:
-----> cuticle knife
-----> cuticle pusher
-----> cuticle clipper
-----> nail file
-----> finger nail clipper- toe nail clipper
-----> oblique nail clipper

I tried the nail clippers and they are sharp and clip well. I also put my hands in the soaker set. Even though the soaker tubs are plastic, they are very nice as the four fingers go in front and the thumb in back. This set would be great if one is doing their girlfriend's or mother's nails. The kabuki brush is soft and perfect for brushing away nail dust.  However, it is so soft, I want to use it as a make-up brush for blush.

In summary, this set is usually not one that someone purchases for themselves but to give as a gift. I actually got this for a friend. The current price of $32.95 ($34.95 minus $2 off) is pricey but one is paying for the presentation along with the full complement of implements.

title: Curling iron & brushes only; not a straightener; instructions are lacking; doubt this will last
text:
I am not impressed with this curling iron / brush combo. In the package is the heating element handle and three attachable ends (curling iron, round brush, and flat brush), one glove, and a USELESS instruction sheet.

Each end that is desired has to be attached before plugging this in. It is a bit difficult to attach unless one lines up the label on the attachment with the top attachment button on the handle. Press both the bottom and top buttons to attach or detach. Once I got the hang of it, it became relatively easy but the first time was difficult.

I tried all three items. The curling iron is great. However, the handle only has an on/off button that can be slid to #1 or #2. The manual does not say what heat level either number is set at. I can only assume #1 is low heat and #2 is high heat, although I did not notice that much of a difference.

I have short to medium fine hair. This curling iron did curl my strands nicely. The barrel is neither too small nor too large. There is a plastic base that keeps the hot iron elevated off the counter. The round brush is also good and is my second favorite tool. However, the flat brush is disappointing. Unless one has long hair, this brush is useless because the heating element is at the base. With short hair, the strands barely get to touch the element.

All three items heat up enough for fine hair. However, I personally do not care to attach and detach implements as I need them. Although this is a versatile unit, it is much easier to work with a solid tool. In addition, I doubt this product will continue to work for long if I keep attaching and detaching tools every day. Products that have such versatile features tend to fail at the attachment point and I can see that happening to this curling iron where one day it will not turn on at all.

This is truly a curling iron and brush combo. It is not a straightener unless one is going to use the flat brush on long hair to comb straight down. Nevertheless, it's versatility is its strongest point. The current price of $25.79 is reasonable for this set.

title: Soothing and moisturizing soap; lathers well
text:
This soap smells nice and is soothing and moisturizing. It also lathers well. However, my favorite shea butter soap is still Shea Moisture Three Butters Men's Utility Soap (Amazon item # B007OC7E2E), which smells better, is just as moisturizing, and is less than half the price.

The current price of $11.95 for this one bar of soap is way too expensive in my opinion. It is very nice soap but still not as good as my all time favorite.

title: Gentle & quiet battery-operated razor; head falls off easily if not careful
text:
I had a razor like this and then gave it to a friend and wound up regretting that. Therefore, I am glad I now have one again. I love this razor but I almost threw it out until I figured out how to operate it. Good vision is a requirement because it is hard to see the control markers..

This razor comes with a cleaning brush. It takes an AA battery (not included). To insert the battery, pull down on the case and put the positive side down. Make sure to line up the arrow on the case with the arrow on the gold colored collar on the unit. I did not do that originally and was fussing with it for a few minutes until I noticed I had put the case on wrong. The markings are hard for me to see, hence the problem. As long as everything lined up, then all I had to do was turn the collar in the "ON" direction and the light and razor came on.
