I use this for my facial hair under my nose and chin. It is gentle, quiet, and quick. It also does a great job and shaves as close as an "electric" razor can. It is also non-irritating. The head does come off very easily, so be careful with it. If the head did not come off easily and if the controls were more visible, this would have received 5 stars from me.

The current price of $14.99 is reasonable for this. I do hope it lasts a long time.

title: Excellent disposable nail set; also good for travelling
text:
There are 12 individually wrapped packages of a nail file and slim nail buffer set.

During Covid, these are great for manicurists who want a disposable manicure set to use with customers that includes a nail file and nail buffer. It is also great for just someone who wants to take these traveling with them. These do not have to be disposable as I am able to use mine several times.

The current price of $8.45 ($8.99 minus 6%) comes to almost $.71 cents per set which is reasonably priced.

title: Good, hefty brush that comes in one solid piece; the bristles are a tad rough
text:
I tried several brushes over the last several months and love the KOZIS Wooden Bath Brush (Amazon item # B08HR2GBHC) the best. However, this one is good too.

The brush head is ample for good coverage but the bristles are a bit rough. It is hefty and is one solid piece, which is fabulous as the brush cannot fall off the handle like some other brushes I tried previously. It also has a rope loop to hang up in the shower. In addition, a self-stick hook is supplied if needed. I did not need to use that.

Overall, I like this brush even though the bristles are not as soft as the KOZIS. The current price of $14.99 is a bit pricey for this, however.

title: Gloves run large for a man’s hands; are exfoliating but reduces suds
text: There are a total of eight gloves (4 pairs) in this set. These gloves are really large and appear to be more for a man's hand. I have about an inch of empty fingertips on every finger and the gloves are loose. Nevertheless, these work and act like my other exfoliating gloves. These can be used in the shower with a bar of soap. They definitely exfoliate but the gloves themselves reduce the amount of suds created. I love a lot of suds, which is why a mesh body puff is my "go to" shower accessory. These gloves are a good buy at $11.99 as it comes to $3 per pair or $1.50 per single glove. However, I recommend this only for those with large hands. I take a large in a female glove and this is still too big.

title: Soft quality headbands with width up to 5 inches; colors close to website pictures
text:
There are six quality headbands in this set. The maximum width is five inches but they can be scrunched up to about one inch. The colors are standard red, burgundy, gray, blue green, and black. However, they are a bit more muted in person than in the pictures on the website. For instance, the blue on the website is a bit lighter or more vibrant that in person.

These are perfect for someone with long hair. I have short to medium hair, so they do not stay on as well. I love how soft they are. The current price of $15.19 ($15.99 minus 5%) is a reasonable $2.53 per band.

title: Surprisingly works to eliminate razor bump –not just for men
text:
Although this is made for men, I got this for razor bumps at the bikini line. I personally do not care for how this dispenses. I found that it is best to put two squirts of this light cream into my hands and then rub it along the bikini line. The next morning, I had absolutely no bumps. I also had no irritation from this product.

The ingredients are Ingredients: Water(Aqua),Alcohol Denat.,Glycerin, Propylene Glycol, Glyceryl Stearate, Salicylic Acid, Caprylic/CapricTriglyceride, Isopropyl Palmitate,Sodium Hydroxide, Propylene Glycol Laurate, Polysorbate20, Carbomer, Cellulose Gum, Fragrance (Parfum),Cucumis Sativus Fruit Extract, Disodium EDTA. 

The current price of $18 ($19 minus $1) is expensive for two fluid ounces as it comes to $9 an ounce.

title: Colorful show cap whose loose “bow” looks silly on my head
text:
This shower cap is vibrant with the leaf design against the black background. Although it does not feel like this would be waterproof, it is also waterproof as it should be. The cap stays on and I have short to medium length hair. I love the feel of the fabric and its gorgeous color combination. What I do not like is that strip of ties on top. No matter how I tie it, it just flops around and looks incredibly silly on me.

I do like the cap very much but the piece on top ruins for me. Also, the current price of  $15.29 is a bit pricey for this.

title: Super comfortable padded mask that blocks out the light; fits my small head w/room to stretch
text:
This 100% mulberry silk mask is so soft and super comfortable because it is also padded. In addition, this blocks out the light exceptionally well. Note that there is no adjustment on the band as it is all elastic. I take a size small hat and this fits me fine. If my head were bigger, the elastic would stretch. I cannot say, however, how comfortable this would feel in the full stretched out position. I can see where if it is pulled too tight, there might be pressure around the eyes, so although this fits me perfectly, it might not be the same for those with a larger head.

Note that this can be hand washed in cold water with a PH neutral detergent such as Woolite. The current price of $28.99 is expected for this type mask.

title: Nice foundation brush good for light application of powder; odd shape
text: This brush has very soft bristles and it is gentle on my skin. I have never seen or used a brush with a sunken center before. This is good for applying translucent powder or foundation powder. It is not good for blush unless one wants only light coverage. I like to have a variety of brushes in my repertoire for various make-up applications and this is just another one to add to my arsenal. The current price of $3.99 is very reasonable for this.

title: CHEAP, CHEAP, CHEAP - just like a $1 store brush
text: This feels like a $1 store brush priced at $7.99. It is super cheap and feels horrible to hold. The only thing that it has going for it is that it is lightweight and it does brush my hair. It is best for the detangling in the shower or just blow drying on vacation when one wants to carry a lightweight brush. Nevertheless, I would pass on this one. It feels super cheap.

title: These clips provide an exceptionally strong hold and feel like quality; they’re gorgeous too
text: I absolutely adore these clips. They are stylish and look gorgeous in my hair. They feel like quality as well with a very strong "bite." I have tried clips before that feel cheap and have a lackluster hold. These are worlds above those types of clips. I also feel the current price of $12.99 ($13.99 minus $1) is competitively priced on the high side at $6.50 per clip.

title: Useful medium-size pump bottles good for hand soap, lotion, etc
text:
I love the colors of these bottles, particularly the teal blue one. I use these for hand soap. The pump works well. It holds about nine ounces of product. These can also be used for hand lotion, shampoo, conditioner, or any other product that is not corrosive and which one wants to put in a smaller container.

They are decorative due to the colors. The only thing is that it is impossible for me to tell the level of my hand soap when I dispense it in a bottle such as this. Other than this, these are great.

The current price of $13.49 comes to an expensive $4.50 per bottle. I personally do not feel these should be priced any higher than $2.50 per pump bottle.

title: Beautiful hair comb but difficult to affix; best for thick hair
text: I think this is a small but beautiful hair comb and very decorative. It is also perfect for the holidays and not only a wedding or special occasion. However, I had a difficult time affixing this in my hair. I have short to medium fine curly hair and, not only was it awkward for me to put this in my hair, but it wanted to fall out. I believe this would be best for someone with thick hair so there is a better hold. Otherwise, this is very pretty and elevates one's hairstyle. The current price of $6.89 is about right for this piece.

title: Leaves my hair shiny & clean – product is not as advertised; it’s w/Marula oil not Moroccan oil
text:
This is a four bottle set of 22 ounces each bottle. However, the product I received is not as advertised. It is supposed to have Moroccan Oil in it and not Marula Oil. It is for this reason, I changed my rating from 4 stars to 2 stars.

The shampoo lathers well and smells great to my senses. It left my hair feeling clean and shiny and without frizz. Overall, I like this shampoo but I hate that what is pictured and ordered is not what is received.

title: Excellent 15-brush set w/powder puff for the current price – 4.5 stars
text:
At the current price of $7.99, this brush set is excellent. If it were priced over $12, I would not have rated this 5 stars. There are 16 items in this set--15 brushes and one powder puff. Many more brushes than I need. I do wish they included two lip brushes.

All the brushes feel great against the skin and are soft. They work well and the bristles do not fall out; at least not on initial use. There are only three items I do not like. The fan brush has bristles that are slightly misshapen as a result of the packaging. The mascara wand arrived bent, so I had to bend it back in place. Also, the powder puff is not as luxurious as I would like. Other than this, I consider this set a good value for the current price of $7.99 which comes to $.50 cents per piece (16 items w/the powder puff).

title: Nice brush but the angled “stamping” end is awkward to use
text: The current price of $29 is outrageous for this brush. It is a nice brush and a great idea; however, the stamping end is awkward to use. The bristles are soft and they do not fall out. I love the blending end of the brush. The stamping end, however, requires the brush be positioned at the exact outward angle (see photo) to "stamp" an angled dose of powder on the lid and then work inward to blend. Other than the awkwardness to use and the high price, this is a nice brush.

title: Remember to cut tip before using; measurements in ML & are impossible to see
text:
There are four angled plastic bottles in this set. The measurements on the side go from 140 from 140  to 260 ml in 40 ml increments. There are no ounces listed and the increments that are listed are impossible to read. Based on Dr. Google, 260 ml equals 8.792 fluid ounces. So these bottles hold a little over 8 ounces.

I needed a strong scissor to cut the top tip off. Do remember to do that before using because otherwise the liquid will spill out the sides during squeezing.

Overall, I am not impressed with these and would not order them again. They are just okay but they do work as designed. The current price of $4.50 comes to $1.13 per bottle.

title: More like a low-budget eye care and tweezer set for travel
text:
This is a low-budget travel eye care and tweezer set that comes with seven tools and one carry pouch as listed below.

- One velvet carry pouch
- One standard-sized eyelash curler
- One mini-travel eyelash curler
- One tiny tweezer
- One case of 10 replacement silicone inserts for the eyelash curlers
- One scissor
- One mascara wand (or eyebrow brush)
- One eyelash extension tweezer to apply false eyelashes

I found parts of this set difficult to work with. Below are my likes or dislikes of each item.

LIKES
- Love the carry pouch as it holds the entire set.

- The scissor is small but sharp and good for cutting wayward hairs.

- The case of 10 replacement silicone inserts for the eyelash curlers is great because they can be easily replaced  when the originals are worn out for either the full-size or mini curler.

- The brush wand can be used for the eyelashes or brow.

- The eyelash extension tweezer will help with the placement of false eyelashes. It felt good in my hands and seems easy to work with.

DISLIKES
- The handle on the standard-sized eyelash curler opens too far out and is awkward to work with simply because it is difficult to extend my hands out that wide to close it. However, once I have a good grip, it works. Also, the piece that keeps it closed has to be saved, otherwise the curler always remains wide open.

- The mini-travel eyelash curler takes some getting used to but I do feel it is innovatively designed. I have never seen one of these before.

- The tweezer works well but is so tiny I have to grip it with my fingertips.

Overall, this is the perfect set for travel. However, I would not use this every day simply because the eyelash curlers and tweezers are the most used items for me and are a bit difficult to work with. The current price of $8.59 is reasonable for this.

title: Nice presentation; giftable; subtle fragrance; bombs have almost no fizz
text:
[[VIDEOID:e42b951059ab4f0bc8bda1f3a01ef75c]] This is an attractive and giftable set of 36 bath bombs. There are four of each of nine varieties wrapped in tissue paper and plastic wrap. They are as follows below with the bath bomb name followed by the essential oils it is infused with.

- Ever Love - Ylang & Orange Essential Oils
- Bucolic Poem - Eucalyptus, Jasmine, & Tea Essentials Oils
- Yoga Matin - Lavender and Vanilla Essentials Oils
- Life Reloaded - Wild Rose & Vanilla Essentials Oils
- Sweet Dreams - Blueberry & Strawberry Essentials Oils
- Pole to Pole - Peppermint, Grapefruit, & Lemon Essentials Oils
- Vitamin C Scherzos - Lemon & Bergamot Essentials Oils
- Ocean Breath - Marine Wood Oil, Peppermint, & Apple Essentials Oils
- Spring Waltz - Lily Essentials Oils

I tried the Spring Waltz bomb in my foot bath. The fragrance of this and each of the others is very subtle but nice. I used almost hot water and suds were created in the foot bath but the bomb had not much fizz. It just eventually dissolved in the water as I bathed my feet for 15 minutes. I felt clean and liked the scent but wished there was more fizz. What I do love is that the color of the bomb does not turn my nails and feet that color. Also, my foot bath did not have a color ring around it like another high-end bath bomb I tried previously. Insofar as "performance," these bombs are just okay. However, for the current price of $31.48, these are very reasonable at almost $.88 cents each.

title: Twelve vibrantly colored blending sponges with one holder; this is a nice set at a great price
text:
This is just a treasure trove of 12 vibrantly colored blending sponges with one holder. At the current price of $11.99 it is a steal at $1 per sponge if I consider the holder a freebie. I love the colors of make-up blenders. The holder is very useful for one of the larger sponges. . 

There are six small egg-shaped sponges, three large egg-shaped sponges, and three large egg-shaped sponges with a sloped side. The flat sides on the three sponges are good for smooth applications. The tiny ones are good for the eye area. The rest are good for many blending make-up tasks.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and wash well with soap and water. These blenders make a great gift for the make-up obsessed. The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. This set is definitely a great one and a superlative price.

title: Nice set of blending sponges with holder but the colors I received are a bit muted - 3.5 stars
text:
I like but do not love the colors of these make-up blenders. The holder is useful for one of the larger sponges. However, the colors I received do not exactly match the vibrancy of the colors pictured on the Amazon site (w/the exception of the hot pink blender) - see photo. 

There are four sponges in this set with one holder. The light pink and pale blue sponges, which are much more muted in color than shown on Amazon, have a flat side and are good for smooth applications. I like the tiny purple sponge for the eye area. The hot pink one is the typical egg shaped sponge and is the best one for the holder.

These feel good in the hands, blend well, and wash well with soap and water. These are great for a gift either by breaking up the set or "as is" in the box. The current price of $13.78 is on the high side but one is paying for the individual containers the larger sponges come in. The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. The colors are important too--at least to me. This set is definitely good for gifting.

title: Excellent for applying creams, mask products, etc. without getting my hands dirty
text:
I have really been getting into silicone spatulas/brush sets for applying face creams, bacitracin on a scar, etc.  This wand is double-sided and has a flat spatula end for applying creams or gels. The opposite side has a ribbed end and another side with larger soft nubs. The nubby side is good for cleaning or also for applying mask products. However, if the large soft nubs are used, there is more cleaning involved to wash off the mask product.

Overall, this wand is excellent and about 6.5 inches long. It is soft on my skin, pliable, and long enough to hold on to. Of course, I would have liked it a bit longer but the ones on the market I tried so far are this size or smaller.

The current price of $5.99 is on the high side for one tool but it is still competitvely priced.

title: Basic, lightweight vent brush with nice curve that molds to my head and is good for blow drying
text:
This is a basic and lightweight vent brush that has a nice curve to it that molds to my head. It is also great for "displaying" the hair outward for blow drying. The handle also has ridges on it which provides me with a good grip.  Included in the package are two hair clips that are just okay. 

This brush is cheaply made but functional. I do not feel this is worth more than $3.99. At the current price of $9.99, it is way overpriced in my opinion. Although I like this brush, its price is the reason I lowered my rating from 4 to 3 stars.

title: Face tools are too tiny and hard to be effective; brush cleaners are okay but unnecessary
text:
I have really been getting into silicone spatulas/brush sets for applying face creams, bacitracin on a scar, etc. However, this set comes with two silicone face cleaners on a "stick" and two brush cleaners. The face cleaners are way too tiny, hard, and inflexible to be useful. Perhaps they can be used to apply a pimple cream in spots, but other than this, I find them useless.

The two brush cleaners, which look like covers for the face cleaner, are okay. The purpose is to soap up a make-up brush to be cleaned and then rub it on the ribbed side of the silicone cleaner. It provides a good surface against which to agitate brushes to be cleaned. However, I find this unnecessary as using this requires I now clean the silicone cap and I am able to get brushes clean just by rubbing them with soap and water between my hands.

In summary, the brush cleaners are useful but I do not care for them and the face cleaners are useless. I personally hate this set.

title: Cheap quality travel bottles that dispenses a fine mist of whatever liquid one puts in there
text:
There are four clear bottles in this set with just a whisper of color in the caps. The words "SWEET DAY" are written in color on the front of each bottle.

These bottles are tiny but good enough to fill with hand sanitizer, perfume, or any liquid that needs to be sprayed in a fine mist. The pump spray dispenses a very fine mist. The negative to me is that they feel very cheap and do not have the quality feel I prefer.

Other than this, they work as designed and are portable for travel. The current price of $9.99 is a very pricey $2.50 per bottle.

title: Perfect tiny bottles for hand sanitizer, perfume, etc.; nubs on rim may have to be removed
text:
There are three clear bottles in this set in clear, teal, and pink. They are tiny but good enough to fill with hand sanitizer, perfume, or any liquid that needs to be sprayed in a fine mist. The pump spray dispenses a fine mist. The only negative I saw is that one of my bottles had a plastic nub around the collar that prevented me from screwing on the top. It is supposed to be removed during the manufacturing process, but I had to pop it off.

Other than this, these bottles are excellent and portable for travel. The current price of $5.87 comes to $1.96 per empty bottle which is on the pricey side.

title: Excellent blow-dryer brush for long hair; handle has great grip; clips just okay
text: This set comes with one large blow-drying brush and four black hair clips with two extra clip elastics. The clips are okay. They do hold the hair a bit but the elastics inside will break easily. However, the brush itself is great. I love the ergonomically designed handle as it feels great in my hands and does not slip. The barrel of the brush is wide for long hair but the bristles are close to the barrel to reduce tangling. At the current price of $9.95, I feel this is competitively priced and a better deal than the [[ASIN:B08PFGS42S same brush]] which is priced at $10.78. I love the brush and could pass on the clips.

title: Excellent blow-dryer brush for long hair ;handle has great grip; clips just okay
text: This set comes with one large blow-drying brush and four hair clips (2 white, 2 black) with 2 extra clip elastics. The clips are okay. They do hold the hair a bit but the elastics inside will break easily. However, the brush itself is great. I love the ergonomically designed handle as it feels great in my hands and does not slip. The barrel of the brush is wide for long hair but the bristles are close to the barrel to reduce tangling. At the current price of $10.78, I feel this is competitively priced. I love the brush and could pass on the clips.

title: Absolutely excellent brush as it is one solid piece and hefty
text:
I have tried many different back brushes. I had several wooden ones like this but they had a removable handle. I have also tried the buff puff type back brushes. They all work well. However, this one is absolutely excellent for this style of brush. It is hefty and it is one solid piece, which is fabulous as the brush cannot fall off the handle like the other brushes. It also has a rope loop to hang up in the shower.

Even though this is made in China, it is high quality compared to others I tried. The current price of $9.99 is definitely worth it for this one, in my opinion.

title: Incredibly soft potholder-sized washcloths (5.5” x 5.25”) with hanging loop; has other uses
text:
These washcloths remind me of super-soft potholders as that is exactly what they look like. There are 12 in this set. They work well as a washcloth. There is no lather to any washcloth and these are no exception. However, these are super soft on the face. I also like that I can hang this in the shower via the attached loop. In addition, they wash well in the washer BUT I lay them flat to dry because I feel the dryer would destroy the material.

Besides acting as washcloths, since there are so many I also use them as soft spacers between delicate dishes to prevent breakage. I suspect these can be used to wash delicate dishes as well if washing by hand. They are small at 5.5" x 5.25" but they are easier to handle than a regular washcloth when washing my face.

The current price of $9.99 is reasonable for this set as it comes to $.83 cents per cloth.

title: Doesn’t have a clean aroma; leaves a pink ring but works like a bath bomb
text:
[[VIDEOID:1a96241d8bd9f03d06e12a7c205e7bc0]] For $9 for one bath bomb, this should smell like heaven. However, it does not have a clean aroma at all; smells like dirty dishes to me. It fizzes nicely but does not last long. The bomb dissolves to reveal a cheap plastic ring young children love.

I used this in my foot bath and my feet felt like I only soaked them in water. When emptying my foot bath, which is where I used this, it left a pink ring around the tub. I personally do not care for this. I do feel, however, young girls might but it is neither fragrant nor is the surprise alluring.

title: Utterly cheap plastic framed mirror; feels like it is going to fall apart
text:
This mirror is so cheap that it felt like the mirror itself was going to pop out of the frame when I slid it out of the package. I had to polish it to a shine as it arrived opaque and plastic looking. I used an eyeglass cleaner to clean it.

It is thin and in a plastic frame that feels too light for the mirror itself.  Drop this once and it will likely break. It must be handled gingerly. I personally do not feel this is worth more than $.50 cents or $1.

title: The liquid is ORANGE; YUCK; I’m so turned off I won’t put this on my face
text:
This is the first time I ordered a face product for review that I absolutely refuse to try on my face and I have tried some smelly and nasty creams. Had I known the solution was orange and very liquidy, I would have NEVER ordered it. I actually thought it was the color of the bottle. SURPRISE!

I put it in my hand ready to put on my face but the color was an incredible turn off. I rubbed it into my palm and it left a slight tangerine tinge to my skin that I had to wash off with soap and water. My palm did not feel moisturized either while it was on.

No matter how good this might be, there is no way I would ever use such a colored serum. The $44.99 price is also outrageous for this watery colored solution.

title: Most instructions in Kugo; masks smell wonderful & are moisturizing
text:
There are 10 mask packets in this set in 2 of each of the below types:

- lifting (w/eye cream) - no English instructions
- revital (w/eye cream) - (see my photo) - no English instructions
- moisturizing
- firming
- hydrating

The lifting and revital masks come with eye cream in the upper right corner. Unfortunately, these masks have no instructions in English and most of it is guesswork. Originally I thought I had to wash off my face until I used the mask. The fragrance is wonderful and my face and eyelids felt great afterward.

The other three types of masks do not include eye cream and instructions are provided in English on the packet.

The masks themselves are super moist to the point of dripping sloppy. However, after applying for 10-20 minutes, I rub in the solution, and let it air dry.

The price of $9.99 for this set comes to a reasonable $1 per application (i.e. packet). Note that this is made in Korea which is why almost everything is written in Kugo (i.e. Korean language). If this product had clear instructions and a write-up in English, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Versatile razor but no charge complete indicator; love the purple color
text:
This is a versatile razor as it comes with an epilator head, lady shaver head, and facial cleaning brush. Also included is the USB charging cable (no wall adapter), stand, cleaning brush, and instructure pamphlet.

LIKES
- It is multi-functional in that 3 tool heads are included. I tried the epilator but it is not my favorite because it feels like I am being mildly electrocuted as the rotating tweezer heads pull out the hair. I never got comfortable putting this too close to my skin.

- The lady shaver is great and shaves as close as an electric shaver can.

- The cleaning brush is soft and feels great when cleaning the face.

- Operation of this razor is simple with the on/off button (which requires some press to move) and the release head button in the back. It is super easy to remove the heads and also the blades for cleaning.

- It is rechargeable.

DISLIKES
- There is no charging completion indicator. I charged this over 24 hours and the light still showed red that I was charging it but I would have liked a green light to tell me the charge was complete. I can only assume it is completely charged.

- There is no cover for the epilator.

- The stand cannot be used for charging. It is only used to hold the razor without the cable being attached.

In summary, this is a great 3-in-1 shaver kit. It works as designed, is reasonably priced at the current cost of $26.99, and the color matches my purple bathroom which I like very much. I will certainly get the most use out of the lady shaver head. I personally will not use the epilator because I do not like how it pinches, but that is typical of any epilator, not just this one.

title: The pump does not work so it is impossible to dispense the product correctly
text:
There is nothing that irks me more than not being able to get the product out of the bottle as designed. I tried pumping for about three minutes and when nothing would come out, I opened the top. I do not see how this solution can pump from that little nub that goes into the bottle. Nevertheless, I did squeeze some out to try it on my face and neck. It is moisturizing but I do not like the smell. This would have received 3 stars if the pump worked.

Note that I tried their eye contour cream and it had the same problem with the pump.

title: The pump does not work so it is impossible to dispense the product correctly
text: There is nothing that irks me more than not being able to get the product out of the bottle as designed. I tried pumping for about five minutes and when nothing would come out, I opened the top. I do not see how this solution can pump from that little nub that goes into the bottle. Nevertheless, I did squeeze some out to try it. It is moisturizing to my eyelids and under the eye but I do not like the smell. This would have received 3 stars if the pump worked.

title: The fragrance is divine; left my hair looking vibrant & tame; relax my curls a little
text:
This set includes Pantene's fortifying damage repair shampoo (9.6 fluid ounces), conditioner (8 fluid ounces), and a tube of intense rescue shots (0.5 fluid ounces).

I tried both the shampoo and conditioner. The rescue shot would be too moisturizing for the winter months for my type of hair. I have fine, curly short to medium-length hair. The shampoo lathers exceptionally well and the fragrance is absolutely divine. I wish I could describe it but I cannot. The conditioner is intensely moisturizing.

I air-dried my hair and it looked vibrant and tame when dry, although it did relax my curls a little--which I expected.

The current price of $16.94 is on the pricey side of competitive for this set.

title: Goes on smooth, light, and shimmery but colors are too “yellow”
text:
There are six pencil shadows. Most of the colors are yellow or orange in hue and there is one blue and one tan that also seems to turn yellow or orange. Each pencil has its own brush for blending and the brush head needs to be turned to release the cream shadow.  I am careful to only turn a little bit because the shadows are soft. They are shimmery as well.

They do go on smoothly but it is a bit difficult to get into corners with the round tip. The colors are light, so that they can be used to blend with other colors.

I personally do not care for this set of pencils. I like the brush head and the fact that I can just turn the top to release more shadow. What I do not like are the strange colors.

The $9.99 price is reasonable for this set as it comes to $1.67 per pencil.

title: Super attractive & flowery brush w/ergonomically designed handle; more like a detangler
text:
This set is very nice and matches my pink bathroom. The large curved brush is more of a detangler than a typical brush. It glides through my hair easily. It comes with three spiral hair ties and a rather large comb. The brush works well in my hair and so does the comb. However, the comb has wide spacing, so it will not get out knots.

Overall this is a nice set. I love the feel of the brush handle in my hands and love the stylish curve in the brush head. The current price of $9.99 which is slightly on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Cute, flowery, functional travel brush or young adult brush
text:
This set is cute and matches my pink bathroom. The small brush is good for travel or for young adults. It comes with three spiral hair ties and a rather large comb. The brush works well in my hair and so does the comb. However, the comb has wide spacing, so it will not get out knots.

Overall this is a cute set for the current price of $8.99 which is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Vegan & moisturizing but I don’t care for the scent
text:
This lotion is vegan and made with plant-based ingredients. It was very difficult to prime the pump for the initial application of moisturizer. I had to pump for about 60 to 90 seconds to get it working. However, after that the pump worked fine.

The lotion is creamy but has a smell I do not like nor can I describe it. It does moisturize well. I used it on my hands over several hours and they felt hydrated and had an interesting soft texture to them.

Currently, this is not priced but I would expect that this 200 mL (6.763 fluid ounces) bottle would be priced in the $6-7 range.

title: 5 tiny plastic jars which hold about 2 teaspoons of product; lids unscrew easily
text:
There are five tiny plastic (a.k.a. acrylic) jars in this set with different colored lids (black, teal, yellow, gray, and pink). Each jar holds 10ml or about 2 teaspoons of product. These are good for holding lip balm, holding spices, a couple of servings of loose leaf tea, etc. 

The main issue I have with these is that the caps unscrew easily. I can see these coming apart in one's purse or pocket. The second issue is the price. The current price of $10 means this equates to $2 per tiny jar. If the lids were more secure, then the price might be somewhat justified.

title: Pump does not work; wash does not lather; I do not like this at all
text:
This is a 16-fluid ounce bottle of antimicrobial hand and body wash. It comes with a pump dispenser but that does not work. I could not get the pump to pop up and the spout fell off (see photo). I tried for over 20 minutes to get this pump to work and it would not open even after I reseated the spout. I have to dispense this by shaking it out of the bottle. 

The wash is a creamy white color. It has absolutely no lather. My hands do feel clean afterward but very dry.

The active ingredient is benzalkonium chloride 0.13%. The inactive ingredients are Water (Aqua), SodiumLaureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine,PEG-IOO Stearate,Glyceryl Stearate, Butylene Glycol, Sorbitan Stearate,Hydroxyapatite* (*Hydroxysomes), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice,Phenol, HydrolyzedWheat Protein, Hydrolyzed Wheat Starch, Chamomilla Recutita(Matricaria) Flower Extract, Cucumis Sativas (Cucumber) FruitExtract, DMDM Hydantoin, Disodium EDTA, Sodium Chloride,Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose, Methylparaben,Propylparaben,Triclosan, and Citic Acid.

In summary, I do not like this at all. First of all, the pump insert not working annoys me as it is difficult to dispense this wash straight out of the bottle. Second, I do not like that there is no lather. Third, I hate how dry and irritated my hands feel afterward. This is definitely not for me.

The current price of $28 for a 16 ounce bottle comes to an expensive $1.75 per ounce.

title: Spray nozzle sprays fine mist or streams; measurements are not exact but these work
text:
There are four blue glass spray bottles with ml/ounce measurements on one side, eight labels, four spray nozzles, and one funnel.

These are perfect for hair solutions, water, window cleaner, vinegar, etc., etc., etc. The spray nozzles dispense a wonderful mist spray or a fine stream just like many store bought spray products. The measurements on the front of the bottle are a little off. It has 400 milliliters  equivalent to 14 ounces.  Per my Google search, 14 ounces is equivalent to 414.029 milliliters. However, this difference does not bother me as I am not using the measurements in milliliters.

The current price of $15.95 is competitive for this as it comes to $3.99 per bottle.

title: The fragrance is divine; left my hair silky and shiny but did relax my curls
text:
This set includes Pantene's complete curl care shampoo (9.6 fluid ounces), conditioner (8 fluid ounces), and a tube of intense rescue shots (0.5 fluid ounces).

I tried both the shampoo and conditioner. The rescue shot would be too moisturizing for the winter months for my type of hair. I have fine, curly short to medium-length hair. The shampoo lathers exceptionally well and the fragrance is divine. The conditioner is intensely moisturizing.

I air-dry my hair and the end result was silky, shiny, and incredibly moisturized locks. Unfortunately, it did relax my curls which is the only reason I took off one star.

The current price of $16.35 is on the pricey side of competitive for this set.

title: Practically useless at cleaning brushes based on my tests
text:
There are two brush cleaners in this set. I tried this on my brush (see before and after pictures) and it barely cleaned it. Please understand that I passed it through the brush many times like I was scrubbing a floor. I tried sideways, up and down, lifting, etc. It got something out but not enough to make these cleaning tools useful.

This brush is probably best used as a scrubber on grout or something because it has stiff bristles but it does not work as designed.

title: Very nice comb perfect for short to medium hair; not good for tangles
text: This is a very nice comb with evenly spaced teeth. It feels great in my hands and is easy to pass through my hair unless it is tangled. This also seems pretty sturdy but I suspect it will break if one pulls too hard on their hair. The current price of $5.99 for this comb is reasonable.

title: Not exfoliating but soothing and massaging; better for a bubble bath
text:
This shower scrubber has two sides. One side has nubs that are perfect for a more massaging feel during showering. The other side is very soft and okay just for washing. Neither side helps with lather. This is best in a bubble bath. It does come with a self-stick hook which has a film that has to be removed in order to stick it to the wall. However, the hook that fits through the hole in the brush causes the silicone brush bristles to stick out at an odd angle (see photo).

I actually ordered this thinking it would be a great silicone brush to pick up cat hair from furniture but it is not good for that because the bristles are too pliable. It is also only okay for showering and is definitely NOT exfoliating. This is best for use as a scrubber in a bubble bath.

The current price of $8.99 for this is about $6 too much.

title: Very nice, complete brush set; works well on my wet or dry hair
text:
This is a nice brush set that comes with one hard plastic hair brush, one detangler (assembly required), and one comb. The plastic hair brush goes through my curly hair easily. Because the tines are hard, they work well to untangle my hair.  The detangler is best for use in the shower and passes through my wet hair easily. I personally prefer the Heeta detanglers (which looks like this one) but has a silicone grip on the handle that this does not. The comb glides through my hair as well but is best on long hair. Also, since the space between the tines are the same, it does not have the same detangling ability as combs with graduated spacing that goes from a fine comb to regular.

Note that the detangling brush is actually like eight combs strung together. I had to set the extra piece that comes with the brush to separate the tines. It takes some dexterity to assemble the bar across the "combs" but eventually I managed. There are only four places the bar should be put and that is where the holes are on the back of the "brush." I assembled that brush on the lower holes. The handle provides an okay grip but I would have preferred a silicone grip. Since the combs are separated, this brush can act as a vent brush for blow drying even though it is not of circular design. Hair can be removed easily since the tines are flat with no "ball" tip.

I definitely like this versatile set. It would even work better if I had long hair as I have curly short to medium hair. Currently there is no price listed but I assume this set would be priced in the $13.99 range.

title: Generously sized storage bags; can be used for more than wigs & hair extensions
text:
About 15 years ago I had a co-worker from Senegal put long extensions in my hair. These bags would definitely hold them and more. There are five generously-sized satin-like bags with tassel drawstrings. The design on each bag is gorgeous and the vibrant gold facial outline pops on the black satin, making this a super attractive satchel for gifts of make-up to female friends and teenagers.

I got these bags for storage of intimates and various things and they work perfectly. The only negative I see is that the tassels are highly subject to static cling. I already have these bags in pink and love them (see Amazon item #B08HVMM2GZ).

The size is 15" x 11" but the usable space is 14" x 11" as the first 1" is taken up by the drawstring.

The current price of $14.99 is a reasonable $3 per bag.

title: Set consists of two clippers & NOT three as pictured, one nail file & one case
text:
The only reason I rated this 3 stars is because I did not receive what I thought I was ordering. Other than this, this is a solid 4.5 star set.

I received two nail clippers (toe and finger) and one nail file all in a tin case. The clippers are sharp and clip very well. It did take me a minute to figure out how to work these. What I had to do was flip the lever forward to engage the spring action of the clipper. Once that was done, they worked great. The nail file is a typical metal file that works like every other metal file on the market.

In order to get these back in the case, the lever on the files have to be flipped into the low-profile position - meaning toward the handle.

The current price of $16.95 is competitive for the set picture but too pricey for the set received. I would not expect to pay more than $12 for the set received. Nevertheless, this is a very nice set that works as designed.

title: Work well as mask, face cream, and precision suntan lotion applicators
text:
I have several sets of these type silicone applicators. They work well to apply a mud or other mask to the face, face cream, suntan lotion, acne cream, bacitracin on a scar, etc.

There are eight applicators in this set with four different colored handles (pink, white, yellow, and pale green).  I would have preferred that they included some round silicone applicators and some angled ones too instead of eight of the same edge. Nevertheless, this set is exactly as described and works well for me.

The current price of $3.99 is very reasonable as it equates to $.50 cents per brush.

title: Very useful cosmetic brush set; bristles do not fall out; wish brush use was written on handle
text:
There are 19 brushes in this set. I love the selection, including the addition of the silicone mask applicators. The bristles also stay put and do not fall out as is problematic with some brushes I tried before. There is a slight chemical smell to the brushes but I can only smell this if I put the brush head to my nose. It is not offensive to me nor does it affect the functionality or my desire to use these. Each brush is also reasonably soft but not super soft.

What would have made this a 5-star set is if the brush use was engraved on the side of the handle, instead of having to refer to the picture on Amazon (see the cropped image from Amazon I attached). Also, it would have been nice to have a larger brush for the application of translucent powder to set one's make-up. Other than this, this set is a good value at the current price of $10.39 which comes to $.55 cents per brush. This is a perfect set to give a beginner or someone who applies a lot of make-up and wants to replace their brushes often.

title: Tall sides keeps water in but it is too short for large feet
text:
This foot bath is great in the sense that it is no frills - just a large-sided tub with tall sides to keep the water in. Most tubs are too short. It has massaging nubs on the bottom which feels relaxing. It also comes with two pumice stones.  I love the bath for me (size 9 to 9.5) but I got this for my boyfriend and he is a size 13 shoe. If I measure his foot with a ruler, it is 11 inches from heel to toe. His foot perfectly fits in this tub as there is absolutely no room to spare (see photo). Therefore, men with large feet beyond a size 13 shoe need to look elsewhere. The current price of $11.88 is reasonable for this, I just wish it were a few inches longer. 

PS My cat commandeered it as a bed.

title: Sweet smelling shampoo that leaves my hair clean & volumized but slightly less curly
text: This shampoo has a sweet, pleasant aroma. It lathers well, cleans well, and leaves my hair volumized. I air dry my hair and it looked great after using this but my curls were more relaxed even though my hair was more poofy. I like that this did not completely flatten my hair, yet it left it less damaged. Overall, this is a very nice shampoo for my fine curly hair.

title: Excellent for removing calluses on heels of my feet & softening under arch, sides, or ball of foot
text:
I have a similar file that I purchased for about $5 years ago and love it. Therefore, I wanted another one as a backup. This very is very similar except it is not as curved as mine (see photo). The concave section is perfect for the heels of my feet. The convex section (reverse side) is perfect for under the arch or around the ball of the foot. It also works on the sides of the ankle or the sides of the heels. I use the concave portion mostly. This file works as well as my other one. I absolutely love these files, particularly for the heel. I also love the teal green color of this one.

The current price of $6.99 is competitive.

title: These scissors cut well but are heavy – 3.5 stars
text:
This set includes a pair of scissors and one soft cloth. I guess the cloth is to wipe down the scissors. The scissors are sharp and open and close easily for easy cutting. I do have to tighten them periodically with the knob on front. It cuts well. I tried it on my boyfriend's hair. The finger holes are small on the scissor but that is to be expected. The scissors are a bit heavy, so that can be tiring if cutting a lot of hair.

In summary, this pair works well.  The current price of $35.99 ($39.99 minus $4) is pricey but these are attractive and work well. I suspect that they can be sharpened since they are handmade from Japanese 440C steel. Since I am not a professional hairstylist, I cannot compare them to what is in a hair stylist arsenal.

title: Soft scrunchies that hold well but embroidery is not discernable
text: There are two scrunchies in this package. Both ties are velvety soft and the elastic in the ties are tight and provide a good grip on my hair. However, the embroidery of the woman's face is very nice but impossible to discern off or on the hair. The scrunchie has to be flattened out in order to see what it looks like. The current price of $7.20 comes to $3.60 per tie which is pricey.  Although these ties feel wonderful and work well, paying for embroidery that can't be seen is foolish, in my opinion.

title: Produces a fine mist spray; perfect for liquid sanitizer, perfume, etc.
text:
I ordered the four-bottle set that comes in two of each size. These bottles are attractive and work very well. They are perfect for traveling. They produce a fine mist spray which is perfect for perfumes or liquid hand sanitizers or even to spritz an air plant with water.

The current price of $7.66 for four bottles is a reasonable price as it comes to $1.92 per bottle. The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because the picture on Amazon shows only three bottles, even though it says four in one of the pictures. The set I received and ordered is four bottles. This review is written for the four bottle set.

title: The color of these scrunchies are RICH and they feel so soft
text: There are three hair scrunchies in this set. The three colors of burgundy, blue, and black are vibrant looking. The ties are super soft even though they are made of PU leather (faux leather). The elastic in the ties are tight and provide a good grip on my hair. At the current price of $15.99 it comes to $5.33 per tie which is a bit pricey but expected with these types of ties. These make a great stocking stuffer.

title: Velvety soft hair ties with a good grip and tight elastic
text: There are six hair scrunchies in this set with several muted colors that go with anything. The ties are velvety soft. The elastic in the ties are tight and provide a good grip on the hair. At the current price of $19.99 it comes to $3.33 per tie which is on the pricey side of competitive. However, because I love the ties so much, I did not take off one star for the high price like I usually do.

title: Colorful and attractive headbands but sizing varies
text:
There are a total of four headbands in this set and two of them are very colorful and attractive. The black is also attractive and the checkered one is very nostalgic looking. However, the sizing is off. The multi-colored black one was so tight it gave me a headache and the checkered one so loose it fell off. Except for the one that fell off, these are really made for small heads or perhaps teenagers.

The current price of $9.99 is competitive as it comes to $2.50 per band.

title: Nine patriotic hair ties; a good value
text: There are nine US flag design hair ties in three different styles (see photo). The elastics are tight and hold the typical amount of hair most scrunchies hold. Other than the design, these are very typical. The current price of $9.99 for 9 comes to a reasonable $1.11 per tie. I really like these with the American flag theme.

title: Pure grease with fragrance
text:
I do not like this stick at all. I applied this to my face, hands, and feet. This is super greasy. I felt like I was taking coconut oil out of the jar and just smearing it all over me. I also did not find it very moisturizing; just slippery / greasy.  I do like the fresh fragrance, however.

Perhaps others will like this, but I do not. As the tube says, this is solid oil. It is made with various oils such as sunflower seed oil, beeswax, limnanthes seed oil, etc. Also, at $26 for a .8 ounce tube is expensive. I already used one-tenth of the tube in the first application.

title: The flat and angled tweezers work best; the other two not so good
text:
This set of four tweezers comes in a cheap plastic case that feel like the latch will break. The angled and flat tweezers work well due to the edge on those tools. The pointed tweezer did not work at all for me and the slightly sloped angled tweezer worked okay. This is not a great set but it is good enough. If the edges on these tweezers were thinner, it would be easier to work with them.

The current price of $9.48 ($9.98 minus 5%) is on the high side of competitive for this set. I would not expect to pay more than $7 for this quality.

title: Works for my needs but not professional quality; just good enough
text:
This set includes a faux leather case with room for two scissors (one is included) and a full height folder pocket. In addition a rainbow comb is in the package.

I think the case is nice enough but it will barely close if I put the comb inside. I doubt a second pair of scissors would fit in the extra pocket. The included one pair of scissors are loose. I tightened the knob and it is a little better. It cuts well. I tried it on my boyfriend's hair. The finger holes are small on the scissor but that is to be expected.

The comb is pretty but is super cheap. I am unfamiliar with the "professional hair styling open knot" that looks like a broken tine in the comb (see photo). However, after searching the web, I discovered that the indented tine is used by the hairstylist to make sectioning the hair easier.

In summary, this set works but is of marginal quality. It is definitely not a set that I would "gift" to a professional hairstylist, especially with an empty pocket in the case that makes this feel like an incomplete set.

title: The cuticle cutter & case latch are awful but the rest is a good nail starter kit – 3.5 stars
text:
There are 18 pieces in this nail set including the patent leather case. The case latch is terrible as it does not snap closed and instead the latch has to be pressed to close. Second, the cuticle cutter is awful. There is no spring action to it; it just flops open, so there is no leverage to cut. Other than this, the nail cutters are sharp and work well. There are a few files and other tools in here; some of which I do not use or even know what they are for. I do wish there was a product sheet included that outlined what each tool was for. Instead I have to look at the amazon site to figure out what each item is.

The current price of $11.89 (13.99 minus 15%) is very reasonable for this despites its flaws.

title: Excellent brush for applying full face translucent powder
text:
I love this brush for applying finishing powder (translucent powder) to my face which helps set make-up. I also love that the bristles are soft and do not fall out of the brush like some other brushes I tried previously.

The current price of $7.49 is reasonable for this.

title: Excellent tools to have in my beauty arsenal; makes mask applying & cleansing easier
text:
I recently tried the HieerBus Silicone Face Mask Brush (see product number B08BXVMY6W) and loved it so much that I wanted to try another brand. This set has one two-sided silicone spatula, a one-sided silicone spatula, and two cleansing sponges.

The "silicone spatulas" are excellent. I use these to apply my mask without getting my fingers dirty. It spreads easily. I prefer the flat end to spread if I do not want to lose product. When using the nubbed end, some product is lost among the bristles. The other silicone spatula spreads easily as well. If these did not smell like silicone, I would be using these to spread peanut butter, cream cheese, and butter.  The sponges are a nice addition and can make cleansing easier but I personally prefer to use my bare hands to wash my face instead of these. There is a finger grip that has to be pulled apart for the sponges to work. All items are easy to wash. I wish I had these years ago.

The current price of  $6.64 ($6.99 minus 5%) is competitively priced for this set.

title: These brushes provide nice blush & foundation coverage; bristles do not fall out; handle slippery
text: I really like these brushes. They both come with their own snap-closure plastic case to keep the brushes from smudging the rest of the products in my make-up case.  Each brush provides good blush and powder foundation coverage. I also love that the bristles do not fall out. The only negative is that the plastic handle is slippery in my hands that makes it a tad tricky to maintain my grip. Other than this, these brushes are lovely.

The current price of $7.09 is reasonable for this brush with cover set.

title: Tames my curls without the frizz; smells wonderful
text: I have short to medium curly hair and applied a little bit of this cream to my damp locks. After working this through, I let my hair air dry. This conditioned without weighing down my curls. It also tamed the frizz. The fragrance is wonderful. The cream is thick. Of course, this does make my hair look darker than normal as a result of putting a product in my hair.  The current price of $17.99 is competitive but some local stores do carry this for a lesser price.

title: Excellent corded razor for quickly buzzing my boyfriend’s hair
text:
This razor set comes with a case, instructions, 4 hair combs, scissors,oil, cleaning brush, 8 guide combs (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, & 8 & left & right taper combs), a barber’s cape, and a blade cover. The cape is garbage and the scissors are cheap but cut a wayward hair okay. It is the razor with guide combs that we love.

I just plugged this in, put on the #2 comb, and quickly buzzed my boyfriend’s hair. There was absolutely no resistance and the blade with comb just glided through his hair. There was a lot of static cling of hair to the blade but that happens with any razor.

Cleaning the blade is not easy because hair gets stuck in between the chassis and the blade. I just had to keep blowing the hair out and working the cleaning comb in the space. I did not want to mess with unscrewing anything.

In summary, we love this razor. The guide combs snap on nicely and come off easily as well. The cape and scissors are not quality and there are entirely too many hair combs in the package. The current price of $25.99 is reasonable for this razor.

title: Great for precision work when finishing my boyfriend’s hair
text:
This set comes with the trimmer, USB charging cable (AC adapter not included), carry pouch, two comb attachments (A &B), cleaning brush, oil, comb, and hair cutting cape.

The hair cutting cape is garbage but the rest is good. I just charged the razor for under 1 hour (charging over 1.5 hours is not recommended), then removed the attached guide comb, set the dial to the cut length I wanted (2), and then did a finishing trim around the edges of my boyfriend’s hair. It cut beautifully and worked great for the detail I was looking for. I then cleaned the razor with a brush and damp paper towel.

The current price of $24.99 is competitive. My only disappointment are the barber cape and comb. The cape is garbage and the comb is too large to fit in the carry case. Other than this, we are very pleased with the cutting ability and precision of this razor.

title: Smells nice, has a moderate lather, cleans my hair well & does not burn my eyes
text:
This 8.5 fluid ounce pump bottle of baby shampoo smells nice but it is a faint aroma and to me it smells like a combination of tea tree oil and citrus even though no such oil is in the ingredients list.

It has a moderate lather and really left my hair feeling clean. I also like that it does not burn my eyes; this is one of the reasons I love baby shampoo.

The current price of $11.99 is pricey but one is paying for organic ingredients and the fact that this is supposedly made WITHOUT phthalates, parabens, dyes, artificial fragrance, or silicone.

title: Generously sized storage bags; can be used for more than wigs & hair extensions
text:
About 15 years ago I had a co-worker from Senegal put long extensions in my hair. These bags would definitely hold them and more. There are three generously-sized satin-like bags with tassel drawstrings. The design on each bag is gorgeous and the vibrant pink color is super attractive. I got these bags for storage of intimates and they work perfectly. The only negative I see is that the tassels are highly subject to static cling.

The current price of $12.99 is reasonable for this as it comes to $4.33 per large drawstring pouch.

title: Excellent keychain carriers but flip top bottles open too easily & no substitutes are possible
text:
Originally I was blown away by the look of this set. There are four sturdy keychain travel bottle carriers with flour flip-top empty bottles. The bottles are designed to fit exactly into these keychain carriers; therefore, there are no substitutes that can be used unless one has a very similar container. The bottles can be removed via the Velcro opening in the front.

I love the look of these and how sturdy the carriers are. Unfortunately, the plastic bottles are not great. Some of the flip tops on these bottles open too easily, which may cause the contents to spill out in one's purse. Also, since these bottles are substandard, I would prefer a carrier that allowed me to put in my own bottles as well, such as these [[ASIN:B08CV7GSVZ Hobein travel carriers]].

There are four keychains with flour carabiners and four empty flip-top plastic bottles. The flip-top bottles can dispense hand sanitizer, hand cream, etc. However, since they are hard, I have to hit the bottle against my hand to dispense any cream as it is not conducive to squeezing. The caps on a couple also open too easily and are its weakest point. However, the keychains themselves are wonderfully designed and sturdy.

The current price of $20.99 is expensive for this set as it comes to $5.25 per carrier. If the bottles were better designed, this would have received 4 stars.

title: Excellent clips that grip well and hold a lot of hair; perfect for that long-hair updo
text:
I admit the clips are odd in the sense that the center is empty. However, they have an excellent grip and do hold a lot of hair. These are perfect for a long-hair updo or just a quick "pick me up." I absolutely love the teal green colored one; in fact, that is my favorite.

There are three large clips in this package and it comes to a reasonable $3.33 per clip at the current price of $9.99.

title: Moisturizes but does not absorb; smells like sour watermelon rind; nothing special – 2.5 stars
text: This is a one ounce pump tube of eye cream for the current price of $22.09 ($25.99 minus 15%). The tube dispenses a lot of cream with one pump so I have to be careful not to press too hard as only a little cream is necessary. I used this regularly around my eye area and it did hydrate my lids and under my eyes. However, I did not find it to be firming and the solution does not absorb well. In addition, the cream smells like sour watermelon rind to me, which is mildly offensive. Oil of Olay face creams (which can be used around the eyes) are so much better. After having tried this, I would never purchase it.

title: Clogs razor; takes forever to wash off; it's terrible; went right in the garbage
text: Even though the tube is sealed, it leaks all over the cap during shipment (see photo). This goes on like cold cream without any lather. I tried this under my nose and on my chin and it gave me a wonderfully close shave and tingled. HOWEVER, it went right in the garbage because the shave cream DOES NOT WASH OFF the razor. I had to replace my razor blade after using this cream for 30 seconds. It's horrible, horrible, horrible. What good is a close shave if the razor gets clogged after first use. I ordered this for my boyfriend but wanted to try this first. There was no way I was going to give this to him. I actually spent 15 minutes trying to get the shave cream out of the cap and I still could not get it off. It just would not rinse off. This is not worth it at any price. If it worked, $9.99 for 4.2 ounces is expensive anyway but at least one could somewhat justify the price. Into the garbage it went.

title: Not a luxury shower cap but a nice one; tight like a bathing cap; runs a bit small
text:
This is an unusual type shower cap in that it is more like a swimming cap style with a bit of a bouffant of a chef's cap as is shown on the model in the Amazon photo. It fits well over my head even though it is not as attractive on me as a regular shower cap. However, it does run on the small side. The elastic stays in place and is very comfortable around my small head. I love how gentle it grips my scalp. There is a loop on the outside (as seen in one photo) where this cap can be hung from.

Both the exterior and interior are waterproof. This cap does run small so this is not for large heads. Coverage is good but my favorite caps are the typical ones that are fully bouffant style. The current price of $19.99 is way too expensive for this cap as it is definitely not a luxury cap. This is not a cap that will last more than six months.

title: Excellent tool to have in my beauty arsenal; makes mask applying easier; some product will be lost
text:
These "silicone spatulas" are excellent. I use this to apply my mask without getting my fingers dirty. It spreads easily. I prefer the flat end to spread if I do not want to lose product. When using the nubbed end, some product is lost among the bristles. These are also easy to wash. I wish I had these years ago.

The current price of $6.99 brings this to $3.50 per wand which I consider competitively priced.

title: Excellent keychain carriers; 6 flip top bottles only okay – 4.5 stars
text:
I am highly impressed with this set, particularly the keychain carriers. The carriers are larger than I expected and the designs are fun and the colors are vibrant and attractive. The pocket in the carrier stretches to accept either the spray bottle or travel-sized hand sanitizers of equivalent size.

There are six keychains with six carabiners and what feels like neoprene carriers. Also included are six flip-top bottles. The flip-top bottles can dispense hand sanitizer, hand cream, etc. However, since they are hard, I have to hit the bottle against my hand to dispense any cream as it is not conducive to squeezing. The cap is also difficult to open and is the bottle's weakest point. However, the keychains themselves are what makes this set worth the purchase because I can put my own travel bottle (if similarly sized) into these keychain carriers. In addition, I can put in a chapstick, nail clipper, etc.

The current price of $10.99 is reasonable for this set as it comes to $1.81 per "souped-up" keychain.

title: Rich, silky cream that leaves my face feeling supple; I love the fresh aroma
text:
This is an absolutely wonderful face cream. The cream is thick, yet silky and perfect for winter. It absorbs well and leaves my face feeling supple. I also love the fresh aroma. Note that I applied this to my entire face and neck but avoided the eye area even though it did not say I had to. This is made in Korea.

In summary, this cream is luxurious and rich all the way. The current price of $32 is competitive for a high-end moisturizer such as this.

title: Versatile set of blender sponges with one display cup; dark colors make it hard to see make-up
text: There are nine vibrant pink/red/mauve blender sponges in this package with one display cup. My favorites are the three with the slanted flat edges. These sponges work as well as any other blender sponges I tried before this and they feel the same too. Someone mentioned that the colors bleeds but I tested that and the color did not bleed on my sponges after washing them with soap and water (see photo). My only caveat is that sponges of this color do not show up make-up well. Therefore, it is hard to see where the make-up has been applied to blend it in. Nevertheless, for the current price of $7.99, I think this set is a steal.

title: Works like many others I tried; pink & yellowish white coloring with body heat
text: These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. The only difference I see is that it changes color from pink to a yellowish white with body heat. This all comes down to price and color preference. I personally feel the current price of $9.99 is expensive for two blending sponges as that comes to $5 each.

title: Great brush with nice handle grip but I do not care for the rubber tire smell
text:
This brush has mostly boar bristles interspersed with nylon bristles. It is generously sized and the silicon-like handle feels great in my hands and keeps it from slipping. I have short to medium-length curly hair and this glided through my hair easily. The bristles are sturdy and the combination of boar and nylon functions well together. My major disappointment is the rubber tire smell. That smell is offensive to me. Other than this, this brush works great.

The current price of $15.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this brush.

title: Works like many others I tried; creamsicle coloring with body heat
text: These make-up blending sponges work like every other blending sponge I tried previously. The only difference I see is that it changes color from orange to a whitish yellow with body heat. This all comes down to price and color preference. I personally feel the current price of $9.99 is expensive for two blending sponges as that comes to $5 each.

title: Pretty & versatile bags but zippers are sticky & one broke immediately
text: These cosmetic bags are very pretty and perfectly sized to carry incidentals or make-up in one's purse. Unfortunately, the zippers on both bags were sticky and would not open and close easily. After opening one of them a few times, the zipper broke as I expected it would. If this had better zippers, then the current price of $9.99 would be reasonable. As is, they are garbage.

title: Stunningly decorated boar & nylon bristle brush w/wooden handled nylon cleaner
text:
This brush has mostly boar bristles interspersed with nylon bristles. It is stunningly decorated with a butterfly and flower. In addition, a wooden handled nylon bristle brush cleaner is included instead of the pink handled metal cleaner shown on the Amazon site.

I have short to medium-length curly hair and this glided through my hair easily. The bristles are sturdy and the combination of boar and nylon functions well together. The brush cleaner is only mildly effective in cleaning the brush. In my opinion, they did not even need to include it as I doubt anything would be effective. This set also comes with a nice cinch closure cloth bag to cover the brush head and hold the cleaning brush.

The current price of $13.57 is reasonable for this gorgeous and colorful set. This is definitely a small enough stocking stuffer or just a general beauty gift.

title: Unusual bathing cap type shower cap; interior is waterproof
text:
This is an unusual type shower cap in that it is more like a swimming cap style as is shown on the model in the Amazon photo. It fits well over my head even though it is not as attractive on me as a regular shower cap which is more bouffant style. The elastic stays in place and is very comfortable around my small head. I love how gentle it grips my scalp.

The exterior of the cap is NOT waterproof. It is the interior plastic lining that is. I actually like this better because the outside dries easier than the inside which reduces mold. The current price of $6.97 is reasonable for this cap.

title: Absolutely gorgeous hair clips that grip small strands of hair very well; LOVE the colors
text:
These clips are absolutely gorgeous. There are 12 clips in this set in six vibrant colors. I ordered the 12cm clips which are almost 4.75 inches from tip to tip.

These grip my hair well. They will hold a small amount of hair and work well as an accent piece or for an updo. The current price of $5.59 ($6.99 minus 20% off) is excellent for this set as it comes to $.47 cents per clip.

title: All four sides on all buffer blocks are the same medium coarseness; these work well
text:
These buffer blocks are of medium coarseness and are perfect for polishing nails, filing nails, or even using on the heels of feet. I need to follow up with a chamois brush after buffing my nails with these. There are 10 blocks (5 pink and 5 white). All sides of all blocks have the same grit. I personally prefer buffing blocks that have various levels of coarseness on each side.

The current price of $6.99 is competitive for this set.

title: Sweet fragrance perfect for a young girl but outrageously expensive & what I rec'd is not pictured
text: This is a nice eyeliner-tube-sized bottle of Ariel Disney fragrance that has sweet notes and is pleasant smelling. The sleek bottle allows this to be easily carried in one's purse and is perfect for travel. As a fragrance, this gets 4 stars. However, I did not receive the bottle pictured. The packaging on mine gets 2 stars. I also personally feel the $88 price tag is outrageous for .27 fluid ounces especially for such a nondescript tube that is being sent out instead of what is pictured on the Amazon site (see my photo). The pricing gets 1 star.

title: A cross between a gel & a cream; says to avoid applying too close to eyes?????
text:
There is one ounce of eye product in an attractive blue tube with a plastic crystal top. Although this says it is eye cream on the tube, it is more like a cross between a gel and a cream and it is slightly opaque. What I don't like is that it says not to apply this product too close to the eyes. Really? This is an eye cream.

Nevertheless, I applied this on my lids and under the eye. It goes on smooth and soaks in and hydrates. However, it hydrated my eye area similarly to the same results I see from the other creams I have. There was no reduction of dark circles or anything like that. I personally would never order this again because of the warning not to apply this close to the eyes.

The current price of $9.59 ($11.99 minus 20% off) is reasonable for this if one does not mind the warning.

title: Very nice face lotion; left my face supple; avoid eye area
text:
This is a very nice face lotion. It has a thick creamy consistency which is perfect for winter. It is also very moisturizing. I apply it day and night to my face and neck after washing. It says to avoid the eye area. I personally do not like face lotions that say that. Nevertheless, it works well, sinks in, and leaves my face supple and hydrated.

The current price of $15.16 ($18.95 minus 20%) is reasonable for this cream.

title: Fragrance-free lightweight hand cream that does not feel very moisturizing to me
text: This hand cream is fragrance free and lightweight. However, it does not feel very moisturizing to me at all. It only lightly moisturized and not enough to make my dry hands feel hydrated. This would be good for the summer when a light moisturizer is needed. However, because the Amazon site says this is an ultra-moisturizing cream, I am rating this 2 stars as it fails as an "ultra moisturizer." The current price of $9.98 would be expensive but competitively priced for a 2.82 ounce tube if it lived up to its claims.

title: ICK – I absolutely hate the stickiness of this lip gloss
text: This feels like glue on my lips and that feeling never went away until I washed this off. I absolutely hate the stickiness of this gloss. It is also only mildly glossy. The only positive is that it is moisturizing and the vanilla scent is nice. Nevertheless, after having tried this, I would never order this again. The current price of $20 ($15 on Black Friday) is also outrageous for a tube of gloss that is similar to Blistex but has the feel of glue.

title: Colorful grooming kit in a nice compact case; I wish tool instructions were included
text:
This 16-piece set contains more grooming tools than I will ever use or need. The quality is good for the price. The nail clippers are sharp and work as designed and the ridged grip keeps them from slipping from my hands. The tweezer works very well. There are other tools, such as facial pimple poppers, ear wax scoops, etc. Absolutely no instructions came with this set, so I had to go to the Amazon site to find out what some of these tools are used for.

It does come in a sturdy and very attractive carry case. This is a perfect stocking stuffer type gift for a young lady. I personally love the purple color as that is one of my favorite colors. The current price of $12.99 is reasonable for this set.

title: Average quality kit that is good for the price – 3.5 stars
text:
This 16-piece set contains more grooming tools than I will ever use or need. The quality is average. The nail clippers are sharp and work as designed but the grip on them is nothing special. The tweezer works well. There are other tools, such as facial pimple poppers, ear wax scoops, etc. Absolutely no instructions came with this set, so I had to go to the Amazon site to find out what some of the tools were.

It does come in a nice carry case. I do not consider this set professional but it is perfect as a complete starter set for a young lady. The current price of $11.19 is very reasonable for this set.

title: Sharp 3-piece nail clipper set with embedded files & carry case
text:
There are three nail clippers in this set (fingernail clipper, toe nail clipper, and an oblique nail clipper which I call an angled nail clipper). The cutting edge on these three clippers are sharp. I was impressed at how easily they cut. In addition, there is an embedded metal nail file on the handle of each clipper. This all comes in a nice metal case.

I have never had an angled nail clipper before and I find it works well on cuticles or to trim the edges of my nails.

The current price of $20.79 is expensive but if these clipper cutting edges hold out, then I consider this worth it and this set is solid and well-designed.

title: Almost scentless hand cream that leaves my hands super silky – I LOVE IT!
text: I just LOVE this cream. It is lightweight but very moisturizing and leaves my hands feeling super silky. I detect a faint scent of tea leaves which is very nice. The current price of $3.99 for a 1.76 ounce tube is competitive. I would definitely order this again.

title: Springs are very strong on this clip set and they hold the hair well
text:
These hold on to my hair well and I have fine short to medium-length hair although these are designed for someone who has longer hair.

I love the four fun colors. The coating feels like silicone and keeps the clips from slipping out of my hands. Also, the spring action is very strong which is not all that common to find. The strong spring is the best feature of each clip. In addition, because the tines cross each other, it grips the hair well.

Overall, I think these are great clips in four fun colors. The current price of $9.87 makes them a reasonable $2.47 apiece.

title: Non-tangling miniature hair ties that stay hidden in the hair; a bit pricey for what they are
text: These spiral hair ties are perfect for making small pony tails or tying up one's hair. They do not tangle my hair and are easily removed. There are four cream soda colored (a.k.a. whiskey) and four clear hair ties for a total of eight miniature spirals. My only complaint is that $6.39 is very pricey for this as it comes to $.80 per tie.

title: Small cosmetic organizer with attractive design
text: This is a small cosmetic organizer. I love the attractive design with what looks like an iridescent emerald green color. Since it is small, it fits about four pill bottles or enough small make-up applicators and compacts for a full face of makeup. There are two half-height mesh pockets on the inside and the central compartment. The zipper also glides easily. It is made of PU (fake) leather and the current price of $7.99 is pricey but competitive.

title: Nice make-up application set but too expensive & finger holds too tight
text:
This set comes with a sponge and brush head as well as one base applicator these go into. It also comes with instructions and a cloth case.

I love the sponge and brush. They apply foundation and blend well. However, I have three issues with this set. First of all, the applicator arm is cheap plastic, so I do not understand why two of them were not included as I have to keep switching sponge and brush heads.

Second, the applicator finger holes are tight. I am able to fit two fingers into it but only at the tip which makes application uncomfortable after a while.

This is a nice set with a giftable box, The current price of $39 is way too expensive for this-- about $27 too expensive in my opinion.
