title: Perfect young-girl hair ties; slides easily out of my hair; has more uses
text:
These hair ties are very useful. They are soft and easily slide out of my hair. They come in two colors. I chose the light and dark yellow and received 25 of each color for a total of 50 ties.

These can be used as fasteners too. For instance, to hold a deck of cards together, tie a small pill case closed, etc.

The current price of $6.64 ($6.99 minus 5% off) is competitive for this.

title: Plus-sized shower caps that fit me perfectly; elastic is not as tight as I would like – 3.5 stars
text: I love the design and feel of these shower caps. These are also very large. I ordered the 13" size. The only issue I have is that the elasticized cap is not tight enough to keep the cap from sliding around a bit during a shower.

title: Excellent large pump bottles 4 everything from dish detergent to shampoo; soap visible thru plastic
text:
The bottles are a thick opaque plastic. Both bottles look exactly the same, so there is no way to tell them apart except for the color of the soap that displays through the plastic. If I were using this to dispense shampoo and conditioner, I would have trouble knowing which bottle had what solution unless the color of the product differed.

I got this to store my dishwashing detergent for easier dispensing. The pump mechanism works very well and feels solid. When filling this, it is important that the soap not come above the top rim because the insertion of the pump causes the soap to spill out over the top. I filled it a tad over the top rim and discovered this.

The current price of $11.99 for two 32 ounce bottles is a bit on the expensive side at $6 each. I think this should not be priced at more than $10.

title: Pancake-sized puffs decent for applying body powder but I would not use for make-up – 3.5 stars
text:
There are three pancake-sized puffs in this package. The puffs have a luxurious feel to them but they are not furry like most powder puffs. As a result, the powder runs off the surface and does not catch in the puff. This is not too much of a problem as long as the puff is angled the right way to reduce spillage during application.

Since these are so large, I would never use this as a make-up puff to set foundation (as per the Amazon site) because it covers almost the entire center of my face. The large size would make this difficult to work with for a facial application.  As a powder puff it is good with the caveat that the powder does not stick to this like some furry puffs I have had before.

The current price of $9.13 is competitive.

PS I love the smell of these puffs. It smells like clean cloth which is not typical of many "made in China" products.

title: Easter-colored blending sponges with holder; love the colors & holder
text: I love the colors of these make-up blenders and the holder is nice for one of the larger sponges. There are four sponges in this set with one holder. The yellow sponge has a flat side and acts well for smooth applications. I like the tiny sponge for the eye area. These feel good in the hands, blend well, and wash well with soap and water. These are great for a gift due to the presentation. The strips of paper in the box remind me of Easter bedding. The current price of $12.99 is on the high side but one is paying for the presentation of this set. The sponges themselves are similar to all of the others that I tried before this. To me what set of sponges to buy all comes down to the price and the angles one wants on the sponges as well as whether it is for gifting or not. This set is good for gifting.

title: Very large and sturdy hair clips
text: These are very nice hair clips. They are super large and perfect to "pin" up long hair. They also feel super sturdy. Of course, clips eventually break and only time will tell how long these lasts.  The current price of $9.99 is a competitive $5 each.

title: Razor works but guide combs & charger are either broken or completely useless
text:
This set comes with the base razor with attached blade, a USB charging cable (wall outlet not included), four guide combs (1/16, 1/8, 1/4, & 3/8mm), a cleaning brush, small bottle of oil, and a hairdresser description pamphlet but absolutely no instructions.

This razor is very goth looking due to the skull contact paper on the handle which feels nice. The tiny blade is good for precision and detail cutting. However, this is where the good stuff ends. The razor only works once because the power cable breaks after the first use. The guide combs simply do not work. The 1/16 guide comb pops off the razor and notice from the photo that the tiny plastic protrusion is missing; it actually fell off when seating the comb. The 1/8 comb goes on but keeps popping off, the 3/8 comb will not snap on at all, and the 1/4 comb is also missing the tiny plastic protrusion so that comb flies off the razor as well.

The light on the bottom of the razor lights red when charging and goes out when the charge is complete. The razor lights up slightly in the dark. There is a tiny on/off knob button on the bottom and it is easy to operate. This is good for precision work with the razor only but since the power cable breaks immediately, I only got one use out of this. Of course one could buy another cable (which I think is a USB type C connector), but it is not worth it for me. Also, I could not use the trimmer combs because they do not stay on the razor. In my tests, the razor (without combs) shaves relatively close but not will not get as close as a straight edge razor. In fact, no electric razor shaves that close, so this does a good job. 

I have no idea if the blade head comes off for cleaning or not; however, that is not needed since it will go in the garbage when the charge dies.

The current price of $29.99 would be reasonable if all parts came in working order and lasted. My recommendation is to look elsewhere.

title: Medium-weight cream that is hydrating; perfect for fall and winter; scentless
text:
This cream is medium-weight which is perfect for fall and winter. I use this on my face and neck and it is very moisturizing and soaks in without feeling tacky. It also does not clog my pores. This is scentless and that is my only dislike. I prefer fragranced creams.

The current price of $19.99 is reasonable for a 1.7 ounce jar.

title: Gorgeously designed razor; clips R easy 2 get on / impossible 2 get off; will break over time; 3.5*
text:
This razor is so artistic looking and the base feels substantial; I love that. This set comes with the base razor with attached blade, a USB charging cable (wall outlet not included), four guide combs (1, 2, 3, & 4mm), a cleaning brush,a small bottle of lubricant, and the instruction pamphlet.

The instruction pamphlet has several mistakes in it. For example, the on/off button is pictured in the wrong spot on the front cover. Also, it says the razor blinks blue when charging and the light is actually solid red when charging and solid blue when fully charged or powered on. In addition, the pictures and captions to those pictures are so small that I felt reading it was an eye test.

There is an on/off button on the bottom of the razor which lights blue when turned on and it is easy to operate. For precision work, I use this without the guide combs. In my tests, it shaves nicely but will not get as close as a straight edge razor. In fact, no electric razor shaves that close, so this does a good job. The cutting combs slip over the blade housing easily but are practically IMPOSSIBLE to unclip. I had to use a tool to pry the clips off the blade. In addition, the combs are very cheap and during unclipping, I felt like I was going to break the plastic clip that holds it onto the blade. I personally believe these combs will break quickly.

I cannot tell if the blade head comes off for cleaning as I could not remove it and there was no mention of removing this in the manual. After cleaning the manual states to lubricate the left, middle, and right of the blade.

Overall, I think this is a reasonable hair/beard razor for the current price of $29.99. Nevertheless, the guide combs are not lasting quality and will most likely break. However, I got this for the main unit which I feel will last a while. I personally love how this razor looks like a work of art.

title: Reasonably priced shaver; a bit on the cheap side; clip guides will break over time
text:
This razor looks elegant and very attractive. However, the housing feels cheap. This set comes with the base razor with attached blade, a USB charging cable (wall outlet not included), four guide combs (1, 2, 3, & 4mm), a cleaning brush, and the instruction pamphlet.

The razor lights red when charging and blue when charge is complete There is an on/off knob on the size and it is easy to operate. For precision work, use this without the guide combs. In my tests, it shaves relatively close but not will not get as close as a straight edge razor. In fact, no electric razor shaves that close, so this does a good job. The cutting combs slip over the blade housing easily and unclip almost as easily. However, the combs are very cheap and during unclipping, I almost felt like I was going to break the plastic clip. I personally believe these will break quickly.

The blade head comes off for cleaning by pushing it backwards. It was a bit scary to try to remove the blade head because I had to push real hard to have it come off. It is almost like popping a bottle cap. Getting it back on is tricky; it's a matter of pushing it in place in reverse of the way it was taken off.

Overall, I think this is a reasonable hair/beard razor for the current price of $29.99. Nevertheless, one is not getting lasting quality with this unit. I feel the main unit will last a while but the guide combs will not. If the guide combs are important, my recommendation is to invest in a high quality trimmer.

title: Has nice clip closure that keeps hair out from the neckline; however, back is too short
text: The way the closure works is that the clip slides over the neck elastic at the point one decides to overlap it. There is a clip for the left and right side and it works wonderful as it keeps the neck clean. The front is long enough but the back is way too short and that is the only reason I rated this 3 stars. The back needs to be long enough to put over a chair and this is not. Other than this detail, I think this is reasonably priced at  $6.45 ($6.79 minus 5% off).

title: Works well enough to keep most hair off the body during a haircut
text: This cape is reasonably sized and drapes nicely in the front. The back has snap closures. If someone's neck is terribly skinny, this would leave a gap around the neck because they need one or two more snaps in that area. The back is short as expected. There is nothing fantastic about this cape but it does the job it is designed to do. In this sense, this is good enough. The current price of $8.49 is on the high side of what I would expect to pay for a cape like this.

title: Clip closure (not snap); long in front, short in back, full sleeves – 3.5 stars
text:
I was almost going to rate this one star because I could not figure out the closure until I went on the Amazon site. I thought the clip was sewn upside down. However, it is a clip closure (see photo) and not a snap closure.

The way the closure works is that the clip slides over the neck elastic at the point one decides to overlap it. There is a clip for the left and right side and it works wonderful as it keeps the neck clean. There are sleeves in this cape and a long front. However, the back is a bit short. I would have preferred it to be a little longer.

The current price of $15.99 is a bit expensive for this.

title: Pretty headband for flower girl, wedding party, or Halloween costume – 3.5 stars
text:
This is a pretty headpiece for the perfect application. Note that it has to be reshaped upon arrival as it gets all bent in shipment. I can see this on a flower girl, for girls in a wedding party or their quinceanera, or even as part of a Halloween costume. It is very feminine. The current price of $13.99 is competitive.

PS Since I did not have anyone to demonstrate this, I put this on my stuffed giraffe.

title: Excellent hair clips for an updo; bobby pins and hair tie cheapen this set
text: This set includes two big claw clips, one package of bobby pins, and a child's colorful hair tie. The clips are absolutely wonderful. They have a good hold and are snug. They also do not feel cheap.  The addition of the bobby pins is okay but unnecessary. However, with the addition of the one child's hair tie, that cheapens the set making it look like garbage to me. My opinion is to hold the extras and only ship the clips as they stand on their two feet and are excellent. The current price of $13.99 comes to $7 per clip which is competitive.

title: Nice set of makeup and blending sponges but extremely overpriced
text: This is a nice set of three makeup sponges for applying foundation or just blending. I particularly like the tiny sponge for precision work. Since they all have rounded bottoms, none of these sponges stand up on their own which is disappointing. Nevertheless, they are soft and as useful as every other similar type of blending sponge I have tried before. Unfortunately, the current price of $18.99 is OUTRAGEOUS as I can buy a set like this at my local store for about half the price which works just as well.

title: Nice makeup sponge but so are many others on the market; a bit $$$
text: This is a nice makeup sponge for applying foundation or just blending. It is soft and has a flat bottom and angled side. Nevertheless, $6.99 is a bit pricey for this. Yes it comes in a pretty package but I can get sponges like this for half the price at my local store. This is the only reason I rated this 4 stars.

title: A wonderful jasmine aroma; last several hours; it’s vegan
text: This is a very small bottle of fragrance but it does pack a punch. I love the wonderful jasmine aroma. It also lasts many hours and does not wear off easily. In addition, it is vegan and is made in the USA. The current price of $14.95 is also competitive. In summary, I find this to be a lovely perfume.

title: The most fragrant rose; lasts several hours; it’s vegan
text: This is a very small bottle of fragrance but it does pack a punch. I love the lovely rose aroma. It also lasts many hours and does not wear off easily. In addition, it is vegan and is made in the USA. The current price of $14.95 is also competitive. In summary, I find this to be a lovely perfume.

title: Beautiful floral notes; fragrance lasts several hours; it’s vegan
text: This is a very small bottle of fragrance but it does pack a punch. I love the lovely floral notes. It also lasts many hours and does not wear off easily. In addition, it is vegan and is made in the USA. The current price of $14.95 is also competitive. In summary, I find this to be a lovely perfume.

title: Colorful buff puffs that lather well in the shower; price is high
text: The current price of $12.99 ($13.99 plus $1 off) is high for four buff puffs similar to ones that can be purchased for $2 or $3 at Walmart. This comes to $3.25 per puff. Nevertheless, these are beautiful. I love the variegated teal with white colors. Each puff comes with a ribbon to hang it in the shower. These lather well just like all the others of this style. These are also tightly "woven." Overall, these are 5-star puffs at a 6-star price.

title: Very nice scrunchies with storage pouch for change which has limited use
text: There are 12 colorful and very functional scrunchies. Each scrunchie has a zippered storage pouch. A few coins or a small key can be secured there. However, if putting in a few bills, it is impossible to use the scrunchie on the hair because the bill makes it too rigid. To me the storage is a gimmick and only mildly useful. However, the scrunchies are great and that is what I am rating here. Also the current price of $7.99 makes each scrunchie about $.67 cents each which is a good deal.

title: Subtle but nice fresh scent, slightly moisturizing, and cleans well
text:
I have this and their [[ASIN:B07J57YC8T Solimo Body Wash, Deep Moisturizing for Dry Skin]] and [[ASIN:B07CJXFTVZ Solimo Moisturizing Coconut Milk and Jasmine Nourishing Body Wash]] on subscribe and save. This one is my second favorite with my favorite being their deep moisturizing one due to the scent and extreme moisture.

This sensitive skin version is very nice. I thought it would be scentless but it is not. It has a light, fresh aroma that is very pleasant. The soap lathers well in the shower with a buff puff and leaves me feeling clean and somewhat moisturized. Overall, I am pleased I purchased this and would order it again; however, their [[ASIN:B07J57YC8T Solimo Body Wash, Deep Moisturizing for Dry Skin]] is still my favorite and first choice with this one a close second and their Jasmine version last choice.

title: "Staying on" is this lip stain’s best feature; the deep color is its second best feature
text:
The current price of $32 for .09 fluid ounce wand of lip stain is expensive. However, now I know why. This has a nice deep mauve color and goes on my lips like paint or nail polish. I actually have to be careful when applying because it is super easy to overshoot the lips. Nevertheless, this has tremendous staying power and does not wear off easily. I had to scrub my lips with soap and water real hard in order to get this off.

I love the "sticktoitiveness" of this "lipstick." If one is looking for a great matte color that has a long-lasting finish, then this is one tube to consider.

title: Beautiful shower caps but they are too small for adults; more kid-sized
text:
I am utterly disappointed in these caps. In the package are two kitty designed shower caps. The Amazon site says these are for women and kids; however, they are too small for adults. It fits plastered around my head with no room for tucking all my hair in. Note that I have a small head and take all my adult hats in a small.

These caps are beautiful with a nice kitty design and a double layer construction. Unfortunately, I cannot use them. If it were not for the small size, I would have given these 5 stars.

These are made in China.

title: Wide teeth, large combs, great grip in the shower; mildly detangling; a bit pricey
text: These combs are large and they feel great in my hands. The thick curved top provides me with a great grip in the shower. The width between the tines is spacious so these are only mildly detangling but they are perfect to work conditioner through the hair. I also love the purple and greenish teal colors. However, the current price of $15 is a bit expensive for this. I personally would not pay more than $8 for this set.

title: Permits me to wear my mask with putting elastics behind my ears; colorful & comfortable
text:
These headbands are wide, colorful, soft, and overall a great way to hold back my hair and attach my mask to the headband. As long as I keep this headband over my ears, this stays on my head. If I do not put this over my ears, the band will slide around.

I love the blue color. The material is slinky (a.k.a. 100% Polyester) but soft and has a nice stretch to it. The buttons have to be positioned on either side of the head. The mask elastics are hooked to the buttons. The headband looks best with the seam turned toward the back. 

In general, these are excellent double layer headbands. There is no price listed; however, they are listed [[ASIN:B08CRJM44P here]] for $12.99 for two headbands which is a very reasonable $6.50 per band.

title: I love the citrus fragrance of this oil but it does not brighten my skin or moisturize better
text: This is an oil that goes on with a dropper. I applied three to four drops for my entire face and neck. It has a citrus aroma that I love and it absorbs well; however, the next morning my face was not any "brighter" or "lighter" than normal nor was it moisturized more than the other cheaper creams I use.

title: Not particularly nourishing; performs no better for me than store-bought cheap creams
text: This is an oil that goes on with a dropper. I applied three to four drops for my entire face and neck. The oil absorbs well; however, the next morning I did not feel any more nourished or moisturized that with the other cheaper creams I use. Also, I see no reduction in wrinkles.

title: Wonderfully moisturizing; absorbs almost instantly; hands are silky afterward
text:
This cream is wonderful. It absorbs almost instantly and my hands are silky afterward. I also had my boyfriend try this and he also thinks this hand lotion is fantastic. It comes out as a gel--more like petroleum jelly than a cream.

I have no idea as to the cost of this tiny 1.69 fluid ounce tube. I would hope that it will not be more than $8 but I suspect they will price between $12-15 which would make this very expensive.

title: Shower cap falls off; bath sponge ok; bath puff is the best item – 2.5 stars
text:
I am definitely not crazy about this set. The bath puff is the best as it is like any other I tried. I love bath puffs because they lather up the soap well. However, the shower cap is kid-sized. I have a small head and it barely covers my entire head and keeps falling off. Therefore, the shower cap is useless to me. The bath sponge is okay but I am personally not into sponges as they do not lather well. This one is more like an exfoliating sponge. It also arrives compressed and has to be cut out of the plastic wrapping.

This entire set gets 2.5 stars from me (rounded up to 3 stars). The current price of $12.99 is not worth it for this set.

title: More like a men’s tie; it is too narrow for my taste
text:
I have [[ASIN:B08794YWYK this version]] of the UPTOUP head scarf and it is wider than this one, which I prefer.

This is a colorfully-designed head scarf with a bear and flower at the edges. However, the scarf is only the width of a large men's tie and has a depth of 3.5 inches. Therefore, this only wraps around my head like the headband of the 1960s. It is very attractive and feels like it is made of Polyester without any stretch. Note that there is no tag on the scarf to say what it is made of.

The price of $6.99 for this is competitive but due to its narrow size, it can double as a men's tie.

title: I love the pink color of this brush but I like URTHEONE brushes better; quick assembly required
text:
I already own these [[ASIN:B08BNHZ833URTHEONE detangling brushes]] and love them. Therefore, I wanted a pink one like this for my pink bathroom so I ordered this.

There is one pink detangling brush with one rod that needs to be installed on top. I prefer a wider brush, so I installed it on the lower rung. 

I use my other brushes every other day to detangle my hair in the shower and love them but this pink one is not as great. First of all the handle is cheap and does not have a silicone grip. This means the grip is not as good. Second, the rod that gets installed only has two nubs on it that connect with the tines of the brush instead of several like the other brushes. This means it does not stay put as easily. However, it still works on detangling my short to medium curly hair in the shower and if some hair gets caught, it easily rinses out. In addition, this can be used as a regular brush too. 

The current price of $5.99 is reasonable for one brush but I recommend the other brand over this one.

title: Versatile hair ties; they do stretch out with use as expected; love the four colors
text:
There are four boxes of three hair ties each box (lilac, spring green, light pink, and sky blue) for a total of 12 ties. These four colors are very attractive but they really are not that visible in the hair.

Each tie is very tiny. They stretch easily to hold a lot of hair and they do hold the hair. I did have some difficulty removing these from my hair because if one is not careful, strands can get caught between the curl of the tie. However, that is to be expected with these type ties, so I unwound the tie to make it easier to undo.

The ring will stretch out with use, so be aware of that.

I do like the individual boxes because they can be used when making up door gifts for tricky trays or as stocking stuffers, etc. They can be worn around the hair, put on a keyring, wrapped around the wrist or ankle as decoration or to hold a key that is on a keyring while swimming, etc.

At the current price of $5.99 each tie comes to $.50 cents each or $1.50 per box.  For a better deal, one might want to buy the larger quantity such as [[ASIN:B08CVHQP84 these]].

title: Razor is beautiful; only partially works; 2 of 3 clips broke immediately – 2.5 stars
text:
The current price of $37.99 for this trimmer would be reasonable if it totally worked. Unfortunately, this gets 2.5 stars from me (rounded up to 3 stars).

This set includes the trimmer, 3 guide combs for 1mm, 3mm, & 6mm trim, USB cable, cleaning brush, and manual. The clippers by themselves work wonderfully. However, the clip on guide combs break immediately when trying to affix it to the top of the trimmer. Of the three combs, I had two clips break. In addition, once the guide combs are in place, this trimmer DOES NOT cut. I gave my boyfriend a haircut and I could not use this trimmer. I actually had to use his other trimmer to buzz his hair. When I was done, I could use this razer without the trimming combs and it did great precision work. Therefore, this is a disappointment.

Note that this charges in a few hours with the provided USB cable (USB wall plug adapter not included). There is a light on the bottom that goes out when it's charged. The on/off switch is on the bottom too.

In summary, this trimmer is absolutely gorgeous. I love the artistic skull design on front and the anchor on back. However, this is only good for precision work without the guide combs. The guide combs are useless, they break immediately, and the trimmer fails to cut with them on. In addition, there is no way to easily remove the head for cleaning without a screwdriver. The supplied brush is good temporarily.

title: Love the large flat edge and point on these blending sponges
text:
These are excellent blending sponges for applying foundation or fading in various make-up and blush colors. There are four sponges. Each sponge has a large flat angled edge and a point besides the typical rounded sides. They feel great in the hands and work very well. However, practically every blending sponge I tried also works well, except the flat angled edge on these is a favorite of mine.

The current price of $6.99 is reasonable for this as it comes to $1.75 per sponge.

title: Leaves my hands and body very silky; goes on smooth & creamy & absorbs well; it's vegan
text: This is very nice unscented vegan lotion. It goes on creamy and absorbs well. It is a great lotion for the fall as it is neither too thick or two light. My boyfriend tried it too and really likes this. The current price of $11.99 for 8.5 ounces is slightly pricey but still competitive simply because this moisturizes well.

title: Moisturizes well but smells like sour milk to me
text:
This cream is thick and creamy and goes on smooth. It absorbs quickly and moisturizes my face well. However, I cannot stand the smell. To me the aroma is more like sour milk and that just kills it for me.

PS This is certified as vegan.

title: More of a decorating bow than a ponytail holder
text:
These bows are gorgeous with the electric pink color full of glitter. However, they are as stiff as cardboard or hard plastic. Although they can be used as a ponytail holder, they are more suited to a package topper or some sort of "breast cancer" decoration than something for the hair. They are not only big, but the stiffness makes it difficult to apply. I was able to get this on my head but then I have short-to-medium-length hair.

The current price of $10.99 for four bows comes to $2.75 each which is very reasonable. Personally, I do not feel these are suitable for what they are being advertised for simply because of the incredible stiffness of the bows.

title: These microfiber (a.k.a. Polyester) head towels feel more like a lightweight terry cloth - 3.5 stars
text:
There are four lightweight terry-cloth-like head wraps in this package that are actually made of Polyester, which is apparently what microfiber is made from. However, they do not feel like the microfiber I am familiar with. They have an elastic on the narrow end that gets looped around the button on the head end. They are somewhat absorbent but not as absorbent as true terry cloth.

I love the purple, light pink, hot pink, and blue colors. The black/white trim is a nice touch but I would have preferred no trim. The current price of $14.99 for four towels comes to $3.75 per towel which is reasonable for what this is. Overall, I like these but do prefer true terry cloth over microfiber because it is more absorbent.

title: I love the purple and greenish teal colors of these detangling brushes; quick assembly required
text:
There are two detangling brushes in this set with two rods that need to be installed on top of each brush. I prefer a wider brush, so I installed them on the lower rung. Also, included is a comb, which I personally have no need for.

I already ordered one of these brushes a long time ago and use it every other day to detangle my hair in the shower. I have short to medium curly hair and this works well. Also, it feels great in the hands and no hair gets caught in the bristles. If some hair gets caught, it easily rinses out.

These can be used as regular brushes too. My boyfriend also likes them. I personally love the colors, especially since the purple one matches my purple bathroom.

The current price of $8.99 is reasonable for two brushes (one large and one medium) and a comb.

title: Permits me to wear my mask with putting elastics behind my ears; colorful & comfortable
text:
These headbands are wide, colorful, soft, and overall a great way to hold back my hair and attach my mask to the headband. As long as I keep this headband over my ears, this stays on my head. I love the orange color. The material is slinky but soft and has a nice stretch to it. The buttons have to be positioned on either side of the head. The mask elastics are hooked to the buttons. The headband looks best with the seam turned toward the back. 

In general, these are excellent double layer headbands. The current price of $12.99 for two headbands is a very reasonable $6.50 per band.

title: “Tissue-sized” wipes that are as strong as baby wipes but they are dry; they hold up wet
text: There are six plastic packages of 80 wipes for a total of 480 "dry tissues." They look and almost feel exactly like unscented tissues. However, they perform very well. These are strong and hold up when wet to pick up messes, clean urine off a litter pan, etc. They are perfect for cleaning a baby's bottom or pet's bottom as well. I use these to clean my cat's urine off the walls of the litter pan but I wet the wipe first. The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because they are expensive at the current price of $32.99 it comes to $.07 cents per wipe. It is $.04 cents cheaper than their [[ASIN:B084X68G38 single boxed version]] but it is still way more expensive than  wet baby wipes that are on the market.

title: “Tissue-sized” wipes that are as strong as baby wipes but they are dry; they hold up wet
text: This comes in a standard tissue box of 100 wipes. They look and almost feel exactly like unscented tissues. However, they perform very well. These are strong and hold up when wet to pick up messes, clean urine off a litter pan, etc. They are perfect for cleaning a baby's bottom or pet's bottom as well. I use these to clean my cat's urine off the walls of the litter pan but I wet the wipe first. The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because they are expensive at the current price of $10.99 it comes to $.11 cents per wipe. Even wet baby wipes are a lot cheaper.

title: Very nice scent and slightly moisturizing
text: I have their [[ASIN:B07J57YC8T Solimo Body Wash, Deep Moisturizing for Dry Skin]] on subscribe and save and fell in love with it over time. As a result, I decided to try all their versions. This coconut and jasmine version is very nice. It has a light coconut flavor with a little bit of the sweet smell of jasmine. Neither of the notes come through pure but the combination is very pleasant. The soap lathers well in the shower with a buff puff and leaves me feeling clean and somewhat moisturized. Overall, I am pleased I purchased this and would order it again; however, their [[ASIN:B07J57YC8T Solimo Body Wash, Deep Moisturizing for Dry Skin]] is still my favorite.

title: Versatile hair ties; they do stretch out with use as expected
text:
There are six boxes of three hair ties each box. Each tie is very tiny. They stretch easily to hold a lot of hair and they do hold the hair. I did have some difficulty removing these from my hair because if one is not careful, strands can get caught between the curl of the tie. However, that is to be expected with these type ties, so I unwound the tie to make it easier to undo.

The ring will stretch out with use, so be aware of that.

I do like the individual boxes because they can be used when making up door gifts for tricky trays or as stocking stuffers, etc. They can be worn around the hair, put on a keyring, wrapped around the wrist or ankle as decoration or to hold a key that is on a keyring while swimming, etc.

At the current price of $6.99 each tie comes to $.39 cents each or $1.17 per box.

title: Convenient warming mask but a washcloth w/warm water is so much better
text:
This is like a hand warmer for the eyes. There is no steam and not much value to this in my opinion. The only value is the convenience of an eye-warming mask when no warm water washcloth is available.

As per the instructions, I opened the mask which causes it to heat up. I then hooked the ear holes around my ears and laid down for 20 minutes with this on my eyes. It should not be pressed to the eyes. After 20 minutes, I removed it. Note the mask still remained warm for about 5 more minutes.  Upon removal, my eyes were lightly burning as if I got soap in my eyes. My lids felt moist but I would not call it steam. I personally feel a washcloth soaked in very warm water and placed on the eyelids is a much better solution.

This mask contains iron powder, activitate carbon, and water.

In summary, this product's only redeeming value is the convenience of having a warming mask when there is no warm water or washcloth available.

title: Typical loofah sponge; mildly exfoliating; doesn’t contribute to soap lather
text: There are three almost equally-sized loofahs in this box with a loop string for hanging. These loofahs are mildly exfoliating like most typical loofahs are. They also do not help work soap into a lather like a buff puff. I personally do not like to use these to wash but instead just use these with water only to exfoliate after I have already showered. The reason is that I find loofahs do not promote suds and I wind up wasting a lot of soap.

title: A nice trio of stretchy headbands; Velcro may not be long enough for a skinny head
text:
I love that these headbands come in a multitude of colors. This trio is more muted in the black, gray, and white and goes with anything. The band is wide, stretchy and perfect for holding my hair back when applying make-up or just as a statement piece. It will help catch sweat as well. I even wrapped it around my wrist. However, if doing that, the looped Velcro side has to be positioned correctly because the Velcro will have to affix itself to the band material and not to the opposing strip.

I do feel that a long strip of Velcro is needed on these bands because if my head were a bit skinnier, the tabs would have overshot each other on either side and I would have been unable to fasten it closed. Lucky these work for me but I do wish they were a tad tighter.

Note that it is best if the band is fastened to the opposing Velcro strip and put in a small lingerie bag in the wash. If that is not done, the Velcro may tear into the fabric and other clothes in the laundry.

Overall, this is a nice set of three wide headbands.  I now have a [[ASIN:B089W3L53V purple set]] for my purple bathroom and a [[ASIN:B089VZBY88 pink set]] for my pink bathroom in addition to this trio.

title: This is very moisturizing and has antibacterial properties; I love the lavender fragrance
text:
This is for skin and hair. I ordered this for my eczema and as an overall moisturizer for my skin. It is very moisturizing. However, for eczema, I prefer the [[ASIN:B083JMN5MB extra strength]] version because it is thicker; note it will take about two weeks to see results. This regular version has a thinner viscosity. 

Since it is thinner, it is not as oily, which reduces any staining on clothing. I love the lavender fragrance of this oil; it is so soothing to the senses.

Jamaican black castor oil has antibacterial / antifungal properties which is why it works somewhat on eczema. Since this is an oil, it will stain clothing with a greasy patch if one does not let it sink in first. That greasy patch does not come out with Tide because I tried to wash it out.

Overall, I like the results, particularly for moisturizing the feet.

title: Lightly moisturizing for a body butter; smells nice; color is off-putting
text:
This review is for the Olive Body Butter by Delon. When I think of body butter, I think incredibly moisturizing and thick. This is moisturizing but it only lightly moisturizes. The cream is also on the thin side. It absorbs easily and makes my skin feel great. I love the subtly sweet scent. Unfortunately, the greenish gray color is off-putting. Also, the current price of $27.99 is outrageous for one jar. The Amazon site says the price is for three jars and if that is correct, then the price is more reasonable at $9.33 each. It is possible that reviewers only receive one jar but the review site does not say that, so I cannot be sure a purchaser will receive one container or three.

I personally would only purchase this if the price were about $4 per jar. If the color was better and the cream thicker, then I would pay up to $8 per 6.9 ounce container.

title: Creates a barrier on my skin; good moisturizer and anti-bacterial; don’t like smoky aroma
text:
I have never used Jamaican black castor oil before. I discovered that it is a good antibacterial and safe to use daily. I used this on my hands and feet and it moisturizes well. It does create a barrier on my hands and takes over 15 minutes to sink in.

The body butter has a sandy feel to it almost as if it is supposed to be used as a pumice. Nevertheless once rubbed in, it goes away. I personally would not use this on my hair because it would be too greasy for that. I'll be using this on my eczema and my feet. Note that oils like this do stain clothes if not allowed to dry.

My only dislike is the smell; it has an ashtray-like smoky aroma.

title: Gorgeous vibrant purple colored stretchy headband; Velcro may not be long enough for a skinny head
text:
I love the vibrant purple color of this headband. It is wide, stretchy and perfect for holding my hair back when applying make-up or just as a statement piece. It will help catch sweat as well. I even wrapped it around my wrist. However, if doing that, the looped Velcro side has to be positioned correctly because the Velcro will have to affix itself to the band material and not to the opposing strip.

I do feel that a long strip of Velcro is needed on these bands because if my head were a bit skinnier, the tabs would have overshot each other on either side and I would have been unable to fasten it closed. Lucky these work for me but I do wish they were a tad tighter.

Note that it is best if the band is fastened to the opposing Velcro strip and put in a small lingerie bag in the wash. If that is not done, the Velcro may tear into the fabric and other clothes in the laundry.

Overall, this is a nice, colorful set of three wide headbands.  I now have a set for my purple bathroom and another [[ASIN:B089VZBY88 pink set]] for my pink bathroom.

title: Very moisturizing and I really like the lavender aroma
text:
I tried this exact same oil in their [[ASIN:B07R4MBDN8 lemongrass]] fragrance but did not like the aroma. Since I really loved the moisturizing effects of this oil, I decided to try another scent.

Nevertheless, this massage oil is very moisturizing, glides on my skin easily, and absorbs pretty fast. In addition, I really like this lavender fragrance as it is not overpowering and smells like lavender to me.

title: Gorgeous deep pink colored stretchy headband; Velcro may not be long enough for a skinny head
text:
I love the deep hot pink color of this headband. It is wide, stretchy and perfect for holding my hair back when applying make-up or just as a statement piece. It will help catch sweat as well. I even wrapped it around my wrist. However, if doing that, the looped Velcro side has to be positioned correctly because the Velcro will have to affix itself to the band material and not to the opposing strip.

I do feel that a long strip of Velcro is needed on these bands because if my head were a bit skinnier, the tabs would have overshot each other on either side and I would have been unable to fasten it closed. Lucky these work for me.

Note that it is best if the band is fastened to the opposing Velcro strip and put in a small lingerie bag in the wash. If that is not done, the Velcro may tear into the fabric and other clothes in the laundry.

Overall, this is a nice, colorful set of three wide headbands.

title: Very moisturizing but aroma does not smell like lemongrass
text: This massage oil is very moisturizing and glides on easily and absorbs pretty fast. However, I do not like the fragrance at all. I normally love lemongrass but it does not smell like lemongrass to me. It has a more medicinal fragrance to my nose. If the fragrance was pleasing to me, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Fragrance is overwhelming and chemical to my nose
text:
There are three 3.25 ounce tubes in this package.

The balm goes on easily and melts (as can be seen from the picture) into the skin from the heat of one's body. I applied this both in the evening after my shower and in the morning after another shower.  This product actually kept me from sleeping well the entire night because the fragrance is incredibly overwhelming and it is also chemical smelling (almost like Raid insect spray) to my nose.  I love fragrance and always feel the more overpowering the better, but not in this case.

This deodorant "protects" as a result of the intense fragrance.  I doubt body odor sweat can overpower this aroma. I personally never get results from any product except those that contain 17% or more of aluminum. Nevertheless, I can attest that it produces results and a "scent" headache in my case.

This is not for me. The price of $21.98 is competitive for three. Since a lot is dispensed as it easily melts on during application, it will probably not last as long as other deodorant.

title: The fragrance is divine and the moisturizing is astounding; LOVE THIS!
text:
Although this is a bath oil, I used this in my foot bath. I made up an Epsom Salt bath and added one capful to the bath (which was probably more than needed for such a small amount of water). I then soaked my feet for 20 minutes. Not only were my feet softer than ever but the fragrance of the almond blossom is wonderful.

There are about 10 capfuls per $20 bottle, which comes to $2 per serving. I love the results and would definitely order this again.

Per the label, this is vegan.

title: Love the spray action but it is hard to see level of contents & bottles smell
text:
I love the colors of these three bottles and the size. The spray action is excellent as well. The problem I have with them is that it is very difficult for me to see the liquid level in the bottle, expecially with the blue bottle. There is an ML measure on the side but that and the "window" is the same color as the bottle. The "window" should have been clear with the measurements written in black. In addition, the bottles have a smell to them; however, a little lemon and water should take care of that.

This is perfect for mixing perfume or essential oils with a carrier oil. It is also good to use to spray vinegar on small items that have to be cleaned, etc.

At the current price of $11.99 plus 5% off, these are a bit pricey but still competitive.

PS All lint and pet hair easily sticks to the outside and inside of the silicone bottles; this is a negative of tacky silicone.

title: There’s no window to see inside the bottles and they stay misshapen – 2.5 stars
text:
I personally do not like these bottles. There are six of the same opaque white silicone squeeze bottles. What I do not like is that there is no clear window on the side of the bottle to easily see the level of the contents. Second, I cannot stand when a bottle does not return to its shape after squeezing out some product. In order to go back into shape, I have to unscrew the cap to let air back into the bottle.

Other than this, these are functional but they just do not suit my purpose due to the two "flaws" I mentioned above. In addition, the current price of $15.99 is on the high side for this set.

title: Useful set but I am not crazy about the larger silicone squeeze bottles - 3.5 stars
text:
This 16-piece set has plenty of containers in which to store creams, lotions, shampoos, sprays, etc. I really love the jars the most because of the interior cover (see pink one that is open in my photo). The jar lids will loosen if they move around a lot so beware of that. The funnel and cleaning brush are useful. The labels are okay. The plastic case it comes in has a bar code label attached that does not pull off fully, so some paper residue may be left behind. My biggest complaint is with the tall silicone squeeze bottles. I personally prefer tapered bottles because they dispense easier and also they do not stay out of shape after squeezing. These bottles remain misshapen unless I release the cap to let air back in.

Despite these minor flaws, this set has a lot of versatility and at the current price of $9.29 is reasonable for what one gets

title: Perfect in every way for home or travel; spray bottles release nice fine mist
text:
There are six bottles in this set.  Four bottles are silicone and are for lotions, shampoos, and creams. What I love about those bottles are that they are easy to fill, easy to dispense, and the "window" on the side allows me to view how much I have left in each bottle.  There are also two hard plastic clear spray bottles. The mist that is released when pumped is very fine and even. In fact, this is perfect for perfumes or just plain water to mist the hair.

I recently ordered several other travel sets to try--this [[ASIN:B085WSPLP3 16 pack]] which has nice jars for cream and this [[ASIN:B07RDJPQ3G set]] which I do not like. So far this is the most useful of the three, with the 16-pack set a close second due to the jars.

title: Nice light and airy hold for my curly hair; fragrance is nice
text:
This review is for the Pantene Non-aerosol Texturizing Hairspray with Volume Lasting Hold. There are three 8.5 ounce pump spray bottles in this set.

I tried their [[ASIN:B07NFRSHNZ Pantene Extra Strong Hold Level 4 Hair Spray]] and did not like it. However, unlike that version, this pump spray is great. I sprayed this all over my short to medium-length fine curly hair and it provided me with a good light and airy hold all day long. This is excellent for me. In addition, the fragrance is wonderful.

title: Provides a strong hold but pumps out very wet making certain areas of my hair over saturated
text:
This review is for the Aussie Sprunch Hair Spray with a strong hold. There are three 8.5 ounce pump spray bottles in this set.

I sprayed this on my short to medium-length fine curly dry hair and noticed that this comes out very wet either because the pump or product does not mist well. Some areas of my hair became more saturated that other areas due to the very "wet" type spray. Nevertheless, it did provide me with an all day strong hold and the fragrance is very nice. If it were not for the wetness of this spray, this would have received five stars from me.

title: This spray DOES NOT provide an extra strong hold but it smells great
text:
This review is for the Pantene Extra Strong Hold Level 4 Hair Spray.

I shook the can vigorously as required and then sprayed a lot on my short to medium fine curly hair and no matter how much I sprayed on, the hold was extremely light. It hardly felt like I had any product in my hair and it did not keep my style at all. The hold it provided was minimal. The scent, however, is great for what it is worth.

title: This is a cross between a hair gel and hair spray
text:
This review is for the Pantene Spray Gel.

I tried this on my short to medium-length fine curly hair and my hair held its shape all day. The fragrance is also wonderful. This reminds me of a light hair gel mixed with hair spray in a pump-style bottle. I love this product.

title: Nice fragrance; provides a moderate hold with moderate shine - 3.5 stars
text:
This review is for the Old Spice  "High Hold Moderate Shine" Swagger Hair Gel that comes in a tube. There are two 6.7 fluid ounce tubes in this package.

I know this is marketed as a man's hair gel but I personally love the fragrance of Old Spice, so I cold not resist using this. In fact, Old Spice is the only deordorant I use simply because I consider it the best and love the scent.

I used a small amount of this gel on my fine short to medium-length curly hair. The hold is moderate and not strong as it claims and there is a moderate shine. The hold lasted all day but was not as strong as I expected. Nevertheless, I love the fragrance of this gel. It entices me every time.

title: Softened my hair but left my curls a bit flat and my hair with a sheen
text:
This conditioner has a fresh light fragrance that is pleasant to my senses. After washing my hair, I massaged a quarter sized dollop throughout my wet locks and waited about one minute before rinsing. My hair dried soft but my curls we almost non-existent and I have short to medium fine curly hair. Also, there was a little bit of sheen to my strands. Overall, this is just okay for me but based on the results, I would not order this again.

The current price of $34 for this lare 33.8 fluid ounce pump bottle is commensurate with the pricing of salon-style products.

title: Tames my hair’s frizz and “fly aways” and my hair remains bouncy
text:
This smoothing cream does exactly what it is supposed to do. It is NOT to provide hold for the hair but to tame "fly aways" and frizz. I applied this to my short to medium fine curly damp hair and then let it air dry. It does not have to be used with a blow dryer. My hair was bouncy and the curls stayed. Also, the frizz and "fly aways" were gone. What I also love is that it feels like I do not have any product in my hair.

Unlike the others, I do like the fragrance of this cream. In addition, it is vegan and cruelty free. The current $18 price tag is expensive but competitive.

title: Gently curls eyelashes; comes w/3 replacements; LOVE the blue wand
text: This is now my new favorite eyelash curler. I have a couple of cheap ones but this one is nicer. First, the blue color of the curler is gorgeous to me. Second, it curls gently without sticking to the eyelashes. Third, there are three silicone replacement pads included. The current price of $14.94 is expensive, however, but that is only because my other two were $8 and under.

title: This hair mask did nothing for my hair and the color stained the creases in my fingernails
text:
The story behind the "Save Me" name is that the founder (April Peck) lost her sister to suicide and designed a brand that donates 10% of the proceeds to suicide prevention.

I tried the [[ASIN:B07R75TP79 SAVE ME FROM Age Acceleration]] hair mask and hated it due to the horrendous smell. I also tried several other types of this brand and got good results from their [[ASIN:B07R5ZPT3R thermal obsession mask]] but that also stinks. This hair mask smells the best of all of them but it is still unpleasant. 

This is a tiny (and I mean tiny) jar of gray hair mask cream. The aroma is a mixture of undesirable and clay like smell. I tried this as a pre-shampoo and worked a small amount throughout my entire head focusing mostly on my ends. I have short to medium fine curly hair, so I used about one quarter sized serving. I left it on for about 45 minutes before washing and conditioning my hair.

After I washed this out and conditioned my hair with my normal conditioner, my hair did not seem any different than if I had not used this product.

Besides the marginal smell, I personally do not like how staining the gray mask is. I had trouble washing the color off my hands and when I scrubbed, I still had gray staining in the creases where my cuticles would be. I had to wash my hands two times to get them to come clean. I cannot imagine how anyone can use this for styling their hair or leaving this in overnight as those are two other uses of this cream. Having the dark color of the mask transfer to a surface would be nasty to me.

In summary, this brand donates to a good cause but this hair mask aroma is somewhat unpleasant and the color stained my hands. In addition, I did not see any favorable results. The current price of $30 for .05 ounces is insanely expensive. This is the fifth (and thankfully last) hair mask I tried of this brand and I would purchase none of them. The one I mentioned above and which I rated 4 stars was good but the price would keep me away. I love the cause but am definitely not a fan of the product or the price.

title: Nice kit but lacks small tweezer; has 7 implements with 9 uses
text:
This kit comes with seven pieces overall but two of the pieces have double sides.

INCLUDED
- Brow gel - like a mascara wand
- Brow pencil - this is two pieces as one side is a highlighter and the other a definer
- Double sided applicator - this is two pieces as one side is like a mascara wand for distributing the color on the brow and the other side is a brush for more finer detail
- Brow shadow in two colors
- Three templates (slim, classic, and arched).

What I really love about this kit is the brow pencil. The color just glides on; it's actually a bit too soft but I prefer that. The brush applicator is nice too as is the shadow. I personally will not use the templates and would have preferred a tweezer in its place.  I actually do not care for the brow gel. It is a bit gooey and a turnoff to me. I prefer to use Vaseline instead.

Nevertheless, at the current price of $7.10, this is a really nice set.

title: This hair mask nourished my hair and left it conditioned but the smell is undesirable - 3.5 stars
text:
The story behind the "Save Me" name is that the founder (April Peck) lost her sister to suicide and designed a brand that donates 10% of the proceeds to suicide prevention.

I tried the [[ASIN:B07R75TP79 SAVE ME FROM Age Acceleration]] hair mask and hated it due to the horrendous smell.  This hair mask also smells but is not as offensive as that one or the two others I already tried. However, I may be getting use to this awful smell as I try each one of her hair masks.

This is a tiny (and I mean tiny) jar of white hair mask cream. The aroma is undesireable.  Despite this, I tried this as a pre-shampoo and worked a small amount throughout my entire head focusing mostly on my ends. I have short to medium fine curly hair, so I used about one thick quarter sized serving. I left it on for 30 minutes before washing and coniditioning my hair.

After I washed this out and conditioned my hair with my normal conditioner and left it to air dry as usual, my hair dried with a nourished look to it and my were curls soft and were not weighed down and it is for this reason only, I rate this 3.5 stars.

I personally would not purchase this because of the smell, not matter how good it is. Nevertheless, this version is even less smelly than the previous one I tried. Note that I cannot attest to its strengthening effect. I personally do not have hair breakage.

In summary, this brand donates to a good cause but this hair mask aroma stinks even if it does work somewhat. I can get the same results from other deep conditioners without the high cost, stink, and long wait. However, if one is tied to this brand, this did work well to nourish my hair.

title: Nice set for a young girl or someone who wants to experiment with make-up
text:
This is a nice set of make-up and is perfect for a young girl just starting out or for someone who wants to experiment with colors. Note that the box has to be used as a guide to locate what items are for what purpose, especially when it comes to the eye creams, brow powder, and foil eyeshadows. There are only 8 applicators provided. There are four double-tipped sponge eyeshadow applicators and four brushes for lips and blush.

I love the presentation of this set and how easy it slides apart.

I tried a few of the eyeshadow, lip, brow, and blush colors and the results are muted and feathery. Although the colors look bold in the tray, they do not go on bold at all. However, for the current price of $14.76, I feel this is excellent for the young make-up artist.

title: Love the tiny tweezer; this is like eyeshadow for the brows; needs more applicators
text:
This is a very nice set. There are two powder brow colors (like eyeshadow powders but for the brow) and one clear (white) wax. There is also a nice little tweezer that works well and one brush applicator. The brow powders are a bit dark for my brows but if I just apply a little and use the wax to set, the results are fine. I particularly love the tiny tweezer.

On the negative side, one brush is not enough applicators for this set. It needs to come with two or three brush applicators to be complete. Nevertheless, the current price of $4.49 is excellent for what one gets.

title: Provides pretty good correction but must be blended well
text:
This does reduce some of the blotchiness I have on my face from pimples, etc.; however, the color is a bit too dark for my skin. Also, it has to be blended well and once it is blended, the coverage is reduced a bit. I prefer correctors that are more skin toned. Nevertheless, this works if blended well and covered with foundation.

I do, however, love the name of this product.

title: Too pink and too drying for me; needs a lip gloss
text: Based on the photo, I expected this to be redder with a bit of a glisten. However, this is way too hot pink for me. It also feels very drying. It also did not glide on my lips easily as some other lipsticks due, so from this perspective, this truly is a crayon. The only way this works for me is if I tone it down with another color and pair it with a lip gloss.

title: Moisturizing but color is too muted; best for blending
text: Unlike the other reviewers, I actually felt this lipstick was moisturizing.  It also stays put and does not come off easily onto my hands. However, the matte finish is blah and the color is not the coral looking hue depicted on the Amazon site, but more like a boring flesh tone. This is best used to blend with other lipsticks to tone down their color.

title: Only 1-1/2” of brow pencil; won’t last long but works perfectly
text: I have very thick brows that are getting gray as I get older. This pencil colors the brows in nicely and the brush disperses it evenly. The color lasted all day on me. However, there is only 1-1/2" of brow pencil and it goes quickly. For the current price of $20, this is expensive.

title: This hair mask softened my hair a little but the smell is undesirable
text:
The story behind the "Save Me" name is that the founder (April Peck) lost her sister to suicide and designed a brand that donates 10% of the proceeds to suicide prevention.

I tried the [[ASIN:B07R75TP79 SAVE ME FROM Age Acceleration]] hair mask and hated it due to the horrendous smell.  This hair mask also smells but is not as offensive as that one.

This is a tiny (and I mean tiny) jar of white hair mask cream. The aroma is undesireable and chemical.  Despite this, I tried this as a pre-shampoo and worked a small amount throughout my entire head focusing mostly on my ends. I have short to medium fine curly hair, so I used about two quarter sized servings. I left it on for about 45 minutes before washing and conditioning my hair.

After I washed this out and conditioned my hair with my normal conditioner, my hair felt somewhat soft but my curls were non-existent. However, the next day my hair looked great and my curls rebounded and it is for this reason, I rate this 4 stars.

I personally would not purchase this because of the smell, not matter how good it is. Nevertheless, this version is less smelly. It was effective on my hair based on the next day's results.  The curren price of $30 for .05 ounces is insanely expensive.

In summary, this brand donates to a good cause but this hair mask aroma stinks even if it does soften it somewhat. I can get the same results from other deep conditioners without the high cost, stink, and long wait. However, if one is tied to this brand, this did work well on my hair but the results only showed up the next day.

title: Leaves my hair with a vibrant shine but weighs down my curls too much
text: This review is for the 2.4 ounce travel-sized bottle that is currently priced at $10. I used a small amount about the size of a quarter on my short to medium fine, wet, just washed curly hair and waited two minutes before rinsing. This left my hair conditioned and moderately soft. My hair also glistened and had a vibrant shine to it but it weighed down my curls too much.  That fact and the price tag for such a small amount caused me to rate this 3 stars.

title: Slightly reduced my acne inflammation; lovely fragrance - 4.5 stars
text:
I usually do not like masks much except for [[ASIN:B002LMD4XK QUEEN HELENE Masque Mint Julep Mask]], which is the only mask that actually gets rid of acne for me.

However, this clay mask is very good. It smells wonderful, glides smoothly on my face, washes off easily, and slightly reduces inflammation from my acne. I waited ten minutes for it to dry before washing it off. When it dried, it did not feel too tight on my face.

In addtion, I love the package design and the incredilbly clean fragrance.  The current price of $13.95 with the $1 off coupon offer is super reasonable as well. I would definitely order this again. In addition, it is cruetly free, vegan, and contains 100% natural ingredients.

title: This hair mask made my hair shine but  the smell is undesirable
text:
The story behind the "Save Me" name is that the founder (April Peck) lost her sister to suicide and designed a brand that donates 10% of the proceeds to suicide prevention.

I tried the [[ASIN:B07R75TP79 SAVE ME FROM Age Acceleration]] hair mask and hated it due to the horrendous smell. This hair mask also smells but is not as offensive as that one.

This is a tiny (and I mean tiny) jar of teal colored hair mask. The aroma is undesireable and chemical. Despite this, I tried this as a pre-shampoo and worked a small amount throughout my entire head focusing mostly on my ends. I have short to medium fine curly hair, so I used about one quarter of the container. I left it on for about one hour before washing my hair.

After I washed this out and conditioned my hair with my normal conditioner, my hair looked shiny and more nourished than usual. My curls were a bit weighed down, but the glowing results was impressive.

I personally would not purchase this because of the smell, not matter how good it is. Nevertheless, this version is less smelly and worked better on my hair. Although no price is listed, I expect it to be priced similarly to their other one at about $30 for .05 ounces, which is insanely expensive.

In summary, this brand donates to a good cause but this hair mask aroma stinks even if it does make my hair glisten and look vibrant.

title: Lightly moisturizing but super messy
text: There are five individually wrapped masks in this package. The instructions are in broken English but still easy to understand. I applied this mask to my clean face -- there are holes for eyes, nose, and mouth. It was dripping wet as most masks of this type are and I always hate that. I let it stay on for about 20 minutes and then removed the mask and wiped off the excess. My face felt mildly moisturized. However, the claims that it brightens the skin and protects them from wrinkles is unfounded in my opinion. This is an okay mask but nothing super spectacular.

title: This hair mask makes me want to jump out of my skin; the smell is horrendous
text:
This is a tiny (and I mean tiny) jar of sparkly gray hair mask that looks like clay. The aroma is so offensive it makes my nose hairs curl. Despite this, I tried this as a pre-shampoo and worked a small amount throughout my entire head focusing mostly on my ends. I have short to medium fine curly hair, so I used about one quarter of the container. I left it on for about 30 minutes before washing my hair. The smell on my hair and hands did not dissipate for 24 hours. The smell on my hands took many hand washings before that was gone. My hair looked nourished but nothing specatularly special. It did not volumize my hair in any way. In fact, my curls were a bit flatter after using this.

At the current price of $30 for .05 ounces, this is insanely expensive.

Note that no matter how good this performs (which it did not for me), there is no way I would use this again due to the terrible "fragrance." It is beyond offensive to me.

On the positive side, this brand donates 10% of the proceeds to suicide prevention. The owner lost her sister to suicide and this one way to help.

title: Nice moisturizer and soak set; soak is tingly
text:
The moisturizer is very nice. The cream is not that thick and a bit on the thin side but my feet felt silky after it soaked in. The tea tree aroma is not overpowering.

The soak also left my skin and nails feeling refreshed. It does tingle but that feels refreshing. The aroma is a bit heavy but as long as I did not bring it near my face, I am okay with it.

Overall, this is a nice set to pamper one's feet. At the current price of $24.39 this is expensive but also competitive due to the cream.

title: Conditions well and left my hair shiny but weighed down my curls
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and it is not colored, so I do not need much conditioning. I applied this to my wet hair in the shower and waited about four minutes before rinsing it out. The instructions say to leave it in for 5-10 minutes but I felt it would be too much for my hair. My hair dried very soft and a bit shiny. It also was a bit weighed down in the sense that my curls were much less defined.

I feel this would be perfect for really damaged hair. Unfortunately, it is too much conditioning for me.

For those who care, this is vegan and not tested on animals. The cream is white with a bit of orange tinge in spots. I am not sure if it is not mixed right or what. It is possible that it is the color of the paper lining inside the lid that came off onto the cream making it a bit orange in spots. The mask has a nice coconut fragrance.

title: Barely there cream with a subtle lavender scent; left my face smooth
text: This cream is extremely lightweight. It is also almost scentless. Until I put this on my face, I could barely smell any lavendar; however, there is just a hint of lavendar.  Although, this left my face smooth, I prefer a more intense scent and a heavier cream. This did nothing for my acne scars but I do like how my skin feels soft after applying this. This cream is light enough for summer. In summary, this is not for me but it is not bad either.

title: I can use everything but the glue cup rings to test make-up
text:
I do a lot of product testing and this set is perfect for testing make-up without contaminating it so that it can be passed on.

I did not count what I received, but supposedly there are 50 each of eyeshadow, lipstick, eyeliner and mascara applicators. However, also included are 100 glue cup rings  which I assume are for affixing false eyelashes or nail decorations. Since this comprises one third of the set, that is a big negative for me. For someone else who uses glue cup rings this is perfect. However, I would have preferred more of the disposable applicators than the disposable rings.

The applicators are of good quality for being disposable and if it were not for the fact that 33% of this set is made up of the rings, this would have gotten five stars.

title: Love the subtle clay fragrance; do not like the black specs but the mask left my face silky
text: I applied this to my face avoiding the eye and lip area as instructured. The clay aroma is very nice. The clay glides on except for the black specs that look like chopped up tar paper (or perhaps leaves). I left this to dry between 10 to 20 minutes and then washed it off with warm water. My face felt silky. However, I absolutely hate the black specs that appear to have no redeeming value. They stuck all over my sink and I had to wash them down the drain. If it were not for this, this mask would have gotten five stars from me.

title: Smells wonderful; conditions and provides shine to blow-dried hair; weighs down my curls a bit
text: I love the fragrance of this blowout cream. I put a little on my damp short to medium fine curly hair and blow dried it. My hair felt conditioned and had a sheen to it when done. However, this product does weigh down my curls and for that reason only, I give this 3 stars. Otherwise this is a really nice cream with a wonderful floral scent.

title: Very gluey but not volumizing only useful as a styling paste; love orange fragrance
text:
I did not expect this paste to be so gluey. I applied a small amount to my damp short to medium length fine curly hair and it went on sticky. It reminds me of a styling gel but with the texture of a paste. It actually made my hair less voluminous that it would normally be had I just left my hair to air dry without any cream. This paste is mildly moisturizing. I do love the mild orange fragrance, however.

In general this is not for me. It works to style my hair but does not add any volume which means it does not satisfy the claims based on my results.

title: Watermelon flavor is subtle just like the color; moisturizes my lips
text: There are four lip balms in this box. This moisturizes just like Chapstick or EOS. The color looks rich in the tube but when it goes on it is barely there. It gave my lips a whisper of color with a nice shimmer. Personally, I hate lip balms with color because if I want color, I just wear lipstick.  When I ordered this, I did not realize it had color. However, I love that this color looks deep on "paper" but almost imperceptible on the lips.  The watermelon flavor is nice but also subtle. If this balm only had the shimmer and no color, it would have gotten five stars from me. This is a very good lip moisturizer.

title: A little oil goes a long way; reminds me of Bio Silk
text: This hair oil reminds of of Bio Silk, which I love for the hair and body. I pumped a tiny (and I mean very tiny) amount into my palm and worked this through my short to medium fine curly hair. It made my hair look great and gave it a nice sheen. My hair even felt more conditioned. Overall this is very nice to tame the frizz. I still prefer Bio Silk over this because it is a bit cheaper and can be used for the body as well.  At the current price of $39, this is expensive.

title: Awkward to use with left hand due to blade angle; cutting edge a bit dull for cuticles & thick nails
text:
This cutter is just okay. The cutting edge is slanted and on one side only. I am right handed and using this in my right hand is easy. However, it is awkward to use this in the left hand because the cutting side has to be angled away from the user.

I tried cutting my cuticles and it is a bit dull for this. It did an okay job but was not as sharp as I expected. It did cut my fingernails fine. However, it is not strong enough for thick toenails. To me this is more of a fingernail and cuticle clipper than and ingrown toenail or regular toenail clipper. In fact, it says cuticle trimmer right on it.

This comes with a felt cinch-strap carry case that is over five times bigger than needed although that is a nice touch.

title: This shampoo & conditioner duo left my hair bouncy and very clean
text:
I  have short to medium fine curly hair and I tried this in the shower. First, I love the navy blue bottles. The shampoo is a bit minty and also blue in color. It lathers and cleans extremely well. The conditioner is a white thick cream and a bit difficult to squeeze out of the bottle. It has a strong methol scent and conditions enough to detangle but not enough to weigh down my curls. I know this is a men's shampoo but I cannot figure out why because I like it too. I am not too crazy about the fragrance but I love the results. I am also not too crazy about the $39 price which is very expensive. 

Note that there is a caution label on both bottles that says "do not eat, drink, snort or pour product into your eyes." Even if the soap or conditioner gets lightly in the eyes it does burn, so be careful.

title: Cleans and lathers well but tea tree oil smell is overpowering
text:
First, it is unclear how many ounces this is. The bottle and box are marked 500ml or 17.6 fluid ounces. However, 500ml is equivalent to 16.9 ounces. That is what the Amazon site says, so I assume it is 16.9 ounces and not 17.6.

In general I like tea tree oil for its antiseptic properties and its use in some beauty products. However, this shampoo smells like straight tea tree oil and it is so overpowering to me, that this is the only reason I rated this 3 stars.

I washed my hair with this and it lathered moderately and cleaned well. My hair looked great after it dried. If the shampoo smelled a little less strong, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: These facial moisturizers are too small, too expensive, and too smelly for me
text:
I so wanted to like this but I do not. There are three very cute and very tiny facial moisturizers in this tube.

There's a 0.5 ounce face and neck cream that is thick and very moisturizing. It felt great on my face. However, that cream smells like dirty pool water to me.

There is a 0.27 ounce eye and lip cream that is a bit thin. I like my eye cream thick. I tried it on my eyes and it was mildly moisturizing. I was not willing to try it on my lips because this cream smells like some sort of meat cold cut that I cannot name.

There is also a 0.33 ounce face oil with eyedropper top that is also moisturizing. I put this on my face and neck. However, it smells like cheap rubber to me.

At the current price of $55, this is super expensive. The smell of these three items are a big turnoff. I will never use this again. I do not hate the results but I hate the smell. The eye/lip cream is the least effective and most revoltingly stinky item of the three.

title: Lightweight brush good for blow drying & detangling but not durable
text: This brush just glides through my short to medium fine curly hair. It is lightweight and the handle is ergonomically designed; it's easy to hold due to the silicone grip. The brush itself, however, does not feel or look durable. A few of the bristles were bent out of shape just in the package. With daily use this will not last more than a few months, in  my opinion. At the current price of $12.99, I feel this is expensive since I do not consider this high quality. However, as a brush, it does the job it is supposed to do.

title: Heavy, plumping moisturizer that is perfect for winter
text:
I really like the moisturizing effects of this cream. I use it on my face and neck, and because it is thick, it is perfect for winter. I personally will not use this in the summer because the cream is too thick. It left my face and neck incredibly hydrated.

It can be used on the face, neck, and decolletage (neckline). The aroma is like a regular moisturizing cream; it does not have any fancy scent added. It claims to be paraben free and vegan and also 90% organic.

title: Three beautiful cloth covered waterproof shower caps
text:
There are three very beautiful shower caps in this package. Both my boyfriend and I love the design. The exterior is cloth and the interior is lined with a waterproof lining. I have short to medium length fine curly hair and these stay put in the shower. The elastic fits nicely around my head. I take a small in a hat size and these caps are bigger than I need but still perfect.

The price of $9.99 is right for the quality of these caps. Eventually they will have to be replaced as the elastic will stretch over time or get moldy.

title: Excellent hair clips that really grip my hair and hold a lot in place
text: I have short to medium fine curly hair and am surprised at how well these work. There are six clips in total. It is easy to gather the long strands in the back of my head and slide these on like large bobby pins. The teeth located in the top part of the clip enable these to stay put. The colors are a bit muted and what I would call fall colors but they go well with brown or brunette hair. These are definitely keepers for me.

title: Helps lather up my hair shampoo routine and feels mildly therapeutic when massaging my scalp
text:
I use this to wash my hair and massage my scalp. The silicone "fingers" feel mildly therapeutic when giving myself a scalp massage. However, because I have short to medium length hair, I have to be careful not to knot my locks as my hair can get tangled in this if I massage too vigorously.

In general, this feels great to use. I would not say at all that it stimulates hair growth or does anything other than help lather shampoo, remove dandruff, and make my scalp feel great.

title: Helps lather up my hair shampoo routine and feels mildly therapeutic when massaging my scalp
text:
This is a two pack of scalp massagers. I use this to wash my hair and massage my scalp. The silicone "fingers" feel mildly therapeutic when giving myself a scalp massage. However, because I have short to medium length hair, I have to be careful not to knot my locks as my hair can get tangled in this if I massage too vigorously.

In general, this feels great to use. I would not say at all that it stimulates hair growth or does anything other than help lather shampoo, remove dandruff, and make my scalp feel great.

title: The case makes this practically impossible to use & comb is cheap
text:
The case makes this impossible to use. In fact, I feel that the comb is fastened into the wrong side of the case on the one I received because the cut for the tail of the comb has to be longer on the side the comb flips out. Unfortunately, on the case I received, the long cut is on the opposite side (see photo).

It is practically impossible to use this comb in its current position because it never opens fully. This is a terrible design. In addition, it feels cheap like plastic.
