UPDATE March 1, 2020 - I fixed the case by unscrewing the rivets on either side and moving the comb to the side with the longer opening. The comb now unfolds correctly. However, this is still a cheap comb and the design still makes it somewhat difficult because the case is flimsy.

title: Not only for a mustache; can be used for eyebrows
text: I know this is a mustache comb for men but it can be used for a woman's (or man's) bushy eyebrows. I like the way this glides through my brown hairs. It is easy to hold and small enough for the task.

title: Difficult to cinch closed & is not a bag that will last long; a bit odd to me
text:
This bag is a bit difficult to cinch closed and strikes me as something that will not last if opening and closing regularly. It comes with a matching coin purse that snaps to the inside of the main cosmetic case (see photo). It also comes with an empty plastic bag for putting used brushes in that also snaps closed (see photo). To me this extra piece cheapens the bag even further because that plastic baggie is something I would normally throw out. Inside the make-up bag are pockets around the side as can be seen in the photo where I inserted a comb in one of the pockets.

This cosmetic case does not hold too much and may not hold a full brush depending on how long the handle is. To me this is a toiletry bag that I consider disposable. It is cute, a bit odd, and will be functional for a short period. However, the current price of $5.99 is about right for this.

title: Dual purpose hair ties that are extremely stylish
text: There are six stylish animal print hair ties in this package. To me they serve a dual purpose. They not only hold hair in a pony tail but they also accessorize the hair. I love the look, function, and style of these and they go with many solid colored outfits particularly black, white, yellow, silver, and brown.

title: Huge paddle-type brush that glides & detangles my hair, wet or dry; love the color
text: First of all, I love the color of this brush. It is a hot pink and goes well with my lighter pink bathroom. The brush is large like a paddle-type brush. It glides through my hair wet or dry and detangles it as well.  It also feels great in my hands and does not slip out like some brushes do. I love this brush.

title: Overpriced shave cream but gives a clean shave
text:
At the current price of $28 for 8 ounces of shave cream, this is way overpriced. 

First, I had lots of trouble opening the top and getting the pump to work. My boyfriend was finally able to get it to pump.

The cream comes out white but changes to almost clear when rubbed in except that you can still see where it is so that one can shave. The cream is super slick and slippery and is a bit difficult to wash from one's hands. It does provide a close shave, however, and my boyfriend likes it. It appears to be scentless. Nevertheless, this is too expensive to be worth it for him or me.

He questioned as to why this needs to be invisible. I ask the same question.

UPDATE March 4, 2020 - After using this for over one week, I'm lowering my star rating from 4 to 3 stars. My boyfriend's major complaint with the invisible shave cream is that it is invisible. It’s difficult for him to determine where he is in the shave process and he continues going over areas again to make sure they are done. On the positive side, he likes that the cream leaves his skin feeling soft. However, he would not purchase this.

title: Just an ordinary make-up bag that is plastic on outside w/black cloth lining
text:
This bag is nothing special. It is an ordinary make-up case that feels like plastic on the outside, has a nice leopard print, and a black lining. It is a bit larger than what most women will carry with them and certainly has enough room to fit sponges, brushes, eye, blush, translucent powder, lipstick, lip liner, eyelash curler, etc. with room to spare.

The zipper open and closes easily. The seam on the bottom of the bag is sized differently in the sense that one side is larger than the other (see photo).

title: A bit over conditioning for my hair; I like the fragrance
text: This is a leave-in conditioner. I applied a little bit throughout my entire head of short to medium length fine curly hair and then let my hair air dry as usual. This does condition well but my curls were a bit weighed down and my hair was flatter and shinier than normal. I do like the fragrance, however. It smells like a vintage scent.

title: Love this body cream; the herbal scent is lovely & it is silky moisturizing
text:
I love this body cream. It is lightweight yet very moisturizing and good for both summer and winter. The cream looks like Noxema in the sense that it is white and pearlized. I applied this to my entire body and once it absorbed, which it does rapidly, my skin was as smooth as silk. This is definitely a keeper.

It also has a nice herbal fragrance that smells a bit like rosemary combined with something else to me.

title: Moisturizing, thick, scentless face and neck cream; takes a while to absorb
text: This face and neck cream is a bit thick and sort of pasty to me. It is scentless and also very moisturizing. I put this on my entire face (excluding eye area) and neck, and after it absorbed my face felt super hydrated. What I do not like about this cream is its pastiness and the fact that it took about 30 minutes to absorb into my skin. Other than this, it is super hydrating.

title: Thick conditioner; smells like Twizzlers
text: I have no idea why they call this a conditioning wash. Supposedly it is supposed to remove residue. However, to me it seems backwards. First I wash my hair and then I apply conditioner and rinse out. I did the same with this. This conditioner is thick, so I had to use a little bit on my fine short-to-medium curly hair. The aroma reminds me of red Twizzlers--okay but not great. The conditioning is ordinary. I do not feel this is anything special for my hair. It lightly conditioned without weighing down my hair--nothing more and nothing less.

title: Vibrating face roller is too gimmicky for me; I prefer the standard one
text:
I own two [[ASIN:B07TH1FC61 rollers and gua sha tools]] and they feel great on my face when the stones are cold. This set feels good on the face as well when they are cold; however, the vibrating design is a bit gimmicky for me. I do not care for the vibration against my face and neck.

This is a pretty pink set in a nice box. It requires one AA battery (not included). There are two tips - the roller tip and the flat tip. It also comes with a sleep mask that is comfortable and slightly padded but not very good at blocking out light because of the way it sits against the eyes.

Personally, I prefer my other tools to this one. However, as long as I do not use the battery option, it performs as well as my others and cools the face and the coldness can relieve puffiness under the eyes. The only redeeming value I find in any face roller and tools of this type are how great these cool stones feel against my skin especially in the heat of summer. I have never experienced any youthfull changes as a result of using these beauty tools.

Note that no instructions are included. The current price of $19.95 is competitive.

title: Wonderful facial massage tools; very cooling; color of stone is a bit muted
text:
I own two other [[ASIN:B07TH1FC61 rollers and gua sha tools]] and they feel great on my face when the stones are cold. This set feels great on the face and neck as well when they are cold. The color of the set is a muted light green and not as pictured on the Amazon site and that is my only disappointed.

This comes in a nice gift box, with a carry pouch, and the roller and gua sha stone. This set performs as well as my others and cools the face and the coldness can relieve puffiness under my eyes.  The only redeeming value I find in any face roller and tools of this type are how great these cool stones feel against my skin especially in the heat of summer. I have never experienced any youthful changes as a result of using these beauty tools but I enjoy them.

PS I also ordered another set [[ASIN:B07JMHN6YC]] from this company and that one was a dissappointment and I rate it 2 stars. The quality control on that set is terrible as there is a chip in the stone and the stone is super thin. The color also differs fom the pictures on that set.

title: Soft, useful face sponges; can even be used for face make-up
text: I really love these. There are five basic soft sponges in pink, green, sky blue, white, and pale pink. It also comes with a hard sponge storage case to store the wet sponge and a toiletry bag. Neither the case nor the bag are high quality. Nevertheless, the main attraction in this set are the sponges. They feel great on the skin and are of the type that can be used or re-purposed to apply a powder (like a translucent powder on the face), etc. I think the current price of $9.99 is reasonable for this set. I personally would prefer these without the hanging rope but that is only a personal preference.

title: Burn potential; provides a more looser curl; best for long hair; actual temperature is a mystery
text:
This is as no-frills of a curler as they come. There is an on/off switch and that's it. There are no temperature controls on the unit and the temperature setting stated in the manual does not jive with what is on the box. It says 200 degrees Celsuis in the manual and on the box and then the box says a max of 450 degrees Fahrenheit. Well 200 C is equal to 392 F, so I'm not sure if it goes to 392 F or 450 F or what the temperature is. I just know it is very hot and can easily cause burns because there is no clip rod or anything separating the heating plate from the human.

This is also a bit difficult to work with because there is no clip. I had to roll my hair around the conical barrel. It is easier to do with long hair as I have short to medium hair. It works but does take some getting use to and is a learning experience. Also the curls are a lot lighter and do not last long.  This provides more of an incredibly loose payot curl than anything else.

Personally, this is not for me. I prefer curling irons with a clip. If one has long hair (which I no longer do), this would be perfect to use on making those side curls some young girls like to wear. However, the barrel gets very hot and is exposed, so the potential burn risk is high.  Th current price of $12 is certainly very reasonable.

title: Low-quality bag at a cheap price; this will not last long
text:
At the current price of $5.99, this bag is priced at its max but is still reasonable. This toiletry bag reminds me of those cloth supermarket bags one can buy for .99 cents that lasts a few uses and that is about it.

I feel this is reasonably roomy to store the toiletries for an overnight or one-week trip. There is one central zippered compartment with two folder slots and two bottle holder slots on either side on the interior of that compartment. In front of the central compartment is another half-height zippered storage area that does not hold much.

Above the central area are also two tiny mesh folder slots that holds nothing more than floss and items of that nature. Above those slots is a clear plastic zippered pocket. Above that pocket is the hanging hook. The bag closes with Velcro strips. The zippers are cheap and will most likely break after a few uses. It has a handle on the top of the bag and on the back is a half-height folder pocket.

I like the color of this. By far the most expensive looking and quality item on this bag is the "Weekeight" silicone label that is stitched to the front. For those looking for a temporary toiletry bag that leans toward the disposable side, then this is the bag to get. However, if a quality bag that holds more is desired, then look elsewhere but it probably will not be sold at this low price point.

title: Moisturizing and firming; love how soft it makes my eye area
text: It is so hard for me to find a good eye cream. However, this is one of several I love. The cream is not overly heavy and glides on easily around the eye area. After it absorbs, my eye area feels firm and my eyelids and surrounding skin feels super soft and silky. At the current price of $14.99, I feel this is a steal. I love it and will definitely be using this as part of my daily routine.

title: Highly moisturizing; thick enough for winter; aroma is okay
text: This face cream is very thick and perfect for winter. It feels very moisturizing and absorbs quickly into my skin. It left my face super smooth. The only thing I do not like is the aroma; it is just okay. The current price of $12.99 is excellent for this cream.

title: Toner is refreshing and makes my skin feel clean
text: I applied a little bit of this to a cotton circle and rubbed it all over my clean dry face. My face felt refreshed and clean.

title: Stunning design and craftmanship; comb comes in leather pouch - a true work of art to me
text:
The design and presentation of this comb is stunning to me. This stainless steel comb has three sides with tines of various width (fine, medium, and large). I love the high-quality leather pouch it comes in. Also, a soft chamois cloth for polishing the steel is included.

I used this comb for my hair. However, this is best used for fine short hair or a beard or mustache. The reason is that the tines are harsh on longer hair or curly hair (like mine) and can rip the hair out. Despite the difficulty with my hair, I love this comb because it is perfect for the right purpose and it is also a work of art.

title: Acts like a bra for the eyes; cups allow eye movement
text: When I first saw this, I was disappointed because this has cups where the eye sockets go. However, this is great. When I used this, I was able to open and close my eyes behind the mask. It is very comfortable on and stays put while sleeping and no light seeps through. The back is also adjustable. In addition, it comes with a very nice carry pouch.

title: Soft, stylish headband with ponytail hole; best for longer hair; runs a bit large
text: This headband is soft, stylish, colorful, and well-made. However, it is best for longer hair. Also, the band runs on the larger side with a very large pontytail hole. I have short to medium length fine curly hair, and I cannot use the ponytail hole. However, even if I fasten this around my head, it wants to slide off. If one has a big head and a thick head of long hair, then this will work. This is definitely not suitable for me.

title: Portable & foldable wooden comb with smelly finish
text: This comb is portable, wooden, and foldable. It does have a smelly finish (meaning a chemical smell to the finish on the wood) that I expect will dissipate over time. This does not comb through my hair easily, especially if there are knots. However, this is a beard comb, so I expect it will work better there. I feel it is best for short straight hair that is not tangled or a short beard. It is very stylish and feels well made.

title: Tiny hair ties with a bit of stretch; can’t see writing or design once in use
text: These are nice looking hair ties when they are not fastened in the hair. They are just small pieces of tied ribbon with writing or a design on them. Once they are in the hair, it is hard to see either the writing or the design. They do have a little bit of stretch to them so that it makes it easier to fasten. Personally, I think these would be best used if someone else is fastening to the bridal team to ensure there is at least some visibility of the design or "team bride" wording.

title: Nice massager/body brush but fantastic for picking pet hair
text: This is a soft and gentle body brush that can be used in the shower. It is mildly massaging but definitely not exfoliating. However, this is even better as a pet hair picker upper on pet bedding and upholstery. The silicone really grabs the hair and this is what I use this for.

title: A bobby pin with the word LOVE on it; too expensive for what it is
text:
This is nothing more than a high-end bobby pin. At the current price of $12.95, I feel this is way overpriced.

The pin is more of a hair accessory that a hair holder. Also, when I tried this on, I had to be careful to fasten the bobby pin in the correct direction so that the word LOVE was displayed correctly. It is a nice accessory, but I would not pay more than $3.50 for this.

title: Bows are huge; I would use them as package toppers or for back of hair 3 Stars
text: These bows are huge.  The picture of the bow in a young girl's hair is deceiving.  These are 1/2 of a foot long and good for gathering hair in the back of the head but not on the side--unless one wants to look like a poodle.  I would use these as package toppers (to decorate gifts or gift baskets) instead.

title: Stylish, attractive hair clips; more of a statement piece than hair holder
text: These clips are colorful, stylish, and attractive. They hold only a little bit of hair and are more of a statement piece than anything else. I have short to medium fine curly hair and these will hold back a few strands and look nice on if placed well on the head.  The current price of $4.99 is competitive for these. They appear to be well made.

title: Good for loose curls on longer hair; controls are not in good place
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and and this iron only curls my longest locks loosely; however, that is to be expected. This size barrel is best for longer hair.

The iron goes from 180 to 410 degrees Fahrenheit. The controls are easy to operate; in fact they are too easy to operate because I kept accidentally hitting them while curling my hair. The temperature stops blinking when it has reached the correct warmth.

The finger grip is sturdy. There is a kick-stand to rest the hot iron on; and believe me it gets hot. Also, note the stand's silicon cover actually has to touch the hot barrel because of the way it's designed. The cord swivels easily. This works as designed.

My only reason for rating this 3 stars is because the controls are placed all wrong and they can be accidentally hit when working with this iron which I did repeatedly.  I love the addition of the canvas storage pouch which is high quality; however, it is a bit difficult to get into the pouch because either the bag or the zipper opening has to be about a 1/4 inch longer to reduce the struggle.

title: This is a bare bones basic curling iron; good for tight curls on very short hair
text:
This review is for the 9mm Curling Iron-Pink.

I have short to medium fine curly hair and I can get even a more tighter curl with this iron. However, it is a bare bones model. There is a light telling the user when it has reached a certain temperature (meaning it stopped blinking); however, it is hard to see because it is the same color as the iron (reddish pink). There's a loosey goosey on/off switch on the one side and a sticky temperature control that goes from 80 to 230 degrees. Nevertheless, this all works.

The kick-stand is good as is the swivel cord ability.

This makes my curls tighter because of the small barrel. If one is looking for a tight curl and wants a super basic curling iron, then this is it.

title: Nice iron but SUPER TRICKY to turn on; awkward positioning of controls
text:
This 1-1/4" straightener comes with one glove and a pouch to store the iron in. I have short to medium fine curly hair and this flat iron works even on my length hair. 

I used  this on my dry hair. I then set this to about 325 degrees. The degrees goes from 200 to 450 Fahrenheit and can be increased or decreased in 10 degree increments. Getting this iron to turn on is the most difficult part and it does not say how to do that in the manual. It says to press the on/off button. HOWEVER, THAT DOES NOT WORK. I always have to hold the on/off button down and then press one of the arrow up or down buttons to get this to turn on. Once it is on, it always starts at 450 degrees and has to be incremented down. To turn off the iron, I had to press and hold the on/off button. Besides this and the arrow up and down button, there is a 450 degree button. That button appears to be useless.

The temperature will turn green when it reaches the correct warmth. I used this on my hair and it straightened my curls. The irons come together nicely and hardly has any space between them, which is good. The grip is also good.

The cord swivels at the end easily. The metallic white color is attractive. The glove is a bonus but unnecessary for me and the pouch is great for storing the cool iron.

Overall, this works well to straighten my hair. with the 1-1/4" plate. The instructions are not good in that it does not tell one how to start the iron correctly. I found it difficult to get my fat fingers on the interior of the iron when manipulating the buttons. There is no lock feature on the iron that I could find but then I do not like such a feature. If the iron was not SUPER TRICKY to turn on and the positioning of the controls was not in such an awkward location, this would have received 5 stars.

title: Works as designed to straighten my hair but flashing light never goes out
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this flat iron works even on my length hair. 

I used  this on my dry hair. I then set this to about 280 degrees. The degrees goes from 250 to 450 Fahrenheit marked in 50 degree increments. The dial is on the interior of the handle as shown in one of my photos.

What I do not like is that after turning on the on/off switch, the light never stopped blinking to let me know the temperature had been reached. I had left the iron on for 15 minutes and it continued to blink even though I had it on the dial between 250 and 300 degrees. However, it does not say what that light is for in the manual. Perhaps it is just an indicator light telling the user the iron is on. Typically with most irons, the blinking light goes out when an iron has reached its temperature. Nevertheless, I used this on my hair and it straightened my curls. The irons come together nicely and hardly has any space between them, which is good. The grip is also good.

The cord swivels at the end but is not as maneuverable as  I expected with a swivel cord such as this. The metallic white color is attractive.

Overall, this works as designed. There is no mention of the flashing light in the manual but I do assume it should go out when the temperature is reached. The swivel cords is a nice feature but is a bit "sticky" in its movement. I was able to straighten my hair fine with this as it has about 1-1/4" plate. This is a decent, basic straightener.

title: This is a tricky straightener to use but it works; best on long hair
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair and this straightener is difficult to use on that length hair. It is best for longer hair because one has to get the strands to seat between the tines in the the ironing comb.

I used on dry hair (hair needs to be dry, per the instructions). I then set this to about 280 degrees. There is no degree setting that is readable on the handle. It only has a marker for the lowest setting at 265 degrees and the highest setting at 365 degrees Fahrenheit (or 130 to 200 Celsuis).

Once the light stopped blinking to let me know the temperature had been reached, I tried to use this like a comb to comb it through my hair. That DOES NOT WORK as it does not grip the hair. Instead I had to thread my hair into the comb by pulling it away from my scalp and laying the comb over my strands to get it between the tines. Once I did that, the straightening power was great.

If it were not so tricky to use, I would highly recommend this. However, it does take some getting use to.

title: Product not as advertised; bowl and wooden handled razor is missing; cheap razor is substituted
text:
I was supposed to receive a shaving bowl and wooden handled razor with this set. Instead I got no bowl and the razor is metal without any wooden handle. The shaving brush is okay, but also not as pictured. Also, there's a leather strap for sharpening the razor that is included in the one I received but is not supposed to be included in the one advertised. The leather case is similar but also not the same.

The razor is sharp and does cut beard hair but it seems cheaply made. I just do not feel this razor will last long. This set is a disappointment both from the perspective of not being what I ordered and the razor not seeming to be high-quality.

title: Perfect for blending in translucent powder on my face
text:
I really love this brush. The bristles are super soft and the contour is perfect for blending translucent powder on my face after I apply a full face of make-up. The bulbous plastic handle is not great for gripping but I do not need to hold on to this for too long.

The bristles do not fall out, which I love. I also pulled on the brush and so far it has not come detached from the cheap plastic top.

Overall, this is a very nice brush. I would have preferred a handle of silicone or wood that is indented at the center to grip it easily. The current price of $18 is competitive but realize the top looks and feels cheap yet the brush feels exquisite.

title: Heavy face cream that moisturizes well; perfect for winter; aroma okay
text: I do not care too much for the aroma of this cream but I love the results. This is a thick face cream that moisturizes my face and neck very well in the winter. For me, it is too thick for the summer. It absorbs within 20 minutes and my face feels smooth by morning. I like everything but the faint chemical fragrance.

title: Lovely scent; highly moisturizing; left my curly hair bouncy & with a sheen
text: This conditioner is absolutely lovely. The fragrance is exhilirating and the conditioner is of medium consistency and feels great going on. After rinsing this out and then air drying my hair, it left my curls bouncy and with a sheen. I love this!

title: Blades shave close but not as close as we would like
text:
I ordered these because I have several Gillette razors. Unfortunately, I did not realize that these blades only work with a Gillette Mach 3 razor. Therefore, we had to purchase the razor so we could use these blades.

The blades shave close but not close enough to be super smooth. This means there is some slight stubble left behind. My boyfriend and I did not like the razor itself (which we had to buy) because the handle is too short and too light. However, these blades are better than the razor. They are good but not great.

title: Not much sunscreen for the price but it is portable & lightly scented
text:
I am going to assume this sunscreen in SPF 30 protects my skin from the sun. I am assuming that because it is winter here and I do not stay out in the sun long but I always try to protect my skin.

This is a nice thick cream that absorbs quickly. The scent is super light but very nice. I actually feel like this sunscreen is a bit moisturizing because it left my skin feeling super soft. These are cute bottles that can be hung on something but the loop is not detachable. I would have liked it if I could hang it on a jean belt loop but that is not possible without a carabiner.

There are four bottles--fluid ounces not specified. The colors are actually the result of the silicone sleeve this comes in.

Overall, this is a very nice, pleasantly scented, and moisturizing suncreen with SPF 30 for the expensive price of $11.99 (as of this writing).

title: Absorbs some moisture from soaking wet hair but is not drying; nice scrunchies
text: These are really nice, thick scrunchies. However, they only absorbed a little bit of water from my soaking wet short to medium fine curly hair. These are not drying at all. Just use these at scrunchies only and do not expect miracles.  I do like the quality of these. They look and feel like a terry cloth towel but they are made of 85% biconstituent fiber (79% polyester 21% plymamide--notice how this does not add up to 85%, but that is what the label says) and 15% polyester.

title: Shampoo lathers well, smells slightly medicinal – careful, it burns the eyes
text: I tend to like products with tea tree oil in them. It has a slightly medicinal aroma. This shampoo has that aroma. It lathers and cleans the hair well. However, it does burn the eyes. I got some suds just near my eyelid and my eye started to slightly burn, so be careful. Tea tree oil is slightly antibacterial and is cooling.

title: Well-made storage scrunchies but using them when full is awkward
text: These are really nice, well-made scrunchies with the ability to store a few items like a key, coins, or a little bit of cash. The zippers work fine even though it requires some strength to open and close. My only issue with these is that once it has something in the storage pounch (which is the entire scrunchy), it is difficult to work with. It would be impossible to put a whole bunch of cash in this because then that cash would have to be bent around the hair while it is inside the scrunchie. A couple of bills is fine or even coins but not too much.  The colors are nice too and black and tan goes with anything. The blue pairs well with blue jeans.

title: Vibrating beauty bar is too gimmicky for me but the roller action is massaging
text:
I own two [[ASIN:B07TH1FC61 rollers and gua sha tools]] and they feel great on my face when the stones are cold. This set is not stone but more like a metal two-prong roller and a T-bar. The coldness is not as deep as the stones, although, it still feels good on the face. I like the rolling action of the two-prong roller; however, the vibrating design is a bit gimmicky for me. I do not care for the vibration against my face and neck.

This is a pretty gold set in a nice box. It requires one AA battery (not included).

Personally, I prefer my other stone tools to this one. However, as long as I do not use the battery option, it performs almost as well as my others and cools and massages the face.  The only redeeming value I find in any face roller and tools of this type are how great the coolness and massaging action can feel against my skin especially in the heat of summer. Note I have never experienced any youthfull changes as a result of using these beauty tools.

Also note that the ON/OFF label is just that--a label that peels off. In one of my photos you can see it peeling off already.

title: Large high-quality boar bristle nylon brush with exquisite finish
text:
This is definitely a high quality boar bristle with nylon brush. It is actually the larger version of Amazon Item # B07YXBM4SZ.  The brush not only looks expensive but feels great in my hands. The black finish on this brush is exquisite. I used this on my short to medium length fine curly hair and the addition of the nylon tines with the boar bristles made it easy to brush through my hair. In the winter, brushing with this causes my hair to have some static electricity but it is minimal due to the addition of the nylon.

The current price of $28.99 is expensive but competitive for this quality brush. There is nothing I do not like about this brush.

title: High quality boar bristle nylon brush with exquisite finish
text:
This is definitely a high quality boar bristle with nylon brush. The brush not only looks expensive but feels great in my hands. The black finish on this brush is exquisite. I used this on my short to medium length fine curly hair and the addition of the nylon tines with the boar bristles made it easy to brush through my hair. In the winter, brushing with this causes my hair to have some static electricity but it is minimal due to the addition of the nylon.

The current price of $24.64 is competitive for this quality brush. There is nothing I do not like about this brush.

title: Quality boar bristle brush; handle is a bit small and bristles create static in my hair
text:
This is definitely a quality boar bristle brush. The design and color of the wood is attractive. I used this on my short to medium length fine curly hair and it brushed fine. There are only two issues. First, I would prefer a longer handle. This handle is more kid-sized. Second, in the winter, brushing with this causes my hair to have static electricity which is one way to add volume.

The current price of $26.21 is competitive for this quality brush. If the handle were longer, this would have gotten five stars as static electricity is expected with brushes like this.

title: Phenomenal brush set, particularly for kids
text: This is a wonderful boar bristle brush set for kids. The wooden handles and wooden comb feel great in the hands. The comb glides through my hair and the brush works through my short to medium hair easily. However, this set is really for kids due to the small size, small bristles, and small comb.

title: Nice set of sponges but sponge holder is plastic garbage
text: This is a nice set of three sky-blue make-up blending sponges. The sponges are soft and are just like the name brand ones. However, the plastic pink holder is really garbage and cheapens the set. I love the sponges but hate the holder. Nevetheless, the current price of $5.59 makes this a very reasonable and decent purchase.

title: Not volumizing and has a terrible smell; had to wash my hair all over again to remove product
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair. I love to use volumizing shampoos when I can get them and this was advertised as such. However, when I received the shampoo, it is actually a hair loss prevention shampoo. It also should NOT be used daily and says so on the bottle.

I decided to try this anyway. It smells terrible to me--like sour watermelon. It has a lackluster lather and feels as if I am adding a grease to my hair. My hair felt flat and lousy after using this. I actually decided to re-wash my hair with my regular shampoo.

I have no idea if this shampoo will stop hair loss but the fact that it cannot be used daily worries me as it is probably more of a medical product than a general shampoo. I hate the aroma and how it makes my hair feel.

title: Love this massaging brush; hair cleans off easily; wooden mirror is a nice touch
text:
This brush has straight hard tines (bristles) and that feels great across my scalp. I love how this brushes and the massaging action. In addition, since the tines are straight, hair is easily pulled out of this brush. It also comes with a wooden mirror. It is important to remove the film covering on the mirror to make it ready for use.

Overall, I really love this ensemble and the current price of $9.49 is reasonable.

title: A colorful collection of hair clips to fasten and highlight my hair with
text:
This is a nice collection of 20 hair accessories. Not all of them are clips. Nine of them are clips (the star is a full fastening clip). The other eleven are like bobby pins (they slip into the hair) and of the eleven, five of them are actual bobby pins.

These are colorful and fasten almost anywhere on the hair. However, they do not hold hair like a big hair clip does. These are clips to accessorize the hair and highlight certain areas.

They are competitively priced at $10.99 for the set. This set is good but will not last forever. I expect the beads to fall off from daily use. The white beaded ones are actually held on by threads wrapped around the beads. Nevertheless, I still like these very much and feel they are a reasonable buy.

title: This is not volumizing to my hair at all; it is just like ordinary shampoo to me
text: I washed my short to medium fine curly hair with this shampoo and although the fragrance is nice and it lathers well, my hair actually had less volume than normal after it dried. It was also a rainy day which normally results in my hair being more voluminous. This is a nice shampoo but it is typical of most other nice shampoos on the market and nothing particularly special.  I rated this 3 stars because it is costly (at the current price of $23) and does not add the volume it claims.

title: Lightweight, does not absorb well, smells sour, & no avocado in the mix
text: This cream is lightweight. It smells slightly sour to me but that dissipates quickly. I applied this to my feet and it still did not absorb after a half hour. I get better results with regular body cream. Also, there is no avocado in the ingredients list--not sure why it is called this. I'll pass.

title: Moisturizes nicely but leaves a pea-soup yellowish green film behind
text:
The moisturizing ability of this face cream is very good. I applied a small amount all over my clean dry face and neck (avoiding the eyes), and my skin soaked it up. It also left my face and neck feeling "plump" and smooth. However, the cream is green and when I use a tissue to wipe my face, I noticed a yellow-greenish tinge on the tissue. This could also get on clothes, etc. This is like having make-up applied to the face. If I wanted something that wears off onto my clothes, I would have applied make-up. I hate products whose color wears off especially when I am not wearing any make-up. 

In summary, despite its good moisturizing ability, I do not like the smell of this product or the color which transfers onto clothes, tissues, etc.

title: Feels wonderful to hold; not for my hair; reminds me of a shoe shine brush
text:
This is definitely not a brush for me. However, it is a nicely made brush and would be good for very short hair like most men have even though it says for medium to long hair. It did not work well on my short to medium fine curly hair. Nevetheless, this is one of those brushes that should last a long time.

I am disappointed that the paint on the base is chipped on the brush I received. If someone paid $21.95 for a brush like this, that person would want it in perfect condition. Nevertheless, I do like the feel of this brush in my hands and if I had shorter and flatter hair, this would be a keeper for me.

title: This is definitely for men with short hair; feels sturdy in the hands
text:
This is definitely not a brush for me. However, it is a nicely made brush and would be good for very short hair like most men wear. It did not work well on my hair. This is one of those brushes that should last a long time.

I rated this three stars because the box says this is for medium to long hair that is regular to thick. Well I have short to medium fine curly hair and did not feel it worked for me at all. Also, for the current price of $25.95, the box it comes in has a plastic window that slides around. It is kind of not nice if one is gifting this.

title: Glides through my hair wet or dry but is not anti-static
text:
I have short to medium length fine curly hair. This brush glides through my hair wet or dry. However, it is not anti-static. In addition, the current price of $13.99 is too expensive for this, especially since it is cheaply made. I can get a brush like this for $4 at my local store.

I like this as a regular brush only--forget the claims.

title: Too big of a brush to be useful to me; also too expensive
text: This brush is way too big. It reminds me of a paddle brush.  I have short to medium length fine curly hair. This goes through my hair fine but I find it awkard to use. Also the current price of $18.99 is too expensive for this even though some of the bristles are boar. The handle is also cheap feeling.

title: Handle grip is excellent; bristles are sharp; works well for blow drying
text:
I love, love, love the handle on this brush. It provides for a good grip and is long enough to allow for comfortable styling. The bristles are sharp, so one has to be careful when using this brush. This worked on my short to medium length curly hair. It is perfect for blow drying and would probably be even more perfect if I had long hair.

Of course with a brush like this, one has to be careful they do not tangle their hair in the bristles--particularly if their hair is long.

title: Lovely body lotion for the summer; has a subtle and pleasant fresh aroma
text:
This lotion is very nice. There is not much to it at 2.70 ounces for $15.

This lotion is perfect for summer because it is of medium consistency but goes on light. It has a very pleasant aroma that is subtle. After I applied this to my skin, it soaked in immediately and left my skin feeling silky soft. Unfortunately, this will not last more than several uses due to the small size. I particularly like to use this on my hands to conserve it.

title: This is definitely not unscented but it does moisturize
text:
The description says that this is unscented and that is not true. Perhaps it means no fragrance is added; however, it smells a bit like bacon grease to me. I personally do not like this scent.

This is a little greasy as it sinks into the skin. It does moisturize but the aroma prevents me from putting this on any body area other than my feet and hands. If this did not smell so bad, it would have gotten 4 stars from me. If it had a little less greasy feeling and also did not smell, then it would have received 5 stars.

title: Good quality back brush, pumice, etc.
text:
Over the last year I purchased about three back brushes from my local store and the plastic handles keep breaking. In addition, I had also purchased a wooden back brush where the handle seats into the brush. That also failed.

Therefore, I decided to order this mostly for the back brush because it is all one piece. The brush is well made and it has rope on the handle to keep it from slipping in the shower. Of course, using this type brush is more exfoliating than three of the four I purchased before.

In addition to the back brush, a four-in-one foot file/callus remover is included and it works. There is also a hand-held shower brush with massaging tips. I will not be using that because I prefer my buff puff. However, the other two are excellent. The only thing to note is that the callus remover stone will shed some "powder" when first opened.

Overall, this is a very nice set. If for any reason it lasts less than one year, I will update my review. After a while brushes like these get moldy in the shower due to the humidity even if using daily. Therefore, they will have to be replaced periodically.

title: I love the simplicity of this double-side mirror and its compact size
text:
I love this mirror because it is simple, compact, mildly stylish, and has both a regular side and 7x magnification that is great for precision tasks. Since it is not tall, the mirror swivels for good positioning. I was able to do some great precision tweezing with this and the light of my kitchen.

Overall, this is as simple as they come for a vanity mirror.  Obviously, if one wants a vanity mirror to apply make-up, then it might be best to buy an LED rechargeable mirror instead so that make-up can be applied in various light. 

I also love the black color as it does not show fingerprints easily on the frame. This mirror is as basic as they come.

title: I am not crazy about the curved tip for grooming facial hair
text:
I find these awkward to work with when cutting facial hair. Another reviewer said these were manicure scissors and perhaps they are. However, the curve design is not effective for facial hair based on my results as they do not cut close enough and the angle is awkward.

The scissors come with a faux leather sheath. These personally do not work for me and I have no need for a pair of manicure scissors.

title: I love the color and the feel of these brushes; bristles also do not fall out - 4.5 stars
text:
I really love the color of these brushes. This set includes eight brushes for blush, highlighting, lips, eyes, etc. The bristles are super soft and they don't fall out. I hate when bristles fall out and these stay put.

The current price of $11.99 is reasonable for this set. This set would be perfect if they labeled each brush along its side as to its use. Rarely does a make-up brush come with its use engraved along the side of the handle. Those type brushes get 5 stars from me as long as the brush works as designed, feels soft, and the bristles do not fall out. This set has everything but that. Nevertheless, I still love it.

title: This must be for some beard; I use these combs for my hair and bushy eyebrows
text:
This is a nice set of plastic combs. Although, it says they are beard and mustache combs, I am surprised how large the beard combs are. The mustache comb is truly for a mustache, or in my case, for my bushy eyebrows. However, the other combs look like regular hair combs. They pass through my short to medium length fine curly hair easily, both when wet or dry.

This is a nice set of sturdy combs with thick tines. There's no reason why one cannot use these for their hair or eyebrows. I do feel, however, that the current price of $21.95 is a bit steep for this set and that is the only reason I took off one star. However, the "cellulose acetate" material (which are used to make eyeglasses) of these combs do not feel cheap, so perhaps the price is right.

title: Sponges work as designed and expand UNEVENLY to about 5x’s their wafer size
text:
There are 50 (I received 51) wafer-thin discs in the box along with a sisal rope drying bag. The sponges expand when wet to about five times their size. However, they expand unevenly in the sense that one side is thicker then the other. The uneveness is visible if one compares my two photos of the expanded sponge. This is because they are sliced unevenly. I have a few sponges where the thickness on one side is thicker than the other before expansion.

These are soft and will last several uses like a regular bathroom sponge. They should be thrown away after awhile, obviously. I even used one to wash my glasses and they do not scratch and are very gentle on skin. These are perfect for the face if that is what one is into.

I do feel the price of $15.85 is expensive for this.

title: Only two of the three tools work; but what works is great – 3.5 stars
text:
This is a three-in-one nail clipper tool that works both on the toe and finger nails.

LIKES
- Comes in a nice case.
- Handle feels great in the hands--almost non-slip.
- Compact design - two tools are stored in the handles and handles are foldable.
- The cutting blade on the clippers is great -- 5 stars.
- The cleaning tools works fine to get grit out from underneath the nails -- 4 stars. Actually, they call it an in-grown toenails lifter but I did not use it for that. To me it is more of a cleaning tool.

DISKLIKE
- The nail file stored in the handle is useless; it does not file the nails at all -- 0 stars.

If all the tools worked, this would have gotten 5 stars from me. The clipper itself is its best feature. The price of $12.99 is competitive and reasonable for this.

title: Two beautiful adult combs & two kid's combs; consider these disposable; they extract fuzz, etc.
text:
The two adult combs are beautiful, small, double-sided, and stylish. The two kid's are three-quarter the size of the adult combs and the tines are smaller. They are also plain compared to the other two.

The tines themselves are made of hard plastic that will break easily if it encounters a tangle. I used one of the adult combs to comb my short to medium fine curly hair and it extracted fuzz from my bedding that was in my hair. This definitely works. The only issue I have is their longevity. However, at the current price of $4.98, I expect them to be periodically disposable. These would be perfect as lice combs because of the thin spacing between the tines.

title: Like a car-wash sponge; big & difficult to work with; definitely not exfoliating
text:
After trying this, I am definitely not a fan. I prefer my mesh $2 buff puff over this any day.

First of all, this sponge is large and thick like a car-wash sponge. This makes it difficult to work with. Also, it is somewhat soft, so it is not exfoliating - though I prefer soft over scratchy. In addition, when using soap on this sponge is does not lather up like it does with my buff puff.

Lastly, this sponge looks pink and not brown as the description says.

In summary, I personally do not care for this set of sponges. However, if a sponge like this is something one likes, then this is as functional as any other of its kind, just don't expect it to act like a loofah.

title: Like a car-wash sponge; big & difficult to work with; definitely not exfoliating
text:
After trying this, I am definitely not a fan. I prefer my mesh $2 buff puff over this any day.

First of all, this sponge is large and thick like a car-wash sponge. This makes it difficult to work with. Also, it is somewhat soft, so it is not exfoliating - though I prefer soft over scratchy. In addition, when using soap on this sponge is does not lather up like it does with my buff puff.

In summary, I personally do not care for this set of sponges. However, if a sponge like this is something one likes, then this is as functional as any other of its kind, just don't expect it to act like a loofah.

title: Nice set of four soft sponges with cleaner
text:
This is a nice set of four soft sponges in two shapes and three sizes. They work well as do any type sponges I purchased before of this type. This comes with a bar of cleaner which is really soap. I used it to clean one of the sponges and it came out very clean. However, a regular bar of soap cleans them just as well. It lathers up like a typical bar of soap.

At the current price of $10.99, this is priced competitively.

title: Tamed the frizz in my hair but did reduce my curls some
text:
This review is for the Pantene Body Boosting Mousse.

I have short to medium length fine curly hair. I shook the can vigorously and dispensed a little mound of what looked like whipped cream into my palms. I then massaged it throughout my hair and styled it. My hair dried without any frizz, so this did tame any fly-aways. I also like that it did not feel like I had product in my hair. However, it did reduce my curls and that I dislike. Other than this, it works as designed.

title: Provides my hair with a light all day hold; love the locking top
text: This hair spray gave me a light all day hold of my short to medium fine curly hair. I like the smell. I love the locking top that prevents the spray from accidentally going off when not in use. This spray almost feels like I have very little product in my hair, which is the way I like it.

title: Provides my hair with a light hold with a bit of a sheen; love the locking top
text: This hair spray gave me a light all day hold and highlighted my fine curly hair with a bit of a sheen. I like the smell. I love the locking top that prevents the spray from accidentally going off when not in use. This spray almost feels like I have very little product in my hair, which is the way I like it.

title: Bag is sturdy but the design causes zippers to be “sticky” & pockets to be mostly useless
text:
As of this writing, this toiletry bag has 35 reviews, 33 of which are 5 stars and 2 of which are 4 stars. I am shocked by these rave reviews, because although the bag is sturdy and the central compartment is spacious, the zippers are difficult to operate, particularly the central compartment zipper. In addition, all the additional pockets are practically useless because not much of anything fits in them.

This black bag comes with a blue drawstring nylon backpack as can be seen in the background in my photos.

What I like about this bag is the sturdiness and the fact that it has a hanging hook. There are two small compartments; one on each side of the bag for a toothbrush, nail file, etc. and a folder pocket on the outside of that. The central compartment has two small zippered mesh pockets below the hook that hardly hold anything. I couldn't even get my deordorant to zip up in it. The central compartment is relatively spacious and has 8 mesh pockets along three sides to hold small incidentals.

In summary, this bag will function as a small toiletry bag. However, I rated this two stars for two reasons. First, I am constantly struggling to get the main compartment zipper closed. This is due to the creases in the bag and angle of the design. I do not want to have to pull and prod at this to close it. Second, the mesh pockets under the lid and the pockets on the side are too small to be useful to me. If the zipper was not so sticky it would have gotten 4 stars.

title: Simple, small toiletry bag with comb – 3.5 stars
text:
This is a very small and simple toiletry bag with a comb that has a design in the same powder blue color as the bag. The comb works fine and the bag holds not much. However, I can get some jewlery, toothpaste, toothbrush, hair gel, and brush in the bag and not much more.

There are lots of pockets. It has a handle on top with one half-height zippered pocket in the back. It has a hanging hook on the inside and a Velcro closure. There's a see-through pocket on the underside of the flap along with a tiny mesh pocket below that both of which have zippers on them. In the front of the main compartment is another zippered pocket. The central mesh interior has four sleeves to put some small items in.

The zippers glide easily throughout the bag. Unfortunately, I would not call this bag large. I like the powder blue color and it is perfect as an overnight toiletry bag as long as one is carrying several travel size products or a few full size products.

The current price of $9.90 is very reasonable for what this is. Had this been priced any higher, I would have given it 3 stars.

title: The perfect gift for mom; it comes in a nice gift box
text:
This is a perfect gift for one's mom who loves carrying around a compact mirror to apply make-up or just check her hairdo. It comes in a gift box with a cardboard sleeve. Inside the box is a heavy dual sided mirror with one set of faux diamond-studded earrings. The front of the mirror is engraved with the saying "Remember I Love You Mom"

The mirror opens and closes easily and looks like a pocket watch from yesteryear. This is definitely a keepsake that a daughter or son can gift the mom they cherish.

title: Perfect gift for the female you love; it comes in a nice gift box
text:
This is a perfect gift for the female you love. It comes in a gift box with a cardboard sleeve. Inside the box is a heavy dual sided mirror with one set of faux diamond-studded earrings. The front of the mirror is engraved with the saying:

"So much
of me is made from
what I learned from you.
You will always be with me like a handprint
on my heart."

The mirror opens and closes easily and looks like a pocket watch from yesteryear. This is a perfect gift for the female you love, especially if she carries around make-up and needs a mirror to touch up.

title: Hand lotion makes my hands super silky—5 stars; dispenser is 2 stars
text:
This review is for the oat blossom hand lotion. This comes in a pack of three. One of the bottle tops was mostly unscrewed even though it is packaged well. Lucky nothing leaked.

I had immense trouble opening the pump top. I kept turning it in the direction stated and it would not pop up. After about 5 minutes of this, I was about to dispense the lotion without the pump when it finally opened. This needs to be fixed as that is a big negative to me when I can't get to the product.

Nevetheless, I got this working. The lotion is of medium consistency and smells wonderful. As I massaged this into my hands, it absorbed rapidly. Within a few minutes my hands were as smooth as silk.

The current price of $19.47 brings this to $6.49 per bottle which I feel is reasonable. I really, really love this lotion and would definitely purchase it once they fix the bottle top.

title: Very nice LED compact mirror that is perfect for a purse or travel
text:
This is a very nice compact mirror. I love how it feels in my hands. It is a little larger and thicker than a normal non-LED compact but it is still extremely portable.

It charges rapidly via the supplied USB cable (AC adapater not included). Once the charge indicators are all green, it is ready for use. The on/off button on the side turns the mirror on and puts it in standby mode. This means if I press this button after opening the mirror the first time, the light comes on. I do not have to press this button again. I can just close the mirror and the light will go out. Open the mirror and the light comes on. However, if I do press the on/off button again, it will disable this feature and the lights will not come on.

If I hold down the on/off button while the mirror is lit, it will cycle through several brightness levels. Keep pressing and it cycles through the levels again.

The magnetic closure works well. The top half of the compact is the 5X magnification. It is not as easy to work with the top half of the mirror as it is with the bottom half.

Overall, this is a lovely mirror. I do, however, think it is priced about $3 too much. The current price of $17.99 is on the expensive side.

title: Consider these beautiful disposable combs that extract fuzz, product, etc. out of hair
text: These combs are beautiful, small, double-sided, and stylish. The tines themselves are made of hard plastic that will break easily if it encounters a tangle. I used the purple comb to comb my short to medium fine curly hair and I could actually see product residue between the tines of the gel I used in the morning. This definitely works. The only issue I have is their longevity. However, at the current price of $5.98, I expect them to be periodically disposable.

title: Impressive rechargeable vanity mirror with 3 light settings – 4.5 stars
text:
This mirror is impressive compared to some of the other junk vanity mirrors I received for review. It has to be assembled with the two supplied screws. Even a screwdriver is provided. Once it is assembled, the silicone gasket gets fitted into the bottom over the screws to prevent slippage.

The base and stand of the mirror has a nice heft to it. Since I am partial to oval shapes, I absolutely love the oval design. Before first use, I charged it for a couple of hours with the supplied charging cord. Note that the USB cord does not come with a wall adapter but most people already have one of those in their home.

Once charging was done, I just pressed the power button in the back and the light came on. To turn the light on or off, I can just tap the "hand" button on the right lower front of the mirror. If I do not want the light to come on accidentally, I can press the power button in the back of the mirror to turn off what I would call "standby" mode.

There are three light settings. The lower left light button on the front of the mirror will cycle through the brightness settings of natural daylight, warm light, and mixed daylight/warm light.

There is also a 10x magnetic mirror which will affix to the top of the oval mirror. Note that only the top of the oval is magnetized and suitable for its placement.

In summary, this is a great vanity mirror. It is perfect for precision work, applying make-up, etc. It is also very elegant and stylish and would enhance the decor in almost any bathroom. The light is bright enough although I wish it even had more brightness settings. Only time will tell how long the battery's charge will last. Nevertheless, this product is nearly perfect; I give it 4.5 stars.

title: Lightly held my hairstyle all day long; gave my hair that styled look
text: I massaged a little more than a dime-size amount throughout my short to medium fine curly hair and it stayed styled all day long. The hold is light but it is enough to keep my curly style. In fact, I like that it is light because it does not feel like I have an immense amount of product in my hair. This also has a fresh fragrance that is a bit flowery and not overpowering.

title: Perfect gift for a super close friend; I know my best friend will cherish this
text: This is a perfect gift for a best friend. It comes in a gift box with a cardboard sleeve. Inside the box is a soft drawstring pouch that holds the heavy dual sided mirror and comes with two sets of earrings (one with round studs and one with faux diamonds). The front of the mirror is engraved with the saying "Side or Miles Apart, Friends Are Always Close at Heart." The mirror open and closes easily. I ordered this for a very close friend of mine who lives on the west coast and I know she will cherish this.

title: I love the flexibility of this brush and the venting for using a blow dryer
text:
Although this brush was not what I expected, it is a gem in its own right. I love how flexible the brush head is as it moves through my hair. Also, the fact that the vents allow hot air to flow through while blow drying is another plus.

This brush glides with relative ease through my short to medium length fine curly hair. Detangling is not its best feature, however. Its best features are the flexibility and venting, to me. This would be a perfect blow drying brush for a person with long straight fine hair.

title: Very moisturizing; has good thickness for winter; love the grape fragrance
text: This is a nice thick cream with a lovely grape fragrance. I put this on in the evening over my entire face and neck and by morning my face is moisturized. Since the cream is thick, it is more of a winter lotion. Nevertheless, I like it very much.

title: Nice detangling brush that can be used wet or dry
text:
I have short to medium length fine curly hair and use this both in the shower after conditioning and when my hair is dry. This brush works as designed. The bristles allow me to easily brush my locks. It is also anti-static and relatively strong. It also matches my all black detangling comb perfectly.

This detangling brush is as good as others I have tried. To me this all comes down to price. The current price of $12.99 is a bit expensive. Other than the price, this functions as designed and is gentle on my hair.

title: Comb is 7-1/2” long and works as designed; it’s anti-static
text: I have short to medium length fine curly hair and use this both in the shower after conditioning and when my hair is dry. This works as designed. The wide-teeth allow me to easily pass this through my locks. It is also anti-static and relatively strong. It also matches my all black detangling brush perfectly,

title: Provides my hair with a deep cleaning and leaves it bouncy and with volume
text:
I have been testing a lot of product on my hair recently and this shampoo really super cleans my hair. I would not call it hydrating at all. It left my hair squeaky clean and a bit dry but full of vigor and bounce. It is not a shampoo I can use daily. I have fine short to medium-length curly hair and cleansing power of this shampoo is a bit strong.

Besides its cleaning ability, I like the coconut fagrance. The aroma reminds me of Hawaiian Trop Suntan Lotion. I took of one star only because this is not hydrating to my hair as it claims to be. Neverthless, I really like this shampoo.

title: Cheaply made body brush set; wand does not seat fully
text: I am disappointed in this set. There are two interchangeable body brush heads, one wand, and one face brush. There is also a burlap carry bag. The white bristled body brush feels softer than the sand colored head. My main disappointment is with the wand. The wand point does not seat well into the body brushes. I cannot fit it all the way. I pushed it as much as it will go and it wobbles with vigorous brushing. Of course the brushes can be used with the hand-held elastic. Nevertheless, I wanted to use the wand and am disappointed in its connection with the brush. Other than this major flaw, the brushes are basic and bargain basement, but they work as designed.

title: Lightly held my hairstyle all day long
text: I massaged this throughout my damp short to medium fine curly hair and it stayed styled all day long. The hold is very light but it is enough to keep my curly style. In fact, I like that it is light because it does not feel like I have an immense amount of product in my hair. This also has a nice apple fragrance as does all their products I have been trying recently. It smells like green apple to me.

title: This "Cadillac of razors" provides an excellent close shave but comes with horrendous instructions
text:
I ordered this razor for my boyfriend and he loves it. He has been using it for a little over one week now. He used it dry, in the shower, and in the shower with shave cream. No electric razor shaves as close as a blade but this comes close. The razor itself is 5 stars but the instructions to me are 0 stars and to my boyfriend they are 2 stars. It is like reading hieroglyphics as it's all pictures, most of which make no sense. We actually had to search out youtube videos in order to figure out how to insert the cleaning solution.

This comes with a charging base which also cleans. There is one container of cleaning solution provided. Just remove the top, insert into the bottom of the base, and then close. When the razor needs to be cleaned, press the button on the top of the protrusion in the base. It takes a while to clean but does a good job. Additional cleaning packets will have to be purchased or the razor can be cleaned manually. The head is easily removable if cleaning manually.

Also included is a trimming blade with trim guide levels of 1, 2, 3, 5, and 7. My boyfriend only uses this as a shave razor and has no plans to use the trimming blade.

Overall, my boyfriend is extremely satisified with this razor. It holds a charge long as he has yet to recharge it and it still shows full power. He does think the cleaning solution is unnecessary but it does make things easier. The base should not be moved when the solution is inside because it will spill and leak all over--we moved it by mistake. We love that it can be used under water and with shave cream. Although this does not provide as close of a shave as a razor blade, it comes very close. The current price of $149.94 (that's with the current $10 off coupon) is expensive but competitive due to the accessories provided.

title: My hair looks so beautiful and nourished with this combing cream
text: I have short to medium length fine curly hair and massaged a quarter-sized dollop through my locks after shampooing and towel drying my hair. I then combed it through. At first I was not sure I would like this because my hair looked a bit flat but after it dried it looked gorgeous. This left a nice sheen throughout, did not weigh down my curls, and made my mousey brown hair look a luxurious deep brown as a result of this product's conditioning effect. In addition, the fragrance is wonderful and smells like apple to me. I will definitely be using this again.

title: Great fragrance, great all day hold, and left my hair with a nice sheen
text:
I absolutely love this hair spray.  I sprayed this over my entire short to medium fine curly hair. My hair felt like it had a light hair net in it. The hold lasted all day, my hair remained styled, and it had a nice sheen to it. In addition, the fragrance is wonderful.

I am not a person that is a fan of hair spray but I love this.

title: Holds stiffly for about 2 hours then my hair goes limp after that; fragrance is great
text:
This review is for the 3-pack of Pantene extra stron hold hairspray (#4).

I sprayed this over my entire short to medium fine curly hair, and it went on thick. My hair felt like it had a net in it. However, that hold only lasted about two hours and after that my hair went limp. The bottle says that it holds without leaving the hair feeling stiff or sticky. The sticky part is true; it is not sticky. However, it does go on stiff and stays stiff for a couple of hours. After that, there is no hold but it still feels like I have product in my hair.

I do love the fragrance which smells like apple to me. However, this hairspray hold power is just so, so and is not as it claims.

title: The results do not wow me; my hair was soft but lifeless after using this
text:
This review is for the Pantene Nourishing Oil Split End Serum.

I applied a couple of squirts to the ends of my short to medium fine curly hair and worked my way up. My hair dried soft but was completely lifeless after using this. I also cannot determine if it helps split ends because I cannot find any on me. However, I love the fragrance. It smells like apple to me. Nevertheless, I need to be wow'd by more than just the scent. It is okay but nothing spectacular.

At the current price of $12.59 (after applying the $1 coupon offer), this comes to $4.20 a bottle which is on the high side.

title: This has a lovely fruity fragrance and it held my curls all day
text:
I am very surprised that I love this gel. I used this on my hair when it was dry and also lightly damp; both ways work well for me. I applied about three quarter-sized drops throughout my short to medium fine curly hair. It held all day and made my hair look styled. I rarely use a hair dryer, so I just massaged my hair and crunched it up until I my curls were the way I wanted it. When it dried, my hair had that wet and curly look I love.

This gel is a level 3 which is for maximum hold. They have a level 1 (flexible hold), level 2 (strong hold), and level 4 (extreme hold). 

At the current price of $10.29, it comes to a reasonable $3.43 per tube. I will definitely be using this.

title: My hair felt conditioned and looked styled after using this; I did not lose my curls but...
text: I have fine short to medium-length hair. After shampooing and finishing my shower, I towel dried my hair. Once my hair was damp and not soaking wet, I then sprayed this all over my head and combed it through. I let my hair air dry and it looked and felt conditioned and had a sheen to it. Also, this did not weigh down my curls. I had almost full body but that was only on the day it was applied. The next day my hair did not feel conditioned; instead it felt dry. I had to apply it again to my dry hair for my hair to feel somewhat moisturized. To me this works nearly perfect on my locks the first day or evening it is applied (4.5 stars); however, the next day my hair felt dry (1 star). Therefore, this will work if I wash my hair daily and apply this to my damp hair. However, the next day my hair feels dry even though it is still easy to comb through it. Overall, it gets 2.5 stars from me rounded up to 3 stars.

title: Excellent as a hair fragrance but hold only lasts 30 minutes
text:
I was so excited to try this. This hairspray comes in a three-pack and at the current price of $14.49 (that is minus the $1.50 offer), it would be a good deal if it worked.

I shook the can as directed and sprayed a generous amount on my short to medium fine curly hair. The fragrance is DIVINE; I absolutely love the scent. I used a generous amount on my entire head. However, once the spray is dispensed, my hair felt like it had a hair net on it. I suspected that was for maximum hold and was initially pleased. Unfortunately, once my it dried, the hold disappeared and my hair went flat. I could still feel some product in my hair but I felt as if most of the product evaporated once it dried. My hold only lasted about 30 minutes. Perhaps this would last longer if I teased my strands but I do not do that. I am extemely disappointed in the hold and would never order this spray again.

In summary, as a hair frangrance, this is wonderful but as a hair spray and it has a minimal and very short-lasting hold.

title: Versatile trimming and styling kit for a man; good for light clean-up - 3.5 stars
text:
I ordered this for my boyfriend but since he does not wear a beard, this is overkill for him. Unfortunately, the stubble, beard, and hair clipping guards are not something he has a need for.

This comes with a short and long beard comb, a 1 and 2mm stubble comb, a precision trimmer, ear and nose trimmer, body grooming head, two hair clipping guides that go from 3 to 23 mm, and a razor with two blades. Also included is a carry bag and a brush along with the main razor body and charging cord and an instruction book.

PROS
- This charges relatively quickly--less than two hours.

- The hair clipping trimming guides slide easily up and down the trimmer with the use of the blue button.

- The ear and nose trimming guide works well. My boyfriend said this was soothing especially since I trimmed his ears with this.

- The precision trimming tool worked perfectly on his sideburns and the hairline on the back of his neck.

- The body grooming head removes hair easily and without pinching.

- The razor heads are easy to clean; although some "white" lubricant gets all over the razer base.

- The razor base is ergonomically designed and feels great in the hands.

- There is a small carry bag for this.

- The supplied razer blade works well.

- This can be used in the shower if desired.

CONS
- Difficult to remove the ear and nose trimming, precision trimming, and body grooming heads. It is very hard to push these heads up and off the trimmer.

- The inclusion of the razor with two blades is a nice touch but kind of negates the need for an electric trimmer. My boyfriend wanted to use a full electric system, and if he wants a clean shave, he has to go back to a razer blade with shave cream.

- The instruction book is minimal. I would have loved the picture on the back of the box to have been included in the booklet.

In summary, this is a versatile trimming tool. One has to use the supplied clean shaving razer for a really close shave; however, the other blades are good for manscapping, ear and nose hairs (even brow hairs), and sideburns and hairlines. This is also good for beards and head hair trimming, although my boyfriend did not use it for that. I feel this is a reasonably budgeted trimming kit for the current price of $59.94. The fact that this can be used in the shower is also a nice feature.

title: Love the fragrance of this conditioner; left my hair soft but I lost my curls
text:
I have short to medium length fine curly hair. After shampooing, I applied a half-dollar size of conditioner to my entire head and then rinsed it off after massaging it in. My hair dried feeling extremely soft but the effect of the conditioning left my hair light and airy but without any curls.  I absolutely love the strong fragrance of this. Both the aroma and soft conditioning is 5 stars. However, I dislike that my hair no longer has curl after using this.

At the current price of $14.99 plus an extra 10% off, this set of three conditioners is a good deal to me. The results I have with this are very good. If my hair remained curly, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Nice conditioner with pleasant fragrance; did not weigh down my curls
text:
I have short to medium length fine curly hair. After shampooing, I applied a half-dollar size of conditioner to my entire head and then rinsed it off after massaging it in. My hair dried feeling relatively moisturized but not overly so. I like the strong but pleasant fragrance of this.

I am surprised at how nice my hair turned out after it air dried. My curls were not as weighed down as I expected. This conditioner is definitely a keeper and I love how the purple bottles match my purple bathroom.

At the current price of $14.91 plus an extra 10% off, this set of three conditioners is a steal to me. The results I have with this are very good. If my hair felt a little more softer, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Love the strong fragrance, face feels smooth but not hydrated nor clean
text:
This dispenses as a light and airy foam. As per the instructions, I applied this to my dry face morning and night and let it sit for a minute before rinsing with warm water. My face felt smooth but not hydrated or clean. I found it weird to let it dry and wait before rinsing off. Also, there is no sudsing action. It dries almost to an invisible film.

I absolutely love the strong frangrance but do not feel this did much for my face. Although I did not use this to remove make-up, I still felt like I needed to wash my face with soap.

Note that my box arrived smashed up and damaged so be aware of that possiblity if buying as a gift.

This claims to be vegan, GMO free, eco friendly, and is a woman owned enterprise.

In summary, perhaps this will work for someone else but I do not see any purpose for this in my daily routine. I do love the fragrance and how smooth my face feels after using this but I still feel unclean and have to wash my face after. I also love how easy it dispenses but wish the foam had a thicker body feel than light and airy as a feather.

title: Definitely worked to smooth my skin but left me looking windburned
text:
The directions say to use this morning and night. Because I know I have sensitive skin, I only used this in the morning for almost 9 days. After the 9 days my face was smooth and it definitely worked as designed. However, almost my entire face looked windburned or as if I was out in the cold for a few hours. It is mostly for this reason I do not like this and will not be using it. The other reason is that $115 is a bit steep. However, for someone who does not have a reaction to this, this product might be worth a try over more radical beauty treatments. Unfortunately, this is not for me.

On another note, this is appears to be fragrance free to my nose. I prefer a highly perfumed product but for those who do not like fragrance, the aroma is barely detectable.

title: Super dark long-lasting lipstick that glides on smoothly; smells like a Crayola crayon
text:
This review is for the lipstick color labeled "watch me" which is a very deep burgundy color that is almost black.

This lipstick glides smoothly on my lips and stays put, even after eating. I do not wear lipstick for 24 hours, so I cannot attest to it's wearability for that length of time; however, I could still see the color after eight hours. Although, this is a matte finish, it still looks great. In the future, I will be applying another lipstick over this because the color is a bit deep for my fair complexion. 

What I find amazing about this lipstick is that when I blot my lips, very little of the color can be seen on the tissue. What I don't like is the Crayola crayon smell and taste of the lipstick and the fact that it is a bit too dark for me. Nevertheless, this is a great long lasting lipstick as long as one wants a muted matte finish and the color complements their complexion.

title: Lotion is lightly moisturizing & its fragrance is awesome but this is expensive
text:
This lotion is lightly moisturzing; I used it on my entire body. What I adore the most is that the aroma is divine. I beyond love the extremely perfumy fragrance which reminds me of a field of very fragrant flowers like frangipani (plumeria) even though that is not in the ingedients list.

I do not like that the label says "natural color change may occur." I have no idea if that means my skin or the product. Either way, I have not experienced either. The only reason I rated this 4 stars is because the current price of $38 is expensive for 8 ounces of lotion. Otherwise, this is a great summer moisturizer with a strong and wild floral aroma.

title: Vegan moisturizer with sweet fragrance; it’s very light, very little, and very expensive
text: This review is for the orange zest and peach blossoms scented lotion. It comes with a tiny pump in a tiny bottle. The aroma is wonderful to me and the lotion is lightly moisturizing and perfect for summer. However, there is too little lotion at 3 ounces to be worth the $35 price and that is the only reason I took off one star. Otherwise, I love it.

title: This tan is perfect for my very fair skin because goes on sheer; not moisturizing
text:
