When I ordered this, I was afraid it would be too dark or a color I had to use for the summer. However, because this moisturizer goes on sheer, it does not leave much color behind. This is obviously perfect for me but someone who is expecting a darker color will be sorely disappointed.

I cannot attest to its sun protection. I also do not feel like it moisturizes. However, this is perfect as a make-up base.

title: Deep dark brown brow pencil that is perfect for my bushy brows
text: I love the deep dark brown color of this brow pencil. I have bushy eyebrows but as I get older, my brow color is fading. I used this to "color in the brow area" and then used the brush to smootly blend the color into my brown hairs. The pencil color glides on easily and the brush blends it well so that the deep brown is a little less deep. This is perfect for my brows.

title: This conditioner leaves my hair super soft but also relaxes my curls somewhat
text: I ordered the two pack of conditioner. Although it is packaged well, one bottle arrived dented. The conditioner itself is  creamy and super moisturizing and has a very nice fragrance. However, it does relax my curls a bit. I do not have damaged hair but this would work wonders on that type hair.

title: Extremely moisturizing, glides on smooth, nice coral pink color, but wears off easily
text:
This review is for the "Beautiful Rosewood" color.

This lipstick is like lip balm with color. It is incredibly moisturizing but has to be applied often. The white center, I assume, is the moisturizer with the color on the exterior. It glided on my lips like a dream and felt so good on. However, it does not last at all. Within about 2 hours or less it wore off even if I did not eat or drink anything. 

The coral pink color is attractive on my fair skin and it is shinier than a matte finish, which provides a nice "glow" to the lips. If this lasted longer on my lips, I would have rated this higher.

title: Scentless moisturizing mask; leaves face sopping wet and over moisturized
text:
There are five individually wrapped masks in this package. The individual mask package was impossible to open, so I had to use a scissor.

The mask itself is drenched in solution and dripping wet. I personally would have preferred it were less wet as there is enough moisturizer on this to moisturize two faces. After cleaning my face and using a toner, I applied this for 15 minutes. After the 15 minutes was up, I removed and threw away the liner and then had to spend time rubbing in the remaining solution. My face dried tacky but after a while it absorbed and felt very moisturized. However, my face felt no more moisturized than if I had put on a face moisturizer right after a shower.

I was surprised this is scentless as I expected a rose fragrance. I have sensitive skin and this mask did not irritate it, which is good. Overall, this does what it says it will do but I found the super wet mask to be overkill due to the abundance of moisturizer. I personally would not order this again simply because I can get the same results with my Oil of Olay moisturizer that I put on after a shower without all the extra fuss and waiting time.

title: Nice make-up brush set in a pinkish purple pouch that smells like fresh paint
text:
I actually like this brush set. I would not call it professional as it is synthetic but there is a nice array of implements in this set. In total there are 15 brushes. The bristles are very soft and so far they have not fallen out. I purchased an expensive brush once that was in the $40 range for one brush and the bristles fell out on first use. This set includes brushes for the eyes, brow, lips, cheeks, and face but does not include every brush needed.

NEGATIVES

- First, I do not like the chemical smell of the case. It smells like fresh paint.

- Second, the brushes do not have their purpose or use listed on the side. I like brushes that are embossed with what they are used for. I am not a make-up artist and am not fully versed on every type brush and its use. I just grab what I think will work. I can tell a brown brush from a mascara brush and a lip lining bush and a blush brush; it is the in-between brushes that are not clear to me.

- Third, there are a few brushes missing. For instance, there is no lip lining brush or fan brush for blending eyeshadow. There are several that look like they can be used for eyeshadow and blending but not a fan brush which is what I usually use to blend.

At the current price of $17.99 each brush comes to about $1.20 apiece which is super cheap. I consider brushes disposable anyway. I think this is a nice portable set. I like that the case has a flap inside to cover the brushes after use so that they do not smear on the other brushes. However, I hate the chemical smell of the case which is headache producing to me. Also, the case is more pinkish than purple. If this set did not have such a bad smelling case, I would have rated this 4 stars. To get 5 stars, it would have had to have the lip liner and fan brush and have each brush's use embossed on the side.

title: Mascara that lasted all day on my lashes and did not flake off
text: This very black mascara lasted all day on my lashes and did not flake off. It also goes on smooth and washes off with soap and water. This is another good mascara from many to choose from on the market today.

title: Barely provides any color but enhances other lipstick with a gloss
text: This lip gloss hardly provides any color to my lips at all and I have light lips and light skin. However, it does enhance my other lipsticks by providing a sheen over them. I also would not call this hydrating. If it did not enhance my other matte lipsticks, I would have given this 2 stars.

title: The fragrance is offensive to me but I love the soft results of this conditioner
text: This conditioner has a very strong and unpleasant fragrance. However, once I get past that, the thick cream conditions my hair well. My dry hair felt super soft. It does relax my curls a little bit but not too much. I certainly would have liked this more if the fragrance were not so offensive.

title: Smells heavenly, lathers well, & leaves hair clean but packaging is dangerous
text: I love the fragrance of this shampoo and how well it lathers. It also cleaned my hair exceptionally well and did not weigh down my curls too much.  The NEGATIVE is that this is packaged like an avocado juice drink and someone who cannot read or quickly reads the label, might think it is safe to consume. To me this is very dangerous. I have seen many times in stores where products that are packaged like food are put in the food aisle by accident and there are people who just look at picture and think it is a drink. This is the only reason I rated this 3 stars. If it was packaged like a shampoo, it would have gotten 5 stars from me.

title: Lackluster lather, hydration is too much for my fine hair
text:
I am disappointed in this travel set for my fine curly hair. There are four items in this travel kit. There is a shampoo, conditioner, moisturizing hair mask, and a moisturizing detangler.

The cleanser has a lackluster lather. I wanted more suds and no matter how much I put on my hair, it barely lathered. The conditioner is nice but when my hair dries, it is over moisturizing and makes my hair look darker and not as curly. The detangler / leave-in conditioner only further weighed down my hair and did nothing to detangle it.

Personally, this is not for me. I like that this has fragrance but absolutely hate a cleanser that does not suds up. The conditioner I can tolerate as I just reduce the amount for more fullness.

Since this is travel size, this will last about 3-6 uses depending on the hair length. The moisturizing mask is one use only since it comes in a pouch.

title: This “wild thoughts” color is too subdued and bleeds into skin
text: This color called "wild thoughts" is more like a matte mauve. It needs some gloss and shimmer as it sort of fades into my natural lip hue and becomes barely noticeable. Personally, this does not suit my fair complexion. In order to wear this effectively, I have to mix it with other lip colors. The picture on Amazon looks very inviting and a bit shimmy; however, in person it is nothing but a flat boring shade.

title: This “rum raisin” color is a nice deep mauve color that goes on smooth and glossy
text: This “rum raisin” lip color is a nice deep mauve that goes on smooth and glossy. It looks good with my fair complexion and is easy to apply. It highlights my lips nicely.

title: Highlights my face with a golden champagne shimmer; not really my taste
text: I applied this bronzer over my makeup and it illuminated my face with a golden champagne shimmer. This does not dust on the face easily and coverage tended to be spotty. Additional applications only made the results look worse. This is really for a younger person and not a middle-aged woman.

title: Brow mascara is easy to apply and makes my brows look full
text: I have a fair complexion with thick brown brows and this brow mascara goes on easily and makes my the look full and evenly colored. I do wish the tiny brush tip was a little bigger, but other than that I like the results.

title: Pencil color goes on too light to provide good coverage
text: Perhaps this would work for someone else; however, this honey brown color is too light of a color to fill in my brows. I also have a fair complexion (almost ivory) with brown brows. It does glide on smoothly but the top is too thin to lay down more than a faint hint of honey brown on the brow. The sponge side is a bit better for blending and the color is darker there.

title: This caramel color is darker than I expected; does not provide full blemish-free coverage
text:
This caramel base is like a dark bisque or mocha color. It blends well but not nearly as easily or flawless as the more expensive [[ASIN:B07PNRDWJ6 pretty vulgar]] brand I have come to love. I am able to use this on my fair skin by really blending it in but it is best used in summer when my skin is "kissed" by a tan and that is only because I selected too dark of a color.

Overall, this is okay, I would just select a lighter color for me. The reason I rated this three stars is because I wish it blended easier and provided a more blemish-free cover.

title: This “savvy” color is more like a deep brown; not very attractive on me; also comes off easily
text:
This "savvy" color glides on smoothly on the lips but also comes off easily. The color is more of a matte deep brown. Since I have a fair complexion, it is not attractive on me, especially since it does not have a high sheen. I actually have to combine this with another lipstick or gloss to make this work. 

I rated this two stars because the color is not suitable for me and is very flat, the lipstick wears off incredibly easy, and opening the square container is not intuitive and took me about 30 seconds to figure out (seems like it should be pulled off when it is unscrewed instead).

title: Too tacky on the skin even after several minutes
text:
I never used a primer before. This looks like a circular tube of pink underarm deodorant for easy application on the face. It is colorless and glides on clear. I waited several minutes before applying make-up but it has a tacky feeling to it that I do not like.

I applied my make-up and it stayed on all day but I did not find this hydrating or brightening in any way. My make-up also wore off like it normally does. Personally, this is not for me. I do not see the purpose of this stick given my results and do not care for its tacky and sticky feel.

title: A beautiful purplish pink metallic that glides smoothly on my lips
text: This "grapevine groove" lip gloss is a beautiful purplish pink metallic that glides smoothly onto my lips. I love metallic and super glossy lipsticks and lip glosses and this certainly delivers. I have a fair complexion and this type color, along with glossy salmon or coral colors, look great on me.

title: Love the color, shimmer, applicator, and pretty wand
text: This "brilliantly sneaky" color is like a salmon colored high gloss lipstick that glides on smooth. I absolutely love the color on my fair complexion. In addition, the pink rose applique on the hande of the wand is also super attractive to me. I love this.

title: Feels very moisturizing when going on; seems to protect; price is steep
text:
At the current price of $23 for 2.5 ounces, this is very expensive. However, I really like it. This is a nice, thick, smooth, scentless cream suncreen that readily absorbs into my skin and makes my skin feel incredibly soft and moisturized. The instructions warn not to get in the eyes and not to apply on damaged or broken skin.

I am going to assume the sunscreen protects as I live in a northern climate and we are not getting much sun now. I particularly love the feel of this sunscreen after application. I wish there were more than 2.5 ounces for this price.

title: Although color is festive, polish is TOXIC in my opinion due to TOULENE ingredient
text:
I used their [[ASIN:B07N27H3GN Pink Tourmaline]] polish once before I realized that polish and this nail polish is TOXIC. It contains TOLUENE which causes neurological issues. In fact, I know someone who has Parkinson's Disease as a result of this chemical.  When I tried this polish previously I did not realize it had this. As a result, I am throwing this away without even using it. Had I known it contained this ingredient, I would never have ordered this for review in the first place.  

For those who do not care about the ingredients, this polish is as festive as the previous one I tried with all the sparkles.

title: Although color is rich, polish is TOXIC in my opinion due to TOULENE ingredient
text:
I used their [[ASIN:B07N27H3GN Pink Tourmaline]] polish once before I realized that polish and this nail polish is TOXIC. It contains TOLUENE which causes neurological issues. In fact, I know someone who has Parkinson's Disease as a result of this chemical.  When I tried this polish previously I did not realize it had this. As a result, I am throwing this away without even using it. Had I known it contained this ingredient, I would never have ordered this for review in the first place.

For those who do not care about the ingredients, this polish is a vibrant deep color that is very attractive.

title: TOXIC festive polish for the holidays; super expensive for 0.16 oz; dries sticky; peels off in 1 day
text:
This nail polish is TOXIC. It contains TOLUENE which causes neurological issues. In fact, I know someone who has Parkinson's Disease as a result of this chemical. When I tried this polish I did not realize it had this. As a result, I am throwing this away after one use.

Besides being TOXIC, the current price of $20.75 is outrageous for this polish. It is also 0.16 and not 0.17 fluid ounces. However, this is a very festive clear polish with glitter that is perfect for the holidays if it were not so dangerous. It has a pinkish hue and matches almost anything.

If one insists on using this, I do feel that this would look better if one coat is used over another base polish. One coat will allow the color underneath to show through yet highlight the nails. This dries somewhat sticky so I had to use a top coat. There are some polishes where a top coat is not needed. For this one it is required. Since this is a clear polish with sparkle, I would have expected that it could be used as its own top coat but it cannot.

If using only this polish, slight chipping is not noticeable because it is not a full color and is just a clear coat with sparkles. However, it peeled off my fingernails in a day (see last three pictures). If I had put this on top of another polish, perhaps it would not peel as easily even though it is designed to peel.

Overall, if it were not so TOXIC, I would like it but am incredibly disappointed in the price, do not like that it dries sticky making a top coat a requirement, and absolutely hate that it peels off my fingernails in less than 24 hours. According to the description, this is a peel off polish and it certainly lives up to that claim. It's just that the edges start to curl by just doing regular household duties and then it peels easily. The good thing is that no nail polish remover is needed but this removes like a decal or face mask one lets dry for a few hours. As for me, I am now throwing this in the garbage after one use. Had I know it contained this chemical, I never would have tried it in the first place.

title: This hand soap has a wonderful fragrance and cleans well
text:
I follow a few Amazon reviewers and discovered ths soap as a result of one of their five-star reviews and I am not disappointed. There are three 12-fluid ounce pump bottles with three separate fragrances below and I love the fragrance of every one. Also, each soap smells exactly as labeled which is usually not typical. Although this soap is thin and has moderate sudsing, it cleans my hands well and leaves them smelling great.

- Rosemary and Peppermint
- Grapefruit and Bergamot
- Sweet Lavender and Lime Hand Soap, Clear

The current price of $16.99 is a bit expensive, however, but I am not disappointed I tried this.

title: Very rich, moisturizing, and soothing eye cream that is priced double what I expect
text:
I just started using this eye cream and LOVE IT. It is thicker than the Nuxe (French) brand I usually use and about double the price of that one too. Dispensing the cream for the first time required a lot of pumping--about 15 pumps before it would come out. However, subsequent applications were fine.

It appears to be fragrance free as I do not detect any aroma. It claims to be SLS (sodium lauryl sulphate) free, paraben free, and petroleum and synthetic color free. I am not one that cares much what the ingredients are in creams; if it works, I use it. This is truly wonderful cream that softens my eylids and the area around my eyes.

Despite the wonderful results, I have two dislikes -- the price and that the box says to "avoid contact with eyes." I know that "avoid" means the interior of the eyes but that message disturbs me with an eye cream.

In summary, I personally have paid up to $48 for creams but I doubt I would buy this at the currently listed price of $84.50. The high price is the only reason I took off one star. Other than this, it is my new favorite eye cream.

title: This is the best brush blow-out styler I tried so far but cumbersome to use
text:
This is the third brush blow-out type styler I have tried and the other two were horrible. However, this is the best one even though it is not great.  What I like is that the brush is hard plastic so it is unlikely to wear out quickly. Also, the steam feature is wonderful especially for when my hair is dry.

What I do not like is that it is awkward to hold because the handle is so thick. In addition, the large base makes it very cumbersome to style with. Also, because the brush is not round, it is impossible to get a good curl with this and is better for producing waves. The other thing I do not like is how difficult it is to air dry the water reservoir which takes several days.

Operation is a cinch. There are only two buttons on the handle. One is the off/cool/low/high slider temperature button to be used when styling with or without the mist. Then there is a vapor on/off button that needs to be held down for a full two seconds to activate or de-activate the steam feature. The cord is long and swivels and the plug has a red test button.

Overall, this styler is actually useful but it could be better. If the brush were round that would permit me to curl my hair, the handle thinner and easier to work with, and the reservoir easier to dry, then this would have received 5 stars from me.

title: Nice fresh summery fragrance that is long lasting, vegan, & cruelty free
text:
This is a nice fresh summery fragrance. Although the label says this is salted coconut and orange blossom, I actually cannot describe the fragrance or detect those scents. Nevertheless, I really like it.

I take two showers per day and this aroma lasts until my next shower. It is also vegan and cruelty free (see second photo) per the label.

I also love the container it comes in as I can re--purpose that to store Q-tips, cotton balls, etc.

title: The tube is dreadful; face scrub is wonderful; 2 stars because I can't easily get to the product
text:
I recently tried their [[ASIN:B07X5WBSZ5 tea tree face scrub]] and loved it. This face scrub is even better because I love the rose fragrance and how nice and smooth it leaves my face.

Nevertheless, I would never buy this until they fix their tube / packaging and that is the reason this is getting two stars. If I have to take a hammer and chisel to get to the product, they lost me.

First this arrived with the cap in three pieces (see first photo which shows part of the cap; tiny pieces went in garbage). Second, I tried to squeeze out the product and a tiny pinhead's worth came out and that's all. I even stepped on the tube and put all my weight on it and still the scrub would not come out of the tube. Note that there is no paper sealing the exit. I finally took a wrench and broke the cap off (see third photo). A tremendous amount then squeezed all over the place which I used for testing. I had to put it in a plastic bag capless since the cap will not go back on.

In summary, this scrub is wonderfully fragrant like a field of roses. I love that. I also love how smooth it makes my face feel. The scrub feels like it has granules of sand in it but that is to be expected. Nevertheless, I would not purchase this and cannot recommend it simply because it is impossible to get to the produt within.

title: Leaves my face feeling smooth; tea tree oil is 16th ingredient
text:
I happen to like tea tree oil because it has antiseptic properties. However, it also has a strong medicinal aroma. This scrub has a very light tea tree oil fragrance (with other notes I cannot enumerate) because it is the sixteenth ingredient.

I use a little bit (about a dime size portion) on my face and work it into my face in a circular motion avoiding the eye area. The scrub feels like grains of sand. Once I wash it off, my face is super smooth. I personally love the results.

title: Perfect shower caps for home or salon use; also great to cover food for picnics
text:
I actually ordered these for an off-market use. However, these are perfect for use in the home. I tried one in the shower to cover my hair and it stayed on perfectly and did not get my hair wet. The elastic made the seal almost air tight yet loose enough to feel very comfortable. I have been using the same disposable shower cap for several days now.

These are specifically designed for use in a salon when women or men get color and they will work well with that. They store small and open up to what is shown in the third photo.

Nevertheless, I ordered these to cover dishes (see fourth photo). I have a friend who eats outside a lot and these will keep the mosquitos and flies away from the food on the outdoor table until it is ready to be served. It is also a lot better than putting those mesh covers (mesh umbrellas) over the food which tend to reduce table space.

Overall, these are excellent and work as designed. The current price of $18.99 for 130 caps seems reasonable at .15 cents apiece.

title: Not recommended for anything but short fine hair and even then it is practically powerless
text:
I am not at all impressed with this hot air styling brush. I have medium length fine hair and tried it on the recommended low setting on damp hair as recommended in the manual. I could barely feel any power or heat. I then raised it to high and it just increases the noise but there is limited heat and air flow.

This has a high, low, and off buttons and a curl release button. The curl release did nothing for me. The styling brush easily removes for easy cleaning by unscrewing the tip (see second photo).

My recommendation is to save your money. A regular roller brush with a blow dryer does a much better job. I had zero results with this. Someone who has very short fine hair might have some success but I doubt it will be worth the purchase. Its only redeeming value is that it can be used like a dollar store brush without the power. This is not worth more than $1 to me and the current price of $39.99 is highway robbery.

title: Works well, smells fine, sinks in quickly, & dispenses like Elmer’s Glue
text: I am extremely surprised at how quickly this absorbs into my skin. That is my favorite feature of this suntan lotion.  It protects me from the sun and smells fine but not great. It also dispenses like Elmer's Glue out of a small tip. The current price of $55 is expensive for this, however.

title: Excellent hand moisturizer but I cannot stand the fragrance
text:
This moisturizer absorbs well, does not feel greasy on my hands, and really moisturizes. However, I absolutley hate the fragrance.  I am a lover of fragrances but this tropical aroma does not smell tropical at all. I would expect a hint of coconut but it smells almost like burnt rubber to my senses. 

The current price of $9.74 for 1.7 ounces is competitive for a high quality cream. Nevertheless, I would not even consider buying this only because of the terrible fragrance. Another complaint I have is that the yellow lettering below the Hand Cream label is practically unreadable on both the front and also in the instructions on the back. They need to change that to another color.

title: I am highly impressed at how this softened my rough heels in a couple of days
text: I never heard of this oil. It is actually more like a white cream and a little goes a long way. I have been using this for a couple of days (twice per day) on my rough heels and feet and the results are outstanding. I usually use large amounts of Vaseline or [[ASIN:B01AASJCPA Bag Balm]] on my feet and then cover them with socks when sleeping. Now I am using about a pencil eraser size of this cream on each foot instead and it results in softer heels much quicker than when I used the other products. I am truly impressed. It is very expensive at $33 per tube but based on the results I am getting, I would buy this.

title: Great as a conditioner; rejuvenated my hair & softened my curls; color protection unknown
text: I love the coniditioning results of this. It did soften my curls a bit but left my hair looking healthy, a bit shiny, and rejuvenated. I like, but do not love, the fragrance. I cannot attest to the color protection properties of this conditioner.

title: Love the fragrance but I cannot speak to the color locking properties
text:
Since I got this after the summer is over, I cannot speak to the color-locking properties of this spray. However, I absolutely love the fragrance. Besides acting as a hair perfume for me it also very lightly keeps my curly hair controlled due to the addition of the product.

I will only be able to tell next year if it protects against sun damage. However, for the fragrance alone, this spray is worth it to me.

title: Glides on; feels moisturizing; color pictured is almost identical to color received
text: I love this lip liner. I received the color called "ride," which looks like a deep mauve. It glides smoothly on my lips and the precision tip makes it easy to do a straight outline. Of course, future applications will depend on how good my sharpener is. The liner feels very moisturizing as well. It lasts the same as other lip liners and will wear off during the day according to use--meaning my eating and drinking habits. I love this lip liner mostly due to its smooth application.

title: My hair felt dry & looked lifeless after using this; predominant aroma is lavender
text:
This is a travel size bottle of shampoo at 2.5 ounces and expensive at the current price of $6.

Years ago I use to use a men's body wash with tea tree oil from Bath and Body Works but that got discontinued. Since I loved the results, I figured I would try a shampoo with this ingredient. However, this shampoo leaves my hair very dry and un-moisturized, even if I add a conditioner. Also, the results are lackluster. My hair is normally curly but with this, it comes out more on the flat side.

The fragrance smells mostly of lavender. I detect other aromas but the tea tree oil and mint do not come through.

Since the bottle is so small, I will only be able to get about three to four washes out of this for my short to medium hair.  Personally, I do not like the results I got.

title: Attractive, easy to hold razor but shave is not as close as a manual razor & it pinches
text:
I wanted to love this razor but the CONS outweigh the PROS for me and my skin is too sensitive for this shaver.

Included in this set is:
-  a razor body
-  two of the same razor heads
-  a plastic cover that looks like it can be used for two different length hair
-  a tiny cleaning brush
- a USB cord (wall adapter is NOT included)- a cloth carrying pouch- an instruction guide

What I love about the razor is:
- the LED tells me the amount of power left
- it is simple to operate with an on/off button and two release buttons to change the razor head
- the carry pouch is a nice touch
- it comes with two blade (razor heads; one of which appears to be a replacement)
- there's a lock feature to lock the blade in place (see dislikes below)
- it is washable
- it is rechargeable and cordless

What I do not like is:
- it is noisy
- pinches when cutting the bikini line and feels as if I am getting a waxing with the hair being pulled out
- it does not provide as close a shave as a manual razor with shave cream
- the instructions say nothing about the blades or the blade cover
- the blade is not seated well in the razor and pulling off the cover sometimes take the blade with it, so I had to use the lock feature to remove the cover

Overall, there are PROS and CONS to this razor. It is super attractive and is ergonomically designed. I love the metallic (glittery) white body and the cloth carry pouch. However, my skin is too sensitive for the constant pinching of this shaver. The only place it did not pinch was on my face.

title: Very nice rechargeable mirror; only time will determine its longevity; can fall easily if bumped
text:
This is a great mirror except that it can easily be knocked off the shower wall.  It comes with a squeegee, charging cable, tape-backed mounting bracket, and instruction manual. I had to charge this for a few hours. 

Once it is fully charged, all that has to be done is to stick the double stick mounting bracket to a previously cleaned shower wall.  Then the mirror gets hung on the tiny hooks that protrude out from the bracket. It can be hung at various heights because the back of the mirror has several horizontal channels that allow this.

In order to use, just fill the reservoir with warm water (to reduce mirror fogging), hang it up, and then turn on the light with the center button. The squeegee easily connects to the mounting bracket and can be removed for use if the mirror fogs. 

The charge port is on the bottom for recharging.

I ordered this for my boyfriend and he loves it. The only complaint we have is that the mirror hangs precariously on the tiny hooks of the wall bracket and if one bumps into it, it can easily fall. So far we have been lucky but we are afraid one day we will break it. Other than this, it is wonderful. We like its recharging ability and the bright light. We also like that it does not fog easily as long as the reservoir is filled with warm water. Note the mirror has an auto shutoff after 5 minutes and comes with a one-year warranty.

title: 18 excellent and soft make-up brushes for a reasonable price
text:
At the current price of $11.99 this is a very reasonable buy for 18 relatively soft make-up brushes. They feel great during use and there are brushes for almost every application. I also like that 17 of the 18 brushes do not fray. The fan brush is the only one that loses a little bit of its bristles. I once purchased one very expensive blush brush that cost over $30 and frayed from the first moment, so the fact that 17 of the 18 hold their bristles is a nice switch.

Only the 4 face brushes are labeled as per below and the remaining 14 brushes that are for the lips and eyes are not labeled.

- face tapered
- face flat
- face round
- face angled

title: Reduced a scaly skin patch I had above my knee by 98%
text:
I had a scaly skin patch above my left knee for a couple of years. I figured it was just a part of getting older. However, I recently developed two rashes on my entire body and had to go through a course of Prednisone and noticed my scaly patch was slightly reduced by that but it never totally went away. Therefore, I thought it must be possible to get rid of it. When I got the opportunity to try this, I figured why not.

I never heard of sea buckthorn seed oil which is supposed to be an anti-inflammatory. I have been using this on this knee patch several times a day for several days and it has reduced my scaly patch by 98%, so I am impressed.

This bottle has a dropper for ease of dispensing. I only use a tiny bit and rub it in. So far I am impressed with the results. It also feels a bit moisturizing. I plan to continue to use this for "spot" application needs when my skin calls for it. I will even try it on acne when I get that.

title: Colorful, simple curling iron for long hair; easy to operate; 4.5 stars
text:
This is a really nice 1-1/4" curling iron best for those with long hair. I have medium to short hair based on my layers and I only got a light curl with this iron. However, that is no fault of the product, it is just that the barrel is wide and I need longer hair.

This is incredibly simple to operate. There are three buttons on the handle and one LED. I just pressed the ON/OFF button and then adjusted the iron to the desired temperature by pressing the plus (+) or minus (-) buttons.

As a guide, the recommended temperature ranges are:

- For fine thin hair, the temperature should be between 255 to 285 degrees Fahrenheit.

- For medium hair, the temperature should be between 300 to 340 degrees Fahrenheit.

- For thick hair, the temperature should be between 365 to 380 degrees Fahrenheit.

- For course hard-to-style hair, the temperature should be between 400 to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.

The 15 to 20 degrees that are not mentioned between the styles above can be added or decreased according to the user's preference. I personally never use above 285 because I have very fine hair.

This iron heats up fast and the LED will stop blinking once it reaches the set degrees. It does take about 15 minutes for the iron to cool down, however. It apparently also has an auto dual voltage feature for worldwide use, although I have no way of verifying that.

The cord swivels which enabled me to easily move around without tangling the line.

The only reason I rated this 4.5 stars is because the kickstand (a.k.a. safety stand) does not stay put as shown in the third photo. It easily falls onto the barrel as can be seen in the last photo.

Overall, this is a very nice curling iron for someone with long hair. It is simple to operate, has a swivel cord, and I love the pale purplish pink metallic color that matches my bathroom. I have no idea what this iron will cost, but I feel $30 and under would be reasonable.

title: Hydrating mask but results are no better than a regular face cream
text:
There are four individually wrapped masks in this package. Each mask just has to be unraveled and then placed on the face for 15 to 20 minutes. There is no cover film to remove from the mask which made it easier for me to just unravel and smooth out over my face.

Each mask is incredibly wet and gelatinous. After I used this and then massaged the remaining gel into my skin, my face felt hydrated. Note that I had to wipe off the excess because there was just too much solution. Nevertheless, the results were hydrating but no more hydrating than when I apply a good face cream. Since a face cream requires less fuss than a mask, I personally would never order this again. However, it does moisturize.

title: I love how hydrated this leaves my skin but it’s too small & fragrance isn’t strong enough
text:
This body butter is incredibly moisturizing without being greasy and it absorbed quickly on my skin. It is a very thick cream, which I love. However, the fragrance is not strong or flowery enough for me. Also, there is such a small quantity. Even though a little goes a long way, this will not last when I use this on my entire body.

Overall, I absolutely love the results and how incredibly moisturized my hands and body feels after applying this. Nevertheless, at the current price of $20 for 1.7 ounces, this is priced more like a high-end face cream than an overall body butter and it can get quite expensive if using daily.

title: Not crazy for the gel consistency but does hydrate; did cause some redness in my face
text:
A little goes a long way with this mask and that is good, as this is a very small jar. I applied this on my face and neck (avoiding my eye area) and rubbed it in until it dried. It did feel a little tacky but not too bad. The directions say to leave this on overnight. There is no way to tell that this is applied as it dries clear.

I did wash it off in the morning as instructed and my face was hydrated; however, parts of it were also slightly red. Therefore, this does irritate my skin a bit. I obviously will not be using this again but I do not feel this is a bad product. Besides the slight irritation I got, I personally do not care for the gel-like consistency; I much prefer creams.

title: Glitzed out bobby pins to accessorize the hair but do not hold much
text:
There are 18 glitzy hair clips in this package. These are perfect for highlighting the hair or tacking down a strand or two. However, they do not hold much. These are exactly like bobby pins with the exception that they are much prettier. There are 10 clips that are easily opened when squeezing the ends together. However, the other 8 required me to pry the clip open at the edge just like a bobby pin.

At the current price of $6.99, these are definitely priced well. Keep in mind when purchasing these that they are to accessorize more than hold the hair.

title: Half-size tiny scrunchies for thin ponytails; love the colors and selection
text:
There are 24 mini scrunchies in this package. By mini I mean that the elastic is a smaller circumference than my other scrunchies so that it will hold a thinner ponytail. It looks almost like a full-sized hair tie but it is not as loose.

These are supposedly handmade. I love the style, colors, and variety (see photo) included in this package. This is perfect for anyone who wants to tie up their hair. Overall, these are super nice and I love them. Although no price is listed, I would expect them to cost $12 or under.

PS I believe each package ordered will result in different colored hair ties based on the fact that the other reviewers pictures do not contain the same patterns as the package I received. Please be aware of this possibility when ordering. I have no way to know if that is true or not, but I do suspect it is.

title: Smells nice, cleans well, but is too drying for my skin
text: This body wash smells nice, lathers copiously, and cleans well. However, it is too drying for my skin. I do not use any other acne product, so it is only this soap causing the dryness. I will only be spot using this on acne since I cannot wash my entire body with this due to its drying effect.

title: Hydration does not last me 120 hours but it is hydrating; very $$
text:
There are four two-piece masks in this package that cost $20 each at the currently published price of $80. The previous price was listed at $125 but they changed it.

This mask is very hydrating. I just removed the thin protective film for the top mask (one with eye holes), placed it on my face, then removed the thicker film. I did the same for the bottom mask. This stays on 20 minutes for it to soak in. It left my face feeling very hydrated and a lot of the solution soaked in during the 20-minute resting time. However, I take two showers per day and it only lasts to my next shower.

The recommended application is once or twice weekly. I personally would never buy this due to the expense. However, it is good for that once in a while hydration especially during the winter when the skin tends to dry out.

I attached a photo of the ingredients list. Note that the mask is scentless.

title: Too subtle a color to be useful; only good to tone down richer hues
text:
This review is for the Cashmere Craving eyeshadow.

It is packaged as a single small bar without a case because this single is for use in a [[ASIN:B07DR9579W Buxom Empty Eyeshadow Bar Palette Case]]. In this sense it is a neat idea because I can build a personalized palette all my own just by ordering the colors I like.

Unfortunately, this hue is too subtle to be useful. I normally use three colors on my eyes with a base color over the entire lid. I figured this would be a great base color. However, it looks no different than my fair skin and I cannot tell I even put any powder on my lid. The only thing I can use this for is to tone down a darker hue. However, after having tried this color, I would never purchase it simply because it is as if nothing has been applied to my lids.

title: Very nice brush blowout styler but brush wears easily & this is best for long hair
text:
This makes styling one's hair as simple as possible. However, this brush/blower is huge and more suited to someone who has long hair and manual dexterity. I have short to medium hair and it was a bit difficult to style. However, that is not the reason I rated this three stars. I think this is a wonderful hair styling tool that makes blowing out one's hair simple as long as the hair is very long.

I really love the idea of this and the look of this styler. There are four settings on the handle (off, cool, low, high) which stay put during styling and are not easily moved. Also, the cord swivels to prevent tangling. Despite these features, I took off one star for each issue listed below.

First, after using this only once, the brush bristles are frayed and out of shape (see second photo). In fact, one bristle fell out into my sink. This means that this tool's use will be limited as once the brush fails or gets badly out of shape, it will be like using a broken brush with a blow dryer.

Second, the current price of $69.99 is way too expensive for this, especially considering the first issue.

Other than these two issues, this is a great idea and simplifies hair styling for the person with the right hair length. If the brush did not fray so easily and the price were better, I would have rated this 4.5 stars. However, if the handle were also a little smaller, it would have gotten a solid 5 stars.

title: A few make-up accessories for travel with stand-up make-up mirror
text:
This is a small collapsible stand mirror with accessories. At the current price of $15.98, it is priced almost $6 higher than their [[ASIN:B07F2F9QZP suction cup mirror]] and the only difference is the tiny collapsible stand instead of the suction cups. Every other accessory is the same. This makes this set less reasonable, especially since one has to crouch low or bend over to look in the tiny mirror on a desk or table. With the suction cup mirror, one can place it at eye level.

ITEMS IN THE SET:
- One collapsible stand mirror
- One tweezer
- One eyebrow or mascara like brush with an eye shadow brush
- One other slightly bigger brush to be used for blush, etc.
- One cleaning cloth for the mirror
- Carry bag for all of the above

The mirror sits well on a counter but it is uncomfortable to bend over to use it. I had to prop it up to bring it more to my eye level and then it was perfect. Since it is 20x magnification, my face has to be close up to the mirror for me to see it. Note that at the higher magnifications, it is impossible to see anything at an angle--one has to look straight on.

The brushes are good. The tweezer is okay; it is not thin enough for super precision work. I'm not crazy about the cleaning cloth. The price is reasonable but not as good as their suction cup mirror. As long as one props up the mirror on books or a luggage, a stand mirror is better in my opinion. However, if such props are not available, this can be difficult to use unless one holds it in their hand by the stand. Note that it is very small for travel and not something I would use every day.

title: Hair styling set for females with very long hair
text:
I consider this a bit gimmicky. There's an insert that says what one should do with these styling tools on wash day and second day after wash--see second photo.

There are nine pieces in this set (see first and third photos), including clips, brush, headband, etc. The brush is very nice and perfect for styling with a blow dryer. The two rollers adhere to the hair easily and the clips can be used to secure them in place.

I like the clips and brush the best. The rest is on the cheap side. Unfortunately, I cannot make full use of this set because it is for females who have long hair. I have short to medium hair and this set is too large to work well with shorter hair unless I am using only the headband.

title: A few make-up accessories for travel with make-up mirror - 4.5 stars
text:
This is a small suction cup mirror with accessories. I actually think the current price of $9.99 is extremely reasonable for this set of six items.

ITEMS IN THE SET:
- One suction cup mirror with a paper tag that acts as a reminder to remove it (photo 1)
- One tweezer
- One eyebrow or mascara like brush with an eye shadow brush
- One other slightly bigger brush to be used for blush, etc.
- One cleaning cloth for the mirror
- Carry bag for all of the above

The mirror has good suction for a temporary installation. Since it is 20x magnification, I had to bring my face close up. Note that at the higher magnifications, it is impossible to see anything at an angle; one has to look straight on.

The brushes are good. The tweezer is okay; it is not thin enough for super precision work. I'm not crazy about the cleaning cloth. Nevertheless, because the price is so low for all these items, I think this is a good buy. I purchased just this type mirror for that price alone.

title: Nice selection of stylish clips; perfect for accessorizing strands of hair; lacks longevity
text:
I already own these [[ASIN:B07SJCBCRR Cehomi clips]] which are currently listed at $5.99. Those clips and these lack longevity in the sense that they will probably break easily and not last too long. However, if the price is right, I consider that okay because I consider these type of barrettes more on the disposable side.

As usual, the picture on the Amazon site do not do these barrettes justice. They are much prettier in person.

There are 12 hair clips in total. All of them operate like bobby pins; they lack the snap-like clasp most people are use to with barrettes. I actually prefer this. These are perfect to decorate the hair. There are four pearlized clips which can be used on a bride's hair. There are two each of speckled blue, speckled pink, and speckled brown. Then there are two small square clips; one of which is black speckled with white and the other which is white speckled with yellow.

Do realize these are small so they WILL NOT hold much hair. These are to be used to accessorize the hair more than contain it. I have medium short hair that is very curly and I cannot get much of my hair in these clips but it does look good on if placed right. They are also good for someone who has flat hair or just wants to highlight certain areas with some "bling."

I have no idea how much these will cost. However, I think a price of $6 would be reasonable for this set since these are not the type of clips that will last forever. I personally like them very much even though they are cheaply made.

title: Rejuvenates my complexion but not much better than my regular moisturizer; also $$$
text:
At the current price of $140 this is outrageously expensive; however, QVC is currently (July 10, 2019) selling this same product and size for $75 which is much more reasonable. Besides the pricing, the other negative is the bottle. There are no instructions on how to get the pump working. The top has to be turned before it can be pumped.

I have been using this morning and night after my shower for several days. It appears to hydrate my skin and makes my complexion look rejuvenated. However, this does not work much better than my usual lotions and potions such as Oil of Olay, which I love. I will report back by August 10 if I see any more positive (or negative) changes and will adjust my rating accordingly.

I attached a photo of the ingredients, the bottle, and what the solution looks like. The amount you see on my finger is what I apply to my face. I use an equivalent amount for my neck.

UPDATE August 1, 2019 - After using this for almost one month, this moisturizer does not rejuvenate my skin any more than my usual brands, so my review above stands as is. This will be my last post.

title: Attractive marbled make-up carrier almost the size an esthetician would carry
text:
This is a very attractive synthetic make-up bag that looks like it is made of white marble. The main compartment has seven cubbyholes that can be re-configured to the desired sized. The top has a Velcro flap covering four small sleeves where make-up brushes or mascara go (see last photo). Behind that is a zippered pocket for small longer items like a long palette of eye shadow. The case has a hard internal shell with an pliable outside marble covering. The handle on the outside makes this easy and comfortable to carry like a small luggage bag.

I love that the zippers glide easily on their tracks. That is no always the case with make-up bags. Overall, this is a very nice case that will probably require re-configuring based on the make-up one puts into the bag.

title: Very nice color palette but I wish there were fewer darker colors
text:
When I use eye shadow, I apply three layers. My base layer is always a light almost translucent color. I then draw an on-the-side arrowhead pointing toward the inside of my eyes with a darker color. The darkest color I apply the same arrowhead pointed toward the outside of my eyes and then I blend it.

This palette has all the colors that allow me to do that. However, since I use more of the light colors, I prefer a color palette that contains a larger selection of those colors. There are only four light colors that I can use for my base layer. I find that this is the same with most eye shadow selections, however.

The colors glided smooth on my eyes and look great on as long as the darker colors are limited. Overall, I really like this set; I just wish they had a couple more light colors for my purposes.

title: Great as a moisturizer directly on the skin
text: I never heard of mango butter before and am only familiar with Shea butter; however, this reminds me a lot of the consistency of Shea butter. It can be used as an ingredient in lotions and as a moisturizer for the hair or skin. I use this directly from the jar as a skin moisturizer, particularly for my hands. It absorbs into my hands quickly and leaves them feeling quenched and soft. The only negative is that I wish this had a fragrance as I love fragrance. It has a subtle natural scent but I would consider it mostly scentless.

title: Nice fragrance but no shine; I'm not seeing any results
text: I really wanted to love this but I am not seeing any results. I sprayed this onto my dry hair as per the directions.  I love the fragrance but there is absolutely no shine or protection (whatever that means). I would have rated this 5 stars if I saw a change or at least some illumination to my hair, but nothing. I even sprayed more on and still nothing.

title: Love the squeeze bottles and small jars; rest is cheap
text: At the current price of $8.49, this is a decent travel set that should last a few uses. I love the squeeze bottles and the small jars. The small jars come with an interior cover as is typical of face creams. The pump fragrance bottles are super cheap as is the funnel, two applicators, and the carry bag everything comes in. Nevertheless, this 14-piece set is priced about right and the squeeze bottles and small jars should last long enough to make it worth it.

title: Like the handle but the blades on these clippers are "sticky"
text: I am a bit disappointed in this toenail clipper. I like the silicone strip on the handle as it makes it easy to hold. However, the cutting blades are not very good. They are a bit "sticky" in the sense that I had to keep re-positioning the cutter to cut my nails and also had to press down twice on some cuts to have the nail come fully off. It does the job but is not as good as a similar toenail cutter that I have had for over thirty years.

title: The cool stone of the Amethyst Roller & Gua Sha Tool feels fantastic under my eyes, forehead, etc.
text:
I already own the [[ASIN:B07HNVF2BR ProCIV Quartz Roller and Gua Sha Scraping Tool]], which is rose in color and I keep in my pink bathroom because it matches the decor in there. This one I ordered for my purple bathroom. It is more grape in color than anything else.

Before I got my first set, I never heard of Gua Sha. However, the Internet educated me. This boxed set includes an amethyst roller and Gua Sha stone in a box. There is a tiny insert that gives a vague idea of how to use this. It just has an image of a face and neck and some arrows to show the direction of the massage I am suppose to give myself. Nevertheless, I like to freeze these tools for about 15 minutes and then use them. The cold stone feels great on my face and neck; even my arms and legs. It particularly feels fantastic under my eyes, over my forehead, and around my chin and cheeks, especially in the summer.

After applying a light oil to my clean face, I then use the Gua Sha stone. I tried several techniques of using it flat, pointed, up, and down. I prefer using it at an angle to my skin in an upward motion.

My face FEELS rejuvenated and massaged when I am done. To me, products like this leave me skeptical as to its efficacy; nevertheless, I will continue to use it simply because it feels fantastic to do so. I feel like I am giving myself a self massage. Overall, this is a nice set even if sets like this are a little gimmicky.

title: Mirror magnifies well;  lights up; but cheaply made
text:
I was going to rate this mirror 3 stars until I saw the price of $39.99. There is no way this mirror is worth more than $12 at the absolute most. Nevertheless, it does magnify well on one side. It's great for extracting pimples and tweezing. The other side is just a regular mirror great for putting on makeup. This mirror lights up, but four (4) AAA batteries are needed (NOT INCLUDED). Just twist the cheap housing to expose the battery compartment (see 1st and 2nd photos). If the light flickers, then the batteries are not seated fully into the slot. Twist on the mirror housing and flip the switch for lights.

Overall, this is a very cheaply made mirror with stand. It feels cheap as well. Nevertheless, it does the job it was designed to do but the price of $39.99 is ABSOLUTELY outrageous.

title: Soap is silky; moisturizer is nourishing & nicely fragranced
text:
This is a nice set of body wash, moisturizer, and a small buff puff. I like how the soap feels silky when washing with it. It also lathers well. However, I do not care for the cocoa butter fragrance of the soap. As for the moisturizer, that has a better and stronger fragrance that I love. I have no idea why it does not smell the same to me, but it does not. The moisturizer is of medium consistency, glides on smooth, and feels nourishing. Once it absorbed, my skin felt silky.

I would order the moisturizer again but not the soap only because the soap's fragrance is not to my likely.

title: Packaging is EXTREMELY concerning & there’s no noticeable affect on aches and pains
text:
I got this for my boyfriend who is almost always hurting; however, this has had no noticeable affect on his aches and pains and he has been using this over a week. If it worked, I would have rated this two stars. However, since it doesn't work and the package is super dangerous, this is a 1 star cream to me.

The packaging of the Hemp Hot Cream resembles Dijon mustard and that in and of itself is VERY dangerous. I can see someone who does not understand the language, cannot read, has dementia, or who quickly grabs what they think is mustard for their sandwich accidentally using this cream as a condiment. This is no different than the controversy with Tide Pods that look like candy to children.

If this was not packaged like specialty mustard and it worked, this would have received 5 stars from me.

title: Silky smooth; lasts all day; feels barely there; provides me with an almost flawless complexion
text:
This review is for the Honey Bisque shade of this foundation.

I have a fair complexion and this shade is just a tad darker than I normally wear. However, it is perfect for summer or for in the winter when I am wearing a turtle neck and the rest of my fair skin is covered.

This goes on silky smooth and is matte, which makes my skin look almost flawless. It is also lightweight and it feels like I have not applied anything. It also lasts all day. Overall, I love the results of this particular shade, brand, and finish (matte) on me.

title: Makes my hair lightly shine & conditions beautifully w/o relaxing my curls
text:
This is a leave-in conditioner that can be used on wet or dry hair. I put a ten cent's-sized dollop in my hands and rubbed it on my medium-length hair.

This elixir s lovely. It has a beautiful scent, pumps out a thick clear serum, goes on smooth, and leaves my hair beautifully conditioned with a healthy looking shine. I would definitely buy this even though it is expensive at $29. However, a little goes a long way. This product reminds me of Bio Silk oil for the hair but on steroids.

My only dislike is that it took me about one full minute of pumping to get the product to dispense the first time.

title: Sleek looking blow dryer that is gentle on hair
text:
This is a sleek looking blow dryer. It is also gentle on my fine curly hair and it feels good holding this in my hands during operation.

The speed setting choices are off, low, and high. The heat setting choices are cool, warm, and hot. In addition there is a cold blast button in the center. A narrow air flow nozzle is also included. Reset and test buttons are on the cord. Note that the cord does not swivel but it really does not need to. A thin instruction pamphlet is provided.

DISLIKES:

- At the current price of $59.99, I would have also expected a diffuser nozzle in addition to the concentrator provided.

- I found it difficult to attach and detach the air flow nozzle provided. It was not easy to screw it on and off.

In summary, this is a very nice dryer and was gentle on my hair. I love the features, I just wish a diffuser was included and that the nozzle that was provided snapped instead of screwed in place.

title: Super strong Indian lilac fragrance; is hydrating & does not weight down my curls
text:
NOTE this review is for the [[ASIN:B01LZQ5LKK L'Oréal Paris EverFresh Balancing Conditioner Sulfate Free, 8.5 fl. oz.]]. Amazon is combining reviews for the shampoo with this product.

I am Ms Fragrance because I just love scents, especially floral. However, the scent of Indian Lavender in this conditioner is intense--almost too intense. Nevertheless, I still like the fragrance.

I used about a quarter sized dollop on my wet hair. I have short to medium-length curly hair. I left if on around one minute and rinsed it out. After my hair dried, my curls were softer but were not weighed down as some conditioners do to my hair.

Overall, I really like the results of this conditioner. I would have given this 5 stars if the fragrance was less intense. I love, love fragrance but it is so super strong that it almost overwhelms my sense of smell.

title: Looks and works like a high-end ($$$) craft fair soap; has a nice rum fragrance
text: This soap is just like the soap purchased at craft fairs. It has a home made look to it and is competitively priced at $5.99 per bar. It smells nice to me. In fact, I did not think I would like the rum aroma but it is refreshing. It also lathers and cleans well but I would not say it is moisturizing. Overall, this is a nice bar of soap.

title: Glittery gold  flecks suspended in clear nail polish; definitely wild and attractive
text:
This is really clear nail polish with gold flakes suspended throughout. Two coats are definitely needed. It is very attractive and definitely on the glam side.

I only use polish on my toe nails because my hands are always in water and all polishes chip easily on my fingernails. In fact, when I paint those nails, they usually chip by the end of the day.

However, with my toe nails, most polishes last about three weeks. I have a funny feeling that this polish will chip faster, however. If it chips in less than three weeks (meaning no later than June 17, 2019), I will update this review and lower my rating to 3 stars. If it does not chip in less than 3 weeks, then this review will stand as is as it is a very nice, glittery polish with bling.

UPDATE June 17, 2019 - I was wrong. This nail polish hardly chipped at all. I am amazed. It is a little difficult to remove as are most glittery polishes.

title: SPF 30 protection for face and neck that worked as good as others I’ve tried
text: I used this on my face and neck right before I was going out all day to a fair and it protected my skin. It is lightly moisturizing and has a pleasing scent. I actually did not have to re-apply it. My only complaint is that this is a facial sunscreen, yet the directions say to avoid the eyes. This means I did not put it on my eyelids or too close to my eyes but since I wear sunglasses, it did not matter. I always feel a facial sunscreen should be safe for the eye area and it makes me uncomfortable to try applying it there because I do not know if this will burn or not. Other than this, this sunscreen works, smells good, lightly moisturizes, and is an excellent price for the protection it provides.

title: It appears to reduce acne but I do not care for the tan thick solution (2.5 stars)
text:
I washed my face as instructed and then applied this to the affected area(s). I did not want to put this on my entire face so I only applied it to my forehead. Unfortunately, I really cannot stand the color and thickness of this. It looks like make-up base and even though I rubbed it in, I could see that the area where it was applied was a bit darker than my regular skin tone.

I did not see the color wear off on to my hat or clothes so that is good; however, this is not for me. It does appear to work and so far I have had no reaction to it. However, I dislike the color and the smell so much that I will not be using this even though it does appear to work to reduce acne. Obviously I am the odd one out as every other reviewer seems to love this.

title: High quality brush perfect for applying powdered highlighter
text:
Several years ago I purchased a very expensive brush (around $30) at my local drug store. Unfortunately, I was extremely disappointed because the bristles fell out from day one. This brush is 10x's better than that brush. The bristles are soft, powder applies easily, it feels great in my hands, and the two-tone bristle color is super attractive to me. Also, the bristles do not fall out during use!!!!!!!!!!!!

This is perfect for applying highlighter lightly all over the face. The only thing I do not like about this brush is that the top section displays fingerprints easily. Note my fingerprints on the brush in the second picture. I had just removed it from the packaging and it had already looked like I had applied powder.

Other than this minor detail, I love this powder brush.

title: Good exfoliator for dry skin patches but product is almost as hard as a rock
text: This is a good exfoliator for dry skin patches but the scrub is almost as hard as a rock. I dug some out of this jar and used it on the scaly patches of my skin like my elbows and heels and it left my skin soft. I cannot say I am crazy about massaging myself with what feels like sticky sand, but it works. I just wish the scrub was easier to portion out. If I shake the container, I can hear it rattle against the plastic as if there is a rock inside.

title: Gives my lips that Porcelain Doll look; too light for my taste but great for mixing
text:
First of all, this says a pack of 12 but since there is no price, I cannot be sure that is correct. I received only one lipstick. Vine reviewers usually only receive one of an item when it says that on the Vine page. However, it did not say that this time, so it is possible the product description is wrong on the Amazon site. 4TIFY lipsticks run about $10 to $15 each so if the price is in that range, then it is only for one lipstick.

This lipstick is true to color. It has a porcelain doll look to it which is very fleshy looking. It is too light to make my lips pop. I can use this to tone down darker colors but I personally do not care for this color on my fair skin. Nevertheless, 4TIFY lipsticks in general are excellent from what I have been trying but this one misses its mark for me.

title: Rich chocolate brown metallic; best for evening wear
text: This is a beautiful rich chocolate brown metallic lipstick. I love how smooth this goes on and it certainly makes the lips pop with color. Since I have a very fair complexion, this is best for evening wear or for someone who has a tan or olive skin. Overall, it is a lovely shade but just a tad too rich for everyday wear for me. I will reserve this for special occasions.

title: Hides the grays and fills in the brow with its 3 applicators
text:
I have mousey brown hair and brows with a little bit of gray or blonde in the brow. This 5-in-1 pencil fills it in. Now to me it is really 3-in-1 but the package says 5.

The pencil tip is to be used for filling and defining. The powder tip (which has to be unscrewed from the center), is used to sculpt. The brush tip is used to diffuse and shape.

I like the powder and brush tips because the powder fills in a lot and the brush blends it. The fine edge is not as good for me because I have bushy brows; nevertheless, it lightly covers some areas.

Overall, this is a very useful and functional brow pencil.

title: Just gorgeous champagne shimmer; particularly for a young adult
text:
I have a fair complexion and this really highlights my skin and face. However, this is more for a younger adult. The champagne glow is beautiful and the shimmer is just enough to make make-up pop or give one's body a radiant warmth to it. If I were younger, I would be wearing this all the time.

I attached two pictures of this on my hand so to demo the color against a fair complexion.

title: Definitely protective, hydrating, and fragrance free; absorbs well
text: I am impressed. I really love this sunscreen. I use this walking to protect my skin. The cream is thick and truly scentless; I do not even detect a chemical smell to the lotion. It goes on easily and blends and absorbs well with little effort. It is also moisturizing and it stays on even when I sweat. This is my new favorite sunscreen.

title: Fragrance is subtle and each bar has unnatural floral notes but the soap itself is good
text:
I love intensely fragranced perfumes and soaps just like I love vibrant colors. This package comes with four handmade bars of soap in lilac, petal dance, hydrangea, and lavender.

The aroma is very subtle to me and seems very unnatural. There is nothing naturally floral about these soaps. Nevertheless, they do lather well. Each bar is softer than regular store bought bars as is expected.

I periodically buy bar soap at craft fairs and they range in price from $4 to $6 each. At the current price of $15.99 this is in the competitive $4 range. However, I would not purchase these bars due to the lack of a good natural floral fragrance. Other than this, they work beautifully even if each bar will probably last about one week or less.

title: Best & simplest iron I ever tried; no temp control & super $$$; fine or treated hair can be burned
text:
This is the best iron I ever tried. It is also the simplest in that it only has an on/off switch. There is no temperature control. Therefore, those with fine or color-treated hair might do damage. I have fine hair and it started smoking my hair almost immediately. I had to rapidly use it yet it still flattened my hair unlike any other iron I tried. After plugging this in, all I had to do was flip the switch to on (located between the blades) and wait until the blinking red light turns a steady red which happens super quickly.

There is hardly any space between the 1" plates so my curls are tightly sandwiched between the two plates once I clasp them together. However, my hair slides through easily. I also love the swivel cord which reduces tangling and increases maneuverability. In addition, the two-tone color of this iron is gorgeous.

To me this is 5 stars but the price is outrageous, especially when there is no temperature control. This is the only reason I rated this 4 stars.

PS - This comes with a 2-year limited warranty. The box also says that it is dual voltage rated. I did not see any switch for this, so I assume that it switches automatically.

title: Moisturizing but greasy, greasy, greasy  & takes about 30 minutes to absorb
text:
This gets 2.4 stars from me. This is very moisturizing but it is super greasy and takes about 30 minutes to absorb into my skin. I wish it had a fragrance because fragrance free does not mean it does not smell. It smells like Vaseline to me and I do not like that smell which is why I wish there was a nice perfume to this.

My hands felt very soft after using this cream, so I loved the results. I just hate that greasy feeling that takes a long time to dissipate. Note that it is a very thick cream perfect for use in the winter months.

title: Barely there shade that is glossy and metallic; great for a subtle shine
text: This is a light copper gold shade that is glossy and sparkly on my lips yet is subdued. The neutral shade blends well with my complexion. It also feels moisturizing on my lips. It is a perfect shade for when I want a subtle shine with a little bit of sparkle and color.

title: Sets my brow without any stiffness thereby keeping my wayward hairs in place
text: I have a brow "mascara" the color of my eyebrows and after trying this, I prefer that. This provides for a light set, thereby keeping any wayward brow hairs in place. It looked natural on and did not make my brows stiff. Nevertheless, I can pass on this because it did not enhance my brows either. I prefer something that makes them look thicker and this does not do that. I could use Vaseline instead of this and have the same effect.

title: Barely there, fantastic setting powder perfect for fair skin with a bit of a shimmer
text: I have been using translucent powder for over 30 years and love how it sets and blends a face full of make-up after everything is applied. This is great for fair skin and is barely noticeable yet gives my face an even tone. I also like that there is a shimmer to this. Normally, I like a matte finish but the sparkle on this is so subtle as long as I do not overload on the powder, that it gives my skin a glow instead of making me look ridiculous. I seem to be the odd one out loving the shimmer.

title: Lovely shade that is glossy, sparkly, and not matte – LOVE IT! Makes my lips POP.
text: This is a lovely copper gold shade that is not matte at all, in my opinion. It is glossy and sparkly on my lips and really makes them look beautiful. The neutral shade blends well with my complexion. I LOVE IT!

title: Too subdued and blah for my tastes; good for mixing lipstick colors
text: This mauve pink color is too subdued on my lips and does nothing to make them pop. For me, this is only good for mixing lipstick colors. I tried their other matte versions such as [[ASIN:B07J9PWGN8 sugar]], and they sparkle, shine, and POP but not this one.

title: Looks like a delicate coral on my lips; it’s a perfect summer color
text: I like a rich coral hue and this lip gloss is close enough in hue as a delicate coral that looks good on. It is not as high gloss as I expected but it a great color for the summer.

title: Too pale to make an impact; good for toning down other brash lip colors
text: Unfortunately, I am like a hummingbird attracted to color. This is too pale to even show that I have lipstick on with this color.  It is good to use to tone down other bold or brash lip colors but personally, this is not for me. Considering I have pale skin, I am surprised it does not show more.

title: Provides a very pale glow; good as a setting powder
text: This is lighter than I expected but it still provides a very pale glow or shimmer to my skin. I use this as a setting powder (like a translucent powder) on my face and neck. This is not as enhancing to my skin as I expected due to the pale shade; however, it does a decent job of making a full face of make-up look cohesive.

title: Utterly stunning, vibrant, & glittery – perfect for a nightclub
text: The color I got is reflector (GGLS04) that is a hot pink with pink and magenta glitter. It looks more magenta to me but it is gorgeous and appears true to color on the Amazon site.  Although I have to personally tone down this lipstick, I absolutely love how vibrant, colorful, and glittery it is. It actually reminds me of a good quality OPI nail polish and particularly reminds me of this [[ASIN:B016NCM0T2 polish color]]. This is perfect to wear when going to a nightclub and is more for a younger woman in her early twenties or thirties. I would definitely have worn this in my younger days as is but now I have to tone it down with another color. I use to be a ballroom dancer and this color is perfect for those performances. I love the hue and the vibrancy of this look. For all these reasons I rate this 5 stars. Those who love their colors to POP would probably love this. It is certainly a "NOTICE ME" type lipstick.

title: Beautiful neutral tan eyeshadow with the right amount of shimmer for any age
text:
I am in LOVE. I always use at least three eyeshadow colors on my eyelids. This is the perfect neutral color to either highlight the edges or use as a base layer for a more richer palette on top. It is moisturizing, goes on smooth, and has the right amount of shimmer without being over the top. I am middle-aged and would definitely wear this.

I also like that this is a pencil that can be "drawn on" the eyelids (so to speak). When the tip wears down, just turn the barrel to release more eyeshadow.

I definitely love this very neutral, barely there color. It makes my eyes pop without advertising "look at my eye makeup." It also lasts all day. Those who want to advertise their eyeshadow color will probably want to buy something with a richer hue than this provides. However, for me, it is perfect.

title: PURPLE LIPSTICK (or bold Orchid); more for teenager or 20 something girl going clubbing
text:
I certainly did not expect this color. When they say bold orchid, they mean it. This lipstick is a bright shiny purple. I have to tone it down in order to wear this. It is a lovely shade but not something a middle-aged woman looks good wearing. This is more for those who go clubbing.

However, even though it is not for me to wear as is at my age without combining it with another color to tone it down, I still love the hue (purple is my favorite color) and how shiny this is. It glides on smooth, is moisturizing, and lasts for a few hours as long I do not eat or drink with this on. I would definitely have worn this in my younger days. I love color and the eclectic style of this look. For all these reasons I rate this 4 stars.

title: Very nice fragrance with a balanced sweetness of fruit and pear
text:
I douse myself with fragrance twice per day after my two daily showers. Therefore, I am always buying parfum sprays. I never use just a little bit.

Periodically, I go to my local chain store to try fragrances I never even smelled before in the chance that I get a good one. I purchased this on a whim because I felt the price of $16.99 plus tax for a Tommy Hilfiger spray was reasonable.

The bottle with the bow is very nondescript but the fragrance is the real gem. It is fruity and pear scented. I personally do not gravitate toward sweet fragrances because they offend my senses, but this one is very balanced.

The price I paid of 16.99 plus tax at my local chain store is a lot cheaper than the $40.99 plus tax price here for the same 1.7 ounce bottle. I would definitely buy this again at the same price I paid.

title: Gorgeous bottle but fragrance smells old lady like and does not last long
text:
I douse myself with fragrance twice per day after my two daily showers. Therefore, I am always buying parfum sprays. I never use just a little bit.

Periodically, I go to my local chain store to try fragrances I never even smelled before in the chance that I get a good one. I purchased this based on the rave reviews. However, what one likes in an aroma is a matter of personal taste. I do not like this fragrance. It smells like a perfume from the 1950's and it is hard for me to describe. I just consider this an intense old lady like fragrance with indistinguishable and unpleasant notes. I will not be buying this again. I do, however, think the bottle is beautiful.

I paid $49.99 plus tax at my local chain store which is about $11 cheaper than the $59.90 plus tax price here.

title: Straightens okay but does not curl; has too many disadvantages
text:
I really thought I was going to like this but I am disappointed. This is supposed to both straighten and curl depending on what is desired. It does not curl but it does straighten to some degree but even that is not too good.

The plates are one inch. There is a locking mechanism that is useless. Although it locks, about half inch of hair can slip through. In order to get a good straightening action, I have to hold down tightly on the wand without the lock. To lock and unlock, I have to press the plates together and then move the lever.

The rotary dial is tight and requires some elbow grease to move. That is good in the sense that it cannot be moved by accident. It is bad in the sense that one has to be careful not to burn themselves as they grip the wand tightly to turn the temperature dials. Of course, if one does not need a temperature change during use, then this feature is good because it can be set and then forgotten.

The swivel cord is a plus as it reduces tangling and increases mobility. The temperature goes from 255 to 450 and blinks in red when heating up and has a steady green when it comes to the full temperature.

In summary, the ineffective locking mechanism and risk of burning oneself when changing the temperature dial during use are its worse features.
