The inability to curl means it is not 2-in-1 as described. It only straightened my fine hair lightly. The current price of $39.99 is outrageous for this item in its current state. I personally would not pay more than $12 and after having tried it I probably would not buy it at all.

title: Colors make me look like I have a bad eye infection; otherwise this glides on smoothly
text:
The four small colors glide on so smoothly with the provided applicator. I love the purple but the pink and orange colors just look horrible on my fair-skin eyelids. It makes my eyes look swollen with an infection. After I put it on, I had to use other colors on top to subdue the terrible look. Perhaps these colors are for someone with olive or dark skin but not for me.

Other than this, I love how easy it is to apply and the color coverage provided by one swipe of the applicator.

title: I hate the smell but love that this sunscreen goes on clear & offers good sun protection
text:
I do not put this on my face because I know sunscreen can burn terribly when rubbing my eyes or if I sweat and it drips down into my eyes. I only use a sunscreen rated for the face. Therefore, I use this for my neck on down.

I really love that this sunscreen goes on clear so that I can put on as much as I want without looking like I bathed myself in a milk bath. It soaked easily into my skin and my skin felt as if I put nothing on it after it dried. However, I absolutely hate the smell so much so that I probably would never buy this as a result.

This is rated for broad spectrum SPF 50 and is apparently water resistant for 80 minutes. Since I do not go in water, I cannot tell if this is true. I use sunscreen all the time due to having my convertible top down any time the temperatures are 55 and above.

title: Feels moisturizing; goes on easy; easily rubs into my skin; offers the sun protection I need
text:
I do not put this on my face because I know sunscreen can burn terribly when rubbing my eyes or if I sweat and it drips down into my eyes. I only use a sunscreen rated for the face. Therefore, I use this for my neck on down.

Unlike what other users are experiencing, I really love this sunscreen. It soaked easily into my skin as long as I rubbed it in. I did not layer it on thickly but put it on lightly and then rubbed it in. Also my skin felt moisturized with it on. I am not crazy about the smell but that dissipates quickly.

I like that this is rated for broad spectrum SPF 60 to shield from UVA/UVB rays. So far this is working for me and one of several lotions I would buy. I often ride around in my convertible and this is providing the protection I need.

title: Left my hair soft and did not relax my curls too much; nice smell
text:
I actually thought I was ordering a moisturizing face mask but this is conditioner for the hair. I certainly have enough conditioner and do not need any extra moisturizer because my hair is not dry and brittle. Nevertheless, I shampooed my hair and then applied this to my wet locks. I left it on for a few minutes and then vigorously rinsed it off. My hair dried nice and soft and my natural curls were not relaxed too much. I also like the smell.

Overall this is pretty good. I personally would not order this again simply because I do not need such intense moisturizing but if I did, this is one of several products I would consider.

title: Fumes from soap burns my eyes and soap itself makes my face all red; free nose strip works
text:
After having tried this soap, I would never buy it. I washed my forehead, chin, and cheeks with this but the fumes from the lather created a burning sensation in my eyes even though the soap never touched my eyes. Also, my face was terribly red after using this. I hate this soap.

The free charcoal pore strip for the nose does work well, however. I applied the strip to my wet nose and let it dry for 15 minutes. I could see the debris / oils / blackheads on the strip.

title: High quality set that needs to be cordless to be fully useful
text:
This is a high quality set and because it is not cordless, it is powerful. However, it needs to be cordless to be fully useful because the cord is not long enough to extend to the floor. In order for me to use this, I have to stand at my bathroom counter while it is plugged in. This means I can only do my fingernails. I wanted to use this on my toenails and feet and I cannot because I would have to be a contortionist to be able to put my foot on the counter. At my age I lack such flexibility.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX

- Storage case

- Sapphire cone to file and manicure nails or for removing dry skin

- Sapphire disk (fine) to gently file and treat nails with precision

- Felt cone to polish and shine nails after filing

- Cylindriical milling cutter to grind and smooth lignified nails; I never heard the term lignified before but apparently these are the woody nails one gets as they age or with toenail fungus

- Needle milling cutter to help free ingrown nails and cut away part of dead nails

- Flame milling cutter to help remove ingrown nails; I was afraid to try this one as I am not interested in any flame (if that what this means)

- Tapered callus rasp to remove hard skin and calluses

- Sandpaper barrell attachment with 10 refills to remove hard skin and calluses on the sole of the foot and heel

- Nail clipper

- Cleaning brush

- Two toe separators

- Soft-tipped cuticle pusher

- Base unit with power cord

- Use and care guide

The toe separators are very comfortable and I like the fine sapphire disk for gentle filing and the felt cone. The rest of the attachments I am unable to use due to the cord issue and, I do not want to use an extension cord. The nail clipper is standard issue. The unit spins bi-directionally (either left or right). The user guide is completely useless. In fact it says to at first start on a low setting; there is no low setting on this device that I could detect. When I press the left or right arrows, I do hear a change but it looks and feels like it spins the same. This comes with a 2-year warranty.

Note that this device has a cancer and reproductive harm warning based on Proposition 65 in California. I have no idea what could be cancer causing, but warnings such as this are unsettling.

If this were cordless, I would have given this 5 stars. In its current corded state, it is only useful if someone else is doing the manicure and pedicure for me. I can use it in a standing position for a manicure but it is impossible to use for a pedicure based on where my outlets are.

title: I don't see the need for this & it leaves black spots on my face; lovely fragrance
text:
I tried these linens by pressing against my face as described. Although it dabbed up any perspiration I had, it also left black specks on my skin. It is highly fragranced. I gave this 2 stars only because I love the fragrance; otherwise, a low-lint tissue or paper towel will do better and without the black speck residue.

There are 100 sheets in this credit-card-sized box.

title: Feels like I am washing with moisturizer but does lather fine and smells nice
text:
Three of the four bottles leaked in shipment even though each was taped shut and was packaged in a box inside another box.

The consistency of this soap is thick like lotion. It does lather pretty well to me; not copiously but enough to feel like it is soap. It also smells nice, similar to the aroma of baby soaps . I felt clean and moisturized after my shower. However, I would never buy this because it just seems too moisturizing. I do not like the sensation of feeling that I am washing with a moisturizer more than a soap.

UPDATE May 13, 2019 - After using this regularly for awhile, this soap has grown on me. Therefore, I raised my review from 3 to 4 stars. I absolutely love the lather and even though I still feel like I am washing with moisturizer, my body feels smooth and soft after a shower. I would actually consider buying this to my own dismay.

title: Fragrant and moisturizing bath bombs with a nice fizz; leaves no residue behind
text:
[[VIDEOID:1ee04c53bc866ae83b782b1b71101680]] As you can see from the video, I tried the lavender mint. It was fragrant and moisturizing, yet did not leave a film on my tub. Also, the color was pleasing. I also like to use these in a foot bath.

For the current price of $32.18, there are ten bath bombs (see below) in this package. Each one is colorful and smells great. I think this is the perfect gift for those who want to relax in a bath.

- Lavender Mint
- Bergamot Lime
- Tie Dye
- Moonlight Roses
- Galaxy
- Pear Raspberry
- Oatmeal Milk & Honey
- Sweet Pea
- Island Citrus
- Tiare Flowers

Overall, these are very nice and competitively priced. This one bath bomb on the video left my bathroom smelling amazing.

title: I love the fragrance and how clean this makes my face feel
text: This is very gentle on my face and leaves it feeling very clean. I also love the fragrance of this gel.

title: Goes on like a paste; smells incredible; left my hair silky; relaxed my curls too much
text:
It feels like I am putting Elmer's glue in my hair when I try to spread this around. However, with the water running in the shower, it does liquefy and turn into a nice wonderfully fragrant lather.

After I let my hair air dry, it was super soft and silky but my curls were too relaxed for me to ever consider ordering this again. I have medium length curly hair and prefer the curls to remain. This conditions super well and I love the feel of my hair afterward but it is the curl reduction I do not like.

title: Provides light curls for those w/shorter hair; best w/long hair; does not have a good counter rest
text:
This is a nice curling iron that is best for someone who has longer hair. Since I have medium length hair, this provided me with light curls.

WHAT I LIKE
- The heat dial goes from 1 - 30; 1-9 for fine hair; 10-15 for color-treated; 16-24 for textured; 25-30 for thick or hard to style hair. (SEE DISLIKES BELOW)

- There is an on/off switch.

- The light is a steady red when it reaches the desired temperature setting in numbers (not degrees). It blinks when it is heating up.

- I like the purple color as it matches my bathroom; although I wish it were a bit metallic instead of just a matte deep Crayola purple.

WHAT I DISLIKE

- It does not come with a good counter rest. The protrusion on the bottom is useless and does nothing for keeping the hot iron off the counter.

- The current price of $55.46 is expensive.

- The instructions provided do not state the temperature for each type of hair. The only reason I was able to provide that guide above is because I have a curling wand from the same company that states the hair types and corresponding setting in their instructions.

It did curl my hair but with only light curls. That was due to the fact that I have shorter hair. During the initial use, I did smell a burning that is typical of the barrel heating up for the first time. This is to be expected. This is perfect for long hair but works well on medium hair too. The absence of a useful counter rest is annoying. Also, the price is a bit steep.

title: Best for long hair where no clip is needed; does not have a good counter rest
text:
I wish I understood what this was before I ordered it. This is just a wand without the clip that a normal curling iron comes with. This means one has to roll their hair around the barrel with their fingers and hold it in place while the iron is hot.

For someone who has long hair this is great. Unfortunately, I have medium length hair and would have preferred the clip that comes with a regular curling iron.

WHAT I LIKE
- The heat dial goes from 1 - 30; 1-9 for fine hair; 10-15 for color-treated; 16-24 for textured; 25-30 for thick or hard to style hair.

- There is an on/off switch.

- The light is a steady red when it reaches the desired temperature setting in numbers (not degrees). It blinks when it is heating up.

WHAT I DISLIKE
- It does not come with a good counter rest. The protrusion on the bottom is useless and does nothing for keeping the hot iron off the counter.

- The current price of $44.44 is expensive.

- The fact that it is a wand really requires one have long hair from about mid-back on down.

It did curl my hair but with only light curls. That was due to the fact that I could not tighten my hair around a hot barrel with my fingers without burning myself. This is perfect for long hair but the absence of a useful counter rest is annoying. Also, the price is a bit steep.

title: Not my kind of facial therapy but I really did like the refreshing results
text:
There is one mask in this pouch sandwiched between two protective sheets that have to be removed. Once removed, the mask is a gel-like sloppily-wet substance. I wish I had another person to put this on me. Nevertheless, I was able to flatten it out and set it on my face. I waited the requisite 20 minutes before removing it and then let the remaining solution soak in as per the directions.

The results were wonderful in the sense that my face felt refreshed and soft. However, I absolutely hate having to go through this. First, there is an ick factor to me with regard to the mask due to its slimy feel. Second, I am not a person who relaxes well; having to lay down and do nothing for 20 minutes other than relax is almost torture to me. Obviously, this is not my kind of therapy. I am glad I tried it but it is not something I want to repeat even though I am rewarded with a rejuvenated face.

title: Concealed my blemishes when blended but am not fond of the applicator & it does not brighten
text: I used this on my blemishes by blotting the problem spots and then blending.  However, I do not care for the wand applicator. I would have preferred a cream in a tube. Also, there is nothing "brightening" about this as it is a brownish or medium tan color.

title: Illuminating and shimmery highlighter; I love the way it made my face glow
text: This is a very light highlighter but because it is has a subtle shimmer to it, it did enhance my makeup and illuminated or gave a glow to my face after I blended it in. Overall, I am impressed with this make-up stick and how it works for me.

title: This chestnut color is great for edge highlighting during the summer tanning season
text:
I actually love this stick because I use it to highlight around the edges of my fair skin before I apply the rest of my make-up. I then blend it all together for a natural look.

It goes on creamy and smooth. It is great for edge highlighting particularly during the summer months when my fair skin has a bit of color to it already.

title: This cocoa color is great for edge highlighting
text:
I actually love this stick because I use it to highlight around the edges of my fair skin before I apply the rest of my make-up. I then blend it all together for a natural look.

It goes on creamy and smooth. I love it.

title: Cream blush that is like rouge from years ago; too light for me
text: This is a cream blush that reminds me of rouge from the 1950's. Unfortunately, it is too light for me and I have a fair complexion. I actually have to highlight it further with a darker blush.

title: Light, shimmery powder that I use to set my make-up
text: This is a light, shimmery powder that I use to set my make-up similar to the way I use translucent powder. Since it is very light, I also have to add some blush on top. The shimmer is also geared toward a younger woman that a person my age. Nevertheless, I like this.

title: This provided a light all-day hold and defined my curls
text: I have find curly hair and used this on my damp hair. It dried into a light hold that held all day. My curls also looked more defined and I had that "wet" look typical of using a styling gel. I personally do not like heavy hold products, so this is perfect for me. Of course, I have to wash my hair at the end of the day when using this.

title: Scentless facial moisturizer; love it
text: I love the way this makes my face and neck feel incredibly moisturized. Also, this cream appears to be scentless. Note that collagen is the last ingredient. It is also made in the USA and not testing on animals. As long as this continues to work for me, I would order it again. Due to the cream being on the thicker side, this more a winter moisturizer.

title: Washes and lathers well but the fragrance is not my favorite
text: This washes and lathers well but the fragrance is not my favorite. The lather is not excessive but good enough. The aroma is hard for me to describe; I think it is the "cotton" part of the fragrance that I do not care for. I felt clean after using this. The only reason I would not buy this particular one is due to the fragrance but that is personal taste only. Based on the current reviews, it certainly seems everyone else loves the smell.

title: I detect tea tree and not much lavender but I still like the aroma; it conditions well
text: This conditioner has a nice aroma and is highly fragranced. I detect the tea tree but not the lavender notes but I still really like it. After washing my hair with one of their shampoos, I used this to condition it. The cream is of medium thickness and it really conditioned my hair. My hair dried with a little bit of a shine too it. Due to its conditioning effects, my curls were not as full but my hair looked healthy and nourished.

title: My face feels very clean after using this but I still have acne
text:
I love the way this makes my face feel after I wash with this. It slightly tingles when rubbing this in and after washing this soap off, my face feels smoother than when using regular soap. It also left it dryer than soap. However, I still have acne. I will continue to use this until the bottle is gone to see if that changes.

I also used the one charcoal pore strip that was packaged with this on my wet nose and it did draw out excess oil. The strip did leave behind some charcoal residue in the creases on either side of my nose but I just washed that off with water.

Overall, I like the clean feeling this cleanser provided and was impressed with the sample nasal pore strip.

title: Highly fragranced but not as coconutty as I expected; conditions well
text: This is a sweetly and highly fragranced conditioner. I do not find the aroma to be coconutty; just incredibly sweet but I still like it. After washing my hair with one of their shampoos, I used this to condition it. The cream is of medium thickness and it really conditioned my hair. My hair dried with a little bit of a shine too it. Due to its conditioning effects, my curls were not as full but my hair looked healthy and nourished.

title: The fragrance is WONDERFUL and STRONG; conditions my hair and leaves it shiny
text:
I feel like I have had a SPA treatment. This reminds me of another favorite of mine - [[ASIN:B000H0SCCG Biosilk]] which I sometimes use on my hair and body. I love that product and this one equally.

I absolutely adore the strong fragrance of this hair finishing serum. Just a couple of drops pumped into my hand and massaged throughout my hair does the trick. It left my hair shiny and nourished. Products like this do make my hair less "poofy" but I am willing to accept that for the shine and "nourishment" this provides.

The only negative is that there is nothing on the bottle that says what this is for. In other words, I have to keep the cardboard box this came in so that I remember this is for the hair. The bottle should contain directions and not just the box.

BTW, this really moisturized my hands. I left the residue on my hands after massaging this throughout my locks because it felt so conditioning.

title: The only thing I liked about this mask was the warming sensation; cleans as good as soap
text: There are four clay masks in this package. I used this after my shower by wetting my face and then massaging this on for one minute but avoiding the eye area. The massaging action is what causes the warming sensation with this mask. After one minute, I thoroughly rinsed this off. My face did not feel any more clean or better than just using plain soap and water. I did not see any unclogging of my pores. Other than the warming sensation that felt great, this mask does not do anything for me.

title: Thin moisturizer that left my feet (and hands) silky with a bit of a tingle
text: Both my boyfriend and I tried this. Initially, he liked this but wanted the lotion to be thicker. I also would have liked it thicker. However, in the end he does not like this because of the thinness. I actually like the way it left my feet feeling so silky and also my hands as a result of using them to moisturize my feet. This is more of a summer lotion to me. I would not say it relaxes but it does lightly moisturize and I do like the tingle and the nice fragrance.

title: A bit too tacky for my taste, don't care for "honey" aroma, but does moisturize
text: I am always trying face creams and I decided to purchase this for $6.99 plus tax at a local Marshalls. This definitely moisturizes and is more for winter than summer because the cream is thick. I put this over my entire face and neck at night. What I do not like is the fragrance, which smells like honey to me. I also do not like the tacky feeling of this product on my face. It almost takes all night to absorb in well or gets removed via the pillowcase; I'm not sure. Also, one night I made the mistake of rubbing my eyes and it does burn slightly. Although I will finish this cream, I would never buy this again because it is not to my liking despite its moisturizing effects.

title: Leaves my face soft and hydrated even on the first application
text: I actually really like this lotion very much. It is a thin cream dispensed via pump. I have been using it for a week both morning and night and my face feels so soft, hydrated, and moisturized. For me this works wonders.

title: This moisturizes my hair without weighing it down; my scalp is also not as dry
text: I noticed Amazon is combining reviews. This is for the deep moisture masque. It is a thick cream. I applied this to my fine curly hair after shampooing and waited about a minute or two before rinsing off. It has a nice clean fragrance. My scalp felt better once my hair dried and my hair felt soft and "airy." It did not weigh down my curls but they were a little less defined due to the moisturizing. Overall, I like this for a once-in-a-week treatment.

title: Absolutely wonderful body butter; a little goes a long way
text:
This body butter is wonderful. A little goes a long way. It rubs in easily and has a smooth, silky feel. I love the orange citrusy scent even though there is no such ingredient in the ingredients list.

At the current price of $25.99, this is very expensive but it is also extremely moisturizing. I have paid a lot of money in the past for craft fair shea butter products that work like this. I would buy this periodically but if the price were around $20, I would be more likely to buy it frequently.

title: This lightly conditioned my hair without weighing it down but I dislike the vanilla  fragrance
text:
This arrived well-packaged so that no conditioner leaked out. There's an internal seal and the pump mechanism has to be inserted once the seal is broken. Since the solution was at the top of the bottle, I had to pound the bottle on the counter until it settled otherwise it was starting to overflow as I inserted the pump.

I have tried several of the HairRx shampoos and conditioners recently and I tend to like their conditioners over their shampoos. Unfortunately, I do not like the vanilla scent of this one. On the plus side this conditioner is not overly moisturizing. To me it is well balanced--not too thin and not too thick. I have fine hair and this does not weigh down my curls. I also do not see any difference between this nourishing conditioner and their revitalizing conditioner. They all lightly condition. If the vanilla fragrance was enticing to me, I would have given this 4 stars.

title: This lightly conditioned my hair without weighing it down and I love the lavender fragrance
text:
This arrived well-packaged so that no conditioner leaked out. There's an internal seal and the pump mechanism has to be inserted once the seal is broken. Since the solution was at the top of the bottle, I had to pound the bottle on the counter until it settled otherwise it was starting to overflow as I inserted the pump.

I have tried several of the HairRx shampoos and conditioners recently and I tend to like their conditioners over their shampoos. I love the lavender fragrance of this one. I also like that this conditioner is not overly moisturizing. To me it is well balanced--not too thin and not too thick. I have fine hair and this does not weigh down my curls. I do not see any difference between this revitalizing conditioner and their other types. They all lightly condition.

title: This is a fabulous make-up sponge set; I LOVE IT!
text:
For the last several years I have been buying blender sponges. I first noticed them at TJX and purchased them on a whim because I just love the colors. The odd shapes of blender sponges allow for different applications with angled sponges permitting more detail work and fat ones for blending. These type sponges can be awkward to work with but I love them because of the colors and unique designs. They are also washable.

These are no different than any other blender sponge I have purchased in the past. There are three sponges included in this package with one sponge holder. Also included is a long-handle tiny brush that I use for eyeshadow.

Overall, I absolutely love this set. The presentation is perfect for gift giving and the sponge holder is a tiny and cute treasure that takes a make-up sponge and turns it into an elegant showpiece to me.

title: My hair dried very soft and felt extremely silky; it looked great too
text: I have short, fine, curly hair and this conditioner did not weigh it down. The fragrance is intoxicating to me and the way it left my hair vibrant, soft, silky, and looking great makes me a big fan of this conditioner.

title: I do not like the fragrance or the consistency (lack of) of the shampoo
text:
This shampoo arrived well-packaged so that no shampoo leaked out. There's an internal seal and the pump mechanism has to be inserted once the seal is broken. It took many pumps to get the shampoo to dispense which was not typical of their other shampoos I tried.

I normally love the scent of vanilla but I do not care for this version. I also do not like is that this is very watery. It has no consistency to it at all. As a result, I did not get the copious amount of suds I expect from a shampoo. I did feel it cleaned my hair very well. However, I did not detect any "thickening" after my hair dried.

Unfortunately, this does not have the consistency, scent, or suds that I desire in a shampoo but it does clean my hair well.

title: Incredibly moisturizing body butter that is just a tad oily
text: I love body butters and lotions and seek them out from Bath and Body, Home Goods, TJX, Marshalls, CVS, etc. This one is very creamy looking but it dries like an oil and feels a bit more oily than my usual body butters. However, I really like it for the winter time. I also love the apricot fragrance. In the morning I feel incredibly moisturized.

title: I love the fragrance of this shampoo but it is too watery to me
text:
I paired this shampoo with their [[ASIN:B07G14PZZT shine-restoring conditioner in the vanilla scent]] because that was all I had available. This arrived well-packaged so that no shampoo leaked out. There's an internal seal and the pump mechanism has to be inserted once the seal is broken.

I love, love, love the coconut fragrance. However, what I do not like is that this is very watery. It has no consistency to it at all. As a result, I did not get the copious amount of suds I expect from a shampoo. I did feel it cleaned my hair very well. I also felt it made my hair more vibrant looking.

Unfortunately, this does not have the consistency and suds that I desire in a shampoo but the fragrance is wonderful and it ships well as packaged.

title: Unless one wants to use a single  or fewer compartments, make-up brushes & other items must be small
text:
This is a nice hard-shelled case that is supposedly waterproof. I actually ran it under running water and it stayed dry but the sides that were in the water felt cold (perhaps wet). I suspect if I submerged the zipper it would leak but I was not willing to risk the potential of destroying this case.

There are 7 main compartments (4 small, 3 large), 4 brush compartments, and 1 zippered compartment behind the brush holders for a total of 12 compartments.

The compartments are mildly configurable. I was able to get some of my make-up in this case but I had two issues. First, if I wanted to get all my make-up in the bag, I would have to remove most of the dividers. Second, because my brush heads and brush handles are fat, I had difficulty closing the case. This is a result of the compartment dividers abutting the brushes as the case gets zippered shut. They would need to make the dividers a little bit lower to fix this issue.

For me, I am not as enamored with this case as the other reviewers are. I need to re-purpose this as it does not work for my make-up as I have many items that are larger (see third photo). I like compartments for a reason and am not able to use them as is and I do not want one big open space without dividers. However, for someone who does not use such large brushes and whose make-up powders are small, this is wonderful (5 stars) for the current price of $14.99. It is sturdy, has a great carry handle, and is functional.

title: 192 cheap and washable pull-apart make-up wedges
text:
There are six packages of 32 wedges each. Each package contains one sheet that has to be pulled apart at certain spots to create the wedges. These work just like other wedges I have. They are good with powder and not as great with liquid but that is typical of make-up sponges like these.

Because they have to be pulled apart, there might be slight imperfections or indentations on one side of each wedge. It was not consistent with the batch I got. However, at the current price of $7.79 that is $1.30 per pack of 32 or the equivalent of 6 cents per wedge. These are fine for this price and they work like other wedges I already own.

title: This lightly conditioned my hair and I love the fragrance
text:
I paired this conditioner with their [[ASIN:B07G1HXS4X frizz-taming shampoo]. This arrived well-packaged so that no conditioner leaked out. There's an internal seal and the pump mechanism has to be inserted once the seal is broken. Since the solution was at the top of the bottle, I had to pound the bottle on the counter until it settled otherwise it was starting to overflow as I inserted the pump.

I love the lavender fragrance. I also like that this conditioner is not overly moisturizing. To me it is well balanced--not too thin and not too thick. I have fine hair and this does not weigh down my curls. I also felt it controlled the frizz as I used it on a rainy day.

This conditioner is pretty good on my hair. The fragrance is wonderful and it ships well as packaged. Even though I like this, I would not purchase it because I do not care for the shampoo that pairs with this. I like to have matching sets of conditioner and shampoo when I make most of my hair care purchases.

title: This shampoo cleans well but is very watery and not super sudsy; love the scent
text:
I paired this shampoo with their [[ASIN:B07G1JHYVY frizz-taming conditioner]]. This arrived well-packaged so that no shampoo leaked out. There's an internal seal and the pump mechanism has to be inserted once the seal is broken.

I love the lavender fragrance. However, what I do not like is that this is very watery. It has no consistency to it at all. As a result, I did not get the copious amount of suds I expect from a shampoo. I did feel it cleaned my hair very well. I also felt it controlled the frizz as I used it on a rainy day.

Unfortunately, this does not have the consistency and suds that I desire in a shampoo but the fragrance is wonderful and it ships well as packaged.

title: Love this flavor and it is extremely moisturizing
text: I use many different lip balms. I am partial to EOS, Chapstick, and some Burt's Bees flavors. This vanilla bean has a very nice vanilla flavor and it is incredibly moisturizing.

title: "Wet" sponge provides great coverage with SPF 50 but "natural" color is for summer on my skin
text:
With a color that says "02 natural skin," I expected this to go well with my fair skin tone. However, it is tad dark (more like suntan) on my skin. Therefore, this is something I can use in the summer. Since it claims to have SPF 50, it is perfect for that time of year as well.

In the compact is a sponge soaked in foundation and an applicator pad. The foundation glides on smoothly and feels great on. The compact is easy to open and has protective cover to keep the sponge from drying out and also soaking the applicator pad.

Overall, I like this very much but the "02 natural skin" is more like a "suntan."

title: Gives me a flawless foundation finish
text: As I was pumping this out of the tube, I thought this was going to be too dark for my fair complexion. However, I was pleasantly surprised.  This foundation gives me a flawless finish once I blend it into my face with a pad. It provides good coverage that lasts and upon which I can add blush, eye shadow, highlighter, etc. It also did not give me acne. I would definitely purchase this.

title: Nice spacious toiletry bag but I wish hook was metal and would fit over a door handle
text:
This is a very nice travel organizer and can fit shampoo, conditioner, soap, toothpaste, brush, razor, perfume, undies, etc. It is made of 80% Nylon Fabric and 20% Polyester. It also has an SBS zipper which is from China's largest zipper manufacturer--unimportant to me. The exterior feels slightly water resistant.

When closed, there is a handle for carrying. The handle is cloth and not very comfortable but it is good enough as long as it is not going to be carried long distances. The front flap has a large zippered compartment for undies, bras, or even paperwork. When unzipped, there is a plastic hook that swivels for hanging. I would have preferred that the hook be metal. Also, it is not large enough to hang on the handle of a door or over a door. This is the only reason I rated this 4 stars as that is a disappointment.

There are three zippered compartments on the interior and three central mesh pockets with extra storage in front of the mesh for larger items--this is the main part of the bag. On either size of the bag, there are banana-shaped zippered pockets that can store very small items such as a toothbrush or razor. Those small compartments have one mesh pocket and two elasticized separators.

The picture on Amazon makes the bag look like a hard case; however, it is a soft case and is not as beautifully formed when full as what is shown on the site. Nevertheless, this feels like a good quality bag. The zippers open and close easily and there are numerous separate compartments for many different toiletry or other items. Although, the carrying handle is nothing special, it is good enough for light transport. My biggest disappointment is with the hanging hook which is plastic (the least durable part of the bag) and is not large enough to fit over a door handle.

title: Fantastic straightener with easily adjustable temperature dial for different hair types
text:
I love this straightener due to its performance and features; I just wish it came with a padded pouch for such a high price.

IN PACKAGE
- This comes with a glove to protect the hand not holding the straightener. It stretches to fit well and feels good on. However, the insert says: "Do not touch hot barrel with gloves. Heat protective glove is intended to protect fingers/hand from incidental contact. Prolonged exposure of glove on heated barrel will melt into barrel."

- The unit has 1-1/4" iron that feels absolutely great in my hands. Also the cord swivels to avoid curling.

- The temperature dial is adjustable from 205 to 455 degrees Farheindt. The dial is actually at the end of the iron where the cord comes out with an easy to read LED. I thought that the dial would accidentally move during use, but it did not.

- The back side of the instruction manual is actually useful; most manuals are not. For instance, supposedly there is an auto shutoff after two hours; however, I was not willing to try that feature.

The on/off switch on the unit is between the wand and once the LED stops blinking, it comes to whatever temperature was set on the dial. It heats up supremely fast and beeps once the desired temperature is reached. I set it to 255 degrees Farheindt. This worked well to straighten my fine curls.

In summary, I love the wide iron, the adjustable temperature gauge, the fact that it also beeps once it reaches the desired setting in addition to displaying the LED temperature. My only disappointment is that it does not come with a quality padded storage sleeve. At the current price of $79.99, I would have expected this to be provided. In my opinion this is a 5-star iron that is 4.5 stars due to the high price and lack of storage sleeve.

title: Great straightener but has no temperature dial for different hair types & no dual voltage switch
text:
I am impressed with this straightener due to its performance and what is in the box.

IN PACKAGE
- First of all, I absolutely love the padded storage pouch. Not only is it elegant but it feels high quality.

- Second there is a glove that comes with this to protect the hand not holding the straightener. It stretches to fit well and feels good on. However, the insert says: "Do not touch hot barrel with gloves. Heat protective glove is intended to protect fingers/hand from incidental contact. Prolonged exposure of glove on heated barrel will melt into barrel."

- Third, the unit has 1" iron that feels great in my hands. Also the cord swivels to avoid curling.

The on/off switch on the unit is between the wand and once the LED stops blinking, it comes to whatever temperature this heats up to. There is no mention as to what that temperature is. It heats up fast but I wish I could choose the temperature. When I used this on my hair, steam rose as I straightened my locks. I was almost afraid I was going to fry my hair even though I did not.

In summary, I give this 3.5 stars only because there is no ability to set the temperature desired. Also, even though I do not care about this, there is no dual voltage switch on the unit. It claims dual voltage on the box, so I assume (perhaps incorrectly) that there would be a switch on the cord or unit for this. This is a very nice straightener but I do feel the temperature is too strong for fine hair.

title: Looks dark but goes on light with a very subtle shimmer; I use it to highlight my eye crease
text: I expected this to go on dark on my eyes but it does not. It is a very light brown and has a subtle shimmer. I use it to highlight the crease and outer portion of my eye. I always use three eye shadow colors on my eye lids and this is the outer one. I love how it glides on so smooth; it makes applying this a cinch. Even though the shimmer is subtle, it is just the way I like it. Note that this does not come with an applicator.

title: Makes my hair look like a greasy mess without much hol
text:
I ordered their [[ASIN:B07FWY38SD Decorum Reform Clear Edge Control]] product, which I love. I thought I would love this as well and I do not.

This is a very thick cream as can be seen from the photo. I tried warming it between my hands but it barely spreads. I have fine short to medium curly hair and after using this it left my hair a greasy mess without much hold. In fact, it is more like a wet, damp, minty smelling barely there hold. I guess the greasy look is the alleged shine. This reminds of something "The Fonz" would wear but it is definitely not for me.

title: Sprays out like a liquid hair net; holds strong for half a day on my hair
text:
I have short to medium fine curly hair. My top is short and sides are a bit longer. I first used this on a head full of curls and was surprised at how this felt like a liquid hair net spraying out of a bottle. It dried thick, hard, and quick. Basically, my hair had to be in the perfect position because I was not able to restyle it into any other position after deploying this spray. Nevertheless, this is exactly what I wanted and it smelled great on. The hold only lasts half a day on me.

I also used it when my hair had flattened overnight. I got the same results but if I waited a bit and then ran my hands through my hair, it actually helped coax out the curls. When doing this the hold softened but also lasted half a day.

Overall, I really love the fragrance and the strong hold. I also do not mind that it does not last the entire day. It does cause my hair to flatten a bit over the hours but not so much that I am disappointed. So far the nozzle has not clogged but I expect it to over time. I have had other bottled hairsprays that I had to get flowing again with a safety pin and hot water. If the hold lasted the entire day I would have given this five stars.

title: These are as good as any other that I have tried, even though they are thinner
text:
I usually use these to apply oil fighting astringent on my face that helps reduce acne. I also use them in the summer to remove nail polish and sometimes blend make-up. In a comparison test with my other cotton rounds, these worked just as good in applying my oil astringent even though they are thinner and not as cottony looking. They held the liquid and were absorbent.

In the first photo, the three 100 packs to the left is this product shown in comparison to one sleeve of my other rounds to the right. The ones I normally use are thicker but they are linty compared to these, so in this sense these are better. The second photo shows one of these pads. The third picture shows this pad on the left in comparison to my old ones on the right.

Overall, I really like these and would purchase them because they work well and do not produce any lint or fuzz. For me, it all comes down to which rounds sell at the better price.

title: Acts like a glue on the hair where needed
text: This is a very thick jelly that I have to warm between my hands before use. I have fine short to medium curly hair. This tames the edges of my curly hair when it is raining and my locks are frizzy as a result of the weather. It is practically (but not totally) fragrance free to me.  I even use a little bit throughout my hair when I want more control. Overall, this is perfect for taming my ends when needed.

title: Love the color of this straightener; did a good job on my curls
text:
First of all I am really sold on the color of this straightener as "teal" is one of my favorites along with purple. Although I now have medium length hair, the top of my hair is short and curly. I fired this up to between 250 and 300 degrees for my fine hair and it relaxed my curls tremendously. Note the dial goes from 140 - 430 degrees.

The temperature dial is on the interior of the straightener and it is a dial and not a button. As a result, dials are easier to "accidentally" move. However, my hands were nowhere near the dial, so I did not have that issue. The on/off button is also on the inside as can be seen from the second photo. Since this does not have an LED, it is very difficult to know what the exact temperature is at any given time.

The tip of the straightener is flush with the opposing tip but as one looks further up, there is a gap between the plates. However, if I pressed hard enough the gap went away. This was the only negative I found. Other than this, I love the color and how this performs. The thin plates are absolutely perfect for short hair.

title: Refreshing floral & almond scent in a body wash that cleans & lightly moisturizes my skin
text: The body wash lathers up generously in the shower and I felt clean and light moisturized when done. Overall, this is lovely and almost perfect. I wish the fragrance was even stronger as it is lightly floral with a delicate almond aroma.

title: Love the fragrance of this shampoo & conditioner duo; shampoo bottle pump needs re-work
text:
I really love the citrusy fragrance of this duo. The shampoo lathers up extremely well. I felt like my hair got a good cleaning. The conditioner is of medium thickness and smells almost as strong as the shampoo. It conditioned my hair well with leaving it flat after drying but I am not as enamored with it as I am with the shampoo.

However, Pantene needs to do something about the pump. I am actually extremely upset because I spent over 15 minutes trying to get the pump to "open" and it would not open, no matter how I turned it. Instead, I had to remove the pump and squeeze the shampoo directly out of the bottle. It is this type of packaging that would prevent me from purchasing this. However, the product itself, I love--particularly the shampoo.

title: This did not leave my hair soft and conditioned as much as I expected
text:
After washing my hair, I massaged a generous 25-cent-sized amount into my wet hair. The conditioner is very, very thick and smells like cinnamon. The cinnamon aroma reminded me of those fragrant pine cones sold at stores during the holidays which have an intense and almost headache-producing scent. There is no fragrance of ginger or honey. Nevertheless, I actually liked the cinnamon smell but wish it were just a little less intense.

I rinsed out this conditioner and after my hair dried, I found it was not as soft as usual when I use a product such as this. It is just okay but not something I would order again. The fragrance is too strong, the lotion too thick, and the results not soft enough for my taste. I cannot attest to its strengthening abilities.

title: Only mildly exfoliating; Welch's Grape Juice fragrance is off-putting to me
text: This scrub should be used only three times per week on a moistened face. I used this in the shower by wetting my face and then applying a generous amount. I made sure to avoid the eye area. It mildly exfoliated my cheeks, nose, and forehead. The scrub is a gel with a sand-like "exfoliator" mixed in. I did not care at all for the Welch's Grape Juice aroma. I am extremely fragrance oriented and this is not my favorite; I feel like I should be drinking it rather than washing with the scrub.

title: This conditioned my hair and left my curls a little more tame
text:
I have curly short hair and put about a 25 cents worth of cream into my hands and rubbed it through my damp hair. I air dried my locks and my curly hair looked more tame than it would look on a rainy day. The smell is vegetal and not Jasmine as described but not too bad.

This is cruelty free and formulated and produced in Italy. Overall, I like it except for the fragrance.

title: This feels like a much higher quality make-up box than most but the keys do not work
text:
Back in the 1980's I received a very large purple Caboodle makeup case that I absolutely loved. In those years, makeup cases were high quality and that one was a very high-quality plastic. Unfortunately, (after about 32+ years) I threw this out about one year ago because the clip lock broke off and many times I spilled the contents all over my floor. I was operating it like this for about five years but then it just got so bad, then I had to look for something else. However, I could not find anything else because every case was thin and like garbage. Instead, I had to buy three smaller cases (one of which was junk) to transfer the items to. See second picture.

When this case became available, I decided to take a chance and order it. I am pleasantly surprised by the quality of it. The box itself feels sturdy; it is definitely not flimsy and it holds enough items. I was not able to get all the makeup from the three smaller cases in here but I was able to get all the items from the two purple cases and about 25% of the items from the colorful cloth case (as shown in photo two).

Photo one shows the case before use as it should be opened. Picture three shows it full of my makeup. Picture four shows the position the case needs to be in when opening it for use. The last photo shows it stored on my shelf.

I like the extra interior box that comes with the case because I can store my brushes upright for easy access. The thin shelves store my lipstick and eye shadow and lip pencils. The bottom stores the foundation. The mirror is a nice touch.

The biggest negative I see with this is that the keys that come with the case do not work. I personally NEVER lock my cases, so even if it did work, I would not use it. Nevertheless, if one is looking to lock their case, then shop somewhere else as the keys are useless. If this box is opened like a luggage, the contents are not situated correctly. Therefore, it is important to make sure the case is upright as shown in photo four.

Overall, I love the quality and like the quantity of items the case stores. I also like the pink shimmery color. I would have preferred purple over pink but that is only a minor detail. The keys are useless, however, but I could care less about that.

title: There is nothing NUDE about this color
text:
This is a deep burnt orange / brown color on my lips; hence the "spice me up" name. There is nothing nude about it. I cannot wear this by itself because it is too dark for my fair complexion. However, I layer it with another lipstick such as a pale pink, etc. and it looks great.

It also feels moisturizing on and lasts a few hours. I always have lipstick come off easily because I am always drinking water, so it has to be reapplied.

Overall, this is a deep color and I like it as long as I layer it with a much lighter tone.

title: Flat iron feels great in my hands and straightens hair in a cinch but...
text:
For the current price of $49.99 I expected everything to work flawlessly on this flat iron but there are some issues that disappoint me.

I am impressed with the feel of the iron in my hands. It does a great job straightening my hair. The cord also swivels and the tip makes this easy to hold on to when in use without burning my hands. I love how it stops blinking when it has reached the desired temperature. I used the 330 setting on my fine hair.

The recommended heat settings are:
280 - 330 degrees F for fine thin, hair
330 - 380 degrees F for normal, medium-textured hair
380 - 430 degrees F for waxy, thick, coarse hair

The fact that I can lock this iron closed for storage is wonderful (see third photo). Note that this is not to be engaged when iron is in use as this came damage hair.

DISLIKES - There are three issues that bother me in order of importance:

- First, the temperature buttons and on/off switch are right where one places their hands. I kept increasing and decreasing the temperature when using this because the action of holding on to the iron when using causes pressure to be applied to these buttons.

- Second, the on/off button really is only an ON button. What I mean by this is that the iron, if ON, will NOT TURN OFF when it is pressed. However, it has to be pressed to turn it on when first plugging it in. There is no mention of this in the manual, but to me this feature is only half useful. It should just be called an ON button.

- Third, I had trouble engaging the iron lock for storage. One really has to press hard and it is hit or miss. After using this several times, I can now engage the locking mechanism almost every time.

Overall I love how well it straightens and how it feels in my hands. I love the cord swivel feature. I like that the LED stops blinking when it reaches the desired temperature. However, the biggest drawback to me is the placement of the temperature control buttons. Since the on/off button does not do anything once the iron is on, pressing this by accident has no effect. It would also be nice if the off button worked. If these two issues did not exist, this iron would have gotten 5 stars from me.

title: This has a phenomenal scent I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE but it dissipates after a couple of hours
text:
I buy men's fragrances for me and particularly love Eternity for Men. This fragrance is right up there with my favorite. The aroma is phenomenal and a pleasure to inhale. It smells great on too. This reminds me of the Bath & Body Works men's shower gels I use to buy before they discontinued them. Some men might remember Glacier Bay, Woodland, Mountain Frost and Cool Springs Shower Gels. I used to buy them by the carload until they discontinued them.

This Eau De Toilette reminds me of one of those fragrances. Unfortunately, it has to be reapplied every couple of hours because the scent dissipates. If the aroma lasted all day or half a day, this would have received 5 stars from me even at the current high price of $74.

title: Very nice curling iron that feels wonderful in my hands & does a nice job curling hair
text:
NOTE - Since AMAZON combines reviews for the same item in different barrel sizes, this review is for the 1-1/4" barrel curling iron. I also have this in the 1" barrel, which is just as good for providing a little tighter curl.

I am impressed with this curling iron. It has a 1-1/4 barrel that provides just the right curl on my medium length hair. The "kickstand" keeps the hot barrel off my counter (see photo). The cord also swivels and the rubberized handle makes this easy to hold on to when in use. The on / off button is to the left of the base of the barrel and the temperature setting is to the right. None of these dials are in the way of handling, which is lovely. The clip is also easy to open and close and the tip of the barrel stays cool to the touch when curling.

The recommended heat settings are:
280 - 330 degrees F for fine thin, hair
330 - 380 degrees F for normal, medium-textured hair
380 - 430 degrees F for waxy, thick, coarse hair

I used the 330 setting on my fine hair.

Overall I love it.

title: I love the perfumey fragrance and how conditioned this leaves my hair
text: This has a nice perfume-like fragrance. I just washed my hair and then applied about a quarter-sized dollop all over my locks. I waited about one minute as per the directions and rinsed off. My hair felt conditioned after drying and was not weighed down. Overall this is a hit with me.

title: These seem like high-quality scrunchies; I particularly love the velvet ones
text:
I really love the variety in this package and am particularly fond of the velvet scrunchies. They also appear to be high quality. I wore a couple over the last few days. I do not have the long hair I use to have, but I am able to use them to pull my shoulder length hair out of the way.

Only time will tell if these hold up. I have purchased scrunchies in the past that come apart at the seams or the elastic breaks too soon. Of course scrunchies will not last forever, but they should not break monthly. If that happens with these, I will update this review.

Since there is no price listed on Amazon, it is hard to say what value is being received for the price. However, I would pay between $15 and $18 for these.

title: 2.5 stars - I DISLIKE the AROMA but LOVE the lather & the way it leaves my hair
text: I really wanted to love this 2-in-1 shampoo and conditioner but I do not simply because it smells like rubber to me. Other than this, it washes my hair well and lathers up nicely. It also lightly conditions.  I love Old Spice products and use their deodorants; however, this otherwise wonderful shampoo / conditioner duo is not one I would buy simply because the fragrance is so unappealing to my senses.

title: I love the fragrance of this gel & how soft and silky my face & neck feels after application
text:
I applied this all over my face and neck (avoiding my eyes). After it soaked in, the application area felt smooth and silky. The gel glides on easily and I absolutely love the fragrance but am unable to describe it.

This is supposedly infused with a broad spectrum SPF 50; however, I cannot tell how that works because we do not get much sun here in the north in the winter. Nevertheless, I am going to assume the SPF 50 claims are accurate.

The feeling of this product on my skin and the wonderful fragrance has me sold even if it did not have the SPF. With the SPF, the current price of $19.07 is reasonable for this 1.7 ounce gel. Previously I paid upwards of $50 just for an SPF 50 for the face that would not make my eyes tear.

title: This bronzer is hardly noticeable on my fair skin
text: I thought this could be used as a contour powder or bronzer over my existing makeup. However, it is hardly noticeable on my fair skin and I used it all over my face. I expected a more enhanced look from this powder.

title: Smells like paraffin; only mildly moisturizing; foot socks are too small
text:
I purchased a pair of Earth Therapeutics moisturizing gloves a while back which I find just okay. Since I wanted to see if I could find something better, I ordered these.

This set contains three "gel-infused" items (i.e. gloves, peds, and heel socks). After using this as prescribed for 30 minutes each item, I found the gel to be mildly soothing and moisturizing but not enough to make too much of a difference in soothing my dry hands, feet, and heels.

The biggest disappointment with this set is that the sizing of the foot peds is small. I take a size 9 shoe and I could barely get the peds on. The heel socks fit, however, because they only cover part of each foot and are open on both ends. The gloves are not as large as my Earth Therapeutics gloves but they do fit my large size hands with some room to spare in the fingertips.

Overall, the soothing effect is nice but temporary. I dislike the aroma because it smells like paraffin wax. The peds also need to be resized. Since I have extremely dry hands and feet, these do not work for me as I had hoped being that both my feet and hands continue to remain dry after this treatment. However, for someone who has small feet and needs only a mild refresher for their hands and feet, this might just be enough.

title: The cool stone feels fantastic under my eyes, forehead, chin, and cheeks
text:
I never heard of Gua Sha. However, after ordering this, I spent several nights researching how to use them. This is not a true jade set; instead it is rose quartz as the title says. In addition, the Gua Sha tools I see others demonstrating on YouTube have one center notch in the middle whereas this has two smaller notches instead.

This boxed set includes a rose quartz roller, Gua Sha stone, a carrying case, and what looks like a silicone face massager or cleaner. There is a tiny insert that is insultingly called a product manual and which is ABSOLUTELY USELESS. It just has an image of a face and neck and some arrows to show the direction of the massage I am suppose to give myself; but other than this, I have no clue as to which tool to use or how to use it. There is absolutely no mention of what the silicone item is for.

After viewing numerous videos, I used both the roller and the Gua Sha tool. I put the roller in the freezer so that it was super cold. I really love the roller because it feels fantastic on my face, especially under the eyes. After applying a light oil to my clean face, I use the Gua Sha scraper. I tried several techniques of using it flat, pointed, up, and down. I prefer using it at an angle to my skin in an upward motion.

I have not yet noticed any VISUAL uplift in my face but my face FEELS rejuvenated after using this. To me, products like this leave me skeptical as to its efficacy; nevertheless, I will continue to use it simply because it feels fantastic to do so. I feel like I am giving myself a self massage. There are two negatives I see with this product. First, these are not traditional Gua Sha / roller tools. Second, the instructions are non-existent. Apparently, it is assumed that one knows what to do with these tools when they receive them.

title: Wonderful, strong fragrance in a moisturizing body lotion that left my skin silky
text:
I really love the sandalwood fragrance of this body lotion. It smells like a vanilla sandalwood to me even though there is no vanilla fragrance in the ingredient.

The pump generously dispenses this lotion which is of moderate thickness. I used this all over my body after my shower and once it absorbed into my skin, my body felt very silky. I love it even though it is not deeply moisturizing. It is more of a summer, spring, or fall lotion to me.

title: This mirror can be hung, held, or propped up on a table
text:
This mirror is versatile in that it can be hung in the shower or elsewhere, held in the hand with the crooked handle, or propped up on a table. One side is a regular mirror and the other side is 10x magnification for more detail work. I was expecting the handle to be flat so that I could hang it flush with the side of a cabinet. Nevertheless, this is very functional.

At the current price of $14.99, this is competitively priced.

title: This has a fresh aroma and is lightly moisturizing
text:
I like the fresh clean fragrance of this hand lotion. It is perfect for use as a light moisturizer. At the current price of $9, this 1.6 ounce tube is super expensive.

My hands feel silky after using this. However, if I want a deeper moisturizer, I have to use a thicker cream like [[ASIN:B000NOYB3A Camille Beckman Glycerine Hand Therapy]].

title: This smells like a Christmas vanilla spice cake to me but without all the calories
text:
I love ChapStick and any other kind of lip balm like EOS. This balm moisturizes my lips well. The "flavor / aroma" reminds me of a Christmas vanilla spice cake. This is not necessarily my first choice in flavors nor is it offensive to my senses.

If one is looking to fool the mind into thinking they just ate cake but without all the calories, then this might just "hit the spot."

title: Surface edge is too small & does not really flatten my hair; also the buzzing noise bothers me
text:
I love the purple color of this iron and how good it feels in my hands. The swivel action of the cord is also nice. The heat dial goes from 280 to 430 degrees and is on the side of the iron next to the on/off button.

The heat settings recommended are:
- 280 to 330 for fine, thin hair
- 330 to 380 for wavy, medium-textured hair
- 380 to 430 for thick, coarse hair

An insert in the package says that the unit will emit smoke and an odor initially due to the oil-based protective coating which will burn off. I detected neither issue.

However, there are several things I do not like about this iron. First, the one-inch wide plate is only 3-1/2 inches long. I would have preferred a little bit longer heating plate. Second, no matter how high I put the heat setting, it barely did anything for my thin, fine hair. Third, I really cannot stand the electrical noise of the iron. There's this buzzing sound during operation that scares me. For all these reasons, I will never use this iron again.

title: Surprisingly impressive battery operated facial hair remover
text:
I pleasantly surprised with this slim profile battery operated hair remover. I always shave under my nose and my chin due to having a lot of hair in both places. This removed that hair with ease. It is not as close a shave as a razor with shave cream, but will do in a pinch. Its extreme portability is a plus.

The package includes one AA battery, a cleaning brush, shaver unit, and instruction manual. My only dislike is that I have to remove the battery after each use as it will discharge if left in the unit.

title: Leaves my face soft but I dislike the gel texture & product packaging is too big for product within
text:
When I received this, I thought some product was missing. As can be seen in the photo, the tube is only half full. However, it was unopened and I assume it is the tube that is just too big making it seem like half the product is gone.

I washed my face with this. I love the menthol-like fragrance and even like the exfoliating properties. However, the gel texture is slimy and I really dislike that. Also, after I wash it off my face, my eyes start to burn just a bit.

After having tried this, I would never order this again as the texture of the gel portion is a complete turnoff.

title: I want MORE MORE MORE - the fragrance is DIVINE but items are too small & dispenser needs redesign
text:
This is highly fragranced and one which is beyond pleasing to my senses.

In a lovely pink box are four tiny treasures:
- "zensational" foaming shower gel - 1.6 fl ounce
- shower rice scrub - 2.3 fl ounce
- magic touch body cream - 2.3 fl ounce
- blossoming hand wash - 3.7 fl ounce

The shower foam squirts out and then foams all over the lid but it lathers up nicely.

The scrub is mildly exfoliating and has no lather.

The hand wash has a lackluster lather but cleans and smells wonderful.

My favorite is the body cream. Its semi-thick, moisturizing, and leaves my body silky.

The contents are too tiny--meaning there is not enough of product. Also, they need to work on how the shower foam dispenses as it squirts out and does not foam, except foam forms on the container from the residue left behind.

If there was more product and better dispensing, this would have received five stars from me. With those improvements, this would make a wonderful gift to someone who loves an intensely fragranced experience that lasts.

title: I do not care for the fragrance but after the lotion sinks in, my hands felt silky
text:
Personally I do not like this cucumber fragrance which smells like old watermelon to me. I applied a liberal amount on my hands and at first it felt tacky. However, after I rubbed it in and waited awhile, my hands were really silky. From this perspective I loved the results. Nevertheless, I am super fragrance oriented and a lotion or soap has to arouse my senses in a pleasant way and this one does not but it does work.

My favorite hand lotion is [[ASIN:B000NOYB3A Camille Beckman Glycerine Hand Therapy in the Camille scent]].

title: I had trouble cutting my toe nails with this
text:
At first glance this looks like a nice nail clipper. The handle is soft and ergonomically designed and the cutting blade is sharp. Unfortunately, it comes with no instructions. It took me a couple of minutes to realize that the left or right wire in the handle is what gives it a spring. I had to use either one or the other by moving it up to the top of the cutting blade as shown in pictures 3 and 4. It does not matter which wire is used. Also, when I tried to cut with the clipper, the cutting blades require that I put my hand at an odd angle. There is certainly an acquired skill required with this clipper.

It comes with a case but mine is bent a bit. Nevertheless, that is a nice touch. Although, I am glad I ordered this, I cannot rave about it either simply because it is awkward to use.

title: Simple basic blow dryer; cheaply made but does the job
text:
This is a bare bones blow dryer. When I first used it there was a burning smell but that dissipated during use. There is only high, low, off, and cold blast. The dryer also has a safety plug with reset button. It is a nice yellow color and feels good in my hands. It is easy to move the high, low, off knob unexpectedly. I did that a couple of times until I seated my hands correctly on the handle.

Overall, it does the job and the price does not "break the bank."

title: Glides on as a peachy / orange matte color for my lips when I want a subtle look
text: This is a peachy / orange / coral / salmon - like color that glides smoothly on my lips. It has a matte finish and feels very moisturizing on. I really love this for the times I want a subtle and less bold make-up look. I add Vaseline or a gloss when I want some shine. It also has staying power as it lasted most of the day.

title: This is exactly the magnification I need
text:
I have a 10x magnifying mirror and wanted another magnifying mirror for my master bathroom. I decided to buy this. It is bigger than I expected but enhances the image much better than the other one I have as long as I am looking head on in the mirror. For example, if I am looking head on at my teeth, I can see clearly. However, if open my mouth to look at the inside of my teeth, the image is super blurry because it is at a different angle--so keep this in mind.

The three suction cups on the back stick solidly atop the medicine cabinet mirror unlike the other mirror I have.

I do feel $15.77 is a lot for this but since I could not find what I wanted elsewhere, I consider it worth the purchase.

title: Washing with this is like treating myself to a SPA experience
text: I love the "talcum powder" fragrance of this body wash. I was in heaven with the scent. It also lathers and washes well. I did feel like it left a film on my body but nothing offensive. At the current price of $22.00 for an 8.5 ounce bottle, this is very expensive. However, for a once in a while treat; it is wonderful.

title: A kit to handle almost any kind of acne as long as you know what to do; instructions are lacking
text:
This kit comes in what smells like a leather-bound snap closure lightly cushioned case. There are seven (7) double-side acne popping and blackhead extraction tools. Included is a one-sheet user guide with a one-sentence description of each tool. I would have liked a more comprehensive instruction pamphlet with pictures of how each tool is used and not just a worded description. I tried several of the tools but apparently do not have large enough acne to make using this effective. I found the 0.01mm ultra-thin needle to be smaller than my pores so it sort of open my pore but I had to use my fingers for the rest and even then I did not have much success.

This tool kit seems to have everything one needs. I think a couple implements (like the S hook or ultra-thin needle) could be used to clean tartar between one's teeth even though that is not what this is designed for. Although, I have not been able to get this to work on my face, I am not holding that against this toolkit. I am impressed with everything included except for the instructions. A "how-to" pamphlet is definitely needed for the uninitiated.

title: This lip balm is super moisturizing and just glides on my lips
text: I love lip balm and apply it morning, noon, night, and when I get up in the middle of the night. This lip balm is super moisturizing and just glides on my lips; however, there is no SPF (sun protection). This lip balm is super moisturizing and just glides on my lips. I tend to like the taste and smell of the medicated lip balms but others might not. I also love the tingle. I applied this all day long and love the results. For the current price of  $10.98, this is cheap but if sun protection is important to you, look elsewhere. There are six packages of three balms--18 sticks in all which is equal to $.61 cents each.

title: Good hair dryer for both professional and personal use; diffuser is NOT included
text:
This is a good hair dryer for both professional and personal use. The dryer is heavy and feels solidly made. It also handles well and is ergonomically designed, so it is comfortable to hold. Since it is heavy, it is not as easy to manipulate as some other "home use only" dryers. My hair dried with no frizz. I particularly liked the comb attachment but I am disappointed there is no diffuser attachment.

WHAT IS IN THE BOX (see picture)
- One 1875-watt hair dryer
- Two concentrator attachments--one with a 2-1/2" nozzle and the other with a 3" nozzle
- One comb attachment
- One bare minimum user manual

NOTE: The Amazon product page says only one concentrator nozzle is included and one diffuser nozzle. A diffuser nozzle is NOT included in the package.

For styling flexibility, the dryer has three "heat" settings - HOT, WARM, COOL and two speed settings - HIGH & LOW (OFF is the last setting). There is also a COOL SHOT button.

There is also a removable filter on the back of the dryer for easy cleaning.

The plug has a GFCI (ground fault circuit interrupter) built in with test and reset buttons.

Overall, this is a good hair dryer that is intended for either professional or home use. I do wish it came with a diffuser instead of two concentrators of similar sizes. Also, it is heavier than most hair dryers I have used previously but that makes it feel like it is built to last. If it came with a diffuser, I would have rated this 5 stars despite the weight.

title: This shaves well but not nearly as close as a razor; it is ergonomically designed
text:
I ordered the [[ASIN:B078SW9JGN Maybuy electric razor]] for my boyfriend and I wanted to see how this compared to that one.

Attached is a picture of everything that comes with the shaver which includes:

- beard shaving unit with head cover an pop-up trimmer head
- carry pouch
- tiny cleaning brush
- USB charger and USB adapter (for plugging directly into the wall socket which is a plus)

My boyfriend shaved with this and likes it. He and I could tell it does not shave as close as a regular razor but no shave cream is needed and it is convenient. He also used the pop-up trimmer for his sideburns and it did a nice job. He was able to wash the razor under running water.

The battery on this razor is apparently replaceable but I cannot tell if the blades are.

This shaver is 100% waterproof & fully washable with its removable cutter head. Head cap is easily removable; just press in the sides.

The shaver's LED display will show low battery, full charge, lubrication status (blade and foil needs to be lubricated with oil), etc. Just consult the manual for what the symbols mean. I assume this has to be lubricated with machine oil when the indicator says so. The instructions are not perfect and leave off this detail.

The razor head can be cleaned by running it under water with some hand soap and turning on until you see bubbles. Shake the shaver head of water when clean; do not wipe. The trimmer, however, should be cleaned with the supplied brush.

There is also a travel lock to prevent the shaver from accidentally turning on. The battery fully recharges in 1.5 hours and should not stay plugged in for longer than 24 hours. There is about a 60-minute running time. The shaver will stop running after 15 minutes and remained shut off for 5 minutes. According to the manual, the shaver can run for 20 days at 3 minutes per day after a full charge.

Overall, this is a nice razor that provides a reasonable shave and has some nifty features. It also feels great in the hand. The instructions are not perfect but are still somewhat understandable. For instance it says the "throw the water" off the razor and "This product cannot be used by physically distempered [sic], sensorially [sic] or mentally disordered, or inexperienced persons (including children), unless they are under supervision or instruction by people in charge of their security."

title: Medium hold pomade with nice citrusy aroma holds my curls all day
text:
This pomade is thick and sticky like condensed milk. Since I have short to medium curly hair, I used about a nickel sized worth of the cream. I rubbed it throughout my dry hair as instructed for short locks. If I had long hair, then I would have used it on the ends only as per the directions.

The fragrance is incredible; fresh and very citrus / orange. At first I did not like it because my hair felt tacky. However, after using my fingers to fluff out my curls, the pomade dried with a medium hold and it was not sticky any more. I usually do not use any products in my hair and almost never blow dry my locks. However, when needed, this is perfect for an all day hold.

Unfortunately, I do not take selfies but I did try to get a picture of my head. The darker pictures are the color with the lighter picture being more of a function of the camera and light in the room. As you can see, my hair looks glossy, curly, and not tacky after using this pomade.

title: It did nothing to minimize puffiness or dark circles around my eyes
text:
I originally thought this was for the entire eye but it is one of those gels used to minimize puffiness or dark circles around the eyes. I tried it for several days so far and it appears to have a little moisturizing affect but my eyes look exactly the same as before using this gel. This gel glides on and absorbs well; it is also fragrance free.

I am disappointed that I cannot use this on the eyelids. In addition, there is a warning on the box to avoid direct contact with eyes; however, this is typical with most (but not all) eye products.

UPDATE: I have been using this regularly for over two weeks and have not seen any difference with regard to minimizing puffiness or dark circles around my eyes. It is moisturizing only to me.

title: "Single session" paraffin bath that requires wax to be remelted after each "keep warm" period
text:
I have been using paraffin wax thermotherapy for 25+ years. I originally owned a Holmes bath (I believe that was the brand name but am not certain) and it died after about 10 years of use. I then purchased a [[ASIN:B004QY719E Therabath Professional Paraffin Bath]] that I absolutely love. However, I decided I wanted a backup to my Therabath and also wanted to see how this Lavany bath compares.

The package includes (see first photo)
- 1 brush for applying the paraffin wax, if desired
- 4 x 200g (about 1-3/4 pound) paraffin wax slabs - I love that this arrived flat.
- 2 thermal mitt
- 1 heat insulating grid (goes inside on bottom of tub)
- 50 plastic glove liners
- 1 tiny and instruction pamphlet

LIKES:
- The paraffin wax are in flat slabs, so there is no breaking needed. I just inserted this into the tub and put the cover on.

- The paraffin wax smells nice.

- It is easy to set everything up. Just insert the plastic insulating grid on bottom of tub and plug in. Make sure the on/off switch is in the ON. position

- The bath's cover has a notch in it that allows me to easily remove it with the finger-hold provided.

- The on/off switch on the side has a protective cover; this is good if using waxed fingers to manipulate.

- The wax melts quickly in around 30 minutes.

DISLIKES:
- Setting the keep warm temperature was utterly confusing and not without some trial and error. The instruction book is not very clear.

- The unit is loud; I thought I heard a fan going the two different times I used it.

- The keep warm temperature can only be set once per session. I could not get the buttons to work after I set it in each session.

-There is not enough wax; it only covers 1/4 of the tub (see second photo). Of course, I could buy more but the instruction pamphlet does not say if there is a fill limit. Also, it would increase the melting time.

- The tub is a bit small to insert a full hand; its more like for child hands. Now if there were more wax, it would be easier to cover both hands, but as delivered, I had to use the opposing hand to "splash" wax onto both sides of the other hand and vice versa. I could have used the brush, but preferred not to.

- MY BIGGEST DISAPPOINTMENT is that this bath does not stay on. The unit has a selection of keep warm temperatures between 127 and 143 F and a keep warm timer function.
