However, after setting the temperature and then the timer, the unit turns off when the time is over. Keep warm is a maximum of 180 minutes (3 hours). Most paraffin baths are designed to stay on permanently and cycle on and off to keep the temperature steady. I have kept my paraffin baths on for six months straight (usually in part of the spring and fall and all of the winter).

Once the bath is plugged in, the LED cycles through some temperatures (probably heating temperature, etc.) and other stuff that is unclear as the manual does not describe what those numbers and symbols are. However, to set the keep warm paraffin wax temperature:
- Hold down the + sign until the F symbol blinks
- Once it does, use either the "+" or "-" to set the desired temperature anywhere between 127 and 143 F. '
- Wait a few seconds until the F symbol is steady.
- Once it is no longer flickering, press and hold the "-" symbol until the MIN symbol blinks.
- Once it blinks, use the "+" or "-" to set it to the desired keep warm time. For instance, if I wanted to keep warm for 30 minutes, I would press either the "+" or "-" until it went up or down to 30 minutes. The timer skips in 5-minute increments.
- The keep warm temperature and keep warm timer are now set. Once the wax melts, the keep warm timer will come on.
- The unit will turn off after the keep warm timer runs out. It stays off permanently, even if it's plugged in and switched on. I left mine on over night and it never came on again. The manual does not provide this information.
- If I want to use the bath a second time, I have to go through the entire process all over again. It does remember the last settings, however, so nothing has to be reset if the desired keep warm temperature and desired keep warm time are suitable. However, the wax has to be melted each time.

Despite the negatives, I gave this 3 stars because there are some cases where I only want to use the bath once in a while. In that case, this is an okay design. However, I personally would not purchase a bath like this because several years ago I used a paraffin bath several times a day due to hand numbness problems and I needed the bath to be ready the moment I experienced numbness. If you need the wax to be ready at a moments notice, several times per day, or daily, then do not purchase this bath. However, if you only want to use a paraffin bath once in a while, then this might be an acceptable alternative because the tiny amount of wax melts quickly and the unit does not stay on all day using up electricity.

title: Conditioner fragrance is subtle Jasmine; left my hair soft and with a nice sheen
text:
This conditioner is marvelous. After washing my hair, I applied it and let it stay on for about three minutes before rinsing off. My hair dried curly as it almost always does and it was soft without being weighed down. Also, my locks had a sheen / gloss to it. In addition, it is cruelty free. I also love the fragrance. Although it is subtle, it is still strong enough for my taste. Note that I LOVE strong fragrances--usually the stronger the better.

My only disappointment was that I had the most difficult time getting the pump head to pop up so I could dispense the conditioner.

UPDATE: I tried this in the vanilla scent and do not like that fragrance at all.

title: Paddle brush works with my just under shoulder length fine hair
text:
This brush is large as I expected. It glides through my fine "just above shoulder" length hair. Also the brush handle feels is comfortable to grab. The outer bristles are not sharp but are not soft either; to me they are like most brushes. It's vented in the back for quicker drying.

Overall, this is a large brush that works with fine hair. I have been using this a couple of days and it does produce less frizz. Also, the design makes it easier to remove hair from this brush, which is a big plus. This is one of many decent brushes on the market but one has to be in the market for a very large paddle brush.

title: The fragrance is nothing special to my senses
text:
Periodically I splurge on men's cologne and eau de toilette because I like the deep fragrance of a men's product on me. For example, I absolutely love Eternity for Men and buy it all the time. However, I often like to try something different. I got this at TJX for $59.99 plus tax because the reviews on Amazon were so positive. I tried it and to me the fragrance is just okay. It smells like a typical male after shave and is not a fragrance I will be purchasing again, especially at such a high price.

P. S. The coach emblem on the bottle is attractive and the bottle itself is hefty.

title: Great brushes for blending eye shadow or using with cream  eye makeup
text:
I really love these brushes; however, I have to use a cream eye makeup if I want to get the product to stick. When using powder eye shadow, these brushes do not hold the powder. This is why they are so perfect for blending eye makeup that has been applied using a typical foam applicator.

I usually put three colors on my eyes. A full base layer along with a dark color angled from the inside and into the crease and an intermediate dark color which is angled on the outer edge. I then use these brushes to blend so that it sort of feather blends all the colors together. For this type application it is perfect. I would not, however, use these brushes for applying eye shadow unless was a cream because I found powder does not easily adhere to the bristles. In fact, based on my experience, I have never really found any brush where powder adheres well to the bristles of an eye brush.

title: Deep red color that is glossy; I layer it with other lipstick
text: For years I have been layering lipstick because it helps keep the color on my lips. I put this on as my base layer. I like that it glides on easily. It is a true red but is not matte like some red lipsticks I tried. There is a bit of gloss to it as if it had Vaseline mixed in.  Since red is too deep a color on my lips, I then add a pink over it and sometimes another color like a black shimmer. Overall this is very nice and I like the gloss. For those who prefer a more matte finish, look elsewhere.

title: Glides on smoothly and is great for contouring on my fair skin
text: I use this cacao foundation stick and their [[ASIN:B07BN1XQXV honey]] shade for contouring. Since I have fair skin, I cannot get away with using this as a complete foundation. This color is more for deep olive skin. However, this is perfect for my application. The foundation glides on smoothly and blends very well. It did not cake up or crease in the areas I outlined and lasted all day. Overall, I like this.

title: This brush does not work no matter what I do; it is complete garbage
text:
[[VIDEOID:f05988dac6fcb1973a29ff449c237d54]] I own a [[ASIN:B01BEYRHBA LumaRx Facial cleaning brush]] which I use periodically. It is a wonderful brush that works very well and is $130 cheaper than this.

Unfortunately, this Clarisonic brush has many flaws and the one I received does not even work. As per the instructions, I charged this for 18 hours. I then installed the software. It required setting up an account and then registering the product. The registration failed because it asks for a lot code (which it says is on the handle); however, there is no lot code on my handle anywhere. I had to skip the registration. I then turned on Bluetooth and tried to pair the app with the Clarisonic. Although, it paired automatically in my Bluetooth "app," the Calrisonic app kept saying it did not pair. I tried numerous times to get this to work and failed.

Next, I tried to operate the brush without using any of the "Smart features." The brush does not rotate when the power is on. That is useless. I tried numerous times to re-seat the brush head and had no luck. I then took a look at the well where the head sits and turned on the unit without the head. I would assume the part inside needs to spin but it did not.

NEGATIVES
- The brush head does not spin. Even though the instructions do not say this, this type of brush should spin--what's the point of power then.

- The instructions are useless. In fact, there are 26 pages and only three are in English that provide cautions and warnings like do not use where it can fall into a bathtub, etc. There is only one line of instructions that is useful and that is to charge the brush for 18 hours for 60 minutes of use time. Everything else is either an FCC statement or DO NOT do this or DO NOT do that. The first page that has a diagram of the product is useful also but does not help the user to get to know the product much more than what part is what.

- The brush head is so top heavy that it repeatedly falls over at the slightest touch when seated in the charging base even if it is on a flat surface.

- This only comes with one soft brush head. The different types of heads they sell should be included.

- No power cord is provided. Yes there is a charging base, but it has a USB connection. That is not much of a problem in today's society, but at this price; a regular outlet plug should be standard or at least a separate USB wall charger should be part of the package.

POSITIVES
There are no positives--nothing works the way it is supposed to.

At any price this is garbage and that is where it is heading.

UPDATE: Clarisonic sent me an email and said "The Clarisonic brush head does not rotate or spin. The inside brush head bristles oscillate in either direction. The oscillation is so fast it looks like a blur. The outside rows of bristles remain still."

Even though I did not say it in my review above, I did try the brush on my face with it oscillating. It did not oscillate much at all and did absolutely nothing to spread the soap on my face. I also tried rotating it myself by using a scrubbing motion and that also did not help because the bristles were too soft. I already threw this out today as this brush is useless to me. My [[ASIN:B01BEYRHBA LumaRx Facial cleaning brush]] is ten times better.

title: Hydrates my face and neck; has a nice orange fragrance; doesn't soak into my skin all the way
text:
I use this on my face and neck and avoid the eye area even though the packaging does not say to do this. It dispenses easily; just twist the cap and squeeze. I actually do not like the dispensing mechanism because I store this cap down and any residue on the cap wears off onto the surface it comes in contact with it. I would have preferred a pump dispenser.

My face and neck felt smooth and hydrated after using this; however, the cream did not fully soak into my skin. I used no more than a cherry-sized dollop (as recommended) for my face and neck combined and even after 30 minutes, my face was still a bit tacky.

In addition to the above, I feel the current price of $45 is a bit much for what this is. My Oil of Olay is a lot cheaper and does a little better job. I will continue to use this until it is finished but this will not be my go to moisturizing product even though it is hydrating and smells citrusy orange.

title: Shaves well but not nearly as close as a razor; ergonomically designed; no shave cream needed
text:
I ordered this for my boyfriend and he likes it. He and I could tell it does not shave as close as a regular razor but no shave cream is needed and it is convenient.

Attached is a picture of everything that comes with the shaver which includes:

- charging base
- beard shaving unit with head cover an pop-up trimmer head
- carry pouch
- tiny cleaning brush
- USB charger (I had to use a separate USB adapter similar like [[ASIN:B01BYO79UE this]] to plug it into a wall socket). Most people have one in their homes due to having Smartphones that need charging. However, if you do not, you will need to buy one or use your computer to charge this.

I found it difficult to seat the USB charger into the recharge stand (a.k.a. charging base). I had to use a lot of strength for that. However, I only needed to do it once because it is going to remain attached.

This shaver has a 3-blade cutting system and is 100% waterproof & fully washable with its removable cutter head. My boyfriend also used the pop-up trimmer for his sideburns and it did a nice job. You can hear the blades cutting. The beard trimmer should be lubricated with machine oil every month and the trimmer every 6 months.

There is also a travel lock to prevent the shaver from accidentally turning on. The battery fully recharges in less than 2 hours (1.5 hours according to the box). There is about a 50-minute running time.

It also has automatic global voltage. I never heard of this but I assume it means that if we travel out of the country and use one of the USB connectors to the country's 220v system, it will automatically adjust and charge the unit.

Overall, this is a nice razor that provides a reasonable shave and has some nifty features. It also feels great in the hand.

title: Strongly scented, lightly moisturizing hand lotion perfect for summer
text:
I love the scent of this lotion. It has a strong orange aroma mixed with what they call cedar wood. This combination is very attractive to me.

The lotion is on the thin side and perfect for summer. It is lightly moisturizing and contains glycerin as second ingredient and Shea butter as the eighth ingredient. It does dry a little greasy but I do not mind that too much since after about 10 minutes it soaks in and my hands felt very silky.

I do feel the current price of $17.50 is a tad expensive for this 5.9 ounce pump lotion. Nevertheless, it does moisturize and the strong fragrance speaks to me.

title: This really warms, cleanses, and exfoliates my face leaving a very smooth finish
text:
Despite what the picture on Amazon shows, there is one 3.4 fluid ounce tube of this charcoal warming cleanser. I was not sure I was going to like this but I love it.

The dark gray charcoal dispenses like toothpaste. As per the instructions, I massaged this mildly aromatic cleanser onto my wet face (avoiding the eye area) and I could feel the sandy particles gently exfoliating my skin. It also warmed up my face immediately but not too hot. I experienced no irritation, which is great. After thoroughly cleaning my face, I rinsed it off. My skin felt immensely clean and soft.

Currently no price is posted on Amazon, but if the cost was reasonable, I would definitely purchase this once I use up this tube.

title: This lotion is thin & perfect for summer; it dries to a silky soft finish; however, the coconut fragrance is chemical smelling
text: I ordered the Coconut Beach scented body lotion. The lotion is thin and glides on easily. It also absorbs well and dries to a silky soft finish. Unfortunately, the coconut smell is more chemical in fragrance to me than fresh coconut. Since I am really hooked on fragrance, this is the only reason I rated this 3 stars. Other than this it is a good summer body lotion.

title: This top coat dries to more of a matte than glossy finish but has the non-chipping power of my favorite top coat
text:
The best top coat I have ever used in my life is [[ASIN:B000EVGQ8U Out The Door Top Coat]], which I have applied on my nails for the last 20+ years. Therefore, I decided to compare this Paris & Vine brand with that one. The first picture shows my left hand with this Paris & Vine top coat and the second picture has "OutTheDoor" top coat on it. The difference is not as visible in pictures but in person it is obvious.

This top coat is not as glossy as the other and dries to a more matte-looking finish. The staying / non-chipping power is about the same. However, considering this is three dollars higher in price plus the fact that it really is not as glossy, I would choose my other brand over this one. It works but it does not beat the best. If the price were equivalent, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: If the temperature dial would stay put, then this curling iron would be fine but the current design is flawed
text:
What I like is that the iron is easy to hold and the "curling wand" and base have "dimples" or nodules on which the curling iron rests when hot. This helps keep it from touching the counter. The tip is also cool to the touch when in use.

Besides an on/off switch there is a turbo button that allowed me to increase the temperature a bit. To me this turbo button is unnecessary, but I guess some will like it. The biggest problem I have with this curling iron is the temperature dial. The dial is at the base of the wand and when I am in the process of curling my hair, the dial has a tendency to move simply because my thumb comes to rest on it. This means the temperature is always fluctuating. I think others will have the same problem.

This iron also comes with a thin sleeve for the wand that is made out of felt-like material. It is cheap but it is still a nice touch. If the temperature dial placement was better designed, I would have rated this iron 4 stars.

title: This lotion is firming but I do not like the initial burning sensation or the fragrance
text: I applied this lotion to my clean face after using their cleansing oil and treatment bar ([[ASIN:B071Z8PW9G both ordered separately]]). This lotion has a mild burning sensation on my face and I do not like the fragrance. Nevertheless, my face felt incredible and firm. It was also smooth and soft as a result of using this lotion in combination with their cleansing regimen that came with the travel set I ordered.  If the fragrance of the lotion were better, even with the mild burning sensation, I would have loved this. However, even if I loved this, the current price of $68 is so outrageous that I probably would not purchase it at that price.

title: I love the treatment bar that exfoliated my face and resulted in a smooth finish; all other items I could pass on
text:
I absolutely love the fragrance of the facial cleansing travel set. This comes packaged in a plastic slide out case with its own soap caddy complete with drip holes. There are three items in the package but that is only part of the recommended cleansing ritual.

There's a 2 ounce bottle of cleansing oil, one 1.7 ounce treatment bar, and one single-use sample of the emulsion serum. The insert instructions say to use the cleansing oil first, followed by washing the face and neck with the treatment bar, then applying the [[ASIN:B079H6TR8F Essence Lotion]] (not included), followed by the serum (one use and it is done).

I used the cleansing oil as a pre-wash and then rinsed off my face. I then lathered up with the treatment bar. I love, love, love the bar. The highly perfumed fragrance is intoxicating to me and the bar has a slight abrasiveness to it that exfoliates the skin. After rinsing off, I applied the [[ASIN:B079H6TR8F Essence Lotion]] (which I ordered separately), followed by the serum. Even though there was no mention of avoiding the eye area, I still avoided that area.

The only thing I really love in this set is the treatment bar. The other items I could do without. The lotion (not included) has a mild burning sensation on my face and I do not like the fragrance. The serum also produces a mild burning sensation and I also do not like the fragrance. Nevertheless, my face felt incredible after the lotion and serum absorbed into my skin - it was very smooth and soft. If the fragrance of the lotion and serum were better, even with the mild burning sensation, I would have loved that. However, I feel it is the exfoliating treatment bar that is the super star in this travel set.

On another note, the current price of $30 is outrageous for what this is.

title: $16 for all packaging and "short lasting" greasy lip moisturizing
text:
This product completely offends me. First, it is all packaging. There are six sleeves of lip moisturizing shields that come in a large flat envelope similar to a super large Band-Aid or piece of gauze.

Inside each package is one tiny moisturized lip cover. I tried one and left it on for five minutes as instructed. It was greasy and I had to "purse" my lips to keep it from falling off even after I pressed down on the thin layer. It has a nice caramel aroma. After my time was up, I removed the "greasy paper" and threw it out. My lips remained greasy and very moisturized for less than one hour until I had to apply lip balm.

After having tried this, I would never purchase this. Not only is this horrendously expensive but it is all packaging. All six greasy sheets would fit in a package the size of a regular Band-Aid. My recommendation is to buy several tubes of lip balm that can be reapplied as often as necessary instead The only thing I feel this is useful for is for First Aid when one gets lost in the desert and emergency services needs to re-hydrate parched lips in a one-application sort of way.

title: Adds shimmer to my lips & an attractive transparent pearlized white color; also moisturizes as good as their non-shimmer balms
text: I love EOS lip balms. I have over 10 of them. This one takes it to the next level. I love that it has a pearlized color to it that does not hide the lips but only enhances them with shimmery bits. The balm also glides smoothly on the lips. This can be used to tone down lipstick as well because it adds just a hint of transparent white to the lipstick that is almost imperceptible. In my opinion, this is another great, moisturizing lip balm from EOS in really cool black "vented" packaging.

title: This "tamed the itch" a little bit but is too medicinal for my preference
text:
Amazon is now developing their own brand of products, from dog food to dandruff shampoo, under the name Solimo. I use [[ASIN:B072J8H5G2 Mountain Falls Dandruff Shampoo]] periodically and wanted to see how the Solimo brand compared to this one.

It lathers and washes well but the fragrance reminds me of a paint thinner. Also, all the warnings on the bottle scare me a bit (see below). This "tamed the itch" slightly but is not a shampoo I would ever purchase for myself due to the aroma and the warnings that are not mentioned on my [[ASIN:B072J8H5G2 Mountain Falls Dandruff Shampoo]].

This also appears to be more than just a dandruff shampoo as the back label says this is also used to control the symptoms of seborrheic dermatitis and psoriasis.

WARNINGS

- Do not get into eyes.

- Use caution when exposing skin to sunlight after applying this product as it can increase risk of sunburn.

- Do not use for prolonged periods without consulting a doctor.

- Do not use with other forms of psoriasis therapy such as ultraviolet radiation or prescription drugs unless directed to do so by a doctor.

- In rare instances, discoloration of gray, blonde, bleached, or tinted hair may occur.

title: Lightly muted cherry red with nice shine and easy application; I really like this lipstick
text: I really like this lipstick. The cherry red is not super rich which is what I prefer, so in that sense it is lighter than I expected ti to be. Also, it has a nice shine, goes on smoothly, and stays put. It also feels moisturizing to my lips. If I want to mute the color, I combine it with another lipstick. Overall, I am pleased. I would definitely purchase this brand if I were in the market for more lipstick in this or other colors.

title: Love how soft my skin felt after I dried off but absolutely hate the film left behind on my body & how this dispenses
text:
I wanted to love this but after trying it, I would not order this again. What I love is the fragrance and its ability to leave my skin soft once I dry off. The lather is okay but not great; I like lots of suds but I do not get it with this soap. What I hate is how this dispenses like shave cream. Before each use I had to shake the can. The first time I almost broke the top off because I did not realize I had to press the smaller button. I thought it was dispensed by pressing on the large nozzle like one would a whipped cream can.

After I was done showering with this, my body felt like it was covered in a film. This is what I hate the most. I am also skeptical how long each can will last.

title: Cleans and lathers well but smells like liquid plastic and for that reason only I dislike it
text: I expect three things from a body wash. It has to smell incredibly good, clean effectively, and produce a good lather.  This cleans effectively and produces a good lather but the fragrance smells like liquid plastic. After having tried this, I would never buy it. A wonderfully fragrant body wash causes me to rejoice in the shower. This body wash makes me dread my shower only because of the "plasticky" aroma.

title: I love this as a shampoo and body wash only; the price is too $$$, and the packaging (bottle) can pose a danger
text:
This bottle arrived in a plastic pouch with 1/4 of the product missing and all over the inside of the envelope. Redken needs to secure the full top like a wine bottle so that the contents do not unscrew and spill out. Also, this is only 10 fluid ounces and not 10.1 ounces as stated on Amazon.

This is a shampoo, conditioner, and body wash in one. I do not feel it conditions but it is a lovely body wash and shampoo. I adore the typical male fragrance that smells like after shave. It also lathers up nicely and left me feeling clean all over.

The current price of $14 for this size bottle is outrageous in my opinion. I would personally not pay that. I also do not like that it looks exactly like a bottle of beer. Someone who cannot read or is highly inebriated may try to drink this. I think this is dangerous. It is for both these reasons that I rate this 3 stars. Other than this, I love it as a body wash and shampoo but its conditioning effects are not evident to me. I know this is marketed as a man's product but I gravitate toward men's fragrances, body washes, and underarm deodorants such as Old Spice. In my opinion, this is good for a woman too.

title: I love the incredible orange tangerine fragrance and it moisturizes well and light enough for summer
text: I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the  orange tangerine fragrance of this face moisturizer. I used this all over my face and it was light going on and kept me moisturized all day. It is creamy but light enough for summer. The only reason I removed one star from my review is because it does take awhile for the lotion to sink in and my face felt a bit tacky. Nevertheless, the fragrance and moisturizing abilities have sold me. When I need more face and neck moisturizer, I would definitely consider purchasing this as one of several other options I love.

title: This has a very nice "after shave" like aroma and lasts most of the day
text: I like this fragrance. I often buy men's fragrances for me because most women's fragrances just do not work well for me or are too sweet. This smells like "after shave"  and has a nice aroma. I am definitely going to enjoy wearing this even if it is made for a man. It lasted most of the day for me.

title: This fragrance smells like a scent from years ago that old ladies use to wear; not enticing to me
text: This perfume comes in a nice bottle but the fragrance is just okay. It reminds me of a scent an old lady would wear from years ago. I wish I could describe it but I cannot. The scent holds for about a half day. I would not order this fragrance again as it is not enticing to me.

title: I ordered this as part of a recipe for making body butter; it's moisturizing and will last a long time.
text:
I ordered this to use as part of a recipe for making body butter. It is very moisturizing.

Body Butter recipe:
- In a Pyrex glass bowl add 1 cup of Shea butter ([[ASIN:B0186TDM1U unrefined]] or [[ASIN:B01MG1KC41 refined]] - depends on smell preference). Unrefined smells not so nice and refined has no smell.
- Melt above in a steamer or over a double boiler.
- Once melted add in 1 cup of coconut oil (such as [[ASIN:B077XW2LKS Vita Coco Organic Virgin Coconut Oil]])
- 1 tablespoon of [[ASIN:B01AYG74DK Jojoba Oil]]
- 2 tablespoons of this [[ASIN:B077BK3XH3 glycerin]]
- Melt again and mix together
- Chill over a container of ice and then put in the freezer for 10-20 minutes
- Remove from freezer and add an essential oil of choice if desired (such as [[ASIN:B000W3VD6K sweet orange]] or [[ASIN:B00181A96A bergamot]]) - Note that the fragrance of the essential oil will not be noticeable if using [[ASIN:B0186TDM1U unrefined Shea butter]] because the smell of it overpowers the oil.
- Scrap sides of glass dish to remove any solution that has set and use a hand mixer to whip it up into the consistency of whipped cream with stiff peaks.
- Scoop into jars for storage and later use.

The resulting butter is very moisturizing, somewhat greasy, but soaks into the skin. Glycerin has other uses besides making body butter. There are other recipes on the Internet. As an ingredient in my body butter recipe, this 32 ounce bottle will take me a long time to use up.

Attached are two pictures. The first photo shows the container of ice that I put underneath the butter and the second picture shows the finished product.

title: I cannot stand the smell of unrefined Shea butter; otherwise this is good Shea butter
text:
I purchased this to use as part of a recipe for making body butter. Although this Shea butter is very moisturizing, I cannot stand the "burnt tobacco" smell and that "fragrance" overpowers any essential oil I add to my recipe.

From now on, I am purchasing the [[ASIN:B01MG1KC41 refined Shea butter]] instead. There is nothing wrong with this Shea butter as all unrefined Shea butters smell like this. It is just because of the smell that I will not be purchasing this again. Otherwise this is great Shea butter and very moisturizing.

title: This body soap is like washing with dessert; it lathers and cleans well and moisturizers too
text:
This body wash lathers copiously, cleans well, and leaves my skin smooth and soft. However, the fragrance is too decadent for me. I love an intense aroma but this one is like washing with dessert.

I purchased this at Walmart on one of those impulse buys to try something new. Although I sniffed it before purchasing, I was surprised that it is more intense during use. If it smelled flowery instead of sweet, I would have loved it. I will not purchase this again.

title: Great lather, intensely moisturizers, and cleans well but it STINKS!
text: I love Method body washes because they lather up better than most shower gels on the market. This lathers copiously, cleans well, intensely moisturizers, but smells terrible. The scent reminds me of a stale dishcloth. The aroma is light but it is enough to be off-putting. This body wash is exceptional in every other way but this. I canceled my subscription due to the scent. If it had a good aroma, I would continue to buy this. I will use what I have because the scent does not linger after the shower is over, but the shower is less enjoyable with a scent such as this.

title: Strong citrus (lemony) fresh fragrance in a body wash that feels moisturizing and leaves my body feeling clean and soft but $$$
text:
I love the strong citrus (lemony) freshness of this body wash. It lathers pretty well and feels moisturizing. This left my body feeling clean and smooth. It is extremely expensive at the current price of $8.49. I paid $7.70 with subscribe and save due to ordering many subscribe and save items. Nevertheless, it is not cheap. This tube only lasts me five days (that's 10 washes at 2 showers per day) so I'll have to rethink whether or not I am ordering this again simply because of the price. There are other body washes I love that are less expensive such as some Method body washes that I get at CVS. There are others that are equally expensive but which provide me with a more intoxicating wash experience and more product such as [[ASIN:B071D6WFTN SheaMoisture Coconut & Hibiscus Body Wash & Deep Moisturizing Lotion]].

Waleda is made in Switzerland.

title: Moisturized my face and neck generously but does not absorb quickly; I love the clean smell
text:
I applied this on my face and neck and avoided my eye area since there was no mention if I could use this for that area. The cream is semi-thick with a subtle clean fragrance that is attractive to me. This moisturized my face extensively and since I have dry skin, that is perfect. However, what I really do not like about this face cream is that it feels tacky on my face and neck for hours and does not absorb into the skin easily. Only after I woke up in the morning was the tackiness gone and that was probably because it was wiped off by my pillowcases. If it were not for this, then I would like this as a winter face and neck moisturizer.

A thin plastic applicator that looks like a small boomerang is included but I found it useless since it is flat. I just used my fingertips to gather and apply the moisturizer.

title: This rotating brush allowed me to apply my foundation flawlessly but it comes with a few caveats
text:
I use a cream base instead of a liquid base. I believe this would work easier with a liquid base; nevertheless, I like how this blends my foundation flawlessly. There are three negatives that I see in the order of importance to me.

First, at the current price of $69, this brush is extremely expensive for applying foundation.

Second, as I got near my hairline, the brush kept grabbing my hair and twirling it around the tip. It is best to cinch the hair back when using.

Third, the battery used is not standard. It's a Lithium 3.0V 2/3A Size CR123A.

The battery and semi-hard case are included. This brush really worked nicely for me.

title: Nice woodsy men's fragrance that I like wearing but the aroma lasts only one-half day on me
text:
I love men's fragrances and wear Eternity for men a lot (even though I'm a woman). This spray has a nice woodsy aroma that reminds me of the now discontinued Woodland Men's Shower Gel from Bath and Body. I like this fragrance but the aroma lasts only about half a day. I would have expected it to last longer since men's products tend to have "staying power."

The black misty bottle with the black bow is super attractive.

title: This razor gave me a fantastic shave and the handle is gorgeous but it is too short and very expensive
text:
I regularly use a [[ASIN:B06X9M4579 Gillette ProGlide Power Razor]]. I also have the [[ASIN:B06X9SLLS4 Gillette Fusion ProShield]] and regular [[ASIN:B06X9PM3GJ Gillette ProGlide]].

I dislike women's razors and always use a man's razor because they shave my hair better. Therefore, I was ecstatic to get the opportunity to try this elegant razor. The blade does not appear to be any different than my other 5-blades. I was able to use my own blades on this handle as well as they are interchangeable.

I got a great shave all over my body. I do shave under my nose and chin as well and this worked as good as my other razors. However, the handle (which is really what this razor is about) is about 1/2 to 1 inch too short. I found this difficult to hold unlike my other cheaper razors. Since my hands are smaller than a man's, I would think men would find the handle even shorter than I do. Also, this handle is costly at the current price of $90.16. Yes it is a gorgeous handle but I need it to be a little longer. If the handle was longer, I would have rated this 4 stars with 1 star off for the steep price.

In summary, this gave a great shave but the handle is too short and the price too expensive for such a short handle. The box it comes in is okay but nothing great as the inside packaging is cheap.

UPDATE April 8, 2018 - My boyfriend tried this razor and said it was okay. He said the handle was not heavy enough or long enough for him. He got a good shave from the blade but overall there was nothing that would compel him to buy this as it is just okay. He likes his Gillette Fusion better.

title: The best hand moisturizer around; leaves my hands silky smooth every time and smells great too!
text:
I have been a devoted fan of this glycerine hand therapy since the 1990s and have been purchasing it since. There is rarely a lotion that comes close to soothing dry, cracked, or chapped hands--except for the one mentioned in the comments section of my review. I have tried all their fragrances and this Camille scent is my favorite. In fact, except for the [[ASIN:B000LUXO2K Rosewater]] scent, there is no other version of this therapy I like. Nevertheless, the lotion works stupendously no matter what the aroma.

I wish Amazon still sold the 32 ounce version because it is like I use it by the gallon. Nevertheless, I ordered this and the rosewater fragrance this week and I am enjoying both several times per day--one in each bathroom. I put my hands in water all day long and, particularly in the winter, this is indispensable to me.

title: Rated as good protection from the sun's UVA/UVB rays but its thickness makes it hard to dispense & fragrance is chemical to me
text:
Thick sunscreen that stays on all day and claims to offer good protection from UVA and UVB rays. Since this is so thick, the sunscreen does not dispense easily out of the squeeze bottle. Also, I do not care for the subtle "chemical" smell.

I did not have to re-apply this all day. However, if I were on the beach, I probably would re-apply every couple of hours for safety sake.

At the current price of $22.66 for 3 bottles, it comes to about $7.55 per bottle which is competitively priced.

title: Moisturizes eye area well but package says "avoid contact with eyes"; I love my Nuxe or Oil of Olay more than this
text:
I prefer my Nuxe pump eye cream and my Oil of Olay over this. I blended around the orbital bone as instructed even though it said in the next sentence to avoid contact with the eyes. Since it is eye cream that worried me.

I used this morning and night over and under my eyelids. It is moisturizing but, as a rule, I avoid eye creams that are for the eye yet say "avoid contact with the eyes." If it did not say that, I would have rated this 4 stars as it does moisturize. Nevertheless, I prefer Nuxe or Oil of Olay over this. There's also a slight smell to this cream that is neither pleasant or unpleasant to my nose. Personally, I would prefer a nice fragrance or non at all.

title: Beautiful cover for storing EITHER a curling or flat iron but NOT BOTH
text:
This is a beautifully constructed curling iron OR flat iron cover that is mostly black and white but has some blue floral outlines.

The larger pocket has a heat protective lining so as long as the iron is not plugged in and is cooling down, a warm iron could be inserted safely. I use this to store my curling iron. The smaller pocket does not have a heat protective lining so I use it for storing my hairbrush with the curling iron (or flat iron).

Vera Bradley items are just gorgeous and creative. If you like or love her products, then this is another excellent buy.

title: This fragrance may be made for a man but it is absolutely loved and used by me
text:
I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE Eternity for Men so much that back in 2015 I finally broke down and ordered the spray [[ASIN:B00021AKJI Calvin Klein ETERNITY for Men Eau de Toilette, 3.4 fl. oz.]] for myself. Unfortunately, I finished both bottles. Although, I cannot do a side-by-side comparison with the original, this "AIR" version smells almost exactly like that one or perhaps a note more subtler.

Even though this smells great on a man, I love this for me, and I do not care that it is marketed as a man's fragrance. I would definitely buy this one or the original any time.

BTW, I tried [[ASIN:B07B2XXV7N Cālvĭn Klęîn Eternĭty Purple Orchĭd Perfume for Women Eau De Parfum 3.4 fl.oz]] and hated it.

title: Excellent makeup brushes—soft, non-shedding, and comfortable to hold
text:
I really love these makeup brushes. First, all seven brushes are labeled. Sometimes I am confused as to the best brush to use for a particular makeup application so the brush labels solve this issue. Second, the bristles are super soft. Third, they do not shed. I purchased expensive brushes in the past where the bristles fall out as I am applying makeup. These do not shed so far and perhaps that is because they do not have natural bristles (i.e. hair).

The seven brushes included are:
- brow and lash comb (two-sided, meaning one end contains the lash comb and the other the brow comb)
- angled liner brush
- concealer brush
- foundation brush
- angled blush brush
- angled eyeshadow blending brush
- powder brush

At the current price of $16.99, I feel this is reasonably priced.

title: Fruity smelling shampoo that leaves my hair at full volume with lots of curls
text: I love this shampoo. It has a beautiful fruity fragrance, lathers up well, and leaves my hair clean and at my full volume of curls when my hair dries.

title: This package comes with only half of what is needed to apply natural make-up
text:
For $34.99 this is what is received:

- 1 package of 10 pre-moistened facial cleaning towelettes
- 1 classic black mascara
- 1 shimmering nudes eyeshadow
- 1 blush basin lipstick

All of the above fits in the palm of one hand. It also comes in a huge box that makes it seem like I received more than I did.

I love the natural colors. The eye shadow goes on smooth, as does the lipstick. The mascara does not clump when applying. The towelettes partially cleaned my make-up off but I had to use five towelettes (1/2 the package) to get a partial cleaning. I never found any towelettes useful to me.

I really dislike that the eye shadow does not come with a foam applicator. That should be standard. Also, the lipstick is more of a sandy orange color. The classic black mascara also looks like a deep brown and not black. I actually like that but someone else may not.

This kit is expensive for what is received. Also, it does not provide all the make-up basics that I expect when applying a "natural" make-up. A full face of make-up to me requires a base, eye shadow, mascara, a highlighter blush, a cheek blush, lip pencil, lipstick, and a translucent setting powder with all the associated applicators and brushes. However, I did not expect that in this kit. At a minimum, I feel an eye-shadow applicator and some blush with a brush should be provided as well instead of the towelettes. Had it come with those three additional items, I would have rated this five stars for quality, value, and price. However, since the very basics are missing, this is only 3 stars.

title: Does nothing but brush my eyebrows and hardly leaves any pigment behind; this is a total waste of money
text:
Dermablend, you have got to be kidding me! There is almost no product and no pigment in this eyebrow gel. I do see product in the tube, but only the tip has some pigment. Attached is a photo of the pigment that comes off the brush when pressing hard on a white paper towel. If you see almost nothing, that is because there is almost nothing.

I have Brooke Shields type thick bushy eyebrows and I figured this gel would highlight them better that the Vaseline I normally use. I kept dipping the brush into the tube and it seemed my eyebrows were getting brushed but absolutely no color was being applied to my brow. I tried over six times on each side and was able to extract a little bit of color on the tip of the brush which is what can be seen in the picture on the white paper towel.

Had I purchased this, I would be incredibly upset. It does nothing but brush the eyebrows and does not deliver on filling them in, highlighting, or applying much pigment. Even at $1 it would be a waste of money and it is highway robbery at $20.

title: This body wash has an intensely sweet fragrance that left my skin smelling and feeling great
text: I love the lather and how moisturized this makes me feel.  I also love that this soap has an intense fragrance. My only dislike is that the fragrance is a bit too sweet. After drying off, my skin smells nice and feels soft. At the current price of $5.66 per bottle ($17 for 3), it is slightly costly but is still competitively priced.

title: Easily straightens out my curls but the current purchase price is a bit too high
text: I have naturally wavy/curly hair and this easily smooths out those curls if I want to. This heats up in seconds and has a heat setting from 180 degrees to 455 degrees Fahrenheit. The iron can be loosely locked in place if desired--note it easily comes undone. The temperature LED is easily readable and the iron feels ergonomically designed and great in the hands. I just slid my hair through the irons and got instant results. There are only two features I dislike. First, the on/off and temperature buttons are very tiny and hard to see and press. Second, the prices shown on Amazon from the independent sellers, which ranges from $54.01 to $87.28. are insane in my opinion. I think this is an excellent iron if it were in the $30 to $35 range.

title: Great curling iron for long hair but I hate that it does not have a resting clip & I dislike the short-clipped barrel
text:
This curling iron is for those who have long hair and want loose curls. It loosely curled my locks but my hair is mid-length and the 1-1/4 inch barrel is better for longer hair.

LOVES:
- This comes with a thick high-quality heat-protective storage sleeve.
- The wand can be heated from 250 to 410 degrees Fahrenheit.
- The tip of the curling iron stays cool.
- The desired temperature can be locked in place.
- It heats up in 30 seconds.
- The cord swivels in the base which reduces tangling.
- The curling iron feels great in my hands.

HATES:
- I thought I would like a short crippled barrel but I hate it. I am so use to the clip extending the full length of the barrel that I find it hard to keep my hair in place with a clip that is about 1/4 the barrel size.
- I am extremely disappointed that this iron lacks a resting clip. It is very important for me to be able to rest a hot iron on my bathroom counter without touching down on my surface. It is impossible to do that with this iron as there is no clip.

Other than the above, this is a very nice curling iron. I particularly love the heat protective pouch that is included.

title: My face feels soft, supple, and well-hydrated after using this but stings on application & smells unpleasant
text:
I use this all over my face and neck after I come out of the shower. Even though the packaging does not say to avoid the eyes, I do apply on my eyelids. I put [[ASIN:B00005JTW8 Olay Total Effects Anti-Aging Face Moisturizer]] or my Nuxe anti-fatigue moisturizing eye cream (no longer sold on Amazon but can be found on Jet) around my eyes.

What I love about this cream is that it is very thick like a body butter. After using this, my face feels soft, supple, and well-hydrated in the morning. However, I am not partial to the fragrance. It smells almost like self-tanning lotion. Also, I feel a tingling sensation in my face when using this cream which either tells me I am very dry or it is a good idea I did not use this around my eyes.

For me this is perfect for the winter time. I will continue applying L'Oreal Revitalift the entire winter. I would have given this five stars if the fragrance was more attractive to me.

BTW - The jar that I received was white and not blue as pictured on Amazon.

title: Lathers great, lightly moisturizes, and leaves my hair clean, curly, and bouncy
text: This is a fantastic shampoo. It lathers great, is lightly moisturizing, and has a subtle baby-powder-like fragrance. I did not need to use conditioner with this shampoo, yet my hair dried soft and curly without being weighed down. This is definitely one shampoo I would buy and at the current price of $3.49, I think it is a steal.

title: This smells like macaroons and does not have enough product in each towelette to be moisturizing for me
text:
This review is for the face and body towelettes. There are 10 single use towelettes (price unknown) in the box the size of a disposable hand wipe. The towelette is hard because the coconut oil has solidified. The action of applying it against my skin melted the oil slightly so that I could apply it.

To me this is not worth the purchase. It smells like macaroons which is off putting. The smell does dissipate after application, however. There is not enough oil to do more than my hands and one arm and the amount was too small to have much moisturizing effect. In a pinch on-the-go this is better than nothing but I am disappointed.

title: This is a glittery pressed powder that did not highlight to me and is more for a teenager or young adult
text: This is all light shimmer and no highlight. I could barely see this on my face and when I got close to the mirror, all I saw were sparkles.  I'm an older woman and this is really more for a teenager or young adult. It did absolutely nothing to highlight my face.

title: Subpar performance for a foot spa; it is loud and water bubbles onto the floor leaving me with a mess
text:
I have an old Dr. Scholl's massaging foot spa with heat feature that I wanted to replace. I figured this might be a good replacement and I was wrong. This spa looks nice and the rollers on the bottom feel good when working them across the soles of my feet. Other than this, the spa is almost useless.

There are two water levels. The first level will not even cover the feet and the second level barely covers the feet. The spa must be filled with warm or hot water because the heater is only good for maintaining the water temperature (if that). Also, when turned on, it generates lots of bubbles. This means it is extremely loud (which is far from relaxing) and water splashes everywhere. I got to clean my floor after using this because the splash guard was useless.

If this is used without the heat and bubble feature (meaning without plugging it in), then it is okay. However, this is poorly designed and provides an extremely disappointing foot spa experience.

title: Washes well and does not sting my eyes but it is a gel-like soap and does not have a copious lather.
text: This face wash does not sting my eyes and cleans well. It also has a nice scent. However, it is a bit gel-like (slimy feeling) and it has a light lather. If it were not more like a gel instead of a soap, I would have liked this more.

title: Extremely lightweight moisturizer that penetrates and does not leave me feeling greasy but also does not moisturize enough
text:
This moisturizers lightly and is unscented. It soaks into my hands and body without leaving them greasy but I still felt dry after using this. On another note, the push top must need to be re-designed because every time I dispense some lotion, it also comes up through the seams as you can see in the picture. Note that I had already wiped away most of it before taking this picture.

Personally, I prefer thicker and more deeply moisturizing lotions and ones with scents. I do like lightweight lotions for summer but this is really too lightweight for me and not moisturizing enough.

title: Rejuvenates my dry chapped lips
text:
This lip balm is extremely moisturizing and really helps keep my lips smooth. It comes in a slanted tip applicator tube with a tiny hole that squeezes out the product. The balm looks and feels like the consistency of wax mixed with Vaseline. It is rose colored but no color shows on the lips nor on my tissues when blotting. I like that there is no color to this. Overall, this is a good moisturizer for my lips and is pleasant tasting.

I attached a picture of the ingredient list for those who are interested.

title: Fragrance is strongly intoxicating to me and this moisturizes deeply
text:
I already purchased [[ASIN:B071D6WFTN SheaMoisture Coconut & Hibiscus Body Wash & Deep Moisturizing Lotion]] and loved it so much that I decided to purchase their body butter too. This lotion is absolutely divine scent-wise and moisturizers deeply.

The fragrance is balanced yet intoxicating. To me the scent is lightly sweet and tropical I do not smell the coconut but instead detect a scent that is predominantly pineapple even though that is not an ingredient in this product. I normally do not like sweet smelling fragrances at all, but this one has a perfect balance.

I would definitely purchase this again as the body butter is great for winter; not so much for summer due to the thickness of the moisturizer. On the negative side, it is difficult to squeeze the lotion out of the tube due to the tiny hole in the cap and the thickness of the product. I wish it came in a tub like the [[ASIN:B000NOYB3A Camille Beckman Glycerine Hand Therapy]] product I love.

title: Fragrance is strongly intoxicating to me and this combo pack washes and moisturizes well
text:
This SheaMoisture body wash and lotion duo is divine. I originally purchased the body wash in CVS and loved it that I decided to buy another one on Amazon and also try the lotion. The fragrance of both is equally strong and intoxicating. To me the scent is lightly sweet and tropical I do not smell the coconut but instead detect a scent that is predominantly pineapple even though that is not an ingredient in this product. I normally do not like sweet smelling fragrances at all, but this one has a perfect balance.

I would definitely purchase this over and over and over again. This is right up there with the quality and highly fragranced [[ASIN:B00XNKMMXC Shea Moisture Mens Utility Soap]] and [[ASIN:B000NOYB3A Camille Beckman Glycerine Hand Therapy]] products that I love so much.

title: I love this moisturizer; it's intense, smells wonderful, and leaves my face all tingly and moisturized
text:
I really like this face moisturizer. It is thick and intensely moisturizing. It is perfect for winter weather. I love the scent and the nice tingling feeling after I apply it to my face and neck. Note that I avoid my eyes even though it does not say to do that on the tube.

This is another men's care product suitable for a woman (in my opinion, of course).

UPDATE: Oct 30, 2017 - I had my boyfriend try this moisturizer and he loves it. He said it feels great on the face and he even loves it for his hands. It also soaks in well. He would use this.

title: Nicely scented but the this face wash is more of a gel and does not produce a lather
text:
I love trying, using, and purchasing men's products because I tend to like them more. This face wash has a nice fragrance but I do not like it because it has a thick viscosity like a gel that produces absolutely no lather. I just do not feel like I cleaned my face after using this.

On the other hand, I love their [[ASIN:B0748G11ZG face moisturizer]].

UPDATE October 30, 2017: My boyfriend tried this and did not care that the soap us thick. He said it does not lather well but it cleans well. He rates this 2 stars because he does not see the point of this for a man. He says it is another step in a busy day when he can just wash his face as part of a shower.

title: Cleans well, has a refreshing fragrance, and is non-irritating to my eyes; one cushion is not effective for full make-up
text:
There are 15 cleansing cushions in one nice (re-usable) plastic dispenser. In order to use, I just added water and rubbed to form a lather, then scrubbed my face with the "scrubbing dots" side, and washed it with the white puffy side. I then rinsed out the pillow and used it to rinse off my face.

I love the fresh fragrance and how wonderful my face feels after using this. The soap also did not irritate my eyes. I also like that I can re-use the plastic container for my Q-Tips or cotton balls or some other beauty item when I have used all the cleaning cushions.

What I do not like is that there is not enough soap in the pad to really clean a full face of make-up. I have to use several pads to do that effectively. This is best reserved for when I am not wearing make-up. Although the price is currently not posted on Amazon, I suspect these are expensive. Since I wash my face twice per day, I would have to buy one box every week. Although, I like this product, it is not something that I feel will be cost effective. I also feel just plain soap and water works just as well.

title: This Shea butter soap is utterly luxurious, almost intoxicatingly fragrant, and intensely moisturizing
text:
This Shea butter soap is utterly luxurious. It is 5.2 ounces of pure bliss. The soap is round and squat like a small hockey puck and fits in the palm of my hand. The lather is abundant and moisturizing. The fragrance is almost intoxicating with floral and citrus notes. The price is equally exorbitant and comparable to the lavishness of the soap. Embossed on top of the bar is a pair of ballet shoes on point. Everything about this soap is rich.

However, I never paid more than $6.50 for a bar of soap and at the current price of $11.25, I think this is a bit steep. I take two showers per day and this bar will not last me one week. Nevertheless, I will let the buyer decide if the price is right. Normally, I take off one star for such a high price but since this bar soap is pure elegance I just cannot do that. I definitely will keep my eye out for this in TJX, HomeGoods, Marshalls, Jet and other places that offer luxury goods at reasonable prices.

NOTE: This review is for the Green Dancer soap as Amazon combines soaps of several different fragrances from the same maker into the reviewer listings.

title: This steam mask has a nice citrus fragrance, is easy to use, and soothed my very tired eyes
text:
This steam mask has a nice citrus fragrance (with menthol-like overtones), is easy to use, and soothed my very tired eyes. The masks warms to approximately 104 degrees Fahrenheit. There are seven eye masks in the box.

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Tear the plastic pouch open
- Remove the eye mask from the pouch
- Tear mask along perforation
- Place white-colored side of mask on eyes with the notch facing down
- Hook the ear straps around the ears
- Sit back and relax for 10 minutes

NOTE: Do not press down against the eyes during application. The heat cell contains iron powder, activated carbon, water, and fragrance. This is harmful if swallowed and must be kept out of reach of children and animals because it contains iron.

Overall, I found this works as designed. However, after having tried this, I would not purchase this because it was torture for me to sit still for 10 minutes. I am very task oriented and am always doing something. Therefore, it is because of my lifestyle behavior that I would not purchase this again and not because of the product.

title: Leaves my hair detangled, conditioned, and bouncy
text:
I could not find direction anywhere on the bottle on how to apply this, so I looked up the info on the Amazon site. After I did that, I noticed the directions were under the ingredients label on the bottom of the bottle. Personally, I prefer that in a more visible spot.

Nevertheless, after washing and towel drying my hair so that it was wet but not dripping, I shook the bottle until the two parts of the solution was combined. Then while holding the pump 6 to 8 inches away from my hair, I sprayed it on all over. It is designed to stay on the hair--meaning there is no need to rinse it out. It definitely detangled my hair and left my locks soft after drying. Since it is a detangler, there is less breakage when combing.

The fragrance is not bad but I am not as enamored with it as the other reviewers are. To me it smells a bit like self-tanning lotion. Had the fragrance been more to my senses and the instructions been clearly visible, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: This soap lathers and washes well and left me feeling moisturized but I do not detect any almond scent
text: This Shea butter honey almond soap moisturizes and lathers well but it does not smell at all like almond. I cannot even describe what it smells like but the fragrance is just okay to me. The scent is the reason I rated this three instead of five stars as it is a five-star soap in every other way. It also mildly exfoliating.  I also tried their [[ASIN:B00BWNGY4U lavender honey]] soap which is also excellent but which I rated two stars because of the fragrance. I guess it is the "honey" in these soaps that just ruins it for me.

title: Nicely scented body butter that leaves my skin super silky
text:
I purchased two of these vanilla and bergamot 6.7 ounce tubes for $6.99 each one at TJX. This scented body butter has a fresh baby powder like fragrance and leaves my skin super silky. It is also super moisturizing. In addition, the lotion absorbs easily and is not tacky or greasy in any way.

In addition to the above, I also purchased two 14 ounce (super-sized) tubes for $12.99 each. One is in the [[ASIN:B00D09EWHK grapefruit and aloe scent]] and the other is in the [[ASIN:B00JGRFB8E lemon and sage scent]]. The grapefruit/aloe one smells just like grapefruit but in a very nice way and the lemon/sage smells lightly vegetal. These body butters are all moisturizing and I love the grapefruit/aloe, then vanilla/bergamot, and lastly the lemon/sage fragrances in that order. Scent is a personal choice so it all comes down to preference. These are wonderful and I would definitely purchase more at the prices I bought them for.

title: This bath salt is like a spa experience at home
text: The fragrance is heavenly, long lasting, and intense and the mineral bath salt is very soothing. I use this to bathe my hands and feet. If I were to use this for the bath, I doubt I could get more than three uses out of this jar. Overall, I love this bath salt. It's like a spa experience at home that is a little less expensive than the real thing. Now if I could only find the time to take a bath with this, I would have a wonderful other worldly experience. I wish this were double the size for the same price.

title: Conditions my hair and leaves it soft and manageable but I doubt its "hair strengthening" claims
text:
I apply two squirts from the pump to my towel-dried hair on the days I am using this in place of my in-shower conditioner. My hair is soft and manageable after each application. The fragrance is also pleasant. Nevertheless, this is very expensive at the current price of $22.50 for 1.7 ounces. In addition, I doubt the claims that this strengthens the hair.

Nevertheless, I like this oil. It reminds me of a less silky and more expensive version of [[ASIN:B002JLUY2M Biosilk Silk Therapy Original Cure]] that I sometimes use on my hair and body. Even though I do like this oil, I like the Biosilk more and would purchase that over this.

title: This body butter is utterly divine and the fragrance is exquisite to my senses
text: This body butter is utterly divine. It smells fresh and like baby powder to me and really moisturizes my hands and body. It is also non-greasy and the moisturizer absorbs into my skin easily. The fragrance has me wanting to apply more, more, more. I would definitely purchase this and at the current price of $15.99 for 6.7 ounces, it is competitively priced.

title: These gloves act like a pumice in the shower to exfoliate my skin but they are thin
text:
These are very thin gloves that definitely exfoliated my body in the shower and left my skin feeling smooth and soft. They act like a pumice to slough off dead skin cells. However, there are three things I do not like about these gloves.

1 - They develop pulls easily. For example, when I was removing the plastic package bindings with a scissor, they developed several pulls just by stretching the glove away from the binding to cut the plastic tie. Perhaps these can be packaged in a plastic bag instead to avoid that issue.

2 - They are very, very thin and I do not expect these to last more than a few weeks of daily use.

3 - They prevent soap from producing copious lather like [[ASIN:B015IHD0LK Mesh Puffs]] do.

Nevertheless, these gloves definitely work but expect a less exhilarating sudsy shower and be prepared to replace them often.

title: This iron softened the curls in my already wavy hair
text:
I used this on my medium length fine hair and even at the highest setting (which is rated for course hair), I could not get a good curl. Perhaps that is because my hair is no longer super long but I still expected some more curl. I have naturally curly hair to begin with but since my hair has been getting longer, my tops have become somewhat flat. This only made the little wave I had left flatter and produced a "softer" curl than the one that existed already. On another note, the heat dial feels cheap.

What I do like, however, is that this has a safety stand and a comfortable thumb grip for easy styling and control. The tip of the curling iron also stays cool. The swivel cord is worrisome to me because I am not comfortable with cords that turn and am not sure how long that cord will last. I always find those type cords stop working after a while. There are 30 heat settings; however, one has to guess how much heat is at each setting. It is suppose to go up to 425 degrees Fahrenheit but the dials go from 1-30. According to the box 1-7 is for fine hair, 8-5 for medium to wavy hair, 16-22 for curly to thick hair, and 23-30 for coarse hard-to-style hair. I tried all settings and did not get the curly results I expected.

title: This lavender honey soap lathers and moisturizes well but the scent is off-putting to me
text: This Shea butter lavender honey soap moisturizes and lathers well but I hate the scent. I do not detect the lavender but do detect the honey scent. The combination is just awful to my senses. The scent is the reason I rated this two instead of five stars as it is a five-star soap in every other way. It also mildly exfoliating.

title: This rhubarb & mint tea hand cream has a fresh citrus scent and moisturizes well
text:
The packaging this comes in is gorgeous to me. I love the colorful bird on the box and on the tube.

I tried this rhubarb & mint tea hand cream and it has a nice citrus scent to it. I do not smell rhubarb or the mint at all but that is fine by me. The cream also moisturizes well. However, it is a bit on the light (thin) side and does not moisturize as well as my [[ASIN:B000NOYB3A Camille Beckman Glycerine Hand Therapy in the Camille fragrance]] that I love so much.

At 2.3 ounces this cream is a bit pricey at the current price of $15.19 per tube. Nevertheless, this is a "spa quality" product and is priced as one.

title: This takes away the itchiness of my mosquito and other bug bites & works like any other aloe gel
text:
I'm not a sun worshiper but I know from past experience that aloe gel cools sunburns. I actually use this for insect bites to reduce the itchiness and it works well for that. To me this has a slight menthol-like aroma that is extremely subtle.

The only negative to me is the cap which is why I gave this four stars. The cap is like a locking pill bottle and to open, I have to press down and twist which is difficult for me to do because I have hand issues. I would have preferred a flip top cap for easy squeeze-type dispensing. Other than this, it works like any other aloe gel. Also, at the current price of $3.74 for 16 ounces, this is a bargain.

title: The fragrance is exceptional and reminds me of a bouquet of fresh flowers; the bottle it comes in is equally as beautiful
text:
I purchased a 3.4 ounce bottle of this "Martinque" fragrance at TJX for $19.99 on a whim and without knowing if I would like the fragrance. I have purchased many perfumes in the past and have been disappointed with 80% of them. However, this one is exceptional. It was the teal packaging that attracted me.

Inside is this bulbous bottle that has a metallic yellow / lime green sheen to it. It is beautiful and pictures do not do it justice. The scent is so refreshing and smells like a bouquet of fragrant flowers. I would definitely buy this again at TJX prices, of course. I'm glad to see I got a deal compared to the $68 price here.

title: This does absolutely nothing to protect me from underarm odor; I have been using Old Spice for years and am so DISAPPOINTED
text:
I love Old Spice deodorant and have been using it for years because it is the only product that protects me from underarm odor. I used the [[ASIN:B003F8Q3UU Fiji]] and [[ASIN:B01LTI08XU Denali]] scents and recently ran out. I thought all Old Spice deodorant contained the active ingredient of "aluminum zirconium tricholorhydrex Gly 18%" or "aluminum zirconium tricholorhydrex Gly 19%" because that is the only active ingredient that works for me. I cannot go lower than 18% of this ingredient. I did not realize that I had to purchase one that says "anti-perspirant/deordorant" in the title. Instead, I purchased a four pack of this from my local BJs and I absolutely hate it.

I take two showers a day because I sweat profusely and apply Old Spice after each shower. Well after two hours with this deodorant, my armpits stink to high heaven. It does absolutely nothing for me because the "aluminum..... 18% or 19%" is missing as an ingredient since it is only a deodorant and not an anti-perspirant.

Old Spice Pure Sport High Endurance Deordorant is a complete waste of my money.

title: Great hand moisturizer but my favorite is their "camille-frangranced" version; nothing beats the smell of that one
text: I love Camille Beckman hand cream because it is one of the best on the market. It moisturizes my hands wonderfully. Sometimes I even use it on my entire body when I want deep moisturizing elsewhere--even though it is for the hands. However, I really only love their [[ASIN:B000NOYB3A Camille fragrance]]. This mango scent is not too appealing to me.

title: Took away the itchiness of my dry scalp
text: I do not have dandruff but I have an itchy and dry scalp. After using this, I feel so much better. The shampoo has to be shaken before each use. It lathers up well and smells nice. It has a hand lotion type texture to it that is not usually the type of shampoo I prefer. After washing, my hair felt clean and moisturized. I let my hair air dry as usual and it was less bouncy but I still had curls. Overall, this worked for me.

title: Cleanses my face and neck more than I expected after a shower during these sweltering summer months
text:
I ordered this for the summer months. I tend to break out because of the excessive sweating during this time period. I make sure I use this after a shower. Since I have extremely sensitive skin, I also use this only once per day in the evening. The recommended "dosage" is three times per day after one's face is washed. That definitely would have too much of a drying effect on my skin even though I follow this with a facial moisturizer.

So far I really like this. The fragrance is clean and even after a good shower with soap and water, the cotton pad I used showed that additional cleansing was achieved after using this. If I have any bad reaction or severe drying from my daily application, I will update this review.

title: Left my hair soft but also weighed down my curls and the aroma is like sour lime
text: Although this conditioner weighs down my hair a little bit it still leaves it soft. What I really do not like is the fragrance; it smells like sour lime to me. If this did not relax my curls more than expected and smelled a bit better, it would be one I would add to my arsenal of hair products.

title: After using 3 towelettes, my face still was not clean & it irritated my eyes
text:
I tried these on a full face of makeup that included:

- foundation
- blush
- eyeliner above the lid
- eye shadow
- translucent setting powder
- lip liner
- lipstick
- washable (NOT waterproof) mascara.

After using three towelettes, a lot of makeup was left behind on my face. It was particularly difficult to clean around my eyes and the solution on the towelette started to make my eyes burn even though they were closed when using them. The package says it removes makeup including waterproof mascara in seconds. I did not find either of those statements to be true.

Eventually I gave up and washed my face with soap and water. I then used a fourth towelette to see if any makeup was left behind, and except for one smudge near my eye that came off, the towelette remained white.

I would definitely not buy these for me because too many towelettes are needed and I found them irritating.

title: Lightly moisturized my body in the shower but this causes the tub floor to become dangerously slippery
text: I purchased a bottle of Nivea body wash and a sample of this "in-shower body lotion" was attached. As instructed, I rubbed it all over my body and rinsed off. It left my skin feeling nice and smooth and somewhat moisturized. However, as the lotion is rinsing off, the bottom of the tub or shower gets very slick. I would never purchase this because of that as it can cause a serious fall. Also, I find moisturizing outside the shower with a regular moisturizer to provide better results. If it did not make the shower slippery, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: Really makes my body feel silky and moisturizes well but I cannot stand the chemical aroma
text: I was surprised by the large quantity of cream at 15 ounces. This can be used on the face and body and I have been applying it to my body. The thick cream moisturizes well and I feel it is comparable to most other moisturizers I use. I would not consider this any more anti-aging than any other thick moisturizer. The major issue I have with this cream is that I really dislike the chemical smell.  If it had a pleasing fragrance, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: Designed for longer hair than I have; smooths out my curls instead; gets VERY VERY HOT so operate safely
text:
My hair is now shoulder length. I use to have long hair but cut it off last year. This curling iron is definitely for long hair. My hair is also fine and wavy and sometimes curly. Unfortunately, since the barrel of this iron is big, it actually flattened out my curls. So for me, this has a smoothing effect. I wish I had this years ago when my hair was past my shoulders.

I like how the handle feels great in my hands; so that is a plus for me. Also, since this gets super hot, I'm glad there's a safety stand that the iron rests on so it does not burn my counter.

FEATURES:
- The cord swivels at the end.
- The tip stays cool to the touch but the barrel gets super hot.
- There are multiple heat settings between 300 and 430 degrees Fahrenheit to curl from fine to the most difficult coarse hair.
- The barrel is 2 inches extra long compared to the ordinary curling iron and wider as well.
- It comes with a 3-year limited warranty.

Overall, this is a quality curling iron that is most suitable for those who have hair that falls mid-way down their back. For those like me who have shorter hair, the thick barrel acts more like a straightening iron. At the current price of $29.99, I feel this iron is worth it for those with longer locks. Even though the thick barrel will not produce a super curly result, the hair will probably not get tangled on the iron. When I was a teenager I use to have curling irons that got so tangled in my long hair that I eventually got rid of them. This one is finally a keeper.

title: The warm beige is more for olive skin or a deep tan; also it does not spread easily on my face
text: This warm beige is darker than I expected and will look better on a person with olive skin or a deep tan. It is too dark for my complexion. In addition, this make-up does not spread well. When I apply a foundation, I expect a smooth flow with my sponge and this did not provide that.

title: Color is extremely deep and more for olive or darker skin and it does not spread with ease on my face
text:
This medium coverage foundation is way too dark for my complexion. I expected the warm beige to be like a tan, instead this foundation is more for women of color or those that have a deep olive or super deep tan. It has SPF 25 sunscreen protection.

In addition to the color issue, I found that it does go on smoothly. Every time I applied a little bit, I had blotches of color on my face and trying to blend it was practically impossible.

title: Almost ivory in color and it does not spread easily over my face
text: I actually expected this beige powder to be darker in nature than it is. It is closer to ivory in color. Nevertheless, I can use this but I'm not crazy about it because it does not blend well nor does it go on smoothly. It is actually very blotchy because I found it almost impossible to spread on my skin. I had to keep reapplying it. If it weren't for that negative, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: Concealer for women with olive or darker complexion
text:
This is way too dark for me. I expected medium coverage to be only a little darker than beige but this is most likely for a woman of color or with deep olive skin or a deep tan.

On the positive side, it goes on easily and does conceal but it's not something I can use due to the color.

title: Fragrance is heavenly' jelly is softening without the greasy feeling of Vaseline; this is my new goto petroleum jelly
text: There's a lot to love about this petroleum jelly. Most surprising to me is that it is not greasy like Vaseline. I lightly applied this to my hands as a moisturizer and my hands felt very soft without the tackiness I expected. I also use this to moisturize my lips. I expect this will work well on my feet to keep blisters from forming on long walks. Also the cocoa butter fragrance is heavenly.  It would be great if this came in a flip top, however, to provide for quick opening and closing.

title: I love the invigorating rosemary and mint aroma; this left my hair clean and curly; conditioner was weightless
text: I purchased this Aura Rosemary Mint Combo Pack on sale for $8.00 plus tax at Marshall's; their price is normally $9.99. I love the rejuvenating smell of rosemary and mint in the shampoo. The conditioner's fragrance is more a strong menthol than mint but was still pleasing to me. The shampoo felt weightless and clean when washing my short hair. It produced a moderate lather that was good enough to clean. The conditioner was thicker and did not weigh down my hair. Overall, I like this combo because it left my short locks clean and curly with moderate softness. I also find the fragrance of the shampoo invigorating.

title: Lightly hydrating face and neck "oil" that has a very berry scent that I find extremely pleasing
text: I love the fragrance of this "oil." It smells like fresh berries to me. I just unscrewed the cap to expose the dropper and dispensed a little bit of "oil" on my fingers and rubbed it into my face and neck, avoiding my eyes. This is lightly hydrating and good for the summer. It is the aroma that attracts me most, however. The ingredients include Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid.

title: These left my feet super moisturized; one package contains two pairs of sockies
text:
I purchased one package of these at my local Marshals for $3.99 plus tax. In each package are two pairs of foot sockies. All I had to do is open the package and then cut a strip away from the ankle of each sockie to open it so that I could insert my foot. After 30 minutes, my feet came out exceptionally soft and conditioned. I rinsed my feet after the treatment only because there was so much lotion left behind; however, that is not recommended. When I use the second pair I will not rinse the lotion off.

Overall, I like the results.

title: This shampoo is not as great for my hair as I thought it would be
text: This review is for the shampoo only. I purchased two 33.8 fluid ounce bottles of the shampoo on sale at Marshals for $10 per bottle (regular price $12.99 each) plus tax because the fragrance was extremely attractive to me.
