However after trying this, I would not purchase it again. The fragrance is not as great when washing my fine short hair with it. It does not have copious lather like I like. Also, I feel as if the shampoo strips my hair like a detergent.

title: Cleans & lathers well but its overwhelming sweet minty fragrance is a turn off & it left a residue on my skin
text: This lathers up well and does not sting my eyes. I feel clean after using this body wash. However, it has a strong minty fragrance that has cloyingly sweet overtones and I feel it left a residue on my body. It is for these two reasons that I do not like this body wash.

title: Provides a nice highlight to my face when I use it like a finishing powder
text: This provides a light sheen to my face. I use this over my make-up like a finishing powder. It gives me a subtle glow. Since the powder has a shimmer to it, this make-up is more suited to a younger adult. Other than the shimmer, I like it.

title: As good as most other mascaras I have tried but the applicator wand is a bit thick on the end
text: This mascara is no better or worse that some others I have tried. I like the mystic black color, the volumizing effect, its long-lasting qualities, and the ease of removal with soap and water. What I don't like is the bulbous end to the applicator wand. The brush is shaped like a subtle hourglass. Since it is not tapered at the end, it can make the mascara difficult to apply on the inside lashes. Other than this, I like it.

title: Sweet smelling pomade the consistency of cold cream that leaves my hair clumpy and dirty looking
text:
This is a sweet smelling pomade the consistency of cold cream. The fragrance is fine but the product makes my hair dirty looking, even when applying a little bit. It tames down the frizz but with a hair gelled wet and stiff look.

I recently tried their [[ASIN:B01KPUWJDK ORIBE Body Wash]] which is absolutely amazing and expected the same of this product but am disappointed. I have short, fine wavy hair that frizzes terribly in the rain. Unfortunately, this is not the product for me.

title: This outrageously expensive 8.5 ounce body wash provides an equally outrageous spa-like shower experience
text: In this ghastly mustard yellow package with an outrageous price tag is the most wonderful shower experience I have ever had in my life. This perfumed body wash produces copious lather, feels incredibly silky going on, does not sting my eyes, and left my skin feeling like velvet when dried. This is definitely an expensive treat worth trying at least once.

title: Surprisingly attractive nail polish
text:
I did not think I would like this color but I do. It is a subtle coffee brown, a bit understated as color goes, but looks good on. The polish also flows smoothly.

Attached are three pictures I took right after applying my own "Out The Door" top coat. However, it was glossy enough without the top coat.

title: This fragrance is too intense for my senses
text:
I love trying new fragrances and often buy them at TJX, Marshalls, and Home Goods without knowing what they smell like. I usually choose the high-end names. I purchased a 1.6 ounce bottle for $24.99 at Marshalls.

The scent is strong and smells like something from the 1920's (like my grandmother wore). For me its okay but not a scent I would buy again simply because it is too intense.

title: I do not care for the scent of this Eau de Parfum
text:
I love trying new fragrances and often buy them at TJX, Marshalls, and Home Goods without knowing what they smell like. I usually choose the high-end names. I purchased this at TJX for $16.99 plus tax for a one fluid ounce bottle, not a 1.7 ounce or 2.5 ounce as stated on Amazon. Based on Amazon's prices, I paid more per ounce than they sell the 2.5 ounce bottle for. Therefore, my review is about the fragrance itself and not the price.

This fragrance smells rich but is impossible for me to describe. The aroma reminds me of a scent that is geared more for an older woman (senior citizen). Although I'll use it until it's finished I wouldn't buy this again because I do not like the scent.

title: I LOVE THIS FRAGRANCE; although I paid lots more at Marshall's for it than is priced here
text:
I didn't expect this fragrance to be so cheap on Amazon at the current price of $29.53 which some are saying is a fake product. Since I actually bought mine at Marshall's for $34.99 plus tax, I can not vouch for what is on Amazon. Nevertheless, the packaging looks the same as what I received.

I LOVE, LOVE the fragrance. It is smells wonderful, feminine (even though it is a men's fragrance) yet not flowery, and reminds me a bit of almond. The spray bottle with the raised face on the front is also attractive. For some reason, I seem to be supremely attracted to wearing men's fragrances. When I purchased this, nowhere on the box did this say it was men's so I assumed it was a woman's fragrance. Overall, I would definitely purchase this again and again and again and will probably purchase this on Amazon since it's cheaper; then I'll be able to compare and see if the fragrance is different or not.

title: This conditions my hair nicely but the fragrance does not attract me enough to make me want to purchase this
text: I neither like nor dislike the fragrance of this conditioner and cannot even describe what the aroma is like. Nevertheless, this conditions my fine hair nicely without weighing it down and left my locks soft. However, I am also very attracted to fragrance and this just doesn't have a strong enough nor an attractive enough scent to make me want to purchase this. Based on the other reviews it appears I'm in the minority in not being overwhelmed by its scent.

title: Cream (not a powder) eyeliner in an iridescent chocolate color that glides on smoothly with the use of the supplied brush
text:
Once I knew how to apply this everything else was easy. To apply, pull out the brush from the top of the cap, flip it around, and secure the other end of the brush inside the hole you pulled it out of. This snaps the brush in place and provides a thicker and longer brush handle with which to work. Once the brush is in place, unscrew the cap and use the brush end to apply. Reverse the procedure to secure the brush back in the cap.

I used this to highlight my upper eyelid. It glided on smoothly. However, to me this is a cream eyeliner and not a powder. The application faded a little bit around the corners of my eyes by the end of the day but for the most part it was still visible. The color is a beautiful iridescent chocolate. It also washed off easy with soap and water.

At the current cost of $24, I feel it is competitively priced. The only issue I had with this is that there are no visible instructions. There is a QR code in the flap of the box but when using my QR reader, it just sent me to senior citizen coupons. I then went to their website and searched for the full instructions which I attached in the comments section of this review. In fact, until I saw the video, I didn't realize I could snap the brush in the cap. During my first application, I used the brush separately and that was not easy since I had to pinch my fingers like a pair of tweezers.

title: I love the coconut fragrance and large size; I don't detect any ginger scent and would prefer more lather
text: I really like this hand soap. It has a wonderful coconut scent and cleans my hands well but lathers lightly; personally I prefer more suds. I do not detect any "ginger" fragrance. Nevertheless, the scent is very refreshing and tropical and reminds me of the beach. I also like that this is a large bottle at 11.25 fluid ounces instead of the standard 7.75 fluid ounces so that I do not have to change it out often.  I would definitely purchase this.

title: Nice fragrance, great moisturizing effects, but it has to be melted before use
text:
I love the smell of frangipani and purchased this on a whim years ago. Although this frangipani fragrance is not as great as some others I smelled in the past, it is still very good. This also keeps my skin moisturized all day. What I don't like about this is that I have to warm it up before using, so I rarely use this which is why I have had this over five years. In order to use I put it in a bath of hot water from the tap and let it sit while I'm taking a shower. When I get out it's mostly liquefied.

Since it's is solid prior to warming it, there is another issue I found. It was never able to fully melt the entire bottle contents at once. As the oil is partially used up there are smaller and smaller "tubes" of the oil that remain solidified. When dispensing the oil that is liquid, that thin tube of solidified oil blocks the exit so it's hard to dispense the liquefied oil. If it were not for this I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: This moisturized my skin while it is rated to protect me from the sun but I don't like the pump
text:
This moisturizing SPF 30 Suntan lotion is not only rated to protect from the sun but I definitely felt moisturized after using it. I also did not have any bad skin reaction.

We haven't had much sun here yet so I assume the protection stated is correct. I really love the product but not the packaging or price. This smelled like typical suntan lotion without any added fragrance.

There are two negatives for me.

- First, the current price of $56.00 is expensive. Previously, I purchased two $55 SPF face creams in the past and I paid the high price because I could use it on my entire face, including my eyelids. This product requires you avoid the eyes and also avoid any broken skin. If I could use this in the eye area as well, then I would not balk about the price.

- Second, I do not like the pump tube because it takes a lot of pumping action to dispense the necessary amount of product. Also, I always feel there is wasted product left behind once I get to the end.

Despite the above, this moisturizing suntan lotion felt good on my skin.

title: This felt as if it moisturized my skin while it is rated to protect me from the sun
text:
This SPF 50 Suntan lotion is not only rated to protect from the sun but I felt moisturized after using it. I also did not have any bad skin reaction.

We haven't had much sun here yet so I assume the protection stated is correct. I really love the product. I did not detect any fragrance which is fine with me. I also like that it is in a tube because I find it easy to dispense.

The only negative is the current price of $51.50. Previously, I purchased two $55 SPF face creams in the past and I paid the high price because I could use it on my entire face, including my eyelids. This product requires you avoid the eyes and also avoid any broken skin. If I could use this on the eye area as well, then I would not balk about the price.

title: Soft bristles, design, & size selection allow me to feather out my eye or blush powder flawlessly for a professional finish
text:
I previously purchased a [[ASIN:B01LX7BCT7 My ibeauty Tool Mermaid Brush Contour Brush]] at Marshall's for $9.99 plus tax and also purchased the My ibeauty concealer brush for 5.99 plus tax that is about 1/2 the size of the contour brush. I loved those brushes so much that I wanted to buy more. I saw this entire set of DSCbeauty brushes for about $20 at Marshalls but before I could purchase them, this same set of brushes (without all the Marshall's fancy packaging) came up on a lightening deal for $8.22 and I immediately purchased it.

The bristles are so soft on these brushes and it's easy for me to apply my make-up and powders. I love the curved "toothbrush-like" handles and the rubberized base ensures the brushes stay firmly in my hand. I have no idea what the bristles are made of but they are super soft and yet very dense. If I were ever in the market for brushes again, I would purchase these. The style is obviously a bit different than the wand-type brushes and is held differently during application, so for some that will take getting use to. Also, the price on Amazon during the lightening deal was half of what I would have paid in Marshalls or TJX. In fact, I could have forgone the two My ibeauty brushes I purchased previously and have just got this set for the price I already paid for one brush. The price is still a steal at $10.28.

title: This leave-in conditioner nurtures my hair without weighing it down; I LOVE IT
text:
I really love this leave-in conditioner. After washing my locks with a volumizing shampoo, I towel-dried my hair until it was partially wet to damp. I then applied a five cents dollop to my short-to-medium fine hair. It dried beautifully. I did not feel like I was weighed down with product and my hair both felt and looked great.

I also love the color of the bottle as it matches my purple bathroom wonderfully.

title: Loved the fragrance but did not like the wet and dirty looking results on my short hair
text: This makes my hair look wet and dirty. It smells great but instead of replenishing my short hair, it just looked like I wet my hair with water and after it was dried, I could tell I had used a product because my strands were slightly stiff. This might work for some but it's definitely not for me.

title: This mascara is easy to apply, lengthens somewhat, but doesn't give me the fullness I get from my favorite brand & it flakes off
text:
My favorite mascara is L'Oreal Paris Voluminous Miss Manga Rock Mascara (in the pink wand) that I buy at CVS or Walmart but it is not this [[ASIN:B00V0XPC7M waterproof version]]. I wanted to see if something could beat the thickness and length of my favorite and this one could not and I've tried many mascaras over the years.

What I love about this Julep Length Matters Mascara is:
- The brush applicator is easy to use and makes applying the mascara a cinch.
- The mascara washes off easily with soap and water.
- It does not irritate my eyes.
- It does not clump. I know other users said it did but it did not for me. If one waits a few seconds for it to dry between applications, I find that it goes on smoothly.

What I dislike:
- It doesn't lengthen unless I apply 4 or 5 coats of mascara.
- It doesn't give me the thick full look of the Miss Magna Rock mascara I love.
- The mascara does not smudge like the Maybelline brands I have used previously but it does flake off a little during the day.
- The current price of $20 is double what I pay for my favorite brand at the local drugstore. Of course if I could find that brand on Amazon at the same price they sell the [[ASIN:B00V0XPC7M waterproof version]], I would purchase it here.

In summary, this mascara is easy to apply, does lengthen somewhat, but doesn't give me the fullness I get from my favorite brand. It also flakes off during the day and cost too much for the product quality I am getting.

title: Light face and neck moisturizer that goes on smooth, absorbs quickly, and feels great on
text: This feels great on my skin and provides good hydration. I applied this to my face and neck and even my eyelids.  It went on smooth and was not tacky. It also absorbed well. To me this is more of a summer hydrating liquid because it is so light. I have no idea if it will last 72 hours because I shower twice per day; all I need is for it to last all day and it has. It has a nice fresh fragrance as well and the pump dispenses the almost clear moisturizer easily. There's also a lot of product for $13.99. I would definitely buy this.

title: Extremely, extremely moisturizing but it took about 20 minutes for the lotion to be absorbed
text: I used this on my entire face and neck, including my eyelids since it didn't have any warning about the eyes. It's very moisturizing but the lotion feels tacky when drying and it took about 20 minutes to absorb. On wake-up my face and neck felt incredible. If it weren't for the tackiness of this lotion, it actually would be one of several I would buy. However, I can get similar moisturizing affects from [[ASIN:B00HB2JQNM Olay Total Effects 7 in one, Anti-Aging Moisturizer]] without all the tackiness. I do love the fragrance of this lotion, however.

title: Moisturizes my lips exceptionally well; love the glitter, wish the color were just a bit deeper
text:
I love the moisturizing ability of this color stick. I also love that turning the bottom releases more product. The plum color is very light and looks like a mauve sparkle on my lips. I have fair skin, so the color does show up. Although I'm middle aged, I love lipsticks with glitter. I only had to apply this several times during the day to keep my lips from getting chapped.

In summary, this is a product that I would purchase to moisturize my lips when I want a little color by itself or used on top of a darker colored lipstick. Had the hue been a bit deeper, I would have rated this 5 stars.

title: Left my hair salon silky and feathery; the fragrance is deliciously minty
text:
I have relatively short hair now that falls just above the shoulder. My hair is fine and curly. With this conditioner, it left my hair silky soft and feathery (not as curly but not flat) as if I had it conditioned at a salon. I also love the strong minty scent. I do not particularly care for the greenish tan color of the conditioner but that is a minor point.

I have no idea if it will leave my hair thicker over time as the bottle indicates. However, this is a really nice conditioner that does not weigh down my short hair and smells deliciously minty. The current price of $21.53 for 8.5 fluid ounces is competitively priced with other salon-based products. This is one of several conditioners that I would buy if I were in a market for one.

title: Nifty, light, versatile, and ergonomically designed trimmer for facial & head hair; wish it came w/a carrying case
text:
My boyfriend wanted to trim his own eyebrows and nose hairs and is even thinking of trimming his own hair. Therefore, I decided to get this for him.

In the package are
- One 1 mm trim comb to use for a stubble look
- One 2 mm trim comb to use for a “longer” stubble look
- One 3-11 mm trim comb for short beards (use 3-21 setting for hair clipping)
- One 13-21 mm trim comb for long beards (use 3-21 setting for hair clipping)
- A precision trimming tool attachment
- An ear and nose trimmer attachment
- One Gillette Fusion ProGlide razor with FlexBall technology for a clean and close shave
- One power cord for charging
- One tiny cleaning brush to clean the razor head
- One instruction manual

Before first time use, I had to charge it for 8 hours. He used the trimming tool to lightly trim his eyebrows and used the nose trimmer to trim his nose hairs and loved the results. We both like how the parts snap on and off easily, how light the tool is, and how nice it is to hold. Eventually, he’ll use it on his hair but he hasn’t got the nerve to try yet. I’ll probably do that when he is ready for a buzz cut as he just got one from the barber.

With regard to the razor, that offers a close shave. Both my boyfriend and I actually own sever power ProGlide razors and love them. This razor is not the power one but it's as excellent as the power ProGlide. For me, I prefer a power ProGlide because I don’t cut myself with that version. My boyfriend loves either razor and has converted to using only the ProGlide razors after I had him try them.

Overall, this is a nifty and light little trimmer that is versatile, easy to assemble and disassemble, and is ergonomically designed. It provides one with the ability to trim facial and head hairs as desired. However, since there are so many moving parts, we would have liked a carrying case to be included.

title: High quality & expensive make-up light but its heft makes it less portable than expected
text:
This is what comes in the package:

- one laptop designed 1 X magnification mirror with compartment and integrated LED light panel on both sides

- a dark pink circular magnetic mirror with 10 X magnification

- a light pink circular magnetic mirror with 5 X magnification

- six Ni-MH Rechargeable AA/1300mAh Batteries already installed

- a strapless Neoprene carry pouch with Velcro closure

- a 12V DC charger

- one tiny folded instruction pamphlet

Before first time use, I had to remove the plastic strip sticking out of the battery compartment and then charge the batteries (in the unit) for a few hours until the console light turned green. Note that the mirror has to be opened to see the charging light.

WHAT I LOVE ABOUT THIS MIRROR:

- The quality of the mirror is exceptional. I almost screamed when I saw what it showed and with the higher magnifications I could see every pore and imperfection.

- The on / off button on the console is easy to press.

- The on / off button is protected from accidental use since the mirror console has to be opened in order to get to it.

- The mirror tilts and rotates 180 degrees in either direction. It’s a 360 degree swivel but without turning in a full circle.

- The 5 X and 10 X mirrors are magnetic, so I was able to “stick them” anywhere on the 1 X mirror and they stayed put without falling.

- Lightly holding the on / off button acts like a dimmer switch to increase or decrease the intensity of the LED lights.

- The LED lights are very realistic and blindingly bright on the highest setting. According to the package, the light mimics natural daylight but personally, I can’t tell if this so.

WHAT I DON’T LIKE ABOUT THIS MIRROR (listed in order of importance to me):

- It is very difficult to open the battery compartment. I had to use a letter opener to push the tab and pry it open to see the batteries. Also, the instructions do not mention what batteries are used and in what quantity or what the battery life is. The six batteries are [[ASIN:B00XP0X2BG Ni-MH Rechargeable Battery AA/1300mAh]].

- The integrated tray is useless because both mirrors have to be stored in that tray and take up all the room. Only a few marbles, coins, or mini-lipstick could be added to the tray (see photo). Of course if the 5 and 10 X mirrors are left at home, the tray can store a few slim items.

- The current price of $88.53 is too expensive in my opinion. I would not pay more than $55 for this mirror due to its lack of portability. If it were lighter with increased tray functionality, then the price point would be more reasonable.

- The on / off button on the console is not easy to see. It could be marked better as someone with eyesight issues will probably have trouble finding it.

- The unit is heavy at 3 pounds 2.8 ounces as weighed with everything but the 2.2 ounce external charger. If I were one of those people who traveled overnight or by plane, then I’d be adding 3 pounds 5 ounces to the luggage weight. In times when airlines charge by the pound, every ounce matters.

- Although this vanity has a portable laptop design, its heft makes it less portable that I expected.

- There is no room for the 2.2 ounce charger in the carry pouch. This is really not that much of a negative but I personally like to keep items together.

- The name “50 shades” on the Amazon site apparently refers to the color of the mirror. I found this confusing because I originally thought it meant 50 light intensities.

Overall, this is a high quality mirror that shows every pore and imperfection on my face and neck especially with the highest magnification. It is also great to use for a facial because of how easy it is to see every detail. On the other hand, its heft makes it less portable than the advertising claims and the tray does not act as storage for anything but the mirrors. The price point is also a bit high. Nevertheless, this is a high quality mirror that can be moved around the house and be used free of cords with the rechargeable batteries included.

title: Lip balm for the feet but the amount in the package is too little for the price & the applicator is faulty
text:
I bought this at ShopRite for $5.99 plus tax as an impulse purchase because I am always trying to find new ways to moisturize. I have [[ASIN:B00COOO7UO Udder Cream]], [[ASIN:B00P17DHEI Bag Balm]], and other products that work and which I use. However, I liked the idea of a sort of "ChapStick" for the heel of the foot.

The coco butter did work on my heels and it was softening. I applied it like lip balm and then wore socks to let the healing action begin and to keep the balm from wiping off. However, this is the only positive. Even though I paid less than the current price of $7.57 on Amazon, I think the price is too expensive for the amount of product in the applicator. I doubt this will even last three weeks.

Second, the balm is on the soft side. It's not like the waxy stiffness of ChapStick. In addition, the applicator top is sticky in the sense that it is almost impossible to unscrew. The balm pushes up from the bottom and I accidentally pushed up too much. It was practically impossible to get it to go back down again.

The combination of high price and lousy applicator put this on the "do not buy list" for me.

title: Feather soft and perfect for applying foundation powder
text: I purchased this Triangle Make-up Brush for $3 on sale at Home Goods. It's so, so soft and extremely pliable. I use this to apply foundation powder all over my face. This brush has limited use but I like it for what I purchased it for and the price was right.

title: Quality shower cap that keeps my hair dry in the shower and which I purchased as a replacement for their Zebra Cap
text:
I purchased this show cap as a replacement for their [[ASIN:B004N71SI4 Bella Il Fiore Bath Diva Shower Cap, Zebra, 3 Ounce]] that I purchased 2 years ago at Home Goods and which I needed to replace because it got moldy. I had stored it wrong but used it twice per day religiously.

This replacement shower cap is well made, the elastic is strong and keeps the water off my hair, and it looks beautiful on. I rated the other one 5 stars because I liked the pattern on the other one better but this brand is great. This one matches my pink bathroom better than my previous one but the zebra one looked better on me than this one.

title: Left my skin silky soft; I like that it only has 8 ingredients and a light fragrance
text:
This oil has a very subtle fresh scent and goes on a bit oily at first. However, after I rubbed it into my skin, it soaked in nicely after a few minutes. The end result for me was silky soft skin that felt almost as good as the [[ASIN:B002JLUY2M BioSilk Silk Therapy Serum]] I love.

Avocado and Macadamia oil are the fifth and fourth ingredient and not first as I expected; however, the results won me over. I also like that this product only has 8 ingredients.

The ingredients in order are:
- Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride
- Isopropyl Palmitate
- Ethythexyl Stearate
- Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil
- Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil
- Gossypium Herbaceum (Cotton) Seed Oil
- Ubiquinone
- Fragrance

title: Quality shower cap that kept my hair dry for years in the shower
text:
I purchased this show cap about 2 years ago at Home Goods and have been using it since. It's well made, the elastic is strong and keeps the water off my hair, and it looks beautiful on. Unfortunately, I had to throw it away today because it got moldy when I left it in the shower. However, it was still going strong after using it twice per day for about 5 of the 7 days per week for over 2 years. I would definitely buy this brand again.

UPDATE Oct 15, 2016 - I decided to purchase [[ASIN:B00795YCTE Bella Il Fiore Bath Diva Shower Cap Gray Floral with a Pink Flower]] on Amazon as a replacement because I could no longer find this brand at Home Goods. I love the Bella II Fiore shower caps as they are such high quality.

title: Softens my face but I don't like the smell or the mask-like feeling when it's on me
text:
This night treatment left my face smooth but I don't like the smell or the way it feels going on. It felt like I was putting on a mask and felt like I had a light mask on all night. There also must be a over 50 ingredients in this product based on the label.

The directions say to apply two drops nightly. I assume it means to face and neck only and to avoid the eyes. I could not find anywhere in the packaging as to whether it meant the entire face or not. I just applied it on my face and avoided the eye area.

Results are smooth after use but I would not buy this for three reasons. The current price of $75 is way too high, I don't like the smell, and do not like the feeling of having applied a light mask to my face that I have to sleep in.

title: Brush applicator is lousy and the blue is not rich in color
text:
I have blue eyes and always used the Maybelline Royal Blue Mascara that I can no longer find in stores and which is way too expensive on Amazon. As a result, I decided to buy this mascara and I am very disappointed.

The mascara is not a deep rich blue like I expected. It also goes on very light and the applicator is horrendous. The brush head is a thick and thin twisting spiral that makes it practically impossible to apply a generous helping of mascara. In addition, the mascara almost seems dried out in the tube.

Overall, I'm very disappointed.

title: Anti-bacterial wax that is not as softening as the Therabath wax
text:
I purchased a [[ASIN:B0047RWN3E Therabath Professional Paraffin Bath]] a couple of years ago and use to purchase the this [[ASIN:B000FEKMQI Lavender Harmony Therabath Paraffin Wax Refill]] for it. Those wax refills are six one-pound packages of tiny wax beads in a light lavender.

However, recently I decided to buy 12 pounds of this MAS208 Lavender wax that is anti-bacterial because I was unable to find the Therabath refills. This wax is a deep purple, has a nice lavender fragrance, and the bars are mostly solid except for some liquid (about one tablespoon's worth) in each package.

Although the wax is similar, I am actually not impressed with the results because my hands do not feel as soft as with the other wax. After trying this, I would not buy it again if I can find the other wax since Therabath wax makes my hands doubly soft.

title: This is my "go to" heel / foot file because the coarse concave side smooths out any rough areas on my feet without missing spots
text:
I purchased this on impulse at Walmart for $4.96 plus tax even though I have several other foot files.

I love that this is shaped like a shovel or scoop because the concave side removes the roughness from my heels and the borders of my feet with minimal effort. I would spend a lot of time going back and forth with the flat files but this shortens the time I spend filing and makes sure I don't miss any rough areas. Also, the outside (convex side) of the file works on the sole of my feet if needed.

This will now be my "go to" heel / foot file.

title: Makes my eye area look younger, moisturized, and rejuvenated
text:
Originally, I thought this was for the entire eye but after reading the instructions I discovered it's only for around the outside of the eye.

I've been using this underneath and around my eye for a little while and I do feel this makes my eye area look younger, moisturized, and rejuvenated.

I love the cap design of this "bottle." All I have to do is twist the cap and the applicator pump "pops up." I then press down on the pump to dispense a pinch of cream. When done, I just turn the cap again and the pump recedes into the bottle.

The cream has a light fresh fragrance that is almost impossible for me to detect but which is pleasant.

The only negative to me about this product is the $75 price tag. I would personally not pay that price for this eye treatment. Nevertheless, I am mostly pleased with the results.

title: I only like the fragrance and am disappointed in the packaging which is both unsafe and illegible
text:
I like the sweet floral scent of this skin cream. It goes on smooth but feels like a mask on until it dries. My face felt soft but not really moisturized.

There are many things I don't like about this.

- I don't like the consistency of the cream (jelly like).
- I don't like how it feels like a mask on my face until it dries.
- Everything is written in Korean except for the title, subtitle, and "theskinfood" website (which is also in Korean).
- There are no instructions with the product or ingredients list on the jar. I had no idea whether this was safe to use around my eyes so I avoided the eye area during application.
- I also really hate that this looks like a small jar of honey. I can see children and uninformed adults thinking this is a food item. To me the packaging is dangerous.

The only thing I liked about this cream is the pleasant floral fragrance.

title: Thin but very absorbent when drying my long wet hair
text: I own over 20 of these Turbie Twists in various colors that I purchased over many years and some of which have worn out. They are thin but they really absorb water off my long hair and are easy to tie up. Although the [[ASIN:B00V680TFQ Studio Dry Turban Hair Towel Wrap]] is much more luxurious and prettier than this towel, Turbie Twist is much more functional in that it dries my hair. It also comes in many colors and patterns and can be purchased at HomeGoods, TJX, Marshalls, etc. for a good price.

title: Pretty to tie up wet hair but not terribly absorbent; I prefer the thinner Turbie Twist brand to this one
text: This turban is not as absorbent as I expected. I purchased this in Home Goods for under $6 in emerald green. The turban is plush, wraps easily around my hair, and ties well with the loop and button. I was disappointed with its absorbency, however. It almost reminded me of waxed paper in the way it felt like it resisted water. Although, this is a beautiful turban, I won't be purchasing another one. I prefer the thinner and more absorbent [[ASIN:B00OJ7784G Turbie Twist Microfiber Hair Towel]] over this.

title: I like this as a summer moisturizer; it cools as it goes on, hydrates my face, & smells nice; it is a bit tacky, however.
text:
This is a great summer moisturizer. It feels cool going on and smells great. The only thing I don't care for is that it feels a bit tacky but that dissipates after a while. Other than this, my face and neck felt moisturized and hydrated.

I re-apply after every shower (which is every 12 hours) for me. However, the box says this hydrates for 48 hours yet it recommends I apply it every morning and evening (meaning every 12 hours). This is an inconsistency, of course.

Nevertheless, I like this moisturizer.

title: I did not care for the earthy fragrance but I absolutely love the "smooth as silk" results
text:
Although I do not care at all for the earthy fragrance (what smells like mushroom to me), I love the results.

I applied a light film of the gray mask to my face (avoiding the eyes) and left it on for about 10 minutes (instructions say 3-5 minutes). Although the clay is gray, it looked green after application. It went on easily and dried within a couple of minutes. After rinsing off, my face felt as smooth as silk. Vichy is known for not having English instructions on their boxes that are easily readable. In this case, they were very clear and took up half a section of the box side.

It says that "this mineral rich formula contains Kaolin and Bentonite clay to help eliminate excess sebum and impurities." This can be applied one or two times per week.

The fragrance is the only reason I knocked it down. Other than this, I love this and would actually buy this product. I've tried several of their products in the past and the [[ASIN:B00Q9660L2 Vichy LiftActiv Supreme Intense Anti-Wrinkle and Firming Corrective Facial Moisturizer, 1.69 Fl. Oz.]] is another one of my favorites. I also like [[ASIN:B01GDUM6UC Vichy Aqualia Thermal Mineral Water Gel Facial Moisturizer, Oil-Free, 1.69 Fl. Oz.]].

title: The most slippery substance I ever got my hands on; good soap that cleans well but creates a dangerous shower situation
text:
This vegan and gluten-free soap is the most dangerous soap my boyfriend and I have ever used in our life. It is so incredibly slippery that it is impossible to hold and ricochets off the shower walls and floors causing a very dangerous slip and fall situation. I purchased two bars at Home Goods because it smelled nice. It cleans well but it's slickness is so dangerous that I will never purchase this again.

I forgot to tell my boyfriend about this new bar of soap in the shower and after he showered I got an earful. He said to me "What is it with that soap? The most slippery substance I ever touched was a garden slug and this is worse than that. THROW IT OUT."

Instead of throwing this out, I purchased [[ASIN:B008AFCEJC One Evriholder 623-2 Paradiso Soft Weave Wash Cloth]] at WalMart to enable me to grip this soap in the shower. That is working for me; however, I WOULD NEVER PURCHASE THIS AGAIN. I don't care if it cleans well; it's not worth the risk.

title: Mildly exfoliating & tames a ricocheting bar of soap
text:
I purchased one of these at WalMart for $1.97 plus tax. My main reason for buying this was to hold a very slippery bar of [[ASIN:B00VPUL3RS Saavy Naturals Vegan and Gluten-free Jasmine Handcrafted Bar Soap, 5oz.]]. The soap was so incredibly slippery I could not grip it and it kept ricocheting off the shower walls and tub floor that could have resulted in a dangerous slip and fall situation. As a result, the soft weave of this wash cloth allows me to grip the soap perfectly without dropping it.

I normally use a mesh puff for my shower but decided to try this as well. It is not as exfoliating as it claims because the weave is too soft when wet. However, I like it that way. It also does not suds up like my mesh buff. Nevertheless, I love it for what I purchased it for which is to grip a very slippery bar of soap that would fly out of my hands if I did not grab it with this wash cloth. This gets 5 stars for my purpose and 3 stars for it's use as an exfoliating wash cloth.

title: This is not a typical mask; it rolls on thin, is fragrant, & smoothing but I prefer exfoliating masks to this type
text:
NUXE is a French brand. I buy and use several NUXE products (such as [[ASIN:B000E1EWT0 NUXE Contour des Yeux Prodigieux Anti-Fatigue Moisturizing Eye Cream, 0.5 fl. oz.]] which I love) but this one is not for me.

This is a fragrant anti-aging mask. I just turned the cap to on and rolled on a thin film of clear "serum" on my face and neck, waited 10 minutes, and removed it. My face smelled great because the product is fragrant and my skin felt soft but not plump as specified. Personally, I prefer exfoliating masks to this type. I'm glad I got the opportunity to try this but it was not for me.

One big negative is that it is hard to find the English instructions on the tube and box (both inside and out). The best instructions are on the inside of the box.

If I were the type that preferred a super light mask that feels almost not there and has no exfoliating properties, then I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: Refreshing baby powder scent that lasts all day
text: This body spray has a wonderful baby powder fragrance that lasts all day. I find it refreshing and would definitely purchase this as part of my fragrance collection which consists mostly of Victoria Secret and Bath & Body fragrances.

title: Shaves closer than any razor we've ever tried and hydrates as it shaves as well
text:
I've easily tried over 20+ razors in the last 30 years and my favorite is the four-blade Fusion ProGlide Power Men's Razor with the FlexBall Handle. It's the only razor that allows me to get a close shave and the vibration from the battery prevents me from getting cut regularly. In fact, I turned my boyfriend on to the ProGlide.

Nevertheless, I selected this razor for my boyfriend and both of us tried it. My boyfriend was supremely impressed. His exact comment was "Wow, real nice." He likes the heftiness of the razor in the hand, the supremely close shave, and the hydrating gel reservoir that delivers a smooth glide along the skin.

I felt the same way over this razor except for two issues. First, I cut myself with this every shave but not as much as I do with some other manual non-battery operated razors. Second, since the 5 blades are so tightly packed, the razor clogged more with my longer hair, skin cells, and the Skintimate shave gel I used. My boyfriend did not have this issue as his hairs were shorter and he used Edge shave gel which appeared to be less clogging.

Even though this is one blade width wider than our ProGlides, neither one of us had an issue shaving under our nose (mustache area). The “up and down” flexing head also moves easily with the curve of the body.

I do believe the price of $30.86 is expensive. For that price, one gets a superbly close shave with one razor handle with a 5-blade cartridge attached and 4 additional refill cartridges.

title: Face moisturizer / aftershave is good enough for both man and woman; smells great too
text:
This is a light moisturizer with a citrusy scent for the entire face (avoid eyes). Okay so it's an aftershave, but who cares. I shave parts of my face too (or I'd have a goatee) and even if I didn't, it works wonders as a moisturizer.

I got this for my boyfriend but I had to try it. We both love it. I don't know why it's just for men or marketed as an aftershave. I absolutely love the fragrance and, in my opinion, it feels wonderful on. My boyfriend used the word "silky" to describe it. I would even buy this for myself. Even though I selected this for him, I was able to convince him to leave it at my house so I can use it as well.

The one negative is that the current price of $36 is way too expensive. If this was $24 or under I would actually buy it for myself as one of my many facial moisturizers because it goes on smoothly and does not leave my or my boyfriend's face feeling tacky. (I rated this 4 stars only because of the high price.)

title: Smells wonderful, lathers fully, and leaves me feeling refreshingly clean
text:
This review is for the [[ASIN:B00BIWZ6PI Live Clean Exotic Nectar Argan Oil Replenishing Body Wash, 17 Fluid Ounce]] (not the product pictured).

I love the fragrance of this liquid soap. It not only smells great to me (like Play-Doh); it also lathers up well for a refreshing wash. In addition, it's made with 98% plant ingredients that are "Eco Friendly." I tried their [[ASIN:B01AVE8FEW Live Clean Coconut Milk Moisturizing Liquid Hand Soap, 17 Fluid Ounce]] and that product did not agree with my skin; however, this wash is very nice and I have had no bad reaction to it.

PS - Amazon has posted my review to the incorrect product and I'm unable to correct this.

title: Wonderful coconut fragrance but is so drying on my hands as to cause them to itch
text:
I love the coconut fragrance of this [[ASIN:B01AVE8FEW Live Clean Coconut Milk Moisturizing Liquid Hand Soap, 17 Fluid Ounce]] (not the product pictured) but my hands feel dry after using this and not moisturized as the product claims. Also, I find that it is difficult to wash off. It's made with 98% plant ingredients that are "Eco Friendly" but based on my results, this is not a hand wash I would purchase mostly because it feels too drying on my hands. In fact, my hands started to itch after using this.

PS - Amazon has posted my review to the incorrect product and I'm unable to correct this.

title: I love how this shampoo is not tested on animals; however, I would like more fragrance and lather
text:
I have fine, long, wavy and sometimes curly hair that falls to my mid back. This shampoo is lightly fragrant and is not tested on animals. It did not lather up as copiously as some other shampoos I have tried.

After using this, my hair dried soft and bouncy but it did not feel any more hydrated than the non-hydrating shampoos I’ve used previously. Since my hair is fine, I actually prefer less hydration so this is not an issue for me. Its limited fragrance and lather make this a shampoo that is just okay to me but one I personally would not buy simply because I prefer a lot of scent and suds. However, I do love how this is not tested on animals

title: Wonderfully fragrant with a hint of coconut and gentle on my hair
text: I have fine, long, wavy and sometimes curly hair that falls to my mid back. This shampoo is wonderfully fragrant with just a hint of coconut. I was incredibly surprised that it was not harsh like a detergent because I was able to easily comb through my locks even before I applied a conditioner. My hair was soft and bouncy after using this shampoo.  I absolutely love this. The only thing I did not like was the fact that the top easily unscrews during shipment and some shampoo leaked all over the box.  I took off one star for the packaging but feel this is a five-star product.

title: This is more like a summer body lotion with an antique scent
text:
This is only lightly moisturizing and the scent reminds me of an antique shop; old and musty but not totally in a bad way. The fragrance is from my grandmother's time in the early 1900's.

The moisturizer sinks in almost immediately and leaves smooth lightly softened skin behind. If the scent wasn't so nostalgic, I'd like this as a summer lotion because it is non-greasy and has no stickiness to it.

title: It moisturizes but is not a product I would purchase to hydrate my face and neck
text:
This review is for the "intensive renewal serum" which for some reason is listed under their nourishing cleanser (probably Amazon's mistake) even though this is to be used like a moisturizer. After a shower, I applied this to my face and neck (avoiding the eye area). The consistency is a bit oily but not too oily. It left my face hydrated and feeling moisturized the next day.

MY DISLIKES:

- I don't like the fragrance.

- I usually prefer a cream to a serum type product.

- I do not like how I cannot use this around my eyes (eyelids, etc.) I always feel a face moisturizer should be good enough to apply to the entire face and neck.

- I find the product packaging confusing. Although this is clearly a moisturizer, there's a note on the package that says "nourishing cleanser contains antioxidant Blackberry Extract." To me a cleanser is something you wash with and not something you leave on as a moisturizer. I suspect Aveeno used the message on the box from the pump cleanser that Amazon shows pictured with this review. However, that is not what I received. I received the [[ASIN:B016OIV5K0 Aveeno Absolutely Ageless, Intensive Renewal Serum, 1 Fluid Ounce]] that contains the one "cleansing" message on the package.

In summary, I found this moisturizing but because of my first three dislikes, I would never purchase this product.

title: A face wash where I must avoid the eye area is not for me; also it does not smell so good
text:
When I selected this product, I originally thought this was a face cream (as in moisturizer). However, it's a cleanser.

This face wash is definitely not for me. A couple of times on the back of the tube it warns about avoiding the delicate eye area or any contact with the eyes. Yet it also says it is a gentle cleanser and effectively removes traces of makeup. I use makeup on my entire face, so a face wash that should not be used in the eye area is not very useful for me.

I did try this on the rest of my face and neck. A small amount of product (the size of half of a dime) lathers up very well. The wash feels very slick / slippery. I did not care for the smell. After rinsing off, I did feel cleansed and my skin felt soft. If this skin care cleanser was safe to use in the eye area, I would have rated this 4 stars (taking off points for smell and slickness). Since this is a face and neck cleanser, it must be okay to use on the entire face in my opinion. For that reason only, I dislike this skin care product and would never purchase it.

title: Love the flowery fragrance, the slight sheen, and the weightlessness but my hair felt too dry and not soft as expected
text:
After washing my long fine wavy/curly hair, I applied this mask from root to ends and left it on almost 3 minutes then rinsed it off. After my hair dried, it had a slight sheen to it and the product did not weigh down my hair. However, my hair felt a bit on the dry side and not soft as I expected.

I do love the flowery fragrance and the fact that it's weightless on my hair. However, since it does not condition as well as I expected, this is not something I would purchase for myself.

title: My face remained hydrated even up to 18 hours but I don't like this serum's consistency
text:
I applied this to my face and neck. Since there are no directions on the package and it is not really a cream, I avoided my eyelids. This serum has a very strong fresh scent, goes on smoothly, and did not leave my face tacky. It left my face extremely hydrated even up to 18 hours. The box says up to 48 hours but I wash my face before then. However, i do not like the consistency of the serum. It is a very liquid type cream.

This product is made in France but most of the writing on the package appears to be in Russian. I don't like is that there are no directions for use on the package.

Overall, the only reason I don't like this moisturizer is because of its consistency. I can overlook the strong scent because it is not offensive. Of the three products of theirs that I tried, I like their [[ASIN:B00Q9660L2 Vichy LiftActiv Supreme Moisturizers]] the most and this product along with their [[ASIN:B00HR1KNIY Vichy Vichy Neovadiol Elixir ]] the least. NUXE from France is my favorite brand of moisturizer with Oil of Olay a close second. This is tie with Oil of Olay in my opinion.

title: I prefer their LiftActive Supreme moisturizer to this oil even though it left my skin supple
text:
I applied this to my face and neck but avoided my eyes since the facial image on the directions did not highlight the eye area. Note that the directions are written on the inside of the box, so I had to tear it open to read them.

This elixir has a clean scent and does not feel oily once it got absorbed into my skin, which was almost immediate. Neverthless, I prefer cream moisturizers and definitely like their [[ASIN:B00Q9660L2 LiftActiv Supreme]] over this "oil" even though it moisturizes just as well.

This product is made in France but most of the writing on the package appears to be in Russian. I would really have preferred the application directions to be either on the bottle, on the outside of the box, or as a paper insert inside the box rather than having to tear open the box at the seams to read them.

Overall, I would definitely choose a cream moisturizer over this replenishing oil even though it did a good job of "quenching" my skin. NUXE from France is my favorite brand of moisturizer with Oil of Olay a close second and their [[ASIN:B00Q9660L2 LiftActiv Supreme]] a more preferable moisturizer for me than this elixir.

UPDATE - I've been using these for a couple of months now and it seems I am having a reaction to it. My face appears windburned from this. As a result, I have lowered my rating to 1 star because of my reaction.

title: Expensive because it probably will not last long but it makes applying tanner so easy and effective
text:
I used this with to apply [[ASIN:B00R1CL2HK XEN-TAN Transformation Ultra Weekly Tan Ultra Dark]]. As per the instructions, I made sure to rinse and air dry the mitt to avoid getting fuzz on my skin. I applied the tanner to the mitt in dime-sized portions and massaged the product on my body in circular motions.

What I like is that the mitt is soft, makes tanner application effective and easy, and it allows for a smooth (and not patchy) application of the tanning product. The only negative is that at the current price of $8, I consider this mitt very expensive. It is thin and feels disposable. I doubt it will last beyond 5-6 applications as it needs to be rinsed and air dried after each use.

title: Expensive facial toner that left my face slightly less acne-prone
text:
I always shower first before using any products so that means my face was already clean. I then applied this religiously both day and night for one week before my moisturizing regimen. As instructed, I saturated one pad and wiped down my face being sure to avoid my eyes. Each pad was as clean as when I started. On a positive note, I did not have any allergic reaction to the salicyclic acid as I do with Proactiv's other products that contain Benzoyl peroxide. The only other benefit I noticed is that my face is a little less prone to acne. Other than this, this toner is not impressive enough for me to buy it at the outrageous price of $44.95.

Ingredients in order are:
- water
- butylene glycol
- hamamelis virginiana (witch hazel) water
- glycolic acid
- salicyclic acid
- sodium hydroxide
- portulaca oleracea extract
- polysorbate 20
- ethylhexylglycerin
- disodium EDTA
- sodium benzoate
- phenoxyethanol

title: File is useless, buff is okay, but shine pad is superb and made my nails look highly polished
text:
This battery operated wand should make manicures and pedicures effortless. However, the file did not work on my nails at all. I am only able to get great results from the shine pad.

Included in the package are:
- One electronic nail care wand with an easy on / off button.
- One AA battery. During first use the battery compartment cap must be unscrewed and the red plastic dot removed before the battery will activate.
- Three nail care pads (one #1 nail file tip, one #2 buff tip, and one #3 shine tip).

All I had to do to operate this is snap on the appropriate tip. I used the #1 file to file my nails and tried several times but the filing was ineffective due to the vibration. It appears that the vibration prevents the file from making full contact with the nail tip thereby resulting in hardly any filing. If I turned the unit off and used it as a manual file, it worked fine. However, that negates the purpose of this unit.

I then used the buff tip to buff the top of my nails which worked okay. I then finished the top of my nails with the shine tip. This tip along with the vibrating action of the electronic wand polished my nails to such a high shine that it looked like I put a high gloss polish on my nails. To me this is what this wand should be marketed for with all three tips being polishing tips. It is the only tip I plan to use and the only tip that works exceptionally well with the vibrating action of the unit.

At the current price of 37.89, I think this is overpriced. I do, however, love the nail polishing tip (called the #3 shine tip) and feel they should market this as a nail polishing unit that shines nails to a high gloss shine without any clear nail polish.

title: Body and face wash that stings my face and eyes but feels refreshing on the body
text:
ABOUT ME:

I'm one of those women who use and love men's body wash. (I even wear Men's Infinity perfume on occasion.) I often choose these over others for my shower such as Old Spice, Irish Spring Gear Body Wash, and some AXE fragrances (although AXE is usually my last choice due to the strong fragrance in their products). My most favorite men's shower gels of all time were Glacier Bay, Woodland, Mountain Frost and Cool Spring from Bath and Body Works but the company discontinued them several years ago. Since I love men's shower products so much, I often hide them from my boyfriend.

ABOUT THE PRODUCT:

When this men's product came up for review, I just had to try it. Since this is both a face and body wash, I used it in the shower on my entire body. It has a mediocre lather and does feel refreshing as a body wash. I also like the fresh scent. My skin also felt clean, soft, and moisturized after showering.

This wash is also touted as a face wash. Therefore, I incorrectly assumed it was gentle and safe enough to use on my face. However, it stung my face and eyes even though my eyes were closed. The product instructions say to keep away from the eyes but I never understood how to do that when washing the rest of my face. Since the cooling affect is achieved via the menthol ingredient in the soap, this is also what causes the sting.

I've purchased mint body washes in the past that have the same effect. I prefer a wash that does not sting and which I can gently use on my face as well as my body, but this is not one of them. It is because, besides a body wash, they market this as a face wash that I rate this two stars for the results I experienced. However for the body, I consider this a 4-star wash.

title: No tears, sweet smelling like coconut, lathers well and only mildly conditions
text:
I selected this for me because I figured a baby shampoo/conditioner would not make me tear and I was correct.

This lathers up well and conditions lightly. Running a comb through my hair was not as smooth as expected but I have long hair and babies do not. There's no burning if it gets in my eyes. I also like the smell. I do feel 12 fluid ounces for the current price of $17.95 is very expensive and for that reason only I would choose [[ASIN:B002LTP8VO Johnson's Baby Shampoo, 20 Ounce (Pack of 2)]] over this. However, price aside, this does what it is supposed to do.

title: Goes on thick without being clumpy and lasts all day; also washes off easily with soap and water
text:
This mascara beats out any others that I've tried because it goes on thick without being clumpy and that is exactly what I was looking for. The applicator is a "spiked" flexible plastic wand and does not have any brush bristles like typical mascaras. This enabled me to apply a thick coating to my lashes. What I also love is that it lasted all day (about 17 hours) and did not flake off yet I was also able to wash it off easily with soap and water. According to the packaging, this is also suitable for contact lens wearers.

The only disadvantage I experienced is that some mascara wore off onto the skin below my eye while it was drying. This was almost impossible to avoid even if I stared straight ahead for a minute or two. However, I just cleaned off under the eyes after the lashes dried and was good to go. I'll take that disadvantage any day for full thick lashes.

In summary, even though I'm middle-aged, I like my mascara thick. Thick lashes are important to me because I wear glasses and this enables them to be seen beyond the lenses. This L'Oreal blackest black mascara will now be my "go to" choice. I wish they also sold this in Royal Blue so that I do not have to purchase that color from Maybelline.

title: Quality 5-piece grooming kit for men which this rugged woman finds wonderful too
text:
This quality grooming kit is really geared for the person who likes the finer things in life. Yes, it's marketed for a man but I feel it's suitable for a rugged woman too.

All instruments are stainless steel with a satin finish and come packaged in a supple brown leather case with a zippered closure. There are tiny holders sewn into the case for each instrument. Included are the following grooming tools listed in order starting with my most favorite:

- Flat folding nail clippers
- Sapphire nail file
- Blunted scissors for facial hair such as a mustache, nose hairs, and other small jobs
- Pointed tweezers
- Twin instrument that can be used as a nail cleaner and cuticle pusher

I've used every instrument in this package and love most of them.

The flat folding nail clippers are my favorite. I found them very tricky to use the first time but once I got the hang of it, I was truly impressed. They are flat (almost like a thick nail file), yet when they are opened their cutting ability is the best I have ever experienced in nail clippers. I found it almost impossible to overcut my nails as I have done with other clippers. Also they are easy to grip and use without putting extra strain on the hands unlike all my others.

The sapphire nail file easily and gently shaped my nail edges. The ease and smoothness of this file beats out any I've tried before and is no comparison to an emery board or cheap metal files.

The blunted scissors are great. They open and close easily and cut small hairs with ease (including nose hairs). I really love that they are blunted on the end to avoid the possibility of sticking myself. This scissor far surpasses the one I own now. Over 20 years ago, I purchased a mustache scissor and comb. I used the comb to comb out my eyebrows and the precision scissor to trim fly away hair and cut labels off soft objects like pillows and cat beds. I've also used them for trimming the extra- long hairs on my cats' paws. Therefore, the scissors in this package are a great replacement. Unfortunately, I feel this grooming kit is incomplete without the mustache comb. I believe most men using this for facial hair will want a comb also.

The pointed tweezers are fantastic for removing a splinter or getting rid of that third eyebrow. I even pulled chin hairs with them. One caveat is that since the tweezers are pointed, there's limited surface area with which to grab a hair. Only sometimes is a little more edge needed for grasping those smaller hairs between the eyebrows where the point can actually be a slight disadvantage. Nevertheless, these are wonderful.

The twin instrument is the only tool I get limited use out of. I like that one side can be used for cleaning the nails; however, I find that Sapphire nail file (which has a pointed edge) even more useful for this job. The cuticle pusher works well too but I prefer to cut my cuticles. I definitely will re-purpose this tool to wipe away nail polish around my nail edges when I paint my nails.

According to the package, this set is made in Germany, Italy, India, Vietnam, and China.

Overall, this is a high-quality grooming kit. At the current price of $199.00 I think this is expensive but it is also obvious quality and the leather case is exceptional. I am, however, disappointed that at this price that a mustache comb was not included; to me that is a major oversight on their part especially since this is being marketed for men. On the other hand, I feel this kit is also suitable for women who are a bit on the rugged side. I can tell you this is perfect for me and I plan on using this for years to come.

title: Curls slightly better than my Maybelline curler
text:
I have a [[ASIN:B0031Y0Y2Q Maybelline Expert Eyes Eyelash Curler]] which has flat inserts and which I paid less than $8 for. This curler's inserts are more concave allowing me to get a greater curl. However, I do not feel the silicone insert infused with organic blue chamomile is going to make much of a difference on my lashes. Nevertheless, only time will tell.

This curler comes with two extra inserts. The package recommends replacing the inserts after three months of use. The silicone inserts are infused with chamomilla recutita (chamomile) flower extract which is USDA-certified organic blue chamomile. This product is made in China.

I will update my review if I have any positive or negative results. I do like this beauty product and it does curl my eyelashes well, but I probably would not pay the current price of $18 just for a tad more curl and the promise of conditioned lashes.

title: Mildly exfoliating scrub  that left my face soft but did not wash off easily
text:
Several years ago I purchased [[ASIN:B003BMI628 Neutrogena Fragrance Free Liquid, Facial Cleansing Formula, 8 Ounce]] to try and did not care for it. Since then I have been using their [[ASIN:B00113HO90 Neutrogena Rainbath Refreshing Shower and Bath Gel- 40 oz (Mega Size)]] twice per day on my face. I love their body wash so I figured I'd give another Neutrogena face product a try.

This white tea daily scrub has a nice fragrance. It is the fragrance and the mild exfoliation that I like. The scrub feels sandy on the skin because of its "skin-polishing microbeads" but it is gentle on the face and can be used daily. The recommendation is to use twice daily. My face did feel softer after using this. However, I did not like the texture of the scrub when mixed with water. I had such a hard time rinsing it off my face as it felt gelatinous to me and took effort for me to rinse it all away.

UPDATE April 11, 2015 - I finally finished this and decided I really dislike this facial scrub, so I lowered my rating from 3 to 2 stars. The gel is so difficult to wash off it feels like I have slime on my face. This is definitely not a product I would buy and I'm glad it's gone.

title: Both my boyfriend and I found this cream moisturizing
text:
My boyfriend uses [[ASIN:B00AHH00R4 Gold Bond Men's Everyday Essentials Cream, 6.5 Ounce]] as a face cream so I wanted him to try this moisturizer. I also tried it and both of us really love it.

This is what we love:

- It's a broad spectrum SPF 15 and does not sting the eyes when used around that area. Of course, don't get it in the eyes or it will probably sting.
- This cream is thick and moisturizing. My boyfriend loves that it takes a while to rub it in his face because he says it sets the moisturizer and prevents him from missing a spot.
- I did find it a bit greasy but he did not.
- There's no alcohol in the ingredients, so there's no drying effect.
- The price is reasonable for three 2.5 ounce tubes, especially if a woman uses this. The reason I say this is because many women's SPF face products in this size cost $15 to $50 and more.

Overall this does moisturizes very well leaving the skin supple and also protected from the sun.

title: Pale pink lipstick with a matte finish that glides easily on my lips and feels moisturizing too
text:
I have fair skin and this pale pink lipstick, which has a matte finish, glides easily on my lips and feels moisturizing. If it had shine and some shimmer, I would love it but that is the only thing missing for me. I do love that I can apply this light color over (or under) a darker lipstick to tone it down. I often mix lipsticks and this is just perfect for that. I also like this as a summertime color for my lips when I tend to wear lighter lipsticks.

The color appears to be geared more for young girls than women because of its pale pink; however, I like it enough that I would purchase this when the tube runs out. It also smells nice.

title: Pencil liner glides on smoothly, lasts all day, and washes off easily with soap and water
text:
This liner glides on smoothly and defines my inner and out eyelids very well. Usually I have to use a cigarette lighter to melt eye pencils so that they go on smoothly. I did not have to do that with this one. It also washes off well with soap and water but resists coming off with just water. I scrub around the eyes twice with soap and water using my fingers as I do when getting off all make-up. It would be nice if I could just dial the pencil when the tip gets worn but I don't mind that I have to use a sharpener with this pencil. Overall, I love it,

I would consider purchasing this pencil liner if I ever run out of Shade 01 which appears black to me although I wish they would have just labeled it a color I could understand instead of with Shade numbers.

title: Solid moisturizer for skin and hair with a sweet coconut cream fragrance
text:
This "solid" coconut oil is designed to moisturize skin and smooth and soften damaged hair. Nevertheless, I do not like this at all. I tried this on my hands and feet which require a lot of moisturizing. Although, it moisturized somewhat, it does not compare with others I've used before.

This is my experience:

- I had to "roll" the solid core on my hands and feet to release (melt) the oil using my body's warmth. Since it is solid, I would have to warm it to melting in a hot water bath if I were applying this to my hair.

- I really hate the sweet coconut cream smell. It reminds me of coconut cream pie and is nothing like the wonderful fragrance found in the Hawaiian Tropic suntan lotions I love.

- The oil felt very greasy going on, although it did smooth out and soak into my skin after approximately 15 minutes. My hands and feet did feel soft and smooth after the wait and this was the only positive point about this product.

Personally I don't like this because of its sickly sweet smell, its solid consistency, and incredibly greasy application. Even though it did moisturize, these three negatives helped me decide that this oil is definitely not for me. I own moisturizers that are much better than this, smell great, and are easier to work with. My boyfriend tried this as well and did not care for this solid oil either; he said it was just okay.

One of my favorite oils is [[ASIN:B000H0SCCG BioSilk Silk Therapy 12 oz]] for both skin and hair in liquid form. Another good oil which comes in solid form is [[ASIN:B005AO9SLS Elemis Spa Home Frangipani Monoi Body Oil, 3.4 Ounce]] for both skin and hair, but this does require the work of melting in a hot water bath. For just skin, two of my favorite deep moisturizing creams are [[ASIN:B000LUXNV2 Camille Beckman Glycerin Hand Therapy, Camille, 1.35 Ounce]] in the Camille fragrance and body butter by Cirese C. Skin Therapy (see comments section for a link to her site).

UPDATE Dec 31, 2014 - I could not take the smell of this product or how oily this is going on and decided to throw this out tonight. The main reason was because the smell was so nauseating to me.

title: Silky coral-colored blush that goes on easily and lasts all day
text:
This blush comes in a tiny yet pretty compact with mirror but no applicator. The color of the rouge that they call "shade 03 teinte" is what I would call coral or salmon with a pink and orange hue. I really love the "marbled pink enamel colored" case that it comes in.

I found this very easy to apply and even after applying translucent powder over the blush, I could still see the color on my cheeks. The blush is silky and stays on all day. There's not much in this compact at 6.5 grams (0.229 ounces) so it will last me about two months. Overall, I like this makeup.

title: Jean Nate changed their ingredients so that the fragrance is putrid blend of pepper and spice; another customer lost
text:
I've been buying Jean Nate for about 30 years as I loved to splash it on after a shower. In fact, I loved it so much that I purchased over 15 years worth and just ran out. Well they changed the recipe and to me it's absolutely horrible. Jean Nate made this into a COMPLETELY FOUL FRAGRANCE. I purchased this a few months ago and just started to use this last night. The fragrance smells like some horrible peppery spice and (thankfully) does not last more than a minute or so.

OLD Ingredients list from my previous bottle (This list is also a different recipe but it was much better):
SD Alcholoh 40-B
Water
Fragrance
Aloe Extract
Retinyl Palmitate (Vitamin A Acetate)
Peg-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil
Benzophenone-2
FD&C Yellow #5
D&C Green #5

These are the NEW ingredients:
Alcohol Denat.
Aqua (Water) EAU)
Parfum (Fragrance)
Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract
Tocopheryl Acetate

title: Heavenly fragrant hand cream that leaves my hands silky; it is comparable to Cirese C. and Camille Beckman creams
text:
I've purchased many many hand creams and body butters over the last 22 years. However, I have a few favorites and this hand cream just made my list as my third favorite.

One of my favorite hand creams over those 22 years was and still is [[ASIN:B000LUXO2K Camille Beckman Glycerin Hand Therapy, Glycerine Rosewater, 8 Ounce]]. (I only like the Camille fragrance in this cream.) However, at a local craft fair a couple of years ago I discovered the ultimate hand cream. It is actually a body butter by Cirese C. Skin Therapy (see comments section for a link to her site). I fell so in love with her body butter, which I use as a daily hand cream, that I purchased 30 jars at once.

Therefore, this hand cream has difficult competition and surprisingly it is almost as good as the above with two slight differences. [[ASIN:B00EIS8980 Antica Farmacista Hand Cream, Bergamot & Ocean Aria, 2.5 fl. oz.]] is as heavenly and strongly fragrant as the Camille Beckman and Cirese C. Skin Therapy products. The only differences are that this leaves my hands lightly moisturized and feeling like silk. The other two products leave my hands deeply moisturized and feeling soft. This hand cream is not as long lasting as my other two but it's perfect for the summer months.

I absolutely love this hand cream and am definitely going to try the other fragrances. Since this is a light moisturizer, I would only use it in the summer months where less moisturizing is needed. I think anyone who loves a heavily fragrant, lightly moisturizing cream would love this. I know I do.

title: Ooey gooey lightly-colored lip moisturizer
text:

I'm going to use this to lighten some dark lipsticks I have which will reduce the stickiness. I definitely won't be purchasing this again.

title: This made me very itchy
text:
DISCLOSURE:

I am an Amazon Vine Reviewer that gets free products in exchange for my reviews. Normally, my review would have the following warning in green at the top "Customer review from the Amazon Vine(tm) Program." The reason this review does not show this green warning is because Amazon canceled this order before it shipped but then several days later shipped me the product anyway. Therefore, I want the readers to know that I did not purchase this item in case that is a concern to you and because I feel like it's stealing if I don't review all the products I receive, I decided to submit my review anyway.

REVIEW:

Normally I am not a fan of creme or moisturizing body washes because those types of soaps always felt like I was showering with hand lotion. However, one day I decided to try [[ASIN:B002Z7EOOE Olay Total Effects 7 in One Body Wash, Deep Penetrating Moisture, 15.2 Ounce (Pack of 2)]] because it was offered under on the Vine program. I absolutely fell in love with that body wash and have since ordered it many times under the subscribe and save program. Therefore, when I selected this body wash I expected a product that acted the same as the Olay body wash. Unfortunately, my experience is extremely disappointing and here is why.

- It lathers lightly.

- It feels like I'm washing with body lotion.

- The fragrance is off-putting to me -- it kind of smells like Aloe but there's no Aloe in the product.

- It leaves a residue on my skin which I am fine with on the Olay product but am not pleased with it on this product because I do not feel as clean or smell as fresh as the Olay product makes me feel.

- I tried to use it for 7 days to see if it "visibly enhances skin's beauty in one week" but was only able to tolerate four days because it itches me. Each day that I used this product made me itch more than the day before. However, the itching was not bad enough to make me scratch but it was almost getting to the point where I would be scratching soon. Originally, I thought the itchy feeling was because of dry skin but because I moisturize heavily I discovered it's definitely this product. I have very sensitive skin so there must be some ingredient in here that doesn't work for me. The only part of my body that does not itch are the soles of my feet and my hands.

I will make sure to never ever buy this product for myself. As far as I'm concerned this creme body wash gets ZERO stars.

PS My review for the Olay product I mentioned is in the comments for those who are interested.

title: One lotion softens my face the other irritates it; applicators are innovative
text:
There is a lot to like in the AINHOA Specific Extreme Pack as well as some things to dislike.

First, the package comes with two products (Extreme Plus Repair and Extreme Eclat Instant). The instructions, which come in every imaginable language, mention there are four AINHOA products available; however, only two are supplied with this package. There is only one tiny paragraph for each product in English and those instructions are pretty much useless because it really doesn't say when to apply these lotions, how much, for how long, etc. I assumed the repair lotion was to be used before bed and the instant lotion in the morning since it said that was ideal before makeup.

After several days of using Extreme Plus Repair (the one with roller ball applicator) before bed, my skin became irritated, dry and itchy. After several days of using Extreme Eclat Instant (the one with brush applicator) in the morning, my skin was soft and smooth. I did not "see" any noticeable improvement in my face from either lotion but I liked the softness that resulted from using the Extreme Eclat Instant. I love the brush applicator the best and although I am not fond of the roller ball applicator; both applicators are extremely innovative.

PROS

This comes in a really nice case with mirror (white exterior with navy blue suede-like interior)

Applicators are innovative and rich looking (I really think the vendor should license their applicators, especially the brush applicator because they are unique. The brush applicator could be used on many products such as self tanners, sunscreens, etc. )

The Extreme Eclat Instant left my face feeling smooth

CONS

Expensive

The Extreme Plus Repair irritated my face and left my skin feeling itchy and dry

I broke out with more pimples than usual and I believe one of the lotions is responsible

Instructions are useless

Not much solution is provided (only .68 ounces in each cylinder)

Personally, I would not purchase this product because one of the solutions irritates my skin and it is too expensive at the current price of $99.63. If both lotions worked well and exceeded my Oil of Olay products (such as Total Effects) and the price was in the $33 range, then I would have rated this 4 or 5 stars and would consider purchasing it even though there isn't much product provided.

title: Like body butter for the face; incredibly moisturizing for me but way too expensive
text:
I love trying out face creams so when this came up for review I just jumped at the chance to sample it.

To me it was almost like applying body butter on my face. I found it to be quite thick. However, I really like that consistency for its incredible moisturizing affects. Yes it was slightly greasy or tacky but this type of cream on my face (and body) during the winter months is very soothing to me and offers me protection from the damaging affects of the wind and cold. So I did not take off any points for the body butter feel; however, I would not use this cream in the summer.

I was able to apply it to my entire face (including eyelids) and it did not bother my eyes like some creams do. Another thing I like about this product is the beautiful triangular purple jar it comes in being that purple is a favorite color of mine. The fact that this cream is not tested on animals is another plus.

So why did I rate this 3 stars? First, even though it moisturized my face well, I did not find it any better than the [[ASIN:B00005JTW8 Olay Total Effects 7-in-1 Anti-Aging UV Moisturizer, SPF 15, 1.7 Ounce]] which is one favorite of mine but is not as thick. Second, the price is absurd at $135 especially since it works as well as my Oil of Olay.

However, anyone who does not mind the price and likes a thick and heavy moisturizing cream that is not tested on animals, might consider giving this a try especially for the winter months up north.

PS - This product is from Switzerland.
