title: Surprisingly good razor that gives a smooth shave
text:
I was skeptical when I turned on this razor because the blades don't move, instead the razor just vibrates. However, this razor is absolutely wonderful. I shaved my entire body except for my head and torso and it gave a close shave. First I tried shaving without turning on the power and the razor felt sharp. However, once you power it on, the vibration allows it to glide smoothly over your body. When I shave with my normal razors I always get pin hole knicks all over my body (about 8-15) and come out of the shower bleeding. With this razor, I only had one knick--simply amazing. Because it gives a close, smooth, and knick-free shave I absolutely love it--5 stars all the way.

I also had my boyfriend try it and he said it was great, although he mentioned that the blade was too large (due to the five blades) to shave under his nose easily but he could get use to that. He also said it shaves as close as his ordinary razor. He gave the razor 4 stars instead of my 5.

UPDATE October 19, 2013 - I've been using this razor regularly and have gone though several refills and still love it. I only cut myself about three times in the three years I've used this.

UPDATE June 23, 2014 - After 4 years, this razor has finally died. The seal holding the battery compartment is no longer leak-proof so now I will order another one. I love this razor and have used no other razor (except to try one or two new ones that I got for free).

title: Miracle oil. Don't hesitate, get this!
text:
I love Mad Hippie and really trust their products. Did you know that many organic, high-end beauty retailers selling oil serums use oils which will naturally go rancid in a really short period of time? I'm talking, 3-6 months from production of the oil. Think about how long it takes from the oil to go from production, to being used in the creation of the product, to be packaged by the manufacturer, to be shipped to Amazon/retailer, to get to you... by the time you get it, you could be putting rancid oils on your face! Yuck! I looked up all the ingredients in this product and none have a short shelf life.

Now, for the product quality. My skin was very nice and healthy to start, but I noticed that after a few months of using this product, the my pores became noticeably smaller in size. It also helps pimples to heal faster. Now this oil is my go-to before and after my period, and whenever I see signs of starting to break out. Just 3 drops is enough to saturate my face.

My husband has really sensitive skin and used to get a bad razor burn on his neck after shaving, even when using the proper lotion, aftershave, etc. He began using this oil on his neck 12-24 hours after shaving and his neck looks much better than it used to, and he says it feels better, too. It is a product for the whole family!!

I have no illusions that this product has the highest possible quality ingredients, but I've done extensive research on antioxidant oils from other natural beauty retailers and I've stuck with Mad Hippie because (1) the oils won't go rancid on me in a few months and (2) the price is 20% of what other organic, natural retailers charge for potentially less product. My skin has seen improvements with these ingredients and I'm sticking with them!

On average we used 2 drops a day every day and this bottle lasted 10 months. The oil does deteriorate over time. We stored in a medicine cabinet in a bathroom in an un-air conditioned environment (but we only have 2 months of hot weather in New England) and it started smelling a little off after 8 months. (For EO newbies, heat and humidity degrade oils, so bathrooms aren't a great place to store, but closed medicine cabinets in bathrooms are better than nothing.)

If you want to extend quality beyond 6 months, an essential oil pro tip is to buy a smaller bottle and transfer some of the oil from the larger bottle, then refrigerate to extend the shelf life. If you're storing in a food fridge, put the oil bottle in a plastic bag or airtight container it case it leaks or breaks - you don't want it ruining your food.

title: Fun fun trend… dries so FAST and easy to go on blemish free!!!
text:
Had to post how smitten I am with the polish.. uncertain of metallic- it’s a really fun trend and doesn’t look out of line or inappropriate. Nothing “Goth” like for work, school, church, dress up or date night!! Don’t get me wrong.. Some colors add a fun flare like a Neon but, may have certain places it can appear tacky- IMHO! Sally Hansen metallic in purple lilac color doesn’t wear in that capacity. Color feels appropriate for preteen and up. As 40+ yr old.. I too actually loved the whimsical vibe with underlying solid color for balance.

As for polish itself.. never used anything like it- goes on evenly and with no tack or grainy feel in its consistency. With adequate paint on brush (and not overdoing it!) paint pulls a perfect stroke.. I say this bc, polish practically dries as you move on to paint the next nail! Crazy helpful it’s sooo easy to paint the whole set. Best yet, you wont be like me- and mess up polish waiting for it to dry!! This by far my favorite aspect.

Note: I tried/wore polish all x3 options and ended with same results- so, in the end it’s a personal preference!

1. Single layer without a top coat. Simple dries beyond fast, looks a tad more matted but still offers a bit of a sheen adding nothing else. I suggest painting to reach all edges in smooth longer strokes. Apply trying for perfection and bc it sets quickly- it should set without any oops! Leaving this the only layer you need.

2. Two layers of paint and no top coat.. this didn’t cause premature peeling due to thickness. It wore just as long as single layer did. IF wanting to achieve deeper color with a second later, you can.. but, 2nd coat won’t drastically darken like some paints- x1 layer gives plenty of color- So, use/not a x2 coat..? I’d say a 2nd layer if needing to fix stroke or blemish.. otherwise, isn’t really necessary!

3. X2 coats of metallic paint along with quick dry topcoat! I must add- this process took longest to dry.. even with quick dry aspect. This adds a bit more of a glossy finish- but, not enough to get a polished chrome effect. Polish alone does have a subtle shine- it’s not flat!! Using X3 layers also last same length of time before needing to redo. But, having x3 layers did peel off in large pieces as it began to lift up in water.

Photos included are just x1 layer of polish painted x14 days ago.. as you can see, this wears off at tip when it begins to lift. I believe site states polish lasts a solid week- and although nails look a bit tattered.. it will give you some idea of wearability. Polish is on natural nail without a base or top coat. Bc results didn’t vary I prefer x1 layer of paint- and use of clear top coat if fixing an error.. otherwise, that’s it! Something I’ve never been able to pull off, except with this metallic polish.. I think I found a new bff- ability not to bump while dying is priceless and speed at which nails can’t be done.. perfect!! Sorry, so long-winded wanted to share a great find- hope this helps.. stay safe everyone!

Made for a man.. Hmm?!! Sure it has a nice ocean scent- depends on who you believe rules the sea.. Poseidon or calypso?!! Ofherwise, I see no reason this cant crossover for either sex!? Don’t over apply.. a dime or nickel size dollop can do the trick.. especially on shorter “men’s” haircuts! (too much and hair will become weighted down!)

Love flip top nozzle design and its simple x1 hand control.. easy and mess free! *Note: if bottle won’t disperse.. look inside cap!! protective cover was wedged into our lid.. must remove prior to use! A higher price gel that brings higher focus to hair health along with gel properties- great for those who want a soft ‘hold’ but with a lot of definition! title: Wow!! Took a risk and it paid off.. love it when that happens!
text:
After becoming smitten with Savauge by Dior I loved everything about it.. but the price. (yes! I’m referencing Johnny Depps guitar playing ad and his inspired cologne.) Looking for a solid alternative that carried a similar note.. I found article that listed this as a solid option and decided to take a chance- BooM.. I’m so glad I do as, it’s payed off big time- yet, it’s only 1/4 the cost!!

I find this so refreshing- and one that truly does smell sharp and sexy on a man. You know.. the kind that the more it heats up and gets “worn in” throughout the day.. they seem to just get better..?!! This cologne seems to do just that! It has a deep woodsy yet airy fragrance mixed with a refreshing fruity blend.. and I’m telling you it works! Ordered for my husband- my 19yr. old has taken to it with gusto! Apparently used once- girls at work were oogling all bc of the fragrance and now, he’s a true fan!! For any who remember polo in the 80s (green bottle/gold horse?) it has that same type of effect as it wears on..

Trust me- i know how hard it is to choose a fragrance by someone else’s opinion/interpretation- so if it helps to know.. my guys usually wear: men’s Hilfiger- original scent, Calvin Klein eternity for men, Drakkar.. I do admit as the female- I choose the scent! The above list are my fav.’s and truly it’s been decades since I’ve found any thing new or worthy to add to the classic 80/90’s lineup… Ha, that was until now!!

My only dislike is longevity.. this definitely needs a reapplication if poss. during the day. But, certainly if planning to go out that night- you’ll need a refresh. Do not expect anything overbearing or even too intense as first applied. This settles in and is pleasant right out of the gate! Cool bottle easy to use- if on the fence.. it’s worth the risk! Hoping this info can help- sorry, so long winded! Stay safe everyone..

title: Blade not close enough to trim or may be put in backwards? No instructions included..!!!
text:
Unfortunately, this is an item we needed to send back.. after owning x1 almost identical for approximately a year- the motor somehow died and needed to be replaced. For the price point, I wasn’t disappointed in its x1 year lifespan- and chose to replace with same item.

Only this particular razor is a look-alike of the same one we owned bc exact option we had wasn’t available.. Problem is, this does not in any capacity, cut and/or shave..at all??!! It’s almost as if there is no blade included- and yet there is! Yes, we remove the safety cover, and I am not for certain.. but would almost guess the razor blades sharp edge is connected wrong side out?! So, instead of trimming.. the razor edge just glides long doing nothing at all??

I’m guessing we have a fluke… As we had luck the first time with this style razor. However, at this point, all I can do is return and start over and see what the results bring.

Otherwise, this is a substantial built device with a lot of extra pieces that I do not know how to operate or change out. No detailed specifics were included with our purchase to do so… maybe we received one that was incomplete? I’m just not certain- it does include tools, but no directions… It also comes with a replacement blade, but I do not want to except if the first one isn’t working!! This charges really well overnight and can hold its charge for a day up to a week- depending on how often it’s used. This has a red charge light to let you know when it’s powered to charge.. and blue when it’s ready.

I can’t discriminate against completely because we had decent results choosing this style razor in the past. However, whatever we have received is lacking the necessary quality control to function in any capacity… Especially, as a Christmas gift! Hopeful that replacing will bring us positive results! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.

title: button placement issues!! Adequate output- ion does not alway equate to faster drying!!
text:
**UPDATE: so, after a few months of courting- I I actually appreciate far more than in beginning. It consistently gives me the same solid results. However… The button placement- UGH!! Easy flip buttons allow for a touch of the thumb to adjust- awesome.. But, placed on the handle where you grip- And I’m sure, you can finish this sentence.. these constantly flip temperature or power off. Definitely something One! would have tested prior to production.. right?! From my starting point I’m liking better than ever- yet feel it’s only fair you know, you may be having a love-hate like I do with the “button bumping!” (X6-8 on/off oops a dry.. and that’s while trying to hold it like a quirky teacup hand!)

Ionic hair dryer 2200 Watts produces a nice smooth end result- It’s best for controlling frizzies and removing excess heat damage to the hair. Don’t mistake that “ionic” translates to the fact it will dry hair Uber fast bc, it’s not always the case! I find this a smaller (more directed) nozzle for air output so it’s not about speed but rather, solid specific heat for smoother end results. Especially noticed if using the varied nozzles and straightening brush.

Even with a smaller nozzle for drying the overall size of dryer is substantial.. so, depending on end-user/length of hair this may cause a bit of wrist fatigue depending on time needed to dry- and something to keep in mind prior to ordering. Cord has solid length and ability to be used with any of the x3 varied heads or without one just the same. I do wish this had a carry case to contain all parts- mine did not include any type bag, etc. *A bathroom cosmetic bag can do the trick And keep components together!

One of my favorite features is ability to clean out motor filter.. doing so prolongs life of dryer itself and keeps your drying time to a minimum! I’d suggest cleaning filter every 30-60 days depending on usage.. I don’t notice any real difference in noise good/bad compared to standard dryer. I find material is easy to grip and hold steady in hand.. I’m unsure of button placement interfering with grip.. time will tell. all expected options for speed, heat, cool shot. Would be a solid edition for multiple users or household- bc of its ability to pivot! Hoping info helps decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: Love this is environmentally friendly…
text:

What can I say, this is inspiring as it will single handedly eliminate SIXTEEN bottles from the landfill- that is so AmAzInG!!! The efforts and purpose are profound in my opinion- and I get hopeful at the idea of impact something like this could have if used in every household!

Talk about a great deal- 16 refills for $10- the best deal I’ve ever seen on foaming soap. *Do note: NO BOTTLE INCLUDED- you must provide the foaming bottle- and it must be a bottle with foaming pump. tbh, I kept a soap bottle I purchased earlier and it works perfect so, one can definitely up cycle.

Fill bottle 2/3 with warm water- place tablet inside to dissolve.. with lid OFF!!! wait 15min. till tablet dissolves and I stir to be sure it’s mixed thoroughly.. then, top off remaining h2o and replace lid. That’s it- Small effort to have such a big impact! Soap is appropriate to use in kitchen or bathroom for hand washing. Hoping info helps your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Read UPDATE!!! After having solid results… iron failed 30 days post use!!?
text:
**UPDATE: after being SO HAPPY with this flat iron.. I’ve been left out in the cold after a month of use- literally!!! I went to plug in iron like usual and it displayed code: 99… would not heat etc. but obviously had power to give me a code at all. Tried a few days later.. now the code is 62.. anyone know what this means or how to get $109 flat iron back to working..??? If not- I cant endorse with good conscience. Work so great and then- failed… WHY????

As one constantly looking for that perfect flat iron that can handle the work.. I’ve found this to be a total contender! I’m surprised at its slim design yet, tool still feels completely solid in hand. Nothing cheap nor, hefty/bulky about it.

Cord has ample length for reach- ideal when using with hotel travel! (I find there’s never enough outlets!) No issues with plate being loose to grab or snag.. 100% quality control.

Easy to read lit LED temp. and one you definitely can see/feel distinct temp variations. I tested this at lowest, med., highest settings.. Doing so, you actually feel exterior temp of the hair iron get cooler or hotter with these adjustments. I had zero issues reaching 450° which is temp. I must use for unruly thick, curly locks that I blow dry and flat iron straight.

Iron heats quickly but I do give it 2-3min. just to have solid all over heat results.. When in continued use- iron maintains temp. approx. 5-7min. before I feel a need to recalibrate.. Simply, an iron in use will lose heat in transfer. Giving a moment to regain that loss/disbursement provides a more even, all over heat in the end. For those who need hair tool longer then 10min. I bet you’ve experienced this as well… Most impressive aspect is how long this iron can maintain and also recover heat. This is where the flat iron steps up in spades..!!!

At higher price point- you’re buying the quality of a hair tool meant to do its job and do it well. Hoping info helps your decision.. stay safe everyone.

title: Pricey product that brings results…
text:
Quite a higher price point for cuticle oil- I assume it’s bc it contains all natural ingredients. I’m also guessing product being 100% natural is the connection to its sustainability claim- Nothing included gives facts otherwise. If for personal use… a smaller bottle will last longer than I ever anticipated.

Built in dropper attached to the lid helps to control amount dispersed.. don’t forget- this is oil!! A little goes a very long way- so less is more. A small drop can be massaged and spread into skin afterwards. *Careful until it’s absorbed.. oil will stain!! I made an error bumping a hand into my white T-shirt which is now stained with oil marks from my fingers.

Stronger fragrance but not off putting.. it will dissipate as it’s absorbed. Stronger scent isn’t real unusual or unexpected when using all natural ingredients.

Overall results: this softens and moisturizes not only cuticles but the surrounding area of the nail bed, nail and skin itself. A great option for use after a rigorous manicure, those in medical profession washing hands multiple times a day, use of latex powder gloves, exposure to cleaning products, synthetic heat, winter dry air.. eczema- anything to cause dryness on hands and cuticles. Hoping info can help your decision.. stay safe everyone!

title: Heavier then expected- better on day #2..!!
text:
Small bottle of hair serum I chose for my frizzy fly aways- using only recommended amount on wet hair (a MUST to remember.. less is more with this!!) I start at the ends + move toward scalp, it is thicker than others I’ve used in the past. *I had best results when spritzing product with h2o. Product moved smoother and felt far less heavy. Styled with a roll brush and blow dryer- it kept frizz/fly aways in control but…

Definitely a product you must play with and adjust to individual hair types- not uncommon with this type of hair oil. Not as “no nothing” as name of product states.. albeit that’s very tongue-in-cheek!! I find this works well- it just takes some trial/error to disperse right amount. On natural curls.. found best to use wet and let hair air dry- dab any trouble spots once dry if needed.. this is where oil works it’s best magic!!

Overall, I’m 90% happy with results. No matter what I try or adjust- the product feels just a tad too heavy in the hair.. that is until day #2. Then, it’s far lighter on 2nd day hairstyle!!? Note: I do not add product again (no product on product!) either by absorption or pillow removal- hair feels about right on day 2… something I’ve yet to create on my own with first try- but, like day #2 a lot!

Rinses out with a good shampoo scrub- doesnt dry hair or leave buildup. No staining on clothing or linens.. scent is a non issue. It is quality at higher price point- only after a dzn. tries I’ve not quite got the perfect remedy. Hoping info can help your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Starting set for beginners- can add to over time-
text:

A very economical way for beginners to try and not spend a lot of $. This is a nice starting set that could be added to over time. Hoping info can help your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Be smart- use gradually to avoid a mishap!!!
text:
Can appear a bit overwhelming but, don’t be intimidated… It’s doable for even the most unsure of husbands- at least in our case it was! I want to provide simple overview to back up my claim…

This has 2 products included and when using- put a pump of each smack into same hand to activate- now apply to hair. Try not to get all over skin, forehead, ears like you may with normal shampoo washing- if you oops.. have a wet washcloth ready to wipe it off! *IF you have trouble spot of gray- apply to that section first.. just to ensure this gets ample coverage and longest time on hair. (this can be applied during shower… However, be sure to clean shower immediately following so no staining of tile/grout/porcelain- a sprayable bleach works fab!) this has set of ear protectors to keep dye off skin- optional to use. I find wet washcloth works just as well to wipe if needed but, we have short crew cut hairstyle (long hair may need to use?)

Product comes with disposable gloves- however, bottle has approx. 4-6 applications.. So, wish it included a pair for each application and not just one set like received. One can apply w/out gloves but note- product can stain hands.. so wash with soap immediately following or, get a few extra gloves to use as needed.

First time application- be careful!! purpose for this method- is to create gradual transformation, a more natural look if done over span of time- you can achieve that! Follow guidelines for length of time to leave on.. error on less until you know how it affects ALL your hair! **trust me on this.. you’ll thank me later. It may color gray if left on longer- but, don’t forget it’s also depositing color to ALL your hair.. IF you don’t want to look like you stepped off the Munsters TV set- or have every person knowing you’ve colored your hair.. be patient and use gradually.

When done- rinse 100% with lukewarm h2o. No need to condition it’s included in shampoo- and that’s it! Repeat process x1 week till desired color… then, apply every 10-14days to keep desired color from fading.. sure! A bit of a commitment but far easier and more natural not to mention healthier on hair then alternatives. Sorry so long-winded… Wanted to clarify. Hoping info can help your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Great price for a solid moisturizer…
text:

All leaving colors with an enhanced wet look or sheen. Not sure if it’s actually going to help for retaining color permanency down the road.. but, it does brighten them up when used! (they say the quicker skin heals post a tattoo- the more it encapsulates the color deposits. In that aspect it should be beneficial bc skin healed really nicely post the trauma!)

Note: this is not the sunscreen! Keep in mind this does not pertain SPF- which is always best to use and protect colors from fading. **Also.. Newly tattooed skin should stay out of direct sun until fully healed! Skin is vulnerable to burn and should be protected as such.

For $10- this is a generous amount of moisturizing cream made to help effected skin heal and return to its natural state. Hoping info can help your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Works like magic! Gave teen his confidence again!!
text:
it’s a fact… Everyone’s genetically different which has an effect on the way we even perspire! Adopting our youngest at 3yr old.. we actually took a course the “keeping and care” of multi cultural and diverse children- an entire night was dedicated to the different needs in hair, skin, hygiene care.. and it matters- these differences are important and real. Forward to now and my 19yr old asked his mama to help with perspiration issues. Not easy for any, especially a teen his age! Looking for options- I found a solution in MJC Body powder for men.

Fact is.. we use baby powder post bathtime with infants to absorb moisture on their delicate skin. Under arms, chin, diaper area… Any place moisture likes to hide in cracks and crevices. So Genius! Why can’t we do the same thing with adult issues and boom- MJC was there!! A solid way to absorb with a fresh, clean scent.. Microsize shaker openings remind me of a kitchen spice bottle- A little extra effort to disperse but also controls the amount.

Better yet- this gives a user confidence.. and that is worth everything!!! It’s hard to be a teenager- and all they really want is to blend in the biggest of ways… at least not stand out for being stinky sweaty. Thank you MJC!! I recommend to any struggling with perspiration that is irritating, obnoxious or embarrassing- after x2wks. in play.. The difference has been uplifting and amazing for us!

A bit pricey but for those who have struggles- it’s an ideal and healthy way to attack problem at the source! Hoping info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone.

title: Has great qualities and see this only getting better..!!
text:
Wow! Such a different concept- this is smaller then I expected- (see photos included to compare sizing) I do suggest using with a slatted soap dish so it can stay dry.. For obvious reasons, if bar stays wet it will melt/dissolve and waste product.

I find lathering in hand and placing onto hair still creates a solid application and fixed my angst!

What I love about this concept is the “going green effect..” Saving our planet from so much wasted plastic and packaging.. this concept alone deserves praise in that regard!! I also feel that being in a new space with this idea/concept.. we’ve only begun to see what it can do. It is a solid option and definitely a positive on helping the environment- hoping info can help make your decision.. stay safe everyone!

title: A solid option for a straight smooth look..
text:
Appreciate the feel of this flat iron in the hand.. It has quality substance- doesn’t feel cheap, hollow, or toy like.. so it takes direction really nicely. Weighted to give the iron merit when clamped- it allows that slight need for pressure all without excess stress on the wrist. A great perk for thick or long hair. If straightening takes a fair amount of time.. a heavy hair tool can cause fatigue to the wrist.. TECHMERI is great for minimizing that!

Buttons are tucked away from accidental change of temp. Cords swivels as expected.. and LED makes it easy to read- but for any struggling to see.. use my hack: turn off all lights and let the #’s glow- they’re far easier to read in dark!! Ha.. you’ll thank me later for that tip- trust me!

Truthfully this needs at least 2 solid min. to gain its desired heat level and calibrate. If not, heat will dissipate into hair unevenly.. Not having even distribution only creates more work and swipes in the long run. (I find this is true with most ‘instant heating’ hair tools- sure! they begin to heat once powered on.. But, calibrated heat is KEY for best results and hair health- yesss!! Another you’ll thank me later secret!)

Overall.. hair tool can provide solid results at a price under $50. Used with heat protectant hair is left smooth and without frizz. A solid contender for daily use. Hoping info can help make your decision- stay safe everyone!

title: Great for longer hair.. either thick or thin!!
text:
This has a surprisingly nice tightness to its spring-clasp mechanism.. making it a solid option for twisting up a full head of hair- regardless if thick or thin..!! Great earthy spring colors add a fun pop without being distraction or obnoxious..

Teeth along the jaw offer an inverted angle to help dig into hair keeping it in place.. all without digging into scalp! Length of hair isn’t really a factor bc, excess hair spills out from the clip.

**When one is ordering sizes- pick the length of clip based off the location you will place/wear it.. ie, this is obviously made for the backside of a head bc it’s 4” long. Smaller clips 1-2.5” can be used to pull hair uptop to create the half spout or half pony. Under 1”’can be used for bangs/sides. *Just note: anything 4-6” is most conducive with back of scalp (banana clip style) or even used at the nape of neck to hold hair aside via those varied styles.

IF.. wanting to clip ALL HAIR tucked into a bun- this style clip may work but might be tricky for longer thick hair.. IF wanting to contain all hair- personally I’d recommend a bun clip!! Those are approx. same length but more oval rounded in shape to fully encapsulate a bun/twist and a full head of hair.. Bun clip is purposely made with excess space when jaws are open to fully hold it all hair content in.

Made up of solid plastic that doesn’t feel flimsy- teeth feel strong and are closely spaced.. fact you tend to lose a tooth/claw over time- closely spaced is nice as it may still be used and hold as expected. Easy enough to open wide this has plenty of spring push back to stay closed in resting position- exactly what you need to have this stay in place!

Whew.. sorry! A lot to say for a little pack of clips- but knowing style and size helps ensure success!! Hoping info can help in your decision- stay safe and beautiful everyone.

title: For $ you get a lot.. but has a few quirks!!
text:

title: Swipes on but also swipes right..
text:
Searching for the perfect eyeshadow- I wanted to love, as there’s such ease behind a shadow stick. Problem is, these do not glide on with any real merit of depositing color.. at least not in shade I was expecting anyway!! After enough swipes to get coloring desired, I find most shades in my set have a lot more orange or red than depicted.. at least on my Icelandic fair/light skin! I ordered: Set E.

title: When something’s too good to be true.. Hmm?!
text:

title: This is quality and results are instant..

title: Great colors! Solid for DIY home salon girls..like me!
text:
As one who doesn’t take time, effort, energy doing their nails at a professional salon.. Yet, wears polish daily- translation: I paint my nails at home myself and have for few decades. Ha! I love the quality of the Pronto Polish set!!

The best application regiment for polish to adhere longer/stronger to natural nails is: apply a base coat so polish sticks solidly.. Next, apply 1 or 2 color coats (2nd coat usually provides most even finish.) Final step, a top clear coat to finish/protect.

Well, I never follow this method! I use x1 coat of colored polish and x1 clear top coat (NO base coat or 2nd layer of color..) And as you see in pic’s after 15 days of wear and tear- this HASN’T CHIPPED A BIT!! In photo one can see tips beginning to wear- but, that is it! *I’m not easy on my nails which makes Pronto Polish even more impressive. Im using household cleaners daily- including bleach and this polish can stand tough with merit (even though it takes a beating on my hands..!!!)

My secret = ONLY USE 2 LAYERS TOTAL..!!! I dont follow guidelines bc, x4 layers is just too thick! *thick polish will peel up and chip off far easier and sooner on natural nails. After decades of trial/error, I’ve tried every combo and the best I’ve found, is to pick either a base OR a top coat..and use nail color that is solid quality- just like Pronto!!

Polish itself is creamy with a wide brush for slick application.. colors are quite vibrant-even with just x1 layer. Bc application goes on so bright/smooth.. a 2nd “correcting” coat isn’t needed. I also notice as I’m completing the 1st layer of color.. the polish is all but drying before too coat has begun. I used “Sophisticated“ love the earthy tones! $15 for x4 is solid deal. Hoping this info helps your decision- stay beautiful!

title: Enhances curls does not create them!
text:

title: Perfected product with quality results..

title: Not best option for thick, curly hair..!!

title: Shuts itself off after 5min- on purpose!!?
text:
For any with curly or “bent“ hair who prefer a straight style vibe- you know the importance of a quality flat iron! As one with very thick, naturally bent hair.. i’ve tried them all in every $ range. I’ve found expensive doesn’t always equal the best.. a few all time fav.’s have actually been hidden gems! I find TYMO flat iron is 3.75/4.0 of 5 stars- Here is why..

Coolest on/off ever- complete with sound effects!! Once plugged into power.. Turn on by just a “wiggle or rotate” of the barrel! Yep, you heard me.. wiggle and its on. Then, 10sec. later you’ll hear another chime to indicate temp is reached, and again with chime when auto shuts off takes place.

Structure: Curved barrel edge creates ringlet or, flip + tuck curl at the end of straightened hair, a 2 in 1 bonus. Matte finish provides a nonslip grip along with rubber finger tip and it’s lightweight on the wrist- a total must for those who have a longer straightening routine.

Heat: states it heats in 10 sec. and sure! Iron begins to warm instantly.. But, to reach a higher, even, sustainable heat like I need. It takes approx. 2-3min. Not a dealbreaker.. Tbh, I find this is the norm with most flat irons. *plates DONT lock shut to help retain heat.

My issues: although this states a heat of 450°- its not hottest I’ve used and with thickness of my hair- I need the heat! But, my big angst is with “rapid shut-off” which happens after sitting 5min. w/out movement- NOOO!!! I want to heat iron while blow drying- and bc it takes me 15min. to dry- I’m left turning iron back on 3-4x just to keep it warming and ready… NOT HELPFUL!! I get the safety of an auto off- but, after 5min.? This is a nuisance… not a perk.

Priced at $39- this has plenty of positives.. including its sweet blush pink color! Just be aware of idiosyncrasies prior to choosing. Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe!

title: Wont dry out hair.. helps curl go BoiNg!
text:

-I appreciate the clamp to keep closed while heating- but, careful.. not sure how- but, I’ve caught skin in the bend when clipping x2.. and it can hurt!

title: Not all dryers are equal- this has what you NEED!!!

title: Can maintain heat well- better yet, DOES NOT SNAG!!!
text:

title: Solid- it save $$ and the planet! A total win/win!!!
text:

text:

Being a family of pure Icelandic descent, this type of attention is vital to our shower regiment- Especially, in winter with drier, artificial heat amuck.. our skin needs kindness! What I appreciate about Dove… Is the fact they have such a great line of lotions and moisturizers to use post shower- and these always complement each other really well.

Product is a perfect consistency.. it has a solid amount of thickness- easy to squeeze out from the bottle yet, not too thin to cause drips running directly into the eyes! I love this produces a nice fresh lather- NOT bubbles but, a “lather!” (um, yess!! There is a difference!) The scent matches the bottles yellow lime shading.. Ha- It’s zesty! Nothing about this screams it’s a ‘must’ for men only. Other then the fact; it isn’t floral, overly fruity or, feminine looking in its appearance.. The scent is super refreshing and a great wake up with its zesty citrus scent. Crisp and clean.. Its invigorating. Stronger when wet and dissipates after drying.

I recommend pairing with a body lotion to keep skin hydrated. Dove line has plenty to mix + match. Personally, I couple this with Dove infant or, Johnson’s baby lotion- giving the right amount of rehydration for those who need A small dose.

Definitely recommend for anyone looking for something that has ability to be appealing to men yet, is perfectly acceptable for women as well.. at a price point of just under $25 x4 - It is the quality you are paying for. I hope this can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

title: Hardest working deodorant Ive found in a long time!!
text:
In a world where mega name brands rule the anti-perspirant industry.. yet, seem to have forgotten the recipe to making a solid, stand up, hard-working deodorant!! It’s a bit surprising to find the solution in a smaller name like Schmidt… But, boy did they hit it out of the park with this one!

As one who needs a working deodorant for adults, teenage boy and college athlete age kiddos- this is a one stop shop! I realize the rose/vanilla scent may seem feminine- but, this isn’t a florally fluff!! The throw is a fresh and clean scent- it has a dryer sheet vibe about it.. meaning one that you can smell after it’s applied-like fresh clean laundry! (which is far better than body odor by a mile!)

Application is rather smooth but, does necessitate 2-3 swipes- If needed.. I also found, a touch up goes on just as smooth, if you’re heading out for the night… and can confidently last through to the next day! There’s no clumping or pilling of product noticed when in use.. Ha!
Using with multiple color fabrics has not been an issue with residue.. and that includes an all black soccer game uniform- this has yet to leave any staining on the fabric, bonus!

Being of pure Icelandic descent- to say we have sensitive skin is an understatement. This uses natural ingredients and has paid special attention to leaving out harsh chemicals- keeps it from adding irritants. So far, adverse reaction.

For a 3 bundle- it is a higher price point at $18.. but, you’re paying more for better quality return. Overall, the Hardest working deodorant I found in a long time!
I hope this info helps your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Smells clean and fresh- scent lingers too!!
text:
This is a clean refreshing scent made for men but, there is nothing that says it can’t cross over! IF, women aren’t wanting the fu-fu flowery smell.. this is a deal for 4 large bottles- for a price point of $16- this is a better discount vs. Purchasing separate.

No, this isn’t hair wash 2 in 1- although, nothing says you cannot apply. However, the amount of lather this creates… May be hard to rinse thoroughly if used in the hair!
For a family with sensitive skin.. this can be a bit drying- something to keep in mind if dry skin is an issue for you. title: Not all inclusive- applicator is out of case!!!
text:
Cover girl is a trusted name for decades so, it was a good place to start when searching for a pressed powder compact. The item is from their Clean-Fresh line.. and it seems to fit the bill! Case is easily accessible yet, protective.. which is so necessary with make up to avoid breakage!

Comes in a clear/pink feminine flip top case (see photos above) clasp is not difficult to open!! Interior lid has a quality compact mirror… One you can actually see real detail in!

**TBH, Im still holding out for the makeup line who decides to create a contact with a replaceable pallet and save the planet and $ from tossing these out when it’s empty or spent… This would be the perfect case to do that with because, it boasts longevity in the quality all around!

Choosing skin color online is difficult at best- however, these seem to be as described and photographed on website. I chose a medium warm- and it as expected. A rule of thumb when should always follow.. if between 2 colors, always error on the lighter side. Doing this worked out perfect for me.

One thing I did not realize, didn’t like and the reason to keep me from giving 5 stars so, take note.. the applicator does not enclose inside the compact!! This is my pet peeve.. I understand wanting to keep germs from transferring… But, it defeats the purpose when applicator is freely shoved into a makeup bag. For myself, this gets make up applicator for yuckier then, if it’s in closed in compact itself. This will be a dealbreaker from me ordering again..

As for Application and longevity: this has easy transfer and applies smooth. I do not use over any primer but, like to apply to just a fresh washed face. Easy enough to place evenly.. length of time before touch up would ideally be x4-5hr. However, I have made it threw the whole day without primping and still have a fair amount of coverage in the evening. I’m not noticing any shiny or, oily patches.. So, the product and self stands solid. I’ve also notes NO skin irritation or break out.. and that is fabulous especially for those with sensitive skin! I hope the info can help your decision.. feel free to let me know!

title: Salon product offered in a great bundle..!!
text:
If matched with the proper hair type, Nexxus is a solid and proven brand. One that is capable of doing its job… Just be certain to select the specific formula for your needs. This is best suited for wild, thick and heavy hair that’s been salon processed, damaged.. or, just thirsty for a drink! (This isn't good for stick straight hair.. as leave it far too heavy and greasy.. my daughter tried and it was way too much for her straight hair.)

Shampoo has a refreshing smell that dissipates after hair dries.. I appreciate simply bc, I don’t want to smell like all the hair product, body lotion, fabric softener, etc.. I use so, consider this a perk! Shampoo creates a small amount of lather in a non sulphate sort of way.. I’m familiar with the lather free idea and why.. but, for me hair washing needs something- to let you know it’s working!! Rinsing on lukewarm helps extract product easy.

Conditioner is an equal important piece to the set! It doesnt take much- so, remember less is more! If, hair begins to feel heavy.. i’d suggest alternating with different conditioner every other wash. When rinsed, hair feels tangle free and manageable, just like conditioner should! (deducted x1 star due to fact- if, using as instructed for intended hair type.. this can weight down the hair- even though listed as use for daily conditioner..)

So, be sure to choose the right focal point for your hair needs. 33Oz bottles are great and you’ll love the ease they offer coming “pump prepared!” As long as you have the right formula.. these won’t disappoint. I hope this info can help your decision… Feel free to let me know!

Note: these larger Size jugs can be heavy and cumbersome for older/younger people in a shower setting.. especially when they are slippery and wet! If so, it may be best to pour 1/2 content into empty 15oz. bottle just to lighten the load.. refill as needed!

text:

title: Perfect for dorm use during covid.. love it!!!
text:

Great idea for a gift as, mine will go home with college kiddo to use in her dorm- she can even start a small business on the side ha ha..!! I hope this info can help you.. feel free to let me know!

title: Smells nice but, dissipates fast…
text:
I truly wanted to like this and was counting on it big time.. I color my hair and have the hardest time keeping the ash blonde from going brassy- So, my stylist recommended try washing it every 2-3 days.. only, this drives me crazy because, hair doesn’t “smell“ as clean as I’d like! So, I set out for a solution and hair perfume seemed like the perfect fit!

In theory, I have no problem with the scent- I find it in the same wheelhouse as using a fruity shampoo. So, no complaints there. I personally chose the apple/berry flavor and it’s harmless. What doesn’t work for me is how fast the scent dissipates after use- if, the whole point is to have hair get a refresh of scent- then, it should last about a good couple hours.. text:
For someone who loves Pureology and I’m a total fan- this one missed the mark for me. $26 for just over 3oz- I expected this to be fabulous.. and at the very least, perform its task at hand. I’m sad to say I found a pureology product I don’t care for- moment of silence please...Ugh!!

title: Hyaluronic Acid Works like wonderful witchcraft!
text:
Waited a month before writing a review so, I could get you solid feedback and it’s pretty impressive. I appreciate the size the jar for the price paid, feels like a decent/fair amount. Love the fact that Neutrogena has been a trusted brand name and that goes a long way when trying any new product..
Skin type applied to is: 100% Icelandic light, fair and sensitive skin for both, myself and my two girls. We have always struggled with finding a good facial solution because of our skin type- Things seem too harsh, oily or, simply leave things worse than when we started! This product provides a nice way to get a good balance for tone repair with the added bonus of moisturizer and if, I’m not crazy- I feel it has a hint of sun protection.. But, I can’t lie as, my favorite ingredient is the “Hyaluronic Acid“..I have become a lover of this and have had such great results when using in a product.. So much that, I won’t buy anything without it!! Neutrogena includes Hyaluronic Acid in a few different facial products.. and they’ve been such great finds for myself- and college age girls! (of course, different ages need different product types but, the fact is.. we all are wanting our product to have the magic ingredient- Hyaluronic Acid!) Way to go Neutrogena facial line..

30 days in and I’m a fan! I have found slow but, steady improvement. The first week things seems to be way off- almost as if my skin was calibrating.. and tbh, I almost quit- so keep in mind to be patient!! However, it began to balance about the end of the second week- I knew I had to keep going bc, I loved how skin started to look/feel.. and from there, it just seems to be holding its own and looking good!! I am not sure if I’ve hit a plateau.. but, my plan from here is to use every other day.. just to see if, I can get away with it and not need 7 days a week. (FYI, I am 40+ yr old.. and personally, I’m not the best at liking a long drawn out nightly routine “have too..” it makes me feel old!) However, I’m willing to go back to everyday if, any decline begins..

Less is more people!! I found this out the hard way and believe, it may have been part of my issues during the first week. I feel it’s easy to get into the mindset… If, we want something new to work and do it quickly and see results- then, using more will help do that.. Um, NoPe!! I suggest start with a small dime size amount and just work it into skin softly… Be sparing under the eye, (at least for myself it tends to irritate there for some reason).. and then, spread outward. After one month use I have over half a jar still- and yes, using in small amounts still produced big results!
Hope this info can help your decision- feel free to let me know!

title: A few adjustments can improve results!
text:
My review is using both shampoo/conditioner as a set. I did so for an entire 30 days- and have posted results from that point of you.
When staying blonde via help from a bottle.. The kiss of death is BRASS!! You all know, the orange and yellow undertone that makes its way to the top- like sneaky witchcraft about the 3-4wk. post your salon visit..??!! My stylist has taught me- BE PREPARED.. Have purple shampoo AND conditioner ready to counterbalance brassiness when coloring hair blonde, platinum or, gray.. NOTE: you should use BOTH shampoo and conditioner as a set to get the maximum effect.

Using this color mask products in platinum had a few pros and cons: these were priced fairly for both as, most may know- any quality color correcting products can be very expensive! Bottles were easy enough to use and product is easy to get out.. The product itself is not very thick! Unlike most correcting pshampoo and conditioners I’ve used of this nature, this has a liquidy feel to it.. **be careful- it can run into your face/eyes quite easily, trailing purple where ever it goes! NOTE: if this gets on tub or shower tile, a quick spray of cleaner with bleach will remove it easy enough. The content is darker in color.. and I have found, this is a good thing.. The darker pigment helps tame brassiness far better! As stated, I recommend one uses both, shampoo and conditioner as a set… It can be very counterproductive otherwise. The biggest perk I’ve found with this product- IF, using the appropriate amount for the recommended amount of time.. your hair won’t get the violet hue that can appear when using purple color correcting products and this was huge for me! But, in order to avoid the “violet halo” -you MUST follow stated time and amount!! Actual smell of product is not an issue- which is nice bc, some of these can have strong chemical smell and be very offputting!

For daily hair washers: I recommend using this only 2-3 a week max! Mask hair products are very drying on the hair in general.. So, you’ll also need a good conditioning set of product, along with this to use intermittently.. trust me, it will help keep hair from drying out and feeling healthier. For those not washing daily: keep a close eye on condition of hair!! If hair is feeling dry and brittle.. more then, usual for treated hair- you will want to mix this with a quality conditioning product as well.. and this was me!! I try to wash every 2-3 days to sustain color life etc.. I noticed this product is harder on the hair then I had hoped. I’ve tried a deep condition to counter balance- but, after x30 days of using.. I feel I can give very accurate results which are the fact- i’ve struggled to maintain a healthy amount of moisture In my hair- something I had previously to using.

With all color correcting products… it is about finding a healthy balance. This product has ability to fight off brass and unwanted undertones in colored hair. Just keep in mind, it does so with a good amount of drying to the hair. To recommend using… I would be sure one pairs the use of this set with a quality conditioning hair product as well.

I hope this info helps… Feel free to let me know

title: Gives the user ability to customize their own wipes!
text:
These are made to work where it matters most!! Purely raw and natural! Don’t expect a wet wipe (or, wet of any kind!) or, preconditioned towelette that you activate in h2o.. this is a Kleenex soft cloth pure and simple made to use with product of your choice as the active agent. Keep in mind, that agent can just be water itself! (personally, my go to favorite is rosewater!! I’ve recently been introduced and become a total fan! Yes, I feel so old + grown up now..!!) For the record, this most resembles a glorified and fancy tissue! Stronger then, Kleenex but, same softness.

• Soft as Kleenex.
• Stronger then, a paper towel When wet.
• Disposable bc, it’s actually not cloth.
• Can be used in small portions (yes, even cut!)
• Works great with your own product of any kind.
• Can be used dry as it has imprint to help clean or
remove any dirt/germ/debris.
• Can get wet without becoming mush even in h2o!

This is a go too for anyone needing that in between tissue/hand towel. Using with product makes it great for make up removal/face washing.
*Hack: These would be great for kiddo’s in a dorm who have limited access (Or limited effort ha ha !) to do their laundry and wash adequate face towels! They could use these to stay on top of hygiene w/o issue of needing endless wash clothes for sure!

Perfect product for those wanting to use their specific “go to” product to wash face or, remove makeup.. Basically, these giving the user the ability to customize a wipe for their needs.

Love these come in 4 separate pouches. One order can be shared in different bathrooms in a house- yay! Plus, opening x1 pack at a time- keeps all unused wipes clean/fresh till needed.. a nice perk.

Definitely a newer concept reaching the market- one I feel that will be well received. Just know what you’re buying- A dry, stronger disposable cloth to customize to fit your needs. Under $10, this is a decent price point for product received.
I hope this info helps… Feel free to let me know!

title: Good qualities- but, trial/error to see if its a fit for hair type!
text:
This caught my eye when searching for a different product.. And after being referred back to this brand from a list found to “meet my hair needs..” I was excited to give it a try. But, to get the full affect, i felt it was a must to try both, shampoo and conditioner combo. In conclusion: I found, conditioner seems better for my hair when used with a separate brand shampoo, not as a complete set.

•Love the bottle, Love love love it! The pump is so handy- Personally, I think it should be a law all hair products come this way! Once you’ve had the convenience of a pump, you will never want to go back to any other top! Especially with larger bottle, it makes things so convenient and helps one use the appropriate amount and not over pour!

• This is 33oz. and sold at a price point around $15. For a brand with the natural qualities the pricing seems respectable. I find this product falls between those in grocery store isle and exclusive salon line.. ..It’s right in the sweet spot!

•This brand boasts all naturale, no harsh chemicals and it’s a vegan friendly product! Being made of pureness, it should not dry or, damage hair but.. actually replenish moisture. I didn’t notice any unwanted drying effect to the hair- but, I’m not certain if it’s replenishing much moisture either? (this was using over 3wk period, washing 2-3 days apart..) This does help tame frizz and flyaways- and that is always a plus! Especially, in dryer summer weather!
•Substance: this has a thick feeling but, lighter texture. **Be careful… the product is deceiving and making you think you need more than you do! A little goes along way.. Doing this will keep hair from feeling limp or weighted down! Trust me, I had to play around with this myself..

•Rinsing: This can be one of the frustrating aspects with conditioner (esp. if you have soft h2o!) This passes test, as it isn’t difficult at all! I do rinse on cooler temp. which helps to remove all of product easier from the hair. Hair feels soft and relaxed after using/drying. I haven’t had any issue with hair squeaky/rubbery feeling in hair...a positive for sure!

•Smell: can be a bit strong but, not offensive- just not my Expectationlavender scent. FYI- smell dissipates after drying.

Overall, this is nice in the hair that is thirsty for a drink! It has good features and seems to protect from frizzies. I prefer conditioner separate from the shampoo- for some reason, the combo of both is just too heavy in my hair.. Personally, this may need to be trial/error to see if it soots your needs- As, all hair types are created so different. (For ref. I am 40+yr old Caucasian with thick blonde shoulder length hair.. I use salon coloring to keep color where it should be- or, where I want it!)

Hope this info helps.. feel free to let me know!

• This brand boasts all naturale, no harsh chemicals -sulphates, and vegan friendly product. When using I do feeling I’m truly cleaning my hair… But, I’ll be honest- I dont have knowledge of each ingredient and its do’s/donts! I follow advice from my stylist and it always helped quite well. This does work up to a lather- yet, I’ve been told that’s not needed/necessity for hair washing.. I’m not sure where this leaves the “no harsh ingredient”.. So, keep that in mind..?!

•Having Caucasian blonde, THICK, shoulder length hair.. blonde that has been color enhanced for the past decade! (When I was coming up 40yr. my color decided to be blah blondish- so ugh, I’ve been hard on my hair since with enhanced coloring!!) My issue with the results: after 3wk. trial.. hair feels heavy, slippery and lacks post wash freshness/bounce that we all love after shower/blow dry routine. Yes, Im using correct amount + rinsing thoroughly and on cooler temp. I’m guessing it’s due to Aragon oil and as much as my dry/damaged hair should love this- it just helped the hair fall flat. When getting body art of any kind… One must treat the aftercare regiment with the utmost importance. This tattoo care kit has a quality and professional vibe to the overall product… Everything is appropriately marked, labeled with ingredients and comes safety sealed. This gives one confidence in the product they are using. Personally, that goes along way in my book-
For anyone wanting an all-inclusive kit for body art after care… This confidently gets my vote!
I hope this info. helps... feel free to let me know!

title: Love the colors and ease- only, it lacks staying power!
text:
Love the Color palette and the ease in which these glide onto the eyelid- they arrive fired up and ready to go… And that’s just what we did!

•Glides on smooth like melted crayon- no sticking or, skipping. Arrives in a sharpened point ready to color.

• After color is applied it can be further blended with your finger or, applicator, smudge brush.

• Color palette is earthy and warm.. and still it offers hues to create a Smokey shadow effect as well.

• Price point is spot on… You get 6 shadow Crayons for $7.00- yes! That is for all 6 colors.. what, what!?!

•Each eyeshadow crayon has its own see-thru lid, which stays securely in place- great for purse or travel.
BUT—
• Eyeshadow struggles to stay in place and not, smudge or smear. Does not seem to have a drying or, setting factor to it. So, If touching the eye area after application- the shadow will come off.
* maybe this could be eliminated with a setting spray/finishing spray? I however did not try it- I’ve used these products in the past and had an adverse skin reaction.. so, unfortunately, this is not an option for myself.

•This set of eyeshadow crayons needs a fatter size sharpener.. ours did not come with, for the price point I’m not disappointed! Most of us have this item in are makeup Arsenal.. but, just a heads up- in case you don’t own.. you’ll need to purchase larger size sharpener to keep pencils on point.

•Shadow pencil do comes sharpened/ready to use. Keep in mind- at its sharpest point… This still has a thick vs. fine line- this is expected with eyeshadow vs. liner.. Yet, some do like to create precise, fine lines with shadow. Note: this is more along the lines of a brand new crayola crayon point... sharp but, fat!

I’ve ordered several things from A2Z make up beauty collection… Everything So far, has hit the mark and I wanted to love these just as much. My issue is with the staying power once applied. I love the color palette and for the price, I’m sure I’ll find a way to put these to good use.. however, in wanting a low maintenance morning routine- this issue will keep me from getting just that. Just know, you may need to blend with powder shadow or setting spray, to get longevity of wear.
Hope this info helps… Feel free to let me know!

title: Love the set covers all basic needs!
text:
Happy as can be with the three set makeup brush.. I ordered these to accompany with the A2z blush palette and glad I did.. the smaller brush of three, is a perfect to fit on the single 1x1 square- but note, this could be used with the A2z brands set of blushes.. or, any other blush of your choice! The small brush has a contoured edge with just enough angle, that it can be very precise to add the desired amount of blush to a specific spot/zone on the cheekbone.. If, using more then x1 color in different places on the face, like I do- this brush is really handy for that (I use it to transfer x2 colors and x1 highlighter to the desired ‘zones’ on my face!) So, Small size for application.. then, after placement- I like to switch out to the bigger of the 3 brushes and use the pouf to blend them in!

All x3 brushes have a firm feel to the actual brush.. tbh, I like the firmness with the smaller size brush- But, prefer a bit more softness in the larger poufs.. I think the softer pouf helps glide along the face easier and this helps with natural blending. Don’t get me wrong! This large size isn’t rough in any way- it just lacks a little extra touch of those oversized style brushes can feel/be so, so soft!

The connections of all x3 brushes to the handle feel sturdy and strong. No loose ends or movement in the handle construction at all. The bristle of the brushes all seem soft enough and cut to shape and size as expected.. and these a natural (not synthetic!) bristles!! overall, for the price point being under $10- this is a great 3 piece set that really covers the basic needs.. and for anyone wanting a good/standard set, this does not disappoint.. these 3 natural bristle brushes can do their job and do it well! I’d definitely recommend..

title: Natural earth tones that really pack a punch..!!
text:
I’m loving the Color palette... it has a wide variety of natural/earth tones and I've found, it is a great way to bring out the natural color pigment of ones eyes! (Mine are hazel with green/orange undertone and various colors bring out the green.. other color mixes, I see the orange fleck.. really these make the natural eye color pop!)

Don’t be fooled by the natural color scheme, one can still create dramatic affects without the use of bold, synthetic colors! This color scheme has a great combination for making a rich smoky eye and with the colors included, it seems to be a match with almost any skin tone- A few colors have a translucent shimmer (not a glitter, at all!) this is a subtle but, fun addition. Again, doing this with a natural hue does not take it to the extreme or, give a gaudy look- and in a current world of lash extensions, micro blading, tattoo lining, the list goes on and on.. I feel one can appreciate the natural color scheme for sure.

These come in their own individual containers.. they have a twist off lid and although they arrive attached to a single plastic pegboard holder, these are removable and can be taken out and used individually. (I put the X3 of the little compact discs in my bag.. and I can swap out colors at any time.. I’m loving that!!)
These don’t come with an applicator- I used my finger.. and tbh, this is something I don’t like to do- I prefer the small wand usually included.. so, I chose to order some and use with application. When applied to the lid, the shadow itself has decent staying power- I can apply in AM and have there at the end of the day. If going out for the evening, it may need a bit of touch up. But, no more then anything else..
Over all, I’m enjoying the subtle fun one can have with all these colors- as a 40+yr old.. I may not want to put on the magenta/teal shadows I used in the 80’s- But, I still want to have fun with makeup and this allows one to do just that!
With a price point under $10 one gets a dozen shadows.. trust me, if ordered you won’t be disappointed.
Hope this info helps.. feel free to let me know!

title: Best find on Amazon in a while.. total deal!!
text:
Are you kidding me??!! This is a total of nine varied shades of blush in one compact component… All for under $6.00..?!! Most of us know- this is a steal of a deal.. It’s very likely, you could pay more for just one single color- total deal, I’m shook!!

One can use a brush you already have or, purchase one to go with it..)
Definitely worth making the purchase- and for the price you can’t go wrong.

Hope this info helps… feel free to let me know!

title: Nude Rose is a dark deep color.. nothing nude about it!!
text:
Ok, WoW!! When I see the word “Nude” in the color I am on the right track for makeup- However, Nude Rose- was much darker in color then I could even have expected!!? When this arrives I assumed it had to be the wrong color palette sent to me.. only, it was not.
So, take note- NUDE doesn’t mean subtle as we may think when matching make-up.

I appreciate this blush is infused with the highlighting perks that are such a hit and fun to use right now. This does however.. give off a bit of glimmer/shimmer.. a tad more then I was expecting. I used Honest beauty product in the past- and I’ve always had great success. Somehow, this one missed the mark for me. Being of pure Icelandic decent- I need I color that’s a bit more subtle or “nude.“ If not, make-up can look a bit comical or theatrical.. unfortunately, this did both with my skin tone.

To avoid the issue I had with matching color… I would definitely recommend, read reviews and view photos provided so, you may get an accurate idea of the color you’re expecting. Sometimes the names of make-up Can’t be trusted.
I do appreciate this is made talc free… It goes on a lot lighter and is much healthier for your skin. I also see the benefit of the shimmer infused into the blush.. if color is appropriate, it will add a nice highlighting feature without creating the need for yet, another product.
The compact comes in a securely closing palette which is nice to keep loose powder from escaping.. and even better for traveling! This is priced on the higher end for blush- but, keep in mind… It’s like getting a 2 for 1 with its added effects. Totally annoying and it’s just my pet peeve, this does not come with a make up brush Just FYI- However, this I do realize is best applied with a nice puff, blush brush!
I also have used a handful of Honest products and they are great quality.. So, if looking to invest and you find a good color match, this may be worth the extra cost.
I hope this info helped.. feel free to say so!

title: Great combo pack with softer color.. great for beginners!
text:
Simple straight forward blush and highlighter combo.. this does need a blush brush, as it doesn’t come with one- just FYI!! This was an ample size compact that offers a nice amount of actual product (some as we all know- can fake us out by selling a bigger case but, inside the product is barely 1/4 size of the total case.. ugh!!) this has a secure lid closure.. which ladies, we know this matters! (if you’ve ever had x1 pop open in your purse.. 😫, you can appreciate a secure lid!!)

The convenience is a blush and highlighter in ONE compartment. These can be used separately or blended (by using large/smaller applicator brush) personally, I prefer to blend both- so, side/side is most convenient. I expect using highlighter will give a glowing effect and let’s be honest, isn’t that why we want to use..? To bring a “shot of life into our makeup routine?!” Well, if you’re worn out and tired like this mama is… This is a good “fakeout” for the look of a blah, pale, and pasty skin tone that tends to appear in winter months! Using blush/highlighter combo, gives a ‘pick me up’ of being kissed by the GLOW from the sun… The highlighter accentuates your favorite features with a brighter bit of light! (Its not the tan look!) *this works without looking like the girl with the “fake tan” face! its a dab of radiance that aides the -full of life effect.. its more fitting then, bronzer in February!!
The color I chose was bling and my only request would be, if the blush itself had a bit more contrast or, power. I feel the highlighter does a great job and I’m assuming, even though the color I chose matches my palette.. i wanted it to stand out more on apples of my cheeks! if a richer blush color… I would get the preferred results. I’m one that prefers to use minimal amount of product, and see it go a long way…a bolder color- and I’d have my cake and eat it too!!
For reference I am pure Icelandic and have always had fair skin. Translation: I’m the girl always needing to create the “illusion of color “ with product. Doing this is an art that is perfected over time and trust me I’ve had almost 30yr to do just that... (I had a great teacher in a pure Icelandic grandma who’s responsible for the gene of gifting her skin tone to her granddaughter!)
Bling is a perfect shade for anyone beginning or wanting to dabble with highlighter. It feels subtle/safe yet, you can definitely see the effects… My issue, I’ve come to like a certain look of Apple cheeks blended with minimal effort!! That’s helped this girl fake her lack of vitamin D!!
Great use of combo packet and a great place to begin with minimal risk!
I hoped this help inform.. feel free to let me know!

title: Smaller travel size make up bag for any user..
text:
Very quaint, and love the fact it’s not too crazy or, in your face bold/loud print... making it a very good option for an adult or, younger crowd alike!
No! it’s not a “grandma flower curtain print”.. yet, it feels subtle and welcoming enough for grandma to appreciate. (If that makes sense?!)
