title: Such a fun activity for ANY age.. we loved these!!!
text:
Being a family of body art in the permanent way… And I’m sure! For a lot of those in this same category you can probably attest along side me, the urge for always wanting to get more permanent ink (can almost be addictive!) However, feeling that way, I’ve also got a unique scruple to always consider... being married to a person who thinks “less is more“ when it comes to the whole body tattoo forever art… My adult children/self are forever trying to strike a respectable balance- when getting a tattoo, it’s done with the idea in mind, that “we won’t break our dad by overdoing it!” (size/location/choice.. they all DO matter!!!)

**THIS product- is also a real handy way to decide if one is wanting permanent ink- or, even a location decision. Sure, it may not 100% give the full or exact effect. However, if deciding on a specific location, size, or color for permanent ink… One could try temporary tattooing the area with something similar but, do so in tattoo pen (make it comparable in size/local)… Then, wear it around until it wears off and see what you think?!

Boom..!! Which brings me to these BODYMARK TEMPORARY TATTOO MARKERS by BIC- and I’m telling you, these could not be more fun to play with- regardless of being a 40+ yr. old adult or, a teen, child, even college age kiddo..!! We chose a 3 pack- and I wish so much, we went for the bigger pack! I can say hands- down, 3 is just not nearly enough.. We have had so much fun using the stencils provided (stencil side note: these are quite delicate/fragile and can rip/tear with any amount of carelessness..) these patterns present a similar Henna styled pattern and are certainly fun to try- But, with the clean fine tip provided on the end of the marker.. we found you can write words or, draw pretty much anything wanted onto the skin.. Of course, you do need to choose a more “SimPle” tattoo drawing idea!
Ha! This would be a fun sleepover idea or, provide birthday party entertainment and all can take part.. I loved that once dried- these will last a few days longer than say.. permanent marker would against your skin. All in all, these were a hit!! Would buy again and recommend to anyone trying to decide!

The other side: the markers can tend to dry out faster then a real marker of same size- these do not have the same longevity even if they look the same in stature. Brighter colors would be welcomed addition… And when using, keep in mind they do tend to bleed/smear so.. apply accordingly- also, they are difficult to remove immediately.. make certain you don’t mind being “inked” for a few days... ie, don’t host children’s party and put these on childs face/cheek.. the day before they do family reunion photo!! Create a few different options in stencil department (or, so as upgrade or add-on item!) and also, create stencil made of something a bit more durable.

Definitely can’t go wrong with the purchase.. its a win/win for all ages.. offering hours of fun and easy to use- time/effort spent can be up to the user.. I say, go big and enjoy!

title: For those who use 2nd day shampoo- give this a try!!
text:
For the first time, I tried Batiste foam for my second day hair.. I’ve been an avid fan of batiste dry shampoo spray when the inbetween shower just looks blah! I felt, this may be similar and even provide a bit more “natural vibe..” Being I usually blow dry hair straight with a paddle brush of my shoulder length hair.. letting the ends find their natural bend. I was hoping this would help keep that same look better..

So. Many. Perks: Besides smelling like a slice of sinful dessert, this hair foam dried within approx 90 seconds, all depending on how much was used. TBH, this is a mind over matter concept! Putting wet substance into hair you want dry..?! Something that never bothered me to do with the aerosol spray. However, when it dries… It leaves no white residue or powder that is sometimes present with the aerosol product! (Big bonus!) probably the best feature is not developing any buildup by using foam!! At least I can say...So far so good!! I noticed with aerosol it’s more of an all over application due to the nature of disbursement and thus, can create a buildup as its covering your entire head. This foam can be more specific in ones placing i.e. at the roots or, just the ends.. Another bonus, I havent noticed any secondary drying effect of the hair itself!! **If you know how this works, “powder“ used in these formulas absorbs the oil from hair that naturally occurs over time hence, the second day (or, 3rd!) namesake it has- Yet, this type of product is unbiased and can also remove some of the natural oil in your hair that is needed to keep hair nourished and healthy. I’m guessing the formula concocted In the foam along with the use of almond oil is what keeps this from drying hair out! Whatever it is, it’s doing a fantastic job…

Without use of sulfate, paraben waxes and color or dyes- one can use with confidence that your not treating your hair to an “early death” by treating it/drying It out with toxic and harmful add-ins. If you’re one who appreciates the creation of dry shampoo… Give this a try. Results are pleasantly surprising!

title: I’ve found a solid product to please many people!
text:
Needing a conditioner for our guest bathroom, that sees a lot of guests like a revolving door… I liked this conditioner- being it was more universal for various hair types… As guests come in all shapes and styles! This I needed to cover the majority and it seems to effortlessly do the trick! I loved that it has eliminated so many of the “not good for your hair” Ingredients… Always nice to provide the guests with a healthy shampoo/conditioner to use! They can confidently travel without worrying about packing theirs and worse yet, making the bottles size appropriate for the airlines!!

I wanted a bigger bottle to last and one that was easy, user friendly and uncomplicated to use! This is a sturdy pump that doesn’t tip while using.. making it one hand friendly! This also compliments the 2 shampoo options of the Pantene brand that I’ve chosen to pair along side this in the bathroom as well (x1 for curly hair.. x1 for straight.)

As mentioned, this has NO sulphate, parabens, Mineral oil, silicone or dyes. A new movement we are glad to see happening.. which is a huge perk for the grocery store line products!!! This will help keep the hair from becoming dried out/full of buildup and brittle- and acting as the gasoline for frizzies!! However, the attention to detail doesn’t stop with just eliminating harsh chemical.. as this Conditioner also boasts a nutrients enriched formula using rose petals and mint.

The smell is surprisingly refreshing! As one who doesn’t care for the smell a roses particularly and yet, loves The benefits of rose water based products..(I know, obnoxious!) This is not an overpowering smell by any means. The mint is subtle.. almost hard to detect in the mixture- again giving you benefit without and overpowering smell. Best description would be a refreshing/clean smell and once dried, the smell dissipates. Maybe it’s the mint involved- but, this almost has the “cooling” effect when lathered you’re on the head.. the hint of tingle makes you feel as if you know this is doing its job?!

Our guests are friends/family and the type who'd feel comfortable giving honest input- even in a negative way... if, they didn’t care for this. I’ve had x3 different parties come and stay (including a snarky mother in-law!) and so far, I’ve pleased even one of my toughest house guests yet!! All with zero complaints.. this tell me, I’ve found a solid product that can please many people!

title: A great universal hairspray for all...
text:
This hairspray Bundle is a deal for 3 large size aerosol bottles- It’s nice to obtain hair products that tend to be used up faster, in bulk and thus, get the price perk for doing so! Not to mention, seems you always run out at the most inconvenient time. With a house full of hairspray users, I appreciate these larger cans last a decent amount of time for 3 girls- in fact, with x1 extra bottle, I placed one in kids bathroom… Curving my ever searching hunt for the hairspray (yep! Kids come in my bathroom-take it to theirs.. never to return, of course!!)

I personally appreciated the hold this offered… On an imaginary “hold scale” I would say its above medium+ in strength and stiffness, in case that helps? This isn’t hair freeze or, non-moving helmet hair.. and it isn’t that lite mist which I’ve personally still yet, to figure out- what is its real purpose..?!! This is a nice tweeń hold that offers more then not. It allows hair a bit of movability but, the tradeoff is touch-ability... Sure, you can touch/move hair but, it definitely has the feel of product in your hair when you do!! So, if looking for a spray that holds a defined shape/placement without cementing- this is a fit.
The smell.. is nice! couldn’t complain if, I tried... The scent is fitting with a bust of mild fresh fragrance, free of a chemical smell. And.. It’s not overbearing for those who do not prefer a heavy scent. Smell will dissipate after setting and unless wet, it’s non existent. See, they’ve covered the bases at both ends on this one!
The pump itself is a soft touch spray nodule.. easy to compress in bursts or, continuous spray and hold without issue. Soft touch also allows for minimal “mini” spray if just needing a little-
If looking for a universal hold hairspray- This is a good fit for all hair types/users.. and the deal given for 3 cans- you can’t go wrong!

title: Loving this more then I knew possible..!!!
text:
The description for this hair gel says… “It will help User to create a Gold platinum rock album just by using-“ well, at this moment, I half believe it!! No, as the wife.. I am not the end-user but, I live with a man who is!
Anyone ever have that someone in your life who gets a new item… And then, all they do is talk at nauseam about their love for the said new item ..to the point of which, you feel like you’re going to go crazy or, move out?! Well, welcome to my life with the Old Spice Swagger Gel!! Sure! the feedback is necessary yet, NO!! I truly don’t want to touch your hair, smell your hair or, talk anymore or, go on and on about why you’re in love with your hair..!!!

Being in the market for a hair gel that did not become cement after drying... nor, Once dried then give the added bonus of creating white particles of solidified gel that looked less then stellar in the hair and also, a gel that could easily be washed out on a daily basis. We had tried L’Oreal, Aussie, and suave- (in fact I’ve got a collection of half used bottles under the counter!) it seemed other brands made claims that didn’t come thru for us in the manner we needed. So, being hesitant I decided to try old spice swagger… And that’s where the love affair began!
As stated in description, this leaves hair touchable soft… But, still it somehow holds its shape and I’m talking ALL DAY LONG! Not sure how- and tbh, the fact that it does is all that matters! For reference, my husband has what I refer to as “Anderson Cooper haircut” ..you know, ‘razor over comb‘ short on the back/sides and then, the front bang section creates a bit of spiked/messy look with gel. This gel allows this look to happen subtle/naturally and not take on an 80’s punk band member effect! My husband also has the bonus of taming a funky cowlick near the back crown.. this has helped keep the hair twisting in the right direction and not appear to be the beginning of a vortex funnel!

Now, The smell has been fantastic and actually is noticeable in the bathroom when he’s using the product. He is an old spice guy of the younger generation. Loves their new pure sport deodorant and also, uses the swagger shampoo/conditioner in one… Pretty much, a walking billboard he is!

Gel removal can be a REAL thing after ongoing daily use- it can be tricky to get the sticky concoction out of hair with just a normal wash and rinse.. yes! Even men can have a few hair snafus too ladies! Not sure why but, something about this creates a satisfied feeling of equality- the year of #MeToMovement.. ha ha!! Having shorter hair like he does, he feels a good scrub does the trick and when/if necessary, he runs a comb through hair while showering after applying the shampoo! But, he hasn’t used this brand long enough to know if buildup will be a problem- so far, so good!

Yes!! x100 I would definitely recommend if looking for gel! If you want a touchable feel, quality smell that doesn’t dry up in hair and keeps it touchable soft - then, give this a try!

title: A must try for ALL the right reasons...
text:
This is great for 3 cans of hair mousse! No skimping when putting together this mega deal.. I did a little price comparison at 2 stores this past week while shopping.. and Amazon steals the show for best bundled $$..!! But, the awesomeness does not end there-
I found myself in the market for something to nourish + quench some serious curls and their evil twin, the frizzies. I have 19yr old daughter in yr. 1 of college who has some serious naturally curly (with 2nd day frizz!) gorgeous, flyaway curls- the kind that just hate to be tamed or contained!!! Length of hair: past bra, all one length -Oh, and did I mention that she hates them?!! Question: Why natural curls are wasted on those who don’t truly appreciate ? Yep! The age old question one can’t explain- we are never happy with what we’ve got?!!

Needing a better way to embrace these luscious locks- instead of fighting to straighten hair -she moved from Utah and a dry climate, to beach of So. Calif. with moisture in air - So, 45min of blow dryer/straightener routine.. for hair that doesn’t stay straight..??!! (It’s called humidity!) Finally, the kid who spent 15yr of straightening and an hour each time to do so- come over to the dark and curly side.. it was an epic battle fought. So, a moment of silence, please ...

We wanted a light, Non-sticky and natural feeling product to apply to hair post freshly showered and then, just let these babies naturally dry! This mousse is light to the touch- almost in a non-forgiving way if you’re not careful!! Don’t overdo it with using too much- It’s not necessary but, first couple of uses we doubted there was enough product on the hair so, added more… We were wrong! All you need is a nice dollop a fluffy white in the hand then, evenly disperse starting about mid hair shaft, working down toward the ends..** she doesn’t like a lot of product at the root- she hates anything heavy on the scalp/or, to weigh down natural lift of her hair. Applying as mentioned gave the perfect curl enhancement-
This is amazing to tame frizzy and yet, keeps hair touchable soft. If she does get flyaway/frizzy.. a dab of mousse to aid re-moisturize does the trick!! I must tell you how amazed at look and feel. I don’t know over the years how many high $$ product I got trying to get her to embrace the curl but, she always hated the way product made her hair feel.

On the contrary now, she loves this and can’t quit touching it!!! She is her own worst enemy… as we know, too many hands in the hair can cause oily and/or a dry reaction- so, once she gets past the “shock-n-awe”… She will be home free- rocking a soft, naturally curly head of luscious locks!! The way she was made-

I can’t compare this product yet, and how it stands up with longevity of use. The one thing I could forsee, is buildup may be an issue? However, if so- here is a hack: a trustee recipe of apple cider vinegar 1/2 and 1/2 water (8oz mix) with a drop of liquid dish soap- (in leui of shampoo) leave on 10min.+ repeat every few months.. We found will removes any buildup- no need to condition, you’ll have combable soft curls without using conditioning - But, buildup will let go of the hair strands and be gone!! The plan is to come back to this if, buildup becomes an issue.

I love how drugstore products are becoming more naturally aware.. and doing so, at an affordable $-price doesn’t always equate to quality! Kudos to Pantene for making a product that feels and works amazingly!! If thinking of purchasing- DO IT!! You wont be disappointed..

title: Don’t be intimidated- if a beginner just follow the steps to use!!
text:
I’m in love with this magic “Genie in a Bottle” and the totally sexy, unique ornamental vile it comes in! As one has never used highlighter before.. I could not resist the look and idea of Pretty Vuglar- Hustle Honey.. and I’m so glad I indulged!!

This starts with such a light weight feel.. which wasn’t what I was expecting- but, this feels like a whipped liquid air… I know, not possible- right!! This isn’t heavy like liquid foundation and if adding it to your primer/foundation before you apply- don’t worry that this will weigh it down, it won’t. This is a smooth slick feel on your fingers- (a much lighter feel of a Vaseline..to give an idea.)

I cant express enough how much I appreciate the fact that beginners could use this and not feel intimidated or, “out of their league.“ Simple step instructions provided by the maker, gave me the confidents in applying this- and if you’re like me and find yourself unfamiliar with a new product, this benefit goes a long way!! I added a minimal amount of this to my foundation.… As this felt like the most subtle way to begin! (Its recommended to be “less Bam!” If mixed into a base layer and that was a good thing for me..) So, I mixed just a touch of a pump into my whipped foundation.. and did this on a makeup “lid.” It made sense to try the mix in a test amount to see if I liked- and I advise doing this too -assuring the results you want, before adding it to an entire bottle of makeup.

Pro’s for blending with everyday makeup: I knew it was there.. and felt it gave more like a healthy glow vs. “sparkles” from an underground rave... just what I wanted! Only, for the rest of the world this didnt appear like “ohh, look who tried a new make up highlighter.. and doesn’t know how to use it!!” Always a positive! I would equate this to a look of a healthy post workout glow- but, without the sweat!

As for color choice… Match to your skin type the best you can from monitor swatches. However, this is quite forgiving when its mixed in your own foundation. Plus, using less vs. more can also keep this from being too dark.

The feel on your skin has such a smoothness to it, I love how it glides across the face and doesn’t feel “cakey or greasy..” This has some supersonic magic (remember after all.. its like a genie in a bottle!) and that magic Squalane serum keeps this from getting dry and cracked or, becoming a road map by settling in all your fine lines/pours.
Hah-hmm... moment of silence, please!

As for my skins condition post using for past 10 days- so far, so good. Personally, when starting a new facial product (makeup or lotion..) I’m prone to a bit of acne and or, irritation.. at least until my skin acclimates or, completely rebels! Well, I’m happy to report I havent noticed a change as I’m keeping a keen eye out for it, just in case.. *if this does become an issue, I will update my review- But, as of now- my skin feels as it did prior to using the product.

Favorite perk I loved so much, i included as a hack-

Hack: without trying, I had this on my finger and dabbed it on my lip at the Cupid’s bow- total great move on my part! This can accentuate the bow in the line of the lip, create a pout and make lips appear subtly fuller- win/win.. ALL THE WAY!!

This brand has done a great job of finding a way to make makeup feel sexy from the moment it arrives in the awesome blinged our bottle.. something about it, feels empowering?! I would definitely be willing to try other products without the worry of quality or, results.

title: Hands-down this is an all-time favorite!!!
text:
This is a fragrance that entered our world x3yrs ago- and it came to us on a fluke! (Love it when that happens…) I say we because, myself and two daughters use this scent- and TBH, we play mixology when it comes to this perfume!
I can honestly say, as the 40+yr. old mom… Ha! I started this trend in our house… We love the Fragrance and collectively… Cannot get enough!!

Now, To say we mix the fragrance does not mean this cannot be used or, hold its own- It can. However, it blends itself so nicely with other scents- and ultimately, helps this stand a little bolder as well! This is the equivalent of your favorite pair of jeans... you can dress it up/down but, in the end however it’s used- it’s perfect!!!

Personally, I like the perfume that has less flower and more citrus to the fragrance- I like things that smell fresh.. crisp.. and have a zing! Try to explain that and things get a bit tricky- but, I love the fruity aroma to almost (key word!) to be noticeable almost if, it wasn’t combined with other flavors. I understand this does have a wispy flower smell to it as well but, for those who don’t like it do not be deterred… Trust me it’s a bit subtle in the flower department-And no! This does not smell like soap. So, on the flipside, if you’re looking for a flowery garden- this is not it. Best way to describe this would be “crisp beachey air” mixed with into a fresh produce section of fruits!! I know- I told you describing it is tricky!
What do I mix this with, that all depends on the day/mood! Most often I mix with sexy graffiti and that was a perfume by Escada from x25yr ago- it is still manufactured in very small amounts… So, good luck but, that too have a citrus zing. I also mix with patchouly oil (Most often, as I’m a child born in the 70’s in San Francisco.. need I say more ?!) and on the fun fun days.. I mix with cotton candy by pink sugar!
Trust me for the price, you cannot go wrong and a bottle of the last you a long time. It’s not perfume but body spray and I tend to put on more than less. But doing so gives longevity.

title: If you love Aussie- this is on par!
text:
Love Ausie- I’ve been true to the brand for decades! However, I love this whole new natural twist.. something i’ve noticed with a lot with grocery store brand and beauty products…(the idea to be more in tune to using natural and less harsh chemicals for hair is reaching all venues/brands!) ie. No paraben free... Of course, using avocado for more then just tacos (ha-ah,ha!!) seems to be the new up-and-coming vibe in hair product.. So, I’m not surprised to see this in Ausie deep conditioner!
This product still has the amazing scent it is famous for… And I don’t care what anyone says, hands-down Aussie products have cornered the market on
“their signature”’scent!! Adding different ingredient choices has not left this smelling less/worse. No worries to those who love the aroma!

The deep 3 minute miracle should be used just as it’s name suggests.. wash hair/rinse.. and condition. Yep, wait 3 minutes for this to reach optimum potential- Personally, I like to shave, wash up, or.. just hide in the hot h2o- 3 minutes is not as long as some may think! (No! You won’t be robbed of a conditioning effect if rinsed sooner- But, if you’re trying to obtain the “miracle” or, best results... then, you should follow instructions.. duh!!)
Our household has varied hair types. X1 mom color treated hair, x1 naturally curly long tangled mane, x1 long hair to the waist. It’s wavy/frizzy hair (she attends colleges in Seattle and it adds to her issue!) she absolutely loves using us to tame frizz. Myself it conditions but, I'm hard on hair w/ color process- so, I need extra/extra! My honest opinion for this conditioner and results: this is best for natural curls and tangled due to dryness or, environmental effects on your hair… This improves those trouble spots! **If you choose to be hard on your hair and inflict extra damage by coloring/bleaching - it doesn’t quite “go the distance”... I accept that (one can’t be utilize their hair and expect cheap fix to undo all the damage!) I feel ones expectations need to be reasonable if so, one will be quite pleased.
This can be tweaked a few ways if hair ever feels heavy/weighted down.. use less when showering, add more time between washes- so, use less often, or- leave on your hair for less time..

This deal is fabulous.. you get x3 16oz. pump style bottles, and all bottles have their own pump.. a bonus!! Meaning, you can simultaneously use more than one bottle at the same time. (Some similar bundles send just x1 pump with expectation to trade pump onto the next bottle as they empty..) I put x1 of these in all 3 bathrooms and love they are equipped and ready to use-

title: Old spice has a new refreshed edge..!!!
text:
This is a mega 2 for 1 deal...!! You receive two large 32oz bottles of shampoo/conditioner combo’d into
one bottle! I ordered for my husband who dislikes all the fluffy shampoos I have In the shower and I have a lot for Specific purposes- he is forever asking, “which shampoo is safe to use?“ (he asks for good reason.. as, I have color depositing items- detox items, leave in hair masks etc..) this is a nice shampoo/conditioner combo- in a big “go to” bottle...

We are a family that loves old spice deodorant line.. Even my girls love men’s pure sport for themselves! So, keeping inline with a brand that We trust/love… I felt this would be a solid choice. the bottle is an easy to use one hand pump- and the combo (both products into one) saves both time/space in the shower.. an added bonus- this cuts down ones shower time!!

As for product.. this works up to a nice lather and rinses quite easily. (I’ve had “rinse issues” in past with some other 2 in 1 combo products) but, not this.. these results were just nice and clean, it’s masculine smelling wash!! Could it be used by the opposite sex? I’d say sure- as long as you appreciate the smell! As for the fragrance… it has a masculine vibe to it. Having said that… It is not your grandpas old spice! This smell is conducive to the newer product line of fresher fragrances- The smell is stronger when using however, it definitely dissipates after rinsing- sort of like, most shampoo and bodywashes do! I can still smell it in dry hair on my husband but, it is subtle- (basically, I have to smell his hair on purpose, to detect.. weird, I know!)

The verdict is a positive one! For a person not usually custom to using conditioner… mine loves the feel/softness post washing. (Yep! That is what conditioning tends to do for hair!!) Overall, this has been a great find- the smell, feel and ease of which this is obtained, is a total win.. I recommend to anyone who shares the love of Old spice- this won’t disappoint!

title: The smell is devine... Yum!!
text:
Take me to the islands!!! That is exactly what this dose of herbal essence shampoo with coconut milk did… If I could make every moment in life smell as great as this, I would make it through these artic utah winters .. and post holiday lull!!

You had me at hello- how about, you had me a coconut milk!!! As you can tell- I absolutely loved this. The best natural smelling tropical fragrance that is natural not, Cant like or, encumbered by fuffy extra perfume yuck! This is amazing, almost edible to me.. and I’m talking post shower. if you know the authentic coconut milk aroma- this is it. (I realize some think tanning oil of same name is the real deal for smell- but, it’s not.. it is more subtle if it’s authentic!) i washed kiddos hair with this and the smell carried on even after hair dried. Now, that is a shampoo fragrance test for you!! I’ve only had the privilege of using on myself for a few hair washes and definitely feel the moisture post drying… However, I have a small concern with the moisture replenishing feeling a bit heavy. (Not greasy.. just heavier?!) because this comes in a bigger bottle- I tend to have the issue of using more then I need.. (not sure anyone else does that too? Large bottles make me use more- I know, I got issues!) I suggest using this a tad smaller amount then, you normally wash hair with.. Or, if you tend to feel the weight of shampoo in hair, wait to wash every 1-2+ days... or, alternate shampoos- but, for some that may be a hassle?

Speaking of the bottle.. LoVe it!! this is a pack of 2 32oz. shampoos (note: it’s not the set!! NOT one of ea. shampoo and conditioner.. but, rather 2 shampoo. **be sure to take note!) I feel anything that makes dispensing easy, gets two thumbs up for me- and this is. These come with a pump already attached in ea. Bottle.. and it allows you to disburse shampoo with one hand and that’s fantastic!
I like the naturalness of this concoction and the eliminating of hash chemicals- more and more you see store brands turning over there natural leaf.. yay!! For the price, this is a great product that is authentically crafted with the intent to improve the condition of one’s hair- You get a lot of it with this duo pack.. a purchase that will last you quite a while!

title: We actually use this universally mens/women’s alike!
text:
These are a good go too when your razor brand isn’t available.. or, if you don’t want to spend a pricey amount!! I love they they are solid and strong enough for men’s use... but, they transition nice for females as well.
I tend to appreciate men’s razors when shaving my legs… Sure! It’s a personal preference when doing this, I use a nice women’s foaming lather shave cream to do so. (Something must feel feminine!)

But, they seem to hold up to more then just x1-2 uses before becoming clogged/dull. That matters- buying razors is like putting gas in a car… There isn’t a whole Lotta pretty to go with the purchase and joy to be had about $ spent- BUT, it’s an evil necessity!!! So, if your looking for a razor that can be a bit universal for his/her needs- I found This a nice, close shave.. minimal movement to bend with the contour (but, for the $ ..it’s alright.) it didn’t feel “grabby” and that’s nice for nicks/dings we all ‘love to hate’ acquiring while shaving.. (the jr.high look of the cutie-patootie who’s just learning to shave.. that can be reserved for the beginners with this razor!) The fact you get a few great shaves out of this with each one- overall, makes this a solid choice for purchase.

title: Lives up to its claims quite well...
text:
This is a very nice aerosol hairspray! (Usually, try i to stay clear of aerosol- but, was struggling with my “go too” pump.. My usual brand after a while tends to need a break- i know this moment, when it starts leaving hair feeling blah! (Hair product and user are just like 2 People in a relationship…after too much time together- things can get a little lack luster, over done, and absence makes the heart grow fonder. When you return- you’ll be happy to see each other again… NoPe! I’m not a hair science wizard or, cosmetologist. Just sharing my personal philosophy!!) So, with my brand not doing it’s best and without another suggestion..i felt this was worth a try.. Imagine getting a nice touchable hold without feeling as if you have cemented your beautiful tresses for all eternity!!? That is how this felt.. I would equate this product to giving your hair “memory” and not cemented hold?!

The Spray nozzle itself, is very obedient. It will respond to a light touch with just a little- Or, you can hold nozzle down for a nice, even continuous spray.. and this matters!! No one likes the unruly burst over an overkill shot landing into one spot in their hair.. and if they do, I haven’t met them!?

The smell is subtle and unimpressionable. I say this because after using and going about cleaning up the bathroom… I actually had to revisit the bottle, to take note of the specific smell! That’s how much it didn’t stand out or, smell off putting to me. Always a good thing!

This won’t help the “blue hair club” and those who want aqua net permanent hold- not sure you could obtain it with this, even if you tried??! I know the reasons some elderly women like to set their hair for the week.. I get it, doing hair takes energy, time, stamina and arm muscle- Note: You WONT get that with this product. (trust me @ 40 something yr. old - I’m SO tired of the morning readying routine!!)

As for the aftermath, I didn’t have any problem washing product out of hair. Sure, I’ve only used this spray a little of a week.. but, x5 shampoo’s later and I’ve never felt like I’ve got hairspray buildup. I’ve been washing with the brand Unite- which would be a higher $$ shampoo/cond. but, I personally think quality shampooing is necessary especially if one colors or, is hard on their hair. I am that type!! I want product that works and if I spend
Higher price point.. I want it to work really well!! Nothing makes me crazier then, wasted $ on product that doesn't do its job. I expect a lot of my hair care products and this did not disappoint.. in fact, as happy as I was… I ordered the 2nd day texture spray. Hopefully, on my second hair day’s- this will do as it says?! Best endorsement I have found to be useful… Is from someone who’s purchased said item- more then one time OR, someone who likes what they got.. enough to try another product from the same brand- I’m the latter.

title: Love product in past but, received 100% wrong color...!!?
text:
So, a little bit disappointed- I ordered this in Flawless diamonds and unfortunately, I received this in bright pink!! Being the fact, I just spent over $150 to have my blonde/silver color redone and my hope was- use the color deposit conditioner for a little color extender to give a tad longer time in-between salon visits.. But, that poses a problem with using product received- due to the fact this came in bright pink!! Oh, I am not about to put it in my hair- and ruin the new color job I just had done!! And the fact I live with my husband and 17yr old son.. They are not willing to give bright pink a try either!! Hmm.. go figure!

I can say I’ve use this shampoo before and love what it can do for blonde hair. It comes in a purple hue so, it takes brassiness away.. plus, it color deposits in a subtle but, noticeably good way and it’s a total gift to those with platinum!
Al of the above got me excited to try the conditioner in hopes that it would not dry out the hair so much (shampoo tended to do that a bit..) But, I’ll have to wait and try at a later time- bc, I didn’t receive the correct color (not even close) I ordered. so, I’ll wait to post feedback!

The bottle this arrives in, is sleek and easy to use with one handed access in the shower- the smell is not overbearing and doesn’t have strong chemical odor. If colors matched appropriately.. I did like affect of the shampoo.. I know, it doesn’t take a lot- (use sparingly) So, I’m guessing the one would get the same quality product in the matching conditioner. Just Be sure to add deep conditioning to the routine as well- so, not to dry out your beautiful lockes!

title: High price for facial cleaner
text:
All right, I must admit I couldn't imagine why this was priced X10 higher Then, similar devices listed online and, like the one I had just picked up and purchased a few months back on Amazon… TBH, it seemed far fetched! After having both- I’ll try to compare-

Purchased a similar device for around $25 and have been pretty content with the item I received- my first purchase came with 3 different type brushes to interchange and a hard sided carrying case to go with it. Love the case, its quite nice to store on bathroom counter or, just to travel with and has charger to reboost as needed. The product did not come with any facial cleaner.. that was up to the person who purchased- but, I felt it was a decent $ for what you received.

Fast forward to the Clarisonic Mia Smart facial cleanser- and let’s compare. This I received with two diff. facial brushes to choose from.. and may I add- these have unique features built into the brush that lets you know when it’s time to replace and yes, you can buy replacement heads (brushes.) Didn’t really think about this issue..!! But, I’m sure the dirt and bacteria removed by the brush can only cause the integrity Of the product to diminish – just like anything else.. A built-in reminder of when to replace the brush head is nice. Another nice feature… This device is compatible with all Clarisonic brush heads. Not just the two introduced with the purchase.

This is different then most facial brushes- it does NOT spin.. and that’s a GOOD thing!! Nope,
Didn’t know that- Research shows the Circular motion can be too abrasive by nearly spinning The skin… So, this oscillates/vibrates instead and has been scientifically proven to clean your face x6 better then, washing by hand alone!!! Who knew?! My original brush purchased spins in a nice little circle… Oops! (Guess it’s pays to do your homework.. here you think your adding to skincare routine- but, without all the knowledge- you can be causing more Harm then good in the long run!) according to instructions one selects head that best fits/feel your need- I did NOT feel either of the two options were abrasive/painful. So, I chose the deep cleaning brush. Another perk- this is waterproof and can be used in shower or, not- let’s you double up on your “getting ready” routine! And/Or, makes it easy to keep clean without worry of water damaging. This device comes with a charger and depending on how often/long you use… You can charge it as needed. I noticed a good 7+ days on one charge and still going strong!

Setting a daily skincare routine- Hate to say it’s “too late” for the 40+-year-old that I am.. I just wasn’t interested in the feature. (Old dog/new tricks Mentality?!) BUT, for my to college girls.. The smart feature that interacts with your iPhone device may prove helpful And benefit them decades down the road. The brush head along, with cleaning gel is made gentle enough to use x2 daily. Again, Sticking to my old ways- I wash face at night and not again in the morning. However, if battling acne is an issue… This might speed up the clear skin process and help regain acne free confidence sooner if used X2 a day..!! I love the feel of skin after use- skin feel soft/ fresh/clean… something I didn’t take extra notice of seeing with the first purchase of cheaper version. Being pure Icelandic myself, I have sensitive skin and had zero reaction In a negative way… and this is one of the biggest features with this product- bc, for a lot of us, this is an issue and it matters!! (No one wants to do skin care routine only to look/feel worse because, the product was too harsh.)

Unisex: ?? I do have teenage son who is in the throes of “high school/teenage acne“… Trying to get his mind around the fact, this isn’t a girly product- is not easy! I feel he could benefit most Of all by using this product.. he’s let us “trial” use on him but, it would be hard sell to have him use daily- personally, as far as teen acne goes he is in a minimal category… So, I feel this is why he isn’t more invested...(just keep in mind if, buying for teen boy- they may be turned off by the girlie product mentality!?) sexist world we live in, right!!?

Overall, I have zero complaints with this product in terms of user-friendly, results, design and function. I love the science that goes along with The Clarisonic facial device- the only thing I don’t quite understand.. is the enormous price!! Again, having used two varied price points of the same device… Yes, I can see paying a higher price for Clarisonic as, it backs up Its product with proven results the best way to use.. but, I do feel that $169 is asking a lot- and by a lot I feel this is charging double what it should. Even at an $70-80 price point.. it would be a higher investment. This is the reason for deducting a star- I do feel a product like this must be reasonably priced in order for most of the public to have the ability to purchase. The product itself, I am pleased with.

title: Sexy tube for a total unique fun make up accessory!!
text:
Haus by Gaga.. is sexy!! I gave it 5 stars bc, it is so unique and fun- super sweet and a simple transformation to a fun night of special event. Being different then- every other product.. warrants the 5 star billing!!!
Having said that:
smudge proof- I gave x3 stars.. as it is a bit tricky to apply Perfect of the 1st try- it takes a lot of Precision and a steady hand for sure! The brush makes it easy to bump in wrong places- which is a tad frustrating!! In fact, I recommend someone helping put it on for you –buddy system gave us our best results by far. Our smudge issue improved, once familiar with the brush/application process… But, when it does get in the wrong place- it leaves dirty black on the skin.. and yes, it’s a pain to get off!! (So wipe any oop’s the second they happen- I recommend using a damp Qtip..) As expected, this is easier and more forgiving when placing on the brows-

Easy to use: I gave 3 stars.. Bottom line, I don’t love the applicator- it isn’t wrong but, it is far from right!! It takes some trial and error to get used to… And TBH, a lot of us don’t have time or patience for that. Before applying this brush to your beautifully made up face- get a feel for it!! (this can be done with minimal product on a clean piece of paper.. And test driving the process before making an error!) and it helps to find the best grip/hand position in using application wand! You’ll need to get feel to master angles etc.. trust me- you’ll have less smudging and better results doing a test run!! (Hence the reason for x3 stars on ease to use!)

Longevity: I gave 4 stars- using this for an evening holiday party it lasted just fine. But, with the wear/tear of drinking, perspiring, dancing.. it was on its way off- and that was approx. 4-5hr of fun. Given the nature of the sparkle party effect.. it most likely will last the event without re-applying. But, no! I feel a touch up would be needed.. IF, you wore this for a full day. So, I removed x1 star.

Overall- I would definitely recommend for anyone who loves to kick it up a notch especially if you’d like to make a statement! Think techno, rave, dance club, theater.. aka- Gaga style events and you get the idea of this fun makeup accessory!! (Yes, its an accessory to your regular makeup- the sprinkles on top!) being unique and different I definitely give it 4+ stars.. if you/anyone fits the bill, I think you’d be happy with purchasing this-
(The $18 price point would most likely be the Gaga name- and quality of ingredient used...)
Ohh, best part of all- the tube this product comes in... Amazing! love unique shape/style/sleekness- it is so cool and done in matte black- SeXy!

title: Consensus says.. Great for normal hair too..!!!
text:
I love the incredible smell... Feels and looks like a smoothie for your hair! So, I’m one of “those kind” of people- One who has color processed hair and uses the dryer and styling tool daily! This unfortunately takes it’s toll and leaves hair looking and feeling every part of dry and damaged…
Using Garnier fructis damage for x1 week has been a fun experience.. like I said, feels like a smoothie… Only thing missing is a tropical umbrella!!!

use of organic/natural materials is a total perk and a MUST when trying to repair chemical and heat damage. I’ve noticed after a weeks use- the after effect has left my hair feeling soft and even smooth/straight.. not an intended purpose- but, an added bonus for one who usually has to accomplish this feat by using heat alone! I’m happy bc, It makes the job much easier when hair starts straight..
Let me state- Im NOT easy on my hair.. I expect it to look/feel good- having said that.. I noticed less is more!! I use 100% NO more then, a quarter size in palm of hand.. i apply shampoo to ends of hair 1st- it helps a lot with “weighted down” issue this gave me after x3-4 days of daily use! I know, it’s not good to wash hair every day but, lately I need a blank canvas each day! (my hair length is at my shoulders and quite thick…Hack: I suggest play with amount used to find good combo for you/hair - I realize, instructions state a written amount to use on the bottle -but, i’ve always found that a bit funny. All have different lengths/type hair and so, the need to adjust amount to meet our needs…Is a must!! Remember that- ladies our #metoo movement in the hair world!
One drawback using this shampoo.. after x1wk. of using sparingly, I feel the overcompensation for dry and damaged… is leaving the hair weighted/oily- maybe this helps for others hair types- and/or, those with other dry/damaged hair issues… I feel as I’m masking issue.. rather then, healing it.

I’ll be honest- This is not the fountain of youth… Nor, holy Grail of hair product… But, for price and its positives (it IS a nice-refreshing-great for normal hair shampoo!! I could easily use when needing break from the “salon gold” and that would extend length of higher $$ shampoo lasting and give both types a chance to work and not become flat/dormant-
I’d buy again.. but, plan to use for entire family and not sole focus on dry hair. Glad I tried and feel I’m left with positive options.. as, I wasn’t disappointed!

title: Helps with frizz.. can feel a bit greasy! Less is more..
text:
Well, finally a shampoo created for those who live in the Pacific North West! My daughter has attended college x3.5 years in Seattle… Where, she has battled frizzies since her arrival date. She’s a college athlete who cannot do the “skip a shower
or, hair wash every other day“ routine. So, the downside is: hair gets dried out frizzy- and she’s left with her beautiful long blonde waist length hair (with a natural wave)… becoming frizzy!! Top that with living with the “all-natural” mentality of the community she lives in.. and unified dislike for man-made hair care products.
Auhh.. the heavens have shined upon her situation and dropped a solution into her lap! The Garnier smoothing treat shampoo is 98% organic- made for those that Need this to be part of their way of life- (like we all should but, fall a bit short.. #greta!) this is 98% all natural and biodegradable and other 2% of necessary ingredients to keep this preserved. Avocado is the number one main ingredient… And yet, no worries about your hair looking greenish/putrid or, smelling like guacamole!! Using avocado gives the smoothing texture to tame the frizzies.. this has a nondescript pleasant fragrance and a little goes a long way! The reason for removing a star… It does tend to feel a little weighted down or greasy post daily use! So, if you must wash hair daily, I would highly suggest that you only use half the amount necessary…
Hack: Some hair dressers suggest to alternate every other day with: shampoo on scalp then, work it down the hair- next day...start shampoo on the ends and work it upwards.. this helps lessen the greasy!! Yes! Where are you pile the first contact of shampoo does matter… Who knew?!!
Does it work? I feel there is definitely an improvement with frizzy flyaways I feel it may mask the issue a bit by weighing the hair down a bit-But, this most definitely improved frizzy situation… No doubt!!
If you have Softwater keep in mind, this tends to be a bit harder to rinse out of your hair.
Best recommendation i have if you struggle with never ending- frizzy/greasy/frizzy/greasy.. is to alternate between 2 diff. shampoos. This definitely leaves hair feeling smooth/soft/clean and can help tame frizzies.. (especially during winter months with all the manmade heat-) but, prolonged daily use may Cause it to feel greasy... hence the every other day wash- or, alternating swap.

title: All natural nail polish.. Wow!
text:
Love this color and it’s natural healthy glow! I received Almond Tan- it actually isn’t much of a color.. it gives the look of a slightly milky layer placed over a healthy nail bed. It’s fantastic!

As for how many coats- I used x2... The verdicts still out but, I think I like it better with one!? double coating almost enhanced the streaks left from the brush. With this color it’s not uncommon to see the brush marks- but, if you don’t “over stoke/brush” (hence, 2 coats can cause bc, more brushing!) Best part of this color- is the healthy look it gives!! I’ve got the palest Icelandic skin..and was worried this may wash me out- but, I love the slight pinkish hue to the almond.. What can I say, healthy looking!!

Not certain what 100% vegan should do for nail polish… But, I am certain it must be better than all harsh chemicals- the brush is 100% plant-based and this was a bit of an issue... I did have a few bristles break off in the nail polish and that’s enough to drive anyone crazy. However, once I removed the two strays- we were good to go! I found the polish on now 3 days- it seems to wear well. The edges do show signs of chipping but, I relate that to drugstore polish. I did not use a topcoat after painting nails… As, I wanted to give it a nice review sally Hansen product alone. I’m sure a topcoat would help with longevity.

Price Point should be about $5.00... much more than that and some may not be pleased however, keep in mind you’re buying 100% natural. I would definitely try another color in this brand- it did not disappoint.

title: Thicker product for longer wear...
text:
Straight across the board quality.. IT IS REVLON!! I feel most have a good idea of how this works and have had some exposure to the brand?! I refer to Revlon level makeup.. as a “purse brand!” One you could definitely use and like- But, should take it with you when you go.. so, you can keep look and desired effect- after its been worn and has time to wear off- easy fix, if you have the product for a quick reapply or, touch up!! I didn’t give this 4 stars.. not because of disappointment- but, I hold that level for those products that absolute WoW me!! This was just fine and as expected- arrived in sleek matte black tube and color is fabulous looking.. I received “Kiss and Tell!” (Ever wish YoU got to be the one who named the products.. I could do this all day long and not get bored- but, I’m sure the buyers would have to have a sense of humor buying my shades of “carpool mom” or “laundry day..“ “not my best day” “Need to look like I give a damn!” but, what a fun job!

Anyway, this goes on smooth and just, a tad thick! I didn’t mind it- just the feel was less slick-more, thick! Probably hard to imagine.. but, it’s best way to describe?!! As for any transfer, I felt this was far less of an issue and that makes sense to the consistency chosen for this..!!

As for the longevity- I did see a bit of what I refer to as “lip stain” that seemed to last upwards 3-5hr. Depending on what you’re doing for that time? Eating, no.. color will be gone- But, the remnants of color seems to stain the lips for residual time after wearing but, with a quick reapply- lips looks fresh and ready to go and hence the name... “purse brand makeup!”
As far as color- KISS AND TELL: I feel this is a universal, easy to match fuchsia.. for anyone who likes the violet undertone to a pink/purple hue- that is what you will get. Personally, I love this color.. I feel this is an easy shade to match with other makeup products as well.. You know universal red? You also know universal fuchsia…or, berry? Well, this is just that!
Overall, it’s a nice product and if your looking for something a tad thicker in consistency giving you a little more longevity… This would be a great find. I do put a clear coat over lipstick to give it a softer look- but, it isn’t necessary. (It May even affect the longevity of use.. but, I find it helps with lipstick looking smooth/fresh vs. dry/cracked...)
My personal skin tone: I’m of pure Icelandic descent- the only color my body retains is from a bottle or, makeup product (sad, but true!) this is a bright and noticeable color for sure.. but, it’s what I like. It does not give a washed out look but rather… Just a nice “pop” of color! Currently, I’ve got my nails painted in the exact same shade- just by coincidence! See, a color that seems universal too many make up products and one I personally love!

title: Heavy on the hair- not specific for blondes..
text:
The shampoo is nice- color saving? I’m not sure.. it is hard to tell on blonde dyed hair- as I need the use of purple shampoo/conditioner to go along with it to fight the brassy orange.. I’m not sure how this would treat color alone?
However- it does leave hair feeling nice and soft. I do think it has a slightly heaviness to it.. so, less is more for sure!! I don’t in any way like the feel of hair being weighted down- and that was how it felt x3 uses.. each time I’m using less and less. The smell isn’t nasty nor, super fabulous.. it almost has a soft honey/almond type smell? With a hint of perfume? I say this bc, some color treating shampoos can truly smell awful! This isn’t that at all- but, it’s sort of a “just there” in the smell dept.!

My husband who doesn’t have color in his hair at all, used this without realizing it was made for color treated hair.. and he actually liked it!! Go figure, he has shorter coarse graying hair- and he felt it gave an entire softness that he hasn’t had in a while.. maybe that is a perk the manufacture didn’t realize it had?
Honestly, if I were to have opportunity to order again- I think I’d choose differently. I’d rather have a formula that felt much lighter.. even if I accidentally did use a bit too much! I’d also prefer to have color shampoo that was all inclusive- one with the anti brass affect for the platinum blondes- leaving me less product to have to use..
I’ll definitely use the remainder of the shampoo- I don’t mind it.. But, I need to find out the best way to take some of the heaviness away! If not, I know now- my husband absolutely appreciates the effects!!

title: Ease and convenience for those who need it..!!!
text:
Got these for my teenage son in hopes they would help make High School acne a little less of an issue… TBH, not sure such a product truly exists?!!

Overall, hands-down the best part of this product.. Is the ease and convenience to use. Problem I found with boys vs. girls- is the fact, they DO NOT want to be involved in a long bedtime ritual… Anything taking too much time/effort seems to be over before it starts. Using these ready to go pads cannot be more Straight forward then, just use and toss!! Even young men with acne should be able to handle that in their nightly routine!
Let me say- The acne we are fighting is really quite minimal in terms of teen acne and maybe, that accounts his sheer lack of effort!? He has had perfect results getting clear skin (pimple/acne) free, with the use of Cetaphil face wash- The pump bottle used daily in the shower as a replacement for their “facial soap” and a soft scrub facial mitt has done the trick. Only, once acne clears up…Somehow, the knowledge to KEEP it that way- goes down the drain with the rinsing of the soap!! And so, the cycle begins all over- welcome to my world...
He has used the acne pad, X1 in AM - X1 in PM. So far, he’s been good about the follow thru! I’m sure it’s because of the ease in which it’s done. He appreciates the feel of his skin post use- said it leaves a clean/tight feeling.. and he is amazed at the amount of dirt left on the pad, something any sweaty boy should expect- but, seems shocked by! Its helped bring recognition to fact.. hands need to stay OFF THE FACE.. and face needs to be cleaned! As far as clearing up acne- what I’ve noticed, is this dries out pimples- ultimately helping diminish the problem. (Keep in mind a moisturizer may need to be used as, this is drying…only, some moisturizers in turn cause acne and that may pose a cyclical problem..)
I think these would be great to enhance and aid the facial cleaning routine.. when less effort is needed, these will do the trick. Or, when time is limited… these are an easy go too.. But, overall I feel the use of a deeper cleaning routine is necessary and these are good to aid that effort.

title: Fantastic concept and great use of space it’s a 2 in 1..!!
text:
Convenient and fantastic idea putting A make up duo into one stick… It’s simply that easy with a flip of the wrist and a pop of the lid- you’re in business!
Lids are great BTW.. they open easy and yet, close quite securely- A total bonus especially when traveling or, carrying in your purse!
The actual blush and bronzer go on with an easy glide of the stick, I realized Some may want to dab makeup on the finger… I am not one of them. Personally, I feel better keeping hands out of make up whenever possible- and as stated, This glides on with such ease. The actual 1/2” width Is just about perfect in placement! From there, blending to create the natural look desired is quite easy...

The blush has a violet hue to the color and depending on skin tone, it may appear less pink more violet- I personally am of Icelandic descent.. I’m pale and need to add my sunshine via makeup! (I don’t feel this color is too harsh- not if blended appropriately.)
The bronzer lives up to its name… There is most definitely a metallic sheen to the actual color so, a little of this will go along way.. which is nice due to the fact, the overall volume of actual makeup is only .5oz. I feel the Sellers $ point should reflect the size for sure-
As for longevity not that this doesn’t last all day. This was my reason for deducting one star.. if putting on in morning, I found myself wanting to touch it up by midday. This product reminds me of something you could count on looking great if you got ready and went on a dinner date- if using on a longer all day basis, keep it with you.. and you can add a quick touch up as needed. I think the true problem is- a creamy style top layer to any makeup doesn’t last as long as other options.. a finishing powder or, setting spray may help this? (Personally, I did not try this myself.) Best comparison would be to creamy lipstick… No, you’re not utilizing your cheeks as you do your mouth- however, it does tend to have the ability to wear off!
As one that likes to have fun with make up on a purely amateur level… This is a really great product to have. I’m hopeful there will be more color combinations available in the future..That would be nice to match colors a bit more!!

title: Fabulous fresh/fruity scent- Thx you Adidas!
text:
Adidas hit the mark with this!! If you love a fresh noticeably fruity smell to your perfumes (and I totally do.. I use Escada, sexy graffiti, tommy Bahama St. Barts and even pink sugar.) and I will say- i’m continuously getting complimented on my perfume from both, young/old, men/women alike. Sort of my unique signature I’ve come to be known by… My smell!!?

Well, Adidas hit it out of the park with this one! I tend to find most sport brands perfume/cologne like to hone in on a clean fresh shower smell- and this isn’t a bad thing! However, if I wanted to smell like my shower gel… I wouldn’t use perfume to begin with!!
If you are not one who’s used a fruity scent or undertone in the past, don’t be afraid. No worries that you’re going to walk around smelling like tutti fruity bubblegum! Blood orange is a stronger, longer lasting fragrance and mixed with other currents it gives a subtle, sweet Pop!

I’m in the latter part of being 40’s+ years old- and I don’t feel like some have mentioned- that this is a scent reserved for the younger.. But, rather it just doesn’t fall in line with a flowery flower scent- which IS more conducive Scent associated with the older vs. younger.

I will happily add this to my standard perfumes for sure- I usually tend to mix x1-2 perfumes as a standard.. this will blend nicely with the signature scents I’ve loved wearing in the past! Whoever created the design with this scent- hit it perfect..
Creating a unique and sassy scent, not giving more of the same old/same old.. this is one I’d purchase without hesitation.
***the ONLY complaint is with the bottle and it’s quite obnoxious! Depressing button to spray the perfume is on the top and it’s a bit tricky to push. Imagine top of Bottle as a rectangle.. you must push down actual inset on top of bottle- with a full hard plastic edge surrounding the button.. there is NO cutout for your finger making this tough..!!!

title: Versatile color for different seasons...
text:
The brush is where it’s at with this!! Anyone has painted their nails even once with a crappy brush- Knows the frustration of “keeping between the lines!” this brush seems to have had a lot of science-ing behind it- and that is worth a lot!!

Love the product is 8free- I guess I never expected adult nail polish to really put a lot of thought into what makes their product work. It’s nice to know, this uses less harmful chemicals and in doing so… the greater good of the nail itself and those who use it.
Boysenberry is a fantastic color! I feel it has multiple transition purpose… This would be a fabulous Color to use in summer against any backdrop! It screams fun and just one layer lets it keep a bright fresh look. The versatility of boysenberry can be created with a second layer… When applying A second coat, you see a rich deep velvety color – one that picks up a burgundy of sorts and that could be perfect for winter holidays, Valentines and the like!
This color it price point is listed around $15.. I do feel it’s a tad high- but, The brush and the absence of harsh chemicals do warrant a higher price.

title: Finally... a brush you can paint nails with!!
text:
The brush is where it’s at with this!! Anyone has painted their nails even once with a crappy brush- Knows the frustration of “keeping between the lines!” this brush seems to have had a lot of science-ing behind it- and that is worth a lot!!

Love the product is 8free- I guess I never expected adult nail polish to really put a lot of thought into what makes their product work. It’s nice to know, this uses less harmful chemicals and in doing so… the greater good of the nail itself and those who use it.
I do feel the french rose is a color best suited to light/fair skin.. it gives a pink, healthy glow when using with just one layer. Keep in mind, one layer of a color such as this… It’s hard to keep from streaking. It’s not the polish- it’s the sheerness of the color! So, less strokes are more. (Id say, wet brush each nail... and wipe off excess without exposing the brush. Making long clean strokes will help streaking!) two layers of this color- will indeed make streaking less... but, it does change the color from a natural glow.. to more of a rose petal pink!!

I find this brush amazing- but, I feel price point at $25...even with the added benefits is a bit high for what you’re getting. Price I feel reflects more of a primer, color and topcoat set. Because of this, id like to give it 3.5 stars- but, being not possible.. I rounded that to 4.

title: NOT just smoke and mirrors for high price!!
text:
Not sure which is crazier… Thinking this concept up or, trying it?! Using caffeine in a topical application is taking science to a whole new level!
Well, I must be in one of the crazies… Because, being from a medical family and background. The idea behind this makes a lot of sense so, I had to try. As much as I hate to admit- I’m one who falls into the higher 40+ Yr. old category.. it’s time I accept- forever young isn't a thing. So, if you want to improve physical appearance then, you must find a quality product to help aid the effects of aging.
I start by saying, this goes on like butter.. it’s much smoother/thinner then a lotion- A little goes a long way. The smell is amazing, not overpowering in anyway, and coming from one who’s usually prefers scent free.. promise, I would say otherwise!

I know this has a few key Ingredients to perform its magic- but, x10 days of using.. I’ve begun to see the benefits. I apply after washing my face in The shower...and just before applying makeup. I place it softly in ‘dot’ formation under the eyes and on eyelids(rubbing this in too hard isn’t a good thing!) The drying is über fast so, you only need gently place it around eye, smooth out excess and you’ll be good to continue routine in no time!! At PM post washing my face- I apply only under the eye and do so BeFoRe using my moisturizer..
My results so far.. a healthy “glow” to eye area- meaning a smoother and more uniform skin color. It doesn’t fill in creases.. I believe it sort of stretches skin to tighten, making line appear less noticeable. I’ve personally not had problems with swelling So, I cannot give feedback in that dept.

For price I feel it should offer a genie in a bottle and reality is, that doesn’t exist. I do believe this is a lot more science and not just smoke and mirrors.. I feel using the product overtime will only benefit in more of the same way. The fact, a little product goes a long way- probably is best way to justify the price… It will last a longer than one probably thinks. So, if looking for a product to start combating mother nature- as I mentioned…I was and this was 1st time coming to terms myself with the need to fight off aging.. Then, this is a quality product to start with. I feel it’s best to get a quality product at a higher Price point then, gimmicks by the dozen for a bargain. If you’re realistic with what a product like this could offer you will definitely be pleased.

title: Nice gloss- with added sparkle!!!
text:
Rimmel stay glossy lip gloss does just that! I liked the really fun quaint, smaller size and shape tube this gloss comes in…it’s sort of hourglass in the middle- easy grip/open, not that any are too hard to open! (but, a fun shape!!)

Putting on gloss- it’s straightforward/accurate with the wand provided.. you can get gloss into all the precise places- like the “Cupid bow” with ease... Gloss is NOT too thick to maneuver or, blend. I DO RECOMMEND: lining lip prior to use- it helps keep gloss contained within clean lines.. (even if you prefer look of no liner- I’d suggest to line with a subtle natural color! You will definitely benefit from doing so!)
As for longevity… Obviously, this does not claim to be a lip stain. Which, I feel is the only product with all day staying power and even then, needs touch up throughout the day- However, this goes on with smoothness of a gloss and “sets” pretty quickly afterwards. Do wait a few moments to drink anything- otherwise, you will definitely see transfer! you will need to take gloss with you to do touch up to keep lips looking fresh...
This asked me to rate the flavor?! truly.. None of these type products ever have what I consider “good” flavor… I will say, it does NOT taste like perfume/make up as some really do. Only type of lip therapy that’s worth its flavor I feel, mint..!!.( I personally don’t want to be tasting any of my lipgloss!)
For those who don’t realize, this does have sparkle infused in the color! I did not realize myself… It doesn’t bother me if, I was using for the right occasion- ie, holiday party, Friday night outing, etc. The sparkle does feel a little excessive for every day carpool mom! No, it is not glitter.. Just “sparkle!” Keep in mind when purchasing -and what you’re planning to use this for!?
I don’t feel my lips any more/less moisturized or, dry when using product. But, whenever I’m not wearing gloss/color… I’m a Susie Chapstick fanatic! I live and die by candycane Chapstick, 365 days of the year (not easy to find in June- so, I stock up!) So, lips rarely if ever are less than moisturized on their own.
Overall, a fun make up addition for days/nights when you’re ready to go “Glam.!” price point should be adequate under $10.

title: Life giving for curly hair...
text:
Finally!! They made a misting spray bottle for those who have naturally curly hair… Anyone who falls into this special “club“ knows, the kiss of death is brushing these beautiful locks… However, it’s also Just as detrimental when styling curly hair, that you have water accessible and in the right amount.

Most water bottles are subpar at best when it comes to rewetting/misting your curls... you get the specific stream- that no one wants, where with one pull of the trigger- water drips down your face!! Or, you get the other and most common- uneven spray that cannot penetrate the top layer causing a wet/heavy soaked top surface- and then, you basically look like a wet drowned poodle.. yep! Not a look anyone would aim for!!

If you are a member of the exclusive “curly hair club”… Then it can be expected you know the rule of thumb and that is, NOT to over wash your curls. shampooing curly hair each day only creates frizzies (as shampoo only dries your hair- we realize you straight hair lament may/not know this!) and it takes away from the beautiful gift God gave you… So, we either pray for a soft tropical rain (um, in utah no less..it prob. won’t happen soon ha!!) or, spend countless amounts of money purchasing magical cures in a bottle- giving us endless potions worthy of a cosmetology yard sale… As adding curl product truly just weights down your hair. (Before I upset anyone, there are a few products that can help a head of curls..but, if looking for convenience done naturally- using a product isn’t the answer..) water if key.. water is LIFE for curls- IF, it can be disbursed in the right way!
We’ve use this each morning on a head of curls that reached down to the shoulder blades.. and what we’ve seen is amazing!! The amount of water emitted is minimal and in a perfect amount- it allows for getting underneath the hair layers- to reach all curls (not just soaking the surface!) and it lets you refresh like we’ve never been able to before.. the results have been so great, it makes me want to buy a back up bottle, at price point under $10. It seems to be worth it. As I’m sure eventually, the nozzle/trigger/mechanics can only last so long-
This mid size black bottle hold approx 5+ Oz. It isn’t too small/big and can be packed nicely for travel (just remember empty water content if taking inside a carry-on!) i’ve seen spray bottles that mist but, they contain a battery in trigger… This does not!!
So, If you struggle with natural curls and to find a way to revive them daily.. this is a must have!! You know the benefits of water- this is a great way to give nourishment to your perfect head of curls!

title: Great palette for useable colors!!
text:
Wow! Love the colors and complimenting contrasts it provides, they are great for fall. Sure, 6 of 8 I feel I’ll most likely use… But, it’s fun to have a palette thats warm with a few bolder choices then I’d normally use- this color mix gives off a no fuss look in a subtle but, noticeable way! I know, sort of sounds like an oxymoron comment but.. as one can see, You could use one soft color all on its own- and blend to softly to Enhance a skin tone. Or, mix/match for a noticeable effect- yet, you’re still doing so with softer earth tones.. so, It becomes noticeable. Nothing too extreme in this palette for the most part!

Makeup arrived in a sleek, slim, polished black case with a small makeup brush in a slot at the front of case itself- Honest, the case is sexy sleek.. I LOVE
how easy it open/closes- some are impossible to open.. this is not one of them!! Yet, the case stay closed nicely-

I don’t think I’ll use the brush provided.. it’s a bit flimsy and not the easiest or, sensible brush to be very accurate to use in applying. I recommend you have/get just 1-2 small angled eyeshadow brushes (can be purchased for just a few $ on their own.) I used a small angled brush and felt it went on smooth- with not much product to create effect. (I did put this on my lid after using a shadow primer.. and this made it so easy to apply..)

With use of the lighter color on inside corner- then, use of a mid shade placed in the crease- followed with a bit darker shade of choice on outside edge of lid that i blended in toward the crease... This gave a really nice defined look- and using only palette colors provided, it was done with natural colors. The darker or, more contrasting choice of color usage.. will obviously increase this effect, all depending on what you want.
Overall- If you’re wanting something you might actually have a use for…(we’ve all been there ladies.. when we’ve seen palettes we got a bit excited over.. sparkles and bright colors?! And- if you don’t normally wear these, tell the truth- how often do you actually find yourself saying.. today is the day I’m going to use sparkly bright turquoise?!!) I say it’s best to pick up something you might truly have use for… I say it’s best to pick a palette with shades that most commonly are liked/used by you!! Trust me, they‘ll still add a few choices in that color wheelhouse – for more daring or dramatic days… But, you have “real” possibilities if, you’re ever feeling the need for “more Wow! or, different” and if not, you still have a palette that it’s made of colors you’re comfortable with- thus, you will actually use!!!
For anyone who uses eyeshadows young/old alike, this is a good solid choice and is most suited for daily use.. vs. more outrageous/daring makeup moments. Easy to use and very well contained.

title: Love all the compartments/extra zip pockets!!
text:
I love this and all it’s compartments.. I feel this is made for a mans toiletry needs. However, as a female… I’m in love! It’s the perfect travel size. It has “Goldilocks status” not too big/too small- it’s just right!!!

Details I like:
This is great for anyone who prefers sections and likes to compartmentalize a makeup bag-bathroom bag.. all These sections truly provide those creature comforts. This toiletry bag is actually pretty roomy and Was able to hold all my make up/bathroom needs and could do so in an organized way.

There are 3 separate zipper compartments and this is what I’d refer to as an accordion style. The Center compartment is the roomy catch all for makeup in my case. men would use for shaving gear, I’m sure. It is big enough to hold the size above travel bottle if needed… And has plenty of room for travel bottles size. personally, I use travel bottle so, not to have things Confiscated at airport security when traveling- total pet peeve of mine but, not an appropriate rant for a review!! I can’t forget to mention- on the outside there is an added bonus zipper pocket, I put med.’s inside this as a single bottle fit or, it can also fit the pack of a BCP wheel- it fits in perfectly..!!

The 2 sides each unzip and fold down- and on each side they have different features. One is made for keeping toothbrush and the accessories inside and Separate and self-contained from other bathroom items. There are built-in little straps to secure items and vented material to keep things dry- love this!
The opposite side is a bonus! So, cool.. there’s an inside zipper pocket inside of side compartment!! Try to follow that- it’s like another hidden little “catch all” That zip shot to keep small items contained and safe! I used the side for hairbrush and travel shampoo/conditioner… And a travel face wipe pack- it all fit!! In the tiny pocket I placed a few loose jewelry items and didn’t have to worry about locating somewhere in the bottom of a bag.

Like I said this is a total creature comfort toiletry bag… If, you consider yourself a light to average user of product/makeup.. ladies you will love it too! The bag itself when zip together stands sturdy. Of course, unzipped it does lose a little bit of the sturdiness but it’s definitely meant To hold items secure and organized yet, be soft sided to pack with ease. I received this in black and again, feel the color/bag is unisex and a great find you those who travel or keep bathroom items in a toiletry bag at home- this is a great find!

title: But, where is the dang applicator?!!
text:
OK! If anyone’s ever seen the movie “I feel pretty” ..?? The movie touches on a great point- when you spend decent $ on a make up item, you expect a brush or applicator to go with!! I realize they sell this at a higher price point – most likely thinking, if you’re purchasing then, you must own a quality set of your own makeup brushes to use with product!!

TBH, this I feels needs it’s own applicator brush!! Call me crazy or, one with high expectations... BUT, it’s one of the biggest reason for 4 vs. 5 stars!!

Personally, I feel if ones buying make up that’s on a higher level (the kind that expects you already own all the needed brush/applicators etc..) Then personally, I’m certain I’ll be buying from the specific designers brand counter that offers the personal help Of the makeup artists- and I’m going all out to be sure in my choosing exact/correct product and pallet etc.. for my specific skin type.
AND.. when I’m buying makeup online, such as a blush from Amazon- then, I expect the item to be “all inclusive” and at very least, give me an option to buy as a set = blush + brush (for a min. $ more then blush costs alone!!)

As for the the product itself- I AM IN LOVE WITH THE GIMMICKY NAME AND COLOR NAME.. I LOVE IT!! The gold case is absolutely adorable.. almost too pretty to keep in a make up bag! This is perfect for a purse/going out and taking make up item with you… It’s all dressed up and ready to go!! I know, a total girly indulgence- but, Some of us “girlie girls” like that! (Again, proving my point if it’s used on the go- there’s such a need for an included brush...)

MAKE THEM BLUSH- Is a very safe color choice. I have fair Icelandic skin and this wasn’t too harsh for my pale color. Personally, I like a finished look of natural colors that can be Nicely Blended to look seamless with other colors- I like colors that skin actually has the ability to be! This is a nice, flush of pink- not drastic nor, too pale. I placed on cheek bones With a bit of intention to help give me life! And... with any color left of blush brush, I softly blended a dusting all over- I liked the look! I didn’t feel the need to reapply during the day however, I got dolled up for an event and then, went immediately there- letting makeup look/be fresh! From photos taken at the event, I would describe this is a very soft flush of color- if, You’re looking for something more dramatic they do have darker color choice in the blush pallets. I’m satisfied with my color choice and how well it went with my skin tone.
