title: Solid straightener for straight forward hair..!!!
text:
Ok- I’ve been so looking forward to trying this ,I got it right out of the mailbox and plugged it in… Of course, let’s just be sure we all know- you’ll get new burn smell… No one panic!!! (My husband always thinks I’m going to burn the house down with hair items- turning on this new item, was no exception to his panic!)

Details:
This has a locking mechanism to help heat up - take note, the two plates do not touch together while in lock position and heating up takes place. (Like my previous brand did) I’m sure there is a scientific reason as to why it’s different.. I just don’t know what it is or, care!!

The button placement is good- it doesn’t accidentally get turned off or, bumped endlessly while using. it IS digital but, may be a wee bit hard to see on inside of alligator handle.. you have an On/Off and -/+ for adjusting. I’m sure after using this x1-2, it will totally be done from memory.. **secret hack: if you’re old like me- and Cant see the digital #’s very well.. turn off the light and you’ll see green glowing numbers quite easy!! One thing I see getting annoying- every time it turns off you must reset temperature at turn on. This may not bother some but, for myself- it will mean no more asking simply for someone to turn off the flat iron for me! (Again, my previous tool stayed at a set temp whether on/off.. until I moved it!)

overall tool feels fairly sturdy but, it does have a little bit of wiggle room to it too. But, my favorite part of this tool… Is the cord!! This cord is industrial and almost like outdoor extension cord. It is thicker round vs. flat normal cord. (Why can they make cell phone charge cords this way!?) it will keep this from kinks/bends in worr- and from tangling!!

Heat mechanism has a strip through middle of one plate… I’m guessing this is the ionic magic(?!) but, all of plate gets hot. The edges being round Will definitely allow for straightening or curling with the flat iron as well.

How did this perform: TBH, I don’t have thin fine hair nor, do I have ethnically curled hair… But, I have thick natural bends (half curls that are useless to wear naturally curly… And look like a rats nests unless straightened!) I consider the front bang and temples to be trouble spots… I will admit my hair it was not completely clean fresh from the wash as I tried the first time and I feel it did satisfactory. I am expecting better results When I start with freshly washed and dried head… I will say heating time does not happen in the 60 seconds advertised, not if you use a higher heat like I do. This does have green light To let you know when temperature is obtained… The light was on and yet the temperature still felt less then. Personally, I feel I need the hair tool that reaches the professional level heat as I’ve used in the past. I realize this is not best for anyone’s hair damage.. but, I do all precautions to make life as simplified as possible with my hair routine and higher heat is one of the things I do need! Having said that, I do pay the price and must deep condition and trim hair often- but, I feel without the higher heat I cannot reach the result I’m looking for.

I feel this product is best suited for those who want a good solid quality product for hair that is quite manageable and straightforward Without many trouble spots or, for those who use a straightener to finish off their style… Then, this Is great tool for you. My results are NOT due to a good straightener per se.. but, more conducive with a harder head of hair to style. Sure, I would love this- if the heat and ability to be aggressive with trouble spots was better.. but, my mane is too unruly!

title: Nice.. but, didn't disguise “mom” under eye circles!!
text:
Okay... WHAT AM I DOING WRONG??! Am I just too old, too tired? For real- I don’t know if this is something that is better suited for younger skin and “teens” and their lack of sleep issues- Ha..!! Bc, I need a concealer that truly only a mother knows... one which equates to helping those who have not slept... in a few decades?!??

Maybe I’m mismatched to the color? But, being I’m a 40+ yr. old who yesss, so NEEDS this.. trust me! As a mom of 4 kids, I can’t figure out why I’m still not able to conceal the tired bags under my eyes? I mean come on, I think maybe I’m too fair..? Honest, I am of pure Icelandic decent and that is pale as can be! (Hey now.. don’t forget, Miss snow white was pale too.. and SHE was fairest in her land🤗!) Maybe the skin tones too mismatched or, even light for beige? Bc, it feels if it’s not enough to hide what I think looks like greenish blue undertone(?) In the bags that ARE under my eyes. Nope, did I get wrong color? I tried pink before as well and it was NOT CORRECT COLOR- So, that pointed me to beige as only other option...(and this should 2 color pigment match- I’ve heard is a real thing.. I just am struggling to find mine!?) Now, not concealing.. is par for the coarse for a handful of cheap drug store makeups to do this. I just expected with higher $ point/quality of product, it would:
Have a deeper concealing ability!
I would use a lot less to accomplish this!
Have better looking/natural results
And as the wearing this it would...
make life smell like sparkly rainbows + sunshine!?!
NoPe-!!!

So, maybe it’s my skin tone? Problem is, when letting this “set“ under eyes (and i use a “dot” formation-) but, once blended I was left with what felt like yellowing jaundice tones- ugh, not pretty!! My 2nd attempt I felt was better to use a tad more. But, when it came time to run carpool – I Couldn’t do it. I had to apply concealer/foundation /etc. by then, I couldn’t understand or justify why do regular make up routine.. on top of an expensive concealer?
A few things to know: this comes in only 2 shades-beige and pink!! **note.. you should match this to your actual pigmentation of your tones and not, match your seasonal skin color. Any Uncertainty with this, get clarification- buying a high $ bottle, for a sparse amount- it’s worth getting right..and I feel the obligation of sellers to provide simple steps to determine this info.(saving any time/effort with a hassle of a return too!)
The feel of this is very light, it reminds me of the oil-less sunscreen for faces.. using, it doesn’t run and stays in place. But, it keeps moist so, you can blend easy- giving soft edges/lines.
My Problem is- it just lets my under eye circles show after applying- I have done a little more research and did find, there are different products in this line that may(??) help conceal as expected IF, used together for the overall effect? Prob. is- if not happy with concealer- does one invest more $$ to chance products will respond better? I’m going to wait for reviews of other items- before I personally make a decision to invest in other product.

**My advice to seller- at this price point, I feel it’s a must to Include the “how to find your color palate”
to match your skin tone. Make it straight forward and readily accessible so, those who want to order don’t get dismayed by not knowing how to match colors.. or, what to match color too- trust me, we want easy/at our finger tips and most of all- accurate!

title: Not you mens shaving cream!!!
text:
Where have you been all my life?! This is coming from a 40+ yr. old.. who grew up taking dad’s shaving cream to the shower with her to shave her legs and carried on with taking it from my hubby after I moved out! Yesss!! you millennial’s out there- that is something we from the older generation had to do…before the mega explosion of the billion dollar industry of beauty products.. made for every female need! We had no Kardashian empire to set the “how to-must have” standard.. Ha-ah Ha!! (How did we ever survive?!)

Of course, I realized there was later a shaving cream product ‘for women’ that had come about- However, in my defense- I thought it was copying the brilliant idea I had been practicing since my teenage years!! My own life hack gone viral...

Well, I’m here to say- ladies.. if your old school, it’s time to make a change! I tried Gillette satin care shaving cream and was beyond pleasantly surprised at the whole new shaving experience. Being I’m a girl of Icelandic decent and have the joy of the very sensitive and fair skin that goes with that… I did not realize, how harsh mens shaving cream was- nor, how soft the female product could be.

This shaving cream doesn’t come out in the same glob if whip cream as you would expect. It’s more of a soft gel substance.. once it’s in contact with air (very scientific I’m sure!) this begins to slighting swell into a foam that is soft, cream like, easily spread and manageable.. and this is where the difference begin!
The product itself isn’t the easiest I found to get out of the can.. it takes applying a bit of pressure- almost giving the feeling of compressed product. However, just a little bit goes a long way and it feels almost lotion/conditioner like as you put it on your skin.. however, it simply helps the razor glide with ease along the surface of skin- keeping the need for shaving multiple places more than once and eliminating one of the common causes of razor burn/rash. The smell was a subtle and almost obsolete pleasant clean smell.. unlike, the men’s shaving cream that can leave you smelling like manly sports or forest pine!
And what a nice touch.. when you’re done shaving, this rinses off your skin with ease… Leaving the feeling of freshly lotioned and soft skin. Best part, I didn’t notice any redness and razor burn and that’s a perk with having such sensitive skin!

The product came with 2 bottles and retails for under $5. For the amount you need to use and shave on regular basis.. I see the bottle lasting you a good month or so. Making this a great deal and
Getting the most bang for your buck!
The only reason for giving this 4 stars- is due to the after effect left in the bathtub and not the product itself. The can is metal as you’ll see. However, it got wet on the shelve in the tub- “call me crazy..” that can happen in tub/shower situations! But, the next day there was rust, yesss rust!! From the ring on the bottom of can- it left a circular rust mark on my shelf. Um, this is to use in the shower and should be able to withstand the possibility of getting wet... The other issue I noticed, and its not a dealbreaker– but, the film it left in the bathtub will definitely make it necessary to give a quick scrub down to the bathtub after using. I’m sure this would be less of an issue in shower vs. tub - But, there are days you want to soak in a hot bath and shave your legs..
and just be prepared to scrub out tub afterwards..

title: Investment for your color treated hair
text:
Ok!! This is a tough one... I love the way my hair feels post using the shampoo. However, I’m not sure it’s a large enough difference between the shampoo I am already using for half the price? I have the age old problem of keeping blonde (with silver highlights!) hair dyed a vibrant shade of blonde color and NOT turning a brassy orange!! Of course, I have used countless purple/blue shampoo and although, they do help… It is a constant chemistry session in my shower to try and get the perfect blend of everything, just to keep the look I want. I’m guessing this shampoo will not help fight the brassiness that comes with blonde color treated hair- and therefore, it will not let me eliminate another bottle from the shampoo line up- and honest, I am really ready for easy!!
Where I do believe this shampoo will have major advantages... is keeping my color treated hair soft, healthy and touchable. This is equally important to my color issue- I want hair that doesn’t feel like straw! After using this about a week (I wash hair every other day) I found if you use just a small amount (NO more then, a size of quarter dollop in hand)… It will not leave your hair with a weighted down/heavy feel. Without feeling greasy- It has the great ability to control static too- this is helpful in the dry climate and summer season.. no flyaways! The smell is fantastic and actually keeps hair fragrant even after it’s dry (it’s not just a delicious smell while showering.. and that is an added perk!)

A lot of people wonder about the lather (lack of!) And I realize certain toxic chemicals usually create excess lather on your head… Well, this does give just enough in that department to make you “feel” like your cleaning your hair (I know it’s just a myth that lather = cleaning.. but, I like it and want it!!) and with this, you can/will physically feel like it is cleaning and doing it’s job.
The bottle is a lot smaller then, I had expected- this is something to consider- it’s good you don’t need a lot to get the job done... BUT, for a premium- you only get a modest amount. Making it something you’ll be replacing more often and that is something to consider as well.
In summary, I don’t have negative feelings against the product itself. The overall feel of my hair is really nice and it seems to be aiding my color treated tresses. However, for my needs- I wish it could keep the blonde in check and free of brassy color.. as well as, replenish the damage done by coloring. I also feel, most would like a larger size bottle for the convenience of not having to reorder as often, and do so at a premium. Yet, as I’m told by my salon- it just makes sense.. for those who spend a lot of $ to get hair colored, one should invest in the product for the upkeep of the hair coloring... and if you agree- this is definitely a quality shampoo.

title: Not bad- but, did not wow!!
text:
The idea behind this was to order a defuser to use on my daughter with long naturally curly hair. With today’s style being stick straight this is hard for her to accomplish. It takes endless time blow dying and countless $ in hair product.. in the end giving you damaged hair and an empty wallet! With her heading to college in So. Cali, we thought this might be a good way to embrace the curls- humidity will be an issue.. so, it just may be time to embrace what God gave and let the curls fly free!

First issue I had was in the assembling of the diffuser to connect it to the actual dryer. It took a minute to lineup and securely connect… This should be marked better or, have a release mechanism? When I finally got the diffuser on, it wasn’t straight… BUT, to take this back off and readjust- was almost impossible! It made me feel like I was going to break the item trying to separate the two.
The actual size/weight of the dryer is great- this design is light and ergonomic friendly. The weight is great for holding at odd angles for 15-20min. it doesn’t over stress the muscles and make the arm hurt! the “built in” defuser eliminates hair getting stuck in the “clamps” on the older add-on version. However, if you have long hair.. keep in mind, hair can still sneak into the protected air intake- and It will wind a stray hair strand right up into the fan, pull it out at the root and it hurts! Not sure how to make that obsolete... So, be careful.
The 2 speeds are nice.. 1 for fastest drying and the second for setting the style. 3 temps. are helpful as well... we used the “cool shot” to give relief of the heat on the scalp. The best feature of all- was the rubber spines on the end of the dryer! These are made to actually separate the curls and that will help with drying below the surface and also, curl definition.. they seemed to work really well. Being rubber- they don’t get too hot and don’t hurt your head.
The downside to this dryer.. it isn’t a traditional dryer as well.. and if your house has a need for both, you’ll need two dryers (that’s not great for space saving.. especially moving into a dorm!)
Bottom line, having an “exclusive” diffuser is not the most practical option.. if I’m going to make room and keep multiple dryers in a tiny bathroom, I must expect a more useable, versatile and flawless device.
I wish I could give 3.5 stars as this will meet some people‘s needs just fine. I feel is geared towards less vs. more hair. I removed one star for overall satisfaction and removed the second star (wish I could have only removed 1/2 a star!) for the trouble had in connecting the diffuser itself..

title: Best used to conceal “minor/minimal” blemishes!!
text:
Ok.. makeup is a hard thing to choose when purchasing in an actual store- So, for those of us who look online for a new product.. we know it can be a bit risky! Having said that- this was a pleasant surprise. I am not one who is brand loyal but, Instead I buy a specific product for my needs and the value. I haven’t bought a Maybelline product in a while and so, I wasn’t sure what to expect..

First of all... I love the shape of the tube it comes in. The contour of the bottle makes it really simple to open- some of these makeup tubes with small twist lids can get a bit frustrating (the middle of this bottle has like an hourglass shape making it easy to grasp and open/close.) The product didn’t come vice wrapped in that impossible plastic layer that we dread trying to get off- instead it arrived in a small appropriate size box and that was nice.
As for the actual application brush- I LOVE IT!! This has a wand attached to the handle. At the end of the wand there is a soft yet, firm sponge shaped perfectly to apply concealer under the eye. The actual sponge is sort of shaped like an arrow- and the thin point at the tip is so helpful... It is a total positive that you can get the concealer in some hard to reach places with this unique brush. I’m hoping the sponge keeps its integrity after multiple uses as, it’s so helpful to get the hard to reach places you want to conceal..
The product itself is made to cover up and I was hoping to target my under eye issues. As a mom of x4 kids- Oh, I got issues! I definitely need concealer and I’ll admit, It did help. However, I could still see the faint dreaded bags under my eyes after makeup was applied. It does make me wonder, if I may need to purchase item in a little darker color? My skin tone is fair (of Icelandic decent) and the color I tried was honey- Only, when I used one of my large pouf brushes and added just a tiny dusting of my ever faithful “blush/sun dust” over the concealer, did it seem to do its job. Being light skin tone- I felt the honey color would be plenty dark- So, you may want to error on the side of dark vs. light.. IF, your deciding between two shades and what is best.

Overall: I noticed no makeup cracking after wearing all day. The makeup goes on quite smooth and seems almost a bit shiny at first.. however, with any finish powder or, blush to just dab the final look- I found this not to be a problem. The actual makeup is not too thick and it stays pliable (wet) for a moment which is nice, as I always want to blend-check-blend-check.... and it’s hard if the makeup is setting before I have time to be sure I’m satisfied with everything. Note: I did place this on my eyelids prior to putting on eyeshadows- this was great!! It made for the perfect smooth and even color eyelid palette and helped keep eyeshadow looking good.

Summary: I’m satisfied with the product and feel it it’s a fine item to purchase if, you have minimal blemishes or.. circles under eyes. I’m thinking it would be best to have this in 1- 2 shades, giving the ability to adjust to skin seasons: light/dark bags under eyes caused by sleep deprivation and/or, the amount of summer sun exposure (as these items flex- the color I need will too!) The bottle and applicator are the best surprise feature- the makeup goes on smooth. The concealing I wish was a little better and able to hide some REALLY TIRED eyes.. afterall, it is what it’s purpose is intended for. However, I know it’s not magic...!!!

title: Great bag of go to scrunchies
text:
Happy as a clam with this bagful of hair scrunchies! Sure... it’s like a flashback to the 80’s but, that cycle is coming around again.
What can I tell you that you may not already know.. they are a large size ponytail holder covered with a soft waffle like cloth imprint material- which the material actually helps to keep the hair tie from slipping out of hair. (Little secret, if that tends to be a problem.. in our house, we will use a plain hair elastic to do the hold/heavy lifting.. and then, place this over the top and no one is none the wiser!)
The elastic seems to have I’d say medium tightness.. which some may like. I prefer the tighter hold.. as they always seem to stretch over time when using. The good thing about having 36- when the elastic seems to give way.. you’ve got plenty more to use!

Another perk we found out by error... these can go thru your washing machine and come out clean and no worse for wear! We actually had one in a pant pocket.. and much to our surprise, it washed up great. I’d just suggest putting them inside a lingerie bag- as they’re small and can get lost in the depths of the washer.. probably with the missing socks!?

As for the variety of color- this is the one area I think they could do better. We received about 14 different colors.. and then, duplicates of them. The color brown/beige/sand/khaki/cream/brownish/ army brown.. seemed to be in large supply- some may like that? However, I was hoping for more of the primary colors or, at least a bigger mix of different hues. We did get x4 black.. which is great for the old stand by- just keep in mind.. when they say random colors, it doesn’t include all colors (having 36- i was expecting all colors!)
Overall, I’m happy with he product and would recommend, especially if you have girls and they use hair scrunchies- seems you can never have enough! I just prefer a tighter elastic to begin with.. and would prefer the colors be more wide spread to cover all basics!

title: No nonsense hair elastic- and lots of them!!
text:
Love the straight forward solid black hair elastic.. having two college kids with hair down to their waist- they wear the hair pulled up in ponytails or, braids 95% of the time.. with one of mine being a college athlete, she needs to pull her hair up and have it be secure during her season games… these look strong enough to do just that.
The opening stretch is about 2.5 inches and seems to have a tight enough hold… I’m sure the elasticity will begin to wear out, like all elastic does! But, this is where the packet size/price point make it very easy to discard once integrity is affected after multiple uses. These are not useful for any smaller braids or very thin hair… It would create way too much bulk with this size of the elastic. Having said that, these seem perfect for about everything else you want to do with your hair!
The closure of the circle does not contain the nasty metal crimp that snags your hair- and the coverage over the elastic seems Thick enough to protect hair from damage… As best as one can anyway when using a ponytail holder! The only place for improvement would be in the amount of stretch from the beginning, it could be a little tighter. You can find small/large elastic hair holders all day long… But, why hasn’t anyone thought to create the happy medium size?!
If you’re looking for a straightforward and no nonsense hair elastic… This is it! You get a lot of bang for your buck and the small carabiner hook that came with mine is nice to keep elastics organized in a drawer.

title: Perfect sunkissed color pallet..
text:
First off, I loved the case and the security closure that it has. If you’re planning to carry the compact in a purse then, I’m guessing you know the frustrations if it was to accidentally open and spill.. yuck!
As far as the pallet of pressed powder- I chose this due to the fact it had such great sun kissed hues that looked perfect for summer. I am a fair skin Icelandic girl who lives for time in the sun! From spring to fall, I try to soak up as much color as I can. Having said that… I usually end up with a calico mix of color! It’s a combo of a lot of sunburn, remnants of tan in a few places, mixed together on my fair complected canvas- And this is why the mixed color pallet was worth trying.. I felt the varied hues would help blend summer kissed skin evenly- and impressively, it did just that.

After using for 4 days, I’ve been happy with the product so far. I use a larger blush brush- about the size of the pallet it self…(note- it doesn’t come with any applicator itself.) with the big brush, it lets me be sure to pick up all the various shades- **a little secret- if you twist the brush on the pallet, it seems to transfer the powder perfectly in a smooth mix of color. Note: I also used an angled eyeshadow brush on one of the darker colors and applied it in leui of eyeshadow- this gave a soft natural vibe and the ease of doing so was awesome!
As far as the longevity of the product and how it wears.. I’m a little unsure?! Yes, I’ve used this the past 4 days- yet, its hard to say because.. I’ve been to the pool every afternoon so, I haven’t given the makeup a full day’s run! From what I’ve experienced so far, it seems as if this powder will stand up to the “stay in place from 9-to-5” job just fine… I’m guessing it may need a little touch up-“powder the nose-“ to go the distance all the way into the night, like most powders do.
The best part of the mixed pallet is the blendable feature to help eliminate the harsh makeup/no makeup line- this color would be best suited for a medium or sunkissed complexion. I’m excited to keep using until the sad signs of winter set in..!!

text: beautiful as a gilt as the packaging is just exquisite.  I love the scent of this product.  Great to use after a relaxing shower/bath.  the scent does linger in a light and pleasant way.  it just makes me breathe a little longer and deeper when I smell a whiff of the cream, especially.

title: easy product to use and apply evenly
text: Application of liquid foundation was very even and smooth.  it did not overly absorb the product and hence minimum wastage.  Each piece was large enough to hold and hence to do the job comfortably with one hand.  We have also used it for acrylic painting too!  great for multiple art uses.

title: support, support support
text: The soap is beautiful and smell delicious.  it lathers very well and I love bubbles.  The soap does not dry the skin at all.  so safe to wash the face and well.  The soap is well made and does not break apart easily - i usually cut the soap into 4 pieces as I like to switch my soaps around.  Great cause too.  we are likely to buy these soaps as gifts to support the cause.

title: good trusted brand.
text: at SPF 50 - this worked like a charm and protected the skin, even when in water.  the product is not thick and sticky and we liked how it did not show up on the skin as a thick white layer!  we didnt have to re-apply after being in the water for 20 minutes.  Also, the skin could still sweat.  We tried so many skin sun screen products and Amazon brand is becoming a trusted brand for us.

title: better flow required
text: the brush is smaller relative to Garnier product and the color a better match.  however - with all of these products the 'gue' was a little thick and hard to apply.  Maybe it was me using this product for the first time.  You do need to rub the brush extensively down the hair line and also allow it to dry.  washes off easily with shampoo.

title: great eye shadow
text: i love this brand and this shadow was very smooth to apply and it stayed on for the whole day.  the powder wasn't a compact as I would like it: the top layer kinda flaked a bit.  that aside, it had a beautiful matted finish.

title: the soap for the super active individual
text: i love the soap.  it lavers very easily and the sud is substantial that with a wash cloth, i was able to wash completely.  there is a lovely minty scent and there must be some eucalyptus in it as I could feel it on my skin.  I worked out every day and often soak through my workout shirts - and i noticed my pores were smaller after 8 says of daily use,  and the little blackheads kinds pops out!  Highly recommend after a good workout!

title: works, just a bulky applicator.
text: the application was awkward and because it was effetely a giant rounded sponge, the color covered more area that I wanted.  However it stayed on and washed away in the next shampoo wash.  No odor and I wouldn't try sleep with it as it did smear on my hand after a workout - not sure how much you sweat when you sleep.  i think there are better applicators out there.

title: Simplicity in color
text: It doesn’t stay on for hours. However, I love the color and moist texture of the ‘lipstick’.  No fragrance and no irritation. Smooth. Pretty color without being dominant in color.  Great grab and go for an active workout day.

title: Quality. Quality. Quality.
text: This is the only brand my hub uses for his daily routine.  The design is always top notch and the blades last a long time despite daily use.  These are no exception.  Quality is key for us as we don’t like to thrown away disposables and bad quality time.  Definitely keeping this product for a long time.

title: Beautiful texture and lip friendly!
text: This is great brand, but arrived broken.  None-the-less, the product is good.  It has a creamy texture and the colorr is brilliantly vibrant. Stayed on for 6 hours without a touch up.

title: Love the light and softness of my hair.
text: This is probably one of the best high street go to brand that has great quality product. I exercise every day and I generally don’t shampoo my hair everyday.  What I noticed with this shampoo, I can wash my hair without the dryness that become inevitable otherwise. Love the conditioner as it does not leave it heavy, but light and soft.  The residual build up is negligible.  Gentle on my scalp.

title: Huge, but love the thoughtful storage design
text:
This bag is ‘huge’. I suggest this can easy double up for family of two. The quality of the fabric is great, the zipper is solid and doesn’t catch. I like there are two side pockets that has a net pocket and two elastic holders: useful for sharper items like razors, or tooth brushes where cleaning this pocket is lot easier. Inside, the design focuses on larger items and has two large plastic pockets, and further divisions for bottles. I like the inside as it creates storage space that isn’t clutter with small pockets.
The hanging mechanism is fab as everything you need it on ful display and morning/evening rituals can’t be easier. Especially in away locations, shelfing space can be limited.

title: Quick heat, tight curls, and light to low for heavy use
text: With 1/2 inch, the curls re tight.  They wand didn’t take long to heat up and given its lightness in weight, it was easy to hold each bunch of hair for about 20 seconds.  I have quite thick hair, and it didn’t take long to get some nice gentle curls.  Definitely the lightness makes this wand effective, any heavier, I wouldn’t be bothered to ya eit.  Quality of the material is decent enough that the handle didn’t overheat, and whilst there is a glove added, I didn’t need to use it.

title: Great for general personal use.
text: The pads work great for removing nail polish and makeup. Super soft and absorbent.  Feels like cotton.

title: Light citrus and authentic . Very relaxing.
text: Nice light fragrance, not overwhelming at all.  We use this one in one of the bathrooms, and it creates a lovely relaxing ambience: light citrus.  We have a beautiful diffuser jar, and hence just poured the amount we wanted.  Great to have in multiple rooms with same delightful fragrance.  Not synthetic smell.

title: Great curler.
text: Nice! The curler heats up within a range of temperature, but even with my thick hair, it worked beautifully at the lower heat setting.  In fact, I didn’t have to wait for it to fully heat up to be effective.  I love there is an on/off switch.  Very well made, and long enough cord that you have a lot of freedom as you move with the curler.  The one-inch curler is great for larger and gentler curls.  They lasted all evening.  Quality.

title: These clippers mean serious business.
text: They are sharp and you don’t need to apply much pressure to work them, be careful.  That aside, they are so efficient and effective.  The clippers are very light and I wish there was rubber on the handles as they do slide a bit when in use.  However, as clippers go, these are very good and gets to parts of my nails a lot easier than my current clippers.

title: Lovely touch of color and still does its moisturizing job!
text: Ha, during the winter I am constantly applying Chapstick before I go out.  With the tint, I don’t have to put on lipstick as they are effective.  So pronounced in color, but definitely visible.  Great idea when i am dashing out of the house and I don’t have to think about lipstick plus chapstick.

title: Nice velvety product. Did the job
text: I have tanned skin, not dark and certainly not pale. I used the foundation as a touch up with blemishes and spots! Nice velvety application and blended well into the skin. Stayed on all day with no fade out.  Cleaned right off with soap and water.  This foundation did a great nice job when my skin sometimes break out with some food sensitivities.

title: Works seamlessly
text: The gel really feels like an invisible cream on my face. No stickiness after application. No fragrance.  I like that I can wear something on my face and protects me from the sun when I am running doing errands.  This is great gel for day to day, not for beach vacations.  No irritation.  Small enough to hold in my handbag/backpack.

title: It works!
text: Soft fragrance and as a shampoo on color treated hair, it did not dry my hair.  I ordinarily have to color my hair every 2 weeks, and with using this shampoo [2x a week], I noticed it did extend the color for another week, less fading. Thank goodness. I only shampoo 2x a week as I exercise everyday.  Very gentle to scalp and I was super happy with the effect.

title: Wow, love the fragrance .
text: Oooh, this has a beautiful fragrance and it lingers in the skin too.  I love this brand and now I have a little spa luxury after a hard work out.  There is certain amount of bubbles/foam, which I love too.  Little went a long way and I thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  I am a soap snob, but this shower milk got my attention!

title: Best brands for skin care, especially hands.
text: This brand never disappoints and I love the light feel and gentle fragrant of the cream.  And keeps my hands soft for a long time.  I love this addition to the selection of skin cares.  Just buy it and treat yourself and loved ones.

title: Super design and quaility.
text: Works like a dream for starters.  The quality of these tweezers is awesome, and looks high quality for the price.  The slant does make a huge different.  I prefer this pair over my older pair that isn’t slanted.  It comes in a little faux leather pouch, which I keep in my bag.

title: Worth the money.  Lovely treat to my hair.
text: Nice, very nice little fragrance.  My hair felt beautiful during the application and once dried.  It felt like I was applying professional product on my hair.  Didn’t feel greasy or heavy afterwards.  Build up on hair was negligible compared with the average conditioner.  Worth treating your hair and time with this product.

title: Olay scores for a luxury no nonsense cleanse.
text: Yummy for my skin.  Lovely foamy application and leaves a soft feel to my face.  Cleans really well as I tested it with a swab of witch hazel, which in my experience can remove the deepest of pores.  No crazy scent and I love the Olay brand for my skin.  Only need to ply once and wash off wit warm water.  I didn’t need to apply any moisturizer afterwards.

title: Use with thick dead skin.  Only.
text: It works, but I would make sure you soak your feet for at least 10 minutes before hand, and you apply cream to your feet afterwards.  And don’t scrap too hard as it can be quite sharp.  What I didn’t love about it:  scrapes up the skin and without an alternative filer to soften the skin afterwards, my heel sticks to the bedding sheets.  It is big, and it does not have to be this huge.  Can’t be used regularly as it scrapes a lot of skin off.

title: Better to use with heat appliance.
text: This hair cream has a fragrance that did not appeal to me, and whilst it appeared to be easy to apply.  After a few hours, I noticed it had a lingering ‘smell;, and my hair kinda clumped together.  It is definitely works better if you use a heat straightener/curling tongs with the hair cream.

title: musky and heavy fragrance
text:
heavy scent and if this is what you are looking for then do try before buying. it also lingers with full scent for the whole day and humidity does not taint it. musky is a good adjective for this fragrance. I am more of a light fragrance person.
presentation box and bottle are beautiful and would make a great gift. Although this is not my kind of scent, i was not going to ding the rating as it was not a cheap fragrance and didn't get affected with all day wear and humidity.

title: Once a week, special hair treatment.
text: This is very creamy, and I wouldn’t use it with the shampoo as it left my hair heavy.  But as a special conditioner and treatment for dry heat. This is a terrific conditioner, and I love the delicate coco smell - not synthetic at all.  As I wash my hair every day, re sports, I use this once a week as a nice treatment, and it does the job beautifully.

title: Wow, wow, wow.
text:
Wow, this is a huge step up (aside from Dyson) for the common hairdryers. I love the lightness whilst the quality of the drying was not compromised. I love the way the settings are place, and made it easy to switch back and forth between the heat/cool and two speed setting. So quiet too! I love this new dryer. Also comes with three attachments, which are super easy to attach and detach.
This is seriously a terrific new design for hairdryers, and will now replace my old one thta was terrific, but heavy.

title: Great quality.
text: Beautiful color, and the quality was excellent.  Definitely needed two coatings, but the viscosity was nice and easy to work with.  No front smell, which often found in other polishes.

title: Works in hot and humid conditions!
text: Great brand, which we are revising again.  The solid block is great for careful application to the under arms. Worked great for sports and in very humid conditions.  Whilst it is clear, it does not appear to stain the clothes.  No obvious irritation to the skin, and one of us does have sensitive skin.  Very light fragrance, neither pungent nor distracting.

title: Lovely cream, but for the fragrance
text: Deliciously cool cream for the whole body. Absorbs quickly with very little oiliness.  Skin felt very soft.  This is a personal reference, there is a fragrance with the cream, which reminded me of brill cream.  Not sure I could continue using it.

title: Luxurious feel.
text: This is a creamy shampoo and cleans well without leaving any heavy residual.  Very llite and pleasant fragrance.  The richness of the shampoo struck me as most shampoo has a different viscosity and feel.  I decided that I would Not apply a heavier conditioner, as I did the first time [the accompanying conditioner], as it left my hair feeling lame and over processed with residual.  It didn’t irritate my scalp, which I am rather sensitive.  Nice shampoo with a ‘rich’ feel, but go light on the conditi7if you use one.

title: Grateful knees.
text:
I wasn’t too sure what to make of a cream for joints. I usually try to have a healthy diet or pop the pills. Sometimes it is easier to apply a cream. I have a left creaky knee, and it just clicks a lot. I decided to be a sceptic and tried this cream 5 days on and 5 days off. All I can say is that it does work. It is not permanent, but I need to try to use this more continuously to confirm, but my knee didn’t click and creak as much after 2 days of applying the cream around my knee joint.
The cream is ‘refreshing’ and light. No greasy marks, and no adverse fragrance. I am generally adverse to strong scents on any body cream.
I often apply this before and on day of a running race. Never thought I would actually like this cream. My knees thank you!

title: and what I loved about it was that it wasn’t harsh
text: Used this daily on my face, and what I loved about it was that it wasn’t harsh , and left my skin soft with a soft sheen to my face, no need for face cream.  Not greasy at all, and I love how my face feels.  Only wish instead of a pump was a nozzle to control the flow better.  Loved the fresh orangey fragrant!  Gorgeous.

title: Super foamy soap, love it
text: I looooove soaps, and I love this soap...the lather is super awesome, and I wasn’t expecting that at all.  Scent is light and does not linger on the skin.  Does a great job as my skin I softbafterwards, and since I am working out everyday, I needed an effective soap thta didn’t dry out my skin.  Love it.

title: Wanted to like it.
text: This is a rather thick/viscose creme, which I rather use for beach vacation.  Even at sp24, which would be perfect screening for day to day wear, the heaviness made it uncomfortable to use.  There is a scent that is neither neutral nor fragranced,  I wished it was thinner in texture given the humidity that I live in.

title: Great brand.
text: Fruity is an applicable description for this parfum.  It is light and not heavy/overpowering.  It lingers for whole day and didn’t deteriorate as the day worn on.  Stays fresh all day.

title: Works a charm.
text: Ooh crikey, this is a beach vacation MUST have.  Super coconut fragrance and super hydrating without it being too oily.  The scent just takes you back to that beach.  Really provided a great moisturizing effect on my tanned skin.  I wouldn’t recommend it for the face, as I noticed my face was little sensitive to it:wee stinging feeling.  Thus far, my tan continues to hold without any peeling.

title: Wow. Impressed.
text: Wow, not normally a fan of this brand, but they scored with this product.  I loved it on so many levels: really cleansed residuals without being harsh on my hair, leaves a lovely fragrance if you choose not to add conditioner, my hair looks and feels great!  Viscosity is medium and goes a long way for sure.  Super impressed with this shampoo and looking at the product’s other offerings.

title: Great brand, love.
text: Love the neutropenia brand, and this lip gloss not only looks great, but it feel luxurious.  It is not long lasting, few hours say, but I use this with a darker lipstick and the neutral,gloss just enhances the color without that deep intensity thta can be too much for day where.  If you like lip gloss, this is the brand to try and fall in love with.  Neutrogena did not disappoint at all.

title: Gushing with love for this luxurious soap. In heaven
text: First, I LOOOOVE soaps.  I use this soap with a body cloth, and boy does it generate a super thick and luxurious feeling foam.  I am in heaven, especially after an intense aerobic workout, and to spoil myself in some pampering time.  Makes shower time for adults super fun and indulgent. It is not totally fragrance free, I rather wish it had a touch of lavender say, but it is very mild fragrance and does leave this lovely freshness on the skin.  I can’t beleive soaps could generate such luxury feel. I don’t mind working out these days!

title: Great product.
text: Delicious color, easy to apply, lovely texture with no drag.  I love this new brand, and note that this is not a stay on for 24 your lipstick!  It last me bets part of the morning after numerous cups of tea.  Even when I reapplied, there no large residual left on the lip to make it look blotchy.  Nice finish and lovely color.

title: Supper effective, super gentle on face.
text: Super moist and large enough to use for removing all makeup from face.  There is no sting from the liquid, and leaves face feeling super refreshed and clean.  Even removed hard core eye liner gently and I didn’t need to over rub any areas.  Sealant was decent to keep the towels moist, but recommend you use as soon the packet is opened.

title: Does not leave oily residual on bath tube/ shower floor.
text:
The winter is always harsh on my skin, and I decided to try this as part of my collection of products to treat my dry skin. Definitely a oily feel, but did not leave an oily residual on the bath tube, and hence no slippery effect. I didn’t worry about slippery accidents. It is not a soap, but plied after you have showered, and rinse. Definitely, helped to,lock in some of the moisture, no oily afterlook on the skin, absorbs right into the skin.
One less star, as the rinse does wash off the impact, I rather wished it could be applied after shower with no rinse.

title: Great product and gift set
text: The material,is greatbquaility, especially the lipstick and eye shawdow.  The lipstick was smooth to apply and didn’t have any after taste.  The eye shadow colours were subtle and stayed on the whole day.

title: A lot packed in this little pencil. Loved it.
text: Two ends to this items. One end has the soft kohl pencil that creates sharp lines and it was very easy to control the pencil without pulling on the skin or creating an unstable line.  The other end was a soft smudge ‘brush’, which I Sed to soften the line on my lower eye lid.  It worked perfectly.  I actually liked this to liquid liner, and definitely easy to use versus powder liner.  Defiantly recommend

title: Need instructions!
text: This needed a YouTube to show me how to use this liquid liner.  With some trial and error, I managed to get a clean line.  It is not waterproof, but the finish was firmer/darker than using powder/cream forms.  It lasted all day, and you need a good makeup cleaner to remove.

title: Love this brand, new comer, does not disappoint
text: We are beginning to love this brand for many of our hygienic purposes.  This sun cream is brilliant.  Not lumpy and spreads evenly cross the skin.  Absorbs easily and doesn’t leave a white sheen that often comes with the 50 factor.

title: Great and reliable brand.
text: We simply love this brand and the spray option.  The nozzle sprays the sunscreen evenly and covers wide range.  There is no wastage.  Works well for couple of dips in the sea too.  Light fragrance upon application, but does not linger.

title: Too strong fragrance.  Way too strong.
text: I love soaps and I am a gal.  THis soap cleans without drying out the skin, a huge plus,  but the fragrance is tooooooo strong.  Way too strong, I felt nauseous.  Shame, as 20% of the fragrance output would be perfect.  I don’t need to advertise that I had a shower this morning!

title: Great for the winter harsh weather.
text: Absorbs right into the skin and leaves not grease mark or it’s presnece. It also Hebrew sun screen factor 15, which is great for the harsh winter weather and daytime.  You need to exfoliate more in winter time, and this thicker cream is great no nonsense protection. It does have little fragrance of sunscreen, but nothing lingering.  Really blends into the skin that you hardly notice it is there.

title: All round great hair conditioner.
text: I am sucker for trying new hair conditioning products as I look for feel in hand, the fragrance, and effect on hair.  Plus plus on this one, as all round hair conditioner, it works wonders to my dry hair (beaten up from coloring, blow dry, winter weather).  Very light fragrance, which I like, and no artificial smell, which I have found expensive hair treatments to have.  My hair does need a lot of TLC, and this product is gentle on the scalp too.

title: No drag, and perfect sharp line.
text: Very very easy to apply, and hence you need a steady hand for sure.  You don’t need to apply much pressure, and the line is confined to the he nib of the pencil.  It feels more like a soft creme against the eye, and creates no drag at all.  I was surprised how easy it was to apply and the line was perfect, sharp and no smudges.

title: Nice produce, great  color.
text: Definitely creamy feel, and no taste/fragrance.  The color makes my lips look natural and matted.  My lips are rosy/dark.  I really like the ‘natural ‘ look this color gives me.  The quality is pretty good.  I am impressed as like Mac, as my go to brand.

title: List love this brand
text: I am definitely in love with this brand, rich lava on the skin that makes you feel like you are a Million dollars.  The fragrance is never overpowering, pitch perfect with every use.  Yes, after continuous use, the delicate fragrance continues to pamper my senses.  Soap does not disintegrate after few use.  Just love it and spoil yourself.

title: Really hoped it lived up to the hype.
text: I really tried to like this luxuriously intense hair conditioner.  What I didn’t like about it was it’s texture, and the fraegrance.  It may be personal, but I felt nauseous and even after the hair dried, I really didn’t like the smell.  Effect on hair was okay, but within one day, my hair felt heavy and I needed to wash it again.  I tried it couple of times, but it really didn’t change my first experience.

title: More please.
text: My new favorite brand for its sheer luxury and creamy feel on my skin.  I am addicted to them, and probably take more showers than before just an excuse to enjoy the soap.  This one is no different one from other fragrances, delicious and continues to release this warmness every time you use it.  I like to cut soap of this size into 4 parts so I can rotate in new soaps.  Yes, I love soaps.  Great for gifts, nothing cheap about this one.

title: Playful fragrance.
text: the fragrance was potent enough, but not overpowering.  This reminds me of a masculine aftershave, but unisex friendly.  The wax didn’t burn down that fast.  We were introduced to this brand from birthday gift, and this brand does a great job In offering so many beautiful and playful fragrance.  Great for gifts too. I burn a lot of candles as part of room cleansing, and self cleansing.  I recommend this as part of meditation session too.

title: Spa experience.
text: The brand speaks for itself.  Great for your visiting guests or for me, as great travel size.  Super luxury feel, and afterwards, my skin feels so soft that I don’t need cream.  Showering is a spa experience every time.  Fragrance is always dictate and lingers lightly on the skin.

title: Spa day!
text: This was amazing, both fragrance, application, and leaves my hair as smooth as when I leave my Hairdresser!.  I was surprised, as I have tried so mny of these hair masks, I felt I was wasting money.  This worked, my hair was smooth, dryness, what dryness, and slight are my waviness, it shows up like mad dog: not this time.

title: Make it a spa day for yourself.  Pampering product.
text: Tried this over 3 weeks, once a week.  I normally dampen my face before adding the mask on my face, and 10 minutes is enough, as it does dry like paint, and can pull your skin uncomfortably.  There is lovely fragrance, not only to remind you have mask on, but it makes the 10 minutes goes quickly.  After the treatment, no need to use moisturizer, skin feels even soft all round.  My skin can get oily around forehead, nose, and chin.

title: Delicious, and makes showers so much fun.
text: This is richer of all their soaps, but always so kind to the skin, and no need for lotions.  Light lather and fragrance steps up when hit with hot water, lovely wake up call.  I am sold on this Brand, and this one is no exception.  Also so pretty and different that it makes a great gift if you can part with the soap.

title: Soapy-liciosuness
text: Delicious and rich feel to the skin.  Lather lightly and leaves your skin feeling soft.  I love soaps and I am sold on this brand, and I feel like taking shower 5x a day with this soap. The fragrance are light and minty, and powers up when it hits hot water. Yummy morning wake up.  The packaging makes this  great gift if you can part with the soap.

title: Great gift idea or for your travel bag!
text: I am sold on this brand of soap. Nice and light fragrance, and little lather, but it feels rich against your skin. I don't need much, if any lotion after use: skin feels very soft. The soap box is great for my travel bag as I love to use soap over shower gels.  Even large soap bars, I tend to cut into smaller pieces so I can enjoy different soaps more frequently.

title: Wonderfully smooth and luxurious
text: Smooooth feeling, not sticky. I get really rough hands as I wash my hands a lot aka, housework, even with use of rubber gloves.  This shea butter hand cream does a perfect job in soothing and smoothing my dry hands.  delicate fragrance only.  Does not give any sheen on the skin.  I love it, and not that big to throw into my handbag.  Shocking how smooth my skin feels.

title: Sooo fruity and creamy.  My new favorite soap.
text: I loooove soaps.  This one is a super treat that leaves the skin soft after use.  I love the fruity smell that bursts in hot water, I simply smile.  Lather is light, but feels creamy on the skin. I often cut up the soap so I can experience many soaps.  I notice the soap does not disintegrate quickly.  My new favorite brand.  Great for gifts.

title: Pricey, but does do the job with spa feel.
text: Any moisturizer is plus plus, but this one?  Very focused around the eyes, which took few weeks of every other day wear at night to see the lines less deep.  Very cool feel when applied, and that just eases the stress around your face!  Not greasy at all, just melts into skin.  Does not leave any residual look if you plan to use during the day.

title: Five Stars
text: Expensive, but provides moisture without any heaviness.  Leaves a delicate fresh fragrance. My little spa moment.

title: Strong fragrance.
text: Very strong, and not subtle like the other Chloe, original or rose.  I was little surprised.  If you like strong fragrance then this one would work for you.  It stays on all day, and you can really smell it.

title: Really nice night cream that reduces the lines, and feels luxurious
text: Age defying?  That I can't attest to, but my skin is softer and less lines after continuous use for over 2 weeks.  Very effective with little amount.  Not greasy or perfume ridden, thank goodness.  Easy to apply, and just absorbs I tot he skin with no grease-shine.  Noticed my greasy forehead is less greasy and that is a plus for me.

title: Cool product., quality is good!
text: Really nice contrasting colors that blend in very well.  Subtle and not overwhelming, which is great for work and not noticed the need to touch up in the evening.  Goes on like a creamy blend, and not blotchy.  Feels like quality material. Really pleased with this product.  Also belnded well with my eye liner too.  I do not ordinarily use the provided application eye brush...

title: Quick k, effective, not fuss makeup and grim remover.
text: Gentle, effective, no sting.  With little moisturization,  I apply this  after washing my face with water, and it removes my eye makeup and grim of the day nicely.  No fragrance, and you wonder if it is not water!  But my eye make up is often the tougher area to  clean off, quickly.  I am not normally big fan of make up remover, but this simple product wins a point from me!

title: Recommend for combo skin type, and no greasy residual.
text: Super light and absorbent, no greasy residual. Face stared super soft for whole day without reapplication. It is clear gel, no lingering fragrance.  Really didn't need to apply much on whole face.  I have combo skin on my face, dry around most of face, but oily on nose, chin and forehead.

title: Perfecto, and well designed with no space wasted.
text: Sooo much space/room...much more than I thought, and to say I need to fill it up, but with all my bits and bottles, everything had a home.  For a compact bag, there was no wasted space in the design.  As a woman, i love the color is neutral , and love that iT fits well in suitcase.

title: Blessing in air conditioned living space.
text: With airconditioning on all day, my skin gets very dry, especially areas under my eyes and cheek.  Apply little around those areas during the day, really minimise the dryness and constant cream application.  Hence avoid very simulating the oily area around my nose.  Economical , tiny amount is suffice.  Great for dry environments.

title: Little spa treatment for an ordinary day!
text: Definitely can smell the eucalyptus. ..used it regulator 5 days, and no dryness, and didn't have to apply any baby oil on mu legal and arms afterwards,  which is a time saver plus.  Skin stayed looking soft all day.  Very foamy thoguh, so careful in amount to your spunge/body cloth.  Live the spa like smell, not over powering at all, and hardly any residual smell once your skin is dry.

title: Great effective plates, just a tad heavy re larger plates.

Ive also been using it only a month or so and am determined to be consistent with it.  It takes time for skincare lotions to do their job.  I'll order again and am considering their facial moisturizer as well.  Customer service is great.  Organic, cruelty free, reasonably priced and good for your skin.  I recommend it highly.  ( I use in conjunction with another organic line - retinoid and vitamin c). Slowly, but steadily I am seeing some improvement in my skin at age 53.  Ive got my skincare routine streamlined now and will be diligent with it.  This particular product lasts awhile as well...a little goes a long way.  Absorbs quickly and I use morning and night.

title: Great product
text: Lovely for exfoliating your back with a moisturizing wash.  Very well made.  Easy to use and reaches your whole back!  Can't miss a spot.

title: Improvement noticed!
text: Has improved my deep frown lines above my nose, between my brows..the dreaded 11.  I use one patch every night (for a little over a month now) and have noticed a decrease in the depth of these two stubborn wrinkles!  I plan on buying another box, they've become part of my nightly skin care routine, are comfortable, affordable, and most importantly are working!

title: Gentle yet effective...lovely moisturizer with Retinol!
text: Considering I dislike retinol because it stings and irritates, it means a lot I'm giving this 5 stars.  This retinal cream has been fantastic.  My skin feels smooth,  more even toned, brighter and just looks and feels healthier.  I'm blessed with few wrinkles so I'm hoping to ward them off for as long as possible by using a retinol product consistently.  I started using this cream only at night and did experiences some stinging.  That soon went away and I now use it In the morning as well.  It absorbs quickly so it's great under my makeup.  I also use sunscreen daily.  I love that it's organic.  I love that's it's a multitasking product.  I'll be ordering more.  One pump is enough to cover my face, neck, and decolotage.  I'm not finding that I need an additional moisturizer although, I sometimes at night use a facial oil after about an hour of applying this cream for extra glow the next morning.  I think when my facial oil is used up, I will try their regular moisturizer for that added glow some extra hydration seems to always give me.  Customer service is lovely.....they emailed me to see if I had any issues with this cream and I don't!

title: Come on, monitored, a bit of sparkle, and coconut!  It's awesome
text: Very moisturizing and so pretty.  I use this when I have a date or a special night out.  Smells delicious!

title: Healthy food for my skin!
text: Too soon for me to tell a difference in my skin.... I've been using only 5 days 1x per day. It absorbs quick and feels great on my skin.  I expect to see results over time... Serums take time.  Consistency is key.  I use this only in the morning.  I will update again after longer use.

title: Love this cleanser, my favorite
text: I love this cleanser..... It works soooo well, gets ALL my makeup off and my skin feels great afterward.  Not oily, just soft and very clean.  I love mini sizes too....a little goes a long way with this oil

title: My skin though is nice and soft in the morning
text: A bit heavy for me, takes awhile to sink in my skin and even though I use at night, I wish it absorbed a little quicker.  I don't use a lot. Could use some additional goodies for the skin... Peptides etc.  My skin though is nice and soft in the morning

Unfortunately the first one I used started unraveling after about 5 to 7 uses. I really like them but am unsure if I would purchase them again. Perhaps I can find a way to better reinforce them.

title: Nice eyebrow pencil
text: This is the second time purchasing these and time I purchased 2. Love these and they work great in filling in my eyebrows. The only problem I have is the cap falls off. It has happened on all of them. This item would be a 5 if not for that.

title: Great lip gloss!

title: Pretty hair comb.
text: This is a beautiful hair comb that I purchased to put my hair up in a French knot for a funeral. It is gorgeous and seems to be well made. It is very heavy but it does stay in  my hair if I have enough hair in the comb.  I have purchased other bobby pins and clips that were heavy that didn't stay in my hair but this does. The only thing is I thought this listing came with 2 combs but it is only one comb and now it is too late to order the other one that I need. This was my mistake as I ordered style "2" and I mistook it for two combs being in this listing instead of one. I would never pay close to $10 or more for one of these but I like it and I will keep it.

title: Could be better. They do work but aren't as high quality ...

title: Wow, what a disappointment
text: I have been eyeing this lotion for months now and I originally was going to buy the coriander scent but decided to go for lime since we were headed into Spring. The lotion is so loud and smells so bad that I had to wash it off my hands to stop coughing. The scent gave me a headache and was very unpleasant. The texture and feel of the lotion wasn't bad, but for the price I paid and the amount given...It was ridiculous. It's like you're paying for the heavy glass bottle instead of the product. Yes the packaging is nice, but the lotion should have been the star. What's ironic is there's no hint of lime, not even a little bit. It's a hit you in the face, foul floral smelling nightmare.

title: I really love this deodorant cream

It is easy to apply, lasts all day and works so well.I live in Texas so the heat can get humid and unbearable. Other brands don't even last 1/2 a day but this lasts all day and night. The smell is pleasant and not overbearing and for the value it can't be beat.

title: Strong Smell
text: These hair clips smell so strongly. It smells like you were in a nail salon, huffing right above them applying acrylic. The strong smell does not go away quickly either. The clips themselves are fine. I feel like they’re a little bit on the small side, but I have very thick hair.

title: Fun Clips
text: These clips are so much fun. They do have quite a bit of hair, but if you have very thick hair they’re not gonna hold all of your hair. I hold about half of my thick curly hair. But they look really cute

title: Calming
text: This is a really nice bag of epsom salt. Honestly, I didn't notice much difference from the brand I can pick up locally, but they are nice. The scent is nice and relaxing. The epsom salt helps relax muscles and relieve tension. Great for all of pregnancy!

title: Great Nails
text: I was a little skeptical about the gel polish thing. These are like the nail strips you get, they don’t have to be heated or anything. You just put them on, follow them down, and then put them under a UV light to harden. They get very hard. They almost feel like fake nails once they’re on. They are on the thick side. But I didn’t notice any damage to my nails when they came off.

title: Great Soap
text: This soap is great! I’m very picky about soap and this one is great! It is slightly gritty, but that doesn’t transfer to a washcloth or loofah. The smell is great— very light. It is great for sensitive skin. Isn’t irritating or drying at all.

title: They Mean Jumbo
text: When they say jumbo, they really mean it! This is a massive clip! It is great for super thick hair! (Or long hair that you want to double up in a clip.) It holds well and doesn’t pull.

title: Love These
text: I love these clips. They work extremely well, even on thick hair. They don’t pull or slide. Very easy to use.

title: Didn’t Notice Much
text: This is really for hair that isn’t very coarse, I’m not super curly. It doesn’t seem to do very much. It didn’t work really well for my curly hair, but it seems to work much better on my daughters wavy hair. Her hair is long and wavy and it just keeps the frizz down a little bit. I wouldn’t say it’s defining her waves though. Just lessening the frizz.

title: Very Thick
text: This is a very thick program. It is very heavy. I really like it, but it is very heavy and will weigh your hair down. But sometimes that is what is curly haired folks need. It seems to do better with coarser hair then finer hair.

title: Not For Me
text: The shampoo was not for me. It just didn’t clean my hair enough. It would be great if you washed your hair very frequently, or didn’t use much product. But for me it just wasn’t quite what I needed.

title: Pretty Good
text: Just leave in conditioner is pretty good. It isn’t my favorite that I’ve ever used, but it does work well. It doesn’t leave the hair too oily. Although it is very heavy. It would not be suitable for thin hair.

title: Fantastic Cream
text: This cream is great! It works really well on sore muscles. It isn’t greasy and doesn’t have a strong smell. Very soothing.

title: Huge!
text: These scrunchies are huge! They are great for putting your hair up after a shower. I don’t necessarily know if they actually dry the hair better, but they are awesome anyway.

title: Dry Feet
text: These smell good. They don't make your feet any smoother! For a week after you use them, you'll have the most unbelievably dry skin on your feet and you'll leave skin flakes all over the place. But once all of that has passed, your feet aren't in any better condition than they were to begin with. In fact, it left certain spots around my toenails dry for almost a month. I wanted them to work. But they were definitely not for me.

title: Not Enough Clips
text: This set comes with twice as many curlers as clips. That is annoying. But the curlers are nice. They hold well. They’re great for adding volume to your hair. For best results, I have found that if I dry my hair most of the way and then put these in while it is damp, blast each curler with the blow dryer for a few seconds, let it set until cool and hair is dry, then remove and brush— I get great volume. If you apply to fully wet hair, you’ll wait all day for your hair to dry unless you have one of those old school dryers to sit under.

title: Great
text: I thought these would be good for my young daughter since she still has fine hair. I was surprised that they work with thicker hair, as well. My hair is medium thickness and past my shoulders and one of these will hold my hair. It also works on my daughter's baby fine hair. They're also really cute with a half up hair style. The prongs are quite long. And they're really cute.

title: Scores an 8
text: On the Think Dirty app, this sunscreen scores an 8. The only problematic ingredient is the fragrance. There are much cleaner sunscreens out there. That said, this sunscreen does work. It is mineral based so it is thicker and takes longer to rub in. I very much prefer a mineral based sunscreen (in fact, I won’t use anything else), so I find it similar to other mineral based sunscreens. It works well. It does separate a little in the heat, so I massaged the tube a bit before each use.

title: Skinny Iron
text: This is a really good flat iron. It is on the skinny side. I have thick, wavy/curly hair and this flat iron works to straighten it really well. I do have to section my hair out and go little section by section— but that is kind of just how flat ironing curly hair works.

title: Dries Quick, Chips Quick
text: This nail polish does not dry in 60 seconds. We timed it and it was more like 90 seconds to 120 seconds. However, that is still pretty fast. The only problem I really have is that it also chips quickly. It does not hold up well at all. In order to get it to stay on, you have to put on a topcoat, which defeats the purpose of having quick dry nail polish. But for something quick and easy that you need done right this second, it works well. The moon stone color does not show chipping as well as the more solid colors. It is also a great color for a topcoat.

title: Curly Hair
text: This shampoo is great for curly hair. It is a very thick shampoo. It would weigh down fine hair, but works great for thick hair. It is very moisturizing, but doesn’t leave a build up on my hair. It smells nice, too.

title: Shower Comb
text: This is a great comb to hang in the shower to use while you’ve got conditioner in your hair. It is wide tooth and great for thick, curly hair. The hook makes it super convenient. It is holding up great.

title: So Good
text: I don’t know what magic Nyx works with their matte liquid lipsticks, but this one is no different. Such good quality. It looks great. Doesn’t transfer. Dries down matte (it takes a few minutes). Lasts all day. Doesn’t get crusty looking or make lips look dry and cracked. Love it! This will definitely be my go-to lipstick for fall.

title: Great Clips
text: These clips are great! I have thick, curly hair and these hold my hair very well. They're very slim looking, but they hold well. I've seen these selling in boutiques individually for the price of 8 on here! They are good quality and are holding up well.

title: Hold Thick Hair
text: These clips are sturdy! They hold thick hair really well. They are a bit big for a halfway up style, but for all the hair, they’re awesome. Much more comfortable than a messy bun!

title: Small Clips
text: These clips are great for normal or thin hair. For my semi-thick hair, they barely hold. So if you have truly thick hair, these are not for you. They also work well on my three-year-old’s wild, curly hair. She likes these better than ponytail holders because they don’t hurt your head at all. Very comfortable to wear!

title: Works Well
text: This soap works well. It does seem like a bit of waste to have it all just ready to go instead of using concentrate with water. Really, I just don’t like the smell. It doesn’t smell like pear at all. It smells like restaurant hand soap.

title: Half Clips
text: These clips are pretty small. They are appropriate for pulling half my hair up at a time. If your hair is super thin or for a younger child, you may be able to do all your hair. They work well and look really nice. They aren’t too heavy either.

title: Cute, But Heavy
text: These clips are very cute. However, they are very heavy. If your hair is on the thin side, these are likely not going to work. My hair is thick, but I still could really feel them. Definitely not clips I'd wear every day. Maybe I'll take them out every now and then-- but whoah baby are they heavy and pull your hair!

title: Broken
text: These are super cute, but they are poorly made. The clip parts are glued and one of them broke the first time I squeezed it. Like, the glued on part just popped completely off immediately. Two of them are usable, but I'm always nervous when I squeeze them that they will break, too. They're definitely not well made.

title: Not As Expected
text: This is the second foot peeling mask I have tried. This one performs just as well, if not better, than the other brand I tried from Ulta. That being said, the peeling effect wasn't as expected. The directions said that if you have significant problems, you should use one and then four days later use the other-- so that is what I did. The foot masks have to be cut open and are just a plastic bag with solution in it. The foot bags are foot shaped and have a little tape tab that you wrap around your ankle to close them. They smell very strongly of lavender. You can sit and read or watch TV while the mask sets. The peeling I experienced was more like just really dry skin on my feet. My feet didn't peel so much as flake and just look ashy and dry for a couple weeks. It didn't significantly help with my heels. (I'm a Southern mama and rarely wear shoes indoors or out, so perhaps that was more of a problem than these could tackle.) My feet were a little softer. But this isn't the same, at all, as getting the "baby feet" pedicure at the nail salon.

title: Great product!
text: I love it. It applies well and moisturizes well. It smells good, but isn't too intense. It doesn't leave my beard oily and can also be used in my hair. Great stuff!

title: Problematic Formula
text: This lotion is smooth and feels nice on the skin. It is a mineral based sunscreen, so it does have a white cast to it. I do still prefer mineral based sunscreen. The problematic part is the use of citrus oils to "brighten" skin in a product for sun use. Citrus oils cause photosensitivity to the skin, so in sunlight, the skin burns more quickly. Putting that in a sunscreen seems very ill advised. I find it find for the winter, when I'm not in the sun quite as much, but in the summer, I'm definitely not going to be using this face lotion.

title: Cinnamon
text: This lip plumper is cinnamon based, it seems. It smells like cinnamon, which is quite pleasant. The color is really nice and the gloss is great. It lasts a couple hours before needing to reapply. It does feel hot on the lips. Not just a tingle, but hot. Think cinnamon on your lips. I didn't really notice any plumping action. But I did tend to hold my lips away from my mouth a bit more because of the hot feel on my lips. It isn't entirely unpleasant. It isn't unbearable. But it is definitely hot.

title: Works Well
text: This works as well as the name brand, as far as I can tell. It is heavy in the had and shaves smoothly. It is a good quality razor and I have zero complaints about its function.

title: No Smell
text: So, at first, you think this is a knock-off product. The lip balms are nothing like Lip Smackers lip balms usually are. There is no smell, no flavor. So, even though it says it is waffles and syrup, it isn't really anything. Which is a bummer. This also has lots of tiny parts. Don't expect quality of any kind. The lip brushes and eye shadow applicators are horrible quality. Nothing in this box is decent. I'd give it one star. However, my daughter loves all of it. She proudly carries it around and loves all of it. The lack of scent and flavor don't bother her little preschool heart. So, I gave it three stars since she adores it.

title: Light
text: This eyeshadow is very light feeling on the lids. You don't really feel or notice it at all. You can build it up to get more of a color impact. Or you can dab it on with your finger lightly and have just a tiny amount of color. It isn't super matte when dry, it still has a little bit of moisture to it, so it doesn't make fine lines around the eyes pronounced. I really like it.

title: Great Natural Deodorant
text: I really like this deodorant. It is very much like Native deodorant, if you’ve ever tried that one. It smells nice and works a good 8-12 hours. It can be a little bit soft and easy to apply way too much. But it is easy to apply. I think the jar version might be personally preferable to me because I tend to get too much on with the stick. Either way, a good natural deodorant with no baking soda! (So it won’t blister your arm pits!)

title: Not Impressed
text:
The container feels backwards. The top is the wide, flat end. The bottom is the point. That just feels backwards. It is especially weird when holding it. It just doesn’t feel right.
The crayon part is really thin. It has a consistency like lip liner and is just barely thicker than a lip liner. It makes lining the lips simple, but the filling is a bit more difficult. You can use the tapered side of the crayon to fill the lips.
The formula was thick, but didn’t offer much coverage. It was also pretty dry and left my lips feeling chapped and uncomfortable. It wasn’t smooth or creamy. It felt like an almost matte lipstick.
Overall, it just didn’t work for me. I did like the color. But it wasn’t long lasting enough or pigmented enough.

title: Sticky
text: This is similar to matte liquid lipstick, but it feels sticky and never fully dries down. If it isn’t going to dry, I’d just prefer to use a typical lipstick rather than a liquid version. The color was fine and I like the shape of the applicator. But I don’t like how the lipstick felt and I didn’t like how it wore.

title: Work Well
text: My boys have super thick hair that is wavy/curly. It is really difficult for them to get shampoo all the way through their hair. These shampoo brushes make it much easier for them to get their hair clean. With these, they can get the shampoo worked in and sudsy much quicker and with much less shampoo. They’re able to get their scalps clean when they never were able to before. These are easy to hold and easy to use.

title: Not Moisturizing Enough
text: This serum isn't very moisturizing. It dries a bit sticky. I haven't noticed any remarkable improvement in my skin. In fact, if anything, my pores seem a bit bogged down. They aren't clogged, but they're more textured with this serum than before. It smelled fine. The bottle worked fine. It has a bit of slip and feels nice putting it one. It does layer with moisturizers perfectly fine. My skin didn't seem more radiant. It did nothing for my dark spots. I don't have a lot of fine lines. And it wasn't enough for dry skin.

title: Local
text: I was surprised to find that this brand is local to me— made in Georgia. This leave-in conditioner is on the thin side. It could be a bit more moisturizing for my personal taste. I find it to be just a tad bit too thin and watery. It is fine. It just isn’t quite as thick and moisturizing as I need. But it smells pretty good and it doesn’t weigh my hair down.

title: Local!
text: This curl cream is really impressive. It works just as well as some double the price products. The smell is like grape candy. It just kind of smells a little sweet once it is dry in my hair. Also, I was surprised to find that this product was local for me! It is made in Stone Mountain, Georgia. It doesn’t have any of the bad stuff in it. It leaves my curls defined, but nice and soft.

title: Work Well
text: We were a bit skeptical, but my teenager and I were determined to see what kind of curls we could achieve with these curlers. You have to work with rather small sections of hair, as larger pieces will not work. The silicone edges of the curlers keep them from slipping, but they also pull your hair when you're removing them. That takes some hair with it. If your hair is thick enough to withstand losing some, these will give Shirley Temple style curls. They're also pretty comfortable to sleep on. Much more comfortable than standard rollers, for sure. About the same as wearing rag rollers. They do take a long time to get all you're hair up. But one set was plenty for my daughter who has very thick hair.

title: Soft Ponytails
text: These are really nice and soft. They don’t pull your hair. They are a bit much for toddler hair, like they should be a little bit smaller and thinner I think for toddlers.
