But my toddler loves to wear them anyway. They just look like she’s going on a giant scrunchie because of how many times I have to go around her hair. However, they work well. And the cute little color combinations are awesome.

title: Nice Scent
text: This cologne has a nice scent to it. I wouldn’t say it is my favorite, but there isn't really anything wrong with it either. A nice masculine scent that is appropriate for everyday wear.

title: Best for Men
text: This is a blowdryer best for men. The attachments are really great for short hair. There is no diffuser for curly hair. It is a bit smaller than other hair dryers. It does get pretty hot. I do find it weird that the attachments for this dryer don't fit other Hot Tools hair dryers.

title: Easy to Use
text: These roller balls are very easy to use. You can make your own oil mixtures that are easy to apply. We just filled it most of the way with a carrier oil, and then placed our essential oil in that. The droppers were extremely helpful for getting the carrier oil from the big bottle into the small bottles. The labels don’t stick if the bottle isn’t completely clean, so we had to clean the outside of the bottle with alcohol after filling to apply the labels.

title: Fantastic
text: These are excellent hair ties. They hold my hair perfectly fine (2c fairly thick, long hair) and my two-year-old’s baby fine curls, as well. They are on the small side, which I like.

title: Surprisingly Impressed
text: I didn't expect this product to be that great, but I'm truly impressed. The shears and the thinning shears are both heavy, strong, and sharp, which I wasn't expecting. The razor is quite dinky, though— not a surprise, but it does the job. Not a bad product at all. I was surprisingly impressed.

title: Terrible
text: These are the worst emery boards I have ever used. The grit on sides 1, 2, and 3 seen the exact same— very coarse. There is no light or medium grit on this emery board. Sides of four, five, and six, are all the same too. They aren’t even really gritty at all. Seven is just slicker. They’re pretty terrible. You get very coarse grit, nothing, and slick. They don’t work.

title: Cheap Shampoo
text: This shampoo reminds me of Tresemme, which is already a super cheap shampoo. It isn't that there is really anything wrong with the shampoo, it just isn't impressive in any way. It is just super cheap, basic shampoo.

title: Works Well
text: I have 2c wavy/curly hair that is very porous. I was skeptical if this would actually dry and straighten my hair. It works! It was a little difficult to dry the roots. The power cord rotates as you twist the brush. The oval shape of the brush keeps hair from tangling on it. My hair is pretty long and I had no issues with the brush getting tangled in my hair. I basically just used it like I would the round brush when usually drying my hair straight. It does get super hot. So I would recommend a heat protectant product on the hair and if you have a heat resistant glove, definitely wear it on the hand you’re not holding the brush in. It has a cool tip on the brush, but the hair gets super hot. I also recommend brushing through on the cool setting once you’re done drying to add some shine.

title: Not Strong Enough
text: I have 2c hair that is highly porous. This brush is too flimsy for me to use to dry my hair straight. Even for finishing, it just isn’t sturdy enough for my hair. It would work much better with fine/thin hair— which is pretty much the opposite of my hair.

title: Puffy Eyes
text: I tend to get puffy under my eyes. These are by no means a complete cure. But if I put them on before applying makeup, they do reduce the puffiness significantly.

title: Work Well
text: These work well to remove makeup. They are soft and gentle enough to use around the eyes. They don’t have a strong smell.

title: Okay
text: As soap, it works. I'm not the biggest fan of the smell. It smells more like a floral Bath and Body Works type scent than I would really like. It may be just the thing for some people. I found it to be an obnoxious smell.

title: Works Pretty Well
text: My daughter has unicorn hair. It is bleached. She retouches with bright colors as needed. This was not quite as long-lasting as Arctic Fox hair color, but just as long-lasting as Manic Panic. The color was great. It applied easily. It will stain anything and everything it touches. It lasted about 4 weeks before it faded to the point of needed to recolor. One bottle lasted two colorings coloring about a fourth of my daughter's very thick shoulder-length hair.

title: Not As Good As Nyx
text: This just isn't as good as other drugstore matte liquid lipstick. I think this dries my lips more the other cheap stuff out there. It is no where near as nice as Coulourpop. It is dry and makes your lips look cracked and old.

title: Pretty Much All The Same
text: While this is a set of three different colors, they are pretty much all the same color. They end up working like mood changing lip balm from when I was a kid. They all make your lips a hot pinkish color. It is really hard to tell the color difference at all. They aren’t awful— they just aren’t revolutionary or even something I will repurchase. My teen daughter was pretty “meh” about them, too.

title: Perfect Lotion
text: I love the feel of this lotion. It is thick and moisturizing without leaving your skin feeling greasy. The scent is a nice vanilla orange scent that is really perfect for summer.

title: Emery Board
text: One side has really thick grit. The other is a medium grit. They are sturdy and work well. The colors keep me from losing them so much. These are large emery boards.

title: Chunky Glitter
text: This nail polish has really chunky glitter, though it is a little sparse. My teenager loves it. It does dry pretty quickly. If you do multiple layers, it works better to let the polish dry between coats.

title: So Nice
text: This smells exactly like the soap! It is very moisturizing. We’ve had no issues with sensitivity. I absolutely love the scent, but there is definitely a scent. It is kind of a clean, floral smell. I really like it. If you aren’t a fan of scents or aren’t a fan of that slightly floral old lady smell— you may want to skip this and the soap. I think it is the best smelling baby lotion ever.

title: Fantastic
text: I don’t think this provides quite enough or long-lasting enough moisture, so I prefer to think of it as a primer and wear it over my usual day moisturizer. (Which isn’t too heavy with both.) It makes my skin look flawless. It provides the right amount of luminosity. I don’t look like a shiny, glittery mess. It gives skin a healthy glow. I have worn it alone, under powder, and under powder foundation. It works well in all scenarios.

title: Scent Heavy
text: This dry shampoo is scent heavy. It smells like you took a bath in body spray. It also doesn’t work really well as dry shampoo. It doesn’t make hair look less oily at all. All it does is make your hair smell like a middle school boy.

title: Looked Fake
text: This eyebrow pencil was just too much for me. It did not give a natural look to the brows at all. It wasn’t a “your brows but better” look, but a “look at these brows” look. It just wasn’t for me.

title: Gloss
text: This is a very pigmented lip gloss. It doesn’t last a long time on the lips. It will also come off on everything. It isn’t a liquid lipstick, really. It really is a pigmented gloss. The color payoff is great. It didn’t streak and looked like a smooth even color without any real effort.

title: Looks Pretty
text: This gloss looks pretty. It feels terrible. It is gritty and makes my lips feel chapped after a couple minutes of wearing it. It definitely isn’t for me.

title: Weird Smell
text: This mask isn’t the best detox mask ever, but it does work. You have to wash it off, and it foams a little bit as you wash it off. The smell is weird. It is slightly licorice smelling, which isn’t a good thing for me. It is decent, if you can tolerate the smell, but it isn’t for me.

title: Just As Good As Expensive Disposables
text: I really prefer reusable handle razors, but find these helpful for traveling. These are just a nice as the pricey name brand version. They work well and I have no issues with the quality.

title: Gloss
text: This gloss looks really nice. The formula reminds me of some other drug stores brands, which isn’t a bad thing. The gloss is a subtle color and adds lots of shine. It is a gloss, so there isn’t a lot of staying power.

title: Nice Soap
text: This soap smells awesome. It is such a clean, relaxing lavender scent. It foams up really well. It leaves your skin with a hint of moisture on it. These bars do go a bit quicker than other pressed soaps do. One bar lasts us about 2 weeks in the shower. It is a pretty large square bar.

title: Smells So Nice
text: These soaps smell so nice. They have a really nice lather. All four are floral scents, so if that isn't your thing, definitely skip this set. These do go a bit faster than some other bars of soap. One bar lasts us about 2 weeks in the shower. As a hand soap, it would last about a month, maybe a bit more.

title: Just Okay
text: This brush doesn’t work as well as my previous ceramic brush. It doesn’t give the same shine to the hair and I’m not entirely sure why. The brush handle is also very narrow, which causes some discomfort in my grip when drying my hair. I feel like it should be slightly larger.

title: Bright and Saturated
text: These colors are really bright and saturated. They are buildable. I found that if I slowly build the color, they aren’t as splotchy and the color looks richer than if I go in heavy handed. The colors are all matte. I was pleasantly surprised with the quality. They packaging isn’t cute or sleek, but the shadows themselves work well.

title: Jade Face Roller
text: This facial roller is a little more narrow on the wider end than other rollers I have tried. And a little wider on the narrow end than other rollers. The rollers work really well. They roll very smoothly. The stone, up close, has a lot of variation, but is completely smooth. It is very soothing to roll this across your face, particularly around the eye area. The stone is cold and it helps reduce puffiness around the eyes.

title: Drying
text: This lipstick is super drying to the lips. It goes on metallic and when you smack your lips together it ends up glittery. There is very little difference in the metallic or glittery look. It also stains the lips pretty significantly. If you make the mistake of moving your mouth before it is completely dry, it’ll travel everywhere. It does stay for a while if you let it fully dry. But again, it is super drying on the lips.

title: Coconut Cream
text: This cream is nice, but it has a very weird consistency. It feels like straight coconut oil. It isn’t smooth at all, but hardens at room temperature and always feels a bit chunky. You can get past that point by rubbing it in your hands to warm it up. It smells like coconut oil. It is soothing and doesn’t seem to bother sensitive skin at all.

title: Lipstick
text: This is a smooth, creamy lip color. It is very light and thin feeling on the lips. It has a soft color to it. It has absolutely zero staying power. Like, if you think about touching something with your lips it disappears. It doesn’t smear around, but definitely comes off on cups and such. Reapplication throughout the day is necessary. But the feel of it is really nice. It looks nice.

title: Chalky Mess
text: I was just not impressed with this palette. The powders feel really chalky. I just don’t feel like they are the best quality. The concealers were a little too bright. They are color correcting, but much brighter than standard color correcting. I also wasn’t a huge fan of the texture, but I am super picky about concealers.

title: Highlight Stick
text: I really liked this product, not just for the brow, but for lining the lower lid, as well. One side of the stick is a matte darker shade. The other side is a more pearlescent highlighter shade. Using the matte color on the lower lash line and the highlighter in the inner corner makes your eyes pop! Yes, you can use it on your brows, too, and I did. That didn't wow me very much. It was fine, but I can easily brush some light shadow up there. The texture is a little on the creamy side. A little more creamy than standard eyeliner.

title: Don't Work Miracles
text: These eye masks are pretty good. They are paper style under eye masks with a gold foil honeycomb print. They fit my eyes well, though if you have wider eyes, they may be too narrow. They stay on and feel nice. They don't really do much in terms of depuffing. They do add moisture to your under eye area and my undereye concealer doesn't crease as much when I use these. But they don't take the puffy bags completely away.

title: Not Moisturizing Enough
text: I like the feel of this moisturizer. It has that creamy-but-gel-like feel to it that hyaluronic acid has to it. I have no problems with sensitivity or breakouts with it. I just feel like it isn't moisturizing enough. It sinks in and completely disappears in a matter of minutes, leaving my skin feeling pretty dry. I tried layering it, to see if I used more, letting each layer sink in that maybe it would be the correct moisture level. It wasn't. I have to add another moisturizer on top, which pretty much defeats the purpose of this one. I tried adding it on thicker to begin with. That didn't seem to make enough of a difference.

title: Smells
text: This has a smell a bit like a perm. Like, not strong, but likely a diluted perm. It also burns when you apply it after washing your face. I'm just not a fan of this formula. I prefer a glycolic acid serum or something more like that. This is thick, so it feels like too much to put moisturizer over it. But it isn't enough to be your night-time moisturizer. And the smell is unpleasant.

title: Rainbow Unicorn Hair
text: My daughter has unicorn hair, so we've been using this on her hair to keep her color looking bright. We use the color stripper/prep packet before we add the new color to her bleached hair. Then we use the small packet of the color locker after. Then the regular shampoo and conditioner. We've only been having to color her hair every 3 months or so using Arctic Fox hair color. I think this helps the color not fade as quickly and it is definitely keeping her hair soft and shiny.

title: Creamy Lipstick
text: This is very creamy lipstick. It wears off naturally, so you don’t have weird color clothing going on. I prefer the pink bubble color, it is a pinky nude. Bright pink is bright fuschia. It is not long lasting. It is not transfer proof. Just nice, creamy color. There is zero scent.

title: Like Most Expensive Lipgloss
text: I have some much more expensive sparkle lip gloss that feels like the exact same formula as this gloss. It is super sparkly. It isn't long-wearing-- it is a gloss. It has a slight gritty texture due to the glitter, but I feel that with expensive glitter glosses. It does dry my lips out, as does the expensive one. So it is a good dupe for the expensive stuff, but I'm not entirely in love with the formula.

title: Hydrating
text: This double mask contains the same mask in two colors. It stays on really well and conforms to your face. It is a sheet mask that has gold or silver foil on the outside. It has a floral scent to it. It really does add moisture to the skin. I like it.

title: Small Tins
text: These tins are tiny. They really aren't very big. But they smell SO NICE. I'm telling you, these are better than most colognes I've come across. I was disappointed in the size of the tins at first, but the smell quickly won me over and I'd pay for them again and again. The solid formula is really nice to use. It goes where you put it and it stays longer than a spritz.

title: Hot Pink Lips
text: This lip color is really easy to apply. I tried it out for a full day wear test with no lip liner. I had no issues with it creeping out of lines. I blotted after applying and let the lip color dry before touching it. It was pretty quick to dry and the formula feels weightless on the lips. I had no problem with shifting or moving during wear, which is often a problem for me and bright colors. It faded off pretty flawlessly. It did leave more of a line around my lips, but it wasn't anything that looked straight awful. It stayed really well through drinking. I did have it come off more while eating, but it didn't come off completely and it didn't smear. It was so lightweight that I honestly forgot I had it on.

title: Awesome Product!!!
text: This pomade is legit! It holds well but is not too shiny. The minty smell is wonderful. Overall, I'm impressed. Awesome product!!!

title: Great Pomade!
text: It is as advertised. It holds firm, smells nice, and has a bit of shine, especially when applied to wet or damp hair.

title: Nice Serum
text: This is a very gentle exfoliating serum. I used it at night before applying mosturizer. The smell is very light and clean— nothing too very heavy. The serum is light on the skin. It isn’t thick or creamy. Just a thin liquid that you apply. It leaves your skin looking “awake” in the morning.

title: Love Hot Tools
text: I regularly buy and use Hot Tools brand hair products. They work well and are reliable. This curling iron has a clamp and is fat, more for like big volume type waves than curls. It gets really hot and works well.

title: Cute Tube
text: The tube is really cute. The lipstick leaves a lot to be desired. The formula smears and moves around the lips. You definitely need a lip liner, but then when the color wears off (super quickly) you’ll be left with just the liner. I need more staying power, especially in a red lipstick.

title: Loofah
text: Very dense loofahs. They loosen up with use. They work really well. I have no complaints.

title: Not for Me
text: I’m not a fan of this formula. It is a bit sheer and has no staying power. It stains the lips a pink color. I’m just not a fan of the color payoff and lack of staying power.

title: They Work
text: I like these. The cloths aren’t too flimsy. The solution isn’t irritating at all. They do have a very slight lavender scent, but it isn’t heavy at all. They remove makeup pretty well.

title: Great for Long Curly Hair
text: I didn’t anticipate liking this gel as much as I do. I use it on my long hair when wet to help set the curls. (I use a curling cream and then this gel.) it isn’t crunchy at all when dry and holds my curls really well. It is a lighter hold gel and doesn’t really dry like a gel. It dries more like a wax or pomade. It smells really nice.

title: Decent
text: This foundation has decent, build able coverage. I like the dispenser. It keeps pretty clean. It is pretty moisturizing. It does get caked pretty easily if you aren’t careful in applying and blending. I think it blends best with a damp beauty blender. It isn’t perfect, but it is decent. I haven’t found a perfect foundation yet, though.

title: love it
text: I love this beard conditioner. Honestly, though, I didn't realize that it's a leave-in conditioner till just now (writing this review). I've been using it as a traditional wash-out conditioner, and I've been impressed.

title: Sticky
text: I've tried this in numerous settings under a variety of circumstances. As a primary moisturizer, it is pretty awful. It isn't moisturizing enough. As a serum used before my moisturizer, it works pretty well. If you let it completely dry down before putting your moisturizer on. It dries pretty stickily, so it can actually work as a primer if you don't need the extra moisturizer on top.

title: Soft Brushes
text: The handles of these look so cheap. However, the bristles feel really nice. That leaves me more than a little on the fence about these. On the one hand, they work well. On the other, they look like a super cheap mess. I think I prefer a better overall brush, but these aren't awful.

title: Color- Yes!
text: I love the color of this cream eyeshadow. However, I cannot get the formula to work for me. This isn't the first product this consistency I couldn't make work. With a lighter color, I can see making it work. But you just don't have enough control of the product to not just look like a muddy mess on your eyes. I tried patting. I tried a brush. I tried eyeshadow primer. I tried layering it under powder shadow. I tried over powder shadow. Nothing seems to help. This just isn't the product for me.

title: Excellent Blow Dryer
text: This blow dryer is excellent. I specifically like the diffuser. I have curly hair and not all diffusers are made equal. This blow dryer gets very hot and works really well. It does also come with an attachment for drying hair straight, but those aren't too difficult to get right.

title: Just Okay
text: This has a dry brush cleaning pad and a bar of soap with a silicone mat to deeper clean brushes. The dry cleaning sponge works really well for quick color changes. The soap and silicone is fine. I prefer to use my own soap for my brushes. And the silicone sticker in the top of the lid isn’t deep enough or varies enough for a good clean.

title: Essential Oil
text: Mine didn’t have labels. However, the bottle works really well. The sprayer works well, even with essential oils. They don’t clog the sprayer. It has a good strong, even mist. I really like them, even though mine didn’t have the cute labels.

title: Awesome Scrunchies
text: These are excellent scrunchies. They hold my hair really well. They are big a fluffy. I absolutely love them all.

title: Wide Headband
text: This headband is really wide and keeps your hair back out of your face. It works well for washing my face, but I think I like it most when using face masks. It keeps all my hair back and out of the mask.

title: Bold and Fake
text: This is the worst eyebrow product I have ever used. It does not look at all natural. It is a very long application process. The doe foot applicator applies the product, then you brush it in with small strokes with the small angled brush, then you brush the hairs with the spoolie. It looks so fake. Very bold. But in no way natural. I already have pretty bold brows, so this was definitely over the top for me. It is also pretty difficult to remove, which is likely a plus, unless you mess up. You must remove with an oil based cleanser.

title: Not Volumizing
text: I can be very sensitive to mascaras, so I was a little nervous to try this mascara. It doesn't irritate my eyes at all. However, it isn't volumizing at all, either. If I was super set on needing volume, this mascara would get one star. It does not give ANY volume at all. It is more of a natural darkened and separated look. It doesn't layer up well. But as a basic mascara, it works really well. If you're looking for a more natural looking mascara, this might just be it.

title: Stays Put
text: This lipstick stays put. It doesn’t transfer to my coffee cup. It doesn’t smear everywhere when I eat. It is an excellent shade of red. The applicator is year drop shaped which makes it really easy to get nice lines. It isn’t too liquid. It is a little on the sticky side, but it doesn’t rub off. It has a slight velvet look to the finish. Matte but not dry.

title: Argan Oil
text: This is nice Argan oil. I use it on my curly hair. Just a couple drops to tame the frizz after I dry it. I do like the pump because I find that I don’t overdo it as much. I can pump a little into my hands and work it in directly where it is needed.

title: Good Shampoo
text: This shampoo works pretty well. It isn't life changing or revolutionary. It is moisturizing and worked well with my curly hair. I just didn't find it to be radically more than just shampoo. I mean, I didn't hate it. It smells nice. It just wasn't hair magic or anything.

title: Decent Conditioner
text: This conditioner works pretty well. It isn't the best conditioner or magical. It is just good, reliable conditioner. It helps significantly with tangles. It isn't super smoothing. It doesn't make your hair silky. But it does help with detangling and does condition it pretty well.

title: An Awesome Shaver!!!
text: I don't shave much, but when I do, I love using this shaver. Its throw-back style is cool, but its performance is FAR BETTER than my previous shaver from a different company. I have very sensitive skin, and I hate shaving. I have had a full beard for many years but use a shaver to clean up my neck. This shaver leaves my neck completely smooth, and I've very happy with it.

title: Best Soap
text: This is my favorite soap. It is gentle on my kids’ skin- even the ones prone to eczema. It is strong enough for teen boys to actually get clean. It smells a bit like nag champa- which I really like. It lathers up really nicely.

title: Not for Puffy Eyes
text: I have super puffy under eyes. I have tried a great many creams that claim to fix the issue. Very few even help, much less fix my under eyes. This cream did not help the puffiness at all. There was absolutely no change, even with daily use. It did moisturize under my eyes. It didn’t aggregate my eyes at all. But it didn’t touch the puffiness at all.

title: Own It
text: I’m not sure I fully understand the concept behind four shadows in the same color but different finishes. I tried wearing it alone and while it works, it isn’t really my thing. However, it is good eyeshadow. The matte color (top left) is darker than the norenshinmery shades. The glitter version (top right) is a little more powdery and harder to pick up with a brush. The color payoff is very lacking. The amount of glitter is super subtle, which defies the entire purpose of glitter shadow, in my opinion. The glitter version is the weakest shadow in the pan. The foil version (bottom left) applies very smoothly. The shimmer version (bottom right) is smooth and buttery feeling, but not much color payoff. I prefer using these with other shadows and not all on their own. But the shadows are really decent- except for the glitter let down.

title: Adds Moisture
text: This serum is okay. It does add some extra moisture to your routine without feeling heavy or like you’ve caked your face in lotion. It doesn’t do anything spectacular or feel super silky. It is actually a little on the tacky side, like a primer. In smooths out fine under moisturizer. I go back and forth on if I like it. One day, I love it and the moisture level is perfect with my moisturizer. The next day, I think it doesn’t add anything.

title: Good Set
text: This beard shampoo and oil smell nice. They have a very strong smell. The beard oil is pretty mediocre. This isn’t a high end set, but it does mimic a high end product at a lower price. So, it isn’t quite as good as high end beard products, but it does smell similarly and work pretty well for the price.

title: Just Conditioner
text: I did not find this hair mask to be any more nourishing than standard conditioner. The dry ends of my hair weren’t helped much at all. It did not leave my hair overly greasy. But it also didn’t perform as well as I expect from a treatment mask.

title: Useful Tools
text: This is an interesting little tool kit. I find it useful for things beyond blackheads. It is nice to have smallish tools for a variety of things. Even hangnails and infected toenails. The case holds each tool. I have found this to be much more useful than I initially expected.

title: Nice Face Wash
text: This is a good daily face wash. It is better for oily skin. It has a really nice, pleasant scent. It leaves skin feeling clean and fresh.

title: Not For Me
text: This smells really nice. However, I really don’t like the jar style deodorant. It is just messy. This deodorant also made my underarms pretty sensitive after about a week of solid use. So, definitely not for me. But it smells nice and has good ingredients.

title: Decent Highlighter
text: This highlighter is not as intensely pigmented as I expected. Mix a few drops into your primer and you have an illuminating primer. It is not a super intense highlight. It looks nice, but isn’t as intense as expected. It is a more subtle glow. The pigmentation isn’t enough to use as a blush/highlight combo. I really think it is best mixed into my primer or foundation for a slight glow effect. It can be nice on “no makeup” days for a little shine to the cheeks. I don’t find the liquid formula as easy to use as powder or stick versions.

title: Not My Color
text: I did. It find this powder to be particularly luminating. I’m very pale. This is a bit lighter than standard banana powder, which is always too dark for me- so there is that. The powder is super fine milled and feels really nice. However, for my complexion- I wasn’t the biggest fan of the color. I have more of a pink undertone, so this just made me look a tad jaundiced. It work when I have a tan. But Coty Airspun is just where it is at for me. This isn’t shimmery, as you might expect.

title: Dermablend Set
text: This is not the full line. You don’t get a foundation (step 2). I really love he setting powder and the setting spray. The powder is super fine milled and brightens the under eye. If you apply it with a fluffy brush all over, it is really translucent. If you bake with it, it does lighten that area up considerably. The setting spray is a pump, but sprays a wide area in a super fine mist. I do not like the primer. I’m more of a pore filling primer, so this one just wasn’t my usual. It is very thick, like sticky honey. It does spread well once you warm it up with your hands. But it stays tacky feeling. I had some areas of my face that remained tacky feeling all day. I also dislike the texture of my skin with the primer. However, this set is awesome because you can try and experiment with the various products without fully committing to any of them. You get quite a bit of primer and setting spray. Only a tiny amount of powder.

title: Not The Best
text: These eye masks don’t do much of anything. They do work okay if you put them in the fridge- but any gel mask would do that. The serum seems like a bunch of nothing. The gel patches aren’t even- they are thicker in some areas than others. They don’t stay on all that well. Again- put them in the fridge and you’ll get some depuffing. But any similar mask or reusable eye mask will do that.

title: Not For Me
text: I am not a fan of this conditioner at all. It does not make my hair softer at all. I end up having to use a leave in conditioner after the fact. It is really thick, but it seems to tangle my hair more than if I didn’t use any conditioner. It seems fine for shorter hair. But with my long, curly hair- it just isn’t the right conditioner for me.

title: Foundation Brushes
text: These brushes are really nice. They are really soft, but very densely packed. They are really well made and I have had zero issues with shedding. The smaller brush is an excellent concealer brush. The larger brush is a great foundation brush. I’m really happy with these.

title: Soft and Fluffy
text: These brushes are super soft and fluffy! I really love them. They are really well made. These are perfect for all over face powder, brushing away bake, or if you want to apply brush in a little fluffier fashion. I really like these.

title: Not Great for Long Hair
text: This conditioner smells really nice. I loved the scent and loved how it scented my hair. However, it just wasn’t conditioning enough for me. It was fine for my husband’s shorter hair. But for my long curly hair, it didn’t really do enough. I had to use another leave in conditioner with it.

title: Okay Foundation
text: This foundation is pretty “meh”. I could really only get medium coverage with it. Which is fine for me, I don’t need high coverage. It blends in pretty easily. However, it tends to cake up and crack if you try to build the coverage up at all. From a distance, it looks flawless. Up close, it is a hot mess. I can make it work if I apply very sparingly and go for a more light to medium coverage. Then it looks fine and wears fine. But if you cover with what Inwould think is a normal amount, it cakes and cracks around my chin, smile lines, and between my eyebrows. It works best if you don’t set it. It tends to cake up and settle into lines faster if you try to set it with setting powder. On the whole, it is fine, but definitely not my favorite.

title: Some Really Good
text: This set has a lot of hyaluronic acid components. Some of the items seem full sized, some seem to be samples. I was not a fan of the mask at all. I didn’t like mixing it. I didn’t enjoy how it felt on the skin. I did t see any noticeable improvements to my skin. I do like the eye cream, night cream, and moisturizer. The moisturizer is super thin, like an elixir, but it is super moisturizing. The eye cream is very filling. It decreased the puffiness of my eyes, which is impressive, since most things don’t. The night cream is nice and thick, but doesn’t make my face greasy or break out. The face washes were fine, nothing too very impressive. I was not a fan of the packaging at all. There is no bowl for the mask mixing. The products are just in a plastic tray inside the box. No ingredients are on the individual products.

title: Not For Me
text: This did not work well for me at all. It leaves a burning sensation on my skin. It made my eyes water pretty constantly, even though I didn’t put it on my eyes. The texture felt nice and it layered well under my makeup. But it made my skin so uncomfortable. It made my skin sting and feel kind of puffy. Definitely not going to continue using it. It smells like sunscreen. It has a thicker feel, like sunblock. But not very oily.

title: Nice, Thick Cream
text: This body cream is so thick and nice. It smells nice and relaxing. It is more of a creamy herbal scent and not a harsh herbal scent. The jar is very big and it looks pretty on the counter. I haven’t had any issue with sensitivity with this cream. It feels really nice and provides really nice moisture.

title: Carrier Oil
text: This is a great carrier oil. Add a couple drops of your favorite essential oil to dilute the essential oil. It doesn’t irritate my skin. I like this carrier oil.

title: Nice Cream
text: This cream is nice and thick, but doesn’t feel greasy at all. The moisture does last without leaving your skin feeling wet or greasy. It also doesn’t transfer oil stains onto your shirt. It is a nice cream to help with dryness and itching.

title: Smells Like Chocolate
text: I got this in the color Dose of Cocoa. I love the applicator. It makes putting this lip color on a breeze. It holds just the perfect amount of product. It is very long lasting. I have a hard time getting it off. It does not want to leave. It does not dry down all the way. It stays at a slightly tacky level, but doesn’t come off on my coffee cup, despite the tackiness. I do start getting some minimal transfer around 6 hours after I apply it. It starts wearing off from the center of the lips and starts oooking a little dry after about 6 hours. (Photo is at the 8 hour mark.) This is more of a fall/winter color for me. It does smell like chocolate. It does not taste like chocolate, or even a little sweet.

title: Beautiful Eyes
text: This is a fantastic palette. The colors are so beautiful and flattering. I’m usually pretty picky about eyeshadow, only wearing high end, but figured I’d give this one a chance. I am so glad I did. They blend really easily. The colors are buildsble. I worried that it looked too brown, but in person there is a lot of peach and pink going on in addition to the brown and cream. They stay put and look really nice. No creasing. No fallout. Just beautiful, flattering color.

title: Pretty Set
text: This is such a nice gift set. The box is absolutely beautiful. Perfect for gifting to someone else or yourself. The actual products all have a similar scent, but some contain menthol and some do not. The lotion is pretty basic. It is nice, but nothing fancy. The foaming soap is really like a shaving gel/cream type product. The cleansing mud is really a body scrub. It has a medium grit to it and contains menthol. The black soap is almost like a gel cleanser. It is very thick and doesn't foam up very much, but it does have a nice scent. The scent is very clean and relaxing. Some of the products have a much more powerful smell than others.

title: Oil Slick
text: This is a little jelly pot. It swatched beautifully. The color is amazing. However, there is quite a bit of glitter in it. I tried this several ways. Applying with the finger was the best method, but it always ended up looking muddy and not very neat. The glitter would eventually fall during the day, leaving glitter trails on my cheeks. I tried eye primer. I tried putting it on top of shadow. I tried setting sprays. The application just ended up being a nightmare that I couldn’t get sorted. I tried to color oil slick, which is beautiful, but dark. The application of a lighter color or if you have a darker skin tone, I would have probably not minded to messy looking application.

title: Not For Me
text: I tried this out a few times and just ended up not liking it very much at all. First, the applicator on the end is useless. It is entirely too small for foundation. Plus, I felt like it was rough since it is attached to the plastic. I’ll just stick to my beauty blender for application. My skin is pretty normal. I felt like this caked up and settled into all the wrong areas. Even when I set it, it wasn’t long before it was creasing on me and getting cakey looking between the eyebrows and around the mouth. It does apply really easily from the stick and then blend really well with a beauty blender, but it just always ended up looking bad. It seemed a little too thick. It just didn’t soak into the skin nicely and seemed to hang out on the surface. It also didn’t like to blend with my concealer. I tried a few of them, but they weren’t friends. It worked best with pore filling primer underneath. Illuminating primer was an instant disaster for me. I would say what coverage you get is a medium coverage to full- but the way the product shifts isn’t going to give even coverage anywhere.

title: Best Scrub
text: I really like this scrub. It is super gritty, but also a fine grit to it. It almost feels like it is skin plumping. It makes your skin really glow. I did find it difficult to rinse, but solved that by using it in the shower instead of at the sink. I like this better than other scrubs I have had in the past.

title: Night Cream
text: I can be picky with face creams. I really like this night cream. It smells nice. It is nice and thick without feeling oily or greasy. I feel like my skin is super hydrated without being suffocated in product. My skin is normal, but tends toward oily. I find this night cream to be wonderful.

title: Good For Curly Hair
text: This works really well for tangles and just conditioning your hair. I think I prefer the OGX coconut oil, but this does work well. It is a little heavy for my hair if I am straightening it. It makes it look a bit greasy. But when I wear my hair in its natural curl (which is most of the time), it looks and feels great.

title: Nope
text: These are nowhere near the right texture for a makeup sponge. These are hard and they don’t work well. When you wet them, they don’t hold water properly. They don’t blend really well. They smell like new tennis shoes when you get them. I really gave them several uses and tried them in several ways and they just do not work well. They are much too firm. It is like trying to apply your makeup with an eraser.

title: Joker Smile
text: I am so surprised at how much I dislike this lipstick. Liquid matte lipstick is my usual go-to. And Nyx is one of the brands I reach for again and again. But I really hate this formula. You get tons of color payoff. I didn’t find it particularly patchy and when I first put it on, I was pretty excited and thought it would be love. However, it was pretty sticky. And then, when it wears off, the mess is completely unbearable! It shifts and slides as it comes off. Meaning it ends up all over your face. At first, I tried to just wipe it with a paper towel. Nope. Just smeared it more. So, I tried a wet paper towel. Nope. At this point, I’m looking very much like Joker. It requires actual makeup remover to get off. And I basically had to take off all my makeup because it just runs from your lips when you try to get it off. It was a nightmare. But it looked really dark and vivid until, you know, I had to use my mouth and sent it smearing everywhere.

title: Good Deodorant
text: I have tried a great many natural deodorants. I really like this one. It works similar to Kiss My Face spray deodorant. It works well. The smell is like sweet rose. It does take a minute or so to dry once you spray it on. I have had no issues with it getting onto clothing or building up in my shirts. If you’re not careful, you will inhale it. That is less than pleasant. But it smells nice. It works well. It is really good natural deodorant. I’ll likely be buying more.

title: Nice Topper
text: This ended up being more of a lip topper. The color in the tube is very vivid, but on the lips, it is very sheer. The blue color is fun, but honestly makes me look like I need my inhaler. It is a sheer blue with purple shift. It is a little patchy on its own. It is not very layer able because it is already a pretty thick gloss formula. I love the wand. It is wide and flat with an angled tip, so it is easy to apply in one sweep and the use the tip to clean up the edges. It feels a little plumping once it is on the lips. Not super plumping, but that slight plumping feel. It tastes a little sweet. It doesn't smell sweet, though. It smells a little chemically- not overpoweringly so, but it is definitely there. The tube looks really pretty. It also sits nicely on its own and doesn't roll when you put it on its side. Overall, as a lip topper, it is nice. Perhaps not my color, but it is very mermaid-like, so it seems great for summer. On its own, it looks a bit like you are either freezing or not getting enough oxygen. It isn't apparent on its own that it is a lip color. It shifts pink lip color to the more purple plummy side. If you really want it to pop, layer over blue or purple.

title: Work Well
text: I was not a fan of this eye makeup remover. It was just too much for my usual eye looks. Yes, it got the eye makeup off, but so do my makeup remover wipes. And they don’t make my eyes sting like this does. But then, I was trying out some waterproof eyeliner and mascara and my makeup wipes were not getting it off. This stuff took it off easily. My eyes still burned from it. I have sensitive eyes. It doesn’t burn like alcohol, but almost like when you get sweat in your eyes. My toddler, bless his heart, decided to cover his face in Sharpie. This stuff took it right off. So, it does work. It is a little much for my daily use, and honestly just not needed. But for waterproof eye makeup and toddler antics, it works really well.

title: Just Okay
text:
I am super picky when it comes to concealer. My main issue with my under eyes is puffiness. As a mom of seven, I just want to look like I get more sleep than I actually get. My skin is also pretty fair. I tend to have combination skin. This isn’t the worst concealer, butnit also isn’t the best.
I’ll start with what I like. I like the thickness of the product. It feels like a thick moisturizer. It goes on easily. It blends in easily with a beauty blender. It is medium coverage. It is buildable to a degree, but doesn’t even get to super coverage.
I am not thrilled with the range of colors. 4 colors is very sparse. I’m wearing medium, but probably should have gone with light or fair. The medium is very yellow undertone and I am pretty pink undertoned. It does blend out to a workable level, so it isn’t as bad as having foundation in a slightly off color. But with only 4 shades, that just isn’t going to be perfect for everyone.
I also found that it creased under my eyes. Even when I set it immediately, it creased. Even with baking. It creased. It did absolutely nothing for my under eye puffiness, despite the bottle saying it would help. The creasing isn’t as bad as other concealers I have tried, but it does crease on me pretty immediately. It isn’t dry looking or cracked looking. It looks pretty matte without being super dry. Just creased in my under eye.
It has a bit of a smell. It is like a sunscreen type smell. It isn’t bad, it is just very noticeable.
For the price, it is just okay. It doesn’t work well for puffiness, which is my main eye issue. It doesn’t have a great color range. It creases a little on my eyes. It does blend well.

title: Excellent Highlighter
text: I love highlighter. I'm a little addicted. It is just like sprinkles or something. I really like this one. I'd say it is more of a pink frost than a true rose gold. It is on the light side, like a champagne color with a pink tint. I'd name the color rosé. But they didn't ask me. With the stick you get quite a bit of product. It isn't thick or oily. It is a very thin feeling product once it is on your skin. I even tried it out as an eyeshadow to see if it would bother me and it worked really well. It does have a certain amount of shimmer. It is iridescent for the most part, but does have a shimmer aspect. Not glittery, just shimmery. It shines on the silver side, rather than the gold side. It was just the right amount of highlight in my opinion. I wasn't able to really layer it much. I tried it both over powder and without any powder makeup. It works both ways. Blends in well over powder without messing up the stuff underneath. I think this is going to be a must have for my summer makeup!

title: They Are Fine
text: These are fine. I don’t think they work for acne any better than other acne pads like this. The smell is really strong. I don’t think these are really very effective for preventing acne, though. They seem to clean well. They leave your skin very dry. I think as part of your skin care routine, they help. But this alone isn’t enough.

title: Comfortable Eye Cream
text: This is pretty good eye cream. It doesn’t have a scent at all. It really moisturizes the eye area. It is comfortable to wear. It doesn’t make the eyelids feel heavy. Makeup layers over it well. Really,  my only complaint is that it does exactly nothing in terms of depuffing the undereye. But if that isn’t a problem you have, this may just be the eye cream for you.

title: Itchy
text: This shampoo is pretty good. Cedarwood is known for making your hair grow, so it makes complete sense for them to use it in this product. It smells good and does thicken the hair a bit, especially with regular use. Really my only complaint about this shampoo is that is makes the scalp itchy. I don’t know if it just lacks some needed moisture or if it is too stripping. Maybe it needs some tea tree or something calming in it. Used with a calming conditioner or leave in treatment and it is workable. But I likely won’t be buying again because of the itchy scalp issues.

title: Awful
text:
This mascara was just awful for me. Honestly, I have nothing positive to say about it and the tube will be going into the trash. It isn’t even worth keeping around.
I’m glad they packaged it the way they did because you see the brush is blue, then you put it in the mascara and, of course, it comes out completely black. This is a good thing because without this color change, I would have been entirely sure I had no product on my brush. This mascara is so thin. It doesn’t plump lashes at all. Don’t know where they got that claim. My lashes looked like I’d used that clear mascara you used as a preteen. Even when you layer it up, you won’t get much. More like lash gel to hold the curl you put in your lashes.
In terms of wear, this stuff flakes like crazy. I had fallout issues every day. (I wore this mascara daily for a week to get a feel for how it would wear multiple days in a row.) I had mascara flakes getting into my eyes and falling onto my cheeks.
The mascara did nothing it said it would. It didn’t even perform basic mascara functions well. It is also pretty difficult to remove for a product that won’t stay put and show up. You’d think the getting it off portion would be simple, but no. You’ll definitely have to break out the eye makeup remover because the makeup remover wipe won’t be enough.

title: Not For Me
text:
I’m not super comfortable with sunless tanners. I’m very, very pale so it isn’t really something I usually even bother with. However after my positive experience with the Coola self tanning mist, I thought I would give the face tanner a try. I first tried it mixed with my moisturizers as recommended on the package. It didn’t really do anything, even when I tried it for a few days in a row. So, I ventured out and tried it all on its own. The first time, I used my moisturizer first and then put the tanner on top. The results were minimal if you could really tell. Since the formula feels like a serum, I decided to try it under my moisturizer. I washed and exfoliated my face and then applied this to a completely clean, dry face. I waited for it to completely dry down before applying my moisturizer. That definitely did something! My skin was several shades darker. However, the tan, while not orange, just didn’t look completely natural on me. Perhaps it is just my complexion is so pale with pink undertones and this seemed to tan with zero pink undertones. It just looked fake. Even my husband commented on my obviously fake tan. It isn’t orange, but it just doesn’t look natural on me. I’m just going to go back to fully embracing the pale life.
The serum was comfortable. It didn’t feel heavy. It didn’t clog my pores or anything. It isn’t moisturizing at all, so you’ll still need your moisturizer. I didn’t think it made my skin look or feel younger. If anything, I looked older just because of the coloring. It isn’t bad, it just isn’t really for me.

title: Bean Colored Lips
text: This lip color is not completely transfer proof. The color is nice. Lips don’t look too dry. Formula and applicator feel a lot like a drugstore matte liquid lip line. The Adzuki color is the exact color of adzuki beans. A brick read with brown and a tiny bit toward the purple side, but not too much. Like a browned out blue red instead of an orange red. Very flattering. Very dark on my super pale skin tone. Feels a little on the tacky side as it dries. Doesn’t fully dry down, which makes it not super dry for a matte lip color. The doe foot applicator is long and flat. Easy to use to get a nice line around the lips. I really like it.

title: Actually Works
text: I am super pale, but sunless tanner terrifies me. I just have visions of streaky mess that would be super obvious on my very, very pale skin tone. The mist on this is perfect. Very light. Covers really well. You do need to exfoliate before because it will settle in dry areas. It has a really odd smell. It smells like a tanning bed. Like slightly toasty skin with a slight tropical smell. I noticed it a lot. (And my first job was a tanning bed, so it took me way back.) But other people around me claim they couldn't smell it at all. It doesn't look dark at first. It darkens over time. And it darkens very slightly. After the first application, you could see a very faint difference. I decided to seeing it would be buildable and applied it daily for three days. That was a little much for me, taking my "tan" to a much darker level than it really should be this time a year. Also, as I was building it, the more I noticed darker patches in drier areas. It lasts a good 4 days before it starts gently fading. I had no streaking. No splotchiness. I think a single application every 4-5 days is probably my sweet spot for this. I am no longer terrified of self tanner!

title: Light Floral Scent
text: I really love this scent. It is floral, but fresh and not oppressive. It smells light and happy. It is a “young” floral scent, not an old woman type of floral scent. I like floral scents, but typically hate honeysuckle and gardenia scents. This is neither of those, so I am happy with it.

title: Good Unscented Body Wash
text: Why am I concerned with my skin's pH? The bottle makes it clear this is good for my pH, but I don't know why I would care. This body wash lathers up really well. Sometimes unscented products fail in that area. Suds for days with this body wash. It feels good on the skin and you feel clean, but not stripped clean. It has no real scent. Truly unscented body wash. Safe for the face, but I prefer to use something else on my face.

title: Terrible
text: These are really terrible. There is no smell at all. They are wrapped in aluminum foil and then wrapped in plastic. They are beasts to get into. They are small bath bombs. But they really do nothing in terms of softening you skin or anything. None of them have a distinct smell. It really feels better to just put plain Epsom salt in the water. Very disappointing product.

title: Not Good
text: I’m not a makeup brush snob, but these fall well below my expectations. The bristles aren’t terrible. They are very soft. They don’t apply makeup very densely at all. The metal holding the bristles is the part I find really problematic. When you wash your brushes, water pools in them. They are also easily bendable. They don’t hold the bristles firmly enough. Really, I haven’t found these useful in makeup application at all. I find them okay for brushing away excess powder or brushing away eyeshadow when I have fall out. There are better cheap brushes out there.

title: Doesn’t Work Well ForMe
text:
I’m not really liking this hair dryer. I really wanted to like it, but there are just several issues I’m having with it. I’ll start with the few things it has going for it.
- It has a really long cord.
- It blows air really forcefully. The power on this thing is no joke. It is really powerful.
Now all the things that annoy me or just don’t work for me.
- Why is there no standardization with blow dryers? None of my other nozzles and things fit on this blow dryer. So, what it came with, in terms of tips, is what I have to use.
- The diffuser is terrible. I have curly hair and wear my hair curly about 80% of the time. This diffuser is one of the worst I have ever used. It is completely flat, so none of the diffuser spike things get between your hair. It just doesn’t actually diffuse the air well since you can’t get the diffuser spikes between your hair to diffuse.
- The narrow nozzle (or whatever you call a blow dryer attachment) tangles my hair like crazy. The power and the super thin nozzle isn’t a good mix for really long hair. I am imagining that one is for shorter hair. But I have to grab both and compare every single time to make sure I’m not grabbing the tangle nozzle.
- The heat is completely inconsistent. While it blows really hard, I can’t manage to get the heat to stay consistent. At times, it is super hot, like hair smoking hot. But then, on the same settings, it can feel completely cold.
- The buttons are horribly placed. They are on the side where if you are right handed, drying your own hair, you’ll hit them constantly on accident.
- The box says there are 14 settings. I have wracked my brain for how they did that math. There are two power settings: high and low. There are three temp setting: low, medium, high. And then there is a cool shot setting, and a “T” setting, that I still cant figure out how it changes anything. I think it is turbo, but it doesn’t change things much.
Overall, it just doesn’t do much for me. If I wore my hair straight more of the time, I would like it more.

title: Basic
text: So, I read “smooth” and I think “straight”. Like tamed, smoothed down hair. That is not what I got. The bottles are a little weird. They look like some kind of lab beaker. The pumps work well. They are taller and thicker at the bottom than other shampoo bottles that hold the same amount. They look like they’ll have a lot more product than they do. But they are a pretty standard size higher end shampoo size. They smell good. Kind of a citrus scent with a little floral hint. Very clean smelling. However, they work just okay. I didn’t really notice my hair any smoother. They made my hair impossible to straighten. (I have curly hair but regularly straighten it. I wear it curly about half the time.) Like, it would not go straight. I was confused. Because to me “smoothing” shampoos mean they will smooth my hair so it’ll lay flat. I wasn’t thinking “de-frizz”. Either way, it didn’t de-frizz it any more than a standard shampoo would. So, I feel like they made claims and then didn’t deliver. If I was just expecting some basic shampoo and conditioner, I’d be okay with these. Though the making my hair unstraightable is a bit of a puzzler. So, they are okay, decent products. But they don’t deliver on what they say they’ll do. They are just basic products. I have better products for smoothing than these.

title: Not A Fan
text: I love skin care. I love face masks. I do not love these. Each container contains a lot of product. If you use all the product on your face, you’ll have a huge mess. You’ll have face mask in your hair, all over your pillow, on your sheets. I’m a side sleeper, so this just got everywhere. It isn’t nice. It kinds of rolls up like dried rubber cement through the night, so you wake up with little rolls and balls of rubber cement stuck to everything. The worst was getting in out of my hair. I gave up after pulling it out strand by strand and just rewashed my hair. It didn’t really make much of a difference in my skin. Definitely not enough to be worth the giant hassle it is. It softens my skin, but not anymore than a standard night cream. Just not worth it, in my opinion. It just feels like really thick lotion that doesn’t properly soak in.

title: Not The Best
text: I go through quite a few makeup wipes, so I have tried many, many brands. I’m not the biggest fan of these. They work-ish. The actually cloth is really soft. Almost too soft. I like a slightly more substantial and less puffy cottony wipe. My main issue is that these aren’t wet enough. They feel almost dry right out of the bag. That makes it really difficult to remove all your makeup with a single wipe. Sure, you won’t be getting cleanser in your eyes- but you may need two or three wipes depending on how much makeup you have to remove. The super soft texture isn’t the best for removing matte lipstick. But it is okay for removing eye makeup, though it takes quite a bit of wiping to get it all off with the fairly dry wipe. I won’t be buying these, but they are good enough that I finished the pack and didn’t throw it straight in the bin.

title: Hard Pass
text: I really do not like this lip gloss. The color is nothing like the picture. In the picture, it looks fuschia. In person, it is a faded mulberry with copper glitter. On the lips, it is just clear, slightly mulberry tinted with some random glitter flecks. It looks fine. Nothing special. It feels and smells like lip glosses I owned twenty years ago. It has that waxy makeup smell. It tingles on the lips. Not a mint tingle, but a thick old lip gloss tingle, like maybe I’m allergic to this tingle. It is really goopy and sticky. The kind your hair gets stuck in and it drives you crazy. When you pull the flattened doe Foot applicator out of the tube, product flies everywhere. It isn’t long lasting at all. I usually like Rimmel products, but this one is a miss. It is like they found a case of old gloss and repackaged it.

title: Excellent Hands
text: This hand balm doesn’t really have a scent. It isn’t exactly unscented, but smells like plain lubriderm lotion. It is super soothing on the skin. It isn’t oily or greasy. Hands just feel really soft after applying. It dries down almost instantly, but provides a really deep moisture to the skin. This has quickly replaced our old favorite hand cream.

title: It Works
text:
I’m going to be talking about my feet. But, I assume you were expecting that, since you’re reading the reviews for a foot product. I’m a southern woman. That means I am barefoot 90% of the time. My toenails usually look cute, but the bottom of my feet are often dirty and feel like sandpaper, thanks to the variety of indoor and outdoor textures I walk across on a daily basis. So, there are a variety of fixes I wh e tried for my sandpaper feet. The best is a pedicure called “baby sole” at a local nail place. It costs about 3x as much as a regular pedicure. Do I really have to do that every 6 weeks to maintain soft feet? Next, I tried a fancy peel off mask for my feet. You know the ones. Creepy pictures of super peeling feet. Between my toes peeled, y’all. But the sandpaper feet, no better. Old school pumice stones just do not work.
So, I try this Remington Callus Remover. I’m not expecting great results. My boys, however, were thrilled with a new foot product. (They love following behind me and trying all my strange foot rocks and graters and files. Weird kids, I know.) I was pretty sure it would be too rough for their little baby southern feet that have only been walking on rocks for a decade or less. However, this was gentle enough for their little feet. Probably isn’t recommended, but they gave themselves pedicures. After this, I was sure this would do nothing on my feet. It actually made my feet really soft. Not super fancy pedicure soft, but good enough for daily feet soft. I don’t feel like it really made my feet less thick, if that makes sense, it it smoothed he thick, rough skin down. So now my feet are still southern girl tough, but they are smooth and don’t scratch the sheets at night.
I saw zero difference in the coarse and super coarse heads. You cannot press hard or you will stop the machine. It does require two AA batteries that come with it.
My only complaint is that I cannot tell which way I am supposed to hold it. Do I hold it so it rolls toward me or away from me? Still havent figured it out. I wish the instructions would tell me which side was “up”.

title: Dry Hair and Skin
text:
The positive first, I’m guessing this is hypoallergenic. We have sensitive skin and have had no skin issues from the product. It also has no smell. Well, as close to no smell as soap can get. This is the most unscented shampoo/soap I have ever used.
This isn’t a clean, natural product. The packaging led me to believe that, but the second ingredient is SLS. So, if you’re avoiding that, you should know this isn’t for you.
My main issue is in performance. It makes hair unbelievably dry. Brittle and awful feeling. It also is very drying on the skin. I know this is a dry time of year, but this has been the driest shampoo and soap that has touched me in a long time. I just cannot get over how drying it is. It was even drying on the toddler’s hair! I had to do a hair mask after a couple days of using it because my hair felt like straw. I just absolutely cannot stand it. It foams up really nicely. You get a nice bubbly, sudsy lather with very little product. But it makes my skin and hair so dry. So, this is hard pass from me.

title: Love This!
text: I was skeptical of this spray. It surprised me in the best way! This spray makes my face feel fresh and refreshed. Perfect for post working out, or just when you’re needing a fresh pick me up. You can spray it on top of your makeup. It doesn’t have a super fine mist, so I pat it into the skin a bit when I spray it on my makeup. Great for travel. Great for the gym. Great for soothing skin after a harsher mask. I love this spray.

title: Excellent Mask
text: This mask tightens and freshens skin. It is so nice. It can be on the drying side during the winter, so maybe skip it if you have dry skin. It smells nice. I apply with a mask brush, which helps me get a perfect layer. Sometimes, when I’m feeling dry, I’ll apply only also no the t-zone. This makes my skin look and feel amazing.

title: Pretty, But More Intense Than I Expected
text:
I don’t know how anyone else is keeping these things in their hair without clips. I needed clips. They slide all around in my hair. First, I can’t use these from wet to dry hair. My hair just will not ever dry that way. Tried it. I took them out after 8 hours in and my hair was still wet. Second, there aren’t enough rollers for all my hair. You can’t put a ton of hair on these. There are only enough rollers to do the top of my hair. From the top of my ears up. I’d need at least two full sets for my whole head. Third, these mainly just boost volume. Very little curl happening. Fourth, if your hair is longer than shoulder length, it can be difficult to pull your hair straight up and get these on it. Grab a section of your hair. Pull it all the way out away from your head. Can you touch the end? I had some trouble reaching the ends of my hair on the top of my head. (And my hair is just barely past my shoulders.)
So, the proper way to use these, I had found, is to dry your hair. Yep. Dry it. Put the rollers into your dry hair and secure with a long alligator sectioning clip. Spray hair with flexible hold spray OR work a little volume pumping product in before putting the rollers in. Blow dry the dry hair on the rollers for about five minutes. Let them cool for 15 minutes. Remove them. Have big hair.
The secondary, less optimal, but works when I don’t feel like drying my hair all the way. Dry hair most of the way. Put rollers into slightly damp hair, securing with alligator clips. Dry the bottom half of hair with a round brush, since it won’t fit in the rollers. Blow dry the rollers for about 5 minutes. Leave them in for an hour or so. Then remove them and have big hair. The downside to this option is that your hair won’t look as smooth and might still be damp when you remove the rollers.
I’m pretty much thinking my hair is too thick for these bad boys. Or maybe I’m just not dedicated enough to my hair. I don’t know. My hair looks pretty awesome when I use them, but they don’t save me time. They don’t help me to not use the blow dryer, which was what I was hoping for. I was hoping to roll my hair up like a granny and then two hours later have dry hair. Doesn’t work like that.

title: Wonderful Baby Soap
text: I absolutely love this baby soap. It smells SO good. I had this soap year ago in bar form, and when I couldn’t find it in bar form again, I decided to try the liquid version. The pump makes the bottle easy to use one handed while bathing the baby. It is gentle on her skin. I think I still preferred the bar soap version, but this version is nice. Smells great. Cleans well.

title: Not Natural, But Makes Hair Grow
text:
I really wasn’t sure how many stars to give this. When I first got this, I wasn’t entirely sure how to use it and I was honestly a little scared to use it. The first ingredient is ammonia. I’ve got black hair. Ammonia isn’t something I ever think about putting on my hair. I finally got up the nerve to use it.
To use, you use it like shampoo, but you wait to rinse it out. That did take a little getting used to, since I don’t typically just hang out in the shower with shampoo on my head. It lathers up like shampoo and everything.
The smell is okay. It smells like the apple shampoo my grandmother’s hairdresser used in the 80’s. When drying my hair, it does smell a faint bit like a perm. Once dry it just smells like generic shampoo. But while drying, you get a whiff of perm smell.
As for actual results. I’m finally to the bottom of the bottle. (6 weeks. Using the product every 2-3 days as recomended.) I can say my hair did seem to grow. I’m not sure about thicken. It doesn’t feel thicker. It is a little more coarse in texture, but I didn’t notice a big volume bump. I have noticed a few baby hairs growing around my hairline, so maybe it is thickening a little. I don’t really know. But it seems to have made my hair grow, so I would say that it works.
I likely won’t continue to use it, just because of the ingredients. They are far from natural and make me a little nervous over long term use. If I were rating based on ingredients, I’d give this 3 stars. Based on hair growth, I’d give it 5 stars.

title: Small Essie Polish
text: I like the actual polish. I mean, it is Essie, you can't really go wrong. My only issue is the color choices and names. The choices aren't very festive to me. You have a dark purple with a green shift polish. Then the mint is actually more of a robin's egg blue. You then have classic red, which is very holiday classic. The dark red isn't very red- it is more of a brown/maroon color. These are small bottles, not full size bottles- which I really like for seasonal colors. So, the polish itself is great. I just don't like the color collection.

title: Dislike
text: This brow pencil was a great color for me. The deep brown is very dark. However, I hate the shape of the actual pencil. It is a weird diamond shape that is way too wide on one side. If you try to just use the tip of the corner, you wear it down. It is just far too chunky for eyebrows. The spoolie on the opposite end if far too small. It doesn't do anything at all. So, even if you happen to like the weird chunky shape of the pencil, you'll have to grab a different spoolie to get your brows tamed properly. I had high hopes, but this just isn't what it should be.

title: Nice Beard
text: This is really nice beard oil. It smells nice. It feels nice. I have no complaints about this product at all. It has a dropper top, making it really easy to use.

title: Must have
text: I love rosebud Salve, so when I saw the strawberry, I had to try it. The strawberry scent is really strong, but not overly artificial. It is a pure strawberry scent. The formula is great. Very hydrating. You can also use this as a hand Salve. I even rub this on the kid’s scrapes when we are out and about (like at the playground) and it works really well. I always have either this or the rosebud Salve in my Bag.

title: Amazing Soap
text: This soap is great. It foams up and is so nice and milky feeling on the skin. It smells really good, but you definitely have to like the scent of Sandalwood to enjoy it.

title: Nice and Soft
text: This face lotion is really nice. It is on the thin/watery side. It isn't a thick cream like women' face lotions. It is kind of clear, milky looking. But it isn't thick or greasy. It just makes the skin feel really soft and gets rid of dryness. The smell is kind of a diluted cologne smell. Not overpowering, but definitely there.

title: Beautiful Soap
text: These are cute little guest soaps and they come in an adorable, giftable box. Both soaps have a very floral smell. They each have a little bird engraved on the soap. The soap itself lathers up really well and is very creamy. These are the kind of soaps some people leave sitting in the box forever because they are pretty. But do yourself a favor and actually use them because they are really lovely feeling on your hands. The hearts are a perfect palm size for hand washing.

title: Fun Set
text: This is a really fun set. It comes with everything you need to make the bath bombs, but you can also reuse the molds for trying out other bath bomb recipes. This is a great set for a tween or young teen to do alone. If the kid is under 9, they may need more adult help. My 11 year old could follow the directions and make these on her own. She has been wanting to make bath bombs for a while, because she loves them. So this set was a great place to start.

title: Yummy Lotion
text: This is really rich and creamy body lotion. It is very whipped. It smells like almonds. The lotion is really thick and moisturizing, but not greasy. And the moisture lasts a pretty long time. It can be used on hands or body. I wouldn't use it on my face because it is a little thick and heavy for that. Perfect for the winter.

title: Smells Nice
text: This is a really nice gift set. It smells great. Not overpowering. The soap is a regular sized soap. The hand cream is on the small side, but really thick and creamy. It comes in a little gift bag with a satin bow. Cute set. Ready for gifting.

title: Milky
text: This is wonderful soap. It is so creamy and milky and wonderful. It does have a scent, but in the way plain goat milk soap has a scent. It smells soft and creamy. Not like vanilla. More fresh. It lathers well and leaves skin feeling soft and clean. It almost smells like baby soap, not a baby powder scent, but like high end baby soap. I really like it. The bar is nicely engraved and pretty, as well.

title: Nice Soap
text: These guest bar soaps are really nice. They fit in the palm of your hand, but are still a pretty good size. They are in a box. Each soap is engraved, but they are not individually packaged. The sage scent is very subtle and not very strong. I think it is a good "anybody" soap. The soap lathers nicely and feels very soft and milky on your skin. These are very nice, well made soaps.

title: Nice Set
text: This is a nice little gift set. The bar of soap is really quite large to be "gift" sized. It is about the size of a regular bar of soap. The scent is strong, not very subtle.The lotion is on the small size. The metal tube comes sealed. Th entire thing comes in a little bag with a ribbon. The soap is soft and milky. The verbena scent is good for anyone. Not feminine, not masculine, just clean. The hand cream is really soft and not greasy at all. Great for dry skin.

title: Very Lavendar
text: This is luxurious soap. It is a very large bar, twice as big as a standard bar of soap. The scent is VERY strong lavender. There is nothing subtle about the scent. The soap itself is soft and milky feeling. Really nice.

title: Fun Activity, But Then What
text: My daughter would give this 4 stars, I would give it 2, so we average out to 3. She is 11, so this is a little young for her. I mean, ability wise, she is probably right at the target age to be able to do this without excessive supervision. However, she is old enough to know good polish from not good polish. And so, while it made for a fun activity, once the activity part is over, that's it. The polish is Kid polish. We aren't sitting around oohing and ahhing over her majestic polish creations. So the fun for this is just very short lived and then it is over and the thing just takes up space. I feel like the set itself appeals to much younger girls (6 or 7 year olds) but they can't really do this activity. They can "help" and "watch" but they can't do it themselves. So, it seems a bit disjointed between the appeal and the ability to actually do it.

title: Love
text: This cleanser is awesome. I was really concerned that it would be too chemical smelling. It isn't. It smells clean without being that overly strong fake clean smell most face cleansers have. This one is really gentle and pleasant. It also leaves your skin feeling amazing. It feels clean, but not overly dry. Just a nice, gentle cleanse. It doesn't have that burn or tight feeling. I also LOVE that the bottle is a pump bottle. It pumps out a very small amount, which means you don't waste product. But it is so convenient to use. I wasn't expecting to love this face wash as much as I do.

title: As If!
text: This color is much darker on than it looks in the bottle, which is a good thing, since I already have a lighter periwinkle color. You need 2 coats for decent coverage. I don't like how the finish wears. It goes from nice and glossy to a little foggy looking. A top coat, which I usually use anyway, solves that issue. A nice color that could go with any season.

title: Smells Like Expired Lipstick
text: I think the deodorant works pretty well. It isn't baking soda based, so it is gentle on the skin. I still sweat, since it isn't antiperspirant, which is fine. I really just dislike the scent. I love, love, love patchouli and this is NOT patchouli. It smells like you grandmother's expired lipsticks that she has had since the 40's and refused to throw away. Like old dirt, but like, expired dirt. It really does not smell at all like patchouli. I'm pretty disappointed in the scent.

title: Nice Moisturizer
text: This moisturizer smells so nice. It seriously smells like Fruity Pebbles. It feels really nice on your skin. Good coverage. Not super thick. Not greasy. Just a nice moisturizer. It doesn't clog my pores. I can begin putting on my makeup right after applying. It soaks in quickly and doesn't leave a sticky residue.

title: Smells Nice
text:
I have mixed feelings on the moisturizer. On the one hand, it smells very nice. It has that traditional cherry almond Jergens scent. And my legs were so smooth and moisturizer without it being greasy or sticky or weird once it dried. Those parts, I like. Now, if only I can get over the actual feeling of drying off with this on.
So, you shower. You turn off the water. You apply this moisturizer, that is pretty much just the consistency of lotion, and then you towel dry off. The problems are that you really can't use it on your upper body if you have long hair. Unless you put your hair up in a towel, but don't dry your body at all. Either way, it is going to require an alteration in your routine, which I am admittedly bad at.
Now, you have the actual experience of drying off with this stuff on you. It reminds me of the awful water we had in Mississippi, where you would rinse and rinse and never feel like you were rinsed off. And then drying takes twice the time because you just cannot get dry. Like putting too much fabric softener in your towels. It took so long to actually get dry. And then, I had to alter my wash routine for my towels to make sure the lotion washes out completely. I felt like they needed to be stripped or washed in Dawn to get them to be nice and absorbant again. So, those are two issues I've really had to work through to be able to enjoy the actual product. And those things keep me from using it daily.
So, it works really nicely, but has some obvious drawbacks.

title: Dark and Pretty
text: On my computer screen, this color looks like a rich maroon or mahogany. In person, however, the color is more of a brown than a red. It is a reddish brown, but definitely not maroon. More like a dark chocolate with a little chili powder. It is very rich color, however, it is a little patchy, especially if you aren't layering it to make it super dark. It does layer nicely. But if you're wanting it the lightest it can be, you'll want to brush a nice neutral color onto your lid first (a light tan or ivory, whatever your blending color happens to be) so when you brush on this color you can really blend it well without it looking patchy. Or use a good eye primer and pat it on with the brush instead of sweeping it on. (It'll look darker this way.) The color is matte and it doesn't really move much. It is a soft powder. The single color does not come with a wand or any way of applying it. So you'll need a makeup brush or some sort of tool for application. (I guess a finger would work.) There is zero shimmer in this brown. It is a pretty color. It would also make a great powder to use on the lash line for a smokey eyeliner type effect.

title: Really Good!
text: I always have a really hard time finding a natural deodorant that works and that doesn't make my skin peel. It is always tricky to find something with just the right balance. This deodorant has no aluminum, but also no baking soda. (The baking soda based deodorants make my skin peel.) This is alcohol based with essential oils, which I find to be the combination that works best.
