Unlike other alcohol based deodorants I have tried, this one sprays really evenly and without the pump action that so often gets clogged when essential oils are involved. It smells like lemongrass, mostly. It also doing sting like other alcohol based deodorants. I really like this and will definitely be buying more.

title: Not Kiss-Proof
text: So this is really dark pigmented color. I'd consider it liquid lipstick, not lip paint. The color goes on really dark without a lot of layering. The shine is really bright and metallic. That is about all the good stuff I can say. It has zero staying power. It gets down in the creases of your lips and bleeds outside of your lip line. It transfers to anything that touches your lips. Straw. Cup. Definitely NOT kiss-proof. The color only stayed on my lips for about 2 hours. And as it wore off, because of the color, it looked like my lips were randomly bruised in places. Not a cute look at all. There is no way I'm wearing this anywhere at all because I'd be having to reapply constantly and you have to be very careful about application because of the color. It looks cool, but just isn't very practical. I'll stick to my mattes.

title: Eyebrows On Point
text: I have been looking for a set like this! It comes with a flip cover case with 4 pockets and 2 elastic loops to hold the tools. You get a blunt end set of scissors, a set of tweezers, a small angled brush, a fluffier highlighting brush, and a spoolie for taming crazy eyebrows. Your eyebrows will thank you.

title: Good Set
text: I am a big fan of Real Techniques Brushes. They are good quality brushes at an affordable price. I feel no need to be precious with them. They hold up to washing and frequent use without any issues. This set comes with a rectangular cup to hold the brushes on your counter. This set has a square foundation brush, a contour brush, a detailing brush, and a fluffy buffing brush. The brushes are soft. The detail brush is tightly packed, so it is pretty firm. So is the foundation brush. This is a really good set.

title: Lovely Face
text: I really like Real Techniques brushes. They are good quality and affordable makeup brushes. This set comes with a contour brush, fan brush, and then a fat angled brush, which I really like for applying highlighter. The brushes come with a rectangular plastic cup to hold the brushes. This is a good set. Brushes are soft, but firm- if that makes sense. I had no problem with shedding hairs when I washed them. Good brushes.

title: Beautiful Eyes
text: I like Real Techniques brushes. I feel like they are good quality and reasonably priced. This set comes with a small cup to hold the tools. It has a tiny liner brush, a crease brush, two shading/blending brushes of different sizes, and a metal eyelash separator. It is a good set. The brushes are soft, but not too soft. Great set for eyes.

title: Love It
text: I have a hard time with nudes. I'm very pale. Most of them just look weird on me. This one looks great. It is a slightly lilac grey, which I think is nice. If you're looking for a matching lippie, this color is very close to ColourPop's marshmallow lip color. Two coats and it is great. I'm a big Essie fan and this was another win for them.

title: Good Primer
text: I'm always on the loo out for a good primer. I'm pretty picky. I tend not to like the colored ones, because they look like my face is dirty since I have very pale skin. But sometimes the white versions just don't do enough. It is always a balance. This primer is very lightly colored. Not enough that it made me look dirty. It evenly covers and is super smooth when applying. It sets in pretty fast, layering other products immediately was no problem. It decreased the shine on my face. It kind of minimized pores, but I wouldn't call it pore minimizing. It looks matte, but not chalky. It is a really good primer.

title: Eh. Not Really Noticeable
text: I was really excited to try this product. As a brunette, fun colors without bleaching just don't happen. So, I thought this was somehow going to change that. Nope. First, I feel like this is a little deceiving. It says for brunettes. On the back of the box, it then says it is for light to dark brown hair, but not darkest brown. Really? The box color example for darkest looked like the model's hair. The box said it isn't recommended for "darkest brown or darker" because it won't do anything. So, a color for brunettes, but only brunettes with light hair, not dark hair. So... brunettes who are closer to blondes. Right. But, since the bottle was already in my hand, I figured, what the heck, let's see what happens. My hair has been easily dyed red straight out of a box before, maybe it would actually work. Eh. Not so much. There is zero mixing, which is nice. It comes with a brush applicator if you're doing something you need more control over. It also has several pairs of gloves included. Not good gloves. Super cheap. But they do provide more than the one super cheap pair. So, that is something. It was easy to apply. I did end up getting it on my scalp and neck. It was easy to remove from my skin, but not my scalp or nails. Not as bad as permanent dye. It did very little to my actual hair color. A few people were able to notice it in the sun or bright stage lights. But not really super noticeable. I think the box model's hair had to have had lighter tips for there to be any contrast. I'd be kind of interested to try the other colors and see if they did anything at all. But really, if you want fun color, you're going to have to bleach if you've got "darkest brown or darker" hair. Bummer. But can't change nature, I guess. Added before and after photos so you could see the shade of brown my hair was before the dye hit it. My grey hairs certainly picked up the color. The rest of it, just looks like my aura is reddish.

title: Good, But Not Fabulous
text: The packaging looks beautiful. It is a clear plastic bottle with a gold lid. No childproof cap, just a slight twist and the top is off. The actual capsules are beautiful. Several of mine were broken in the bottle, so there was some oil floating around in my bottle, as well. The capsule isn't very user friendly. I feel like it just produces a lot of waste. Yes, it helps you know exactly how much serum to use, but a simple pump would be the same. The capsules aren't very difficult to open, but would be if you had limited mobility in your hands. The serum itself does not smell at all. For some reason, I expected a floral or perfume smell, but there is zero smell. Completely unscented. Honestly, I think I get the same results with plain almond oil, so I can't say I really recommend this product. It does leave my skin very soft and no clogged pores. It soaks in nicely and fairly quickly. Makeup applies over it without any troubles at all. It isn't bad at all, I just would expect much, much more at this price point.

title: Love It
text: I love the Real Techniques Beauty Blender and Brushes, so I was happy to give this set a try. It comes with 5 pieces. You get a plastic spatula for getting creams and such out of the jar so they don't get contaminated by your fingers, an under eye reviver which is a metal ball on a stick that seems ridiculous but feels oh so nice and works to depuff the under eye area, a primer brush to apply creams and masks, a beauty blender, and a stand for your beauty blender which is really handy after you wash it. The primer brush is super soft, but the bristles are sturdier than a regular makeup brush, almost like super duper soft toothbrush bristles. I like the entire set much more than I anticipated.

title: Okay.
text: I'm just not all that impressed. The deep cleaning mask is like a thick cold cream. I've had better results from cheaper cold creams, honestly. It isn't bad. It is just mediocre in its deep cleansing. (And I have pretty normal skin.) The peel is better. It is really irritating if you get it anywhere near your eyes, so be careful. But it did make my skin look brighter and more youthful, like it took the dead, dull skin away and left bright summer skin, if that makes any sense. It smelled pleasant enough. I did have issues with the bottles arriving punctured. One punctured the other. But I think that was a shipping issue, not a product issue, so I'm not holding that against the product and think it was just a weird freak accident.

title: Nice
text: This eye cream is thick, but soaks in well. It is a little on the sticky side, so you do have to give it ample time to set before applying your makeup. It is really moisturizing.

title: Nice
text: Rosebud salve is a long time favorite of mine. This is slightly minty. It isn't pink on your lips. On the thin side. This says lips, but I use it like my rosebud salve, on hands, scrapes, chapped cheeks, even the occasional diaper rash. The mint is very minimal and not at all overwhelming.

title: Just Okay
text: This hair dryer just does not meet my expectations. It works. It does a decent job. The compact feature doesn't make the hair dryer significantly smaller. It only has the quick dry nozzle. The size of the barrel is too wide for my other diffusers. I was excited about the three settings, but they are just cool, low, and high. The high is also not as hot as my Hot Tools hair dryer. It does have decent enough power. The cord is on the short side. All in all, it is just a mediocre hair dryer. Better than most of the lower end brands, but not as good as the bottom of the higher end brands.

title: Good
text: It smells really nice. It contains baking soda, which takes a little time for your skin to get used to. It can be very drying at first. The application method is not simple. I mean, it is simple, rub a little into your armpits. But unlike a deodorant stick, you have to touch the product. Good for a natural deodorant alternative. I think I prefer the alcohol spray type, but this is a good product.

title: Nice
text: I'm really impressed with this lip balm. It smells really nice. It is greatbfor conditioning your lips. It works like some of the pricey lip treatments I have used. The lid completely comes off. I like that it looks like its bigger cousin.

title: Love
text: This polish is great. Not super thick. Great full coverage from just one layer. Dried well.

title: Nice Set
text: This is a good razor and good shaving gel. This set would make a great gift for a tween beginning to shave. Really, the only thing I dislike is the hanging refill thing. Why would I want that? It just seems so bizarre. If I were to hang any part, it would be the actual razor. I also feel like the price is too high. Razors are really getting ridiculously expensive.

title: Love It
text: I use this in my foaming hand soap pumps. It works really well and the lather and smell are really nice. Just add about 2 tablespoons of the soap in the foam pump container, fill the rest of the way with water, shake, and soap! If you want to make it a little softer on your hands, add a teaspoon or two of almond oil.

title: Great Product
text: I am very fair and the porcelain color is perfect for me. It is super good coverage, but you can thin it down a little (with a wet beauty blender) to get a little more sheer coverage if needed. I find it lasts all day and doesn't crease on me. Isn't oily or powdery. I found the formula perfect. And I rarely find a perfect concealer. And I rarely find a concealer light enough. In fact, I usually use Ooh la la lift from Benefit instead of concealer because it is white and I don't have color matching issues. This concealer is also great for baking.

title: Tweens Love It
text: I am straight up not a fan of these. Most of the colors looked the same. It just looks like red, orange, or pink. First, the smell. Fruity hair spray. Second, the application. You better get it right because it will stain everything it touches. It paints on like school glue. It tastes terrible. Once dry, you peel it off your lips. Then your lips look like you are a red, orange, or pink popsicle. It was just a lot of gross work for little payoff. This is really just a novelty for fun kind of thing. As an adult, I would give it one star. But that brings me to my tween who would give it 5 stars. She thinks it is so much fun. To her, all this gross stuff is magic in the making. She wears it every day and carefully chooses the color. She loves showing her friends this weird lip stuff.

title: Smells Nice
text: I really like this treatment cream. It is very moisturizing. I like using it at night, as it feels a little heavy to wear under makeup. It also gets a little tacky as it dries. That fades, but it makes for a very long morning routine if you wait for it to set in before continuing with other products. It smells really nice. Kind of perfume and citrus. It does have a significant smell, if that bothers you.

title: Love This Perfume
text: I love this perfume! It is my current favorite. Very adult, yet still youthful. It isn't extremely overpowering. Just a nice scent if you lean in close. I love the rollerball applicator. It makes it easy to just get it where I want it and not have to shower in the scent. Just a little roller behind the ears and I am set. If I am feeling it more, I'll roll it on the wrists, as well. The scent is hard to describe. It is floral, but still bright and young. It doesn't smell like a funeral home or roses. More like a spring garden and sunshine. Man, I am bad at describing smells!

title: Super Soft
text: These brushes are so soft and fluffy! I am also very surprised and impressed by the case they come in. It can be a case, OR you can fold it back to make it a stand. Such a cute and thoughtful addition!

title: Great Brows
text: I liked this brow set. I usually don't like brow products, so that is really saying something. The pencil is twist up and is very fine. It looks much more natural. It is also a very dark brown, which worked much better for me, as I have brown/black hair. The brow mascara wand is a perfect shape. It has a little ball end. The tweezers are good quality. My only complaint is the packaging. It is huge and difficult to open. But the actual product is great.

title: Good Soap
text: I decided to give this soap a try since my [[ASIN:B003NZFMCK Chandrika Bath Soap Ayurvedic, 75g, 10 Pack]] keeps going out of stock on S&S. I really like this soap. It smells amazing, lathers really well, and leaves your skin feeling clean. It isn't overly drying. I really like it. Each soap is inside a plastic bag inside the box, so the soap does stay fresh. I think I still prefer the other, but this soap is a really good option, as well. I even use it to wash my face and my face has had no issues at all. I also use this soap on my kids and baby and it has been great for them, as well. (And my kids have sensitive skin.)

title: Floral with A Little Sweet
text: At first, I smelled this and thought, no way! It smells very old lady floral at first. But as it settled in, you can smell something sweet in it, which makes it more of a youthful smell. It ends up being a really nice fresh feminine scent. A little does go a long way, though. But definitely a nice fragrance.

title: Smells Yummy
text: This comes cutely packaged in a little brown box. The labels on the box are all stylized to match the product. It says it is made in the US. The bottle itself is a spray bottle. The perfume sprays pretty evenly and finely. The smell is a little more masculine, especially when first sprayed, but I could see a man or woman wearing it. The scent is sweet with the tobacco scent prominent. Not like a smoke scent, rather the scent of pip tobacco before you smoke it. It also has a frankincense smell to it. That makes it almost addictive to sniff. It settles in nicely and isn't too overpowering in any way. It isn't strongly musk or floral or anything like that. Maybe a little myrrh that I can pick up. Mainly just vanilla, tobacco, and frankincense scent.

title: Good Stuff
text: I think this hair stuff smells like honey, not tobacco. It is the consistency of honey. It gets a little slimy if your hair is wet. But the hold and shine are spot on. Not a crunchy hold like hair gel. Just a medium hold and high shine.

title: Good
text: It works really well alone or mixed with foundation or moisturizer. It isn't too shimmery. The 001 Latte color is a little dark for my skin. Since it is summer, I am able to make it work with good blending and a little highlighter. Come winter, it won't work for me at all.

title: Is That A Butterfly?
text:
The best bits first, since my overall impression is positive.
These are soft and work really well with toner or makeup remover. They are much thinner than I anticipated, but still thick enough to hold liquid and such. They work really well for a cold or warm wet compress. Their size and shape just work well for that sort of thing. I have also liked using them for first aide purposes. Squirt some peroxide on there to clean up a scrape. Works well.
They look a lot like a short, wide panty liner with no sticky backing. They just have a panty liner look and feel.
You still need cotton balls. There are just some things you do with a cotton ball that you can't do with these, like keeping oil in an ear. text:

It feels good on your skin. It is a little on the heavy side, but it does provide lasting moisture. It has not clogged my pores at all. It hasn't been any kind of magic potion, but it moisturizes well. It is also soothing on the skin after a bit too much sun.

title: Thick and Soothing
text: This lotion is on the thick side. It is great for really cracked or beat up skin. (Hands or feet.) It smells like lemon grass. Zero sensitive skin issues. Even put it on a new tattoo (accidentally) and had no irritation issues from it.

title: Good Mask
text: This mask is the color of terra cotta. It has a super fine grit feel to it, which feels amazing when you rub it in. It smells really nice. Floral and white tea, I would say. It feels good on the skin and exfoliates beautifully.

title: Good Stuff
text: I expected this to smell, well, terrible. Truffle oil isn't the best smell in the world. I mean, I am sure there is someone out there who loves the smell. Something for everyone, right? However, this skin serum smelled very sweet and milky. It only has a very slight truffle, earthy scent in there. Mostly just sweet and milky scent. It is very light. It doesn't feel heavy on your face. Really my only complaint is that it is more sticky when it sets. It isn't smooth and silky like I would expect. It is tacky and sticky feeling. That feeling eventually goes away, but I don't like products that set that way. It honestly just feels more like a thin moisturizer than anything. It hasn't clogged my pore or caused breakouts or any issues with my sensitive skin. Overall a good face product. Once I got used to the slightly sticky setting, it has been great. I have even used it mixed in with BB cream or foundation with great results.

title: These Work
text:
I was skeptical about these little pads. I was sure they were just going to clean my skin a little, but no way did I really expect younger looking skin.
You wash your face like normal. Then you take one of these little pads out of the jar. They are like old school stridex pads you used as a teenager. They smell like a mix of chemicals and alcohol. They are damp, but not soaked. One side of the pad is textured and rough. The other side is softer and less abrasive. You just rub your skin with the pad. I mostly used the textured side for good exfoliating. The chemicals kind of burned my eyes, even though I kept away from them. After I used the pad, my face was red. It also stung a little. Like, not so much I wanted to cry. But definitely not comfortable. I thought that was it. A little chemical pad that made my eyes and face sting and make me look red. Then I got up the next morning and my skin was flawless! Like, baby skin on my face. It didn't erase wrinkles or freckles or anything. My skin just looked young and happy.
Now, they say you need to wear sunblock on your face while using these. I have been using the Bright Reveal spf 30 moisturizer.

title: Sheer Pink
text: Like all Baby Lips products, this balm is a little thin feeling on the lips but very moisturizing. It smells great. The color is very light. Just a slight touch of pink. Suitable for a tween, teen, or adult.

title: Awesome
text: I was super skeptical about the ability of a brush to straighten. My hair is curly. I usually blow dry my hair straight and then straighten it with the straightener. However, with this, I tried it on just my dry, curly hair. I was thinking it was an unfair trial because there was no way it would do anything without me blow drying it straight first. I was shocked when it actually straightened my hair. It also didn't take nearly as long as my regular straightener. I couldn't get my hair stick straight like I can with my Chi, but I can get it pretty straight and smooth. I am very impressed.

title: Smells Fabulous
text: This moisturizer smells really good. Like grapefruit. Nice and fresh smelling. As sunblock, it works really well. I was out in direct sun for a couple hours and had zero pink on my face at all. The consistency is great. Not too thin, not too thick. Really ideal for a daytime moisturizer. I don't really know how brightening it is. It isn't shimmery or anything. So, "bright" is kind of hard to judge. The grapefruit scent makes me think it is bright, but I don't really know that it is. Plus, I am a highlight fanatic, so I have a lot of bright going on usually. But overall, I really like this moisturizer and will continue using it this summer.

title: Great Soap!
text:
This is my favorite soap. It lathers up so ridiculously bubbly. My son's use it for their hair, it lathers that well. It smells amazing. It leaves you clean without being overly drying. I buy this soap again and again.

I have also used it in my homemade laundry detergent and it works really well for that, as well. (I grate 2 bars of soap and melt it in boiling water. I add that to a 5 gallon bucket with 1/2 cup borax powder, 1 cup of washing powder, and fill it to the top with hot tap water. Let it sit at least overnight before use. I dilute it half and half with water before use.)

title: Good Soap
text: This soap smells nice. It is masculine without smelling like a junior high dance. My daughter and I didn't mind using it at all. It lathered nicely and lasted about 30 washes. It does have a fine grit to it, which was not unpleasant. I liked this soap very much. I did not like washing my face with it, though. The smell was just too much and left me feeling hay feverish when I used it on my face. (I am, admittedly, sensitive to such things.) But my husband and children with sensitive skin had no issues with this soap.

title: The Best Soap Ever
text: This is my favorite soap ever! I am a bit of a soap snob and am so happy I came across this soap! It smells amazing! I don't feel like the smell lingers on me, but have been asked in public about the "nag champa" smell, so apparently it does linger a bit. It foams up like crazy. Enough foam you can wash your hair with it. I use it for my entire family, even the baby. The bars are on the small side, but they last about 20 - 25 washes. (I have used plenty of natural soaps (*ahem*zum*ahem*) that are gone in 5 or less washes. So annoying. So, while the bar is small, it does last. My husband and a couple of my kids have very sensitive skin and this soap doesn't irritate them at all. Yet, it is strong enough to get that funky boy smell off my boys. I will be buying this soap again and again.

title: Awesome Cleaner
text: This smells amazing and cleans wonderfully. I put a couple squirts in an empty spray bottle and then fill with water. It smells amazing. You can also use it as hand soap. It does not work well as dish detergent- it doesn't really foam up enough. But it is a pretty good laundry degreaser.

title: It Works!
text: I have been using this for three weeks and I am sold! I thought I would try it out because I have grown increasingly uncomfortable with using chemicals on my body. I try to cut that out where I can. This deodorant works. I put it on in the morning and I am still smelling fine by evening. Even with running, I don't smell! You still sweat with this, because it is not an anti-persperant. I am not a particularly heavy sweater (except when I run, which is acceptable to me) so it has worked wonderfully for me. I love the vetiver scent. I don't want anything particularly girly. This is woodsy and fresh smelling. It reminds me of patchouli, but a little lighter. The vetiver scent is strong when you first put it on, but after about an hour, you can't really smell it anymore. Then you really just smell nothing. It does sting a little when you put it on right after shaving. I guess that is the alcohol. I've also had no staining of my clothes with this product. I recommend it.

title: New to Microdermabrasion
text:
I have never had microdermabrasion, so I wasn't quite sure what to expect. Microdermabrasion is for aging or damaged skin. It isn't for acne. It helps get rid of those fine lines and facial scarring.

This machine basically vibrates a small metal plate (reminds me of a metal nail file) against your skin as it suctions. (The vibration is caused by the suction.) You rub it over the problem areas and it renews your face.

I did not notice much difference in my fine lines. Admittedly, I don't have many. It did make my face feel fresh and awake after. It seems to increase the circulation to my face and give me a more youthful appearance in that way.

The tips for this machine have to be replaced every 10 uses. [[ASIN:B004YZ3ZJK NuBrilliance Precision Diamond Tip 11 count]] You can order replacements through Amazon. It comes with 3 tips for various uses. Each tip needs to be replaced after 10 sessions. Each filter needs to be replaced every 2-3 sessions. So, know that there will be a small upkeep cost in this machine.

It works really well. I have not had problems with it loosing its suction or had any difficulties with the machine itself. It also comes in a very pretty box, if you were thinking about purchasing this as a gift.

text: I really like the idea behind this organizer. The slanted opening prevents brushes from popping out even though there is no closure for the organizer. They rest inside the holder nicely and it is great for organizing.  The only drawback I see is that I set it on the counter and it grabbed a number of crumbs and dog hairs. I think the material is just a little too clingy for our dog haired household.  It will be used in my step daughters hermetically sealed room and should be loved.

title: Great Solution for my First World Problem
text: I have to admit that my least favorite thing about shaving is trying to clean up all the bits of trimmed goatee hairs that elusively scatter around the bathroom sink and counter.  My go to procedure had been to use a little wet toilet paper to round up what I could and come to peace with what I couldn't get.  The is kind of based on the same technology as the wet toilet paper, but much better.  The sponge does a good job of grabbing and holding onto the loose hairs and does a pretty decent job.  The rubber handle is perforated enough to mold to the angles and curves of the sink.  I do have some problems cleaning it, as I don't want to fill my sink trap with a mass of shavings, but I can get most of them off with a square of toilet paper and then a quick rinse.  Glad I have it, it does make post shave clean up easier.

title: Love the lemony scent
text: My partner and I both love the lemon scent of this boy wash.  It lathers well and leaves you feeling fresh and clean.  The pleasant scent also seems to linger for a little while.  Perhaps the best body wash I have used in years!

title: Had High Hopes for These
text: I got these and my partner tried these.  We loved the idea but were not overly impressed.  First knock was trying to get them out of the wrappers, the plastic is tough to wrestle off and inevitably broke the disk into a number of pieces.  Also, my partner felt the scent was a little too chemical in nature, especially at first.  Placing the tablets in the floor of the tub looks messy as well.  I found the scent to be ok, but weakened quite a bit to a rather subtle scent.  We will use them all, but probably will not reorder.

title: Nice, fine file
text: My partner used a heel plane that makes me wince every time she brings it out.  It looks brutal so I really like that this seems far less aggressive at filing off calouses.  The other looks like a cheese grater... She has been very happy with this and says it is easy to use and control.  The only bad thing we can see with this set is that the brush is super cheap and seems like a cheap add on.

title: Actually using these as ceramics and crafting tools
text: My son does a lot of scale modeling and we always seem to need a good set of snippers for getting parts off of the plastic sprues. This trimmer is very nicely made.  The blades line up very well and are sharp and make quick and clean work of the snipping we have done.  Both pieces look classy and high quality and both work well.  The wire loop is fantastic, the wire is stiff and it should hold up to ceramic sculpting well.  Great little set, I have no doubt that you would be happy using them for nail and cuticle care, but I am going to be very happy using them for arts and crafts.

title: Great Gift Box of Bath Bombs
text: This came in an impressive box and is an impressive selection of scents.  We have not found an off scent in the bunch yet.  In fact the only real disappointment so far is that my fiancee loved the first one so much that she was bummed that there were not more of it.  She felt the same about her second one. She says the quality seems very good and she is looking forward to many more baths.  Great set!

title: Great Manly Scented Soap
text: My fiancee and I were both taken by the scent.  The cedar, woodsy smell fits what I would like to think of myself.  The soap has a great artisinal feel and look and it lathers well.  Also love the completely recycleable packaging. It lathers okay and definitely left me feeling clean.  Everything I could ask for in a soap with a great scent.

title: Nice Looking Bottle Nice Scent
text: We are really enjoying this soap in our bathroom.  It does not have a strong lather, but it does has a very pleasant, lingering, slightly floral scent.  Both my partner and I find it to be very pleasing, but beware if you do not appreciate lingering scents. I don't know that it does much for moisturizing but it definitely does not dry your skin out.  All in all, a very nice hand soap.

title: I'm impressed
text: I have to admit, I have never used a spray on deodorant in my life, but I'm kind of sold. I like the scent, it does not seem overwhelming by any means.  It is almost magical how quickly it feels dry and how well it lasts.  Ive had some misgivings about aerosol sprays but this has been a great experience so far.  Very happy with it. Will be interesting to see how long a can lasts.  It does not feel like you have to put much on.

title: Great Scent, Great Lotion
text:
I wish I could have captured the look on my partners face when she took the first whiff of this lotion. It is a very pleasant vanilla. That and the nice looking metal can it came in made her want to save it for fancy use, but I mentioned the reasonable price and the fact that the replacement comes in a similar bottle and she is hooked. She also said it is a very good lotion and she appreciated the shea butter and other ingredients.

It really does look pretty classy in it's metal bottle. I think this would make a great housewarming gift.

title: Good Ceramic Brush
text: My partner really appreciates this brush.  It heats up quickly and leaves her hair flat and near perfect as far as I can tell.  She does find it a little bulky to use, but workable.  It cannot be much easier to use, just plug in, choose one of the three heat settings  (she uses high or medium), and brush through your hair.  I can confirm the end result looks great.

title: A Decent Hair Clipper
text: I can't say that I am overwhelmed by anything on this clipper set.  It is a little bulky and I'm not wowed with the gold color.  It does the job, and it does it quietly and powerfully enough.  The blades slide over skin without issue and the guides are nice but no great shakes.  The packaging is as generic as you can get and there is no carry pouch for the clippers and guides.  If anything, quietness is what it does great, that and they designed it for a replaceable rechargeable battery, those are the highlights.  But it is workable and it does the job and for that I am happy enough with it.  I don't think I would gift it, but if it lasts a number of years, I am happy with it.

title: Nice Bar Soap
text: I was a little worried when the label made a lot of its moisturizing.  I was worried that these would leave a greasy feeling when you used it but that does not seem to be a problem.  They soap is not overly good at lathering, but it does leave me feeling clean and has a nice floral scent.  My fiancee was very impressed with the way I smelled, which was not overly masculine, but a guy can pull it off.  Very nice soap, better than my Irish Spring go to soap i have to say.

title: Great Collection of Temporary Tattoos
text: These were a pleasant surprise.  They are better than I was expecting and was a lot of fun for the kids.  I was actually happier with the smaller tribal tatoos than the full sleeves which do not do as well with hair arms.  The tatoos are vibrant and fun.  they do fade after a couple days so you may need to work on removing them.  But for the price, this is an afternoon of fun!

title: Great way to apply Mineral Sun Block
text: We have been moving to mineral sun blocks in our family for health and envronmental reasons and found all the short comings of Mineral blocks.  This stick version is a great delivery system.  It is easy to control the application and not as hard to get rid of streaking.  It is very convenient and effective.  This may be our go to in the future.

title: Decent Hand Soap, Decent Price for Amount
text: This is a good anti bacterial hand soap.  It has a hint of citrus, but otherwise a kind of generic soap scent.  The bottles are big, a little too big to be elegant in guest bathrooms, but big enough that they will be pumping for a long time in the kids bathrooms.  We are actually using one to refill the dispenser in the kitchen.  It is a lot of soap for the price and it is decent.  I have been using it for about a week in my bathroom and it is working great.  Recommend.

title: Good Temporary Tattoos
text: These are decent tattoos.  They have great Halloween themes and we will be giving them out along with candy this year at Halloween.  We tried one of this batch and it worked well.  It applied well and lasted for a few days before we washed it off.  All in all, good temp tattoos.

title: Great Body Wash
text: I have always like Dove body washes for both effectiveness and cost.  This four pack is no different, in fact the only difference I see is that this has an even fresher, crisper scent.  It is a perfect body wash thickness and leaves you feeling clean and soft.  Perfect Mens body wash that leaves you smelling clean and not cologned.  Highly recommend.

title: Perhaps the Coolest Clippers I've Ever Owned
text: Nailclippers have not been the most innovative category in my lifetime, so these are pretty amazing in design.  They look amazing and I love the little metal arm that rotates to become the spring, then rotate back for easy storage.  The clippers are effective, but feel a little clumsy at first. It took a little getting used to but they work well.  The storage case falls well short of the elegant design of the clippers and I ended up casting that out.  Otherwise, Kudos on the coolest clippers!

title: Great Lotion
text:
My partner has been fighting a war with her heels which are splitting at the end of every summer. We were very glad to get a reviewer container of this balm and even happier with the results. We have been applying it at bedtime and placing a sock over it through the night and her heels already feel softer and suppler. The splits seem to be healing for the first time.

The lotion applies well and does not leave an oily feel. It absorbs quickly and definitely softens and moisturizes All in all a great healing lotion!

title: I'm torn about usage
text:
I got these thinking that they would be great wipes and tissues. what I got were such luxuriantly thick tissues that I cannot justify using them to blow my nose, but not filled with liquids so they didn't seem to be perfect for camping wipes. In the end, my partner has been using them as face towels for cleaning off make up.

They are wonderfully soft, they are well made, and they are well packaged. All in all, they actually seem to nice for the uses. Like using ten dollar bills to start a fire.

title: Great Smelling and Lasting Deodorant
text: I really like these Cremo men's deodorants.  They have nice masculine scents that last well.  They are small which makes them good for travel, but the top caps are super thin and brittle which make them less good for travel.  But all in all, I love this deodorant.

title: Love this product!
text: This hand wash dispenser seems like a rich luxury.  I love the silly flower pattern it dispenses in, even though it looks more like a nebulizer than a soap dispenser.  It is kind of a novelty conversations starter.  The soap itself is a rich lathering foam like no other I have tried.  The scent is pleasant and all in all a great product.  Hope I can find refills!

title: Decent Deodorant, Unsure about Tone Restoring
text: My partner was a little confused when these arrived and was unsure what skin tone restoring meant.  As far as we know, she does not have any armpit skin toning issues.  But she is supportive of Dove's recent cruelty free rating by PETA.  It is a good deodorant in general, with a good scent and good applications.  She likes it but is a little worried about what the skin toning part is doing.

title: Good manly scented deoderant
text: I was intrigued with Bourbon and Oak as a scent.  Turns out it smells like men's deodorant.  It is a good, it applies well and seems to last at least through a day. All in all, a decent mens deodorant.  What I didn't like is that the caps are paper thin plastic and it cracked the first time I tried to open it. that was a little disappointing, but the actual product is good.

title: Nice manly scent, good cleaning action
text: I really like this body wash, it is much more watery than any I have used in the past, but that works well in that more of it makes it into washing rather than sloughing off.  The scent is cologne like and I was surprised to read Patchuli when I read the label.  I did not get a sense of that when using it.  It did not lather richly, but did leave me feeling and smelling fresh and clean.  This is a heavy candidate for reorder in the future.

title: Best Shampoo I have gotten from Head and Shoulders
text: Head and shoulders is my go to shampoo, but it has always seemed like a utilitarian choice.  It cleans my hair well but not with the luxury of other salon type shampoos.  At least until now, this is a wonderfully rich feeling and smelling shampoo with everything I look for in Head and Shoulders and it's dandruff control.  The smell is richly tropical and based in coconut.  The feel is rich and creamy both in your hand and when lathering.  Add to this a H&S conditioner and you have a wonderful experience with a trusted name I don't think of as a luxury brand.  But this all comes at what I feel is a luxury price, but my partner says is appropriate for what I am getting.  Love the product, a little put off by the price, but it might be my next refill I buy.

title: Expensive but Good
text: This is a very nice sunscreen.  It applies well and soaks in without leaving any an oily residue.  All in all,  I really like this sun screen, but $25 is a very stiff price.  We have been using it and used it on a canoeing trip and it kept us all from burning our faces.  Good product.

title: Decent Styling Cream
text: I like this cream.  It doesn't take much to define my curls and give them a decent hold.  The scent is pleasant and seemed to have disappeared after use.  I found the cream a little dry to the touch and when working it on my fingers, but it worked well in wet hair.  Hair and curls ended up looking good.  It seems a little expensive and I'm not sure that any dandfruff fighting ingredients really make it to my scalp.  I like it, but probably will not be changing to it, but will definitely use the rest of the container.

title: A Good Spa Day Mask
text: My partner has beauty parlor day on the weekend and loves to try new masks and creams.  She really liked the packaging for this one, thinking it was apple sauce when I handed it to her.  It went on well and formed a good mask.  She was not so sure how much stress relief it has done, but she has enjoyed pampering herself with this.  I almost think that the act of self pampering is more important than anything the ingredients do for her.  She doesn't think she will order more, but she said it was nice and did leave her face feeling clean and renewed after she rinsed it off.  She said, 4 stars, she liked it but didn't love it.

title: Cheap for Retinol
text: We got this for my partners beauty parlor day and she was excited to try it.  She uses a number of much more expensive retinol products so she was excited about the price.  After putting it on, she said that it was causing a mild stinging sensation on her face, but she did not have a visible reaction to the product.  It left her face moisturized and fresh looking, but she could not say that it was much different from any other product that she has used.  Which might be saying something for the price.  Asked if she would switch to it, she said no, but it was not bad. She just preferred her other standby's.

title: A Good Base Set for a Tween
text: This is a pretty OK makeup set for a tween, and probably specifically a tween because there are a lot of glittery eye shades included.  It is something of a young assortment.  It is also not particularly exhaustive at only 41 different items, but it is plenty for a youngster looking to make her own style statement.  We let our tween use this after she went to a professional makeup coaching at a local spa.  She was able to show off everything she had learned and give her mom a little make over.  She has used it several times since and says she is pretty happy with it.  The quality of the cosmetics is probably along the lines you would expect for a kit like this, it is ok, but not stellar.  But for the price and a young audience, it is a pretty good set.

title: Really like the Scent of this body wash
text: This is a very nice body wash.  I'm not certain what the scent is, but it is reminiscent of a brown sugar body wash I once had.  It is wonderful and warm and sweet - almost tasty. It is not much of a soapy, lathering wash, it seems almost more like a lotion.  It does leave a lotion like feel to your skin and that nice scent although that is not long lasting. I don't know that I will reorder this product as I like a more lathering, soap clean feeling body wash, but I will happily use the two bottles I have now.  It is a very nice body wash.

title: A Great Guest Soap
text: This seems like a rich bar soap.  We used it in the guest bathroom until it got used enough to lose the embossed label.  After that we put it in our bathroom and I have to say we found it to be a good soap.  It is a little too floral for my tastes, but my wife commented it a couple times about how much she liked the smell and that it did moisturize.  It is a little luxury in the time of multiple coronavirus mandatory hand washings.  All in all a  very nice soap.

title: Nice Body Wash with Nice Subtle Smell
text: I really like this body wash.  It has a floral, but not overly feminine scent that is subtle and does not last on your body too long.  It lathers ok and leaves me feeling clean and I have to admit moisturized.  I don't know that it will replace my standards which tend to be Old Spice and Dove products because I can get them locally at a good price, but I would not shy away from use this wash.

title: A Really Good Foil Razor
text: I can't say that foil razors are my favorite, but this is a pretty solid one.  We got it for our second oldest son who is just starting a few whiskers that need to be snipped.  It is a great starter razor and has done well taking care of his thin facial hair, but I have had issues getting a close shave with foil razors in the past and some issues with skin irritation.  For now though it is fantastic and meets the needs well.  The motor and battery seem strong and even at the $150 price point, I think this is a solid razor choice.  Recommend it!

title: Yes! Now here's a Man's Gel
text: I had picked up some Aussie hair gel and was disappointed with it.  The scent seemed childish and the gel itself reminded me of the industrial Dep I used to use in college.  I don't really care for it.  This gel was different right out of the bottle.  It is thick and I only need a tiny glob to set my hair perfectly.  The scent is mature and masculine and got complements from my partner as soon as she stepped into the bathroom.  These tubes will probably last me a good long while which is great, and I have been very happy with my curls, volume and hold.  I have my new go to gel.

title: Functional but Underwhelming Calipers
text: I actually got these as a sculpting aid, and I am happy that they do the job of getting ratios and even fixed scalings up and down.  They are rugged enough to last for all my purposes in the clay studio, but all in all, the constructions is not going to wow anyone.  I don't know that I would want to take advantage of its bendable qualities and not sure why that is listed as a benefit.  All in all it is an OK caliper which will do the job for me for conveying ratios and maintaining symmetry, but I'm definitely not wowed.  The box seemed a step better than the product.

title: Have I Outgrown Aussie
text: I used Aussie products a lot in the past and was happy to get a reviewers sample of it, but was a little taken aback by it.  First, it has kind of a kiddy scent to it, perhaps fruity and sweet scent.  I have been using a lot of other suggested hair products with more manly scents.  Oddly, the scent brought back a lot of memories of college, using Dep and other crunchy hair gels.  The worst thing is that I just didn't like how it worked in my hair.  I was underwhelmed throughout the day.  It did not seem to define my curls and just left my hair with disorganized volume.  Won't be on my reorder list.

title: Good Beard Trimmer
text: I go through a beard trimmer every couple of years and I am hoping this one will make it a couple of years.  Right off the bat, I'm not overly impressed with its ability to cut.  It took a lot of passes to thin my goatee and eventually manage to get it down about a half inch.  Perhaps it will do better with more regular shaves, but again, not too impressed.  In the end it did look good an it does come with an ample collection of guides and brushes etc.  The battery seems to be decent and I am pretty happy with the looks of it.  It looks like it will do the job, but not in an impressively powerful way.  It is a decent beard trimmer kit all in all, but not great.

title: Good Shampoo, Has a strong and lasting scent
text:
Unlike the typical Head and Shoulders with zinc pyrithione, this product uses Coal Tar, which unfortunately for me will forever be connected with our dogs flea shampoo. That smell brings me back to a time when we had to flea bomb our house and scrub our dog daily with this type of shampoo. That smell has been clinging to me all day since I showered with this product. It is not horrific, but it is a little strong. This is also the active ingredient in T-Gel if you have ever used that product. Coal Tar is effective and often a good change of pace to help solve dandruff as you body ajusts to zinc pyrithione.

As a shampoo, this seems pretty good. It left my hair soft and had a nice lather to it. It is orange rather than the typical Head and Shoulders mint great and definitely has a stronger scent. But after, my hair styled well and it looks good. I expect it to work as well as T-Gel which was effective. All in all, a decent shampoo, but a slight change of pace from the more classic H&S shampoos.

title: A Decent Flat Iron
text: My partner and her daughter both tried this and they said it was fine.  They were a little put off by the fact that it would not fully close, but in the end it did flatten their hair satisfactory.  They could not say that the infrared was any great shakes but it worked.  So it was a decent flat iron but did not inspire them particularly.

title: Does What It Is Supposed to Do
text: Our daughter had a manipedi party and this was very popular.  Everyone put on a base coat which made the next layer of polish go on smooth and shiny.  My partner also tried it to see if it helped her polish last longer and look better and there were mild yeses for both of those things.  She was also happy that it came off well when she removed it and it did not damage or discolor her nails.  Her only criticism was that she thought $8 was a little high for the product but she thought it did what it should do well.

title: Love the Colors and Selection, Not in Love with the Material
text: This is an absolutely wonderful selection of colors.  54 is an amazingly impressive collection of hair ties, I just wish they were a little better quality.  The velvet material does not work for me.  Our daughter has used a number of them.  They are ok, but they could be better quality.

title: Not Our Favorite
text: Well, I had higher hope for this product than we received.  My partner tried it on and the color was bold, but not overwhelming.  I actually liked it in general although it was a little bolder than she was used to.  But from there it when a little downhill.  She was not thrilled with it in application or for longevity.  It doesn't seem like it even made it through a meal.  In the end, it was relegated to our daughter's dress up makeup collection.  Trust the brand, but this product didn't connect with either of us that well.

title: Didnt give the luxuriant feeling we expected
text: We weren't overwhelmed by this product. The scent is ok. It has a kind of artificially floral scent to it and it just doesn't smell that natural.  I find it subtle after a bath using one product, but my partner says that it smells a little old ladyish.  It did lather fine and felt clean.  We have tried other Kai products that we have liked, but we did not care for the gardenia scent.  The travel set seemed nice enough, but seems a little expensive for what you get.  Still like Kai, but this product didn't quite do it for us.

title: Family loved color, Little pricey, took a bit to apply
text: We got a reviewer sample of this nail polish and our youngest loved the wild gold metallic color.  She had friends over and the sampled this and liked it once on.  Sounds like it was a little harder to apply than they were expecting and needed second coats before looking deep and rich.  It wore okay, but was getting worn after a couple days and needed to be removed.  I can see that the metallic polish could take more to get right, but it seemed a little troublesome for the price.  They definitely liked it, but due to price and issues with application, four out of five stars.

title: Partner and Kids Love This, a Bit Pricey Though
text:
We got a reviewer sample of this and we really liked the Crimson color. It goes on smooth and remained very shiny. They have worn it for a couple days now and it seems to have help up well. The general opinions have been, love the color, it is really good nail polish, and it is a little expensive.

Our daughter had a small get together with friends and it was chosen by two of the girls for their mani/pedi's so it has proven popular.

title: Smells Great!
text: This is a wonderful body wash.  It smells great in a non-perfume way and leaves us feeling clean, moisturized and soft.  We love Shea Butter and could not be happier with it.  This is on our reorder list.  It is a rich luxurious experience to shower with and feels good all day.  Love this product.

title: Great Find, Will Reorder
text: My partner has been using this for her weekend beauty parlor tradition and she loves it.  It leaves her skin, clean, soft, moisturized and good smelling.  The scent is subtle and I think it would work fine for both men and women.  The texture is a little off putting as it is kind of like a gel, but it lathers up like a good soap and rinses clean, leaving you feeling clean and soft.  I love this product on my partner and she is planning on ordering it again to add it to her routine.  It is a great product and a good price.

title: Nice Collection of Hair Ties
text: By numbers, this is a very impressive collection of hair ties.  36 is a pretty big collection of decent quality ties.  The quality is pretty good, they are soft and don't pull the hair when putting them in, but they also don't slide out unexpectedly.  There is just a minor diversity of textures which would have been nice and the color selection is not horribly broad, like why isn't there a white.  Most of the colors are muted and neutral which is ok, but it would have been nice to have a larger selection of bright colors.

title: Nice For Kids to Play With
text:
This collection has an amazing selection of colors but the hair is pretty artificial looking. There are some good gradations but overall, just too fake for most uses. Except for kids. Our 12 year old loves swapping them in and out and has had others over to have an extension party. It is fun for them and the price is good, so if you are looking for a little dress up play, this is a good set.

The combs are a little trick, the instructions very limited. It didn't take too long to figure out how to get things to hold fairly well and I'm sure these will be worn to school from time to time.

title: A Good Hair Dryer
text:
We really like the size and weight of this hair dryer. I'm not sure why it looks so big in the photos on the Amazon page, unless the model is a little smaller, or we are big at over six feet. It has a lot of power and all in all, it does everything we want from a hair dryer.

The only strange thing is that the on off buttons are on the front of the handle so it is easy to bump it off while using it, but that is pretty easy to avoid once you know.

title: Perfect for a Girl Scout Craft Party
text: We used these and some essential oils to make aroma therapy crafts.  They worked perfectly, they are thick glass and functional rollers that the girls enjoyed filling, capping and sharing.  Some of the rollers were a little stiff, but the amount of bottles you get at a decent price was perfect for an aroma therapy party.  Recommend!

title: Nice Body Wash
text: I like that this body wash puts a lot of thought and effort into keep the product free of toxins and possible inflammatories.  The fragrance free does not mean scent free and it smells lightly of witch hazel, but mildly.  It lathers well enough and is a gentle soap.  I do feel clean and moisturized after using it and it appears to be a good soap.  It does everything I want out of a body wash and does it in a thoughtful way.  Would recommend

title: Not Wowed
text: My partner tried these and she was a little underwhelmed. The scent is not pleasing, not a strong smell, but could have benefitted from some kind of soothing scent like lavender.  She doesn't feel that her skin is overly moisturized and actually is a little greasy.  She also found the mask to be a little creepy, although she did enjoying showing it to the kids.  She has a Sunday beauty parlor day tradition, and it sounds like this mask will not become part of it as she favors other mask products.

title: Very Nice Tweezers
text:
OK I’ll admit right up front that we did not get these for cosmetic purposes. We use a lot of different tools in scale model making and these tweezers are perfect. They come to a great point for grabbing a very fine pieces, we are easy to hold and hold closed. Sometimes you get fatigue when trying to hold cheap tweezers closed these are very comfortable and hold very well.

After reading the description of German engineering and quality, I was a little disappointed that the tips do not meet quite right for mine. Only the tip comes together completely, and there is daylight showing through the rest of the ends where they come together. Also it looks a little misaligned. We are still fantastically manufactured tweezers, but I feel like I may have gotten a lesser pair. The metal and finishes our first rate. The price is a little higher $10, but they may be the best tweezers I’ve ever owned.

title: Good Epsom Salts, Great Scent
text: The women of the house really like the scent of this Epsom salt.  We got them for the soreness we were seeing after workouts but have not had to use them for that. They are currently just using it to have more luxurious baths and they enjoy how soft and wonderfully scented the water is.  But my partner says that it is kind of just a bulk Epsom salt product that she likes, but it doesn't have anything about it that she loves.  So she says it would be about a price value when she goes to reorder, but she likes it enough that she would consider reordering.

title: Works Great
text: This is a very interesting product.  It comes out thick and a little oily and feels a little like styling wax.  It was a little off putting, but it applies to hair very well and I need to use just a tiny amount to get good results.  This goes a long ways toward is approximate $45 price that is listed right now.  Although that still seems a little steep for me. The scent is pretty subtle so no issues there.  The hold is nice and I like the bit of shine that it adds to my hair.  To tell the truth, purely for hold and styling it is one of the best I've tried with the least work, but the price is a little hard to swallow.  But I have a good long time before thoughts of reorder because this will last a good long time.

title: A Very Good Mineral Sun Screen
text:
This is a good mineral sun screen with all the good and bad that comes with mineral sunscreens. The good being mostly environmental and health related as it does not kill coral or show up on the blood stream to the extent that chemical blocks do. On the bad side, it takes a little more to apply and is a little streaky. the feel is a little greasier than spray ons but it feels fine after a little extra time rubbing it in during the application. If you still haven't used a mineral sun screen, it will take a little getting used to, but it will be worth it.

SPF 50 is good and it appears to be pretty effective and we used it one day in the yard on a sunny spring day with now sign of burns. Definitely a decent sun screen.

title: Good Toenail Polish
text: We got a reviewer bottle in the mail just in time for my partner's home beauty parlor day.  She liked the She-Ro mauve like color and it looked good on her.  She said that it is kind of thin, especially for a reportedly long lasting polish. It was drippy which made it a little more difficult to apply, but also made it easy to smooth and get a good surface.  She has worn it all weekend and gotten compliments (after some prodding) and it has worn well, even with barefoot activities. All in all, everything she is looking for in a polish.

title: Intimidating, But Very Effective
text: This this was terrifying right out of the packaging.  It seems painfully sharp and looks like a cheese grater.  Worse, it feels like a cheese grater when you run your fingers over it.  It is an aggressive foot rasp which is not for the faint hearted.  I winced just thinking about my partner using it on her feet and she paused before using it.  But she did use it on her next beauty parlor Sunday and said she loves it. She has used lots of files before and they all took time to file off her callouses.  This took no time at all and she was super excited about how soft her feet were.  It's kind of an industrial strength callous file, so be careful with it, but her results were actually quite amazing. Recommended, but with a word of caution to be careful.

title: Great Atrisenal Soap
text:
I winced a little when this was listed as lye soap, thinking, why would anyone make a harsh lye soap, but this is anything but. The ingredient list is great, the scents are wonderful and the soaps make fantastic treats for bath and hand washing.

This contains Shea Butter and natural plant based oils, including essential oils for scents. Together they make a nicely moisturizing gentle soap that feels good on the hands. The scents are strong on the soap, but don't seem to linger too long on the skin. I love the care that was taken in ingredients and manufacturing. Would make a perfect gift.

title: A Premium Soap and a High Premium Price
text: There is a lot to like about this soap, except for maybe the current $16 a bar price tag.  It is obviously a high quality product and I like the mix of embedded exfoliants and manly scent.  It lathered well and gave a great clean feeling after the shower. The scent in particular is very nice, it is a clean spiced and manly scent that wears well on a man, although it faded rather quickly.  I can't justify the price, but will fully endorse the quality of the product.  With it's wonderful appearance and molded mustache in the soap, it would be a great gift.

title: A Good Mineral Sunscreen
text: After reading about the dangers of chemical sun screens to people and the environment, we have been moving more and more toward mineral sunscreens with zinc oxide.  It does come with a few drawback, mostly that it is streaky when applied and leaves a chalky residue.  This product does have this drawback, but seems better than most that we have tried.  My partner took it to a trip to Arizona (we are pale Minnesotans) and used it daily with no ill effects and good sun protection.  She did not get burned (or tanned) and said it worked well.  We will finish the container, but right now it is looking like a great candidate for our new go to sunscreen.

title: 11 ounces is a big bottle of spray sun screen
text: Well, this is the imposing bottle. We go through a lot of sunscreen with camping sports,

title: Not What We Were Hoping For
text: My partner uses a lot of witch hazel and was hoping to try a witch hazel toner, but the addition of alcohol made it harsh and drying to her skin.  She said it stings and even when taking care, she got it in her eyes.  It is a pretty harsh astringent in this form.  I understand that this is intended as a toner and seems to be working, but the harshness made it so she does not want to continue using it.  For now we will try to avoid witch hazel with alcohol in it.

title: Wanted to Love It, But Experience is Just OK
text: I really wanted to find a mineral sunscreen to use on trips to beaches with corals.  I don't like the ecological effects of most chemical sunscreens and jumped at the chance to try a mineral sunblock.  I think a lot of the shortcomings I had with this are issues with the mineral products, like the white lines left when trying to rub it in.  It is aesthetically a little unsettling.  Also I found it less moisturizing and actually a little drying.  It goes on thick and it never seems to soak in.  Otherwise, I have worn it a few times and had no sun burn, so it has been effective, but not my favorite sunscreen experience.

title: It was Ok, but we probably will not be purchasing again.
text: It was a little confusing how to free the mask from the packaging.  It is possible to get confused about which part is the mask and which is packaging.  It is a little weird having to keep it on for 20 minutes, it has a strong smell that is a little uncomfortable to breathe in for 20 minutes.  The smell is not bad, but it isn't a relaxing spa experience, it is more an ongoing attempt to keep a cold slimy thing on your face.  It was not horrible, but we probably won't be purchasing it in the future.

title: It was OK, but not a future buy.
text: It was a little confusing how to free the mask from the packaging.  It is possible to get confused about which part is the mask and which is packaging.  It is a little weird having to keep it on for 20 minutes, it has a strong smell that is a little uncomfortable to breathe in for 20 minutes.  The smell is not bad, but it isn't a relaxing spa experience, it is more an ongoing attempt to keep a cold slimy thing on your face.  It was not horrible, but we probably won't be purchasing it in the future.

title: Everything My Partner Looks for in a Disposable Razor
text: My partner used this the morning after it arrived and said she was very happy with it.  It did give a close and smooth shave, it felt good in the hand and is easy to use and replace blades.  She is very happy with it.

title: Great Line of Hair Creams
text: I have gotten a couple of these Garnier Hair Creams to review and I really like them.  This one has a very strong hold that defines my curls very well and keeps my hair held all day.  The cream is liquid which pours easily from the nicely designed and sized container.  A little bit goes a long ways and it looks like one of these bottles will last me several months. To be honest, this might be my go to hair product when I do run out.  I am very happy with it all around.

title: Love the Cause and Love the Soap
text:
My partner really loves the scent of this soap which is another benefit. The bars are oversized, almost to the point of being unwieldy, and after a couple of weeks of using a bar, they have proven that they will be long lasting. The scents seems mostly a kind of generic but pleasing soap scent with a floral touch. Not sure that I can smell charcoal at all, but all in all it is a very pleasant and not overwhelming scent. The price is reasonable for a artisan gift soap, and well worth it if the creators are able to make their mobile showers.

The cause is wonderful. I love that they are focusing on such a small but important issue that makes peoples lives better. I cannot imagine a world where bathing was not available. Kudos for the founders for coming up with such a meaningful good deed for the world.

title: A Great Soap Helping a Great Cause
text:
I'm really impressed with the meaningful cause that the sale of this soap supports. Showers to the homeless is an amazing idea that is so easy to overlook, it reminds me of the laundry trucks that go to hurricane hit cities. It is a simple universal need that does not get as much thought but means so much. I would love to support this cause.

And in return for your support, you get a very nice soap. First impressions are that it's a very big bar of soap, almost unwieldy, but three for $20 is a reasonable price for artisan soap and it feels like these bars are going to last a while. In the shower they put out a very satisfying lather and feel like Shea butter bars in their moisturizing feel. I found the scent to be more of a generic shower soap smell rather than ginger and currants, but my partner found it to be wonderful and manly so she's happy. All in all a great soap, also loving the no animal testing and attempts at sustainable sourcing. Although the ingredient list has plenty of chemicals and I'm a little leary of the warning to keep it out of eyes. I definitely didn't have any bad effects with the soap, but will be careful with that warning.

title: Decent Hair Gel
text: I have been wearing this for a couple days and I really like the hold and curl definition this is giving me.  The scent is a strange botantical smell that seems a little citrusy, a little floral and a little vegetable.  It has a strong scent that does fade quickly, but has a pretty strong, although not unpleasing scent right out of the container.  It is pretty thin and works into the hair very easily and dried quickly.  All in all it does everything I want in a hair gel and I would definitely be willing to buy in the future.

title: It's OK, It Does Trim a Beard
text:
I was excited to get this as a travel beard trimmer and cheater shaver while traveling, and after running a test shave, I think it will do that fine. But, I'm not overly impressed with the quality of the shaver. It is cheaply made and more thought was put into the packaging than the product. I don't think this could possibly be a go to every day shaver, but it will still fit the role of travel shaver when I go out of the country for a week or more.

It does have enough power to power through my goatee which is nice. Not sure how quickly it will deplete two double A's. The nose trimmer is a little big but also had good power with a fully charged battery. I was a little disappointed with the trim guards until I realized that I can just travel with perhaps two and leave the rest home. The travel bag is nice enough, but again kind of on the economy side of quality.

All in all it will do what I was hoping to do, but without making me feel rich for having it.

title: Decent, it defintes curls but does not hold them
text:
I like what this looks like when it dries, but it does not seem to hold my hair well in windy conditions, even including the wind generated by walking down the hall. I don't want crunchy like Dep or old school gels, but I would like a little bit better hold that this provides.

The gel is a little strange out of the bottle, kind of has a petroleum jelly appearance and feel, but it blends into hair well. The scent is subtle enough to almost be unscented. The price is reasonable, but probably will not be going into my daily hair product slot. Like I said, it defines curls well, but I will need a little more hold.

title: An Interesting Gel
text:
This gel has the feel of lotion when you rub it on your hands and even more so when you go to wash it off. But it does not leave my hair oily or greasy, in fact it just gives nicely defined curls. It doesn't weigh down my hair and leaves the curls soft, not crunchy. After just a couple days of using it, I'm sold that this is a very good gel for me.

I also love that it tries to do the right things. It is cruelty free and avoids things like parabans. It is always good to support companies that at least put thought into these things.

The scent is a little strange, reminding me of a orange chewable I had to take some time in my childhood. It is not overwhelming, but it does last throughout my drive in and part of my day before it fades or I become nose blind to it. It seems crisp and citrusy. Again, not unpleasant, but definitely there.

title: Absolutely Wonderful
text: My partner feels absolutely rich having all these cotton rounds.  They are far better than cotton balls for cosmetic removal and blending.  At just over $10 for 600, this is a very reasonable product that for us will last for a year or more.  They are well made, soft, store nicely in zip lock sealed sleeves which fit well in the vanity.  All in all a nicely designed and manufactured basic supply for makeup.

title: Applies Well, Bold Color
text: My partner really likes this eyeliner although we wasn't sure of the maroon color we got.  However, she had just ordered a different pencil eyeliner and said that application was a disaster, but this one went on smoothly and had a lot of control.  The color was very dramatic when looked at closely, almost resembling the reflectiveness of a butterfly wing, but subtle in a small line.  We will see what happens when we try to sharpen the pencil, but the quality of the eyeliner itself is very good.  Applies well and wears well.

title: Light Conditioning, Good Scent
text: We were not overwhelmed by this conditioner.  It is noticeably harder to come through our hair after using it so it is not a strong detangler and it even left my partner wondering if she had forgotten to use a conditioner.  Her hair looked fine after using it, but nothing obviously better.  I did like the scent when I used it, but not the conditioner for us.  I did like this companies curl defining shampoo much better than this conditioner.

title: Great Scent, Nice Container and Shea Butter as a Bonus
text: This is everything I was looking for in a guest bathroom soap.  Even the container is pretty nice for a disposeable soap.  But the main thing is that it smells wonderful and has a richness due to the Shea butter.  All in all a great product.

title: More Sunscreen than Moisturizer
text: I was hoping this would not feel too oily but at least on application, it feels like I'm putting on a sunscreen.  It does soak in in time which is nice.  The scent is strong and perhaps not that necessary.  Both my wife and I used it on a recent trip for the sunscreen qualities and it was fine.  I can't justify the price as we could have gotten the same effect for far less.

title: Wonderful Scent but a Little Pricey
text: We really like this soap.  The scent is crisp and fresh and not too overwhelming.  I definitely felt and smelled clean after using it.  We also love the aloe and its soothing moisturizing.  All in all we really love this soap except that it is pretty pricey at over $5 a bar.  A luxury for sure, and it feels it.

title: A Very Nice Clipper Set
text: I like the gift box that these come in and they are solid clippers.  I'd never used a diagonal clipper and not sure that it is needed at least in my case, but all the clippers work well and they have a nice quality feel to them.  They feel a little luxurious and do the job.

title: Subtle and Protective
text:
First, I don't like Chapstick or Lipstick, I find them greasy and makes lips basically unkissable. But my partner loves both and loves this product. Personally I like it because the color and gloss really are very subtle. We got warm pink and it did add a nice pinkness to her lips and gave her a light gloss (and greasy kisses.) She was very happy with it and really liked the aesthetics that came with the protection she wants from Chapstick.

Not sure if this will become a regular purchase, but she said she would definitely consider it when looking for chapstick in the future.

title: Luxuriously Thick with a Manly Scent
text:
I'm not completely sure what Ginseng and Hawthorn Berry are supposed to smell like, but to us it smells like a mens cologne. The scent is strong and lingering but not overpowering, but after my partner wiped her face with one, she had problems getting to sleep because she said she smelled like a man. Personally, I find the scent a plus.

There are not many wipes to a container, just ten, but they are luxuriously thick. They are obviously not flushable, but they reek of quality. We use wipes like these when camping when it is too cold to swim and I am totally looking forward to using these. In fact, I think they will be my go to wipes for future trips despite their somewhat expensive price tag. This is a luxury I would appreciate in the field.

title: A Very Decent Razor
text:
My son was needing a razor to start out his shaving career and I think this is the perfect razor to do it with. It is definitely not the most powerful razor in the world, but it does have very workable and quiet power to work through his babyfaced, sixteen year old facial hair. It does not seem to have affected his skin too much after a couple shaves which is nice and has given him a clean shaven look.

The design is nice and I live that it is washable. It is fairly big, but not huge. He has used the beard trimmer to straighten out his sideburns and that seems to work well too. All in all a very decent razor.

title: This is nearly perfect but a little big
text:
This is a strange size in a toiletries organizer. It is too big for air or camp travel. Perhaps it is a good size for car travel if you are the type to bring all your full sized bottles of shampoo and other hair products. We usually go small for all travel and often depend on hotels for soap and shampoo so this seems a little overkill.

As far as organization, it is perfect. I love the toothbrush holding side pockets and the next little compartments. The large compartment is nice for full sized bottles of hair products and the hanging hook is great for keeping it all together yet still handy in a hotel bathroom. The fabric seems pretty tough and should handle light travel fine. I'm sure we will use this, especially on upcoming car trips, but due to size it will not be our one stop solution. We camp and fly a fair amount and I really can't see it replacing our other smaller solutions.

It's pretty nice, but doesn't fit our needs perfectly.

title: Nice Scent, Low Lather
text:
This was a very interesting shampoo. It comes out of the bottle rather thin, much thinner than an average shampoo. It says in the title line, luxurious lather, but I did not find this at all. It actually was rather light on lather, but it lives up to the curl defining part. I have very curly hair and it definitely made a difference in how the curls held. I use gel and after using this shampoo, I felt like my curls were wider with more hair in each curl. At any rate, it did make my curls look different.

I wish the bottle was bigger. It seems small, like what you would expect from a prescription shampoo. As it stands, the small bottle makes the price tag bigger. You are getting a small bottle for a big bottle price.

The scent is nice. At first I thought, wow this Jasmine is actually a masculine scent. Followed quickly by, no it isn't. I think I thought that just because it actually smells pretty good, but it is definitely a feminine scent. Very floral, but pleasant. In fact good enough that my partner has taken it off my hands and plans to finish it.

title: A Great Product at a Slightly High Price
text: Cetaphil has a nearly legendary reputation for great and gentle products.  This lotion holds this reputation up well.  It is a very good lotion to use daily.  It moisturizes and smooths well with the gentleness you would expect.  I recommend this product completely, but I have a bit of hesitation based on price.Currently this is listed for $27 for two bottles and a bonus Cetaphil soap sample. I can usually get the same bottle Locally for $12 and better on sale or coupon. So watch the price but the product is great.

title: Still not sure what a hot scrub is, but it does give a clean feeling
text:
This scrub has kind of a medicinal scent, probably because of the Eucalyptus. The salt is pretty coarse so it falls off when you apply it so it feels like you are wasting a lot in application. And I'm also a little confused by why it is called a hot scrub. It is not explained on the bottle. The lettering is tiny and hard to read, but once we deciphered it, it did nothing to take away the "Hot Scrub" mystery. We also found no sign of the tingling or warming.

The bottle is pretty and easy to get to the product but hard to get cap back on because of salt getting into the grooves. Did leave us feeling clean.

title: A Decent Hand Lotion
text: This lotion has a nice scent and works well as a hand lotion.  It is a little thicker than we are used to but it goes on smoothly and does seem to moisturize well.
