I can't say that there is anything that will put this on or shopping list, but there is nothing that would keep it off.  I also trust Jergens in general and this seems to live up to the quality I would expect from them.

title: Like the subtle coloring and Looks Good On
text: In general my partner really liked this blush.  She does not wear much makeup but does put on a modest amount for nights out.  She has been using this for going out to dinner etcetera and says she like it and the color.  The packaging is nice and it is easy to apply.  It is subtle, at least in the way that she uses it and it seems to make her even more beautiful.  But she said she would probably only get four out of five stars because it doesn't completely wow her.

title: The Great Product I have Enjoyed for Years in Monster Sized Bottles
text:
This four pack is a lot of Shampoo. I love that it is labeled as the original 2 in 1 shampoo and conditioner because I used Pert years ago when it first came out and this kind of felt like a walk down memory lane. The shampoo lathers well and has a nice scent which seems more like cologne than a shampoo - think Old Spice. It has a rich but non lasting scent.

The bottles are big in the four pack - about 24 ounces so they will last a long time. We put a bottle in every bathroom and I don't expect to run out in any of them soon. Great product that I have enjoyed on and off over the last many years.

title: Good Solid Sunscreen, nice smell
text:
This is pretty much what I would expect from Hawaiian Tropic, a good solid sunscreen lotion with a pleasing scent. Added oxidants seems nice although perhaps a little gimmicky. It arrived just in time for a full day of spring time sun and we put it on ourselves and our kids and there were no sun burns despite spending 5 hours in sun after coming out of a Minnesota winter. All in all it is a good product.

I have been reading about the chemicals in sunscreen (which this is a chemical sunscreen as opposed to a mineral screen like Zinc Oxide.) Sounds like the jury is out, especially since I have red hair and fair skin, my chances of melanoma are probably so high that it makes the chemical issues moot. But it is something to think about.

I like the product and would probably buy it again if it comes in SPF 45.

title: It's OK, wish the ingredient list matched the natural claims
text: The best I can say is that this shampoo is OK.  I'm not a particular fan of the scent and reading the ingredients list, I'm not overly content with it's naturalness.  It has been in the shower for a while and my partner and I have gone back to using our standard shampoos.  We put it in the kids shower and it still doesn't appear to be used.  I did seem to clean well although I never cared for the conditioner, it felt like I couldn't get any of it off my hair.  It's just OK.

title: Not a Big Difference in Appearance, Harder to Put on Than Pencil Filler
text:
My partner has occasionally used a brow pencil and we thought this might be a good alternative. She found it harder to apply than the pencil and prefers the pencil to the little brush this one comes with. She found it a little clumsy to apply with the brush and took a while to get it to spread evenly. The color matched her brows very well, perhaps so well that the results were a little hard to notice.

To be honest, when all was said and done, it made so little difference and seemed so futzy that I prefer her natural look.

title: Great Detangler, Small Bottle
text:
My partner really loved the way this hair detangler worked and smelled. She has fine straight hair that gets pretty snarled every night. She said that this is one of the few detanglers she has ever found that not just works well, but has an adult scent that she likes. Apparently most detanglers are for children and come in children's scents. But she has a couple of issues with it. First, since she uses it everyday and this is a rather small bottle she would burn through one a month. Second, Garnier is a part of Loreal which has been historically a big animal tester and that is a little unnerving and in this market, you can find good products that do not test on animals. But if it were not for the animal testing and the size/price of the bottle, she said this would be on her reorder list.

Perhaps Garnier can confirm if this product was involved in animal testing. I don't see any cruelty free labeling.

title: Looked Great, Applied Very Well, and Lasted the Whole Evening
text:
This eyeliner pencil did everything my partner was hoping for. The brown we got worked very well with her and was a nice darker shade. We had read a few reviews that said it was hard to put on and the pigment pulled on application. We did not find that and it seemed pretty typical of most pencils she has ever used.

The proof was in the pudding and she looked beautiful with it on. She reports that it stayed on well, better than her lipstick, on our night out. No irritation, all in all a great product.

title: It works well and it well built
text:
We weren't really sure what to expect from his. My partner has straight long hair that occasionally gets unruly, especially if napping or during flights. She got this for business trips so she could touch up and the results are great. In our pre-trip tests she has gone from frizzy to lustrous and flat in almost not time. I'm a little concerned about the effects of heat on her hair but she shouldn't have to use it that often so it should be good, and she has it no where near the maximum setting.

She said the great things about it are the large surface areas and the fact that it remembered her last temperature when she couldn't. It feels well built and has a little heft to it. It definitely feels like it will be around for a while and not soon to be broken. So it's made fine, but I love it for how beautiful it makes her hair look. Well done Revlon.

title: Everything I like about Irish Spring, but gentler
text:
I have used Irish Spring products off and on most of my adult life. Often it is driven by low costs for large bricks of bars. I perceive the scent as harshly strong and lasting. This differs in that it does not seem so harsh, in fact the whole product seems to have the had its edginess removed. Add Shea butter and you have a soft, moisturizing and properly scented product. I also get a sense that my go too Irish Spring bar soap is a little harsh on skin and this is the exact opposite.

I'm not knocking Irish Spring, but this product seems a step above my usual experience with the brand, but maintaining the low prices. I think I have a new go to body wash for the shower.

title: Pricey but Effective
text:
Products like these always make me think about the law of diminishing returns. A $25 lotion is almost always noticeably better than a $1.99 lotion, but the difference from $25 to $100 is usually not that big. So I'm not surprised that this is a nice lotion that proved to be light and effective, but perhaps not worth the extra $75 a bottle.

Also, and maybe this is its thing, but the packaging is kind of baffling. It uses a little spoon to pull a small amount of a rather inefficient bottle. In one way, it is good that you can only get a small amount out of the bottle with the little spoon, but it seems like a clumsy way to dispense the lotion. I can only think that this is a Erno tradition. But why not a wide mouthed circular bottle for easy access?

My partner did really like the performance of the lotion. I like the SPF, she liked that it seemed to absorb into her skin and leave it soft and moisturized. But again, I have to think you can get this performance at a fraction of the price. Otherwise we really liked this product.

title: Bold Colors
text:
This was a surprisingly bold color, it does not subtly enhance lip color, it boldly makes a statement. The matte surface is also different from anything else my partner uses, and I kind of like that. However since she rarely uses much makeup, "Cruel Ruby" was a shock. But less shocking than the other colors currently listed on Amazon. They seem a little Avante Garde.

She says that it applies well and is everything she would expect from a decent lipstick. It wore well and she was intrigued by how matte the finish was. We wore it out to the movies and snacking on popcorn definitely took some of the color off so it might need to be reapplied at more of an evening function. I thought it was strikingly bold on her, but she didn't think she would wear the shade often.

title: Feels like Power Was Traded for Quietness and Light Weight.
text:
This driver is definitely quieter than any I have ever had, but it is seems to come to that at a price. This dryer definitely does not push as much air as my older dryer and that is kind of a painful trade off. Same thing about weight, while it is lighter it feels a little bulky and unwieldy and sometimes weight gives a sense of quality and power. This feeling is lacking with this dryer.

It is not a bad dryer and it does work. I do appreciate how quiet it is, I just feel that there have been a few too many trade offs to truly love this dryer.

title: A Luxurious Hair Brush for $5
text:
Sometimes it is hard to truly love a low price utilitarian item, but these inexpensive brushes are super nice. The handle is thick and ergonomic and feel good in the hand. There is even a little thumb tab molded into the handle that helps control the brush through strokes that is missing from our old brushes. The bristles are short and densly packed which helps get through snarls and feel like they massage the scalp.

It gives a pretty luxurious experience for a $5 hair brush.

title: Expensive but jury is still out on effectiveness
text: My partner has been using this and I actually think there are fewer smile lines around her eyes.  She thinks there is no noticeable difference after a week but says she is still hopeful. She likes the scent and feels that it is pleasant.  She also likes the dispenser that dispenses small amounts of product, which is good at over $100 a bottle.  It does a leave her skin a little greasy - her description not mine. She started beautiful and still is.

title: Hmm...Might Need Some More Time on the Drawing Board
text:
Well I can see what they were trying for here, and it is an interesting concept. However it only worked okay on long strands and not so good at the roots. Also, it seems like the design doesn't have the oomph that our other Hair Dryers have. I think this idea of drying longer hair by drying from both sides might work, but it needs more heat and air and it needs to be better at getting to the roots. Perhaps if it could blow both inwardly and outward like a standard hair dryer to the get to the roots.

Otherwise it feels ok, but it seems to specialized. And that specialization is not a big enough step to overcome a conventional hair dryer. Lets see what 2.0 brings for this product but right now it is not a improvement over our existing dryers.

title: Leaves Face Soft and Smooth and Clean
text:
This is kind of interesting stuff. It doesn't feel like a face wash because it goes on more like a lotion than a soap. There is no lather, and there is moisturizing. I'm not really sure what this is.

But for not knowing what it is, I can find a lot of pros. It has a nice scent that does not linger too long, but is nice to put on. It is like a wonderfully mild cologne. I'm also impressed how little you need to use, just a dab will cover your face very well. Also, it is moisturizing and makes my skin feel soft. And I guess I can say that my face feels clean. But I don't know that I will continue purchasing it after this tube runs out. Again, mostly because it doesn't fall into my soap spot on my shopping list. But that might change since it looks like I will be using it for months to come.

I don't know that I can say anything bad about this product. I like it and it does make my face feel soft and smooth.

title: A Great Engaging Kit
text:
Our daughter and friends have made bath fizz bombs from scratch using whatever they could find for forms. So they were familiar with these when it came in the mail. And by chance they arrived on the first day of NEA break, so it was fantastic that they were able to be absorbed in a project this and basically need no help (ages 10 through 12.) It works for our tweens very well and it had them completely engaged during the creation and they like to use them and gift them later.

We really like creative kits and this one is great in that it is engaging, easy to do unsupervised for tweens, and most of all, it has a useful and consumable end product. Love this set

title: Great Guest or Gift Soap
text:
This is a wonderfully scented, wonderfully designed gift or guest room soap. We have come to love Shea butter and Pre de Provence soaps in general. This one came in a small cellophane gift bag with a small silver bow which made it ready for gifting. It is elegant and decently sized, fitting in the hand a little under baseball sized.

We have put this one out in our guest bath and it does have a pleasant floral scent.

title: A very nice soap, Wonderfully scented.
text: Great bar soap, love the scent, love the lather, love the potential as a housewarming gift.  First the scent, I wish I could place it, it definitely brings back a sense of a snack food but I cannot for the life of me place it.  But it is wonderfully scented to just the right level.  It is not over or underwhelming, smells clean and perfect.  As for soapy lather, again, everything I would hope for in a soap.  Add a great label and this is perfect for gifting.

title: Love the Shea, Don't Love the Container
text:
We absolutely love the shea butter in this. This product works well as a moisturizer. The smell is a little strong. The lavender is nice and stress relieving, but people will notice that you are wearing it because of the scent. It does give a bit of a greasy feeling but it does soak in after a while. It does seem to give lasting moisturization once the greasiness fades.

I like that the container has a lot of cream, almost a lifetimes supply. But the container is so big it is hard to store and we are not even sure that we can get through the tub before it starts to go bad.

We like the product, but not in love with it.

title: Powerful Lip Balm in Hipster Packaging
text:
This has proven to be an amazingly powerful lip balm which should be tested with the oncoming Minnesota winter. It is a small package at a premium price, and although I am impressed with the moisturizing it provides, it is a not clear that the improvement over chapstick is worth the price. It is a small amount in a somewhat wide cardboard applicator. The chapstick tubes seem to be sized better for application on lips. I do like the mix of oils, the taste is pleasant, kind of a vanilla lemon.

Granted this can be applied beyond the lips, but we have many, much more cost effective products for that. And where the tube is wide for applying to lips, it is small for applying pretty much anywhere else.

So products works well, but dispenser may need some retooling and value for price is a little stretch for us.

title: Love the tin and Shea in the mix
text: We love the playfully illustrated tins.  They were immediately claimed as keepsake boxes by our kids and makes the soap a great house warming gift etcetera.  The soap itself has a strong but clean smelling scent and we love both the addition of Shea and the lack of animal testing by the company.  The lather was good and the shea makes it moisturizing so it feels clean and smoothing.  All in all a very good soap.

title: Great Scents, Great Shea Moisturizing
text:
A Ghanan friend of mine turned me on to Shea Butter years ago. She imported artisan soap bars made from villagers and sold in her shop. I was quickly sold on the moisturizing it brings immediately. This soap has all the benefits of Shea combined with a wonderful scent (I tried mint leaf and sage, both which were wonderful.)

This soap lathers well and is perfect for guest baths or every day soap if you want to treat yourself. We have tried several brands and these are among the top.

title: Hmm...Interesting, But...
text: We used this in a spa day and it was good for an experience, and it did seem to moisturize, but so does a decent lotion. We can't say that it's a bad product but we can say that it is a ridiculous product. It applies easily and it was somewhat entertaining.  But the mask is just too much fuss for the results. We got a reviewer sample and it is probably not going onto our to be purchased list.

title: Good Soap, Good Scent, Good Price
text:
I was torn to give this four or five stars. It is hard to love a soap, but this has it all I guess. It has a nice clean crisp scent, it works well, and it has a decent price point. For $3 it is a great refill. We actually used it to refill a couple of Green Apple scented, disposeable foaming bottles. I like that we can refill and reuse the old bottles and the Pear is not too far from the apple smell.

The soap foamed well and like I said it does the job at a good price. I don't know that it's love, but it is everything I want to refill the kids' bathroom dispensers.

title: My hair did feel stripped of residue but I did not care for the strong scent at all
text:
I really could not get over the smell of this shampoo. It was strong and reminded me strongly of a flea soap we used on our dog when I was a kid. The smell is strong enough that it lingered on my hands and hair for most of the day. But I do have to admit, I noted a definite difference in my hair. It seemed cleaner and subtle but not different from other more pallettable shampoos.

Also, this leaked quite a bit in shipping. I would have liked to see a better seal for something that would be shipped individually. A foil seal would be best, but something needs to be done to make it a better sealing packaging.

title: Natural, cruelty free, wonderfully scented, richly lathering, fantastic
text:
Easily the best compliment we can give a beauty product sample is to add it to our shopping list and this exfoliating scrub is definitely on our Amazon shopping list. My partner loves it and lit up when I asked it how it was.

First, there is a foil seal on the cap so it will not leak during shipping. Seems small, but we have gotten lots of shampoos etcetera that have leaked during shipping. It has a nice non chalky texture (which she explained by showing me how an Aveda product felt.) It comes out of the tube rich and creamy. The exfoliate grit is made from recycled nut shells and is rather subtle when compared to the Aveda product. The scent is wonderfully floral and citrusy. It lathers well and has a rich feel.

I think she would give it 10 stars if possible and when told it was about $14 a tube she pointed out that that is a good price for a high quality scrub and right in line with her normal Aveda products. She has put it on her wish list and will be ordering it in the future.

And one more great fact, they use as many organic, sustainable products as possible. It is labled cruelty free which is always good to look for. We love it.

title: Decent But Over Priced
text:
My partner tried this product and was very happy with it until I told her the price. She thought the compact with mirror was nice with it's mirror and triple separated colors. The compact is smallish with a nice elegant styling. It seemed to have made it through shipping without issue and the powders were still intact and in place.

She found that she liked two of the colors and said that they went on fine although she wish it came with it's own applicator. She did not care for the lightest color which I assume is for a highlight. All in all she said it was decent cosmetics.

Until she got to the price, at which point she said that this set is fine for a much less expensive product, but this is kind of marginal for such a premium price. She said she does get better powders at a much lower price and much better products at this price point. It really turned her opinion of the product when she found it was near $70 for this compact.

title: Painless!  No snagging hairs like a Rotary.
text:
I have tried a couple nose hair trimmer solutions and this one is imperfect, but toward the top of the heap. By far the best thing this thing has going for it, is that it does not pull the hairs like a rotary trimmer. It is relatively painless and easy to handle. The straight cutting edge works fairly well in the nose as well as being able to trim other areas. However, I found it a little unwieldy and I was not able to trim extremely close to the skin. This is not uncommon with nose trimmers (other than rotary ones that yank half the hairs out at the root -- Ow!)

Size and price were good, functionality was good. I think there is a better solution out there, but right now, this is my go to trimmer until someone comes out with a better solution.

title: Whoops Missed Color, but otherwise decent
text:
Unfortunately, we missed the correct skin tone on this one and it ended up a little too dark. It ended up making darker circles under the eyes. That is unfortunately because it was easy to put on, it did seem to hydrate and soften the eyes. Might have to buy a lighter shad and give it a better test. My partner loved the lipstick applicator which made application easy. It was not thick and was a effective concealer.

Just wish the skin tone match had been spot on, but that is not the fault of the product but more out eye.

title: A Decent Shampoo, rich lather and sweet aroma
text: This is a very nice shampoo. I love the sweet scent and rich lather.  Turns out the kids did too and they took it to be their main shampoo.  It definitely left my hair feeling clean although I don't know that it gave more volume, but I tend to use products to maximize my curls.  Kid's hair looked clean and all in all, it seems like a decent shampoo.

title: Well Engineered, but Expensive
text:
This is a little gimmicky, kind of like the perfect mouse trap, but solving the making a better bar of soap dilemna. Third world problems... But I have to admit that this is kind of a nice little product. The pouch does dispense soap and suds well while the exfoliating pad on the back side is some kind of tactile miracle. To the touch it is smooth, but when run accrossed you body, it somehow grows teeth and does a decent job of exfoliating.

The design is actually pretty good. It is well sized for the hand. It fits in the shower fine. All in all a well engineered product. The scent is pretty floral and decently strong to cover soiled bodies. Definitely overpriced when considering that this is just a glorified bar of soap. $20 for 30 uses compares poorly to $1.89 for 5 months of soap bars and a washcloth.

title: Stings on application, did not seem overly effective at moisturizing
text: I got this for my partner to test out as she is always looking for the best moisturizer.  She did not like this for several reasons, but the strongest was that the scent was too strong and it has a stinging, tingling feeling when applied.  She didn't care for the application of this product and was not overwhelmed by the moisturizing effect. She will probably finish the bottle but will not buy it again.

title: A Very Decent Beard Trimmer
text:
This is a very nicely designed and functional beard trimmer. I have gone through a number of these, often picking up the cheapest possible on a trip and finding they fail fairly regularly. I have found that paying a moderate amount gets you a much better trimmer and this seems to be the case here. This is not an expensive trimmer, but it is heads and shoulders above the $20 trimmers. This is a decently solid trimmer.

I think I'm rougher on these through neglect rather than over use, but this really seems like it will hold up well. It feels good in the hand and cuts well. I'm not sure why, but for some reason, this gets to my mustache directly under my nose better than most, must be the shape of the guard. The guard itself is easily set and glides well.

I don't use the wet dry at all, but did appreciate that I could rinse the device.

Perhaps the worst thing about the trimmer is the charger. It plugs directly into the socket without a cord and you place the trimmer into it. This leaves it in clear view. I had run electric to my closet to charge devices out of sight, but this charger does not fit between the shelves when plugged in. I would need to put in an extension. Perhaps this will not be an issue with others.

title: This has proven to be a wonderful hand treatment
text:
This has proven to be a wonderful hand treatment. It has a surprisingly abrasive quality to it. It cleanses the hands and leaves them moist with a short lived slight greasiness. It made my partners hands supple and wonderfully scented. She has beautiful hands to begin with and this just left them that much more attractive.

I do have to say that the scrub has a rather unappealing appearance. It was kind of a gross yellowish gel, but otherwise it is fantastic and does a great job of leaving your hands moisturized and clean.

title: A Really Good Spray on Sun Screen
text:
Our kids, like most kids are not big fans of putting on sunscreen, but the spray makes it far more pallettable for them. We use a lot and have tested this (November is not the best test of course) and it sprays on clean with a decent scent. 30 SPF could be a bit stronger but with reapplication it should be fine.

I don't trust "sweat and waterproof" as I have seen the spray on fail to completely protect after swimming. But for scent, cost and ease of use, this is one of the best deals I have seen.

title: Overall a Decent Conditioner
text:
The bottom line is that this conditioner works how I would expect any conditioner to work. It does give a clean, soft feeling to my and my partners hair. The cost is decent and I would feel fine getting this as our household conditioner, but I guess I am not completely won over. When applying the scent seems a little overwhelming although not horrible. The scent does tame down a lot after applied and rinsed and seems fine.

Definitely a good conditioner.

title: Great soft curls, my partner loves it
text:
My partner likes my hair in ringlets, and she is amazed at what this stuff did for my curls. Well that and she applied it and put in a bunch of extra twists, but it definitely formed soft ringlets without any crunchiness. It is pretty darn good. Although she raves about it and that's all that matters.

It has a pleasant scent and comes out in a soft lotion like consistency. It dried with the same speed as always and has a strong but soft curl. Great product.

title: Maybe I got a bum product
text:
Maybe I got a bum product, but we really can't say anything good about this product. Even from the start, it was difficult to get it out of the package. then you are left with a tall, skinny bottle that seems designed for tipping and spilling. We shoot the dickens out of the bottle and it was still watery thin. We shook it again to the point of ridiculousness and still watery. Each time we tried to apply it, it would run down the edges of the nail and bleed every where. When we finally got something of a base layer on, the color was a little along the lines of bruised finger nail.

I really think we got a bum sample so I'll put our experience out there and let customers see if it's a trend.

title: She has been very happy with the way the product work and would give ...
text:
I got this for my partner because it has her colors in it. She has been very happy with the way the product work and would give it five stars except for the packaging. The best thing, besides the color is that there is a built in mirror in the reflective material of the lid. Both the top and bottom work as great mirrors. The mirror in the inside is ingenious, The mirror on the outside unfortunately almost instantly collects finger prints and looks messy quickly.

The other big issue with this compact is that it does not come with an applicator. Nor does it have a place to store one if you had an extra to put with it. So that makes me wonder if the built in mirror that is brilliant is meant for mobile use, or if the lack of an applicator means it should be used in a stationary location where applicators would be available. It doesn't seem to fit either perfectly.

As for the product. my partner immediately put it on and we went out to eat and she looked great as we left as well as after we returned. The product seem great.

title: Decent Moisturizer, I Like the Sun Screenesque scent
text:
The Coconut oil gives this moisturizer a strong hint of sun tan lotion. But it is a pleasant scent that fades. It does soften and smooth skin and makes my partners arms wonderfully touchable. She believes that it leaves a sticky residue, but I cannot detect it a short time after she applies it. She did say she plans on using it all and will probably order more, so it passed the test.

From my perspective, it does make her skin soft and smooth so I think it's a winner.

title: Cute Packaging, Decent Toe Nail Polish
text: Love the playful bottles.  My partner put the polish on with the protective over covering and it lasted an open-toed weekend in Portland.  The worst thing about this is the applicator brush is very wide which makes precise application a little difficult.  Good thing is the protective polish that lets the polish stay on better and longer.  The color was a rich red and we were pleased with it.  All in all a decent Nail Polish.

title: Good Conditioner, Not so Good Container
text:
I love the smell of this conditioner, it has a warm smell of bees wax candles and gives a great but somewhat oily feel you to your hair. Both I and my partner used it and like the results. The only bad thing thing I can say about it is that the fat, wide mouthed jar is both too wide for any of our shower shelves and awkward to handle in the shower since you need to hold it in one hand, remove the lid with the other, find a place to put the lid, then scoop some of the product out. All while trying not to fill the jar with shower water. Not a huge thing, but annoying none the less.

Other wise this is a very decent conditioner with a very much above average scent.

title: Bottom line: the kids had fun
text:
We have given other lip balm kits away as gifts in the past and the have been universally loved, so this was our turn to try it. Our youngest two were psyched to try in out and we worked with them to get all the ingredients. I understand not wanting to include olive oil in the box, but was surprised that there were to flavored. We only had a mint concentrate to use, so that is the only flavor we have.

The kids had fun. The kit was spare, but I guess a large part of this is the experience. For experience it was a bargain, for a kit it was a little wanting.

The end product was not as solid as Chapstick but worked well enough. The containers seem treasured and they are packed for school tomorrow, so the excitement continues.

title: Good Scent, Seems to be Working to keep Skin Soft and Moisturized, will have to see what Summer brings
text:
My partner has issues with deep cracks on her feet during the summer when she walks barefoot a lot. We are trying to get ahead of it this year so we have tried a couple things from vaseline in socks over night to this Balm. This one seems to be as good as anything we've tried and there are a couple things that I like about it. The price seems fair because a little seems to go a long ways, and the scent is pleasant. Like Cocoa Butter and it hasn't made any kind of mess.

It seems like it soaks in well although she did mention that it felt slick in the shower after she had applied it. I like the natural sounding ingredients like beeswax and lanolin, but question the chemically sounding substances. But it does seem to work to make her skin moist and supple. The proof will be in the pudding over the summer, but keeping fingers crossed.

title: Decent Floral Scent, Surprisingly not as Bold as We Expected
text:
We were a little surprised to find such a conservatively understated floral scent in such a jazzed up container. Juicy Couture sounds youthfully edgy, and the scent is rather mildly floral. It's a decent scent, but I found it almost generic. Especially when juxtaposed to such a glitzy bottle. It almost seems like an entry level perfume for tweens.

But I don't want to knock it, just show my surprise for it's seemingly understated fragrance. It is a decent floral perfume.

title: Subtle and Natural Looking
text:
This is not what we thought we were going to get, but it's OK. We thought this was just blush but it is a different product. This ended up being much more of a foundation product. We found it a little confusing for a few reasons. First, expecting blush we were confused with the gel consistency of the Matte foundation. The instructions are very clear and we applied it by finger and it is a very subtle foundation that fills pours and removes shininess.

The pink side is another confusion. It should be used to create a dewy effect. We are not sure what that means, or if that is even something you would want. But even thought the Matte is a tan and the dewy side is a bright pink, both blended into fair skin tones rather well, leaving a nice non-shiny subtle skin tone.

It wasn't at all what we were expecting, but we like the subtle smoothing it leaves, and you can apply makeup over it. I like that it keeps the natural beauty of my partner.

title: Great Cream, Cheap Pump
text:
We were very happy about how well packed this came. Amazon even took the precaution of putting it in a plastic bag. Then we were impressed that it had a locking pump for safe travel. But then we realized the pump would not work at all which is a little disappointing.

The cream though is great. It Ina's a subtle scent that my partner said reminded her of pannenkuchen. Which was from the apple and faint lotion smell. She said it is one of the best smelling eye creams she's ever used. It applied well, not oily and seems to have soaked in well. Will watch for long term results.

The only bad thing about the product is that we have to kind of spoon it out of the bottle with the pump tube. We do wish the pump worked.

title: Despite Initial Doubts, It's OK
text: I was a little taken aback by this product because of the runniness.  I am used to gels and was surprised by it's more liquid feel.  I was skeptical when applying it to wet hair, but I am pretty happy of how it ringleted my hair.  It did seem a little crunchier than some products I have been using and it has something of a strong scent when applying, but it did the job.  Don't think I'll swap from my usual hair gels, but it is OK.

title: Good Lather and Clean Scent, Get it in a bigger container
text:
In general, I really liked this product. It lathered well, it rinsed well, and it had a subtle scent that seemed a little perfumed but manly enough. The main drawback is that it is a small bottle, especially if it is both shampoo and body wash. To be honest, I'd be surprised if it makes it more than a couple more weeks. The product is great, just wished it came in a 20 ounce bottle.

Pros
+ Great Lather
+ Subtle, Pleasant Scent
+ Clean Feeling after rinsing

Cons
- Small Bottle, it won't last long

title: A Very Nice Clean and Crisp Scent
text:
My partner and I really liked this fragrance. It is crisp and light was subtle enough that she didn't pick up on it or mention it when I wore it out. She just said you smell nice like you always do. Which is what I like about it. It is not loud and call itself out.

Initially I thought it was a very simple scent that was heavy on the high notes, but after a little while the lower range came out a little bit. It has a pleasant aroma and for me anyway seems to lack a musk to make it more complex. We like it a lot despite or maybe because of this lack of complexity.

As for the container, it is clean, sprays well and have a nice classy and useful shape. It sits well in the cabinet, not tippy and classy looking.

title: Fine, But not sure that it helps lenghten tan
text:
We have the entire set from pre-wash to extender and this seems to be the least worthwhile. It is hard to tell if it extended the tan at all and feel the least organic in a trio of obviously not organic products.

We appreciate the Natural Glow Tan line since we live in Minnesota and it gives my partner a healthy glow mid winter in a state where everyone is pretty pasty come February. The Tan does have a nice natural tone to it, so I support the product. We just couldn't tell if this product actually extends its life. It seems a little gimmicky.

As for the product itself, it is highly fragrant, and a little thick. It feels greasy on application but quickly goes away. I guess it's less offensive than it is gimmicky.

title: Oof...Parabans, Otherwise Decent
text:
After reading about Parabans, I've been on the lookout for them. I did not see them in the description and trusted the name Neutrogena and the term Healthy when I ordered these. I was a little disappointed to find them in the ingredients on the bottle. Which is a shame since I really liked the product otherwise. The aroma was pleasant and not overly heavy. It rinse off well and left a clean but somewhat taut feeling to my skin.

The only other really issue I had to with the pump which is not working well on mine. Perhaps I just got a bum pump.

title: A nicer, gentler Head and Shoulders
text:
Head & Shoulders was my default shampoo for years. It wasn't until the last couple of years where I found a few other shampoos that seem as effective and feel better as a shampoo. Notably Dove's anti dandruff shampoo. This Head & Shoulders seems to move a little more toward the Dove product.

I was surprised that this shampoo very openly has an aroma. Usually the aroma seems very utilitarian, and for this product it seems more aimed for appreciation. This shampoo seems much more a hair product than an industrial solution to dandruff that the classic product seems. It still has the same feel and lack of lather that I remember, but I guess the fact is, it is effective and for that I like this product.

title: A Very Good Conditioner with a Sharp Clean Scent
text: I particulary like the crisp clean smell of this conditioner.  The lemony smell is subtly sharp and combines with the basil to make a nice refreshing aroma.  Otherwise, it does everything I'm looking for in a conditioner.  My hair feels supple, healthy and clean and it does not effect the curliness of my hair when I apply gel.  All in all I really like this conditioner, but the scent is my favorite part.

title: A Decent Cleanser, But Perhaps a Little Too Strong for my Facial Skin
text:
OK, I have to admit that I have near blind faith in Neutrogena based on its brand, so I was very happy to receive a reviewer sample. It appears to be as high quality as I would expect but I'm not entirely sure how this should be used. It feels a little strong for facial use, and I am not a believer that all that tingles is working to your good. I found that it gave me a good clean feel to my face, but caused a little redness. I liked it far better on shoulders and arms.

The cleanser is fairly thick and leaves a slightly oily, moisturized softness to my skin. The Aroma is fairly strong and not overly pleasant but not too bad.

title: Having problems getting past the odor
text:
First of all, this appears to be a good product in all ways except one. (Okay, maybe two, the tamper proof cover was hard to get off, and then a big chunk of the product sticks to it, but that is minor). The cream is smooth and glides on nice, absorbs well and does not leave a greasy feeling. We can't tell that lines are disappearing, but it is not causing any bad reactions. Except for that one.

My partner describes the odor as old woman perfume trying to hide the smell of fish. I don't know that I sense the fishiness, but I am not fond of the scent. The cream seems good otherwise so it will get used, but the smell just isn't overly appealing. So decent product except for the smell.

title: A Decent Antiperspirant
text:
This has proven to be strong antiperspirant with a nice clean, crisp smell. I've been very happy with it and it seems to be long lasting. Perhaps the biggest compliment for how good it was, was the fact that my son took it for his own. Kinda would like it back.

I actually got this both in stick and gel, I have to admit I like the stick better. My gel got knocked off the counter and the cap cracked on the floor, spreading gel across the tile and leaving a cap that will not really fit again. It also seems to have broken the turning wheel so it is hard to get more gel to come out. Would be nice if the cap were not so brittle.

title: A Very Decent Sun Screen
text:
I really like this Sun Screen because it is so light on the skin, that it is easy to forget you have it on. Unfortunately, being winter it's hard to test this fully, but I did put it on for cross country skiing and love that it did not have a heavy oily feel. It goes on clean and for the sunny, snow reflecting day I spent skiing, it seemed to work fine.

I am looking forward to testing it at the pool this summer, but if it is as water resistant as it claims...this self confessed SunScreenaphobe may have found his new solution.

title: Gentle Soap with a Great Supple Smell
text:
I've been using this soap for several weeks now and I am very happy with it. I like that the apple smell is subtle and pleasant. It is definitely not over powering and I've had a couple guests mention that they liked it.

This is my first foray into foaming hand soap an may never go back to bar soap at the bathroom sinks again. It is gentle, easy to dispense and far less mess than bars. I recommend this to anyone thinking about getting a hand soap.

title: Hands Down the Best Clipper I have Owned
text:
I've gone through a number of beard clippers in the last few year. Admittedly they were all cheap and you get what you pay for, but this one just exudes quality. The clipper have a great feel in the hand and has an understated buzz for the way it powers through my beard.

I also love the power base that this comes with. Much better than the charging cords of the others I have owned. The guides work well although you need to press a couple of releases on the guide to change between modes 1-3,4-5, and 6-9. I've seen better solutions but the guides stay steady and like I said, it powers through hair easily.

I also have used it to clean up my neck and sideburns between haircuts, and again it performs admirably. Its list price is higher than any trimmer I have bought in the past, but you get what you pay for, and this is a quality device.

title: A Really Good Shampoo
text:
I may not be the most particular shampoo user but I am looking for a number of things. Effective Dandruff protection, clean feel, decent smell, and cheap price. This shampoo wins on all of these things. I have used it for a couple of weeks with no sign of dandruff despite the fact that it seems to be a gentle shampoo. It is not as thick as many other antidandruff shampoos and gives a great lather with a pleasant and rather understated aroma.

I'm impressed with this shampoo.

title: A Great Conditioner
text:
I love the clean, tropical scent of this conditioner. In my mind I thought it smelled coconutty, but I have now been told that is not actually coconut. But it was agreed that it was a very pleasant scent. The conditioner left my hair soft and looking good. I have paired it with [[ASIN:B000GCY224 Dove Advanced Care Color Repair Therapy Shampoo for Colored or Highlighted Hair, 12 Ounce]]and I'm very happy with their performance.

Definitely will consider buying again.

title: A Decent, but fairly basic trimmer
text:
I guess I got what I was hoping for and what you would expect from Philips for the Price. It is a decent product that did a good job of trimming my beard but with few whistles and bells.

I was hoping to get a trimmer for my travel bag and it fills that role perfectly, well except that it would have been nice if it came in a small travel bag or container. The construction is pretty good. It worked well right out of the box (corded) for the initial trim and then a few days later it worked well again on battery power. I did like the rotary setting for the guard height, and found that the guide goes higher than my other trimmer which is a nice plus. I am very happy to have it for my travel trimmer but it feels like it could stand up to fairly regular usage.

I feel like I'm giving it an underwhelming review, it's not anything to pull out and show the friends, but it does the job. For the price point, a very decent trimmer.

title: A Very Decent Grooming Kit
text:
I had a little dynamo of a nose hair trimmer that I lost a few years ago and was looking to get a replacement. This package seemed perfect, and for the most part it is. The nose/ear trimmer pulls the hair out a little more than I remember but it serves its function fine. The two trimmer attachments are actually very nice (my old one did not have these.) They function well and I quickly cleaned up neck hair missed by a barber. They seem to work very well for small touch ups.

Where I was a little less than excited was in what it lacked. Since it is a multiple attachment trimmer, it would have been nice to have a small travel bad to hold them together. Which seems reasonable to ask for at over $20. Also they went a little too cheap on the cleaning brush. The cleaning brush is less than 1/4 inch across and virtually useless.

Pros:

. I like that it uses a single AA battery.
. the different cutters interchange quickly.
. Compact.

Cons:

. The cleaning brush is so small and cheap to be almost useless.
. Nose trimmer is not painless.
. No travel bag.

text: I am a natural brunette and get my hair highlighted aka stripped to a blond shade every 6 weeks. text:

text: I loved this product. Everything from the price to the application (a little goes a long way, goes on very thin and very light feeling. title: Bronzer Stick, Golden Shimmer - 0.3 Ounce Burt's Bees All Aglow
text: I live in Oregon where it rain more than it is sunny, I am Irish and very pale. I thought Golden Shimmer was perfect for me, I applied once and got nothing to show for it. I applied 10 more strokes. It didn't "instantly illuminate".  No "sun-kissed glow".  It feels great on my cheeks and where I applied feels nicely moisturized. Looking a bit closer at the marketing on the product page, I've come to the conclusion that this product is designed for people who already have a tan or a darker complexion and are looking to add a 'pop' to their natural color. I think I can utilize this as an addition to my regular routine of foundation and blush by using it as a top coat, much like I do with lip gloss being a topcoat to lipstick.

title: “Snail Secretion Filtrate” Biopelle Tensage Intensive Serum 50, 10 ct.
text:
It really works! I used every day, twice a day for 5 days and my 50 year old skin is noticeably smoother and softer. The packaging is attractive. The tubes took a moment to figure out how they work. My mother once told me, decades ago, she could always depend on Maybelline (she also was known to enjoy spending an afternoon at Elizabeth Arden NYC). This one just isn't for the dash and go gal that I am. I get enough volume already from their other products without the 3 step process that takes time.

'Glycation' is a function of your body when sugars attach to proteins, one result being the drying of your skin called Avanced Glycation End products, (AGEs).

MEG 21 uses their Supplamine ingredient (which is a combination of an amino sugar, N-Methyl-D-Glucamine, also called megulamine, and an amino acid arginine) to reduce the effect of AGE and was developed by Dynamis Skin Science which is a sister company of Dynamis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (founded in 1997) which is a biopharma company that is developing proprietary small molecule drugs to treat chronic inflammatory diseases. Its proprietary drug candidates inhibit a novel enzymatic pathway that causes the formation of a highly reactive sugar, 3-deoxyglucosone, that stimulates the production of Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs), oxidative stress and a cascade of inflammatory cytokines.

title: Different
text:
To protect my skin against dehydration. Adding an additional step to keep my 50 year old complexion looking healthy. Using this twice a day, morning and evening. I wash my face, and before I use a day lotion or night cream I use this (have been using for over a month now), then apply lotion or cream. I never had oily skin even as a teenager. The oil has not caused me to break out but I can't say it won't for other skin types (I am also fair skinned - Irish).

Mornings after washing or showering I apply 2 to 5 drops of oil on my skin and allow it to absorb before using a light facial moisturizer.

In the evening after removing makeup, I place 4 or 5 drops in my palm, rub my hands together and spread the oil on my forehead, cheeks and neck, then apply night cream.

I love the way my complexion looks.

title: Consistant, gradual tanning product that works, and for the price you can't do better
text:
Using on my legs, chest and arms. Follow these steps and you will have the results you are looking for and less chance of skin cancer that tanning in the sun can give you. Just don't expect the tan to look like you just came off a weeks vacation at the beach, you will look better than your pallid current self, but no product can give you a fabulous tan better than the beach.
> Exfoliate before application. Remove dead layer of skin in the shower using a body scrub, including knees and elbows.
> Moisturize daily, immediately after your shower forgetting this step probably will result blotchy coloring.
> Don'T apply in your steamy bathroom, or when you are warm from the shower/bath, or when perspiring, the self tanner will streak.
> Don't rush, focus and don't get distracted.
> Lightly apply to knees, ankles and elbows - these areas tend to concentrate the tanner and will look darker if you don't use less.
> Wash your hands ASAP!!! Using a moisturized makeup sponge is always an option.
> Don't put on clothes or sit/lie down for at least 20 minutes!! Phone a friend.

It really lays the hair down and makes it smooth. I have several brushes, but none work like this when it comes to smoothing. The handle gets a bit slippery when you're working with gel. You can solve this problem by wrapping a paper towel around it for some traction. Also, you can't beat the price for the quality of this brush. I'd definitely buy it again.

title: At-Home Spa Experience
text: I've been wanting to try these tools after watching many skincare videos. I suffer from severe allergies, so my face is always a bit puffy. These tools really help with lymphatic drainage. The smaller end of the roller fits the undereye area perfectly. Both the roller and the Gua Sha tool have a pleasant weight and feel expensive. I like to leave this kit in my skincare fridge for a pleasant cooling effect. There's a handy instruction guide to show you how best to use the tools. As a tip, make sure your face has some type of oil or serum on it to provide enough slip for the tools. You may want to do this as the last step in your routine to ensure thst your products are properky absorbed. Also, the tools so pretty that you just want to leave them out for display. The box itself is beautiful enough to make a great gift. If you're a skincare addict, you'll definitely want to add this to your arsenal.

title: Amazing Bargain

This one is a great beginner set. The brushes are super soft and feel nice in my hand. They have a weird smell when you first open the package. Just let them air out for a couple hours before use.

title: Hands-Down Best!!!!
text: I've been searching for years to find the right product to cover the white hairs that crop up along my hairline. I have naturally curly hair that I need to wet to style. That's a problem with many of these products. This one goes on very easily, covers completely and barely rubs off at all. I kind of glide the crayon's side (not the tip) along my hairline. I wear a scarf at night and I just barely see the product on it in the morning. It's not like other products I've used where it completely stains the scarf. I highly recommend this and wish I had discovered it sooner.

title: One of my favorites
text: I have several PTR masks. This is one of my favorites. First off, it smells like pie. Next, it really does a great job of exfoliating and resurfacing your skin to give you that glow everyone craves. I use it more frequently in the winter. I use it with a facial steamer to get the best results. This mask is definitely a staple in my skin care routine.

title: Perfect for Beginners
text: I love making custom perfumes. These bottles are pretty, easy to assemble (and refill), and even come with cute labels. I haven't experienced any leakage. I'm even keeping the box they came in because the bottles store so nicely in the Styrofoam organizer that came with it. I will definitely be purchasing these again. You really can't beat the price for all that you get with this kit.

title: A Must for Masking
text: I love masking! I do it at least twice/week. I decided to take it to the next level by incorporating steam. This was the perfect buy for me. It takes a little while for the steam to get going full force, but it's pretty powerful once it does. It's really important to thoroughly read the instructions. Only use distilled water. Don't put the steam too close to your face. Properly clean the unit after each use. I feel like I can have a spa-quality facial at home now. My skin is loving it!

title: Great for Perfume Making

title: Good Price by Comparison

I really like these. My only complaint is that the ends (the white caps) came loose after the first use. I would advise not rolling your hair near the ends snice it might get caught.

title: Masking Without Mess

It will remove nearly everything with very little effort. I only wish it had a pointy end to get into containers that aren't as wide as PTR masks.

title: Effective and Budget Friendly
text: After doing some research, I decided to purchase this product to help brighten my skin. I have oily skin that is prone to breakouts. I also deal with post-inflammation hyperpigmentation. I use this in conjunction with a treatment essence. I'm really pleased with the results. After a bit of trial and error, I've found that I don't need a moisturizer after using this. Also, it goes on a bit sticky, but that goes away when it's dry unless you use too much. I stick with two drops on my face and 1.5 drops on my neck.

title: Must Have for PIH
text: I'm a POC with oily acne-prone skin. Any inflammation leads to PIH (post-inflammation hyperpigmentation). It takes several weeks to heal. I watched one of Gothamista's videos and decided to give this a try. I started using it a week ago during an active hormonal breakout. I immediately noticed that my skin was healing faster than normal. Over the following days, I found that the spots that healed weren't nearly as brown as they would have been. I'm really excited to see how this product will work over time. I'm already very pleased with the results.

After I remove the rods, all I have to do is hold on to the ends of each section and shake it gently a few times. The curls separate beautifully and don't stick together like before. I also like that it evenly distributes product. This brush really is amazing.

title: Miracle Cream

After just two weeks, the calluses are nearly gone. I use the cream on my knees and elbows too. I don't think either has been soft since childhood. I've noticed that the cream has also helped with hyperpigmentation. I'm so glad I found this!

title: Fantastic Hair Growth Treatment

title: Do Not Use As Directed!!
text: I am giving this product 4 stars because it works great after some doctoring and a different approach. I first used it on wet hair post-shampoo. First off, it felt like putting lotion in my hair. It left my hair feeling awful and hard to comb. I was so disgusted that I almost threw it away. I then remembered that I can't afford to be wasteful and decided to make it work. I added 1/3 cup coconut oil and 1/4 cup olive oil. I applied the new mixture to dry hair in sections, covered it with a plastic cap, and left it in overnight. The next morning, I shampood as usual. My hair was very soft and I noticed that there was far less shedding when combing my wet hair. I think I've found my new go to DC.

It doesn't bleed. It goes on slightly sheer with one pass but if you go over your lips again, the coverage is opaque. It does remind me of the frosted pink lipstick of the eighties, which I wasn't going for.

I wanted to find a slightly pink nude, like a baby pink, and this is a bit to pearly for me. Bummer, because I was really excited to use it. It will go into the lipstick graveyard of tubes I don't use. :(
