Overall, this GLOW Beauty Bundle from Germany contains a nice assortment of skincare products, but I’m not sure a list price of $99 seems absolutely necessary. The individual product packaging has all been attractively designed, and the pink storage pouch is versatile and features smooth zipper construction, so the perceived value of this beauty set might just vary from person to person.

title: Glamorously Sleek and Comfortably Sized! 💗
text: I love the chic look of the coppery rose gold handles and hardware of this set, and the rose quartz pale pink roller head spins with silent precision! The eye cream applicator wand has a 360-degree rolling feature that applies the perfect amount of targeted pressure, and the T-shaped massage stick glides ergonomically across my skin with ease. I love that this boxed set also includes a soft drawstring storage bag and instruction booklet, and it seems to be reasonably priced, so I’d definitely gift this product to friends or order it again without hesitation!

title: Moisturizing Feel but I Don’t Care for the Scent
text: This night cream does absorb quickly, and it has a thinner consistency than other PM face lotions I’ve tried, but I haven’t been overly impressed with its performance, especially for the price. The blend of vitamins A, E, and hyaluronic acid in this cream do leave my face feeling moisturized, but I really don’t care for the scent of this formulation. It does dissipate fairly quickly after application, but it doesn’t entice me to gladly use it again. My skin never feels heavy or greasy, but I’m just feeling neutral about this one overall.

title: Watery Formulation but Cleanses Effectively 💦
text: This cleanser does dissolve most of my makeup away at the end of each day, and the scent is very light, but I am not able to use it like a typical face wash while in the shower. It does leave my skin feeling soft (and cleaner than before), but I’d prefer that it be marketed more like micellar water or a toner, since it’s a very thin liquid. The recommended usage instructions do suggest applying it to a cotton ball, and I can definitely see why after initially making the mistake of dispensing it directly into my hand like something that would lather! It does rinse easily away though, and I like that it contains moisturizing aloe vera, so I do intend to keep using it (now that I’ve figured out the ideal approach).

title: Uniquely Beneficial!
text: I love the shape and hue of this terahertz skin scraper! The ergonomically placed indentation/depression makes it easy to grip and hold, and it polishes up nicely after each and every use! It retains fluctuating temperatures well, and it seems to effectively de-puff and soothe my problem areas. Like most gua sha acupressure tools, it increases circulation and promotes better absorption of various skincare products that I apply, and I like that this scraper weighs slightly less than stainless steel versions that are similarly shaped and sized!

title: Botanically Based, Antioxidant-Rich, Plant-Powered, Anti-Aging Eye Cream! 👁
text:
I like the minty green hue of this eye cream, and the little glass jar it comes in! The inside of the box lid features a catchy slogan, and the cream’s tint helps combat any redness on my face. I will say that I have some reservations about the $79 price point of this product, but other consumers may place a different emphasis on that factor. I do like that this collagen-enhancing mixture contains milk thistle, bakuchiol, coffee leaf, and saffron, as they all have gentle and natural anti-inflammatory properties! I do have acne-prone skin, and I’ve experienced no breakouts or irritation with consistent use of this one.

While this is a fragrance-free formulation, I will say that it still has a strong mineral scent. After using the tiny (oh-so-adorable) spoon scoop to apply a trio of product dots under each eye, this cream spreads easily and absorbs fairly quickly, but it does leave my skin surface feeling a bit sticky — I prefer a softer result with eye creams. That being said, my makeup still seems to apply evenly on top of it, and it definitely leaves my skin feeling more moisturized than before. I haven’t noticed any immediately beneficial effects with this one, but I plan to keep using it over the next several weeks before making a final assessment. I’ll check back in with any updates!

title: There’s a Tiny Garden Inside! 🌷
text:
The floral design of this facial tool pair makes it slightly more unique than some other similar sets I’ve tried. The little pink flower sprigs are brightly colored and romantically eye-catching, but the clear resin encasing them is so lightweight, that it makes the handle feel cheaper than the rose quartz cylinders present at each end. The smaller roller head does have a slight wobble to it that prevents smooth and seamless rolling, but the larger roller head spins with silent precision.

The included gua sha scraper is an attractive shade of pale pink, and it’s nicely shaped and sized, but it does have a line transecting it that looks like an internal area of breakage upon first glance. I’m wondering if it’s a transverse area of weakness that might affect the overall integrity of this piece, making the tool more susceptible to snapping in two over time. I’ll have to watch and see what happens with repeated use of this one.

I love that usage instructions are printed on the inside of the box lid, and the set seems to be affordably priced. Overall, both tools do glide easily across my skin, and they help with lymphatic drainage and product absorption of various creams and serums, so I’d recommend this boxed set to anyone looking for an affordable roller/scraper duo with a unique feature present. 🌸

title: I’ve Been Loving this Unique Variety Pack! 🍉
text: What a fabulously fruity variety pack! These masks come packaged in colorful pouches, each one is soaked in plenty of liquid essence, they unfold and apply easily to the face, and they always leave my skin feeling more moisturized and hydrated, especially during the winter months!

title: Easy-To-Use Patches with a Pleasant Forest Aroma 🌲
text:
These little felt patches adhere easily to medical scrubs and face masks! I just used an unopened package that had a 2020 expiration date, and the internal sheet of 6 patches still had a very strong scent with a 4-6 hour longevity of a lingering and noticeable aroma. I wear one patch for an entire shift, and then easily peel it off and dispose of it. No residue is left behind and my hospital coworkers love these affordable scent stickers too.

In Latin, "phyton" means "plant" and "cide" means to exterminate. Phytoncide is a self-protective substance emitted by plants and trees to combat and repel harmful insects and bacterial microbes. Forest bathing is the contact of phytoncide in the atmosphere with the respiratory tract and skin, so these essential oil patches create a relaxing atmosphere solely through scent!

title: Rose Gold Rolling Goodness!! 🌅
text: I love that this weighted, dual-headed roller can be used for both facial and body massage, and the rotating heads are so glossy and smooth against my skin! Both devices are waterproof and they seem comfortable enough to use and hold. The metal gua sha tool does double-duty as well because it has a faceted orb on it that looks like a little disco ball! It works great around my eyes, and I always feel like my various creams and serums and elixirs spread and absorb into my face that much better when I massage them into place with these ergonomic tools! The boxed set also comes with a handy drawstring storage pouch and soft polishing cloth, so I think this would be a great skincare product to give OR receive!

title: What a fabulous set of skincare tools! 🌸
text: These are pretty great. I will say that the included gua sha scraper is a much paler shade of pink than the dual-ended roller is, but they both appear to be made from genuine pieces of rose quartz. All of the metal attachments are a shiny shade of rose gold, and both roller heads exhibit smooth and totally silent movement! I love that this boxed set also contains 2 silicone skincare brushes, and the product listing seems to be very affordably priced. All of the items glide easily across my skin, helping various creams and serums fully sink in, and I look forward to chilling these pieces and using them daily as part of my relaxing skincare routine. I’m quite pleased!

title: Sublime Citrus Scent, Skin-Softening Results! ⛅️
text:
I’ve been so pleased with every product I’ve tried from the Tangerine Toneright line, and the fresh citrus scent of each formulation is sublime! The refreshing toner is hydrating without being sticky, and the emulsion is soft and creamy and seems to absorb well. I love that these antioxidant-rich concoctions are packed with vitamins A and C!

My skin clearly agrees with the citron peel extracts in these products, and my complexion looks more clear, less dry, and less splotchy overall. I think the packaging is chic and user-friendly, and the brand seems to be listed at an affordable price point. I’ve been really pleased with the immediate and long-term results!

title: A Hydrating Design that’s Great for Both Genders! 💦
text:
These vegan and cruelty-free microfiber sheet masks come in a unique kickstand box, and they contain a blend of anti-inflammatory and anti-aging plant extracts and hydrating, freshwater marine algae. They do seem to soothe on contact, and my boyfriend and I both have tried them out!

The product box says these sheet masks are globally sourced and manufactured in Taiwan for a company based in Seattle, so they aren’t technically a Korean skincare product, as the listing might imply, but I’m sure they have been designed with Asian-inspired formulations in mind. At a current list price of $28 for the boxed set of 4, some consumers may be hesitant to pay that amount for something that’s single-use and disposable after a short 15 minutes, but the product does seem to be quality packaged and produced.

These masks are suitable for either gender, but for men with any face stubble present, they obviously don’t adhere as well as they ideally could, but the hydrating and skin-softening effects still seem noticeable. Each pouch contains plenty of serum, and the masks have a very light and pleasant scent.

title: This Classy Set Provides Ultimate Hydration and Quality! 🌸
text:
This Rising Star Travel Set makes every day feel
indulgent! The gelatinous under eye slivers exhibit great adherence, and they come imprinted with a very fine honeycomb pattern that help give them a texturized grip. They don’t slip and slide around, and they’re a little thinner than some of the other gel eye masks I’ve tried, so they don’t slowly migrate downward with gravity.

The algae and niacinamide combine to create a very moisturizing blend that pairs perfectly with the tub of the hydra-therapy memory gel sleep mask that features prickly pear and Vitamin E! The pink concoction is lightweight, bouncy, and incredibly soothing! It clearly has a high water content, and feels absolutely dreamy when applied. It leaves my skin feeling more hydrated than I can even put into words!

The included cosmetic bag/travel pouch is gorgeously designed, and I love the gold geometric pattern that gives the entire accessory such a chic and classy look! The zipper works great, and it’s adequately sized. The rose quartz gua sha scraper tool is uniquely shaped, and it comes with an engraved brand name and a soft canvas storage pouch.

Every product in this set leaves my skin feeling super soft and hydrated, and I love the light, clean scent of this collection! I’ve never used ERNO LASZLO products before, but I’m definitely a lifetime fan now. 🙌🏽

title: Luxurious Granules of Skin-Softening Exfoliation! 🛀🏽
text: This exfoliating body polish is the ideal amount of granulated and dreamy! I love that it’s vegan and cruelty-free, and the included wooden mini scoop is absolutely adorable. The blend of crushed sugar, passion fruit oil, shea butter, coconut oil, rosemary, and Vitamin E truly does leave my skin feeling silky smooth after my shower, and I love the earthy scent of this mixture. The packaging is attractive with a humorous slogan, and the product tub is a beautiful shape and shade. I’ve definitely been loving this one!

title: Skin Serum Superstars! 🍊
text: This moisturizing serum and cream both leave my face feeling beyond nourished and hydrated! I love that this line is packed with healing Vitamin C fruit juices, and neither product ever feels heavy, unpleasant, or sticky on my skin. I love the fresh citrus scent of this Tangerine Toneright collection, and how well each of the products soaks in and absorbs, so I’m definitely ordering these two again!

title: Good for Skin that Needs a Bit of Rolling Relaxation
text:
This candy-smooth, dual-ended facial tool exhibits an iridescent sheen or chatoyancy like a tiger’s eye stone. There are some surface scuffs and scratches present on the rose gold hardware portions, but both roller heads do spin smoothly and silently. The roller does arrive securely nestled within a cushioned foam cutout in a sturdy product box, and I appreciate that an instruction card accompanies it.

This facial tool can be chilled prior to use, but it doesn’t get quite as cold as some other rollers I have tried. The listing title also indicates so sort of gua sha scraper is additionally present, but that is not the case here.

The price of a true yellow jade stone varies greatly depending on its source. When it has been derived from NEPHRITE it is a rather affordable stone that sells for roughly $10. But if it comes from JADEITE then a yellow jade crystal the size of a small coin would sell for a minimum of $60. That being said, I still think this particular product is likely dyed glass and not sourced from an earth mineral at all. Even a lemony shade of cloudy quartz would still exhibit milky or cloudy inclusions.

Overall, this dual-ended roller is very eye-catching and is affordably priced, but I do not believe it’s natural jade. The zinc alloy hardware on the tool I received is slightly scratched, and there is no gua sha scraper or storage pouch included, so I feel somewhat neutral about this one.

title: These Are Da Bomb 🛁
text: These bath bombs fizz well, dissolve fully, don’t stain my tub, come in a varied assortment, have a light and pleasant scent, and leave my skin feeling really soft! For a full dozen, I think the list price seems appropriate for this boxed set, and since they are individually paper-wrapped and labeled, they’d also be easy to hand out as individual gifts (or include in thank you packs or gift baskets)! I’ve enjoyed using them during at-home pampering sessions.

title: Bubblegum Pink and Polished! 🌸
text: This is a beautifully feminine facial tool! It’s well-shaped, easy to hold, and I love how it glides over my skin after it’s been chilled in the refrigerator. It arrived securely packaged and I rather like the natural mineral striations throughout. I’ve gladly added it to my daily skincare routine!

title: Pink Petals Float in Sea of Glitter Particles 🌸
text:
These ice globes do seem to be fairly easy to use and easy to chill, and they’re affordably priced, but they do seem to be a bit more fragile than other pairs I’ve tried. They do arrive securely nestled within a sturdy box containing cushioned foam cutouts, and I love that a polishing pad is also included. Bi-colored flower petals float delicately amidst the flecks of suspended glitter, and the coated foam finger sleeves securely hug each tool’s handle.

Despite the product title mentioning something about rose quartz, these are in fact made of traditional borosilicate glass, so that terminology might mislead some consumers, but overall, I think most users would be pleased with these ice beauty globes, if they could take care of them gently enough to avoid breakage.

title: Milky Nourishment 🥛
text: This vegan and cruelty-free French skin cream product is very hydrating! It spreads easily, absorbs fully, and leaves my skin feeling soft and nourished. I like the black and white design of the packaging, and the lotion has a milky consistency and feel. It does have a very faint scent, but I don’t detect any sort of added fragrance. The caffeine, aloe vera, and sunflower oil components seem to work well together!

title: Soft and Smooth and Scentless 👀
text: I’ve had great results with this gentle eye contour cream! The fragrance-free blend is soft and moisturizing, and it seems to absorb quickly while also providing hours worth of long-lasting hydration. I especially love how it keeps the skin of my crows’ feet conditioned enough to create a decent base for makeup. I always try to find skincare products that help me avoid foundation creasing throughout the day, so this eye cream has been a great addition to my routine!

title: This Set Left Me Feeling So Glamorous and Glowy! 🌟
text: This set’s definitely got the Midas touch! I loved the brightening effects of the vitamin C serum and the gold flakes suspended within it. The jelly mask was an interesting texture, but it did leave my skin feeling soft and not sticky in any way, and I feel like the entire set has been well priced at $58. As an artist, I often work with delicate foil sheets, so I enjoyed applying these 24K gold layers to my face, especially since my combination skin will often react to harsher irritants. All in all, this boxed group of elements worked well for me, and even though it took a bit of time to mix and apply everything correctly, the glamorous pampering session felt nice!

title: Lightweight and Versatile Roller 💿
text:
I like the stainless steel sheet that’s wrapped around this Complexion Perfection Ice Roller because it does allow this device to roll over the skin smoothly and silently! It helps increase lymphatic drainage, thereby reducing puffiness, especially beneath my eyes, and it eases some of my stress headaches and migraines.

I do wish that the handle was some sort of metal or alloy material, because the lightweight black plastic makes the tool feel a bit cheaper to me, but it DOES protect fingers from cold temps since it doesn’t drastically chill like the roller portion does. This product seems to be affordably priced and easy to use, so I think consumers will be pleased with this one overall, but I like the all-metal versions a bit better. I do, however, love that this one comes with a clear plastic cover though (and instructions on the back of the package)!

title: Heat Waves for Days! ♨️👩🏼‍🦱
text:
I like the forest green, matte metallic hue of this hair tool, and it seems to be nicely sized and weighted! The 5 temp settings range from 286-410 degrees Fahrenheit, and there’s even a little switch at the end that lets you clamp the barrels closed for storage or transport. The silky smooth barrels have a ceramic tourmaline coating that also helps prevent static! I love that the cord attachment rotates freely with ease because having 360 degrees of circular movement really helps keep the cord from ever getting twisted or tangled!

I do like that this iron creates soft S-shaped beach waves, giving strands a more timeless appeal than the sharper V-shaped angles created by hair crimpers from the 1980s, and it also heats up so fast! It ships quickly and arrives nicely packaged, so I think this hair device would make an affordable and unique gift!

title: Helps Address Hyperpigmentation and Sun Spots 🍊
text: What a pretty product bottle shade this one has! This Vitamin C face serum has been so easy to apply and work into my morning skincare routine, and it has genuinely helped to even out some of the splotchy areas of my complexion over time. I’d recommend it to anyone else wishing to address post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, and I love that it also contains green tea and ginseng! “Radiant and glowing” skin is something we all wish to achieve, so this organic serum has been a great product from the start!

title: Intensely Hydrating and Beautifully Packaged! 💦
text:
This gentle serum dispenses nicely and it’s easy to spread across my face and neck! I’ve been using it at night in combination with the Infinitek Paris retinol moisturizer, and I use it each morning with my vitamin C serum and sunscreen layers. I love that it’s a fragrance-free, cruelty-free product, and it offers my skin some much-needed hydration (during these dry winter months especially)!

This one seems to be comparably priced, and I love the pastel blue bottle and recyclable packaging that it comes in! My fine lines and creases are slightly less noticeable (especially across my forehead), now that I’ve been consistently using several of the products from the Infinitek Paris line for the past month, so I’m glad this organic hyaluronic acid serum gives me nice results.

title: Works Wonders Overnight! 🌝
text: This retinol moisturizer cream has been a great addition to my nighttime skincare routine! The push top dispenser is easy to depress with just one hand, and it seems to release the perfect amount of product. I love that this cruelty-free formula can be applied on top of the vitamin C serum I also have from the Infinitek Paris line, so I’ve noticed some visible lessening of my fine lines and neck creases. I’d definitely recommend this gently moisturizing cream to others who might be looking for a low-concentration retinol product.

title: Glow-Worthy Results! ✨🐝
text:
This facial serum has been deeply infused with Manuka honey extracts from New Zealand!! It pairs delightfully with the Manuka honey deep care moisturizing cream from the same Ogi line, and I love that it spreads on easily and absorbs to a final, non-sticky state.

English language usage instructions have been stuck to the side of the product box, and I appreciate that the frosted glass bottle also features a clearly marked expiration date on its base. This Korean skincare product is very lightly scented and seems to produce pleasing effects with my combination, breakout-prone skin, so I plan to happily keep using it on a daily basis!

title: Superpowered Skin Serum! 🐳
text:
This hydrating, super-moist power Korean face serum features a complex blend of 7 different hyaluronic acids! The allergen-free formula deeply hydrates my dry winter skin and the 3.38 fluid oz (100 ML) total quantity feels generously sized. It has a milky translucent hue and it seems to absorb nicely.

As per the instructions on the box, I’ve been applying 2-3 drops of the serum daily and patting it gently into my skin, and after 2 weeks of use, I can definitely see a difference in my previously thirsty complexion! I also have sensitive, combination skin as well, so I’ve been pleased with how this one has gently helped plump up my skin surface overall.

The bottom of the bottle has an expiration date clearly printed on the base, and that’s always a feature I appreciate seeing on skincare products, and the fact that it’s made of blue plastic and not glass makes it far less likely to break if I accidentally knock it over on my bathroom counter! I definitely recommend this product from the Ogi line.

title: Subtle Tint Provides Protective Coverage 🌞
text:
I like the SPF 50 factor of this tinted mineral lotion, and it seems to work well as a non-greasy, yet still moisturizing, sunscreen product! I’m often hesitant to try new facial lotions (due to my tendency to breakout), but this one seems to be non-aggravating and gentle enough for my sensitive-skin needs.

It truly does absorb quickly, and it dries with a matte finish that doesn’t leave my face looking oily or shiny. The final color tint is very faint, suggesting that it should work well as a neutral base layer for a wide range of skin tones, so all in all, I would enthusiastically recommend this Infinitek Paris product to others!

title: A Soft Shade of Smooth Seafoam Green!
text:
This dual-ended facial/massage roller is smoothly polished and nicely sized! The stone components
are a muted, pastel shade of seafoam green that’s quite likely aventurine (and not jade), but it’s a modern and contemporary hue that’s still quite pleasing to look at. The coppery gold hardware complements the color of the stones nicely, and the larger roller moves with silent precision. There is a slight wobble present that allows the smaller roller to make a quiet “clunk” with each revolution, but the internal silicone plugs cushion most of the sound.

There are some helpful usage instructions printed on the back of the box, and the tool sits snuggly contained within a soft foam cutout. Compared to some other dual-ended rollers currently available, I feel that this facial tool has been overpriced, but I’ve gladly added a few minutes with this device to my daily skincare routine!

title: Frosty, Icy Globes of Radiant Goodness! ☃️
text:
After trying several different shapes, sizes, and colors of ice beauty globes, I’ve determined I like this clear variety the best! These super sparkly globes contain an anti-freeze sort of liquid that easily retains frosty temps, and I like that the little rubberized foam sleeves help provide a solid grip while protecting my fingers from the chilled surface of the borosilicate glass.

These facial tools would make a great gift, and they always put me in a peaceful state of mind. Maybe holding and staring at mini snow globes on sticks is just my special sort of peaceful. I love using these to depuff my eyes before nights out and/or special events, and the cushioned storage box also contains a soft cleaning sponge!

title: Deeply Hydrating and Creamy! 🍯🐝
text:
I love the moisturizing deep care cream compactly contained within this frosted glass jar! It has such a smooth and creamy feel, and it seems to absorb quickly once it’s applied. I’ve really gotten into using Manuka honey products over the past year, and this Ogi blend in particular is just dreamy!

This specific moisturizer is blended and packaged in Korea, but all of the active honey ingredients and compounds are harvested from New Zealand. I absolutely love the light and fresh scent of it, and I’ve been applying it morning and night for the past 3 weeks with great results!

title: It’s Sea-sational! I love this hydrating blend 💦
text:
This marine skin serum smells refreshing, spreads easily, absorbs fully, and is affordably priced! The beautiful blue glass bottle features a reliable pump dispenser, and a printed expiration date appears helpfully on the back of the bottle. I’ve had great results with repeated daily use of this product, and I love that it contains sea water, ceramides, AND aloe vera!

This has been another great K-beauty brand discovery for me, and I’d definitely recommend this specific product to anyone else in search of a gentle but moisturizing formulation for dry or dehydrated skin!

title: Adequate, But Not the Best Quality for the Price
text:
I recently tried on a few different black and white, dual-colored Cruella cosplay wigs for Halloween and this one was pretty much just neutral for me. It came pre-styled curled and seemed to fluff up okay and sat decently on my head without issue. The included faux pearl choker looked and felt like typical plastic costume jewelry, but the cigarette holder stick felt undeniably like a cheap prop from a dollar store. The red gloves seemed adequately sized for a typical adult, but the stitching around the open arm hems looked a bit uneven and loose in places.

I’m not sure that this set feels worth the current list price of $25.99 to me, but other consumers might feel differently. It does the job for a brief night out somewhere that encourages a theme or costume involvement, but if I had it to do over again, I’d probably just purchase slightly better quality versions of each of these accessories separately.

title: A Fabulous Travel Team! 🧳
text:
This is a great little travel set that’s attractively packaged and bundled! The scentless foaming cleanser, serum, gentle toner, cleansing oil, and facial cream all seem to be very soothing and layer well together. Whether for yourself or another lucky recipient, I think most users would be just as happy with this sample size kit as I have been!

The olive/beige bag is compact and sturdy and the attached zipper has reliably held up through many repeated openings and closings. These products are nourishing and gentle, so I think they’d be great for most skin types and for year-round application!

title: Conditions Deeply and the Rose Scent is Sublime! 🌹
text:
I absolutely love this skin oil!! It spreads easily and offers long-lasting absorption, and I love that it smells like roses! I’ve been using it on some newly acquired scars, and it really seems to condition my problem areas while keeping my skin super soft.

The complex blend of botanical extracts also gives my dry skin a layer of sweet almond, jasmine, clove, apricot, and sunflower oils too, so this MEDERMA product has been a gentle yet pleasing addition to my daily skincare routine.

title: Sleek, Shiny, Contemporary, and Beneficial! 💿
text:
I’m always looking for a quality gua sha/facial roller set that’s both beneficial to my skin and eye-catching overall, and this set didn’t disappoint! This is the first time I’ve tried using terahertz tools, and I can honestly say they’re super stylish and sleek. The dual-ended roller exhibits silent rolling at both ends, and the gua sha scraper is smooth to the touch and ergonomically comfortable to hold!

This duo does a great job of stimulating the increased absorption of many of my applied moisturizers and skin serums, and I love how the silver and gold metallic hues complement each other! I can easily chill this pair prior to each use, and I like that these tools weigh slightly less than similarly shaped and sized stainless steel devices. I’m really happy with this set overall and would definitely recommend this product!

title: Smells Like Grape Jelly 🍇
text:
This red wine facial mask has a vibrant hue and a jiggly texture that’s visually appealing! It actually spreads fairly easily and has just a faint blush hue when applied, but it does dry a bit sticky. I will say that it has a distinct fruity smell, so I can’t help but think of grape jelly the whole time I’m using it, but I appreciate that the product box comes with a clearly printed expiration date. After wearing the mask for about 15-20 minutes, it easily rinses off my face, and my skin always feels soft and smooth, but I can’t honestly say that it has provided any deeply visible results yet.

At a current list price of $4.49, it would certainly be an easily affordable and unique skincare novelty gift, but I haven’t been able to discern any noticeably beneficial changes in my overall skin appearance after several applications, so (at least for now) I’m neutral about the thought of potentially ordering this product again. I’ve had a good experience with it though, and I still think plenty of others will like its scent and texture as well!

title: Helps Repair My Hair! 👱🏼‍♀️
text: My color-treated hair always benefits from repairing treatments that leave it slightly more conditioned, and this product definitely adds some softness to my strands! The scent is just okay to me; it does smell somewhat clinically artificial. The formula is also fairly thick, so it can be challenging to easily squeeze it out of the bottle at times, but it does provide noticeably nourishing results overall, so I do plan to keep using it!

title: Easy to Use and Apply but My Skin Feels Hot
text:
These sculpting wands are lightweight and simple to use, but for the first 10 minutes after I’ve applied and spread the collagen-boosting cream, my neck feels hot (like I’ve splashed hot pepper juice on myself). One depression of the pump releases an ideal amount of lotion, and the silver roller ball heads smoothly move with ease. I have noticed some taut tightening around my jawline, but the mild skin reaction/burning sensation keeps me from giving this sculpting wand duo a perfect rating.

From reading some of the other reviews, the irritating reaction actually seems to be quite common among all users, so between that issue and the $195 list price, I personally think many other potential customers might be deterred from trying this duo.

title: Rosy Results! 🌹
text: I love the moisturizing mix of aloe vera, rose water, vitamin E, and hyaluronic acid in this balmy blend! The packaging is attractive, the cap is easy to place and remove, and the formula always leaves my hands feeling hydrated and soft. I’ve used it time and time again with pleasing results!

title: Provides Subtle but Beneficial Tightening Results!
text:
This Italian skin cream has a light, pleasant scent and it absorbs quickly, so it’s simple enough to use morning and night on a daily basis! I like that it contains retinol, marine extract, probiotics, and antioxidants, and the patent-pending SIREN capsules help combat those pesky free radicals that we all get exposed to!

The pump dispenser atop the plastic product bottle has been consistently reliable for me, and I love the consistency of the cream. Once each application dries in place, I can definitely feel a mild tightening (and hydration) of my skin, so the promised firming sensation is notably present.

At a $98 price point, this formula is more costly than some broadly comparable options found elsewhere, so I’m not sure that this one produces miraculously shocking results that warrant that steep of a price, but U Beauty SCULPT has provided me with some subtly visible skin benefits, and I do generously slather it on daily!

title: Nourishing and Easy to Apply!
text: This little vibrantly colored jar of product contains a delightful face mask cream! It’s a dreamy consistency, spreads easily, removes fully, and always leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated! The product box also includes a plastic mini scoop, so this combo is perfect for travel. The cruelty-free formulation is full of revitalizing antioxidants, and the box comes with a helpful expiration date, so I’d definitely order this one again, especially since hyaluronic acid is always so hydrating!

title: Gilded Magnetic Magic! ✨🧲
text:
This is the first time I’ve ever tried using a magnetic face mask, and I’m so glad that I got to experience the true magic of one! The thick gold substance applies and spreads easily across my face, and it doesn’t begin to crack or flake off as it dries (like some other clay masks I’ve tried). The set also comes with a little magnet that firmly attracts the embedded iron particles in the applied mask, and the hydrating goo warms up as it sits on my skin.

With an added tissue in place, removal and clean up is a breeze, and this is a fun, at-home treatment to try twice a week! My face is always soft and smooth after each application of this Egyptian-inspired treatment, so I would definitely recommend this one to family and friends!

title: Unique Storage and Distribution System; Liquid Cream Smells Amazing!
text:
This kit provides users with several small tools and components. The 5 glass ampoules come securely packaged and separated, and they sit snugly in the aquamarine-colored base. The easy-open sleeve tool safely breaks the tip off of each ampoule, but there may still be some jagged glass edges present, so care should be taken around kids especially. After opening the vial, the clear plastic sleeve goes back on, and then you tip the liquid contents into the leakproof/drip-proof syringe sleeve. Nothing will come out of the tip until you give it a slight squeeze, so there is thankfully no chance of accidental spillage.

The contents have a creamy liquid sort of consistency, and the formula spreads easily and absorbs quickly, and it smells like a pleasantly scented sunscreen! I did feel a bit of a tingling sensation at first, but it dissipated quickly, and my skin was left feeling lightly moisturized.

If you use half an ampoule daily (as recommended by the manufacturer), then this $29 listing fulfills a 10-day supply, but I think users would be satisfied with the results overall! And the set thankfully comes with a couple of small caps that seal off the tips to keep the contents contained until you’re ready to use the second half of each ampoule. I do wish that some of the product wouldn’t get tossed and wasted in the recesses of each broken-off glass tip, but it’s still possible to get most of the lingering solution out with gravity. All in all, I’ve enjoyed using this skincare set, but the ampoules will break if dropped, so it’s a bit of a fragile storage system that takes some careful handling!

title: Pleasantly Scented and Packaged Curated Group of Products! 🌸🕯
text: What an attractive gift set! The stainless steel tumbler is compactly sized, the font is attractive and well placed, and the cup is a very pretty shade of warm rose gold. The candle is perfect for small spaces or bathrooms, and the floral soaps and bath bombs provide a relaxing and aromatic touch! All of the items come safely nestled inside a sturdy box, and this gift set would be perfect for a wide variety of recipients and occasions!

title: Vitamin-Packed, Superfruit Serum! 🍊
text: I’ve loved all of the Vegan Mia products I’ve tried recently, and this earthy-scented, organic superfruit vitamin C face serum does not disappoint! It’s beautifully packaged, spreads evenly, absorbs throughly, and always leaves my skin feeling soft and cleansed! It genuinely seems to be a very gentle yet nourishing formulation full of 7 different fruit oils. I love it!

title: Leakproof and (100mL) TSA-Approved! 👍🏽✈️
text:

I will say that they work best with watery liquids like micellar water, toners, and eye-makeup removers, because the tubing is too small to vertically transport anything thicker like conditioner, lotions, or granulated face scrubs.

Even with that being said, they are quite suitable for holding liquids of a thinner consistency (and despite the product page saying they are 3.5 oz containers, each bottle has “100mL” printed on each side, which equates to 3.4 fl oz, so they are, in fact, TSA-approved thankfully). I was glad to have them on my most recent flight!

title: I Love the Sponge AND the Rolling Volcanic Stone!
text:
I’ve been pleasantly surprised by the effectiveness of this discretely camouflaged, dual-ended facial tool! The end with the pointed-tip sponge does a great job around the nose and under the eyes, where makeup tends to settle and where mascara sometimes smears throughout the day, and the other end features a volcanic stone that really is so unique! It’s smooth to the touch and rolls with ease, and you can immediately see it soak up surface oils because it gets slightly darker with each pass across the skin. It’s simple enough to wash and air dry, and both ends of this metal tube feature easy-to-remove, metallic pink caps.

It’s so easy to pack and transport this reusable touch-up device in my purse or makeup bag, so I prefer using this combo over a small box of single-use blotting papers like I’ve relied on in the past. I really like this product and would recommend it to other ladies on the go!

title: Simple Yet Effective! 🚿
text: I gifted this bath and body brush to my mom and she loves it! It’s great for wet or dry brushing techniques, and it does well with applied soaps and body gels. It comes packaged in a sturdy box and the one-piece design gives it some reliable sturdiness. title: Super Festive and Fun! 🌈
text:
I love the wide range of available colors and the fact that these tinsel strands are heat-resistant, but since they are so lightweight, you do have to battle forces of static electricity somewhat. It’s also important to tug and tighten them as close to the anchored slip knots as possible, otherwise, the strands will begin to stretch with too much applied pressure if you start pulling on them halfway down each piece.

You can easily add several strands all over your head though, or just a few subtle hints of sparkle here and there, but they’re great for adults and kids alike! Perfect for holidays, parties, sporting events, and dances!!

title: Pretty Good but Not Quite Perfect 🍥
text:
The metal attachments are attractive, and the larger roller head exhibits silent movement, but the smaller roller head clanks a little because it moves some from left to right due to being shaped too short. What’s most interesting is that the actual handle of the roller seems to be made of plastic (not rose quartz), so even though it color matches each of the roller heads, it’s not heavy and cool to the touch like the natural stone pieces are. I have tried and tested many different jade and rose quartz facial rollers, and this is the first one I’ve come across with a synthetic handle.

The gua sha tool is nicely sized, polished, and contoured, and both of the tools fit safely within their custom foam cutouts, and the set is affordably priced overall, so it would make a great beginner set for someone!

title: Pore-fection! 👌🏽
text: This product listing contains 2 boxed sets, and each set contains 5 individual two-step treatments that are joined along a perforated edge, so you receive 10 treatments total! I’ve experienced no skin sensitivities or issues while using them, only great results! The witch hazel and evening primrose combine to create a soothing skin combo, and every pouch comes with a clearly marked expiration date. Love this set!

title: Oh So Moisturizing!
text: I’ve really enjoyed using this organic facial cream from France! I love that it contains hyaluronic acid, algae, and coffee components, and it genuinely seems to plump and hydrate my skin! The fragrance-free formula is also vegan and cruelty free, and it comes in an attractive brown glass bottle. It’s become a beneficial part of my daily skincare routine. It dispenses and spreads like sunscreen, and it makes my skin soft but never greasy.

title: These Only Work if You Sleep Like a Corpse ⚰️
text:
These thick silicone sheets are very attractively packaged and described. They do seem to exhibit great adhesion, and as long as you place each pad back on the included clear mat each morning, it is easy to reuse them again and again, night after night! But…

The neck pad feels like an Elizabethan collar, and if you (like me) tend to have a habit of reading a book right before drifting off to sleep, the pad definitely limits any ability to look down comfortably. If you happen to sweat at all while you sleep, the silicone will trap the moisture against your skin because it prevents evaporation. And while the chest pad doesn’t restrict any necessary range of movement like the neck one does, it also lacks breathability, so when I wake up each morning, my skin is red in both areas, in the exact shapes of the pads. Sometimes my skin reacts that same way to waterproof band-aids, so a lot of it could just be due to a hypersensitivity I personally have with adhesives.

My biggest issue though was just an unavoidable compatibility with this type of product. Most people cannot consciously control what they do when they’re asleep, and I’m definitely one of those people. I always end up in various positions throughout the night (on my back, on my side, and on my stomach), and these pads really require that you lie flat on your back the whole time. If you don’t, they start to ripple and pull up at the edges, and they end up disrupting your sleep cycles altogether.

So while these silicone sheets sound like a great idea in theory, I could not stay peacefully cool and still enough every night to reap any quantifiable benefits. They might work great for some, but they unfortunately did not agree with my sleeping habits.

title: Mushroom Sheet Mask Moisturizers!
text: What a soothing variety set of sheet masks! The dark and earthy designs on the packaging visually pulled me in, but I’ve honestly loved using these hypoallergenic face masks. title: This Pillow Elevates Every Soak! 🪨
text:

title: An Earthy Green Duo! 🌱
text:

title: Such a Lovely Duo of Cooling Stainless Steel
text: I absolutely love this pair of cooling globe cryo sticks! The stainless steel orbs offer such a cooling sensation, and it feels great to apply an extra bit of pressure. title: Botanically Produced and Simply Sublime!

text:

text:

title: Pretty Shade but Difficult to Apply to Semi-Wet, Unconditioned Hair
text:
This color-mask, pigment-depositing formula is easy to squeeze out, it smells AMAZING, and it is a vibrant shade of Barbie/bubblegum pink, but it is a bit tricky to evenly apply. The longer your hair is, the harder it is to try and coat each strand evenly, and since you’re only supposed to leave it on for 5-10 minutes, there’s not much forgiveness time when it comes to getting the job done quickly.

I do not wear gloves during application, and it has never stained my hands, but it did stain my ivory plastic bathroom countertop when I didn’t get a globular splatter immediately wiped away. The hardest part about the application process to me is the fact that you’re supposed to apply this mask to clean, towel-dried hair. So I get in the shower, shampoo my hair, and rinse it out. Then I have to get out of the shower, try to brush through wet hair that hasn’t been conditioned, try to coat my semi-wet hair all the way down with the pink stuff, and then get back in the shower less than 10 minutes later. My hair has been color-treated with blonde highlights, so it doesn’t evenly absorb the color all the way down every blonde strand, and it ends up splotchy in places. I usually wait a couple of days and then try applying it a second time before the first attempt has had a chance to be washed out.

All in all, I think it’s a pretty shade that smells fabulous, and it leaves your hair well conditioned, but it’s tricky to apply to longer hair if you’re by yourself. I wish that it worked like a regular box of hair color, where you just section off dry strands for systematic application, but others might struggle less than me.

title: Nicely Cushioned and Patterned but Bottom Bars Slip on Hard Surfaces
text:

It works okay if you place it on a towel, but I’d prefer a non-slip feature be present.

Since this product weighs less than 1 lb, it’s easy to store and transport, especially when it’s folded flat, but it quickly extends to give a cushioned resting height that conveniently hovers above most of the currently available nail lamps on the market. I think this one would be great for salon use or at-home use because it definitely gives manicurists a helping hand, so I think it’s worth its current list price! 💅🏼

title: Portable and Efficient Nail Lamp! 💅🏼
text:
This pale pink portable 80W nail lamp features 36 light source beads that seem to do a great job of curing gel nail polishes on the hands or feet. I like that it has three available time settings (30s, 60s, 90s) and an auto-sensor that turns the lights on when movement is detected. It easily fits beneath most of the standing hand pillows for manicures, so its compact size makes it versatile and convenient!

Since it is lightweight (weighing less than 1 lb), it’s perfect for travel or transport since it’s so easily portable, and the package also includes the necessary power adapter, so you just open the box and plug it in for immediate use! I’ve been very satisfied with the performance of this one, so I’d gladly recommend it to others. 🌸

title: Masks Worked Great (but Pouches Arrived Sticky) 🥑
text:
This variety pack contains an Avocado mask, a Shea Butter mask, and a Pomegranate mask! Each individual pouch seems to contain plenty of hydrating essence, and each mask unfolds easily to create a smooth and slippery application. The pomegranate variety smells like red wine, and all of the masks adhere well for the entire duration of recommended wear (15-20 minutes). The full set comes with a clearly marked expiration date, and the artistic designs are all very vivid and eye-catching!

* Now this part may only apply to the packaged set I received, but for some reason, every pouch arrived sticky. All 3 of the bags were stuck to one another, and the entire trio was stuck inside the containment envelope… but since none of the pouches were torn or damaged in any way, I suspect that some liquid essence spilled on them prior to packaging and shipment, and then dried in place before they ever reached my doorstep. It didn’t affect the performance of the masks themselves, but the packages wouldn’t ever rinse clean, even with soap and water. That is the only reason I deducted a star, and I think most sheet-mask users would enjoy the moisturizing benefits of this set!

title: Delightfully Scented Seaside Suds! 🛁
text: This invigorating sea salt body wash really evokes an oceanside feel! The sea fennel and baobab essence combine with pepperiment oil to create a clean and refreshing blend. The body wash itself is a pearlescent yellow hue, and it produces foamy suds easily. It rinses cleanly away and always leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized. The squeeze tube comes with a foil safety seal in place, and I also love that this is a cruelty-free product made in the USA! I’d definitely recommend it to others. 🌊🧂

title: Glittery Purple Globes of Cooling Delight! ❄️🔮
text:
These cooling facial globes are whimsically adorable! The glittery purple design is youthful and eye-catching, and the anti-freeze liquid substance bobs around freely inside each globe. I like the little white rubberized foam sleeves that encircle the handle of each tool, since they help provide a good grip while protecting fingers against chilly temps.

The globes are easy enough to refrigerate, and they do genuinely seem to help reduce puffiness, so they definitely provide a relaxing range of benefits! The set comes packaged in an attractive box, and the product seems to be competitively priced, so I’d definitely recommend this cooling facial globe set to others, especially anyone who loves sparkly violet!

title: Super Handy, Convenient Nail Cushion Setup! 💅🏼
text: This cushiony pillow hand rest is perfect for manicures! I like that the foldable metal brackets are easily collapsible and expandable, which makes this product easy to store and transport. The non-slip silicone tubes have already been pre-slit, so they’re easy to place on the horizontal bars (or remove) as desired. The diamond-pattern on the silvery gray fabric is attractive, and the entire unit weighs less than a pound! It fits perfectly over many of the currently available portable nail lamps on the market, so it makes great use of vertical space in compact quarters, and the box even has a complimentary, soft polishing cloth included. Overall, I’m impressed with the quality of this hand rest, and I think frequent polishers would love the comfortable convenience it could provide their clients!

title: Tropical Temptations! 👙🍍
text:
This product contains tan enhancers and subtle colorants that are said to promote and extend a golden tan, but it also contains coconut, apple, kiwi, and pineapple components! I love that it’s a cruelty-free product, and it comes wrapped in plastic with a foil safety seal in place, so it’s well packaged and immediately ready to use!

It glides on easily and seems to be very moisturizing, and I love the tropical scent, so the multi-fruit blend of ingredients works well from a fragrance standpoint, but like most indoor tanning bronzers, it does require several sessions back to back before you see a noticeable difference with coloration. I didn’t see any over-the-top results right away (possibly because my skin was already somewhat tan), but consistent use of this lotion did seem to provide a lasting and enhanced effect!

title: Super Light Shade of Pink with a Semi-Matte Finish
text: It’s always nice to have a rose quartz gua sha stone on hand, and this one seems to be authentic and reliable! The tool I received is an incredibly light shade of creamy pink (almost white), and it’s less polished than some others I’ve tried, so it’s not as slippery (but it’s also not as shiny). It comes safely cushioned within a slim white box and it’s affordably priced, so I’d recommend this product to anyone looking for a semi-matte, super light pink scraper. Usage instructions are also helpfully printed on the back of the box.

title: Keeps Things Visible and Sanitized! 💈
text:
This disinfectant soaking jar is pretty great in most ways! The glass is very thick, making it less prone to accidental breakage, and it’s a perfect size, so it’s fairly compact while still providing plenty of room for multiple tools. I like the black foam circle on the base, and the upright knob is easy to grab and grip with one hand, making this an efficient and timeless container with a nostalgic look that’s attractive to customers.

In regards to the one I received: the lid doesn’t sit perfectly flat on the top rim of the jar. It will level out if I hold pressure down on it, but it won’t sit evenly on its own, so the thin steel of the lid is ever-so-slightly misshapen. It doesn’t really affect the functionality of the unit, but it is a manufacturing defect that changes the visual impression of the piece as a whole.

I was impressed with the safe and thoughtful packaging of this product because the jar came securely sandwiched between two styrofoam halves that were in a box inside a box inside another box, so it thankfully arrived intact!

title: Sparkly, Demure, and Elegant! ✨
text:
I love this fashionably elegant hair clip! It’s lightweight and sturdy, and the branched golden tendrils are surprisingly flexible, so it’s easy to make little curvatures and final adjustments to the overall shape as needed. The backside features a hinged alligator clip that easily grabs the hair, and the adornment can be placed at any angle since the design looks great from every orientation.

I think it would be perfect for weddings, but it might look great as an updo accessory for proms and homecomings too. It’s affordably versatile regardless, and the tiny botanical accents give it an enchanted garden sort of feel! 🌿 I’d definitely recommend it! 👰🏻‍♀️

title: Facial Alchemy! 🔮
text:
The niacinamide, vitamin C, and clay components of this Mystic Mask provide a unique and interesting facial treatment! The color-shifting reaction is definitely fascinating to experience, and I do genuinely think that some visible pore minimization has resulted. The product has a light scent and spreads easily, so I think it would be great for anyone sensitive to strong fragrances.

I’ve enjoyed using several products from the Tru Alchemy line, and the attractive packaging always catches my eye! I’d definitely recommend this mask concoction to others.

title: Cushiony and Soft but Suction Cups Could be Better 🛀🏽
text: This bath pillow is definitely soft and cushioned, but it’s not quite as comfortable as some other bath pillows I’ve tried recently, and a couple of the attached suction cups arrived bent slightly out of shape. As a result, the suction power isn’t all that it could be, but it’s suitable enough for a product that costs less than $15. Bath pillows like this are always great for travel, since they’re easy enough to toss in the car and take into hotel/motel rooms along the road, so I think this one will be perfect for that!

title: Gentle Yet Effective! ⭐️
text: I have greatly enjoyed using these vitamin-enriched facial masks! Each pouch seems to contain plenty of hydrating essence, and I usually apply the extra liquid to my neck and chest. The individual sheet masks seem to be comfortably sized, and they adhere nicely as I sit back and relax. They provide a very hydrating experience, and I’ll gladly keep using them all until they’re gone! I have always had a good experience with this brand, and I’d definitely buy more!

title: Sleek, Relaxing, and Stylish 🪐
text: This is a beautifully designed facial tool that also exhibits ergonomic functionality! It’s very easy to use, I love the weight of it, and the sleek handle seems to offer adequate traction. The frosty metallic finish gives it a glamorous sheen, and the massaging heads roll with ease, kneading and healing as they go. This genuinely seems to be a quality product that can easily be worked into anyone’s daily beauty and skincare routine, so I’d gladly recommend this unisex tool to others!

title: Stretchy, Colorful, and Comfortable! 💫
text: These headbands are stretchy, fashionable, super soft, comfortable to wear, and affordably priced! I love the grouped color variety, and they’d make great gifts, especially for an at-home spa day! I’d gladly order another set and recommend them to others.

title: Slick, Smooth, and Beneficial to Have on Hand!
text: This jade gua sha tool arrived quickly, and it came packaged within a nicely cushioned gift box! All of the edges seem to be smoothly shaped and contoured, and the surface appears to be very well polished on both sides. It’s super easy to use this scraper with various acupressure techniques, so I’d gladly recommend this affordably priced stone to others who are searching for a reliable jade stone!

title: My Hair Has Truly Been Living Its Best Life! 👩🏼🌿
text:
I’ve always loved reaping the salon-quality rewards of IGK-branded haircare products, and this Best Life Dream Hair Oil is just as nourishing as the others I’ve tried! I love that it’s a vegan, paraben-free, silicone-free, cruelty-free product that’s 100% plant based, and it gives my hair some enviable shine! 🍃

I’ve used it before blowdrying and styling my hair, but I’ve also used it when I’m just letting my hair slowly air dry, and it genuinely seems to provide noticeable benefits via either approach. The coconut oil, jojoba seed oil, and orange peel oil combine to give it a lovely scent, and it’s super easy to dispense and apply! A little goes a long way, so the bottled quantity seems sufficient. I love this stuff!

title: Brightening Powerhouse Packs!
text: These soft cotton, charcoal sheet masks are easy to unfold and apply, and they seem to drape over my face nicely! The accompanying ceramide ampoules offer an extra dose of hydrating and age-defying goodness that I’ve really come to appreciate, and each pouch seems to contain plenty of liquid serum. I’ve loved all the MEDIHEAL products I’ve separately tried, so this sheet mask variety is another winner in my book!

title: A Conditioning Cream that Goes on Smoothly!
text: The ceramides, red algae, and edelweiss extract in this cream combine to create a very conditioning skincare product! The lightweight consistency of this hydrating cream makes it a great choice for PM moisturizing, and while the aroma did seem a bit too heavily scented at first, it quickly dissipated as the fast-absorbing product soaked into and softened my skin. While using it, I haven’t experienced any issues with topical reactions, breakouts, or skin sensitivity, so I’ll gladly keep patting this stuff on nightly! 🌝

title: Perfectly Pink and Pointed! 🩰
text: This gua sha scraper is a beautiful shade of pale pink rose quartz, and the natural mineral inclusions give it some visually appealing depth! It’s nicely contoured and smoothly polished, and it works perfectly for so many different acupressure and massage techniques. I think everyone needs one of these facial/body tools in their lives! They are so pretty AND functional.

title: A Truly Awesome Mixing Palette Set!
text: I love this paired set of silver mixing palettes! They are fairly lightweight overall, and the ringed finger holes make them very comfortable to hold. The included hand tools do a great job of scooping up and depositing small product particles, and they work for gels, pigmented powders, or semi-solid balms. I am also a painter (and have used many plastic trays that are of a similar shape and size), but these stainless steel ones are far superior! The mixing depressions are perfectly sized, and they don’t stain, so these trays are super easy to clean as well!

title: Offers Compressive Reinforcement with Stabilizing Flexibility!🦵🏽
text: This single-knee compression sleeve features a unisex, pixilated design that’s universally flattering, and the range of available sizes will make it suitable for most. The wavy grips along the inside of the seamed edges seem to offer some gravity-defying staying power, and the fabric offers an ideal blend of breathable flexibility and compressive comfort. I think this product is priced affordably enough, and I’ve now used it a handful of times with satisfying results, so if you’re in search of a lightweight joint sleeve that is easy to pack, place, and transport, it might be worth giving this stabilizing product a try!

title: Feeling Sun-Kissed! 🤎
text: I really enjoyed using this Wonder Serum bundle! The pre-tan primer and dual-sided application mitt complemented the instant bronzer serum nicely, and the developing glow seemed to provide even coverage that had some staying power! Impressed with this combo set for sure.

title: An Effective Scrub Brush Trio
text: I like that the long-handled brush is dual-sided, and the face brush and body glove offer a soft, yet exfoliating, experience! I also like the blue rubber star grips and the cotton hang loops. This is an affordably priced skincare trio, and I only deducted a star on account of some small scrapes and scuffs that were already present on the wood before I even took them out of the package.

title: Flexible, Adjustable, Lightweight, and Dependable! 💇🏼‍♂️🍉
text: I think most kids 10 and younger will love the flying saucer shape of this umbrella-shaped barber cape! I love the playful watermelon print, and it definitely makes at-home hair trim sessions a breeze! It’s lightweight, flexible, portable, affordable, adjustable, and easy to clean, and I like that it comes with a cute bear sponge and yellow holder clip! The Velcro attachment seems reliably affixed to the neckline, and I’ve had great success with using this cape more than once. Definitely worth a try!

title: A Floral-Printed Variety Pack Worth Trying! 🌻
text: I love the decorative rose patterns that are printed onto these sheet masks, and I appreciate that this 8-pack set features collagen, aloe, pearl extract, squalane, charcoal, and chrysanthemum components! Each of the pouches contains plenty of essence, and I love the mixed variety that’s present throughout the boxed grouping. The masks are easy to place and seem to adhere nicely for the duration of recommended wear, so I’d definitely recommend these fun facial-treatment sheets to others!

title: Rolling Orbs of Massaging Relaxation!
text: I love that these rolling cryo orbs really do seem to help de-puff, sculpt, lift, and tighten the skin! The plastic handles are an attractive shade of robin’s egg blue, and the smooth globes glide easily across my face and neck. They provide a cooling sensation, especially when adequately chilled before use, and the clear containment case makes them easy to store and transport! They seem to be well made and affordably priced, so I’d gladly recommend this cryo globe duo to others! They contain a really neat liquid gel that helps them stay colder longer. ☃️

title: Everything’s Coming Up Roses! 🛁
text: This floral-scented soap trio is absolutely fabulous! The three individual bars of soap are beautifully packaged, and they honestly smell romantically divine. I love that they are a vegan, cruelty-free product, and I appreciate that all the packaging is recyclable! ♻️ The boxed set also includes some mesh storage bags, and this rose-scented group of bars creates some nicely cleansing suds. I think this relaxing beauty product would make a very nice gift!

title: Nicely Polished, Pretty Color
text:
PROS:
This rose quartz stone is smoothly polished and nicely contoured. It’s easy to hold, simple to use, and affordably priced. As a gua sha tool, it can be used for various acupressure treatments on the face, limbs, trunk, and extremities, and it’s easy to transport, store, and clean. It’s a lovely shade of pale pink dreaminess and would make a beautiful gift!

CONS:
It comes packaged in a gift box with a magnetic flap closure, but the rose quartz product I received is not the same size and shape as the custom foam cutout it’s supposed to securely nestle into, so it slides around in the box without adequate protection during transport. The protective foam layer that sits on top of it also doesn’t fill all of the empty space within the box, so my main issue with this product is sloppy packaging. Perhaps my unique experience isn’t fully representative of this brand’s typical order fulfillment, but I received this product in exchange for an honest review, so I hope this information is helpful in some way!

title: A Shimmering Bronze Delight! 🍂✨
text: The almond oil, shea butter, aloe vera, and vitamin E in this body lotion blend together to create a liquid substance with a silky smooth texture, and this shimmering gold goodness glides on easily! It gives my skin an instantaneous glow, and it really does seem to ensure a look of subtle yet even coverage. I like that it’s a wash-off, vegan, cruelty-free formula with a pleasant 🥥 coconut scent, so I’d gladly recommend this Australian beauty product to others!

title: Cheers to Feminine Fizziness! 🌸🛁
text: This fizzy champagne bath bar is beautifully colored and packaged, and it does leave my skin nice and smooth! It breaks easily enough along the partitioned contours and doesn’t seem to crumble too bad. I like the blend of shea butter and sea salt, and the marbleized swirl of pink and white hues is visually attractive, but the scent isn’t incredibly fragrant during use (despite the fact that my dog 🐶 seemed to like it when the plastic wrap was still on). All that being said though, I still think it’s a delightful product for the most part, and it would look great in gift bags, housewarming baskets, bachelorette/bridal party gift boxes, or Christmas stockings!

title: Shimmering Golden Glam Goodness!!
text: I always love finding beauty products that aim to feature “biodegradable” glitter, so I was anxious to try out this metallic body oil! The scent is sublime, and the consistency is dreamy. It spreads easily and mixes well (since the particles settle at the bottom before shaking), and it offers a subtle yet noticeable sheen! It’s also beautifully packaged, and the pump dispenser functions reliably, so overall, I’d gladly recommend this silky skincare product to others!

title: Slippery Slivers of Thin Black Gold! 💽
text: The black pearl extract in these slippery, metallic eye masks has been combined with licorice and aloe vera to create quite a sparkly metallic blend of elements. The tub seems to contain plenty of liquid essence, and the slivers are easy enough to apply to various parts of the face. I love the little spoon scoop tool that’s been conveniently included, and this entire set of 30 pairs seems to be affordably priced! Since the slivers do provide a cooling effect that seems to add a sense of moisturizing hydration, I think they’re worth a shot. It’s easy enough to apply a new pair at the end of each day for a 15-20 minute period of relaxation.

title: Such a Universally Beneficial Tool!
text: This is a lovely rose quartz gua sha massage stone! It’s a pastel pink hue and seems to be nicely polished and contoured. I love how easy it is to use and how versatile its applications are. From a full-body standpoint, it can be used for various acupressure treatments on the face, body, AND extremities, so for such an affordable facial tool/skin scraper, it really does achieve a lot! I do enjoy using it primarily on my face to increase circulation and help with the absorption of various serums, but it’s easily portable and always at the ready. I’d happily recommend it to others!

title: Mineralized Magic! This Crystal-Infused 🥑 Oil is Sublime
text: This crystal-infused Parisian body oil is magical! The chunks of green aventurine float and settle in a sort of suspended animation, and the scent is absolutely sublime. The ylang ylang, white floral essence, and sandalwood scents combine to aromatically provide a light, refreshing smell, and I love that this certified-organic product also features avocado oil, sesame seed oil, and sunflower seed oil. The box has a clearly stamped expiration date, and the plastic product bottle is comfortably sized and attractively designed. I’d gladly recommend this unique blend and brand to others! 🍃

title: Helps Reverse Minor Discoloration and Hydrates Fine Lines
text: The combination of jojoba oil, squalene, tomatoes, sunflower oil, microalgae, and rosemary extract make this retinol skin serum feel deeply nourishing. It does have a fairly thin consistency, but it applies easily enough, and seems to fully absorb. UV-related sun damage has affected most of us to some degree, so I like that this all-natural skincare product tries to help even out pigmented discoloration of age spots and the appearance of fine lines. I appreciate that it’s also a fragrance-free, small-batch, vegan, cruelty-free product, and I’ve personally experienced no issues with prolonged use of it. I’d recommend this concentration of retinol serum to others!

title: A Sequined-Rainbow Trio of Mermaid Tails! 🧜🏼‍♀️
text:
This 3-pack set of children’s hair clips is quite whimsical! I love the mix of multicolored sequins, and the mermaid-tail shapes are quite adorable. Due to their appreciable size, adults could wear them too, even clipped to a belt or a bag, so these offer plenty of accessorizable possibilities. The silver alligator clips all feel securely attached, and the teeth offer a fairly good grip, but they won’t hold much hair back on their own (they’re primarily just a novelty decoration).

In the set I received, one of the faux pearl beads has a visible surface scratch, and there are some scattered areas where the sequins don’t fully go all the way to the edge, but in photos and from a distance, these sparkly shapes look great! Each one is backed by a soft fabric, and they’re pretty lightweight overall.

title: Super Smooth and Attractive! 🍧
text: This pale pink pastel gua sha scraper is great for reliving muscle tension and for increasing healthy circulation! It’s nicely polished, affordably priced, and comfortable to hold for various acupressure treatments, so I’m pleased with this natural stone product overall! It can be placed in the refrigerator prior to use, and it’s easily portable, so the potential usage possibilities are endless. It comes securely contained within a box that features a magnetic flap closure, and handy usage instructions are printed inside!

title: Gentle Yet Effective Foam Cleanser!
text: I really like this fragrance-free, hypoallergenic foam cleanser! The ingredients are printed directly on the front of the squeeze tube, and the salicylic acid component helps keep my occasional breakouts at bay. The tube comes with a foil safety seal in place, and the box has a clearly printed expiration date. The product seems to be adequately sized and described, and I appreciate that it came with some extra samples of hydration cream and hydration gel. I’d definitely recommend this minimalist face wash to others!

title: A Contemporary Tool that Provides Muscle-Relaxing Pressure! 💿
text: What a cute little tool this is! I love that the handle has some substantial weight to it, I like that the 360-degree rotating (plastic) heads resemble little disco balls, and the device seems to have an ergonomically designed shape that’s comfortable to use and hold! This little compact stainless steel-handled contraption is really quite versatile and I love the relaxing feel of the waterproof, rotating, faceted heads. The complimentary soft storage pouch is a much-appreciated bonus, and I’d gladly recommend this facial/body tool to others!

title: Easy-To-Use 3-Step Skincare System!📍🧿
text:
The cleanser is a thick gel-like substance that transforms from a clear slimy state into a dense white foam once water is applied. It creates a fairly thick layer of sudsy cleanser, but it rinses away easily and leaves my skin feeling prepped and primed for step two!

The bio-cellulose mask has a gelatinous texture, so it adheres better and has a bit more weight to it than some other sheet masks I’ve tried, and it’s also easier to unfold because it has a removable backing layer present on each side that keeps it from sticking to itself. The pouch also seems to contain plenty of essence.

The energy cream then becomes a nice final step because it genuinely seems to help lock in the hydrating effects of the previous two treatments. All of the products are basically unscented, so fragrance sensitivities aren't an issue, and I haven’t experienced any mild reactions or dryness of any kind.

Overall, I am really impressed with the performance of this 3-step skincare system from South Korea, and I appreciate that the set included some complimentary sample product packets too!

title: This One Helps Banish Breakouts! 🥊
text:
I’ve now used this treatment cream a handful of consecutive nights, and I have genuinely seen some beneficial results! Due to the 5% concentration of benzoyl peroxide, it works great as a spot treatment. It smooths on easily, absorbs fairly well, and a little goes a long way.

I appreciate that it comes with a foil safety seal in place, and I haven’t noticed any sort of worrisome dryness. I will say that this is a pretty small tube though, and since the perceived value of anything is widely subjective, a list price of $24.95 might deter some potential buyers while leaving others unconcerned. Overall, it’s an effective product that does exactly what it promises to do!

title: Such a Uniquely Colored Shade of Jade!
text: This is one of the most uniquely colored jade gua sha tools that I’ve ever come across! I love the chunky mineral inclusions and the muted mossy green pastel hue. It’s nicely shaped, comfortable to hold, and it’s smoothly polished all over too! I love using it for different acupressure techniques and along my facial contours, so I’d definitely recommend this one to others. It even comes in a little tin box with a hinged lid and a matching celadon-green polishing cloth!

title: Glittery Blue Globes — They See Me Rolling 🖲
text:
These ice globe products are very popular at the moment, and I’ve seen them showing up recently in several magazines. They are quite the eye-catching novelty product, but they do also seem to provide some visible benefits! They help stimulate lymphatic drainage, increase circulation, and encourage collagen production, so they work great as facial tools, and I like that they can be used as BOTH hot or cold therapeutic tools.

That being said, the product box and usage instructions seem to have several typos present, and I’d honestly prefer that they not contain glitter. It seems like a sparkly and attractive quality in the listing photos, but in person, I get the feeling that these tools have been marketed to adolescents or teenagers. All in all, they seem affordable and visually intriguing, and I haven’t had one break yet, so I’m anxious to see how they hold up over time!

title: What an Attractive Set! ❤️
text: I love the super slick, shiny surface of this stainless steel heart-shaped gua sha piece, and it’s always cool to the touch at room temperature. It’s comfortable to hold, has a very slim profile, and it always immediately provides a relaxing sense of rebalanced alignment. This gua sha tool also comes with a pink polishing cloth and a red leather storage pouch, and it’s cheaper than some of the other ones I’ve found! The snap on the pouch flap is secure and reliable, the stitching is straight, and the scraper device fits snugly inside. I’m really pleased with this product overall!

title: Rainbow-Handled, Reliable Makeup Assistant! 🍭
text: I love the rainbow-chrome, reflective shine of this brush handle, and the ombré-tinged bristles are super soft! The brush is a great length overall, it’s comfortable to hold, it’s easy to use and clean, and it seems to be quality constructed. I also appreciate that it came with a protective netting in place that kept all the bristles securely protected. All in all, this makeup brush seems to be affordably priced and effectively designed!

title: Has a Woodsy, Masculine Scent and Leaves Hair Super Soft!
text: This shampoo smells a bit like men’s cologne, but I love the woodsy notes of earthy freshness! It comes packaged with a safety seal under the cap, it dispenses easily, and it leaves my hair so incredibly soft! I almost didn’t even need to use conditioner. The box and bottle have been attractively designed, and the product even comes with a complimentary wildflower seed card! 🌱 I also love that it’s a vegan and cruelty-free product made in the USA, so I’d definitely recommend this one to others, especially those with color-treated hair! It is admittedly quite pricey, but the botanical extracts feel super nourishing. 👩🏼

title: Gives Eyelids a Frosty Champagne Sheen! 🥂
text:
I love the frosty champagne shade of this liquid eyeshadow, and it seems to glide on easily! It can be applied directly to bare skin or layered on top of a base shadow to provide a sparkly finish. Either way, it stays in place better with a mist of setting spray because that definitely keeps it from settling into creases as the hours pass.

It is easily removed with traditional eye makeup remover, and the box has a holographic finish that color shifts, so this is an attractively packaged product overall. I’d definitely recommend it!

title: Such a Soft Experience! ❄️
text: I use sheet masks often, and I love that these packages contain a unique sort of essence that’s much creamier than the liquid serums in most sheet mask pouches!! Each mask unfolds nicely and seems to fit my face well, and the lotion-y substance feels very soft and nourishing. It lingers and absorbs and moisturizes long after the mask itself has been removed. I’d gladly recommend this boxed set of masks to others, and the separate pouches would make great individual gifts too!

title: A Marbleized Set of Earthy, Artisanal Soaps! 🕊
text:
Each of these handmade soap bars has been beautifully colored and thoughtfully produced, and I love that they contain earthy, botanical extracts! The aromas are intriguingly enticing, and each formulation seems to provide a moisturizing sense of clean. They are nicely sized and last a long while!

I love that they come bundled together as a mixed variety pack, and I greatly appreciate that ALL of the packaging is fully recyclable! I’d definitely recommend this boxed set of artisanal soaps to others, especially those who might be looking for a soap product that looks nice enough to gift! 🌠

title: Metallic Slivers Soaked in a Slippery Essence! 📀
text:
