text: These nose strips are super easy to open and place, and they visibly unclog my pores with every use! As long as my skin surface is adequately moistened first, the shiny sides stick down super well, and then the entire strip quickly begins to harden as the water droplets evaporate. Each strip pulls off my nose painlessly, even with the firm grip that’s resulted, and there is visible evidence on the fabric to prove that the strips have actually achieved their goal. This grouped set is priced affordably, and I can honestly say that I’m a little bit addicted to using this product!

title: Moisture with a Hint of Alluring Masculinity! 👕
text: This lotion has performed reliably, and I’d gladly recommend it to others! I like the blend of amber notes and woody top notes, as I think they provide a semi-masculine scent profile that is still alluring and appealing to all genders, and this lotion dispenses easily and spreads with ease, leaving a hydrated skin surface behind that provides a reliable feeling of a moisturized face and body for an entire day’s duration. The packaged set of 4 pump bottles arrived snugly contained within the same cardboard box, and I’ve had no issues or concerns with this product. My boyfriend loves it too!

title: Light, Refreshing, Hydrating Sheet Masks!
text: I’ve enjoyed using my trio of Japanese sheet masks! They are easy to open, unfold, and place, and the solution they’re soaked in is very hydrating. It’s not at all sticky (like some other sheet mask essence solutions can be), and the perceptible mask moisture slowly evaporates over a period of about 20 minutes. Once the placed mask is ready to remove, my skin has already absorbed most of the provided moisture. These facial products are fragrance-free and have little to no scent, so I think they’d be suitable for a variety of skin types. I can definitely see how regular use of this product might help keep surface oil levels stable, while keeping drier skin hydrated as well! No issues or concerns with this one.

title: A Little Goes a Long Way! 👁
text: This is a nice, unisex AM/PM eye cream! I will say that this product does seem to help reduce under-eye puffiness, and it helps ease the appearance of dark circles, lines, and creases. It has a very light scent that would appeal to all genders, and the moisturizing effects linger and are still perceptible many hours later. A little goes a long way, so I did definitely follow the suggested use of half a pump per application, but it smooths on easily and absorbs quickly. And my boyfriend genuinely likes this eye cream too!

title: Pore-Minimizing, Creamy, Egg-Based Cleanser! 🐣
text: This was my first time using a facial cleanser with egg extract as one of the primary ingredients, but I’ve been so impressed with the results! This cream is like a smooth white lotion that’s semi-solid when it squeezes out of the tube. It doesn’t have noticeable air bubbles like a typical foam, nor does it suds up with liquid bubbles like a traditional facial wash would; it just glides on like a cream and feels very nourishing. It has a sweetly pleasant scent that caught me by surprise, and it leaves my normal-oily skin feeling tighter and squeaky clean! It really does seem to diminish the visibility of my pores, and it provides me with a smooth, crease-free surface that offers a better base for my liquid cosmetics. I would definitely recommend this Korean egg cleanser to others, and I will quite likely order more for myself! 🥚

title: Cooling Hydration and Skin Nourishment in a Tub!
text: I like the blend of gold and plant-based collagen in these gelatinous eye masks, and they’re quite affordable overall, especially considering how many you receive in a single tub! They are super lightweight and flexible, and they’re simple enough to place and adjust for optimal coverage. They do offer a cooling sense of hydration and nourishing softness, and the light scent is pleasant enough. They don’t make a huge difference with under-eye puffiness, dark circles, or wrinkles, but they do provide some delicately perceptible benefits!

title: Nice Variety But Hard to Determine Colors at a Glance
text: This is a nice set of mini bottles for customers who like a wide color variety, and I love that the box also includes a base coat, a glossy top coat, and a matte top coat. I will say that the glitter red one looks more purple, and the 9 polishes don’t have color labels; they only have alphanumeric codes that are meaningless without some sort of legend as a guide. But no legend is included, so you have to unscrew every bottle to determine what it is. That being said, they do seem to dry and cure well under a UV/LED nail lamp, but they only have a solid wear time of about one week.

title: Luxurious Coconut Bliss! 🥥
text: The blend of sesame, sunflower, and jojoba seed oils complements the verbena nicely, and this body oil makes your skin smell like a tropical coconut dream! It slathers on smoothly and does seem to absorb nicely, leaving behind a smooth and conditioned skin surface for the next several hours. The nozzle tip seems to be the ideal size for the viscosity of this product, and the oil concoction squeezes out easily without any unnecessary drips or spills. I love using this skin treatment after a day spent outside (poolside or lakeside), and I also love that it’s a cruelty-free product made in the USA!

title: An Incredibly Soothing and Relaxing Salt Crystal Experience! 🛁
text: I love the blend of lavender, chamomile, and frankincense in this relaxing bath soak! The epsom salt component dissolves nicely and leaves no residue behind, giving me a truly delightful bath-time experience!! The jar is generously sized and I dutifully reach for it every time I wish to unwind. I’d readily recommend this product to others or gladly add a tub of this granulated stuff to a spa gift basket as a thoughtful gesture for a family member or friend!

title: An Effective Unisex Facial Product!
text: This formula has a light and pleasant scent, and I feel that it would easily appeal to all genders. I like the 1.6% salicylic acid content, since that’s a slightly higher level than other acne products often offer, and it goes on smoothly while offering long-lasting hydration. This cream does help control breakouts and it effectively addresses active blemishes. I’ve experienced no issues with troublesome drying or overall skin sensitivity, and the bottle features a clearly marked expiration date. Applying it before bed is a perfect treatment approach, and I even had my boyfriend try out this product as well, and we have both been pleased with the results!

title: Mulberry Magic: Blemishes Be Gone! 🪄
text: I did find this formula to be nourishing, enriching, and revitalizing! I’ve never before used a skincare product that consists mainly of mulberry tree extracts, but this Korean beauty brand doesn’t disappoint. The white cream smooths on easily and seems very hydrating, but users should expect to feel a minor burning sensation when this gets applied to active blemishes — although in my opinion, that clearly just indicates that the ingredients are targeting exactly what they’re intended to target and treat! The burning feeling quickly dissipates though, and the cream soaks into the skin like a moisturizing lotion. The pleasant scent smells botanical to me, and I’ve had no sensitivity issues or concerns with this one. I generally rely on salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide products, but I can say that this formula offers me comparable results. I’d gladly recommend this one to others!

title: Left My Hair Shiny and Easily Manageable! ✅
text: When this product box arrived, I was definitely excited to try this anti-frizz haircare trio! The combination of vegan keratin and moringa seed oil left my hair shiny, soft, and manageable, and even my dog was attracted to the subtle aromas. The shampoo and styling cream both had a light and fresh scent, but I will say that the conditioner smelled slightly more medicinal. All of the solutions seemed to have a great consistency, and the shampoo was a lovely pearlescent white hue. After showering, my below-shoulder-length hair was incredibly easy to brush through, and the styling cream gave my damp hair some subtle lift and hold when I paired it with a heat diffuser tool. I live in Texas, and humidity is always an issue, but these products seemed to weather well under sweltering conditions. This brand seems to offer comparable results to other keratin combos I’ve tried, so all in all, I’m happy with all 3 of these formulas!

title: Nourishing and Jiggly! I Love This Honey Blend 🌟🌸
text: This aloe, honey, calendula concoction is absolutely divine!! The light, floral scent is aromatically refreshing, and I love the jiggly consistency of this mask product. It’s like a smooth, lightweight lotion that’s been infused with little exfoliating granules of woodland magic! Just smear it on and you’ll instantly take a deep breath and relax! It’s adorably sized and affordably priced, so I’d readily recommend it to others and/or give it as a gift. It’s 70% organic, and it even comes in a glass jar that’s recyclable! I’m so pleased with this one. I love Round Barn Apothecary products. ✅

title: This Unique Mask/Moisturizer Combo Provides Soft and Luminous Results!
text:
I love the mixed blend of macadamia oil, vitamin E, shea butter, and rice bran extract that’s been soaked into these bamboo-based Tencel masks! Each packaged mask is wrapped around a mesh layer that provides some gripping texture during the unfolding process, and the overall mask thickness seems to be just right. Once placed on the face, each mask adheres well and smooths out easily enough, and the various package compartments tear open with ease! The rice cream “topping” is a creamy white lotion that has a light and pleasant scent, and it seems to be very hydrating. After 20 minutes of combined wear, I just peel off the creamy mask combo and find that I’m left with a soft and refreshed skin surface.

From a universal user standpoint, I think it’s worth mentioning that 99% of the wording on the product box and packaging is foreign, so unless the customer can read Korean, much gets lost in translation. Without having access to the product listing page on Amazon, it’s not readily apparent how to approach and overlap both steps of the process. Some users might assume that the 2nd step comes after wearing the Tencel mask and removing it, rather than layered application of the 2 components simultaneously. For a list of ingredients, consumers would also need to refer to the English content on this product page. Beyond that minor language barrier though, I do love how this mask and lotion topping function together, so I do gladly recommend this product to others!

title: Golden and Gelatinous! 🌟
text: I do like the blend of 24-karat gold micro particles and collagen that are present in these gelatinous eye patches, and they seem to adhere fairly well once placed on the skin. It’s nice that they can be used across any part of the face, and since the essence provides nourishing levels of general hydration, they effectively target puffiness and parched areas universally. This product does contain a long list of ingredients (as shown on the back of the box), but for a jar of 60 pieces, this product genuinely seems to provide an effective facial treatment at an affordable price. I had no issues with skin sensitivity, and this brand seems comparable to other similar eye gels I’ve tried. If you like the cooling sensation that comes with the application of glistening undereye patches, then it’s worth giving these a shot! ✨

title: Hydrating, Refreshing, and Nicely Scented! 🧖🏽‍♀️
text: I love the blend of argan oil, citrus peel, lavender oil, sunflower seed oil, vitamin E, aloe vera extract, and shea butter in this shampoo! I’m thrilled it’s made in the USA, and the mix of natural ingredients does seem to gently cleanse my hair while providing a nourishing sense of freshness! The consistency is lightweight and bouncy, and the solution has a pleasant scent. It rinses out easily and leaves my hair feeling soft and manageable. I think it would be perfect for men or women, and it’s nice that this set includes 2 bottles! I’m very pleased with the results.

title: Rose Quartz Lovelies 🌸 and a Soft Headband Too!
text: I love natural stone rollers and massage tools, and this rose quartz set is divine! The stones are a beautiful shade of pale pink, and the metal hardware readily complements the overall design. The dual-ended roller exhibits smooth and silent movement, and the gua sha heart piece is very comfortable to hold. The super soft headband is a beautiful shade of warm bubblegum pink, and the Velcro provides a snug and secure hold. I love pampering myself with these rose quartz delights when I really need to increase circulation and stimulate lymphatic drainage, and the results are refreshing. This is truly a lovely gift set of facial tools, and the included headband beauty accessory (and instruction sheet) are an awesome bonus! I’d highly recommend this product to family, friends, and coworkers (but you should really order one for yourself)! I also have the jade version of this roller and gua sha tool from the same brand, and it’s great too! 🛍

title: Each Pouch Provides Tons of Juicy-Extract Goodness! 🥑
text: I love that these masks are a cruelty-free product, and I love that they offer a refreshing sense of natural hydration! Each biodegradable sheet is made from plant fibers, and each package is filled with a generous amount of juicy extracts. These sheets are slightly thicker than some of the other face masks I’ve recently used, so they’re easy to unfold and place. Once proper placement is achieved, they also seem to adhere well for the entire duration of chosen wear time. They have a very light scent and no added fragrance, so they should be suitable for all skin types. You can certainly place them in the refrigerator prior to use, but I’ve found that they provide a cooling sensation even at room temperature. Once I’m finished with each mask, I just drop it in my composter and let the cellulose-based fibers revert back into organic matter. ♻️ The 5-pack set is very affordable, and I can recommend this product without hesitation!

title: Beautiful Shade of Jade, Smooth and Silent Movement! 🥝
text: This jade dual roller and massage stone are such beneficial tools to have in your skincare arsenal! I love how the gold hardware complements the mossy green jade hues, and the roller attachments both seem to exhibit smooth and silent movement. The gua sha stone is nicely sized and comfortable to hold, and I appreciate that the box has foam cutouts that allow each tool to nestle safely inside. The set comes with a helpful instruction sheet, and I think that this product is reasonably priced! The only reason for deducting a star is due to the noticeable presence of some adhesive residue that was left around the joint of one of the gold roller attachments with the shaft. Other than that small visual defect, all of the other natural stone blemishes are attractive and acceptable.

title: I Love This Multicolored Set of Shimmery Metallic Pigments! 🪅
text:
I’ve been really pleased with this set of 8 metallic pigments!! They are very shimmery, as promised by the manufacturer, and they catch the light beautifully (especially in social media videos with a ring light present)! I use my fingertips to dab the clear fix gel into place across my eyelids and beneath my lower lash lines. After waiting about 10-15 seconds, it becomes just tacky enough to really hold the applied pigment. With the tub sealed, I just shake the container upside down so that some pigment collects on the inside of the cap, and then I just use a dry fingertip or brush to tap collections of the powder onto my lids.

Users should definitely keep each eye closed until it all dries (in order to prevent lid creases) but then wearers can lightly mist it all into place with a setting spray and they’ll be good to go for hours! At the end of the night, it all washes off easily, and if it has been intentionally fixed in place, it won’t scatter or smear or cause stray sparkles throughout the day. ✨

title: They See Me Rolling 🍵 3-Piece Set!
text: This 3-piece facial set provides all of the basic essentials! The dual-ended jade roller seems to exhibit quality construction with a smooth rolling mechanism, and the gold hardware complements the  overall aesthetic and upscale look of the piece. The gua sha massage tool is nicely sized and comfortable to hold, and the included cotton headband is an appreciated extra! All of the pieces fit snugly within the product box foam insert, and while these pieces of jade are a very pale shade of green, I can still see color variations throughout, further supporting the claim that these are naturally sourced stones. Whether purchasing it as a gift for yourself or a friend or loved one, I think the recipient will be pleased!

title: Hydrating and Nourishing Slippery Slivers of Gold!
text: These adorable gel eye patches offer customers a delightful way to quickly indulge! The tiny golden flecks absolutely sparkle and glisten, and since each little patch can be a bit slippery to wrangle, a plastic spoon scoop is included for fetching them from the tub. They are super lightweight and flexibly floppy, but once seated in place, they adhere super well to the skin beneath the eyes, and they stay firmly seated until you’re ready to peel them off. They have a light, pleasant scent, and they always leave my skin feeling hydrated and nourished! This tub of 30 pairs is very affordably priced at just $7.99, so I feel like this is another Korean beauty product that’s easily attainable at a desirable price!

title: Dries Super Fast but Requires 4-5 Coats of Polish and It’s More of a Pastel Shade!
text:
I was anxious to try this “neon” nail polish, as I always love wearing eye-catching shades in the summer, but while this color is admittedly brighter than a matte pastel, it’s still less vivid than a true neon hue.

Pros:
Dries super fast!!
Feels very smooth to the touch
Will last for an entire week
Doesn’t chip (if you apply a topcoat)
Easy to remove
Good application brush

Cons:
Requires 4-5 coats in order to achieve even coverage
Very thin formula
Strong smell
Not that vivid of a hue
It definitely has pale lime green undertones

Overall, I love the quick-drying feature and glossy finish, but the color isn’t really neon, and no polish should require such an excessive number of coats.

title: Iridescent Fuchsia Enchantment!! 🔮
text: Let me first mention how gorgeous this holographic packaging is! The design is so dramatic and captivating; you can’t help but want to see what sort of product lurks inside. The dual-ended tube is easy to use, and it’s super easy to transport and tuck inside a clutch. The berry lip gloss has a thin consistency and dries fairly quickly to a matte, wine-colored base stain. Due to the smudge-proof design of the formula, it has a tendency to dry a bit unevenly, and it will stay slightly darker in some spots, depending upon how your lips absorb the stain overall. Due to that minor splotchiness, I would not feel comfortable wearing the lip stain alone but... when I apply the glitter-infused conditioning transformer balm on top, pure MAGIC results! It turns your pout the most-alluring shade of iridescent, sparkly fuchsia! The pearlescent transformation layer is very conditioning, but it will kiss off and transfer like a typical lipstick or gloss does, so after eating or drinking, that layer needs to be reapplied if you hope to revive the glistening purple-sparkle shade. After all-day or all-night wear, I can confirm that the lip stain will not smudge, but it does start to slowly wear away from the center, so rather than all of the hue disappearing at once, it has the tendency to linger at the edges — so you basically just look like you’re wearing lipliner. All in all, it’s not super long-lasting, but the hue is vibrantly vivid and eye-catching when the glittery smooth balm is applied!

title: Holistic Cleanser That’s Great for Everyday Use! 💟
text: This celestial cleanser contains mineral clay, cucumber, and melon components that help to draw out impurities AND leave my skin feeling refreshed. With no sulfates, synthetic fragrances, or dyes present, it truly offers a purifying sense of holistic cleanliness. The packaging is visually attractive, the color scheme is appealing, and I also love that this product is made in the USA! I will say that the non-foaming solution does have a thin consistency and a very faint scent, but it still works great as a makeup remover, even without any appreciable sudsing action. The creamy feel is delightful, and it rinses away easily, leaving a smooth skin surface behind. Perceived value at the current price point of $29.99 is a subjective determiner that will vary from customer to customer, but from just a product perspective, I feel like this cleanser provides quality results!

title: Cleanse and Clarify with Black Gold and Charcoal! 🌟🌘
text:
What a gorgeous and delightfully scented substance this is! The pouches contain a rich black goo that is infused with metallic flecks of shimmery gold sparkle, and that glistening element makes the product feel that much more sumptuous! The mineral-rich mask does seem to effectively draw out impurities while leaving my skin hydrated and detoxified. I love that the charcoal powder exfoliates while the gold component helps trigger a rejuvenating sense of enrichment.

You can certainly use a brush to apply the substance (instead of your fingertips) if you so choose to, but I smoothed it on generously with my hands and still had even-enough coverage to produce great results. After about 20 minutes, 95% of my tightened film mask truly peeled off all in one piece! It does have a tendency to stick to hair like tar, so just be conscious of that when applying it near your hairline.

I would suggest cutting the package apart on 3 of the 4 sides, so that you have a flat surface from which to easily access all the goo, but the provided quantity seems plenty sufficient. I’d highly recommend this cruelty-free product to others, and these individually wrapped mask packets make them a perfect gifting option! I was truly impressed by the overall results, and I can now say that I prefer this brand over other charcoal-mask brands I’ve tried.

title: Pretty, Feminine, and Oh So Smooth! 🩰
text: I love my new set of vitamin-E enriched lip balms! They are tinted with subtle yet discernible hues that complement a variety of complexions and skin tones, and I love that they’re all cruelty-free products. These balms have a low melting point, so they go on very smoothly and offer hours of long-lasting hydration. Their scent is pleasant, the packaging is attractive, and I’d definitely order them again or give them out to family and friends as adorable gifts! I’ve been trying to pick a favorite shade, and I think I’d go with the “DUSTY ROSE,” but I genuinely love them all equally and always look forward to finding one of these tubes somewhere in my purse.

title: Will Diminish Redness of Scar Tissue and Discoloration from Post-Inflammatory Hyperpigmentation
text: This Rescue No. One Cream by Science of Skin goes on smoothly! I love that it contains green tea and other natural plant extracts like grape-seed oil, green algae, and magnolia bark. For the treatment of scars due to acne/healed blemishes, I really would advise using it twice a day on problem areas. While it will address the lingering discoloration that often results from post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, it’s primarily designed to reduce and eliminate the redness of thickened scar tissue. It genuinely does seem to be gentle but effective, and no alcohol or parabens are present in this vegan, cruelty-free product from the UK! The bottle features a reliable pump-dispenser attachment, and the mentioned Cosmo magazine feature is a reassuring accolade for sure! I can see why this one has won several beauty awards. 🏆 I’ve been impressed by the results.

title: Pearlescent and Shimmery Superstar! 🌟
text:
I’m really pleased with the consistency and pearlescent hue of this product! It’s definitely more silver than it is light pink, but it applies smoothly, and the slightly drier consistency of the gel means that it adheres pretty well to whatever spots you dot it onto. It’s not overly creamy, so it doesn’t have the tendency to smear or travel like some other highlighters do, and it quickly dries in place. The product tube is attractively shaped, but the sponge-tipped applicator does take a little bit of tugging to fully dislodge from the inner lip of the tube (that’s there to help scrape off excess gel). The internal dimensions of the tube don’t allow for much product to fit inside, so you don’t receive quite as much highlighter as you might initially expect to, but what is there is delightful.

Overall, I love the product, I just think the tube design has some room for improvement! From a usage standpoint, I wear this metallic goodness daily, and I love to apply this shimmery iridescence to certain spots on my face. Namely, the inner corners of my eyes, the area just beneath my brow bones, the centermost spot down the bridge of my nose, and the v-shaped area of the Cupid’s bow just above my upper lip. Highlighting all of those specific areas will really help illuminate your face in social media videos! 💫

title: Does Not Spray As a Fine Mist but Works Well Otherwise!
text: This little bottle of moisture mist setting spray is conveniently sized, and the smell reminds me of a lightly scented floral hand sanitizer! Once sprayed, it does dry fairly quickly and doesn’t leave any sort of sticky or tacky residue behind, but since the pump allows so much product to spray out at once, liquid droplets land on my face instead of a light micro-mist — so that’s a huge drawback. 💦 Once I’ve reached the step of wanting my finished makeup to stay put, I don’t welcome the introduction of large, wet droplets onto my cosmetic handiwork. I think the actual liquid solution is great, put the pump lid needs some sort of mechanical improvement.

title: Mini Makeup-Sponge Delights! 🪅
text: These little mini beauty blender makeup sponges are super adorable and handy to have in my beauty arsenal! They help me apply products sparingly along facial curves and crevices that only require a small amount of shadow or highlighter. They’re super soft, appropriately sized, affordable, lightweight, and available in a pleasing blend of neutral colors. They’d make a great gift for yourself (or friends and loved ones), and I’d order them again for sure!

title: Great Tropical Cleansing Balm! 🍍
text: I love the combination of jojoba oil and pineapple extract in this cleansing balm, and the packaging design is really attractive! This cruelty-free Korean skincare product tube arrives with a small safety seal in place, and the solution works great as a nighttime cleanser when I need to remove my makeup at the end of the long day. I would say there’s a lightly detectable scent, but no added fragrance, and it seems to work great for my sensitive skin. I recommend massaging this product into dry skin in order to really penetrate and dissolve away the adhered surface particles, then wipe it away easily with a warm, wet washcloth and you’ll be left with a smooth and lightly hydrated face!

title: Silky Smooth Balayage Extensions!
text: These extensions are absolutely divine! They’re easy to place, easy to straighten, super soft, and the tape components seem to provide a secure and reliable grip! I ordered the 18” variety and I absolutely love the length and movement. The color gradation is so attractive, and each segment provides a sleek and layered look that seems to wash and wear well over time. The package also included a complimentary rhinestone star hairpin that is beyond darling, and I look forward to wearing these extensions for as long as I can!

title: Nourishing Skin-Rejuvenation Product! 💦
text:
This is a very unique Korean beauty serum! I can definitely say that I found it quite pleasing to “burst the Red Shot” pomegranate extract component by pressing down on the pump. Then shaking it well to mix all of the ingredients together was a very satisfying experience! I like that this solution promises to help maintain a healthy skin barrier by using natural plant extracts that strengthen the microbiome. It contains rosemary, eucalyptus, fruit juice, and other root and flower extracts. Since fermented skin care products offer increased rates of absorption, I was anxious to try this serum on my combination skin. And I loved the results!

I also greatly appreciated seeing a sticker on the box that provided an English translation of the product instructions, since all of the other words printed on the box are in Korean. The box also had a clearly marked expiration date on one end. I genuinely feel like this soothing serum smooths fine lines and helps even my overall complexion. It has a pleasant scent and goes on smoothly. The antioxidants excite me!

title: Highly Polished, Nicely Sized, Easy to Use!
text:
I will say that these gua sha stones are comfortable to grip and hold, and they make excellent massage assistants! Increasing circulation helps stimulate lymphatic drainage and encourages cellular regeneration and healing over time, so these two devices equip users with a natural approach to whole-body wellness. The marbleized paper box they arrive in is attractive, and each tool comes separately protected within its own bubble wrap bag. But since the set only comes with one pink drawstring pouch, there’s no way to keep the pair properly separated for safe storage (without a second travel pouch being present). I wish 2 soft bags had been included.

While my heart-shaped piece has one line of visible, milky veining present, the other piece does not. The uniformity of the stones makes me question whether or not they come from naturally sourced jade. Most mineral sources show a wide range of perceptible imperfections, but these tools are highly polished and a fairly vibrant shade of green, so who knows whether they were manufactured or not. Overall, I think these are attractive, functional, and affordably priced. They’d likely make an excellent gift.

title: Eco-Conscious Exfoliation! 🌎 So Awesome!
text: I absolutely love the mix of lavender, bergamot, rosemary, aloe vera, dandelion root, juniper, grapefruit oil, and vitamin B5 in this cruelty-free product! The walnut shells and rosehip seeds give this vegan face scrub an earth-friendly texture that contains absolutely no microbeads! The scent is so earthy fresh and invigorating, and I appreciated finding a small foil safety seal present under the cap. This product is non-drying and truly leaves my skin feeling incredibly rejuvenated and refreshed. The texturized mixture stimulates circulation and removes the outermost skin layer, allowing for deeper penetration of moisturizers and serums that are applied post-scrub. I gladly use this concoction daily, and I’m happy to know I can recycle the product tube once it’s all gone! ♻️ (I’ll definitely be ordering more at that point) and recommending it to all my friends. What a great company — kudos to these skincare specialists!

title: Total Social Media Game-Changer! ⭐️
text: This is the first selfie ring light that I’ve ever used, and I’m beyond pleased with its capabilities! It is lightweight, easily portable, and the tripod base is sturdy and dependable — it even sits securely on my sloped driveway when I’m filming short videos outside. When I’m inside, the ring light offers a wide range of light hues and brightness levels, and it’s simple enough to plug it into a USB charger. The remote pairs easily through Bluetooth, and it’s incredibly lightweight and easy to use. I will say that I accidentally dropped it once, and the remote popped apart into 3 pieces, but I easily placed the flat battery back inside and popped the two plastic halves back together (and it’s worked fine ever since). I pair this product with my iPhone 12 Pro Max that’s in a mag charger case, and the bendable grip stand expands to hold the width of it just fine. I will say that due to the weight of my phone, it will sometimes start slowly leaning forward, but I just angle it back up a little and film the next segment. The pole features a range of available heights, and it’s simple to lock the extensions into place with one hand. With the remote clicker, and stabilizing stand, and adjustable height options, my social media content has really excelled this year! I’d definitely recommend this product.

title: A Playfully Colored Brush and Comb Combo! 🌸✔️
text: This hair care set effectively performs its intended purpose! The paddle brush offers a comfortable experience with the nylon ball-tipped bristles that are present, and I love the pink and black color scheme. I do feel like the brush’s handle is a bit too short, but it might be ideal for adolescent hands that are a bit smaller than the average adult’s. The comb also performs as expected, and I’ve had no issues or concerns with using it. I have naturally wavy hair, and while the brush works well for me (on wet or dry strands), I’d be curious to know if it is just as effective for naturally curly locks. Overall, it’s an attractive 2-piece set.

title: Lightweight and Simple to Use!
text: This portable nail lamp is dependable and handy to have access to at home. It’s lightweight, easy to use, and provides ample room for fingers or toes beneath the dome. The digital display provides a clear indication of what’s been selected among the 60s, 80s, and 99s options, and it seems to effectively cure UV-activated polishes, just as promised. I’d recommend placing a small white towel beneath it, in order to protect whatever surface the light is consistently shining down on, but overall, I’m impressed with this lighting product, and I really love the auto on/off sensor feature it comes equipped with!

title: Great for Curls and Waves, Lightweight! 💢
text: I love the metallic red accent on this one, and the way that it complements the matte black finish. The digital display is easy to read, and the cord freely rotates with ease! While not immediately apparent, the power button and temperature mode switch is located on the inside of this hair tool’s handle, so that feature took some getting used to, but this 2-in-1 product heated up quickly and it seems to be very dependable! I have found that the 180-degree setting works best for me, and this device is great for making curls and waves. As far as the straightening capabilities go, I’ve experienced better results with other ceramic-plate straighteners, so this product doesn’t fully tame the frizz for me, but it’s definitely lightweight and conveniently sized for travel! I do like that it has an auto-shutoff feature, but I wish that it was a shorter duration than a full 60 minutes. While the interior button does allow you to turn on the device and rotate through the available temp settings, you have to physically unplug the straightener to turn it off manually. All in all, I think this one is affordably priced and versatile!

title: Conveniently Packaged, Single-Use Treatment Towelettes!
text: These wipes are quite hydrating and have a light, clean scent! I like that they’re a vegan product containing simple ingredients like willow bark, lactic acid, and aloe leaf juice, but they don’t do as much for me as other products do (especially those containing benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid as the main ingredient). I think that these disposable wipes are attractively packaged and affordably priced, but they might not be stringent enough to tackle all types of problem skin. Being individually wrapped, they are a convenient option for trips to the gym or exercise sessions outdoors, so I suspect that they’d be a perfect match for certain customers, but for me, they only acted as basic cleansing wipes that didn’t offer much additional treatment for active and future breakouts.

title: Leaves Hair Soft and Straight! 👩🏼
text: The dark hunter green color of this heated hair brush is appealing, and the gold/coppery rim accents add a nice touch. The device does genuinely help to smooth frizz by eliminating static electricity along the hair shaft, so your tresses end up soft and smooth! The thermal insulation feature makes it easy to hold and manipulate, especially when you don’t have to worry about scorching yourself on accident. It heats up quickly, the LED screen is easy to read, and the cord seems freely flexible (but it does not rotate) — making this one much better suited for straightening hair rather than curling it. And like most heated hair tools, this one gives you a few different temperature levels to choose from. It shuts itself off after 20 minutes of inactivity, so that safety feature is hugely appreciated, and I’m really pleased with the results overall! This one is quite dependable and perfect for daily use or travel.

title: Moisturizing Skin Protection! 🌞🧴
text: This broad-spectrum sunscreen delivers the promised results. It genuinely seems to blend seamlessly and hydrate skin while doing so. It has little to no fragrance, and it offers noticeable, moisturizing effects when used daily. I’ve willingly added it to my consistent beauty product routine, especially now that hot summer days are approaching! Thorough prevention of potential UV damage is a critically important step in the fight against skin cancer. When sunny-day activities are on the agenda, this product is a great tool to have on board!

title: Smooth Conditioning, Smells Like Coconuts! 🥥
text: What a delightfully scented leave-in conditioner product! I love that this spray contains vitamin-rich nutrients and aloe vera, and it legitimately smells like fresh coconuts!! I use it right after I shower and then let my hair air-dry overnight. The next morning, my locks are smooth, soft, shiny, and easily manageable. I’m really impressed with the results of this salon-quality spray! 👩🏼 I’d order it again and recommend it to my friends for sure.

title: These Help You Put Your Best Foot Forward! 🦶🏽
text: I’m pleased with the skin resurfacing capabilities of this foot-exfoliating set of pumice stones! The beech wood handle of the long file is smooth to the touch and comfortable to hold, and the braided cotton rope attachments of each piece hang easily on the included hook accessories. It’s also nice that the hooks have clear backs, and I love that these pumice stones are naturally occurring elements that are easy to source AND affordable. They have a great texture — making repeated use a welcoming thought!

title: Ros(é) Pink Mask Offers Effervescent Skin Hydration! 🌸🥂
text: I did enjoy using this Korean sheet mask! It does have a light scent of sweet rosé, and it is tinged a rosy pink hue. I suspect that the resveratrol and strawberry extract ingredients might contribute to that blush-infused coloration. The package contains a copious amount of serum, so I found it necessary to squeeze a great deal of it out of the mask before placement to prevent a drippy experience. I patted the extra liquid on my arms, neck, and chest but it did feel noticeably sticky once dry. The mask exhibited good adhesion, and after removing it, I rubbed the remaining serum onto my face (but I will say that it also felt somewhat sticky there too). The directions mention a suggestion of placing this mask in the refrigerator before use, but even at room temperature, it still provided a noticeable, cooling sensation. The hyaluronic acid component does seem to provide lasting hydration after use. I love the mini bubbles printed on the packaging, they look like reflective sequins when the light catches them! At a list price of $8, I’d honestly hesitate to buy only one of these packaged masks; I think a bulk discount option would offer a better deal overall. My skin did seem soft and replenished the next day, so I think this antioxidant-packed product did its job!

title: Offers a Replenishing Sense of Soft Hydration!
text: I love the CICA component of this product, and the other ingredients seem to effectively blend themselves into a hydrating mixture worth trying! The cream goes on smoothly and seems to offer a well-moisturized end result. The smell is comparable to a typical unscented lotion product, and while it doesn’t leave my skin greasy in any way, it does give my face a noticeable shine. It takes a little while for it to really soak in, but it seems to work well when patted on and layered beneath my other makeup products. The cap screws on and off easily, and I appreciate that the tube arrived with a small safety seal in place. I’ve enjoyed adding this Korean skincare product to my daily routine!

title: Bubbly, Foamy, and Oh So Cleansing! 🧼
text: I’m super pleased with this vegan cleanser, and I love that it contains a blend of green tee, cactus, rosemary, and raspberry root extracts! The packaging is whimsically adorable and the plastic cap snaps securely into place. I use one pump of the product daily, and the foam is super soft and nourishing — like a wispy cloud on a mission! I will say that the scent is slightly citrusy and a tad bit medicinal, but it genuinely evokes an aromatic sense of all-natural clean. I massage the foamy solution onto my face and leave it on for about 30 seconds while the mini (micro)bubbles work their magic, and then it rinses off easily without leaving any sort of residue behind. My face feels toned and replenished after each use!

title: Fashionable but Slightly Too Large 🛁
text: I’m always in need of a trusty shower cap, and I’m always on the lookout for one that’s fashionable too! I do love the black-and-white striped pattern of this one, and the fact that the back edge is stretchy and elasticized. In order to ensure a proper fit, you must adjust the bow at the front to suit your individual needs. Since I have a small/average head circumference, I did have to tighten the bow significantly, which threw off the intended style proportions. The bow ends became floppy and were somewhat in my way. The unlined, waterproof, thin vinyl material is like a shower curtain, so it is flexible and dries quickly after use, but for me, this cap just had a little too much material overall. From a practicality standpoint, I’ve had a better fit with the cheap shower caps that have elastic edges all the way around. This product will likely be perfectly suited for some, but I was not one of those ideal people.

title: Hydrating and Anti-Aging Eye Cream!
text: I do like that this product contains a blend of rosehip seed oil, sunflower oil, several essential vitamins, sunflower oil, aloe vera juice, coconut oil, hibiscus flower extract, neem seed oil, and rosemary leaf extract! It has a very faint scent, and I only deducted a star due to all of the grammatical errors on the packaging (and lack of clear usage instructions). English-speaking consumers would be more impressed with a box and listing that had been properly edited, and while the product tub does have a lid that will unscrew, it’s actually been designed with a pump feature. Customers are meant to depress the upper portion of the container straight down so that a small amount of product appears out of a pea-sized hole in the center of the plastic lid portion. Since this aspect is not clearly stated or depicted anywhere, I think most users would assume they are supposed to unscrew the top to access the moisturizer with all of their fingertips, rather than fetching the expressed mini dollop of white moisturizer with one fingertip. Other than those issues, I was pleased with the beauty product itself, and my skin felt hydrated and renewed after several days of consecutive application and use! I think this eye cream has been affordably priced, and it offers plenty of beneficial results.

title: Interesting Hues but NOT Waterproof
text: I would not say that these eyeliners are waterproof. They don’t smudge and they are water-resistant (if you don’t touch your eyes), but a small amount of rubbing while wet will remove the product from your skin, without the use of any sort of soap or eye makeup remover. I like the blue one the best, followed by the purple hue, and then the reddish-brown coffee shade. It’s nice to get 3 color options in one box, but I wouldn't say that these are top-quality makeup products. That being said, I had no issues with skin sensitivity or all-day wear, but they function a bit like markers — if you retouch the tip to a portion of your eyelid where you’ve just placed some of the liner, it picks back up the color in uneven streaks and leaves a patchy application. You must let one swipe of the eyeliner dry completely before layering on more color or a thicker line.

title: Clarifying, Moisturizing, Invigorating! 🌿🚿
text: I’ve truly enjoyed using this set! The shampoo has a beneficial clarifying effect and doesn’t exhibit an unnecessary amount of sudsing, and the conditioner provides an immediate jolt of invigorating scent. I absolutely love the mix of aloe, apricot, almond, rosemary, and coconut oils! I truly feel that these are salon-quality haircare products, and I always look forward to using them! They leave my hair shiny, moisturized, and easily manageable. The fresh scent lingers after use and my strands feel more lightweight and calm overall. Highly recommend!

title: A Luminous Treat for Sensitive Skin! 🕊
text: I will say that this plant-based sheet mask did help bring some moisturized radiance to my face! There was an ample amount of clear serum present in the package, so I did squeeze some of it out of the mask before application (to help avoid any wayward drips). I patted the extra serum onto my neck and chest and wore the mask for about 20 minutes. It seemed to be adequately sized and offered great adhesion. While I did like that no synthetic scents were added, the “natural botanical fragrance” had a faint smell of citronella to me, so I didn’t love the thought of smelling like bug repellent while I was trying to relax, but for an affordably priced, earth-conscious, cruelty-free skincare treat, I’d readily recommend this pearl and diamond infused face mask to others! It gives your skin a needed dose of vitamin B3, all while smoothing fine lines and wrinkles!

title: Very lightly scented and with a generous amount of hydrating goo!
text: I had an enjoyable time using this prebiotic/probiotic beauty product. ☁️🦄 The included mesh layer helped me unfold the quartered mask, since it was moist and squishy and somewhat stuck to itself, but the finished sizing seemed to adequately fit my face. All the cutouts appropriately contoured to my features, and I had no issues or concerns with wearing the mask for the allotted amount of time. Upon peeling away the microfiber layer, my skin was left feeling incredibly soft and smooth, especially after I massaged and patted in the residual product goo. I liked that the solution was just thick enough to not be drippy in any way, and the mask was so velvety soft and thin; I felt like I was wearing a luxurious second skin! I also loved the iridescent, recyclable packaging! Overall, really pleased with this one.

title: Soft Results but Slimy, Sticky Process 🍊🦶🏽
text: This box contains 2 pairs of foot masks. Each “pair” is a solid white, plastic, dual sock-shaped piece that’s sealed along a center seam. There are no included instructions in the box, but it seems fairly clear that customers are supposed to cut the 2 foot bags apart, creating an opening at each ankle. The bags are internally coated with a gel-like substance that smells like chemically artificial blueberries (at least to me). I wear a women’s size 7 shoe and these universal foot sock/bags are undeniably ginormous. Thankfully, they do come with a sticky tab attached, so you can gather them at the ankle and firmly secure them tighter against your leg for the extended 1-hour wear time. Upon removing the bagged treatments, my feet felt very slimy at first. I rubbed in the remaining product as best I could, and then I wiped off the excess moisture with a paper towel. Then for the next hour my feet just felt sticky. After that, I went to bed, and the next morning, my soles were noticeably softer, but it wasn’t really an enjoyable, relaxing experience to get to that point. I do love the vitamin C content of these, and the attractive outer packaging, but the process itself felt a little messy and artificially scented.

title: Aromatic and Whimsical - A Bathtub Delight! 🛀🏽
text: The sweet orange, chamomile, rose, and grapefruit scents of these bath products were delightful, and the dried rose petals were a nice surprise! I wasn’t expecting to receive potpourri sachets in the box (in addition to the bath bombs), so the packaging was a colorful gift in and of itself. I liked that a plastic cutter tool was also included with the set, as it made opening each individually wrapped bath bomb that much easier. With no artificial colors or dyes, I didn’t have to worry about any sort of residual staining, and plenty of colorful, aromatic fizzing occurred with each dissolving use. I can definitely say that these would make an affordably priced gift set!

title: Hydrating and Absorbs Quickly!
text: This cream has a thick, luxurious consistency, but it manages to feel extremely lightweight and hydrating! I love that it contains organic extracts, wildflowers, botanical oils, aloe vera, jojoba oil, and shea butter, and (to me) it has a faint scent of cinnamon! It absorbs quickly and does not leave any sort of greasy or oily quality behind, and it comes attractively packaged with a clearly marked expiration date. I love that it’s also a cruelty-free, vegan product made in the USA! I couldn’t personally wait to try this skincare product out on myself, but I think men would be just as satisfied with the results!

title: Fast-Acting, Antioxidant-Packed Spot Treatment!
text: This skincare product is made in the USA and is free of parabens and sulfates, and while the front of the box indicates that it’s [Specially Formulated For Darker Skin Tones], I experienced no issues using it on my lighter skin (it goes on clear). I do apply this product at night, although I will say it’s tricky to “apply a thin layer” as the product box suggests because it’s quite watery. It does not glide on like a cream or gel; it will drip. I use the included dropper to apply some of the liquid onto my fingertips before patting it onto my face. It does have somewhat of an unpleasant odor, but I have not experienced any sensitivity or irritation, and the sulfur component does seem to actively and effectively fight active blemishes.

title: Ensures a Flawless Finish!
text: I love this super soft foundation brush! The geometric-shaped handle provides comfortable gripping angles, and the hard plastic protective case is extremely handy to have on hand for safe storage before and after use. The bristles are extremely bendable and forgiving, allowing for thorough contouring and coverage. I’ve had no issues or concerns with repeated use of this beauty tool!

title: Burning Sensation But Great Results!
text:
When I mixed a teaspoon of this powder with water, it quickly turned a saturated shade of mustardy chartreuse. The resultant paste applied smoothly enough, but some tiny mineral grains did remain visibly present once it was evenly spread. Within 1 minute of application, I definitely began to feel a burning sensation (like I’d accidentally splashed some pepper juice on my face), and it took several rinses of soap and water to remove the yellow residual stains from my fingertips, but sitting in front of an oscillating fan helped ease the fiery sensation some as the mixture dried on my skin. I did experience a noticeable tightening effect, and the product rinsed off easily when I reached the removal stage.

I was delightfully pleased with the immediate results, and I was just as satisfied with my skin and complexion the following day. All in all, I think the bentonite clay component probably offered the strongest detoxifying effect, but the added presence of various seeds, oats, aloe, turmeric, and cinnamon made for an interesting amalgamation of combined ingredients!

title: Lavender-Scented Lovelies! 🌿
text: I have greatly enjoyed using my 5-pack set of moisturizing hand creams! Each pouch contains a non-greasy formula with a light floral scent, and they make excellent mini beauty/skincare gifts for friends and family. The product leaves my skin soft and faintly fragrant, and I can still detect the lingering softness several hours after application. I recommend these with enthusiasm!

title: Stretchy and Comfortable!
text: This shower cap fits comfortably and seems to serve its intended purpose! The elastic edge offers just the right amount of secure stretch, and the pattern is a fun design! It keeps my hair adequately dry and protected. 👍🏽

title: Inky Enchantment! ✔️
text:
I love this liquid eyeliner! It took me a couple of tries to master smooth application (since I don’t generally use liquid eyeliner), but the results were amazing!

While it’s still wet, it’s very easy to make minor adjustments and corrections, but then once it’s dry, it truly offers all-day, smudge-proof wear that’s reassuringly waterproof! The vibrancy of the inky black shade is alluring on its own, but it also looks enchanting when layered beneath metallic eyeshadow. It comes off easily with eye-makeup remover, and I’m beyond happy to have 2 tubes of it!

title: File These Under Pretty Awesome! 💅🏼
text: I love this pastel assortment of mini nail files! While their length is compact, their overall width is still substantial. The collection of candy colors is pleasing to the eye, and they’d make an affordable gift (they also come in a cute box)! The grit and grain component of each file is also quite satisfactory, so I can confidently say that I’m beyond pleased with the overall presentation and functionality of this product!

title: Gentle, Unscented Formula 🌿
text: This vegan formula is lightweight, unscented, and seems fittingly appropriate for sensitive skin! I experienced no notable issues or concerns with this rice essence toner. Being a Korean skincare product, most of the labeling appears foreign, so I appreciated seeing an additional sticker on the box that provided detailed product instructions in English. The quantity seems generous enough for consistent, daily application. Would recommend. 👍🏼

title: Eye Am Pleased with the Results! 👁
text: I have no prior experience with Philosophy products, but I am pleased with the results of this creamy formula! It spreads on smoothly and has a nice consistency. A thin application seems to absorb well overnight and offers subtle, hydrating benefits that are visually discernible. I’m not sure that I would personally buy a small-quantity jar of eye cream at this price point, but I am happy with the product itself! Will gladly apply and enjoy the contents of the entire container. 🔖

title: Smooth Contenders Guarantee Clear Skin Results‼️
text:
Smooth consistency, unscented, suitable for full-face coverage with daily use. Creamy white formula spreads on easily and dries clear. Results comparable to other benzoyl peroxide treatments I’ve tried. Really pleased with this product! Plan to happily add it to my skincare-defense arsenal. Would gladly recommend it to others. 💯

The salicylic acid serum is equally beneficial, and it dispenses as a clear gel substance. They make a great daily combo!

title: Lightly Scented, Sudsy Soap Solution! 💟
text: I feel this 2-pack of liquid hand soap offers a good quality product for the price! The quantity is substantial, and the solution is just the right amount of viscous and sudsy (not runny, not watery, and it produces noticeable bubbles). 🛁 The scent is slightly more clinical in nature than it is aromatically flowery, but I think it effectively serves a gender-neutral purpose in that regard. The pale lavender hue is attractive, and the bottles arrive securely packaged with a safety seal in place. While I did not notice any appreciable moisturizing qualities per say, it certainly doesn’t further contribute to skin dryness in any way. I’d gladly recommend this soap! It gets the job done.

title: A Perfectly Flexible Fit!
text: I find that this formulation blends seamlessly onto skin (with a matte finish as promised), and it truly helps diminish the appearance of pores. The even coverage ensures all-day-wear and longevity, making it perfect for hot summer days. The product is lightweight and unscented. I especially love the design of the mess-free, no-waste FLEXIBLE pouch! It’s my first time using this sort of packaging, and I am highly impressed by the ingenuity of the design. This “Creamy Beige” concoction FIT me perfectly!

title: Barely There, Hydrating Wear!
text:
I love that these eye masks feature and promote vegan collagen as a skin nutrient! While the microcrystal particles absorb deep within to release smoothing, plumping benefits, the hyaluronic acid component offers a hydrating bonus! 💦

The layered backing around the edges is easy to peel off, and there is some ability and wiggle room to slightly adjust them, if the initial angle of placement doesn’t feel like it has ensured a comfortable fit. Once placed, they exhibit good adherence, and I would describe the manufacturer’s mentioned “sensation” as a feeling of tiny pinpricks. It’s not uncomfortable at all, just topically stimulating, and it quickly dissipates over the first 5-10 minutes of wear.

They are sized appropriately and the external layer is transparent and smooth. They come thoughtfully packaged within a thin, rigid plastic box (inside the product pouch) that has individual indentations for each eye patch to stay separately protected and flat.

I placed a pair on mid-morning and wore them all afternoon while I did errands around the house. After about 6 hours of wear, I found them quick, easy, and simple to remove. A minimal amount of dried residue was left behind that easily rinsed off. I will say, that it’s probably best to avoid wearing them in warm environments because if you perspire, they do have the tendency to shift and slide around somewhat. Overall, I was quite pleased with the product and look forward to using the 2nd included pair soon!

✔️Cruelty-free
✔️Preservative-free
✔️No artificial colors or fragrances
✔️Great for all skin types

title: Hair Needs Conquered with Coiled Ease!
text:
These little black spirals are fairly small when not in use, but their stretch capability is commendable. The glossy coating keeps them slick enough to avoid any sort of tangling, and they offer multi-use versatility. Whether you are hoping to secure a ponytail or a bun, they can fix strands in place with ease! No creases or dents seem to ever be visibly left behind.

This listing set truly does contain 18 coils (6 clear boxes containing 3 rings each). I’m not really sure why they are separated into mini trios, it just seems like an excessive use of packaging to me, but if you are hoping to give them out as gifts, it does provide a convenient feature! 🖤

title: Super Moisturizing and with a Sublime Scent! 🔆
text:
With vitamins C, E, and B5 blended in, this hydrating lotion goes the extra mile to nourish parched and thirsty skin. The provided sense of added moisture feels decadently smooth, and the fresh scent is absolutely sublime! Not at all greasy and the absorption is quick and complete. The plant protein complex component helps ensure thorough moisturization throughout, and supple skin is immediately restored.

For those who often experience dry or cracked skin from frequent hand-washing or sun exposure, I would gladly recommend this (scent)sational🧴 Jergens Ultra Healing variety without hesitation!

I bought Rose Petal, which is okay (not TOO bright) for my very pale, pink-undertone skin. Thank you ChapStik!

title: wonderful everyday moisturizer for dry skin
text: I used this in my 30s and still do in my 40s. It has always been budget-friendly compared to high-end products while not smelling or feeling like a drugstore product. I will say that I have naturally 'good skin' (if dry). Also, I think that most people ought to think about incorporating specific ingredients (start at any age!) like retinols/oids, vitamin c (though this has ascorbic/citric acid in it), and copper peptides. And SUNSCREEN. Nevertheless, sometimes I just want something straightforward and non-irritating. I love this stuff!

It is just what I wanted. If you have another skin tone, yeah, it might not show up. For me, it gives just enough color to seem almost natural and 'finished'. Also, it fell out of my medicine cabinet from a height of about 6 ft and slammed onto a tile floor and the powder was fine. It did not crumble or anything. So the quality is just fine for this price!

By the way, I did not see any initial discoloration in the cream--my tube was perfect from the start.
