title: Depends on what you want…
text: I’m used to nail strengtheners functioning as a base coat and top coat of nail polish. This isn’t nail polish, so if that’s what you’re looking for you should look elsewhere. This strengthener serves as more of an extra layer of “nail”. It’s very natural, which I do love. It will not give you that clear nail polish look, but it will let your nails “breathe”. I found that my nails were able to absorb moisturizer even while wearing this which really helped keep them healthy. It also feels like this strengthener is moisturizing them as well. Now for the cons. It isn’t very lasting because it is more natural. It will start to peel within a couple of days, but I don’t think it is damaging the actual nail which is good. All in all, I do like this strengthener and will continue to use. Will post an update after a few months.

title: Love!
text: Great product and much more sanitary than loufas or glove scrubbers. Been using it for over a year and I really love it! You do use more body wash buy I feel that it cleans well and offers a very gentle exfoliation. I hang it to dry in the shower and it has held up really well.

title: Great for Aquaphor Ointment!
text: As expected! Like other reviewers wrote, these work great with Aquaphor. I use it on my lips and needed a way to apply on the go without using my fingers. Work like a charm! Tip: when filling these up using the syringes in the kit, start filling from the very bottom of the tube to the opening. Otherwise, thicker ointments will get stuck at the opening and you won’t be able to fill completely.  Only con is, I wish there was a more sustainable option.

title: Great product!
text: Comes with multiple attachments and replacements. Easy enough to use for a beginner! Love that you can control the speed of the drill, too. Honestly, I can’t think of anything that I would improve. Great purchase!

title: Great quality oil
text: I haven’t used the product consistently enough to notice significant results so I’ll be speaking mainly about the quality and packaging. The shipping was pristine. It came really well packaged with all the proper tools included. The quality of the oil is great and it doesn't have any odor of any kind. I have acne prone skin so I was a little worried about breakouts but I haven’t had any issues. My lashes do feel softer and using this oil has increased the growth rate!

title: Amazing.
text:
Pricey, but worth it. It lasts a long time. I received this in May of this year and ran out just two weeks ago. I applied it every morning; just a couple shakes into the palm is enough.

Before using this (and after), I primarily used lotion, either body or face. I have oily skin, so a lot of lotion isn't desirable. Good face lotions I've used require just a small amount. Body lotions require more, but then I remove some later in the day.

This lasts almost all day. Even with my oily skin, it's like my face feels lubricated, not oily. There's a bit of sheen that lasts; sometimes I dab my face with a paper towel.

The bottle feels nice in the had. The glass is sturdy and the cap is threaded well. Not once did it get stuck, as sometimes is the case with other bottled supplies. If there's any residue on the threads, a quick clean does the trick.

title: Affordable pouch with patches
text: These pouches with patches are all the rage now but they are SO expensive! This pouch is an affordable alternative. My daughter loves it and uses it as a pencil case for her art supplies rather than a makeup case. It’s perfect for travel and very versatile. Would make a great gift for a preteen or teen.

title: Works with sensitive skin
text: I’ve always been apprehensive to try products with retinol because I have extremely sensitive skin. However, I’ve always heard the great benefits of using a retinol. This product balances the retinol and moisturizer. It was thick but not too heavy where it clogged my pores and aggravated my acne.

title: Holds up to the Hot Tools name
text:
This waver lives up to the Hot Tools name! It heats up quickly, lasts well over time, and is easy to hold.
I have shoulder length, medium-thickness hair and this waver has worked well to give me soft subtle waves.

title: My makeup and Gabby’s dollhouse obsessed six year old loves it
text:
The backpack honestly didn’t last long. The makeup that came in the kit is not the best in terms of quality, but my six year old has enjoyed playing with them simply because it’s associated with Gabby (she was Gabby for Halloween this year and LOVES her).
It’s a cute set and I’d recommend it as a gift option for a Gabby’s dollhouse fan.

title: Typical shampoo; haven’t noticed a difference with growth
text: I haven’t noticed a huge difference in terms of hair growth with this biotin shampoo. It is comparable to other shampoos I have used. I’ve had better success with hair growth with using rosemary based shampoos and hair oils.

title: Roomy makeup bag that works well for traveling
text: This makeup bag has a TON of room for all sorts of makeup tools - brushes, lipsticks, eyeshadows, etc. I've taken this with me on a few trips and it fits nicely in a suitcase or weekend bag. It is also extremely durable and easy to clean which makes it even better.

title: Not bad.
text:
Fine portable mirror that I carry in my backpack. There have been many times that I could've used a portable mirror; a phone doesn't suffice since the "reflection" is going to be reliant on the quality of the front-facing camera. I also wanted a mirror that wasn't round.

This is great because there are two mirrors in one. One is a normal, non-magnified mirror, while the other is magnified (3 times according to the listing). There also is a dimmable light that comes in handy.

I wish the mirror was just a wee bit taller and wider. While they do work, I find myself moving my face around a lot in order to spot certain areas.

title: Beautiful colors, easy to use, does not last
text: I was really excited to use this kit as it contained a good number of holiday colors - perfect for Christmas and New Years. The directions included were very straight forward. The kit was easy to use. The process was similar to other dip kits that I’ve used in the past. The only drawback is it didn’t last. Typically when I use dip powders I am expecting them to last at least one week. These lasted only a few days.

title: Tugs a lot.
text: The quality of the materials is great. It's comfortable to hold, and works well in the shower. I use this to groom my body hair (I'm very hair), including my private areas. While the trimmer works fine, it doesn't work as well as I hoped. Sometimes it tugs my hair, which causes a painful trimming experience. (My hair is also coarse.) Nor does the trimmer trim as low as I'd like. So far I've been having to go back with a razor to get it low.

title: Thick but works fine.
text: Not much is needed when using this argan oil, especially if you're using just for hair, which is what I do. A couple pumps is all that's needed for my thick, wavy locks. A little too thick for my liking, but dries a little after application, so it's not all that bad.

title: Did not work
text: The adhesives did not work when applying the nails. My 9 year old was disappointed with the fake nails included in the kit. She did, however, like the nail polishes included.

title: Convenient brush set when painting nails
text: I am not experienced in terms of doing my nails but have started to do my own nails at home to save some money. This brush set has been helpful when using gel nail polish and dip powder. There are so many brushes in the set that I haven’t used all of them yet.

title: Perfect mouse ears for our Disney trip
text: These mouse ears are perfect for a Disney trip or for a Halloween costume. They are the perfect size and can stretch to fit a wide variety of head sizes. The price point is also great for the quality.

title: Love this kit!!
text: I love this gel nail kit! It is so easy to use and the nail polish lasts me over a week before chipping (this is a long time for me compared to other nail polishes). The attached photo shows the red and white colors from this kit (green color is from another kit). This kit comes with a shiny top coat and a matte coat. The only drawback is you have to open the nail polishes in order to get a good understanding of the color inside.

title: Been using this nonstop!
text: This set is AMAZING!! I am going to be purchasing more nail sets from Azure. This set was extremely easy to use and perfect for beginners. It also provided me with salon nails in the comfort of my own home and for a fraction of the price! The set lasted over a week which I was happy about (longer than most sets last me). I use this all of the time. Highly recommend.

title: Hurts!
text:
Hurts a lot, but my skin feels and looks much better in the morning. I've been using this for at least a month, but each time is the same. I use it only weekly, though.

My skin is raw and at times bleeds. At least I know it works, though, because my skin is usually smoother the next few days.

title: Worked well, but not a lot given.
text:
My skin felt so refreshed and hydrated every time I applied the serum. My routine was wash my face with a cleanser in the mornings, then pump the serum into my palm and rub onto my face. A small amount is all that's needed; my skin felt quenched and satisfied.

There isn't a lot in the bottle, however. I felt that the bottle was larger than it needed to be.

title: Hydrates and refreshes!
text: Keeps my skin taut and uber frosh. A little goes a long way: only a dab on my fingertips is enough for my entire face.

title: Stings, but brings the follicles.
text: Stings when applying, no matter how many times I apply. But the follicles are thicker. As I age, I realize how important self- and preventative care are. There is a lot to do, but the work is rewarded. Applying a bit of this stuff routinely has helped maintain the crown.

title: Nice at-home dip powder kit
text:
My daughters are relatively short so I was worried about how this dip powder would work. It comes with 20 different colors- all colors I would wear. When I started with the kit I was sure to read the directions at least two times because there are a lot of steps and it’s important to do them in the correct order. The powder containers were filled to the top so the container overflowed a bit when I placed my nail in the powder. Parts of the kit do smell like chemicals so I would be sure to use this away from children and in a well ventilated area.
I’m looking forward to see how long this manicure lasts.

title: Color matched well; not lasting coverage
text: I used this as both an under eye concealer and a regular concealer and it worked nicely. The color matched well to my skin tone and it was fairly lightweight. However, it did not last very long and began to get valet after a few hours.

title: Great curling wand
text:
I have consistently used typical curling irons to curl my hair so I was nervous to use this curling wand. It definitely takes getting used to - it’s not the easiest to use in the beginning. However, once you get used to it, the curls from the curling wand are comparable to typical curling irons.

I’ve always loved the Hot Tools brand and this curling wand is no exception. It heats up well and is built to last.

Note: I would recommend using a curling wand on longer hair. I had a hard time using this on my daughters short hair.

title: Creates beautiful curls; heats up quickly; buttons on side are inconvenient
text:
This curling iron has numerous heat settings which is great for a variety of hair types. The heat settings are on the side of the curling iron which is quite annoying and my main complaint with this curling iron. I can’t count how many times I’ve been holding the curling iron, curling my hair, and I accidentally hit the buttons on the side and change the setting. The positive thing is it heats up quickly so if you accidentally change the setting lower it won’t take long to hear back up.
My hair is thin and slightly wavy. I like the thickness of the barrel as it creates nice sized curls.
It’s nice for traveling as well. It comes with a storage container.

title: Good, but doesn't last a while.
text: The lotion yielded to my fingers when I scooped it. It spread like a popped water balloon through my hands when I rubbed them together, being easily applied to my face. However, it's a small container and not much lotion is pumped into it.

title: Perfect for sensitive skin
text:
I have extremely sensitive skin. It is so sensitive that even slight touch can turn my skin red. I have actively avoided using face cleansing brushes for this exact reason, even though I have always wanted to try one. This brush has a lot of options in terms of types of brushes which helps in choosing one that is right for your face. They even have one for your feet, but I haven't tried that one yet.
The brushes are perfect for people with sensitive skin - they are not too rough but do the job. You have the option of using the brushes with a cleanser or just water. Each time I use this, whether with a cleanser or just water, my face is left feeling smooth and clean.
It does come with a USB charger which is extremely convenient - just make sure you can charge it with USB or have an outlet charger to connect it to.
Overall, this is a really great set, especially for someone that is just starting out using a face brush, like myself.

title: A little goes a long way.
text: Not much is required for this stuff to make my skin feel hydrated. I place just a dab onto my fingers, and transfer to my palms and rub. Then I apply to my face, leaving my face feeling refreshed for hours, even in frigid winter.

title: Nice.
text: Makes my skin feel smooth and refreshed. Definitely a good feeling every morning. Only thing required is extra lotion after using this.

title: Difficult to apply.
text: It gets my hair when it needs after handfuls of water. It's very thick and dries quickly. From my experience, drenching it with water helped, but still was too thick to apply easily into my hair.

title: Use just a little!
text: It's very thick but deceptively so. Always I'd place too much throughout my face; my face would be quickly dry even though the shine of the gel wouldn't go away.

title: Easy to use.
text: The pump is great and seems to leave my hair much better.

title: Haven't noticed a difference
text:
I do not have an extensive skincare routine. I hadn't even realized that serum needed to be a part of it until recently. I've been using this serum as part of my skincare routine for a few weeks now and haven't noticed a difference. When I first received the serum, I liked that it was vegan and preservative free since we are slowly trying to eliminate toxins from our every day products. When you open the serum, it locks into place. I really like this feature. You push on it to pump it out. It is a thin liquid and glides on the face nicely. It soaks into the skin and absorbs fairly quickly.
Overall, it is a nice product. I like the ingredients and the versatility of the container. However, I have to knock down two stars simply for not seeing a difference in my skin after using it for several weeks.

title: Decent. Spoils quickly.
text: Worked with my hair while it was effective. I have thick, wavy hair, and I need stuff that won't make my hair look too shiny. This is good, but it lasts only a couple of months (at least for me).

title: Very difficult to spread.
text: I'm not sure if I used this correctly, but the wax was too difficult to spread over my hair. Upon arrival, the wax just clumped and separated in my hands, like dry butter that hadn't been churned well. There was no moisture at all and, consequently, did my hair no good.

title: When they stick, they work well.
text: They're a bit tricky to keep on. Both my wife and I used them, and they wouldn't completely stick. Almost always at least half of one would fall off. However, they do provide some relief under the eyes, and my aging skin looks healthier.

title: Thick and creamy.
text: Great lotion, even better in the winter. It layers on thick, so be sure to use small amounts over wider surfaces.

title: On the go foundation
text: This foundation comes in an easily transportable container with 1.3 fl oz of makeup. It fits nicely in my purse and the twistable cap makes it easy to use when on-the-go. I have fair, combination skin with mild acne. This foundation was easy to apply; simply twist the cap and squeeze onto a brush or sponge and dab onto the skin. It comes out fairly thick but applied evenly. The thickness made it perfect when covering up my acne spots; however, it wasn't so thick that it felt heavy. It last approximately five hours before I had to reapply it.

title: Great traveling straightener
text: This iron comes with a traveling container (pouch to hold the straightener), a comb, a heat resistant glove, and two hair clips. It has a lock switch that makes it very convenient when it comes to traveling. This straightener can both straightener hair and curl hair. The temperature options vary between 265 and 450 degrees to be used with thin hair (like mine) as well as thick hair. My two favorite things about this straightener are the built-in sensor where it shuts off after about 60 seconds and the fact that it is great for traveling.

title: Great pair of travel tweezers
text: These tweezers are perfect for traveling and would fit nicely into a purse. They are compact and come with a place storing case with a lid. I'm impressed with the quality of these Tweezerman tweezers. They are able to get at the most stubborn eyebrow hairs! Would highly recommend.

title: Moisturizes the shave.
text: Diminished a lot of razor burns. I shave with a straight-edge, but they almost always are too sharp for my sensitive skin. I blew off pre-shaves thinking they were snake oil, but once I used this one on both my face and the blade, I became a believer. It smoothened the cuts while still shaving off as much hair as before. I realize now the pre-shave oils are best used when applied to the blade.

title: A little oil left, but nothing to cry home about.
text: To be fair, I have very oily skin, so most cleaners don't excel at removing it all. Of course, it's better than using straight soap (which always removes the oil). These work well enough for my needs.

title: Succulent.
text: Leaves my beard nice and fluffy. I have no qualms now stroking the furs at any length. I scent is pleasant, which is very important considering I'm having so smell it all the time.

title: The only hairdryer you'll need
text:
This is a one-step hairdryer - hairdryer and hairbrush all in one. You get the results of a blowout from the hair salon right at home.
I have shoulder length wavy, thin hair. Using this has helped me cut out using a hair straightener, which only damages my hair in the long run. This hairdryer has three heat settings and heats up very quickly on the highest setting. It is a fairly big brush but works well when covering a larger service area of hair. Immediately after using this brush, my hair was straight and felt smooth. It's fairly pricey, but is definitely high quality.

title: Good bundle. Fast expiration date.
text:
I was pretty excited to use this set, but for some reason couldn't get around to it until recently. I noticed the expiration dates on these, and got to them quickly.
The products that weren't expired worked well. The amount provided for this bundle is generous, and lasts quite a while (meaning you don't need as much as you may think). The added bag is also pretty useful. I use it to store my trimming set!

title: Detangles unruly hair
text: My daughter's hair gets EXTREMELY knotty and she is not the best at brushing it every day. We have attempted the basic sprays at the store which have only slightly helped. We tried this detangling fluid and it worked really well! She didn't particularly like the scent though. Overall, I would recommend this for anyone that has brittle or knotty hair. It has smoothed out my daughter's hair and made it more manageable.

title: Great soap with nice, earthy scent.
text: Fragrance scents give my nose a hard time, but this scent is good. Like all the other Pre de Provence soaps I've used, it lathers generously on my exfoliating towel, but it's robust enough to last a while. There is some residue with this one because of the ingredients, but they always wash off easily.

title: Highly fragrant, thick body cream
text: This is an extremely fragrant thick body cream. I would highly recommend this for someone with extremely dry skin. It has been perfect for my elbows, knees, and ankles (where my skin is the most dry). This is extremely thick, so I wouldn't recommend putting it on your face if you have sensitive skin and skin prone to breakouts like me.

title: Strong scent; doesn't stop the sweat!
text: This is a deodorant and not an antiperspirant so you will still sweat...a lot...with this deodorant. The smell of the coconut water and mimosa flower is a bit overpowering. It really took me a few days of wearing it to be able to bear it. I've tried other "natural" deodorants in the past and this one just didn't stand up to the other ones I've tried. This wouldn't be my first choice for a natural deodorant.

title: Provides a nice, creamy lather.
text:
I quickly fell in love with this brand. The scents are great, and each soap, no matter the composition or scent, provides a great lather. I've used this one with both exfoliating towels and sponges, and each one worked great (though the exfoliating towel worked better).
The mint on this gives a nice pick-me-up, so it's preferable to use in the mornings.

title: Very good moisturizer.
text: Even though this stuff warms my skin after application, I can apply in both winter and summer and feel refreshed. You don't need much; maybe just a nickel size. It applies evenly on my face. There's a slight cooling effect upon immediately application, but then it warms up and feels great on my skin.

title: Worked well for a year.
text:
I didn't expect these to last as long as they did. We gave them to our children for their bath times, and the brushes held up for a little over a year. My kids loved them as they loved the brush side as well as the sponge side, though they rarely used the brush side for actual bathing.
The only reason we had to toss them is the sponges eventually fell off.

title: Strong and solid.
text: These chunks of soap are tough. I've dropped them handfuls of times, and they barely got a dent. I use an exfoliating cloth, so you need to really rub these bar in, but it lathers beautifully. The scent is good and subtle, and lasts a while.

title: Works well on thin, wavy hair
text: I have thin, wavy hair. I don't need a whole lot of heat in order to straighten my hair. I've always been impressed by Hot Tools products and this one is no different. It works well and heats up quickly. The only drawback is the temperature switches are right where you place your hands when actually straightening your hair. This causes the temperature to change unintentionally while you are holding the straightener. If you are aware of this when using it, you can be proactive in continuously checking the temperature while using it.

title: Great for sensitive skin!
text: I have extremely sensitive skin. Most products make my skin turn red, making it extremely irritated. This serum was moisturizing and gentle on my skin. Although I haven't noticed dramatic effects with my skin, I have noticed my skin is smooth after using it. I would highly recommend that this be added to your daily skin care routine.

title: Effective straightener!
text: I have thin wavy hair and need a straightener to just fix a few pieces that have a mind of their own! I've used a variety of hair straighteners and this Revlon straightener is effective. I haven't tried it on thick curly hair, but it works well for thin wavy hair. I would definitely recommend this for those that want an effective straightener on a budget!

title: Worked well!
text: I am not a hair expert. Honestly, I am fairly incompetent when it comes to anything beauty and hair-related. I was excited to take a shot at using a curling wand, but was scared at the thought of balancing the wand and protective glove. With a little practice, it was fairly easy to use, even for someone like me that isn't proficient with curling wands! I would definitely recommend this for anyone interested in trying out a curling wand - including novice hair doers like me!

title: Must have for skin care routine!
text: I have extremely dry, sensitive skin. My skin turns red very easily. I included this in my skin care routine and my skin reacted better than I expected! It did not turn red or become irritated. It was moisturizing and the scent was not overpowering. I would recommend adding this to part of your skin care routine if you have dry and sensitive skin.

title: Moisturizing; mild smell compared to similar products
text: I have extremely dry skin, especially in the winter. This body was  extremely moisturizing and great for dry skin. The scent was not very overpowering, compared to similar moisturizing body washes. I would recommend this for anyone that has dry skin and is looking for a body wash to combat the dryness.

title: Very thick. Difficult to apply.
text:
This stuff has got to be one of the most difficult clays to use. It's very stiff and does not really apply over my hair at all. I have thick, wavy hair, and I have to apply a little more water than I'm accustomed to get this stuff over half of my hair.
At least it smells good, though.

title: Doesn't really smell like bourbon, but at least provides a generous lather.
text: The lather is really good on my exfoliating towel, which is my main wash cloth. You don't need a lot to lather nicely; just a quarter-drop will do. The color is an apple-juice tone, but I don't really get the bourbon smell from it. Maybe it's just supposed to be the wood-like smell? In either case, it doesn't smell too far from other generic scents you may find from such sprays like Axe, but at least it leaves my skin feeling clean.

title: Doesn’t do the job
text:
I’ve used blackhead strips on and off for the last 15 years so when I had the chance to try these charcoal ones out I was excited! They work the same as the basic white strips - wet your nose, place the strip on, wait, and take it off. After using every strip in the box, I’m just disappointed with how these worked. They did not remove the blackheads from my nose and left black residue on my face. Although it was easy to wash off, it was a bit annoying.
I’ve tried the charcoal cleanser that came with the strips and haven’t noticed a difference with my blackheads.
Overall, I’m disappointed and will stick to the white strips to remove my blackheads.

title: Not great for my fine hair
text: I have a lot of hair, but it’s very fine. I noticed after consistently using this hairbrush for a few weeks, my hair was breaking faster than ever before. This brush is just not meant for fine/thin hair.

title: Use just a smidge and you're good for the rest of the day.
text:
I started using this in winter and found myself not really needing as much as other moisturizers. I have very dry skin which gets worse in the winter. I apply lotion to my skin several times a day, but after I started using this one I found I didn't need to apply as much.
At first, I began applying it just to my face, but then realized how well it performed and used it for my knuckles (the driest part of my body) and arms, legs, and torso. Lotion application went from several times a day to just a couple (or three, depending on the severity).

And the best part is that you don't need to use as much, so even though you get a small-ish tube it will last you a while.

title: Has a hint of alcohol, but it's just the cooling effectt.
text:
I used this every morning for about a month after using the scrubbing mix. The scrub would leave my skin feeling raw (especially in this brittle Chicago winter), so a moisturizer afterward was a must. This one was my go-to until it ran out. Definitely hydrated appropriately. Upon first application, I would get a tingling sensation which would go away after about a second, which would then leave my skin feeling refreshed. It's a thick lotion, so not much is needed.
I did notice, however, that the container gets a bit hard to press when the lotion is about halfway done. I would have to smack the container against my palm to get it out every time.

title: Good consistency and feel.
text: The soap has a mild scent to it that everyone in the family can enjoy. My wife is pretty sensitive to scents, whereas I'm not. This strikes a good middle ground. The soap is also thick but not thick enough to clog our dispensers (which we purchased from local stores). I like the milky pink color as it stands out from others and you can easily see how much is left in our clear dispensers.

title: Works great for me!
text:
My armpits tend to be pretty sensitive, which annoys me because my body is overall accepting of many other skincare products. But as such, I need certain antiperspirants and this one works well overall. I can use about six swipes on each armpit and it lasts until 6pm. I put it on around 7:30am and need maybe just one or two swipes more each, if that.
With other antispirants I have to be careful when wearing black clothing; not so much here. I can use it fine while already wearing black clothing and I find that it doesn't stain in the slightest.

title: Just a quarter-size is great.
text:
I use this every morning. Love the way it scrubs my skin and love the way it smells during and after. I do find that the sink backs up more quickly, but just a quick routing is all you need to clear it up.
The can is large and durable; you get pretty good bang for your buck. Make sure to leave substantial room in your medicine cabinet for the cannister.

My skin feels pretty good after and some lotion helps ensure smoothness throughout the day.

title: Pains my face and does not let up.
text: From the moment this goes on it absolutely hurts my face. I'm no stranger to stinging sensations after shaving, but usually they last 10-15 seconds tops. This lasts minutes. Sometimes I have to rub it off completely and replace it with something else. Even I use this as a rubbing lotion in the morning, the sensation is strong and a pain. I cannot recommend balms that has a stinging sensation that lasts minutes; there is no joy to this one. The scent is reserved and definitely reveals a cool flavor--once you get past the four-minute wall of pain, that is.

title: Nice, but wastes pretty quickly.
text: Since this stuff is a bit watery, you may require more pumps than necessary. I usually use 4-5 each morning, and it was gone within a month. But it feels great on my skin and nourishes it nicely, especially paired with a thick lotion for my darker skin. Nice bottle; took me a bit to figure out how to take the safety block off (when it was brand new), but I figured it out after a few minutes.

title: Not for sensitive skin
text: I have combination skin and am prone to breakouts. I have sensitive skin so I have to be careful with the type of face wash that I use. A few days after using this face wash, my skin became very red. This is not a great face wash for sensitive skin.

title: Subtle smell
text: This apt and wax candle burns for up to 45 hours. It has a subtle smell that is not overpowering. It’s the perfect gift for any candle lover.

title: Not my favorite mask
text:
The main positive for this product is that it is easy to apply. You simply roll the product on your face. The actual mask is extremely thin so you need to continually roll it on your face to get a mask that is thick enough.

The directions state to keep it on your face for about ten minutes. This seems like a sufficient amount of time as I could feel the mask tighten up at the ten minute mark. I have very sensitive skin and this mask made my face slightly red immediately after use. This redness did go away within a few hours though.

After using this product for several weeks, I haven’t noticed a difference with my skin. I’ve tried other masks that require more work during the application process but provide more benefits and changes in my skin.

title: Liquid highlighter that gives overall glow. Difficult to get out of the bottle.
text:
This liquid highlighter can be used on its own or when mixed with liquid foundation. When I mixed it with my liquid foundation, it gave a nice glow all over my face. This type of glow is perfect for a night out.

I don’t countour my face because I have no idea how to! But applying this liquid highlighter was easy. Getting the liquid out of the bottle is a different story - the dropper doesn’t work well so the liquid just sits on the dropper. This may become more annoying as there is less liquid in the bottle.

It’s a small bottle - .5 ounces. When using the highlighter, a little goes a long way. I think this small bottle will last a while.

title: Makes hair silky and soft immediately after use. Needs to be used on damp hair
text:
I don’t usually wear a lot of product in my hair so using this spray was new for me! I have thin blonde hair that’s about shoulder length. After having two kids, my hair tends to fall out constantly and has continued to thin.
I was excited to try this product as the information promised to make my hair shinier and softer. The directions say to apply this product to damp hair. I ended up spraying the product throughout my hair after the shower. The fact that it needs to be applied to damp hair is a bit annoying. I only wash my hair 1-2 times/week so I’ve only been using it that amount. You could use this everyday and just spray your hair with water to make your hair damp prior to using it. With two young kids, I can’t justify making my hair wet and drying it just to use this product.
This product states it’s 100% vegan. My hair felt silky and soft immediately after using the product but did not maintain in the coming days. Granted, I did not use it every day. I only used it 1-2x/week. I’ll definitely continue to use it to see if a difference maintains over time.

title: Floral, Powdery Scent
text: I don’t usually wear perfumes, but this perfume is overwhelming. I am 30 years old and found this scent may be better suited for women more mature than myself. It has a powdery, floral scent and is very overpowering. The bottle is 3.4 fluid ounces.

title: Fruity scent that lasts all day
text:
I work with children with sensitives to smell so I do not usually wear perfumes. When I do wear perfume, it’s on the weekends and usually when my husband and I go out on a date.
This Mercedes Benz perfume is 3 ounces. The smell is close to a fruity scent. The description of the perfume states that it is a peach smell. The scent is very powerful and lasted all day. It can be a bit overpowering when first applied, but it fades gradually as the day goes on.

title: Leaves my skin feeling great, rich, and refreshed.
text:
I use this almost every night that I remember and my skin almost always feels fantastic in the morning. At the very least, it feels far better than if I don't use it at all.
I can tell a difference in the composition of my skin feel, which actually helps me to feel refreshed as well. I apply any excess on my arms and neck and chest, and those parts of my body feel richer and thicker than skin on the rest of my body.

The case in comes in is great, too. The container is thick and heavy, weighty with a presence of authority. The lid feels a bit flimsy compared to the rest, but always comes off and closes with ease.

I dip just a couple of fingers into it per hand and I find that enough to use every night. So far, after a month of using it, I'm just about halfway through.

title: Creamy.
text: I use it in the morning to wash my face before applying a morning cream. While no scrub, the lotion does feel good in teh hands. It's not as viscous as soap, but still stays neatly in the palm while rubbing it and transferring it to the face. Tthe skin on my face feels a bit lubricated while washing, and even after rinsing it off with water the oil makes it feel refreshed. That combined with the lotion after leaves for a pleasant face before walking out in this blistering Chicago heat.

title: Shampoo was great - conditioner was eh.
text: I am extremely brand loyal when it comes to beauty products, including shampoo and conditioner. I had never used the GLISS brand and was skeptical upon receiving the product. My hair is thin yet wavy and gets oily pretty quickly. My hair is also a little longer than chin length. The shampoo brought on a decent lather, but the conditioner was a bit heavy. It weighed down my hair and didn't leave it feeling clean when done. The scent of both the shampoo and conditioner are nice. I'd definitely buy the shampoo again, but not the conditioner.

title: Great product but a bit expensive
text:
This is a great skincare product! I have very sensitive skin and react easily to different products. To use this product, you apply the peel to your face and rub it in for about three minutes. When you're done, you apply the activator and rub it in for approximately one minute and then rinse with water. It smells AMAZING - just like oranges! Immediately after using the product, my skin felt smoother and softer. It did not cause my skin to breakout. After using this product consistently (2x/week for a minimum of three weeks), I noticed a difference in the size of the pores on my face. I will continue to use this product consistently!
The only downfall to this product is the price tag - it's a bit steep for me.

title: Basic body wash
text: This is a pretty basic body wash. My mom used Dial all of the time when I was a kid, so I would agree with the ad in that it is comparable to Dial in its ability to cleanse your body. It is also comparable to Dial in regards to price point (with this body wash being a little less expensive). The bottle states that the scent is lavender and jasmine. The scent is subtle but not overpowering, which I like. I wouldn't necessarily agree that it smelt like lavender, but it was close enough. I have sensitive skin and am usually worried about how my skin will react when trying new soaps. My skin did not react to this soap - it did not break out or become dry. Overall, I would recommend this as a great alternative to your every day body wash.

title: Great haircut kit for kids!
text: Couldn’t wait to try out this kit! I supervise behavior therapy with children with Autism and one of the many concerns that parents have is having their kids get their hair cut without behaviors. Children with Autism usually have a difficult time with the noise of the clipper and the sensation of it touching their skin/head. One of the ways we work on this is desensitizing them to the sound of the clippers and the process of getting a haircut. When using this haircut kit, it was a lot quieter than other clippers I have used in the past. The sound, however, is still noticeable, as I would expect. I’m glad that I chose to try out this kit – it’s had a positive impact in the lives of the kids I work with.

title: Love these soaps.
text:
I use the tinned soaps for the gym showers and they're fantastic. Perfect size to toss in the gym bag and prop on one of the shower's small surfaces. The tins haven't rusted on me for the duration of the soap's life, and the soap lathers really well. I'm glad I've discovered these soaps as they're now my go-to; I have larger bars for home.

My only gripes are that the soap can be a bit too slippery compared to others, and the soap can get pretty stuck into the tin if there's water. Otherwise, I think I found my favorite gym soaps

title: Great summer scent.
text: Great scent that smells light and springy, without being overpowering or dense. Pleasant to smell in the hot summer months, and doesn't need many sprays to stay on all day. I usually do two-three depending on the day, and I still can get light traces of it by the time I come back home in the evening.

title: Good smell, lackluster consistency.
text: The smell is very good, but it's very hard to get a good lather with a minimal amount of water and using my synthetic brush. I'm used to soaps, but even then I still use the occasional cream. The consistency on this one is very difficult to get foamy, but I still really like the scent so I use it often.

title: Jeez; it actually is that tiny.
text:
I read reviews before getting this and thought, "Well, yeah; for the price you can't be expecting much." But little (haha) did I realize that the size matters because you really can't use it as the standard size. Meaning, even as a sampler, you can't get the full effect, if at all.
I can understand this is to get people into using brushes for wet shaving, but the brush is so small as to be pretty unusable. I have a couple of regularly sized brushes and found this to be just too small to have a lather, and I have experience using brushes. I can't imagine giving this to someone as a sampler and expecting them to get a good experience out of it.
With the soap provided, it's impossible to get the brush completely absorbed and then use it on your face.
While the rest of the kit is fine, and a good sample set, the brush, which is key to using during shaving, is too small to use.

title: Steller smell!
text:
This smell is fantastic; definitely one of the better scents I've picked up recently. I wouldn't use this much in warmer weathers, but in cooler (and maybe even ice-cold) weathers it's great. It has a warmer scent to it, but I feel too much may be overpowering. I feel two-three sprays is good.
My wife, who's very finicky with colognes, said she's a fan of this one.

title: Like drinking water for the skin.
text:
The stuff does hydrate and is required in only small amounts. I usually put about two-quarters' worth anyway, as I have *very* dry skin, and I use up the rest on my hands and arms, which get pretty dry and ashen during the winter months.
The cream is thick, which is meant to get through to every inch of your skin and applied in a thick coat. It will leave a white residue if not applied throughout.

But my face feels super refreshed after every application. I apply it every morning and each time I do I think, "Man, my skin was *thirsty*." The tube is also pretty easy to grip.

title: Great makeup brush - easy to use!
text: I am not great when it comes to applying makeup. I do a quick foundation and sometimes mascara and call it a day. I was excited to try this makeup brush as a friend once told me that having the right makeup brush makes all of the difference when it comes to applying makeup (who knew!). The brush is easy to put together and the instructions on how to use it (with liquid makeup and powder makeup) are very straight forward. I used it for both powder and liquid foundation and I found the coverage on my face to be great. What a difference compared to not using it! I have extremely sensitive skin and it did not irritate my skin when I used it. This brush really helped me achieve a natural makeup look in a short amount of time - which is exactly what I'm looking for when it comes to applying makeup!

title: Good product - time consuming and has a learning curve
text:
I am a bit of a klutz when it comes to curling my hair and am deathly afraid of burning myself. I was so scared of using this product when I first got it that it sat in the box for about a month. I also don't have much experience when it comes to curling irons so that added to my anxiety. My motivation in using it, however, is that I have extremely fine, straight hair. I want to add a little curl to my dull head of hair!
Since I have fine hair, I put the curling wand on the low setting. I also made sure to wear the glove provided since I am deathly afraid of burning myself. When first using it, it was extremely difficult to navigate. Having limited experience with curling my hair, I had no idea what I was doing. With time, it did become easier to use.
This is a great tool for someone who is used to curling their hair and is willing to take the time to curl small sections of hair one by one. I don't have the time for that and found the regular curling irons to be so much easier to use.

title: Reasonably priced flat iron for beginners
text: I have used a ton of straighteners over the years. I have hair that is wavy in some parts and straight in others. I really just need a straightener to even things out a bit. I love Revlon products and have used their straighteners in the past. This Revlon Salon Straight Damage Control flat iron is a reasonable price ($34.99) and does the job.  It only has one heat setting (385) which is a bit annoying if you want a different heat setting, but it will suite someone with hair like mine. I would recommend this flat iron for someone who is just starting to use flat irons and does not have extremely wavy or curly hair. Honestly, for the price you can't beat it.

title: Nice, mild scent.
text:
It's more of a summary scent, as the packaging itself implies. The wrapping on it looks nice, but feels a bit cheap for the price you pay.
The presentation itself from the box is nice, however, and the smell overall is a nice splash, especially during the warmer months.

title: Nice.
text: Great wash to use in the mornings, especially with cold water to refresh the face. The liquid doesn't stay thick, which I prefer, but instead washes thin with water. Combined with anti-aging lotion, this wash makes for a nice combination.

title: Good stuff.
text:
I apply this on my face in the morning after using my face wash. The smell is nice, and the cream is light enough that you don't need to take much with every application day after day. The cream is darker in person than in the listing photographs, but that's a minor fuss.
The aroma is pleasant and stays on for a couple of hours.

title: Love this line of soaps.
text:
Sold on this brand from their bars of soap that I use for showering. Was a no-brainer when we ran out of soap in the bathroom and had to get some, and found out that they make liquid pumps as well.

Smells wonderful and dispenses easily. Love that the pump doesn't disseminate too much as otherwise it would waste too much soap. That is my biggest gripe about soap dispensers because you're constantly having to buy more; one half-pump is more than adequate.

title: Fantastic quality soap.
text:
As soon I opened the box I was greeted with the strong but inviting smell of the bar of soap, even though it was wrapped in plastic. No other labeling or packaging of any kind; just a simple bar of soap in the box wrapped in a thin layer of plastic. My guess is these are meant to be sold in boutique shops or else online.

The soap is a bit hard to scrub onto a soap sponge. You really have to keep reapplying it or scrubbing it on for a while to make it a good lather. Otherwise, it smells and feels wonderful.

title: Deep purple color, nice finish
text:
Love this nail polish and that it comes with both nail polishes. I've gone to the stores and found these but they're sold separately. Love that this is a set.
The nail polish itself is a deep purple - can look more blackish purple when two coats are applied to the nail. I've always loved Essie nail polish - the gel polish gives the nail a shiny look and lasts less than two weeks for me, which is long.

title: Not the makeup for me
text:
have acne prone skin and a lot of blackheads and pores. It's hard for me to find a makeup that works - aka: doesn't sink into my skin and can cover my breakouts. This makeup seeped deep into my pores making my face look like a hot mess. It did cover my breakouts but the cakey feeling was just too much for me.
I'm bummed because I have other Dermablend makeup and have been happy with those.

title: Nice color. Didn't last long.
text:
I love Essie nail polish and own quite a few. When given the opportunity to try the gel nail polish, I was very excited. Hearing that it can be used with any Essie nail polish made it even more exciting since I'd be able to use the colors I have at home.

When I used this nail polish, however, I was disappointed. The color was beautiful but it only lasted two days before it started to chip! Granted I wash dishes and have two young kids, but the OPI gel nail polish lasts a lot longer than this.

title: Good coverage. Sinks into pores
text:
I've tried many different powder foundations and this one definitely provides a decent amount of coverage. I've been using this over a week and it hasn't caused my sensitive skin to break out.
The one thing I don't like about this foundation is that it sinks into the pores on my nose and breaks apart on the areas of my face that are dry.

title: Great hairspray- strong smell
text: This is a great lightweight hairspray that's perfect for every day looks and hairstyles. It helps keep my hair in place, even with humidity. It sprays easily and evenly. The other negative I would point out is the smell - it is extremely overpowering. Whenever I use this hairspray, I smell like it for hours after using it.

title: Great color for spring and summer
text: I LOVE Essie nail polish!  This is no exception. This is such a pretty color - perfect for spring and summer =) Can't wait to wear it again once the weather warms up.  It is extremely light and requires two coats, but overall very pretty color. It is easy to apply and tries fairly quickly compared to other nail polish brands.

title: Love the color!
text:
I got the "Berry in Love" color and its beautiful both in the bottle and on my nails! I've actually never used Gel nail polish at home. Whenever I have Gel nail polish on my finger nails, it's done at a salon. I was excited to try it in the comfort of my own home.
From my first experience using this type of nail polish, I did not like the brush. It's extremely wide (compared to other nail polish brushes I have used in the past) which made painting my nails a bit of a challenge. Once the nail polish was one my nails, it lasted a little over a week (this is with cleaning, washing dishes, and being a mom to two kids under the age of 4). I call this a win!

I'm a cheapskate and don't like paying so much for nail polish, but I love the ESSIE brand and it's less expensive than getting it done at the salon. Overall, great nail color!

title: Great cleanser, not a fan of the smell
text: This cleanser does a great job of removing most of my makeup and making my skin feel smooth and clean. I have extremely sensitive, acne-prone skin and this cleanser did not irritate my skin, which was a relief.  It's hard for me to find a face wash that doesn't irritate my skin in some way or another. I like the pump on this container more than the squeeze bottles of other face washes.  This product comes in a HUGE bottle and the price is reasonable (about $15). The only thing I didn't like about this face wash was the smell - I washed my face before bed and when my husband went to kiss me goodnight, I was extremely self conscious about the smell on my face.  Otherwise, works well with my sensitive, sometimes oily skin.

title: Good tingly feeling without the pain.
text:
When I put on a new balm/lotion after shaving I always expect a sensation, whether pleasant or harsh. I've grown used to the Clubman aftershave (which is still my favorite), and that's what I was expecting here.

There's definitely a heightened sensation when you apply this, but it doesn't hurt. At all. At least, it didn't on my skin. I did feel the heightened sensation I normally do with stuff like Clubman, but there was no after-pain.

The bottle is squeezable, too. While you may think you will have to pound the bottle on your palm to get the lotion out, the material is firm enough to keep its shape but soft enough to squeeze easily.

title: Great addition to makeup routine
text:
This product comes with three different shades of highlighter. It also comes with three separate gift boxes, allowing the consumer to keep a box and gift the other two boxes. I kept all three shades of highlighter for myself :-)

I was disappointed that the product didn't come with brushes. I think it would've been a nice addition to the overall product if it came with brushes to use with each of the highlighters.

I don't usually use highlighters in my makeup routine. I usually keep it simple with powdered foundation and a little mascara. Each of the highlighters in this product were easy to use and beautiful colors on my fair skin. It has been a nice addition to my makeup routine, but not necessarily something that I feel I need to use. Overall, great product. Like the idea of being able to gift the shades that may not work as well with my skin tone.

title: Helps control oily skin
text:
I used the Proactiv system to treat my acne back in high school and it severely dried out my skin. I'm now 30 years old and still experience acne. I decided to give this product a try after several other products didn't work out. I applied the product to problem areas on my face (nose, chin, forehead) twice a day for a week. It did not dry out my skin which was pleasantly surprising considering my experience with Proactiv in the past. It helped keep my oily skin under control. It also helped my acne heal faster than without use of the product.
It is a bit on the expensive side, in my opinion, but will last a long time given the amount of product in the bottle and how much is used per day.

I'm giving this product 4/5 stars rather than 5/5 stars due to not knowing the long term use of the product as I've only used it for one week. I will update my review once I've used it for a longer period of time.

I did not use this product in addition to the three step system as recommended on the packaging.

title: Makes my face feel smooth
text: I don’t usually wear masks, but was given the opportunity to try this one.  I have combination skin and occasional acne.  I also have very sensitive skin that reacts to different products.  I liked the feeling when I first put this mask on my face.  It has a pretty strong scent, but it didn’t bother me.  After a minute or two, my face started to tingle.  I’ve been leaving it on a little longer than the directions state and it hasn’t adversely affected my skin.  I’ve only been using it two weeks and haven’t noticed a change in my pores, but it does make my skin feel soft after each use.  It’s a nice, reasonably priced mask that can be used at home.

title: Fine for even little beards.
text:
I had to regrow my beard in preparation for this conditioner. I usually only keep mine during the winter, but this was a good opportunity to try growing a tamer version in the summer. I have many other Proraso products and they're all very excellent; I expected to feel the same with this, and I was.

So my beard grew only about a little over an inch by the time I started using this. Usually my beard grows thick and curly in the summer, and this time it was thick and stubby with a little curl forming at the ends. I applied this as directed and was rushed by the pleasant smell. I usually let it sit for an hour before the results fully kick in, and do they ever. Even at the less-than-inch beard I have I can tell that my hairs are far softer and less churlish to the touch. I can finally rub my beard against my wife's face when going in for a smooch without being told it's scratchy. I might even let my beard continue to grow despite the crude Chicago summer weather.

title: Daughter loves it, but could be cut in price.
text:
It's a basic lip balm making set. What you see is what you get. It's very simple to make, and the containers are sturdy enough. It seems this pod shape is pretty popular with certain lip balm brands, so the company decided to emulate the design.
My daughter (3) immediately knew what it was because of the pod. What she didn't know was that it was a kit.

She had a blast making it, and, as aforementioned, it was particularly simple. The shapes are nice, although they're a bit wobbly so it was a bit challenging to get the shape perfect. Still, it's not a huge concern since the beeswax will wear with use.
The taste is just like the other homemade lip balms we've made; no issue for us there, but if this is the first kit you've experienced then expect a very raw flavor. I'm sure you can alter that with your own ingredients. We plan on doing that with some of the other colors since we've made only two as of this review.

That said, the kit is pretty simple, so the price tag can deter some. For all items that we have that are homemade, I've found that kits tend to be cheaper than already-made products. In fact, you can purchase almost as many lip balms at the checkout aisle for the same price. I guess the advantage is that you can make your own, but making your own products should almost always be cheaper, unless you're somehow sprucing them up. Since I don't see that happening here, I'd say the kit can drop a few bucks at the very least.

title: Always wanted to try one of these. Now that I did, no idea why.
text:
I've seen these plentiful at my local department stores, as well as in the bathrooms of some family members. I've always used the cheapo loofahs you can get in bulk for a buck, and just got into the routine of replacing them when necessary.
Since I've seen Dove's tool ubiquitously, I've always wanted to try it out. I finally did, but now I'm waiting for the day it craps out so I can replace it with my old standard ones.

You see, I use regular bars of soap and the loofah to lather it up. The bars of soap are of usually better quality than body wash, not to mention are they cheaper in the long run and last longer. I simply use the loofah to scrub against the the bar of soap, build a lather, and use the loofah to wash my body without having to refill it.

With the Dove tool, you get half a loofah that doesn't maintain a lather very well. I always start with my top half, and by the time I reach my bottom half there is no soap to be found on the Dove tool. So I've gotten used to scrubbing the bars of soap on the other side of the tool, but that leaves little to no soap on my skin at all.

Also the plastic board containing the two halves is a bit difficult to hold and often slips off my hand when I'm scrubbing my body. Not only that, but there's no way this bulkier soap scrub can shrink, meaning you can't get into certain crevices, which is pretty necessary to have a fully clean body.

It's pretty expensive for what it is, and I'm sure it works for somebody, but in my experience it doesn't work well with me and my bars of soap. I'll stick with the regular loofahs, even though they tear apart sooner than desired.

title: Some negatives, but will definitely use again
text: I am extremely pale and do not tan naturally.  I was curious to see if this product would appear orange on my fair skin.  I used it shortly after showering.  Keep in mind you can't shower for at least three hours after applying the product.  I used the product on my arms, shoulders, back, legs, and feet.  I didn't use it on my face.  The mitt is essential to using this product effectively.  If I didn't have the mitt, I would be worried that the tanning solution would remain on my hands, even after washing.  It makes the application process so much easier.  I would definitely recommend doing one application at a time.  Keep in mind that it will take a little bit of time for the color to show.  One of the drawbacks to this product is that you cannot see where you are putting the mousse when you apply it.  This can make it difficult to know where you placed the product and where you did not.  Once the product dried and started to show, I found that I missed several spots, which looked awkward since I am so pale.  It has a strong scent, which I didn't like, but my husband liked it so I guess it is based on your personal preference.  I did notice that, as the product faded, my skin appeared blotchy on my legs.  This might be a result of my somewhat dry skin, but keep that in mind when applying the product.  Doing one application, the color is very subtle, so you might want to do several applications.  Also, be cautious around your ankles, knees, and elbows as I found they soaked in more of the product and ended up being much darker than my legs or arms.  This is really where the lack of tint in the product becomes a real problem.  Overall, this is a nice product and I will use it again.  It did not look very orange when I applied it, which is reassuring coming from someone who is very pale.  I wouldn't use it for a special occasion like a wedding, but I would use it for date night.

title: Very strong scent
text: The jar of this cream is huge!  There is no doubt that this will last a while, which might explain the high price tag. You don’t need much of the cream as too much of the cream makes the scent overwhelming. The overwhelming scent was a bit much for me as I don’t usually wear strong smelling lotions or creams. The scent lasted the entire day and made my skin feel smooth.

title: Decent conditioner
text: I've used several Herbal Essences shampoos and conditioners in the past and have enjoyed their smell.  This conditioner isn't any different.  It smells great!  I have fairly short and thin hair.  I don't usually use much conditioner and even a little bit of conditioner usually leaves my hair feeling smooth.  This conditioner, like other conditioners I have used, left my hair feeling smooth.  This particular conditioner left my hair smelling great too!  I would say it's comparable to the other Herbal Essences conditioners on the market. It's an average conditioner and doesn't necessarily produce different results than other conditioners (e.g. Tresemme, Pantene, etc).

title: Great to remove makeup, but a bit pricey for what it is.
text:
The actual remover is fine, and has been easy to remove makeup with, but the tips are cumbersome and only so much better than Q-tips. I don't feel I'd be buying replacements for the tips.

The remover works well without smudging much, but even smudges are easy to remove.

For the price, however, I'm not sure I'd be ordering it again.

title: Great for the family.
text:
My wife and I use separate soaps, but we finally agreed on this one. It lasts long for us both (about a month, if you can believe it), and has a nice soft feel to the skin.

However, I use a loofah anyway so I use less soap, but the lather thickens quite a bit for the small amount I use. It leaves a very distinct soft feel to the skin even after scrubbing.

title: Keeps my bristles in check.
text:
I've begun to grow a moustache. I've never grown one before, so I didn't know how to go about bringing a proper handlebar on my face. I want to be able to curl the ends, and I've looked up resources describing different methods. The consensus was that you shouldn't trim it, keep combing it, and use wax. I've been following all methods, and this little comb is handy-dandy for step two.

I was shocked at how small this would be, but I guess I shouldn't be considering it's for beards and moustaches. It fits great in my fingers, and really keeps my moustache combed to either side. I primarily use the narrower teeth, but I'm sure the thicker end would be great for bushier moustaches or beards.

I have the pocket comb version of this, and both are made of equal quality. Excellent choices for a man's grooming collection.

title: Great little comb.
text:
Being of Mexican ethnicity, I have very thick wavy hair. I've had to search high and low to get brushes to work with my locks, and I even had to get more than one to brush my hair when it's at different lengths.
But those I keep at home. For my office job, I needed something handy to tame my wild knots during winter, the season in which I cover my top-mane with a beanie to fend off the harsh elements. Doing so leaves my hair a tangled mess all over again, so morning visits to the restroom to comb my hair and moustache were necessary.

I used to use a cheap black comb that came with a trimmer set, but it often left my scalp irritated when my hair was short and did nothing when my hair was long (except for pulling on knotted ends). My hair demanded something better, so I thought I'd get a quality comb and see if any difference can be made.

Sure enough, this tortoise shell pocket comb is perfect to keep in my desk drawer. The quality is outstanding, though I say that from upgrading a cheap plastic comb that's probably worth less than $0.50. The teeth are thicker but round, so it glides through my hair easily. I still get some knots pulled, but nowhere near as much as I used to.

Perfect.

title: Fantastic smell.
text:
First, it's embedded in really sturdy glass, so even if this topples over the table on which I've set it I'm not afraid if it shattering.

We keep it in our living room and light it when people come over. The smell isn't insultingly strong and wafts down the hallway into the dining room and kitchen. We live in a single-level apartment, but it's a very wide layout, so I was surprised to find the smell all the way in the opposite side of the house. But the living room (again, where this candle is) doesn't have such a strong smell as to be harrowing on the senses. Yes, the smell is obviously stronger, but not unpleasant in the way some candles can be.

It's a warm woodsy smell, and everyone who has come in has commented on how nice it smells. We used to use Febreze NOTICEables, but they can get quite expensive if you don't find them on clearance, and they would often leave a very strong smell in the beginning then suddenly fade away, even if there was half of the liquid still in the cartridge. Candles are a better alternative, though may not be as strong as something like Febreze. Which is completely fine for me.

It may seem a bit expensive, but when you stack up the prices for electric replacements, the candles are certainly a better deal in the long run.

title: Flat Iron
text: When I received this flat iron, I was very excited to try it out.  I have used quite a few flat irons and a variety of brands.  There are a few things that I like about this iron - it is thin and heats up fairly quickly compared to other flat irons that I have used in the past.  I have wavy and frizzy hair, about shoulder length, and it does wonders.  It is extremely easy to use and allows me to straighten the hair near the top of my head and scalp.  It has digital setting which I don't mind.  I could, however, do without the temperature in Celsuis.  I would much prefer to have it in Fahrenheit.  Other than that, it's a great flat iron.  I think it is worth the price it is currently at on Amazon ($59.99).  There are several other flat irons that I have tried that are just as good but a lot more expensive.

title: It is a regular cleansing wipe.
text:
They were able to take off a majority of my makeup and didn't dry out my skin. I have relatively sensitive skin and my skin didn't become irritated.
If you love the citrus smell, you'll love these!

title: Thin and fluffed.
text:
I was introduced to the wonderful world of wet shaving last year. Because the razors themselves are usually so pricey, I had gotten the brush and proper shaving soap much earlier, and the razor was a birthday gift.

I used Proraso shaving cream from the tube for years, so it was time to get something new. Obviously, I ordered this.
The container itself is very clean and blank, which actually catches the eye. Using it the first time, I applied some with just my fingers. I found it to be incredibly thin, having to use double the amount than when I used Proraso.

The next time I used it, I used my brush. I have an Omega badger brush, and it's worked well over the past couple of years. I rinsed the brush in warm water and lathered it right in the bowl. Still, the product was a bit thin. It was obviously much better with the brush, but I had to use more than my previous cream. At the price, I may not order this again.

The actual shaving was fine, and it has a nice scent, but know that you may have better options for the cost.

title: Great--at first.
text: I have used this product quite a few times over the past few months.  I was excited to receive this product and was looking forward to the results it promised.  The first few times I used the product, it was amazing and I was very happy with it.  After these first few uses, however, it began to lose suction.  Overall, I was not impressed by this product, especially for the price.  I would assume that there are other products on the market that are of the same quality but for far less money.  I would suggest researching other products before considering this one.

title: Great for hobbies, not so good for ears.
text:
The fine-tipped Q-tips are great for hobbies and crafts, but not so great for ear cleaning. I realize many people, including myself, have found many other uses for these cotton swabs other than cleaning out the Dumbo muscles, so the company decided to create these swabs for better precision. They're a bit softer than I'd like, but certain able to get at finer areas than the regular ones.
Just be careful if you're using them as actual ear cleaners; used on the other day, and accidentally went too deep. It hurt quite a bit!

title: Envyderm Eyelash Enhancement
text:
From my wife:

After using this product for a few weeks, I have noticed minimal differences. I did not experience any side effects with this product either. I have very sensitive skin and my eyes are easily irritated so I was worried about the possible side effects, but there weren't any which was reassuring. Although it is less expensive than other eyelash enhancement products, it does not seem to give dramatic results. If you are looking for dramatic results, I would suggest looking elsewhere.

title: Clearasil Perfectawash
text:
A review from my wife:

I love the fact that this product is hands free!! I love being able to put my hand under it and have a good amount of face wash placed in my hand. I tend to overuse my face wash, leaving me buying more than I really need. This stops me from doing that!
The sensor on the dispenser is fairly sensitive so it will go off even when you don't put your hand underneath it. This can be avoided by turning the dispenser off and turning it back on when you want to use it. This is slightly inconvenient though because you have to wait for the blinking lights to stop blinking before it is ready to be used. This is just a little annoyance compared to how it dispenses the perfect amount of face wash and saves me money considering I'm not wasting any face wash.
As for the actual face wash that comes with the dispenser, I was not completely impressed with it. I have sensitive skin and it was gentle enough to use on my sensitive skin, which was nice. However, it did nothing to help my acne. Granted, I used it once a day for a couple months and didn't see any differences. Perhaps if I used it in the morning and at night and for an extended period of time, my results regarding my acne would be different. I'm just hesitant to stray away from my current face wash as it has been working quite well for me. For the price and the awesomeness of the dispenser, I'd consider it a good buy.

title: Sure beats my old dryer =)Thanks Remington!
text:
A review from my mother-in-law:

My hair is thinning and this dryer gives me volume! With my head upside down while blow drying, in just a couple of minutes, I have full, shiny and manageable hair! The user friendly design is great too. The heat and speed settings are at a comfortable spot on the handle and unlike my last dryer, they stay where I set them!
Definitely a good purchase

title: Straightener
text:
Review from my wife:

I have used a lot of straighteners and this one is pretty good. It heats up fairly quickly and my hair is super smooth and soft when I'm finished straightening it! It cools down fairly quickly which I can appreciate because I want to put my straightener away after I use it but if it hasn't cooled down enough by the time I have to leave for work, I leave it on the counter, which drives my husband nuts :-)
As for the design, I'm a little surprised. The look of the straightener is nice and sleek, and is lightweight. However, the buttons on the top of the straightener cause a lot of frustration!! They are placed right where I put my fingers when I straighten my hair!! I find myself turning it off or changing the heat settings without even knowing it. Very frustrating.
Side note - heat controls are based on temperature rather than low, medium, and high which I like.
Overall, the straightener is nice but not worth $50.

title: Good, but only for a while.
text:
I've been using Gillette since my first razor--which, incidentally, was my first razor--and they have treated me well over the years. Despite their abundantly mass-produced stock, they have been well-built (some more than others) and have stood the test of time. These new fangle-dangled battery-operated ones, however, are questionable.

They vibrate to shake the hairs from their rested position, and, as I'm the only one who can grow a full beard in my family, getting the closest shave is very important. But more than any technology can provide, you must know your face more than the razor knows it. While Gillette's multi-blade cartridges to a great job for my face, I sometimes find myself turning the vibration off because it interrupts my study of my face. Where I know some bumps on my cheeks and chin should be, the vibration may confuse me and cause me to improperly shave and leave some spots thicker than others.

The blades themselves are super sharp, but very expensive and a pain in the butt to clean. My sink cannot handle wads of hair (nor should any other household bathroom sink), but water is the only way to wash these suckers of the hair stubble, but it also washes away some of the lotion attached (depends which cartridges you get). In the long run, these razors will be very costly, so I'm considering doing the ol'-fashioned wet shaving.

All in all, however, I will still keep this Fusion on hand for the comfort a Gillette shave provides, and will turn the vibration on to keep my skin massaged, and off when I end up missing some spots on my face.

title: It's toothpaste...with whitening power!
text:
Don't blame me; I'm no toothpaste aficionado. I know, however, if stuff works as advertised.

I've been using this stuff for over a week now, and I can tell right after a good brushing that my teeth are a tint whiter. It's no drastic change, but I see my own teeth in the mirror often enough to know if there are any color changes (or food stuck in between). The box shows that it takes up 14 days, but already I know there are some subtle differences.

However, if you're skeptical about this sort of stuff, that's fine. Really, if you brush your teeth as you're supposed to every day, then it wouldn't really matter what sort of toothpaste you use. Only once did I have to use a whitening kit (by Crest) years ago, and that's becuase my teeth yellowed from drinking gallons of black tea.

This stuff works fine, and that's coming from a guy who has used the Colgate toothpaste bundles from Wal-Mart for years.

title: These are extremely disappointing!
text:
I chose to purchase this set, in part, because of all the positive reviews. I'm really wondering about those reviews in retrospect. I bought this set to help distribute hand sanitizer within our family (given the current Covid 19 scare). I have one large commercial bottle on hand and plan to make some new myself with recipes once I have all the ingredients needed. I wanted the 4 of us to each have our own carry bottle. The silicone, no leak, easy squeeze pitch appealed to me. I filled the 4 larger bottles (still quite small) with the sanitizer. But here's the rub: If I squeeze the bottle at all, the sanitizer squirts all over, up to a yard away and even into eyes (dangerous to say the least). Sanitizer is like liquid gold these days since it's very hard to buy. So at very least, these bottles have caused me harm and waste. And here's the other point: These are advertised as no leak, but that's just not true. The upper caps do not click down in any way. They are attached, but don't snap. No locking mechanism. While it's true that there's something of a sealed opening where the contents are intended to squeeze through, if the bottle is inadvertently squeezed, easy to do at the bottom of a purse or in a pocket, the contents leak/squeeze all over, again, making a mess and causing waste. I tried putting sanitizer into the very tiny little jars, but they don't work well either. The lids are hard to screw on and the tiny bit of contents they carry also seems to get all over. Perhaps these work better for other contents, like creams or something thicker. I can't speak to that as I purchased them only for sanitizer. I have not yet tried the spray bottles. I think there are only 2 of those, so maybe I can find some use for those. Over all these have been a real waste, wasting both my time and my supplies and my money purchasing! The have been pitifully disappointing, and I really wonder how they received many starred reviews.
Post Script: This company reached out to me following this review with both apologies and a welcome refund. While it doesn't change my mind about the bottles themselves, I will say that the company couldn't have been nicer. There's so little customer service these days, it's nice when a company goes out of its way to please.

The kit is very well packaged. My hair is thick and shoulder length. The amount of product supplied is sufficient. Instructions are easy to follow/understand-be sure to read prior to using for the first time.

Light Blonde (9N) is the perfect shade for me. Covers grays beautifully, doesn't make hair brassy or dry it out. I do wish the color lasted longer; it fades a bit faster than my normal hair color brand.

Overall, a very good hair dye/color that is easy to use, delivers results and doesn't cause adverse effects to my sensitive skin.

title: Feels Wonderful and is Long Lasting
text:
I was experiencing a flare-up of eczema on my face the first time I tried this cream. As soon as I applied it, the itching and burning sensation was calmed and soothed. Felt wonderful. In addition to helping with eczema, this is a fantastic daily cream. Its lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feel behind. A little goes a long way. Skin is softened and moisturized immediately and stays that way for a long time. I have terribly dry skin and especially during cold months must apply moisturizer more than once a day. I don't have to do that when i use this cream. Once in the morning and once before bed is all it takes. There is a bit of a light scent that I can't quite place...I want to say maybe 'earthy'/'grassy'? At any rate, its not long lasting at all. By the time the cream has absorbed, the scent is gone.

I experience no adverse effects from this cream despite my skin being dry and very sensitive.

This is a keeper. I just love it. Delivers results and not much is needed per use making the price reasonable.
