title: Wonderful Scent, Even Better Products
text:
I am new to the Nudy Rudy brand and am already a huge fan. It arrives beautifully packaged. Included in the trio of products: hand soap (app 16oz size), hand cream and a bar soap. All are crafted from natural ingredients and no harsh chemicals. The hand and bar soaps cleanse gently but very well. The hand cream (my favorite) softens and helps prevent those awful, painful dry little cracks that appear on my hands throughout the cold winter months. Absorption is fast and doesn't leave a greasy feel behind. All are in the 'cloudberry' scent. My only experience with cloudberry is a lemonade from a local fast food restaurant...lol. I have no other experience/knowledge of cloudberry. But these smell fantastic. Not strong or overpowering. A bit cherry-like and delicious.

This is an excellent trio of quality products. The price is reasonable. Makes a nice gift. Once I use these up, I'm going to try the the Hunny Bunny scent.

text:
Got this for my husband to cover the greys that have been popping up more and more. Its very easy to use-the bottle has shampoo on one side, coloring on the other. While wearing gloves, dispense, rub hands together to form a lather, work into hair, allow it to sit 15-20 then rinse thoroughly. Does an impressive job of covering greys and the black is very natural looking. Blends beautifully with the rest of his hair, you can't tell the difference between his 'regular' black hair and the grey-turned black hair. Doesn't burn/itch in any way. He's only used it once so far and the color is holding up nearly 2 weeks after use.

No mess, works well and delivers results with the first use. Can be used on all hair types. This bottle will last him quite some time. The price is more than reasonable. This product does what it promises to do.

title: Delivers Long Lasting Moisture, Even in Cold Winter Months
text:
Is this ever working wonders on my dry, sensitive skin. I prefer to use it at night after cleansing and using toner. A little goes a long way. I apply/rub lightly into skin to get it started but change to lightly patting for proper absorption which is fast and doesn't leave a greasy look/feel behind. My skin is left incredibly soft and moisturized for a long time; exactly what i need, especially throughout cold winter months.

Torriden is packed with lots of wonderful skin-loving ingredients that do not cause any issues for my sensitive, dry skin. The price is reasonable.

title: Easy To Use...Can't Wait to See Results!
text:
Light therapy can work wonders on skin. Baniful's LED light therapy face mask couldn't be any easier to use. (READ THE INSTRUCTIONS PRIOR TO USE! They're not complicated but they are important!) The mask has 7 different light color settings, each provides a particular benefit to skin.

7 lights:

*red-reduces the appearance of fine lines/wrinkles
*orange-evens skin tones
*green-reduces oil secretion
*blue-acne skin inflammation/reduces acne
*cyan-promotes metabolism ,whitens skin
*dark purple-heals acne scars
*purple-tightens sagging skin

The mask is comfortable to wear and when in use. No pain involved. No need to keep your eye on the clock, it has an automatic timer and will shut off on its own.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues using this.

Can't say I've experienced any results but I've not used it very long; its too soon. I'm excited to continue use, hoping for some help with my fine lines and dull skin tone. Makes a nice gift.

title: Works/Smells Great and at a 'Can't Be Beat'  Price!
text:
Ordered this for my husband and he loves it. Very refreshing, especially first thing in the morning when he showers. Helps wake him up. Very cleansing and doesn't further dry his already dry skin. Has a fantastic, clean scent though it does fades quickly.

Cleanses, smells great, 16.9oz bottle, contains 90% natural origin ingredients, bottle is 100% post consumer recycled plastic....all these benefits and the price can't be beat! Highly recommended

title: Cute, Durable and Secure Hair Very Well
text:
I have thick, shoulder length hair and have broken my share of hair clips over the years. Kitsch's plastic large claw clips are surprisingly strong (Especially so seeing as they're made from recycled products!) and do a fantastic job of securing my hair and keeping it in place. No strands pop out throughout the day, even when I exercise. The claws are easy to open/close and don't pull or hurt in any way. They're cute and come in three different shades. (the neutral color set)

What's not to like about these clips? They're cute, durable and get the job done. The price is more than reasonable. Definitely recommended for those with thick hair.

title: Wonderful Conditioner
text:
Just had the pleasure of testing/reviewing Soapbox's leave in conditioner and now I've tested/reviewed Soapbox's Biotin conditioner (travel size). I'm happy to say, I love it as much as the leave-in.

24 travel size (3.3oz) bottles come in a pack. One bottle more than sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. The conditioner is easy to work into/rinse from hair. Does a wonderful of detangling and softens instantly. Leaves my normally dull hair shiny with some much needed bounce. I've not yet used it long enough to experience more hair growth. I'm OK with that, I'm loving the results I've already achieved. There is a gorgeous, light scent. I wish I could say its long lasting but it fades quickly.

Can be used on all hair types.

The travel bottles are perfect for travel. I actually gave a few bottles to family, friends and neighbors so they can try this conditioner. I'd definitely purchase it again~

title: Great Leave-In That Delivers Promised Results
text:
This is a really nice, well priced leave-in conditioner that delivers promised results. It dispenses evenly like a mist. 3-4 spritzes sufficiently covers my thick shoulder length hair. Does a wonderful job of detangling and instantly softens and adds shine to my normally dull hair. There is no scent and it does not weigh down hair or cause it to look or feel greasy.

In addition to delivering results and a reasonable price, Soapbox donates bars of soap to people in need, so don't forget to enter the Hope Code (on the back of the product) on Soapbox's website to help others!

Recommended

title: Cleanses and Softens Well
text: I have dry, sensitive skin and deal with bouts of eczema, especially during the cold months. My doctor recommended I use a soap free cleanser on my face where I experience the worse eczema. KOOPE gel facial cleanser is soap and SLS free.  I like the consistency-gel but creamy. It works into a light lather and feels nice on my skin as I'm cleansing. Though gentle, it cleans well leaving my skin impressively soft (to the point I could get away with not using a moisturizer after though I do) and fresh. A little goes a long way. There is a bit of a scent that I find to be kind of chemical/medicinal. I don't care for it, however, when the cleanser is washed away, the scent goes with it. It is not long lasting and for that reason, I will not deduct anything from my overall score.

title: A Nice, Lightweight Leave-In (can be used on dry or damp hair)
text:
Sally Hershberger's 24K daily conditioner is a leave in that can be used on damp or dry hair. I tried both. When used on damp hair, it does a good job of detangling and softening. Though not heavy, it relaxes my natural waves a bit more than I'd like. When used on dry hair, it prevents frizz and adds fullness and even a bit of shine to my normally dull hair. I prefer to use it on dry hair.

It dispenses as a mist without issue. Has a nice, light scent.

Overall, a nice, lightweight leave in conditioner.

title: No Positive Results, Scent is VERY Strong
text:
My husband and I both used this shampoo. Neither of us experienced positive results. He used it mainly to help with dry flakes. Still has them. He also experienced some burning around his head from the shampoo. My use resulted in tangled hair that felt and looked dried out. Had lots of flyaways as well. We didn't care for the scent. Its very strong, almost medicinal/chemical.

Neither of us experienced positive results from using this and we have no plans to continue using it. Based on lack of results and the price, this is not a shampoo I can recommend.

title: So Far, So Good
text:
I am pleased with the reduction of puffiness around the eyes this cream delivers. And it does so quickly. However, I've yet to experience a noticeable change in the fine lines and dark circles that plague me. Keep in mind, I've not been using the cream very long.

Its easy to apply and absorption is fast. Doesn't leave a greasy look or feel behind. It does have a chemical-medicinal light scent that fades pretty much by the time absorption has occurred.

I am going to continue to use this twice daily as instructed.

So far, so good

title: Eliminates Frizz, Detangles and Smells Great
text:
A few pumps worth on my newly washed, damp hair does a great job of helping to eliminate frizz and keep my natural waves and curls nice and smooth. Helps to detangle as well. Has a nice, light, fresh scent though it doesn't last very long. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products for whatever reason) I love how it evenly dispenses as a mist on my hair.

Works great and I'm really looking forward to using it during the summer when its hot and humid and my hair majorly frizzes. This will keep it calm and smooth.

title: Does Everything It Promises to Do
text:
Moroccanoil does it again! Another fantastic product. This is a great leave in treatment. Can be used on dry or damp hair. (I tried both, I prefer to use it when hair is damp) Only a small amount is needed and its easy to work into hair. Doesn't weigh it down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. Adds shine and wonderful softness to hair while preventing frizz. Smells fantastic. Geared towards those with fine, light hair.

Love this. It does everything it promises to do. Its not cheap but I'd absolutely purchase again. I see its a limited edition item. Here's hoping Moroccanoil changes that and keeps it around permanently.

title: My First Mask...Love the Results!
text:
I never tried a face mask before. (Heck, if I'm being honest, I never heard of this type of face mask before!) Its quite easy to use. (FYI-keep the box the packets come in. This is where you'll find the instructions in English!) After cleansing the face, apply a moisturizer. Then simply place the mask (Grid side on your skin) on your face for 10-20 minutes. (I do it for the full 20 minutes) Once the mask has been removed, lightly press the remaining lotion into your skin for full absorption. Don't worry, holes for the eyes/mouth are pre-cut and you don't need to add any of the cream product, its already on the mask. The results are instant. Not only does the mask deliver hydration, it 'wakes up' my normally dull skin by brightening and adding glow. And the results last for quite some time.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no adverse effects/reactions to any of the products in the mask. Absorption is pretty fast adn doesn't leave a greasy/sticky look or feel behind.

My first experience using a mask of this type was a good one. I very much enjoyed it, felt like I was pampering myself. And the results are better than expected. 5 masks total are included in the pack. The price is reasonable.

title: Decent But Doesn't Really Stand Out
text:
Though it has a thick consistency, this conditioner is easy to work into hair/easy to rinse out. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel greasy. Adds moisture and hydration while at the same time softening and smoothing. Has a decent scent though it fades quickly.

I've not noticed any enhanced shine to my hair since using this.

This is a decent conditioner for those with thick hair. It does a nice enough job, I'm just not blown away by it. Doesn't really stand out for me. I find it a bit pricey as well. I have no plans to purchase this again.

title: Smooths, Unclogs and Even Gives My Dull Skin Some Glow
text:
Love everything about this exfoliator. Dispenses without issue. A little goes a very long way. Easy to apply, easy to rinse. Does a brilliant job of smoothing and softening-I literally can feel a difference immediately after use. Helps unclog pores and to my amazement, even adds some glow to my normally dull skin.

I have terribly dry, sensitive skin and was initially concerned the cranberry ingredient might cause some discomfort or an adverse reaction. Nope. No issues whatsoever.

The price is on the high-ish side. However, thanks to fantastic ingredients, only a small amount is needed per use, Pangea recommends using this only 3 days a week (Though it CAN be used daily...I'm following their recommendation and using it 3 days) and wonderful results, the price is reasonable.

**I'm a worrier so I figured I'd add this as an FYI...aside from the small metal screw on/off cap, the tube this comes in looks just like a tube of toothpaste. I immediately had visions of grabbing this tube in the morning when I'm half asleep thinking its toothpaste or the kids not paying attention and using it as toothpaste by accident. lol. So I keep this tube far away from the toothpaste to avoid any accidents. Just thought I'd mention that...lol**

title: Soothes, Smooths and Softens
text:
After using toner, I apply a few drops worth all around my face. Its not greasy or sticky, absorption occurs within a few minutes. Instantly cools and soothes the dry eczema patches on my cheeks and forehead. Softens and smooths as well. Really makes my skin feel good and fresh. Despite having terribly dry, sensitive skin I experience no adverse reactions to any of the ingredients in this product. Because a little goes a long way, this bottle will last quite some time. I very much like what this does for my skin, especially during the cold winter months. It is scent-free.

Recommended

title: Helps Calm and Soothe
text:
This is a very nice cream that applies easily without leaving a greasy feel behind. Absorption is fast. While it does a great job of softening and hydrating, I'm most impressed by its ability to calm and soothe redness, inflammation and irritation I experience courtesy of eczema. As promised, it does smooth but I can't say I notice a shine to my skin.

All in all, a very good, moisturizing cream that is helping to protect my skin during the harsh winter months.

title: Practically Performs a Miracle  On My Hair
text:
Jung Saem Mool Salon.ZIP Intensive Treatment isn't cheap but boy, its worth every penny of the price! My hair looks and feels like it did decades ago, before I damaged it by using too many hair care products, curling irons, hair dryer, hair dye, etc.

The treatment is fairly thick yet dispenses easily. A little goes a long way. I used an amount roughly the size of a half dollar (a tad more) to adequately cover my thick, shoulder length hair. Applies/rinses without issue. Its a nice consistency; I was a bit surprised by the little 'beads' in the treatment. (much like exfoliating skin care products) But they're not an issue, they don't get left behind after hair is rinsed, they come right out.

The first time I used this was right after I exercised so my hair was sweaty and tangled. After allowing it to sit for a few minutes I was able to run my fingers through my hair and remove the tangles easily. Does a wonderful job of not only softening but repairing, hydrating and healing. My hair shines after using this and that is huge since my hair is normally on the dull side. Adds much needed bounce as well. My natural waves/curls are left silky soft and smooth as if I just had my hair styled in a salon. I LOVE that.

There is a light scent that I just cannot place. I want to say kind of orange-ish yet kind of flowery but I stress its VERY light and not at all gagging/overpowering. It also doesn't last very long though that might be my hair, it rarely holds the scent of hair products for whatever reason.

I love this treatment. Its a miracle in a bottle for my hair. It restores and revives and adds much needed life to my hair. No doubt about it, I WILL purchase this after I finish my current bottle. Its that good.

title: Fabulous Conditioner That Delivers Results and is Well Priced
text:
Easy to apply, easy to rinse from hair. A little goes a long way. Does a great job of detangling, softening and adding fullness to hair. Adds long-lasting hydration to dry hair. Has a pleasant scent but it doesn't last very long. Love that the bottle is made from 100% recycled plastic!

Great conditioner that delivers results. Thanks to those results and the fact its 32oz in size, the price is incredibly reasonable.

title: Cleanses and Softens So Very Well
text: I've been doing Amazon's 'subscribe and save' plan for a name brand body wash. Recently, it  became temporarily unavailable and since I was almost out, I had to choose another. I went with OGX Smoothing Coconut Coffee Exfoliating body scrub. (Admittedly, I chose it because I really love OGX's Coconut Caffeine hair conditioner) And I chose well! This is an excellent exfoliating body wash. The exfoliating beads feel so nice.  Cleanses gently but very well while leaving my skin nice and soft. I have terribly dry skin-this doesn't dry it further nor do I experience any negative reactions/effects. Works well when I shave my legs.  Has a nice , pleasant scent but its not long lasting at all.  One bottle lasts me a LONG time.  The price is reasonable. I've since cancelled my old 'subscribe and save' body wash subscription and started a new one for this body wash.  I love it and will continue to purchase/use it.

title: Does A Good Job But Not Long Lasting
text:
Does a great job of removing brassiness while conditioning hair. I often have reactions (mainly itching) to hair color products but didn't experience any with this.

However, per the info provided, the reduction of brass can last up to 3 weeks. My hair didn't make it that long. Within a week I could tell it was wearing off. I seem to get better results using purple shampoo/conditioner for longer lasting removal of brassiness from my hair. This does a good job but because I experience better results with other products, I have no plan to use/purchase this again.

title: Works SO Well, Its Now an Important Part of My Skin Care Routine...WOW!
text:
Now THIS is something special! I'm so very impressed with the results I achieved after ONE use!

The device is packaged in a very nice box. Included is the device itself, a stand to keep it on and good, easy to understand, detailed instructions.

Its SO easy to use. On clean, dry skin (Do not use lotion prior to use, use AFTER!) make either round circular motions or up/down motions. I tried both a number of times and found I prefer circular motion. My skin is terribly dry and so very sensitive; its at its worst now that winter is here. Using this instantly removes the dryness leaving my skin so soft and smooth while decreasing the itching and redness.

This is not painful to use though the first time I tried it, I pressed down a bit too hard. For awhile after, my arms felt as though I had a mild sunburn. It should not be used on the face/neck. (I admit, I'm a bit bummed about this, I was hoping to use it on my face. )

In addition to removing dry skin, this can help reduce wrinkles/fine lines (remember, don't use on your face!), fade stretch marks /brown spots, improve crepiness/red bumps and scars.

I normally slather lotion all over my arms and legs during the winter. I no longer have to use it thanks to this tool. It is WAY better than any lotion or other exfoliating device I've tried. My husband used it once on a particularly dry area on his leg. He's not had to use it since.

This is a phenomenal tool that works so incredibly well with the very first use. Its definitely worthy of gift giving. There is a note included in the box from Diane, the creator. She writes that she designed this to help her mother's dry skin. Unfortunately, her mother passed away without giving it a try. I have no doubt her mother would have been proud and experienced wonderful results. This has become one to the most important parts of my skin care routine. Without a doubt, I highly recommend it.

title: A Bit Pricey But Delivers Results
text:
My dry, damaged hair is revived after using this mask. Just 10 minutes on hair (after shampooing) is all it takes. The product is easy to apply, easy to rinse. Doesn't weigh hair down or leave it greasy. Eliminates frizz while moisturizing, softening and even adding some shine to my normally dull hair. And its nice to see my hair shine.

Nice product. A bit on the pricey side but it delivers results.

title: Awesome for My Thick Hair
text:
Love these 'hair snap clips'. (In my mind, they're barrettes! lol) They do a brilliant job of not only containing my thick hair but somehow, they stay in place and don't slide down no matter what activity I' perform. That is impressive. I can't say the same for many other barrettes! They're easy to use/easy to remove. They work great and the price is more than reasonable.

Recommended

title: Helps Puffiness But No Noticeable Change to Fine Line
text:
As the saying goes, 'cool as a cucumber'. This eye cream feels nice and cool when applied around my tired, puffy eyes. The coolness instantly settles and calms puffiness. It even helps reduce the dark circles that plague me on the nights insomnia is paying me a visit. And I'm grateful for that relief.

But I can't say I notice a decrease to my fine lines and wrinkles. Perhaps I've not used it long enough? I will continue to use it because I like how it really helps the puffiness.

Has a light, crisp cucumber scent that I do enjoy though its not long lasting.

Time will tell if I decide to purchase this eye cream. Its fairly pricey for a small jar. I'll need to see a reduction to the fine lines /wrinkles in order to consider purchasing/continued use.

title: Eh-Not the Right Moisturizer for Me
text:
This is a nice, lightweight moisturizer that works well on my dry, sensitive skin. It dispenses well, is easy to apply, absorption is fast. Doesn't leave a greasy/sticky look or feel behind. Scent-free. Hydrates and moisturizes well. But I cannot say that it keeps my skin moisturized for 24 hours. It does not. Perhaps my skin is too dry and sensitive because one application in 24 hours just isn't enough. I also cannot say that it makes my skin glow.

Though not expensive, I just don't get enough results to warrant continued use/purchase of this moisturizer. By no means is it bad, its just not the right moisturizer for me.

Overall rating is 3.5 stars

title: Relieves Dry Scalp While Adding Moisture to Hair (smells good too!)
text:
Ordered this for my husband who is experiencing issues with dry scalp/hair. Ever since we turned the heat on full time for the winter, he's been dealing with both. The conditioner is lightweight. Easy to apply/easy to rinse. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel greasy. Keeps his natural curls nice and soft. Definitely adds much needed moisture and doing a great job of keeping his hair hydrated. His scalp dryness has improved-still has it but not nearly as bad as it was. He uses the conditioner twice a week. Has a nice, light scent though it doesn't last very long.

Thanks to an almost 33oz bottle size and him only using it 2x's a week, this bottle will last a LONG TIME. The price is reasonable, the results are awesome.

title: A Good Enough Conditioner-But Not a 'Must-Have'
text:
I like Maui hair care products and was exciting to give Black Soap conditioner a try. Applies/rinses easily. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel greasy. Softens and moisturizes pretty well. Has a nice scent that doesn't stick around very long. (Few hair care product scents last long in my hair for whatever reason)

Its a good conditioner, I'm just not blown away by it. Overall score: 3.5 stars

title: Works Great, The Pouch is Handy
text:
Big fan of OGX products, especially Teatree Mint conditioner. I love this refill pouch. The cap twists off easily. I initially considered using the conditioner straight from the pouch as it dispenses easily but in the end, decided to use as instructed. I filled an empty OGX bottle with this conditioner then stored the pouch in a the bathroom closet. When the bottle is empty, I'll refill.

The pouch contains 36oz, enough for 3 refills. I love this conditioner-the mint feels so nice and cool as it sits on my hair. Kind of like when you eat a menthol cough drop or Peppermint Patty candy but not quite as bold. lol. Easy to apply, easy to rinse. Adds much needed moisture and shine to my hair without weighing it or my natural curls down. Has a nice scent that unfortunately fades quickly. (Most hair care product scents do not last in my hair for whatever reason)

Great conditioner, great price and by reusing the bottle via this refill pouch, it'll help the environment.

title: One of the Best
text:
Without a doubt, this is easily one of the best face creams I've ever used. A small amount is dispensed with each pump of the bottle. The consistency is thick yet its easy to apply, a little goes a long way and absorption is fast. Skin is instantly softened and smoothed and stays that way. The ingredient list is impressive, especially the Hyaluronic Acid.

Not sure if this is normal or due to my dry, sensitive skin but right after applying, my skin feels a bit tight for a few minutes. (not in a painful way)

I've not used this very long but absolutely will continue to. The price is reasonable.

title: Adds Dewiness to My Dull Skin
text:
Despite a fairly thick consistency, the cream is lightweight, easy to apply and a little goes a long way. Absorption is fast and doesn't leave a greasy look/feel behind. Skin is immediately softened and that includes the red, rough patches of dryness and eczema that are out in full force on my face thanks to the cold weather. I love the noticeable dewiness to my normally dull skin. Looks so much healthier after applying. There is no scent and I experience no issues with any of the cream's ingredients despite having terribly sensitive skin.

This cream isn't cheap but it is worth the price.

title: Fabulous Conditioner!
text:
Love this conditioner. Does a wonderful job of of moisturizing my dry, damaged hair while delivering incredible softness. Doesn't weigh hair down. Easy to apply/rinse. Has a scent that I can't really describe and should be one that I don't care much for but I actually do, if that makes sense. lol.

You can't go wrong with Renpure products!

title: Excellent Deal-Razors Work So Very Well
text:
This is an excellent deal. Twelve -3 blade disposable BIC Sensitive razors come in this value pack. My husband has sensitive skin and the lubricating strip which contains vitamin E and aloe really go a long way in helping to prevent itching, burning and red spots after he has shaved. The head is pivoting, ensuring a complete shave including the 'hard to reach' spots and the handle is comfortable to hold. He's been using the same razor for over a week and its holding up well, still delivering a great shave.

The price is more than reasonable. Recommended

title: Fabulous Leave-In (and it smells great!)
text:
What a fantastic leave-in conditioner! I was a bit worried when I sprayed some for the first time. Its on the thicker side and I was afraid it would weigh my hair down. Nope. Not an issue. (It also dispenses well despite the thick consistency) 3-4 sprays on my thick, shoulder length hair is sufficient. Does a wonderful job detangling and instantly softens hair. Adds some shine and bounce to my natural waves. Has a lovely, mild scent but it fades quickly.

I don't use a hair dryer so I cannot comment as to how well it protects against heat. (up to 450 degrees)

Love this leave in. Yes, its a bit on the pricey side. But its packed with great ingredients for hair, works fantastic, smells wonderful and only a small amount is needed per use; the bottle will last me quite some time. Its worth every penny.

title: Overpriced, So-So Results
text:
This is a 4 ingredient/4 step skin care kit from Bare Method

Step 1/Ingredient 1: Calming cleanser. Removes impurities

Step 2/Ingredient 2: Serum with hyaluronic acid, squalene, avocado oil . Hydrates and protects skin barrier

Step 3/Ingredient 3: Moisturizer w/UV protection. Moisturizes and brightens.

Step 4/Ingredient 4: Whipped facial mask. Firms and brightens

The cleanser is nice and gentle. Refreshing. Doesn't burn or negatively affect my dry, sensitive skin in any way. Cleanses well.

The serum feels kind of oily/greasy prior to absorption which takes a bit of time to occur. It does kind of hydrate but I see no skin barrier change. Doesn't entirely get rid of the redness/inflammation /dry skin patches I experience.

The moisturizer does moisturize and does so very well. But it doesn't brighten my skin very much.

The facial mask does help reduce fine lines.

This kit isn't cheap. If I'm going to spend a lot of money on a skin care kit, it better blow me away. Unfortunately, this kit does not. Based on the results I experienced (or lack of) and the small amount of product in each container, I find the kit overpriced. I have no plans to continue to use/purchase in the future.

Overall score: 2.5 stars

title: Does Everything It Promises To Do...And Then Some!
text:
Prior to writing this review, I logged into my account and purchased another bottle of this sensational conditioner. I'm obsessed!

This particular formula is for thin, fine hair. My hair is thick. (With the exception of the scalp area where its thinning due to aging). I probably shouldn't have ordered this particular formula but I did and am SO glad. Despite having thick hair, this conditioner really gave it life! Added so much bounce and fullness all over. And the shine...oh, the shine is wonderful. My hair never shines but now it does. My natural waves and curls just look so nice and so smooth, like i stepped out of a salon. The scent is gorgeous and long lasting. The scent of hair care products rarely last long in my hair for whatever reason. This one does and its awesome. I'm also thrilled how well this detangles.

This is perfection in a bottle, at least when it comes to my hair. Its almost as though time has been turned back a few decades to the days when I was young, before I subjected my hair to dyes, heat, curling irons, all kinds of hair care products, etc. Back to the days when my hair was untouched. (Wish this worked on the rest of me like that! lol) I just love it. Already ordered a second bottle as well as CHI's Curl Reactivating Spray.

The price is more than reasonable. This conditioner does everything it promises to do and then some.

Highly recommended

title: Good Cream But I'm Not Blown Away
text:
This is a nice, lightweight, scent-free day cream with the main ingredient being rice water. Provides long lasting moisture and softness while strengthening the skin barrier. Absorption is fast and doesn't leave a greasy/sticky look or feel behind.

Overall, a good day cream but I'm not blown away by it. I find the price a bit on the high side as well. I'll definitely use the jar but have no plans to purchase in the future.

Score is 3.5 stars

title: Inexpensive, Salon Quality Polish (This blue is just gorgeous!)
text: KISS Gel Strong is a VERY reasonably priced nail polish that works just as well as salon polish. Though its 'gel strong', a lamp is not needed.  The brush is a good size and provides good coverage. I've been using this particular color, Mystery Ocean for years now. Its a GORGEOUS shade of blue with such a pretty shimmer. The polish lasts quite some time and doesn't chip or peel off.

title: A Phenomenal Body Butter (and it smells SO good!)
text:
The best way to describe Kopari Ultra Restore Body Butter??? PHENOMEMAL! This truly is a phenomenal body butter. Though on the thick side, its easy to apply, a little goes a LONG way, absorption is fast and doesn't leave a sticky/greasy feel or look behind. Works wonders on my dry, sensitive skin keeping it nice and moisturized for quite some time. Softens beautifully as well. The ingredient list is impressive: hyaluronic acid (a fave of mine!), prickly pear extract, coconut oil, vitamin B5 and mango butter, to name a few. And the scent? How I LOVE the scent. Unfortunately, it fades quickly. I wish it didn't. Its so very nice.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues using this cream.

Testing this marked my first ever experience with the Kopari brand and I'm already a huge fan. I love this body butter. And now I have my mom hooked on it as well...she bought her own jar after trying mine. Thanks to the great results, scent, large jar size, ingredient list the price is absolutely reasonable.

Definitely recommended!

title: An Excellent Overnight Cream That Delivers Good Results
text:
Love how this feels in the instant it touches my skin. The dry patches are immediately soothed and calmed. Keeps my skin soft and moisturized long after its been applied. The consistency reminds me of a very firm custard. Its thick yet easy to apply-a little goes a long way-and absorption is pretty quick; a matter of minutes. Doesn't leave a greasy look/feel behind. Has a very faint yet pleasant scent that is pretty much faded by the time absorption has taken place.

I have dry, terribly sensitive skin and experience no negative issue from this cream.

I've not experienced a noticeable change in the firmness of my skin but then again, I've not used this very long.

I prefer to use this at nighttime. I believe this is going to help my skin tremendously during the upcoming winter months. I REALLY like this cream and will definitely continue to use AND purchase. The price is reasonable, the results are great.

***The cream contains discarded animal placenta but don't worry, animals are NOT harmed in any way***

title: My First Balm-Love It.
text:
Testing this marked the first time I've ever used a balm. And I really like it. The triangle shaped applicator does a fabulous job of getting to my 'hard to reach spots' (aside of my nose) but also around my eyes where new fine lines seem to pop up on a daily basis. lol. No more getting cream in my eyes as sometimes happens when I'm applying, the balm stick prevents that from happening. It glides over skin easily, absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky/greasy look or feel behind. I'm happy how this brightens my normally dull skin while softening as well. Brings relief to the patches of eczema that are starting to flare up thanks to the cold weather/heat on in the house 24/7.

I can't say I've noticed a huge change in my fine lines but I don't expect to at this point, I've not used this very long. I will continue to use the balm. The price is reasonable and its probable I will continue to use/purchase in the future.

title: Good Serum Helping to Make Fine Lines Thinner
text:
Such a nice serum that applies without issues and doesn't cause skin to look or feel oily/greasy. Absorption is fast. Skin is left soft and silky smooth. Thanks to continued use, I do have a noticeable decrease in my fine lines, especially around my eyes. But so far, I've not noticed a lightening to dark spots.

I like this serum and plan to continue using it. I hope that with continued use I see the dark spots lighten.

The serum is a bit on the pricey side but I do think its worth it.

title: Not the Right Conditioner for My hair
text:
This is not the right conditioner for my hair.

It dispenses, applies to/rinses from hair without issue.

After rinsing, my hair looked and felt like wet straw. It didn't detangle-in fact, it seemed to add tangles. Had to use some leave-in conditioner in order to get a comb through my hair. While it did deliver some softness, it pretty much made my hair limp with my natural waves more on the straight side. There is a light scent that I didn't care for-reminded me of plastic. However, by the time my hair air dried, the scent was no longer detectable. It faded quickly.

Due to little positive results as well as a price on the high-side, I have no plans to continue to use/purchase this conditioner again.

title: Good Cream That Delivers Results-Reasonably Priced
text:
Creamy and lightweight, VVBetter Centella Asiatica moisturizing cream is easy to apply. A very small amount sufficiently covers my face. As long as I don't use too much at once, absorption is pretty fast and does not leave a greasy/oily look or feel behind. Delivers much needed moisture to my skin leaving it dewy and hydrated. Continued use helps reduce the fine lines that seem to pop up more and more often around my eyes.

I cannot say that I've noticed a change in the firmness of my skin but then again, I've not been using the cream terribly long.

Comes with a spatula and arrives safety-sealed. There is no scent. The cream does not affect my sensitive skin in a negative way at all.

Good results and a very reasonable price. Recommended

title: From Bad to Worse...
text:
Things rapidly went from bad to worse from the moment I removed the lid. Despite a safety seal on the jar that was intact, the cream managed to leak all over the place. What a mess. (see photos) After wiping down the jar, I attempted to pull the tab on the seal to remove it....and it broke. I couldn't get the tab off with my fingernails, I had to get a sharp steak knife and use the tip to finally pry it off.

The next issue was the cream itself. The consistency was thick and gummy, almost like melted taffy but not sticky. Felt very heavy as I applied it though that feeling did go away eventually. Unfortunately, it was replaced with a burning sensation. I waited it out a few minutes but the burning didn't go away so I wiped it off entirely.

The cream had a scent-not overpowering but noticeable. Reminded me of clay

I don't know if my jar was just a fluke; between leaking all over the place (despite a safety seal), the gumminess, scent and burning sensation, this is not a cream I can recommend and one I have no plans to continue to use (already threw it away) or purchase in the future.

title: Not a Temporary Fix...This Really Thickens Hair!
text:
Finally. A product that doesn't simply make my thinning hair look thicker, its actually making it thicker and strengthening as well.

The one thing I've always had is thick hair. Thanks to aging, the once thick hair around the scalp area and front (bangs area) is now pretty thin, making me terribly self-conscious. For a time, I was able to cover the areas pretty well with volumizing sprays and a boar bristle hairbrush. Unfortunately, those were temporary solutions. I'm still aging and my hair is still thinning.

The Bosley kit comes with 3 products: shampoo, conditioner and a leave-in spray. The instructions for each are simple and so very easy to follow. Nothing out of the ordinary. I have sensitive skin and experience no adverse reaction to any of the products. They have a nice scent to them though it doesn't last very long and fades quickly.

Now that I've used the products for a few weeks, results are starting to show. Soon after using for the first time, I noticed a decrease of hair in the shower drain as well as hairbrush. (That continues to be the case.) I'm both surprised and impressed to see how quickly my hair now grows since using the kit. I'm 51 years old; my hair growth has slowed down considerably over the last 15 years or so. To see the growth increasing now is pretty amazing. Best of all, the thinning hair that has made me so self-conscious is starting to thicken. And not in a temporary way like the volumizing sprays/boar bristle brush deliver. I mean its actually coming in thicker and fuller...slowly but surely. Its such a relief and I'm truly grateful for the result. I'm really starting to feel much better about my appearance.

The shampoo and conditioner bottles are 5.1oz, the leave-in is 3.4oz in size. They are small. Despite the size, the kit is worth every penny of the cost. Its quite a bargain thanks to how well everything works and the amazing results. I've not only purchased a second kit, I' purchased one for my mom as well. I am so very pleased, happy and satisfied. I truly hope everyone achieves the same results as me.

title: Soothing, Not Sticky, Lots of Uses (and reasonably priced!)
text:
I meant to update this a few weeks ago and forgot. Just remembered now. Per the info on this page, this gel cream can be used on hair. However, no instructions were included. I emailed the company and received a response after just a few days. A nice, detailed response. Apply gel throughout wet hair (after shampooing/rinsing), allow it to sit on hair for 5-10 minutes, rinse thoroughly with warm water. I'll tell you right now, this does NOT detangle. I am able to comb through the tangles w/o too much of an issue but 2-3x's, I did break down and spray a light coconut mist leave in conditioner to help get through thte tough tangles. And its worth it. I LOVE using this on my hair. My goodness, it not only makes my hair bounce, it makes it shine, something it just does not do on its own (and often doesn't do even when using products that claim to make it shine) My natural waves are more prominent and just
look SO good. My hair is softer and smoother for days after using this.
I use it once a week, sometimes twice. Love not only how well this works on skin but hair as well!

******************************************
We've only been using MIZON's Cica Aloe gel cream for a few days and we all love it. I purchased a second jar for my parents-that's how well it works and how much we love it.

The jar is 10.58 fl oz and filled to the top. I LOVE gel creams and this does not disappoint. A little goes a VERY long way. Its easy to apply and absorption is super fast. Doesn't leave a sticky/greasy feel behind at all. It is unscented.

We went straight from summer to fall here. No in-between. One day the AC was on, literally the next the heat. Skin dryness /itchiness is already affecting all of us in the house...especially me due to my terribly sensitive, dry skin. This gel cream delivers instant soothing and much needed hydration. And it feels so nice because the gel is cool. I use it 2x's a day, as does my husband. I also used a tiny drop on 2 mosquito bites that have been driving me bonkers the past couple of days. lol. The itching was decreased big time. I'm going to give it a try as a hair mask as well. (I've not yet done so, I emailed MIZON with a question and will give it a try once I hear back)

We love this gel cream and my parents will as well. The price is very reasonable and I will definitely purchase another jar.

title: An Incredible Leave-In (and boy, does it smell GOOD!)
text:
There's magic in this bottle! At least when it comes to my hair. After I shampoo and towel dry, I spray some of the product onto my hand then apply throughout my hair. The instructions say to use an amount the size of a quarter. That's too much for my hair. (Just above the shoulders and thick) An amount a bit larger than a nickel is a sufficient amount for me. It immediately detangles and softens. Frizz is not an issue for me after using this, even on hot, humid days. My natural waves are left smooth, without flyaways. Doesn't weigh my hair down. I know strengthening is happening; I'm noticing next to no hair in the drain and hairbrush since using this. Doesn't harm my hair color at all and actually adds a bit of shine , something my hair normally lacks.

And the scent...ah, the scent. Its fantastic! Light and soft-I'd be perfectly fine if my hair smelled this way 24/7...its THAT good!

This is an exceptional leave-in. A little goes a long way and it delivers results. Definitely worth the price and highly recommended for all hair types.

title: Lacking Impressive Results-Overpriced
text: AG Care Curl conditioner does a decent enough job detangling and softening my hair. Has a nice enough scent that doesn't last very long. Easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. That's about it. I've not noticed any change to my natural curls/waves from using it. Nothing about it really stands out and makes it special.  Due to the lack of results, I find this to be overpriced. This isn't a conditioner I plan on using again.  It just doesn't do anything major for my hair.

title: No Different Than My Regular Conditioner
text:
I've used this twice so far and haven't really seen any results that stand out and make this product special. Yes, it softens and I've had less hair in the shower drain/hairbrush. But nothing about it really stands out. I don't see a change in my hair color lasting longer, my hair still becomes dry a few days after use. There is a scent that's pleasant enough but it has a hint of medicinal tone to it.

The results from this really aren't any different from the daily hair conditioners I use. I really don't have a reason to use this over other less expensive conditioners that do the same job. I have no plans to purchase/use this again. It just didnt' do much of anything for my hair.

title: Decent Enough (but overpriced!)
text:
Without a doubt, this is a decent conditioner. Its lightweight, easy to apply/easy to rinse out. A little goes a long way. Detangles very well while moisturizing and keeping frizz away. Has a lovely , light scent that unfortunately doesn't last very long.

While the conditioner pretty much does what it promises to do, I'm just not blown away by it. It doesn't really stand out for me...its not a 'must have'. Despite it being an Amazon 'Premium Beauty ' product (For those not aware, a 'premium beauty product = Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men.) I feel its over-priced.

title: Refreshes My Curls and Waves
text: Another awesome Kenra product! A few sprays worth of this leave-in keeps my curls and natural waves shiny, soft and smooth while preventing frizz.  Refreshes my hair and even adds a bit of shine, something my hair normally lacks. Does a nice job of detangling. Has a great smell that I wish lasted longer. The price is reasonable.

title: Love This!
text: What an awesome rinse out conditioner. Easy to work into hair/easy to rinse out.  Doesn't weigh hair down. Detangles so very well.  My natural curls and waves are made soft and smooth, my dry hair is quenched and moisturized. And it stays that way for a few days after use. There is a nice, light scent; unfortunately, it fades quickly.  The price is quite reasonable...this conditioner does everything it promises to do.

title: My Hair Needs This-So I Enrolled in 'Subscribe and Save'! (It works that well!)
text:
Love this. It just what my hair needs when its at its worst. And believe me, right now it is at its worst thanks to extreme heat/humidity coupled with swimming almost daily. This conditioning cream revives and strengthens my damaged hair while smoothing and softening and keeping frizz at bay. I'm not seeing hair in the drain or in my hairbrush. And the positive results actually last for awhile. There is a light and lovely scent though it fades quickly.

My hair is just above shoulder length and very thick. I used the entire 1.7oz bottle at one time. The conditioner is very thick, I had to use it all to adequately cover my hair. Rinsed out with no issues.

I love this. It works so very well in my hair. I enrolled in Amazon's 'subscribe and save' to have this delivered once a month to help heal and strengthen my dry, damaged hair. The price is reasonable. (-Keep in mind this is a 1.7oz bottle!)

title: Works Great, Smells Great!
text:
If your curls and waves need a 'pick me up' in the morning as mine sometimes do, L'Oreal's Professional Curl Reviver just might be what you're looking for. On the mornings when my hair is just flat and 'blah', a few sprays worth followed by some hair scrunching is just what my waves and curls need to revive them. While it is lightweight, its important to heed the instructions of holding the bottle 20cm (app 8 inches) away from hair while spraying. I didn't do this the first time and my hair looked oily with curls/waves weighed down and not very prominent. When dispensed from the recommended distance, the product is evenly distributed on hair and doesn't weigh it down or cause it to look/feel oily nor does it make hair hard/crunchy. I spray , scrunch and am then good to go. Works all day long, even against hot, humid temps.

Has a lovely scent that I very much like and can actually detect long after I've applied the spray.

Some curl refreshers don't work well on my hair. This one does. I love how it revives, keeps frizz away and smells. Great product, reasonable price.

title: Love Everything About This Conditioner!
text:
What a wonderful conditioner! Its lightweight- a little goes a long way. I use an amount a bit larger than a half dollar to sufficiently cover my thick, shoulder length hair. Easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. Detangles beautifully. Doesn't weigh hair down. Helps bring some shine and brightness to my typically dull hair while softening and smoothing as well-with the first use. Has a fantastic scent that I can still smell the day after use. That doesn't happen often, my hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products. I have no clue why, its sure nice to experience my hair smelling so good!

This conditioner does what it promises to do and then some. The price is reasonable, especially for being an Amazon 'Professional Beauty product. (For those not familiar, "What is Amazon Professional Beauty? Amazon has curated a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices. ")

title: Work Great, Excellent Price
text:
I'm still a fan of good old eyeliner pencils. None of that liquid eyeliner for me. I had a really good sharpener that I've used for years that magically vanished and needed another. I ordered this 5 pack of sharpeners. They do a great job. Each sharpener has 2 different size holes to handle different size pencils. With just a few easy twists, the pencil is well sharpened. The lid comes off for easy disposal of the shavings. A small pick is included to help assist cleaning out the sharpeners.

The sharpeners are a nice, compact size and work very well. The price is reasonable.

title: Delivers a Deep Cleansing While Smoothing and Brightening
text:
The instructions are simple: after cleansing, wipe a pad all around the face, rub in any excess liquid. So that's what I did. It was a bit unsettling to see dirt on the pad seeing as I had literally just washed my face moments earlier. Goes to show, regular cleansing is not enough.

The liquid product is gentle yet effective. Provides a good, deep cleansing that leaves my skin smooth, soft, brighter and CLEAN! I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues using this. Feels nice as its applied and absorbs quickly.

Though the instructions recommend using the pads twice daily, I use only one per day. The price is a bit on the high side, but well worth it. This is a great product that does what it promises to do. Its also an Amazon 'Premium Beauty' product and deservedly so. (For those not familiar, "Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men. To buy Premium Beauty and Premium Men’s Grooming items, just look for the Premium Beauty badge.")

Recommended

title: Purchased a Second Bottle After Trying This For the First Time
text:
I'm surprised by the price of this conditioner. I expected it to cost far more than it does seeing as it works wonders on my dry damaged hair. Its easy to apply, easy to rinse out. A little goes a long way. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look greasy. Detangles. Does a great job of hydrating my drier -than-usual hair (thanks to swimming daily) while adding some much needed bounce and even some shine, something my hair normally lacks. My natural waves stay soft and smooth all day long after using this.

It is scented...a lovely, light scent that unfortunately doesn't last long in my hair.

This is wonderful conditioner packed with awesome ingredients for healthy hair. Does a beautiful job of healing dry, damaged hair. The price is more than reasonable. I've already purchased a second bottle. That is how much I love this conditioner.

title: Works & Smells Great
text: An excellent, lightweight finishing spray that doesn't weigh hair down or make it hard and crunchy.  Adds fullness, especially around my scalp where hair is thinning due to aging. Does a great job maintaining my natural waves all day long, even in heat and humidity.  Has a fantastic scent that  unfortunately doesn't last very long before fading. (My hair tends to not hold the scent of most hair products very long...no clue why) This is an Amazon Premium Beauty product and deservedly so.  (For those not familiar: "Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men")  The price is reasonable..

title: Wonderful Creme...(this jar will last a LONG time!)
text:
Nivea Creme is proof an excellent product doesn't have to cost and arm and a leg! I do love Nivea products. Been a fan for ages. This creme is packed with vitamins and other skin-loving ingredients. Applies well, absorption is fast and doesn't leave a greasy look/feel behind. Can be used on the face and body. Does a wonderful job of moisturizing and quenching the dry patches of skin that plague me. I must admit, the size of the jar surprised me. I did know it was a 16oz size but when I actually lifted it out of the packaging I couldn't believe how big it was! lol. Cold weather is right around the corner...this will certainly last us throughout the winter months.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues using this

The price is incredibly reasonable. Exxc

title: A Good Shampoo/Conditioner Duo
text:
I've only used this shampoo/conditioner duo a few times so its far too soon to tell if its helping with hair growth. But they are both very good products. The shampoo consistency is on the thin side, it dispenses without issue and is easy to work into/rinse from hair. The directions recommended allowing it to sit on hair for 2 minutes before rinsing. It has a bit of a chemical/medicinal scent though its pretty much gone once the shampoo is rinsed out. The conditioner is thicker, dispenses well , is easy to work into/rinse from hair. It has a pleasant, yet light scent that I can no longer detect once my hair has dried. In both cases, a little product goes a long way.

This duo does a great job of cleansing, moisturizing and detangling hair. It adds softness and even some shine to my normally dull hair. My husband has been using the shampoo as well and it is helping to prevent minor dandruff that he sometimes experiences.

I don't yet know if these will help with hair regrowth but so far, so very good! I do recommend it and keep in mind, Club Roots offers a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

title: A 'Must-Have' for Frozen Fans (and you can't beat the price!)
text:
A 'must-have' for Frozen fans! 10 tubes of Lip Smacker lip balm are including in this party pack, each tube with a different Frozen character on it and each tube a different flavor. Flavors include: Northern Blue Raspberry, Optimistic Berry, Wonderful Waffles & Syrup, Trusted Lemon Custard, Mythical Juniper, Pistachio Power, Vanilla Snowitall, Stronger Strawberry, Wilderness Peach and Born to Lead Lychee. Keeps lips soft and moisturized. Perfect for gifting. (Using mine as a stocking stuffer this Xmas!) The price isn't just reasonable, its INCREDIBLY reasonable! Keep in mind its recommended for ages 6 and older

HIGHLY recommended

title: Best Hairspray Ever...(and it has the signature Moroccanoil scent!)
text:
Best hairspray ever! Moroccanoil's limited edition supersized Luminous Hairspray is so lightweight and airy, I can't even feel it. Doesn't make hair hard/crunchy, I can easily run my fingers through it. Its as though I've not used any hairspray except for the fact it does a fantastic job keeping my hair in place while preventing frizz. Even in hot, humid conditions. And its got the fabulous signature Moroccanoil scent which is actually long lasting and doesn't fade much.

My hair is shoulder length and thick. I just purchased my second bottle of this limited edition hairspray; the first bottle lasted just over 3 months. I don't need to use much at all and it provides all day protection.

The price is reasonable. I'm buying another bottle since this 14.6oz larger size is a limited edition. Going to stock up now before this size is discontinued!

title: Made Just For Me? (No...but it seems like it is!)
text:
It feels as though this cream was made specially for my skin. Its perfect...absolutely perfect. I love the creamy, silky feel of it as it easily glides across my skin. A little goes a very long way. Absorption is quick. Results (some) are immediate-my dry, sensitive skin is immediately quenched and moisturized. The patches of eczema that burn and itch are soothed in an instant. Continued daily use is helping my aging skin's elasticity and its a noticeable change, especially in the eye area. One of my favorite qualities about this cream is the glow my normally dull skin now has. I no longer always look so pale and almost sickly.

I've not heard of some of the ingredients in this cream before but I do know its easily one of the best I've ever used. It not cheap but its absolutely worth every single penny of the cost.

title: No Change to Hair Color, Otherwise a Good Masque
text:
This is a nice, reasonably priced hair masque that helps strengthen and protect hair while keeping frizz away. Its lightweight, easy to apply/rinse out. I use once a week as instructed and keep it on my hair for 10 minutes. Doesn't weigh hair down. There is a lovely scent that isn't overpowering.

I don't notice an 'intensity' to my hair color. I don't notice any change to my hair color. Otherwise, its a good masque that delivers results.

title: Wonderful Daycream
text:
Such an amazing day cream! Glides easily over my skin while delivering instant hydration and moisture. I notice an immediate softness to my dry, sensitive skin. Absorption occurs quickly and leaves behind no sticky/greasy look or feel. Helps balance my uneven skin tone. Results are long lasting, I only need to apply once a day. (Unless i go swimming, then I usually apply a 2nd time) Can also be used on the neck area.

There is a scent that I very much like. I do find it a tad strong at first but it quickly diminishes to only a hint of a scent before fading altogether. Because its not long-lasting and fades quickly, I will not deduct any stars from my review.

The cream is a light tan shade and comes in a frosted glass jar.

I never heard of the Mudita Earth brand before but now that i have, I'm a fan. This is a wonderful day cream packed with important nutrients/ingredients for good skincare. And ME donates 1% of all sales to the 1% for the Planet organization. This cream is an all around win-win!

title: Awesome Conditioner at an Excellent Price
text: An exceptional conditioner that softens, hydrates and brings bounce and shine to my normally dull hair. Also does a great job of detangling.  Doesn't weigh hair down, leaves my natural waves smooth and free of frizz. There is a great, light scent.  The price can't be beat.

title: Perfect for Dry, Sensitive Skin
text:
I absolutely love this cleanser. Its packed with 100% all natural ingredients that not only feel wonderful but work wonders on my dry, terribly sensitive skin. It especially feels great after being in the sun/pool all day. The consistency is almost like heavy whipping cream (prior to it being whipped). Glides right over my skin and rinses off without issue. My skin is instantly hydrated and softened. Inflammation is instantly soothed and calmed. Though gentle, it does a fabulous job of deeply cleaning pores. Even gives my normally dull skin a bit of a glow. And these results are long lasting.

There is no fragrance. I experience no adverse reactions when using this. And I do use it daily.

This is a keeper for me. I especially recommend it for those with dry, sensitive skin though it can be used on all skin types. The price is reasonable. Should you have an issue, Symply offers a 90 day hassle free return policy.

title: Does What it Says it WIll Do
text:
Don't panic when you use this for the first time. Though its considered a cream, the consistency is liquidy. And that's how it should be. It soaks into my dry, sensitive skin almost instantly after applying. Doesn't leave a greasy look/feel behind.

Despite the fact I have terribly dry skin and its summertime which only makes it worse, using this keeps me hydrated and moisturized all day long, even when I sweat or swim. And it actually does make my normally dull skin glow a bit.

I have no negative reactions using this cream

This is a wonderful product that does what it says it will do. The price is reasonable.

title: Wonderful Conditioner
text:
Such a wonderful conditioner. A little goes a long way. Lightweight. Easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. Softens, smooths and prevents frizz. (Especially impressive now that its summertime-hot and humid) It even adds much needed bounce and shine to my hair. Detangles as well. The ingredients (especially hemp seed oil) are wonderful as is the scent. And i just love the bottle. At 2.75 x 1.63 x 5.88 inches, its compact. Perfect for travel, gym locker, bathroom w/small closet, etc.

I use this with Hempz Sweet Pineapple & Honey Melon shampoo. (Sold separately) They make quite the duo. Love what this does for my hair. This is a keeper for me.

title: Some Positive Results-Not Enough For a Future Purchase
text:
The cream is supposed to improve skin's firmness, moisturize, plump and reduce redness. It absolutely moisturizes, plumps and reduces redness but I've not noticed a change in firmness since using this. The consistency of the cream is on the thin side but absorption is fast and doesn't leave a greasy feel behind.

The ingredients list is impressive. Take a second to look it over. As I get older, hyaluronic acid has become my friend. This particular cream contains FIVE different types of hyaluronic acid as well as a host of other wonderful skin care ingredients.

There is a mild scent that fades quickly

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues using the product.

This cream isn't cheap. While I'm satisfied overall, not experiencing a noticeable change to my skin's firmness is going to prevent me from purchasing this in the future. Its just too much money to not see a positive firmness result.

title: All Around Great Conditioner
text:
Great conditioner! A little goes a long way. Easy to apply, easy to rinse. Hydrates, moisturizes and softens. Eliminates frizz well. Doesn't weigh hair down. Smells like rose (the scent lasts long!) but is not overpowering or gagging. Can be used on all hair types.

Works great, the 16.9oz bottle will last me quite some time. Price is reasonable

Recommended

title: Miracle in a Bottle
text:
This spray does everything it promises to do and then some! I love it. It can be used on damp or dry hair. I tried both methods and while I do achieve results both ways, I prefer to use it on dry hair. Does a beautiful job of detangling and adding shine to my hair while keeping frizz away, even on the hottest and most humid summer days. Keeps hair nice and moisturized. Doesn't weigh hair down or make it look greasy. Dispenses evenly mist form. Has a nice scent though it doesn't last long.

I've been using this daily since summer arrived and its helping tremendously. The price isn't just good, its a steal for how well this works. Since it dispenses in a light, mist form, not much product is used with each spray. (I use 3-4 spray's worth daily on my thick, shoulder length hair) This bottle will last me a long time. Can be used on all hair types. Its available on Amazon's 'subscribe and save' plan.

There's a good reason this is an 'Amazon's Choice' product. (For those not familiar: "Amazon's Choice highlights highly rated, well-priced products available to ship immediately.) I love this spray and WILL continue to purchase and use it. Its' a 'must have' in my hair care routine!

title: I'm Impressed How Well These Work
text:
I'm impressed. I really wasn't expecting these to work as well as they do. They're easy to use and truly feel wonderful. They heat on their own to a warm and relaxing temperature. At no point in time did any of the masks my husband and I used not get warm nor did any become too warm. So far, they've all worked great-we only have a few left. They definitely help revive tired, puffy eyes. My husband works at home, he likes to lay down over his lunch break and use one, especially on the days when he had trouble sleeping the night before. (He even dozed off one day while wearing one, he was that relaxed by it! lol) The first time I tried a mask to help with dark circles under my eyes, I was surprised when I got a bonus result-I happened to have a PMS headache at the time that very much decreased after using the mask for a good 30 minutes. Talk about a win-win situation.

The masks are comfortable to wear, do not have a scent nor do they cause any irritation to sensitive skin. Perfect to use at home, while traveling, after using a computer or reading when eyes get tired. The price is very reasonable. Our box is almost empty. We'll definitely continue to purchase and use these.

title: Does a Nice Job But No Better Than Other Purples (and, it costs more)
text:
This is a great smelling conditioner that does a wonderful job of removing brassy tones making my blond hair uniform throughout. Has a thick consistency yet, easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. Doesn't weigh hair down and even adds some shine to my typically dull hair.

I've used other IGK products that really stood out and worked wonders on my hair. While this does do a great job of eliminating the brassy tones and adding shine, it doesn't do more than other purple conditioners I've used in the past. Because this doesn't really stand out compared to other conditioners and the price is higher, I have no plans to purchase this particular IGK product.

title: Absolute Perfection
text:
My dry, sensitive skin, including eczema, is usually at its worst during winter months. That's not the case right now. Winter is long gone yet I'm still plagued by terrible eczema (on my face) that burns and is inflamed. The instant Moringa Anti-Aging Cream touches the inflammation, its immediately calmed and soothed. Like putting a fire out. Instant relief. It doesn't stop there. With continued use, fine lines become finer, skin even softer and hydrated.

Absorption is fast and doesn't leave a greasy look/feel behind. The cream is so easy to apply, a little goes a very long way. There is a scent-I don't particularly care for it but it fades very quickly. For that reason, I will not deduct any stars from my rating.

This is a phenomenal cream. For all of the benefits it delivers and the incredible ingredients, the price is unbelievably low-it even comes with a 30 day money back guarantee! I'm telling you, if someone told me I could only use one facial cream for the rest of my life, Moringa would be my choice. Its THAT good.

title: Fun 'Spa Kit', Beautifully Presented
text:
Such a fun and beautifully presented 'spa' kit that is easy to use and delivers nice results.

Included in the kit: a jar of powdered facial mask (mix w/water prior to use), a bowl to mix the product, sponges to assist in mask removal, scoop and spatula.

Simply mix the product, apply, allow it to sit on skin for 15 minutes, then peel and remove. Simple as can be. Skin is left feeling fresh, bright and smooth and feels nice.

The information provided states the mask can be used on eyelids, arms, legs, breasts, armpits, 'booty', thighs, neck. I only use this on my face (not eyelids...that's cutting it too close for me).

There is a rose scent to the product that fades quickly.

I have dry, sensitive skin and experienced very mild burning that lasted just a few seconds when I first applied the mask. VERY mild and it never returned throughout the treatment.

I didn't experience any notable 'tightening' of skin after using the mask.

Fun product. Definitely makes for a nice gift, the packaging is very impressive. Give it a try. Should you find you have issues with the product, Olivia Primavera offers a 100% no questions asked money back guarantee.

title: Takes Facial Cleansers to a Whole New Level
text:
Cocoage 24K Gold Facial Cleanser is proof not all facial cleansers are the same. This one is very different from any other I've ever used. (Yes, it is gold in color...don't worry, it doesn't discolor skin) The consistency is thick-ish, creamy and silky. A little goes a long way. Easily works into a lather and feels great while applying. Rinses without issue. Does a gorgeous job of deep cleansing and exfoliating. I love how soft and smooth my skin is after using this and it stays that way for quite some time ; to the point I could actually skip using a moisturizing cream if I wanted to. But I especially love the way my normally dull, pale skin plumps and glows after using this. I'm not used really used to either -to see it-is wonderful. I think it turns back time a bit and knocks some years off of my age...the big 5-0.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues with this cleanser.

Never knew a facial cleanser could do more than cleanse and soften. Cocoage takes facial cleanser to a whole never level with the results it delivers. Because the results are so fantastic and the fact that a little goes a long way (the bottle will last me quite some time) I do believe the price is reasonable. I absolutely recommend this product.

I

title: I'm Telling You, This Spray is Pure Magic!
text:
R+Co Bleu Rose Water is the 'creme de la creme' of wave spray. Its incredible...magical...simply amazing. After washing, I use 4-5 sprays of Bleu Rose on my slightly damp hair then put it in a messy bun and go to bed. In the morning after I remove the ponytail holder is when the magic happens. Out spill gorgeous, absolutely perfect, voluminous waves full of bounce and shine, two things my hair normally lacks. I simply run my fingers through my hair a few times and I'm ready to go. It honestly looks as though I just stepped out of a hair salon. I received 3 compliments on my hair the very first time I used this spray!

Doesn't weigh hair down or make it sticky or crunchy. Despite the excessive heat and humidity we're currently enduring my waves stay in place, nice and full. No frizz, no flattening of hair. That's impressive seeing as my hair tends to turn into a frizzy mess in hot weather. There is a lovely, light scent that I don't think smells like roses at all. I'm not quite sure what it smells like but I very much like it. Unfortunately, it doesn't last long in my hair. Wish it would.

I have no clue what ingredient(s) in this spray is responsible for turning my hair into luscious, wavy locks but I love it. Never ever used a wave spray like this before and believe me, I've used many. Its deserving of the Amazon Premium Beauty badge (for those not familiar: "Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men. To buy Premium Beauty and Premium Men’s Grooming items, just look for the Premium Beauty badge."). No doubt about it, it is priced on the high side. Way more than I'd ever spend on wave spray. But it works so darn well and makes my hair gorgeous , its worth every penny of the cost. I will continue to use/purchase. I have to. Its THAT good.

title: What a Wonderful Conditioner!
text:
I've not used Dr. Hempster conditioner long enough to notice any type of new hair growth. But I am loving the results it has delivered thus far.

This is a very thick conditioner...in my third photo, my hand is upside down to show you the consistency is so very thick, it doesn't move. Don't worry...as thick as it is, its easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. (The instructions do not say how long the product should sit prior to rinsing...I let it on for about 5 minutes)

Dr. Hempster does an awesome job of detangling. After my hair has air-dried, its so very soft and bouncy. It even shines, something it normally lacks. My natural waves are full and smooth and free of frizz. (especially impressive now that its summertime-the heat and humidity normally turn my waves into a frizzy mess) Best of all, the area around my scalp where I'm experiencing some serious thinning due to aging is thickened with added volume. Let me tell you, its NICE to not be so self-conscious about that area of thinning hair.

The conditioner is free from harmful products. It contains excellent ingredients for healthy hair-care: hemp oil, saw palmetto, argan oil, wheat and biotin. There is a scent and its just lovely. Its light and refreshing-I can actually smell it a bit the following day which is a nice surprise since my hair really holds the scent of hair care products.

I'm thrilled with everything about this conditioner. I do find the price reasonable for the size of the bottle and how well it works. I'll absolutely continue to use and purchase Dr. Hempster conditioner.

title: Enhances My Curls/Natural Waves
text:
Such an awesome defining cream! The pump dispenses a small amount of cream. I do 3 pumps into my hand, rub both hands together and run it through my (damp) thick, shoulder length hair. Doesn't weigh it down, doesn't make it hard or look greasy. Does a beautiful job of enhancing my natural curls and waves. Keeps frizz away, especially impressive now that its summer and hot/humid. Adds a bit of shine to my typically dull hair.

There is a very light scent that fades quickly. Smells nice. I wish it stuck around longer.

I love this cream. It really helps enhance and bring out my waves/curls. Because it does a great job and only a small amount is needed per use, I find the price to be reasonable.

title: Really Loving This Brand-Conditioner Works Well
text:
I had the pleasure of testing Mario Badescu's coconut body soap for the VINE program. It was my first ever experience with this brand. I liked the body soap so much, I decided to try their Hair Rinsing Conditioner as well and purchased a bottle. The conditioner dispenses without issue. A small amount goes a long way and is easy to work into/rinse from hair. Does a wonderful job of detangling and softening. Made my natural waves nice and smooth with no fly-aways.

The scent is supposed to be tropical fruit. I detect NO scent of tropical fruit. Smells like a combo of plastic and rubber. Not pleasant. BUT...the scent was pretty much gone by the time my hair dried. Since it faded so quickly, I'm not going to deduct any stars.

I like this conditioner. Does nice things for my hair and the price is right. Its also an Amazon Premium Beauty item. (For those not familiar: 'Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men.') Recommended

Overall score: 4.5 stars

title: Far Better Than 'Regular' Face Washing, Easy to Use
text:
I'm a fan of WOW products and now I have a new product to add to my list of likes. The Coconut Hydrating Foaming Face Wash w/ Brush is pretty neat. The brush is already attached to the bottle, no 'assembly' required. (even comes with a handy cover to keep on the brush when not in use) Wet your face, give nozzle a pump and the foaming face wash dispenses out the brush. Using circular motions, clean your face with the brush, squeezing if more cleanser is needed. The brush does not hurt and really does a great job of cleansing, exfoliating and getting those 'hard to reach' areas on the sides of my nose. Leaves a nice, soft and fresh feel behind.

Great ingredients in this cleanser include: hyaluronic acid (a fave of mine!), vitamin E (another fave!), coconut water and aloe. I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues with this product.

I really like this. Its fast and easy to use and does a better job than regular face washing. Perfect for all skin types. The price is reasonable.

title: Gentle But Cleanses Well-Has a  Lovely Scent
text:
Love everything about Mario Badescu Coconut Body Soap! Dispenses via a lift up 'nozzle' built into the cap. The consistency reminds me of a liquid hand soap but a bit thinner and lightweight. A little goes
a long way. Lathers very well (perfect for shaving your legs, ladies!) while providing a gentle, yet cleansing wash. Doesn't leave a greasy feel behind. Instantly softens and keeps skin soft. Contains skin loving ingredients including coconut oil, jojoba, aloe, and glycerin. Does not contain parabens, sulfates or dyes. I have dry, sensitive skin and have absolutely no negative reactions at all. (Can be used on all skin types) Has a light, fresh coconut scent that smells wonderful but doesn't last very long. The price is reasonable, especially since this is an Amazon 'Professional Beauty' product. (For those not familiar: "Amazon has curated a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices.") I will definitely buy this again. Because I like this soap so much, I ordered Mario Badescu's hair rinsing conditioner and cannot wait to try it. Definitely recommended.

title: What a Serum!
text:
I adore this serum. Light and creamy, its easy to apply. 2 pump's worth adequately covers my face. Absorption is fast, skin is instantly softened and moisturized with no greasy look/feel. And I love that. But what I really love and appreciate about this serum is the way it reduces not only my fine lines, but the rough red patches I have, especially around and under my nose. Those areas can get so bad and so red at times it looks as though I have a bad cold and am blowing my nose all the time. Its wonderful to see those horrible patches calm down. Even the burning feeling that accompanies them has drastically reduced as well.

The serum is made in Switzerland and contains plant stem cells and an ingredient called Swiss Snow Algae. Never heard of this before but I'm sure glad I know about it now! For those interested in packaging, this comes in a lovely glass bottle with a pump that dispenses a small amount of the product. There is a very mild scent that fades by the time absorption has occurred.

This does not negatively affect my dry, sensitive skin

What a serum. This is like magic in a bottle. I do hope it becomes available soon, it works wonders on my skin.

title: Keeps Frizz Away, Even on the Hottest, Humid Summer Day!
text:
Love this. It is indeed lightweight. Easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. Doesn't cause a greasy look/feel, softens so very well and does an impressive job of keeping my natural waves in their normal shape preventing them from turning into a frizzy disaster. And I'm so very grateful, my hair does NOT handle heat and humidity well. (Right now the temps here are 90+ with high humidity.) I wash my hair daily so I cannot comment as to the claim the conditioner keeps hair smooth for up to 72 hours. I can tell you it keeps mine smooth for the 24 hours between daily washes.

Another 'light' thing about this conditioner is the scent. Its quite lovely, light and mild. Unfortunately, it doesn't last in my hair (my hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products) and is pretty much gone by the time my hair has dried.
