Once again, Nexxus has come up with another winning conditioner. It works so very, very well. The price is reasonable. I can tell you with 100% certainty I will continue to purchase/use this. In fact, I just purchased 2 bottles! For those interested, this is an Amazon 'subscribe and save' item!

title: The Perfect Hair Travel Set for Blondes (and that scent!!!)
text:
I am SO excited to take this travel set along on our summer vacation. Unfortunately, I have another 6 weeks to wait. lol. The set contains 4 fabulous Moroccanoil trial size products: Light Tones Dry Shampoo, styling cream, leave in treatment and fragrance mist. I've never used the dry shampoo before, I'm looking forward to not having to pack a bottle of liquid shampoo. The styling cream works very well-lightweight, doesn't make hair greasy or hard. The leave in treatment is nice and also works very well. A very small amount goes a LONG way. Can be used on damp or dry hair. (I prefer using on damp) And my absolute favorite...the 'star' of the show (in my eyes!)-the fragrance mist. If you're already familiar with this brand you're familiar with its trademark scent. It is simply amazing and addicting. Its one of a few hair products where the scent actually lasts in my hair for some time. Most fade VERY quickly. Not this brand. The fragrance mist can be used on hair AND the body. All 4 products come in a nice, compact/lightweight tote (with handle) that measures 2.5 x 7.6 x 6 inches; 1.06 Pounds and easily fits in a suitcase, overnight bag and even some larger purses. Of course I'll hang onto the mini tote and continue to use even after the products are long gone.

This is definitely worthy of gift giving. Perfect for travel, hospital stay, camping., etc. The price is reasonable seeing as you're getting 4 high quality Moroccanoil products + mini tote.

*Note: This particular set, the Mediterranean Escape Blonde Styling set is geared towards blondes*

title: Absorption a Bit Slow But Otherwise a Wonderful Skin Care Product
text:
An ingredient in Annod Natural Skincare Repairing Avocado Face Oil didn't agree with my dry, sensitive skin (caused red irritation) so I wound up passing this along to my sister in law who happily accepted it and uses it daily. And very much likes it. She says it adds much-needed hydration to her dry skin and its long lasting. Helps to soften minor red spots on her face. She travels for her job with the Army Reserves and likes how the pump pops up and down for dispensing. She doesn't have to worry about the nozzle breaking or leaking all over. She wishes absorption was faster, however. It takes a bit longer than she prefers, leaving her skin feeling somewhat greasy until absorption has occurred. Once it has, her skin is fine.

Thanks to the wonderful ingredients and the results she experiences, her overall rating is 4.5 stars, she "definitely!" recommends it and finds the price reasonable.

title: A Good Daily Moisturizer (its unisex!)
text:
This is a daily moisturizing cream that is packed with vitamins, plant based and unisex. I ordered it for my husband mainly to help with dry skin and the reduction of fine lines. Its easy to apply and absorbs pretty quickly. Does a very nice job of moisturizing and hydrating his dry skin. There is a light scent though its not long lasting.

He has not experienced much in the way of a reduction of fine lines, however, he's only been using the cream for just under 2 weeks. He will contiA Gnue to use on a daily basis.

title: OK at Softening, Greasy Like Butter
text:
Though it contains ingredients good for skin, I'm not blown away by this moisturizer cream. Its thick but greasy like melted butter. Absorption takes quite some time. I have eczema on my face, the cream does an OK job of calming and soothing the burning/itching. It does soften somewhat. Has a hint of a scent to it that isn't long lasting.

I just do not see enough positive results to warrant continued use and have no plans to purchase in the future.

title: Gives Me Long Lasting Beachy Waves
text: I love to try various wave sprays on my natural waves.  Bed Head's Queen Beach Salt Spray ranks up there with one of the best I've ever tried.  It dispenses well and i only need a few pump's worth to adequately cover my thick, shoulder length hair.  It can be used on both wet and dry hair. I did try both and while I'm satisfied with the results using it on dry hair, I absolutely prefer to use it on wet.  Its not sticky, it does not weigh hair down.  Does a beautiful job of enhancing my natural waves but gives them more of a beachy-type wave that lasts all throughout the day. (Even in humidity!) I love the scent. It has a nice, clean, fresh scent. But it doesn't last long-at least not in my hair. (My hair rarely hold the scent of hair care products) Thanks to great results and the fact I only need a few pump's worth to achieve my beachy waves, I find the price reasonable. Definitely recommended.

title: Awesome Conditioner
text: I had a few concerns the first time I tried this conditioner. The consistency is very thick and heavy-ish. I feared it would be hard to rinse out and weigh my hair down as well. Neither concerns were warranted. The conditioner applies and rinses out easily. It does not weigh my hair down; quite the opposite. It makes my hair bouncy while keeping my natural waves soft and smooth. Does a nice job of detangling as well.  There is a light scent and i find it very pleasant. But it pretty much fades by the time my hair has completely dried. (I air dry) After using this, my dry , damaged hair is well moisturized and hydrated.  Definitely a conditioner I'll use again. I also ordered Tree Hut's Texture Tango Sugar Shake Styler and am very much looking forward to trying it once it arrives. Thanks to good results, the fact that a little conditioner  goes a long way and the bottle size is 12oz, I find the price reasonable and recommend it.

title: Expensive...But Does What It Promises to Do
text:
Bird saliva. Of all things, bird saliva is the magical ingredient in this moisturizing cream that makes it a superb product. I had NO clue bird saliva was a thing! lol. Glad I found out about it...better late than never.

The cream is lightweight, soft and silky. Easily glides over skin-a little goes a long way. Absorption is fast. Skin is immediately softened and moisturized and stays that way for a long , long time. Continued use protects skin elasticity, firms and reduces wrinkles. It turns back time and improves the health of skin.

The cream is pretty, light peachy shade. There is a hint of a scent...reminds me of baby lotion. It fades quickly.

The price of the cream is on the high end. Keep in mind, it contains the rare swiftlet bird's nest ingredient, results are achieved quickly and only a small amount is needed per use. The cream does what it promises to do.

title: An Excellent Anti-Aging, 3 Step Regimen for Men-(delivers great results!)
text:
I ordered the HOMMEFACE Advanced Age Defense 3 Step set for my husband and let me just say, he is really enjoying the products and pampering himself. The set comes in a nice tin. The 3 anti-aging products included are: eye cream, facial serum, face cream. It is recommended the products be used twice a day and in the following order: serum, eye cream, face cream.

facial serum: The first product to be used. A small amount should be massaged into the face and neck. (He doesn't use the products on his neck at all...face only) Absorption is fast, skin is well hydrated. Does not leave a greasy look/feel.

eye cream: Second product. Its also the product that has provided the best results thus far and is my husband's favorite. Its recommended a 'pea' size amount be dabbed under both eyes. 'Pea size' is more than he needs-he uses about half that amount. Does a beautiful job of removing the dark circles, puffiness and swelling he experiences when he's not had enough sleep. It also delivers the same results when he's experiencing the same issues due to seasonal allergies.

face cream: Third product. Easy to massage into skin. Absorption is fast , no greasy look/feel left behind. Instantly softens and smooths. It also takes care of the dry patches, especially around his nose where his skin often flakes because its so dry. Plumps skin. Reduces fine lines. (It also reduces wrinkles but he doesn't have any on his face...yet! lol)

He experiences no negative reactions to any of the products.

These 3 products make for an excellent anti-aging skin care regimen for men. All of the products deliver great results. Absolutely worthy of gift giving. Thanks to the great results and the fact only a small amount of each product is needed per use, the price is reasonable.

title: Smells Great, Does What It Promises to Do
text:
Such a wonderful conditioner that strengthens and moisturizes my dry, damaged hair and leaves it smelling fresh and clean. Its easy to work into hair, easy to rinse. A little goes a long way; an amount roughly the size of a half dollar sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. Doesn't weigh my hair down while keeping it smooth and free of frizz.

The scent is light and fresh but it fades quickly.

This is a great conditioner that works very well on my hair and delivers promised results. Because it works so well and repairs my hair, only a small amount is needed per use and it smells great, I find the price reasonable.

title: She Loves It
text:
I was unable to accurately test this cream as I had a reaction to it (burning sensation) due to a pre-existing diagnosis of perioral dermatitis. I passed it along to my sister- in- law and and writing this review based on her experience with it...

And, she LOVES it. The consistency is lightweight and airy. Easy to apply and absorption is super fast. A little goes a long way. Leaves no sticky/tacky feel behind. Her skin is immediately softened and moisturized and stays that way throughout the day with just one application. She is in the Army Reserves and recently spent time down south where the temps were hot. She used the cream each day and was amazed how well it kept her skin hydrated even in the heat and while sweating.

The cream has a scent which we both do not care for at all. However, because the scent fades quickly (by the time the cream is absorbed, the scent has faded), no stars will be deducted from the overall rating.

My SIL is thrilled with the results she receives from using this cream. We just had dinner with her a few days ago and she even brought it up and commented about how much she loves its. Says she continues to use it daily and plans to continue to use/purchase it as well. She told to, "Give it as many stars as you can in your review... I love it!".

There you have it. She loves it.

title: Long Lasting Color and NO Itching/Burning!
text:
I've paid for boxed hair dyes that cost more than IL Salone and didn't work half as well. I've used MANY different brands of dyes over the decades...IL Salone is hands down, the BEST I've ever used.

The directions are super easy to follow. I was beyond thrilled and grateful that the dye sits well on hair and does not run or drip AT ALL! It stays exactly where applied until rinsed out. And rinsing out is easy as well-I had absolutely NO issues. The color shown on the box (I used extra light blonde) is the end result I wound up with. I did not experience any hair breakage. One of the best things about this hair dye...I experienced NO itching or burning! That is unheard of for me. I have terribly sensitive skin. Until I tried Il Salone, I've ALWAYS experienced burning and itching with every other hair dye I've used. Some more than others but I had a reaction with every single one and in most cases. scratched my head like crazy the day after use while popping a Bendryl to try to calm the itching. That did NOT happen with this dye...AT ALL. Also included with the dye and instructions: plastic gloves to use while applying, an after care conditioner and a hair mask to use 3 weeks after hair has been dyed. Both are very important, make sure to use them.

The color stays fresh and vibrant for a long time. I can actually use this less often that my previous brand.

This is a salon quality hair dye you can use in the comfort of your own home. I truly thought the price would be higher for as well as it works. I've officially switched from my old brand of dye to Il Salone. (In fact, I enrolled in Amazon's 'subscribe and save' for monthly delivery!) If you're coloring your hair yourself, I HIGHLY recommend IL Salone hair dye!

title: A Superb Day Cream Packed w/Awesome Skin Care Ingredients
text:
Sophia Line Dead Sea Moisturizing Day Cream promises to put an end to dry skin. And it does exactly that for my dry, terribly sensitive skin. Its easy to apply and absorption is fast. A little goes a long way. Skin is immediately softened and moisturized and those results last throughout the day. The cream is packed with wonderful ingredients for skincare including salts and minerals straight from the Dead Sea.

Thanks to wonderful ingredients and super results, along with only a small amount of cream needed per use, I find the price reasonable and do recommend this day cream, especially for those with dry, sensitive skin.

title: Ladies, If You're 40+, Try This Cream!
text:
I must get out of the habit of touching my face after using this cream but I can't help it! lol. I love how soft this cream makes my skin. The cream is lightweight and airy. (Reminds me of angel food cake mix when the peaks start to form after using the hand mixer for a few minutes) Its easy to apply and absorption is fast. Instructions say to use a 'pearl size' amount but I don't need to use that much to adequately cover my face. Does not make skin greasy/oily/sticky. Instant softness is achieved and long lasting, fine lines are reduced. It also helps to calm and soothe my dry, sensitive skin/eczema patches. Continued use (2x's a day is recommended) will help improve elasticity and firmness. I've not used it long enough to achieve this but I'm more than satisfied with the results so far and will continue to use/purchase. My mom has already purchased a jar after I informed her how great it works.

This is a fantastic cream geared for those of us over 40. The price is reasonable, however, should you have an issue, Fiera offers a 30 day, full refund money back guarantee.

title: SO Unique, Delivers Amazing Results
text:
WOW! Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Nectar Hydratant is in a league of its own. This truly is a special skin care product. I have terribly dry, sensitive skin and am plagued with frequent bouts of eczema and newly diagnosed perioral dermatitis. Since using this, my skin issues have improved in a HUGE way. It does a gorgeous job of softening and hydrating. The itching, inflammation and burning (from eczema/perioral dermatitis) experience immediate soothing and calming once the product comes in contact. The unbelievably ugly, unattractive rash all around my mouth, aside of my nose and even up to my eye on the right side of my face is finally begun to clear up. And I've had the rash for MONTHS now.

The consistency is a cross between a gel and syrup. (It can get watery, give it a stir before use) It is easy to apply and massage into skin. Full absorption occurs but not immediately. It does take time and for that reason, I use this at nighttime before bed. Feels as though I' used baby oil on my face prior to absorption. Does not leave skin sticky. I do not detect much of a scent.

In addition to creating a brilliant product, Bloomeffects also nailed the packaging. Its beautiful. Comes in such a pretty box (no wrapping paper necessary if you're purchasing this as a gift) and the jar is just gorgeous.The spatula...a tulip shaped spatula is included for easy application. How cute is that?

Without a doubt, this is easily one of the most unique skin care product I've ever tried. I do find the price reasonable: a little goes a long way, it can be used on the body not just the face, the results are excellent and fast (with continued, daily use) I recommend this for all but especially those with dry, sensitive skin

(FYI...I tore the box lid -that's why you see a piece of tape on it)

title: Best Trimmer He's Ever Used
text:
Ordered this for my husband, so this review is based on his experience/opinion using the trimmer. After trying it for the first time, he said this...

"You can write in your review this is the best trimmer I've ever used". (That is a direct quote!)

He went on to add its easy to use and while gentle, especially in the private area, it still does a fantastic job trimming. It is not necessary to keep running the trimmer over the same area repeatedly to obtain the desired length it trims accurately right off the bat. Has a good amount of power: 90 minutes of charging delivers approximately 90 minutes of use. Its waterproof and ideal to taking along while traveling. He was especially impressed with the mirror/light feature that allows you to see the 'blind spots' you might otherwise miss. Best of all, he experienced no itching/red spots/bumps after use. The trimmer works great and the price is reasonable.

title: Hooray for Snails! This Cream is Wonderful
text:
When you take a look of the photo I've included with my review, you might think this cream is a syrupy mess. Don't worry, its not. The reason the cream looks syrupy is due to the snail secretion filtrate. While that may sound unappealing, snail secretion does wonderful things for skin. It doesn't just moisturize-it increases and protects the moisture barrier helping to prevent dryness. Continued use reduces fine lines and wrinkle while helping heal damaged skin. I have terribly dry, sensitive skin. I also have perioral dermatitis. This is new for me, just developed it a few months ago. Its not fun. Feels like a terrible sunburn most days...other days it itches like poison. Comes with a terrible rash that doesn't go away easily. It also causes my skin to flake. Using this cream brings instant calming and soothing to the irritation while helping to reduce the rash. (Reduce...doesn't make it go away entirely but it reduces it a good deal)

It is recommended Dewytree be used after applying serum. A small amount of the lightweight cream goes a very long way. Absorption is fast, no sticky/greasy feel is left behind. Perfect for all skin types. The price is more than reasonable. This cream is a keeper.

title: Gentle, Yet Delivers Great Results
text:
I like what this conditioner does for my hair. Morgan Cosmetic's Argan Oil/Bulgarian Lavender Natural Conditioner can be used on all hair types and is gentle enough for daily use. Don't let the word 'gentle' fool you. While gentle, it does an excellent job of hydrating, smoothing and strengthening. It even adds some shine to my normally dull hair. Its easy to work into /easy to rinse from hair. A little goes a long way. Its not heavy. Has a nice lavender scent though it doesn't last long-by the time my hair is dry, the scent is pretty much gone. (Hair care product scents rarely last in my hair for whatever reason) Should you have an issue/question with the product, Morgan Cosmetics invites you to contact them for assistance. I've not had to contact them since I' haven't had an issue but it sure sounds like they make customer satisfaction a priority.

This is a wonderful conditioner that I will continue to purchase and use. The price is reasonable. I recommend it for all hair types.

title: Fast, Excellent Results
text: Ordered these for my husband for the occasions when his knee swells and flares up due to an old injury. Thanks to a dog toy in the middle of the floor I didn't notice until the moment I stepped on it, causing my foot to twist in an odd direction, I wound up testing the pads before he could. lol.  5 come in a box, each individual wrapped.  The pads are pre-moistened; no need to worry about soaking or pouring anything into them. Simply apply the pad to the affected area for the recommended 20-30 minute timeframe. Each pad has plenty of liquid mineral magnesium sulfate to keep the pad moist throughout the treatment time. There is no scent/color to the product, it does not burn/sting/itch. (I have terribly sensitive skin and have NO issues  using these)  My foot injury wasn't serious by any means but after using a pad, the slight swelling and soreness I experienced were soothed completely. My foot hadn't bothered me at all since. Very pleased with the results and will definitely use/purchase these pads again.  Absolutely recommended (FYI...refrigerate prior to use! )

title: Love This Conditioner-Revitalizes My Hair
text:
Wonderful conditioner that wakes my dry, damaged hair up and helps revive it. Softens, smooths, puts an end to fly-aways and even adds shine and bounce, two things my hair normally lacks. Easy to apply, easy to rinse out. A little goes a LONG way. The scent is fantastic though not long-lasting. The price is incredibly reasonable. Can be used daily.

Highly recommended

title: Wonderful Conditioner (SO wonderful, I signed up for 'subscribe and save'!)
text:
A friend recommended this conditioner and I'm so glad she did. Its wonderful. Has a nice consistency that is easy to apply/easy to rinse from hair. A little goes a long way. Does a fantastic job of softening and smoothing my hair while preventing frizz and fly-aways. Makes my natural waves bouncy and even adds some shine, both things my hair normally lacks. Seems to melt the tangles away in an instant.

There is a VERY light scent. Its nice...really nice. I wish it were stronger because its no longer detectable by the time my hair has dried.

Without a doubt, I highly recommend this conditioner. And I can say with 100% certainty I will use/purchase it again...I'm already signed up for 'subscribe and save'! Hope you love it as much as I do.

title: Could Use a Bit More Moisture-Still a Good Cleanser
text: This is a lightweight, scent-free cucumber cream cleanser that contains: cucumber extract, royal jelly/manuka honey, aloe and wild yam extract. (I had no clue wild yam extract was a thing! lol) Easy to apply, easy to remove.  Removes makeup, dirt, residue. Perhaps my skin is too dry/damaged/sensitive...while it does soften and moisturize, it doesn't quite moisturize as much as my skin needs it to, leaving it a tad dry. Still, a good cleanser VERY well priced.

title: A 6 Second Miracle
text:
Doesn't sound possible, does it? In less time than it takes to tie a shoelace...sneeze...chew a potato chip, even the most damaged hair can be revived and made healthy again. 6 seconds is all it takes with Dr. Bond's No. 6 Ampoule. After cleansing hair/towel drying, place the pointed cap on the bottle. Apply the product from scalp to tip of hair for a mere 6 SECONDS then rinse w/lukewarm water. (FYI: the ampoule is watery, its not thick like a conditioner) That's it. That's all it takes. In just 6 seconds, hair is left softer and smoother than ever before with added and shine and bounce. The amount of moisture the amazing ingredients in this ampoule deliver turn back the clock to the days when I was a child and my hair was untouched and undamaged. Best of all, all these results are LONG LASTING! (Results are supposed to last on average 6 days. I made it roughly 5 days)

Everything about this product is sensational-the results, the 6 seconds of use and the price. This is a 'must-have' for me...a definite 'keeper'. HIGHLY recommended!

title: Works Great (except for detangling)
text:
I like this conditioner. It does a nice job conditioning, softening and smoothing while keeping frizz away. Easy to work through hair, easy to rinse from hair. Its not heavy, doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look oily/greasy. It is scented and in all honesty, I initially felt the lavender scent was overpowering when I first used the conditioner. However, after rinsing and when my hair dried, the scent had calmed down tremendously, leaving a nice, light scent that actually lasted a decent amount of time. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products for whatever reason...its always nice to find a product w/a scent that is long lasting since it rarely happens)

Though not a terribly big deal, the conditioner doesn't do such a great job detangling my hair. I spray a pump or two of detangler to assist me after using this.

Overall, a good conditioner suitable for all hair types and daily use. A little goes a long way...not much is needed per use. The price is reasonable and I do recommend it.

Overall rating is 4.5 stars

title: Phenomenal. I've Already Purchased a 2nd Jar
text:
This is a phenomenal product that is working wonders on my skin. I have very dry, sensitive skin and eczema. I was recently diagnosed with perioral dermatitis. Its not pleasant at all; burns and itches terribly. And it looks horrific. Not only does this cream cleanser gently but brilliantly cleanse my facial skin, it relieves the burning/itching perioral dermatitis patches. It has also done what my medication hasn't been able to do; reduce the rash/inflammation. It is nowhere as noticeable as it had been.

The cleaner is nice and soft and creamy. A little goes a LONG way. It feels nice while applying and wonderful after its rinsed off. In addition to the helps it delivers to the areas of skin affected by the dermatitis, it softens, cleanses and refreshes my skin. Makes it feel like the skin I had ages and ages ago, before makeup, sunlight, aging, etc affected it. It is lightly scented -a pleasant scent that vanishes once the cream cleanser has been rinsed off.

I can tell you with 100% certainty I WILL continue to use this cleanser. I've already purchased a second jar. I plan on trying facetheory's overnight cream as well.

The price is incredibly reasonable. This is a MUST-HAVE skin care product for me and I absolutely recommend it.

title: Does a 'Pretty Good Job'
text: According to my husband for whom I ordered this, it does a 'pretty good job' of shaving off his facial hair.  He also uses it to trim his nose/ear hair as well.  The power is good when fully charged (it slows down when the charge is running out)  and it delivers a close shave though at times he must run the trimmer over the same area a few times to get all of the hair.  4 combs are included and it can be used wet or dry. (He did try it both ways and definitely prefers using while dry)  He experiences no irritation after use.  Ideal for home use as well as travel.  The price is reasonable.

title: A Wonderful, Unisex Conditioner For All Hair Types
text: Never heard of this brand before but after using the Natural Conditioner, I'm already a big fan. This conditioner is unisex and can be used on all hair types.  Its packed with wonderful hair care ingredients, including: organic  herbs, aloe, coconut oil, tea tree and water from the Dead Sea.  ( I especially love the Dead Sea water ingredient...I'm a HUGE fan of Dead Sea products) Its easy to work into hair and easy to rinse out.  Doesn't weigh hair down or make it appear greasy.  Does a wonderful job of deep conditioning, detangling and even adds both bounce and shine to my hair, something it normally lacks.  Has a nice, light coconut scent that smells wonderful. The price is reasonable and I absolutely will purchase and use it again.

title: Works Well, Reasonably Priced
text: Nice and lightweight, this cream is easy to apply and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or sticky  look/feel behind.  Can be used any time of the day, including prior to applying makeup. I prefer to use it in the morning.  Adds some hydration and moisture to my dry, sensitive skin while softening as well. I've not noticed a change in elasticity, however, I've also not been using this very long. I like that it contains a number of plant derived ingredients. Can be used on all skin types, including sensitive. (I have terribly sensitive skin and have no issues with this cream) All in all, this is a nice refreshing cream that works well and is reasonably priced.

title: Experiencing Some Decent Results So Far..
text: Ordered this set for my husband. Included is a facial cleanser, toner and emulsion. The packaging is very nice as are the bottles 2 of the 3 products are in. No instructions were included, I had to come here to the page to find out how to use each product. The cleanser is to be used first. Lathers easily and does a nice job of cleansing. Next product to be used is the toner followed by the emulsion.  Neither product causes burning/itching.  Each absorbs quickly leaving skin fairly soft and smooth. No change in my husband's fine lines though he hasn't been using this 3 step skin care regimen very long. There is a nice scent to the products that is not at all over powering or gagging, but it fades quickly. He's going to continue to the use the products until finished but as of right now, he doesn't know if he will continue to purchase/use  in the future.

title: A Nice Trio For Those w/Curly Hair
text: My favorite product in this trio is definitely the Miracle Styler Leave-In Treatment. A few sprays worth on my freshly washed, damp hair ensures my curls and waves will be soft, smooth and bouncy.  The shampoo does a very nice job of cleansing ; easy to apply and easy to rinse out. The conditioner is fairly thick-if I use too much, it  weighs down my hair a  bit so I use a small amount. It also is easy to apply and easy to rinse out.  Leaves my hair tangle-free and soft.  All 3 have a nice, light scent that surprisingly lasts pretty long in my hair. This is unusual (but a nice surprise!) as my hair rarely holds the scent of hair products.

title: Incredible Facial Cream That Delivers Incredible Results
text:
This is a VERY special facial cream. It truly does everything it promises to do. My skin is dry and very sensitive. The instant I apply Orpheus, the dryness is quenched and hydrated, skin is immediately softened. It absolutely does heal; I had awful patches of eczema with small dry pieces flaking off. That vanished after using this only a few times. I love the plumping, it reduces my fine lines greatly. The lines that were tiny to begin with aren't visible unless I hold my face a few inches from the mirror and look closely. My skin has a glow to it, something it does not achieve on its own. Its wonderful to not have such a dull, flat appearance.

Absorption is fast, no greasy look/feel is left behind.

The cream is dispensed via a pump. One pump's worth sufficiently covers my face. There is no scent. I have no adverse reaction to the cream.

The price is far more than I'd normally spend on facial cream. But it is so worth it. Orpheus works and it works well and quickly. Not much cream is needed per use, it applies easily. These factors make the price of the cream reasonable. What this product does for skin is incredible. I cannot stress how highly I recommend it.

title: Good, Reasonably Priced Serum for Men
text:
This is a very nice, well-priced facial serum for men. It dispenses via a pump and 1-2 pumps worth sufficiently covers the face. The first time my husband used the serum, he did so in the morning. It was a bit sticky/tacky until full absorption occurred. Because of this, he prefers to use it at night before bed. He's using the serum to help smooth skin and reduce fine lines and is pleased with the results he is experiencing.

The serum does not negatively affect his skin in any way.

There is a light scent-it kind of smells like carrots to me. lol. Doesn't last long, its undetectable after mere minutes.

Overall, a good facial serum for men.

Actual rating : 4.5 stars

title: This is an Amazing Conditioner!
text:
I've not yet used BELLISSO's Biotin Conditioner for Hair Growth long enough to know if it will help stimulate regrowth. But I have used it long enough to know its a superb conditioner that adds bounce, some shine (2 things my hair lacks!) and a ton of hydration and moisture to my normally dry, damaged, color-treated hair. While I do have thick hair, it is thinning around the scalp due to aging. This conditioner increases my hair's volume in the scalp area making it far less noticeable. Let me tell you, that has done wonders for my confidence. Vain as I sound, the thinning hair is the worst part of aging I've experienced thus far. Worse than the fine lines and dark spots. It feels good to not be so self-conscious about my thinning hair.

The consistency is on the thick side yet its easy to work into/rinse out. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look or feel oily/greasy. A little goes a long way. Has a lovely, light, fresh scent. Unfortunately, it doesn't last long in my hair. (Very few hair care product's scents last long in my hair for whatever reason)

This is a fabulous conditioner. I fell in love the first time I used it. The price is absolutely reasonable. So, will I purchase it again? I already have! I've not even used half the bottle and I've already purchased a second bottle! (As of now, it IS an Amazon 'subscribe and save' item)

Without a doubt, I HIGHLY recommend this conditioner. Hope you love it as much as I do!

title: Does What My Hair Cannot Do Own Its Own
text:
Leave it to Garnier to come out with another fabulous hair care product. Whole Blends Miracle Color Protector does what my hair cannot do on its own and what most hair care products fail at...it adds both shine and brightness to my typically dull hair. I've not used it long enough to tell if preserves my color-treated hair (roots)-: if it does, I'll be happy. But I have to say, I'm already thrilled with the shine/brightness it delivers. Such a noticeable improvement!

For whatever reason, I assumed this was a liquid product. It is not, its a lightweight cream. Very easy to apply to hair. I apply a small amount to my hair after washing, while its damp, focusing on the tips as instructed. It can also be applied to dry hair as needed. (I do not do this.) Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel oily or greasy. There is a light rose scent that I very much like though it doesn't last very long in my hair.

I love this product. It works great. The price is reasonable. The 2 bottles will last me quite some time and I'll absolutely continue to use/purchase it in the future.

title: Miracle Gel
text:
I swear, this is magic in a bottle! DERMAXGEN's Aloe Vera Gel is organic, contains 100% pure aloe, witch hazel, vitamins C & E. It is a clear gel that absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky look/feel behind. My skin is terribly dry-the instant the gel touches my skin, its calmed and soothed. I especially like to use it on my face to tackle eczema, reduce inflammation and keep it soft and moisturized. The kids use it after their baths as well and my husband also uses it on his scalp in addition to his face to help with some dandruff he is currently dealing with.

The gel does not have a scent.

The bottle arrived well -packaged and well -protected. The pump dispenses a perfect amount of gel-not too much, not too little. Gel is cold-pressed and feels nice.

Spring is right around the corner and with it, bug bites, sunburn, poison ivy... and we'll be ready to tackle all of it with this gel. The price is reasonable and worth every penny.

title: A Good Daily Conditioner
text:
The first time I used this conditioner, I had a bit of a hard time working the product into my hair. Its very thick. The next time I used it, I added a capful of water to the bottle, gave it a shake and was good to go. Much easier to apply. It rinses out easily as well. Overall, it does a very nice job of softening and moisturizing my dry hair. Doesn't weigh down my natural waves. Its gentle enough to use daily. There is a light, minty scent though it fades quickly.

I didn't notice an increased shine to my hair.

This is very good conditioner comprised of plant based ingredients and free of parabens, sulfates, gluten and cruelty. In light of the good job it does, the ingredients and the fact it can be used daily, the price is reasonable.

Actual score: 4.5 stars

title: Softening/Smoothing...But No Change in Firmness Yet
text:
M. Asam's Resveratrol Lifting Cream is packed with beneficial ingredients that work wonders on skin. The consistency is a bit thick yet its easy to apply; a little goes a long way. In an instant, skin is noticeably softer and smoother. I have experienced some thinning of fine lines on my face via plumping, but I can't say I've had a change in the firmness of my skin. I will continue to use the cream and see what happens.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues using this cream. It can be used on all skin types but is geared towards those with dry/dehydrated and mature skin. Recommended for day and night use.

title: Feels Great, Does a Nice Job Conditioning
text:
I normally wash my hair at night. After using Botanic Hearth Peppermint conditioner, I might have to rethink this. The peppermint oil delivers a nice cool, crisp feeling that feels wonderful on my scalp and hair. Definitely invigorating. The conditioner does a nice job of softening and adding fullness to hair. Its easy to apply/easy to rinse. Doesn't weigh hair down. It does have a light peppermint scent but it fades quickly.

Overall, a nice , reasonably priced conditioner for all hair types.

title: Scent is Overpowering
text:
If you like the scent of roses, this is the fragrance for you. 6 different rose varieties are combined to achieve the scent. The first time I smelled it, I was standing in the kitchen and did a quick spray-I didn't push the nozzle all the way down. The scent of rose immediately filled the kitchen...and stayed that way for HOURS. Not an exaggeration in the slightest, we could smell roses for hours, even over food I had cooked for dinner. It was overpowering and strong. I also did a quick spray on my wrist. Again, overpowering and long lasting. But when it finally calmed down and faded somewhat, it was a fairly pleasant rose scent.

For those interested in packaging, the perfume comes in a large red bottle and a nice box. It was well packaged and protected for shipping and arrived in perfect condition.

This isn't the perfume for me. Its too strong and overpowering for my taste. I'm not at all familiar with the Chopard brand but I find this to be overpriced. I have no plans to use/purchase this again. I'll be passing it along to my mom; hopefully she'll like it.

Overall score is 2.5 stars. (I had to round up)

title: An Exceptional Serum for All Skin Types-(love the brightness it brings to my skin)
text: The vitamin C in this serum goes a long way in adding some brightness to my otherwise dull, pale skin while improving its texture. Provides long -lasting hydration. Applies and absorbs easily without leaving a greasy appearance or feel.  Can be  used on all skin types.  I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues whatsoever. My mom spent a few days with us recently and 'borrowed' lol it...now she's hooked as well. The price is reasonable.

title: Good News...(and a bit of not so good news)
text:
Let's start with the good news. This is a fabulous deep conditioning hair mask. It works wonders on my dry, damaged hair. The consistency is very thick yet it is easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. Have a book /magazine handy or fill the tub up with hot water and prepare for some 'me time' because the mask is to remain on for 20-30 minutes. I did the full 30 minutes and, WOW. Looks and feels like I have a head of brand new hair! My normally dry/damaged hair is healthy, shiny and has bounce, something it normally lacks. I know its stronger since I'm not pulling hair out of the brush or bathtub drain. My natural curls and waves honestly look salon styled. Frizz? What frizz? Its gone and in its place is smooth hair.

And now the not-so-good news...

I do not care for the scent. Its listed as lavender, a favorite of mine, but it smells more medicinal and chemical than lavender. And its strong. I tried using a hair fragrance mist (different brand) but the mask's scent overpowered it. The scent does eventually fade.

Scent aside, this mask is phenomenal. It has worked wonders on my hair. I find the price a bit on the high side but worth it. Without a doubt, I recommend it highly. Give it a try...you have nothing to lose. EQUI Botanics offers a 100%, no questions asked refund.

Overall rating is 4.5 stars.

title: This is a Keeper For Me-(the scent is heavenly!)
text:
en Love Knot Ever Moisture Crush Detangler does everything it promises to do...and then some. This is one heck of a wonderful leave-in. Though the instructions say to "apply generously", an amount a bit larger than a nickel sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. The product is light and creamy; doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel oily or greasy and should be used on damp or towel dried hair. It detangles the worst of the worst tangles, adds shine to my normally dull hair and is the reason why I am no longer pulling strands of broken hair out of the hairbrush. The softness in my hair reminds me of the hair I had as a child-before I damaged it (in sun, with dyes, hairsprays, etc)-back when it was still untouched.

Ingredients include: 100% natural aloe vera (the FIRST ingredient, even before water), marula, honey, and argan oil, all beneficial to hair.

There is a scent and its heavenly. I think it smells like warm vanilla cake just out of the oven. Its delightful, not gagging or overpowering. And I can still detect it the day after applying it.

I love this product. The price is incredibly reasonable. This is a keeper for me. It works wonders on my hair. Without a doubt, I absolutely recommend it.

title: She Loves It
text:
Due to the fact I experienced some burning after applying to this cream (due to an eczema flareup), I stopped using it and passed it along to my mom. This review will be based on her use of the cream.

My mom absolutely loves this. Its 'lightweight, creamy and silky' is how she describes it. Absorption is very fast and no greasy look or feel is left behind. It softens and smooths her skin and keeps it well hydrated, even in the terribly cold weather we've been experiencing. She say she believes her wrinkles and fine lines are both thinning in size. (This is her favorite thing about the cream) She loves the light scent but notes that it fades quickly.

She uses it in the morning and at night before bed. While she finds the price on the high side, she says its worth it because the cream works so very well. She notes that a little cream goes a long way and doesn't need to use much each time she applies it

My mom says she's glad my eczema prevented me from using this cream because now it belongs to her. lol. (I know that sounds harsh but she truly doesn't mean it that way) She loves it, recommends it and says she will 'very likely' but it when her current jar runs out.

title: A 'Must-Have' Skin Cream (especially for those with dry, sensitive skin)
text:
This is one heck of a cream. It truly is. The consistency is light and creamy; reminds me of vanilla Greek yogurt. lol. Absorption occurs quickly leaving my terribly dry skin hydrated and revived for quite some time. Inflamed patched of eczema are soothed and calmed. Thanks to continued use, my normally dull skin is plumper, giving me a healthier, refreshed complexion. There is no scent and the cream is suitable for both daytime and nighttime use.

Thanks to an impressive list of ingredients, great results and the fact that 'a little (cream) goes a long way', the price is reasonable. Vichy also happens to be an Amazon 'Professional Beauty' product. (For those not familiar, "Amazon has curated a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices." I absolutely recommend this for all skin types but especially to those with dry, sensitive skin. Its wonderful.

title: Nothing. Feet Are Still Dry and Cracked
text:
I ordered this foot peel some time ago to try on my husband. (Same brand, different scent) He didn't have much luck. Now it was my turn to give it a try.

The instructions are quite simple and easy. Results are expected within 6-7 days. And by 'results', I mean the peeling is expected to begin in that timeframe. Today marks day 12 since I used the product. To date, nothing. No peeling whatsoever. My feet are still dry and cracked.

This mask didn't work for my dry, cracked feet. Based on the lack of results and high price, I do not recommend this product.

title: Awesome Night Cream
text:
What a fabulous night cream. Firain's Repair and Rejuvenate Plant Stem Cell Cream applies easily. Absorption is fast and doesn't leave a greasy feel/look behind. A little goes a long way.

This cream does a wonderful job of hydrating and moisturizing my very dry skin. (And believe me, now that winter is here, my skin is VERY dry) Its packed with ingredients that are wonderful for healing and protecting skin. Helps to reduce the signs of aging, something I appreciate now that I've reached the 'big 5-0'.

I start my morning with Firain's day cream and end it with Firain's night cream. Both work very, very well and are reasonably priced. Recommended

title: A Superb Day Cream
text:
If you're looking for a good day cream, look no further. I apply Firain's Repair and Rejuvenate Plant Stem Cell Day Cream first thing in the morning. Absorption is fast and leaves no sticky/oily look or feel behind. (Once absorbed, makeup can be worn over the cream) One application is all it takes, my skin remains well hydrated and moisturized all throughout the day. While the coral-ish shade of the cream doesn't discolor skin, it does breathe some life into my dull, pale skin tone helping to revive it.

The ingredient list is extensive. (See photo #4 above, left hand side for a full list) Lots of great skin-loving ingredients. I especially like the plant stem cells which work to prevent new wrinkles.

The cream does have somewhat of a pleasant scent though i can no longer detect it once full absorption has occurred.

Thanks to the impressive ingredient list as well as the good results the cream delivers, I find the price reasonable. (Quite honestly, I find it to be on the low side)

title: Works Great, Smells Wonderful
text: The leave-in coconut water mist I've been using for years is no longer available. I had to find a new brand. Based on the reviews I read, I decided to try Bella Curls Coconut Water Replenshing Treatment. To those who wrote a review that led me to try Bella, I thank you all.  I love this  mist.  Its water and dispenses in a mist: 2-3 pump's worth sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair and doesn't weigh it down. Enhances my natural waves while helping to prevent frizz. Does an excellent job of detangling.  And boy, does it smell fantastic. I will definitely purchase this mist again.

title: Miracle Cream
text: The bottom of my feet are so dry and cracked, they resemble funky fish scales!  O'Keeffe's begins to work with the very first use.  Within 7-10 days my feet are back to normal, nice and soft. Its not greasy and full absorption takes 15-20 minutes.  My husband is now using it on his dry, cracked feet as well.  This cream is exceptional and the price is more than reasonable for how well it works.

title: Great Conditioner (and it smells wonderful!)
text:
Such a nice, lightweight conditioner that does a great job and smells absolutely wonderful. Taza is easy to apply, easy to rinse from hair. A little goes a long way. Doesn't weigh hair or cause it to look oily/greasy. Eliminates frizz and tames/smooths my natural waves. Hydrates and softens my dry hair.

I've never heard of broccoli seed oil before-it contains vitamins and strengthens hair. Its one of many great ingredients found in Taza. The coconut scent is wonderful though it fades quickly.

This is a very good conditioner. Does everything it promises to do. The price is reasonable.

Overall rating is 4.5 stars

title: Love This...We Use it Daily
text:
We've been practically bathing in The Skin House's Aloe Fresh Emulsion since the bottle arrived on our doorstep. Its nice and lightweight; absorption is fast and leaves behind no sticky/greasy look or feel. Skin is instantly softened and moisturized. It works wonders on the particularly nasty patch of eczema that has been bothering me all winter long by soothing, calming and reducing inflammation. There is a very light, fresh scent though it fades very quickly.

The price is reasonable. This is a keeper in our home. I will purchase it again!

title: No Change in Dry Scalp...Yet
text:
Ordered this set for my husband due to his dry scalp. He's been using it daily since it arrived and hasn't noticed much of a difference though his dry scalp hasn't worsened. He is satisfied with the job it does cleansing and softening; adds some shine as well. Neither product weighs his hair down or causes it to look or feel oily/greasy. Both are easy to work into and rinse from hair. A little goes a long way. Both bottles will last him quite some time.

Overall rating is 3.5 stars

title: Delivers Fast, Wonderful Results
text:
I love how lightweight and airy this cream is. It feels nice as its applied. Absorption is fast and leaves behind no greasy look/feel. Skin is instantly moisturized and hydrated, both are long lasting. Thanks to continued use, I have a noticeable reduction to fine lines as well as some plumping. Ingredients include: shea butter, 7 types of hyaluronic acid (a fave of mine!), olive oil and Propanediol. I have no issues using this cream on my dry, sensitive skin.

Thanks to the fast and great results as well as the impressive list of ingredients, I find the price to be reasonable. This is the first time I've ever used a Terrazen product and I'm already a big fan!

title: Not the Right Duo For Me
text:
I'm a fan of various Maui Moisture Hair Care products and assumed I'd love the Coconut Oil product as well. Turns out, I don't. Coconut Oil is meant for those with thick, curly hair and that's precisely what I have. Both the shampoo and conditioner are easy to work into hair and easy to rinse from hair. My hair was not detangled after using both-I had to use a detangling spray to comb through it. Rather than defining my curls and waves, they were left on the flat side and kind of limp. I noticed no added shine.

Other than soft hair, I didn't really experience any positive results. I will continue to use Maui products, just not the Coconut Oil formula.

title: One of the Best Masks I've Ever Used
text:
Without a doubt, this is easily one of the best masks I've ever used. Its easy to apply (a little goes a long way) and easy to rinse off. Once applied, it can stay on skin up to 15 minutes. I do the full 15. The texture is thick and dark brown in color. It does one heck of an awesome job exfoliating, leaving my skin so soft and smooth. Delivers long lasting and much needed moisture while helping to reduce fine lines and calm inflammation due to dry skin /eczema. It does not dry out my skin in the slightest, nor does it negatively affect my sensitive skin.

I am not a coffee drinker. I do not care for the scent of coffee. Imagine my surprise when I smelled the coffee scent of the product and LOVED it! The coffee is not overpowering at all. It actually smells like a combo of coffee and chocolate to me. It is not long lasting...I can no longer detect it minutes after I've rinsed my face.

For those interested in packaging, it comes in a neat jar. I'm thinking of saving it once I've used all of the mask. The jar is packaged inside a pretty box...so pretty, I can't bring myself to throw it away! lol

The price is on the high side, however seeing as it delivers promised results and not much is needed with each use (I use it 2x's a week) I do find the price reasonable. Hope it works as well on your skin as it does mine!

title: Gentle, But Very Effective
text:
Revigen is a lightweight, almost creamy foaming face wash that does a wonderful job cleansing. Feels nice as I apply it and leaves my skin clean, soft and smooth after I've rinsed it away. Noticeably reduces pores. It does not burn or negatively affect my dry , sensitive skin in any way. Its packed with ingredients that work wonders on skin.

Revigen isn't just a facial cleanser. Its gentle enough to use as a feminine cleanser as well. (At this time, I'm only using it on my face. ) It can be used daily and works on all skin types though it is geared towards those with dry, sensitive skin.

It does have a bit of a chemical/medicinal scent to it, however, once its rinsed I can no longer detect the scent at all. Because the scent doesn't last, I will not remove any stars from my overall rating.

I like what this wash does for my skin. The results are immediate, it moisturizes and does 'double duty' as both a facial cleanser and a feminine cleanser. For these reasons, I find the price reasonable and recommend it.

title: Nice and Lightweight...Smells Wonderful
text: This shampoo + conditioner duo is quite lovely. Both are lightweight, easy to work into hair, easy to rinse from hair. Shampoo does a great job of gently cleansing. Leaves hair soft and hydrated when used alone. The conditioner hydrates, softens and smooths hair while leaving it soft and shiny. Each has an amazing scent that is not at all overpowering, gagging or terribly 'flowery'. Both can be used on all hair types, including color treated hair.

title: Works Great, Delivers Fast Results
text: I ordered Land and Lore's Men's Face Moisturizer for my husband  due to his very dry skin. (And because he uses my facial creams...its about time he has his own! lol) He has dry skin year round but it far worse in winter months.  He very much likes it.  It dispenses without issue.  He has no  problems applying it, absorption is fast and not at all greasy. It immediately provides much needed moisture that lasts all day, leaving his skin soft and smooth. He's not experienced a change in elasticity but then again, he hasn't been using it very long. The ingredients used are wonderful for skin care; he has no adverse reaction to any of them. He finds the scent 'OK' (I like it!) though it fades quickly. The price is reasonable and he says he 'absolutely' recommends it.

title: Not Enough Results to Justify the Price
text:
For the price of one ounce of HydroPeptide Power Luxe Cream, I expect to be blown away by it.

I'm not.

Don't get me wrong, this is a great nighttime cream. I appreciate that it contains Bakuchiol rather than Retinol which tends to irritate my sensitive skin. It definitely delivers deep, lasting hydration and does help reduce my fine lines. But I've experienced no 'youthful glow to the skin', plumping or firmer skin.

I do not experience enough positive results to justify the cost of the cream. I have no plans to purchase it in the future.

title: Does What It Promises To Do
text:
Solflower Hair Detangling and Conditioning Spray does everything it promises to do. This is a nice, lightweight, leave-in spray that detangles, moisturizes, eliminates frizz and softens hair. I'm happy to add it also delivers some shine, something my hair normally lacks. Its packed with all natural ingredients including, vitamins and minerals, botanicals and essential oils. 3-4 sprays sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. Works on all hair types

The spray can be used on damp or dry hair. I tried both and definitely prefer to use it on damp hair.

There is a scent and I do not care for it at all. Smells like a combo of paint and chemicals to me. However, this isn't an issue seeing as I can no longer detect it within a few minutes of using the product. Because it fades quickly and entirely, I will not deduct any stars from my overall score.

I'm more than pleased with the results Solflower delivers. The price is definitely reasonable.

title: Another Wonderful Curel Product
text:
I love the creamy, milky consistency of this face cream. I use it first thing in the morning. A little cream goes a long way. (If its incredibly cold outside or I'm experiencing an eczema flareup, I'll use a bit more than usual)
Absorption is fast leaving skin soft and incredibly hydrated and those results last all throughout the day. It is scent free. I have no negative reaction using it on my dry, sensitive skin.

I've loved every Curel product I've ever used and this is no exception. Its worth the price and I recommend it, especially for those with dry, sensitive skin.

title: Does A Lot of Good Things for Hair
text:
I love that this dispenses as a mist. 3-4 sprays sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. Detangles and prevents frizz beautifully while hydrating as well. Keeps my natural waves soft and smooth without weighing them down. It does have a light scent that is pleasant but not long lasting. (At least not in my hair) Can be used on all hair types.

There's a good reason this is an Amazon 'Professional Beauty' product. (For those not familiar, "Amazon has curated a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices. To buy Professional items, just look for the Professional Beauty badge.) This spray works so very well. The price is reasonable and worth every penny.

title: Hold Hair in Place, No Creases, Great Elasticity
text:
I am so very pleased with these hair scrunchies. I have thick, shoulder length hair and they easily hold my hair in place even though they're thin. I use a scrunchie when my hair is in a ponytail but also every night when I go to bed, otherwise I get sweaty. Not only do the scrunchies not lose their elasticity, they do not make the annoying creases in my hair like some ponytail holders tend to do.

The scrunchies are well-made, crafted from mulberry silk. There are no holes, tears or loose threads. You have the choice of black, pink or white...I chose white and I'm glad I did. At first, I thought the price was a bit high for 3. Seeing as they're strong, made from mulberry silk which prevents hair breakage, crease free and dont' lose elasticity, I do believe they will last for quite some time. Therefore, I find the price reasonable.

title: A Great Overnight Cream
text:
Curel Intensive Moisture Face Cream is a great night cream. Its not thick and heavy, absorption is fast and no greasy look or feel is left behind. A small amount of cream sufficiently covers my face and forehead. In the morning, my skin is soft, smooth and moisturized. It also helps calm and soothe the patches of eczema on my face and neck.

There is no scent. I have no issues using the cream on my sensitive skin. Recommended as a night cream, especially to those with dry, sensitive skin.

title: Works and Smells Great!
text:
My husband has awfully dry, rough 'alligator elbows'. (I like to tell him a block of cheese could be grated on his elbows...he doesn't find this very amusing but I sure do....lol) Parasilk Clementine Repair stick really does a nice job of softening and smoothing his elbows. When I saw how well it worked for him, I immediately tried it on the extremely painful fissures plaguing my fingers now that its winter. I was concerned the clementine might burn -nope. Instant relief!

The stick is easy to use. It doesn't cause skin to look/feel greasy. Has a great, light orange scent. Contains skin-loving ingredients including : antioxidant oils, vitamins, shea butter, coconut oil and vegan waxes.

Wonderful product that delivers fast results. Thanks to those fast results, the ingredients and the scent the price is reasonable. Perfect for anyone who experiences rough, dry patches of skin

title: Delivers Wonderful Shine
text:
I have to say, I'm impressed. My hair normally lacks shine, so to see it so shiny after using Garnier Glass Hair Water conditioner is awesome. I have thick hair so I use the 2-3 dose (per use) amount. Its easy to use-simply massage it into hair for 10 seconds (that's right...seconds, not minutes!) and rinse. It leaves my hair smooth and shiny without weighing it down or causing it to look oily/greasy. Has a nice , light scent that I can no longer detect once my hair has dried.

Its certainly not the end of the world but I must say, it doesn't remove all of my tangles. Makes it easier to comb through them but doesn't eliminate them entirely. Despite this, I very much like this conditioner. It works well and is unique. The price is reasonable. Perfect for those who need some shine and smoothness in their hair.

title: The ONLY Clear Polish I Use is Sally Hansen
text: I'm a fingernail biter.  Any colored nail polish looks absolutely ridiculous on my chewed down nails so I only use clear nail polish on them. I've used Sally Hansen Hard as Nails for literally decades.  Doesn't chip and helps to strengthen.  I also use it as a top coat on the colored polish i use on my feet to give it a nice shine and help prevent chipping. The price can't be beat, the quality is excellent.

title: Purchased a Second Bottle After Only ONE Use!  (It works THAT well!)
text:
I'm not at all familiar with this brand so I wasn't sure what to expect. I became impressed by it as I rinsed it from my hair the first time I tried it. As I rinsed and used my hands to to wash the conditioner away, I could already feel how soft and tangle-free it made my hair. After my hair air dried, I took a look in the mirror and immediately said, 'Oh my God!'. This wonderful conditioner added much needed brightness and shine, something my hair normally lacks. It worked wonders on my wavy hair, making the waves nice and even and incredibly smooth. I experienced no frizz whatsoever. I'm not a big fan of citrus scents and this does have a light mango scent but I actually like it. However, it fades quickly. (At least in my hair it does...my hair rarely holds scents from hair care products....no clue why)

I can honestly tell you with 100% certainty, I will continue to use and purchase this conditioner. In fact, not only have I used it again, I've already purchased a second bottle. The price is definitely reasonable...low, actually. I thought it would cost more than it does because it works so well. I love this conditioner and the results it delivers. Absolutely recommended!

title: My Hands Don't Feel Entirely Clean
text:
Despite the fact the soap kills 99.9% of bacteria, I'm not certain it cleans my hands as well as it could and should. Maybe its because it doesn't produce much lather. Or maybe its because it leaves a slight stickiness behind even after hands are thoroughly rinsed with water. (It eventually fades)

It doesn't dry out my skin. I have no negative reactions using it on my dry, sensitive skin. It is lightly scented...I don't really detect coconut, only lime. The scent doesn't last very long.

Since I'm not certain my hands get a thorough cleaning and because I find the price to be a bit on the high side, I have no plans to purchase this soap in the future.

title: Wonderful Daytime / Nighttime Cream (You can't beat the price!)
text:
This is a VERY reasonably priced facial cream suitable for both daytime and nighttime use. The consistency is nice, absorption is pretty quick. Does a beautiful job of quenching my terribly dry, sensitive skin, rendering it soft and smooth, even now when my skin is at its worst thanks to cold weather and a furnace that runs 24/7. Its packed with ingredients that work wonders on skin, including vitamins B5, E and C, coconut serum and hyaluronic acid.

I also love the airless container. Rather than scooping cream out of the jar with fingers, the top of the jar has a plastic covering with a small hole in the center. Simply press the covering and the cream dispenses via the small hole. This not only ensures the correct amount is dispensed, it also increases the shelf life keeping it fresh for a long time.

I seriously thought the price would be higher. Its more than reasonable.

title: A Dynamic Duo
text:
This is a fantastic shampoo and conditioner set from Herbal Essences. Both the shampoo and conditioner are easy to work into hair and easy to rinse. A little goes a long way with both products. Hair is detangled, smoothed, softened, cleansed and hydrated beautifully. Each has a lovely scent that actually lasts in hair for quite some time. Each bottle contains 29.2oz of product. Thanks to the great results delivered by both as well as the large bottles, the price is more than reasonable.

Definitely recommended

*I forgot to mention, both bottles arrived VERY well packaged. The nozzles on both were very well protected as were the bottles themselves. *

title: A Nice, Beneficial to Skin Set of 3 Great Hemp Oil Soaps
text:
Dr. Hempster (love the name!) hemp soaps are crafted from premium grade hemp seed oil and rich in omega fatty acids making them ideal for moisturizing yet gentle for those with sensitive skin. I have dry, sensitive skin and the soaps do indeed work well. I have absolutely no negative reaction. In fact, they not only cleanse and moisturize, they help soothe the dry, itchy inflammed areas.

3 soaps come in this set, each in its own nice box, ideal for storing, travel or even gifting:

Hemp + Mint
Chacoal Aloe
Shea Butter Citrus

Each has a clean, very light pleasant scent. All of the soaps easily create a good amount of lather (enough for shaving my legs without issue!) and rinse well. Perfect for hands, face or full body . Take a second to look at the thumbnail photos at the top of the screen, left side. You'll see a picture and description for each soap and how it benefits skin. Though a bit on the high side, I do find the price reasonable for the 3 bars. They work well and deliver results.

title: Gives Me a New Head of Hair
text:
I've always enjoyed trying shampoos and conditioners, even prior to joining VINE. I've tried A LOT over the years. GK Hair's Global Keratin Hemp shampoo and conditioner , without a doubt, is easily one of the best I've ever tried. Quite honestly, they might be the best. They're that good.

Scratch that. They're that spectacular.

The shampoo is lightweight and easy to work into hair + create a lather/easy to rinse out. A little goes a LONG way. The conditioner is on the thicker side yet its also easy to work into hair/easy to rinse. Together, this duo gives me brand new hair... at least makes it appear I have new hair! It undoes damage while strengthening. I don't clean hair out of the drain/hairbrush after using these. The patches of thinning hair around my scalp (due to aging) are made fuller. The moisture and hydration is amazing...and long lasting. My hair truly shines and has bounce, something it normally lacks.

The serum eliminates frizz. And not a little bit...it eliminates frizz entirely, leaving my natural= waves silky, soft and amazingly smooth.

The products are scented. They smell orange-ish to me. Normally, I do not care for the scent of citrus but i LOVE the scent of these products. My hair still smells good long after I've use the products. This is unusual for me, as my hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products.

This 3 piece set isn't cheap but its worth every single penny of the cost. What these 3 products do for my hair is amazing. I HIGHLY recommend this set and sure hope everyone experiences the same mind-boggling results I do.

title: Does Add Fullness/Thickness to Thinning Hair
text:
I wanted to give this conditioner a try to see if it would add fullness to the thinning hair around my scalp. (The rest of my hair is thick) Its easy to work into hair and easy to rinse out. Doesn't weigh hair down. And it did help to add some fullness to my thinning areas. But it also took some of the curl out of my natural waves and left my hair fairly tangled after use, though it wasn't super hard/painful to comb through to remove them. The conditioner does have a very light, pleasant scent which was undetectable once my hair was dry.

I did try this for the purpose of seeing how it worked on my thinning hair and I'm satisfied with the job it did in that regards. I would use it again in those areas only. I do believe it will help make hair fuller and thicker to those with thin hair and do recommend . The price is reasonable.

title: Cleanses, Softens...No Real Difference in Volume
text:
I ordered this for my husband to help add volume to his thinning (due to aging) hair. He needed only a small amount to adequately clean his hair. No issues working it into his hair; it lathered easily. No issues rinsing it. His hair was left soft and clean, which pleased him. Unfortunately, there wasn't much of a change with regards to the volume of his hair. He says it has a light, pleasant enough scent that fades quickly. (I didn't detect a scent but I do have a nasal cyst that at times affects my sense of smell)

Overall, he says this is a 'decent enough' shampoo and rates is 3.5 stars

title: Work SO Well, I Already Ordered a 2nd Jar!
text:
KTW's Pure Rice Water Milky Toner pads are a 'must-have' skin care product for me. I knew from the start I would incorporate the pads into my daily skin care regimen.

I have terribly dry, sensitive skin. Now that winter is here and the heat is on 24/7, its at its worst. An annoying, inflamed red patch of eczema aside of my mouth has been plaguing me for weeks, stubbornly refusing to respond to creams and lotions that normally heal. Figured I'd have to live with it until the weather gets warmer. When I used a KTW pad for the first time, the burning and itching was instantly soothed and calmed. After using the pads for a few days, the patch is now all but gone. What a relief! On top of the reduced inflammation, the pads do brighten my normally dull skin tone and even add a bit of a glow which is nice to see. I find myself touching my face from time to time after using a pad just to feel how soft and smooth it is.

I've not yet noticed a reduction to my fine lines but I've not been using the pads very long.

The pads are contained in a jar with a snap top lid. I prefer this type of lid...many times I've not screwed the lid of a jar on properly only to have the product inside dry out. Each pad is thoroughly soaked in the rice water + niacinamide product. Take a look at my photos. The pad looks to have small specks of dirt all over it. Its not dirt and is part of the rice so do not panic when you see it like I did. lol. The pads are incredibly soft and made from pure, unbleached cotton.

There is no noticeable scent to the product. Absorption is fast and doesn't leave an oily/greasy look or feel behind. Doesn't irritate my skin in any way.

My skin responds SO well to these toner pads. I wasn't kidding when I said these will now be part of my daily skin care regimen. I've already purchased a second jar. I was SO surprised when I saw the price for 70 pads. I fully expected the price to be at least double. What a nice surprise. I VERY highly recommend KTW rice pads, especially to those with dry, sensitive skin.

Wish I could give these more than 5 stars.

title: SO Easy to Use and Pain Free
text:
I'm going to start this review with a mini lecture. Take the time to read the instructions prior to use. Dont' worry...instructions are easy to understand, the device easy to use. But the system has different energy levels and flash modes, its imperative you know ahead of time which is best for you as well as instructions how and how often to use it.

OK, enough lecturing. The HLAIE laser hair remover IS easy to use. Its also pain free. I have terribly sensitive skin and experience no negative issues. The device can be used on the face, upper lip, arms, legs, bikini area and even the armpit.

Understand that it does take some time (app 8 weeks) for the full effect of the device ; it won't happen overnight. I'm in the middle of my 2nd week of use and while I've lost hair, I'm only now starting to see a decrease in the speed in which the hair grows back.

I cannot wait for the day to arrive when my body hair is gone! This is an easy to use, remarkable device and I just love it. Definitely worthy of gift giving. No need to have your hair professionally removed, now you can do it in the comfort of your own home.

title: After the Very First Use, I Purchased a 2nd Bottle. LOVE IT!
text:
I purchased a second bottle of OGX Coconut Caffeine conditioner immediately after trying it for the first time. That's how well it works. That's how much I love it!

Its very easy to work into hair, very easy to rinse out. A little truly goes a long way. I allow it to remain on my hair (after shampooing) for 5 minutes. Does a wonderful job of detangling, keeping frizz away, hydrating my dry hair , softening...all, while strengthening as well. I experience little to no hair breakage after using this awesome conditioner. Adds body and bounce to my hair.

The first thing I thought of when I smelled the scent of this conditioner was Hershey Park. If you go to the chocolate factory in Hershey, PA, the 2 block radius surrounding the factory literally smells like cocoa butter outdoors. That is what this scent reminds me of though there is also a hint of coffee as well. I normally cannot stand the scent of coffee but it somehow works...and works well in this conditioner!

Fantastic conditioner! The price is reasonable. I not only recommend it, I will continue to purchase and use it. It works wonders.

title: Strong, Variety of Colors, Well-Made, LOW Price!
text:
VIABTY's small claw hair clips are strong and durable. They're easy to open/close. I have thick, shoulder length hair. Once I place a clip, it stays in place and doesn't slide down. The clips are comfortable and BPA-free.

10 clips in a variety of colors are included. They're packaged in a lovely gift box, perfect if these are a gift for someone or to store the clips in. These are ideal for thin and medium-thick hair.

The price is incredibly LOW. Its a steal. You're getting high quality hair clips in a variety of colors for VERY little money. Absolutely recommended!

title: Good Conditioner for Daily Use
text: I wash my hair daily . KMS Conscious Style Everyday Conditioner is gentle enough for every day use. It does a great job of detangling, softening and hydrating. Because its lightweight, it doesn't weigh hair down.  There is a scent and I like it. Its not overpowering or gagging but it also doesn't last long in my hair. I can no longer detect it by the time my hair has dried (air-dried) I find the price a tad high but overall, this is a good conditioner, especially for those who wash daily.  (My overall rating is 3.5 stars)

title: Doesn't Work Well in My Hair (but I do like the scent!)
text:
I did not like the way this made my hair look and feel. It can be applied to both wet and dry hair and I tried both methods. When applied to wet hair, it removed a lot of waviness from my natural waves ; it looked as though I hadn't brushed my hair very well. When used on wet hair, it kind of weighed it down and made my hair look greasy. I do find the scent pleasant. Its one of a very few hair care products whose scent actually remains in my hair for a decent amount of time.

This just doesn't work well in my hair. I have no plans to continue to use/purchase it and have already given the remainder of the bottle to my mother to try.

title: Great Results
text:
I love Better Natured's shampoo and couldn't wait to try their Color Care Deep Conditioning Balm. After washing with BN shampoo, I applied the balm to my wet hair and allowed it to sit for about 5 minutes, despite the instruction of 1-2 minutes. Its easy to apply, easy to rinse. Doesn't weigh hair down. It does soften and even add a bit of shine to my normally dull hair while at the same time hydrates and eliminates frizz making my natural waves nice and smooth. I especially love that it doesn't cause my color treated hair to fade quickly as other products tend to do.

There is a scent that I VERY much like though it doesn't last long.

This conditioning balm works very well , delivers excellent results and i don't need to use much product to sufficiently cover my thick, shoulder length hair. The price is reasonable and I definitely recommend!

title: Does a  Nice Job of Healing/Repairing Dry, Cracked Feet
text:
I deal with dry, cracked feet year round. But winter is when my feet are at their worst...to the point they look like I have funky fish scales! lol. Heal a Heel (LOVE the name!) cream is a bit thick yet easy to apply and doesn't take long to absorb. Skin is left soft and not at all greasy. After 4 days use, I began to notice an improvement; the horrific cracks started to heal and close up and the dry areas were greatly reduced. Thanks to continued use, my feet are soft, smooth and greatly healed.

The cream is scented...its not strong and doesn't last very long.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no adverse reactions to Heal A Heel.

Overall, this cream does a good job with fast results. I do find it a tad pricey for a little over 3 ounces but I still recommend it

title: Pamper Yourself
text:
If you're looking to pamper yourself or someone else, look no further. Bwana Butter has put together a beautiful package containing products that will make the recipient look and feel wonderful.

The kit arrives packaged in a lovely gift box. No need to wrap it if you're gifting it. Included is an 8oz container of an ultra moisturizing facial mask, an 8oz ultra facial moisturizer, a small container (no size listed) of pure hyaluronic acid (comes in powder form) and your choice of a jade or rose quartz roller and gua sha. (I ordered jade and love it) Instructions for using the products are included and should be followed.

I have very sensitive skin and can use all of the products without issue.

The products make skin look and feel wonderful. I will say my initial impression was that the price was a bit high, however after using the products, I've changed my mind. All of the products included are fantastic, work well and the beautiful packaging all make the price reasonable.

title: One of the Best Hair Conditioners I've EVER Used!
text:
I typically end my reviews by commenting whether or not I recommend the item and if it is worth the price. Not this time. I'm going to do the complete opposite and start out by telling you this is easily one of the BEST hair conditioners I've ever used (And I've used A LOT. I've always enjoyed trying new hair products, even before I joined the VINE program). Its worth every penny of the price.

Its not often I come across a conditioner that does everything it promises to do...and more. That's precisely what Tree to Tub's Biotin and Collagen Conditioner does. I do have thick hair; Tree to Tub thickens the thinning areas (courtesy of aging). It delivers the long lasting hydration my dry, damaged hair so desperately needs while keeping frizz away and softening and smoothing at the same time. My typical dull hair literally shines from this conditioner. Its not often I get to see such a wonderful shine to my hair and i just love how it looks. I experience a big decrease in hair breakage from using this so I know its doing a great job of strengthening my hair.

Perhaps it the lemon ingredient that is responsible but after I use Tree to Tub, my blond hair color is nice and even throughout. No patches of different blond shades, the color is uniform . I hadn't expected that and was delighted when I noticed it. (And I noticed it after the very first use!)

I've never been a big fan of citrus scents. Almost pains me to say I do not care for the lemon scent of this conditioner at all. Not even a little bit. Seeing as I can pretty much no longer detect the scent by the time my hair air-dries, I am not going to deduct any stars from my overall review.
