Tree to Tub does a gorgeous job with packaging and presentation. The box the bottle is packaged in is very sturdy and quite lovely. The bottle itself is pretty, it lists ingredients, directions for use and even includes an expiration date of the product. Also included as an actual soapberry along with an interesting, informative pamphlet on the soapberry and how to use it. (I honestly found this fascinating since I'd never heard of soapberry before!)

This is my first time using a Tree to Tub product. In all honestly, I'd never heard of this brand prior to testing this conditioner. I am now such a HUGE fan. This conditioner is a 'keeper' for me. It does SO many wonderful things for my hair. I've already purchased a second bottle. This is truly one of the BEST hair conditioners I've ever used in my life and I absolutely recommend it!

title: Perfect for Dry, Sensitive Skin
text:
I really must stop making assumptions. I took one look at Be Happy cream and groaned. The cream is VERY thick. I automatically assumed it would be very heavy on my skin. I scooped some out and applied it. It applies VERY easily. Despite the thick consistency, its incredibly lightweight. Full absorption happens quickly without leaving a greasy/oily look or feel behind. I have terribly dry, sensitive skin. Now that winter is here, my eczema is flaring up more than usual. I have painful, burning red patches of skin all around my face. Be Happy calms, soothes, hydrates and removes the red patches/pain. And it does so FAST. Does a heck of a job softening my skin too...to the point I find myself touching it to feel how soft it is. lol.

I just love Be Happy! I use it twice a day. The price is reasonable and I absolutely recommend it, especially to those who have dry, sensitive skin.

title: Wonderful Results. Perfect for Those w/Dry, Sensitive Skin
text:
Now that winter has arrived and the heat is on in the house 24/7, my normally dry, (very) sensitive skin is unbelievably dry and terribly sensitive. I have rough red patches of dryness and eczema that itch and burn terribly. No Brainer Gentle Facial Cleanser does a wonderful job of not only cleansing my skin but calming and soothing it as well. Its lightweight and creamy. Doesn't product much lather. While some facial cleansers dry my skin out more than it already is, No Brainer does the opposite. It freshens my skin and helps to hydrate and moisturize. I use it in the morning and at night before bed. There is a light, clean scent but its not long lasting. I can no longer detect it after I've rinsed the cleanser off.

This is the perfect cleanser for those with dry, sensitive skin. I love it. I find the price reasonable: it delivers wonderful results and not much is needed each time I use it. I'm new to this brand and can't wait to try out other products. Highly recommended.

title: How I Love en Love Shampoo!
text:
Very rarely do I not use conditioner when washing my hair. (I wash it daily) en Love is one of a very small number of shampoos I will use solo. Its not a 2-in-1 shampoo + conditioner but it sure works like one. The consistency is nice and creamy, its easy to work into hair and easy to rinse. Lathers very well. Cleanses hair beautifully while softening, smoothing and adding shine, something my hair lacks. My natural waves are left nice and bouncy. Overall, my hair looks and feels fresh and clean.

The scent is wonderful...vanilla bean. Reminds me of a vanilla cake freshly baked out of the oven. Its not sickeningly sweet or overpowering. Because the scent from hair products rarely last in my hair for whatever reason, it thrills me to report the scent of this shampoo actually stays in my hair for a day or so.

en Love is packed with 100% natural ingredients, including: marula oil, aloe vera, argan oil, coconut milk, and honey. A small amount roughly the size of nickel is sufficient to cover my thick, shoulder length hair. Thanks to awesome ingredients, excellent results and a wonderful scent, the price of this shampoo is very reasonable. Quite honestly, I find it to be on the low side. I absolutely WILL purchase and use this again and I definitely recommend it.

title: Revives  My Childhood Hair To When It Was Healthy and Free of Damage
text:
'spectacular' isn't a word I use often but it absolutely applies to Goldwell's Bond Pro Fortifying Conditioner. I really had no clue what to expect. Not only had I never tried a Goldwell product, I'd never heard of it before.

The bottle is huge...33.79oz. Dispensing is easy; the pump works well. The conditioner is easy to apply/work into hair and just as easy to rinse. A little truly goes a long way. Goldwell revives my dry, damaged hair. It softens, smoothes and detangles. My natural waves are enhanced , have bounce and shine, something my hair normally lacks. I don't have to clear the shower drain or hairbrush after using this, it eliminates breakage. Has a wonderful scent that is not overpowering or gagging. Unfortunately, the scent doesn't last very long. (This is normal for me...my hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products)

I feel like I have my 'tween' hair thanks to this conditioner. The hair I had while young before decades of sun damage, hair tools, hair coloring, hair spray etc ever touched my hair. There is a good reason why this is an Amazon Premium Beauty product, its so deserving. (For those unaware, 'Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men. ") The price is reasonable due to the results the conditioner delivers, the large bottle size and only a small amount is needed to adequately cover hair. This bottle will last me quite some time. I HIGHLY recommend Goldwell Bond Pro Fortifying Conditioner.

title: Very Limited Results
text:
I didn't experience many positive results from this conditioner. Its very thick-to the point i had to remove the cap and squeeze the bottle to dispense it. Due to the thick consistency, I had trouble working through my hair. Rinsing wasn't an issue. It did a nice job of softening and helped add some hydration but my natural waves were barely there and my hair wasn't terribly smooth and remained dull, without shine. There is a nice, light apple scent though it didn't last long in my hair.

I didn't experience enough positive results to warrant continued purchase/use of this conditioner.

title: Shampoo Works So Well, I Don't Need to Use Conditioner W/It.
text:
*This review is for Better Natured's Moisturizing Shampoo ONLY. I received the shampoo to test/review*

I wash my hair daily and that includes using conditioner. When I use Better Natured's Moisturizing Shampoo, I don't need to use conditioner. This is not a 2-in-1 shampoo + conditioner product but it sure works like one. The shampoo is nice and creamy. Despite being a tad thick, it is easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse. I use an amount roughly the size of a nickel to adequately wash my thick, shoulder length hair. Lathers quickly. Leave my hair silky soft, very well-hydrated, bouncy and something it normal lacks: shine. I very much love the scent of this shampoo though I can no longer detect it a few hours after use. The price of the shampoo is reasonable seeing as not much is needed for each use and it delivers great results. I will continue to purchase and use this shampoo and absolutely recommend it.

title: What This Does for My Hair is Simply Incredible!
text:
This is my new obsession. Seriously. Vera Prime Argan Oil & Diamond Hair Serum is positively phenomenal. I was worried the very first time I tried it. It kind of reminded me of olive oil and I envisioned my hair as a greasy mess.

That didn't happen...

A small, pea size amount is all that's needed. Dispense into the palm, rub hands together and then through hair. The serum can be used on wet or dry hair. I tried both methods. I can think of one other hair care product that I prefer to use on dry hair, every other product seems to work better when my hair is wet. That's not the case with this serum. When used on wet hair, it adds some bounce and softness. Pretty much the same as other leave-in conditioners. When I use on dry hair, good things happen. VERY good things happen. It adds life to my hair. My natural waves become fuller/enhanced, have bounce, are free of frizz , smooth and soft. This serum breathes life into my hair. And...it actually adds shine! My hair is always dull. Many products that promise to add shine do not do so in my hair. This actually does and how I LOVE having shine and not dull hair! The serum keeps my hair in place all day long. It doesn't get flat or lose the bounce/shine. It feels and looks fresh as well. All this from using a PEA SIZE amount of serum! Its just incredible. Honestly, my hair looks like I stepped out of a salon every time I use the serum. Its mind boggling (in a very good way!) A neighbor even complimented my hair after I used the serum for the first time!

The serum is scented and its wonderful but light and not long lasting. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products)

This is a keeper for me. Though only a very small amount is used and the bottle will last me quite some time, I've already purchased a second bottle. What this does for my hair is simply incredible. I'd LOVE to give it more than 5 stars. I absolutely recommend this serum. I WILL continue to purchase/use it.

title: Does a Very Good Job On My Dry, Sensitive Skin
text:
When I squeezed some COSRX Vitamin C Daily Cream out of the tube for the first time, I found myself wondering if the cream would be greasy. Its not terribly thick and is a tad watery. (That was the part that concerned me). Turns out, I had nothing to worry about. Absorption is quick into my dry, sensitive skin and leaves behind no greasy/oily look or feel. A little amount of cream goes a long way. Leaves my skin hydrated and moisturized something I always need but especially now that the weather is cold and the house is dry from the heat running all the time. I do notice some plumping of the skin which helps to reduce the appearance of my fine lines. But I dont' really notice a brightness to my skin.

I have no adverse reactions to this cream with my dry, sensitive skin. It is scent-free.

Overall, I'm pleased with COSRX cream. The tube holds 1.69fl oz of cream. I know that doesn't sound like a lot but thanks to the cream applying easily and only a small amount is needed to sufficiently cover my face, the tube will last quite some time. I do find the price reasonable as this delivers good results and does so quickly.

title: Hair Looked and Felt Kind of 'Straw-Like'
text:
I didn't have much luck with this conditioner. My hair wasn't detangled after using it though the tangles were easy to comb through. As my hair air-dried, it looked and felt dried out; kind of straw-like. My natural waves were all over the place; some were OK, others were barely there. I noticed no shine to my hair though that is pretty normal for me.

The scent of this conditioner is nice but its very light and I could no longer detect it once my hair was dry.

This conditioner just doesn't work well with my hair. I have no plans to purchase or continue using it.

title: A Fantastic Gift Set (One you might want to keep for yourself! )
text:
I'm going to begin my review with a warning. If you're buying the Moroccanoil Magic of Repair Holiday Kit as a gift for someone, prepare yourself for the very real possibility you might be tempted to keep it for yourself! The holiday hair repair kit comes with 3 full size Moroccanoil products : shampoo (8.5oz), volumizing mist (5.4oz) and weightless hydration mask (8.5oz). Also included is a small, trial size bottle of Moroccanoil treatment. All 4 products are packaged in a VERY nice and VERY well -made , reusable cosmetic bag. Each product has the wonderful, signature Moroccanoil scent. All items were packaged very well for shipping and arrived in perfect condition.

I just love this kit. I'm a huge fan of Moroccanoil products. Without a doubt, this makes a fantastic gift whether it for someone else or you're treating yourself. The price is reasonable seeing as the products are full size and the cosmetic bag can be used long after the hair products are used up.

HIGHLY recommended!

title: This is a Good Conditioner
text:
Overall, I'm pretty impressed with Four Reasons Intensive Conditioning Treatment. It is easy to apply and easy to rinse. Does a nice job of adding much-needed hydration to my dry, damaged hair while controlling frizz and softening. Detangles well. Has a nice, light scent though it doesn't last very long

While it doesn't weigh my hair down, it does relax my natural waves a bit more than I'd prefer. I do not notice a whole lot of shine added to my hair. Despite this, I still find this to be a conditioner that does a great job. The price can't be beat! I would purchase/use Four Reasons again.

title: A Must-Have for My Hair
text:
I've used Renpure's Coconut Water Mist Leave-In for YEARS. It works very well and is a definite 'must have' for me. The consistency is like water and lightweight. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel oily or greasy. Dispenses as a mist; 3-4 pumps' worth sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. Detangles beautifully. Softens, smooths and moisturizes hair. Has a lovely, light refreshing scent though by the time my hair dries, I can no longer detect the scent.

I will continue to purchase and use Renpure's Coconut Water Mist. Works wonders for my hair.

title: Does a Good Job But I'm Not Blown Away By It
text:
For the most part, this is a very good repair conditioner. Its easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out as well. A little goes a long way. Delivers much needed hydration while softening and strengthening. There is a very nice, light scent though it was pretty undetectable by the time my hair dried. (My hair doesn't often hold the scent from hair products very long...no clue why)

While it does do a good job of detangling, it doesn't make my hair tangle free. I do have some small tangles after using this though they are easy to comb through. I don't experience any noticeable shine to my hair as well.

Overall, this is a good conditioner but I'm not blown away by it. I believe its a bit overpriced for the results it delivers to my hair; I have no plans to continue to purchase it in the future.

My actual rating is 3.5 stars

title: Works Well & Quickly on Aches and Pains
text:
When I was a kid, I used to think my parents and grandparents were exaggerating when discussing their 'aches and pains'. Now that I've reached the big 5-0, I know they weren't exaggerating in the slightest! lol. I had plenty of areas to test Better Shea Butter's Hemp Balm Cooling on. Now that cold, damp weather is upon us, the arthritis I have in my thumb is flaring up. Its not agonizing pain but it is noticeable. I rub a small amount of the balm on my thumb area 2-3 times a day during a flareup and it soothes the pain quickly. After performing 2 belly-flops on the same patch of ice last year, I'm left with on an off again arm soreness. Once again the balm takes care of it and does so quickly. Shortly before I sat down to write this review I had a slight headache. Noticeable, but not strong enough to warrant an OTC pain reliever. I simply applied some balm to my forehead and as of this moment as I write this, my head feels fine.

I love the ingredients in the balm. I have no adverse effects to any of them on my dry, sensitive skin. Absorption is quick and doens't leave a greasy feel or look behind. There is a scent-reminds me of Vicks rub and a hint of peppermint. I love it but its not long lasting. I can barely detect it once absorption has occurred.

I love the packaging. The jar is cute and has a safety seal between the lid and the balm. I especially love the hemp pouch the balm is packaged in.

I'm happy and impressed with the great and fast results this balm delivers. Works great on my aches and pains and the price is reasonable.

title: A Wonderful, Well Priced Product That Does What It Promises To Do
text:
Titicii Biotin Deep Moisturizing conditioner has a fairly thick consistency yet dispenses from the bottle without issue and is easy to work through hair and rinse out as well. Does a beautiful job of detangling, smoothing, keeping hair frizz-free, softening/hydrating and even adds a bit of shine to my hair, something it normally lacks. Has a nice, light scent though I can no longer detect it by the time my hair dries. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products for some unknown reason) Includes some great hair care ingredients such as aloe, pumpkin, Argan oil, honeysuckle and rosemary

Though it doesn't weigh my hair down or cause it to look/feel oily or greasy, it does diminish my natural waves just a bit. I'm able to remedy that with a few sprays of a sea salt hair product (different brand) that I sometimes use.

I never heard of the Titicii brand until now. Count me as a fan because this conditioner is awesome. Does everything it promises to do and at a very reasonable price. I absolutely recommend this conditioner. If you find it doesn't work for you, Titicii offers a 100% satisfaction guarantee

title: Tones the Brassiness in My Hair (and has the Moroccanoil signature scent as well!)
text:
Does exactly what it promises to do. Tones the brassiness in my hair so its all the same shade of blonde. And in doing so, I don't have to color my hair as often. Also softens and adds some shine to my otherwise dull hair. Its easy to apply-a little goes a long way-and its just as easy to rinse out. Doesn't weigh heavily or cause hair to look/feel oily or greasy. (And, if you've never used a purple shampoo/conditioner before, don't worry...though the product is purple in color it doesn't turn hair purple! lol) Detangles s well. If you're familiar with Moroccanoil hair care products, you know their signature scent. This conditioner does have the scent. Perhaps its my imagination...while its the same scent, it doesn't seem as strong as other Moroccanoil products. My hair still smells great the day after I use this but it doesn't seem quite as strong. I still love it.

I like the results this purple conditioner delivers. I find the price reasonable as well.

title: Nice , Soft Facial Cleansing Brush
text:
We just got a new puppy. I'm not sure which is softer, his puppy fur or my Alana Mitchell Face Wash Brush! lol.

Such a lovely brush. The bristles are so soft and light. They keep their shape well, stay in place and take care of the 'hard to reach' area on my face -the side of my nose. The brush delivers a gentle yet thorough cleansing that is nice and relaxing. The handle is comfortable to hold. At 10.08 x 3.35 x 2.56 inches; 3.21 ounces, the brush is a good size to take along while traveling,

I have terribly dry, sensitive skin and have no issues with the brush. Doesn't leave any scratch marks behind.

I don't use the brush for exfoliating, only cleansing. It just seems far too soft to exfoliate.

I do wish the brush could be hung up while not in use not only to keep it off of the bathroom counter but to give the bristles a chance to dry. There is no hole for hanging. I did ask my husband if he could drill a hole so I could hang it but he didn't think that would work very well. I'm also curious as to how long the bristles should last. Unless I missed it, I cannot find any info about it.

This really is a nice, gentle brush that does a great job of cleansing the face. So far, its holding up very well and I do use it daily. I find the price reasonable and do recommend it.

title: Both Work Well, Deliver Some Good Results
text:
I love to use products containing Hyaluronic acid on my skin. It works wonders. I was excited to find out if the same could be said of hair care products containing it. SNP Cafferonic Shampoo + Conditioner both contain fermented green coffee as well as 5 types of hyaluronic acids. The shampoo is nice and creamy, easy to work into hair and easy to rinse. Does a really nice job of cleansing. The treatment (conditioner) is thick, easy to work into and rinse from hair as well. Leave hair soft, smooth and well hydrated.

I experienced less hair breakage after using this duo. Still had some, but not much. I was pleased that the thinning hair around my scalp was made somewhat fuller as well. Neither product weighed my hair down but my natural waves weren't quite as wavy after using both.

There is a very light scent. Doesn't smell at all like coffee to me. Its nice but doesn't last long at all. I can no longer detect it by the time my hair has dried.

Overall, I get good results from this duo. I recommend the set. Keep in mind, SNP offers a 30 day no-hassle money back guarantee should you have issues or find you don't care for it.

title: Definitely Strengthens Hair
text:
Despite having a thick texture, this conditioner is easy to work into hair and easy to rinse out. Has a nice, light and pleasant scent that doesn't last very long in my hair. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair products for whatever reason) I know it helps strengthen my hair; after using this I don't have to scoop out any hair from the shower drain or clean broken pieces from my hairbrush. Protects my hair color...doesn't cause it to dull or fade. Prevents frizz and keeps my hair smooth. But a bit too smooth. While it doesn't weigh my hair down, my natural waves aren't quite as wavy as usual after using this conditioner. It does add a bit of shine but nothing major. Seeing as my hair is normally dull, I'll take whatever shine I can get!

Not a huge deal but my bottle arrived w/o a pump so I must take the lid off each time I use it and squeeze some out of the bottle in order to dispense it.

Overall, I do like this conditioner. Seeing as it protects against UV rays I think I'm going to put it away until the summertime to help combat damage my hair will experience due to a lot of time in the sun and pool.

Rating is 4.5 stars

title: Perfect for My Dry, Sensitive, Eczema Plagued Skin
text:
This lovely T'else Chamomile Calming Tea cream quenches my dry, sensitive skin in the instant I apply it. Its very lightweight , absorbs unbelievably fast and doesn't leave a greasy/oily look or feel to skin. A little cream absolutely goes a long way.

'Azulene' is a new one for me. Never heard of it until I tried this cream. As promised, it is wonderfully soothing. It does a beautiful job of calming the itchy, inflamed red patches on my face , courtesy of dry skin and eczema. Keeps my skin hydrated and moisturized throughout the day.

The cream is unscented

What a wonderful cream, especially for those of us with dry, sensitive skin. I prefer to use this as a day cream because its so lightweight. I love the results it delivers and find the price reasonable.

title: Soothing, Convenient, Well-Priced
text:
Argan oil and chamomile work together to make Virgin Baths eye balm a wonderful and reasonably priced product. I love the instant soothing it delivers to the red, puffy (and sometimes itchy) skin under my eyes when I wake up in the morning. As an insomniac, it makes my eyes not look so tired as well. It goes on easily and keeps skin hydrated all day long, leaving behind no greasy/oily look or feel.

I have sensitive skin and have no issues with this balm

Virgin Baths uses 100% organic materials and are free from harmful chemicals. The packaging is bio-degradable and recyclable.

I really do like this eye balm. I'm pleased with the results, it feels wonderful, the tube is a convenient size , the ingredients are wonderful and its reasonably priced.

title: Not Enough Positive Results to Warrant Continued Use/Purchase (3.5 stars)
text:
I have mixed feelings when it comes to this conditioner. It does a great job of softening, smoothing and eliminating frizz. Also does a decent job of moisturizing and protecting hair color. There is a scent that I find pleasant though it doesn't last very long. On the other hand, it doesn't make my hair shiny. While it doesn't weigh my hair down, my natural waves aren't quite as wavy after using this. I am seeing less hair in the shower drain and my hairbrush but am still experiencing some breakage.

I have no issues applying or rinsing it from my hair.

My overall score is 3.5 stars. The conditioner has delivered some positive results but not enough for me to continue using/purchasing it.

title: Works Well
text:
ZZ LOVE's conditioner for damaged hair is nice and lightweight. A little goes a long way. Its easy to work into hair and easy to rinse out. I ran my hands through my hair as I rinsed it off and though wet, I could feel how soft my hair was. It was tangle free as well. When my hair was dry (I air dry), my natural waves were nice and smooth and free of frizz. I noticed some added fullness around my scalp where I experience thinning due to aging. My normally dry hair was well hydrated.

The conditioner has a lavender scent , however, I really couldn't detect it at all. I also didn't experience shine to my hair after using this. Despite both of these, I like this conditioner. Overall, it does a good job and is reasonably priced.

title: Does Everything It Promises To Do
text:
Testing EVO's The Therapist Hydrating conditioner (1.1oz) was the first time I've ever tried an EVO product though I had heard of the brand before. The Therapist is a lightweight conditioner that does a great job of detangling while adding a ton of hydration to my terribly dry, color treated hair. Keeps my natural waves nice and smooth while preventing frizz and breakage. And it actually makes my hair shine, something it normally lacks. Its easy to apply/work into hair and just as easy to rinse out. EVO doesn't contain harmful ingredients and is vegan. I love that EVO makes a point of saying they don't test products on animals...only humans!

This is an excellent conditioner that does everything it promises to do. This 1.1oz travel size is perfect to take along while traveling. But its also a great way to try the conditioner to see how well it works on your hair if , like me, you've never tried it before.

title: Not Your Typical Loofah
text: This isn't your typical loofah.  Its well made, strong and durable and does a great job of cleansing and exfoliating.  Feels nice on skin when in use and isn't rough or scratchy.  The small sponge pieces, which are securely attached to the loofah, help body wash/soap lather more than usual allowing for a better cleansing, exfoliating and (at least for me) shaving experience.  A convenient loop ribbon is attached so the loofah can be hung up to dry/ be stored while not in use. I love this loofah! The price is reasonable.

title: Good Conditioner That Delivers Results
text:
I've not yet used Ethica Beauty Anti-aging conditioner long enough to notice any kind of new hair growth but I can tell you that since using it, I don't clean hair out of my hairbrush or the shower drain. Its definitely strengthening my hair while adding much needed moisture and hydration.

The conditioner is easy to work into hair and easy to rinse out. I let it sit on my hair for 5-6 minutes before rinsing. Does a wonderful job of detangling as well. Doesn't weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy.

There is a bit of a medicinal scent, however I can no longer detect it once my hair is dry. Since the scent doesn't last long, I am not deducting any stars from my overall score.

Ethica can be used on all hair types. A little goes a long way. I'm pleased with the results it brings and recommend it.

title: Excellent Results, Incredibly Low Price!
text:
The wash is a tad on the thick side ( not in a bad way) and creamy. Lathers easily and feels nice when applied. Little apricot granules can be felt and they do a wonderful job of exfoliating. Skin receives a deep yet gentle cleansing. Does a great job of moisturizing and softening as well. I have dry, sensitive skin and have no problems with the wash.

There is a nice, light scent that's not overpowering or gagging. It also pretty much disappears when the wash is rinsed off.

I fully expected this to cost at least twice the listed price because it works so well. In fact, when I sat down to write this review and saw the price, I got up, went to the bathroom and doublechecked to make sure i had received the correct product. (I did). I'm truly stunned by the low price of this wonderful facial wash. I love how fresh my face feels after using this. This is a wash I will continue to purchase and use. Absolutely recommended!

title: How I Love This Soap
text:
I almost passed over Anmous's Goat Milk soap when I saw it in my VINE queue. For some reason, I took a second look at it and decided to give it a try. Thank goodness I did because I love this soap! Two round soaps are included, each with its own mesh bag. Lathers easily. Cleanses and exfoliates gently, leaving even the driest skin like mine soft, smooth and hydrated. Feels fantastic on the patches of eczema I have on my arms, legs and cheeks...nice and soothing. There is a scent but I can't quite put my finger on what it is. Its not flowery, overpowering or gagging, it smells great. But it fades quickly.

Phenomenal soap. Does a lot for skin yet is gentle enough to use on babies. It can even be used on laundry! I absolutely will purchase this again.

title: A Lovely, Gentle Mask That Delivers Results
text:
This was a new experience for me as I've never used a facial mask that I had to prepare ahead of time. Don't let my use of the word 'prepare' scare you. Preparing the mask takes roughly a whopping 10 seconds. Maile Organics Kaua'i Detoxifying Facial Clay Mask is a powder. Simply mix 1tsp of the powder with 3 tsps of warm water until a smooth, creamy consistency is formed. (Reminds me of cake batter! lol) It may not seem like a lot but only a thin layer of the clay mask is needed so you'll have enough to cover your face and neck. (I only use this on my face) The instructions say to allow the mask to dry for 3 minutes. I keep it on for closer to 5 minutes of drying time. After 5 minutes, I rinse it off. It rinses easily. My skin is normally very dull. This mask helps with the dullness while reducing pore size, gently but deeply cleanses and leaves my face feeling fresh and soft. Feels as though I spent the day at the spa getting pampered!

I have sensitive skin and have no issues using the mask. No pain, burning, itching , etc.

The mask is unscented.

For those interested in packaging, it comes in a pretty glass jar. Be careful opening the safety seal, I took it it off too quickly and wound up spilling some powder. The box its packaged in is very pretty. If you're giving this as a gift, wrapping paper probably isn't necessary, the box is pretty enough on its own.

This is such a lovely mask. And its packed with wonderful ingredients that keep skin healthy and clean. Seeing as the mask only needs to be used 1-2 times a week, a very small amount of powder is used to make the mask, the results are great and the wonderful ingredients, I find the price to be reasonable. There's a good reason this is an Amazon 'premium beauty' product. (If you're not aware, a 'premium beauty' product means, "Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men. "

recommended

title: Works Great/Contains Important  Skin Care Ingredients
text:
Bliss's Drench and Quench serum is a lightweight, refreshing facial serum. Packed with helpful skin care ingredients such as 4 types of hyaluronic acid and amino acids, it does an exceptional job of moisturizing, softening and hydrating skin. Absorption is fast as are the results I just mentioned. No greasy, oily or sticky feeling is left behind following absorption.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no negative reactions to the serum.

This is a wonderful serum. I love the refreshing feeling that comes with using it. The price is reasonable. I actually expected it to cost more since it works well and delivers results. I would purchase this again.

title: Gives Me Beachy Waves (when used on dry hair)
text:
GoodMood's Sea Salt Texturizing spray can be used on damp or dry hair. I tried both ways. When used on damp hair, my natural waves were barely there by the time my hair air-dried. When used on dry hair, I had far better results. After a few sprays worth and scrunching, my natural waves had a nice, 'beach wave' look. And they stayed that way throughout the day.

The spray doesn't weigh heavily on hair nor does it make hair hard and crunchy. There is a slight scent. I'm not sure what the scent is exactly, but I don't care for it. However, its not an issue for me because the scent fades quickly.

All in all, I'm pleased with the results this brings me when used on dry hair. The price is reasonable and I would purchase this again.

title: Not the Right Conditioner For Me
text:
This isn't the right conditioner for me.

The consistency reminded me more of shampoo than conditioner. In fact, I had to double check the bottle to make sure it was a conditioner. This wasn't a problem for me, I was just surprised by it. I did have to use more than usual to adequately cover my shoulder length hair. I wasn't able to work it into my hair easily. Detangled my hair pretty well, still had a few small tangles that came out when I combed them. When my hair dried (I air dry) my natural waves weren't really there, instead my hair was straight w/some frizz. While I did experience a noticeable improvement to the thickness the conditioner left a 'waxy' feel on my hair. (I definitely rinsed all of the conditioner out)

The scent is nice and refreshing. I like it a lot though it doesn't last long.

I have no plans to use this conditioner again. I've already given it to a relative. Its not the right conditioner for me.

title: Unique Ingredients
text:
Boscia's Plant Stem Cell Defense Moisturizing cream is packed with ingredients beneficial to skin health. The main ingredient is natural and sustainably sourced plant and fruit stem cells. The ingredients come together to make a good day and nighttime facial cream that delivers a lot of moisture, softens, improves skin barrier and with continued use, reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.

The cream is a pretty shade of pink. Reminds me of strawberry yogurt. lol. Its easy to apply and absorption takes a few minutes. No sticky/greasy look or feel is left behind, it absorbs fully. There is no scent to this cream.

This is a good facial cream that provides skin care benefits. Its also an Amazon 'premium beauty' product. For those unaware, a 'premium beauty' product means: "Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men". It is a bit pricey for a small jar (1.7oz) but keep in mind it is of high quality.

title: Nice and Creamy, Cleans Well and Smells Fantastic
text:
How I love the scent of Jergens Extra Moisturizing hand soap! Its a wonderful cherry almond that isn't overpowering and actually lasts for a while. The soap itself is nice and creamy. Easy to work into a lather. Not only does it do a great job of cleaning, it makes skin nice and soft as well. I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues /adverse reactions.

This is a wonderful hand soap. Works great, smells SO good. This item contains 3-8.3oz bottles. The price is reasonable.

title: Nice, Lightweight Conditioner
text:
Nuuvo conditioner contains some great ingredients for hair care. They come together to make this a very nice conditioner that does a great job of softening, smoothing, detangling and hydrating hair. Its nice and lightweight, easy to apply/rinse from hair. The scent is light and lovely though it doesn't last very long. (At least not in my hair...my hair rarely holds the scent of hair care products)

I do find the conditioner to be a bit pricey. Other than that, its a very good conditioner that takes good care of hair.

title: Love This Soap!
text:
I'm normally not a fan of citrus scents but I have to say, TROFREE's Dead Sea Salt Beauty Soap (lemon) smells wonderful. It has a light, lemony scent not at all overpowering or gagging. The soap itself works beautifully as well. It lathers quickly and easily. Gently, yet thoroughly cleanses skin leaving it feeling fresh yet incredibly soft. I love that the bar doesn't turn into a messy soap clump as some other bar soaps tend to do. I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues using this.

I can say with 100% certainty that I will continue to use this soap...I just purchased another bar! lol. I love it. Works great, packed with great skin care ingredients. smells wonderful and the price is reasonable.

Recommended

title: A Lovely Facial Cream,
text:
Such a lovely, lightweight facial cream. The consistency reminds me of very soft butter; its so easy to apply. Don't worry, unlike butter it doesn't leave a greasy look/feel behind. Absorption is pretty fast and with it comes much softer, smoother skin. This cream quenches my dry skin with long-lasting hydration and moisture. Calms the patches of inflammation on my face due to eczema.

There is a light scent and I think it smells great. Its not long lasting. I can no longer detect it once absorption of the cream has occurred. For those interested in packaging, its packaged in a nice, heavy box. I think the jar is so pretty; its glass and hexagon shaped.

I have dry, very sensitive skin and have no issues at all with the cream.

OGI's Manuka Honey Deep Care Facial cream is wonderful. Its packed with great ingredients, easy to use, results are long-lasting. A small amount of cream goes a long way. For these reasons, I find the price reasonable and recommend it.

title: Wonderful Conditioner-(But something needs to be done about dispensing it)
text:
Such a lovely conditioner. Does a marvelous job of not only softening my dry hair but making it silky and smooth. Eliminates frizz and fly-aways leaving my natural waves bouncy and shiny, two things my hair normally lacks. I love the hydration it brings and it actually lasts a good amount of time. After using this conditioner, I feel as though I just stepped out of a salon. My hair looks and feels light, fresh and clean.

The scent is gorgeous. Its not at all overwhelming and it actually remains in my hair for a good amount of time. That is rare. Most hair care product scents don't last long in my hair.

I do have an issue which makes my actual score 4.5 stars and not the full 5. The conditioner is thick. And I do mean THICK. I gave up trying to pump it and removed the nozzle from the bottle. Figured I'd just give the bottle a squeeze or two and get it out that way. Nope. The bottle is very firm. I spent nearly 5 minutes squeezing and shaking the bottle just to get enough conditioner for use.

Other than the dispensing issue, this conditioner is wonderful. Love how it makes my hair look and feel.

Overall score: 4.5 stars

title: Dry, Sensitive Skin? Give This a Try
text:
My dry, sensitive skin is instantly soothed upon application of Bonabella Teatree Gel cream. It feels especially cool and calm on the patches of inflammation due to eczema. Absorption is so very fast and doesn't leave behind a greasy or oily look or feel. Best of all, my skin stays hydrated and moisturized throughout the entire day, even in the hot, humid weather we've been having. A little gel cream goes a long way, the jar will last quite some time.

I definitely recommend this Bonabella Teatree gel cream, especially to those who also have dry, sensitive skin.

title: One-of-a-Kind Serum
text:
L'Oreal has a phenomenal product with their Revitalift Eye Serum. We'll start with the serum itself. It contains hyaluronic acid (a fave of mine) as well as caffeine. The serum does a fabulous job of thinning and visibly reducing fine lines . My very thin /small fine lines are no longer visible. The larger lines are not gone but they are noticeably thinner. Dark circles become lighter and lighter and puffiness is reduced. Skin is left moisturized.

The triple roller applicator is one of a kind. 3 stainless steel balls not only help to apply the serum but are cold and feel absolutely wonderful over skin, especially when puffy. They deliver a nice little massage and I do believe it works better than just using fingers to massage serum into skin.

This serum delivers promised results. I love the results I've experienced thus far and I love that my eyes look well rested even when I 'm tired and dragging. The price is reasonable. I absolutely recommended this serum.

title: Such a Lovely Conditioner
text:
Everything about ZENTS Moisturizing conditioner is lovely. Its absolutely perfect for my dry, damaged hair. Works into hair /rinses from hair easily. Detangles and delivers intense hydration and moisture leaving my hair soft, shiny and smooth. (To make my hair shine is impressive, it doesn't shine on its own!) Leaves my hair looking and feeling light, fresh and bouncy. I love the bounce my natural waves have after using ZENTS. Frizz is eliminated and that's not easy to do with my hair, especially when its so hot and humid outside as it is now. The scent is gorgeous. Its light and airy. Unfortunately, it doesn't last very long in my hair. (For whatever reason, hair product scents rarely last long for me. ) A little conditioner goes a long way. I need a small amount (roughly half dollar size) to sufficiently cover my thick, shoulder length hair.

This conditioner is packed with awesome ingredients for hair health, results are immediate, it smells great and leaves hair looking and feeling wonderful. ZENTS also uses products and packaging with Green practices. The price is reasonable.

title: No Complaints. This is the Real-Deal
text:
I have absolutely nothing negative to say about Goldwell's StyleSign Curls and Waves salt oil spray. Its fantastic. Lightweight, airy and dispenses in a mist. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look oily/greasy. A few sprays worth from roots to end on my damp hair followed by scrunching results in my natural waves being fuller, wavier and improves the texture. Makes my hair feel and look fresh. And the scent...how I LOVE the scent of this spray! Easily one of the best hair care product scent I've ever experienced. It doesn't last very long, unfortunately. At least not in my hair. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair products. )

There's a good reason why this spray is an Amazon Premium Beauty product. For those not familiar, 'Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men'. You'd think a premium product would have a hefty price tag. Not in this case. I find the price absolutely reasonable. I 100% recommend this spray to those with curly/wavy hair. Hope it works as well for you as it does me!

title: Exceptional Night Cream (at such a LOW price!)
text:
What a phenomenal night cream. I've tried many creams that deliver instant softness to skin but this is like no other. The softness is a whole new level and its felt as soon as I apply it. Absorption is super fast and absolutely no greasy, oily or heavy feeling is left behind. Age Perfect brightens my otherwise dry, dull skin and keeps it moisturized for an extended time. I love the firmness to my skin that I'm just starting to notice.

There is a light, lovely, fresh scent. But it doesn't last long at all. (We're talking a matter of minutes...I can no longer detect it after just a few minutes)

I find this to be an exceptional night cream. Does what it promises to do. The price is incredibly low.

HIGHLY recommended

title: Work Better Together
text:
Inverto's Silk Shampoo has a very creamy consistency. Easy to work into hair, lathers quickly, also rinses easily. Used alone, it softens, reduces frizz, adds moisture and helps detangle hair. (still had a few small tangles easy to comb through). Combined with Inverto's Silk Conditioner, both come together to detangle beautifully (and completely...i had no tangles after using both together), moisturize, eliminate frizz and add some shine to hair.

Both have lovely scents, are sulfate free and safe for color treated hair.

Both are good products. They work better when used together. I do think they're priced a bit on the high side for 12oz bottles.

title: Not the Right Conditioner For Me
text:
A nice conditioner that does a good job of detangling, softening and moisturizing hair without weighing it down. The scent is lovely and not overwhelming. But I wasn't blown away by it. My natural waves were lacking a bit. Didn't really experience much shine.

Sea Shine conditioner contains some wonderful ingredients for hair. Its also plant based, organic and the bottle is made from 90% ocean-bound plastic. It does NOT contain harmful ingredients such as parabens, sulfates, synthetic fragrance , synthetic chemicals.

Though I did experience some positive results, I didn't experience enough to warrant continued use. I have no plans to purchase /use this conditioner. (gave it to my SIL)

title: Does SO Much for My Hair
text:
I highly recommend taking a minute to read the info supplied on this page regarding the the Mexican Nopal cactus. Its incredible. And it is packed with nutrients, vitamins, amino acids, minerals that work wonders on hair. Its RARE for me to not use conditioner when washing my hair. (I wash my hair daily) I don't need conditioner when using CACTUSNARA scalp cleaner, it does the work of both a shampoo and conditioner. Its thick yet easy to work into hair/easy to rinse. Doesn't weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. Cleansing isn't all it does. It delivers shine and bounce to my hair, two things it normally lacks. I've been spending a lot of time in the hot summer sun and in the pool as well so my hair is more dry/damaged than normal. CACTUSNARA softens and strengthens it and did so with the very first use. I don't clean hair out of the brush of drain after using this. My natural waves are nice and smooth, free of frizz and flyaways. And the scent...how I LOVE the scent of this cleanser! Its light and fresh and actually lasts. My hair rarely holds the scent of hair products but thankfully, it does keep this scent. I had to take my dog to the emergency vet late last night and a nurse commented how good my hair smelled.

This cleanser helps my hair in so many ways. Not much is needed to sufficiently wash my thick, shoulder length hair. I use an amount a bit larger than a nickel. The bottle contains 16.9oz and will last me quite some time. The price is more than reasonable. Highly recommended

title: Dynamic Duo
text:
I never heard of the Lafe brand before and was very much looking forward to trying their shampoo/conditioner duo. An amount approximately the size of a dime is all the shampoo I need to sufficiently wash my thick, shoulder length hair. Lathers very well and is easy to rinse out. Has a nice, light herbal scent. The conditioner applies/rinses easily. I use an amount a little larger than a half dollar to cover my hair. Detangles hair very well. Has a light scent. This won't be very helpful...I don't think it smells like coconut or cinnamon but I can't put my finger on what it smells like. Its pleasant, not overpowering and doesn't last very long.

Together, the shampoo and conditioner make my hair nice and soft with some bounce and shine. My natural waves stay smooth and free of frizz. This is a great shampoo/conditioner duo and both are free of toxins and harmful chemicals. Recommended

title: Fantastic Results
text:
I was so excited to test NutriGlow Natural's Onion Conditioner. A few months ago, I tested an onion shampoo (different brand) and loved it. I was curious about an onion conditioner but couldn't find any to purchase. Last week, NutriGlow's onion conditioner showed up in my VINE offers and I immediately ordered a bottle.

It does not disappoint!

This is a fairly thick conditioner. Easy to work into hair, easy to rinse out. It does not weigh hair down or cause it to look oily/greasy. The directions state to leave it on hair for 2-3 minutes but I keep it on for closer to 10. I'm so very pleased with the results. Does an excellent job of detangling. My natural waves are more enhanced and frizz-free. I have thick hair but this adds a nice, even fullness to it. And that fullness not only looks really nice, but it helps to thicken the thinning hair (due to aging) on my scalp. I am especially pleased by the added bounce and shine results. My hair normally lacks both.

I've not used this conditioner long enough to experience an increase to the growth of my hair but I do not notice hair in the hairbrush or shower drain.

There is a scent and I just love it. I can still detect it faintly the day after washing my hair.

I'm so thrilled with the results, I logged into my Amazon account to purchase another bottle only to find its not available at this time. I sure hope that changes. I really would like to continue to use this conditioner. Hope it works as well for you as it does me!

title: Sturdy, Strong, Work/Look Great
text:
When I placed my order for MAORULU's Octopus Hair Clips, I did take note of the 3" size. When they arrived, I immediately thought they looked too big. I use hair clips to secure the sides of my hair behind my head while leaving the rest down. Since I pull back small portions of hair, I normally use small clips. Though I have thick, wavy/curly hair, I pictured the MAORULU clips sliding right out of my hair due to their large size and didn't hold out much hope for their success in my hair.

I was wrong!

The clips open/close easily. They're also easy to put in/remove from hair. Once its in place, it doesn't move. No sliding, no wobbling, no loose strands of hair popping out. The clip stays where its placed until I remove it. They're nice and lightweight. I love the term 'octopus' for these. Its very fitting.

As mentioned, I normally pull the sides of my hair back. But I did pull all of my hair back into a clip and it held it with no problem.

8 well made, sturdy, pastel clips are included. They work SO well, I prefer them over the small clips I used to use. The price is absolutely reasonable.

Recommended

title: Works Well and Smells Great! (awesome packaging)
text:
I'm losing it. For the life of me, I cannot place what the scent of Uriid's Neroli Hand Cream reminds me of! The scent is wonderful but I'm drawing a blank. I made my husband smell it and he also thinks it smells familiar but can't place it. lol. Scent aside, I just love this cream! The container is awesome. The perfect size to keep in a purse, gym locker, desk at work, school bag, car, etc. (Its round and does not stand upright) The nozzle is small and dispenses a thin amount of cream with just an easy little squeeze. The cream is lightweight, non greasy and absorbs quickly. Does a wonderful job of moisturizing my dry hands.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no adverse reactions to the cream. It can be used on all skin types.

Because it works well, is non greasy, moisturizes, is in a great container, has good ingredients and smells wonderful, I do think the price is reasonable. Even though the container only holds 1.76oz of cream, because I use such a small amount (a little goes a long way!), this is going to last me quite some time. I' know I'll definitely use it throughout winter when my hands get even drier, chapped and cracked.

title: Does a Nice Job and Has a Unique Scent
text: The consistency of Rikoko Lock shampoo is very thick.  I put a small amount in the palm of my hand, add a few drops of water , rub my hands together and then work it  into my hair. Despite the thick consistency, it rinses out well.  Does a good job of gently and thoroughly cleansing hair while softening. Works on dry, damaged, colored, straight and curly hair types.  Has  a scent that is pretty unique.

title: Long Lasting Color, Beautifully Presented
text:
Wow. Better Natured goes all out on packaging! This hair color kit is beautifully presented. It really feels like a gift. Items are individually wrapped and presented in a gorgeous box that I'm keeping. I'll find use for it, its too pretty to throw away or recycle!

The kit includes an applicator bottle, gloves (nice gloves that are easy to put on/take off, unlike some other brands of hair dye whose gloves tear easily or are hard to put on), a packet of shampoo/conditioner, and the hair color. Instructions are easy to follow. I recommend watching the 2 short videos above prior to use.

I have very sensitive skin. Its rare that a hair color doesn't cause itching/burning for a day or two after I use it regardless of how well I rinse /remove it; to the point at times I must take Benadryl for relief. I experienced next to no itching or burning from Better Natured's hair color. What a wonderful treat!

My grays were covered beautifully. The hair color can last up to 8 weeks. I'm at week 2, just starting my 3rd week after using Better Natured and so far, so good.

I had no issues rinsing this out of my hair. The shade I used (10N-lightest natural blond) blends well with my hair color. I definitely chose the right shade. I like the hair color remover wipes included. I've never used a hair color product that included after use wipes to clean around hairline/ears! I really appreciate that extra touch. I do wish the color care conditioner packet was larger, it doesn't contain much conditioner. I happen to have a regular size bottle of the conditioner so I was able to use that to sufficiently cover my hair.

Normally, $25 is more than I would spend on hair color. Seeing as color lasts up to 8 weeks, I experienced no itching/burning and I'm more than satisfied with the results, I do find the price reasonable. This was the second Better Natured product I've tested. I'm quickly becoming a fan!

title: A Great Conditioner, Ideal for Daily Use
text:
Great Clips' Solutions conditioner is reasonably priced and does an impressive job of moisturizing, hydrating and softening even the driest of hair. It detangles and prevents my hair from becoming frizzy, even in hot and humid conditions. Applying to hair and rinsing is easy. A little conditioner goes a long way. Hair is not weighed down or made to look or feel oily or greasy. There is a light, fresh scent that smells great though it doesn't last long in my hair.

This is a great conditioner geared towards those with naturally curly, dry or chemically damaged hair. I appreciate the fact that it is safe to use daily. The price is reasonable. Recommended

title: My Hair Looks Like I Was at the Beach (even though the closest is 125 miles away!) :)
text:
I love the way Authentic Beauty's Beachy Texture spray takes my natural waves to a new level. They go from normal waves to the waves I get after spending the day at the beach. Seeing as I don't live near the beach and don't get there very often, it almost makes me giddy that I can now have proper beachy waves anytime I like without leaving home. The spray can be used on dry or damp hair and can air dry or used with a diffuser. I use it on damp hair that I air dry. A good amount is released, so 4-5 spray's worth is sufficient for my thick, shoulder length hair. Its nice and lightweight. I cannot feel it at all and it does not make my hair hard or crunchy. I can easily run a comb/my fingers through it. Doesn't make hair look or feel oily/greasy. There is a nice, light scent though it fades very quickly . (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair products)

I'm thrilled with the results from this texturizing spray. Works beautifully. There is a good reason it is an Amazon Professional Beauty product. (For those not familiar, " Amazon has curated a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices.") Its definitely deserving. Definitely recommended~

title: Not Enough Positive Results
text:
This is a lightweight, overnight gel that is supposed to repair skin, de-tan, reduce scars, cause skin to glow, hydrate and moisturize. Ingredients include: Spanish saffron, aloe vera, oils and extracts of jojoba. A pea sized amount is to be used on clean facial skin before bedtime. At first, I thought it looked like it might be sticky. Its not. Absorption takes a few minutes on my dry, sensitive skin.

So...how well does it work? It does a nice job of hydrating and moisturizing. Helps reduce fine lines. My skin is very soft in the morning. But it doesn't glow. I had hoped the small scar I have on my cheek would be made even smaller but that's not the case. It hasn't changed at all.

As you can see in my photos, there are 2 empty areas inside the jar. The total amount of gel fills a little over 2/3 (of the entire jar), its not filled all the way to the top.

There is a scent. I'm not a fan. Reminds me of air freshener in a public restroom. It fades once absorption occurs.

I experience a VERY small amount of burning sensation on my chin/cheeks. I want to stress its VERY mild and vanishes within minutes.

This isn't for me. While I do experience some fine line thinning, moisturizing and hydration, I just don't get enough results to warrant continued use.

title: Feels Great and Helps Rid Dark Circles/Puffy Eyes
text:
Thanks to insomnia, stress, and aging, many mornings I roll out of bed only to find puffy eyes and more often than not, dark circles. CIBLUTY's Ice Beauty Ball feels SO good on my swollen, puffy eyes. The ball portion is crafted from safe, high quality glass that is safe to place in the freezer *FOR NO MORE THAN 10 MINUTES!!!!* The ball's interior contains a material that will not freeze. The handle is also glass but has a foam covering to place over the handle so hands don't get cold while using the beauty ball. After popping the beauty ball in the freezer for 10 minutes to get it nice and cold and applying moisturizer, I simply roll it around my eyes. It feels wonderful as it calms the puffiness around my eyes. Very soothing and relaxing. Helps to diminish the dark circles as well. Doesn't get unbearably cold since its only in the freezer for 10 minutes. When not in use the beauty balls can be stored in the lovely box they are packaged in.

The beauty balls are pretty and without a doubt are worthy of gift giving. I gave one to my mom; she gets dark circles and puffy eyes as well. But I also gave her one because she slipped and fell while watering her flowers and has a huge bruise on her cheek. (She's on Coumadin so she bruises VERY easily!) She's been using the beauty ball on her eyes and her cheek and just loves it. I find the price very reasonable and absolutely recommend CIBLUTY's beauty balls.

title: Another Great Nature Nut Product
text:
I'm a fan of the Nature Nut brand having used the leave-in conditioner, face serum and moisturizing cream. This deep conditioning hair mask is yet another product I'm now a fan of. It strengthens my hair and helps to prevent breakage while delivering desperately needed hydration, some shine (something my hair always lacks) and softness. I especially like to use this after a day outside in the hot summer sun/swimming. The mask is easy to apply and just as easy to rinse. Doesn't weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. Has a nice, light nutty scent that doesn't last long in my hair. One mask packet=2 uses on my thick, shoulder length hair. Can be used on all hair types. The price is very reasonable and I like that the packets can be purchased individually rather than having to buy a large quantity at one time.

Recommended

title: A Good, Germ Killing Hand Soap
text: Nyle Naturals liquid hand soap is a nice, creamy hand soap that does a great job not only cleansing hands, but moisturizing as well thanks to the aloe vera extract ingredient.  Lathers/rinses easily without irritating,  including sensitive skin.  Best of all, it kills 99.9% of germs.  There is a scent-a soapy scent. I like it though it fades quickly.  This is a good hand soap, perfect for homes, offices, businesses, schools, etc.

title: Decent
text: This is  a decent leave in conditioning mask.  I'm not blown away by it but it does provide some benefits .  Its not super heavy and is easy to work into towel-dried hair.  It softens my hair and does a decent job of keeping frizz away.  I don't really experience much help to repair my dry, damaged hair and no added shine. It has a lovely scent that doesn't last very long. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair products ) While this provides some help, its not enough for me to continue  to use/purchase.  And that's a shame because the price can't be beat.  However, despite limited results on my end, I'm going to recommend this mask. Hopefully  you'll have better results but if you don't, gowwim does offer a full refund.

title: Dove Does it Again!
text:
I've not had to remove any hair from the shower drain and only a few strands from my brush since using this conditioner. It really does a wonderful job of strengthening hair and mine is certainly taking a beating right now with spending a good deal of time outdoors in the sun and swimming all summer long. Its easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse. Doesn't weigh hair down in the slightest. Provides long lasting hydration and even gives my hair some bounce, something it normally lacks.

The bottle is a whopping 33.8oz size and the built in pump actually dispenses a good amount of conditioner. There is a nice, fresh, light scent that I do very much like, but it doesn't last long in my hair. (My hair rarely holds the scent of hair products for some unknown reason)

I'm a big fan of DOVE and this conditioner is another to add to the list of my favorites. It delivers results and comes in a huge bottle (with an easy to use pump!) The price is more than reasonable; I find it to be on the low side. There's a good reason this is an 'Amazon's Choice' product. (For those not familiar, this means, "Amazon's Choice highlights highly rated, well-priced products available to ship immediately.")

I definitely recommend DOVE's Hair Therapy Breakage Remedy

title: A Good Shampoo/Conditioner Duo
text:
Fermosa's Charcoal Shampoo does a great job of cleansing hair and the scalp. Its easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse. Take note that the instructions state the shampoo should be massaged into hair and scalp for a full minute prior to rinsing. I follow these instructions and it doesn't strip my hair or dull the color in any way. The conditioner should also remain on hair for a full minute though I leave it on closer to 5 minutes. It also is easy to work into hair and rinse.

Neither weighs hair down. Hair is left soft, clean and shiny. Fermosa does a nice job of preventing frizz and that's a good thing seeing as its awfully hot and humid here right now.

While my hair isn't weighed down by either of these products, I do experience a bit less wave in my naturally wavy hair. Despite this, I still like this shampoo/conditioner duo. The price for both is reasonable.

title: Works Wonders on Sensitive Skin
text:
Such a wonderful cream for sensitive skin! I have terribly sensitive skin; there are many products I cannot use because of sensitivity. So happy that isn't the case with Manyo Factory's Our Vegan Heartleaf Cica cream. When I first opened the jar I was a tad concerned that the cream might be too thick for me. Its not...not at all. Its easy to apply and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy look or feel. Once absorbed, skin is softer and smoother. I'm amazed at the impressive level of hydration this delivers to my skin that so desperately needs it. It also does a great job of calming and soothing the patches of eczema on my cheeks. The cream is without a scent. I experience no negative reactions whatsoever to this cream. It contains white birch; and though I'm new to this ingredient, I love and appreciate its benefits to skin care. Also included : bamboo and cica.

If your skin is sensitive, I urge you to try this cream. It delivers results and does so quickly. The price is reasonable for all that this cream does and the fact that a small amount is needed for each use.

title: Works Wonders on My Skin Issues
text:
I have dry, sensitive skin as well as eczema and have never tried blue tansy until now. Wow, does this ever do a fabulous job of calming and soothing my skin issues! Reminds me of butter when I apply it. A very small amount easily covers my entire face and it applies beautifully. Inflammation and burning is instantly relieved, the red patches vanish and my skin is left softer than ever. It does have a scent; a different and rather unusual scent that I'm not familiar with but like very much. The cream is a pretty shade of blue but don't worry, it doesn't discolor skin in any way.

Though the info above states this can be used as a day or night cream, I use this as a night cream only. A small, thin layer takes quite some time to absorb. Most creams/serums absorb quickly in my skin, I suppose due to it being so dry. But I can feel and see it on my skin for quite some time (hours) until absorption fully takes place.

Due to skin sensitivity issues, there are many products out there I cannot use. But i have absolutely no issues with this cream. And thank goodness for that because this works wonders for me. I fully expected the price of this cream to be higher. I was very surprised as to how low it is. This is a wonderful cream that helps me so much and delivers fast results. The 4oz. jar will last me quite some time, even if other family members decide to use it too. And when it runs out, I will continue to purchase and use.

title: Very Secure, Perfect for All Hair Types!
text:
Long hair/short hair. Thick hair/thin hair. Adult hair/child hair. Doesn't matter what type of hair you have. Gingbliss barrettes keep it place without slipping or strands popping out; even while exercising or outdoors in windy weather. With a quick (and painless!) snap, hair is secured. And they're just as easy (and painless!) to remove. 60-2 inch barrettes are included with this pack. 20 silver, 20 gold, 20 black. A very convenient and sturdy plastic storage box is included and believe me, it comes in handy! I don't have dozens of barrettes spilled out in the bathroom drawer, they're all contained in the storage box.

The price for 60-2" barrettes that do a fantastic job of securing all hair types is more than reasonable. These are well made and sturdy and will last a long time.

title: Lightweight w/Great Results
text: How I love gel creams and Dr. Ceuracle Vegan Kombucha gel cream is no exception.  Its lightweight and feels wonderful pretty much from the moment I apply it.  Absorption isn't instant but it is quick (matter of minutes) and doesn't leave a heavy, oily or greasy feel behind. Skin is left soft and supple.  And my  dry, sensitive skin is quenched with a deep, long-lasting hydration.  On top of the great results, the cream is vegan, has eco-friendly packaging and loaded with skin friendly ingredients.  There is a  barely noticeable pleasant scent that I can no longer detect once absorption has occurred.  The price is reasonable.  I believe you're going to love what this gel cream does for your skin!

title: Wonderful
text:
Such a fantastic conditioner! Better Natured Color Care conditioner is a lovely, lightweight conditioner that is easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse. A little goes a long way. It leaves my hair moisturized (something it desperately needs especially now that I spend a lot of time outdoors and in the pool), soft and shiny. Even has some bounce, something it normally lacks. The scent is phenomenal though it doesn't last very long. (Most hair products don't hold their scent long in my hair for whatever reason)

With 95% of the ingredients naturally derived, great results and a wonderful scent, the price of this conditioner is definitely reasonable. There's a good reason it is an Amazon 'Professional Beauty' item. (For those not familiar, a 'professional beauty' means, "Amazon has curated a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices."

Recommended

title: Another Awesome Product from Mane Club
text:
I had the pleasure of testing/reviewing Mane Club's One Hit Wonder10 -in-1 leave in spray for the Amazon VINE program and loved it so much, I immediately purchased their Wavy Baby Wave Texture Spray. And its just as awesome as the leave-in.

I have naturally wavy hair. Wavy Baby makes the waves more organized. By that, I mean they keep their shape beautifully without turning into a ball of frizz /flyaways, instead staying smooth and in place. It gives my hair some volume, something it needs especially around the scalp area where I experience thinning due to aging. Doesn't weigh my hair down at all or make it hard and crunchy. It has a lovely, light, fresh scent though it doesn't last long at all in my hair.

This spray contains some great ingredients for hair. Its free of many ingredients that are NOT good for hair. I only need 3-4 spray's worth to sufficiently take care of my roots and the rest of my thick, shoulder length hair. 2 bottles come in a pack are will last me a LONG time. The price is definitely reasonable and I absolutely recommend Wavy Baby!

title: Magic in a Bottle
text:
This is a very special serum. Its magic in a bottle. It really is.

The Dewy Serum is the first TATCHA product I've ever heard of or tried. As I applied my first ever pump's worth of the light, milky cream, it felt wonderful. By the time absorption took place (a matter of minutes) I didn't have to touch my skin to feel how soft and smooth the serum had made it. I could just feel the change. As if by magic, plumping occurred right away, erasing the smallest of my fine lines and greatly reducing the larger lines in size. All with the very first use.

TATCHA is lightly scented and smells wonderful though it isn't long lasting at all.

For the first time ever, I have dewy skin and it is due to this wonderful, magical serum. I literally become happy when its time to apply TATCHA; I love the changes it has brought to my skin. Normally, the price would be out of my spending range. But this is an absolute MUST-HAVE product for me. The results are wonderful and long-lasting and it really makes my skin look and feel GOOD.

VERY highly recommended!

title: Fantastic Day Cream
text: When I ordered Yangu's day cream, I didn't realize it is meant for women of color.  Though I now know, that hasn't stopped me from using it daily. Its a fantastic day cream.  It applies beautifully and absorbs quickly leaving skin silky and soft. Its lightweight and doesn't weigh heavily on skin.  Protects and moisturizes skin all day long. My skin is dry and sensitive. I don't have to reapply this a second time like I do with some other creams. It really feels wonderful and helps skin look wonderful as well.  I love the scent though it doesn't last very long.  (I can no longer detect it once the cream has absorbed)

title: Works So Well, Conditioner Isn't Necessary
text:
This is the second W2 Why Wait product I've tested and I'll tell you something...I'm quickly becoming a huge fan of this brand. Their cucumber + aloe vera gel is phenomenal and now that I've tested it, the apple shampoo is pretty awesome too. I used an amount roughly the size of a nickel to sufficiently cover my thick, shoulder length hair. Its nice and creamy...lathers nicely and is easy to work into hair. Rinses without issue. Hair is left wonderfully soft and shiny...smooth and free of frizz. I've not used it long enough to notice a decrease in grey hair (I very recently colored my roots also) so I cannot comment how well it works on greys. But I haven't had to remove much hair from the shower drain or hairbrush so it is helping to strengthen my hair. The shampoo has a nice, crisp, light apple scent that I do very much like but its not long lasting.

This is an excellent shampoo for all hair types. Contains some awesome ingredients for hair health. A shampoo has to be REALLY good for me to say I would use it alone and skip the conditioner. ( I'm a hair conditioner fanatic. ) This is one of the few shampoos I can say that about.

title: Wonderful Overnight Mask That Delivers Results
text:
An overnight , leave-in hair mask that can be used on damp, towel dried hair or dry hair. I tried it both ways and it works great either way though I think I prefer it a bit more on dry hair. Just a few pump's worth worked into hair before bed is all it takes. (avoid the root area) In the morning, hair is soft and shiny. It looks and feels nice fresh. It is not weighed down and does not look oily/greasy. The mask has a wonderful scent though by morning, it is pretty much gone, unfortunately.

I love this mask. It delivers results and works great. Because I only use 2 pumps' worth, the bottle will last me quite some time. I do find the price reasonable. Definitely recommended

title: Love It. Love Everything About It!
text: I missed using sunscreen on my arm in a few spots and wound up with some sunburn.  It wasn't agonizing but I did feel it.  The instant i applied some W2 Why Wait aloe + cucumber gel on the spots, I no longer felt the burn. That's how fast this amazing gel works.  Its a nice, light gel that absorbs in a matter of minutes and feels wonderful. Its cool ,crisp and refreshing.  I love to use it on my face. It softens, hydrates adn moisturizes beautifully.  My husband uses it on his 'alligator' elbows and it works wonders. He also used it on the numerous mosquito bites he got while fishing (that's the only thing he brought home...mosquito bites...no  fish! lol) and it put an end to his itching. He didn't even have to reapply the gel, it was one application only and the bites stopped itching.  It is scented and I find the scent to be phenomenal. Unfortunately, it fades quickly.  The gel is not sticky nor does it weigh heavily on skin. I love everything about it, especially the aloe/cucumber duo. I've only tried a few aloe gels and experienced great results with each and every one. But W2 is the best, hands down. Because the gel can be used for a variety of reasons, the container is huge, a little goes a long way, its fast acting and has fabulous ingredients in addition to the aloe/cucumber, its absolutely worth every single penny of the price. This is a keeper in my house . I will continue to use/purchase W2.  Its that good.

title: Nice and Durable: They Work Great!
text:
These are great, durable ponytail holders that keep my hair in place, even when I'm exercising and working up a sweat. They don't slide and strands of hair don't pop out all over. They are nice and comfortable and don't pull hair while putting in/removing. Elasticity is good; they don't lose their shape or become stretched out. Thankfully, they keep hair crease-free. I love the variety of colors.

ILTUY ponytail holders are perfect for those with long and/or thick hair. They're great quality and I find the price reasonable and fair. Should you have an issue, ILTUY offers a 100% satisfaction solution.

Recommended!

title: An Exceptional Lotion for Those W/Dry, Sensitive Skin
text:
Lubriderm is a 'must-have' for anyone with dry, sensitive skin. The instant this lotion touches my damaged skin, I get relief. Just like that. The itching and burning is immediately soothed. Like throwing water on a fire. Best part is, it stays that way all day long and I don't have to reapply it. Once and done. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave an oily /greasy feeling behind.

My skin isn't too bad right now but the colder months are rapidly approaching. Between the dryness in the house due to the furnace running 24/7 and the cold temps outside, my skin takes a HUGE beating in the cold months. Looks/feels like I have a bad sunburn...that's how dry my skin gets in the cold months. And those darn little cracks I get on my fingers. They may be small but the pain can be excruciating. I'm very relieved to have Lubriderm Advanced Therapy on hand to get me through the cold. In fact, the entire family will benefit from Lubriderm lotion. The price is reasonable and worth every penny because this lotion WORKS.

title: Does a Nice Job w/Curl Control
text: Kavella Defining Cream is a nice cream used as a styler for blowouts and curl control. I use it for curl control.  It doesn't weigh my hair down or make it look or feel oily/greasy.  Keeps my natural waves soft and smooth while preventing frizz. And those results are long lasting.  It is unscented.  Overall, a good cream that delivers results. The price is reasonable.

title: A Must-Have for My Skin
text:
As I dispensed a pump's worth of the cream for the first time, my first thought was 'Elmers Glue'. lololol. That's what the cream reminded me of. Don't worry, its NOTHING like the glue! This is a wonderful night cream. One pump's worth is all it takes to cover my face. (It can also be applied to the neck) It applies easily and absorbs quickly without leaving skin oily, greasy or feeling heavy. (and definitely not sticky like glue! lol) Skin is immediately softened and moisturized and stays that way for some time. Helps to reduce signs of anti-aging and really makes my skin feel and look good. I have dry, sensitive skin and this is the perfect night cream for my troubled skin. It does have a VERY light scent which I find to be kind of medicinal. But it really doesn't bother me, its pretty much gone by the time the cream is absorbed. (For that reason, I will not deduct stars from my score...not going to penalize it for something that goes away quickly)

I love how quickly this cream works. I love how long it works. I love the results it brings. I love the ingredients and the ingredients it does NOT contain. And I love the price. An exceptional night cream at a more than reasonable price. Since only one pump's worth is needed daily, this bottle will last me a LONG time! I absolutely recommend this for everyone but especially those with sensitive skin!

title: Does a Nice Job of Cleansing, Exfoliating and Brightening
text:
The directions state the pads should be used in the evening after cleansing. And that is precisely how I use the pads. But imagine my surprise the first time I tried a (re)fresh Bright Peel Pad. I had just washed my face moments earlier. After wiping it and my forehead with a pad, I was shocked to see how dirty the used pad was. I had literally washed my face only moments earlier yet the pad was dirty. Just goes to show regular facial cleansing isn't getting my skin as clean as it should be! The pads are soft and gentle. They're already soaking in the product so there is no mixing/adding products involved. It takes about 30 minutes or so for the product to fully absorb. Until it does, my skin feels only damp; doesn't feel oily, greasy or heavy, just damp. The pads do a nice job of deep cleaning and exfoliating while brightening my skin a bit and eliminating red, uneven patches.

There is a notice on the jar stating it is normal to have a 'slight tingling sensation' after using the pad. I have dry, sensitive skin and experience no tingling, burning itching or irritation of any kind.

These pads do a nice job. They really do. Though they work well and quickly and have some really great ingredients, they're out of my price range. For this reason I have no plans to purchase more. If money isn't an issue, I definitely recommend these cleansing pads.

(photo is what the pad looked like after I tried it for the first time)

title: Works Well to Preserve Color
text:
