This conditioner does a nice job of protecting color, allowing it to last longer without fading or becoming dull. It also does a nice job of softening and smoothing hair while taming frizz and flyaways. I did still have some tangles in my hair though they were easy to comb through.

There is a nice scent but it doesn't last long.

All in all, this is a pretty good conditioner for those with color treated hair. I do think its worth the price.

title: There's Not One Thing I Don't Like About This Cream
text:
I can't find one thing wrong with Bliss' Drench and Quench Cream to Water Hydrator. Love everything about it. Its so lightweight. A little goes a very long way thanks to the cream to water consistency. Absorption is pretty fast but hydration is instant; as soon as its applied, skin immediately becomes softer and hydrated. And it stays that way, even with my dry, sensitive skin.

I'm a huge fan of hyaluronic acid. But I had no clue there is more than one type! Drench and Quench contains 4 different hyaluronic acids. Equally impressive is what it does NOT contain...1300+ harmful ingredients.

There is a very pleasant, light , fresh scent. Doesn't last long. I can no longer detect it once the cream is absorbed. The cream is a pretty shade of blue.

I was so surprised by the price. In light of the great ingredients, the ingredients NOT included and the quick , lasting results the price is very reasonable. Actually, I find it to be on the low side. This is a phenomenal cream and I highly recommend it.

title: One Heck of a Shampoo!
text:
I had no clue goat milk was beneficial to hair and was very much looking forward to trying Legend's Creek Farm Herbal Shampoo with all natural goat milk. Let me tell you, this is one heck of a fantastic shampoo! It lathers well and does so quickly. Its lightweight and creamy; feels nice while cleansing hair. No issues rinsing it. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look or feel oily or greasy. It softens, hydrates and moisturizes my hair as well as any conditioner. It adds bounce and shine, something my hair normally lacks.

I wash my hair daily. This shampoo is gentle enough for daily use. Its also gentle enough for children and babies and those with sensitive skin (myself included!) It is scent free. I need an amount roughly the size of a nickel to sufficiently clean my thick, shoulder length hair. Because I need only a very small amount of shampoo, the wonderful ingredients and the fast results, I find the price reasonable. This is a fabulous shampoo and I love what it does for my hair.

title: Nice, Nourishing Cream
text:
Infinitek Paris is a lovely night cream that is easy to apply and absorbs quickly without causing skin to look or feel oily/greasy. It comes in a nice jar with a pump for dispensing. Packed with skin nourishing ingredients such as: hyaluronic acid, macadamia, aloe, jojoba, sunflower oil, it also contains Retinol. I have dry, sensitive skin and have tried other products in the past containing Retinol, some of which I had to discontinue using due to having a reaction. I have no problem with this cream, though I only use a small amount.

There is a light scent that smells very nice though it fades quickly.

Infinitek softens and smooths my skin while I sleep. It does a nice job of plumping so my fine lines are noticeably reduced. I like the results I receive, I like the ingredients as well. I even like the handy built in pump! Recommended

title: Love This Conditioner
text:
Now that its summertime I'm spending a lot of time outdoors in the sun and pool. My hair is taking a beating . DOVE's Hair Therapy Hydration Spa conditioner works wonders on dry, damaged hair; mine included. It dispenses easily from the pump and 2-3 pump's worth sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. I keep it on for 5-10 minutes before rinsing. It rinses easily and doesn't weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. When my hair dries (I air dry) its rehydrated, soft and shiny. It actually has bounce to it, something it normally lacks. Rather than becoming frizzy ,something it normally does, especially in heat/humid temps it stays nice and smooth.

There is a nice, mild scent to this conditioner but it fades quickly.

Free of parabens. Contains hyaluronic serum.

This conditioner delivers results with the very first use. Its wonderful. For a minute, I actually dreaded looking at the price. I knew this was a conditioner I wanted to continue to use but figured it would cost a small fortune since it works so well and at 33.8oz, the bottle is big. Nope. The price is extremely reasonable! Can be used on all hair types. This is a keeper for me!

title: Awesome Product /Great Size!
text:
This item is for 12-3oz. bottles of TRESemme hair conditioner. I actually received 6-3oz bottles of TRESemme conditioner and 6-3oz bottles of TRESemme shampoo. I've been a fan of TRESemme products for quite some time now. Years and years. These are salon quality products at drug store prices. My hair always looks nice and fresh after using TRESemme...especially the various conditioners!

These small trial size bottles are just perfect for travel. And I'll be doing just that in a few days...traveling! Going away for a quick, mini vacation. Rather than having to pack full size shampoo and conditioner bottles (I wash my hair daily), now I can just pack a trial size bottle of each and I'm good to go. I'll have plenty of both product to carry me through while I'm away. The bottles are nice and sturdy, I don't have to worry about them breaking/exploding in my overnight bag.

In addition to travel, bottles this size are also perfect to fit in a purse, school/gym locker, RV, college dorm.

This is a great deal...I do find the price reasonable for such quality products. Absolutely recommended.

title: I'm Not Terribly Impressed...
text:
I'm just not blown away by this cleanser. I don't know if there is something wrong with mine. I watched the 10 second video at the top of the page. In it, one pump on the nozzle and out comes the cleanser. I can't get the cleanser out via the nozzle, its far too thick. I must remove the nozzle in order to get to it. I've not experienced any type of calming my mind or spiritual balance. However, it does feel nice on my skin even with the thick consistency. It does a very nice job of cleansing and refreshing my skin while also making it soft and smooth. It also soothes the small patches of eczema and helps to stop the itch.

There is a scent...its so-so. But I'm not factoring that into my overall score of the product seeing as the scent fades quickly and isn't long lasting.

Its a decent enough cleanser but not one I would purchase. I find it priced on the high side seeing as there are other cleansers out there that do just as much but are priced far lower.

title: One Heck of a Mask!
text:
The first thing that impressed me about the Paon Rose Plump-kin-Paya Masque (cute name!) was the packaging. Its packaged VERY well for shipping. But that's not all. Its like opening a gift. The jar is nicely wrapped in decorative paper, the box is just nice and neat. Feels almost like a friend sent a lovely gift. A nice, personalized touch. Very thoughtful.

What impressed me next was the 2 page, typed out instructions /information about the product. I love that I didn't have to hunt down my glasses and try to read tiny print on the side of a jar. Everything I needed to know about this masque is typed out and explained in detail. I appreciate that.

I love how easy this is to use. A thin layer of the mask on the face (avoid eye contact!) is all that's needed. Due to rich, powerful ingredients in the mask, its not necessary to pile it on. A thin and even layer only. The mask can remain on for 5-10 minutes but no longer than 15. I keep it on for 15 minutes then rinse it off using lukewarm water, followed by a moisturizing cream. Now here's the part that really surprised me. The mask should only be used EVERY 10 DAYS! The reason being (this is straight from the instruction list), 'Because of its high concentration of enzymes, vitamins, and amino acids, the mask is not designed for everyday use. It is best to use it every 10 days or more'. That goes to show you right there how powerful and nutrient-rich this mask is!

So what does it do? It immediately makes skin soft and smooth. Pores are reduced in size. (I noticed that immediately after I rinsed it off the first time I used it) Fine lines become finer. I wouldn't say my skin glows from this but it IS helping to brighten it which is nice because I am terribly fair skinned and always pale with dull-ish looking skin. The brightening helps me look a bit more...alive and healthy. The pumpkin ingredient helps to reduce UV damage to skin while also helping with elasticity.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no negative reactions to using this mask. There are no artificial dyes or scents added.

A small applicator brush is also included. I prefer to use my fingers to apply the mask.

This is a great product. Love everything about it from the results to the packaging, to the printed instructions. The price is reasonable to begin with but when you factor in only using this every 10 days, that makes the price VERY reasonable. I absolutely recommend this mask. You and your skin deserve it! Per the printed instructions if you are dissatisfied for any reason, Paon Rose wants you to email them so they can address your concerns. They also add if you have questions to email them as well. This is a company that clearly believes in customer satisfaction and stands by their products! And I am a new fan!

title: Fantastic 3 Piece Set-Does Great Things for Skin
text:
I've always known watermelon is delicious and how much I love the taste. But I had NO clue of the benefits it has for skin care. This Glow Recipe gift set includes 3 awesome watermelon based skin care products that deliver great results.

-watermelon glow PHA + BHA pore tight toner: Its nice and gentle, but don't worry...it does a fabulous job of exfoliating -a deep exfoliation to cleanse pores and remove dead skin cells. Pore size is noticeably reduced. It also helps to tighten and tone. Feels nice when applied; no burning, itching or irritation of any kind on my sensitive skin

-watermelon glow pink juice moisturizer: A lightweight, lovely moisturizer that applies easily to skin. A little goes a LONG way. Absorption is fast. Skin is left well hydrated/moisturized and nice and smooth. Very refreshing.

-watermelon glow niacinamide dew drops: I have VERY fair skin. These drops help to bring a bit of brightness to my skin, something it normally lacks. Helps me look not so pale.

All 3 products have a nice watermelon scent. It doesn't last very long. Each product is in a nice bottle suitable for keeping out on a bathroom counter. All 3 dispense easily.

This is a wonderful 3 piece set. All 3 products work wonders on skin. I do believe the price is reasonable. This is worthy of gift giving. Recommended

title: What a Cleanser~!
text:
What a fantastic cleanser this is! Its light and creamy and feels nice when applying. It doesn't lather much at all; its not supposed to. Though gentle, it does a great job of cleansing , exfoliating and removing makeup and bacteria. Skin is left feeling and looking fresh and light. And boy, does it ever soften and hydrate skin...to the point I don't have to use a moisturizing cream!

There is no scent, at least none I detect. I even removed the nozzle and sniffed the open bottle and didn't smell anything.

Two pump's worth is all I need to clean my face. This bottle will last quite some time. This is a cleanser I will buy and continue to use. Love the results and freshness it delivers.

title: Fast, Lasting Results
text:
Head Wear's Supercharged conditioner is a great leave-in spray that really is lightweight. Just a few sprays worth on my thick, shoulder length damp hair detangles it while hydrating and softening. It helps keep frizz away and allows my natural waves to stay wavy and smooth. And it keeps it that way for a good amount of time. There is no greasy/oily look or feel to my hair and the leave in doesn't weigh it down.

There is a hint of a scent with this spray that's nice and refreshing but fades very quickly from my hair.

At 4oz, the bottle is a nice size and fits in a purse, gym locker, suitcase, etc nicely.

This is a great leave -in that delivers results with the very first use. Suitable for all hair types. Because it works so well and so quickly and since only a few sprays worth is needed on my hair (the bottle will last me quite some time) I do find the price reasonable. I do recommend Head Wear's leave-in conditioner.

title: Does What It Promises to Do
text:
I wanted to try House of Dear's Volumizing Tonic for the volume boost at the roots but mainly for the light texture control on wavy hair. It does deliver some volume around the root area which pleased me as that is where I'm experiencing some hair thinning due to aging. The tonic helped make it less noticeable. I really like using it on my natural waves. Its so hot and humid here and my hair normally turns into a frizzy mess. This keeps my waves nice and smooth and in place and does a great job of preventing frizz.

Hair is not weighed down or made to look /feel oily or greasy after using this. There is a pleasant scent but it fades quickly in my hair.

I'm happy with the results this delivers. It does what it promises to do. My one issue -which isn't a huge deal-the sprayer /trigger for the bottle arrived broken in pieces. Had to put the product in a mist bottle. Hardly a tragedy and not something I will deduct from my overall product rating, but perhaps it could be protected better when packaged for shipping? Good product, good ingredients, good results. Recommended.

title: Great. Well-Priced Overnight Cream
text:
What a wonderful night cream this is! On the thick side, yet easy to apply; a little goes a long way. Absorption is fast as are results. In the morning when get out of bed and get ready to start the day, my skin is incredibly soft and smooth. Hydration lasts throughout the day, even in excessive heat and humidity. I see a reduction in my fine lines and that's always a good thing!

I've not yet noticed an improvement to my skin's elasticity but I've also not been using this very long.

There is a light scent that pretty much vanishes once the cream has been absorbed.

I love the ingredients in H &B, mainly the Hyaluronic acid, caviar extract and especially the Dead Sea minerals. This is a great night cream , very reasonably priced. Recommended

title: It Really Does Resurrect Hair!
text:
'Resurrecting Rinse' is the perfect name for this conditioner because it does just that. It resurrects hair. This is a nice, on the thin side conditioner. A small amount roughly the size of a half dollar sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. Its easy to apply to hair and just as to rinse. My hair is left detangled, soft, bouncy and with shine, something it normally lacks. Its terribly hot and humid here. This conditioner does a wonderful job of keeping my hair from turning into a frizzy mess like it normally does in extreme weather.

Lots of great ingredients in this conditioner! There is a scent and I have to say, as soon as the bottle arrived I took the nozzle out to smell it. And I was less than impressed by the scent. I didn't care for it. But when I actually used it for the first time, I liked the way my hair smelled! Its a different scent; I say that in a good way. Unfortunately, it didn't last very long. (That could just be my hair...doesn't hold scents of hair products well)

I love how my hair looks and feels after using this. It looks and feels great! Like I just stepped out of a salon. It has brought my hair back to life and right now being outside in the summertime heat/humidity as well as swimming almost daily, my hair needs Resurrection Rinse more than ever! Because it does what it promises to do (and does so with the first use!), only a little is needed at a time and it provides lasting results, I do believe its worth the price. Recommended!

title: Works Great, Affordable Price
text: I'm a huge fan of hemp products.  And Annabis Cremcann Hemp face cream is no exception. But, I also love that it contains other ingredients including almond oil, shea oil, hyaluronic acid (a fave of mine!), lavender, sandalwood and beeswax.  Together, these ingredients come together to make a great cream that does a wonderful job of softening, hydrating and reviving skin. Though a thick cream, it absorbs pretty quickly and doesn't cause skin to look or feel oily/greasy.  Its easy to apply and a little goes a long way. There is a faint scent which is pleasant though it fades fast.  It can be used as a night cream (this is how I use it) or under makeup as well.  The price is reasonable for the job it does. Recommended

title: Salon Quality at Drug Store Price
text:
This is a salon quality conditioner at a drug store price! Karseell Conditioner is packed with amazing, high quality ingredients. Its easy to work into hair...a little goes a very long way. I need only a small amount to sufficiently cover my thick, shoulder length hair. And its jsut as easy to rinse out. It immediately detangles hair, delivers a ton of moisture...long lasting moisture. Keeps my natural waves nice and smooth while preventing frizz in the summertime heat and humidity. My hair was terribly dry from being in the sun/swimming in a chlorinated pool. Karseell did a beautiful job of helping to fix the damage and rehydrate. The UV protection is exactly what I need right now!

Has a lovely scent though it doesn't last very long. (At least not in my hair...for whatever reason, my hair usually doesn't hold the scent from hair products very long)

I'm impressed with Karseell for a number of reasons. It does everything it promises to do and does so quickly. Not much conditioner is needed to get those great results so this bottle is going to last me for a decent amount of time. And to top it off, its VERY reasonably priced. Quite honestly, i find the price on the low side for all that it does! Should you find this isn't the conditioner for you, Karseell offers a return/refund policy! This is a company that stands by its products and truly wants their customers happy! (I was hoping to find a leave-in conditioner by Karseell but didn't see one on their Amazon page. Hopefully that will become available at some point. )

Definitely recommended

title: My New Leave-In
text:
I've been using a name brand coconut leave-in spray for years. I had a nice supply stocked up in the bathroom closet. The other day I realized I was rapidly working my way to the end of a bottle but when I went to get another from the bathroom, I had none left. I used them all. I went online to buy more only to find the product is no longer available! However, all is well thanks to Amir Coconut Leave-In spray! Its a great replacement for my prior to product. A few sprays worth on my damp hair immediately removes tangles, softens and hydrates. It does so without weighing my hair down or making it look oily/greasy. My natural waves dry (I air dry) well and free of flyaways. Also adds a bit of shine to my hair, something I normally lack.

There is a light scent that smells great but isn't long lasting.

Looks like I've found my new coconut leave in spray. I'm more than pleased and satisfied with Amir!

title: A Trio of Amazing Products
text:
A perfect trifecta of skin care products! YADAH's Cactus Skin Care Kit consists of 3 fantastic products containing minimal but wonderful skin loving ingredients. We all know how awesome aloe vera is. As great as it is, prickly pear cactus contains 5x's more Vitamin A and C than aloe vera. All 3 products in this kit consist of at least 87% prickly pear extract making each so very beneficial to skin.

The toner pads (60) are in a container, soaking in the toner. Perfect to use as a makeup remover, toner,
or cleanser. Can also be used as a mask for 'problem areas'.

Soothing gel is perfect for after-sun care. It can also be used all over the body to deliver lasting moisture to skin. It absorbs quickly and without stickiness. Even soothes inflammation caused by eczema. Feels very refreshing and hydrating. Gentle enough for children. As recommended, I keep it in the fridge and it feels better when cold.

The 3rd bottle contains more toner. Does a beautiful job of softening, moisturizing and exfoliating. A spray nozzle is included making this perfect to use when overheated or if skin needs some freshening.

The results delivered by each product not only occur quickly but are also long lasting. None of the 3 products affects my dry, sensitive skin in a negative way. I'm new to the prickly pear ingredient and am loving it. I do find this amazing kit to be reasonably priced and recommend it.

title: Strong and Durable-Such Pretty Colors and Designs
text:
I own a lot of hair clips. I must say, SOPHISTICATEE's small hair claw clips have the prettiest colors and designs! They're so colorful and unique, I just love them.

These are the perfect size . Many times I pull smaller sections of hair back into a clip and these work very well for me. They stay in place and no hair comes out of the clip. Opening them is easy, just a light pinch and they open right up.

They're very sturdy and can hold my shoulder length, thick hair without issue.

I did have a small issue with one of the clips. I sent SOPHISTICATEE a message and received a response/necessary info I needed within 30 minutes time. I was able to resolve the issue thanks to the info they provided me. Excellent customer service.

Such cute, colorful clips! I find the price reasonable and recommend them.

title: Fast Acting and SO Many Uses
text:
We've been using Bee Magic All-Purpose Balm pretty much nonstop since it arrived. I originally ordered it for my husband to use after shaving and he does. But we've also used it on sunburn, bug bites, patches of dry skin, a sore arm and as a facial moisturizer. Bee Magic is easy to apply; a little goes a very long way. Absorption does take a few minutes but once it occurs, skin is not left greasy. I used it on some patches of sunburn where I missed using sunscreen and in the instant it came in contact with my skin, the sunburn was instantly soothed and calmed. Felt wonderful! Took the sting and itch out of mosquito bites immediately as well. And it does a fabulous job of softening and moisturizing not only facial skin but rough elbows and dry, cracked feet.

This is scented and I absolutely LOVE it. It does fade fairly quickly ,however.

Take a minute to look over the list of 100% all natural ingredients listed above. Its quite an impressive list and the reason why this balm delivers impressive, fast results! I believe the price is reasonable. Without a doubt, I absolutely recommend Bee Magic. Should you find its not right for you, Wood Pals, the company that makes this magical balm offers a full money back guarantee!

title: Turns Back Time and Brings Back my 'Untouched' Hair
text:
What a phenomenal hair elixir! Coco & Eve's Miracle Hair Elixir does what it promises to do. It made my hair look and feel as it did many, many years ago, before I used hair dye, hair spray, had sun damage. Before I wreaked havoc on my hair. And it only takes a few drops to do so.

This can be used on damp or dry hair. Coco & Eve recommends using this one of 3 ways:

-At nighttime before bed, rub a few drops into hair for a hydrating treatment

-Rub a few drops on damp hair to protect from heat (protects to 220C/428F) and for prestyling

-Rub a few drops into hair after its been styled

I applied a few drops into newly washed, damp hair. I normally do not blow dry my hair so I cannot comment as to how it works in that regards. But I still used some on damp hair and once my hair dried, it was SO unbelievably soft and smooth. And it stayed that way. No flyaways, no frizz.

I prefer to use this once my hair has been styled. I rub a few drops' between my hands and then into my hair. It does NOT weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily greasy. It adds a wonderful fullness and incredible shine my hair normally lacks. It keeps my natural waves in place, nice and smooth while combatting frizz, especially impressive now since its so hot and humid here. The softness it brings to my hair is just wonderful. My hair looks and feels untouched...as though its never ever been damaged!

There is a scent and its light and lovely. It doesn't last long in my hair, unfortunately. I wish it did.

This really is a 'miracle' elixir. It turns back time and restores my 'virgin', untouched hair. For all of the results this delivers, I find the price absolutely reasonable. I absolutely recommend it.

title: A Fabulous Leave-In
text:
MANE CLUB's One Hit Wonder 10-in-1 Leave-In spray is an exceptional leave-in! I'd never heard of this brand prior to trying this for the first time and wasn't quite sure what to expect. I'm so pleased with this leave-in, I've already purchased MANE CLUB's Wave Texture spray as well!

This leave-in smells good. Has a nice, musky scent to it though it's not long lasting at all. (At least not in my hair where hair product scents usually don't last very long for whatever reason) Its lightweight, doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel oily or greasy. I've only used it on damp, newly washed hair but it can also be used on dry hair. I spray about 4-5 pumps worth on my thick, shoulder length hair. It detangles, softens and smooths hair immediately. When my hair dries (I air dry), my natural waves are nice and fresh and free of fly-aways and frizz, especially impressive since its been so hot and humid here recently. I do notice less hair in the brush since using this leave-in.

I allow my hair to air dry so I cannot comment firsthand as to the heat protection this delivers but it does protect to temps of 445 degrees F/230 degrees C.

I'm a new and huge fan of MANE CLUB! This is a wonderful leave-in and the price is incredibly reasonable, especially since its packed with great ingredients. (huge fan of cannabis sativa seed-my hair responds well to it) I'm SO excited to try the wave texture spray as well! Absolutely recommended~!

title: Great, Re-usable Sponges-Lots of Uses
text:
Siluker's 50 count compressed facial sponges are so handy and have so many great qualities. Don't worry when you first see them. Each sponge is compressed and flat. When you're ready to use, simply hold one under water and in a few seconds, it will decompress into a thin, round facial sponge. (2.9” in diameter x 0.32” in thickness after decompressed)

These are perfect to use when cleansing your face, removing makeup, applying toner, applying acne cream, etc. They're nice and soft and gentle on the skin. (even baby skin!) Best of all, they can be reused, are biodegradable and can be used on all skin types.

Due to their compact size, they're perfect to take along when traveling, fit in a purse, gym locker, etc. I keep mine in a small bowl on the bathroom counter.

Thanks to all of the great qualities, 50 resusable sponges come in a pack, I find the cost more than reasonable. This is an excellent deal. Definitely recommended!

title: Fast, Long Lasting Results
text:
This was my first experience with birch juice and let me tell you, it does wonders for my dry, sensitive skin!

Enature's Birch Juice Hydro cream is nice and lightweight. (reminds me of vanilla Greek yogurt!) Its easy to apply and a little goes a long way. It feels nice the instant it touches my skin, especially the red, inflamed areas due to eczema. Absorption is quick but not instant. No sticky/greasy/oily look or feel is left behind, only soft, smooth, soothed skin. Skin is left well hydrated as well. And these results are long lasting.

I have no adverse reactions to this product.

There is no scent to this cream.

I'm impressed with the fast results and the fact they're long-lasting. This is an exceptional cream and its priced incredibly well for all that it does. This is a cream I'll use again.

Highly recommended

title: Great Results Beginning With the First Use
text: This is a wonderful, lightweight gel that doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look oily or greasy.  A small amount (a tad smaller than a penny) sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair.  It leaves my hair nice and soft...and even adds a bit of bounce to my hair while keeping it smooth and frizz free.  The frizz free part is especially impressive because the heat and humidity here has been awful lately but 007 Keratin helped keep it calm and smooth.  There is a nice, light scent though its not long lasting. I do not know the price of this but I can say it works great and delivers results with the very first use!

title: Works Great, Love the Choice of 3  Hold Types Feature
text:
When it comes to hairspray, I've never seen anything like Nuuvo's 3 in 1. Nuuvo gives you the option to choose from 3 different holds, light , medium and heavy; all from the same can! The top of the can surrounding the nozzle is labeled, 'L', 'M' and 'H'. Simply turn the nozzle to your preferred hold level and you're good to go. The hairspray itself does a great job of keeping hair in place without making it sticky, gummy or hard and crunchy. Does a nice job of adding volume as well. I can run my fingers through my hair after spraying it and it stays in place. It also holds up well in humidity. It's been incredibly hot and humid here and Nuuvo does a really nice job of preventing my hair from turning into a frizzy mess.

There is a scent and its light and pleasant though it does fade quickly. (At least in my hair it fades quickly...for whatever reason, my hair rarely holds scented hair care products)

This is a clean hairspray, plant -based and doesn't contain any ingredients that are proven to irritate, dry out or amplify hair problems.

I use the highest hold level and still don't need to use much to sufficiently handle my thick, shoulder length hair. Because you can choose your hold level ( making it unnecessary to buy multiple cans of hairspray with different hold levels), it works well and has good, clean ingredients, I do believe the price of this hairspray is reasonable. It can be used on all hair types.

I absolutely recommend Nuuvo hairspray.

title: Not the Right Mask for My Skin
text:
I'm just not blown away by this clay mask. Its easy to apply and doesn't irritate my dry, sensitive skin at all. It definitely does a nice job of reducing my pores; its a noticeable reduction. My skin does feel nice and fresh after using this. But I don't really experience 'radiant' skin. And it doesn't calm my inflamed areas very much.

I was hoping I'd love this clay mask seeing as its packed with nutrients and minerals. For whatever reason, it just didn't jive well with my skin. Perhaps its too dry/sensitive.

I have no plans to continue using this mask. My overall rating is 2.5 stars.

title: Wonderful Results...(be patient, it takes time!)
text:
I really didn't think Nulastin was going to work for me. I used ((and continue to ) it as instructed and noticed no difference. In fact, I almost quit altogether. But I kept using it. And now, the thinning hair around my scalp area is SLOWLY filling in! Though small to begin with , the visible patches of my head that could be seen around the thinning hair are no longer quite so visible. Unlike hair thickening shampoos, conditioners, leave-ins, etc, these results are not short lived! Quite the opposite. Slowly but surely, my hair thinning issue continues to improve. I'm amazed and grateful.

I will continue to use Nulastin. Its not cheap but its worth every penny of the price. Should you find you're not satisfied, Nulastin offers a 100% customer satisfaction guarantee ; either exchange the product or a refund of your purchase price (less shipping/handling) . If you need some help with thinning/balding issues, I absolutely recommend giving this a try. Instructions are simple to follow.

title: Does What It Promises to Do
text:
This is one heck of a facial serum! I apply a few drops after I've used toner on my face. It absorbs quickly and doesn't cause my skin to look or feel oily, sticky or greasy. Immediately after applying, skin is soft and smooth. Small fine lines are no longer visible. Larger fine lines are greatly reduced in size. I have a few small saggy areas that are firming up because of this awesome serum.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues with this serum.

The ingredient list is impressive. They work together to make this a wonderful serum with excellent results that are achieved quickly. and long lasting. The price is more than reasonable. Recommended

title: An Amazing Conditioner...(used it 1x and already ordered another bottle!)
text:
So far, I've used this conditioner ONE time and I've already ordered a second bottle! How I LOVE LOVE LOVE it! Its on the thin side and lightweight. A little goes a LONG way. Easy to apply and rinse from hair. Detangles my hair beautifully and leaves it soft, smooth and shiny. My natural waves look great after using Rooted Rituals and my hair has bounce to it, something it normally lacks. Even in the horrible heat and humidity we're experiencing right now, my hair does not turn into a frizzy mess after using this like it usually does.

What a beautiful scent this conditioner has. And it actually lasts in my hair. This normally is NOT the case. My hair rarely keeps a hair product's scent very long.

Following the first use, I immediately knew i wanted to order another bottle. But I was kind of dreading coming to the Amazon page to do so because I assumed the price would be a small fortune seeing as it delivered exceptional results. I was FLOORED (in a good way!!!) when I saw the incredibly low price! I immediately purchased another bottle.

I literally love everything about this conditioner. From the results it delivered, to the scent and of course, the low price. The ingredients are impressive as well! I WILL continue to purchase and use this conditioner. I'm so very impressed by it! I do hope you love it as much as I love it!

title: SO Lightweight. Results Are Immediate
text:
This is the perfect moisturizer for hot and humid days. Don't get me wrong, its wonderful for year round use, but it is especially ideal for warm temperatures. Its incredibly lightweight and airy. It applies beautifully; a little goes a long way. Absorption is fast, leaving no oily/greasy look or feel behind. Skin is immediately hydrated and softened. And it stays that way for a long time! This is a very long lasting moisturizer.

There is a light scent but it fades quickly. The bottle is a nice size and dispenses well. Perfect size for a purse, gym bag, suitcase, etc.

Results are immediate and long lasting, making the price reasonable and fair. Recommended.

title: A Toner, Mask AND Mist! SO Many Uses!
text:
Question: Is ONE THING's Hyaluronic Acid Complex a toner? Is it a mask? A mist?

Answer: Its all 3!

This is an all around fabulous product! I've now used it as all 3: a toner, mask and mist and it works great regardless of how its used. As a toner it helps deep clean and shrink my pores, leaving my skin nice and soft. Fine lines become even finer ; in fact, my smallest, thinnest lines are no longer visible after using this. The larger, thicker lines are greatly reduced. My skin is left nice and soft. As a mask I do as instructed and pour some on to a bamboo makeup pad and allow it to sit on my 'problem area' (cheek) for 10 minutes. The inflammation caused by eczema is reduced greatly as is the burning/itching sensation. I also put a small amount into a mist bottle and use it prior to going outside into the extreme heat/humidity. It keeps my skin moisturized and soft against the harsh elements.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have absolutely NO issues using this. It absorbs quickly and does not make my skin look or feel sticky, oily or greasy.

ONE THING's Hyaluronic Acid Complex is a wonderful skin care product. It has many uses, does an exceptional job and the price is ridiculously low. HIGHLY recommended!

title: Immediate Results
text:
Fantastic facial moisturizer that moisturizes and brightens my skin as soon as its applied. The 'instant glass-skin luminosity' is real and does indeed happen in an instant. My tiny fine lines are not visible, the larger, thicker lines are reduced greatly thanks to skin plumping.

I just love how lightweight the moisturizer is. This is the perfect time of year to use this with all of the heat and humidity. Don't get me wrong, it is for year round use but I especially appreciate the lightweight consistency in the high temps/humidity of summer) Absorption is almost instant and doesn't cause skin to look or feel oily/greasy.

A result of this cream that is not visible? Skin is protected from pollution and blue light.

A light citrusy scent can be detected but it pretty much vanishes once the cream has fully absorbed.

There is a good reason this product is a 'Premium Beauty' Amazon item. For those not familiar, 'Premium Beauty' means, "Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men."

SO many wonderful results and benefits occur with this moisturizer. (I was so impressed after trying it the first time, I made my husband try it. Stupid move on my part, now he uses it daily too! lol. ) And, they're long lasting. A small amount of cream sufficiently covers the face; the bottle will last a decent amount of time. All of these factors make this a facial moisturizer I highly recommend.

title: Delivers Great Results-Smells Wonderful!
text:
I really like the consistency of this conditioner. Its light; almost mousse-like; and easy to work into hair. Doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look or feel oily/greasy. I had no issue working into my hair or rinsing it. It did help to increase my hair's volume a bit while doing a nice job of softening and moisturizing. I was pleased to not have to clean any hair strands out of the drain or hairbrush...it strengthens hair as well.

Does a nice job of protecting my hair color, doesn't cause it to fade quickly.
It has a fantastic scent that I could actually still smell the day after using. Scents typically don't last long in my hair for whatever reason, so to still detect it a day later was pretty impressive to me!

I do experience some hair tangling after using this. Not the end of the world, I simply spray a small amount of coconut leave-in conditioner on my hair that helps detangle. (I use this spray daily , regardless of the shampoo/conditioner I wash my hair with)

Overall, I'm pleased with this conditioner. I do find the price reasonable.

Recommended -my overall rating is actually 4.5 stars (I rounded up)

title: Amazing, FAST Results!
text:
What a wonderful, amazing and fast-working eye cream! In a matter of days, Kona Peptide dramatically reduced the dark circles that have been plaguing me in recent weeks due to stress and insomnia. They're all but gone; barely noticeable. The very small fine lines around my eyes are no longer visible at all. The thicker fine lines have been thinned greatly, making me look-dare I say it-a bit younger than my actual age!

A very small amount of the cream around the eye area once a day delivered these results. I have sensitive skin and do not experience any negative issues from the use of this cream. For those interested in packaging, the cream comes in a pretty box and an even prettier jar.

There is a light scent with this cream. What's kind of weird for me is the fact I do not like the scent of coffee. This cream has a light coffee scent but there is another scent as well that I cannot place. Together, I absolutely LOVE the scent of this eye cream. Its not long-lasting and is light and mild.

I'm so amazed, impressed and happy with this eye cream. Thanks to the fast, amazing results and the fact that only a tiny amount of cream is needed per use, I find the price reasonable. Though a small jar it will last me quite some time. I will continue to use this product and am going to purchase Hanalei's Makai Marine Hawaiian Daily Moisturizer as well! Can't wait to try it!

title: Provides a Myriad of Benefits
text:
The only Julep product I've ever used prior to trying this face polish was Julep's nail polish collection. I love Julep nail polish and was bummed when they discontinued it. It wasn't a huge surprise to learn I like this cleanser as well. It provides a myriad of skin care benefits. It doesn't just clean, it deeply cleans pores while removing dirt/makeup, exfoliating and moisturizing at the same time. My skin is soft, fresh and revived after using this. My pores are noticeably smaller as well.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no issues with this cleanser.

This is an excellent facial cleanser and its reasonably priced.

title: No Improvement at All
text:
My feet get terribly dry and cracked, especially in colder months. Right now, its summertime. My feet aren't too bad but they do have some dryness and cracks. Seeing as I wear sandals and flipflops throughout the summer, I want my feet to look decent. I decided to give Ontel's Genie Feet Exfoliating Foot Cream Peel a try. This isn't the same product as many other foot peels where you wear 'socks' filled with a lotion for some time and a few days later, dead skin can be peeled off of feet. This is a cream that gets massaged into feet until little 'balls' and flakes appear. The cream is then to be washed off, revealing soft, smooth feet. At least that's what is supposed to happen. But for me, it didn't. After the 'balls' and flakes appeared, I cleaned both feet. And they looked pretty much the same as they had prior to use. I used the cream three nights in a row with the same results. No improvement.

My feet remain dry and cracked. I had absolutely no improvement of any kind. Genie Feet Cream didn't work for me and I have no plans to continue using it.

title: Instant Fullness and Volume! (Smells wonderful too!)
text:
After using this for the first time, I immediately logged in to Amazon to order another bottle only to find its not currently available. I hope that status changes SOON! JOICO Hair Shake is a lightweight spray that dries almost immediately. It does not weigh hair down, make it look or feel oily/greasy or hard and crunchy. Results including fullness, increased volume and thickness are instant AND long lasting. It can be used prior to the use of a hot tool and once hair has been styled. (I don't use a hot tool, I only use this once I've finished styling. ) It holds up well, even in hot and humid weather. The scent is phenomenal! How I LOVE the scent. Doesn't last long in my hair, unfortunately. How I wish that it did!

I sure hope this spray becomes available, I'd love to continue using it!

title: A MUST-HAVE For Damaged Hair!
text:
Pinch me, I must be dreaming. I cannot believe what BRAE's Bond Angel Deep Conditioning does for my hair! This treatment is magical. Its easy to use. No instructions were included but I found them here on this page. I followed them exactly as described. (used regular H20, not coconut) When all was said and done, it was as though I had someone else's hair. I honestly could not believe it was MY hair I was seeing in the mirror! My hair was dry, color treated with sun/pool chemical damage when I used Bond Angel. I've used MANY products that did a wonderful job softening my hair. Bond Angel takes softness to an entirely new level. I had no clue hair could be so soft. My blond hair color is now uniform throughout; no uneven tones. My natural waves smooth and perfect, free of flyaways and frizz. It is SO hot and humid here now and my hair normally turns into a frizzy mess . That didn't happen after using Bond Angel. Its been free of frizz for DAYS now! DAYS!!! My hair is nice and full, including the scalp area where its been thinning due to aging. And the shine. My hair does not normally shine. Now, its always shiny since using Bond Angel! I realized today I haven't had to clean hair out of the drain or hairbrush for a few days, its obviously stronger as well.

This is a miracle in a bottle. At least for my hair it has performed miracles! I WILL continue to purchase and use this product. I have to , it does so very much for my hair. (especially during summertime with the added sun/pool damage) Bond Angel is suitable for all hair types. If yours is damaged, this is a MUST-HAVE!

title: Great Shampoo + Conditioner Duo
text:
My husband used to have a big dandruff problem. Over the years, it has improved. Recently, however, his scalp has been itching him and he's starting to see a return of dandruff flakes. He hasn't done anything different to warrant the increase. We're thinking it could be due to the fact the weather here has been hot and humid lately, though neither of us has a clue if that is a valid reason for the return of itching/flakes. At any rate, I ordered him FIORA's Tea Tree shampoo + conditioner. Both bottles are 16oz size. They arrive with caps on but 2 pumps are included which is a nice bonus and very much appreciated. He RARELY uses hair conditioner but he is using both shampoo and conditioner and on a daily basis. Both have pleasant scents (though not long lasting) and are easily to work into hair and just as easy to rinse from hair. His hair is not weighed down and does not look or feel oily/greasy by either product. When his hair dries (he air dries), his natural curls are nice and his hair shines. (I'm so jealous of this...mine rarely shines! lol) He especially likes the conditioner; he says when he works it into his hair, his itchy scalp is immediately soothed and calmed. He experiences no burning sensation even in the areas he'd been scratching.

I did order this set for him but I also tried it. I don't have a dandruff issue but I liked the ingredients (rosemary, lavender , peppermint) and loved the way the conditioner especially felt while sitting on my hair for a few minutes. When my hair dried, it was soft and tangle free. My natural waves and curls looked nice and were smooth adn without flyaways.

This is a great shampoo + conditioner duo. We both find the price reasonable and worth it. Can be used on all hair types. Recommended.

title: Works Well on Mature, Sensitive Skin
text:
Time to face reality. I have dry, sensitive skin. But with the big 5-0 rapidly approaching, I also have 'mature' skin as well. (I can't believe how quickly time flies!) Medipharma's Olive Oil Intensive cream is geared towards those with sensitive, mature skin. The cream is a pretty, light pink shade. Its easy to apply to skin; a little goes a long way. The first time I tried the cream, I went to bed 45 minutes after applying it. It still hadn't entirely absorbed at that point though I didn't know it because the cream didn't weigh heavily or leave a greasy feeling. I only realized it hadn't fully absorbed when I touched my cheek and felt it. By morning, it had fully absorbed. This is definitely a cream to use before bed.

And its a good nighttime cream! Its packed with vitamins, nourishing oils and a particular ingredient I happen to love...hyaluronic acid. It moisturizes and softens even the driest skin. Brings relief to the patches of eczema I sometimes experience.

I've not yet noticed a change in elasticity but I've not used the cream very long.

There is a mild scent. I'm not a huge fan of it but it fades quickly so scent isn't an issue for me.

I recommend this cream for those with mature, sensitive skin. I urge you to not let the fact that absorption isn't quick deter you from trying it. Not sure if the absorption timeframe is because it absorbs deeply into the skin and takes some time to get in down deep, but it WILL absorb fully. Should you find you don't care for this cream, Medipharma offers a risk free money back guarantee.

title: Soothes and Calms Inflammation
text:
I must admit, I did kind of wonder if Naturopathica Marshmallow & Microalgae Sensitivity Soothing cream would remind me of marshmallow fluff...would it be sticky and gooey like the food?

Nope. Its nothing like marshmallow fluff. lol

This is a nice, thick cream. Don't let the 'thick' part scare you. I have no issue applying it. It takes a few minutes to absorb and when it does, it does not leave a heavy feeling behind nor does it cause my skin to look or feel oily/ greasy. The instructions say to apply a 'generous' amount of cream. Quite honestly, I'm not sure why a 'generous' amount is recommended. An amount roughly the size of a dime sufficiently covers my face. (It can also be applied to the neck...I do not use it on my neck) Once applied, my dry skin is moisturized. Dry skin and eczema is soothed and calmed immediately. The redness due to inflammation decreases soon after.

The cream comes in a small, 0.5oz jar...perfect size to fit in a purse, gym locker, won't take up room in a suitcase when traveling, etc.

I'm happy and satisfied with the results from this cream.

title: I May Be Out of the Age Range, But This Cream Still Does Great Things for My Skin
text:
Though geared towards those in their 20's and 30's, an age range that does NOT include me lol, I still find this to be an exceptional gel cream that immediately moisturizes and hydrates even the driest of skin.

Wilma Schumann Moisture Active Gel Creme is a lightweight gel cream that applies easily . A little goes a long way. Absorption is fast-takes about 10 minutes to fully absorb into my dry skin. Does not leave a sticky, oily or greasy feeling behind, only incredible moisture, softness and hydration. Fine lines are made even finer, in fact, the smaller of my fine lines are pretty much no longer visible. The larger, thicker fine lines are reduced greatly as well.

The ingredient list for this cream is impressive and together these ingredients do wonders for my skin. My skin is very sensitive and I have absolutely no negative issues with this cream. There is a very light scent to the cream that I'm not particularly fond of, however, its light and fades entirely once the cream is absorbed. (Since its not long lasting and so mild, I will not deduct any stars from my overall review due to the scent) I may be out of the targeted age range for users of this cream but I still find it works incredibly well on my skin and delivers great results. Recommended!

title: Makes My Skin Yellow-ish
text:
This is not the serum for me.

I am VERY pale skinned. And maybe that's the problem. This serum is a bright yellow shade (due to the vitamin A) and my skin actually gets a yellowish tint to it after using this. Not nearly as bright as the serum itself, but yellow nonetheless. This happened all 3 times I applied the serum. I did apply at nighttime before bed and woke up to the yellowish skin color.

I will say, once absorbed, the serum does a wonderful job of softening and moisturizing. I didn't use it long enough to experience a reduction to fine lines or fading of blemishes.

The serum has a light scent...a very light scent. It doesn't last very long. To me, it smells ( faintly )like oranges.

Due to the issue with skin discoloration this is not a serum I will continue to use.

title: Turns Back Time
text:
exuviance Age Reverse cream is special. Its a thick cream that absorbs a bit longer than I'm used to (15-20 min) though that's not a problem for me. It literally feels good as I apply it. Results are immediate: it softens and smooths skin, moisturizes and plumps causing super thin fine lines to vanish entirely and larger fine lines to decrease in size. These results are long lasting.

Just as impressive as the results are the ingredients included in this cream. Take a minute to look at the ingredient info and what each does at the top of the page. This ingredients come together for to make a fantastic cream that does so much for skin.

I've not yet used this long enough to experience the more defined cheekbones/jawline but I am SO looking forward to experiencing these results! I've never before used a product that can define cheekbones/jawline and I can't wait for it to happen.

There is a light, kind of flowery scent but it vanishes once the cream is absorbed.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no negative reactions to this cream.

There is a good reason exuviance is an Amazon 'Professional Beauty ' product. For those not familiar, 'Amazon has curated a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices. ' This is definitely a high quality product that does wonders for skin. A 'must-have' if you're looking to turn back time as I am!

title: Perfect for Traveling
text:
Stay at home due to COVID has now been lifted entirely in my state. Last summer, we couldn't go on vacation because of it. Now that its safe, my husband and I are heading to Atlantic City for a few nights. No need for me to pack full size hair products, I'm going to take my Moroccanoil On the Go kit along. It contains everything I need; shampoo (2.4oz), conditioner (2.4oz), volumizing mist (1.7oz) and treatment oil (.85oz) . My hair tends to get frizzy close to the beach but the products in this kit will prevent that from happening. Moroccanoil has such a gorgeous scent and that will help in the smoke-filled casinos as well. The kit even comes in a handy and cute tote to carry the products in and will fit nicely in my suitcase. And I'll be able to reuse it for quite some time.

This kit is perfect for traveling but is also ideal for those who have never tried Moroccanoil products and want to. No need to pay a lot of money for full size bottles only to find you don't care for the products. Test them out via the trial size kit first.

title: One of the BEST Facial Moisturizers  (the eye cream is awesome too!)
text:
I swear, Georgette Klinger Hydro Glucan Moisturizer was made for my skin! The instant it comes into contact, my dry skin is hydrated and moisturized and stays that way for quite some time. One pump's worth covers my face and my skin just drinks it right in. Absorption is fast and leaves behind no greasy/oily look or feel; only soft skin. I think my favorite thing about this cream is the way it plumps my skin and smooths my fine lines, giving me a tighter, more even skin texture. Its such a noticeable difference and is a bit of a confidence booster for me. The big 5-0 is rapidly approaching and to have a product that helps me to not quite look my age , well, I appreciate it!

Included with the cream is a small sample tube of Georgette Klinger's Sea Extracts eye cream. This too, is a miracle cream! The very small, thin fine lines around my eyes vanish entirely when I use this cream. The larger fine lines are greatly reduced and barely noticeable.

My dry, sensitive skin has no adverse reactions to either cream.

I love the ingredients in this cream and I especially LOVE the results! They arrive quickly and are actually long-lasting. (that goes for both the face cream and eye cream!) This is easily one of the best facial moisturizers I've ever used and I HIGHLY recommend it. I will continue to use/purchase it; my skin needs this cream.

title: Does Everything It Promises To Do!
text:
Kenra's Platinum Pearl Detangler does everything it promises to do. Its a nice, lightweight milk conditioner that de-tangles hair while delivering moisture and shine. 3-4 spray's worth on my thick, shoulder length hair is sufficient. I'm immediately able to comb through hair easily because it eliminates tangles. It does a great job of moisturizing my dry hair and giving it some shine, something my hair normally lacks. And these results are actually long-lasting; that doesn't happen often with my hair.

It does not weigh my hair down or cause it to look or feel oily/greasy.

There is a phenomenal scent with this spray, unfortunately it doesn't last very long in my hair. How I wish it did. I just love it.

This is one of the better leave-in milk type conditioners I've ever used. It works great and delivers promised results. There's a good reason its an Amazon 'Professional Beauty' product. (For those unaware, an Amazon 'Professional Beauty product is: "a selection of high-quality products that can be found in professional settings such as salons, spas, and dermatology offices.") I do believe the price is reasonable and absolutely recommend this conditioning spray.

title: Helps With Healing and Diminishing of Bruises
text:
I ordered this for my mom who bruises very easily thanks to prescription blood thinners. A light bump or tap that wouldn't affect most people results in immediate bruising for her. Her bruises tend to last longer than normal as well.

I was hoping it would be awhile before she had a reason to test the cream. Unfortunately, that wasn't the case. She was walking her granddog, Mac (our dog) and he got a bit excited when he saw a neighbor he loves and started to run, catching my mom off guard. This caused the top of her hand she held the leash in to smack against a parked car. I was there, it wasn't a particularly hard hit but as always, she immediately began to bruise and wound up with a fairly large one. When she went home, she used Epione for the first time. She did not notice a difference. She re-applied more twice the following day. Her bruising began to fade. The soreness that accompanied it lessened as well. She re-applied once a day. 12 days later, her bruise was incredibly faint and pain free. To have a bruise gone in less than 2 weeks is on the FAST side for her, they usually stick around far longer until they're entirely gone/pain free.

She has fair skin which is also sensitive and did not have any negative reactions to Epione cream.

My mom is very pleased with the fast results Epione delivered and plans to continue using and purchasing it, as needed. I'm glad she has this cream. She tends to get a bit self-conscious when her bruises are visible to others. Now, she has a cream she can use to help expedite her recovery.

title: So Unique, So Many Positive Results~
text:
I absolutely love this cream. It is a light, watery gel cream that only requires a small amount to adequately cover my face. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave behind a sticky/oily/greasy look or feel. My skin is immediately hydrated, softened and refreshed. I have dry, sensitive skin with bouts of eczema. Inflammation and itching is immediately soothed when I apply Natural Derma Project's Cica Bio-Placenta cream.

I love the variety of ingredients in this gel cream but I do believe the NDP bio-water makes this cream stand out and top other similar gel creams out there. (Take a minute to read all of the information above about this cream and the ingredients it contains. ) I'm impressed and pleased with the immediate results and benefits Cica Bio-Placenta delivers and will continue to use and purchase this gel cream. I really wish I could give it more than 5 stars.

HIGHLY recommended!

title: Both Do a Really Nice Job-Good Results
text:
Fiora Naturals Coconut Milk shampoo and conditioner is a reasonably priced duo that does a really nice job on hair. The shampoo is very creamy yet easy to work into hair and rinse out. The conditioner has a nice consistency and i don't need much to cover my thick, shoulder length hair. (roughly half dollar sized amount) It also rinses from hair without issue. When my hair dries after using these two, my natural waves are nice and wavy with no fly-aways or frizz. Its also soft and tangle free.

I've not noticed much of a shine to my hair using these.

There is a nice coconut scent to both but fades once my hair is dry. (kind of smells like coconut+bubblegum to me)

Fiora's duo can be used on all hair types. The ingredient list is impressive. Equally impressive are the ingredients NOT in these products. I like this duo and recommend it.

title: Its Not Perfect But Delivers Good Results
text:
I wanted to try Amos Professional's Green Tea Volume Mist for 2 reasons. I have thick, shoulder length hair with thinning around the scalp due to aging. And, for whatever reason, the right side of my hair doesn't have as much volume as the left.

The mist is nice and light, it does not weigh my hair down. After washing my hair, I spray it around my scalp area where hair is thinning. I do spray it on the left side of my hair-just a quick spray but I spray 2-3 times on the right, less voluminous side. It does indeed give my hair a boost of fullness in the thinning area as well as the right side though the right side is still not as full as the left. I am pleased with the help it provides. However, after 2-3 hours, I begin to lose volume, especially on the right side.

There is a scent and its fantastic. Its light and refreshing. Unfortunately, it doesn't last long at all. Wish it did.

I've not noticed any new hair growth but I've also not been using this very long.

I am happy with the results this mist provides. I like the ingredients it contains as well. I do believe its worth the price.

title: I WILL Continue to Use/Purchase This...(it works THAT well!)
text:
Add bee venom to the list of things I had no clue about! Until I ordered Beloved New Zealand's Bee Venom facial serum, I had NO CLUE bee venom is so beneficial to skin care!

This serum is simply amazing. I can't get enough of it. There is a noticeable tightness to my skin since using this. My fine lines are practically non-existent. My skin stays hydrated and moisturized but also has a natural glow to it. My skin almost never glows! I've had a small scar on my face since I was a toddler. Its very small, about an inch long. Since using this serum, the scar is now practically unnoticeable! While I hadn't set out looking to get rid of the scar , what a nice surprise it is to hardly be able to see it!

The serum is easy to apply. 2 pumps worth adequately covers my face. It does take a few minutes to absorb and is SLIGHTLY sticky. Once absorbed, the stickiness is gone. I experience no burning or irritation with this serum and I have dry, sensitive skin.

In addition to bee venom, there are loads of other beneficial ingredients included. I recommend taking a few minutes to read over all of them.

For those interested in packaging, the serum comes in a nice, sturdy bottle with a built in pump that is super easy to use. The design on the bottle and box is too cute!

There is a light scent that pretty much fades entirely by the time the serum has absorbed. To me, its a light orange-ish scent. Its pleasant.

This is a keeper for me. I WILL continue to use/purchase Beloved New Zealand's Bee Venom facial serum. I believe the price is reasonable and worth every penny. I absolutely recommend this serum.

**DO NOT USE THIS IF YOU ARE ALLERGIC TO BEE STINGS!!!! It is recommended a patch test be performed prior to using for the first time. (I'm not allergic to bee stings but still did the patch test first and was fine-no reaction)

title: Good Results
text:
I ordered this for my husband to help with his hair loss and hair thinning (due to aging) . He has noticed a decrease in his hair loss since using both the shampoo and conditioner. The hair around his scalp that has been thinning has a bit more fullness as well which makes him beyond thrilled. lol. Both the shampoo and conditioner are easy to work into hair and rinse out. His only complaint is the scent. He does not care for the scent at all. (neither do I!) Thankfully, it doesn't last very long and soon fades.

He's pleased with his results and plans to continue to use both Pure Herbal shampoo and conditioner.

title: Hold Their Shape Well and NO Creases!
text:
Mary Lavender's large stretch ponytail holders do a wonderful job of keeping my thick, naturally wavy hair in place. I don't experience strands of hair popping out. The holders don't slide down my hair at all, even if I'm sweating. They're easy to put it and just as easy to take out. Thanks to the nylon and spandex materials, these holders have a great elasticity and keep their shape well. They're soft and comfortable; I pile my hair in bun using a Mary Lavender ponytail holder and in the morning, NO crease in my hair! (I think that is my favorite thing about these holders...NO crease in my hair!)

12 large holders -all different colors- are included in this item. Perfect for thick, curly hair. Holders do an all around fantastic job and the price can't be beat. Definitely recommended!

title: Magic in a Bottle
text:
In Common Magic Myst hair elixir is one of the better leave-ins out there. Its nice and light with a fabulous scent. My natural waves and curls don't turn into a frizzy mess after I use this. Hair is detangled and easy to comb through after using Magic Myst. It breathes life back into my hair; giving it bounce and shine as well as unbelievable softness.

I especially love that it protects against UVA/UVB rays. I'll definitely use Magic Myst all summer long. Another important feature that I appreciate is it protects from water containing high mineral content and heavy metals. The water here is so hard (we even have a water softener but the water is STILL hard and awful here) I need all the protection I can get.

There's a good reason this is an Amazon Premium Beauty product. Its SO deserving. (premium beauty means: Amazon sources from top brands to offer you a wide range of high-end products for women and men. To buy Premium Beauty and Premium Men’s Grooming items, just look for the Premium Beauty badge.) Recommended

title: An Exceptional Cream
text:
Let me tell you, THANK YOU FARMER has delivered one heck of a wonderful cream in their Argan Oil Rich Cream facial cream! It is packed with impressive ingredients. I especially love the generous amount of Vitamin E, a necessity for my dry, damaged skin.

The cream applies easily to skin and doesn't take long to absorb. It immediately softens and hydrates my skin for an extended time. Its not greasy, oily or heavy. This cream revives my skin and helps to heal sun damage and keep wrinkles at bay. I do not detect much of a scent from this cream.

I use this cream after my nighttime skin ritual and it has worked wonders. In addition to the cream, I received some samples from THANK YOU FARMER and look forward to purchasing some of them. Testing this cream was my first experience with this brand and I'm already a huge fan! The price is reasonable for this cream and I absolutely recommend it.

title: A League of Its Own
text:
Paul Brown's Hawaiian curling wand is in a league of its own. It unlike any other curling iron I've ever used and has some incredible features, including:

-Takes 30-60 seconds to heat up with the temp reaching a max of 410 degrees. Hair does not stick to the barrel, eliminating burned/scorched hair

-It takes only 3-12 seconds to curl hair

-There is no clamp on this curling iron. Hair is simply wrapped around the barrel to achieve the curl

-The cord is 9 FEET in length. Its not a typical plastic cord either. I do not know the type of material-reminds me of a jump rope? Its heat resistant, VERY important seeing as this curling iron reaches a high temp of 410 degrees! It also swivels so there's no worry the plug will yank out of the wall outlet.

-Barrels can be interchanged with other like EOS curling irons, allowing varying curl sizes (note: other barrels are NOT included with this, they're a separate purchase)

-This curling iron allows you to create styles from waves to curls

-Cleaning is a breeze and only requires a microfiber cloth (not included)

-Can be used on all hair types

-In addition to the curling iron, a glove for protective the hand from heat is included

-A helpful instruction pamphlet is included with styling tips, cleaning/storage instructions. Included with the pamphlet is the limited lifetime warranty which MUST be completed and returned within 90 days of purchase!

I had fun experimenting with the curling iron and didn't have to spend much time doing so since it heats up so quickly and hair only needs to remain on the barrel for a matter of seconds. This is SO different than any other curling iron I've EVER used. Its not damaging my hair and its providing much needed fullness to my natural waves. It is, without a doubt, absolutely worthy of gift-giving. I absolutely recommend the Paul Brown Hawaiian Curling Wand.

title: Repairs Hair Quickly
text:
My teenager great-niece has type 3 hair. She's been experiencing dry, damaged hair as well as some breakage and its really starting to upset her. I ordered Salwa Petersen's Chebe du Tchad hair cream hoping it would help. And it is. This leave-in moisturizes her hair and prevents it from becoming frizzy. She has had a noticeable decrease with regards to her hair breaking and continues to see less and less breakage. This cream doesn't weigh her hair down or make it greasy. She doesn't need to use much cream to sufficiently cover her hair. The instructions say to use 1-2 'pea size' drops. She uses 1 drop's worth a 'tad' larger than pea size. That's all it takes. She's also pleased with the ingredients in the cream as well as the scent.

In her opinion, this is priced high but she says its worth every penny. Because she's a full time college student and not employed, she does not know if she will purchase this after she finishes the bottle she has now. (perhaps a care package from her fave great aunt is in order? lol) When asked if she recommends this hair cream, her response is 'definitely!'.

title: These Work Great!
text:
Linziclip hair clips are easy to operate, comfortable and do a great job of keeping my hair in place. I never have to deal with hairs popping out of the clips. I don't have to worry about the clips breaking as I have in the past with other brands of hair clips, Linziclip are well made and durable. The springs that allow the clip to open/close are indeed out of sight; all that is visible is the exterior of the clip.

I have thick, shoulder length hair. These are far too small for me to use as a ponytail (I've never used a hairclip as a ponytail anyway) but perfect for when I clip small sections of my hair away from my face, which I often do. As for being able to lean back in comfort, I sat on the bed with the back of my head against the headboard while wearing a clip. I could feel the clip touching the headboard but it didn't dig into my skin , was not painful and did not cause my hair to come out of the clip at all.

Linziclips come in tortoise or black. Both are very nice. (for no particular reason, I prefer the black clips)

I'm impressed with Linziclips. I've used hairclips for years and years and tried many different styles and brands. Linziclips really does an all around great job. I do find the price of the clips (6 total, 2 different colors) reasonable .

title: Hold Up Well, Keep Their Shape and Are Comfy
text:
YANRONG's 20 piece ponytail holder set comes in 3 different styles. 2 of the 3 styles are plastic and resemble an old telephone cord. I love these types of ponytail holders! They do an excellent job of keeping hair in place, they don't tangle, they're comfortable to wear as well as place in hair/remove and they keep their shape and elasticity well. There are 2 different sizes for this type and 5 holders are included for both sizes. The 3rd type of holder from YANRONG is a soft cotton holder in various colors. These also keep their shape well and are comfortable, easy to place in hair/remove without pulling or tangling. 10 holders of this type are included.

The smaller 'telephone cord' holders and the cotton holders work well in adult and kid's hair. The larger 'telephone cord' holders are too big for a younger child's hair but perfect for adults hair. So far, all 3 types of holders are holding up very well and I'm more than pleased with them. I DO experience a bit of creasing with the thinner 'telephone cord' holders in my hair.

One unique feature with YANRONG's 'telephone cord' holders is that they can go back to their normal shape should they stretch out of place, simply by holding a hair dryer over the holder or placing it in a glass of warm water. I've not stretched any of my cord holders out of place so I've not yet tried this feature. I'm thrilled that they're keeping their shape and elasticity but I must admit, I'm a bit excited to try these methods firsthand and see how well they work!

The YANRONG holders are already getting a lot of use in our home and will continue to, especially during the summer! I'm pleased with them and find the price to be incredibly reasonable!

cord holders: 4.5 stars (had to deduct a bit for the crease)
soft cotton holders: 5 stars

photos: #1- I did receive 10 cotton holders, 3 were in use when i took the photo , #2-cotton holder being stretched, #3-cotton holder AFTER I stretched it for the photo, #4-smaller 'telephone cord' holder being stretched, #5-smaller 'telephone cord' holder after I stretched it for photo, #6-thicker 'telephone' cord being stretched for photo, #7-thicker 'cord' holder after I stretched for photo

title: Another Awesome Nature Nut Product
text:
I just knew I would love Nature Nut's Deep Conditioning Hair mask! I'm already a fan of their leave in conditioner and face cream, so I wasn't surprised when the mask delivered excellent results as well.

I could have gotten away with using 2/3 of a pack to sufficiently cover my thick, shoulder length hair but I went ahead and used an entire pack. Its easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse out. Though the instructions say to allow it to sit on hair 2-3 minutes, I left it on for 5. It detangled my hair beautifully. I didn't have even one tangle when I combed it. When my hair dried (i air dry), my natural waves and curls were soft, smooth and shiny. My hair doesn't shine on its own so its always a good thing when a product allows it to! The day after I used the mask I spent a good deal of time outside in the hot sun planting tomato plants and flowers and had worked up a sweat. My hair frizzes when I get sweaty but it didn't following the use of this mask.

There is a scent to this that I very much like though it didn't last very long.

This is an exceptional mask. It revived my hair while delivering shine, softness and smoothness. My normally dry hair became moisturized and hydrated. The instructions say to use it 1-3 times per week and I plan on doing just that. I've already purchased a 2nd box! I also gave my mom a packet too to try ; I have a hunch she'll soon place an order of her own as well! lol. The price is more than reasonable. This mask delivers salon -quality results to my hair and I absolutely recommend it. Perfect for all hair types!

title: Fun Polish...(and it really changes colors!)
text:
I'm a nail polish junkie and have 1200+ bottles yet I've never tried Del Sol polish until now. This also marks the first changing polish I've ever used. This particular polish, 'Future's So Bright' is a pretty coral shade w/shimmer while worn indoors. Personally, I consider it to be more of an orange than a coral but its still a really pretty color. When outdoors, the color changes to garnet red w/shimmer, also a pretty color. The color change happens pretty much immediately; as soon as I go outside into the sunshine, the polish is garnet red. When I return indoors, its back to the coral/orange shade. Pretty neat! The polish is easy to apply, it has a nice brush that delivers even strokes. It does indeed dry pretty quickly. I used 3 coats to get my desired shade with a coat of clear on top as well. I experienced NO chipping of the polish at all. I had no issues removing it, it came right off with nail polish remover.

This is a FUN nail polish! Worth the price and makes for a nice gift/stocking stuffer.

title: Does a Really Good Job (but overpriced)
text:
I'm pretty new to the world of toners and boy do I appreciate the benefits and results that come with using a toner. Kerstin Florian Correcting Refiner toner does not disappoint. It is one of the best. Its gentle, yet does an exceptional job of cleansing, removing dead skin cells, hydrating/moisturizing and reducing pores. It claims to reduce the effects of photodamage due to sun exposure but I've not yet used it long enough to experience this particular result.

The toner is light and refreshing. It feels so nice when it touches my skin. I have sensitive skin and have no negative reactions. It is lightly scented. The scent is OK...not my favorite but perfectly acceptable, especially since it doesn't last very long at all.

I'm pleased with the fast results this toner delivers though I do feel it is overpriced.

title: PERFECTION! EXACTLY What I Wanted!
text: Scunci's The Most Comfortable Headband Ever (2 pack) is even BETTER than I expected! I almost didn't buy it. I was looking for a headband that makes my hair look like sunglasses are sitting on the top of my head; I already have one but it recently broke.  I nearly ordered another when I spotted this 2 pack of Scunci headbands. I will say I thought the claim on the packaging, 'bends and forms comfortably to the shape of your head' sounded too good to be true. But I do use Scunci ponytail holders and they're good quality so I decided to give the headbands a try.  Scunci isn't kidding...these headbands DO indeed bend and form to the shape of your head!  And when I placed the headband on my head for the first time I learned I have a square-ish shaped head.  lol.  I'm so happy I got the Scunci headbands. They fit perfectly AND sit in my hair exactly like I wanted; the headbands make my hair look like I have sunglasses sitting on top of my  head.  They are comfortable, I really don't even feel it sitting there. It doesn't slide out of place either.  I'm beyond thrilled and satisfied with my purchase and the price is a steal.

title: Excellent Conditioner That Does What It Promises To Do (and smells wonderful!)
text:
This was my first experience with the NIUCOCO brand and I'm a fan! This conditioner is easy to work through my thick, shoulder length hair and just as easy to rinse out. It has a nice, creamy consistency and I don't need to use much to adequately cover my hair. (an amount roughly the size of a half dollar) NIUCOCO keeps my hair nice and smooth and frizz free! My natural waves have bounce and shine, both of which my hair normally lacks. This conditioner doesn't weigh my hair down or make it look or feel oily/greasy. Quite the opposite; it makes my hair soft and hydrated.

If you're a fan of the scent of coconut, you're going to love NIUCOCO! It smells fabulous.

Wonderful conditioner with great ingredients and its gentle enough to use daily. Because of the excellent results, the scent I love and the fact I don't need to use much conditioner to sufficiently cover my hair, I absolutely recommend NIUCOCO conditioner and find the price reasonable and fair.

title: Nothing...Except Greasy Looking Hair (smells good)
text:
I had high hopes Joico Beach Shake Texturizing Finisher would make my hair look as though I just spent the day on a tropical beach, swimming in crystal blue ocean water under the warm sun. That didn't happen. Not much of anything happened. I have thick, shoulder length hair. As instructed, I sprayed it on my dry, finished hair and used my hands to tousle my hair. It didn't make my natural waves look as though I had spent the day on the beach. The only noticeable difference was that my hair looked greasy. This surprised me because it is a VERY light, airy and dry spray.

Beach Shake does have a nice , light, refreshing scent though it doesn't last very long in my hair.
