I am a fan of Joico hair products. Just not this particular product. Beach Shake didn't work for my hair and is a product I will not continue to use or purchase.

title: One of the BEST Hair Products I've EVER Used!
text:
Oh boy. This is a game changer for me!

I was worried when I dispensed 2 pump's worth of serum into my hand for the first time. It reminded me of olive oil and I assumed it would weigh my hair down and possibly cause it to look oily/greasy. How wrong I was. After rubbing the serum between both hands, I applied it to the ends of my (dry) hair. After running my fingers through my ends a few times, my natural curls were instantly revived and refreshed, as if by magic. It was that quick and that easy! The next time I used it, I applied it throughout my hair. It immediately added body and volume to my hair while breathing life into my natural curls and waves. All without weighing my hair down. Running a brush through my hair only HELPED to style my hair. And it held all day long. Didn't need to brush my hair again throughout the day. My hair stayed smooth and without frizz. I didn't have many split ends to begin with but since using Devine...I can't find ANY! On top of these awesome results I experience, the scent of this serum is positively DIVINE! I absolutely LOVE IT! Its light and fresh and though I don't use much serum at all, the scent actually lasts in my hair for a decent amount of time.

Using B R A E's Plume Sensation Divine serum has taught me a good lesson. STOP making assumptions! I immediately assumed this serum would not work in my hair due to the olive oil-like consistency. I went into trying this for the first time already thinking it wouldn't work. Turns out, its one of the best products I've ever used in my hair! It can be used on both dry and wet hair. I have tried both and I get better results when used on dry hair. Thanks to the exceptional results and the fact I don't need to use much serum at all, I find the price more than reasonable. This is a keeper for me!

title: Melatonin: Not Just a Sleep Aid!
text:
Well what do you know...Melatonin doesn't just help me sleep at night, it now also helps fix the problem areas around my eyes. I had no clue Melatonin could be used to aid in anything other than sleep; I've been taking it for quite some time to help with insomnia issues. Now, when I take my Melatonin pill before bed, I also apply MAXCLINIC's Time Return Melatonin Under Eye Cream as well. Just a few dots of cream around my eye area reduces and thins my fine lines and helps lighten the dark circles that are more and more often waiting to greet me when I awaken each morning. My skin is also moisturized and hydrated, something it normally lacks, thanks to this cream.

The cream can be used both in the morning and at night. As of now, I'm only using it at nighttime. Thought I'm only using it in my eye area, it can also be used on the forehead area as well as on 'smile lines'. (I've not tested this on either of those areas)

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no negative reactions from using this cream. Positive results only!

I'm impressed by the Melatonin and Hyaluronic acid (one of my faves!) duo. These two work together beautifully and deliver impressive results to my problem areas around my eyes. With such awesome results and the fact I only use a little bit of cream with each use, I find the price to be incredibly reasonable (low, actually) and definitely recommend this eye cream!

title: Works Better Than Anticipated
text:
First and foremost, my apologies. My photos aren't going to be much help to you as they were taken on my awful cell camera.

This was the first time I've ever tried a root touch up stick. For those not familiar, it reminds me of a giant crayon. Its easy to use; simply brush in short strokes over the hair you'd like to cover at the hairline, part or sideburns. The stick is soft and it applies easily. You won't need to press down hard. Once the hair is covered, comb it to help blend the color. Give it a few minutes to set and you're good to go.

Other than shea butter and jojoba, I'm not at all familiar with the ingredients in this stick. Its kind of waxy but not in a bad way. As long as you don't use too much of the product, it does blend well with hair and doesn't weigh it down. I used the light blonde shade and when I first applied it, it almost looked
orange-ish. Once I combed it in, it evened out pretty well with my blonde hair. I have sensitive skin and had no issues with irritation. I was able to wash it out of my hair easily.

You can't tell by my photos but the stick did a pretty good job of covering up my roots. It worked better than I anticipated. I will not use this stick in place of hair coloring on my roots. But I WILL use the stick to touch up my roots when the greys start to appear until its time to use the hair dye.

*photos: before/after...I turned the lights out for the 'after' hoping you'd get a better idea of how the stick worked

title: Another Exceptional SHASH Brush!
text:
Everyone in our home, including the pets (don't worry, they have their own) use a SHASH boar bristle hairbrush on a daily basis. They are, simply put, AMAZING. I'm still blown away by these brushes. And now, I have a SHASH face brush that does an unbelievable job of cleaning and exfoliating skin.

The SHASH face brush is of the same exceptional quality as SHASH hairbrushes. The bristles are nice and secure. I've not seen any fall out or lose shape. The handle of the brush is crafted from ecosourced beechwood and excellent quality. (My dad builds with all kinds of wood and praises beechwood!) Its so incredibly smooth and comfortable to hold. Light and small enough to pack and take along when traveling.

I was initially concerned the bristles were too hard for my skin. I scratch easily. I'm a nail biter and have no fingernails yet if I scratch myself, even lightly, it looks like I got into a battle with a cat! lol. I simply adjust the amount of pressure I put on the brush while in use so it doesn't hurt and am still able to easily and exceptionally cleanse and exfoliate with no issues. It actually feels GOOD and relaxing while in use AND after I've finished. I can see and feel how clean and revived my skin is. The dead skin cells are cleaned away and pores get a good gentle but thorough cleaning as well. I've not used the brush long enough to notice a firmness to skin but I will definitely continue to use it and have no doubt I'll experience that firmness in no time.

SHASH's face brush is well made, easy to use and produces great results. Should you have an issue with your SHASH face brush, SHASH offers an unconditional money back guarantee. This is a company that puts out high quality, affordable products AND clearly believes in customer satisfaction!

(BTW...the info above refers to this as a brush for men. I'm female and use the brush! )

title: Revives My Waves and Keeps the Frizz Away
text:
I originally received a notification that this was undeliverable. Somehow, it made it to my home anyway and I'm so happy that it did!

This is yet another excellent quality hair product courtesy of John Frieda. The conditioner is easy to work into hair and rinse out. It detangles, softens and enhances my natural waves while preventing them from turning into a frizzy mess. I only need to use a small amount, roughly the size of a half dollar to sufficiently cover my shoulder length, thick hair. Doesn't weigh my hair down or make it look or feel oily or greasy. This is a conditioner I can and do use daily.

I love this conditioner and have already ordered a 2nd bottle! The price is incredibly amazing , especially for the great results it delivers. Perfect for those with wavy/curly hair!

title: Does What It Promises To Do...and Smells Great!
text:
Moroccanoil's Smoothing conditioner really does a great job of keeping my natural waves nice and smooth and preventing them from turning into a frizzy mess. It removes tangles and softens hair in the process and boy oh boy does it ever smell F-A-B-U-L-O-U-S! The delicious scent and soft smooth hair results actually last for a good 2 days in my hair which is practically unheard of. That alone impresses me.

This conditioner does what it promises to do and does so very well. Even with the good results it delivers, I still find it to be overpriced. I'd love to continue to use it but its way out of my price range, unfortunately. Otherwise, I absolutely recommend it.

title: Unbelievably Unique w/Amazing Results
text:
I've never used a skin care product quite like Troiareuke's Pit Cleansing Milk. The instructions are different than any other skin care product I've ever used.

The milk, which isn't really 'milk' but a cream, is to be applied to DRY skin. Troiareuke recommends using a spatula to evenly distribute the cream. I use one and it definitely helps. After allowing the cream to sit on skin 10-15 minutes (I do the full 15), a face wipe is first used to wipe the cream off followed by rinsing with lukewarm water.

PIT Cleansing Milk gets deep into pores and cleans them out without causing skin to dry out. Makeup and impurities are removed as well. Skin barrier is protected and not stripped. My skin is instantly softer and smoother after using this. I don't often have glowing skin but it absolutely glows after a PIT treatment. The inflammation on my cheeks, courtesy of eczema is calmed and soothed.

There is a lot to this cleansing milk. It cleanses skin (gets down deep), softens, smooths and hydrates. Its a cleanser AND a mask combined. Its packed with fabulous ingredients. But its Troiareuke's Phase Inversion Technique that REALLY makes this special and this is what it does: 'Phase Inversion Technique and Mineral Oil turns all impurities into oil and water for perfect cleansing for all skin types.'. That is absolutely impressive to me. Never heard of or used anything that before.

I HIGHLY recommend taking the time to read ALL of the information on this page, from top to bottom as well as the info that comes with the cleansing milk. You'll read and see for yourself when you actually use the product why its so incredibly unique.

When I use PIT Cleansing Milk, I'm not just cleaning my skin, I'm pampering it as well. My skin looks and feels healthier and younger. For all of the benefits and results PIT delivers, its worth every penny of the price. Without a doubt, I HIGHLY recommend Troiareuke's PIT Cleansing Milk.

title: I'm Impressed!
text:
I've used the same perfume for years and years , so it was pretty adventurous of me to put my normal scent down and give Antonio Banderas' Queen of Seduction Lively Muse a try. (OK, 'adventurous' might be a tad dramatic lol) Queen of Seduction is very different from my regular perfume...and that's a good thing. Its nice to use a new scent. The description (above) refers to Queen as being a 'floral fruity fragrance'. I have to say, I find it far more floral than fruity. Its not a gagging, overpowering or sickeningly sweet scent by any means but I only use 2 sprays at the most. More than 2 sprays' worth and it does become overpowering to me. The scent actually lasts a good deal of time-all day. I don't have to reapply it at any point which is nice. The bottle it comes is in pretty.

I'm not sure why , perhaps because I've been using my regular perfume for so long, but I didn't expect to like this as much as I do.! What a happy surprise. Definitely worthy of gift giving. Because I only use 1-2 sprays' worth , the bottle size, the lovely scent and the long lasting scent, I find the price to be reasonable.

title: Overpriced With Minimal Results
text:
This is not the product for me. Yes, I did experience some thinning of my fine lines which is always a good thing. And it does deliver hydration to my dry, sensitive skin. That's about it. I've not noticed much plumping or firmer skin.

Due to the minimal results I achieved and the fact its to be used 2x's a day, I think this is very overpriced. I've tried other products that cost a fraction of the price and delivered more results.

I have no plans to continue to use (already gave it to my mom) or purchase this.

title: Long-Lasting and Great Results!
text:
Not sure if its because I have dry, sensitive skin or perhaps it happens with all skin types, but I find that gel/gel cream products seem to work a bit better and last a bit longer than regular creams. OGI's Water Rich Gel Cream is a good example. This is a nice, light gel cream that is easy to apply to skin. It does begin to absorb quickly but it also takes a tad longer to completely absorb into my skin. (10-15 minutes) It doesn't weigh heavily or cause my skin to look or feel oily/greasy. Softening of skin literally begins as soon as this gel cream touches my face and it just continues to get softer and softer. My eczema is calmed and soothed and the redness leaves as well. OGI keeps my skin nice and hydrated for quite some time. My skin looks and feels healthier when I use this gel cream. There is a light scent I find pleasant though it fades FAST.

Cactus extract is a main ingredient in this cream. This is, I believe, the second product I've ever used containing cactus and I'm rapidly becoming a HUGE fan!

OGI works beautifully on my skin and keeps it looking and feeling great for quite some time. I have no negative reactions using OGI with regards to my dry, sensitive skin. I love the results OGI delivers. 1.69oz of gel cream is in this jar. I know that doesn't sound like much but keep in mind a little goes a LONG way. This jar will actually last me quite some time since i don't need to use much each time I apply it. Because of that as well as the results I receive, I find the price definitely reasonable. I will continue to use this cream in my skin care regimen. Absolutely recommended!

title: Works Well...But Overpriced
text:
This is a nice conditioner that does a really great job of de-tangling, softening, hydrating and adding a bit of shine to my hair. Its easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse out. It doesn't weigh my hair down or cause it to look or feel oily /greasy. I'm pleased with the way it keeps my natural waves and curls in place and prevents frizz from creeping in. The scent is out of this world. And its actually a scent that lasts a long time!

However...

I just cannot justify the price. I find it this conditioner to be overpriced, hence my overall rating. It works very well. I'm pleased with my results. I'm especially appreciative that this conditioner is gentle enough for daily use as I wash my hair daily. But other daily- use conditioners that provide the same results/benefits are out there for a fraction of the price. This is way out of my price range and I have no plans to purchase this conditioner in the near future.

title: Great Serum...Scent is FAR Too Strong For Me
text:
I'm not looking forward to writing this review...

Shore Magic serum does good things for my skin. Its packed with clean organic ingredients; collagen, elastin, vitamins, enzymes, vegetable glycerin, marine collagen and salicylic acid-ingredients that do wonderful things for skin. This serum gets down deep into pores and achieves noticeable results. My skin is hydrated and moisturized after using this. It looks and feels fresh and revived. Fine lines are reduced. It feels nice as I massage it into my skin. Soft and smooth skin is achieved immediately. Absorption is FAST!

So, why is this a hard review to write? This is a great serum that delivers great results. I do love the way it makes my skin look and feel. When I opened the bottle for the first time, the scent immediately exploded. Immediately, the word 'Nana' popped into my head. 'Nana' is my deceased grandmother of 35+ years. This serum smells like the perfume Nana wore when I was a kid. That's not necessarily a bad thing except for the fact the scent is VERY overpowering. A few drops worth on my face and it smells like I bathed in Nana's perfume. Its that strong. It literally caused my husband to have a coughing fit though to be fair, many scents make him cough. Most product scents tend to fade quickly. Not this one. The scent is long lasting and it is just too strong for me. It truly pains me to say that I will not continue to use this serum due to the overwhelmingly strong scent because it IS otherwise a great serum.

title: Works All Day Long and Smells Fabulous!
text:
Oh, how I adore this finishing spray! Everything about it is fabulous! It works as a hairspray and keeps my hair in place. It adds volume when my hair is lacking. My natural waves stay nice and wavy without turning into a frizzy mess. It is SO light and airy and dries instantly. It does not weigh my hair down or cause it to become hard and crunchy. A light spray around my hair in the morning provides all day coverage. And the scent is just gorgeous. I was quite surprised to see how inexpensive the price is. I expected it to be higher seeing as this is a Matrix product and it works so incredibly well. Its also an 'Amazon's Choice' product. For those not familiar, that means 'Amazon's Choice highlights highly rated, well-priced products available to ship immediately'. Its definitely deserving of that title!

Matrix's Total Results Miss Mess is quite impressive and I love the results it delivers. Definitely recommended!

title: My Favorite DOVE Body Wash
text: I love Dove body wash and now that I've tried it, Purely Pampering Shea Butter w/Warm Vanilla is my favorite.  It smells fabulous, lathers well and feels great on my skin.  It does a fantastic job of cleansing yet at the same time, its nice and gentle.  I bathe at night and this wash helps me relax.  Leaves my skin soft, moisturized and smooth.  Perfect for those with sensitive skin (I have sensitive skin and have no issues whatsoever with this body wash) and children as well.  A little body wash goes a LONG way.  These 4 bottles will last us quite some time.  Arrived in perfect condition. All 4 bottles were taped together securely and the packaging box included cushioning all around the interior; no leaks/spills.  Definitely worth the price. Highly recommended!

title: Works Pretty Well
text: Ordered this for my husband. He tried it and says, 'It works pretty well'.  It does a good job trimming his ears/nose hair. Has a good amount of power and runs smoothly.  Runs on a AA battery (not included)

title: Another Awesome IGK Product!
text:
I quickly went from never hearing of the IGK brand to absolutely LOVING it. First Class is a fabulous, weightless replenishing conditioner. I don't need to use much on my shoulder length, thick hair. It rinses from hair easily. Doesn't make hair look or feel oily/greasy. My natural waves/curls do not become frizzy at all after using this. My hair is unbelievably soft and shiny and it removes tangles as well. The scent is fantastic but unfortunately, it doesn't last long in my hair.

An exceptional weightless conditioner. Revives hair and makes it look and feel good!

title: Game Changer For My Skin
text:
Prior to using Yon-Ka Gommage Peeling Gel, I read the instructions and wondered what this product could do for my skin seeing as it only sits on it for 1-2 minutes before it needs to be removed. Turns out, 1-2 minutes is enough time to deliver plenty of wonderful results!

I have dry, sensitive skin as well as eczema. I'm always prepared when trying a new skin care product, even those made for sensitive skin. I have soft towels and a Dove bar (soap bar, not candy bar lol) on hand and I do the test by a sink. That way, if I experience a reaction, I have everything on hand to quickly remove the offending product. Thankfully, I have no issues with Yon-Ka. It works beautifully on my skin. Its a clear, thick-ish watery gel that reminds me of pancake syrup, minus the stickiness. I will tell you right now, the scent is horrific. I can't even pinpoint exactly what it smells like: its medicinal, chemical, maybe a touch of the scent of a hospital as well, if that makes sense? Even after washing my hands I could still smell it faintly and had to go back and wash them again. But it DOES go away and I urge you-as bad as it is, do NOT let this stop you from using this product. A thick layer of the gel is to be applied to the face (and neck though I do not use it on my neck) for 1-2 minutes. When the time is up, the gel peels off the face and any remainder can be removed using a cotton ball. I don't experience much peeling, more like small flaking. I do remove the remainder with my fingertips followed by a wet compressed facial sponge to ensure its all off. Yon-Ka removes the red patches caused by eczema. It reduces and tightens my pores. Scratch that...it NOTICEABLY reduces and tightens my pores! It also exfoliates, leaving my skin soft, smooth and glowing! My skin rarely glows. Yon-Ka actually makes my skin GLOW! It truly is remarkable. I never expected I'd experience such drastic, incredible results!

I must continue to use Yon-Ka. It does wonders for my skin and does so quickly. It is now a part of my skin regimen. It can be used 1-3 times per week. Its not cheap (though worth EVERY penny...and keep in mind it IS an Amazon 'subscribe and save' item! YAY!) , a decent amount is used each time and the tube is only 1.8oz. For these reasons, at least for now, I will only use this once a week. Prior to trying this gel, I'd never heard of the Yon-Ka brand before. I'm sure aware of it now and am a huge fan! I'm looking forward to trying more Yon-Ka products in the future. This gel is phenomenal and I highly recommend it.

title: Cleanses AND Soothes Skin
text:
This may be a face wash but as I apply it to my skin and work it into a lather, it soothes the burning/itching patches of eczema on my face in an instant. That kind of caught me off guard...I wasn't expecting a face wash to calm my eczema! But that's certainly not all it does.

Melora Double Action Face wash is on the thick side. Kind of reminds me of pancake syrup, minus the stickiness. Its easy to apply and work into a lather and washes off just as easily. In addition to soothing my eczema inflammation, it delivers a deep cleansing of my pores, removes dead skin cells leaving my skin feeling revived and wonderfully soft.

I have some hair care products made with Manuka honey but this is the first skin care product I've used containing it and I'm equally impressed. I really like this face wash. It works great on my dry, sensitive skin (no negative reactions of any kind!) and the price cannot be beat. It works well on acne/acne prone skin and I actually just bought a second tube for my husband. I don't have issues with acne but he tends to have outbreaks at times. This cleanser should help put a stop to them. Definitely recommended. (Parents who send their kids care packages at college, this would be a perfect item to include!)

title: Simply the BEST Foot Treatment...EVER.
text:
My feet are gross. The bottoms are SO dry and cracked, they resemble funky fish scales and my heels are dry as well. I've tried MANY creams, lotions, electric callous removers and foot peels. You know those egg shaped foot files? I once bent some of the blades on one because my feet were that dry, cracked and callused. Don't get me wrong...I've had some good results with various products but more often than not, they do not work or improve my feet much at all...

Until now...

Kerasal Intensive Foot Repair Mask is magical. 6 treatments are included and they couldn't be easier to use. Simply wash and dry feet, place a mask on each foot ( don't worry, the treatment lotion material is already inside the mask), keep the masks on for 20 minutes and when time is up, remove masks and discard and massage any residual cream into the skin. That's all it takes. The tea tree oil, chamomile, shea butter and aloe work together beautifully to heal, soften and deliver incredible moisture. My feet were repaired with the very first use in a HUGE way. There is still some dryness but the horrific deep cracks/funky 'fish scales' are no longer. My feet are SOFT and incredibly smooth now. I have never ever experienced such incredible results. And those results came with ONE use! Amazing. Simply amazing.

I do have sensitive skin and have no issues with the treatment material in the mask. There is no burning, itching, redness, etc. My feet actually feel nice and relaxed while in the masks. The treatment lotion has a scent-its not my favorite but its not a big deal to me seeing as it doesn't last long anyway.

I'm blown away and so incredibly impressed with Kerasal. These masks work unbelievably well and do so with the very first use. My horrible feet finally look and feel GOOD and thank goodness for that seeing as summer and flipflop/sandal season is right around the corner. While Kerasal masks cost more than other foot treatments I've tried, they're worth every penny and then some. These are 'must have' masks for anyone with dry, cracked feet.

title: Such a Pretty Shade of Blue!
text:
I own a number of Keeki polishes and just love them. I actually ordered Blueberry Pie by accident. I meant to order a different shade but ordered BP by mistake. Turned out to be a happy mistake! Its a gorgeous shade of blue. Its easy to apply; goes on nice and smooth. Thanks to the good quality brush, the strokes are nice and even. Drying time is pretty fast as well. I especially love that Keeki is 100% biodegradable, non-toxic, gluten free and free of phthalates, formaldehyde and toluene as well. The price is incredibly reasonable especially since the polish is long lasting. I experience no issues with the polish chipping.

I must add that removing the polish isn't the easiest with a regular remover. It takes a bit of work. I urge you to NOT let this stop you from using Keeki polish. I found a remover (different brand) that I use for all of my various polishes and it works well on Keeki polishes.

I HIGHLY recommend Keeki polish. They've got a great variety of gorgeous colors to keep your nails colorful year round.

title: Delivers Results...and Smells Fabulous!
text:
I really, really like Moroccanoil's Extra Volume conditioner! The consistency is awesome. Its on the thin side, so a small amount of conditioner really goes a LONG way which is especially good seeing as the price is on the high side. I have no issues working this into my hair. And its just as easy to rinse out. It does a fantastic job of de-tangling, softening and smoothing my hair while adding volume and bounce as well. It prevents my natural waves and curls from turning into a frizzy mess as well. And the scent... the scent of this conditioner is positively sensational. I LOVE THE SCENT OF THIS CONDITIONER! And it actually lasts long and stays in my hair for quite some time.

I do love this conditioner. Unfortunately, its way out of my price range but it works great and delivers the results promised.

title: Great Serum
text:
OGI's Water Rich Pure Serum is a nice, lightweight serum that absorbs quickly and leaves skin hydrated and moisturized. I especially like the cactus extract and jojoba seed oil ingredients. I believe they're responsible for helping to soothe my eczema. Once the serum has absorbed I then apply a facial moisturizer cream. I like the extra level of protection this serum contributes to my skin care ritual.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no negative reactions to OGI serum. It can be used on all skin types.

Overall, this is a great serum with awesome ingredients. I'm pleased with the results it delivers.

title: One of the Best Conditioners...EVER!
text:
This is easily one of the best conditioners I've ever used. No question about it. It's lightweight and an amount roughly the size of a half dollar sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. With the very first use, it deeply hydrates and moisturizes. My natural curls and waves are left unbelievably soft and incredibly smooth. My hair tends to frizz easily; that does not happen after using this conditioner. But that's not all. IGK Legendary adds both shine and bounce to my hair, something it lacks on its own. The scent of this conditioner is out of this world and it actually lasts in my hair a decent amount of time.

IGK not only does everything it promises to do, it does it with the very first use. My hair doesn't just look good, it feels good as well. I love this conditioner. This is a keeper for me. Since it delivers a lot of great results and does so quickly and only a small amount is needed per use, I find the price to be worth every penny.

title: Good Results But Overpriced
text:
Moroccanoil's Curl Enhancing conditioner really does a nice job smoothing my natural curls and waves and eliminating the frizz that tends to plague my hair on a fairly routine basis. My hair always looks great after using this conditioner; tangle-free, soft and shiny. And the scent is out of this world! My hair, for whatever reason, tends to lose the scent of hair products quickly. Doesn't happen with this conditioner. The scent lasts for a LONG time and it is absolutely phenomenal! I wish my hair could smell like this 24/7!

While I'm pleased with the results I get from Moroccanoil's Curl Enhancing conditioner, I'm not blown away, with the exception of the long lasting scent. It does a great job on my hair, waves/curls but I've tried other conditioners that work just as well for a fraction of the price.

title: Good, Durable Hair Ties (though not entirely creaseless)
text:
DDSJJTOU's Elastic Hair Ties do an excellent job of keeping my thick, shoulder length hair in place. They do not slide down hair, even if I'm walking or exercising. Strands of hair don't fall out. The ties are easy to put in and remove from hair; no tangles or pulling. They hold their shape well and maintain elasticity. 22 ties are included and they arrive in a cute, plastic zippered bag. I chose all black colored ties.

I put my hair in a messy bun when I go to bed at night. I DO at times experience crease marks in my hair the next morning after using these ties.

Overall, these are good, durable hair ties. Perfect for those with long, thick, curly/wavy, straight hair.

title: My Hair's New BFF!
text: IGK Sold Out Curl Priming Basecoat is my hair's new best friend!  After washing my hair and while damp, a  couple of sprays worth of IGK on my thick, shoulder length hair keeps my natural curls and waves in place, prevents frizz and adds volume to my hair. My waves/curls never lose shape. For whatever reason, the right side of my hair doesn't get quite as curly/wavy as the left. I've tried everything I can think of to even it out without luck. I didn't expect IGK to work either but the first time I tried it, I did an extra spray on the right side of my hair and scrunched it at the same time and it helped!  Both sides are pretty much the same with regards to curls and waves.  IGK also works great as a curl refresher on dry hair.  It does all of this without making hair hard and crunchy and does not weigh hair down in the slightest.  Its packed with fabulous ingredients such as sweet almond oil and sea kelp . There is a scent and its delicious and actually lasts in my hair which is rare.  IGK Sold Out is exactly what my hair needs and it will likely replace the wave sprays I normally use.  It works far better.  I love this priming spray and absolutely recommend it.

title: This Shampoo is Fabulous!
text:
I wash my hair daily. I also use conditioner daily. For me, conditioner is more important than shampoo. I RARELY skip the conditioner. DOVE's Care and Protect Purify and Hydrate shampoo is a rare shampoo that I would use without conditioner. It works THAT well. An amount a bit smaller than a quarter is all it takes to clean my thick, shoulder length hair. It lathers quickly and is easy to massage into hair and rinse out as well. It does not weigh my hair down or cause it to look or feel oily/greasy. Quite the opposite. After washing, my hair is tangle free, incredibly soft and has some bounce and shine which it normally lacks and is frizz free! The dryness is replaced with desperately needed hydration.

I love this shampoo. It does a fantastic job of cleansing yet its gentle enough to use daily. And I do. I find the price incredibly reasonable and am happy to see its an Amazon 'subscribe and save' item. When not testing other shampoos for VINE reviews, this is now my 'go to' shampoo from now on. Absolutely recommended!

title: I'm Sold on the Benefits of Horse Oil!
text:
I did a double take when I came across CHARMZONE's Horse Oil Cream. Thought for sure I had misread the 'horse oil' part. I had not! I immediately Googled 'horse oil cream' and read the benefits of using it on human skin. Some of those benefits include: clearing eczema, wrinkles, fine lines, acne, elasticity and moisturizing. As someone with fair/dry/sensitive skin, I decided to give CHARMZONE a try.

This cream reminds me of vanilla pudding! lol. It looks like and has the consistency of pudding. It also as a very light scent that I cannot place for the life of me; its a great scent but doesn't last. A little cream goes a long way. Its easy to massage into skin and takes a few minutes to absorb. But when it is absorbed, it leaves behind only softness...no greasy/oily look or feel. It keeps my skin soft, smooth, hydrated (and it is a DEEP hydration!) and moisturized all day long. (I use it in the morning) It helps to calm down the patches of eczema I experience on my cheeks. My fine lines are noticeably reduced thanks to CHARMZONE cream. But I've not yet used it long enough to experience a noticeable change in skin elasticity. I dont' have issues with acne or wrinkles on my face (other than fine lines) so I cannot comment as to how this cream works on either.

For those interested in packaging, the jar comes in a pretty neat thick, round cardboard box. The jar itself is a nice, thick glass w/a cute label and very little writing.

I'm sold on horse oil cream! I liked this cream from the moment I applied it for the first time. I'm pleased with the results I've experienced in such a short time. I will continue to use this cream. It does wonders for my skin.

title: Works Great! Gentle, Yet Effective
text:
I have dry, sensitive skin. I was a tad concerned the peppermint oil ingredient might cause a negative reaction. Nope. All is well with Brittanie's Facial Toner! I use it first thing in the morning after washing my face and before I use a moisturizer. Its gentle and feels nice on my skin. Dryness is replaced with hydration. It applies well and absorbs quickly and doesn't cause my skin to look or feel oily/greasy. Has a very light, pleasant scent though it doesn't last long.

This is a really great toner with fantastic ingredients. Good price as well. Recommended.

title: An Exceptional Conditioner
text:
I usually end my reviews mentioning if I think the price of the item being reviewed is reasonable. I'm doing the opposite with this review of Pureology's Strength Cure Strengthening Conditioner for Damaged, Color-Treated hair.

This conditioner is worth every penny of the price. Not only does it do everything it promises to do for my hair, it does so in a huge way. My hair is shoulder length and thick. Its also dry, damaged, color-treated and thinning around the scalp due to aging. Pureology makes my hair stronger. I know this because there is never any hair in the shower drain or on my hair brush. Dry hair is replaced with well -hydrated, moisturized, unbelievably soft hair. Frizzy hair is eliminated as are fly-aways. Shine and bounce, two things my hair lacks are the result of using this conditioner. Thinning hair around my scalp becomes fuller. Hair color remains; it doesn't strip or fade. And my hair smells fantastic! My hair rarely maintains scents from scented hair products. Not with Pureology. The scent lasts in my hair and I even got 2 compliments about it on the same day! The scent of this conditioner is outstanding!

Using this Pureology conditioner is like going back in time to my childhood hair...before I used hair dye, curling iron, hair dryer, various products, sun damage...back to the time when my hair was untouched and not damaged. Excellent results, little conditioner needed to adequately cover hair and fast results make this conditioner worth every penny of the price.

title: Awesome!
text: This conditioner works wonders on flat, dull hair.  With the first use it revives hair, giving it extra body and fullness.  Its nice and lightweight; easy to massage into hair and just as easy to rinse out.  Hair color isn't stripped and does not fade making this a great conditioner for those with color treated hair. Until I tried this, I had no clue conditioners can contain salt!  This conditioner, does not. Its also free of sulfates and surfactant. Its nice and lightweight and does not weigh hair down or cause it to look or feel oily/greasy.  There is a scent with this conditioner and its awesome. Unfortunately, it doesn't last very long in my hair. By the time my hair is dry after washing, the scent is gone as well.  This is a fantastic conditioner and I do find the price to be reasonable based on the great results, the bottle size , the fact that only a small amount of conditioner is needed to adequately hair and it's gentle enough to use daily.

title: What's Not To Love? This Cleanser is Amazing!
text:
'Come Clean Face Wash is the ideal facial cleanser with targeting effects for dry and oily skin'.

That is a direct quote from the information above for Come Clean Face Wash. And its 100% accurate. I have dry, sensitive skin. And Come Clean does wonders for it. You do not need to use much of the cleanser. The first time I tried it, I used WAY too much. An amount roughly the size of a dime is enough to wash my entire face/forehead. Its a bit on the thick side and incredibly creamy. Has a nice, light lather that is easy to rinse off. The first time I used it, I was amazed by the incredible softness of my skin I felt as I rinsed it off my face. My skin was so soft and smooth, it was as though I had used a moisturizing cream rather than a facial cleanser! My skin felt great and remained soft, smooth , moisturized and hydrated.

I experience no negative reactions with this facial cleanser. It works beautifully on my dry , sensitive skin. This cleanser is unscented, vegan and contains no parabens. I find the price reasonable and definitely recommend LA Beauty's Come Clean facial cleanser.

title: Good Combo of Clean Hair Products
text:
If you're looking for clean hair products, Nexxus' Clean & Pure shampoo , conditioner and scrub pack is worth considering. Both the shampoo and conditioner are lightweight and easy to work into hair/rinse out. After using both, my hair is left soft, silky and tangle free. My natural waves and curls are nice and my hair actually has bounce to it, something it normally lacks. There is a nice, light scent to both though it's pretty much gone by the time my hair dries.

My hair normally lacks shine and I really don't notice a difference /increase after using this shampoo and conditioner. I do use the scalp scrub but have not noticed any type of change/improvement.

Overall, this is a nice combo of clean hair products that work well.

title: Cirque Colors Does It Again!
text:
I'm a nail polish-aholic and Cirque Colors ranks up there as one of my favorite brands. You cannot go wrong with Cirque Colors. They deliver high -quality polishes and have a gorgeous variety of shades and textures. All polishes are hand poured, vegan, non-toxic and 10 free.

I saw a swatch of Cirque Colors' Oracle on YouTube and knew immediately I wanted it. Oracle is a beautiful navy blue polish with shimmer and its even prettier in person than in the video or photos. Oracle also happens to be a magnetic polish. I am not using a magnet with this polish. I love the shade the way it is, so my apologies as I cannot comment as to how it looks once a magnet has been used with it.

Oracle applies very well; nice and even. It dries quickly. While I've not been wearing it very long, so far, it hasn't chipped at all. (NONE of my other Cirque Color polishes chip either) I did apply 2 coats and then use polish remover just to see how well it comes off; it came right off easily.

I love this shade and its a Limited Edition shade so I better get moving and order another bottle before its gone for good! lol. If you're a fan of the color blue, this is a polish you're going to want in your collection.

title: Can't Go Wrong With Sally Hansen Polish!
text:
I've used Sally Hansen nail polishes for decades. (Love Sally's clear polish...the only brand of clear I use!) I find SH polishes to be salon quality yet inexpensive. Lips Tulips, the shade I received to test in the VINE program is from Sally's Color Therapy line of polishes. Argan oil is an ingredient in this polish and it provides nourishment and hydration to nails, something my nails DESPERATELY need! It comes in a nice, heavy bottle and has a nice size brush that applies polish evenly. The bristles stay in place as well-they don't bend in all different directions. I found the polish a tad on the thick side so I did have to wait a bit longer than normal to apply a second (and third) coat. Not the end of the world since I apply my polish at night while watching TV; that little bit of extra needed wasn't really a problem. Just wanted to mention it didn't dry quite as fast as other polishes I use. I had no issues with the polish chipping and no issues when I removed it from my nails-it came off easily.

Sally Hansen does it again! Another exceptional nail polish that I will get a lot of use out of and wear often.

title: Not Enough Positive Results To Continue Use...
text:
L'Oreal Paris EverPure Moisture Sulfate-Free conditioner (for colored hair) does a decent enough job on my color-treated hair. Its easy to apply to hair, has a nice scent and washes from hair easily. It does a nice job of protecting my hair color; doesn't strip it or cause it to fade. While it doesn't weigh my hair down, it also doesn't make my hair terribly soft or moisturized. My hair is a bit on the dry side after using this conditioner and I must use a leave-in to not only soften and moisturize but to help with the tangles that are still in my hair after using this conditioner.

I don't experience enough positive results from this conditioner to warrant continued use of it. Its just not the best fit for my hair.

title: This is an Excellent Toner
text: I love the way LuxeJoie's Ginseng Mineral toner feels  on my skin! Its lightweight, cool and refreshing with a scent that I didn't quite like the first time I smelled it but soon after, fell in love with.  I use this toner after bathing each night. (LuxeJoie recommends using this once during the day and once at night. I only use it at night) It immediately softens my skin and helps reduce the appearance of pores.  I spray it onto a facial sponge and then apply it. I"m always amazed at the dirt that comes off onto the sponge. I literally use this toner right after bathing and washing my face. Based on the dirt on the sponge, I obviously don't get my face clean enough from washing alone.! Absorption is super fast and leaves no greasy/oily look or feel behind.  I have  sensitive skin and have no burning, itching, etc using this toner. It really does a wonderful job in my nightly skin care routine.  The bottle is  a good size , the toner delivers excellent results and the ingredient list (I recommend taking a minute to read over the ingredient list and what each does for skin above in the description) is impressive.  I find the price to be reasonable and recommend this skin toner as part of your skin care regimen.

title: Works Well on Dry, Damaged Thick Hair
text: I fully expected to be blown away by Pureology Hydrate Moisturing conditioner.  I wasn't. Don't get me wrong, it does an excellent job of softening and hydrating my dry, damaged, color treated thick  hair. But it didn't blow me away.  Its easy to apply to hair and rinse out. Does a nice job of de-tangling as well.  At first, I didn't like the mint scent and found it a bit overwhelming.  Once my hair was completely dry, the mint scent had diminished a great deal and was just a light, pleasant scent. I don't mind the cold feeling that occurs when the conditioner sits on my hair thanks to the mint and menthol ingredients. I actually like that feeling. And it didn't cause any issues with my sensitive skin. I was  a bit worried the mint/menthol might irritate my skin...nope.  This is a great conditioner for color treated, thick hair. Its not the best I've ever tried but it works well.

title: What a Trio!
text: My hair has been through a lot recently...I've suffered hair loss due to stress, dry/damaged hair, color treated and thinning due to aging. My natural waves/curls have a tendency to become frizzy easily. My hair lacks shine and bounce as well. Lasio's trio of keratin infused shampoo, conditioner and masque revives my hair, quenches the dryness, fights the frizzies and gives my hair some shine and bounce that it doesn't  achieve on its own. All 3 are easy to apply to hair and rinse out as well. Hair doesn't look or feel oily, greasy or weighed down by these products.  All have a fabulous scent that actually remains in my hair for some time.  I especially like the masque-I let it sit on my hair for 15 minutes and after I use it, its as though my  hair from my younger years is back.  The hair I had before I began to use hair color, hair spray, curling irons/hair dryers, before I aged, before it thinned, fell out due to stress.  The hair I had when it was still untouched.  That's a great feeling to have! Now that warmer weather is finally here, I'll really get good use from Lasio's trio. I know its going to tame the frizzy hair I experience when the temps outside are hot and humid.  This kit has done wonders for my damaged hair.

title: SO Pretty in Pink!
text:
I'm a nail polish junkie ("polish hoarder", according to my husband lol). Sally Hansen is a brand of polish I've been using since high school. Its inexpensive, yet delivers high quality results. Insta-Dri Pink Aurora is from SH's 'Prismatic Shine' collection. Its also a '3-in-1' polish, meaning it has a base and top coat already in the polish. Pink Aurora dries within 60 seconds of application, however it did take a bit longer than 60 seconds to completely dry for me. This pink is such a gorgeous shade. Not too dark, not too light. Pink and purple glitter really makes this polish stand out. I absolutely LOVE it! I had no issues applying the polish. The brush is a nice size and pretty much covers the entire nail with one stroke. I had no issues with the polish chipping. I did do a test and applied 3 coats and then used polish remover and the polish came off easily.

This particular polish shade can also be used as a top coat for other polishes.

You can't beat the price of this polish! It is SO very reasonable. If you're a fan of pink, I really believe you'll like Pink Aurora! (My apologies for the photos. My cell camera stinks. It doesn't come close to doing this polish justice. I'm wearing 3 coats of Pink Aurora + a clear top coat. I know the top coat isn't necessary with this polish but I liked the bit of extra shine it added. And please ignore my gross bunion and the scratch on my foot. lol )

title: Dynamic Duo!
text:
I have thick, shoulder length hair. I do have thinning in the hair around my scalp due to aging. In addition, my hair is dry, dull and color treated. My natural waves/curls turn into a frizzy mess in heat and humidity or when my hair is exceptionally dry.

Nuspa's shampoo is nice and creamy. An amount roughly the size of a dime is all it takes to clean all my hair. It massages well and lathers quickly. Rinsing it is easy as well. The conditioner is also nice and creamy and easy to apply to hair. I let it sit for 10 minutes before rinsing. It also rinses without issue. After using this dynamic duo, my hair is left incredibly soft, moisturized and shiny, something it normally lacks. My curls and waves stay in place nicely and do not turn into a big frizzy mess. I don't have hair to clean out of the shower drain or comb after using these which is awesome! My thinning hair becomes noticeably fuller as well. Both products have a wonderful scent to them and to my surprise, I can still smell it in my hair after a good deal of time has passed. That doesn't happen often for me, my hair rarely holds the scent of hair products.

I've not used Nuspa long enough to experience any type of new hair growth. I do know it makes my hair stronger since I have hair to clean out of the shower or comb. I don't have dandruff so I cannot comment as to how well Nuspa works on it. I do have dry, sensitive skin and have absolutely no problems with Nuspa on my skin.

For those interested in packaging, the bottles come in a handy plastic tote bag (small), perfect to use if you're taking Nuspa along while traveling. I was impressed with how well the pump dispensers were packaged -lots of bubble wrap and thick tape on the pumps to keep them safe during shipping. (And it worked! They arrived in perfect condition) I had no issues with the pumps on either bottle; they both were use to easy and dispensed a good amount of the product.

I'm more than satisfied and impressed with Nuspa shampoo and conditioner. I don't need to use much of either so both bottles will last quite some time. This, along with the very good results I receive from this duo makes the price more than reasonable. Quite honestly, I would have expected the price to be higher for as well as these products work. I definitely recommend both and hope it works as well on your hair as it does mine!

title: Hair Felt and Looked Weighed Down
text:
I very much like Maximilian's Biotin and Collagen shampoo. Its silky and creamy. Just a small amount, roughly the size of a dime is all I need when washing my shoulder length hair. It massages into hair and lathers immediately and really feels nice. As I rinsed the shampoo and ran my fingers to help guide the lather and water out, I could feel how soft my hair had become. Had I only used the shampoo I think my hair would have turned out great. But after I rinsed the shampoo, I applied the conditioner. And, to my surprise, I wasn't terribly impressed. It was a bit 'syrupy' and I had to use more conditioner than I normally do to sufficiently cover my hair. After it sat on my hair for a good 10 minutes, I rinsed it out as I had the shampoo. And when I used my fingers to guide the water and conditioner out, I could feel tangles in my hair. Not terribly big tangles, but tangles that hadn't been there previously. When my hair dried (I air dry), it looked and felt a bit weighed down. My curls and waves weren't as prominent as usual. I wound up having to put my hair in a clip instead of wearing it down as I usually do. And , yes...I definitely rinsed all of the conditioner out of my hair. I didn't leave any behind.

Both the shampoo and conditioner have nice, light scents that I really do like very much. The scents do not last long at all.

I do like this shampoo and would continue to use it, but not the conditioner. Since its suggested they be used together, I've given both bottles to my mom. Hopefully, she'll have better luck. I have tried and still do use some of Maximilian's other hair care products with excellent results and I will continue to use them. This particular (pomegranate) product just isn't the right fit for my hair and I have no plans to continue using it.

title: One of the BEST Leave-Ins...EVER!
text:
Pureology's Colour Fanatic Leave-In conditioner is truly one of the best leave-in conditioners I've ever tried. And, believe me, I've tried A LOT! I use this leave-in on my newly washed hair while its damp. 3-4 sprays sufficiently covers my shoulder length hair. It de-tangles hair-no pulling or tugging and no hair loss while trying to battle tangles. It helps maintain my color treated hair while keeping my natural waves and curls soft , smooth and frizz free. My hair lacks shine; this leave-in delivers shine to hair just as it promises to do. It does all of these things without weighing hair down or causing it to look or feel oily/greasy.

What a fabulous scent this spray has! I love it. Unfortunately, it is not long lasting. Also fabulous is the ingredients, including: camelina, coconut and olive oils, sunflower seeds and Vitamin E, to name a few. But do not worry, you wont' find parabens, sulfates, mineral oil or animal products in this amazing spray.

This is a wonderful leave-in conditioner that delivers the results it promises to and I absolutely recommend it.

title: WOW...This is One AMAZING Cream!
text:
I'm going to start out with an FYI. Be VERY careful when you open the jar of cream upon delivery. There is NO safety seal under the lid. When I opened the jar for the first time, a decent amount of cream just poured down the sides of the jar.

That is the only negative thing I have to say about Shea Radiance's Shea Butter Cream-Lavender Bliss. Because it IS bliss! Pure bliss when it touches my skin. The consistency reminds me of Greek vanilla yogurt. Its easy to apply and does not weigh heavily on skin or cause it to look or feel oily or greasy. It absorbs quickly. And when it does, skin is left incredibly soft and smooth. I experience flareups of eczema. In the instant Shea Radiance touches the eczema inflamed skin, it is immediately calmed and soothed. The burning/itching is alleviated. Its gentle enough that the kids use it as well. Even my husband has used it on his extremely rough, dry elbows with exceptional results.

I prefer to use the cream after bathing as its recommended it be used on damp skin. I do use a tiny amount on my face again before bedtime some nights as well, just because my skin is dry and needs extra moisturizing. I have terribly sensitive skin and have no bad reactions to this cream at all.

There is a lovely lavender scent and its not at all gagging or overpowering. It actually lasts for awhile too!

The high quality shea butter, collodial oatmeal, lavender and rice bran oil ingredients help to make this one amazing cream. Its perfect for daily use, for those with sensitive skin, babies/children, sunburn relief pregnancy/post-pregnancy use as well. I WILL continue to purchase this cream and use it as part of my skin regimen. I already bought a jar for my mom because I know she will love it as much as I do. I VERY HIGHLY recommend Shea Radiance cream. (Be careful when opening the lid!)

title: Noticeable Results With the Very First Use
text:
What a difference this conditioner makes in my hair. The very first time I tried L'Oreal Paris' Ever Pure Purple Conditioner, I could see a noticeable reduction to the brassiness in my blond hair. It did take a few uses to get all of my hair the same, even tone and now its exactly as it should be. It doesn't just neutralize the brassiness; in addition, it softens, hydrates and nourishes hair. I never have tangles after using it either. It has a nice scent to it though it doesn't last long at all. By the time my hair dries (I air dry), I can no longer smell the scent. Its easy to work into as well as rinse from hair.

I have very dry, sensitive skin and have no negative reactions using this conditioner. It does contain purple dye but I also have no issues with the dye coloring my hair/skin purple. I don't need to use much conditioner at all to sufficiently cover my shoulder length hair and with the bottle being 33oz, this will last me quite some time!

Its wonderful to have that uneven brassy blond out of my hair. I use this conditioner once a week and am thrilled with with it. For the amazing and fast results it delivers and the huge size bottle, I find the price more than reasonable and definitely recommend it for those with color treated, blonde, bleached, silver and brown w/highlights hair.

title: I Just Love What This Masque Does For My Skin (my sensitive skin!)
text:
The night I tested LuxeJoie's Aloe & Azulene Gel Masque for the first time, I followed the directions and allowed it to remain on my newly cleansed face for 15 minutes before removing it with a warm washcloth. I have very fair skin which is also dry and very sensitive. I also happened to be experiencing a flareup of eczema the first night I used this masque as well. Though the eczema flareup wasn't one of my worst, the first thing i noticed after removing the masque was that my skin felt and looked soothed. The red inflammation I'd had on my cheeks was FAR calmer and the slight itching/burning sensation that comes with a flareup was gone. My skin was cool, calmer, soft and smooth.

I now use the masque a few per week. (3, at most) And its like going to a spa. I feel as though I'm pampering myself when I use this masque. It feels nice while applied to my skin but REALLY makes my skin feel wonderful once removed. I immediately experience a decrease in my fine lines. My skin has a suppleness to it that it did not have before. I don't know if its a coincidence but I've also not had an eczema flareup at all since I've begun to use this masque routinely.

I' really wasn't super surprised to discover how well this masque works and how much I love it. LuxeJoie makes a night cream that I just LOVE and now I love this masque as well. It does wonders for my skin and literally did so the very first time I ever tried it. This is a 'keeper' for me. This is a masque I'll continue to use in my skin care regimen. It causes no negative interactions with my skin sensitivity. It doesn't take much masque to cover my face (I don't use it on my neck though it can be used there) and because I apply it 2-3 times per week, the jar will last me quite some time. I find the price more than reasonable seeing as it delivers wonderful results. The scent isn't my favorite but it is gone as soon as the masque is removed so its not at all an issue for me. HIGHLY recommended!

title: SheaMoisture Knows How to Care For Hair!
text: Another winning combo from SheaMoisture. I've used various SheaMoisture products over the years and, WOW... does SM know how to do hair care! And that definitely includes the Manuka Honey & Yogurt Shea shampoo + conditioner duo.  The shampoo is nice and creamy. Not much is needed to cover my shoulder length hair. It lathers easily, doesn't weigh hair down and rinses without issue.  The conditioner feels nice while it sits on my hair. It rinses easily as well and de-tangles without weighing hair down or making it look or feel oily/greasy.  As my hair air-dried, my curls and waves were nice and smooth as well as soft and silky.  My dry hair was quenched and moisturized and both felt and looked good.  I don't have a huge problem with split-ends so I cannot comment as to how well it works on them but I know this duo strengthens and repairs my hair as I didn't have to scoop any out of the shower drain or my brush after using both.  Each  product has a lovely, light scent. How I wish it would be long lasting but its pretty much gone once my hair dries completely.  Definitely a duo I will continue to use and I hope it works as well for your hair as it does mine.

title: What an Amazing Duo
text:
Coco & Jengibre (coconut and ginger) shampoo and conditioner work SO well together to make hair clean, healthy and shiny. The shampoo smells fabulous. Only a small amount is needed to clean the scalp and hair. A dime size amount is more than sufficient to take care of my thick, shoulder length hair. It lathers quickly and easily and rinses without issue. The conditioner is thicker and luxurious. Feels good while sitting on hair. I do use a larger amount of conditioner-roughly the size of a half dollar. As I rinse, I can feel my hair is soft and de-tangled. When my hair dries (I air dry), I'm left with soft, silky hair that doesn't frizz but instead, is nice and smooth. My natural waves and curls are as they should be. And boy, does my hair ever shine, something it normally lacks. And the shine is actually long lasting! It makes me happy to add that the wonderful scent of this duo actually lasts in my hair! I can smell it the next day. I don't know if its just me, but my hair rarely holds the scent from hair products. This scent is long lasting without being overpowering or gagging.

This is an exceptional shampoo and conditioner duo. I honestly love everything about both and what they do for my hair. I believe the cost is reasonable and highly recommend both for your hair care needs.

title: Phenomenal Cream
text:
Prior to testing Brandless Coconut Water Body Butter, not only had I never before tried a Brandless product, I'd never even heard of the Brandless brand! But boy, am I ever a fan now because this body butter is phenomenal! Its light and creamy and my dry, very sensitive skin drinks it up quickly. The absorption rate is so incredibly fast and it doesn't leave my skin feeling or looking oily or greasy. My skin is immediately softened, hydrated and moisturized, all results it desperately needs since its so dry and I have no negative reactions to the butter due to my sensitivity issues.

There is a wonderful scent to this body butter though it pretty much vanishes once absorbed.

Brandless is a company obviously passionate about what they put-and what they don't put in their products. This body butter contains shea butter and coconut which are awesome for skin. But what it DOES NOT contain is what is really impressive. Brandless has banned 400+ 'questionable ingredients' from their products as well as parabens, Phthalates, gluten. Their products are vegan and cruelty free as well.

I love this body butter. Its incredible. The price is ridiculously low for as well as it works! Once I finish this container, I'll absolutely order more. Definitely recommended. Hope your skin loves it as much as mine does!

title: Didn't Do Much For My Feet
text:
The bottoms of my feet are awful. The dry, cracked skin looks like funky fish scales. I recently tried an electric callus remover with little results. I've tried a few other foot peels in the past; some with good results, others not so good. Unfortunately, Kastu Foot Peel falls in the latter group. It didn't do much to improve my feet.

The process is quite easy. (The instructions are on the back of the box. I did notice it says to keep the mask 'socks' on 20-30 minutes near the top of the instructions but at the bottom, it says 1 hour. In the product info at the top of this page, it clarifies 20-30 minutes up to a max of 1 hour) The box contains 4 mask 'socks', enough for 2 treatments. Make sure your feet are clean prior to use. The mask material is already in the socks, you have nothing to add. As someone with terribly dry, sensitive skin I experienced no negative reaction from the mask material..no burning, itching, etc. Pull the 'socks' apart and cut the top of each to open. Stick a foot in each sock and seal with a sticker (included). Make sure to press the 'sock' onto the foot so it fits perfectly, ensuring the mask cream covers your feet. I kept it on for a full hour due to the severity of my cracked heels. Regardless of the time you keep the socks on your feet, once socks are removed, wash your feet.

I'm guessing everyone's 'peels' are different. The day after I used the mask, my feet looked exactly the same. The following day I had no peeling until I bathed. When I dried off, I noticed my toes and between my toes were peeling on both feet. I was able to easily pull off strips of skin. Don't worry, its completely pain free. The rest of my feet had light flakes so small, I couldn't pull them off. Same result the next day. Other than my toes, no other part of my feet peeled at all. My feel are definitely dry and callused; its not a matter of my not having skin to come off, I definitely do.

The Katsu foot peel barely worked for me. I will not use it again.

title: Limited Results
text:
This is my first ever PrettyParty product. It also happens to be the first time I've ever heard of the PrettyParty brand. The RENEW Blue Agave Anti-Aging Moisturizer cream that I tested has some good and not so good features to it. Overall, I find it to do a decent job on skin though I do find it on the pricey side. PrettyParty definitely nailed the packaging aspect. It arrives in a nice gift box. Included, is a gift pouch. The glass jar is quite pretty with very little writing. (expiration: 12/2022) The lid is nice and solid, fits the jar well and protects the cream. A pretty zinc spatula is also included. The cream itself is a lovely, light blue shade.

Pros:

-The cream has a light, whipped consistency. It does take a bit longer to absorb into my skin (which is dry and sensitive) but it does fully absorb. (We're talking 15-20 minutes for full absorption)

-The cream immediately softens and hydrates my terribly dry skin

-I have no negative issues with my skin sensitivity from this cream

-It doesn't weigh heavily or cause my skin to look or feel oily/greasy

-While it takes a bit longer than other products, I do notice a reduction in my fine lines

-Dark circles under my eyes are lightened by using the cream though I only noticed a difference after putting the cream in the fridge

Cons:

-I've not noticed firmness to my skin

-While it does help to lighten dark circles, I've not really noticed a brightness to my skin

-I definitely do not look younger

This isn't the right cream for me. Between the price and the limited results/benefits it delivers, its not a cream that I will continue to purchase and use. (Had I been able to rate using half stars, I would have given this two and a half stars. Since I can't, I rounded up to 3 stars.)

title: Aloe-My Fave in the Garnier Fructis 'Treat' Haircare Line!
text:
This aloe duo just might be my favorite out of all of the shampoo/conditioner duos offered by Garnier Fructis Treat hair care line. Both smell fantastic, the though the scent is on the mild side and doesn't last long at all. I wish it did...its nice and refreshing! The shampoo lathers easily and rinses out easily as well. The conditioner felt good as soon as I massaged it into my hair. I had colored my roots 2 nights before trying the conditioner and my head was a bit itchy. It was immediately soothed and relieved once I added the conditioner. As I rinsed, I ran my fingers through my wet hair to guide all of the conditioner out and could already feel how soft and tangle free my hair was. When it dried (I air dry), my hair was hydrated, soft, smooth and shiny. No frizz anywhere to be found. My natural waves and curls were exactly as they should be.

This is a wonderful shampoo and conditioner duo that does a beautiful job of hydrating, reviving and even healing hair. In both cases, a little goes a long way. I don't need to use much of either product to sufficiently take care of my thick, shoulder length hair. And the conditioner can be used as a conditioner, a mask or leave-in. I'm very pleased with both and recommend them. (I also recommend taking a second to look over the list of ingredients in both...pretty impressive!) And give the sample of Garnier's Micellar Cleansing Water a try. It works very well on skin.

title: Such A Gorgeous Shade!
text: I'm a nail polish-aholic with well over 1200 bottles of nail polish in my collection. ZOYA brand polish is one of my favorite brands and I have many ZOYA polishes. ISA is easily one of my favorite shades.  Its a deep blueish-purple with beautiful shimmer that gives nails a hint of sparkle.  The majority of my polish collection is blue since its my favorite color. ISA is easily one of my favorite blue shades.  The polish is easy to apply. It goes on evenly and dries evenly as well. I have no issues removing it as well and I've NEVER experienced chipping of the polish at all.  I do 2 coats of ISA with a top coat of clear for a bit of added shine.  Its absolutely gorgeous.

title: Love This So Much (and WOW, does it ever smell fabulous!)
text:
I'm nothing but impressed with the Paul Mitchell Clean Beauty line of hair care products. The anti-frizz conditioner is no exception.

This is a creamy conditioner that is easy to massage into newly washed hair. The instructions say to use a small amount and a small amount is all I need to cover my thick, shoulder length hair. The conditioner feels nice as it sits on my hair. It rinses easily, does not weigh hair down and de-tangles. When my hair dries (I air dry) its soft and has 2 things going for it that it normally lacks: bounce and shine. Can't tell you how nice that is to see! My natural waves and curls look so very nice and smooth and are miraculously frizz FREE!

The scent of this conditioner is, hands down, easily one of the BEST scents I've ever had it a hair care product. Sadly, it doesn't stick around very long in my hair. (By the time my hair is dry, the scent is all but gone) I honestly wish my hair smelled like this 24/7.

I'm pleased with the results I experienced using Paul Mitchell's Clean Beauty Anti-Frizz conditioner. So pleased, I set up a 'subscribe and save' order for this conditioner. I won't use it daily but plan on using it once a week as a mask treatment. It works and smells great and I definitely recommend it it you need help taming frizzy hair.

title: Didn't Remove Very Much
text:
The bottom of my feet are so dry and cracked, the skin looks like funky fish scales. I think my feet are just too severely cracked and dry because I didn't have much luck with this callus remover.

This kit comes with an electric callus remover, a USB cable (a fully charge takes nearly 3 1/2 hours for 30 minutes worth of use) and 3 roller heads. The device is comfortable to hold and easy to turn off/on. It can be rinsed under water but should not be fully submerged in water.

Its easy to use. Either submerge feet in warm water for 10 minutes or keep feet dry and clean prior to use. Simply place the device on the affected area, turn it on and move it around slowly. Do NOT press hard on the skin. Feel should be moisturized after each use of the remover.

I followed the directions. Many times, the roller stopped turning while in use and shut off. I had to continuously turn it back on again (Yes, it was fully charged at the time). With each use, the remover only removed a VERY small amount of skin into a tiny pile of what looked like dust. I never really achieved much of a noticeable improvement throughout the time I used the remover. I do not know how well this remover works on feet less dry and cracked than mine, by my feet are apparently too severe for this device.

title: Does a Really Nice Job on Dry Hair
text: Garnier Fructis' Nourishing Treat shampoo & conditioner duo does a really nice job of hydrating and softening hair.  Both are light and easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse out.  Hair is left moisturized, soft and shiny. Neither products weighs hair down or causes it to look or feel oily/greasy.  There is a very light scent to both though it vanishes from my hair by the time it dries. The conditioner can be used as a mask, a leave in or a regular rinse out conditioner. (I've used it both as a mask and rinse out but not a leave-in)  Overall, this is a good duo that work well together to help heal and hydrate dry hair.

title: Works Very Well Defining Curls (has a great scent too!)
text: I ordered this for my husband to help define his curls.  He cut his hair months ago short....VERY short. When it grew back, his usual thick curls weren't nearly as curly as normal.  He never had that problem before following  a haircut.  BEVEL Curl Cream is a lightweight cream that does indeed help define his curls. His curls look much better and somewhat like they used to prior to the short haircut. And the curls do last all day.  The cream has an awesome scent to it as well.  He has no skin sensitivity to BEVEL and is pleased with the results he gets from  using this curl cream.

title: My Hair NEEDS This Mask!
text:
If you're looking for help for your dry, damaged hair your search is over. IL Salone Milano Professional Supreme Mask For Dry to Damaged Hair is a wonderful mask that heals, replenishes and revives hair and does so with the very first use.

I applied the mask to my newly shampooed hair. A scoop, roughly the size of a ping pong ball sufficiently covered my thick, shoulder length hair. While the directions say to keep the mask on hair for 5 minutes, I left it on closer to 10-15 minutes. It was easy to apply and work through my hair and just as easy to rinse out. When my hair was dry (I air dry), it was soft, silky and smooth. My natural waves and curls were perfectly in place and free of fly-aways and frizz. My hair had shine and bounce, two things it normally lacks. Though not very strong, there was a light and fresh scent to my hair, courtesy of this mask.

IL Salone Milano mask healed and revived my dry, damaged hair with the very first use. This mask works and it works VERY well. The jar is HUGE and will last me quite some time. Thanks to the exceptional, fast results and the fact that it doesn't take much mask to adequately cover my hair, I find the cost to be absolutely reasonable. (Quite honestly, I would have thought this mask would cost more than it does!) Without a doubt, this is a mask I WILL continue to use and purchase. I absolutely recommend it to anyone experiencing dry, damaged hair. Hope it works as well on your hair as it does mine!

title: Delivers Results With the Very First Use
text: My dry, damaged hair practically inhaled SheaMoisture's Silicone Free Conditioner for Dry Hair.  This creamy conditioner hydrated, moisturized and breathed much needed life into my hair and did so with the first use. Its easy to work into hair and just as easy to rinse. It doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look/feel oily or greasy.  I let it sit on my hair for about 10  minutes before rinsing. When my hair was dry (I air dry), my curls and waves were soft, shiny and bouncy. My hair was well hydrated. It looked good and had much needed bounce and shine to it as well.  Some of the ingredients in this conditioner, including marshmallow root and meadowfoam are new to me but I'm definitely a fan.  There is a nice, light scent to the conditioner though it was pretty much gone by the time my hair was dry.  I love this brand and I absolutely love and recommend SheaMoisture's Silicone Free Conditioner for Dry Hair.

title: Does a Decent Job...But Nothing Out of the Ordinary
text:
I was super excited to try watermelon hair care products for the first time. I think I've tried just about every other fruit-based hair care product except for watermelon. Unfortunately, I wasn't blown away. Both Garnier's Fructis Plumping Watermelon shampoo and conditioner did a nice job on my hair. The shampoo easily works into a lather and does a good job of cleaning hair. The conditioner is also easy to massage into hair. It did a good job of de-tangling as it sat on my hair for a few minutes. I had no issues washing either out. After my hair dried (air-dry), I just didn't notice a difference. My hair didn't appear 'plumped' or fuller. My natural waves and curls looked nice but nothing out of the ordinary. My hair was soft and smooth and not at all weighed down.

This duo did a nice job on my hair but nothing special. Both have a nice scent-reminds me of watermelon jelly rings (candy) though the scent didn't last long in my hair. (I VERY much liked the sample of Garnier Micellar Cleansing Water that was included.) Overall, a decent shampoo and conditioner though I won't purchase Garnier watermelon. Many of Garnier's other products deliver excellent results, so I"ll continue to use/purchase those rather than this watermelon product.

title: How I Love PM's Clean Beauty Line
text:
Three for three! A perfect tri-fecta! I've had the pleasure of testing/reviewing 3 products from Paul Mitchell's Clean Beauty line. Everyday Leave-In (love this so much, I signed up for 'subscribe and save' after only one use!) , Repair Leave-In and now, Everyday Conditioner. An amount roughly the size of a half dollar sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair. This conditioner is a rinse out conditioner ; you can apply it and rinse immediately or apply and allow it to sit on hair for 3-5 minutes before rinsing as a mask treatment. That is how I use it. Its easy to massage into hair and also easy to rinse out. It does not cause hair to feel weighed down or look/feel oily or greasy. Everyday Conditioner consists of 94% natural origin ingredients (grown on a bio-dynamic farm!), including aloe and argan oil, this conditioner leaves hair soft, smooth, tangle free and shiny! My hair lacks shine so it thrills me that this conditioner delivers it.

There is a light citrus eucalyptus scent, however, it doesn't last long in my hair. Its pretty much gone by the time my hair dries.

I am so very pleased with this conditioner as well as the other 2 products from this line I tested. Works wonders on my dry, damaged hair.

title: Pretty Impressive
text:
I'm pretty impressed with Denoue's Drench Conditioner. Its a creamy, thick-ish conditioner that is easy to apply and massage into hair. The directions recommend letting it sit on hair for 'a few minutes, or longer'. After washing my hair and applying Denoue conditioner, I let it sit on my hair for 10 minutes. It rinsed easily and without issue. I know my hair had a decent size tangle in it prior to washing-when I finished my shower, Denoue had removed the tangle and my hair was tangle free. When my hair was dry (I air dry), it was soft, smooth and well hydrated. My hair had a nice fullness as well. My natural waves and curls looked as they always do-no difference at all.

Two extremely minor 'issues'. There is a bit of a scent to this conditioner though I can't place it. Weird as this sounds (Keep in mind, I do have a nasal cyst that at times affects my sense of smell) when I sniffed the conditioner after removing the cap, I thought I smelled a FAINT whiff of orange. When I massaged it into my hair, the scent seemed almost medicinal. (faintly) At any rate, the scent doesn't last at all. I could no longer smell anything once my hair was dry. The conditioner arrived packaged well. It was in a plastic bag, surrounded by plastic air filled bags (for cushioning/protection during shipping)inside a box. Despite the good packaging, the pump on the bottle arrived broken. The bottle itself was fine and not one drop of conditioner had leaked. Because the scent doesn't last long and in light of the fact the bottle was fine and nothing leaked out, I'm not lowering my rating of the conditioner. Both are minor issues easily remedied.

Overall, this is a really good conditioner. I'm pretty impressed. If your hair needs hydration, I do recommend giving Denoue Drench Conditioner a try.

title: Works Great and Well Made
text:
I absolutely love how clean and revived my skin feels after using SQLHM's loofah/back scrubber loofah. I have terribly dry, sensitive skin. I've already used loofahs that were too harsh for my skin; even gentle scrubbing caused scratches on my skin. I don't have that problem with this loofah at all. Its nice and soft yet does a fantastic job of cleaning and exfoliating. Thanks to bamboo charcoal fiber infused in the loofah, it absorbs excess body oil and sweat. The loofahs are very well made and hold shape without coming apart. The back scrubber handle is is wooden (don't worry...its nice and smooth...no chance of splinters!) with a no-slip grip that makes cleaning your back or other 'hard to reach' areas easy.
