Included in this item is 2 loose loofahs, one attached to the wooden back scrubber handle and a handy hook that sticks to the shower tile from which to hang the loofah/back scrubber. For as well as this scrubber and loofahs work, I find the price absolutely reasonable and definitely recommend this loofah/back scrubber set!

title: Excellent Cream -Does What It Promises To Do
text:
This marks the first time I've ever tried a VELY VELY product and I sure hope its the first of many.

VV's Artemisia Return Cream is creamy and lightweight. A very small amount is all it takes to cover my face and forehead. Its easy to apply and my skin absorbs it completely within 15 minutes. It doesn't cause my skin to look or feel oily/greasy. Its very light brown in color (reminds me of a melted peanut butter! lol) and I detect no scent. It softens my skin immediately after applied but also hydrates and soothes my dry, sensitive skin right away as well.

VV contains Artemisia extract which helps soothe and calm skin. I am VERY new to this ingredient ; I've only used one other product containing it. It works wonders for my dry, sensitive skin. Glycerin is another ingredient in this cream and that helps balance and hydration of skin. Squalene is yet another ingredient and is one I'm totally unfamiliar with, so I did a quick look up and read up on it. It helps keep skin hydrated, making it yet another important ingredient for my damaged skin.

VV can be used on all skin types. I liked this product from the moment I tried it for the first time and I like it more and more each time I use it. It delivers the results it promises and does not irritate my sensitive skin in the process. Excellent cream and I absolutely recommend it.

title: Works Well Though No Huge Change to My Curls
text: Nexxus Curl Defining Moisturizing conditioner does a really good job of moisturizing and softening hair. Its easy to apply and rinse out of hair.  It left my hair soft and smooth, without frizz or fly-aways.  Tangles were eliminated and my hair smelled nice for awhile after washing as the conditioner has a very nice scent to it.  I can't really say I experienced defined curls after using it. My curls and waves looked normal. Overall, this is a good conditioner.  I do wish it had helped define my curls as my hair could use some help in that area.

title: SO Cute and They Work GREAT!
text:
I am so unbelievably pleased with ILTUY's 12 piece floral elastic hair ties!

The hair ties are shipped in a nice cardboard gift box, suitable for gifting. The ties come in four different colors: pink, purple, yellow and aqua, each with a cute and different flower pattern. You will receive 3 hair ties of each color for a total of 12 hair ties.

The material used for the ties is nice and soft and does not hurt when placing or removing from hair. They do not slip out of place and I do not get strands of hair popping out at all. Thanks to the interior elastic, the ties ARE stretchable. So far, I've had NO issues with the ties losing elasticity. They always go back to their normal shape after they are removed. You'll notice each tie has a knot at the end of the tie. The knots ARE adjustable so you CAN remove them and re-knot the tie to adjust the size to the hair type the tie will be holding. That makes the ties perfect for children and adults and the ties fit beautifully in my young daughter's hair as well as my thick, shoulder length hair. And....(drum roll, please) NO creases! ILTUY's hair ties do NOT cause creases in my hair like SO many other hair ties do! This is SUCH a treat for me. I am so appreciative of this feature!

These hair ties are well made. They're adjustable, the come in a variety of colors with cute flower patterns. They hold up very well. They keep creases out of hair. I find the price to be incredibly reasonable. We'll be using these hair ties often and I absolutely WILL order more when needed. DEFINITELY recommended!

title: Eh...Not Super Impressed
text:
Don't get me wrong... this is a good conditioner that does a nice job of hydrating and softening my hair. But its not a conditioner that I just HAVE to use again. It is lightweight- and easy to apply to hair/ easy to rinse as well. It does not weigh my hair down or make it look or feel oily/greasy. But it also doesn't do anything to my hair to make it stand out as many other TRESemme conditioners do. It has a light scent that isn't unpleasant but its also not the greatest. Thankfully, it doesn't last long.

I've had fantastic results from just about every other TRESemme conditioner I've never tried. And believe me, I've tried MANY of them. Full Fiber Volume conditioner just doesn't compare to the others and it not a conditioner I plan to use again.

title: My First Overnight...and I Am Thrilled With the Results!
text:
My very first overnight mask! I wasn't sure what to expect but it turns out, the process is easy peasy!

DOCTOR BABOR's Cleanformance Renewal Overnight Mask comes in a very sturdy tube. The opening is very thin. A light squeeze of the tube dispenses a thin line of mask cream. It is white and creamy and easy to apply. I only use an amount roughly the size of a dime to cover my face. After a 10 minute wait per the directions, I simply massage the cream into my face and then its off to bed. in the morning when I wake up, I wash my face and enjoy the results and benefits provided by the BABOR mask. My skin is incredibly smooth. The reddish, dry and chapped cheeks from the cold temps are calmed and soothed and without inflammation and itching. My skin actually has a bit of a shine to it, something it normally doesn't have. I'm starting to notice a bit of firmness to my skin that wasnt' there before. Its VERY mild but so far, so good. I can see the improvement. And my fine lines become a bit finer and thinner.

There is a light scent to this cream and its very pleasant. It KIND of reminds me a bit of baby lotion. At any rate, it doesn't last long. At no point does the cream feel heavy on my face. My skin does stay a tad wet overnight from the cream-almost like baby oil that hasn't been wiped off all the way. The feeling isn't unpleasant and I don't really notice it unless I touch my face. I'm a side sleeper so I have found a bit of the cream on the pillowcase in the morning but nothing horrific and it doesn't stain. In no way do this mask cause any issues with my dry, sensitive skin.

I'm beyond thrilled with this mask. I really am. I'm SO happy and pleased with the results. Because this is my first overnight mask, I really cannot compare the price to any other masks out there. But I WILL say based on my results and the fact that only a very small amount is needed for each use (to be used 1-2 times a week), I find the cost reasonable.

title: Works Great!
text:
Aweganics' Tea Tree Mint conditioner is a nice, thick hair conditioner that delivers great results. It feels great on my scalp-nice and soothing. I have dry, sensitive skin and for a second I was concerned that the peppermint oil ingredient might burn or irritate. It did not. Quite the opposite...the conditioner felt calming and soothing on my scalp. I was also briefly concerned about the thick consistency. As the conditioner sat on my hair, it did feel a tad heavy. When I rinsed it out (without issue), the consistency wasn't an issue. It did not weigh my hair down in the slightest. My natural waves and curls looked great and were nice and smooth and frizz free. My hair was nice and hydrated and had bounce. There is a nice peppermint scent and I found it to be light and not at all overpowering. It also didn't last long in my hair. By the time my hair was dry, the scent was gone.

I can't say that I noticed much shine to my hair but that's not a huge issue for me. It would be nice to have it, but its hardly the end of the world that I don't get it from this conditioner. This is a conditioner that CAN be used daily and on all types of hair. But that's not all. This conditioner can also be used (Are you ready for this...???) ...as a shaving lotion!!!!! I had to read that a couple of times, I thought for sure I wasn't understanding it right! lol. I have not used it to shave and have no plans to do so but I am fascinated by this feature! I do find the price to be a tad on the high side since the bottle is 8oz, but I DO recommend it. Should you try it and find you're not satisfied, Aweganics offers a hassle free full refund. This is a company that clearly believes in their product as well as customer satisfaction!

title: Excellent Results
text: Conditioner...leave -in conditioner...lip balm.  These are Palmer products that I use and love. Now I can add shampoo to the list.  This really is one heck of a shampoo. Its thick and creamy and lathers quickly and easily.  It rinses out of hair easily as well.  Its gentle yet does an exceptional job of cleaning , hydrating, softening and detangling hair. My hair color isn't affected negatively in any way. And boy, does it smell great! I've not yet used it long enough to notice any changes to the length of my hair but I will continue to use it.  It works and smells great and I absolutely find the price to be reasonable.

title: Repairs Hair and Does So Quickly
text:
This leave-in repair cream works wonders on my hair. Just a small amount-roughly the size of a nickel covers my thick, shoulder length hair. It hydrates, softens, moisturizes and heals and repairs my dry, damaged hair. It eliminates frizz. The cream itself is nice and light and doesn't weigh my hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. It has a nice, light refreshing scent as well.

Another reason I love this leave-in... "Handcrafted with 91% natural origin ingredients grown on a bio-dynamic farm that deliver professional results in 100% recyclable packaging for a heal your hair/heal the earth moment." (This is from the info above) Its wonderful for hair and wonderful for the environment. Talk about a win-win! However, at this time, I do not have any plans to continue to purchase this particular leave-in. Prior to trying this product, I tested/reviewed Paul Mitchell's Everyday Leave-In Treatment and loved it so very much, I immediately signed up for Amazon's 'subscribe and save' plan. I'm happy with the results it delivers.

title: My First Jhirmack Product...And I Like It! (LOVE the scent!)
text:
Jhirmack is a brand that has been around for a very long time. Even before I joined VINE, I always loved to try various hair care products. And yet, I cannot recall ever trying a hair care product by Jhirmack before. Its possible that I did, but if so, I don't remember. So I was looking forward to giving the 10-in 1 Leave-In conditioner spray a try. And I must say, I'm pretty impressed. Its a nice, light and airy spray that does not weigh my hair down or make it hard and crunchy. A decent amount is dispensed in mist form so 2-3 sprays is sufficient to cover my thick, shoulder length hair. Some ingredients include: macadamia oil, green tea extract, vitamins E & B5.

The 10 benefits the spray promises to do for hair are:

-moisturizes-- it does
-adds shine--I didn't notice any extra shine to my hair
-reduce frizz-I didn't experience frizz after using this leave -in though the regular conditioner I used while washing my hair was geared towards reducing frizz as well
-softens-does a pretty nice job of softening hair
-prevents breakage-I've not had to remove a lot of hair from the shower drain or my brush since using this
-smooths-it does...and no flyaways
-detangles-does a nice job of detangling
-prevents breakage-I've not had to remove a lot of hair from the shower drain or my brush
-conditions-it does
-protects from heat-I don't use a hair dryer or curling iron so I cannot comment how well it protects from heat

How I LOVE the scent of this leave in! Its light but SO good!

Overall, this is a pretty impressive leave-in that works well and does so quickly. Its geared towards those with grey or blonde hair and can be used on wet or dry hair. (I' only use it on wet hair) I like this leave-in and I'm glad it finally tried a Jhirmack hair product. I do recommend this leave in.

title: Fun, Cute,  Does a Great Job (Say goodbye to static!)
text: I ordered the Yyclgvca comb because I thought it would be cute and fun to use. And it is. But it has some great benefits  as well.  It is made of plastic and very comfortable to use.  It glides through wet/damp/dry hair, is unisex and can be used by both adult and children.  It doesn't hurt or yank hair while in use and combing through tangles is  a breeze.  Its VERY durable and the size is perfect for a purse, gym bag/locker, makeup bag, etc. The comb sits upright and looks cute on a bathroom counter when not in use. But the feature I especially love and appreciate about this comb is that it keeps static away.  From the moment the heat is turned on in our  home,  at some point in autumn through spring, every single morning I rub a fabric softener sheet through my hair to keep static away, otherwise my hair stands on end.  I no longer have to do that thanks to this comb. I am so happy I ordered it.  Everyone in the house uses it. I'm looking forward to using it this summer to comb through wet hair after spending the day at the pool. Definitely recommended!

title: Works AND Smells Great!
text:
I was a bit concerned that my husband wouldn't care for the lime and cedarwood scent in DOVE's Men + Care 2 in 1 shampoo and conditioner. I think he was a bit concerned he might not like it as well. To our surprise, he very much likes the scent (so do I!) as well as the product itself.

He has thick, curly hair though it is thinning in areas due to aging. He sometimes has bouts of dandruff as well. At this time, he isn't having issues with dandruff. He says DOVE 2 in 1 is easy to massage into his hair and works into a lather quickly. He has no issues rinsing it out as well. At no point does it cause his scalp to burn or itch. It doesn't weigh his hair or his curls down, instead, it makes them nice and soft. And the scent is REALLY nice. You can smell the lime though its not a fruity scent, if that makes sense. The cedarwood REALLY smells awesome. I find the combo to be a refreshing, masculine scent.

Turns out, the duos in this product make it a winner! Shampoo + conditioner and lime + cedarwood, make DOVE's 2 in 1 shampoo and conditioner a great hair care product for men that cleans, hydrates, softens and smells great. Factor in it is 90% naturally derived with plant based cleansers makes it a must-have hair product for men. For all of the excellent results this delivers, I believe the price to be reasonable and absolutely recommend this 2 in 1.

title: Two Great Hair Care Products For Thick, Curly Hair
text:
This bundle pack of Shea Moisture hair care products contains 2 fantastic products that heal, protect and keep hair looking and feeling fabulous. Both contain coconut oil, hibiscus flower and shea butter and boy, do they have a great scent. The Coconut & Hibiscus Curl Enhancing Smoothie is a cream to help define curls and keep them look their best. The cream can be applied to damp or dry hair. (I"ve only ever used it on damp hair) My hair does not look or feel weighed down, oily or greasy when using this cream. I only need a small amount to adequately cover my thick, shoulder length hair. The Coconut & Hibiscus Hold & Shine Moisture Mist is a light and airy mist that tames frizz, smooths and softens and adds shine to hair. I love that it dispenses in mist form so it evenly covers hair with just a few sprays. It also does not weigh down hair or cause it to look or feel oily/greasy.

Both products work very well in my hair. Both are geared towards those with thick, curly hair. I only need to use a small amount of each, so both products are going to last a LONG time. For this reason, along with the great results and the lovely scent, I find this bundle pack reasonably priced and definitely recommend both!

title: Didn't Work Well On My Hair
text:
I am not looking forward to writing this review. I am a big fan (have been for quite some time) of the Herbal Essences brand, especially the bio renew line. (HE's bio renew white charcoal conditioner is one of my all time fave hair conditioners) I was looking forward to trying HE's Honey & Vitamin B shampoo and conditioner. I really expected to love it. Unfortunately, that's not the case. I had no issues applying/massaging into my hair both the shampoo and conditioner. Both rinsed without issue as well. I had a few minor tangles after but was able to comb through easily. When my hair dried, it was rather...flat, I guess is a good word. It lacked bounce. (My hair normally isn't super bouncy but after using these, it had next to no bounce) My natural curls and waves were few and far between. My hair looked and felt rather dried out-not as bad as 'hay' but not good. I wound up wearing it in a ponytail that day.

There is a scent to both that is so-so. Doesn't last long-at least not in my hair.

I don't know why this duo didn't work well in my hair. I definitely rinsed both out entirely. Neither weighed my hair down to cause the flatness/lack of bounce/lack of curls and waves. While I have no plans to use this particular formula again, I WILL continue to use the other Herbal Essences hair product that I love.

title: PHENOMENAL!
text:
I need more than 5 stars for this review. 5, is simply not enough.

Paul Mitchell's Clean Beauty Everyday Leave-In Treatment is positively phenomenal. I wash my hair at night. The first time I tried this leave-in, when my hair finished drying, it looked SO darn good, I wished I hadn't already taken my nightly Melatonin so I could go somewhere with my hair looking as good as it did...even the grocery store would have been fine! (I'm not kidding!)

After washing and towel drying my hair, I started with 3 pump's worth of leave-in which turned out to be sufficient to cover my thick, shoulder length hair. I simply dispensed the conditioner into my hand, rubbed my hands together and ran the conditioner through my hair. Per the directions, I then used a comb to evenly distribute . I will include a photo to show you how much conditioner is dispensed in ONE pump. (I don't know if its just my bottle but when I used it for the first time, I had to pump it quite a few times before it finally dispensed. I was actually close to just removing the pump and squeezing the bottle to get some conditioner out but then it began to come out of the nozzle. . It has worked perfectly fine ever since. Not a big deal at all, just in case this is how every bottle is, I wanted to make you aware you might need to pump a bit the first time you use it.) This leave in is so light and creamy. It doesn't weigh my hair down nor does it cause my hair to look/feel oily, greasy, hard or crunchy. After applying, I allowed my hair to air dry as usual. When it was dry, I was floored. I literally stood in front of the mirror and said, "Oh my God!". I was SO excited. I'm about to be very vain here...my hair looked beautiful. It was absolutely perfect as if Paul Mitchell himself had styled it. I cannot recall if there was ever a time in my life I felt my hair was perfect. THIS was absolute perfection. Every strand was in place. My natural waves and curls were gorgeous. My hair was soft and incredibly shiny. I do have thick hair but its thinning around my scalp area due to aging. That wasn't the case after using this leave-in. The thinning hair looked like the rest of my hair. Out of all the 'fun' things that come with aging, my thinning hair has been the hardest for me to accept. To see it look natural and like the rest of my hair was just unbelievable. My hair had a nice bounce to it as well. It felt lighter even though it hadn't been cut. And it felt FRESH and ALIVE. Like it had woken from a long sleep. (Now you know why I wished I hadn't taken my nightly Melatonin and wanted to go somewhere since it looked so good! lololol. )

It goes without saying, I love Paul Mitchell's Clean Beauty Everyday Leave-In Treatment. I love it so very much, I'm already signed up for Amazon's 'subscribe and save' plan. I WILL continue to purchase and use this leave-in. I must. It works THAT well and does SO very much for my hair. I HIGHLY recommend this leave-in and I sure do hope everyone has as much success with it as I do!

title: Great, FAST Results!
text:
MoreBeauty's Avocado Face & Neck Cream is a fantastic cream that does a beautiful job of softening, hydrating and reducing my facial fine lines and does so quickly. Its packed with awesome skin care ingredients such as: Dead Sea minerals (a fave of mine!), avocado, vitamins A, D, C and B5, aloe (another fave of mine!) and more. (Take a minute to look at the full list of ingredients shown above in the thumbnail photos on the left side of the screen.) Its lightweight and my skin absorbs it quickly. It does not leave behind a 'heavy' feeling nor does it cause my skin to look or feel oily/greasy.

This cream can be worn under makeup. It also contains UVA and UVB filters to protect skin from the sun's rays. It can be used on the face and the neck. ( I only use it on my face) I have terribly dry, sensitive skin and have no negative reactions to this cream. It can be used on all skin types though this particular cream (avocado) is geared towards normal to dry skin types.

I had the pleasure of also trying MoreBeauty's Olive Oil face cream which is also fantastic. Given the choice, I do SLIGHTLY prefer the Olive Oil cream. The avocado cream has a fairly strong scent which reminds me of soap, though its NOT long lasting. This is the reason I didn't deduct a star from my overall rating. I do find the scent fairly strong but since it doesn't last very long at all (by the time the cream absorbs into my skin, the scent is pretty much gone...minutes after applying) I don't think its fair to penalize the cream overall.

For those interested in packaging, this cream comes in a heavy and nice glass jar with a good, strong lid.

I VERY much like this cream. It works quickly and it works well. Thanks to the good and fast results, I find the price to be reasonable. Recommended.

title: Heals Hair Starting With the First Use
text:
This really is a rescue product for hair! It repairs damage to hair with the very first use. After washing/rinsing my hair (shampoo + conditioner), I emptied a tube of Pantene Hair Mask Miracle Rescue Shot into my hand, rubbed my hands together and worked the cream into my wet hair. It was easy to do and covered my shoulder length, thick hair well. After allowing it to sit on my hair for 10 minutes I rinsed and had no issues. I normally use a bit of leave-in conditioner on my towel dried hair as well as some wave spray to enhance my natural waves while my hair is still slightly damp. I skipped both after using the Pantene Rescue Shot and allowed my hair to air dry as usual. The shine and softness from this treatment was mind boggling. I didn't know my hair could be so shiny. But it was also fuller, including the area around my scalp that is thinning due to aging. My hair was hydrated and moisturized and that combo lasted for quite some time. It gets terribly dry, especially in the winter. After using this , it didn't look like hay as it does at times when the dryness is REALLY bad. While I don't have a terrible problem with split ends, the ones I did have were gone. Also gone was hair in the shower drain. I don't know if it was supposed to, but this treatment helped prevent hair loss for me in addition to the other results I achieved. And with only ONE USE!

The scent of these shots is gorgeous. But it didn't last long in my hair; it was pretty much gone after my hair dried. Wish it would have stuck around longer, it really is a beautiful scent.

Pantene's Miracle Rescue Shot did indeed perform a miracle on my dry, damaged hair. And it wasn't a temporary miracle, the results lasted a good amount of time. It did not interfere with my color treated hair negatively in any way. This is a must-have hair care product for me. I will continue to purchase and use this treatment. My hair needs the healing and protection these rescue shots provide.

title: Delivers 'Beachy' Hair Waves
text:
I REALLY like what Denoue's Sea Me Wave spray does for my natural wavy hair. It makes the waves, well, beachy! It loosens them so they have more of a tousled, 'messy' appearance as though I swam in the ocean and my hair air-dried. It only takes a few pumps of the spray to cover my hair. I love that it dispenses in mist form so it gently lands on my hair evenly. It does not make my hair hard and crunchy. I can still comb it and run my fingers through it. It doesn't weigh hair down or cause it to look oily/greasy. The beach-like waves stay in my hair until I wash it. I don't have to use the spray multiple times throughout the day, its long lasting. There is a nice, pleasant scent but it leaves my hair pretty quickly. It can be applied to damp or dry hair. I've only used it on damp hair, haven't tried it on dry hair. ( I dont' use any wave spray on dry hair....damp only )

I'm very pleased with Denoue's wave spray. Love what it does for my hair. I find the cost to be reasonable-it works very well and only takes a few pumps to adequately cover my hair. The bottle will last me a good amount of time. Recommended!

title: Keeps Curls From Turning Into a Frizzy Mess!
text:
TRESemma Pro Care Curl conditioner does a very impressive job of preventing my curls /natural waves from turning into out of control hair in heat and humidity. I pretty much spend the entire summer with my hair in a ponytail because it turns into a frizzy mess. Thanks to TRESemme Pro Care Curls, I can now choose whether I want to keep it down and natural or put it in a ponytail because it protects hair from the harsh temperatures. It keeps my curls and waves nice and calm and eliminates frizz. That's not all. It also softens and hydrates my hair as well. Its easy to work through hair. I use an amount a bit larger than the size of a half dollar to cover my shoulder length, thick hair. It rinses just as easily. Hair is not weighed down or left looking/feeling oily or greasy. Tangles are removed as well. The scent of this conditioner is just gorgeous and not at all overpowering or gagging. Unfortunately, it doesn't last very long in my hair. How I wish it did. Its a wonderful scent.

I've been using TRESemme hair products for years and years now. What an incredible brand it is. TRESemme really knows how to take care of hair and this curl conditioner is no exception. The price is more than reasonable. If your hair frizzes like mine does in heat/humidity, I very much recommend giving TRESemme Pro Care Curls conditioner a try!

title: Didn't Work In My Hair
text:
I was especially excited to test Denoue Curl Dream defining cream not only because I never tried it before, but this is a brand I'd never heard of before until I saw it in my VINE offers. Unfortunately, this defining curl cream isn't for me. (I'm happy to say I LOVE Denoue's wave spray and will be submitting a review soon!)

When I saw Denoue curl cream contained rice protein and tomato extract to help define curls and add bounce to hair, I got excited. I can always use the help defining my curls but I especially need help with bounce-my hair lacks it. I had NO clue rice protein/tomato extract could help with these issues. After washing my hair, I applied Denoue curl cream to my clean, towel dried hair per the instructions. But in the end, though I didn't use much cream and what I did use didn't weigh my hair down, my curls and waves were almost nonexistent. My hair was more straight than curly and lacked bounce though it was nice and soft. It smelled good too as this cream has a nice, light scent.

Denoue isn't the right curl defining cream for my hair.

title: Not Your Typical Ponytail Holder...
text:
VOLO's Scrunchie Microfiber Ponytail Holders are SO cute! They have so many great features. In addition to being cute, the microfiber material is nice and soft. I don't get the dreaded creases in my hair from these ponytail holders which is a HUGE relief! Hair stays in place as does the ponytail holder itself. It doesn't slide, it stays exactly where I put it....even when my hair is wet or damp! Strands of hair do not pop out of the holder either. I have thick hair. The holders do not stretch out of shape because of my hair; they keep their shape beautifully. Thankfully, my hair doesn't get twisted or tangled around the holders. They're easy to put in hair and just as easy to remove. I don't wind up pulling out hair along with the holder when i take it out. The microfiber helps absorb water from wet hair and that is a pretty neat feature. VOLO's ponytail holders work for pretty much every hair type.

For those interested in packaging, these holders come in a really cute and sturdy box. I like that i have a box to keep them in while not in use; no need to worry about misplacing them or my dog getting ahold of one. (He loves to pick up a hair scrunchie in his mouth and throw it into the air and catch it in his mouth. lol. He's a very energetic 9 year old bichon!)

VOLO has a great set of 2 well-made ponytail holders with some pretty impressive features. They work VERY well in my hair and I'm definitely happy with them.

title: Already Bought Another Bottle After Using This ONE Time!
text:
I am so pleased and impressed with Shiny Leaf's Ultimate Blonde Purple Conditioner that I already purchased another bottle after using the conditioner exactly ONE TIME! THAT is how well this conditioner works on my blonde hair!

The conditioner is thick and a light purple shade. (Don't worry..it won't dye your hair or stain your skin purple!) Its easy to work and massage into hair. After massaging it into hair from root to tip, per the instructions it should sit on hair 2-3 minutes. I let it sit for closer to 10 minutes. It rinses out easily without weighing hair down or making it look or feel oily /greasy.

When my hair was dry (I air dry), the color was nice and even. My hair is thick though I have thinning around the scalp due to aging. My hair was bouncy and full, including the area of thinning. My hair had shine to it-A LOT of shine; like it used to when I was a kid, before I damaged it with dyes, hair products, curling irons, hair dryers, etc. It was SO soft and smooth and hydrated. And it felt so light. You know how good your hair feels after you've been to a salon...they wash it , cut off a few inches and you leave feeling like you have a whole new, lighter, better head of hair? That's how my hair felt after I used this conditioner...and I didn't even have to trim any off the length to feel that way! I loved how my hair looked and felt and that is the very reason I ordered purchased a second bottle of Shiny Leaf conditioner after using it only ONE time. It made my hair feel and look THAT good!

This conditioner comes in a 16oz bottle. I LOVE the fact that Shiny Leaf sends a pump with the bottle. You can either remove the bottle lid and squeeze some conditioner out or remove the lid, put the pump in the bottle and pump the condition out. Shiny Leaf does this with their oil products as well and I, for one appreciate that added bonus. Purple conditioner can be used on any shade of blonde hair as well as silver and gray hair. And it doesn't matter the color is color treated or natural. The scent of this conditioner is fantastic though it doesn't last long in my hair. (Its pretty much gone by the time my hair dries)

I have very sensitive skin and had no issues with this conditioner.

As you can tell, I clearly love Shiny Leaf Purple conditioner and I recommend it to fellow blondes and those with grey or silver hair.

title: Revives and 'Wakes Up' Curls (smells awesome too!)
text:
3-4 sprays of Maui Moisture's Curl Refresher Mist on my damp, shoulder length, thick hair is all it takes to wake up my natural curls and waves! Maui's curl mist adds volume and softness to my hair. It keeps flyaways calm and hair nice and smooth. My niece's hair has coils and when she stopped by a few days ago, I had her try it and she was so excited by the bounce and volume it added to her hair. She's in college and said she was going to have her mother send her a bottle in a care package. Said she's looking forward to not having to wash her hair daily, she can just revive and freshen her coils with Maui Moisture mist.

I love that 100% aloe vera is the very first ingredient, followed by flaxseed oil , coconut water and citrus oil. All good and important ingredients to help keep hair hydrated and healthy. I just as much love the fact the spray is free of parabens, silicones, surfactants , dyes , mineral oil and gluten. Its so easy to use: give the bottle a good shake, spray hair , scrunch hair. DONE! That's it! That's all it takes make curls look gorgeous. I love the way it dispenses when sprayed; it comes out in a mist form , ensuring hair will be evenly covered with the product. Its not heavy; it doesn't weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy nor does it become hard /crunchy. There is a light scent to this mist. Its a citrusy scent. I'm not normally a fan of citrus scents but this scent is GREAT! Light and airy and isn't overpowering or gagging at all.

Maui's refresher mist works great and smells SO good. Because it works so well and I only need a few sprays of the nozzle to sufficiently cover my hair, I do find the price reasonable. If you're looking for some help to maintain your curls, give this a try.

title: Garnier Knows Hair Care!
text:
Garnier really knows how to take wonderful care of hair. I've been using various Garnier products for years and years. Shampoos, conditioners, leave-in, wave/curl sprays. I have tried two other Garnier Whole Blends Sulfate Free shampoo + conditioner: honey, coconut. Love them. So I was beyond excited to give Hibiscus + Shea a try. Once again, Garnier delivers yet another fabulous shampoo + conditioner!

Hibiscus + Shea focuses on curls. I wash my hair daily. I RARELY skip using conditioner. The consistency of this shampoo is silky and creamy. I love it. An amount roughly the size of a nickel is sufficient for my shoulder length, thick hair. It is so easy to work through my hair and it lathers immediately. As I rinsed it and ran my fingers through my hair I could already feel how soft, silky and tangle free my hair was. I decided to skip the conditioner; the shampoo had worked SO well I wanted to see how my hair looked using shampoo only. (Again, I stress that I VERY rarely skip conditioner, so this was practically unheard of for me ) After towel drying my hair, I combed it and let it air dry as I always do. In the end, my natural curls and waves looked great; they were soft and smooth and free of the usual flyaways. There was a bit of a decrease in how wavy/curly my hair normally is but I was still impressed with the result and didn't regret skipping the conditioner. The following night, I used both the shampoo + conditioner. The consistency of the conditioner is far thicker than the shampoo. After having it sit on my hair for about 5 minutes, I rinsed the conditioner and did so without issue. As with the shampoo, I could feel how soft and tangle free my hair was during the rinse. Again, I towel dried my hair and then allowed it to air dry. When dry, my waves and curls were fantastic. No flyaways. Soft, shiny and a bit of a bounce. And my hair smelled GREAT! There is a scent to both the conditioner and shampoo though its very light. But its not long lasting, unfortunately. (IDK if its just me but my hair rarely holds a shampoo/conditioner scent for long)

Though I havent' tried it, I want to mention this conditioner can be used as a leave in.

I'm not the least bit surprised how well this duo worked in my hair. Garnier knows what they're doing when it comes to hair care. I'm more than satisfied with the results this combo delivered and absolutely recommend it to those with curly/wavy hair.

*FYI...this product comes with a sample of Garnier's Miracle Nectar Honey leave in. I've been using this leave in on and off since last year and it works beautifully!

title: Wonderful Cream That Delivers FAST Results
text:
MoreBeauty's Olive Oil Face and Neck Cream is absolutely wonderful. Its packed with incredible ingredients such as: Dead Sea Minerals (a fave of mine!), Vitamins A,D, C and B5, aloe, jojoba and carrot oil, olive oil, glycerin and chamomile. Together, these ingredients make a cream that softens skin instantly while quickly reducing fine lines. I had an noticeable decrease in my fine lines FAST thanks to this cream. Its lightweight and absorbs quickly without causing skin to look or feel oily/greasy. It has a lovely scent as well that is not overpowering or gagging. The cream can also be used on the neck though I don't use it there. (For whatever reason, my neck is very sensitive to products so I tend to not put anything in that area. ) For those who wear makeup, this cream CAN be worn under makeup as well.

I have dry, very sensitive skin and experience NO negative issues/side effects from this cream.

For those interested in packaging, it comes in a pretty, heavy glass jar with a heavy gold lid.

This is a keeper for me. This is a cream that I will continue to use in my skin care regimen. It works that well. In light of the fact that a VERY small amount of cream goes a long way as well as the wonderful results I experience, I do find the price of the cream to be reasonable. I absolutely recommend MoreBeauty's Olive Oil cream.

title: Your Curly Hair Needs This Conditioner!
text:
Another amazing conditioner, courtesy of TRESemme!

This sulfate free conditioner works great on my natural curly, wavy hair. My hair is normally dry, but drier than usual during winter months with the heat running in the house 24/7. This conditioner hydrates and moisturizes while keeping my curls and waves soft and smooth, ridding my hair of flyaways as well. When I sweat, my hair frizzes and looks like a pile of out of control Ramen noodles. lol. Needless to say, the other day I moved furniture all around and did some spring cleaning. I worked up a sweat. Using TRESemme's Pro Care Curls conditioner the night before, prevented my hair from frizzing and turning into a pile of out of control Ramen noodles. Its a wonderful conditioner-easy to apply to hair and just as easy to rinse out. It does not weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. It has a fabulous scent as well though not long lasting. (at least not in my hair) This conditioner works wonders on curly, wavy hair and I absolutely recommend it. The price can't be beat either!

title: A Miracle Worker For My Hair!
text:
Wow. WOW...WOW...WOW! Without a doubt, Joico Moisture Recovery Treatment Balm is easily one of the BEST products I've EVER used on my hair! After shampooing, I applied it to my hair-an amount roughly the size of a half dollar was sufficient to cover my shoulder length, thick hair. It was easy to apply and work into my hair. I let it sit for 10 minutes before rinsing. It was easy to rinse out as well. I had NO tangles after using this. I combed my hair easily. I could already see a nice shine as my hair air dried. My natural waves and curls were pretty much perfect -soft and smooth with no flyaways. And it stayed that way. I usually wash my hair daily but didn't' wash it for 2 days after using Joico. I didn't need to. My hair stayed shiny and soft with my waves and curls in place. I did use a curl few squirts of a curl refreshing spray 2 days after using Joico and a bit of hairspray but that was all I needed. It seriously thrills me to tell you that the scent of this conditioner stayed in my hair the day after I used it. Scents RARELY last in my hair. This one did and my goodness, it smells SO SO SO good!

I might be a bit obsessed with Joico's Moisture Recovery balm. It pretty much performs miracles in my hair. For all that it does and the incredible length of time it lasts, the price is more than reasonable to me. I'd love to give it more than 5 stars, its so VERY deserving!

title: Talk About a Dynamic Duo!
text:
The ultimate power couple! SheaMoisture's Power Green's Curly Hair shampoo + conditioner (with kale, morninga, avocado, green algae and matcha) adds incredible hydration and moisturizer that my hair desperately needs and in doing so, revives my natural waves and curls making them fuller and more prominent -yet at the same time keeping them soft and smooth. My hair has shine to it that I don't often see after using this duo as well. The shampoo easily works up a lather and doesn't take much to superbly clean my hair. The conditioner is thicker than the shampoo, yet still easy to apply and rinse away. My hair was free of tangles after I rinsed and combed easily. As it air dried, I could see how lovely my curls and waves looked and by the time my hair was dry, it was visibly softer, smoother and had a nice shine.

There is a great fresh scent to both the shampoo and conditioner though it didn't last long in my hair. Overall, a fantastic duo that did a lot for my hair with the very first use!

title: Excellent Mask For My Dry, Sensitive Skin
text:
H & B 's Purifying Mud Mask does an exceptional job of exfoliating and cleansing my dry, sensitive skin. It also revives and moisturizes at the same time, something my skin desperately needs after enduring a rough, cold winter.

The mask is easy to apply and i don't need to use much to cover my face. I experience no burning/itching or issues of any kind while the mask is on my skin. Once its gone, my skin is left unbelievably soft and smooth while at the same time clean and glowing.

I use it 2x's per week and always look forward to using it. I love what this mask does for my skin!

title: Didn't Work Well On My Hair
text: My hair and this conditioner are not compatible.  My hair looked and felt dried out after I used this conditioner...like straw.  My natural waves weren't very wavy as well.  It does have a nice scent.  I've already given it to my mother, hopefully she will have better results than I.

title: Adds Volume and Bounce to My Normally  Bounce-less Hair
text:
Testing Joifull Volumizing Styler marks the first Joico product I've ever used. I'd certainly heard of the brand before, just never tried it. I very much like the Volumizing Styler. Its a combo cream + gel. Its easy to apply to hair and absolutely added some volume to my hair as well as some bounce, which my hair usually lacks. And it kept my hair that way for a good 24 hours, until I washed it again. Its not sticky or gummy nor does it weigh my hair down. The scent is A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!! I wish my hair would always smell like this styler, its THAT fantastic!

This is a good styling product and delivers good results.

title: Does a Good Job Though No Change To Hair Color
text:
Argan Magic is a wonderful conditioner. With the very first use, it conditioned and moisturized my hair. My natural waves were nice and wavy , yet at the same time soft and smooth. It also brought some much needed bounce to my hair. I experienced very little hair breakage after using Argan Magic as well.

This conditioner is packed with argan oil , vitamins and essential fatty acids, all important ingredients for keeping hair healthy and well protected. There is a citrusy scent with this conditioner. I'm not a huge fan of citrus scents but wasn't bothered by this scent since it doesn't stick around very long.

While Argan Magic definitely worked well on my hair, I didn't notice any difference in my hair color. It didn't look brighter, it looked the same as usual.

Overall, this is a good conditioner, though I am a bit disappointed to not have experienced a difference in the brightness of my hair color.

title: This is Not For Me
text: Not a huge fan of this rinse out treatment by Redken. After shampooing/rinsing, I followed the directions and sprayed the treatment on my hair. I sprayed the pump 4 times on my thick, shoulder length hair. After allowing the treatment to sit on my hair for 5 minutes, I rinsed it out and had no issue doing so. As my hair air-dried, it didn't feel super soft, it actually felt dry in spots.  When my hair was completely dry, my natural waves weren't as wavy as normal-my hair was more straight than wavy, though it didn't look or feel weighed down.  The treatment did make my fuller which was nice but I just did not like not having my waves.  I am not going to continue to use this treatment spray and will be giving it to my niece.  Hopefully, it will bring her better results.

title: Excellent Leave-In That Reduces Breakage and Has Pretty Much Ended My Split-Ends
text: Wow, does Redken's Extreme Anti-Snap /Anti-Breakage Leave-In Treatment ever do a fantastic job preventing my hair from breaking off.  After washing and towel drying my hair, a few pumps of the nozzle (3-4) sufficiently covers my thick, shoulder length hair.  And I love that it dispenses in a mist form.  Since using this leave in, I have FAR less hair breakage to remove from the shower drain and almost NO breakage in  my brush each time I brush my hair.  Though I didn't have a huge issue with split ends when I started using this, they're pretty much non-existent now.  My hair does not become weighed  down nor does my hair look/feel oily or greasy from this leave in.  There is a light scent though it doesn't last very long.

title: Does What It Promises To Do...(and then some!)
text:
I cannot believe how well Redken's All Soft MEGA conditioner works on my hair! It almost seems to good to be true. It is easy to apply to hair and just as easy to rinse out. I let it sit on my hair for about 10 minutes before rinsing. I happened to have fairly large tangle thanks to a ponytail holder that got wrapped around my hair in an odd manner. This conditioner removed the tangle immediately. After rinsing I was able to run my fingers through my wet hair and they didn't get stuck on any tangles! My hair was unbelievably soft, smooth , hydrated and moisturized which it DESPERATELY needed. My hair's natural curls and waves looked great and stayed looking great all day long until I washed my hair later that night. How i LOVE the scent of this conditioner. I thought for sure the conditioner contained cocoa butter because that's what the scent reminds me of. (Keep in mind, I have a nasal cyst that sometimes affects my sense of smell) The scent actually stayed in my hair for a few hours...wish it would have remained, I just LOVE it! (Perhaps the Sacha Inchi oil is responsible for the scent-I'm not at all familiar with this ingredient?)

My hair felt as though I had just spent the day at the hair salon getting pampered when in reality, I never left my home! This conditioner does what it promises to do for my hair and I absolutely love it. DEFINITELY recommended.

title: What a Perfect Conditioner!
text:
A few weeks ago, I reviewed TRESemme's Pro Pure Micellar Moisture conditioner and branded it the best of all of the TRESemme conditioners I've ever tried. (And I've tried nearly all of them!) That review and #1 ranking still hold, BUT now must share the #1 spot with TRESemme's Maximum Lengths Biotin conditioner.

My hair is on the long side-shoulder length and thick. (except around the scalp where its thinning due to aging). After washing and rinsing my hair, I poured the conditioner into my hands, rubbed them together and began to apply to the ends of my hair and worked my way up. A majority of the conditioner went on the ends to about midway ; I made this section of hair the priority per the instructions. The remaining conditioner I massaged into the rest of my hair. While the instructions said to keep the conditioner on 2-3 minutes, I kicked back and enjoyed the nice, hot bath water and peace and quiet and kept it on for closer to 10 minutes. As easy as it was to apply into my hair, it was just as easy to rinse out. As the water ran through my hair , I could already feel how soft and tangle-free my hair was. .As my hair air dried, my natural waves and curls were present and nice and smooth. No fly aways. By the time my hair dried, it had a pretty shine, was wonderfully soft and smelled great. After using this a few times, my split ends came to an end...and by that, I mean GONE! This conditioner does exactly what it promises to do!

TRESemme truly delivers salon quality products at a fraction of the cost . I've yet to try a TRESemme product that isn't fantastic. The price for this 4 pack of conditioner is insanely LOW! Its a steal, especially considering how well and how quickly it works. No question about it...I ABSOLUTELY recommend TRESemme Max Lengths conditioner to anyone with long hair!

title: So Far, So Good!
text:
It is my hope BeautyBio's Healthy Scalp Serum Hair Density Treatment will help strengthen and thicken the area of hair around my scalp that is thinning due to aging. The rest of my hair is thick so to have the thinning around my scalp, especially where it's noticeable if I don't find a way to cover it up really makes me self conscious. I've not been using it long and haven't really experienced any results...yet. I use it daily and only a very tiny amount to cover the affected area. I've not experienced any negative issues: its not sticky, it doesn't cause my hair to look or feel oily/greasy, it doesn't flake off. It dries/absorbs quickly. I have very sensitive skin and have no negative reactions to the serum.

Didn't I have to go and open my mouth about what the product does to my husband. Now HE is using it too! He is hoping to thicken hair where its become thinner due to aging as well. He has mild dandruff which has been reduced since using BeautyBio Serum.

So far, so good. We're both excited to achieve our hair goal results and will continue to use BeautyBio serum!

title: All 3 Are Fabulous and Deliver Promised Results
text:
I felt like I was spoiling myself in a nice salon when I tried Pantene's Pure Clean & Clarify shampoo/conditioner + rescue shot for the first time! And I didn't even have to leave my home to feel that way. To say I'm impressed doesn't begin to cover it. All 3 of these products are fabulous and made my hair look and feel fabulous too.

The shampoo (9.6oz-comes in a bottle) and conditioner (8.0oz-comes in a tube) are both free of silicone and fragrance. I didn't need to use much of either produce to thoroughly cover my thick, shoulder length hair. (shampoo...nickel size portion, conditioner...half dollar size portion) Both are easy to work into hair and easy to rinse out as well. Neither weighed my hair down or caused it to look or feel oily/greasy. Actually, quite the opposite. After washing my hair and using both, my hair felt lighter and had some bounce to it that it doesn't normally have. I don't use a hair dryer, I air dry. When my hair finished drying, my natural curls and waves looked great and fell into place naturally which does NOT happen often! lol. My hair is terribly dry now thanks to the cold temps outside and warm temps inside the house with the heat running 24/7. After using these, my hair was left nice and soft as well.

The rescue shot was FANTASTIC! This IS scented. It has a wonderful fresh scent which, unfortunately, didn't last long in my hair. (We're talking by the time my hair was dry, the scent was already gone...THAT quickly) It helped revive my hair and just made it feel good after I used it.

I find all 3 of these products fabulous. They deliver the promised results and do so starting with the first use. While I do not plan to use both daily, I DO plan to keep them as a part of my hair care regimen and will continuet to use them on a routine basis. I absolutely recommend all 3 to help repair, revive and refresh your hair.

title: Fantastic Shaping Jelly
text: I ordered HASK Curl Care Shaping Jelly for my husband who has thick, curly hair.  He had been using a different brand of hair gel but recently hasn't been able to find it anywhere. I had a hunch he might like this. I've been a huge fan of HASK hair products for years, especially HASK hair conditioners. I recently tried HASK's Curl Care Defining Cream and LOVE it!  And I was right...he does love this shaping jelly. Just a small amount (less than the size of a dime) sufficiently covers his (short) hair. It keeps his natural curls from frizzing or getting out of control (especially when he sweats).  His concern prior to using the jelly was that it might make his hair hard and crunchy. Nope. Didn't happen. His hair remains nice and soft. He washes it first thing every morning and the jelly works all day/night long. He doesn't have to reapply more jelly at any point. Just a small amount after his morning shower while his hair is damp and he's good until the following day when he showers and washes his hair again.  There is a light scent to this jelly which didn't thrill him at first-he's not a fan of scented hair products. But it doesn't matter because the scent doesn't last very long.  He's more than satisfied with HASK's Curl Care Shaping Jelly. Because he doesnt' need to use very much and due to his short hair, these 2 bottles will last him quite some time. The price is more than reasonable as well. This is an exceptional shaping jelly that works great and is long lasting. Absolutely recommended!

title: These Are a LifeSaver...(and in my dog's case, literally a life saver!)
text:
Products Simplified pack of 2 reusable mist sprayers are absolutely phenomenal! They're well made and durable. Each holds up to 11.8oz of liquid. The bottles are SO secure and do not leak. One push of the trigger (And it only takes a gentle push, the triggers are SO easy to operate...they do not get stuck either!) dispenses a wonderful, large mist that covers a wide range and does so evenly.

This particular item contains 2 bottles, one black and one white. I like the 2 different colors...that way, I"m able to 'assign' a bottle color to the products. For example, the black spray bottles contain hair products that I use and the white bottles contain cleaning products. That way, I don't have to worry about mixing up bottles and trying to figure out which product is in each bottle.

There are SO many uses for these bottles. And I want to share with you how I used a Products Simplified mist bottle just the other day....in a way I never anticipated. Recently, on a Friday, our sweet bichon frise Mac, began to experience trouble urinating. I made him a vet appointment but couldn't get him in until Monday. As he struggled more and more on that Friday, I decided to take him to an animal hospital. He was examined and x-rayed which showed stones that had moved from his bladder to his urethra and were stuck. The animal hospital operated immediately. That involved going into his urethra to push the stones to his bladder. The vet then cut into his bladder to remove the stones for good. He was also neutered at the same time. He was able to come home the following day, thankfully. As you can imagine, the poor baby was HEAVILY bruised (and in sensitive areas) and extremely uncomfortable. We had been given some liquid medication to apply to the 'sensitive' surgical areas. But he was in so much pain, we couldn't apply the liquid medicine to the areas via a clean cloth as we'd been instructed. I was starting to think we might have to take him back to the animal hospital so they could care for him for a few days until he healed a bit more when I remembered the Products Simplified bottles. I grabbed one and cleaned it thoroughly for quite some time. I then poured' Mac's liquid medication into the mist bottle and sprayed his incisions/heavily bruised areas. Two pushes on the bottle trigger dispensed the enough medicine to cover the areas on Mac. And unlike the cloth method we weren't able to do because he was in too much pain, we were able to medicate him and it didn't bother him one bit! He didn't have to return to the vet and more importantly, the Products Simplified mist bottle got the medicine he needed on him and helped prevent infection. See what I mean when I say there are SO many ways to use these mist sprayers???? They're AWESOME regardless of what they're being used for.

I WILL continue to use AND purchase these bottles. Truth be told, I would have done so even if I hadn't used one to spread medicine on my dog! They work THAT well! I find the cost definitely reasonable adn HIGHLY recommend them.

title: This is Not the Conditioner For My Hair
text:
I love to try new hair products. I'd never heard of the Authentic Beauty Concept brand before so I was very much looking forward to trying the Replenish conditioner. Turns out, this isn't the right conditioner for my hair.

I like the consistency. Not too thick, not too thin. Its easy to work through hair and rinse out. It is scented and I very much love the scent. It actually stays in my hair for some time, unlike many other conditioners whose scent fades once its rinsed out of my hair. Its not overpowering or gagging.

I air-dry my hair. As my hair dried following the use of this conditioner, I could see that my natural waves and curls weren't all there. I had patches of hair that were more straight than wavy/curly. My hair did soften and hydrate but not much. I

Perhaps I'm being overly fussy, but the bottle is weird. This is a large, heavy bottle and its VERY thick. After shampooing my hair, I grabbed the conditioner bottle. Even when I squeezed and squeezed as hard as I could, I barely made a dent in the bottle; its that thick. I couldn't get any conditioner out. I had to squeeze with both hands at the same time. Since both hands were tied up squeezing the bottle, I wound up having to squeeze a pile of conditioner onto the side of the bathtub and then scoop it up and apply it to my hair. ( Perhaps it becomes easier to squeeze and dispense the conditioner as the amount of conditioner in the bottle decreases???) I decided in that moment if this turned out to be a conditioner I planned to continue to use, I'd move it to a different (empty) conditioner bottle so I wouldn't have to keep using both hands and pile the conditioner on the side of the bathtub. But based on the results following the use of this conditioner, I have no plans to continue using it. It just didn't work well on my hair. I'm giving the bottle to my sister in law. Hopefully, she'll have better results.

title: SO Many Uses. I LOVE These Mist Bottles!
text:
Oh, how I LOVE continuous spray bottles! I have several and use them on a daily basis in a variety of ways. They're perfect for hair care products, watering plants, cleaning products and much more.

Cosywell's 2 pack continuous mist sprayer contains 2 bottles, both measuring 13.5" x 9.8" x 2.5". They're the perfect size and easy to store. Very durable...these are not flimsy bottles. The trigger is easy to use and works well. No need to use any kind of force to get it to spray. I love how easy it is to spray a large, continuous mist. A few presses on the trigger and the bottle doesn't miss a beat...it continuously mists, ensuring the product being sprayed sufficiently covers a large area. Its very comfortable to hold and spray-doesn't cause fingers/hand to hurt at all.

I had already decided how I was going to use both of my Cosywell mist bottles. One was for a leave-in hair conditioner, the other for liquid aloe. Our family is going bonkers with itchy skin thanks to the heat being on in the house 24/7 and drying our skin out. But today, I had a change of plan for one bottle. I have a fantastic battery operated mop. Once charged, the battery provides power to the mop. The mop glides easily across the floor, dispenses cleaning product, buffers and shines the floor. Since its not plugged into an outlet when in use, all types floor cleaners can be poured into the mop and used. Prior to this mop, I used a steam mop-nothing but water could be used in it since it plugs in during use. Once I got my new battery operated mop I was SO happy to use pine floor cleaner again. I just LOVE the scent and how well it cleans. Unfortunately, my beloved mop broke and no longer works. At all. Today was my cleaning day so I had to dig out the old steam mop, disappointed that the scent of pine wouldn't be in the air by the time i was finished. And then I spotted a Cosywell sprayer. I added some water + pine cleaner. I walked from room to room continuously pressing the trigger so my pine + water would dispense evenly on all of the flooring. Dining room, kitchen, 2 bathrooms and a long hallway. Hardly took any time at all, the Cosywell continued to mist from room to room and did so evenly. It didn't form any puddles. It didn't dispense on anything other than the flooring. It was easy to control the area I wanted to put pine + water. My fingers /hand did not get tired/sore from continuously misting. When I finished spraying, I took my old steam mop, turned it on and mopped the floors. It worked great! I had the awesome pine scent I love AND the floors were nice and shiny and clean! SO happy I can continue to use pine cleaner thanks to my Cosywell mist sprayer!

There's just SO many uses for this mist sprayer bottle. I have so many products I want to use in a mist bottle, I absolutely WILL purchase more Cosywell mist bottles. They are so handy and so convenient! I HIGHLY recommend these bottles!

title: Turning Back Time? Sure Seems That Way!
text:
This is a new one for me. I have NO experience/history using an EGF product. EGF-'a natural protein in our body that products collagen and elastin'. At the time I ordered this cream, I was curious as to the age our bodies slow down the production of collagen. I assumed it was around the time menopause arrives. Nope. The info I found states around the age of 25, we begin to produce 1% less collagen yearly. I had NO clue it begins at such a young age.

I've not used this very long. It is easy to apply and doesn't cause skin to look/feel oily or greasy. It does moisturize my skin well. I'm VERY fair-skinned and pale. This cream is beginning to 'wake up' my skin. There's a subtle brightening and a bit of a glow to it now. Dont take that the wrong way...I do NOT look like i went out and got plastic surgery...nothing that drastic. Its subtle change taking place. Its also starting to reduce the fine lines around my eyes. I've not yet noticed a tightening or firmness to my saggy areas.

Now that I'm more familiar with EGF, along with now knowing my collagen production began to decrease nearly 25 years ago, this is a product I must continue to use . Divesome cream is going to provide my skin with the collagen i stopped producing years ago, hydrate, continue to diminish fine lines and firm up my skin. In a way, its going to turn back time. Seeing as 5-0 is coming up, I can't tell you how happy it makes me, knowing I'll be able to make my skin look younger and healthier. I have dry, sensitive skin and have had no issues with this cream. This is a product I want to continue to use.

title: Decent Conditioner-No Help Thickening My Hair

title: Nice Toner, Works Well!
text: I really like BREYLEE's Rose Water facial toner. Its light and airy and does a nice job of refreshing, softening and moisturizing my skin. title: Repairs Hair Beginning With the First Use

title: Works Instantly!
text:
WOW... I DEW CARE's Chill Kitten face moisturizer doesn't waste any time. As soon as it is absorbed (a matter of minutes), it gets to work and pretty much immediately softens and moisturizes skin. title: Results In Such a Short Time!

title: Does What It Promises To Do!
text:
This is one impressive hair mask! BELLISSO's Apple Cider Vinegar hair treatment conditioning mask improves hair with the very first use. Its easy to apply and work through hair. title: Amazing Results in a Matter of Weeks!
text:
Weeks ago, I tried Herbs Botanica Red Onion shampoo for the first time. What an incredible shampoo...I can't recommend it enough, its absolutely INCREDIBLE! I did post a review for it and have been purchasing it ever since I first tried it. Because I love the shampoo so much, I couldn't wait to try Herbs Botanica Red Onion Hair Growth Oil. Turns out, my husband wanted to try it as well so we're both using it!

My reasons for wanting to try this oil vary. I have shoulder length, thick hair. However, for the past couple of years my hair has been thinning around the scalp area due to aging. I'm hoping to thicken that area of hair. I also want to strengthen my hair (all of it) to prevent breakage/split ends. I don't have dandruff but I do have sensitive skin and now that its winter, my skin is drier and itchier than ever so I'd like to calm the itchy areas on my head. Some shine to my hair would be nice as well. The onion oil is easy to use and can be used daily though I average every other day. Simply rub the oil into my scalp and work down from root to tip. Its suggested the oil remain on overnight but I leave it on 30 minutes and then wash my hair. It does not cause my hair to look/free oily or greasy and I'm able to wash it all out easily. The oil in no way burns or delivers a negative reaction to my sensitive skin. Since using Herbs Botanica oil for the past couple of weeks, my head isn't terribly itchy. I'm not seeing nearly as much hair in the shower drain or on a hairbrush as I had been-my hair is getting stronger and healthier. Using this oil with a boar bristle hairbrush has helped add fullness to the thinning hair around my scalp.

My husband's reason for using the oil is to help stop his dandruff, thicken his thinning hair/regrow hair where he has lost some (aging related) , counteract gray hair and strengthen his hair. He uses the oil daily and has been for a few weeks. He's not yet experienced new hair growth but his patches of thinning hair are thickening. His dandruff is SO close to being gone altogether (he didn't have a ton to begin with but its now nearly all gone), his grays are surprisingly decreasing (still has some though after getting a haircut, most is growing back black and not gray). And he's beyond thrilled with his results, especially since he just turned 50 a few weeks ago!

We're BOTH thrilled with our results thus far from Herbs Botanical Red Onion oil and we both plan on continuing to use it (and I will continue to use the shampoo as well) For everything this oil has done for the both of us and the awesome results we're experiencing, the price is ridiculously LOW! Weeks ago, I had NO CLUE red onions could be so beneficial for hair. Now I"M a HUGE fan of Herbs Botanical red onion products and DEFINITELY recommend them!

title: You Can't Go Wrong With Aussie Products!
text:
I've been using various Aussie hair products for 3 decades. And in that time, I've had exactly ONE complaint. A few times, nozzles on the hairspray cans didn't work. That's it. That's the worst thing I can say about Aussie products. I LOVE everything Aussie. Such a variety of great products that work VERY well on my hair, reasonably priced (coupons in the Sunday paper make them even cheaper!) and they have a fantastic scent. When I spotted Aussie's Miracle Coils Collection in my VINE queue, I jumped at the chance to try it. SO happy I did!

The 4 Aussie products in the Miracle Coil Collection:

Aussie Miracle Coils shampoo- This is a nice, light shampoo. A little goes a LONG way. I use an amount roughly the size of a nickel to wash my thick, shoulder length hair. It comes in an 8oz bottle which will last me a good amount of time since I don't need to use a lot of shampoo. Its easy to massage into hair and rinses out just as easily. Its sulfate/paraben free and contains Australian macadamia nut oil as well as cocoa butter. And, it smells great. Does a great job of washing/cleaning my hair

Aussie Miracle Coils conditioner-Comes in a 16oz bottle. Like the shampoo, a little goes a long way. I use an amount slightly larger than a half dollar. Its easy to distribute through my hair where I allow it to sit for 10 minutes before rinsing. It rinses out without issue. It de-tangles my hair, gives it bounce/shine, smooths my natural curls and waves and prevents frizz. It also contains Australian macadamia nut oil + cocoa butter and smells wonderful. It does NOT contain parabens of sulfates. It doesn't weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. I love this conditioner!

Aussie Miracle Coils stretching cream- This is a leave-in stretching cream. The jar contains 7.6oz of cream. It controls coils and prevents frizz while enhancing curls. Contains Australian macadamia nut and cocoa butter and has a great scent. The first time I used it, I didn't care for it. It weighed my hair down far too much and rather than enhancing my curls and waves, it caused my hair to look and feel weighed down. My hair was more on the straight side; my natural waves and curls were barely there. I realized I had scooped out and used WAY too much product. The next time I used this, I used FAR less and boy, did that ever help! I had my curls and waves back and my hair looked as though I had just stepped out of a salon!

Aussie Miracle Coils shaping jelly-I started out a bit 'iffy' with this. I rarely use hair gel so I figured I wouldn't get much use out of this. WRONG!!!!!! After washing my hair, I put an amount of shaping jelly roughly the size of a nickel on my hand, rubbed my hands together and then distributed the jelly throughout my hair. I 'scrunched ' my hair a bit. I could already see that my curls and waves were more defined and enhanced than usual. When I saw this particular result, I realized i no longer have to use any kind of wave enhancing spray in my hair, the jelly takes care of it. It doesn't weigh hair down or make it look/feel hard, oily or greasy. It is sulfate free, contains Australian macadamia nut oil and cocoa butter and smells GREAT. I am THRILLED with this shaping jelly! I've tried and use a lot of really good wave enhancing sprays in my hair but this beats them all! The tube contains 6.8oz of shaping jelly.

This is a FANTASTIC collection ...even more Aussie products to love! I love what each of the 4 products does for my hair. The price is a steal. No doubt about it, I WILL continue to use Aussie's Coil Collection products and I absolutely recommend the entire collection!

title: Does What It Promises To Do
text: My hair wasn't too brassy or yellow  when I started to use Aussie's Purple Dayz shampoo.  The small amounts of each were well taken care of , thanks to this shampoo. It evened out my hair (color) nicely and brought some shine and brightness to it. It also softened my hair. Its easy to apply to hair and rinses out without issue . But I don't believe in penalizing my rating just because I don't care for the scent and because it doesn't last very long at all.  I'm pleased with what this shampoo does to fix my hair color and definitely recommend it.

title: Not Much Help For Drying My Hair *but I can use them for other reasons!*
text:
My thick, shoulder length hair takes a little over an hour to air-dry after I've washed it. In the winter, when the heat is on in the house, it takes a bit less time; 50-55 minutes to fully dry. While METLUCK's hair drying towels are soft and comfortable, easy to use, secure and hold my hair well, they only shave off about 10 minutes of my hair's drying time. I cannot comment on the towels causing less hair breakage for being used in lieu of hair dryers because I don't normally use a hair dryer.

A roughly 10 minute faster drying time isn't enough of a change to make me HAVE to use these towels for fast hair drying purposes. However, I find METLUCK's towels particularly helpful /useful for the times when I want to make sure my hair does NOT get wet or when I'm doing a deep conditioning treatment on my hair. I've already given one towel to my mom and will continue to use the other two. I do think the towels might decrease the drying time for those with short or thin hair. Factor in the other scenarios the towels can be used for and I do find the cost reasonable and worth it.

title: Good Lotion, Does a Nice Job
text:
YADAH's Cactus body lotion is a nice, light vegan lotion that really helps to soften and moisturize dry skin. Rather than using water, YADAH uses palm cactus (and other impressive ingredients!) which has 5 times more nutrients than aloe, something I never knew until I tried this lotion. The consistency is nice-its easy to apply and takes minutes to absorb into skin, however, it doesn't absorb entirely. I can feel a HINT of the lotion on my skin until it eventually fades or is washed off. (and I do mean a HINT) In addition to palm cactus, YADAH uses other great ingredients that also help hydrate , moisturize and soften skin. (I recommend taking a minute to read all of the info above about YADAH, especially the ingredient list.) There is a VERY light scent to YADAH. In fact, I only smell it when I apply YADAH. I cannot detect it once its rubbed in/absorbed into skin. Its a pleasant scent but its gone quickly.

I have dry, sensitive skin and have no adverse reactions to YADAH. I've been using it on my hands, feet, heels, elbows and knees as those spots are especially dry right now thanks to the heat running in our home 24/7. My husband likes using YADAH on his back where he experiences very dry skin. This is really a good lotion that hydrates, softens and moisturizes. I do find the price a tad on the high side, however, I do not know of any other lotions that contain palm cactus to compare it to. And it definitely does a nice job protecting, helping and healing skin.

title: Fantastic Cream w/Fast Results...(not a fan of the scent!)
text:
I must be losing it. The first time I opened the jar of SeroVital Deep Moisture Recovery Whip, the scent reminded me of pumpkin pie with nutmeg. lol. I'm not a fan of pumpkin anything, so I wasn't into it. The next time I opened the jar, it smelled more like oranges with a hint of cinnamon. Enough about the scent. SeroVital is a nice, light /airy whip. It is meant for women ages 45+. (I'm still 10 years away from needing this cream...OK, that's not true. I lied. It does a nice job of explaining the ingredients and what each does for skin. SeroVital is easy to apply to skin , it absorbs quickly and not much is needed to cover my face. I am just starting to notice a hint of reduction to my crow's feet. I haven't yet experienced visible skin elasticity , or supple, youthful skin. I have NO doubt that WILL happen with continued use of SeroVital. And that is precisely what I plan on doing...continuing to use SeroVital on a regular basis. I like what its done thus far for my skin in such a short time. My skin looks and feels good and I can't wait to see what ongoing, continuous use of SeroVital does for my skin.

title: You Can't Go Wrong With Palmer !
text: I honestly believe its impossible for Palmer's brand to make a bad product. title: Decent Conditioner That Delivered Some Good Results-(but not enough for me to continue using it)
text:

title: Soothes, Heals, Softens and Cleans My Dry, Sensitive Skin
text:
My skin is terribly sensitive and dry to begin with. Now that the cold, harsh winter months are here and the heat is on in the house 24/7, my skin is even more sensitive and drier than ever. My cheeks were beginning to look like I sat outside in the tropical sun without sunscreen for a few hours... bright red, dry and chapped. And boy, did they ever sting and itch! REAL BARRIER Cicarelief facial toner does exactly what it promises to do. It soothes and calms my inflamed, itchy, burning skin from the moment I apply it. The itching/burning isn't as bothersome and my terribly dry skin isn't as dry as it had been. My skin is healing and starting to look and feel good again. Each day I use this toner, my skin gets better and better!

I have no adverse reactions to this toner and I'm SO relieved because I would hate to have to stop using it! I love that my skin gets some extra cleaning on top of my regular face washing and at the same time, is receiving relief for the various irritations I experience. My skin is nice and soft after using REAL BARRIER toner and I plan to continue using it and incorporate it into my skin care regimen. I find the cost to be very reasonable as well-not much toner is needed each time I use it and the results are worth every penny of the cost!

title: Does Amazing Things For My Hair!
text:
What the SHASH boar bristle brush does for hair is simply mind-boggling. I have shoulder length, thick hair. Thanks to aging, the hair around my scalp is thinning BIG TIME. title: Works Quickly To Eliminate My Circles/Puffiness
text: I'm an insomniac.  Aside from fatigue, insomnia also leaves me with dark circles and at times, puffy, swollen eyes.  Dr. Denese eye masks are not only cool and refreshing to the skin around my eyes, they are soothing as well.  They do a nice job of reducing the dark circles and puffiness and they work quickly for which  I am SO appreciative!  A small tweezer is including with the jar, allowing me to easily pick up each patch (from the jar) to place under my eyes.  I do, however, have an issue keeping the patches on my face.  No matter what I do, they slide down and won't stay in place.  Even when I blot some of the serum off of the patch, it still slides down my face.  Lying down when I do the 10-15 minute treatment still causes the patch to slide though it does stay in place far better that way.  I also make sure to rub the serum into my skin.  I've not yet used these patches long enough to notice a decrease in the fine lines around my eyes.  Should I notice a decrease , that will be a nice bonus. I'm using the patches mainly to rid the dark circles and puffiness that I sometimes experience in the morning.  And I'm happy with the job Dr. Dense eye masks do to reduce the circles/puffiness. I just wish I was able to better keep them in place and prevent them from sliding down.  I have sensitive skin and experience NO negative reactions to the patches.

title: Nice Cream!
text:
I have terribly dry, sensitive skin . Now that its winter, my skin is drier than usual thanks to the heat running in our home pretty much 24/7. BOTANITY Flavon cream does a nice job of hydrating and soothing my dry skin. It helps reduce the bright red patches of skin on my cheeks though doesn't get rid of them entirely. The burning and itching that comes with red, irritated skin is calmed as well. Some great ingredients are in this cream: hyaluronic acid (a fave of mine!), aloe and shea butter. There is a a pleasant enough scent with this cream though it doesn't last very long. I love that Flavon doesn't sit heavily on my skin, nor does it cause my skin to become greasy and/or oily.

I like this cream. It does a nice job though I do believe it would be more beneficial for me when the heat is no longer on and my skin isn't at its driest/most sensitive.

title: Works Wonders...
text: Let me tell you, come summertime, DRYBAR 's Liquid Glass Miracle Smoothing Sealant is going to get a workout from me!  This sealant does a fabulous job of preventing frizz.  When I sweat, my hair gets frizzy. title: So-So....
text:

title: Not For Me...

title: Works Beautifully!
text:
