I never knew sugar (sugar cane extract) could be used on hair and I just love the results. KENRA is a fabulous spray, easy to use and delivers great results. This spray is an 'Amazon's Choice' item and deservedly so. If you're not familiar...Amazon's Choice means its a highly rated, well priced product. I absolutely recommend KENRA Professional Sugar Beach spray!

title: Perfect Cut...
text:
G$ Vision isn't kidding when they say the G4 J2 Japanese Steel Barber Hair scissors 'achieve perfect results every time'. That is exactly what it does! The G4 cuts beautifully and precise. The blades are nice and sharp while the scissors itself is lightweight and comfortable to hold. Two rubber handle inserts are included, allowing any hand size to hold the scissors comfortably. The info above states, 'exclusively crafted to give a powerful cut and feel while requiring little to no thumb pressure and no hand fatigue'. I can't explain how they're crafted... I have no clue. But I CAN tell you that info is accurate . This scissors does deliver a powerful cut while preventing both pressure on the thumb and hand fatigue. I received the multi-colored scissors and the colors are pretty and unique.

The info above also states the scissors can be used by men, women and children. They are sharp and I definitely recommend adult supervision if a young child is going to use it. I found an old, hard eyeglass case that I keep my scissors in when not in use just to be safe.

I find the price to be more than reasonable. The G4 J2 is very well made, very comfortable to hold and deliver one heck of a nice, even cut. (And the colors are pretty too! lol) Perfect for home use, a barbershop or hair salon!

title: Incredible...Dark Circles, Puffy Eyes Eliminated!
text:
Somehow, someway, for decades I managed to avoid the same dark circles under my eyes that plague many of my family members. And I sure am grateful that I was able to do so for such a long time. A few years ago, that came to a grinding halt. Thanks to a combination of aging, stress, fatigue, insomnia and probably genetics, I began to experience dark circles under my eyes as well as puffy, red eyes at times as well. Splashing cold water helped a bit at first but I'm WAY past cold water being a solution now that the dark circles appear on a fairly regular basis. I JUMPED at the chance to try Generation Skin De-Puff Matcha Green Tea eye patches. And I am SO glad that I did!

The patches are wonderful. Absolutely WONDERFUL! They contain matcha green tea, an antioxidant that takes care of not only the dark circles under my eyes but also eliminates puffiness and redness as well when it appears. I keep the patches, which are easy to apply/remove, under my eyes for 15 minutes. After removing the patches I gently massage the remaining serum into my skin which helps to brighten my skin.

Generation Skin eye patches also contain another ingredient that I LOVE...hyaluronic acid. It does a great job of reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles but I also learned (thanks to info provided by Generation Skin!) that hyaluronic acid also restores moisture AND holds 1000 times its weight in water. I had NO clue it did that as well. Yet ANOTHER reason to love it!

I am beyond thrilled, happy and relieved to have found Generation Skin eye patches. They work quickly and so very well. I have very sensitive skin and have no issues with these patches at all. This particular jar contains 30 pairs of eye patches. Because they work so well and so quickly, I find the price more than reasonable. For those interested in packaging, the jar is pretty shades of blue and green and very sturdy and durable. Keep the lid on nice and tight and your patches will stay protected and moist. A spatula is included to help apply/remove the patches.

If you're looking for a product to help eliminate red, puffy eyes/dark circles and brighten the skin around your eyes, you've found it! I HIGHLY recommend Generation Skin Matcha Green Tea eye patches!

title: SO Cute and They Work Well
text:
Oh, how I LOVE YOCEAN's resin alligator style cat clips!!! I literally let out a little squeal when I first saw them, they're so darn cute and fun! They arrived packaged very well and in perfect condition. I received the blue clip; especially love the vibrant lighter blue clip. Such a pretty color! Both cats are incredibly cute and nicely detailed. (They even have cute bows around their neck!) The cats are very well made. They are crafted from resin. I know pretty much NOTHING about resin, but I can tell you they're not flimsy...fairly heavy (not in a painful way...in a good quality way). I don't think its easy to break the cats, they're durable and sturdy. The clip is an alligator clip-fairly long and works like a clothespin. Its easy to open/close. A nice soft pouch is also included with the clips, perfect for storing them or gift giving . (My dog felt the need to use it as a toy and ripped it, so I cannot post a photo of it.) The clips hold my thick hair well and stay in place for quite some time but eventually, they do begin to slip a bit.

In addition to working as a hair clip, you could always use them for decorative purposes. Clip them on a curtain, Xmas tree, a bow/ribbon on a wrapped gift, etc. They are definitely worthy of gift giving, especially for cat lovers. I do love these clips and absolutely recommend them.

title: Great Texture Spray-Works Well & Smells Good Too!
text:
Cuvee's conditioner just did not work well with my hair. But, I'm happy to say, I made out far better with Cuvee's color safe texture spray.

While the conditioner seemed to dry out my hair, this spray did not. It is indeed nice and lightweight- I have no issues with it weighing my hair down, making my hair 'crunchy' or giving it an oily/greasy look or feel. This spray can be used on wet or dry hair. (I use it on damp, towel dry hair only. I've not tried it on dry hair at all) . As instructed, i spray some around my roots which gives my hair some added volume and lift that it desperately needs. I also spray the rest of my hair as well. Because it sprays in a nice mist, 2-3 sprays is sufficient to cover my shoulder length, thick hair. It really does a nice job of moisturizing my hair while giving it a bit of shine as well. As for the scent...I just LOVE the scent! Its unique and unlike any other scent I'm familiar with . Best of all, I can actually still smell it in my hair the next day! It lasts that long but is not overpowering or gagging.

I'm so happy Cuvee's texturizing spray works well with my hair. I like it very much and will likely purchase it, however, in the trial size only as the regular size bottle is a bit pricey for me.

title: Not The Right Conditioner For Me (but it smells GREAT!)
text: As my hair air-dried following my first use of Cuvee conditioner, I thought perhaps I hadn't rinsed it out entirely.  It looked and felt dried out and kind of hard. I had some tangles as well though they were easy and painless to comb through.  When it did dry  completely, it wasn't any better.  It was visibly dry and crunchy.  My natural waves weren't nice and smooth, they kind of looked as though I had a mild case of static electricity taking place. I kept my hair in a ponytail and gave it another shot the next night.  Unfortunately, and after spending extra time rinsing my hair to be safe, I wound up with the same result as the previously night.  I really wish this conditioner had worked better with  my hair. I really like the consistency-it reminds of me of canned whipped cake frosting!  Its nice and lightweight and 'airy'  and boy, does it ever smell GOOD!  I could still smell it in my hair the following day and that doesn't happen often for me. Its rare that I can still smell a conditioner the following day as I could with Cuvee.  I also found it easy to work through my hair when I applied it and didn't have to use much to sufficiently cover my shoulder length, thick hair.  I did have some better luck with Cuvee's texture spray and Blowout Bombe (I will review both). For whatever reason, Cuvee's conditioner just did not work well on my hair and I have no plans to purchase it in the future.

title: Another GORGEOUS Polish From Cirque Colors
text: Cirque Colors has done it again...another gorgeous, unique polish!  New Wave is one of 6 polishes in Cirque's newest collection, Superfuture.  All 6 polishes are multichrome.  New Wave is a beautiful shade that goes from cerulean blue to purple, to gold with a light shimmer. Its applies well-nice and even.  I use 3 coats and LOVE the results.  Cirque Colors is an awesome brand and I own many of their polishes.  Love them all and I'm happy to add New Wave to my  collection of polishes!

title: Exceptional. Everything About This is Exceptional!
text:
This truly is an exceptional product. You cannot go wrong with OVLUX's Hair Clippers for Men.

There are so many fabulous features to this hair clipper, I almost don't know where to start. Everything about this is well made and high quality. It is crafted from stainless steel. It will not scratch or rust. Thanks to the ergonomic design, its comfortable to hold while in use. (I say this from experience as I do use it to trim my husband's hair) Included with the clipper is something I've never seen included before with any other brand...a 6 foot long cord! That allows A LOT of extra room to move around while using the clipper and boy, does it ever come in handy! That's not all. The clipper also comes with 6 different size guide combs. According to my husband, the most his other clippers came with was 4 combs , so 6 is unheard of! I was quite surprised the first time we used the OVLUX. Its far quieter than I expected. Another stand out feature the OVLUX has that no other clipper (that my husband has ever used/owned) is an LED screen that lets him know when its time to charge or oil the clippers~. No more guessing when its time, the OVLUX lets you know when maintenance is needed. (A cleaning brush and oil is included to help keep your clippers nice and clean!)

I'm completely at ease when using the clippers to cut my husband's hair. He is as well. (I do the back, he does the front lol) I don't worry about messing up or cutting too much or not enough. Its next to impossible to do that. This OVLUX is super easy to operate and has a good deal of power making hair trimming jobs quick and easy. Clean up is easy as well.

The OVLUX is ABSOLUTELY worthy of gift giving! It makes for a fantastic gift. It really does an incredible job and is SO easy to use. OVLUX backs this clipper with a 1 year extended warranty as well.

Take a minute to check out all of the features and benefits that come with using this hair clipper. It does everything it promises to do. Without a doubt, I HIGHLY recommend the OVLUX mens clippers!~

title: LOVE This So Much, I Immediately Enrolled in 'Subscribe and Save'!
text:
Alterna's Caviar Anti-Aging Leave-In Conditioning Milk does wonders for my hair and I just LOVE it!

I noticed the description on this page refers to it as a 'spray'. Perhaps there is a spray version of this, but the bottle I received dispenses via a pump. A small amount is dispensed with each pump (photo included shows one pump's worth ). 3-4 pumps dispenses enough conditioning milk to apply to my shoulder length, thick hair. After washing and towel drying my hair, I pump conditioner into my hand, rub my hands together and run them through my hair. It applies and distributes throughout my hair easily. It goes to work immediately and de-tangles my hair. I'm able to run my fingers or a comb through hair without getting snagging on painful tangles. When my hair dries (I air dry), my natural curls and waves are soft and smooth. There are no fly-aways to be found. My hair doesn't just have bounce, it is also shiny, soft, tangle free, hydrated and moisturized. Between the awesome way my hair looks and feels, along with the light and refreshing scent of this leave in conditioning milk, my hair looks and feels like I just walked out of a salon. Silly as it may sound, my hair just feels GOOD!

I really love what Alterna Caviar conditioning milk does for my hair. I also love what it does NOT do for my hair. It does not weigh my hair down-the conditioning milk really is lightweight. It also goes not cause my hair to look or feel oily/greasy. My hair is thick, however, due to aging, over the past couple of years its been thinning around my scalp. Due to extreme stress, I also experienced hair loss in the form of clumps falling out. Thankfully, that ended about a year or so ago. But I'm aging and my hair is as well. Its not as easy to care for as it once was. I need to do everything I can to keep it healthy and using Alterna Caviar Leave-In conditioning milk is one way I can ensure I'm taking the best possible care of my hair. I will continue to purchase and use Alterna. Because it benefits my hair in SO many ways and I don't need to use much, I find the cost to be reasonable. I was thrilled to see that it is an Amazon 'subscribe and save' item and I've already set up my delivery schedule to receive Alterna Caviar Leave-In conditioning milk. I love what this does for my hair and HIGHLY recommend it. (BTW...this is a unisex product!)

title: Very Pleased With My Results!
text:
I first became aware of Natural Formula brand a few months ago when I tested/reviewed their Ampoule Intense Pro-Repair. I loved it so much , I purchased another bottle almost immediately. I jumped at the chance to try Natural's Color Intense Toning Conditioner. And it did not disappoint. The bright blonde formula evened my hair color. I don't have different shades of blond any longer, its all pretty much the same now. This conditioner also makes my hair nice and soft and frizz free .while hydrating at the same time. It does keep the color evened out for a few weeks without fading, which is pretty impressive! The description of the item (above) says using this conditioner leaves hair with 'bold color'. While it did help brighten my hair nicely, I wouldn't call it 'bold color'. And I'm fine with that because i am extremely pleased with the results this conditioner delivers. .

If you're a blond, I recommend trying Natural Formula's Color Intense Toning Conditioner. It works so very well and quickly too! Love this brand...I just purchased Natural Formula's Cream and Coconut Oil hair styling cream and cannot wait to try it.

title: Not For Me
text:
Kavella conditioner does a very nice job of softening and smoothing my hair. It is indeed lightweight and was not only easy to apply to my hair but easy to rinse out as well and did not leave an oily or greasy look/feel behind. The scent, I especially like though it doesn't last long.

I didn't experience much of an increase to both the strength and volume of my hair from using Kavella. Nothing about it stood out and made me think to myself that I REALLY need to use this conditioner again. This just is not the right conditioner for me, unfortunately.

title: Does a Nice Job (but boy is the bottle a force not to be reckoned with!)
text:
This conditioner does a nice job of moisturizing and softening my dry hair. My natural waves look great and have no frizz/fly aways after using this. And it is doing a pretty decent job protecting my hair color and preventing it from fading. It doesn't weigh my hair down or make it look or feel oily /greasy. The scent isn't bad...not my favorite but certainly not horrible. I can't detect it once my hair dries so scent is not an issue either way for me. I will say that I don't really notice much shine to my hair after using this, which I find to be a bit disappointing but not the end of the world. Its easy to work through my hair and just as easy when it comes time to rinse it out. There is a bit of a downside to this...the bottle. Its a nice looking bottle but goodness, I must squeeze and squeeze to get just a little conditioner out. ( The first time I tried this conditioner, I was taking a bath. I had been shaving my legs. I put my razor down on the edge of the tub and had to use 2 hands to get conditioner out of the bottle. As I was doing so, the bottle slipped out of my hands, hit the handle of the razor causing it to fly up in the air . Naturally, on its way back down it whacked me on the forehead. The blade came off of the razor and I couldn't find it anywhere...until I glanced in the trash can! LOLOLOL...I got a kick out of that...guess you had to be there!)

Overall, I'm pleased with the results I get when using Alterna Caviar conditioner.

title: Not The Right Sea Salt Spray For My Hair
text:
I experienced such positive results from both Alterna Caviar Anti-Aging Replenishing Leave-In Conditioning Milk and Alterna Caviar Anti-Aging Infinite Color Hold Conditioner, I suppose I just assumed I'd feel the same about Alterna Caviar Professional Styling Sea Salt Spray. Sadly, it didn't turn out that way. I do very much like the scent of the spray and it is indeed lightweight, but, for whatever reason it just didn't work well in my hair. It does not weigh my hair down but at the same time, it also doesn't add much volume to my hair. Patches of hair felt kind of 'gummy' and 'waxy' after I used this spray. I was hoping my natural waves would be a bit more pronounced but I really didn't notice much of a difference.

I have no plans to continue using this sea salt spray. But I WILL continue to use Alterna's Leave-In Milk conditioner as well as Alterna's Color Hold Conditioner.

title: Absolutely Incredible...FAST Results! (already purchased a 2nd bottle!)
text:
I did a double take when I saw Herbs Botanica Red Onion Hair Growth shampoo in my VINE queue offers. After reading the description, I immediately ordered a bottle. I had NO CLUE that red onions could help strengthen hair and help with hair growth as well as prevent dandruff and itching on the scalp. I knew I loved to cook with and eat onions (Seriously, I'd bite into them and eat them like an apple if my stomach would let me get away with it...I REALLY love onions!) but had no clue about the hair/scalp benefits they provide as well. For the past couple of years, I've been experiencing thinning hair due to aging as well as some hair loss (In clumps) due to stress. Thankfully, the stress related hair loss has stopped. Still experiencing the hair thinning as well as breakage of hair.

I've used Herbs Botanica Red Onion shampoo every day for the past week. I've not noticed any new growth yet. And to be honest, at this point, that would just be a bonus. While I originally ordered this shampoo to help with hair growth and to add fullness around my scalp, its already done so much more for my hair. This is a fabulous shampoo! An amount about the size of a nickel covers my shoulder length, thick hair. My hair already begins to feel different as I work the shampoo into a lather . It immediately becomes softer. It eliminates tangles. As I use my hands to help work the shampoo out while rinsing my hair, I can already feel a new fullness to my hair. I really wish I could explain this better. Yes, my hair is soaking wet at this point but it feels different, it feels thicker and fuller as I rinse and after my hair dries (I air dry), it IS thicker and fuller, including my scalp area where I've been experiencing thinning. It is noticeably healthier and shinier. There is no frizz or fly-aways. Less breakage as well. This may be a shampoo, but it works as a conditioner as well in my hair. When I use Herbs Botanica, I don't need to use a hair conditioner with it though I do at times. This is not a 2 -in 1 product but it sure works like one!

I dont' have an issue with dandruff, so I cannot comment as to how well it stops dandruff. I do have dry, sensitive skin which worsens in winter months when the heat is on in our home. I am still scratching my head since using this but it has calmed down a bit.

In addition to red onion extract, this shampoo also contains: coconut/sunflower/argan/castor/neem/rose /jojoba and sandalwood oils, Vitamin E and shea butter, to name a few. I recommend you take a minute to read over all of the info on this page including the ingredients in this shampoo and what each does to help repair and keep hair healthy.

When the shampoo first arrived, I immediately opened the cap to smell its scent. (I'm weird like that...I'm the wacko you see in stores taking the caps off of hair products, laundry detergents to check out the scent prior to purchasing) I thought the scent wasn't too bad. But when I used the shampoo for the first time and worked it into a lather, I was able to smell it far better. I don't care for it. It reminds me of the scent from do it yourself hair coloring though it doesn't make my eyes/nose burn like boxed hair coloring does. I've not removed any stars from my rating of this product due to the scent. In the end, it really doesn't matter that I don't care for it. Once I rinse this shampoo from my hair, I no longer detect the shampoo's scent. It doesn't stay in my hair.

Herbs Botanica shampoo has done so much for my hair in such a short time. I not only plan to continue using it, I already purchased a second bottle! I HIGHLY recommend this shampoo! I hope it helps everyone as much as it has helped my hair in such a short time! I do love it. I absolutely LOVE it. Yet another reason for me to love red onions! lol

title: Heals and Helps My Hair Immediately-This is a Keeper!
text:
This is one heck of a fabulous leave in conditioner! ISHA DNA isn't kidding when it claims to provide damage control in an instant! Once I've applied this lightweight leave-in to my hair, it immediately becomes softer and well moisturized. My hair had recently taken a beating between the cold weather outdoors and the constant running of heat in our home all day long. Its become dry and breaks easily. ISHA gets to work healing and keeping my hair protected. I use 3-4 pumps' worth of the conditioner. I dispense it into my hands, rub them together and then work the conditioner through my shoulder length, thick hair. It applies easily without weighing my hair down or making it look/feel oily or greasy. I'm able to comb right through my hair and don't have to fight through tangles. ISHA takes care of detangling my hair as well. I use ISHA after washing my hair while its damp. It can be used on dry hair, however, I've never used it that way, only on damp hair. When my hair air dries, my natural waves and curls are nice and calm...smooth and free of fly aways and frizz. My hair has a healthy bounce to it and feels good. There is a bit of a scent to this leave in and it smells good but it doesn't last long at all. (An hour tops, in my hair)

I'm thrilled with this leave in. It gets to work healing and protecting my hair as soon as I apply it. This leave -in is a definite keeper for me. The price is incredibly reasonable and because I don't have to use much to cover all of my hair, this bottle will last a long time.

title: Pros and Cons
text:
I was hoping to blown away with VIVAIODAYS Organic Tsubaki Leave-In conditioner. Unfortunately, I wasn't. But it DOES have some good qualities that I like and appreciate.

Good:

--Does a nice job of softening hair and adding some shine

--Does a nice job of detangling hair. I did have a few stubborn tangles that I had to give another squirt to before they came out. (and they did come out...easily, after I used a bit more)

--The leave-in conditioner is lightweight. It doesn't weigh my hair down nor does it cause my hair to look /feel oily or greasy

--Works well with sensitive skin. I have terribly sensitive skin and have no issues using this

--Bottles are made from recyclable sugarcane bottles

--I love that the conditioner sprays out in a mist; it evenly covers my hair and only takes 2-3 sprays to cover my shoulder length, thick hair

Downside:

--I've not noticed any strengthening of my hair (Keep in mind, I've not used this very long-only a week. The info doesn't state how long it takes for hair to strengthen)

--I still experience split ends (I've only been using this for a week...info does not state how long it takes to see a stop to split ends)

--I don't care for the scent...in the first instant I smell it, it seems OK; soft and light. But when I actually fully smell it, I don't care for it. There is something about it that I can't put my finger on. Ridiculous as this sounds, when I was a kid, I had a Pizza Hut toy that really baked. (a lightbulb heated it! lol) It came with dough mix-some kind of powder that I had to mix with water to form the dough, then spread onto the mini pizza pan. That is what the full scent of this spray reminds me of. The mini Pizza Hut dough from my oven when I was a kid.

I experienced pros and cons with this leave in conditioner. Its not terrible but I don't think its the right leave in for my hair.

title: Definitely Delivers Shine and Moisture...But Leave a 'Waxy' Feel To Hair
text:
If you're looking to add shine to your hair, look no further. Raincry's Shine Conditioner delivers on its promise to make hair shiny and does so with the very first use. I'm really not quite sure when or if my hair was ever as shiny as it is after I use Raincry. Its impressive. But it does more than just make hair shine. It adds much needed moisture to my hair and helps strengthen it.

I wish I could end my review there...all positives. Unfortunately, that's not the case. After my hair is dry following use of Raincry, it has kind of a 'waxy' feel to it. The first time it happened, I figured I hadn't rinsed out my hair well enough so I bent over the kitchen sink and used the sink hose to rinse my hair out again. (I did not add more shampoo or Raincry...only water) Once again, when my hair was dry, it still had the 'waxy' feel to it. By no means did it flatten my hair...absolutely NOT. But my natural waves and curls weren't as prominent as they normally are.

Raincry smells wonderful and the scent actually lasts in my hair the day after I use it. For those interested, Raincry really nailed the packaging! Raincry is in a tube, not a bottle. The tube is contained in a nice, sturdy cylinder container.

I really love the shine Raincry brings to my hair. I'm happy with the way it moisturizes my hair as well. Due to the 'waxy' feel that remains on my hair after using Raincry, its not for me. I have no plans to purchase any Raincry products in the future.

title: Love Everything About This Conditioner!
text:
I usually mention the scent of shampoo/conditioner toward the end of my reviews. Not this time. This time, I'm starting with it. Because I absolutely LOVE the scent of this conditioner! It smells fantastic and unlike most conditioners, it doesn't fade quickly. But the scent is hardly the only thing to love about Lonstin Argan Oil conditioner. It has a creamy, yet lightweight consistency that makes it easy to work though hair. I don't need to use very much to thoroughly cover my shoulder length, thick hair. Its rinses from hair without issue and does not weigh hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. Now that winter has arrived and the heat is on in the house all the time, my already dry hair is even drier. Lonstin argan oil conditioner provides the moisture and hydration my hair so desperately needs. It tames fly-aways, de-tangles and makes my hair nice and shiny.

This conditioner is suitable for all hair types

My hair looks and feels good after I use Lonstin. It does a fabulous job of repairing damage to my hair and keeping it healthy. the price is absolutely reasonable. I still have 3/4 left but already placed an order for a 2nd bottle. (even used a $3.00 coupon!) This is a 'keeper' conditioner that I will continue to purchase and use.

title: Pantene Delivers Another Awesome Product
text:
Pantene does it again! Another fantastic product. Sunlit Blonde Daily Rescue conditioner is perfect for my blonde hair. Its packed with important ingredients that my hair desperately needs: Vitamins B5 & E, argan oil, biotin and silk extract, to name a few. It does not contain parabens , dyes or mineral oils. Its nice and lightweight-it does not weigh my hair down or cause it to look or feel oily or greasy. It only takes an amount the size of a half dollar to sufficiently cover my shoulder length thick hair. I notice less hair breakage when brushing my hair after using Pantene, along with a nice shine and brightness to my blonde hair. And boy, is my hair ever incredibly soft thanks to Pantene Sunlit! Soft AND tangle free. There is a scent and I just love it. Its not strong or overpowering. Its on the lighter side-coconut, rice milk and lotus flower. ( I mainly detect the coconut scent. ) I dont' know if its just me but my hair rarely still smells like shampoo/conditioner the day after I use it, it usually fades by then. Not with this conditioner...the scent actually sticks around the following day and my hair smells GOOD!

If you have blonde hair, I recommend giving this a try. It works great and delivers results with the very first use.

title: This Might Be the Perfect Conditioner...I Love Everything About It!
text:
Oh, how I LOVE Kenra Sugar Beach conditioner! I fell in love with it the very first time I used it. In fact, it was not only the first time I ever used a Kenra product, it was the first time I heard of Kenra as well.

Sugar Beach is a nice, lightweight conditioner. After I shampooed and rinsed my hair, I massaged an amount of conditioner roughly the size of a half dollar into my shoulder length, thick hair. I waited 10 minutes before rinsing my hair. It rinsed beautifully and left behind NO tangles. As my hair air-dried, I could already feel how soft it was. When it was completely dry, it had not only a fantastic shine to it but my natural waves were more pronounced and fuller while smooth with no fly-aways. I do use hairspray but I normally don't need much. I used even less after using Kenra conditioner. I just didn't need it. My hair stayed in place and styled exactly the way I wanted it.

The day after I used this conditioner for the first time, I had yet another reason to love it. I stopped to talk to a neighbor briefly and she told me my hair smelled so good! Kenra has a FANTASTIC scent to it that I LOVE. I was thrilled that the scent stuck around the day after I used Kenra.

The Kenra brand is an 'Amazon's Choice' product. If you're not familiar, an Amazon's Choice product means its a highly rate, well priced item. Kenra definitely deserves the honor. This conditioner is wonderful. I love every single thing about it and what it does for my hair. I do find the price to be reasonable. This is a conditioner I will continue to purchase and use. (You can do 'subscribe and save' with Kenra products!) I've already ordered Kenra's Professional Sugar Beach spray and can't wait to try it. I absolutely recommend Kenra Sugar Beach conditioner.

title: Decent...But Not For Me
text:
Immediately after I use Curlyshyll primer , it detangles and softens my hair. It does a nice job of hydrating as well. I like and appreciate that it does not weigh my hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy. It is nice and lightweight.
and does not make my hair hard or crunchy. I'm able to easily comb it. There is a bit of a scent and its a nice scent but it fades quickly. While this does an overall nice job, it doesn't really do anything to my hair that makes it a stand out or unique primer. The price is higher than I'm willing to pay. I have no plans to purchase/continue to use this after I finish this current bottle.

title: Does Everything It Promises To Do
text:
Each of the 12 key ingredients in FoxyBae's bounce volumizing conditioner provide a specific benefit for hair care. Together, they make this a fantastic conditioner. (Take a minute to check out the chart above showing the 12 key ingredients and what they contribute to this conditioner. It's impressive!)

I'm a new fan of the FoxyBae brand having tried their Maliboo conditioner last month...and its great. I'm happy to report that this bounce volumizing conditioner is just as good! It is a repair + volumizing conditioner. It not only repairs damaged hair, it makes it shiny, soft and healthy. It also detangles hair. An amount roughly the size of a half dollar covers my shoulder length, thick hair. Its easy to distribute throughout hair and rinses out without issue. It doesn't not make my hair look or feel oily /greasy nor does it weigh my hair down. It also tames my flyaways. This is a fantastic conditioner that does everything it promises to do. Because it benefits hair in so many ways, has 12 important ingredients and only a small amount is needed to cover my hair entirely, I absolutely find the price reasonable. title: Does A Really Nice Job

title: Instant Relief From Aches and Pains...Bruises Fade Much Quicker As Well
text: I've had excellent results with various hemp products over the years and use them often. I'm not exaggerating in the slightest when I say a light bump of her arm against something that wouldn't leave a mark on me shows up on her as though someone took a hammer to her arm and pounded away. Over the summer, she opened the car door and lightly brushed it against her knee. A short time later, her knee was so bruised and purple, you would have thought she had broken her kneecap.  Obviously, these bruises bring her aches and pains.  If they're visible, they also draw attention to people who don't know she's on blood thinners and why her bruises are so extreme. The day after I gave her the jar of Bruizex, she was putting a grocery bag into her car trunk. The handle of a bag became twisted and bent her fingers back a bit.  By the time she got home, her fingers and top of her hand were already bruised.  She reached for her Bruizex, rubbed some onto her bruising and called me about an hour later, amazed.  She said as soon as she rubbed the cream in, relief from the pain came immediately.  Her relief lasted so long that later that night when her sister asked what had happened to her hand after seeing her bruises, she'd forgotten all about it because she had no pain.  She didn't quite follow the instructions that first day and only applied the cream one time. The following day, she read the instructions and learned she needed to apply the cream 3x's a day and rub it in 2-3 minutes each time its applied. So she did. By that end of day #2 of that particular injury, her bruising was FAR lighter than it had been that morning and she was pain free. No aches or soreness at the bruise site.  After using her cream for 4 days (3x's a day, except that first day), her bruise was gone...FAR quicker than normal.  She has no issues using the cream...no burning or adverse reactions of any kind.  As soon as she uses it on the affected area she is soothed and pain is relieved.  It absorbs quickly and doesn't cause skin to look or feel oily/greasy. In addition to the hemp, this cream also contains:  menthol, aloe vera, peppermint, lavender, arnica (this was new for me...did some reading and learned it helps with pain and swelling), and MCT oil.  She smells the menthol in the cream, I do not. I smell the peppermint.  (Don't worry, the scent vanishes quickly) I hate that she has had to put up with so many bruises and pain over the years as a result of bruising easily. But I AM thankful she now has Bruizex to help relieve her pain and heal her quickly. She plans on continuing to use and purchase Bruizex.

text: I've been using a leave in cream conditioner that I love. I thought I'd always use it but in the end, it was just too expensive so I set out to find a new leave in cream conditioner. title: Its As Though I Have a New Head of Hair When I Use This Mask!( and the scent is FABULOUS!)
text: I didn't have much luck with RR's ultra conditioner but this mask is an entirely different story! I swear I could feel it working as it sat on my hair. When my hair dried (air dry), it was soft, shine, silky, healthy, smelled great and it just looked AND felt fantastic...like a new head of hair.  The mask consistency is definitely creamy-its easy to apply throughout hair and rinses without issue. It does not weigh hair down, nor does it make hair look or feel oily/greasy.  The scent is phenomenal! I wish my hair smelled like this mask 24/7, 365 days. This mask works wonders on my hair. I do not know how much it costs but I ABSOLUTELY can see myself using this mask again and again. I LOVE it. I LOVE how it makes my hair look and feel. Its simply amazing.

title: Not the Right Conditioner For Me
text: I was so excited to try a Richard Rojas product for the first time ever. I was hoping it would be a 'must have' for me.  Unfortunately, that didn't happen.  It is a good conditioner-nice and lightweight. (Richard Rojas' Crema Hair Repair Mask is  a different  story. I it as well and LOVE it! Review will be posted soon)

title: No Hair Growth...But I'm No Longer Losing Hair!
text: I've been using Naturindia hair growth treatment shampoo for a few weeks now.  I've not  had any noticeable hair growth. Quite honestly, I was about ready to give up on it. And then I realized while I haven't experienced any hair growth, I  DO have a huge decrease in hair loss .  I'm no longer pulling hair from the bathtub drain like I used to.  I'm not seeing much hair in my hairbrush after brushing it.  I don't have split ends any longer.  The loss of hair I've been experiencing due to aging has slowed TREMENDOUSLY since I started to  use this shampoo.  In addition to the decrease in hair loss, my hair is soft and shiny and I rarely have tangles. Naturindia doesn't weigh my hair down and make it look/feel oily or greasy.  It does have a slight scent but I can no longer detect it after I rinse the shampoo from my hair.  I began using this shampoo with the hopes it would stimulate hair growth for me. That hasn't happened yet but then again, I haven't been using it very long. Perhaps it will happen in time. Even if it doesn't, I'm more than satisfied and pleased with Naturindia because its definitely strengthening/ preventing me from losing hair. My clean bathtub drain and hairbrush are proof of this.  I can't recommend this with regards to hair growth since I haven't  yet experienced it but I can and DO recommend this shampoo to help prevent hair loss.  I'm SO very grateful for it and what its doing for my hair.

title: One of My Fave Brands of Polish!
text: There's a good reason why ILNP is one of my favorite brands of nail polish!  Their polishes are high quality, last a LONG time and the colors are just SO vibrant and gorgeous! Blue is my favorite color. I absolutely LOVE LOVE LOVE the  shade of blue in ILNP Summer Stargazing. Its positively GORGEOUS!  I absolutely recommend Summer Stargazing and  ANY polish by ILNP!

title: Great Taste, Moisturizes and Soothes Dry, Chapped Lips Instantly!
text: Sky Organics has put together a tasty trio of holiday lip balms that don't just taste good, they provide immediate relief to dry, cracked, chapped lips.  Winter has yet to arrive and my lips are already starting to look and feel as though I've been spending a lot of time outdoors in cold weather! As soon as  I apply the lip balm to my dry, itchy lips, they are immediately calmed and soothed thanks to the beeswax, coconut oil and Vitamin E healing ingredients. Re-applying the balm 2-3 times throughout the day keeps my lips hydrated and moisturized.  Since using Sky Organics lip balm, my lips are far less chapped, look AND feel better.  All 3 flavors:  Pumpkin Spice ( I'm not normally a fan of pumpkin anything but I do very much like this lip balm!), raspberry truffle and sugar cookie (my fave!) taste great and work beautifully.  The packaging is nice and festive.  This trio makes a perfect stocking stuffer, topper on a holiday gift ,  a little something extra to include with a monetary gift,  or do as I am...keeping it and enjoying it for myself!  The price is incredibly reasonable; I would have expected this trio to cost twice the price.  If you experience dry, chapped lips, Sky Organics lip balm trio is a 'must have'!

title: Does What It Promises To Do
text: This is the first product from Cab's I've ever used. Its also the first time I've ever heard of Cab's. lol. So, far, so good! No, make that so far, so great! This argan oil spray delivers everything it promises to do. It makes my dry hair soft and shiny. I don't normally have a ton of split ends; since using Cab's I have fewer.  I love how lightweight this spray is.  It does not weigh my hair down nor does it make it look or feel oily/greasy. It keeps my natural waves and curls nice and calm and prevents my hair from becoming frizzy.  (I'm anxious to use this when the temps get hot and humid!) I can't comment as to how well the spray works to protect hair from heated styling tools because I do not use curling irons, hair dryers , flatirons, etc.  I also cannot comment as to how it works when sprayed on dry hair. I use it only when my hair is damp. There is a scent and I very much like it but it doesn't stick around long at all.  My hair is shoulder length and only requires a few pumps of the spray to sufficiently cover it, so this bottle will last me a decent amount of time. I will continue to use Cab's argan oil spray  and absolutely recommend it.  Cab's offers a 30 day guarantee if you find you're not satisfied.  I find the cost to be perfectly reasonable and worth it!

title: Works Wonders While You Sleep
text: I'm familiar with SheaMoisture's hair care products and am a big fan of their Manuka Honey & Mafura Conditioner, Curl Enhancing Smoothie and Coconut Hibiscus conditioner. SheaMoisture not only makes awesome hair products, their skin products are fantastic as well!

title: Wonderful Aloe Vera Gel...(even our dog uses it!)
text: Everyone in our home uses PalNour's Aloe Vera gel daily. When I say 'everyone', I'm not kidding. Even our DOG uses it!  We saw  a tick on our dog Mac a few days ago. Luckily, he'd just been to the groomer so we spotted it quickly, when it had just started to attach itself. While a fairly easy removal, it did leave a small lump on him.  For 2 days, twice a day, I put a few drops of PalNour's aloe vera gel on the lump. By the end of day 2, the lump was gone and the tiny scab completely healed. The bottle is definitely unique (kind of reminds me of a giant Tic-Tac! lol) and the pump dispenses the perfect amount of gel each time.  I have the 9.45oz size in the home for all of us to use but after trying PalNour for the first time and loving it so much, I ordered 1.70oz since for my purse as well so I have it with me at all times.  Our entire family uses AND recommends PalNour's aloe vera gel. (even Mac!)

title: WOW...I Never Knew There Was a Fix For My Un-Even Tones/Brassiness!
text: I'm  new to the world of 'purple' hair products. (I'm NOT new to the Majestic Pure brand, however...I've used some of MP's shampoos/conditioners with great results, especially the apple cider vinegar and argan oil products)  Until I tried purple hair products, I never realized how uneven my hair tone was and I pretty much thought the brassiness, while not a lot, was something I just had to learn to live with. I didn't know there was a way to get rid of it.  I am a natural blond...medium-ish blond except in the summer when my hair gets VERY light blond-almost white. I do use coloring on my roots every couple of weeks to cover the greys.  MP's shampoo recommends  lathering and massaging the shampoo on wet hair and letting it sit for 3-5 minutes. I was enjoying  a nice, hot bath and reading a magazine when I used MP and wound up leaving the shampoo on my hair for about 10 minutes. lol. No worries, all was well.  After rinsing the shampoo, I applied MP's purple conditioner and followed the directions, allowing it to sit on my hair for 3 minutes before rinsing. I had no issues rinsing either out of my hair. My hair dried (air dried) like normal and my natural waves/curls were exactly as they should be. My hair was soft, smooth and shiny and looked great. And then I realized the little brassiness I'd had was gone.  My hair tone was nice and even as well.  All this time, there was a solution to my uneven tones/brassisness and I never knew it. Better late than never, I suppose! Not sure how often I will use MP's purple products. I have to wait and see when my hair needs a treatment again.  As soon as it's necessary, I absolutely will take care of it with Majestic Pure's shampoo and conditioner.  Great products, I'm incredibly satisfied (and still a bit amazed!) with my results!

title: EXACTLY What I Wanted! Love the Mist!
text: I tried a SUREAM spray bottle to hold the liquid fabric softener that I spray on my bedding on a daily basis. The spray bottle worked SO well for me, I got 4 more!  I sometimes use a hemp leave-in conditioner spray.  I love the spray itself but I do not love the nozzle on the bottle the spray comes in. It sprays in one long stream so I'm unable to adequately cover all of my hair. Today, I poured my hemp  conditioner into a SUREAM spray bottle. There are SO many things to use the spray bottles on...its not only for hair products.  I absolutely recommend SUREAM's spray bottle!

text: I'd never heard of the Royal Moroccan brand before but after trying it, I'm definitely aware of it now! What  a fantastic hair conditioner this is! text: If a lotion weighs heavily on my skin or makes it look or feel oily/greasy, I won't use it. I just cannot stand how that feels. title: How I Love This Clay Mask- Delivers Immediate Results!
text: Argiletz pink clay mask does a wonderful job of cleaning and softening my skin while giving it a nice, healthy glow.  Its so easy to use. There is no mixing or prep work of any kind involved. title: Nature Nut Delivers Yet Another Fabulous Product That I LOVE!
text: I'm already a huge fan of Nature Nut products. I've been using the styling and moisturizing hair cream for months and love what it does for my hair.  I also use the moisturizing face cream as well and very much like it.  It was hardly a surprise when I tried Nature Nut's Face Serum and, of course, found another NN product to love! title: These Will Make You Nice and Clean While Exfoliating at the Same Time!
text: MainBasics seaweed loofahs are very well made and don't easily come apart like some loofahs do!  Together, with body wash, they produce a wonderful lather . title: Works Just As Well As the Expensive Name Brand Razors-But Cost FAR Less!
text: After using a DreamGenius razor, you're going to wonder why on earth you've been paying an absurd amount of money on name brand razors and razor blades. (I did!) DreamGenius offers customer service to help with any issues you might come across and allows returns unconditionally should there be a problem/flaw with the handle or cartridge. And the the cost is FAR lower than the name brands out there. They're going to last you a LONG time.  I can't recommend these enough.  Give yourself a wonderful shave and enjoy the money you're going to save with DreamGenius razors!

title: Works Beautifully and Tames my Frizzy, Fly-away Hair!
text: Soapbox Argan Oil soothing spray does a very nice job of taming my frizzy hair.  With the heat and humidity we're experiencing here, I really need all the help I can get! title: Keeps Skin Healthy and Fresh!
text: I was already a fan of Follain's Mattifying Moisturizer so it wasn't a huge to surprise to discover that I really like Follain's Balancing Cleanser as well. My skin feels unbelievably soft, smooth, clean and refreshed after  I use it. The charcoal in the cleanser provides a deep cleaning of skin while removing excess oils and unclogging pores.  (I'm a HUGE fan of products containing charcoal!) Rosewater and witch hazel work together to provide an even balance to skin tone.  The cleanser, when dispensed from the container, has the consistency of  body wash (thick, gel-ish) but lathers beautifully  once face washing commences. It can be rinsed off immediately or left on the face for a minute or two to do a very deep cleaning of skin.  Skin is fresh and vibrant after using Follain cleanser.  I have very sensitive skin. I do  notice a slight dryness (and I do mean slight) to my skin after using this cleanser which is easily remedied with a bit of facial moisturizing cream such as Follain Mattifying Moisturizer. I'm guessing the cause of that slight dryness is the rosewater as I sometimes experience reactions to items containing it. This slight dryness is nowhere close to being severe enough to keep me from using this cleanser.  While the cleanser is on your face, be VERY careful to keep it away from your eyes.  I , somehow managed to get a tiny bit in my eye causing a burning sensation-luckily,  I  quickly rinsed my eye and all was soon well.  Follain products are vegan, clean, cruelty and gluten free,  non GMO made in the USA and dermatologist tested. They're also awesome and do a wonderful job of cleaning skin and keeping it healthy.

title: A Much Needed Fullness To My Hair AND It Smells FABULOUS!
text: I'm not sure what I love more about Moroccanoil Volumizing Mist-the way it brings fullness to my hair or the scent of the mist.  Both are fabulous! I  have thick, shoulder length hair. For the past couple of years, my hair has experienced normal thinning that comes with aging, mainly around my scalp. After using Moroccanoil for the first time, I really was amazed by the results.  My already thick hair had an added fullness and more body to it, but wasn't out of control by any means. But the area of my scalp where I experience the most thinning had an even look and fullness to it to match the rest of my hair. I could no longer see the small, bare patches of my head where thinning is at its worst. My hair was thick enough to cover those patches just as it had been years ago before the thinning started!  I really was quite stunned AND of course, thrilled!  These results were courtesy of the wonderful argan oil and Dead Sea salt ingredients found in Moroccanioil products.  This mist does NOT weigh my hair down or make it look/feel oily or greasy at all. Its very light.  2-3 sprays dispenses enough mist to cover my hair. It should also be noted that this product is an Amazon 'Professional Beauty' product. For those not familiar, that means this is a high quality item that can be found in professional settings such as spas, hair salons and dermatology offices. This is a wonderful product and I can't stress enough how much it has helped my hair.  Definitely 100% recommended!

title: This is a Miracle Cure For Those W/Bleached/Highlighted Hair!
text:
***I also tried and reviewed Redken's Extreme Bleach Recovery Lamellar Treatment. Since this cream and the lamellar water are to be used together, my reviews are nearly identical with a few changes***

This is very simple. If you bleach or highlight your hair, you NEED to use Redken Extreme Bleach Recovery Treatment. I first washed my hair with Redken's Extreme Bleach Recovery Shampoo. This shampoo alone does an amazing job in not only cleaning but repairing and strengthening hair. You might even think your hair can't possibly get any healthier than it does after using the shampoo but I promise you, it can and it DOES! After the shampoo, the next step is to use Redken's Extreme Bleach Recovery Lamellar Water Treatment. This is a rinse out product (see my review on Redken's Lamellar Water Treatment for more info) The final step in this miraculous hair treatment is Redken's Extreme Bleach Recovery Cica Treatment. This is leave in cream. The cica in this cream heals and strengthens hair while putting an end to split ends in the process. Your already amazingly soft hair gets even softer and healthier. This cream does not weigh down hair or leave a greasy/oily look or feel to hair. It works through hair and covers each strand easily. Silly as it may sound, I look and feel as though I have someone else's hair on my head after using these Redken products. They bring an entirely new life and healing to my dry, bleached hair like nothing I've ever seen before. And they do so with the VERY FIRST USE! My hair is noticeably stronger and healthier. I experience FAR less breakage and split ends. My natural waves look and feel wonderful while remaining smooth at the same time. Fly-aways no longer plague me. I've been in the pool a lot this summer which is NOT a good thing for my hair. Redken is there to protect and heal my hair. I WILL continue to use this 3 step hair system. I don't even care about the cost. This is literally saving and healing my hair, its worth every penny. If you bleach/highlight your hair, your hair needs this Redken 3 step system. You CAN fix and heal the damage that comes with coloring hair. I do use this as recommended. I use all 3 products together. While I've never skipped any of the three products and technically cannot comment as to how well not using all 3 together works, I HIGHLY recommend doing this as instructed and using all 3 together. Don't cut out any of the 3 products, use them all as instructed to heal and strengthen your hair. Get ready...your hair is going to look and feel phenomenal!
