title: Another Victoria Beauty Product I'm Hooked On!
text: The first Victoria Beauty product I ever tried was their Snail Gold day cream. When it arrived, I remember asking myself why on earth I ordered a cream containing snail extract.  I hadn't known how beneficial it can be for skin, I was simply grossed out at the thought of putting it on my face. lol.  When I opened the jar , I did what I always do with a new product such as a cream, lotion, conditioner, detergent, etc. ...I smelled it. (I'm weird, I know...I just have a thing about smelling those types of products) And I LOVED the scent! (apparently, I'm the only one who loves the scent but I think it smells fantastic) And I love what the cream does for my skin even more than the scent. Because of my love for the cream, I decided to order Victoria Beauty's Snail Gold face serum. The serum has the same scent as the cream (YAY!).  It comes in a small bottle that has an easy to use pump that distributes a just right amount of the serum. A little serum goes a LONG way. Its not necessary to use much at all, it spreads nicely.  It absorbs into skin quickly as well without leaving a greasy/oily feel or appearance. 97% of the ingredients in this serum are natural, including snail extract which consists of : Vitamin A (retinol), Vitamins C & E, allantoin, collagen, elastin, glycolic acid, and hyaluronic acid (a fave of mine as I get older). Since using VB serum, the crow's feet around my eyes are slowly becoming less pronounced and filling in.  Don't get me wrong...they're still there...they're smaller and less obvious than before.  My skin is soft and hydrated after using the serum as well, though I will say, I believe the VB cream moisturizes and softens a tad better than the serum. I'm such a fan of Victoria Beauty products that I ordered a jar of the VB Hyaluron Retinol  caviar and red grape anti-wrinkle day and night cream and I cannot wait to try it!  I have my eye on the VB  Cannabis cream as well! I'm blown away by the ridiculously low cost of VB products.  VB could easily charge at least twice the cost of their products and I'd pay it without batting an eye. THAT is how well these products work.  I WILL continue to use and purchase VB's serum and snail gold cream (I'm guessing I' will love the hyaluron caviar cream just as much!) and I absolutely, without a doubt, recommend these products. You have nothing to lose as Victoria Beauty offers a 100% hassle free, money back guarantee if you're not satisfied!

title: Does SO Much and Costs SO Little! Give It a Try!
text: When I washed my hair with True Curl shampoo for the first time, it also marked the first time I had ever tried a non-lather shampoo. It was different, but  not in a bad way. Just took one or two washes to get used to it. True's shampoo is easy to work thru hair and rinse out. It has a nice, fresh scent. But its True's cream conditioner that REALLY won me over! This also is easy to work through hair and it doesn't take much to cover my hair, which is thick and just above my shoulders.  The directions say to keep the conditioner on hair for 3-5 minutes, then rinse.  I keep it on my hair for closer to 10  minutes. Rinsing the conditioner from my hair is easy to do as it rinses out without issue. After towel drying my hair, I'm able to comb right through it because True makes it tangle free. When my hair dries (air dries, I don't use a hair dryer), my natural waves are shiny, smooth, incredibly soft and boy, does my hair smell GOOD! You know the feeling you get after you've been to the hair salon and had your hair washed and trimmed and it just feels good? That's how my hair feels after using True.  It just feels and looks GOOD! True Curl is made for curly hair-from wavy hair all the way to super curly-kinky hair. It does not contain parabens, silicone or sulfates. Its cruelty free, 100% vegan (take a minute and look at all of the ingredients listed about that are in True Colors-its the best of the best hair care ingredients!) and made in the USA. If you're looking for a shampoo and conditioner for your wavy to curly hair, you must give True Curl a try.  I think you'll VERY much like what True does for your curls/hair!

title: Kept My Normally Heat Related Frizzy Mess Nice and Calm
text:
I ordered Alterna's My Hair My Canvas shampoo. I was sent a bottle of Volumizing Blowout Mist instead, therefore that is the product I will review here.

I stopped using a blow dryer on my hair a few years ago. I did blow dry my hair in order to try out Alterna's volumizing blowout spray. This spray is a nice, light mist spray-and it IS a mist spray. It doesn't fly out of the bottle as a regular spray would, it comes out in a mist that covered my hair with a total of 3 sprays. (My hair is thick -some thinning in scalp area- and shoulder length) I didn't even feel it land on my hair-if I hadn't been watching in a mirror as I applied it, I think I would have thought it had missed my hair entirely! That's how light it is. At no point could I feel it sitting on my hair-not while my hair was wet, not when it was dry. It did not weigh my hair down or cause it to look/feel greasy. It did not make my hair look/feel crunchy either. After spraying/combing my hair,I used the blow dryer. My natural waves tend to frizz out while using a blow dryer. That did not happen after I used this spray, though I did use it on the low setting. My hair was nice and soft and wavy when it dried. The spray has a light, refreshing scent though it was pretty much gone by the time my hair had dried. Alterna mist provides volume while protecting hair from heat (up to 450 degrees) and humidity for up to 72 hours. Its extremely hot and unbearably humid here right now. My hair turns into a huge, frizzy cottonball in extreme heat/humidity. Alterna really did a great job of keeping it nice and calm, though I didn't get 72 hours worth of protection. It kept my hair nice and calm for about 48 hours before it started to become frizzy. That's still impressive, seeing as the heat and humidity here is extreme right now. I had no issues styling my hair after using this. Alterna mist works very, very well. I'm pleased with the results. Because I do not normally blow dry my hair, after testing this out I did give the bottle to my mother who does blow dry her hair. She too, did not get a full 72 hours worth of protection (day and a half, according to her...and she lives near me and experienced the same heat/humidity I did) but she is still pleased with the Alterna and continues to use it. We're both impressed with the results and recommend Alterna spray to those who blow dry hair.

title: Takes Great Care of Hair-No Thickening Results Just Yet...
text: I've not used this long enough to notice a difference to the area of my hair near my scalp that has been thinning due to aging.  Per Amalia, their Good Lab Blooming conditioner must be used 2-3 months to notice results. While its too soon for me to notice thickening results,  I will say this is a very nice conditioner.  It smells nice and does a fantastic job of hydrating and softening my hair.  Its lightweight and is easy to both apply to my hair and rinse out as well.  It does not leave my hair looking or feeling greasy/oily.  My hair has a nice bounce and shine to it after use. Good Lab Blooming is packed with impressive ingredients including: watermelon, biotin (a nice, thickening ingredient), gotu kola, ginseng, argan oil, grapeseed, pumpkin  and jojoba. Its  both paraben and sulfate free, not tested on animals and PETA certified. I will continue to use this and update my review as necessary to report on the hair thickening results.

title: Another Nature Nut Product to LOVE!
text: I've been using Nature Nut Leave in Conditioner for some time now and I absolutely LOVE it.  It does an amazing job of strengthening, softening and hydrating my hair.  So it came as little surprise to discover that I love Nature Nut moisturizing face cream just as much as the leave in conditioner. This cream is packed with SO many important ingredients that work together to soften, hydrate and best of all...PREVENT fine lines and wrinkles! Jojoba oil, chia seed, avocado oil, one of my faves hyaluronic acid, Vitamin E and Omegas work their magic on skin and do an amazing job in the process. This cream is, well, creamy! Its nice and creamy and absorbs into skin quickly without feeling or looking greasy or oily. The hydration and softening results are immediate. I've not yet used it long enough to see a prevention of fine lines and wrinkles but I'm going to continue to use it daily and will update this review when applicable. Nature Nut cream contains no parabens, perfurmes, dyes. Its vegan and cruelty free.  I cannot detect a scent with this cream. My husband says it has a slight scent but I don't smell it. (I have a nasal cyst that sometimes affects my sense of smell) I have extremely sensitive, dry skin and have NO negative reactions from Nature Nut cream. I am such a fan of this brand -it delivers results!  Next up: I'll be trying Nature Nut hair conditioner for dry/damaged hair and I"m SO looking forward to it.

title: Whipped is Wonderful!
text: There is one thing and one thing only that I do not like when it comes to Dr. Denese Essential Lipid Whipped Cream. And that one thing is that I never heard of this brand until now! I missed SO much time not using this product because I'd never heard of it before.  Thank goodness I finally have. This cream is fabulous. I love it, especially because its whipped. Its light and airy and  just feels GOOD as soon as it touches my skin. It absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy/oily look OR feel to the skin.  It softens instantly. There's a noticeable skin softness with the first use and I just love that. It also does a sensational job of moisturizing and hydrating skin and my very sensitive, dry skin REALLY needs all the hydration I can give it. I love that in addition to the vitamins, peptides, hyaluronic acid, this cream also contains natural plant lipids. There is no scent to this cream so I don't  have to worry about added perfumes negatively affecting my sensitive skin. Its recommended this cream be used at nighttime or in the morning. I use it before bed. It can be used under makeup as well, but I haven't tried that since I use very little makeup. You can't beat the size of this jar either. This is a HUGE jar of cream, bigger than any other I use! I just love what Dr. Denese's cream does for my skin and I HIGHLY recommend it!

title: Excellent Mask I'll Use Weekly
text:
"The damage may be done , but it doesn't have to be permanent".

That's the promise made by Advanced Clinicals and it really caught my eye when I was reading the product information above. I'm already a fan of Advanced Clinicals' lotions and have been for quite some time, so I didn't hesitate to give AC's Tea Tree Oil hair mask a try. After washing, I scooped out some tea tree oil mask and coated my hair in it from root to tip. I let it sit for a good 10 minutes. I'm a bit confused as to why 'warmth' is a rate feature here--- I don't feel warmth when using this. Quite the opposite. While not nearly as powerful, I felt the same coolness on my head/hair that comes with eating a menthol cough drop or using Vicks vaporub. Its mild, yet nice. The mask rinsed out with issue. As always, i let my hair air dry. My natural waves were nice and smooth, my hair incredibly soft and shiny. My hair felt nice and light. It did not look or feel weighed down. It was tangle-free as well. There's a scent to this mask-its not my favorite but its not horrible and it doesn't last long. I'm going to continue using this tea tree oil mask on a weekly basis. I like how it feels on my hair as well as the results that I get from using it on my hair. I definitely recommend this. Advanced Clinicals offers a money back guarantee if you find you don't care for it.

title: I Might Have to Steal This From Hubby,..
text: I'm nothing but impressed with hemp products.  Conditioners, creams, toothpaste, etc.  I love the results from using these hemp infused products. M's Skin Care Hemp Therapy Lip Balm for Men is another awesome hemp product as well.  This balm has a combo of hemp seed oil, shea and a hint of peppermint. These ingredients combined make for a lip balm that moisturizes, soothes, hydrates and heals dry, chapped lips. And it begins to do so in the moment its applied to the lips. Lips are soothed  immediately. The burning/itching that comes with dry, chapped lips stops immediately bringing relief. This balm is going to take  care of my husband's lips all throughout the winter. And that means he no longer has to steal my chapsticks! lol.  I actually tested this in order to write review and liked it so much, I might have to turn the tables on him and steal his chapstick this time around! lol This is an exceptional lip balm that will take wonderful care of your dry, chapped lips. It will bring you instant relief as soon as its applied.

title: Too Heavy/Greasy For Me.....
text: Phenic oil cream moisturizer just isn't my cup of tea. I realize the title of the cream includes the word 'oil' but when i ordered it, I assumed the oil cream would absorb into the skin and not leave any kind of oily/greasy residue. That didn't happen. I applied the cream before bed as suggested.  It has a  thick , oily/greasy consistency. It does spread well on skin and I didn't have to use much to cover my face.  I applied it about an hour before i went to bed-by the time I did go to bed, it hadn't absorbed/dried.  It felt heavy sitting on my skin and greasy. The next morning, things hadn't improved much. My skin still not only felt greasy, it looked greasy as well. Not as much as the previous night but still noticeable. I gave it another try the next night and even used a bit less cream than I had the  night before. Same result. Both times I wound up cleaning it off of my face soon after I woke up.  I did  notice my skin was VERY soft after I wiped the cream off which was nice.  I have terribly sensitive skin. The second time i used the cream I did develop a small red rash on my cheek, however I that's normal for me at times so I'm  not sure if it was cream related, or just something that happens every once in a while.  While I did notice a softness to my face after cleaning the cream off, that's just not enough of a reason for me to continue to use this cream.  I can't stand the greasy feeling and the heaviness of the cream sitting on my skin and not going away. I ended up giving my mom the cream.

title: Removes Even the Toughest Polish Easily! This is the ONLY Remover For Me!
text: I'm a nail polish junkie. With 1200+ bottles, as you can imagine, I have all brands, colors, textures, ingredients, etc.  I paint my nails daily.  For years, I've been using 100% acetone polish remover.  It does an excellent job on all of my polishes except for one type. There's a blue shade of nail polish that is my all time favorite.  Its a watercolors , non-toxic, water-based Earth friendly polish. Its free from most harmful polish ingredients, paraben free, safe for adults and kids, etc.  The only downfall is its hard as heck to remove.  The brand recommends using vodka (yes, vodka!) to remove it. I've tried EVERYTHING. Acetone does remove it but it takes a heck of a lot to finally remove it.  I tried the vodka route as well - it didn't do very much.  Because I' have such a hard time removing this particular polish, I don't use it very often. (I do have other shades in addition to my fave blue) I did paint my nails with this particular polish when the Morgan Taylor Strip Ease Lacquer Remover arrived for me to try and review. I figured I might as well put the remover to the ultimate test right off the bat to see how this remover works.  MT Strip Ease remover comes in an 8oz bottle.  There is a bit of a nail polish remover scent to it but its FAR less harsh than regular removers.  When I use my regular remover, my husband complains that he can smell it all the way at the other end of our  home. Our home isn't huge but I thought he was being overly dramatic about the scent. And then the furnace repair guy came to our house one night when the heat went out and as soon as he walked in, he commented about the scent of my remover. I was at the opposite end of the house,  having just removed polish. THAT'S when I knew my husband hadn't been exaggerating over the smell.  When I used MT remover, not only did my husband NOT smell it at the other end of the house, he didn't smell it when he entered the room I was using it in! That's how mild the scent of this remover is. Impressive. Even more impressive? IT REMOVED THE POLISH THAT THE OTHER REMOVERS COULDN'T EASILY REMOVE! ( Yes, I'm yelling but its a happy yelling! lol) MT removed the polish right away and I didn't need to use extra remover for that to happen. I was floored! I was stunned. I hadn't been expecting that at all ...what a fabulous surprise.!  In addition, this remover doesn't irritate my skin as the acetone  sometimes does.  The acetone I use costs just under $3. for a 16 oz bottle. While the MT bottle is half the size of  the acetone and costs more, it doesn't matter. I could care less. THIS is the nail polish remover i will use from now on.  There is no reason for me to buy/use any other brand or type. (For the record, I did try MT on other polishes as well...shimmers, glitters, mattes, shiny, etc and it removed all polishes fast and easy as well. ) Absolutely recommended! (*My apologies...my cell camera is horrific so the photo I'm posting isn't great quality-but you can see, MT remover did a fabulous job of removing my hard to remove nail polish)

title: Could This Be the Fountain of Youth?
text: I love salmon and eat it faithfully 3-5 times per week for lunch. I've always known salmon has a number of impressive health benefits but I had NO clue that salmon egg extract helps cell regeneration as well as skin pigmentation and improves skin elasticity. When I read Duft & Doft VGENE hydro cream contains salmon egg extract, I decided to check it out. Turns out, the salmon egg extract is only one of MANY wonderful ingredients found in this cream. In addition to the egg extract, the  VGENE also contains:  collagen/peptides, hyaluronic acid (as I age, this is quickly becoming one of my 'must have' ingredients!), aloe (you can't go wrong with aloe..SO many benefits!), pearl powder (another ingredient I had no clue about-its packed with amino acids which help skin elasticity and also brighten skin, causing dark spots to fade), mussel extract (vitamins A & C +iodine prevent aging) and fermented green tea water (  causes the skin to absorb the cream  instantly and with NO irritation).  VGENE is like the fountain of youth! Since using it, my skin is unbelievably soft and so very well hydrated. Its incredibly hot and humid here, so for this cream to provide all day hydration is beyond impressive! I'm just starting to notice that my wrinkles aren't quite as noticeable as they had been.  My fine lines and wrinkles are becoming thinner and smaller slowly but surely.  I do not have any dark spots on my face (and I hope I  never do...wishful thinking! lol) so I cannot comment as to how well VGENE lightens dark spots.  The fermented green tea water really DOES cause the cream to absorb into skin quickly and leaves NO oily/greasy feeling behind. the cream is on the light side and easy to apply: a little goes a long way.  I have extremely sensitive skin and have absolutely no negative reactions from VGENE.  VGENE has next to no scent. I can only slightly detect it if I hold the jar right under my nose and sniff.  This cream is paraben /cruelty free and dermatologist tested as well.  For those interested in the packaging, VGENE comes in a VERY nice, very pretty jar that is incredible durable with very little writing on it. (you won't be able to see how nice the jar is in my photos-they're not so great as my cell camera is horrible...my apologies) I'm happy to tell you that I will continue to enjoy salmon  for lunch multiple times weekly AND enjoy salmon egg extract on my face on a daily basis as I ABSOLUTELY plan on continuing to use Duft & Doft's salmon  VGENE cream .

title: A Noticeable Improvement After Only ONE Use!
text: My hair has taken a beating recently. Due to extreme stress, I had some bouts of hair loss. (seems to be OK now..knock wood!) Thanks to aging, the hair on my scalp area has thinned over the past couple of years.  Now that its summertime, I spend  a good deal of time outdoors and in the pool swimming which, of course, dries my hair out terribly.  I also color my roots every couple of weeks as well.  Issues aside, I otherwise have shoulder length, thick blond hair. I've always enjoyed trying new hair care products but now, its more important than ever I try and use products that will help heal and strengthen my hair.  When I came across SO Jamaican Black Castor Oil on my Vine list, I looked into it a bit . As soon as I saw that it can be used on all hair types (even colored hair!), helps thinning hair and is especially geared towards hair needing extreme hydration I didn't hesitate and placed my order.  I'm very happy to say, this conditioner is WONDERFUL!  It has a fabulous, light scent to it. I can't place what exactly the scent is but it smells clean and fresh to me. The conditioner is a great consistency and spreads nice and evenly over hair. Directions say to use an amount the size of a quarter-more if hair is long. In light of my hair issues and hair length, I did use more than a quarter size amount the first time I used it. I kept in on my hair for 10 minutes before rinsing. (I happened to have a fairly large tangle in my hair caused by my ponytail holder while swimming. I didn't even need to comb it out, SO Jamaican removed it on its own. ) The conditioner rinsed out of my hair beautifully and did not leave a weighed down/oily/greasy feeling on my hair.  In fact, my hair actually felt lighter once it dried.  (air-dried) My hair had a nice , silky shine to it.  My natural waves looked nice and healthy and had NO fly-aways.  It was quite obvious SO had done an excellent job conditioning and hydrating my hair because it no longer looked like hay as it sometimes does when its extremely dried out. My hair just felt so darn good after using this conditioner.  Clean, healthy, light, smooth and refreshed. Since I just started to use this conditioner, I've not used it  long enough to see  a difference on my scalp where my hair is thinning. But there is NO doubt about it, my hair is visibly healthier after only ONE use of SO Jamaican. The Amazon page for SO Jamaican has it listed as 'currently unavailable'.  Fingers crossed that it becomes available and SOON because this conditioner is a keeper!  (also hoping it becomes a 'subscribe and save' item as well. ) I'm so pleased with SO Jamaican and I DEFINITELY  recommend it!

title: SO Many Reasons to LOVE This Cream!
text: There's a small stand near my home where we go for spring water...5 gallons for $1.00.  You can't beat the price. Even better? The water comes directly from a nearby mountain.  Doesn't get much fresher than that. I'd never heard of ALIVE: LAB products before.  When I came across their  Multi Ice Cream moisturizing cream and saw that the first ingredient is glacier water (from Canada), it  reminded me of our fresh, clean spring water. I ordered a jar immediately.  The cream is thick (a pudding -like consistency),  yet light. Its a clear colored cream and its actually cool to the touch-very refreshing!  It doesn't take much cream to cover my entire face.  I simply dab a small amount on my face and then massage it into my skin. I'm really weird about lotions and creams sitting on my skin. I can't stand how it feels just sitting there. This cream does not dry /absorb instantly.  But it doesn't take much time before it does and it does not leave behind a heavy/greasy/oily feeling to my skin.  Once it absorbs, my skin is left feeling cool , refreshed and (as silly as it may sound), good. My skin literally feels GOOD after I use this creme .  I do  have dry, extremely sensitive skin.  I often have red patches of skin  on not only my face, but my arms as well.  While this creme is for all skin types, it especially helps those of us with dry, sensitive, red skin.  It soothes  as soon as it comes in contact with inflamed skin and gets rid of the red patches, leaving behind soft, moisturized, hydrated skin.  (yes, I use it on the red patches of skin on my arms as well as my face) The cream claims to also soothe acne. I don't have acne so I cannot comment as to how it works in that regard. I love the moisturizing and softening benefit that  comes with using Multi Ice Cream but also the cool, refreshing and soothing benefits as well.  I also love that glacier water is the first ingredient! I've already added this cream to my Amazon shopping list and absolutely WILL continue to use it! This cream is wonderful and I especially recommend it for those with dry, sensitive skin.

title: Works  as Well as Acetone...Also Contains Aloe!
text: I'm a nail polish junkie (with 1200+ bottles to prove it! lol) and I frequently change my nail polish. Actually, I do so on a daily basis. I have all kinds of polishes: matte, shimmer, glitter, shiny, water-based, etc. As you can imagine, I use A LOT of nail polish remover. For years I've been using 100% pure acetone remover. It works very well on polishes with the exception of  the water based polishes.  I must use A LOT of remover to get that type of polish cleaned off of my nails. The website I purchased the polishes from suggests using vodka to remove polish. (I tried it with next to no luck) . Some of my glitter polishes take a little bit more remover than usual to get the polish completely cleaned off-not really a big deal. I was curious to see how well Red Carpet remover worked against my various polishes. RC works pretty much the same as the straight acetone  I use. Mattes, shimmers, shiny remove  nice and easy. Glitter takes a bit more remover to get off but otherwise comes off fine.  Water -based, as usual, isn't cooperative and takes a lot of RC remover to clean off. There IS one difference between my normal remover and RC remover. RC also contains aloe.  We all know how beneficial aloe is.  I'm very satisfied with RC remover. It works very well and has the added bonus of aloe.

title: There IS a Noticeable Improvement After Only One Use!
text: Royal Formula isn't exaggerating with the claim that hair will be noticeably healthier after using their coconut oil mask for the first time!  Between spending time outside in the sun and swimming this summer, along with some thinning around my scalp (due to aging), my hair isn't at its healthiest.  It gets dried out and damaged quickly. When I tried Royal Formula coconut oil mask for the first time, I opened the lid of the jar and sniffed.  I didn't really detect much of a scent at all. However, after washing my hair and applying the coconut mask, I was then able to smell it and I just LOVE the scent.  Its not gagging or overpowering. Its a wonderful coconut scent. The mask was easy to apply to my hair and evenly distribute.  My hair is almost shoulder length and thick-I used an amount of conditioner the size of a little larger than a half dollar coin. I let the mask sit on my hair for 10 minutes, then rinsed it out. I had no issues-it rinsed out easily. It did not weigh my hair down nor did it leave my hair looking for feeling oily/greasy. I always use  a very light leave in conditioner spray after washing my hair. I didn't bother to use it after using the Royal Formula.  My hair combed out  beautifully and tangle-free.  My natural wavy hair was nice and soft once it dried. It was also smooth with no fly-aways and boy did it ever shine! It also smelled faintly of coconut.  My hair felt good, fresh and clean. All of these benefits...after only ONE use! (Royal Formula claims to promote new hair follicle growth. Because I've only used it one time, I cannot confirm/dispute this claim at this time) I fully intend on using Royal Formula weekly. My hair NEEDS this mask.

title: Refreshing
text: I love using this after my bath each night.  I feel like I'm pampering myself...heck, I AM pampering myself when I use Zents Cashmere body oil!  This is wonderfully light body oil that literally softens as soon it touches skin.  Its also lightly scented-a nice combo of vanilla, sandalwood, amber, blood orange and grapefruit.  Both coconut oil and Vitamin E are in Zents cashmere.  Coconut oil does a wonderful job of moisturizing skin while Vitamin E protects skin from sun damage and helps to reduce wrinkles.  This oil does NOT contain: parabens, sulfates, phthalates, glycol, dyes or palm oil.  We all live busy lives.  We deserve to pamper ourselves every once in a while and Zents cashmere lotion is one way to do so!

title: A Wonderful Serum for All!
text: My fine line and wrinkles have not magically vanished since I began using Claireity Hyaluronic Acid  Serum. But thanks to a combination of Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamins A & C which cause skin to plump up  by stimulating skin's natural collagen production, my fine lines and wrinkles are less prominent.  That's REALLY nice to see, especially since it seems as though every time I look in the mirror new wrinkles/fine lines have popped up on my face. lol.  The serum also does a great job of moisturizing and hydrating my dry skin. The serum dries quickly and does not leave a greasy/oily feeling behind. My extremely sensitive skin has no negative reactions to the serum as well.  The serum does not contain alcohol, dye or parabens.  This bottle only contains 1oz of serum but don't worry-you will only use a very small amount each time its applied to skin. A little goes a VERY long way! This serum is not geared towards anyone in particular...its safe for both men and women no matter the age and can be used on all skin types as well.

title: A Wonderful, Light Curl Cream w/NO Frizzies!
text: Ah, the joys of summer. I love summertime but my hair doesn't always share my sentiment. My naturally wavy hair can turn into a huge, frizzy mess in the heat and humidity.  Because I spend a good deal of time outdoors, any hair product I use to help combat and prevent the frizzies  has to be lightweight so my hair doesn't stick to my head when I sweat.  To top it all off, I recently experienced some hair loss due to extreme bouts of stress.  I've been OK for a few months now (knock wood!) but I'm still VERY careful about what I put on my  hair as I work to get it restored and healthy again.  Saints & Sinners Medusa Divine curl activator cream for curly, wavy hair promises to add moisture and shine to hair and protect hair color  while eliminating frizz. I'd never heard of Saints & Sinners before (I DO love the name!) but after reading the ingredients in the curl cream, including:  shea butter, coconut oil, jojoba oil, olive oil as well as the ingredients NOT in the curl cream (glutens, parabens, sulfates, synthetic colors, to name a few) I decided to try it.  This is a leave-in cream to be applied after washing hair while hair is still damp.  The bottle says to 'use sparingly'.  My hair is thick (except around my scalp where its thinning thanks to aging) and just above my shoulders.  I use about a nickel size amount of cream  and its enough to cover all of my hair.  Medusa Divine does not weigh my hair down when  its wet or when dry. It does not cause my hair to look or feel oily /greasy .  As  promised, it does not make my hair 'crunchy' or hard.  After applying Medusa Divine to my just washed, damp hair I always let my hair air dry.  When its dry, my natural waves are present without fly-aways and my hair is smooth, soft and shiny.  My hair does not get frizzy nor does it get weighed down/plastered to my head when I'm outside in heat and humidity, except when exercising.  Medussa Divine has a very light, pleasant scent to it though I am no longer able to smell it soon after I apply it to my hair. Saints & Sinners works on all hair types.  Its also clinically certified as being 'non-irritating'. I have extremely sensitive skin and have absolutely no negative issues with Medusa Divine. title: Magical!
text: I cannot even begin to tell you how much I LOVE LOVE LOVE TerraBella's Hemp&Argan conditioner.  When I tell you that my mouth dropped when I saw my reflection in the mirror after using this for the FIRST time, I'm not kidding. I'm not even exaggerating a little bit.  A few days ago, I was on Amazon looking for a hemp conditioner  a friend had recommended.  I do currently use various hemp products including shampoo/conditioners, but I was looking for a specific brand and couldn't find it. But I came across TerraBella hemp conditioner and though I'd never heard of this brand before, I figured for $6.95 a bottle, it wouldn't be the end of the world if I tried it and didn't like it.  When it was delivered today, I immediately opened the bottle and took a sniff, curious about the scent. (I'm really weird like that...I'm the person you see at the store taking lids of fabric softeners, conditioners, etc to smell prior to purchasing to make sure i like the scent. ) I wasn't the least bit impressed with the scent of this conditioner. I flat out HATE it. (more later) But that didn't deter me from trying it. Tonight, when I washed my hair I used TerraBella. I have thick (though thinning on the scalp due to aging), shoulder length hair.  I used roughly the size of a half dollar amount of conditioner on my hair and it was sufficient to cover all of it.  I rinsed with lukewarm water after close to 10 minutes. The conditioner rinsed out beautifully with no issues. I had no tangles in my hair and was able to fun my fingers through it while wet.  As always, I let my hair air dry.  When I got up and walked past a mirror and caught a glimpse of my hair (now dry), I was floored.  My hair looked as though I had just stepped out of a hair salon. I know this sounds vain but it was absolute perfection.  My natural waves were perfect and in place with NO frizz or flyaways. My hair had shine to it.  It was visibly soft. What floored me the most were the ends of my hair. Absolutely incredible.  They had a curl to them that I've never seen before in my hair.  They were visibly healthy with NO signs of split ends.  My hair-all of it-looked as healthy as it was back when I was a kid-before I started to use curling irons, hair dryers, hair dye, hair sprays, etc. Even my husband noticed my hair-he had known I was trying this conditioner for the first time but I didn't ask what he thought-he commented on his own and it was genuine.  He was impressed.  I swear, this conditioner is magic in a bottle. This conditioner contains SO many fabulous ingredients:  hemp oil (50%), argan oil, coconut oil, shea butter and kukui oil, all responsible for nourishing hair , adding shine and smoothness and outright delivering healthy hair.  (The kukui oil is new to me so I Googled it-a natural oil  from Hawaii pressed from the kukui tree that is a symbol of rejuvenation! ) This conditioner contains no parabens, and is SLS free.  Its safe for damaged and dry hair as well.  As for the scent...I hate it. Seeing as I can no longer smell it after my hair is dry, I will not deduct any stars from my review regarding the scent.  It doesn't linger, it vanishes quickly. For all this conditioner does, the price is ridiculously low.  Right before I sat down to write this review, I ordered another bottle.  I hope at some point TerraBella qualifies for the Amazon subscribe and save plan. I'll be the first to sign up.  I highly recommend this product.  If you try it and don't like it, TerraBella offers a full refund within 30 days of the purchase.

title: Gentle Formula Excellent For All Skin Types!

title: Fantastic Scent-Clean and Refreshing
text:
I normally bathe using a loofah and body wash. When I tried Island Essence's Tahitian Gardenia loofah soap+body butter, it marked the first time I ever tried a loofah soap. It took a bit getting used to but it was worth it.

I'm officially a fan of loofah soap! I love how it smells and how it feels while bathing and after. Applying the body butter after bathing is the icing on the cake. Feels like I just spent time at a spa. I especially love that Island Essence makes both with 100% all natural, organic ingredients! Once I use all of the Tahitian Gardenia loofah soap+body butter, I'm going to order Island Essence Ocean Passion scent next. Pamper yourself with Island Essence loofah soap and body butter. You deserve it!

title: Arlena Keratis Mask is Healing My Hair and Making It Healthy Again!
text:
I experienced one moment of disappointment after using Arlena Keratin hair mask for the first time. Keep reading and I'll explain.

One day last week, after spending some time swimming, I went home to take a bath and wash my hair. My hair is blond, shoulder length and very thick with natural wave. (I've been experiencing some thinning around my scalp due to aging. I do not use hair dryers or curling irons on my hair at this time. I do use conditioning sprays/leave in conditioners as well as spray products (salt water sprays) to enhance my naturally wavy hair. ) After washing my hair and towel drying per the directions, I scooped some Arlena keratin mask from the container and worked it into my hair. I then rinsed the mask out of my hair using lukewarm water. It rinsed out without any issues. The mask did not leave my hair looking or feeling greasy, heavy or weighed down. When it was dry, I got up to look at it in the mirror and this is where I had my one and only moment of disappointment. My hair looked (and I don't mean to sound vain here) AWESOME! I was floored! My waves were there as always but they were so smooth and relaxed. My hair looked as though I had spent a good deal of time fixing it. There was such a shine, softness and bounce to it that I' haven't seen (without the aid of hair care products) in such a long time! It was as though I had my childhood hair back-before I grew up and subjected it to curling irons, perms, hair dryers, curling irons, sprays, etc and damaged it. It looked so darn good, I was disappointed because it was nighttime and I had nowhere to go with my hair looking as good as it did! lol. i was simply stunned with the result after using Arlena ONE TIME. I now use it twice a week and i just love it. I love the results and i love how good my hair looks and feels after using the Arlena mask. I absolutely WILL continue to use Arlena on my hair.

title: Bye Bye To My Former Hairspray...I"m an Airspray Fan Now!
text:
I use Pantene conditioner off and on and am very pleased with it. However, I'd never before tried Pantene hairspray, so I was anxious to see if it works as well as Pantene conditioner.

This is a 3 pack of Pantene hairspray/airspray. Each bottle is 7 ounces. The nozzle of the hairspray is easy to use, dispenses a good amount of spray and does not clog. I really do like the scent of this hairspray. Its light and not at all overwhelming or gagging. The hairspray itself...rather, the airspray itself is free of alcohol as well as ethanol. Its very light...it doesn't weigh hair down at all. The bottle says it resists humidity. Since its not humid right now as its winter, I cannot confirm that this is true but I have no reason to not believe it. Pantene airspray does a surprisingly excellent job of keeping my hair styled the way I want it without alcohol and without weighing it down. Quite honestly, it really doesn't feel as though I'm using any hairspray on my hair because its so lightweight, I don't feel it.

I almost feel guilty. I was so devoted to my regular brand of hairspray that I've been using for years and years. And i still do love it. But I'm making the switch to Pantene. Its far better for my hair than my regular brand and works a bit better. Due to my age, I've been dealing with thinning hair so i really need to make sure I do everything I possibly can to keep my hair as healthy as possible. Removing the alcohol from hairspray was the game changer for me. Thanks to Pantene, my hair is alcohol/ethanol free and yet my hair STILL stays in place where it belongs without being weighed down! Fabulous product, HIGHLY recommended!

title: Revives And Awakens Your Skin With a Nice, Cool Burst !  Smooths and Softens While U Sleep!
text:
Bioaqua Face Freeze Mask does indeed feel nice when applied to the skin. When I applied it for the first time last night before bed, it gave my skin a nice burst of crisp coolness, very menthol -like. Skin feels like its waking up and revived when Bioaqua first touches it! I like not only the feel of Bioaqua when it first touches my skin but the texture of it as well. Though a jelly, its on the thin side so it dries quickly (HUGE plus for me!) and does not at all feel greasy or oily when applied or after it dries. I like products that contain hyaluronic acid and Bioaqua is no exception. The plant extracts in Bioaqua moisturize, hydrate and replenish your skin while you sleep and in the morning when you awaken , your skin is nice and soft and very smooth. I normally have dry, extremely sensitive skin but now that its winter and the heat is on in the house 24/7, my skin gets drier and itchier than normal so its extremely important that i use a product that can keep up with my skin especially during the rough winter months. I do like what Bioaqua does for my skin. I will continue to use it a few times a week before bed but not on a daily basis as I do have some other creams and lotions I like to use overnight as well. This product is definitely worth the price! (I actually expected it to cost far more ...I was very pleasantly surprised at the price when I saw it!)

I really cannot detect a much of a scent with Bioaqua so I cannot comment on how I think it smells. ( I do have a nasal cyst that sometimes affects my sense of smell, perhaps that is why I don't really smell anything. )

If you're someone who cares about product packaging, the container Bioaqua comes in is REALLY nice! Its a thick glass container with a nice metal lid that screws on/off easily. I wound up having to do some online research to try to get basic instructions as how to use this properly. For this reason, I did deduct a star from my rating. title: Herbal Essences Never Disappoints!
text:
I'm a HUGE fan of Herbal Essences conditioners, especially in the biorenew collection! I especially love the arabica and white charcoal conditioners. Now, I'm a fan of Herbal Essences biorenew coconut milk conditioner! Not only do I love the scent, I love that I can smell it in my hair the day after I wash my hair! But the scent isn't the only great thing about this conditioner. This conditioner is made with real botanicals as well as purified water. What it does NOT contain is paraben or colorant. I've been an Herbal Essences fan for quite some time and continue to be, especially when they come out with wonderful hair products such as this. title: Good Cream, Slight Irritation At Times
text:
ORO24KARAT day cream is a good cream that works well. I apply it first thing in the morning when I wake up. The cream itself is light and a bit 'fluffy'. Its easy to apply to apply ( it spreads well) and doesn't take a lot of cream to cover the face. A little goes a long way. Its not that it dries quickly...it absorbs into the skin quickly and actually feels refreshing as it does. It also leaves skin feeling nice and soft and smooth. Its packed with anti-aging products like Hyaluronic acid, collagen and (I didn't know this was an anti-aging product!), 24k gold! Rounding out the positives about this product is that fact that its paraben free, contains no harmful fragrances , is not tested on animals and is made here in the U.S.A.!

As mentioned, I use this cream first thing every morning. Well, almost every morning. I have extremely sensitive skin, especially during winter months. A few mornings when I applied ORO24KARAT to my face, my skin burned a bit. It wasn't a severe burning feeling by any means and it did not last more than a few seconds. The slight burning feeling did not return at any point throughout the day. It happened on mornings when my cheeks were reddish due to being dry/chapped from cold weather. I've now stopped using ORO24KARAT on days when my cheeks are visibly dry/chapped. Otherwise, I do use it first thing in the morning without issue. Its a good cream that I very much like and really does a nice job making my skin look and feel good.

title: Miracle In a Jar!
text:
Time for me to 'eat crow', as the saying goes. You see, I didn't believe for one second that Skinmed Cutem daily cream moisturizer could possibly relieve dry skin for 144 hours. 144 is 6 days....6 DAYS! I thought it impossible that Cutem could possibly work that long. Silly me!

I applied Cutem to my face at night before bed. ( When I first began to apply it, I noticed the texture was thick and at first, greasy. I hate the feeling of greasy lotion touching my skin. When the Cutem touched my chapped and dry cheeks, that sunburn feeling was instantly soothed and gone. Even before I fell asleep, I could already feel my cheeks calming down and softening. In the morning, they felt wonderful. As if they'd never ever been subject to harsh weather conditions, dry skin, eczema, etc! I always use a moisturizer in the morning. I didn't need to the morning after trying Cutem for the first time. THAT is how soft and healed my skin looked and felt. My skin continued to feel great all day. It did not burn or itch and the reddish, chapped cheeks I'd had only the night before were under control and looking and feeling normal. After I bathed that night, I rubbed a bit of Cutem on some patches on my arms and legs that were particularly chapped and dry. (Just like my cheeks had been...the patches were red and looked/felt like a sunburn. They itched as well) The Cutem dried in a matter of a minute or two and the greasy feeling was gone. So was the burning and itchy feeling my arms and legs had been experiencing. Gone. Just like that. I did this 3 nights ago. I haven't had to put any more Cutem on my arms and legs since that ONE time because they are no longer red and burning or itchy. They're back to normal. That is HUGE for me as I'm a life long sensitive skin person. To get such relief, so quickly and so long lasting is beyond amazing! My husband is now using Cutem as well for his sensitive skin with the same results as me. It works. I've tried MANY different creams and lotions, including prescriptions without having results like Cutem. This is wonderful and provides IMMEDIATE relief to painful skin and it continues to work as promised. Cutem is now a part of my daily skin regimen and will continue to be, even when the weather isn't cold. This is unbelievable and worth every single penny!

title: My Hair Looks AND Feels Like It Did When I Was A Kid!
text:
I must tell you, I was a bit hesitant to try Marc Daniels Professional Clear Henna Wax on my hair for a few reasons. The word 'wax' in the title of the product made me nervous. I immediately had visions of my hair feeling and looking like it was coated in Crisco shortening! lol. The title of the product also includes the word 'clear', so I assumed the conditioner would be clear. Turns out, its brown. That was a bit of a concern as well for a minute or two but I stopped worrying and got to work testing Henna Wax Conditioner!

This conditioner can be used on any hair type and especially works well on chemically treated and coarse hair. The product also claims to be safe for colored treated hair and promises to not interfere with the coloring process or change hair color. (As a blonde who does indeed use hair dye, I can absolutely confirm that my hair/hair color was NOT negatively affected in ANY way after using this product.) I love the scent of this conditioner. Its not over-powering at all. This will sound odd, but when I smelled this conditioner for the first time, the first word that popped into my head was CLEAN! It has a such a wonderful, light and clean scent and I absolutely LOVE it. After washing my hair, I applied the Henna conditioner and let it sit on my hair for a good 10 minutes. I applied enough to coat all of my hair. (You can wrap your hair in plastic for a more intense conditioning...I did not do this so I cannot comment as to how it works/what difference in makes) As I rinsed the conditioner out of my hair, I could already feel how soft it had become. I was able to run my fingers through my wet hair and feel that it was tangle free! I let my hair air dry as usual. I normally spray my hair lightly after washing it with a lightweight leave-in conditioner but this time, I didn't. I didn't want anything on my hair so I could accurately determine how Henna had worked on my hair. When my hair was dry, I was impressed with the end result! My hair was just SO soft and shiny. It felt so good, it reminded me of the feeling you get after a hair cut when your hair is fresh and light . My natural waves and curls were pretty close to perfect. I had no fly-aways at all. And my hair smelled wonderful!

Everything about this conditioner is pretty darn perfect! Its made of organic ingredients and vegan friendly. ALL hair types can use this product and its safe for color treated hair. It does exactly what it promises to do for hair. I have now incorporated this conditioner into my hair care routine and I"m beyond thrilled. Henna has made my hair look AND feel like it did when I was a kid...when my hair was still untouched by hair dye, curling iron, hair dryer, various hair products, etc. And that is pretty incredible, IMO!

I wish I could give Henna more than a 5 star rating. Its THAT good! If you're looking to repair your hair, make it healthy and breathe new life into it, THIS is the product you want to use.

title: Works Well But No Different From Other Leave-In Conditioners
text:
The directions on the bottle say to dispense 1-2 pumps of L'emarie Overnight Leave-In Serum into palms, rub hands together and apply to hair, beginning at the ends and working upwards. The serum is not to be washed out.

I wasn't sure if my hair was supposed to be wet, dry or towel-dried when applying the serum as this was not specified in the directions. I wash my hair at night so I decided to apply the serum when my hair was still slightly damp but nearly dry. The serum has a nice scent to it. Its not a strong scent and I didn't notice it much the following day. (My apologies...I cannot place what it smells like...its definitely not a flowery scent) I had been concerned that the serum would cause my hair to look greasy and/or have a 'waxy' feel to it as some conditioners tend to do. This was not the case with L'emarie overnight serum. My hair did not look greasy, nor did it feel 'waxy'. It wasn't weighed down. The serum did not negatively affect my naturally wavy hair in any way. My hair was definitely nice and soft the following morning. I had no issues styling it. (I did not use a curling iron or any hair care product other than a few sprays of hairspray) My hair didn't look shiny to me. It didn't look dull either, I just didn't notice any particular change with regards to shine. It looked like it always does. My hair didn't have any fly-aways which was nice!

I do like L'emarie and what it does for my hair. It works well and my hair looked and felt good after using L'emarie. But it didn't really do anything different than other leave in conditioners that I use /used in the past. Because it costs more than other leave in conditioners I use which pretty much deliver the same results, I have no plans to purchase L'emarie.

title: SO Disappointed!

title: I Feel Like I'm At a Spa When I Use Once Upon a Tea Mud Mask!

title: Eh...So-So

title: This Conditioner Does What It Promises To Do For Your Hair! Love It!
text:
I love to try new products, especially hair and skin products. (and food! lol) Deep Chamomile Hair Conditioner Treatment (for all hair types including color treated and damaged hair) by Mark Daniels Professional 'spoke' to me when I first read the details about it on its Amazon page. The information states that this conditioner moisturizes the scalp and hair, locks in colors, soothes the scalp and keeps your hair supple and soft all day long. The product claims to work well on color treated, damaged hair and is recommended for curly hair as well. I color my roots every couple of weeks. I'm also experiencing hair thinning (getting old stinks! lol) as well as some bouts of hair loss due to extreme stress. In an effort to restore my hair, I've stopped using a curling iron (used to use one daily) as well as a hair dryer which I used every couple of days. I'm eager to try any hair product that will take good care of my hair and hopefully help to strengthen and restore it. After reading the information on Mark Daniels' Deep Chamomile Hair Conditioner Treatment for all hair types, I was excited to give it a try to see what it could do to help my hair.

This was my first time ever using a Mark Daniels product. I'm not at all familiar with the brand. This conditioner comes in an 'e 500 g' size container. (I googled it...e 500 g=17.636981 ounces) . The label on the jar is rather plain. (I truly don't care about the label, but some people do so I thought I'd mention it) I'm the weirdo at the grocery store that you see standing in the hair conditioner and laundry detergent aisle, taking the caps off the products so I can sniff them to see what they smell like prior to purchasing. (Sadly, I"m not kidding! lol) When I smelled this conditioner for the first time, I did not much care for it. I found it to be too 'flowery'. But I got used to it and actually ended up finding the scent pleasant. I didn't really notice the scent at all in my hair after I used the conditioner, however. The consistency of the conditioner is nice and it spreads easily throughout hair. It doesn't take a lot to cover my hair. (Hair is shoulder length and thick except for the top where its thinning at my scalp) You can see the little specks of chamomile in the conditioner as well. (see photo) I put the conditioner on my hair and then sat back and enjoyed the warm bathtub water for about 10 minutes and then I rinsed the conditioner out of my hair. I had no issues rinsing it out. It all came out easily and left no 'waxy', oily or greasy feel to my hair. I air dried my hair and when it was dry, my natural curls/waves looked great and my hair was, without a doubt, supple and soft and shiny! I had no fly-aways. The thinning hair on my scalp wasn't as pronounced as it had been. It wasn't magically back to normal, but it definitely wasn't as noticeable to me which was wonderful to see and experience. Gave me a bit of a boost to my self esteem!

I like what this product did for my hair. I was thrilled to see results literally after the first use! It makes me happy to be able to say that this product does what it promises to do and my hair is proof of that! I never heard of Mark Daniels products before, but I' sure have now and I'm a fan! I will continue to use this conditioner and I will take a look at other Mark Daniels' products as well because now i"m hooked! Without a doubt, I absolutely recommend this conditioner!

title: Best Ponytail Holder Ever!
text: Once upon a time, an entire family used to have to share a telephone!  The telephone was either on a wall or on a table somewhere in the house.  It didn't have a camera attached to it and you couldn't take it with you wherever you went! lol. Sorry, I couldn't resist!  lol. In all seriousness, I vividly recall as a child entering the kitchen while my mom was on the phone talking to my grandmother or a friend of hers.  She could literally stand on the opposite end of the kitchen from where the phone was based, the cord long enough to stretch from one end of the kitchen to the other.  A basic phone cord stretched to 25 feet in length but was only a foot long when the phone was hung up.  The cord kept its shape even with all of the stretching.  And that is exactly how the spiral hair ties/no crease coil telephone cord hair ties work!  These telephone cord hair ties can be stretched accordingly due to thick or long hair but once removed from the hair, they revert back to their normal size and do not become stretched out/misshapen.  The plastic  and the coil material keep hair in place, preventing hair from popping out or coming loose from the ponytail.  (And that includes exercising...they hold up well and keep your hair in place if you're jogging/walking/exercising!)  These ponytail holders do not cause any kind of discomfort and are easy to use and easy to remove from your hair as well.  They do not cause any type of crease to the hair as some other types of ponytails holders do.  I have a large Tupperware container filled with various types of ponytail holders...elastic, scrunchies, grab&go, ouchless , spiral, no crimp, ties, etc and without a doubt, the telephone cord coil ties work the best in my hair!  I love them.  I've included photos...the first photo is a of an unused holder. The second shows me stretching it out. The third shows the holder revert back to its normal size after I stretched it. title: I Love My Hair After Using L'emarie!

title: Feels So Good AND Keeps Your Skin Healthy!

title: I Love Everything About This Lotion!
text:
I'm not a fan of citrus-y scents, so I wasn't entirely sure how I'd feel about Esscentials "In the Mood" lotion. Turns out, I had absolutely NOTHING to worry about! I can't really smell the orange in it (my husband and son DO say they smell orange in it...I have a nasal cyst that at times affects my sense of smell so its probably just me who can't smell the orange) , but I do smell the lemon, jasmine and musk and somehow, they all work BEAUTIFULLY together! (I seriously cannot believe I love this scent because I'm truly NOT a fan of citrus! lol) The lotion comes in a very pretty box. Instead, the bottle has a seal to prevent lotion from coming out during shipping that you must remove before placing the pump inside of the bottle. The pump dispenses a good amount of lotion which I will include a photo of. You're not going to get too much or too little lotion from that pump. If it doesn't dry quickly, I won't use it. This dries quickly! ) Once the lotion dries, the light , gorgeous scent of this lotion remains. The lotion is vegan and, get this, uses alcohol derived from sugar cane!!!!! The lotion is free of phthalates, sulfates, parabens, dyes, is cruelty free and made in the USA! i have extremely sensitive skin and have had absolutely NO issues with this lotion!

This lotion does cost more than I normally would spend, however, in light of the fact that I love everything about it...from the packaging, the bottle, the scent, the fact that it dries quickly, etc. I'm willing to pay more for it. Its worth it to me!

(Just an FYI...the bottle is plain white. There is no writing on it. My young daughter assumed it was hand soap since I had it on my bathroom counter. Just wanted to pass that tidbit along as an FYI to others...)

title: Calms An Itchy Scalp While Restoring Hair!
text:
My husband suffers from an itchy, dry scalp. He has bounced around from product to product looking for relief. And occasionally, he'll find a product that gives him some relief but its always a temporary fix. To make matters worse, his normally thick, dark, curly hair is thinning in areas on his head (some small bald spots as well) and its noticeable. On top of that, since its winter and the heat is on full blast in the house 24/7, his scalp itches more and is even drier than usual. I ordered him a bottle of Mountain Top Hair Thickening Scalp Serum. He has been using it for 3 weeks and is experiencing noticeable and pleasing results!

The info on the box of the serum states:

title: EXACTLY What I Was Looking For!
text: As a kid, I could wear headbands in my hair with no problem.  As an  adult, headbands just do not look right in my hair at all.  I look downright ridiculous. I've tried all kinds of headbands:  hard, soft, plastic, material, combs in the headband, no combs, etc.  None looked right or worked so I gave up.  About 4 months ago, I noticed my vision was beginning to change. I became unable to read a book, the words were too blurry. I chalked it up to fatigue but it didn't go away.  In the middle of the grocery store, I had to ask my husband to read the expiration date on a coupon (not the first time I had to ask him to read something to me since my vision had changed!)  because I couldn't see it. As we argued our way to the checkout line (He was nagging me to go to the eye doctor..I'm usually the one who does the nagging! lol) we passed the store's medicine aisle and right on the end of the aisle was a display of reading glasses.  I tried a bunch and found I could FINALLY see clearly with the strongest pair.  I paid $4.99 to the reading glasses and have been able to read books once again.  I began to do that thing where I'd put the glasses on top of my head when I wasn't reading rather than remove them entirely.  And I liked the way my hair looked with the glasses working as a headband! This was EXACTLY what I'd been looking for in a headband and it FINALLY looked right with my hair!!  But I couldn't walk around in public wearing glasses on top of my head, could I? Of course not.  For the heck of it, I googled 'is there a headband that looks like I have glasses on top of my head?'.  I didn't expect a response at all. To my surprise, Zazzy Bands popped up! I couldn't believe it! I thought for sure I was the only person who was looking for a headband that made my hair look like i had a pair of glasses sitting on my head! lol.  I immediately bought one.  And I LOVE LOVE LOVE it! Though its a bit square shaped, it felt fine on my head. It wasn't tight nor was it loose.  It didn't cause any pain at all and soon after I put it in my hair, I forgot it was there. I didn't even feel it! It held my hair back exactly the way glasses hold it back...EXACTLY what I'd been looking for in a headband for such a long time! I LOVE this headband and now that I know it works and looks great, I will be ordering more headbands in different colors!  THANK YOU for making a headband that does what I want to it and makes my hair look GOOD!

title: Works VERY Well On My Sensitive Skin~ Smells Good Too!
text:
I am very fair skinned and have extremely sensitive skin. I have a list of sprays, perfumes, detergents, fabric softeners, soaps, etc that I cannot use due to reactions. I cannot use any Bath and Body Works product containing coconut. It literally makes my skin feel like its on fire...it burns that bad. I was a bit concerned about trying BeauKON Hyaluronic Acid Daily Facial Moisturizer because it contains coconut so I started out by applying a tiny amount to my skin to see if it would burn/itch/hurt, etc. After not having any type of negative reaction with the 'test' I had done, I felt confident enough to apply it to my entire face as directed. And I'm happy to say, I had NO negative reaction whatsoever! I'm now a fan of BeauKON facial moisturizer. I love that 'a little goes a long way'. And it does. Its not a heavy cream at all. Its on the thinner side and easy to apply and spread around the face. I have a weird OCD thing about having lotion touching my skin. If it doesn't go on dry or dry quickly, I won't use the product at all. (Yes, I know how ridiculous I sound...stupid OCD! lol) The BeauKON moisturizer does take a few minutes to dry but it dries quickly, thankfully! It has a bit of a light scent-nothing overpowering or gaggy but a nice, light scent. To me, it smelled faintly of oranges. I didn't smell coconut at all. I do love how soft my skin is from using BeauKON. I made the HUGE mistake of mentioning to my husband how well this works on dry skin. Now that we have the heat on in the house, he too gets terribly dry skin. I should have kept my mouth shut because he tried and LOVED it as well~ lolol. I'm going to have to hide it from him and keep it for myself.

I very, very much like this moisturizer. Everything about it is wonderful...the texture, the scent, the little pump nozzle which ensures I won't squeeze out too much cream, the fact that it dries quickly and leaves my skin noticeably soft. I absolutely, without a doubt, DO recommend BeauKON Hyaluronic Acid Daily Facial Moisturizer!

title: The Presentation is the Best Thing About This Polish
text:
I"m a nail polish fanatic. I own just under 1500 bottles of nail polish, all different colors, brands and styles. (And I had to leave at least 1 star for the review to go through)

This bottle of polish is supposed to be a very pale pink. The only time I ever spotted even a tiny hint of pink was when I held a flashlight up close to my nails. Even then, then hint of pink was barely visible. This was more of a white /slightly off-white shade. The consistency was super thick. It took a LONG time for the polish to dry. Hours after I had applied the polish, I went to bed. The bedsheet -(a normal bedsheet-) that touched my toenail as I slept smeared the polish on my big toe. It looked like I had brushed up against something while the polish was wet, but the polish was definitely dry when I went to bed. Just touching the bedsheet lightly smeared it. This particular polish/color reminded me of a cross between Milk of Magnesia and Wite-Out correction fluid....the color AND consistency. I removed this polish from my nails first thing the following morning after I had applied it. The brush with this bottle of polish worked as expected...no issues with it but there was also nothing special about it.

title: Smells Great, Works Even  Better!

title: No Thanks!

title: Love How My Skin Looks AND Feels!
text:

title: This Brush Makes My Skin Look and Feel GOOD!!!!!!!
text:

title: 4 Wonderful Soaps That Smell Fantastic!
text:
I'm one of those (weird) people who likes to unscrew caps and sniff laundry detergent/fabric softener in the aisle of the grocery store to figure out which scent i like the best. And I do the same with liquid and bath soaps!

I was (and still am) beyond thrilled over the 4 pack of 13 ounce bottles of Soft Soap that appeared in my Vine queue to test. The 4 pack includes the following scents: Wild Basil and Lime, Jasmine and Mint, Peony and Plum , Shea and Cocoa Butter.

Wild Basil and Lime: I am usually not a fan of citrus-y scents. I actually expected to not like this scent at all due to the lime. Turns out, I LOVE this scent! I LOVE IT! title: Works Well

title: Your Skin Will Be Soft AND Healthy Thanks To GreenIVe Shea Butter!
text:
I wouldn't normally disclose this because it can be terribly embarrassing, but I feel its necessary for my review of this product. I have OCD-Obsessive Compulsive Disorder. Its not a self diagnosis or the result of a Google search, I was diagnosed with having OCD nearly 20 years ago by my family physician. My OCD comes with some bizarre compulsions. One compulsion I have is that I cannot stand to have any type of lotion touching my skin. I cannot stand the way it feels just sitting on my skin. If its a lotion that dries quickly or a lotion that goes on dry, such as certain sunscreens, then I"m fine. If I can feel lotion after a few minutes, I wipe it off, end of story. And I never touch that lotion again. (Yes, I realize how freaky I am...OCD can be extremely annoying! lol)

When I was 15, I took notice of my mother's skin. Very smooth and soft and practically wrinkle free. I wanted my skin to be the same when I reached her age (early 40's) so right then and there, I began to use moisturizing cream on my face daily. Decades later, I continue to. In addition to keeping my skin soft and preventing wrinkles, I also use moisturizers because I have extremely fair and sensitive skin. In the winter, it doesn't take long before my skin is bright red, itching and burning if I don't keep it moisturized.

As soon as I took the GreenIVe container out of the box upon its arrival, the first thing I noticed was the word 'BUTTER' in huge letters on the label. Uh oh. Butter=greasy feeling of lotion sitting on my skin. And you know what that means for my OCD. I began to dread trying GreenIVe shea butter before I even dipped my finger in the container. I got a VERY small dollop of shea butter on my finger and began to spread it on my cheeks, my chin, my forehead and my neck area. I immediately felt as though I had smeared Crisco shortening all over my face but I did NOT wipe it off. How I wanted to! But this was the first time I was trying this product and I had to give it a fair shake before banishing it forever because I didn't like the way it felt on my skin. So I applied a thin layer and waited for a few minutes. And a few minutes was all it took because the greasy feeling to go away and the shea butter to be absorbed into my skin. I was NOT left with a greasy-Crisco feeling. I did not have that dreaded feeling of lotion sitting on my skin. My skin was now dry but it was SOFT. Incredibly SOFT!!! I happen to have a small patch of skin on my forehead that frequently itches and drives me bonkers. I did apply a small dab of shea butter to that spot and it no longer itches AT ALL. I have a small scab on the top of my hand from a small cut I got a few days ago. And you know how scabs are...they itch but if you scratch it off, you start the healing process all over again . My scab and the area around it itch but instead of scratching, I applied a TINY dab of shea butter. The itching has stopped completely.

I could NOT be happier that i have found a new product to use to moisturize my skin , keep my skin soft AND stop it from itching. Even better is the fact that GreenIVe is 100% all natural! NO additives...NO fillers...NO coloring added...NO scent added. This is 100% raw Africian shea butter and if it can keep my dry, itchy skin soft and healthy, there's no doubt it can do the same for everyone. I did a little research and found this product works on ALL skin types. And believe me , it DOES work! You want to use GreenIVe shea butter to keep your skin as healthy as possible. It works and its ALL natural.

title: Get Back the Skin You Had Before Years of Sun, Makeup and Time Affected It!
text:
(I put the steamer close to the wall to take the pics so you'd be able to see the amount of steam it emits)

I decided to try the Revlon Illuminating Facial Steamer for a few weeks before writing my review to see if I noticed any changes to my skin.

The machine itself is bigger than I expected. I dont' mean to imply that its overly huge, I just pictured something smaller. It fits nicely on my bathroom counter and its lighter than i expected. The instructions are simple to follow. One thing to ALWAYS remember is to make sure you fill the tank with water EVERY SINGLE TIME you use it to the level line marked on the tank. When you've finished using it, dump the excess water from the tank. Don't reuse it, fill it again each time you use the system. And make sure the system is UNPLUGGED when you fill the water tank and insert it into the steamer. Make sure the system is UNPLUGGED when you remove the water tank from the system as well.

It takes roughly 40 seconds after turning it on for the steam to come out. Do NOT put your face right up against the nozzle. Do not touch the nozzle when its in use, the nozzle gets HOT. Read the directions so you know how close to get to the steamer so you don't get burned. The tank provides 20 minutes of steam as long as you fill it up to the water level line prior to turning the system on.

The steamer has a built in timer which you can control and the instructions clearly explain how to set/use the timer. A light will come on around the on/off switch when the system has run out of water.

Cleaning the system is easy. Make sure to discard all water remaining in the tank and use a towel to dry out the system.

I use the Revlon facial steamer 2-3 times per week for approx. 10 minutes each time. I have extremely sensitive skin. SO many products cause me to break out. I have eczema as well. My eczema is very mild at this time of the year, thankfully, but I still have some itching. The very first time I used the Revlon Illuminating Facial Steamer, I noticed a different in my skin. The very FIRST TIME! My skin felt GOOD when I finished. I know that's a pathetic description, but it did. My face felt good and very refreshed. My concern was that I felt that way since this is a new product for me to use and eventually, that feeling would stop happening. It has not. Every single time I use this, my skin feels and LOOKS great. I do sometimes apply a light layer of unscented lotion to my face after I do a treatment. My skin is so soft. It kind of reminds me a child's delicate, soft skin and not what it actually is... skin belonging to someone who is in her mid-40's, who has experienced too many incidents of sunburn, makeup use, eczema etc. And that is thanks to the Revlon Illuminating Facial steamer. It really is.

I will be going on vacation soon for a few days and my Revlon steamer will be coming along, no doubt about it. This steamer is now a part of my routine and will remain that way.

And BTW...this isn't just for women. My husband uses it as well and he loves it. And speaking of him...while this isn't what the steamer is supposed to be used for, I thought I'd mention this anyway. Somehow, he got a cold. Its the middle of summer and somehow, he managed to catch a cold. (We did go to a casino not long before he got sick, he probably picked up germs there?) He happened to be using the steamer on his face and realized he was having a much easier time breathing through his stuffy nose thanks to the steam. I"m NOT suggesting anyone should use this in place of a vaporizer/humidifier, but I just wanted to mention that he did get some relief from his stuffy nose after using this!

You deserve to be pampered. Get yourself a Revlon Illuminating Facial Steamer, relax and ENJOY. You are going to look and feel so much better!

title: My Hair is Healthy AGAIN!
text:
I need to be able to give this product more than 5 stars!!!

I've always had very long and very thick hair. I graduated from high school years and years ago. Recently, a former classmate told me my hair was the envy of the girls throughout school because it was so long and thick. (Yes, I'm bragging a bit by writing this but I don't have much to brag about, so I"m going to enjoy this while I can! lol) I had no clue they felt that way. My hair was always my best feature. Now that I"m older, its thinning on top. In addition, due to stress, its been falling out as well. I"m extremely self conscious because of this. I used to have the type of hair that I could wash, run my fingers through while damp and BAM! Done. My hair had a nice, natural wave to it that I've always loved. Since my hair began thinning/falling out, that natural wave isn't anywhere close to where it used to be. I sometimes use a curling iron to help but try not to as I'm trying to protect my hair and not further damage it. I use biotin conditioners as well and they do help the appearance of thicker hair but that's a very temporary fix that doesn't last long. I also now use a hairbrush made from boar bristle which works nicely, but again, a temporary fix.

In all honestly, I"d never heard of the Oribe brand before. I didn't expect the Oribe Styling Butter Curl Creme to be any different than any other brand that I've already tried. I didn't expect much and I didn't get my hopes up. I washed my hair last night and put a small amount of Oribe creme on my hand and ran in through my damp hair. The first think I noticed was the scent. It has a nice, light scent to it. Its not powerful and its not flowery or gagging at all. Its a nice, light scent that to me, smells clean. (hope that makes sense~) I did not need to use much of the creme in my hair. Just a little amount covered the areas I wanted covered. It did not weigh down my hair as some other brands do, nor did it feel waxy. (I HATE products that feel 'waxy' in my hair!) I put my hair in a loose bun on top of my head and went to bed. This morning, I took out the ponytail and my hair had the nice curly wave to it that I've missed for so long . And best of all, ALL I HAD TO DO WAS RUN MY FINGERS THROUGH MY HAIR AND I WAS GOOD TO GO!!! (Yes, I'm yelling, but happy yelling! :) ) My hair was finally behaving the way it used to before I got old and before stress took its toll. And best of all, it STAYED that way all day. I sound so vain, which is not my intent, but you have NO clue how happy this makes me. I finally have some of the confidence back that I had lost due to my thinning hair and hair loss. Without a doubt, I WILL continue to use Oribe. Oribe is the ONLY product that has helped me get my hair back and I WILL use it from now on! THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU, Oribe! (Oh and my hair STILL has the nice scent to it today as well! ) Give Oribe products a try. You will NOT be disappointed!
