text: These masks are thin, but durable enough to do the job.  They have a really nice fragrance!  They fit on the small side and kind of wrinkly, due to the thin sheet.  The essence is nice; it’s watery not at all milky and offers no lotion-like quality, strictly water essence.  I purchased these masks at a price point of .90 each and they do the job, however: the list of ingredients is long, I prefer FaceTory’s natural ingredients as well as milky essences, beautiful fragrances, etc.  This is a very basic, but hydrating/fresh fragranced mask that’s affordably priced.

title: Dual Ended Brush Saver!
text: I love this thing; Kitch is the best for your hair!  One end snatches hair from your brush in bulk, and the other brushes any product flakes, stray hairs and dust right away.  Squeaky clean brush!!

title: No Tangles!
text: The satiny finish allows for easy removal from your hair; less tangles, pulling and breakage!  Kitch is the best 💕

title: Perfect!
text: The portability attracted me to Tréstique, and the formulas have me hooked!  I typically wear CT, Mac matte or Chanel lip and cheek balm; this lippie is on par with any of these.  It’s soft, but not balm-soft, and it’s lasts as well as any good lippie.  Love the strong pigment and true-to-photo color(s)-it really is good stuff!  The excellent built in primer is a great bonus.

title: PUMPKIN ESSENCE!
text: Love the on-the-go packaging!  It keeps the product clean and fresh.  I think of these as one of my 7 skins (k beauty method that promotes the application of seven toners/essences as a routine).  I have TOO MANY nice beauty products to have much of a routine.  I just use the 7 skins; that allows me to use many kinds of serums and essences, sheet masks, etc, every day).  Pumpkin Pack, like Zombie, Mummy and Witch Packs, is a top shelf quality product!  It’s cool and reviving to the skin (especially when kept in a beauty fridge).  Open the small, triangular pack and squeeze out the entire contents. Then press, press, press, pat, pat, pat with fingertips until most of the essence has been absorbed.  Allow the last of it to dry before finishing with heavier moisture or moving on to the next skin!  Product smells fresh like fall, you’re going to love it!

title: Special Find for Dry Skin!
text: I feel so lucky!  I was shopping beauty supply when I noticed a pretty pink box from Neutrogena💕. This little serum/essence is SO delicious!  It’s 7% AHA/PCA to chemically exfoliate dry skin; followed with HA for fine exfoliation and moisture PLUMPLING!!  Just a simple collection of proven ingredients to keep your dry skin baby butt smooth and bright with moisture.  It won’t break your budget either!  Make this product one of your 7 skins today.

title: No Marks Left Behind!
text: I don’t know how they do it, but Kitch has taken the “bump” out of barrette hair!  When wearing a hairband to apply masks or make up, you get “flat head.”  An area at your  hairline peak that flattens just like a board.  Unattractive.  Similarly, clips to hold back your hair give you “barrette head,” complete with “bumps.”  These Kitch clips ARE THE ANSWER!!  No dents, bumps nor flattening!  Just your hair, outta there!  Shout out to Kitch everything!!  Especially soap/conditioning bars-delightful!

title: Great Whipped Texture
text: I actually love this product but gave 4⭐️ due to it’s lack of longevity.  It’s creamy and lovely to wear.  The color is true; it goes on whipped and smooth, very comfortable.  Used as cheek color, it’s easily blended and buildable.  It lasts well on the cheeks but frequently reapplication is necessary for lips.  The texture is just lovely.  This product is much like MAC Powder Kiss formula and the price point is much lower than the high quality of the lipstick.  NYX always surprises me with top shelf quality.

title: Solidly Good Sheet Mask
text: I honestly don’t understand how anyone could leave a bad review for these great sheet masks.  I use sheet masks at least once daily, often twice, and have literally tried them all!  I have several beauty subscriptions and I get high-end sheet masks frequently.  Some of the most expensive sheet masks are too fragile to unfold without tearing; these are really sturdy.  They’re VERY delicately scented and have ample, hydrating essence.  There is the occasional mask that’s really moisturizing, but most provide watery hydration and these do exactly that.  I keep them in the refrigerator, of course, and they are marvelous.  They’re particularly wonderful when you’re hot!  They cool me right off and leave my skin refreshed and drenched in plumping, dewy essence.  Buy with confidence!

title: Worse Than Meh
text: What a cute palate, right?!  Wrong.  Extensive fall-out and poor pigment.  Zero payoff with lots of “mess.”  Pass.

title: Cheap

title: Excellent Shadow Brushes!

title: Don’t Listen to Haters!
text: I got this in an Ipsy Glam Bag X.  This coveted bag/box comes to members only 4 x per year and only if you choose to pay more for it.  It has top shelf products only, like Tatcha!  I’m in love with the product and reviews from Ipsy members are off the chain!  I’m 54 and have great skin that still benefits from the silky blur of this primer.  If it’s “clumping” on you? you’ve used too much, if 50. is steep? you obviously aren’t a make up junkie and if you don’t adore this product and feel that “elf primer” is better? you should see a Dr., REALLY.  The problem is you, NOT this micro-color correcting, silk and botanical, perfecting, velvety primer!  Buy with confidence!  BTW:  Crying about the price?  Until now, Urban Decay was my go to primer and it’s 58.  You’re high end, or your not.  Me?  I’d skip groceries for this stuff!

The tassel detail is strong and so cute!  I got these specially priced at 1/2 off or 8.  The sentiment written on the bag is SO true:  Better Late Than Ugly.  Truer words have never been spoken/written.  The little pink elephants in bow ties are just too adorable-dancing all over the bag, and you’ll have room for EVERYTHING!

I like them for moisture packs as they hold everything against your skin and prevent evaporation.  They’re also great for sheet masks, which I use daily.  The silicone mask keeps the sheet mask in place so you can move about.  These are high quality with enough to share with friends!  Excellent!

title: Great Product!
text: I’ve used Touch Base for years.  It’s a perfect nude-ish canvas for at number of looks.  Smudges on easily and quickly dries to a powder finish that’s compatible with both cream and powder shadows.  Looks great by itself for a natural “no make up” day.  It does dry out quickly, however, I’ve always finished the pot before that happens.  Touch Base is a staple in my bag of tricks!

I’m very happy with this little black wonder.

title: Great Low-price Alternative
text: I find this product as effective as PoreFessional by Benefit, though very different.  This product has a light, loose formula with more working time than creamier products like PoreFessional.  The biggest difference?  The price.  I HAD to try this lower cost product and it works!  I don’t have large pores and my primers usually do just fine.  This would be a good adjunct.  It’s not the best primer for your make up.

title: Sinful Black Cherry Yumminess!
text: Matte lipstick by MAC, is there anything so wonderful?  The formula is a staple, not “retro matte” which is dry and chalky on application (I love it, it doesn’t budge) but just “matte.”  There’s a wee bit of cream with this formula; it’s comfortable and grippy.  I suggest the ozone pencil (also by MAC) underneath to prime.  Liner by Buxom in plum works to but isn’t necessary.  The color is rich and stunning; heavily pigmented with vivid color payoff.  It’s a kind of black cherry red; some may call it wine, but that’s not quite accurate.  There’s nothing warm about it.  It’s cool, cool and more cool, which I love.  So no brick in there at all.  I think black cherry is a good description.  Like all MAC matte lipsticks, you won’t wear it on your teeth (be sure to allow setting time and blot), it lasts and lasts, reapply after eating.  You’ll love the deep, fruity black/red look!

title: Best Blur/Primer Ever!
text: This product is a stunner!  Very thick, pore filler/putty-like consistency.  Application can be tricky, less is more!  Best to cleanse, apply moisturizer, allow 5 min for absorption and apply product in very small amounts to one area of the face at a time.  Think of yourself as glazing a thin coat on top of the skin.  I tried a beauty blender - EPIC FAIL, use the warmth of fingertips to melt onto skin gently.  Allow at least 5 min to “set” before moving onto foundation.  It makes a velvety canvas for your make up and seems to shield skin from cosmetic residue.  All imperfections, and I mean ALL, are blurred and minimized!  It’s magical!  I carefully pat foundation on top with a blender so as not to disturb or mix products.  I highly recommend this pricey can’t-live-without.  It will no doubt last a long time as a tiny bit goes so far.  Once I have my foundation on top I spritz with UD All-Nighter setting spray (best product ever), allow to dry and apply the rest of my makeup.  With several, layered applications of setting spray you’ll find your makeup will be grip taped in place until you remove it.  It’s a comfortable wearing grip, not tight nor cakey.  This is a blur, pore filler, primer in one.  It’s soft as silk and oh so comfy.  Really worth every penny.  You won’t be disappointed!

title: Milky Piggy K-Beauty JOY!!
text: Wow.  I bought this primarily for fun and was pleasantly surprised.  It’s the consistency of gel-like pudding and smells mildly of clay/charcoal.  It’s easy to apply, I used a mask applicator of my own; it comes with a small scoop that isn’t suited for application.  It immediately begins to bubble and soon you start morphing in to “Elephant Man Face!”  You can hear the bubbles crackling all over your face and the “foam” just gets bigger!!  There’s a slight tingle; more intense than I expected.  Removal with warm water is easy too; I used a face cloth.  Skin is left squeaky clean and I mean clean almost to the point of dry.  Pores are tight and appear smaller and there’s a discernible smoothness to the skin.  Plan to apply products after as you’ll need moisture!  A moisture mask would be great.  I applied my Roc retinol followed by some serums/moisturizer.  My husband got a big kick out of my growing and distorting face!!  For 10.?  Super bargain K-beauty fun and oddly effective!  There were some odd comments about whether to remove makeup prior to use.  I followed common sense logic and removed make up/cleansed first.  Enjoy!

title: Not a Tinted Moisturizer
text: Another disappointment from my fave brand!  I’m so puzzled.  This is a tinted moisturizer, more or less, but it’s really thicker with more coverage than my Clinique foundation.  I like and will use the product, it’s rich and moisturizing, but it’s def not the tinted moisturizer I expected.

title: Depuff and Soothe Quickly and Easily!
text: I was introduced to this product via my Ipsy subscription.  The offering was for ice globes similar to these but I failed to get them before the offer expired.  Anyway, that brings us to shopping for ice globes on Amazon.  These globes are filled with liquid that doesn’t completely freeze, at least not in 30 min or so.  They are obviously very old but have handy sleeves to prevent fingers from getting to cold.  I have naturally puffy eyes, worse when I cry or have allergic reactions.  I’m in love with these ice globes!  They not only chill and depuff the eye area, but can be used to massage facial tissues to decongest and get fluid draining.  They really work and feel wonderful!  They are a new favorite “find” for me and I highly recommend them as part of the beauty ritual.  Tired, irritated eyes are cooled and refreshed with just a few minutes of use.  I got the pink ones and couldn’t be more pleased!

title: Save your time and money -- go for a real paraffin treatment at your local spa/salon
text:
Having had plenty of paraffin wax treatments in spas and salons, I had high hopes for these gloves and being able to save some cash and do it myself at home. Unfortunately, it's not as easy as I thought.

The gloves are bulky and large which made me think that my hands would fit but also realized that I would need my husband's help to get the second one on. While I did require help to put the second glove on (putting them both on yourself is near impossible), they weren't as large as they first appeared and my hands barely fit inside (I was actually surprised I didn't rip them) and so the fit was tight and uncomfortable.

I heated them in the microwave as instructed but the wax melted in a weird way in both gloves. Glove 1 - the wax melted so much that, while I was able to get my hand in and smush/spread the wax around my fingers, it was an odd watery texture. Glove 2 - the wax hardly melted at all, making it so lumpy and hard in places that my fingers didn't even fit into the finger slots all the way and I didn't get as much full coverage from the wax since it wouldn't spread at all.

Despite these difficulties, I did manage to wear them for the recommended 10 minutes (with the aforementioned assistance of my husband). Removing them was yet another challenge... my hubby held the glove itself while I slid my hand out, trying to keep the wax inside the glove. Now, anyone who has had a wax dip knows exactly what "sweeping" maneuvers I was doing along my fingers but I must say that these techniques didn't work with these gloves. I think it comes down to the weird consistency of the wax. Needless to say, I got wax everywhere but inside the gloves. It was a mess.

Once off, I tried to clip them shut with the included clip and this is where yet another challenge presented itself... the clip is not as wide as the openings on the gloves so it is not possible to clip the gloves closed using the included clip. Since these gloves are claimed to be multi-use, I just laughed at this point.

Bottom line.. these gloves are too much of a hassle. They are too difficult to use, the wax must be bottom of the line grade and the included clip was not made to fit the gloves in the same kit rendering this kit a one-time-use deal. Oh! And my hands didn't feel any more moisturized than before I began this entire ordeal. These are a definite no go for me and I will not be recommending it. Just save enough to buy two of these kits and go and treat yourself to a real wax treatment at your local spa or salon. Trust me.

And finally, the price is *excellent* for what you get!

title: These glass files are wonderful!
text: Besides the obviously sparkly (and gorgeous!) colorful rhinestone accents, these come as a set of 2 and each one has its own velvet storage sleeve. I keep one in my purse and one in my truck. They work very well in both shining up your nail surface and filing and shaping your nail tips. They wash and rinse well and fit perfectly back in their storage sleeves. And finally, the price is *excellent* for what you get!

title: Great for dog feet!
text: I got these Gemice Premium Manicure Rounded Tip Scissors to use for grooming my dogs' feet and they work outstanding! They are a solid stainless steel build, cut very smooth on the first pass, lightweight, not awkward to hold and the slightly longer length did not cause my hand to cramp (my puppy is a wiggle worm so doing his feet can take a good amount of time lol). If you need a pair of grooming scissors, look no further! There is no need to spend a ridiculous amount of money on products specifically made for dog grooming. Instead, grab these and use your savings to pamper your pups!

title: Uncomfortable and awkward
text: This EYCOBEAUTY 7 Color Photon Led Light Machine, while an aesthetically pleasing design, has its caveats. The size is on the small side.. either that or I have a particularly large face. While I could get it to lay on my face, lined up pretty well for nearly full coverage, there is no easy way to secure the mask to your head so I found myself having to hold it which turned into a very awkward and uncomfortable position. And since this device is not wireless, you are restricted to having to be near an outlet.. this only added to the awkward position I mentioned. The included instructions were difficult to follow and understand. Overall, this device just isn't for me and unless you have a small face and a decent amount of patience (something I admit I lack at times lol), I'd recommend steering clear of this item.

title: Not for me
text: This GOODRAIN Heated Eyelash Curler just isn't for me. I have somewhat stubborn eyelashes and this tool, while very cool, unfortunately had no effect on my lashes whatsoever. It is a nifty little gadget though.. small enough to travel with and it did heat up and work as described.. it just couldn't tame my wayward lashes.

title: Sturdy
text: These Pronto Professional and Premium Nail Files are great! Very sturdy, the perfect length and work as expected and are indeed washable. And to top it off, the price is good for the 12 pieces you get. I keep one in my purse, my truck, my nightstand and have extras to spare!

title: Sturdy
text: These Tiphulan Washable Nail Files 100 180 Grit are great! Very sturdy, the perfect length and work as expected. And to top it off, the price is good for the 12 pieces you get.

title: Very little scent, but great taste
text: This is an excellent deal for this 10 pack Chapstick Party Favor Lip Balm! At the current price point, they work out to be about $1.50 each! I got the Toast to Love pack and the vanilla flavor tastes great without being too much while the smell is extremely light and barely there. I've already handed a few out to friends and will keep these in mind for baby showers and birthday parties in the future!

title: NOT for use with thick hair!
text: These Silk Scrunchies For Hair, 3 Pack are much smaller than I expected them to be after reviewing the product photos and description. I can only get two wraps for a ponytail which is hardly enough to keep my thick hair up off of my neck and without at least a third wrap these scrunchies just fall out of my hair (I actually broke the teal one when trying to force it into a third wrap). They are nicely made but the photos and/or description need to be updated to properly demonstrate just how small these are. Fortunately, I have some granddaughters who will love these (and who will be able to wear them with their thinner and finer hair).

title: Stretchy and (mostly) comfy
text: This pack of Satin Lined Sleep Cap Beanie Hats is a great deal! The caps are made of very soft material, are lined in silky fabric, have lots of stretch, are adjustable and come in six great colors. The only issue I ran into was that, despite being adjustable, the little plastic buckle (the one you use to adjust the tightness) kept leaving an indent in my forehead. I tried to fix this by paying close attention to the buckle placement when I put it on so the buckle was placed at the back of my head.. but that didn't really work. I could still feel the buckle pressing against my head. I then tried to lessen the tightness but , while I no longer had the buckle digging into my head, that only resulted in the cap falling off. I;m not sure what else I can do or try to alleviate the buckle issue.

title: Decent cap/beanie.. won't stay on
text: This Satin Bonnet Silk Lined Sleep Cap is nice. It does have a hidden adjustable elastic strap on the inside of the seam but I found that when I adjusted it to my head and then put it on to go to bed, the adjustment gave out and the slack allowed the cap to fall right off. I tried several times to adjust it and try to get it to lock in and stay on my adjusted size/setting but it fell off every time. I do like the inner silky lining and the style is such that it could easily double as an outdoor beanie. Sadly, since I can't get it to stay on my head, I will be donating it to the local women's shelter in hopes that it can put a smile on someone else's face (preferably a larger headed person who won't need to mess with the adjustment).

title: HUGE!!! Thick haired peeps, rejoice!!
text: Okay. I have to say that yes, I did read the description before ordering these, BUT... nothing could have prepared me for just how HUGE they are! I have very thick hair and I tend to break the elastic in almost every scrunchie I buy. I'll get maybe 5 or 6 uses out of one and then the band will break rendering it useless. Well now. THESE scrunchies have more stretch and are so flipping big they darn near make me look like I've got one of those derby hats on! LOL!! And I don't have a small head! I love them and love the fact that I can get a full 3 wraps around my thick hair! And the elastic actually holds my ponytail in place too! The thicker the hair, the heavier it is and I am so used to having to readjust my ponytail several times throughout the day -- not with these scrunchies!! And the price is perfect for what you get! Safe to say I'm all in on these oversized scrunchies!

title: Okay salts.. very overpriced
text: I got this Vitabath Lavender Chamomile Epsom Salts Infused with Vanilla - Moisturizing, Relaxing Aromatherapy Soak - Cruelty-Free, Gluten-Free, Soy-Free - 36 oz to try out as I love my nighttime baths! Having tried so many different bath salts, I can say these are better than some others but certainly not the best. The scent is nice but very underwhelming and could be much stronger. The salts did not fully dissolve for me (and I take hot spring temp baths people!) so I ended up sitting on and then chasing little clumps of the undissolved bits. I also didn't get much of the described moisturizing effect. And finally, the cost is a too high to me. For what you're getting, I'd say this bag shouldn't cost more than $10 and even that is being generous. I will use the rest of the bag up in my next 3-4 baths but after that I do not plan to replenish my supply of this particular brand.

title: Adjustable, comfortable and huge!
text: I got this set of Qishare Satin Lined Sleep Cap, 2pcs (Large, linen purple + linen black) because I tend to shower and wash my hair in the late afternoon or early evening and my shoulder length, extremely thick hair is never thoroughly dry in time for bed. I do not like to blow dry it, choosing to allow it to air dry instead. My hair stylist told me about how a satin sleep cap would allow me to go to bed with slightly damp hair and that it wouldn't be a complete tangled disaster by morning. She was right. I tried one of these caps out for the first last night. My hair was barely damp to the touch. After looking the cap over trying to figure out how I was going to fill the 17 inch bonnet with all my hair, I ended up turning the cap inside out over my hand, grasping my hair and then pulling it into the bonnet. This worked nearly perfectly (I had a couple of wayward strands that weren't in the mood to cooperate). Feeling accomplished, it was then that I remembered the adjustable band but I didn't have to remove the cap (thank god!). The cap can be adjusted while it is on, making me all the more appreciative. It didn't stay on all night however, but that was on me not the cap's fault. I'll simply have to adjust it a smidge tighter tonight. Overall, I am quite pleased with this set of caps! They fit all of my hair, highly adjustable, are silky smooth inside and out and even come in attractive colors. And the price is very reasonable for what you get. I would recommend these (actually I already have! I called my mom about them this morning lol).

title: Not for use on thick hair
text: This BEAUTYFYN Apple Cider Vinegar shampoo – All-Natural Hair Care Shampoo for All Hair Types – Nourishing Formula for Healthy, Hydrated Hair and Scalp – No Parabens & Sulphate free - 200ml is not good for those of us with thick hair. There are much better options. The bottle is much smaller than my other shampoos and it took about 1/3 of the bottle for just one application. And that didn't even lather up completely. After rinsing out what little lather I was able to work up, I felt like my hair just wasn't clean and proceeded to wash my hair with my regular shampoo. This shampoo is a little on the creamy side but a runny creamy (if that makes sense). I prefer and have come to discover that thicker, more creamier shampoos work best and lather up best in my thick hair. I think I used so much of this bottle due to how watery the shampoo is. Just an all around no go for me and my hair.

title: Not for thick hair
text: This BEAUTYFYN Onion Hair Fall Shampoo for Hair Growth & Hair Fall Control With Red Onion Seed Oil Extract 200ml is absolutely not for those of us with thick hair. The bottle is much smaller than my other shampoos and it took nearly half the bottle for just one application. And that didn't even lather up completely. After rinsing out what little lather I was able to work up, I felt like my hair just wasn't clean and proceeded to wash my hair with my regular shampoo. This shampoo is also very runny. I prefer and have come to discover that thicker, more creamier shampoos work best and lather up best in my thick hair. I think I used half of this bottle due to how watery the shampoo is. Just an all around no go for me and my hair.

title: Bath bombs for the shower!
text: Since I practically live in my bathtub (okay, not literally, but you get it) and love using bath bombs, I was intrigued when I saw these Serenity Select- Shower Steamers and knew I had to try them out. They really are bath bombs for your shower! While you (obviously) don't get any moisturizing benefit, you do get a wonderful spa-like aromatherapy session. The scents are heavenly and fill the bathroom very well, while not being overly powerful or suffocating. It turned the mundane task of showering into a luxurious retreat!

title: Great for kids!
text: I got these ZBORH 50PCS Black Hair Ties for Women, Seamless Hair Bands, Elastic Ponytail Holders, No Damage for Thick Hair(2 Inch in Diameter) to keep on hand for my grand kids. They are always losing or misplacing their hair ties or they simply fall out while they're playing. It happens. So this bag of 50 hair ties was a great deal! They have more than enough stretch and black goes with anything and everything. All in all, a great purchase at a great price.

title: Effective deodorant!
text: This Dove Nourishing Secrets Dry Spray Antiperspirant Deodorant for Women Waterlily Sakura Blossom 48 Hour Sweat Odor Protection 3.8 oz 3 Count, 11.4 Ounce is very effective at its job. I applied some first thing in the morning then headed out to remove a perimeter fence from our property. It was never above 60F degrees but I still worked up a sweat.. or should have! This deodorant worked surprisingly well. I love the scent which is not overly perfumy or baby powdery like other deodorants tend to be and I also did not have any white stains in my shirt at the end of the day. The only negative for me is that the price is a bit steep, even for a pack of 3.

title: Happy, close-shaven Hubby :)
text: I got this Remington Wetech 100% Waterproof Cordless Foil Shaver, 1 count in the white color for my husband since his nearly 10 year old Remington has been on the fritz lately. He says it is lightweight, shaves close and the battery seems to hold a charge decently. He has charged it only once when it first arrived, has used it 10-12 times and has yet to recharge it. It will also be excellent to take with us on trips given its lightweight so it won't add much weight at all to our luggage.

title: Husband likes and wife approves
text: This C.O. Bigelow Cologne for Men - Elixir White - No. 1585, 2.4 fl oz is from the same line I have purchased for my husband from Bath and Body Works. I usually buy for him in bulk so I haven't looked lately to see if they still carry or offer this product line. This cologne is a fresh woodsy scent that lasts almost all day and both my husband and I like it. You get a decent size bottle for the price and since you (should) use this in moderation, the bottle should last for a long time.

title: Disappointing
text: I really expected this Goldfaden MD NeedleLess Line Smoothing Concentrate, 1 Ounce to give me better results.. or any results at all. Unfortunately, after nearly two months of use I have had no firmer or tighter skin, no affect on my fine lines and no change in my skin's elasticity. Given the cost, I was expecting it to hold up to its claims, but alas that just wasn't the case for me. Overall, due to the non-existent results and the astronomical price tag, I cannot recommend this product.

title: Very uncomfortable
text: These Jakuva 24K Golden Bio-Collagen Facial Patch, Gold Collage Facial Patch/ Pad For Moisturising come in a pack of 12 and I used four over the course of a month (1 every weekend). I've used quite a few different brands of facial masks and these were some of the most uncomfortable for me. Maybe it is the shape or the thickness of the masks..? I have no idea and haven't been able to figure it out. They also had no affect on my wrinkles or other "signs of aging" (like crows feet). They are a pass for me.

title: Just okay
text: I used this Marette Naturals Night Cream with Anti-Aging Plant Stem Cells doesn't for nearly two months and I've seen none of the results that the description claims I should.. no reduction of wrinkles, no change in firmness and no brightening. It does smell good, applies smoothly and the little jar will last awhile as a little bit goes a long way.

title: It's okay
text: This Korean Lip Scrub & Balm Set is just okay. It doesn't exfoliate nearly as much as other brands I've tried and love. It does apply easily, isn't very messy and leaves my lips soft though.

title: Excellent product!!
text: This Pantene Hair Mask, Leave In Conditioner, Miracle Rescue Deep Conditioning Treatment is hands down, one of the best products I have ever used on my hair! I have very thick, wavy hair that tends to dry out and fall out. I replaced the conditioner I'd been using with this and I am stunned by the difference. Due to the thickness of my hair, I only wash it every 3-4 days and I am extremely pleased to report that since using this deep conditioning treatment my hair isn't only softer right after the shower, but also 4 days later! I love how you get two bottles at this price.. I know I will be ordering more soon as I never want to run out!

title: Results in soft hair!
text: This Pantene Hair Spray Miracle Rescue Leave In Conditioner Spray & Mix-In Treatment leaves my hair very soft! I have very thick, wavy hair so I am always on the hunt for products that can assist in not only keeping my hair tangle free but smooth and soft as well. After a shower, I towel dried my hair then sprayed this treatment throughout all of my hair (didn't want to miss any of it!) and then proceeded to let it air dry (because it is so thick and tends to tangle easily, I do not blow dry it often). The softness lasted four days until my next shower! (Again, due to the thickness of my hair, I only wash it every 3-4 days.) I am quite pleased with my personal results and believe I have found the leave-in treatment I have been looking for!

title: Takes time but they do work on puffiness
text: I got these under eye patches in hopes of treating my puffiness and they are decent at that. Easy to use, they adhered to my face no problem, they didn't annoy my eyes so I was able to read my Kindle while I was wearing them and the came off without issue. The next morning, I didn't notice much of a difference in my under eye puffiness, but I continued to use them every other day for the rest of the week and by Sunday morning I was beginning to see a reduction in my puffiness! Yay! These come as a pack of 30 pairs, so I'll be good for awhile.

title: Nice scent
text: I got this Nabia Rose Glow Face Sheet Mask with French and Damask Rose, Cica(10 Sheets) to pamper myself. Given the state of the world these days, going to a spa is difficult to say the least. I am pleased to report that these masks are very nice.. they fit my face, smelled very nice and had the perfect amount of serum. These masks work well for pampering yourself or would make a great gift also.

title: Nice scent
text: I got this Nabia Rose Face Sheet Mask(5 sheets) + Rose Face Mist(3.38 Fl oz.) Set to pamper myself. Given the state of the world these days, going to a spa is difficult to say the least. I am pleased to report that these masks are very nice.. they fit my face, smelled very nice and had the perfect amount of serum. Using the mist as a final touch was quite soothing and relaxing. This is quite a nice set that works well for pampering yourself or would make a great gift also.

title: Perfect for taking your fav scent with you on the go
text: This refillable atomizer makes taking your favorite perfume with you anywhere. Being TSA approved and given its small size (no larger than a tube of lipstick) it is also perfect for traveling - just toss it in your bag or purse and you're off. It is extremely easy to refill and the color (I got silver) is very nice. I am very happy with mine and it is highly likely I'll purchase more as gifts soon!

title: Excellent files!
text: These Senignol glass nail files are excellent for what they do! I am picky when it comes to my files and have come across my fair share of crappy files.. but these are superb at filing and smoothing my nails and the length is just great - not too short, not too long. I've got these spread out between my purse, my truck, my bathroom and my nightstand.. and all of them have they're own slip sleeve to keep them safe and protected no matter where you keep or carry them. Overall, perfect files! I'll be purchasing more as gifts I'm sure!

title: Relaxing but way too expensive
text: You get one each of four different types of mask (calming, brightening, moisturizing and rejuvenating) making it a great starter kit. The masks smelled nice but fit my face kinda funny. They have slits to allow for different face sizes and shaped but I couldn't get them flat against my face.. ended up with multiple ripples. Still felt relaxing though. Overall, while these masks due smell good and were relaxing, I won't be a repeat customer - they are just too expensive compared to many other available options on the market.

title: Gillette missed the mark on this one
text:
I have been using Gillette Venus razors for decades.. the 5 blade Olay refills are fantastic! I use them to shave everything (legs, underarms, nether regions and even my upper lip) and they work perfectly. So when I saw this new offering focused on use for the nether regions, of course I had to try it.

Long story short.. I don't like it. It took multiple passes to get all the hair shaved off and my skin smooth. The blade got clogged up with shaved hair too easily (and would not rinse out) making it take even more passes to get the desired results of a smooth shave. I ended up having to finish the job with my trusty Venus Olay razor which got the job done as always with no issues.

This Intimate Grooming razor was, at first glance, a great idea. Compared to my old reliable Venus Olay razor, it is more slender and lighter and the blade is not as thick (no large moisturizing bar) but I cannot stand a razor that makes a job as simple as shaving hair take so darn long. My back began to hurt due to how many passes and how much time it was taking with the Intimate Grooming razor. So for me (your mileage may vary) it is an absolute no go and ended up in the trash before I even got out of the tub (a 3 point toss into the trash can that I am still proud of lol).

Overall, while Gillette completely missed the mark on this one, my loyalty to this great brand is unaffected and I'll continue to purchase the 5 blade Olay refills for my original Gillette Venus razor.

title: Smells SO good and has Staying power!!
text: Buying perfumes or any stink pretties (as my husband likes to call them LoL) off the internet is always a gamble. For this DEFINEME hair fragrance, I chose the Peyton scent based on the description stating it contains Orange Blossom and Clove Buds. Well, once I received it I have to admit that I don't catch the orange blossom at all but I do pick up the clove buds. The scent smells absolutely heavenly to me! I love it! It has a longer staying power than I expected.. a few spritz in the A.M. and my hair still smells wonderful come late afternoon. I've even applied it as a perfume in a pinch - I go to pool therapy twice a week and I give myself a couple of squirts to my neck after my shower to help mask the chlorine smell. Works like a charm! I love this fragrance spray and feel like being adventurous and giving the other scents a try!

title: Wonderful results!
text: I recently purchased an at home wax melter waxing kit so I could keep up with my eyebrows and not have to go to a salon. I got this skin care kit to use in conjunction with my new waxing kit and the results are amazing! The pre-wax lotion is not too thick or overly scented and applied and absorbed well. The wax remover oil was fantastic at helping to remove all of the left over wax! I am new to personal at home waxing and I suck at removing all the wax when I'm done and this wax remover does the job perfectly! I didn't experience much reddening so I didn't need to use the post wax lotion, but it is a nice consistency and smells very nice. Overall, this is a great kit for those of us taking on the task of waxing ourselves at home during this pandemic. I highly recommend this kit to anyone who shares my shoes!

title: Contains alcohol
text: These masks didn't work well for me. They contain alcohol and that was a no go for my sensitive skin. I didn't pay attention to the ingredients, as I should have, prior to use and I ended up with a slightly reddened face for the next 24 hours. It wasn't painful and did fade but I will be donating the rest of the box to a local women's shelter. If you want to try these, go for it! But please note the alcohol ingredient and be mindful if you have sensitive skin like me.

title: Moisturizing
text: These masks are very moisturizing. Easy to use, I used it right before bed and in the morning I noticed my skin was much softer and more plump. I haven't noticed any reduction in my wrinkles but I did feel like I had a deep clean.

title: Excellent treatments for winter skin!
text: I used the hand mitts and let me tell you -- just wow! I live in Wyoming and the winters here are long and hard and always reek havoc on my skin. My hands are usually the worst and I'm always on the look out for a way to help protect them and treat them. These mitts *really* helped return a ton of moisture to them! The face masks were no different, except for being used on my face instead of my hands lol. They also put a lot of moisture back into my facial skin and made my skin pre-winter soft again!

title: Learning curve
text: I got these wax strips mainly out of curiosity. I've been shaving for decades but I thought I'd give these a try to see if this method of hair removal would be easier or more cost effective (when compared to how much I'm paying for replacement razor blades). The box contains 24 strips and 4 or 5 individually wrapped wipes. The strips are pretty small and proved a little hard for me to use with my large man hands lol. I've used 12 of the strips and am still on the fence on whether I'll use the rest. The pain level is neither here nor there for me but the bending over for long enough to place the strips properly is just too much strain on my neck and shoulders. Yes, I bend over to shave also but the level of precision for shaving isn't nearly equal to placing a strip of wax in my nether regions. It's certainly a new experience and comes with a learning curve.

title: Exfoliating Face Wash
text: This face wash is okay. The consistency wasn't as thin as water, but it could have been a little thicker. Perhaps that is personal preference though. I did notice a slight stinging during and after use which I figure is from the exfoliation beads. The scent was okay, nothing special for me. This purchase comes with a pack of 2 face wash tubes and the price is decent but I don't see myself buying it again.

title: Beautiful Packaging
text: These bath bombs are a little smaller than I expected, but they work great. The scents included are very pleasing but not too powerful. The bombs arrive in an extremely nice box with a ribbon attached to the lid, making this very easy to immediately hand over to someone as a gift. Or if you want to break the set up and give one or two to multiple recipients (think stocking stuffers!) you can because each bomb is individually wrapped and labeled with its scent. Overall, a VERY nice set of bath bombs that I highly recommend!

title: OMG the scent!!
text: This rose water toner smells amazing!!! I'd love if they offered this scent in a perfume form! The toner applies easily and absorbs well. I use this every night right before I crawl into bed and my face doesn't stick to my pillow case or comforter.. and it is so smooth and a little brighter when I wake in the morning. My skin feels so clean and fresh after using this, I can't imagine skipping a night or using anything else!

title: Great kit for traveling!
text: This manicure kit is like the All-In-One set you've been looking for. It has everything you need to maintain nails on your hands and feet. The tools are sharp and precise and easy to hold and use and the case is a very nice blue and soft.. so soft that I must confess to "petting" it a little too much LOL!

title: Great masks!
text: These masks were easy to use and made my skin feel so smooth and look great! The cactus flower scent was amazing too. I will be buying more of these and suggest you give them a try if you're on the fence!

title: Great deal
text: These bath bombs are awesome. They arrive in a very nice, nearly gift wrapped box and each of the 24 bombs are individually wrapped and labeled - which makes giving a couple as gifts easy. The bombs themselves are smaller than what I am used to but they dissolve quickly and smell oh so good. Overall, I'm really impressed and highly recommend this set!

title: Durable and very long lasting
text: I purchased this and gifted it to my step-daughter back in November 2011.. she still uses it today! It still works like new and she says it wraps up and travels with her on all of her business trips. If this ever fails, I won't hesitate to get her another one. Good job Conair!

title: Good set of trimmers
text: This is a nice set of trimmers. They are sharp, work with little squeezing pressure and I like the multi-colored metallic color! They certainly stand out in my nail case, that's for sure!

title: Stripless waxing great for wimps with sensitive skin!
text: I love the results that waxing gives me but I am a huge wimp with a low pain tolerance. I came across these wax beads that claim to need to strips to remove and figured why not? They truly do work the way they say and with less pain and less irritation of my sensitive skin compared to my normal run of the mill waxing experiences. Bonus! If you're a fellow wimp I suggest you give these stripless beads a try.

title: Great for gifting and traveling
text: These Brilifled Refillable Perfume Atomizers are the perfect size for taking a little bit of your favorite perfume with you on the go! They are very pretty, easy to fill, are leak proof and would make great gifts (I'm thinking stocking stuffers!)! Highly recommend!

title: Wonderful masks!
text: These ReinPlatz Intensive Hydrating Blueberry Essence Face Masks are fantastic! They are extremely easy to use and my skin was so very soft afterward and the scent was heavenly! Plus you get a pack of 10 masks! Great deal!

title: Nice facial treatment
text: These [BACK AT ONE] Deeply Calming Tea Tree with Lemon Facial Sheet Masks are easy to use. I found the scent to be very subtle and the overall experience was relaxing and calming. My skin was noticeably smoother and softer afterward. I think these are a decent deal given you receive a box of 5 masks.

title: Soothing soak, but no pain relief
text: This set of 3 Hydrogen Peroxide Bath Epsom Salt pouches gave me a soothing bath experience. I poured one bag into my tub as it was filling.. the salt dissolved faster than other bath salts.. there was little to no discernible scent.. it rinsed out of the tub cleanly, leaving no residue behind.. but I did not note any pain relief after my soak. Overall, it was a pleasant experience, I appreciated the single pouch "serving" so I didn't have to use a scoop, but the cost is just too much in my mind for only 3 single use pouches. I will use the other 2 pouches but I don't think I'll buy this again.

title: I love it!
text: This Dead Sea Mud Mask is amazing! The mask was a little thick and took more time to spread than other mud masks I've used, but the results were fantastic! I know that mud masks can make a mess when you remove them, so I thought I would side step that problem by applying and removing it while soaking in the tub... bad idea. I applied the mask, let it dry and set for about 6-7 minutes and then rinsed it off. I didn't have any stinging or tingling, but I did feel a slight pull and stretch sensation -- a good sign that it's working. I rinsed it off and immediately realized my error - the mud didn't dissolve in water as much as my previous mud masks did. I ended up having to wipe my tub clean after it drained. LOL! But that was all my bad! Later that night as I was getting into bed, I noticed my face was the softest I have ever felt it! Amazing!!! So overall... I absolutely love this mud mask!! I have vowed to always have a jar! I'll just never take it off in the tub again LOL!!

title: Happy Hubby = Happy Life
text: I got this AXE Men's Body Wash for my hubby. He is picky and difficult when it comes to his hygiene products. I am happy to report that he is happy with these and pleased with the scent and results. Having received 4 bottles, I am happy that our hunt is over for awhile! A great deal and a happy husband has made this a great purchase IMO!

title: Easy tool that works
text: This Skin Scrubber, GUGUG Skin Spatula is easy to operate. The digital display is helpful to know the settings at a glance. It works pretty well at scooping all the gunk out of my face. This tool is so much better than squeezing and popping!

title: Great for thick, heavy hair!
text: I have extremely thick hair and I was getting tired of wearing it only in ponytails so I got some of these DRESHOW Adjustable Headbands in hopes of expanding my hair styling options. I am here to say that these headbands are a dream for me! Because my thick hair is so heavy, other headbands I've tried have simply fallen off my head since I was not able to tighten them. I even had a couple that were too tight and gave me severe headaches. But these!! These are fully adjustable allowing me to get a custom fit! They are quite comfy, and pretty, and I was able to wear one yesterday for close to 8 hours without it shifting, me having to adjust it or take it off and put it back on AND I had no painful headache! I'm sold! Thank you!

title: My fav perfume is now on the go!
text: I absolutely love this atomizer! I have never owned or used an atomizer before, so this was a new experience for me. My husband bought me a larger bottle of my favorite perfume and I have always wanted to be able to take it with me on trips. Now I can! This atomizer fills so unbelievably easily! I removed the cap from my full size bottle and lined up the bottom of this atomizer with the top of the bottle and just pressed down a few times and the atomizer was full. Now, this may be nothing special to others who have done this before but I found it fun to watch the atomizer tube fill up so easily. The atomizer slides into its case - which is quite nice. Again, I have nothing previous to compare this one to, but I think this one is just perfect. The outside is not real leather, but it looks very elegant. I am so very pleased with this and am already planning to buy a few as gifts in the near future!

title: Great adult sized cape
text: This is a nice sized cape at a very decent price. The neck adjustment fit my husband comfortably. Good product at a great price!

title: Flaky white mess
text: This Vanity Planet Ease Instant Lift Concentrate did absolutely nothing for me other than creating a white flaky mess that I had to clean up after. I saw no lifting at all. Perhaps it was just my experience, but I don't think the product justifies the high price tag on this one.

title: Sticky
text: I gave this LumaDrops Vitamin C Topical Face Serum two weeks to wow me. I'm afraid to say that, in the end, it did not. While the serum is not too thick or too runny and while it applied easily to my face, it did leave my face feeling slightly tacky.. even after allowing it plenty of time to absorb. I do have acne prone skin, even in my forties, so perhaps that was my skin's fault. Who knows. But since I didn't notice any changes whatsoever after two weeks of use, I have to admit that this products just didn't work for me.

title: Good mix of colors
text: This is a nice package of nail tape. You get a wide assortment of colors for the tape (tape that actually sticks, I might add!), the two dispensers and tweezers. Good quality and a fair price! I'm a happy camper!

title: Excellent set!!
text: This is the manicure set I've been looking for! It has every tool I could possibly ever need and the tools are great quality. The case is the nicest I've seen in my search.. it clips together perfectly, the outside is so soft to the touch and the navy blue color is very nice. It is most definitely worth every penny - and at its current price, it's a bargain! Absolutely recommend this set!!

title: Excellent for thick hair!
text: I have very thick hair and am always needing to be picky when it comes to hair products, including shampoo and conditioner. This Sultry Bronde formula from Pantene is one of the best I've come across in a long time! The scent is amazing, not overpowering and the consistency is a perfect balance, not to runny or too thick. Like I said, my hair is really thick so I am used to use a lot of shampoo to get a decent amount of coverage and suds going on - well, I should have started with a lot less my first time using this because I ended up using way too much and having to spend more time than normal rinsing it all out. So, on the next use I used about a half dollar size dollop and it was the perfect amount. Y'all, I've never used less than double that (or more!) of any shampoo. I always need more to get a good wash of all of my thick hair. So I am very impressed with the coverage, the scent and the long lasting fresh feel! I think I may be done with my hunt for the perfect shampoo for me! If you have thick hair, I certainly suggest you give this a shot!

title: Sharp & Precise
text: These Norchan Ingrown Toe-nail Clippers are *very* sharp which lends to their high precision. Extremely well made, high quality tools! Excellent value for what you get. The kit includes a mesh storage/travel bag which is very handy. It's a snug fit, but all the included pieces do fit inside.

title: Cheap, Quality Set
text:
I have been searching for the perfect cuticle and nail maintenance kit and decided to give this one a try. I am glad that I did. While it is not perfect, it is certainly very good!

This kit includes 1 cuticle trimmer, 1 cuticle pusher, 1 nail polish remover and 1 metal nail file and the set comes in a (somewhat) reusable clear plastic case/pouch and all pieces are finished in a kaleidoscope of metallic colors, making them stand out from the rest of your nail tools.

Usually in a set at this price point of less than $10, the tools are very blunt and malleable. I am very happy to report that this is not the case with this set! The cuticle trimmer comes with a tip protector and is surprisingly sharp! Also a nice size, not too small like similar trimmers tend to be, and operate easily without having to contort your hand or get a better grip every time you squeeze the handles. The nail polish scraper and cuticle pusher work as expected and the opposite end of the cuticle pusher is perfect for cleaning under your nails without any pain because, unlike others, this tool isn't so sharp as to make you wince in pain or bleed.

Bottom line... all of these tools work as intended, are lightweight and are priced well. The see-through, plastic "case" is very thin and I don't expect it to last very long. If you're in the market for a new set of manicure tools, I'd say go ahead and give this set a try because, with the money-back guarantee, you have nothing to lose!

title: Soothing
text:
Purchased this for my hubby.. here's his review as dictated to me (his typist, lol):

Right off the bat, I was not impressed with the packaging. This beard balm came in a small tin can (all fine) but there was absolutely no wrapping or outer seal on the outside. If that wasn't alarming enough, there was also no inner seal or anything under the lid. That is a little worrisome. However, the balm inside didn't appear to me to be spoiled. It smelled good and looked good so I used it. It has a nice consistency and a tiny bit of this stuff goes a long way.. I believe I'll have this tin until the day I die. The scent isn't too bad. It's not overwhelming. I'd say its tolerable which is a good thing since it's right under your nose. Overall, this beard balm is nice, soothing, not greasy and will, seemingly, last a lifetime.

title: This is a quality set
text:
Purchased for my hubby.. here's our review from his point of view:

I've never owned or used a beard straightener, so this was my first experience with one. Right off the bat, I noted the quality of the case. It is a nice presentation and, thus, would make a good gift to someone. Looks so nice, you wouldn't have to wrap it! I liked the 360 degree rotating cord, it heats up fast, controls are easy to use and the lights are easy to see. The manual was easy to understand and follow. The comb works okay but it doesn't separate the hairs very well. After brushing through my beard a bit, I decided I was done and my beard felt softer and a little straighter so I suppose this tool did its thing.

I passed on testing the included beard soap and beard balm so I have no comments on those.

A few things to note..
The beard protectant spray needs an adjustable nozzle. The mist was too broad. Even though I aimed at my beard, it sprayed my entire face.
Be careful when using this thing near your nose. I was brushing the hairs on my upper lip and the back of the straightener lightly touched the underside of my nose and it darn near seared me. So, just be careful. Maybe this is something a veteran user of beard straighteners knows to be careful of, but being new to this tool, I didn't know - even though I was taking it slow and had it set to a low heat setting. I figured I'd toss that out there in case another new guy reads this.
It takes a long time to cool off enough to put it back in the case. Again, I'm no expert.. my only experience close to this is with soldering irons and they cool off and can be put away faster than this thing. I guess that's not a big deal since you can just leave it out on the bathroom counter and put it away later.

Overall, I feel this is a high quality set.. from the case to the straightener itself.

title: Jury is still out...
text: I've been taking this for 2 weeks and I have had no noticeable changes in how fast or how long I fall asleep. I haven't experienced any negative effects, so I figure it isn't hurting anything to continue taking it to see if I get better (or any) results. If anything changes, I'll update my review but for now the jury is still out on this.

title: Great moisturizer
text: I don't like when products have an overpowering scent so I was quite pleased to discover that this water cream has next to no scent at all. It also absorbs quickly, takes a very little amount to cover my entire face and neck and it dries by the time I get into bed so I don't have to worry about it transferring to my pillow case. And by morning my face is so smooth! I'm very happy with this product and when it finally comes time to buy another jar I won't hesitate! (But that will be a long time in the future asna little dab on a fingertip usually I need so I see this jar lasting me quite some time.)

title: Heel tastic = Fantastic
text:
My husband's feet are terrible. I've been trying for years to get him t accompany me to get a pedicure. The rest of his feet aside, his heels are the worst! Since he refused to go with me and get a man's pedicure (I've tried to explain that the won't put polish on his toes 🤣) I've been buying all sorts of remedies to try on him that he's unwittingly become my guinea pig! I bought this Heel Tastic balm and I am extremely pleased to report that my hunt is over!!

This comes in what I can only refer to as a small deodorant stick or large version of Chapstick form.. you apply it by removing the cap, spinning the bottom to push the product up the tube and then rubbing it over your (or your hubby's) heels. Slip on some comfy socks and you're done! What I really love is that this product has no scent! So many others that I've tried have either a really potent tea tree oil scent or, for some odd reason, an obscenely over powerful lavender or lemony scent. Who wants their feet to smell like lemons??

Anyway... we (which means me) applied this Heel Tastic to my guinea pig's (which means my hubby) feet the night it arrived, had him out socks on, then we hit the hay. (I must mention here that socks aren't necessarily required.. but he is a very active sleeper and during our test runs of all previous foot products, we discovered that they would rub off and transfer to our sheets while he was chasing rabbits all night.. so socks it is! The product stays on his feet long enough to do their job and our housekeeper (which means me) doesn't have to do our laundry ever morning.) Anyhoo.. come morning, the socks were removed and his heels.. were.. smoother y'all! Not the perfectly just-scraped-buffed-and-polished by a pedicurist smooth 😆 but much smoother than the night before and that gave me hope!

So we tossed the other products in a drawer and continued to use Heel Tastic for a week straight. Y'all.. his heels look Heel Tastic now! There's still some cracks visible but this stuff isn't going to work every miracle. However it dd work one more miracle of freeing home ton of space by allowing me to throw away all the other stuff I'd tried! So if you need something for rough, dried out feet I'd highly, strongly, everything-ly recommend you give this Heel Tastic stuff a go! I doubt you'll have any regrets!

title: These glass files are wonderful!
text: The come as a set of 3 and each one has its own clear plastic storage tube. They work very well in both shining up your nail surface and filing and shaping your nail tips. They wash and rinse well and fit perfectly in their storage tubes - the are ever so slightly larger than the tubes, making you have to give a little guy to get them out, but that is a good thing as I rest easy knowing that if the end piece pops off the file itself won't slide out and get broken while in my purse or luggage (I'm looking at you, baggage handlers!). And finally, the price is *excellent* for what you get!

title: Glass files are so much better
text: than emery board files! They don't fall apart and they help maintain your nails health. They're also wonderful in helping seal nail polish strips, like Color Street, to your nail tips as the last step of a manicure. These files are a nice thickness, not too bulky as to be uncomfortable to hold and use and they come in a storage case. My only gripe is that the are all the same.. I thought I woukd receive a set of varying lengths but that is probably on me as I didn't read through the entire description before ordering. Aside from that, this is a great set of glass files that are comfortable to use, easy to clean and come with a nice storage pouch.

title: I used this to reseal Color Street strips
text: and it works really well! I place the unused strips left over after a manicure into the plastic pouch they come in and then use this hair straightener to seal the end of the pouch. So far it has worked as well has I expected it to. I have since purchased an actual resealer but at the time I couldn't find one (I had never needed one and didn't know what to look for) so now that I have a true sealer, this straightener will find its home in my bathroom (where it really belongs) 😂 But if you're in a pinch and find yourself with a plastic bag that needs to be sealed again.. this straightener will do the trick. 👍

title: Wouldn't recommend
text:
The case is nice until yiu go to open it. It is not easy to open one handed, as I assumed to be the case based on the pictures showing that it is similarly built to other manicure cases I have owned in the past. The case is also flimsy.. it doesn't like to close square. The tools are no where near sharp enough. I used the one with the curved too to try to clean out under my fingernails and it took way more passes than should have been necessary (my old one would clean my under nails in one swipe). Alao, while swiping under my nails, I noticed black specks appearing on my fingertips and under my nails... the black finish was coming off the tool! Not acceptable. And finally, cleaning under my nails is not exactly a tough job and I don't use very much pressure at all.. that being said, the tool was completely bent out of shape afterwards. I was able to bend it back into a mostly straight appearance, but it now looks wavy.

Bottom line... I would not and cannot recommend this set. Mine is going in the trash and I'll pick up a different, better quality set.

title: Good quality and great colors
text:
Ibgot these mostly to wear while I'm washing my face. I learned awhile ago that my head just doesn't like headbands.. they slip off the back of my head way too easily. And if I get some that are tight enough to stay in place, they become extremely uncomfortable after a short time. These are very comfortable, thick and made of some of the softest material I've touched. However, as expected, they do work their way away from my forehead and do end up just hanging on my ponytail. This is not the fault if the headbands at all - that's just my odd shaped head. These do work perfectly for what I purchased them for.. they hold all my hair, even the little ones around my ears and that frame my face, back and away while I wash my face! Perfect!! No more wet hair globbed on my cheeks!

Bottom line... These headbands are very colorful, have cute patterns, are thicker than others, have quite a bit of stretch, are VERY soft and comfortable to wear. So don't let me egg shaped head cause you to hesitate in purchasing them! 😂

title: Great Bag!
text:
This bag was much larger than I expected!! I love how the material is thick, but not so thick that it doesn't have a little give - it's got some give and flex that allowed me to stuff it into a suitcase and it kept its shape when I got it back out. It has an attractive design, the zipper works flawlessly for me and is large enough to store all of my color street nail cards with a bottle of nail polish remover and some cotton swabs.

Bottom line... this is a great bag for keeping small items or bottles organized when on a trip!

title: Nice storage bag!
text:
This bag is thicker than I expected, which is a bonus! It is large enough to store my collection of nail polishes, files, cuticle pushers and nail clippers. I have not dunked it into water, but it looks and feels like it would be waterproof.

Bottom line... a very cute small bag that is great for storing smaller items or using for your travel sized bottles when flying!

title: Fantastic cleanser.. But the cap won't close!
text:
This facial cleanser is nice. It has noticeable exfoliating granules (something other exfoliating cleansers claim to have but do not), it is on the thicker side which makes it easy to get spread on your face without it running or dripping from your fingers and it has a light, pleasant scent (no where near overpowering like some others). I was very impressed and ready to add it to my routine... but then I went to close the lid. The lid will not snap shut flush! It makes a small snap sound when I try to close it, but when I let go the lid separates from the tube just enough to cause me to think that it isn't air tight. Since a little of this cleanser goes a long way (as I discovered), that means I won't be able to use all of it before it dries up all because the lid won't close all the way.

Bottom line... This is an excellent exfoliating facial cleanser. But the lid won't close! I'm hoping this is because I was unlucky and simply got a dud lid.

title: Works but creates a mess
text:
I pamper the heck out of my feet and am always looking for new products to try so I was excited to get this foot file and try it out. It is light weight and the handle is just long enough to be comfortable to hold and use without being cumbersome or awkward. The file did smooth out my heels a bit but that's where the pros end. After using it, I noticed that while my heel was smoother, I could now see every crevice in my skin because the file had - in a sense - leeched black into every little crack in my heel. I also noticed tons of tiny black balls floating in the tub around me. The file had disintegrated during use.

Bottom line... The file is comfortable to hold and use and will help smooth out any calluses on your heels. But it will also come apart in the process. I'm not sure how long it would last before the black file portion is no longer rough, having shed completely.. but I will never know because I refuse to use it again. I just wish it didn't disintegrate because it is one of the nicest files I've used as far as weight, comfort and ease of use goes.

title: Too cumbersome
text:
First off, this manicure tool is very well made. The handle is smooth, unlike other similar tools, which feels good in the hand and on the fingertips. However, for me, that is the end of the good. The slanted edge is sharp (pro) but it is too slanted.. causing me to cut into the underside of my nails. Any position I tried to hold it in had the same result. I watched as tiny curls of shaved nail appeared from under my nail. I felt like the tool was too long for me to use comfortably. I had a tough time keeping the tip in place due to the weight and length. Perhaps it's just my hands and will work well for others, but I could not use this for more than a minute or two because my hand began to cramp.

Bottom line... It's a well made and solid tool. The slanted edge is sharp, but it is also too slanted. It's heavier than any other similar tool I've used, making it difficult to hold properly. It might work better if you were using it on someone else and not yourself.

title: Too Difficult To Use
text:
I chose this product based on the description and reviews. I pamper feet more than any other part of my body and I am always on the lookout for new products to try. This pumice stone bundle was a grave disappointment. I found the surface too rough and the handle too long. It was very difficult for me to use on my feet.. I ended up holding it on the back of the wood where the stone is cemented onto the handle. That was the only way I could manage it. It was also entirely too rough on my feet. My regular foot files are much more effective, weigh less and leave my feet quite smooth. This product left my feet just as rough as when I started.

Bottom line... I appreciate the use of natural pumice, the wood used is high quality and I like that it has a string to hang it in between uses. It is simply too rough and too long, making it extremely awkward to use.

title: No More Crick Neck
text:
This bath pillow is divine! It has two sections, a small upper pillow and a larger lower back support pillow. It also has 7 large suction cups, 2 on the small upper section and 5 on the larger lower section. I appreciate the large size of the suction cups as this only serves to increase the surface area they can stick to thus increasing the staying power once put into place.

My bathtub is positioned right up against the wall, meaning I have little to no head room when I recline (or try to recline) while in the tub. This causes me to have to crick my neck if I want to lean back and relax. Not anymore! This pillow makes reclining and relaxing possible for me! It also keeps my back from hitting the back of the tub itself which prevents that quick jolt of cold that I usually deal with.

Bottom line... I highly recommend this pillow! I will note that when placing the pillow in your tub, be mindful of where your suction cups are placed. I have a tile surround and the 2 suction cups on the smaller upper pillow did not want to stick at first due to the grout line in between the tiles. I had to reposition it slightly to one side and it then stuck into place without further issue. This will be my favorite bath accessory until my husband gives me a green light to remodel and get the jetted tub (with plenty of head room) of my dreams!

title: Actually works!
text:
Just so you know where I'm coming from ---- I'm not your average female. I don't (can't) wear makeup.. I don't get facials.. I don't use moisturizers.. I basically don't do anything with or to my face other than wash it.

I love these strips! I've never used anything remotely like them before so when I ordered them, I had no idea how to use them. But the description and other reviews piqued my interest. They have some of the best instructions I've ever encountered on just about anything. Clear, concise, to the point. A newbie to facial strips, I was able to apply them easily without any confusion on what the steps were and how to do them.

These strips are the perfect size for my nose. There are slits on the top and bottom of the strip making it infinitely easy to apply the strip and have it contour perfectly to your nose. I would imagine that the slits would allow easy application on just about any nose. Per the instructions, I applied 1 strip onto my just washed and slightly damp nose, left it in place for approx 15 minutes (and yes the instructions are on the nose (ha!) with the reference to the strip feeling like paper mache! I removed the strip, starting from the outside, working in.. I was a little apprehensive that the adhesive would cause discomfort, redness, swelling or possibly remove hair upon removal of the strip... but none of that happened. It came off quick, easy and painlessly.. and I immediately inspected my nose for any of the aforementioned anticipated afflictions, but it was unscathed by the experience. I then inspected the strip itself and.. wow. I am amazed at what all it had stuck to it! In fear of sounding disgusting, I shall only say that this strip pulled more out of my pores than I thought was in my pores!

Bottom line... These are quality strips. The instructions are superb, they apply simply, come off painlessly, do not pull any hair out and there was no residue, no signs of any kind, left behind on my nose to indicate that I had even just used a nose strip at all. AND they actually work as described! I will not hesitate to purchase another box (however, with the box I received having 42 strips (well, 41 now ha!) in it, I believe I am good for awhile!

title: Close but no cigar
text: I got this brush with the hope that it would reach my skull and work with my very thick hair. Unfortunately for me, it does neither. The brush has a really nice weight, not too heavy to make it difficult to use and raise over your head to brush your hair, but also not too light that you're afraid it's going to fly out of your hand mid-stroke. The bristles are as advertised.. quite thick and very stiff and hard and the bristles also seem to be set into the brush extremely well, so much so, that I would be surprised if they fell out - ever. Bottom line - I would imagine this brush will offer a long lifetime of servitude for someone without hair as thick as mine.

title: Smooth but pricey
text: I've been using these replacement blades for a few years now. I like how the shave is smooth, given the double lotion bars. They are extremely easy to remove and replace from the razor's handle. I just wish they weren't so expensive. I only purchase them when they are on sale or there is a coupon available.. then I stock up so I can make it to the next sale or coupon.

title: Gifted
text: I purchased this for my stepson for Christmas. He loved receiving it and before he left I got a chance to take a look myself. It is not too heavy or cumbersome to handle, charges rather rapidly in comparison to other shavers I have experience with and is not very loud when turned on. As for how it shaves, my stepson reports it is a smooth and closest shave he has ever had from an electric razor. He also reports that the procedure for cleaning it is simple and straight forward.

title: Nice scent, bad packaging
text:
I purchased this salt in hopes of relieving sore muscles due to my profession as a massage therapist. The bag arrived quickly via Prime two day shipping, however the bag was open in the box upon arrival. There was not enough damage or product lost to require a return or exchange. After inspection, I noticed that the salt had gotten into the track of the zipper closure. After several attempts to clear the track, I ended up pouring the entire bag into a Rubbermaid container.

The salts themselves smell wondrous. I usually prefer my lavender scented salts but this variety is a nice occasional switch up. They dissolve well when added to the tub water and my skin feels smooth afterward. Unlike some other salts I have previously used, this product does not leave my skin feeling oily or like I have a thin layer of wax covering me. Recommend this product if you are looking for a relaxing and clean experience.

title: Really holds up
text: I purchased this bolster on January 9, 2011 as I needed a second bolster while in school. This item has held up very well after over 2 years of use. It is just as firm and has retained its round shape as when I originally bought it and that is after using it with almost every client in school clinic and in my current practice. When I ever need to replace one of my bolsters or if I find a need for another one, I will not hesitate to purchase this one again.

title: Wonder Mud!
text: This stuff is awesome! I will never be without. I am a massage therapist and I get quite a workout performing my job. In place of getting massage myself, I turn to my jar of Jason Tea Tree Oil Gel. I soak in a steamy bath first then rub my shoulders and neck with this gel and then don my sleep shirt (so the gel will not rub off on to my sheets) and then settle in. The heat kicks in within a few minutes and is extremely therapeutic and relaxing. This gel is not too greasy and a little goes a very long way. I purchase one 4 ounce jar every 6 months - which makes it very cost affective as well. I recommend this product to my clients (and friends and family) all the time to use between their sessions with me and I have yet to hear anything back other than rave reviews and many 'thank you's'. This is my favorite at home remedy for sore, tired and achy muscles and my nightstand drawer will always have a jar of my 'Wonder Mud'!

title: Excellent Blow Dryer
text: I recently decided to upgrade my original classic pink Revlon 2 1/2" barrel because my hair is now shorter. The 'plus' is truly an upgrade and dries my hair in about 15mins flat. Looks like I went to the salon. Best investment ever!

Hair remains soft and curls are ready to catch into an adorable pony tail the next day. So easy. Love it!

title: Update -Apology- Great Product!
text:
I ordered too many of these!! As an Olay fan, I had never tried this product before.
Before I received the 2-Pack of this product, I ordered one for my 32 yr old daughter as we both have dark spots.
She received hers first, and hated it as it made her skin rough and break out. When she made me try it, I was horrified to have a SEVERE allergic reaction - swelling, redness, itching - HORRIBLE!!! Then it started to strip off copiously.
This took about 3 weeks to get under control and several trips to the dermatologist.
I look horrible in all the Christmas photos - how ironic, as I had wanted to look better than ever!!
I have always been a huge fan of Olay products and never had a problem before.
Now what do I do with 3 bottles of tone-correcting moisturizer?? I just wanted a great all-purpose moisturizer.
Not fair.
UPDATE:
I must apologize to Olay. After having been convinced that my severe allergy was caused by this Olay product, it turns out to have been caused by a new brand of Vit C serum. I've been applying a VitC serum with great results for years with no problem so did not suspect this one.
I deeply regret having been unfair to Olay in my earlier review.
Oops
In truth, the 7-in-one feels like sheer luxury!

Dry off and then apply the lotion where you need a tan. I apply it all over, except my face. I use the face tanning lotion for that. Avoid applying heavily on knees and other dry areas, or they'll turn super dark, as your drier skin will absorb too much of it. Tip: before applying the tanning lotion, apply REGULAR lotion lightly to knees, elbows and feet bottoms, then resume with the tanning lotion for a more even tan. I do this every time. Rub in vigorously and well. Be generous with the lotion and don't skimp. Remember, if you miss a spot, that area won't tan! Don't put on your clothes until you're dry to the touch (about 10 mins). In the morning, you'll wake up with a deep tan. Shower the lotion off before getting ready for the day.
