text:
For the record, I've only used it once so if anything changes in the near future, I'll be sure to change my review.

First of all, it came already charged so that was a surprise to me. It looked clean so I don't think it had been used and repackaged or anything, and I examined it really closely.

It shaved my legs very well. Not ultra-smooth like you'd expect from a regular razor or from waxing, but good enough to last a day or two depending on how picky you are about prickly legs. I think it did as well as I'd expect from an electric shaver. I tried it briefly on my underarms but my skin didn't agree with it--not tight enough maybe? I had no chance at getting it smooth that way so I just used a regular razor in the shower for my underarms.

It shaved my private area extremely well. No nicks or cuts. It pulled a little on the longer hair even after I trimmed it, but that was to be expected from something like this. It helps to go with the grain rather than against it at first. Overall, it did a very smooth job down there--the best I can get without waxing and without risking the Nair.

I wish that the charger had a cord rather than plugging right into the wall. My electrical outlets in the bathroom are horizontal rather than vertical. I figured out that I can still plug it in that way with the razor charging, but I think it probably puts stress on the little prongs that go into the razor so I probably won't do that again, but find another outlet somewhere else in the house.

It comes with a small white plastic-ish bag to put it in (the charger doesn't fit with it in there), so that was better than nothing which I was expecting.

So far, so good.

**Update 8/16/2016**

I came on Amazon to look for another electric razor since this one is almost dead. It barely keeps enough charge to do one full leg anymore. I was hoping it would last more than a few years. And since it looks like this is the "best" one you can get, I'm not sure if I'll buy another one or not.

title: 4c hair- you NEED this but be careful
text:
I have terribly flaky scalp and extremely thick 4c hair that goes down almost to my waist. I flat iron my hair every weekend never wear it natural.

The brush was very easy to hold! It was softer than I expected but still firm enough to get all the way to my scalp which I never can with my extremely thick hair. None of my hair got tangled into the brush as the brush is made of material that’s slippery enough to prevent this. It got deep into my scalp and got all the product buildup and flakes I normally miss. When blow drying my hair later, rather than seeing a rain of flakes that got trapped in my clean hair, I see some flakes but like 80% less! My scalp actually felt clean and there wasn’t any product buildup.

If your hair is thick and long like mine, however, or if you’re transitioning (different textures mixing together) or prone to tangling, be careful about how aggressively you rub the brush to your head as you may cause tangles. Same thing if you’re using a clarifying shampoo or a shampoo that tends to dry out your hair as less moisturized hair can be prone to tangling. It was nothing a good deep conditioner and a 2 minute finger detangle couldn’t fix for me, though. No tangles got onto the brush itself and it didn’t get trapped into the brush! The brush was very clean when I finished with it. It’s just the texture of our hair can be finicky if you manipulate our hair type too much.

title: Natural hair? Do it!!!
text:
As an AA woman with very thick, long, natural 4b/c hair that I flat iron every week for a professional white collar DO IT. I hate the cost. I need to use a lot of it to matter, but nothing can compare. When I use this, I can actually have defined curls almost like a very thick 3c. I never knew that was even possible! My hair flat irons faster, gets less frizzy, and stays straighter with the flat iron. And my hair is buttery soft. I like to skip deep conditioning because wash day takes long enough (I don’t get my hair done professionally during the pandemic because I’m afraid of covid so it takes hours to do every Sunday).

I’ve tried many deep conditioners that were highly rated for natural hair ranging from $5-$15, and frankly, none can compare!! I need to buy this in bulk because I go through the normal $25 container in about 3-4 washes. The second they make a cheaper alternative that comes close to this, though, I’ll switch based on cost. The leave in spray is pretty good too

title: Worth a try but don’t expect much if have thick natural AA hair
text:
Update- 4b/c hair. Works minimally but super fast compared to their 3 step line and very little fumes

Very watery product so easy to get it over every strand. It will burn your scalp a bit if it’s already irritated. I got a little on my arm and it started burning (nothing unbearable) within 2 minutes.

It’s very quick to put it in and blow dry your hair. My hair is almost to my waist and super thick 4b/4c. Didn’t expect much from the product.

After blow drying, it was straighter and more shiny than it normally was (but my curls remained before blow drying it). I put this on 5 days ago. I flat ironed it for 3 hours after to make sure I got every strand I could. I live in a very average climate. Not very humid. I haven’t encountered any rain either. Already the very thick part of my hair near the middle back is reverting and doing its kinky/coils thing. The edges are not straight. I don’t think I’ve saved any time doing my edges either because I attempted to quickly flat iron the front and edges before work and I don’t think it took fewer passes to do so.

The sections of my hair that were already heat trained due to flat ironing have improved. I see maybe a 30-50% reduction in frizziness. Minimal fumes unlike their 3 step program which choked me even when I did it outside. Also much quicker. Overall, assuming there’s no damage, I’d do it again, but I’d rather go to a hair salon and pay $300 for a blowout I know will last 4+ months and have the results I want versus $40 for something that makes it ever so slightly less frizzy and a bit more shiny

Oh and for my near waist length extremely thick hair, I needed about 1.75 bottles, so if your hair is very thick or very long, I’d get two to be safe.

title: REALLLY great for long, thick 4c hair
text:
Omg this...is...amazing! Okay, maybe not amazing but pretty great. I have an extremely sensitive scalp (tender headed) and 4C hair. Like, normally when I get my sew in taken down at the salon, I'm that grown woman fighting back tears when they comb my hair. Then the stylist will suggest that I get a relaxer or cut my hair shorter so it will be less painful. I've used the Denman brush before. It still hurt even on my best days. But, it hurt less than most combs hurt.

My hair is thicckkkkkkkkkk. It is also extremely long (like I'm 5'5 and it's all the way down to my belly button). I wear a sew-in for convenience because I hate dealing with my unruly hair. I had my sew-in a little too long because I was busy...okay more than a little but still. I knew it was going to be matted. I feared I'd have to cut it. This saved my life! It got the mats out and only hurt a little on the most tangled parts. It still takes an extremely long time to detangle. I've spent 5 hours detangling it but have stopped and started a lot. But, it's no longer an impossible task with my extremely long and thick hair. I was able to do it myself. I plan to bring this with me to all hairstyling appointments and ask my hair stylist to use it. The brush wasn't perfect. It didn't glide through as much as I would've liked without product, but it's pretty sturdy. I've had it for a week. I also would've preferred another color, but that's just me.

I will say, though, that it didn't seem to be as effective for my sister's 2/3 hair. She's mixed and has curly, medium sandy brown hair that's a lot thinner than mine. She's 8. I don't know if she was being dramatic because she knew it was a different brush, but she kept saying "ouch" even when her hair was wet with product. I noticed it didn't glide as well through her hair as a round brush. So, maybe it's better for afro tectures than for hair that resembles caucasian hair.

text:
Love it. Helps dry under extensions and will get you dry in no time. Couldn't do that with my old Gold N Hot dryer and just had to put up with sitting under there for 3 or 4 hours only to have my braids underneath be still extremely damp. It would take 2 days to air dry after sitting under the dryer for those 3 or 4 hours. Then I'd get a girl friend to causally sniff my hair or scalp to make sure I didn't get that mildewy old weave smell from hair that hasn't been dried.

The hinge is a little loud which sucks in an apartment when you open the flap to get under or exit the dryer though, but that's minor unless you're doing that constantly instead of just sitting under there.

Nice and portable. Sturdy. Not wobbly. I wheel it from room to room. Don't expect to be able to sit on your couch and dry your hair. I wish I could but it doesn't work like that without me contorting my body in weird positions. Expect to sit at a chair. I'm sure a nice Lazy Boy would work but I sit at my kitchen table.

This has saved my life when I get last minute job interviews and can't get a hair appointment or have too much school work to do to wait in the salon for them to finally start your hair 2 hours after your scheduled appointment and work on like 5 clients in between you. My hair comes out quite nice actually. Almost as nice as the salon. This dryer is better in my opinion than most salon dryers I've had to sit under which fail to dry underneath my braids.

Overall just make the investment if you can. I hesitated for a few months because of the price but am so happy I bought this!!!

I thought Cetaphil was supposed to be more "friendly" to various skin types, but I could not see someone sensitive to scented products using this. I am a man with slightly oily skin who was looking for an alternative to using benzoyl peroxide wash. The scent lingered on my beard and skin, which would have been fine if it had been more neutral.
As far as how well it washes, I noticed no significant difference from any other soap I've ever used. It was just soap. I was expecting a feeling of "healthy" skin after using it for a while. If you have success using this product, go for it. For people new to this wash, I would try a SMALL bottle before buying larger quantities. I cannot recommend this product; it is simply too strongly scented with no noticeable benefit over other plain soaps.

title: HIGHLY RECOMMEND
text:
I recently went dark auburn. I wanted something for in between so I wasn't coloring my hair every two weeks to keep the red vibrant. I read reviews and I saw that this was comparable, even better in some cases to overtone, which I have used for different colors in the past and was pleased with. So, I decided to give this a try! I had a hard time deciding between the red and the merlot. I went with merlot for a bit if the darker aspect. I made the right choice for what I was wanting!
Here is how I did it:
I wet my hair. I leaned over the shower and used my detachable shower head to quickly wet it.
I then put the clenditioner all over and combed through with a wide toothed comb.
I let it wet for 20 minutes in a hair clip before washing it out. I didn't use shampoo afterwards, just conditioner.
It worked perfectly!
I wore gloves. It didn't stain anything in my shower, my comb, or my skin on my face or shoulder but I had a class reunion I was going to right after and didn't want to chance it! I dont think it would have stained them but I can't say for sure until I try without gloves.
The product goes on wet hair SO EASILY. it spreads so easily and feels like it melts into your hair. Be sure and comb it through.
The smell is nice.
I 10/10 recommend this!

To put on, I put my finger at the start of the part and match that to the top of my forehead. I clip the front and then the back. (2 clips in front and 1 in the back.) the Clips hold well. I add the headband and make sure to fix bangs and side hair. I then brush the topper to smooth it all out. I’m all set and out the door.

I have thinning hair so I wore it to Christmas dinner and oh my goodness I had so many compliments and no one suspected it was a topper. They all insisted it was the right look for me with my new haircut with bangs 😉

I have a small head and even with the adjustable elastic on the tightest setting, I still don’t think it is enough to secure it properly.

it has two clips as well to secure it. I still will need bobby-pins to secure as well.

Synthetic-so does tangle easy. With A little brushing, it looks so pretty.

title: Great little trimmer.
text:
I got this to replace an old trimmer and it is a great deal. There are three different sizes for the trimmer itself depending on the size of the area you want trimmed. One can be used for ears and noses and the middle one is perfect for my beard. I haven't found a use for the larger one yet but if the dog keeps shedding, I may fine a use for it.
There are a bunch of attachments, but the middle sized trimmer has an adjustable comb that has 5 different positions. That'a about all I use. I like the size and heft of the device, it feels sturdy in my hand and is easy to maneuver.
The pouch is a bonus if you want to take this on the road. I was able to put the charger, trimmer and the attachments I use into the pouch and still have room.
It also seems to hold a charge very well. I used to keep the old one plugged in all the time, but with this one I just charge it once every couple of weeks. My only slight issue is the lack of a charging indicator. Normally there is a light that goes from red (charging) to green (charged), but for this trimmer you just plug it in and let it charge overnight. I'm not sure it is necessary or even very helpful since leaving it charge overnight seems to do the trick.
Update: three years later it stopped working. I called Wahl and talked with a real person who sent out a replacement. They were very nice and sent a whole new kit. Outstanding customer service.

When I shampoo and condition with this, then just fluff my hair around and let it air dry, I end up with the kind of hair I like best (given what my hair is capable of): it’s in shiny waves (or, when it’s humid, loose ringlets). The fuzzy, cotton-candy, messy look I’m not as happy with is rare for me now.

Some reviews complain about the scent, but I actually really like the scent. (It also fades quickly after your hair dries.) Others have said that the product builds up over time. I’ve been using this for a couple of months now every day, and I haven’t noticed any problem yet. But I’ve read that you can use certain kinds of shampoo to get silicone out of your hair if it builds up.

I couldn’t be happier with these products. They have made a real difference for me.

title: Worth Every Penny
text:
Expensive, but the very best self tanner I have ever used. It goes on quickly and easily, and the results look completely natural. My pasty legs now look great without pantyhose.

A couple of tips:

Skip the costly exfoliating product they sell separately and simply use your own loofah or buff puff or similar item in the shower. Definitely shave and exfoliate well before you use the product. Do not use Dove or any oily soap.

Skip the mitt they sell separately and buy yourself a box of 100 disposable latex gloves. I think the product goes on better – and with a lot less waste – when you use disposable latex gloves. Using the gloves also eliminates the possible problem of hard-to-remove stains on the palms of your hands.

Very important: use a bit of a light moisturizer on the tops of your feet, the anklebone area, and the tops of your hands/fingers at least five or 10 minutes before applying the moose. Use a paper towel to take off any excess moisturizer. Do not use a moisturizer that contains heavy oils. Using a light moisturizer (I use Lubriderm) and allowing a few minutes for it to sink in makes hands and feet look natural. If you don't do this, there is a chance that there will be strange – looking darker areas on parts of your feet or hands.

The directions say to apply generously. I have not found this to be necessary. The most important thing is to make sure that you spread even a very thin layer of the mousse everywhere. Even if it looks streaky at first, it will not after you gently wash off the tanner after the required time. By using a thin layer, I get many uses out of one 8 ounce bottle, and I've never had streaks.

To extend the life of your tan, skip shaving for a day or two afterward if you can't get away with it. Also, I find it very helpful to use Jergins 3-Day Day Glow, a much cheaper (and more gradual) product, after each shower every day between my applications of St. Tropez. The Jergins product on its own does not give me the desired result, but using it between applications of St. Tropez extends my "tan" very effectively and economically.

Don't worry if you go to bed after initial application, before it is time to wash off the tanner, and get a little bit of brown staining on your sheets. It washes out completely. But – do not sit on good upholstery with skin contact during the initial application period! However, after you wash off the tanner, your "tan" will no longer transfer to anything. The Jergins product, should you decide to use it to extend your tan, does not stain anything at any stage in my experience.

With that one cracking it gave me a good idea on how removal would go. I soaked for about 20 minutes in pure acetone and it dissolves nicely. I used gel polish removal tools to clean what little was left on the nail and there was no damage to my mail from the whole process. I was pleasantly surprised with how nicely it came off. So I guess the clippers causing a problem helped me see soon in that removal is smooth.

The tips seem strong. Ive never done this application process before, I’ve only ever done false nails using the standard nail glue. I tugged on the nail and it was definitely secured on my nail. I applied a gel polish after and the polish went on nicely as it has with other false nails. I just need practices with applying while the nail is already on my finger. So don’t judge any of this by my horrible paint job lol

I’m glad I got this kit. I’ve had this first application on for 3-4 days and none of them have budged. Usually I’m gluing at least one nail back on by now. I do hope they last at this strength. I’ll try them longer next time. I wanted shorter nails at the time I did these ones.

It takes getting used to for the application but it wasn’t too bad for the first time. I may try nail clips in the future to help hold down for the light. I definitely like the little light for this since it is one nail at a time and it allows for me to hold the nail while it starts to cure.

title: Use with caution and good ventilation
text:
Be careful to use sparingly & in well ventilated room. This powder contains SILCA which is essentiall chalk dust. It's very absorbent but you can breathe it into your lungs and it's really dangerous. I learned the hard way when I was using it one winter and my new forced air furnace ductwork wasn't properly balanced. What was happening was the intake was sucking in the excess powder from the bathroom then what wasn't absorbed by the furnace filter was being blown back into the air inside the house so we were breathing microscopic particles of drying dust. Inside of about a month my dog started going blind from the excess drying of her eyes and I developed a severe cough that took months to get rid of and required inhalation therapy.
I was fortunate because I had an Ionic Breeze air cleaner and when I went to clean it, I discovered it was completely covered with this dry, white dust. It was SILCA from the Gold Bond Body powder. We could have become much sicker if I had t noticed this. I had the furnace fixed as it needed to be properly adjusted and it has worked fine for 5 years now.
I actually loved the product but be careful. Do NOT use this on BABIES or on your bedding as they suggest.

text:
The right size I thought they would. Just got them off my porch and there wasn't any pictures so here ya go haha. Product delivered as described! I wanted these over something battery operated, because that's not exactly environment friendly and a face washer with that charges instead of interchangeable batteries means one thing, limited life. These seemed like my best shot and 5 for $7.99 was worth trying. These are soft which I love, because I have sensative skin. I am gonna try them, but having sensative skin after 27 years I can tell when I'm gonna love or hate something. Plus they're silicone so you can boil these to sanitize.

Update: these bad boys work. I actually dedicated the pink one to my legs for exfoliating before shaving. I also use the "my Billie" razor and I have come lick (grows in odd directions) leg hair. Billie razors got it close, but this topped it off.

I also use two different facial skin care routines everyday for my cystic prone skin and I've been choosing these over my chemical exfoliator, because these do a good job and are more gentle on my skin. I also have pitted scaring and on a small level I've noticed a slight improvement with my less pitted scars. If you're using these daily I'd say do it at night more specially if you're like me and prewash your face for your medicated washes. After a week of doing it twice a day I was...uh...shiny...too shiny.

If you do a lot of constant work with your hands like a job or you craft a lot and are starting to experience pain in your joints maybe something slightly larger would work better for you. I'm 27 and have done just about everything you could constructively do with my hands and I have had a slight bit of pain some days from holding them. My hands have been this way for years, I've always tried to be handy, so that's not a big bother for me right now seeing as I can still use them.

Silicone isn't like other similar materials, because it doesn't have tiny microscopic holes in the material like plastic does. That being said these clean easily so if you're storing these in your bathroom wash them before every use so you're not putting unnecessary bacteria on your skin. Anyone who doesn't leave their toothbrush in,the bathroom knows why.

They are thin so if you're hands are worse than mine please explore your options, because price isn't everything if you can't use it. My mom, who's always been a hard worker, and is in her 50's has no issue holder the one I gave her either, but if that's a concern for you it's something to think about. They're not thin to the point of being useless I've been using medicated washes on mine for almost two months and they're holding up just fine.

Like all liquid products, you cannot smudge this product. If you want a smudged out line, stick to typical pencil/crayon style liners. title: OK not perfect.  VERY WATERY
text:
I was thrilled when I picked this product up. I've had it about 3 weeks. I've used it under foundation as a primer, mixed with foundation, and as a highlighter on top of cheek bones. Works well as primer - although if I apply too much foundation, it masks the glow. Product is very white and I feel makes my whole skin tone look a little lighter. OK mixed with makeup - very watery and thins my foundation a lot so not as much coverage which is OK for more casual look. NOT good as a highlighter in strategic places. If I use it to highlight my cheeks or brow bone... it is so watery it "washes off" my foundation. It is very watery. Recently the product has "separated" it comes out of the tube part water, part oil, with white flecks in it. GROSS and unusable. If I shake it vigorously it is a little better. But it is still very watery and somewhat separated. I've read other reviews on the net of others saying same thing. Product has not been exposed to heat or anything. Not sure.

I will say the glow that it gives is pretty - very pearly and soft NOT glittery or overdone at all.

title: Great product!
text:
This definitely game my lips a fuller appearance - especially if you also apply some just outside your lip line. My bottom lip is quite full but my upper lip could use a boost and this product does the trick. I wear a long lasting lip stain and then up this clear gloss on top and it works wonderfully. It is a VERY shiny gloss. It smells great (like red hot cinnamon), tastes great, and I like the texture very slick. Some glosses are sticky and this one is not.

As far as the sensation, it does NOT hurt. Its more a warm sensation like you get when eating salsa. The sensation goes away after 5 minutes. I would say the fuller look lasts 2-3 hours.

This product works by irritating the skin. So don't wear it 24/7. Don't apply to chapped or cracked lips. I haven't had any problem with this product harming my lips. I usually put some lip balm on before I go to bed anyway (even before I purchased this product).

I would buy it again.

title: BURNS so badly!!!  And I DON"T have sensitive skin.

I can't imagine what this would feel like on a person with sensitive skin. I was really surprised. I usually think of Neutrogena as a good brand. I have other of their products that I like.

There are so many other SPF moisturizers without irritating ingredients. I would highly recommend trying something different. Check Beautypedia for a list.

title: Game Changer for Caregivers!!!!
text:
My son, my sweet sweet fella... legally 25, cognitively around 2.... and he's tiny - maybe the size of an 11 year old. EXCEPT
FOR THE FACE FUR 😫 He has moderate tactile issues in regards to his face being touched; unless he's sound asleep, he flinches and pulls away and can become agitated if I even do that 'mama stroke', where I lightly caress his cheek with the back of my fingers. So you know that shaving is a NIGHTMARE. Throw in the fact that he's a bit of a 'wooly booger', has 5 o'clock shadow within 12 hours of being shaved, and he's quite literally just the epitome of a shaving challenge. And quite frankly, being a 'sandwich' caregiver (adult GenZ child and Boomer parents), I'm too exhausted to wrestle an agitated bear for a mediocre shave. He walks around looking like an 11 year old with a beard half the time.

Saw this as 'Suggested for You' and figured why not; I'll spend more money I don't have on something that doesn't help me. EXCEPT IT TOTALLY HELPS ME!! I'm still a little shocked. He's not happy and it's not easy, but this little 'shazor' isn't horribly loud, it's quite easy to grip and handle one handed while I move his head (usually slumbering because it's just easier if I can that way) and it gives him a close shave. I will say I've yet to price the replacement blades but I can tell they will not last him long, maybe a half dozen shaves at best. He's got super fine head hair but that face fur is like steel wool... and not the 0000 kind. I'll just have to live with the cost of replacement blades, because I do like when he wakes up first thing in the morning, all smiles and giggles and wanting to snuggle, and he's looking like a sweet little fella and not some tween werewolf.

title: Used it as an extreme tint/toner to get rid of red undertones
text:
I'm 51. Haven't seen my natural hair color - not more than 2.5" during pandemic, anyway - since I was 19. My natural color is such an extreme ash, it's literally not even a color it's just ash. If 'light charcoal BLONDE' was a color, that'd be mine. And weirdly enough, adding any bleach to my unique natural color would always bring out the red that apparently hides deeeeeeeeeep within (from my daddy's sisters, both redheads). I've used all the toners, all the hair colors, embraced the reds, desperately tried to remove them with every product sold in salons, salon suppliers, Sally's, etc. had every shade of blonde from platinum to dark ultra ash, several shades of brown, you name it. My hair has definitely been good to me, never leaving me no matter how much I abused it 😅 But I am at that stage in my life where I just want to embrace natural color before it turns silver and white. My current color was the dark blonde, very close to my natural color except no amount of product was taking the red out and restoring the world's ashiest ash.

Note: I was nervous and some parts of my hair didn't get left on as long as others. BUT I am so so so so so so happy!! I believe this is as close as it will get while I leave it to grow out now. I did add 1:1 water to the developer, to lessen any bleaching. Again, I was attempting a tint/tone and not a color.

Scent is typical of any other box color, still floral just not as yuck and heavy as others.

title: The Holy Grail in face wash
text:
I'm a GenX girl... we've used everything short of battery acid to wash our faces over the years, especially those of us with acne prone skin. In the 32 years I've been 'adulting' I've gone from oily skin to oily/normal combination skin to normal/dry/really dry combination skin. I still get acne - all kinds, even the occasional seborrheic volcano (acidic foods + stress + hormones). I finally figured out about 10 years ago that the drier and tighter my face was after cleansing, the worse I broke out. I thought I needed acne face wash and moisturizer, but that has never really fixed anything. I've used everything. EVERY. THING.

I saw a dermatologist on TikTok recommend this. So I thought 'why not'. The very first time I washed my face, I knew... like, KNEW knew... this is 'The One'. I have one of those 14x magnification mirrors and there was absolutely no residual (missed) makeup in a single pore. And, strangely, my face felt... normal. No tightness, no greasiness. I almost forgot to use my moisturizer after washing, my skin felt so bizarrely... balanced of moisture, maybe...

Anyway, I truly wish I'd known about this product 20, 30 years ago. I'll update when I've used it longer to comment on how it affects my ornery acne, but I honestly have a really good feelin mg about that aspect, too.

title: They're awesome... for ~4 months... 2nd set, so not a fluke
text:
With a severely autistic son who REFUSES haircuts, these were a gahdsend... for about 3 months the first time and about 4 months the second time. The problem is that the battery is, apparently, absolute garbage. They charge up well, they hold a charge well, until you notice (and it took 2 pairs of these clippers for me to see that it is a pattern) they just don't anymore. That is a situation that gets a little worse every time... like they have a pre-determined number of charges that they're gonna take then BAM! they've just stopped. Each time you charge them, the charge lasts a little less. For example, the first full charge, the clippers didn't need charging again for about 10 days (I clip my son, and my Dad sometimes will come around for a trim). By the 3rd charge the battery lasted about 6-7 days between charges. By about the 5th or 6th charge, the light will blink red [indicating battery is almost depleted] within about 3 minutes of turning on the clippers.)

I'd still buy the clippers at this price if I had to put my own rechargeable (or even disposable) batteries in and that would give them a few years of life. I would still buy the clippers at this price if plugging them in would make them work when the battery croaks. I'd pay double if the battery was guaranteed for 3 years.

Sadly they're a waste of money the way they're currently [not] working, with a 4 month or less lifespan. I give 2 stars rather than 1 because I did get about 8 haircuts out of them and I feel cheap (I'm poor not cheap - lol) complaining about haircuts costing less than $3.50 each.

title: I won't buy anything else!
text:
I'm a solo parent. Stay at home mom of an adult, disabled, medically fragile kid. Full time house mom. In other words, I look like I sound - exhausted, stretched for time, priorities not the same as they used to be.... I don't have time for watching YouTube or TikTok and learning how to do 273 steps for perfect 'smoke and mirrors' on my face. I just need to not look like I'm exhausted and given up on life (joking... a little) when I want to put on makeup. I want coverage without caking. I want easy peasy, fast, reliable product.

This is that.

After my shower, I use my moisturizer, then a quality primer, then the Bisque or Summer Bisque. I just apply to any acne spots with a concealer brush then use my powder finishing brush to lightly apply to the rest of my face. It is a full coverage concealer that I use as a foundation, yes. It gives decent color and fantastic coverage. It doesn't break out my ridiculously sensitive skin and it doesn't look cakey or thick. I have found that using a finishing spray helps set it for longer, keeps it from settling in allllllll my lines (my words say 'twentieth anniversary of my 30th birthday' but my skin says '50 and she got in tanning beds in the early 90s').

My only qualm with this product - and I'm guessing it's something they cannot do anything about because of the ingredients - is that it doesn't come in a tone that suits more porcelain complexions. Because in winter my color is like that kid from that old movie 'Powder'. Or 'Casper' and makes blending a bit of a task.

Put it in a scrunchy on top of my head, put an old brown microfiber pillowcase on my pillow, and sleep on it. The next day, I 'wash' my hair with very little shampoo, rinse, condition, etc. and my hair feels a little better every time. Two weeks ago it felt like literal hay straw. If your hair is even a little thickish or you’ve put any amount of hair between the ‘barrels’, then you press even a little for a few seconds, you can feel the give in the plastic handle. HERE’S YOUR DESIGN FLAW, REVLON!! The handle should have been spring-loaded in my opinion, so that you press the handle to open the ‘barrels’ and insert your hair, which takes maybe 5 seconds, as opposed to pressing the handle to clamp and wave the hair, which - if your hair is like mine - can take 20 to 30 seconds. 4 to 6 times as much pressing (and I’d guess at least double the pressure to just opening). If, in the design process, they found that a spring-loaded handle handle wasn’t possible, then the handle should have been silicone coated metal. BUT I stand more firmly on the spring-loaded option: In a day and age where carpal tunnel is becoming more common due to handheld device usage, I’ve found my carpal tunnel creeps in while having to clamp and hold my hair for the 20 to 30 seconds per section. I didn’t even get 1/3rd of the way finished when the beyond awful numbing and über uncomfortable pins and needles set in my right hand. REVLON needs to reevaluate their design pronto... unless they’re just counting on the bad design for more sales(?). 3.5 STARS ROUNDED UP TO 4 because I don’t know how long it will take til this sucker does break. My curls held really well, which is usually impossible for beyond a day and the ones that didn’t hold are in the back, from when my carpal tunnel had taken over and I was ready to be done.

title: THE BEST
text:
After doing the whole tanning bed/sunning phase in my 20s, I found myself at 38 years old having a huge basal cell carcinoma removed from the top of my butt crack...the scar made my b/c look like it was 2 inches taller. At 40 I had a second huge basal cell carcinoma refused from my left butt cheek. I *never* laid in the sun naked, just the tanning bed, FWIW. At 44 I had a blue nevus with melanoma 'spindles' removed...it literally wasn't there and then 3 days later it was there on my shoulder. I honestly wouldn't have found it if I hadn't been using my Fake Bake Flawless Darker. So, theoretically, self-tanning can save lives :) I started self-tanning several years ago and have used Tan Towels, generic tanning towels, Jergen's lotion, and Jergen's foam. I caved and bought Fake Bake Flawless two years ago, started using it during the end of winter so I could figure out how to apply for a truly flawless finish before summer arrived (with built in bronzer it is possible to streak). I've gotten my application (whole body) down to under 10 minutes. I've learned what works best for me: On Sunday evening, when I take my shower, I shave and I use a Scotch Brite scrubber (that's right, those green kitchen scrubbers...laugh all you want, but they are THE BOMB and so much cheaper than body scrubs!!!) to wash myself with a good moisturizing body wash. I get out, towel dry, use my towels to cover where I'll stand on the floor (overspray is inevitable), mitt up, spray the mitt, start from the feet and work my way up. I can do my entire body except the center of my back. I rub and rub and rub each section until it is obviously dry before moving on to the next section. I wear loose clothes to bed. With the FB Flawless Darker I can go longer between re-application (necessary after a week but I usually do after 3 days, just without applying as many pumps of the spray for maintenance applications) and the color is crazy good. Whereas my natural tan was a sort of beige tan, this is a bit warmer (though not scary Kardashian bronze). I love, love, love this stuff!!!

UPDATE: Something I may not have mentioned above that, I think, is important (as far as value) is that I should note that I am legit Casper white. My Ancestry says I’m 84% British and 15% Other European. I’m WHITE white. I can actually use the Flawless Darker and look okay, not like “Whoa, that girl is CLEARLY not really that dark.” It looks that natural. ANNNNNNNNDDDDDD because I am soooooo lacking of color in real life, I can apply my layer of FB Flawless Darker, allow it to ‘set’ for 24 hours before I shower (some inexpensive brown microfiber sheets have been a must - lol) and I will have some semblance of a tan, starting with Miss Hawaiian Tropic and fading to ‘normal Anglo chick with a light tan’ for nearly two weeks. That’s value. Not just in $$ but in time (though, honestly, it takes me about 8 minutes to do everything from my jaw down. I’m just lazy and would rather say it’s a timesaver ;P )

Yay!

title: If you have dermatillomania (sp?), you need these....
text: I pick my cuticles and just peel, peel, peel away.  (That scene in Black Swan ain't no joke!  People really do that.  Thank God I don't peel the tops of my fingers.)  There are no real treatments for dermatillomania other than behavior modification ($$$$$$ or your first three offspring is the going rate for that) and the suggestion of using acrylic nails.  For some reason acrylic nails do help me a good bit; I would say I pick 60% to 70% less on average.  There's something about putting on an acrylic nail that makes the picking less (whatever - picking is not pleasurable or comforting, but there's really no right word.  We don't pick because we want to just like those with eating disorders, or alcoholics, or drug addicts don't have their vices because they want them.  It happens and in it you find that "control" that you need in that moment and you're hooked.  It sucks! It really, really is gross!! It just sucks!!!) Anyway these nails help more than anything else.  So, why 4 stars instead of 5, you ask:  The color isn't as pretty pink on my lily white skin as I'd hoped; it's almost an 'electric rose'.  Kind of hooker-ish for my tastes.  (Nothing against hookers, they just have a more outgoing color-scheme preference to mine).  I had hoped I wouldn't have to paint them, but I do as a matter of personal preference.  That isn't necessarily anything I'd deduct a star for; I did deduct a star because I find that once I cut these down to my desired length (just beyond the tips of my fingers) and then file them to my desired shape, they do break/crack and then peel very easily.  Perhaps that's because I just glue mine on, cut, shape and leave 'em.  Maybe you absolutely are supposed to put the acrylic gel on top every time and so my deduction of a star is unfair.  If that's the case I apologize to whomever may be offended by my deducting a star.  BTW:  You have to get the Bondini glue that's sold on Amazon.  It makes the beauty supply store/monster-mart glue look like a joke.

title: Makes Shaving More Comfortable
text:
I normally use electric razors for the bulk of my shaving. But then, I invariably finish up the job with a hand, disposable razor so that my shave is complete. I have tried lots of disposable razors with mixed results and one of the best is Schick Hydro 5 Disposable Razor for Men with Hydrating Gel Reservoir.

These disposable razors come three in a pack. They feel light, but the handle is easy to grip so there shouldn’t be any slippage while you shave. The razor has five blades to help get the job done quickly. Five blades are more than what you find in the typical disposable razor. It might seem unnecessary, but it does get the job done.

One of the best features of this disposable razor is the lubrication strip. Lots of disposable razors have them, but the one here lasts much longer. And since I only use mine for touch- ups anyway, I can get a lot of mileage out of a single razor. Oh, and there is even a flip- up trimmer! When was the last time you saw something like that on a disposable razor? Likely never.

Shaving is part of the daily grooming routine. You should do what is necessary to make this part of your life as trouble- free as possible and Schick Hydro 5 Disposable Razor will help you in this regard. The lubrication strip and multiple blades make shaving as easy and comfortable as possible. The cost a little more but it’s easily worth the small investment.

title: Good, Pure Shampoo and Conditioner
text:
Hair care isn’t super important to me, and that is because I don’t have enough hair to matter much. But hair care is a big deal to the ladies in my home and knowing that they are always looking for new and better ways to shampoo and condition their hair, I decided to try this Club Roots Rice Water Shampoo and Conditioner set.

These bottles utilize a pump delivery system. It can take time to get the pumps to pop up, so that you can use them. I just kept twisting until they finally popped. The tops of the pumps lift off easily, so don’t pull them thinking it will pop and be ready to use. You will end up pulling it right off if you do this. Just keep twisting and apply pressure and it will eventually pop.

The shampoo that comes with this set has no scent and the most unusual quality about it is that it’s very thin. It’s only slightly thicker than water, so you need to be careful when you pump. But for something so thin, it does produce a good deal of lather. And it rinses clean with minimal effort. With the conditioner, the most interesting fact is how it stays on your hair. I pumped out some of the thick, white conditioner, spread it on my hair, and noticed that when I looked at my hands, they were completely clean! With other conditioner products, you expect to see bits of conditioner stuck to your hands, but that doesn’t happen here.

With the conditioner sticking to your hair so well, I was afraid it would be difficult to rinse out, but it’s not. It rinses out easily and cleanly. My hair felt soft and smooth after using these two products. I can thus vouch for the quality. But I am having a tough time with the price of this set. I guess if you want a pure shampoo and conditioner, free from unwanted ingredients, it may be worth the investment.

I don’t fret much about hair care, but the ladies with whom I share a home do and they very much like this shampoo and conditioner set from Club Roots. If you can get past the price tag, you will probably like it, too.

title: Great Idea for Those who Travel
text:
Anyone who travels knows the importance of taking certain personal items with you. The problem with many personal items of a liquid variety is that you can end up losing them at airport security. That is, unless the containers are small enough to meet security requirements, like this set of travel bottles from Beveetio.

You get a total of 15 different containers with this package set. There are five small bottles with screw- on caps, perfect for things like shampoo and conditioner. Plus, you get a spray bottle and pump bottle and even a handful of small containers for gels, lotion etc. The set even includes labels you can add to the containers so that you don’t forget what is what.

I can’t count the number of times I have had items confiscated at airport security and that is why a set like this is so useful and practical. I normally buy the small sample sizes of personal items from the store when I travel, but this option is better and far more economical. I already have plenty of these items already in my bathroom. With this set of small containers, I just make my rounds, fill them each up, and I’m ready to go.

I like the extra attention to details with this set, too. One cool feature with the pump bottle is that you can lock the pump so that it doesn’t accidently squirt while it’s in your luggage. The containers don’t leak either, at least they haven’t yet, and they are squeezable, making it easy to dispense. About the only thing missing from this set is something to dispense toothpaste. I suppose you could use one of the small cream jars for toothpaste and then use the included trowels to scoop it out, but toothpaste is messy/sticky so I will continue to just buy a small travel size tube at the store.

Personal items make travel more enjoyable. Don’t get caught at airport security with a too- large bottle of your favorite lotion, shampoo, or other personal item. Use these small containers from Beveetio and you will be safe and secure.

title: Fresh Scent and Good for My Dry Scalp
text:
Shampoos are generally not something I think much about. I don’t have as much hair as I used to, my hair is fine, and my scalp is dry. So, about the only thing that matters to me is a shampoo that will not make my scalp any drier. One that helps add thickening is also good. Thus, I thought it would be a good idea to try this Maya Mari Biotin Keratin Strengthening Shampoo.

Packaged in a large, pump activated bottle, this shampoo has a fresh scent that most anyone will find agreeable. The pump action is a little slower than I like- it takes multiple squirts and the pump is slow at bouncing back up, so that you can press it again. Anyway, no biggie overall and the shampoo is good from these perspectives.

As for performance, this shampoo does well on my dry, fine hair. My scalp doesn’t feel dry after using this product, so that is a positive. I can’t say that it is helping my hair look or feel thicker, but I don’t take claims like this too seriously. When your hair is thinning the way mine is, you need a special hair restoration product if you want the level of results I need.

Shampoo choices matter quite a bit for those who have a ton of hair, curls, coarseness, etc. They don’t matter as much for someone like me, but I still take my choice of shampoo at least semi- seriously. Maya Mari Biotin Keratin Strengthening Shampoo has proven itself worthwhile for me and it’s a product I recommend.

title: Makes Your Hair Look and Feel Great
text:
I don’t have enough hair to be too particular about how I wash and condition. But the ladies in my home feel much differently, seeking out the best brands that help define their hair, improve its look, and make it feel better. That was reason enough to give this hair care set from Curlsmith a try.

You get shampoo, conditioner, jelly, and cream in this package and there is a reason it is sold as a kit: They are made to work together. You start, of course, with the shampoo and conditioner, then apply the jelly and/or cream afterward, using the combination that works best for you.

My wife really likes this product for several reasons. She likes that it doesn’t have added fragrance. Too many high- end hair care products overdo it with fragrance and it is much too strong and noticeable. It leaves your hair super soft and not sticky or crunchy. You just need to be careful to go easy with the jelly and your hair will look and feel its best. People at work have commented directly that her curls look great. There is no frizzing, and the style lasts for several days.

This Curlsmith set is a little on the pricey side, but for what you get and for the results, the cost is worth it. Great looking hair, well- defined curls, and softness to the touch- these are all reasons to trust this product with your hair. It’s an excellent set overall and makes a great gift package.

title: Hair and Scalp Feel Good
text:
Hair care isn’t as important to as it was when I was younger, mainly because I have a lot less hair to deal with. But the are others in my household who care very much about what they use to wash their hair and Maui Moisture Hair Care shampoo and conditioner have lived up to their standards.

Coconut is the main scent of this shampoo and conditioner and coconut oil is one of the chief ingredients. It also contains aloe and it does an effective job making your hair feel moisturized. There is no problem working up a good lather and rinsing clean, so it earns points in these areas.

This product claims it is made for those with thick, curly hair. I have never, but I still use it and I find it good overall. I don’t see the level of shine that I often get with certain other shampoos, but that’s okay with me. Most important of all, my hair and scalp are not dried out when I use this product. They feel good, and I am ready to go about my day.

With short, thinning hair, I don’t give much thought to hair care and shampoo options. But hair care still matters some and it matters a great deal to the teenagers in my home. We all agree that Maui Moisture Hair Care Shampoo and Conditioner is a very good product for everyday washing and conditioning and it has enough positive points to recommend trying.

title: Good Haircare Product
text:
Hair care is important and when your hair is thinning, what often matter most is finding ways to prevent or slow down the hair loss process. A good shampoo is an appropriate starting point and a good choice is Titicii Biotin Original Rossa Label Anti-Thinning Shampoo & Conditioner Set.

Packaged in a pump bottle and sold here as a set, this product is easy to dispense and the first thing you will notice is the scent. It doesn’t small like most other shampoos or conditioners. The scent is one of herbal/spice with a slight lemon note. I wasn’t so sure I liked it at first, but I warmed to it after a few days of use. It's not masculine or feminine, so it’s neutral and should be acceptable for anyone.

This product is easy enough to use and it rinses clean. I use the conditioner only about once every few days. It takes very little for me, since my hair is thinning anyway. I cannot comment on whether it really does prevent thinning because it will take longer to make that determination. But one thing I noticed right away is that my hair is shinier than before. The blend of oils and other ingredients do make a difference in this area.

Titicii Biotin Original Rossa Label Anti-Thinning Shampoo & Conditioner Set would make a good gift for someone who is concerned about their hair. I’m not so sure it’s worth this price, but it does have much going for it and several good reasons to consider adding it to your hair care routine.

title: Cuts Hair with Ease and Fast Charging
text:
Shaving is an annoying but necessary daily grooming routine. It makes sense to try to spend as little time as possible when you shave, and a good electric razor is key. An electric razor made for the task is this LOBINH Electric Shaver.

There are lots of reasons to recommend this electric shaver, starting with the fact that it shaves well and removes hair with relative ease. I have used several different brands of electric razors in my day and I have found that the three- head variety is best for removing the most hair in the shortest amount of time. With other styles of electric razor, I find that I spend far too much time, pressing the razor against my skin and moving it back and forth over the same stray hair, over and over. With the three head variety, the stray hairs are captured and cut more quickly. This razor is also extremely lightweight! I was surprised when I started using it for the first time. I expected a little more weight than this.

Another reason to like this electric razor is that it’s washable. You just press the button in front, revealing all the tiny hairs, then wash it clean. I also like the fast charging and I like that it displays the percentage of your charge that remains. You will, however, need a USB to plug this in, and that may not be good for some consumers. On the other hand, if you prefer using a normal plug, just find a spare plug from an old cell phone that is already made to accommodate a USB, as most of them are.

If there is one issue I have with this LOBINH electric shaver, it is the fact that the on/off button is a little out of place. What I mean is that, because of where it is placed, it is very easy to accidentally press it while you’re shaving, which means shutting it off by accident. But that is a minor issue, really, and not enough to change my rating, which is 5 stars and an enthusiastic recommendation.

title: Cooling Action with Minimal Suds
text:
Liquid body wash is a staple product for me. I don’t think I could ever go back to using traditional bar soap and while my preference is body wash with a more masculine scent, a neutral scent is fine too, which is what you get with DASHU Daily Cooling Body Wash.

This body wash is packaged in a half liter bottle and the blue, see- through packaging does make it look cool. And that is what you expect for a cooling body wash, right? What I noticed, however, is that the colling effects are not extreme like they are with other brands. In fact, most all the cooling sensation I feel is on areas of the skin that are, shall we say, more sensitive. The rest of my skin feels little to no cooling sensation.

So, if you don’t want to feel the cooling effects to the extreme, this body wash will do you good. If you’re the type who prefers less suds action, this is another reason to like this brand, as the suds are minimal. It doesn’t feel sticky, and it rinses clean with almost no water. The scent, which is like a mixture of mint/menthol and cologne, is different, that is for certain. And it is neutral, so anyone can use it.

I like that this product dispenses easily through its pump, and I like that it doesn’t overdo it with the cool. I would like a little more in the way of suds, but this is still a good body wash overall that should satisfy most who use it.

title: Controls Odors and Designed to Last a Long Time
text:
Using deodorant is part of the daily routine for most of us. Deodorant keeps getting better and now there are many brands that are effective enough that you don’t need to use them every day. One good example is Old Spice High Endurance Sport.

I normally use gel deodorant, but this specific one is a stick deodorant. It doesn’t leave white streaks or other stains on clothing, which is good. It goes on dry, too, which isn’t something I can say for the gel variety. You must give gel some time to dry, but there is no such problem with this stick deodorant.

This product has a fresh, sporty scent and it effectively fights odor. You don’t need to use it daily in most cases, which means it is made to last. It depends on your lifestyle. If you spend most of your day sitting in an office chair, like I do, then you likely don’t perspire much anyway and therefore don’t need to use this product daily. More active individuals will need to use it each day.

This specific Old Spice deodorant is sold in a three pack bundle, which is great because you can feel confident it will last a long time. It has the Old Spice name, so you can also feel confident that it’s a product of quality. I have used it for many weeks now and I like the results. I recommend it to everyone who uses deodorant and wants something that works and lasts.

title: Adds a Nice Level of Shine
text:
Do you color your hair? If you do, then you may be rightfully concerned that your color won’t last with repeated shampooing. You need a shampoo that is made for the job and a good choice is Argan Magic Color Care Shampoo.

This shampoo has a somewhat oily texture and a light fragrance. It lathers up well and it rinses cleaner than expected. There is no residue remaining like I worried would happen, given the oily feeling. Considering the oily feel, it may not be a good choice for someone with exceptionally oily hair, as it could make your hair even more oily than before.

The results from this shampoo are positive. It does help maintain the color and it does add a certain level of shine. One problem I had, however, is with the dispensing. I could not get the pump to pop, not matter what I did. I twisted it, pulled it, but nothing works. I was forced to screw off the cap and pour out the shampoo instead.

Color treated hair needs a shampoo that helps keep it looking like it did in the beginning and Argan Magic Color Care Shampoo is good for this purpose. Even if your hair isn’t color treated, the shine that it adds to your hair can make this a worthwhile product for your hair.

title: Gets Hands Clean with a Nice Scent
text:
There is a much stronger emphasis nowadays on washing hands. It has always been important, but the critical nature of handwashing has heightened over the past year and I, too, find myself thinking about it more than before. I prefer soap that is lighter scented and not too harsh and these desires led me to try GreenFist Lotionized Hand Soap.

Green in color, this soap produces an average amount of lather than rinses away in no time. The soap is scented with lime and coconut, but the lime is the dominant smell. Citrus is a pleasant scent, so I like it but it would be nice if there was a little more coconut. It also seems like the type of soap that could be useful for a good scrubbing. I don’t have sensitive skin and I don’t usually get down and dirty, so I don’t need heavy duty cleaning. Still, this soap seems capable of deep cleaning so it could be useful for those who need extra cleaning power.

With a jug this large, this soap is designed to last. I have soap dispensers in every bathroom and in the kitchen and it will take time before I use up this entire jug. When you consider the number of small soap dispensers you can fill, this is an economical product.

We need to keep our hands clean and prevent the spread of germs. More frequent washing can help and GreenFist Lotionized Hand Soap is as good as any. It smells fine and gets your hands clean with just a small amount of soap and it’s fairly priced.

title: Softens Skin and Pleasantly Scented
text:
I’m not one to use lotion. It’s never been something that I deemed necessary, but age has a way of creeping up on you and as the years pass, your skin tends to get dry. An excellent solution to the problem is NIVEA Breathable Nourishing Body Lotion Tropical Breeze.

Formulated for normal to dry skin, this product has a scent that is falls somewhere between tropical fruits and flowers. It’s a reasonably light scent, too, so while you can certainly smell it close up, it isn’t excessive. This is good because I don’t prefer lotion that is so strongly scented that it gets attention from those around me.

Scent is one thing, but what matters most in a lotion is how it feels and how it absorbs into the skin. I have used this on my hands and just a small dab is all you need to spread it around and cover your hands with a thin layer of lotion. In about three minutes, it is completely soaked in. And best of all, it doesn’t feel greasy. Your skin feels noticeably softer to the touch and this softness lasts for hours and hours.

I use skin care every now and then and I can say that NIVEA Breathable Nourishing Body Lotion Tropical Breeze is one of the best I have ever tried. It takes little to get the job done, the scent is pleasant, and it makes a tremendous difference in softening the skin and eliminating dryness. It’s another winner from NIVEA, one of the best names in skin care.

title: Light Scent and Prevents Odor Well
text:
One thing that is a must if you live in a warm climate is deodorant. Yes, everyone needs deodorant to some extent, but the need is greater when you live in warm muggy climate like I do. The ladies in my home are well- aware of this need, but they also recognize the need to use ethical products and this was enough to convince me to get Love, Beauty, and Planet Vegan Deodorant for women.

This odor- control product features a light scent that is mostly floral and pleasant. It applies smooth and is silky soft. There is no irritation to the skin, even after shaving. This latter point was a pleasant surprise. With some deodorant, you can feel the irritation if you apply immediately after shaving but there is no such issue here.

Since I do live where it is hot, a good test of any deodorant is its ability to stand up to the heat. This product did hold up well, as the wife can attest. She said it was still going strong even after a day of shopping and visiting a local park. It’s not the absolute best at controlling wetness, but it’s good enough and it does keep odor at bay.

Deodorant is part of the daily grooming routine for most of us. There are so, so many brands on the market, most of which perform well enough to pass the tests of minimum quality. But if you want a deodorant that blocks nasty armpit odor and is friendly to the planet we inhabit, then consider Love, Beauty, and Planet Vegan Deodorant. It controls odor well, doesn’t irritate the skin, and has a pleasant smell. It’s a little pricey, but the quality is above average.

title: It's Dry Scalp Treatment and It Works Okay
text:
How is your scalp feeling lately? Is it a little drier than usual and you need a quick treatment? If your answer is yes, then a possible solution is Nexxus Scalp Inergy Leave-in Conditioner for Damaged Hair Spray.

One thing that needs mentioning right away is the misleading name of this product. You are led to believe that it is leave in conditioner for your hair, because that is what the name says. But it is, in fact, treatment for your scalp not your hair. There really needs to be a name change on this product, by the manufacturer, so that consumers are clear about what they are getting.

As for its usefulness as a scalp treatment, it is okay, but not the best. It does help eliminate some itching for about 24 hours, so it has some usefulness. The instructions say to use it every day, but each person is different, and they may not need it that much. It’s a runny/watery product, and not a mousse, which would be better. It has an overly strong scent, too.

Because the consistency of this product is lighter/watery, you don’t feel it so much, and that is a good quality to have. You can use it on wet or dry hair also, so it’s good to have the flexibility. It seems to have its share of hits and misses, and thus it’s an average product overall.

title: Nice Scent and Great Price
text:
Almost no one uses bar soap anymore. The trend has been toward using liquid body wash and it is doubtful things will ever turn back. Some body washes are more expensive than they should be, but there are less expensive, quality alternatives and one of them is Suave Men Sport Body Wash.

This body wash is clear, like a gel, so it washes cleaner. The scent has a light spice and is cologne- like, making it appealing to most men. Some women might find it acceptable also, but the scent tends in a masculine direction. I like the scent and consider it one of the product’s strongest selling points.

Suave men Sport Body Wash works as promised and leaves you feeling fresh and clean. It is not a two- in- one product, so you shouldn’t use it to wash your hair. Just lather some up, apply, and rinse. It works well for eliminating body odor and leaves you feeling refreshed and ready to tackle the day. The scent isn’t lingering- it fades quickly but it smells nice while it lasts. It's not great for moisturizing the skin but as long as your skin isn't excessively dry, you should be fine.

I would probably use this body wash and recommend it based on quality alone, but there is one other good reason to consider Suave Men Sport Body Wash, and that is the price! It is far less expensive than other men’s body wash and you can get larger quantities of it for a lower cost. All things considered, Suave Men Sport Body Wash is a very good product with wide availability and it’s tough to beat for the price.

title: Gets Your Hair Flat and Straight in Due Time
text:
When you share a home with a wife and two daughters, hair care is an important part of everyday life. Each of them needs the necessary tools to get their hair looking just right and a good tool for taming the curls and straightening the locks is the DAN Technology Ceramic Tourmaline Travel Hair Straightener.

Intended for travel, this straightener is smaller than most, but not as small as I expected. It’s just over 9 inches in length, and that makes it a little longer than the typical mini straightener. One thing that is longer than expected is the cord. It’s over 8 feet in length, which is good. You should have no trouble reaching a power source and using the straightener the way you need to.

To use this straightener, you just flip the switch and turn the dial to the desired temperature. My wife likes that the controls are inside the handle so that you don’t accidentally turn the straightener off. She noticed, however, that she needed a higher than expected temperature to work on her hair. The recommended temp for her hair thickness wasn’t hot enough. She required more heat. Speaking of heat, the device gets hot very quickly and it does have an auto shut- off feature, both positive qualities.

With the DAN Technology Ceramic Tourmaline Travel Hair Straightener, you can straighten your hair only gradually, since it is capable of handling only a small section of hair at a time. If you have a large amount of hair, it may not be practical and might take too long to use. The included glove is useful and the handle is comfortable, too.

When you need to flatten your curls, a hair straightener is a necessity and the DAN Technology Ceramic Tourmaline Travel Hair Straightener is a good enough tool for the job. The ladies in my home all agree that they have used better, but this hair straightener is sufficient and it passes enough tests of quality to recommend.

title: Keeps Your Skin Looking its Best
text:
Moisturizer is one product that is in constant need in my household. Dry skin always sneaks up during the cooler times of the year and, combined with age, can leave your skin feeling rough. My wife swears by tea tree oil and her confidence in this substance convinced me to try Bevel Moisturizing Face Gel with Tea Tree Oil, Vitamin C, and Algae Extract.

This product is different from other lotions, first due to its consistency. It’s a gel, and that means it’s thicker than the typical lotion. I actually didn’t mind this, even though I was skeptical at first. It applies easily and it only requires a small amount to get the job done- which is a good thing, considering the small size of the bottle.

Tea tree oil is a popular item with the wife, but she has told me that the scent with this product is a little strong. I noticed that, too. Not only is it strong, but it isn’t the type of scent I expected. Most lotions have added perfumes to make them supposedly more appealing to the nose. This product has no additives, that I can tell, which gives it a more natural scent.

This moisturizing gel has proven a good one for day use. It’s easy to get just the right amount- about a dime’s worth- from the container because it dispenses slowly. With other products, it either dispenses too quickly, due to being runny, or it has to be scooped out and you end up using too much. It’s easy to get just the right amount with Bevel Moisturizing Face Gel.

It’s a good idea to keep dry skin properly treated. Bevel Moisturizing Face Gel with Tea tree Oil, Vitamin C, and Algae Extract is a good product for the task. The small bottle may seem inadequate, but it takes so little to get the job done that it will last longer than you think. It’s a reliable product overall and good for keeping the moisture in your skin and keeping it looking its best.

title: Ligth Scent and Works Well
text:
Hairspray is a commonly used grooming item and since I share a house with three women, there is a constant need for this type of product. Most get the job done, but among the better options available is Pantene Hairspray Smooth Finish Pro-V Airspray.

I’ve used Pantene shampoos and conditioners for a long time and have had good success. This Pantene product continues the reputation for quality. It is a lighter- scented product, which is good, and it doesn’t weigh your hair down excessively. The use of the word airspray, as opposed to hairspray, emphasizes this quality.

Pantene Airspray is alcohol free and leaves hair feeling soft and smooth, not sticky or dry, and it can still be brushed with the spray in place. My girls say that it’s good for those times when you want some control, but want your hair to still look and feel soft and natural. And the nozzle and the delivery are designed in such a way that you don't have to worry about clogging.

Pantene Hairspray Smooth Finish Pro-V Airspray is sold in three packs, which is perfect for my household because it means all three ladies can have a bottle of their own. It’s a very good hair styling product and worth giving a try.

title: Nice Scent and Cleans Well
text:
Liquid hand soap is part of most every home. I like to keep an assortment of different scented soaps in each of my four bathrooms and in the kitchen and laundry area. I like the scent of citrus and lavender and that is why I like Sapadilla Sweet Lavender + Lime Biodegradeable Liquid Hand Soap Pump.

This liquid hand soap is packaged in a 12-ounce container and is dispensed via pump, for convenience. The soap is made using oil blends and is biodegradable, for added earth- friendliness. The bottle is narrower than that of other hand soaps I have tried and use, and that means it fits nicely on even the smallest bathroom sink.

One of the things that attracted me to this product is the scent and I do find it pleasant. I love the smell of citrus and lavender and this hand soap offers both. One thing I wish was a little different is the concentration of the two scents. I would rather have a little more lavender and a little less citrus. The combination here emphasizes the lime scent a little more.

With cleaning, this hand soap works as good as any. It doesn’t take much at all to get your hands clean and fresh, so be sure to pump only a small amount at a time. And since this soap is sold three to a pack, you won’t have to make a return trip to the store to restock. The three containers should last a while.

I love the smell of citrus and lavender and Sapadilla Sweet Lavender + Lime Biodegradeable Liquid Hand Soap Pump is a good soap for those of us who like this scent combination. Yes, I would prefer a little less lime, but this is still a very good product overall and great for any home.

title: Let Aussie Get Control of Your Hair
text:
Good hairspray involves lots of different factors, from the scent to the hold and much more. The brand name isn’t necessarily important, but it can’t hurt when the brand is one you trust and a quality hairspray with a reputable name behind it is Aussie Hairspray, with Bamboo & Kakadu Plum, Headstrong Volume.

With the application, this hairspray goes on easily thanks to its wide spraying range. It has an extremely pleasant scent of flowers and citrus and reminds me of the scent of some of my favorite candles.

The dispenser on this Aussie hairspray has a great nozzle, but my wife worries about how much comes out because it seems like it can easily get clogged. You also need to go easy on the usage because it doesn’t take much to achieve results. Too much, and your hair will feel stiff. After a few uses, however, consumers should have no problem judging how much is just right for their hair and all is well from there.

Aussie has always come through for me with great hair care products and Aussie Hairspray, with Bamboo & Kakadu Plum, Headstrong Volume is yet another in a long line of quality goods. The amazing scent and ability to produce the hold you need make this an excellent choice for anyone who needs to better manage their hair.

title: Helps You Manage Your Curls
text:
One brand name that has been taking care of our hair for a long time is Aussie. I’ve used their shampoos and conditioners on and off for quite a while and the wife and kids in my house often use their other hair care products. One that they have tried and liked is Aussie Leave In Conditioner & Mousse with Jojoba & Sea Kelp Sprunch For Curly Hair.

With its fruit and musk combination scent, this sprunch has a pleasant smell. It is thick and ready to apply. It creates a swirl when you release it from the container and while I know that this is more of a novelty feature than anything, it still looks attractive.

Using this Aussie product leads to soft hair with a good bounce to one’s curls, when used with a diffuser. It also helps if you happen to run a straightener through your hair. My wife says that she doesn’t use it every day because she also doesn’t wash her hair every day. However, there was some build up so it would be a good idea to use a clarifying shampoo or tea tree shampoo if your hair starts to feel a little limp.

Aussie is one of the foremost names in hair care and its Aussie Leave In Conditioner & Mousse with Jojoba & Sea Kelp Sprunch For Curly Hair is yet another quality product from this company. It has a very nice scent and it does help to better manage your hair. And with a pack of three, you should be set for a good, long time.

title: Works Well on My Short Hair
text:
Shampoos are many and the choices one makes can make a difference in the way their hair and scalp look and feel. Those of us with short hair don’t need to worry so much, but quality does still matter and a decent shampoo and conditioner for the money is Herbal Essences, Sulfate Free Shampoo and Conditioner Bio Renewal with Honey and Vitamin B.

This shampoo is lightly scented, so it doesn’t leave behind much of a smell after washing. This is good if you’re the type who doesn’t necessarily want to get attention due to the strong scent radiating from your hair. It takes only a small amount of shampoo for me to get the job done. I don’t use the conditioner as much, but again only a small amount is necessary.

As for the results, they seem sufficient to me. My hair doesn’t shine as a result of using this shampoo, but that is fine with me. It does have a bit of a drying effect on the hair and scalp, but on those days that I use the included conditioner, everything seems to turn out okay. I like to alternate between regular shampoo and dandruff shampoo and this product seems to work well for this purpose.

Herbal Essences has been making shampoos and conditioners for a long time and this Honey and Vitamin B variety is a good choice for the money. From the perspective of someone with short hair and limited needs, it does the trick and is more than good enough to add to my shampoo rotation.

title: Good Moisturizing Ability and Performs as Promised
text:
Applying makeup is a chore, but there are ways to make the task a little more bearable and the results a little more long lasting. Using a makeup setting spray is one way to improve and a good choice for the task at hand is Neutrogena Healthy Skin Radiant Makeup Setting Spray.

I got this spray for my wife and the first thing she noticed is that the spray is wider; that is, it reaches a broader spectrum than some other sprays she has used. This means it covers your face more quickly. With other sprays, she must spray two or three times, but not so with this spray. You also need to keep it the recommended 6 inches from your face when you spray, for maximum effectiveness.

This makeup setting spray works well and performs as promised. My wife also uses a primer before and powder after makeup and before setting spray so she can’t really say for sure if this product would work well without those items. But used the way she uses it, the performance is very good.

Probably the best aspect of this spray is the moisturization. With some sprays, even after spraying her contour seems to look dry and then she has to use additional moisturizer, dabbing a little coconut oil on dry spots. There is no need for extra moisturizer with this Neutrogena product. It works all by itself.

This bottle is sized right. It is small and fits into a small space so it is there when you need it. It gets the job done with a single push of the button so while it is small, it still lasts. All things considered, Neutrogena Healthy Skin Radiant Makeup Setting Spray has many things going for it and it’s a product that is recommended.

title: Good Results but Don't Care for the Scent
text:
My hair is fine and quite a bit thinner than it once was. It is common for strands of my hair to break and fall off, adding to my thinness issue. There are, fortunately, some brands of shampoo designed to help with this problem and one of them is Garnier Har Care Whole Blends Ginger Recovery Strengthening Shampoo and Conditioner with Ginger and Golden Honey Extracts.

I require only a small amount of this shampoo and conditioner to treat my hair. About a half- dollar size amount is all it takes- I just work it into my hair and scalp. I don’t plan on using the conditioner very much, since my hair doesn’t really need it. The shampoo alone does the trick for me.

This Garnier shampoo works well overall and the conditioner is good for occasional use, when you feel your hair needs to be conditioned. The one quality I wish was possibly difference is the scent. I like the smell of ginger, but I don’t necessarily like the scent of ginger on my hair. The scent lingers, too, so others around you can smell it for a few hours after use.

It’s good to find a shampoo that is specially formulated for dry and brittle hair like mine. Garnier Har Care Whole Blends Ginger Recovery Strengthening Shampoo is that shampoo. I could do with less of the spicy scent but other than that, this shampoo is a good one.

title: Take Care of Your Skin with Covergirl
text:
Skin care is important for everyone, but women seem to get involved in the skin care routine more than men. Manufacturers have responded with an abundance of skin care products and Covergirl is one of the best-known names for skin care and cosmetics. Given Covergirl’s penchant for quality, I had no problem giving Covergirl Clean Fresh Skin Milk a try.

My wife took to this product quickly. She says it provides good coverage. She likes the hydrating qualities and the luminous aspects. She says it works as expected and confirms her longstanding confidence in this brand. Just a small amount is all it takes and the results are quickly noticeable, both to the eyes and to the touch.
