This product is meant as a liquid foundation and my wife says that the best way to use it is to apply it to the darker areas of your skin first, allowing it to bake- so to speak- before then applying it all over. She says this provides the best results and the most even skin tone overall.

Skin care is important and Covergirl Clean Fresh Skin Milk is a good means to soft, moisturized, clearer skin. It’s another good product from one of the most trusted names in skin care and one that earns an easy recommendation.

title: Its Easy to Clean, but Fails in Most Other Areas
text:
My wife has long hair and spends a good deal of time making her hair look its best. She has curling irons, hand brushes, and other tools to make hair styling easier, but one thing she did not have is an electric styling brush. My solution to her need was the Hot Tools Professional 3/4" Hot Air Brush.

The brush has a high setting and low setting. The brush removes with ease, for cleaning. Unfortunately, the positive points end right there. The problems with the brush are many and they begin with the slow flow of air. I turned it on myself and I can see what my wife means. The flow is too light to make much difference.

Another issue with this brush is that it doesn’t do well on longer, thicker hair. It makes almost no difference at all- using a regular, hand brush is about equally good. It might work for someone with shorter hair, I suppose, but if you have short hair you likely don’t need an electric brush in the first place.

So, the final verdict on the Hot Tools Professional Hot Air Brush is that it is less than adequate for our needs. It could work for some people, but it would be a risky investment. I recommend passing, as the price is a little high and the odds of it working too low to justify a purchase.

title: Cleans Well and the Scent is Fresh
text:
Bar soap is practically a thing of the past. Today, people use body wash almost exclusively and this is certainly the case in my home. I don’t have any specific favorites when it comes to body wash- I am fine with most brands and that means I am open to trying new brands at any time. This readiness to try something new led me to get Alpine X-Treme Mountain Stream Body Wash.

Alpine X-Treme Mountain Stream Body Wash is a three in one product, and that means it can be used as a body wash and as shampoo and facial wash. I don’t normally use multi- purpose body wash for my hair, so I still plan to use regular shampoo for this purpose. But it is good to know that this product can be used for the hair if shampoo is scarce.

This body wash has a cologne- like scent. It washes clean with little effort, so you don’t need to worry about finding soap deposits left on your skin. The blue liquid is clear, not milky like some brands of body wash. And the scent does linger for a little bit of time after use, but not obnoxiously so.

Alpine X-Treme Mountain Stream Body Wash is dispensed from a pump, making it easy to get just the right amount. I find this a good product overall and I like the scent and cleaning abilities. It’s a product that would be suitable for most men and I product I plan to add to my body wash rotation.

title: Adds Cuteness and Style to Your Hair
text:
When you share a home with a wife and daughters, you have to be ever mindful of personal care needs. Hair care is the most prevalent of all these needs and my girls like to keep their hair looking good, and also out of their faces when possible. They have gone the route of cutting their hair so short that control isn’t necessary, but when their hair is longer, it needs to be tied back and this is why they love the Hitbeam Hair-Scarf Bow Scrunchies for Hair Chiffon Soft Elastic Hair Bands Hair Ties.

With these scrunchies, you get a pack of eight different colors that are more natural in shade, so they can be paired with most any hair color or attire. They fit on the hair with ease and the added bow gives them a more decorative appearance. My girls like that they do not stick to their hair when they remove them, so there is no pulling involved. They are more comfortable to wear.

Because of the more decorative look, these scrunchies could actually be used in other ways. Most who get them will want to use them in their hair, but they can also be used in other decorative ways, like by attaching them to a purse or handbag. Because there are eight per pack, which is a larger than needed number for most girls, some folks will take to using them in other places, for a decorative touch.

Ordinary hair ties are fine in most instances, but these scrunchies by Hitbeam are a better option when a woman wants a little more style to their hair tying needs. My girls have pointed out that more flashy colors would be nice and they would like to at least have a green and blue color in the mix. But other than this, these scrunchies get enthusiastic praise from my girls who love wearing them whenever possible.

title: Great Looking Skin and Nails and Cord Free
text:
Nail care can get expensive if you visit a salon. It’s nice to do this on occasion and let someone else handle the work. But the do- it- yourself solution can be just as good and a lot less expensive and a tool made for the job is the Beurer Cordless 10 Piece Professional Manicure and Pedicure Set.

With this tool, you get ten different attachments, made either from sapphire cone for callouses or dry skin removal, or felt cone for nails. The dry skin and callous removal is quite nice and something that anyone can use and benefit from, even if you don’t care that much about your nails. For those who want the full treatment, the felt cone options are perfect for nails and they help you shape and form your nails into the look that you prefer.

This device has three different speeds and an LED light, which is useful for those who like precision when they get a mani or pedi. Probably the best feature of all, compared to other devices like this one, is the fact that it is cordless. Without the need for a cord, you are free to use this wherever you like. My wife has commented that the cordless feature alone makes this tool superior to most others and is reason enough to give it a try.

Professional mani and pedi treatments are something many people look forward to but there is something to be said for having the ability to finish a mani or pedi yourself, from the comforts of home. You need an appropriate tool for the job and the Beurer Cordless 10 Piece Professional Manicure and Pedicure Set is a good choice for the task at hand, or foot. The ten different attachments, the added light, and the cordless design make this a great gift idea for someone who wants to have the nicest looking nails, feet, and hands and doesn’t mind doing the work themselves.

title: Gets Rid of Dryness and Smells Pleasant
text:
I don’t use lotion very much. Living in a warm, humid climate my skin usually holds up well and generally retains moisture. But things can change quickly during the cool season and I have been known to apply lotion when the need arises. One lotion I have used with good results is J.R Watkins Lemon Cream Hand Cream.

J.R Watkins Hand Cream Lemon Cream is a lemon- scented body cream that is off- white in color. The product is non- greasy in nature and it’s quite thick. It is dispensed by squeezing a small amount from the tube through the flip- cap opening and then applying as needed. The product is labeled as hand cream, but it can be used on any area of the skin where dryness is a problem. Just apply a small amount, spread it around, and let it penetrate the skin. In a short time, the lotion will no longer be noticeable. The hand cream has a scent like a lemon dessert with a small amount of added butter.

This J.R Watkins hand cream is non- greasy and one thing I like is that it takes very little time to penetrate the skin. I have used other hand creams that were noticeable for a long time. The white blotches would show up on the skin and I would have to repeatedly spread the lotion around or even reach for a tissue to wipe some of its away. With J.R Watkins, the lotion is visible for only a few minutes, after which it disappears from view. It is still there, protecting the skin, but no one can see it.

J.R. Watkins Hand Cream Lemon Cream can be used on the hands, feet, and other areas of the body where dry skin is a problem. I like its versatility, but one thing I do not like is the price. It sells for a high price per ounce, but the good news is that it takes very little to get the job done. Just a small dab is all you need, so a small tube should last for a fair amount of time. It’s good for minor treatment of dry skin, but it may take too much to handle a serious dry skin problem so I probably wouldn’t use this if a large amount of skin needed quick moisturization and care. But for small uses, this product works quite well and its lemon- dessert scent is very pleasing to the senses.

title: Fresh Scent, not Overpowering
text:
Bathing and grooming are a regular part of life and one area where the routine has improved for the better is with the invention of body wash. The liquid soap is far better than the old bar variety and manufacturers have come up with some pleasantly scented options, some of which are tailor- made for specific individuals. A good example is Solimo Men’s Body Wash, Sports Scent.

This body wash is medium in thickness and it has a good, fresh scent that is generally masculine overall, but not extremely so. It doesn’t take much to work up a good lather and the scent is like that of other name brands, most of which are priced much higher. Another thing I like about the scent is that it isn’t overdone. Once you dry off, you can notice it on your skin, but only if you really try. It could be described as a light cologne smell with added spice.

Amazon has produced many useful products with its Solimo line. I have tried and liked most all of them, and now I can add Solimo Men’s Body Wash to the list. It’s an economical way to get clean, not overpowering in scent, and just as good as the other brands that are priced higher.

title: Very Good Hair Care for a Fair Price
text:
My wife has curly hair and she often needs a little help getting her curls to retain their shape. She has tried several of the expensive, overpriced brands but has found that many of the reasonably priced brands work just as well and Garnier Hair Care Fructis is one of them.

This Garnier hair care product is a jelly- like substance that you have to apply using your fingers. They recommend using a quarter- size amount, but you may need a little more depending on the amount of hair you have and the amount of curliness.

With its fresh scent, this product is pleasant from the start and my wife told me that the curls do, indeed, hold their shape. Hers held for a few days, which is more than expected. Her hair feels soft and not sticky, which is another positive. Given the unusual texture of this product, I feared that it would leave my wife’s hair feeling stiff and unpleasant to touch, but that isn’t the case at all.

The way this hair product is dispensed, by dipping your fingers into it, isn’t the most desirable means to apply and it would be better if it was dispensed some other way, like with a pump. But all things considered, this is a small issue for a product that is very good overall and definitely a good choice when you want better than average hair care for a fair price.

title: Fun, Safe Means to Create Body Art
text:
I have two tween-age girls and one thing that is obvious about both of them is that they like to express themselves. They like to make statements about what they like and don’t like and one way they enjoy doing this is by showing symbols and making statements on their skin. Using ordinary markers for this purpose isn’t safe, and I have caught them doing it. A better, skin- friendly means to self- expression is BIC Bodymark Temporary Tattoo Marker.

This set of markers comes 8 to a pack with all of the basic colors you need to create works of art on your skin. The tips are thin, which is perfect for drawing fine lines but if you need thicker lines, you can get them by pressing slightly. The tip is flexible, so pressing down widens the contact with your skin’s surface, perfect for wide lines and for shading.

With BIC Bodymark Temporary Tattoo Marker, kids can make works of art on their skin and best of all, the product is safe for regular use. It has the properties of a cosmetic, so you don’t need to worry about ink and the potential health hazards it can cause. We all know that kids like to write on their skin and ink markers are what they normally use. With BIC Bodymark Temporary Tattoo Marker, you don’t need to worry about potential health issues. It is possible that some people, with exceptionally sensitive skin, could have a reaction but this isn’t likely and most anyone who uses these should have no problems whatsoever.

The designs made with BIC Bodymark Temporary Tattoo Marker last a good deal of time and take effort to wash off. If your kid makes a quick visit to the shower and doesn’t try to wash the markings away, there is a good chance most will still remain. This is good for those who want the designs to stay visible longer than a day.

My girls love to make designs on themselves and with BIC Bodymark Temporary Tattoo Marker, they can write and draw as they like without worry. It’s a cool way to make temporary tattoos without health concerns and a fun, safe means to create body art.

title: Shaves Quickly and Cleans with Little Effort
text:
I use electric razors every morning as part of my routine. Since I am usually in a hurry to get groomed and ready for work, I don’t have time for a traditional hand razor and shaving cream- I grab my electric razor instead for the fastest shave possible. I have used many different brands over the years and one I just recently tried and like is the Braun Series 9 Men’s Electric Foil Shaver with Wet and Dry Integrated Precision Trimmer Rechargeable Cordless Razor.

My previous cordless razor featured three floating heads and did a good enough job but I have always liked Braun and decided the Series 9 might be an improvement. And from what I have seen so far, there are many things to like about this Braun electric razor. This razor has 5 shaving elements and each is intended to cut hairs based on different factors. I found that the speed at which this Braun razor is able to completely shave my face and neck is faster than that of my old razor. With my old electric razor, it took more times, going over and over the same batch of skin, until the heads would grasp the hair and make the cut. Braun takes less effort.

To keep the razor clean, Braun Series 9 comes complete with a clean and charge station that lubricates, cleans, and dries the razor heads with the push of a button while also charging the razor so that you don’t need to wait for the cleaning and then remember to switch over to the charger. The cleaning fluid does require purchasing refills from time to time, but a clean razor is a happy razor and I find I do clean this razor a lot more than I did my old one. Convenience is the reason.

Braun Series 9 is waterproof and you can shave wet or dry. The latter feature is great for those who still like to lubricate and soften their facial hair with shaving cream, before shaving. I doubt I will ever use this feature because, like I said, the reason I prefer electric razors in the first place is because I can shave quickly. But it’s nice that the option is there, in case I change my mind in the future.

This Braun razor has many cool, added features. The fact that you can clean and charge in a single step is one of them and another is the charging countdown. On the LED display, when it gets down to the final 9 minutes of remaining charge, it shows the number of minutes that remain from that point all the way down to zero. This is nice because you know exactly how much more shaving you can do before the razor goes completely dead. With other razors, all you usually see are colored bar lights that give you a rough idea when the charge is almost out, but it’s still a guessing game, as you don’t know precisely how much time is left.

Brain makes quality products and the Series 9 razor is definitely one worth considering. It makes a cool holiday gift for someone who prefers electric razors and with its extra features and fast cutting, 5 shaving element technology, your facial hair will be gone in minutes so you can get on with your day.

title: Fights Germs and Rinses Clean with Ease
text:
Hand soap is essential. In my household, I have four bathrooms, a kitchen, and a sink in the laundry room and every one of them is accompanied by a container of hand soap. This ongoing need was more than enough to convince me to try Form and Function Antibacterial Foaming Hand Soap.

Dispensed with a push of this pump, this soap comes out foamy and ready to get your hands clean. I like foaming hand soap better than the liquid variety because it’s already in lather form and requires less time to use and wash. It’s easy to rinse off, too, and it leaves your hands clean and smooth. Some liquid soaps are heavy and thick, requiring more time to work into a lather and rinse off. There is no such issue here.

This hand soap has a most pleasant scent that is slightly flowery, soapy, a touch fruity, and fresh. It’s a neutral scent, so it will likely not be rejected by anyone in the household who uses it. My entire family likes it and finds the scent nice; not overpowering or incredible, but nice. And with 18 oz in a bottle, it’s the type of hand soap that is made to last.

Washing hands is important in order to avoid germs. Form and Function Antibacterial Foaming Hand Soap is very good way to control germs and with its foaming action, it’s easier to use and rinse. The fresh scent nice, too, and all things considered, it easily rates as an above average product, deserving of your consideration.

title: Works Well on My Short Hair
text:
When you have short hair like I do, you don’t need to be too particular about your shampoo. My scalp is dry, so I try to go for shampoos that moisturize, but other than that, most shampoos will do what I need them to do. The ladies in my home feel more strongly about their shampoo, due to their longer locks. And this desire for a shampoo we could all agree on led me to try POV Moisturizing Shampoo.

Packaged in a large, 28 oz. bottle, this shampoo has enough volume to last a long time. The shampoo is white in color and has a light, pleasant scent that is soapy/floral in nature. The flip top cap means you don’t have to search for the lid or worry about dropping it in the shower. And just a small squeeze is all it takes to dispense enough shampoo to clean your hair and get on with your day.

As I said, the moisturizing capabilities of a shampoo are important to me and POV Moisturizing Shampoo does fulfill its moisturizing duties, as its name promises. It doesn’t overdo it, and that is good because since I have short hair, I don’t want too much moisturizing because it will make my minimal amount of hair look too flat. This shampoo strikes a good balance in this area and, at least for me, eliminates the need for conditioner.

POV Moisturizing Shampoo seems to be a hit with the ladies in my house, too. They like how it smells and tell me that it works well on their longer hair, although for them, they still like to use conditioner. They don’t rate this shampoo as good as their favorites, but they agree that it’s nice to have a large size bottle that lasts and the price is very reasonable for such a large container.

Short haired individuals don’t need a fancy shampoo, but we do have standards that must be met and POV Moisturizing Shampoo easily meets mine. It’s a very good product overall and it’s difficult to beat considering the price per ounce.

title: Softens the Skin with a Pleasant Scent
text:
Those of us who work with our hands often need special protection- something we can add to our worn out fingers and palms to re- hydrate, smooth out rough edges, and otherwise reduce the effects of daily life. A good choice for the task is Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hand Gel Cream with Hyaluronic Acid.

I work in an office, so I’m not prone to the rough or dry skin problems others experience. But a day of working in the yard can take its toll and I have a wife who likes to keep her hands soft and touchable regardless. This Neutrogena works well at moisturizing the skin and smoothing out rough edges. You can feel and see a difference and it still holds its own even after washing hands.

Neutrogena Hydro Boost does what its name says, but I did notice that it takes longer to completely dry than other hand creams. I try to use only a thin coating when I use this hand cream in order to speed up the drying process. Not knowing it was like this at first, I used too much and it was taking longer to dry than I had time for. I ended up scraping some off to avoid waiting.

This product has a light scent that is pleasant and fragrant. I have heard others describe the scent as similar to that of baby lotion or powder and that seems like an accurate description. With the thin coating that I use, I can’t smell this product after a while and I am fine with that, since I don’t like heavily scented hand creams or other personal care products anyway.

Everyone has dry skin issues at some point. Rather than put up with the dry, rough patches, why not use Neutrogena Hydro Boost? It’s a good product for those who want softer skin and it works pretty much as promised, making it yet another good product from the Neutrogena family.

title: It Gets the Job Done and No Spillage
text:
Facial toner is not something that enters my conversations, much less my shopping cart. But when you live in a house full of women, products like this do have their place and this was enough to convince me to get my hands on Beauty American Tea Tree Facial Toner.

My wife is the person in the house who uses facial toner most frequently so I immediately handed these bottles to her for assessment. The first word of praise she made about the toner was the way it dispenses. The push- down applicator means you don’t need to worry about spilling or using too much. You just grab a cotton ball or cleansing pad, dispense a small amount with a single push, and you’re all set to apply.

With the scent, it is a little lighter than others and there is no apparent added fragrance. In other words, it smells the way the ingredients make it smell and that is good, because some other toners have a scent that is obviously overdone through the use of additives.

As for the performance, the toner is very good at closing your pores and it gives the skin a refreshed feeling. Your skin feels better and looks smoother. And it seems to be gentle for those who have more sensitive skin.

Facial toners have their use and my household has found a good product with Beauty American Tea Tree Facial Toner. There are other toners that might be slightly better for performance, but this product is a very good value and it’s tough to beat the way it dispenses.

title: Kenneth Cole Perfume: Quality Gift for the Lady in Your Life
text:
Kenneth Cole is a name associated with quality and when we hear this name, we normally think immediately of clothing. But Kenneth Cole is more than just a company that makes stylish garments; they also make perfume, like the Kenneth Cole for Her gift set.

I live in a household full of ladies so when I decided to get this perfume set, I was confident that at least one of them would find a scent to their liking. The box consists of a large bottle of base perfume along with three smaller bottles, named Energy, Intensity, and Serenity respectively. The wearer can use just the base perfume or combine it with one of the other three scents, for a result that suits their own individual preferences.

I got this perfume set mainly for my wife who promised she would pass it on to one of our girls if she didn’t prefer the scents herself. Well, there is no need to have the kids sample the bottles after all, because my wife loves this Kenneth Cole perfume. She likes the musk and floral combinations and loves having three different scents to match her mood at the time. She likes the Serenity best, but all are good and even the base perfume is fine by itself. The base comes in a large bottle, too, which is cool because it should last a good long time.

Kenneth Cole is a well- known name in clothing circles and I have liked what I have seen and worn from this stylish maker of men’s clothes. I’m glad to discover that Kenneth Cole has branched out into other areas and this perfume gift set easily maintains the level of quality I expect from the brand. Get a box for the lady in your life- she will love what Kenneth Cole has created.

title: Good Travel Accessory
text:
We do a good deal of travelling in my household so anything that makes our lives easier while on the road is a definite plus. The Conair LED Lighted Makeup Mirror was thus a good choice for an addition to our travel accessories.

With three panels, this mirror is made with makeup application in mind, as it lets you see your face from different angles. The mirror is foldable, which is nice, because that makes it easy to store. It weighs a little more than expected, and my wife and kids say they like it this way because it makes it sturdier when placed on a table.

Probably the best feature of this mirror is the lighting. It uses LED lights which the manufacturer claims will never need to be replaced and use far less energy than other lights. There are three light settings, too, which is cool. My kids tell me the lowest setting is too soft, but it’s good to have multiple options, in order to get the lighting just right.

This mirror would be better if it came with a cord. As it is, you have to use batteries to power the lights and it takes four AAA to get it going. One of my kids uses it in her bedroom and for usage like this, an electrical cord would be nice. But I suppose that, for limited travel use, the fact that batteries are required isn’t a big deal.

Travel accessories are something we cannot seem to have too much of in our house and the Conair LED Lighted Makeup Mirror is a good addition to our accessory collection. Aside from the battery issue, it’s a good mirror for the ladies and my family members recommend it for travel or household use.

title: One of the Best Lotions You Can Buy
text:
If you have issues with dry skin, you may need to treat the problem directly by using lotion. It seems like the hands get dried out the most and a product that works quite well for moisturizing dry skin is Lubriderm Daily Moisture Lotion.

I don’t use lotions as much as I used to. When I lived where the climate was colder, I had issues with dry skin much more frequently. Washing dishes by hand also added to the problem. Today, I don’t have the dry skin problems, but my wife does and she swears by Lubriderm. The product is non- greasy and fragrance- free and it goes to work immediately, softening the skin and eliminating dry patches.

This Lubriderm product is good for a full 24 hours after applying. Depending on what you do with your skin throughout the day, you may want to apply a second coat. It feels very good on the skin and I notice a definite difference with my wife’s hands. They are softer and smoother than before and even though I don’t use lotions as much as she does, I can tell a difference on my own skin, too.

Lotions are often necessary when you have dry skin issues. Lubriderm Daily Moisture Lotion is one of the best products around for dry skin treatment and with such a large bottle, you won’t need to shop for more lotion for a long time. It’s an excellent product that goes above and beyond.

title: Works Well and No Burns
text:
My two tween age girls have reached the age when they care about their hair so when I had the opportunity to get them a new curling iron, I happily accepted. They already have other curling irons, but this was different than the others and looked like something they would find useful.

Based on its name, the Playful Ceramic Fiber Curling Iron, I first thought this was something that was not meant to be taken seriously- not quite a toy, but something only a notch better. But quick examination shows that it is not the case at all. This is a serious styling tool, with four heat settings, auto shut off, and a unique curling system that lets a person wrap their hair around and curl without the use of a clamp. This is good, because it means there is less chance for burning your fingers on a hot curling iron- a problem that happens with my girls when they use a traditional curling iron.

As for the performance, my kids tell me this curling iron is a good one. They told me that the low heat setting isn’t very useful- they usually go for the second hottest setting for best results. And from what I can see by looking at their hair and what they have told me, the results are very good with this device. Their hair looks nice and the curls hold throughout the day.

My girls still have a couple of traditional curling irons and depending on what they want to do with their hair on a particular day, the traditional, clamp- style curling irons still work well. But the Dear Drew You Are Playful Curling Iron is generally better overall and my tweens say it ranks among the better curling irons they have used. It’s a unique way to curl hair and a good option for people who get tired of accidently touching the hot metal parts of a traditional curling iron and want something different, and safer.

title: Secret Clinical Strength Protects Against the Elements
text:
I live in a warm, subtropical climate and that means we spend a good part of our life sweating. I will start to sweat within a minute after walking outdoors on a hot day and the high dew point/humidity makes matters that much worse. Since moving to this warm climate, my wife has noticed that clinical strength deodorant is a must and her brand of choice is Secret Clinical Strength.

With Secret Clinical Strength, a person gets the extra protection they need. The product is so powerful it is good for two days and my wife can attest to the effectiveness. It is recommended that you apply at night, but my wife says it works well regardless of when she uses it. The special formula keeps perspiration at bay and keeps odors under control.

This specific product is unscented, which may be to some people’s liking. I personally prefer a light scent with my deodorant, but I think I’m in the minority. With Secret Clinical Strength, you get a product that is scent- free, and that means your scent remains neutral. It’s easy enough to apply, too, and doesn’t leave white streaks on clothing- all plusses, in my book.

Hot, humid climates require a powerful underarm solution and Secret Clinical Strength is a good choice for the task. There are less expensive options out there, but Secret is a respectable name in odor protection and it performs as promises, making the price worth it for the peace of mind it brings.

title: Quality Shampoo and Conditioner Duo from Clairol
text:
Shampoo and conditioner are two essential household purchases and this is even truer when you live in a house full of women, like I do. I don’t fuss much about the shampoo and conditioner that I use, but I still have minimum standards which seem to be more than met by Clairol Hair Food Moisture Shampoo & Conditioner Set Infused With Honey Apricot Fragrance.

My hair is short so I don’t need an incredible shampoo or salon- level shampoo. But even for me, it does matter that my chosen shampoo at least cleans quickly and doesn’t leave behind any residue. This shampoo accomplishes exactly that. It cleans quickly, rinses away fast, and lets me get on with my morning prep without any problem.

I use conditioner maybe once every 2 weeks and I must say this conditioner is a good one. What I like best is that it doesn’t weigh down your hair, like other conditioners are prone to do. When you don’t have much in the way of hair anyway, you don’t want your hair to look even flatter, prompting people at work to ask if you just got your hair cut. This conditioner doesn’t do that, so it scores points in this area, too.

Another pleasant surprise with Clairol Hair Food is the scent. Yes, it’s fruity but it’s very subtle and doesn’t make you smell like a fruit salad. Again, this is a good thing, as I don’t really like fruity scents anyway. The pump dispensers are also nice because they make it easier to get just the right amount of shampoo or conditioner from the container without worry of spills.

These products contain no mineral oils, parabens, or silicone and my girls tell me these things are important. They also advised me that this shampoo/conditioner duo is good, although they have other brands they like a little more. So, when I factor all things pro and con, Clairol Hair Food does rank better than average and it’s definitely a product pair I recommend.

title: Gentle is Definitely the Word
text:
I quit using bar soap a long time ago and, along with the other family members, I use body wash exclusively when I shower. I’m not too particular when it comes to my body wash, but I know that my wife and kids prefer a gentler wash. This is why we like Le Petit Marseillais Extra Gentle Shower Cream Cotton Milk and Poppy.

With its milk and poppy formula, this body wash is certainly gentle, much like its name asserts. There is nothing at all harsh about this body wash- not in its texture, its scent, or its performance. It cleans you up in a gentle way without irritating the skin and in some ways, it actually reminds me of a baby’s body wash/gel.

The scent of this body wash may not be suitable to some- especially to men who prefer the more masculine, cologne like scent of a man’s body wash. But the scent is pleasant enough, with a dab of soapiness and nature combined into one. I think it’s safe to say that women, in general, will like the scent better than men. I agree that I have smelled better body washes, but one thing I like is that the scent doesn’t linger. You can certainly smell it when you use it but once you shower, rinse, and dry, there is no scent left behind.

Body wash is a household essential and Le Petit Marseillais Extra Gentle Shower Cream Cotton Milk and Poppy is a good product for the task. It cleans you up without skin irritation and seems gentle enough for even the most sensitive skin. I don’t think it will be replacing my man’s body wash anytime soon, but it is a good product overall and one that most people will like.

title: Keeping Clean with Softsoap
text:
Bodywash has forever changed the way we shower. We no longer purchase bar soap in my household and haven’t for years and we have a few brands of body wash we prefer to others. One of our preferences is Softsoap, a brand with a strong lineup of scents.

Softsoap Jasmine and Plum Body Wash turned out to be another quality product. The scent of this body wash is what you notice first. It is floral and very pleasant. I couldn’t detect any plum scent at all, but I will take their word that plum is there. The floral aroma is very nice and while it might seem like a more feminine scent, it is actually fine for men or women.

This Softsoap body wash glides on smoothly and rinses clean quickly. The wash is clear and while it claims to be moisturizing, it doesn’t have that ‘lotion like’ feel that you get with some body washes. Still, it seems more than good enough for this purpose and it delivers as promised. They don’t recommend this for your hair- this is intended for body washing only.

One side note about this body wash that I feel I should mention is the bottle design. With the round top, you cannot easily stand the bottle on its cap, like you can with other, flat- top bottles. I like to stand my bottles of body wash and shampoo on their heads because it means I can more easily get every last drop. You cannot do that with this bottle, so if you want to extract every list bit, you will have to prop the bottle in a corner.

Softsoap has always satisfied and this scent, Jasmine and Plum, is just as good as any. The scent is great and it delivers as promised, making it a good choice for your morning routine.

title: Straight Hair for a Fair Price
text:
My hair is straight. It’s also short and thinning, so I have little use for a hair straightener. But the female members of my household do like the idea of straight hair, at least from time to time, and based on their usage thus far, they like the Remington Flat Iron Hair Straightener.

This personal hair care item scores points in several areas. For one, it heats very quickly. In a matter of minutes, it’s hot and ready for use. It heats up so well, in fact, that you have to be careful not to use some of the higher settings- your hair will be too hot to touch. My wife told me this happened to her and she has been careful not to use the high settings any more- her hair was so hot, it was like pulling laundry out of a hot dryer. The cord is nice and long, too, so it reaches far and makes it more convenient to straighten.

The two inch width of this hair care device is sufficient for most hair. It can handle a good enough amount of hair to get the job done in reasonable time. One small issue we have is with the power button. It is very small and requires pushing with a fingernail, unless you have very small fingers. However, this is also a positive point because it makes it more difficult to accidentally turn the power on. I also like that it has a power light. This way you know when it’s powered up and heating up.

Straightening hair is necessary from time to time and the ladies in my home like the Remington Flat Iron Hair Straightener. It has proven itself useful so far and works very well for the price. As long as you can get past the issue with the tiny button, you should find this a good, practical means for straighter hair.

title: Gets Hair and Body Clean with a Pleasant Scent
text:
Personal items made for men often have a manly, cologne- like scent and Axe is known for taking this concept and sometimes carrying it to extremes. Body washes often follow this trend, but Axe White Label Body Wash is a little different. It gets you clean with a fresh but not overbearing scent and it can be used on the hair or body, for maximum convenience.

Axe products have made their way into my home more than once and I have been satisfied with most of them. This 2 in 1 body wash and shampoo is as good as the rest, with a scent that is cologne- like, but with added aromas such as citrus and lavender. The manufacturer claims there are other scents present like wood, pralines, etc. but the ones I notice are cologne, citrus, and lavender. Okay, perhaps some wood but pralines?- I don’t know where they get that. The overall smell is pleasant and it’s neutral enough that the ladies in the home might even consider a squirt when in a pinch.

Axe White Label 2 in 1 hair and body wash is purple in color, applies easily, and washes clean with no residue. I normally don’t like to use these 2 in 1 products on my hair, but this one actually does a decent job with cleaning the hair and scalp. Of course, I don’t have as much hair as other people so my opinion on the matter may not carry much weight. But it does work well for this purpose and that means you don’t need a separate shampoo.

Axe makes lots of good, dependable men’s personal care products and Axe White Label 2 in 1 hair and body wash ranks among them. It’s less pricey than others and it does a good job getting you clean with a nice but not overwhelming scent. I like it enough to buy it again and I think most will agree that it’s as good as any other men’s body gel on the market.

title: Healthier, Happier Hair and Scalp thanks to CLEAR
text:
Dandruff and dry scalp are sometimes an issue for me. I usually keep a separate bottle of anti- dandruff shampoo on hand for occasional use and I’m always up for trying a new brand. This is what led me to consider CLEAR Men Scalp and Hair Anti- Dandruff Shampoo.

I have never used anything from CLEAR before so I went into this experience with no previous brand- name bias. And I am happy to report that the results are positive. My hair feels soft and my scalp feels less dry than before. There is less itching and my hair looks good.

This shampoo is thick and it has a scent that is menthol- like. When applied to the hair and scalp, it produces a cooling, tingling effect that is not unlike other shampoos with tea tree mint. Yes, it’s only a feeling, but it does make you feel like something special is happening to your hair and scalp. I like that the scent isn’t overbearing and the same could be said of the cooling effect. Some of these tea tree mint/medicated shampoos are too intense. CLEAR seems to have everything in check.

With its ability to control dandruff and make my hair look and feel great, CLEAR Men Scalp and Hair Anti- Dandruff Shampoo earns a high recommendation from me. I don’t know how readily available this product is at my local stores, but it’s definitely a product I will look for and purchase again.

title: Crank Your Way to a Convenient Shave
text:
Solarific Handcrank Personal Shaver is a hand- charged razor that functions with or without electric power. A handy device for those who spend a good deal of time in the outdoors or in places where electric outlets are scarce, it offers a means to a quick shave anytime, anyplace.

Easily the most appealing feature of this razor is the hand crank and this is the main reason I wanted to try it. I do not spend time camping or doing other things that would take me away from easy access to electricity, but the concept still appealed to me. My wife is a green activist and we are always looking for ways to save power, so the idea that a razor could be charged by turning a crank sounded interesting. And it turns out, it is very easy to use. It takes a few minute of continuous turning of the crank to charge it fully, but there is no need to spin the crank for that long- just turn it for a minute or so and you will have enough charge to use the razor. A red light glows when turning the crank, while a green light glows if you use the included electrical cord. Either way, a full charge will last for about 40 minutes, making it good for a couple weeks of use.

As I said, I like the concept of the Solarific Handcrank Personal Shaver and I like the price. What I am not too thrilled about is the quality of the shave. I have another electric razor I normally use, from Phillips, and this razor cannot compare. With Solarific’s 2 heads and other factors, it takes longer to get the job done. I had to continuously go over the same area of my neck again and again until this razor was able to grab the hair and shave it off. I also had to use a hand razor for touch- ups later, but that is okay, as most all electric razors require touch- ups afterward. The flip- up trimmer in the back is the same way- it works okay, but not as good as my other razor.

Emptying the Solarific Handcrank Personal Shaver is easier than with other razors. The push of a button, right under the heads, flips the top open and makes it easy to dispose of trimmings. On the other hand, the ease of opening is something you have to watch, for it is very easy to accidently push this button and send the small beard trimmings flying. Other razors take a little more effort to open and clean out, but are less likely to result in an unwanted disposal.

A hand-cranking razor is an interesting idea and I think this razor would be ideal for those who find themselves in places where electrical outlets are difficult to find. Its price is very good, too, but its shaving ability is not the best. Add everything up and it earns an average rating overall.

title: Nourishes the Hair and Scalp and the Scent is Nice
text:
Clear Scalp Therapy is a good hair conditioner for most any type of hair. I have been using this product for a few weeks now and generally like what I see.

I have short hair and I don't use or need conditioners very often, but even those of us with shorter hair need to turn to conditioners at some point. My scalp and hair tend to be dry and conditioners can make a difference. With this product, my hair does look shinier and it feels softer, with a certain slickness to the touch. It isn't an oily slickness, but more like the slick feeling you get when you touch something that is smooth and clean.

Because my hair is shorter, the positive effects are not as noticeable, but the wife- who has much longer and thicker hair than mine- agrees that this is a very good conditioner and I can see a difference in her hair when she uses it. The slickness I described above is certainly present, as is a certain amount of shine. I also notice that my hair is a little less brittle than before and there is less breakage at the root.

Overall, this is a very good conditioning product that I am glad I took the time to try. I like the performance better than that of my usual conditioner, Aussie, and I like the scent, too. It's definitely a good product to try, for all hair types.

title: Suave Helps Kids Control and Beautify their Hair
text:
My girls love to have their hair done and they want to look pretty. Since they are in elementary school, they also love and appreciate anything made specifically with kids in mind and for that reason alone, they really enjoy this product from Suave. It is made for kids and it helps to keep hair from frizzing and make it look its best.

Besides the kid- friendly factor and obvious kid appeal, this mousse is good for other reasons. It does control frizz, as promised, and the smell is very nice- fresh and clean, and not too heavy. It only takes a small amount applied to the hair to make it look its best and hair looks natural after applying. This is better than some other kid's hair styling mousse my girls have tried, some of which makes their hair look like an oil slick.

Suave seems to have hit the mark with this product. It does dispense very quickly and is therefore easy to waste, so you need to be careful when you use it. Otherwise, it is a very good hair care/styling product for kids and most any young girl- and parent- will find it better than average.

title: No More Tangles and Plenty of Shine
text:
Motions Hair Lotion is a product made for those with hair issues related to tangling, lack of shine, and overall manageability. A small amount added to hair, we are told, should help relieve some of these problems and make hair look shinier and healthier.

Putting this product to the test shows that most of what it claims is true and the most noticeable difference is the shine. Hair does look more radiant when this product is used and it takes only a small amount to achieve this goal. You don't necessarily need to coat all of your hair- just a small amount combed through the bottom section of the hair is enough to make it look shiny and healthy. The ladies in my house agree that the product is worth buying for this reason alone.

Another helpful quality is the ability to break up tangles. By adding some moisture and smoothness, tangles are broken up quickly. In this area, Motions is about as good as any, but I agree that there are other de-tangling products that work as well for less cost.

Hair management is easy when your locks are short and thin, but it can be a real challenge for those with thick/coarse hair that needs greater attention. Motions may not have a great scent, but it does make it easier to gain control of your hair and make it look healthy and vibrant.

title: No More Frizz with Motions Naturally You
text:
I have short, straight hair and in no way do I need any type of hair styling gel, oil, or anything else. But I do live in a house full of women who can use a product to help keep their wavy locks looking beautiful. This hair gloss from motions does exactly that, helping their hair keep the shape and look that they like.

Among the hair complaints from the women on my house, having their hair frizz is number one. I often point out that this was the standard back in the 1980's and they should consider it a fashion statement, but they are not amused. They do not want any frizz and this product from Motions is specially formulated to control this problem. They apply just a small amount and then finish styling their hair. It keeps hair in its present form so that there is no chance for frizzing.

This product, as expected, does add some gloss to the hair and that seems to be fine with the ladies in my home. They don't necessarily love the gloss, but they don't complain either. From what I gather, the main thing they want is frizz control and that is what they get with this product. They wash their hair, dry like usual, and then apply the gloss. The frizz is gone and doesn't return for the day.

So, in summary, this product appears to be a good one for accomplishing one main goal and it does earn a recommendation for that reason alone. It isn't the best product of its kind, according to my wife, but it is good enough to recommend.

title: Motions at Home Works Fairly Well on my Short, Thin Hair
text:
With shorter hair than most people, I don't have any great need for conditioner. But even I agree that conditioning the hair every now and then is still a good idea and I am game to try most any type of conditioner, just to see how it will perform. Curiosity is what led me to try this conditioner brand and now that I have used it a few times, my feelings are mixed.

First, let's talk about the good points. This product does succeed at adding moisture to the hair and it does make it feel soft. The difference is noticeable and in this regard, the product works as well as most other conditioners. Another thing I like is that the product doesn't weigh down my hair and make it look like I just got out of bed. I have had this issue with other conditioners and I was worried that Motions at Home would be the same. But my hair actually looks as full as before while still feeling soft, so the product scores points in this area.

Adding softness and moisture are very important, but this conditioner comes in short in other areas. For one, the scent isn't that nice or memorable. It doesn't get your attention the way some hair care products do and, in fact, the scent reminds me of a bar of soap. Another issue I have with this product is that it doesn't add the shine it promises. Of course, one must keep in mind that my hair is short, thinning, and a mixture of dark and gray. For others, the shine may come through but it didn't for me.

This conditioner is a little thicker than others and it takes a little more time to spread around and work into the hair. It also leaves a coating on the hair that doesn't rinse out right away. Other conditioners have similar staying power, but it seems a little more intense with this product. You can tell, after the hair is dry, that there is still some conditioner present, but your hair looks good and feels soft, so I suppose it doesn't matter.

My conditioning needs for my hair are minimal, but I do like to condition a few times per month regardless. Motions at Home Moisture Plus Conditioner satisfies my minimal needs, but it isn't the greatest conditioning product I have ever used due to its bland scent, lack of shine, and other concerns. It has proven itself an average product for me, but it may work better on those with thicker, fuller hair who condition more frequently.

title: Exotic in Name and Appearance, but Mostly Gimmick
text:
Axe Shock Body Wash with Glacier Water, Deep Sea Mint, and Menthol is another Axe shower gel for men; a shower gel made with a masculine scent and marketed to younger men looking for some female action. Its unique scent is distinctly male, with after- shave qualities and other added extras like the smell of menthol.

Looking first at the good points of Axe Shock Body Wash, I must admit that the scent is intriguing, even if not my favorite in the Axe lineup. You can smell the menthol and you can smell aftershave, but the mint is a little more difficult to detect, probably because the dominant scents overwhelm it. Another positive point is the product's cleaning ability. It makes a good choice when you are drenched in sweat and/or covered in dirt. It has the power to remove anything clinging to the skin and it rinses clean quickly.

The above qualities are nice, but I still do not rate Axe Shock Body Wash among the very best for a few specific reasons. First, it feels a little odd and slimy. The appearance is unusual, too, with hues that include green and blue with smell specs that almost seem to sparkle when held up to a light. I can only assume the manufacturer did this to make the product seem more exotic. They wanted the shower gel to look unusual and they did succeed, but I don't know if this was really necessary. After all, this is a body wash. It isn't supposed to double as a work of art.

Another quality I am not too thrilled with is the cooling effects of the menthol. I don't mind menthol in other personal care products, but in body wash? I don't prefer it, but I know there are others who are going to love this quality and rate it as one of the reasons to recommend the product. Finally, there is the issue of the marketing gimmick. Besides the appearance, the name suggests the use of glacier water and mint. Do I really care that the water came from a glacier? Also, there is no mint listed in the ingredients, but rather mentha aquatica leaf extract. It all sounds exotic, but it is more gimmick than anything and ultimately isn't as great as it sounds.

I find most of the Axe shower gels good and several better than average, but this one seems very middle-of-the-road to me. It certainly sounds exotic and intriguing, but it is really just an average product overall and more hype than anything.

title: Old Spice Fiji Body Wash makes you Smell like a Soapy Plant
text:
Old Spice Fresh Collection Fiji Body Wash is another entry in the Fresh Collection series and it easily sets itself apart from the typical men's bodywash. Rather than smell like cologne or aftershave, the Fresh Collection series often has other ideas in mind and the products under this name are a little different from the norm.

What sets this body wash apart from the majority of men's body wash products is its scent. It is the type of smell some will love but others will question and I happen to fall into the latter group. The smell of this product reminds me of plants combined with soap and I don't find it all that appealing. I know there are some consumers out there who will find this unusual combination intriguing, but it just doesn't do much for me.

Once you get past the smell, however, most men will agree that this is a good body wash product. It doesn't produce a large amount of lather and that is good because it means the gel is easy to rinse clean. There is no soapy residue left behind and you leave the bathroom feeling clean and fresh. The cleaning ability is good, too, and most will rate this product highly based on performance.

Old Spice Fresh Collection Fiji Body Wash has a somewhat lighter smell than other body washes, but depending on the quantity used, you will have no trouble smelling this body wash long after you step out of the shower stall. I try to keep my usage to a minimum in order to make the bottle last longer and also because, as I said, I am not that cray about the smell. Due to my minimum usage, my skin doesn't radiate the smell the way it often does after using other body wash products.

Old Spice has come up with some interesting ideas with its Fresh Collection series and its Fiji Body Wash is certainly unique among body washes. The smell isn't a strong point in my book, but many will enjoy it just fine and everyone will agree that this body was does perform as well or better than other men's body wash products.

title: Crest Sensitivity Extra Whitening Solves Tooth Sensitivity Issues
text:
Crest Sensitivity Extra Whitening Clean Mint Toothpaste is an effective product in the fight against tooth sensitivity. My teeth are not super- sensitive like those of some people, but I do have some issues with discomfort and it mainly occurs when eating or drinking cold foods and beverages. A toothpaste made specially for this problem is often all it takes to provide temporary relief.

Crest Sensitivity Extra Whitening Clean Mint Toothpaste is just one of many different sensitive teeth tooth care products. I have tried several and I find most are at least marginally effective. Crest Sensitivity Extra Whitening Clean Mint Toothpaste takes care of the problem slowly, with its effects becoming more and more noticeable with each passing day. Brush with this product day and night and you will feel the problem diminish over time, making it easy to eat ice cream, drink hot coffee, or enjoy other products that once set the nerves of your teeth on edge. I have noticed when I use this product that my front teeth seem to experience the most relief in the shortest amount of time, but I think the reason is because I tend to concentrate my brushing more intensely on my front teeth. Spending equal time brushing all teeth should result in more uniform relief.

Crest Sensitivity Extra Whitening Clean Mint Toothpaste is minty in flavor, but this is one area where I have some reservations. It isn't that the taste is bad- the problem is that it isn't as freshly minty as some of the more popular, non- sensitivity brands. There is a certain chemical dimension to the taste that will turn off some consumers who want their toothpastes to taste as fresh and mint- like as possible. I can tolerate it, especially if it gets rid of sensitivity issues, but I know that some consumers will not like it.

Tooth sensitivity is a curse, but it isn't one that everyone must live with. There are means to an end to this problem and Crest Sensitivity Extra Whitening Clean Mint Toothpaste is one of them. The flavor isn't as fresh as I would like but this toothpaste works well at cleaning, whitening, and eliminating sensitive tooth problems and these reasons alone make it worthy of a purchase.

title: Organix Shampoo Smells Nice, but Does it Perform?
text:
Organix Vanilla Silk Shampoo is a decent shampoo from Organix- a company I can usually count on for producing some good, effective hair care products. The company has made a name for itself as a shampoo maker that uses unusual ingredients in its products, openly indicated in the name so that consumers know exactly what they are getting. Everything from yogurt to pomegranate and beyond can be found in Organix hair care products and many consumers claim that these special ingredients do make a difference.

Organix Vanilla Silk Shampoo is actually one of the company's simpler products but it still has some good things going for it. The vanilla scent is one. It reminds me of the scent from a vanilla- scented air freshener. I also like the ability of this product to soften the hair and smooth it out. But other than these two qualities, this product is actually very average overall. One of its weaknesses is its inability to moisturize. This shampoo claims it is made for all hair types, but I don't see how it helps those with dry hair.

Organix Vanilla Silk Shampoo is easy enough to rinse out, if you have short hair. Those with very long hair may not be so fortunate, but it still passes the test in this area. As for its shine and softness claims, I agree that it does make hair a little softer, but the verdict is still out on the shining abilities. It isn't bad and I can think of other products that are much worse. The problem with Organix Vanilla Silk Shampoo is that it just isn't as good as its ability claims or price tag would lead you to believe.

Organix offers several good hair care products, but Organix Vanilla Silk Shampoo isn't one of them. It is okay, but nothing special and unless a consumer can find it on sale, its results are really not worth the price. There are other, better products on the market for the same or less money and I can therefore only rate this product average overall.

title: Good Shampoo that Delivers on its Promises
text:
Infusium 23 Moisture Replenishment Shampoo is a good product that helps those with dry hair by moisturizing the strands of hair, making them less brittle and hair more manageable. My hair and scalp are dry and I count on shampoo products like this to help alleviate the problem. Infusium 23 Moisture Replenishment Shampoo does exactly that- it adds moisture to dried- out hair strands and helps keep hair under control.

Infusium 23 Moisture Replenishment Shampoo cleans well and for those with short hair, a single washing is usually all that is necessary to get the hair clean. The product builds up a very good amount of lather- more than other shampoos and probably more than necessary. This fact concerned me at first, because I was worried that it wouldn't rinse out very easily. Fortunately, that isn't the case. It takes little effort and the shampoo is gone in seconds. The final result is a head of hair that is shinier than average, feels moisturized, and is free from worry.

I like this Infusium product overall, but one area in which I am undecided is the scent. It is like bar soap with a small amount of perfume and while I am pretty sure the manufacturer intended the scent to be gender- neutral, it is more on the feminine side and some men will not like it. I find it tolerable and certainly not so bad that I would discontinue use. Still, it would be nice if it had a little more masculine scent or if there was another version available with an aroma more in tune with the needs of men.

Dry hair is a problem and those who have dry hair know that it takes patience and special hair care products to get the dryness under control. Infusium 23 Moisture Replenishment Shampoo is a good product for this purpose. It makes hair feel more moisturized, adds shine, and adds to manageability. It is a little on the pricy side and the scent could be a problem for some users, but the product is still a good one that performs the way the manufacturer promises.

title: Effective Itch Relief from Head and Shoulders
text:
Head & Shoulders is a well- known and well- respected name in dandruff control and its products are generally effective and perform as promised. Head & Shoulders manufactures slight variations on its products from time to time and the latest is Head & Shoulders Itchy Scalp Care with Eucalyptus.

I have sampled this product and I have noticed a difference in itching. I have dry scalp and dry hair so anything that can help alleviate these problems is welcome in my home. This particular Head & Shoulders shampoo does help get itching under control and it leaves your hair feeling soft and manageable. I don't feel the urge to scratch as much as before, so the product receives good marks in this area.

Besides the itch control and the moisturizing properties, the other standout with this product is the scent. There is no mistaking that eucalyptus is one of the ingredients in this shampoo and you will realize it the moment you open the bottle. Besides the eucalyptus scent, there is also an element of menthol and this combination makes the product smell a little medicinal. This could be a turn- off to some consumers, although I found it perfectly fine.

Dry scalp and itchiness go hand in hand, but Head & Shoulders Itchy Scalp Care with Eucalyptus is here to remedy the problem. Its active ingredients help to moisturize the scalp and get the itching under control and while it is a tad on the expensive side, those who have these problems will likely consider the relief provided by this shampoo to be money well spent.

title: Organix Whitea Grapeseed Shampoo Tantalizes the Hair and Scalp
text:
I like to try new shampoos from time to time and Organix Reviving Whitetea Grapeseed Shampoo ranks as one of the more interesting shampoo products I have ever used. This shampoo includes many special ingredients to help heal and nourish the hair and scalp and it offers a great scent that combines herbs, floral, and fruity notes.

Organix Reviving Whitetea Grapeseed Shampoo gets your attention from the start, thanks to its very pleasant scent and gel- like consistency. Applying to the hair, this shampoo product feels like a powerful detergent and it goes to work at once. This shampoo includes several special ingredients, each with a specific purpose: Organic grapeseed oil for moisturizing; White tea and orange peel for healing and rejuvenation; and yogurt protein for nourishment.

Due to its heavy nature, Organix Reviving Whitetea Grapeseed Shampoo takes a little longer to rinse out than other shampoos, but the results are very nice. Once the hair is dried, it smells great and feels very soft. It cleans the hair very well and is more powerful than the average shampoo. Because of this, it may be too much for daily use for some people. It depends on your hair and scalp. If you have a more sensitive scalp, you may need to limit you use of this shampoo to no more than a few times each week. It may prove to be too harsh.

Organix makes several different shampoo products and many of them include unique ingredients you don't find in the typical hair care product. Organix Reviving Whitetea Grapeseed Shampoo is no different in this regard. It includes many special ingredients to clean your hair and scalp with a great scent to boot. Yes, the cost is somewhat high, but the results are very nice, with hair that smells great and feels soft.

title: American Crew Offers a Different Type of Shaving Cream
text:
American Crew Moisturizing Shave Cream offers a different means to a close comfortable shave. This product is white in color, like other shaving creams, but it has an interesting scent that combines menthol, herbs, and mint along with an interesting consistency that is more like paste than cream. It is specially formulated for coarse beards and it contains special conditioning agents such as added antioxidants, aloe, and avocado oil. These ingredients moisturize the skin and make it easier for a razor blade to glide across with little irritation.

Once you get past the unusual scent and interesting feel of this shaving cream, the next two surprises will be noticed the moment the paste touches your skin. First, this product actually has a cooling effect on the skin. Most other shaving creams and gels offer no feeling at all in terms of temperature. Second, this product is unique in the way it lies so flat against your face. Most shaving creams and gels produce a puffy foam that sticks out from the skin, but American Crew Moisturizing Shave Cream is different. It lies completely flat against your face, resulting in a look that is similar to someone who just covered his or her face in a mud mask.

In spite of these unusual characteristics, American Crew Moisturizing Shave Cream does produce a close, comfortable shave. The cool feeling and the way this product hugs the skin are unusual and these facts made me wonder if American Crew Moisturizing Shave Cream would be as good as I expected. But I can honestly report that this product does produce a very good shave. In addition, your skin feels healthier thanks to the added aloe, avocado oil, and other ingredients. Your skin is left feeling moisturized and refreshed after using this product.

American Crew Moisturizing Shave Cream is much more expensive than other shaving creams and gels and because of this, it is tough to justify using it on a continuous basis. But cost aside, this is a good product for shaving; offering an effective means to remove unwanted hair with a level of comfort and a quality that makes it easily worthy of the American Crew label.

title: Axe Skin Contact Soothing Scrub Cleans and Moisturizes
text:
Axe Skin Contact Smoothing Shower Scrub is one of many different body wash products manufactured under the Axe label and while I have used a few different Axe products, Axe Skin Contact Smoothing Shower Scrub is the only one of the Axe scrub products I have tried. I have liked the other varieties of body wash made by Axe, so I felt good about giving this one a try.

This product is different from the regular varieties of Axe for a few notable reasons. The most obvious difference is the gritty feel to this body wash. These small specs aid in scrubbing the skin clean and they are most definitely noticeable, but not in a negative way. They gradually dissolve away as you scrub, leaving clean, smooth skin behind.

Other differences with Axe Skin Contact Smoothing Shower Scrub include its scent and lotion- like qualities. The smell isn't like the regular Axe products. It combines scents that are masculine and cologne- like, along with citrus and even a touch of coconut. I knew from reading the label that Axe Skin Contact Smoothing Shower Scrub contained unusual ingredients like cactus milk, but I still expected a strong, cologne- like scent. There is a masculine scent present, but it isn't as strong as I expected. The addition of other ingredients gives it a certain air freshener quality, although it is still masculine at its core.

Axe Skin Contact Smoothing Shower Scrub produces positive cleaning results. This body scrub generates only a small amount of lather and because of this, the body wash rinses away very quickly. Another nice quality is that the scent doesn't linger for very long. This is nice for those who want some scent with their body wash, but don't want to smell like they doused themselves with after shave.

Axe Skin Contact Smoothing Shower Scrub is a very good product and it certainly lives up to my expectations. It leaves your skin feeling smooth, clean, moisturized, and fresh smelling without taking the scent to an extreme level. It might cost a little more than the budget- priced body scrubs, but the quality is better than average and it ranks as one of the better body wash/scrub products available.

title: Belli Prevents Stretch Marks, Moisturizes, and Smells Great
text:
Stretch marks are a problem for many different people and most people wait until they have stretch marks to do something about them. Of course, by that point it is often too late. The stretch marks may itch and they may leave a permanent mark on the skin that no over- the- counter treatment can ever correct.

Prevention is the key with stretch marks and one product designed to stop stretch marks before they start is Belli Elasticity Belly Oil. This product is specially formulated to help the skin stretch more readily and thus prevent or reduce the formation of stretch marks. This oil is heavily marketed toward pregnant woman since they have an obvious need to prevent stretch marks. With greater elasticity in the skin, it is therefore able to stretch more easily, thereby reducing the instance of stretch marks in pregnant women.

I don't have any immediate plans to get pregnant but I have found there are still uses for this oil. This body oil super- moisturizes the skin and this fact alone could make it a worthwhile alternative to ordinary body oils. From my experience, I have found that Belli Elasticity Belly Oil works wonders on dry elbows, and it could be very useful for other patches of skin that are prone to dryness. It leaves the skin feeling soft, clean, and moisturized.

Belli Elasticity Belly Oil is promoted as a product designed for the special needs of pregnant women, but it can actually help anyone who would like some added protection against ugly stretch marks. If you lift weights or have any other reason to worry about the formation of stretch marks, then Belli Elasticity Belly Oil can help. Pregnant women have the greatest need and represent the largest market for this type of product, but it can be used by anyone who worries about stretch marks and, as mentioned above, by anyone who would like a little therapy for their skin.

Belli Elasticity Belly Oil does seem to have many great things to offer. It does moisturize the skin very nicely and it does eliminate dryness, as well as preventing the formation of stretch marks. But there is one fact that could cause many potential customers to change their minds: The high price. Belli Elasticity Belly Oil carries a price that will place it out of reach for many and even those who can afford it could find the cost unacceptable. There are alternative oils that are priced at half the cost, so one really has to consider whether or not Belli Elasticity Belly Oil has enough special qualities to justify a purchase.

Stretch marks are an ugly, itchy reality for those who are pregnant and for others who partake in any type of activity that could result in excessive stretching of the skin. Belli Elasticity Belly Oil won't eliminate exisiting stretch marks, but it will control the ones that could appear in the future and it effectively moisturizes the skin to eliminate dryness. If you can get past the price, you could find many things to like about this product and it certainly ranks as a highly useful oil treatment for anyone who anticipates excessive weight gain or other stretching of the skin in a short period of time.

title: BIC's Best Disposable Razor
text:
I use disposable razors almost exclusively and they are one of a group of products where price and quality are directly correlated to each other. A cheap, inexpensive razor isn't likely to result in a comfortable shave. In my younger days, I would often reach for the cheaper varieties out of financial necessity. But today, I invest more time and money on shaving and other health care products. BIC Comfort 3 Advance is BIC's most expensive razor and it does rank a notch better than the other, more expensive members of the BIC family and several notches better than BIC's cheapest razors.

Judging by the ability to cut hair, this razor seems like a pretty good one. The cutting device offers three blades that get the job done in the most efficient manner possible. Each stroke sends three blades across the surface of your skin, cutting the hair more quickly and with less effort than other disposable razors. I did experience an occasional small cut (usually above my upper lip), but this is common with almost all hand operated razors.

The lubrication strips just above the blades offer extra protection by moisturizing the skin before the blades make contact. These strips release aloe and Vitamin E and you can feel them working with each stroke across your face. They leave a trail of moisture on the skin that is slippery to the touch but washes off quickly with water. This is one part of the razor, however, that wears out more quickly than the rest. After about four uses, I could feel a distinct difference in the amount of lubricant that was released from these strips. There was practically nothing left and their enhancement to the shaving experience was minimal. Also, since they do leave the skin feeling rather slimy, they make it more difficult to check for a close shave. When I shave, I am most picky about the moustache area and I tend to shave it more rigorously. I even turn the razor around and shave against the growth of the hair for added closeness. I always rub my fingers across the skin to check for closeness but this process is interfered with lubrication is present. The sliminess of the aloe and Vitamin E makes it feel like the shave was closer than it really was. This is why you must remember to wipe off the slimy lubricant before you administer the touch test.

The handle of BIC Comfort 3 Advance is designed to make shaving easier. The wider bottom fits nicely into the palm of the hand while the narrow middle is good for gripping between the fingers. The raised "bubbles" (for lack of a better word) offer a gripping surface and they are placed in several strategic places on the handle. This design is a good one and it ranks with some of the better, more expensive disposable razors.

BIC Comfort 3 Advance is just like other disposable razors in at least one regard: It has to be thrown away in about one to two weeks. Based on my experience, this razor is good for about seven to twelve days depending on the density of one's hair and the frequency of shaving. I shave once every day so with this razor, I can expect to get through one full month with about three or four razors. This is a little bit better than other disposable razors and it helps to partially justify the extra cost.

Overall, the BIC Comfort 3 Advance is a very good razor from BIC and it ranks as the best disposable BIC razor I have tried thus far. The price per razor is almost greater than BIC's other varieties but when it comes to disposable razors, the added cost is worth it. Better grip, efficient cutting, and improved comfort make this one of the better disposable razors on the market.

title: Depends on what YOU think curl elixir is.... Spoiler Alert - this is hair oil.
text:
I am guilty of ordering natural hair care products at an alarming rate - always looking for the holy grail of products that will make my curls pop, my hair moisturized, and my 2nd/3rd/4th day look on point. I have found some of those products (TGIN curling mousse) and acknowledged that some of these products aren't for me... This one falls somewhere in the middle. I ordered it thinking it would be a product that helped with my 2nd/3rd day look. It does, kind of. This is not going to make your curls pop. It's essentially hair oil. It's a nice light hair oil and it smells nicely. I have sprayed it on my hair at night before bed to keep it moisturized in the bonnet (and that has worked). I have also sprayed it on my hair as a pre-shampoo treatment - and I guess that's fine, I didn't notice much of a difference. I have also sprayed it on to styled (wash/product/go) hair for shine and it's okay - It didn't add much in my opinion.

So bottom line - if you need and like spray hair oil, this might be a great product for you - if you don't, then I'd move on and find something else.

title: A bit too thick for me...
text:
So...I think your desire for gel thickness will determine if you like this particular gel.

First the good things - it smells great. This has a nice light scent. It also creates and holds curls pretty well IF you need a heavier gel (I do not hence the score).

Now the cons, this is pretty thick. When I use it (because I hate to waste products), I tend to water it down (with water) to make it easier to spread and less likely to clump in my curls. I prefer to thinner gel (like Jane Carter). If you have thicker hair or a tighter curl pattern and need a heavier gel, this may work for you - it might just be experimentation. When I thin it out with water, it works just fine.

The issue with the product is the spray bottle. It creates a hard stream instead of a bit of a spray/spritz. This means it's hard to get the product all over your head. It took me a while to pinpoint what I didn't like about the product, but then I transferred it to another spray bottle that I could create more of a spritz with and voila! Perfection.

title: Great for 2nd, 3rd, and 4th day curls...
text:
