I use this as my 2nd, 3rd, 4th day curl refresher. I use a curl moisturizing spray to dampen my hair a bit, then i use this mousse in a circular motion to get my curls poppin. I sometimes add a little gel or curl cream after, but don't always need it after using the mousse. This holds my curl without making them crunchy. I'd also like to note that this does actually moisturize my hair, which is why I don't usually use a curl cream after using this. On the 3rd or 4th days, my curls may be wilting a bit, and I'll use a light gel for hold. It's also worth noting, this doesn't really hold, so if you're looking for hold - you need to follow this up with some gel.

title: Great at home Gel manicure!
text:
I purchased this as an experiment to see if I could reasonably do my own gel nails at home. The price was less than one visit to the salon - so why not. The verdict - great choice! I really like this nail lamp. Just to be clear, this is an UV lamp. It takes 120 seconds (2 minutes) to cure the nail polish. When I researched UV versus LED lamps, I decided to go with UV because it would cure any nail polish, not just special LED curable ones.

The lamp has a setting that will leave it on until you turn it off and a setting for timer that can be used with the 120 seconds switch in the back. This allows you to just hit the switch and it will turn off when your 2 minutes are up. The opening/tray on this is large enough to put my full hand in (including thumbs) and large enough for my husbands significantly larger hands. I can also fit my toes in the opening. The sliding tray is pretty helpful for not bumping your fingers on the top when removing your hands.

I used gel polish I got through a groupon deal to try this out and it worked very well. I'm still getting the hang of polishing my nails (please don't judge my pics), but they are nice and hard and set to a hard and beautiful shine. Make sure to follow whatever directions your polish has (including using rubbing alcohol to set the polish). All in all, for less than a manicure costs, I think this baby packs a mean punch!

So this is about as light as it appears and that probably doesn't matter a whole lot for a primer. The better question is how it interacts with the eyeshadow. I've used MAC, Clinique, and Urban Decay eyelid primers. I love my urban decay eyelid primer - it's the perfect shade for me.

I found this relatively easy to put on and I was able to use a sponge to rub it in so the color almost didn't matter, it just added a slight lightening of the eye. In terms of primer, this gets the job done. I think the Urban Decay is better at keeping my eyeshadow in place and allowing me to blend the way I want to, but for the price, this works. I added a picture of the raw product and it rubbed in a bit on my arm for reference.

One last note, like other reviewers, I thought the bottle felt a bit empty. This didn't last very long - again for the price that could be expected, but you'll be purchasing this frequently if you do your make-up daily.

title: Nice long lasting matte color.
text:
All in all, I really like this Matte Lip Color. It's not insanely bright and goes on very smoothly. It's not a lip stain, so it does fade a bit with wear. I think how much it fades will depend on the normal stuff (how much you drink, eat, rub your lips, etc.) and if you top it with a gloss. Overall, at the end of a normal day, I can still see the color on my lips.

As for the color, the picture doesn't offer a swipe, but the bottom of the container makes it look pretty dark wine. It's a nice wine color, but I found it to be a bit lighter than I expected. It certainly isn't rocket red or anything, but lighter than expected. I posted pictures of the color on my lips for reference.

title: Just what you need to make those Youtube tutorials a reality!
text: I'm not a make-up professional. I watch youtube videos like the rest of the amateurs and then go try to recreate the looks I see, often to hilarious and results - other times to flawless. It takes practice and good tools, cheap-o brushes just will not do. I have a few of the real Techniques sets and I LOVE them. You, of course, have to get used to the brushes and decide what tools you like for what, but I have found these brushes to be soft, easy to use, and blends nicely. I'll continue to buy real Techniques brushes. They are also quite sturdy.

title: Doesn't seem to be working
text: I bought the RoC Retinol Correxion, Deep Wrinkle Serum a month ago after reading the good reviews it received from other consumers.  Not knowing the age, or skin type of the other fine reviewers I was just hopeful that it would work for me...sadly it hasn't seemed to make any difference in my wrinkles whatsoever.  I will tell you that I am 44 years old.  I am brunette and didn't really get any wrinkles until I hit my 40's.  I have an olive complexion and try not to spend too much time in the sun (I do live in Arizona however) so when I do go out into the sun of course I use sun screen. I only have wrinkles on my forehead but there are two deep wrinkles right where my eyebrows meet my nose (on each side, I don't have a uni-brow just yet:) that make me look like I'm always scowling.  Anyhoo, I have been applying the serum to my forehead every day, twice a day for about a month now and nothing has happened.  Nada, zip, zilch, zero, difference.  I still have my DEEP wrinkles on my forehead and the two DEEP wrinkles above the bridge of my nose.  In fact I would say that the added moisture to my skin has kind of made it more oily thus causing breakouts...YUCK.  So I continue to look like an angry brunette (I look angry because of those nasty wrinkles between my eyebrows) and I'm out $20 bucks (including shipping).  I would say if you have dry skin this couldn't hurt because at least it will moisturize but if you have naturally oily skin you might want to reconsider...unless of course your partial to adult acne.

I read several positive  reviews on this B.B. cream, so I decided to try it.  I apply my B.B. cream mixed with my moisturizer so it isn't so "thick'.  When I mixed this with my moisturizer it still maintained it's thickness.  I imagine that the high S.P.F. of 45 had a lot to do with it. This has more pigment than I care for.  My other B.B. cream is white and turns to beige upon application, but when I wipe in on my towel , it. doesn't leave a beige mark. I notice that this has a lot more beige pigment in it especially when I wipe it on my towel almost reminding me of makeup but much more dilute, however, still a little bit bothersome to me.  I have ruddy skin and what I was looking for in a B.B. cream is something to hide the redness when I blush. which is frequently. This is kind of beigish and I haven''t seen myself blush in the mirror yet. I do know that I will use up this tube over the summer on the occasions that I will got to public places where I may become redder., but I don't think I will buy it again.

title: Very Nice Shaver
text:
This singular, monolithic shave head that removes in one piece. This makes cleaning all 7-heads SO much easier than trying to pop open seven individual shaver heads and keep them open when you're brushing out the whiskers. I can't easily get to a sink and I tend to clean my razor at least once if not twice during a shaving session. I wouldn't want to shave with a wet razor when I'm dry shaving my head.
This gives a decent shave though the head is less flexible than most multi-head razors.
For the ease of cleaning alone I'd recommend this razor.

title: Good Razor
text:
First and foremost I just wanted to point out this design looks like it has a pivoting head. It doesn't. The head is fixed in place. The cutters and screens are spring mounted but that's it. Another flaw, nothing not to use the razor over but still annoying is the location of the power button. Why they didn't recess it into the bottom on the handle below or above charging port? I have to juggle holds to shave my head all over and invariably I turn the razor off three or four times per session.
I know this sounds like I'm only feeling negative about the razor but I'm not. I just wanted to touch on those two things because they're important to me. The razor which i use for a finishing cut (using a foil razor to finish is something I learned from a local barber) after using a 7-head rotary shaver for an initial shave. It's amazing how much this picks up even after my head feels and looks smooth. It does take quite a few passes over my entire head to get done. It will probably get easier as I go.
Battery life is outstanding. I've shaved my entire scalp, my cheeks and throat with upwards of five passes over some areas, three times now and there's 68 minutes of runtime left.

title: Sandalwood Scent Really Lasts
text: I like this product. I'm very accustomed to alcohol based aftershave. I've tried oil based products and truly disliked the way they felt. This product is witch hazel based whis is completely new to me (as an aftershave at least) but so far I like it. I'm a major fan of sandalwood it's the only incense I burn. The bottle is a nice size for traveling and just as good at home. I shave my head and face at the same time and found spraying this on a gloved hand and then I can apply the product to my skin where needed. The scent fills the room and lingers for a good while on the skin. It does a nice job as a moisturizer. All in all I like this and will also spritz some on my sheets and pillows.

title: Feels/Sounds Like It Is Going To Break
text:
Okay, first and foremost the power button is 8n the STUPIDEST place possible. Directly in the center of the flat side, right where you're going to hit it every time you change your grip, not so much shaving your face but trying to shave my head I must have turned the razor off a dozen times.
The foil heads are set up one above the other by about a quarter of an inch. You want both foils contacting your skin at the same time so you need to use an angle. It works but it's awkward.
I got a decent shave with a couple patchy spots but I had to go over my head at least twenty times.
Cleaning is easy, either blow the beard dust out/off of the foils, the cutters and the cover or rinse it under the faucet real quick. I recommend dry cleaning until you're sure your done, then doing a thorough job under the faucet.
The case is handy though I had to squeeze the USB-C cable in next to the unit. The net area for storage puts the cable on top of the unit and you can't zipper it closed. I've always got a wall wart and nine foot cable when I travel so not having one in the razor case isn't a problem. The case is handy to keep everything else you own clean.
Unit isn't excessively loud. Though there's cracking noises from the posts the cutters are mounted on and the foil can flex and dent in.
Not my favorite razor but not the worst I've used.

title: Attractive and Functional
text:
My beard after seven months in the hospital was a horrible mess. I got these clippers and used them that day after a couple hours charging. With the longest comb attached it went through my scraggly mess like it wasn't there. Why do some manufacturers not include long combs? I settled for the 1/2” because it was the longest (I guess I misread thinking there was a 3/4” comb included) but I would really have liked a full 1" comb. I'm pale, my beard is silver. When it's fairly short it doesn't even look like I have facial hair from a short distance. Rant aside I was very pleased with how these cut with and without the comb. No pinching, grabbing or jamming. We clipped my goatee with a comb and the rest of my head, cheeks, skull etc. With the blades retracted to their shortest setting.
The body of the clippers have nice weight, not light and cheap feeling but also not so heavy your hand will get tired. The info display just about disappear when the unit is off. The body is a very attractive purple fading to silver at the end.
My face and head were done thoroughly, going over all areas 2-3 times and the battery barely dropped 5%. These should last quite a few shaves before needing a recharge.
This came with a bunch of accessories, comb, scissors, cape and oil. I guess the cape is useful though the material is very thin. The scissors and comb aren't very high quality if you had nothing else I guess they'll do until you can replace them. The oil is a nice plus. I've had some sellers in the past open the sealed box and remove the oil bottle. Clippers should be oiled frequently to maintain cutting quality.
I was rather impressed with these clippers.

title: Aromatherapy Rocks
text: I'm a big fan of aromatherapy. I will take my time in the shower while I blade shave my head. It's a real pleasure to have the added scent and uplifting feeling from the shower pucks dissolving. It turns a chore into a relaxing pleasure. Not crazy about the soaps, I'm a bodywash fan but got this specifically for the aromatherapy in the shower.
