The product lathers and rinses well and while it got my hair clean it left it flat and lifeless the several times I used it. This isn't a product I'd recommend or use again.

title: Great Groomer/Trimmer
text: This is my 2nd 3-In-1 Groomer from Gillette. The first got a lot of use and broke after an accidental drop. I love how close this gets. It's nicer than shaving and even though the head is narrow I can zip through trimming my face in less time than I can with bigger clippers. Not having to plug the trimmer in or recharge it is nice. I have handfuls of rechargeable batteries around the house.

title: Clean hair with good flake and itch control.
text:
A decent shampoo from Head & Shoulders. I've finally gone from extremely long hair which I wouldn't trust 2-in-1 shampoos to take care of to a much more manageable hair length and can take advantage of the dual care product.

This product boasts new fresh scent technology that is supposed to give an improved in-shower experience. Eh, it smells a lot like regular old Head & Shoulders, maybe a little more potent and sweet in the shower but nothing that would make you stand up and shout "Wow!"

I had been using a competitor's anti dandruff product for a while and it was losing its effectiveness. After using this Head & Shoulders product for a week now the returning flakes are just about completely gone and the scalp itchiness has drastically decreased.

Although my hair's fairly short right now I can see a definite volume increase in the hair I have.

I'll definitely get this product again. It works well. Head & Shoulders has always been a good, go to product for dandruff and itch control.

title: Awkward Clipper, Decent Shave...
text:
I prefer a slightly scruffy look so a good clipper designed for the face is something I keep my eye out for. I've used this numerous times to clip my face (except for my goatee) down to stubble and have used the shave head a few times. I have not used the body grooming head.

I find the clipper head very awkward to use. It mounts in an odd angle/position and I can't find a really comfortable grip to use this easily and comfortably. With that said it does a decent job of cutting the hair on my cheeks and neck very short.

The shave head mounts in a more conventional position on the body and although it only has to heads instead of the typical three a rotary system has it produces an acceptable shave. It isn't the closest electric shave I've ever had but it does the job and does it with limited irritation.

The body grooming head I have not tried. I do no body grooming or sculpting and the head is designated for use below the neck only so I have no experience with that facet of the device.

All in all... It's not great. But for one device that does three jobs, two of which I can attest to being decent, it isn't bad. You can probably spend more for several different devices to do the individual jobs far better but this would be good for throwing in the gym bag or keeping in the office desk for that quick touch-up.

title: Gives a Good Shave.
text:
This Philips Norelco AT790/40 Caretouch razor gives a decent shave. I've used it several times now and I haven't had any problems with it or any real complaints about it.

The razor is quite quiet. When I first used it I thought it sounded underpowered or low on charge but it powered through two days worth of stubble without a hitch.

Using this razor gave far less irritation than most electric razors. It can be used with shaving cream or gel but it is not a true wet/dry razor. Don't take this in the shower with you!

The trimmer is mounted somewhat further forward on the barrel of the razor than some others that I've used. This makes it a bit easier to trim my moustache and sideburns than other razors. It's still somewhat awkward but it's not a horrible task.

My only complaint is the 30 - 40 minutes of charge the razor holds. I find myself just using it and leaving it plugged in when I'm done.

title: I Like This Razor
text:
Right off the bat let me say this razor doesn't give the closest shave. It's nowhere near manual blade close. But more than any other razor I've tried over the years gives me the most comfortable shave I've ever had. After shaving my skin doesn't feel tight or hot and there are no tender or irritated spots.

I've used the razor both wet and dry. The results are so similar that it is really personal preference; do you want to shave in front of the mirror or in the shower? I like using the mirror.

I wear a long Van Dyke style beard and can shave right up to the edge without the Panasonic grabbing onto the longer hair like some razors like to do.

The trimmer is in an awkward spot It pops up perpendicular to the shaving head on the reverse side of the handle. It's usable but not the best design.

Clean-up is a breeze. Put a little liquid soap on the foils, splash on some water and run for a minute. Then open the slide under the shaving head and run water through the unit. Pop off the foils to thoroughly rinse the cutting blades.

All in all this is a comfortable razor to shave with though the trimmer could be better positioned. It's attractive as far as razors go. It holds enough of a charge for several shaving sessions. The charging stand holds the razor vertically so it takes up little counter space.

Are there better razors out there? Sure. Some cut much closer, hold a longer charge, do self cleaning but they also cost a LOT more than the Panasonic ES-Sl41-S. You'll get a good shave at a economical price. To me, that's all I need in a razor.

title: Pretty Good Trimmer
text:
I received this trimmer just about four months ago and after using it several times a week on both my nose and ear hair I'm happy to say I'm still on the original battery I installed the day I got this.

The trimmer does a good job of cutting close. I recommend using a mirror, especially on the nose or you will miss things. I've only had it grab hair and yank instead of trim once or twice which is far better than the last trimmer I purchased.

This trimmer is sold as Wet/Dry but I see no evidence of o-rings in the battery compartment to ensure a water tight seal. I would not use this in the shower or allow it to be submerged in water.

The 'Vortex Cleaning System' the trimmer boasts is just an open/close vent at the base of the cutter head that allows you (with the trimmer on) to run it under a stream of water for superior cleaning capability. The instructions even remind you to mind the position of the exit port to avoid splashing water all over. I've tried the Vortex system under two sink faucets and a bathtub faucet. None of which produced more than a trickle of water out the exit port and I really wasn't impressed with how clean it left the unit. It was far easier and you can get the trimmer much cleaner by disassembling it and cleaning it with the small brush it comes with. This task is easily accomplished. Disassembly and reassembly are a breeze.

All in all it's a good trimmer that does it's job well and uses little power so you'll save money on batteries.

title: Sticky, uncomfortable, and difficult to work with.
text: (This is the review of a performer, who over decades has worked with numerous different types and brands of products.) I bought this product because I have bought other products from this company that I liked, and was looking for a matte finish gloss that wouldn't cost $15+ dollars. This seemed ideal. First, I put this product on dry, unprimered, unchapped lips. Immediately, it smelled awful. The color does not go on evenly, and settles in to every line and pore. It dried quickly, and felt sticky. I figured as it dried more, that stickiness would disappear (the way many glosses do). It doesn't. It stays sticky. The worst part is that after five minutes, when I pressed my lips together, the color "broke", so I had to reapply, which made the color even more uneven. I decided to start over. I tried to remove it with a makeup remover cloth. That was an awful experience. It was painful, and the color left a stain on my skin. I put on Chapsick first to make my skin less dry and a bit more soft. After the Chapstick dried, I reapplied the color. The color was lighter, went on smoother, but was still uneven. It settles into the creases and corners, and requires blotting with the fingers, which then stains your fingertips. It was passable, but still sticky, but the color eventually darkened to that black currant color on the chart (I have olive/tan skin). It's not worth it, though, when there are less expensive options which don't end up sticky and don't cause this much trouble. Also, this lipstick comes off on everything your lips touch as you wear it, including but not limited to - cups, straws, silverware, and children.

text:
That sounds better than a hand soap snob, which I'll be the first to admit that I am. I'm always looking for that perfect soap that cleans well without drying my hands, smells great without artificial fragrances, and isn't full of unhealthy stuff. If you have tried them all like I have, then you know that even some of the most natural-sounding soaps, once you use them, have that smell and feel of the same industrial products we can buy on the supermarket shelf. This hand soap is different. This is more of a craft soap, probably made in smaller batches with love & attention by hand. I don't know that, but the product itself gives me that impression.

It is not, as one reviewer mentioned, as thick as some other hand soaps, which makes me wonder what actually makes soap thick & viscous because this soap is certainly not watered-down in any way. This soap has a rich & creamy feel on the skin, but it works into a nice strong lather that let's me know that my hands are clean. This is the first product I've tried from The Naked Bee, and not only would I buy it again and recommend it to others, it makes me want to try their other products too, and that is the sign of a quality product.

title: Much better than my old rotary shaver
text:
I took a chance and was surprised at how well this shaver works. I have been a Norelco user since I first started shaving. I tried Remington years ago and Braun, both foil shavers and they weren't as comfortable as Norelco.

Lately, I haven't been getting a short enough cut from my rotary, so time to buy a new one, because the replacement blades are $40, so why not upgrade--what Norelco wants--right. I read the reviews online for best razer and this one popped up a few times. More research suggested this was the one to take a chance on and I'm glad I did.

The razer not only gives a comfortable shave it cuts closer than the old rotary ever did. And faster too. must be those 4,000 rpm blades doing their work. It's good for about 10 shaves. I only shave every two days because my beard is still trim the second day.

I didn't go for the self cleaning one for $100 more because I didn't want to mess with the soap and I really didn't want to spend the money.

Turns out I can rinse it in the sink for 30 seconds and turn it on and hold the on button which switches it to cleaning high volume for a sharper vibration for 3 seconds and it's clean. The manual says I can add soap but really it's not needed.

I can whole heartedly recommend this razer.

title: This stuff works
text:
Okay, I'm 70 years young and just stumbled across Williams Lectric Shave. I had put a new razor on my Christmas list because I just wasn't getting a close shave anymore, and the Norelco rotary shaver was irritating my skin.

So I tried this based on reviews and guess what? My new shaver is not longer on my Christmas list.

When I apply it, my beard does stand up. Shaving time is cut in half, and the shave is soft and smooth, no irritation. I wish I'd known about this 50 years or so ago.

I learned that it works better when I use a bit more. I was going spare inly at first. Just enough to wet it down properly. The smell when applied that way was too strong, so I hold my breath to avoid the fumes and they are gone promptly, so just taking about holding it a few seconds.

My only other comment is all the reviewers positive comments are true. This is great stuff and it lasts forever. Well, for a long time. I've barely used any in the 2 weeks I've been using it.

Also, pay close attention to the description--it says: "11" from top of mirror to bottom of handle". This is accurate - the actual mirror is maybe 6-7" diagonal. title: So far so good, but blade oil is NOT included and the pictures are misleading (not waterproof)
text:
After several attempts at trimming my hair with what I had (beard trimmer), I decided it was time to get something with a little more power. This fit the bill perfectly and indeed managed to produce a passable (almost) haircut in about 15 minutes. The Beard trimmer took much longer. I say passable because the lack of haircut capabilities lies with with the haircutter, not the tool. I have used this once, and it did a great job. My only design complaint is the body is pretty slippery, and your hand will get sweaty maneuvering this thing around your noggin--droppage is possible. It would be nice if it were somewhat grippier.

Additional issues: 1) a picture in the product listing here clearly shows someone putting the whole thing under the faucet, but the instructions tell you not to do this, and clearly indicate the only waterproof part is the trimmer blade, which you have to remove to clean. Misleading. 2) The trimmer is supposed to come with a small vial of oil to lubricate the blade. Nope, no oil.

title: The perfect beard comb for longer beards - a case would be nice!
text:
When I decided to grow my beard out longer, I discovered there is a whole world of high quality beard care products out there--after half a lifetime wasted using cheap, inferior combs. This is an excellent, high-quality product, which does a beautiful job of combing my beard without snagging. The teeth are cut with a saw and milled/polished to a smooth tip by hand. This means they don't have a seam from injection molding like cheaper combs, and the right width/tooth density for your hair type (this one is a medium sized tooth--just right for longer beards) will not snag your hair at all. The teeth on the Kent fine comb are a bit too close together for the thick hairs of my beard, but the ones on this are just perfect. Highly recommend.

Note: I wish they also sold a nice leather sleeve for this comb so it would stay clean and lint-free in your pocket. I am using a felt sleeve made for small reading glasses, but it is less than ideal. I have ordered a leather sleeve made for two pens, and hopefully, that will do the trick. Kent would be doing their customers a solid by offering a high quality leather sleeve for another $10 or so. Kent--are you listening? (August Grooming makes a lovely comb case, but it is not wide enough to accommodate this comb. :( )

title: What a difference quality makes!
text: When I decided to grow my beard out longer, I finally discovered there is a whole world of high quality beard care products out there, after half a lifetime wasted using cheap, inferior combs. title: Brush is just okay, comb is cheap junk and will harm your beard
text:
I bought this kit hoping to get a decent set of a beard comb and brush. Sadly, what I received was cheaply made and poorly finished--a serious problem when it comes to beard combs. The hallmark of a high quality comb are seamless, completely smooth teeth which do not snag and harm your hair. This comb has sharp, rough edges on the teeth (the tines are only rounded near the tips) and it is not smooth or gentle at all. It snagged my beard repeatedly. I have included photos of the poorly finished tines--they are barely sanded and have small burrs which will snag your hair. I have done plenty of woodworking in my life--if I were so inclined, I could sand each tine individually by hand myself with a fine grit sandpaper to make them smooth, but frankly, when a higher quality comb can be purchased for $12, I can't be bothered. I will not be using the comb, and have notified Amazon of this issue. Look at the completely unfinished interior edges of the tines in the pictures. Junk.

The brush is cheaply made as well, and I worry that as several bristles have already fallen out, it may lose more when washed. This set is simply not a high quality product, and I cannot recommend it--in fact, it is junk. I am rating it only one star, as the set has no positive qualities and I now have to go do more research, buy something else instead and toss this cheap crap. I wish I had spent a little more and bought something better in the first place.

title: Does not rinse cleanly at all - cannot recommend

I have been using their products for years, and generally stick to the Miraculously Moist shampoo (I do not use conditioner, as I do not like the feeling of having something still in my hair after I rinse it). This feels like it has a lot of conditioner or something in it. Yes, it leaves your hair feeling smooth, but also heavy, like there is something in it, like a leave-in conditioner. I now find myself having to rinse my hair out twice in the shower, which increases time and water use (here in southern California, we try to conserve water), and there is no way you can skip a day without washing your hair with this stuff--it looks and feels dull and dirty the next day. This is just not a good shampoo, and when this bottle is gone, I am switching back to the other one.

I get a few cuts in before I have to recharge it which is fine. I haven't used any attachments with it since I'm always going as close to the scalp as possible anyway but so far I'd give this set of a clippers my seal of approval. I usually end up frantically rubbing my nose when done using one of these because it pulls the hairs versus cutting them. I was pleasantly surprised with this one I didn't experience that at all. I have used it several times and have yet to see power loss so the battery lasts for quite some time.
BONUS: It has a cover, so the nasty little goo hairs don't end up finding their way into a drawer.

title: Built to last!
text:
These don't particularly look like they are high quality but the stainless steel really allows them to work well. It's also nice to be able to clean them rather than have a pumice stone that generally absorbs some of what is scrubbed off.
I tend to have to really scrub as I don't tend to my feet as often as I should but I don't have issues with a raw foot when I am done. The handle held up well to the pressure as well (though I wasn't trying to apply all I had, which would kind of be disgusting if I needed to do so).
HIGHLY recommend!

title: Good product, weird scent choice
text:
The product has great hold and really allows for the ability to style with hold. I don't like paste because it is either too thick or thin and then hold is temporary. Clay really helps solve that issue because the texture just doesn't work if you use too much so you have to do that in layers. It also has great hold.

The issue here is they used eucalyptus as an ingredient so it has a cough drop type scent which is hit or miss for people on a pleasant scent.

title: Joe Exotic
text:
If you toss a ball cap on top, you've got a near perfect start to becoming Joe Exotic for Halloween.
Carole Baskin did... well you know the rest.

title: Works well
text: Overall I found the scent to be very pleasant with this product. It doesn't really dry with too much of a hold, but I've found it helps provide an excellent boost when applying before blow drying my hair. The effects of the product really seem to shine as a blow drying agent rather than a standalone product used to hold and add curl effects.

title: Smell good, feel good
text:
Great moisturizing product and the smell is nice! I really enjoy this product, but was hoping it would come in a larger bottle. It is a thicker liquid soap (some are very runny) so that was nice to see, and also not have most drip onto the shower floor.

Loving this one!

title: Just ok
text:
I am not sure what the deal is with paste lately but I have struggled to find a decent one. The paste isn’t easy to work into the hair as I am used to and it is either too thin or too thick. There is another brand that sells a decent paste but this review is about this product.

The upside here is that it has a decent smell and if you are willing to work it through with a comb after putting in your hair you’ll be ok with this product.

title: Ok
text:
Middle of the road. It’s not great in that it doesn’t really easily work into the hair. It requires a bit more product than I’m used to using and then that causes the hair to be too weighed down to be able to properly style it.

I didn’t notice much of a scent either and that’s usually a nice bonus for these types of products.

This product was just ok for me.

title: Not worth it
text: I was expecting this to have some sort of decent smell to it since it has the look of more of a musk smelling item. Looks so deceive as it smelled more bland with a hint of chemical. It didn’t seem to have much more effect than washing with a mild soap.

title: Not great
text:
My son has fairly dry, flat hair so I purchased this to see how well it would work for him. Unfortunately it just makes his hair look like it has been unwashed for several days. I think the same results would come from simply add olive oil to his hair. It also seems to leave the product on your hands more so than the hair and is quite difficult to wash off.

The upside is that it does smell good. That seems to be all though.

title: Love it
text:
Hold
Excellent overall and it dried for a nice clean matte look versus shiny.

Scent
Amazing. There is something about this brand though that I’ve always enjoyed this scent.

Spray nozzle
This tends to be an issue for most aerosol hair spray items because it gets clogged. The tip here is to either wipe the nozzle when finished or tip upside down to clear the nozzle each time. This isn’t particular to just this bottle but it does help. Outside of that the spray nozzle is a wider one so it makes it less likely to snap off as the can is used (thinner ones tend to bend over time)

title: Great smell, but started leaking
text:
The product hits on the fact that it smells great. The smell also does last for quite some time.

The issue my wife had with this bottle is after about 1.5 months the ring around the top started leaking. This has required her to hold the bottle incredibly still while spraying the bottle. She also has to keep something underneath since it’s slowly and constantly leaking.

title: Buy it.
text:
I waited awhile to write this review.

The product works perfect. It has held its' power over the past several months of daily use. It has been dropped once (onto wood floor) and functioned well and did not crack.

The heat/warm/cool settings work as expected.

The cord doesn't seem to be wanting to become a tangled mess which is awesome.

title: Smack, right on
text: Smells like Dr. Pepper, has a little bit of a sweet taste to it, and brings back impressions and memories of the 70's.  On top of that it lasts and effectively keeps lips moisturized and soft.

title: Au Revoir Gray Hair
text: Finally a henna that works! This was my last try with henna. I've tried two other brands and was not successful, plus the coloring time was ridiculously long. I left this on for two hours despite it saying thirty minuted, but I'm not sure if the extra time was necessary. My hair is relaxed (chemically processed) and I didn't want another harsh chemical on my hair. I am not yet ready to "rock" gray hair, and my hair has stubborn grays. This was the best solution. Hairline saved! Advice: rinse out forever and a day and use a deep conditioner afterwards. It's drying. The dark brown was (for me) a touch too dark, too close to black, but 1. I'm not sure if this is because I left it on for longer and 2. I am so grateful that the henna worked. Next coloring I will go for the chestnut color on the new growth.

title: Good and Gentle Soap
text: The soap is very gentle with a very mild fragrance. I used it specifically for the lichen planus on my arms. It was a blessing.

title: Don't Miss out on this!!
text: Provides major relaxation and comfort. Very glad I bought this.

title: Great product
text: Gently warm and beautifully fragrant. Makes my feet feel good. Also helped to clear up toe fungus.

title: Excellent!!
text: Saves my day. I have always been afflicted with ingrown toenail problems. This kit is wonderful. Easy to use and has all the necessary tools that help with this problem. Excellent product.

title: Pleasantly surprised ... and love it!
text:
My last attempt at using an electric shaver was in the 1970s. This is vastly different, aside from the obvious advances in rechargeable battery technology, etc. For one thing back in the day I actually had to use a pre-shave lotion to prevent my face from getting chaffed. This one does not require that step. Also, the closeness of a shave using this is incredible. My face is ultra smooth in the spots where I do shave, especially my neck (I purchased it to trim around my goatee and mustache.)

Another major improvement is I can not only use this while my face is wet, but I can actually use it in the shower!

As for the included attachments - I have never used them, so assume that they work as well as the primary head. I love the travel case since I do travel overnight often. The charging stand is designed for travel. I would have referred a larger stand, but am not going to complain since I have had no real issues with it.

A final note: since I am not doing a full shave, and only use it every other day, I am getting over a week on a single battery charge. If you are using this daily on a full shave I imagine that you'll still get two to three days on a single charge.

title: Better than a shower back brush; has some shortcomings
text:
This does not come close to providing the same level of exfoliation as a loofa, but it is still an inexpensive way to provide a minor level of exfoliation. It's much better than any shower brush that I've used, especially when it comes to reaching every square inch of your back. I purchased the smaller model, and at 5'8" and 170 pounds this had both the reach and ease of use.

I would have added a star if both sides were textured. Or if the texture on the exfoliating side was a little rougher. And while I am comparing this to a loofa, I have to give credit for the cost, which is a lot less than a real loofa.

If this wears out I will probably repurchase it. Price and functionality do make this a value. Just be aware of the shortcomings.

title: Everything it's claimed to be
text:
For once a product description was not hype. This is quiet, extremely effective at removing ear and nose hair, and will not snag or otherwise cause little blips of pain. Nice size too.

I normally purchase Wahl clippers, and this one replaced one that I had for over twenty years. That one started life doing a perfect job like this one, but in the past year had been having issues. Also, it was never as waterproof as this one. The only reasons why I didn't go Wahl this time is because of the stellar reviews this one has (and over two thousand of them!) and it was labeled by Amazon as "Amazon's Choice." For the price I felt I could not go wrong. And if this one lasts me twenty years like the Wahl I will be 92 when it comes time to replace it. To be honest, this one may outlive me.

title: Very effective for basic trimming
text:
I purchased this back in May 2020, and have only had to change the batteries once. I use it at least weekly, so battery life is pretty darn good considering it's only fourteen months old. I've only used the basic clipper - none of the included attachments (other than the cleaning brush.) I also only use it for trimming my mustache, under my chin, behind my beard, and trimming my sideburns.

Performance per my use is excellent. It's sharp enough were I don't experience pulling or catching. To be honest, there is nothing particularly fancy about it, and for the less than twenty bucks it cost me, I didn't expect anything but a basic trimmer. Like I said, I have never used the included attachments, so I cannot say anything about those one way or the other, However, I do love the battery life, and the fact that it remains sharp after fourteen months (about 68 uses based on how many weeks there are in that period, and the fact that I've used it weekly.) No complaints here, and the price was definitely right.

title: Genuine
text: My wife normally uses L'Air Du Temps by Nina Ricci Eau De Toilette Spray. I thought that I'd surprise her with the same scent in a perfume. She was more than pleased. This is MUCH stronger than the toilette spray (same fragrance, but one quick spray is all that is needed.)  Some earlier reviews claimed that this is a knockoff. I ordered the one sold and delivered by Amazon and it is definitely the real thing. It is also a major step up in quality and longevity  of scent compared to the toilette spray (at close to the same price point if you shop around on this site.)

title: Scarce these days - Amazon one of the few places we found it
text: My wife searched her normal Central Florida (Orlando-to-Daytona area) and there was none to be found anywhere. I did a search here and, voila!, was able to order it. Bear in mind it was about five bucks more here (even with free shipping and tax factored in), but worth it to her, which makes it worth it to me. She has been using this brand and type for literally decades and was near panic. Note: this is NOT a knock-off. The fragrance and strength are identical to her almost-depleted supply.

title: Hard to find
text:
I ordered these for my wife because her usual sources for these (Walmart, CVS and Walgreens) did not have them. She has been searching for months, and I decided to look here. Viola!

As for the tweezers, they are easy to grip when you need to have both precision and control when removing follicles. They also last forever. The only reason we needed these is she misplaced her precious pair during a move.

title: High quality construction with close attention to functional design
text:
I received this as a free review sample. My five star rating is based primarily on the construction, which is essentially chrome and glass of the highest quality. The stand for the mirror and the base of the assembly are precise. Perfect threads, and a smooth assembly.

The nicest feature, though, is the mirror is distortion free. I checked it at a number of angles and the reflection is totally undistorted across the main viewing surface of the glass. Of course, the beveled edges are not included because the angle of those are going to refract differently. I am guessing that the bevel is to protect the edges of the main surface, which goes to my opinion about the overall quality.

Other things that show good design practices are the heavy base that has a felt bottom to ensure that it is not easily knocked over, and the thin, chrome adjustment handle that keeps your hands (and fingerprints) off of the mirror surface itself. When the mirror is adjusted it holds that position firmly.

title: Superior shave - smooth and perfect for sensitive skin
text:
I purchased a can of this on a whim locally and have a love/hate relationship with the gel. On the plus side I love the absolutely smooth shave I get. In fact, although I normally wet shave, I use a gel and disposable, multi-blade razor for when I am in a hurry. Until this gel I had never experienced such a smooth, easy shave with a foam or gel.

One thing that particularly impressed me is the razor I was using when I first got this gel was nearing the end of its useful life. It was becoming a bit scratchy, but with this gel it provided a smooth shave.

What I dislike is the way it dispenses gel. I have been using this for two weeks and somehow cannot get the right amount to come out. Usually it's too much gel, although it looks deceptively like too little until I apply it. The reason why I subtracted a star is there are no instructions on the can, and there clearly needs to be because unless you hold this vertical it does not properly dispense. It took some trial and error to figure this out.

The ingredients have not caused any reaction with my sensitive skin, so that is another plus and why I still rated this at four stars. Despite its relative thickness I have no problems when rinsing it from my three-blade disposable razors, which was not the case with the previous gel I was using.

Finally, I like the gel gauge on the side of the can. Interestingly, it only extends to a third of so of the can, which tells me that there is less gel and a lot of propellent. After two weeks of using it daily, though, the gauge still indicates 100% full, so a little gel goes a long way.

title: Especially perfect for travel-size items
text:
I received this as a free review sample. Aside from the color this would work for men as well as women. I received the red case and it is still a little too feminine for me, but I was able to easily fit all of my personal toiletries in it when I tested it out.

While it's best for TSA approved sizes, this will also hold many full size items. It will easily accommodate items up to two inches in diameter without stressing the zipper when closing the case. Also, I was able to get items nearly six inches tall into the compartment.

The outer fabric is very sturdy and water resistant. The zipper has nylon tracks so there is zero chance of developing rust. This can also be machine washed (I tested it), but on a gentle cycle and I highly recommend air drying it.

It's fairly compact, holds quite a bit of personal toiletry items (at least from a man's perspective) and is well constructed.

title: Superior to other disposables I have tried
text:
I normally wet shave with shaving soap and an old school safety razor, but when I am in a hurry (or lazy) I use multi-blade disposables. When I ran out of Mach 3s a week ago I grabbed a pack of these on sale locally on a whim. To me they are superior in every respect.

First, there was a little learning curve. For some reason when I was doing my first shave with these there was a little resistance going with the grain, but not against. I thought that a little odd, but the shave left my face the smoothest it had been since I can remember, and with no razor burn. Apparently the razors need breaking in because subsequent use did not have the resistance problem. It glided smoothly with or against the grain.

This razor works a lot better with a gel type cream than foam, but does not work well at all with shaving soap and a brush. Note that if you are a wet shaver who is looking for a travel razor or an occasional multi-blade shave.

One final note: these take a strong stream of water to clean, which is the only complaint I have. Otherwise this model has proven to be the best disposable, multi-blade razor that I have tried.

title: Great starter for wet shaving
text:
I received one of these razors as a review sample. If you are an experienced wet shaver or in my age group (I am 66) and used this style in your earlier years there are some key differences between this razor and ones to which you may be more accustomed.

One of the differences is weight. This razor weighs a hefty 3.1 ounces. For someone just getting into wet shaving the weight gives a lot of control. For someone experienced or in my age group who want to return to that shaving experience the weight can be a hindrance.

Another is this is truly an old school design regarding the blade compartment. That is accessed by unscrewing the head assembly. Back in my day the norm was the blade compartments that were exposed by a double door type of arrangement that opened when you twisted the handle. I prefer this razor's design because it is not only easier to keep clean and sanitary, but is not prone to jamming and other failures like the style that I used in the 60s. Of course, that is personal preference, but something take into account when making a purchase decision.

The head and blade compartment are not as efficient as the razors back in the day. I tested this using [[ASIN:B0059VTCSG 7 O'clock Double Edge Safety Razor Blades]] and got a relatively close shave, but not as lose as a vintage Gillette safety razor provided. In fact, the shaving experience was vastly different between the two - the vintage double edge razor was easier for me to handle and felt more natural. Of course I had shaved with similar razors for years, so that may account for my bias.

For someone who has never wet shaved with a double edge razor I am betting that this one is a better choice because of the weight and control factors that I mentioned. Plus the fact that you are less apt to nick yourself with this one.

title: Very useful and works per specs. If you camp this is must-have
text:
I own a number of solar solutions and am somewhat OCD about them, so when I was offered a review sample of this kit I immediately accepted. Before proceeding I want to clarify what you get because at the time of this review the product photo implies that you will receive two lights. You won't. The light in the photos show the single one front and back. More about that below.

The product description, though, is otherwise accurate.There is one statement (at the time of this review) that '18650 9V batteries required', which is true, but the battery is included and integrated into the light itself.

Charging from the solar panel will take the stated eleven hours if the light is fully depleted. Note that that figure assumes strong sunlight. In my neck of the woods in December there is not enough daylight on most winter days to completely charge the light if it's been rundown. However, even on a partial charge you can use it practically all night on the dimmer settings.

The solar panel will put out a half an Amp, so do not expect miracles when it comes to using it for charging phones of tablets, It will, but it will take up to a half a day to charge a depleted phone, and it will only charge one device at a time.

I was very impressed with the amount of illumination the light puts out. In flashlight mode using the bulb at the end of the light the highest setting is excellent for path finding or quick inspections. The longer part of the light with the array of LEDs puts out a lot of light, even at the lower settings, but at the highest settings will easily illuminate a 10x10 area sufficiently for reading or detailed work.

Out of the box there are scant instructions and the kit is a little confusing at first. The solar panel has a long cord with a female USB type A connector that mates with the charging cable that is also provided or a charging cable for your phone. The light's charging cable is the only thing I do not like about this light because it employs the standard USB type A connector on one end, but a non-standard barrel connector on the end that connects to the charging port on the light itself, For the life of my I do not understand why a micro USB cable was not designed into this kit since they are easily replaceable, whereas the barrel connector type cable is not. Not a show stopper, but a peeve for me.

A few quick dimensions to give you an idea about the size of the parts. The solar panel is 5.75x6.75 inches with a cell area that measures 5x6 inches. The light is a little less than 9 inches long with the LED area measuring a little less than 7 inches and 180 degrees of the circumference.

One final note: the light also incorporates a 4400mAh backup battery that allows you to charge phones and other devices from the large USB out port on the end of the light. This is a nice convenience, especially for emergencies when you are off the grid and need to contact 'civilization' for assistance.

This is perfect for emergencies, wandering off the grid, and camping. Aside form a few things that I personally dislike everything about this kit works per the product description and it earns a solid five stars for that.

title: Perfect combo for wet shavers
text:
This is the perfect starter set for someone who wants to get into wet shaving. It is comprised of two products that can be purchased separately: [[ASIN:B00KO46CTA Perfecto Deluxe Chrome Razor and Brush Stand]] and [[ASIN:B00LDYFGFQ Perfecto 100% Pure Badger Shaving Brush]].

I'll cover the stand first: it has a heavy, tip-proof base with a rubber (or perhaps neoprene) bottom. The weight and the bottom ensure that it stays put regardless of how wet your sink cabinet top becomes. Plus the forks for holding your razor and brush will fit just about any model of either.

The heavy, chrome and the knurled part of the post is a wonderful masculine touch with a true function. It will not slip from soapy hands if you want to reposition it. I mentioned that this stand's design showed attention to detail and the knurling is a prime example. Since it is heavily chromed it's easy to keep clean and sanitary. For me that is a major factor. Plus the post can be unscrewed from the base for thoroughly cleaning it. When the post is screwed into the base, there is no indication that it's a two piece unit. It appears to be seamless, so that is one less place for bacteria to hide.

While the stand is suitable for experienced and beginners alike, I consider the brush to be more for folks who are just getting into wet shaving. To be sure, it's not an entry level or cheap brush by any means. It is genuine badger in a grade called pure badger. Not the top grade to be sure, but still is vastly superior to non-badger brushes and this one is a joy to use.

What I love is it's soft, but has sufficient firmness to lather up a soap, but still glide across your face. Note that there will be a slight variability in bristles when brushes are made from genuine animal hair. The handle has a traditional designed form factor, and has a nice, balanced feel, I also noticed that there is a retaining ring at the base of the bristles that will keep the knotted bristles intact after the preliminary shedding (an inevitable occurrence when you are using genuine badger hair.)

Bottom line: this is a great starter set and even if you outgrow the brush the stand will last a lifetime.

title: Much better than the old Dopp kits
text:
The design and construction of this bag is light years ahead of the Dopp kit I dragged around the world during my 22 year navy career (and it lasted that long too!) That one I received from my father when I enlisted. This one came as a review sample and I have to admit that this one is superior in every way.

First, it's larger than the old Dopp kits and their imitators, This one measures 9x6x4.5 inches and has soft sides. I can easily fit all of the modern size toiletries and an electric toothbrush with room to spare.

This one is easy to clean too. I literally sprayed it down with a shower nozzle and air dried it upside down.

I love the way it's made. This is built to last. I doubt I will be around to see if this one will last the same 22 years as my Dopp kit since I am sixty five, but I am betting that it will Plus this one is sturdy enough for camping and other open environments. The materials seem designed for harsher environments, and the construction is first rate from the reinforced seams to heavy-duty zippers.

For the above reasons and the fact that this is generously sized, yet packs easily, I gave it five solid stars.

title: Super bright and distortion free
text:
When my review sample arrived I thoroughly tested this mirror. It is best used as a mirror-in-a-mirror, and I tried it out using the supplied suction cups to affix it to the large wall mirror in my bathroom.

The light made off the difference. It's very bright, but not glaring. There is a certain amount of diffusion that allows you to use the mirror and see everything it magnifies in stark relief. And when you consider the wrinkles on my sixty-five year old face, 'stark' is an apt description.

One feature that I love is the fact that this mirror magnifies, but does not distort. I have used too many magnifying mirrors in the past to know that nearly all have a little distortion. This one does not. I checked it from a few angles and the reflection was true.

It's easy to keep clean, but if you are using it as a travel mirror with the kickstand know that the glass surface attracts fingerprints. I mention this because I found myself cleaning it repeatedly during the initial evaluation when I was handling it.

Overall, this is an excellent mirror for traveling or affixed to a larger mirror to provide a closer look. I am male, so cannot comment on how well the light works for applying cosmetics (most women I know are very particular about light for that), but it's great for trimming eyebrows and checking the closeness of a shave.

title: Beautiful and functional
text:
Close up the review sample that I received is far more attractive that the product photos. But the real reason why I awarded this five stars is it's functional.

For one thing the LEDs provide a bright, but diffused light that makes anything from trimming eyebrows to shaving easy. Since I am a male I am not sure how this would work for cosmetics since most women I know prefer a natural light.

I use the normal mirror side. I did check it out on the 5x side and it accentuated every wrinkle and, frankly, that old codger staring back at me was frightening. Seriously, the magnification is not distorted and the light allows you to see every detail clearly. Some magnified mirrors that I have used in the past did distort a little, so another reason for five stars is this reflects back truly.

It's easy to keep clean - a quick wipe does the trick, but the glass does love to pick up fingerprints if you handle it. Again, a quick wipe leans that off too.

One final note: the machine turned design and chrome finish are a perfect complement to most bathrooms and this looks great on my sink top. So, on top of being one of the better mirrors I have ever used, it looks great too.

title: Good for slowing things down
text:
I purchased my set from eBay, but it's identical to this one. What I love is I have a touch of the vintage with modern convenience (I use a Mach 3 razor and did not want to give up shaving that that style instrument.)

Make no mistake: this is a low end set that will introduce you to the joys of wet shaving or as a part of a daily ritual. I purchased it for the latter use because I am retired and wanted to slow things down, including my morning shave. Another part is I love the smell and feel of [[ASIN:B001OMVB38 Col. Conk Bay Rum Shaving Soap]] and this set was a perfect excuse to ditch the gel I had been using and switch to that.

At some point I will probably replace the brush, which is adequate, but frankly detracts from the overall experience. I would kill to have the brush I owned in the 1960s, but that is long lost. But the bottom line is this set was a relatively inexpensive way to get me back into wet shaving without giving up my favorite razor, and for that I'll overlook the warts and give it five stars. If you are already a wet shaver pass this one by. If you are exploring it, though, this is a good way to start. I had looked at other inexpensive sets on the market and this is the best of them (some were pure junk.)

Overall I am pleased with this set and am actually enjoying shaving each morning. That makes it worthwhile and a value.

title: High quality in a small form factor
text:
I received this as a gift and was immediately struck by nostalgia because it is every bit as well made as the one I was given by my father when I joined the navy in 1967. That one followed me around the world during my twenty-two career and held together through use and abuse. This one looks as though it will outlive me.

The first thing that I noticed was the close and strong stitching. Next, the quality of the cowhide and the finish. Finally, the zippers are smooth and likely to last as long as the cowhide itself. All in all this is a classic Dopp bag that is old school and built for the frequent traveler and road warrior.

Do note that this is a fairly compact bag. It's not designed for anything more than the essentials - soap, razor, small shaving cream and toothpaste. If you are using travel size toiletries this is perfect. The best thing to do is to measure out a rectangle on a piece of paper that is eight by five inches. If your articles will not fit within that space you are going to be disappointed. If you are a minimalist who is experienced enough to purchase the bare essentials and keep them to true travel sizes you will probably love this case.

Bottom line: this is a true luxury and makes an ideal gift for anyone who travels. It's a perfect and thoughtful gift for any young man who is starting his military service too. Trust me on that.

title: Fast and easy
text:
This is one of the easiest and fastest ways to clean toilets (and sinks and other fixtures) that I have used. It is truly based on a simple spray-wait-brush-flush sequence that makes short work of most stains.

For mineral streaks and other hard to remove stains the directions recommend either waiting longer after the foam turns from blue to clear, or going over the area a second time. Regardless, this requires a brush for inside toilets and a damp rag for other surfaces in order to work.

It works beautifully for me. I do have mineral streaks down the inside of my toilet bowl, so I take care of those first by mixing a little bleach with water and going over those with a toilet brush before using the Kaboom. I concentrate on the streaks. Once that is out of the way I thoroughly flush to make sure that this foam will not mix with any residual bleach and form noxious gas, then spray this over the full inside surface and rim. After the color clears a quick going over with a toilet brush, then a flush results in a gleaming toilet.

What makes this handy is the nozzle allows you to spray the foal from any angle, including upside-down. I make sure I get under the inside of the rim, which seems to collect gunk. A can lasts me literally months if I only clean the toilet. However, I sometimes hit the bathroom sing and shower with this for periodic cleaning. Even with that volume of use I get at least eight weeks from a single can.

For me - someone who lives alone and hates housework - this is a godsend. It makes a distasteful chore easier than previous methods and is a product that I will continue using.

title: Clever design and quality construction

My friend is a tea drinker and the coaster turns out to be perfect as a lid to steep the tea. After the steeping, she wipes the bottom side of condensation and uses it as a coaster.

The colors on both are strikingly vivid, and the ceramic is heavy and beautifully fired. What I mean is the glaze or outer finish is smooth and non-porous on both sides. I've owned mugs in the past where the insides were slightly porous. Not so these, which to me indicates superb craftsmanship.

These are perfect gifts that are sure to please coffee or tea drinkers. I only wish they were available in value-priced sets.

title: A perfect alternative to after shave lotions
text:
I personally detest the strong fragrances of just about every brand of men's after shave lotions on the market, yet, until I discovered this product I was forced to use them. If I didn't shaving would cause my skin to chaff and rashes. I did resort to using rubbing alcohol as an aftershave for a period of time. The fragrance was quickly neutralized (although I did smell like I was in a hospital to anyone who got too close), the initial burn of applying it was not pleasant.

While this product is claimed to heal irritated skin and moisturize it, I cannot vouch for that one way or the other. What it does do is prevent chaffing and rashes on my own face, and is fragrance-neutral. That is the biggest selling point to me.

Purchasing a two pack is more economical, and it meets all of my needs (protect my skin after shaving and no obnoxious, strong fragrances), so I am a life-long customer who is very pleased with the product.

title: I keep coming back to this Method Sweet Water gel hand soap
text:
I have liquid soap pump dispensers all over my house in the kitchen all the bathrooms. My dispensers are clear glass and I wanted a clear gel soap on display…so a bit of a minimalist look.

I also am not a fan of fragrances. I think there is supposed to be a slight citrus (grapefruit) fragrance to this, but frankly I never notice it, which is just fine with me.

Like many of us, I wash my hands a lot more now throughout the day. This soap is very gentle on my skin. Normally I might have some dryness around my knuckles, but that’s not really a problem with this soap.

One thing I’ve learned is to be sure you are rinsing soap off your hands well each time you wash them. I think this helps avoid any possible skin irritation.

I try to only buy commonly-used liquid products that have refills to cut down on my heavy plastic recycling. These refill pouches really are very handy. They are light-weight and take up little room…they actually take up less room as you empty the pouch to refill your soap dispenser.

They are easy to hold while refilling your bottle and, as I get low on the product in each bag, I just start at the bottom and keep folding the pouch over and over on itself…squeezing everything last bit out.

I especially like this six-pack of refill pouches so I can have them stored around the house wherever we have soap dispensers. I feel the value is pretty good and I don’t have to worry as often about running out.

I can highly recommend and will continue to keep purchasing this product. Also plenty of other nice fragrances and colors to choose from if that is your preference.

title: I keep coming back to this foundation
text:
I’ve tried other foundations over the years but seem to always come back to this one. I have fair skin and use the L1 ivory color. My skin is also sensitive and I honestly find this somewhat soothing.

No fragrance, not too thin (I do like some coverage for my uneven skin and some minor scarring) but not too thick. It actually glides on very smoothly with my make-up sponge. It easily smooths into the hair line and blends well over the chin-to-neck area. No obvious borders from skin color to make up, so I know it’s a good color match for me.

I like the pump feature for ease of putting on my sponge (I never apply foundation with my fingers), but I do hate leaving product in the bottle when it gets low. I typically save a “low” bottle and then when my next bottle gets low, I stand one on top of the other to hopefully drip down into the bottom bottle. There is still some waste, but at least I’m getting the use of more product. I think there are even small make-up “spatulas” out there, so perhaps I will try that.

I dislike spending money on high-end make-up, and I find this is a quality brand and good value. I highly recommend.

title: Perfect eye shadow primer
text:
For years I used a Beauty Control eye lid primer and it worked well for me.

Recently I decided to see what other brands are out there and found this “Thank Me Later” primer. Love the name and totally “get it.” This conditioning primer will help maintain fewer wrinkles on my eye lids.

The seller’s page says to use a pea size portion, but I think that would be too much. For me it’s just a “dot” on my finger (so smaller than a pea) and then I dab that one dot on very lightly on each eye lid. A little goes a very long way, so if I feel like I might be putting on too much, I use another bare finger to smooth it out. I find it helpful to dab it gently on (never be rough on your eye lids) and then let set for a minute before applying liner and shadow over it.

Without the primer, my eye shadow and eye liner don’t seem to last as long throughout the day. With this primer, my eye make-up lasts until I take it off at night. Actually I recently bought a new eye liner pencil and it slides over my lid just fine after applying this primer.

This one tube lasts quite a while. I suggest storing upside down, if you can, to help the product reach the tip of the tube after it starts getting used up..

I highly recommend this product and think this is a great value. I will certainly keep buying.

title: I have no need to look for another deodorant

I’ve always been pretty picky about my deodorant not having a fragrance, drying quickly, and not leaving a residue that would get on my clothes…this product fits all my requirements.

Getting a six-pack helps me not worry about running out any time soon. One single deodorant lasts quite a while. Even if I have them in my cabinet for several months, they still provide the protection I’m looking for. The last bottle always has the same quality as the first.

I think this is a good value and can recommend. I will continue to buy.

title: This is my new favorite body lotion
text:
I moved about a year ago and I feel like my “life” routines got completely messed up. I totally got out of the habit of taking good care of my skin on a daily basis. The older we get, the more important that is, right?

I noticed a distinct increase in the dryness and crepey-ness on my arms and legs. My daughter recommended this CeraVe moisturizing lotion so I gave it a try…and immediately really liked it.

It has no fragrance (which is a must for my sensitive skin) and absorbs quickly…who has time to wait around for lotion to absorb?

I recently ordered a second bottle because I liked it so much. It is a bit pricey but it did last quite a while and offers more ingredients than other lotions I’ve tried. Hyaluronic Acid and Ceramides are ingredients I’ve heard about on YouTube for fighting aging skin.

After using it on a more regular basis, I can tell a difference in my skin. It feels softer and healthy. Since I work from home full-time, I sometimes skip the lotion so I can get on my computer faster. I am, however, learning that this does NOT help me take care of my skin. It honestly only takes a minute to apply, so well worth the time.

I find this to be a good value for the quantity, the bottle is well-balanced for a one-handed pump, the consistency is perfect for me…not too runny or too thick.

My daughter also is an avid user of this CeraVe brand. I highly recommend and will continue to keep purchasing.

title: My favorite green concealer or perfector
text:
My entire adult life I’ve had trouble with breakouts and then it taking forever for my skin to heal. I react to everything…stress, seasonal and food allergies, spicy foods, somebody looks at me the wrong way, etc.

A normal ivory concealer just doesn’t hide these imperfections or some general redness that my face might show. This NYX green concealer is the best color for me to neutralize the redness.

When I start putting on my make-up each day, this green concealer is the first thing I apply to those areas. A little goes a long way and the thin wand helps me not waste the product by applying too much. I dot it on and then stipple it with my make-up sponge.

I apply my foundation after that and then some ivory concealer that is a good match for my skin tone. And I’m all set!

No annoying fragrance and the price and value is certainly right for me. I always stock up so I don’t run out so easily. This tube may look like a small quantity but it really does last quite a while.

Great quality and I highly recommend.
