title: My favorite mascara at a reasonable price
text:
I know a lot of us spend a small fortune on beauty products, but if I find a product that works for me at a “drug store price,” I’m going to stay with it.

My daughter once recommended this Maybelline mascara because I was having trouble finding one with an applicator I liked. This product comes with a silicone applicator called a “grabber” with the rounded shape being very narrow at the tip but wider at the base. It really helps me apply just the amount of mascara I want and separate the lashes that might stick together.

I use the brownish black color and apply my first coat carefully…not too much, not too little. I’m not trying to build up my lashes unnaturally but trying to separate and lengthen them. (I am not a fan of the fiber mascara for myself.)

I may apply a second coat but try not to wait too long. For me, the dryer everything gets, the more clumpy my lashes might look.

If my mascara starts going on in clumps, I know it’s time to switch to a new tube. I always have back-ups ready to go.

I learned long ago not to pump the brush in and out of the tube…this just adds air and causes the product to dry out faster. I just twist it gently in the tube to get it on the brush.

Before my mascara dries, I use a small coarse brush (you can buy them in packs) to better separate the eyelashes and get them going in the right direction.

If I accidentally get any on the skin under my eyes, a Q-tip works well to wisk it off.

I never see flecks of mascara on my face. It lasts all day unless, of course, I rub my eyes…which I don’t really do.

I remove the product at night with Neutrogena eye make-up remover which works well for me and is gentle on my skin.

I am totally happy with this mascara (and frankly love the pink and green color of the tube). The wand is easy for me to hold and control, versus some of those thicker tubes.

I highly recommend (we each really have to find what works best for us) and will continue to purchase. I find it a great value.

title: A great facial cloth for sensitive skin
text:
I’m a big fan of Olay products and this is my go-to method for cleaning off makeup at the end of my day.

I have ruined many a wash cloth trying to wash my face without first taking off my make-up…and, being in Southern California, I don’t really want to use more water doing extra laundry.

These disposable cloths are the perfect solution. They are very soft and have plenty of surface area to clean off my make-up. I do use eye make-up remover first, because I don’t like irritating my eyes with cleanser.

This product is fragrance and sulfate-free. My sensitive skin has never had a bad reaction to using it.

I “activate” the cloth with water, then use it to cleanse my face. I then use Neutrogena liquid cleanser (just using my finger tips) to get the last of any residue that may be left on my skin. Rinse well and then pat dry. I then apply any serum or cream after that.

I really like buying this item in a 3-pack to be sure I have plenty of back-up. Since the cloths are sealed in a wrapper, I always remove those packages from the boxes to store in my cabinet…more space-efficient.

If I use one cloth a day, these three boxes should last me well over three months.

I find these to be a great quality and value and certainly will keep buying.

.

title: A great straightener for my frizzy dry ends
text:
My daughter gifted this straightener to me and I’m very pleased with it.

I like that it heats up fast and that it slides through my somewhat frizzy hair (mostly the ends) with ease.

It’s not too heavy for me to hold.

I like the ridged spot on the center back that helps me to get a better grasp and keep my hand in the proper place.

Love the swivel cord so it doesn’t get in my way.

It’s helps give me some lift if I angle and hold it just right.

I have learned NOT to try and use it too close to the roots of my hair, since most straighteners flatten my hair so much that you can see more of my scalp. At first I thought my hair was thinning but I was actually just flattening it too much.

I have yet to burn myself but nice that they supplied a glove if you want it

Love the cute black and pink color, too.

I really like this straightener as it helps me speed through my drying and styling time. I highly recommend and would buy again.

title: I’ve used this lip balm for years…maintains soft lips
text:
Years ago I (like so many people) used Chap Stick, but I felt it was too waxy.

Later this Vaseline lip balm came out in a tube and I never looked back. It was so convenient to use and gave my dry lips a lot of relief. Many things can cause this dryness…hot or cold weather, wind, even certain medications.

I keep these tubes all over so I never have to go searching for them. In my purse, my work desk, various drawers around the house, in my car, etc.

I honestly think, since I have been using this for so long, that my lips are still nice and soft and maybe do not have the wrinkles around my mouth that might have surfaced without using this product.

Recently my order came with all the tubes having a flat tip. My preference is a round tip so I don’t have to look when applying it.

I like that there is no fragrance or flavor…just plain Vaseline. I think that it also gives a slight gloss look to my lips…but don’t overdo it and keep within the lip line. A little goes a long way.

Note that, if the temperatures get warm, this product will get thinner. Once it cools down, however, I feel like it returns to its thicker state.

I think this is a good value and highly recommend. I will certainly continue to purchase.

title: Really helps me dry my slightly curly hair
text:
So, I have a low attention span when it comes to drying my hair. The faster I can get it done, the happier I am. I have medium texture hair that has a slight curl or wave to it. And, depending on the humidly, slight frizz.

My daughter bought one of these dryers for herself and insisted I try it out. I liked it so much that I bought one for myself.

I have never been coordinated enough to style my hair with a brush in one hand and a dryer in the other hand, but this product adds everything in one dryer.

I have small hands so I’m happy it isn’t a strain for me to hold onto this dryer for the time it takes me to dry my hair. I would not mind it being a bit more narrow, but I certainly can work with it. I like how I can twist my hair in the dryer brush and then hold it for while…getting that lift and slight shape I really like.

I love the combination of bristles…some being brush bristles and the others nylon bristles with the little balls on the end. I feel like that combination helps hold my hair in place while drying.

I tend to dry on the low setting which is fine…also it is not loud on that setting.

Appreciate the swivel cord.

A pretty dryer to add to my bathroom... and that’s always a bonus.

The quality is certainly there, so I can highly recommend. I felt the value was absolutely there for something I use so often.

I would purchase again, assuming there isn’t a newer model out there.

title: My new go-to concealer for my fair not-so-young skin
text:
My daughter and I recently tried out some of the Wet n Wild products, and we are so pleased with many of their items.

I hate spending a lot of money on beauty products but I want quality, too. This concealer is everything I could ask for.

The “fair” color is perfect for my light skin tone. The coverage is light-weight but still masks what I need covered. My skin is very sensitive and breaks out easily. I also have some slight scaring. I dot on some concealer and then stipple with a makeup sponge. A light dusting of loose powder (Wet n Wild, of course) and I’m good to go. I also notice it does last all day.

No fragrance is a must for me and I never notice any with this concealer.

I especially like the thin foam tip and delicate application that it provides. I used another brand concealer for years and recently their applicator is really large, causing me to layer on way too much product.

The price is right on this concealer and I highly recommend it. Even though it feels like a small amount in the tube, I find that it lasts quite a while.

I will certainly continue to keep purchasing.

title: My favorite go-to eye shadow
text:
I have been using this eye shadow for quite a while, because the colors go with my green eyes and wardrobe nicely. CoverGirl is always a brand I can depend on.

No glitter and the colors blend well. I prefer a brush to apply this shadow versus the little foam applicator they provide. It also stays on nicely.

The quality is certainly there and this three-pack makes for a good value.

I highly recommend and will continue to purchase.

title: Great for my chapped, inflamed hands in colder weather
text:
I am a big fan of Neutrogena products and have been buying this particular item for years.

During the colder months I always have trouble with the knuckles on my right hand getting severely inflamed and chapped. Just the right hand…not the left. (And yes, I’m right-handed.) It seems the more I move the fingers on my hand (I’m at a computer typing all day long) the worse it gets. It gets even worse in the colder weather.

If I don’t apply something soon to the inflammation, my skin literally starts to crack open.

This product feels more like an ointment to me than a cream. A little goes a very long way. I apply it to my hands right before bed and this helps keep my hands nice and smooth. I wouldn’t says this absorbs quickly…but it certainly does protect and soften my skin again. During the day when I’m working, I try and apply it only to the back of my hands, where the most irritation is. That way I don’t stick to my keyboard. And, of course, I reapply after washing my hands.

Don’t forget the ends of your fingers around your nails. That skin also can get dry and cracked.

There is no fragrance, which is a must for me.

It takes some time to get every last bit out of the bottle, but I keep at it. Standing on its cap helps keep the product moving down to the opening.

I recommend this product for inflamed, broken skin (the sooner you can apply, the better)…or just if you want to soften and smooth out the skin on your hands. It also works great on dry feet. I apply this product each night to my feet and then lotion on top of it for that extra benefit. Sometimes socks over that if I need to get up and walk around.

Small enough tube (2 ounces) helps make it easy to carry with you. One tube does last quite a while.

I like purchasing in this six-pack so I’m sure I have on hand. I will certainly keep purchasing.

title: My favorite cream to apply before make-up
text:
I love Olay products and have used this cream for a long time.

I have sensitive skin and this cream is soothing and non-irritating. No fragrance is a must for me. Vitamin E, aloe, and beta-hydroxy complex are great ingredients.

This cream goes on smoothly (a little goes a long way), and I apply to face, neck, and uppers shoulders and upper chest area. I let it set for a bit and then apply make-up with no problem. Not sticky and absorbs quickly.

I love the three-pack so I don’t have to be concerned about running out too quickly.

I find this product to be a good value and highly recommend. I will continue to purchase.

title: Perfect for detangling, blow drying and styling
text:
My daughter recommended this brush a few years ago when I wanted something for detangling my wet hair after shampooing. My hair is slightly curly/wavy. I use a spray-on detangler and this brush then practically slides right through my shoulder-length hair. Any more serious tangles don’t take much effort to brush out.

I have tried other style brushes but keep coming back to this one…because it works so well for me.

This WET brush is light-weight, made from a material that is easy to hold, has “vents” that help speed up blow drying, has flexible but firm enough bristles that work for my hair. Each bristle has that little ball on it that feels good against my scalp.

I also use this brush for styling, which these days it just to put it up in a pony tail.

The shape of the brush helps it stay balanced in my hand. The bristles are just the right amount and distance apart to work well on my hair.

Easy to remove hair from the brush (I use a small “pick” that I have to pull the hair out) and clean (brush dries quickly). Bristles do not easily break off.

These brushes last a while, but sometimes they get broken or you want a fresh, new brush.

I find it to be a good value, highly recommend and will purchase again.

title: My go-to make-up pencil sharpener
text:
I have tried other make-up pencil sharpeners but I always come back to this Revlon sharpener. When I can find it, I tend to stock up.

It’s sturdy in structure and completely enclosed, so shavings don’t fall all over the place.

It has two openings that hopefully will accommodate the size pencil you are using.

It’s easy enough to empty by just taking the cover off and shaking out the shavings. The cover is also clear which helps see when it needs to be emptied.

I use mine primarily on an eye liner pencil. This sharpener does a great job by making a nice fine point and not splintering the wood.

I recommend not trying to sharpen anything too soft. Sometimes the material might get caught in the sharpener. I have cleaned out broken pieces with a toothpick. Maybe a dampened cotton swab would also help. I’ve just learned to not often break pencils by using the right pressure and angle.

I do keep the sharpener in a small plastic bag (snack bag size) just in case I don’t get the top on properly, or I’ve been too lazy to empty the older shavings out. No point messing up a drawer or make-up bag with those tiny pieces.

These do last quite a while (based on the sharpness of the razor) and I think they are a good value. I recommend and will continue to purchase.

title: So great for my sensitive skin
text:
Like so many women, I have used this Olay product for years. I feel it is kind to my skin and helps keep it moisturized, smooth, and soft…like so many other Olay products do.

I only use no-fragrance products and those that absorb quickly. (I have no patience for a lotion, cream or serum that takes a long time to absorb.)

I also find this serum soothing to my skin. I apply it to my face and neck in the evening after cleaning off my make-up. My skin and eyes can be very sensitive to some products, but I do not hesitate to apply this serum around my eyes and lids. I have never had any eye irritation from its use.

Since we only need to use a little, the bottle does last a while. I keep pumping away until I get every last drop out.

Sometimes I put it on the back of my hands…and they seem happier for it.

I recommend this product and will continue to purchase.

title: Be kind to your feet!
text:
Years ago I used Dr. Scholl’s pumice stones (with the wooden handle). Eventually I could no longer find them.

My daughter recommended this one and I found it to be an even better product for me with more surface potential. I love the handy jute loop at the end for storing away to dry. I find it better to hang it up than to toss in a drawer where it might scratch something.

I use it on my heels (and one single toe callus that keeps appearing) when my feet are dry…afterwards I then soak my feet in a pan of warm water. (What a great relaxing time!) I then apply lotion or foot cream after drying my feet. This has always worked well for me and has helped me maintain soft feet.

If you want to go further…put plastic wrap or bags around your feet and socks over them. Your feet will thank you!

I find maintenance to be key. Try not to wait too long between exfoliating sessions. But…better late than never!

I also recommend being gentle with this product. No need to press hard…just let it do its work and it will not only be gentle on your skin but the pumice will last longer.

I am happy with this product and would buy again.

title: No need for me to look any further
text:
I love Neutrogena products and have used this eye make-up remover for ages. I don’t see myself even bothering to look for anything to replace it.

No fragrance, which is a must for me. A gentle solution that provides enough glide to not pull on my skin. (Really…it is not oily.) A pretty blue bottle to satisfy my eye when I pull it from the medicine cabinet.

The most comfortable way for me to remove my eye make-up is with cotton balls (not synthetic). Two balls with remover on both sides does it. No dripping and no mess. No stains on my washcloths.

Don’t forget to “activate” it first by shaking the bottle. (That’s just a fancy word for mixing it.)

It doesn’t bother my eyes at all…and I am sensitive.

The quality and price provide a good value. I really like the three-pack so I don’t have to think as often about running out.

I highly recommend this product and will continue to purchase.

title: I find this to be very soothing to my skin
text:
I always seem to come back to Neutrogena products. I find them to have quality and be budget-friendly.

I no longer am young but my complexion has not gotten the memo. My skin tends to easily be sensitive to weather, spicy foods, stress…my face can sometimes be inflamed or have slight breakouts.

This face wash is what I prefer the most. I use it every evening after I have taken off my make-up. One pump is all it takes. I also use it in the morning to start my day fresh. It always feels very soothing to my skin.

I love the color (looks cute in my medicine cabinet). I do not notice any fragrance which is a must for me.

I don’t feel it’s drying but I do apply a few drops of serum (The Ordinary Buffet) afterwards, while my skin is freshly cleaned.

One of these bottles lasts quite a while.

Also, if you have an FSA account, I found it is currently covered because it’s considered an anti-acne treatment.

I am completely satisfied with this product and highly recommend. I will continue to purchase.

title: My favorite shaving gel with a great fragrance
text:
I have tried different shaving cream and gel products over the years, but I keep coming back to this Skintimate raspberry rain gel.

This three-pack is a great value and the 7-ounce cans last quite a while. (I like having back-up cans ready to go when I run out.)

A little gel from the can expands into a healthy portion to smooth over your skin.

The razor glides over the area nicely for me and allows for a close shave.

I recently moved into a home with a bench in the shower, so now I’m shaving in the shower. How did I manage all these years not doing that? What a pleasant shaving experience with the steam and this great scent of berries.

My skin also feels moisturized afterwards which is another bonus. I’m also sure I’m getting a much closer shave.

I highly recommend and will continue to purchase.

title: Much easier for applying nail polish
text:
This is a very handy item for supporting my feet while applying nail polish. Anything that gets me closer to seeing what I’m doing is a bonus for me!

I love the adjustable options. I use the highest for applying the polish and the lowest to just prop my foot or feet up while the polish dries. It has a bit of textured rubber to keep my feet from slipping. It also has rubber bumpers to help keep the whole unit from slipping around on the floor.

It stays in place and does not easily fall over. Smooth edges so nothing to harm my skin.

Once I’m done, I just collapse it flat and store it away with my other pedicure supplies. Easy to keep clean with a damp rag.

I good value and I would buy again.

title: My current favorite for more natural-looking brows
text:
Who doesn’t feel better with pretty, more-defined eyebrows?

I have tried several products and this is my current favorite. I no longer like the thick pencils you have to keep sharpening or the mascara-type applicators.

This applicator gives me the best, more natural-looking end result. I feel like it’s much easier for me to get those short hair-like strokes.

I also like the firm brush with its protective cap. If it starts to lose its course feeling, I just wash it out a little with water and it’s like brand new again.

I do agree that it feels like we don’t get that much product. Or maybe I just want to know when I’m going to run out. I always have back-ups ready to go.

Overall though, I do think it’s a good product value. Who wants to spend a lot when you can put your money elsewhere?

I highly recommend and will continue to buy.

title: I’ve used this foundation for a long time
text:
I’ve tried other foundations over the years but seem to always come back to this one. I have fair skin and use the L1 ivory color. My skin is also sensitive and I honestly find this somewhat soothing.

No fragrance, not too thin (I do like some coverage for my uneven skin and some minor scarring) but not too thick. It actually glides on very smoothly with my make-up sponge. It easily smooths into the hair line and blends well over the chin-to-neck area. No obvious borders from skin color to make up, so I know it’s a good match for me.

I like the pump feature for ease of putting on my sponge (I never apply foundation with my fingers), but I do hate leaving product in the bottle when it gets low. I typically save a “low” bottle and then when my next bottle gets low, I stand one on top of the other to hopefully drip down into the bottom bottle. There is still some waste, but at least I’m getting the use of more product. I think there are even small make-up “spatulas” out there, so perhaps I will try that.

I hate spending money on high-end make-up, and I find this is a quality brand and good value. I highly recommend.

title: I wish I had found this sooner!
text:
For years I have used compact powder to finish off my make-up. I was very unhappy with this way of applying powder and the expense of the compacts, so started thinking about a loose powder.

My daughter and I saw this Wet n Wild translucent powder on YouTube and I decided to give it a try. I absolutely love the results!

The translucent fine powder goes on well with just a fluffy make-up brush. A little goes a long way. The quantity in the container is generous and it lasts forever.

I have sensitive skin and have absolutely no bad reaction to this. I notice no fragrance at all, which is another positive.

I love how it sets my make-up and it holds up well.

Who can beat this price? Put your money somewhere else and enjoy the quality of this product.

title: Practical inexpensive hand mirror
text:
I recently needed a replacement hand mirror after dropping and breaking my other one. I didn’t want to spend a lot of money, however, so this mirror was a good fit for me.

It’s very simple and light weight, but the actual mirror is a decent quality. I love that the handle has a hole for hanging.

Since it is very light weight, I don’t think it would hold up well to a lot of abuse. I’m pretty careful with my things, though, so it serves its purpose well enough for me. I also like the bright refreshing white color of the frame.

I recommend for the value and overall function.

title: Reliable quality tweezers
text:
I have long been a fan of the Tweezerman beauty accessories.

The only reason I buy more tweezers is because I sometimes misplace them. This time I dropped my cute pink set and they bounced under the bed. (Roomba finally found them three weeks later but who can wait that long?)

This time I went with the pretty Moon Dust color which has a slight sparkle to it. A nice bright color to stand out on my gray bath counter. As reliable as ever and easy to hold. I am also pretty good about not losing the little rubber cap for the tips. This helps maintain the tautness of the tweezers and protects the ends for better gripping.

And frankly, it never hurts to have more than one set of tweezers…in another room, in my purse, etc.

I feel quite comfortable recommending these.

title: Everything I could ask for in a tiny blow dryer package
text:
I’m not usually a “red” person but this little dryer makes me smile every time I pull it out.

I originally bought it for travel but hadn’t yet used it. When my old dryer died, I pulled this BaBylissPRO dryer out to “hold me over” until I could order a replacement for my older bigger dryer. Well, bigger isn’t always better!

I was immediately thrilled with the overall function. It has plenty enough power for drying my hair, it’s light-weight, and folds up for easy storage or packing. Why go back to a bigger, heavier dryer when this one does the job for me?

It came with the little black diffuser attachment which I keep on all the time. I felt this sped up my drying time and I could better aim at the area I wanted.

The color is a cute metallic red that isn’t overly bold (who wants that first thing in the morning?) but certainly helpful enough for you to find it in a drawer of other items…or a packed suitcase.

I highly recommend and would by again.

title: Recommended by my hairdresser
text:
I have been using this product for a long time and haven’t considered looking to replace it with anything else.

I have slightly curly hair and I just need something after washing it to detangle it. Even though I use a conditioner, it still needs some help when I first brush out my wet hair.

I don’t even notice a scent, so that’s always a plus for me. It doesn’t weigh my hair down or leave it feeling too conditioned with product.

I find it more economical to buy the larger size and then re-fill my smaller spray bottle that fits in my medicine cabinet. Buy some of those smaller silicone funnels and that will make this job a lot easier. (I just figured that out.)

And, who can resist the “sexy” name and the pretty teal bottle in your cabinet?!

title: Can you see me now?
text:
The master bath in the home I bought two years ago has deep counter and poor lighting. I typically have trouble seeing what I’m doing while putting on makeup or anything that takes close work. I decided this lighted, adjustable mirror was a good option. I especially like that it is rechargeable so there was no hard-wiring necessary or batteries to replace.

My daughter and I installed it ourselves by just drilling a hole (or two) in the wall, inserting the plastic plugs, and then screwing everything in place. It’s been up about ten months and I’ve never had a problem with it. I pull it out from the wall and put it back again every time I use it…so it has held up well.

I only have to recharge it about every two weeks. I try not to leave it on for very long, if I’m not using it. It’s easy enough to turn on and off.

There is a socket right below my mirror, which makes it very handy to charge… the cord that came with it easily reaches it. I am thinking there must be some way to recharge it if you are not close to an outlet. Either a longer cord or maybe one of those recharging batteries for phones. It’s not like you can take this off the wall every time. When you need to recharge it, a red glow appears on the lower mirror rim. When it is fully charged, a green light takes its place. Once you charge the mirror for a few minutes, you can use the lighting.

I still can’t decide which light choice I prefer. My need actually changes with the existing lighting around me, so I sometimes use any of the three options with dimming potential on each. I also like the touch screen on the mirror…no mechanical pieces to fall apart.

It’s very easy to position the mirror to different angles and to view the magnification side. 5x is plenty magnification for me. Whatever way I position the mirror holds well enough for me. If it does slips a little, you just tighten the side screws. It really hasn’t been a problem for me and I adjust it all the time up or down, left or right.

I would buy this mirror again, if needed. I have not been disappointed!

title: Pretty and Functional!
text:
I’ve seen these around for a while and my daughter had recommended the GuaSha stone in the past. I decided to buy this set (who could resist the pretty pink quartz and rose gold?) and started using the roller a week ago.

I’m not usually so optimistic about products like this, but wanted to give it a try. I can’t believe the results I’m feeling so far!

After looking at the directions and watching a couple of YouTube videos, I am now using it every morning and night when I clean my face. There are many ways to use this roller and stone, but for now I’m just using the roller when my face is wet. It’s so easy to use and glides over my skin easily. Just make sure to use something to allow it to slide over your skin and not tug at it.

I have always had trouble with sinus headaches and swelling and sometimes my skin actually feels uneven underneath, like certain small glands are swollen or clogged. This swelling and puffiness has gone down significantly just after using this for a couple days. How can that be?

I probably am not using it “correctly” but I just try to work towards the hairline and not be too harsh. I probably go too fast but I don’t have the patience (yet) for that slow massage. I spend maybe 60 seconds..??

I use it on my neck, in front of and behind my ears, on the jaw line, forehead, under the eyes, mouth/lips, upper brow. With its cool touch, it feels very invigorating. I flip from smaller to larger roller as needed or feels right.

For such a little bit of effort, I see myself using this twice everyday to just get the results I am currently getting.

title: Good value and a good choice for applying foundation and blending
text: I really like this makeup sponge but it’s getting harder to find. The four-pack is cost-effective and works really well for me, based on size and quality. I have used these for a long time, so I hope they aren’t discontinued!

title: My stylist recommended this shampoo
text:
I have my hair straightened with keratin treatment and this is the shampoo my stylist recommended to retain the straightening. I love it.

I buy it in this large size which I find more cost-effective. I have a shampoo dispenser in my shower and fill it from this larger bottle. That way I’m using the right amount and not wasting it.

I highly recommend and will help buying.

Then I ordered some as a gift for a friend in Maryland that I wanted for her birthday on the 10th or for Valentine's Day and it's going on the 16th and still have not arrived. I am GREATLY DISAPPOINTED about them not making it to her yet.

title: Our favorite lip balm
text: We've tried lots and lots of lip balms.  We avoid anything with parabens and the problem with most in this category is that they get too soft and melt in your car.  This one doesn't.  It stays like new.  Works great, keeps our lips moisturized and has no bad flavor or smell.  We keep one on our nightstand, in my wife's purse, on the counter, and in each car.  Love it!

title: Works perfectly.  I'm through with gimmicky fogless mirrors! This one is it.
text:
After twenty years of supposedly fog-free mirrors that eventually lose their coating and fog endlessly, this mirror was the answer to my prayers. I made it pretty for the wife with a nice oil-rubbed bronze metal 3M Comand hook (size small). Not one complaint.

I run water over it for 5-10 seconds and it never fogs up. Perfect! Love this item.

title: Love It!
text:
Made in the USA.
Ingredients: Coconut oil, palm oil, purified water, pine tar oil (Pinus palustris), vegetable glycerin.
Ingredientes: Aceite de coco, aceite de palma, agua purificada, aceite de alquitran de pino (Pinus palustris), glicena.

Grandpa's Pine Tar Soap has a strong, pleasant scent. Pine tar soap has reminded me of the days when most people used King Pine to clean and disinfect their homes, but the scent of this soap is milder and nice. Although the bar feels oily to the touch, it left me un-oily and squeaky clean from head to foot. With the proper wash cloth, it exfoliates the skin well, leaving it soft to the touch. After washing, I have recently been rinsing my thick short hair with vinegar (1 part white vinegar to 3 parts water) and rinse again with plain water. I repeated the process after washing with the pine tar soap and it left the squeaky clean hair feeling smooth to the touch. The soap and the rinse are a nice natural combo.

As a price reference, the cost of this soap ranges from $3.00 to $4.50 per 4.25 ounce bar at local stores and at the Swanson Vitamins web store. It also comes in a 3 ounce size. My local Shoprite was out of stock and I didn't think of the competitor when I ordered a four count multipack from an Amazon vendor. In the end, I ended up paying an extra $7.00 for that pack, so I suggest you do the math before you commit.

title: Excellent Clipper
text:
I used an excellent La Cross for years that went missing with several other items after I had people help me with some cleaning and organization. So, I tried numerous nail clippers and nippers, some in the $100+ range with nothing satisfactory until this particular clipper arrived about a week ago.

It's sharp and well designed, meeting the old LaCross standards and then some. It's well-balanced and has a metal nail catcher that slides with ease and can probably be easily removed. I haven't attempted to remove it because I have arthritis and am afraid that I won't be able to slip it back on.

Although it's a normal size toenail clipper, I often wondered if these standard designs are good for people with larger feet and toes. But, it works fairly for me with my bum hands and I'm happy with it.

title: Disappointing Clipper
text:
If it weren't for the fact that I'm using this nail clipper with handicapping arthritis, maybe I'd go left or right on the 2 stars that I've given it. I had a La Cross nail clipper that worked well for many years until it developed legs. So, I've bought numerous brand name replacements because that particular La Cross model is no longer available. One company was nice enough to send me three free models; all were a disappointment. The Mehaz Wide Jaw was one of the many that I've purchased in less than a year and nothing comes close to that old La Cross.

The problem with this Mehaz concerns the annoying location of that abrasive file; it would have been better if they hadn't glued it to the lever. The second peev is with the angled edge; it's not a straight or curved edge; it's an acute angle edge, which I guess would be okay if you hold the clipper at less than ninety degrees to the nail that you're cutting, but that design doesn't work well with my arthritic hands. Also because of the angled edge, I end up with a jagged nail cut because I have to cut the nail in sections. My sock got caught on the jagged big toe nail, causing the toe to bend up and making me walk awkwardly and in pain until I managed to pull the shoe off. Then I had to work the sock loose without knowing exactly how it was caught in the nail. As the nails grew, they also snagged in the sheets, making me get out of bed to smooth the annoying nail with a file.

Because I believe that these clippers will work better as a straight or curved edge, I've ordered another Mehaz model and hope that I will have better luck. Of course, I've also managed to find three different La Cross models, which are now manufactured by Sally Hansen and a third company whose name I can't recall at this time.

title: Very Inexpensive and Excellent
text:
I bought three different razor combs and have given each of them a test run. The three were Diane Tinkle Hair Cutter (DTHC),the Diamond Edge Platinum Hair Shaper (DEPHS) and the Seki (most expensive). I liked the DTHC for the following reasons: It was the least expensive of the three and, in comparison to the Seki, it's an excellent product for the price. However, it is plastic, which doesn't seem to be too sturdy. The Seki has variable settings and the DTHC has two edges, one on either side. In the vendor's picture, you will notice that the Diane Tinkle comb (DTHC) has two notches along the center of the comb; those notches are the tracks to open the comb to change the blades. I have feminine hands with arthritis and the comb was fairly easy to open. If I have a problem opening the unit, I insert an ice pick into one of the notches to help me glide the comb's cover. I couldn't open the Seki. And, unlike the Seki, the DTHC's two double edge blades are positioned vertically, making the cutting edge two times longer than the Seki. Both of these cutters use regular double edge blades, have two cutting edges (one on either side), and although I probably won't use them in my lifetime, I purchased 500 blades for less than ten dollars from an Amazon vendor. The way the blades are positioned within the Seki, only one edge of each blade is exposed for use; with the DTHC comb, both edges are exposed (one is for a short cut and the other is for a longer cut). I recently tried the Diamond Edge Platinum cutter (DEPHS), it has interchangeable heads and a blade that I can replace very easily with my arthritic hands, even easier than the DTHC. However, the length of the cutting area is about 25% shorter than the DTHC comb, and that blade's design is a single edge blade with a unique length, given that it is 50% longer and also narrower than normal single edge blades. If and when the user needs a blade replacement for the DEPHS comb, that factor may be a problem. And, although the DEPHS has different heads, they all appear to be the same height, but designed with different angles and increasingly wider spacing between the teeth. I chose a head that had about 1/4 inch space and was satisfied with the cut until I realized that I had accidentally knicked myself in a few places, including my ear. I may have positioned the blade at a wrong angle. The blade is so sharp that I didn't feel a thing, but I did notice the drop of blood on my ear and later felt a couple of stings on my scalp. I finished the cut with the Diane Tinkle comb because it hasn't hurt me yet.

The more I use the DTHC, which is about once a week, the more I like it. I've had it for about four months, and I haven't replaced the blades yet; I simply clean and reinsert them. I notice that it works best on dry, clean hair. I suggest that after you get a barber or salon cut, maintain the length by using the DTHC periodically.

None of these razor combs is going to give you a salon style cut. They make uneven cuts,and the Seki and the Diamond Edge Platinum Tip tend to pull the hair at times. With the bad winter, I didn't cut my hair during the duration of the season and when I went to get a cut, both the hair salon and the barber shop had gone out of business. My solution was to give myself my first haircut; I grabbed a Fiskars Softouch scissors (another excellent product) and proceeded to fill my small paper trash can with hair. Then I grabbed the Seki to finish the job (razor combs don't work well near the ears, so you may need a trimmer for that kind of work).

The combs don't come with instructions, so I start at the back of the neck and work my way north and forward as I try to follow the hair's natural directional growth. I have thick, wavy hair and I didn't have a problem with any of these products' ability to cut. In the end, I was satisfied that I had a short cut and hair that washes with less effort, but it's definitely not a designer style and it's something that I can live with. A couple of weeks later, I did the second trim with the Diane Tinkle Hair Cutter, which I now use once a week, as I mentioned earlier.

title: Fine for my several types of eczema
text:
I have suffered the last several years from several different forms of severe eczema. After a few months of messing with my primary doctor I even went to a dermatologist for a biopsy. Yeah, eczema. She wanted me to stop all my vitamin/nutritional supplements and my neem soap (which I liked because it soothed the itch and burn). I did as requested but after a month no improvement so went back to using my neem soap.

This did not cure my eczema or even put it into remission. It took heavy steroids to settle it down to a point where people don't back away from me in close quarters LOL. But I found every single other soap I tried including ridiculously expensive body washes the dermatologist had me used, BURNED. Neem soap does not burn. Therefore, neem soap OK in my book.

The smell. OK it does have an odor. Does not linger as far as I can tell. If you get more into other neem products you may run across the burnt garlic/rancid peanut stink. I don't this soap smells bad. If you want something to make you perfumey than go get something perfumed. If you need something non-irritating and don't mind a little off smell when actually lathering up, this is for you.

title: The odor descriptions are accurate, otherwise OK
text:
Well, I read the reviews and noted all the "stink" comments. I am familiar with neem and use the soap. I thought like with the soap, people might be a teensy bit exagerating the comments. No, they weren't they are dead on in the description of rancid peanuts and burnt garlic. Never having had the experience of smelling rancid peanuts you would think that would be a hard thing to pin on this. But no, when you smell it, you too will be an expert on rancid peanuts.

That said, the cream in all other ways is good. It doesn't make my eczema worse (you would be surprised how many products can) and it does seem to be soothing to the itch and/or burn.

Myself I won't buy it again because of price. There are a few products not quite as expensive as this that do a similar job for me. And without the odor.

Although, like I was telling my boss when I gave him a heads-up if anybody at work complains about my smelling - if rubbing actual rancid peanuts and burnt garlic on me would cure my eczema I would happily do so.

My subsequent ones, while I am milking them to last a little longer I am now noticing it. I don't find it lingers so still will keep using it. If you have sensitive skin, give it a try. My derm wanted me to stop all my neem and other homeopathic products at first - even my supplements. I did for awhile but noticed no improvement and went back to my neem soap first thing. title: Hair's the buzz
text:
The first thing that you should know about this clipper is that it's called the "Shortcut" for a reason, the reason being that it only works if you want a buzz cut with your scalp showing.

The second thing is that you should read the instructions before using it. It comes with the "balding comb" attached, so if you decide to charge it and start clipping, you're going to end up with a buzz cut.

Pros:

1. It comes in an easy to open package that you won't need a chainsaw to open
2. It includes two combs, a cleaning brush, blade oil, a charging adapter and an instruction manual
3. It's compact and easy to hold
4. It doesn't come with a bunch of different sized cutter attachments, as it uses a 5 position zoom wheel to set the length of cut you need
5. It has a pop out trimmer for around the ears and neck area
6. It has a warning light to tell you when it should be recharged

Cons:

1. It takes about 16 hours for a full charge
2. As mentioned above, it comes with the balding comb already attached, and unless you read the instructions first (or this review) you won't know that the adjustable hair length settings only work with the adjustable guide comb. If you need to trim longer hair, you MUST change the comb first.
3. It doesn't work well with the adjustable guide comb. It hardly looks as though it's doing any cutting at all, but in a very short time you'll find that the hair clogs up the comb, necessitating removing the comb and cleaning it out before continuing. (The comb is curved inwards at the top, with horizontal bars, and these trap the hair, clogging the blades)
4. It takes much too long to get the job done.
5. The pop out trimmer works, but is tough on tender skin.
6. The location of the "on" button makes it much too easy for accidental starting while popping out the trimmer or changing the combs.

I wouldn't recommend this for anything longer than a buzz cut or complete hair removal. For longer hair that just needs a quick trim, there are better clippers available.

For buzz cuts - 4 stars
For longer cuts - 1 star
Average - 2.5 stars

Amanda Richards, August 7, 2008

title: Beware the dreaded "thwack"
text:
I've owned an inexpensive fabric shaver for many years, and although I couldn't exactly call it perfect, it did a really good job, all things considered. However, with the added burden of my son's school uniforms, it had been getting a little finicky, going on strike more often than not, clogging too easily and taking much too long to do the job. (I should add that the aforementioned uniforms are made from the material from hell, which seems to grow pills out of thin air until every square inch of surface resembles coarse sandpaper.)

So there I was, struggling along with shaver and brush, until one day I decided to retool my arsenal, and treat myself to some new firepower. After looking at all the models available on-line at this site, I settled on this one based on brand name, appearance and the reviews. Here's my report:

1. Appearance - Cool and modern looking, with a nice big cutting area and a big fat sliding on-off switch. A large transparent plastic receptacle catches oodles of lint.

2. Ease of operation - the easy grip handle is okay for smaller hands like mine, but I can see that people with large hands and fingers would have a hard time holding this shaver comfortably.

3. Price - Extremely affordable

4. Performance - This shaver is fast and gets the pills off quickly. Emptying the receptacle is easy, and so is putting in the batteries. The instructions suggest that you use only alkaline batteries and not the heavy duty ones. I used two high quality alkaline AA batteries, and was amazed by the speed and power of this little gizmo. Unfortunately, I think I gave it too much juice, because from time to time when it got hold of a particularly large and deeply-rooted pill, it also excavated a tiny chunk of material with a loud "thwack" sound. I subsequently replaced the batteries with a cheaper, less powerful brand, and even though it still occasionally bit too deeply, it was much easier to operate without damaging the fabric.

Points to note:

1. Try it out on a small piece of fabric first. This product is not recommended for angora wool or textured knits et al. It's also not so good with thin polyester/cotton blends or cheap knits (like low quality polo shirts), but works well on twills and similar materials.

2. Make sure the fabric is laid out smoothly, preferably on a flat surface. Wild swipes with the shaver at areas of bunched-up cloth will result in the dreaded "thwack" sound and the loss of a little piece of cloth.

3. Read the instruction manual - it's in understandable English

4. Use inexpensive batteries which have less power than the ones that keep going and going.

Overall, I'm pretty satisfied with this fabric shaver. It cuts fast and is very efficient in sucking up the lint and catching it in the receptacle, but one little slip on your part and those little holes will appear out of nowhere. Once you get the hang of it, I'm sure that you will find that this is another hand held battery operated toy that you can't do without.

Amanda Richards, April 27, 2007

title: Easy to assemble, but some extra hands are needed
text:
Sauder products are the best on the market for finish, precision, attention to detail and ease of assembly. I have tried others, expecting all assemble it yourself products to be the same, but there's an ocean of difference. Sauder's parts fit exactly as they should, with pre-drilled holes and instructions a young adult could master. Their patented fasteners make joining pieces a snap, and they have the coolest little gizmos to make the job easy and fool proof.

This entertainment center comes neatly packed in two boxes on a pallet, and after you open it, there's no way of packing it back - the packaging is amazing. This is a fairly big unit, 65 inches wide and nearly 5 feet high, and is simply too bulky for one person to assemble. For example, at one point you have the thing lying flat on the floor, and you have to turn it over to nail on the backing pieces. I had two helpers turn it over for me, not only for the bulk, but also for the weight.

Every piece is clearly labeled or easy to identify, and there are step by step illustrated instructions for the entire job. They even send extra nails and screws in case you lose a couple. A word of advice - you need a big work area to spread out the parts, and make sure your screwdriver is a Phillips with a long shank. I had a little difficulty fastening the feet, because my screwdriver wasn't long enough.

The unit itself is big enough for my 27 inch flat screen with space to spare, and has adjustable shelves for the other components. There's an ingenious double door lower compartment, with an inner door that locks, which is handy for keeping the R (and X) rated movies out of reach. (Note: Only cardboard cased VHS tapes fit in the back compartment)

Not shown is a side compartment for CDs, tapes or DVDs, with a magnetic opening device that opens the door when you press it. There are also two drawers for audio paraphernalia and a big middle section with an adjustable shelf.

It looks exactly like the product photograph, and is extremely sturdy. I had an earlier model for six years, and the only thing that damaged it was a major flood. This product will dissolve like an ice cube when immersed in water.

If you're going to be assembling it yourself, get Sauder.

Amanda Richards, June 25, 2005

title: Do you have toenail issues?
text: Normally I wouldn't feel comfortable revealing something humiliating like this. However, I have a feeling this may help some of you out there. These nails have helped me tremendously.  I had the worst nail fungus infection. It was so bad that more than half of the nail on my big toe thickened, turned yellow, cracked and eventually fell off (this happened to both big toes not just one) Disgusting! Yuck yuck yuck! Anyhow,  I live in California.  California's notorious perfect weather permits the use of sandals all year long (high-heeled sandals are  my favorite). I consider myself lucky as I have many pairs of high heeled sandals to choose from. But how was I to wear sandals with this disgusting nail problem? I tried these on a limb. I wasn't expecting very much,  to be quite honest. I didnt want to feel disappointed.  It took me just a few minutes to place these over my own nails, or what was left of them anyway. Wow! The difference was unbelievable.  Suddenly,  I felt like I could be a foot model. Okay, maybe I'm exaggerating a bit.  Maybe not a foot model exactly,  but you get my point! I received so many compliments on how cute my toes looked. IF THEY ONLY KNEW HOW AWFUL MY REAL NAILS LOOKED (p.s. -- nail infection still not completely healed) .  The nails lasted for quite some days. No one could see through the nails, not even me. I kept a couple of extra fake nails and some glue in my purse just in case I happened to lose one. I don't know what I would do without these fake nails. They have been a real God-send to me.  Kiss nails have provided me with so much more than cute nails. If you have a similar problem,  you need to buy these.  One last thing-- using fake nails has not had any visible effect or hindrance, good or bad,  on the ongoing treatment and betterment of my nails.  Please note, I was not given any perks or merchandise for my review. I just wanted to give credit where it was due.  I hope this helps some of you.  If you found my review helpful, you can thank me by giving it a thumbs up or you can help other people with similar problems by writing your own product review.  Nothing quite like the feeling of complete self confidence.

Why?, 'cause of their easily getting fouled-up with the residue of the whisker-whacking process...the hair & lather. And then, so often, I wasn't able to dislodge this gunk by shaking the device in the sink. I found that I was forced to use an old tooth brush to clean it...before using it again. WELL!, that inconvenience is now but a faded memory...Ta-Da!...as this beauty has a wide enough gap to prevent said problem.

title: A Must For Hemorrhoidians
text:
If you are a member of the exclusive "Hemorrhoids Club" , then you MUST 'ave one of these! We understand, more than most how bloody (pun intended) important it is to keep THAT area well groomed at all times...as one never knows the day or hour, when a "procedure" will be initiated. I, for one, DO mind a "Tug-boat Annie" LVN messing about back there with a straight razor...that she probably uses on herself.
Anyways, this right-sized tool is great for its efficiency and safety...it WILL NOT grasp nor cut/break the flesh. Heck, ya might say it's even refreshing! And...and, after you take care of the nether region (with due diligence), you can then attack the nose & ear hairs...OR, reverse the sequence if-you-so-desire.

title: 19 th. Century Barber Shoppe Aroma
text: Love its' "Old-Fashioned" aroma...as do ALL my girl/lady friends! And gets the gents thinking 'bout forming a barber shoppe quartet. Labels one as being manly, not effeminate. This IS Special!

title: FLESH COLOURED!
text: To me TALC is talc...BUT this wondrous supply is flesh coloured!,as long as your ancestors marched out of the Caucasus' Mt's. way-back-when. If'n you're of a darker skin tone you'll be apt to wind up looking like a Michael Jackson impersonator...not good...unless?

title: TURKISH DELIGHT?
text: If any of you lads wondered 'bout the prevailing fragrance in the largest Turkish bordello in Ankara, this is it! NOT saying that it's bad, just VERY,VERY unique! That aside, this product does a truly GREAT job of assisting you, and your shaver, in the job at hand. Much better than Williams or any other item of its type that I've come across in 51yrs. of whisker-wacking.

title: Love it!
text: Very good for my hair.  Could be a bit cheaper but love the product.

title: Super
text: Very nice

title: Beauty essential
text: Simple and not caked on look

title: Easy to use with excellent results
text: I loved that I could select the darker shades for my tanned face , then select a lighter shade under my eyes. Easy to use, great product.

title: Unhappy with purchase
text: The ends are not smoothly filed and it snags hair when inserting.  The product is not properly finished.

title: Improves hair quality
text: My hair was thinning due to using Tresumme. I've been using this and I can see the hair returning! Who knew. Be careful of the products you use.

title: Looking for this for years
text: My sister was trying to find this brush for years. She has an old one she loves and she said it's the same. She has very fragile hair and this does not cause any breakage. Amazon comes through again.

title: Exactly what I was looking for
text: I wanted something that would take the shine off my face without caking on my face. This product is just what I was looking for. The shade is perfect, really blends with the shade of my skin. Very happy with purchase.

title: Absolutely love the fragrance
text: It's such a soft, warm, inviting fragrance. Not the least bit overwhelming. My new favorite.

title: Awful
text: The minute I put it on my face it felt awful. It felt like a tightening mask. Weird feeling, just not right. I immediately washed it off. Waste of money.

title: Anchor screws defective
text:
The mirror was not attached correctly so I just popped it into the bracket. See how long that lasts. Also I had to go to hardware store for new anchor screws, no size in instructions. Disappointed with product.
That being said, once installed it seems sturdy and I really like it.

title: I find them very easy to use and my hair comes out great
text: They are easy to use and work great for my hair.

title: DO NOT buy
text: They sent me large not jumbo rollers. Also, the actual length of rollers, the area to roll your hair, is way too short. I have long hair, I could not even wrap it around twice and it started to overshoot the foam.  Cheap shoddy product. Going to return it right now. I refuse to keep this and put it into the landfill by throwing it away even though it's cheap. What do you expect from China.  I have learned my lesson.

title: Works
text: Wow, it really runs hot.  I use it on the power setting with no additional heat.

title: Garbage - don't purchase
text: Do NOT purchase. They are flimsy, paper thin, junk. This garbage made in China is the reason their economy is going down the drain. When you produce cheap, shoddy, worthless products the word gets out. You will have NO repeat customers and a bad reputation.  I was fooled by the (USA seller) not realizing it was made in China.  I have to be more diligent in the future.  Not even worth returning.

title: Great soap
text: Quite like this soap. Leaves skin clear and soft. Excellent value, I almost always purchase this brand.

title: Great little product
text: It really works. It is easy to use and really does remove dead skin quickly and easily. Much better that any other product I have tried.  Worth the money.

title: Absolutely love this product
text:
I had read about this soap somewhere and decided to give it a try. I love this product!!! It washes off and leaves your skin so clean and soft. No residue or oily feeling. Just a clean, clean feeling.
I will never use anything else, and I have spent $$$ on bath soaps, etc. Never again...

title: Wonderful as usual
text: This is one of the best soaps on the market. You feel so fresh and clean after showering. Leaves no film and softens the skin. Hypo allergic as well.  The only soap I use now...

title: Disliked product
text: Not much to say, very poor quality + does not hold hair properly. Does not appear to be made for any extended period of usage.  Very disappointed with purchase.

title: Good Ol Pumice Stone
text: High quality, low price. Sturdy strap to hang. Must-have for pedicures.

title: For a picky girl, this is all I use
text: This is supreme lip balm. I'm very picky- I want last hydration without any greasiness, I hate when my lip balm spreads outside of my lips, I can't stand when i have to apply pressure to get it to apply- this lip balm is the best. Top 3 lip balms of all times. You can apply this on top of liquid lipstick even and it still wont spread or move around your makeup. Leaves lips soft and nourished for hours.

title: Bad choice
text: These are little the worst makeup sponges ever. They’re hardly even sponges- they’re super firm and not bouncy, they just kind of smear the makeup around, not blend it in. Not absorbent at all. Would not use or buy again

title: Super short battery life
text: Do love this mirror, but the charge lasts about 5 minutes.

title: You get what you pay for
text: THIS WILL BLEACH YOUR TOWELS! Did take a bit of the yellow out of my blonde hair, not as much as  advertised though. Scent is fine, doesn’t leave hair dry or damaged.

title: Smells Amazing.
text: The scent of this is dreamy delicious. Not significantly more moisturizing than other brands but I would buy again!

title: Great purchase
text: Very light coverage, gives a dewy glow, does not make sensitive skin break out. Haven’t noticed difference in quality of my skin though

title: Not a Sandalwood perfume
text: Not a fan. Very powdery scent, more like vanilla baby powder. No trace of sandalwood.

title: Great Mirror!
text: Great mirror for the shower!

title: Good for DIY
text: Perfect for DIY hairpieces, good quality.

title: Great Brushed
text: Great brushes, very soft, perfect for foundation and powder.

title: Five Stars
text: Great color, glides on perfectly
My 2yr old daughter loves these!

title: can't go wrong
text: Light scent, need tiny amount so it lasts, works for a lot of things

title: Surprised how nice this is for the price
text: I got this due to chemo and wanting to have a wig very similar to my original color and style. I've never owned a wig and, while I realize this is a budget choice, it's comfortable, adaptable, fun, and looks cute. Comes with a wig cap. I don't think it will fool everyone up close, but considering that most people aren't really paying that much attention in day-to-day life, this is fine and a great bargain.

title: These always smell a tad rancid
text: Because I have sensitive skin, over the years I've occasionally gone back to try this product. Every time I'm disappointed for a couple of reasons. First, the bars always seem to smell a wee bit rancid which gets worse pretty quickly. Second, the product seems to dry out my skin. Third, I personally find the shape just awkward to use and I drop this a lot, when I don't have that problem with other bar soaps. Fourth, it doesn't give your skin a clean scent, you can smell that little rancid hint. I never actually end up using these more than once when I am reminded why I didn't like them before! I honestly think this is a highly overrated product.

title: Vanilla scented, no rose scent at all - ???
text:
I'm confused. I just received a pack of three of these. They have NO rose scent whatsoever. They are scented with fake vanilla. Why?

Otherwise, they appear to be your typical petroleum jelly based salve.

title: Hair feels dry
text: I don't like this conditioner nearly as much as the shampoo. This just doesn't leave my hair as soft as Pantene or even Sauve conditioners. I have very thick, long hair and I end up using 50% more of this conditioner than my other brands every time.

title: Decent shampoo
text: It's a decent, budget friendly every day shampoo that smells nice. There's nothing extraordinary about it though. I alternate this with a very expensive color enhancement shampoo for my red hair.

title: Pretty colors
text: I like this lipstick and all 3 colors are nice. It goes on smoothly and doesn't feel dry or look bad after a few hours. However, it definitely stains coffee cups more than my Estee Lauder lipstick.

title: Beautiful rich red
text:
I am so very sick of Pandemic Hair. I let my grey grow out for 2 years and just woke up a month ago hating it. I wanted to go back to my red hair and was delighted to find my favorite shade still available.

The photo is the R3 color on 100% grey hair. That was three weeks after the initial application and 2 weeks later, the color has actually held up very well. Reds tend to fade faster than other colors. I'll reapply at 6 weeks to prevent that dulling effect and the tacky visible roots from beginning.

title: Works with thick hair
text:
I like this more than I thought I would. My hair is very thick and long and it takes literal hours to air dry. A traditional hairdryer does work faster than this brush dryer.

However, this straightens as it dries my hair and that's definitely useful. The handle is big and easy to grip. The brush doesn't get tangled and doesn't pull my hair at all. I'll keep using this.

title: Thick, absorbs quickly
text: After 10 days of use, I like this moisturizer cream well enough. It dispenses through the top and is a thick creamy texture. It doesn't take a lot of it for full coverage. I think this absorbs pretty quickly and there's no sticky residue left over.

title: Thick, hard to rinse off
text: This is ok, but not my favorite. It doesn't irritate my skin and that's great. This is really thick, so a little goes a long way. My issue is that if you have any sort of soft water, this can be difficult to rinse completely off.

title: Roomy, easy to use
text:
I needed a larger travel bag for makeup and toiletries when on business trips. Just something easy to use, easy to clean and nothing fancy....it just holds deodorant and the like.

This bag holds an awful lot of random stuff and fits into a corner of my suitcase comfortably. It sits level on the bathroom countertop and doesn't flip over. Wipe it clean and keep going.

title: Large variety of stuff
text: This would make a good gift choice. There are a number of different items in the reusable bag. I took this set on a cruise and the bag was big enough for other toiletries as well. The scent is sweeter and stronger than I normally care for overall, but decent lotions.

title: Really works
text:
I have not used these nose strips in years and thought they were off the market. However, I rediscovered them and I'm glad I did.

These adhere with no problems and stay in place easily. Removal is pain free and easy and the strips actually do work!

title: Thick, silky smooth cream
text: I love the Green Tea moisturizer from this brand and use it daily. This is very similar, but feels thicker. Both absorb completely and quickly and my skin feels soft all day  I can't detect any odor at all from either version.

title: Masculine scent
text: My husband says he likes this and his hair looks... fluffier to me. The scent is not overwhelming and it smells nice.

title: Like a smelly 2nd rate generic
text:
I don't hate this, but I would not purchase it at all. It's a thin conditioner out of the bottle and yet, still left my hair feeling heavy when it dried.

The scent was overwhelming in the steam of the shower. There's a distinct chemical odor that I really dislike. Unfortunately, that smell lingered 12 hours later. I'll stick to my regular products.

title: Chemical scent
text: The texture of this is a smooth cream and it absorbs fairly quickly. Unfortunately, I was only able to use it once. There's a strong chemical smell and my eyes watered after applying.

title: Pretty, but sloppy application
text: I like the colors in this set and two in particular are great with my olive skin tone. However, every applicator in all the bottles is clumpy and sloppy. The tint goes on either runny or splotchy so I have to smooth it out with a tissue. If these were smooth, silky applications like traditional lipstick, I would love them.

title: Really nice foot lotion
text:
This is a thick, smooth creamy lotion. I like the scent and it does not irritate my skin at all.

We live in the dry Chihuahua desert and that means dry cracked feet if you don't use a good lotion regularly. I've put this on my heels for a week and it's excellent. It absorbs fast and there's no greasy residue. My feet are soft and look great in sandals.

title: Clean, fresh scent
text: I like this scrub a lot. It has a very fresh, clean scent. My skin is definitely softer and completely clean after riding horses in the desert. This actually gets the sweat and dirt off without irritating my skin.

title: Beautiful red, chips fast
text:
I don't do those fake nails or plastic manicures. But I do like a little nail polish now and then to spice up my day.

This red is really beautiful and has a shimmer to it in the sunlight. Unfortunately, even with a clear coat on top of two coats of color the polish chips. It chips fast and looks bad by day two.

title: Really nice foundation for sporadic wear
text:
I grew out of my obsession with full make up many many years ago. However, there are times when it's still an appropriate choice and this is the first foundation in years that I've actually liked. It's thicker than some, so apply with a light touch. I had a scratch on the bridge of my nose from the cat the other day and a critical meeting with the press.... Foundation was required.

This is completely covered the cat scratch and smoothed my entire face as well. It did not look heavy or and did not feel heavy on. By the end of the day, my make up looked nice and not cakey or splotchy at all. Cleaning my face was reasonably simple and there was no make up residue left behind after my shower.

title: Silky texture, light foam action
text: I've used this cleanser three times now and I like it for minor cleaning after a day in the office. As a cleanser after a day in the saddle, this is not my first choice for real grime. However, it feels nice on the face and rinses away completely. I don't really see "foaming" going on though as much as just a light lather.

title: Way better than expected
text: I thought a matte finish would be dry and dull, but it isn't. It's a reasonably soft color that highlights the lips with screaming "look at me". This stays on quite well through the day and doesn't get that weird feathered appearance.

title: Expensive, but so good
text:
Let me first say that I have never found a face cream or moisturizer that I felt was worth more than twenty bucks. Most of these behave exactly the same and do exactly the same thing no matter what the price point. However, I really like this one. It has displaced ROC as my favorite actually.

The cream is very thick, viscous and feels cool on my face. It absorbs very quickly into the skin with no sticky or damp residue left behind. My face feels and looks soft and healthy since I've been using this and there's no skin or eye irritation after 10 days. I live in the very dry Chihuahua Desert and that's hard on the skin, but this stuff is keeping my skin looking and feeling good.

title: Absorbs fast, smell fake
text: This is a pretty decent hand cream. It absorbs quickly without a greasy residue left behind on the skin. After a week, it does seem to have softened my dry hands. We live in the desert and dry air is brutal on the skin day after day. However, this does not smell like roses. It has a definite fake added scent type of smell to me. Still, the lotion works.

title: Menthol scent, rinses clear
text:
My husband likes this more than I do actually. There's nothing wrong with the shampoo. It has a distinct menthol scent and it rinses away clean without any residue left behind.

I just don't see any reason for this to cost literally 4 times what my regular, very good shampoo costs me. This isn't any better and you get less in the bottle.

title: Dry desert air means dry feet
text:
We live in the Chihuahua Desert of the Big Bend Region of Texas and that means super low humidity (Hallelujah) and high temperatures 9 months out of the year. 15% humidity and 100 degrees leads to dry skin and especially feet for me. I do the whole moisturizer thing of course, but this foot file has definitely helped.

It's big enough to hold easily and maneuver in tight spots and around the heel without dropping the file. it does a good job at removing dead, dry skin and doesn't hurt at all. I do wish it had a little "debris" catcher of some sort, but that's just me.

title: Not the best for my very thick hair
text: I have long, very thick hair and thought these claw things might be a nice alternative to a pony tail. Unfortunately, my hair is just too thick and falls out within a half hour. My friend with shorter hair loves these those and says they work fine. So I'll stick to a traditional clip or scrunchie and leave these for those with shorter or finer hair.

title: Left my face clean after a sandstorm
text: We had a heckin' sand storm this week and my skin was definitely feeling gritty and just...yuck. I used the peel off mask the first day and the wash off version the second day. Both definitely cleaned the grit and grime off my skin and left my face looking and feeling fresher. Neither product irritated my skin at all. However, because we are in a very low humidity, dry desert, these did leaving my face drier than I really wanted. It's not a big deal, but I can't even think of skipping moisturizer if I use these first.

title: Not as good as Pantene
text: I've used this conditioner with my regular shampoo for several days now and I'm not thrilled with it. My hair definitely doesn't feel the same as when I use my regular Pantene Silver conditioner. It feels weighed down with this stuff and has almost no bounce. I have very thick, long hair and it only looks and feels like this if I haven't washed it. I am going back to my regular stuff.

title: Body scrub is great
text: The facial and body scrubs in this set are pretty darn good. The daily grime of desert dust, sweat and horses was completely gone and only soft, clean skin left behind. There is not strong scent either and I have had no skin irritation after using these scrubs for a few days. I don't care for the shampoo though - my very thick, long hair just felt too dry even with conditioner afterwards. It might be fine for finer or shorter hair though.

title: Noticeable softer skin
text:
I have been pleased by the results of this cream after several days. We live in a very dry, low humidity climate in the Chihuahuan Desert of the Big Bend region of Texas. My face gets dry very fast between hiking, riding horses and just life out here. I take moisturizer seriously.

This is a thick lotion type texture and a little goes a long way. It has not irritated my skin at all or caused any breakouts after a week. The product is cool on the skin and has no perfumed scent either. My face is definitely looking better and the dry skin is gone. However, this stuff can be sticky for an hour after applying, so don't plan to put it on and go directly to bed.

title: Smells nice, no lather
text: Overall, this is a decent basic soap. It smells nice, citrus fresh. The cardboard packaging feels like a gimic since the inner bottle is plastic anyway. I like this soap for quick wash ups only - real cleaning requires something more.

title: Not great for thick hair
text:
This conditioner is ok. It's not the worst, but it isn't one I would buy. My hair is very thick and long and we live in the desert, do dry hair is a battle.

After a week of use, this leaves my hair still feeling dry. I have tried using less, more and way too much conditioner and always the same results. It just is not as good as Pantene or even Sauve.

title: Slightly medicinal scent
text: The shampoo itself lathers nicely and rinse away completely. My hair looks fine and is definitely clean. This removed all the day's dust and horse related grime. Unfortunately, there's this weird, chemical like scent - almost like a medicine smell to the shampoo. I really dislike the scent.

title: Nice selection of colors
text: This set is a budget friendly way to experiment with different colors. I like three of the colors and the other three are too light for my tastes. These don't last more than a couple of hours unless you get heavy handed on the initial application.

title: Soft colors
text: These are soft, subtle colors rather than flashy or attention getters. They highlight the overall look instead of being the look. That works for me in a professional environment....I just want makeup to slightly enhance my appearance rather than announce my presence.

title: No huge difference
text: These are really wet and one pad is definitely enough for one face. They do give you that tingling sensation, but not a burning sensation like some of the random products. I think this stuff hasn't done anything negative, but I don't see any visible difference at all. I'm religious with moisturizer, so perhaps my skin is where is needs to be.

title: Long lasting color
text: This lip gloss actually lasts longer than any other I've tried. It doesn't stay shiny long, but the actual color stays on a long time. The colors are more subtle than you usually see in lip gloss - appropriate for work certainly.

title: Light, fresh scent
text: This is definitely not a fancy, expensive perfume, but it doesn't need to be. I like it as a quick, light scent for errands or every day wear. It fades more quickly than a real perfume. The overall scent is fresh and floral, but not overwhelming or cloying sweet.

title: Cool gel
text: This is a silky, cool gel consistency. A little goes a long way. There's no greasy or oily residue left behind. My skin is soft and feels nice without any sort of irritation.

title: Caramel is pretty
text: I rarely bother with eye shadow, but sometimes it's nice. This is creamy and goes on smoothly without wrinkling up or clumping. The caramel color is a chocolatey brown that works well with my olive skin tone. Eye shadow should not "shout look at me" in a professional environment, it should just enhance and this does that.

title: Nice blush, dark colors
text: I like this blush, but I am not a bronzer girl. The blush goes on smoothly with a good brush and looks nice if you have a light touch. Otherwise it's too dark for my olive skin tone

title: Seems to work
text: This is a clear, thick almost gel consistency. It goes on smoothly and feels cool on my face. It rinses away completely and there's no residue left behind. My skin is soft and clean after I use it a6i haven't experienced any dryness or irritation.

title: Sticky
text: I'm not thrilled with this serum. It's a thin fluid that just feels sticky on my skin. It also takes forever to dry/absorb. I just don't like the hassle.

title: Heavy, heavy vanilla overtone
text:
This is a very heavy scent. It reminds me of that perfume from the 80s...Opium. It goes on very strong and more than one spritz is way too much.
The scent descends into a strong vanilla. I don't like this one much....my preference leans towards truly light, airy perfumes like White Linen or classic, timeless scents like Chanel No. 5

title: Hair is soft and shiny
text: This is a nice conditioner. It smells better than the matching shampoo actually. My hair looks and feels great after using this stuff. However, this is a budget killer compared to my regular and equally good conditioner.

title: Nice lather
text:
I have very thick, long hair and we live in the desert.... my hair gets sun, wind, dust and general grime daily. Shampoo and conditioner are important to me.

This smells ok, not my favorite, but not a bad scent. The shampoo creates a thick, rich lather and rinses away clean. My hair looks nice and has body after using this. It's just a budget killer compared to other equally well performing shampoos.

title: Cleans well, rinses clear
text:
I am a huge lover of honeysuckle, so I was thrilled to see a honeysuckle scented shampoo. Unfortunately, the added coconut scent overwhelms the delicate honeysuckle.

The shampoo does clean and it has a reasonable lather. It rinses away clean as well. My hair looked like normal after it dried and had some bounce.

title: Softens with no skin irritation
text:
I like this moisturizer, but I don't love it more than my regular brand. This is a soft creamy texture and one push dispenses enough.

I've used it for 10 days or so now and it has not caused any irritation or breaking out. It seems to fully absorb and does not leave a sticky residue behind on your face. I think it does a good job at moisturizing out here in the desert. However, this stuff is 3 times the cost of my regular product and I don't see any performance difference between the two.

title: Meh. Colors are muted
text:
The colors are definitely not as vibrant/rich in person as the photos depict. They are very muted shades which is fine, but not great.

I will say none of this palette works alone for my olive skin, I need to mix 3 colors to get what I need. Definitely get a better brush than the one included with this set though.

title: Fresh scent, effective cleaning
text:
We're deep in the Chihuahua Desert of West Texas and that means dust, sweat and general grime. I take cleansers seriously.

After working horses and doing some adobe mixing yesterday, my face was filthy. This cleanser is not extra thick but offers complete coverage.

Within a minute or so you definitely notice a tingling on your skin and the minty scent is quite refreshing. It rinses away completely and there's no residue left behind. My skin is clean feels nice after I use this stuff.

title: Good with thick hair
