text: I used to do clips like these instead of a ponytail and I had forgotten about them. These do a good job holding back thick hair and staying in place. The colors are neutral without being boring. I like these.

title: Excellent razor
text: I'm pleasantly surprised by the razor portion. It's the first one I've found that shaves as closely and smoothly as my Venus blades. It didn't knick or skip any spot, not even over the knee. The trimmer attachment works on a single battery and does a decent job on the bikini area. The handle is easy to grip even in the shower.

title: Delighted a 4 year old
text:
The designs are very nice - super cute the colors are bright and sharp and set my 4 year old neighbor into gales of delighted giggles.

The "tattoos" stuck and stayed on for the most part. Only one was defective and just would not stay on. Nonetheless, these made a young girl extremely happy and that was the whole point.

title: Much, much lighter in person
text:
I like the idea of this foundation more than I like the actual product. It's creamy and easier to apply than a traditional liquid foundation. It does offer full coverage to hide imperfections or blemishes and that's good.

Unfortunately, the color goes on lighter than it looks in the compact. It also dries much lighter and ended up making me look like my face was two shades lighter than my neck or arms. Not exactly what I want from foundation.

title: Soft, good bag
text: This set has a lot of brushes in different shapes and sizes. The handles are all easy to grip and use. The brushes have been good with blush and powder so far. I like the bag as well.

title: Decent coverage
text:
I like this an option for days when I don't want to do full makeup. I use this lightly instead of regular foundation, add a tiny brush of blush, lipstick and I'm good.

This powder is a tiny bit lighter than I normally go, but it's not a visible color difference out 8n direct sun. It stays put and does sort of smooth my overall skin texture. I haven't experienced any skin irritation with it either.

title: No adjustable fit, but soft
text:
I love the rich jewel tones colors of these masks. The material is smooth, cool and comfortable against the face.

They do block out the light of my husband's late night TV. My only issue is that these are big and the strap isn't adjustable at all. When I set up, the entire mask falls off because it's too big.

title: Not impressed. Can't open most of them
text:
First, I do like the colors I was actually able to view. The red glitter is gorgeous and a little sparkly, but not trashy. The burgundy is really classic and timeless. I did notice that the polish was lumpy in the bottles though.

Unfortunately, literally none of the other bottles would open. We tried everything to get them open and zero luck. It's like they sealed from the inside. Quality control here is really poor.

title: Really strong chemical scent
text:
This has a strong chemical scent that hits you as soon as the lotion comes out. And it stays for a long time. I would never put this on my face.

I've used it on the tops of my feet while wearing open shoes outside. And I've used it on my arms. I think the sunscreen part works, but the long term texture of this stuff is greasy.

title: Lovely color, smooth coverage
text:
I like the color of the Mocha - it definitely has a brown undertone rather than regular red. It's a flattering color with my olive skin tone.

The lipstick itself is a little....drier than my usual choices from Chanel or even Estee Lauder. It does apply smoothly and without any sticky spots, but it doesn't feel quite as lush on the lips. So a good back up option rather than my go to lipstick.

title: Feels heavy
text: I'm not really a fan of this. It's heavy and feels thick on the skin. I don't think it ever really absorbs in....it sort of sits there like a too heavy foundation. And if you sweat, it leaves tinted streak marks....not really the look I'm going for.

title: Looks good, no skin irritation
text:
CoverGirl is just reliable in a world of hundreds of make-up options. There might be better products out there, but I prefer stability and known quality.

This blush works well with my olive skin tone and isn't bright pink or carrying a yellow undertone. It doesn't irritate my skin or get cakey over a light foundation.

title: Not noticable
text: I'm not impressed. My original grey is still the original color despite using this twice. It does condition pretty well though. However, I'll look for a better option for brightening my hair

title: Extremely strong scent
text:
Ugh. This is just awful. We could smell it in the sealed box and it did NOT leak. It's strong enough that the UPS guy said he hated it in his truck.

It smells like grapes and something else we couldn't identify with a chemical undertone. Additionally, it made me and my husband sneeze.

title: Doesn't travel well
text:
Well this is unfortunate. The entire block of powder arrived shattered and leaking out of the compact. They need to do like the major brands and wrap these in bubble wrap prior to being sent out. I recently bought Cover Girl blush and it was cushioned. Arrived fully intact and ready to use.

Additionally, the colors here are weird. The one I received is much darker in person than expected. It looks like it has a sort of yellow undertone as well.

title: Budget killer, smells good
text: Holy cow this is a budget killer compared to the major name brands. This smells super nice and it lathers well. However, I literally don't see any difference between this shampoo and the silver shampoo from Pantene that I already use. Well....the cost of three times more for this stuff.

title: Thick lather, very strong scent
text:
I stopped coloring my hair 18 months ago and it turns out that my natural color is no longer auburn. It's grey. Sigh.

However, I have embraced the grey and decided to live my life with less vanity. We're in the Chihuahua Desert with intense sun year round and my hair has developed sun streaked highlights that I like. However, I want to enhance my natural color without coloring my hair. I've tried several different "purple" shampoos with varying degrees of success.

This one is fine overall, but not the best. It does lather well and the conditioner softens my hair completely. The scent though is super strong and not my favorite. I think the Pantene Silver shampoo is still the best.

title: Great in hot, dry climates
text:
I keep Chapstick in my purse, in the car, the horse barn, my saddle bag and of course, in the house. We live in the Chihuahua Desert and that means dry air, sun and heat almost year round. A recipe for chapped lips.

This Vanilla flavor is fun. It smells fresh and tastes like vanilla to me. It goes on smoothly and coats completely. My lips feel hydrated and soft just like with the regular or cherry Chapstick.

title: Pretty colors, looks nice
text:
I really like two of the colors in the "E" collection. The one I don't like is almost purple on the lips - not really my style.

The others are quite pretty and work well with my skin tone. The lipstick is smooth and has a non shiney matte finish. It does rub off easily on cups and straws though.

title: Irritated my skin
text: Not for me. It looks caked on in just a couple of hours - exactly what you don't want in make-up. Additionally, this stuff irritated my skin after just one use. I'll stick with name brand powder from now on.

title: Handy for day trips
text:
We used this for a day trip to Balmoreah State Park swimming hole (Texas) and for lunch out at Monohans Dunes Park. It's light and east to carry from the car to wherever you need.

The blanket worked well for designating our space and setting up chairs and the cooler. It rinses clean easily and dries fast.

title: A finished, smooth appearance
text:
Let me just say first how very much I hate wearing makeup. I have far better things to do with my time, but sometimes I do need to polish my appearance in public.

I've used the mineral powder foundation in the past, but as I've gotten older, it ends up looking caked on. This is a better solution.

It's liquid, but not runny and it doesn't get clumpy on the face. It blends easily and stays looking fresh most of the day. It does smooth pores as more. I haven't had any skin irritation after three uses - but I thoroughly scrub all makeup off as soon as possible.

title: Very light color palette
text:
I haven't worn eye shadow in close to a decade. For lots of reasons, but primarily because the application is obnoxious and I hate messing with it. These cream type sticks take a lot of the tedious application out of the equation.

The color goes on smoothly with very little pressure and feels soft. No dust falling around the eyes either. The little brushes attached to each stick are super soft and actually do blend well. The colors complement each other, but they are very soft and light. When I put on my glasses, you can't really see the eye shadow at all.

title: Not sharp enough
text: This is an attractive set if that's actually important in nail clippers. I don't care what they look like. I care if they cut smoothly in one stroke. These don't. They just aren't really sharp enough and I end up doing several clips. My dollar store silver clippers work perfectly and don't annoy me. In a pinch, these will get the job done.

title: Really nice scent and texture
text:
I'm growing to love this lotion after almost 2 weeks. It has a thicker consistency compared to other lotions, but it goes on smoothly and without glumping up.

The scent is a fresh green tea, but it fades pretty fast so it won't announce your presence in a room. I use this after my shower and love it on my legs - it doesn't irritate my skin after shaving. My skin is soft and feels lovely even 24 hours later.

title: Works well overall
text:
The cleanser in this works well for just everyday, indoor dirt. If you've been outside sweating, cleaning horse stalls or gardening, you're going to want something stronger or exfoliating.

The moisturizer absorbs quickly enough that I don't get that sticky feeling after using it. My skin is softer and feels nice after using both products for several days.

title: Don't stay in place. Inconvenient
text:
I like the theory of this sort of under eye intensive moisturizer. Unfortunately, it's really inconvenient to use.

The viscous gel like texture is very soothing and cool against the skin. The problem is it's also slippery and if you're upright, these things slide down your face. They do not just stay put. The only way I can leave the patches in place for ten minutes or more if I just lie flat.

title: Surprisingly good
text:
I never expect much from these off brand hair conditioners and even so, I still wind up disappointed more often than not. Surprisingly, this is pretty darn good.

I'm outside every day working with horses and a restoration project in the Big Bend area of Texas. This means lots of harsh sun, high heat (it was literally 109 degrees yesterday) and very dry air. It's a terrible climate for long, thick hair. Good conditioning is the only way I don't look like a cave woman.

After using this once, my hair was soft and looked nice. A few more used and my hair feels great, is manageable and does not look like it's dried and fried from the sun/heat/wind. This conditioner does have a strong scent, but it fades in a few hours. I'm pretty pleased.

title: Very wet, does soften skin
text:
Ok, I take skin care seriously. I live in the Chihuahua Desert and that means wind, intense sun, dry air and dust year round. A recipe for leathered, dry skin if you're not careful. I'm also 50 with no wrinkles because I wear a hat, sunscreen and I moisturize for real.

I'm just not bowled over by this stuff. It's fine and does leave my skin soft with a wet like hint of a glow and no irritation. This takes longer to fully absorb, but that sticky sensation eventually vanishes. But there's nothing super special here or better than my regular cream...which also costs half of what this costs. So, it works and is interesting, but it won't replace my regular products.

title: Great option for an RV
text:
I have very thick, long hair and I don't straighten it often, but there are times when I just want a smooth, flat look. My plug in flat iron gets super hot and draws a ton of wattage - fine in a sticks and bricks building, but terrible in an RV.

We're in our RV on a volunteer project for 18 months. I have been trying to find a cordless straightener that actually works and isn't stupid expensive. This one meets my needs.

It gets hot enough to actually straighten waves in my hair on high humidity days, but not so hot that I worry. The exterior is coating in a thick material so it's not burn your finger hot if you touch it. Storage is simple and this unit is very light. I'm surprised and quite pleased.

title: Fine for basic needs, expensive
text:
I used this for the first time after a week in the desert horse camping. Exfoliation was definitely needed. It did a decent job, but nothing extraordinary.

This is softer than I thought it would be. It didn't irritate my face or arms and it did leave my skin softer than when I started. However, after 5 days, it's no better than any other exfoliating scrub for less money.

title: Ok. Hair looks the same with Pantene
text:
Meh. This is the second shampoo from this brand that I have tried in the past month and I'm not really impressed by either of them.

This does clean and it has a reasonable lather. But my hair is not any straighter or smoother than when I use a national brand like Pantene. I won't switch.

title: Basic shampoo at best
text:
I have very thick, long hair that is constantly sun bleached. I've been using the Pantene Silver shampoo and conditioner with excellent results for brassiness and softness. I'm trying this shampoo in direct comparison to the Pantene.

This far, I prefer the Pantene. This gets my hair clean and leaves it looking ok. It just isn't as good for softness as the Pantene. This costs significantly more and it just doesn't measure up for me.

title: Left my hair feeling dry
text: Yeah....I'm not a fan.  This just is not good conditioner for my thick, long hair.  Its thick and sort of stiff coming out of the bottle when compared to three other brands. There is also a weird, very strong chemical scent to it as well  - really don't care for that. My hair feels dry and as if I  didn't bother to use any conditioner. I wont use this stuff again.

title: Helping a dogs dry nose
text: I am actually using this for one of our dogs. Her nose gets really dry in the summer and can crack if not treated. This stuff is soft enough to apply without rubbing or clumping. The larger tube covers more area than a regular sized Chapstick. So far, she hasn't objected to its use and her nose is staying sunburn free and no excessive dryness.

title: Good for real dirt and sweat
text:
This is a decent exfoliating scrub. It's very thick and rough on the skin, but not too rough. After a day working on a very remote desert cabin, my face was definitely grimy - sand, saw dust, sweat etc.

This stuff got my skin clean and soft. No signs of the dirt and I felt refreshed. It does have a more masculine scent, but it vanishes after you rinse off. My husband says it did a good job for him as well.

title: Decent shampoo.
text:
This is a thick, silky smooth shampoo. It's sort of pink in color, so you won't confuse it with a different brand in the shower.

It does get my thick, long hair clean. There's no oil or residue left behind - it rinses away completely. I like this, but it's not the best shampoo I've used and it is definitely a budget killer. I don't see any real difference between this and Pantene actually.

title: Pretty colors
text: I have very thick, long hair and pull it into a ponytail or bun almost every day. Scrunchies are a mainstay for me.  These are decent, basic daily use options. Not as thick or plush as the name brand versions, but certainly functional.  I like the color mix and they stay put in my hair even when horseback riding.

title: Fresh scent,  actually cleans real sweat and dirt
text: I love this cucumber scent  - its just fresh and light rather than heavy perfume. It foams lavishly with every pump. Despite working outside in sun, sand and heat every day, this body wash gets me clean. No sweat or horse grime left behind.  I haven't experienced any skin irritation with it either.

title: Soft, thick and no skin irritation
text: My husband and I both have seasonal allergies. We go through a lot of tissues. We like the Puffs and Kleenex extra soft equally. These are thick, soft and non irritating. They don't cause redness or a sore nose if you're having a severe attack.

title: Softens thick, long hair
text:
So this isn't a leave in conditioner, you need to rinse it out after letting it sit awhile. It's a thick, creamy texture that fully covers my thick, long hair.

I am in a dry desert environment and I spend a lot of time outside in the sun - just begging for dry, stiff hair out here. This conditioner did a great job. My hair is very soft, shiny and tangle free and it looks good. I've been leaving this in for 5 full minutes before rinsing.

title: Nice coverage
text: This powder is interesting.  It's a nice color match for my skintone and it doesn't irritate my skin. It does have a glittery finish to it, so this is not a matte powder. I like it, but adding blush, eye shadow and lipstick with this powder is way too much because of that glitter finish.

title: Hair is soft and clean
text:
I'm outside in the West Texas sun and wind every day working with horses. That can be hard on long hair. A good conditioner is a must.

This shampoo gets all the daily grime and dust and sweat out. It has a mild scent and rinses away cleanly. The conditioner is thick and creamy and coats fully. My hair is soft and bouncy and looks pretty good.

title: Good for mineral style foundation
text:
I very rarely wear makeup since we're down at the ranch and see very few people. However, I still try to resemble a 21st century women rather than a covered wagon hag when we make that 60 mile trip to town.

I use a light powder type foundation and this brush handles that fine. It distributes the makeup evenly without needing a heavy hand. It doesn't leave my face looking cakey either. The brush is certainly easy to see in this neon lime green color. The handle is thick and easy to hold, but I do think it is a smidge slippery.

title: Thick, long hair is no problem
text: I work outside with horses every day. That means a bun or pony tail every day. These scrunchies actually work great with my very thick, long hair. They hold well and don't slide down or loosen up even in wind. I prefer the velvet type over the slick ones in this pack, but they all work very well.

title: Great for a dry, word climate
text:
After two weeks of daily use, I really like this cream. My skin looks great and is very soft despite hours in the West Texas sun, wind and dry air every day.

It's thick, but not clumpy and smoothes on easily. It absorbs fast and doesn't leave any sort of residue or get sticky. I haven't had any sort of skin irritation or redness with this either.

title: Ended up looking weird
text: Normally,  I avoid foundation at all costs. I just hate the way it gets cakey, splotchy and feels heavy after a long day. Sometimes you do need actual makeup and I thought this might be better than old school liquids,. It's not. After 4 hours, it was looking like I had extra crows feet and adding powder made it look like I was plastered in makeup. I'm going back to the old mineral dry foundation or doing without foundation entirely  - my time is more valuable than vanity.

title: Helped with very dry skin in low humidity
text: My husband is using this on his arms and hands daily. We're deep in the Chihuahuan desert of West Texas and the air is dry. Very dry. And sunny with wind. His skin really suffers for it despite our abiding love of this climate and locale. After ten days, he's pretty happy. He says there's a sticky feeling at first, but once the cream fully absorbs, it goes away. His skin definitely looks better and no more visible dry spots.

title: Needs extra rinsing
text: Meh. I don't hate this cleanser, but I don't love it either. It left a slightly greasy residue on my face and I had rinse several times to get rid of it. After trying several times with decreasing amounts,  I still never fully lost that weird sensation. It did clean basic daily grime and dust and my skin was never irritated by this stuff. It's just not a product I would ever use on a regular basis.

title: Smells real,  helped desert air skin
text: I am surprised that this lotion smells like real roses and not fake, chemical too sweet "rose". It is thick and creamy without being heavy.  I've been using it daily after a shower for my very dry desert skin. It absorbs reasonably quickly and  doesn't leave a sticky residue behind. The scent fades after an hour or so, but that's fine. My skin is definitely softer and does not look or feel dry despite working outside in the Chihuahuan desert every  day. I am beginning to love this.

title: Would not turn on at all
text: Well, I don't know if this thing works or not. My unit will not power on at all. We tried three different brands of new batteries and...nothing. I do not have the time or patience to fix some random junk. I trashed it.

title: Creamy, but sticky after applying
text:
I use moisturizer daily without fail because I'm outside in the elements working with horses. Despite the West Texas sun and heat, I have hit 50 with no wrinkles to speak of and my skin isn't leathery. I have a couple of go to brands and mostly use Olay products. But it never hurts to try something new.

This is a cream. Its not super dense, but its not thin either. It does go on easily and there's no scent I have noticed. It takes awhile to fully absorb and that's my issue with it. If I go outside to saddle horses, I certainly don't want a sticky face cream that attracts dirt to my face. If I were stuck in an office all day, this probably wouldn't be an issue.

title: Darker the photos
text: For functionality, I like this foundation. It's smooth and applied almost mess free. The little tube is easy to handle and store in small quarters. I wore it for a few hours at home only and had no skin irritation.  Unfortunately, the color was significantly darker than expected and made me look like I had a bad fake tan. I am willing to try this again, but only after I see the actual colors in person first.

title: Thick, no greasy residue and no scent
text:
I work outside with horses in West Texas and volunteer at a state park doing outside projects. That means sun exposure and wind every day - dry skin and sun damage is a given. I take moisturizer seriously. This is a pretty good cream. Its thick and silky feeling. There's no scent that I can detect which is always good.

This goes on easily and absorbs completely and quickly. I haven't noticed any greasy residue or stickiness after using it either. My face looks good and feels very soft which is what I expect from a face cream.

title: No greasy residue,  no skin irritation
text: This is a good quality set of products.  I can't detect any perfume or added scents in any of the three items.  I've used the face cleanser and moisturizer for several days now without any skin irritation.  The cleanser gets the daily horse and desert grime off completely,  but doesn't dry my face. The moisturizer is silky and absorbs really fast without leaving behind any type of residue.

title: Softer, shinier hair
text:
I've been really pleased with the Silver Expressions conditioner, so adding the shampoo was a no brainer. This smells good and produces a nice lather.

It rinses clean without any residue left behind. My long, thick hair has more grey than I care to admit and it's time to treat it better. After using both this shampoo and conditioner for a week, my hair is softer and looks great. I'll continue to buy this in the future.

title: Thin & small. Not good in long, thick hair
text:
Scrunchies are a daily use item for me. Unfortunately, this set is just not working for my hair. These are small, thin and just don't hold thick, long hair well.

They get loose and begin to slide within 2 hours. Perhaps someone with thin hair, short or fine hair might be able to get better results.

title: Working in direct West Texas sun
text:
I've used this for several days consecutively in bright West Texas sun while working outside. My skin tends to dislike most sunscreen so I am careful about it. Going without is absolutely not an option down here on the Texas/Mexico border.

This spritzes on lightly and does not get goopy or feel heavy. It absorbs quickly without any greasy residue left behind. After five days of making and applying adobe mud in the direct desert sun, I have no sunburn or any skin irritation at all. That's important and I'll keep using this.

title: Really improved my hair in just days
text:
I'm rather impressed with this conditioner after a week. Like so many others, this year, I decided there was no reason to continue paying to have my grey hair colored. There just comes a point where you embrace the grey hair as a sign of life lived well and move on. Very freeing actually.

What I had not realized was going full grey meant my hair was becoming more coarse and dry. Plus relocating to the ranch in West Texas meant much drier air, stronger sun and heat. None of which are doing my locks any good. This Silver Expression conditioner has done what my other three conditioners failed to do. My hair is soft, thick and very manageable again. After a week of daily use now, my hair feels great and looks good - no more coarseness or dry fly aways. Plus this stuff smells really nice.

title: Smells weird, but softens dry heels
text: This is a thick, but silky cream. It feels heavy at first before it fully absorbs into the skin. It does seem to soften dry heels and with daily use it keeps them that way. My issue is the scent.  Something about the scent makes my nose itch and I have sneezed a couple of times when using this.

title: Not great, smells like wax
text: Meh. This says it is unscented, but it smells like candle wax to me. There's no lather and I didn't feel clean using this after hiking and sweating before my shower. I tried it again on a day with no outdoor grime etc and it was ok. If you actually need to get clear, you need a real soap. I just can't see spending more than a couple of bucks for this, certainly not in the twenty buck range.

title: Looks and feels like cheap vinyl
text:
These certainly look better online than in person. The colors are ok - your basic autumn palette in brown, tan, and an orangey color.

My immediate impression as I opened the package was "Cheap vinyl". And that impression is still correct after using these. They do hold a pony tail or loose bun, but not as tightly as a traditional scrunchie.

These things also make a weird noise when touched.... remember those low end pleather chairs in waiting rooms that squeak when you sit down? Yeah...that sound.

title: Helps cracked, dry skin
text:
I'm out in the Chihuahua Desert for the winter. That means sand, sun, low humidity and wind which all lead to dry hands and feet.

This goes on creamy and absorbs fast. It doesn't leave a greasy residue behind either. It has helped the cracked skin around my finger tips after 4 days.

title: Working well in the desert
text:
We're in deep West Texas where the sun is extra strong and the humidity extremely low. (Yay) However, this leads to dry hair very quickly.

I'm really surprised at how well this leave in conditioner worked for me. It didn't leave a heavy or sticky residue. Yet, my hair was tangle free and soft for 24 hours. I've used it a few times now and my hair definitely looks and feels better overall.

title: No help with really dry skin
text:
I'm not impressed with this lotion. I suppose that if your skin isn't truly dry, this stuff will keep it in good condition. However, I'm in the West Texas Chihuahuan Desert and dry skin is serious. Our average humidity is 15% and there's wind which can lead to cracked fingers and elbows in a hurry. I need a real moisturizing lotion every day,

This stuff smells very strong and the perfume scent lingers for a couple of hours. It doesn't leave any sort of greasy residue behind. However, my hands still feel dry and rough despite using this 3 times a day for a week. I'm going back to the Goat Milk lotion.

title: Nice, sturdy clippers
text:
Nail clippers are literally something I never think about until I can't find them. I have no idea when we last bought one...maybe 5 years ago?

This set is pretty good. The clippers are easy to hold onto and use. The blades are sharp enough to get the job done in one take.

I don't think the catcher actually works well. Not do I care for the glass nail file - it wasn't helpful with a snagged nail that had a sharp point.

title: Soft and no skin irritation
text: I can't speak to makeup removal, but these wipes definitely get the day's grunge off my face. I'm working outside in West Texas and the sand, fine dust and sweat create an unpleasant grime. The wipes are a reasonable size and quite soft. I haven't experienced any skin irritation yet and these do leave my face clean and soft.

title: Harder to rinse off, no better than my regular body scrub
text: Meh. I'm not sure exactly why I would choose this over a different brand of scrub. It's  smooth and smells nice, but as far as true exfoliating action....I didn't notice a difference at all. My skin didn't feel any softer, more moisturized or cleaner than with a significantly less expensive product. I did notice that it was harder to fully rinse off.

title: Works fine, but not the best in a dry climate
text: I had thought this might be as good as my regular Bates Farm Honeysuckle Goat Milk Lotion for the super dry air of the Chihuahuan desert. It isn't. This stuff is thick and creamy and feels nice when you apply it. I appreciate that this lotion absorbs reasonably quickly and doesn't leave behind a sticky residue. There's a faint eucalyptus type scent to this, but I definitely prefer the honeysuckle in my regular lotion. In the end, the Goats Milk Lotion hydrates better for longer. I also prefer paying half the money for double the quantity of my usual brand.

title: Very pretty,  rich color. Not drying
text: Wow - this Red Glass Ruby is a gorgeous color. Softer than most true reds, but brighter and  fuller than even red tinted pinks. The lipstick itself is soft and smooth and just glides on without smearing or feeling dry. It stays slightly..."wet" for a long time as well. My lips don't look dry or blotchy 2 hours after putting it on. I really like this.

title: Smells so good
text: I'm reviewing the shampoo, not the conditioner. This stuff smells just amazing- I can't quite identify the scent, but I love it. The shampoo is a tad thicker than some other brands and very creamy. It really  lathered well and my hair felt and looked completely clean after a day in dust, wind and sweat. My hair is shiny and soft, can't ask for more than that.

title: Same results as more budget friendly brands
text:
Ok, I understand that some women swear by the most expensive, fanciest, high end brands of moisturizer and face cream. I also grasp that there are certain ingredients that work better than others. However, after a week of use, I just do not see why this is a 3 figure price point vs my very budget friendly Olay products.

This stuff is silky smooth and feels nice on my skin. It does absorb fully within 30 minutes and there's no sticky residue left behind. My skin does feel and look good.

All these things can be said about the Olay products Ice used for years or even the Tizo gel. I'm about to turn 50 and I have zero crows feet despite a life outside with horses and dogs. I swear by daily sunscreen, sunglasses and a daily moisturizer routine - it doesn't need to take a fortune if you want good skin that ages well.

title: Budget killer,  but does deep clean
text:
My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back, so shampoo is important for me. Plus I work outside with horses ever day and means sun, dust and sweat. I've used this stuff three times so far and I like the scent. It lathers well and doesn't feel runny or too thick.

After a particularly hot day, yesterday, my hair was literally soaked with swear - like i had been swimming. This shampoo got all the day's grime and sweat out entirely. Whatever those exfoliating beads are, they left my whole head feeling super clean and fresh. Unfortunately, I have to use a lot of shampoo to be sure all of my hair is covered and that makes this shampoo unaffordable for me. At this price point, it's four times the cost of my regular stuff and thats a deal breaker.

title: Strong scent
text: As a rule, I wear sunscreen daily since I'm outside with dogs and horses year round.  Thus seems to be working, but I sweat a lot most days, so I'm reapplying often. This doesn't leave a greasy residue behind, but it takes longer to fully absorb than other brands.  I really don't like the chemical sweet scent of this - fortunately it fades fast.

title: Cooling and soothing
text:
The texture of this more jelly than gel - its definitely got the wiggle and jiggle of jelly. Applying it is simple and the product actually absorbs quickly without any greasy or sticky residue left behind. I love the agave plant and have seen amazing uses for it throughout Mexico over the years, including facial care.

This stuff feels very cool on the skin, especially after a hot shower. It does seem to moisturize and soften skin - within 4 days, I really noticed the effect. None of these products are cures for wrinkles, crowsfeet or general aging. However, this agave stuff feels nice and softens things a bit.

title: Stiff even  when wet
text: I'm not entirely sure what these are really suited for. They do work to remove makeup when wet, but the fabric is hard and stiff. I really don't care for the texture against my skin. I tried these on the dogs' paws to get mud and the towelettes perform the job. However,  even the dogs don't like the feel of these.

title: Absorbs quickly, no sticky residue
text:
I'm almost 50 with no visible crows feet despite a life lived outside working with dogs and horses. I moisturize and, wear sunscreen and sunglasses every single day. As a rule, I buy Olay under eye cream and that is what i have used 90% of the time for many years. After two weeks using this stuff, I honestly don't see any reason to spend three times as much for the same results.

This is a thicker texture than most under eye creams - it almost feels stiff at first. It goes on smoothly and absorbs very quickly without a sticky residue left behind. There are no fumes that waft up to irritate my eyes after putting it on. It does help with under eye puffiness, but no more than my usual daily cream. It's nice stuff, but no miracle in a jar.

title: Expensive, works as well as store brands
text: This is a light moisturizer. It isn't thick, but isn't watery either. There's no real scent that I can discern and it hasn't irritated my skin at all. I have noticed that it 5akes longer than other similar products to fully absorb. This is not some miracle cure for aging or dry skin....it works as well as my usual Oil of Olay, but I'm not sure this worth the extra cost.

title: Use after a shower before hair dries completely
text: My husband has tried this a couple of times so far and he will continue to use it as needed. His scalp can get a little dry in summer as the temperature heats up. He says it works best for him right after showering.  The cream absorbs in without leaving a greasy residue on his hair when it dries. It does help with his minor seasonal itch.

title: Works great for every day use
text: Solid hairspray. This sprays evenly and dries fast. It does seem to help with smoothing unless you're in high humidity. I do like that this holds without giving the hair that crunchy texture.

title: Smells great and holds well
text: All the Aussie sprays smell great and this one is no different. It holds well all day as long as it's not super humid. There's no crunchy texture to my hair when I use this. It's good hair.

title: Smells good
text: I don't know if this hair spray actually protects from uv damage or not. There's no real way to determine that. But it does smell nice and it covers well. In high humidity, it's not as effective as other brands. However,  on regular day, this does hold my hair in place without getting super stiff.

title: Full coverage of heavy grey. No ammonia smell
text:
I am pleasantly surprised by this hair color for several reasons. First thing to note is the Intense Red is really a deep, burgundy color. It's lovely, but not a bright red, more like a glass of burgundy wine type of color. It's very pretty though.

This does require an extra step that the other box colors don't. It has a cream you apply to your dry hair before the actual colorist put on. My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back, so there wasn't enough of the prep cream to cover all of it. If you have short or fine hair, you'll be fine. The color mix doesn't have that overwhelming ammonia scent that most of them have which is a nice change- this color did not give me a headache.

The color absolutely covered all of my thick, distinct grey roots and that is awesome. I left it on for 40 minutes to set before rinsing and the color is rich and even and I did get full coverage out of the bottle for all of my hair. I'm pleased and would definitely buy this in the future.

title: Severe allergic reaction
text:
I was in the middle of my shower when I started itching and my skin began to feel like a huge bug bite. I had just finished lathering with the pomegranate and hibiscus body wash. My entire body began to turn red as I rinsed off and scrubbed with a clean washcloth. 30 minutes afterwards, I'm dry, but everything itches. I've had to take Benadryl to stop the allergic reaction from escalating any further.

My house guest used this last night and she had zero problems. She loves it and says her skin is very soft. I'm sending her home with all of this stuff. I'm disappointed because I've never had a reaction to a Dove product before and this smells great.

title: Holds well even in humid weather
text: I really like the other Pantene hair spray I've tried and this one is just as good. It holds well even in high humidity. I don't know that my hair could be considered soft and touchable with this or any hairspray actually. This does not leave a crunchy, hard shellacked feeling though.

title: Ok, but nothing special. Average performance
text:
I have very thick hair that reaches the small of my back and I take conditioning seriously. I have used this 3 times now and it's average quality conditioner. There is absolutely nothing special going on here to warrant the extreme cost.

It left my hair soft, but no more moisturized than my usual Suave conditioner. There's a slight vanilla type scent as you use it and it has a thick, creamy texture. Everything rinses away completely and I can't detect any scent after my hair dries. I do think my hair is softer and looks better with my inexpensive Suave products.

title: Smells nice, lathers well
text: This is a very thick bar of soap almost like getting a bar and a half of regular soap. The one side has a rough texture for some exfoliating action and the other side is smooth, regular soap. It smells nice - very floral, but not an overwhelming scent. My skin feels nice and clean and soft after a shower with this. I like it, but I'm not entirely convinced that it is worth a ten dollar purchase.

title: Caused burning and breaking out for me. Sister loves it
text:
My sister and I both used this peel yesterday. We had completely opposite reactions to it. She loves it and I really hate it. The texture is a thick, lumpy gel that you apply and then rinse off. There may be more detailed directions on the bottle, but every word was printed in Korean and utterly undecipherable by us.

My sister said it left her face feeling super soft and smooth. I have to admit that her skin looks very nice. I, on the other hand, experienced burning and redness and 8 hours later four break out spots on my face. I won't ever use this again.

title: Nice
text: This is thicker and creamier than my usual chapstick. The tubes are bigger which makes them easier to hold even with gloves on. I like this stuff, but I still prefer the medicated original chapstick for real chapping.

title: Fine for touch ups on the go
text: In a pinch or traveling, this could be quite handy. It weighs very little and can easily be recharged on the go. I would not use this to shave my legs on a regular basis - its just too small and doesn't create as close a shave as a real razor. This is fine for quick touch ups though. Its quiet too.

title: Thick texture.  Chemical scent
text: Meh. This is not something special or fancy. This is a thick texture that actually feels dry after it absorbs  and feels weird. It also has a distinct chemical odor that I really dislike. After five nights, I stopped using this entirely.  Zero effects and my skin felt dryer than it did without it. I'm going back to my regular Olay  moisturizer.

title: Works well for thick, long hair in high humidity
text: So much humidity here. It leaves my hair with fly away puffiness that drives me nuts. I've used this conditioner three times now and I've been pleased. Its thick and provides full coverage easily for my very thick, long hair.  My hair is soft and pretty well behaved after using this. It seems a bit smoother and less prone to frizz despite our ridiculous humidity. It seems to do what it claims.

title: Fine for basic stuff. Little bit crunchy dry
text:
I've tried several new hairspray products recently and this is good stuff, but not great. I spray my hair every day to survive barn chores and outdoor elements.

This does hold in a brisk breeze and humid. It has no obvious perfumed scent added either. However, it did dry with a bit of that crunchy feel and look.

title: Great for thick, long hair
text:
I have rotated between Pantene and Sauve hair products for years on a regular basis and been happy. I have very long, very thick hair and I work outside with horses and dogs every day. That means a good conditioner is a must or my hair can end up dry and dull.

I love the light rose scent of this conditioner. It's soft, subtle and classic. The texture is very creamy and silky and it moves through my hair easily. My hair looks shiny and bright and is very soft to the touch after using this conditioner. I will definitely continue to use this in the future.

title: Works well, but gets a little crunchy
text: I've tried several new hairspray products recently and this is good stuff, but not great. It does hold in a brisk breeze and humid. It has no obvious perfumed scent added either. However, it did dry with a bit of that crunchy feel and look.

title: Surprisingly good at refreshing my hair color. Easy to use
text:
I'm actually really surprised and pleased by this colored conditioner. It's dead simple to use and did actually revive my color. I used the red for my auburn red hair with grey. The conditioner is very thick and a brick red color out of the tube. I just massaged it into my wet hair after shampooing while in the shower. Put on a shower cap over it and finished my shower. I only left this on for 5 minutes and then rinsed it out. Everything went directly down the drain with zero staining.

The end result was a soft, subtle refresh of my color. Almost like light highlights. Its noticeable, but doesn't scream "look at me". This certainly won't cover grey hair, it's not meant to, but it did soften the grey by adding fresh color to the hair around the greys. I suspect if I leave it on for the full ten minutes that result would be more intense. I'll definitely keep using this.

title: Holds in high humidity
text:
I have very thick and very long hair and I work outside with horses and dogs. That's a recipe for a mess without good hair spray.

This spray smells good and continues to offer a light scent for quite awhile after it dries. I like the flat angle of the spray as it comes out of the can - I get very good coverage. It holds up in high humidity and my hair stays put. I'll definitely use this on a regular basis.

title: No skin irritation. Easy to use and clean
text:
My husband has always had a thick beard for the entirety of our 24 year marriage, but a new job means he has to be clean shaven now. Once the grumbling and complaints ran their course, he decided that an electric shaver was required. He seems happy with this one and he looks good after using it. His skin doesn't have red spots or signs of irritation after several weeks of daily use.

The razor stand charges it and that makes things go faster every morning. It uses a solution to clean it and a little brush to remove the bulk of the stubble. He says the razor is shaped well and comfortable for his big hands to hold and maneuver. He also likes the pop up trimmer on his mustache and lower neck area. Overall, he's as pleased as he can be considering the loss of his beard and new daily hassle of shaving.

title: Smells wonderful,  holds hair all day
text: Wow this spray smells amazing.  It's a very fruity, cheerful smell. I like that the spray comes out in a wide mist and offers greater coverage than expected for a non aerosol. I've used this for several days now and it's done a fine job. My hair is very thick and long and wind can leave me looking like a crazy person.  This spray keeps everything in place and looking nice all day long.

title: Works great with long, thick hair
text:
I work outside with horses and dogs every day and that means sun and dust which can dry out my hair fast. I take conditioner seriously. My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back, if it's not conditioned, I look like a crazy person.

The texture of this is very creamy and thick. It covers very well without using a ton of it and it smells nice. I let this sit in my hair for the full three minutes and rinsed. Everything rinsed cleanly without a greasy residue. My hair dried very soft and tangle free and looks great. I will definitely add this conditioner to my routine a couple of days a week.

title: Dries without the crunchy, stiff feel
text: I'm pretty pleased with this hair spray.  It was windy today and I had stuff to do that meant no ponytail today. Had to actually style my hair and I used this stuff. It smells nice and comes out in a decent mist that offers real coverage. My hair looked good and started in place all day. It did not have that stiff, crunchy look or feel that you get with cheap hairspray.

title: Dries without being crunchy, holds well in high humidity
text: We live in East Texas and that means high humidity and rain year round. Hairspray is a must if I don't want to look like a big puff. This spray smells really good and it goes on in a light mist. It dries smooth and doesn't feel crunchy. It has held up well on a 95% humidity day with no wind.

title: A little goopy, better on feet than the face
text: I'm not thrilled with this lotion for my face. It's very thick and takes a very long time to fully absorb. Plus it just does not leave my face feeling as soft as my other moisturizer.  I've actually been using this on my feet and it does ok there. My heels are in nice shape.

title: Smells awful.  Cleans ok
text: I work with horses and dogs every day and that means real dirt and sweat on my face.  I take cleansing seriously. This stuff does get the grime off and rinses away clean, but it doesn't lather. I have not experienced any dry skin or irritation with this. My problem is the smell. It just sells awful. Very strong chemical scent that totally grosses me out.

title: Thick lather,  soft scent
text: I have very thick,  very long hair and I take care of it. That means shampoo and conditioner are important. This smells great, but it's a soft, unobtrusive scent. The lather is fluffy and thick and rinsed away completely. My hair is soft and shiny with this shampoo and looks nice. Plus all the day's horse related dust etc is washed out fully.

title: Finding the right amount can be tricky
text: I like Garnier products for the most part. This leave in conditioner does work if you get the amount right. Use too little and it doesn't do anything. Use too much and you get left with a slightly greasy feel and look to your hair. I have very thick hair that reaches my lower back and I work outside with horses, so conditioner is important. It took me four uses to find the right balance to avoid the greasy overload and the not enough tangles. My hair is soft and manageable using this and it has a nice coconut scent.

title: Nice shampoo for long, thick hair
text: I really like this shampoo after several uses. My hair is very thick and very long and I work outside with horses every day. That means actual dirt and sun damage if I don't take care of it. This shampoo lathers nicely and it smells nice without being an overpowering everything else. My hair looks good and is soft without looking or feeling dry.  I also like that this rinses out clean and there's no residue left behind.

title: Thick, but absorbs very fast
text: I've been using this every night for about ten days.  It's a very smooth, thick and creamy, but not goopy. It absorbs very quickly and thoroughly without leaving a sticky residue behind. I use it in the under eye area and  around the crows feet real estate. I haven't experienced any skin irritation or burning fumes from the cream. My skin looks refreshed and feels very soft.

title: Still need a leave in conditioner. No lather
text:
I have very thick, long hair and I work outside with dogs and horses year round. I take shampoo and conditioner seriously simply because the Texas sun can dry hair fast. After a week of daily use, I just can't see why this stuff is so expensive - there's no way it's worth thirty some odd bucks!

There's relatively no lather from either the shampoo or the conditioner. My hair also feels drier and far less conditioned than compared to my usual Suave or Loreal shampoos and conditioners. My hair still needs a leave in conditioner after using the Luseta. Maybe if you have short hair or thinner hair, this stuff might be fine, but it's not getting the job done for me.

title: Not for real grime or sweat
text:
I work outside with horses and dogs every day and that means sweat, dust and real dirt. I typically need a serious scrubby type cleanser because the fancy stuff doesn't really do grime. This isn't any different - it's just too mild for real dirt. However, as a second step, following a heavy duty cleanser, this is nice.

The texture is very silky and smooth and it does not foam or lather at all. It leaves my already clean skin softer and feeling nice. It also rinses away clear and no residue left behind.

title: Working fine for light, daily use
text:
It might be December, but this is Texas and it's still 74 degrees here today with loads of sunshine. Sunscreen is basically a year round requirement for me since I work outside with horses.

This seems to be working fine - I have not had any tanning or sunburn and that's all I ask for. I will say that I like the sort of dry way it applies - it's not a liquid, goopy mess. I have noticed that the sprayer will gum up now and then and has to be cleaned out.

title: Smooth and silky application
text: The Getting Serious color is a deep, bright true red. There's no hint of pink or softness in this red. I like it, but this is not a red for the shy. It applies smoothly and easily - it's not dry or stiff at all.

title: Good for long, thick hair. Smells great
text: I picked up a bottle of this locally for two bucks on a whim. It's a giant bottle and the coconut scent is very nice. I have very long, very thick hair and this stuff has done a good job of keeping it soft and shiny.

title: Absorbs fast and no skin irritation or fumes
text:
Olay is just reliable. I know the product will be safe and budget friendly and work for me. I like this eye cream much more than the so called luxury brands for four times the price.

The cream is silky and doesn't feel heavy as it's applied. It absorbs very quickly without leaving a greasy residue behind. I've used this for ten nights and haven't experienced any skin irritation or redness and there are no times irritating my eyes. I think it may have softened the under eye circles a bit.

title: No skin irritation and no magical results
text: All these face serums and lotions seem to proclaim superpowers for miraculous results. This one is no different and performs no better than the Olay products for significantly less money. It is a thicker texture than my regular stuff and takes longer to fully absorb. However, I didn't have any redness or skin irritation and my skin felt soft after using this for ten days. It's not likely that I will switch over permanently though.

title: Lovely scent
text: What a cute little set. The scent is definitely orange spice - it reminds me of the orange spice tea my Mother drinks. The candle burns properly and the scent floats quite a way. The hand lotion is very thick and absorbs quickly without a sticky residue. I like the soap for light washing up rather than heavy cleaning after doing barn chores.

title: Does what it says with a nice lather
text:
My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back and I work with dogs and horses every day. That means I take shampoo and conditioner seriously. I also color my hair my original auburn red now that the grey has taken over.

Red can fade and get brassy fast in the Texas sun. This shampoo did tone it down a tiny bit after four uses. I like the texture and that it really creates a thick lather. The price is right - especially since I tend to use more product than someone with shorter hair.

title: No skin irritation
text: I'm a fan of wipe cleansers when I'm traveling. These are fairly good about removing the accumulated grime. They didn't irritate my skin or cause any redness. They are small though when compared to other similar products from Olay etc. I think for the money, there are better options if you need to use them daily, but for a couple of days on the road, these are fine.

title: Not great with very thick, long hair
text:
This is not a bad leave in conditioner if you have short or fine hair. My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back so conditioner is something I use a lot of.

I used this three times and had two issues with it. I do love the scent - it's sort of lemony and fresh. However, it takes almost twice as much of this than my regular conditioner to fully cover all of my hair. As a result of the excess quantity needed, my hair feels like it's coated in a slightly greasy film after it dries. It sort of looks flat when I use this.

title: Too thick for the face. Ok on feet
text: As a face cream, this is not for me. It is very thick and gooey in texture and feels like it just globs on the skin. It takes forever to fully absorb and leaves a greasy residue behind. It's better for elbows and feet and seems to soften the skin in those areas - but still leaves a residue behind.

title: Did nothing for undereye circles
text: Yeah....as a concealer, this is just next to useless. It doesn't conceal anything. Dark under eye circles don't appear any lighter either. My inexpensive concealer from the drug store is much better. I will say this stuff has a nice texture and absorbs quickly.

title: Whipped texture. Takes a long time to absorb fully
text:
I like the texture of this potion. It's very light, airy and mousse like. It goes on thicker than you expect though and it's taken me a few days to get the hang of not using too much.

This stuff takes awhile to fully absorb - an hour after applying it, I can still feel a sticky residue. I don't like that at all. After two weeks of using this nightly, I have not seen any difference at all between this and my usual eye cream. Well.... this is way more expensive than my regular brand.

title: Nice selection of body lotionsthem
text:
The Body Lotions set is a nice sampler of different Aveeno lotions and scents. Three of them are basically sample size and one bottle is full size. I really like the Daily Moisturizing lotion for my legs and elbows. It's creamy and absorbs very quickly. I've actually noticed a definite positive change in my elbows after a week of daily use.

Unfortunately, the big bottle of Stress Relief lotion just smells terrible to me. It's a combo of lavender, chamomile and ylang ylang and the ylang ylang just overwhelmed everything else. Plus it made me sneeze. My friend seems to think it smells lovely, so it's just me.

title: Heavy, thick and takes hours to absorb
text:
This is a really thick, heavy cream that reminds me of the old fashioned cold creams. It takes forever to absorb even with a light coat. I won't use it on my face again because it felt like sunscreen that never went away.

I will say that it is nice on the legs after shaving and it does soften feet. Of course at almost forty bucks a tub, it's not worth using just on legs.

title: No real results that I can see
text:
I don't think this actually does anything for colored hair at all. Natural highlights seem slightly brighter immediately after using this, but that may simply be wishful thinking.

It doesn't smell bad and the spray comes out in a fine mist. The directions say to completely soak your hair and wait three minutes to wash it. That is probably fine if you have short or thin hair, but my hair reaches the small of my back and is very thick. It took almost a quarter of the bottle to get it all wet. That's just not worth the effort or cost for me.

title: Does a nice job getting grime off hands
text:
We wash our hands constantly here - with 7 dogs, 1 cat, and multiple horses around here, hand washing is just a constant thing. My preference is the foaming soap, but really, almost any soap will do.

This stuff smells like tea tree oil and it's not too thin or so thick that it feels like toothpaste. It does lather reasonably well with some vigorous rubbing. My hands and forearms get clean and the barn grime comes off completely.

title: Lubricant strips are way too thick to remove all hair.
text:
I am one of those women who shaves my legs every single day. Stubble just grosses me out, so I don't mess around with substandard razors. I absolutely love the original three blade Venus razors. I have used them for years because they never fail and my legs are smooth without nicks.

Unfortunately, this one isn't great. At all. The lubricant strips on either side of the the blades are way too thick. They leave a slimy trail before and after the blades pass over and.... stubble. You cannot get a true, close, stubble free shave with this razor until those gel things wear off. It took four uses to get the stuff out of the way enough to have a complete removal of hair. I'll just stick with the originals.

title: Nice scent. Works for fine, short hair
text: My husband is very pleased with this two in one shampoo. His hair looks good and feels soft and he says his scalp feels fine. For me though, this isn't a great option. My hair is very thick and reaches the middle of my back... conditioner is just non-negotiable. This stuff left my hair clean and shiny, but tangled and feeling a bit dry. I ended up using a leave in conditioner just to be able to brush my hair. If you have short or fine hair, this is probably a good choice, just not for me.

title: Sturdy sticks that don't bend or break easily
text: As a rule, I don't like any other brand of cotton swabs except the original, Q-Tips. Most of the others have weak sticks that bend. These really surprised me - they are sturdy and don't bend with the slightest pressure. The tips aren't as thick as Q-TIPS, but there's enough cotton to do the job. I've used these to keep our dogs' ears clean after they go swimming or on a hike in the woods and they work fine.

title: Consistency of water.
text: Ahhh.... another skin potion/snake oil making oodles of grandiose claims. And yet another one that does zilch. This has the consistency of watery and absorbs about as quickly as plain water. I put this on for eight nights. Absolutely no effects of any sort other than laughter. Well, I did notice that I needed to go back to my regular, simple moisturizer.

title: Nice moisturizer. Takes a couple of hours to fully absorb
text:
I use several different Olay products and I like them - they are affordable and seem to work as well as the hyper expensive potions. This is a decent overnight moisturizer. It's a gel like texture and applies very smoothly. It feels cool as it goes on too.

My one complaint is that it still feels a little sticky two hours after putting it on. I can't use this right before bed because of that - I put it on around 8pm and by 11pm/midnight it's fully absorbed and there's nothing rubbing off on my pillows.

title: Subtle scent, rinses clean and lathers well
text: My husband normally use another brand of body wash, but the scent is really strong. He and I both wanted something else that was a little less pungent. This stuff has been a hit the past few days. It lathers up nicely and definitely gets him clean. He likes that it rinsed away clean in the first try - no residue left behind. We both appreciate the softer, more subtle scent. It doesn't smell like he literally showered in cologne.

title: No white residue. Absorbs quickly
text:
I'm in Texas and that means sunscreen year round. I use it, but I don't like most of it. This stuff is better than most in several ways....but I don't think it's worth the extra cost. At least not for daily use.

It does feel light instead of a greasy mess and that's good. It absorbs quickly compared to other sunscreens without any of the old fashioned white residue left behind which is also good. I have noticed that it feels sticky for awhile after the first application and the scent lurks around for a long time.

title: Slow and ineffective with thick, long hair
text:
This is a good idea in general, but not for every head of hair. My hair is very thick and reaches the middle of my back and this Gizmo just can't handle it. It doesn't put out enough heat or blow enough air to even pretend to dry my hair - even in small sections. If I use a real hair dryer first and get my hair just shy of completely dry, then this works ok for me. It does add a bit of wave and movement, but I get the same results just using a curling iron.

My sister was here and used it on her shorter, fine hair. It did dry her hair, but it took significantly longer than with a regular dryer. She wasn't impressed any more than I was. I can't see ever using this thing on a regular basis.

title: Working well in Texas summer sun
text: I can't speak to the water resistant ability here because I haven't been in a pool or beach scenario this year. However, I do work outside with horses every day and sunscreen is just a must. This isn't goopy thick or watery, it has a nice consistency and goes on smoothly. I think it absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky residue behind on my skin. So far I have no extra tanning on exposed skin and no redness at all. It has been bright sun with a heat index of 106 for days now and I still have barn work to do, so I've definitely been in direct sun.

title: Greasy residue, doesn't absorb.
text: I really don't like this. At all. It's very thin and runny and feels like vegetable oil rather than a facial product. I used very little and it just doesn't absorb fully and left my face looking and feeling oily. The next time I used even less and the results were the same. Your skin looks "dewy" because it has a layer of oil on it shining in the sun. The third day was my last - my skin felt clogged and just gross.

title: Much too sweet vanilla smells like cookies.
text:
I'm reviewing the vanilla scent hand lotion and I'm not thrilled. The scent is so strong and way too sweet - it literally smells like cookies.

The lotion itself does moisturize and it goes on smoothly. I also tested it on my legs after shaving and had no irritation from it. I do like that this absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy residue behind. However, I still prefer my regular lotion and it costs a quarter of what this stuff does.

title: Cakey and heavy looking
text: I try not to wear makeup daily - just when I need to see folks in professional or social situations. This stuff just isn't quite right even for my occasional needs. The included sponge thing is stored under the make up and seems like an invitation to grit and bacteria growth. It's also thin so trying to put the foundation on is not a great experience. The end look is cakey and heavier than I care for. I'll just stick to my regular Estee Lauder products in the future.

title: Very handy, lightweight mirror. Lights on it are dim
text: I like the mirror for basic hair touching up and a quick confirmation that my lipstick is on right. The magnified side is helpful as well. I'm not thrilled with the lights though. They are really dim on my mirror and essentially useless even with the high setting chosen. I do like that this is portable and can be used in different places and stores away easily.

title: Strong citrus impression
text: I like this cologne more than my husband does...which means he still wears it sometimes to humor me. It has a masculine scent with strong citrus overtones. It takes a long time to fade back, so you definitely don't want more than a single spritz.

title: No difference between this and Ivory actually
text: This is a simple bar soap with no scent. It does clean and I haven't had any skin irritation using it. I think this does melt faster than other similar bar soaps though. In comparison to a simple Ivory bar, this isn't any better than Ivory. I can't really find a reason to buy this over our usual soap.

title: Ok if you're not really dirty or sweaty
text: This stuff is as good as any other body wash, but it's not fantastic enough to warrant a price over twenty bucks. It is scent free and didn't cause any skin irritation after three days use. It does a fine job getting you clean as long as you're not grimy with sweat or real dirt. After a day working with horses in 90 degree temps, this stuff just didn't get me clean. I had to use real soap. I think I'll stick to my regular Caress and Ivory soap.

title: Once a week and my hair looks great and is healthier
text: It's very rare to find a hyper expensive hair product that is actually worth the extra money.  This stuff is really great.  I'm still not convinced it's worth quite as much as the current price, but almost. I have very thick, long hair and it can get dry after working outside with the horses every day. This shampoo and conditioner really made my hair soft, bouncy, and shiny. It looks great. I'm using it once a week and my regular shampoo and conditioner the rest of the time and my hair is noticeably healthier and prettier. I'm kind of amazed actually.

title: Absorbs quickly with no residue
text: I like this better than some of the high, pricey brands. I've used it for a week straight and my skin is soft and there's been no irritation or redness. It has a creamy texture and feels light on. I really appreciate that this cream absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky residue behind.

title: Really strong scent
text: Seriously strong scent that takes hours to fade back. It's not bad, just not even a little bit subtle. My husband says it's a decent deodorant, but not a great antiperspirant. He still gets a little sweaty in the underarms compared to his regular stuff. This does go on dry and hasn't left marks on his clothing.

title: Stays too wet for every day use
text: This stuff is definitely shiny and bright. It's a nice color that doesn't shriek "look at me", but does brighten your face a bit. I like the color. This stuff does tend to stay wet and sticky a little too long. Because of that, I don't wear this before going out to eat simply because I don't want to leave lip color all over a glass or silverware.

title: Fresh, clean scent
text: I definitely prefer refilling soap bottles to just throwing them out. This stuff smells fresh and clean and isn't so strong that it fills the room when you wash your hands. The soap is thick and cleans well. After several days of multiple hand washings per day, my hands don't feel dry or rough.

title: Great for legs
text: I love these razors for shaving my legs. My husband can get his own batch, these are mine. The handles are easy to hold even in soapy water. The 3 blades are sharp and smooth and glide along without any nicks. I've used one four times to shave my legs and it's still very sharp - I do shave my legs daily, so your mileage may vary.

title: Beautiful, bright red that isn't for the shy
text: Whoa...this is not your Granny's red. This is bright, high shine, reach out and grab you red and it is gorgeous. This stuff does stain so use some vasoline along your skin at the hairline and old towels etc. I've gotten lots of compliments on my hair and I'll probably use this again. It's red and it does fade even when you avoid sun and use appropriate shampoo and conditioner....all red hair dye fades and within a couple of weeks.

title: Actually colored the grey hair and looks good. Super easy
text:
At 48, grey hair is just a part of life and so is not always having time to get my color done before the grey is super visible. I tried this tonight after procrastinating for too long. The color is a surprisingly close match. 90% of my grey roots are no longer grey, so it worked for me.

It's very easy to use - certainly easier than doing a full color at home. Just push the button, mix the two creams together, brush on right where you need it, wait five to ten minutes, rinse it out and you're done. There's enough product for several uses. I'm pretty pleased overall and will definitely use this again.

title: Thin, requires double the usual amount and still needed a leave in conditioner afterwards
text:
This brand is new to me and I have used both this conditioner and the matching shampoo for several days now. I really didn't like the shampoo at all and the conditioner is fractionally better. My hair is very thick and long so conditioner has to really work or I end up with big puffy, frizzy tangled mess. I have had to use a second leave in conditioner every time I've used this stuff.

The scent is fine, but strong. The texture of this is gross. It's thin and a dirty, yellow brownish color. I have to use double the amount of my normal conditioner to get full coverage for all of my hair. At this price point, that's just a budget killer. It leaves my hair soft and looking clean, but also difficult to brush and needing a second product. Maybe fine or short hair fares better than mine.

title: Thin, watery consistency. Not great with thick, long hair
text:
I have very thick and pretty long hair - it reaches the small of my back - so shampoo and conditioner that really works is important. I normally rotate between Sauve and Loreal for my daily hair care with excellent results. This stuff smells ok, but that's about the best thing I can say.

The shampoo is very thin and watery and a gross brown color. I ended up using twice as much as my normal shampoo just to fully cover all of my hair. It doesn't lather as well either and it took a little longer to wash all my hair than I'm used to. Everything rinsed away clean with no residue left behind. For me, this just isn't worth the premium pricing and I don't see anything special about it. Maybe it's better with fine or short hair.

title: Hair is soft and low frizz in humidity.
text: I've never heard of this brand before, so I was skeptical about it actually working. My hair is very thick and reaches my lower back - conditioner is a requirement for my hair in our high humidity region. I've used this twice now and it really does leave my hair soft and tangle free and reasonably frizz free despite the 80% humidity today. The scent is mild and there's no stickiness left behind after I use it. I'll continue to use this when my hair needs a little extra help.

title: Scent is too strong and sweet
text: I like Olay products for the most part, but this body wash isn't one I would repurchase. The strawberry scent just overwhelms and it's a bit too cloying for me. Plus the weird bottle/bag makes no sense. It doesn't stand correctly and tips over easily.

title: Thin, watery consistency
text: Meh. This isn't bad stuff, but I don't think it's terrific either. It's a very thin, almost watery texture out of the bottle. It takes more of it to do a dry mask than !y usual stuff, but it does seem to have the same effect. My face feels smooth and soft and there's zero skin irritation from this. I don't think I'll switch brands though.

title: Smells great, gets real dirt off
text: I'm not usually a fan of body washes because they tend to be hard to rinse off fully and they don't always get actual dirt off. This one is really better than others I've used. It smells great - very bright and crisp sort of scent and it doesn't irritate my ski . It did get off real dirt after a day working with horses and cleaning the barn. It seems to rinse clean - I haven't noticed a residue left behind. I like this enough to continue using it.

title: Smells terrible.
text: Ugh. This conditioner smells terrible. Makes me think of glue and it stays with your hair. It did a basic conditioning on my hair - not as good as the Loreal or Sauve conditioners I normally use though. My hair is very thick and very long and I had to use almost twice as much as the Sauve to cover all of it. I won't use this again simply because of the bad smell.

title: Worked while trail riding
text: I like the spray can application simply because it's faster and less messy. I've used this a couple of times now while trail riding and no sunburn. This has that normal sunscreen smell and it doesn't seem to fade away.

title: Smells great and cleans well
text: I love this scrub. It smells fresh and clean and light. The scrubbing bead things do their job and left my skin soft and definitely clean. This stuff does lather and I actually used all over, not just on my face yesterday. No skin irritation or redness - I am going to add this to my daily skin care regime.

title: Light lather, thin consistency. Takes more than usual to do thick, long hair
text: I've used this three times so far and while it is gentle for colored hair, it's too gentle for really dirty hair. The consistency is really thin and it takes more of this shampoo to get all of my hair than my usual shampoo. My hair is very thick and reaches almost to my waist plus I'm in the midst of a remodel project which means there's dust and what not in my hair every day.  This shampoo does lather, but lightly. The scent is very mild and I think it cleaned my hair, but I had to use more than normal. That means this stuff is a budget killer for my needs

title: Absorbs quickly, no greasy residue
text:
Retinol is an ingredient that I have not used often and the general consensus is only use it at night - sun can cause a reaction. So I have been using this cream after my shower in the evenings only. The container has a push top that allows the cream to come out and you run your finger over it to swipe it up. It dispenses just enough in one push for my needs.

The texture is a smooth, cream that's not watery or oily. It applies easily and for me anyway, absorbs very quickly. I haven't experienced any skin irritation or sensitivity. After three weeks, I haven't noticed any changes either... My skin is moisturized and soft though.

title: Reminds me of Dial soap
text: This is a lot of hand soap. A lot. It is very similar to Dial soap in appearance, scent and consistency. I think it gets my hands just as clean as the Dial and it's not drying my skin. I've just refilled a couple of bottles with this soap without any problems.

title: Rinses away completely, no skin irritation
text: These are simple to use and seem just as effective as the Biore strips. The main difference is that these dissolve when wet and can be simply be rinsed off, scrubbing as it goes. I haven't experienced any skin irritation with these and my face is clean and free of blemishes.

title: Easy to hold and clean, soft shave
text: I shave my legs daily - stubble is just never acceptable. My normal razor is the original 3 blade Venus and it just works without drama. These disposable versions are almost as good and the best disposable razors I've used yet. They are easy to hold and give a smooth, clean shave. I've used one four times now and no nicks or cuts. My legs are smooth as silk and look great.

title: It's ok, but nothing special here
text: I have very thick, very long hair and I work with horses outside every day. Dry hair is always a risk so I take my shampoo and conditioner seriously. This stuff is ok, but it's not great and it certainly isn't any better than the Loreal or Garnier I typically use. And at twenty bucks for a small bottle, it's not worth it. The scent is ok and fades out after you dry your hair. It lathers fine and my hair is clean and soft after using this. After a week, I haven't noticed any significant difference and no change in my hair overall.

title: Works as well as Gold Bond, but stronger scent
text: My husband has used Gold Bond powder for decades with no complaining. He tried this for a week and says it works just as well as Gold Bond. It kept his feet comfortable and dry all day. The only thing we both noticed, is the scent is pretty strong and stronger than the Gold Bond.

title: Will not turn on or run at all
text: I have another of these from a different brand and it's really a great gadget. This one just doesn't work. It literally won't turn on. I thought the included battery might be dead, but even with my own new battery, nothing happens. For whatever reason, my unit is a dud.

title: Does a nice job, but so does my daily conditioner
text: My hair is very thick and very long, so conditioner is must. This stuff is a thick, cream texture and easy to massage through all of my hair. It has a nice scent that fades away pretty quickly. It rinses completely out and my hair feels soft and not dry after I use this. It's fortunate that this stuff is just once a week rather than daily use. It's really pricey and a small bottle. The results are fine, but any better than a good daily conditioner.

title: Pretty good for shaving legs
text: I'm always on the lookout for a great razor for my legs. This one is pretty darn good. It moves and rotates without being loose and so far, no knee knicks. The blades are sharp and I've done my legs 4 times with one.

title: No allergic reactions, keeping our hands clean at the stables
text: I really appreciate these big bottles and dispenser systems  - with lots of dogs, we wash hands all day long. This soap has no scent and doesn't irritate my skin at all. It does a good job of getting dirt off and it foams well. I've put one of these with the dispensers, in our horse barn bathroom and the feed room so no one has any excuse for dirty hands.

title: Helps slow color fade
