text: This shampoo does not add color, it just helps slow down the fade that is so fast with red hair. It does seem to do that pretty well. I like the scent and the fact that it does actually lather and clean my hair. My hair is soft and bouncy when I use this and I don't have any real complaints.

title: Left thick, long hair tangle prone
text: I like the body wash from Simple Suds, but this conditioner is not for me. The scent is weird and my husband really disliked it. My hair is very thick and very long, so conditioner is a must have, especially in our humid climate. I have used this twice and both times my hair feels soft, but is difficult to brush. It still behaves as if I had not used any conditioner. Maybe with thinner or shorter hair this would be fine, but not for me.

title: Not really good with very thick, long hair
text:
I've tried several of different shampoos and conditioners from HairRX and I'm just not impressed. The scents are fine and I haven't experienced any allergy issues. However, I have very thick and long hair and so far none of the products from this brand do much for my hair.

It takes more of this to cover my hair fully than my regular brands - I normally use Sauve and Loreal. My hair looks dry after using the HairRX and is definitely more prone to static electricity. My mother tried this stuff and the lavender scent while visiting and her looks nice - she also has short hair rather than down to her waist like mine. I think this is just better suited for short and finer hair.

title: Not great with very thick, long hair
text:
I've tried several of different shampoos and conditioners from HairRX and I'm just not impressed. The scents are fine and I haven't experienced any allergy issues. However, I have very thick and long hair and so far none of the products from this brand do much for my hair.

It takes more of this to cover my hair fully than my regular brands - I normally use Sauve and Loreal. My hair looks dry after using the HairRX and is definitely more prone to static. My mother tried this stuff while visiting and her looks nice - she also has short hair rather than down to her waist like mine. I think this is just better suited for short and finer hair.

title: No fumes or irritation. Seems to help with puffiness
text: I have a tendency towards dark under eye puffiness when I'm stressed or sleep deprived. I've used this cream for two weeks and it does help. It's a little thicker than the other stuff I had been using, but it still absorbs quickly. I have not experienced any skin irritation and it doesn't have fumes that cause my eyes to water. I'll buy this in the future.

title: Strong and very effective
text: I work outside with horses every day and that means dirt, sweat and grime. I try to take care of my skin and these strips are certainly a welcome tool. They are stronger and thicker than the original version and I noticed the difference immediately. The results are noticable as soon as you remove the dried strip - I'm going to use these twice a month as a part of the regular routine.

title: Pretty copper color, not great for grey coverage
text: I've been using a different version from Garnier to color my hair for a couple of years with good results. This is slightly different in color and the mix in oil is a different type. It's still the same basic process and my long, thick hair still requires two boxes for full coverage. This color is more copper toned than my usual red and offers some faint golden undertone shading. This is a little bit light for true grey coverage for me - the other deep red is much better for me.

title: Not good with thick, long hair
text:
My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back, plus we live in a very humid part of East Texas. This means there are days when my hair gets frizzy and puffs up like cloud - not a good look. I've used other frizz control conditioners with decent results, but this one just doesn't measure up.

I have to use twice the normal amount to get full coverage with all my hair. After my hair dries, it just doesn't feel as soft or look as nice as with my usual brand. I don't think it does as well with frizz either. The coconut scent is very nice though. If you have short hair or fine hair, this is probably better than with my thick, long hair.

title: Left my thick, long hair feeling unconditioned and needing a second leave in detangler
text: If you have thick, long hair, you may want to find a different conditioner. My hair is very thick and reaches my waist line so conditioner is a critical item or I end up looking like a cave woman. This stuff just isn't up to my needs and I ended up using a separate leave in detangler after my hair dried. The vanilla scent in this is super strong and stays around all day.

title: Worked out in West Texas
text: I used this for a couple of days in West Texas and I had no sun burn on my face. So it seems to work. It can be hard to get applied and fully absorbed. I had a weird, slightly visible residue on my skin for a while after putting it on. I am pleased that I didn't experience any skin irritation.

title: Sweet scent, thick and does work with long, thick hair
text:
I have very thick and long hair that behaves badly in high humidity. Conditioner is a must for me. I have been pleased with the different Garnier shampoo and conditioner products and this one is a decent leave in conditioner. It has a very distinct sweet scent, but it does not overwhelm you.

This is meant to be used after you shower, while you're hair is still wet. It's a thick cream like any regular conditioner and you massage it through your hair and go on about your business. It does leave a bit of a residue behind on my hair, but it does condition and help control humidity induced puff.

title: Strong, sweet scent. Hair is soft and shiny
text: I've used several of the Garnier Whole Blends shampoos and conditioners and I like them. This one does a nice job with my very thick and very long hair. My hair feels clean and soft and has a clean, bright appearance after it dries. My only issue is the intense scent - it's really sweet and can overwhelm the bathroom after your shower is finished.

title: Smooth and creamy texture that definitely needs careful blending
text: This is very creamy and goes on smoothly, but you still need to blend it in. A very little amount goes a long way to sort of brighten up the area. Use too much and you'll end up with glittery bits spread over your face like a clown. I have not had any skin irritation from it so far.

title: Works well with long, very thick hair
text:
This is a product that either works or doesn't and this stuff works for my hair. It has a definite, strong scent that sticks around a long time. It's sort of flowery, but not bad. This comes out in a fine mist rather than a stream so you see better coverage.

My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back plus I work outside with horses every day. This means my hair can definitely get dry and wind whipped. This spray helped me brush out my hair after being in a ponytail in the wind yesterday. No tangling and my hair looked and felt softer for several hours after I used it. I'm impressed.

title: Fresh, bright scent. Cleans well, very thick
text: This stuff smells great - very citrusy and fresh. It's a thick, viscous texture that goes on thick and massages in thoroughly. It does take a little more effort to rinse off than thinner products, so I only use this in the shower. It does a good job cleaning the daily grime off my face and neck after being out with the horses. My skin is soft and clean and I haven't experienced any skin irritation at all.

title: Not great with thick, long hair. Slides down and loosens easily
text:
First, I do like the color and it goes well with most any hair color. It feels like cheap silk and behaves accordingly - wrinkles and snags very easily. I wear a pony tail almost every day because I work outside with horses and dogs. My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back, so scrunchies have to be tough.

I require a scrunchie to stay in place and hold all of my hair without slipping or loosening with lots of body movement. This scrunchie starts to slide within an hour or so and that drives me nuts. I think perhaps if you have fine hair or short hair - like shoulder length - it will probably work fine.

title: No skin irritation, daily horse barn grime is gone
text: I work outside with horses and dogs every day and that means my face has grime that requires real cleaning. This is a thick texture and it doesn't really have a scent that I can detect. It does a good job cleaning my face and I haven't had any skin irritation. This is not really exfoliating, but it deep cleans for me.

title: Left my hair tangled and way too fluffy. Not good for thick, long hair
text:
First, let me say that I love this brand's hairspray and it really works for my hair. However, I'm not impressed with this conditioner at all. I have very thick, long hair and it requires real conditioner or it becomes a thick, tangle of knots. I use Sauve or Loreal normally and my hair is soft, shiny and tangle free even after a day at the horse barn.

This is a reasonably thick cream texture and it has a strong sweet pea scent. It does rinse clean, but I had to use double the usual amount for full coverage. When I tried to come through my wet hair afterwards, it was painful. Lots of tangling and it didn't get better as my hair dried. After it was dry, my hair looked clean, but was missing the normal softness and it had a lot of extra puffiness - not what I need from conditioner.

title: Budget killer, but it does work well
text:
I typically hate the dry shampoo stuff because most of it leaves a weird residue or powder behind. This is a foam that goes on sort of wet, but dries very fast. I have used it twice and there was no visible residue left behind either time. It has a light flowery odor, but not overpowering and I don't smell it at after 30 minutes.

My hair does look fresher and any oil built up from not really washing it appears to be gone. This really is good stuff for occasional use. I can see taking it out to the ranch in West Texas where water is precious and I try not to wash my hair every single day. However, at this price point, it definitely will never be a regular purchase for us.

title: Really good with thick hair and no stickiness
text:
Frankly, I am surprised at how much I like this hair spray. I have very thick hair and it goes up n a bun or ponytail every morning before working with the horses and hairspray is the only thing that keeps me from looking like a complete cave woman.

This smells flowery with an undertone of that usual chemical scent of all hairspray. It really holds well even in a wind and while doing physical chores. My hair doesn't feel sticky or look shellacked when I use this spray. I will definitely consider buying this stuff in the future.

title: Stick part is weaker than actual Q-Tips and bejds with light pressure
text: These technically do the job for cleaning an ear. However, I definitely think the original Q-Tips are superior. These have a little less cotton on the tip, but that's not a problem really since it's just a tiny difference. My problem is the sticks. The sticks are not as sturdy as the Q-Tips and they bend with the least pressure. This is a pet peeve of mine and means I can't use these to clean in crevices or grout lines.

title: Easy to apply, red 66 is a rich color. Lasts about 4 weeks before roots show
text:
I've been using the Garnier hair dye for a couple of years now since the grey took over my naturally red/Auburn color. This Red 66 is a slightly less vibrant red than the Garnier R3 Intense Auburn that I usually buy. This is still a nice, rich red, but with less copper.

I like the included conditioner and it's fine for a single use. The key to the red colors is do not shampoo when you first rinse the color out and use the conditioner. Then wait two days to do a full wash and condition so the red has time to really set. I find the color lasts about 4 weeks for me before I have truly visible roots. It does cover my grey.

title: Work as well as the regular Venus razor and easy to travel with
text:
I've been using Venus razors and blades at home for many years and I have yet to find something better. I shave my legs every day - stubble is just so gross - even when I travel. As a rule, I dislike all disposable razors, but they are a necessity on the road.

These have big enough handles to be comfortable and easy to hold. The blades are sharp and sturdy enough to actually do the job several times before needing a new razor. I don't have any nicks, cuts or missed spots after three days with one razor.

title: Thick enough for thick, long hair. Stay in place all morning
text: I have very thick hair that reaches the small of my back and I wear a ponytail every morning when working with the horses. Finding scrunchies that both fit my thick hair and stay put can be a problem. Most of them are just too small, hut these do a great job. They also stretch enough to let me put my hair in a bun and stay tight. The colors are a little drab, but it isn't a deal breaker for me.

title: Works very well for legs
text:
I shave my legs every day and I do not bother with cheap disposable razors - stubble is just gross and completely unacceptable. I expect a razor to be sturdy, easy to hold in the shower and have flexibility to move a bit over the knees. I expect the blades to be sharp and provide a smooth shaved for at least 10 uses before needing to be replaced.

This razor does what it should and it's a little heavier than the typical plastic women's razors. That extra weight is nice and helps guide it more easily without slipping out of my fingers. These razor blades are three blades and about the same size as any other brand of blades on the market - though they only fit this razor. I actually waited 3 days to shave my legs before using this (yuck) and it did a great job - no nicks, no cuts, no missed spots at all. My legs are extremely smooth and that's exactly what I expected.

title: Way too bright and hard to get off
text: I love gorgeous lipstick and I tend to wear red often, though my favorite has always been Sugared Maple from Estee Lauder. I thought it might be fun to try a pink lipstick and it turns out that this isn't a good one for me. It's very bright and very pink - way too pink for me. I have olive toned skin and red hair and this looks like I'm trying to be a teen again. It also stains my lips and requires some effort to fully remove.

title: Big enough for really thick, long hair. Nice assortment of patterns and colors
text:
My hair is very thick and long enough to reach the small of my back. Pony tails are a daily thing for me since I work with horses every day. I only use scrunchie style ties to protect my hair from damage, but finding ones big enough can be difficult.

This set is really nice. The 18 scrunchies come in a wide variety of colors and patterns to suit you moods or outfits. Most are single jewel tone velvet and there are several in a slick material with flower patterns or stripes. The stripes are actually quite attractive. I'm really pleased, these fit my hair easily and stay in place all day without loosening or sliding out.

title: Caused 2 breakouts in ten days. Unpleasant stuff
text: I'm not understanding why this is so much pricier than any of the other serums from every day brands. After ten days, I've literally seen no difference at all in fine lines or general improvement of my skin. What I have noticed is that on day three my face had two break out spots for the first time in many months. By day 10 it happened again. So I'm not going to use this again, something ugly is going on here and I'm returning to my regular Tizo face serum.

title: Absolutely softens and conditions dry hair.
text:
I have very thick hair that reaches the small of my back - a lot of hair. I also work outside with horses and dogs every day in the sun and wind and that can lead to dry hair. I take care of my hair and this conditioner is definitely going to be a permanent part of my hair supplies.

It smells good, but not flowery, like a mix of Moroccan oil and something else similar. It has a thick consistency that spreads easily for full coverage of even my thick hair. After a week, my hair is visibly shinier and softer to the touch and looks great even in a pony tail.

title: Skin is soft and this absorbs fast with no residue left behind
text: I'm surprised by how much I like this. It has no scent or fumes and a very smooth texture. It's almost the same texture as Vasoline, but it does not behave like it. Applying it is fast and easy and there's no greasy or wet, sticky residue left on your face. I use it immediately after my shower and it absorbs very quickly. My skin feels soft and looks great and this doesn't irritate my eyes.

title: Weird fake shine and slightly waxy feel.
text:
I'll be honest, I quite sincerely do not understand why any man would ever wear a rug. There's no need to hide a balding head, just be you and be proud. My brother began losing his hair at 25 and by 28 he was just shaving his head and he looks great. It's never hurt his romantic life or his self confidence.

Meanwhile, this is supposed to be human hair, but it feels weird and a little waxy to the touch and has a very artificial shine to it. It's actually creepy. My brother agreed to try it on and said the net thing made his head itch. My husband declined to even put it on after inspecting it. It actually just looks fake and ridiculous - I suppose you could pay to have it cut and styled by a professional, but again....Why? Why torture yourself? My husband and brother both suggested I use it as part of the Donkey's Nativity costume instead.

title: Caused immediate allergic reaction.
text:
I deeply wish perfumes were required by law to list their ingredients and allergens used. I'm very allergic to soy in all forms. I had a nasty reaction to this within minutes of a single spritz on my wrist. My skin turned red, my eyes itched and watered and I was definitely beginning to wheeze. I couldn't scrub it off fast enough. I have never in my life had a physical, allergic reaction to any perfume before. There has to be a soy derived ingredient in this.

The scent is very pleasant and I would probably love it - hints of Jasmine and vanilla. The bottle is an attractive shape, but very slick and wide so it may be difficult to use if you have any sort of arthritis issues. I'm just going to stay with my Chanel No 5 - it's reliable, classic and always a beautiful scent.

title: Smells great, coverage is smooth and complete. Dogs think I actually have cake
text:
I'm one of those people who has tubes of Chapstick everywhere - in all my purses, in the truck, in the bathroom and kitchen and on my bedside table. I work outside with horses and dogs every day, so Chapstick is a must.

I normally only use the Peppermint or the Medicated versions, but the Cake Batter just sounded fun.
It smells amazing! No flavor and the coverage is smooth. My only issue is the dogs smell this and are convinced that I have cake hidden on my face. They are cracking me up trying to sniff me and find the secret cake.

title: Smells amazing. Shampoo is better than the conditioner for long, thick hair
text:
This is easily one of the best smelling shampoos ever - I wish I had body lotion in this scent actually. The shampoo is very silky and creamy in texture and it lathers nicely. My hair can get full of dust and the like after working with the horses, but this does actually clean.

The conditioner is a different issue. It's too thin and watery for my hair. My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back - good conditioner is a must for this much hair. The conditioner might be fine for someone with short hair. I have to use almost double the amount compared to my usual brand to keep my hair soft and untangled.

title: Takes twice as much for sketchy results compared to Sauve
text:
Nope. If you have thick or long hair or, like me, very thick hair that reaches the small of my back, this is not good conditioner. It smells good. The texture is creamy, but thin and it takes A LOT to cover my hair.

I had to use literally double the amount of my regular conditioner and my hair still felt and looked like I had not conditioned it fully. My hair still needed a leave in spray on conditioner after my shower to eliminate tangling. That's just ridiculous and at this price point, it's a bad joke. I will just stick with my regular Suave and Loreal color care shampoo and conditioner.

title: Works like any regular powder. No skin irritation
text: Maybe I'm just not seeing something everyone else sees with this powder, but it literally looks no different on than my regular powder from Estee Lauder. It brushes on smoothly and without caking or clumping up. It's a subtle color that blends quietly over make-up and doesn't stand out. I am pleased that I haven't experienced any skin irritation using this, but I just don't see anything extra super special here.

title: Smells great and rinses away clean without a residue left behind
text: My husband really likes this particular scent. He uses the Dial three in one regularly and likes it, but this scent is new to us. It's bright, crisp and fresh. He says the soap rinses away clean without any residue. His hair and beard are soft and look nice too with this.

title: Nice wide plates are good for thick hair
text: I have very thick hair and it tends to get wavy in our high humidity. Normally, I just put it up in a ponytail and go about my business. However, there are times when I need my hair to behave and look nice so a straightener is a must. This one is nice and wide which is good for thick hair. It does a decent job for my hair, but I have another Revlon straightener that I like better. This one is a little shorter than the other one so it takes longer to do my hair. If you have short hair, it won't be an issue.

title: Lots of foam, good coverage and fresh, cheerful scent
text: We go through soap here like crazy. Between dogs and horses and everything else, we wash our hands multiple times a day. This soap foams up thick and it doesn't take a lot to get full coverage. I really like the scent as well - it's fresh and clean and cheerful. So far, I haven't noticed any drying of my skin with regular use and that's certainly a good thing.

title: Heavier and slower than my old dryer. No retractable cord
text:
I have very thick hair that reaches the small of my back, so hair dryers are a thing I'm picky about. I have a very powerful Conair that I love, so I'm comparing this dryer to that. This one is bigger and heavier than my Conair, but this one has a better grip. It's wider and easy to hold, but the cord doesn't retract and that's a negative.

The actual drying is fine. This dryer gets hot fast and it dries just like it should. However, it takes longer than with my Conair - like a full 25 minutes to do my long hair compared to 20 minutes. It works well enough for a basic hair dryer that is used infrequently. I'm going to put this in the guest bath and keep using my old one.

title: Thin, weird residue left behind and strong chemical scent.
text: This is a generic copy cat of the St Ives apricot scrub and it's not great. The scent is definitely more chemical/artificial than the real St Ives scrub and it's really strong. The cleanser itself is thinner than the original and it feels a little oily in my hands. The scrubbing bead things are noticeable and I did feel like it got the day's horse barn grime off my face. However, I had to use regular Dove soap to get rid of the residue left behind. I think I will just stick with the real St Ives in the future.

title: No visible difference, but no skin irritation either
text: I've used this eye cream for ten days now and I like it. The texture is soft and creamy with no weird oily residue. It absorbs quickly and I haven't experienced any fumes that cause eye irritation. I don't really see any difference whatsoever in the condition of my under eye area, but my skin is soft.

title: Cleans well even after a day at the horse barn. Skin is soft and clean
text: A good face scrub is a must in my world. I spend my days outside working with horses and dogs which means real dirt and sweat. This is very viscous and thick with a distinct scent that makes me think of cinnamon rolls. It heats up when you start to massage it into your skin and it feels great. My face is clean and looks it after I use this scrub. I like it, just wish the scent wasn't as strong.

title: Silky smooth, absorbs fast, but a budget killer
text:
I've been religious about using eye cream and moisturizer since my 20s. Now, at 47, despite a life spent outside working with horses, I have no visible crows feet. I've tried lots and lots of different brands and formulas and in the end, they are almost all pretty much the same. I literally can't see or feel anything significantly better or different with this stuff compared to my usual Tizo.

This cream is very silky smooth in texture and it has no fumes that waft toward your eyes. It does absorb quickly and there's no greasy or oily residue left behind. My under eye area feels soft and the skin looks good when I use this. However, like I said, it's not any better than my regular stuff - both work well.

title: Nice for simple face washing, but not deep cleansing after a day outside with sweat
text:
This is a decent face cleanser for simple needs like after removing make-up or if your face hasn't seen anything more than a day in an office. If you really need to clean after working out or being out riding horses - real dirt - then you'll really need something more substantial.

For the light duty stuff though,vthis isn't bad. It's a silky texture with a bit of a pearly appearance. It does foam and produce a lather. I haven't had an skin irritation using this and it's nice, but not really suitable for my active, outdoor animal lifestyle.

title: Very thin, watery texture. Doesn't lather well, but smells fantastic
text:
The Jasmine scent is heavenly and fills up the entire bathroom - frankly, I need to find a perfume like this. However, as actual shampoo, this just isn't great and it's certainly not worth paying the premium for it. The shampoo is very thin and does not lathers well. It takes twice as much to get my hair clean as my regular shampoo.

My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back so rinsing clean is a big deal for me. This stuff just doesn't really feel like it's completely gone. I will say this, it did leave my hair shiny and feeling soft and that Jasmine scent was still present hours after my hair was dry.

title: Beautiful, rich true red color. Doesn't make my lips dry at all
text: Sometimes a woman just wants a gorgeous, deep, true red lipstick. Something that declares her presence and confidence. This is indeed a True Red color that looks great. It's smooth and silky going on and doesn't feather at all. My lips felt soft and didn't have that waxy texture that you get with the cheap off brand lipsticks. I'm adding this one to my regular rotation.

title: Gabby color is much lighter than the photos. Feels nice on
text: I love a good lipstick and wear it often. I was thinking this Gabby color would be reasonably close to the Sugared Maple from Estee Lauder - alas, it's not at all. This is much lighter and barely visible. I have an olive skin tone and this is just a bit darker than my actual lips. The lipstick itself feels nice on and it didn't dry my lips. It's more like a tinted gloss with a matte finish than traditional, full color lipstick.

title: Very soft, nice with blush application
text: These are really nice brushes - very soft bristles that seemingly float over the skin. I have used this set for blush and they do a great job. I like the longer handles because I can get a better grip with my arthritic fingers and still maintain control.

title: Very soft against the skin with even application.
text: I did not realize how ratty my old make-up brushes had gotten until I used these. These are incredibly soft and the bristles just flow over my face. The foundation is deposited smoothly and evenly with no clumping or splotchy spots. I like the long handles because I can use a light stroke and control how much powder goes where. These are very nice brushes - hopefully they will last long term.

title: Strong scent that lasts all day. Fresh floral/citrusy scent.
text: I'm pretty finicky when it comes to perfumes and as a rule I almost never stray from Chanel No 5. This one is surprisingly nice and I really like it. It's a mix of floral and citrus and something else I can't quite put my finger on. It's also strong - two quick spritzes is plenty and the scent lasts all day for me. I don't care for the bottle simply because you can't see how much is actually in there.

title: Smooth effect without skin irritation. Color choices can be hit or miss
text:
I don't wear a lot of make-up as a rule and I only do foundation when we're going out with friends or to an event of some sort. As a result, my skin can react negatively to liquid and mineral based foundation so I thought this might be a better option.

The stick cuts a wide swath so you speak so you don't need to cover your whole face. Just blend it with a sponge and do the rest of your make up like normal. It has a smooth effect without looking cakey or heavy. My face hasn't broken out or felt itchy after using this twice and that's a huge improvement over the other options.

However, the colors are probably something I need to see and choose in person next time. The Honey was much too dark for my olive tone skin and the Shell Beige was pretty close, but still a bit too light. Mixing the two actually looks pretty good, but it is more work than I have patience for.

title: Doesn't clean dirt off hands as well as real soap. Does smell nice
text: I'm not sure what this actually is since it brags about being soap free. It's not a sanitizer. The liquid smells nice and using it on hands that are essentially already clean. My issue is trying to use this as an actual cleaner with real dirt. It just doesn't work as well as real soap like Dial etc. So for just rinsing off and washing up to freshen up, this is fine, but for cleaning dirty hands - not so much.

title: Really does warm up, feels great. My face is very soft and looks great
text:
It takes a lot for a face cleanser to really impressed me - most of them have nonsense claims and aren't really any different from the next five on the shelf. This one is rapidly becoming my favorite. I work outside with horses every day and that means real dirt and grime so I take face cleaning seriously.

This is a thick, almost paste like texture in a very unappealing charcoal black color, but it goes on smoothly. I notice it warming up almost instantly every time I use it and it is really a nice sensation. I've used this with a cleansing brush and had no problems. My skin looks great and is very clean and soft - definitely softer than a week ago before I started using the Visage.

title: Handy for traveling. Works with thick hair too, smells nice
text:
This says it is for fine hair, but I used it on my very thick hair and it worked pretty well. It's not significantly any different than any other dry shampoo as far as I can tell. You lift your day old, lightly dirty, dry hair and spray this on at the roots. Then work it through with your hands and repeat until you've done all your hair. Pretty simple.

The stuff smells nice, but if you use too much, you're going to end up with a powdery look on your head and in your hair brush. It does absorb oil and whatnot allowing you to skip a day washing your hair, but it's not going to address really dirty hair or really oily hair that looks limp. My hair had a bit of body and while it certainly didn't look freshly washed and styled, it didn't look like I had failed to wash my hair either. I will keep this around for the rare desperate day or travel day requirements.

title: Oil is easy to spill due to poorly designed bottle. Soap cleans fine
text:
I'm not sure that there is anything extra special about this cleaning/brightening duo. It's a face cleaning oil followed by a bar soap. After a week of daily use my skin looks good, but it looked good before - no change. I haven't experienced any negative effects or skin irritation so that's definitely a good thing.

My first thought was that the bottle for the oil is not well thought out at all. Instead of having a pour spout to control the amount being dispensed, it's just fully opened and you end up with way too much in your hand every time. (This stuff is way too pricey to waste this way.) The oil itself does clean the daily dirt and grime off my face and rinses away clearly.

The little bar of soap smells nice and leaves my face feeling soft and clean, but it's nothing special. My regular Nutrogena cleanser does exactly the same thing. As to the "whitening" effect....is this actually a thing in this day and age? Seriously?

title: Champagne color is bland, black is just black, green is pretty. Nothing new or special here
text:
I rarely wear any eye makeup - I spend my days outside working with horses, eye shadow and liner is just ridiculous 99% of the time for me. However, there are occasions when I need to dress things up a bit and I thought a little eyeliner might be a nice change from the aggravation of actual eye shadow.

These are soft pencils that are definitely prone to melting if you carry them around in your purse, so home use only. The black is just a regular dark black - nothing special there. I wasn't impressed with the champagne color either. It literally just disappears on me - if you have a darker skin tone, this color would probably be gorgeous though. The emerald green is pretty and really highlights my hazel eyes. I got several compliments on the green.

title: Smells fresh, lathers nicely and rinses away clean
text: I work outside year round with horses every day and that means real dirt and real sweat, especially in the Texas summer. I'm not prone toward body acne as a rule, but it can happen in spots here and there once in awhile. This body wash is a nice option to have around when needed. The grapefruit scent is fresh and clean, but light and doesn't smell like a perfume. The wash itself lathers well and rinses away entirely without leaving any slick residue behind on my skin.

title: No sticky residue, softens elbows and truly scent free
text: I must say that I'm surprised by this oil in a couple of ways. I tried the hair conditioner from this company and hated it, so I was wary of this. Fortunately, this is a much better product for me. This is truly scent free - absolutely no smell at all and I love that. The texture is a little viscous and thick, so it's not just a slick, thin, drippy oil. It does takes a few minutes to fully absorb, but once it does, there's no sticky residue left behind. My hands and elbows are soft and feel nice - I don't mind using this emu oil on a regular basis at all.

title: Left my hair feeling dry and looking unconditioned. Scent made me sneeze
text:
I really really don't like this stuff. I have very long, very thick hair that is soft, shiny and healthy. I rotate between Loreal, Sauve, and Herbal Essences shampoos and conditioners. I expect new brands to at least live up to any one of these three. This Emu Oil doesn't even come close.

My first problem is that it literally takes double the amount of this conditioner to fully cover my hair compared to the Sauve or Loreal conditioners. That's going to get expensive fast. Second strike is the scent. It's overwhelming. The rosemary is just so strong that it actually made me sneeze - in the shower - sneezed! EEEWWW.

However, my main reason for the one star rating is because my hair is now dry and it feels dry and looks dry with fly away hairs. It does not look conditioned or have it's usual softness or shine. I'm actually going have to resort to using a styling mousse and that really irks me - I rarely have to bother with more than a brush and hairspray unless it's an extremely high humidity day. I won't use this on my hair again - back to the real conditioner for me.

title: Mikder scent than older tea tree stuff. Cleans well with no skin irritation or drying
text:
It has been years since I've bothered with any sort of tea tree product and all I remember was an really strong scent that I did not care for. Fortunately, the face wash has toned down the smell and it doesn't overwhelm at all.

The wash is a smooth type texture with little exfoliating scrub beads mixed in. It feels cool and clean going on and doesn't irritate my face at all. I've used it for several days and it seems to really get the grime from the horse barn off and leaves my face clean. I am not experiencing any extra dryness from this either. I'll keep using it.

title: Light, citrusy summer scent.
text:
My husband never wears cologne, just not his thing. I love it when he will consent for me and wear a light scent now and then, but finding one he can tolerate has been a battle for 22 years. This Silver Water and Birch may work out once in awhile.

It's a light, citrusy type that doesn't cling or lurk around long. It's not musky or heavy at all. I definitely think summer when I smell it on him, but it's not a feminine scent. He says it doesn't make him sneeze or make his eyes itchy and the scent itself doesn't annoy him - that's big praise from my husband.

title: Nice blush that blends well and adds subtle color. Fragrance is chemical and fake smelling
text: I have used various Loreal make-up products over the years, haven't we all? Some are great, some are basic and most are just regular every day make up that requires no real thought. This blush falls into the decent everyday use category. It's a simple, subtle color that doesn't look clownish. The texture is smooth and blends well with a mineral type foundation. I don't understand the reason for an added scent at all. This smells like any other chemical make-up scent to me and is a gimmick I don't see any reason to pay extra for.

title: Does smell like vinegar, but fades fast. Seems to work
text:
I have never heard of using vinegar as a hair rinse before, so I was definitely sceptical about it. However, after using it twice in 8 days, I'm thinking it's not a bad thing to add to the hair care regime now and then. This does smell like vinegar to me, but it's toned down and fades pretty fast.

My hair very thick and reaches the middle of my lower back so I tend to use a lot of conditioner and hairspray just to keep it under control every day. This rinse does seem to get more of the build up erased than daily shampoo/conditioner alone - my hair feels lighter. I do have to use a lot of it each time though for full coverage because I have so much hair.

title: Remake of the old school Opium. Really strong scent
text:
My immediate impression of this perfume was "knock off of Opium". The instant I smelled it for the first time, I thought of that old, 70s Yves Saint Laurent Opium perfume. This has the same underlying, very strong almost musky scent. One spray lasts all day - any more and you just reek. I only wear Chanel No 5 and now I remember why - it's classic and elegant and doesn't announce itself before I enter a room.

I will say that you get an awful lot of this for the money. Makes me think of those giant jugs at the discount warehouses. This stuff isn't terrible, but it's not great and it definitely is not original.

title: Rose scent is heavenly. Great with very thick, long hair
text: This smells heavenly and leaves both my hair and the bathroom smelling lightly of roses. The conditioner itself is pink and shimmery and very creamy in your hand. My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back and I live in a high humidity area, so I take conditioner seriously. Otherwise, I end up with a giant, fluffy, out of control riot of red hair around my head. This stuff is easy to use and covers all of my hair evenly. Drying my hair is a snap and tangle free. It looks shiny and bouncy and in control when I use this conditioner.

title: Works great for long, thick hair in high humidity
text:
Holy soft hair doing the right things! I was sceptical about this when I saw the cream in my hand. It's thin and doesn't resemble the old school mousse I was expecting. It's a liquid texture and smoothing it through my wet hair was extremely easy. Plus it smells great, a little strong at first, but it does fade.

My hair is very thick and reaches my lower back so I used a bit more than others might need. After air drying only, my hair looks great and is actually doing what I want it to do without drama. The humidity induced frizz/puffiness is visually reduced as well. There's no stickiness or oily look at all and my hair is soft and touchable. I love this cream.

title: Shaving is faster, easier and actually works. This thing...not worth the trouble
text:
First - this is not a "hair removal" tool. It's a hair growth retardant that may or may not show actual results in 12 weeks (3 months!) You still have to shave your legs and anywhere else you want to use this before each "treatment". I shave my legs daily (any stubble just grosses me out) so this gizmo just isn't helpful.

This instructions say to use once a week on very light skin and dark hair. I'm an olive skin tone and the unit gave me four lights as acceptable. I don't have a lot of dark hair, so it's not going to be as effective for me. My first test location (upper thigh) looked like a yellow bruise within seconds after using this on the feather light setting one time. Clearly, it is NOT suitable for my skin. Definitely try a sample place that can be covered up if needed. My second test location on my ankle didn't have the same reaction.

I did not notice any pain, just a quick sting. I would rather just shave my legs than fiddle with this nonsense. Zero stings, zero skin discoloration and shaving literally takes two minutes since I have a system down pat in the shower and it doesn't require weeks to see results.

title: Chemically type scent, takes a long time to absorb.
text:
I'll be honest, I don't understand why this is priced so much higher than other similar creams. It's very thin and has a seriously funky chemical scent. It's not scented like other skin creams that smell like flowers or something, just a random, almost plastic scent - at least to my nose.

I used this twice after a shower, just like my regular lotion and it took a very, very long time to absorb fully. My legs and elbows felt sticky for awhile. I think I will skip using this again and just stick to my Nivea and Sauve lotions.

title: Essentially invisible on the face. No skin irritation, but I can't see a reason to use it
text: Meh. I am surprised at how little color is in the iced pink....not sure there's actually any pink in this at all. Applying it is really easy and the make-up is very creamy so it blends smoothly.  However, once it's on, you literally can't see it or tell anything has been used. My husband said it looked like I had something shiny on my cheeks in a certain light. I just don't see myself ever using this since there's no visible effect.

title: Blends easily, looks great with under eye circles. No skin irritation
text:
Because I work with horses every day, I don't always wear makeup - seems pointless with the horse and dog hair and associated dirt. I do wear concealer fairly often though and this one is really good.

The little sponge thing is a neat way to apply it, but it can easily fill with more than you need if you twist too fast. The color is actually perfect for my skin tone. It feels creamy and smooth and blends without drama. I have not experienced any under eye skin irritation from this concealer either.

title: Strong scent, takes a while to fully absorb. Great on feet though
text:
The perfume here is really strong, it smells nice, but wow there's a lot of it. The lotion itself reminds me of old cold cream - it's very thick. For me though, it takes way too long to fully absorb. My legs and elbows felt a little sticky a half hour after applying.
I will say that using it on my feet is really nice. My heels feel soft and look smooth. I think for regular body lotion that I prefer my usual Sauve or Mountain Home Aloe, but for my feet, this is better.

title: Takes a very long time to fully absorb. No skin irritation and my face feels soft
text: This is a decent moisturizer when compared to an awesome moisturizer, but it's not great for my face. The consistency of this is more liquid and thin than I care for. It also takes a lot longer to fully absorb than my usual stuff from Tizo. My face still feels tacky to the touch a half hour after applying the Honest Beauty. However, it does smell nice and my skin definitely feels moisturized and soft. I have not experienced any skin irritation from using this for 7 consecutive days.

title: Almost invisible on the lips. Very soft texture that doesn't really stay in place
text: Chapstick is a must for me throughout the day. Sometimes I want a dash of color as well. Unfortunately, the crayon I have is essentially a nude/tan and invisible on my lips. The texture is very soft and it doesn't really stay put long. It's very easy to wind up with this stuff around the lips instead of on them. It does moisturize, but I really prefer plain Chapstick for that.

title: Wears like a moisturizer and doesn't irritate my skin. Adds a little hint of color
text:
I don't usually wear full make up because working with horses every day is a dirty, sweaty job. However, there are days when I'm meeting new students or someone for lunch and I need a bit of help. I've used this lotion for a few days now and I like it.

It's light and absorbs into the skin like a traditional moisturizer. I haven't had any skin irritation or break outs from this. It's not like a foundation, but it does add just a hint of color. I'm not sure about a glow, but it does lightly smooth your skin tone and looks nice.

title: Smell nice, but not for my sensitive skin. Soft and thick
text: I really like the other Kallea wipes in the green package, but these are not for me. The physical wipes are nice - thicker than some other brands and very soft. They do get grime and make-up off. These have an intense fragrance added. It smells nice and I can see where these could be a nice thing to have after a long flight or roadtrip for a quick freshen up. For me though, the chemicals used for the perfume isn't good for my face. My skin is sensitive and I had a little itchiness after using these one time.

title: Softens and moisturizes without skin irritation
text:
I have a face mask from this brand that does an excellent deep clean on my face, so I had big hopes for these eye strips. The actual patches that go under each eye are a little bit too big for my needs - I actually trim a little off each one before using them.

The serum itself is thick and feels very nice - cool and refreshing. My under eye area looks lightly refreshed after using these and the skin is soft. So far, I have not experienced any skin irritation or redness.

title: Nice color with a lot of sparkle
text: What a great color! It's not too brown, not too pink and it looks great on. The gloss has a ton of glitter mixed in and I normally don't care for that, but oddly, the glitter doesn't bother me here. It goes on with a silky coating and doesn't have an odor or weird taste. The color doesn't last as long as true lipstick, but it really isn't meant to - it's just a gloss. I like this for a quick bit color before I see people when I'm teaching riding lessons at the barn - I don't do full make-up on those days, but still want to look presentable.

title: No skin irritation and all my make-up comes off with just one wipe
text:
I don't wear a lot of make-up every day - typically just a bit of gloss or lipstick most days. I work with horses every day and make-up is just a mess after a morning of dust, horse hair and sweat. When I have a club meeting or lunch with friends, I will add a very light powder and blush. On those days, these wipes have been very useful.

They are a generous size, but not enormous. I am able to remove my light amount of make-up easily and completely with just one of these. They haven't dried out my skin or caused any irritation - that's a big plus because a lot if these types of products can cause my face to break out. I also like that the package fits in my hand bag.

title: Lightweight gel that feels great and cleans well
text:
Over the years, I've come to expect high quality and real results from Neutrogena products. This daily face wash lives up to my assumptions. I work with horses daily and that means my face is exposed to dust, dirt, pollen and the like every day. I also have sensitive skin prone to break outs.Cleansers are an important part of my daily regime.

This is light weight gel consistency that feels nice on your skin. It lathers a bit and really works well with one of those facial scrub brushes. My face looks and feels truly clean and my skin is soft. After two weeks of daily use, I have not experienced any skin irritation or redness and no breaking out. I think I'll definitely keep this as part of my skin care program.

title: Not great with actual grime. Doesn't irritate my skin, but doesn't clean as well as others
text:
Meh. I've used this several times and I just don't see anything special here. It does not lather and that bothers me - makes me feel like maybe it's just sitting on top of my skin. There's no scent and I haven't had any skin irritation from this stuff.

My issue is that it just doesn't clean well if you have actual, real grime on your skin. A morning out working with the horses in Texas humidity and sweat and dust leaves your face dirty. This stuff just didn't handle the job and I wound up needing to use my regular cleanser after this. It's just not for me.

title: More sunscreen than facial moisturizer
text:
I'm inclined to classify this strictly as sunscreen rather than a moisturizer with sunscreen added. It's definitely sunscreen - smells like sunscreen. The lotion is thick and feels like sunscreen rather than moisturizer.

I've used this for a few days now and I think it behaves just like regular sunscreen. It takes about twenty minutes to fully absorb and my face still feels sticky. It hasn't dried my face, but my skin doesn't feel as soft as it does with just my normal moisturizer. Treat it like sunscreen and you know what to expect.

title: Works well in 95% humidity and 78 degrees repairing horse fences
text:
I'm in deep East Texas - land of year round high humidity and temps in the mid 70s even in February. Since I work with horses every day, sweat is just a way of life. I typically use Degree and it works well enough, but there are days when I need something stronger.

This week we've been repairing fences between thunderstorms at the farm. It was 78 degrees with 95% humidity the other day - perfect day to test this Secret. It handled both wetness and odor prevention with aplomb. I can't say if it works for 48 hours because I would never go two days without a shower - just eeewww. However, for real, physical labor in hot, damp conditions this stuff actually works.

title: Made my face itch. Reasonable foot cream though
text:
I have mixed feelings about this cream. After two weeks I know that it is absolutely never going on my face again. The first two nights were fine, but the third use made my face itch and I had to wash it off. It's possible that this concoction might help someone else's wrinkles, but not mine.

I've been using it on my feet and heels instead and have not had any negative reactions. My heels are soft and don't look or feel dry or rough. This is a bit greasy and can take awhile to fully absorb - it was the same the three times I used it on my face. It's just not a great moisturizer when compared to others like Skii and Tizo.

title: Nothing special. Curls fall flat quickly, takes forever with thick hair
text:
Meh. This rod does work, but there's absolutely nothing special about it. It does come with a heat pad to set it down on and a glove to wear for wrapping the hair around the rod. The cord rotates which is helpful.

I have very thick, long hair and this rod isn't really designed for my hair. I can only do thin sections at a time - about half the hair I can do with my traditional curling iron. It took twenty minutes to get noticable curls in half my hair. I just don't have that sort of time to waste. I would much rather be out having fun than spending forty minutes doing my hair.

The curls themselves are ok, but again, nothing special. Within an hour in the East Texas humidity, they were looking more flat/frizzy than like spiral curls. For the three figure price tag, this just does not live up to expectations.

title: Works well, goes on pretty clear and no goopiness.
text: I work outside in Texas year round with horses and sunscreen is a daily must. It's non negotiable and I have just learned to accept the funky white lotion look on my nose. This is pretty much clear as they claim. I'm very happy about that actually. So far I haven't experienced any skin break outs or irritation with this sunscreen - nor have I had any sunburn. I'm using this on my face and neck when working at the farm and I scrub my face clean as soon as I get home.

title: Takes a lot for long, thick hair. Does work well - my hair is soft and bouncy
text:
As a rule, I am not a huge fan of leave in conditioner with my very thick and long hair. Most of them just leave half my hair dry and unconditioned. This one is different and I am pretty impressed.

I washed my hair like normal with Sauve shampoo and only used this leave in conditioner with nothing else. My hair is really thick and reaches the small of my back - it requires real conditioner or I end up with a dry, tangled puff surrounding me like a ridiculous hair cloud. I put this stuff on my hair right before I got out of the shower and let it sit while I got dressed. No tangles when I brushed it out still wet and after it dried, my hair was still tangle free and surprisingly soft. There's no oily or greasy film like some of the leave in conditioners cause and my hair feels light and looks nice. I did end up using almost a golf ball size amount of the conditioner to get full coverage - more than my regular conditioner actually.

title: Full grey coverage, no headache caused by chemical fumes. Burgundy color is lovely
text:
I started going grey at 30 and my natural auburn hair was looking drab by 32. I've colored my grey for over a decade until last summer. I got busy and at 46 decided to just go natural again and see how severe the grey was after the last color grew out. It's been six months and I'm horrified. So last night I tried this Henna color in the Natural Burgundy color.

It starts as a weird olive green colored powder and becomes a dark, dark brown paste with the water mixed in. It does have a mildly unpleasant scent, but nothing like the malodorous chemical scent the salon color has. I usually end up with a bad headache after getting my hair done, but this stuff didn't bother me.

Actual application is straight forward with gloves and a stiff brush you paint the color on with. I left it on for 35 minutes. I've never done my own color before, so I didn't get total, smooth coverage, but the grey roots are definitely gone. After rinsing, washing, conditioner and blow drying, my hair is soft and the color really looks nice. Very close to the shades of my natural hair color... well before my natural color became grey apparently. I'll definitely use this again and get someone to help me get full coverage through the back as well.

title: Nice splash of color without looking made up. Shine without stickiness
text:
I don't wear gloss as a rule - I wear Chapstick all day when I'm working at the barn doing horse stuff and lipstick for other social things. But sometimes I need a dash of color as well as wind protection and lip gloss fits the bill. I've never used Rimmel brand products before, but this gloss is nice.

The color isn't shocking and doesn't scream "Look at me!". It's just a brightening and makes me look a bit more put together. The shine is fine and it does feel like my lips are getting a bit of protection. Like any lip gloss, this doesn't last as long as lip stick, but it serves my purposes well. I have not noticed any bleeding over or distinct taste wearing this either.

title: Rollerball applicator is neat. Zero visible change after ten days
text:
The description on this eye gel says "instantly" and that's just nonsense. This isn't any different than most other eye gels on the market with regards to results. It's a tube with a metal roller ball contraption for application and that is actually a nice idea - no more sticking your fingers in a jar of goo.

It does roll on smoothly and feels cool immediately and there aren't any fumes wafting up to cause eye irritation. However, after ten days of daily use, there is zero visible improvement. The middle age under eye puffiness still exists and the dark circles after a bad night don't diminish after using this gel. We'll stick to our regular gel from Loreal instead.

title: Leave in conditioner works better than Gliss regular conditioner
text:
I'm not a fan of the Gliss shampoo or conditioner products for my hair. After using the Gliss conditioner in the shower, my hair was still tangled and felt like I had not used any conditioner at all. Fortunately, this leave in conditioner works.

It has a really sweet smell, but that fades pretty fast. You need to shake it well before using. It's not sticky or heavy and using it on damp hair works fine. My hair is softer and definitely easier to brush after using this, so it can salvage a potentially bad hair day.

title: Heats fast, multiple digital temperature options. Works well with thick, long hair
text:
I have very thick, long hair and I live in East Texas where the humidity is essentially a bad house guest that never leaves and makes you uncomfortable. The combination means if I don't straighten my hair, I end up looking like a frizzy pouff. The only alternative is a bun or puffy ponytail.... every single day.

I have a couple of good straighteners, including a different Revlon unit, but neither has the copper coated plates like this one does. The digital temperature setting is a nice addition and makes it easy to use just enough heat so I am not frying my hair. This one heats up quickly and the rotating cord stays out of the way as you use it - that is important if you have long hair. I like this straightener a lot. See the before and after photos. I do wish this came with a heat resistant resting pad, but it's not a deal breaker.

title: Amazing with very thick, very long hair. My hair is soft, shiny and bouncy
text:
Wow. That was my first impression after drying my hair the first time I used the coconut/jasmine conditioner. I have very thick hair that reaches the small of my back and I work outside with horses daily. This means sun exposure, dust and wind every day - dry hair is a constant battle and a great conditioner is a must for me.

The push top is very handy and the conditioner is creamy and a bit thinner than my usual Loreal conditioner. However, I don't need to use more because this is very...potent for lack of a better word. The bottle does suggest to leave it in for three minutes before rinsing, not a big deal though. My hair is amazingly soft when I use this stuff and it shines in the sun. Styling was simple, my hair isn't weighted down with this at all. I'm concerned about this being significantly more costly than my usual conditioner so I will continue to use it, but I'll alternate with the Loreal.

title: Great with very thick, really long hair. Smells nice too
text:
I love the Loreal Total Repair shampoo, so trying the conditioner was a natural move. I had been using a Gliss brand conditioner for several days prior to this and it left my hair tangled when wet and not soft at all. Two uses of this stuff and my hair is super soft and tangle free out of the shower.

The scent is very pleasant, but doesn't lurk around after your hair is dry. My hair is extremely thick and reaches to my lower back, so good conditioner is an absolute must. Two uses and I'm very happy with the look- it's not limp or life less and there's a definite shine. I also like the pump dispenser instead of the usual pour bottles - easier to use with wet hands.

title: Left tangles when wet. Dry hair looks flat and tired. Not for me at all
text:
As my last review of 2017, I'm sad it's not a great product. This conditioner smells great, but is pretty awful for my specific hair. My hair is extremely thick, healthy with zero split ends, and reaches the small of my back - very long. I stopped coloring it 7 months ago, but there's still some chemical evidence in the last 18" of length. So I still like a color conditioner now and then.

I mostly use Loreal's Extreme Damage Keratin conditioner with excellent results. The Gliss version is just nowhere close to the same quality or results. I literally had to double the amount of conditioner to fully cover every hair compared to the Loreal's. Rinsing took longer as a result and that's just a waste of water.

I'm accustomed to towel drying my hair and then immediately brushing it out with no drama. I had tangles and couldn't brush my wet hair until I sprayed a leave in conditioner on it! Seriously? Further more, when my hair dried, it looked flat and just....off. I don't have the time or patience for this.

title: Too narrow and not as sharp as the original Venus blades
text: I'm a huge fan of the Venus original razor blades. I picked these up on sale and I won't do it again. The blades are more narrow than the original and they just don't seem to be as sharp to me. I shave my legs daily and never have nicks with the original blue blades, but after two nicks with a new one of these, I'm done. I'll stick to the original.

title: Heats fast, adjustable temps are very handy. Does a good job on long, thick hair
text:
I have very thick and long hair that tends to frizz within minutes of walking outside in our East Texas humidity. I have two choices - wear a ponytail or bun if I'm working at the horse barn and use a straightener if I am seeing people. I have a couple of tools in my humidity war arsenal - a very wide straightener, a curling iron and a short straightener and so far the best one has been the wide plate straightener.

This straightener is longer and the plates are slightly more narrow than my favorite one. This has several adjustable temperatures and they actually do adjust up and down. It heats up quickly and is ready to use without extra steps or time. I like the adjustable heat level - I use a lower setting on my bangs and hair near my face first. Then I increase to the higher temps for the thickest part of my hair in the back. Nothing burns or gets fried and my hair is straight all the way through. It also stays straight through an entire day without puffing up before dinner time. This is a good flat iron.

title: Actually does what they claim - smoother skin & smaller pores
text:
I tried a mask from this company and just wasn't impressed. However, this peel absolutely redeemed the brand in my eyes. I've seen real results from the peel in just one use. Additionally, there is a significant amount of product so you can do multiple treatments before needing to buy more. That's good because at first glance the cost here is beyond my reach for a single treatment.

Opening the big jar for step one releases a distinct citrus scent and it even has an orange tint. Neither of the two concoctions smells like chemicals. Step one is a thick paste like ointment with a slight gritty texture. You smear it over your face - avoid the eyes and lips - and let it set up for three full minutes. It feels cool on and there are no nasty fumes to irritate my eyes from step one.

Step two is a thick liquid serum that you massage in on top of the orange paste. You let it sit for one minute after it's completely integrated with the orange stuff. While it mixes, there's a definite heat sensation, but it's not uncomfortable at all. Again, I have not noticed any unpleasant fumes with it. Rinsing all of it off reveals an immediate smoother complexion and smaller pores. I was very surprised by the highly visible results - I take care of my skin and it looks good, but this peel just took things up a notch. Worth every penny.

title: No skin irritation and it has no scent
text:
I don't ask a lot of bath soap - get me clean, don't irritate my skin and it shouldn't smell like cheap perfume. This one meets the basic requirements. It lathers ok, not a super thick lather, but not bad either. It has no real discernable scent even when wet.

I've used it as a regular body soap in the shower and I do feel clean afterwards. I haven't had any skin irritation from this soap or breakouts. It works, but I don't love it. I think it left my face a little drier than my old soap, but it's not a significant difference. My husband likes this more than I do actually.

title: Actually lives up to the claims. Hair is soft with a gloss
text:
I have zero patience for conditioner that doesn't do what it says. My hair is very thick and reaches the small of my back. Plus, we live in a high humidity climate which means I am always battling frizz and extra puffiness. My hair is healthy, but I do end up using a straightener a few days a week and that can cause damage.

This conditioner smells nice, but not super perfum-y. It's a bit thicker than other brands and after a couple of shampoos, I realized that I can actually use less of this and still have great results.

My hair feels very soft and looks great. Yesterday, after using the straightener, my hair didn't have a dry feel or look stiff. I am impressed with this stuff after multiple uses.

title: Skin is soft after use, but nothing outstanding is going on. Works as well as other masks
text:
This is one of those products that doesn't do anything negative, but also fails to live up to it's hype. It's supposed to brighten and clarify the skin. My initial reaction was that my face looks no different than with any number of other facial masks. For a product in this pricing point, I really expected a lot more.

This is a dry powder and a lotion that you mix together. The powder reminds me of powdered sugar in consistency actually. I just used a disposable bowl and spoon since the included spatula arrived cracked. It mixes pretty well and gets thick and pasty very quickly. While it's on, it does feel cool and soft - even as it dries. It took about 22 minutes for the mask to fully dry both times I've used it. It just pulls off with a tiny bit of residue left behind that is easily removed with a damp wash cloth. I just don't see enough of a difference compared to the other brands I've used to justify buying this in the future.

title: Splashes water everywhere and a part broke on day one
text:
I think using the word "massage" is a steep exaggeration of what this tub of water does. You fill it with already hot water and hope you get to relax fully before the water goes cold - that takes about 14 minutes, by the way. There's no heater in this thing.

There are nubby plastic things in the bottom that you manually roll your feet on to create the "massage". Meanwhile, the unit creates bubbles that do.... well.... nothing except splash water out. Lots of water. It bubbles and splashes out on the floor and against the chair you're sitting in. Fortunately, I had placed a thick towel under the spa tub before turning it on - that towel was soaked when I was done.

While I was using this, one of the blue foot rollers popped out and now will not go back in place. My final opinion is that you would achieve the same result just soaking your feet in a wide bucket filled with hot water. This thing is garbage.

title: Smells great, no greasy or sticky residue left behind
text:
This cream smells so nice - very fruity and fresh without any chemical undertone. It's very thick and reminds me of the old cold cream stuff my Grandmother used. The tub says this can be used both as a night cream or regular day moisturizer.

I am very particular about the face products I use at night. So many are sticky or goopy that I can't bear to have them on my face or my pillow. This one is very thick, but it absorbs faster than other brands. It feels cool on and does not leave a greasy residue behind. I've been using this in the mornings before going out to work with my horses and I definitely prefer it as a day cream. Plus that pleasant scent is a nice way to get the day started.

title: Two step application needs a brush. Provoked color is actually a more nude shade
text:
I have worn Estee Lauder Sugared Maple lipstick for twenty years and I love the color. Sometimes a change is called for, if for no other reason than to be sure your old stand by is still the best choice. I got the Provoked color of this Python lip stick.

It's definitely more subdued and brown than the pictures. The base color is almost a nude once it's on my lips. Adding the metallic second shade adds some sparkle, but doesn't brighten up the base color. You have to apply this with fingers or a separate lip brush and I find both a little difficult - I just prefer a traditional lipstick. The color does last awhile and feels more dry/flat than regular lipstick, but it's not really dry per see. This just isn't the color for my lips.

title: Left my face feeling sticky and unclean. Takes a long time to absorb completely
text:
I'm strict about using moisturizer and sunscreen daily and have been for twenty years. At 47, I'm fortunate to have no crows feet or lines of any kind except laugh lines despite a life spent in high heat and sun working with horses. However, I have noticed that my skin has started to feel dry faster than in years past.

I was hoping this cream might be a good idea for overnight use in addition to my morning cream. Unfortunately, I really don't like this stuff. It has no real scent and it didn't cause any breakouts or irritation. But it takes forever to fully absorb and just feels sticky on my face. I used it before bedtime and an hour later I still felt like I had goop on my skin. When I use the Tizo PM Restore gel it absorbs immediately and my skin feels soft and clean. I think I will pass on the CeraVe cream.

title: I still need regular lotion after using this. Just doesn't work for me as well as regular lotion
text:
Lotion you put on while still in the shower sounds like a good idea. And yet.... I don't like this stuff. It smells nice and feels good when you apply it. There's some of those tiny microscopic exfoliating beads in the lotion - I thought that was no longer being done actually. My problem is two fold.

First you must fully rinse the shower floor immediately or this leaves a greasy, slippery spot. That's not a deal breaker, just an extra step. The end result using this for a week is that my skin feels dry again. I actually needed to use the regular Nivea lotion last night after my shower. My elbows and hands feel like I haven't used any moisturizer in several days. This just doesn't work well for me.

title: Handy for after surgery care or extended travel with limited hygiene options
text:
I first used this wash lotion when I was the caregiver for my grandmother after she broke her hip. This stuff allowed me to bathe her safely and with little anxiety for her. Fast forward a few years and my husband had three major abdominal surgeries in six months and was in various stages of recovery for almost a year.

A tremendous amount of that recovery time required avoidance of regular showers. We depended on this in the hospital and at home. Since then, he carries this with him when traveling overseas on those 28 hour, multi plane and multi country transits. He can quickly freshen up in the restroom and keep moving. He has also used it while moving through Afghanistan and other locals with sketchy water availability. There's no weird residue or greasy coating with the lotion and it does get you clean. He's never had any skin irritation or negative reaction to using it.

title: Leaves a residue behind that I don't care for
text:
We've used this lotion for several days and compared it to our regular two brands - Nivea for me and Vaseline for my husband. I have never heard of this brand before. There's zero scent in this lotion which is good, but I actually prefer the light scent of our regular stuff. Neither of us has experienced any skin irritation with this.

The lotion is thinner than the other two and feels more like a cream. It does help soften dry skin, but it leaves a weird residue behind. I can't describe it exactly.... it's not sticky, it feels a little bit like a coating left on my hands. I really dislike that feeling and I won't continue to use this at all.

title: Matter of Fiction is more white on than in the bottle. Dries very fast
text:
I tried a different type of the Essie polish a few months ago and it was terrible for me for several reasons. This gel version is considerably better, but I think I still prefer the OPI brand polish for simplicity and longevity.

The brush in this is thicker and wider than the other Essie polish and as a result the polish is definitely easier to apply. It goes on in fewer strokes which means smoother, more even coats. I don't have the time or interest in messing with top coat sealers - I want a simple polish that I can apply quickly in the evening and will look nice for the next several days. That's where the OPI outshines the Essie - OPI looks shinier with just two quick coats and nothing else.

This gel does dry super fast by the way. The Matter of Fiction color looks like a pale pink in the bottle, but dries more on the white side of pink. It's not an unattractive color, but definitely too whitish for my olive skin tone - it looks like a bad French tip job on me. I would be willing to try this gel again in a darker color though.

title: His hair feels soft, looks good and I love the Swagger scent
text: We have the Swagger scent and man does it smell great. My husband shrugged and said whatever, but I love it. The whole bathroom smells good after he uses this stuff. He said it lathers well and it doesn't take a lot to get his hair and beard clean. The texture is a thick cream that has no weird residue left on his hands. I think his hair looks good and it feels soft, so the conditioner part of this two in one seems to be working. This is a big bottle, so he's going to be using it for a long time.

title: Feels oily on and has no taste, but smells nice
text: I use Chapstick almost daily and I love the Candy Cane version, so trying this pumpkin pie seemed perfectly natural. I snagged a tube for under a dollar at a local store yesterday and I think I'll stick to the candy cane from now on. The pumpkin smells great, but it has zero taste and definitely goes on with a faint oily feeling. It just doesn't feel like regular Chapstick to me

title: Better on fine hair or light growth. Star Wars decoration is minimal
text:
So I can't resist a Sci-fi theme item, my husband on the other hand, looked me like I had finally fallen off the edge when I handed him this Star Wars themed razor. After twenty years, the man has learned to just accept my geeky side and go with the flow - well, he draws the line at costumes for Comic Con.

The razor is quiet and runs correctly. My husband has a full beard and mustache, so he used the beard trimmer attachment to trim and neaten the edges and the foils just on the neck area immediately underneath his beard. He felt like the foils are really better for someone who shaves daily and has a thinner or finer hair growth than he does. He normally uses a beard specific type of trimmer and while this one did the job, it just wasn't as good. Again, the issue seems to be the thickness of the hair being trimmed. This works, but it's not a heavy duty razor.

title: Better scent than the argan oil version. Good for dry hands
text:
I've used this lotion for a couple of days and I really like the lotion, but the cherry scent is diluted. It doesn't smell bad and it's not overwhelming, but it just isn't very cherry to me.

The lotion itself absorbs quickly and isn't greasy or oily feeling. I'm especially pleased with this stuff on my dry elbows and heels. My skin is soft and smooth again and all the dry areas have stopped showing the early signs of cracked skin. This has also worked well for my fingers which are always dry after hours in gloves at the horse barn.

title: Definitely has a glossy shine and lasts awhile. Strawberry is very pink
text:
I'm a fan of the Loreal lipsticks for many reasons. This one is true to the usual good quality that I've become accustomed to. The holder is solid and the lid stays put when it's tossed in my purse and I'm on the go.

Putting this on is a very smooth application. There's almost a gloss texture in this that adds a noticable shine and sort of wet look. The color I have is "Strawberry" and it's very bright, very pink in the tube. However, once it's on the lips, it tones down and is a less clownish version of pink. One coat survived drinking from a straw and talking for about two hours before reapplication was needed. I like the product, but the Strawberry color is a little too pink for my skin tone.

title: Ok for bangs, but does nothing on very thick, really long hair
text:
I have very thick hair that reaches past the middle of my back, it's healthy, but prone to frizz in our high humidity. I don't want to do a full straightening on my hair every day, so I was hoping to use this as a quick fix on busy mornings.

The silicone bristles don't get hot, just the metal barrel under the brush part. That's good and bad - it's unlikely to scorch your hair, but it won't actually heat thick hair like mine effectively. I can get a flip of the ends and it works well with bangs, but nothing else is really happening for me. It doesn't smooth out frizz or curl my hair well. I do think that if you have thinner and shorter hair this would probably work fine. I'm returning to my high end straightener and the occasional use of a traditional curling iron.

title: Thin and somewhat flimsy materials. More of a single use kit than permanent use kit
text: I'm not crazy about this kit as a whole. It's really basic and a bit flimsy, but it does work for simple maintenance. The emory board works ok and does smooth uneven nail edges. The little buff brush works as well, but it's thin plastic and can bend. The little toe separation foam thing is pretty much a one use item - one piece bent as soon as I used it. The foot/heel file thing does work on mild dry areas, but again it's thin and heavy use probably is not a great idea. I consider this to be similar quality to a travel kit like your hotel provides free of charge - not a daily use kit.

title: Smells lovely, lathers fine. Not great for grime after a day outside though
text:
This shower gel smells as pretty as you would expect. A soft, definitive rose scent that stays on your skin a long time after the shower. The entire bathroom smells like rose garden after using this.
