It's a little thinner consistency than some other similar products we use. It lathers pretty well with one of the pouff things and rinses off without a residue. However, if you're actually dirty...like a layer of grime from working outside, this gel isn't quite up to the job. I had to resort to real Ivory soap last night to feel completely clean. So it's fine for just daily bathing as opposed to heavy duty cleaning.

title: Strong scent, lathers, cleans and rinses away cleanly without a residue
text:
I have the full size, large heart shaped bar in the rose scent. I was assuming it would be one of those tiny "look at me, don't use me" decorative soaps, so I'm quite pleased to get a full, shower size bar.

The scent is so strong that I could smell it before I even opened the package. It's a true pink color and lathers as it should. It also rinsed away clean without leaving behind a residue. The smell seems stronger to me in hot water, but it fades pretty quickly. I like this, but my husband says the scent is too much for his tastes - he's a straight up Ivory man. I have not had any skin irritation or breaking out with either of the Provence soaps I've used so far.

title: Sweet scent, lathers & cleans fine. Too rich for my budget
text:
I have the tiare scent of this bar soap. It's not a scent that I can easily break down. It makes me think of brown sugar, lavender and coco butter. The scent is way too sweet for me, but it doesn't linger long.

The soap itself is smooth and lathers pretty well. It is very soft, feels nice on the skin and does actually clean you off. I found that I needed to rinse a little more than usual to get the last residue of it off though. (We don't have soft water) I like this, but I am not convinced it's any better than a regular soap for a lot less money.

title: Takes a bit to fully absorb, but helps cracked fingers
text:
I wear gloves daily working in our horse barn and my hands can get dry, cracked and rough if I don't pay attention. Most lotions are fine for my legs, elbows, and feet, but don't do much for my hands.

This has very mild scent and is thick without being gloppy. It coats my hands completely and seeps into the cracks and really dry places. This does take a bit to absorb fully, but it does work. My fingers are healing.

title: Buttons badly placed. Left long, thick hair still wavy from frizz
text:
This isn't a great straightener and if you have thick or long hair, it is not a good straightener. I have a straightener from LumaBella that is amazing and that's what I compared this one to.

This one is noticeably shorter with smaller plates and lower heat. The first issue is that the controls on the Revlon unit are placed badly. The on/off and temperature buttons are exactly where your hand holds the unit - meaning that I lowered the temp twice in the first few minutes doing my hair.

The main problem is that it just doesn't straighten quickly or thoroughly or well. I have thick, long hair that gets frizzy in our high humidity region. Usually, I can straighten in 10 minutes flat and my hair is smooth, straight and looks sleek and put together. However, this straightener can't handle the size sections of hair that I usually do. That adds time to an already tight morning schedule.

My hair was a bit straighter, but it still had a frizz induced wave. If your hair is thinner than mine and shorter this thing might work fine. But I won't use it again.

title: Better suited for short, fine hair than my very thick, very long hair
text:
It's turns out that I'm not a fan of the curling wand instead of a traditional curling iron. This is the first one I've used and I did watch a couple of how to videos before working on my hair. I have very thick hair that reaches the middle of my back and this tool seems better suited to thinner and shorter hair.

This is very awkward to actually use hot compared to a regular curling iron. It does less hair in each stroke, is very difficult to get long hair completely wrapped around, and it's just hard to get hair in the back curled without burning my hand. Yes, there is a glove included, but mine keeps slipping and doesn't really fit. A traditional curling iron has the hinged clip that holds hair to the rod so it doesn't slide off and your fingers are not near the heated metal. This wand thing just isn't a good match for me.

title: Cocoa butter scent is overwhelming, takes a long time to fade
text:
I really love the Aloe version of this lotion so this one should have been as pleasant. The lotion itself dispenses cleanly from an easy to push button. It has a very smooth, creamy texture that absorbs quickly.

My issue is the ridiculously strong scent. It just overwhelms everything else and takes forever to begin to dissipate. I felt like I was in a weird cocoa butter fog for hours. This one and the Aloe scent are worlds apart.

title: Ten days and my skin looks amazing. No toxic scent, absorbs very quickly
text:
I've tried a lot of the facial creams and lotions over the last few years. I'm 46 and have zero crow's feet or wrinkling on my face or neck despite a lifetime of working with horses outside. I use sunscreen & moisturizer religiously and wear sunglasses every second if I'm outside. I don't have time to waste with skin products that do not work.

Tizo flat out works and I have two more bottles in my shopping cart right now. This is the best face cream I've ever used. It comes out in a tiny dot from the dispenser and that is all you need to get full face coverage, one more dot for the neck.

It feels a bit like petroleum jelly initially, but smooths out and absorbs almost instantly. My under eye area is smooth, far less puffy and there's no toxic fumes to irritate my eyes after putting this on. My face is very soft and smooth after ten days of use. A friend asked me this morning what I'm doing because my skin has a bit of a glow and looks "refreshed". That makes me very happy since I wasn't wearing makeup - just applied the Tizo 3 hours earlier. I love this stuff.

title: Gentle with faces and rinses cleanly. No scent added
text:
This is definitely suitable for sensitive skin or using in the shower for any area with a wound etc. I have a minor cut on my ankle and regular soap stings a bit, but this cleanser doesn't sting and it does clean.

It's a bit thin and doesn't really lather much, but my skin is clean and it rinses away entirely with no residue left behind. There's no scent that I am noticing when I use this. It is gentle and works fine for daily face washing.

title: Soft, moisturized heels, elbows and hands. Has a fresh, pleasant scent
text:
This has to be my favorite of the different Mountain Falls products. The Aloe scent is mild, but very refreshing. The lotion is soft, creamy and not too thick so it comes out of the pump smoothly every time.

Using this on my legs after shaving is really pleasant. There's no irritation and my legs are very soft, smooth and look great. I'm also using this lotion on my feet and elbows - working with horses, outside every day can definitely lead to dry skin. My skin is in great shape after a week of using this daily and my heels are soft again. I'll definitely choose this lotion over the brand name version in the future.

title: Looks nice when used instead of foundation. Zero skin irritation and washes off clean
text:
Wow. Who knew a "bronzing powder" could be so useful and look so good? I don't wear a lot of makeup daily and when I do, I try to keep things as simple as possible. I am not a fan of heavy foundation ever, but I haven't quite figured out a way around using it. Until this stuff.

I was doubtful that this powder would do anything my regular stuff can't do, but I absolutely love this. It applies nicely with a brush - no cakey spots or excess product in places. I have used it in lieu of foundation and as a light finish after regular foundation and blush. My preference is putting this on first, then blush and a feather light dusting of this again. Simplicity that looks great, stays on, gives a soft glow, and is easy to clean off. This powder really accents my natural light olive skin tone without screaming "look at my makeup!" Additionally, this hasn't irritated my skin like another famous mineral makeup does. I'll definitely buy this in the future.

title: Need to use a lot more for similar results to my current brand.
text:
I used to use Tresseme shampoo and conditioner regularly and switched to Suave Moroccan oil shampoo and conditioner. The Mountain Falls conditioner is almost identical to the Tresseme in scent and performance.

This is a little thinner than the original, not watered down, but not as thick. It has the same issues as the original that caused me to switch to Suave. My hair is very thick and reaches the middle of my back - good conditioner is a must or my hair becomes a huge, frizzy puff. The problem is this conditioner just doesn't do the job completely. My hair feels like it's still dry and isn't as soft or manageable as it should be. I could double the amount I use for better results, but that defeats the purpose of buying a reduced cost generic in the first place - especially when I get great results with a different brand using less.

title: Really great for feet and elbows. Too heavy for my face
text:
This is a generic version of the old school Ponds cream. I've never used Ponds, so I can't compare the two. I remember my Grandmother using it on her elbows and feet, but warning me it was too heavy for the face. I kept that in mind for the Mountain Falls cream.

This is thick and I definitely believe my Grandmother, much too heavy for my face. It is excellent as as foot and elbow cream and feels great after shaving my legs. It takes a bit of time to fully absorb and can leave a hint of stickiness behind if you use too much. My feet are super soft and smooth with none of the usual summer dry skin.

title: Does moisturize, but takes forever to fully absorb. Thick texture
text:
This lotion is comparable to Cetaphil - even the bottle sports the same colors. I've used several of the Mountain Falls products recently and liked most of them quite a bit. However, this one isn't my favorite.

The lotion is thick and viscous as it dispenses which makes it easy to get too much with each push of the pump. I used this on my legs after shaving, in place of my usual Suave lotion. This definitely moisturized the skin, but took almost 8 full minutes to fully absorb. I don't have the patience for feeling sticky that long. Additionally, the next morning, my legs felt soft, but not as soft as with my regular lotion.

title: Absorbs promptly, zero skin irritation and mild scent
text: I use the Neutrogena moisturizer often, so I was able to compare this generic version directly over a few days. I can't tell any significant difference between the two. This version is very creamy and smells identical to the original. It doesn't take a lot to get full coverage either. It absorbs very quickly and I have not had any skin irritation or eye irritation - sometimes the fumes from skin products causes my eyes to sting. I would definitely consider buying this instead of the name brand in the future.

title: Smells nice, no skin irritation. Does require an extra rinse to prevent any residue
text: This is pretty close to the brand name version. It has a soft scent that doesn't overwhelm your entire bathroom as you shower. The soap is creamy and lathers fast with a pouf. It works for cleaning the day's grunge off and I haven't experienced any skin irritation from using this. My one issue is that I think it takes more effort to rinse it entirely off then the Dove version - sort of feels like a bit of residue is left behind if you don't run your hands over your skin one extra time before you turn the shower off. That's not a deal breaker though.

title: Works the same as the name brand, no skin irritation
text:
The label says this compares to the Clean and Clear original cleanser, so I used both over several days - one in the morning and one in the evening, alternating. Both smell good, with a citrus base, but the Mountain Falls version is a softer scent.

As for cleansing, this works as well as the Clean and Clear. This version seems to have fewer of little scrubbing beads, but it works fine. It rinses away completely with no residue left behind. I haven't had any sensitivity or skin irritation using this.

title: Really meant for short hair. Color is fine, not brassy, but not gorgeous
text:
My hair is a reddish auburn color naturally and I have some blonde natural highlights - especially in the summer. I wanted to see if I could lighten/highlight a few areas deliberately instead of hoping the sun lightens my hair where I want it. I've never actually done any color work myself before - I 've always had a great hairdresser, so this was a challenge.

My hair is extremely healthy and very thick and long - reaching to my bra strap mid-back. The box should clearly state that it's adequate for only short or thin hair. I really needed two boxes to do exactly what I wanted. Nonetheless, I carried on. If I ever do this again, I'm getting help because with long hair, it's very difficult to get strands through the tiny holes on the back of the net thing. I missed a lot of hair. Sigh. The color itself is ok, not brassy or too bright, but not obvious either at first glance. I do like the shampoo and conditioner that came with this and my hair feels soft and bouncy.

title: Simply will not power on under any circumstances. Avoid
text:
This is just garbage. The box states that two hair clips are included, but there weren't any in my box. Alas, that is least of the issues with this comb.

It simply will not come on. I've tried multiple outlets and nothing. The directions say to hold the power button for 3 seconds to turn it on. Nope. Five seconds? Nope. Holding it constantly? Nope. It just doesn't work.

title: Feels cool going on and absorbs pretty quickly
text:
I'm out in the sun daily, 365 days a year and keeping my skin in good shape is a priority. I really like the Olay eye cream with sunscreen during the day, but have been looking for the right eye cream for night.

This is definitely a gel and it's thick - if you're not careful, you can end up with a very heavy application. The gel goes on cool and feels nice after a hot shower. I haven't had any irritation and there aren't any obnoxious fumes as it's absorbed. After a week, my under eye circles seem a bit diminished. Thanks to 20 years of sunscreen, I don't have crows feet or lines around my eyes, so I'm not sure what effect this gel might have in that circumstance. I will keep using this gel as part of my prevention routine.

title: Cool texture that lathers and smells nice. Rinses clean and does moisturize skin
text:
I am hooked! This is a genius idea. Shake the can and soap comes out as a mousse. It's smooth, soft and actually forms a lather as you use it. I like the foaming soaps, but this is really nice. There's no damp soap bar leaving residue on the shower caddy now.

It doesn't take a lot to get clean and the scent is pretty mild. I didn't do my usual after shower body lotion because I wanted to see if this Nivea would moisturize as well as clean. This morning my legs and arms felt soft - not as soft as when I do a lotion after showering, but not dry by any means. I'll definitely use this again.

title: Does keep your underarms dry and odor free. Takes a couple minutes to dry after applying though
text:
We've never used Mitchum antiperspirant before, so I was interested to see how it performs compared to our regular brands. This says it's for me, but it has no scent, so I used too. My test was pretty simple - three hours feeding horses, shoveling stalls, stacking hay and playing with a dog. The temperature was 89 degrees with a humidity induced heat index of 100 degrees. Sweat is inescapable.

The Mitchum is a wet gel formula and it feels like a wet gel when putting it on. It took a couple of minutes for it to dry and to not notice it was there. It does work. While my face and back literally had sweat dripping, my underarms were pretty dry and totally odor free when I finished my barn chores. I don't mind this stuff, it does work equally as well as my usual Suave and it doesn't add a perfume so you could use it for every day.

title: Takes forever to dry. Needs a wider brush
text:
I sort of like this color. It definitely looks like a pale pink outside, in natural light. However, inside it looks almost white - enough so that I had to laugh at my clown fingers. On the toes it's actually much nicer and seems more subtle than on finger nails.

However, there are two problems. First the brush is too thin and too narrow. It takes two coats to hide the brush marks. I thought maybe I was using too little polish the first coat, but still had brush lines with extra thick polish applied. To get a smooth, even look takes effort and lots of time. The second problem is each coat takes a very long time to dry fully - two coats took exactly 16 minutes to dry enough to do my other hand. I don't know about others, but I just don't have the patience for multiple coats and waiting around, doing nothing while polish dries.

title: Absorbs very fast, light on the skin without a oily residue
text:
I spend a lot of time outside in the sun with horses and I swim laps daily. Sunscreen and moisturizer are my morning staples. I've tried a lot of the combination products and some are useless and others are definitely worth buying. This Olay version is on my buy list.

It takes very little to get complete, even coverage. The lotion is very silky to the touch and absorbs almost instantly. It doesn't leave any sort of oily residue behind either. I like that it does sort of lighten up the appearance of dark under eye circles - just a subtle improvement. So far, I have not seen any sort of sunburn starting on my nose or cheeks and it's been nothing but direct, hot sun for a week.

title: Subtle changes after a week of use. Looks nice
text:
I have auburn hair with grey highlights - gotta love your 40s. I wasn't expecting miracles from the Sun Bum spray, just a bit of a boost. It's taken 7 treatments over ten days to notice any difference. I didn't want to use it every day.

The change has been very subtle, but not streaky or strange looking. There are highlighted areas that are definitely lighter & brighter than before I started using the spray. It isn't really meant to cover grey, but it has added depth to the hair color with the grey interspersed. One thing that I do like is the scent - no chemical undertone or toxic fumes and my hair feels soft after using this.

title: Does remove residue, but left my hair feeling a bit dry.
text:
I'm a long time fan of the Neutrogena facial products so trying their new shampoo was a must. This is completely clear in the bottle and feels a bit like a gel in your hand. I don't care for the scent of this shampoo at all. It reminds me of an old school barber shop.

My hair is very thick and reaches the middle of my back - it requires a decent lather to really get clean. Unfortunately, while this leathers, it's not as full or rich as my regular shampoo. That being said, the Neutrogena really got my hair clean. It definitely sweeps out any built up residue from other products and left my hair feeling light, but extremely pouffy. For my hair, I will probably just use this twice a month - my hair felt a little dry after using it..

title: Caused my face to itch after two hours.
text:
This is very creamy and goes on smoothly with very little effort. They included a little spatula to make it easy to apply as a spot concealer. As actual foundation, this particular color is too dark for me, but the product feels nice on. I wore it as foundation around the house just to see how it would fare through a full day.

The make up didn't get cakey or look heavy. It does act as sunscreen which is a nice bonus. However, my face started to feel itchy after a couple of hours and I had to wash it off. I have sensitive skin, so this reaction is not unheard of for me, but I don't think I can use this in any color as my face foundation.

title: The Fair is a bit lighter than the Light. Works well for dark circles
text:
There's a difference between the Fair and Light tints on this concealer, but it's miniscule. Honestly, I think the two are misnamed. The Light tube is actually a bit darker to my eye than the Fair. See the photo.

The Fair turned out to be the right shade for me and after several days of use, I like it. I haven't had any skin irritation when using it to cover under eye circles. It doesn't cake up, but I use a very tiny amount so your mileage may vary.

title: Covers bruises well - I can wear a skirt again without pantyhose
text:
This is really good for hiding bruises or other marks. Riding and working with horses daily leaves me random bruises all the time - especially on my legs. This is a problem if I need/want to wear a skirt or dress. I have to decide between pantyhose or attempting to cover the bruise or just wearing pants.

This camo medium coverage actually did a good job covering a fresh bruise on my thigh. I bumped into a rock trying to clear a trail by the creek this morning. The resulting scratch and dark area is seriously ugly. One thin layer covered and hid 90% of the discoloration. Unfortunately, the copper color is a tad too dark for my skin tone, but I am perfectly willing to find the correct shade for future use.

title: Heats quickly, well balanced with extra length and doesn't burn my hair
text:
Try as I might, I can't find a reason not to like this curling iron. I was assuming that the extra length would make it unbalanced and top heavy, but it doesn't. It feels stable in the hand and has a little brace to stand up on so it's not resting directly on the counter.

It heats up fast and has a traditional on/off switch rather than just getting hot as soon as you plug it in. The adjustable temperature is nice - I had stopped using these tools because my hair always seemed to fry a bit. This gave me curls without burning my hair because I am able to lower the temperature. It works fine and is easy to use, I have no complaints.

title: Works to disguise bruising on legs. No skin irritation
text:
I constantly have bruises on my legs - the price of riding and working with horses every day. In the summer it's always an issue if I need to wear a dress for a club meeting or other social event. My choices are usually wear pantyhose or show those dark, ugly marks to the world. Neither is a great choice.

This stuff is actually pretty good at covering the bruises on my lower legs. It goes on smooth and doesn't clump or rub off on my clothes. One layer is enough to hide a light mark, but it takes two blended coats to completely cover a dark or large bruise. Two coats can mark a skirt if you get dressed before the foundation has really set. I do think this works, but if I use it all summer and fall it will cost a small fortune - this isn't inexpensive. The photos are before and after one coat.

title: Gimmicky exfoliating powder. Sticky night cream. The whipped day cream is very nice
text:
There are some really nice products in this set. My skin is really sensitive and prone to breaking out with a lot of products, so I tend to use new things with caution. So far, I have had just a small reaction to the NxN creams.

My favorite item in this set is the whipped day cream. It's light and absorbs very fast. My face feels and looks soft all day when I use it and so far, no skin irritation. The night face mask stuff isn't quite as good. It takes awhile to fully absorb and if you use it before bedtime you can end up with it rubbing off onto the pillow.

The two cleansers are questionable. The gel to milk stuff does perform a cute trick by coming out as a gel and turning to a milky texture. However, if you use it with wet (instead of just damp) hands, it tends to run off before it actually cleans your face. It's really thin. The powder to liquid exfoliating stuff is a cute parlor trick, but messy and not really effective. Every time I try to use this, the powder spills and then when it's wet, you are supposed to rub your hands together then apply to the face. It's just messy and overly complicated for minimal results. My skin has broken out twice in four uses of the exfoliating powder. I'm going back to the Cetaphil.

title: Rosemary scent is nice, but fades quickly. Left my hair soft and tangle free
text:
If I hadn't already tried the Grapefruit version of this conditioner, I would love this rosemary version instead of just liking it. This is pretty good stuff, but the grapefruit scent is better.

The texture is a bit thicker than most conditioner and it massages in easily. That rosemary scent is pretty strong, but it fades fast. My hair is very thick and reaches the middle of my back - when wet, it can become a tangled mess. Both of the Herbal Essences bio renew conditioners keep my hair soft and tangle free, but I think the grapefruit smells fresher .

title: Completely absorbs fast. No skin irritation and my skin is softer
text:
As a rule, I don't typically like a full moisturizer treatment before bed. It can be sticky and I don't like having to check to see if my face cream has absorbed before I lie on my pillow. Cetaphil may have changed my mind.

It's a very rich, smooth cream that feels great on your fingers. It feels even better on the face, very cool and soft. It absorbs very quickly with no sticky residue or odor left behind. It's just gone.

I've used this for a few days now and I am really pleased. I have had absolutely no skin irritation or breaking out. My face and throat feel softer and none of the cream remains in the morning. My skin looks good and that's all I ask for.

title: Works nicely at lightening the appearance of under eye circles
text:
I rarely wear full makeup - my days are usually spent outside working with horses, foundation is a wasted effort. I do use moisturizer and sunscreen, so I wasn't expecting much from this primer during my typical routine. However, I have noticed an improvement.

The cream is soft and light and has a very faint, subtle tint of some sort. I'm using this as an under eye cream since I have dark circles. It just seems to float there rather than settling into any lines or creases. I've definitely noticed that those circles seem lighter and less noticeable when I use this. There's no greasy residue left behind and so far I haven't experienced any skin irritation - 10 days so far.

title: Best smelling conditioner ever. My hair is soft, healthy and looks great
text:
I'm completely obsessed with the scent of this conditioner. It just smells like a fresh cut grapefruit with a splash of mint - fresh and cheerful. I love how my hair smells after using this and I noticed yesterday that if you get your hair wet, the smell reactivates. I got out of the pool and my hair smelled like grapefruit instead of chlorine.

As far as conditioning results, this is pretty good. I've used it and the matching shampoo for a week straight on my very thick, mid-back length hair. It is soft, shiny and lush looking and feels like silk. I'm definitely keeping this in my regular rotation.

title: Very lightweight, no retractable cord. Does dry thick hair effectively
text:
At first use, I like this dryer fairly well. I have extremely thick hair that reaches the middle of my back, so a low power dryer just won't get the job done. This dryer did get my hair completely dry and while it's a little slower than my regular Conair, it is a reasonable back up.

This one is considerably lighter than my usual dryer and there is a definite difference between the hot and warm settings. The cool shot does work. Since there's no retractable cord, you have to roll the cord up or have it dangling loose when you put this away. I'm vaguely concerned about that cord business because of the previous history folks have with this dryer smoking or shorting out. That's the reason for my two star deduction.

title: Smells so good. Good with thick, long hair - mine is soft and shiny
text:
It's been a very long time since I have come across a conditioner that I like as much as my usual Suave Moroccan oil. This Cucumber and Green Tea is an amazing scent that just makes me happy.

I have very thick, long hair that reaches the middle of my back and can be difficult to condition fully. This conditioner is thick and creamy and is easy to massage fully through my hair. After three days of consecutive use, my hair is very soft, shiny and looks great. I'll definitely keep this in my rotation with my usual hair care products.

title: Purple/brown undertones left me looking bruised and tired
text:
I rarely wear eye shadow and never mascara due to a retina problem that can cause my eye to hurt unexpectedly and requires prescription eye drops throughout the day. When I do wear eye shadow, I go very light and I need it wash off cleanly and quickly.

This just isn't right for me in the Matte-ison color. The texture is very smooth and goes on like silk with no clumping or sticking. However, the color made me look like I was hiding a big, purplish bruise - even with a very light application. As soon as my husband stopped laughing, he suggested that I wash it off before we went out in public together, lest his reputation take a hit. Unless you are inclined toward blending or can pull off a heavy, darker eye color, this one may not be a great choice.

title: Mild citrus scent. Gets the horse barn grime off
text:
Softsoap is standard product in our home. It's reliable for getting grime off and not over drying my hands with multiple washing every day and it's not a budget killer.

This version has a light, crisp sort of citrusy scent. I appreciate that it's not an overwhelming perfume because I do wash my hands at least 10 to 15 times a day. I'm ok with the antibacterial properties here. I keep a couple of bottles at the barn to use after cleaning horse stalls and the other assorted horse chores. I also use it after petting the cat which is the only way to keep my allergies under control for small exposure to cat dander.

title: Very lightweight, well made and does stop some movement on the bed. One person installation
text:
I used this box spring/foundation to replace a one that was 11 years old on our guest bed. The mattress is actually in excellent condition, but we bought a high end mattress and the cheapest box spring we could find 11 years ago.

This piece is about the same height as the old one, but weighs less and seems more sturdy. I wallowed on the bed with three big dogs before swapping the box spring and after. I can definitely tell the difference because we aren't all bouncing each other every time we pounce and roll around. (I realize that most folks don't wrestle with a pack of hounds on the bed, but this is how we roll)

I was able to swap these by myself with relatively little trouble. The old unit weighs more, but has sewn in grip handles on all four sides to make it more maneuverable. This one is surprisingly light, but doesn't have those handles which can make it awkward to get in place alone. It arrived in a real box and plastic wrap so there was no damage or dirt, which is more than I can say for the local guy when our old one was brought in. Our guests will sleep well now.

title: A little too much volume and fluff for really thick hair . Smells great
text:
I have very thick hair that reaches the middle of my back, so great shampoo and conditioner is a priority in my daily personal care routine. This shampoo is decent stuff and feels nice in your hand. The scent is really fresh and invigorating - nothing sweet or cloying here.

If you have limp or thin hair, then this will probably give you a noticeable bump in overall volume and fluff. For my hair, this shampoo produced so much extra puff and bounce that I looked like a big poodle. My hair was definitely clean and had plenty of shine, it was just a bit much overall. I do love the conditioner in this line though.

title: Sweet, fruity scent and really adds bounce to long hair
text:
This conditioner smells sweet and tropical and fruity - reminds me of the Thailand countryside every time I use it. Just a warm, summery fresh fruit scent.

The texture is very thick and massages through thick hair with complete coverage. After two uses, my hair is soft, feels light and looks full and it's tangle free. I have very thick, long hair to begin with, but this really adds bounce and volume.

title: Consistency and scent of vegetable cooking oil. Took forever to absorb, feels oily
text:
My first impression, the first time I used this serum, was "Vegetable Oil". It smells like Crisco or Wesson oil immediately. The texture is very similar to cooking oil as well. The weird yellow tint to it certainly doesn't dispel thoughts of corn oil.

I really don't like the oily, slick consistency as it goes on my fingers or my face. It took an hour for this stuff to fully absorb and I could still smell it afterwards. I can't bring myself to use it again. If your skin is already trending toward oily, then this product is probably not a good match. It might help someone with dry skin or a sunburn....or possibly with a chicken in need of frying.

title: Scent is much too strong after a shower. Does clean well
text:
Whoa! The scent of the Sport version is really, really strong. Like overwhelms the entire bathroom and lingers too strong. It doesn't smell bad, it's a fresh, crisp citrusy type smell, just a bit too much of it.

The texture is fine and it does clean well with a decent lather. It rinses away clean with no residue left on the skin. My husband said he'll use this, but only when he's not going to be around other people because that smell just cloaked him. He was concerned about causing someone else an allergy problem if they stood too close.

title: Left my thick, long hair limp & oily and looking unwashed. Did stop frizz in humidity
text:
I'm not a fan of this. It smells very sweet and the cream feels very slick in your hands. The bottle says this stuff tames frizz and helps get your curls/wave in control.... it technically does do this, but at a cost.

I scrunched a dollop through my wet hair as directed. Dried my hair and looked at my reflection in horror. Yes, my hair my frizz free and the natural, humidity induced curling was definitely reduced. However, in exchange for that, my hair was flat and felt oily. It looked dirty and limp. I have long, very thick hair that normally has lots of bounce and life and shine. It reacts poorly to high humidity and can be a big puff ball, but the limp, hanging results from this cream was not a good substitute. It's probably a good product for shorter hair that is already really dry or heavily processed.

title: Heavy scent with a chemical odor. Left my hair pouffy and in need of conditioner
text:
Meh. The bottle touts this as a high shine glaze you use instead of conditioner once a week. I used it yesterday and I definitely wish that I had used a conditioner instead.

The scent is really strong and has chemical undertones, it does fade, but I don't care for it. My hair has a bit shine in the sun, but nothing extraordinary. I have thick, long hair and it feels puffier than normal and I can tell it's more difficult to brush - unlike when I use regular conditioner. It might be ok if you have shorter or layered hair. At this price point, this just isn't a product that I would ever purchase.

title: Lathers well, smells fresh and light and hasn't dried my hands
text:
I am a huge fan of the various Purell products - spray on sanitizer for surfaces, sanitizing wipes and of course, the original hand gel. Now they have liquid soap.

I tried the Clean & Fresh scent for the past week multiple times per day. This smells crisp, clean and light. The actual soap lathers quickly and rinses away with no residue left behind. My hands are clean and my skin isn't drying out as a result of several uses a day.

title: Smells crisp and masculine. Cleans normally, but can be slow to rinse fully off
text: I think this smells great - a fresh, crisp, slightly masculine scent. I actually like the smell better than my husband does.  My husband says it seems to clean as well as his usual body wash. He did say that this doesn't rinse completely off as fast. His skin is not dry nor is it necessarily much softer than with his regular brand.  He hasn't experienced any sort of skin irritation using this.

title: Love the summery fresh scent and it does clean well
text:
I am obsessed with the cucumber and green tea scent in this soap. It just smells fresh and clean like the perfect spring day. It foams instantly when it comes out of the pump.

My skin feels soft and clean after several days of use. This also cleans well after a day with horses and a subsequent layer of grime and sweat. I haven't had any skin irritation and I like that it doesn't require one of those puff things. You can use it with your bare hands like a bar soap and it still foams and covers well.

title: Light scent, no stickiness after using. My bangs looked flat, but no frizz
text:
This is a new thing for me....mousse. I haven't used a mousse in my hair since the 80s big hair went away. This is light and has a mild, pleasant scent. It comes out fluffy as a mousse should.

I used it to coat my damp hair, before drying it. It disappears quickly and my hair didn't feel sticky or heavy. After drying it, I had no trouble styling my hair, but I did notice it seemed a little flat. On the one hand, the frizz was much more manageable in 80% humidity, but I won't use this in my bangs again. I think using the straightener on my hair this morning, after this mousse was a little easier too.

title: Works very fast for thick hair. Heats up rapidly and has a rotating cord.
text:
My hair is extremely thick and long with a natural wave. Living in a year round high humidity climate turns that wave into a curly, frizzy mess more days than I like. On days when I am riding or just working on the horse barn, it's not a big deal, but if I want to be out in public without a pony tail, straightening is definitely required.

I have a couple of other straighteners that work well enough, but this one blows them away. It heats up super fast and I appreciate being able to adjust the temperature. The machine also has a setting that lowers its temperature if it detects damaged or brittle hair - honestly, there's something not quite right about that claim - the instructions say that it can take upwards of a minute for plate temperature to drop if you change the temp setting.

The cord rotates so I don't have to fiddle with it during use and that means that I can be in and out fast. I also like the cover that holds the plates closed when not in use. My photos are before and after just one pass. Two passes smooths every hair and it stays that way for the entire day. I shower and wash my hair daily, so I don't know if it would hold up for two days. After using this daily for a week, my hair still feels soft and shows no heat damage.

title: Works fine, but is not any different or better than a multitude of other hair conditioners
text:
At this price point, I expected to be impressed by this conditioner. I'm really not. The scent is soft and pleasant, and pretty much vanishes after rinsing. The actual texture of the product is very creamy and it massages in nicely.

However, the end result after using for several days is exactly the same as my Suave conditioner. My hair doesn't look or feel any different at all. Running a comb through my wet hair after using this reveals no tangles - like almost any conditioner on the market. For me, Infusium just doesn't seem to be worth making a permanent switch for.

title: Very light scent, foams well. No skin irritation with daily use
text:
I like this foaming gel wash for every day use. It has a mild, fresh scent that almost isn't there at all. The gel foams easily when used with one of those rotating facial brushes and it doesn't take much.

My skin feels clean and is oil free after use. Over the last few days, I have not experienced any skin irritation or redness. This also works well on the rest of the body in the shower.

title: Blends easily, great applicator for less mess and a controlled application where you really need it
text:
I don't wear a tint or foundation on a daily basis simply because I work outside with horses and dust etc every day. However, I have worn this for a few days in a row now and I am impressed with how well it holds up. I especially like the application stick with a little sponge on the end - so you dab it on your desired areas and then blend it with your finger tip. Much less messy than traditional liquid make up.

The Buff color is a little big lighter than I expected which is just right as it turns out because it's a semi-perfect match for my skin tone. It goes on smooth and creamy and blends very easily. It just brightens up my face and under eye areas without looking or feeling like a full face of heavy make up. I haven't experienced any caking or goopyiness by the end of the day with this tint either. I will probably continue to wear it fairly often.

title: Lots of foamy lather, really gets the daily grime off with no irritation
text: Foams and lathers much more than expected - it doesn't take much. I use it with a rotating cleansing brush and it really does a good job.  I am impressed with how well this cleans my face. It has no real discernible scent. I've been using this daily for a week and I have not experienced any skin irritation or redness. My skin feels soft and looks great.

title: Soft and smooth feeling with a natural looking brightening of dark circles
text:
For my requirements, this is one the best under-eye concealers that I have used. I have hereditary dark circles under my eyes, but no crow's feet yet. I tend to look tired whether I am or not without a dab of concealer in the morning.

This goes on lightly and is very easy to smooth/blend with a fingertip. It feels creamy and light on rather than a pasty feel some other brands have. It feels soft several hours later - again, not dry or pasty. The look for me, is clean and free of crepe or settling and my eye area looks smooth and definitely brighter.

title: Fresh, mild scent. Thick enough to do more with less
text:
I work year round with horses in dirt, dust and sweat. These conditions can ruin your skin and if you aren't careful, you find yourself experiencing breakouts along the neck and chest. So not a problem that I care to have. I've used other, similar products and avoided this issue in past summers, but I trust Neutrogena with my facial skin care, so trying their version seemed like a no-brainer.

The scent is mild and pleasant, it's not overwhelming with perfume, but still smells refreshing. The little scrubber micro-beads do a great job of cleansing and getting the grime off after a day in the dust. I have not had any skin irritation or threats of breaking out anywhere while using this. It comes out pretty thick, so you don't need as much as some other body scrub/wash to do the job

title: Produces a thick lather and cleans well.
text:
Gliss is a new brand to me and I wasn't sure what to expect. I've been very happy with my Sauve color care shampoo for a long time, so that's the standard for judging this.

The scent is ok, not great, but not chemical based either. The actual shampoo feels light and very silky in your hand. It lathers a lot and does a good job actually cleaning my hair after a day out in the dust of the horse barn. I don't think it does anything special for my hair color that Sauve doesn't do. I like this shampoo, but I don't love it.

title: Same nice scent as the scrub version. Hasn't dried my face after several days
text:
The scrub version of this has been a regular item in my facial cleaning routine for a few years now. This is the first time that I have used the cream version. Both have the same fresh, invigorating scent.

This feels creamy and is thick. I have been using it with one of those spinning face brushes and that seems to be better than just using my hands or a wash cloth. My skin feels very clean and has not begun to get dry after several days. Because I work with horses outside most days, I can end up cleaning my face several times a day and this is not a bad replacement for the old micro-beads formula.

title: Lid is much too difficult to snap shut. Conditioner is really great
text:
I like this conditioner a great deal and I really hate the tube it comes in. The conditioner itself is silky smooth in your hand and smells like a fresh apricot tart. The whole bathroom smells nice after a shower with this and I catch whiffs of it all day in my hair. This leaves my hair completely tangle free and easy to dry and style, plus my hair is soft to the touch.

My issue is the tube and the lid. The tube is then and very flexible - that's fine for dispensing the conditioner, but it makes it extra difficult to close the lid. The lid snaps on the bottom, but it fits too tightly to just snap it closed one handed. Using both hands means you wind up squeezing some out as you close it. This annoys me enough to not want to use it every day.

title: Smells nice, foams well in the shower. No skin irritation
text:
I really like the scent of this cleanser - sort of a mild citrus and fruit. It dispenses as a soft, creamy lotion texture and it doesn't require a lot to clean your face.

In the shower, this foams really nicely. It feels good on my face which is the menthol added. The salicylic acid that actually controls break outs is mild enough to not burn or sting. I have not had any skin irritation or break outs in a week of daily use. I'm using this once a day though rather than multiple times.

title: Takes forever to absorb, feels sticky while you wait. Pads are decent
text:
Like all other face creams, moisturizers and so called anti aging options, this one makes some big claims and the use of a beautiful celebrity increases the price. Yet, after ten days, I literally can't tell any difference between this potion and standard Oil of Olay or Neutrogena versions.....well price and quantity that you get.

My first issue is that the pads were leaking all over the inside of the box when it arrived despite a plastic over wrap. It was never sealed fully in manufacturing. The pads smell a little citrusy and are easy to use, plus I have had no skin irritation with them.

The moisturizer is a little thick and sticky on the face. The directions do say to apply and wait until it's fully absorbed before putting on makeup etc. The problem is that I use sunscreen daily and these two things don't work well with each other. It ended up feeling like I had two sticky layers of goop on my face - I had to scrub it all off and start over with just a moisturizer with sunscreen protection built in. These Meaningful Beauty products do work basically, but I'm not impressed enough to buy more.

title: No faster than a Conair, attachments do NOT fit! No retractable cord means it's a pain to put away in a small space
text:
I must say that while this is a pretty good dryer, it's not as good as my simple Conair dryer. Both are similar size and both include the diffuser thing and the more narrow "finger curl" tip, but the Conair is about half the price of this FHI dryer. After using this one three times, I have to call nonsense on the claim that this FHI dryer is faster than other hair dryers.... It takes the same 15 minutes to dry my hair with both this unit and my Conair. Charging extra for speed means I expect....well...more speed. (I have thick hair that reaches the small of my back)

My primary issue with this dryer is the fact that the accessory parts do not fit on the dryer! The diffuser goes on, but is almost impossible to remove because it's too tight. The finger curl narrow attachment simply will not go on - it's too small for the end of the dryer. You can't force it or twist it and there are no actual instructions to show that it might got differently than the diffuser does. So I have a pricey dryer that is less functional than my simple Conair. This one does have a very long cord and that's quite handy except that to put it away, I have to wrap the cord around the dryer or stuff it in the included storage baggie. Ummm....no. My old Conair has a retractable cord so I am not risking a break or crimp in the power cord every time I finish using it. Bottom line.... I'm tossing this FHI dryer in the guest bath cabinet for the occasional visitor rather than using it myself.

title: Works as well as Neutrogena and no skin irritation or breaking out
text:
My first impression was that this is very creamy and takes a few minutes to fully absorb. After a week of daily use, that's still my impression. It's a bit thick, but goes on creamy and smooth. Just give it a bit to fully absorb in your skin before going to bed or you'll end up with a sticky mess.

So far I haven't experienced any break outs or skin irritation from this moisturizer - after a week of daily use. My skin doesn't look or feel any different than when I use my regular moisturizer, but it's not any worse either. I do like that the scent is mild.

title: Smells fresh, excellent with thick, long, colored hair - soft & shiny after using
text:
I have to say that I am surprised and pleased with the results of using this new conditioner from Aveeno. My hair is long and thick and responds beautifully with Sauve Moroccan shampoo and conditioner in the gold bottles, but I have had trouble finding another brand that I like equally as well as the Suave.

This is very creamy and it doesn't take a bunch to cover all my hair. I love the scent, though I can't quite place what it is. My hair is soft, bouncy, tangle free and has none of the fly away bits or frizz after blow drying. I am really pleased.

title: Dried my hair like a tumbleweed. Husband's hair was fine & we both like the scent.
text:
Not great for my thick, long and colored hair. My hair is actually really healthy - soft, shiny and not oily or dry. I take good care of it especially because I color it. This shampoo left my hair looking and feeling dry to the touch. Despite using my normal conditioner and even extra leave in conditioner the second time I used it. It's just not for me.

My husband, on the other hand, really likes this shampoo for his very short, straight man hair. It didn't dry his out and he didn't grumble about a "perfumed girly scent" with it either. I'll say this, we do both like the citrus scent.

So...1 star from me, 5 stars from him.... 3 stars seems to be fair overall.

title: Generous sized jar of mud mask, travel sizes of the other 4 items.
text:
Having used several of the Vichy products this year, I know that they make a number of nice things that work well. Like any skin care line though, not every item is good for every face or every situation.

This is a nice way to try several of the products and see what you like without a big cash investment. I don't care for the Aqualia Night Spa stuff in the blue bottle for example. It's just a little too much for my face and feels a bit goopy to me. But the 3 in 1 One Step Cleanser in the white tube is great in the shower for getting rid of the day's grime. It does have mineral oil in it, if that is a problem, so be aware.

I've been using the grey mud mask for several months already and I really like this. It cleans and leaves my skin soft and bright. I love that the jar in this kit is very generous. The pink tube is their Ideal Body lotion. It smells a little like roses and is amazing on your legs right after you shave. It's a thick lotion/cream, but absorbs quickly and my legs feel so soft and smooth for 24 hours. I have a big tub of this that I have been using for several weeks already, so I am going to keep the sample sizes as a travel kit.

title: Burned chemical odor, slimy textures, made me break out. Under eye serum sort of works
text:
Well this is a mess in a pretty bottle. Let's just start with the bad and go from there, because of the three products in this set, only one is better than a one star rating. I'm not kidding.

The worst here is the so called Acne Scar treatment serum. It has a sort of burnt odor. The instructions say to shake well before each use, yet it still comes out with a slimy texture. The major problem is that after just three uses, the skin where I applied this stuff broke out, was irritated and stung within minutes of each application. Nope - directly in the garbage.

The eyelash growth serum wants you to apply it directly along your eyelash line. One whiff of it and I wisely decided not to bother. The chemical stench was appalling. After what the first serum did to my chin, I wasn't about to put another of their products on my actual eye, near my eyeball.

The last item in this set is the under eye circles serum. It is supposed to brighten and reduce puffiness. Once again you have to really shake the bottle before every application. Once again, there is an absolutely horrible smell - best described as burned chemicals mixed with some weird 1970s night cream and patchouli. This scent takes a while to fade after you put the serum on, a half hour later and I am still smelling it. However.... after using the under eye stuff twice a day for five days, both my husband and I have noticed that the circles around my eyes are not as dark or visible as before. No change in the puffiness or size, they just look a little less dark. I will not buy more of it in the future though.

Bottom line - three stars for the under eye serum, one star each and a warning to avoid both the eyelash stuff and the acne scar serum. Total is a cautionary two star.

title: Smells nice, cleans exactly the same as Suave Gold line for 8x the price
text:
This is nice smelling shampoo, very strong eucalyptus scent. It comes out in a thick, pearly green color and lathers richly. I'm pleased with how my hair feels after using it for a few days.

My hair is very healthy, thick and long and this shampoo has not left it feeling oily or dryer than my usual Suave shampoo. To be honest though, this H20 shampoo has not performed any miracles beyond my usual Suave shampoo either. My hair is just as clean, just as shiny and the only real difference is that it smells like eucalyptus now. I don't see any reason why buying one bottle of H20 costs the same as eight bottles of my current brand for the same performance. One star reduction for no verifiable improvement in relation to value.

title: Makes an excellent foot and leg moisturizer cream. Too heavy for use on my face
text:
Roses are the first thing I think of every time I open this tub of creamy lotion. It smells lovely and feels very nice to the touch despite being thick. I actually find it a bit too heavy for use on my face and I prefer something different, lighter.

However, as a body cream, this is very good after a week of nightly use. I'm especially pleased with it on my feet. My heels trend toward dry and will crack if I don't take care of them daily. The Vichy Balm absorbs well and the heavy feel that I don't care for on my face is perfect on my feet. I'm also liking this as a leg moisturizer immediately after shaving my legs every evening - no stinging and my legs feel & look like silk.

title: Does a fine job removing make up & dirt. Contains mineral oil
text:
If you have dry or normal skin - not skin prone toward oiliness to begin with, then this is a really nice face wash. It contains mineral oil so that could definitely be a problem for some folks.

After a week of daily use, I do like this for getting the day's grime off and making my skin feel soft & moisturized. Again - mineral oil. I don't wear a full face of make up every day, but when I do, I want it cleaned off totally and this cream does accomplish that very well. However, I find the best way to fully rinse it off is to use it in the shower.

title: Pods dissolve fully in all temperatures. No allergic reactions ever!
text:
I've tried multiple dye & scent free detergents over the years due to an allergy to most of the chemicals and perfumes used in laundry soaps. I always come back to the Tide Free and Gentle Pods. These just work. I don't have any skin rashes or hives after using this soap and none of my dogs have issues after I wash their dog beds with the Tide.

The pods dissolve fully in cold, warm and hot water and I have not seen any issues with the sticky mess left on my clothes like you get with some off the off brand pods. The other reason I always come back to Tide is because it gets all the red dirt out of my white socks & shirts after working at the horse barn and out in the pastures and riding arena. Other detergents sometimes leave a reddish hue behind and frankly, if I have to wash socks twice, then I'm not saving any money by using the off brand.

title: The Velcro snags the fabric in the wash & looks bad
text:
This fits and it's quite handy for use after toweling dry from the shower. I use it for finishing my grooming and drying my hair etc before getting dressed. The Velcro strap that holds it in place is really strong, but the photo here is off some - it shows the cover up reaching the model's knees. I'm 5'4" and this barely reaches mid-thigh on me. I'm a size 8 and the circumference of this wrap is fine - there's enough material to fit someone larger.

My primary problem is with the laundry. I washed this twice, following the directions on the label, and both times the Velcro has caught itself on the fabric of the wrap. The entire wrap now has visible snags and pulls all over it. Additionally, there are places where it is pilling. It looks like I've had it for years and worn it out. It just looks ratty.

title: A pleasant surprise for a tender nose in the midst of a bad cold
text:
We've used Kleenex tissues happily for years, but I caught a vicious head cold on the last day of our vacation and we ran out of Kleenex on the 12 drive home. I picked up a box of these Puffs Plus Lotion at a dollar store and WOW!

My nose had already reached the point of being red, sore and trying chap so I was expecting pain when I used these the first time. I was so surprised that the Puffs Plus actually does sooth and isn't stiff or thin or harsh on sensitive skin. Five days later with the ridiculous summer cold almost gone and I have not gone back to the Kleenex tissues. I think we're a converted household.

title: Works better in high humidity, high activity outside than Secret
text:
It has been extremely humid and hot here for weeks - heat index of 103 to 106 degrees every single day for 17 days straight. I am outside working with horses and doing physical labor in the barn every day and I sweat enough some days to require changing my shirt before I go home. I did a little research on ingredients this year because my old standby Secret just was not getting the job done this summer. Turns out this Suave has 20% of the active ingredient and Secret has 18%. I didn't want to go to a prescription strength unless absolutely necessary, so I tried this.

Sure enough, the Suave's 2% bump has been enough to give me the deodorant protection and help cut down on the excess underarm perspiration. My only complaint is the very, very sweet flowery scent. It's really strong and sort of just lurks. Better than sweat smell though.

title: Peony color is beautiful & comparable to Sugar Maple by Estee Lauder
text:
I've been wearing Estee Lauder Sugar Maple forever and it's a beautiful lipstick - classic, elegant color. But it is also expensive and I have to go into the local department store to pick up a tube which is always a forty minute trip. I have just never found another brand or color that I like as much until now.

The Peony color of this Mineral Fusion lipstick is very close to the Sugar Maple and looks great on. It's not too red or pink; it is very flattering if you're an "autumn" with olive undertones. I have not noticed feathering with lots of laughing and smiling while wearing this and my lips don't get that dry, waxy feeling after a few hours either. I think I found my back up to the old standard. I used my credit from the Amazon Beauty Sampler Box to buy this lipstick.

title: Actually does absorb on wet skin and softens nicely
text: Who knew putting lotion on while you're still a little wet was a good idea? I tried this the first time with a large dose of skepticism and a raised eyebrow. Rub it on just before you get out of the shower while you are damp and then go on about your business. I do find that it feels a little greasy at first and that sort of creeps me out, but it passes and the lotion absorbs pretty fast. This does make my skin feel really soft and the smell is fine. I like it, but honestly, I still think my favorite skin lotion is the Sauve Moroccan Infusion. It smells so great and there's no greasy sensation on my hands ever.

title: UPDATE - DOWNGRADE TO 2 STARS Smells nice, works as well as Fekkai for less. My hair looks great, holds in wind & humidity
text:
************** I am downgrading this hairspray to two stars from five. Why? Because after a week and less than 1/4 of the can used, the entire spray nozzle has failed. It's not clogged or blocked. It has simply stopped working. This happened as I was in the middle of preparing for a formal wedding at 5pm on a Saturday night at a country resort in the middle of nowhere. I couldn't run out and buy a new can of hair spray and I had to borrow some from the bride!!! Never again.

***************** Original Review below **************************************************
I use hair spray every single day and I have been trying to find a single good brand that does the job off my current two brands. I have settled on Suave for the days when I am outside with the horses in the wind, dust and humidity simply because it is inexpensive and my hair stays put. But the trade off is I can't run a brush through my hair after spraying it and it can get dry in the summer. My second option has been Fekkai brand which is excellent, smells pretty, and holds well, yet feels soft & I can brush my hair and it still looks great. But....Fekkai is outrageously overpriced and hard to justify & the nozzles don't always work.

This CHI Keratin has a mild and not unpleasant scent, sprays out in a wide, fine mist and doesn't feel sticky. My hair feels soft and looks nice - the same way it does with the Fekkai and I can brush it for touch ups. If I use a bit more than when I use the Suave, I get a similar strong hold in a wind outside and humidity. On a normal day or if I am going to be inside only, a light spritz of the CHI is all I need. So I think I may have finally found my combination hair spray that does what both the others did all in one.

title: Gentle on sensitive skin. Feels good on and softer skin after
text: Opening the bottle releases a gentle scent of aloe vera and a solid grey cream inside. This stuff is very smooth and silky soft to the touch. Putting it on feels like silk and it drys gently without that sudden tight feeling you get from other brands of masks. Wait five minutes and rinse off. When my face had dried completely, my skin definitely felt softer and was cleaner. I haven't experienced any redness or irritation at all - no burning or itchiness either. (This has happened before with generic, random skin creams) You just use a thin layer of this mask twice a week, so the bottle should last a long time making it a better value than it might appear at first glance.

title: No rash, no itching and I am clean! Finally a an option besides just Ivory for skin allergies
text:
I have become an allergic special snowflake in the last few years and find myself reacting with itchy skin and rashes to soaps that I used to love. This drives me crazy, but life goes on and I thought I was just going to use Ivory soap forever. There's nothing wrong with Ivory, but I like a little variety in my life.

These Dove Sensitive Skin bars are pretty good.... after daily use in my showers for two weeks I haven't had any rashes or itchiness and no red spots! Plus I feel like my skin in general is in good shape and I am just as clean as I was with the Ivory soap. I am very pleased to find a soap that I can alternate between.

title: Absorbs quickly without the visible white residue. Seems to work in just a couple of days
text:
I work outside in the heat and East Texas humidity every day with my horses - this means that summer brings some breakouts despite my best efforts. I've been using the Neutrogena rapid clear spot treatment when needed for awhile with good results. Like the other brands of spot treatment ointments, it can dry the skin and is only effective for the single place you apply it and there's that tell tale faint white medicine residue left behind.

This daily leave on mask version is a definite improvement. It goes on smoothly and absorbs almost immediately with no weird white visible residue left. I have seen an improvement in the one impending break out spot that was threatening to start and it has almost vanished in just two days. I'm applying a light layer of the mask twice a day. So far I like this better than the other version from Neutrogena.

title: No skin irritation or breaking out after four days. Looks good with no foundation
text: I was a little concerned about this powder being too dark for my skin and if I wear it with foundation, it is a bit. Using it alone seems to be a really subtle match that tones natural shine and just blends away skin imperfections without actually doing a full face of make up. It goes on more like a thin foundation rather than your typical loose powder which means it stays in place. After four days, I have not had any skin irritation or break outs, so I will definitely continue to use it.

title: Nice for very thick, long hair - doesn't create static electricity.
text: I just bought my second one of these brushes in two years at a local store - the first one finally began to break down after daily use multiple times a day. The big, flat surface smooths my thick, long hair nicely and doesn't create static. The handle is thick and easy to hold with a hairdryer I n the other hand. This is just a decent, every day hairbrush.

title: Nail clippers are pretty bad. Tweezers & file are good, but set is not a good value.
text:
On first inspection, this set appears really nice. The leather pouch is especially nice - honestly, I would love a wallet made of this stuff. The kit fits in my handbag pocket discreetly and that makes it very handy. The nail file is easy to hold and doesn't slip out my fingers, it shapes and smooths natural nails correctly. The tweezers are well designed and easy to use - again they don't slip out of my fingers and the little plastic cap keeps them closed so you don't poke yourself pulling them out of the pouch.

The failure here is the weak nail clippers. They fold flat to fit in the pouch, but that is a prime example of design over function. Unfolding the clippers to use them means the hinge for the clipping action is small and weak and easily bumped loose during use. If you use these just for a quick hang nail or to snip a loose thread they are fine. To actually do your fingernails or toe nails, these clippers are an exercise in frustration. I ended up getting out my dollar store nail clippers instead. If you can find this set for under fifteen bucks it's worth it, but that's just because the leather case and tweezer are really good.

title: One use and I can see a reduction in humidity induced puffiness
text:
I tried this for the first time as a sample in the Amazon Hair & Beauty Sample Box this week - I had never heard of this brand before actually. I have really thick hair that reaches the middle of my back. It can take on a wavy, pouffy life of its own in high humidity and I don't have the patience to play with a straightener or hot iron most mornings.

I used this last night after my shower as a leave in conditioner. Today, my hair is very soft and seems to have a bit of extra shine to it. It's not straight or totally free of humidity induced puff, but it it is better behaved. I'm inclined to continue using the Black spray and see what the long term results might be.

title: Terrific on your face and for soft legs after shaving. Cheerful smell
text: I'm a big fan of the Clean & Clear line of products. They are affordable and they work without irritating my skin. This scrub has a very fresh, bright scent that has the faintest hint of menthol, but not in that cough drop way. It leaves my face soft and feeling very clean and I have no residual film on my skin afterwards. I also love this product after shaving my legs. Sounds wrong, I know! But it will exfoliate and leave your legs soft and looking & feeling extra smooth.

title: No sticky residue or offensive scent. Really helps if you don't use regular conditioner
text: My hairdresser introduced me to this detangler spray and I keep it around to use when I am trying a new shampoo and especially if I am traveling. It can be used as leave in conditioner and it works very well to detangle and smooth long, thick hair just before you dry it. The scent is a little strong, but it fades away quickly. Additionally, there's no sticky residue in my hair when I use the Brocato spray.

title: Leaves a weird slick feel to my hair & doesn't perform as well as Suave
text: I picked up a bottle of this on clearance at the grocery store for under two dollars and thought it was worth a try. I typically use the Suave color care conditioner with argan oil with excellent results. This version from Pantene seems to work with basic conditioning and moisturizing, but it also feels like there's a slick coating left on my hair. I don't think it's as a good as the Suave and certainly not worth several dollars more per bottle than the Suave. My hair looks better with the Suave and I prefer the scent of the Suave Moroccan Infusion.

title: Seems to work as described, but not worth the extra price compared to other brands
text: I picked up a bottle of this on clearance at the grocery store for under two dollars and thought it was worth a try. I typically use the Suave color care shampoo with argan oil with excellent results. This version from Pantene seems to work with shine and general brightness after a week of use immediately after a root touch up for my bright red hair. I don't think it's any better than the Suave though and certainly not worth several dollars more per bottle than the Suave. My hair looks fine, but I prefer the scent of the Suave and I'll go back to it on a regular basis.

title: but this is just as good and in some ways better
text: I normally only use the Chapstick medicated with the menthol added, but this is just as good and in some ways better. You get the same mint cooling sensation and it tastes better. It's not sticky and it definitely protects against sun and wind damage when you're working or playing outside for long periods every day. I haven't been able to find this Candy Cane variety locally, so I am glad to see it available on Amazon.

title: Spray it on, walk outside in the wind and don't worry. Your hair isn't moving.
text: I picked up a single can of this on a clearance rack at the grocery store last week and tried for two days while outside riding horses. It absolutely holds your hair in place - like a helmet! The scent isn't bad and it fades away pretty fast (unlike the awful Loreal hairspray I got off that same clearance rack) This stuff isn't a spray to use if you want to touch your hair or run a brush through it after using it though. This for shellacking your style into place and staying there. Period.

title: Nice scent & my hair looks good
text: I picked up a bottle of this conditioner at the grocery store for under two dollars on the clearance rack and thought it was worth a try. It smells very nice - softly floral without filling the whole bathroom with its scent. The conditioner is thick and it doesn't take an excessive quantity to thoroughly coat my thick, long hair. My hair is soft and smooth and looks good, so it has done equally as well as my usual brand. I'll keep this and add in the rotation until it's gone. I do prefer the scent of the Sauve Moroccan Oil to this & I think the Sauve leaves my hair a little shinier.

title: Overpowering chemical scent that others can smell.
text: I bought a bottle of this for less than two bucks in the clearance rack at the local grocery store this week. I'm really glad I didn't buy more than one or pay full.price! The scent is overwhelming and terrible. It's a distinct fake apple and potpourri smell that envelopes your hair and never seems to dissipate.  The spray itself does hold fine, but the smell is so strong that a friend asked me at lunch if I was wearing a cheap off brand perfume. She said it was starting to give her a headache - I was appalled. This stuff is going right in the trash and I will stick to unscented Suave or Pantene hair spray.

title: Medium size. Soft and these don't pull my hair
text: These are as just described - basic pony tail scrunchies. They are soft and don't pull my hair or break it. These are not big by any means. The velvet jumbo version is twice the size of these, so if you have a lot of hair, these are going to be tight for a three wrap pony tail. My three pack included one each in black, white and chocolate brown.

title: Scrubby side cleans well. Smell is pleasant, but not overpowering
text:
My husband has a habit of wiping sweat etc off his face with a paper towel or napkin from the last burger joint he drove through - this is not a great skin care plan. His response has typically been an arched brow and words about showering later & not being a girl. So these wipes are my halfway point offering - he doesn't act like a caveman and I don't make him smell like a debutant.

The rough side of the wipe is pretty good at scrubbing outdoor grime off and it didn't irritate his skin under his beard. The smooth side does fine as a polish after cleaning. The scent is a rosemary and chamomile mix with a faint mint undertone - it's mild and a little masculine. He doesn't seem to mind the wipes and hasn't thrown them out with a snarl - that's high praise around here. My issue is the overall value. At this price point, there should be double the number of wipes in each package.

title: Smells nice, doesn't dry my hands. Not really meant for heavy dirt,  light duty only.
text: I love a foaming soap for my hands. It's just faster and visiting kids seem far happier about washing up then with regular soap. This smells nice and doesn't dry my skin even on days when I end up washing my hands several times. My one issue is that both versions of the Method foaming soap that I have tried have really been suitable only for light duty. I use Dial liquid after working with the horses or in the yard - real dirt needs a stronger soap than this. Washing up after house work, after being out in public, or cooking...Method is fine.

title: Keeps my Andalusian horses' long, thick manes looking show ready and feeling soft as silk
text: I've been using this for years for our show horses at competitions and at home when they are just wallowing around in the pastures. This is easy - just spray on dry or wet hair, comb through and braid if you need to or turn them out. Our Andalusians have natural long, thick manes (past the shoulders) and tails that drag the ground like capes. Mane N Tail Detangler keeps their beautiful hair soft and free of tangles & knots. Plus the burrs and pasture debris just comes out with no drama.

title: Smells like flowers, no shellac look. My hair is touchable and still stays in place.
text: I tried this because it was dirt cheap on sale at the grocery store this week and I was out of my usual Fekkai hair spray. I'm very impressed and frankly, quite surprised by how well it works. It sprays out in a fine mist and has a light flowery scent - instead of the traditional alcohol based odor most hair spray has. It definitely holds my hair even when I'm outside working with the horses. I can still run a brush or my fingers through my hair and it doesn't feel sticky or hard - no helmet head with this version of Suave.

title: Absorbs very quickly, no oily residue afterwards.
text: My husband swears by Corn Huskers Lotion and has used it for many years. It absorbs very fast and has a mild scent that fades quickly. He works with tools and small metal repairs daily, so his hands are exposed to a lot of stuff and can get dry and chapped in the winter. The Corn Huskers slows that process considerably and definitely gives him relief.

title: No build up, my hair feels soft and looks healthy with bounce and shine.
text: I love the light, fresh scent of this masque. I have very thick, color treated hair that reaches the middle of my back and I take good care of it. Working outside with horses every day means my hair is constantly exposed to sun, wind and dust so it can get dry fast. This goes on like a thick conditioner and you leave it in for five minutes, then rinse it out. I used it after a regular Suave color protection shampoo, but no additional conditioner. My hair is very soft, shiny and full. It doesn't look weighed down or heavy at all. No tangles and it smells nice and doesn't look or feel dry in the least. I received a free sample for testing and review.

title: Absorbs very fast, scent vanish very fast, no skin irritation or break outs. Budget breaker for outdoor lifestyle
text:
I typically dislike all sunscreen products. They smell terrible, most make my face break out, they feel greasy and because I work outside with horses almost every single day the layer of sticky sunscreen can draw extra dust & dirt to my face and neck. This La Roche Posay Anthelios is a little different than the usual stuff out there. It has that gross sunscreen smell - BUT it goes away very quickly after you apply this. I am pretty impressed with how fast the smell is gone. We're talking minutes. Well done.

The product itself looks and feels just like most of the other sunscreens out there on the market when you pump it into your hand. It's white and is a creamy type texture. Maybe a little silkier than the cheaper grocery store beach style stuff. This goes on like a moisturizer and a little bit (for me at least) goes a long way. I find that a ball about the size of four peas is just right to cover my face completely without leaving a greasy coating on my skin. It absorbs within a few minutes and my face and neck feel soft and smooth. My face can be a nightmare with any products, but I have not had a rash or irritation from this serum. Again - well done La Roche.

My one star deduction is quite simply the value factor. As much as I like this product, I can't understand how a woman like me can afford to use it daily. The suggested use on the bottle is reapplication every two hours while exposed to the sun and daily use otherwise. If you are a active outside every day for more than two hours at this price, there is no way I can afford two or three bottles of this a month! That's more than my cell phone bill. It's a great item, but a treat, like a trip to the spa.

title: Subtler scent than the Tangle Free & Tea Tree Oil versions. My hair is very soft.
text:
I have tried several of the Luseta hair products over the past couple of months and while I really like the overall quality of everything, I have been searching for my favorite shampoo and conditioner from their varieties.
