I liked the tea tree & argan oil, but not the scent. I bought the Tangle Free and it really works, but again...not my favorite scent. ( I love the way the Suave Moroccan Infusion smells.)

This Argan Oil moisture version is better than the other two. The scent is much more subtle than the other two Luseta versions - softer. The shampoo is a creamy white with an almost iridescent, shimmer to it. It doesn't take much to generate a real lather - two pumps for me. My hair is very thick and reaches to the middle of my back. The conditioner is similar in color and texture and the bottles are almost identical. If you're in a rush, it could be easy to mix them up. Luseta definitely needs to change up the color on one of the pumps so you have a visual cue. My hair is soft, shiny and has lots of bounce after using this combination. It looks good and feels good to the touch. I would be happy to keep this in my shower and my guest shower. I received a free sample of the Argan Oil moisture & repair shampoo and conditioner for testing and review.

title: Smells lovely, works with thick, long hair. No humidity induced frizz
text:
I have never used a hair masque prior to this Luseta masque - conditioner and a conditioning leave in treatment of course, but this heavy paste cream type thing was a first. I have tried both the Tea Tree & Argan Oil and just the Argan Oil shampoos from Luseta, so I like their products and expected decent results from this masque as well. I have very thick, long hair and I take excellent care of it - no split ends or excessive styling damage here. But this is a humid area which can mean frizz and I work outside with horses daily, so sun and wind do dry it out.

This masque smells wonderful - very fresh and soft. The texture is like a thick conditioner. I left it in for about 7 minutes while I did my usual shower before rinsing it out. My hair is super soft and definitely shines. I skipped the conditioner on day two all together just to see if there would be any lasting, residual benefit from the masque and my hair was still soft and tangle free when it dried. I'm pretty impressed. The frizz factor seems improved as well. I can see making this a part of my weekly routine above and beyond regular shampoo & conditioner. I did receive a free sample of this hair masque for testing and review.

title: Left a sticky film on my skin, never felt like it fully absorbed. No odor
text:
This lotion does seem to soften really dry, cracked skin. I have a couple of places on my hands that are constantly under threat from daily work with horses and barn equipment in all weather conditions - I wear gloves, but that can make it worse in the summer dry heat. It is almost completely fragrance free and the texture is soft and creamy - no weird old school petroleum jelly texture. I immediately tried it on my heels and hands. No allergic reaction, off to a good start.

I think this Vaseline probably works as well as my usual Dove Body lotion with Shea and the Vaseline might even be better in the long run. However, I absolutely hate the greasy, sticky residue the Vaseline leaves behind! It takes a looooong time to absorb into my skin and it leaves behind a sort of film. This creeps me out and if I touch my eyes or mouth or food, now I have Vaseline transference from my fingers. I'll put this in our guest bathroom, but I think I will stick to the Dove for my skin.

title: The smell fades fast, really makes dry skin soft
text: I really like this lotion and I normally don't care for the shea butter scent. It smells strong as you first apply it, but fades back pretty quickly and it didn't give me a headache. Dove definitely knows what they are doing when it comes to lotion and dry skin. I work outside with horses a lot of hours each day and between the weather, gloves, and just dirt & physical labor, my skin sees some abuse. This stuff absorbs quickly and doesn't seem to leave a greasy coating on my arms or hands afterwards. My legs feel very soft and silky and I really appreciate that when it's time to wear riding pants & tall boots.

title: Much subtler scent than the tea tree version, rich lather, leaves hair shiny & manageable
text:
After using the Luseta Tea Tree and Argan Oil shampoo and conditioner with good results, I wanted to try this without the tea tree oil in it. I like this better in some ways. The shampoo is silky in your hand and lathers richly. It has a much softer, gentler scent than the other Luseta shampoo and I really like this better.

The conditioner in this Argan oil version is thicker and has a different consistency than their tea tree product. This conditioner definitely works better for my very thick hair. Again, it also has a more subtle scent. My hair is manageable, shiny and looks fine. But honestly, I am still getting the best results from the new Suave Color Care Moroccan Infusion line with Argan oil.

title: Leaves my hair soft and looking great. Affordable luxury
text: I really like the new Suave Moroccan line of hair and body care stuff. It's like they have stepped up their game with regard to quality and results, but kept the prices affordable as always. This smells good and feels silky in your hand, it lathers richly also. My hair is clean, soft and looks great after using both this shampoo and the partner conditioner.

title: Smells nice, really does add lift at the roots & body, needs to be washed out daily
text:
I take good care of my hair and I rarely use any styling products beyond hair spray. However, I do use a clarifying shampoo and conditioner once a week instead of my usual stuff just to get rid of any build up etc. The problem is that leaves my hair flat if I let it air dry. This Dove Youthful Silk Creme is an interesting product and fixed the limp, flat problem, just as it claimed.

I have very thick hair that reaches to the middle of my back, but I followed the directions and just used four pumps of this creme on my clean, damp hair. The creme is very soft and reminds me of a high end face cream or moisturizer in texture. It smells good too - not strong, just a faint pleasant floral scent. You massage it evenly into the roots and through your hair and then go on with your normal routine. Takes a minute or less. I have to say, my hair had body and none of that hang dog look like usual after the clarifying shampoo. (Of course....adding product sort of defeats the purpose of using a clarifying shampoo.) My one caveat is if you don't wash your hair daily and you're using this, it will look sticky/unwashed the second day and you're going to have a ponytail day.

title: The only thing that really works against sun and wind damage
text: I keep a tube of this in my handbag, one in my car, one in the bathroom and one one in the office at the horse barn constantly. The medicated version is the only one I use. It keeps my lips from being sun burned in the Texas summer and wind chapped in the winter - I spend a lot of time outside every day. There isn't any taste to this and you can apply a light coating over lipstick if you want without ruining the color - nice little bonus.

title: Feels gross - just scented, greasy mineral oil that never absorbs. Do not wear silk after using this.
text: I have been using the aerosol spray version of this body oil and loving it. I bought this because I thought it was the same and I wanted a pump bottle to take on the plane when I travel. This is not the same. At all. The only similarity is the scent. The aerosol spray goes on light and absorbs almost instantly with zero greasy feel after. This stuff is just gross. It's just argan scented baby oil and it stays sticky, slick and greasy for hours after application. My friend hugged me at lunch two hours after I had used it and cracked up laughing - she said my arms felt like I had stepped out of 1974. No thanks.

title: Three days and already a noticeable improvement in dry, frizzy short hair
text: My mother and I bought this at the grocery store to try on her hair while she was here visiting. Her hair is very dry and frizzy this summer and nothing else has really helped. I love the Suave Moroccan Infusion line of shampoo and conditioner, so we figured this styling oil was worth trying. Three days now and we're both amazed at soft her hair feels. It looks great too. The frizz has been cut by half and she no longer looks like she has a big pouf on her head. I think with continued use, the results will just get better.

title: Smells like flowers and mandarin oranges, a little goes a long way
text: I love this scent...sort of citrus, flowery garden and tropical vacation all in one. The whole bathroom smells fresh and happy after using this body wash in the shower. This is a giant bottle and will last a long time primarily because a little goes a long way here. It lathers up lushly on a bath pouf thingy and I had no skin irritation using this. Summer in Texas means dry skin, so Dove products are always helpful in keeping a balance of moisture and comfort.

title: Easy to hold handle, rinse clean, mine have lasted since 2010!
text: I love the entire Oster line of brushes and grooming tools for our horses. My Andalusian stallion is ticklish along his flanks and this curry comb is the only one he will tolerate against his skin. It gets the loose hair and dirt easily and rinses clean. The fine curry also works well on the slightly thicker coated Percheron. I have a pair of these that I bought in 2010 and I'm still using them.

title: Works better than the generics, but Fekkai is worth a little more cash
text:
I tried this Pantene hair spray in an effort to find a less expensive option to the Fekkai spray that I love. At $20 a can, that stuff is just not suitable for every day use around here! The Pantene humidity hair spray was on a buy one - get one free sale at Kroger locally, so I've used it all week. It's definitely been humid, hot and damp here and this spray does hold my hair in place even when outside working with horses. It has a nice scent as well.

My one star deduction is because unlike the pricey Fekkai, I don't dare try brush my hair after spraying it with the Pantene. It's very stiff and tacky/sticky feeling for about 15 minutes after using it. You better be SURE your style is the way you want it before using this stuff, because changes are hard. Even after it's dry my hair feels stiff to the touch. A lot like when I use the less expensive Suave hair spray. For really beautiful, touchable hair that stays where you put it, splurge and use Fekkai.

title: Simply better than the rest. The three blade version is sharper & lasts longer than other Venus types
text: The original Venus three blade version is still the best razor on the market for daily leg shaving. I've been using this for years and recently tried the Venus five blade razor refills, but the shave just wasn't as smooth or as close as with this original version. These blades are simply sharper and stay sharper for more uses. I won't stray again.

title: Not as good as Venus THREE blade razors. Leaves stubble behind
text:
One would think that five blades would be better than three. Not so much. I shave my legs almost every day, year round, so I notice even the tiniest hint of stubble immediately. Using the Venus three blade razors I can skip a day here and there without having stubble the second night. The shave is smooth and clean.

This five blade version just isn't as good. It's like the blades aren't as sharp or something maybe. The moisturizing strips do a very good job, but I wonder if the extra stuff on those interferes with the shave in some way? Within 24 hours, I definitely feel a bit of stubble around my knee and while it's not visible to the naked eye, it's still gross. These five blade refills aren't worth the extra money, the original Venus three blade razors are still the best on the market.

title: Not as good as more expensive brands,but a bit better than Suave or White Rain
text:
I tried this Pantene hair spray in an effort to find a less expensive option to the Fekkai spray that I love. At $20 a can, that stuff is just not suitable for every day use around here! The Pantene humidity hair spray was on a buy one - get one free sale at Kroger locally, so I've used it all week. It's definitely been humid, hot and damp here and this spray does hold my hair in place even when outside working with horses. It has a nice scent as well.

My one star deduction is because unlike the pricey Fekkai, I don't dare try brush my hair after spraying it with the Pantene. It's very stiff and tacky/sticky feeling for about 15 minutes after using it. You better be SURE your style is the way you want it before using this stuff, because changes are hard. Even after it's dry my hair feels stiff to the touch. A lot like when I use the less expensive Suave hair spray. For really beautiful, touchable hair that stays where you put it, splurge and use Fekkai.

title: Not good for thick or long hair needing actual conditioner
text: I normally love Suave hair products. Not this time. I have long, thick hair and this. 2 in 1 just left my hair dry and tangled. It lathers up nicely and smells good in the shower. My hair was clean after using this, but there's just not any conditioner to speak of. I wound up having to use a spray on, leave in conditioner after my shower because I couldn't get a comb through my damp hair! The remainder of this bottle will go to my husband.

title: Not for long thick hair or anyone needing actual conditioner
text: I normally love Suave hair products. Not this time. I have long, thick hair and this. 2 in 1 just left my hair dry and tangled. It lathers up nicely and smells good in the shower. My hair was clean after using this, but there's just not any conditioner to speak of. I wound up having to use a spray on, leave in conditioner after my shower because I couldn't get a comb through my damp hair! The remainder of this bottle will go to my husband.

title: Easy-to-use and store, dries without being hot to hold, multi temperature settings - UPDATE Feb 2016
text:
I have had my old Conair hair dryer for at least ten years and it's been a workhorse with nary a problem. Stepping up into this newer version with it's fancier tech has been a bit of an eye opener. I have very thick, long hair and blow drying it can take twenty minutes if I am being persnickety or getting ready to go out. If I rush, I can end up with that stereotypical pageant "big hair" in puffy halo and no one wants that. This pretty purple drier definitely didn't give me pageant hair.

This machine dries my hair in about the same amount of time as my old unit, but this one is quieter overall and it doesn't feel as physically hot in my hand. You can choose between cool, warm and hot air and low high power settings. This is really nice for styling and getting the last damp ends dry without frying your hair. The cord does retract into the handle with the push of a button - makes for neater storage. One thing that I really like is that this unit folds in half. Combine that with the retractable cord and you can pack it easily for a trip. It is rated for both 120 and 250 volts, but I have no way to test anything other than the regular 120 in the USA at this time.

*********** UPDATE February 2016 **************
I use this hair dryer a couple of times a week and it's just easy. It still doesn't get hot to the touch and it just works every time. I've taken it with me on a couple of weekend trips and it's easy to pack and travel with. I haven't had any trouble thus far.

title: Excellent for wind and serious hold - touching your hair is like touching a helmet
text: This is serious hairspray when you need your hair to just stay where you put it and be done with it. With one pass I know my thick hair will not come undone in wind or while riding horses or on a breezy beach. On a regular day I can spray it and not have to touch up again all day. My one star deduction is because the strength of the hold in the Suave Max Hold means you can't run a brush through your hair after you spray it and you certainly don't want your significant other touching your hair. It's like feeling a shellac helmet.

title: Makes my long, thick hair very soft and easy to style. Scent is really strong
text: I am really pleased with how soft my hair is after several uses of this conditioner. I've used it with a couple of different shampoos and my hair is very soft and shiny and feels nice when touched. It looks good too. My one star deduction is the scent. The Moroccan oil scent is very strong and while it's not unpleasant, it sort of overwhelms me. I have long, very thick hair, so this scent is everywhere anytime I move and my hair moves.

title: Takes more than Dial soap for the same dirty hands, smells nice
text: This smells wonderful and it seems to get my hands clean. It also rinses away easily without any residue or oily feeling left behind, nor does it irritate my sensitive skin. But.... The foaming part just doesn't seem to be up to the same standards as the Dial foaming soaps. There's less foam with this Method in a single pump and far less soap in a single pump. I found that I was having to use more of this stuff for the same results than with Dial.

title: Good for removing other product build up, smells nice, my hair is soft & clean
text: Very light green tea scent, not enough to make you think you steeped your hair in a pot,but enough just be refreshing - surprisingly, like the description says. I've used this twice between uses with my normal shampoo and conditioner and is does seem to clear any build up. I have had no skin irritation either. My hair feels light and soft and the tea scent sort of floats around every time I run a brush through it.

title: No build up in his hair, smells good without being too girly
text: My husband uses this and the Nivea version in rotation. He says he can't tell any difference between them,  but I think the Nivea makes his beard softer. Both get him clean and both smell good without being "girly" and neither one irritates his skin or leaves a build up in his hair. I just keep both in the shower on regular rotation and he's happy.

title: Made my already thick hair look awesome - bouncy, shiny and healthy
text: I like the Pantene Color protect shampoo, but the conditioner that goes with it is not a great match with my hair. Tends to leave me looking flat and a feeling a little dry, so I use a couple of other brands in rotation. This Pantene Volume version may very well be the answer. It smells great, just light and sort of spring fresh to me, not a heavy perfume. It rinsed out clean, but my very thick hair was still tangle free while wet. Once dry, my hair looks great! I have thick, lush hair that reaches the middle of my back in a blunt cut - no layers here. The wrong conditioner can make my hair look like a curtain. Nobody wants that. My hair is shiny, floaty and looks like I spent more than three minutes brushing it this morning. I did not. I'm not only surprised, I am really happy. I'll totally buy this in the future.

title: Really does work to smooth and brighten your complexion, super easy to use
text:
Just wow! I have never used any of the StriVectin products before, so I had an open mind and no real expectations when I started using this weekly peel. After all, all these types of beauty and skin care products claim to improve your skin, reduce the appearance of wrinkles or blemishes, etc etc etc. I have yet to find one that actually lives up to the hype, until now.

It's a pretty simple three step process. 1. Apply the first cream in a thin layer on your face. 2. Apply a layer of the gel over the cream on your face and wait five minutes. 3. Wipe off with a damp towel and rinse. This is easy and fast. AND IT WORKS!! There hasn't been any irritation or breaking out after using this system. The first time I did have a bit of tingling sensation, but that passed quickly. There has not been a repeat of that in subsequent use either. After three treatments, I have seen a slight smoothing overall in my complexion and a friend commented yesterday at lunch about how great my skin looks. She said I just look brighter. With no make up on. That alone means I will continue to keep this StriVectin peel in my closet and part of my beauty regime on a regular basis.

title: Works great, kids like tge instant foam, mild scent
text: I have found the instant lather with these foaming soaps makes getting the ick off after handling meat much easier. And it makes it fun for my niece to wash up after using the bathroom and before meals when she visits. The Dial scent is pretty non-offensive and unobtrusive.

title: Smells awesome, thick long hair is shiny and bouncy
text: I love the scent of this stuff - a pepperminty, figgy, lemon zest is the best description I can come up with. It wafted through the bathroom for awhile after my shower and even twelve hours later, I could still smell a hint of it in my hair. I usually alternate between Tresemme moisture conditioner and a Pantene color care version and it's been years since I've tried any of the Herbal Essences products. This Turkish Fig conditioner was a welcome surprise - I have very thick, long hair (down to the middle of my back) and I spend a lot of time outside in the Texas sun, so conditioner needs to really work. It took about a half dollar size dollop to do all of my hair and there was no excessive greasy feeling - it rinsed clean. Brushing out wet was a cinch with no tangles. Once it's dry my hair looks shiny and bouncy and there's no flatness or oily residue that you can sometimes get from a moisturizing conditioner. I kind of love this.

title: Definitely the best for every day leg shaving
text: I much prefer these to the five blade version. These give a much cleaner, closer shave and maneuver around/over the knee area more smoothly. I think the smaller overall size of the razor head makes it less cumbersome and easier to use in tight or delicate areas. Especially for everyday use.

title: Pleasant scent, performs well in Texas summer heat, leaves streaks on dark clothing
text: Typically,  Secret is the most reliable daily use deodorant on the market for my needs. It does what it should - keeps the sweat smell cut down and keeps me drier longer than other brands when I am working with the horses outside in the heat. I like the shower fresh scent - it's the least flowery of the bunch and doesn't interfere with my perfume on a regular day. The one star deduction is for the white streaks this leaves on your nice bras or shirts if you get dressed too quickly after applying it....just...ick. But, lesson learned - wait a few minutes and you're good to go.

title: Perfect for long, thick hair - no damage & neutral colors. Holds without pulling
text: Finally! A jumbo/XL size Scunci and in neutral colors. These have a velvety, smooth texture that doesn't pull or snag my hair when I take them out. I have very thick, long hair and it ends up in a ponytail at least once a day so a large scrunchie that's comfortable and doesn't damage my hair is must. Love these.

title: No skin irritation, great at dirt removal, small package with big wipes inside
text:
I normally use only fragrance free skin care products, but I am a sucker for anything with the scent of honey suckle. Breaking my own rules, I took a chance with these Olay Fresh Effects make up removal wipes. So far, so good. Three days of twice a day use and I haven't had any break outs or skin irritation. The wipes are really soft and feel nice against the skin and that honey suckle smell is a soft, fairly subtle scent. The package is small and would easily fit in a handbag or your travel kit, but the actual wipes generously unfold to almost half the size of a paper towel.

I found the wipes to be very effective at removing grime from the horse barn after my usual morning routine of cleaning stalls, feeding six horses and riding - my face ends up with a layer of dust, hay partical dirt, horse dirt and sweat. I do light make up later depending on what I have on my schedule. So far, these wipes have done a good job of removing a mineral foundation, light blush and powder.

title: Not as good as the original 3 blade razor from Venus
text: I love my original Venus razor and the three blade version refills. I tried this five blade Embrace version when it was on sale, figuring five blades would be better than just three. Not so much... I typically shave my legs every single day, year round, so I notice stubble immediately - hate that. The Embrace razor blade just doesn't get as close and it does leave stubble if you skip a day or two. I never had the before with three blade original. One good thing about the Embrace, the moisturizer strip is really good.

title: No skin irritation, looks great after many hours, coordinating concealer works well
text:
No skin irritation!! I love the coverage that the mineral type make up provides, but I have had a difficult time finding a brand that doesn't cause breaking out and itchy spots after three or fours days of consecutive use. The Bare Minerals brand looked great on, but within a few hours my face would sting or itch in spots and the next day there would be red spots.

I tried the Loreal True Match as a last resort and two months later I am still using it with no drama. It blends smoothly and the brand's coordinating liquid concealer is a perfect match to this foundation. I had to spend 18 hours in the emergency room and hospital with my husband recently and the make up still looked good after all that with no touching up. Perhaps not the time for vanity, but my husband complimented me for always looking "put together" even in an emergency....that alone means this product will always have a spot on my shelf.

title: Not good with thick long hair - left mine dry!
text:
I love the Fekkai hairspray, so I expected to love this Glossing Conditioner as well. Not so much. It left my hair dry and feeling like I had just shampooed and forgotten to condition entirely. I have really thick, full hair that reaches the middle of my back and it is healthy. I take good care of my hair, so for it to feel dry is abnormal. The first night I used it, I thought I might not have used enough...lots of hair & a new product = a learning curve. One positive is the scent, it smells fresh and light.

Three days later and same problem. Even my husband commented that my hair felt dry when he touched it instead of soft and silky like normal and it looks "off" to him. That does it! In the trash with the Fekkai and back to Treseme for me. I will keep using their hair spray.

title: Pretty amazing! Blends very easily, hides the dark circles perfectly
text: I am really amazed at this concealer! It actually does what it is supposed to do - conceals the dark under eye circles smoothly and without drama. It blends easily and is essentially invisible under makeup. Even with just a dash of powder and nothing else, it does it's job.

title: Useless in humidity or damp weather
text: Overall these little covers do work as claimed BUT and this is a big caveat... they work in optimal conditions. If you are like me and outside doing anything phsyical - actual work for example, then they things are essentially useless. If the weather is humid and hot or you are working up a sweat, then they fall off. It's just that simple. However, if you are inside an air conditioned office or house all day long and not doing much of anything they do absorb oil etc from a blemish and stay on long enough to do their job. For my real life requirements (working with horses outside) this product just doesn't perform well enough to spend money on and that is a shame.

title: Works pretty well, no skin irritation!
text:
I am NOT a waxer....just too mych pain for me thank you very much. I have tried some other hair removal creams with unpleasant results over the years. This one is a nice surprise. First the good - it does get the hair off with very little fuss and almost no mess. It rolls on easily and cleanly with no drips. The hair comes off pretty evenly for the most part. Most importantly there has been no skin irritation, no burning sensation or rash after using it twice in different areas! I tend to have sensitive skin so I was concerned, but no problems at all!

Now for the negative - the smell is horrific!! There is no subtle way of using this product - it produces a very strong chemical odor that lingers in the bathroom for a couple of hours afterward. And it does leave some visible stubble here and there, but I think that is to be expected from most of these products. Bottom line is that I will buy this again.

title: Dispenser is quirky, does tighten skin
text: The little pump design is a good idea, it just doesn't work well for some reason. I have to pump it several times and it will either dispense a tiny drop or shoot out a stream of the gel that ends up being wasted. When you do finally get the product out of the tube and are able to actually use it, it does what it says. It does tighten the skin and decrease the look of any crows feet you might have. You need to follow the directions closely to get the best results of course, but it does work and seems to hold up for a couple of hours alone or under makeup. If the pump worked properly and reliably, I would probably buy this to keep on hand, but for now I will use what I have left and call it good.

title: So overpriced, fragrance free, pretty presentation
text:
Ok...I have used the vBeaute It Kit for almost a month, every day, following the directions. I like the foaming cleanser very much - it did not irritate my skin and it did clean well without drying my skin. I like the exfoliating scrub well enough - again does not irritate my skin. None of the products had any real fragrance and none of them caused any breakouts or redness when used daily, so those are definate pluses.

title: IF it says MADE IN CHINA, then you don't really know what ingredients are in it- PERIOD.
text:
I have tried many products like this lately and I can tell you that if it was made in China, I don't trust the ingredient list and false claims.
Also, if there are 12 ingredients and the main oil is listed below half of the items on list, (such as number 9 or 10th), then that likely means there is only a small drop or two of that item/oil in the product. The main oil should be listed in top 5 ingredients. If not, prolly wasting your money. If Dimethicone is listed before the oil, it seems to me that dimethicone is more of a coating and protectant (short term), but not a penetrating repair item like the oil... That's my take on it...

title: ARGAN OIL IS 16th on Ingredient list, Not Much Argan oil in product...
text:
ARGAN OIL IS 16th on ingredient List, not much Argan oil in product... Also, the almond oil appears last on ingredient list. That means that this product contains a high amount of Dimethicone (which is a smoothing ingredient used in many products). I find the dimethicone helps smooth hair bbut is a coating and not a lasting moisturizing ingredient like the argan oil. For the price of this product (which temporarily coats hair until next shampoo), I can buy pure 100% Argan oil and heat it on hair once per week for truly penetrating deep conitioning treatment. This product here seems way overpriced to me, given the ingredient list. Also Panthenol is a coating and not a deep penetrating conditioning item. Just my opinion after using and reasing many ingredient lists. I am a licensed cosmotologist. This would be great if it was around $10.00. But for $20 I can get the same (ingredients) thing in twice the amount at Sallys.... It seems many products use a drop of Argan oil in the bottle (meaning its low on the ingredient list), and they use the word Argan to jack up the price. Don't be fooled. If Argan or other oul is listed after the 10th item on ingredient list, than there is not much of it in product, don't waste your money on inflated claims. READ THE LABELS-
Also, I just tried another well known brand recently which stated deep conditioning treatment with Argan. The label had it listed as the 18th ingredient, and true to my suspicion, it did not do anything good for my hair. My hair was just as dry and frizzy after using it, as it was before. I am better off using pure olive oul with a heat cap, or even mayonaise....

title: Don't bother! Too small to be useful
text:
Well, I have to say I was not impressed. I must note that I was not looking for a hair straightener - I was looking for something small and simple to seal mylar bags.

It LOOKS good. But the design vs actual use just don't line up.
The on-off switch is on the INside of the flat iron. Never had one like that before. Next, the button that looks like it would be the on-off switch in gold tone is nothing more than a thumb rest. I don't have super big hands, but still found it fairly easy to slide off the thumb rest.

It gets VERY hot. No temp control, just on or off. The two plates are very small. Very small.

The cord was plenty long. It came with two plastic hair clips to help hold back your hair. It also came with a lined pouch that claims to be heat-resistant. There is a belt loop on the back, but cannot imagine wanting to wear this one. The cord does not go into the pouch, only the iron itself.

I am trying to figure out who this would really be marketed to. I sure wouldn't use it on a child's hair. It would be way too easy to burn them.
I would also not use it on synthetic hair, given there is no high/low temp control.

I tried it on sealing my mylar bags, the original reason I chose this iron. It did seal the bags, but with ZERO time saved. In fact, I'd estimate that it took three times longer than if I had just used my regular iron. The plates are so small, it took several pinches to seal just one small bag. For the future, I am going to stick to my iron.

I cannot recommend this item. It looks cute, but is very lacking in practicality, has some very poor design, and not much temperature safety. The only safe thing about it was the little heat-resistant storage pouch that came with it.

text:
Well, there is both good and bad with this one. Let's start with the good.

This is a stick type hair dryer. There are three settings, high, medium and low (cool) heat. The brush bristles go all the way around the brush head and are tipped with plastic so they don't scratch. The cord has an attached hook-n-loop fastener to help keep it under control. Some of the manufacturer's photos show a metal plate on the brush. Mine was just plain black plastic.

Now for the less-good parts:
This thing is very heavy. As in, made my arms ache a bit to hold it up. I hope it means that it is sturdy, but it just seems to be awkward to hold. Even the handle is so large, my hand doesn't go all the way around.
The hair paddle is very wide. So wide, it had virtually no impact of my relatively-short hair. I have a different brush/dryer, and the barrel is small enough that I can add some curl to my hair while blowing it dry. Not this one...it is just too large. So, it might be perfect for very long or thick hair. On the plus side, it made my hair feel very soft after drying. And the box it comes in is perfect for organizing your box-crazed cats

Overall, this seems to be very well made. But the weight and the wide hair paddle means it will not be the go-to for my hair.
