The colors are mostly muted, but there's enough variety that you should be able to find one to coordinate with any outfit. The fabric is soft, so shouldn't damage most hair types. Very nice for sure, a great gift or for your own use. I personally love the colors and construction, so high marks from me.

title: Solid construction, no distortion ...
text:
This arrives ready to use right out of the box -- no assembly required. The base is weighted so that the mirror feels stable in use. I like having a magnifying mirror that I can move from room to room -- the light is better in some locations than others.

I notice no distortion on either mirror -- no "wavy" areas, which can be a problem in lower quality mirrors.

My only quibble is that the description here says the magnifying side is 7x. My mirror has a sticker on the magnifying side that says "3x" -- which is perfectly fine for my use (tweezing eyebrows, applying eye liner, etc.). But if it's critically important for you to have 7x magnification, you might want to search elsewhere.

Solid 4 stars -- I like it!

title: Nice light slightly moisturizing lip tint ...
text:
I don't use a lot of makeup, but I do use lip balm/shimmer/etc. as my lips tend to dry out. I don't like a lot of wild colors -- I stick mostly to pinks, mauves, and other less conspicuous shades. I received the "Pretty Kiss" of this Revlon Kiss Cushion Lip Tint -- it's barely-perceptible beige/tan with just a hint of salmon pink.

Overall, I like it. It does provide some moisture, the color is "barely there," and it seems to last long enough to make it "worth it." It's also transfer-resistant, which means it doesn't rub off on glassware. Getting it started requires some patience -- you twist the collar until you see the color start to appear in the middle of the sponge tip. It takes quite a while (and LOTS of "clicks") for that to happen. Don't oversaturate the sponge or you'll have a mess. Once the color appears, all you need is a couple more clicks to get the right amount for use.

I like this enough that I'll probably purchase another shade to have on hand when I want to add a bit more color. I like the feel of it and it seems to perform as advertised.

title: Lovely holiday gift -- for Rituals lovers ...
text:
What a great idea! A traditional Advent calendar filled with small sizes of Rituals cosmetic products -- lots of interesting potions and lotions to please any Rituals lover.

And that's the key: Rituals products all feature more "earthy" scents -- you won't find light florals or sweet citrus-y scents in their products. If you (or your gift recipient) expects more "traditional" smelling products, you'll likely be disappointed. However, if you are already a Rituals fan OR have a sense of adventure and like more exotic scents, you will probably like this. A lot.

You get 24 items, ranging from an emery board to shampoo/shower gel to scented candles. All the fun of an Advent calendar with the added bonus of some premium cosmetics. May be a bit pricey, but you do get a chance to try a lot of different items in the Rituals family of products.

title: Great for paper crafters!
text:
I've used this so far on a few holiday cards. It works great as "filler" for shaker cards -- I added a few regular-sized sequins to the mix for variety and it looks wonderful! I've also used it with "sticky" embossing powder: I stamped a sentiment with "bold" letters using Versamark, added the "Sticky" embossing powder, heat set, then sprinkled on one of these chunky glitters, tapping slightly to help it adhere a little better. Wait a few seconds, dump off the excess, and there it is: a fun glittered sentiment.

The jars are small -- just under 1" in diameter and just over 1" in height -- but a little of this goes a long way. The colors are in the blue/green/aqua family, with a couple of lilac/orchid shades, an iridescent white, and a silver/pewter blend (I think they refer to this as "color1"). These all work nicely for winter/holiday decor (and makeup) -- there are a couple of other color combinations offered that will work nicely for spring/summer projects.

I liked these a lot for my specific use (card making) -- haven't tried it as a makeup highlight, so can't really talk about its success in that area. But for crafters -- especially card makers or scrapbookers -- this is a nice choice! Solid 5 stars -- I intend to purchase additional sets for future use.

title: Subtle color, great feel ...
text:
The "Go Wild" color isn't all that "wild" -- it's very subtle, more of a beige mauve in tone, not quite as "pink" as it might appear in the photos. This is my first experience with "matte" lipstick and I was rather pleasantly surprised at how "creamy" it is. I was expecting something more waxy and/or dry, and it's neither. Very creamy, definitely contains moisturizers, with a very nice "feel." I like the fact that the case is mostly stiff cardboard rather than plastic (there's a little plastic for the extension mechanism) -- less plastic / more paper = more environmentally friendly. Maybe not a huge deal, but it was a surprise to me.

I may look at some of the other colors and formulations -- it's well priced and seems to be a great product.

title: Made for quilling, but useful for other crafts ...
text:
First things first: these were originally designed to be used in quilling for holding tiny strips of paper while forming coils. As such, they're as strong as they need to be for that purpose. The tips are very sharp and fragile, so any excess pressure can cause them to bend, leaving a gap at the tip. You really have to be extra careful with these -- the temptation will be to "squeeze" them tightly, but it doesn't take much pressure to cause a problem. Bottom line: you have to be "gentle" with these. If you are, they'll perform just fine.

I have a pair of these that I've been using for almost a year now for my paper crafts -- specifically, placing tiny bits of adhesive foil onto printed card bases (see photo). They're still in fine shape, no problems at all with the tips bending out of shape. I'm just really really careful with these, and use the ONLY for this purpose.

And they work great! I'm able to pick up the bits of foil and get them transferred and placed accurately onto my cards.

Highly recommended, but you do have to be careful with them. Treat them gently, and they'll perform and last for years.

title: My favorite lotion!
text:
I have a lot of allergies triggered by scents so I have to be really careful with personal care products. They often bring on an asthma attack — not fun!

However, this lotion does not trigger an allergic reaction. It has a very light vanilla/citrus/herbal scent that dissipates quickly. And it works great! I have problems with dry skin especially in the winter, and this totally takes if the problem. I started using it at the recommendation of several nurses at my local clinic who swear by it. They have to wash their hands many times a day, and they said this was the best product to prevent redness and chapped skin.

Definitely works for me! Will continue to purchase when needed. Solid 5-star product!

title: Works best in my climate -- not sticky or waxy ...
text:
I've been using Burt's Bees Lip Shimmer in various shades for at least 10 years, and it seems to work the best for me. I live in the Pacific NW where it can get windy especially in the winter. You'd think with all the rain we get up here that dry lips/skin wouldn't be much of an issue, but it is.

I like this product because it's not sticky, not too "waxy," and it seems to last quite a long time between applications. My favorite color is "Grapefruit" -- a pale shimmery pink that is barely perceptible. I also like Champagne (a light beige shimmery neutral) and Radiance (clear with just a bit of shimmer). I usually purchase them in the 4-packs, and that will last most of the winter.

I try to stock up when it's on sale -- it goes with me everywhere! Love the stuff -- solid 5 stars!

title: Decent lip gloss + troublesome applicator = 3 stars
text:
This review pertains to color 10: Soft Blush --

I think this is an OK lip gloss (whatever they call it, it is, in the end, a lip gloss). It's shiny, can be a little sticky, leaves residue on glasses, etc. It has a slightly better hydration aspect, but otherwise, it's basically your tried and true familiar lip gloss.

PROS:
-- it does add some hydration
-- the color -- a very soft pink -- is nice and probably suitable for a lot of complexions
-- it's very sheer, so it doesn't add much color (if you want more color, you'll need to get a darker shade)

CONS:
-- very sticky when first applied (even when minimal amount is used)
-- the applicator is VERY difficult to remove from the tube and VERY difficult to put it back into the tube
-- applicator is an odd "spoon" shape that doesn't work that well with lips
-- does NOT last anywhere close to 24 hrs. I have to reapply every 4 hrs or so to get the advertised softening effect. Yes, I know the claim is that the hydration lasts "up to 24 hrs" but I would expect it to last more than 4. Obviously, your mileage may vary.

Honestly, I don't think this is any better than many other lip glosses on the market. I'm concerned about the applicator -- it doesn't appear to be that sturdy and will likely wear out or break before the I use the contents due to the difficulty to get it in and out of the tube.

Overall, this is a decent hydrating lipgloss, Soft Blush is a sheer soft light pink color, but I have some real concerns about the applicator. So ... 3 stars (It's OK)

title: Excellent quality, great colors, and useful for more than nails ...
text:
This may sound strange, but I often use nail art products in my paper crafts. I make a lot of handcrafted greeting cards, and the sizes and colors available in the striping tape, faceted flat back rhinestones, metallic studs, etc. are amazing!

I purchased this set of striping tape rolls because I had an "idea" for a card I wanted to make based on an example I'd seen, and the tape seemed to be just what I needed to add a bit of sparkle. I was right -- this is PERFECT! I placed it on some red foil cardstock, then applied several coats of crystal lacquer to add some dimension. I trimmed it with evergreen sprigs punched from green cardstock and finished it with red flat back 2mm rhinestones (also a nail art product that I'd purchased here on Amazon). I think it turned out exactly how I pictured it in my ​mind.

Art is art -- and many times there is overlap in materials, techniques, etc. All it takes is a bit of imagination -- and a willingness to answer the question "what can I use to create the effect I want ... ?"

title: The best I've found so far ...
text:
I use these to trim my cats' claws, and they're perfect for that. I have two older cats who aren't particularly fond of having their claws trimmed -- sometimes, they're just fine with it, but other times they're not very cooperative. It's important to me to have clippers that are sharp and cut cleanly so as not to traumatize my furry friends more than necessary.

I've tried 3 or 4 other clippers (including a couple specifically designed for pets), and THIS one is the best so far. It's not too big and it's easy to handle. When you're dealing with a cat who isn't terribly interested in the process and is squirming a bit, having a secure grip on the clipper is essential,. The "housing" holds the clippings until I'm ready to empty -- just hold it over the waste can, cutting end down, and shake a bit.

This is a sturdy well-designed and well-built unit, and should last for years. I know for sure that it's much easier on my cats than other clippers I've tried. Definitely a keeper!

title: Non-drying, works well with my older skin ...
text:
I've been using this for awhile, and really like it. It's the best of the "sensitive skin" moderately-priced cleansers I've found, cleans well without drying, and lasts quite a long time. Initially, I used it either with my hands or a soft washcloth, but recently I've been using it with a Philips skin cleaner with good results. You don't need to use much at all for it to do its job.

I'm older, so need something that is gentle enough but still cleans well. This is it. I've had no problems at all.

title: Well-made set for nail art and more!
text:
I'm not a nail artist -- I make handcrafted greeting cards using a variety of techniques, including watercolor, pergamano (embossing/piercing on parchment), pigment powders on images stamped with tacky medium, etc. I realize this set is specifically designed for nail artists, and includes tools most often used in that craft, but it ALSO is perfect for my use as well.

The brushes are first-rate, very well made, good sizes, and work perfectly with my watercolor pencils to add detail to the focals I create for my cards. There are shaders, liners, chisel-tipped, and detail brushes. I haven't noticed any "shedding," either - the fibers are held securely.

The two fan brushes work especially well for pigment powder work (an example would be Perfect Pearls [[ASIN:B004PGRS0K Ranger Perfect Pearls Pigment Powder Kit, Confections]]) -- they pick up just the right amount of powder, and evenly spread it over the tacky-stamped image without "dusting" surrounding areas. It's easy to get precise color placement.

The double-ended dotting tools are perfect for pergamano work. The different sizes produce different effects in the parchment, allowing for an almost endless variety of shading techniques. The size of the shaft is nice, too -- if the size is too small, my hand starts to cramp; not a problem with these.

All this is packaged in a nice folding case with magnetic closure. The brushes are protected by a clear plastic flap. As with a lot of items with this feature, it arrived with a slight "chemical" smell, but that dissipated within 24 hrs.

All in all, this is a very nice set, designed for nail artists, but useful for other artists as well.

Sample supplied for review; opinions expressed are based on my personal experience with the product.

title: Nice smoother/moisturizer ... strong (and lingering) scent
text:
This was my first experience with L'Occitane products, and I rather liked this.

My skin gets extremely dry and flaky in the winter, and I tend to use more "pedestrian" creams and lotions to relieve the accompanying itchiness. This cream worked very nicely to calm things down, and I like the silky texture, both in the product itself, and the results of using it on my skin.

This is a cream -- not a lotion -- and a little goes a long way. It absorbs quickly, too -- no "sticky" or "greasy" feeling after applying. The effects seem to last a long time, too -- I put it on after showering in the morning, and I still feel the effects in the evening.

What I didn't like so much was the scent -- I think it's a bit "flowery," and it lingers ... and lingers ... and lingers. It's not a "bad" scent -- just a little much for my taste.

Still, overall, this is a nice product. It works for me -- but the fragrance is just a bit too much for my taste. Solid 4 stars.

title: Impressed! Better than I expected ...
text:
I love being pleasantly surprised by a product. I was definitely impressed at how wonderfully this towel performs.

My hair is thick, hip length, and naturally curly, so I was skeptical when I saw the size of this towel. I usually use a huge bath sheet to dry my hair. How could something less than a quarter the size do the job?

Well, I'm happy to say it worked nicely! This towel is super absorbent, and very soft. It dried my hair in about half the time of a regular cotton terry towel. The towel itself also dries fairly quickly, too, when you're done with it.

The size means it will be easy to pack and take on my trips -- instead of relying on hotel towels, I'll have something that works much better.

(I was provided a sample for review purposes; my opinions are my own based on my experience with this product.)

title: OK ... not fantastic, not terrible, just "OK"
text:
I have long naturally curly fairly thick hair, and I almost always wear it pulled back in a clip or elastic. I like the cloth-covered scrunchies because they're easier on my hair. These Scunci twisters have been wonderful in the past: substantial heavy elastic, etc.

Something happened between the last package I purchased (maybe 2-3 yrs ago) and now, because these new ones aren't nearly up to the quality of my older ones. The elastic is thinner, there's not as much material -- just generally not as good.

I can use them, but it looks like they're going to wear out much quicker. I've had these for about 6 weeks, and one of them has already failed (elastic broke). On the plus side, you get six of them for just under a dollar each, so they're not too expensive. Still, I'm going to look around for another option.

title: Good for adults, too ...
text:
I recently had to undergo surgery to remove a brain tumor which resulted in an incision from in front of my ear to the top of my head. Everything went well, neurosurgeon preserved almost all of my hair, and recovery is going nicely, but I was told to use only baby shampoo until everything was totally healed. I have hip-length thick curly hair that always tangles when I wash it, so I asked about using this extra conditioning 2-in-1 baby shampoo, and nurses said "OK" -- so that's what I used.

I have to say, I'm REALLY impressed with this. It's very gentle, of course, but it cleans nicely, and the extra conditioning component means fewer tangles. After a few weeks, I also purchased the "no more tears detangler," and the combination definitely works well.

I've been using high-priced salon shampoos, conditioners, detanglers, etc. for years -- and I'm switching to this permanently. It performs at least as well, in some cases even better, than most of the much higher-priced alternatives. Who knew?

title: I was skeptical, but WOW! it really works!
text:
I have hip-length thick naturally-curly hair, and always have problems with tangling after washing. I use huge amounts of conditioner and "detangling" products, and it still would take me at least 45-60 minutes to work through it all with a wide-tooth comb.

So I have to admit I was skeptical when Is aw this brush.

I'm not sure how it does it, but it really does make the process much easier. In 15-20 minutes, I can work through the tangles, and then either air dry or blow dry (I usually air dry). Yes, I still have to start at the ends and work up to the scalp, but it goes so much faster, and with little "tugging."

I'm ordering a second one of these to keep with my "travel" supplies -- it's definitely worth having two!

title: My search is over ....
text:
I've been trying various bath brushes, a couple a year, for several years, and never found the "right" one. Most of the time, the bristles are just too soft to do much. I was beginning to think that no one made a brush with stiffer bristles.

I was offered a sample from the manufacturer to try out, and provide an honest review. I can honestly say, I really LOVE this brush!

The bristles are just stiff enough -- not too abrasive, but stiff enough to feel like they're really DOING something. The handle length is just fine for me, too -- I'm tall-ish (about 5'8"), and I can reach what needs to be reached with no problem. The handle is textures so that it doesn't slip in soapy hands.

I like this enough that I'm planning to purchase another one for my guest bathroom, and possibly one more to pack for trips. It's really that good.

title: My favorite winter accessory ...
text:
I've been using Softlips for years to prevent the usual winter chapped lips situation. Dry heat indoors, cold wind outdoors -- it really takes a toll on my lips. The trick is to stay ahead of it, and start moisturizing BEFORE the dry cracklies appear. For me, that means applying Softlips several times a day.

I love the cherry flavor with a hint of mint -- refreshing without overpowering. I've tried other flavors, but this one is my favorite.

Buying "in bulk" means that I won't run out before spring. Great deal here on Amazon. Very happy with this.

title: Good hair elastics ... nice colors, too ...
text:
I have long fairly thick naturally curly/wavy hair that I usually wear pulled back into a low pony tail. These work nicely for my hair -- I can wrap 3 times, and they hold well. They're sturdy, too -- thicker than a lot of alternatives. However, they don't "recover" when I take them out as well as I'd like. And when I reuse the same one the next day, it's looser -- in other words, they seem to lose their elasticity with use.

Fortunately, you get a LOT of them in a package, and I like this set of colors: black, dark blue, denim blue, and other "neutrals" that can go with just about everything.

So, bottom line: 4 stars -- not perfect, but good enough for my purpose.

title: Useful for crafts projects ...
text:
I make a lot of hand-crafted greeting cards, and often like to "distress" the edges of different parts of the card with a light shading of beige or brown ink. These foam wedges are PERFECT for this purpose! They allow me to pick up just the right amount of ink, and lightly blend it into the edges of my card.

They also work well for blending Gelatos, like these: [[ASIN:B00C1SMYPS Faber-Castell Mix & Match Gelatos Colors Tropical Creamy Vibrant Water Soluble]] -- they allow a nice soft "feathering" of colors without shredding the cardstock.

And you get a HUGE amount of these for the money. I know they're intended for use with make-up, but they definitely are useful for other applications. Very happy with these!

title: Great size, nice colors ...
text:
I have fairly thick long hair, and these work nicely to keep it off my face. I can loop one of these twice around my hair for a low ponytail, and it holds tightly.

These are really covered elastic bands -- the covering isn't too wide or thick, so they don't look overly juvenile. The selection of colors is nice: good assortment of neutrals, plus a nice dark wine, a denim blue, and a navy blue. These are the colors I wear most often, so these are perfect for me.

Quality seems to be superior, too. I've had mine several months, wear one of them daily, and they're holding up beautifully. No complaints at all.

title: Works great ...
text:
Scent isn't obnoxious, either. I'm allergic to some deodorants, but this one hasn't caused any problems after 3 weeks of daily use. No white streaks on my dark clothing, either.

Price is much lower than my previous "favorite," too, so I'll be sticking with this one for now.

title: Great for long hair ...
text:
I have very long (hip-length) thick wavy hair, and a lot of brushes can't handle the volume.

Not this one. It's as close to perfect as I've found. It works out tangles without too much tugging, and doesn't break my hair, either.

It seems to be holding up well, too. I've been using it twice daily for about 3 months, with no sign of wear.

Very happy with this purchase.

title: Nice subtle sheer color ...
text:
I'm a long-time user of Burt's Bees Lip Shimmer, and absolutely love the stuff. The colors are sheer, with a hint of iridescence for a pearl-like effect.

I have probably 5 or 6 different shades, and this Peony is my favorite. It's a medium dusty rose color, very neutral and natural looking.

The product has a light mint flavor, and slides on smoothly with no "drag," important if your lips are chapped.

This 4-pack makes this more economical, too.

title: Excellent quality ...
text:
I'm not a nail artist -- but I purchased these to use with the MASH rhinestones [[ASIN:B005BF1M10 MASH Rhinestones 2400 Piece 12 Color Nail Art Nailart Manicure Wheels]] that I purchased to use on my hand crafted greeting cards.

I was really pleasantly surprised by the quality of these -- VERY high quality for the price. And they really do work well to wrangle those tiny rhinestones. The tweezers aren't huge -- very nice manageable size -- and come with a little plastic cover for the tips. You should use it -- those tips are SHARP, but that helps when I place a rhinestone: I can use the sharp tips to "tap" it down into the glue.

These now have a place in my crafts tool bag -- definitely a great purchase!

title: Useful for more than nails!
text:
I make handcrafted greeting cards and I'm always looking for less-expensive alternatives for some of the supplies I use the most.

I stumbled upon these little rhinestones while searching for embellishments for my cards, and they are PERFECT! I use them to embellish some of the lacy die-cut trims and to highlight different aspects of the embossed card stock backgrounds. I use a glue pen [[ASIN:B0096XVVDM Sakura of America Quickie Glue 0.7mm Point Ink Pen - 1 Pack]] to adhere them -- this allows me to place a tiny "spot" of glue, then drop the rhinestone in place. Quick and easy.

I invested in the MASH tweezers [[ASIN:B005KCAGEI MASH Nail Art Tweezer for Rhinestones Fimo Canes Glitter Confetti and 3D Shapes]] and find they really help me keep these little gems under control.

My case arrived intact, no "spillage," but these do have a tendency to "float" due to static electricity. I usually just tap the top of the case a coule of times, and the gems fall back into their compartments.

Very happy with these, especially since rhinestones specifically made for paper crafts can cost up to six or eight dollars for 40 or 50 gems! For card makers, this is an incredible deal.

title: Very pretty ...
text: Love this! It's really pretty, but even more important, it works beautifully! It's very "smooth," but it definitely does the job. It's etched to give it it's abrasive quality. I've ever dropped it, but I suppose it's breakable. It comes with a protective plastic sleeve, and I keep it in there when I'm not using it.

title: Great concept, not-so-great execution ....

The light is bright, and the general idea is excellent.  But these are supposed to be tweezers, and that part just doesn't work that well.  In fact, it barely works at all.  Two stars for the light only -- I think I may be able to remove the tweezers and use the light as a mini-flashlight

title: DHC is the best!
text: Big DHC fan, and this is my favorite face wash. The price was great. I also have the lotion and cream in the DHC Pore line. Can't go wrong with DHC. I have used their products for more than ten years now - I'm 53 and have sensitive skin. I would never use another brand and haven't since I was first introduced to DHC.

title: Disappointed
text: Very soft with the aloe but has lavender in them too, which caused irritation to my skin. Could not wear. Very disappointed.

title: Great dryer and great price!
text: Best hair dryer I've ever owned. Very powerful air flow with three temps, two speeds, and a cool button.

title: Best primer out there!
text: Best makeup primer out there!!! I have used the DHC brand for more than ten years now and am very pleased. I have tried many of their line, but this product is one I continue to purchase. I would not use any other primer. I have sensitive skin and find DHC products to be very easy on my skin. I'm 53 and get compliments on my skin, and I have to give kudos to DHC. Always pleased with their products.

title: Loads of compliments and not overbearing!
text: The only fragrance I use now. I used to always go to the vanilla-fragrance colognes, but found this one that has vanilla and other pleasing smells. Never overbearing and I get loads of compliments. Also a workplace friendly fragrance!

title: Perfect
text: Best mixture of nude skin tones ever! No really dark or really light with just the right amount of shimmer.

title: My favorite hairspray
text: Good hairspray for a hold that's not too stiff with just the right amount of give. My favorite hairspray now.

title: Can't beat it!
text: I keep coming back to this one! Little pricey, but it still does the best on my hair.

title: Great plumper!
text: As expected. Color is nice and does plump. Price is great.

title: Great Smackers!
text: Love these! All smell good and go on without the gritty feel. Lip Smackers are the best!

title: Like Delicious Cotton Candy better
text: I actually use this at home before I go outside. Vanilla is a great mosquito repellant. I prefer Delicious Cotton Candy, though. Wear out and always get compliments.

title: Wasn't impressed
text: Still looking for that miracle mascara, and this sure was not it. Puts out a lot but I can't use it on my bottom lashes without getting it all over the place. A bit cumbersome. Would not recommend

title: I didn't care for this scent
text: Love the soap refills for the Lysol Healthy Touch Soap dispenser, but I did not like this smell. I prefer the vanilla.

title: Used this for years and love the vanilla scent
text: I have used this for a couple of decades. I am a vanilla fan, and if you are, you will love these. Dries fast and does not stain clothes.

title: Too tedious
text: I followed all the directions, and they started pealing up after one bath. Also, it took me forever to put these on. So much easier to paint them, but I understand the appeal of all the designs. Guess I just don't have enough patience, and I was willing to get past that, but within hours they were pealing up. Just not a winner for me.

title: Smells to much like a men's musk perfume
text: Just could not tolerate this one. It smells too much like a men's musk perfume. Was way too scented for me. I gave it to my son, and he likes it, but he did not rave about it. I know everyone's sense of smell is different, but cannot understand the good reviews on this one; especially by the women. ??? I, preferably, do not want to smell like a man.

title: Got it for my son and he loves it!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: Bought this one for my son who was going off to college. He said it was a world's difference from the one he used at home. He has lots of facial hair and used to hate to trim, but said he now actually enjoys trimming. He told me, "WOW! What a difference. So I gave this one five stars from his testimony. Well worth the price!!!!!!

title: If you have psoriasis, this is the one to use!
text: Been a severe psoriasis sufferer for more than 20 years. This is the ONLY bath soap I have found that does not sting - not ever! I've tried some of the other Aveenos, and some of them do sting, but not this one. And it lathers up really good and moisterizes. Can't go wrong with this one!!!

title: Great product!
text: I buy this for my Mom, and she loves it! She also uses the conditioner. If you have a lot of hair, this will tame it and give it a pretty shine without the too-soft feel.

title: Disappointed in the smell
text: After reading the reviews, I couldn't wait to try this, but buyer beware, it has no vanilla smell that I could detect. I'm a huge vanilla fan (use vanilla toothpaste, cologne, deodorant, etc.) of vanilla, but there is no vanilla smell at all. I guess its suppose to smell like Jasmine, but yuck! I could not even wash with it the smell bothered me too much. Gave it to my son with a less sensitive nose, and he's made no comments one way or another. Won't buy this again. If you want one that smells great, lathers up really good, and is loaded with moisturizer, try Olay Ultra Moisture Vanilla Indulgence Body Wash.

title: Gotta love vanilla!
text: Who doesn't like the scent of vanilla? I use vanilla everything when I can find it, and I've used this one for years. Keeps me feeling fresh and clean all day.

title: Roc always a great product!
text: I've bought this for years, but this is the first time I've found it for the whole body. I've used the Roc Enydrial hand cream for years. Only thing I've ever found that really helps keep my hands from the peeling, which can get really bad in the winter. I'm a 20-year severe psoriasis sufferer, and I give this product a big thumbs up!!!

title: Was hoping for more
text: Saw rave reviews on this one, but I was not so tickled. I use it more for an eye shadow base, and it does help brighten up the eye area. Putting this on my cheeks seemed very strange for me, because I only use powder-based products.

title: Dad loves it!
text: Bought this for my 83-year-old dad, and he loves it! He can no longer bend done to wash his feet. It sticks to the bottom of a smooth-based tub. You just add liquid soap before you use, and it works great!

title: The best vanilla cologne
text: Been using this cologne for years. I love vanilla, and that's what this smells like. No heavy alcohol smell. And, the bottle lasts a good long time. Very pleasant, and I get a lot of compliments!

title: Great mirror!
text: Best mirror ever. Very easy to install on my bathroom wall, and perfect for me to put on my mascara. I'm 47, and it's starting to get hard to see how to apply my eye makeup, but this 7x mirror is perfect for that and other facial grooming things needed done. Good bang for your book. Definitely recommend.

title: Successful at Preventing Nail Flyaway
text:
Presentation is quite poor. This is just put loose in a small plastic bag. No box. Disappointing for a $25 nail clipper.

The best part of these is that they successfully prevent nail flyaway.

The cutting head is rather large for fingernails, making it sometimes a bit difficult to get the corners. You might have to do some filing down of the corners afterwards.

It looks nice with the gold color. It does make quite a loud noise when the cuts are made. It is overpriced.

title: Fragrance is the Second Inactive Ingredient
text: Under inactive ingredients, you will find Fragrance. It is strong fragrance. I hate the fragrance, and I hate that it is strong and that it lingers.

title: Excellent Bottles
text: Very nice quality 16 oz. clear bottles. Lids open and close fine. I recommend these bottles.

title: Produces Great Amount of Steam
text: This puts out an impressive stream of steam. It's easy to use. It's good if you have a cold. Put it on a table next to you, and breath in the steam.

title: Keeps Wounds Moist
text: You get a scrape or cut, you know the key to avoiding the wound scabbing is to keep it moist. This vaseline is great for just this. The top is very easy to pen. The scent is not overpowering at all. Apply it as often as needed daily to your wound, and then you can cover with a gauze pad or bandage.

title: Cut My Face Multiple Times
text: Unfortunately, this razor cut my face multiple times. I have been using an electric razor for many years, so my face is used to one. I cannot recommend this Philips Norelco Electric Razor.

title: Scent Is Too Strong
text:
The scent is of strong mens cologne. If you're sensitive to scents, I would stay away.

The company claims this shampoo has polymers that plump up the hair. I do not think the hair is all that plumped after using the shampoo. There is some plumping, just not as much as expected.

The good of this shampoo is that it doesn't make your hair dry, and that it does a good job cleaning the hair.

title: Daily Temporary Thickening . Too Expensive for Such Little Product
text:
What this absurdly over-priced product will do, and do very well, is temporarily make your hair look fuller for that day you use it. And then you'll apply the next day and get the same temporary thickening, etc.

If you want it as a daily temporary thickening of your hair, I would give it 5 stars. I just have to deduct a star due to its outrageous price for so little product.

There is no scent that lingers at all, which is great. It doesn't leave any kind of brittleness to the hair.

Oh, and one more reason to deduct a star: There are no specific instructions on the bottle other than spray on and style. There is no mention on the product that you should rub this into your hair with your fingers, or how much of the product to apply.

title: Pump Spout Easily Broken Off
text: The Long-Neck Pump Spout is easily broken off; and where the break occurs, it leaves behind dangerous sharp edges, in addition to completely making the pump spout useless, and thus the product. I have had two bottles in a row where the pump spout has broken off.

title: Not Just for Women
text: As of this writing, the title for this product says "Women Primer" ... I'm not a woman, and I am using this. My forehead gets overly oily, and rather quickly. I am applying this on my forehead, and it does a good job keeping the oil from showing. The product is odorless, which I really like. Yes, it's pricy for a small amount, but it's effective for what I am using it for. The "oil control" does last for me all day.

title: Unscented
text: This is completely unscented, which is nice. It leaves no sticky residue. Leaves skin soft.

title: No Permanent Positive Results
text:
I am writing this after 3 months of use, applying twice per day. There has been no permanent positive results. And this product is way too expensive not to produce an increase in facial skin elasticity or a decrease in wrinkles or some skin plumping, as advertised.

The biggest positives for sure are that this is completely unscented and that it doesn't leave any kind of stickiness.

The applicator lid is fine until it is unable to get the remaining product from the bottom of the bottle. And at this price, you want to make sure none goes to waste. Once the dropper is unable to suck in the product at the bottom, your only choice is to manually pour out the serum.

title: Makes a Decent Men's Face Aftershave
text:
Completely unscented. No stickiness. I am using this to calm face shaving irritation. And, this does a good job for that purpose.

I deducted a star because it is quite pricey, at $36 for just 6.7 ounces. However, if only used for that purpose, the product should last quite a while. This is made in Thailand...and it's an Avon product.

title: Do Not Buy!
text:
The tube you will receive is trial size-like. It is a tiny amount for $27, keeping mind that the instructions say to "apply generously." If you were to apply generously, this one-ounce small tube is not going to last very long. And if you reapply every two hours, as directed...well, you know.

The way this is as of this writing is too cost-prohibitive. The value just isn't there.

This product does not leave a white cast and it is not oily, but it totally irritated my neck, giving me a burning sensation.

title: Causes Acne
text: Unfortunately, this causes acne. I have not had any pimples for so long. As soon as I started using this, I am getting them. The serum is completely odorless, which is great. As far as effectiveness goes regarding their claims that the serum can restore face skin elasticity, I saw no improvement whatsoever in elasticity.

title: Very Disappointing
text:
First, the bottle arrived with the lid not screwed on tight. So, oil had poured out onto the bottle.

Second, the aftershave oil was completely ineffective at relieving razor burn on the neck after an electric shave. Even after more than one application during the day/evening.

I discarded the bottle into the trash, not even bothering to ask the seller for a refund.

title: Now This Is How Unscented Is Done
text:
There is absolutely no scent to this product, which is exactly what I wanted and what I expect when something claims to be fragrance.

I like that this leaves no residue or color behind. Rubs in nice. It's good for dry skin.

title: The Best Anti-Body-Odor Body Wash I Have Ever Used
text:
As of the writing of this review, the Solpri Company is titling this product at the top of the page "Solpri Shield Antifungal Body Wash" ... and I don't agree with them only including in the title that this is an antifungal body wash. I think it's more of an anti-body-odor body wash and that this is its greatest attribute more than the fact it is also an antifungal body wash. What I mean is that this is the best body wash I have ever used, and I don't have fungus. And if I had just ignored this product because the title says antifungal body wash and nothing else, I would have missed out.

Luckily, I have never had fungus. I am only using this as a traditional antibacterial body wash, and it's really great as an all over the body anti-body-odor body wash.

This body wash is not causing me any skin irritations or dryness. The scent is very good and not overwhelming at all, which I like. Only a very small amount with each pour is needed.

I highly recommend this body wash as one's primary body wash.

title: Nice Mirror
text:
I think this mirror is very nice looking. I found it to be the perfect size for my needs. I use it mostly when I shave my face. I like the touchscreen buttons, and the fact it uses internal LEDs instead of having external bulbs. I only the use the pure white brightest setting. It's bright enough to use for shaving.

Assembly of the base was easy. Mirror clarity is good. I like the magnetic magnifying mirror.

It's probably overpriced at $190, and one can never know its longevity, of course. But so far, I am enjoying using it, and I find it useful.

title: Nice Volume
text:
I am a guy using this shampoo, and I really like it. It does such a nice job, I do not feel the need to use their conditioner.

This shampoo does not have an overwhelming scent, or a lingering one, which I really like. It is not overly perfumed. After using it 3 times, I hardly even think about it.

The shampoo does provide excellent volume. It doesn't dry out my hair and it rinses off well. Assuming the manufacturer doesn't change the formula, as so many others eventually do, I am going to stay with this shampoo.

title: Effective & Unscented
text:
This cream is totally unscented, which is really nice. It also does not leave any stickiness behind.

This cream is also effective at removing the dry skin cracks at the bottom of feet at the heal. Just make sure you apply it daily until you see the results. It might take at least a week before you start seeing the positive effects.

title: Beautiful Deep White Color
text:
[[VIDEOID:8a966b4bfb9adf2148facbdb496e2819]] I like this deep white vanilla color much better than the original color. The pure white color and the smooth finish is very attractive, with a good feel.

The hair dryer puts out strong air flow at the high setting. The fact it's cordless, of course, is its greatest attribute.

If you do not require hot air to dry your hair, I think you'll really like this hair dryer. It certainly adds convenience. I applaud Lylux for bringing to market a cordless hair dryer like this and look forward to their future models as battery technology will allow them to continue to increase the heat output capability.

title: Heat Died After Just 3 Months
text:
This was a fabulous hair dryer for 3 months. So lightweight. Good power. Easy to use. Great small size.

However, after just 3 months, the heat is totally dead. The dryer only blows out cold air, no matter the speed or temperature setting. I had read here that the reliability of these hair dryers was very poor, but I took a chance anyway.

title: Comfortable to Use
text: Soft tips make the brush comfortable to use on your scalp. The bush does a good job, as expected.

title: Arrived Damaged: Leaked Shampoo
text: The shampoo bottle arrived damaged, having leaked out.

title: Nice Cloths
text: The cloths are nice. They are thin but absorbent. They feel good to the hand. The only negative is the high price.

title: No Heat At All
text:
I bought this hair dryer at Amazon, but it was at a different Amazon page. The seller recently created this new Amazon page for this hair dryer, and I am submitting my review here on this page so that people will know there is no warm or hot air.

This hair dryer has absolutely no heat. It's well-built, and the fact it is cordless is great. However, if you want warm or hot air to dry your hair, this dryer is incapable of producing this. If you do not mind drying your hair with cold air, this hair dryer will satisfy you with its powerful air flow.

title: Keeps the Shaver Clean
text: These keep my Braun shaver clean. It makes things easier.

title: They Should Add That This Is a Nice Aftershave
text: This actually makes for a pretty good aftershave to help prevent irritation. It is truly unscented. It does not feel sticky on face.

title: Excellent Hand Soap
text:
You only need to use a very small amount when washing hands. These bottles should last a long time.

This is truly unscented, and after using the small amount, I have no detectable smell on my hands.

This soap leaves my hands soft. It does not dry out my skin.

title: Misleading
text:
As of this writing, this company stated at Amazon under "About This Item" that this "Soap contains natural Sweet Almond Oil, Olive Oil, and Grape Seed Oil." It does not. The actual ingredients are "Aqua (Water), Potassium Cocoate, Glycerin, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Tetrasodium EDTA, and BHT" only.

Besides the above, which is bad enough, look at the ingredients. They are very basic and inexpensive and nothing really special. This company says they saponify the ingredients in an "old-fashioned cauldron." I guess that might add enough value to justify the high price for some.

Regarding the soap itself: It's the unscented version, but it left behind a smell on my hands I did not like at all.

title: As Expected for the Braun Shaver
text: This is a genuine blade cartridge replacement, and it fits and works as expected.

title: Truly Unscented Which is Great
text: The best part of this product is that it is truly unscented, which I really wanted. With repeated use, it does help with dry skin. It does not leave a greasy feeling on the skin. It does leave slight stickiness on the skin when applied. Dispensing from the container is working nicely, as expected, so far.

title: Defective
text: In the picture I submitted, the longer gray socks are inside out so you can see that one was sewed with blue thread, while the other was not. But it's not the color of the thread that's the issue. The right-side end of where you see the thread sticking out is hard and uncomfortable. The lack of quality control for such expensive socks is very disappointing.

title: There is a Smell
text:
They advertise that it is fragrance-free, but there is a distinctive smell ... and sadly, I don't like the smell. After I dry my hands, the smell has lessened, but it's still there on my hands for a little while. The smell is tolerable, I just wish there was no smell at all.

The soap foams immediately once pumped out, and the soap does not dry my hands.

title: Good
text: They solidly hold 8 ounces of your stuff and the price is reasonable. I am satisfied with this purchase.

title: The Best Hair Dryer I Have Ever Used
text:
I really like how light-weight this hair dryer is, and the high volume of air it puts out. It is also a bit quieter than most hair dryers.

This Velecta does a great job, and I am glad I bought it. It's the best hair dryer I have ever used.

title: I Like This Lighted Mirror
text:
I am very happy with this mirror. I like that I can either run it off of AA batteries or via a USB cable to a USB power supply.

The mirror is light weight to hold if one wants to hold it up to the face or mouth.

Light is excellent.

Magnification is as expected at the 10x side of the mirror.

I like that it has normal view on one side and 10x on the other side of the mirror.

title: Great As An Antiperspirant -- Disappointing As A Deodorant
text:
There is a lot to like with this Unscented Ban Roll-On Antiperspirant Deodorant.

1) It truly is unscented.

2) It is very gentle.

3) It is invisible once it dries, for the most part.

4) Its antiperspirant part is effective.

5) Price is very reasonable.

The big negative: It's ability to keep armpit odor totally away is quite weak. If I do the sniff test myself after a couple of hours I can smell some odor. And there is no way the deodorant part could come close to lasting 24 hours.

title: Very Disappointing
text:
These are way, way overpriced when you consider how truly small these cloths are. And just as frustrating is the fact they sew a huge tag connected at two separate edges. Because the cloths are so small, this big tag is extra ridiculous. And it's not as if they made it perforated where you could just do a quick tear to remove. No, you need to perform careful surgery with a scissors, making sure you don't accidentally cut too deep. I have never seen such small cloths have such a huge tag connected at two edges.

The cloths are soft, but they really do not do anything miraculous that justifies their high price. I would only recommend these cloths if the price was much lower and if the manufacturer doesn't sew in a big tag connected to two edges (big when you keep in context these cloths are small).

title: The Deodorant Cream Has Aluminum Chlorohydrate
text:
As of the date of this review, the Amazon title for this Deodorant Cream product specifically says "Aluminum Free"

The second ingredient on the box I received says it has "Aluminum Chlorohydrate."

Again, Amazon's title: "Vichy 24 Hour Dry-Touch Aluminum Free Deodorant Cream" -- But right there on the box is listed that this Deodorant Cream has Aluminum.

title: I Give These An E for Effectiveness & Expensiveness
text:
There is no doubt that these are the best body wipes I have ever used when it comes to their effectiveness at keeping the stink away.

It would just be nice if these were not so expensive, at $1.15 per wipe.

I like that these are alcohol free. They stay wet because the package has a resealable edge. The fragrance is not too overwhelming.

The wipes are soft enough, and quite large, so you can use them all over your body. The wipes do not dry out your skin.

I wish they offered these in a smaller size, which would be great to use on targeted areas like your armpits or face, for a full cleaning or quick "touch-up," and at a reduced price.

title: Very Nice Spray Bottle
text: Good quality bottle and sprayer. It does spray nicely, and at multiple angles, as advertised. I recommend it.

title: I Expected a Closer Shave
text:
I was using the Braun 5090cc (which, by the way, can be purchased much cheaper than this 9290cc at $115 here at Amazon).

I decided to take the plunge and try the much more expensive 9290cc after reading all the information.

I am sad to report that I am disappointed with the 9290cc considering its high price. It leaves behind way too many neck hairs, and isn't as good as I had hoped directly under the chin.

I pulled out my 5090cc to see if it could get the neck hairs left behind by the 9290cc and it succeeded.

I was really hoping the 9290cc would be great for me, but no such luck. It is light weight, and it glides well. It just doesn't give as close a shave as I expected.

Also, as of the date of this posting, replacement heads are about $75 here at Amazon. The 5090cc heads are $30.

title: To Comb or Not to Comb (that is the question)
text:
Decent comb. Not really sure about the "volumizer" part. It volumizes a little, but not as much as I thought it would. For me personally, I think I'll stick with a brush for volumizing, as it does a better job.

(This is one of those items that will not offer the same satisfaction for everyone, of course.)

title: They Lied. There Is No Ion On-Off Switch.
text:
As of the posting of this review, there are two places in the description where they state this device has an on-off switch regarding the ions. It does not have such a switch. You cannot turn off the ion generator.

I would not have bought this had I known they were deceptive (intentionally or not) regarding the inclusion of an ion on-off switch.

title: $48 For Just 250 Milliliters of 100% Oak Wood Vinegar
text:
Way, way, way too expensive ($48) for the measly 250 milliliters you get.

It is good quality 100% oak wood vinegar.

Smells good, as expected.

title: I Recommend This Styler
text:
I like this very much, and think it is the best of the so-called "air stylers" I have tried. Perhaps it's overpriced at its current price because it has to be imported, but that did not stop me from buying it after I read all about it.

Seems like good quality build. No odor from the air produced, which I like. I also like that it doesn't get too hot.

The result I see after using this is nice.

The attachments are easy on and off.

The swivel cord works on this one quite well to help fight cord tangling.

title: The Best
text:
I have tried quite a few different mattifyers for my oily forehead. This one truly works better than all the others, and lasts the longest throughout the day. I hope DHC never stops making this.

No irritation. No scent at all. Keeps the oil (and shine) away. Does not dry my skin. Strong recommendation.

title: Too Heavy & Attachments Unnecessarily Difficult To Pull Off The Hair Dryer
text:
Do the people who run the companies like Revlon actually use their own products? I am really starting to be skeptical. For if they did, they clearly would have demanded a re-design. Come on! The attachments are way to hard to pull off. (If you have any strength issues or arthritis, etc., do not even think about buying this hair dryer.)

Also, it's too heavy. You're not gonna like holding this hair dryer for any length of time. I certainly don't.

I hope Revlon goes back to the drawing board with this hair dryer. In the meantime, I absolutely cannot recommend this to anyone. There are lighter weight similarly-priced hair dryers that will dry your hair just fine, where the attachments are not so difficult to take off. (The attachments are also a bit hard to push on, but not as hard as they are to pull off.)

title: My Favorite Face Pad
text: My favorite pad, as it causes no irritation to my face whatsoever. And the scent is not overwhelming or lingering at all. Pads are of good quality. I like that this is alcohol-free. These pads do not dry out my skin. I recommend these pads.

title: Why Does This Have To Smell So Bad?
text:
It smelled of burning rubber at first. The smell got a little better, but is still bad. And the smell lingers. Why does this hair dryer have to smell so bad?

Also, would it have killed them to include a hook so it can be easily hung?

Also, I think it would have been better if they had two separate heat settings, separate from the fan speed setting. The high setting is quite hot. If you want less heat your only choice is the low fan setting.

I cannot recommend this hair dryer as is. I hope the makers go back to the drawing board for a redesign because this really has potential to be great.

title: Highly Recommended (As Long As You Get One Of The Units That Works Perfectly & Stays Working For A Long Time)
text:
If you read all the reviews here at Amazon for this product, you will see that getting a perfect one is luck of the draw. I am hoping the one I just got is one of the good ones. (Simplehuman includes a thing in the box that says they warrant the product for 2 years, so that makes worrying less.)

I own both this rechargeable model, and the one of similar size that takes the 4 AAA batteries. By all means, choose this rechargeable model, even though it is more expensive. First of all, it is great being able to see the liquid so you know how much is left, etc.

Secondly, the rechargeable battery feature is way better than having to insert and use the 4 batteries.

The product is very easy to operate. You can decrease or increase the level of soap dispensed. The silicone seal looks of good quality. Turning the unit off when moving it to be plugged in for recharging is very easy.

$50 is a fine price to pay for this model as long as you do not get a lemon, as so many others have reported. It would be nice if Simplehuman could do better quality control...but as long as they'll replace it during the 2-year warranty, I was willing to give it a shot.

title: Let Me Help By Listing The Shampoo's Ingredients
text:
I really wish Amazon would require the ingredients be listed for all cosmetics, shampoos, conditioners, etc. Since the ingredients are not listed for this shampoo as of this posting, let me post them in an effort to help anyone deciding to buy their shampoos based on the ingredients.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Glycereth-26, Glycol Distearate, PEG-150 Distearate, Cocamidopropylamine Oxide, Polyquaternium-70, Trimethylsiloxyamodimethicone, Polyquaternium-10, Cocodimonium Hydroxypropyl Silk Amino Acids, Sericin, Guar Hydroxypropyltri-monium Chloride, Methyl Gluceth-20, Silicone Quaternium-8, Polyquaternium-7, Cetrimonium Chloride, C11-15 Pareth-7, C12-16 Pareth-9, Behentrimonium Chloride, Dipropylene Glycol, Trideceth-12, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid, Methylchloroisothiazolinone, Methylisothiazolinone, Limonene, Linalool, Lilial, Fragrance/Parfum

The shampoo comes out creamy white. There is a lot of lather while applying. With the silicone Quaternium, you expect your hair will finish up being soft, and it is. (This company also sells an "anti-residue" shampoo for when your hair suffers from shampoo product build-up...they call it a "detoxifying shampoo." Maybe someday they can come up with a shampoo with all the above ingredients which includes something to prevent hair shampoo residue build-up. And where you do not have to buy an anti-reside shampoo to restore the main shampoo you use to its original effectiveness.)

title: Be Forewarned. This shampoo has Ammonium L. Sulfates and other ingredients not listed in the product description.
text:
I feel strongly that Amazon should require products' full ingredients list be made available to buyers before buying. But if you do not agree, hopefully you will agree that Amazon should require those sellers who do list the ingredients to be forthcoming and either list all of them, or advise people they are only listing some of them.

As of this review posting, the ingredients list for this shampoo here at Amazon is very misleading. They should require notice that only some of the ingredients are listed, and not all. Someone might look at the ingredients posted and think this is a great shampoo with just few natural ingredients. This is so not the case.

This shampoo has sulfates. This is the full ingredients list, from the actual box itself:

Ingredients: Water, Ammonium Laureth Sulfate, Ammonium Lauryl Sulfate, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Lauramide MEA, Lauryl Glucoside, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Silk Amino Acids, Camillia Sinensis Leaf Juice, Lavender Flower/Leaf Stem Extract, Anthemis Nobilis Flower Extract, Rosemary Leaf Extract, Tea Tree Flower/Leaf Stem Extract, Oat Meal Extract, Willow Bark Extract, Hydrolized Wheat Protein, Peppermint Leaf Extract, Sodium Chloride, Phenoxyethanol, Caprylyl Glycol, Sorbic Acid, Citric Acid, Benzyl Salicylate, Geraniol, Limonene, Linalool, Hexyl Cinnamal.

Ammonium L. Sulfates (either of them) are reported on some sites as possible negative ingredients. I myself have no idea if this is true. I just find it unfortunate that the seller on Amazon chose to leave out the fact the shampoo has sulfates, and leave out the full ingredients list...so potential buyers can make an informed decision for themselves in advance.

I have purchased this shampoo and I can tell you in my opinion it is a very nice shampoo. It is a competent shampoo. Hair is clean. Hair is soft. Feels good. I love the pump dispenser bottle. The shampoo lathers up a lot. I like that it is not perfumed at all. I recommend trying this shampoo if none of the ingredients listed are a negative to you.

title: Warning: Misleading Labeling (There is no silk whatsoever), and the shampoo is highly overpriced
text:
Quite overpriced when you see the ingredients. Also shamefully extremely misleading as there is no silk at all in this shampoo called "Supersilk." Right above the name they put a logo that says "Brocato Nano Silk Complex," which implies there will be nano silk complex in this shampoo. But again, there is not.

The second ingredient is Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate: "Can be derived from coconut. Used primarily as a detergent cleansing agent, but is potentially drying and irritating for skin and is also tricky to formulate with due to stability issues, though it does produce copious foam."

If you look at all the ingredients you will see there is nothing special, and all are really cheap, and can be found in much cheaper so-called detoxifying shampoo.

But again my biggest complaint is there is no silk whatsoever in this Supersilk shampoo with the Brocato Nano Silk Complex words written right there on the front of the bottle. They should be required to warn people that this product contains zero silk.

Full Ingredients List:

Water, Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Sodium Chloride, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, PPG-2 Hydroxyethyl Cocamide, PEG-40, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Tetrasodium EDTA, Citric Acid, Methylchloroisothiazolinone, Methylisothiazolinone, Limonene, Linalool, Lilial, Fragrance.

(According to Wikipedia, "Lilial (lily aldehyde) is a chemical compound which is used in cosmetic preparations i.e. skin care lotions [for external use only]. It can sometimes act as an allergen and may cause contact dermatitis in susceptible individuals.")

title: At $13 Per Bottle I Want To Believe Their Bold Claims
text:
Update in 2014: As I am sure most of you have seen, the company has dropped the word "Toothpaste" from their redesigned "New Look" bottles. This product is no longer subtitled (or referred to as) "Toothpaste + Mouthwash." I am glad they have done this.

Original Review:

Essential Oxygen calls this product "Brushing Rinse Toothpaste + Mouthwash." But it absolutely is not toothpaste. It is 100% watery-like liquid. You pour 1/3 of an ounce of the liquid into your mouth and are supposed to start brushing immediately.

What this is is 1% Food-Grade Hydrogen Peroxide. The company claims that this 1% Peroxide will whiten your teeth, fight gingivitis and plaque, decrease tooth sensitivity, fight bad breath, fight canker sores, fight tartar, and give you healthier gums.

Wow! Amazing claims. (And right there on the bottle, they say "It Works.")

So, are we to assume that 1% Hydrogen Peroxide is a miracle for our teeth and mouth? If 1% Hydrogen Peroxide can really do all that stuff, why isn't the ADA and every dentist pushing it? Why doesn't Colgate and Crest go out of business? (Or at the least, market their own 1% Hydrogen Peroxide as "toothpaste" the way Essential Oxygen is doing?)

Essential Oxygen does write on the label: "These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease."

So, I ask you: Do we believe their incredible claims of what this product can do?

And if 1% Food-Grade Hydrogen Peroxide can really do all that stuff, where has it been all my life?

A 16-ounce bottle will last you 48 teeth brushings, assuming you use exactly 1/3 ounce each time. If you brush twice a day, like most people do, you will have to buy a new $13 bottle approx. every 3 weeks. (I guess you could simply buy your own very inexpensive 1% Food-Grade Hydrogen Peroxide, if money is tight.)

There are other ingredients in the bottle: purified water, organic aloe vera, organic essential oils of peppermint, rosemary, eucalyptus, lemon, clove, and cinnamon. (I have no idea if any of these ingredients do anything except add flavor and/or texture.)

The taste is fine to me. Mild. Non-stinging. The peroxide fizzes/bubbles as you'd expect.

You are supposed to shake the bottle before use. Even with the lid tight, some liquid leaks from the top. (That just could mean I got a defective bottle.)

When I am done brushing, my teeth do not feel as clean as when I am done using "real toothpaste" (but maybe they are...and maybe I just do not have the confidence they are).

I am giving this product 3 stars (meaning "It's OK") because I feel they are doing a disservice--and are certainly being misleading--by calling it "Toothpaste" right there on the bottle. It is not toothpaste. Why not call it "Tooth Cleaner"? "Tooth Liquid"? It is not paste. Yeah, it could be called "Brushing Rinse Teeth Cleaner + Mouthwash."

I would love to see clinical studies that prove hydrogen peroxide stops teeth sensitivity (I am sure Sensodyne would be interested to see that too.) Same goes with studies proving hydrogen peroxide prevents tartar build-up.

After using the product for 2 weeks, I have not noticed any remarkable results.

I would love for all of their claims about this product to be true. I would love for it to whiten my teeth, prevent plaque and tartar, keep my gums healthy, and decrease teeth sensitivity to cold.

title: Good Shower Gel That Will Frustrate You With Its Repeatedly Clogging Cap
text:
The cap that will always clog up to the point you can no longer pour out the product.

Come on! Do the owners of the company that makes this product actually use it?

$9 and up for this soap, and yet they cannot find a way to have it dispensed without the cap getting clogged to the point it becomes useless?

Oh sure. They and others are gonna say, just twist off the cap and run it under very hot water until the clog is cleared. (The cap's just gonna get clogged again fairly soon. And even under hot water, the clog is very difficult to clear.)

Or, why not just twist off the cap entirely and pour the soap out when you want to use it instead of cleaning the cap itself? (Because it is harder to control how much comes out that way.)

I have used many other extremely cheaper liquid soaps where their caps did not get clogged.

How about changing your cap style so it doesn't get clogged?

So again, awful cap that will repeatedly get clogged by the product, frustrating you and making you wonder how they can charge so much for this soap and use a piece-of-crap cap that clogs.

Product itself is an effective shower gel, but I cannot recommend it until they solve the cap-clogging issue.

title: The Perfect Shaver If You Want Lots Of Hair To Remain On Your Face
text:
With increasing frequency, these electric shaver companies release a new product, coming up with increasingly enticing words that turn out to be more hype than substance.

But, we read these "words of hope" and gamble the money, only to be let down, just like I was with this shaver. I am sure you have read the sales pitch: "Sensotouch 3D." "Combining gyroflex 3d, ultratrack heads and skinglide...." My gosh, I read "skinglide" and start to believe there can be no skin irritation with a shaver that has "skinglide."

They wrote this shaver has holes to catch the shortest stubble. Well, perhaps those holes are blocked since my shaver left so much stubble, and so much longer hair for that matter that I would give this shaver a total fail when keeping in context all that crap they wrote to sell this. I realize they will exaggerate to sell shavers, but this level of exaggeration is unacceptable.

There is absolutely nothing extra special about this shaver. This shaver does exactly what every other shaver before it does. And not as good, in my opinion. So much hair is left on my face, I would only use this if I wanted the short stubble look. And yes, even with shave gel I still felt skin irritation. Lots of irritation.

Please know that while Amazon only began selling it today, the shaver has been available from other sources since mid August. I have tried to stay with this shaver hoping things would improve, but they have not.

I bought this item mainly as a beard trimmer and neck cleaner-upper, so it will work fine for me. It's solid, well-built and feels as if it will last forever; no more batteries or dust- and hair-collecting chargers. I'm glad I won't be using it for extended periods, however, because the noise and the vibration would be very annoying for the cutter and for whomever it's used for a full haircut. If you're accustomed to a battery-charged trimmer, you'll have some work to do to get accustomed to working around an electrical cord, especially with out-maneuvering the cord to position the cutter just so to get the exact results you're wanting. The manufacturer also advises you apply machine oil to the blades before, during, and after any extended use.

So...four stars for the quality and price, three stars because of the noise and vibration. If you're older than fifty, it will remind you of the old-fashioned barbers' clippers: wicked effective hair cutting that sounds like a fan jet parking on your shoulder.

title: Yes, it works... BUT....
text:
Does it work.. absolutely, BUT, IF you watched the commercial for it, it is a bit misleading. It shows someone using just like any other shampoo. Got news for you, if you use JUST LIKE any other shampoo (with your fingers rubbing in your hair as it shows in the commercial), your fingernails are going to slowly turn black.

To use, you put it in your PALM and then carefully massage it into your hair using ONLY your palms, KEEP IT AWAY FROM YOUR FINGERNAILS! IF you manage to get some on your fingernails, it ain't washing off that easy. You will have darker fingernails for several days. Even after using this for about 2 months now, every once in a while a small amount will drip on a nail (like this morning) and now I have one nail that is slightly darker than the others.

The Pros:

It works pretty quick, considering. Grey was nearly gone in about 1 week. Once you get to that point, you can use it everyone other shower or even skip 3-4 days.

It's much easier to use than other dyes, which seem to wash out within a day or two

It looks really natural. Some people noticed SOMETHING different about my hair (did you get a haircut?), but no one noticed the grey was gone.

The Cons:

You can't REALLY use it like you would any shampoo.. you have to be very mindful of how you apply it and where it touches, b/c it is a strong dye.

Anything your wet hair touches will turn black over time.

The Puffs Ultra facial tissues are the best tissues I have run into, definitely heavier than the other Puffs or Kleenex or other variants.  They are also reasonably soft.  Not scented.  Weight is pretty heavy as these things go.  And if you forget to take the tissue out of your pocket when washing a garment, these have an above average chance of staying together, not shredding in the clothes washer.  So these are not cheap, and there is not a whole lot per box (P&G keeps reducing the count there, assuming that we won't notice it as a price increase, but...), but they are the best generally available tissues.

title: what a wonderful shaving experience
text:
I received this razor about a week ago and have shaved with it twice now.
I'm an older man and remember well the single edged and these double edged razors from long ago.
When the plastic disposable razors were introduced they were all the rage and we all had to get modern and buy them. They were very inexpensive back then and they completely took over the shaving manufacturing and marketing industry.
When I first used this steel razor I thought for sure I was going to cut and nick myself.
Wrong, didn't.. Amazingly my hand remembered how to slide the blade across the skin with just the right pressure and angle. I hadn't used a DE steel razor since about 1973.
My goodness, what a wonderful shaving experience. The results are clean and smooth skin.
I also received a pack of 100 double edged razor blades and I think I should get many shaves from each one. This 100 pack of razors should last me two years at least.
After all those years of using the new plastic disposable razors, I'm right back to the technology of my youth.
This Steel Weishi razor is beautiful old school high tech.

text:
I cannot put into words how much I love this stuff. I’m definitely not someone who
wears makeup very often. I’m a SAHM and only wear makeup, of any kind, once or twice a week. Idk why but over the last few years mascara has been so annoying for me. Every time I wore it I would notice dark smudges under my eyes. I’ve tried a handful of different brands thinking it would help, but it never did. I never had this problem before, and have no idea what’s different now, but mascara apparently hates my lashes and will do anything to jump ship onto my skin. I’m so glad I came across this primer during one of my late night online shopping binges. I figured: for the price, it’s worth a shot. BEST. DECISION. EVER.

When I first opened it I was a little bummed. I assumed it would be clear and planned to use it sometimes by itself without mascara. I’m glad I’m horrible about reading product descriptions because if I knew it was white, I don’t think I would have bought it. I’ve only used it 2-3 times now, but holy cow!! My lashes have never looked so good in all my life. It really does make my lashes look longer and separates them so they don’t get all clumpy. The best part is that it holds on tight to the mascara, and won’t let it run away to the skin around my eyes. Once I even fell asleep without removing my makeup and my eyes looked just as good as the night before.

I’m sure there are a million brands of mascara primer in every price range. I can’t compare this to a more expensive product, but I can say there’s no reason to look any further. Buy this and you won’t regret it.

I wanted my family to keep hand sanitizer with them at all times to keep everyone safe and healthy but it was a constant struggle to keep track of all the little bottles we kept losing.
Let’s face it, if you have to dig through your purse to find the bottle of sanitizer, you’ve already touched everything and probably left behind the virus!
This set of refillable bottles with the handy carbide clip was just what my family needed to stay virus free.
It’s easy to clip on the outside of my purse or on the loop of your jeans. It can be clipped just about any place in your vehicle so it’s not lost when you need to use it.
I purchased the sanitizer at the same time and I filled up all of the refillable bottles, placed the handy clips on the opening to the bottles and passed them out to my family members, with extras to store in the glove box and a few for my friends.
So far after several months they are still holding up well and no leaks, the caps fit well and they even sent a few extra caps with the set. I would purchase this set again and I also like the handy little funnel that was included, I’ve used it for a few things in my kitchen.
A great buy, especially since it’s refillable.

They last all day and don't move around or peeloff on their own. Even knowing I have them on, I can't see them... so I'm confident no one else can either.

The tapes come in 4 individually sealed packages. The packaging on the 4 sets of tapes is very high quality and super cute, even if the English isn't perfect. In each of the 4 packages is a slide-lock bag, and in that bag is another cello-bag in which the sheets with the tapes are in. I like this a lot, because you can divide each package into 3 seperate holders without ever having loose sheets -- I put one in my purse, one in my makeup bag, and keep one in the medicin cabinet. Each package also comes with its own little Y tool, meaning you get 4 Y tools. The whole set comes with plastic tweezers (1) and instructions.

Very happy with these, will buy again.

EDIT: A few days after I started wearing these, I saw a good friend I hadn't seen in a while. Almost immediately after meeting up, she said "wow, you look really good today! I don't know what it is, but you look really good." She's not the kind of person to just say that "just because". The only thing different was the eye tapes, and while I don't know for sure that's what it was, I'LL TAKE IT! If that's not the best endorsement you can get, I don't know what is. (!)

I figured I'd try it but didn't expect much since most of the aforementioned wowee-zowy miracle buzzword products (which this isn't) give me underwhelming results. But I've been really surprised what a difference this product makes! And the smell is really nice.

I have break-out prone skin and I've had no breakouts since using this product and if anything my skins been much easier to deal with. I don't know if that has anything to do with using this or not, but at the very least I can say it's definitely not breaking me out or anything. But because of my skin I usually have to put my foundation on thick and also try to camouflage some decent-sized areas of my face since my breakouts tend to cluster. Anyone in the same boat knows that it's really hard to do without creating a patchy uneven look and a heavy coating that looks nothing like tge texture of skin. I feel like this spray does a great job of adding a more natural finish to my makeup as well as smoothing out/blending in/hiding the areas which before definitely looked like I was trying to hide something. I'll definitely keep using this product. Plus it's nice to find something effective that's going to last a long time and which I don't have to save up for to afford.

title: Not sure what makes it special
text:
I used this mirror for the first time today. I just can't see what makes it special; it is essentially an overpriced, regular mirror with a hole drilled near the top so you can hang it. I guess at the end of the day it's only a few bucks, so even if it's 'overpriced' for what it is, it's no big loss. But it doesn't seem to have any special anti-fog coating on it--mine started fogging up halfway through the shower even though I had held it under the water first to 'warm it up' as the instructions directed. Guess I didn't hold it under long enough, or maybe you have to 're heat' it if taking a longer shower.

So yeah, you could make this yourself buying a small mirror and drilling a hole near the top; I guess the benefit of buying it pre-made as most people wouldn't be willing to go through that effort or would worry about chipping the glass. So I only give it 3 stars because of the value for the money. If you run it under water frequently enough, I'm sure it does exactly what it's designed to do, so it's not necessarily a bad product.
